title_en: Improved induction heating circuit, protection circuit and cooling system for an appliance
abstract_en: An induction heating circuit for an appliance, the induction heating circuit comprising: an AC power supply with an AC monitoring output connected to the active line of the AC power supply, the AC monitoring output providing an indication of current being drawn from the AC power supply; a control circuit comprising at least one processor and a semiconductor current sensor, the semiconductor current sensor arranged to i) detect the current being drawn from the AC power supply and ii) output an output voltage based on the detected current; and an induction driving circuit for driving an inductor of the appliance comprising a semiconductor switch, wherein the semiconductor switch is controlled by the processor based on, at least, the output voltage.

title_en: Household cooking hob
abstract_en: The invention relates to a household cooking hob, particularly to an induction heating hob comprising a cooking surface (2) and a heating power transferring element, particularly an inductor or induction coil (3) preferably provided below the cooking surface (2), wherein at least two sensor elements (4) are distributed in an area covered by the heating power transferring element (3), the sensor elements (4) being configured to gather information regarding the temperature of a piece of cookware placed on the cooking surface (2), wherein an electrical circuit (5) is provided which comprises switching means (5.1) for providing a selective electrical coupling of one of said sensor elements (4) with a control entity (6).

title_en: Four-device-in-one multi-function bungalow
abstract_en:
A four-device-in-one skybox dehydrator sauna wind-redirecting bungalow 
comprises: adjustable louver blades , solar-rechargeable batteries installed within 
adjustable louver blades, a solar panel mounted to adjustable louver blades, panel frames, 
panel inserts inserted within the panel frames for enabling the bungalow to become a sauna 
and a skybox and a dehydrator, louver braces inserted within the panel frames for allowing 
the louvers to be rotated, flipped, and positioned to redirect wind direction, axis pins 
inserted within the louver braces for providing eight locking points, louvers attached to the 
louver braces to create a sauna and a skybox and a dehydrator, an extending-and-retracting 
door for providing insulation from cold temperatures and security within bungalow, drain 
openings formed into the corner-posts, corner-post base-plates, tube-screws for leveling 
bungalow when installed on an uneven ground surface and providing adjustment points for 
each of the corner-post base-plates, and anchoring bolts screwed through the tube-screws 
for securing the corner-post base-plates to a ground surface.

title_en: Stator and rotor design for periodic torque requirements
abstract_en:
Disclosed is a method, comprising: arranging one or more magnets of a rotor of an axial 
flux motor or generator non-uniformly about an axis of rotation of the rotor; and 
arranging one or more magnetic flux producing windings of a stator of the axial flux 
motor or generator non-uniformly about the axis of rotation.

title_en: Device and method for handling cross arms
abstract_en: The present application relates to a device configured for supporting a cross arm of an electricity pole during its removal from and/or attachment to the pole during maintenance from a mobile elevation vehicle. The device comprises: a first portion adapted to receive and support a cross arm of an electricity pole on an edge of a wall of an insulated bucket or bucket liner of the mobile elevation vehicle; a retainer for releasably securing and retaining the cross arm adjacent to and supported on the first portion, and a second portion, integral with the first portion, for maintaining the device in association with and supported on the insulated bucket or bucket liner of the mobile elevation vehicle as the bucket of the vehicle is raised and lowered during maintenance. The application also relates to a method of handling a cross arm of this type using the above device. (Fig. 1)

title_en: Circuit breaker forensics for power distribution units
abstract_en: Disclosed are power distribution systems and methods in which a power distribution unit (PDU) is provided with an overcurrent protection device and per-outlet current sensing at each of the multiple electrical outlets of the PDU. The described embodiments enable the identification of the electronic device connected to a specific outlet or electronic device that may have caused the overcurrent protection device to trip. The methods of outlet identification in a PDU having multiple electrical outlets includes detecting whether either a peak current or a half-cycle root mean square (RMS) current at each outlet has exceeded a selected threshold prior to the occurrence of the trip event associated with the overcurrent protection device.

title_en: Charge demand controller device
abstract_en: A charge demand controller device for electric vehicles or the like, preferably for installation with an existing residential electrical control panel, connects between a main switch and the electrical control panel made to operate at a maximum amperage value. The device includes a controller unit that constantly monitors an actual total load current at the input line connector from the main switch, and selectively operates a load switch controlling an electric vehicle supply equipment (EVSE) upon the actual total load current being above or below a trip value being a predetermined safety ratio of the maximum amperage value.

title_en: Composite polymer electrolyte membrane, and membrane electrode assembly and solid polymer fuel cell using same
abstract_en: Provided are: a composite polymer electrolytic membrane that has excellent proton conductivity even under low-humidification and low-temperature conditions, a small dimensional change rate, and excellent mechanical strength and chemical stability, and that is capable of achieving a high output and excellent physical durability when being used in a solid polymer fuel cell; and a membrane electrode composite and a solid polymer fuel cell using the composite polymer electrolytic membrane. This composite polymer electrolytic membrane has a composite layer formed by combining a polyazole-containing nanofiber unwoven fabric (A) and an ionic-group-containing polymer electrolyte (B), and is characterized in that the polyazole-containing nanofiber unwoven fabric (A) is basic.

title_en: Method of controlling a multivalent energy supply system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for controlling a multivalent energy supply installation. The multivalent energy supply installation comprises at least two energy generators which use at least two different energy carriers in order to provide energy in the form of heat and/or cold and/or electric energy. The energy supply installation comprises a regulating device for each energy generator in order to regulate regulating variables of the energy generator and a controller for controlling the regulating devices in a coordinated manner. The controller detects at least one energy supply request for at least one respective energy form of heat and/or cold and/or electric energy and determines a division of the energy generators into groups according to a specific property of the energy generators. Precisely one group is assigned to each generator for each energy form provided by the energy generator. For each energy generator, the controller determines target values for satisfying the at least one energy supply request on the basis of the division of the energy generators into groups and outputs the target values to the regulating devices.

title_en: Portable dual-device charger system
abstract_en: A portable charger system provides two charger ports with different charging characteristics. Two devices having different charging characteristics may be coupled to the two charger ports to be charged simultaneously.

title_en: Camera system and method for monitoring an installation, in particular switchgear
abstract_en: A camera system for monitoring an installation, in particular switchgear, has at least one camera, a display device, a switchover device and a power supply which, in an active state, supplies the camera with power via the switchover device. The switchover device is configured to transmit an image signal from the camera automatically to either the display device or to an interface to which a computer can be connected. There is also described a method for monitoring an installation, in particular switchgear, by way of the camera system.

title_en: Ground fault protection circuit and techniques
abstract_en: A fault protection arrangement. The fault protection arrangement may include a neutral grounding resistor including a first non-ground end, connected to a neutralizing point, and a second non-ground end. The fault protection arrangement may include a neutral grounding resistance monitor assembly, directly coupled to the second non-ground end of the neutral grounding resistor. The neutral grounding resistance monitor assembly may include comprising a signal source coupled to the neutralizing-point; a first current sense circuit coupled between the signal source and the neutralizing-point; a first voltage sense circuit coupled between the signal source and the neutralizing-point; a second current sense circuit, comprising a current sensor, coupled between the second non-ground end of the neutral grounding resistor and a protective earth connection.

title_en: Thermally stabilised conductive polymer coatings
abstract_en: The present disclosure generally relates to coatings and compositions comprising conductive polymers. The present disclosure also relates to thermally stable coatings and compositions comprising solution processable polyaniline conducting polymers and thermal stability agents, and to processes for preparing the coatings and compositions.

title_en: New anode material in lithium and sodium batteries
abstract_en: The invention pertains to the use of porous, chemically interconnected, carbon nanofibres-comprising carbon networks as electrochemically active material in the anode of lithium or sodium batteries. It has been found that said carbon nanofibres-comprising carbon networks can beneficially be used in the anode of lithium or sodium batteries when added in an amount of 10 - 100 wt%. The benefits include a high capacity, high lifetime (stability over extended cycling), high charge and discharge rate and being resilient during manufacture and use. The porous, chemically interconnected, carbon nanofibres-comprising carbon networks can be used in the anode of lithium or sodium batteries of many areas of technology, such as smartphones, laptops and electric and hybrid vehicles.

title_en: Device and method for monitoring and inhibiting potential induced attenuation effect for photovoltaic power station
abstract_en: The invention provides a device for monitoring and inhibiting potential induced attenuation effect for a photovoltaic power station, wherein the photovoltaic power station comprises a photovoltaic group string and a battery module, and the device comprises: the charging control module is used for controlling the photovoltaic group string to charge the battery module; the discharging control module is used for controlling the battery module to apply reverse voltage to the photovoltaic string when potential induced attenuation PID effect occurs; the data acquisition module is used for acquiring voltage data of the photovoltaic string and electric quantity conditions of the battery module; the clock module is used for collecting the current time of the system; and the control operation processing module is used for analyzing and processing according to the data acquired by the data acquisition module and the clock module, so as to control the start and stop of the charge control module and the discharge control module. The invention also provides a method for monitoring and inhibiting the potential induced attenuation effect for the photovoltaic power station. The invention has simple structure, small volume and low cost, and can effectively monitor and inhibit the PID effect of the photovoltaic power station.

title_en: Bus monitor connection structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bus monitor connecting structure, comprising: monitor and connecting wire, wherein: the monitor is provided with a wiring port, and the outer wall of the monitor is provided with a connecting part; the connecting wire comprises a terminal and a lead; the terminal comprises a plug part and a wiring part; the wiring part comprises a shell and a conducting strip; the insertion part comprises a conductor and an insulator arranged on the periphery of the conductor. The monitor comprises a monitor body, a monitor terminal and a connecting line, wherein the monitor body is provided with a monitor port, the monitor terminal is provided with a connecting part, the connecting part is arranged on the outer wall of the monitor, the connecting terminal of the connecting line is structurally arranged to comprise a plugging part and a wiring part, and the plugging part and the wiring part are respectively structurally arranged, so that when the connecting line is connected with the monitor, the wiring part connected with a lead is fixedly connected with the monitor, and a conductor inserted into the wiring port is movably connected with the lead, so that the connection between the connecting line and the monitor is firm and reliable, and simultaneously, the conditions of shaking and falling off of the connecting line, plugging looseness and poor contact of the monitor in a long-term vibration working environment can be effectively avoided.

title_en: Negative electrode for lithium ion secondary battery and lithium ion secondary battery
abstract_en: The present invention provides a negative electrode for a lithium ion secondary battery, comprising a negative electrode active material, a fine graphite material, a conductive auxiliary agent, and a binder, wherein the content of the fine graphite material is in a range of an equivalent amount to 10 times (mass ratio) the conductive auxiliary agent, and the average particle diameter (median diameter D) of the fine graphite material 50 ) Smaller than the average particle diameter of the negative electrode active material, and in the range of 1 to 15 μm.

title_en: Automatic assembling and on-line detecting equipment for universal automobile negative electrode battery bolt
abstract_en: The invention discloses a general automatic assembly and online detection device for a negative electrode battery bolt of an automobile, wherein a carrier conveying mechanism can enable a carrier to sequentially pass through working areas of a stud automatic feeding device, a main body automatic grabbing manipulator, a gasket automatic feeding device, a nut automatic feeding torsion device, a riveting device and a finished product discharging mechanism, a control system controls the devices to sequentially realize the positioning of the stud on the carrier, the sleeving of a body on the stud, the sleeving of a gasket on the stud, the screw connection of a nut and the stud for a specified number of turns, the riveting of the end part of the stud nut, and the discharging of a finished product into a finished product storage device.

title_en: Double-inverse star half-wave in-phase anti-parallel rectifier transformer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a double-inverse star half-wave in-phase anti-parallel rectifier transformer, wherein an a1 vertical copper bar and an a5 vertical copper bar are arranged vertically oppositely, an x2 vertical copper bar and an x6 vertical copper bar are arranged vertically oppositely, an a3 vertical copper bar and an a7 vertical copper bar are arranged vertically oppositely, and an x4 vertical copper bar and an x8 vertical copper bar are arranged vertically oppositely. The b1 vertical copper bar and the b5 vertical copper bar are arranged vertically oppositely, the y2 vertical copper bar and the y6 vertical copper bar are arranged vertically oppositely, the b3 vertical copper bar and the b7 vertical copper bar are arranged vertically oppositely, and the y4 vertical copper bar and the y8 vertical copper bar are arranged vertically oppositely. The c1 vertical copper bar and the c5 vertical copper bar are arranged vertically oppositely, the z2 vertical copper bar and the z6 vertical copper bar are arranged vertically oppositely, the c3 vertical copper bar and the c7 vertical copper bar are arranged vertically oppositely, and the z4 vertical copper bar and the z8 vertical copper bar are arranged vertically oppositely. The invention can be applied to a transformer for realizing a current of 40kA or more.

title_en: Negative electrode for nonaqueous secondary battery and nonaqueous secondary battery using the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a negative electrode for a secondary battery, which is formed by extruding a mixed composition comprising: calculated by the weight ratio of A to B of 90: 10-99: 1, in terms of 2kN/cm 2 The extruded pellets had a density of 1.50g/cm 3 Amorphous carbon-coated graphite active material A having a density of 1.65 g/cm when subjected to extrusion granulation under the same conditions 3 The carbon-based active material B having the above density serves as an anode active material, thereby suppressing cracking of the amorphous carbon-coated graphite and improving the high-temperature life characteristics.

title_en: Charging base and robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a charging base and a robot, wherein the charging base comprises: the charging switch circuit is also coupled with a power supply; the induction circuit is used for triggering the charge switch circuit to be conducted when external equipment is induced, and the power supply outputs charging voltage to the charging contact piece; when no external equipment is sensed, the charging switch circuit is turned off, and the power supply does not output charging voltage to the charging contact. Through the mode, the safety of the robot charging base in use can be improved.

title_en: Square mounting plate static electricity removing device for LED lamp
abstract_en: The invention discloses a square mounting plate static electricity removing device for an LED lamp, which comprises: the device comprises an installation fixed block, a sliding guide cross rod, a conveying clamping plate and a plurality of conveying rotating wheels, wherein the sliding guide cross rod is installed on the installation fixed block, the conveying clamping plate is installed on the sliding guide cross rod, and the conveying rotating wheels are arranged in a straight line and are rotatably installed on the conveying clamping plate. The transmission rotating wheel is provided with a static removing rod, and the static removing rod is arranged on the transmission rotating wheel in a penetrating way. The installation fixed block is provided with a connecting elastic block, and the connecting elastic block is arranged between the sliding guide cross rod and the installation fixed block. According to the square mounting plate static-removing device for the LED lamp, the mounting fixed block, the sliding guide cross rod, the conveying clamping plate and the conveying rotating wheels are arranged, so that static-removing operation on the square plate of the LED lamp is completed, the working efficiency is effectively improved, the structure is simple and compact, and the use and the operation are convenient.

title_en: DC operation power supply monitoring and charging device for vehicle-mounted generator set
abstract_en: The invention discloses a direct current operation power supply monitoring and charging device of a vehicle-mounted generator set, which comprises a monitoring part and a charging part, wherein the monitoring part comprises a communication board, an upper computer, a communication manager, N batteries, N/2 battery detection modules, a communication connecting wire, a Hall type current sensor, N temperature sensors, a battery connecting wire and a copper bar, the charging part comprises a DC-DC conversion circuit unit, a constant voltage control circuit unit, an overvoltage protection circuit unit and a third optocoupler, and the monitoring part processes and displays parameters such as voltage, current and temperature of the batteries and controls the charging part to charge and de-charge the batteries under the conditions of undervoltage, overvoltage and overheat.

title_en: Controller, switch control method and applicable LED driving system
abstract_en: The application provides a controller, a switch control method and an LED driving system suitable for the controller. Wherein the controller is used for connecting a switching device, the switching device is used for controlling the input source to supply power to the load, the controller includes: a detection unit for detecting and generating a first detection signal reflecting the load side power supply; and the control unit is connected with the detection unit and is used for controlling the time interval for switching the connected switching device from the off state to the on state based on the first detection signal, wherein the time interval is related to the load determined by detecting the detection signal. The LED driving system and the LED driving method thereof improve the efficiency of configuring the LED driving system with multiple mode switching for dynamic LED loads.

title_en: Multilayer ceramic electronic component
abstract_en: The invention provides a laminated ceramic electronic component capable of ensuring reliability even if the thickness of an external electrode is reduced along with miniaturization. A multilayer ceramic electronic component has a multilayer part and an external electrode. The laminated part has an end face facing a first direction, a side face facing a second direction perpendicular to the first direction, a ridge part, a plurality of ceramic layers, and an internal electrode. The thickness of the external electrode at the position adjacent to the ridge part on the side surface and in the second direction is A, the thickness of the external electrode at the position adjacent to the ridge part on the end surface and in the first direction is B, and the length of the electronic component in the first direction is L and the length of the electronic component in the second direction is T, the relations of A/L ≥ 0.0142 × ln (L) +0.0256, A/T ≥ 0.0274 × ln (T) +0.0719, B/L ≥ 0.0103 × ln (L) +0.0281, B/T ≥ 0.0189 × ln (T) +0.0707 are satisfied.

title_en: Cable for nuclear magnetic resonance instrument
abstract_en: A cable for nuclear magnetic resonance equipment belongs to the technical field of special electric wires and cables for medical equipment. Including cable core and the interior weaving layer, outer weaving layer, isolation layer and the restrictive coating that set gradually outside the cable core, the cable core includes shielding layer, control line and power cord, and control line and power cord are located the shielding layer, interior weaving layer be located outside the shielding layer, this interior weaving layer is woven by tinned copper wire and is constituted, outer weaving layer weave by tinned copper wire equally and constitute, the isolation layer be the spacer paper, the restrictive coating be polyurethane and extrude through the armature mode and cover outside the spacer layer. The cable has good high dielectric capacity, can reduce the outer diameter of the cable core, and can ensure the stability of dielectric constant and good signal transmission capacity; the fabric is soft and simultaneously has excellent electromagnetic interference resistance; has high strength, large elastic modulus, excellent low temperature resistance, alcohol resistance, chemical corrosion resistance such as ETO and the like, and ideal ultraviolet radiation resistance.

title_en: Manufacturing method of CF card holder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CF card holder and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the CF card holder comprises a rubber core, long terminal pins and short terminal pins, wherein the rubber core is provided with an upper terminal hole, a lower terminal hole, shallow grooves and deep grooves, the number of the long terminal pins and the number of the short terminal pins are the same as that of the long terminal pins, the number of the lower terminal holes and the number of the deep grooves are the same as that of the short terminal pins, each long terminal pin is provided with a long terminal head and a long terminal tail, each short terminal pin is provided with a short terminal head and a short terminal tail, all long terminal heads penetrate through the upper terminal holes in a one-to-one correspondence manner, all short terminal heads penetrate through the lower terminal holes in a one-to-one correspondence manner, all long terminal tails penetrate through the shallow grooves in a one-to-one correspondence manner, the shallow grooves and the deep grooves are staggered, all long terminal tails and the short terminal tails are in the same horizontal height and are in the same as that of the short terminal heads are in the same horizontal height and in the same as that of the short terminal heads are in the same horizontal height and in the same horizontal height.

title_en: Lithium ion battery cathode material synthesized by low-temperature heating of polyhydric alcohol and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lithium ion battery cathode material synthesized by heating polyhydric alcohol at low temperature. The material is prepared by the following method, comprising the following steps: dissolving antimony trichloride in triethylene glycol to obtain a mixed solution A; adding selenium powder into a mixed solution of monoethanolamine and thioglycollic acid to obtain a selenium precursor solution; then mixing the selenium precursor solution, polyvinylpyrrolidone and triethylene glycol to obtain a mixed solution B; and finally, pouring the mixed solution A into a container containing the mixed solution B, stirring, placing the mixed solution A into a condenser, heating to 175-185 ℃ in a nitrogen atmosphere, reacting for 15-25 min, cooling to room temperature, and washing to obtain antimony selenide nanorods, namely the lithium ion battery cathode material.

title_en: Road surface dust suppression system for hydrogen fuel cell automobile and hydrogen fuel cell automobile
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pavement dust suppression system for a hydrogen fuel cell automobile and the hydrogen fuel cell automobile, wherein the pavement dust suppression system comprises a gas-liquid separation system, a liquid collection system, a liquid pressurization system and a liquid spraying system, wherein the gas-liquid separation system is used for separating gas and liquid generated by a fuel cell stack of the hydrogen fuel cell automobile and conveying the separated liquid to the liquid collection system, the liquid collection system is used for collecting the liquid and conveying the liquid to the liquid pressurization system, the liquid pressurization system is used for pressurizing the liquid and conveying the liquid to the liquid spraying system, and the liquid spraying system is used for spraying the liquid. The pavement dust suppression system for the hydrogen fuel cell automobile has the advantages of simple structure and easiness in implementation, and can suppress dust pollution generated by the operation of the hydrogen fuel cell automobile on a road on the premise of not violating the structural standard of the automobile and related regulations.

title_en: Electric actuating mechanism and continuous variable lift power system
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the field of power systems, and discloses an electric actuating mechanism and a continuous variable lift power system, wherein the electric actuating mechanism comprises a motor and an actuating mechanism, the motor comprises a motor main body, an end cover, an output shaft and a first sealing element, the actuating mechanism comprises a shell and a worm wheel arranged in the shell, one end of the end cover is connected with the motor main body, the other end of the end cover is connected with the shell, one end of the output shaft penetrates through the motor main body, the other end of the output shaft penetrates through the end cover and extends into the shell, a worm matched with the worm wheel is arranged at the end, extending into the shell, of the output shaft, a first concave cavity is formed at the end, opposite to the motor main body, of the end cover, the first sealing element is arranged in the first concave cavity, and the first sealing element is provided with a sealing surface tightly attached to the outer side wall of the output shaft. The electric actuating mechanism and the continuous variable lift power system provided by the invention have the advantages of simple and compact structure and high sealing reliability.

title_en: Waterproof positive and negative plug USB socket and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The utility model provides a waterproof positive and negative USB socket that inserts, includes insulating housing that is equipped with the cavity, integrated into one piece in the interior blocking piece of cavity of insulating housing, cover locate in the interior plug connector of insulating housing and coating in the waterproof glue of insulating housing afterbody, the blocking piece include keep out the main part, set up in keep out perforation on the main part and from keep out the extension piece that the main part upper and lower side bent and extended and formed, extension piece integrated into one piece in the insulating housing, the plug connector include the basal portion, from the butt joint tongue that the basal portion forward extended and formed, the butt joint tongue passes the perforation of keeping out the piece, the basal portion keep out in keep out on the main part, the extension piece still extends and is formed with the stationary blade, after the plug connector inserts, bend the stationary blade, make the stationary blade detain on the rear end face of basal portion. The application also comprises a manufacturing method of the waterproof positive and negative plug USB socket.

title_en: Noise-reducing self-priming pump
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of water pumps, and discloses a noise-reducing self-priming pump which comprises a motor, a pump shell body and a connecting cover body for connecting the motor and the pump shell body, wherein a rotating shaft is arranged in the motor, an impeller is coaxially arranged on the rotating shaft in a clearance fit manner, the impeller is rotationally arranged in the pump shell body, a water pressure balance hole is formed in the impeller, and the water pressure balance hole is communicated with two opposite sides of the axial direction of the impeller; the liquid passes through the water pressure balance hole and makes the hydraulic pressure of the relative both sides of impeller keep the same, when the axial float takes place for the pivot, clearance fit and the holding power of impeller both sides liquid between impeller and the pivot have reduced the float range of the axis direction of impeller, and then have avoided collision and friction between impeller and connecting lid body and the pump case body, have reduced the noise that produces and realize the purpose of protecting the impeller owing to the during operation collision and friction of impeller, have reduced the noise pollution of self priming pump and have promoted the practical life of self priming pump.

title_en: Solid oxide fuel cell composite system and method of use
abstract_en: The invention provides a solid oxide fuel cell composite system and a using method thereof, wherein the solid oxide fuel cell composite system comprises a power generation system and a carbon dioxide capture system, the power generation system comprises a reformer, a cell stack, a vaporizer and a burner, the first input end of the reformer is communicated with a fuel gas supply device, the second input end of the reformer is communicated with the vaporizer, and the first output end of the reformer is communicated with the cell stack; the first input end of the burner is communicated with a fuel air supply device, and the second input end of the burner is communicated with air; the inlet of the trapping system is communicated with the anode outlet of the cell stack, and the outlet of the trapping system is selected from at least one of the group consisting of the inlet communicated with the combustor, the inlet communicated with the reformer and the outlet directly exhausted. Combustible components and generated water in the anode tail gas of the cell stack are separated, so that the combustible components are recycled; the high-grade heat energy of the fuel gas is fully utilized to drive the carbon dioxide capture system, and the recovery of the carbon dioxide is realized on the basis of low energy consumption and even zero energy consumption, so that the system can generate power efficiently and realize near zero emission of the carbon dioxide.

title_en: CuCo bimetal organic framework composite sulfur material and preparation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CuCo bimetal organic framework composite sulfur material which can be used as a lithium sulfur battery anode material, wherein Cu atoms and polar Co atoms which are not completely coordinated are staggered in different proportions and are coordinated with an organic ligand to form a polyhedral MOF structure, sulfur and polysulfide reaction product thereof exist in pore channels of the MOF structure and are adsorbed by the pore channels and different active sites provided by two metal atoms, and the sulfur can be well adsorbed in the pore channels of the MOF by the structure, so that a large amount of loss caused by carbonization temperature and reaction can be avoided. The invention also provides a preparation method thereof, solves the problems of too fast capacity attenuation of the lithium-sulfur battery in the charging and discharging processes and unstable structure of the anode material caused by volume expansion, has simple preparation method and easily obtained raw materials, is beneficial to solving the problem of too fast capacity attenuation of the lithium-sulfur battery, thereby accelerating the development of the lithium-sulfur battery to a greater extent and has great research value and commercial value.

title_en: Temperature layer staggered type thermal-voltage power generation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a temperature layer staggered type thermal voltage generating device, which comprises n layers of shelves (200) arranged in a power generation box body (100), wherein n is a natural number, thermal voltage generating plates are arranged on the shelves (200), and each thermal voltage generating plate is one or more of a module series thermal voltage generating plate, a module parallel thermal voltage generating plate, a module series parallel thermal voltage generating plate, a plate series thermal voltage generating plate, a plate parallel thermal voltage generating plate and a plate series parallel thermal voltage generating plate; the power generation box comprises a power generation box body (100), and is characterized in that n+1 fluid inlets (300) and n+1 fluid outlets (400) are respectively arranged on the left side and the right side of the power generation box body (100), fluid with temperature difference is sequentially and alternately introduced from the fluid inlets (300), the fluid with temperature difference passes through two sides of a photovoltaic power generation plate through pipelines, finally flows out from corresponding fluid outlets (400), and the temperature difference can be directly converted into electric energy for output by the photovoltaic power generation plate due to the fact that the temperature difference exists in the fluid passing through the two sides of the photovoltaic power generation plate.

title_en: Automatic system for efficient production of transformers
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic system for efficient production of a transformer, which comprises a base platform, wherein a lifting motor base is fixedly arranged in the middle of the base platform, a vertical lifting linear motor is fixedly arranged on the lifting motor base, a horizontal lifting platform is fixedly connected to the top of a linear push rod of the lifting linear motor, a vertical guide arm is fixedly connected to the upper side of one end of the lifting platform, and a transverse cantilever beam is fixedly connected to the top end of the guide arm; the cantilever beam is positioned right above the lifting platform; the transformer inserting device is simple in structure, the I-shaped silicon steel sheets and the E-shaped silicon steel sheets are staggered and stacked in the inserting process and are always in a stacking and aligning state by adopting a mode of limiting a plurality of guide pillars and matching with a lifting type transformer framework structure, so that the silicon steel sheets after the whole device completes the inserting process are in a completely overlapped state, and the yield of transformer production is improved.

title_en: Configurable hybrid drive system
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a configurable hybrid drive system. A drivetrain for a vehicle includes an electric machine and a controller. The motor has electrically isolated windings and is connected to an inverter. The controller may be configured to configure the respective terminals of the windings to form a Y-connection and reconfigure the respective terminals of the windings in response to an electrical connection between the vehicle and the three-phase power grid such that each terminal of the windings is connected to a corresponding phase of the three-phase power grid.

title_en: Fixing base and intelligent capacitor convenient to plug fast
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fixed seat and an intelligent capacitor convenient to plug and pull out quickly, and belongs to the field of power equipment. The intelligent capacitor comprises a fixed seat and a capacitor body, wherein the fixed seat comprises a seat body, and further comprises a clamping bamboo shoot, a first elastic piece, a push rod and a second elastic piece which are arranged on the seat body, the clamping bamboo shoot is connected with the seat body through the first elastic piece, the capacitor body is fixed between the seat body and the side wall of the clamping bamboo shoot when the clamping bamboo shoot is located at a locking position, one side of the capacitor body, which is far away from the clamping bamboo shoot, is propped against the second elastic piece, the clamping bamboo shoot is provided with a first hole part, when the push rod is pushed to move in a direction which is close to the second elastic piece, the push rod penetrates into the first hole part, and then is propped against the clamping bamboo shoot to be separated from the locking position, so that the capacitor body is popped out under the action of the second elastic piece, the first elastic piece is used for providing a reset force, and the fixed seat is a part structure suitable for the intelligent capacitor. The fixing seat and the intelligent capacitor convenient to insert and withdraw are beneficial to realizing the function of preventing arc discharge of the intelligent capacitor.

title_en: Nonaqueous lithium-type storage element
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a nonaqueous lithium-type storage element. The method for manufacturing a nonaqueous lithium-type storage element according to the present invention includes the steps of: a step of providing a nonaqueous lithium-type storage element having a positive electrode, a negative electrode, a separator, and a nonaqueous electrolytic solution containing lithium ions; and an aging step of maintaining the nonaqueous lithium-type storage element at 40 ℃ or higher to decompose the nonaqueous electrolytic solution.

title_en: High-frequency power generator for improving pulse function
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a high frequency power generator with improved pulse function for supplying high frequency power to a plasma load, comprising: a rectifier; a DC-DC converter; a radio frequency power amplifier; a radio frequency power controller; and a dc-dc converter controller; the dc-dc converter controller includes: a first subtractor; a first proportional integral controller; a second subtractor; a second proportional-integral controller; a comparator for generating a pulse width modulation signal by comparing an output of the second proportional-integral controller with a carrier frequency, and supplying the generated pulse width modulation signal to a switching element constituting the dc-dc converter; and an adaptive controller for receiving a pulse signal corresponding to an output of the rf power amplifier from the rf power controller to adjust gains of the first proportional-integral controller and the second proportional-integral controller.

title_en: Adapter joint
abstract_en: The invention provides an adapter connector which comprises a shell, a supporting component, a circuit board and at least two pin components, wherein each pin component is sequentially arranged in a stacked mode, the supporting component comprises a first supporting frame for installing a live wire connecting piece and a zero wire connecting piece and a second supporting frame for installing the pin components, the first supporting frame and the circuit board are respectively arranged at the top end and the bottom end of the second supporting frame, the shell is connected with a plurality of deducing devices, the second supporting frame is connected with a plurality of guiding devices, the pin components are connected with the guiding devices corresponding to the pin components in a sliding mode, the live wire connecting piece, the zero wire connecting piece and each pin component are electrically connected with the circuit board, a plurality of jacks are formed in the top end of the shell, and a plurality of jacks are formed in the bottom end of the shell corresponding to each pin component. The invention can solve the problems of low utilization rate of parts arranged in the adapter and low space utilization rate in the shell in the prior art.

title_en: Battery pack, electronic device, vehicle, electric power tool, and power storage system
abstract_en: Provided is a battery pack having heat diffusion properties and vibration-proof properties. The battery pack according to the present technology provides a battery pack including: a plurality of batteries 200; and a battery holder 100 having a plurality of battery housing portions 102 for housing the batteries 200, the battery holder 100 being formed of a material including an elastic material having thermal conductivity. The elastic material may also be a rubber or a thermoplastic elastomer. The battery holder may also be formed of a material including an electrically insulating material.

title_en: Surface-treated steel sheet
abstract_en: The surface-treated steel sheet according to one aspect of the present invention comprises a steel sheet base material and a plating layer, wherein the plating layer comprises a Ni-Co alloy plating layer, a Ni-Fe alloy layer, and a Ni layer, and the total Co adhesion amount in the plating layer is 0.2 to 2.3g/m 2 The total amount of Ni deposited was 8.9g/m 2 The Ni layer has a thickness of 0.3 to 3.0 μm, the Co atomic concentration on the surface of the Ni-Co alloy plating layer is 20 to 70 atomic%, and the concentration gradient y of Co in the plating layer in the depth direction is 50 to 400 mass%/μm.

title_en: Double-color extruded lamp strip seamless butt joint connector capable of supplementing electric power
abstract_en: A double-color extruded lamp strip seamless butt joint connector capable of supplementing electric power relates to the technical field of LED lamp strip connectors. It comprises the following steps: a lamp strip body; one end of the terminal wire is detachably assembled with the lamp strip body and is electrically connected with the lamp strip body, and the other end of the terminal wire is electrically connected with an external power supply and is used for continuously supplementing power for the lamp strip body; and a fixing assembly, one part of which is assembled with one side of the lamp strip body near the terminal wire, and the other part of which is assembled with the terminal wire, for fixing the lamp strip body and the terminal wire again so as to prevent the terminal wire from being separated from the lamp strip body. Adopt the seamless butt joint connector of double-colored extrusion lamp area of above-mentioned technical scheme, it not only can effectively avoid public terminal and lamp area body separation, can provide extra electric power for the lamp area body moreover, has seamless connection effectual, and the tensile performance of taking off is good, connects firm, stable, and the cooperation compactness is high, simple to operate, and the performance durability is strong, the effectual advantage of electric power replenishment.

title_en: Nitrogen-rich triphenylamine derivative conjugated polymer material and preparation and application of monomer thereof
abstract_en: A2, 8, 14-tri (4-diphenylamine-phenyl) -hexa-aza-naphthalene has a structure shown in formula (II); a method for preparing 2,8, 14-tri (4-dianilinophenyl) -hexaazanaphthalene comprises the following steps: (1) preparing (III)4- (N, N-diphenyl-benzene) -1, 2-diaminobenzene by Suzuki coupling reaction of 4-triphenylamine borate and 4-bromine o-phenylenediamine; (2) the 4- (N, N-diphenyl-benzene) -1, 2-diaminobenzene and cyclohexadene shown in the formula (III) are subjected to ring-buckling under the action of acetic acid to obtain 2,8, 14-tri (4-diphenylamine-phenyl) -hexaazanaphthalene shown in the formula (II); a poly [2,8, 14-tri (4-diphenylamine-phenyl) -hexaazanaphthalene ] conjugated organic polymer material, wherein the poly [2,8, 14-tri (4-diphenylamine-phenyl) -hexaazanaphthalene ] has a structural formula shown in a formula (I). The invention has the advantages of excellent oxidation-reduction reversibility of triphenylamine, higher discharge voltage platform and high specific capacity of hexaazanaphthalene.

title_en: High-capacity electrode material for high-nitrogen-doped carbon-coated metal sodium sulfide secondary battery and application of high-capacity electrode material
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-capacity electrode material for a high-nitrogen-doped carbon-coated metal sodium sulfide secondary battery and application thereof, wherein a soluble metal salt solution is adopted to react with an organic ligand to obtain a micron-sized metal organic framework precursor; then controlling the carbonization temperature of the precursor in an inert atmosphere to obtain a carbon-coated metal intermediate; and fully grinding and mixing the prepared intermediate with thiourea or L-cysteine in a certain proportion, and reacting at a proper temperature in an inert atmosphere to obtain the electrode material of the high-nitrogen-doped carbon-coated metal sodium sulfide secondary battery. The nitrogen doping content in the interface carbon layer can be effectively controlled by adjusting and controlling the carbonization temperature of the precursor. According to the invention, the content of doped nitrogen in the coated carbon layer is effectively regulated and controlled, the reversibility of metal sulfide conversion reaction is improved by high-content nitrogen doping, and the prepared high-nitrogen doped carbon coated metal sulfide as a sodium secondary battery electrode material shows high specific capacity, excellent rate capability and cycle stability.

title_en: Connecting part of connecting piece and stranded conductor
abstract_en: A connecting part for connecting the wires to the stranded wires, wherein the connecting part has a first metal surface made of a first metal material and a second metal surface made of a second metal material different from the first metal material, the stranded wires are formed of a metal material, the connecting part surrounds the stranded wires in a manner such that the first metal surface adjoins the stranded wires, and the connecting part is connected to the stranded wires at least in a form-fitting manner.

title_en: PDU testing arrangement
abstract_en: The invention provides a PDU testing device, comprising: the direct current power supply unit and the current source unit are respectively connected with the PDU to be tested; the direct current power supply unit is used for providing voltage for the PDU to be tested; and the current source unit is used for converting the current input by the input end of the current source unit into a first direct current and a second direct current with the same magnitude, and providing current for the positive pole loop and the negative pole loop of the PDU to be tested. Preferably, the PDU testing apparatus further includes a second dc power supply unit, and the second dc power supply unit is connected to the input terminal of the current source unit. The PDU testing device provided by the invention tests and tempers the PDU to be tested by connecting the output large current of the current source unit in series, so that the power required by the PDU testing and the tempers is greatly reduced, and the energy consumption in the production process is greatly reduced.

title_en: Operation maintenance platform for isolating switch of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an operation maintenance platform for an isolating switch of an electric power system, which comprises a platform base, a support and a multifunctional frame, wherein the support is fixedly connected to the platform base, an extension frame is connected above the support through a joint, the multifunctional frame is connected to the support through a sliding device, a pulley is arranged on the extension frame at the top end, a hook is arranged on the sliding device, a winch is arranged on the platform base, the hook is connected to the winch through a steel wire rope by bypassing the pulley, the support and the extension frame are connected to the isolating switch base or an isolating switch supporting porcelain bottle through a clamping support, and the top end of the multifunctional frame is connected with a sliding rail device through a function installation platform. When the disconnecting switch is required to be overhauled and applied, the disconnecting switch can be assembled on site for use, and the original components with different functions can be assembled according to the requirement. The hoisting function of the isolating switch is realized, so that the isolating switch is overhauled without participation of large-scale machines such as a climbing vehicle, a crane and the like, the working efficiency is improved, the safety risk is reduced, and a good using effect is achieved.

title_en: Protection circuit for satellite load
abstract_en: A protection circuit for satellite loads comprises a power supply output circuit, an overcurrent protection circuit, an overvoltage protection circuit, an undervoltage protection circuit, a surge current suppression circuit and a TTL switch control circuit. The TTL switch control circuit controls the on and off of the power supply output circuit according to the TTL switch control instruction; and when the power supply output circuit is switched on, the power supply output circuit supplies power to the satellite load, and when the power supply output circuit is switched off, the power supply output circuit stops supplying power to the satellite load. The overcurrent protection circuit collects current after the satellite load is electrified, and the power supply output circuit is switched off when the current exceeds a set current. The overvoltage protection circuit collects the voltage Vin + of the input end of the power supply output circuit, and the power supply output circuit is turned off when the voltage Vin + exceeds a set upper limit voltage. The undervoltage protection circuit collects the voltage Vin + of the input end of the power supply output circuit, and the power supply output circuit is turned off when the voltage Vin + is lower than a set lower limit voltage. The surge current suppression circuit controls the starting time of the output voltage of the power supply output circuit so as to achieve the effect of suppressing the load surge current. The invention is simple, reliable and comprehensive in function.

title_en: Optimal layout method of photovoltaic array voltage and current sensors including fault discrimination
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimized layout method of photovoltaic array voltage and current sensors including fault discrimination, aiming at the characteristics of a series-parallel photovoltaic array connection structure, the voltage sensors of each series branch are distributed in a staggered mode, characteristic quantities such as voltage mean values, numerical deviations and the like are calculated according to collected data, and short circuit and shading hot spot faults of components are discriminated in groups; the photovoltaic array current sensors are distributed at intervals, the characteristic values of all groups of currents are calculated according to the collected data, the open-circuit faults of the assemblies are judged in groups by combining the judgment results of the voltage sensors, so that the monitoring of the running state of the photovoltaic array and the positioning and identification of common faults are completed by using limited sensor collected data and combining the structural characteristics of the circuit, the number of the sensors is reduced under the condition of ensuring the monitoring precision, and the investment cost of the system is reduced.

title_en: Stator of rotating electric machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a stator of a rotating electric machine, which can reduce the height above the stator of the rotating electric machine even if a power conversion device is arranged above the rotating electric machine. A stator (12) of a rotating electrical machine (1) is provided with a stator core (121), a coil (122), and a plurality of bus bars (30U, 30V, 30W). First terminal portions (301U, 301V, 301W) of the bus bar are arranged substantially vertically outside the stator core in the radial direction when viewed from the direction of the rotating shaft (CL) of the rotating electrical machine, second terminal portions (302U, 302V, 302W) of the bus bar are arranged substantially horizontally above the stator core, and the first terminal portion (301U) arranged uppermost among the first terminal portions of the bus bar is arranged so as to be positioned below the uppermost portion (121T) of the stator core.

title_en: Core-shell structure precursor for lithium ion layered positive electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a core-shell structure precursor for a lithium ion layered cathode material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the core of the core-shell structure precursor consists of Ni x Co y M 1‑x‑y (OH) 2 Wherein x is more than or equal to 0.80 and less than or equal to 0.95, y is more than or equal to 0.03 and less than or equal to 0.1, x + y is less than 1, and M is one or a mixture of more of Mn, Al, Zr and Ti; in the precursor with the core-shell structure, the molar ratio of the nickel content of the inner core layer to the nickel content of the outer shell layer is 1.03-1.15, and the thickness of the outer shell layer accounts for 2-15% of the particle size of the precursor with the core-shell structure. According to the invention, by regulating and controlling the ammonia concentration and pH value at different stages, incomplete precipitation of metal ions in the metal mixed salt solution is realized at different reaction stages, the element component concentration distribution of the precursor is regulated and controlled, and the precursor with the core-shell structure is prepared.

title_en: Partial pressure type oxygen sensor with ceramic heater structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A partial pressure type oxygen sensor with a ceramic heater structure and a preparation method thereof relate to a partial pressure type oxygen sensor and a preparation method thereof. The invention aims to solve the technical problems of low heat transfer efficiency, large heater volume, uneven temperature field distribution and poor mechanical shock and vibration resistance of the existing partial pressure type oxygen sensor. The partial pressure type oxygen sensor with the ceramic heater structure consists of a core body and a ceramic heater; and (3) placing the core body in a through hole in the middle of the ceramic heater, filling the hole between the core body and the ceramic heater with high-temperature sealing glass, and finally sintering and forming to obtain the partial pressure type oxygen sensor with the ceramic heater structure. The partial pressure type oxygen sensor can improve the mechanical impact strength of the sensor, improve the heat conduction efficiency, shorten the cold start time and improve the temperature field distribution uniformity, and has the advantages of high precision and high reliability. The oxygen concentration detection device can be used for detecting the oxygen concentration in the environment such as closed environment, atmospheric environment and the like.

title_en: Stacked capacitor assembly structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stacked capacitor assembly structure, which comprises a capacitor unit and an electrode unit. The capacitor unit includes a plurality of stacked capacitors. Each of the stacked capacitors has a positive electrode portion and a negative electrode portion. The electrode unit comprises a first electrode structure and a second electrode structure. The first electrode structure is used as an outer end electrode to cover one end of the capacitor unit and electrically contact one of the positive electrode part and the negative electrode part of the stacked capacitor. The second electrode structure electrically connects the other of the positive electrode portion and the negative electrode portion of the stacked capacitor. Therefore, the production efficiency of the stacked capacitor component structure is effectively improved.

title_en: Battery module and method for manufacturing battery module
abstract_en: The invention provides a battery module and a method for manufacturing the same. Battery module (1, 1A, 1B) comprising: a battery cell group (3) in which a plurality of battery cells (2) are stacked; a pair of end plates (4, 4A, 4B) disposed at both ends of the cell group (3); and regulating members (5, 5A, 5B) that are provided so as to straddle the pair of end plates (4, 4A, 4B) and that regulate the cell group (3) between the pair of end plates (4, 4A, 4B), wherein in the battery module (1, 1A, 1B), the regulating members (5, 5A, 5B) are connected to the pair of end plates (4, 4A, 4B) by means of a hook structure at both ends along the stacking direction of the battery cells (2), the pair of end plates (4, 4A, 4B) clamp the cell group (3) in a compressed state, and, at the same time, a tensile force in the opposite direction is applied to both ends of the regulating members (5, 5A, 5B) by means of a restoring force when the cell group (3) is restored from the compressed state.

title_en: Hub generator
abstract_en: The invention provides a hub generator which can eliminate the generation of abnormal sound from a laminated magnetic yoke along with rotation. A stator body (101A) is configured by arranging a first yoke (120A) on one side of the axial direction of a coil frame (110) and arranging a second yoke (120B) on the other side. A first stator (160A) is disposed on the other side in the axial direction of the stator body, a second stator (160B) is disposed on one side, the tip (121a) of the outer peripheral magnetic pole section (121) of the first yoke is disposed in the holding groove (163) of the first stator, and the tip (121a) of the outer peripheral magnetic pole section (121) of the second yoke is disposed in the holding groove (163) of the second stator. The tip of the outer peripheral magnetic pole part is held in close contact by a pair of pressing walls (162) on both sides of the holding groove (163).

title_en: Automatic assembling machine for oppositely-inserted wiring terminals
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic assembling machine for a plug-in type wiring terminal, which is provided with a conveying mechanism for conveying the wiring terminal and a plug-in mechanism for conveying and assembling a plug-in component to a set position of a bottom plate, wherein the conveying mechanism and the plug-in mechanism are opposite and adjacently arranged; the conveying mechanism is provided with a feeding bottom plate, a material pushing device, a discharging device and an on-off device for controlling the disconnection of a conveying track between the material pushing device and the discharging device; the on-off device is arranged between the material pushing device and the discharging device, and the three devices are all arranged on the feeding bottom plate; the inserting mechanism is provided with a plug-in feeding device, an inserting power mechanism, a material shifting structure, a flattening structure and an inserting structure; one side of the plug-in feeding device is arranged adjacent to the conveying mechanism, and the other side of the plug-in feeding device is connected with the plugging power mechanism through the material poking structure, the flattening structure and the planting structure respectively; controlling feeding and discharging at a bridge needing to be communicated at different heights by the lifting of the on-off device; the automation of the inserting process is realized, and the structure of the plug-in can be improved.

title_en: Foreign object detection in a wireless power transfer system
abstract_en: A wireless power transmitter (101) includes a driver (201) that generates a drive signal for a transmitter coil (103) to generate a power transfer signal during a power transfer interval that includes a repeating time frame of at least one power transfer interval and one foreign object detection interval. A test generator (211) generates a test drive signal for the test coil (209) to generate an electromagnetic test signal during a foreign object detection interval. A foreign object detector (207) performs a foreign object detection test in response to a measured parameter for the test drive signal during the foreign object detection time interval. An adapter (213) generates a varying test drive signal for the test coil (209) during an adaptation interval and determines a test drive signal parameter value in response to the varying test drive signal. The test generator (211) sets a signal property of the test drive signal during at least one foreign object detection interval in response to the test drive signal parameter value.

title_en: Bismuth phosphate positive electrode material with good conductivity for lithium battery and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lithium battery anode materials, and provides a bismuth phosphate anode material with good conductivity for a lithium battery and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the steps of firstly preparing a bismuth phosphate precursor and a lithium vanadate precursor respectively, then preparing a nano carbon black suspension, adding the bismuth phosphate precursor and the lithium vanadate precursor into the suspension to obtain a composite wet gel, then carrying out ball milling, and finally carrying out sectional calcination to obtain the lithium vanadate and carbon black composite bismuth phosphate anode material. Compared with bismuth phosphate which is not subjected to composite modification, the conductivity of the bismuth phosphate anode material prepared by the invention is obviously improved.

title_en: Cable protection and unit lifting prevention combined device for submersible electric pump
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cable protection and unit lifting prevention combined device for a submerged pump, which comprises a main shaft, a well cover, a submerged pump, a cable sealing pipe and a combined mechanism, wherein the submerged pump is arranged in the main shaft, the cable sealing pipe is fixedly connected to the outlet end of the top of the submerged pump, the well cover is fixedly arranged at the top of the main shaft through the combined mechanism, a pressing plate and a sealing gasket are fixed on the well cover through the well cover, the submerged pump is tightly pressed and locked through a screw rod by sleeving an lifting prevention pressing ring, the submerged pump can be effectively prevented from lifting, rotating, tilting and the like, the cable sealing pipe is provided with a direct contact of an isolation conveying medium and a cable, and meanwhile, the sealing gasket, an O-shaped sealing ring and the outlet pipe sealing gasket can be effectively sealed, so that the external conveying medium is prevented from entering the inside of the cable sealing pipe through a matching surface and a gap, and the cable can be effectively protected.

title_en: Crystalline Fe-based alloy powder and method for producing same
abstract_en: A crystalline Fe-based alloy powder comprising Fe-based alloy particles having a structure containing nanocrystalline grains with an average particle diameter of 30nm or less, wherein in a cumulative distribution curve showing the relationship between the particle diameter and the cumulative frequency from the small particle diameter side, which is obtained by a laser diffraction method, the d50, which is the particle diameter corresponding to the cumulative frequency of 50 vol%, is 3.5 to 35.0 [ mu ] m, and the proportion of Fe-based alloy particles having a particle diameter of 2 [ mu ] m or less among all the Fe-based alloy particles obtained by the laser diffraction method is 0 to 8 vol%.

title_en: Method and system for controlling an electrical system
abstract_en: A method for reactivation of an electrical system of a vehicle, the vehicle comprising a first electrical system operating at a first voltage and a second electrical system operating at a second voltage, the second voltage being higher than the first voltage, the method comprising: detecting (100) a fault or crash condition in the second electrical system; disconnecting (102) the power supply of the second electrical system; determining (104) that the fault of the second electrical system is no longer present or that a crash situation is resolved; reconnecting (106) the power supply to the second electrical system and increasing the voltage of the second electrical system from zero to an intermediate voltage lower than the second voltage; and if (108) the current detected in the second electrical system is above a current threshold; or if (110) the detected voltage of the first electrical system is above a voltage threshold; the voltage of the second electrical system is reduced (112) to zero.

title_en: Solid electrolyte material and battery
abstract_en: A solid electrolyte material according to one embodiment of the present application contains Li, Y, at least 1 selected from Mg, Ca, Sr, Ba, Zn, Zr, Nb, and Ta, and at least 1 selected from Cl, Br, and I. An X-ray diffraction pattern of the solid electrolyte material obtained by using a Cu — K α ray as an X-ray source includes peaks in a range where a value of a diffraction angle 2 θ is 30 ° to 33 °, a range where a value of the diffraction angle 2 θ is 39 ° to 43 °, and a range where a value of the diffraction angle 2 θ is 47 ° to 51 °, respectively.

title_en: Filament for ion source, ion source and ion implanter
abstract_en: The invention provides a filament for an ion source, which can release thermoelectrons when being electrified, wherein two ends of the filament are respectively used for being connected with a power supply, the filament comprises three torsion parts, the torsion part positioned in the middle is in a single-helix annular shape, the torsion parts positioned on two sides are in a multiple-helix annular shape, and the diameter of a ring formed by the torsion part in the middle is larger than that of rings formed by the torsion parts on two sides. The invention arranges the torsion part of the single helical ring between the torsion parts of the two multiple helical rings, the torsion parts of the multiple helical rings have high efficiency of releasing thermoelectrons, and the torsion part of the single helical ring balances multiple currents, so that the filament can keep the efficiency of releasing thermoelectrons and reduce the risk of open circuit. The invention also provides an ion source and an ion implanter.

title_en: Energy storage power station charge-discharge rapid switching method with equal inductance energy change rate
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of control of lithium battery energy storage systems, in particular to a method for quickly switching charge and discharge of an energy storage power station with equal inductance capacity change rate, which is characterized by comprising a method for giving direct-axis current in the process of charge/discharge power reduction and a method for giving the direct-axis current when the charge/discharge power is increased, wherein when a system processes high power, the current change rate is small, and when the system processes low power, the current change rate is larger; the change rate of the inductance energy is constant in the whole switching process and linearly changes along with time, and the envelope curve of the grid-connected current and the current at the direct current side changes according to the law of a power function of 0.5 in the charging and discharging conversion process, so that the invention has the advantages that: the response time of the energy storage system can be improved, and compared with the traditional linear scheme, the time can be improved by 50% under the same condition. The method has the advantages of stable switching process, small waveform distortion, quick response and the like.

title_en: Method of manufacturing secondary battery and pouch for secondary battery
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method of manufacturing a secondary battery. The method of manufacturing a secondary battery according to the present invention includes: a forming step of pressing the pouch sheet by using a press mold such that left and right receiving grooves, which are bilaterally symmetric to each other and open upward, and a bridge connecting the left and right receiving grooves to each other are formed in the pouch sheet to form a pouch sheet for receiving the electrode assembly; and a folding step of disposing the electrode assembly in one of the left and right receiving grooves, and folding the pouch sheet such that the left and right receiving grooves face each other, wherein, in the forming step, the pouch sheet is formed such that the bridge protrudes upward with respect to bottom surfaces of the left and right receiving grooves, and a bent portion having a circular arc shape is formed at an upper end of the bridge.

title_en: AC-DC power conversion device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AC-DC powerThe source conversion device comprises a power stage of the active clamping flyback converter and a main control chip, wherein the main control chip integrates a main power tube M L Clamping tube M H The device comprises a secondary side control unit, a starting isolation driving unit and an original secondary side power supply unit. The invention adopts an active clamping structure, and compared with the traditional RCD structure, the invention can reduce the switching loss, improve the working frequency and reduce the volume of the whole chip; meanwhile, ZVS of two switching tubes on the primary side is realized by adopting secondary side sampling, so that high-voltage sampling on the primary side is avoided, the voltage stress of a device is reduced, and the reliability is improved; in addition, the isolation driving module can adopt various modes such as capacitance isolation, inductance isolation or micro transformer isolation, and the like, and compared with the traditional optical coupling isolation, the invention has the characteristics of high transmission rate, low power consumption, long service life and the like.

title_en: X-capacitor device for interference suppression and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: The invention relates to an X capacitor device for interference suppression and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the device comprises an X capacitor main body, a self-discharging circuit component and a sealing colloid formed by encapsulation, a plurality of extending pins are connected by electrodes of the X capacitor main body, the self-discharging circuit component is in short circuit with the extending pin, the sealing colloid seals the X-shaped capacitor main body and the self-discharging circuit component, the sealing colloid also seals the short joint, and the extending pin is exposed out of the sealing colloid. The invention has the effect of automatically forming the self-electricity discharge in the X capacitor device for interference suppression from the X capacitor main body to the self-discharge circuit component when the power is turned on or off.

title_en: Socket for protecting big data equipment by using commercial power current characteristic
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of plug-in connection for big data equipment, and discloses a socket for protecting big data equipment by utilizing commercial power current characteristics, which comprises a shell, wherein the surface of the shell is provided with a socket, the interior of the shell is movably connected with a magnetic block, the bottom of the magnetic block is movably connected with a compression spring, one end of the compression spring, which is far away from the magnetic block, is movably connected with a telescopic rod, the lower end of the telescopic rod is movably connected with a potential box, the interior of the potential box is movably connected with a coil, the top of the magnetic block is movably connected with a spring rod, one end of the spring rod, which is far away from the magnetic block, is movably connected with a supporting plate, the surface of the supporting plate is movably connected with a stabilizing box, the interior of the stabilizing box is provided with a slide rail, the surface of the slide rail is slidably connected with a shaft rod, the lower end of the shaft rod is movably connected with an elastic plate, and the bottom of the elastic plate is movably connected with an adsorption bag. The adsorption bag is stretched to generate adsorption force, so that the force of inserting the plug into the socket is increased, and the effect of regularly stabilizing the insertion force by utilizing the fluctuation characteristic of the mains supply voltage is achieved.

title_en: Fixed value checking method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for checking a fixed value. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: searching a target data sheet associated with the characteristic information of the relay protection equipment in a pre-stored fixed value sheet according to the characteristic information of the relay protection equipment; receiving fixed value data of relay protection equipment sent by the relay protection equipment, and determining a fixed value list according to the fixed value data; the electronic equipment is connected with the relay protection equipment; and checking the fixed value list according to the target data sheet. The embodiment of the invention directly acquires the constant value data to be checked by connecting with the relay protection equipment; the problem of low verification efficiency caused by the fact that verification data are required to be printed and manually verified through relay protection equipment in the verification process is solved; the checking efficiency of the fixed value can be effectively improved.

title_en: Sag analysis method, device, equipment and medium for transmission line wires
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of transmission lines, and provides a sag analysis method, a sag analysis device, computer equipment and a storage medium for transmission line wires. The sag analysis method and the sag analysis device can improve sag analysis efficiency and accuracy of the transmission line wires. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining the theoretical sag of the transmission line conductor according to the first conductor sag corresponding to the internal parameter and the second conductor sag corresponding to the external environment parameter by obtaining the internal parameter and the external environment parameter of the transmission line conductor to be analyzed, outputting the fitting sag of the transmission line conductor by a fitting sag model constructed in advance by the internal parameter and the external environment parameter, and correcting the theoretical sag according to the fitting sag to obtain the actual sag of the transmission line conductor.

title_en: Electrode assembly and secondary battery
abstract_en: Embodiments of a secondary battery having an electrode assembly are provided. The secondary battery may include an electrode assembly having a stacked series of layers with an offset between an electrode layer and a counter electrode layer in a stacked series of unit cell members. A primary restraint system may be provided for a set of restraints, the primary restraint system having first and second primary growth restraints separated from each other in a longitudinal direction and connected by at least one primary connecting member, and the secondary restraint system comprising first and second secondary growth restraints separated in a second direction and connected by a stacked series of layers of members. The primary constraining system may at least partially limit growth of the electrode assembly in a longitudinal direction, and the secondary constraining system may at least partially limit growth in a second direction orthogonal to the longitudinal direction.
