title_en: Method, device and system for adjusting grounding resistance of self-adaptive symmetrical monopole direct current power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a system for adjusting the grounding resistance of a self-adaptive symmetrical monopole direct current power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of continuously acquiring the voltage of a neutral point on the valve side of a connecting transformer in the symmetrical monopole direct current power distribution network; determining the number of the grounding resistance units based on the relation between the number of the grounding resistance units and the voltage of a neutral point on the valve side of the connecting transformer, and realizing automatic adjustment of the number of the grounding resistance units, wherein each grounding resistance unit comprises two reverse parallel-connected IGBTs and a resistor r  0  The grounding resistor units are connected in parallel, and all the grounding resistor units are sequentially connected in series to form a grounding resistor. When a high-resistance grounding fault occurs, the resistance value of the grounding resistor is automatically reduced, so that the fault component of the short-circuit current can meet the requirements of protection and sensitivity of a light current transformer to the maximum extent, and the fault can be accurately identified and removed.

title_en: Hybrid direct current breaker
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hybrid direct current breaker, belonging to the technical field of medium and low voltage direct current transmission and distribution. The circuit breaker provided by the invention adopts a mode that the isolating switch is connected with the transfer branch in series, so that the circuit breaker can bear the voltage between the ends of the circuit breaker when the circuit breaker is in an off-state operation state, each power electronic switch module in the transfer branch is protected, and the power electronic switch modules are prevented from bearing the voltage between the ends, therefore, only a small number of power electronic switch modules are required to be connected in series in the transfer branch, the production cost of the circuit breaker is greatly reduced, and the cost can be reduced by more than 50%. The circuit breaker has the advantages of reliable technical performance, higher economic benefit, stronger market popularization and better application prospect.

title_en: Building engineering power line stringing device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of constructional engineering equipment, in particular to a constructional engineering power line stringing device which comprises an adjusting rotating wheel, a screw rod, an upper movable plate, an upper movable connecting rod, a turnover support, a fixed stringing mechanism and a support mechanism, wherein the adjusting rotating wheel is fixedly connected to the top end of the screw rod; the bottom end of the lead screw is matched with the inner side of the support mechanism through threads; the upper movable plate is rotatably connected to the upper end of the screw rod; the outer side of the upper movable plate is uniformly connected with one ends of the four upper movable connecting rods in a rotating mode in a surrounding mode, and the other ends of the four upper movable connecting rods are respectively connected to the middle of the inner side of the turnover support in a rotating mode. When the wiring device of the power line in the building engineering needs to be carried and moved, the wiring device can be controlled to be integrally contracted inwards, so that the overturning bracket and the wiring mechanism of the fixing frame are contracted towards the lead screw, the occupied space of the wiring device is reduced, and the wiring device is convenient to move.

title_en: Full-duplex WPT energy signal parallel transmission system based on bilateral LCC
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wireless power transmission, and particularly discloses a full-duplex WPT energy signal parallel transmission system based on bilateral LCC. The primary side resonant circuit and the secondary side resonant circuit of the energy transmission channel both adopt LCC type topological structures (bilateral LCC), primary side constant current and load constant current can be achieved, and in addition, a wave resistance network arranged in the energy transmission channel can reduce the influence of the energy channel on a signal channel, so that more stable energy transmission is achieved. The signal channel adopts a parallel injection mode (a signal forward transmission channel and a signal reverse transmission channel are connected with a coupling circuit in parallel), and a wave resistance network on the signal channel blocks carrier waves of opposite transmission frequency, so that the influence on energy resonance is avoided. Overall, the system can ensure that signal transmission is not affected by energy interference voltage basically, and meanwhile, full duplex communication is realized.

title_en: Light source module
abstract_en: The present invention provides a light source module, comprising: a light source having a light emitting surface on an upper surface; and a light guide member including a lens section having a rotation axis on a light emitting surface. In the light source module of the present invention, the lens unit includes: a concave incident surface facing the light emitting surface of the light source and into which light from the light source is incident; a reflection surface which is disposed outside the incidence surface and which reflects a part of light incident from the incidence surface, and which is inclined by 45 degrees or more from a direction perpendicular to the rotation axis; an emission surface that emits a part of light incident from the incidence surface and light reflected by the reflection surface to the outside; the incident surface is four times symmetrical with respect to the rotation axis, and has a first incident region having a concave curved surface in a cross section including the rotation axis and a second incident region having a convex curved surface in a cross section including the rotation axis at a position rotated 45 degrees from the first incident region.

title_en: Method for preparing graphene quantum dot doped noble metal nanotube array by constant current codeposition
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing a graphene quantum dot doped noble metal nanotube array by constant current codeposition, and belongs to the field of novel material preparation. The method comprises the steps of taking a titanium sheet as a substrate, and obtaining a zinc oxide nanorod array template through constant current deposition; then, loading graphene quantum dots and noble metal nano particles on the zinc oxide nano rod array simultaneously by using a constant current codeposition technology; and finally, dissolving the zinc oxide template in an acid solution to remove the zinc oxide template, thereby obtaining the self-supporting graphene quantum dot doped noble metal nanotube array. The method adopted by the invention is mild, green and efficient, the preparation process is simple, the operability is strong, and the method is suitable for mass production, and the prepared graphene quantum dot doped noble metal nanotube array has a high effective electrochemical active area and has a good application prospect in the fields of electrocatalysis and proton exchange membrane fuel cells.

title_en: Fiber cloth-based lithium ion battery diaphragm and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of lithium ion batteries, and discloses a fiber cloth-based lithium ion battery diaphragm and a preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises the following steps: preparing composite fine denier fiber yarns with polyolefin as a core and blended polymer as a sheath by a composite fiber spinning method technology; and then warping and weaving the composite fine denier fiber yarns into warp-weft fiber cloth or carrying out biorthogonal composite lamination on the fibers in the same direction to obtain weftless cloth, and then carrying out hot pressing by a smooth roller to obtain the fiber cloth-based lithium ion battery diaphragm. The method has simple steps, the diaphragm does not need to be coated with slurry on one side or two sides, and the battery diaphragm with high liquid absorption rate, high ionic conductivity and high mechanical property can be prepared without stretching, orienting and forming holes; the gel layer is attached to the polypropylene skeleton fiber in situ in the production process, namely, the gel polymer attached to each skeleton fiber is equivalent, so that the thickness of the fiber cloth diaphragm is uniform, and the porosity and the pore size distribution are kept constant.

title_en: Multi-core phase-shifting frequency modulation control structure, phase-shifting frequency modulation method and heating device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-core phase-shifting frequency-modulation control structure, a phase-shifting frequency-modulation method and a heating device, and the multi-core phase-shifting frequency-modulation control structure comprises an operation module and a control module, wherein the operation module can acquire electrical information of external objects in operation and process the electrical information to obtain phase-shifting instructions and/or frequency-modulation instructions in a digital signal form, the control module is connected with the operation module to acquire the phase-shifting instructions and/or the frequency-modulation instructions and modulate and output driving instructions according to the phase-shifting instructions and/or the frequency-modulation instructions, the control module only needs to implement a control process without performing operation processing, and modulates and outputs the driving instructions according to the phase-shifting instructions and/or the frequency-modulation instructions, so that the external objects are driven.

title_en: Power domain control system, domain control system and fuel cell vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a power domain control system, a domain control system and a fuel cell vehicle. The power domain control system comprises: the whole vehicle control module determines the torque requirement of the whole vehicle according to the working condition of the whole vehicle; the power control module includes: the motor control module is used for converting the torque demand into a power demand; an energy management module that determines a charge-discharge state of the secondary battery and a distribution of the power demand between the fuel cell system and the secondary battery based on the power demand, a condition of the fuel cell system, a state of charge of the secondary battery, and an operating condition of the fuel cell vehicle; and the power source control module determines the working points of the fuel cell and the secondary battery of the fuel cell vehicle according to the energy management strategy determined by the energy management module. The scheme of the invention ensures that the signal transmission is more direct and effective, can obviously improve the real-time property, robustness, reliability and safety of the control system, and can greatly reduce the number of controllers and the quantity of wire harnesses, thereby reducing the cost.

title_en: Electrostatic actuator and physical quantity sensor
abstract_en: The electrostatic actuator is provided with a fixed electrode (1) and a movable electrode (2) disposed so as to face the fixed electrode (1). The movable electrode (2) is displaceable relative to the fixed electrode (1) and the fixed portion (3). An attractive force acts between the movable electrode (2) and the fixed portion (3). In addition, in the electrostatic actuator, when a voltage is applied to the fixed electrode (1) and the movable electrode (2), nonlinear vibration of the movable electrode (2) is reduced by attractive force acting between the movable electrode (2) and the fixed portion (3).

title_en: Method and apparatus for use in ground fault protection
abstract_en: A method and apparatus for use in ground fault protection in a three-phase electrical network, the apparatus being configured to: detecting a phase-to-earth fault (60) in a three-phase electrical network (50); determining, for each of the three phases (a, B, C) of the three-phase network, a phase current during the detected phase-to-earth fault or a change in the phase current due to the detected phase-to-earth fault; determining an estimate of the ground fault current based on the determined phase current or based on a variation of the determined phase current; determining whether the estimate of the ground fault current represents an actual ground fault current or a surface ground fault current; and determining that the estimate of the ground fault current is valid in response to determining that the estimate of the ground fault current represents an actual ground fault current.

title_en: Relay protection system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a relay protection system and method; the system comprises a relay, a resistance sampling circuit and a control unit; the resistance sampling circuit is connected with the relay and used for acquiring a first resistance value of a coil corresponding to the relay when the relay is disconnected and a second resistance value of the coil corresponding to the relay when the relay is connected; the control unit is connected with the resistance sampling circuit and used for receiving the first resistance value and the second resistance value sent by the resistance sampling circuit, calculating the actual working temperature of the coil according to the first resistance value, the second resistance value and the current working environment temperature of the relay, and realizing the protection of the relay according to the actual working temperature; the current actual working temperature of the relay coil is judged by detecting the resistance change of the relay coil, so that when the actual working temperature reaches an alarm, corresponding cooling treatment can be performed in time, the relay is effectively protected, and the possibility that the relay is damaged due to overhigh working temperature is avoided.

title_en: Shockproof circuit breaker of new generation information technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a shockproof circuit breaker of a new generation of information technology, and relates to the technical field of circuit breakers. This shockproof circuit breaker of new generation information technology, the power distribution box comprises a box body, the spring coil on the top fixedly connected with of box, the outside fixedly connected with electro-magnet of post stabilizes, the electro-magnet is keeping away from the one end fixedly connected with spout of post stabilizes, the inside sliding connection of spout has the slider, the slider is at the one end fixedly connected with magnetic pole that is close to the electro-magnet, the slider is at the one end fixedly connected with extrusion stem of keeping away from the magnetic pole. Switch on through the circuit breaker, make its inside electro-magnet produce magnetism, use through the cooperation of slider with the telescopic link, when the circuit breaker circular telegram, the spring coil of its outside can enlarge, makes the inside space grow of circuit breaker, has reached can the absorbing effect, drives the carriage release lever through the circuit breaker circular telegram and plugs up the vent, makes the vent open during the outage, has reached the dustproof effect of can dispelling the heat.

title_en: Lithium battery charging and discharging indicating circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium battery charging and discharging indicating circuit, which comprises a lithium battery, a voltage sampling circuit, a comparison circuit and a plurality of indicating circuits connected in parallel; the voltage sampling circuit comprises a plurality of voltage division resistors which are connected in series at two ends of the lithium battery; sampling points are respectively arranged between two adjacent divider resistors; the comparison circuit comprises a plurality of voltage comparators; the non-inverting input ends of the voltage comparators are respectively connected with the sampling points in a one-to-one correspondence manner, and the inverting input ends are connected with each other; the indicating circuit comprises a light emitting diode and a conducting module which are connected in series with the lithium battery; the conduction module is connected with the output end of the voltage comparator, and the conduction module is connected or disconnected according to the voltage output by the voltage comparator, so that the light-emitting diode emits light or does not emit light. The invention realizes the effect of accurately displaying the change of the electric quantity of the lithium battery through the luminous quantity of the light-emitting diodes, has simple circuit arrangement and accurately displays the change of the capacity of the lithium battery in the charging and discharging processes.

title_en: Water heat exchange device for fuel cell
abstract_en: The application discloses a water heat exchange membrane assembly of a water heat exchange device for a fuel cell, which is characterized by comprising at least one water heat exchange membrane assembly unit, wherein the water heat exchange membrane assembly unit comprises a five-in-one membrane structure and a support framework which are stacked and formed in a composite mode; five unification diaphragm structures include from last down in proper order: the water-heat exchange membrane comprises a first hot melt adhesive layer, a first support net layer, a water-heat exchange membrane, a second support net layer and a second hot melt adhesive layer, wherein the first support net layer, the second support net layer, the water-heat exchange membrane, the second support net layer and the second hot melt adhesive layer are bonded together through the first hot melt adhesive layer and the second hot melt adhesive layer, the water-heat exchange membrane is a water-permeable and air-impermeable flexible porous material, and all water-heat exchange membrane components are stacked in pairs and then placed in an oven to complete the forming and sealing of a water-heat exchange device main body at one time.

title_en: Safe discharge method and wet physical sorting method for retired batteries
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safe discharge and wet physical sorting method for retired batteries. The wet physical sorting method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of carrying out discharge treatment on a battery cell disassembled from a retired battery, then removing electrolyte in the battery cell, and then sequentially carrying out crushing, magnetic separation, electrolyte harmlessness, friction scrubbing and wet vibrating screen separation treatment on the battery cell, so that at least a positive electrode material, a positive electrode current collector, a negative electrode material, a negative electrode current collector and a diaphragm are separated from each other. The safe discharge method for the retired battery provided by the invention can realize safe discharge, can keep the integrity of the battery and is convenient for subsequent disassembly. Meanwhile, the wet physical separation method provided by the invention can realize the high-efficiency stripping of the anode material and the cathode material from the current collector, and simultaneously solves the problem that the anode material and the cathode material are difficult to separate at present, so that the regeneration of the graphite cathode has possibility.

title_en: Intelligent device for field water boiling
abstract_en: The invention discloses intelligent equipment for field water boiling, which comprises a pedal device, wherein a shaft sleeve space is arranged in the pedal device, a rotating space with a left opening is arranged at the lower side of the shaft sleeve space, a liquefied gas tank is arranged at the right side of the rotating space, a reciprocating space is arranged on the upper side of the liquefied gas tank, a power generation device for generating power is arranged between the reciprocating space and the rotating space, the power generation device comprises a large sliding rod fixedly arranged between the upper wall and the lower wall of the reciprocating space, a pedal is connected to the large sliding rod in a sliding manner, the equipment is movable equipment, can take in the knapsack when camping or field survival, be equipped with power generation facility in the equipment and can step on through the people and generate electricity for whole equipment, need not people's many band portable power source, reduce the physical demands of people on the journey, ignition can let people fire in the field.

title_en: Frequency conversion cabinet for oil field beam-pumping unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a frequency conversion cabinet for an oil field beam-pumping unit, which comprises a cabinet body, wherein an electrical element placing frame is fixedly installed in the cabinet body, a heat dissipation mechanism is arranged at the inner bottom of the cabinet body, a rotating mechanism and a driving mechanism are arranged on the inner wall of the cabinet body, the rotating mechanism is abutted against the top of the heat dissipation mechanism, a transmission belt is connected between the driving mechanism and the rotating mechanism in a transmission manner, two cleaning mechanisms are arranged on the driving mechanism, both the two cleaning mechanisms are abutted against the inner side wall of the opposite cabinet body, and both the opposite inner side walls of the cabinet body are provided with collecting mechanisms. The water-cooling type electric appliance cabinet has reasonable structural design, can improve the heat dissipation in the cabinet body, simultaneously can clean condensed water drops on the side walls at the two ends of the cabinet body, ensures the drying of the side walls at the two ends of the cabinet body, and avoids the situation that when the temperature rises, the water drops are evaporated and enter the electric appliance element placing frame to damage the internal electric appliance element and influence the normal use of the electric appliance element.

title_en: Nonaqueous electrolyte secondary battery
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to improve the cycle characteristics of a nonaqueous electrolyte secondary battery having a wound electrode body in which an Si-based active material is used as a negative electrode active material. A nonaqueous electrolyte secondary battery according to an embodiment includes a wound electrode assembly in which a positive electrode and a negative electrode are wound with a separator interposed therebetween. The negative electrode has a negative electrode collector, a 1 st negative electrode mixture layer formed on a 1 st surface of the negative electrode collector facing the outside of the electrode body, and a 2 nd negative electrode mixture layer formed on a 2 nd surface of the negative electrode collector facing the inside of the electrode body. At least the 1 st negative electrode mixture layer contains a Si-based active material, and the Si-based content ratio of the Si-based active material in the 2 nd negative electrode mixture layer is lower than the Si-based content ratio of the Si-based active material in the 1 st negative electrode mixture layer.

title_en: Mobile power supply circuit and mobile power supply
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mobile power supply circuit and a mobile power supply, comprising a power supply discharging module, a device interaction module and a power supply stabilizing module, wherein the device interaction module establishes communication interaction with mobile equipment to be charged, and sends a power supply stabilizing signal according to the equipment information of the mobile equipment to be charged. Further, if the device information of the mobile device to be charged is received to send a power supply stabilizing signal, when the power supply discharging module charges the mobile device to be charged, the power supply stabilizing module stabilizes the discharging of the power supply discharging module, and the mobile device to be charged or the mobile device to be charged is prevented from being damaged by the excessive discharging of the mobile power supply circuit. Based on the method, through interaction with the mobile equipment to be charged, extreme working conditions brought by charging of part of the mobile equipment to be charged are prevented, and the safety of the mobile power supply is improved.

title_en: Method for controlling operation of garden tool and battery pack
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for controlling a garden tool with a battery pack (2), the battery pack (2) comprising a control unit (100) for performing the method, when the tail end of the battery pack (2) is inserted into a recess (32) of the garden tool, data communication is performed with a control assembly (200) of the garden tool via a data bus (30) for performing the method. -the control unit (100) reads an identification code (34) of the garden tool; control data corresponding to the garden tool is retrieved from a memory (14) based on the identification code (34). The control unit (100) may also be used to collect sensor data collected by sensors (20; 22; 24) of the garden tool; the control unit (100) controls the operation of the garden tool based on the feedback acquired control data and the acquired sensor data.

title_en: Flexible self-adaptive arc extinction method for single-phase earth fault of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a flexible self-adaptive arc extinction method for single-phase earth faults of a power distribution network, which adopts a three-phase cascaded H-bridge converter as an arc extinction device and is connected between each phase line and the ground in a hanging manner; the voltage drop from the neutral point to the fault point is calculated through secondary injection, the zero sequence voltage is regulated and controlled to the voltage drop, and the voltage at the fault point is suppressed to be zero, so that the problem that the current at the fault point is possibly increased when the low-resistance grounding fault occurs at the tail end of a circuit and the circuit load current is large because the impedance voltage drop influence of the fault circuit is not considered in the existing arc suppression cabinet and flexible voltage arc suppression technology is solved. The phase relation between the zero sequence voltage after the ground fault and the power voltage of the fault phase is utilized, the fault phase is selected through phase comparison, the problem of phase selection of the single-phase ground fault of the power distribution network is solved, a flexible current arc extinction method which can be used for phase selection is adopted, the flexible current arc extinction method is used as transition before the flexible voltage arc extinction method is put into use, and the increase of the ground fault current caused by the secondary injection of any current or voltage is prevented.

title_en: Multi-energy complementary power supply base optimal configuration method, storage medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-energy complementary power supply base optimal configuration method, a storage medium and equipment, wherein basic data of a composite power station, power plant data in the composite power station and operation prediction data of the composite power station are obtained from power supply bases and relevant departments of a power system; constructing a multi-energy complementary power supply optimization configuration model target by taking multi-aspect comprehensive cost of the minimized composite power station planning operation as a target function; constructing constraint conditions of optimal configuration of the composite power station; and inputting the acquired data into an optimal configuration model based on the established objective function and the established optimal configuration constraint condition of the composite power station, and solving to obtain a configuration result of the composite power station. The method takes the minimized comprehensive cost in multiple aspects as the target, fully considers the internal strategy and the external characteristics of the power base, the whole power station and the unit characteristics, considers the physical reality and the mathematical simplification of the optimization problem, can quickly and accurately solve the optimization configuration of the complementary power supply in the power base, and has guiding significance for planners.

title_en: Primary controller applied to primary side of power converter and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a primary controller applied to a primary side of a power converter and an operation method thereof. The primary controller comprises a current compensation circuit and a compensation voltage generation circuit. The current compensation circuit is used for generating a compensation current to the sensing resistor of the primary side according to a direct current voltage and an auxiliary voltage, wherein the auxiliary voltage is related to the output voltage of the secondary side of the power converter, and the compensation current changes the peak voltage of the primary side. The compensation voltage generating circuit is used for generating a compensation voltage according to a reference current, the discharge time of the secondary side and a peak current, wherein the reference current can change along with the output voltage. The compensation current and the reference current are used for keeping the output current of the secondary side of the power converter unchanged along with the output voltage. Therefore, compared with the prior art, the invention can effectively eliminate the influence of the output voltage on the output current.

title_en: Laminated battery pole core assembly, laminated battery and preparation process
abstract_en: The invention provides a laminated battery pole core assembly, which also comprises a support plate and a pole core winding body, wherein the support plate is arranged on at least one side of the length direction of a pole core, the pole core winding body is simultaneously wound on the surfaces of the support plate and the pole core along a spiral line direction, a plurality of lightening holes are formed in the support plate at intervals, the laminated battery comprises a shell structure, the laminated battery further comprises the laminated battery pole core assembly, and the laminated battery pole core assembly is arranged in the shell structure.

title_en: Filtering compensation device for test transformer
abstract_en: The invention provides a filtering compensation device for a test transformer, which comprises a harmonic detection unit, a command current operation unit, a trigger pulse generation unit and a compensation current generation unit which are electrically connected in sequence, wherein the harmonic detection unit is used for collecting voltage and current signals output by an induction voltage regulator, the command current operation unit is used for generating command signals, the trigger pulse generation unit is used for sending pulse driving to the compensation current generation unit, and the compensation current generation unit is used for generating compensation current.

title_en: Energy routing control strategy and direct current energy router
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy Internet; the utility model relates to an energy route control strategy and direct current energy router, direct current energy router include central control module, switch drive module, carrier communication module, data acquisition module, two-way contravariant module, preprocessing module, post processing module and power module, wherein: the power supply module supplies power to each module; the central control module is embedded with the energy routing control strategy, receives the data signal from the data acquisition module and controls the working mode of the switch driving module by the energy routing control strategy; the carrier communication module, the bidirectional inversion module, the preprocessing module and the post-processing module execute corresponding switching actions according to the specific working mode of the switch driving module. The invention can greatly eliminate the disordered flow of the power grid energy, improve the power quality, ensure the power supply, maintain the stability of the power grid operation and improve the energy utilization rate.

title_en: Radio frequency heating equipment and thawing box with same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radio frequency heating device and a thawing box with the radio frequency heating device, wherein the radio frequency heating device comprises: heating chamber, radio frequency power amplifier, semiconductor radiator and fan. Through setting up the semiconductor radiator and initiatively cooling to radio frequency power amplifier, transfer away the heat through the semiconductor radiator to send this partial heat into the heating intracavity through the fan, improved the temperature in heating chamber and can heat food more rapidly, in addition, the semiconductor radiator initiatively conveys the heat to the hot junction from the cold junction after, the fan in time moves the heat at hot junction into the heating chamber, the heat at hot junction has been reduced, the radiating effect of messenger's semiconductor radiator is better, the heat that produces through recycle radio frequency power amplifier has improved the energy utilization, the heating effect is better, the same food of heating consumes less energy.

title_en: Automatically controlled cabinet of regulation type environmental control
abstract_en: The invention discloses an adjusting type ring-controlled electric control cabinet which comprises a cabinet body, an electric element mounting plate and a cooling fan, wherein a first through groove is formed in the outer side of the cabinet body, a first transmission screw rod is rotatably installed between the inner surface walls of two sides of the cabinet body, a driven bevel gear is installed on the first transmission screw rod, a second transmission screw rod is rotatably installed between the inner surface walls of two sides of the cabinet body, and a driving bevel gear in meshed connection with the driven bevel gear is fixedly installed on the second transmission screw rod. According to the invention, the third driving motor drives the second transmission screw to drive the driving bevel gear to rotate, and the driven bevel gear is driven to drive the first transmission screw to rotate, so that the installation box moves towards the outer side of the cabinet body in the horizontal direction, the installation space of the cabinet body is enlarged, compared with a traditional environment-controlled cabinet with a fixed inner space, the space of the cabinet body is flexible and adjustable, enough installation space is provided to be suitable for installation of increased electric elements, and installation of operators is facilitated.

title_en: Foldable combined furniture and use method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of composite furniture, in particular to foldable composite furniture and a using method thereof, wherein the foldable composite furniture comprises a dining table mechanism and a plurality of foldable dining chair mechanisms, the dining table mechanism comprises a dining table platform, an extension assembly and a support assembly, the support assembly comprises a containing box and a plurality of support members, the containing box is provided with a containing groove for placing the dining chair mechanisms, the plurality of support members are rotatably connected to the corresponding side surfaces of the containing box, and the dining table platform is arranged at the top of the containing box; the extension assembly comprises a plurality of extension pieces, the extension pieces are rotatably connected to the corresponding side edges of the dining table platform, the support pieces are detachably connected to the side surfaces of the extension pieces, and the side surfaces of the extension pieces rotating to the horizontal state are on the same horizontal plane with the dining table platform. The energy-saving environment-friendly solar water heater has the effects of increasing the space utilization rate and saving energy and protecting environment.

title_en: Positive electrode active material
abstract_en: Provided is a positive electrode active material which can suppress an increase in the interface resistance between the positive electrode active material and a sulfide solid electrolyte over time and has a low interface resistance. The positive electrode active material of the present invention includes particles having a core particle containing a lithium metal composite oxide and a coating layer disposed on the surface of the core particle, and is used for an all-solid-state battery including a sulfide solid electrolyte. The coating layer is composed of an oxide containing Li and M (M is 1 or 2 or more elements selected from the group consisting of B, Nb, Ti, Zr, Ta, Zn, W and Al, and B in the case of 1). The molar ratio of Li/M in the surface of the coating layer, which is determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, is 0.85 to 3.95.

title_en: Negative electrode composite thickening agent, negative electrode plate and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lithium ion batteries, and provides a negative electrode composite thickener, a negative electrode plate and a preparation method thereof, aiming at solving the problems that negative electrode slurry is blue and a negative electrode rolls on the surface and is stuck to a roller frequently in the preparation process of a water-based CMC-SBR mixed adhesive negative electrode plate, wherein the negative electrode composite thickener is prepared from sodium carboxymethylcellulose and high-substituted guar gum according to the mass ratio of 1: (0.2-5) mixing. According to the invention, the highly-substituted guar gum is introduced to prepare the negative composite thickening agent, the highly-substituted guar gum is compounded with SBR emulsion when a negative pole piece is prepared, and the affinity of the electropositive cationic group of the highly-substituted guar gum and the electronegative carboxyl group on the surface of SBR is utilized to anchor the SBR on the thickening agent, so that the SBR floating problem of the current CMC-SBR adhesive system is relieved, the roller sticking problem when the negative pole piece is rolled is improved, the negative adhesive force is improved, and the electrochemical performance of the lithium battery is improved.

title_en: Electronic table card and electronic table card system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electronic table board and an electronic table board system, wherein the electronic table board comprises a microcontroller, a POE network power supply module, a wireless communication module, a display module, an electric energy conversion module and a USB charging module, the microcontroller, the POE network power supply module, the wireless communication module, the display module, the electric energy conversion module and the USB charging module are included, the microcontroller is respectively and electrically connected with the POE network power supply module, the wireless communication module and the display module, the wireless communication module comprises a Bluetooth communication module and a Wi-Fi communication module, and the microcontroller is used for controlling the POE network communication module, the wireless communication module and the display module; the electronic table card system comprises the electronic table card. Therefore, the electronic table board is beneficial to improving the diversification of the use mode of the electronic table board and has adaptability under different requirements of different use scenes.

title_en: Wireless power transmitter and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a wireless power transmitter and a control method thereof. The method includes outputting, by a power transmission circuit of the wireless power transmitter, a first power for charging the first wireless power receiver, receiving, by a communication unit of the wireless power transmitter, power information of a second wireless power receiver, which includes a maximum power of the second wireless power receiver, while outputting the first power for charging the first wireless power receiver, recognizing, by a controller of the wireless power transmitter, that the wireless power transmitter cannot support the maximum power of the second wireless power receiver, transmitting, by the communication unit, a power adjustment command for reducing a magnitude of power received by the second wireless power receiver to a magnitude within a range that the wireless power transmitter can support, based on the recognition result, and outputting, by the power transmission circuit, the second power for charging the first and second wireless power receivers, based on at least the reduced power magnitude.

title_en: Detection control device and control method for converter
abstract_en: The invention provides a detection control device and a control method for a converter, which solve the technical problems that potential safety hazards are brought to normal and stable operation of the converter and normal and stable operation of a wind generating set due to the defects that a busbar in the converter is short-circuited, a power module is exploded and devices are damaged and the like because the potential safety hazards of leakage of a heat exchanger in the converter cannot be found in time. The converter includes the heat exchanger, and the device includes: the liquid leakage detection device is used for detecting liquid leakage of the heat exchanger and outputting a liquid leakage signal; and the switch control device receives the liquid leakage signal and controls the converter to stop according to the liquid leakage signal. The method comprises the following steps: s1: carrying out liquid leakage detection on the heat exchanger and outputting the liquid leakage signal; s2: and controlling the converter to stop according to the liquid leakage signal.

title_en: Wide voltage isolation circuit, battery isolator, charger, inverter and carrier
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wide-voltage isolation circuit, a battery isolator, a charger, an inverter and a carrier. The isolation circuit comprises an mcu circuit, a generator output circuit, a switch circuit, a high-frequency power transformer circuit, a rectifying and filtering circuit, a secondary battery circuit, a generator voltage monitoring circuit, a secondary battery voltage monitoring circuit and a power supply circuit. The input of the switching circuit is connected with the output of the generator, and the output of the switching circuit is connected with the input of the high-frequency power transformer circuit. The output of the high-frequency power transformer circuit is connected with the input of the rectifying and filtering circuit. One end of the output of the rectifying and filtering circuit is used as a zero line, the other end is used as an anode wire to be connected into a main circuit for charging the secondary battery. By means of the PWM mode control, the secondary battery is a charging system completely independent of the main battery, and can be charged completely according to the technical requirements of a charging curve of a battery manufacturer.

title_en: Continuous terminal sliding mode composite control method of permanent magnet brushless direct current motor speed regulation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a continuous terminal sliding mode composite control method of a permanent magnet brushless direct current motor speed regulation system, which mainly comprises a composite anti-interference speed and current controller. The composite anti-interference speed controller consists of speed feedback control based on a continuous terminal sliding mode, speed loop interference estimation based on a sliding mode observer I and feedforward compensation; the composite anti-interference current controller consists of current feedback control based on a continuous terminal sliding mode, current loop interference estimation based on a sliding mode observer II and feedforward compensation. Compared with the traditional terminal sliding mode control method, the method has continuous control rate, and can effectively reduce buffeting phenomenon caused by the existence of a symbol function in the traditional terminal sliding mode control method. In addition, the rapid convergence performance of the system state in the original control method is maintained, and the anti-interference capability of the system is further improved. Therefore, the application requirement of the permanent magnet brushless direct current motor speed regulation system in the high-performance field can be met.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: An exemplary embodiment relates to a display device including: the display panel, the window, the metal layer and the first conductive strip. The display panel includes a display region, a non-display region, and a bending region disposed between the display region and the non-display region and bent such that the non-display region overlaps the display region. The window is disposed on the first surface of the display panel and includes a protruding portion overlapping the non-display area. The metal layer is disposed on a second surface of the display panel. The second surface is opposite to the first surface. The first conductive strap connects the protruding portion of the window to the metal layer.

title_en: Electric power energy terminal equipment based on distributed acquisition framework
abstract_en: The invention discloses electric power energy source terminal equipment based on a distributed acquisition architecture, which comprises the following parts: the control cabinet is internally provided with three power supplies and a plurality of circuit breakers; the main module is fixedly arranged in the control cabinet and is connected with the three power supplies, and the main built-in power supply system of the main module converts alternating current of two hundred and twenty volts into direct current of five volts; the display module is fixedly arranged on a cabinet door of the control cabinet, a display screen displays electric parameters of outlets of the circuit breakers through page turning of touch buttons on the screen, the display module is connected to the main module through a network cable, and the main module supplies power to the display module through the network cable and performs data interaction with the display module; the slave modules are fixedly installed in the control cabinet, the number of the slave modules is the same as that of the circuit breakers, the slave modules correspond to the circuit breakers one by one, and the slave modules are close to the circuit breakers corresponding to the slave modules and are connected with the corresponding circuit breakers through ABC three-phase current sampling lines. The invention has the advantages of simple wiring mode and good stability.

title_en: Earphone charging box and wireless earphone charged by using same
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wireless earphones and charging boxes for the wireless earphones, and particularly relates to an earphone charging box which comprises a lower box body, an upper closing cover, a light guide column, a charging box PCB, a charging box battery, a Hall FPC board, a first inner support magnet, a lower inner support, a second inner support magnet and an upper inner support. The charging box adopts the inner supporting magnets which are regularly arranged to assist in positioning the wireless earphones, optimizes the structural design of the magnets, effectively adsorbs the wireless earphones, enables the wireless earphones to be more firmly fixed, ensures the charging effect, realizes the integrated integration of the PCB and the PFC board by adopting a welding mode, realizes stable electrical connection performance, has high mechanical strength, optimizes the design of interfaces, and effectively reduces the height space and the cost.

title_en: Novel low-loss transformer
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel low-loss transformer which comprises two or more magnetic cores, a coil, a winding framework and a conductive metal terminal, wherein the coil is wound on the winding framework, and the magnetic cores are formed by insulating and coating one or more high-saturation low-loss alloy magnetic powder and an insulating medium, then pressing the magnetic cores through a die and then baking and curing the magnetic cores at a high temperature. The initial magnetic conductivity of the magnetic core is 10-250, and the magnetic conductivity can be adjusted by changing the proportion of the particle sizes of the magnetic powder, so that a closed magnetic circuit without air gaps is realized. The problems of increased eddy current loss and poor EMI performance caused by the diffusion of magnetic flux in the air gap of the traditional ferrite core structure in high-frequency application are solved. The transformer without air bubbles has the advantages of high reliability, high power density, high conversion efficiency, high saturation magnetic flux density, excellent heavy current resistance and EMI performance. Can completely replace the traditional transformer ferrite air gap core structure.

title_en: Preparation method and application of NiCo-LDH nano material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a NiCo-LDH nano material, wherein the method comprises the following steps: dissolving a nickel source and a cobalt source in a mixed solution composed of isopropanol and glycerol according to a proportion, and carrying out ultrasonic treatment and stirring treatment until the nickel source and the cobalt source are fully dissolved; placing the obtained system in an oven, reacting for 6-10h at the temperature of 170-190 ℃, and naturally cooling; collecting the nickel-cobalt double-metal hydroxide product obtained by the reaction, removing redundant impurities through centrifugal washing, and drying to obtain the NiCo-LDH nanosphere. The nickel-cobalt double metal hydroxide prepared by the method has a spherical structure with the diameter of nano level, has larger specific surface area, increases the contact area of an electrode material and electrolyte, and is beneficial to the rapid transmission of ions; meanwhile, the spherical structure is not easy to collapse or agglomerate in the charge-discharge cycle process, so that NiCo-LDH as a supercapacitor electrode material has high specific capacitance and good cycle stability.

title_en: Rechargeable lithium battery
abstract_en: Disclosed is a rechargeable lithium battery including a positive electrode containing a positive active material; a negative electrode containing a negative electrode active material; an electrolyte solution containing a lithium salt and a nonaqueous organic solvent; and a separator between the positive and negative electrodes, the separator including a porous substrate and a coating layer on at least one side of the porous substrate. The negative electrode active material includes a Si-based material; the non-aqueous organic solvent comprises a cyclic carbonate comprising ethylene carbonate, propylene carbonate, or a combination thereof, the cyclic carbonate being present in an amount of about 20% to about 60% by volume based on the total amount of the non-aqueous organic solvent; and the coating comprises a fluorine-based polymer, an inorganic compound, or a combination thereof. The rechargeable lithium battery has improved life and high temperature storage characteristics.

title_en: Oriented carbon nanotube fiber-graphene composite membrane, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oriented carbon nanotube fiber-graphene composite membrane, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: drafting original carbon nanotube fibers to obtain oriented carbon nanotube fibers, and simultaneously uniformly applying graphene oxide dispersion liquid to the surfaces of the carbon nanotube fibers to obtain a carbon nanotube fiber-graphene oxide composite film; and carrying out carbonization and graphitization treatment on the carbon nanotube fiber-graphene oxide composite membrane to carry out thermal reduction, or carrying out chemical reduction treatment on the carbon nanotube fiber-graphene oxide composite membrane to obtain the oriented carbon nanotube fiber-graphene composite membrane. Graphene in the oriented carbon nanotube fiber-graphene composite membrane is uniformly distributed on the surface of carbon nanotube fibers, and the carbon nanotube fibers are subjected to quantitative drafting in the film forming process and have good orientation. The oriented carbon nanotube fiber-graphene composite film disclosed by the invention has excellent mechanical property, heat conduction property and electric conductivity, and can be widely applied to the fields of mechanics, heat conduction or electric conductivity and the like.

title_en: Wisdom signal lamp device with automatic rising system
abstract_en: The invention provides a smart signal lamp device with an automatic lifting system, which comprises a lamp post and a base, wherein the lamp post is fixedly arranged on the upper side of the base and is of a hollow structure, through holes penetrating through the side surfaces of the lamp post are respectively formed in two opposite side surfaces of the lamp post, a handle can be rotated according to PLC control, so that a rope can be wound on a third pulley, and under the guiding action of the through holes, the support rod can be driven to ascend or descend, so that the smart signal lamp is driven to ascend or descend.

title_en: Multifunctional urban street lamp
abstract_en: The invention provides a multifunctional urban street lamp, which comprises a lamp post, an LED illuminating lamp, a wireless module, a control system, a high-pressure water atomization system and a solar photovoltaic module, wherein the LED illuminating lamp, the wireless module and the control system are all arranged on the lamp post, an equipment control box for controlling the LED illuminating lamp is arranged in the lamp post, and the lamp post is arranged beside a road through a base; the high-pressure water atomization system is arranged at the upper end of the lamp post, and a solar photovoltaic component is arranged on the high-pressure water atomization system and used for supplying power to the high-pressure water atomization system and the LED illuminating lamp; the wireless module is connected with a control system, and the control system is respectively connected with the equipment control box and the high-pressure water atomization system. The multifunctional urban street lamp has the advantages of novel structural design, integrated use, energy conservation, high efficiency, environmental protection, strong expandability and easy implementation.

title_en: Magnetic latching relay mounting structure applied to electric energy meter
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of magnetic latching relays, in particular to a magnetic latching relay mounting structure applied to an electric energy meter, which comprises: the electric energy meter bottom box is provided with an installation slot group; the pushing block is slidably arranged in the electric energy meter bottom box and arranged at one end of the mounting groove group, a clamping groove is formed in the pushing block, and a pushing sheet extending into the mounting groove group is convexly arranged on the pushing block; the magnetic circuit component is fixedly arranged on the electric energy meter bottom box, the clamping groove is slidably arranged on the electric energy meter bottom box, two ends of the clamping groove are fixed on the pushing block, the armature component is arranged on one side of the magnetic circuit component, and a permanent magnet is arranged in the armature component; the moving plate component elastic sheet is arranged on the mounting groove group, one side surface of the moving plate component elastic sheet is opposite to the pushing plate, and the moving plate component elastic sheet can be pushed by the pushing plate; the static sheet component is arranged in the mounting groove group; the mounting copper column is connected with the moving plate assembly and the static plate assembly; the elastic sheet is arranged on the mounting groove group and continuously applies elasticity to enable the movable sheet assembly to be abutted against the static sheet assembly; the invention has the characteristics of compact structure, convenient installation and the like.

title_en: Electric machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a motor which comprises a rotor and an electromagnetic corresponding body, wherein an electric brush A and an electric brush B are arranged on the rotor, the electric brush A and the electric brush B are arranged in an electric communication mode, an inductance conductor A and an inductance conductor B are arranged on the electromagnetic corresponding body, a commutator is arranged on the electromagnetic corresponding body, the inductance conductor A and the inductance conductor B are arranged in an electric communication mode through the commutator, the electric brush A and the electric brush B, the electromagnetic corresponding body is arranged corresponding to the rotor, a magnetic force area on the rotor is set to be a permanent magnetic force area, or a magnetic force area on the rotor is set to be an excitation magnetic force area, and the excitation magnetic force area is connected with the electric brush A and the electric brush B in series. The motor disclosed by the invention can realize the function that the electric brush works when the motor is used as a motor, and the electric brush can be in an idle state when the motor is used as a generator.

title_en: Motor braking method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of motor control, and provides a motor braking method and device and electronic equipment. The braking method comprises the following steps: in response to a braking signal, closing an upper arm of a PWM circuit and conducting a lower arm of the PWM circuit; acquiring a target duty ratio; outputting a duty ratio signal to the PWM circuit according to the target duty ratio; and if the flux linkage of the motor is smaller than a preset flux linkage threshold value, closing the PWM circuit. The braking time is judged by determining whether the flux linkage is lower than a preset flux linkage threshold value, so that the requirement of timely and accurately braking the motor under different loads can be met.

title_en: Conductive paste and solar cell containing same
abstract_en: The invention provides a conductive paste and a solar cell containing the same. The conductive paste comprises micrometer paste and nanometer paste which are respectively and independently packaged, wherein the mass ratio of the micrometer paste to the nanometer paste is (50-99) to (1-50); the raw material composition of the nano-slurry comprises (5-85)% of nano-metal powder, (0-10)% of nano-additive and (15-95)% of organic phase, wherein the total mass of the raw material compositions of the nano-slurry is 100%. The conductive paste has no problem of poor printing. The invention also provides a solar cell containing the conductive paste, and the solar cell has higher photoelectric conversion efficiency.

title_en: Spiral coil's ligature structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a binding structure of a spiral coil, which comprises: the coil comprises a coil cake positioned at the coil outlet, an end ring adjacent to the coil cake, wherein more than two small holes are formed in the position, adjacent to the coil cake, of the end ring, and the coil cake and the end ring are bound into a whole through a binding belt through the small holes. The invention also relates to a binding method of the spiral coil. According to the binding structure and the binding method for the coil outlet of the transformer, the fixation firmness of the spiral coil outlet can be effectively improved under the fixing action of the small holes, the coil is prevented from being damaged when the spiral coil outlet is subjected to a large twisting force, and the operation reliability of the transformer is improved.

title_en: Lead storage battery waste recovery equipment and recovery method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lead storage battery waste recycling device and a recycling method thereof, and the device comprises a workbench, a lifting mechanism, a clamping turnover mechanism, a waste liquid box, a battery body, a chuck, a slideway, a movable seat, a screw rod, a second motor, a through hole and a mounting groove, wherein the clamping turnover mechanism is fixedly arranged on one side of the top of the workbench, the through hole is arranged at the position of the workbench close to the clamping turnover mechanism, the slideways are respectively arranged on both sides of the top of the workbench, the movable seat is arranged on one side of the top of the workbench far away from a fixed seat, the movable seat is connected with the workbench in a sliding manner through the slideway, the lifting mechanism is fixedly connected with the top of the movable seat, the chuck is arranged in the lifting mechanism, the screw rod is arranged on the top of the slideway on one side, the second motor is fixedly arranged at the corner of one side of the workbench, the output shaft of the second motor is fixedly connected with one side of the screw rod, and one side of the movable seat is in threaded connection with the screw rod, this recovery unit can get rid of lead accumulator top cap, collects the acid waste liquid of pouring.

title_en: New forms of energy dust collecting equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of dust removing equipment, and particularly relates to new energy dust removing equipment which aims at solving the problems that the existing dust removing equipment cannot adjust the angle of a solar panel, rainwater is inconvenient to collect, and illumination treatment is inconvenient to carry out at night. The solar energy collecting device is suitable for building construction environments, can automatically adjust the angle of the solar panel according to the movement of the sun, is convenient for collecting rainwater and is convenient for lighting treatment at night.

title_en: Single-inductor multi-output DC-DC converter
abstract_en: The invention provides a single-inductor multiple-output DC-DC converter, comprising: the step-down output circuit comprises a first switch, a second switch, an inductor and N output branches, wherein an input power supply is grounded through the first switch and the second switch which are connected in series; one end of the inductor is connected with a node between the first switch and the second switch, and the other end of the inductor is connected with the second connecting node; in each output branch, a branch switch and a branch capacitor are connected in series between a second connection node and a ground terminal, and a node between the branch switch and the branch capacitor is connected with a branch output end; the first to Nth input ends of the feedback control circuit are respectively connected with the output ends of the N branches, the first to Nth output ends of the feedback control circuit are respectively connected with the control ends of the N branch switches, and the (N + 1) th output end of the feedback control circuit is connected with the control end of the first switch; the (N + 2) th output end of the switch is connected with the control end of the second switch; and a voltage suppressing circuit connected between the second connection node and the ground terminal. Compared with the prior art, the invention can reduce the chip area and the energy loss.

title_en: Charging and discharging control method and energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention provides a charge-discharge control method and an energy storage system, which are applied to the technical field of direct current energy storage, wherein a preset voltage range is set, the lower limit value of the preset voltage range is larger than the upper limit value of the rated voltage range of a DC/DC converter, and after the battery voltage of the energy storage battery voltage is obtained, if the obtained battery voltage is in the preset voltage range, a battery storage mode is executed: and controlling the DC/DC converter in the energy storage inverter to be in a bypass state, and controlling the DC/AC converter in the energy storage inverter to carry out commutation work. According to the method, under the condition that the battery voltage is larger than the upper limit value of the rated voltage range of the DC/DC converter, the DC/DC converter is controlled to be in a bypass state, the DC/AC converter directly conducts current conversion work, and the limitation of the DC/DC converter is removed, so that the battery voltage is matched with a higher battery voltage, and the use range of the energy storage inverter can be enlarged within a certain range.

title_en: Low-noise shaftless pump with compact structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a shaftless pump, which is formed by changing a three-phase squirrel-cage motor, wherein the motor is used as a pump body: the stator is the pump shell, and the rotor is the pump wheel. The rotor frame is a squirrel-cage structure made of metal or permanent magnet material. The metal or permanent magnetic material frame is embedded in the outer wall of an engineering plastic cylinder. The inner wall of the plastic cylinder is in an internal thread shape. When the rotor rotates, the inner screw can drive the liquid. End covers are arranged at two ends of the stator. A plane ball bearing is arranged among the end cover, the rotor and the shell, and a liner and a bearing frame made of polytetrafluoroethylene materials are arranged.

title_en: Electric connector and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric connector and a manufacturing method thereof, which are characterized by comprising the following steps: the insulation body is provided with an outer side edge, a plurality of grooves are inwards recessed from the outer side edge, and two convex blocks are inwards protruded from two opposite sides of the grooves to the grooves; the substrate is provided with a plurality of material connecting parts which are integrally connected with the same material belt before injection molding; after injection molding, the plurality of material connecting portions are disconnected with the material belt, the material connecting portions are located in the grooves, the upper surfaces and the lower surfaces of the material connecting portions are exposed in the grooves, the material connecting portions do not exceed the outer side edges outwards, the material connecting portions can be prevented from being scraped by external objects, and workers can be prevented from being scratched by the material connecting portions. The two opposite sides of the connecting part are abutted against the two bumps, and the two bumps can absorb damage caused by acting force applied when the material belt is removed, so that the structural integrity of the insulating body is facilitated.

title_en: Preparation method of high-power ultralow-temperature lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a high-power ultralow-temperature lithium ion battery, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: preparing raw materials including a positive plate, a negative plate, a diaphragm and electrolyte into a coiled lithium ion battery cell, and then carrying out formation treatment, wherein the formation treatment comprises the following steps of 1) charging for 200-280 min at a constant current of 0.02-0.06C; 2) charging to the charge cut-off voltage V at the constant current of 0.08-0.12C 1 Then the constant voltage charging is carried out by the charging cut-off voltage V1 until the current is less than or equal to 0.02C. The lithium ion single battery prepared by the invention can meet the discharge capacity of-50-55 ℃, and the 0.5C discharge capacity can reach more than 70% of rated capacity at the ultralow temperature of-40 ℃, and 1C discharge capacity can reach more than 50% of rated capacity. The 0.5C discharge capacity at minus 50 ℃ and ultralow temperature can reach 50 percent of rated capacity, and the low-temperature discharge rate performance of the lithium battery is enlarged.

title_en: Method and device for transmitting data to mobile terminal by using three-color LED
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for transmitting data to a mobile terminal by using three-color LEDs, wherein the three-color LEDs are matched with an LED controller to emit light, and a camera of the mobile terminal is used for completing data transmission from information to the camera of the mobile terminal. According to the invention, according to 8 luminous states of the three-color LED, the all-off state is used as a data transmission indication state or a background indication, and the luminous colors formed by the rest 7 luminous states are expressed in a 7-system mode. The invention takes the three-color LED all-off state as the data transmission indication state or the background indication, and takes all-off as the synchronous signal, so that error codes generated by data acquisition out-of-step can be avoided; within one cycle, valid data may be transmitted twice in synchronization. The invention has the advantages of low power consumption, higher transmission bit rate, large information capacity, small volume and low cost of the transmitting end.

title_en: High-current high-voltage vacuum diode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-current high-voltage vacuum diode, and aims to solve the problem that a vacuum diode insulator is easy to generate surface flashover. The invention is composed of an insulator, an anode, a cathode, a shielding ring, a flange and a sealing ring, wherein the cathode, the shielding ring, the insulator and the anode are coaxially nested from inside to outside, the outer edge of the insulator is tightly pressed on the inner wall of the anode through the flange and the sealing ring, and the shielding ring is screwed at the right end of the cathode; the anode is grounded, the side surface is provided with air holes, and the air holes are externally connected with a vacuum unit. The insulator is in a long conical hollow structure, a medium area of the high-power pulse driving source is isolated from a vacuum area in the anode cylinder, and a cathode is inserted into the hollow part of the insulator. The shielding ring is a disc-shaped metal structure with a round tube and consists of the round tube, the disc and the cylinder, and the shielding ring can block a part of electron beams flowing back along magnetic lines of force to prevent the electron beams from bombarding the surface of the insulator. The invention solves the problems that the vacuum diode insulator is easy to generate surface flashover, and the electron beam guided by the magnetic field is easy to reflux along the magnetic force line to bombard the cathode.

title_en: New energy station power generation control method based on power generation priority on master station side
abstract_en: The invention relates to a new energy station power generation control method based on power generation priority on a master station side, which comprises the following steps of S1: estimating the regulating quantity of each new energy station which is adjusted to the maximum capacity and the regulating quantity which is adjusted to the lower control limit in a control period; step S2: estimating section regulating quantity of the section with different priority power limits on the section based on the power generation capacity and the power generation priority of each new energy station under the section; and step S3: according to the active power of the section, the section limit value and the section regulating quantity, the priority of the actual power limit of the section is estimated; and step S4: and traversing the new energy station in the section according to the actual power limiting priority, and determining the control target of the new energy station. The invention realizes the purpose of meeting the power generation priority of the new energy station while ensuring the safe active control of the power grid.

title_en: Plasma processing method and plasma processing apparatus
abstract_en: Provided are a plasma processing method and a plasma processing apparatus for suppressing an etching shape defect of an organic film. The plasma treatment method comprises a step of repairing the shape of a mask, wherein the step of repairing the shape of the mask comprises a step of modifying the side wall of the opening of the mask, and a step of etching the upper surface of the mask.

title_en: Generating set for elevator handrail sterilization system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of generator sets, in particular to a generator set for an elevator handrail belt sterilization system, which comprises an inner machine shell assembly, a generator assembly arranged in the inner machine shell assembly, a generator control panel and an ultraviolet light source panel, wherein the inner machine shell assembly comprises a shell body and a shell body; two ends of the generator assembly are horizontally inserted into the inner shell assembly; the generator assembly is electrically connected with a generator control panel, and the generator control panel and the ultraviolet light source plate are respectively and fixedly arranged on two sides of the inner casing assembly. This generating set for elevator handrail area sterilization system, simple structure can realize it from electricity generation through the operation of elevator handrail area, and the energy saving reduces the energy consumption, when guaranteeing elevator handrail area bactericidal effect, improves whole sterilization system's availability factor, is convenient for extensively promote and use.

title_en: Supporting wiring connection structure of smart power grids
abstract_en: The invention discloses a matching wiring connection structure of a smart grid, which comprises a first support plate and a second support plate, wherein two first connecting plates are symmetrically connected to the outer side of the first support plate, two second connecting plates are symmetrically connected to the outer side of the second support plate, the first connecting plates and the second connecting plates are circular, sealing rings which are in contact with the first support plate and the second support plate are connected to the surfaces, close to each other, of the first connecting plates and the second connecting plates, clamping mechanisms are arranged at the ends, close to each other, of the first connecting plates and the second connecting plates, and a first fixing block is vertically connected to the end, close to each other, of the first connecting plates. According to the invention, the waterproof mechanism is arranged, so that moisture can be prevented from permeating into the connecting structure, and the short circuit at the connecting part of the first electric wire and the second electric wire can be avoided, thus the service life of the first electric wire and the second electric wire can be prolonged.

title_en: Battery pack
abstract_en: The battery pack comprises a battery holder and a battery unit detachably arranged on the battery holder. The battery unit comprises a battery, a first clamping part and a second clamping part, wherein the first clamping part and the second clamping part are arranged at the end part of the battery, and the second clamping part can move relative to the end part. The battery fixing seat comprises a clamping piece, wherein the clamping piece is clamped with the first clamping part to position the battery unit at a first position, and the clamping piece is clamped with the second clamping part to position the battery unit at a second position. When the clamping piece and the first clamping part move relatively along the unlocking direction to release the clamping, the battery unit moves from the first position to the second position along the disengaging direction, and the second clamping part is allowed to move relative to the end part to release the clamping with the clamping piece, so that the battery unit moves again along the disengaging direction to disengage from the battery fixing seat. After the clamping of the battery pack at the first position is released, the clamping of the battery pack at the second position can be still maintained, so that the battery unit is effectively prevented from directly falling to reduce the damage of the battery unit.

title_en: UPS control circuit and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a UPS control circuit and a control method, wherein the UPS control circuit comprises a UPS, a power converter U1, a bidirectional DC/DC power supply U2 and a super capacitor module C1, wherein the AC input end of the UPS and the input end of the power converter U1 are connected with an AC power supply, the output end of the power converter U1 is connected with the DC input end of the UPS, the first end of a bidirectional DC/DC power supply U2 is connected with the output end of a power supply U1, the second end of the bidirectional DC/DC power supply U2 is connected with the super capacitor module C1, and a super capacitor module C1 is connected with the DC input end of the UPS.
