According to the invention, the super capacitor module C1 is used for supplying power to the UPS when the alternating current power supply is powered off, and the bidirectional DC/DC power supply U2 starts a reverse working mode to supply power to the UPS, so that seamless switching of the power supply end of the UPS is realized, the power failure of the UPS caused by too long time consumption of starting the reverse working mode by the bidirectional DC/DC power supply U2 after the alternating current power supply is powered off is avoided, and the normal work of a load is ensured.

title_en: Processing equipment for skewed slot of motor stator core
abstract_en: The invention discloses a machining device for a chute of a motor stator core, and relates to the technical field of motor production. According to the invention, air suction is carried out from the front side of the grille net through the operation of the air suction device, partial noise can be brought into the inner cavity of the sound absorption pipeline through air, the air enters the noise reduction pipe through the dust removal pipe, the noise is diffused through the matching of the honeycomb noise reduction pipe and the sound absorption sponge filling block, the function of absorbing the noise in the air is realized, then the air flows to the top of the sponge arc plate through the bottom of the smooth arc plate, and the noise is reduced through the vibration of the noise reduction under the matching of the sponge arc plate and the sound absorption arm.

title_en: Electrostatic elimination structure on operating room door
abstract_en: The invention discloses a static electricity eliminating structure on an operating room door, which belongs to the field of operating room devices and comprises a handle static electricity automatic eliminating part, an operating room door grounding part and a top static electricity automatic eliminating part. Wherein the handle static electricity automatic eliminating part is arranged on a door handle of an operating room. The operating room door grounding part is used for keeping the operating room door and the ground wire to be connected at any time. The top static electricity automatic eliminating part is arranged at the top of the operating room door and is used for eliminating static electricity for people passing below. The static electricity eliminating structure on the operating room door disclosed by the invention not only can eliminate static electricity for people contacting with the door handle of the operating room door and people passing through the operating room door, but also can keep electrical connection with the ground wire constantly, so that static electricity stored in the operating room door is avoided, and each static electricity eliminating structure is automatically controlled, so that the static electricity eliminating structure is not required to be manually operated, can eliminate the static electricity only by passing through the operating room door, is convenient and fast, and has high static electricity eliminating efficiency.

title_en: Small bending radius low-loss flexible support superconducting cable for superconducting magnet
abstract_en: The invention provides a small-bending-radius low-loss flexible support superconducting cable for a superconducting magnet, which sequentially comprises a central cooling pipe, a cable stabilizing layer, a superconducting layer and a cable protecting layer from inside to outside; the central cooling pipe is a spiral pipe, and the outer surface of the pipeline of the spiral pipe is provided with a flat surface with a first preset width; a cable stabilizing layer consisting of conductive strips is wound on the flat outer surface of the spiral tube at a first preset small angle, and preset gaps are reserved between the strips of the cable stabilizing layer in the axial direction; a superconductive layer is wound on the cable stabilizing layer, and a preset gap is reserved between strips of the superconductive layer in the axial direction; gaps with a second preset width are reserved between pipelines on the outer surface of the spiral pipe, and the gap value is smaller than the width of the strip material adopted by the stabilizing layer; the cooling medium is circulated between the superconducting layer and the stabilizing layer of the superconducting cable through the gaps and the predetermined gaps of the cable stabilizing layer and the superconducting layer, so that the cooling medium can directly contact the superconducting layer and the cable stabilizing layer.

title_en: Heat tracing cable state monitoring system and monitoring method based on wireless network transmission
abstract_en: A heat tracing cable state monitoring system and method based on wireless network transmission. At present, the heat tracing cable of a power plant is not provided with a state monitoring function, and the running state of the heat tracing cable can not be monitored in real time only by daily routing inspection of maintainers. The invention comprises the following components: pt100 thermal resistance temperature element (4), Pt100 thermal resistance temperature element is connected with temperature acquisition system (3), temperature acquisition system is connected with wireless acquisition terminal DTU (2), wireless acquisition terminal DTU passes through antenna (1) and is connected with internet (13), wireless acquisition terminal DTU is connected with state acquisition system (6), state acquisition system respectively with state relay (7), it is connected to accompany hot cable structure (5), the internet passes through telecommunication network and is connected with preventing hot wall (12), prevent that hot wall is connected with switch (11), the switch is connected with data communication server (10), data communication server connects computer control system (9). The invention is used for the heat tracing cable state monitoring system of wireless network transmission.

title_en: Lithium-rich manganese-based composite cathode material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a lithium-rich manganese-based composite positive electrode material, which comprises secondary particles, wherein the secondary particles comprise: the inner core is a high-nickel ternary material; the shell is primary particles of the lithium-rich manganese-based positive electrode material. The invention adopts the lithium-rich manganese-based anode material and the single crystal material to construct the composite secondary spherical particles so as to obtain the high-capacity lithium-rich manganese-based composite anode material. The lithium-rich manganese-based composite anode material provided by the invention is used as an anode material of a lithium ion battery, and the battery has high energy density and long service life. The invention also provides a preparation method and application of the lithium-rich manganese-based composite positive electrode material.

title_en: Secondary battery
abstract_en: A secondary battery is provided. The secondary battery includes: a protective module package including a tab bridge, input/output terminals, and an insulator including a middle block having the input/output terminals therein and a side block spaced apart from the middle block, the tab bridge connecting the middle block to the side block; and a bare cell including an electrode electrically connected to the tab bridge.

title_en: Power supply control method, power supply module and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply control method, a power supply module and a storage medium, wherein the power supply control method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target current value and an actual current value of the step-down conversion circuit; calculating a current difference value between the target current value and the actual current value; obtaining a first duty ratio according to the current difference value, and performing iterative calculation on the current difference value in the current power supply period and the current difference value in the last power supply period to obtain a second duty ratio, wherein the second duty ratio is used for generating a current signal opposite to the ripple current; and correcting the first duty ratio according to the second duty ratio to obtain an actual control duty ratio of the buck conversion circuit, and controlling a switching tube of the buck conversion circuit according to the actual control duty ratio. The method can reduce the ripple influence and improve the power supply stability of the power supply.

title_en: Intelligent energy-saving frequency converter control system
abstract_en: The application relates to an intelligent energy-saving frequency converter control system which comprises a frequency converter body, a fan, a frequency converter temperature detection unit, an ambient temperature detection unit and a controller. The fan is used for supplying air to the frequency converter body; the frequency converter temperature detection unit is arranged on the frequency converter body and used for detecting the real-time temperature of the frequency converter body; the frequency converter temperature detection unit sends the frequency converter temperature to the controller; the environment temperature detection unit is arranged on the fan and used for detecting the real-time temperature of the frequency converter body and the environment where the fan is located; and the ambient temperature detection unit sends the ambient temperature to the controller. The controller adjusts the rotating speed of the fan in real time according to the temperature of the frequency converter, the ambient temperature and the temperature difference between the temperature of the frequency converter and the ambient temperature, namely, the power of the fan is reduced on the premise of meeting the heat dissipation requirement of the frequency converter, so that the energy consumption is reduced.

title_en: Clean effectual insecticidal street lamp
abstract_en: The invention relates to an insecticidal street lamp with good cleaning effect, which comprises a base, a fixed rod, a cross rod, a glass plate, a fixed box, an insecticidal mechanism and a cleaning mechanism, wherein the insecticidal mechanism comprises an electric net box, a lamp tube, a connecting rod, a driving assembly and a vibration assembly, the cleaning mechanism comprises a water spraying assembly and a cleaning assembly, the insecticidal street lamp with good cleaning effect realizes the rotation of a paddle through wind power, thereby realizing the movement of the electric net box through a cam, further realizing the cleaning of a main body on the electric net box, enabling the main body on the electric net box to fall on the glass plate through vibration, realizing the limit of a sliding block through a bead screw, enabling the electric net box to realize the knocking of the cam through the restoring force of a first spring, further improving the vibration effect, improving the cleaning effect on the electric net box, realizing the cleaning of the main body on the glass plate through the cleaning mechanism, and realizing the uniform collection of, improve illuminating effect, the operating personnel of being convenient for simultaneously has reduced intensity of labour to the collection of main part.

title_en: Alkaline dry cell
abstract_en: An alkaline dry battery, comprising: a positive electrode comprising manganese dioxide, a negative electrode comprising zinc and/or a zinc alloy, a separator disposed between the positive and negative electrodes, and an alkaline electrolyte comprising at least 1 sulfonyl-containing anion selected from the group consisting of bis (perfluoroalkylsulfonyl) imide anions, bis (fluorosulfonyl) imide anions, and fluorosulfonic acid anions.

title_en: Niobium-based oxide material, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a niobium-based oxide material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the niobium-based oxide material is Nb with a three-dimensional porous structure 2 O 5 The size of the niobium-based oxide material is micron-sized, and the micron-sized niobium-based oxide material ensures that the electrode has high tap density, is beneficial to improving the volumetric specific energy of the battery, and ensures the good safety and stability of the battery.

title_en: Generator
abstract_en: According to the generator provided by the invention, the plurality of solenoid coils are arranged in the interlayer of the permanent magnet, and magnetic field energy generated after the plurality of solenoid coils are electrified is superposed with a magnetic field generated by the permanent magnet, so that the magnetic induction intensity is increased, and the current is increased along with the increase of the magnetic induction intensity. Compared with the existing generator, the generator provided by the embodiment of the invention overcomes the defects that the existing generator is weak in magnetic induction intensity and cannot generate strong current.

title_en: Multiphase buck converter and method of operating the same
abstract_en: Buck converters use flying capacitors and cross-coupling. The flying capacitor reduces voltage stress across the inductor and device and may provide high efficiency at very low duty cycle ratios. In addition to the high efficiency performance, the converter may provide a significant reduction in area because smaller inductors may be used as compared to typical buck converters. One implementation example shows up to 90% efficiency at the 0.5V output and 10A load from the 3.6V input with a small flying capacitor compared to capacitors typically used in switched capacitor converters.

title_en: Laser emission and dynamic calibration device, method, equipment and medium based on image processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a laser emission and dynamic calibration device, method, equipment and medium based on image processing, wherein the device comprises: the image acquisition system is used for acquiring images of the target and the laser spot; the image processing system is connected with the image acquisition system and is used for extracting the attribute and the coordinate information of the target and extracting the coordinate information of the laser spot; the control system is connected with the image processing system and used for aiming or calibrating the laser emission angle according to the result of the image processing system and sending an instruction to the laser emission system; the laser emission system is bound with the image acquisition system, is connected with the control system and is used for calibrating the laser emission angle or emitting laser according to the instruction of the control system. The invention completes the automatic adjustment of the laser emission angle by decomposing the angle to be adjusted of the laser emission into the angles in the transverse direction and the longitudinal direction, and realizes the automatic aiming and emission of the laser.

title_en: Biomass-based graphitized carbon/Fe7S8Method for preparing composite material
abstract_en: The invention provides biomass-based graphitized carbon/Fe 7 S 8 A method for preparing a composite material. The method comprises the following steps: 1. pretreatment of biomass material; 2. treating iron ions; 3. carrying out graphitization treatment; 4. and (6) vulcanization treatment. The method adopts a two-step calcination method to prepare biomass-based graphitized carbon/Fe 7 S 8 Composite material, first calcining process to form graphitized carbon/Fe 3 C intermediate substance for chemically bonding iron element with carbon substrate, and secondary calcining treatment for making Fe 3 C in situ conversion of Fe 7 S 8 Nanoparticles and a composite structure coated with graphitized carbon. The product obtainedCan be directly used as the lithium ion battery cathode material without the post-treatment steps of acid washing, water washing and the like. The method has simple process, adopts cheap biomass as a carbon source, is environment-friendly and can be used for large-scale preparation. Prepared biomass-based graphitized carbon/Fe 7 S 8 The composite material as a lithium ion battery cathode material shows excellent cycling stability and rate capability.

title_en: Underground pipe gallery cable laying method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for laying underground pipe gallery cables, which comprises the following steps: (1) cable fixing: connecting and fixing a cable connecting piece of the underground pipe gallery cable paying-off robot and a cable to be laid on a cable supply device; (2) cable paying-off: the underground pipe gallery cable paying-off robot travels in the underground pipe gallery according to a set requirement; in the advancing process of the underground pipe gallery cable paying-off robot, the paying-off navigation obstacle avoidance unit of the underground pipe gallery cable paying-off robot constantly detects environmental obstacles and transmits the environmental obstacles to a paying-off control system, and the paying-off control system controls a paying-off supporting unit to avoid obstacles and advance; (3) cable management: drawing the cable to be laid in the underground pipe gallery to a bridge frame set by the underground pipe gallery through a cable arranging robot to finish the laying operation of the corresponding cable; (4) And (5) repeating the step (2) and the step (3) until the cable is laid. The method has the advantages of less manpower input, higher laying efficiency and better application value.

title_en: Motor stator manufacturing and processing machine and processing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a motor stator manufacturing processing machine and a processing method. The motor stator manufacturing and processing machine and the processing method provided by the invention can solve the problems that the length of copper wires to be wound is long, the structure of a winding wire group of a stator core is complex, the manual winding efficiency is low, meanwhile, the winding copper wires wound manually are not compact, and when the motor stator is manufactured by the existing motor stator manufacturing and processing machine, the copper wires are difficult to supply during the winding of the needle head due to the fact that the diameter of common copper wires is thin, the existing motor stator manufacturing and processing machine usually adopts the needle head winding wire group, and the copper wires are difficult to supply during the winding of the needle head, so that the copper wires are easy to break in the process of winding the copper wires by the existing motor stator manufacturing and processing machine.

title_en: Heat-resistant rare earth aluminum alloy conductor for power cable and processing technology thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat-resistant rare earth aluminum alloy conductor for a power cable, which comprises an outer protective layer, wherein the inner wall of the outer protective layer is fixedly connected with an armor layer, the inner wall of the armor layer is fixedly connected with an inner liner, the inner wall of the inner liner is fixedly connected with a wrapping tape, the inner wall of the wrapping tape is fixedly connected with a filling layer, the inner wall of the filling layer is fixedly connected with an insulating layer, and the inner wall of the insulating layer is fixedly connected with an aluminum alloy conductor. The heat-resistant rare earth aluminum alloy conductor prepared by the processing technology is compatible with two conductor characteristics of 8030 and 8A07 at the same time, so that the heat-resistant rare earth aluminum alloy conductor can be used in a power cable, has the flexibility of 8030 rod materials and the heat resistance of 8A07, the conductor resistivity at 20 ℃ is not more than 29.73n omega.m, the tensile strength is 110-.

title_en: Conductive track and lighting equipment are inhaled to magnetism
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses conductive track and lighting apparatus are inhaled to magnetism, conductive track is inhaled to magnetism is used for assembling on the installation basis and can form magnetic adsorption and electricity with lighting device and be connected, and conductive track is inhaled to magnetism includes installation main part and a pair of conductive substrate. The conductive substrate comprises a magnetic absorption layer, an insulating layer and a conductive layer; the magnetism suction layer orientation the installation side of installation main part, the conducting layer orientation the connection side of installation main part is exposed outside and is supplied lighting device to get the electricity, the magnetism suction layer can be used for adsorbing connection lighting device. The conductive track is magnetically attracted by the conductive substrate, so that the conductive substrate has a conductive function and a magnetic attraction property, and the conductive structure and the magnetic attraction structure are combined into a whole, so that the assembly process is simplified, and the cost is lower; meanwhile, the conductive substrate can be conveniently and visually detected in a power taking mode at the lower parts of the two sides of the guide rail.

title_en: Uninterrupted power source and energy storage system
abstract_en: The application provides an uninterruptible power supply and an energy storage system, wherein the uninterruptible power supply is applied to the energy storage system, an alternating current end of a rectifying circuit is connected with an alternating current power supply, a direct current end of the rectifying circuit is connected with a direct current bus, and meanwhile, a direct current output port is connected with the direct current bus; the first direct current end of the DC/DC circuit is connected with a direct current bus, and the second direct current end of the DC/DC circuit is connected with a battery pack; the DC end of the inverter circuit is connected with a DC bus, and the AC end is connected with an AC output port. The uninterrupted power supply only carries out one-stage power conversion from alternating current input to direct current output, namely the rectification circuit, and the alternating current input to the alternating current output can directly pass through the bypass, so that the power conversion loss from the alternating current input to the direct current output or the alternating current output is reduced. Moreover, the online time of the input alternating current power supply in the energy storage system is far longer than the offline time, and the power of the uninterruptible direct current power supply consumed by the energy storage system is larger than that of the uninterruptible alternating current power supply, so that the whole working efficiency of the uninterruptible power supply is improved by the scheme.

title_en: Embedded bird recognition system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an embedded bird identification system, which comprises a bird repelling unit, a bird identification unit and a bird identification unit, wherein the bird repelling unit comprises a protective case and a positioning mechanism arranged in the protective case; the main control unit is arranged on the protection case and comprises an acquisition module and a processing module; the power supply unit is connected with the bird repelling unit and the main control unit through a power transmission line; and the client terminal is in wireless communication with the main control unit. The bird damage control device can automatically identify birds through artificial intelligence according to the sound image characteristics of different birds, analyze bird distribution conditions and bird damage occurrence probability, is beneficial to finding and treating bird damage in a targeted manner, and adopts solar energy to supply power, save energy and protect environment; the bird damage prevention device provided by the invention utilizes green laser with the wavelength of 532 nm/power of 500mw to effectively drive birds, and can effectively protect equipment such as laser and sensors when the environment is severe and the use is less, so that the service life of the equipment is prolonged.

title_en: Press-fit terminal
abstract_en: A press-fit terminal (10) that is inserted into a through-hole (31) provided in a circuit board (30) in an insertion direction, the press-fit terminal comprising: a base (11) extending in the insertion direction; a tip portion (12) provided at the front side in the insertion direction with respect to the base portion (11) and having a tip portion side corner portion (14); and a pair of deformation parts (13) which connect the base part (11) and the front end part (12) and are in contact with the inner wall of the through hole (31) to be elastically deformed, wherein deformation part side corner parts (15) are arranged on the pair of deformation parts (13), the pair of deformation parts (13) are provided with easy deformation parts (16), the easy deformation parts (16) are parts of which the curvature Radius (RL) of a curved surface arranged at the outer deformation part side corner part (15A) is larger than the curvature Radius (RS) of a curved surface arranged at the front end part side corner part (14), and the outer deformation part side corner part (15A) is the deformation part side corner part which is positioned at the outer side in the direction intersecting with the insertion direction in the deformation part side corner parts (15).

title_en: Landscape lighting design method and landscape lighting system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landscape lighting design method and a landscape lighting system, wherein the landscape lighting design method comprises the following steps: acquiring integral position information; setting lighting equipment and planning a control circuit of the lighting equipment; arranging and connecting lighting equipment and a control circuit; establishing a data path request and obtaining a response; sending a request for establishing a data path to control equipment; transmitting the display data to the control device via the data path; controlling the lighting equipment to display according to the display data; and acquiring a display effect, and judging whether the lighting equipment and the control circuit need to be adjusted according to the display effect. Therefore, the design environment and the field environment are effectively combined, problems can be found in time, the lighting equipment and the control circuit can be adjusted accordingly, remote point distribution operation and verification can be carried out at the design end without cooperation of technicians, data can be updated to the control system remotely, repeated round trip at the design position and the construction field is not needed, manpower and communication cost are saved, and working efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Variable torque formula overload protection device and prevent overload motor thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a variable torque type overload protection device and an overload-proof motor thereof, belonging to the technical field of motors and comprising an outer sleeve body, an inner sleeve body and a limiting body, wherein the inner sleeve body is arranged in the outer sleeve body and can synchronously rotate with the outer sleeve body; wherein the motor can make the inner and outer cover body produce relative displacement. The overload protection device realizes overload protection through a mechanical structure, can form a plurality of torque critical values, realizes a torque variable overload protection mode, and can realize control of the plurality of critical values so as to meet different working conditions.

title_en: Auxiliary device is used in lamp pole installation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lamp post installation, and discloses an auxiliary device for lamp post installation, which comprises a first fixing plate, wherein a second fixing plate is vertically arranged at the rear side of the first fixing plate, a first servo motor is fixedly installed in the middle of the front side of the first fixing plate, and a motor shaft of the first servo motor penetrates through the front side of the first fixing plate and is fixedly connected with a rotating rod. According to the invention, the lamp post is horizontally placed in the fixed groove and the position of the lamp post is adjusted, the connecting block at the bottom side of the clamping block is inserted into the connecting groove, the pushing block is loosened, the pushing positioning pin can be inserted into the positioning groove through the elasticity of the spring, further, the two groups of clamping blocks can fix the lamp post in the fixed groove, the first servo motor is controlled to work to drive the lamp post to rotate to a vertical state, the second servo motor is controlled to work to drive the screw rod to rotate clockwise and anticlockwise, and the screw rod which further rotates can push the lamp post in the vertical state to move downwards, so that the bottom end of the lamp post is inserted into the soil pit to be fixed.

title_en: Electric energy distribution method and device
abstract_en: The application provides an electric energy distribution method and device, and relates to a power supply technology. The electric energy distribution method can obtain the power output by the solar power generation module and the state of charge value of the energy storage battery module; under the condition that the state of charge value belongs to the first state of charge interval and the output power is larger than the minimum required power of the load power supply module, the power output by the solar power generation module is indicated to supply power for the energy storage battery module while providing power capable of running for the load. And determining the value of the power supply power output by the load power supply module and the value of the charging power for charging the energy storage battery module according to the output power and the rated power of the load power supply module. Therefore, the energy storage battery module can have higher energy storage, and the load power supply module outputs higher power supply energy for the load, so that the load equipment can operate because of being supplied with power.

title_en: Driving method and driving circuit of flat motor and electronic equipment
abstract_en: A driving method of a flat motor, comprising: the signal triggering circuit sends a starting instruction for instructing starting of the flat motor to the processor; the processor receives a starting instruction, sends a first trigger instruction to the voltage processing circuit after receiving the starting instruction, and after receiving the first trigger instruction, the voltage processing circuit provides a first working voltage V1 to the flat motor and provides a second working voltage V0 to the flat motor after a first time period; the signal triggering circuit sends a motor running stopping instruction to the processor; when the processor receives a motor running stopping instruction, the processor stops sending a first trigger instruction to the pressure processing circuit; the slow stop circuit provides trigger voltage for the voltage stabilizing circuit in a second time period to control the voltage stabilizing circuit to output voltage, and the voltage stabilizing circuit provides reverse voltage for the flat motor under the control of the switch circuit. By adopting the technical scheme, the quick start can be realized when the flat motor vibrates, the starting time when the flat motor vibrates is shortened, and the user experience is favorably improved.

title_en: Bluetooth charging control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Bluetooth charging control system, which comprises a charger body and an external intelligent terminal, wherein the charger body comprises a shell, a display part connected with the shell, a key module, a battery jar, a battery button and an I/O interface, the display part comprises a display screen and a plurality of indicator lamps, the Bluetooth charging control system also comprises a communication module, and the communication module comprises a voltage detection module, a current detection module and a Bluetooth module, so that the problems that the charger in the prior art is not intelligent, the charging system is complex in structure, a large number of chips are consumed, and related data feedback cannot be obtained in time are solved.

title_en: Intelligent light control system for vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vehicle lamp control, in particular to an intelligent vehicle light control system, which comprises a vehicle-mounted sensor node, an ECU, a LoRa wireless communication module and a plurality of vehicle light controllers, wherein the vehicle-mounted sensor node transmits acquired vehicle ambient environment parameters and vehicle running state parameters to the ECU in a wireless mode, the ECU outputs a corresponding vehicle light working condition adjusting command to the vehicle light controllers through the LoRa wireless communication module after certain analysis and processing, and the vehicle light working conditions are adjusted through the vehicle light controllers. The intelligent control system can realize intelligent control of the car lamp, thereby avoiding errors caused by manual operation as much as possible, and has the characteristics of automation, intelligence and multiple functions.

title_en: White balance control method for RGBW lamp and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a white balance control method for RGBW lamps and application thereof, wherein the scheme comprises the following steps: acquiring a target chromaticity coordinate according to the input RGB value; acquiring a dominant wavelength according to the coordinates of a target chromaticity; judging whether the target chromaticity coordinate is positioned outside the color gamut space according to the dominant wavelength; if so, obtaining an intersection point with a sideline of the color gamut space according to the extension line of the main wavelength; taking the intersection point as a chromaticity coordinate to be calculated of mixed light calculation; adjusting the dominant wavelength of the chromaticity coordinate to be calculated to be consistent with the dominant wavelength of the target chromaticity coordinate; acquiring tristimulus values of the RGBW lamp according to chromaticity coordinates to be calculated; acquiring a duty ratio value when the luminous flux of the RGBW lamp is maximum according to the tristimulus values, wherein the duty ratio value is taken as the maximum duty ratio value; acquiring a final duty ratio value of the input RBG value according to the input RGB value and the maximum duty ratio value; adjust the RGBW lamp according to final duty cycle value, this application has the advantage that adjusts convenience, mixing of colors precision height, can not the color cast.

title_en: Chip and battery integrated integration method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chip and battery integrated integration method, which comprises the steps of uniformly printing or coating anode material slurry on the surface of a chip conductive shell to form an anode film, and drying; the positive electrode film is covered with a diaphragm and a negative electrode material in sequence to form a sandwich structure of the battery; covering a battery core shell with a sealing ring on a base on the battery with a sandwich structure, and bonding an insulating hot melt adhesive at the contact position of the sealing ring and the chip conductive shell for fixation; and respectively connecting the positive and negative connecting wires to the PCB. In addition, the integrated equipment for the chip and the battery is disclosed, a current collector of a positive electrode material is omitted, the integral structure of the chip and the battery is optimized, the integrated flow line production of the chip and the battery is easy to realize, the production efficiency is improved, and meanwhile, the miniaturization of the device of the Internet of things is realized; and the power supply requirements of chips with different functions can be met.

title_en: Water surface garbage fishing equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses water surface garbage salvaging equipment which comprises an annular support, wherein a plurality of connecting cross rods are fixedly connected to one side of the annular support, one end, away from the annular support, of each connecting cross rod is fixedly connected with a connecting vertical rod, the upper end of each connecting vertical rod is fixedly connected with an installation seat, a driving box is fixedly connected onto each installation seat, a driving device is arranged in each driving box, a photovoltaic assembly is arranged on the upper side of each driving box, and a power assembly is arranged at the bottom end of each driving box. According to the invention, the first driving motor is controlled by the remote controller to enable the power shaft to drive the first spiral blade to work, the fan blade area of the first spiral blade is larger, so that a vortex is generated above the garbage collection barrel, garbage enters the garbage collection barrel from the fan-shaped garbage inlet of the fixing frame by virtue of the vortex and is finally filtered and collected through the net bag, the fishing efficiency is high, workers only need to operate at the bank, and the labor intensity of manpower is greatly reduced.

title_en: Nitrogen-doped porous lamellar carbon and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses nitrogen-doped porous lamellar carbon and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the nitrogen-doped porous lamellar carbon comprises the following steps: and mixing and heating the nitrogen-containing compound, the chloride, the active additive and the carbon source until the mixture is melted together, and calcining the mixture in a protective atmosphere to obtain the nitrogen-doped porous lamellar carbon. The nitrogen-doped porous lamellar carbon has excellent electrochemical performance, simple preparation process, controllable reaction, cleanness, environmental protection and low cost, and has good industrial application prospect.

title_en: Flow divider
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shunting device which comprises a mounting seat, a driving piece, an inner core and an outer sleeve, wherein the driving piece is mounted on the mounting seat; one end of the inner core is in transmission connection with the driving piece, a first liquid passing port and a second liquid passing port are formed in the outer wall of the inner core, and a liquid flow channel communicated with the first liquid passing port and the second liquid passing port is formed in the inner core; the outer sleeve is fixed on the mounting seat, the outer side of the inner core is arranged in a sealing manner, a liquid inlet and a plurality of liquid outlets are formed in the outer wall of the outer sleeve, the liquid inlet is communicated with the first liquid passing port, the driving piece drives the inner core to rotate, and the second liquid passing port can be selectively communicated with one of the liquid outlets. The shunting device of the technical scheme of the invention can improve the battery liquid injection efficiency and ensure the consistency of the pump liquid injection amount.

title_en: Double-stator single-rotor axial magnetic flux hybrid excitation motor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-stator single-rotor axial magnetic flux hybrid excitation motor which comprises two stators and a rotor, wherein the rotor is fixed on a shaft, a bearing is arranged on the shaft, and the stators are in running fit with the rotor. The magnetic conduction cover is embedded in the base in the stator, and at least one of the base, the bearing and the shaft is made of non-magnetic conduction materials. The direct current excitation unit is arranged on the outer circle side of the stator core and fixedly connected in the engine base, a direct current excitation magnetic flux path generated by the direct current excitation unit passes through a closed loop of the soft magnetic pole, the first air gap, the first stator core, the first magnetic conduction cover, the second stator core and the second air gap, and the direct current excitation magnetic flux only passes through the two air gaps. The motor is easy to manufacture, is suitable for batch production, has wide rotating speed operation range and constant-voltage power generation adjustment capacity in operation performance, and also has the advantages of high power density, low demagnetization risk of the permanent magnet and high operation reliability.

title_en: Automatic insect pest detection device for comprehensive land reclamation farmland construction engineering and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic insect pest detection device for land comprehensive farmland reclamation farmland construction engineering and application thereof, wherein the automatic insect pest detection device comprises a stand column, a deinsectization lamp, an infrared camera and a control system; the upright posts are uniformly distributed at intervals at the edge of the farmland; the side surface of the upright post is provided with a vertical rail, and the upper part of the upright post is provided with a lifting device; the lifting device is connected with a steel cable I downwards; the upright post is also provided with a support column; the supporting column is provided with a transverse moving device in a matching way; a steel cable II is connected between the opposite support columns of every two adjacent groups of the upright columns; the steel cable II penetrates through the transverse moving device; the transverse moving device is movably connected with the steel cable II; the deinsectization lamp is movably sleeved with the vertical track; the deinsectization lamp is detachably and movably connected with the lifting device and the transverse moving device; the top of the upright post is also provided with a solar panel. The device can automatically detect the number of pests in the field, and control the pest killing lamp to move to a place with a large number of pests in the horizontal and vertical directions for trapping and killing, and the pest killing effect is excellent.

title_en: Conductive connecting piece and rotary plug
abstract_en: The invention discloses a conductive connecting piece and a rotary plug, which comprise a shell, a rotating disk, a swing seat, a pair of inserting pieces, a fixed electrical connecting piece arranged on the shell and a movable electrical connecting piece arranged on the swing seat, wherein the rotating disk is rotatably arranged on the shell, the pair of inserting pieces arranged at intervals are fixedly inserted into one side of the swing seat, two ends of the swing seat are respectively provided with a conductive shaft for electrically connecting the inserting pieces and the movable electrical connecting piece, and two ends of the swing seat are rotatably arranged on the rotating disk through the conductive shafts. Through directly stretching out a pair of inserted sheet from the front end of casing, form rotary plug's first form, and through stirring the inserted sheet, make to swing the seat and rotate to the inserted sheet and be perpendicular with the surface looks of rotary disk, form rotary plug's second form, the casing can rotate around the rotary disk this moment to adapt to the position of using electrical apparatus and the continuous change in position with electrical apparatus, strengthened rotary plug's suitability.

title_en: Method and system for cleaning surface of solar photovoltaic panel
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for cleaning a solar photovoltaic panel surface, wherein the system is characterized in that the whole cleaning device is arranged on an unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle is provided with an infrared camera and a visible light camera for shooting, a stain positioning system for positioning, and a device for loading a cleaning solution and a device for loading carbon dioxide.

title_en: Power supply loop protection device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a power supply loop protection device and a method, wherein the device comprises: the protection circuit comprises a fuse and a protection unit which are arranged in the power circuit; the protection unit is connected with the fuse in series and used for acquiring a real-time current signal in the power supply loop and performing overcurrent protection on the power supply loop based on the real-time current signal; the specification parameters of the fuse are determined based on the real-time current signals collected by the protection unit. The power supply circuit protection device and the method provided by the invention can quickly and effectively cut off the power supply circuit according to the real-time current signal, and can also provide fuse protection when the protection unit fails.

title_en: LED explosion-proof platform lamp
abstract_en: The invention relates to an LED explosion-proof platform lamp, which comprises a lamp panel II and a plurality of lamp panels I, wherein the lamp panels I are uniformly and fixedly arranged at intervals on the circumference; the second lamp panel is fixedly arranged and is located on one side of one end of the lamp panels. The invention has the advantages of simple structure, reasonable design, realization of 360-degree omnibearing illumination, convenient operation and convenient use.

title_en: Power distribution network area early warning method, system, terminal equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a power distribution network area early warning method, a system, terminal equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the power distribution network area early warning method comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-source fault information of a power distribution network; calculating and obtaining a current fault influence value and an induced fault influence value according to the multi-source fault information; and fusing the obtained current fault influence value and the induced fault influence value to obtain a fusion result, and realizing the early warning of the power distribution network area according to the fusion result. The early warning method disclosed by the application integrates multi-source fault information, has universality for power distribution network fault early warning and has important significance for guaranteeing safe and stable operation of the power distribution network.

title_en: Processing system and preparation process of conductive film
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing system and a preparation process of a conductive film, and relates to the technical field of substrate coating; comprises a first vacuum magnetron coating device used for forming a magnetron sputtering alloy layer on the surface of a film; the second vacuum magnetron coating device is arranged behind the first vacuum magnetron coating device and is used for forming a first copper plating layer on the outer surface of the magnetron sputtering alloy layer; the second copper plating layer forming device is arranged behind the second vacuum magnetic control coating device and is used for forming a second copper plating layer on the outer surface of the first copper plating layer; the water plating device is arranged behind the second copper plating layer forming device and is used for forming a thickened conductive copper layer on the outer surface of the second copper plating layer; the invention has the beneficial effects that: the uniformity and compactness of the copper layer surface are improved, and the quality of the conductive film is improved.

title_en: Concentrating frequency division photovoltaic photo-thermal and geothermal integrated system with solar energy and geothermal energy coupled
abstract_en: The invention provides a solar energy and geothermal energy coupled concentrating and frequency dividing photovoltaic photo-thermal and geothermal energy integrated system, relates to the technical field of energy, and particularly relates to a photovoltaic photo-thermal decoupling solar energy and geothermal energy comprehensive utilization system. The system comprises a geothermal collecting pipe, a first three-way valve, a check valve, a four-way valve, a first water pump, a cooling back plate, a battery, a parabolic trough condenser, a frequency division sheet, a heat collector, a first water storage tank, a first temperature sensor, a second temperature sensor, an electric valve, a boiler, a second three-way valve, a heat exchanger, a water replenishing tank, a heating water return pipe, a second water storage tank, a second water pump, a first valve, a second valve, a heating water supply pipe and a domestic water supply pipe. According to the system, the concentration and frequency division photovoltaic photo-thermal array is used for improving the quality of geothermal resources, so that users supply heat and generate electric energy, the solar spectrum separation and cascade utilization are realized, and the full-spectrum comprehensive utilization rate of solar energy is greatly improved.

title_en: Temporary emergency traffic light for road
abstract_en: The invention discloses a temporary emergency traffic light for roads in the technical field of traffic lights, which comprises a base, wherein a groove is formed in the middle of the base, a storage battery, a PLC (programmable logic controller) control box and a control switch are arranged in the base, the base is a rectangular base, storage grooves are formed in four opposite angles, an electric telescopic rod is hinged to the tops of the storage grooves, an electric telescopic supporting rod is arranged between the upper side of the base and the traffic light, a rotary table is arranged at the top of the traffic light, and a solar cell panel is fixedly connected to the upper side of the rotary table. The device stability is high, and the electric telescopic handle in base four corners extends work to make the gasket in ground in close contact with, the condition that the device that effectively prevents emptys, the convenient orientation adjustment to solar cell panel has improved the conversion to solar energy.

title_en: Automatic steering pedestrian lighting lamp
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of illuminating lamps, in particular to an automatic steering pedestrian illuminating lamp. The automatic illumination device comprises a support, wherein an illumination mechanism is arranged on the support and comprises a fixed shaft and an adjusting illumination part, the fixed shaft is fixedly connected with the support, the adjusting illumination part comprises a plurality of connecting plates which are rotationally connected with the fixed shaft, the connecting plates are axially distributed along the fixed shaft, the connecting plates are fixedly connected with limiting seats, the limiting seats are used for being abutted to limiting seats on adjacent connecting plates, and adjusting lamps are fixedly arranged on the limiting seats. The invention has the effect of matching the brightness of the illuminating lamp with the illumination requirement.

title_en: Fuel cell system and method of controlling fuel cell
abstract_en: The present invention restricts the release of high concentration hydrogen via the drain control valve. A fuel cell system (1) is provided with: a fuel cell (10) including a hydrogen passage (10 h); a hydrogen supply path (31) connected to the inlet of the hydrogen path; an injector (44) disposed in the hydrogen supply path; an anode off-gas passage (AP) connected to an outlet of the hydrogen passage; and a drain control valve (46) provided in the anode off-gas passage. A hydrogen replacement process is executed in which the drain control valve is opened and the injector is opened so that the pressure in the hydrogen passage becomes the required hydrogen pressure. The fuel cell system (1) is further provided with a pressure sensor (94a) that detects the pressure in the hydrogen passage. When it is judged that the pressure in the hydrogen passage is higher than the required hydrogen pressure, the hydrogen replacement process is not executed.

title_en: Circuit breaker and configuration method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a circuit breaker and a configuration method thereof, wherein the circuit breaker comprises an electric control unit, and the electric control unit comprises a main control assembly and a wireless communication assembly; the wireless communication assembly is in communication connection with the main control assembly; the wireless communication component is used for receiving the parameter configuration information sent by the external connection equipment and sending the parameter configuration information to the main control component; the main control assembly is used for configuring the protection parameters of the circuit breaker according to the parameter configuration information when the parameter configuration information is received. According to the circuit breaker and the configuration method thereof, the external equipment can configure the protection parameters of the circuit breaker in a wireless communication mode, so that the circuit breaker can be suitable for different environments, the configuration mode is simple and convenient, the safety of electric appliances can be protected, the safety of personnel can be protected, and the safety is high.

title_en: Backboard connector and assembly thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a backplane connector, which comprises a plurality of conductive sheets, wherein each conductive sheet comprises a conductive support piece, a plurality of signal terminal pairs and a shielding piece, and each signal terminal comprises a butt joint part, a middle part and a mounting part. The conductive support member is provided with a first surface, a second surface and a plurality of terminal grooves which are opposite to each other, each terminal groove penetrates through the butt joint end, the mounting end and the first surface, so that the terminal groove is provided with an upper inner wall surface, a lower inner wall surface and a side inner wall surface, each signal terminal pair is accommodated in the corresponding terminal groove, the butt joint part is positioned between the upper inner wall surface, the lower inner wall surface and the side inner wall surface of the corresponding terminal groove, the shielding sheet is attached to the first surface, a plurality of elastic arms extend out of the shielding sheet, and the elastic arms extend into the terminal grooves and are positioned on the upper side and/or the lower side of the butt joint part of each signal terminal pair. Compared with the prior art, the conductive support part is a conductive body, provides three-faced shielding effects for the signal terminal pair, simplifies the manufacturing and meets the high-frequency performance.

title_en: Contact monitoring device for vacuum circuit breaker and correction method for the contact monitoring device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a contact monitoring device for a vacuum circuit breaker capable of compensating for a temperature-dependent deviation of a sensor for monitoring a contact wear amount, and a method for correcting the contact monitoring device. According to the present invention, the characteristic value of the optical sensor, which changes according to the operating temperature, is corrected in consideration of the temperature characteristic of the optical sensor, thereby sensing the accurate amount of contact wear.

title_en: 21700 cylindrical capacitor battery supporting ultralow-temperature quick charging, high-rate, high-safety and long-service life and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 21700 cylindrical capacitor battery supporting ultralow-temperature quick charging, high multiplying power, high safety and long service life and a preparation method thereof, wherein the 21700 cylindrical capacitor battery supporting ultralow-temperature quick charging, high multiplying power, high safety and long service life comprises a positive plate, a negative plate, electrolyte, a diaphragm, a shell and a cover cap, wherein a first insulating gasket and a second insulating gasket are respectively installed at the bottom and the top of the shell, the positive plate is provided with a positive tab, the negative tab is provided with a negative tab, the positive plate and the negative plate are arranged in the shell, the positive plate comprises positive slurry and a current collector, and the positive slurry comprises positive material powder and a dispersing agent. The invention adopts the method of the step current vacuum formation and the small current step formation, which can fully generate the side reaction on the surface of the pole piece and ensure that the SEI film formed on the surface of the pole piece is more compact and stable, thereby improving the specific energy and prolonging the service life of the capacitor battery.

title_en: AC/DC series-parallel system power coordination control method for inhibiting DC continuous commutation failure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power coordination control method of an alternating current-direct current series-parallel system for inhibiting direct current continuous commutation failure, which comprises the following steps: when the system faces the continuous commutation failure risk, the active power of the direct current transmission system is reduced by adjusting the direct current instruction at the inversion side, so that the continuous commutation failure of the direct current is restrained; meanwhile, monitoring the trend change of an alternating current-direct current series-parallel system, and judging overload risk of an alternating current transmission system; if overload risk exists, starting the thermal power unit frequency modulation system to reduce active output, and if the adjustment level of the thermal power plant cannot effectively reduce the wide fluctuation of the system trend, adjusting the active output of the power grid at the transmitting end by adopting a wind power unit active power control method to reduce the overload hazard of the alternating current transmission system. The method can inhibit direct current continuous commutation failure, reduce the overload phenomenon risk of the alternating current transmission system, and effectively ensure the flexibility, rapidity and economy of the power coordination control of the alternating current-direct current series-parallel system of the power grid with the high-proportion wind power transmission end.

title_en: Neutral point grounding reactor with magnetism increasing structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a neutral point grounding reactor with a magnetism increasing structure, which comprises: the four iron yokes are sequentially connected end to end and comprise an upper yoke positioned at the top of the hollow coil, a first side yoke positioned at one side of the coil, a lower yoke positioned at the bottom of the hollow coil and a second side yoke positioned at the other side of the coil; the first return yoke, the second return yoke and the central axis of the coil are parallel and coplanar; the central axis of the coil passes through the central point of the iron yoke, and the magnetic lines of force generated after the coil is electrified all pass through the iron yoke. The iron yoke made of silicon steel sheet is used to replace the aluminum shielding cylinder in the prior art, and the silicon steel sheet has high magnetic permeability, so that the magnetic circuit outside the coil can be closed, the reactance of the same coil is larger, and the magnetizing function is realized. The resistance loss and the eddy current loss are small, so the number of turns of the coil can be smaller, copper wires are saved, and the cost amplitude is greatly reduced.

title_en: Fuel cell system, control method thereof, and non-transitory storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a fuel cell system, a control method thereof and a non-transitory storage medium. The fuel cell system is provided with: a fuel cell; a target operating point determination unit that determines a warm-up target operating point on the basis of the warm-up request power amount and the warm-up request heat generation amount; an operation control unit; and a failure state determination unit that determines whether or not a failure has occurred in the power consumption device that consumes the generated power generated by the fuel cell, and if a failure in the power consumption device is determined, the target operating point determination unit determines, as a failure-time target operating point, an operating point that satisfies the failure-time request power amount obtained by reducing the warmup-time request power amount and the failure-time request heat generation amount obtained by reducing the warmup-time request heat generation amount.

title_en: Method and system for quickly starting Buck circuit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for quickly starting a Buck circuit, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a first transcendental equation set; performing finite power series expansion on the first transcendental equation set to obtain a first power series expansion formula set; acquiring topological parameters of the Buck circuit; substituting the topological parameters into the first power series expansion form group, and simplifying to obtain a second power series expansion form group; calculating a correction coefficient of a second power series expansion type group, and endowing the correction coefficient to the second power series expansion type group to obtain a third power series expansion type group; transforming the third power series expansion form group to obtain initial on-time and off-time; performing binary Newton iterative computation according to the initial on-time and off-time to obtain final on-time and off-time; and realizing the quick start of the Buck circuit according to the final on-time and off-time. The invention can effectively improve the starting speed of the Buck circuit.

title_en: New energy automobile charges anti-drop mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy automobiles, in particular to a new energy automobile charging anti-falling mechanism. The utility model provides a new energy automobile anti-drop mechanism that charges, is including setting up the charging head on charging gun and setting up the charging seat in the car mouth that charges, the lateral wall of charging gun is provided with the protection machanism that is used for protecting the charging head, and is provided with the anti-drop mechanism that prevents charging head drop in the charging process between charging head and the charging seat. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: this kind of new energy automobile anti-drop mechanism that charges can avoid charging the head and drop from the charging seat when charging, and the atress is more even for anti-drop effect is better, simultaneously, avoids its damage, and can carry out self-sealing protection to charging the head after charging the completion, avoids outside water stain and impurity such as dust to get into its inside easily, guarantees its result of use and life.

title_en: Installation method of split type shaft generator rotor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for mounting a rotor of a split shaft generator, which solves the problem of how to mount and fix a rotor magnetic yoke on a main shaft; the method comprises the steps of fixing a rotor with a motor on a middle shaft of a main shaft of a diesel engine in a splicing mode, sequentially arranging annular supports of magnetic yokes in the splicing mode in an inner cavity of a magnetic yoke of a two-piece cylindrical rotor in a radial direction, arranging an intermediate ring annular support formed by splicing two half annular outer expanding sleeves inwards in a central hole of an outermost circle of the outer ring support formed by splicing two half annular outer expanding sleeves in the radial direction, splicing the upper half cylindrical magnetic yoke and a lower half cylindrical magnetic yoke into a cylindrical shape, forming a central hole at the same time, and achieving the purpose of sleeving the cylindrical magnetic yoke of the rotor on the main shaft of the diesel engine.

title_en: Cobalt iron selenide/graphene nanoribbon composite negative electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cobalt-iron selenide/graphene nanoribbon composite negative electrode material which comprises a graphene nanoribbon matrix and spherical cobalt-iron selenide embedded in the graphene nanoribbon, wherein the mass percentage of the graphene nanoribbon in the cobalt-iron selenide/graphene nanoribbon composite negative electrode material is 20-80%, the width of the graphene nanoribbon is 10-100nm, and the particle size of the cobalt-iron selenide is 0.5-4 mu m. The invention also provides a preparation method of the cobalt iron selenide/graphene nanoribbon composite negative electrode material. The cobalt-iron selenide/graphene nanoribbon composite negative electrode material is a three-dimensional multistage composite negative electrode material formed by embedding spherical cobalt-iron selenide into a graphene nanoribbon, can inhibit the volume expansion of the cobalt-iron selenide, can ensure the structural stability of the negative electrode material, and has excellent conductivity, electrochemical cyclicity and rate capability.

title_en: Flexible electric heating paper and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses flexible electric heating paper and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the flexible electric heating paper comprises the following steps: (1) soaking the stainless steel fiber in a sodium hydroxide solution for pretreatment, adding water for cleaning after the pretreatment is finished, and drying to obtain the pretreated stainless steel fiber; then mixing and dispersing the pretreated stainless steel fibers and unbleached bleached hardwood pulp uniformly, and then making into wet paper sheets to obtain a middle layer of the electric heating material; (2) defibering and pulping bleached hardwood pulp until the pulping degree is 30-60 DEG SR, and then making wet paper serving as a bottom layer and a surface layer of the electric heating material; (3) and sequentially compounding the bottom layer, the middle layer and the surface layer, squeezing and drying to obtain the flexible electric heating paper. The wood pulp fiber is used as the substrate of the electric heating material, the stainless steel fiber is used as the main body of the electric heating material, and the electric heating material has high strength, flexibility and electric heating performance and wide application prospect.

title_en: Non-aqueous electrolyte of lithium ion battery and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a lithium ion battery non-aqueous electrolyte and application thereof. The lithium ion battery non-aqueous electrolyte comprises a lithium salt, a non-aqueous solvent and an additive, wherein the additive comprises an alkenyl siloxane compound with a cyclic structure, an impedance reducing additive and a film forming additive. According to the invention, when the alkenyl siloxane compound is added into the electrolyte and is compounded with other additives for use, stable SEI films can be formed on the surfaces of the anode and cathode electrode materials, and meanwhile, the SEI films have excellent ion conduction performance, so that the impedance and capacity attenuation speed of the lithium ion battery are reduced, and good capacity retention rate and recovery rate and small battery volume expansion can be maintained in a high-temperature storage environment.

title_en: B1-grade ultraviolet light crosslinking low-smoke halogen-free flame-retardant cable material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a B1-grade ultraviolet crosslinking low-smoke halogen-free flame-retardant cable material and a preparation method thereof. The cable material comprises the following components in parts by mass: 6-40 parts of ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer, 8-18 parts of polyethylene, 1-5 parts of crosslinking agent, 1-5 parts of photoinitiator, 40-65 parts of inorganic flame retardant, 5-10 parts of smoke-inhibiting and carbon-forming agent, 5-15 parts of synergistic flame retardant, 0.3-2 parts of antioxidant and 0.5-2 parts of lubricant. The cable material has the advantages of high extrusion speed, high crosslinking efficiency and excellent mechanical property; the flame spread, the total heat release amount, the peak value of the heat release rate, the total smoke production amount, the peak value of the smoke production rate, the combustion growth rate index and other performance parameters reach the B1 flame-resistant level.

title_en: Laminated electrostatic actuator
abstract_en: The invention provides a laminated electrostatic actuator which exerts sufficient contraction force even when being stretched by a large external force and does not reduce the contraction rate even under a light load. A multilayer electrostatic actuator comprising a plurality of electrode films having a 3-layer structure including a first insulating layer, a conductor layer, and a second insulating layer, the multilayer electrostatic actuator being configured such that: each electrode film has, on a first insulating layer of the electrode films, a bonding region P which is surface-processed so as to be capable of bonding to another electrode film, and a non-bonding region Q which is not bonded to another electrode film, a boundary C between the bonding region P and the non-bonding region Q has a wavy pattern which can be defined using at least one finite curvature radius, the electrode films are stacked so that the bonding region P of the first electrode film and the bonding region P of a second electrode film immediately below the first electrode film do not overlap each other in the stacking direction, and the axis of the wavy pattern of the boundary C of the first electrode film is parallel to the axis of the wavy pattern of the boundary C of the second electrode film, and the first electrode film and the second electrode film are bonded to each other in the bonding region P of the first insulating layer of the second electrode film, whereby the plurality of electrode films have an electrode portion to which the two electrode films are bonded and a hinge portion which is not bonded to each other as viewed from the stacking direction, when the electrode layers are stretched in the stacking direction by an external force, the hinge portions are elastically deformed, the electrode portions are separated from each other and elongated in the stacking direction, and when a voltage is applied between the conductor layers of the electrode films, the separated electrode portions are contracted by an electrostatic force and contracted in the stacking direction.

title_en: Method for growing graphene on structured copper base, cable core material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The method for growing graphene on the structured copper base, the cable core material and the preparation method thereof, wherein the method for growing graphene on the structured copper base comprises the following steps: step S1: copper powder and copper foil are alternately stacked and placed in a die, and are subjected to isostatic pressing treatment and molding to form an ingot; step S2: the ingot is grown with graphene via chemical vapor deposition to form copper-based graphene. And sequentially carrying out re-pressing, sintering and hot sintering wiredrawing molding on the formed copper-based graphene to obtain the cable core material. The prepared cable core material comprises a copper material and graphene, wherein the copper material comprises copper foil and copper powder, and the copper foil and the copper powder are coated by the graphene. The copper-based is structured by adopting a copper powder and copper foil alternately laminated mode, so that the service life and performance of the copper-based graphene material are integrally improved. The cable core material is further processed to generate obvious anisotropism, so that the phenomena of uneven current distribution and increased equivalent resistance of the cable core material caused by alternating current in use are improved.

title_en: LED control equipment control method, device and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method, a device and a system for controlling LED control equipment. The method for example comprises the steps of: receiving a target control instruction transmitted by a management station of LED control equipment based on a simple network management protocol, wherein the target control instruction comprises a target LED control service identifier; searching a corresponding target LED control service processing function in a preset configuration list according to the target LED control service identifier, wherein the preset configuration list comprises a mapping relation between the LED control service identifier and the LED control service processing function; and responding to the searched target LED control service processing function, and processing corresponding LED control services through the target LED control service processing function according to the target control instruction so as to control the LED control equipment. According to the embodiment, the LED control equipment is remotely controlled by the management station, the problem that the remote control LED control equipment must depend on a special server is solved, and the cost is reduced.

title_en: Small-size large-stroke plunger pump
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a little volume large stroke plunger pump, including the drive assembly and the pump body, seted up movable chamber, flowing water chamber and a plurality of slip chamber in the pump body, the both ends in slip chamber communicate movable chamber and flowing water chamber respectively, slip intracavity sliding connection has the plunger, set up inhalant canal and exhalant canal with external intercommunication on the flowing water chamber, be equipped with the first check valve that allows water to advance into the flowing water chamber from the external world on the inhalant canal, be equipped with on the exhalant canal and allow water to arrange to external second check valve from the flowing water intracavity, drive assembly drives a plurality of plunger sliding connection and at corresponding slip intracavity, its characterized in that: a plurality of plungers are divided into a plurality of groups of plungers in pairs, each group of plungers is distributed in sequence along the horizontal direction, and two plungers in each group of plungers are distributed in sequence along the vertical direction. Compared with the prior art that a plurality of plungers are arranged in a straight line, the plungers are arranged up and down, so that the size of the whole plunger pump can be reduced.

title_en: Sound generating device and scooter
abstract_en: The application provides a sound generating apparatus and scooter, sound generating apparatus includes: the vehicle comprises a wheel assembly, a generator, a control main board and a piezoelectric exciter; the wheel assembly comprises a tire, a hub and a wheel axle; the generator comprises a stator assembly and a rotor assembly, and the rotor assembly is driven to rotate relative to the stator assembly when the hub rotates, so that the generator generates electric energy; the piezoelectric exciter is attached to the tire vibrating diaphragm; the generator generates electric energy to supply to the control main board, the control main board outputs an audio signal to the piezoelectric exciter after entering a working state after being electrified, and the piezoelectric exciter drives the tire vibrating diaphragm to vibrate, so that sound is generated. Compared with the prior art, the sounding device automatically sounds when in motion, so that people around the sounding device can be reminded, the friction and collision of children in the riding process of the scooter can be reduced, and the children are prevented from being hurt by accident.

title_en: Welding-free sealed type battery cell cover plate
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of welding-free battery cell cover plates, and discloses a welding-free sealed battery cell cover plate, which comprises a sealing ring, a cover plate body, pole pieces and a rubber layer, wherein a rubber groove and a sealing groove are formed between the cover plate body and the pole pieces, the rubber groove and the sealing groove are in up-down correspondence and are communicated, the rubber layer is arranged in the rubber groove, the density ring is arranged in the sealing groove, the rubber layer and the sealing ring are respectively sleeved with the pole pieces, and the rubber layer and the sealing ring are in up-down abutting arrangement; the cover plate body is provided with a bending part which is arranged towards the rubber layer in a bending way, the bending part is used for limiting the rubber layer to be separated from the rubber groove, and the rubber layer and the sealing ring synchronously play a sealing role. Under the cooperation of the sealing ring and the rubber layer, the sealing effect is achieved, and the bending part enhances the assembling stability among the cover plate body, the sealing ring, the rubber layer and the pole piece; the assembly of the battery cell cover plate is realized without welding, the assembly steps are simplified, the assembly efficiency of the battery cell cover plate is improved, and the assembly among the sealing ring, the cover plate body and the pole piece is convenient.

title_en: Decoding method of high-precision magnetic encoder for compensating appointed subharmonic
