abstract_en: The invention discloses a decoding method of a high-precision magnetic encoder for compensating appointed subharmonic, which comprises the following steps of utilizing a double synchronous rotation coordinate system to convert sine signals v of the magnetic encoder  C  And v  S  Performing double synchronous coordinate transformation to obtain four positive and negative sequence components; decoupling the four positive and negative sequence components through a forward and reverse decoupling network to obtain decoupling components, and obtaining the modulus value of each decoupling component through a low-pass filter; by means of solutionsThe amplitude and phase of the fundamental wave signal are calculated by the modulus of the coupling component, and the fundamental wave signal v is reconstructed by combining the output angle of the phase-locked loop  S_1  And v  C_1  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Obtaining a high-frequency signal v containing each subharmonic according to the two paths of sine and cosine signals and the fundamental wave signal  S_har  And v  C_har  And successively carrying out double synchronous coordinate transformation, decoupling and filtering operation on the harmonic signals to obtain harmonic signals v with specified times  S_n  And v  C_n  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Feeding back the harmonic signals with the appointed times to the two paths of sine and cosine signals and subtracting the signals to form a closed loop; the invention realizes the calculation of the angle, improves the angle settlement precision and can ensure the dynamic and static performances of the system.

title_en: Movable quenching device and movable quenching method
abstract_en: The mobile quenching apparatus includes a primary coil, a secondary coil, a single-axis drive, a multi-axis drive, and a control device. The control device controls the single-axis actuator and the multi-axis actuator such that the plurality of secondary coils and the primary coil move to one side in the axial direction at least in a specific section in the axial direction included between both ends of the small diameter portion, at a position where the plurality of secondary coils are formed in a circular ring shape around the axis of the small diameter portion on one side in the axial direction with respect to the primary coil, and the plurality of secondary coils maintain a constant gap in the axial direction with the primary coil.

title_en: Wiring cap autoloading pressfitting frock
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic feeding and pressing tool for a wiring cap, which comprises a feeding mechanism, a pressing mechanism and a pneumatic clamp, wherein the feeding mechanism is used for transferring the wiring cap in an automatic feeder to the pneumatic clamp; the feeding mechanism comprises a cylinder I, a fixing block II, a discharging head and a connecting block; the first air cylinder is detachably connected with the automatic feeder; the first fixing block is fixedly sleeved on the outer side of the first air cylinder; the fixed block II is fixedly sleeved on the outer side of the cylinder I; the discharge head is fixedly sleeved at the upper end of the cylinder; the connecting block is fixedly connected to the right end of the discharging head and is connected with the automatic feeder; manual work is replaced by an automatic mode, so that the working strength of operators is reduced, the working fatigue of the operators is effectively reduced, and the production efficiency is improved; meanwhile, the pressing work of the wiring cap can be finished easily without needing an operator to hold the workpiece or the wire rod by hands.

title_en: Intelligent switch feeder terminal with traveling wave ranging function
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent switch feeder terminal with a traveling wave ranging function, which relates to the field of intelligent control and comprises a signal acquisition and processing module, a control quantity output module, a traveling wave module, a processing module, a display module and a superior communication module; the signal acquisition and processing module is used for converting the measured voltage and current signals into digital signals and sending the digital signals to the processing module, wherein the voltage and current signals comprise line frequency voltage and current signals and zero sequence voltage and current signals; the traveling wave module is used for receiving the fault information sent by the processing module, then acquiring the wave head time of the traveling wave current at the fault moment, and sending the wave head time of the traveling wave current to the processing module. The method can accurately position the fault point, simultaneously improve the accuracy of judging the single-phase earth fault, guide operation and maintenance personnel to patrol the line, and shorten the time for searching and repairing the fault.

title_en: Rotor bearing pressing-in auxiliary device for processing direct current motor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rotor bearing press-in auxiliary device for processing a direct current motor, which comprises a bottom plate, a bearing body, mounting frames arranged on two sides of the outer wall of the top of the bottom plate and a notebook computer arranged on the outer wall of one side of the bottom plate, wherein a press-in mechanism is arranged on the inner wall of the mounting frame, a supporting mechanism is arranged on the outer wall of the top of the bottom plate, the rotor body is arranged on the outer wall of the top of the supporting mechanism, a guide mechanism is arranged on the outer wall of the top of the mounting frame, a mounting plate is arranged on the outer wall of the top of the mounting frame, and a fourth sliding chute is arranged on the outer wall of the bottom of the mounting plate. The rotor bearing press-in auxiliary device for processing the direct current motor, disclosed by the invention, has the effects that the working state of the rotor body can be detected through the matching of the sound collecting hopper and the driving wheel, and whether the bearing body has a problem or not can also be detected, the mounting efficiency of the bearing body is improved, and the repair rate of the rotor body is also reduced.

title_en: Power semiconductor module packaging structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a power semiconductor module packaging structure, comprising: the semiconductor package comprises a package substrate, a package tube shell and a half-bridge type power semiconductor module; the packaging tube shell is fixedly connected with the packaging substrate to form an accommodating space; the half-bridge type power semiconductor module is arranged in the accommodating space; the half-bridge type power semiconductor module comprises an upper switch tube and a lower switch tube which are arranged on a packaging substrate in parallel and are paired, and the upper switch tube and the lower switch tube are oppositely arranged in the horizontal direction; the upper switch tube comprises a first liner plate bonded on the substrate, and a power semiconductor chip set, a main power terminal and an auxiliary control terminal which are bonded on the first liner plate; the lower switch tube comprises a second liner plate bonded on the substrate, a power semiconductor chip set bonded on the second liner plate, a main power terminal and an auxiliary control terminal; the first lining plate and the second lining plate are connected through a main power terminal, an auxiliary control terminal and a module-level bonding wire, and the tops of the main power terminal and the auxiliary control terminal extend out of the packaging tube shell.

title_en: Self-moving anti-seepage outdoor power distribution cabinet
abstract_en: A self-moving anti-seepage outdoor power distribution cabinet comprises a cabinet body, a base, a liquid level sensor and a plurality of groups of rotary supporting rods; the cabinet body is enclosed into an installation bin for installing electrical equipment through a plurality of groups; the end surface of the base is provided with a liquid inlet groove; the side end face of the liquid inlet groove on the base is provided with a plurality of groups of through holes and reset modules; a plurality of groups of embedded cylinders are arranged on the bottom surface of the base; the end face of each group of embedded cylinders is provided with a sealing guide sleeve, and each group of embedded cylinders is internally provided with a thread block in a threaded manner; one end of each of the plurality of groups of rotary supporting rods respectively penetrates through the plurality of groups of sealing guide sleeves in an interference fit manner and is connected with the plurality of groups of thread blocks, the other end of each of the plurality of groups of rotary supporting rods is rotatably connected with the bottom surface of the cabinet body, and the plurality of groups of rotary supporting rods are respectively connected with the two groups of rotary shafts in a transmission manner; the two groups of rotating shafts are rotatably connected with the inner wall of the cabinet body and are in transmission connection with a driving device in the cabinet body. The invention is convenient to use, can effectively prevent accumulated water from permeating into the cabinet body, and greatly prolongs the service life of the power distribution cabinet.

title_en: Electric cutting device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric cutting device, comprising: a fixed disk, a rotating frame and an electric saw mechanism; the electric saw mechanism includes: the cutting head, the telescopic component provided with the driving motor, the oscillating motor, the sensor, the controller, the first switch and the second switch; the telescopic assembly drives the cutting head to move along a first direction close to or far away from the steel-cored aluminum strand when the driving motor rotates; the oscillating motor drives the cutting head to oscillate back and forth along a first direction; the sensor is used for detecting the distance between the cutting head and the sensor and is electrically connected to the controller so as to send the detected distance information to the controller; the controller is electrically connected to the driving motor to control the driving motor according to the distance information. According to the electric cutting device, the outer-layer aluminum strands can be automatically cut through the electric saw mechanism, and an operator only needs to rotate the rotating frame to enable the electric saw mechanism to cut the outer-layer aluminum strands from multiple directions. Time and labor are saved, and meanwhile, the cutting stability is greatly improved.

title_en: Communication method, charging box, wireless earphone and communication system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a communication method, a charging box, a wireless earphone and a communication system, wherein the communication method comprises the following steps: when the communication mode of the charging box is in the carrier communication mode, acquiring an initial carrier reference voltage of the charging box; when the initial carrier reference voltage is larger than the preset carrier reference voltage, the carrier reference voltage of the charging box is adjusted from the initial carrier reference voltage to the preset carrier reference voltage; transmitting the data to be transmitted to the wireless earphone through a single bus and/or receiving the data to be transmitted by the wireless earphone.

title_en: Circuit structure, electrical connection box, and method for manufacturing circuit structure
abstract_en: A circuit structure (20) is provided with: a circuit board (21) in which a conductive path and a through hole (22) electrically connected to the conductive path are formed; a coil device (50) provided with a coil (51) and a core (54) of a magnet, the coil (51) having a terminal section (52); a heat radiation member (30) having a housing recess (34) for housing a coil device (50), and on which a circuit board (21) is superimposed; and grease (25) which is in contact with the inner surface of the housing recess (34) and the coil device (50), and the terminal section (52) of the coil device (50) is inserted through the through hole (22) and soldered.

title_en: Battery core, battery core assembly method and battery
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power batteries, in particular to an electric core, an electric core assembly method and a battery. According to the battery cell, the battery cell assembly method and the battery, the anode lug and the cathode lug are respectively arranged at the two ends of the cuboid electrode group in the length direction, a larger setting space is respectively provided for the anode lug and the cathode lug, so that enough space is provided for the anode lug and the cathode lug with larger lug height values, the flow of the anode lug and the cathode lug is ensured, and the charging speed of the battery is ensured.

title_en: Servo motor and inertia control method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a servo motor, which comprises a driving device, a counterweight control device, an inertia disc, a friction disc, a bearing and a motor rotating shaft, wherein the driving device is connected with the counterweight control device; the driving device is used for sending a counterweight driving signal to the counterweight control device; the counterweight control device is used for controlling the inertia disc to axially slide along the bearing until the inertia disc is contacted with the friction disc according to the counterweight driving signal, and the inertia disc and the friction disc rotate along the rotating shaft of the motor simultaneously, so that the rotational inertia of the servo motor is increased, the inertia of the servo motor can be correspondingly adjusted when the load inertia changes, the performance of the system is improved, and the servo motor can have quick motion responsiveness and stability. In addition, the motor can be directly modified on a low-inertia motor without an inertia disc, the motor does not need to be redesigned, the electromagnetic scheme and the whole structure of the motor cannot be changed, and the motor has better stability and reliability.

title_en: High-gain bidirectional Y source-LLC isolated DC-DC converter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-gain bidirectional Y source-LLC isolated direct current-direct current converter. The bidirectional Y source-LLC isolation direct current-direct current converter comprises a Y source impedance network, an LLC resonant network and a high-voltage side full bridge which are sequentially cascaded; the Y source impedance network provides high gain through the Y-shaped coupling inductor, so that the parasitic effect of the transformer is reduced; the LLC resonant network provides pulse frequency modulation capability through the resonant cavity and the transformer, and realizes adjustment of voltages at two sides and port isolation; the high-voltage side full bridge provides synchronous rectification and inversion functions, realizes bidirectional flow of energy and improves the efficiency of the converter. The invention greatly reduces the difference between the turns of the primary side and the secondary side of the transformer in the LLC resonant network and effectively reduces the high-frequency parasitic capacitance in the transformer. The input loop and the output loop of the invention are electrically isolated, the operation environment of the Y source impedance network is optimized, and the number and the cost of the switching tubes are reduced.

title_en: Multi-energy complementary operation system and method for offshore wind farm
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-energy complementary operation system and method for an offshore wind farm, and belongs to the technical field of offshore wind farms. Wherein, the system of the invention comprises: an offshore wind farm providing electrical energy to a power grid; a seawater desalination plant that produces fresh water from seawater using the remaining electrical energy of the offshore wind farm; and the coastal thermal power plant generates power by using the fresh water and supplements electric energy to the power grid. According to the invention, a large offshore wind farm, a seawater desalination system and a coastal thermal power plant are combined to form a regional comprehensive energy system, so that the operation flexibility of the offshore wind farm is improved, and the maximum utilization of wind energy is met through a multi-energy complementary strategy. And the regional comprehensive energy system is connected to the power utilization side nearby, so that the remote power transmission loss is reduced.

title_en: Voltage drive circuit and printer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a voltage driving circuit and a printer. The voltage driving circuit includes: the boost-buck driving module comprises a charging constant current source, a discharging constant current source and a load capacitor; a first end of the charging constant current source is connected with a power supply signal, a second end of the charging constant current source is electrically connected with a first electrode of the load capacitor, and a second electrode of the load capacitor is grounded; the first end of the discharging constant current source is electrically connected with the first electrode of the load capacitor, and the second end of the discharging constant current source is grounded; the first electrode of the load capacitor is electrically connected with the first power input end of the load, and the second power input end of the load is grounded. In other words, according to the embodiment of the invention, the voltage change slope of the power supply in the charging state and the discharging state is controlled to be stable by the voltage boosting and reducing driving module, so that the stability of the voltage change slope output by the voltage driving circuit is improved.

title_en: Modulation method of diurnal rhythm spectrum
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modulation method of a daytime rhythm spectrum, which comprises the following steps: providing a white light LED, a blue light LED, a green light LED and a blue-green light LED; regulating the luminous flux of each LED to obtain a daytime rhythm spectrum with preset luminous flux; the light fluxes of the white light LED, the blue light LED, the green light LED and the blue-green light LED respectively account for 62.32-75.9%, 1.74-1.91%, 1.5-20.27% and 15.5-22.8% of the preset light flux. By implementing the invention, the daytime rhythm spectrum with high rhythm stimulation and high color rendering index can be obtained.

title_en: Overhead insulated cable convenient to jointly fix
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an aerial insulated cable convenient to jointly fix, it includes by interior air wire, wire shielding layer, insulating layer, insulation shielding layer, flame retardant coating, dampproof course and the outer protective layer that sets gradually outside to, be provided with a plurality of fixed subassemblies that are used for aerial insulated cable to jointly fix each other on the outer protective layer surface, it is a plurality of fixed subassembly is along aerial insulated cable length direction evenly distributed setting. This application when needs bind the wiring with many cables, only need carry out interconnect behind the fixed subassembly angle regulation on each cable, can realize that the binding of many cables is fixed, need not to lay wire while wearing to establish mounting fixture, and the cable quantity that can bind according to actual need is nimble to be adjusted, and need not to cast in advance and prepare the mounting fixture of the pattern that corresponds for cable fixed convenient and fast has improved the jointly fixed efficiency of cable greatly, and then has effectively improved cable wiring efficiency of construction.

title_en: Ultra-thin lithium manganese battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultrathin lithium-manganese battery, which comprises an aluminum-plastic film, a diaphragm, a cathode and an anode, wherein resin type oily adhesive with stable electrochemistry is coated on two sides of the diaphragm, the cathode is arranged on one side of the diaphragm in an adhesive manner, the anode is arranged on the other side of the diaphragm in an adhesive manner to form an integrated structure, and the aluminum-plastic film is arranged on the outer sides of the diaphragm, the cathode and the anode.

title_en: Photovoltaic support with self-protection function under severe weather
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation, and discloses a photovoltaic support with a self-protection function in severe weather, which comprises a photovoltaic support main body and a protection mechanism, wherein the protection mechanism comprises an installation support, an installation cross beam is fixedly connected above the installation support, a movable block is sleeved on the outer side of the installation cross beam, a driving rod is movably connected to the outer side of the movable block, and one end, far away from the movable block, of the driving rod is connected with a driving motor. This photovoltaic support that has oneself protect function under bad weather drives fixed block and joint piece through the movable block and removes, thereby lateral shifting is carried out in step to the protection shield of the inboard joint of joint piece, can adjust the position of protection shield according to actual need, and the expansion plate tail end that cup joints through in the axis of rotation begins to rotate, wears out from the protection shield is inside, extends the length of protection shield, carries out better protection to photovoltaic support main part.

title_en: Battery pack without module frame, vehicle and energy storage device
abstract_en: The application discloses a battery pack without a module frame, a vehicle and an energy storage device, wherein the battery pack comprises: a battery pack case; a plurality of unit cells arranged in the battery pack case; the battery pack housing comprises a tray defining a battery receiving cavity having an open end, a plurality of unit batteries arranged in the battery receiving cavity, and a sealing cover mounted to the open end of the tray; the tray comprises a side frame and a bottom plate, the bottom plate is connected with the side frame to define a battery accommodating cavity, the single batteries are arranged at intervals with the bottom plate, and an insulating layer is arranged between the single batteries and the bottom plate. The battery pack is a battery pack without a module frame, the heat insulation layer is used for isolating the single batteries from external heat transmission, the function of heat insulation of the single batteries is realized, a plurality of single batteries are directly arranged in the battery pack shell, the number of elements and the assembly procedure are reduced, the cost is reduced, the number of the single batteries arranged in the battery pack shell is increased, and the cruising ability is improved.

title_en: Pure copper plate
abstract_en: The Cu content of the pure copper plate is 99.96 mass% or more, and 1X 10 is the average grain size of crystal grains in a rolled surface is X [ mu ] m, and the Ag content is Y mass ppm  ‑8  ≤X  ‑3  Y  ‑1  ≤1×10  ‑5  It is true that NF represents the ratio of J3 in which all three grain boundaries constituting the grain boundary triple points are special grain boundaries to all the grain boundary triple points  J3  The ratio of J2 in which two grain boundaries constituting grain boundary triple points are special grain boundaries and one grain boundary is random grain boundaries to all the grain boundary triple points is NF  J2  0.30 < (NF) > (NF  J2  /(1‑NF  J3  ))  0.5  Less than or equal to 0.48.

title_en: Three-phase coaxial superconducting cable terminal system and assembling method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a three-phase coaxial superconducting cable terminal system and an assembling method thereof, wherein the three-phase coaxial superconducting cable terminal system comprises: the terminal low-temperature container comprises a frame structure and a shell structure which are connected; the superconducting connection device is arranged on the frame structure and used for penetrating a superconducting cable so as to enable the superconducting cable to extend into the terminal low-temperature container; the drainage device is arranged in the terminal low-temperature container, and the input end of the drainage device is connected with the output end of the superconducting cable; and the sleeve assembly is arranged on the frame structure, extends towards the inside of the terminal low-temperature container and is connected with the output end of the drainage device. Said invention adopts the frame structure and shell structure design connected together, so that it is convenient for electric connection of superconducting connection device, drainage device and sleeve connection device and Dewar installation, and its operation is simple and reliable, and at the same time it is convenient for maintenance and replacement in the course of use.

title_en: Wide area power system stabilizing method based on self-adaptive virtual resistor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wide-area power system stabilizing method based on self-adaptive virtual resistance. Firstly, establishing a wide area impedance model of the grid-connected inverter considering the influence of a phase-locked loop and a current control loop by analyzing the influence of the phase-locked loop and the current control loop on the output impedance of the grid-connected inverter and the interaction between the output impedance of the grid-connected inverter and the impedance of a power grid; then, designing a wide-area stability criterion based on a wide-area impedance model to judge whether the grid-connected inverter system is stable in a wide-area range; meanwhile, a wide-area power system stabilizer is established, and the wide-area power system stabilizer is connected in parallel to the PCC point, so that the output impedance of the grid-connected inverter can be remodeled and the phase of the grid-connected inverter can be improved on the premise of not changing the control parameters and the structure of the original system; finally, the virtual resistance value is adaptively adjusted in real time according to the change of the resonance working condition of the system, so that the effect of suppressing resonance and stabilizing the system in a wide area is achieved.

title_en: Electrical device and power conversion device
abstract_en: One embodiment of the present invention relates to an electrical device and a power conversion apparatus. Provided are an electric device and a power conversion device capable of suppressing surge and ringing without hindering miniaturization. The electrical device includes a primary-side loop circuit having a main circuit for flowing a current in a loop shape; and a secondary-side loop circuit that is disposed opposite to the primary-side loop circuit with a predetermined distance therebetween, and that causes an induced current based on a magnetic field generated in the primary-side loop circuit to flow in a loop shape.

title_en: Charging of battery cells
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for charging a battery cell, wherein during a charging phase (LP 1-LP 2) having a constant charging current (I  L ), whether a charging voltage (U  L ) applied to the battery cell reaches or exceeds a preset switching voltage (U  U ), and if so, to a next charging phase (LP 2-LP 3) having a smaller constant charging current (I  L ), and wherein during each charging phase (LP 1-LP 3) it is additionally monitored whether a preset difference (DeltaU) between the charging voltage (U  L ) and the switching voltage (U  U ) of the charging phase (LP 1-LP 3) is reached or falls, and if so, at least one discharge pulse (P0-P9) is applied to the battery cell. A battery charging device (BV) is arranged to perform the method. The vehicle (F) and/or the charging station (LSt) have at least a portion of a battery charging device (BV). The invention is particularly advantageously applicable to the charging of a vehicle battery, in particular to the charging of a vehicle electrically driven by a battery.

title_en: Excitation closer for enhancing insulation capability
abstract_en: The excitation closer for enhancing insulation capability comprises a first shell, a second shell, an excitation source, a piston, a first conductor, a second conductor and a third conductor, wherein the second shell is arranged in the first shell, the excitation source, the piston, the first conductor, the second conductor and the third conductor are arranged in an insulation mode, the first conductor and the second conductor are respectively arranged between contact surfaces of the first shell and the second shell in a penetrating mode, one end of the first conductor is positioned outside the shell, the other end of the first conductor is arranged on the second shell in the first shell in an insulation non-contact mode, and the excitation source receives an excitation signal to drive the piston to drive the third conductor to move so as to be communicated with the first conductor and the second conductor in the first shell. The exciting closer can be used for rapidly switching on the grounding branch after the fault current of the main circuit of the battery pack is cut off so as to release the residual energy of the energy storage element in the main circuit, thereby ensuring the safety of the subsequent operation. The second shell is arranged in the first shell, so that the shell structure is more compact and the volume is smaller.

title_en: Power supply device and control method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a power supply device and a control method thereof, and relates to the field of communication. The power supply device includes: the power supply system comprises a direct current input power supply end, an alternating current input power supply end, a first power supply module and a second power supply module; the input end of the first power supply module is connected with the direct current input power supply end, the output end of the first power supply module is connected with the power receiving load, the input end of the second power supply module is connected with the alternating current input power supply end, and the output end of the second power supply module is connected with the power receiving load; the first power supply module is used for detecting the power supply state of the direct current input power supply end; the second power supply module is used for acquiring the power supply state of the direct current input power supply end from the first power supply module, determining the power supply proportion of the second power supply module to the power receiving load according to the power supply state of the direct current input power supply end, fully meeting the user requirements, better realizing the uninterrupted power supply of the power supply device, and simultaneously improving the flexibility and configurability of the power supply device, thereby improving the reliability of the power supply device.

title_en: Isolating membrane, electrochemical device comprising same and electronic device
abstract_en: Provided are a separation film, an electrochemical device including the same, and an electronic device. The isolating membrane comprises a porous substrate, an inorganic material layer and an adhesive layer, wherein the inorganic material layer is arranged between the porous substrate and the adhesive layer; the bonding layer comprises a copolymer, the monomers forming the copolymer comprise a first monomer and a second monomer, the first monomer is propylene, and the second monomer comprises at least one of ethylene, vinylidene fluoride, vinyl chloride, butadiene, isoprene, styrene, acrylonitrile, ethylene oxide, propylene oxide, acrylate, vinyl acetate or caprolactone. The isolating membrane can reduce the expansion and deformation of the lithium ion battery and improve the performance of the lithium ion battery.

title_en: Motor insulation treatment method
abstract_en: The application discloses a motor insulation treatment method, which comprises the following steps of 1: placing slot insulation between the core and the winding of the stator or rotor; step 2: vertically placing the stator or the rotor, wherein the notch is vertical to the placing plane, and encapsulating the upper end of the notch; and step 3: turning the stator or the rotor up and down to enable the filling and sealing end of the notch to be positioned at the lower end of the stator or the rotor, and performing a paint dipping treatment process in the posture; and 4, step 4: and carrying out a baking process according to the posture of the stator or the rotor during dip coating treatment. Compared with the prior art, the motor insulation treatment method is simple to operate, and the problem of loss of the impregnating varnish in the slot opening in the vertical impregnating varnish process can be solved.

title_en: Electric heating device for outer wall of inner tube of tank body
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of heating of outer walls of pipes, and particularly relates to an electric heating device for an outer wall of a pipe in a tank body, which comprises the following components: the pipe body, the body is installed in body clamping mechanism, installs heating control mechanism on the body clamping mechanism, and heating control mechanism is connected with electric heating mechanism, and electric heating mechanism installs on body clamping mechanism, and this device can self-holding body, and can adapt to the tubular product of different specifications, and this device can be applicable to the material that needs preheating earlier and then heating through adjusting heating distance.

title_en: Bending-resistant cable and combined components thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bending-resistant cable and a composition component thereof, the bending-resistant cable comprises a wire core, an insulating layer for coating the wire core, a shielding layer for coating the insulating layer and a sheath for coating the shielding layer, wherein the wire core comprises a central conductor, a first twisted layer and a second twisted layer, the central conductor, the first twisted layer and the second twisted layer are all formed by twisting a plurality of conductors, the twisting pitch of the first twisted layer is 10-14mm, the twisting pitch of the second twisted layer is 12-16mm, the conductors are formed by twisting bare copper wires and copper foil wires, the twisting pitch of the copper wires and the copper foil wires is not more than 20mm, the twisting directions of two adjacent conductors are opposite, the ratio of the twisting pitch of the first twisted layer to the diameter of the first twisted layer is 14, and the ratio of the twisting pitch of the second twisted layer to the diameter of the second twisted layer is 16. The cable disclosed by the invention improves the torsion resistance and flexibility of the conductor, improves the overload resistance and flame retardance of insulation, and also improves the shielding efficiency of the shielding layer and the torsion resistance of the whole cable.

title_en: Preparation method of silicon-carbon fiber film and application of silicon-carbon fiber film as negative electrode material of lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of a silicon-carbon fiber film and application of the silicon-carbon fiber film as a lithium ion battery cathode material. The preparation method is simple, the used raw materials are cheap and easy to obtain, and the obtained product has excellent cycling stability and high specific capacity when being applied to the negative electrode of the lithium ion battery.

title_en: Motor-driven high-voltage circuit breaker and driving system thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a motor-driven high-voltage circuit breaker and a driving system thereof, which are used for increasing the protection function of the circuit breaker in a power grid by fully utilizing the effect of a secondary circuit breaker when a fault is detected.

title_en: Sodium ion doped lithium ion battery positive electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a sodium ion doped lithium ion battery anode material, the chemical formula of which is Li  x‑y  Na  y  Ni  z  M  1‑   z  O  2  Wherein M is one or more of Mn, mg, ti, al, co, 0<x≤1；0<y<0.1，0.5≤z<1，I(003)/I(104)>1.2 The peaks of I006 and I012 are obvious, and the positive electrode material is prepared by preparing precursor material Na  x  Ni  z  M  1‑z  O  2  And then is obtained through molten salt ion exchange and heat treatment. The cathode material Li/Ni mixed emission is low, the structure of the material is stable, gaps among primary particles are less, crack growth of the material is difficult to occur, and the electrochemical performance of the material is excellent.

title_en: UUV broadside high-power propulsion motor quick installation and vibration isolation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid installation and vibration isolation device for a UUV broadside high-power propulsion motor, which relates to the technical field of UUV and comprises the following components: the device comprises more than one base fixed on a UUV shell and more than one butt joint arranged on a propulsion motor, wherein each butt joint is matched with a corresponding base hole shaft; wherein, the base is provided with a vibration isolation component; the device can integrate the rapid butt joint and vibration isolation technology, realizes integrated installation, enables a high-power propulsion motor to be light and rapid when being installed, realizes a vibration isolation function, and has the characteristics of compact structure, convenience in installation and disassembly, low personnel operation intensity, good vibration isolation effect and the like.

title_en: Adjustable light collector based on tunnel safety technology
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of sunlight guides, in particular to an adjustable light collector based on a tunnel safety technology, which solves the problem that dust can be attached to the surface of a transparent shield of a sunlight guide affected by the external environment in the prior art to influence the sunlight collecting effect. The utility model provides a light collector with adjustable based on tunnel safety technique, includes the mount pad, and the mount pad surface is equipped with the carrier ring, and the carrier ring surface is equipped with the carrier block through the bolt mounting, is equipped with water spray assembly on the carrier block, and the intercommunication has the spray pipe on the water spray assembly, and the mount pad top has been seted up the installation cavity, and the mount pad surface runs through and is equipped with the butt subassembly that extends to the installation cavity inside. The application utilizes the self power of the device to drive, combines the cleaning and the water spraying to ensure that the ash cleaning effect is better, and simultaneously when the light collector follows the rotation of the sun, the ash cleaning and the water spraying move, thereby realizing the maximum saving and utilization of resources, and the application has smart structure, novel thought and stronger practicability.

title_en: Quartz crystal electronic transformer for circuit board
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic equipment, and discloses a quartz crystal electronic transformer for a circuit board, which comprises an electronic transformer body, wherein the outer side of the electronic transformer body is composed of a fixed frame, a quartz crystal transformation group is arranged on the inner side of the fixed frame, a pin groove is formed in the bottom surface of the fixed frame, transformer pins extend from the bottom of the quartz crystal transformation group, the transformer pins extend to the bottom of the electronic transformer body through the pin groove, and a winding framework is arranged on the inner side of the quartz crystal transformation group. The overload capacity of the transformer is improved by arranging the corresponding copper wire grooves and the corresponding winding copper wires outside the winding framework, the electronic transformer is internally composed of two groups of windings which are distributed up and down, the overload capacity of the electronic transformer is increased in a double mode, and therefore the stability of the electronic transformer is improved to a large extent, the electronic transformer is used on a circuit board and is more stable, and the transformer is prevented from being damaged.

title_en: Method of manufacturing secondary battery and apparatus for manufacturing secondary battery
abstract_en: The method of manufacturing a secondary battery according to the present invention includes: a step (a) of alternately stacking electrodes and separators to manufacture an electrode assembly; step (b), at 5kgf/cm 2 Or a larger pressure laminated electrode assembly, thereby bonding electrodes and separators provided in the electrode assembly to each other; a step (c) of accommodating the electrode assembly in a battery case and injecting an electrolyte into the battery case, and then sealing the battery case to manufacture a preliminary battery; step (ii) of(d) Charging and discharging the preliminary battery to activate the preliminary battery; and (e) aging (aging) the preliminary battery at a high temperature of 60 to 100 ℃ for 1 to 6 hours to heat-treat the preliminary battery.

title_en: Instrument adds clamping apparatus
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of instrument processing, in particular to an instrument processing clamp which is convenient for improving the drilling efficiency, improving the drilling automation degree, saving the labor and time and improving the practicability; including the processing platform, the baffle, the lifter, elevator motor, the lead screw, the slider, the crossbeam, drilling motor, the drilling axle, the rotation regulation motor, the axis of rotation, press from both sides tight platform, three telescopic links of group, three group's springs, three splint of group and cleaning device, processing platform bottom symmetry is provided with the support frame, baffle fixed mounting is on processing platform top, and baffle rear end intercommunication is provided with the mounting groove, lifter fixed mounting is in the baffle rear end, and the vertical spout that is provided with of lifter front end, elevator motor fixed mounting is on the lifter top and elevator motor's the rotatable spout that passes lifter top to lifter of output, the lead screw is rotatable to be installed in the spout of lifter and the lead screw top is connected with elevator motor's output.

title_en: Mandrel self-adaptive torque threaded connection locking mechanism in signal lamp
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mandrel self-adaptive torque threaded connection locking mechanism in a signal lamp, which consists of a lamp holder body, a signal board body, a mandrel holder body, a lower mandrel body, an upper mandrel body, a tower-shaped spring and the like. The self-adaptive torque threaded connection is formed by the relative circumferential rotation of the lower section of the lower mandrel and the inner peripheral wall of the mandrel seat in the assembly and screwing process, the screwing torque is self-adaptive and constant and is not increased any more, and the screw thread of the threaded connection is prevented from being invalid due to overlarge screwing torque.

title_en: Super-large-size high-length-diameter-ratio ferroferric oxide two-dimensional nanosheet and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a super-large-size high-length-diameter-ratio ferroferric oxide two-dimensional nanosheet and a preparation method thereof. The method has simple process and high yield, is suitable for mass preparation, the obtained nano-sheet has the length of 20-100 mu m, the thickness of 3-5nm, ferromagnetism (the saturation magnetization is 50-70emu/g, and the remanence is 10-15emu/g), and can be applied to the fields of spinning electronic devices, super capacitors, wave-absorbing, catalyzing and magnetic functional composite materials and the like.

title_en: Series reactor is with bridging voltage limiting system and device thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of reactors, and particularly discloses a cross-over type voltage limiting system for a series reactor and a device thereof, wherein the cross-over type voltage limiting system comprises an installation module, a protection module, an overvoltage suppression module and an on-off module, wherein the installation module is used for connecting the voltage limiting system at two ends of the reactor; the protection module is used for protecting the overvoltage suppression module; the overvoltage suppression module is used for suppressing overvoltage in the reactor; the on-off module is used for controlling the switching-on or switching-off of a circuit where the overvoltage suppression module is located. Through the setting of overvoltage suppression unit, can effectual absorption eliminate the overvoltage that the reactor produced, simultaneously, through the setting of solenoid and iron rod, solenoid and iron rod pass through the principle of electro-magnet, on the one hand can effectual improvement the closing speed of the device, and on the other hand, when not producing the overvoltage in the reactor, disconnection between iron rod and the slide bar, and then make the device can effectually carry out effectual protection to overvoltage suppression unit.

title_en: Main shaft winding device
abstract_en: A spindle winding device comprises a shell and a winding driving structure. The winding driving structure includes an outer rotating part, an inner rotating part, and a locking part. The outer rotating part has a first bobbin. The inner rotating portion has a tool mounting assembly. The jig mounting assembly comprises a mounting cylinder and a jig sleeved on the mounting cylinder. The outer rotating part and the inner rotating part rotate in opposite directions so as to wind the line on the first bobbin on the jig. The locking portion includes a link, at least two connecting tabs, a hydraulic pushing device, and a locking tab. The main shaft winding device is provided with a locking part which can lock a jig sleeved on the mounting cylinder. The locking part pulls the connecting rod through the hydraulic pushing device, so that the connecting sheet and the locking plate are driven, the tail end of the locking plate penetrates out of the side wall of the mounting cylinder, and the steps of unlocking and locking are simplified.

title_en: Vanadium sodium phosphate composite positive electrode material capable of realizing quick charge, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of sodium ion battery electrode materials, and particularly relates to a vanadium sodium phosphate composite positive electrode material capable of realizing quick charge, a preparation method and application. According to the invention, through simple ball milling and mixing and introducing reducing gas into the tube furnace to directly perform oxidation-reduction reaction in the sintering process, the ball milling process is only used for refining the size of raw material particles, and simultaneously fully contacting the raw material particles, so that the related reaction is easier to occur, good conditions are provided for the preparation in the next stage, the ball milling reaction time of the traditional solid phase method is saved, the flow is short, the control is easy, the cost is low, and the NASICON sodium vanadium phosphate is compounded with carbon, so that the obtained product has good conductivity, excellent cycle stability at high multiplying power and can realize quick charging.

title_en: Hub magnetic steel assembly equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent manufacturing, and particularly relates to hub magnetic steel assembly equipment and a method, wherein the hub magnetic steel assembly equipment comprises a frame, and a positioning assembly, a hub fixing piece, a material disc and a magnetic steel driving assembly which are arranged on the frame; the positioning component is used for positioning the retainer so that the magnetic steel fixing position of the retainer is opposite to the magnetic steel sheet on the material tray; the hub fixing piece is used for fixing the hub when the magnetic steel sheet is pressed into the hub; the charging tray is used for placing a magnetic steel sheet to be pressed into the hub; the magnetic steel driving assembly is used for pressing the magnetic steel sheet into the fixed position of the retainer. According to the hub magnetic steel assembly equipment, the retainer can be fixed by arranging the positioning assembly, so that the magnetic steel can be accurately aligned to the fixed position of the retainer; the magnetic steel driving assembly can assemble the magnetic steel sheet on the retainer in the hub at one time, the position is accurate, the production efficiency is high, the assembly quality is stable, the manpower input is reduced, and the cost is saved.

title_en: Negative electrode current collector for lithium-free battery, electrode assembly comprising same, and lithium-free battery
abstract_en: An anode current collector for a lithium-free battery according to one embodiment of the present disclosure is an anode current collector for a lithium-free battery, including: a metal current collecting substrate; a conductive layer formed on at least one surface of the metal current collecting substrate and including a conductive material; an auxiliary layer formed on the conductive layer and increasing an electrodeposition density of lithium.

title_en: Lithium battery insertion device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium battery inserting piece device, which relates to the technical field of lithium battery production and comprises a workbench, a two-stage moving mechanism and an angle adjusting mechanism, wherein the two-stage moving mechanism is provided with a clamping mechanism, the clamping mechanism comprises a clamping component, a guiding component and a fine adjusting component, the clamping component comprises an installation frame, one side of the installation frame is rotatably connected with the two-stage moving mechanism through a rotating shaft, an adjusting gear is sleeved on the rotating shaft, two installation plates are arranged in the installation frame, two sides of each installation plate are respectively provided with a connecting rod, inner side walls on two sides of the installation frame are respectively provided with a driving slide rail, the front end of each installation plate is respectively fixed with a clamping piece, one side of each connecting plate is provided with a guiding rod, and the installation frame is provided with a guiding hole corresponding to each guiding rod; when the pole piece is clamped, the length of the pole piece reserved at the front end of the clamping piece is not too long, so that the operation requirement of an operator is greatly reduced, and the effect of the equipment inserting piece is improved.

title_en: Housing, in particular wire housing, system and method for producing such a system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a housing (8) for mounting on an electrical flat conductor rail (2), comprising a flat conductor receptacle (12) extending along a first axis, and a connecting conductor receptacle (14) extending transversely to the first axis and along a second axis, wherein the flat conductor receptacle (12) and the connecting conductor receptacle (14) are formed by a housing upper side (8 a) and a housing lower side (8 b) each having an inner side and an outer side, the housing upper side and the housing lower side accommodating the flat conductor rail (2) with their inner sides facing one another in a closed state of the housing (8), wherein a shielding contact element (16) is arranged on at least one inner side, wherein the shielding contact element (16) rests directly on a shielding conductor (2 b) of the flat conductor rail (2) in the closed state of the housing (8).

title_en: Hydrogen fuel cell purging system and anode fluctuating hydrogen pressure purging method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hydrogen fuel cell purging system and an anode fluctuating hydrogen pressure purging method thereof. The invention can accelerate the purging of the cathode side, adopts the purging mode of fluctuating hydrogen pressure on the anode side, uses hydrogen to instantaneously and repeatedly raise or lower the impact force of about 5kpa, and rapidly purges accumulated water in the anode, thereby effectively reducing the purging time.

title_en: Light source device
abstract_en: The invention provides a light source device. A light source device (100) is provided with: the light emitting device (1) having a light emitting surface on the upper surface thereof, a first lens (11) disposed so as to face the light emitting device (1), and a second lens (31) disposed so as to face the first lens (11), wherein the first lens (11) has, on the lower surface thereof which faces the light emitting device (1): the light guide unit includes an incident portion (12) disposed at the center of the lower surface and into which light from the light emitting device (1) is incident, and a light guide portion (21) disposed outside the incident portion (12) and guiding the light incident from the incident portion (12), and the lower surface of the second lens (31) facing the first lens (11) has a Fresnel lens surface (32) formed of a plurality of annular convex portions (34).

title_en: Portable transformer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable transformer, which comprises a magnetic core winding assembly, wherein the outer sides of two sides of the magnetic core winding assembly are respectively provided with a buffer heat dissipation assembly consisting of a thermal buffer assembly and a heat exchange plate; the thermal buffering assembly comprises an inner lining plate and an outer protecting plate; the inner lining plate is a heat-conducting ceramic insulating plate which keeps surface fit with the magnetic core winding assembly; the outer protective plate is a heat-conducting metal plate arranged on the outer side of the inner lining plate; a closed interlayer is formed between the inner lining plate and the outer guard plate, and the closed interlayer is filled with the electronic fluoridizing liquid, is spread open and is tensioned at the position of the insulating rubber seal; the heat exchange plate is a heat conduction metal plate and is arranged on the outer side of the outer guard plate so as to form a space heat exchange system with a space transversely and longitudinally arranged among the plurality of groups of heat buffer assemblies, the heat exchange channels of the hollow convex ribs and the hollow convex ribs adjacent to the upper position of the outer guard plate. The portable transformer has a compact structure, can effectively meet the heat dissipation requirement under the compact structure characteristic of the portable transformer, and can realize long-time continuous operation.

title_en: Double-power-supply change-over switch
abstract_en: The invention provides a double-power-supply change-over switch. This dual supply change-over switch includes: the device comprises a first phase pole static contact, a first neutral pole static contact, a second phase pole static contact, a second neutral pole static contact, a main shaft, a phase pole moving contact connected with the main shaft, and a neutral pole moving contact. When the main shaft is located at the first position, the phase pole moving contact is contacted with the first phase pole fixed contact, and the neutral pole moving contact is contacted with the first neutral pole fixed contact; when the main shaft is located at the second position, the phase pole moving contact is in contact with the second phase pole fixed contact, and the neutral pole moving contact is in contact with the second neutral pole fixed contact. During the process of the main shaft from the first position to the second position, the motion process of the neutral pole moving contact comprises a first stage and a second stage: in the first stage, the neutral pole moving contact keeps static and is only contacted with the first neutral pole fixed contact; in the second stage, the neutral pole moving contact realizes the overlapping conversion from the first neutral pole fixed contact to the second neutral pole fixed contact.

title_en: Modularized deformable multifunctional table lamp
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modularized deformable multifunctional desk lamp, relates to the technical field of desk lamps, and solves the problems that the desk lamp on the market is low in efficacy, single in function and incapable of well illuminating a reflective liquid crystal screen. The invention relates to a modularized deformable multifunctional desk lamp, which mainly comprises a desk lamp support, a lamp source, a power switch, a power line, a bearing plate, a frame on the edge of the bearing plate and the lamp source on the frame, wherein a fixing device and an intelligent control system for fixing an illuminated object are arranged on the bearing plate, and the modularized deformable multifunctional desk lamp is mainly used for reading paper books, electric paper books, front-light-free reflective liquid crystal screen terminals and serving as a reading support after deformation.

title_en: High-voltage bushing direct-insertion 1000kV parallel reactor
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-voltage bushing direct-insert 1000kV parallel reactor, which comprises: the high-voltage wire outlet device comprises a high-voltage sleeve, a transformer body, a magnetic pressing plate, a high-voltage wire outlet device, a coil and an oil tank; the high-voltage wire outlet device is completely installed in the oil tank and fixed on the device body, one end of the high-voltage wire outlet device is connected with the coil, the other end of the high-voltage wire outlet device is connected with the high-voltage sleeve, and the magnetic pressing plate is arranged above the coil. According to the scheme provided by the invention, the 1000kV wire outlet device and the transformer body are in the same oil tank, the oil flow in the operating environment is smooth, and accidents or defects of products can be found and processed in time. The 1000kV outlet device has an integrated structure, so that the installation process is simplified, the integral mechanical strength of the reactor is enhanced, and the electrical performance of the reactor is improved.

title_en: Fuel cell low-temperature starting system based on phase-change heat storage and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fuel cell low-temperature starting system based on phase change heat storage and a control method thereof, wherein the system comprises a fuel cell electric pile, a thermal management controller, an air system, a cooling liquid circulating system and a hydrogen system, wherein the thermal management controller is respectively in communication connection with the air system, the cooling liquid circulating system and the hydrogen system; the coolant circulation system includes: the device comprises a water pump, a three-way electromagnetic valve, a phase change heat reservoir, a thermostat, a radiator and a temperature sensor. The system has the advantages of high utilization rate of vehicle-mounted energy, quick low-temperature starting and the like, and prolongs the service life of the membrane electrode of the fuel cell to a certain extent.

title_en: Center line load center
abstract_en: A power line track is provided for a centerline load center. The line track includes a bus bar assembly for supplying electrical energy and an insulating housing for the bus bar assembly. The bus bar assembly includes separate first and second line buses. The first and second line buses include two branched first bus bars and two branched second bus bars, respectively. The first and second bus bars are separated from each other in an X-shape to provide first and second pairs of separated bus bars. The insulative housing includes first and second sets of windows on opposite sides of the housing through which to connect to first and second pairs of bus bars in the housing, respectively.

title_en: Wide-range controllable electronic impedance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wide-range controllable electronic impedance, which belongs to the technical field of electronic impedance, and is converted from an ab coordinate to a dq coordinate system by a single-phase Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) rectification technology; aiming at the problem that virtual orthogonal components need to be constructed in the coordinate transformation of a single-phase system; s is based on a second-order generalized integral (SOGI) algorithm, a dq current decoupling control algorithm is adopted to carry out double-loop control on the wide-range controllable electronic impedance, the direct-current voltage can be stably, accurately and quickly controllable, and the electric angle of current lag or lead voltage on an alternating-current side can be controlled, so that the wide-range controllable electronic impedance enables a pure-inductance operation mode, namely a variable inductor, to be realized when the current lag voltage on the alternating-current side is 90 degrees, the existing working principle of the impedance including the inductor is thoroughly eliminated, the impedance and the inductor in a wide range, a wide working voltage range, a wide working current range and a wide power range are obtained, and the self-adaptive impedance matching is realized.

title_en: Balanced control method and device of battery management system, control equipment and automobile
abstract_en: The invention provides an equalization control method, an equalization control device, control equipment and an automobile of a battery management system, wherein the equalization control method comprises the following steps: simulating the running of a Battery Management System (BMS) by utilizing a first mode of at least two modes of a simulation model of the BMS to obtain a simulation result of the simulation model under at least one balance control strategy; determining a target balance control strategy of the BMS from the at least one balance control strategy according to the simulation result; and when the BMS works, performing balance control by utilizing strategy parameters corresponding to the target balance control strategy. According to the scheme, the balancing strategy of the BMS can be rapidly determined, the passive balancing efficiency of the BMS is greatly improved, and therefore the problem of consistency of the battery pack is improved to a greater extent.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for route inspection and obstacle removal
abstract_en: A circuit inspection obstacle-removing unmanned aerial vehicle is characterized in that four rotors capable of providing lift force are symmetrically arranged on the periphery of a main body, four supporting rods are mounted on the upper side of the main body and can move left and right, a motor and a driving wheel are mounted at the upper end of each supporting rod, the motor can rotate and lock and position corresponding to the driving wheel, a rod disc capable of rotating freely is mounted on each driving wheel, a fifth motor can simultaneously drive two inner shafts to rotate through a gear meshing relationship, two outer shafts are respectively driven to rotate after energy is stored by two spiral springs, and then the four driving wheels are enabled to clamp and release a high-voltage circuit through two synchronous belts; two cameras are installed at the front end and the rear end of the main body respectively, the execution arm installed on the upper side of the main body has the advantages of high degree of freedom and flexible movement, the cleaning requirement for foreign matter attached to a high-voltage wire can be met, the data processing system can automatically screen and analyze image data collected by the two cameras, suspicious damage points are marked and used for manual reexamination and analysis.

title_en: Nail pulling equipment for lithium battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium battery nail pulling device which comprises a frame, wherein a battery conveying mechanism is arranged on the frame, a battery is arranged on the battery conveying mechanism, a horizontal driving mechanism is arranged on the frame, a nail pulling mechanism is arranged at the movable end of the horizontal driving mechanism, a plurality of glue nails can be pulled out by the nail pulling mechanism at a time, a post-lithium battery nail pulling detection mechanism is arranged on the battery conveying mechanism, the post-lithium battery nail pulling detection mechanism is positioned at the downstream of the nail pulling mechanism, and the post-lithium battery nail pulling detection mechanism can detect whether the glue nails on the battery are pulled out or not. The invention has the advantages that the whole nail pulling efficiency of the nail pulling equipment is higher, and meanwhile, whether the glue nail is pulled off or not can be detected, so that the battery is prevented from being scrapped due to flowing into the next station.

title_en: Traction network fault position calibration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traction network fault position calibration method, and belongs to the technical field of traction power supply of electrified railways. According to the invention, after a fault at a certain position of the contact network circuit occurs, the in-phase power supply device is used for injecting harmonic currents with different times for carrying out a traction network fault calibration algorithm, so that the influence caused by factors such as traction network transition resistance and the like can be effectively eliminated. The method is suitable for the non-metal short circuit fault condition with larger transition resistance, and has high fault positioning precision. The method is widely suitable for fault location of the in-phase power supply electrified railway.

title_en: Distribution network main station side automatic checking device and method based on allocation integrated system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network main station side automatic checking device based on a distribution integrated system, which comprises primary equipment, a DTU device, an automatic main station and an automatic checking device, wherein the primary equipment is in hard-wired connection with the DTU device, the DTU device is in network communication or IEC (International electrotechnical Commission) protocol connection with the automatic checking device, and the automatic main station is in network communication or IEC protocol connection with the automatic checking device. By adopting the checking method of the automatic checking device at the side of the distribution network main station based on the allocation integrated system, the checking efficiency and reliability of the transformer substation can be improved.

title_en: Fuel cell temperature control device, fuel cell system and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fuel cell temperature control device, a fuel cell system and a vehicle, wherein the fuel cell temperature control device comprises a deionizer, a pump, a radiator and an overflow tank; the pump outlet of the pump is communicated with the inlet of the fuel cell stack through a first pipeline; the radiator inlet of the radiator is communicated with the outlet of the fuel cell stack through a second pipeline; a radiator outlet of the radiator is communicated with a pump inlet of the pump through a third pipeline; the first pipeline is communicated with a deionizer inlet of the deionizer through a fourth pipeline; the deionizer outlet of the deionizer is communicated with the overflow tank inlet of the overflow tank through a fifth pipeline; and the overflow tank outlet of the overflow tank is communicated with the third pipeline through a sixth pipeline. The fuel cell temperature control device can effectively reduce the conductivity value of the cooling medium and realize quick cold start.

title_en: Separator having excellent thermal conductivity and electrochemical device using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a secondary battery separator having superior heat dissipation characteristics and thermal stability compared to conventional polyolefin-based separators, and an electrochemical device including the same to ensure safety and improve performance.

title_en: Electric motor system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and system for an electric motor system. In one example, a motor system is provided that includes a first electric machine rotationally coupled to a second electric machine through a planetary gear set having three components: a ring gear, a sun gear, and a carrier having a plurality of planet gears. In this system, the first electrical machine is a different size than the second electrical machine, and one of the planetary assembly members is permanently grounded.

title_en: Method of controlling a wind power plant
abstract_en: A method of controlling a wind power plant (12) comprising an energy storage device (44, 46), the wind power plant (12) being connected to a power grid (19) and comprising one or more wind turbine generators (1), the one or more wind turbine generators (1) producing power for delivery to the power grid (19), the method comprising processing input data related to the power grid (19) to determine a probabilistic prediction of a future state of the power grid (19), and controlling charging and discharging of the energy storage device (44, 46) in accordance with the probabilistic prediction.

title_en: Oil lubrication motor structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oil lubrication motor structure, and relates to the field of motors. The technical scheme is characterized in that a middle shaft, a core assembly, a gear reduction assembly and a motor shell are included, wherein the motor shell comprises a hub, a first end cover and a second end cover; the inner side wall of the hub is integrally formed with a partition plate, and the partition plate divides the motor shell into a machine core cavity and a gear cavity; the hub is provided with an oil hole communicated with the gear cavity and an oil hole plug matched with the oil hole; and lubricating oil is arranged in the gear cavity. The invention has simple structure, is convenient to produce and assemble, can reduce the volume and the weight of the motor, effectively prevents lubricating oil in the gear cavity from entering the cavity of the machine core, and prolongs the service life of the motor.

title_en: Negative electrode, method for preparing same by electrolytic deposition and preparation device thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a negative electrode. The negative electrode may include a three-dimensional structure current collector and a negative electrode active material layer provided on a surface of the three-dimensional structure current collector.

title_en: High-voltage relay with built-in intelligent chip
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-voltage relay with an intelligent chip inside, and belongs to the technical field of relays. The high-voltage relay comprises a shell, a relay main body and an intelligent chip, wherein the relay main body comprises a static contact, an arc extinguish chamber and a coil, the static contact penetrates through the arc extinguish chamber to be arranged, the coil is arranged below the arc extinguish chamber, a magnetic conduction cylinder is arranged in the coil, the magnetic conduction cylinder is hermetically connected with the arc extinguish chamber, a push rod, a movable iron core and a static iron core are arranged in the magnetic conduction cylinder, the top of the push rod is positioned inside the arc extinguish chamber, and a movable spring is arranged at the top of the push rod to form a movable contact; the arc extinguishing chamber comprises a ceramic cover, and arc extinguishing gas is filled in the arc extinguishing chamber. The ceramic cover is used as an arc extinguishing chamber material, compared with plastic, the ceramic cover is excellent in insulating property and high-temperature resistance, and meanwhile, the arc extinguishing chamber is a closed space and arc extinguishing gas filled in the arc extinguishing chamber, so that the arc extinguishing property of the high-voltage relay can be improved, and the high-voltage relay is endowed with good electrical property.

title_en: Virtual synchronous double-fed fan parameter optimization method and system based on energy dissipation rate
abstract_en: The invention relates to a virtual synchronous double-fed fan parameter optimization method and system based on energy dissipation rate, belongs to a wind power generation system, and solves the problems that the virtual synchronous control stability level can not be accurately evaluated and the vibration of a wind turbine generator set is dispersed after the wind turbine generator set is disturbed due to unreasonable parameter configuration in the prior art. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring instantaneous value variation of port voltage, current, active power and voltage phase angle of the virtual synchronous double-fed wind turbine generator and corresponding key control parameters; calculating the energy dissipation rate of the wind turbine generator according to the variation of the instantaneous value of each electric quantity, and evaluating the stability of the system; when the system is unstable, calculating the energy dissipation rate sensitivity of each key control parameter; and acquiring the optimal key control parameter value of the virtual synchronous double-fed wind turbine generator set according to the key control parameter optimization model and the acquired energy dissipation rate sensitivity of each key control parameter. The stability evaluation and parameter optimization of the virtual synchronous double-fed wind turbine generator are realized.

title_en: Solar photo-thermal photoelectric system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solar photo-thermal photoelectric system, belonging to the field of solar energy utilization, comprising: the angle of the folding plate can be controlled to change so as to adapt to the angle change of the solar rays; the sunlight tracking unit can obtain the real-time angle of the sunlight and drive the photo-thermal photoelectric unit and the folding plate to rotate according to the change of the angle; the light and heat photoelectric unit, it is confined cylinder structure, the cavity is held in the inside being of cylinder volume structure, be equipped with a plurality of photovoltaic cell on the inner wall of cavity in, light and heat photoelectric unit is including the outer wall, be equipped with preheating chamber between outer wall and the inner wall, it is equipped with frequency division liquid to preheat the intracavity, the bottom of cylinder structure is equipped with a passageway, be equipped with light and heat subassembly on the passageway, the inside light and heat chamber that is equipped with of light and heat subassembly, light and heat chamber and preheating chamber can communicate, be equipped with frequency division liquid in the light and heat chamber, solar ray can follow light and heat subassembly and get into in the cavity.

title_en: Power supply device for vehicle
abstract_en: In a power supply device for a vehicle mounted on the vehicle and obtaining a low-voltage power supply from a high-voltage power supply via a step-down unit, the power supply device prevents a human body from being electrically shocked without using an insulating unit such as a transformer. In this configuration, a leakage current from the high-voltage power supply is measured during a dead time period in which the storage element group is not connected to the low-voltage electrical load, and when the leakage current is equal to or greater than a predetermined value, the supply of electric power from the high-voltage power supply to the high-voltage load device is cut off, thereby preventing an electric shock.

title_en: Integrated heat management system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an integrated heat management system and a method, at least comprising a control unit and a cooling circulation pipeline of a galvanic pile; the pipeline for inputting air to the cathode (5) of the electric pile is at least provided with an air compressor (3) and an intercooler (4), and the intercooler (4) is communicated with a hydrogen input pipeline; the cooling circulation pipeline of the electric pile is communicated with the air compressor (3) in a loop forming mode, so that part of cooling fluid completes cooling circulation in a mode of flowing through the air compressor (3), the cooling fluid cools air in the air compressor (3) in a heat energy transfer mode, the air and hydrogen exhausted by the air compressor (3) achieve temperature equalization of the two gases in the intercooler (4) in a heat transfer mode, and the air and the hydrogen respectively enter the electric pile in a mode that the temperatures are approximately consistent. The invention improves the control precision of the fuel cell system based on the accurate management of temperature control and ensures the high-efficiency and reliable operation of the fuel cell system.

title_en: System and method for operating a power generating asset
abstract_en: Systems and methods for controlling a power generating asset having an energy storage device are provided.
