Accordingly, the controller of the power generation asset initiates a state change event for the energy storage device. The controller determines an actual Equivalent Series Resistance (ESR) function for the energy storage device based on changes in the first and second electrical conditions at each of a plurality of sampling intervals of the state change event. The controller determines a health assessment for the energy storage device based on the actual ESR function and executes a control action based on the health assessment.

title_en: Small-wire-diameter charging cable structure and charging device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small-wire-diameter charging cable structure and a charging device, wherein the small-wire-diameter charging cable structure comprises: the insulating outer cover is axially provided with a mounting cavity; the insulator is arranged in the mounting cavity, a containing cavity extending along the axial direction of the insulating outer cover is formed in the insulator, and a liquid flow channel for flowing cooling liquid is formed between the outer peripheral surface of the insulator and the inner surface of the insulating outer cover; a conductor disposed within the flow channel; and an auxiliary cable disposed in the accommodating chamber. The invention provides a small-wire-diameter charging cable structure and a charging device, and solves the technical problem that the existing liquid cooling cable is poor in heat dissipation effect.

title_en: Power dispatching equipment based on data center convenient to maintain
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power dispatching equipment, and discloses power dispatching equipment which is convenient to maintain and based on a data center. The mounting frame can drive the electrical component mounting plate to move outwards and be in an inclined state through the matched use of the first sliding column and the second sliding column, so that the convenience of the device is improved, the electrical component mounting plate can be detached through the matched use of the wedge-shaped block and the rotating seat, the detachment efficiency of the device is improved, the control module mounting plate can move outwards through the matched use of the fluted disc and the second tooth groove, and the use effect of the device is improved.

title_en: Self-energy-taking ice measurer device and use method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-energy-taking ice measurer device and a use method thereof, wherein the self-energy-taking ice measurer device comprises: the ice measuring module is connected with the energy taking module, the rectifying circuit, the filtering circuit and the voltage stabilizing circuit; the rectifying, filtering and voltage stabilizing circuit is respectively connected with the energy storage module, the ice measuring module, the control module and the communication module; the energy storage module is respectively connected with the ice measuring module, the control module and the communication module; when icing is carried out, the motor drives the rotating shaft to rotate coaxially, the control module starts to record the icing quality of a single cylinder, the data is uploaded to the background server through the communication module, and the actual icing condition is calculated by the background server; when the transmission line starts to melt ice, the positive temperature coefficient heating layer is electrically heated through the wire, and the heat is directly transferred to the surface of the skin under the action of the heat insulation layer to melt ice; the problems of insufficient energy supply and difficulty in self ice melting caused by the fact that an ice measuring device near a power transmission line cannot take energy from a lead are solved.

title_en: Sodium ion composite solid electrolyte, preparation method thereof and battery
abstract_en: The invention provides a sodium ion composite solid electrolyte, a preparation method thereof and a battery. The preparation method comprises the following steps: soaking a metal organic framework compound in the sodium electrolyte to obtain a process product, wherein the process product comprises the metal organic framework compound filled with the sodium electrolyte; dissolving a process product and a polymer in an organic solvent, and stirring to obtain a mixed solution; and pouring the mixed solution into a mold, and drying to remove the organic solvent to obtain the sodium ion composite solid electrolyte. The sodium ion composite solid electrolyte is prepared by the preparation method of the sodium ion composite solid electrolyte. The battery comprises the sodium ion composite solid electrolyte. The beneficial effects of the invention can include: the preparation method has simple process flow, does not relate to complex reaction process, and reduces energy consumption and equipment investment; the process links do not generate 'three wastes', accords with the concept of green industry and is environment-friendly.

title_en: Cap assembly, secondary battery including the same, and battery pack
abstract_en: The present invention provides a secondary battery including: an electrode assembly; a can for accommodating the electrode assembly; an electrolyte solution that is distributed throughout the electrode assembly when injected into the can; and a cap assembly installed at the opening of the can, wherein the cap assembly includes: a top cover having a top hole formed vertically therethrough; a safety vent disposed below the top cover and having a vent hole formed vertically therethrough; and a CID filter disposed below the safety vent, coupled to a positive electrode tab disposed on the electrode assembly, and having a CID hole formed to vertically pass through the CID filter, wherein the CID hole is completed or opened by the positive electrode tab.

title_en: Method for determining the position and/or speed of a rotor of an electric machine by processing signals of a position sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for determining the angular speed and/or angular position of the rotor of an electric machine by determining harmonics using a closed loop comprising a harmonic observer, a phase difference correction and a first phase locked loop estimating the position of the rotor.

title_en: Wave parameter measuring device and wave measuring method
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of wave observation, and particularly relates to a wave parameter measuring device and a wave parameter measuring method. The traditional wave buoy has low measurement precision and relatively high manufacturing cost. The application provides a wave parameter measuring device, including hollow floating ball, be provided with connection platform in the hollow floating ball, last solar cell panel and the acceleration sensor who is provided with interconnect of connection platform, acceleration sensor with x, y, the three direction of z set up in connection platform is last, acceleration sensor includes shielding shell, be provided with the friction power generation subassembly in the shielding shell, be provided with the balancing weight in the hollow floating ball, be provided with the accumulate module, calculation module and the communication module that connect gradually on the balancing weight, communication module with accumulate module connects, accumulate module with solar cell panel connects, acceleration sensor with calculation module connects.

title_en: Charging circuit, charging chip and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a charging circuit, a charging chip and an electronic device. In the low temperature or the charging environment of undervoltage, this charging circuit can be according to the battery to the demand of electric current under current charging environment, adjusts the current value of the electric current that flows into the battery through the reposition of redundant personnel effect, can prolong battery life to guarantee charging process's safety.

title_en: Pre-charging using a center-point node
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to pre-charging using a center point node. For example, an apparatus for connecting a first network including a first energy storage element and a second network including a second energy storage element includes switching circuitry and pre-charging circuitry. The switching circuit arrangement is configured to electrically couple the first network and the second network. The switching circuit arrangement includes a first switching element configured to bidirectionally allow current flow between the first network and the center point node when operating in a closed state. The switching circuit arrangement further comprises a second switching element configured to bidirectionally allow current flow between the second network and the center point node when operating in a closed state. The pre-charge circuit arrangement is configured to limit current to the center-point node when a first voltage at the first energy storage element is equal to a second voltage at the second energy storage element.

title_en: Full-wave rectifying circuit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electronic circuits and discloses a full-wave rectifying circuit which comprises a first operational amplifier, a second operational amplifier, an inductance coil, a resistor and a detection device, wherein homopolar power supply terminals of the first operational amplifier and the second operational amplifier are respectively connected in parallel, the output end of the first operational amplifier is connected with one end of the inductance coil, the other end of the inductance coil is connected with the output end of the second operational amplifier, a power supply supplies power to the first operational amplifier and the second operational amplifier through the resistor, a detection port of the detection device is connected with the first resistor in parallel, and the detection device outputs a full-wave rectifying signal. The full-wave rectifying circuit is simple in circuit, the threshold value of the rectifying circuit can be accurately controlled without using a diode for rectification, the effective detection of direct current leakage current is realized, the high-frequency higher harmonic leakage current with potential harm is also effectively detected, and the cost is low.

title_en: Apparatus, system, method, device, and medium for multi-node power metering
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a low-voltage transformer district data monitoring field, concretely relates to an equipment, system, method, device and medium for multinode electric energy measurement, this node side equipment for multinode electric energy measurement includes: the open-type current transformer is arranged on a cable to be detected at a node and is used for detecting phase current information of the cable to be detected; and the node terminal is used for acquiring the phase current information detected by the open-type current transformer through mutual inductance and sending the phase current information to the gateway side equipment. This technical scheme can reduce equipment cost, and the wiring is simple, and it is convenient to maintain, can not influence the normal operating of node side equipment when circuit transformation or dismantlement, mainly used monitors the electric energy data of each distribution node.

title_en: IGBT (insulated Gate Bipolar transistor) through detection method and device, frequency converter and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an IGBT (insulated gate bipolar transistor) through detection method, an IGBT through detection device, a frequency converter and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of frequency converter fault detection, wherein the method is used for detecting a full-bridge type inversion unit, the inversion unit comprises a first phase, and the first phase is any phase of the inversion unit; the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first bus voltage of an inversion unit; controlling a first bridge arm IGBT of the first phase to be conducted for a first preset time to obtain a second bus voltage of the inverter unit; obtaining a bus voltage drop according to the first bus voltage and the second bus voltage; and obtaining a through detection result of the second bridge arm IGBT of the first phase according to the bus voltage drop. The invention solves the problem that the converter which is not provided with VCE detection in the prior art can not detect the IGBT through fault, and realizes the purpose that the IGBT through fault can be detected without VCE detection on the IGBT.

title_en: Fault processing method, device, medium and equipment for electric vehicle thermal management system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method, a device, a medium and equipment for processing faults of a thermal management system of an electric automobile. The method comprises the following steps: determining a fault electronic device in response to a fault processing request sent by a thermal management system, and determining fault information of the fault electronic device; wherein the thermal management system comprises at least two thermal management modules; the thermal management module comprises at least two electronic devices; determining a thermal management module to which the faulty electronic device belongs in the thermal management system, and taking the thermal management module as a target thermal management module; and determining a target fault processing plan in the candidate fault processing plans of the target thermal management module based on the fault information of the fault electronic device, and processing a fault processing request based on the target fault processing plan. The technical scheme provides a systematic fault processing method for the electric automobile heat management system, so that the reliability of the electric automobile heat management system can be improved, and the driving safety is ensured.

title_en: Method for twisting coil segments, twisting jig and twisting device
abstract_en: On an outer peripheral surface of the inner torsion jig (26) corresponding to the innermost layer, a plurality of first accommodation recesses (38 a) and a plurality of second accommodation recesses (38 b) are formed at intervals in the circumferential direction, the first accommodation recesses (38 a) accommodating distal end portions (12 d) of slot insertion portions (12 a) of the ordinary coil segments (12), and the second accommodation recesses (38 b) accommodating long distal end portions (14 d) of the slot insertion portions (14 b) of the modified coil segments (14). The first accommodation recess (38 a) is located at a position offset in the circumferential direction with respect to the distal end portion (12 d) to be accommodated in a state in which the long-distal end portion (14 d) of the long-groove insertion portion (14 b) before twisting is inserted into the second accommodation recess (38 b). The inner torsion jig (26) is rotated in this state to perform primary torsion, and then the distal end portion (12 d) of the normal coil section (12) is further inserted into the first accommodation recess (38 a) to perform secondary torsion, the rotation amount of the secondary torsion being larger than that of the primary torsion.

title_en: Probability prediction method for generating capacity of distributed photovoltaic station in area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a probability prediction method for generating capacity of a distributed photovoltaic station in a region, which comprises the following steps of firstly establishing a prediction model, secondly checking whether the prediction model needs to be updated, thirdly training each prediction model by using training data, fourthly finding out optimal weight of each prediction model, fifthly deriving error distribution from an aggregate model, fifthly predicting deterministic photovoltaic generating capacity by the aggregate model, seventhly generating PI (proportion) from the error distribution and the deterministic prediction, developing a model with universality and a method for predicting the intra-region distributed photovoltaic generating capacity, and performing aggregate prediction by using three data-driven regression models of K-Means, naive Bayesian classifiers and a neural network to process a plurality of PVs geographically distributed in a specific region.

title_en: Metamaterial energy transmission window based on sapphire substrate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a metamaterial energy transmission window based on a sapphire substrate and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of microwave electro-vacuum. Through the interaction between the metal structure and the electric field, the transmission performance better than that of the traditional box-shaped window is realized; through the interaction between the rectangular metal frame and the electric field, a TM11 mode and a TE21 mode are excited on a sapphire substrate window, so that the energy transmission window realizes better mode matching, reflection is reduced, and better transmission performance than the traditional box-type window can be realized.

title_en: Power supply and connecting support thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply and a connecting bracket thereof, which comprise a clamping part and a connecting part, wherein the clamping part is used for fixing the connecting part and an installation position, and the connecting part is used for fixing the clamping part and the power supply; the connecting part comprises a connecting arm arranged on one side of the clamping part, the connecting arm is rotatably installed with the first clamping part through a first rotary table, one end of the connecting arm is rotatably provided with a connecting rod, and the connecting rod is connected with the first rotating part; one side of the first rotating piece is provided with a second rotating piece. According to the invention, the sealing performance is improved through the inclined planes arranged at the connecting positions of the top edge of the first shell, the second shell and the limiting part, namely through surface contact, and compared with a sealing ring, aging and abrasion are not needed to be worried about, so that the production and use cost is reduced; the power supply is convenient to take out and place by pressing the lock to lock and fix, namely, the anti-theft device is provided with a plurality of anti-theft mechanisms, so that the loss caused by the loss of the battery is reduced; the rotation of accomplishing power and handlebar through linking bridge is fixed, does not confine to single handlebar, promotes the application scope of this device.

title_en: Power conversion apparatus, control system, drive system, and power conversion method
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a power conversion apparatus, a control system, a drive system, and a power conversion method. The power conversion apparatus may include: a power conversion circuit configured to perform power conversion for outputting drive power to the induction motor; and a control circuit. The control circuit may be configured to: receiving a master command phase from a master power conversion device; generating a voltage command having a command phase in a rotating coordinate system based on the torque target value, wherein the rotating coordinate system follows a rotor of the induction machine; calculating a rotational phase of the rotating coordinate system based on the command phase difference between the master command phase and the command phase to reduce the command phase difference; and controlling the power conversion circuit to output the driving power to the induction motor in synchronization with the main power conversion apparatus based on the rotation phase and the voltage command.

title_en: Distributed photovoltaic power generation structure and installation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation, in particular to a distributed photovoltaic power generation structure and a distributed photovoltaic power generation method.

title_en: Automatic adjust anti-shadow photovoltaic support
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photosensitive automatic-adjustment anti-shadow shading photovoltaic support which comprises a bearing support device, a photosensitive device and an angle adjusting device. The bearing support is mainly a long steel pipe, and the bottom of the bearing support is connected with an underground reinforced concrete ground cage through a fixing bolt, so that the stability of the bearing support is ensured; the photosensitive device is composed of an upper condensing plate, a lower condensing plate, a light guide pipe and a photosensitive hydrogel balance pipe, and the shadow signal is captured through the photosensitive characteristic of the photosensitive hydrogel; the angle adjusting device mainly comprises an encoder, a signal line and a power rotating part, so that an optical signal is converted into an electric signal and transmitted to the power gear to adjust the angle of the photovoltaic module. The invention realizes the extraction of real-time optical signals mainly according to the photosensitive dehydration characteristic of photosensitive hydrogel, and reflects the shadow condition by means of a balancing rod to drive the angle adjustment, thereby achieving the effect of anti-shadow. The novel combined type air conditioner is simple in structure, convenient to install and low in manufacturing cost and maintenance cost.

title_en: Multiphase EMI and transient protection circuit and synchronous rectification control for a compressor of a refrigeration system
abstract_en: A driver for a mobile compressor includes EMI and transient protection circuitry, a second choke, a converter, and an inverter. The EMI and transient protection circuits include a common mode choke and at least one component, respectively. Each of the common mode chokes is configured to receive a first direct voltage and is connected to a first ground and a second ground. At least one component is connected to a third ground. The first ground, the second ground, and the third ground are at different voltage potentials. The second choke is connected downstream of the common mode choke. The converter is connected to an output of the second choke and is configured to commonly provide a second dc voltage to the dc bus. The inverter is connected to the DC bus and is configured to convert the second DC voltage to an AC voltage to power the mobile compressor downstream of the inverter.

title_en: Parameter optimization method for motor load torque observer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a parameter optimization method for a motor load torque observer, wherein the load torque observation adopts an algorithm that feedback gain is automatically adjusted according to the variation of a load torque set value and the variation of a load torque observation value, and when the system speed changes or the parameters change and the load is disturbed, so that the load torque set value changes or/and the load torque observation value changes, the observation error of the load torque is quickly reduced, the load torque observation value is feedforward compensated into a current regulator, and the control precision of a permanent magnet synchronous motor is improved. When the parameters of the load torque observer are optimized and adjusted by adopting a wolf set algorithm, aiming at different optimized objects such as searching an accurate optimal solution and avoiding local optimal objects near the optimal solution, the wolf set algorithm can carry out maximum adaptation by reasonably selecting the value of an attack step attenuation factor xi so as to achieve different optimization effects.

title_en: Gear box rotating mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to a gear box rotating mechanism, which solves the problems of insufficient transmission power and unstable transmission of the existing multimedia screen rotating mechanism. Including the base, locate the driving shaft on the base, and the driven shaft, driving shaft and driven shaft are located the both ends of base respectively, driving shaft and the parallel concentric setting of driven shaft, be equipped with drive driving shaft pivoted actuating mechanism in the base, actuating mechanism is including the motor, the worm gear mechanism of being connected with the motor spindle, and the gear train of being connected with worm gear, the driving shaft is connected with the gear train, still be equipped with the angle stop gear who is used for restricting driving shaft and driven shaft rotation angle in the base, during the use, install on driving shaft and driven shaft at the both ends of screen, in the transmission process, motor power passes through worm gear mechanism and sends the gear train to, the gear train drives the driving shaft and rotates, thereby the drive ratio has been improved, transmission torsion has been improved, driving shaft and driven shaft set up with one heart in addition, thereby the screen rotates stably.

title_en: Circuit structure for realizing leading-lagging phase change of motor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a circuit structure for realizing leading and lagging commutation of a motor, wherein the circuit structure comprises a Hall angle mapping module, a Hall angle mapping module and a phase switching module, wherein the Hall angle mapping module is used for receiving three Hall signals generated by a Hall module of an external motor and respectively configuring and converting the three Hall signals into Hall synchronous angle values; the Hall angle updating module is used for selecting a corresponding angle updating mode according to the internal logic of the circuit structure; the three-phase angle generating module is used for carrying out time-sharing calculation on the angle generated by the Hall angle updating module to generate a current three-phase angle signal; the angle conversion module is used for carrying out corresponding angle conversion on the three-phase angle signal generated by the three-phase angle generation module; and the PWM generating module is used for generating three-phase six-path complementary PWM waveforms. The circuit structure of the invention can simply realize the phase lead-lag operation only by additionally adding partial logic circuit modules, and can realize smooth switching between the square wave control mode and the sine wave control mode.

title_en: Method for fully recycling waste lithium ion batteries and realizing metal separation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for fully recycling waste lithium ion batteries and realizing metal separation, which comprises the steps of crushing waste lithium ion battery cores, adding air into obtained black powder for roasting, adding an ammonia solution into obtained roasting slag for leaching, and collecting filter residues and filtrate, wherein the filtrate is lithium-nickel-cobalt-containing liquid; heating and evaporating the obtained filtrate, collecting evaporated gas, returning to an ammonia leaching process, filtering the evaporated liquid, and collecting filter residues to obtain nickel-cobalt mixed hydroxide, nickel hydroxide or cobalt hydroxide; and heating and crystallizing the filtrate, and collecting and drying the crystallized product to obtain lithium carbonate. The method simultaneously recovers the positive electrode material and the negative electrode material in the waste batteries, realizes the separation of iron, manganese, lithium and nickel cobalt, has no secondary pollution in the recovery process, and has short process flow and low cost.

title_en: Control method and device of lighting equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method and a device of lighting equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring image information from image source equipment; screening target image information associated with the lighting equipment from the image information, wherein the target image information is used for identifying data information for controlling the lighting equipment; carrying out image recognition on the target image information to obtain a target recognition result; determining a light control signal of the lighting equipment according to the target recognition result and a preset parameter conversion model; and controlling the lighting equipment to display light according to the light control signal. Therefore, the invention can generate the control signal associated with the lighting equipment by screening and identifying the image information, realize the smooth conversion from the image visual effect to the light visual effect, effectively improve the flexibility and the adaptability of the control of the lighting equipment, improve the richness of the adjustment of the lighting effect of the lighting equipment, improve the display immersion degree of the lighting equipment and realize diversified control and display effects.

title_en: Relay with flexible connection multi-break
abstract_en: The invention discloses a relay with flexibly connected multiple fractures, which comprises at least one group of contact assemblies, wherein each group of contact assemblies comprises a moving contact A and a static contact A which are oppositely arranged, and a moving contact B and a static contact B, wherein the moving contact A and the moving contact B are electrically connected through a flexible part; and the two groups of driving mechanisms are a moving contact driving mechanism A for driving the moving contact A to be connected with or disconnected from the static contact A and a moving contact driving mechanism B for driving the moving contact B to be connected with or disconnected from the static contact B. The invention is provided with at least one group of contact assemblies and two groups of contact driving mechanisms at the same time, and the two groups of contact driving mechanisms are used for independently controlling two rigid contact groups of one group of contact assemblies, and moving contacts between the two rigid contact groups are connected through a flexible piece. When the suction and release actions of the contacts occur, if the clamping stagnation or the fault occurs to a single contact pair, the product can still realize partial functions, and the complete failure can not be caused, thereby improving the reliability of the product.

title_en: Resin frame-equipped MEA and method for manufacturing same
abstract_en: The invention provides an MEA with a resin frame and a manufacturing method thereof. In the MEA (10) with a resin frame, an electrolyte membrane (26) has an outer circumference overlapping part (40) overlapping with an inner circumference part (24 i) of a resin frame member (24). Ion flow blocking parts (50, 140) are provided at the peripheral overlapping part. The ion flow blocking part blocks the flow of iron ions, copper ions, or the like. The ion flow blocking section has an annular shape and surrounds the power generation region (44) of the MEA (22). The ion flow-through preventing portion can be formed as a physical barrier or a chemical barrier. This can prevent the central region of the electrolyte membrane from being deteriorated by the entry of ions from the outer peripheral side of the MEA.

title_en: Electricity core hot pressing equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cell hot-pressing device, which comprises: the pressing device comprises a first pressing piece and a second pressing piece, the first pressing piece is used for bearing the battery cell, and the second pressing piece is arranged opposite to the first pressing piece; the driving device is used for driving the first pressing piece and the second pressing piece to relatively approach or separate; the first magnetic conduction device comprises at least one first magnetic conduction piece, and the first magnetic conduction piece is connected to the first pressing piece; the second magnetic conduction device comprises at least one second magnetic conduction piece, and the second magnetic conduction piece is connected to the second pressing piece; at least one of the first magnetic conductive part and the second magnetic conductive part is connected with a coil; when the first pressing part and the second pressing part are relatively close to the pressing position, the first magnetic conduction part and the second magnetic conduction part are relatively close to each other, so that the first magnetic conduction part and the second magnetic conduction part form a closed magnetic conduction passage. The hot-pressing equipment is provided with the magnetic conduction piece, and the magnetic conduction piece can form a closed magnetic conduction path, so that the penetrating capability of a magnetic field is enhanced, and the heating time is shortened.

title_en: PMMA/PVDF composite diaphragm and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a PMMA/PVDF composite diaphragm and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: the base membrane is a porous film; a heat-resistant layer disposed on at least one side surface of the base film; an organic layer disposed on a surface of the heat-resistant layer, the organic layer including PMMA/PVDF complex aggregates, a binder, and a defoaming agent; the PMMA/PVDF composite agglomerate is formed by agglomerating PMMA particles and PVDF particles, and the mass ratio of the PMMA particles to the PVDF particles is 3. The PMMA in the aggregate can provide a channel for lithium ions to shuttle through the secondary particle size aggregate, so that the obstruction of the secondary particle size PVDF on the shuttle of the lithium ions is improved, and the cycle performance of the battery is improved; the introduction of PMMA increases the adhesive force between the diaphragm and the pole piece, and improves the hardness of the battery.

title_en: Deicing operation device for overhead line of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cable maintenance, in particular to a deicing operation device for an overhead line of a power distribution network. The existing deicing method can only perform deicing treatment on cables with the same size, so that the use occasions of deicing equipment are reduced, and ice cones at the lower ends of the cables cannot be removed, so that the normal work of the deicing equipment is influenced; the deicing unit can adjust the angle of the ice scraper, change the ice scraping area of the ice scraper and realize the function of scraping ice shells with different thicknesses in a certain range, so that the flexibility of the device is improved.

title_en: Energy-saving 5-sulfosalicylic acid sublimation device and use method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of 5-sulfosalicylic acid sublimation, in particular to an energy-saving 5-sulfosalicylic acid sublimation device and a using method thereof. The storage battery supplies power to the electric heating placing plate to enable the electric heating placing plate to be heated, and then air circulation is carried out through the circulating pipe.

title_en: Fuel cell system and aircraft
abstract_en: The invention provides a fuel cell system and an aircraft capable of charging a battery while ensuring independence and redundancy of the fuel cell and the battery as power sources. The fuel cell system is a fuel cell system for an aircraft, and is characterized in that the fuel cell system includes a fuel cell, a battery, a motor, and a control unit, the motor is electrically connected to the fuel cell and the battery as independent power sources and has a dual 3-phase winding using a dual inverter, and the control unit drives the motor at a predetermined 1 st output from the fuel cell and charges the battery with a torque generated by the motor when receiving a normal output request from the motor.

title_en: Self-cleaning type assembled box-type substation with dust classification clearance effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-cleaning assembled box transformer substation with a dust classification cleaning effect, which belongs to the field of box transformer substations and comprises a cabinet body, wherein the back surface of the cabinet body is bolted with a back plate, a dust blocking box is arranged inside the back plate in a penetrating way, and a filtering and intercepting frame is arranged inside the dust blocking box; a blocking net and a screen frame are arranged in the filtering and intercepting frame, a foam ball is placed in the screen frame, an inner ball is placed in the foam ball, through holes are formed in the surface of the foam ball, an inner sticking block is connected to the inner surface of the foam ball, and a hook and winding net is wound on the surface of the inner ball; the bottom of dust blocking box is installed and is changeed the magazine, can carry out the dust self-purification when handling to the environment that the case becomes the place, can realize the processing of pertinence to linear debris such as poplar wadding silk thread, hydrophilicity dust and hydrophobicity dust that contain in the dust, avoids taking place the pipeline shutoff phenomenon, and then ensures that the case becomes and going on carrying out the continuation of surrounding environment dust self-purification processing in-process.

title_en: New energy storage coupling multi-resonance transformation method and system
abstract_en: In the new energy storage coupling multi-resonance transformation method, system and storage medium provided by the application, an isolation transformer, a first converter are arranged on the primary side of the isolation transformer, a multi-resonance converter is arranged between the first converter and the isolation transformer, and a second converter is arranged on the secondary side of the isolation transformer. Therefore, the multi-resonant converter comprises the parallel resonant circuit, the first inductor and the auxiliary inductor, the gain characteristic of the circuit is changed by the parallel resonant circuit, and then the output voltage can be adjusted in a wide voltage range. Meanwhile, through the multi-resonance converter, the fundamental wave and the third harmonic wave are both subjected to resonance, and the energy of the fundamental wave and the third harmonic wave is transmitted to the load, so that the loss caused by reactive power circulation in the converter is reduced.

title_en: Electromagnetic voltage transformer
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electromagnetic voltage transformer, which relates to the technical field of voltage transformers and comprises an assembling mechanism, a sealing mechanism and an installation adjusting mechanism, wherein a connecting rod is inserted into a slot, a pull rod is sleeved outside the connecting rod, a first bolt is fixedly connected to the outer surface of a rotating shaft, a first sealing ring is inserted into a pressing ring, a second sealing ring is abutted against the upper surface of a top ring, and a through groove is formed in the upper part of an installation frame. The transformer box is provided with the assembling mechanism, so that the transformer box is favorable for production and assembly, and the disassembly operation of the box body is also favorable, so that the later-period maintenance is more time-saving and labor-saving, the transformer box is suitable for high-altitude operation, the sealing property between the box body and the box cover can be effectively improved by arranging the sealing mechanism, the mounting hole on the transformer and the hole site on the external bracket can be adjusted when certain dislocation exists by arranging the mounting adjusting mechanism, the mounting hole corresponds to the hole site on the external bracket, and the mounting construction of the transformer is prevented from being influenced.

title_en: Electric drive system and design method
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric drive system and a design method, wherein the electric drive system comprises at least one axial magnetic field motor and at least one speed reducer, an output end surface is arranged on one axial side of the axial magnetic field motor, and the design method comprises the following steps: (a) Designing the speed reducer according to the radial size of the axial magnetic field motor and the transmission ratio required by the electric drive system; (b) Will axial magnetic field motor's output terminal surface connect in the reduction gear deviates from one side of wheel, in order to obtain electric drive system utilizes axial magnetic field motor axial dimension little, and the big advantage of radial dimension further increases the design space utilization of reduction gear to can satisfy arrange two between two wheels axial magnetic field motor and two the reduction gear.

title_en: Film manufacturing apparatus
abstract_en: A thin film manufacturing apparatus according to the present invention is an apparatus for forming a thin film by adhering film-forming particles to one surface of a substrate moving in a hermetically-sealable chamber, the apparatus including: a plasma generating section, a substrate moving section, a film formation source supplying section, and a film formation region defining section. The plasma generation portion includes: a magnet located on the other surface side of the substrate; and a gas supply unit for supplying a film forming gas to the vicinity of one surface of the substrate. The film formation region defining section has a shielding section which is located in the vicinity of one surface of the substrate and has an opening. The ratio of the diameter of the opening of the shielding portion to the diameter of the plasma generated by the plasma generating portion in the direction along the one surface of the substrate is set to be 110/100 or less.

title_en: Secondary battery, electronic device, and vehicle
abstract_en: A positive electrode active material having a large charge/discharge capacity is provided. A positive electrode active material having a high charge/discharge voltage is provided. Provided is an electric storage device with little deterioration. Provided is a highly safe power storage device. Provided is a novel power storage device. The positive electrode active material contains lithium, a plurality of transition metals, oxygen, and impurity elements. The positive electrode active material includes a first region having a surface layer portion and a second region provided inside, and the concentration of the transition metal in the first region is higher than that in the second region. An impurity region is included between the first region and the second region.

title_en: Air conditioner outdoor unit, air conditioner and control method of air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air conditioner outdoor unit, an air conditioner and a control method thereof, relates to the field of air conditioners, and solves the problem that the air conditioner has low universality because the air conditioner in the prior art can only be connected with a single power supply system. The air conditioner outdoor unit comprises a heat exchange assembly, a control assembly and a power supply switching assembly, wherein the heat exchange assembly comprises a variable frequency compressor and a fixed frequency compressor, the control assembly comprises a first control unit and a second control unit, the first control unit is connected with the fixed frequency compressor, the second control unit is connected with the variable frequency compressor, the first control unit or the second control unit is further connected with the power supply switching assembly, and the power supply switching assembly is further connected with the variable frequency compressor or the fixed frequency compressor. The air conditioner outdoor unit can switch the alternating current power supply connected to the air conditioner into the direct current power supply through the power supply switching component, or switch the direct current power supply connected to the air conditioner into the alternating current power supply, so that the air conditioner can use the variable frequency compressor and the fixed frequency compressor at the same time, and the universality of the air conditioner is enhanced.

title_en: Flame-retardant photoelectric composite cable and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flame-retardant photoelectric composite cable which comprises a sheath layer, a winding layer and an optical fiber and a conductor embedded in the winding layer from outside to inside, wherein the sheath layer is made of a flame-retardant polypropylene material; the flame-retardant polypropylene material comprises the following raw materials: 65-105 parts of polypropylene, 15-35 parts of modified graphene, 12-26 parts of calcium carbonate, 0.5-2 parts of coupling agent, 6-18 parts of auxiliary flame retardant and 3-10 parts of lubricant. The invention utilizes the flame-retardant polypropylene material as the raw material of the protective sleeve, utilizes the excellent elasticity and bending resistance of the polypropylene, reduces the deformation of the photoelectric composite cable, improves the stability of optical signals, and simultaneously carries out flame retardance and heat conduction modification on the polypropylene material, so that the protective sleeve has high temperature resistance, heat dissipation and flame retardance. The flame-retardant modification is that the modified graphene and the auxiliary flame retardant MCA exert flame-retardant performance in a coordinated manner, so that the flame-retardant polypropylene material is endowed with high flame retardance.

title_en: Multi-element manganese-iron-carbon-doped composite electrode material based on electrolytic manganese slag and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: A multi-element manganese-iron-carbon-doped composite electrode material based on electrolytic manganese slag and a preparation method thereof relate to the field of electrolytic manganese slag treatment, and specifically are characterized in that waste electrolytic manganese slag is extracted by adopting a leaching mode to extract elements such as medium manganese, iron and the like to prepare a manganese-iron-carbon composite material, and the manganese-iron-carbon composite material is applied to a super-capacitor electrode material to obtain good capacitance capability. The invention uses dilute acid to leach on the basis of acid of waste electrolytic manganese slag, and takes acid leaching liquid of manganese, iron and the like as raw materials to prepare oxides. And the adsorption and stability characteristics of the carbon material are combined to prepare the manganese-iron-carbon-based composite material, and the material is prepared into the supercapacitor electrode, so that higher specific capacitance and stability can be obtained. The method mainly utilizes the manganese element in the electrolytic manganese slag in a high-value way, and solves the problem that the heteroatom exists, namely the doped S, ca, al, si and the like can not have adverse effects on the capacitance performance or the adsorption performance of the material, and can even play a weak gain role.

title_en: Three-level DC/DC circuit control system
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-level DC/DC circuit control system, which comprises a voltage control unit, a current loop control unit, a bus voltage difference loop control unit, a duty ratio distribution unit and a three-level DC/DC circuit, wherein the voltage control unit is connected with the current loop control unit; the three-level DC/DC circuit comprises a switch tube group consisting of at least two switch tubes; the voltage control unit is used for obtaining voltage comparison information; the current loop control unit is used for comparing the current instruction with the current feedback to obtain a duty ratio and an instruction; the method comprises the steps that a duty ratio difference instruction of a switching tube group is obtained through a bus voltage difference loop control unit, and the duty ratio difference instruction is used for determining the duty ratio difference of each switching tube in the switching tube group so as to carry out voltage equalizing control on a bus; the input end of the duty ratio distribution unit is connected with the output end of the current loop control unit, and the input end of the duty ratio distribution unit is connected with the output end of the bus voltage difference loop control unit, so that voltage equalizing control on the bus can be ensured when the circuit is in a current continuous state and a current discontinuous state, and damage to circuit devices is prevented.

title_en: Photovoltaic support and photovoltaic system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaics, in particular to a photovoltaic support and a photovoltaic system. Because the connecting piece can the joint in the support base, can simplify the assembly process of photovoltaic support, and because the connecting piece can the joint in photovoltaic panel, can simplify the assembly process of photovoltaic panel and photovoltaic support for assembly, dismantlement and maintenance are all more convenient, and work efficiency improves. The photovoltaic system comprises a photovoltaic panel and the photovoltaic bracket. This photovoltaic system can conveniently assemble, dismantle and maintain, improves work efficiency.

title_en: Rubberizing mechanism and rubberizing device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rubberizing mechanism and a rubberizing device, wherein the rubberizing mechanism comprises a fixed plate, a rubber belt unreeling assembly is arranged on one side of the fixed plate, a first sucking disc, a rubber cutting assembly and a rubberizing assembly are sequentially arranged at the unreeling end of the rubber belt unreeling assembly above a feed inlet, and a second sucking disc is arranged at the bottom of the rubberizing assembly; still be provided with on the fixed plate and draw gluey subassembly, draw gluey subassembly including drawing gluey unit, lateral shifting unit and longitudinal movement unit, it is provided with the adhesion face to draw gluey unit, the lateral shifting unit is used for driving draw gluey unit first sucking disc with the adsorption face below of second sucking disc reciprocates, the longitudinal movement unit is used for driving draw gluey unit with first sucking disc or the adsorption face contact of second sucking disc. The adhesive pulling assembly of the adhesive sticking mechanism is in contact with the adhesive tape and drives the adhesive tape to move through the adhesive surface of the adhesive pulling unit, so that the working space required by the adhesive pulling assembly is reduced, and the size of equipment is optimized.

title_en: Spacer for fixing split conductors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a spacer for fixing split conductors, which comprises an annular plate, wherein the side part of the annular plate is rotatably connected with six strip-shaped plates arranged in an annular array through six pin shafts, the inner wall of the annular plate is fixedly connected with six arc-shaped rods arranged in the annular array, the six arc-shaped rods are sleeved with twelve first springs, the outer wall of each threaded rod is sleeved with a sleeve in a threaded manner, the inner wall of each guide sleeve is connected with a guide rod in a sliding manner, one end of each guide rod is fixedly connected with a limiting block in blocking fit with one end of each guide sleeve, and a horizontal damping clamping mechanism is jointly installed on each guide rod and each guide sleeve. The split spacer solves the problems that six cables are usually directly and fixedly clamped by the split spacer, the cables can swing under the action of wind force, each cable can drag the split spacer, the split spacer can be damaged by long-time dragging, and meanwhile the connection part of the cables and the split spacer is also abraded.

title_en: Power grid dispatching control method based on model
abstract_en: A power grid dispatching control method based on a model belongs to the field of power grid dispatching control and aims to solve the problems that a power grid dispatching control system in an existing combined operation mode cannot guarantee that net income of a power grid unit is maximum and carbon emission is high. The method comprises the steps of predicting the next-day wind power generation value according to historical weather data; forecasting the next-day power grid demand load value according to the historical power grid load value; introducing an energy storage battery, balancing the load of the power grid, and obtaining the value of the electric power which can be stored or provided by the energy storage battery; the next-day power grid demand load value is used for removing the next-day wind power generation value and the power value which can be stored or provided by the energy storage battery, and a next-day firepower generation initial value is obtained; outputting penalty cost by using the constructed model; determining a planned value of next-day wind power generation by using the constructed net income value function so as to maximize the net income value; and carrying out power grid dispatching control according to the next-day firepower power output planned value. The method has the beneficial effects of good environmental protection benefit and economic benefit.

title_en: Distributed electrochemical energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed electrochemical energy storage system, comprising: the system comprises a battery energy management system and a plurality of energy storage subunits, wherein each energy storage subunit comprises a battery module, a battery management unit, a charge-discharge strategy analysis module and a current conversion subunit; the battery management unit comprises a battery core data acquisition module, a module SOC/SOH calculation module and a passive equalization module; the battery energy management system is used for acquiring first data in the battery management unit and second data in the charge-discharge strategy analysis module in each energy storage subunit and making a charge-discharge strategy of the energy storage system. By implementing the invention, the battery management functions such as battery information acquisition, equalization, analysis and calculation and the like and the energy storage converter function are submerged into the battery module layer by layer, so that the energy storage system gets rid of the limitation of external organization forms; the core functions of the battery management system and the energy management system are integrated, so that the management and task issuing of the battery are more refined and more targeted.

title_en: Wind, light, fire and storage combined delivery optimization configuration method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wind, light, fire and storage combined delivery optimization configuration method, a system, equipment and a medium, which comprises the following steps: determining a wind-solar-energy-fire-storage outgoing power transmission channel and an outgoing power transmission channel curve thereof based on the capacity of an outgoing power transmission channel to be planned, and determining an outgoing power transmission channel configuration energy storage charging and discharging principle and an outgoing method; based on the determined energy storage charging and discharging principle and the determined delivery power transmission channel configuration energy storage method, a wind-light-fire-storage combined delivery model is established by taking the minimum running cost of the wind-light-fire-storage combined delivery system as a target, and the established wind-light-fire-storage combined delivery model is solved by adopting a particle swarm algorithm to obtain the optimal capacity ratio of the wind-light-fire-storage. The method can be widely applied to the field of power grid optimal configuration.

title_en: Switched reluctance motorized pulley and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a switched reluctance motorized pulley and a control method thereof, comprising at least three fixed rotor assemblies which are sequentially arranged along the axial direction, wherein each fixed rotor assembly has the same structure and comprises an outer rotor iron core connected with the inner wall of a barrel body, an inner stator iron core connected with a shaft and a single-phase winding; the inner stator iron core comprises a pipe part for winding a single-phase winding, wherein two ends of the pipe part are tooth parts, stator teeth are formed on the tooth parts, and the stator teeth at the two ends are aligned along the axial direction; the number of teeth of rotor teeth and stator teeth on the outer rotor iron core is N, and N is an even number which is more than or equal to 2; the stator teeth of the at least three stator and rotor assemblies are aligned along the axial direction, and the rotor teeth are sequentially staggered by an angle alpha, or the stator teeth are sequentially staggered by the angle alpha, and the rotor teeth are aligned along the axial direction, wherein alpha =360 DEG/N/m, and m is the number of the stator and rotor assemblies. When the roller works, the electrifying directions of the single-phase windings are the same. The roller can be directly used as a driving roller, and has the advantages of good stability, small noise, large output torque, good speed regulation performance and compact structure.

title_en: Integrated QJET and Q0 rod sets sharing the same rod diameter and RF potential
abstract_en: In one aspect, an ion guide assembly for use in a mass spectrometry system is disclosed that includes a first plurality of multipoles arranged to allow ions to pass therethrough, a second plurality of multipoles arranged to allow ions to pass therethrough, and a plate disposed between the first and second plurality of rods, the plate including an ion lens. The first and second pluralities of rods are coupled to the plate, and the rods of the first plurality are aligned in pairs with and coupled to the rods of the second plurality.

title_en: Contact system of contactor and contactor
abstract_en: A contactor contact system of a contactor comprises a fixed contact, a movable contact plate, an upper magnetizer and a lower magnetizer which are arranged on the upper side and the lower side of the movable contact plate and can form a magnetic conductive loop, and a bracket for supporting the movable contact plate and the lower magnetizer, wherein the bracket is fixedly arranged at the upper end of a transmission shaft, and the movable contact plate and the fixed contact can be driven to contact and separate to realize the on-off of the contactor in the up-and-down movement process of the transmission shaft. Through the improvement to magnetizer mounting structure, guaranteed that the contactor product passes through at the heavy current, even electronic repulsion is greater than the coil holding power, the contact ageing can not take place for the contactor contact yet, has reduced the clearance between the magnetizer about the contactor is under the closure state simultaneously to air gap magnetic resistance between the magnetizer has been weakened about, has improved the performance of high-voltage contactor product.

title_en: Highway service area power supply system considering anti-dazzle and wind power generation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a highway service area power supply system considering anti-dazzle and wind power generation, which relates to the technical field of wind power generation and comprises an anti-dazzle wind power unit, an AC/DC conversion unit 1, an energy storage unit, a PCS bidirectional conversion unit, a power distribution management unit, an acquisition control unit, an AC/DC conversion unit 2, a DC/DC conversion unit and a power distribution network; the expressway service area is provided with a charging station, the anti-dazzle-wind power unit is sequentially connected with the AC/DC conversion unit 1, the energy storage unit and the PCS bidirectional conversion unit, and the power distribution network is respectively connected with the PCS bidirectional conversion unit, the AC/DC conversion unit 2 and other conventional power utilization units. The invention can monitor the battery state, control the charging and discharging system and realize energy interchange by the synergistic effect of the subsystems such as the BMS, the PCS bidirectional converter unit, the energy storage unit and the like, thereby improving the utilization rate of the battery, preventing the battery from overcharging and overdischarging, prolonging the service life of the battery, balancing power fluctuation and ensuring the operation safety of a power supply system.

title_en: Negative electrode active material comprising graphene-silicon composite, method for producing same, and lithium secondary battery comprising same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a negative electrode active material comprising a graphene-silicon composite material, a method for preparing the same, and a lithium secondary battery comprising the negative electrode active material, wherein the graphene-silicon composite material is a secondary graphene-silicon composite material formed by aggregating a primary graphene-silicon composite material on a conductive carbon substrate, and the primary graphene-silicon composite material is formed by laminating (laminating) silicon-containing particles on a reduced graphene oxide sheet.

title_en: Tunnel lighting system construction method for expressway based on wireless WIFI
abstract_en: The application relates to a tunnel lighting system construction method of a highway based on wireless WIFI, which belongs to the technical field of tunnel lighting construction and comprises the following steps: s1, determining materials and equipment required in the early stage, and leaving a factory by contacting the factory; s2, installing a tunnel entrance street lamp foundation, a lamp post and a bridge in a tunnel, wherein the bridge comprises a cross rod, a lamp holder and a plurality of vertical rods, the lamp holder is used for installing an illuminating lamp, and the vertical rods all slide along the length direction of the cross rod; s3, installing a tunnel entrance street lamp and an illuminating lamp in the tunnel; s4, installing a loop control terminal; s5, installing a wireless WIFI base station; and S6, installing a lighting system service background. The application has the effect of energy conservation.

title_en: Heating nozzle and heating nozzle unit
abstract_en: The invention provides a heating nozzle and a heating nozzle unit which are easy to realize good heating efficiency no matter the thickness of the plate is increased or decreased. The heating nozzle is a plate-shaped heating nozzle (2) for thermocompression bonding a terminal lead to a terminal member, and the heating nozzle (2) is provided with: a soldering iron part (6) provided with a soldering iron tip part (13) which is contacted with the terminal lead in a state of protruding downwards from the soldering iron body (11); and a connecting arm section (7) which extends upward from the left and right end sections of the soldering iron body (11) and which heats the soldering iron section (6) by passing a current from a power supply through the soldering iron body (11), wherein the soldering iron body (11) is set to have a plate thickness smaller than that of the connecting arm section (7) and a cross-sectional area smaller than that of the connecting arm section (7).

title_en: Intelligent current control method for inverter of photovoltaic system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation, in particular to an intelligent current control method for an inverter of a photovoltaic system. The PID control parameters output after the previous iteration are used for controlling the photovoltaic inverter to output actual waveforms, fitting the actual waveforms to obtain fitted waveforms, inputting the PID control parameters output after the previous iteration, the actual waveforms and the fitted waveforms into a BP neural network, taking the integral distortion rate of the actual waveforms compared with the fitted waveforms as the error of the BP neural network, iterating the PID control parameters with the error reduced as expected, completing iteration when the error is enough to obtain optimal PID control parameters, continuously detecting the environment of the photovoltaic power generation system, iterating again after the environment is changed to determine new optimal PID control parameters, determining the most suitable PID control parameters of the photovoltaic power generation system under different environmental conditions, enabling the output waveforms of the photovoltaic inverter to be smoother and more stable, and improving the grid connection quality of photovoltaic power generation.

title_en: Power distribution method and device of energy storage power station
abstract_en: The application discloses a power distribution method and device of an energy storage power station. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring grid-connected point frequency and total power of an energy storage power station, wherein the total power at least comprises total active power and total reactive power of the energy storage power station, and the energy storage power station comprises at least two energy storage converters; frequency modulation is carried out on the total active power according to the frequency of the grid-connected point to obtain target active power, reactive voltage regulation is carried out on the total reactive power according to a preset voltage difference regulation coefficient to obtain target reactive power; acquiring the current residual electric quantity of each energy storage converter in an energy storage power station; determining a weight value corresponding to each energy storage converter according to the current residual electric quantity, wherein the weight value represents the distribution proportion of each energy storage converter in the power distribution process; and distributing the target active power and the target reactive power to at least two energy storage converters according to the weight value corresponding to each energy storage converter. By the method and the device, the problem of low power distribution efficiency of the energy storage power station in the related technology is solved.

title_en: Control method of low-voltage treatment device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method of a low-voltage treatment device, which comprises the steps of obtaining parameter data information of the low-voltage treatment device; when the power grid is normal, the inversion power supply part serves as a current source and is in a small-current grid-connected hot standby state; the inversion power supply part is used as a voltage source when the power grid is abnormal, and a voltage-current double closed-loop feedback control mode is adopted to supply power to a load; when the power grid is low in voltage, a power loop feedforward control mode is adopted to control the grid-connected rectifying part; and the photovoltaic and energy storage direct current conversion part is controlled by adopting a proportional control mode and an integral control mode. The invention can realize the accurate treatment of the low voltage problem, improve the voltage and current quality of the grid-connected system, remarkably improve the dynamic response speed and steady-state control precision of the control system, reduce current ripple and improve current quality, effectively inhibit the capacitive coupling and high-frequency resonance between multiple inverters, and has high reliability and good practicability.

title_en: Manufacturing method of stator coil of high-voltage motor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing method of a stator coil of a high-voltage motor, which comprises the following steps of installing two semicircular structure winding moulds on a winding machine, winding a runway-shaped coil, fixing a straight line edge by using adhesive tapes, placing the runway-shaped coil on a special pre-packaging taping machine, adjusting a calibration position, half-folding two layers of mica tapes as pre-packaging to be insulated to the ground, completing the pre-packaging runway-shaped coil, completing expansion on an expansion machine according to the drawing requirement, placing the expanded coil on a common taping machine, completing the bundling of the residual insulation to the ground, and completing the manufacturing of the stator coil of the single high-voltage motor. The invention does not need the procedures of primary coating the white cloth belt and dismantling the white cloth belt, shortens the production period, saves the material and labor cost, does not need the procedures of turn-to-turn gelatinization, reduces the electric energy consumption and reduces the pollution to the environment.

title_en: Wireless power transfer transmitter, system and method for wirelessly transferring power
abstract_en: An apparatus for use in a magnetic induction wireless power transfer system includes at least one boost coil positioned adjacent to an active coil of the magnetic induction wireless power transfer system and a capacitor electrically connected to the boost coil. The capacitance of the capacitor is selected such that the current in the boost coil is approximately equal to the current in the active coil during wireless power transfer. The apparatus may include at least one shield coil positioned adjacent to an active coil of a magnetic induction wireless power transfer system, a capacitor electrically connected to the shield coil, and a conductor positioned adjacent to the shield coil opposite the active coil. The conductor surrounds the shield coil.

title_en: Installation device and installation method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a mounting device and a mounting method. The mounting device includes: a support; the tray is movably arranged on the bracket and comprises a first bearing part and a second bearing part, the first bearing part is used for bearing a first upper electrode part of the semiconductor equipment, the second bearing part surrounds the periphery of the first bearing part and is superposed with the gravity center of the first bearing part, and the second bearing part is used for bearing a second upper electrode part; the first sensor is arranged at the gravity center of the first bearing part and is used for collecting the gravity center offset of the first upper electrode part and/or the second upper electrode part; and the driving component is connected with the tray, drives the tray to lift, and drives the tray to adjust the bearing position of the first upper electrode part and/or the second upper electrode part according to the gravity offset. The embodiment of the application improves the installation and cleaning success rate of the semiconductor equipment and ensures the working time of the semiconductor equipment.

title_en: Self-adaptive control method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a self-adaptive control method, a self-adaptive control device, self-adaptive control equipment and a self-adaptive control medium, and relates to the technical field of power systems. The method is applied to the STATCOM system and comprises the following steps: constructing a mathematical model of the STATCOM based on an equivalent structure of the STATCOM; respectively obtaining a direct-current voltage expression at the direct-current side of the STATCOM and an alternating-current voltage expression at the alternating-current side; decoupling the current in the rotating coordinate system to obtain the decoupled current; determining adaptive control parameters of the PI controller by using a direct-current voltage expression and an alternating-current voltage expression based on an MRAC strategy and an MIT rule; and adjusting the direct-current voltage and the alternating-current voltage according to the self-adaptive control parameters so as to facilitate the STATCOM to realize that the method is suitable for multiple scenes, and meanwhile, the self-adaptive control is realized on the premise of the least self-adaptive control parameters and the fastest response speed.

title_en: Non-isolated high-voltage gain single-switch DC-DC converter and control method thereof
abstract_en: A non-isolated high-voltage gain single-switch DC-DC converter comprises a direct-current voltage source, a coupling inductor, a switching tube, a first capacitor, a second capacitor, a third capacitor, a fourth capacitor, a first diode, a second diode, a third diode, a fourth diode, a fifth diode and a resistor. The passive clamping circuit composed of a capacitor and a diode is selected to reduce the voltage stress on a switching tube by properly selecting the coupling inductance turns ratio so as to obtain the required voltage gain, and the energy in the leakage inductance is recovered by using the clamping capacitor so as to avoid generating larger voltage peaks; the invention reduces the stress of the switching tube, and simultaneously, the switching tube can select the on-state resistance with smaller resistance value to reduce the conduction loss and improve the efficiency.

title_en: Manufacturing device and method for molten iron inoculated artificial graphite cathode material
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for manufacturing an economical and environment-friendly molten iron inoculated artificial graphite cathode material, wherein the device mainly comprises the following steps: the device comprises a vacuum system, a furnace body, a heating and temperature measuring system, a graphite crucible, a piston assembly with enhanced dispersion function, a displacement control system and an artificial graphite powder negative pressure suction and cache system; the upper surface of a piston assembly (CP 1) is conical, the included angle between a bus and a central line of the piston assembly (CP 1) is less than 45 degrees, and a plurality of graphite rods are arranged at the bottom of the piston assembly (CP 1) to play a role in enhancing dispersion of forced flow and local shearing on a liquid/solid two-phase mixed material (L/S); the high-temperature molten iron has a wetting angle lower than 90 degrees to the graphite precursor fine powder, has higher saturated solubility to carbon elements, and has the capability of selectively dissolving amorphous carbon and surface high-activity carbon; and (L/S) cooling to a low-temperature range, and allowing carbon precipitated in low-temperature molten iron to realize epiphytic crystallization on the surface of the graphite powder to form the artificial graphite negative electrode material mainly with the coated core-shell structure.

title_en: Transport cart
abstract_en: The invention provides a technology capable of stabilizing the magnitude of the braking force of a motor braking circuit acting on a motor. The carrier disclosed in the present specification includes: a drive wheel; a motor that rotates the drive wheel; a motor drive circuit configured to drive a motor; a motor braking circuit configured to electrically brake the motor; a rotation speed sensor that detects a rotation speed of the motor; and a control unit configured to control the motor via a motor drive circuit and a motor brake circuit based on a target rotation speed of the motor and a rotation speed detected by the rotation speed sensor. The motor brake circuit includes: an electronic variable resistance element capable of operating in a linear mode and a switching mode in response to a control input signal. The motor braking circuit is configured to: when the motor is braked, the electronic variable resistance element is operated in a linear mode.

title_en: Electrode, battery and preparation method of electrode
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an electrode, a battery and a preparation method of the electrode, wherein the electrode comprises a current collector layer and an active component layer, and the active component layer is covered on at least one surface of the current collector layer. The side of the active component layer, which is far away from the current collector layer, is provided with a plurality of first bulges, and the first bulges can form a first fold surface of the active component layer. The electrode is characterized in that a plurality of first bulges are formed on one side, far away from the current collector layer, of the active component layer, the first bulges can form a first fold surface of the active component layer, and the first fold surface can reduce the outer layer stress of the pole piece and relieve the pole piece deformation and the expansion of the battery caused by the expansion of an electrode material. In addition, the contact area between the electrode and the electrolyte can be increased by the first fold surface, so that the friction effect between the electrode and other components in the battery is reduced, and the energy density and the cycle life of the electrode are further improved.

title_en: Electromagnetic heating driving controller and driving control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic circuits, and discloses an electromagnetic heating driving controller and a driving control method.
