The electromagnetic heating driving controller comprises a driving module and a control module, wherein the driving output end of the driving module is connected with the G pole of the IGBT, the driving module is used for driving the IGBT to be turned on or off by outputting a driving signal to the IGBT, the control module is provided with a signal input end and a control output end, the control module is used for receiving the working parameters of the IGBT through the signal input end and generating corresponding control signals, and outputting the control signals to the driving module through the control output end, and the driving module is used for generating the driving signals when receiving the control signals, so that the average voltage of the rising edge driving signals in the starting stage is inversely related to the working parameters of the IGBT. According to the embodiment of the invention, when the IGBT is protected from overcurrent or overvoltage, the loss of the IGBT is reduced, the temperature rise of the IGBT is reduced, and the stable operation of the electromagnetic heating cooking utensil is ensured.

title_en: Electrical junction box
abstract_en: An electrical junction box includes a case body having a plurality of connector portions, a power supply-side circuit board accommodated in the case body, and a universal connector mounting unit provided in the case body and configured such that a plurality of types of connectors are selectively attached to and detached from the universal connector mounting unit. The universal connector mounting unit is configured such that power supply side terminals of a plurality of types of connectors are electrically connected to terminal connection portions of a power supply side circuit board.

title_en: Multi-target planning method for source-grid and storage cooperation of power system and application thereof
abstract_en: A multi-target planning method for power system source network load storage cooperation and application thereof comprise the following steps: the method comprises the steps that morphological changes of a novel power system after new energy is merged into a power grid are analyzed, and analysis content comprises high power electronization and strong uncertainty in multiple time and space; for a planning area, acquiring the contents of load demand, power grid operation condition, power supply development condition, power system safety and the like in a planning year; constructing a source network load-storage cooperative multi-target planning model according to the obtained related information in the planning region and by combining the characteristics of a novel power system; and obtaining a novel power system source network charge-storage collaborative planning result containing high-proportion clean energy according to the established source network charge-storage collaborative multi-target planning model. The invention further reduces the operation cost of the power grid, enables the power grid to operate more smoothly, eliminates new energy power generation to the maximum extent, improves the operation efficiency and safety of a power system, promotes the development of new energy wind-light power generation and protects the ecological environment.

title_en: Emergency dispatching method for movable hydrogen energy power supply system
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency dispatching method for a movable hydrogen energy power supply system. The method comprises the following steps: after a power-loss node appears in the power distribution network, according to the position and the power shortage of each power-loss node and the position and the initial capacity of each movable hydrogen energy power supply system, based on a moving path model and an energy consumption characteristic of the movable hydrogen energy power supply system and an output model considering the output deviation of renewable energy sources, multi-objective optimization is carried out by taking the minimum economic cost of the full life cycle of the movable hydrogen energy power supply system and the minimum number of isolated nodes after island division of the power distribution network as targets, and a corresponding target scheduling scheme of the movable hydrogen energy power supply system after the power-loss node appears in the power distribution network is obtained. The target scheduling scheme obtained by the invention is more suitable for the power distribution network environment with high permeability of renewable energy sources, and ensures the power supply of important loads as fast as possible.

title_en: Power supply and standby network of communication equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses communication equipment's confession and backup power network relates to the communication field, and this communication equipment's confession and backup power network includes: the system comprises a medium-low voltage distribution system, a high-voltage battery standby power system, a power distribution system and a high-voltage direct current (HVDC) bus system, wherein the medium-low voltage distribution system is connected with the power distribution system through the HVDC bus system, and the high-voltage battery standby power system bypasses the HVDC bus system; the medium-low voltage distribution system is used for providing high-voltage direct current power supply for the distribution system by using input commercial power and oil engine standby power through the HVDC bus system; the high-voltage battery backup system is used for providing high-voltage direct current backup power for the power distribution system through the HVDC bus system; and the power distribution system is used for distributing the high-voltage direct current transmitted on the HVDC bus system to connected electric equipment. By adopting the technical scheme, the problems of large energy loss and the like caused by multi-stage conversion in the electric energy transmission path of the power supply system in the related technology are solved.

title_en: Key structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a key structure. The key structure comprises a keycap, a support plate and a support element. The supporting element comprises a first frame and a second frame, and the first frame and the second frame are used for connecting the keycap and the supporting plate, so that the keycap can move up and down relative to the supporting plate. When the first frame and the second frame are combined, a first span and a second span can be formed, and the second span is smaller than the first span.

title_en: Power supply unit
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a power supply unit including a power supply and a converter that performs at least one selected from the group consisting of voltage increase and voltage reduction of an output voltage of the power supply, wherein the converter includes a reactor in which n-phase coils are magnetically coupled to each other, n-phase switches, and a control unit that controls a duty ratio of the n-phase switches and monitors a current value flowing through the n-phase coils, and the control unit is configured to perform phase switching control in which, when the n-phase switches are driven in the same phase, the n-phase switches are switched from the same phase to a different phase, and in which, when the n-phase switches are driven in different phases, the n-phase switches are switched from the different phase to the same phase.

title_en: High-lanthanum cerium neodymium iron boron sintered permanent magnet and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of permanent magnet materials, and particularly relates to a high-lanthanum cerium neodymium iron boron sintered permanent magnet and a preparation method thereof. The raw materials for preparing the high-lanthanum cerium neodymium iron boron sintered permanent magnet comprise an alloy I and an alloy II, wherein the chemical molecular formula of the alloy I is [ (PrNd)  1‑x  (RL)  x  ]  a  (TM)  b  (HM)  c  B  d  Fe  100‑a‑b‑c‑d  X is more than or equal to 0.3 and less than 1, a is more than or equal to 29.5 and less than or equal to 32.5, b is more than 0 and less than or equal to 5, c is more than 0 and less than or equal to 0.8, d is more than or equal to 0.85 and less than or equal to 1.1, and the chemical molecular formula of the two components of the alloy is (PrNd)  a1  Ga  b1  Fe  100‑a1‑b1  A1 is more than or equal to 70 and less than or equal to 90, and b1 is more than 0 and less than or equal to 20. The high-lanthanum-cerium neodymium iron boron sintered permanent magnet is obtained by compounding the alloy I and the alloy II and combining proper sintering and aging processes, and the surface magnetic hardening of the high-content lanthanum-cerium main phase crystal grains is realized.

title_en: Battery cooling device and new energy vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a battery cooling device and a new energy vehicle, wherein the battery cooling device comprises: the cooling unit comprises a first cooling structure and a second cooling structure, the first cooling structure and the second cooling structure are respectively used for cooling the two sides of the battery, a first flow passage is formed in the first cooling structure, a second flow passage is formed in the second cooling structure, and the flow sizes of cooling media in the first flow passage and the second flow passage can be independently adjusted. According to the invention, when the temperatures of the two sides of the battery are inconsistent, the flow rates of the cooling media in the first cooling structure and the second cooling structure can be adjusted, namely the first cooling structure and the second cooling structure can respectively take away heat of the two sides of the battery in different degrees in unit time, so that the temperatures of the two sides of the battery can be kept consistent, and the problems of uneven overall temperature and poor performance of the battery are solved.

title_en: Anti-falling device for maintaining hydraulic generator rotor
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of hydraulic generator rotor maintenance instruments, and particularly relates to a falling prevention device for hydraulic generator rotor maintenance. The technology is including placing the platform, the top of placing the platform is provided with the slide bar, the diameter of placing the platform is less than the internal diameter of slide bar, the below of slide bar is provided with lifting unit, the cover is equipped with the slider on the slide bar, the bottom of slider is fixed with the coiler, the coiler includes the roll-up box of hollow columnar structure, the mounting groove has all been seted up to the preceding lateral wall and the back lateral wall of roll-up box, be provided with the dwang in the roll-up box, the winding has the safety belt on the dwang, the expansion end of safety belt is fixed with the safety buckle on the maintainer body, install the wind spring in the mounting groove of roll-up box rear side, be provided with locking mechanism in the mounting groove of roll-up box front side. When the maintenance personnel fall carelessly, the locking mechanism can limit the rotation of the rotating rod, and the safety belt is in a safe length by matching with the coil spring, so that the safety of the maintenance personnel is guaranteed, and meanwhile, the sliding rod can be always positioned above the maintenance personnel.

title_en: Conductive hydrogel and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a conductive hydrogel with high mechanical property and electrical property and a preparation method thereof. Aiming at the problems of poor mechanical property, poor electrical property and the like of the traditional conductive hydrogel, the hyperbranched polysiloxane prepolymer, aniline and graphene oxide are polymerized in situ to form a hyperbranched polyaniline graphene compound, and then the hyperbranched polyaniline graphene compound and acrylamide are jointly used for preparing the composite conductive hydrogel, so that the hyperbranched polyaniline graphene compound can be practically applied to the fields of sensors, capacitors, fluid control, intelligent machinery and the like.

title_en: Expansion adhesive tape for lithium battery and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of swelling adhesive tapes, in particular to the field of IPC 09J7, and further relates to a swelling adhesive tape for a lithium battery and a preparation method thereof. The expansion adhesive tape for the lithium battery is formed by compounding a base layer and an adhesive layer, wherein the thickness of the base layer is 25-6 mu m, and the thickness of the adhesive layer is 5-25 mu m. The expansion adhesive tape for the lithium battery fixes the electric core of the lithium battery by absorbing the electrolyte to generate expansion in the thickness direction, has strong acid resistance, high electrolyte resistance and low high-temperature shrinkage rate, and has high swelling multiplying power and longer service life; and the preparation process is simple and is easy for large-scale production.

title_en: Intelligent air conditioner and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent air conditioner and a control method thereof; the intelligent air conditioner controls the lighting device according to the detection information to illuminate the room, so that the indoor lighting requirement of a user is met, and the life of the user is greatly facilitated; and in the control process of the lighting device, the voltage value output by the power supply module is detected through the voltage detection circuit, and different power supply modes of the lighting device are determined according to the voltage value, so that the situation that the lighting device is too dark due to too low power supply voltage is avoided, the lighting effect of the lighting device is further ensured, the service life of the lighting device is prolonged, the intelligent requirements of health, comfort and safety of a user are met, and the lighting device has good practical value.

title_en: Power equipment heat abstractor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power equipment, in particular to a heat dissipation device of power equipment; the cleaning device comprises a first cleaning mechanism and a second cleaning mechanism, a rotary object placing table is arranged at the top of the collecting box, and a circulating device is also arranged at the top of the base and communicated with the collecting box; through rotatory shower head blowout cooling water, in rotatory shower head blowout cooling water, radiating power equipment's surface is treated simultaneously to first wiper mechanism and second wiper mechanism and washs, in the abluent while, the thing platform is slowly rotatory to the rotation of putting to make belt cleaning device can prevent because dust and corrosive substance in the air corrode power equipment to the all-round washing on power equipment surface, through cooling fan's cooling, make power equipment cooling efficiency higher.

title_en: Battery pack control method, system, electronic device and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a battery pack control method, a battery pack control system, an electronic device and a readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining current limiting values of the battery packs, and determining a minimum current limiting value in a plurality of current limiting values, wherein the current limiting value is a maximum current value allowed by the battery packs at present; and determining a total current limiting value of the battery pack charging and discharging equipment according to the minimum current limiting value, wherein the total current limiting value of the battery pack charging and discharging equipment is a maximum value allowed by the sum of current values of the battery packs. The total current limiting value of the battery pack charging and discharging equipment is determined through the minimum current limiting value in the plurality of battery packs, so that the current limiting requirement of the battery pack with the minimum current limiting value can be met to a certain extent, the actual current value of the battery pack is prevented from being too large, and the service life of the battery pack is ensured.

title_en: Method and system for controlling network output power of double-source trolley bus
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium for controlling network output power of a double-source trolley bus, and belongs to the technical field of double-source trolley buses. The method comprises the steps of obtaining motor bus current, judging a vehicle state according to the motor bus current, calculating wire network output current according to the vehicle state, calculating wire network target output power according to the wire network output current, setting a power change gradient according to the current output power of the wire network and the target output power of the wire network, obtaining final output power of the wire network, and regulating and controlling the wire network output power. The full-automatic electric vehicle system on a chip (SOC) balance of the full-automatic electric vehicle is guaranteed, and the effect of recovering the motor energy can be exerted to the maximum during braking, so that the problems of over-charging of the battery of the trolley bus and unstable output voltage of a wire network in the prior art are solved.

title_en: Semi-active inerter device based on operational amplifier circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semi-active inerter device based on an operational amplifier circuit, which comprises a top end shell, a direct current brush motor, a fixed bearing, a coupler, a screw rod nut, a bottom shell and a ball screw, wherein the direct current brush motor is arranged on the top end shell, a motor shaft of the direct current brush motor is connected with the ball screw through the coupler, an inner ring of the fixed bearing is in interference fit with the ball screw close to one end of the coupler, an outer ring of the fixed bearing is in interference fit with a reinforcing rib of the top end shell, the bottom shell is sleeved at the outermost end of the ball screw and fixed on the bottom surface of the screw rod nut, the outer diameter of the bottom shell is smaller than the inner diameter of the top end shell, and the semi-active inerter device also comprises a controllable operational amplifier circuit module, the controllable operational amplifier circuit module is fixed on the top end shell and is connected with a direct current brush motor through a lead wire close to one end of the direct current brush motor. The invention solves the problem that the prior art cannot independently adjust the inertia capacity in an electromechanical combination scheme.

title_en: Planar magnetron sputtering target with adjustable target surface magnetic field distribution width
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of magnetron sputtering, in particular to a planar magnetron sputtering target with adjustable target surface magnetic field distribution width, which comprises a magnetic conduction seat, a target material part arranged on the magnetic conduction seat, and a magnet part arranged between the magnetic conduction seat and the target material part, wherein the magnet part comprises a central magnet arranged on the magnetic conduction seat and a plurality of movable magnet groups, each movable magnet group comprises a first magnet and second magnets arranged on two sides of the first magnet, the first magnet is in sliding connection with the magnetic conduction seat, and the first magnet can move towards a direction close to or far away from the central magnet. Therefore, the distribution width of the magnetic field on the surface of the target can be gradually increased by gradually moving the peripheral moving magnet group, so that the plasma width on the surface of the target is increased, the width of the etching groove on the surface of the target is gradually increased, the target utilization rate of the planar magnetron sputtering target is effectively improved, and the problem of low target utilization rate of the planar magnetron sputtering target in the related technology is solved.

title_en: Multi-strand wire harness traction equipment and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-strand wire harness traction device and an operation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of wire harness traction, wherein the multi-strand wire harness traction device comprises a base, a transverse plate is arranged on one side of the top of the base, a plurality of guide grooves for wire harnesses to pass through are formed in the top of the transverse plate, guide plates are arranged at the end parts of the guide grooves, and through holes for the wire harnesses to pass through are reserved in the middle of the guide plates; the top middle part of base is provided with the riser, and the top fixed mounting of riser has the roof, and the top of roof is provided with a plurality of and the guide way section of thick bamboo that alternates that corresponds each other, and the inside of interleaving section of thick bamboo is provided with the round brush. According to the wire harness winding device, the wire harness can pass through the inserting cylinder before being drawn and wound, the inserting cylinder provides limiting for the wire harness, meanwhile, a circle of hairbrush arranged inside the inserting cylinder can effectively intercept dust on the surface of the wire harness, the surface of the wire harness passing through the inserting cylinder is enabled to be cleaner, the attractiveness of later-stage drawing wire harness winding is improved, and secondary cleaning treatment is reduced.

title_en: Waterproof integration roofing subassembly of photovoltaic
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a photovoltaic waterproof integrated roof assembly. The waterproof integrated photovoltaic roof assembly comprises a first photovoltaic panel assembly and a second photovoltaic panel assembly, the first photovoltaic panel assembly comprises a first photovoltaic panel, a first sealing strip arranged at the edge of the bottom surface of the first photovoltaic panel and a first fixing strip arranged at the edge of the bottom surface of the first photovoltaic panel, the first fixing strip is far away from the bottom surface of the first photovoltaic panel and is provided with a first fixing structure, the second photovoltaic panel assembly comprises a second photovoltaic panel, a second sealing strip arranged on the side surface of the second photovoltaic panel and a second fixing strip arranged on the side surface of the second photovoltaic panel, the second sealing strip is far away from the side surface of the second photovoltaic panel and is connected with the top surface of the second photovoltaic panel, the top surface is provided with a second fixing structure, and the second fixing structure is used for being in sealing connection with the first fixing structure.

title_en: Hydrogen circulating pump and mounting structure thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrogen circulating pump and an installation structure thereof, and relates to the field of hydrogen circulating pumps. The utility model provides a hydrogen circulating pump, includes motor and pump head, the pump head includes the runner, the intercommunication is provided with two sets of gas-liquid pipes on the runner, it is provided with the impeller to rotate in the runner, and the intercommunication is provided with diffusion mechanism on a set of gas-liquid pipe, diffusion mechanism and gas-liquid pipe intercommunication department is provided with the nozzle, and diffusion mechanism has the runner structure of variable cross section, and this variable cross section's runner structure includes sectional area shrink section, cross section invariant section and cross section expansion section. When the fluid passes through the diffusion mechanism, the medium can be pressurized by the fluid mechanics principle without additional consumption of electric energy, so that the additional energy consumption requirement is reduced, and the miniaturization and high energy density requirements of the whole system are facilitated.

title_en: Water-cooling oil-lubricating rolling bearing device of high-thrust vertical motor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water cooling oil lubricating rolling bearing device of a high-thrust vertical motor, which comprises a bearing box, a thrust bearing seat and a bearing guide seat, wherein a cooling water chamber and a lubricating oil chamber are arranged in the bearing box; the whole bearing device is kept in a stable state, water is prevented from being supplied from the water inlet and outlet pipe through the wall of the oil tank, leakage phenomenon cannot occur, the heat dissipation effect of the water cooling oil lubricating rolling bearing device of the high-thrust vertical motor is improved, and good sealing performance is kept.

title_en: Closed Faraday receiving cup structure
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of mass spectrometry instruments, and particularly relates to a closed Faraday receiving cup structure. The invention comprises a T-shaped ceramic piece, a square ceramic pad, a shielding box, a graphite cup, a slit sheet, a positioning ceramic column, a restraining grid, a first ceramic tube and a second ceramic tube, wherein a step is arranged in the shielding box, a step is arranged on the side edge of the bottom of the step, and the restraining grid is arranged on the step; slit sheets are arranged on the side edges of the shielding boxes; the graphite cup is arranged at the bottom of the shielding box through a T-shaped ceramic piece, and a square ceramic pad is arranged between the graphite cup and the shielding box; the upper surface of the graphite cup is provided with a positioning ceramic chip, and the positioning ceramic chip is provided with a positioning ceramic column; the side of shielding box is equipped with first lead wire hole and second lead wire hole, installs first ceramic pipe, second ceramic pipe respectively. The invention effectively eliminates the influence of scattered ions on the detection of effective ions by the receiving cup and improves the performance of the instrument.

title_en: Wafer carrying table
abstract_en: The invention provides a wafer carrying table, which improves the soaking property of wafers. The wafer stage (10) is provided with a ceramic substrate (20), a cooling substrate (30), and a metal bonding layer (40). The ceramic substrate (20) has a wafer mounting surface (22 a) on the upper surface on which a wafer can be mounted, and a wafer suction electrode (26) is incorporated therein. The cooling substrate (30) has a coolant flow path (32). A metal bonding layer (40) bonds the ceramic substrate (20) and the cooling substrate (30). Regarding the cross-sectional areas of the coolant flow path (32) at the most upstream part (32U) and the most downstream part (32L) in the area where the plane view of the coolant flow path (32) overlaps the wafer mounting surface (22 a), the cross-sectional area of the most downstream part (32L) is smaller than the cross-sectional area of the most upstream part (32U).

title_en: Switch cabinet, three-station switch double-tool-bit isolation disconnecting link and disconnecting link position monitoring method
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of switching devices, and provides a switch cabinet, a three-station switch double-tool-bit isolation switch and a switch position monitoring method, wherein the switch cabinet adopts a lower isolation scheme and comprises the following steps: the three-station switch double-cutter-head isolating disconnecting link, the photoelectric sensor group and the display device; the knife switch is arranged in the sealed air box of the switch cabinet and comprises a first knife head and a second knife head, the first knife head is used for being closed with the grounding contact, and the second knife head is used for being closed with the isolation contact; the photoelectric sensor group is arranged on the side wall of the sealed air box and used for monitoring the position of the disconnecting link and transmitting the position of the disconnecting link to the display device; the display device is arranged outside the switch cabinet and used for receiving the position of the disconnecting link transmitted by the photoelectric sensor group and displaying the position information of the disconnecting link. The switch cabinet provided by the application is when one cutter head is damaged, the other cutter head can be normally used, the reliable operation of the switch cabinet is not affected, the position of the disconnecting link can be monitored in real time, and the accident potential caused by the fact that the disconnecting link is not closed in place is eliminated.

title_en: Safe charging method, system and power supply
abstract_en: The application relates to a safe charging method, a safe charging system and a safe charging power supply, which belong to the technical field of charging power supplies, and the safe charging method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first voltage value of an output end of a charging circuit, wherein the output end of the charging circuit is connected with one end of a switching circuit, and the other end of the switching circuit is used for being connected with a battery to be charged; acquiring a second voltage value at the other end of the switching circuit; and switching on the switching circuit in response to the first voltage value being within a first preset interval and the second voltage value being within a second preset interval. According to the charging method and device, in the charging process, electric shock accidents caused by the fact that a user contacts with a charging port can be effectively prevented, the battery is effectively prevented from being damaged due to overvoltage or undervoltage faults of a charging circuit or mismatching between a battery to be charged and a charging power supply, the battery is protected when the user is protected, the charging safety of the battery is improved, and potential safety hazards of the user when the user uses the charging power supply are reduced.

title_en: Energy storage device
abstract_en: The invention provides an energy storage device which comprises a box body, and a battery cell group and a heat exchange module which are arranged in the box body. The battery cell group comprises a plurality of battery cells which are adjacently arranged. The heat exchange module comprises a converging component, and at least two adjacent electric cores in the electric core group are correspondingly provided with the converging component. The converging component comprises an overlapped electric connecting sheet and a semiconductor refrigerating sheet, wherein the electric connecting sheet is used for electrically connecting two adjacent electric cores, the semiconductor refrigerating sheet is arranged on one side of the electric connecting sheet, which is away from the electric cores, and the semiconductor refrigerating sheet is used for refrigerating after the electric current in the first direction is introduced so as to dissipate heat of the electric connecting sheet. The battery cell comprises a shell, a terminal assembly, a heat conducting piece and at least two electrode assemblies which are stacked in the shell side by side, wherein the terminal assembly is electrically connected to the electric connecting sheet, the heat conducting piece is arranged between at least two adjacent electrode assemblies, and the heat conducting piece is connected to the terminal assembly to conduct heat of the electrode assemblies to the electric connecting sheet connected with the terminal assembly. The heat dissipation efficiency of the battery cell in the energy storage device is higher, and the service life of the battery cell is prolonged.

title_en: But self-cleaning's photovoltaic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic device capable of automatically cleaning, which comprises a base, a supporting rod, a mounting frame and a photovoltaic plate, wherein the supporting rod is mounted at the top end of the base, the mounting frame is mounted at the top end of the supporting rod, the photovoltaic plate is mounted in the mounting frame, two symmetrically distributed mounting seats are fixedly mounted at one end of the mounting frame, a driving motor is fixedly mounted on the mounting seats, a fixing plate is fixedly mounted at two sides of the other end of the mounting frame, an output shaft of the driving motor is fixedly mounted with a reciprocating screw rod with the end part rotatably mounted on the fixing plate, a rod body of the reciprocating screw rod is in threaded connection with a movable block sliding along the side edge of the mounting frame, a sleeve is fixedly mounted at the top end of the movable block, and a movable rod extending to the upper part of the sleeve is slidably mounted in the sleeve. The invention can realize effective cleaning of the panel surface of the photovoltaic panel and improve the service efficiency of the photovoltaic panel.

title_en: High-power electronic device based on semiconductor thermistor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of thermosensitive semiconductors and electronic circuits, and provides a high-power electronic device based on a semiconductor thermosensitive resistor, which comprises a data acquisition circuit, a signal amplification circuit and a stable output circuit, wherein the signal output end of the data acquisition circuit is connected with the signal input end of the signal amplification circuit, the data acquisition circuit is used for sending target device data to the signal amplification circuit after differentiating a mixed variable from an environment variable, the signal output end of the signal amplification circuit is connected with the signal input end of the stable output circuit, and the signal amplification circuit is used for amplifying and transmitting the target device data to the stable output circuit and outputting the target device data through the stable output circuit in a voltage stabilizing way; the invention can realize a high-power electronic device based on the semiconductor thermistor.

title_en: Barium ferrite composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a barium ferrite composite material, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of batteries. The barium ferrite composite material comprises a barium ferrite core and a conductive shell layer coated outside the barium ferrite core; the conductive shell layer is made of at least one material selected from copper, silver and gold. On the premise of keeping the advantages of the barium ferrite, the conductive shell layer of the barium ferrite composite material is beneficial to improving the conductivity and structural stability of the barium ferrite composite material, so that the barium ferrite composite material has the potential of being applied to lithium ion batteries.

title_en: Nanometer stamping equipment for improving stamping uniformity
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nanoimprinting, in particular to nanoimprinting equipment for improving imprinting uniformity. The nano-imprinting device comprises a soft film substrate adsorption unit and an imprinting substrate fixing unit, wherein a dispensing unit is arranged between the soft film substrate adsorption unit and the imprinting substrate fixing unit, and the nano-imprinting device also comprises a static removing unit and an exposure unit for curing nano-imprinting materials; the soft film substrate adsorption unit comprises an adsorption plate and a soft film substrate, and the imprinting substrate fixing unit comprises an imprinting substrate adsorption disc and an imprinting substrate, which are arranged right below the soft film substrate adsorption unit; the dispensing unit comprises an upper dispensing nozzle and a lower dispensing nozzle, which are respectively dispensed on the soft film and the stamping substrate; the static electricity removing unit comprises a deionizing fan, and the exposure unit comprises a UV lamp. According to the invention, by accurately controlling the thickness of the nano imprinting adhesive layer and controlling the uniformity of the adhesive layer, the equipment for copying the soft film and imprinting the product is realized, the service life of the template is prolonged, the production cost is reduced, and the mass production is realized rapidly.

title_en: Battery cell processing equipment, battery cell processing method and battery production line
abstract_en: The application relates to a battery cell processing equipment, battery cell processing method and battery production line, battery cell processing equipment includes: the first support component is used for fixing the battery cell body and can rotate around a first rotation axis; the second support assembly is used for fixing the battery cell body and can rotate around a second rotation axis; the first rotation axis and the second rotation axis are arranged in parallel; the third support component is used for fixing the lug and the end cover; the third supporting component comprises a supporting seat and a shaping piece; a pole positioning groove is formed on the supporting seat; the shaping piece is movably arranged relative to the supporting seat. According to the battery cell processing equipment, the battery cell processing method and the battery production line, the problem of tearing of the electrode lugs can be effectively solved.

title_en: Nonaqueous electrolyte for lithium secondary battery and lithium secondary battery comprising same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a nonaqueous electrolyte for a lithium secondary battery and a lithium secondary battery including the same, the nonaqueous electrolyte including: a compound represented by formula 1; an organic solvent containing a nitrile-based solvent in an amount of 90 to 100% by volume; and a lithium salt, wherein the amount of the compound represented by formula 1 is in the range of 2 to 50 wt% based on the total weight of the nonaqueous electrolyte.

title_en: Method for detecting initial position of rotor of sinusoidal electro-magnetic doubly salient motor
abstract_en: The method is easy to realize, remarkably shortens the position estimation time, and avoids the problem of shaking of the motor in the initial position detection process. Compared with a method for causing phase current change through injection signals, the method has the advantages that the value of the phase current containing rotor position information is larger, the signal to noise ratio of detection signals is increased, and the accuracy of position estimation is improved.

title_en: Aluminum alloy conductor wire rod and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an aluminum alloy conductor wire, a preparation method and application thereof. The aluminum alloy conductor wire comprises the following components: 0.8 to 1.5 percent of Mg, 3.5 to 5 percent of Zn, less than or equal to 0.05 percent of Si, 0.2 to 0.5 percent of Fe, 0.01 to 0.05 percent of Er, 0.05 to 0.2 percent of Y, 0.01 to 0.05 percent of B, and the balance of aluminum and unavoidable impurity elements. The invention also provides a preparation method of the aluminum alloy conductor wire, which comprises alloy smelting, furnace refining, online refining, ultrasonic treatment, continuous casting and rolling, solution treatment, drawing and aging treatment. The invention also provides application of the aluminum alloy conductor wire in overhead conductor transmission lines. The aluminum alloy conductor wire provided by the invention has high strength and high conductivity.

title_en: Lamp with detachable light source
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lamp with a detachable light source, comprising: the mounting assembly and the lamp panel assembly. The mounting assembly is provided with a screw-fixing part and two elastic contact pieces. The lamp panel assembly is provided with a plurality of luminous components, a lamp panel and two circuit contacts. The light-emitting component is arranged on the lamp panel and is electrically connected with the two circuit contact pieces, the lamp panel is provided with a corresponding screw-fixing part, the corresponding screw-fixing part of the lamp panel component is detachably and rotationally fixed on the screw-fixing part of the mounting component, and when the corresponding screw-fixing part is rotationally fixed on the screw-fixing part, the two elastic contact pieces are respectively contacted with the two circuit contact pieces and form elastic deformation, so that a plurality of light-emitting components are electrically connected with a power supply through the circuit contact pieces and the elastic contact pieces.

title_en: Manufacturing method of copper-aluminum composite new energy terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing method of a copper-aluminum composite new energy terminal, which comprises the following steps: step one, preparing raw materials; step two, machining and forming; processing the copper plate to form a torsion spring copper strip, and processing the copper-aluminum composite plate to form a terminal bottom bracket; step three, preheating and tinning; after preheating the tin bar, pressing the tin bar on the belt edge of the torsion spring copper belt to couple the tin bar with the torsion spring copper belt; step four, torsion spring processing; the torsion spring copper strips in the third step are curled end to form cylindrical copper columns, and then the copper columns are twisted to form torsion spring terminals; step five, assembling the terminal; inserting the torsion spring terminal into a reserved groove on the terminal base; step six, ultrasonic welding; and welding the tin bars between the terminal base and the torsion spring terminal by using ultrasonic welding equipment to obtain the copper-aluminum composite terminal. The ultrasonic welding heating head has the advantages that the ultrasonic welding heating head can accurately heat, and the influence of welding on the temperature rise of the copper-aluminum composite material terminal is reduced.

title_en: Protective housing of electronic equipment and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a protective shell of electronic equipment and the electronic equipment, wherein the protective shell of the electronic equipment comprises a main body; the bracket is arranged on the main body; the first magnetic conduction piece is arranged on the first side of the bracket, and the second magnetic conduction piece is arranged on the second side of the bracket.

title_en: Anti-interference communication cable and anti-interference control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-interference communication cable and an anti-interference control method, which relate to the technical field of communication cables and comprise a communication cable core assembly, a fixed shielding layer, an adjustable shielding layer, an insulating layer and an adjustable shielding control device; the fixed shielding layer wraps the outer surface of the communication cable core assembly, the adjustable shielding layer comprises a shell layer and a liquid shielding layer, and the control assembly is in control connection with each electric device of the liquid exchange pump assembly. According to the invention, the adjustable shielding layer is wrapped, the adjustable shielding layer adopts the liquid shielding layer, the liquid shielding layer with different electric conductivity can be replaced under the support of the adjustable shielding control device, and the anti-interference performance of the liquid shielding layer is changed, so that the communication cable can adapt to the anti-interference requirements of interference sources suddenly appearing in different environments, the resistance to different interference sources can be greatly increased, the flexible controllability of the anti-interference performance of the communication cable is realized, and the communication cable has better applicability to important application scenes.

title_en: Rotary peeling mechanical structure of coaxial line
abstract_en: The coaxial rotary peeling mechanical structure with small occupied space effectively solves the problem that the existing peeling machine is large in size and complex in mechanism; comprises a bottom frame, wherein a peeling mechanism is arranged on the bottom frame; the peeling mechanism comprises a first fixed plate and a second fixed plate which are arranged on the underframe, the second fixed plate is provided with a first synchronous wheel, a plurality of cutter shafts are arranged on the first synchronous wheel, the front ends of the cutter shafts are provided with blades, the second fixed plate is provided with a first driving device for driving the blades to rotate, and the second fixed plate is also provided with a second driving device for enabling the blades to rotate relative to the first synchronous wheel; the invention realizes the interpolation motion through the first driving motor and the second driving motor, so that the blade realizes the adjustment of the knife edge size while realizing the wire stripping function, and realizes the function of rotary cutting control.

title_en: High-compaction-density composite positive plate, preparation method thereof and energy storage device
abstract_en: The application relates to a high-compaction-density composite positive plate, a preparation method thereof and an energy storage device. The composite positive plate comprises a current collector, a coating layer and a plurality of inserts. The composite positive plate has high compaction density, and the energy storage device prepared from the composite positive plate has excellent electrochemical performance.

title_en: Electrode, method for manufacturing the same, and electrochemical device using the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides an electrode excellent in catalyst activity and stability for oxygen reaction, a method for producing the electrode, and an electrochemical device using the electrode. The electrode has an oxide as an oxygen catalyst, and the oxide has peaks at positions of 2θ=30.07++1.00°, 34.88++1.00°, 50.20++1.00° and 59.65++1.00° in an X-ray diffraction measurement using cukα rays, and has bismuth, ruthenium, sodium and oxygen as constituent elements.

title_en: Fresh-keeping storage device in fish prefabricated vegetable transportation process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fresh-keeping storage device in a fish prefabricated vegetable transportation process, which relates to the technical field of fresh-keeping storage in the fish prefabricated vegetable transportation process and comprises a heat preservation cabinet, wherein a fixed block is welded at the top of the heat preservation cabinet, a driving motor is arranged in the fixed block, a connecting rod is connected to the top of the driving motor through an output shaft, a motor controller is arranged at the top of the fixed block, a supporting rod is welded at the top of the connecting rod, a first fixing rod is symmetrically welded at one side of the supporting rod, a second fixing rod is transversely welded at one side of the first fixing rod, a mounting plate is welded on the outer wall of the second fixing rod, a solar panel is embedded and mounted at one side of the mounting plate, a fixing plate is welded at one side of the solar panel, and a solar inductor is arranged at the top of the fixing plate. The fresh-keeping storage device in the fish prefabricated vegetable transportation process converts light energy into electric energy, provides sufficient electric energy for the refrigerator, can effectively save electricity consumption, and is more energy-saving and environment-friendly in use.

title_en: Comprehensive energy system full life cycle carbon emission trend tracking method
abstract_en: The application discloses a comprehensive energy system full life cycle carbon emission trend tracking method, which comprises the following steps: s1: collecting known basic network data; s2: establishing an optimization objective function and constraint conditions; s3: calculating the optimal solution of the output power of each multi-energy conversion device according to the S2; s4: calculating the total carbon emission generated by the multi-energy conversion equipment in the construction stage and the carbon emission of unit power generated in the construction stage according to the step S3; s5: tracking carbon emission of each comprehensive energy trend in the urban comprehensive energy system, and calculating the carbon emission of unit power of various energy used by the end user; s6: and outputting the distribution condition of carbon emission along with the comprehensive energy trend of the full life cycle of the urban comprehensive energy system. The beneficial effects of this application: the distribution situation of the carbon emission along with the comprehensive energy trend in the whole life cycle in the urban comprehensive energy system is determined, and the situation of difficult carbon emission reduction caused by undefined carbon emission distribution in the urban comprehensive energy system is solved.

title_en: Battery BMS protection board and battery pack
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of battery protection, and discloses a battery BMS protection plate and a battery assembly, wherein the battery BMS protection plate comprises a connection assembly and a battery assembly, the connection assembly is used for being inserted into the battery assembly to form electric connection, the battery assembly comprises a battery shell, a battery body, a heat dissipation mechanism, a BMS protection plate and a recognition device are arranged in the battery shell, the heat dissipation mechanism is used for carrying out liquid cooling heat dissipation on the battery body after the connection assembly is inserted into the battery assembly, the BMS protection plate is matched with the recognition device to recognize the connection assembly, if the connection assembly is matched with the battery assembly, the BMS protection plate sends out a signal, the recognition device and the connection assembly form electric connection, and if the connection assembly is not matched with the battery assembly, the BMS protection plate does not send out a signal, the recognition device cannot form electric connection with the connection assembly, and the recognition device takes liquid flow of the heat dissipation mechanism as a driving medium to realize connection with the connection assembly.

title_en: Security protection structure of energy storage container
abstract_en: The invention discloses a security structure of an energy storage container, which comprises the following components: the lithium ion battery module is arranged on the battery rack assembly, and the energy storage box assembly at least comprises a box body; the battery rack assembly includes: a multi-layered tray for housing lithium battery modules; the brackets are arranged around the multi-layer tray in a surrounding way and used for supporting the multi-layer tray; and a plurality of radiating pipes which are arranged at the bottom of the tray and/or are arranged at the side surfaces of the two brackets at one side of the battery rack assembly, wherein: a plurality of radiating pipes arranged on the side surfaces of the two brackets on one side of the battery frame assembly are abutted on the side wall of the tank body of the energy storage tank assembly. By implementing the security structure of the energy storage container, the probability of occurrence of thermal runaway accidents of the energy storage container can be reduced, and the security application of the energy storage container is further enhanced; the structure is simple, the disassembly and the assembly are convenient, and the maintenance is convenient.

title_en: Cylindrical lithium battery cap packaging equipment and processing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lithium battery processing, and discloses cylindrical lithium battery cap packaging equipment and a processing method thereof, wherein the processing method comprises the following steps: the sealing cover feeding mechanism is arranged at one side of the top of the frame and is used for conveying battery sealing covers; the battery main body feeding mechanism is arranged at one side of the top of the frame and is used for conveying the battery main body; the battery main body fixing mechanism is arranged at the axle center of the top of the frame; the invention is provided with the battery main body fixing mechanism, and particularly when the battery main body is positioned in the groove, the sealing cover is carried and packaged by the sealing cover carrying and packaging mechanism, the supporting bolt is pressed, the second driving rod is pressed down to drive the driving gear to rotate under the elastic action of the third reset spring, the driving gear is meshed with the rack to enable the V-shaped clamping block to clamp and fix the battery main body, the length of the supporting bolt is adjusted to adjust the pressing force, the advancing length of the V-shaped clamping block is changed, batteries with different specifications can be clamped, and the adaptability of the device to cylindrical lithium batteries is improved.

title_en: Sulfide solid electrolyte material and battery using the same
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a sulfide solid electrolyte material having high ionic conductivity and a small amount of hydrogen sulfide produced. The sulfide solid electrolyte material (10) of the present disclosure includes phosphorus and sulfur. Passing sulfide solid electrolyte material (10)  31  The peak appearing in the range of 87.5 to 88.5ppm in the spectrum obtained by P-NMR measurement was defined as the 1 st peak, the peak appearing in the range of 84.2 to 85.2ppm in the spectrum was defined as the 2 nd peak, and the ratio of the integrated intensity of the 1 st peak to the integrated intensity of the 2 nd peak was represented by x:1-x, at this time, 0.00926.ltoreq.x.ltoreq.0.37 was satisfied.

title_en: Image acquisition device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an image acquisition device, which has the technical scheme that: the telescopic rod comprises a bottom plate, wherein an electric push rod is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the bottom plate, a connecting disc is fixedly arranged at one end of a telescopic rod of the electric push rod, a fixing plate is arranged above the connecting disc, and a camera is arranged on the top surface of the fixing plate; the adjusting component is arranged above the bottom plate and used for remotely adjusting the camera, the adjusting component is arranged, the shooting angle of the camera can be dynamically adjusted remotely through the adjusting component, the camera can be effectively protected when the camera shoots, meanwhile, the camera can be controlled to shoot a target material according to shooting requirements in advance by a preset device in a certain time, and therefore the camera does not need to be erected and started all the time, and visual acquisition work of workers is facilitated.

title_en: Liquid ejecting apparatus, liquid ejecting method, electrode forming apparatus, and multilayer diaphragm forming apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a liquid ejecting apparatus, an electrode forming apparatus, a multilayer separator forming apparatus, and a liquid ejecting method, in which printing is performed without causing liquid to adhere to a transport surface when borderless printing is performed not only on a surface of an electrode substrate but also on a side surface. In borderless printing in which not only the surface but also the side surfaces of the electrode substrate are printed, a liquid adhering member for printing without adhering liquid to the transport surface can be provided with high accuracy by a small and simple device. Comprising the following steps: a conveying section for conveying the substrate; and a liquid adhering member provided on the conveying portion and partially sandwiched between an end of the substrate and the conveying portion, and a spraying portion that sprays a liquid composition toward the substrate and the liquid adhering member, the substrate being inclined to a conveying surface of the substrate in the conveying portion.

title_en: New energy electric car liquid cooling board convenient to fire prevention operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy electric car liquid cooling plate convenient for fireproof operation, which relates to the technical field of new energy automobiles and comprises a fixing box, wherein a battery body is arranged in the fixing box, the inner wall of the fixing box is fixedly connected with a fixing plate at the upper side of the battery body, the inner wall of the fixing box is fixedly connected with a fixing plate, the outer wall of the fixing plate is fixedly connected with a sliding chute, the inner wall of the sliding chute is inserted with a liquid cooling plate, one side of the liquid cooling plate is fixedly connected with a liquid inlet pipe, the upper end of the liquid inlet pipe is positioned at the upper side of the liquid cooling plate, the lower end of the liquid inlet pipe penetrates through the liquid cooling plate and extends to the lower side of the inner part of the liquid cooling plate, and the outer wall of the fixing box is positioned at the upper side of the liquid cooling plate and is adhered with a fixing block. This new energy electric car liquid cooling board convenient to fire prevention operation makes this device cover the coolant liquid to it fast when the battery body fires through being provided with flowing back mechanism, makes it reach the purpose that prevents the intensity of a fire diffusion of quick cooling.

title_en: Additive for lithium ion battery anode slurry, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of lithium ion battery anode slurry, in particular to an additive for lithium ion battery anode slurry, a preparation method and application thereof. The additive for a positive electrode slurry for a lithium ion battery comprises a diblock copolymer comprising a first block having a nitrogen-containing group and a second block having an oxygen-containing group. The additive for the lithium ion battery anode slurry can reduce the viscosity of the slurry and improve the solid content of the slurry, thereby reducing the baking energy consumption and improving the manufacturing efficiency of the pole piece; the additive can also endow the slurry with higher stability, reduce the crystallinity of PVDF, and make PVDF softer, thereby improving the softness of the pole piece; the diblock copolymer contained in the additive has electrochemical stability, and the residual diblock copolymer in the pole piece can not affect the performance of the battery.

title_en: Erection equipment for aluminum alloy conductor installation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aluminum alloy conductor cable erection equipment, in particular to erection equipment for aluminum alloy conductor installation, which comprises the following components: the bridge comprises a plurality of bridges, wherein the cross section of each bridge is U-shaped, two sliding grooves are formed in the inner side of each bridge, and one end of each bridge is fixedly connected with two first connecting plates which are symmetrically distributed; through setting up traction structure, limit structure and trigger structure, can be through traction structure to fixed back of conductor cable, drive the conductor cable through traction structure and pass the laying pipeline fast, and at the in-process of wearing to establish conductor cable, under rack and pinion's mutually supporting, can carry out spacingly through limit structure to the position of conductor cable fast, reduce the circumstances that the conductor cable skew influences the use in the use, accomplish the spacing to conductor cable at the in-process of wearing to establish conductor cable, need not to fix spacing operation alone, the process of erection has been optimized, and is easy and simple to handle, and efficiency of construction has been improved.

title_en: Solar-driven comprehensive energy system for hydrogen production and combined cooling heating and power
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solar-driven comprehensive energy system for hydrogen production and combined cooling heating and power, which belongs to the technical field of energy systems and comprises a hydrogen production system and a hydrogen utilization system, wherein the hydrogen production system generates electricity to supply to users or stores energy to supply to the hydrogen utilization system; the hydrogen production system comprises a solar heat collector, wherein the solar heat collector collects heat and exchanges heat with a transcritical carbon dioxide circulating system, and the transcritical carbon dioxide circulating system generates electric energy to supply to a user and a proton exchange membrane electrolytic tank, and the proton exchange membrane electrolytic tank is used for producing hydrogen by electrolysis; the hydrogen utilization system comprises a high-temperature proton exchange membrane fuel cell, the high-temperature proton exchange membrane fuel cell utilizes hydrogen and air to output electric energy to supply to a user, and the high-temperature proton exchange membrane fuel cell exchanges heat with a transcritical organic Rankine cycle system.

title_en: Carbon coating preparation method of graphite anode material for lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon coating preparation method of a graphite anode material for a lithium ion battery, which comprises the following steps of crushing and grinding a certain amount of coated asphalt or phenolic resin, and dissolving the crushed and ground asphalt or phenolic resin in an organic solvent; adding a certain amount of spherical graphite particles into the prepared solution under the stirring condition, and performing ultrasonic treatment to form uniform suspension; at a certain temperature, after ultrasonic stirring for a certain time, filtering to remove most of the solvent in the material; placing the obtained material into a microwave dryer, and drying for a certain time under a certain microwave frequency; and carbonizing at high temperature in a protective atmosphere to obtain the carbon-coated graphite anode material. According to the invention, the prepared negative electrode material improves the rate capability of the graphite negative electrode material on the basis of ensuring the cycle performance, and can improve the first discharge capacity.

title_en: USB charging head with replaceable pins
abstract_en: The application relates to a USB charging head with replaceable pins, and belongs to the field of charging heads. The charging device comprises a charging seat, two first inserting sheets and three second inserting sheets, wherein the two first inserting sheets are connected and are arranged according to the positions of two pins and the three second inserting sheets are also connected and are arranged according to the positions of triangular pins, a first sliding groove is formed in the charging seat opposite to the first inserting sheet, a second sliding groove is formed in the charging seat opposite to the second inserting sheet, the first inserting sheets slide in and out of the charging seat through the first sliding groove, the second inserting sheets slide in and out of the charging seat through the second sliding groove, a fixing mechanism is further arranged on the charging seat and is connected with one of the first inserting sheets and one of the second inserting sheets, and the fixing mechanism is used for fixing and limiting the first inserting sheets and the second inserting sheets. The application has the effect of increasing the application range of the USB charging head.

title_en: 5G active power distribution network fault self-healing system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault self-healing system and a fault self-healing method for a 5G active power distribution network, which relate to the technical field of fault self-healing of active power distribution networks and comprise a 5G core network, an intelligent terminal unit STU and a plurality of distributed power sources DG, wherein the intelligent terminal unit STU is electrically connected with the distributed power sources DG through a power grid line, and the distributed power sources DG are mutually connected through the power grid line. The invention has the advantages that: the 5G communication is utilized to provide a wireless solution for the establishment of a peer-to-peer communication network of a power distribution network by the excellent characteristics of high reliability, low time delay, high speed and the like, the wireless solution is suitable for the characteristics of changeable topological structures of an active power distribution network and reduces the cost increase caused by the laying of an optical fiber network, and the positioning of a fault section, the isolation of the fault section and the power supply of a power-losing load recovery as soon as possible can be automatically completed on the premise of minimum human factor intervention, so that the load power-losing rate is greatly reduced, the power-off time of a user is reduced, the load power-losing rate is reduced by DG, and the power-off time is reduced.

title_en: Configuration method, device and equipment of reactive power compensation resource
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a configuration method, a device and equipment of reactive power compensation resources, which are applied to the technical field of power systems. The method comprises the following steps: dividing each node according to sensitivity indexes of each node in the power grid under different power grid operation scenes to obtain corresponding reactive compensation partitions; according to dominant nodes in each reactive compensation zone in different power grid operation scenes, determining one or more candidate installation positions of reactive compensation equipment of the power grid; and solving the reactive power compensation resource allocation optimization model according to the one or more candidate installation positions of the reactive power compensation equipment, the load of each node and the photovoltaic output prediction, so as to obtain an optimal reactive power compensation resource allocation scheme of the power grid and allocate the optimal reactive power compensation resource allocation scheme. In this way, the configuration effect of the reactive power compensation resource can be effectively improved.

title_en: Method for transmitting power of wireless power transmitter
abstract_en: There is provided a method of transmitting power of a wireless power transmitter, comprising: a reception stage for receiving a signal including the FOD status packet from the wireless power receiver; a first determination stage of determining whether foreign matter exists in a charging area of the wireless power transmitter based on the FOD status packet; a power control stage that controls power transmission in a first power transmission mode when it is determined in the first determination stage that foreign matter is present in the charging region, or that controls power transmission in a second power transmission mode when it is determined in the first determination stage that foreign matter is not present in the charging region; and a second determination stage of determining whether or not foreign matter is present in the charging area based on information other than the information included in the FOD status packet while controlling power transmission in one of the first power transmission mode and the second power transmission mode through the power control stage.

title_en: Control method and control system for repairing reset error of wiper motor
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of vehicle windscreen wiper control, in particular to a control method and a control system for repairing a reset error of a windscreen wiper motor. The application mainly carries out filtering processing of response time when the domain controller logic control detects the reset signal for the first time, avoids the phenomenon that the wiper cannot be reset caused by clutter, and further improves the accuracy of the domain controller reset signal acquisition; in addition, when the next automatic wiper switch signal is sent out, logic processing can be performed, the situation that the wiper does not act due to the fact that the reset signal is wrong due to the last clutter signal is avoided, and then the reset error of a wiper motor can be repaired in time, and the normal work of the vehicle wiper is effectively guaranteed.

title_en: Flexible multilayer composite transparent electrode and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a flexible multilayer composite transparent electrode, comprising: a flexible support layer and a high-conductivity transmission layer which are stacked in sequence; wherein, the flexible supporting layer is made of high polymer material and is arranged on the bottom layer; the high-conductivity transmission layer comprises at least two layers which are arranged on the flexible supporting layer, and the high-conductivity transmission layer is in a hollow and/or semi-hollow structure. The hollow and/or semi-hollow structure can improve the flexibility, light transmittance and surface velvet degree of the electrode, and solves the problems that the traditional transparent conductive indium tin oxide (ITO for short) in the prior art is hard and brittle, the bearable deformation is very small, and the metallic silver with good conductivity is poor in light transmittance; the yellowing index of the copper film is too high, the copper film reflects light and is easy to form mole lines. The transparent conductive oxide material dielectric protective layer arranged on the high-conductivity transmission layer solves the problem that the metal nanowire or the metal grid structure in the prior art has large specific surface area and is active, and once the transparent electrode is oxidized, the transparent electrode is invalid.

title_en: Anti-aging wire and cable and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of wires and cables, and discloses an anti-aging wire and cable and a preparation method thereof; cobalt (Co) is selected as a metal blank, and bipyridine-imidazole connecting agent is introduced to prepare a two-dimensional MOF material with high heat dissipation performance and oxidation resistance; the preparation method comprises the steps of immersing carbon nano tubes in a MOF preparation process to prepare the composite MOF crosslinked carbon nano tubes with the three-dimensional structure, preparing two materials into a coating to be coated on the surface of a conductor, extruding a coating insulating layer through an extruder, cooling, rolling and packaging to obtain the anti-aging wire and cable. The material has wide application prospect in the field of wires and cables, and provides an effective way for solving the problem of cable aging.

title_en: Power conversion device and DC/DC conversion device
abstract_en: The invention provides a power conversion device and a DC/DC conversion device. The power conversion device is provided with: a DC-DC converter section including a transformer having a coil substrate forming a primary side coil and a bus bar forming a secondary side coil, the DC-DC converter section converting a voltage of DC power input from a DC power supply into a different voltage; and a cooling unit provided with a cooling flow path through which a cooling liquid flows, and provided with a DC-DC converter unit. The bus bar of the transformer has a cooling portion side fixing portion that is fixed to a cooling portion provided with a cooling flow path.

title_en: Battery cell capacity balancing method, battery management system and storage medium
abstract_en: Provided are a battery cell capacity balancing method, a battery management system (1), and a storage medium. The balancing method is applied to a battery management system (1), the battery management system (1) is electrically connected to a battery (2), the battery (2) comprises N electric cores (21), N is an integer larger than 1, when the electric cores (21) are in a charging state, the voltage change rate dV/dSOC of the electric cores (21) is calculated, the voltage change rate is a value obtained by differentiating the current capacity SOC of the electric cores (21) by the output voltage V of the electric cores (21), the time when the voltage change rate of the electric cores (21) meets preset conditions is recorded, the balancing capacity corresponding to the electric cores (21) is calculated according to the time when the voltage change rate of the electric cores (21) meets the preset conditions and the function of the charging current for charging the electric cores (21) along with time, and the electric cores (21) are balanced according to the balancing capacity. The capacity difference among the electric cores (21) is calculated quantitatively, and the electric cores (21) are balanced at one time directly according to the difference, so that the calculated amount and the time consumed in the balancing process are reduced.

title_en: Voltage balance control method and device for public power grid and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a voltage balance control method, a device and electronic equipment of a public power grid, wherein the method comprises the steps of predicting an estimated instruction value of a target submodule at the next moment, judging the consistency of the estimated instruction value and an actual voltage average value, and obtaining a judgment result; respectively determining the consistency scores of the voltage balance algorithms based on the preset number of judgment results, and taking the voltage balance algorithm with the highest consistency score as a target algorithm; and carrying out voltage balance control on all sub-modules in the public power grid based on a target algorithm. According to the application, the consistency of the prediction results of different voltage balance algorithms is judged on the specific public power grid, the algorithm with high prediction accuracy is selected as the target algorithm, the actual situation of the specific power grid is met, and the voltage balance improvement effect is better. And sequencing all the submodules according to the alarm data so as to regulate and control the voltage according to the sequencing order, thereby realizing the integral intelligent regulation and control of the voltage balance.

title_en: PMSM three-vector model prediction dead-beat current control method based on geometric analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a PMSM three-vector model prediction dead-beat current control method based on geometric analysis. The method mainly comprises the following steps of 1, establishing a PMSM motor mathematical model, obtaining current prediction quantity of model prediction current control by using the model, converting the current prediction quantity into voltage prediction quantity by using dead beat control, 2, setting a cost function in the model prediction control to be in a root mean square mode, establishing connection between the cost function value and a vector in a voltage vector diagram, 3, calculating the duty ratio of action time of each cycle of three vectors by analyzing the geometric relation of the voltage vector diagram, and 4, carrying out pre-modulation or compensation on the voltage of an overmodulation part, ensuring stable operation of the motor, and reducing errors during overmodulation.

title_en: Solar street lamp controller for adjusting brightness of LED (light-emitting diode) based on time and battery voltage
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of solar street lamp controllers, in particular to a solar street lamp controller capable of adjusting LED brightness based on time and battery voltage. The main control power supply circuit comprises a lithium battery, a 5V voltage reduction module and a 3.3V voltage reduction module. The solar charging circuit comprises a charging main circuit and a charging control circuit, and the charging main circuit is electrically connected with the charging control circuit. The LED brightness adjusting circuit comprises a constant current control circuit and a street lamp port. The main control circuit comprises an MCU, a current and voltage measuring circuit and a clock circuit, wherein the current and voltage measuring circuit, the clock circuit and the MCU are connected. The brightness of the LED can be changed along with the time and the voltage value of the battery, so that the battery can be utilized more efficiently; the voltage threshold value for extinguishing the LEDs is set, so that the phenomenon of cyclic opening and closing of the LEDs caused by voltage rise due to the extinction of the LEDs can be avoided.

title_en: Two-machine coaxial series connection booster fan
