abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-machine coaxial serial booster blower, which comprises a base mechanism, wherein the upper surface of the base mechanism is provided with a blower mechanism; the air blower mechanism is provided with a connecting pipe, the middle part of the air blower mechanism is provided with a cooling mechanism, and one end of the air blower mechanism is provided with a protection mechanism; the protection mechanism comprises a fixed pipe, a connecting cover, a protection net, a clamping groove, a cover plate assembly, two positioning assemblies, an elastic assembly, a limiting assembly and a clamping assembly, wherein the fixed pipe is clamped with the inner cavity of the clamping groove, the protection net is fixed on the inner wall of the connecting cover, the elastic assembly is arranged at one end of one positioning assembly, and the limiting assembly and the clamping assembly are arranged at two ends of the other positioning assembly. The invention utilizes the matched arrangement mode of the cooling mechanism and the protection mechanism, is convenient for stably cooling the double-shaft motor of the blower mechanism, is convenient for stably disassembling and assembling the connecting cover, reduces the influence of vibration on the cover plate assembly, and ensures that the blower mechanism can stably intake air for use.

title_en: Arc extinguishing system of novel circuit breaker in arc cutting mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel arc extinguishing system of a circuit breaker in an arc cutting mode, which comprises a base, wherein a protection shell is arranged on the outer side of the upper end of the base, and a moving contact assembly, a fixed contact assembly and an arc cutting assembly for cutting and blocking an arc and elongating a partial arc are arranged in the protection shell at the upper end of the base. The invention has reasonable design, when the distance between the moving contact and the fixed contact of the circuit breaker reaches the distance that the arc cutting piece can pass through in the breaking process, the arc cutting piece is quickly inserted between the moving contact and the fixed contact under the action of the accelerating spring to cut off the arc, the arc is cut off and partially elongated, the arc is re-burned and re-elongated through the small hole on the arc cutting piece, the arc is quickly cooled, thereby achieving the purposes of extinguishing the arc, improving the limit breaking capacity and the operation breaking capacity of the circuit breaker, further improving the electrical life of the circuit breaker, and simultaneously, the moving contact compresses the quick spring to store energy and prepare for the next breaking.

title_en: Bending-resistant power cable
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power lines, and provides a bending-resistant power cable which comprises a power transmission line and a signal transmission line, wherein the power transmission line is provided with a plurality of local circumference arrays, the signal transmission line comprises a plurality of first conductors and a plurality of first filling glass fiber ropes, the first conductors are layered and stranded by adopting a pitch, a signal line sheath is arranged on the peripheries of the first conductors and the first filling glass fiber ropes, and the signal line sheath is formed by braiding a plurality of superconductive filaments; the power transmission line and the signal transmission line are distributed in a round shape integrally, and second filling glass fiber ropes are arranged at the intersection points of the power transmission line and the circle center extension lines of the signal transmission lines. Based on this, the power cable that utilizes this structure wholly possesses good bending resistance, also can possess certain compliance under the strength structure that keeps, and the process installation of being convenient for uses, and the practicality is strong.

title_en: Single-stage AC-DC LLC resonant converter device and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a single-stage AC-DC LLC resonant converter device, which comprises an input rectifier bridge and an input capacitor C  in  Coupling inductance L  r1  Coupling inductance L  r2  Switch tube Q  1  ‑Q  4  Resonance capacitor C  r  Transformer T, output rectifier bridge and output capacitor C  o  And output load R  o  One end of the input rectifier bridge is connected with an alternating current source v  ac  The other end of the input rectifier bridge is connected with an alternating current source v  ac  Is arranged at the other end of the tube; the positive output end of the input rectifier bridge is connected with the input capacitor C  in  Positive terminal of (a) and coupling inductance L  r1  Is the same name terminal and coupled inductance L  r2  Is a heteronym terminal of (a); the negative output end of the input rectifier bridge is connected with an input capacitor C  in  Is connected with the negative terminal of the switch tube Q  2  And Q  4  Is connected in parallel with the source electrode of the capacitor and is grounded; the coupling inductance L  r1  Is terminated by a switch tube Q  1  Is connected with the drain electrode of the switch tube Q  1  Source electrode of (C) is connected with switch tube Q  2  Drain of (C) and resonance capacitance C  r  Is provided. The device has good optimization effect on the efficiency and the power factor of the single-stage LLC PFC resonant converter, and improves the reliability of the converter.

title_en: Multifunctional vehicle-mounted outdoor charging box
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional vehicle-mounted outdoor charging box, wherein a battery pack is arranged on the right side inside the box body, a cover plate is rotationally connected with the box body, a solar panel is arranged on the upper surface of the cover plate, a table plate is rotationally connected with the box body, the table plate is positioned between the cover plate and the box body, the upper end and the lower end of a limiting telescopic rod are respectively rotationally connected with the cover plate and the box body, the expansion and the contraction of an inner rod are controlled through a knob on the surface of the limiting telescopic rod, the angle adjustment of the cover plate and the solar panel is further realized, the solar panel is favorably irradiated by sunlight directly, the utilization efficiency of light energy is improved, the solar panel is fixed on the cover plate, the occupied space of the solar panel is reduced, the storage utilization rate of the box body is improved under the condition that the box body is not excessively large under the control of the box body, the problems of outdoor cooking and electricity consumption of an electric cooker and a discharging plugboard can be solved, the electric cooker can be conveniently used for an automobile under the condition of deficiency of electricity, and the battery damage caused by new energy automobile or traditional automobile battery deficiency can be prevented at ordinary times, and the outdoor camping is convenient.

title_en: Energy conversion system, method, equipment and storage medium for coiled tubing equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses an energy conversion system, an energy conversion method, energy conversion equipment and an energy conversion storage medium of coiled tubing equipment, wherein the energy conversion system comprises a control room, a first damping unit and an energy conversion assembly; the control chamber is respectively and electrically connected with the first damping unit and the energy conversion assembly; the control room is used for controlling the first damping unit to generate energy to be converted and controlling the energy conversion component to convert the energy to be converted. The application solves the technical problem of large energy loss of continuous oil pipe equipment.

title_en: Housing for an electric machine, structural assembly for the construction thereof and drive assembly
abstract_en: The invention relates to a housing (10) for an electric machine (20), comprising: -an outer housing (11) having: ■ A hollow cylindrical outer jacket (111), and a ■ a first bearing end cap (112) closing the outer jacket (111) on one side; -an inner housing (12) which is pushed into an outer housing (11) in a form-fitting manner, said inner housing having: ■ The invention is characterized in that an additional eccentric bearing seat (124) for the outer shaft (42) is arranged on the outer side of the second bearing end cap (122), said bearing seat not extending through the second bearing end cap (122) and extending at least partially into the region of the second bearing end cap (122) protruding out of the outer jacket (111), said bearing seat being provided on the inner side of the second bearing end cap (122), said bearing end caps being provided with a central bearing seat (113, 123) for the inner shaft, i.e. the rotor shaft (221) of the electric motor (20), on the respective inner side of the second bearing end cap (112), and the second bearing end cap (122) protruding radially outwards from the outer jacket (111). The invention also relates to a structural assembly for such a housing (10) and to a drive device having such a housing (10).

title_en: Navigation-aiding lamp, navigation-aiding lamp control device and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a navigation-aid lamp, a navigation-aid lamp control device and a control method, which belong to the field of navigation-aid lamp and monitoring thereof, and comprise the following steps: the system comprises an FPGA module, a signal conditioning module, a wireless communication module, an AC/DC module, an LED driving module, an isolation transformer and a signal coupling module; the AC/DC module is used for converting constant current output of the isolation transformer into direct current and providing working power for the LED driving module, the FPGA module, the signal conditioning module and the wireless communication module. The invention realizes accurate identification of the input light level and accurate light intensity output of the lamp, optimizes the power carrier networking method aiming at the serial loop of the navigation-aiding lamp, can greatly reduce networking time after the navigation-aiding lamp is electrified, realizes plug and play, receives remote control instructions to carry out on-off and flicker control on the navigation-aiding lamp in a wireless and power carrier communication mode, can realize appointed light intensity output, and meets the requirements of single lamp detection and light guidance.

title_en: Universal four-port converter with series LC voltage equalizer and control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a universal four-port converter with a series LC voltage equalizer and a control system, wherein the converter comprises two partial power processing double-active bridges and a series LC branch, each partial power processing double-active bridge comprises a full-bridge circuit, a half-bridge circuit and a high-frequency isolation transformer, the full-bridge side ports of the two partial power processing double-active bridges are respectively used as a first port and a second port to be connected to a direct current source or a load, the two half-bridge side ports of the two partial power processing double-active bridges are respectively connected to a positive bus and a neutral line of a bipolar direct current micro-grid, and the neutral line and a negative bus, and the two partial power processing double-active bridges are used for realizing a power transmission function; the LC branch and the two half-bridge circuits are connected in series to form an inductance-capacitance voltage balance unit for realizing the voltage balance of two poles of the bipolar direct current micro-grid. The invention can realize port power control and bipolar voltage balance without additionally adding a voltage balance converter, and can improve the efficiency of the converter.

title_en: Electrode assembly, battery cell, battery and electricity utilization device
abstract_en: The positive plate comprises at least two positive bending parts positioned in a bending region, the negative plate comprises at least two negative bending parts positioned in the bending region, wherein a first parameter corresponding to one negative bending part positioned at the outermost side of the electrode assembly in the winding direction is 1.03-1.20, the absolute value of the difference between any two first parameters in the bending region is less than or equal to 0.035, and the first parameter is the total capacity ratio of active substances of the outer surface of the negative bending part and the inner surface of the positive bending part positioned at the outer side of the negative bending part and adjacent to the negative bending part; and/or, the second parameter corresponding to one negative bending part of the electrode assembly positioned at the outermost side of the winding direction is 1.03-1.20, the absolute value of the difference between any two second parameters in the bending region is less than or equal to 0.035, and the second parameter is the ratio of the total capacity of active materials of the inner surface of the negative bending part to the outer surface of the positive bending part positioned at the inner side of the negative bending part and adjacent to the negative bending part. In this way, the rationality of the distribution of the active substance can be improved.

title_en: Amorphous magnetic yoke special for induction furnace and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of magnetic materials, and provides a special amorphous magnetic yoke for an induction furnace and a preparation method thereof. The amorphous magnetic yoke special for the induction furnace comprises the following components in percentage by weight: fe:80.0% -85.0%, si:3.44% -6.02%, B:2.58% -5.16%, P:1.57% -6.45%, C:0.03% -0.15%, nd:0.03% -0.05%, ti:1.5% -2.5%, zr:0.17% -0.35%, ni:2.0% -3.1%; the preparation method comprises the following steps: and (3) putting the powder containing the weight percentage into a vacuum induction melting furnace, carrying out gradient heating and heat preservation treatment, cooling to room temperature, and carrying out machining to obtain the amorphous magnetic yoke special for the induction furnace. Through the technical scheme, the problems of low magnetic permeability and low compressive strength of the iron-based amorphous alloy in the prior art are solved.

title_en: Lithium battery packaging equipment and process
abstract_en: The invention discloses lithium battery packaging equipment and a process, and relates to the technical field of lithium battery packaging. The lithium battery packaging equipment comprises a packaging table, wherein a cap packaging mechanism is arranged at the top of the packaging table through a supporting frame, a supporting table is movably arranged on the packaging table, a storage component for placing a cylindrical lithium battery is arranged on the supporting table, and the cap packaging mechanism is positioned at the top of the storage component. According to the invention, the cap packaging mechanism, the storage component and the film sealing component are arranged, and the cylindrical lithium battery can be placed at the bottom of the cap packaging mechanism through the storage component, so that the cap packaging is realized, after the packaging is finished, the cylindrical lithium battery can be enabled to move upwards through the storage component, and the cylindrical lithium battery protective film is packaged through the film sealing component, so that the multifunction of the packaging equipment can be realized, and the problem that the existing cap packaging equipment is single in function and difficult to package the qualified cylindrical lithium battery after the packaging is finished is solved.

title_en: Method for thawing pig small intestine by using radio frequency
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of food industry, and particularly relates to a method for thawing pig small intestines by using radio frequency. The method comprises the following steps: (1) Splitting frozen pig small intestines and setting radio frequency equipment parameters; (2) Uniformly placing the split frozen pig small intestines on radio frequency equipment, starting the radio frequency equipment, thawing, and transferring the frozen pig small intestines into a water tank for soaking after thawing; (3) And (3) putting the soaked small intestines of the pigs into an intestine arranging machine and an intestine scraping machine for arrangement and scraping to obtain the mucous membrane of the small intestines of the pigs. According to the invention, the radio frequency thawing technology is adopted for thawing the small intestine of the pig, the small intestine of the pig can be thawed from-20 ℃ to-15 ℃ to 0 ℃ to 1.5 ℃ only by 15 minutes, the deterioration risk of the small intestine of the pig is minimized due to the treatment speed and uniformity, the change of the rational characteristics is avoided, the bacteria breeding is avoided, and the optimal quality of the small intestine of the pig can be maintained.

title_en: Graphene composite silicon-based negative electrode lithium battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a graphene composite silicon-based negative electrode lithium battery, which comprises a negative electrode plate, wherein the negative electrode plate is prepared by stirring silicon monoxide, graphene and absolute ethyl alcohol at normal temperature in sequence according to the weight ratio of 8:1:1, drying after stirring, and obtaining powder after drying; grinding the obtained powder and polyvinylidene fluoride with the mass concentration of 5% according to the weight ratio of 45:100, coating the uniformly ground powder on a copper foil, putting the coated copper foil into a vacuum drying oven for drying, and cutting the dried copper foil into wafers by a slicer to prepare a negative plate; through the combination of SiOx and novel carbon material graphene, capacity sharp reduction is reduced, and stability of the silicon-based negative electrode lithium battery is improved.

title_en: Sodium ion battery positive electrode material precursor and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a precursor of a positive electrode material of a sodium ion battery, which comprises the following raw materials: perylene diimide derivatives, graphene oxide; the perylene diimide derivative has good dispersibility and conductivity, and can be endowed with excellent cohesive force after hydrolysis treatment, so that the binding force with other raw material components is enhanced; the perylene diimide derivative and the graphene oxide are used cooperatively, so that the specific capacity and the cycling stability of the perylene diimide active substance in the sodium ion battery are improved; the sodium ion battery anode material precursor prepared by taking perylene diimide derivative and graphene oxide as electrode active materials is mixed with conductive carbon black and sodium polyacrylate, and is subjected to grinding, hydrolytic condensation treatment to realize synergistic interaction, so that the charge-discharge specific capacity, rate capability and cycle performance of the sodium ion battery are remarkably improved. The application also discloses a preparation method of the precursor of the positive electrode material of the sodium ion battery.

title_en: Positive electrode active material, preparation method thereof, positive electrode plate, battery and electricity utilization device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a positive electrode active material, a preparation method thereof, a positive electrode plate, a battery and an electric device. The chemical formula of the positive electrode active material is Na  x  M  (1‑y)  Ca  y  O  2  M comprises transition metal elements, x=0.8-1.1, and y is more than or equal to 0.005 and less than or equal to 0.015; wherein 95wt% or more of Ca element is distributed in a surface layer of single crystal particles of the positive electrode active material, and the thickness of the surface layer is 1 μm. The positive electrode active material has low residual alkali contentThe air stability of the positive electrode active material is improved, thus improving the cycle performance of the positive electrode active material applied to a battery.

title_en: High-efficient heat dissipation lithium cell group
abstract_en: The application provides a high-efficiency heat dissipation lithium battery pack, which relates to a lithium battery. Through V-arrangement aviation baffle, pneumatic link gear, T shape guide duct and the circulating pipe that set up, the wind that has realized driving in the advancing process at the car can get into the wind-guiding intracavity of installing shell bottom, and blow whirlwind flabellum rotation, and then make the gangbar rotate, can get into T shape guide duct simultaneously under the water conservancy diversion effect of V-arrangement aviation baffle, blow out from the air outlet on the perpendicular L shaped plate, blow out to lithium cell group top, heat dissipation is handled from the top to it, cooperate the cooling liquid at circulating pipe internal circulation, effectually dispel the heat to lithium cell group, the gangbar can drive the generator operation, the partly mechanical energy that produces the wind energy turns into the electric energy, the gangbar drives the brush board and rotates, clear the brush to the filter screen frame.

title_en: Motor rotor linkage type annular line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a motor rotor linkage type annular line, which comprises: the device comprises an annular track, a motor stator module, a motor driving module and a sliding module; the motor stator module comprises a plurality of coil modules, and each coil module is annularly distributed above the annular track; the motor drive module comprises a plurality of motor drive modules, the sliding module comprises a sliding seat, a rotor fixing seat, a first magnetic block group and a second magnetic block group, and the sliding seat is arranged on the annular track in a sliding manner. According to the motor rotor linkage type annular line, the annular track, the motor stator module, the motor driving module and the sliding module are arranged, so that the coil module serving as the motor rotor can be fixedly arranged at the corresponding position of the annular track, and the rotor fixing seat on the sliding seat is driven to move, and annular circulating movement is realized; this structural design can avoid wiring on the sliding seat to solved no iron core motor drive's limitation, and can save holistic manufacturing cost.

title_en: Intelligent highway service area energy comprehensive management sunshade pavilion and use method
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent highway service area energy comprehensive management sunshade pavilion and a use method thereof, belonging to the technical field of intelligent management, and comprising a sunshade pavilion body, a renewable energy supply module, a wireless charging table and an intelligent dustbin; the renewable energy source supply module is connected with the wireless charging table and the intelligent dustbin; the sunshade pavilion body comprises a sunshade top and a support column, and the sunshade top is arranged at the upper end of the support column; the renewable energy source supply module comprises a small wind power generation device and a photovoltaic power generation device, wherein the small wind power generation device is arranged at the top end of the sunshade roof, and the photovoltaic power generation device is arranged on the upper end face of the sunshade roof. The renewable energy source is supplied by utilizing natural resources through the small wind power generation device and the photovoltaic power generation device, and meanwhile, the wireless charging table is provided for providing convenient charging service for users. The intelligent garbage bin improves garbage treatment efficiency through intelligent control and classification treatment, and reduces negative influence on environment.

title_en: Flexible self-supporting lithium-sulfur battery electrode material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flexible self-supporting lithium-sulfur battery electrode material, a preparation method and application thereof, which consists of P-MoTe  2  Modifying carbon cloth to form a unique self-supporting material, wherein the surface of the carbon cloth is formed by lamellar P-MoTe  2  Covering. The preparation method comprises the following steps: adding molybdate and carbon cloth into DMF for solvothermal reaction to obtain Mo-containing precursor nano-arrayThe composite CC is calcined in the air to obtain the precursor MoO  3  CC, precursor MoO  3  CC in Ar/H  2  Calcining the obtained product with tellurium powder to obtain MoTe  2  CC, finally calcining with sodium hypophosphite under Ar to obtain P-MoTe  2  /CC. Immersing it in the solution of carbon disulfide sublimated with sulfur, taking out, drying and heating to obtain P-MoTe  2  And (3) modifying the carbon cloth/S self-supporting flexible electrode. The phosphorus-doped molybdenum telluride composite carbon cloth flexible self-supporting material can be used as a high-performance electrode material.

title_en: Ultraviolet lamp control circuit and control equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultraviolet lamp control circuit and control equipment, wherein the ultraviolet lamp control circuit comprises a control module, a driving module, a display module and a parameter adjusting module; the control module is connected with the driving module and is used for sending a driving control signal to the driving module when receiving the parameter signal; the driving module is connected with the ultraviolet lamp and is used for driving the ultraviolet lamp to emit light according to the driving control signal; the display module is connected with the control module and is used for displaying the luminous parameters of the ultraviolet lamp according to the display control signal of the control module; the lighting parameters at least comprise the lighting brightness of the ultraviolet lamp; the parameter adjusting module is connected with the control module and is used for sending parameter signals to the control module according to an adjusting instruction input by a user so that the control module can adjust the driving control signals. According to the technical scheme, the user can acquire the luminous parameters of the ultraviolet lamp, and can adjust the luminous parameters of the ultraviolet lamp, so that the brightness precision of the ultraviolet lamp is improved.

title_en: 7.4V lithium battery pack with heat conduction structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 7.4V lithium battery pack with a heat conduction structure, and relates to the technical field of lithium batteries; the invention comprises a box body and a battery pack, wherein the battery pack is positioned in the box body, an adjusting mechanism is arranged in the box body, the adjusting mechanism comprises four mounting boxes in Yu An boxes of the battery pack, a limit mechanism is arranged on the outer side of each mounting box, and a heat conducting mechanism is arranged on the inner wall of the box body; according to the invention, through arranging structures such as the adjusting mechanism and the like and adjusting the space between the mounting boxes, the lithium battery packs can be fixedly mounted according to the number and the specification of the lithium battery packs, so that the purpose of convenient mounting is achieved.

title_en: Cooling system for high density motor
abstract_en: The present application relates to a cooling system for a high density motor. The application provides a method and a system for an electric motor. In one example, an electric motor may include a stator with an end winding protruding axially from a first end of the stator along a central rotational axis of the electric motor, and a first end plate disposed at the first end of the stator. The first end plate may have an inner face with a recess configured to receive the end winding, the recess including a thermally conductive material to interface with the end winding. Furthermore, the first end plate may comprise at least one cooling channel for flowing a coolant.

title_en: Lithium ion battery heating system and method for low temperature
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium ion battery heating system and a method for low temperature, comprising a temperature relay connected with the negative electrode of a battery module, wherein the temperature relay is connected with a positive thermistor, the positive thermistor is connected with a heating element capable of converting electric energy into heat energy, and the heating element is connected with the positive electrode of the battery module. The invention uses the passive element temperature relay to control the heating system to start, reduces the failure probability of the heating system function, and can simplify the control method of the battery management system; the invention adopts the heating element capable of converting electric energy into heat energy, and adopts the mode of heating the resistance type heating sheet by the electric energy of the battery, so that the application range of the heating system is wider, and the heating system is applicable to the battery pack of any system; the invention takes the positive electrode/negative electrode of the battery as a heating path, and can greatly improve the heating efficiency of the heating system on the lithium ion battery.

title_en: Method and device for suppressing direct-current voltage of flexible direct-current power grid and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium for suppressing direct-current voltage of a flexible direct-current power grid, wherein the method comprises the following steps: under the condition that the alternating current side of an inversion station of a flexible direct current power grid fails, obtaining the direct current deviation amount of the inversion station; based on the DC current deviation amount, an original DC voltage reference value of an active power outer loop controller of the inversion station is adjusted to obtain a new DC voltage reference value; determining the number of submodules in a converter valve bridge arm of the inversion station according to the new direct-current voltage reference value; and setting submodules in the converter valve bridge arm according to the number of the submodules so as to inhibit the direct-current overvoltage of the flexible direct-current power grid. The method can reduce the cost of suppressing the direct-current overvoltage.

title_en: Antitheft door with heat insulation reinforcing layer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of burglary-resisting doors, in particular to a burglary-resisting door with a heat insulation reinforcing layer, which comprises a door body and a cat eye hole, wherein feedback grooves are formed in the upper side and the lower side of the cat eye hole in a communicating manner, a camera and an alarm are fixedly installed on the door body respectively, a sliding frame is slidingly installed on the upper side of the feedback grooves, a first contact electrode is fixedly installed on the bottom wall of the sliding frame, a protection groove is formed in the upper side of a protection block, and a second contact electrode is arranged in the protection groove. According to the invention, after the cat eye is disassembled and extracted, the first contact electrode falls to be fully contacted with the second contact electrode, the alarm and the camera are started, and secondly, the two contact electrodes have good protection and dustproof measures to prevent poor contact, and the baffle plate is additionally arranged while alarming to block the cat eye hole, and the baffle plate can generate heat, and meanwhile, the baffle plate is sprayed with lubricating oil and is not easy to take out, so that the safety of the burglary-resisting door is further improved.

title_en: Heartbeat sensing temperature limiting start-stop energy-saving switch for heating ventilation air conditioner
abstract_en: The application discloses a heartbeat sensing temperature limiting start-stop energy-saving switch for a heating ventilation air conditioner, which comprises a power supply module, a temperature control module, a human body sensing module and a temperature acquisition module. By collecting the human breath and heartbeat life signal and the indoor temperature signal, the low-temperature protection and temperature limiting start-stop of the heating and ventilation equipment are performed, the problem that the traditional heating and ventilation control equipment cannot consider the energy waste caused by various factors such as people, temperature, freezing prevention and the like is solved, the purposes that the people start, leave the automatic stop, the temperature reaches the required value and the automatic stop is achieved, and the deep efficient energy-saving temperature control target for nursing by special people is not needed. The energy-saving switch solves the problems of temperature setting, complex structure, low control precision, poor operation reliability, high manufacturing cost, short service life, high fault and small energy-saving space of the traditional temperature controller.

title_en: Torque pulsation suppression device and method for switched reluctance motor
abstract_en: The application provides a torque pulsation suppression device and a torque pulsation suppression method for a switched reluctance motor, comprising the following steps: acquiring actual current values of each phase of a motor and the absolute position of a rotor; acquiring each opposite feed torque value according to the obtained phase current and the absolute position of the rotor; setting an opening angle, a closing angle and a commutation overlapping angle according to the acquired absolute position of the rotor and the motor characteristics, establishing a cosine type torque distribution function and according to an error coefficient alpha  k  Performing on-line optimization on the cosine type torque distribution function; multiplying the cosine-type torque distribution function optimized on line of each phase with the reference torque to obtain the reference torque of each phase; the motor is controlled by the switch signal, so that the actual phase torque can timely track the reference phase torque, and the control of the motor is completed. The application establishes error coefficient to optimize the torque distribution function on line, and ensures the full speed rangeThe internal motor has the smallest torque pulsation, the torque pulsation can be reduced by more than 40% on the basis of the traditional TSF strategy, and the current peak is greatly reduced while the torque pulsation of the motor is effectively restrained, so that the running efficiency of the motor is improved.

title_en: Coupling transcritical CO 2 SOFC thermal management system with combined heat and power supply
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of SOFC thermal management, and in particular relates to a coupling transcritical CO  2  And a heat management system of the SOFC with combined heat and power supply. Including SOFC thermal management system, transcritical CO  2  The heat and cold combined supply system and the reformer comprise an air preheater, an SOFC electric pile and a afterburner, and a transcritical CO  2  The cold and hot combined supply system comprises a natural gas inlet pipeline and a transcritical CO  2  A circulation system and a mixer; the air preheater is connected with the cathode inlet of the SOFC stack, the anode outlet of the SOFC stack is connected with the heat source inlet of the reformer through the afterburner, and the mixer is respectively connected with the reactant inlet of the reformer, the natural gas inlet pipeline and the transcritical CO  2  The circulation system comprises a circulation system, a control system and a control system,and the obtained natural gas and high-temperature steam are mixed and then input into a reactant inlet of a reformer, and a product outlet of the reformer is connected with an anode inlet of the SOFC stack. The system can efficiently utilize the exhaust fuel of the anode of the SOFC stack, recover the latent heat of exhaust smoke and provide a stable and adjustable steam source, and solves the technical bottleneck existing in the current SOFC thermal management system.

title_en: Fuel cell catalyst, preparation method thereof and fuel cell
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fuel cell catalyst, a preparation method thereof and a fuel cell. The method comprises the following steps: 1) Adding a non-noble metal element precursor into an organic solvent, and uniformly mixing to obtain a mixed solution; 2) Carrying out electrostatic spinning by adopting the mixed solution to obtain a spinning material; 3) Carrying out low-temperature reduction heat treatment on the spinning material in a reducing atmosphere, and then carrying out high-temperature heat treatment in an inert atmosphere; 4) Dispersing the product of the high-temperature heat treatment in an acidic solution in an inert atmosphere, adding a noble metal precursor solution, carrying out a displacement reaction, and then carrying out heat treatment in a reducing atmosphere to obtain the fuel cell catalyst. The method of the invention reduces the cost, improves the bonding strength of the active component and the carrier, and improves the activity and the service life of the active component.

title_en: Photovoltaic backplate spot belt cleaning device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cleaning devices, in particular to a photovoltaic backboard dirt cleaning device which comprises a cleaning tank body, wherein a drain pipe is fixedly arranged on one side of the cleaning tank body, a mounting hole is formed below one end of the cleaning tank body, a trapezoid supporting table is fixedly arranged in the cleaning tank body, fixed bottom blocks are symmetrically and fixedly arranged on two sides of the outer part of the cleaning tank body, protruding battens are symmetrically and fixedly arranged on the cleaning tank body on two sides of the mounting hole, limiting through holes are formed in the protruding battens, a mounting plate frame is fixedly arranged on the cleaning tank body on the upper side of the mounting hole, the traditional manual cleaning mode is changed, the photovoltaic backboard is pushed into the cleaning tank body when being cleaned, the photovoltaic backboard is positioned through a positioning groove plate, then an electric telescopic rod is started to drive a U-shaped water spray pipe to move, two sides of the photovoltaic backboard are cleaned simultaneously, convenience is achieved, manpower is liberated, and meanwhile the cleaning work efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Gas circuit control system, gas circuit control method and battery cell formation equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of new energy power battery automation production lines, in particular to a gas circuit control system, a gas circuit control method and electric core formation equipment. Comprising the following steps: a gas input module and a first control module; the first control module comprises a first gas circuit unit, a first detection unit, a buffer tank, a second gas circuit unit and a second detection unit, wherein the input end of the first gas circuit unit and the input end of the second gas circuit unit are respectively communicated with the output end of the gas input module, and the output end of the first gas circuit unit and the output end of the second gas circuit unit are respectively communicated with the input end of the buffer tank. Therefore, the concentration of hydrogen generated by the battery core at different stages of formation of each charge state is within 25% of the lower explosion limit of the hydrogen, so that explosive gas environments are avoided from being formed inside and outside the gas production collection system.

title_en: Low-voltage distribution network cable-user relationship identification method, device, storage medium and equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a low-voltage distribution network cable-user relationship identification method, a device, a storage medium and equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring fault information of a low-voltage power distribution network line; identifying a target line in the fault information; the target line is a line of which the fault position is positioned on a single-phase line under the branch box; acquiring an electric energy meter with power loss in a target line, and determining a line-to-user relationship according to the target line to which the electric energy meter belongs; acquiring a to-be-identified electric energy meter with the remaining undetermined line-to-user relationship in a low-voltage distribution network line; acquiring voltage time sequence data of each electric energy meter to be identified when the electric energy meter operates normally; clustering voltage time sequence data of each electric energy meter to be identified based on a Hausdroff clustering algorithm; and establishing a 0-1 integer programming model based on the clustering result and solving to obtain the line-family relationship of the electric energy meter to be identified. The method and the device utilize the fault information to identify partial user relations, reduce the data calculation amount of cluster analysis, ensure the identification accuracy and improve the calculation efficiency.

title_en: Winding device for transformer coil production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a winding device for producing a transformer coil, which comprises a bracket and a bearing rod arranged at the upper end of the bracket, wherein a motor is fixed at one side wall of the bracket, the bearing rod and the motor are mutually driven, a collecting roller is fixedly arranged at the side wall of the bearing rod, a transformer wire is wound at the side wall of the collecting roller, a reciprocating screw rod is arranged at one side wall of the transformer wire, a control block is matched and moved at the side wall of the reciprocating screw rod, one end of the reciprocating screw rod far away from the motor is connected with a rotating rod, and the rotating rod penetrates through one side wall of the collecting roller. The invention relates to the technical field of transformer coils; this winding device is used in transformer coil production under the elastic action through the spring for restraint the piece and produce pressure to the lateral wall of transformer line, and then compress tightly the insulating layer that wraps up in on the line body lateral wall, compress together insulating layer and line body all the time, prevent the condition that takes place to loosen.

title_en: Asynchronous motor for electric automobile
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of asynchronous motors, and discloses an asynchronous motor for an electric automobile, which comprises a shell, a stator and a rotating shaft fixedly arranged in a rotor, wherein a plurality of winding parts are arranged on the inner annular surface of the stator, the surfaces of the winding parts are used for winding a winding group, and a first channel is formed in the winding parts; the surface of the shell is provided with a cooling liquid tank, cooling liquid is added into the cooling liquid tank, an output pipe of the cooling liquid tank can be communicated with the first channel, and cooling liquid in the cooling liquid tank can enter the first channel in the stator; this asynchronous motor for electric automobile through the combined design of water conservancy diversion subassembly and stator internal passage one, honeycomb duct, input tube and back flow, can make the coolant liquid in the coolant tank circulate in the casing inside to this liquid cooling heat dissipation that realizes the casing inside is handled, is favorable to improving the radiating effect of casing inside.

title_en: Modbus communication protocol-based voltage control curve transmission method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a voltage control curve transmission method and a system based on a modbus communication protocol, which belong to the technical field of urban rail transit and comprise the following steps: the upper computer transmits the voltage curve to the DSP in a real-time sectionalized and cyclic manner, wherein two arrays are defined in the DSP and are respectively used for storing one section of voltage curve data; the DSP alternately uses the voltage curve data in the two arrays to control the running of the direct current power supply system, and the head address of the other idle array is sent to the upper computer during the period that the DSP uses the voltage curve data of one array; and the upper computer sends a section of new voltage curve data to the DSP by taking the head address as a starting address, and the DSP assigns the section of new voltage curve data to the idle array. The invention ensures that the DSP can continuously receive and use the voltage control curve issued by the upper computer under the limited data storage space.

title_en: Coiling and feeding integrated machine
abstract_en: The application provides a coiling and feeding all-in-one machine, which comprises a supporting device, a coiling device, a feeding device and a rubberizing device, wherein the coiling device comprises a coiling needle assembly and a driving assembly, the coiling needle assembly comprises at least one coiling needle part, the coiling needle part is used for coiling an electric core, and the driving assembly is used for driving the coiling needle part to rotate; the feeding device comprises a storage component and a material taking component, wherein the storage component comprises a storage box, the storage box is used for storing the core rods, the storage box is provided with a material taking opening, and the material taking component is used for taking out the core rods from the storage box; the rubberizing device is used for rubberizing the adhesive tape on the pole piece. Compared with the prior art, the feeding device and the rubberizing device are arranged, the feeding device comprises the storage box and the material taking assembly, the material taking assembly can take the core rods out of the storage box one by one, and the working efficiency is improved; the rubberizing work of pole piece can be accomplished through rubberizing device to this application, places the pole piece on coiling mechanism again, consequently this application need not to use the finished product pole piece that processes, greatly reduced manufacturing cost.

title_en: Heating lens
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lenses, in particular to a heating lens. A heating lens comprises a first lens, a heating plate, a spring plate and a lens cone; the first lens, the heating plate and the elastic sheet are sequentially arranged in the lens cone from top to bottom; the bottom of the heating plate is arranged on the elastic sheet, and the top of the heating plate is abutted against the first lens; the elastic sheet comprises a main body part and supporting legs, and the heating sheet is fixed on the main body part. According to the invention, the elastic sheet is additionally arranged below the heating sheet, so that the heating sheet is conveniently positioned and installed, and the installation is ensured to be in place; according to the invention, the heating plate is fixed on the main body part of the elastic sheet, and the elastic sheet applies elastic force to the heating plate, so that the heating plate always clings to the surface of the lens, and the heating efficiency is improved; the shell fragment passes through the stabilizer blade to be fixed in the lens cone, and the area of contact of stabilizer blade is less to reduce the heat conduction loss downwards that the heating plate produced, promote the heating rate of first lens.

title_en: High-low voltage coupling test equipment for battery pack
abstract_en: The invention discloses high-low voltage coupling test equipment for a battery pack, which relates to the technical field of high-low voltage coupling test for the battery pack, and now proposes a scheme that a shielding shell is internally provided with a ground plane, the top of the ground plane is provided with a low-coherence dielectric constant material, the low-coherence dielectric constant material reduces the dielectric constant of a dielectric material used in an integrated circuit, can reduce the leakage current of the integrated circuit, reduces the capacitance effect between leads and reduces the heating of the integrated circuit, and the top of the low-coherence dielectric constant material is provided with a tested piece; the invention ensures the testing environment through various processes, avoids the influence caused by environmental factors in the testing process, ensures the accuracy and stability of the coupling test, ensures the stability of the test from the aspect of environment, and solves the problem of circuit interference to ensure more stable and accurate testing data through multidirectional power transmission processing from the aspect of power processing.

title_en: Bracket and electric connection assembly
abstract_en: The application provides a support and electrical connection subassembly relates to battery technology field. The bracket comprises a first bracket and a second bracket. The first side of the first bracket is used for installing the CCS component, the second side is connected with the second bracket, the second bracket is provided with a first installation groove used for installing the BMS board, a groove end of the first installation groove is provided with a first notch penetrating through a first side wall of the second bracket, and the first side wall is used for being in contact with the BDU module; the first bracket is provided with a first through hole for electrically connecting the CCS component and the BMS board; the first notch is used for BMS board and BDU module electricity to be connected. This application will be used for installing the support of CCS subassembly and the support integration of installation BMS board, and with BDU module close on the BMS board setting, make the CCS subassembly can be directly with BMS board electricity be connected, and can be connected with BDU module via the BMS board, thereby make the CCS subassembly adopt one set of first output extremely both can realize voltage signal's transmission, can realize high-voltage current's output again, and then simplify the structure of electrical connector and improve assembly efficiency.

title_en: Method for improving current performance index of three-phase grid-connected inverter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving current performance indexes of a three-phase grid-connected inverter, and relates to the technical field of grid connection of photovoltaic power generation. The method comprises the following steps: sampling three-phase currents output by the three-phase grid-connected inverter according to different sampling frequencies respectively to obtain a fundamental wave current signal and a preset frequency current signal; respectively performing signal processing on the fundamental current signal and the preset frequency current signal to obtain fundamental current control quantity based on the fundamental current signal and obtain current control quantity based on a plurality of frequencies of the preset frequency current signal; obtaining a comprehensive control quantity according to the fundamental wave current control quantity and the current control quantity of a plurality of frequencies; sending out an adjusting signal based on the PWM waveform according to the comprehensive control quantity; the invention only uses higher control frequency for the current loop control of the fundamental wave, and other control loops, such as harmonic control, direct current component control and the like, are lowered to lower control frequency, so that the stability of system control and the resource consumption of a CPU can be considered.

title_en: Cable sealing structure of cable branch box
abstract_en: The invention provides a cable sealing structure of a cable branch box, and relates to the field of cable sealing. This cable seal structure based on cable feeder pillar, including burying the feeder pillar, the front side of burying the feeder pillar is equipped with the fixed plate, the rear end fixedly connected with of fixed plate installs the fixed roller, the outside fixedly connected with second seal rubber cover of installation fixed roller, the inside fixedly connected with of front portion of burying the feeder pillar is a plurality of solid fixed ring, gu fixed ring's inboard is equipped with the block groove, the outside of second seal rubber cover is hugged closely in gu fixed ring's inboard, the inside extraction chamber that is equipped with of front side of burying the feeder pillar. Through the notch of burying the feeder pillar front end with the installation fixed roll, the installation is more convenient not only, increases seal structure's life, and sealed effect is better, and the sealing gum accomplishes the seal after accomplishing the drying, not only can protect the junction of cable and feeder pillar, further improves the leakproofness of cable junction more.

title_en: Transformer oil heating device and method and oil immersed transformer
abstract_en: The application relates to a transformer oil heating device and method and an oil immersed transformer. The transformer oil heating device comprises a magnetic shielding silicon steel plate, an induction coil winding, a double-end heating rod, a transformer oil temperature probe, a circuit breaker and a control circuit, when the transformer operates, induced electromotive force can be induced when leakage inductance of one side of the transformer passes through the induction coil winding wound on the magnetic shielding silicon steel plate, the formed induced current enters the double-end heating rod, heat can be generated through the double-end heating rod to heat insulating oil, the insulating oil is prevented from being solidified, the transformer oil temperature probe can monitor the oil temperature of the transformer everywhere, when the transformer oil temperature is too low, the circuit breaker is communicated, heat can be generated through the double-end heating rod to heat the insulating oil, and when the transformer oil temperature is too high, the circuit breaker can be opened to stop heating. Therefore, the oil temperature control of the oil immersed transformer is effectively realized, and the heating efficiency of the transformer insulating oil can be effectively improved through the oil immersed transformer oil temperature control device.

title_en: Membrane electrode cathode catalytic layer and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a membrane electrode cathode catalytic layer and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of fuel cells. The membrane electrode cathode catalytic layer comprises a first catalytic layer and a second catalytic layer which are sequentially laminated; the first catalytic layer comprises a first catalyst and a first ionomer, and the second catalytic layer comprises a second catalyst and a second ionomer; the side chain of the first ionomer has 3-7 carbon atoms and an equivalent molecular weight of 700-1100. The invention adopts the ionomer of the middle-long branched chain with specific side chain carbon atom number and equivalent molecular weight as the ionomer of the first catalytic layer, controls the dispersion pressure when the second catalyst slurry is dispersed, controls the cracking degree of the cathode catalytic layer of the membrane electrode, improves the performance of the membrane electrode, and simultaneously does not cause the accelerated degradation of the local proton exchange membrane in the operation of the fuel cell, thereby ensuring that the service life of the membrane electrode is not influenced.

title_en: Voltage conversion circuit, voltage conversion method and display device
abstract_en: The application relates to a voltage conversion circuit, a voltage conversion method and a display device, wherein the voltage conversion circuit comprises a voltage input end, an inductor, a plurality of control switches and a plurality of voltage conversion units, the voltage conversion units correspond to the control switches one by one, one end of the inductor is electrically connected with the voltage input end, the other end of the inductor is electrically connected with the input end of each control switch, the output end of each control switch is electrically connected with the input end of the corresponding voltage conversion unit, each voltage conversion unit is used for outputting the voltage of the voltage input end after conversion when the corresponding control switch is turned on, and the rest control switches are turned off. Therefore, a single voltage conversion circuit can output driving voltages of a plurality of grades, and a plurality of voltage conversion units for outputting the driving voltages of the plurality of grades are realized to multiplex the same inductor in a time-sharing way, so that the inductance number of the power supply circuit is reduced, the occupied space of the power supply circuit can be reduced, and the cost of the power supply circuit is reduced.

title_en: Power converter and control method of power converter
abstract_en: The application provides a power converter and a control method of the power converter, wherein the power converter comprises a power conversion circuit, an input end of the power conversion circuit is used for being connected with a direct current power supply, an output end of the power conversion circuit is used for being connected with an alternating current load or a power grid, the power conversion circuit comprises a plurality of power bridge arms which are mutually connected in parallel, and the power bridge arms comprise a plurality of switching tubes. A controller in the power converter acquires a high-frequency component in the current of an output end of the power conversion circuit, and adjusts the switching frequency of a switching tube in the power conversion circuit in a first direction in response to the amplitude of the high-frequency component being larger than a preset amplitude. The controller is further configured to adjust the switching frequency of the switching tube of the power conversion circuit in a second direction opposite to the first direction such that the amplitude of the high frequency component is below a preset amplitude in response to the switching frequency of the switching tube in the power conversion circuit increasing or decreasing based on the first direction and the amplitude of the high frequency component increasing. By adopting the method, the power converter can be prevented from being damaged by the excessively high ripple current.

title_en: Method for relieving characteristic value oscillation in small-interference stable constraint optimal power flow model
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for relieving characteristic value oscillation in a small-interference stable constraint optimal power flow model, which comprises the steps of firstly, solving power flow calculation of an initial operating point and carrying out small-interference stable analysis; secondly, constructing a small interference stability constraint which fully considers the influence of steady-state operating point change on the characteristic value; on the basis, a small-interference stable constraint optimal power flow model is established; then, the Lagrangian multiplier method is utilized to process the equality constraint, the external point penalty function method is utilized to process the inequality constraint, and an augmented Lagrangian function is constructed; and finally, realizing simultaneous solving by using a quasi-Newton method. Characteristic value oscillation in the small-interference stable constraint optimal power flow simultaneous solution can be effectively relieved, and the convergence of an algorithm is improved; has the advantages of strong practicability and good effect.

title_en: Monitoring substation creation management method and system based on extraction commonality measuring points
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring substation creation management method and system based on extraction of commonality measuring points, and relates to the technical field of electric power monitoring. The invention improves the information common extraction capability of new energy equipment, reduces redundant work, realizes the efficient monitoring and management of power station equipment, reduces the work load, improves the data processing efficiency, ensures that a monitoring system has more adaptability and intelligence, effectively optimizes the reliability and safety of the monitoring of an electric power system, improves the power supply quality, and brings obvious progress to the operation and maintenance of a transformer substation.

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation system with snow removing function
abstract_en: The application discloses possess photovoltaic power generation system of snow removing function, include: the solar energy power generation device comprises a photovoltaic power generation module and at least one heating module, wherein the photovoltaic power generation module comprises a plurality of photovoltaic modules, and the included angle between each photovoltaic module and the horizontal plane is an acute angle; at least one heating module is arranged on the lower frame of the photovoltaic module; the heating module and the photovoltaic module are independently arranged. Through set up heating module on photovoltaic module's lower frame for when there is snow on the photovoltaic module, open heating module and heat photovoltaic module, so that the snow of photovoltaic module top is the landing in order, high-efficient snow removing. Meanwhile, the heating module and the photovoltaic module are independently arranged, so that the photovoltaic power generation system is more flexible when the heating module is arranged, the heating module can be arranged on the photovoltaic module when the snow removal requirement is met, and the photovoltaic power generation system without the snow removal function can be modified.

title_en: Switching device for automatically adjusting switching of pressing plate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a conversion device for automatically adjusting switching of a pressing plate, which comprises a chassis (1) positioned at a pressing plate base (6), wherein a pressing plate assembly (2) and a driving assembly (3) are arranged on the chassis (1), and the driving assembly (3) drives the pressing plate assembly (2) to rotate; the pressing plate assembly (2) comprises a fixing plate (21), the fixing plate (21) is installed on the chassis (1) through a support (22), a movable pressing plate (23) which is coaxially distributed is arranged below the fixing plate (21), two contact pins (231) are arranged at the bottom of the movable pressing plate (23), and a lifting assembly (4) which drives the movable pressing plate (23) to move up and down is arranged on the fixing plate (21). The invention has the characteristic of automatically controlling switching function conversion.

title_en: Intelligent learning table
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent learning table, which comprises a frame body, an upright post connected with the frame body, a lifting motor connected with the upright post and a table top device, wherein the frame body comprises a bottom plate and a frame extending upwards around the bottom plate; the control terminal APP is used for inputting the required rotating desktop height and rotating angle instruction information; and the intelligent control module is arranged in the cavity of the frame body and comprises a microprocessor unit and a communication unit connected with the microprocessor unit, the communication unit receives instruction information sent by the control terminal APP, and the microprocessor unit carries out data processing on the instruction information received by the communication unit and outputs control information to the lifting motor and the push rod motor.

title_en: Power supply circuit and switching power supply
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply circuit and a switching power supply, wherein the switching power supply is provided with an alternating current input interface, and the power supply circuit comprises: the filter circuit is used for outputting the alternating voltage after the alternating voltage is filtered; the rectification circuit is used for converting the input alternating voltage and outputting direct voltage; the input end of the voltage conversion circuit is electrically connected with the output end of the rectifying circuit, and the voltage conversion circuit is used for carrying out step-up/step-down conversion on the direct-current voltage and then outputting a power supply voltage; the input end of the clamping circuit is electrically connected with the output end of the voltage conversion circuit, and the output end of the clamping circuit is electrically connected with a load; the clamping circuit is used for stabilizing the output voltage. The invention aims to improve the stability of a switching power supply circuit.

title_en: Novel switch structure and air cooling device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel switch structure and an air cooling device, and relates to the technical field of network data hardware. The invention comprises a shell, wherein the front end of the shell is provided with a connecting mechanism, the connecting mechanism can be inserted with a net wire for connecting the net wire, bending and false pulling and falling off of the connecting position of the net wire can be avoided, the bottom of the shell is provided with an air cooling mechanism for carrying out omnibearing heat dissipation on the inside of the shell, and the bottom end of the shell is provided with a mounting seat. The invention can avoid bending the net wires at the joint, lighten the damage of the net wires, limit the crystal head, ensure that the net wires are stably spliced, avoid the falling off and the false pulling of the net wires even if the buckle on the crystal head fails or breaks, uniformly dissipate heat in the switch, simultaneously avoid the problems that the gas at the stacking position of the electronic components in the shell cannot flow effectively and the heat is easy to accumulate, and improve the heat dissipation effect.

title_en: Recovery method of bending limiter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recovery method of a bending limiter, which comprises the steps of pre-installing an automatic induction lock catch on the bending limiter, controlling the locking and unlocking of the bending limiter through the automatic induction lock catch, connecting the free end of lifting equipment on an operation and maintenance ship with the bending limiter, lowering the bending limiter together with a rush-repair joint, when the rush-repair joint is lowered to a designated depth on the sea floor, bouncing off the automatic induction lock catch on the bending limiter, continuing to lower a sea cable, automatically separating from the bending limiter, and finally pulling the separated bending limiter up to the operation and maintenance ship through the lifting equipment, thereby completing recovery operation. The invention realizes the recycling of the bending limiter, obviously reduces the cost of the rush-repair joint and avoids waste.

title_en: Method for reducing vacuum baking time of lithium battery
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a method for reducing the vacuum baking time of a lithium battery, which comprises the following steps of S1, preheating a vacuum oven, and setting a preheating temperature range; s2, loading the materials into an empty oven when the preheating temperature range is reached; s3, continuously heating, vacuumizing to reach a first pressure value and continuously heating for a first time; s4, adding inert gas for heating until the vacuum degree reaches a second pressure value; s5, baking the materials, vacuumizing to set the high vacuum degree as a third pressure value, and enabling the vacuum oven to reach the lowest vacuum degree as a fourth pressure value, wherein the fourth pressure value is larger than the third pressure value. S6, blowing inert gas to break vacuum, wherein the vacuum degree is 75000-85000Pa, and the holding time is 15-20min; s7, cooling the material, vacuumizing to reach a first pressure value, then continuously vacuumizing for a second time, stopping, and blowing normal-temperature inert gas for cooling; s8, vacuum storing the materials; the vacuum pumping can be continued as required, and then inert gas is continuously blown in, so that the problem of reducing the vacuum baking time of the lithium battery is solved.

title_en: Electrolyte additive, electrolyte, battery and electricity utilization device
abstract_en: The application discloses an electrolyte additive, an electrolyte, a battery and an electric device, wherein the electrolyte additive comprises a first additive, a second additive and a third additive, the structural formula of the first additive is shown as a formula I, the second additive comprises a sulfonate lactone compound, the structural formula of the third additive is shown as a formula II, wherein R is  1  、R  2  、R  3  And R is  4  Each independently comprises an alkyl or alkenyl group, M comprising an alkyl group of 2 to 10 carbon atoms or an o=c=n-substituted alkyl group of 2 to 10 carbon atoms. Therefore, the electrolyte additive is added into the lithium ion battery, so that the gas production of the battery can be reduced, and the improvement of the gas production of the battery can be realizedThe high-temperature cycle performance and the high-temperature storage performance of the battery reduce the impedance of the battery.

title_en: Three-dimensional multiport direct current hub substation topological structure
abstract_en: A stereoscopic multi-port direct current junction substation topology comprising: the first MMC converter, the intermediate frequency transformer and a plurality of second converter modules with different voltage levels; the direct current port of the first MMC converter is connected with a high-voltage direct current power grid or a new energy direct current output port, and the alternating current port of the first MMC converter is connected with the primary side of the intermediate frequency transformer; the secondary side of the intermediate frequency transformer is connected with an alternating current port of the second converter module; the direct current ports of the second current conversion modules with different voltage levels are connected in series and then connected into a direct current power grid; the intermediate frequency transformers are consistent with the second converter modules in number; the capacity of the first MMC converter is larger than that of the second converter module. The invention adopts a plurality of second current transformation modules with different voltage levels, further has a plurality of ports with different direct current voltage levels, is easy to expand the ports, can realize fault isolation, and meets the technical requirements of high-voltage high-capacity direct current hub transformer stations for realizing new energy collection access, direct current power grid access, load power supply and the like.

title_en: High-protection generator
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of generators, in particular to a high-protection generator which comprises a wind power generation mechanism, an airflow blowing mechanism arranged on the wind power generation mechanism and a dust filtering mechanism arranged on the airflow blowing mechanism. The traction frame can carry out reciprocating lifting movement along the inner cavity of the base, the two end plates pushed by the traction frame can drive the combined clamping seat and the partition plate to stretch, the eccentric rotary disc movably mounted on the clamping assisting rod can rotate in cooperation with the elastic force of the first tension spring, the fan blade shaft rod positioned in the middle of the inner cavity of the base can blow air flow inside the air bin towards the inside of the drainage cover, finally, filtered air flow can be subjected to comprehensive cooling treatment against the split disc rotor and the split intermediate stator, and at the moment, the disc rotor and the intermediate stator in the closed cavity inside the shell can be in a constant temperature state without being influenced by outside air temperature, and meanwhile, the constant temperature operation of the disc rotor and the intermediate stator does not need to consume extra kinetic energy.

title_en: Glass powder for preparing TOPCON battery silver paste, silver paste and preparation method of glass powder
abstract_en: The invention provides glass powder and silver paste for preparing TOPCO battery silver paste and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of glass powder preparation, wherein glass powder comprises various oxides, and the oxides comprise: 5-10 parts of bismuth oxide, 30-40 parts of lead oxide, 25-40 parts of tellurium oxide, 0-20 parts of silicon oxide, 2-4 parts of zinc oxide, 1-3 parts of lithium oxide and 5-20 parts of boron oxide; magnesium oxide, calcium oxide, sodium oxide, aluminum oxide and copper oxide, wherein four or five of the magnesium oxide, the calcium oxide, the sodium oxide, the aluminum oxide and the copper oxide account for 4-10 parts, and all the components in the glass powder account for 100 parts; 60-80 parts of lead oxide and tellurium oxide in the glass powder; boron oxide: lead oxide: tellurium oxide=1-4: 3-8:2-7.

title_en: Doped multi-layer coated iron phosphate-based sodium ion battery positive electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a doped multilayer coated iron phosphate-based sodium ion battery anode material and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following contents: ball-milling and mixing ferric phosphate dihydrate, carbon source, dispersing agent and solvent to obtain precursor slurryMaterial preparation; drying and grinding, and then sintering at high temperature in inert atmosphere to obtain Fe  3  (PO  4  )  2  @C; mixing it with Ti  3  AlC  2  Mixing sodium source, lithium source, fluorine source and acid, and adding Fe  3  (PO  4  )  2  In situ growth of Ti  3  C  2  AlF (aluminum foil)  3  Forming a coating; and (5) sintering in an inert atmosphere after drying and grinding, and grinding to obtain the composite material. The method presinteres ferric phosphate dihydrate and carbon source at high temperature, increases graphitization degree of coated carbon, and utilizes in-situ grown Ti  3  C  2  AlF (aluminum foil)  3  The nano sheet is coated, meanwhile, part of lithium element is doped, and a three-dimensional structure is formed after sintering, so that the electron conductivity of the material can be improved, agglomeration of the material in the drying and sintering processes is effectively prevented, ion transmission is accelerated, loss of sodium ions in the charging and discharging processes can be reduced, and the electrochemical performance is improved.

title_en: Battery, heat conduction device and battery module
abstract_en: The application relates to a battery, a heat conduction device and a battery module. The battery according to the present application has a heat conduction device including a heat conduction rod and a base having heat conductivity formed at one end of the heat conduction rod, the heat conduction rod being inserted into a central hole in the center of a cell of the battery, and the base being located at the other end of the cell in the axial direction in a state in which the heat conduction rod is inserted into the central hole, whereby heat generated inside the cell is conducted to the outside of the battery using the heat conduction device. The battery module is constructed by disposing a plurality of batteries having heat conduction devices on a cooling plate and bringing the bases of the heat conduction devices into contact with the cooling plate. According to the battery, the heat conduction device and the battery module, the heat conduction device can be utilized to directly cool the inside of the battery, so that the cooling efficiency of the battery is remarkably improved, and the energy density of the whole battery module can be improved.

title_en: Power distribution cabinet
abstract_en: The invention provides an outdoor power distribution cabinet, and relates to the technical field of power distribution cabinets.
