An outdoor power distribution cabinet comprising: the power distribution cabinet comprises a power distribution cabinet shell, a power distribution cabinet and a power distribution cabinet, wherein an air inlet and an air outlet are formed in the power distribution cabinet shell, and a plurality of supporting plates for fixedly mounting electric elements are arranged in the power distribution cabinet shell; the air inlet fan is used for extracting air outside the power distribution cabinet shell, so that the air can cool electric elements in the power distribution cabinet shell to form high-temperature air flow; an air outlet fan; the storage shell is internally stored with a collapsible liquid, the collapsible liquid can expand with heat and contract with cold along with the temperature change, and the collapsible liquid is heated to enable the air outlet fan to discharge high-temperature air flow out of the power distribution cabinet shell; the driving mechanism can drive the air outlet fan to turn over towards the inside of the power distribution cabinet shell when the collapsible liquid is cooled and contracted, and the driving mechanism and the air inlet fan form air internal circulation and can simultaneously close the air inlet and the air outlet. The invention has the advantages of improving the timeliness and stability of the temperature regulation in the power distribution cabinet shell, and being beneficial to the normal power supply of the power distribution cabinet.

title_en: Heating wire wave-regulating control method and device, heating wire control system and blower
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of heating wire control methods, and provides a heating wire wave-regulating control method, a heating wire wave-regulating control device, a heating wire control system and a blower, wherein the control method comprises the following steps: acquiring a preset driving period of heating wire wave regulation driving, wherein the driving period comprises a plurality of half-waves and a plurality of Guan Banbo which are uniformly staggered; determining a target small period and a target half-wave in the driving period according to the driving period and the target duty ratio; and inserting a target half wave at the end of the target small period to generate a new driving period so as to drive the heating wire. According to the method, the closed or opened target half wave is inserted periodically in the driving period of the heating wire, so that the generation of the second harmonic wave can be interrupted, the function of reducing the harmonic impact of the whole product machine to the power grid is realized, the EMC of the whole product machine is ensured to meet the national regulations, meanwhile, the hardware of the product is not required to be increased, the production cost of the product is effectively controlled, and the market competitiveness is improved.

title_en: Hydrophilic corrosion-resistant LaPO 4 Preparation method and application of interface layer modified zinc metal anode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrophilic corrosion-resistant LaPO  4  Preparation method and application of interface layer modified zinc metal anode, aiming at the problems of hydrogen evolution and zinc corrosion side reaction, serious and uncontrollable zinc dendrite growth caused by zinc and electrolyte in water-based electrolyte of pure zinc metal anode, hydrophilic corrosion-resistant LaPO is adopted  4  And the interface layer is modified to improve the comprehensive electrochemical performance of the zinc anode. Spherical LaPO  4  LaPO of particle composition  4  The interface layer has excellent hydrophilicity and rich porosity, can play the role of a reservoir, inhibit the activity of water in the zinc anode interface electrolyte, and weaken the reactivity of water and a zinc anode, thereby inhibiting electrochemical hydrogen evolution and zinc corrosion side reactions of the zinc anode interface. Furthermore, laPO  4  The interface can also inhibit two-dimensional diffusion of zinc ions at the interface, induce uniform zinc deposition, avoid zinc dendrite generation and realize development of long-cycle-life zinc anode.

title_en: Polyolefin microporous membrane and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a polyolefin microporous membrane, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the polyolefin microporous membrane comprises a core layer and a surface layer arranged on the surface of the core layer, the average value of the micropore length and diameter of the surface layer is D1, the average pore diameter of the polyolefin microporous membrane is D0, and the ratio of D1 to D0 is more than or equal to 6. The average value of the long diameter of the surface layer and the average pore diameter of the polyolefin microporous membrane are larger than or equal to 6, so that the surface layer has higher wettability relative to the core layer, the polar adhesive is facilitated to infiltrate and spread at the surface layer of the membrane, the peeling strength of the polyolefin microporous membrane is facilitated to be improved, and therefore, the surface modification of the membrane is facilitated and the influence on the cycle performance of the secondary battery is avoided.

title_en: Special channel and sealing structure for gas tank of gas insulated switchgear
abstract_en: The invention discloses a special channel and a sealing structure for a gas tank of gas-insulated switchgear. The special structure is connected with an air chamber inside the switch equipment air box. When the special structure of the invention is adopted, components in the gas tank can be arranged in the gas tank from the outside of the gas tank from a special channel after the gas tank of the switch equipment is welded, and after the components in the gas tank are arranged, the installation channel holes are covered by the sealing plate, and 4 metal cooling fins are arranged on the sealing plate, thereby realizing the technical requirements of the gas tank protection grade IP65 of the environment-friendly gas-insulated metal-enclosed switch equipment and the technical requirements of temperature rise under 1.1 times of rated current.

title_en: Preparation method of coated composite current collector film
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electronic materials, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a coated composite current collector film. The preparation method provided by the invention is that a polypropylene porous membrane is placed in a polymer gel catalytic solution, under the assistance of ultrasonic waves, a pore is filled by a dipping and pulling method, the coating of a catalytic adhesive layer on the polypropylene film is realized, and then a copper layer is prepared on the catalytic adhesive layer by using chemical plating and electroplating processes, so that the coated composite current collector film is obtained. Thickness of the composite current collector filmThe degree is less than or equal to 6 mu m, and the conductivity is more than or equal to 3.51X10  5  S/cm, 2X 2mm by confocal laser microscopy  2  The surface roughness of the coated composite current collector film is Ra less than or equal to 0.3 mu m and Rz less than or equal to 0.8 mu m. Through the test of a lithium ion battery test system, the discharge capacity is more than or equal to 90% of the initial capacity after 1000 cycles are realized at 25 ℃ and at 1C charge-discharge rate and 100% discharge depth and 2 atmospheres.

title_en: Speed-adjustable transformer winder and winding method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a winding method of a speed-adjustable transformer winder, which comprises a tower structure and a drill rod member, wherein a driving mechanism assembled by bolts is arranged on the inner side of the tower structure. The device mainly utilizes the threaded assembling pipe which is in threaded connection with the bottom end of the main body of the drill rod, the threaded assembling pipe is connected with the upper drill bit by utilizing the threaded interface, the drill rod can be assembled quickly, the top side of the main body of the drill rod is provided with the annular groove, the protruding ring block of the lengthened drill rod can be spliced when the main body of the drill rod rotates at a high speed, the working efficiency and lengthening operation are ensured, the inner side of the lengthened drill rod is provided with the fixed cylinder component, the cylinder can be fixedly spliced on the inner side of the top of the main body of the drill rod by utilizing the hinged structure under the action of output power, and the lengthening firm strength is improved, so that the effect of lengthening connection can be achieved when the device still works, and the device cannot fall off.

title_en: Deicing device for high-voltage line
abstract_en: The application discloses high-voltage wire deicing device, which comprises a support body, wherein the support body comprises a left hoop and a right hoop, the left hoop and the right hoop are connected, and a clearance space for penetrating a high-voltage wire is formed between the left hoop and the right hoop; at least two groups of clamping moving assemblies are connected to the support body, and the single clamping moving assemblies are respectively used for clamping the high-voltage wire; one side of the support body is connected with an ice breaking assembly, and the ice breaking assembly is used for hammering and cleaning an ice layer on the high-voltage wire; the invention solves the problem that the existing deicing equipment cannot pass when encountering frozen blocks which are difficult to clean.

title_en: Thermal control method for thermal power generation planning curve examination of day-free reduction of thermal power generation
abstract_en: The thermal control method for checking the thermal power generation schedule curve of the thermal power generation and the daily power generation is avoided comprises the following control steps: step1, adding a clock synchronization plug-in; step2, dividing a front-end control method for reducing the assessment cost of a daily power generation plan curve of the thermal power into a power grid frequency normal time and a power grid frequency abnormal time, and adopting a data analysis method to judge whether the whole point value of every 5 minutes is assessed or not and controlling in advance; step3, calculating a power deviation signal and a time deviation signal, wherein the power deviation signal is a deviation value between actual power and a power instruction, and the time deviation signal is a difference value between actual time and the whole point of the next 5 minutes; when the time deviation is activated and the power deviation signal is activated, the power deviation signal is modified by the time deviation signal and the piecewise function and then acts on the comprehensive valve position command to act on the valve of the steam turbine. By setting a front-end control strategy for reducing the evaluation cost of the daily power generation planning curve of the thermal power, the post analysis type is improved to front-end control, the process is corrected, and the post-optimized daily power generation planning curve is evaluated.

title_en: Low-moisture high-heat-resistance ceramic coating diaphragm and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-moisture high-heat-resistance ceramic coating diaphragm and a preparation method thereof, wherein the coating diaphragm comprises a diaphragm base film and a coating coated on the base film, and the coating is formed by drying after being coated by ceramic coating slurry; the ceramic coating slurry comprises the following components: the modified boehmite comprises silane modified boehmite, a binder A, a binder B, a thickener, a dispersing agent and a wetting agent; the content of each component is calculated by mass parts, and the silane modified boehmite: binder a: binder B: and (3) a thickening agent: dispersant = 100: (3-8): (0.3 to 0.8): (0.2-1): (0.5-2), wherein the content of the wetting agent is 0.1-0.5% of the total mass of the ceramic coating slurry. According to the invention, long-chain silane coupling agent and short-chain double bond-containing silane coupling agent are adopted in ceramic coating slurry to blend and modify boehmite and alkyl modified hydrophobic sodium carboxymethyl cellulose, and the hydrophobic effect of the boehmite and sodium carboxymethyl cellulose is enhanced by utilizing the hydrophobic effect of alkyl, so that the water content of the ceramic coating diaphragm is reduced, and the heat resistance of the ceramic coating diaphragm is improved.

title_en: Explosion venting structure and energy storage equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of explosion venting and discloses an explosion venting structure and energy storage equipment. Through the mode, the embodiment of the invention can realize the bidirectional opening of the explosion venting channel, when the device is matched with the box body structure and the battery for use, the explosion venting channel can be opened from inside to outside and timely venting and explosion can be avoided when the battery is in thermal runaway and exceeds the preset pressure, and the explosion venting channel can be opened from outside to inside for water injection when the battery is not in thermal runaway and does not exceed the preset pressure so as to shorten the emergency disposal time and reduce the probability of explosion.

title_en: Ultraviolet lamp group control circuit and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an ultraviolet lamp group control circuit and a system, wherein the circuit comprises a controller, the controller is electrically connected with a switch circuit, and the switch circuit is electrically connected with N ultraviolet lamp groups; the N ultraviolet lamp groups are electrically connected with the dimming circuit, and the input end of the dimming circuit is electrically connected with the controller; the dimming circuit is used for adjusting the power of the N ultraviolet lamp groups, and the switching circuit is used for controlling the working state of each ultraviolet lamp group; wherein each ultraviolet lamp group comprises a plurality of ultraviolet lamps, and N is more than or equal to 1. The controller controls the switching circuit to selectively turn on a part of the ultraviolet lamp groups or turn on all the ultraviolet lamp groups. In the case where only a part of the ultraviolet lamp group needs to be turned on, the part of the ultraviolet lamp group is turned off, thereby reducing power consumption. The controller controls the dimming circuit, so that the power of the ultraviolet lamp group in the working state is regulated, the ultraviolet lamp group is prevented from being too low or too high, and the device is suitable for different application scenes.

title_en: Ultraviolet light curing silver paste for flexible printed circuit and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: An ultraviolet light curing silver paste for a flexible printed circuit relates to the technical field of low-temperature curing conductive silver paste, and comprises silver powder, an organic carrier and an auxiliary agent, wherein the silver powder is a conductive functional phase, mainly comprises sheet silver powder and/or silver-coated copper powder, and can be additionally added with one or more of spherical silver powder, dendritic silver powder, silver-coated aluminum powder, silver-coated nickel powder and silver-coated carbon powder; the organic carrier consists of light-cured resin, photoinitiator and non-light-cured resin, wherein the light-cured resin consists of acrylic resin monomer and acrylic resin high molecular weight polymer in a mass ratio of 5-30: 70-95% of photo initiator, wherein the dosage of the photo initiator is 0.5-10% of the mass of the photo-curing resin, and the dosage of the non-photo-curing resin is 0-15% of the mass of the photo-curing resin; the silver paste can be quickly cured at room temperature under ultraviolet light without heating, can be surface cured within 10 seconds and deeply and completely cured within 10-15 minutes, and the volume resistivity of the silver paste prepared by the formula and the preparation method is generally not higher than 7X 10  ‑7  omega-m.

title_en: Preparation method of lithium bis (fluorosulfonyl) imide
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of lithium ion battery electrolyte preparation, and in particular relates to a preparation method of lithium bis (fluorosulfonyl) imide, which comprises the steps of reacting a lithium source with bis (chlorosulfonyl) imide to obtain the bis (chlorosulfonyl) imide lithium; and (3) reacting the lithium bis (chlorosulfonyl) imide with a fluorination reagent to obtain lithium bis (fluorosulfonyl) imide. The invention provides a new synthetic route of lithium difluorosulfimide, and the lithium difluorosulfimide is prepared by adopting the modes of lithiation and fluoridation, can be performed under mild reaction conditions, does not need to use high-temperature hydrogen fluoride, and has the advantages of simple process, low energy consumption and high safety.

title_en: Battery module
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a battery module including: a battery cell stack including a plurality of battery cells; and a module case covering the outside of the battery cell stack. The module housing includes: a first housing including a rib and a first coupling portion, the first coupling portion having a thickness greater than that of the rib, and the first coupling portion being connected to a side surface of the rib; a second housing including a second coupling portion facing an upper portion of the rib and a side surface of the first coupling portion; a tunnel portion formed between the rib portion, the first coupling portion, and the second coupling portion; and a welded portion formed by welding boundary regions of the first and second joining portions.

title_en: Electric wire fixing device of power transmission and transformation circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric wire fixing device of a power transmission and transformation line, and particularly relates to the field of electric wire fixing. According to the invention, the distance between the two arc limiting plates is driven to be adjusted, so that the two sides of the electric wire inside the annular bracket can be limited and pressed, and in actual use, the electric wire can be adjusted in real time according to the specification of the electric wire, so that the electric wire is higher in overall practicability and convenient to operate.

title_en: Over-current protection energy storage cabinet and control method
abstract_en: The application provides an over-current protection energy storage cabinet and a control method. The explosion fuse is used for disconnecting the plurality of battery packs from the power converter when the current value of the direct current end of the power converter is greater than or equal to the first current threshold value. By adopting the application, when the current value of the direct current end of the power converter is overlarge, the electric connection between the plurality of battery packs and the power converter can be disconnected in time, the circuit protection device has small volume and high response speed, and meanwhile, the safety of the system is improved, the structure is simple, the design cost is low, and the applicability is strong.

title_en: Optical wavelength conversion structure
abstract_en: A light wavelength conversion structure includes a substrate, a reflective layer, an oxide stack layer, and a wavelength conversion layer. The reflecting layer is arranged on the substrate. The oxide stack layer is disposed on the reflective layer. The oxide stack has a gas barrier index of about 300 to 1000, and the gas barrier index is defined as Where L is the thickness, d is the density, and n is the number of layers. The wavelength conversion layer is disposed on the oxide stack layer.

title_en: Electrode assembly, battery pack including the same, and vehicle
abstract_en: An electrode assembly, a battery pack including the battery, and a vehicle are disclosed. One end of the electrode assembly includes: a plurality of segment alignment units in which a plurality of segment groups are aligned in a radial direction; and an electrolyte impregnation portion in which an end of the active material portion between the segment alignment units adjacent in the circumferential direction is exposed between the convolutions of the separator, wherein the segments included in the segment alignment units form a bending surface region, and the end of the separator may be spaced apart from a reference line extending in the winding axis direction along a position corresponding to a cutting groove between the segments by a distance of not more than 30% of a minimum height of the segments forming the bending surface region.

title_en: Preparation method of high-specific-surface-area current collector
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a high-specific-surface current collector, which comprises the following steps: s1, providing a smooth metal foil; s2, treating the smooth metal foil by adopting two high-energy physical discharge processes to obtain a semi-finished metal foil; and S3, sequentially carrying out thermal acid treatment, cleaning and drying on the semi-finished metal foil to obtain the metal foil with the high specific surface area. Compared with the smooth metal foil, the specific surface area of the high-specific-surface metal foil prepared by the invention is increased by 10% or more, and the tensile strength is reduced by 3% or less.

title_en: Busbar and capacitor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a busbar and a capacitor, wherein the busbar comprises a busbar body; the busbar body has electrode terminals connected to the electrodes of the capacitor core and connection terminal portions connectable to external terminals; the connecting terminal part comprises a welding area and an overlapping area overlapped with the insulating sheet; the overlapping area is provided with a hollowed-out structure so that the connecting terminal part has elasticity and the welding area is suitable for being attached and welded with an external terminal. The hollow structure is arranged on the overlapping area of the connecting terminal part, so that the elasticity of the connecting terminal part can be improved, and when the connecting terminal part is connected with an external terminal, the welding area and the external terminal are easily pressed and bonded and welded, so that the connecting terminal is suitable for laser welding and bonding the busbar, and the requirement on dimensional accuracy is reduced; and the hollow structure can reduce heat conduction to the insulating sheet, so that the performance of the insulating sheet is prevented from being damaged.

title_en: Multi-sensor data acquisition system and method for safe transmission
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of data acquisition and provides a multi-sensor data acquisition system for safe transmission, which comprises an acquisition device and a sliding rail mechanism, wherein the acquisition device comprises a shell, a shell cavity is formed in the shell, the shell cavity is communicated with the bottom wall of the shell through more than two access channels, a driving mechanism, more than two sensor bodies and more than two electric connectors are arranged in the shell cavity, all the sensor bodies are connected with the driving mechanism, all the electric connectors are fixedly connected to the rear wall of the shell cavity, an electric connecting groove is formed in the electric connector, an electric connecting plug is fixedly connected to the sensor bodies, the electric connecting plug is inserted into the electric connecting groove, two moving mechanisms are fixedly connected to the top wall of the shell, and each moving mechanism comprises a third rotating shaft, a driving wheel, an extending plate and a driven wheel. The invention can collect data from multiple directions.

title_en: Toilet capable of recording urine volume and preventing falling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of toilets, and discloses a toilet capable of recording urine volume and preventing falling, which comprises the following components: the closestool body, the chamber of accepting has been seted up to the inside of closestool body, accept the inside in chamber and be provided with the interim mechanism of accepting of excrement and artifical urine volume urine color detection mechanism respectively, and the interim mechanism of accepting of excrement is located the rear of accepting the intracavity portion, and artifical urine volume urine color detection mechanism is located the place ahead of accepting the intracavity portion, the inside of closestool body is provided with electronic type urine volume urine color detection mechanism, one side of artifical urine volume urine color detection mechanism is provided with siphon liquid discharge mechanism, sampling auxiliary mechanism is installed to one side of water tank. This can remember urine volume prevents closestool that tumbles can measure the urine volume through manual type urine volume urine look detection mechanism and electronic type urine volume urine look detection mechanism, makes things convenient for the urine sample, avoids the patient to use squatting toilet or urinal to cause squatting down for a long time to arouse leg sour and vertigo, reduces the physical demands when defecating, avoids tumbling easily.

title_en: Battery cell pairing system, battery production system and battery cell pairing method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a battery cell pairing system, a battery production system and a battery cell pairing method. The conveyor line is configured to convey the first cell and the second cell. The battery pack is configured to receive the first battery cell and the second battery cell and to group the first battery cell and the second battery cell into a battery cell pack. The first flipping mechanism is configured to selectively flip the first cells of the battery cell stack. The pairing mechanism is configured to pair a first cell and a second cell of the cell group to form a pairing group, and the pairing group comprises a first part and a second part which are adjacently arranged. The second flipping mechanism is configured to selectively flip the first portion of the mating group. The rotation mechanism is configured to rotate the first portion or the second portion. The battery cell pair lug pairing and the battery cell pair lug quadrupole pairing can be compatible, the production cost is reduced, and automation is facilitated, so that the pairing efficiency of the battery cells is improved.

title_en: Plug-in waterproof power supply
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pluggable waterproof power supply, which comprises a power supply fixing seat, wherein a first accommodating groove is formed in the top of the power supply fixing seat, and a first connecting column is further connected in the first accommodating groove; a first mounting hole penetrating to the bottom of the first connecting column is formed in the top of the first connecting column, and a first clamping block is further connected to the inner wall of the first mounting hole; the outer wall of the female needle seat is provided with a first clamping groove; the female needle seat is arranged in the first mounting hole and is clamped with the first connecting column through the first clamping block and the first clamping groove. The invention utilizes the mechanical structure of the round axle center rotary buckle to realize the rapid assembly of the power supply, adopts a rotary plug mode to realize the electrical communication between the power supply male needle seat and the female needle seat arranged on the surface of the lamp body, can facilitate the disassembly and repair in the later period, and can reduce the volume and the packaging cost of the whole lamp, thereby leading the wiring and the later maintenance of the power supply of the lamp to be simpler and more convenient.

title_en: Rotating speed control method and device of permanent magnet synchronous motor, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a rotating speed control method, a rotating speed control device, electronic equipment and a storage medium of a permanent magnet synchronous motor, wherein the method and the rotating speed control device are applied to the electronic equipment for controlling the permanent magnet synchronous motor, and particularly, a disturbance estimation model constructed based on an improved motor motion equation considering system disturbance is utilized to process nominal parameters, control parameters and monitoring parameters of the permanent magnet synchronous motor, so as to obtain a total load disturbance estimation value of a speed ring of the permanent magnet synchronous motor; correcting the nominal load torque of the permanent magnet synchronous motor based on the total load disturbance estimated value to obtain the real-time electromagnetic torque of the permanent magnet synchronous motor; and (3) performing rotational speed control on the permanent magnet synchronous motor based on the real-time electromagnetic torque. According to the scheme, through the online feedforward processing of the system disturbance of the rotating speed control ring, the working condition adaptability of the speed ring control strategy is improved, the calibration workload is reduced, and the defect that a permanent magnet synchronous motor needs repeated calibration by a user in the later use process is avoided.

title_en: Silicon-carbon composite anode material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of lithium batteries, and particularly discloses a silicon-carbon composite anode material and a preparation method and application thereof. The silicon-carbon composite anode material comprises a silicon-carbon substrate and a polymer coating layer coated on the surface of the silicon-carbon substrate; wherein the polymer comprises at least one of polyaniline, polycarbazole, polythiophene, polypyrrole, polythiophene and polyaromatic amine. According to the silicon-carbon composite anode material provided by the application, the polymer coating layer is coated on the surface of the silicon-carbon substrate, so that the volume expansion and shrinkage of silicon-carbon particles in the silicon-carbon substrate in the lithium ion intercalation/deintercalation cycle process are effectively relieved, the combination of the silicon-carbon particles is maintained, the performance of the silicon-carbon composite anode material is improved, and the conductivity and the cycle stability of the silicon-carbon composite anode material are improved.

title_en: Dimming method, dimming system, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a dimming method, a dimming system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of image pickup equipment. The light-emitting component is in communication connection with the soft light plate with adjustable atomization degree, and the soft light plate is arranged on the light-emitting side of the light-emitting component. The luminous component can determine the luminous parameter compensation quantity of the luminous component according to the atomization degree adjustment quantity by acquiring the atomization degree adjustment quantity of the electric control atomization film, and adjust the luminous parameter of the luminous component according to the luminous parameter compensation quantity of the luminous component. Namely, after the atomization degree of the soft light plate is adjusted, the luminous component can correspondingly and automatically adjust the luminous parameters according to the atomization degree adjustment amount so as to automatically compensate the luminous parameters of the light rays passing through the soft light plate, so that the luminous parameters of the light rays passing through the soft light plate are consistent with the target luminous parameters of the predetermined light rays, manual adjustment of a user is not needed, the operation is convenient, and the shooting requirement of a fast rhythm can be met.

title_en: Prussian blue with low defects, derivative thereof and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a preparation method of low-defect Prussian blue and derivatives thereof, which comprises the following steps: providing a sample of crystal water to be removed, mixing the sample of crystal water to be removed with water-absorbent resin, and fully reacting to obtain low-defect Prussian blue and derivatives thereof for removing crystal water, wherein the sample of crystal water to be removed is at least one of Prussian blue and Prussian blue derivatives. The application uses the water-absorbent resin to dehydrate Prussian blue and derivatives thereof, and reduces the water content in the crystal lattices of the Prussian blue and derivatives thereof by means of low cost and low energy consumption, thereby reducing the defects caused by crystal lattice water and preparing the low-defect Prussian blue and derivatives thereof. The Prussian blue and the Prussian blue derivative prepared by the method have the advantages of low lattice water content and low crystal structure defect, so that the Prussian blue and the Prussian blue derivative have higher specific capacity, and the sodium ion battery prepared by the Prussian blue and the Prussian blue derivative has higher performance.

title_en: Rocker connector
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rocker connector, which comprises a wire end assembly and a plate end assembly, wherein the wire end assembly comprises a first shell, a mounting seat, a wire end terminal and a rocker, the first shell is provided with a mounting cavity, the mounting seat is connected with the first shell and is arranged in the mounting cavity, the wire end terminal is arranged on the mounting seat, the rocker is rotationally connected with the first shell, the front end of the rocker is provided with a ratchet part, a first limit rib is formed in the mounting cavity, a first limit part matched with the first limit rib is formed on the mounting seat, and a second limit rib is formed on the first shell. The board end assembly comprises a second shell and a board end terminal, the second shell comprises a containing cavity and a ratchet groove, the board end terminal is arranged in the containing cavity, a limiting groove matched with the second limiting rib is formed in the containing cavity, the movement of the installation seat is limited through the first limiting rib and the first limiting portion, the movement of the line end assembly is limited through the second limiting rib and the limiting groove, and further the smoothness of the line end assembly and the board end assembly during plugging is guaranteed.

title_en: Through-wall sealing electric connector with jack contact
abstract_en: The application provides a through-wall sealing electric connector with jack contacts, which belongs to the technical field of sealing electric connector mechanisms and electric connection, and particularly comprises a glass sintering assembly, a plurality of switching assemblies and a plurality of jack assemblies, wherein the switching assemblies are fixed on a plate-shaped glass insulator, the two ends of each switching assembly are connected with the jack assemblies, the jack assemblies are positioned at the end parts of two end faces of a disc shell and are used for forming electric connection with an external electric connector.

title_en: Control method, system and device of ultrasonic motor and computer program product
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a control method, a control system, a control device and a computer program product of an ultrasonic motor, and relates to the technical field of motor control. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: in a starting stage, determining a first driving parameter based on first friction force data of the ultrasonic motor, and generating a driving signal of the ultrasonic motor based on the first driving parameter; determining a second driving parameter based on at least the reference position information and the measured position information of the ultrasonic motor load, determining a driving stage compensation parameter based on the second friction force data of the ultrasonic motor in the driving stage, and generating a driving signal of the ultrasonic motor based on the second driving parameter and the driving stage compensation parameter; and in the setting stage, determining a third driving parameter based on the reference position information and the measured position information of the load, determining a setting stage compensation parameter based on third friction force data of the ultrasonic motor in the setting stage, and generating a driving signal of the ultrasonic motor based on the third driving parameter and the setting stage compensation parameter.

title_en: Preparation method of TOPcon battery front silver paste
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of front silver paste of a TOPcon battery, which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 78-85 parts of negative charge silver powder, 1.5-3 parts of modified glass powder and 10-18 parts of organic adhesive; the method comprises the following steps: mixing negative charge silver powder, modified glass powder and an organic adhesive, uniformly stirring, grinding to fineness of less than 10 mu m, filtering by a filter cloth with 250-450 meshes, dispersing for 10-30min by a high-speed dispersing machine, and uniformly dispersing to obtain TOPcon front silver paste of the battery. The silver powder with negative charges has an average granularity of 0.6-1.5 mu m, a D50 of 0.9-1.5 mu m and a tap density of 4.5-6.5g/m  3 . The modified glass powder is formed by mixing hydroxyapatite glass powder and silicate glass powder according to the mass ratio of 1.3:1.5-2. The invention overcomes the defects of the prior art, can improve the charge transmission efficiency and promote the movement of current, thereby realizing the efficient conversion and utilization of light energy and having higher social use value and application prospect.

title_en: Charging gun head assembling equipment and production method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of charging pile equipment, in particular to charging gun head assembling equipment and a production method thereof. The application has the effect of improving the convenience of the charging gun head production method and the assembly equipment thereof in the operation process.

title_en: Laying device for electric power cable
abstract_en: The invention relates to a laying device for a power cable, belonging to the technical field of power line laying; the cable conveying device comprises a crawler, wherein a bracket is arranged in the middle of the upper end surface of the crawler, a cable frame is rotatably arranged in the bracket, a cable conveying mechanism is arranged at the rear side of the upper end surface of the crawler, and cables on the cable frame are conveyed backwards and released through the cable conveying mechanism; the rear end face of the crawler is provided with a fixing clip pressing mechanism, a row of U-shaped fixing clips are arranged in the fixing clip pressing mechanism, the fixing clips can be intermittently pressed down through the fixing clip pressing mechanism, and the cable which is released by the pressed fixing clips is fixed on the ground; a driving chain is arranged on a crawler belt on one side of the crawler, and the driving chain respectively drives the cable conveying mechanism and the fixed card pushing mechanism to synchronously operate through a first conveying mechanism and a second conveying mechanism; the problem that the current power cable cannot be released and fixed at the same time when being laid is solved.

title_en: Grid-connected inverter self-correction control method and system of fully artificial neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a grid-connected inverter self-correction control method and a grid-connected inverter self-correction control system of a fully artificial neural network, wherein the grid-connected inverter self-correction control method comprises the following steps: collecting power grid voltage and inputting the power grid voltage into an ANN phase-locked device, and multiplying a phase angle cosine value obtained by the output of the ANN phase-locked device with a reference current amplitude value to obtain a reference current; comparing the difference value of the grid-connected current and the reference current, inputting the difference value into an ANN controller, generating a modulation wave under the action of the ANN controller, inputting one path of modulation wave into an ANN parameter estimator, and controlling the on-off of an inverter switch in an inversion grid-connected system after one path of modulation wave passes through PWM; the ANN parameter estimator receives the modulation wave and the grid-connected current and outputs a fitting value of the grid-connected current; solving the output weight of the ANN parameter estimator in real time, feeding back parameters, and adjusting the parameters of the ANN controller on line based on the output of the ANN parameter estimator to generate a required modulation wave; and sequentially circulating the steps, and enabling the grid-connected current to quickly track the reference current by continuously and automatically adjusting the weight of the ANN controller to carry out grid connection.

title_en: Power converter and control method
abstract_en: The invention solves the problem of more reliable soft handoff. In a power converter (100), a plurality of resonant capacitors (9) are provided for a plurality of switches (8), one for each. Each of the plurality of resonant capacitors (9) is connected between the first terminal and the second DC terminal (32) of a respective one of the plurality of switches (8). A controller (50) controls the plurality of first switching elements (1), the plurality of second switching elements (2) and the plurality of switches (8). When it is determined that two-phase resonant currents corresponding to two switching circuits (10) belonging to a plurality of switching circuits (10) simultaneously flow through a resonant inductor (L1), a controller (50) performs control for shifting respective on-periods of a first switching element (1) and a second switching element (2) in one switching circuit (10) of the two switching circuits (10).

title_en: Rapid heating wind tunnel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wind tunnel tests and discloses a rapid heating wind tunnel which comprises a fan, wherein a connection diffusion section is fixedly connected to an air outlet end of the fan, a first stabilizing section is fixedly connected to one end of the connection diffusion section, which is far away from the fan, a heating section is fixedly connected to one end of the first stabilizing section, which is far away from the fan, a second stabilizing section is fixedly connected to one end of the heating section, which is far away from the fan, a contraction section is fixedly connected to one end of the contraction section, which is far away from the fan, a test section is fixedly connected to one end, which is far away from the fan, of the exhaust diffusion section, a slot is formed in one side of the heating section, an electric connection plate is fixedly connected to one side of the slot, electrode holes are formed in the upper end and the lower end of the electric connection plate, and an insulating frame is connected to the inside of the slot in a sliding mode. The rapid heating wind tunnel has the advantages that the air can be preheated by the auxiliary heating component in the first stable section before being heated by the heating section, so that the heating speed is higher when the air is heated by the electric heating network, and the heating effect is better.

title_en: Nickel-cobalt-manganese ternary material, preparation method thereof, positive electrode material containing nickel-cobalt-manganese ternary material and battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nickel-cobalt-manganese ternary material, a preparation method thereof, a positive electrode material containing the nickel-cobalt-manganese ternary material and a battery. The preparation method of the nickel-cobalt-manganese ternary material comprises the following steps: sintering a mixture of a precursor LiNi  x Co y Mn 1‑x‑y (OH) 2  and an aluminum source in an oxygen atmosphere; wherein x is more than or equal to 0.55 and less than or equal to 0.63,0.08 and y is more than or equal to 0.12; the use level of the aluminum source is 700-2000 ppm of Al element, and the sintering temperature is 900-1000 ℃; the sintering time is 14-22 h. The preparation method of the nickel-cobalt-manganese ternary material reduces the cation mixing degree, and controls the crystallinity of the material, the lithium-nickel mixing degree and the free lithium content on the surface in an optimal range; the prepared nickel-cobalt-manganese ternary material has excellent dynamic performance, structural stability, thermal stability and electrochemical performance.

title_en: Preparation method and application of silicon-based negative electrode of lithium battery
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lithium battery negative electrode preparation, and provides a preparation method of a lithium battery silicon-based negative electrode, which comprises the steps of firstly uniformly mixing a silicon-based negative electrode active substance, a conductive agent and deionized water, adding a modified binder, and continuously uniformly mixing to obtain a negative electrode mixed material, wherein the modified binder is a transition metal modified polyacrylic acid/lithium polyacrylate composite material; coating the obtained negative electrode mixture outside a porous current collector, and drying to obtain a silicon-based negative electrode plate of the lithium battery; the application of the silicon-based negative electrode in a lithium battery is also provided. The adhesive disclosed by the invention has good performance, high specific capacity and stable performance of the lithium battery, and lays a foundation for further development and application of the lithium battery.

title_en: Auxiliary device for uninterrupted extension of HGIS combined electrical apparatus and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an auxiliary device for uninterrupted extension of an HGIS combined electrical apparatus and a construction method thereof, relating to the technical field of auxiliary devices, and comprising an electric hoist, wherein a heat dissipation mechanism is arranged at the end part of a motor of the electric hoist, and comprises: the heat dissipation cover is sleeved on the outer surface of the electric hoist; the heat dissipation assembly is arranged in the heat dissipation cover and can dissipate heat of the electric hoist by blowing air in the heat dissipation cover; the clamping assemblies are arranged on the side edges of the radiating covers, and the clamping assemblies fix the radiating covers through clamping the electric hoist. According to the invention, the heat dissipation mechanism is arranged, the heat dissipation component is conveniently utilized to dissipate heat of the motor end of the electric hoist, the clamping component and the driving component are matched, the heat dissipation cover and the heat dissipation component thereof can be rapidly installed, and meanwhile, the risk of abnormal loosening of the clamping component caused by false touch can be reduced through the anti-falling component.

title_en: PFC power factor correction circuit and control system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a PFC power factor correction circuit, a control system and a control method thereof, wherein the control system comprises: the self-adaptive amplitude limiting high-order differential feedback control module is used for controlling the output direct-current voltage of the power circuit to track a given voltage reference value and obtaining an input signal of the double-integration single-period control module; and the double integration single-period control module is used for generating a driving signal of the power circuit and controlling the input current and the input voltage of the power circuit to be in the same frequency and phase. The outer ring of the invention adopts the self-adaptive amplitude limiting HODFC, and has the advantages that the design of control parameters is not dependent on a system model, the robustness of a control strategy is strong, and the like; the inner loop adopts double integral OCC, has the characteristics of simple control strategy and strong input interference resistance, reduces phase shift between input current and voltage, reduces total harmonic distortion rate of the input current, improves power factor, and eliminates harmonic current pollution.

title_en: New forms of energy photovoltaic power generation fortune dimension monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of photovoltaic power generation devices, in particular to a new energy photovoltaic power generation operation and maintenance monitoring device. The technical problems to be solved are as follows: the existing floating type photovoltaic power generation device cannot protect the photovoltaic panel when the photovoltaic panel is not used, so that the photovoltaic panel is corroded by seawater for a long time, damage is caused, the performance of the photovoltaic panel is seriously affected, and meanwhile, the existing device cannot automatically clean snow on the surface of the photovoltaic panel. The technical proposal is as follows: the new energy photovoltaic power generation operation and maintenance monitoring device comprises a floating frame, a photovoltaic panel and the like; the photovoltaic panel is installed on the floating frame and is obliquely placed. The shielding cover is used for shielding the photovoltaic panel, so that the surface of the photovoltaic panel is prevented from being corroded due to the fact that sea waves are beaten to the surface of the photovoltaic panel excessively at night, the performance of the photovoltaic panel is prevented from being influenced, snow on the shielding cover is blocked through the first curved arc part, the folding process of the shielding cover is prevented, snow falls onto the photovoltaic panel after crossing the monitoring rod when the snow slides downwards, and the reduction of the power generation efficiency of the photovoltaic panel is avoided.

title_en: Auxiliary tool of uninterrupted power supply system and misoperation preventing method
abstract_en: The application provides an auxiliary tool of an uninterruptible power supply system and an anti-misoperation method, wherein the auxiliary tool of the uninterruptible power supply system comprises: the host computer is connected with the air switch, the front end of the host computer is provided with a man-machine conversation panel, the man-machine conversation panel is provided with a mode indicator lamp, a mode switching key, a first air switch state indicator lamp, a setting switch and a password keyboard, which are all connected with the host computer, and the host computer stores a mode switching operation program; the anti-misoperation lockset is connected with the host machine and is fixedly arranged on the air switch; when the mode is switched through the man-machine conversation panel, the host executes a mode switching operation program, and the host transmits an instruction to the anti-misoperation lockset so as to control the anti-misoperation lockset to unlock or lock, and collect the state of the air switch. The technical scheme of the application effectively solves the problem that the air switch in the related technology is misoperation.

title_en: Novel high compression ratio narrow-spacing plane distribution multi-beam electron gun
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel high-compression-ratio narrow-space plane distribution multi-beam electron gun, and belongs to the technical field of electronic devices. The electron gun is provided with a control electrode between a cathode and an anode, and emits an electron beam from an electron emission surface of the cathode, wherein the electron beam is compressed in a one-dimensional compression mode and then emitted through an anode hole. The invention compresses the electron beam in a one-dimensional compression mode, specifically compresses the electron beam only in the Y direction, and can greatly reduce the axial distance between adjacent electron beams; the control electrode is arranged between the cathode and the anode, so that the problem of divergence of the electron beam in the X direction can be well solved, the range of the electron gun is increased, and the high compression ratio is realized.

title_en: Intelligent control method and equipment for capacitor element nailing machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent control method and equipment for a capacitor element nailing machine, wherein the method comprises the steps of detecting the internal state of production equipment, detecting the quality of capacitor products, calculating the working state prediction of the equipment according to the quality of the capacitor products and the detection result of the internal state of the production equipment, obtaining a working state prediction value, and when the working state prediction value is larger than a threshold value, indicating that the working state is abnormal, and entering the step of adjusting equipment parameters; and adjusting the movement speed and the tension of the feeding mechanism, the positive electrode nailing machine, the negative electrode nailing machine and the winding machine based on an improved swarm intelligence algorithm. The invention realizes the automatic control of the capacitor element nailing machine, effectively improves the production quality of the capacitor, reduces the probability of generating foil leakage and deflection nails, and improves the qualification rate and the service life of the capacitor.

title_en: Cation co-doped lithium-rich manganese-based material, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a cation co-doped lithium-rich manganese-based material, and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: mixing a lithium source, a nickel source, a manganese source, a doping source and a solvent to obtain a mixed solution; the doping source comprises aluminum zirconium oxychloride compound; and carrying out spray pyrolysis and calcination on the mixed solution to obtain the cation co-doped lithium-rich manganese-based material. According to the preparation method, by adopting the specific doping source, the co-doping of aluminum and zirconium ions is realized when the precursor is prepared by spray pyrolysis, the doping source can also play a role of a dispersing agent, particle agglomeration during spray pyrolysis is prevented, and the cycle performance and the thermal stability of the lithium-rich manganese-based material are improved.

title_en: Double-sided patterned composite polymer film and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a double-sided patterned composite polymer film, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: and filling polymer fluid into the template to form two identical or different patterned polymer exchange membranes, and removing the membranes after treatment by adopting a solidification-interface fusion process to obtain the double-sided patterned composite polymer membrane. The polymer exchange membrane obtained by filling the template with the patterned structure through the polymer fluid is subjected to curing-interface fusion process treatment, and then the template is removed, so that the double-sided patterned composite polymer membrane can be formed.

title_en: Electric connector
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric connector, comprising: an insulating body; a row of terminals accommodated in the insulating body and comprising at least four terminal groups, each terminal having a contact portion for contacting the butt-joint element, the contact portions of the terminals of a row being arranged side by side, each terminal group being composed of a ground terminal and a pair of differential signal terminals or a single-ended signal terminal located at one side of the ground terminal, one ground terminal of each terminal group being arranged in the same order as the pair of differential signal terminals or the single-ended signal terminal in the left-right direction, there being no ground terminal between each two terminal groups; and one of the two grounding terminals in each nearest two terminal groups is electrically contacted with the serial connection piece, and the other is electrically isolated from the serial connection piece, so that resonance is optimized, and noise and interference are reduced.

title_en: Power information management and control method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electricity consumption monitoring, and provides a method and a device for managing and controlling electric power information. The method comprises the following steps: the concentrator judges whether the overall electricity consumption data is matched with the electricity consumption rule according to the electricity consumption rule, if the overall electricity consumption data is matched with the electricity consumption rule, whether the overall electricity consumption data is abnormal or not is judged, and/or whether a new electric appliance is added in a user family or not is judged; if the overall electricity consumption data is abnormal, reporting the overall electricity consumption data to a server; if the new electric appliance appears in the user family, after the new data with effective duration is collected in the whole electricity utilization data, the new data is reported to the server, so that the server updates the electricity utilization rule of the user family. According to the invention, the concentrator is used for matching the electricity utilization rule, so that the data transmission frequency and the total data transmission quantity between the concentrator and the server are reduced, the transmission channel between the concentrator and the server is ensured not to be blocked due to excessive data quantity, and the load of the server is reduced.

title_en: Composite nitride positive electrode additive, modified positive electrode material and preparation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a composite nitride positive electrode additive, a modified positive electrode material and a preparation method, wherein the composite nitride positive electrode additive comprises the following components in parts by weight: 80-99 parts of metal nitride and 1-20 parts of conductive additive; the metal nitride includes one or more of zinc nitride, magnesium nitride, titanium nitride, or copper nitride. The preparation method comprises the following steps: and mixing the metal nitride and the conductive additive in proportion, and performing ball milling to obtain the blended composite nitride positive electrode additive. The modified positive electrode material comprises the following components in parts by weight: 90-99 parts of NCM powder and 1-10 parts of composite nitride positive electrode additive. Compared with the prior art, the composite nitride positive electrode additive can effectively inhibit the dissolution of metal ions, enhance the conductivity of the positive electrode and synergistically improve the cycling stability of the NCM positive electrode.

title_en: Method for preparing SCR catalyst by rapidly recycling waste lithium ion battery positive electrode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preparing an SCR catalyst by rapidly recycling the positive electrode of a waste lithium ion battery. The method comprises the following steps: adding the positive electrode powder material into a low cosolvent, and stirring for 10-12 hours at 90-150 ℃ to obtain leaching solution containing nickel, cobalt, manganese and lithium ions; wherein the low cosolvent comprises choline chloride, oxalic acid and alcohol; the alcohol is glycol or glycerol; adding the leaching solution into a second solvent, heating in a water bath under stirring for 1-2 h, and standing to obtain a solid-phase product and a supernatant; washing, suction filtering and drying the solid phase product, heating to 350-500 ℃ and calcining for 3-5 h to obtain a recovered product, namely the composite metal oxide. The invention avoids adding extra precipitant, simplifies the experimental process and saves the economic cost; the prepared catalyst has excellent catalytic performance.

title_en: Drainage method for fuel cell system start-up procedure
abstract_en: The present invention provides a water draining method for a starting process of a fuel cell system, comprising the steps of: s101, continuing to supply fuel after the purging step of the starting process of the fuel cell system is completed; s102, when the fuel pressure is increased to be not less than a drainage pressure P   Row of rows  , cutting off the supply of fuel; s103, opening a drain valve; s104, closing the drain valve when the trigger condition of closing the drain valve is met; the drainage method performs an independent drainage step in the starting process before the operation process of the fuel cell system, overcomes the technical prejudice that the independent drainage step is not required to be performed in the starting process of the fuel cell system, can drain liquid water accumulated in the fuel system (such as a hydrogen system) of the fuel cell system after shutdown, particularly the liquid water accumulated in the gas-water separator, and avoids various faults caused by excessive liquid water possibly existing.

title_en: Inverter and control method of inverter circuit
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an inverter and a control method of an inverter circuit, wherein a first switching tube of an original side bridge arm of the inverter and a first end of a third switching tube are connected with a negative electrode output end of a direct current power supply, a second end of the first switching tube is connected with a positive electrode output end of the direct current power supply through a second switching tube, a second end of the third switching tube is connected with the positive electrode output end of the direct current power supply through a fourth switching tube, and a connecting end of the first switching tube and the second switching tube and a connecting end of the third switching tube and a connecting end of the fourth switching tube are connected with a primary side winding of a transformation unit. The connection ends of the first secondary half bridge arm and the second secondary half bridge arm in the secondary bridge arm and the connection ends of the first capacitor and the second capacitor are connected with secondary windings of the voltage transformation unit. The primary side driving circuit takes power from the direct current power supply, the first switching tube and the second switching tube are driven to be conducted alternately in one control period, the third switching tube and the fourth switching tube Guan Jiaoti are conducted, the second switching tube and the third switching tube are conducted simultaneously, and the first switching tube and the fourth switching tube are conducted simultaneously.

title_en: Photosensitive thick film resistor paste and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photosensitive thick film resistor paste and a preparation method thereof, which belong to the technical field of electronic materials, and the photosensitive thick film resistor paste comprises the following components in parts by weight: 25-35 parts of organic carrier, 1-5 parts of glass powder, 50-70 parts of modified ruthenium oxide powder, 1-5 parts of palladium powder and 1-5 parts of silver powder; the mass ratio of the glass powder to the modified ruthenium oxide powder is 1: (15-40), the glass powder can effectively improve the adhesive force, promote the diffusion and migration of the modified ruthenium oxide powder, enable the modified ruthenium oxide powder to be uniformly diffused, effectively improve the diffusion uniformity, improve the irregular edges of the resistor caused by the screen printing pressure and the diameter of the screen gauze silk thread, reduce the surface tension effect, reduce the thickness difference between the middle position and the edge position of the resistor, and effectively reduce the resistance change rate between the resistors.

title_en: Method for rapidly evaluating lithium ion transmission capacity of composite positive electrode of solid-state battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for rapidly evaluating the lithium ion transmission capacity of a composite positive electrode of a solid-state battery, and provides a detection method for measuring the lithium ion transmission capacity of the composite positive electrode by using a battery test system to obtain the conductivity and tortuosity of the composite positive electrode, which comprises the following steps: assembling an electronic blocking and negative electrode symmetrical battery by taking the button battery as a carrier; using a battery test system to conduct constant voltage charging on the symmetrical batteries to read steady-state current values; calculating ion impedance of two symmetrical batteries; the impedance difference value of the two symmetrical batteries is the ion impedance of the composite anode; and calculating the ionic conductivity and tortuosity of the composite positive electrode based on the ionic impedance, thickness and sectional area of the composite positive electrode and the ionic conductivity and volume fraction of the solid electrolyte, so that the lithium ion transmission performance of the composite positive electrode can be evaluated simply and rapidly. According to the technical scheme, a technician can evaluate the lithium ion transmission capacity of the solid-state battery composite positive electrode through the existing equipment, and then quick composite positive electrode screening is realized.

title_en: Lithium ion battery electrolyte and lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium ion battery electrolyte and a lithium ion battery, wherein the lithium ion battery electrolyte comprises main lithium salt, an organic solvent and an additive, and the additive at least comprises the following components: the first additive is monofluorophosphoric acid lithium fluoroborate, and the dosage of the first additive is 0.1-10.0wt% of the total mass of the electrolyte; the second additive is a dicyclic sulfate compound, and the dosage of the second additive is 0.05-5.0wt% of the total mass of the electrolyte. The electrolyte can effectively reduce the impedance of the battery, improve the storage and circulation performance of the battery at high temperature and high voltage, and ensure that the battery has better low-temperature and multiplying power performance.

title_en: Ordered mesoporous PPy oxygen barrier film fully-coated MXene composite material, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nano functional materials, and discloses an ordered mesoporous PPy oxygen barrier film full-coated MXene composite material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the composite material comprises a single-layer or less-layer MXene nano sheet, and the surface of the MXene nano sheet is fully coated with a PPy oxygen barrier film; the PPy oxygen barrier film has an in-plane ordered mesoporous pore structure; the oxygen barrier film is used as an intercalation medium between MXene nano-sheets; the preparation method is characterized in that the preparation method is carried out by self-assembly and in-situ polymerization, the interfacial self-assembly is carried out by the electrostatic interaction of-NH-of pyrrole, -O-of P123 and the negative functional group of MXene, so that the growth of the in-plane ordered mesoporous full-coating film of the MXene nano-sheet is realized, the preparation process is simple, a novel composite material with excellent ion transmission rate, storage capacity and oxidation resistance can be obtained, and the material is applied to the desalination of a capacitance method, and has the outstanding advantages of high desalination capacity, high desalination rate, high charge efficiency and high electrode operation stability.

title_en: Safety sodium ion battery electrolyte and sodium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safe sodium ion battery electrolyte and a sodium ion battery, wherein the electrolyte comprises sodium salt, a first flame retardant solvent, a second flame retardant solvent and an additive, the first flame retardant solvent is one or more than two of methyl dimethyl phosphonate, trimethyl phosphate, triethyl phosphate, tripropyl phosphate and tributyl phosphate, and the second flame retardant solvent is one or more than two of (2, 2) -trifluoroethyl diethyl phosphate, di (2, 2) -trifluoroethyl ethyl phosphate, tri (2, 2) -trifluoroethyl phosphate, fluoroethylene carbonate, methyl trifluoroethyl carbonate and di (2, 2) -trifluoroethyl carbonate. The safety type sodium ion battery electrolyte has the characteristics of high safety, good stability and strong compatibility.

title_en: Three-dimensional carbon-coated aluminum fiber current collector and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional carbon-coated aluminum fiber current collector and a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of battery current collector materials and preparation thereof. The invention solves the problems of complex preparation process and poor circulation stability of the existing three-dimensional porous aluminum current collector. According to the invention, firstly, metal aluminum fibers are tiled into a net shape, then, after pressure treatment, the surfaces of the metal aluminum fibers are coated with carbon in a vapor deposition or physical coating mode combined with a calcination mode, point contact is formed among the metal fibers by the pressure treatment, and then, after the welding effect on the physical contact points among the metal aluminum fibers in the calcination process, the three-dimensional aluminum fibers are coated with carbon to form an integrated network structure, so that the three-dimensional aluminum fibers have stronger mechanical strength and conductive network, and remarkable optimization in the aspects of resistivity, electrolyte permeability, multiplying power performance and the like is realized. In addition, the preparation method provided by the invention is simple, and is favorable for reducing the production cost and realizing industrialized mass production.

title_en: New energy inertia simulation control optimization method and system based on super capacitor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy inertia simulation control optimization method and system based on a super capacitor, and relates to the technical field of new energy inertia simulation control, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring operation parameters, acquiring three-phase voltage, inputting the three-phase voltage into a phase-locked loop, outputting alternating frequency and generating a super capacitor voltage initial reference value; detecting the discharge current of the super capacitor, and calculating and generating the reference value correction quantity of the voltage of the super capacitor; summing the generated initial reference value of the super capacitor voltage and the correction quantity of the reference value of the super capacitor voltage to generate a final reference value of the super capacitor voltage; and performing voltage and current double-loop control on the bidirectional DC/DC converter to control the on-off of the DC/DC power switching device. The method is beneficial to improving the rapidity and the accuracy of inertia simulation, relieving the negative influence of the uncertainty of new energy power generation on the power system, ensuring the safe and stable operation of the novel power system, realizing the novel power system by simply correcting the classical inertia simulation, avoiding adding additional signal measuring links and being easy to implement.

title_en: Portable VPSA vacuum miniature physical oxygenerator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable VPSA vacuum miniature physical oxygenerator, which belongs to the technical field of oxygenerators, and comprises a machine body, wherein the upper end of the machine body is fixedly connected with an upper cover, the side edge of the upper cover is inwards sunken to form a user panel attachment area, the side edge of the upper end of the machine body is provided with an oxygen joint, the middle part of the upper cover is provided with an air inlet, and the inside of the air inlet is provided with a filter cover; further comprises: the lower extreme fixedly connected with curb plate of upper cover, and the inboard of curb plate is installed vacuum compressor unit, and vacuum compressor unit comprises last jar and lower jar, vacuum compressor unit's below is provided with molecular sieve adsorption tower. This portable VPSA vacuum miniature physics oxygenerator can conveniently clear up the filter automatically when making oxygen, improves oxygenerator's work efficiency, conveniently carries out the forced air cooling to the battery through the mode of blowing simultaneously, reduces battery working area's temperature, prevents that the battery from being in overheated state.

title_en: Multifunctional operation vehicle for construction operation of rural power distribution network and telegraph pole erecting method
abstract_en: The invention provides a multifunctional operation vehicle for construction operation of an agricultural distribution network and a telegraph pole erecting method, and belongs to the technical field of special vehicles for agricultural distribution networks. The technical problems that in the prior art, a special vehicle for the agricultural distribution network has single function, the labor intensity of operators is high and potential safety hazards exist are solved. The technical proposal is as follows: the device comprises a chassis, a forklift lifting device, a traction winch, a coiling and uncoiling reel, a generator set and a control mechanism, wherein a carriage is arranged on the chassis; a telegraph pole erecting method comprises the following steps of S1: collecting and paying out the steel wire rope; s2: the steel wire rope passes through all the guiding devices; s3: paying out a section of steel wire rope; s4: lifting the forklift lifting device; s5: is connected with a telegraph pole; s6: and (5) recovering the steel wire rope, and pulling up the telegraph pole to be vertical. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the single trolley has various functions, has the functions of fork loading, cable winding and unwinding, traction, power generation, illumination, tool storage and transportation and the like, reduces the labor intensity of operators and eliminates potential safety hazards.

title_en: Circuit breaker, battery pack and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a circuit breaker, a battery pack and a vehicle, relates to the technical field of circuit breakers, and aims to solve the problem that an arc cannot be timely weakened after a copper bar in the circuit breaker is broken in the prior art. The circuit breaker comprises an electric connection structure, a breaking device, an insulating liquid module and a driving device. The breaking device is arranged at one side of the electric connection structure. The insulating liquid module at least comprises insulating liquid. The driving device is used for driving the breaking device to move towards the electric connection structure so as to break the electric connection structure and drive the insulating liquid of the insulating liquid module to be sprayed on the position on the electric connection structure which is broken by the breaking device. The circuit breaker is used for breaking a circuit.

title_en: Combined power cabinet
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power cabinets, in particular to a combined power cabinet which comprises a cabinet, wherein a first rotating shaft is fixedly connected to the front end of the cabinet close to the left side, a door plate is rotatably connected to one side of the first rotating shaft far away from the cabinet, a first handle is fixedly connected to the left side of the door plate close to the front end, a distribution table is arranged in the cabinet, two corners of the distribution table close to the front end are arc-shaped, a connecting assembly is arranged between the door plate and the distribution table, the distribution table is conveniently controlled to slide, the door plate is driven to rotate around the outer part of the first rotating shaft by holding the first handle, the connecting assembly is driven to move by the door plate, so that the distribution table is pulled out from the interior of the cabinet, the observation effect can be improved by the structure for maintenance, the problem that a user needs to stretch a hand into the narrow interior of the cabinet for maintenance when the maintenance is carried out in the past, the operation space is small, the operation is inconvenient to operate is solved, and the convenience in the maintenance is improved.

title_en: Automobile wire harness layout device
