abstract_en: The invention discloses an automobile wire harness layout device, which is arranged in a framework of a seat of a vehicle, wherein the framework comprises a head framework and a back framework, and the device also comprises: the inner clamping type mounting structure comprises an upper fixing plate, a lower fixing plate and a plurality of vertical ribs which are connected, the inner clamping type mounting structure comprises a clamping cylinder used for fixing a wire harness, a redundant position accommodating assembly is arranged in the clamping cylinder, the wire harness length in the clamping cylinder and the redundant position accommodating assembly is larger than that of the clamping cylinder, a movable adjusting assembly is arranged on the outer side of the clamping cylinder, a first arranging piece is arranged above the upper fixing plate, and a second arranging piece is arranged below the lower fixing plate; the invention discloses a wrapping type containing structure, which is characterized in that a vertical rib is arranged in a hollow mode, the wrapping type containing structure comprises a separation sheet arranged in the vertical rib, two sides of the separation sheet are respectively provided with a wrapping bag, the inner side of the vertical rib is communicated with an air pump of a seat through an outer edge pipeline, and the routing strength of a wire harness is guaranteed on the premise that a framework is not enlarged.

title_en: Micro-focus X-ray tube
abstract_en: The invention discloses a micro-focus X-ray tube, which belongs to the technical field of X-ray tubes and comprises a shell, a window, an anode component and a cathode electron gun component; the anode cap in the anode assembly comprises a cap body and an anode electric field correction structure; anode in cap and anode assembly the shape of the top of the head is sleeved and matched; the top of the anode electric field correction structure is a special-shaped surface formed by a rectangle and a semicircle, the diameter of the semicircle is adjacent to the first side of the rectangle, the second side opposite to the first side is close to one side of the cathode electron gun assembly, and the lower bottom surface of the anode electric field correction structure is attached to the top surface of the anode head; the second side extends downwards to form a plane perpendicular to the electron beam; the first through hole on the side surface of the anode cap penetrates through the plane, and the second through hole on the top penetrates through the center of the adjacent area of the rectangle and the semicircle. The invention can improve the symmetry of the electric field, absorb scattered electrons and disordered X rays, reduce the ignition of cathode and anode, avoid the problems of inconsistent focusing, poor focus and large X-ray background noise and low contrast, and comprehensively improve the performance of the micro-focus X-ray tube.

title_en: Stacked assembly of electrochemical energy converters
abstract_en: The invention relates to a stack assembly for an electrochemical energy converter, in particular a fuel cell or an electrolysis cell, comprising at least one stack assembly formed by a plurality of cells arranged one above the other. The batteries each have a membrane, which is assigned to a cathode functional surface and an anode functional surface. Bipolar plates and/or monopolar plates are provided between the cells of the at least one stacked assembly. The active surface of the membrane is divided into a plurality of sections that are galvanically isolated from one another, so that at the level of the cell, the sections that are galvanically isolated from one another are electrically connected in series at the cell level. Further, the invention relates to the use of a stack for generating hydrogen in an electrolysis device or a fuel cell for converting hydrogen into electric current and to the use of a stack for converting a gaseous and/or liquid medium into electric current in an electrochemical system and to the use of a stack in a redox flow system.

title_en: Explosion-proof motor for mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of motors, in particular to an explosion-proof motor for a mine, which comprises a motor body, wherein a motor shaft is rotationally connected to the motor body, one end of the motor shaft extends to the outer side of the motor body, a limiting mechanism is arranged on the motor shaft, an extrusion mechanism is arranged in the motor shaft, a protection mechanism is connected to the extrusion mechanism, a lubrication mechanism is arranged on the motor body, a control mechanism is arranged in the motor body, a locking mechanism is arranged on the motor body, and a sealing mechanism is arranged on the locking mechanism; through the cooperation of stop gear and extrusion mechanism, make the epaxial belt pulley of motor spacing to make things convenient for subsequent dismouting, the drive through protection machanism is to extrusion mechanism shutting protection, through the motor shaft to control mechanism drive, realize that lubrication mechanism carries out the inside lubrication maintenance to the motor body, through locking mechanism and sealing mechanism, be favorable to the control of terminal box switching, make things convenient for electric wire quick connect.

title_en: Energy-saving design method for dead man alarm and unmanned cabin illumination linkage
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy-saving design method for dead man alarm and unmanned cabin lighting linkage, which comprises the following steps: dividing a normal lighting lamp line of a cabin working area into two lighting lamp lines; the two paths of lighting lamp circuits are respectively controlled by two mutually independent switch components; an integral control part capable of controlling the switch parts of the two paths of lighting lamp circuits is arranged; a signal transmission component is arranged between the cabin dead man alarm system and the integral control component; the whole control part enables two paths of lighting lamp lines to be opened when receiving a starting signal of the cabin dead man alarm system, and enables one path of lighting lamp lines to be closed when receiving a closing signal of the cabin dead man alarm system. According to the invention, the illumination in the same working area can be managed in groups according to the use situation, the energy consumption is reduced, the service life of the lamp is prolonged, and the intelligent degree of the ship is improved.

title_en: Algae cultivation illumination adjusting device and control method
abstract_en: The invention provides an algae cultivation illumination adjusting device and a control method, comprising a seedling raising room, wherein a plurality of seedling raising pools for cultivating algae plants are arranged in the seedling raising room at equal intervals; the ceiling is arranged at the top of the seedling raising room and is provided with a plurality of hollow grooves which are sequentially and symmetrically formed; an illumination detection module for detecting and adjusting a light source in the nursery to facilitate cultivation of the algae; the adjusting mechanism is used for rolling the illumination intensity adjusting piece and adjusting the natural light illumination intensity required by different algae plants; the illumination intensity adjusting piece comprises a first grid curtain, a second grid curtain, a third grid curtain and a fourth grid curtain which are sequentially connected. The invention can monitor different states of algae plants during growth, thereby controlling the motor to adjust the light control grille curtain, and enabling the holes with different light transmittance on the light control grille curtain to correspond to algae plants with different growth periods.

title_en: Seal assembly for a vehicle
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a "seal assembly for a vehicle". A seal assembly includes a cap and a seal. The cover includes an engagement structure and a flange. The engagement structure is configured to couple the cover to the housing. The flange defines a plurality of openings that open through a first side of the flange and a second side of the flange. The seal includes a seal body and a plurality of bosses. The seal body engages the second side of the flange and includes a plurality of bosses. Each boss is positioned in a respective one of the plurality of openings. The seal is compressible against the flange from a relaxed state in which the bosses are flush with the first side of the flange or recessed within the opening and a compressed state in which each boss extends from the respective opening beyond the first side of the flange.

title_en: Protection method and device for outgoing line of doubly-fed fan system, storage medium and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a protection method and device for outgoing lines of a double-fed fan system, a storage medium and computer equipment. The method comprises the following steps: in response to the doubly-fed wind turbine system being in a fault state, determining positive sequence equivalent impedance and negative sequence equivalent impedance of the doubly-fed wind turbine system according to voltage data and current data at a distance relay corresponding to the doubly-fed wind turbine system; determining the system equivalent impedance of the doubly-fed fan system according to the positive sequence equivalent impedance and the negative sequence equivalent impedance; determining compensation impedance according to the positive sequence equivalent impedance and the system equivalent impedance; and carrying out compensation processing on the set impedance of the distance relay according to the compensation impedance so as to update an action characteristic equation of the distance relay. According to the application, the set impedance is corrected through the compensation impedance, the influence of correction, unequal negative sequence impedance and double-fed fan system load conditions on the range of protection of the range relay is improved, the accuracy of judging the range relay is improved, the protection range is enlarged, and the risk of power grid operation is reduced.

title_en: Low-speed three-phase synchronous motor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of motors and discloses a low-speed three-phase synchronous motor which comprises a shell, wherein an output shaft is rotatably arranged in the center of the shell, ventilation holes are formed in the inner circumference of the shell in an array mode, a supporting seat is fixedly arranged outside the shell, a fan shell is arranged at the end part of the shell, radiating fins are fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the shell, and a radiating device is arranged at the end part of the output shaft positioned inside the fan shell.

title_en: Operating mechanism and circuit breaker
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of piezoelectric devices, and discloses an operating mechanism and a circuit breaker. The operating mechanism comprises a shell, a long shaft, two contact supports, a first transmission frame, a second transmission frame and a handle. Two ends of the long shaft are arranged on two opposite side walls of the shell; the two contact supports are rotatably arranged on the long shaft and are provided with a closing position and a separating position; the first transmission frame and the second transmission frame are both rotatably arranged on the long shaft, the first transmission frame rotates along a first direction to enable the contact support to move to a closing position, and rotates along a second direction to enable the contact support to move to a separating position; the second transmission frame can push the first transmission frame to rotate along the second direction under the action of double-metal or push rods; the handle is rotatably arranged on the shell and used for enabling the first transmission frame to rotate along a first direction and enabling the second transmission frame to rotate along a second direction under the driving of external force. The operating mechanism integrates two-phase operating mechanisms of the circuit breaker, reduces the use of parts and improves the synchronism among the phases.

title_en: Composite anode material, preparation method thereof, anode sheet and lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of lithium ion batteries, and particularly relates to a composite negative electrode material, a preparation method thereof, a negative electrode plate and a lithium ion battery; the composite anode material comprises an inner core and a coating layer coated on the outer surface of the inner core, wherein the inner core is graphite, and the coating layer is nano diamond. According to the invention, the nano diamond component is added into the liquid phase coating agent, and the high-strength combination of the nano diamond particles and the graphite surface is realized through the liquid phase coating to form a compact nano diamond coating layer, so that more lithium ion adsorption sites are provided for the graphite surface coating layer, the lithium ion transmission speed is accelerated, the specific surface area, the multiplying power performance and the circulating performance of the anode material are improved, and the multiplying power performance and the circulating stability of the lithium ion battery are further improved.

title_en: Pre-buried wiring device for building electrical construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric wiring, in particular to a pre-buried wiring device for building electric construction, which is convenient for connecting wires in pre-buried PVC pipes, and comprises a supporting component, a flip component, a plurality of groups of winding components and a connecting box, wherein the supporting component comprises a bottom shell, the flip component comprises a cover plate and a gland, one end of the cover plate is hinged with the bottom shell, the other end of the cover plate is clamped with the bottom shell, gland one end rotates with the apron to be connected, and other end lower surface and drain pan edge butt or separation all offer down logical groove on the lateral wall that drain pan and wire winding subassembly correspond, go up logical groove on the apron correspondence, go up logical groove and logical groove butt down and form circular hole groove, the PVC pipe wears to establish at circular hole inslot, wire winding subassembly includes wire winding piece, locating clip and holding ring. According to the invention, the problem that PVC is in butt joint with the side part Kong Chakong of the box body and the wire is complicated in perforation is avoided due to the arrangement of the bottom shell and the cover plate in a matched manner, the length of the reserved wire can be reduced due to the arrangement of the winding assembly, and the wire is not easy to excessively bend.

title_en: Rotor assembly, motor and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rotor assembly, a motor and a vehicle, wherein the rotor assembly comprises: a rotor core; the first permanent magnets are arranged on the rotor core at intervals along the circumferential direction of the rotor core; the plurality of second permanent magnets are arranged on the rotor core at intervals along the circumferential direction of the rotor core, and the second permanent magnets are respectively and correspondingly arranged on two circumferential sides of each first permanent magnet; the plurality of third permanent magnets are arranged on the rotor core at intervals along the circumferential direction of the rotor core, each third permanent magnet is perpendicular to the d axis, the second permanent magnets are respectively and correspondingly arranged on two circumferential sides of each third permanent magnet, the first permanent magnets and the second permanent magnets are respectively rare earth magnetic steels with different remanence, and the third permanent magnets are ferrite. Therefore, the torque fluctuation of the motor can be reduced, the NVH performance of the motor is improved, the utilization rate of the magnetic steel can be improved, and the cost is reduced.

title_en: Carbon nano tube cladding doped precursor, preparation method thereof and positive electrode material
abstract_en: The invention provides a carbon nano tube cladding doped precursor, a preparation method thereof and a positive electrode material, wherein the carbon nano tube cladding doped precursor comprises a core and a carbon nano tube cladding layer cladding the outside of the core; the core comprises a nickel-cobalt-manganese ternary precursor core containing a doping metal M; the doping metal M comprises any one or a combination of at least two of aluminum, titanium, niobium, zirconium, tungsten, vanadium, strontium, gallium, cerium, yttrium or lanthanum. According to the invention, the doped metal M is coated and combined with the carbon nano tube to prepare the high-performance precursor, so that the discharge capacity, the rate capability and the cycle performance of the anode material are improved.

title_en: Multi-device constant-voltage wireless charging system with adjustable output power
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-device wireless charging system, in particular to a multi-device constant voltage wireless charging system with adjustable output power, which comprises a power circuit and a control circuit, wherein the power circuit comprises a direct-current power supply, a parallel full-bridge inverter, a signal coupling transformer, a corresponding compensation capacitor, a magnetic coupling resonance type wireless power transmission circuit, a power adjusting circuit, a rectifying circuit, a filter circuit and a load, and the control circuit comprises a voltage sampling conditioning circuit, a current sampling conditioning circuit, a transmitting end grid driver, a receiving end grid driver, a transmitting end MCU system and a receiving end MCU system which are sequentially connected. In the invention, the magnetic coupling resonance type wireless power transmission circuit adopts a plurality of groups of inverters to generate a plurality of groups of high-frequency power with different working frequencies, and a single group of transmitting coils are used for simultaneously carrying out wireless charging on a plurality of devices. The wireless charging system has lower cost and can avoid the problem of mutual electromagnetic interference among a plurality of groups of transmitting coils.

title_en: LED traffic lighting street lamp and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of lighting street lamps and discloses an LED traffic lighting street lamp and a working method thereof, wherein the LED traffic lighting street lamp comprises a lamp post, a base is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the lamp post, a movable seat is movably sleeved on the outer side surface of the lamp post, a heat dissipation box is fixedly arranged at the front end of the movable seat, a power box is fixedly arranged at the rear end of the movable seat, the movable seat is vertically displaced relative to the lamp post, and an LED lamp packaging part is fixedly arranged at the front end of the heat dissipation box. According to the invention, when active heat dissipation is utilized, the power generated by the rotation of the heat dissipation fan is utilized, and when the heat dissipation fan is needed, the rotation of the gear is realized through the combination of the electromagnetic clutch, and the active descending or ascending of the LED lamp packaging piece is realized through the mutual engagement between the electromagnetic clutch and the rack, so that the motor and the electromagnetic clutch are controlled in the whole process, the problem that the traditional device needs to be overhauled in a climbing way is avoided, the overhauling operation of a conventional height can be realized, the safety coefficient is higher, and the overall maintenance efficiency is remarkably improved.

title_en: Cable connector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cable connector, which comprises a socket body, an inner conductive terminal, an outer conductive terminal, an inner insulator, an outer insulator, a metal riveting piece and a cable extending out of the socket body backwards; the cable comprises a conductor, an insulator, a metal braid and an insulating sheath, wherein the insulator wraps the conductor, and the braid is arranged between the insulator and the insulating sheath. The outer conductive terminal is of a tubular structure manufactured by an extraction molding process and is provided with an outer contact arm positioned at the front end and an outer connection part positioned at the rear end, the riveting piece is riveted on the outer connection part, the front end of the weaving layer is clamped and fixed between the outer connection part and the riveting piece, the outer surface of the outer connection part is arranged to be uneven, friction force between the outer connection part and the weaving layer is increased, and cable falling phenomenon caused by abnormal dragging is prevented.

title_en: Electric automobile charging power scheduling analysis method and device
abstract_en: A method for dispatching and analyzing the charging power of electric car includes such steps as designing contract, building the demand response strategy of electric car user and aggregator, making the user meet the power index of charging demand, providing auxiliary power supply service to electric network, setting the charging and discharging prices, charging electric car user in low-load period, discharging electric network in high-load period, building the simulation experiment model, real-time dispatching and power distribution, and regulating the charging power of electric car user by aggregator. According to the invention, the charging power is distributed and scheduled based on the margin of the electric automobile, so that real-time quick solving is realized, and charging and participation demand response are satisfied.

title_en: Organic polymer with oxidation-reduction activity for lithium ion battery positive electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of synthesis of lithium ion battery anode materials, and relates to an organic polymer material with oxidation-reduction activity, a preparation method and application thereof. The N, N-diamino-1, 4,5, 8-naphthalene tetraimide and hexaazabenzophenanthrene hexacarboxylic acid dianhydride are subjected to dehydration condensation reaction, after the reaction is finished, deionized water is used for washing, centrifuging and vacuum drying are carried out to obtain the organic polymer with oxidation-reduction activity, and the button-type lithium ion battery prepared by using the organic polymer as the positive electrode material has higher specific capacity, better multiplying power performance and excellent cycle stability. Therefore, the organic polymer material has wide application prospect in the field of lithium ion batteries. The material has the advantages of simple synthesis method, rich raw material sources and good reproducibility, and is suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Control cabinet for shock-absorbing diesel generator set
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control cabinet for a shock-absorbing diesel generator set, which relates to the technical field of generator control cabinets and comprises a cabinet body, a cabinet door, a sliding support and a shock-absorbing mechanism, wherein the cabinet door is arranged on the side part of the cabinet body in a matched manner, the sliding support is connected with the cabinet body in a sliding fit manner, limit frames are symmetrically and fixedly arranged on the two sides of the top of the sliding support, mounting grooves are formed in the side parts of the limit frames, mounting plates are arranged in the mounting grooves, the shock-absorbing mechanism comprises shock-absorbing springs and shock-absorbing cushions, when the mounting plates are subjected to shock, relative displacement is generated between the mounting grooves and the mounting plates when the shock is transmitted to the limit frames through the mounting plates, so that the shock-absorbing springs and the shock-absorbing cushions are extruded or stretched, and further the shock-absorbing springs and the shock-absorbing cushions deform, and the shock-absorbing and buffering electric components work, so that the interference of the electric components on the cabinet body and surrounding environment is reduced.

title_en: Preparation method of boron-chromium-nitrogen co-doped carbon-based oxygen reduction fuel cell cathode material
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of development of fuel cell cathode materials, and relates to a preparation method for preparing a boron-chromium-nitrogen co-doped carbon-based oxygen reduction fuel cell cathode material by Yang Meishan Ning modification based on white skin powder as a carbon source precursor. The hydrolysis product of the white skin powder is gelatin with rich active groups, the molecular structure of the gelatin is rich in amino, hydroxyl and other active groups, and the hydrolysis product can also be used for efficiently complexing various metal ions, and can be used as an electrocatalyst good carrier for anchoring various nano metal active components to prepare high catalytic activity and long service life. The invention takes hydrolysis product gelatin of white peel powder as a base material, and is compounded with boron element and chromium metal modified by waxberry tannin, and the high-performance low-cost waxberry tannin modified boron-chromium-nitrogen co-doped carbon-based oxygen reduction fuel cell cathode material is prepared by pyrolysis.

title_en: Composite polymer film for current collector, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a composite polymer film for a current collector, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the composite polymer film comprises a first polymer layer, a second polymer layer and a third polymer layer which are sequentially laminated; wherein the first polymer layer and the third polymer layer are both made of a combination of a first polyester material and a polyolefin material, and the second polymer layer is made of a second polyester material; in the first polymer layer, the mass ratio of the first polyester material to the polyolefin material is (20-60): 40-80; in the third polymer layer, the mass ratio of the first polyester material to the polyolefin material is (20-60): 40-80; the second polymer layer has a second polyester material content of 100wt%. The invention can reduce the polarity of the composite polymer film, solve the problem of film surface adhesion, and also can solve the problem of low adhesion between the metal layer and the composite polymer film, thereby improving the high-temperature cycle performance of the current collector.

title_en: Temporary cable lifting device for electric power overhaul
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric power overhaul, and particularly relates to a cable temporary lifting device for electric power overhaul, which comprises a supporting plate, supporting pieces, adjusting pieces and limiting pieces, wherein a bracket is fixedly arranged at the top of the supporting plate, a plurality of cable clamps are arranged on the bracket and uniformly distributed on the bracket, the adjusting pieces are arranged at the bottom of the supporting plate, the supporting pieces are symmetrically arranged at two sides of the center line of the supporting plate, each supporting piece comprises a sliding frame, a pulling piece and supporting legs, and the sliding frame is slidably arranged on the supporting plate. The cable supporting device can support cables on roads with different widths, the cable clamps can prevent the cables from falling off the device due to shaking, the supporting pieces are positioned at two ends of the supporting plate, and the supporting pieces can not influence travelling on the ground when supporting the cables, so that the supporting quality of the cables is ensured.

title_en: Regeneration method of vanadium electrolyte waste liquid
abstract_en: The invention provides a regeneration method of vanadium electrolyte waste liquid, which takes vanadium battery waste liquid as a raw material, filters insoluble impurities in the waste liquid through first filtration, adjusts the valence state of the electrolyte to be lower than trivalent through first electrolysis, and avoids flocculation caused by high valence state of vanadium ions; adding a flocculating agent to perform stirring to perform flocculation reaction, performing secondary filtration on impurity ions after flocculation, performing secondary electrolysis on the filtered vanadium electrolyte through an electrolysis device, separating out copper ions on a cathode electrode, putting the separated copper strips into a cathode liquid storage tank through flushing of the electrolyte, settling, removing copper ions introduced into the flocculating agent, and finally obtaining regenerated high-purity vanadium electrolyte after the electrolyte is adjusted to a target valence state; the whole method has the advantages of simple operation, low energy consumption, no pollution, high efficiency and short regeneration time.

title_en: High-power coil power supply with fast response to arbitrary wave and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fast response arbitrary wave high-power coil power supply and a control method, comprising the following steps: the main power supply circuit is used for providing high-power factor and high-power energy storage power supply, the power supply front-stage circuit filters the input three-phase power, outputs the three-phase power to the power supply rear-stage circuit after power factor adjustment to supply power for the energy storage power supply, and keeps high-voltage insulation and isolation with the rear-stage power supply circuit and the load; the power supply post-stage circuit realizes energy storage and accumulator and rapidly follows any heavy current and filtering stable output required by the control circuit; the control circuit is used for controlling the main power supply circuit to realize high-precision, quick response and high-power arbitrary wave output of the coil power supply; and specifically, according to a current setting instruction and a hardware enabling signal sent by the upper computer, performing control response based on the acquired current signal, and outputting a control result. The coil power supply can reach enough power in complex fusion experiments, has high response speed and high precision and can stably operate.

title_en: Local ordering method of graphite carbon material, graphite carbon material prepared by same and application of graphite carbon material in double-ion battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a local ordering method of a graphite carbon material, the graphite carbon material prepared by the method and application of the material in a double-ion battery. The method according to the invention comprises the following steps: 1) Dispersing active carbon and eighth group metal salt in water, stirring for 2-24h, and mixing uniformly; 2) Drying and fully grinding the mixed solution obtained in the step 1) to obtain a precursor, and roasting and carbonizing the precursor in an inert atmosphere; 3) And (3) cooling the product obtained in the step (2), washing with acid and water to remove residual metal particles, and drying to obtain the graphitized carbon anode material. According to the preparation method, the local micro-area structure of the active carbon is regulated so that the inside of the active carbon is converted from a completely disordered structure into an ordered-disordered structure, and the designability of the graphite anode material is improved. The preparation method fully utilizes the ion adsorption mechanism of the pore canal in the active carbon, increases the anion intercalation capacity of the double-ion battery in a high-voltage area, and remarkably improves the energy density.

title_en: Separator, secondary battery, sodium supplementing method of secondary battery, battery module, battery pack and power utilization device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of batteries, in particular to a separation membrane, a secondary battery and a sodium supplementing method thereof, a battery module, a battery pack and an electric device, wherein the separation membrane comprises a base membrane and a coating layer positioned on at least one side surface of the base membrane, the coating layer comprises a sodium supplementing agent, the isolating film with the structure and the composition, the positive pole piece and the negative pole piece are assembled together according to the conventional battery assembling process of the battery, and when the battery is charged and discharged, the sodium supplementing agent is decomposed into sodium ions and byproducts which can be separated from the isolating film, and the byproducts are separated from the sodium battery in the heating process after the formation. Because the byproducts are separated from the battery as much as possible, the content of the residual byproducts in the battery is limited and/or the influence on anode and cathode materials or electrolyte is small, and the decomposed sodium ions are used for compensating the active sodium ions lost in the first charge and discharge cycle, thereby being beneficial to improving the capacity and the cycle life of the battery.

title_en: Insulating tube body for fuse and fuse
abstract_en: The application provides an insulating tube body for a fuse and the fuse, wherein the insulating tube body is provided with a first penetrating cavity for placing melt of the fuse, the tube wall of the insulating tube body is provided with at least one second penetrating cavity, the at least one second penetrating cavity is communicated with the first penetrating cavity, the volume of the at least one second penetrating cavity is smaller than that of the first penetrating cavity, the at least one second penetrating cavity is filled with an arc extinguishing layer, the arc extinguishing layer is formed by arc extinguishing materials, when the melt begins to fuse, the arc extinguishing materials in a target penetrating cavity are decomposed by heating, and arc extinguishing gas is generated to blow the melt in the first penetrating cavity from a connecting port of the target penetrating cavity and the first penetrating cavity, wherein the target penetrating cavity is one of the at least one second penetrating cavity. Therefore, a small amount of arc extinguishing materials are used for pressurizing and blowing an arc to a fused mass fusing part, so that the generated gas quantity is reduced, the total pressure in a pipe body is reduced, and the explosion-proof capacity and breaking capacity of the fuse can be improved.

title_en: Hydropower plant operation control method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a hydropower plant operation control method, a hydropower plant operation control device, an electronic device and a storage medium, wherein the hydropower plant at least comprises: the system comprises a monitoring device, a factory bus, a diesel generator, a backup switching device, a backup power switch, a main power supply switch and a plurality of load switches, wherein the monitoring device is used for executing the method, and the method comprises the following steps: under the condition that a power failure event occurs in a hydropower plant, determining a first operation state of a backup power switching device in the hydropower plant, and under the condition that the first operation state is a non-operation state, determining diesel oil level information and fault detection information of a diesel generator in the hydropower plant, wherein the diesel oil level information indicates: under the condition that the oil level of the diesel generator reaches the standard and the fault detection information indicates that the diesel generator has no fault, a first control instruction is executed for the hydropower plant, and the diesel generator in the hydropower plant can be quickly and automatically controlled to be started to restore load power supply after a power failure event occurs in the hydropower plant.

title_en: Negative electrode and secondary battery comprising same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a negative electrode comprising: a negative electrode current collector; a negative electrode active material layer disposed on at least one surface of the negative electrode current collector and containing a negative electrode active material; and a coating layer containing a negative (N-type) organic active material, wherein the negative active material layer includes an inclined portion provided on at least one side thereof by dividing the negative active material layer, and a flat portion excluding the inclined portion, the inclined portion being inclined toward a surface of the negative current collector, and the coating layer is provided on at least a portion of the inclined portion.

title_en: ISCC-based collaborative allocation system for producing hydrogen by electrolyzing water
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of hydrogen production by water electrolysis, and particularly discloses a collaborative allocation system and a collaborative allocation system for hydrogen production by water electrolysis based on ISCC, wherein the collaborative allocation system comprises the following components: the system comprises an energy supply system and an electric energy allocation system, wherein the energy supply system comprises a photo-thermal power supply module, a fuel gas power supply module and a waste heat power supply module, and the electric energy allocation system comprises a first monitoring module, a second monitoring module, a third monitoring module and an allocation module; the photo-thermal power supply module and the fuel gas power supply module are used for supplying power for hydrogen production by water electrolysis in real time; the waste heat power supply module is connected with the photo-thermal power supply module and the fuel gas power supply module through steam pipelines. The beneficial effects of the application are as follows: the application monitors and regulates the power supply in real time: the method can monitor the electric energy output values of the photo-thermal power supply module, the gas power supply module and the thermal energy storage module in real time, and regulate and control the electric energy output values according to preset values so as to meet the electric power requirement of real-time water electrolysis hydrogen production.

title_en: Control chip terminal cartridge device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control chip terminal plugging device, which relates to the technical field of new energy forklifts and comprises a mounting frame, wherein a conveying belt is arranged on the outer wall of the mounting frame, and a driving wheel, a plugging mechanism and a moving mechanism are rotatably connected inside the mounting frame. According to the invention, the connecting seat is driven to move to the lower part of the pushing block by the movement of the conveying belt through the arrangement of the inserting mechanism and the moving mechanism, the pushing block is driven to move downwards by the operation of the electric push rod, the pushing block is contacted with the terminal to move downwards, the terminal cannot move downwards at the moment, so that the supporting plate and the movable rod are driven to move downwards, when the supporting plate moves to the upper part of the chip, the fixing frame moves to be separated from the fixing groove at the moment, the fixing of the limiting block is canceled, the terminal moves downwards along the placing groove and is inserted into the chip, the process of grabbing the terminal is conveniently omitted, the terminal is directly subjected to inserting operation, and the conveying belt is driven to quantitatively move by the power for terminal inserting.

title_en: Flexible stretching photovoltaic module and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of photovoltaics, and particularly discloses a flexible stretching photovoltaic module and a manufacturing method thereof. The flexible stretched photovoltaic module comprises a flexible substrate and a photovoltaic device. The flexible substrate is divided into a plurality of flexible bearing units by the cutting slits in a transverse and longitudinal linear cutting mode, and connecting parts which are positioned at corners of each flexible bearing unit and are used for connecting adjacent flexible bearing units are arranged; each flexible bearing unit respectively bears one photovoltaic device, and different photovoltaic devices are connected in series-parallel through wires. After the photovoltaic module generates stretching or bending stress, stress and deformation can be concentrated at the position of the connecting part, so that the flexible and stretchable integrated structure is realized, and the problems of easy damage and inflexibility existing when the mature commercial photovoltaic device is used for supplying energy to portable wearable equipment are solved from the angle of an integrated flexible substrate.

title_en: Construction site temporary charging and replacing station with protective structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a temporary charging and replacing station of a construction station with a protective structure, and relates to the technical field of temporary charging and replacing stations. The electric pile is firmly limited by angle irons, fixed lug plates and fixed stop rods, others cannot steal the electric pile, so that the electric pile is protected, when the electric pile is not used, the dust guard can automatically slide downwards to seal the charging slot of the electric pile, so that external sundries cannot enter the charging slot, the problem that the electric equipment of a construction station needs to be temporarily provided with a power exchange station when being charged, the electric pile is exposed outside during charging, multiple limitation is needed to be carried out on the electric pile in a carriage, otherwise, the electric pile can be stolen by outsiders, and meanwhile, the charging position of the electric pile is also required to be sealed and protected, otherwise, the external sundries enter the charging position to cause damage is solved.

title_en: Battery thermal runaway protection structure
abstract_en: The application relates to a battery thermal runaway protection structure, which comprises a heat insulation part, an explosion-proof valve and a fire-retarding and heat-releasing part, wherein the fire-retarding and heat-releasing part is arranged and covered on one side of a battery cell group, which is away from a battery tray, so as to prevent flame generated by the battery cell group from spreading towards a vehicle body chassis, the heat insulation part is arranged on one side of the vehicle body chassis, which is towards the fire-retarding and heat-releasing part, so as to prevent heat of the flame from being transferred towards the vehicle body chassis, the heat insulation part and the fire-retarding and heat-releasing part are arranged at intervals to form an exhaust cavity, and the explosion-proof valve is used for exhausting gas in the exhaust cavity. The battery thermal runaway protection structure provided by the application solves the problem that the existing scheme for controlling the battery thermal runaway is poor in overall effect.

title_en: Energy-generating and energy-storing system coupled with PVT by compressed air and pumped storage
abstract_en: The invention provides a capacity energy storage system which utilizes compressed air, pumped storage and PVT coupling, the coupling system comprises a pumped storage power generation unit, a compressed air energy storage unit and a compressed air power generation unit, wherein the pumped storage uses an upper water storage space and a lower water storage space for energy storage and power generation, an upper gas storage space and a lower gas storage space formed when an air compressor is used for coupling the pumped storage and the power generation are used for energy storage and turbine power generation, the coupling system also comprises a connection of the pumped storage unit and the compressed air energy storage power generation unit, a connection of a PVT photovoltaic photo-thermal reheating unit and a turbine power generation unit, an inlet of a high-pressure energy storage gas storage unit is connected with an air compressor, a gas inlet of a solar reheating unit is communicated with an outlet of the high-pressure energy storage gas storage unit, and the turbine power generation unit comprises a turbine which is communicated with a gas outlet of the solar reheating unit, and the turbine, the water pump, the water turbine and the air compressor are all electrically communicated with a PVT plate. The invention realizes the comprehensive energy-storage utilization of the local photoelectric storage and the wind, light and thermal power energy storage, and realizes the pumped storage of the totally-enclosed reservoir.

title_en: Separator and battery pack
abstract_en: A partition member has a thickness direction and a surface direction orthogonal to the thickness direction, and partitions between unit cells constituting a battery pack or between unit cells constituting the battery pack and members other than the unit cells in the thickness direction. The partition member is characterized by having a fluid having a boiling point of 80-250 ℃ at normal pressure and a fluid flow path extending in the plane direction, the fluid being held by a fluid holding portion, and the fluid holding portion being sealed by a packaging material.

title_en: Ring main unit
abstract_en: The invention provides a ring main unit with an arc-preventing structure, which is characterized by comprising a cable chamber and a pressure release chamber, wherein the cable chamber is used for accommodating at least one cable cone, the pressure release chamber is connected with the cable chamber and is used for discharging air flow and/or heat generated by an arc outside the ring main unit when the arc occurs at the position of the at least one cable cone, and a double-layer arc-striking structure is arranged on a top plate and side plates on the left side and the right side of the cable chamber. The ring main unit can effectively guide the arc generated by the cable cone arcing, reasonably distributes the pressure relief channels, and is convenient for rapidly releasing the pressure when the arcing air pressure rapidly rises.

title_en: Gas diffusion layer for fuel cell, preparation method of gas diffusion layer and fuel cell
abstract_en: The application provides a gas diffusion layer for a fuel cell, a preparation method of the gas diffusion layer and the fuel cell, and belongs to the field of fuel cells. The waterproof coating comprises a basal layer, wherein the content of the waterproof agent in a plurality of basal level intervals of the basal layer is gradually decreased from a basal initial interval, a microporous layer is arranged on the outer side surface of the basal layer, and the content of the waterproof agent in a plurality of microporous level intervals of the microporous layer is gradually increased from the porous initial interval. The application designs a graded gas diffusion layer microporous layer, wherein the position of a gas inlet close to a runner adopts high water drainage, so that water brought by gas can be well discharged, the position close to a catalytic layer adopts low water drainage, and the produced water is led in to prevent overdry; the air outlet is close to the runner and is arranged in a low-hydrophobic mode, and the air outlet is close to the catalytic layer and is arranged in a high-hydrophobic mode, so that water is discharged, the uniformity of overall water-gas distribution is guaranteed, and the uniformity of mass transfer of the membrane electrode is guaranteed. Thereby improving the drainage and mass transfer capacity of the microporous layer of the gas diffusion layer of the fuel cell.

title_en: Method and system for preventing fault misalignment in CT secondary neutral line disconnection time zone
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for preventing fault misalignment in a CT secondary neutral line disconnection time zone, wherein the method comprises the steps of setting a single-phase fault phase zone distinguishing element in a zone formed by sequence component differential flows, distinguishing faults in the zone by adopting split-phase differential motion combined with positive and negative sequence differential flows when a line is in non-full-phase operation, when the line is in three-phase operation, the split-phase differential motion only has one phase meeting an action condition, the single phase is jumped when the multiple phases meet the action condition, and when the multiple phases meet the zero sequence or negative sequence differential flow, the single-phase fault is jumped if the phase zone distinguishing element judges the single-phase fault, otherwise the three phases are jumped when the zero sequence differential motion meets the action condition, and when the single-phase fault is judged by the phase zone distinguishing element, otherwise the three-phase is jumped after the differential motion protection is started, the fault phase is not jumped or the positive and negative sequence differential motion is returned. According to the invention, through the single-phase fault phase zone distinguishing element in the zone and the recovery jump command when no current or positive and negative sequence differential motion of the fault phase is returned, the condition of misalignment caused by CT secondary neutral line disconnection during single-phase fault in the circuit zone can be prevented.

title_en: Multi-level low-voltage transformer area topology identification method and related system based on linear regression
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of low-voltage power distribution of power systems, and discloses a multi-level low-voltage transformer area topology identification method based on linear regression and a related system, and combining the voltage load curve and the current data, the connection relation between each meter box in the low-voltage transformer area and the branch nodes, the main circuit and the transformer can be more accurately identified, and the identification error is reduced. The invention can effectively process and analyze the complex connection relation between the table box and the branch nodes by utilizing the multi-scale similarity measurement and hierarchical clustering method, and solves the problem of difficult identification when facing the complex topological structure in the traditional method. According to the invention, through automatically acquiring and processing the voltage load data, the current data and the correlation information thereof, the manual intervention can be greatly reduced, and the topology identification efficiency is improved.

title_en: Rotor structure of radial superconducting motor and radial superconducting motor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rotor structure of a radial superconducting motor and the radial superconducting motor, and belongs to the field of motors. A rotor structure of a radial superconducting motor comprises a rotor core and superconducting magnets, wherein the rotor core comprises a plurality of rotor teeth and rotor yokes, the rotor teeth are distributed at equal intervals in the circumferential direction of the rotor core, all the rotor teeth are identical in structure, and the superconducting magnets are wound on the rotor yokes of the rotor core in a straddling mode and distributed at equal intervals in the circumferential direction. The superconducting magnet is wound on the yoke part of the rotor core in a straddling way, so that the utilization rate of the rotor space is improved to increase the pole pair number of the motor, further, the saturation of iron teeth is reduced, and the power density of the motor is improved. The problems that a superconducting magnet of a superconducting motor occupies a large circumferential space of the motor, iron teeth of the superconducting motor are saturated, the pole pair number of the motor is limited, and the power density of the motor is difficult to improve are solved. The radial superconducting motor has the beneficial effects of improving the power density of the radial superconducting motor, reducing the structural complexity and simplifying the processing flow.

title_en: Structure of micro-grid battery energy storage integrated device convenient for operation and maintenance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a convenient operation and maintenance structure of a micro-grid battery energy storage integrated device, which comprises a steel machine frame, a front panel, an upper cover plate and a lower cover plate, wherein the machine frame is formed by welding a front plate, a rear panel, a right side plate, a left side plate, a right partition plate, a left partition plate and a middle partition plate, the front panel is arranged in front of the machine frame, the upper cover plate is arranged at an upper opening, the lower cover plate is arranged at a lower opening, the right partition plate and the left partition plate longitudinally divide the machine frame into an alternating current box, a current box and a direct current box, and the middle partition plate is connected with the rear panel and divides the current box into a current upper chamber, a current lower chamber and a current front chamber. The invention has the characteristics of simplicity and rationality, and is easy to produce and manufacture, low in cost, convenient to operate and maintain after the micro-grid battery energy storage comprehensive device is installed and used, rapid and timely in fault judgment and treatment, and beneficial to improving the use effect and popularization and application.

title_en: High-performance fast temperature control all-solid-state square battery and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of solid-state batteries, in particular to a high-performance quick-temperature-control all-solid-state square battery and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: the shell, the clamp plate, the bottom plate, the apron, roll up the core, negative pole busbar, anodal busbar and liquid guide fastening plug, two liquid guide fastening plug are located between clamp plate and the bottom plate, roll up the core stromatolite and set up on two liquid guide fastening plug and both ends compress tightly through clamp plate and bottom plate, negative pole busbar and anodal busbar are connected with the negative pole utmost point ear and the anodal utmost point ear of rolling up the core both sides respectively, the apron lid is located on the clamp plate and the anodal post of apron, negative pole utmost point post is connected with anodal busbar, negative pole busbar respectively, the shell cover is located and is rolled up outside the core and both ends are sealed with apron, the bottom plate respectively and are connected, the both ends of liquid guide fastening plug are exposed through apron and bottom plate respectively. The invention solves the problem of poor heat dissipation capability of the battery core, improves the cycle rate performance and the service life of the battery, and has simple assembly, safety and reliability.

title_en: Membrane electrode, preparation method thereof and fuel cell
abstract_en: The invention provides a membrane electrode, a preparation method thereof and a fuel cell. The method for preparing the membrane electrode comprises the steps of providing a proton exchange membrane, forming a first electrode catalytic layer and a first microporous layer on the first surface, wherein the first electrode catalytic layer is in contact with the first surface, the first microporous layer is positioned on the surface, far away from the proton exchange membrane, of the first electrode catalytic layer, and forming a second electrode catalytic layer on the second surface. One of the first electrode catalytic layer and the second electrode catalytic layer is a cathode catalytic layer, and the other is an anode catalytic layer. The first microporous layer is formed on one side of the proton exchange membrane and is directly adjacent to the first catalytic electrode layer, so that the resistance of the membrane electrode when in operation is smaller when the gas is transmitted to the first catalytic electrode layer, mass transfer overpotential of the membrane electrode can be reduced, and further the performance of the membrane electrode can be improved.

title_en: Start-up system for fuel cell
abstract_en: The invention discloses a starting system for a fuel cell, which comprises a first control component, a heating component, a heat exchange component and a humidifying component, wherein the first control component is suitable for being communicated with a fuel cell stack so that the first control component controls the flow of cooling liquid flowing out of the fuel cell stack, one end of the heat exchange component is filled with compressed air, the humidifying component is communicated with the other end of the heat exchange component so that the compressed air subjected to heat exchange by the heat exchange component flows into the humidifying component to increase the humidity of the compressed air flowing into the humidifying component, and the humidifying component is suitable for being communicated with the fuel cell stack so that the compressed air humidified by the humidifying component flows into the fuel cell stack. The starting system for the fuel cell has the advantages of simple structure, capability of ensuring the temperature and humidity of the air entering the stack, and the like.

title_en: EMS energy management system for producing hydrogen by photovoltaic off-grid coupling PEM (proton exchange membrane) electrolyzed water
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy management, and particularly discloses an EMS energy management system for producing hydrogen by coupling PEM (electro-mechanical system) electrolytic water through photovoltaic off-grid, which comprises an energy acquisition module, a power analysis module, a model construction module, an energy efficiency analysis module and an energy regulation module, wherein the energy acquisition module divides a PEM electrolytic water hydrogen production system into a plurality of units according to functions to acquire time interval distribution power, the power analysis module performs comparative analysis on the time interval distribution power of the units and a required power range to obtain input energy passing units, judges whether the power matching of each unit needs analysis, if the power matching of the units needs analysis, constructs an energy efficiency evaluation model of each unit, calculates an energy efficiency evaluation value and judges whether the power of the input energy passing unit needs regulation, and the energy regulation module adjusts the input power if the power of the input energy passing unit needs regulation.

title_en: Wind power plant high-voltage fault simulation method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power plant high-voltage fault simulation method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a high-voltage fault simulation model to simulate an asymmetric high-voltage fault of a wind power plant, performing fault simulation under the condition that a wind power plant is controlled by a fan controller to be empty, obtaining target grid-connected point bus voltage rising data, determining target asymmetric high-voltage fault parameters of the high-voltage fault simulation model according to the target grid-connected point bus voltage rising data, performing fault simulation under the condition that the wind power plant is controlled by the fan controller to be loaded, and performing the asymmetric high-voltage fault simulation in the high-voltage fault simulation model based on the target asymmetric high-voltage fault parameters.

title_en: Concentrated stator winding, stator and motor
abstract_en: The invention provides a concentrated stator winding, a stator and a motor, wherein any phase winding is formed by winding a wire, each phase winding comprises a plurality of winding coils which are sequentially arranged along the circumferential direction of a stator core, adjacent winding coils are connected through connecting overwires, the connecting overwires are arranged on the radial inner side of each phase winding, a wire inlet end and a wire outlet end of each phase winding are arranged on the same winding coil, and the wire inlet end and the wire outlet end are arranged on any layer between two axial sides of the winding coils. The invention has the beneficial effects that the radial outer side of the stator winding is not provided with a connecting overline, so that the outer side diameter of the stator core can be increased, the output torque and the output power of the motor are further improved, the technical process is simplified, and the production cost is reduced.

title_en: Permanent magnet motor and assembly structure of rotating transformer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a permanent magnet motor and a rotary transformer assembly structure, which belongs to the technical field of motors and comprises a motor rotating shaft, a stator iron core, a rotor iron core, a base, a bearing inner cover, a rotary transformer stator, a rotary transformer rotor and an end cover. And setting a datum line on the rotary rotor, the rotary stator and the stator core respectively, wherein the datum line is overlapped with a special line on the corresponding rotor core, the bearing inner cover and the stand respectively. The bearing inner cover and the stator core are detachably connected and can rotate relative to the central shaft to adjust the relative position. In the generation process of a single batch of motors, the relative position relationship among the rotor and the rotor core, the rotor and the bearing inner cover of each motor and the stator core and the base is formed into specific standardization for assembly through positioning control, so that the consistency of the electrical angles of the motors in the same batch is improved, potential variable parameters in the motor debugging process are reduced, and the debugging program is simplified.

title_en: Electric connection assembly and charging device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electrical connection assembly and a charging device. The electrical connection assembly comprises a sealing member, a cable, a charging terminal, a temperature sensor and a sealing plug, wherein the cable is provided with a cable through hole and a jack, the cable passes through the cable through hole and is in interference fit with the cable through hole, the charging terminal is electrically connected to the cable, the temperature sensor is used for detecting the temperature of the charging terminal, the sealing plug is arranged on a lead of the temperature sensor and is inserted into the jack of the sealing member in an interference fit mode, the electrical connection assembly is suitable for being inserted into a mounting hole on a shell of the charging device, the sealing member is used for sealing a rear port of the mounting hole, and the sealing plug is extruded between the sealing member and the lead and is used for sealing between the lead and the sealing plug and the sealing member. In the invention, the temperature sensor can be quickly assembled to the sealing member of the cable through the sealing plug, so that the temperature sensor can be inserted into the housing of the charging device along with the charging terminal and the cable, thereby improving the assembly efficiency.

title_en: Silver microparticles
abstract_en: The present invention provides silver microparticles having a large volume shrinkage and high conductivity. The silver microparticles have a particle diameter of 0.1-1 [ mu ] m as measured by the BET method, a volume resistance value of 15 [ mu ] Ω & cm or less after firing in a granular state at 100 ℃ for 1 hour in a nitrogen atmosphere, and a volume shrinkage of 5% or more.

title_en: Multifunctional working lamp
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional working lamp, which relates to the technical field of lighting equipment and comprises an adjusting mechanism and a conducting strip arranged in the adjusting mechanism, wherein one side of the adjusting mechanism is provided with a bracket mechanism, one side of the bracket mechanism is provided with a fixed sleeve, the adjusting mechanism comprises a lamp support, one side of the inside of the lamp support is fixedly provided with a connecting rod, one side of the connecting rod, which is far away from the lamp support, is provided with a plurality of fixed holes, one end of the lamp support, which is close to the connecting rod, is fixedly provided with a mounting sleeve, the bottom of the mounting sleeve is fixedly provided with a fixed fluted disc, when a clamping fixed plate is separated from the fixed fluted disc, a limiting block is driven to slide in the inside of a horizontal rotating groove by rotating a connecting bracket, and a fixed lamp plate and a rotating lamp are driven to rotate by rotating a first rotating handle, so that the rotating lamp and a light source of a moving lamp are converged, the irradiation brightness is improved, and the lamp is manually operated to adapt to a complex lighting environment.

title_en: Flexible interconnection photovoltaic platform region global optimization regulation and control method based on sequence quadratic programming
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible interconnection photovoltaic platform region global optimization regulation method based on sequence quadratic programming, which comprises the steps of selecting a direct current port of a converter to adopt a constant voltage control strategy for maintaining voltage stability of a direct current bus, adopting a constant power control strategy for the direct current port of the converter of the rest platform region, reading data information of the platform region to generate real-time data, obtaining final tide information by deducing and regenerating nodes of a flexible interconnection system of a multi-platform region, calculating power loss on the direct current bus by using a power transmission loss coefficient, obtaining constraint conditions among powers, optimizing the power loss in step S3 by using an SQP optimization algorithm, obtaining a power control instruction of the flexible interconnection system of the multi-platform region, and completing regulation optimization. The invention realizes the maximum absorption of photovoltaic resources, and plays a certain role in regulating and controlling the voltage of each node through the 'active-reactive' cooperative voltage regulation.

title_en: Method and system for increasing the service life of a converter switch
abstract_en: The application relates to a method for increasing the service life of a converter switch (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4) in a system (10) comprising an energy source (PV) attached on a DC bus (DC+, DC-) jointly with a DC/DC converter (12) comprising the converter switch (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4). The method comprises the steps of determining a system state in which the electrical power of the energy source (PV) is available, for which no transmission via the DC/DC converter (12) and no output to further participants of the DC bus (DC+, DC-) are provided, and operating the DC/DC converter (12) during the determined system state such that a loss of power is generated in the DC/DC converter (12) without transmitting power via the DC/DC converter (12). The application further relates to a system (10) having an energy source (PV) and a DC/DC converter (12) having converter switches (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4), and to an energy generation installation having such a system.

title_en: External ring main unit dehumidification anti-condensation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an external ring main unit dehumidifying and condensation preventing device, which comprises a cabinet body, wherein two groups of ventilation seats are arranged in the cabinet body, net machine components are arranged on the surface of the ventilation seats below the cabinet body, an inner plate component is arranged in the cabinet body, the inner plate component comprises a partition plate and a guide plate, the partition plate is arranged at the peripheral position, close to the net machine components, of the cabinet body, an airflow channel is formed between the partition plate and the cabinet body, buckling grooves are respectively formed at the upper side and the lower side of the interior of the cabinet body, close to the partition plate, the partition plate is connected with the output ends of two groups of execution electric cylinders through a C-shaped frame, and the execution electric cylinders drive the partition plate to move up and down in the interior of the cabinet body.

title_en: High-molecular weight polyethylene insulating layer module capable of being secondarily formed for high-voltage cable
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-molecular weight polyethylene insulating layer module of a high-voltage cable capable of being secondarily formed, and relates to the field of high-voltage cable welding, comprising a module, wherein the module is in a semicircular tube shape, clamping blocks are integrally connected to the bottom of the module, the clamping blocks are bent towards one side at right angles, the number of the clamping blocks is two, and the two clamping blocks are bent towards the same side at the bottom of the module; two modules are matched with one another for use, the two modules are clamped through clamping blocks, and the two modules are centrally symmetrical. The invention realizes the secondary molding effect of the module by low-temperature stamping and secondary heating during production and is used, in addition, the high-molecular-weight polyethylene module has better wear resistance and corrosion resistance and better impact resistance and tensile resistance, and the insulating layer is welded by assembling two modules by arranging the modules, and the two modules are clamped, so that the mounting step of the module can be effectively simplified, and the welding operation of the insulating layer is faster and more convenient.

title_en: Photovoltaic inverter monitoring and metering device, system and monitoring and metering method
abstract_en: The application provides a photovoltaic inverter monitoring and metering device which is arranged at a photovoltaic inverter side and comprises a communication module, a control module and a power module, wherein the communication module comprises at least one input interface and at least two output interfaces, the input interface is connected with the photovoltaic inverter, the at least two output interfaces are respectively connected with a first 4G module and a second 4G interface, the first 4G module is in communication connection with a photovoltaic monitoring platform, the second 4G interface is in communication connection with the photovoltaic metering platform, the control module is in communication connection with the communication module and is used for collecting data of the photovoltaic inverter and reversely regulating and controlling the photovoltaic inverter, the control module controls the at least one input interface to be in single-line or parallel communication with the at least two output interfaces, and the power module is arranged at an input interface end and is respectively connected with the communication module, the control module and a storage module and is used for converting voltage and supplying power.

title_en: Motor unit and working machine with motor unit
abstract_en: The invention provides a motor unit and a working machine with the motor unit. The motor unit is used for enabling the operation unit to operate. The motor unit includes a main body case including a 1 st case and a2 nd case, an accommodation space being defined between the 1 st case and the 2 nd case, the 1 st case and the 2 nd case defining an entire outer shape of the main body case, a motor disposed in the accommodation space, an output unit capable of being fixed to the operation unit and operating the operation unit when the motor is operated, a battery connection terminal exposed to an outside of the main body case and capable of being connected to a battery for supplying electric power to the motor, and a control unit disposed in the accommodation space and controlling the motor. Accordingly, a motor unit that can be used for a low-output work unit is provided.

title_en: Cooling structure for whole-pack recycling energy storage charging station of retired power battery for vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooling structure for an integral package recycling energy storage charging station of a retired power battery for a vehicle, which comprises a heat radiation plate, an air supply pipeline, an air return pipeline and an air return pipeline, wherein the heat radiation plate is provided with a relative conduction surface and a heat radiation surface, the conduction surface is attached to the top surface or the bottom surface of the battery package, heat radiation fins are arranged on the heat radiation surface, the air supply pipeline is positioned at the head end of the extending direction of the heat radiation fins and is provided with an air outlet, the air outlet direction of the air outlet is consistent with the extending direction of the heat radiation fins, the air return pipeline is positioned at the tail end of the extending direction of the heat radiation fins and is provided with an air return port, the air return direction of the air return port is consistent with the extending direction of the heat radiation fins, and the battery in an energy storage box can be charged and discharged in a charging and discharging environment with ideal temperature, so that the multiplexing performance of the waste battery is improved, and the quality of the energy storage box is improved.

title_en: Preparation method of lithium battery cathode and lithium battery
abstract_en: The application relates to a preparation method of a lithium battery negative electrode and a lithium battery, and relates to the field of new energy, the method comprises the following steps of carrying out coaxial electrostatic spinning on a core solution and a shell solution to obtain a fiber membrane, carrying out carbonization treatment on the fiber membrane to obtain a carbon fiber membrane, carrying out heat treatment on the carbon fiber membrane in an ammonia atmosphere to obtain a current collector, preparing lithium metal on the surface of the current collector to obtain a prefabricated negative electrode, and carrying out pressing treatment on the prefabricated negative electrode to obtain the lithium battery negative electrode, wherein the fiber of the fiber membrane has a core structure and a shell structure, the core structure is coated with the core solution, the core solution is used for forming the core structure, the shell solution is used for forming the shell structure, the core solution comprises a carbonizable first polymer, the shell solution comprises a salt substance and a carbonizable second polymer, and metal elements of the salt substance are at least one of chromium, nickel, cobalt, manganese, iron, copper, molybdenum and zinc. The application can easily obtain the lithium battery cathode with very thin thickness.

title_en: Primary frequency modulation control method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a primary frequency modulation control method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method and the device are applied to the electronic equipment and are used for controlling real-time load of a thermal power generating set, and particularly, a plurality of first measurement and control parameters and a plurality of second measurement and control parameters of the thermal power generating set are acquired, the first measurement and control parameters are processed based on a slip-load curve to obtain a turbine valve position comprehensive instruction, the second measurement and control parameters are processed to obtain a small frequency difference comprehensive feedforward amount, and the valve adjustment control is performed on a turbine of the thermal power generating set based on the turbine valve position comprehensive instruction and the small frequency difference comprehensive feedforward amount. The small-frequency-difference comprehensive feedforward quantity is overlapped to the valve position comprehensive instruction of the steam turbine to drive each valve adjusting action of the steam turbine, so that the real-time load of the thermal generator set is controlled to rise and fall, and the primary frequency modulation adjusting effect is improved.

title_en: Physical vapor deposition machine
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a physical vapor deposition machine, wherein a radio frequency coil is positioned between the inner side of a process cavity and a process kit, so that the process cavity has a simple sealing structure and thoroughly solves the problem of electromagnetic interference. The first sleeve member of the single-layer Faraday cage structure is adopted at the inner side of the process sleeve member, so that the shielding effect of the Faraday cage structure on the electromagnetic field generated by the radio frequency coil is effectively reduced, and the transmission efficiency of the electromagnetic field is improved.
