The second sleeve member made of the insulating material is added to the outer side of the single-layer faraday cage structure, so that sputtered ions can be effectively prevented from penetrating through gaps of the faraday cage structure, and the radio frequency coil and the inside of the process cavity are damaged. The process kit is relatively simple in structure, easy to detach, maintain and adjust and convenient to install. The radio frequency coil is fixed in the process cavity and is positioned at the outer side of the second sleeve, the radio frequency coil is protected by the second sleeve and is prevented from being corroded, and the radio frequency coil is detachable and convenient to maintain and adjust.

title_en: Method for improving consistency and corrosion resistance of magnetic properties of NdFeB
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving consistency and corrosion resistance of magnetic properties of neodymium iron boron, relates to the technical field of sintered neodymium iron boron rare earth permanent magnet materials, and aims to solve the problem that the consistency and corrosion resistance of coercive force of a neodymium iron boron magnet are difficult to meet production requirements simultaneously; the invention comprises the steps of uniformly spraying alloy powder of Dy or/and Tb on two orientation planes of a prepared sintered neodymium-iron-boron magnet, uniformly spraying fluoride powder of Dy or/and Tb on the two orientation planes of the sintered neodymium-iron-boron magnet after spraying the alloy powder, and carrying out heat treatment to obtain a neodymium-iron-boron magnet product.

title_en: Small sample photovoltaic prediction method based on instance migration learning and hybrid neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small sample photovoltaic prediction method based on an instance transfer learning and hybrid neural network, and selecting a source domain instance similar to the target domain based on the migration learning of the instance for training the model, and migrating the model to the target task. Meanwhile, an efficient hybrid neural network prediction model is built, the model combines the advantages of a long-term memory network (LSTM) algorithm and a fractional forest regression (QRF) algorithm, the LSTM is responsible for mining deep patterns in time sequence data through a parallel training strategy, and the QRF is focused on probability distribution of a prediction result. The model is innovative in that a weighting network is introduced, the weight is dynamically adjusted according to the prediction performance of LSTM and QRF, so that the optimal comprehensive prediction effect is realized, and finally, the photovoltaic prediction is carried out by using the trained hybrid neural network prediction model, so that the reliability is high.

title_en: Power generation power prediction method and system for photovoltaic power station
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power stations, and discloses a method and a system for predicting the power generated by a photovoltaic power station, wherein the photovoltaic power station is divided into a plurality of data acquisition areas, and power generation influence data in each data acquisition area are acquired; the method comprises the steps of outputting a data influence value corresponding to each piece of power generation influence data to construct a plurality of power generation influence data sequences, respectively extracting the same category of power generation influence data from the power generation influence data sequences to construct a power generation influence data set, calculating a power generation power influence coefficient, obtaining actual power generation power in a current period, calculating a product value of the power generation power influence coefficient and the actual power generation power to serve as the predicted power generation power in the next period of the photovoltaic power station, accurately predicting the power generation power in the next period, guaranteeing prediction precision and prediction efficiency, further improving the power generation efficiency of the photovoltaic power station, and providing powerful support for optimal scheduling and stable operation of a power system.

title_en: Multi-time-scale coordination optimization scheduling method for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of multi-time-scale scheduling of power distribution networks, in particular to a multi-time-scale coordinated optimization scheduling method of a power distribution network. The technical scheme includes that the power distribution network multi-time-scale coordination optimization scheduling method comprises long-time-scale optimization scheduling, short-time-scale optimization scheduling and a coordination mechanism, wherein the long-time-scale optimization scheduling and the short-time-scale optimization scheduling are matched to form the power distribution network multi-time-scale coordination optimization scheduling method, and the coordination mechanism performs seamless connection and integral optimization on the long-time-scale optimization scheduling and the short-time-scale optimization scheduling. The multi-time-scale coordination optimization scheduling method for the power distribution network has the advantages of improving the system operation efficiency, enhancing the system stability, improving the economy and the flexibility, comprehensively considering multi-objective optimization and the like. The advantages enable the method to have important application value and development prospect in the optimal scheduling of the modern power system.

title_en: Balanced output method and terminal of shared direct current bus energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention provides an equalizing output method and terminal of a shared direct current bus energy storage system, comprising the steps of initializing an upper limit value and a lower limit value of a voltage sampling value of a direct current bus in the energy storage system, acquiring the working state of the energy storage system and the voltage sampling value of the direct current bus of each subsystem in real time, determining a first charge/discharge subsystem according to the voltage sampling value, acquiring the SOC of an electric cabinet in the first charge/discharge subsystem in real time, stopping the working of the first charge/discharge subsystem if the SOC of the electric cabinet is charged/discharged to a first charge value/first discharge value, setting an overvoltage threshold/undervoltage threshold of DC/DC in the first charge/discharge subsystem as the first overvoltage threshold/first undervoltage threshold, and repeating the steps for the rest subsystems until the overvoltage threshold/undervoltage threshold of DC/DC in each subsystem is set as the first overvoltage threshold/first undervoltage threshold. The invention can effectively solve the problem that the SOC balance of each subsystem is poorer and worse due to the fact that the energy storage system cannot be charged and discharged simultaneously.

title_en: Brightness adjusting system and method
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a brightness adjustment system and method. The brightness adjustment system includes a camera, a direction sensor, and a processor. The camera is configured to obtain an image based on the exposure setting and the gain. The orientation sensor is configured to obtain sensor data. The processor is configured to determine a current direction in which the camera is facing based on the sensor data, and adjust an exposure setting or gain of the camera based on the current direction.

title_en: Sodium iron pyrophosphate phosphate positive electrode material, preparation method thereof and battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sodium iron phosphate pyrophosphate positive electrode material, a preparation method thereof and a battery, and relates to the technical field of batteries. Wherein, tris-HCl buffer solution is used to control the pH value of the reaction in the hydrothermal reaction, so that the precursor is uniformly crystallized and has high crystallinity, and then the low-temperature sectional presintering is adopted, so that the compaction density of the material can be controlled, and the related electrical property of the material is better. The carbon source and the doping elements are supplemented twice in the preparation process, so that the carbon coating is uniform in the sintering process, the compaction density of the NFPP positive electrode material is further improved, and meanwhile, the doping and carbon coating modification can also enable the theoretical specific capacity and other performances of the positive electrode material to be better, so that the high-compaction and high-capacity ferric sodium phosphate positive electrode material is obtained.

title_en: Driving force lifting device of electromagnetic force driving mechanism and electromagnetic force driving structure
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a driving force lifting device for an electromagnetic force driving mechanism and an electromagnetic force driving mechanism, the driving force lifting device includes a frame structure and a driving rod, a coil frame and a plurality of high-energy permanent magnet units are arranged in the frame structure, the coil frame has a W-shaped loop structure, and a coil is wound on the coil frame. According to the embodiment of the disclosure, the through-flow of the electromagnetic force driving mechanism can be reduced or the electromagnetic force driving mechanism is prevented from being driven by a double system, the output force of the electromagnetic force driving mechanism can be increased through a W-shaped winding coil loop, and the electromagnetic force driving mechanism is more compact in structure through rearranging the arrangement form of the permanent magnets.

title_en: Surge protection failure detection circuit of railway communication equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a surge protection failure detection circuit of railway communication equipment, which comprises a first transistor, a first current-limiting protection branch, a fuse module, a second current-limiting protection branch, a first LED lamp, a second LED lamp, a fifth resistor, a voltage stabilizing tube and an oscillating circuit, wherein the positive electrode of the first current-limiting protection branch is connected to the positive electrode of a power supply, the negative electrode is connected to the negative electrode of the power supply through a collector electrode and an emitter electrode of the first transistor, one end of the fuse module is connected to the positive electrode of the power supply, the other end of the fuse module is connected to the positive electrode of the second current-limiting protection branch, the negative electrode of the second current-limiting protection branch is connected to the positive electrode of the first LED lamp, the negative electrode of the voltage stabilizing tube is connected to the connecting point of the first current-limiting protection branch and the first transistor through the fifth resistor, the negative electrode of the oscillating circuit is connected to the two ends of the voltage stabilizing tube, the output end of the oscillating circuit is connected to the positive electrode of the second LED lamp, and the negative electrode of the second LED lamp is connected to the negative electrode of the power supply. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of high reliability, striking reminding and the like.

title_en: Method and device for determining capacity allocation accuracy of super-capacity energy storage system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a capacity allocation accuracy rate determining method and device of a super-capacity energy storage system, and relates to the technical field of power grid frequency modulation, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a frequency modulation instruction and a decomposition layer number adopted by capacity allocation; and determining the capacity allocation accuracy of the capacity allocation of the super-capacity energy storage system represented by the second predicted decomposition purity obtained in the last cycle, wherein the smaller the second predicted decomposition purity is, the higher the capacity allocation accuracy is. The method provides an efficient and accurate assessment and determination method for the accuracy of the distribution of the capacity of the energy storage equipment in the super-capacity energy storage system.

title_en: AI-driven big data intelligent photovoltaic power generation monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AI-driven big data intelligent photovoltaic power generation monitoring method and system, relating to the technical field of photovoltaic systems; the method comprises the steps of creating a safety monitoring strategy of a power generation system, calculating a power generation threat value in each historical auditing round period, building a power generation threat prediction model to obtain the power generation threat value of the current auditing round period, carrying out fault analysis to output a fault monitoring result of photovoltaic power generation equipment, setting a task scheduling algorithm, outputting and generating an operation and maintenance task list according to the power generation threat value of the current auditing round period, including equipment maintenance, cleaning and replacement tasks, and tracking task execution conditions. The method can accurately predict the power generation threat value of the current auditing round period based on the historical data, provide scientific basis for operation and maintenance decision, adaptively adjust the strategy according to the current situation, and ensure continuous optimization and improvement of operation and maintenance work.

title_en: Fuel cell system, operation control method thereof and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fuel cells, and discloses a fuel cell system and an operation monitoring multi-objective optimal control method thereof. The invention judges whether the electric pile is in normal operation state by monitoring the frequency conversion impedance of the fuel cell electric pile, and timely adopts measures such as flow regulation, output voltage regulation, temperature regulation and the like according to the monitoring result, thereby ensuring the electric pile to operate in a healthy state and improving the working efficiency and service life of the electric pile. In addition, the operation working conditions of BOP components such as an air compressor and a hydrogen circulating pump are considered, the gas flow, the pressure and the temperature of the input fuel cell are optimized based on a plague green bird optimization algorithm, and the point with the minimum ratio of the consumption of the BOP system to the output power of the electric pile is found, namely the highest efficiency point of the system operation.

title_en: Control circuit compatible with multiple platforms, vehicle-mounted charger and control system
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of vehicle-mounted chargers, in particular to a control circuit compatible with multiple platforms, a vehicle-mounted charger and a control system, wherein the control circuit comprises a transformer T1, a primary winding W1, a first secondary winding W21 and a second secondary winding W22, a primary circuit coupled with the primary winding W1, one or more high-voltage secondary circuits, an input end of each high-voltage secondary circuit is coupled with the first secondary winding W21 and the second secondary winding W22, a switching unit, and for one high-voltage secondary circuit, the switching unit is arranged between the first secondary winding W21, the second secondary winding W22 and the high-voltage secondary circuits and used for switching the serial-parallel connection relation between the first secondary winding W21 and the second secondary winding W22, and for a plurality of high-voltage secondary circuits, the switching unit is arranged between output ends of the high-voltage secondary circuits and used for switching the serial-parallel connection relation between the output ends. The application has the effect of widening the output range of the vehicle-mounted charger, so that the same vehicle-mounted charger can meet the charging requirements of different vehicle-mounted batteries.

title_en: Source-storage-transportation combined planning method considering carbon emission responsibility allocation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy planning, in particular to a source-storage-transmission combined planning method considering carbon emission responsibility allocation, which comprises the steps of establishing a carbon emission responsibility double-layer allocation strategy; and solving the source-storage-transmission combined planning model considering the carbon responsibility allocation to obtain the optimal combined planning scheme of the system source-storage-network. According to the method, carbon emission responsibility is scientifically allocated according to the principle of 'who is caused, who is responsible, who is treated and who benefits', the role of the carbon emission responsibility in the planning process is effectively considered, an energy storage system is additionally arranged, the flexibility of the system is improved, and the renewable energy source is promoted to be consumed.

title_en: Pilot protection method of Sha Gehuang new energy base collection system based on amplitude-phase coefficient
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for pilot protection of a Sha Gehuang new energy base collection system based on an amplitude-phase coefficient, which comprises the following steps of obtaining a new energy side setting current of a collection line and a high-voltage direct-current side setting current of the collection line in a first sampling window based on the Sha Gehuang new energy base collection system to obtain an amplitude-phase coefficient setting value, obtaining the new energy side current of the collection line and the high-voltage direct-current side current of the collection line in a second sampling window to calculate the amplitude-phase coefficient, obtaining pilot protection criteria of the collection system according to the amplitude-phase coefficient and the amplitude-phase coefficient setting value, identifying Sha Gehuang fault types of the new energy base collection system according to the pilot protection criteria, and starting protection measures according to the fault types. The invention provides a Sha Gehuang new energy base collection system pilot protection method based on an amplitude-phase coefficient, which has reliable fault identification, full-line quick-action when faults occur, strong transitional resistance and noise resistance and wide application range.

title_en: Aluminum oxide copper chromium alloy material, preparation method and electrical contact
abstract_en: The invention provides an alumina copper chromium alloy material, a preparation method and an electric contact, wherein the material comprises, by weight, 0.02% -2.5% of alumina, 47.5% -49.98% of copper and the balance of chromium and unavoidable impurities. The preparation method of the material comprises the steps of blank preparation, infiltration treatment and annealing treatment. The method comprises the steps of respectively preparing an alumina dispersion copper alloy body and a chromium blank, stacking the alumina dispersion copper alloy body and the chromium blank in a die, performing infiltration under a high-temperature vacuum condition to obtain an infiltration alloy body, and annealing the infiltration alloy body to obtain the alumina copper chromium alloy material. The prepared alloy material has excellent wear resistance, arc ablation resistance and mechanical property by optimizing the proportion content of copper, chromium and aluminum oxide in the alloy material. The material is used for manufacturing an electric contact component of the high-voltage vacuum circuit breaker, improves the breaking performance of an electric contact, and realizes the high reliability and long service life of the high-voltage vacuum circuit breaker.

title_en: Coil assembly
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a coil assembly including a main body having a first surface, a second surface opposite to the first surface in a first direction, and side surfaces connecting the first surface and the second surface to each other, a support member provided in the main body, a coil provided on each of one surface of the support member and the other surface of the support member opposite to the one surface in the first direction, the coil including first and second lead-out portions extending to the first and second side surfaces of the main body, respectively, and a first dummy lead-out portion provided on the other surface of the support member and connected to the first lead-out portion. W2/W1 satisfies 0.3 or more and 0.8 or less, W1 is the width of the first lead-out portion, and W2 is the width of the first dummy lead-out portion.

title_en: Photovoltaic panel cleaning device, cleaning method and photovoltaic field
abstract_en: The invention provides a photovoltaic panel cleaning device, a cleaning method and a photovoltaic field, and belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic panel maintenance. The system comprises a support frame, two spraying mechanisms, a scraping plate and a height adjusting mechanism, wherein the support frame is arranged above the photovoltaic plate and can move above the photovoltaic plate under the action of a driving force, the two spraying mechanisms are oppositely arranged at two ends of the support frame, clear water or mixed liquid can be sprayed to the surface of the photovoltaic plate through one of the spraying mechanisms in the moving process of the support frame, the mixed liquid is prepared by mixing cleaning liquid and clear water, the scraping plate is arranged on the support frame through the height adjusting mechanism and is positioned between the two spraying mechanisms, and the bottom end of the scraping plate is in contact with the upper surface of the photovoltaic plate and is used for scraping clear water or mixed liquid on the surface of the photovoltaic plate in the moving process of the support frame so as to clean the surface of the photovoltaic plate. The invention has simple structure, low use cost and good cleaning effect.

title_en: Battery pack
abstract_en: The battery pack according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a side cover, a front cover coupled to the side cover in a direction intersecting the side cover, a top cover coupled to upper portions of the side cover and the front cover, a first sealing member disposed along a first region, which is a coupling region of the side cover and the front cover, and a second sealing member disposed along a second region, which is a coupling region of the side cover, the front cover, and the top cover, wherein the first sealing member may extend along a boundary between the side cover and the front cover in a contact region in contact with the second sealing member.

title_en: Photovoltaic building integrated reconstruction design method for old community
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integral reconstruction design method for a photovoltaic building in an old community, and particularly relates to the technical field of building reconstruction design, comprising the following steps of firstly acquiring three-dimensional structure data of the building by using scanning equipment, and determining a proper photovoltaic installation area based on a preset reconstruction area level; then carrying out bearing capacity calculation of the photovoltaic module according to the reconstruction area, determining the total weight of the bearable photovoltaic module and designing the primary distribution of the module; according to the invention, a feasible scheme is provided for large-scale popularization of renewable energy sources, the installation of the photovoltaic system can fully utilize the idle space of old buildings, the utilization efficiency of solar energy resources is improved, the dependence on traditional energy sources is reduced, and the energy consumption of old communities is reduced.

title_en: Acquisition terminal supporting new energy and distribution transformer monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of smart power grids and discloses an acquisition terminal supporting monitoring of new energy and distribution transformer, which comprises a shell, wherein a first side plate and a second side plate are respectively arranged on two sides of the shell, a connecting port for connecting external equipment, a monitoring unit and the distribution transformer monitoring unit are arranged on the first side plate, a starting button, a first indicator light and a second indicator light are arranged on the second side plate, the first indicator light is electrically connected with the monitoring unit, and the second indicator light is electrically connected with the distribution transformer monitoring unit.

title_en: Electric mechanical swing type moxibustion device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electromechanical swing type moxibustion device, which relates to the technical field of rehabilitation equipment and comprises a movable base, wherein an adjusting swing mechanism is arranged above the movable base, a driving cabin is arranged on the rear side of the movable base, bevel gears I are movably arranged on the left side and the right side of the bottom of the inner wall of the driving cabin, and the top ends of the bevel gears I penetrate through the top of the movable base and are fixedly provided with threaded rods I. According to the invention, through the mutual coordination among the movable base, the first threaded rod, the lifting cylinder and the adjusting swing mechanism, the moxibustion stick burning hot spot is enabled to be as equidistant as possible on each acupoint on the channels in a mode of remote control of the motor, the equidistant moxibustion on multiple acupoints on one channel is almost realized through remote control of the moxibustion stick, the force of warming yang at the burning end of the moxibustion stick is enabled to better invade the channels of a human body, the effect of high-temperature moxibustion is achieved, the defects of easiness in fatigue, unstable moxibustion distance and the like of the handheld moxibustion stick are overcome, and the effect of moxibustion on the channels is truly realized.

title_en: Torque tube interface with two-part bearing sleeve
abstract_en: A two-part bearing housing (202) for use within a torque tube (108) interface may include a first component (206) defining a first part (210 a) of a bore configured to receive a first part of a rotational bearing, a second component (208) defining a second part (210 b) of the bore configured to receive a second part of the rotational bearing, and a connection interface (215 a,215 b) between the first component (206) and the second component (208), wherein the connection interface (215 a,215 b) is located below a center point of the bore defined by the first component (206) and the second component (208) when the first component (206) and the second component (208) are in an attached configuration. The two-part bearing sleeve (202) may include one or more ridges (222 a-q), gussets (230 a-d), and/or folds (420 a-d) to increase the structural integrity and rigidity of the bearing sleeve (202).

title_en: High-stability doped sodium iron sulfate positive electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-stability doped sodium iron sulfate positive electrode material and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of sodium ion battery electrode materials. Aiming at the problems of poor circulating performance and water resistance of the existing sodium iron sulfate under high multiplying power, the high-stability doped sodium iron sulfate positive electrode material comprises sodium zinc calcium zinc sulfate particles and carbon nanotubes, wherein the mass ratio of the sodium iron sulfate particles to the carbon nanotubes is 85-95:5-15. The method comprises the steps of ball milling anhydrous ferrous sulfate, anhydrous sodium sulfate, anhydrous calcium phosphate, anhydrous zinc phosphate and carbon nanotubes in an inert atmosphere ball milling tank to obtain a roasting precursor, and then placing the roasting precursor in an inert atmosphere tube furnace for roasting at 360-400 ℃ for 16-24 hours to obtain the ferric zinc calcium sodium sulfate phosphate composite electrode material. The electrode material provided by the invention has the advantages of simple and convenient preparation method, low cost, good air stability and rate capability, good cycle stability (6000 times) and the like, and has stronger market competitiveness in the field of large-scale energy storage application.

title_en: Distributed photovoltaic power station and building method
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed photovoltaic power station and a building method, the distributed photovoltaic power station comprises a driving device and a plurality of photovoltaic modules, the photovoltaic modules are distributed in a plurality of groups, one photovoltaic module group comprises a plurality of uniformly spaced photovoltaic modules, the photovoltaic modules comprise adjustable rotatable photovoltaic plates, the rotating parts of the photovoltaic modules in the same group are in transmission connection, the driving device comprises a track and a driving assembly arranged on the track, the track extends along the arrangement direction of the photovoltaic modules, the two ends of the track exceed the outer sides of the photovoltaic modules in the tail end positions, the driving assembly slides along the track and is used for driving and adjusting the arrangement angles of the photovoltaic plates in the same group, the structure is simple, the cost is low, the later use and maintenance cost can be reduced, the adjustment of the angles of the photovoltaic plates in the plurality of groups can be realized by sharing the same driving, the efficiency is improved, and the probability of equipment failure is also reduced.

title_en: Positive electrode composite material and electrolyte of water-based zinc ion battery and application of positive electrode composite material and electrolyte
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anode composite material of a water system zinc ion battery, electrolyte and application thereof. According to the invention, an ion pre-insertion method and a heterostructure design are adopted, vanadium pentoxide and zinc citrate are mixed and heated for reaction, so that the ZVO@ZVOH composite material is formed. The material has rich heterogeneous boundaries and active sites, and can be used as a positive electrode material of a zinc ion battery, so that the chemical dissolution problem in the circulating process of the vanadium-based compound is remarkably solved. The heterogeneous boundary in the ZVO@ZVOH is beneficial to electron transport, more Zn  2+  storage sites are provided, so that the rate performance is effectively improved, and ZVOH is used for effectively inhibiting the dissolution problem of the positive electrode in the circulating process, so that the circulating stability is effectively improved. And the mixed Zn (CF  3 SO 3 ) 2  and ZnSO  4  electrolyte can effectively reduce the dissolution of ZVO@ZVOH and inhibit the dendrite growth of Zn cathode.

title_en: High-conductivity fiber grounding ring and processing device for vehicle motor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-conductivity fiber grounding ring for a vehicle motor, which comprises a grounding body, an inner ring hole, a round hole, a sink and a through hole, wherein a processing device for forming the inner ring hole comprises a placing plate, a supporting component, a cutting mechanism and a fixing mechanism, the cutting mechanism and the fixing mechanism are matched with each other to clamp a material blank left and right and press and limit the front and rear sides downwards when the annular cutter moves downwards, the fixing strength is gradually enhanced along with the downward movement of the annular cutter, the stability of the material blank is greatly improved, waste inside the annular cutter can be automatically pushed out when the annular cutter completes the upward movement, the annular cutter is conveniently cut again, the annular cutter can be rotated and cut in a limited guide way by matching the supporting component with the cutting mechanism, the rotating stability of the annular cutter is ensured, and the annular cutter precision is greatly improved.

title_en: Sealing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sealing method which is suitable for sealing a liquid injection port of a battery cell, wherein the battery cell comprises a cover plate and a sealing nail, a groove is formed in the cover plate, a liquid injection port is formed in the bottom wall of the groove, the sealing nail is covered on the liquid injection port, an annular groove is formed between the periphery of the sealing nail and the inner periphery of the groove, the sealing method comprises the following steps of preparing an annular solder piece, placing the annular solder piece into the annular groove, heating and welding by adopting an induction welding device, melting the solder piece to enable the sealing nail to be welded and fixed with the groove, sealing the liquid injection port, and cooling a welding position between the sealing nail and the groove. The invention is beneficial to reducing equipment cost and maintenance cost, can improve the sealing performance of the liquid injection port and improves the product yield.

title_en: Negative electrode composite material, preparation method thereof, battery and electronic device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a negative electrode composite material, a preparation method thereof, a battery and an electronic device, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of performing pre-oxidation treatment on a biomass material to obtain a pre-oxidized biomass material; and placing the nitrogen-containing polymer and the obtained porous hard carbon material in different carriers of the same equipment under the inert gas atmosphere, simultaneously performing third calcination, and cooling to obtain the negative electrode composite material. The sodium ion battery assembled with the negative electrode composite material has excellent initial effect and cycle performance. The preparation method is simple and controllable, and is suitable for large-scale production.

title_en: Light storage clustering control method for self-adaptive voltage regulation and power balance
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-adaptive voltage regulation and power balance optical storage clustering control method, and relates to the field of distributed optical storage optimization operation in a power distribution network. The invention provides a comprehensive dividing index based on voltage regulation and regional power balance, which is used for respectively establishing objective functions of voltage offset and power balance degree under different voltage instructions to perform optimal control, thereby solving the problems of power dumping, large light rejection and the like caused by long-line light load operation states of a medium-low voltage distribution network. In the high-permeability distributed photovoltaic power distribution network, excessive controllers lead to the direct rise of coordination calculation difficulty, the running mode of the cluster not only reduces power flow among all areas, but also reduces communication calculation burden existing in the traditional control mode, reduces the means of running control to the cluster range as far as possible, reduces the complexity of control, improves the running speed and flexibility of the power distribution network, and realizes the division and flexible voltage regulation of the light storage group of the distribution line containing high-proportion distributed photovoltaic.

title_en: Single-phase axial magnetic circuit brushless direct current actuator with absolute angle detection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a take single-phase axial magnetic circuit brushless direct current executor of absolute angle detection, including stator, rotor, shroud, bearing, the rotor passes through the coaxial location ground frame of bearing and installs on the stator, and the shroud is fixed with the stator opening one side of the frame of stator that installs the rotor, and the stator includes 2N (N is the natural number of at least 1) iron cores, 2N skeleton, base, coil, the iron core suit is in the skeleton, and the coil twines on the skeleton, and the base forms closed magnetic circuit with the iron core amalgamation, the rotor includes axle, target support, target, and the target is fixed in the target support and can rotate along with the axle together, and the shroud includes shroud casing, PCB, emission detection coil, and emission detection coil is arranged on the PCB, and with axle coaxial arrangement, and the target is arranged with emission detection coil axial opposition. The actuator of some embodiments can avoid the signal drift problem caused by the interference of external general magnetic fields and the change of the ambient temperature, and greatly increases the angle control precision of the actuator.

title_en: Silicon-carbon negative electrode material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a silicon-carbon anode material and a preparation method thereof. The silicon-carbon negative electrode material includes a carbon skeleton having a pore structure and a silicon-based material disposed in the pore structure, wherein the content of high-valence silicon is less than 25% relative to the total amount of low-valence silicon and high-valence silicon in a region formed by extending 10nm from the surface of the silicon-carbon negative electrode material to the inside from the surface, wherein the low-valence silicon is silicon having a valence of 0to 2, and the high-valence silicon is silicon having a valence of 3 to 4. Therefore, the lithium removal gram capacity and the first coulombic efficiency of the silicon-carbon negative electrode material can be improved, and the discharge gram capacity and the first coulombic efficiency of the secondary battery can be improved.

title_en: Thermal sensor production method, system, device and medium using ultra-fine wire
abstract_en: The invention relates to a production method, a system, equipment and a medium of a thermal sensor using superfine wires, and relates to the technical field of thermal sensor design, wherein the method comprises the steps of controlling the rotation of a capillary tube through a third driving motor, driving wires from a coil rack to pass through a wire needle to wind wires to the capillary tube to be wound, and controlling a second driving motor connected with the wire needle to rotate so as to drive the wire needle to perform position adjustment, so as to guide the wires to move towards the capillary tube to be wound; in the process of winding the wire to the capillary tube, the tension of the wire collected by a tension sensor arranged in front of a wire needle is obtained, the rotation speed of a first driving motor connected with a coil rack is controlled according to the obtained tension of the wire so as to change the rotation speed of the coil rack, and then the effective tension of the wire is maintained. The invention obtains the thermal sensor with excellent quality by improving the winding mode of the capillary wire.

title_en: Battery module and electric equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a battery module and electric equipment, wherein the battery module comprises N electric cores which are arranged in a first direction, the N electric cores comprise a first electric core and a second electric core, the first electric core is closer to two ends of the battery module in the first direction than the second electric core, each of the N electric cores comprises a positive electrode plate and a negative electrode plate, the positive electrode plate comprises a positive electrode material layer, the positive electrode material layer comprises a positive electrode material containing nickel element, the mole percentage of the nickel element is W1 based on the mole number of the positive electrode material in the first electric core, the mole percentage of the nickel element is W2 based on the mole number of the positive electrode material in the second electric core, and the mole percentage of the nickel element is W1-W2 is less than or equal to 10%. The battery module provided by the application is beneficial to considering the cycle stability and the energy density.

title_en: Detachable coaxial terminal connector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detachable coaxial terminal connector which comprises a base assembly and a plurality of jack assemblies, wherein each jack assembly comprises an outer conductor and an inner conductor, a dielectric body sleeved on the surface of the inner conductor is arranged inside the outer conductor, one end of the inner conductor is fixedly connected with an external wire, a separation sheet is arranged at the end part of the inner conductor, the middle part of the outer conductor is a curved transition section, two symmetrically-arranged backward sector bayonets are arranged on one side of the curved transition section of the front section of the outer conductor, and two symmetrically-arranged forward sector bayonets are arranged on the other side of the curved transition section of the rear section of the outer conductor. The jack assembly can be detached to set up and can be independently replaced the terminal, and the whole connector is not required to be replaced, and the jack assembly can be connected and disconnected rapidly, so that more accurate signal measurement and fault investigation can be performed, the trouble of detachment and reconnection is reduced, and the jack assembly is more convenient in the application of frequent detachment and recombination.

title_en: 72-Slot 6-pole hairpin type flat wire armature winding and motor
abstract_en: The invention provides a 72-slot 6-pole hairpin type flat wire armature winding and a motor, wherein the winding comprises an annular stator which is formed by adopting a U-phase, a V-phase and a W-phase three-phase parallel flat wire to pass through and wind an inner side and is provided with n layers of 72 stator slots in a matched hairpin, the U-phase winding comprises two parallel branches, the first branch and the second branch are respectively formed by sequentially carrying out circumferential spiral reciprocating winding on the flat wire from a first starting point and a second starting point which are positioned on the n layers to the 1 layers in a direction of n-1 in a matched hairpin, then carrying out circumferential spiral reciprocating winding on the 1 layers in a reverse direction of the 1 layers in a direction of n+1 to the n layers, forming an annular loop from the first end point and the second end point which are positioned on the n layers after the n layers to the 1 layers are reciprocally wound, and respectively rotating the V-phase winding and the W-phase winding by 8 slots and 16 slots along the increasing direction of the slots relative to the U-phase winding. The winding is favorable for improving the full rate of the motor slot, generating higher magnetic field intensity, improving the motor power, balancing the potential of each branch, and avoiding the circulation problem.

title_en: Loop parameter self-adaptive adjustment method and device for digital power supply loop and readable storage medium thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a loop parameter self-adaptive adjustment method and device of a digital power supply loop and a readable storage medium thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of switching a digital loop feedback source to a protection measured value and setting a reference value as a safety value when the protection measured value (such as Kelvin voltage drop) triggers an alarm, dynamically adjusting PID control parameters based on a reinforcement learning algorithm (such as a depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm), including incremental adjustment of a proportional coefficient, an integral coefficient and a differential coefficient, and realizing rapid elimination alarm by combining forced parameter switching (such as increasing the proportional coefficient to 2 times and limiting the integral coefficient adjustment range to +/-5%). The invention shortens the adjusting time to 50 microseconds after the alarm is triggered, reduces the overshoot to within 5 percent, solves the problem of circuit overheating caused by disconnection delay or invalid adjustment in the traditional scheme, does not need extra hardware, and is suitable for an embedded power supply control system.

title_en: Packaging box structure of fully-sealed assembled lithium battery module and assembling method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a packaging box structure of a fully-sealed assembled lithium battery module and an assembling method thereof, wherein the packaging box comprises a packaging box body, a cover plate is arranged on the packaging box body, a connecting structure is arranged between the packaging box body and the cover plate, a plurality of groups of partition plates are arranged on the packaging box body and are mutually matched to divide the packaging box body into a plurality of battery cabins, a jogging groove is formed in the partition plates, a locking structure is arranged in the battery cabins and comprises clamping blocks which are slidingly jogged in the jogging groove, a fixing plate is further arranged on the packaging box body, a buffer structure for reducing the influence of vibration on the lithium battery module is arranged on the fixing plate, the fixing plate is connected with the partition plates through a clamping structure, and therefore the fixing plate is connected with the partition plates through the clamping structure, a certain protection and a certain position limitation are provided for the lithium battery module.

title_en: Immersed cooling liquid and preparation method thereof, battery device and electricity utilization device
abstract_en: The application provides an immersed cooling liquid and a preparation method thereof, a battery device and an electric device, wherein the immersed cooling liquid comprises, by weight, 40-50 parts of poly alpha-olefin synthetic base oil PAO 2, 50-60 parts of poly alpha-olefin synthetic base oil PAO 4, 0.1-0.4 part of pour point depressant and 0.1-0.9 part of antioxidant. The immersed cooling liquid has better fluidity, stability and heat transfer performance.

title_en: Copper-based graphene composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a copper-based graphene composite material and a preparation method thereof. The copper-based graphene composite material comprises monocrystalline copper foil layers and graphene layers which are alternately stacked, wherein the monocrystalline copper foil layers are provided with {111} crystal faces on two-dimensional planes, the monocrystalline copper foil layers are provided with {110} crystal faces in the thickness direction, the two-dimensional planes and the thickness direction are in mutually perpendicular relation, the monocrystalline copper foil layers and the graphene layers are respectively and independently of each other in a multi-layer structure, and the number of layers of the monocrystalline copper foil layers is more than or equal to 10. According to the application, the monocrystalline copper foil layers and the graphene layers are alternately laminated, so that the composite material can exhibit excellent conductive performance and mechanical strength. The defects in the composite material are minimized, the scattering effect of electrons is greatly reduced, and the conductivity of the composite material is further improved through the combination design of crystal plane orientation of the monocrystalline copper foil layer, the number of layers is more than or equal to 10 and the hot-press sintering process in the preparation process of the copper-based graphene composite material.

title_en: Lithium iron phosphate positive electrode material, preparation method thereof, positive electrode plate and lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention provides a lithium iron phosphate positive electrode material, a preparation method thereof, a positive electrode plate and a lithium ion battery. The preparation method comprises the steps of preparing a first slurry from a ferrous source, a phosphorus source, an oxidant and a first pH regulator, performing a first reaction on the first slurry to obtain a second slurry, adding the second pH regulator into the second slurry, performing a second reaction to obtain a third slurry, aging and filtering the third slurry to obtain a first precursor and a second precursor, mixing and calcining the first precursor, the second precursor and a metal doping source to obtain a third precursor, mixing the third precursor and a lithium source to obtain a fourth precursor, mixing the fourth precursor and oxalic acid, performing a second calcination to obtain a first product, and reacting the first product with a carbon source and a nonmetal doping source to obtain the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode material. The preparation method optimizes the precursor preparation process and optimizes the whole preparation process of the lithium iron phosphate anode material.

title_en: Method for stabilizing power grid voltage quality by charging and discharging of new energy automobile
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for stabilizing power grid voltage quality by charging and discharging of a new energy automobile, which comprises the steps of monitoring voltage, frequency and waveform changes in a power grid by a data acquisition unit, acquiring battery conditions and electric quantity of the new energy automobile and current electric quantity requirements of an automobile owner, uploading the battery conditions and the electric quantity to a cloud analysis unit, judging whether the power grid voltage quality is in a normal interval by the cloud analysis unit through a GM-GRU prediction model, if the power grid voltage is not considered to be abnormal and a voltage gap is determined, calling a PSA algorithm to search electric quantity or charging electric quantity required to be released by the new energy automobile with the minimum economic cost as a target, and sending an instruction to an intelligent regulation unit, and responding to the strategy by the intelligent regulation unit, and sending an instruction for encouraging the automobile owner to discharge or charge the power grid. Compared with the prior art, the invention can quickly respond according to the change of the voltage quality of the power grid, find out a solution at the first time, greatly improve the power supply reliability, reduce the processing economic cost and play a role in stabilizing the voltage quality of the power grid.

title_en: Multi-level charge and discharge management control system of photovoltaic energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic energy storage and discloses a multi-level charge and discharge management control system of a photovoltaic energy storage system, which comprises a micro-grid layer, a block chain communication module and a block chain layer, wherein the micro-grid layer is used for building a full-bridge and half-bridge mixed LLC resonant circuit, acquiring original data of a supplier, a acquirer and the photovoltaic energy storage system through the full-bridge and half-bridge mixed LLC resonant circuit, installing the block chain communication module for each supplier, the acquirer and the photovoltaic energy storage system and configuring parameters, the configured parameters comprise node IDs, preset intelligent contract templates and preset communication protocols, and the block chain layer is used for adding time stamps and equipment signatures to the original data based on the preset intelligent contract templates and broadcasting the original data to a block chain network of a consensus mechanism fused into DAG+PoS for storage.

title_en: Electrical set screw connector system and method
abstract_en: An electrical set screw connector system is provided. The system includes a connector body and a drill bit. The connector body has a set screw and a pressure limit for mechanically and electrically securing the conductor cable therein. The pressure limit corresponds to a torque limit applied to the set screw. The drill bit has a torque limiting region separating the body engagement portion from the tool engagement portion. The body engagement portion is operatively engaged with the set screw and the tool engagement portion is operatively engaged with the tool. The torque limiting region is shear broken at the torque limit.

title_en: Application of covalent organic polymer, negative electrode plate and preparation method thereof, zinc-based flow battery and zinc ion battery
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of covalent organic polymers, flow batteries and zinc ion batteries, in particular to an application of a covalent organic polymer in inhibiting the growth of dendrites of a negative electrode of a flow battery or an ion battery, wherein the covalent organic polymer has one or more structural units shown in a formula (1), a formula (2) and a formula (3);  In the formula (1), the formula (2) and the formula (3), M  1 、M 2 、M 3  is independently selected from one or more of metal elements of VIII group, IIB group and IVA group. The covalent organic polymer is used for negative electrodes of zinc ion batteries and alkaline zinc-based flow batteries, and can inhibit the growth of zinc dendrites effectively.

title_en: Structural member with conducting function, application and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a structural member with a conducting function, which comprises a first body member and a second body member arranged on the first body member, wherein the second body member is matched with the outer body surface of the first body member, and the second body member is configured as a cylinder member of a soft conductor structure. The structural member with the conducting function has the advantages of simple structure and wide adaptability, the surface of the structural member has stable tension, is firm and wear-resistant, is not easy to slide and deform, can stably transmit current, has the conducting function and the guiding and guiding functions, and can rapidly and safely conduct flaking processing on a processed object. The application also provides application of the structural member and a preparation method of the structural member.

title_en: Virtual power plant load prediction control method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual power plant load prediction control method and system based on big data, and relates to the technical field of intelligent control. And introducing power plant environment parameters of the virtual power plant, performing power analysis according to the power plant environment parameters based on the big data information base, and determining a plurality of power characteristics. Modeling is conducted based on the plurality of power characteristics, a power plant load prediction model is built, and a virtual power plant is predicted through the power plant load prediction model to obtain a load prediction data set. And carrying out power tracking on the virtual power plant according to the load prediction data set to generate a power distribution diagram. And performing data mining according to the power distribution diagram, formulating a power scheduling strategy, and executing the power scheduling strategy to perform self-adaptive control on the virtual power plant. The method solves the technical problem that in the prior art, the load prediction accuracy is low, so that the energy utilization efficiency and the system operation reliability are difficult to improve.

title_en: Flat wire motor stator winding structure, motor and automobile
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flat wire motor stator winding structure, a motor and an automobile, wherein the flat wire motor stator winding structure comprises a stator body, a plurality of stator slots and a stator winding, wherein the stator winding component is a phase a, a single-phase branch is formed by connecting 1 loop or 2 loops in parallel, a single loop comprises m、d 1 -1、m、d 8 、m、d 1 、m、d 8 、m、d 1 、m、d 8 、m、d 1 -1、m、d 8 ;d 1  first type hairpins with the span d from a first layer to the first layer, d  1  -1 second type hairpins with the span d-1 from the first layer to the first layer, d  8  third type hairpins with the span d from an eighth layer to an eighth layer, m is a cross-layer hairpins group, fourth type hairpins with the span d from a sixth layer to a seventh layer, fifth type hairpins with the span d-1 from the fourth layer to the fifth layer, and sixth type hairpins with the span d from the second layer to the third layer are sequentially welded. Meanwhile, the short span of the end part of the average hairpin, fewer and concentrated outgoing lines, short distance and contribution to inter-phase insulation in-slot distribution are met.

title_en: Quick-connection type railway signal cable connecting sleeve
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cable laying and wiring, and particularly discloses a quick-connection railway signal cable connecting sleeve which comprises a switching structure, a pair of wire fixing structures and a protection structure, wherein the switching structure is used for cable butt joint, the pair of wire fixing structures are symmetrically arranged on the switching structure respectively, the wire fixing structures are used for fixing a cable butt joint end, the protection structure is detachably buckled on the switching structure and the wire fixing structure, the protection structure is used for shielding and protecting the switching structure and the wire fixing structure.

title_en: Low-energy-consumption cooling device for pure electric tractor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pure electric tractors, in particular to a low-energy-consumption cooling device for a pure electric tractor, which comprises a heat radiation fan and a hand-operated generator, wherein the heat radiation fan and the hand-operated generator are matched with the pure electric tractor to be used and are arranged on the pure electric tractor, the hand-operated generator can be used for charging a storage battery arranged on the pure electric tractor and supplying power to the heat radiation fan, and the low-energy-consumption cooling device also comprises a traction frame, a driving rod, a driving assembly and an adjusting assembly, wherein the traction frame is arranged on an upper arm of the pure electric tractor. According to the invention, through the hand-operated generator and the driving assembly, the hand-operated generator can be driven to generate power in the braking process of the pure electric tractor, the power generation efficiency of the hand-operated generator is improved when the pure electric tractor is braked in a turning mode, the auxiliary energy supply of the storage battery and the heat dissipation fan is realized, and meanwhile, the system energy consumption when the heat dissipation fan works is reduced, so that the driving mileage of the pure electric tractor is ensured.

title_en: Equipment temperature inspection method and system integrating short-time load prediction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of equipment inspection and task scheduling, and provides a method and a system for equipment temperature inspection fused with short-time load prediction, wherein the method comprises the steps of generating a load prediction curve in a future preset time length through a load prediction algorithm; the method comprises the steps of outputting an object sequence with unified format according to a load prediction curve, setting TopN time window parameters to obtain a specific TopN time window entity, drawing the object sequence from the TopN time window entity to obtain a plurality of time window sequences, obtaining a final time window sequence according to the time window sequences, dynamically generating a task execution strategy according to the obtained final time window sequence, binding the task execution strategy with a specific equipment temperature inspection task, and executing the equipment temperature inspection task according to the task execution strategy to realize tracking load operation. According to the invention, the load prediction result is utilized to guide the equipment temperature inspection, so that the tracking and monitoring of the equipment temperature change are realized, the monitoring precision is improved, and the safe operation of the equipment is ensured.

title_en: Transformer
abstract_en: The application discloses a transformer, which relates to the technical field of transformers. The primary winding is wound on the iron core, the primary winding is electrically connected with the board, the secondary winding comprises a conductive shell and a conductive inner core arranged in the conductive shell, the conductive shell is provided with a containing cavity for containing the iron core, the conductive inner core penetrates through a closed magnetic circuit formed in the iron core, and the conductive shell and the conductive inner core are electrically connected with the board. The transformer adopting the design has compact structure, small volume, low cost and good heat conduction, heat dissipation and shielding performances on the basis of ensuring the basic electrical performance.

title_en: In-situ deposition coated phosphorus-carbon negative electrode material, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lithium battery materials, and particularly discloses an in-situ deposition coated phosphorus-carbon negative electrode material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the in-situ deposition coated phosphorus-carbon negative electrode material comprises an inner core and an in-situ deposition layer coated outside the inner core, the inner core is porous carbon deposited with red phosphorus, and the in-situ deposition layer has a structural formula of Ag  1‑x Cd x  S or Zn  1‑x Cd x  S, wherein x is 0< 0.3. According to the in-situ deposition coated phosphorus-carbon negative electrode material provided by the invention, ag  1‑x Cd x  S or Zn  1‑x Cd x  S is used for in-situ deposition coating of the phosphorus-carbon material, so that uniform coating can be realized at a lower temperature, direct contact between red phosphorus and electrolyte is effectively avoided, the conductivity of the material can be improved, and capacity attenuation of the phosphorus-carbon composite material in the circulation process is inhibited.

title_en: Method and device for processing small-amplitude overcurrent based on intelligent fuse
abstract_en: The application provides a small-amplitude overcurrent processing method and device based on an intelligent fuse, which belong to the technical field of circuit devices or systems for power supply or distribution in the field of high-end equipment industry, wherein a photovoltaic server monitors first current data and first temperature data of a combiner box, a direct-current cabinet and a centralized inverter in real time through the intelligent fuse, determines whether small-amplitude overcurrent abnormality exists according to the first current data, a rated current value, fusing parameters, the first temperature data and a preset heating rate, determines an abnormality occurrence position after detecting the existence of the small-amplitude overcurrent abnormality, and indicates a controller of the abnormality occurrence position to adjust a fusing current threshold of the intelligent fuse, so that the problem that the traditional fuse cannot act due to insufficient heat accumulation is solved, the protection capability for the small-amplitude overcurrent is greatly improved, the equipment damage rate and the failure rate caused by the small-amplitude overcurrent in the photovoltaic system are reduced, and the overall stability of the photovoltaic system is improved.

title_en: Prevent wind and beat insulator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a windage yaw prevention insulator, and relates to the technical field of overhead line laying. The electric power transmission device comprises a mounting plate, wherein an upper sleeve is fixedly arranged at the center of the top end of the mounting plate, an insulating rod is inserted into the bottom of the upper sleeve, a lower sleeve is sleeved on the outer side of the bottom of the insulating rod, a buffer assembly is arranged between the insulating rod and the mounting plate and used for buffering movement of the insulating rod and the lower sleeve, a mounting assembly is arranged at the bottom end of the lower sleeve, and the mounting assembly is used for mounting a power transmission wire. The invention is beneficial to the stable fixation of the insulator installation part, slows down the abrasion of the insulator installation part, can buffer the movement of the wire, simultaneously can inhibit the shaking amplitude of the wire, improves the windproof deviation effect, avoids the relative movement between the wire and the fixed installation part, slows down the abrasion of the wire, ensures the stable extrusion fixation of the wire, and avoids the loosening of the wire.

title_en: Silicon oil-based magnetic liquid and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silicone oil-based magnetic liquid and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of nano functional materials, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of stirring and mixing ferric trichloride hexahydrate and ferrous sulfate heptahydrate uniformly to obtain a solution A; adding strong alkali solution into the solution A, stirring and mixing uniformly to obtain dispersion liquid B, performing magnetic separation and washing on the dispersion liquid B to obtain Fe  3 O 4  nano particles, adding Fe  3 O 4  nano particles into alcohol solution to obtain solution C, adding main chain double-end carboxyl silicone oil into the solution C, performing magnetic separation and washing after constant temperature reaction, and drying to obtain coated magnetic nano particles, and stirring and dispersing the coated magnetic nano particles into a base carrier liquid to obtain the magnetic liquid. And coating the main chain double-end carboxyl silicone oil in an alcohol solution, and finally dispersing the silicone oil in high-viscosity silicone oil to finally prepare the silicone oil-based magnetic liquid with high saturation magnetization intensity, high temperature resistance and high stability.

title_en: Automatic power control switch cabinet of intelligent power grid and overload power control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a switch cabinet for automatically controlling electricity of a smart grid and an overload control method thereof, which comprise a cabinet body, wherein a static contact is arranged on a wiring board, a rotary table is arranged on a wiring block, a knife switch is arranged in the cabinet body, a fuse is arranged on the knife switch, a movable contact is arranged at the other end of the fuse, a separation structure is further arranged on the knife switch, the separation structure can drive the rotary table to rotate, an induction structure is arranged on the cabinet body, the induction structure comprises a heating resistor connected with a circuit, the rotary table is connected with the induction structure through a unidirectional driving structure, and the induction structure can drive the rotary table to rotate through the unidirectional driving structure so as to enable the movable contact to be in contact with or separated from the static contact. The cabinet body is also internally provided with a signal transceiver, the state of the circuit can be monitored in real time through the induction structure, and the induction device monitors the load through resistance heating, so that the induction numerical error is small, fluctuation is small, and the circuit is in hysteresis after the circuit is restored to the channel state.

title_en: Short-term power load prediction method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a short-term power load prediction method and device, the method comprises the steps of obtaining power load and environment information of a target area, wherein the environment information comprises a daily maximum temperature, a daily minimum temperature, a daily average temperature, relative humidity and a date type, determining a short-term power load prediction value of the target area according to the power load, the environment information and a preset short-term power load prediction model, wherein the short-term power load prediction model is obtained by pre-training a neural network model based on batch training samples and actual short-term power loads corresponding to the batch training samples, each training sample comprises a historical power load and historical environment information, and the neural network model comprises a bidirectional gating circulation unit layer and an attention mechanism layer. The method and the device can improve the accuracy of short-term power load prediction.

title_en: Anti-precipitation lithium graphite negative electrode composite material suitable for low-temperature quick-charge working condition, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lithium ion batteries, and discloses an anti-precipitation lithium graphite negative electrode composite material suitable for a low-temperature quick-charging working condition, and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of loading indium antimonide on the surfaces of graphite particles, carrying out pretreatment by adopting an anionic surfactant, constructing a nitrogen-containing organic metal framework compound containing cobalt on the surface of the pretreated composite material, and finally carrying out pyrolysis treatment to obtain the negative electrode composite material. According to the invention, the ZIF derivative is coated outside the indium antimonide/graphite to form an N & Co doped porous carbon layer, so that conductivity is improved, electrolyte is effectively dredged, the transportation process of Li  +  is enhanced, lithium precipitation of a graphite negative electrode under the condition of low-temperature quick charge is prevented, meanwhile, the Co element doped indium antimonide can effectively inhibit agglomeration and inactivation of In due to steric hindrance effect, thus further improving the cycle performance, the band gap is reduced, the free electron concentration is increased, the conductivity of the material is improved, and the lithium intercalation energy barrier can be effectively reduced.

title_en: Single-tooth motor with magnetic bridge for flywheel energy storage
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of motors and energy storage, and particularly discloses a single-tooth motor with a magnetic bridge for flywheel energy storage, which comprises a stator assembly and a rotor assembly, wherein the stator assembly and the rotor assembly are concentrically arranged, the pole number ratio of the stator to the rotor is 2:1, the rotor assembly comprises a plurality of segmented rotor blocks, the segmented rotor blocks are circumferentially arranged at equal included angles, and adjacent segmented rotor blocks are connected through a magnetic bridge connecting part. The invention can obviously improve the energy conversion efficiency while guaranteeing the high-frequency start-stop reliability, thereby effectively solving the industrial problems of discontinuous magnetic circuit, complex manufacturing process and the like of the traditional segmented rotor motor.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for analyzing abnormality of energy storage system of all-vanadium redox flow battery
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of all-vanadium redox flow batteries and discloses an abnormality analysis method, device, equipment and medium of an energy storage system of an all-vanadium redox flow battery, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining operation data of each electric pile of the energy storage system of the all-vanadium redox flow battery in a preset electric quantity range, and determining the energy efficiency of a single electric pile corresponding to each electric pile based on the operation data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional efficiency matrix based on the energy efficiency of a single galvanic pile, carrying out quantitative analysis on the three-dimensional efficiency matrix, determining the liquid path efficiency corresponding to each liquid path and the circuit efficiency corresponding to each circuit in the energy storage system of the all-vanadium redox flow battery, comparing the liquid path efficiency with the circuit efficiency through a preset abnormal threshold value, and determining a corresponding target abnormal position based on a comparison result. The technical scheme provided by the application can realize intelligent operation and maintenance of fault investigation.

title_en: Cable overhauling device for power transmission
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cable overhaul and discloses a cable overhaul device for power transmission, which comprises a shell, wherein the inner wall of the shell is fixedly connected with an air cylinder, the output end of the air cylinder is fixedly connected with a long plate, the top of the long plate is fixedly connected with a long arc block, the inner wall of the shell is fixedly connected with a motor, the inner wall of the shell is fixedly connected with a first elastic telescopic rod, and the telescopic end of the first elastic telescopic rod is fixedly connected with an arc plate.

title_en: Control device for synchronous motor
abstract_en: The invention provides a device for controlling a synchronous motor with a high torque by saving the structure as much as possible. The control device for a synchronous motor includes a synchronous motor having a rotor using a permanent magnet, a voltage command value conversion unit that converts d-axis current and q-axis current into three-phase voltage command intermediate values based on a d-axis voltage command value, a q-axis voltage command value, and a motor position, a voltage compensation operation unit that performs voltage compensation operation based on the three-phase voltage command intermediate values, and calculates a three-phase voltage command value, and an inverter that outputs a voltage to the synchronous motor based on the three-phase voltage command value.

title_en: Hot air type photovoltaic photo-thermal comprehensive utilization unit and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hot air type photovoltaic photo-thermal comprehensive utilization unit and a hot air type photovoltaic photo-thermal comprehensive utilization system, and relates to the technical field of photovoltaic photo-thermal comprehensive utilization, wherein the comprehensive utilization unit comprises a heat preservation shell, a transparent packaging layer, a photovoltaic cell and a heat collecting plate, and the top of the heat preservation shell is open; the solar heat collecting device comprises a heat-insulating shell, a transparent packaging layer, a plurality of photovoltaic cells, a plurality of through holes, a heat collecting plate and at least a part of light transmitting parts, wherein the heat-insulating shell is provided with an air inlet and an air outlet, the transparent packaging layer is arranged at the top of the heat-insulating shell and seals the top of the heat-insulating shell, an interlayer is arranged in the transparent packaging layer, the photovoltaic cells are paved in the interlayer, the interlayer is not fully paved by the photovoltaic cells, the transparent packaging layer corresponding to the part of the interlayer, which is not paved by the photovoltaic cells, is a light transmitting part, the heat collecting plate is provided with the plurality of through holes, is obliquely arranged in the heat-insulating shell and divides the inner space of the heat-insulating shell into two cavities, the two cavities are communicated with the air inlet and the air outlet through the through holes, and at least a part of the light transmitting part is opposite to the heat collecting plate. The scheme provided by the invention can simultaneously generate heat and electricity and improves the heat collection efficiency.

title_en: Three-dimensional monitoring, adjusting and compensating system and method for photovoltaic structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional monitoring, adjusting and compensating system and method for a photovoltaic structure, and relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation.
