The system comprises an air-ground integrated monitoring subsystem and a photovoltaic structure adjusting bracket, wherein the air-ground integrated monitoring subsystem is used for acquiring deformation data of a mine subsidence area to be mined and combining mining parameters to construct a settlement dynamic partition model, determining and implementing multistage adjusting instructions of different photovoltaic areas in a grading manner according to the settlement dynamic partition model, and the photovoltaic structure adjusting bracket is used for supporting a photovoltaic panel and receiving structure adjusting parameters in the multistage adjusting instructions to carry out supporting adjustment. The deformation data of different stages are automatically acquired, the regions and the units are divided, and a multi-stage regulation strategy is formed, so that the regions with different subsidence amplitudes are regulated and controlled in a grading manner. The three-dimensional monitoring of the surface deformation and the self-adaptive adjustment of the support are realized, and the safety and the long-term stability of the photovoltaic power station in the subsidence area to be mined in the mine are improved, so that the subsidence area is fully utilized and is changed into a precious subsidence area.

title_en: Secondary battery and electronic device
abstract_en: The application provides a secondary battery and an electronic device, which comprise a negative electrode plate and electrolyte, wherein the negative electrode plate comprises a negative electrode material layer, the surface density of the negative electrode material layer is ρmg/mm  2 , the negative electrode material layer comprises a negative electrode active material, the negative electrode active material comprises graphite with a coating layer, the coating uniformity of the coating layer is C, the graphite comprises at least one of natural graphite or artificial graphite, the mass percentage of the coating layer is M based on the mass of the graphite with the coating layer, the liquid retention coefficient of the electrolyte is Ag/Ah, the electrolyte comprises a film forming additive, and the mass percentage of the film forming additive is N, and is more than or equal to 0.6 and less than or equal to A/(ρMXC) and less than or equal to 47 based on the mass of the electrolyte. Through the arrangement, the problem of stripping of the fast-charging graphite in the negative electrode overhang area and the non-lithium-intercalation area is solved, and the low-temperature performance of the secondary battery is considered.

title_en: Intelligent assembly equipment and method for motor end cover for vehicle
abstract_en: An intelligent assembly device for an automotive motor end cover and an assembly method thereof comprise a working platform, a track type material conveying mechanism, a CCD visual detection mechanism, a transfer platform, a transfer mechanism, a supporting platform and a shaft pressing mechanism. The assembly method comprises the following steps of S1, initializing, starting an electric control system, S2, feeding, S3, starting a track type material conveying mechanism to convey a motor shell tool table, starting a CCD visual detection mechanism to detect a motor shell, S4, stopping running the track type material conveying mechanism when a first light sensor receiving and transmitting module monitors a light reflection positioning block, S5, starting a transferring mechanism, transferring a motor end cover to the upper part of the motor shell, starting a shaft pressing mechanism, penetrating a motor shaft into the motor shell, S6, driving the motor shaft to approach the motor end cover until the motor shaft is assembled in the motor end cover by the shaft pressing mechanism, and S7, starting the track type material conveying mechanism to convey the motor shell tool table to the next link, so that finished product blanking is achieved.

title_en: Electrolyte for lithium ion secondary battery and lithium ion secondary battery
abstract_en: A lithium ion secondary battery comprises a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and an electrolyte solution containing a nitrile compound having one or more cyano groups in the molecule, and a fluorinated alcohol represented by formula (1). The content of the nitrile compound in the electrolyte is 0.5 wt% or more and 5 wt% or less, and the content of the fluorinated alcohol in the electrolyte is 0.05 wt% or more and 1 wt% or less. R1R2R3 COH. (1) (R1, R2 and R3 are each any one of a hydrogen group, an alkyl group and a fluoroalkyl group; wherein at least one of R1, R2 and R3 is a fluoroalkyl group.)

title_en: Aluminum alloy photovoltaic cable
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cables, and provides an aluminum alloy photovoltaic cable which sequentially comprises a conductor, an insulating layer and a sheath layer from inside to outside, wherein the sheath layer comprises, by weight, 100 parts of high-density polyethylene, 10-15 parts of nitrile rubber, 10-20 parts of unsaturated polyester composite pyrophyllite powder, 6-10 parts of ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer, 0.2-0.3 part of vulcanizing agent, 2-4 parts of plasticizer and 0.5-1.3 parts of antioxidant, the raw materials of the unsaturated polyester composite pyrophyllite powder comprise pyrophyllite powder and unsaturated polyester in a weight ratio of 32:2-9, and the unsaturated polyester comprises 196-type unsaturated polyester and 191-type unsaturated polyester. Through the technical scheme, the problem that the tensile property of the aluminum alloy photovoltaic cable sheath layer is poor in the related art is solved.

title_en: Offshore energy island power supply system and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an offshore energy island power supply system and a working method thereof, wherein the system comprises an offshore wind power flexible direct current delivery device which is used for delivering offshore wind power to an onshore power grid through a submarine cable, and an offshore hydrogen production ammonia alcohol power supply device which comprises a direct current power supply device and an alternating current power supply device, wherein the direct current power supply device comprises an energy storage type MMC converter, a direct current side capacity type energy storage, a direct current side power type energy storage, a direct current side PEM (proton exchange membrane) electrolytic cell, a direct current side alkaline electrolytic cell, a distributed photovoltaic, a distributed energy storage and hydrogen production device which are respectively connected with the alternating current bus, and the alternating current power supply device comprises an alternating current side alkaline electrolytic cell, an alternating current side PEM electrolytic cell, an alternating current side capacity type energy storage and ammonia alcohol production device which is used for carrying out hydrogen production ammonia alcohol operation through offshore wind power and photovoltaic power. The embodiment of the invention is used for improving the utilization rate of offshore wind power, improving the power supply efficiency and prolonging the service life of energy storage equipment.

title_en: Method and system for managing harmonic waves and evaluating heat loss of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for managing harmonic waves and evaluating heat loss of a power distribution network, and relates to the technical field of power quality optimization and heat loss evaluation, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting power distribution network signals, extracting harmonic characteristics, and calculating harmonic contribution of each load based on harmonic power flow; and dynamically adjusting parameters of a harmonic compensation device according to harmonic treatment and heat loss evaluation results, and optimizing load scheduling. The method provides more accurate harmonic source identification and harmonic power flow calculation, improves the accuracy of harmonic management, introduces vortex loss modeling, heat conduction analysis and dynamic temperature prediction in cable heat loss evaluation, enhances the operation safety of the cable, combines dynamic harmonic management optimization and load scheduling, forms a closed-loop regulation mechanism, improves the electric energy quality, and effectively avoids the overheat risk of the cable.

title_en: Adapter box and test system
abstract_en: A transfer box and a test system are beneficial to reducing the volume and the overall weight, reducing the workload during testing and improving the test efficiency. The adapter box is used for connecting an aircraft with a controller for communication and comprises a circuit chip, a microprocessor and a microprocessor, wherein the circuit chip is provided with a plurality of first circuits and a plurality of second circuits, the first circuits are parallel to each other, one end side of the first circuits is used for being connected with the controller, the other end side of the first circuits is used for being connected with the aircraft, the second circuits are parallel to each other and are respectively intersected with the first circuits, one end of the second circuits forms a test end, the microprocessor controls the on-off of an intersection part of the first circuits and the second circuits, the first circuits are respectively provided with a switch, and the microprocessor controls the on-off of the switch.

title_en: Explosion-proof heating tube
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of heating equipment, and particularly discloses an explosion-proof heating tube which comprises a heating component and a wiring component, wherein the heating component comprises a hollow sealing metal column and a heating wire, the heating wire is fixedly arranged in the hollow sealing metal column, the heating wire is in a spiral shape, a spiral channel is formed in the hollow sealing metal column, the heating wire is used for converting electric energy into heat energy, a wiring terminal is detachably arranged on the outer wall of one end of the hollow sealing metal column, the wiring terminal is electrically connected with the heating wire, the wiring terminal is electrically connected with an electric wire so as to convey current to the heating wire, the wiring component comprises a metal tube, one end of the metal tube is detachably connected with one end of the hollow sealing metal column, which is provided with the wiring terminal, and the metal tube is used for shielding the wiring terminal. The application has the effect of improving the problem that the wiring position of the existing explosion-proof heat pipe is inconvenient to check and maintain.

title_en: Device for protecting electric element through sea
abstract_en: The invention provides a device for protecting an electrical element through sea, which comprises a sea-going steel pipe, an MCT (metal-organic composite) penetrating through at least one deck, wherein the lower end of the sea-going steel pipe is fixed with a ship body structure, the outer wall of the sea-going steel pipe is connected with the deck in a sealing way, the MCT is penetrated and arranged at an inlet at the upper end of the sea-going steel pipe and used for sealing an outlet of an electrical element at the upper section of a water line of the sea-going steel pipe, and a ventilation pipe, the lower end of the ventilation pipe is communicated with the sea-going steel pipe, and the connection part is close to the inlet at the upper end of the sea-going steel pipe. The invention provides a device for protecting an electrical element through the sea, which meets the requirements of the specifications of a class society, replaces the original protection electrical element and cable combined by a surrounding well and a cable protection pipe, reduces the cost and has less influence on space.

title_en: U-shaped heat exchanger for cooling conductive paste, U-shaped tube and heat dissipation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of general heat exchange, in particular to a heat exchange device for fixing a tubular channel component of two heat exchange media, and particularly relates to a U-shaped heat exchanger for cooling conductive paste, a U-shaped pipe and a heat dissipation method, wherein the U-shaped heat exchanger comprises a bracket, a plurality of U-shaped pipes, a heat exchange device and a heat dissipation device, wherein the bracket is used for fixing the U-shaped pipes, the conductive paste to be cooled is conveyed in the U-shaped pipes, and the heat exchange medium flows outside the U-shaped pipes; the U-shaped pipe inner wall is coated with an insulating coating, a plurality of conductive assemblies are arranged on the U-shaped pipe inner wall, when the temperature of conductive slurry in the U-shaped pipe exceeds the deformation temperature of the conductive assemblies, the conductive assemblies deform to enable the conductive assemblies to protrude out of the U-shaped pipe inner wall, metal pieces in the conductive assemblies contact the insulating coating of the U-shaped pipe inner wall, the insulating coating of the U-shaped pipe inner wall loses electrostatic adsorption force, and therefore the electrostatic adsorption force in the U-shaped pipe is eliminated, particles are prevented from being adsorbed on the U-shaped pipe inner wall, and heat exchange efficiency is guaranteed.

title_en: Environment-friendly fire-resistant cable and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly fire-resistant cable and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of power cables. The cable comprises a conductor, and an insulating layer, a metal shielding layer and an outer sheath layer which are sequentially arranged outside the conductor, wherein the outer sheath layer comprises, by weight, 75-85 parts of polyethylene, 8-12 parts of tea polyphenol flame-retardant particles, 0.5-1 part of a lubricant, 0.5-3 parts of an antioxidant and 0.8-3 parts of a peroxide cross-linking agent.

title_en: FPC piercing type automatic terminal pressing and shell inserting machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to an FPC puncture type automatic terminal-pressing shell inserting machine, which belongs to the technical field of automatic assembly machines and comprises a soft-row wire-feeding mechanism, a terminal-row press-fitting mechanism, a shell inserting mechanism and a deviation correcting and transferring mechanism. According to the FPC puncture type automatic terminal shell inserting machine, through mutual matching of the soft row wire feeding mechanism, the terminal row press mounting mechanism, the shell inserting mechanism and the deviation correcting and transferring mechanism, full-automatic conveying and assembling actions of the soft row, the terminal row and the terminal shell can be realized, the processing efficiency is greatly improved, meanwhile, through repeated deviation correction, the processing precision is greatly improved, the defective rate is reduced, and the production cost is reduced.

title_en: Fireproof plugging mechanism for wiring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fireproof blocking mechanism for wiring, which relates to the technical field of fireproof blocking and comprises a protection box, wherein an installation groove is formed in the inner wall of the protection box, a plurality of supporting frames are slidably arranged in the installation groove, installation blocks are arranged outside the supporting frames, a through groove is formed in the outer part of the protection box, the installation blocks are slidably arranged in the through groove, a blocking box is arranged in the supporting frames, a sliding block is arranged outside the blocking box, the sliding block is slidably arranged in the sliding groove, a rotating rod is arranged in the supporting frames, the rotating rod penetrates into the blocking box and is provided with a winding reel, chucks are arranged at two ends of the winding reel, the rotating rod winds and stores cables in a mode of driving the winding reel, the transmission mechanism drives two ejector rods to be mutually far away, the blocking boxes are mutually close to each other and block the cables in the inner parts, and the split blocking boxes are used for cable blocking, so that subsequent cable detachment and replacement are more convenient.

title_en: Charge and discharge control method, controller, system, storage medium and electric equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a charge and discharge control method, a controller, a system, a storage medium and electric equipment. The method comprises the steps of determining starting point values of a next down-flow interval based on characteristic inflection points of a plurality of single battery cells in a current down-flow interval during battery charging, wherein a charging current value in the current down-flow interval is smaller than a charging current value in a non-down-flow interval. Because the charging current value in the current down-flow interval is smaller than the charging current value in the non-down-flow interval, the characteristic inflection point of the single battery cell can be detected in the current down-flow interval, and the starting point value of the next down-flow interval is updated in real time based on the characteristic inflection point, so that the battery charging device is applicable to batteries with different power deviations, and the charging efficiency can be guaranteed.

title_en: Novel six-order wide-frequency vibration-proof device for power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a six-order wide-frequency vibration-proof device for a power transmission line, and belongs to the technical field of vibration-proof of power transmission lines. The device comprises a connecting component and a restraining component which is symmetrically arranged, wherein the connecting component consists of a wire clamp and a matched bolt nut, and the restraining component consists of a steel strand and a damper fixedly connected with two ends. The damper adopts a double-mass block structure with large and small hammerheads connected through a rear side plate, and the two groups of suppression components are made of the same materials and structures and are installed in an antisymmetric mode. When the wire is excited by breeze to generate vibration, vibration energy is transmitted to the damper through the steel strands, the large hammer head and the small hammer head are driven to generate reverse vibration to form dynamic damping, and meanwhile, the friction effect among the steel strands further dissipates the vibration energy. The device realizes six-order effective natural frequency coverage through a multi-mode coupling mechanism, has broadband coverage capability and strong damping characteristics, remarkably widens the frequency response range compared with the traditional single-order damper, can effectively inhibit breeze vibration of a wire, and improves the operation reliability of a power transmission line.

title_en: Switching control method and system for distribution network area inverter based on double-layer MPC
abstract_en: A power distribution network area inverter switching control method and system based on double-layer MPC comprises the steps of obtaining operation parameters and equipment parameters of an area power distribution network, building a voltage source type inverter system model considering frequency fluctuation, building an outer layer model, generating an output voltage reference value of an inverter grid-connected mode and an output voltage reference value of a grid-built mode according to the operation parameters and the equipment parameters, calculating a synchronous decision signal, switching the working mode of the inverter, calculating a bus voltage reference value and an output current reference value of a current sampling period of an integrated system, building an inner layer model, calculating a predicted value and a reference value of a voltage and current of a next sampling period, building a cost function cost optimizing model according to the deviation degree between the predicted value and the reference value, generating an optimal switching state, and controlling the power distribution network area inverter. The invention gives consideration to dynamic response and stability, realizes seamless switching of the voltage source type inverter, avoids voltage out-of-limit and improves the stability of the power system.

title_en: Lead-free ferroelectric relaxor ceramic material based on local structure strengthening design and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lead-free ferroelectric relaxor ceramic material based on local structure strengthening design and a preparation method thereof, wherein the chemical composition of the ceramic material is Bi  m Na n Ba y Ti 1‑x Zr x O 3 , wherein x is more than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 0.16,0.45, y is more than or equal to 0.55, and m+n+y=1. The preferred chemical composition is Bi  0.25 Na 0.25 Ba 0.5 Ti 1‑x Zr x O 3 . Is prepared by adopting a solid phase sintering process. According to the ceramic, through atomic-level chemical frame engineering and dynamic relaxation polarization regulation and control, a large-radius Ba  2+  is introduced into an A site to serve as a lattice expansion frame, ferroelectric activity Bi  3+  and small-radius Na  +  are used for synergistically optimizing local polarization displacement, and the synergistic effect of B site Ti  4+  and Zr  4+  is combined to inhibit long-range order polarization, so that breakthrough performance of breakdown field intensity up to 98kV/mm, energy storage density of 24.3J/cm  3  and efficiency of 92.4% is realized. The inversion contradiction between the polarization intensity and the breakdown field intensity of the traditional lead-free ceramic is solved, and a novel dielectric material solution with high energy density, low loss and reliability is provided for a high-power pulse power supply and a new energy device.

title_en: Positive electrode plate, electrochemical device and preparation method of positive electrode plate
abstract_en: The invention provides a positive electrode plate, an electrochemical device and a preparation method of the positive electrode plate, and belongs to the technical field of secondary batteries. The positive electrode active material layer is arranged on the positive electrode current collector, the positive electrode active material layer comprises a positive electrode active material, a solid electrolyte and a binder, the binder comprises polyvinyl butyral, the molecular weight of the binder is 40000-53000, and the viscosity of the binder is 80-180 mPa.S. According to the positive electrode plate, polyvinyl butyral (PVB) is introduced into the positive electrode active material layer to serve as a binder, so that high coverage rate bonding of a contact interface between a positive electrode active material and a solid electrolyte is finished, stress concentration caused by volume change of a positive electrode in a charge-discharge cycle process can be relieved, stable contact between the positive electrode active material and the solid electrolyte interface is maintained, and the rate performance and the cycle life of a solid battery are improved.

title_en: Preparation method of toughening nano-coating current collector
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of current collectors, in particular to a preparation method of a toughening nano coating current collector. The preparation method comprises the steps of (1) preparing a macromolecule RAFT reagent from a micromolecule RAFT reagent, a functional monomer and a hard monomer, (2) firstly blocking a soft monomer and then blocking a hard monomer of the macromolecule RAFT reagent to obtain a block elastomer, 2) uniformly mixing a conductive agent, the block elastomer and a solvent to obtain a toughening nano coating slurry, and 3, uniformly coating the toughening nano coating slurry on two sides of a current collector, and drying at 120-150 ℃ to obtain the toughening nano coating current collector. In the scheme, the tensile strength, the elongation and the electrical property of the toughening nano coating current collector are effectively increased by optimizing the toughening nano coating slurry.

title_en: Nickel metal battery electrolyte, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nickel metal battery electrolyte, a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of nickel metal battery electrolytes. The nickel metal battery electrolyte comprises nickel salt and an organic solvent, wherein the nickel salt is one of nickel chloride hexahydrate, nickel sulfate hexahydrate, nickel nitrate hexahydrate and nickel acetate tetrahydrate, and the organic solvent is one of alcohol solvents, ester solvents, ether solvents and sulfoxide solvents. The nickel metal battery electrolyte, the preparation method and the application thereof provided by the invention have the advantages that the prepared nickel metal battery electrolyte shows excellent stability when being applied to a nickel metal battery cathode, the generation of byproducts can be effectively inhibited in the battery reaction process, the electrochemical window is obviously widened, the electrochemical performance of the battery is greatly improved, the nickel metal battery electrolyte is applied to a three-electrode system for carrying out the deposition/stripping operation of metal nickel, the extremely high coulomb efficiency can be realized, and an innovative and effective solution is provided for the research and development of high-performance batteries.

title_en: Distributed affine recovery method for power transmission and distribution-electric integrated energy system considering geological landslide under typhoon disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed affine recovery method of a power transmission and distribution-gas integrated energy system for taking geological landslide into consideration under typhoon disasters, which is characterized by calculating mechanical stress fault probability of an electric power line based on a typhoon field model, calculating failure probability of a pole tower caused by landslide based on effective rainfall and landslide probability models of the landslide, modeling new energy output and load demand into affine forms, constructing a power transmission network flow constraint, a power distribution network reconstruction constraint and a gas network slow dynamic gas storage model containing affine operators, establishing a cooperative recovery model with minimized load loss by an electric-gas coupling equipment equation and a power transmission and distribution network mutual aid equation, adopting an affine self-adaptive alternating direction multiplier method to parallelly solve recovery strategies of the power transmission and distribution subsystem and the gas network subsystem, updating factors based on original punishment and dual proportion, and outputting a switching state, a unit start-stop and a load recovery scheme.

title_en: Method and system for optimizing charge-discharge control strategy of V2G applied to virtual power plant
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for optimizing a charge-discharge control strategy of a virtual power plant by using V2G, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a collaborative optimization strategy of comprehensive gain data based on electricity price change prediction and peak regulation demand prediction, constructing a collaborative optimization strategy of user demand matching based on user behavior patterns and user historical charge behavior data, constructing a collaborative optimization strategy of battery health degree management based on a health degree quantification model of a battery, and constructing a multi-objective dynamic optimization model based on the comprehensive gain data, the user demand matching and the collaborative optimization strategy of battery health degree management to realize charge-discharge control strategy optimization of the virtual power plant by using V2G. The invention realizes the full-flow coordination of strategy customization-dynamic invitation-user response by the virtual power plant leading, realizes the combination of the multi-mode charge-discharge control strategy, effectively utilizes the distributed energy storage characteristic of the electric automobile group to carry out load aggregation, and maximizes the power grid regulation capability.

title_en: County power grid power conservation and supply power grid source load cooperative control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a county power grid power supply and protection grid source load control system, which comprises a data acquisition module, a data classification processing module, a modeling component, a safety evaluation module, a control module, a power grid source load control strategy determination module, a source load control optimizing configuration method provision and a power regulation plan generation setting and issuing module, wherein the data acquisition module can acquire power grid power generation information data, load demand data and adjustable equipment information data, the data classification processing module can perform preprocessing and classification operation on the data, the modeling component can establish an integrated cooperative control model with multiple time scales based on the preprocessed and classified data information, the safety evaluation module can judge and divide the risk level of the power grid running state based on the integrated cooperative control model, the control module can determine the power grid source load control strategy according to the risk level of the power grid running state, the source load control optimizing configuration method provision is adopted, the power regulation plan generation is formulated and issued, the execution module can change the power distribution of adjustable equipment according to the power regulation plan.

title_en: Power converter and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power converter and a control method thereof, wherein the power converter comprises a first energy transmission circuit, a second energy transmission circuit and a power inductor, the first energy transmission circuit comprises a first primary winding and a secondary winding, the first primary winding and the secondary winding are connected in parallel through a power switch, the second energy transmission circuit comprises a second primary winding and a secondary winding, the second primary winding and the secondary winding are connected in parallel through the power switch, the power inductor is used for alternately receiving energy transmitted by the first energy transmission circuit and the second energy transmission circuit and transmitting the energy to an output port of the power converter, and the first energy transmission circuit and the second energy transmission circuit alternately work. According to the invention, through the magnetic coupling of the non-isolated transformers in the first energy transmission circuit and the second energy transmission circuit, the advantages of high transformation ratio and voltage reduction of the transformers are maintained, the stress of primary and secondary side power devices is reduced, the loss is reduced, and the system transmission efficiency is improved.

title_en: Crosslinked polyethylene insulated cable with protective structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of crosslinked polyethylene insulated cables, and provides a crosslinked polyethylene insulated cable with a protective structure, which comprises a conductor, an inner insulating layer, an outer sheath, an armor layer, a protective structure, a protective plate and a protective sleeve, wherein the inner insulating layer is wrapped outside the conductor, the filling is arranged between the outer insulating layer and the inner insulating layer, the armor layer is wrapped outside the outer insulating layer, the outer sheath is wrapped outside the armor layer, the protective structure is detachably arranged outside the outer sheath, the protective structure comprises a mounting assembly, a protective plate and a sealing ring, the mounting assembly is detachably mounted outside the outer sheath, the protective plate is in a semi-annular shape, the protective plate is connected outside the mounting assembly through a buffer spring and a buffer rod, the sealing rings are arranged at two, and the sealing ring is connected at two ends of the protective plate through a telescopic sleeve. Through the technical scheme, the problems that the crosslinked polyethylene insulated cable in the prior art is poor in protective performance and easy to damage in the laying process are solved.

title_en: Low-loss multiphase inductance material and inductance preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a low-loss multiphase inductance material which comprises a magnet and a winding, wherein coils adjacent to the winding are reversely wound, and meanwhile, the magnet is outwards extended to form an electrode, and the magnet comprises Fe-based nanocrystalline and iron powder. The application has the effect of reducing the loss of the inductance material.

title_en: Dynamic regulation and control method and system for distribution network operation mode based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of distribution network regulation and control, and discloses a dynamic regulation and control method and a system for a distribution network operation mode based on artificial intelligence. The method and the system can acquire the distribution network operation data of the target monitoring line in real time, realize real-time data perception of the target monitoring line, accurately predict the distribution network operation data by utilizing a pre-trained dynamic prediction model, realize accurate prediction of the distribution network operation state of the target monitoring line, judge whether the regulation and control conditions are met or not according to the prediction result, generate a dynamic regulation and control strategy, further execute regulation and control operation, realize dynamic regulation of the distribution network operation mode, and are beneficial to improving the distribution network power supply reliability of the target monitoring line, reducing line loss and improving voltage quality, enhancing the capability of the distribution network to cope with load change and fault conditions, and improving the distribution network safety and stability.

title_en: Energy storage battery compartment for realizing cluster-level liquid cooling and fire fighting integration
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy storage battery compartment for realizing cluster-level liquid cooling and fire fighting integration, and relates to the technical field of energy storage batteries, comprising a carrier plate, a plurality of liquid storage tanks and a plurality of liquid storage tanks, wherein an installation cavity is formed through the upper surface and the lower surface of the carrier plate, and a liquid inlet pipeline and a liquid outlet pipeline are respectively arranged in the carrier plate at the front side and the rear side of the carrier plate corresponding to the installation cavity; the cooling pipeline is arranged in the mounting cavity, the spraying mechanisms are arranged on the outer sides of the cooling pipeline and are communicated with the cooling pipeline, and the metal heat-conducting plate covers the upper opening and the lower opening of the mounting cavity. The battery cooling liquid is used as fire extinguishing liquid, and is used for absorbing heat released in the charging and discharging processes of the battery in the upper battery box in a normal state, so that the battery is stabilized in a normal working temperature range, when the battery is in thermal runaway, the circulating cooling liquid can be sprayed to the battery in the lower battery box through the spraying mechanism to extinguish the fire, and the integrated and combined high-integration structure of 'upper cooling and lower extinguishing' is adopted, so that the technical effect of 'one liquid with two purposes' of the circulating cooling liquid is realized, and the economic benefit is improved.

title_en: Charging and discharging control circuit and energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy storage, and mainly provides a charge-discharge control circuit and an energy storage system, wherein the circuit comprises a control module connected with a battery and an inverter, a charge switch module and a discharge switch module connected with the control module, the charging switch module is connected with the discharging switch module, the charging switch module is also connected with the battery, and the discharging switch module is also connected with the inverter and the heater arranged on the battery respectively. When the residual capacity of the battery is sufficient and the temperature is low, the control module cuts off the charging channel in time and opens the discharging heating channel, so that the damage to the battery caused by continuous charging at low temperature can be avoided, and meanwhile, the temperature of the battery is raised to a proper range through the heating of the inverter, and the cycle life of the battery is prolonged. And through carrying out dual monitoring to the electric current of discharge channel and heater, when the dc-to-ac converter output current is greater than the actual input current of heater, turn off discharge channel rapidly, can effectively avoid the battery to appear the safety risk such as overdischarge.

title_en: Smart city energy dynamic scheduling system and method based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy scheduling and discloses a smart city energy dynamic scheduling system and method based on big data analysis, wherein the method comprises the following steps of collecting the running state of a transformer substation, the basic parameters of a charging pile and the regional load prediction data in real time, and constructing a complete dynamic information base of a power grid-charging facility by data cleaning and outlier filtering; and generating a charging pile power adjustment instruction through a multi-objective optimization model, and iteratively correcting a power distribution scheme and generating a final dispatching instruction set while meeting the capacity of a power grid and simultaneously taking the minimum user satisfaction loss as a target. According to the invention, by constructing a dynamic response mechanism and a multi-target collaborative optimization model, accurate and rapid regulation and control of traffic load are realized under the sudden power shortage scene of the power grid.

title_en: Stackable power semiconductor assembly
abstract_en: The invention relates to a stackable power semiconductor component having a first power semiconductor and a second power semiconductor with a drain connection on a first side and a source connection on an opposite second side, wherein the first and second power semiconductors are arranged in a half-bridge circuit with the first and second sides of the first power semiconductor oriented in the same direction, a lower contact module for thermally connecting the first and second sides of the first and second power semiconductors with a lower cooling element and for electrically connecting the drain connection of the first power semiconductor with a first direct voltage input and the source connection of the second power semiconductor with a second direct voltage input, and an upper contact module for thermally connecting the second side of the first power semiconductor and the first side of the second power semiconductor with an upper cooling element and for electrically connecting the source connection of the first and second power semiconductors with an alternating voltage output.

title_en: High-Wen Gusuan-resistant lithium positive electrode material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of batteries, in particular to a high-temperature-resistant Wen Gusuan lithium positive electrode material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the high-temperature-resistant lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode material comprises a lithium cobalt oxide substrate and a coating layer coated on the surface of the lithium cobalt oxide substrate, the lithium cobalt oxide substrate is doped with Mg, ti and La, the coating layer is a fast ion coating layer of Li-Gd-Ti-O  4  spinel phase, during the preparation, the high-temperature solid phase method is used for carrying out bulk doping, the lithium cobalt oxide substrate is doped with Mg, ti and La, the lattice structure thermal stability of lithium cobalt oxide under high voltage (4.4V) is improved, the solid phase method is used for forming the fast ion coating layer of Li-Gd-Ti-O  4  spinel phase on the surface of the lithium cobalt oxide substrate, and the comprehensive performance, especially the capacity, the cycle stability, the thermal stability, the high-voltage tolerance and the like of the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode material are improved through multiple mechanisms such as the lattice stabilizing effect of rare earth ions, the interfacial barrier effect of composite oxide, the lithium ion conductivity regulation and the like.

title_en: Double-input signal virtual power system stabilizer optimization method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for optimizing a dual-input signal virtual power system stabilizer, and relates to the technical field of power system stability control. The method comprises the steps of collecting VPSS multi-source signals in real time during operation, carrying out normalization processing, converting one-dimensional time sequence signals into two-dimensional image matrixes by adopting GASF and GADF, completely reserving time dependence and dynamic phase relation of the signals, carrying out frequency-power coupling of physical variables through multi-channel GAF matrix coding, adopting a lightweight convolutional neural network to extract optimization features from the GAF matrixes, combining a near-end strategy optimization algorithm and matching with Lyapunov stability guarantee, dynamically adjusting VPSS control parameters, introducing an online learning mechanism and an abnormal switching strategy, adopting a closed-loop framework of signal collection-feature coding-pattern extraction-parameter optimization-control output-abnormal recovery, and enabling a real-time feedback system to respond and adjust dynamic performance and steady-state efficiency of a parameter balancing system to enable VPSS B to adapt to various operation conditions of network-built converter access.

title_en: Resident user ammeter case with electric leakage alarming function
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of resident ammeter boxes and provides a resident ammeter box with an electric leakage alarming function, which comprises a box body, wherein a supporting frame is arranged in the box body, a mounting plate is connected with the supporting frame through bolts, a zero-sequence current transformer, a singlechip and a wireless communication module are arranged on the mounting plate, a buzzer is fixedly arranged outside the box body, the box body is hinged with a cabinet door, the cabinet door is fixedly provided with an alarm lamp, and the singlechip is respectively and electrically connected with the zero-sequence current transformer, the wireless communication module, the buzzer and the alarm lamp.

title_en: Power grid operation optimization method, device, equipment and medium based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twinning-based power grid operation optimization method, device, equipment and medium, and belongs to the technical field of power grids. The method comprises the steps of collecting power grid operation data, inputting the power grid operation data into a pre-built power grid digital twin body, carrying out power grid multi-state coupling analysis through a dynamic behavior simulation process to generate a twin data set of the power grid, comparing the data in the twin data set with corresponding preset safety thresholds, adjusting a power grid operation strategy according to comparison results, and sending control instructions to corresponding physical equipment. The invention realizes accurate simulation and prediction of the operation of the power grid by constructing the digital twin body with the height consistent with the actual power grid. The digital twin body not only can reflect the current state of the power grid, but also can predict the running condition of the power grid under different conditions in the future through the dynamic behavior simulation engine, thereby providing powerful support for the optimized running of the power grid.

title_en: Energy control method and system based on multi-objective collaborative optimization
abstract_en: The invention relates to an energy control method and system based on multi-objective collaborative optimization, wherein the method takes the maximization of photovoltaic power generation and the minimization of outsourcing power charge as optimization targets, and comprises the following steps of carrying out photovoltaic output prediction and charge load prediction in different time intervals next day based on actual power generation data of a photovoltaic array in a photovoltaic storage and charge integrated power station, charge load data of a charge pile and historical weather data, and making a day-ahead plan, and carrying out real-time rolling adjustment on the basis of the day-ahead plan according to deviation of actual running conditions and the day-ahead plan by taking the minimum adjustment cost as the goal of maximizing the power consumption of the photovoltaic array, the real-time charge load of the charge pile and the real-time electric quantity of an energy storage subsystem. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of realizing energy efficient utilization, optimizing cost, improving the stability of the power grid and the like.

title_en: Positive electrode active material and method for preparing same
abstract_en: A chemical formula of the positive electrode active material is Li[Li x Ni a Co b Mn c M d ]O 2 ,x+a+b+c+d=1,x＞0,a＞0,0＜b＜0.1,c＞0,d≥0;M elements including one or more of Mg, nb, cr, ce, fe, ta, B, al, V, ti, zr, sn and Mo, wherein the specific surface area BET of the positive electrode active material meets 0.9m  2 /g~3.2m 2 /g, and the diameter spacing SPAN= (Dv 90-Dv 10)/Dv 50 of the positive electrode active material meets that the SPAN is more than or equal to 0.94. The positive electrode active material is obtained by acid treatment and sintering treatment of lithium-rich manganese-based sintered powder under specified conditions, and can effectively improve gram capacity of a battery.

title_en: Stator core, motor and household appliance
abstract_en: The invention provides a stator core, a motor and a household appliance, wherein the stator core comprises a plurality of core units, the core units are sequentially connected, the core units are enclosed to form the stator core along the circumferential direction of the stator core, the core units comprise a first core and a second core, a first plug-in part is arranged on the first core, a second plug-in part is arranged on the second core, the first plug-in part and the second plug-in part are mutually plugged, any core unit comprises a tooth part and a yoke part, the yoke part is connected with the tooth part, and an axial through hole is formed between the yoke parts on two adjacent core units.

title_en: Automatic miniature motor production line feeding system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic miniature motor production line feeding system and a control method thereof, and relates to the technical field of transportation or storage devices. The method comprises the steps of carrying out part segmentation on a global image of a feeding bin in a feeding system, determining target parts to be grabbed in the global image, correcting the movement of grabbing equipment in real time based on deviation between an actual running track of the grabbing equipment and a global planning path in the moving process of the grabbing equipment until the target probability of the target parts contained in a local image of the feeding bin is larger than a preset probability threshold value, adjusting path planning weights of the global image and the local image in real time based on the local image of the feeding bin when the target probability is larger than the preset probability threshold value, and moving the grabbing equipment to an optimal grabbing position based on surface texture information of the target parts when the grabbing equipment moves to a preset stopping position of the target parts. The invention can obviously improve the feeding efficiency.

title_en: Quality monitoring system and method for production of insulating side-expanded casing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quality monitoring system and a quality monitoring method for production of an insulating side-expanded casing pipe, and relates to the field of pipe quality monitoring. The method comprises the steps of S1, collecting ultrasonic wall thickness, infrared temperature, capacitance signals and process parameters, S2, calculating local gradient abnormality indexes by normalizing the signals to generate enhanced signals, S3, calculating flaring stress indexes according to thickness deviation and process parameters, S4, calculating coupling non-uniformity based on the local gradient abnormality indexes, S5, calculating comprehensive quality factors according to the local gradient abnormality indexes, the flaring stress indexes, the coupling non-uniformity and the process parameter deviation, S6, detecting abnormality to generate abnormality marks based on the dynamic deviation rate of the comprehensive quality factors and the self-adaptive threshold, S7, mapping time sequence characteristics corresponding to the abnormality marks to space coordinates to output defect distribution information, S8, generating process parameter adjustment quantity according to the defect distribution information, and feeding back to a control system.

title_en: Current transformer production method and current transformer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production method of a current transformer and the current transformer, aiming at providing a process production method of the current transformer with high production efficiency and manufacturing cost saving and the current transformer, which has the technical proposal that the process comprises chamfering the corners of an iron core, the winding method has the advantages that the corner rings made of the insulating paper boards are omitted, two layers of DMD insulating paper are half-folded, the material and labor cost is reduced, the production efficiency is improved, the wires are more tightly attached to the iron core, the increase of the winding size generated by the corner rings is reduced, and the coil size is reduced. The adverse effect of the water content in the insulating paper board on the transformer is reduced. And the secondary winding can not discharge the iron core tip, so that the product safety is further ensured, and the product quality is improved. The invention is suitable for the technical field of electrical equipment.

title_en: Outdoor protective low-voltage power distribution cabinet
abstract_en: The invention discloses an outdoor protective low-voltage power distribution cabinet, which relates to the technical field of power distribution cabinets and comprises a power distribution cabinet body and an exhaust hood arranged at the top of the power distribution cabinet body, wherein an adjusting component is arranged at the top of the power distribution cabinet body. When the rain-proof cap is used, the first electric push rod is started to push the adjusting plate, the adjusting rod and the fixing plate to move upwards, so that the rain-proof cap peak and the drainage plate are jacked up and separated from the exhaust hood. Simultaneously, the elastic drainage pad is elastically deformed to form a sharp cone shape, and V-shaped drainage strips with different angles are distributed on the four inclined surfaces of the elastic drainage pad. At this time, the rain-proof hat brim and the drainage plate are suspended above the exhaust hood, hot air flows outwards from the suspended space, the air circulation space is obviously enlarged, hot air is rapidly discharged through a convection mode of 'lower inlet and upper outlet', retention is avoided, narrow slits between the flat plates are changed into quadrangular frustum pyramid-shaped spaces by the conical elastic drainage pad, the air circulation volume is obviously increased, and the hot air discharge efficiency is improved.

title_en: Permanent magnet synchronous motor prediction torque control method based on double priority ordering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a permanent magnet synchronous motor prediction torque control method based on double priority sequencing, which belongs to the field of motor control and comprises the steps of predicting alternating-direct axis current based on multiple groups of alternating-direct axis alternative control voltages, alternating-direct axis currents and rotating speeds at the current moment of a permanent magnet synchronous motor, and obtaining a predicted flux linkage value by the predicted alternating-direct axis currents; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a first priority ranking result by calculating flux linkage error evaluation values according to obtained multiple groups of predicted flux linkage values and set reference flux linkage values and ranking, obtaining motor torque values based on multiple groups of alternating-direct axis currents at the current moment of a permanent magnet synchronous motor, calculating torque error evaluation values according to obtained multiple groups of motor torque values and set reference torque values and ranking to obtain a second priority ranking result, and obtaining an alternative control voltage with optimal comprehensive ranking by fusing the priority ranking results. According to the invention, the weight factors are not required to be set manually, and the control precision and the robustness of the motor are improved.

title_en: Preparation method of intangible ferric oxide and application of intangible ferric oxide in negative electrode of sodium ion battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of amorphous ferric oxide and application of the amorphous ferric oxide in a negative electrode of a sodium ion battery, and belongs to the field of amorphous material preparation. The method takes an iron sheet as an electrode, selects a mixed solution containing inorganic salt and glucose as electrolyte, electrolyzes and stirs under sine wave alternating voltage, and obtains the micro-magnetic amorphous iron oxide material by regulating and controlling parameters such as glucose concentration, voltage, stirring speed and the like. The obtained material has the characteristics of high specific capacity, excellent cycling stability and low impedance, the initial specific capacity reaches 389.10 mAh/g, the 230.71 mAh/g is kept after 200 times of cycling, and the impedance is about 279 ohm. The invention solves the problems of poor capacity and poor cycling stability of the existing sodium ion battery cathode material, has simple process and low cost, is suitable for the fields of intelligent power grid energy storage, distributed energy storage, low-speed electric vehicle power supply and the like, and has remarkable economic value and application prospect.

title_en: Auxiliary device for power transmission climbing
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the technical field of power transmission climbing devices, specifically to a power transmission climbing auxiliary device, comprising a pedal and a clamping rod for clamping electric poles. A connecting rod is provided between the pedal and the clamping rod for connection, and a foot cover for foot wearing is provided at the top of the pedal. The self-adjusting mechanism is set on the pedal and the connecting rod. Through the setting of the self-adjusting mechanism, the safety hazard of the user needing to readjust at high altitude due to the loosening and sliding of the hook during climbing use is avoided. With the change of air pressure driven by the stepping action, the device can automatically stabilize the clamping according to the diameter of the electric pole when stepping down, and automatically release when lifting the foot upward. Easy to climb up again, The clamping distance of the device during this period is determined by the height when the foot steps down, and has a freely adjustable effect.

title_en: Multi-dimensional beam angle adjusting system and lamp based on stepping motor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of lamps and lanterns and discloses a multi-dimensional beam angle adjusting system based on a stepping motor and a lamp, wherein the multi-dimensional beam angle adjusting system based on the stepping motor comprises a horizontal stepping adjusting mechanism, a vertical stepping adjusting mechanism, a base, a rotating rod, a bearing and a rotating seat, wherein the vertical stepping adjusting mechanism is arranged on the rotating seat, a containing cavity is formed in the base, an outer ring of the bearing is connected with the inner wall of the containing cavity, and the rotating rod is fixedly sleeved in the middle of the bearing and used for driving the vertical stepping adjusting mechanism to change the horizontal position; the horizontal stepping adjusting mechanism is arranged in the base. When the rotating rod rotates, the sucking and filtering mechanism automatically sucks, filters and circulates lubricating liquid under the action of the magnetic part, the filtering net filters impurities, the axial flow blades are self-cleaning and anti-blocking with bristles, the maintenance service life is prolonged, and the symmetrical mechanism balances the centrifugal force and shaking of the rotating rod by means of the force of the baffle ring Shi Jingxiang, so that friction is reduced, and stability and adjustment precision are improved.

title_en: Rubber frame and rubber frame lamination integrated manufacturing system, manufacturing method and solid-state battery
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of solid-state battery production, in particular to a rubber frame, a rubber frame lamination integrated manufacturing system, a manufacturing method and a solid-state battery. The invention provides a rubber frame, which comprises a film and a composite film which are arranged in a stacked manner, wherein the film comprises a frame part and a film part positioned in the frame part, and an easy-tearing structure is arranged between the frame part and the film part so that the film part can be torn off by the frame part. According to the invention, the adhesive rubber frame with the adhesive property is prefabricated, when the adhesive rubber frame is used, the composite sheet is torn off from the frame part, the adhesive property of the adhesive part in the composite sheet is transferred to the frame part, the frame part is adhered to one side of the negative electrode sheet, and the sheet part is positioned on the non-adhesive part and basically has no adhesive property, and the easily torn structure is arranged between the frame part and the sheet part, so that the sheet part can be torn off, the positive electrode sheet can be placed in the frame part, and the situation that toxic gas is easy to generate due to direct gluing and solidification at the peripheral edge of the negative electrode sheet is avoided due to the prefabricated rubber frame.

title_en: Power distribution network power flow calculation method based on super-parameter optimization graph attention network
abstract_en: The power flow calculation method of the power distribution network based on the super-parameter optimization graph attention network comprises the steps of simulating and generating power flow operation data of a system according to historical wind-solar output data and load data, and forming graph data by utilizing node characteristic data and topology information of the power distribution network. On the basis, a power distribution network trend regression model based on a graph attention network (graph attention network, GAT) is established, and spatial correlation characteristics among nodes are mined through a graph attention mechanism. In addition, when the topology of the power distribution network changes, the model can dynamically adjust the attention coefficient according to the new node connection relation, so that the rapid adaptation to the new topology is realized. In view of the fact that the performance of the neural network is highly dependent on the setting of the super-parameters, an improved seagull optimization algorithm (improved seagull optimization algorithm, ISOA) is introduced to automatically optimize the super-parameters of the network so as to obtain an optimal GAT trend regression model, namely ISOA-GAT. Finally, through a Python simulation platform, the method provided by the invention can be used for rapidly and accurately calculating the power flow of the power distribution network, and has stronger topology generalization capability.

title_en: Stator inslot oil-cooled insulation structure and driving motor based on foaming inhibitor control
abstract_en: The application relates to a stator tank internal oil cooling insulation structure based on foaming inhibitor control and a driving motor, which relate to the technical field of driving motors, and comprise a stator core and an oil cooling insulation structure, wherein the application forms rectangular protruding ends by arranging the oil cooling insulation structure, namely foaming insulation paper arranged inside, and combining with epoxy resin strips, thus, oil guiding grooves are formed between adjacent rectangular protruding ends to realize the transmission of cooling oil, thereby meeting the high-efficiency oil cooling heat dissipation of stator windings, and the inboard concave end of rectangle protruding end still is equipped with the foaming layer, is heated the inflation promptly, comes in close contact with stator winding, realizes connecting sealed activity to this, avoids the emergence of oil leak problem, simultaneously, foaming insulating paper then the setting of each layer in inside, and supplementary improvement oil cooling heat dissipation and the insulating effect to through the cooperation of substrate layer, improve structural strength, realize life's enhancement, with this, make driving motor heat dissipation and life show promotion.

title_en: Arc path forming part and direct current relay comprising same
abstract_en: The invention discloses an arc path forming part and a direct current relay comprising the same, which can prevent a magnet from being arbitrarily separated, and comprises a magnet frame; and a plurality of magnetic blocks formed of a magnetic material, the plurality of magnetic blocks being adjacently arranged on an inner peripheral surface of the magnet frame and being aligned in one direction, wherein the inner peripheral surface of the magnet frame includes a spacer arranged between two magnetic blocks adjacent to each other among the plurality of magnetic blocks.

title_en: Composite positive electrode active material, method for preparing same, positive electrode comprising same, and all-solid-state secondary battery
abstract_en: Disclosed are a composite positive electrode active material, a method for preparing the same, a positive electrode including the same, and an all-solid secondary battery, the composite positive electrode active material including a core including a lithium-containing sulfide-based positive electrode active material, and a shell disposed along a surface of the core, wherein the shell includes at least one first metal oxide represented by a chemical formula M  a O b  (0<a≤3 and 0< b <4, and b is not an integer if a is 1,2, or 3), a first carbon-based material, and a second carbon-based material, the first metal oxide is disposed inside a first carbon-based material matrix, M is at least one metal selected from the elements of groups 2 to 16 of the periodic table, and the second carbon-based material includes fibrous carbon having an aspect ratio of 10 or more.

title_en: Sodium ion battery formation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sodium ion battery formation method, which relates to the technical field of sodium ion batteries, and constructs a compact initial SEI film as a high-quality basis through precisely controlled small current; the potential weak area of the initial membrane is actively exposed and shattered by utilizing the limit expansion of the high-current full charge initiation electrode, and then the advanced decomposition of unstable components and the controllable discharge of gas byproducts are accelerated in the high-temperature aging stage, so that the reparative membrane formation at the newly generated crack can be promoted. The SEI film finally obtained after the process is executed for a plurality of rounds has excellent chemical stability and mechanical flexibility, and can be perfectly adapted to the volume change of the electrode in long-term circulation, thereby fundamentally inhibiting continuous side reaction and gas production, and remarkably improving the storage performance and the cycle life of the finished product of the sodium ion battery.

title_en: High-voltage GIS combined type auxiliary maintenance operation platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-voltage GIS combined auxiliary maintenance operation platform and method, comprising a maintenance platform, a safety belt tying unit and an intelligent control unit, wherein the intelligent control unit comprises a data acquisition and processing module, a rolling control module and a rolling motor driving module, the data acquisition and processing module is used for receiving data of a platform positioning sensor and a tension sensor, the rolling control module is used for calculating errors of a theoretical value and an actual value of a rope tension of an operator according to a lever balance theory and position change of the operator, the rope tension is adjusted through a gradient descent algorithm, the system approaches to a lever balance state when the position of the operator changes, charged detection time factors are considered, the detection path and the progress of the operator are optimized, and the rolling motor driving module is used for controlling operation of a motor of an electric rolling device according to instructions output by the rolling control module. The invention can ensure that the rope always maintains proper tension and provides dynamic safety protection for operators.

title_en: Low-power consumption control method, direct-current energy storage device, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of new energy, in particular to a low-power consumption control method, direct-current energy storage equipment, a system and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of starting a wireless communication module and a first timer after the direct current energy storage device is electrified, controlling the wireless communication module to be powered off when the first timer reaches a first on-line time length, controlling the MCU to enter a deep sleep mode when the battery of the device is detected to be in a non-charge-discharge state continuously, periodically detecting an activation source or a timed wake-up time through the RTC module, controlling the MCU to exit the deep sleep mode if the activation source exists, controlling the MCU to exit the deep sleep mode if the timed wake-up time is reached, and starting the wireless communication module and a second timer, and controlling the wireless communication module to be powered off when the time length of the second timer reaches a second on-line time length. The method of the application not only remarkably reduces the power consumption of the direct current energy storage equipment, but also optimizes network resources and improves response reliability.

title_en: DC converter valve, control method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a direct current converter valve, a control method and a system, wherein the direct current converter valve comprises a plurality of bridge arms, a plurality of power components are connected in series in each bridge arm, each power component comprises at least one power device, a plurality of voltage-sharing modules are connected in parallel at the input end and the output end of each power component, each voltage-sharing module comprises a dynamic voltage-sharing unit and a static voltage-sharing unit which are connected in parallel, each dynamic voltage-sharing unit is connected with each power component in parallel, each dynamic voltage-sharing unit comprises a branch circuit formed by electrically connecting a switch component and a preset capacitor, each dynamic voltage-sharing unit is used for carrying out voltage sharing on the power devices in fault recovery conduction and fault states, each static voltage-sharing unit is used for carrying out voltage sharing on the power devices in blocking states, and the problem that the voltage-sharing effect on the plurality of semiconductor devices connected in series in the bridge arms of the converter valve is insufficient is solved.

title_en: Cultivated land backup resource investigation integrated equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cultivated land reserve resource investigation integrated device, which relates to the technical field of investigation equipment and comprises a support column and control equipment, wherein a frame body is symmetrically arranged at the upper part of the support column, a solar panel is arranged at the inner side of the frame body, a processing component is arranged on the support column, the processing component comprises a first transmission unit arranged on the support column, a movable box symmetrically and slidingly arranged above the support column, a scraper plate movably connected with the side surface of the movable box, a second transmission unit arranged on the movable box and a plurality of fan blades rotatably connected with the inner side of the movable box, the first transmission unit starts to drive the two movable boxes to move back and forth on the solar panel and scrape dirt on the solar panel through the scraper plate, the processing component is arranged to scrape the dirt on the surface of the solar panel through the scraper plate, and blowing and sucking forces are generated through the rotation of the fan blades in the moving and cleaning process of the scraper plate, so that the scraped residual impurities are further cleaned, and the automatic cleaning of the dirt on the surface of the solar panel is realized.

title_en: Scheduling control method based on power grid virtual power plant optimization
abstract_en: The invention provides a dispatching control method based on power grid virtual power plant optimization, which relates to the technical field of power system dispatching, and comprises the steps of collecting basic data through a distributed monitoring network, preprocessing, and predicting load by using a deep learning model; the method comprises the steps of formulating a scheduling strategy according to a prediction result, preferentially scheduling the adaptive single distributed energy nodes or combining multiple nodes through a cooperative scheduling algorithm, monitoring the state of a power grid in real time, starting a dynamic adjustment mechanism based on deviation grading, accessing a standby energy system according to the characteristics of a gap if a load gap still exists, and finally evaluating the scheduling effect and optimizing the strategy. Through collaborative design of accurate prediction, intelligent scheduling, dynamic adjustment and multi-objective optimization, a closed loop system of prediction, scheduling, adjustment and optimization is formed, the energy utilization efficiency, the power supply reliability and the scheme scientificity are comprehensively improved, a high-proportion distributed energy access scene is adapted, and efficient, stable, economical and low-carbon virtual power plant scheduling is realized.

title_en: Quick closing mechanism of circuit breaker
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quick switch-on mechanism of a circuit breaker, which comprises a shell, a contact support piece rotatably arranged in the shell, a moving contact hinged on the contact support piece, a fixed contact matched with the moving contact, a stop piece and an energy storage elastic piece. The stop piece is rotatably arranged in the shell and is abutted against the tail part of the moving contact in the initial stage of the closing process so as to limit the initial movement of the moving contact, namely, the moving contact is limited to freely rotate along with the contact support piece through the stop piece, so that conditions are created for the subsequent rapid closing action. The energy storage elastic piece is connected between the moving contact and the contact support piece and is a power source for quick closing. The invention has compact structure and high reliability, and drives the moving contact to move at high speed immediately before the moving contact and the fixed contact are contacted in a mode of firstly storing energy and then releasing energy in the closing process, thereby realizing quick closing, effectively inhibiting the generation of electric arcs, protecting the contact and obviously improving the electrical life and reliability of the circuit breaker.

title_en: Battery and power utilization device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of batteries, in particular to a battery and an electric device. The battery comprises a shell, a pole group and a cover plate assembly, wherein the shell comprises a first side plate, a second side plate and a connecting side plate, the first side plate and the second side plate are alternately connected, the second side plate comprises a main body part and a protruding part, the main body part is connected with the first side plate, the protruding part is arranged at least one end of the main body part along a first direction, the connecting side plate is connected with the protruding part, the size of the first side plate along the first direction is smaller than that of the main body part, the first side plate, the second side plate and the connecting side plate jointly form a containing space with a Z-shaped opening, the cover plate assembly comprises a cover plate body, the cover plate body is Z-shaped and covers the Z-shaped opening, and the pole group is arranged in the containing space. The battery increases the internal space of the shell, further increases the volume of the pole group, improves the capacity and energy density of the battery, can adapt to the requirements of specific application scenes, fully utilizes space resources and improves the deformation resistance of the cover plate body.

title_en: Wide-temperature-range hydrogel for battery thermal management and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of battery thermal management, and discloses a wide-temperature-range hydrogel for battery thermal management, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of adding polyvinyl alcohol and gelatin into water, heating, stirring and dissolving; adding sodium alginate and polyalcohol, stirring, adding polyacrylic acid, stirring, adding cross-linking agent, stirring, degassing, maintaining the temperature, standing to obtain hydrogel, soaking the hydrogel in H  2 SO 4  water solution, vibrating to swell completely, heating in oven to constant weight, and washing with deionized water to neutrality. According to the invention, jiang Shuige groups are introduced into the hydrogel to establish a strong connection structure between water molecules and a polymer network, so that the water molecules are firmly fixed in the polymer network of the hydrogel, escape or icing is prevented, the network structure can be sacrificed by hydrogen bond formation, the flexibility of the hydrogel in a wider temperature range is effectively maintained, and the thermal management capability in a battery pack is improved.

title_en: SmFe with low rare earth and high performance12Preparation method of base permanent magnet alloy
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a SmFe  12  -based permanent magnet alloy with low rare earth and high performance, which comprises the steps of proportioning simple substance raw materials according to the proportion of Sm  0.75+x Zr 0.25 Fe 8.8+   y Co 2.2+z Ti 1+m B n , and preparing the SmFe  12  -based permanent magnet alloy through the steps of arc melting, melt rapid quenching, heat treatment and the like. According to the invention, zr, co, ti, B elements are introduced into the SmFe  12  -based permanent magnet alloy, so that the permanent magnet alloy has lower rare earth content and the loss of ferromagnetic element content is minimized, the utilization rate and high-valued level of the rare earth elements are improved, meanwhile, the generation of alpha-Fe phase is effectively inhibited, a better phase composition structure is obtained, the balance between coercive force and remanence is realized, the SmFe  12  -based permanent magnet alloy has excellent magnetic performance, the coercive force of the SmFe  12  -based permanent magnet alloy reaches 8.78 kOe, and the maximum magnetic energy product is 71 kJ/m < 3 >.

title_en: Entropy-stable lithium-rich layered oxide positive electrode material, and preparation method and application thereof
