abstract_en: The invention discloses an entropy-stable lithium-rich layered oxide positive electrode material, and a preparation method and application thereof. The chemical general formula of the entropy-stable lithium-rich layered oxide positive electrode material is Li  1.2‑   2x Be x Na x Mn 0.54 Ni 0.13 Co 0.13 O 2‑x F x , x is the mole percentage of doping elements, and the value range of x is 0.01-0.03. Dissolving a lithium source, a nickel salt, a cobalt salt, a manganese salt and a sodium salt in a citric acid aqueous solution according to a stoichiometric ratio to obtain a first solution, mixing a beryllium source, a fluorine source and the first solution according to the stoichiometric ratio to obtain a precursor solution, continuously stirring the precursor solution at 50-100 ℃ to form a precursor gel, presintering the precursor gel in an air atmosphere at 300-500 ℃ for 3-5 hours, and sintering the precursor gel at 700-1000 ℃ for 8-15 hours to obtain the lithium-rich layered oxide anode material with stable entropy. According to the lithium-rich layered oxide positive electrode material prepared by the entropy stabilization strategy, the Be element and the Na element are doped to replace the Li element, the F element is doped to replace the O element, and the coulomb efficiency and the cycling stability of primary charge and discharge are improved.

title_en: New energy vehicle and high-voltage discharge control method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a new energy vehicle and a high-voltage discharge control method thereof. The new energy vehicle comprises vehicle end equipment and a charging gun, wherein the vehicle end equipment comprises a direct current power supply, a DC-DC converter, a switch assembly and a high-voltage external interface, the direct current power supply is connected with the input end of the DC-DC converter, the output end of the DC-DC converter is connected with a high-voltage terminal of the high-voltage external interface through the switch assembly, the charging gun comprises a first gun end and a second gun end which are connected through a conductive cable, the first gun end is used for being connected and matched with the high-voltage external interface, and the second gun end is used for being connected with a high-voltage direct current interface of a vehicle at a receiving end.

title_en: Stator housing kludge
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of assembly, in particular to a stator shell assembly machine which comprises a production line workbench, wherein a stator guide mechanism and a shell guide mechanism are arranged on the production line workbench, the stator guide mechanism comprises a plurality of guide plates, the guide plates are round, a fixing ring is fixedly connected to the guide plates, a first vertical plate is fixedly connected to the right side of a first placement block, two first air cylinders are arranged on the first vertical plate, a first arc-shaped block is fixedly connected to an extension rod of each first air cylinder, the shell guide mechanism comprises a C-shaped cylinder, the fixing ring close to the C-shaped cylinder is attached to the C-shaped cylinder, a second vertical plate is fixed to the left side of each second placement block, two second air cylinders are arranged on the second vertical plate, and a second arc-shaped block is fixedly connected to the extension rod of each second air cylinder.

title_en: Current reconstruction method for open-winding permanent magnet synchronous motor in single-phase open-phase operation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of open winding permanent magnet synchronous motor control, in particular to a current reconstruction method for an open winding permanent magnet synchronous motor in single-phase open-phase operation, which comprises the following steps of obtaining The method comprises the steps of obtaining a reference voltage in a coordinate system, a sector where a reference voltage vector synthesized by the reference voltage is located, a first action time and a second action time, obtaining bus currents corresponding to each condition of the sector where the reference voltage vector is located, the first action time, the second action time and the minimum sampling time, and obtaining phase currents of the residual phases of the open-winding permanent magnet synchronous motor after reconstruction. The invention effectively reduces the unobservable area of the single-phase open-phase space vector pulse width modulation method, reduces the number of current sensors, reduces the system cost, realizes accurate reconstruction of phase current on the premise of maintaining the symmetrical triangular carrier modulation method, and improves the performance and reliability of the open-winding permanent magnet synchronous motor in the single-phase open-phase operation.

title_en: Mobile power track device and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a movable power rail device which comprises a plug, a bracket main body and a power rail, wherein the bracket main body comprises a base and a vertical shell, the shell is divided into a strong current area and a weak current area, the power rail corresponds to the strong current and weak current rails, the strong current rail is arranged in the strong current area and is connected with one or more rail socket modules in a sliding manner, the weak current rail is arranged in the weak current area, and one or more magnetic attraction low-voltage functional modules are connected in a magnetic attraction manner. The device solves the problems of poor mobility, single function, large potential safety hazard and insufficient expansibility of the traditional power distribution device, can move integrally, isolate strong and weak electricity physics from electricity, integrate strong and weak electricity power supply, can be flexibly adjusted by a module, realize safe, flexible and efficient power consumption experience, and adapt to multiple scenes such as families, offices and the like.

title_en: Three-phase single-stage power supply
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a three-phase single-stage power supply, which comprises a positive output end, a negative output end, a first single-stage conversion module, a second single-stage conversion module and a third single-stage conversion module. The output ends of the first, second and third single-stage conversion modules are connected in parallel with the positive output end and the negative output end. The third single-stage conversion module comprises a third transformer, a third output rectifying circuit, a relay, an auxiliary inductor and an auxiliary capacitor, wherein the third output rectifying circuit comprises a fifth group of switch circuits and a sixth group of switch circuits. The fifth group of switching circuits and the sixth group of switching circuits respectively comprise two switches connected in series. The relay, the auxiliary inductor and the auxiliary capacitor are connected in series between the midpoint of the two switches of the sixth group of switch circuits and the negative output end, so that the third single-stage conversion module forms a buck/boost converter.

title_en: Wide-temperature-range high-magnification lithium titanate battery and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wide-temperature-range high-rate lithium titanate battery and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of wide-temperature-range high-rate lithium titanate batteries, and comprising an anode active substance, wherein the anode active substance consists of nickel cobalt lithium manganate and lithium cobaltate; the negative electrode comprises a negative electrode active material, wherein the negative electrode active material consists of lithium lanthanum titanium oxide and lithium titanate, the current collector is carbon-coated aluminum foil, the diaphragm is a single-sided ceramic diaphragm, and the electrolyte comprises an organic solvent, a composite electrolyte and a composite additive. The positive electrode of the lithium ion battery adopts the composite of the nickel cobalt lithium manganate and the lithium cobaltate as the active substance, the nickel cobalt lithium manganate and the lithium cobaltate cooperatively optimize an electrochemical window, the stability and the ion conductivity of the material are obviously improved, the interface impedance is reduced, the negative electrode adopts the composite of the lithium lanthanum titanium oxide and the lithium titanate, the high fracture toughness of the lithium lanthanum titanium oxide effectively improves the compaction density of the lithium titanate, shortens the lithium ion transmission path, and can supplement lithium, improve the interface condition of the electrode and reduce the capacity loss.

title_en: Iodine-doped graphene material of lithium-sulfur battery positive electrode catalyst and rapid preparation method
abstract_en: According to the method, iodine atoms with high content and low price are selected as catalysts, the characteristic of absorbing waves of the reduced graphene oxide material and the characteristic of easy sublimation of the iodine simple substances are utilized, the method of microwave gas phase synthesis is utilized, the high-temperature reaction or long-time hydrothermal synthesis is not needed, the iodine doped reduced graphene oxide material can be quickly and efficiently prepared, and is used on the sulfur positive electrode side of the lithium sulfur battery, the battery positive electrode material can be prepared by adding the catalysts, the reaction energy barrier of sulfur reduction is reduced, the polarization of electrochemical reaction is reduced, the redox reaction kinetics is accelerated, the polysulfide shuttle effect is restrained, and the cycling stability of the battery is improved.

title_en: Gas diffusion layer structure with durability and high conductivity and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fuel cells, and particularly relates to a gas diffusion layer structure with durability and high conductivity, and a preparation method and application thereof. The gas diffusion layer comprises a metal ion capturing layer, a substrate layer and a microporous layer which are sequentially stacked, wherein the metal ion capturing layer contains a metal ion capturing material, the metal ion capturing material is one or more selected from polyethylenimine, polyacrylic acid, polyvinyl alcohol, chitosan and perfluorinated sulfonic acid ionomer, and particularly the metal ion capturing layer is constructed on the substrate layer close to one side of a flow channel, and the conductivity of the gas diffusion layer is improved by a method of strong interaction force between a high electronegative chemical group and metal ions, and meanwhile, the metal ion is efficiently captured in a broad spectrum, so that the gas diffusion layer has a wide application prospect.

title_en: Polybenzimidazole modified ion conducting membrane for flow battery and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of ion exchange membranes, and particularly discloses a polybenzimidazole modified ion conducting membrane for a flow battery and a preparation method thereof. The ion conducting membrane is prepared by dissolving polybenzimidazole polymer resin and a cross-linking agent in an organic solvent to obtain a liquid phase raw material and doping proton conductors, wherein the cross-linking agent is selected from one or more of polyethylene glycol diglycidyl ether, polymethyl triethoxysilane, epoxy resin, chloromethylated polysulfone, melamine formaldehyde resin and propyl trimethoxysilane, and the proton conductors are selected from phosphoric acid metal salt, phytic acid metal salt, perovskite oxide, silicon dioxide substrate sub-conductors and metal organic frame derived proton conductors. By utilizing the technical scheme for the body, the prepared ion conducting membrane ensures excellent ion selectivity and proton conductivity, and has excellent chemical stability and mechanical property.

title_en: Electrochemical device and electronic device
abstract_en: The electrochemical device (100) comprises an electrode assembly (20) and a first conductive plate (30), the electrode assembly (20) comprises a first pole piece (21), the first pole piece (21) comprises a first current collector (210) and a first conductive material layer (211), the first current collector (210) comprises a first surface (210 a), the first conductive material layer (211) is arranged on the first surface (210 a), the first conductive material layer (211) is provided with a first opening (2110), the first surface (210 a) comprises a first area (2100), the first area (2100) is configured as an area of the first surface (210 a) exposed by the first opening (2110), the first conductive plate (30) is connected to the first area (2100), the first pole piece (21) comprises a first end edge (213) and a second end edge (214) as seen in a first direction, the first end edge (213) is provided with a first concave portion (2130), the first concave portion (2130) is arranged separately from the first area (2100) as seen in the first direction, and the first area (2130) is overlapped with the first area (2130) in the first direction and the first conductive plate (2100) is partially overlapped on the first area (2130) as seen in the first direction.

title_en: Flooding control method and device for fuel cell system and fuel cell system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fuel cells, in particular to a flooding control method and a flooding control device of a fuel cell system and the fuel cell system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of obtaining operation parameters of a closed fuel cell; the method comprises the steps of calculating and obtaining water saturation data according to operation parameters, wherein the water saturation data at least comprises a water saturation distribution result and a water saturation reduction rate, comparing the water saturation distribution result with a closed fuel cell flooding threshold value to determine a high flooding area in the closed fuel cell, discharging liquid water in the high flooding area, and adjusting the reaction gas introduction rate according to the water saturation reduction rate. The invention can realize the directional and dynamic regulation of flooding, improves the stability and durability under variable working conditions, simultaneously quantifies the distribution of the water saturation in the closed fuel cell in real time, directly uses the core field quantity as the regulation and control basis, realizes the accurate regulation and control based on the internal real flooding state, and avoids the defect of misjudgment of macroscopic parameters.

title_en: Short-term scheduling rule extraction method for water-light complementary system
abstract_en: A method for extracting short-term dispatching rules of a water-light complementary system comprises the following steps of correcting an existing business prediction result by a probability prediction model based on historical observation data and business prediction data of runoffs and light power, generating a plurality of groups of possible runoffs and light power scenes in the future by a data sampling method based on the business prediction result corrected by the step-one probability prediction model, constructing a water-light complementary peak regulation optimizing dispatching model, constructing a Bayesian gating cyclic network capable of considering uncertainty of business prediction results and model parameter, introducing a probability recalibration mechanism capable of effectively relieving uncertainty estimation deviation of the Bayesian gating cyclic network, extracting complementary system dispatching rules considering multiple uncertainties based on an optimizing dispatching solution set obtained in the step three, and guiding water-light complementary system peak regulation dispatching by utilizing the complementary system dispatching rules. The application can improve the comprehensive benefit of the multi-energy complementary system.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle cluster-based distributed optical storage network energy regulation and control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distributed optical storage network energy regulation and control system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, which comprises an energy network module, a mobile energy routing module and a decision control module, wherein the decision control module is configured to establish an energy topological relation mapping table of each node and each unmanned aerial vehicle according to the electric energy state and the position of each node obtained in real time and the electric energy state and the position of each unmanned aerial vehicle, introduce a virtual guide signal to generate a routing map based on the electric energy gradient difference between each node in the mapping table and the mobile energy consumption cost of the unmanned aerial vehicle, discretize the routing map into a field intensity vector set and broadcast to the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, trigger the self-organizing behavior of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, and enable the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster to execute power taking or backfeed operation. Therefore, the invention aims at the technical problems that the traditional micro-grid cooperative mode has high cost and cannot adapt to the urban complex environment due to dynamic unbalance of supply and demand caused by the island effect of the distributed optical storage system, and realizes the global optimal configuration of the distributed energy sources by constructing a multistage cooperative framework.

title_en: Temperature-control pressurizing rapid curing system and method for square-shell battery pack
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power battery packaging, in particular to a temperature-control pressurizing rapid curing system and a temperature-control pressurizing rapid curing method for a square-shell battery pack, wherein the curing system comprises a transverse moving connection mechanism, a temperature-control mechanism and a pressurizing mechanism, the transverse moving connection mechanism comprises a jacking mechanism and a transverse moving mechanism, the jacking mechanism realizes feeding and discharging of the square-shell battery pack, and the transverse moving mechanism transversely moves the square-shell battery pack to the temperature-control mechanism; the temperature control mechanism comprises a contact temperature control mechanism and a blowing temperature control mechanism, the contact temperature control mechanism comprises a temperature control table and a heating plate, the heating plate is used for carrying out contact heating on the square-shell battery pack, the blowing temperature control mechanism comprises a hot air circulation mechanism and a wind knife assembly, the wind knife assembly is connected with the hot air circulation mechanism through a pipeline and used for carrying out blowing heating on the square-shell battery pack, and the pressurizing mechanism is used for vertically and downwards pressurizing the electric core pole. The invention can effectively solve the technical problems of poor glue curing uniformity, low curing efficiency and unstable product quality in the existing glue coating and curing process of the battery pack.

title_en: Thermal power generating unit frequency modulation control method based on super capacitor and deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a thermal power generating unit frequency modulation control method based on super capacitor and deep reinforcement learning, which relates to the technical field of deep reinforcement learning and comprises the steps of constructing a frequency characteristic prediction model to generate a prediction sequence by acquiring frequency deviation signals and charge state information of a thermal power generating unit; the method comprises the steps of carrying out intelligent agent group emergence learning and cooperative relation self-adaptive clipping in a multidimensional feature embedding space, carrying out wavelet multi-scale decomposition on frequency deviation signals and analyzing dynamic response characteristics, quantifying dynamic cooperative weights through multi-level association mapping of emerging cooperative feature vectors and charge state information, and finally generating a frequency modulation instruction. The invention improves the frequency modulation precision and response speed of the thermal power generating unit.

title_en: Control strategy adjustment method, device and equipment based on photovoltaic energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control strategy adjustment method, a device and equipment based on a photovoltaic energy storage system, wherein the method comprises the steps of responding to an energy data processing instruction to obtain energy related data, and carrying out data preprocessing on the energy related data based on a preprocessing strategy to obtain processed energy related data; determining a current system operation judgment result based on the current system operation state parameter set, and acquiring and executing a current target control strategy based on a preset dynamic self-adaptive control strategy when the current system operation abnormality is judged. The embodiment of the invention can acquire and process the operation parameters in the photovoltaic energy storage system, and then carry out timely and intelligent judgment on whether the current target control strategy needs to be acquired by combining with the dynamic self-adaptive control strategy, and timely and self-adaptively adjust the current target control strategy to ensure the stable operation of the system when an abnormality occurs in the operation process.

title_en: Traction auxiliary integrated converter and control method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of rail transit, in particular to a traction auxiliary integrated converter and a control method. The traction auxiliary integrated converter comprises a traction inverter, an auxiliary inverter unit, a bidirectional charger, a storage battery and a control unit. When the traction auxiliary integrated converter works in an emergency traction mode, the bidirectional charger converts direct current voltage output by the storage battery into first alternating current voltage and outputs the first alternating current voltage to the second branch of the auxiliary inversion unit, the first branch of the auxiliary inversion unit generates second alternating current voltage according to the first alternating current voltage input into the second branch and outputs the second alternating current voltage to the alternating current bus to supply power to the medium-voltage load, and the first end of the auxiliary inversion unit generates third alternating current voltage and outputs the third alternating current voltage to the first middle direct current bus. According to the application, through the cooperation of the auxiliary inversion unit and the bidirectional charger, the high-voltage direct current and the medium-voltage alternating current required by traction are simultaneously provided by the storage battery in an emergency traction mode, long-distance emergency traction is realized, and the integration level and the emergency traction capability of the traction auxiliary integrated converter are remarkably improved.

title_en: Buffer material for solid-state battery or battery module, preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a buffer material for a solid-state battery or a battery module, a preparation method and application thereof. The raw materials of the buffer material comprise silicon rubber, reinforcing materials, aramid fibers and vulcanizing agents. According to the invention, through the synergistic interaction of the silicon rubber, the reinforcing material and the aramid fiber in the raw materials, the compression stress of the buffer material is greatly improved, so that the problem of volume expansion of the battery core of the solid-state battery or the solid-state battery module can be effectively solved, and the safety and electrochemical performance of the battery are improved.

title_en: Wire harness device for litz wire winding and litz wire winding method
abstract_en: The invention provides a wire binding device for litz wire winding and a litz wire winding method, which relate to the technical field of cables and comprise a mounting cylinder fixed on a frame, two functional cylinders rotationally connected to two ends of the mounting cylinder and a wire binding rope connected end to end, wherein the inner walls of the two functional cylinders are rotationally connected with a first wire guide wheel, the wire binding rope is pulled by the two first wire guide wheels, driven gears are respectively arranged outside the two functional cylinders, driving gears are respectively fixedly arranged on the two driving shafts, the two driving gears are respectively meshed with the driven gears, the two functional cylinders can independently rotate, the wire binding rope is tightly wound outside a stranded wire passing through the two functional cylinders, the wire binding rope further comprises a film winding frame and two second wire guide wheels, the film winding frame is positioned on one wire winding side of the film winding frame through rotation, and the two second wire guide wheels guide and compress stranded wires on one wire winding side of the film winding frame. The invention has the advantages of even winding and the like.

title_en: Charged short-circuiting device of harmonic eliminator and use method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a charged short-circuiting device of a harmonic eliminator and a use method thereof, comprising a telescopic insulating operating rod and a short-circuiting device, wherein the top end of the telescopic insulating operating rod is detachably provided with a grounding wire clamp assembly, the grounding wire clamp assembly is connected at a neutral point of a circuit in a lockable way, the grounding wire clamp assembly is connected with the input end of a jumper wire protecting device through a connecting wire, the input end of the short-circuiting device is connected with the jumper wire protecting device, the output end of the short-circuiting device is connected with a grounding wire, and the short-circuiting device is connected with a remote control device in a wireless communication way.

title_en: Connector with a plurality of connectors
abstract_en: The object of the invention is to obtain a desired contact load. A connector includes a connector conductor including a cylindrical portion and an elastic piece extending from an opening edge of the cylindrical portion. The cylindrical portion has a cylindrical forming portion forming a cylindrical shape, a1 st end portion in a circumferential direction of the cylindrical forming portion, and a2 nd end portion in a circumferential direction of the cylindrical forming portion. The elastic piece includes an end elastic piece, at least a part of which protrudes from an opening edge in the 1 st end toward one side in the central axis direction of the cylinder. The 1 st end portion has a1 st inner peripheral side end portion and a1 st outer peripheral side end portion, the 2 nd end portion has a2 nd inner peripheral side end portion and a2 nd outer peripheral side end portion, and the 1 st end portion and the 2 nd end portion are fixed in a state in which the 1 st inner peripheral side end portion overlaps with the inner peripheral side of the 2 nd outer peripheral side end portion, and the 1 st outer peripheral side end portion overlaps with the outer peripheral side of the 2 nd inner peripheral side end portion.

title_en: Lithium iron phosphate coated lithium-rich manganese-based material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of lithium ion batteries, in particular to a lithium iron phosphate coated lithium-rich manganese-based material and a preparation method thereof, comprising the following steps of firstly, forming a first mixed solution by ferrous sulfate, oxalic acid and an organic solvent, forming a second mixed solution by adding an ammonium dihydrogen phosphate solution, forming a third mixed solution by dripping lithium hydroxide, and then, heating the third mixed solution to react to obtain a coating precursor; grinding and calcining the coating precursor to obtain the lithium iron phosphate coated lithium-rich manganese-based material, wherein the organic solvent is a mixture of ethylene glycol and glycerol. The lithium iron phosphate coated lithium-rich manganese-based material battery prepared by coating the lithium iron phosphate on the surface of the lithium-rich manganese-based material has beneficial cycle performance and multiplying power performance.

title_en: Battery and electricity utilization device
abstract_en: The application relates to a battery and an electric device, and belongs to the technical field of batteries. According to the application, the direction of leading the positive electrode plate out of the positive electrode lug is taken as the first direction, the specific relation is satisfied by controlling the ratio of the size of the insulating layer in the first direction to the size of the positive electrode plate in the first direction and the concave-convex degree of the surface of the positive electrode active material layer, which is far away from the positive electrode current collector, so that the connectivity between the positive electrode plate and the diaphragm is ensured to be proper, lithium ions are easy to transmit between the positive electrode plate and the diaphragm, the lower interface impedance is realized, the first charge and discharge efficiency of the battery is improved, the bonding is too tight after the circulation can be avoided, the electrolyte infiltration effect is optimized, the lithium ion transmission efficiency is improved, and the dynamic performance of the battery is enhanced, so that the first coulomb efficiency and the dynamic performance are excellent and balanced.

title_en: Intelligent ground wire monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent ground wire monitoring method, and belongs to the technical field of monitoring of the Internet of things. Aiming at the problems that the traditional ground wire hanging relies on manual visual inspection to cause high misjudgment rate, high-voltage induced electricity damages an electronic module, communication interruption and field cruising deficiency, the invention adopts a multi-source data fusion technology, namely judging the hanging state by fusing Beidou positioning data and pressure sensing data through dynamic weight distribution, triggering an acousto-optic alarm when positioning or pressure is abnormal, adopting a hierarchical protection circuit to inhibit induced electricity interference, sequentially passing through gas discharge tube voltage limiting, TVS diode clamping, a metal shell and a ceramic substrate shielding, controlling solar power supply by a conductivity tracking method, preferentially using solar energy, and dynamically adjusting a power supply switching threshold according to the battery state. The method improves the monitoring accuracy, enhances the anti-interference capability, prolongs the field endurance time and realizes the full-flow automatic protection of the state of the grounding wire.

title_en: Offshore wind speed synthesis method and wind power prediction method
abstract_en: The application relates to a method for synthesizing offshore wind speed and a method for predicting wind power. The application is suitable for the technical field of offshore wind power. The application aims to solve the technical problem of providing an offshore wind speed synthesis method and a wind power prediction method. The offshore wind speed synthesis method comprises the steps of generating wind speed data in a second time scale based on average wind speed in a first time scale and combining a Weibull distribution model and wind speed time characteristics, and generating wind speed data in a third time scale based on wind speed data in the second time scale and combining a Vor-karman power spectral density function and an autoregressive moving average model.

title_en: Robot for bypass cable lifting lap joint distribution network and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots for distribution networks and provides a robot for bypass cable lifting lap joint distribution networks and an operation method thereof; the telescopic rod driving protrusion is clamped in the groove, so that the axial limit of the male head in the female head is realized, and the problem that the male head is separated from the female head after the rope is broken or a rope knot is broken due to instantaneous small-distance falling of the rope during mechanical locking is avoided.

title_en: Modularized intelligent circuit breaker
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electricity, in particular relates to a modularized intelligent circuit breaker, and aims to solve the problem that the current circuit breaker is highly dependent on a single main processor and a communication bus due to the fact that a centralized processing architecture is commonly adopted. The modularized intelligent circuit breaker comprises a base and a core functional module, wherein the core functional module comprises a main control communication module, a measuring and protecting module, an interaction and display module, a load control and expansion module and a mechanical operating mechanism module, wherein the main control communication module is integrated with a main processor and a communication unit, the measuring and protecting module is integrated with a current sampling unit, a voltage sampling unit and a sub-processor with a built-in protecting algorithm, the interaction and display module is integrated with a touch display screen, the load control and expansion module is integrated with a plurality of programmable relay output interfaces and a signal input interface for connecting an external sensor, and the mechanical operating mechanism module comprises a contact system, an operating mechanism and an integrated state monitoring unit. The invention realizes the modularized design of the intelligent circuit breaker and effectively improves the flexibility and maintainability of the system.

title_en: Composite magnetic material, preparation method thereof and magnetic device
abstract_en: The invention provides a composite magnetic material, a preparation method thereof and a magnetic device, wherein the composite magnetic material comprises alloy powder and epoxy resin material, the epoxy resin material and the alloy powder are uniformly distributed, the composite magnetic material is composite powder, the alloy powder comprises first nanocrystalline with a first particle size, second alloy with a second particle size and third alloy with a third particle size, the first particle size is larger than the second particle size, the second particle size is larger than the third particle size, and the alloy powder further comprises an inorganic coating layer arranged on the surfaces of the first nanocrystalline, the second alloy and the third alloy. The composite magnetic material prepared by the invention has good fluidity, can realize higher relative magnetic conductivity and lower magnetic loss in a high frequency band, and provides powerful support for miniaturization, light weight and high performance development of magnetic devices.

title_en: Intermittent gear drive-based GIS connecting mechanism tail end mechanical indicating device and method
abstract_en: The application provides a GIS (gas insulated switchgear) connecting mechanism tail end mechanical indicating device and method based on intermittent gear driving, and belongs to the technical field of high-voltage switch equipment. The application provides a GIS connecting mechanism tail end mechanical indicating device based on intermittent gear driving, which comprises a gear transmission shaft, an intermittent gear assembly driven by the gear transmission shaft to operate, an indicating assembly connected with the output end of the intermittent gear assembly, and an observation window for displaying the opening and closing state. The gear transmission shaft is connected with the tail end of the GIS linkage transmission mechanism main shaft, a driving gear on the gear transmission shaft is meshed with a spur gear at the input end of the intermittent gear assembly to form speed reduction transmission, and the intermittent gear assembly adopts a double intermittent gear combination structure to convert the continuous rotation after speed reduction into intermittent output so as to drive the indication assembly to rotate according to a preset angle. The indication disc is matched with the observation window through the indication shaft to display the opening and closing states. The application can reduce misjudgment and improve display reliability and transmission stability.

title_en: Method for studying, judging and verifying power failure and power restoration of low-voltage transformer area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power failure emergency repair, in particular to a method for judging and verifying power failure recovery of a low-voltage transformer area. The judging method is applied to rush repair of power failure recovery of an HPLC low-voltage transformer area and comprises the following steps of judging power failure of the low-voltage transformer area and judging power recovery of the low-voltage transformer area. The verification method of the invention comprises the following steps of verifying power failure of the low-voltage transformer area and the duplicate power of the low-voltage transformer area through cross verification of the transformer area and the ammeter. The invention sets rated voltage and judging threshold values of different electric energy meters, accurately judges the power failure state through calling the voltage, confirms the power failure recovery from local and whole multi-dimensional degrees by utilizing cross verification of a platform area and the electric meters, reduces misjudgment, provides accurate information for emergency repair personnel in time after accurately judging the power failure condition, reduces on-site investigation time, sets a delay reporting mechanism, avoids information interference, ensures accurate judgment, reasonably allocates the emergency repair resources, changes the original passive mode into the active mode, and actively researches and judges the power failure recovery condition.

title_en: Power grid synchronization method based on coupling harmonic observer pre-filtering and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid synchronization and provides a power grid synchronization method and electronic equipment based on pre-filtering of a coupling harmonic observer, wherein a target voltage signal is input into the coupling harmonic observer to obtain a fundamental voltage component, state variables of the coupling harmonic observer comprise the fundamental voltage component, a direct current component and an orthogonal component of the fundamental voltage component in the target voltage signal, a gain coefficient is determined in a pole configuration mode, and the natural frequency of a pole configuration characteristic equation is set as the angular frequency of the fundamental voltage component; and sequentially carrying out normalization and phase-locked loop operation processing on the fundamental voltage component to obtain an estimated value of the phase and an estimated value of the angular frequency, wherein the estimated value of the angular frequency is used for calculating the power grid frequency and updating the coupled harmonic observer, and the power grid synchronization is carried out based on the estimated value of the phase and the power grid frequency. The method solves the problem that the stability of the grid-connected converter under the weak grid condition can not be improved while the phase locking logic is simple.

title_en: Spherical silver powder with nano shell structure and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses spherical silver powder with a nano shell structure, and a preparation method and application thereof. The method comprises the steps of adding 30% -35% of oxidant solution and 30% -35% of reducing agent solution by total mass of oxidant solution into a dispersing agent solution simultaneously to obtain a first reaction solution, adding the rest of the reducing agent solution and 20% -65% of the oxidant solution by total mass of the oxidant solution into the first reaction solution simultaneously to obtain a second reaction solution, adding the rest of the oxidant solution accounting for 5% -45% of the total mass of the oxidant solution into the second reaction solution to obtain a third reaction solution, adding a coating agent solution into the third reaction solution, and then stirring, solid-liquid separation, cleaning and drying to obtain spherical silver powder with a nano shell structure. The method greatly reduces the problem of difficult printing and agglomeration of the nano silver particles caused by the high specific surface area of the nano silver particles, is simple to operate, has low cost and is suitable for industrial production.

title_en: Flame-retardant electrolyte additive for power battery and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a flame-retardant electrolyte additive for a power battery and a preparation process thereof, which relate to the technical field of material processing, wherein the additive comprises trimethyl phosphate, fluorinated phosphate, ethylene carbonate, a borate compound, a surfactant, a silane coupling agent and nano oxide particles, wherein the addition proportion of the trimethyl phosphate is 8-20%, the addition proportion of the fluorinated phosphate is 12-28%, the addition proportion of the ethylene carbonate is 18-32%, the nano oxide particles account for 1 to 4 percent of the total mass of the additive, the particle size is 20 to 40 nanometers, the invention precisely adjusts and controls the specific proportioning relationship of trimethyl phosphate and fluorinated phosphate, and ethylene carbonate and boric acid ester compound, the high-purity flame-retardant component raw materials are matched, so that the synergistic flame-retardant effect of each flame-retardant component is ensured, the flame-retardant effect of the electrolyte is obviously improved, and the viscosity of the additive can be strictly controlled within a reasonable range.

title_en: Driving power supply for power module of motor controller
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of motor controllers, and provides a driving power supply for a motor controller power module, which comprises a driving power supply of a lower three-bridge driving circuit, a high-voltage Buck circuit and a push-pull circuit with negative pressure output, wherein the driving power supply comprises a high-voltage Buck circuit and a push-pull circuit with negative pressure output; the output voltage of the high-voltage Buck circuit is supplied to the lower three-bridge driving circuit through the push-pull circuit with negative voltage output. In the embodiment of the disclosure, the driving power supply of the lower three-bridge driving circuit of the motor controller adopts the combination of the high-voltage Buck circuit and the push-pull circuit with negative pressure output, so that the use of a high-voltage-resistant MOS tube and a flyback transformer is avoided, the cost is reduced, the size of a PCB is reduced, and the power density is improved.

title_en: Closed loop accurate dimming system and method based on PI-GA algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a closed-loop accurate dimming system based on a PI-GA algorithm, which comprises a monitoring and feedback module, a lamp module and a data processing module, wherein a microprocessor is arranged in the data processing module and integrates four functional sub-modules, the monitoring and feedback module is used for collecting illumination index data of a plurality of working partitions in a space, the lamp module is used for receiving and executing a dimming instruction, a target setting module is used for presetting and storing target illumination related data, a contribution matrix module is used for constructing and storing illumination contribution weight data of each lamp to each working partition, a dimming calculation module is used for calculating a dimming correction amount based on the illumination index data, the target illumination related data and the illumination contribution weight data, and a closed-loop iteration module is used for realizing dimming instruction issuing and error closed-loop adjustment and realizing accurate closed-loop dimming through cooperation of each module. The invention realizes the precise control of the illumination of multiple areas, quick response and dynamic self-adaptive dimming.

title_en: Multi-column pin integrated cycloidal pin gear reducer joint module
abstract_en: The application provides a multi-column pin integrated cycloidal pin gear reducer joint module, wherein a torque output end of a motion input mechanism is connected with an eccentric input shaft, the eccentric input shaft is connected with a cycloidal gear assembly through a first bearing assembly, a plurality of pin teeth are arranged on the inner side of a first shell, the outer edge tooth profile of the cycloidal gear assembly is meshed with the pin teeth, the cycloidal gear assembly is arranged between a pin limiting piece and an output flange plate, an output pin penetrates through the cycloidal gear assembly, two ends of the output pin are respectively embedded into the pin limiting piece and the output flange plate, a fastening pin sequentially penetrates through the pin limiting piece and the cycloidal gear assembly and is fixedly connected with the output flange plate, and the eccentric input shaft drives the output pin and the fastening pin through the first bearing assembly and the cycloidal gear assembly so that the output flange plate rotates. The application ensures that the output pin and the fastening pin are stably arranged on the speed reducer mechanism, prevents axial movement, realizes miniaturization and light weight of the joint module, and reduces assembly difficulty.

title_en: Dynamic trend electricity consumption prediction method based on multipath fusion and related equipment thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic trend electricity consumption prediction method based on multipath fusion and related equipment thereof, comprising the steps of obtaining historical service data of a target object, wherein the historical service data comprises historical electricity consumption data and corresponding environmental factor data; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing historical electricity consumption data and corresponding environmental factor data to determine target data to be predicted, carrying out dynamic reference feature calculation on the target data to be predicted to obtain a corresponding dynamic reference sequence, and carrying out fusion prediction processing on the target data to be predicted based on a preset double-path fusion prediction algorithm and the dynamic reference sequence to obtain a power consumption prediction trend result of a target object. The self-adaptive selection of the optimal reference sequence is realized through dynamic reference feature calculation, and the long-term change trend of the electricity consumption behavior and the disturbance effect of the external environment can be considered by combining the dual-path fusion structure of the internal trend prediction and the external factor correction, so that the accuracy and the stability of the prediction are improved.

title_en: Method and system for measuring and calculating carbon emission reduction of extra-high voltage alternating current engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon emission reduction measuring and calculating method and a system of an extra-high voltage alternating current project, wherein the method comprises the steps of dividing operation scenes of the extra-high voltage alternating current project according to the effect of the extra-high voltage alternating current project in an electric power system, and acquiring basic data under each operation scene to construct a time sequence production simulation model so as to determine actual operation parameters of the extra-high voltage alternating current project under each operation scene; and carrying out apportionment calculation on the regional carbon emission reduction amount by adopting a carbon reduction benefit apportionment method to obtain the carbon emission reduction amount of the extra-high voltage alternating current engineering. By dividing the operation scene of the extra-high voltage alternating current engineering and combining the actual operation data of the engineering and the time sequence production simulation model to calculate the carbon emission reduction amount, the carbon emission reduction amount of the extra-high voltage alternating current engineering can be quantized, and the problem that the carbon emission reduction amount cannot be accurately calculated in the operation stage of the extra-high voltage alternating current engineering is solved.

title_en: Cable penetration piece and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nuclear power equipment, and particularly discloses a cable penetrating piece and a manufacturing method of the cable penetrating piece, wherein the cable penetrating piece comprises a conductive rod, an insulating sleeve and a sealing ring, the conductive rod is axially and sequentially divided into a head part, a middle part and a tail part along the self-body, and the peripheral wall of the head part is convexly provided with an annular bulge; the insulating sleeve is sleeved on the conducting rod and positioned in the middle, the sealing ring is arranged between the annular bulge and the insulating sleeve and is used for sealing a gap between the insulating sleeve and the annular bulge. The cable penetrating piece is inserted into the through hole of the motor, the head is inserted into the motor, the sealing ring is used for sealing a gap between the insulating sleeve and the annular bulge, and then liquid in the motor can be prevented from entering into a gap between the insulating sleeve and the middle part from the gap between the annular bulge and the insulating sleeve, and the problem that the wet winding motor is leaked due to poor sealing between the insulating sleeve and the conducting rod of the cable penetrating piece is avoided.

title_en: Batch generation method for power monitoring primitives
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system monitoring, in particular to a power monitoring graphic primitive batch generation method which comprises the following steps of selecting graphic primitive sets by a user, verifying correctness of data associated with each source graphic primitive in the graphic primitive sets and generating a data verification list, correcting erroneous data according to the data verification list by the user to obtain graphic primitive sets to be duplicated, constructing a source service tree based on the graphic primitive sets to be duplicated, reading all data in a database, establishing a target service tree, comparing the source service tree with the target service tree, calculating mapping parameters, addressing target positions in the target service tree according to the mapping parameters, and generating copies of the source graphic primitives at the target positions. The method solves the technical problems that the prior art cannot process the requirement of batch multiplexing of the prior primitive files, the workload is large and the like.

title_en: Backlight module and display device
abstract_en: The invention provides a backlight module and a display device, wherein the backlight module comprises a backlight lamp, a backlight driving circuit, a key and a key conversion circuit, the key conversion circuit and the backlight driving circuit are connected, the backlight lamp comprises a second lamp string and a first lamp string surrounding the second lamp string, the backlight driving circuit is connected with the first lamp string, the second lamp string inputs a first driving voltage and displays first brightness, when the key performs multiple key actions, the key conversion circuit alternately outputs a first level signal and a second level signal, the backlight driving circuit is controlled to alternately output the first driving voltage and the second driving voltage, so that the first lamp string respectively displays the first brightness and the second brightness, the second brightness is smaller than the first brightness, the backlight module provides global backlight or local backlight, the regional light control of a display panel is realized, and the key conversion circuit and the backlight driving circuit are adopted to realize hardware control, so that the light control switching efficiency is improved.

title_en: Battery cell
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of batteries, in particular to a battery, which comprises a positive plate, a negative plate and a diaphragm, wherein the diaphragm is positioned between the positive plate and the negative plate, the positive plate comprises a first surface and a second surface which are opposite to each other in the thickness direction of the positive plate, the first surface comprises a plurality of concave parts, the depth D  2  of each concave part is 3-50 mu m, the diaphragm comprises a substrate layer and an organic coating positioned on at least one side surface of the substrate layer, and the organic coating comprises organic particles. Through the synergistic effect of the organic coating of the diaphragm and the concave structure of the positive plate, the high-temperature safety performance of the battery can be obviously improved on the premise of not sacrificing the voltage stability and the impedance performance in the high-temperature circulation process, and the furnace temperature tolerance of the battery is improved, so that the increasingly severe high-temperature application requirements are met.

title_en: Stator, motor, compressor and stator assembly method
abstract_en: The invention provides a stator, a motor, a compressor and an assembly method of the stator, wherein the stator comprises a stator core, a framework and a stator winding, the stator core is formed by splicing a plurality of first iron core blocks and a plurality of second iron core blocks together along the circumferential direction of the stator core in an alternating arrangement mode of the first iron core blocks and the second iron core blocks, the first iron core blocks comprise first tooth parts and containing grooves arranged on the outer sides of the first tooth parts, the second iron core blocks comprise second tooth parts, the framework is sleeved on the first tooth parts and is positioned in the containing grooves, the stator winding is wound on the framework, the width of the first tooth parts is larger than that of the second tooth parts, necessary space is provided for containing the framework and the stator winding, the stator winding can be wound on the framework first tooth parts and the second tooth parts without winding the stator winding, the framework is sleeved on the first tooth parts, complex wire embedding procedures of the traditional integral stator core are abandoned, and only simple equipment is needed for winding the stator winding.

title_en: Wireless charging receiving synchronous rectifying device based on current transformer and implementation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless charging receiving synchronous rectifying device based on a current transformer and an implementation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of wireless charging. The device comprises a current transformer sampling unit, a current signal amplitude-phase adjusting circuit unit, a gate control signal generating circuit unit and a driving circuit unit. The implementation method is to collect resonance current through a current transformer, perform phase compensation and amplitude attenuation on a sampling signal by utilizing a differential amplifying circuit configured with a capacitive or inductive element, and introduce direct-current bias voltage. Two complementary PWM signals with hardware dead zones are generated to drive the synchronous rectifying tube by utilizing the dual threshold voltage comparison logic. The phase error of the transformer is effectively corrected in a pure hardware mode, accurate zero-crossing detection is realized, dead time is flexible and adjustable, and the phase error detection circuit has the advantages of simple circuit structure, low cost, high rectification efficiency and high system reliability.

title_en: Radio frequency switching device of antenna unit and TR module
abstract_en: The invention provides a radio frequency switching device of an antenna unit and a TR module, which comprises an adapter body, a first port used for being in butt joint with the antenna unit and a second port used for being in butt joint with the TR module, wherein the first port and the second port are both arranged on the adapter body, and the first port is connected with the second port.

title_en: Nitrogen protection system and method for power battery, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a nitrogen protection system, a nitrogen protection method, electronic equipment and a storage medium of a power battery, and relates to the technical field of battery safety, wherein the system comprises a main controller, a three-position five-way electromagnetic valve, a high-pressure gas settling tank, a nitrogen production module, a three-position multi-way electromagnetic valve and a battery pack with a full-closed structure; the full-closed structure battery pack is matched with the closed pressure maintaining position design of the three-position multi-way electromagnetic valve, so that the nitrogen supplementing interval is obviously prolonged, the high-pressure gas is fully settled by the high-pressure gas settling tank controlled by the three-position five-way electromagnetic valve, the cleanliness is obviously improved, the nitrogen making module is effectively protected, the service life of the nitrogen making module is prolonged, the full-closed structure battery pack can be directly compatible with an oil air compressor commonly used by a vehicle, the system cost is reduced, the automatic control of nitrogen supplementing, pressure discharging and nitrogen making supplementing is realized by the main controller, the response is timely and accurate, the full-life-cycle nitrogen protection is provided for a battery system, and the thermal runaway of the battery is effectively inhibited.

title_en: Charge-transporting ink composition and ink composition for upper film of quantum dot layer
abstract_en: Provided is a charge transporting ink composition which has a practical charge transporting property and can inhibit PL extinction of an element obtained, and which comprises one or more metal oxide nanoparticles selected from the group consisting of Ti, fe, zr, sn, ta, nb, Y, mo, W, pb, in, bi and oxides of metals in Sr and a complex of at least two of these, a compound having a thiol group or a thiourea group, and a solvent.

title_en: Automatic equipment applied to twist needle welding and operation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic device and an operation method applied to welding of a twist needle; the device comprises a frame, a wire pulling mechanism, a wire cutting mechanism and a displacement welding device. The wire pulling mechanism pulls and straightens the wire, the wire cutting mechanism cuts the wire by laser, and the displacement welding device comprises a linear displacement mechanism, a first rotary table displacement mechanism, a second rotary table displacement mechanism, a welding wire positioning mechanism and two laser welders. The linear displacement mechanism is responsible for transferring wires among stations, the double-turntable displacement mechanism synchronously transfers the wires, the wire welding positioning mechanism centers and positions the wires, and the laser welder respectively welds two ends of the wires. The invention realizes the full-process automation from paying off, straightening, fixed-length cutting to double-end welding of the twist needle, saves a great deal of manual labor, and has the advantages of high production efficiency, good welding precision and high degree of automation.

title_en: Silicon rubber heat insulation material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a silicon rubber heat insulation material and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of lithium ion batteries. The material is obtained by blending and curing a silicon rubber substrate, hollow silica microspheres and phenolic microspheres, wherein the mass ratio of the silicon rubber substrate to the hollow silica microspheres to the phenolic microspheres is 4:0.8-1.2:0.8-1.2, the particle size of the hollow silica nanospheres is 50-500 nm, the wall thickness is 30-80 nm, and the particle size of the phenolic microspheres is 5-20 mu m. The hollow silica nanospheres and the phenolic microspheres are combined and filled into the silicon rubber substrate to form a multiphase composite structure, and the heat conductivity is obviously reduced through a gas-solid phase interface effect.

title_en: Operational amplifier compensation network circuit and method in switching power supply
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of switching power supply control, and discloses an operational amplifier compensation network circuit and a method thereof, wherein a clamping diode is additionally arranged on the operational amplifier compensation network, the anode of the clamping diode is directly connected with the output end of an error amplifier, the cathode of the clamping diode is connected with an inverting input end, and the clamping diode is positively conducted when the voltage of the output end is higher than the voltage of the inverting input end in the power supply starting stage; the unidirectional conduction characteristic of the diode is used for establishing a low-impedance path, and the COMP terminal voltage is forced to be pulled down to the voltage level of the reverse phase input terminal. The circuit design eliminates the overshoot risk of the output voltage of the starting machine, does not need to increase a reference time sequence control or an independent power supply circuit, remarkably simplifies the system structure, avoids the fine calculation requirement of the parameters of the precharge circuit and the negative influence on the dynamic response, and realizes the unification of reliability, conciseness and performance optimization.

title_en: Dynamic voltage-regulating LED driving system with overvoltage protection function
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic voltage-regulating LED driving system with an overvoltage protection function, which comprises: the system comprises a voltage-adjustable DC-DC conversion module, a dynamic feedback network, a multi-path selection switch array, a constant current source module, a dummy load module and a control module, wherein the control module is used for coordinating and controlling the working time sequence of each module so as to realize the overvoltage protection of the LED during strobe-free, high-efficiency, constant current driving and channel switching; the invention aims to solve the technical problems that the existing multipath LED driving system has poor voltage regulation matching performance, low constant current precision, overvoltage risk exists in switching of the light string, and timing sequence coordination is lacking in control of each module, and is used for realizing strobe-free and high-efficiency constant current driving of the LED light string, meanwhile, realizing overvoltage protection of channel switching from the aspects of hardware and algorithm, and improving the stability and adaptability of the system.

title_en: Heating device, control method and battery production line
abstract_en: The application discloses a heating device, a control method and a battery production line, wherein the heating device comprises a roller body and a heating component, the roller body is configured to support and convey a current collector, the current collector at least partially wraps the outer peripheral surface of the roller body, the heating component comprises an arc-shaped substrate, a heating element and a reflecting cover, the arc-shaped substrate is matched with the roller body, an arc-shaped mounting surface is formed on one side of the arc-shaped substrate, which faces the roller body, the heating element is arranged on the arc-shaped mounting surface, and the reflecting cover is arranged between the heating element and the arc-shaped substrate. According to the scheme provided by the application, as the curvature of the arc-shaped mounting surface is matched with the curvature of the outer peripheral surface of the roller body, the uniform distance between the heating element and the current collector wrapped on the roller body is kept, so that the non-coating area is uniformly heated in the tape running direction, and the expansion consistency of the non-coating area is prevented from being influenced due to local overheating or insufficient heating.

title_en: Three-phase permanent magnet alternating current motor protector
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of three-phase permanent magnet alternating current motors, and discloses a three-phase permanent magnet alternating current motor protection device which comprises a protection box, a three-phase permanent magnet alternating current motor arranged in the protection box, a filtering part, a collecting part, a heat dissipation part and a driving component, wherein the filtering part is arranged on the right side of the protection box, the collecting part is arranged on the right side of the protection box, the heat dissipation part is arranged on the protection box, the filtering part comprises a filtering component, the filtering component is arranged on the right side of the protection box, the driving component is arranged in the filtering component, and the filtering component comprises a ventilation pipe communicated with the right side of the protection box. According to the invention, the filter part is arranged, so that the problems that impurities are easy to accumulate on the surface of the filter plate and gradually block the surface of the filter plate in the use process of the existing protective device, so that air inlet is blocked, heat dissipation efficiency is reduced, the operation stability of a motor is influenced, frequent shutdown, disassembly and cleaning are required, maintenance burden is increased, and the overall use efficiency of equipment is reduced are solved.

title_en: Burn-out-preventing wiring device in photovoltaic power generation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wiring devices, in particular to a burn-out prevention wiring device in a photovoltaic power generation system, which comprises a box body, wherein a cover plate is arranged on the top surface of the box body, an adjusting module is arranged in the box body and comprises a mounting plate, two sliding frames which are in contact with each other are connected to the top surface of the mounting plate in a sliding manner, and a plurality of sliding seats are connected to the top surfaces of the sliding frames in a sliding manner. According to the invention, the two sliding frames are connected with the top surface of the mounting plate in a sliding manner, the two wiring modules corresponding to each other can be conducted through the conducting rod, then the electric wires can be arranged on the wiring seats, the temperature inside the box body can be monitored through the temperature sensor, when the temperature at the joint is increased, the two sliding frames can be separated through the adjusting mechanism, so that the two wiring seats corresponding to each other on different sliding frames are separated, the circuit is disconnected, the continuous temperature increase is prevented, the fire condition occurs in the box body, and the safety coefficient is improved.

title_en: Lithium ion secondary battery, battery device, and electricity using device
abstract_en: The application provides a lithium ion secondary battery, a battery device and an electric device. The lithium ion secondary battery comprises a positive electrode plate, a negative electrode plate and an electrolyte, wherein the positive electrode plate comprises a positive electrode current collector and a positive electrode film layer arranged on at least one side of the positive electrode current collector, the positive electrode film layer comprises a positive electrode active material, the positive electrode active material comprises lithium-containing transition metal phosphate particles at least part of the surfaces of which are provided with carbon coating materials, the positive electrode film layer is subjected to graphitization degree C value accumulation distribution curves obtained under a laser micro-confocal Raman spectrometer surface scanning mode, the median C  50  of graphitization degree is more than or equal to 0.95 and less than or equal to 1.20, the concentration degree of C value (C  90 -C 10 )/C 50  is 0.01-0.04), wherein the graphitization degree C value is I  G /I D ,I G  and represents the G peak intensity of a Raman spectrum at 1580+/-100 cm  ‑1 , and I  D  represents the D peak intensity of the Raman spectrum at 1350+/-100 cm  ‑1 .

title_en: Dry-method coated g-C3N4Modified sulfide solid electrolyte and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy battery materials, in particular to a dry-coated g-C  3 N 4  modified sulfide solid electrolyte and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of carrying out surface charge regulation treatment on g-C  3 N 4  through a pH buffer solution to obtain negatively charged g-C  3 N 4 , carrying out surface protonation treatment on sulfide solid electrolyte through a weak acid atmosphere to obtain positively charged sulfide solid electrolyte, mixing the negatively charged g-C  3 N 4  with the positively charged sulfide solid electrolyte, enabling the negatively charged g-C  3 N 4  to be adsorbed on the surface of the positively charged sulfide solid electrolyte through electrostatic adsorption, and carrying out cold isostatic pressing and low-temperature thermal diffusion to obtain the dry coated g-C  3 N 4  modified sulfide solid electrolyte. The electrolyte prepared by the method disclosed by the invention is more uniform and compact in coating and more firm in interface combination, and the performance of the electrolyte is obviously improved.

title_en: Battery pack and vehicle comprising same
abstract_en: A battery pack includes a plurality of battery modules including a plurality of battery cells, a battery pack case having an accommodation space configured to accommodate the plurality of battery modules, a cover member disposed between the battery modules and the battery pack case and having a through hole through which exhaust gas discharged from the battery cells passes, and a spacer mounted to the cover member and configured to maintain a gap between the cover member and the battery pack case.

title_en: Ion guide coupled with slit type ion transmission tube and guiding method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ion guiding, and provides an ion guide coupled with a slit type ion transmission pipe and a guiding method, wherein the ion guide comprises a twelve-pole part and a four-pole part which are connected in series, an inlet of the twelve-pole part is connected with an outlet of the slit type ion transmission pipe, and an outlet of the twelve-pole part is connected with an inlet of the four-pole part; the field radius of the twelve pole segment tapers from the inlet to the outlet, and the field radius of the quadrupole segment is constant or slightly decreasing from the inlet to the outlet. Compared with the prior art, the ion guide effectively improves the ion transmission efficiency in a wide mass range (100-2000 m/z), shows great potential in comprehensive mass spectrometry application, and has the Instrument Detection Limit (IDL) of reserpine reaching 0.15 fg (RSD 6.08%), which is two times lower than that of the traditional quadrupole-linear ion trap mass spectrometry configuration (0.3 fg and RSD 11.1%).

title_en: Light-emitting element, display device, and method for manufacturing light-emitting element
abstract_en: The light-emitting element (2) has a light-emitting layer (23) located between an anode (21) and a cathode (25). The light emitting layer includes a plurality of quantum dots (30) and an inorganic matrix (31) filled between the plurality of quantum dots and having a metal oxide. The inorganic matrix comprises a first portion (41) having a metal oxide and a second portion (42). The ratio of oxygen atoms to metal atoms in the second portion is lower than the ratio of oxygen atoms to metal atoms in the first portion and is stoichiometric, i.e., the ratio of oxygen atoms to metal atoms in the metal oxide is greater than or equal to.

title_en: Fuel cell hydrogen circulation system and adjusting method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a fuel cell hydrogen circulation system, an adjusting method and an adjusting device, and belongs to the technical field of fuel cells. The system comprises a hydrogen storage bottle, a pressure reducing valve, a purge valve, a steam-water separation device, an air pump and a battery pile connected between the pressure reducing valve and the purge valve, wherein the hydrogen storage bottle, the pressure reducing valve, the purge valve, the steam-water separation device and the air pump form an anode loop. Embodiments of the present application aim to reduce the cost, noise and parasitic power of a fuel cell hydrogen circulation system.

title_en: Battery management system
abstract_en: The application discloses a battery management system. The battery management system comprises a first chip, a second chip, a power switch and a control end, wherein the first chip is connected with the battery unit and comprises a discharging control pin, the second chip comprises a discharging input pin and a control electrode output pin, the first end of the power switch is connected with the negative end of the battery unit, the second end of the power switch is used as a first pair of external interfaces of the battery unit so as to be connected with a load or a charger, and the control end of the power switch is connected with the control electrode output pin and is used for being conducted or turned off under the control of signals of the control electrode output pin.

title_en: Power connector and power connector assembly
abstract_en: The invention provides a power connector and a power connector assembly, wherein the power connector comprises an insulating shell, two sides of the insulating shell are respectively provided with a matched combined sliding groove and a matched combined sliding column, the combined sliding column of one power connector is suitable for being inserted into the combined sliding groove of the other power connector, a pair of power terminals are oppositely arranged in the insulating shell, each power terminal comprises a connecting sheet and a plurality of power elastic arms arranged on the connecting sheet, the connecting sheet is positioned in the connecting cavity to be electrically connected with a cable extending into the connecting cavity, and the power elastic arms are exposed in the inserting cavity to form a plurality of power contacts. The connector provided by the invention can meet the use requirements of the current electrical equipment, such as expandability, easiness in maintenance, high universality and modularization.

title_en: Wind power generation electricity quantity prediction method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power generation electricity quantity prediction method and a wind power generation electricity quantity prediction system based on big data, and relates to the technical field of wind power generation prediction, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical multi-source data and extracting multi-scale characteristic components; according to the multiscale characteristic components, a causal relation path among meteorological data, unit operation parameters and power generation is analyzed by a causal relation finding algorithm to form a causal relation network, a power generation prediction model is constructed and trained, future meteorological sequences are predicted, causal relation path propagation deduction is carried out, a deduction sequence of unit operation parameters is generated, predicted power generation is obtained according to the future meteorological sequences and the deduction sequence of the unit operation parameters, physical boundary constraint verification is carried out on the predicted power generation, an abnormal predicted value is corrected, final predicted power generation is obtained, and predicted power generation electric quantity of a future period is obtained through time integral calculation based on the final predicted power generation. The invention considers the fine influence of weather on the unit and improves the accuracy of generating capacity prediction.

title_en: Network-structured VSC transient stability analysis method and system considering dynamic influence of inner ring
