abstract_en: The invention discloses a network-structured VSC transient stability analysis method and system considering dynamic influence of an inner ring, comprising a control system for determining GFM-VSC, determining active power and virtual power angle based on virtual synchronous power outer ring control, determining port node voltage phase and inner potential amplitude based on the active power and the virtual power angle, determining output current amplitude of GFM-VSC based on the inner potential amplitude and the virtual power angle, judging whether the GFM-VSC triggers a saturation link based on the inner potential amplitude and the output current amplitude, determining the type of the saturation link when the GFM-VSC determines to trigger the saturation link, and analyzing transient stability according to the type of the saturation link.

title_en: Urban rail transit stray current monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a system and a method for monitoring urban rail transit stray current. The system has the advantages of high precision, high adaptability and high stability through the design of a measuring system, an error control module and an anti-interference module. Volt-ampere method and kirchhoff current law based construction system and collocation 1 The resolution high-precision voltmeter accurately captures weak voltage drop of the steel rail, the parallel connection does not interfere the original loop, and then the high-precision voltmeter is compared with total current of a traction substation for cross verification, so that measurement precision and result reliability are ensured. Aiming at the influence of fluctuation of factors such as temperature and humidity on the rail resistance, a resistance-temperature and humidity model is established in a laboratory, and parameters are acquired in real time on site to correct the resistance value, so that errors are effectively counteracted, and the complex working condition is adapted. In the face of strong electromagnetic interference of tunnels, software and hardware are adopted to cooperate with anti-interference, the hardware is used for inhibiting interference by shielding cables, filter circuits and the like, and the software smoothes noise through algorithms such as sliding average filtering and the like, so that closed-loop protection is formed, and signal stability is guaranteed.

title_en: Solid-state transformer based on single-stage conversion module
abstract_en: The invention provides a solid-state transformer based on a single-stage conversion module, and belongs to the field of power conversion. The power module adopts a modularized framework of star-type series connection on the alternating current side and parallel connection on the direct current side, is of an isolated AC-DC single-stage conversion topology, and comprises an AC supporting capacitor, an AC reversing half-bridge, two groups of conversion bridges, double transformers T1 and T2, a resonant capacitor, a bus capacitor and other devices. The primary winding of the double transformer is connected in parallel with the alternating current side conversion bridge and the alternating current voltage end in a staggered manner, and the secondary winding is connected in series with the direct current side conversion bridge through the resonance capacitor. Alternating current side of the power module adopts interleaved SPWM modulation, direct current side adopts phase shift control, alternating current and direct current side control pulse synchronization, and each module selects interleaved or synchronous control. The scheme has the outstanding advantages of being simple and efficient in topology, capable of improving reliability and dynamic characteristics, high in direct-current bus voltage utilization rate, capable of reducing the number of modules connected in series, capable of realizing zero-voltage soft switching (ZVS) on a direct-current side, and easy to realize digitally.

title_en: High-strength high-conductivity high-temperature softening-resistant copper alloy and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-strength high-conductivity high-temperature softening-resistant copper alloy and a preparation method thereof, wherein the copper alloy comprises 0.1-0.5% of Sn, 0.1-0.3% of Cr, 0.1-0.3% of Zr and 0.05-0.35% of X, wherein the X is selected from at least one element of Zn and Mg, and the balance of Cu and unavoidable impurities. The specific combination can realize the perfect combination of high strength, high conductivity and high softening temperature resistance after the alloy is subjected to the thermomechanical treatment and the final low-temperature annealing treatment through the synergistic effect of multi-element microalloying. The high-strength high-conductivity high-temperature-resistant softened copper alloy has the hardness of 160-195 HV, the tensile strength of 625-761 MPa, the conductivity of 71.6-80.5% IACS and the softening-resistant temperature of 380-470 ℃. The excellent comprehensive performance enables the alloy to be widely applied to lead frames, connectors, relays, switches and other electronic appliance core components.

title_en: Graphene for improving electrode compaction density, preparation method and application thereof, electrode sheet and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of graphene for improving electrode compaction density, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of (1) granulating graphene oxide to obtain graphene oxide particles, drying the graphene oxide particles, (2) puffing the dried graphene oxide particles under an inert gas condition, wherein the puffing maximum temperature is 235-385 ℃, the temperature is kept for 5-40 min within the temperature range, the heating rate is 2-8 ℃ per min, and (3) heating the puffed product to 1000-1500 ℃ under the inert atmosphere condition, and the temperature is kept for 2-4 h to obtain graphene powder. The invention also discloses corresponding graphene, application of the graphene in the electrode slice and a manufacturing method of the corresponding electrode slice. The graphene disclosed by the invention can improve the electrode compaction density.

title_en: Positive pole piece capable of being charged quickly and lithium battery
abstract_en: The application provides a fast-chargeable positive electrode plate and a lithium battery, wherein the positive electrode plate comprises a current collector, and a first active material layer and a second active material layer which are respectively and sequentially arranged on the surfaces of two sides of the current collector, wherein the first active material layer is arranged between the second active material layer and the current collector, the Raman peak value of the first active material layer is I  1 , the Raman peak value of the second active material layer is I  2 ,I 1  which is smaller than I  2 , and the difference value is more than 10cm  ‑1 . The technical scheme provided by the application improves the cycle stability and the multiplying power performance of the positive pole piece under the quick charge condition, and has wide application prospect in the field of lithium batteries.

title_en: Battery pack system with cell surface pressure dispersion structure
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a battery pack system including a base plate, a cross member, and at least three upwardly extending longitudinal members separating a surface of the base plate into a lattice. The battery modules including the battery cells are mounted in the formed lattice-shaped spaces and coupled to the mounting parts at each of the crossing parts. Each longitudinal member includes a face press block located between two fixing units, the face press block pushing the battery modules on both sides toward the fixing units to achieve firm holding.

title_en: Terminal for connecting electrical conductors
abstract_en: The invention relates to a connection terminal (1) for connecting electrical conductors (2), comprising a housing (10), a contact element (11) arranged on the housing (10), a cutting element (123) for cutting into an insulating sheath (20) of the conductor (2), a pressure piece (12) movable relative to the housing (10) for acting on the conductor (2), and a spring element (126) for causing an elastic tensioning force on the pressure piece (12) in the direction of the contact position. The push element (12) has at least one holding element (121) which is designed to hold the push element (12) in a release position, wherein the push element (12) can be released from the release position and transferred into a contact position in conjunction with the insertion of the conductor (2) into the insertion opening (100) in order to bring the conductor (2) into electrical connection with the contact element (11) by the cutting element (123) cutting into the insulating sheath (20) of the conductor (2). A spring element (126) is supported on the contact element (11) in order to induce a tensioning force on the pressing element (12).

title_en: Thermochromic-phase-change energy storage coupled double-sided photovoltaic Langbo wall structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-sided photovoltaic Langmuir wall structure with thermochromism-phase change energy storage coupling, which relates to the technical field of building enclosure and comprises an outer building wall body and a structural connecting layer, wherein the outer building wall body is sequentially provided with a PCM energy storage layer, a high absorption coating and a thermochromism layer from inside to outside, the outer building wall body is provided with a double-sided photovoltaic module, an air flow channel is arranged between the double-sided photovoltaic module and the thermochromism layer, a ventilation module I is arranged between the double-sided photovoltaic module and the structural connecting layer, a ventilation module II is arranged on the outer building wall body, and by integrating a plurality of key components such as the double-sided photovoltaic module, the air flow channel, the thermochromism layer, the high absorption coating, the PCM energy storage layer, the outer building wall body and the like, not only can effectively utilize solar energy to generate power, but also can remarkably improve the overall energy utilization efficiency and the building environment regulation and control capability through the organic combination of various mechanisms such as heat collection, heat storage, heat rejection, heat preservation and the like.

title_en: Multi-disaster coupling risk assessment method and system for electric tower group
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-disaster coupling risk assessment method and system for an electric tower group, and relates to the technical field of electric transmission towers, wherein key characteristic information for risk assessment is obtained according to space-time correlation matching items of multi-source heterogeneous data streams; the method comprises the steps of judging the influence degree of each single disaster on the electric tower based on key characteristic information, obtaining a single-side disaster influence result, identifying interaction among the single disasters, obtaining a coupling disaster influence result, identifying an unknown risk result based on an expected structural response baseline of a key component of the electric tower, calculating a comprehensive risk value of the electric tower by combining the single-side disaster influence result, the coupling disaster influence result and the unknown risk result, and obtaining a risk assessment result by combining action paths among disasters. The application systematically characterizes complex enhancement or weakening effects among disasters, and avoids real-time refined simulation of all-condition full components while guaranteeing the description precision of multi-disaster coupling response, thereby giving consideration to the accuracy and the evaluation efficiency of risk evaluation.

title_en: Liquid cooling circulation cooling battery cabinet for liquid cooling battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a liquid cooling circulation cooling battery-changing cabinet for a liquid cooling battery, which relates to the technical field of battery thermal management and battery-changing equipment, and comprises the following components: the novel battery charging device comprises a cabinet body, wherein a guide slideway is arranged in the cabinet body, a first elastic telescopic rod is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the guide slideway, a second electric telescopic rod is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the cabinet body, a heat dissipation mechanism for ventilation and heat dissipation is arranged on the inner wall of the first electric telescopic rod, and the inner wall of the first electric telescopic rod is arranged in the first electric telescopic rod.

title_en: Control method of multi-stack solid oxide fuel cell cogeneration system
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of fuel cell control, and particularly discloses a control method of a multi-stack solid oxide fuel cell cogeneration system. The method comprises the steps of taking the overall efficiency of a system as a target, dynamically distributing power reference values of all power generation modules according to the real-time running state of each power generation module, constructing a dynamic equation in each power generation module by taking the power reference values as an adjustment target, smoothly adjusting virtual load current, determining the current reference value of the SOFC stack according to the smoothly adjusted virtual load current, and finally controlling a DC/DC converter according to the current reference value by adopting an anti-saturation proportional-integral controller so that the output current of the SOFC stack tracks the current reference value. The method can meet the requirements of load power and stable bus voltage, and simultaneously, the method utilizes the cells to bear transient power and utilizes the SOFC pile to bear steady-state power, thereby effectively improving the overall efficiency of the system and prolonging the service life.

title_en: SOC calculation compensation method and system for hydrogen storage system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hydrogen storage system SOC calculation compensation method and system. The method comprises the steps of collecting pressure and temperature of hydrogen in a hydrogen storage container in real time, correcting the pressure based on the pressure and the temperature, converting the pressure to obtain 20 ℃ standard state pressure, calculating an initial SOC value based on the 20 ℃ standard state pressure by adopting a pressure-temperature method, obtaining a heat transfer coefficient, a heat exchange area, real-time hydrogen storage quality and constant pressure specific heat capacity of the hydrogen in the hydrogen storage container, calculating a thermal effect compensation coefficient according to a pressure change rate and a temperature change rate, carrying out thermal effect compensation on the initial SOC value based on the thermal effect compensation coefficient to obtain a thermal compensation SOC value, correcting hydrogen density based on a second temperature coefficient of the hydrogen, real-time absolute pressure in the hydrogen storage bottle and real-time thermodynamic temperature to obtain a density correction coefficient, and correcting the thermal compensation SOC value based on the density correction coefficient to obtain a final SOC value. The method improves the accuracy and stability of SOC measurement of the hydrogen storage system.

title_en: Multi-form TPMS structure composite flow field-diffusion layer integrated fuel cell based on gradient porosity and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fuel cells, and discloses a multi-form TPMS structure composite flow field-diffusion layer integrated fuel cell based on gradient porosity and application thereof, wherein the multi-form TPMS structure composite flow field-diffusion layer integrated fuel cell comprises an anode current collecting plate, an anode gradient porosity TPMS integrated flow field-diffusion layer, an anode catalytic layer, a proton exchange membrane, a cathode catalytic layer, a cathode gradient porosity TPMS integrated flow field-diffusion layer and a cathode current collecting plate; one side of the anode gradient porosity TPMS integrated flow field-diffusion layer is connected with an anode current collecting plate, the other side of the anode gradient porosity TPMS integrated flow field-diffusion layer is connected with an anode catalytic layer, one side of the cathode gradient porosity TPMS integrated flow field-diffusion layer is connected with a cathode current collecting plate, the other side of the cathode gradient porosity TPMS integrated flow field-diffusion layer is connected with a cathode catalytic layer, the anode gradient porosity TPMS integrated flow field-diffusion layer and the cathode gradient porosity TPMS integrated flow field-diffusion layer are of symmetrical structures and are respectively divided into a flow field distribution area, a diffusion enhancement area and the like along the direction perpendicular to the corresponding catalytic layer, and a transition layer is arranged between a D-type TPMS structural unit and a G-type TPMS structural unit.

title_en: Offshore oil and gas field power grid energy storage control management system
abstract_en: The application discloses an offshore oil and gas field power grid energy storage control management system which comprises a power grid, a data acquisition unit, a data processing unit and an energy management system, wherein the energy management system is used for carrying out energy management and optimal scheduling on the energy storage system according to power grid requirements and states of energy storage devices, the energy storage system comprises the energy storage device, an electric energy converter and a controller, the energy storage device is used for storing electric energy, the controller is used for monitoring the energy storage states of the energy storage device and controlling the flow direction and the conversion efficiency of the energy of the electric energy converter under the instruction of the energy management system, the energy management system is used for carrying out real-time control on the energy storage device so as to realize energy management and optimal scheduling on the energy storage system, and the real-time control on the energy storage device at least comprises the steps of starting charging or discharging, stopping charging or discharging, adjusting power output and changing one or more of operation modes. The application improves the stability of the offshore power grid.

title_en: Spring three-station isolation operating mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of three-station isolation switch equipment, and provides a spring three-station isolation operating mechanism, which comprises: a mechanism body; and the driving units are symmetrically arranged on the mechanism body, and each driving unit comprises a main shaft, a driving plate and a driving groove. The invention overcomes the defects of the prior art, has reasonable design and compact structure, realizes stable clamping in or out under the action of the torsion spring by matching the stop groove, the stop pin and the brake-separating stop claw, and forms a compact mechanical position locking mechanism. The main shaft is matched with the fixed connecting column through the arc-shaped groove on the limiting plate, so that the rotating angle and the rotating direction of the main shaft are accurately limited, and an external complex limiting device is omitted. And the manual and electric operation clutch component has compact structure and simple shape, and provides strength foundation for high-torque operation so as to meet the driving requirement of the integral epoxy resin casting switch. Meanwhile, the sharing of parts is strong, and the electric parts are additionally arranged to meet the requirements of later-stage project upgrading and reconstruction.

title_en: Battery pack and energy storage system
abstract_en: The application provides a battery pack and an energy storage system, wherein the energy storage system comprises a flue, a smoke treatment device and a plurality of battery packs, the battery packs are stacked, pressure relief valves of the battery packs are communicated with the flue, the smoke treatment device is arranged at a smoke outlet of the flue, the smoke treatment device is used for collecting smoke generated when any one of the battery packs is out of control, the smoke comprises carbon monoxide and hydrogen, the smoke treatment device comprises a catalyst for removing the hydrogen in the smoke, the catalyst comprises platinum oxide and a carrier, the platinum oxide is loaded on the carrier, and the mass percentage of the platinum oxide in the catalyst is more than 1% and less than 3%.

title_en: Multi-energy port space-time cooperative scheduling method based on cooperative game
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-energy port space-time collaborative scheduling method based on cooperative game, which establishes a multi-port comprehensive energy system collaborative optimization model by introducing a green hydrogen energy sharing mechanism and describing energy-logistics ties. The system builds a cross-port hydrogen energy sharing model by taking the lowest multi-port joint operation cost as a global objective function, and innovatively characterizes the hydrogen fuel cell ship as a mobile energy storage unit so as to realize space-time smoothing of hydrogen energy resources. The model deeply considers the dynamic coupling of the port logistics system and the energy supply, and establishes a fair cost allocation mechanism by using a shape value method so as to ensure the excitation compatibility and cooperation stability of each port. The model can obviously reduce the running cost of the system and greatly improve the new energy consumption capability, and provides powerful theoretical guidance and technical support for low-carbonization transformation and marketization collaborative operation of the multi-energy port.

title_en: Electronic power limiting device and method for limiting output power
abstract_en: An electronic power limiting device comprises a control unit designed to determine a control signal based on a voltage difference between a first input voltage and a second input voltage received at a first input and a second input of the control unit, wherein the first received input signal is representative of a voltage at an input of the electronic power limiting device, and a switching element designed to receive the control signal and to ensure a limited power at an output of the power limiting device.

title_en: Ultrathin lithium anode with bulk ion channel and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an ultrathin lithium anode with a bulk phase ion channel, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the ultrathin lithium anode is subjected to mechanical folding-rolling treatment along with doping compounding of rare earth metal compounds, the ultrathin lithium anode with the bulk phase ion channel is obtained through modification molding, the mass content of the rare earth metal compounds is 5-30wt% of the mass of the lithium anode base material, the method comprises the following steps of paving the rare earth metal compounds on the lithium anode base material, repeatedly aligning and folding the lithium anode base material, and obtaining the ultrathin lithium anode with the bulk phase ion channel, and the application of the ultrathin lithium anode in a liquid battery, wherein the liquid battery comprises an anode, electrolyte and the ultrathin lithium anode. Compared with the prior art, the invention has excellent ion directional transmission effect, can radically inhibit the growth of lithium dendrites and remarkably improve the electrochemical performance.

title_en: Surface-control modified silicon-based anode material of lithium ion battery, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The product belongs to the field of lithium ion batteries, and discloses a surface-control modified silicon-based anode material of a lithium ion battery, and a preparation method and application thereof. The material consists of a silane coupling agent modified pure silicon core, a uniform carbonized shell layer, a three-dimensional crosslinked carboxymethyl cellulose-pyrrole phytic acid binder and acetylene black. The siloxane group is condensed with the hydroxyl on the surface of the nano silicon and exposes double bonds, methyl methacrylate is carbonized to form a uniform carbon shell after being grafted by double bonds through synergistic polymerization, the adhesive is formed by crosslinking carboxymethyl cellulose, pyrrole and phytic acid, and amino and carboxyl groups of the adhesive respectively form covalent bonds and coordination bonds with the carbon shell and a copper foil current collector. The product solves the problem of instability of the electrode structure under the volume expansion of the pure silicon negative electrode, relieves the volume expansion, improves the conductivity, and enhances the interfacial adhesion and the mechanical stability.

title_en: Combustion power generation assembly based on energy storage peak shaving, control method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a combustion power generation assembly based on energy storage peak shaving, a control method and a device, and belongs to the technical field of electric power energy. The combustion power generation assembly comprises a first energy storage unit for storing pyrolysis gas generated in a coal pyrolysis process, a second energy storage unit for storing coal tar generated in the coal pyrolysis process, a third energy storage unit for storing pyrolysis coke powder generated in the coal pyrolysis process, and a coal-based power generation unit for executing peak regulation action under the condition of receiving a power grid peak regulation request. The peak shaving action comprises at least one of introducing pyrolysis gas stored in the first energy storage unit, blending coal tar stored in the second energy storage unit and blending pyrolysis coke powder stored in the third energy storage unit. The combustion power generation assembly based on energy storage and peak shaving improves the flexible peak shaving capacity of a power system.

title_en: Independent phase-shifting transformer and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an independent phase-shifting transformer and a control method thereof, belonging to the technical field of power system power flow regulation and control, wherein the independent phase-shifting transformer comprises a primary side winding, a secondary side winding, a tertiary side winding and a polarity switch; the primary side winding is arranged in a triangular structure, the nodes of the triangular structure are excitation points, the secondary side winding and the tertiary side winding are in a three-phase independent state, the secondary side winding and the tertiary side winding are connected in series on circuits on two sides of the excitation points, the primary side winding is respectively connected with the secondary side winding and the tertiary side winding in parallel through a polarity switch, the primary side winding is used for acquiring excitation voltage from the circuits based on the excitation points and synthesizing the excitation voltage into compensation voltage, the polarity switch is used for carrying out inverting operation on the compensation voltage, the secondary side winding is used for adjusting a source side gear, and the tertiary side winding is used for adjusting a load side gear, wherein constant amplitude phase shifting, amplitude rising phase shifting or amplitude falling phase shifting are carried out on the compensation voltage based on the cooperative adjustment of the source side gear and the load side gear.

title_en: Waterproof, dustproof and electric shock-proof electric connector socket and electric connector thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a waterproof, dustproof and electric shock-proof electric connector socket and an electric connector thereof, which comprise a plug and a socket and are characterized in that an insulating sealing cap is fixed on the head of a public current carrier body to form a part of the plug, an active sealing mechanism is arranged in an insertion opening of the socket and comprises an inner core assembly, a resilient reset element, a limiting rod and at least one inner core outer side waterproof ring, wherein the inner core assembly is arranged in the insertion opening of the socket, a plurality of public current carrier body holes are distributed on the surface of the active sealing mechanism, the public current carrier body is arranged in the insertion opening of the socket, the public current carrier body penetrates through the public current carrier body holes and can move forwards and backwards, the resilient reset element enables the inner core assembly to keep an outward moving trend, the limiting rod is connected with the inner core assembly, the inner core assembly can only move in a limiting mode, and a plurality of carrier fluid sealing rings are fixed on the outer peripheral surface of the inner core assembly and are lined in the inner walls of the respective public current carrier body holes to realize sealing fit with the public current carrier bodies.

title_en: Circle device and group circle welding equipment are pieced together to pieced together stator core
abstract_en: The invention provides a split-block stator core rounding device and rounding welding equipment, wherein the split-block stator core rounding device comprises two oppositely arranged first rounding action mechanisms, a first rounding action fixing frame is fixedly used for fixing a stator core unit, a first hinge shaft is arranged on the first rounding action fixing frame, the first rounding action moving frame is connected with the first hinge shaft and used for fixing a stator core unit, a first rounding action driving piece is used for driving the two stator core units to form a first stator core group, two oppositely arranged second rounding action mechanisms, and a second rounding action driving piece is used for driving the two first stator core groups to form a second stator core group. Through adopting above-mentioned technical scheme, adopt the two-stage articulated rotation to piece together round structure, promote stator core whole assembly uniformity and structural stability, be convenient for realize automatic continuous operation, improve sectional type stator core's group round efficiency and finished product quality.

title_en: Preparation method of solid-state battery monomer and related device thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a preparation method of a solid-state battery monomer, the solid-state battery monomer, a battery module, a battery and an electric device, wherein the preparation method of the solid-state battery monomer comprises the steps of providing sulfide electrolyte and electrolyte solvent, and performing aftertreatment to obtain sulfide solid-state electrolyte pole piece powder, wherein the electrolyte solvent comprises an ester solvent and a benzene solvent, the mass ratio E  1  of the ester solvent in the electrolyte solvent is more than or equal to 35% and less than or equal to E  1  and less than or equal to 55%, the mass ratio X  1  of the ester solvent and the benzene solvent is more than or equal to 0.5 and less than or equal to X  1  and less than or equal to 1.22, and the sulfide solid-state electrolyte pole piece powder is provided to prepare the solid-state battery monomer. The preparation method of the solid-state battery monomer can ensure that the sulfide solid-state electrolyte performance of the prepared solid-state battery monomer can meet the production requirement on the premise of not influencing the performance of the solid-state battery monomer.

title_en: Thyristor converter and hybrid trigger control method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a thyristor converter and a mixed trigger control method thereof. The mixed trigger control method of the thyristor converter comprises the steps of outputting a first trigger signal to thyristors of all sub full bridges in a first trigger mode, enabling the trigger angle of a common cathode group thyristor in all the sub full bridges to be identical to the trigger angle of a common anode group thyristor, enabling the thyristors of all the sub full bridges to comprise the common cathode group thyristor and the common anode group thyristor, outputting a second trigger signal to the common cathode group thyristor of all the sub full bridges in a second trigger mode, and outputting a third trigger signal to the common anode group thyristor of all the sub full bridges, wherein the trigger angle of the common cathode group thyristor and the trigger angle of the common anode group thyristor in all the sub full bridges are different, and the maximum value of the direct current output voltage commonly output by all the sub full bridges in the first trigger mode is larger than the maximum value of the direct current output voltage commonly output by all the sub full bridges in the second trigger mode.

title_en: Motor overheat protection method and device based on dynamic heat accumulation
abstract_en: A motor overheat protection method and device based on dynamic heat accumulation relates to the technical field of motor control and protection and mainly comprises the following steps of monitoring the running state of a motor in real time, starting dynamic heat accumulation calculation when the motor meets the condition of entering a protection working condition, comparing a heat accumulation value with a threshold value, and judging and protecting motor overheat. The method realizes the high-precision approximation of the motor heat accumulation physical process by a discretization and normalization processing means with extremely low integer operation complexity, dynamically adapts the protection action time to the real-time current, greatly reduces the requirement of an algorithm on calculation resources, and is particularly suitable for a new energy vehicle driving motor controller and other high-reliability motor driving systems.

title_en: Control method of motor
abstract_en: The application provides a motor control method, which comprises the steps of controlling the motor to run according to first position and rotation speed information, wherein the first position and rotation speed information is position and rotation speed information of the motor detected by a position sensor, outputting a torque limiting signal if the position sensor is determined to have a fault according to a fault detection signal output by the position sensor, and controlling the motor to run according to second position and rotation speed information after a first preset duration is reached, wherein the second position and rotation speed information is position and rotation speed information of a rotor estimated by a non-sensing observer. It can be understood that limiting torque essentially limits the output current of the motor control system, so that interference of a larger current generated due to a larger torque demand on the sensorless sensor when the sensorless control mode is switched can be reduced, estimation accuracy of rotor position and rotation speed is improved, sensitivity of the motor control system to estimation deviation is reduced, and stability of motor control is further improved.

title_en: Intelligent cleaning device and method suitable for large-inclination-angle flexible photovoltaic shed roof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of cleaning of photovoltaic panels, and particularly relates to an intelligent cleaning device and method suitable for a large-inclination-angle flexible photovoltaic shed roof. The intelligent cleaning device suitable for the large-inclination-angle flexible photovoltaic shed roof comprises an anchoring traction system and a cleaning robot body, wherein the anchoring traction system comprises a winch assembly arranged on the shed roof, a composite cable connected with the winch assembly and a central control unit, the composite cable is integrated with a traction cable, a power supply cable and a water supply hose, the cleaning robot body is connected with the winch assembly through the composite cable and comprises a walking and adsorbing mechanism, an intelligent adsorption pressure control system and a cleaning mechanism, and the walking and adsorbing mechanism is a crawler-type vacuum chuck composite walking mechanism. The intelligent cleaning device suitable for the large-inclination-angle flexible photovoltaic shed roof realizes safe, stable and efficient full-automatic cleaning operation with the cleaning robot body on the surface of a large-inclination-angle flexible photovoltaic panel.

title_en: Method, device, medium and equipment for constructing digital twin bodies of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, a medium and equipment for constructing a digital twin body of a power distribution network, which belong to the technical field of power distribution networks, and the method comprises the steps of firstly combining communication resource allocation and edge computing resource allocation, carrying out decoupling and phased optimization on the cooperation of transmission resources, determining model training time delay through the optimization of the communication resource allocation, dynamically matching time-varying channels according to the time delay requirements of model transmission under multiple time scales, ensuring the stability and the cooperativity of overall resource scheduling decisions, on the other hand, through edge computing resource allocation optimization, the computing power requirements of different scale model training are adapted, the resource utilization rate is improved, then digital twin modeling is carried out according to different time scales, the suitability of gridding management and control is improved, all local models are uploaded and then are subjected to global aggregation, instant response in grids and global coordination across grids are achieved, the precision of multi-scale gridding digital twin body construction is improved, and then the gridding management effect of the power distribution network is improved.

title_en: Environment-friendly polyethylene insulation low-voltage power cable
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment-friendly polyethylene insulation low-voltage power cable, and belongs to the technical field of power cables. The invention solves the problems of weak bonding force, easy aging of water tree and poor thermal oxidation stability of the existing cable interface. The cable comprises a conductor, an insulating layer, a filling layer, a wrapping layer and a sheath layer from inside to outside. The insulating layer is made of a masterbatch comprising a two-monomer grafted polyethylene and modified magnesium hydroxide. The modified magnesium hydroxide is obtained by self-assembling polyethylene imine and phytic acid layer by layer, and a phosphorus-nitrogen flame-retardant shell is formed on the surface of the filler. The cooperative promotion of mechanical property, water tree aging resistance and thermal oxidation stability under high filling is realized through a multipoint chemical anchoring interface and a sectional gradient cooling process. The cable has high elongation at break, excellent insulation resistance retention and smooth surface quality.

title_en: Computer instrument cable convenient to lay and maintain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a computer instrument cable convenient to lay and maintain, which comprises a cable main body, wherein the cable main body sequentially comprises a conductor core, an insulating layer, a filling layer and a sheath layer from inside to outside, a plurality of reinforcing ribs are uniformly arranged on the outer side of the cable main body along the length direction, the reinforcing ribs are connected with the cable main body through connecting strips, identification grooves are formed in the connecting strips, replaceable identification plates are embedded in the identification grooves, anti-skid lines are arranged on the outer side of the sheath layer, a positioning mark is arranged on the sheath layer along the length direction at intervals of 1-2m, and quick connectors are arranged at two ends of the cable main body. The cable bending device is simple in structure, reasonable in design and high in practicability, not only is the bending laying of the cable convenient, the laying difficulty is reduced, but also the later identification, overhaul and maintenance are convenient, and meanwhile, the wear resistance and the tensile resistance of the cable are improved, and the service life of the cable is prolonged.

title_en: Control method and controller of single-phase LCL grid-connected inverter
abstract_en: The application relates to a control method and a controller of a single-phase LCL type grid-connected inverter, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a reference current, calculating a feedforward duty ratio according to the reference current and nominal physical parameters of the single-phase LCL type grid-connected inverter, inputting feedback state signals of the reference current and the single-phase LCL type grid-connected inverter into a radial basis function neural network controller, forward reasoning and outputting the compensation duty ratio, presetting network parameters of the radial basis function neural network controller through end-to-end offline training, and carrying out end-to-end offline training based on a microphysical evolution model which is formed by an inverter side inductance dynamic equation, a network side inductance dynamic equation and a capacitance voltage dynamic equation of the single-phase LCL type grid-connected inverter in a tensor calculation graph. The system state can be perceived in real time, and the compensation signal is generated autonomously to counteract the influence caused by the mismatch of all unmodeled dynamics and parameters. Independent of accurate offline parameter setting, the method has strong online self-adaption and robustness.

title_en: Production equipment and process of halogen-free flame-retardant polyolefin material
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of extruders, and particularly discloses production equipment of halogen-free flame-retardant polyolefin materials, which comprises an extruder, an extruder head arranged at the end part of the extruder, a plurality of discharge holes formed in the extruder head, a plurality of discharge pipes arranged at one side of the extruder head, micropores formed in the side wall of the discharge pipe, which is far away from the extruder head, of the extruder head, a sleeve sleeved on the outer wall of the discharge pipe, an annular oil storage tank arranged on the inner wall of the sleeve, an oil supply device connected with the oil storage tank, and a gap arranged between one end, close to the extruder head, of the sleeve and the outer wall of the discharge pipe. The production equipment and the process of the halogen-free flame-retardant polyolefin material can effectively reduce the generation of die orifice accumulated materials.

title_en: Thermal insulation foam capable of maintaining integrity under thermal runaway and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of silica gel foam, and relates to a thermal insulation foam for keeping integrity under thermal runaway and a preparation method thereof, wherein the raw materials comprise a first component and a second component, the first component is obtained by uniformly mixing vinyl silicone oil, base gum, hydroxyl silicone oil, a catalyst, mica powder, diatomite, low-melting-point glass powder and a flame retardant, the second component is obtained by uniformly mixing vinyl silicone oil, base gum, hydrogen-containing silicone oil, an inhibitor, mica powder, diatomite, low-melting-point glass powder and a flame retardant, according to the application, diatomite and mica powder are added into a silica gel foam formula, glass powder and flame retardant powder are compounded, and the content of the powder in the silica gel foam formula is regulated and controlled, so that the silica gel foam can be cooperatively regulated and controlled to still maintain good elasticity under thermal runaway, the foam can be prevented from being damaged while the buffering function is maintained, the heat transfer under the thermal runaway is prevented, and the silica gel foam can be suitable for the protection of the thermal runaway of the battery cell under 600 ℃.

title_en: Wiring terminal
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wiring terminal relates to the circuit breaker field, and it includes support, shell fragment, wiring board, screw and fixed plate, the fixed plate is installed in the support, screw and fixed plate screw-thread fit and end stretch into inside the support, the wiring board is installed the upper end of support, be equipped with the location axle that transversely sets up and be located the wiring board below in the support, the shell fragment has the slope and takes and lean on the epaxial first state in location, and quilt the screw promotes and leans against the second state that location axle rose. The utility model has the advantages of simple structure, labor saving operation and high working stability.

title_en: Mobile phone charger convenient for batch production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cell-phone charger convenient to batch production, concretely relates to cell-phone charger technical field, including charger shell, charger shell's bottom fixed mounting has connection panel, connection panel's inside is inlayed and is installed insulating cassette, the outside demountable installation of insulating cassette have with charger shell is fixed connection's joint knot, the inside of insulating cassette is fixed respectively and has cup jointed business turn over wiring gear shaping and ground connection gear shaping. The utility model discloses a set up skeleton and magnetic core, in the device course of operation, replace sleeve pipe and the operation of the anti-sticky tape of rolling over through adopting the membrane package line, automated production has both been realized, save material and man-hour cost, the production efficiency of charger has also been promoted, the inside of rethread magnetic core is equipped with N1, N2, N3 and N4, N1, N2 and N3 all adopt the automatic coil winding machine coiling, the tail-lead that plays of the inside N4 of magnetic core all is in the same one side of skeleton level, N4 plays the line by PIN7, PIN end recess connects PIN8 between 8.

abstract_en: The utility model discloses a special storage cabinet for ethylene oxide, which comprises a cabinet body and a cabinet door, wherein the cabinet body is of a hollow double-wall structure, a plurality of parallel clapboards are arranged inside the cabinet body, a pearl cotton tray is embedded above the clapboards, a plurality of gas tank accommodating tanks are evenly distributed on the pearl cotton tray, a plurality of pairs of horizontal slide rails are symmetrically arranged on the two side walls inside the cabinet body, the clapboards are inserted into the slide rails and can be freely pushed and pulled, the clapboards are selected to be inserted with different slide rails to realize the adjustment of the distance between the adjacent clapboards, a fan is arranged inside the cabinet body, a plurality of fireproof and explosion-proof vents are arranged on the side walls of the cabinet body, an anti-static grounding device is connected on the outer wall of the cabinet body, the cabinet door is of a single-door structure and can be opened and closed at 180 degrees, a door lock is arranged on one side of the cabinet door, the utility model has the advantages of simple structure, firmness and reliability, convenient use, good ventilation performance, high safety, and can effectively prevent the danger of combustion and explosion caused by the leakage of ethylene oxide gas, has wide application prospect and is beneficial to popularization and application.

title_en: Crawler-type high-pressure water mist fire-fighting robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a thin water smoke fire-fighting robot of crawler-type high pressure, its technical scheme main points are: the method comprises the following steps: the water spraying device comprises a crawler-type chassis, a shell, a water tank assembly for supplying water, a control assembly for pumping the water in the water tank assembly to a high-pressure spray gun assembly, and the high-pressure spray gun assembly for spraying high-pressure water mist; the shell is arranged on the crawler-type chassis; a cavity is formed between the shell and the crawler-type chassis; the control assembly is mounted within the chamber; the water tank assembly is arranged on the crawler-type chassis; the water inlet end of the control assembly is communicated with the water tank assembly; the high-pressure spray gun assembly is arranged on the shell; the high-pressure spray gun assembly is communicated with the water outlet end of the control assembly; this application has the advantage that can be applicable in the fire control occasion of different grade type.

title_en: Angle-adjustable hoisting lamp bracket
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an angularly adjustable hoist and mount lamps and lanterns support, concretely relates to lamps and lanterns installing support field, the upper cover comprises an upper cover, the upper cover top is provided with first preformed hole, the upper cover both sides all are provided with the second preformed hole, second preformed hole one side is provided with the junction tube, junction tube one end and second preformed hole threaded connection, junction tube other end threaded connection has angle adjusting mechanism, angle adjusting mechanism includes the regulating block. The utility model discloses a set up angle adjustment mechanism, the junction tube rotates, the junction tube other end and adapter sleeve threaded connection, pull the adapter sleeve, the ball that the adapter sleeve drove the stopper top rolls in annular spout, angle regulation later twists the locking cap, the locking cap is inwards screwed up the cooperation stopper and is pressed from both sides on the regulating block, thereby make and to come to carry out nimble angle modulation to hoist and mount lamp support according to user's demand, make the third dimension better, satisfied customer's demand and used more convenient and fast.

title_en: Energy storage power supply
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model relates to the technical field of energy storage application, and discloses an energy storage power supply, which comprises a shell, a first cavity and a second cavity, wherein the shell is provided with the first cavity and the second cavity; an inverter installed in the first chamber; the main control board is arranged in the first cavity and is electrically connected with the inverter; the battery module is arranged in the second cavity; and the connecting plug comprises a male plug and a female plug, the male plug is electrically connected with the battery module, the female plug is electrically connected with the main control board, the male plug is detachably connected with the female plug, and therefore the battery module can be conveniently replaced by detachably connecting the battery module with the main control board through the directional plug-in connection of the male plug and the female plug.

title_en: High-frequency switch direct-current power supply cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-frequency switch DC power cabinet, which comprises a cabinet body, wherein the bottom surface of the cabinet body is provided with dense air inlet holes, the bottom end of the cabinet body is provided with a base, the base is sleeved at the bottom end of the cabinet body, the inner side of the base is provided with a dehumidification box, a dehumidifying agent is placed in the dehumidification box, the dehumidification box is spliced with the base, and the top end of the cabinet body is provided with an air exhaust fan through screws, so that the problem that the prior DC power cabinet is often installed in a humid environment, the internal parts of the power cabinet rust and then the failure occurs due to the long-time wet environment of the power cabinet is solved, the structure of the power cabinet is improved and optimized, the power cabinet can be elevated, the direct contact with the humid ground is avoided, and the air entering the inside the power cabinet can be dehumidified while the heat of the power cabinet is dissipated, thereby conveniently guaranteeing that the air entering the power cabinet is dry enough.

title_en: Energy-saving lamp
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy-saving lamp, which relates to the technical field of energy-saving lamps and comprises an electric lamp and a manual switch, wherein a fixed frame is arranged at the top of the electric lamp, the fixed frame is movably connected with the electric lamp, one side of the fixed frame is connected with a power generation plate through an electric wire, the power generation plate is electrically connected with the fixed frame, and the manual switch is electrically connected with the other side of the fixed frame through an electric wire; the fixing frame is composed of a power connection frame, a storage battery, a time relay, a control group, a heat dissipation hole and a threaded pipe, the time relay in the fixing frame electrically connected with the manual switch is powered on when the manual switch is turned on, the time relay is powered on, and the electric lamp is turned on; the solar energy is absorbed by the power generation board for power generation, the solar energy is converted into electric energy by the power generation board, the electric energy is transmitted to the storage battery through the controller to charge the storage battery, the storage battery is electrically connected with the time relay, the Bluetooth connecting plate and the timing switch plate, and the storage battery supplies power; the lamp switch is switched on and off in a timing mode, not only is intelligentized, but also waste of electric energy is reduced.

title_en: Automobile tail lamp assembly capable of being maintained quickly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rapid maintenance tail lamp assemblies, in particular to an automobile tail lamp assembly component capable of being rapidly maintained, which comprises a base, a shell, a supporting plate, a side plate, a circuit control panel, an LED lamp, a top plate and a cover plate, the side surface of the upper end of the base is provided with a shell which is a cuboid with a hollow upper opening and a hollow lower opening, four sides of the lower end of the shell are fixedly connected with four sides of the upper end of the base, the upper end of the base is provided with a supporting plate, the supporting plate is a rectangular plate, the upper end of the supporting plate is provided with a side plate, the lower end of the side plate is fixedly connected with the side surface of the upper end of the supporting plate, the upper end of the side surface of the side plate (4) is provided with a circuit control plate, the upper end of the circuit control plate is provided with a plurality of regularly arranged LED lamps, the top plate is arranged at the upper end of the shell, the lower end of the top plate is fixedly connected with the top end of the shell, and the cover plate is arranged at the upper end of the top plate. The utility model discloses solved the difficult direct dismantlement of structure among the prior art betterly and leaded to maintaining or maintaining the scheduling problem fast.

title_en: Plasma surface treatment machine for cables
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cable plasma surface treatment machine, which comprises a bracket, adjustment mechanism is installed to the inner wall of support, adjustment mechanism includes roof, first threaded rod, sheave, belt and motor, the outer wall of roof and the inner wall four corners slip joint of support, the left and right sides of roof respectively with the outer wall threaded connection of first threaded rod. The height adjustment of machine has been realized, the manual transport has been saved, the operation degree of difficulty has been reduced, time saving and labor saving, and convenient to use, and then the circular slot of cooperation outer wall makes the quarter butt move down, the quarter butt that removes drives the riser and moves down, support tightly with the holding surface until the riser bottom, the overall stability has been improved, prevent to take place to remove, normal use has been ensured, the second threaded rod drives the outside bent plate and rotates to the inboard simultaneously, thereby make two bent plate tops fix the inserted cylinder bottom, the bolt and nut mounting form has been changed, be convenient for change, the practicality is improved, and the convenience is popularized and used.

title_en: Synthetic frock of outer cover in car battery
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a synthetic frock of automobile battery inner and outer cover, which comprises a tool rack, a pedestal, including a motor, an end cap, a controller, and a cover plate, battery cover tool and positioning mechanism, the base rotates and sets up on the mesa of frock frame, the motor sets up in the frock frame and its output is connected with the base, battery cover tool fixes on the base, positioning mechanism includes drive arrangement and clamp plate, drive arrangement fixes on the base, the output at drive arrangement is fixed to the clamp plate, the border is equipped with the location opening on the clamp plate, be equipped with the switch on the mesa of frock frame, before the battery cover tool top, the back, a left side, four sides in the right side all are equipped with first infrared detection module, each clamp plate outside all is equipped with the infrared detection module of second, still include host system, a switch, first infrared detection module, infrared detection module of second and motor, drive arrangement all with host system electric connection. The utility model discloses can not only guarantee that the adhesive tape pastes the position accuracy, reduce the finished product defective rate, can also accelerate the production process, improve machining efficiency.

title_en: Anti-static polyester needled felt
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of needled felt, in particular to an anti-static polyester needled felt, which comprises an upper layer of polyester needled felt base cloth and a lower layer of polyester needled felt base cloth; the middle part of the terylene needled felt base cloth is sequentially compounded with a nylon fiber cloth layer, an antibacterial cloth layer and a flame-retardant heat-insulating layer; the polyester needled felt base cloth positioned on the upper layer is provided with a hole groove; the polyester needled felt base cloth positioned on the lower layer is provided with air holes; conductive yarns are blended in the polyester needled felt, and the conductive yarns are arranged in a staggered manner; the conductive yarns penetrate through the nylon fiber cloth layer, the bacteriostatic cloth layer and the flame-retardant heat-insulating layer; the intersection of the conductive yarns leaks out of the hole groove; the weaving that runs through inside of dacron acupuncture felt base cloth has the location yarn, and the location yarn runs through inside nylon fiber bed of cloth, antibacterial bed of cloth and fire-retardant insulating layer, the utility model discloses electrically conductive effectual possesses antibacterial and fire-retardant function simultaneously.

title_en: Doctor of gynaecology and obstetrics uses wrist lamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a medical instrument technical field's a doctor uses wrist lamp for gynaecology and obstetrics, including the cavity base, the equal fixedly connected with bandage of terminal surface around the cavity base, it is two sets of all be provided with the magic subsides of mutually supporting on the bandage, the inner chamber fixedly connected with gear motor of cavity base, the top interval of cavity base is provided with the carousel, just gear motor's output shaft fixed connection is in the bottom of carousel, the top of carousel is connected with the mount, the top of mount is provided with control panel, be provided with lighting assembly on the mount, the device when the arm that the doctor wore the wrist lamp keeps the inspection posture, can be nimble adjust illumination angle and direction, be favorable to the promotion of illuminating effect, make things convenient for the doctor to use.

title_en: High-strength wire slot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-strength wire casing, which comprises an outer plate and a bottom plate, wherein the outer plate is arched, and the outer plate is enclosed on the bottom plate to form a cavity; an inner plate is further arranged in the cavity, the inner plate is arched, and the inner plate is arranged on the bottom plate in a surrounding mode to form a wiring channel for a power line to pass through; wherein, the planking with be equipped with a plurality of strengthening ribs between the inner panel, be used for the planking with form between the inner panel and support and compare in current wire casing, the utility model discloses a wire casing adopts bilayer structure, just is in the planking with the inner panel still is equipped with the strengthening rib, and compressive strength is high, the security is good.

title_en: Switch board start button with feedback
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a power distribution cabinet starting button with feedback, which comprises a bottom plate, a button body and a dustproof mechanism arranged on the bottom plate; the dustproof mechanism comprises sliding support plates, sliding blocks and a cleaning brush disc, wherein one side surface of each of the two sliding support plates is provided with a sliding groove, each sliding block is of a hollow structure, two ends of each sliding block are movably arranged in the two sliding grooves respectively, and the upper surface of the cleaning brush disc is connected with the top surface of the inside of each sliding block; the utility model discloses a stir the slider and slide on the slip extension board to wrap up start button, and then protect it, avoid it to expose for a long time and receive external collision and damage outside easily, improve its barrier propterty greatly, improve its life, simultaneously to accumulational dust, stir the sliding block at every turn, the cleaning brush dish of top all can once clean it, avoids the dust to pile up, the material resources of using manpower sparingly, improve the convenience performance and the practicality of equipment's use.

title_en: Armored movable type alternating current metal closed switch cabinet capable of quickly completing hinge disassembly and assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an armor that can accomplish hinge dismouting fast moves open type and exchanges metal-enclosed cubical switchboard, including the main part, the surface of main part is provided with a plurality of door plants, and a plurality of door plants all are provided with the hinge with one side of main part, and a plurality of door plants are provided with the lock with the opposite side of main part, and the surface of a plurality of door plants all has seted up the standing groove, and the inboard of standing groove is provided with the handle, the inboard of standing groove has seted up the fixed slot, it has the gag lever post to run through between handle and the standing groove; through stopper, the spacing groove of design, make the handle inboard at the standing groove carry on spacingly, through handle, torsional spring, the fixed slot of design, make this armor move open type exchange metal-enclosed switchgear's door plant expand the in-process, expand the operation to the door plant through this structure, when improving originally and drive the door plant through the key and expand, the cracked problem takes place for the block department of key and lock to increase life.

title_en: Switch power supply
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a power technical field relates to a switching power supply especially. The utility model discloses a switching power supply, including the casing and set up the PCB board in the casing, be equipped with switching power supply circuit on the PCB board, still including compressing tightly the piece, the casing is the casing of heat conduction, and the power device on the PCB board compresses tightly on the inside wall of casing and carries out the thermal contact through compressing tightly the piece. The utility model discloses a power device's radiating effect is good, has promoted circuit job stabilization nature, reliability and efficiency, has prolonged life.

title_en: Bypass type change-over switch
abstract_en: The utility model provides a bypass type change-over switch, belonging to the technical field of switches, comprising: a fixed seat; the movable groove is formed in the fixed seat, and a switch main body is inserted in the movable groove; the holding tank, the holding tank is seted up on the fixing base, two baffles of fixedly connected with in the holding tank, press the briquetting through pressing two, press two fixture blocks of briquetting extrusion to offset the extrusion force of a plurality of second springs through two, make two fixture blocks slide between two stoppers, it is fixed to remove the block to two butt joint pieces through the removal of two fixture blocks, because reset spring's elasticity resets, promote the push rod and slide in the expansion pipe, extrude the switch main part from the activity inslot through the push rod, realize carrying out visual inspection to the activity groove, pass through the press switch main part after the inspection, make two butt joint pieces and two fixture block looks blocks, through the removal to the switch main part, the maintenance staff of being convenient for of the inspection to the switch main part is maintained and is maintained.

title_en: Processing of cell-phone vibrating motor is with permutation frock
abstract_en: The utility model provides an arranging tool for processing a mobile phone vibration motor, which is used for shaping materials conveyed by a material vibration disc and comprises: the shaping table, the mounting frame and a fine adjustment mechanism for realizing the movement of the shaping table along the X direction and the Y direction; the upper surface of the shaping table is provided with a plurality of shaping grooves along the length direction, the shaping grooves are provided with feed inlets which are butted with discharge outlets of the material vibration discs, and the shaping table is arranged on the mounting frame through a micro-adjustment mechanism. The shaping groove can receive materials conveyed by the material vibration disc, can carry out high-efficiency and high-quality shaping on the weight piece, can be slightly adjusted along the X direction and the Y direction, is greatly convenient for a pickup device to accurately pick up the materials, and has scientific and reasonable structural design.

title_en: Intelligent door and window sensor convenient to equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides an intelligent door and window sensor convenient to assemble, which comprises a first main body and a second main body, wherein the first main body and the second main body are arranged in parallel and have a gap, the first main body and the second main body are induced by magnetic force, the first main body comprises a protective shell, a bottom plate, a circuit board, a mounting frame and a battery, the mounting frame penetrates through the circuit board and is clamped with the bottom plate, the mounting frame shields the circuit board, a placing groove is arranged on the mounting frame, two conducting potentials are arranged on the circuit board and are contained in the placing groove, the battery is contained in the placing groove and is respectively abutted against the two conducting potentials, the battery is electrically connected with the circuit board, and the protective shell is clamped with the bottom plate and shields the mounting frame and the battery; this intelligent door and window sensor convenient to equipment not only is convenient for the workman and carries out the fast assembly, and also the person of being convenient for simultaneously installs fast when changing the battery.

title_en: Stator positioning and processing working platform
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of stator machining, and particularly relates to a stator positioning machining working platform. The novel rotary table comprises a working table, wherein the bottom of the working table is connected with supporting legs, a rotary seat is fixedly arranged on the working table, a rotary disc is rotatably connected in the rotary seat, a disc limiting part is arranged on the side surface of the rotary seat, an electric push rod is connected to the rotary disc, a support frame is connected to the electric push rod, two oppositely arranged moving plates are slidably connected to the support frame, clamping plates are hinged to the inner sides of the two moving plates, and a clamping plate limiting part is arranged on the side surface of one moving plate.

title_en: Cable insulator convenient to fix
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cable insulators, and particularly discloses a conveniently-fixed cable insulator, which comprises an insulator main body, wherein the bottom surface of the insulator main body is movably connected with a control screw rod, the lower surface of the control screw rod is in threaded connection with a stabilizing block, the surface of the stabilizing block is fixedly connected with a control protective shell, the inner wall of the control protective shell is movably connected with a mounting plate, the surface of the control protective shell is provided with a socket matched with the mounting plate, the surface of the mounting plate is provided with a threaded hole matched with the control screw rod, and the surface of the control screw rod is movably connected with a limiting rod; according to the utility model, by controlling the protective shell and the T-shaped rod, when the insulator main body is required to be installed on the installation plate, the corresponding jack on the protective shell can be directly inserted into the surface of the installation plate, so that an operator can install and fix the insulator main body at the root of the installation plate, and the effect of conveniently installing and fixing the insulator is achieved.

title_en: Magnetic audio adapter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a magnetic audio adapter which comprises a first connector and a second connector, wherein the first connector comprises a first electric connection part, a first magnetic part and a first buckling part, and the second connector comprises a second electric connection part, a second magnetic part and a second buckling part. When the audio signal transmission device is used, the first connector and the second connector are fixed through magnetic attraction, so that external audio equipment respectively connected with the first connector and the second connector can be connected, and audio signal transmission between the two audio equipment is realized. The first connector and the second connector can be always inserted into corresponding audio equipment, and when audio signals need to be transmitted, the first connector and the second connector are connected together, so that the problem that the connectors are not easy to loosen is solved. Still can further fix first connector, second connector through first buckling parts and second buckling parts lock, the connection of first connector and second connector is reliable and more stable.

title_en: Clinical multi-functional pathological diagnosis platform
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a clinical multifunctional pathological diagnosis table, which comprises: a housing assembly: the LED lamp comprises a supporting shell, a top plate and a lighting assembly, wherein the top plate is integrally formed at the top of the supporting shell, and the lighting assembly is arranged between the top plate and the supporting shell; an illumination assembly: the LED lamp is arranged at the bottom of the top plate and has the same length as the top plate, and the lamp box is fixed on the surface of the supporting shell; the test tube storage assembly comprises: the device comprises a second cavity arranged in the support shell, sliding chutes arranged on two sides in the second cavity, and a placing shell arranged in the sliding chutes and capable of sliding relative to the sliding chutes. This clinical multi-functional pathological diagnosis platform can carry out effectual protection to the test tube, has improved holistic security, also can form the space that disease and medical personnel were interviewed face to face, has improved the efficiency of seeing a doctor.

title_en: Embedded hydrology monitoring collector
abstract_en: The utility model provides an embedded hydrological monitoring collector which comprises a protective box, wherein two sliding frames are arranged on the inner wall of the bottom of the protective box, sliding seats are movably connected to the outer walls of the circumferences of the two sliding frames, connecting rods are movably connected to the inner walls of the two sliding seats, one ends, far away from the sliding seats, of the two connecting rods are movably connected with a same lifting frame, an electric telescopic rod is arranged on the inner wall of the bottom of the protective box, the output end of the electric telescopic rod is arranged on the outer wall of the bottom of the lifting frame, a guide pillar is arranged on the outer wall of the top of the lifting frame, and a monitoring collector main body is arranged on the outer wall of the top of the guide pillar. The monitoring collector body can be protected by the protection box, and the lifting frame can be pushed to move upwards by the electric telescopic rod, so that the lifting frame can drive the monitoring collector body to move upwards in the lifting process, and finally the monitoring collector body can be led out from the through hole.

title_en: Detachable protection mechanism for block terminal
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of distribution boxes, and discloses a detachable protection mechanism for a distribution box, which comprises a box body, wherein a motor is connected inside the box body, one end of the motor is connected with a gear, a slide seat is connected above the box body, a second protection plate is connected on the inner side of one group of slide seats, a slide block connected on the inner side of each slide seat is arranged inside each second protection plate, a rack is connected below each second protection plate, the rack is connected with the gear, one side of the rack is connected with a first limiting block, the utility model starts the motor through the slide blocks, the slide seats, the motor, the gears and the racks to drive the gears to rotate, the racks and the second protection plates above the racks are driven to move under the connecting action of the gears and the racks, so that the slide block below the second protection plate slides out of the slide seats, and the second protection plates are separated from the box body, realize dismantling, solved and fixed in the block terminal top, do not possess the problem that can dismantle the function.

title_en: Heat radiation structure of double-source trackless mine car capacitance system
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of electric cars, and discloses a heat dissipation structure of a double-source trackless mine car capacitor system, which comprises a frame, wherein a fixed strip is arranged on the inner wall of the frame, a spacer is arranged inside the fixed strip, a positioning rod is arranged on the front surface of the fixed strip, an installation frame is arranged on the front surface of the positioning rod, a fan is arranged inside the installation frame, a second baffle plate is arranged on one side of the first baffle plate and penetrates through the inner wall of the frame, a first leak hole is formed inside the first baffle plate, and a second leak hole is formed inside the second baffle plate. Thereby increasing the heat dissipation efficiency of the super capacitor.

title_en: Rural power grids switch board for distribution that security performance is high
