abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rural power grid power distribution cabinet with high safety performance, which comprises a cabinet body, wherein an opening is formed in the front side of the cabinet body, the inner cavity of the opening is provided with a box door with the size matched with the opening, the position of the front side of the box door close to the left side is movably connected with the position of the front side of the box body close to the left side, the front side of the box door is fixedly connected with a handle near the right side, the rear side of the box door is provided with a rotating rod, through the mutual matching of the parts such as the bearing plate, the sleeve, the fixed block, the worm wheel, the rotating wheel, the worm, the fixed rod and the like, the bearing plate is arranged on the device to support the tool, so that the tool is convenient for the worker to take, and the device has the characteristics of convenience in repair and maintenance and the like, through the mutual cooperation of the shell, the movable plate, the movable rod, the cross rod, the reset spring, the mounting plate, the power switch and other parts, the device is automatically powered off when the box door is opened, and the device has the characteristics of high safety and the like.

title_en: Leakage current protection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a leakage current protection device, which comprises: the machine core comprises a shell, a machine core unit and a wire harness assembly; the shell comprises a shell base and a shell upper cover which are coupled with each other; the movement unit is arranged in the shell base and comprises at least one drainage sheet structure; one end of the wiring harness assembly is arranged in the upper cover of the shell and comprises at least one shielding detection line, wherein the shielding detection line is correspondingly coupled with the drainage sheet structure; and one end of the shielding detection line is provided with a connecting terminal, so that the drainage sheet structure is inserted into and kept connected with the connecting terminal. The disclosed leakage current protection device achieves the purposes of quick assembly and firm connection of the wiring harness assembly and the movement unit, so that secondary arrangement shielding detection lines in the leakage current protection device are not needed after assembly, and automatic mass production is facilitated.

title_en: Electric cabinet of magnetic suction switch door
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric cabinet for a magnetic suction switch door, which comprises a box body, a door body and a door body, wherein the box body consists of an upper cover and a lower cover; a plurality of installation cavities of electronic devices and windows which are communicated with the installation cavities and are exposed by the electronic devices are formed in the lower cover; the electronic devices in the installation cavity comprise a main circuit breaker and a plurality of breaking circuit breakers, and the main circuit breaker is connected with a conductive rod; the first magnetic attraction structure comprises a first magnet and a second magnet which are respectively arranged on the upper cover and the lower cover, and an attraction magnetic field is generated between the first magnet and the second magnet; the second magnetic attraction structure comprises a third magnet and a fourth electromagnet which are arranged on the upper cover and the lower cover; the standby power supply of the fourth electromagnet and the conducting rod form a series circuit; the electric cabinet can detect whether the internal leakage safety index of the electric cabinet is higher through the second magnetic attraction structure.

title_en: Power adapter with wire storage function for artificial intelligent equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a power adapter with a wire storage function for artificial intelligence equipment, and relates to the technical field of power adapters, wherein the power adapter comprises a power adapter main body, wherein a wire storage structure is arranged on one side of the power adapter main body; according to the utility model, the power line is wound along the four winding rings, then the magnet ring is placed on the magnet block, the plug is fixed through the magnetic attraction between the magnet ring and the magnet block, the storage operation of the power line is completed at the moment, the power adapter has the storage effect, the power adapter can be recycled, the power line is repeatedly stored, the subsequent position moving and carrying of the power adapter are convenient, meanwhile, the four winding rings limit the winding range of the power line, the power line is wound to be approximately rectangular, the length of one winding ring is greatly increased compared with that of the power line wound on the winding ring alone, and the power line can be completely stored by reducing the thickness of the winding ring.

title_en: Wisdom traffic device based on thing networking
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent traffic device based on the Internet of things, which comprises a first lamp post, a second lamp post, a third lamp post and an installation rod, wherein a first installation base is installed on one side of the first lamp post, safety piles are installed on two sides of the first lamp post in a separated mode, a second installation base is installed on one side of each safety pile, an iron chain is installed between each second installation base and the corresponding first installation base, the second lamp post is installed on the top of the first lamp post, the third lamp post is installed on the top of the second lamp post, the installation rod is installed on one side of the third lamp post, and a camera is installed at one end of the bottom of the installation rod. According to the utility model, the camera is arranged at one end of the bottom of the mounting rod, and the position of the device can be monitored through the camera, so that the traffic supervision of each road section is enhanced, the traffic accident without monitoring is avoided, the dispute is prevented from being continuous, and the assistance of the device on traffic management is effectively improved.

title_en: Lithium battery with automatic power-off structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lithium battery with an automatic power-off structure, which comprises a high-temperature-resistant adhesive tape and slots, wherein a lithium battery body is attached to the inner wall of the high-temperature-resistant adhesive tape, a positive wire and a negative wire are sequentially arranged above the lithium battery body from left to right, a shielding copper foil adhesive tape is attached to the outer side of the negative wire, an aluminum foil heat-insulating tape is arranged outside the shielding copper foil adhesive tape, a woven sleeve is attached to the outer side of the aluminum foil heat-insulating tape, a rubber sleeve is fixed outside the woven sleeve, a connecting ring is installed at one end of the negative wire, the outer side of a fuse is installed outside the connecting ring, and a cladding is arranged outside the fuse. This lithium cell with auto-power-off structure compares with current ordinary lithium cell, and the pencil of this lithium cell is being connected at the fuse both ends, and fuse fusing during the short circuit realizes auto-power-off, avoids whole lithium cell body to burn out, opens behind the be built by contract, can change the fuse of new, practices thrift use cost for the user.

title_en: Hand-held tool
abstract_en: The application provides a handheld tool, including battery package and battery cavity structures. The battery cavity structure comprises a battery bin for accommodating a battery pack, an ejection mechanism and a locking mechanism. The battery compartment comprises an outlet for plugging and unplugging the battery pack. The ejection mechanism is arranged at one end opposite to the outlet and is positioned in the battery bin. The locking mechanism is positioned in the battery bin; the battery pack is inserted into the battery bin, and the locking mechanism is connected with the battery pack and used for limiting the battery pack. So, through set up pop-up mechanism and locking mechanical system in battery cavity structures, cooperate with the battery package for the installation and the dismantlement of battery package are more convenient.

title_en: Electric fireproof current-limiting type socket protector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric fireproof current-limiting type socket protector which comprises a first shell, wherein the upper end of the first shell is connected with a first clamping plate in a sliding mode, the middle of the bottom end of the first clamping plate is fixedly connected with a plug, the bottom end of the first shell is connected with a second clamping plate in a sliding mode, the middle of the upper end of the second clamping plate is fixedly connected with a socket, and the right side of the upper end of the second clamping plate is fixedly connected with a cooling fan. According to the utility model, the protector can be conveniently connected to the socket circuit through the plug and the socket, when the socket circuit operates, the current condition in the socket circuit can be monitored constantly by means of the signal processor integrated in the first circuit board, the sensor for current monitoring and the like, once short circuit occurs, the protector can rapidly limit the short-circuit current at microsecond speed to realize arc extinction protection, so that the effects of avoiding fire accidents and guaranteeing use safety are achieved, and the protector is worthy of great popularization.

title_en: Portable power source that many lithium batteries package supplied power
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mobile power supply powered by a plurality of lithium battery packs, which relates to the field of mobile power supply devices and comprises a mobile power supply body and a plurality of lithium batteries, wherein the lithium batteries are arranged inside the mobile power supply body, a wireless charging module is arranged inside the mobile power supply body, a USB power supply module is arranged outside the mobile power supply body, the wireless charging module and the USB power supply module are electrically connected with the lithium batteries, an LCD display screen module is arranged on the upper surface of the mobile power supply body, and an LED lighting module is arranged on the side wall of the mobile power supply body, the mobile power supply body can be powered by the lithium batteries, when the electric quantity of one lithium battery is insufficient, the other lithium battery can be switched to supply power under the condition of no power failure, the electronic equipment which is being charged is prevented from being disconnected in the process of travel, and the cruising ability of the mobile power supply is greatly improved, whole utility model simple structure, convenient operation, safe and reliable, the practicality is high.

title_en: Prevent distortion, waterproof porous PE electric power pipe
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a twist deformation prevention and waterproof porous PE power pipe which comprises a pipe body, wherein an outer function layer is arranged in the pipe body, an elastic rubber body is arranged on the inner wall of the outer function layer, five inner pipes are arranged in the elastic rubber body, an inner function layer is arranged on each inner pipe, an outer waterproof membrane is arranged in the outer function layer, and an outer waterproof layer is arranged on the inner wall of the outer waterproof membrane; this prevent porous PE electric power outside of tubes portion water proof membrane of distortion, outside waterproof layer prevents that steam from corroding the body, prevent steam from corroding the inner tube through inside waterproof layer and inside waterproof membrane, and absorb water the steam of invasion inner tube through the dry layer, can reach good water-proof effects, through setting up the elastic rubber body, the buffer layer, the elastic buffer ball, buffer spring cushions external force, the connector, the arc buffer body, it prevents to receive external force extrusion each other to be separated by the spring between the inner tube, compressive capacity has been improved greatly, can reach the effect that prevents the electric power pipe by external force distortion.

title_en: Detachable variable frequency motor for single-stage centrifugal pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detachable variable frequency motor for a single-stage centrifugal pump, which comprises a base, wherein the top of the base is fixedly connected with a single-stage centrifugal pump body, one end of a pump shaft of the single-stage centrifugal pump body is fixedly connected with a fixed shaft, the top of the base is fixedly connected with a rotating support, the fixed shaft is rotatably connected inside the rotating support, the top of the base is fixedly connected with a base, the top of the base is fixedly connected with T-shaped slide rails which are symmetrically distributed, and a case is arranged above the base. Give the heating wire circular telegram through the terminal box to heat the inside of quick-witted case, guarantee the drying of inside air, and can carry out the circulation of air through the through-hole, further guarantee the drying of inside air, electric heating assembly singly is equipped with the terminal box, separately with motor body's wiring, can start the use alone like this, and lie in the outside of quick-witted case, make things convenient for the wiring like this, and convenient maintenance has reached damp-proofing effect from this.

title_en: Fool-proof card slot communication interface
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a foolproof card slot communication interface, belonging to the technical field of communication interfaces and comprising a guide post, wherein the front side of a communication equipment main body is provided with a positioning groove matched with the guide post for use, the rear side of the guide post is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the positioning groove, the number of the guide posts is a plurality of, the right side of the inner wall of the positioning groove is fixedly connected with a foolproof rod, the right side of a plug is provided with a foolproof groove matched with the foolproof rod for use, the rear side of the plug is provided with a guide groove matched with the guide post for use, the surface of the foolproof rod is movably connected with the inner cavity of the foolproof groove, the surface of the foolproof rod is contacted with the inner wall of the foolproof groove, when the plug is inserted into the inner cavity of a socket, the guide post is clamped into the inner cavity of the guide groove to connect the plug with the socket, the anti-reverse insertion phenomenon of the plug can be effectively prevented through the foolproof rod, the shape of the foolproof rod is clamped into the inner cavity of the foolproof groove, the surface of the foolproof rod is contacted with the inner wall of the foolproof groove, the phenomenon that the plug rocks can be effectively prevented.

title_en: Compact end detection hub motor
abstract_en: The utility model provides a compact end detection hub motor, which comprises a hub, an inner stator and an outer rotor, wherein the inner stator and the outer rotor are assembled in the hub, the left end of a middle shaft extends into the hub, the right side axis position of a left edge sealing of the hub is provided with a cylindrical installation groove, a bearing at the right side end part in the installation groove is rotatably assembled with the left end part of the middle shaft, a threaded hole is processed in the middle of the left end of the middle shaft, the left end of the middle shaft is assembled with a PCB seat, the PCB seat is fixed on the left side of the middle shaft through a screw assembled with the threaded hole, the left side of the PCB seat is assembled with a magnetic woven PCB plate assembly, and a detection magnetic steel facing the magnetic woven PCB plate assembly is assembled in the installation groove of the left edge sealing; this in-wheel motor mainly uses in the side wheel of vehicle, and among its measurement structure, carries out fixed mounting through the screw hole in the middle of the axis, detects the structure and is located an independent cavity moreover, can not influenced by other components, and the result of use is better, and this simple structure easily processes the implementation.

title_en: Dual waterproof electronic detonator junction box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double waterproof type electronic detonator junction box, which comprises a box body and a box cover, wherein the box body and the box cover can be opened or buckled with each other; one end of the box cover is connected with one end of the box body in an integrated forming mode through a hinge piece, and a first annular waterproof convex rib and a second annular waterproof convex rib are arranged on the inner side face of the box cover in a protruding mode. Through utilizing waterproof protruding muscle of first annular and the waterproof protruding muscle of second annular closely to inlay respectively and realize inside and outside dual waterproof in first waterproof annular groove and the waterproof recess of second annular for outside steam can't get into first cavity and second cavity, realizes fine waterproof performance, protects electronic components better, and this product one shot forming makes, simple structure, and the preparation is easy, and is with low costs, and simple to operate saves artifically.

title_en: Enameled wire for high-speed digital motor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of enameled wires, and provides an enameled wire for a high-speed digital motor, which is characterized by comprising the following components in parts by weight: the metal inner core comprises a first paint layer, a second paint layer, a third paint layer and a fourth paint layer; the first paint layer is a polyamide imide (PAI) priming paint film layer and is arranged on the surface of the metal inner core; the second paint layer is a high-temperature polyester PE paint film layer and is arranged on the surface of the first paint layer; the third paint layer is a polyamide imide (PAI) paint film layer and is arranged on the surface of the second paint layer; the fourth paint layer is a polyamide-imide self-lubricating PAI paint film layer and is arranged on the surface of the third paint layer; the four materials are adopted as the paint layer of the enameled wire, so that the performances of high temperature resistance, high adhesion, high flexibility, high scratch resistance, zero salt water pinhole and the like can be effectively improved, and the requirements of the enameled wire in use of a high-speed digital motor are met.

title_en: Wear-resistant direct-current brushed speed reduction motor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wear-resistant direct-current brushed speed reduction motor which comprises a machine shell, wherein a transmission rod is installed at one end of the machine shell in a penetrating mode, a connecting round seat is installed at the other end of the machine shell close to the middle of the machine shell, a protective frame is installed on the outer side of the machine shell, stators are installed on two sides of the inner wall of the machine shell, electrode connecting blocks are installed at the front ends of two groups of stators, a plurality of groups of coils are installed on the inner sides of two groups of commutators, steel plate plates are installed between the coils, a wire connector is installed on one side of each electrode connecting block, the protective frame comprises a plurality of groups of vertical rods, a plurality of groups of transverse rods are installed between the vertical rods, rubber layers are installed on the inner sides of the transverse rods, supporting rods are installed at two ends of one group of the vertical rods, and telescopic rods are installed at one ends of the two groups of the supporting rods. The wear-resistant direct-current brushed speed reducing motor increases the utilization rate of the motor and reduces the error rate of the motor in working.

title_en: Anti-aging wire cable
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cables and discloses an anti-aging wire and cable, which comprises an external sleeve, wherein the external sleeve is a circular outer layer, inner cores which are arranged at equal intervals are arranged inside the external sleeve, a plurality of groups of air cushions are arranged inside a wear-resistant layer, air is arranged inside the air cushions, the air cushions are connected with buffer blocks in clamping grooves through connecting rods, when the wear-resistant layer is subjected to external extrusion force, the air inside the air cushions firstly buffers the acting force transmitted by the wear-resistant layer, at the moment, the air cushions can drive an external protective layer to slide on the external sleeve through extrusion blocks, the extrusion blocks can extrude buffer springs, when the extrusion blocks rotate in the opposite direction, the extrusion blocks inside the external protective layer can pull the buffer springs, so that when the external acting force is transmitted to the inside of the external protective layer, the extrusion blocks inside the external protective layer can buffer through the elasticity of the buffer springs, thereby the effect of avoiding the inner core inside the external sleeve from being damaged and prolonging the service life of the whole cable is achieved.

title_en: Extensible deformable heating equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses extensible deformable heating equipment, which comprises a heating skin, a sliding telescopic column, a heat insulation curtain, a bottom heating skin and a steel skeleton, wherein the heating equipment is internally of a hollow structure, the heating skin is arranged outside the heating equipment, and the heating skin is arranged in an accordion structure; a plurality of sliding telescopic columns are arranged at the bottom end of the heating skin at equal intervals; the heat insulation curtains are arranged on two sides of the heating skin, and the top ends of the heat insulation curtains are fixedly connected with the heating skin; the bottom heating leather is transversely arranged at the bottom of the heating leather, and two sides of the bottom heating leather are fixedly connected with the heating leather; many the vertical equidistance setting of steel skeleton is in heating skin inside, both ends respectively with heating skin and bottom heating skin fixed connection, but this firing equipment extension flexible, the low cost satisfies the demand that the production line changed, improves workshop space usage, and this equipment adopts the heating skin, for the face heating, heating temperature is even.

title_en: Outdoor special UPS portable power source
abstract_en: An outdoor special UPS mobile power supply relates to the technical field of UPS equipment. It includes the bottom plate, the baffle, the curb plate, the UPS power supply box body, a groove, vertical support, horizontal support, the top cap, moving mechanism, stop gear, both sides fixed mounting has the baffle around the bottom plate, the left and right sides fixed mounting of bottom plate has the curb plate, the UPS power supply box body sets up the upper surface at the bottom plate, be equipped with the recess on the face of both sides around the curb plate, movable mounting has moving mechanism in the recess, the curb plate is equipped with stop gear in the one side of keeping away from the UPS power supply box, the top middle part fixed mounting of curb plate has vertical support, the top and the horizontal support fixed connection of vertical support, the both ends top and the top cap fixed connection of horizontal support. The movable mechanism can be rapidly stored and fixed, and can be unfolded and erected more rapidly and conveniently when moving is needed, so that the movable mechanism is more flexible to use and strong in realizability.

title_en: Motor, fan assembly and air conditioner
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a motor, a fan assembly and an air conditioner, wherein the motor comprises: rotor subassembly, stator and protection casing. The rotor assembly comprises a machine shell, a rotor and a rotating shaft, the rotor is arranged in the machine shell and connected with the machine shell, one axial end of the machine shell is open, the open end of the machine shell exceeds the rotor, and the rotating shaft is positioned in the rotor and connected with the machine shell; the stator is arranged between the rotor and the rotating shaft; the protection casing is including the cover body and the rotation portion that link to each other, and the rotation portion rotates with the pivot to be connected, covers the body and establishes the end of opening at the casing, and the part of the cover body is located the casing, is equipped with the manger plate groove that extends along the circumferential direction of the cover body on the periphery wall of the cover body, and the end of opening of casing is relative with the manger plate groove. According to the motor, the water retaining groove is formed in the peripheral wall of the cover body, the open end of the shell is opposite to the water retaining groove, water is prevented from flowing into the motor from a gap between the protective cover and the shell, the waterproof capability of the motor is improved, the fireproof capability of the motor is also improved, and therefore the safety of the motor is improved.

title_en: High-strength commutator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of commutators, in particular to a high-strength commutator, which comprises a commutator body, wherein a through hole is arranged in the commutator body, a fixing groove is arranged at the outer side of the commutator body, a commutator segment is arranged in the fixing groove, a clamping groove is arranged at the inner side of the fixing groove, a connecting part is arranged at one side of the commutator segment, the connecting part is matched with the clamping groove, the connecting part and the commutator segment are integrally arranged, the commutator segment is arranged in the fixing groove at the outer layer of the commutator body, two connecting parts on the commutator segment are fixed in the clamping groove, the commutator segment is installed, the stability of the commutator segment in use can be effectively improved by adopting the arrangement of the two connecting parts, then a first fixing ring and a second fixing ring are respectively arranged in a first groove and a second groove, the firmness of the commutator segment is also effectively improved by adopting the arrangement of the two fixing rings, the commutator segment is prevented from shaking or shifting the original position in the use process, so that the practicability of the commutator is improved.

title_en: Luminous road surface
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model discloses a luminous pavement, relates to the technical field of pavement construction, and solves the problem that the guide and appreciation functions of a special pavement in the prior art are greatly weakened at night when the special pavement meets the requirements of both guide and appreciation; the road surface recess internal fixation has inside frame, and the inside frame internal fixation has the LED fluorescent tube, and the inside frame upper surface is equipped with the printing opacity concrete layer that equals with the inside frame width, including leading optic fibre in the printing opacity concrete layer, the upper surface on printing opacity concrete layer and the upper surface parallel and level of road surface masonry. The embodiment of the utility model realizes the functions of effective guiding, illumination and appreciation.

title_en: Working lamp
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of lighting, and provides a working lamp which comprises a lamp body and a base, wherein two sides of the base are provided with support frames, the lamp body is rotatably connected with the support frames, the lamp body comprises a lamp bracket, a first lamp cover and a second lamp cover, the first lamp cover is arranged on one side of the lamp bracket, the second lamp cover is arranged on the other side of the lamp bracket, the lamp bracket is connected with an LED lamp, the second lamp cover is at least provided with a warning lamp, a circuit board is arranged in the base, the circuit board is connected with a switch button, a brightness adjusting button, a charging button and a power supply button, and the circuit board is electrically connected with the LED lamp and the warning lamp; the lamp body can rotate around the support frame, and the spring and the support block are arranged in the support frame to fix the rotated lamp body, so that the problems that the angle adjustment is very inconvenient and the lamp body is not easy to fix after the angle adjustment in the prior art are solved.

title_en: Spectacle case of intelligent rechargeable glasses
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of intelligent glasses and spectacle cases, in particular to a spectacle case of intelligent rechargeable glasses, wherein the glasses comprise a spectacle frame, a charging contact is arranged on the spectacle frame, the spectacle case comprises a case body, a case cover is rotatably connected to the case body, and a pressure buffer mechanism is arranged on the case cover; meanwhile, under the action of matching of the guide rod and the guide hole, the buffering pressing plate can be guided to vertically move up and down, so that the pressing pressure of the buffering pressing plate on the spectacle frame can be balanced, and uneven stress on the spectacle frame is avoided.

title_en: Direct-insertion type aluminum electrolytic capacitor with shock-resistant and liquid-leakage-proof functions
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a direct-insertion type aluminum electrolytic capacitor with an anti-seismic and anti-leakage function, which comprises an aluminum electrolytic capacitor and a protective sleeve arranged outside the aluminum electrolytic capacitor in a detachable mode; wherein, the aluminum electrolytic capacitor is configured to comprise a capacitor and a sealing mechanism matched with the capacitor, and the protective sleeve is configured to comprise a double-layer protective sleeve, a base and a clamping hoop. The utility model provides a direct-insertion type aluminum electrolytic capacitor with an anti-seismic and anti-leakage function, which can effectively seal internal liquid electrolyte by limiting the structure of the direct-insertion type aluminum electrolytic capacitor, effectively prevent the liquid leakage phenomenon during the use process, and simultaneously perform anti-seismic protection through an external protective sleeve so as to ensure the service life and have better product stability.

title_en: Centrally installed switchgear
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a middle-placed cabinet, which comprises a cabinet body and three cavities arranged in the cabinet body, wherein a ventilating partition plate is arranged in the cabinet body, an exhaust port is formed in the top of the cabinet body, a fan is arranged at the bottom of the exhaust port, and a gas collecting hood is arranged at the top of the cabinet body; through the design of ventilative baffle, make between each cavity gaseous can circulate each other, thereby be favorable to putting going on of the inside heat dissipation work of cabinet in, through the first otter board of ventilating, the second otter board of ventilating, third otter board and fan of ventilating, mutually support between the gas collecting channel, can form a complete wind channel in the inside of putting the cabinet in, thereby make external normal atmospheric temperature air can cool down with putting the inside electronic component of cabinet in abundant contact from bottom to top, make put the inside radiating effect of cabinet in better, can avoid putting the inside condition emergence that leads to inside electronic component ageing speed to accelerate that high temperature state leads to for a long time of cabinet in.

title_en: Winding former and winding device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a winding former and a winding device. The winding former comprises a die core and two opposite side plates. The mold core is arranged between the two side plates and is enclosed to form a winding area. The two sides of the winding area are respectively provided with a first protruding part and a second protruding part, the first protruding part is used for enabling the first-layer coil winding of the second layer and the winding which is located on the second layer and adjacent to the first-layer coil winding to be bonded on the first-layer tail coil winding, and the second protruding part is used for enabling the second-layer tail coil winding and the winding which is located on the second layer and adjacent to the second-layer tail coil winding to be bonded on the first-layer head coil winding. So, increase the first layer first circle wire winding and the wire-wound bonding area of first layer tail circle, improve the adhesion, effectively avoid the phenomenon that the coil appears the pine line, guarantee product quality.

title_en: Quick-connection type switching power supply shell
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of switching power supplies, in particular to a quick-connection type switching power supply shell, which comprises: the bottom shell comprises a bottom plate, and a first side wall and a second side wall which are vertical to each other and are vertical to the bottom plate, wherein the first side wall is provided with a clamping seat, the opening direction of the clamping seat faces the second side wall, and a clamping block is arranged at the diagonal position of the adjacent angle of the second side wall and the first side wall of the bottom plate; the upper cover comprises a top plate, and a third side wall and a fourth side wall which are parallel to each other and vertical to the top plate, wherein a clamping groove which is in splicing fit with the clamping seat is formed in the fourth side wall, the third side wall is bent corresponding to the position of the clamping block and extends out of a mounting seat which is parallel to the top plate, and the mounting seat is in clamping fit with the clamping block. According to the utility model, the bottom shell and the upper cover are connected in a clamping assembly mode, so that the mounting steps of the switch power supply shell are simplified, the mounting efficiency is improved, and the reliability of the connection of the bottom shell and the upper cover is improved due to the insertion fit of the clamping seat and the clamping groove and the clamping fit of the clamping block and the mounting seat.

title_en: Power distribution cabinet double-door plate structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-door plate structure of a power distribution cabinet, which comprises a bottom plate, an inner cabinet body, an inner door plate, an outer cabinet body and an outer door plate, wherein the outer cabinet body is arranged at the central position of the top end of the bottom plate, the inner cabinet body is arranged inside the outer cabinet body, the inner door plate is hinged to the central position of the surface of the inner cabinet body through a hinge, a first visible through window is arranged at one end of the surface of the inner door plate, indicator lamps at equal intervals are arranged on the surface of the inner door plate below the first visible through window, a first pull handle is arranged on the surface of the inner door plate below the indicator lamps, pull gates at equal intervals are arranged on the surface of the inner door plate, far away from one end of the indicator lamps, of the first pull handle, and power distribution modules at equal intervals are arranged on the surface of the inner door plate below the pull gates. The utility model not only eliminates the potential safety hazard existing when the double-door plate structure is used, reduces the phenomenon that the internal elements of the outer cabinet body are burnt due to high temperature when the double-door plate structure is used, but also improves the convenience when the double-door plate structure is used.

title_en: Deep well ion earthing pole construction auxiliary device
abstract_en: The application discloses a deep well ion grounding electrode construction auxiliary device, which comprises a bracket, a filling assembly, two clamping assemblies, two lifting parts and a plurality of sleeve assemblies; the plurality of sleeve pipe assemblies are detachably connected, each sleeve pipe assembly comprises a sleeve pipe and a hose, and the hoses are arranged on the inner wall of the sleeve pipes; the two clamping assemblies are arranged on two sides of the sleeve, the fixed ends of the clamping assemblies are connected with the bracket in a sliding manner, and the telescopic ends of the clamping assemblies can clamp the sleeve; the fixed ends of the two lifting parts are fixedly connected to the support, the telescopic ends of the two lifting parts are fixedly connected to the fixed ends of the two clamping components respectively, the filling component is fixedly connected to the side face of the fixed end of one of the clamping components, and the filling port of the filling component is detachably connected to the hose. This application has realized that deep well ion earthing pole construction hose and protective case promote in step when pouring the backfill to demolish protective case and hose segmentation in step, save man-hour and the purpose of raising the efficiency.

title_en: Seamless cable fireproof blanket
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a seamless cable fireproof blanket which comprises a first coating sheet, a second coating sheet, a third coating sheet and a fourth coating sheet, wherein a head fireproof part, a tail fireproof part and a main fireproof part are formed by sewing, flame-retardant fillers are filled in the head fireproof part, the tail fireproof part and the main fireproof part, a first accommodating groove is formed between the head fireproof part and the head end of the first coating sheet, and a second accommodating groove is formed between the tail fireproof part and the tail end of the second coating sheet. The cable joint is fixed on the cable through the strapping tape, so that the cable joint is suitable for fireproof transformation of a mature cable system, when the cable joint is wrapped on the cable, the tail fireproof part is accommodated in the first accommodating groove, and the head fireproof part is accommodated in the second accommodating groove.

title_en: Insulating cutter of intelligence wire stripper
abstract_en: The application discloses insulating cutter of intelligence wire stripper compares with prior art, includes: a tool holder frame; the wire stripping blade is connected with the tool rest frame; the insulating wall is arranged between the tool rest frame and the wire stripping blade; the wire stripping blade includes: a first blade; a second blade arranged symmetrically to the first blade; the insulator is arranged between the first blade and the second blade and used for insulating and isolating and fixing the position of the wire stripping blade; the surfaces of the first blade and the second blade are plated with conductive layers; a first wire having one end connected to the conductive layer on the first blade; a second wire having one end connected to the conductive layer on the second blade; the other ends of the first conducting wire and the second conducting wire are used for being connected with a control chip for signal feedback processing. Compared with the prior art, the method can accurately strip the insulating layer of the lead, and effectively avoid damaging the inner core of the lead.

title_en: Testing device for fuel cell expander
abstract_en: The utility model provides a test device for a fuel cell expander, belongs to the technical field of fuel cell engines, and solves the problems that the prior art can not effectively simulate the test performance when a compressor to be tested is matched with a fuel cell system, and the cost is high. The test device comprises an air compressor, a humidification tank, an air water separator, a tail exhaust valve, an expander to be tested and a controller; the output end of the air compressor is connected with the input end of the air water separator through the humidifying tank; the liquid output end of the air water separator is connected with the tail valve, and the gas output end of the air water separator is connected with the driving end of the air compressor through the expander to be tested; the output end of the controller is sequentially connected with the control ends of the air compressor and the humidification tank. The purpose of verifying the performance of the expander to be tested with various specifications and different performances by only one testing device is achieved.

title_en: Battery explosion venting structure with vacuumizing and liquid injection functions
abstract_en: The application discloses a battery explosion venting structure with vacuumizing and liquid injection functions, which comprises a shell and an explosion venting structure arranged in the shell, wherein the explosion venting structure comprises a valve clack used for sealing a first through hole of the shell, a first elastic piece arranged in a groove of the valve clack and used for limiting the movement of the valve clack, and an adjusting structure connected with the valve clack and used for adjusting the elasticity of the first elastic piece and the position of the valve clack; wherein the adjustment structure is connected with the housing. This application simple structure can be as an organic whole with the three function collection of evacuation, notes liquid, let out and explode, and a through-hole does benefit to the sealed of battery, can also repeat the repetitious usage.

title_en: Photovoltaic windproof device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a photovoltaic windproof device, which aims at solving the problems that the windproof structure of the existing photovoltaic device is not sensitive enough, the outdoor environment is complex, the windproof structure is easy to generate a blocking phenomenon after being not used for a long time, the structure is complex and the manufacturing cost is high.

title_en: New forms of energy electric automobile charging connecting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of new energy automobile charging, in particular to a charging connecting device for a new energy electric automobile. The utility model relates to a charging connecting device of a new energy electric automobile, which comprises an alternating current socket and an electronic lock assembly, wherein the alternating current socket comprises a joint and an installation panel arranged outside the joint; the two ends of the joint are respectively provided with an inlet end and a butt joint end, two positioning blocks are arranged outside the inlet end of the joint, a positioning groove is formed between the two positioning blocks, and a clamping groove is formed in the positioning blocks along the length direction; the electronic lock assembly includes a main housing and a lock shaft extending outside the main housing. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: this new forms of energy electric automobile charging connecting device can realize exchanging the rapid Assembly of socket and electronic lock subassembly, adopts the location arch to slide along the constant head tank and insert along the draw-in groove with the locking piece of buckle, and the lever arm can accomplish the fixed to whole electronic lock subassembly until locking piece and locating piece lock die along draw-in groove slip process.

title_en: Resistance-preventing type cable laying equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses anti-resistance type cable laying equipment, and particularly relates to the field of cable laying equipment. Compared with the prior art that the electric telescopic rod is directly connected with the movable rod through the welding part in a welding mode, the connecting mechanism is arranged, so that the device not only facilitates the adjustment of the gap between the two straightening wheels by personnel, but also facilitates the replacement of the straightening wheels by the operator, and the practicability of the device is obviously improved.

title_en: Lithium battery protection board with multistage protection mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lithium battery protection board with a multistage protection mechanism, which comprises an installation board, a protection unit and an adjusting unit, wherein the installation board is provided with a plurality of protection units; the mounting plate is provided with an adjusting unit through a protection unit; the protection unit contains fixed subassembly, fixed plate, dampproofing pad and heat conduction pad, dampproofing pad is installed to the upside of mounting panel, the fixed plate is installed on fixed subassembly, and the fixed plate adopts the heat sink material to constitute, the heat conduction pad has been inlayed to the bottom side of fixed plate. The dampproofing pad of mounting panel upside prevents that the lithium cell from weing, fixes the fixed plate on the mounting panel through fixed subassembly, fixes the lithium cell through the fixed plate, and the heat conduction pad prevents that the fixed plate from pressing from both sides the lithium cell of hindering, can dispel the heat to the lithium cell through heat conduction pad and fixed plate, prevents that it from leading to the life-span to shorten because of high temperature, fixed subassembly contains dead lever and screw, both ends are equipped with the dead lever about the fixed plate bottom side, and the fixity is good, and the function is many, and the practicality is high.

title_en: Intelligent GIS bus device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent GIS bus device, which comprises a shell, wherein a bus penetrates through the shell, first fixing plates are fixedly connected to two sides of the front side of the shell, a servo motor is fixedly connected to the first fixing plate on the left side, the output end of the servo motor is connected with a lead screw, the lead screw is rotatably connected with the first fixing plate, a first sliding plate is screwed on the lead screw, second fixing plates are fixedly connected to two sides of the rear side of the shell, a polished rod is fixedly connected between the two groups of second fixing plates, a second sliding plate is slidably connected to the polished rod, and a cleaning assembly is connected between the first sliding plate and the second sliding plate; drive the lead screw through servo motor and rotate, first slide along the lead screw motion, first slide drives clean subassembly motion, and clean subassembly drives the second slide and slides along the guide bar, and clean subassembly clears up the dust at shell top, and is effectual to the cleanness at shell top, can avoid influencing the inside heat dissipation of shell because of the dust.

title_en: Automatic material collecting device for grinding of magnetic materials of centerless machine tool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic receiving device for grinding of magnetic materials of a centerless machine tool, which comprises a casing, wherein a collecting box is fixedly connected to the side wall of the casing, a blanking groove is formed in the upper end of the casing, a collecting mechanism for collecting magnetic scraps is arranged on the casing, the collecting mechanism comprises a blanking casing fixedly connected to the inner top of the casing, a blanking pipe communicated with the interior of the blanking casing is arranged on the blanking casing, a blanking frame is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the collecting box, a plurality of strip magnets are fixedly connected to the upper end of the blanking frame, and one end, far away from the blanking casing, of the blanking pipe penetrates through the inner wall of the collecting box. The automatic water-magnetic dust collector is provided with the strip-shaped magnets, so that the automatic separation of water and magnetic dust can be completed, the collection of the subsequent magnetic dust is facilitated, the scraper is arranged, the automatic collection of the magnetic dust can be completed, the waste of resources is reduced, and in addition, the hot air blower is arranged, so that the magnetic dust is in a dry state, and the direct recycling of the magnetic dust is facilitated.

title_en: Shielding type large-current integrally-formed inductor
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of current inductors, and particularly relates to a shielding type large-current integrally-formed inductor which comprises an outer shell, wherein an inductor body is installed at the bottom of the inner side of the outer shell, a conductive elastomer lining protection frame fixedly connected to the inner part of the outer shell is arranged on the outer side of the inductor body, an electromagnetic strip for shielding the inductor is also fixedly connected to the inner wall of the outer shell, a cover plate is in threaded connection with the top of the outer shell, and a heat dissipation fan for cooling the electromagnetic strip and the inductor body is installed in the center of the cover plate. According to the utility model, the protection assembly is arranged on the outer side of the radiating fan, so that dustproof and moistureproof treatment can be realized, the protection assembly is simple and convenient to assemble and disassemble, and the filter element is convenient to replace.

title_en: Metal battery shell and battery
abstract_en: The utility model provides a metal battery shell and a battery, which comprise a first shell, a second shell and a reinforcing plate, wherein the first shell comprises a top cover and a middle shell, the middle shell is a cylinder which extends from a first end to a second end in a straight line and is provided with openings at two ends, the top cover is connected with the first end of the middle shell to seal the opening at the first end, the second shell is used for sealing the opening at the second end of the middle shell, and the reinforcing plate is connected with the middle shell and the second shell.

title_en: Battery and battery pack
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of batteries and provides a battery and a battery pack. The battery includes: the battery comprises a battery cell, wherein the battery cell comprises a battery cell main body and a lug, the lug extends out of the battery cell main body, and the lug comprises at least two single-sheet lugs; the pressure welding piece is positioned on one side of the lug so as to compress at least two single lugs into the lug; wherein, the pressure welding piece is welded with the compressed tab thereof. Each single lug that will form utmost point ear compresses tightly through the pressure weldment to make the pressure weldment and the utmost point ear welding that compresses tightly, thereby avoid appearing the rosin joint problem between the single lug, with this connection stability who improves pressure weldment and utmost point ear, thereby improve the performance of battery.

title_en: Strawberry is planted with driping irrigation device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a drip irrigation device for strawberry planting. The drip irrigation device for strawberry planting comprises a drip irrigation device body for strawberry planting, the drip irrigation device body for strawberry planting comprises a water supply device, a water pump, a bent pipe, a water diversion pipe and a plurality of drip irrigation pipes, the water pump is arranged on one side of the water supply device, the water inlet end of the water pump is communicated with the water supply device, the bent pipe is fixedly installed at the water outlet end of the water pump, the water diversion pipe is fixedly installed at the water outlet end of the bent pipe, and the drip irrigation pipes are all fixedly installed on the water diversion pipe; the mounting bracket is fixedly mounted on the water supply device. The drip irrigation device for strawberry planting provided by the utility model has the advantages that rainwater can be filtered to supplement water, external water is saved, solar energy can be converted into electric energy to supply power to equipment, and the power consumption expense of the equipment is reduced.

title_en: Lamp resetting structure and lamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lamp resetting structure and a lamp, the lamp resetting structure comprises a first optical coupling component, a shielding piece and a controller which is in communication connection with the first optical coupling component and a lamp driving motor, the first optical coupler assembly comprises a first signal receiving end and a first signal transmitting end, a first gap is formed between the first signal transmitting end and the first signal receiving end, the shielding piece comprises a mounting part and a shielding ring, the mounting part is fixed on the rotating end of the lamp and is arranged concentrically with the rotating center of the rotating end of the lamp, so as to be suitable for rotating along with the lamp, the shielding ring is arranged at the outer edge of the mounting part, and part of the shielding ring is arranged in the first gap, the shielding ring is suitable for rotating along with the installation part, the shielding ring is an arc-shaped plate, and the lamp resetting structure can avoid repeated impact on the limiting mechanism when the lamp is reset.

title_en: Municipal administration is light for environmental protection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a municipal environment-friendly illuminating lamp, and relates to the technical field of illuminating lamps. This light for municipal administration environmental protection, including the installation base, fixed surface installs first support column on the installation base, slidable mounting has the second support column on the inner wall of first support column, second support column lateral wall fixed mounting has first bracing piece, fixedly connected with lighting apparatus on the lateral wall of first bracing piece, the inside adjustment mechanism that is provided with of first support column, second support column inner wall fixed mounting has the screw thread slider, the mechanism is relieved to inside being provided with of first support column. This light for municipal administration environmental protection when using, through the antiport runner, the cooperation worm wheel drives the hob and rotates, makes the screw thread slider drive the second support column along first support column inner wall downstream in vertical direction, makes the staff need not high altitude construction and can maintain lighting apparatus, has reduced the risk of maintenance.

title_en: High-efficient magnet subassembly UV solidification equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-efficiency magnet assembly UV curing device, and belongs to the field of magnet assembly curing. A high-efficiency magnet assembly UV curing device comprises LED linear UV light sources, wherein lenses are fixedly connected to the front ends of the LED linear UV light sources, the number of the LED linear UV light sources and the number of the lenses are two, the LED linear UV light sources and the lenses are distributed on two sides of a magnet assembly in a V shape, iron sheets are covered on the magnet assembly, and the width of each iron sheet is smaller than that of the magnet assembly; according to the utility model, the lens is designed at the front end of the LED linear UV light source, UV light is effectively converged at the glue gap, the LED linear UV light sources are arranged at two side sides of the magnet assembly according to the V shape, the LED linear UV light source is adopted, a light band with high power density can be generated after the lens is used, the curing of the UV glue at the glue gap can be achieved within a few seconds, and the curing time is shortened and the efficiency is improved due to the rapid curing of the UV glue at the glue gap.

title_en: Cotton yarn electric wire scalding and stripping mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a cotton yarn electric wire hot-stripping mechanism which comprises a rack, wherein a fixed plate, a movable plate and a lifting driving unit are arranged on the rack, the movable plate is arranged above the fixed plate, the lifting driving unit is used for controlling the movable plate to move up and down relative to the fixed plate, an accommodating groove used for accommodating a cotton yarn electric wire is formed in the upper surface of the fixed plate, a transverse downward cutter used for cutting off a cotton yarn layer along the radial direction of the cotton yarn electric wire is arranged at one end of the accommodating groove, a transverse downward cutter corresponding to the transverse downward cutter is arranged on the movable plate, a longitudinal cutter used for cutting off the cotton yarn layer along the axial direction of the cotton yarn electric wire is arranged on the lower surface of the movable plate, and a heating system used for heating the transverse downward cutter, the transverse downward cutter and the longitudinal cutter and the yarn cutter is arranged on the rack. The utility model adopts a semi-automatic mode to cut off the cotton yarn layer, can improve the production efficiency, reduce the production cost of enterprises, has better product consistency and also has the functions of temperature regulation and cutting length regulation.

title_en: Structure of recessed lamp
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a structure of an embedded lamp, which mainly comprises a light-transmitting cover body, a light guide part formed by integrally forming and extending the inner side of the light-transmitting cover body, a plurality of arc guide parts formed by integrally forming and continuously surrounding the inner side of the light guide part, a shielding part formed by integrally forming and surrounding the outer side of the light guide part, a plurality of positioning columns formed by integrally forming and extending one side of the shielding part, an isolation space formed between the light-transmitting cover body and the shielding part, a light-emitting plate arranged on one side of the light guide part, which is far away from the light-transmitting cover body, and a plurality of light-emitting elements arranged on the light-emitting plate, wherein the positions of light-emitting centers of the light-emitting elements are respectively opposite to the arc guide parts. By means of the structure, the light source of the light-emitting element is uniformly and softly dispersed to the surface of the light-transmitting cover body by the light guide part and the arc guide part, and the visual line of the direct-viewing positioning column is isolated by the isolation space, so that the appearance and the aesthetic feeling of the illumination effect are improved.

title_en: Multidirectional key structure and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multidirectional key structure and electronic equipment, wherein the multidirectional key structure comprises a key base, a key push rod and a key cap, wherein one end of the key push rod is connected with the key base, and an anti-falling block is further arranged on the key push rod. The key cap is sleeved on the key push rod, and an anti-falling groove matched with the anti-falling block is formed in the key cap. According to the embodiment of the utility model, the anti-drop block and the anti-drop groove are matched with each other, so that the bonding strength between the keycap and the key push rod is improved, the keycap can be prevented from dropping or losing even if the keycap is subjected to fatigue damage after being used for multiple times, and the service life of the multidirectional key structure is prolonged. The utility model also provides electronic equipment applying the multidirectional key structure, so that the service life of the keys in the electronic equipment is prolonged.

title_en: Grounding wire hook
abstract_en: The utility model provides a grounding wire hook. The earth connection couple includes: a hook body; the locking assembly is arranged on the hook body and comprises a first clamping part and a second clamping part; the operation structure is connected with the first clamping part; the locking assembly is provided with a locking state of a first clamping part and a hook body limiting stop and an initial state of separation of the first clamping part and the hook body, and the operation structure is used for driving the first clamping part to move relative to the hook body so as to enable the locking assembly to be switched between the locking state and the initial state; when the locking assembly is in a locking state, the first clamping portion, the second clamping portion and at least part of the hook body surround to form a locking space for installing a lead. The utility model effectively solves the problem that the ground wire hook in the prior art is easy to fall off after hanging the lead.

title_en: Plaque structure for mounting vehicle camera shooting element
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a trim structure for mounting a vehicle camera element, which comprises a trim main body, a trim cover and a trim cover, wherein the trim main body is connected with a target vehicle body part so as to form a shelter for a mounting hole formed on the target vehicle body part; the plaque main body is provided with a light-transmitting light path area; the conductive light-transmitting coating layer is connected with the light path area and used for generating heat so as to eliminate water quality dirt formed on the surface of the light path area under the action of the heat. The application provides a plaque structure is used in installation of vehicle camera element, the plaque main part can form the protection to camera element. The heat that provides through electrically conductive printing opacity coating film layer can effectual elimination printing opacity regional surface's quality of water filth for the light path region can obtain good light transmissivity, guarantees the definition of the environmental image information that camera element gathered, and then makes vehicle driving auxiliary system can normally work, improves vehicle driving security, is worth using widely by a large scale.

title_en: Flow measuring station room
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flow measuring station house which comprises a wall body and a roof, wherein a door opening is formed in the wall body, a rolling door is arranged on the door opening and consists of a door curtain and a rotating shaft, an opening and closing motor is electrically connected to the rotating shaft, and an opening and closing control device is electrically connected to the opening and closing motor. The main body of the current measuring station room comprises a wall body and a roof, wherein a door opening is formed in the wall body, and a rolling door and an opening and closing controller for controlling the rolling door are installed on the door opening, so that the rolling door can be remotely controlled to be opened and closed, and the current measuring trolley is safely guaranteed. Meanwhile, a second charging device is further arranged in the current measuring station room, so that the electric energy supplement of the current measuring trolley can be realized.

title_en: Cable with charging interface
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cable with a charging interface, and relates to the technical field of notebook computer accessories. The cable with the charging interface comprises a shell, a magnet, a terminal assembly and a connecting wire. The shell is provided with a first accommodating groove and a second accommodating groove, the side wall of the first accommodating groove is provided with a first elastic part, and the bottom of the first accommodating groove is provided with a second elastic part; the side wall of the magnet is provided with a limiting groove, the magnet is arranged in the first accommodating groove, the first elastic part extends into the limiting groove, and the second elastic part is elastically abutted against the magnet; the terminal assembly comprises an insulating body and a plurality of conductive terminals, the insulating body is provided with an inserting groove, the conductive terminals are arranged in the inserting groove, and the insulating body is arranged in the second accommodating groove; the connecting wire is electrically connected with the conductive terminal. This cable can utilize second elastic component elasticity butt magnet in order to promote magnet, makes the cell wall butt of the spacing groove of first elastic component and magnet, prevents that magnet from appearing the abnormal sound because of not hard up.

title_en: Wire harness cutting tool
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wire harness cutting tool which comprises a base, wherein an arc groove for accommodating a wire harness is formed in the upper end surface of the base, a first support is arranged in parallel with the arc groove, a first air cylinder is arranged on the first support, a rod-shaped pressing block is fixedly connected to a piston rod of the first air cylinder, and the pressing block is pressed on the wire harness; a second support is arranged perpendicular to the arc groove, a second air cylinder is arranged on the second support, a piston rod of the second air cylinder is fixedly connected with a cutter holder, and a cutter is arranged on the cutter holder; a cutting line part is arranged below the cutter, the upper end face of the cutting line part is equal to the bottom of the arc groove in height, and the cutter cuts the wire harness along the radial direction of the wire harness. According to the wire harness cutting tool, the two cylinders are connected in parallel, the time relay is additionally arranged in the middle, so that the objects to be cut are pressed and cut firstly, the objects to be cut can be fixed, the stability of cutting is guaranteed, and the cut is smooth.

title_en: Connector and terminal structure thereof
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a connector and a terminal structure thereof, which comprises a base body, a plurality of tuning fork terminals and two positioning terminals, wherein the base body is provided with a positioning seat and a butt joint seat movably arranged in the central positioning space of the positioning seat, a plurality of terminal grooves are arranged at the butt joint space, a limiting slide block is convexly arranged at the two outer sides of the butt joint space, a plurality of fixing grooves are arranged at the positioning seat in a penetrating way at the positioning space, limiting grooves for movably arranging the two limiting slide blocks are arranged at the two sides of the positioning space, positioning parts are arranged at the outer sides of the two limiting grooves, a cover body of the positioning terminal sealed at the upper openings of the two limiting grooves is fixedly arranged above the positioning parts, welding ends extending downwards to the bottom of the positioning seat are arranged at the two sides of the cover body, a first contact section of a butt joint part in the plurality of tuning fork terminals is positioned in the plurality of terminal grooves of the butt joint seat, a fixing part is fixed in the fixing grooves and used for solving tolerance and slight deviation when the connector is butted, and can have a reliable electrical connection state.

title_en: Intelligent instrument with voice broadcast function for farming
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent instrument with a voice broadcasting function for agricultural planting, which comprises a shell and voice broadcasters, wherein a solar panel is installed at the upper end of the shell, a display screen is installed on the front end face of the shell, the voice broadcasters are arranged on two sides of a controller, a meteorological sensor is arranged on the upper right side of each voice broadcaster, a temperature and humidity sensor is arranged on the upper left side of the shell, and a rotating shaft is installed on the outer side of a rotating plate. Be provided with the weather inductor that can respond to the plantation weather, utilize weather inductor to catch weather on every side, the real-time supervision plantation environment, and be provided with the voice broadcast ware, when rainy weather, can utilize the voice broadcast ware to inform the peasant household of working in advance to when rainy season, dry season come, also can inform the peasant household in advance to notice the plant condition, remind the peasant household to make the counter measure, protect plant species safety, protection peasant household property.

title_en: Wiring device of intelligent terminal and intelligent terminal
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wiring device of an intelligent terminal and the intelligent terminal, comprising a box body, wherein the box body comprises a mounting plate and a protective cover connected with the mounting plate; be provided with pencil changeover plug, terminal row and miniature circuit breaker in the box, pencil changeover plug, terminal row and miniature circuit breaker install in on the mounting panel.

title_en: Anticollision subassembly and power plug
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-collision assembly and a power plug, and relates to the technical field of power plugs, which comprise a plug body and a protective sleeve body, wherein embedded grooves are formed in the upper side and the lower side of the plug body, a plurality of symmetrically distributed accommodating grooves are formed in the side surface of the plug body, clamping pieces are arranged inside the accommodating grooves, the protective sleeve body comprises a plurality of connected side wall plates, a protective area is formed by the side edges of the plurality of side wall plates, a plurality of symmetrically distributed clamping grooves are formed in the side surfaces of the plurality of side wall plates, and a cover plate connected with the side edges of the plurality of side wall plates is arranged on one side of the protective area. The protective sleeve body is clamped with the plug body through the embedded grooves, the embedded grooves are formed in the two sides of the plug body, and when the protective sleeve body is not used, the protective sleeve body is clamped on the outer side of the metal contact of the plug body, so that the protective sleeve body is protected, and the problem that the protective sleeve body is damaged under the impact of external force is solved.

title_en: External excimer lamp of high pressure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-voltage external excimer lamp which comprises an outer tube, an inner tube, a low-voltage electrode, a high-voltage electrode and an isolation cover, wherein the inner tube is inserted into the outer tube and extends along the tube axis direction of the outer tube, discharge gas is sealed in a sealed cavity formed by the inner side of the outer tube and the outer side of the inner tube, the high-voltage electrode is arranged on the periphery of the outer tube, the isolation cover is arranged on the outer side of the high-voltage electrode, and the low-voltage electrode is arranged on the inner periphery of the inner tube in a covering mode and surrounds an irradiation working area. The high-voltage electrode has the advantages of simple structure and low cost, can effectively prevent creepage between the high-voltage electrode and the implant and between the high-voltage electrode and the outside, and is safe and reliable.

title_en: High-performance low-inductance coaxial cable
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-performance low-inductance coaxial cable which comprises an outer protection layer, wherein a through hole is formed in the outer protection layer, a reinforcing rod is fixedly connected to the inside of the through hole, and a spring is fixedly sleeved on the outer surface of the reinforcing rod. This high performance low-inductance coaxial cable, through the antistatic layer, the shielding layer, the setting of cavity and anti-interference ring, the antistatic layer can effectually prevent that outside static from influencing the electric field between cable core and shielding layer, guarantee the transmission performance of cable, the shielding layer can effectually reduce the influence of electromagnetic field to the cable, the phenomenon of diffusion also can prevent the radiation that produces from appearing simultaneously, the cavity can play the effect of buffering resilience, avoid hard extrusion, improve the crushing resistance of whole cable, the anti-interference ring is provided with a plurality ofly, all fix the inside at the cavity, the interval sets up, reduce the inductance of cable, improve the withstand voltage performance of cable, reduce the material when guaranteeing the interference killing feature, save the cost.

title_en: Winding resistor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a winding resistor, which is characterized in that a wrapping cavity is formed in the winding resistor, and moisture-proof filler is filled in the wrapping cavity, so that the waterproof and moisture-proof performance of the winding resistor is improved; meanwhile, the bottom of the winding resistor is provided with the ring feet to form a groove, and the groove is filled with heat-conducting silicone grease, so that the winding resistor has an excellent heat dissipation effect on the substrate.

title_en: Side-in large-size backlight lamp bead
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a side-in large-size backlight lamp bead, which comprises a lamp holder, a lamp shade, an LED lamp bead, a heat dissipation fixing seat and a heat dissipation module, wherein the lamp shade is arranged outside the lamp holder, a first support and a second support are arranged in the lamp holder, a bearing groove is formed in the top of the first support, the heat dissipation fixing seat is arranged on the bearing groove, the LED lamp bead is arranged in the heat dissipation fixing seat, one side of the heat dissipation module is connected with the heat dissipation fixing seat, the other side of the heat dissipation module extends downwards to penetrate through the outer bottom of the lamp holder, a first pin is arranged outside the bottom of the lamp holder on the first support, a second pin is arranged outside the bottom of the lamp holder on the second support, and the heat dissipation module comprises heat dissipation silver columns symmetrically arranged on two sides of the heat dissipation fixing seat. The utility model belongs to the technical field of lamp beads, and particularly provides a side-in large-size backlight lamp bead which utilizes heat conduction and heat transfer performance to take heat generated by lamp bead operation out of a lampshade, reduces internal heat and has good insulating and heat dissipation performance.

title_en: Energy-saving incandescent lamp
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of incandescent lamps, in particular to an energy-saving incandescent lamp. The energy-saving incandescent lamp comprises a lamp cap, a bulb body and a light-emitting part; the lamp holder is fixedly connected with the bulb body; a first hole site is formed in the outer wall of the lamp holder, and a metal terminal is arranged in the first hole site; the top of the lamp holder is provided with a conductive cap and a second hole site, the conductive cap comprises a conductive part and a connecting part which are integrally formed, the connecting part is arranged in the second hole site, and the conductive part is arranged outside the lamp holder; the light emitting part is arranged in the bulb body and comprises a stem mounted on the lamp holder, a support mounted on the stem, a halogen lamp mounted on the support and two inner leads; one ends of the two inner leads are respectively connected with the conductive cap and the metal terminal, and the other ends of the two inner leads extend into the core column along the inner part of the core column and are electrically connected with the halogen lamp. The utility model solves the problems of high energy consumption and unstable use of the existing incandescent lamp.

title_en: Split type up-down luminous linear lamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a split type up-down luminous linear lamp, which comprises a lamp shell, an upper light source component and a lower light source component, wherein the lamp shell is arranged in a front-back extending manner; the upper light source component is arranged in the upper light trough; the lower light source component is arranged on the lower lamp trough. The upper light source assembly and the lower light source assembly are used simultaneously, namely, direct illumination and indirect illumination are carried out simultaneously, the contrast between the ambient brightness and the brightness of a working area is reduced, and the upper light source assembly and the lower light source assembly can be independently used to meet different illumination requirements.

title_en: Electromagnetic relay
