abstract_en: The present invention provides an electromagnetic relay, including: a substrate; the lower part of the shell in the vertical direction is a rectangular opening, the shell is provided with a side wall surrounding the opening, and the shell is embedded with the base body; an interior space; a contact portion including a fixed contact and a movable contact; an electromagnetic drive unit that brings the movable contact into and out of contact with the fixed contact; and an adhesive portion and a non-adhesive portion, wherein an adhesive layer formed using an adhesive material is formed in the adhesive portion, the adhesive layer is not formed in the non-adhesive portion, the adhesive portion is formed in a part of the lower end of the case, the case and the base are fixed together by the adhesive material, and the non-adhesive portion is formed in a part of the lower end of the case other than the adhesive portion and a region of the base overlapping the part of the case. According to the present invention, it is possible to provide an electromagnetic relay capable of reliably preventing the housing from coming off the base body.

title_en: Precision cutting die for battery pole piece
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a die, in particular to a precision cutting die for a battery pole piece. The die is characterized by comprising a lower die base and an upper die base, wherein the lower die base and the upper die base are arranged in parallel. The upper surface of the lower die base is provided with a lower die plate, and the lower die plate is provided with a groove matched with the shape of the battery pole piece. The module is arranged in one end of the groove, virtual contact is formed between the module and two side walls and one end face of the groove, the reset spring is arranged between the bottom of the module and the bottom of the groove, the reset spring is in a state of not receiving external force, and the top of the module extends out of the opening of the groove. An upper template is fixed on the lower surface of the upper die base above the lower template, a cutting block is fixed on the lower surface of the upper template above the groove, and the shape of the cutting block is matched with that of the groove. The efficiency of processing the battery pole piece by adopting the die is higher, and the size precision is higher.

title_en: Low-voltage switchgear that radiating effect is good
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of low-voltage switch cabinets, in particular to a low-voltage switch cabinet with a good heat dissipation effect, which comprises a switch cabinet, wherein heat dissipation frames are respectively arranged at two sides of the switch cabinet, a heat dissipation plate is rotatably connected in the heat dissipation frames, a pushing groove is formed in the heat dissipation plate, a pushing rod is slidably connected in the heat dissipation frames and is positioned at one side of a hinged joint of the heat dissipation plate and the heat dissipation frames, a pushing post inserted in the pushing groove is fixedly connected to the pushing rod, a driving device is detachably connected to one side of the pushing rod, a limiting groove is formed in the switch cabinet, a limiting rod inserted in the limiting groove is slidably connected to the heat dissipation frames, an inclined groove with the upper end inclined towards the direction of the switch cabinet is formed in the limiting rod, a sliding rod is slidably connected to the heat dissipation frames through springs, and a pushing block inserted in the inclined groove is arranged on the sliding rod. The problem that the existing heat dissipation device is inconvenient to disassemble and clean is effectively solved; according to the utility model, a worker only needs to push the auxiliary plate inwards to take the heat dissipation frame down from the switch cabinet for cleaning.

title_en: Light storage and charging integrated device with self-cleaning function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a light storage and charging integrated device with a self-cleaning function, which comprises photovoltaic panels, a charging pile and a storage battery, wherein the photovoltaic panels are obliquely arranged, the lower ends of the two photovoltaic panels are fixedly connected with a collecting tank, one side of each photovoltaic panel is provided with a cleaning pipe for spraying water opposite to the photovoltaic panel, one end of the collecting tank is connected with a water storage tank, the water storage tank is connected with a water pump, and the water pump is connected with the cleaning pipe and the storage battery. The rainwater can flow into the collecting tank when falling on the photovoltaic panel, then enters the water storage tank through the collecting pipe to realize the collection of the rainwater, and the collected water is flushed to the surface of the photovoltaic panel through the cleaning pipe by starting the water pump in the water storage tank, so that the surface of the photovoltaic panel can be cleaned, and meanwhile, the rainwater can be recycled.

title_en: Nonstandard communication connector
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a communication joint field discloses a non-standard communication connector, including standard male joint and non-standard female joint, standard male joint and non-standard female joint communication link to each other. The communication connector of the utility model is composed of a standard male connector and a non-standard female connector, and can realize the connection conversion between the non-standard connector and the standard connector in special occasions, thereby improving the practicability of the connector; and secondly, the sizes of the net mouths of the non-standard female connector and the standard male connector are different, and a common net mouth male head (a crystal head) can not be inserted, so that the non-standard female connector and the standard male connector have the functions of identification and misplug prevention.

title_en: Screening device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a screening device. The screening device comprises a feeding assembly for providing the granular materials; the first static eliminating part is used for eliminating static on the granular materials; the screening assembly is used for screening broken granular materials and complete granular materials; first receipts feed bin subassembly and second receipts feed bin subassembly. Through setting up first static elimination spare in the feed subassembly, eliminate the static between the granule material, solved the problem that can't separate easily because of static gathers each other in the automatic screening process, and then realize the thorough separation of granule material.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant multi-core coaxial cable
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cables and discloses a high-temperature-resistant multi-core coaxial cable which comprises a cable outer sheath, wherein a cable inner sheath is arranged inside the cable outer sheath, a cable core is arranged on the inner side of the cable inner sheath, the cable outer sheath is coated with a rubber layer, an anti-corrosion layer, a first heat insulation layer, a wear-resistant layer, a waterproof layer, an impermeable layer, a flame-retardant layer and an insulating layer, and the anti-corrosion layer is arranged on the outer side of the rubber layer. According to the cable core, the first heat insulation layer is formed by uniformly coating the glass coating, the glass coating can effectively isolate solar heat radiation heat so as to block partial heat invading from the outside, and a plurality of heat insulation barriers can be formed on the outside by matching the flame retardant layer, the second heat insulation layer, the heat resistant layer and the fireproof layer, so that the heat invasion onto the cable core is avoided, the flame retardant and high temperature resistant effects of the cable are improved, and the cable core can be prevented from being overheated and spontaneously combusted.

title_en: Solar gateway with position switch
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a solar gateway with a position switch, and belongs to the technical field of power internet of things. The solar energy water heater comprises a solar panel, a basic control unit, a position switch and the like; the antenna unit consists of a local built-in antenna and a surface-mounted uplink antenna; the basic control unit arranged on the upper part of the back surface of the solar panel comprises an uplink module, a logic unit and a downlink module, the downlink module of the basic control unit is connected with a local built-in antenna, the right side of the basic control unit is provided with a position switch, the energy storage battery pack is arranged below the basic control unit, and the surface-mounted uplink antenna arranged on the left side of the front surface of the solar panel is connected with the basic control unit through a surface-mounted uplink antenna connecting wire; the first contact of the position switch is connected with the anode of the energy storage battery pack, the second contact of the position switch is connected with one end of the basic control unit, and the other end of the basic control unit is connected with the cathode of the energy storage battery pack. The antenna is convenient to install, the on-off of the switch is reliable, the protection performance is strong, the antenna is suitable for being used in the field and in a humid environment for a long time, and the continuous normal operation of the gateway is guaranteed.

title_en: Make things convenient for circuit breaker casing of lead wire
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a circuit breaker shell convenient for leading, which comprises a shell, wherein a lead hole is formed in the front side of the shell, slide rails are symmetrically arranged on the inner side of the shell up and down by taking the lead hole as a symmetry axis, adaptive slide blocks are arranged on the two slide rails, a slide plate is fixedly connected between the two slide blocks, a clamping plate is fixedly connected onto the side wall of the slide plate, a limiting plate is fixedly connected onto one side of the slide plate, which is far away from the clamping plate, a push plate is fixedly connected onto one side of the limiting plate, and an assembling end of a positioning pin penetrates through a through hole to be in threaded connection with the limiting hole. According to the utility model, the push plate is manually pushed, so that the push plate pushes the sliding plate through the limiting plate, the sliding plate drives the clamping plate to synchronously move transversely, the wire body is fixed between the clamping plate and the inner wall of the wire hole, the wire body is prevented from falling off due to left-right swinging, the assembling end of the positioning pin penetrates through the through hole and is in threaded connection with the limiting hole, and thus the limiting plate can be quickly fixed at a proper position, and the clamping plate is prevented from moving.

title_en: Solar algae removal device for water surface

And the support frame is welded firmly by adopting steel, can bear great impact force, is not easy to distort, ensures the reliable connection inside the side outgoing line copper bar, and is convenient for direct lap joint with the low-voltage cabinet busbar after in-situ placement.

title_en: Air-compression type load switch
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pneumatic load switch, which belongs to the technical field of high-voltage switch equipment, and comprises an upper insulating shell and a lower insulating shell, wherein the upper insulating shell and the lower insulating shell are relatively sealed and assembled to form an insulating chamber, the insulating chamber is divided into an arc extinguish chamber, a moving contact piston chamber and a moving contact motion chamber from top to bottom, the top of the arc extinguish chamber is provided with a static joint, the moving contact motion chamber is internally provided with a moving joint, the top of the moving joint is arranged in the moving contact piston chamber in a penetrating way and is sleeved with a piston, and the bottom of the moving joint is provided with a tower spring component; a plurality of air injection holes are formed in the piston at equal intervals in an annular shape, so that air in the moving chamber of the compression moving contact is sprayed out from the plurality of air injection holes when the piston descends; a unidirectional air inlet channel is formed in the air injection hole through a plurality of passive bulges. The utility model discloses a cup joint the improved generation piston on the movable joint, utilize a plurality of fumaroles that have one-way admission on the piston to improve circulation of air speed, realize the extrusion to the air, improve the air impulse, be favorable to strengthening arc extinguishing efficiency.

title_en: Safe interaction device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safe mutual device, connect including shell, storage main part and interaction, a serial communication port, the whole cylinder that is of storage main part, the whole slip of storage main part peg graft in the inside of shell, the shell tail end is provided with revolves the cap, revolve the central fixedly connected with regulation double-screw bolt of the inboard one end of cap, adjust the double-screw bolt whole peg graft in the inside of shell, the center of storage main part tail end is provided with the regulation screw, adjust double-screw bolt front end screw butt joint in adjust the inside of screw, shell front end outside edge installs the protection dish. The utility model provides a pair of when safe mutual device uses, the cap soon of rotating tail end drives the adjusting screw bolt and rotates, and then just can provide good side direction holding power with the inside of the mutual ejecting shell of joint before the storage main part, the protection dish of shell front end in the data interaction process under the condition that meets and collide with, has avoided the mutual damage that connects, and is more durable and practical.

title_en: Power generation aluminum veneer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of aluminum veneers, and discloses a power generation aluminum veneer, which comprises an aluminum plate; a photovoltaic panel disposed on one side of the aluminum panel; the cell panel is arranged on one side of the aluminum plate opposite to the photovoltaic plate; the photovoltaic panel is connected with the battery panel through a wire; an upper heat dissipation layer disposed between the aluminum plate and the photovoltaic plate; and a lower heat dissipation layer disposed between the aluminum plate and the battery panel. The utility model discloses in, photovoltaic board turns into the direct current with solar energy, and pass through the wire with this direct current and defeated to the panel in, defeated storage in the copper indium gallium selenide thin-film solar cell promptly, thereby when making aluminum plate as the curtain, can realize photovoltaic power generation's function, the last heat dissipation layer that sets up between aluminum plate and photovoltaic board, and the lower heat dissipation layer that sets up between aluminum plate and panel, can dredge the heat, give off, and reduce thermal piling up, thereby make aluminum plate as the curtain, and when carrying out photovoltaic power generation, the security is better.

title_en: Art ceramic lamp
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a technology pottery lamp, including lamp body, printing opacity nail and light-emitting component, the lamp body is the casing, and the casing of lamp body comprises ceramic material, the lamp body still includes cavity and light trap, the cavity is the space in the lamp body, the light trap is for running through the perforation in the lamp body internal and external surface, the printing opacity nail part be located in the light trap and with the light trap block, the printing opacity nail comprises for the transparent material of conducted light, the light-emitting component part is located the cavity and is connected with cavity bottom dismantlement formula, adopts unified light source, cavity leaded light to combine the mode that the printing opacity nail carries out the light filtering astigmatism to give out light, thereby realizes the effect of easy change through the detachable mode combination with light-emitting component after light-emitting component damages.

title_en: Insert formula test jumper board soon suitable for many liquid crystal display
abstract_en: The utility model provides a formula test jumper board inserts soon suitable for many liquid crystal display, include: the printed circuit board is provided with at least one flip-type connector, and the output end of the flip-type connector is connected with the liquid crystal display screen; the first pin header connector is arranged on the printed circuit board, and the output end of the first pin header connector is connected with the input end of the flip-type connector; the control platform connector is arranged on the printed circuit board, and the input end of the control platform connector is connected with the control platform; the first row of pin female seats are arranged on the printed circuit board, and the input ends of the first row of pin female seats are connected with the output end of the control platform connector; the second row of pin female seats are arranged on the printed circuit board, and the input ends of the second row of pin female seats are respectively connected with the output ends of the first row of pin female seats; and one end of each single PIN connecting line is respectively inserted into the corresponding second row PIN female seat, and the other end of each single PIN connecting line is inserted into the first row PIN connector. Beneficial effect is that the utility model discloses can be applicable to multiple liquid crystal display's different interface demands.

title_en: Wireless mouse charging base
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wireless mouse charging base, which comprises a charging structure and a supporting structure, wherein the charging structure comprises a charging contact, a circuit board and a TYPE-C interface, the charging contact is fixed above the supporting structure, the supporting structure comprises an upper panel, a shell main body and a light-passing plate, and the device is separated from the constraint of wires and can be taken and used immediately; the metal shell and the engineering inclination angle of 30 degrees are adopted on the device, so that the device is attractive and elegant and is convenient to serve as a desktop ornament; the device is provided with the USB interface, so that the USB receiver can be placed, and the signal interference of the outside to the wireless mouse is reduced; the device adopts the magnetic material as the core material, so that better use experience is brought, and the device cannot fall off; the anti-skidding foot pads are arranged on the device, so that the device can be more stably fixed on a desktop.

title_en: Pipeline connection protection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pipeline connection protection device in pipeline connecting device field, locate the sealed cowling in the pipeline outside including the pipeline and can dismantle the cover, the fixed cover in position that the pipeline is close to the link is equipped with the installation cover, the outside end fixed connection of sealed cowling has the adapter sleeve, the lateral surface of adapter sleeve is provided with the bayonet lock of connecting in the installation cover, and the butt joint face of the sealed cowling of adjacent setting all runs through and is provided with the opening, the sealed cowling has set gradually armor, insulating layer, buffer layer from outer to interior. The utility model discloses a sealed cowling that sets up two sets of butt joints in near the outside position of two sets of pipeline links seals the protection, and armor, insulating layer and the buffer layer in the cooperation sealed cowling outside can play effectual buffering protection and anticreep insulating effect, and holistic structure sets up simply rationally to have obvious practical function and promote, be worth using widely in current field.

title_en: Battery reverse connection prevention protection circuit and UPS power supply
abstract_en: The utility model provides a battery prevents reverse connection protection circuit and UPS power, the battery prevents reverse connection protection circuit includes first voltage stabilizing unit, partial pressure unit, the control unit, relay, controlled unit and benchmark unit, wherein, the first end of first voltage stabilizing unit is connected with battery positive input end, the second end with controlled unit's first end is connected, the third end with UPS power negative pole input end is connected; the one end of relay is connected with UPS power supply positive input end, the other end with battery positive input end connects, the second end of controlled unit with the relay is connected, the third end with the control unit connects, the control unit still with battery negative input end connects, the relay with the control unit connects, the reference unit with the control unit connects, the one end of partial pressure unit with the relay is connected, the other end with the control unit connects, with the disconnection the battery with be connected between the UPS power. Through the mode, the cost can be reduced.

title_en: Suspension type natural gas power generation device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of natural gas power generation devices and discloses a suspension type natural gas power generation device which comprises a base and four struts, wherein a second storage battery is fixedly arranged on one side in the base, a water pump is fixedly arranged on one side, far away from the second storage battery, in the base, an air cushion is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the base, inflator barrels are fixedly arranged at the front end and the rear end of the base, an air cooling mechanism is fixedly arranged on one side of the upper end of the base, the air cooling mechanism comprises an air cooling frame, a natural gas internal combustion engine is fixedly arranged in the middle of the upper end of the base, and a transmission mechanism is fixedly arranged on one side, far away from the air cooling mechanism, of the natural gas internal combustion engine. According to the utility model, the device is arranged on the bank beside the river, so that the water pump can conveniently pump water into the water cooling pipe and then flow back to the river, heat generated by the transmission mechanism during working can be effectively taken away, the heat dissipation efficiency is greatly improved, and damage caused by overhigh temperature is avoided.

title_en: Ladle-shaped hollow conductive foam automatic wrapping jig convenient for adjusting coverage area of pressing plate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a ladle-shaped hollow conductive foam automatic wrapping jig convenient for adjusting the coverage area of a pressing plate, which is arranged on a production line of a circular cutter die-cutting machine and is applied to conductive cloth with two flanging edges inside. The entrance of the shaping groove is provided with a turnover guide opening with the section width gradually reduced along the advancing direction of the conductive cloth at two sides of the shaping groove. The utility model can automatically wrap the original material strip-shaped conductive cloth to form a wrapped state with a cylindrical surface, and has high production efficiency and high yield.

title_en: Moistureproof fireproof cable
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a moistureproof fireproof cable, which comprises a plurality of cable cores and protective sleeves; the protective sleeve is coated outside the cable core; the protective sleeve comprises two layers, namely a protective sleeve layer arranged on the outer layer and a fireproof isolation layer arranged on the inner layer, and a moisture blocking layer with an annular structure is arranged between the protective sleeve layer and the fireproof isolation layer; the moisture blocking layer is longitudinally coated on the inner wall of the sheath layer and is tightly adhered to the sheath layer. This scheme keeps off damp structure and multilayer fire prevention isolation structure through being equipped with multiple dampproofing, has realized multiple protect function, has guaranteed the comprehensive fire prevention dampproofing performance of cable, has improved the reliability of cable greatly.

title_en: Motor
abstract_en: The utility model provides a motor which is used for solving the problem that lubricating oil is easy to rush upwards from the periphery of a thrust plate when the traditional motor is assembled. Comprising the following steps: a base having a shaft tube; a bearing assembly located inside the shaft tube, the bearing assembly having a bearing; the rotating piece is rotatably combined with the bearing assembly and is provided with a rotating shaft and a thrust plate which are connected, the rotating shaft penetrates through the bearing, a gap is formed between the thrust plate and the rotating shaft, the rotating shaft is provided with an inner axial end face which is positioned in the shaft tube, at least two connecting parts are arranged between the thrust plate and the inner axial end face, a gap is formed between any two adjacent connecting parts, and each gap is communicated with the gap; a stator located outside the shaft tube; and a hub connected to the rotating shaft.

title_en: Low-voltage control cabinet with adjustable base
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a low-pressure control cabinet with an adjustable base, which comprises: the cabinet body comprises a plate body, the top of the plate body is fixedly connected with electric hydraulic pushing rods, the number of the electric hydraulic pushing rods is four, and the top ends of the electric hydraulic pushing rods are fixedly connected with the cabinet body. According to the utility model, the motor works to drive the rotating shaft to rotate, so that the threaded rod rotates in the threaded cylinder, the first sliding block slides in the first sliding groove, the fixed seat is driven to move downwards, the universal wheel is suspended on the ground, the position of the device is fixed, whether the cabinet body is horizontal or not can be observed through the arrangement of the level meter, the independent fixed seat is convenient to adjust, the situation of uneven ground is further met, and the device can be provided with an anti-skid fixed position through the arrangement of the anti-skid pad.

title_en: Trigger device for multiple power supply systems and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a trigger device and electronic equipment for many power supply system, many power supply system includes power supply unit, power supply unit includes the power module and at least one reserve power module that are supplying power, trigger device includes: the light sensor is used for receiving ambient illumination, collecting illumination intensity and generating a control instruction; the input end of the control module is connected with the light sensor, and the output end of the control module is respectively connected with each power supply module in the power supply unit; wherein the control module is configured to: and controlling the power supply module which is being supplied with power to be powered off in a delayed manner according to the control instruction, and controlling one power supply module in the at least one standby power supply module to supply power to the power consumption equipment.

title_en: Auxiliary device for capacitor small space installation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an auxiliary device for installing a capacitor in a small space, which is characterized in that: the device comprises a supporting plate and a gripper plate, wherein the supporting plate is connected with the gripper plate through a connecting mechanism; the left end of the supporting plate is connected with the connecting mechanism, the top of the right end of the supporting plate is provided with a regular polygon groove, the right center of the bottom of the regular polygon groove is provided with a yielding hole, the outer diameter of the yielding hole is smaller than the width of the regular polygon groove, and the bottom of the yielding hole is communicated with the bottom surface of the supporting plate; an adjusting component is detachably arranged in the regular polygon groove. The utility model improves the convenience of capacitor installation, reduces the installation difficulty and also reduces the equipment cost.

title_en: Efficient drying device for adhesive tape production
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-efficiency drying device for adhesive tape production, which comprises a frame, wherein an upper surface of one end of the frame is provided with an electrostatic removing assembly, the outer surface of the lower end of the electrostatic removing assembly is provided with a plurality of groups of pressing rollers, the upper end and the lower end of the pressing rollers are respectively provided with adhesive tapes, the middle outer surface of the upper end of the frame is provided with a drying assembly, the outer surface of one side of the drying assembly is provided with a fixing frame, a winding roller is arranged between the fixing frames, the drying assembly comprises a blower, a first supporting frame, a telescopic air outlet pipe, a drying box, an upper cover, a movable wheel, an electric heating pipe, a fixing clamp and an air outlet pipe, and the middle of the outer surface of the upper end of the frame is provided with a drying box. According to the efficient drying device for the adhesive tape production, provided by the utility model, the drying effect of the adhesive tape is improved conveniently through the arranged drying assembly, and static electricity on the surface of the adhesive tape is removed conveniently through the arranged static electricity removing assembly.

title_en: Automobile wire harness processing fixing frame
abstract_en: The application provides an automobile wire harness processing mount, which comprises a frame, the inside of frame is equipped with first mount and second mount, the frame is close to the upper surface of second mount and is equipped with lifting unit, first mount includes the support, the inside of support is equipped with the bottom plate, the upper surface of bottom plate is equipped with the montant, the surface of montant is equipped with the spring ring, and the mounted position of spring ring is located the top of bottom plate and support, relate to automobile wire harness processing technology field, wherein, be equipped with first mount inside the frame, one side at first mount is equipped with the second mount, the wire harness is fixed stable through the lifting unit of second mount and top like this after, the other end of wire harness is spacing through first mount, make the wire harness can not appear winding problem, abandon and can slide in the frame inside for first mount, when needs are processed follow-up wire harness, promote first mount and can drive the pencil and remove, make wire harness production convenient and fast more.

title_en: Bus duct with aluminum alloy shell
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an aluminum alloy shell bus duct, and relates to the field of bus ducts. The bus duct comprises a transverse plate and vertical plates, wherein limiting blocks are fixed on two sides of the transverse plate, connecting clamping rods are fixed on the limiting blocks, the limiting blocks are positioned at positions above two sides of the transverse plate, and clamping grooves are formed in the top and bottom of the vertical plates.

title_en: Municipal administration switch board that heat dispersion is good
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a municipal power distribution cabinet with good heat dissipation performance, and relates to the technical field of power distribution cabinets. This municipal power distribution cabinet that heat dispersion is good uses through the cooperation of temperature sensor and radiator fan and servo motor and baffle for this municipal power distribution cabinet that heat dispersion is good is at the in-process of work, temperature sensor continuously monitors the temperature in the municipal power distribution cabinet, when the heat dissipation demand is not high, servo motor accessible drive the transfer line rotatory, then drive the deflection pole through the transmission of first bevel gear and second bevel gear rotatory, it opens to drive the baffle deflection after the deflection pole is rotatory, carry out supplementary heat dissipation to municipal power distribution cabinet through natural wind, when temperature sensor monitors that the temperature is higher in the municipal power distribution cabinet, radiator fan starts and prepares the wind beam, the opening that the cooperation baffle was opened assists the heat dissipation of equipment in the municipal power distribution cabinet.

title_en: Transformer protection cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a transformer protection cabinet which comprises a protection cabinet main body, wherein a ventilation plate is arranged at the bottom end of the protection cabinet main body, a support base is fixedly connected below the ventilation plate, a movable rod is arranged in the support base, a fixed rod is arranged above the movable rod, and a cleaning scraping plate is arranged above the fixed rod. According to the utility model, external air can conveniently enter the inside of the main body of the protection cabinet through the ventilating plate, and when the fixed handle is pulled, the movable rod can drive the support column and the fixed rod to move on the inner wall of the support base, so that the cleaning scraping plate can clean the bottom end surface of the ventilating plate in the moving process of the fixed rod, the phenomenon that dust blocks the support base and influences the heat dissipation effect in the main body of the protection cabinet is avoided, and the connecting column can drive the transmission rack to move in the protection frame through the movement of the movable rod, so that the cleaning scraping plate is conveniently driven by the fixed rod to move in the support base.

title_en: Single battery, power battery pack and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a battery cell, power battery package and vehicle, this battery cell includes shell, lid, heat exchange part and two at least battery inner cores, be provided with the opening on the shell, the lid is connected with the shell and is used for sealing the opening, be provided with two at least holding chamber in the shell, battery inner core and holding chamber one-to-one, every battery inner core can put into one respectively through the opening and hold the chamber, heat exchange part connects in the shell and close to holding the chamber, heat exchange part structure can cool off or heat the battery inner core. The single battery is provided with a plurality of battery inner cores, and the battery inner cores share one shell, so that the proportion of the mechanical structure, the heat exchange component and the shell of the single battery in the total weight is reduced in the formed power battery pack, the number of the battery inner cores is increased instead, and the energy density of the power battery pack can be improved. In addition, by providing the heat exchange member in the case, the cooling or heating efficiency of the battery core can be improved.

title_en: Energy-saving bus duct with stable wiring
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of power transmission, and particularly relates to an energy-saving bus duct with stable wiring, which solves the problems that the structure is complex and special situations cannot be effectively prevented in the prior art; the utility model discloses a frame, including frame, fixed block, screw hole, pull rod, straight-bar, screw, protection cover, screw hole has all been seted up to the both sides of frame all to the screw fixedly connected with fixed block, two the screw hole has all been seted up to the inside of fixed block, the inside of frame is sliding fit with two pull rods and the straight-bar that are symmetrical arrangement respectively, two the bottom of straight-bar all has the push rod through screw fixedly connected with, two the top of straight-bar all has the dog through screw connection, one side of frame rotates installs the protection cover, has solved among the prior art structure complicacy, can not effectively prevent the problem that special condition takes place.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant insulating film, conductive metal film and automatic production line
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-temperature-resistant insulating film, a conductive metal film and an automatic production line. According to the embodiment of the utility model, the high-temperature-resistant nano coating is arranged outside the supporting layer, so that holes cannot be burned due to high temperature in the subsequent production of the conductive metal film, and the production quality of the conductive metal film is improved.

title_en: Automatic wire end wrapping mechanism of full-automatic magnetic ring winding machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic wire end wrapping mechanism of a full-automatic magnetic ring winding machine, and belongs to the technical field of winding equipment. The device comprises a main body frame, wherein one side of the main body frame is connected with a first cylinder, the other side of the main body frame is connected with one side of an encapsulation mechanism, the middle part of the encapsulation mechanism is connected with a positioning mechanism, one side of the positioning mechanism is connected with a wire guide mechanism, and the other side of the encapsulation mechanism is connected with one side of a wire clamping mechanism. The automatic wire-wrapping head mechanism of the full-automatic magnetic ring winding machine provided by the utility model has the advantages of simple structure, low manufacturing cost and convenience in operation, reduces the condition that the wire head of the full-automatic magnetic ring winding machine scratches a product due to sharp, and improves the product quality. And the structure is finely adjusted to be suitable for most of full-automatic magnetic ring winding machines with different styles on the market, and the copper wires can be always kept at the same position by matching all the mechanisms, so that the debugging cost is reduced, the investment of manpower and material resources is reduced, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Multi-core pipe with strong bearing capacity and corrosion resistance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-pressure-bearing and corrosion-resistant multi-core pipe, wherein a plurality of clamping grooves are formed in the top of an inner cavity of a protective layer, a plurality of clamping blocks are fixedly connected to the bottom of a corrosion protective layer in a protruding mode, the clamping grooves and the clamping blocks are mutually clamped, a plurality of first elastic pieces and second elastic pieces are respectively fixedly connected to the upper side and the lower side of the inner cavity of a compression-resistant layer, the plurality of first elastic pieces and the plurality of second elastic pieces are made of the same materials, and the technical field of the multi-core pipe is related to the high-pressure-bearing and corrosion-resistant multi-core pipe.

title_en: Automatic rotating and collecting device for water surface floating objects
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of floater collecting devices, and discloses an automatic rotating and collecting device for water surface floaters. The main technical characteristics are as follows: including the collecting box that has the kicker, be provided with the filter screen in the collecting box and collect the frame, be provided with the sewage pump that has the drain pipe in the collecting box that the filter screen collected the frame below, the delivery port of drain pipe stretches out the collecting box outside, is provided with the anchor chain that has the anchor block below the collecting box, has the flange at the collecting box week, is provided with the floater import on the flange of the opposite side with the delivery port of drain pipe, is provided with the guide plate in floater import outside. When the water outlet of the drain pipe drains outwards and water containing floaters flows in through the floaters inlet, the collecting box can be pushed against the direction opposite to the water flow direction of the floaters inlet, the whole collecting box can move within the limit range of the anchor chain, the collecting area is larger, the collecting effect is good, the collecting cost is reduced, and the energy is saved.

title_en: Fusing device with arc extinguishing device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fusing device with an arc extinguishing device, wherein a second conductive part of a first sheet-shaped pin and a second sheet-shaped pin is connected in a charging and discharging loop of an electric vehicle, when the charging and discharging loop is normal, current in the loop passes through a temperature sensing body, when the fusing device senses abnormal temperature rise, the temperature sensing body fuses, because the voltage and the current are larger, an electric arc can be generated at the moment of disconnection, the first magnetic steel sheet and the second magnetic steel sheet can rapidly break the electric arc after the temperature sensing body fuses, the reliable action of the device is ensured, and further accidents are avoided.

title_en: Motor stator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a motor stator, which comprises an iron core component, a plurality of windings arranged on the inner side of the iron core component, a plurality of wiring terminals arranged on the iron core component, and a plurality of wires connecting the windings with corresponding wiring terminals, wherein the wiring terminals comprise first connecting parts which penetrate through the radial outer peripheral surface of the iron core component to extend to the outer side of the iron core component, and one ends of the wires extend to the outer side of the iron core component and are connected with the first connecting parts of the corresponding wiring terminals. The first connecting part penetrates through the radial outer peripheral surface of the iron core assembly to extend to the outer side of the iron core assembly, the lead is connected with the first connecting part, namely, the connection part of the wiring terminal and the lead is positioned at the radial outer side of the iron core assembly, so that the height of the motor stator in the axial direction of the motor stator can be reduced, and meanwhile, the lead and the first connecting part are also convenient to fix.

title_en: Riveting die for silver contact
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a riveting die for silver contacts, which relates to the technical field of silver contact riveting and comprises a lower die holder upper die holder and a riveting head, wherein an installation groove for installing the riveting head is formed in the upper die holder, empty grooves are formed in the upper die holder and are positioned on two sides of the installation groove, a clamp structure for facilitating disassembly and assembly of the riveting head is arranged in each empty groove, the top end of the riveting head is connected with an installation seat, clamping grooves are formed in two sides of the installation seat, and constraint fixation of the installation seat and the riveting head is realized through clamping pieces and the clamping grooves. In the riveting die of the silver contact, the riveting head and the upper die are fixed through the clamp structure, so that the riveting head can be independently detached to be replaced after being worn, the upper die is not required to be connected, and the maintenance cost of enterprises is reduced.

title_en: Plane slip ring, rotary conductive assembly and telescopic data line assembly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electronic accessories, in particular to a plane slip ring, a rotary conductive assembly and a telescopic data line assembly, wherein the plane slip ring is used for ensuring stable electric connection with a PCB (printed circuit board) in the rotation process and comprises a structural support and a plurality of conductive pieces arranged on the structural support, the structural support comprises a limiting ring and an extension section formed by extending along the radial symmetry of the limiting ring, the conductive pieces are arranged on the extension section and comprise contact parts electrically contacted with other external assemblies, contact points are formed on the contact parts, and the contact points of each conductive piece are on the same straight line. According to the plane sliding ring, the symmetrically arranged extension sections can keep balanced stress at the two ends during rotation, so that abrasion of the plane sliding ring and other components during action is reduced, and the service life is prolonged; the contact part of the conductive piece is convenient to prop against other components, and the contact point of the contact part can ensure the whole coaxiality in the same straight line, so that the rotation process of the planar slip ring is more stable.

title_en: Permanent magnet brushless servo motor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a permanent magnet brushless servo motor, which belongs to the technical field of permanent magnet brushless servo motors, and the technical scheme is characterized by comprising a motor shell, wherein one side of the motor shell is provided with a mounting assembly, and the bottom of the motor shell is provided with a fixing assembly; the motor shell is characterized in that the two fixing plates are welded at the tops of the motor shell and the maintenance shell respectively, the fixing bolts are in threaded connection with the two fixing plates, the fixing nuts are in threaded connection with one end of the fixing bolts, the motor shell can be quickly opened through the installation assembly and then maintained, the installation assembly is different from a traditional motor shell opening mode after being opened, the assembly connection is simple, the maintenance steps and the maintenance time are reduced, the fixing assembly enables the motor shell to be attached to each other more tightly between the installed positions, and friction force can be increased when the motor shell is installed.

title_en: Photovoltaic panel support prefabricated part
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a photovoltaic panel bracket prefabricated member, which relates to the technical field of photovoltaic panel brackets, and comprises an installation seat and further comprises: the fastening seat is fixedly provided with a first screw rod, and the fastening seat is in threaded connection with the mounting seat through the first screw rod; the bottom plate is fixedly provided with a second screw rod, and the bottom plate is in threaded connection with the fastening seat through the second screw rod; the waterproof winding piece is arranged between the fastening seat and the mounting seat, a through hole is formed in the waterproof winding piece, the mounting seat penetrates through the through hole to be connected with the fastening seat, and a connecting screw is fixedly installed on the mounting seat. The waterproof roll is made of flexible materials, and the small amplitude at the center of the waterproof roll is counteracted when reaching the periphery, so that the adhesion effect between the waterproof roll and a waterproof layer is not affected, gaps and damages are avoided, and the waterproof roll can better prevent the position on a roof, which is damaged by the installation bottom plate.

title_en: Weak current box electrostatic protection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of weak current box protection, and discloses a weak current box electrostatic protection device which comprises a placing box, wherein hinges are respectively and rotatably connected to the upper end and the lower end of the left side of the placing box, a box door is fixedly connected to the middle part of each hinge, and a plurality of isolation plates are respectively and fixedly connected to the upper end and the lower end of the inner wall of the placing box. According to the utility model, the electric appliance is placed in the weak current box, the metal rod is pushed out by the spring in the hollow tube and is limited by the metal sheet by matching with the limiting ring, so that the problems that the electric appliance and the circuit fall off due to careless overturning in daily life because of more electric appliances stored in the weak current box are solved, the stability of the electric appliance in the weak current box is improved, water in the water accumulation box is pumped out by the miniature water pump, the water is sprayed out by matching with the water pipe and the atomizing nozzle, a large amount of water is absorbed by the water absorbing sponge, and the problems that the air in the weak current box is dry and static electricity is easy to cause when the electric appliance in the weak current box is used are solved.

title_en: Rolling device and battery manufacturing equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of battery production and provides a rolling device and battery manufacturing equipment, wherein the rolling device comprises a rack and a roller pushing mechanism, and the roller pushing mechanism comprises a driving piece, a connecting component, a pressing roller and a limiting component; the driving piece is arranged on the frame, the connecting component is connected with an output shaft of the driving piece, and the compression roller is detachably connected with the connecting component; the limiting assembly comprises a limiting structure and a moving piece, the moving piece is connected to the connecting assembly, and the limiting structure is arranged on a moving path of the moving piece; the rolling device is provided with a rolling station, and the moving piece is configured to be abutted against the limiting structure when the pressing roller is arranged at the rolling station; according to the compression roller, the travel of the moving part is limited through the limit structure for limiting the travel of the moving part after the compression roller is disassembled and assembled, the limit for the travel of the compression roller is further achieved, the compression roller can accurately return to the rolling station, and the complex procedure that the compression roller can be moved to the rolling station after repeated correction and adjustment is reduced.

title_en: Small-diameter bending-resistant multi-core shielded cable
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a small-diameter bending-resistant multi-core shielding cable, which comprises three inner-layer power supply cores, two inner-layer control cores and an inner-layer grounding wire core which are twisted together to form an inner-layer wire core body, wherein the outer part of the inner-layer wire core body is sequentially coated with a copper-plastic composite belt inner wrapping layer and a silicone rubber longitudinal hole insulator, six outer-layer fan-shaped power supply cores and three outer-layer fan-shaped grounding wire cores are uniformly distributed on the outer part of the silicone rubber longitudinal hole insulator to form an outer-layer wire core body, and the outer part of the outer-layer wire core body is sequentially coated with a copper-plastic composite belt outer wrapping layer, a copper wire wrapping shielding layer and a PVC outer sheath. The cable is prepared based on reducing, the layered structure inside the cable core is balanced, the flexibility and the bending resistance are better, the electrical shielding performance is stable, and the durability is better.

title_en: Electrode leading-out assembly for battery and battery
abstract_en: The utility model provides an electrode leading-out assembly for a battery and the battery, and relates to the technical field of batteries, wherein the electrode leading-out assembly comprises: a top cover sheet provided with a mounting hole; the pole is arranged in the mounting hole, and the side wall of the pole is provided with at least one first plane; the connecting piece, the connecting piece is annular, and annular connecting piece cup joints on the utmost point post, and the inside wall of connecting piece is equipped with at least one second plane, and first plane and second plane laminating each other, connecting piece card is on the top cap piece. Because the connecting piece card is on the top cover plate to, first plane and second plane rotate spacingly each other, and then, have prevented that the utmost point post from being located the mounting hole and torsion, and guaranteed that the installation of utmost point post is accurate, compare in welded connection's mode, improved the qualification rate of product, reduced large-scale laser welder's equipment input, improved the competitiveness of product.

title_en: Solar charging's electronic structure that opens and shuts of umbrella
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric opening and closing structure of a solar charged umbrella, which comprises an umbrella rib assembly and an electric opening and closing mechanism, wherein the electric opening and closing mechanism is connected with the umbrella rib assembly through a first connecting piece, the umbrella rib assembly comprises a main umbrella rib and a solar panel assembly, and the electric opening and closing mechanism comprises a driving motor, an opening and closing base, an opening and closing screw rod, a movable umbrella disc and a fixed umbrella disc. According to the utility model, the driving motor drives the opening and closing screw rod to rotate, so that the movable umbrella disk is driven to move up and down along the screw rod, and the movable end of the umbrella rib is driven to slide on the guide rail of the movable umbrella disk, so that the opening angle of the umbrella rib is changed, the opening and closing of the umbrella body are finally realized, and the functions of remote control, automatic umbrella closing protection in strong wind, automatic umbrella opening and charging in sunlight and the like can be realized.

title_en: Grille lamp unit and grille lamp
abstract_en: The first aspect of the utility model provides a grille lamp unit, which comprises a lamp body, a grille reflecting cover and a light source module, wherein the grille reflecting cover is fixed on the lamp body, the grille reflecting cover comprises a plurality of grille reflecting units which are arranged in an array, each grille reflecting unit is of a structure with a closed side surface, an opening downwards and a hollowed bottom, the light source module emits light through the hollowed-out area at the bottom of each grille reflecting unit, a detachable light-transmitting cover is fixed at the bottom of each grille reflecting unit, and the light-transmitting cover covers the hollowed-out area at the bottom. A second aspect of the present utility model proposes a grille lamp whose light source is a single grille lamp unit according to the first aspect or is composed of a combination of a plurality of grille lamp units according to the first aspect. The grille lamp provided by the utility model has the advantages that the light-transmitting cover is designed to be of an independent movable and sectional structure, so that the problem of inconvenient replacement of the light-transmitting cover can be solved. Meanwhile, the grid reflection unit is designed into a cell structure with the side face and the bottom face closed, so that light is prevented from being scattered to other areas, the light efficiency is improved, and glare is reduced.

title_en: Cold shrink type optical fiber composite medium-voltage cable
abstract_en: The utility model provides a cold-shrink type optical fiber composite medium-voltage cable, which relates to the technical field of cables and comprises: the inner wall of sheath subassembly is provided with the filling layer, the inner wall of filling layer is provided with the take-off coil, take-off coil's inside is provided with a plurality of conductors, sheath subassembly is including the wearing layer. When the cable is used, the sheath assembly is sleeved outside the conductors, so that the cable formed by the conductors is wrapped, the pull-out coil is pulled outwards, the protection ring is pulled outwards, gaps between the conductors can be filled with materials of the filling layer in the pull-out process of the protection ring, and the problem that the sealing effect is poor due to the fact that external water vapor is easy to permeate onto the conductors through gaps due to the fact that gaps appear between the existing conductors and between the conductors and the inner wall of the cold shrink sleeve is solved.

title_en: Durable insulated wire
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of insulated wires, in particular to a durable insulated wire, which comprises a protection component, wherein the protection component comprises an outer sheath, a protective layer is arranged on the inner wall of the outer sheath, a wire core sheath is arranged in a first shielding layer, the wire core sheath comprises a rubber insulating layer, a mica tape is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the rubber insulating layer, a second shielding layer is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the mica tape, and a wire core conductor penetrates through the second shielding layer. Through the arrangement of the protective layer, the utility model can improve the integral compression resistance effect of the cable through the distribution of the honeycomb structure, thereby playing a role in protecting the inner wire core conductor safely, reducing the external extrusion loss, simultaneously having excellent buffering and vibration isolation functions and improving the integral insulation effect by matching with a plurality of layers of insulation materials.

title_en: Wire core stranding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wire core twisting device which comprises a rotary round rod, wherein a wire core turntable is fixed on the outer wall of the rotary round rod, a wire collecting disc is fixed on one end of the rotary round rod, a wire core is fixed on the wire core turntable, and the wire core penetrates through the wire collecting disc; the support assembly comprises a first support seat, a second support seat arranged beside the first support seat and a twisting hole frame fixed on the side wall of the second support seat, the other end of the rotary round rod is rotatably arranged on the first support seat, the wire collecting disc is rotatably arranged on the second support seat, a round hole is formed in the twisting hole frame, and a wire core penetrates through the round hole from the wire collecting disc; the driving assembly drives the rotary round rod to rotate; the winding roller structure is arranged on one side of the second supporting seat, and the wire cores penetrating out of the round holes are wound on the winding roller structure; and the compaction assembly is arranged on one side of the winding roller structure and is used for compacting the wire core wound on the winding roller structure. The wire core wound on the winding roller structure can be automatically and simply pressed.

title_en: Battery cell
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a battery, which comprises a battery body, a process sealing nail and a nail shell, wherein the surface of the battery body is provided with a liquid injection hole, the process sealing nail comprises a sealing part and a force application part, the sealing part is embedded in and sealed with the liquid injection hole, the force application part protrudes out of the surface of the battery body, and the nail shell is covered on the force application part and is connected with the battery body in a sealing way. This battery is equipped with the nail casing at the outside cover of process seal nail, and the nail casing forms the safety cover to the process seal nail, makes in the manufacturing process of battery, need not to change the process seal nail, simplifies the manufacturing process, reduces the human cost, cancels simultaneously and seals the gluey nail structure, reduces battery cost to nail casing and battery body sealing connection have improved the sealed effect of battery notes liquid hole.

title_en: Intelligent complementary energy storage device for power distribution network and new energy power grid
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent complementary energy storage device for a power distribution network and a new energy power grid, which comprises an energy storage cabinet body and a heat dissipation mechanism arranged on the side of the energy storage cabinet body, wherein one side of the energy storage cabinet body away from a side door plate is communicated with an upper pipeline and a lower pipeline, a pipeline fan I and a pipeline fan II are respectively fixed in the upper pipeline and the lower pipeline, a water tank is also fixed on the side of the energy storage cabinet body, the upper pipeline and the lower pipeline are respectively connected with the water tank through an air outlet pipe and an air inlet pipe, and the middle part of the air inlet pipe is also connected with a dehumidifying box. The energy storage cabinet has the beneficial effects that the upper pipeline and the lower pipeline are arranged on the back surface of the energy storage cabinet body, and the pipeline fans are respectively arranged in the two pipelines, one of the pipelines is used for exhausting air outwards, the other pipeline is used for supplying air inwards, so that the air flow speed in the energy storage cabinet body is increased, and the efficient heat dissipation is realized; utilize cold water absorption to take out the heat in the air, send the energy storage cabinet body again after cooling with the air in, can realize circulation heat dissipation cooling to improve the practicality.

title_en: Power module protection circuit and electric equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a power module protection circuit and consumer, this power module protection circuit is used for comparing the reference voltage that first power output and the voltage signal that power module output through multiplexing port through voltage comparison circuit to under the condition that reference voltage is greater than voltage signal, output fault signal to the controller, can make the power module use multiplexing port to output fault signal and temperature signal's condition, the controller can sample the temperature information of power module at high temperature range, and because voltage comparison circuit just outputs fault signal under the condition that reference voltage is greater than voltage signal, also can avoid appearing the error triggering power module's protect function.

title_en: Double-ring magnetic steel brushless direct current motor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-ring magnetic steel brushless direct current motor, which relates to the field of direct current motors and comprises a motor main body, a first mounting plate and a second mounting plate, wherein the motor main body is fixedly arranged on the upper side of the first mounting plate, the second mounting plate is horizontally arranged on the lower side of the first mounting plate, an adjusting mechanism is arranged on the second mounting plate and is connected with the first mounting plate through the adjusting mechanism, a sleeve is sleeved on an output shaft of the motor main body in a sliding way, a connecting plate is fixedly arranged at the right end of the sleeve, a plurality of limiting sliding grooves which are uniformly distributed in an annular way are formed in the inner circular side wall of the sleeve, a limiting sliding block is slidingly arranged in each limiting sliding groove, the limiting sliding blocks are fixedly connected with the right end of the shaft wall of the output shaft, and a nut is rotationally connected to the left end of the sleeve through a bearing. The utility model can conveniently adjust the position of the motor main body and the output length of the output shaft, thereby leading the motor main body to be suitable for installation and use in different occasions, expanding the application range and being convenient for people to use.

title_en: Heart-shaped luminous portal device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a landscape decoration device, in particular to a heart-shaped luminous portal frame device. The heart-shaped luminous portal frame device comprises a heart-shaped portal frame and a luminous device, wherein the heart-shaped portal frame and the luminous device are erected on an installation basis, the heart-shaped portal frame is formed by combining two half frames, the heart-shaped portal frame is made of C-shaped channel steel in a bending mode, the cross section of the heart-shaped portal frame is a C-shaped groove, the luminous device is arranged at the bottom of the C-shaped groove, and a C-shaped notch is sealed by a light-transmitting acrylic plate. The heart-shaped luminous portal device disclosed by the utility model is bright and beautiful in whole, various in changeable shapes, and capable of providing the gas quality of net red explosion, and the device is simple in manufacturing method, high in structural strength, safe and durable, and has the waterproof function.

title_en: Assembled pipeline for 5G communication pipeline construction
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of communication pipelines, in particular to an assembled pipeline for 5G communication pipeline construction, which comprises a first connecting pipeline, wherein the left side and the right side of the first connecting pipeline are respectively provided with a first side plate, the surface of the first side plate is provided with a mounting groove, the top surface of the first connecting pipeline is provided with a second connecting pipeline, the left side and the right side of the second connecting pipeline are respectively provided with a second side plate, the bottom end of the second side plate is fixedly connected with a mounting soft cushion, and the mounting soft cushion and the mounting groove are mutually matched. According to the utility model, the upper clamping plate and the second clamping frame are arranged on the surfaces of the second side plate and the first side plate, and the upper clamping plate is lowered by starting the telescopic rod, so that the second side plate and the first side plate are connected more tightly, the use stability is improved, and meanwhile, the first clamping frame and the second clamping frame are used for connecting and stabilizing the installed second connecting pipeline and the first connecting pipeline.

title_en: Meta universe zero-carbon energy storage device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a metauniverse zero-carbon energy storage device, which comprises: the box body is provided with a first accommodating space; the two battery installation components are arranged in the first accommodating space, and a battery installation space is arranged between the two battery installation components; the pure water lithium ion batteries are arranged in the battery installation space; and the cooling liquid is filled in the first accommodating space and submerges at least a part of the plurality of pure water-based lithium ion batteries. The embodiment of the utility model ensures that the energy storage battery is safer to use.

title_en: Patch type aluminum electrolytic capacitor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a patch type aluminum electrolytic capacitor in the technical field of capacitors, which comprises a base, wherein elastic bulges are adhered to the edge part of the inner wall of the base at equal intervals, a capacitor body is fixedly arranged in the middle of the top end of the base, an adjusting and positioning assembly is fixedly arranged at the edge part of the top end of the base and comprises a positioning ring, an L-shaped block and a manual telescopic rod, the positioning ring is arranged at the position outside the capacitor body at the edge part of the top end of the base, and the L-shaped block is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the positioning ring at equal intervals.

title_en: Mobile power supply vehicle
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model discloses a mobile power supply vehicle, which relates to the technical field of mobile power supplies and comprises a vehicle body, a traveling module and a power supply module, wherein the traveling module is arranged below the vehicle body, a mounting frame and a plurality of sliding rails are arranged in the vehicle body, each sliding rail is arranged on the mounting frame, the power supply module is arranged on the mounting frame through each sliding rail, the power supply module comprises a plurality of battery packs, each battery pack is internally provided with a first connecting end, the mounting frame is internally provided with a plurality of second connecting ends, the traveling module can finely adjust the mobile power supply vehicle, and because each battery pack is in sliding connection with each sliding rail, the first connecting ends of each battery pack can be respectively abutted against each second connecting end of the mounting frame so as to electrically connect the first connecting ends of each battery pack with each second connecting end of the mounting frame in a one-to-one correspondence manner, therefore, the battery packs are pushed, the power supply module can be electrically connected with the vehicle body while the power supply module is installed, the connection is convenient, the installation efficiency is improved, and the installation time is saved.

title_en: Explosion-proof electric actuator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an explosion-proof electric actuator which comprises a machine head, a motor and a gear box, wherein the machine head and the motor are respectively arranged at the top and one side of the gear box, a third guard rail is arranged at the outer side of the motor, a protective cover is arranged at the outer side of the machine head, limit baffles are arranged at the middle positions of the front side and the back side of the protective cover, a first guard rail is arranged at the outer side of the protective cover, a supporting frame is arranged at the bottom of the gear box, and a valve rod is arranged in the gear box. The machine head is provided with the protective cover, the front and rear surfaces of the protective cover are respectively provided with the limit baffle, the machine head can be reinforced and protected through the limit baffles, the outer side of the protective cover is provided with the first protective fences, the second protective fences are arranged among the first protective fences, so that the protective capability of the machine head can be improved, cold water can be stored in the protective cover, and the cold water can be split into the first protective fences, and can be split into the second protective fences through the first protective fences, so that the machine head can be subjected to heat absorption and cooling.

title_en: Battery fixing assembly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of battery fixing, and discloses a fixing assembly of a battery, which comprises a base, wherein a first screw rod is rotationally connected to the left side wall and the right side wall of the base, first limit plates are connected to the two sides of the first screw rod in a threaded manner, second screw rods are rotationally connected to the front side wall and the rear side wall of the base, second limit plates are connected to the two sides of the second screw rods in a threaded manner, the battery is clamped between the first limit plates and the second limit plates, two limit plates are provided with hook holes, two hooks Kong Nagou are connected with a first L-shaped connecting plate, the upper parts of the first L-shaped connecting plates are provided with adjusting long bolts, the first L-shaped connecting plates are connected with a second L-shaped connecting plate through the first adjusting long bolts, and the second adjusting long bolts are connected between the second L-shaped connecting plates.

title_en: Driving circuit and voltage conversion circuit
abstract_en: The present utility model relates to a driving circuit technology. The utility model aims to provide a driving circuit and a voltage conversion circuit, which aim to solve the problem that when a lower bridge arm switch tube is turned off, a first power ground end can have larger negative pressure on a negative direct current bus if the driving circuit adopts a general bootstrap driving mode to form the bootstrap driving circuit. The utility model ensures that the first power ground terminal in the bootstrap driving circuit does not generate larger negative pressure on the negative direct current bus.

title_en: Angle-adjustable solar photovoltaic panel
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of solar photovoltaic panels, and provides an angle-adjustable solar photovoltaic panel which comprises a base, wherein a supporting plate is rotated at the top end of the base through a supporting shaft, two guide strips are fixed at one side of the top end of the supporting plate, sliding blocks are slidably connected to the inner walls of the guide strips, one ends of the sliding blocks are rotationally connected with a placing plate through rotating shafts, worm wheels are driven by rotating worms to drive the supporting shaft, the supporting shaft drives the supporting plate to change the orientation of a photovoltaic panel body, a motor drives bevel gears, a screw is driven by bevel gears to drive the screw under the action of a belt, the screw drives a setting block, the placing plate is pushed by the setting block under the assistance of the connecting shaft and the rotating shafts, the sliding blocks slide in the guide strips to change the orientation angle of the photovoltaic panel body, and through the technical scheme, the problems that in the prior art, when other orientations need to be changed, the whole photovoltaic panel can only be carried for orientation are solved, and the using effect of the photovoltaic panel is reduced are solved.

title_en: Photovoltaic module installation briquetting, photovoltaic module installation device and photovoltaic equipment
abstract_en: The photovoltaic module installation pressing block comprises a fixing part and a pressing part; the fixing part is used for being fixed to the photovoltaic bracket; the compressing part is connected with the fixing part and comprises a first compressing part and a second compressing part which are connected with each other, the first compressing part is used for compressing the top surface of the frame of the photovoltaic module, the second compressing part comprises a second sealing piece, and the second sealing piece is used for compressing the top surface of the lamination piece of the photovoltaic module.

title_en: 3D inductance skeleton terminal
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of inductance frameworks, in particular to a 3D inductance framework terminal, which comprises a main winding part and an auxiliary winding part arranged around the circumference of the main winding part, wherein the main winding part and the auxiliary winding part are of an integrated frame body structure, the central axis of the main winding part and the central axis of the auxiliary winding part are arranged at intervals and in parallel, the main winding part comprises a plate body and a main winding groove arranged on the plate body, the main winding groove is concavely arranged from the surface of the plate body, the auxiliary winding part comprises a block body and an auxiliary winding component arranged on the block body, and the auxiliary winding component is convexly arranged from the surface of the block body. The utility model uses the main winding part and the auxiliary winding part in a matched way, so that the winding is simple and convenient, the condition of more windings or less windings of the coil is effectively avoided, and the production quality and the service life of the inductance element are improved.

title_en: Automatic pressure-relief explosion-proof lead-acid storage battery protection mechanism and fixing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lead-acid storage battery protection mechanism capable of automatically relieving pressure and preventing explosion and a fixing device, comprising a box body, a fixing frame arranged on the inner wall of the box body, a fixing plate arranged on the inner wall of the fixing frame, a splayed ring arranged on the inner wall of the fixing plate, an explosion-proof frame arranged on the outer side of the splayed ring, an explosion-proof valve arranged on one side of the explosion-proof frame, and a plurality of anti-explosion valves arranged on the outer side of the explosion-proof frame; the pressure relief assembly comprises a fixed seat arranged at the top of the box body, a pressure relief pipe arranged in the fixed seat, and a fireproof net arranged on the inner wall of the pressure relief pipe. The device solves the problem that the storage battery is easy to explode and burn in the current charge and discharge operation process of the storage battery.

title_en: Portable air conditioner water receiving box and portable air conditioner
