abstract_en: The utility model relates to a portable air conditioner water receiving box and a portable air conditioner, and belongs to the technical field of household air conditioners. The portable air conditioner water receiving box comprises a box body with an opening at the top and a controller, wherein one side surface of the box body is used as a water level observation surface, a pressure sensor is fixedly arranged at the bottom of an inner cavity of the box body, a plurality of water level signal lamps are fixedly arranged on the water level observation surface, and the pressure sensor and the water level signal lamps are electrically connected with the controller. The pressure sensor is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the inner cavity of the box body and is used for detecting the pressure of condensed water in the water receiving box, different condensed water pressures correspond to different condensed water levels as the pressure of liquid is in direct proportion to the water depth, the controller can feed back the detected condensed water pressure to the water level signal lamp, the water level signal lamp is used for directly displaying the water level condition in the water receiving box, and a user can conveniently, rapidly, intuitively and accurately observe the water level condition in the water receiving box.

title_en: Lightning protection equipment convenient to installation lightning protection
abstract_en: The utility model provides a lightning protection device convenient to install, which comprises a base and a lightning protection main body; the base comprises a bottom plate, a containing cavity arranged on the bottom plate and a locking mechanism; a through hole is arranged at the center of the bottom plate; a plurality of locking holes are formed in the side wall of the accommodating cavity; the locking mechanisms are the same as the locking holes in number and are arranged in one-to-one correspondence with the locking holes, and can penetrate through the locking holes and extend into the accommodating cavity; the lightning protection main body comprises a mounting plate, a lightning rod body fixed with the mounting plate and a high-voltage-resistant insulation buffer sleeve arranged between the lightning rod body and the mounting plate; the mounting panel is arranged in and holds the intracavity to can dismantle fixed lightning rod body lower extreme through locking mechanical system and pass the hole, and not contact with the hole that passes, the bottom of lightning rod body is equipped with earth connection terminal. The lightning protection equipment convenient to install is simple in structure and convenient to operate, can be quickly disassembled and installed, effectively reduces workload, and improves working efficiency.

title_en: Enclose recovered monitoring facilities of joint postoperative
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rehabilitation monitoring device after joint surrounding operation, and relates to the technical field of medical appliances. Including the installed part and can dismantle the monitoring module of connection on the installed part, the installed part includes the mount pad and connects first connecting band and the second connecting band in the mount pad both sides, the other end interconnect of first connecting band and the other end interconnect of second connecting band, monitoring module demountable installation is on the mount pad, monitoring module is used for monitoring human articulated motion signal and transmits to monitor terminal, its dismantlement and the installation that can be convenient for monitoring module to charge to monitoring module.

title_en: Electrode assembly and battery
abstract_en: The utility model provides an electrode assembly and a battery. The first aspect of the utility model provides an electrode assembly, comprising a positive electrode plate and a negative electrode plate, wherein the surface of a positive electrode current collector is provided with elastic coatings positioned at two sides of a positive electrode active material layer, and the elastic coatings are arranged at two sides of the positive electrode active material layer, so that the distance between the negative electrode active material layer and the positive electrode active material layer can be increased, and a certain expansion space is reserved for the negative electrode plate, thereby reducing the risk of lithium precipitation of the electrode plate and fracture at a fillet, and improving the cycle performance and safety of a battery; meanwhile, the elastic coating provided by the utility model is suitable for the positive electrode plate with high surface density and high compaction density, and does not influence the use and preparation of the positive electrode active material layer.

title_en: Fin type heat dissipation power distribution cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model provides a plate type heat dissipation power distribution cabinet which comprises a cabinet body, wherein a first heat dissipation mechanism is arranged on one side of the cabinet body and comprises a heat dissipation plate and heat dissipation fins, the heat dissipation plate is arranged in the cabinet body, the heat dissipation fins are arranged on one side of the heat dissipation plate, an exhaust mechanism is arranged on one side of the inner wall of the cabinet body, a baffle plate is arranged on one side of the cabinet body, a second heat dissipation mechanism is arranged on one side of the inner wall of the cabinet body and comprises a fixing frame and a heat dissipation fan, and the heat dissipation fan is arranged in the fixing frame. The plate type heat dissipation power distribution cabinet solves the problems that the existing plate type heat dissipation power distribution cabinet generally adopts the heat dissipation plate to dissipate heat in the power distribution cabinet, the heat dissipation mode is single, and meanwhile, in the use process, the heat in the power distribution cabinet is difficult to discharge due to the fact that the air exhaust holes of the power distribution cabinet are small, and the service life of the power distribution cabinet is affected.

title_en: MIpi circuit punching structure of display screen FPC connector position
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mipi line punching structure of a display screen FPC connector position, which comprises an FPC body, wherein a plurality of binding position golden fingers are arranged at the tail part of the FPC body, a plurality of extension position golden fingers are arranged at one side of the binding position golden fingers, the extension position golden fingers are in one-to-one correspondence with the binding position golden fingers, and the extension position golden fingers are separated from the binding position golden fingers by a preset isolation distance. The extending golden finger and the binding golden finger adopt the wiring punching mode with the same pattern and the same distance, so that the success of connection and wiring can be ensured, the consistency of signals of the five groups of data signal lines in the transmission process can be ensured, and the display effect of the display screen is ensured.

title_en: Pulse encoder speed regulating device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pulse encoder speed regulating device, which belongs to the technical field of pulse encoders, and adopts the technical scheme that the pulse encoder speed regulating device comprises a pulse encoder speed regulating device shell, a control panel, a digital display window and a speed regulating knob, wherein the top of the speed regulating knob is provided with a limiting mechanism, the front side of the digital display window is provided with protective glass, and the front side of the control panel is fixedly connected with a fixed block; the problem of current most pulse coder speed regulator do not have and carry out spacing structure to the speed regulation knob, because the speed regulation knob is comparatively smooth, when staff takes place to touch by mistake with the speed regulation knob, lead to the unexpected rotation of speed regulation knob easily, lead to the maloperation to pulse coder speed regulator to wipe the dust on digital display window surface after long-time use to pulse coder speed regulator, cause scraping to the digital display window of non-wear-resisting material easily, influence and observe speed regulation information, thereby influence the result of use is solved.

title_en: Waterproof protection device for underground coal mine wire connector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waterproof protection device for an underground coal mine wire connector, which belongs to the technical field of underground coal mine circuits and aims to solve the technical problem; the existing waterproof treatment of the underground electric wire joint is generally to wind a waterproof adhesive tape at the joint, but the continuous dragging of the electric wire can lead to the falling of the waterproof adhesive tape, so that the risk of electric leakage exists, and the adopted scheme is that; the utility model discloses a waterproof protection device for an underground coal mine wire connector, which comprises a protection box, a cavity and a cover plate, wherein a threading hole is formed in the outer wall of one side of the protection box, a live wire connecting column and a zero wire connecting column are fixedly connected inside the protection box, a ground wire connecting column is fixedly connected to four corners inside the protection box, two threaded rods are in threaded connection with the protection box, an air bag is fixedly connected to the connection part of the threading hole and the cavity, and an electric wire and a gap in the threading hole are blocked through air bag expansion, so that a waterproof effect is achieved.

title_en: Movable solar air conditioner
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of equipment and discloses a mobile solar air conditioner, which comprises an air conditioner for use, epidemic prevention clothes for work, a solar power supply for transmitting power under the sun and a commercial power supply for the work of the air conditioner.

title_en: Quick sealing and cutting device for circuit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a circuit rapid sealing and cutting device, which comprises a shell, wherein an igniter, a piston and a conductor are arranged in the shell, the conductor penetrates through the shell, the igniter and the piston are positioned on the same side of the conductor, an arc-extinguishing chamber positioned on the other side of the conductor is also arranged in the shell, a baffle plate component is fixedly arranged in the arc-extinguishing chamber so as to divide the arc-extinguishing chamber into a plurality of arc-extinguishing chambers, and each arc-extinguishing chamber is internally provided with an arc-extinguishing body which is mutually independent; the igniter can drive the piston to move to a blocking state in a direction approaching to the arc extinguishing body so as to cut off part of the conductor through the piston and form a plurality of fragments, and each fragment corresponds to one arc extinguishing cavity; under the blocking state, the piston, the baffle plate component and the arc extinguishing body jointly isolate the fragment in the corresponding arc extinguishing cavity; the arc carried by the fragments is prevented from being conducted with each other through the metal arc extinguishing body, the possibility of re-burning and leakage of the arc is reduced, and therefore the effect of increasing the insulation effect of the device is achieved.

title_en: Crossing construction device for power transmission overhead line
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of overhead line construction and discloses a transmission overhead line crossing construction device, which comprises an extension ladder fixedly arranged on a base, wherein the extension ladder comprises two telescopic extension rods, a plurality of connecting rods are uniformly arranged between the two telescopic extension rods, upright posts are fixedly arranged at the tops of the two telescopic extension rods, fixed plates are fixedly arranged on the outer walls of the two upright posts, a rotating shaft is rotatably arranged between the two fixed plates, and an L-shaped isolation frame is fixedly arranged on the rotating shaft; the utility model adopts an integrated design, has simple structure, only needs to use one telescopic ladder, and is easy to carry and use; by arranging the rotatable L-shaped isolation frame, the construction cable and the straddled line can be effectively isolated, so that the construction safety is ensured, and the two types of wires are prevented from being mutually erected; the L-shaped isolation frame can be rotated by controlling the operation of the driving motor, so that the control is simpler and more efficient.

title_en: Transmission mechanism for feeding device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of feeding transmission mechanisms, in particular to a transmission mechanism for a feeding device, which comprises a main support, wherein a lower feeding roller and an upper feeding roller are arranged on the main support, a mounting frame is arranged at the front end of the main support, a feeding motor is arranged on the mounting frame, a motor shaft of the feeding motor is fixedly arranged on a front end preset connecting shaft of the upper feeding roller, and a rear end preset connecting shaft of the upper feeding roller is rotatably arranged on the main support. Through the vertical sliding control structure of automatically controlled formula that sets up, realize that the belt carries out the convenient taking off of automatically controlled formula, avoided because adopt a word screwdriver for a long time to warp the mode of taking off the belt from driving disk and driven disk and cause the driven disk to be scratched by a word screwdriver's condition to set up bilateral symmetry's dust cover to set up convulsions heat radiation structure, realize to the heat dissipation of the directed type convulsions of pay-off motor, improved the heat dissipation to the pay-off motor on the drive mechanism for the material feeding unit.

title_en: Floating plug connector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a floating plug connector, which comprises: the device comprises a floating plate, a test circuit board, a fixed seat, a plug-in main body and a fixed plate. The floating plate comprises a first front end face provided with a first accommodating cavity; the test circuit board is arranged in the first accommodating cavity; after the fixed plate is fixed on the tabletop, the floating plate is connected with the fixed plate through the elastic piece, the inserting main body is detachably arranged on the floating plate through the fixed seat, and the inserting main body can be floatingly arranged on the fixed plate through the elastic piece between the floating plate and the fixed plate, so that when the inserting main body is inserted into a test port of a product to be tested, the inner side test conductor of the inserting main body is better contacted with a terminal in the product to be tested through the elastic action of the elastic piece, and the lateral pressure of the test conductor can be prevented from being received by the elastic piece; meanwhile, through the specific movement between the floating plate and the fixed plate, the situation that after the plugging main body is plugged with the product to be tested, the gap between the plugging main body and the product to be tested is too small or even no gap exists after the product to be tested is shifted is avoided.

title_en: Anti-turbulence generated low-noise motor end cover
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a low-noise motor end cover capable of preventing turbulent flow from being generated, relates to the technical field of motor end covers, and aims to solve the problems that the existing motor end covers are in mesh shapes in most of air outlets, air outlet paths are blocked, turbulent flow is easy to form, and noise reduction performance of the motor end covers is poor. One end of the motor main body is provided with a motor end cover, the other end of the motor main body is provided with a front sealing cover, and the center of the front sealing cover is provided with a motor shaft connected with the motor main body; further comprises: the air outlet is arranged at the center of the motor end cover and is hollow and round, a protection cavity is arranged in the motor end cover, and the air outlet is communicated with the protection cavity; the air guide plate is arranged in the protective cavity, two air guide plates are arranged and are respectively positioned at two sides of the air outlet, and an air guide inclined surface is arranged on the surface of the air guide plate.

title_en: Power supply circuit, power supply equipment and wireless earphone
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a power supply circuit, power supply equipment and a wireless earphone. The power supply circuit comprises a power supply module, a voltage division module, a detection module and a main control module, wherein the power supply module is configured to provide driving voltage for a load based on power supply voltage; the voltage dividing module is configured to generate an identification current when an output terminal of the power supply module is connected with a load. The detection module is configured to output a power supply signal when a voltage difference between an input terminal of the power supply module and an output terminal of the power supply module reaches a rated voltage. The main control module is configured to control the power supply module to supply power to the load based on the power supply signal. The voltage dividing module and the detection module can acquire the connection condition of the power supply circuit and the load, so that corresponding driving voltage is provided, and the voltage dividing device is simple in structure and low in cost.

title_en: Transformer switch cabinet with protection structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a transformer switch cabinet with a protection structure, which comprises a top protection mechanism and a cushioning protection shed arranged at the top of the top protection mechanism, wherein a ventilation mechanism is arranged at the center of the top protection mechanism, a cabinet body mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the ventilation mechanism, a cooling fan and a clamping motor are arranged in the cabinet body mechanism, the clamping motor is arranged at one side of the middle of the cabinet body mechanism, the top protection mechanism comprises a protection bracket, vertical cushioning grooves are symmetrically arranged at two sides of the inside of the protection bracket, a first cushioning spring is fixedly connected to the top of the vertical cushioning grooves, a cushioning sliding rod is fixedly connected to the bottom of the first cushioning spring, the top of the transformer switch cabinet can be safely protected by arranging the top protection mechanism, ventilation can be carried out on the inside of the switch cabinet body by arranging the ventilation pipeline, and the transformer body is sealed by arranging the cabinet body mechanism, so that the transformer body is protected.

title_en: Connector with waterproof function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a connector with a waterproof function, which belongs to the technical field of communication and comprises a mounting shell, wherein a dustproof assembly is arranged on the outer wall of one side of the mounting shell, a fixing assembly is arranged on the outer wall of the other side of the mounting shell, a waterproof sleeve is arranged in the dustproof assembly, the dustproof assembly comprises a mounting shell, a connecting plate is rotationally connected on the inner wall of one side of the mounting shell, the outer wall of one side of the connecting plate is fixedly connected with the outer wall of one side of a protection plate, a connecting spring is arranged on the outer wall of one side of the connecting plate, one end of the connecting spring is fixedly connected with the inner wall of one side of the mounting shell, and the other end of the connecting spring is fixedly connected with the outer wall of one side of the protection plate; according to the utility model, the dustproof assembly and the waterproof sleeve are arranged, so that the connector can be dustproof and waterproof through the protection plate when not in use, and can also be waterproof through the waterproof sleeve when in use.

title_en: Embedded tunnel embedded lamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pre-buried tunnel embedded lamp which comprises an embedded lamp module and a lamp holder, wherein the lamp holder is pre-buried in a concrete structure of a tunnel, and the embedded lamp module is detachably arranged in the lamp holder; the embedded lamp module comprises an embedded lamp base and a plurality of annular lamp strips arranged on the embedded lamp base; the lamp embedding module is characterized in that a connecting assembly is arranged at the center of the lamp embedding module, and the lamp embedding module and the lamp holder are detachably connected together through the connecting assembly. The embedded tunnel embedded lamp comprises an embedded lamp module and a lamp holder, wherein the lamp holder is embedded in a concrete structure of a tunnel, and the embedded lamp module is detachably arranged in the lamp holder, so that the whole tunnel lamp is embedded in the concrete structure of the tunnel; the problem that a tunnel lamp is difficult to install in a narrow subway tunnel space is solved; meanwhile, when the lamp embedding module is damaged, the lamp embedding module can be directly taken out from the lamp holder for maintenance or replacement without disassembling the lamp holder, so that the lamp embedding module is convenient and quick.

title_en: Control cabinet assembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a control cabinet assembly in the technical field of electrical control cabinets, which comprises a control cabinet, wherein sliding rails are arranged on two sides of the inner bottom end of the control cabinet, an electrical installation frame is arranged in the control cabinet, a sliding groove is formed in the center of the inner bottom end of the control cabinet, and a box body is arranged at the top of the control cabinet.

title_en: Modular assembled distribution box
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of power distribution, and particularly relates to a modular assembled distribution box which comprises a box body, wherein a box door is rotatably connected to an opening of the box body, component mounting seats are arranged on the inner side face of the box body, supporting plates are arranged on opposite faces in the box body, a protective cover plate is fixedly connected to the side face of each supporting plate through screws, and an operation window is arranged on the side face of each protective cover plate in a penetrating mode and corresponds to the component mounting seats. The box is reasonable in design, and electrical component can install on the components and parts mount pad to the pencil can be packaged safely in the protective cover board. Therefore, the contact between the wire harness and the electric element can be prevented, the electric shock risk is reduced, and the electric element can be conveniently installed and replaced, so that the maintenance efficiency of the distribution box is improved; because the distribution box adopts a modularized design, a user can add or delete electric elements according to requirements, and the flexibility and the expandability of the distribution box are greatly improved.

title_en: Special frock of overhauling of enclosed busbar is fallen into to prevent foreign matter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a special tool for overhauling a closed bus, which comprises plastic cloth, wherein a zipper is arranged on the side edge of the plastic cloth, the plastic cloth forms a funnel-shaped structure through the closure of the zipper, deformable wiring grooves are formed around the plastic cloth at the opening part of a large opening end, the opening part of a small opening end and the joint part of the large opening end and the small opening end of the plastic cloth, a first elastic rope is embedded in the wiring groove at the small opening end in a penetrating manner, a second elastic rope is embedded in the wiring groove at the joint part of the small opening end and the large opening end in a penetrating manner, a third elastic rope is embedded in the wiring groove at the large opening end in a penetrating manner, so that the falling foreign matters are prevented from being difficult to take out, the falling foreign matters are subjected to bottom covering and collection, and the falling foreign matters are convenient to take out.

title_en: Connection structure of motor shaft and rotating shaft
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mechanical tools and discloses a connecting structure of a motor shaft and a rotating shaft. The connection structure of the present utility model includes: the connecting sleeve, the connecting key, the elasticity presss from both sides cover and lock nut, and connecting sleeve's one end is connected with the motor shaft through the connecting key, and the other end is equipped with second coupling groove and external screw thread, and lock nut is equipped with the screw hole, and the elasticity presss from both sides the cover and includes: the first conical section and the second conical section respectively comprise a plurality of first sector blocks and a plurality of second sector blocks, the elastic jacket is arranged in the second connecting groove in a penetrating way, the rotating shaft is inserted into the elastic jacket, and the lock nut is meshed on the connecting shaft sleeve. According to the connecting structure, when the lock nut is rotated and screwed, the elastic jacket is pushed to move towards the inner side of the connecting shaft sleeve, so that the first fan-shaped block and the second fan-shaped block of the elastic jacket are contracted inwards, the rotating shaft is clamped and fixed by the elastic jacket, and the connection between the motor shaft and the rotating shaft is realized.

title_en: Cable wire harness device for road monitoring camera
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cable harness device for a road monitoring camera, which comprises a harness plate, a connecting plate, a guide rail block, a sliding groove, an abutting plate, a push plate, a placement bin, a fixing plate and a fixing ring A, wherein the connecting plate is arranged on the harness plate, the placement bin is arranged on the abutting plate, a spring B is arranged in the abutting plate, a buckle is arranged on the pulling plate, a clamping groove is formed in the connecting plate, a connecting rod is arranged on the pulling plate, a pull handle is arranged at one end of the connecting rod, a spring A is arranged on a wall channel of the placement bin, a push plate is arranged at one end of the spring A, a harness hole is formed in the harness plate, a spring C is arranged on the wall of the harness hole, and the fixing ring A is arranged at the other end of the spring C.

title_en: Junction box and mud pump motor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of dredging engineering equipment, in particular to a junction box and a dredge pump motor, wherein the dredge pump motor comprises a motor main body, the junction box is connected to the motor main body and comprises a box body, a cover body and a cable pipeline, and an installation inner cavity is formed in the box body; at least one mounting opening is formed on the box body; the cover body is detachably connected to the mounting opening and comprises a cover plate and a cover edge which is formed on the bottom surface of the cover plate and extends downwards, the size of the cover edge is matched with the size of the mounting opening, and sealing elements are respectively arranged between the cover edge and the box body and between the cover plate and the box body; the cable pipeline is connected to the box body and communicated with the installation cavity; there is double-deck sealed between the installing port of lid and box body, namely, all is provided with the sealing member between apron, lid edge and the box body for the connection sealing performance between lid and the box body is better, avoids liquid to enter into in the box body from the junction gap.

title_en: Detachable router dust keeper
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detachable router dustproof device which comprises brackets, a bottom plate, vertical sliding rods, transverse plates, a lower dustproof shell and an upper dustproof shell, wherein the router comprises a net wire interface and a router main body, a plurality of net wire interfaces are arranged on the front side of the router main body, two brackets are symmetrically and fixedly connected to the top of the bottom plate, the router is arranged on the two brackets, the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with the vertical sliding rods, the transverse plates are fixedly connected to the top of the vertical sliding rods, sealing strips of the lower dustproof shell and the upper dustproof shell are mutually attached, and the sealing strips are attached to the front side wall of the router main body, so that the net wire is tightly pressed in a net wire perforation notch through the lower dustproof shell and the upper dustproof shell, the dustproof effect is further improved through the sealing strips, the net wire interface is prevented from dust, the risk of poor contact of the net wire interfaces caused by dust accumulation at the net wire interfaces is greatly reduced, and the service life of the router is ensured.

title_en: Power distribution box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a power distribution box, which comprises a box body with an opening at one side, wherein the opening of the box body is rotationally connected with a box door through a hinge, the opening of the box body is provided with a rotating groove, a rotating cavity is arranged in the box body at one side of the rotating groove, a connecting hole is arranged between the rotating cavity and the rotating groove, a rotating block is connected in the rotating cavity in a sliding way, a connecting rod is fixedly connected to the side wall of the rotating block corresponding to the position of the connecting hole, one end of the connecting rod, which is far away from the rotating block, penetrates through the rotating groove and is fixedly connected with a mounting block, the side wall at one side of the mounting block is provided with a clamping groove, and a spring is sleeved on the wall of the connecting rod, which is positioned in the rotating cavity, of the power distribution box, and the power distribution box has the advantages that: the clamping groove on the rotary mounting block is used for limiting the box door in a clamping way, so that the box door can be opened and closed for many times, and the normal use of the box door cannot be influenced due to the damage of a switching mechanism.

title_en: Box-type substation monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a box-type substation monitoring device in the technical field of distribution equipment, which comprises a box-type substation, wherein a U-shaped frame is arranged at the center position of the top end of the inside of the box-type substation, and a chute is formed in the lower surface of the U-shaped frame.

title_en: Lithium ion battery pole piece and lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of lithium ion batteries, and particularly relates to a lithium ion battery pole piece and a lithium ion battery, wherein the lithium ion battery pole piece comprises a current collector and an active material layer arranged on at least one surface of the current collector; the middle part of the current collector is provided with an empty foil area, and the empty foil area is provided with a tab. Compared with the prior art, the utility model can effectively improve the charge and discharge efficiency of the battery, reduce the heating value of the battery, simplify the production flow, improve the production efficiency and improve the safety of the battery by arranging the lug at the middle part of the pole piece.

title_en: Battery and battery head shell structure thereof
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a battery and a head shell structure thereof, wherein the head shell structure is used for being installed at the head of a battery core module, the head shell structure mainly comprises a heat dissipation shell, the inner side of the heat dissipation shell can be connected with the battery core module, and a groove type water cooling area is arranged on the outer side of the heat dissipation shell, so that the heat dissipation shell can be rapidly cooled in a water cooling mode, and then the battery core tab and a main board can be rapidly cooled through the heat dissipation shell, and finally the purpose of cooling and radiating the battery head is achieved.

title_en: Lithium ion winding battery
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lithium ion wound battery, which comprises a wound body and a tab, wherein the tab comprises a nickel-plated copper sheet and a copper column, the nickel-plated copper sheet comprises a first section extending into the wound body, a second section exposed relative to one end of the wound body and a third section arranged at one end, far away from the first section, of the second section, and the third section is welded with the copper column through a column terminal. The utility model improves the convenience and efficiency of the assembly of the battery by arranging the copper column and the third section of the nickel-plated copper sheet, and the copper column and the column terminal are in column shapes, so that the two parts are easier to tin, and the problem that tin liquid is easily accumulated at the end point when the existing flat lug is tin can be avoided; the nickel-plated copper sheet is softer, and can deform along the winding direction of the winding body, so that no gap exists between the nickel-plated copper sheet and the winding body, and the sealing effect and the contact are better.

title_en: Assembled variable frequency cabinet convenient to splice
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an assembled variable frequency cabinet convenient to splice, and relates to the technical field of variable frequency cabinets; the novel multifunctional cabinet comprises a cabinet body, wherein a fixed frame is fixedly connected to one side of the inner wall of the cabinet body, a screw rod is rotatably connected to one side of the inner wall of the fixed frame, symmetrically distributed sliding rails are fixedly connected to the bottom end of the inner wall of the cabinet body, a mounting plate is slidably clamped at the top end of the sliding rails, a movable block is fixedly connected to one side of the mounting plate, a thread groove is formed in one side of the movable block, the thread groove is in threaded connection with the outer side of the screw rod, one end of the screw rod extends to one side of the fixed frame and is fixedly connected with a worm wheel, and an L-shaped plate is fixedly connected to one side, close to the worm wheel, of the inner wall of the cabinet body; through the cooperation between changeing handle, worm wheel, lead screw and the guide bar, drive the movable block and carry out lateral shifting along the outside of lead screw, pull out the mounting panel to one side that is close to the cabinet door, when avoiding overhauling, need the staff to visit in the frequency conversion cabinet, the space is narrow and small and light is dim, inconvenient problem of operating.

title_en: Motor transmission mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a motor transmission mechanism, which belongs to the field of motor transmission, and comprises a shell, wherein the inner side of the shell is rotationally connected with a driving shaft, the outer side of the driving shaft is provided with a first gear, the inner side of the shell is rotationally connected with a driven shaft, a second gear is fixed on the outer side of the driven shaft and positioned at a position corresponding to the first gear, the second gear is in meshed connection with the first gear, a third gear is fixed on the outer side of the driven shaft, the inner side of the shell is rotationally connected with a transmission shaft, the outer side of the transmission shaft is fixedly provided with a fourth gear corresponding to the third gear, the fourth gear is in meshed connection with the third gear, the outer side of the driven shaft is further provided with a single-tooth gear, the top of the single-tooth gear is in meshed connection with a meshing wheel, and the meshing wheel is in rotational connection with the shell; the gear in the transmission mechanism can be continuously and properly lubricated, the transmission efficiency is improved, the service life is prolonged, and the requirement for manual intervention is reduced.

title_en: Capacitor convenient for automatic welding
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electronic components, in particular to a capacitor convenient for automatic welding, which comprises a core and a capacitor shell, wherein a mounting groove is formed in the capacitor shell, the core is mounted at the bottom end of the inner wall of the mounting groove, the inner wall of the mounting groove is filled with sealing materials, and a reinforcing component is further arranged on the inner wall of the mounting groove.

title_en: Pole piece and lithium ion battery
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of battery production and manufacturing, and particularly relates to a pole piece and a lithium ion battery, comprising a current collector; a safety primer layer coated on at least one side of the current collector; a reactive coating layer coated on the surface of the safety primer layer; the active coating passes through the hollowed-out patterns or the hollowed-out holes and contacts with the current collector. According to the utility model, by optimizing the pole piece structure, the internal resistance of the battery can be reduced, and the risk of deterioration of the electrical performance of the battery caused by increase of the internal resistance is avoided.

title_en: Lithium cell is with equipment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of lithium battery production, and particularly relates to an assembling device for a lithium battery, which solves the problems of lower automation degree and poorer flexibility in the related art.

title_en: New energy automobile battery external packing case with vibration reduction function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of battery external packaging boxes, in particular to a new energy automobile battery external packaging box with a vibration reduction function, which comprises a gravity block, wherein the top of the gravity block is fixedly connected with a supporting plate, the inside of the supporting plate is provided with a lifting groove, the inside of the lifting groove is fixedly connected with a connecting pipe, the inside of the connecting pipe is movably clamped with a nylon rod, the top of the nylon rod is fixedly connected with a connecting rod, the outer side of the connecting rod is fixedly connected with a stable cover, the outer side of the nylon rod is fixedly connected with a vibration reduction spring, the outer side of the stable cover is fixedly connected with a packaging box body, the top of the packaging box is provided with a sealing plate, and the top of the sealing plate is fixedly connected with a handle.

title_en: SVG intelligent early warning and fault refinement processing system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an SVG intelligent early warning and fault refined processing system, which comprises a main power supply system, wherein the main power supply system is electrically connected with an intelligent early warning system, the intelligent early warning system comprises a monitoring module, the monitoring module is electrically connected with a transmission module, the transmission module is electrically connected with a signal coding module and a collecting system, the signal coding module is electrically connected with a digital display module, the transmission module is connected with a central control system, and the central control system comprises an adjusting module; according to the intelligent early warning system, the design of the intelligent early warning system is added, the signal coding module converts real-time working conditions of all components into signals through the transmission module and feeds the signals back to the monitoring module when the monitoring module monitors that the signals are abnormal, and the signals are fed back to the adjusting module, so that the adjusting module starts to adjust and lock, various power utilization components are protected and early warned in time, the damage probability of a power supply system is reduced, and the practicability of the intelligent early warning system is improved.

title_en: Adjustable divider resistor device
abstract_en: An adjustable voltage dividing resistor device comprises a resistor adjusting part, wherein a binding post A and a binding post C are connected with one end of the resistor adjusting part, a binding post B and a binding post D are connected with the other end of the resistor adjusting part, and a protection resistor is arranged between the binding post A and the resistor adjusting part; the resistance adjusting part comprises a plurality of rotary adjusting parts which are connected in series, each rotary adjusting part comprises a ten-gear knob and 9 constant resistors, and the 9 constant resistors are connected in series and are connected with 10 contacts of the ten-gear knob in sequence. The adjustable voltage dividing resistor device is convenient to wire, has a multi-gear selecting function, can intuitively display the size of a selected resistor by adjusting gears with different accuracies, improves the accuracy and convenience of field test, and adopts mechanical type grading resistor adjustment to be more accurate.

title_en: Grounding pile of solar street lamp
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of grounding piles of solar street lamps, in particular to a grounding pile of a solar street lamp, which comprises a fixed column, wherein the top end of the fixed column is fixedly connected with the bottom end of a first connecting plate, the first connecting plate is fixedly connected with a first connecting frame, and the top end of the first connecting frame is clamped with the bottom end of a street lamp mounting plate; a rotating component is arranged at the top end of the fixed column; the rotating assembly comprises a first telescopic rod, a first sleeve is sleeved outside the first telescopic rod, the first sleeve penetrates through the first connecting plate, and rotating threads are formed in the surface of the first sleeve; through the structural design of rotating assembly, realized the pivoted function of earth pile, solved when the installation street lamp, need insert among the earth in advance with the earth pile, because of the earth pile is great with the area of contact of earth for among the earth pile can't be convenient insert earth, improved the earth pile and inserted the convenience of earth.

title_en: Antistatic device for powder coating production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mounting structures, in particular to an antistatic device for powder coating production, which comprises a mounting plate, wherein a fixed block is arranged on the outer wall of the mounting plate, an energy supply box is arranged on the outer wall of the fixed block, a charging box is arranged on one side of the energy supply box and positioned on the outer wall of the fixed block, a controller is arranged on one side of the charging box and positioned on the outer wall of the fixed block, and a fixed assembly is arranged on the outer wall of the fixed block.

title_en: Novel hybrid stepping motor of high accuracy
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel high-precision hybrid stepping motor, which comprises a stator and a rotor, wherein the stator is in a circular design, 18 poles are uniformly distributed on the stator, 15 teeth are uniformly distributed on each pole, 300 teeth are uniformly distributed on the periphery of the rotor, the rotor is positioned in the middle of the stator, and the motor has high-precision positioning precision of 0.2 degrees when the stator and the rotor are mutually matched. Through the stator and rotor design, the step angle of the motor is increased from 1.8 degrees to 0.2 degrees, and the positioning accuracy of the motor is greatly improved. Compared with the existing hybrid stepping motor, the motor has higher positioning precision, more stable motor in the running process and smaller shaking.

title_en: Automatic power generation control device of generator set remotely controlled by double channels of power plant movement device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an automatic power generation control device of a generator set of a double-channel remote control of a power plant movement device, which is connected with the power plant movement device in a communication way on a dispatching data network; the power plant moving device is in communication connection with the power plant moving device double channels; the two channels of the power plant movement device are connected with an automatic power generation control device of the generator set; the power plant movement device solves the problems that in the prior art, a power plant movement device of an automatic power generation control device of a generator set generally adopts only one channel, but if a network is in a problem, a dispatching data network can not be used for calling the data of the automatic power generation control device of the generator set and controlling the data, so that the condition that the automatic power generation control device of the generator set is out of control is caused, meanwhile, when a power plant telemetering device can not transmit a telemetering command to the dispatching data network, the execution terminal can realize self-picking, and meanwhile, the power plant movement device also has the capability of directly outputting a control signal.

title_en: Liquid cooling plate, power battery assembly and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a liquid cooling plate, which comprises: the collecting pipe is internally and sequentially provided with a water inlet chamber, an intermediate chamber and a water outlet chamber along the width direction of the collecting pipe, the intermediate chamber is partitioned by a partition plate to form a first compartment and a second compartment, the water inlet chamber is communicated with the first compartment, and the water outlet chamber is communicated with the second compartment; an organ pipe, which is provided with a first end and a second end which are oppositely arranged, wherein the first end is used for connecting the middle chamber, at least one group of first flow passages and second flow passages which are mutually communicated are formed in the organ pipe, the first flow passages are used for communicating the first compartment, and the second flow passages are used for communicating the second compartment; the utility model can solve the problems of limited cooling capacity, poor cooling of the battery core and uneven temperature distribution caused by poor design of the liquid cooling plate, thereby influencing the charge and discharge performance, the safety performance and the service life of the battery core.

title_en: Overvoltage protection control circuit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an overvoltage protection control circuit, which relates to the field of safety protection, and comprises: the power supply module is used for supplying power to the lower-stage circuit through a switching tube; the clamping module is used for ensuring that the switching tube is stably conducted when the power supply module supplies power to the lower-level circuit; the voltage detection module is used for detecting the voltage of the input side of the switching tube, and controlling the driving protection module to work when the voltage exceeds a threshold value; the driving protection module is used for disconnecting the switching tube when in operation and stopping supplying power to the lower-stage circuit; the power supply module is connected with the clamping module and the voltage detection module, and the utility model has the beneficial effects that: the utility model has the advantage of cost, the cost of the components selected by the whole circuit is low, and the common conventional components are adopted completely, so that the economic benefit is considerable; the selected devices and materials are universal, industrialization of the circuit is easy to achieve, circuit consistency is good, and the method can be widely applied to power supply control and low-voltage BMS control systems.

title_en: Powertrain and vehicle
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a power assembly and vehicle, and the casing of this power assembly includes cooling channel, and the casing includes aluminum alloy layer and magnesium alloy layer, and the cross section along cooling channel is magnesium alloy layer around arranging in the outside of aluminum alloy layer. Through the power assembly and the vehicle provided by the embodiment of the application, the corrosion resistance of the cooling channel on the power assembly shell can be improved, and the possibility of leakage of cooling medium is reduced.

title_en: Pulse capacitor with heat conduction holes
abstract_en: The application discloses pulse capacitor with heat conduction hole relates to pulse capacitor technical field, has improved current device because pulse capacitor need place it in external environment when not using, leads to external environment's dust adhesion to lead out the end surface easily, and the poor phenomenon of contact produces appears when making to lead out the end and being connected with other devices, including shell and leading out the end, two the leading out the end setting is at the surface of shell, the shell is provided with dustproof subassembly near the surface of leading out the end, the surface of shell is seted up flutedly. This application can be installed the dust cover at the end surface of drawing forth through mutually supporting of installation piece and mounting groove to play dirt-proof effect to the end of drawing forth, avoid pulse capacitor's dust adhesion in external environment when not using at the end surface of drawing forth, influence pulse capacitor's performance, make its effectual dust of preventing and other pollutants get into inside the shell, thereby protect pulse capacitor's performance.

title_en: Fast-assembling formula frame
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of frames, in particular to a quick-mounting type frame which comprises a mounting seat and a telescopic plate, wherein a battery box is inserted into the upper surface of the mounting seat, a convex block is fixedly arranged on the lower surface of the battery box, slots are formed in the surfaces of the mounting seat and the convex block, and a clamping block is fixedly arranged on the surface of the telescopic plate. According to the utility model, through the structures such as the protruding blocks, the inserting plates and the telescopic plates, the protruding blocks on the lower surface of the battery box can be better clamped in the grooves on the upper surface of the mounting seat, so that the battery box can be rapidly positioned by the design, a user can insert the inserting plates into the inserting grooves on the surfaces of the protruding blocks and the mounting seat to realize the fixing effect on the battery box, the protruding blocks can be limited and fixed under the action of the inserting plates, the telescopic plates can stretch and retract at a small distance on the surface of the mounting seat, the user can realize the fixing effect on the telescopic plates through the adjusting knob and the adjusting hole, and the telescopic plates are used for enabling the rack to be capable of fixing the battery boxes with different sizes.

title_en: Annotate liquid anchor clamps
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a liquid injection clamp, and relates to the technical field of lithium battery processing and production. The novel cantilever type cavity filling machine comprises a bottom plate, long-side rib plates and side rib plates, wherein the two long-side rib plates are arranged on the bottom plate in parallel, the two side rib plates are arranged on the bottom plate in parallel, a cuboid-shaped accommodating cavity is formed by the bottom plate, the two long-side rib plates and the two side rib plates, a plurality of middle rib plates are uniformly arranged between the two long-side rib plates, the accommodating cavity is divided into a plurality of subchambers by the middle rib plates, width fillers for adjusting the width of the subchambers are hung in the subchambers, a plurality of cantilever pins are arranged on the surfaces of the middle rib plates and the side rib plates, which face the width fillers, of the cantilever pins, hanging holes are formed in the position of the cantilever pins in a one-to-one correspondence and are matched with the size, and fixing pieces for fixing the width fillers can be detachably arranged on the middle rib plates and the side rib plates. The lithium battery has the advantages of being applicable to lithium batteries of various specifications, being high in mold changing speed and effectively improving production efficiency.

title_en: New forms of energy fills electric pile with locating component charges
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of charging piles, in particular to a new energy charging pile with a charging positioning assembly, which comprises a charging pile main body, a socket and a clamping frame, wherein one side of the charging pile main body is provided with the socket, a plurality of clamping frames are arranged in the socket, the bottom of each clamping frame penetrates through one side of the bottom of the socket, a positive and negative screw rod is arranged at the bottom of each socket, one end of each positive and negative screw rod is movably connected to the inner wall of one side of the charging pile main body, the other end of each positive and negative screw rod penetrates through one side of each clamping frame and is fixedly connected to a shaft rod of a rotating motor, one side of the rotating motor is fixedly connected to the inside of a side plate of the charging pile main body, one side of each positive and negative screw rod is provided with a round rod, two ends of each round rod are respectively fixedly connected to two sides of the inner wall of the charging pile main body, the outer side of each round rod is movably connected to one side of each clamping frame, and one side of each clamping frame is attached to one side of a charging gun head.

title_en: Novel power battery module sampling connector fixed knot constructs
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of power batteries and discloses a novel power battery module sampling connector fixing structure which comprises a plastic part support, wherein an epoxy plate is arranged at the upper end of the plastic part support, aluminum bus I is arranged on the left side of the epoxy plate, the upper end of the epoxy plate is fixedly connected with a connector body, and a plastic film sucking body is arranged at the lower end of the plastic part support. This novel power battery module sampling connector fixed knot constructs, the connector body that the interface direction is the horizontal direction has been set up, do not occupy battery module end plate space, the plug is convenient, do benefit to mill's assembly, and the level is qualified for the next round of competitions when not influenced safety by condensate, facilitate the use, the upper end of working of plastics support is provided with the bubble cotton, effectively avoid the effect of the fixed scheme behind the rivet inefficacy, the reliability of product has been improved, the working of plastics support has integrated the effect of location and fixed connector body, the utilization ratio of sub-part has been improved, the cost is reduced.

title_en: Low-voltage reactive compensation capacitor cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of low-voltage reactive compensation, and discloses a low-voltage reactive compensation capacitor cabinet which comprises a cabinet body, wherein a base is fixedly connected to the bottom of the cabinet body, a placing groove is formed in the front end and the rear end of the bottom of the base, a fixed block is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the placing groove, a driving assembly is fixedly connected to the inside of the fixed block, support rods are rotatably connected to the left side and the right side of the driving assembly, wheels are fixedly connected to the bottom of the support rods, a shell is fixedly connected to the bottom of the rear end of the cabinet body, a pushing assembly is slidably connected to the inside of the left side of the shell, and a clamping column is fixedly connected to the front end of the pushing assembly. According to the utility model, the capacitor box can be conveniently installed and moved, the problem of damage risk such as sprain or back damage caused by manual transportation is solved, the filter plate can be quickly replaced, and the heat dissipation effect is prevented from being influenced by long-time replacement of the filter plate.

title_en: Waterproof connector
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of connectors, in particular to a waterproof connector which comprises a main body, a shell, a sealing element and a terminal structure, wherein the shell is arranged on the left end face, the right end face and the top end face of the main body in a wrapping mode, an inserting port is formed in the main body, the inserting port extends out of the front end face of the main body, the sealing element is arranged at the position where the inserting port extends out of the main body, the terminal structure is arranged on the main body and extends out of the rear end face of the main body, the terminal structure is positioned at one end in the main body and is connected with the inserting port, and a glue sealing structure for waterproof is arranged on the rear end face of the main body.

title_en: Condensed water treatment device and energy storage container
abstract_en: The utility model provides a condensed water treatment device and an energy storage container, wherein the condensed water treatment device comprises a water collecting tank, a water guide pipeline and a water pump, the water collecting tank is connected with a condensed water collecting pipe and used for collecting and concentrating condensed water in the energy storage container, a first end of the water guide pipeline is connected with the water collecting tank, the other end of the water guide pipeline extends into an outdoor unit of the energy storage container, the water guide pipeline is used for conveying the condensed water collected in the water collecting tank into the outdoor unit and discharging the condensed water to a heat exchanger fin of the outdoor unit, and the water pump is arranged on the water guide pipeline and used for driving the condensed water to flow towards the outdoor unit. By arranging the condensed water treatment device, the condensed water in the energy storage container can be collected and conveyed to the heat exchanger fins of the outdoor unit, so that the heat dissipation effect of the outdoor heat exchanger in a high-temperature environment is remarkably improved, the energy consumption is reduced, the air conditioner is prevented from being stopped under high-temperature protection, the air conditioner can be normally operated in the high-temperature environment, and the safe and stable operation of the battery module is ensured.

title_en: Large-size particle cutting and removing device for lithium battery diaphragm
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a large-cutting particle removing device for a lithium battery diaphragm, which comprises an unreeling roller, a slitting roller, an upper rolling roller and a lower rolling roller, wherein a plurality of guide rollers are respectively arranged between the unreeling roller and the slitting roller, between the slitting roller and the upper rolling roller, and between the slitting roller and the lower rolling roller, a static removing mechanism and an adsorption mechanism are also arranged between the slitting roller and the upper rolling roller, and between the slitting roller and the lower rolling roller, the static removing mechanism is a plurality of ion wind bars, the adsorption mechanism is an upper vacuum adsorption roller set and a lower vacuum adsorption roller set, and the vacuum adsorption roller set comprises two vacuum adsorption rollers which are respectively attached to the inner side and the outer side of the diaphragm. According to the utility model, the positive and negative charge-carrying air mass generated by the ion air bar is used for neutralizing the charges on the diaphragm, so that the electrostatic adsorption acting force of the diaphragm on surface particles is reduced, and then the particles on the surface of the diaphragm are adsorbed into the cavities in the roller by using the vacuum adsorption roller.

title_en: Wireless voltage sensor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wireless voltage sensor, which belongs to the technical field of sensors and comprises a first shell and a second shell, wherein two screws are arranged in the first shell and the second shell, and the same OLED display screen is arranged between the first shell and the second shell; according to the utility model, the sensor can measure direct current and alternating current data according to actual conditions by being provided with the control assembly, the first interface, the second interface and the OLED display screen, so that the sensor has higher applicability, and can be directly spliced with external JK5 through the second interface without wiring, the operation is simple, the sensor can be independently used, the sensor can automatically measure the voltage of a power distribution loop, the measured data is transmitted to the control center of the Internet of things and the OLED display screen through a WIFI or RS485 signal line, and a pair of conversion dry contacts are arranged inside the sensor, so that the sensor can automatically and real-timely acquire the voltage of the power distribution loop.

title_en: Novel FPC connector structure capable of reducing bending impedance
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of FPC connectors, in particular to a novel FPC connector structure capable of reducing bending impedance, which comprises a device main body, wherein the front end and the rear end of the device main body are fixedly connected with heat dissipation mechanisms, the front part and the rear part of the lower end of the device main body are respectively provided with a movable groove, the left side of the inner surface of each movable groove and the right side of the inner surface are respectively fixedly connected with a fixed block, the lower part of the left end of each fixed block is respectively provided with a movable hole, and the inner surfaces of the front two movable holes and the inner surfaces of the rear two movable holes are respectively and movably connected with an anti-bending mechanism. According to the novel FPC connector structure capable of reducing bending resistance, the heat dissipation mechanisms are arranged at the front end and the rear end of the device main body, when the device is used, the two heat dissipation mechanisms can dissipate heat of the device, stability of the device in use is guaranteed, meanwhile, the aluminum plate is arranged in the heat dissipation mechanism, the aluminum plate is high in self hardness, and damage caused by longitudinal bending of the device in use can be prevented.

title_en: Stable-connection single-drive multi-connection connector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stably connected single-drive multi-connection connector, which adopts the arrangement of a plurality of guide connection parts to carry out matched clamping with conductive parts by adopting different guide connection parts for different wires, so that each guide connection part carries out adaptive deformation according to the corresponding wire, and the advantage of stable clamping of each wire is realized.

title_en: Semi-automatic rubberizing machine of flexible package lithium cell
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a semi-automatic rubberizing machine for a flexible package lithium battery, and aims to provide the semi-automatic rubberizing machine for the flexible package lithium battery, which has high production efficiency, good rubberizing quality, high qualification rate and reduced operation burden of workers. The automatic glue folding machine comprises a frame and a feeding workbench, wherein a film assembly, a glue clamping assembly, a glue pulling assembly, a front glue attaching assembly and a back glue folding assembly are arranged on the frame, the glue clamping assembly is positioned on one side of the film assembly, the glue pulling assembly is connected with the frame in a sliding mode and corresponds to the glue clamping assembly, the back glue folding assembly is positioned below the front glue attaching assembly and corresponds to the feeding workbench, and the glue folding assembly comprises a glue folding plate, a glue clamping plate and a glue folding cylinder, and the glue folding plate is arranged at the movable end of the glue folding cylinder and is matched with the glue clamping plate. The utility model is applied to the technical field of automatic rubberizing.

title_en: Ion generating device and air duct
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ion generating device and an air duct, comprising: a base; the mounting seat is provided with mounting holes and is distributed on the base in an array structure; the gap is used as an air flow channel and is arranged between the adjacent mounting seats; the wiring grooves are formed in the base and are communicated with the mounting holes in each mounting seat; the ion emission head is arranged in the mounting hole of the mounting seat, and the emission end of the ion emission head is arranged in an inward inclined structure towards the geometric center of the base; the conducting strip is arranged in the wiring groove, and conducting pins electrically connected with the ion emission heads are arranged at positions, extending into each mounting seat, of the conducting strip. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the beneficial effects that: the ion emission head adopts an inward inclined structure mode to offset the problem that emitted ions repel each other due to like charges, and meanwhile, the ion emission head is more compact in overall structure, reliable in electric connection relationship and high in stability through a reasonable layout connection mode.

title_en: Permanent magnet synchronous electronic rotor structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a permanent magnet synchronous electronic rotor structure, which comprises an injection molding squirrel cage, a rotor iron core and a permanent magnet; the rotor core comprises a second rotor core and a plurality of uniformly distributed first rotor cores; a magnetic separation tape is arranged between the first rotor core and the second rotor core, and a fine positioning hole and a plurality of magnetic separation holes are arranged on the first rotor core; the cross section of the first rotor core is isosceles triangle sector, and the cross section of the second rotor core is circular with a plurality of triangular bulges uniformly distributed. According to the utility model, the rotor core is split into the second rotor core in the middle and the first rotor core in the outer ring, the processing difficulty of the independent parts of the split type structure is lower, the production cost can be reduced, and the damaged part can be split during maintenance, so that the maintenance cost is greatly reduced. The first rotor core, the second rotor core and the permanent magnet form a complete whole through the injection molding squirrel cage, so that the strength and the precision of the rotor are effectively ensured. The utility model has the advantages of ensuring small magnetic leakage and ensuring the strength of the rotor core.

title_en: Double feedback cooperative servo joint motor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-feedback cooperative servo joint motor, which comprises a motor shell, a hollow transfer shaft, a rear cover, a harmonic speed reducer, an encoder and an output transfer flange, wherein the output transfer flange is connected with the output end of the harmonic speed reducer, one end of the hollow transfer shaft is connected with the output transfer flange through a screw, and the other end of the hollow transfer shaft is connected with the rear cover through a rear deep groove ball bearing support, and relates to the technical field of servo motors. The utility model relates to a disc encoder which consists of a reading head, an input end code disc and an output end code disc, wherein the input end code disc is in interference fit connection with a motor rotor shaft, the input end code disc is used for reading the position precision of a motor, the output end code disc is locked on a hollow switching shaft through a compression nut, so that the output end code disc is used for reading the position precision of a speed reducer after speed reduction, and the final positioning precision is ensured through differential compensation and fine adjustment, so that the motor can play more roles in design.

title_en: Overload protector
abstract_en: The utility model provides an overload protector, which comprises a base, wherein a static terminal is arranged in the base, one end of the static terminal extends to the outer side of the base, one end of the static terminal, which does not penetrate through the base, is connected with a contact, a movable terminal is also arranged in the base, one end of the movable terminal is connected with a bimetallic strip, the bimetallic strip is arranged above the contact, one end, far away from the static terminal, of the base is connected with a hexagonal bolt sleeve, and the middle part of the hexagonal bolt sleeve is movably sleeved with a button; the contact point is used for directly electrifying the static terminal and the movable terminal, the bimetallic strip is deformed due to heat generation, the contact block is directly disconnected with the contact point, the static terminal and the movable terminal are not electrified any more, the real-time induction and the rapid response are realized according to the internal temperature during use, the protection effect on a circuit is realized, the response is very sensitive, and the danger of burning caused by overlarge internal load of a motor and the like is prevented.

title_en: Battery pack and electric automobile
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a battery pack and an electric automobile. The battery panel includes: the battery comprises a plurality of battery cells, a flexible composite row, a battery energy distribution module, a control module and an external interface. The flexible composite row is connected with the battery core; the battery energy distribution module is connected with the flexible composite row; the control module is connected with the battery energy distribution module; the control module is used for controlling the on-off of the battery energy distribution module; the external interface is connected with the control module; the external interface is used for being connected with an external circuit; the circuit of the battery energy distribution module connected with the external interface is configured as a high-voltage circuit; the loop of the control module connected with the external interface is configured as a low-voltage loop; the low-pressure circuit and the high-pressure circuit are provided separately. The embodiment of the utility model is beneficial to enhancing the shock resistance and the control reliability of the battery pack.

title_en: Building construction faces limit protection device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a building construction limb protection device which comprises a base, wherein vertical rods which are vertically arranged are fixedly connected to the upper surface of the base, two vertical rods are respectively positioned at two ends of the base, a transverse guardrail is fixedly connected between the two vertical rods, a fixing hole is formed in the lower surface of the base, a supporting rod is rotatably connected in the fixing hole through a bearing, a transverse supporting rod is fixedly connected to the supporting rod, a supporting wheel is rotatably connected to the supporting rod, a sliding groove is formed in one side of the base along the length direction of the supporting rod, one end of the sliding groove is closed, a sliding rail which is matched with the sliding groove is fixedly connected to the other side of the base along the length direction of the supporting rod, the length of the sliding rail is smaller than that of the sliding groove, and an anti-drop structure for limiting the sliding rail is arranged on one side of the base, which is close to the sliding groove, so that the building construction limb protection device has good maneuverability is achieved.

title_en: Assembly structure of LED cold light source and HID lamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an assembly structure of an LED cold light source and an HID lamp, wherein a cold light source body is fixed on a lamp holder of the HID lamp, an electronic ballast and two wiring lamp holders are arranged on the lamp holder, the cold light source body comprises a cold light source and a radiator, the cold light source comprises a lamp panel provided with a plurality of LED lamp beads, the lamp panel is arranged at the bottom of the radiator, a wire is arranged on the lamp panel, the wire extends outwards from two sides of the radiator to the inside of the wiring lamp holder and is electrically connected with the electronic ballast, a screw hole is formed in the top of the radiator, the screw hole is connected with a screw rod, the screw rod penetrates through a fixing bracket and is fixedly connected through screws, and the fixing bracket is also connected with the lamp holder. The LED lamp is utilized to replace the lamp body of the existing HID lamp, the bracket is connected on the basis of the lamp holder of the HID lamp, the electronic ballast is arranged in the wiring lamp holder through the lead to supply power, the heat dissipation design of the radiator and the shell of the bracket connected with the radiator are combined, the existing HID lamp can be compatible, and the cold light source body has the characteristics of low heat, fast heat dissipation, stable performance and the like.

title_en: Quick mounting structure of national culture lamp decoration
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of cultural lamp decoration and discloses a rapid mounting structure of a national cultural lamp decoration, which comprises a mounting plate, wherein an adjusting plate is fixedly mounted at the bottom of the mounting plate, a moving block is slidably mounted at the right side of the adjusting plate, a female seat is fixedly mounted at the right side of the moving block, a male plate is spliced at the bottom of the female seat, a cultural lamp is fixedly mounted at the bottom of the male plate, a pull rod is arranged, when the cultural lamp needs to be disassembled and recovered, a dust cover at the outer side of the pull rod is unscrewed in a rotating way, the pull rod is exposed, the pull rod is pulled outwards to drive a wedge-shaped locking block to leave a clamping groove, so that the limit of a wedge-shaped inserted rod is relieved, at the moment, the spring on the wedge-shaped inserted rod is rebounded, the wedge-shaped inserted rod is pushed downwards, a distance is pulled out from a slot, and the cultural lamp can be taken down.

title_en: Modularized integrated high-low voltage power distribution cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a modularized integrated high-low voltage power distribution cabinet, which relates to the technical field of power distribution cabinets, in particular to a modularized integrated high-low voltage power distribution cabinet.

title_en: Movable reed for sealing relay
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sealed relays, and discloses a movable reed for a sealed relay, which comprises a transverse piece, wherein an arc-shaped elastic piece is fixedly connected to the left side of the transverse piece, a vertical piece is fixedly connected to the bottom of the arc-shaped elastic piece, a first U-shaped plate is fixedly connected to the right side of the vertical piece, a round hole is formed in the first U-shaped plate, a bolt is arranged on the inner wall of the round hole in a fitting manner, a first limiting ring is fixedly connected to the surface of the bolt, and the surface of the first limiting ring is in contact with the inner wall of the first U-shaped plate.
