According to the utility model, the first U-shaped plate, the round hole, the bolt, the first limiting ring, the first strip-shaped hole, the threaded cylinder, the second strip-shaped hole, the limiting support and the strip-shaped ring are arranged, wherein when the bolt rotates, the position of the limiting support on the bolt is changed through the cooperation of the bolt and the threaded cylinder, the rotation stroke of the transverse piece is changed through the limiting support, and the movable reed has the function of adjusting the stroke of the movable contact.

title_en: Leg structure and robot
abstract_en: The application discloses a leg structure and a robot, which comprises a motor assembly, a leg rod part and a radiator, wherein the radiator at least comprises a water tank, a pumping device and a radiating pipe, a driving motor in the motor assembly is arranged on a first side wall of the leg rod part, the water tank is wrapped on an annular outer wall of the driving motor and stores cooling liquid, and a liquid outlet and a liquid inlet of the water tank are communicated with the radiating pipe to form a liquid loop for the cooling liquid to flow; at least part of the radiating pipes are annularly distributed in a space between the annular outer wall and the water tank along the driving motor, the pumping device is arranged on the liquid loop and is used for generating power to enable the cooling liquid to circularly flow in the liquid loop. According to the technical scheme provided by the application, the leg motor can be efficiently radiated.

title_en: Multifunctional street lamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional street lamp, which comprises a stand column, a fixed frame, a driving mechanism and a plurality of lighting units, wherein the fixed frame is arranged above the stand column and is fixedly connected with the stand column, the fixed frame is a polygonal frame, each side of the fixed frame is at least provided with one lighting unit, each lighting unit is respectively hinged with the fixed frame, each lighting unit is synchronously driven by the driving mechanism to rotate around the fixed frame and can be synchronously unfolded to disperse lighting or synchronously raised to enclose for concentrated lighting, each lighting unit is provided with a solar charging assembly, and the solar charging assembly is used for converting solar energy into electric energy to supply power for the lighting unit of the solar charging assembly, so that various different lighting modes can be provided, the ornamental value of the street lamp can be improved, and a color and interestingness are added to a city.

title_en: Dustproof structure of power distribution cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dustproof structure of a power distribution cabinet, which comprises a power distribution cabinet body, wherein a heat dissipation mechanism is arranged on the upper end face of the power distribution cabinet body, a dustproof device is arranged on the upper end face of the power distribution cabinet body and is positioned above the heat dissipation mechanism, the dustproof device comprises four support rods, the four support rods are respectively positioned at four corners of the upper end face of the power distribution cabinet body, dust-proof plates are fixedly arranged at the top ends of the four support rods, and limiting grooves are formed in the upper end faces of the dust-proof plates. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the dustproof device, dust in the air conveyed into the power distribution cabinet body can be filtered, so that the dust in the air conveyed into the power distribution cabinet body is prevented from affecting the normal work of internal electric elements due to accumulation, and the radiating dustproof net is convenient to detach and install, so that the cleaning and replacement of the radiating dustproof net are simpler and more convenient.

title_en: Motor with concealed installation of external centrifugal switch
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a motor with an external centrifugal switch in hidden installation, which comprises a motor body, wherein a motor fan housing is arranged at the rear end of the motor body, a containing cavity is formed in a rear end cover of the motor body from outside to inside, and a rotor rear shaft of the motor body penetrates through the rear end cover and extends out of the containing cavity; the centrifugal mechanism of the centrifugal switch is arranged on the rotor rear shaft in the accommodating chamber, the fixed switch of the centrifugal switch is arranged at the bottom of the accommodating chamber, the rotor rear shaft is sleeved with the fan blade, the fan blade is covered on the accommodating chamber, and the fan blade and the rear end cover are positioned in the motor fan cover. The motor has smaller size, raised protecting level and prolonged service life. Meanwhile, the wind collecting and air supplying effects are improved, and the cooling effect of the fan blades on the outer wall of the motor is fully exerted.

title_en: Paying-off device for comprehensive wiring of data center
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pay-off device for comprehensive wiring of a data center, which comprises a base, wherein the base is rotationally connected with a wire fixing mechanism for placing coiled wires, the wire fixing mechanism comprises a main shaft, a fixing disc and a fixing nut, the main shaft is rotationally connected with the base, the fixing disc is fixedly connected with one end of the main shaft, the other end of the main shaft is in threaded connection with the fixing nut, at least one partition plate is arranged between the fixing disc and the fixing nut, and the middle part of the partition plate is provided with a shaft hole in sliding connection with the main shaft; the base is equipped with the fixture that is used for the centre gripping wire rod in the one side that is located wire rod fixed establishment, and fixture includes upper roller and lower roller with main shaft parallel distribution, and the both ends symmetry that are located fixture is equipped with the fixing base, upper roller and lower roller rotate with the fixing base respectively and be connected, and upper roller is located the top of lower roller, and the fixing base is equipped with the adjustment mechanism who adjusts the high position of upper roller. The utility model can lead the wire to be tidy and straight when the wire is discharged.

title_en: Pre-stacking apparatus
abstract_en: The application relates to a pre-stacking device, which comprises a first conveying mechanism, a second conveying mechanism and a pre-stacking mechanism. The first conveying mechanism is used for conveying a first material, and a first transplanting station is arranged at the downstream of the first conveying mechanism along the conveying direction. The second conveying mechanism is used for conveying a second material, and a second transplanting station is arranged at the downstream of the second conveying mechanism along the conveying direction of the second conveying mechanism. The pre-stacking mechanism comprises a pre-stacking table and a pre-stacking transplanting variable-distance assembly, the pre-stacking table is arranged between the first transplanting station and the second transplanting station, the pre-stacking table is provided with a pre-stacking station, and the pre-stacking transplanting variable-distance assembly is used for transplanting the first material and the second material to the pre-stacking station according to a preset stacking sequence. The layout mode between the first conveying mechanism, the second conveying mechanism and the pre-stacking mechanism can enable pre-stacking equipment to be compact, space required by production of the pre-stacking equipment can be saved, space utilization is high, stacking of the first material and the second material is facilitated to be completed in time, and production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Electric circuit construction fixed knot constructs
abstract_en: The application discloses an electric circuit construction fixing structure, which relates to the technical field of electric construction and comprises a fixing base, wherein a plurality of supporting feet are arranged on the outer wall of the top of the fixing base, one end of the top of each supporting foot is fixedly provided with a same silicon rubber supporting plate, two fixing plates are symmetrically arranged on the outer wall of the top of each silicon rubber supporting plate, adjustable fixing mechanisms are arranged on the two fixing plates, a plurality of rubber placing pipes are arranged on the outer wall of the top of each silicon rubber supporting plate, clamping mechanisms are arranged on the rubber placing pipes, and a long plate is detachably arranged on the outer wall of one side of the fixing base. According to the application, under the cooperation of the long plate and the like, the disc rotates to drive the screw to rotate, the screw rotates to drive the long plate to move upwards, and the long plate moves upwards to drive the fixed base to move upwards, so that lines with different heights can be quickly installed, and the device is simple and convenient.

title_en: Static electricity eliminating device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a static electricity eliminating device, which comprises a static electricity eliminator main body and a connection controller for controlling the static electricity eliminator main body; the main body of the static eliminator utilizes air ionization (X-Ray) to eliminate static, and Corona discharge electrodes are not used, so that metal sheets are not generated, the static eliminator is suitable for clean rooms which are sensitive to pollution, and the static elimination rate is faster than that of Corona discharge types; generating ions by using soft X-rays to uniformly generate positive ions and negative ions, and obtaining an ability to eliminate static electricity regardless of the polarity of charged surface charges; no need to send ions by blowing, and static electricity can be eliminated even under inert gas; the control circuit board is used for controlling the power panel to realize voltage boosting and outputting high voltage to the electron beam glass tube, and the real-time control is carried out through the control tube voltage and tube current.

title_en: Fixing structure and electric control box with same
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fixing structure and an electric control box with the same, relates to the technical field of electric control boxes, and is designed for solving the problem that the existing capacitor fixing structure cannot be compatible with capacitors with different diameters. This fixed knot constructs including electric capacity mount, electric capacity mount has and holds the chamber and be used for making electric capacity pack into the installing port that holds the chamber, holds the chamber and includes roof and lateral wall, and the installing port is relative with the roof, and the terminal export has been seted up to the roof, and the lateral wall is provided with the elasticity knot that stretches into and holds the chamber, and the elasticity knot includes high-order buckle and low-order buckle, wherein, along the axial of electric capacity, forms first clearance between high-order buckle and the roof, forms the second clearance between low-order buckle and the roof, and first clearance is less than the second clearance. The utility model can be compatible with capacitors with different diameters, thereby realizing the purpose of fixing the capacitors with different diameters.

title_en: Portable desktop water pump
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable desktop water pump, which comprises an upper shell and a first water outlet pipe, wherein the bottom of the upper shell is connected with a lower shell through screws in a screwed manner, the first water outlet pipe is connected with a water outlet arranged on the surface of the upper shell in an inserting manner, the top of the first water outlet pipe is connected with a second water outlet pipe through a sleeve, the sleeve sleeved at the joint of the first water outlet pipe and the second water outlet pipe is removed by pulling the first water outlet pipe out of the water outlet in the upper shell, so that the first water outlet pipe, the second water outlet pipe and the upper shell are separated from each other, a water inlet pipe can be pulled out of a water inlet and is stored in a storage shell at the bottom of the lower shell, the problem that the water inlet pipe is lost due to small size after the water inlet pipe is detached is avoided, and the size of the water pump is reduced by detaching the first water outlet pipe, the second water outlet pipe and the water inlet pipe, and the water inlet pipe are convenient to store and carry out.

title_en: Manual joint-setting misoperation prevention structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a manual closing-setting misoperation preventing structure, which particularly relates to the technical field of closing safety, and comprises the following steps: the circuit breaker comprises a circuit breaker main body, wherein a switch gate is arranged on the circuit breaker main body; the fixed block is characterized in that a supporting plate is fixedly arranged at the top of the rear side of the fixed block, the supporting plate is arranged at the top end of the main body of the circuit breaker, a plurality of movable grooves are formed in the top end of the fixed block, movable limiting plates are arranged in the movable grooves, and the movable limiting plates are arranged at the top ends of the switch gates; the movable limiting plates are provided with two limiting holes, and one end of each movable limiting rod penetrates through the front end of each fixed block and extends into one limiting hole. According to the utility model, the fixed block convenient to detach and other structures on the fixed block are arranged on the breaker main body, so that the closed switch brake can be limited, the situation that the switch brake is closed by misoperation of other people is avoided, and further the situation that potential safety hazards are brought to maintenance personnel by misoperation of other people is avoided.

title_en: TF card seat capable of preventing false pull
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a TF card holder capable of preventing false pulling, which comprises a TF card holder, wherein a TF memory card is connected with the inner wall of the TF card holder in a clamping manner, and a false pulling preventing mechanism is movably connected with the outer wall of the TF card holder. According to the TF card seat capable of preventing the false pulling, the false pulling preventing mechanism is convenient for preventing the TF memory card from being separated from the inner cavity of the TF card seat due to false pulling and false touching, the protection performance is enhanced, the movable connecting holes formed in the two sides of the TF card seat are utilized for connecting the movable posts to move, the movable connecting plates are used for being positioned on the two sides of the TF card seat and are convenient for moving, then when the TF memory card is positioned in the inner cavity of the TF card seat, the positioning insertion bar connected with the lower end of the positioning connecting plate is clamped into the positioning insertion groove, then the triangular positioning block is clamped into the positioning anti-falling hole for positioning, and one end of the TF memory card is sealed by the positioning connecting plate, so that the separation and careless touching of the TF memory card are prevented, and the firmness is enhanced.

title_en: Detachable mounting structure for junction box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of junction boxes, and discloses a detachable mounting structure for a junction box, which comprises a junction box, wherein positioning assemblies are respectively arranged on two sides of the inner wall of the junction box; according to the utility model, the locking ring is screwed, so that when the external thread groove on the mounting pipe orifice gradually moves to one end of the positioning block, the positioning block on the circumference of one end of the fixing ring can be contracted towards the circle center by the locking ring, and one end of the wire pipe penetrating into the junction box can be meshed and fixed, thus one end of the wire pipe penetrating into the junction box is positioned, and the wire pipe is prevented from being separated from the junction box when the wire pipe is pulled through wires; compare in current terminal box and spool cross-under position, increased to penetrating the detachable positioning mechanism of spool, prevented that spool and terminal box from linking the breaking away from of position, the cable is when the pull, takes place wearing and tearing, carries out firm location with the spool of cable and box cross-under position.

title_en: Cable joint
abstract_en: The utility model provides a cable joint, which belongs to the technical field of connecting pieces and comprises: the connector comprises a connector body, a gland nut, a sealing ring and a gasket, wherein a first channel, a second channel and a third channel which are sequentially communicated are arranged on the connector body along the axial direction, the inner circular surface of the second channel is a conical surface, the gland nut is in threaded connection with the third channel, the sealing ring is arranged between the conical surface and the gland nut, a conical pressing surface matched with the conical surface is arranged towards the conical surface, a pressing plane is arranged towards the gland nut, and the gasket is arranged between the pressing plane and the gland nut; when the compression nut is screwed, the sealing ring is pressed and pushed to the conical surface, and under the interaction action between the conical surface and the corresponding conical pressing surface of the sealing ring, the pressure applied by the sealing ring to the cable is increased, so that the fastening effect of the cable connector to the cable is enhanced, and the reliability and stability of the cable connecting part are effectively improved.

title_en: AC compensation type regulated power supply
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an alternating current compensation type stabilized voltage supply, which relates to the technical field of power supply voltage stabilization and comprises a shell, wherein the front surface of the shell is rotationally connected with a box door, the inner wall of the box door is fixedly connected with a door lock, the front surface of the box door is fixedly connected with a voltage conversion switch, the front surface of the box door is fixedly connected with a voltmeter, and the inside of the shell is slidably connected with a supporting plate. The utility model has reasonable design structure, can open the box door through the cooperation of the components such as the voltage stabilizing controller, the sliding mechanism and the like, pulls the supporting plate, and the lower part of the supporting plate slides to the outside of the shell under the action of the sliding mechanism, and then fixes the supporting plate through the fixing mechanism, so that the electric elements on the supporting plate slide out of the inside of the shell, the maintenance space is increased, the maintenance convenience effect is further enhanced, and the problems of lower internal space, insufficient maintenance space, poor maintenance efficiency and inconvenient later maintenance of the voltage stabilizing power supply are solved.

title_en: Corn breeding illumination simulation device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of corn breeding, in particular to a corn breeding illumination simulation device, which comprises a box body, wherein two sides of the box body are provided with a first fixing hole, a rotating shaft is inserted into the two first fixing holes, and a first fixing column is inserted into one of the first fixing holes. The utility model has the advantages that: this maize breeding illumination analogue means when needs the angle of illumination lamp to adjust, rotate the handle for the second belt pulley rotates, through the effect of belt, and then makes first belt pulley rotate, and first belt pulley rotates and then drives the pivot and rotate, and the pivot rotates and then makes fixed block, electric putter, fixed plate and a plurality of light rotate, and the light rotates and then has realized the regulation of the angle of illumination, has solved when maize breeding, can use the light lamp strip to fix in the top of breeding basin, and the angle of illumination is inconvenient to adjust, unable comprehensive problem of covering when illuminating maize seed.

title_en: Current collector, pole piece and battery
abstract_en: The application discloses a current collector, a pole piece and a battery. The current collector comprises a support layer, a metal layer and a metal foil layer. The support layer has a first surface and a second surface, each of the first surface and the second surface including a first region and a second region, the first region being contiguous with the second region; the metal layer is plated on the second area; the metal foil layer is arranged in the first area and is adjacent to the metal layer. The current collector, the pole piece and the battery can solve the problem that the current collector in the prior art is inconvenient to weld the pole lug.

title_en: Hidden self-locking connector structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hidden self-locking connector structure which comprises an insulating base, a riveting wire terminal and a connecting wire, wherein the insulating base comprises an insulating plate, a plurality of riveting wire fixing grooves which are distributed at equal intervals are formed in one side, close to the riveting wire terminal, of the insulating plate, a limiting plate is arranged in one side, close to the riveting wire terminal, of the first through groove, a stitch connecting groove is formed in one side, far from the riveting wire fixing groove, of the insulating base, the riveting wire terminal comprises a rectangular connecting pipe, second through grooves are formed in the upper side and the lower side of the rectangular connecting pipe, a pressing plate is arranged below the second through grooves which are located at the upper end of the rectangular connecting pipe, and stitch gaskets are arranged above the second through grooves which are located at the lower end of the rectangular connecting pipe. The connector is simple in structure, small in occupied space, good in universality and good in connection stability between connector structures, the phenomenon that cables are loose is avoided, and the use stability of the connector structure is effectively improved.

title_en: Multi-part fixed medical head lamp capable of being adjusted at multiple angles
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-part fixed multi-angle adjustable medical head lamp which comprises a multi-part fixed assembly, an angle adjusting assembly and an illuminating lamp, wherein the multi-part fixed assembly comprises a hoop, a first adjusting ring arranged outside the hoop, a limiting hoop arranged on the upper side of the hoop and a second adjusting ring arranged outside the limiting hoop, and a first adjusting bolt is arranged on the first adjusting ring. This multi-part fixed multi-angle adjustable's medical headlight rotates through setting up first motor drive lead screw, and pivoted lead screw drives slider and sliding plate and slides about, and then drives the light and move about, and the second motor drive pivot through setting up rotates, and pivoted pivot drives the rolling plate and rotates, and then drives the light and rotate to the illumination lamp carries out multi-angle regulation, can carry out multi-part fixed to the head of wearer through adjustable hoop and the spacing hoop of setting up, thereby ensures that it wears stably.

title_en: Novel anti-theft cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel anti-theft cabinet, which comprises a cabinet body, wherein a through groove is formed in the upper end of the cabinet body, a placement box is arranged in the cabinet body, a supporting plate is fixedly arranged at the top end of the placement box, a driving mechanism is arranged at the inner bottom of the cabinet body and connected with the bottom of the placement box, a damping mechanism is also arranged in the cabinet body, the inner top of the placement box is provided with illumination, the driving mechanism comprises a driving box fixedly arranged at the inner bottom of the cabinet body, a motor is fixedly arranged at one side of the driving box, a worm wheel and a worm are arranged in the driving box, the worm wheel is meshed with the worm, an output shaft of the motor penetrates through the driving box and is fixedly connected with one end of the worm, a rotating shaft is rotatably connected with the inner bottom of the driving box and fixedly arranged on the worm wheel, a threaded sleeve is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the placement box, a rotatable threaded rod is penetrated in the threaded sleeve, and the lower end of the threaded rod is fixedly connected with the upper end of the rotating shaft.

title_en: Shearing mechanism is used in national dress production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a shearing mechanism is used in national clothing production belongs to national clothing processing technology field, the on-line screen storage device comprises a base, the top fixedly connected with of base cuts the platform, the top sliding connection of base has the regulating plate, the top fixedly connected with portal frame of regulating plate, electric telescopic handle is installed to the inside wall of portal frame, electric telescopic handle's telescopic end fixedly connected with lug. Through electric telescopic handle operation, the lug drives the kelly and removes, shears the cutter and shears the processing to the cloth, through the cooperation use of kicking block and installation piece for the slant board drives the ion fan and removes when shearing the cutter and removes, and the effect that the static caused in the rethread ion fan eliminates the shearing in-process, thereby avoids shearing the waste material that produces in the cutting process to adsorb on the cutter, further increases shearing precision, avoids tiny fibre adhesion together at shearing in-process simultaneously, and then increases the planarization at national dress cloth cutting edge.

title_en: Multifunctional mobile power supply
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multifunctional mobile power supply, which relates to the technical field of power supplies and comprises a bottom plate, a front panel and side plates, wherein the front panel is arranged at the front end of the bottom plate, the side plates are arranged on two sides of the bottom plate, a cover plate is covered above the side plates, an inner cavity is formed among the bottom plate, the front panel, the side plates and the cover plate, a middle partition plate is arranged at the middle position inside the inner cavity, a battery pack is arranged inside the inner cavity at the lower position of the middle partition plate, an electric control part connected with the battery pack is arranged inside the inner cavity at the upper position of the middle partition plate, and a control output part connected with the electric control part is arranged on the front panel; according to the utility model, the battery pack and the electric control part for control are placed in the inner cavity formed by the bottom plate, the front panel, the side plates and the cover plate, and the handle can be rotated to push the front handle rod or push the rear handle rod when moving, so that the power supply can be moved integrally, and the portable electric bicycle is more convenient to carry by matching with the functions of the universal wheels and the rear wheels.

title_en: Inverter, fuel cell system, and vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to an inverter, a fuel cell system and a vehicle. The converter comprises a box body, a first power piece, a heat dissipation piece and a second power piece, wherein the box body comprises a bottom plate and a side plate which are connected, the bottom plate and the side plate are enclosed to form a containing cavity, and the bottom plate is provided with a first flow channel; the first power piece, the heat dissipation piece and the second power piece are sequentially arranged on the bottom plate in a stacked mode and are positioned in the accommodating cavity, and the first power piece and the second power piece are used for boosting or reducing the voltage input into the converter; the heat dissipation piece is provided with a second flow passage, the first flow passage and the second flow passage can be communicated and are used for circulating cooling fluid, and the bottom plate is matched with the heat dissipation piece and used for dissipating heat of the first power piece and the second power piece. The converter has a good heat dissipation effect.

title_en: Conductive terminal
abstract_en: The utility model provides a conductive terminal, including the terminal body of integral type, this terminal body includes from front to back continuous wiring portion in proper order, installation department and connect the portion of inserting, connect the portion of inserting and connect electric structure including two side by side spaced, each connect electric structure to have two electric shrapnel that set up relatively from top to bottom, be formed with between two electric shrapnel and be suitable for conductive insert male clamping gap, installation department is provided with in the top or the below that connects electric structure and ends the unit for prevent to connect electric structure to relieving clamp direction swing by a wide margin, so that make to connect electric shrapnel to keep pressing from both sides the state of tight conductive insert after inserting the clamping gap. The utility model has the beneficial effects that the abutting unit matched with the electric connection structure is arranged to prevent the electric connection structure from swinging upwards or downwards to a large extent under the non-clamping releasing state, so that the electric connection structure has the capability of resisting the action of external force, thereby further keeping the contact stability and further ensuring the electric connection effect.

title_en: Voiceprint detection device of brush motor and motor data acquisition device
abstract_en: Voiceprint detection apparatus and motor data acquisition device of brush motor, voiceprint monitor includes: the device comprises a placing seat, a built-in seat, a detection head and a monitoring component; an outer seat cavity is arranged in the placement seat; an external groove is arranged on the outer side of the placement seat, and a detection port exposing the outer seat cavity is arranged in the external groove; the built-in seat is arranged in the outer seat cavity; the detection head is arranged on the internal seat and extends into the external groove through the detection port; the bone conduction sensing mechanisms are connected with the detection head or the built-in seat and distributed in different directions of the detection head; the sound recording mechanism is arranged on the built-in seat and is provided with a sound input end. The motor data acquisition device uses the voiceprint monitor; the motor abnormality judgment method and device can judge the abnormality of the motor according to different vibration information and sound information, improve the abnormality judgment accuracy, and solve the problems of difficult motor data acquisition and inaccurate data.

title_en: Anti-winding underwater sealing power generation device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an antiwind seals power generation facility under water, include the cutting blade group of electricity generation, still include one-level sealing device, a first main bevel gear, the bevel gear train, a second main bevel gear, the motor shaft, second grade sealing device and cutting blade group, the cutting blade group of electricity generation is fixed with first main bevel gear connection, bevel gear train and motor shaft connection are fixed, second main bevel gear is fixed as an organic wholely with cutting blade group connection through second grade sealing device, first main bevel gear, bevel gear train, second main bevel gear meshes in proper order, one-level sealing device, second grade sealing device mutually suit is fixed in the cutting blade group of electricity generation and cutting blade group inside, the device outside sets up mechanical seal device and motor fixing device again; the utility model provides a prior art's underwater power generation device, the leakproofness is poor and easily twine by the underwater plant, damages quick life-span short difficult problem, has realized rivers and has cut aquatic plant when generating electricity from the source, compact structure, the design is exquisite, simple to operate, unmanned maintenance, green low carbon.

title_en: Motor magnet mounting rack
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of installation frames and discloses a motor magnet installation frame which comprises a workbench, wherein a connecting rod is fixedly connected to the top wall of the workbench, a fixing piece is fixedly connected to the top wall of the connecting rod, telescopic rods are fixedly connected to the left side and the right side of the inner wall of the fixing piece, an installation block is fixedly connected to the output end of each telescopic rod, a clamp is installed on the right side of each installation block, the two clamps are rotationally connected through a hinge, a replacement assembly is arranged on the left side of the fixing piece, a conveying mechanism is arranged on the top wall of the workbench, the replacement assembly comprises a threaded column, the threaded column is rotationally connected to the inner wall of the fixing piece, a buffer pad is fixedly connected to the left end of the threaded column, and a knob is fixedly connected to the left side of the buffer pad. According to the utility model, the mounting blocks are driven by the two telescopic rods, and the two clamps are rotationally connected by the hinge, so that the device can fix the magnet, and the mounting is more accurate.

title_en: Multipath power supply fuse box for new energy automobile
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multipath power supply fuse box for a new energy automobile. The technical scheme adopted comprises the following steps: the base, establish shunt row on the base, through large fuse with first output binding post and a set of respectively through small fuse with the second output binding post that the shunt was arranged and is connected, the shunt is U-shaped structure, including middle wiring portion, left wiring portion and right wiring portion, first output binding post pass through large fuse connect in the middle wiring portion rear end of shunt row, second output binding post pass through small fuse connect respectively in the left wiring portion and the right wiring portion rear end of shunt row, the front end of left side wiring portion is equipped with big bolt.

title_en: Attached intelligent double-color temperature-regulating control device
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of tunnel dimming control, and particularly relates to an attached intelligent double-color temperature dimming control device which comprises an upper cover, a PCB (printed circuit board), a bottom shell, a left baffle and a right baffle; the PCB is arranged on the bottom shell, the upper cover is connected above the bottom shell, the left baffle and the right baffle are respectively fixed on the left side and the right side of the bottom shell, and the PCB is provided with a power supply device, a Bluetooth device, a 4G communication device, an alternating current input/output terminal, a lamp monitoring device and a double-color temperature dimming device; the Bluetooth device is connected with the bi-color temperature dimming device through unidirectional signals, the lamp monitoring device is connected with the Bluetooth device through unidirectional signals, and the Bluetooth device is connected with the 4G communication device through bidirectional signals. According to the application, the double-color-temperature lamp can be regulated according to the condition outside the tunnel, and the LED tunnel lamp is tracked to be started by the vehicle, so that the electricity waste is effectively reduced on the premise of avoiding the potential safety hazard of the vehicle running in the tunnel, the state of the lamp can be monitored in real time for maintenance, and the situation that the driving safety is influenced due to the fact that the lamp cannot be lightened due to the fault of the lamp is avoided.

title_en: Heat exchange plate and battery pack
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of heat exchange, in particular to a heat exchange plate and a battery pack. The heat exchange plate comprises a first collecting pipe, a second collecting pipe and a cooling pipe group communicated with the first collecting pipe and the second collecting pipe. The cooling pipe group comprises a plurality of runner pipes, the plurality of runner pipes are arranged side by side along the length direction of the first collecting pipe and are sequentially and fixedly connected, wherein the plurality of runner pipes are identical in structure, each runner pipe is independently arranged, and two ends of each runner pipe are respectively communicated with the first collecting pipe and the second collecting pipe, so that heat exchange media in the first collecting pipe can flow to the second collecting pipe through any runner pipe. The heat exchange plate and the battery pack provided by the application solve the problem that the dimension precision of the heat exchange plate is easy to be reduced when the traditional harmonica tube type heat exchange plate is used for harmonica tubes with different widths.

title_en: Energy-saving bus duct of light
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of bus ducts, and discloses a lightweight energy-saving bus duct, which solves the problems that the existing bus duct is inconvenient to repair and disassemble, increases the operation difficulty of operators and reduces the working efficiency, and comprises a bus duct body, wherein a connecting column is fixedly arranged at the top of the bus duct body, a mounting plate is fixedly arranged at the top of the connecting column, an equipment box is arranged at the upper side of the mounting plate, a mounting box is fixedly arranged at the top of the equipment box, a quick disassembling and assembling component is arranged in the mounting box and the equipment box, a connecting plate is fixedly arranged at the top of the mounting box, connecting holes are formed in four corners of the surface of the connecting plate, four positioning slots are formed in the surface of the mounting plate, and positioning clamping blocks are fixedly arranged in the positioning slots; this bus duct maintenance dismouting time ten minutes convenient, reduced operating personnel's the operation degree of difficulty, improved work efficiency.

title_en: Overvoltage protector of lightning protection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of overvoltage protectors, and discloses a lightning-proof overvoltage protector, which comprises a base and supporting legs arranged on the lower side of the base, wherein an overvoltage protector body is arranged on the upper side of the base, and a baffle is arranged above the overvoltage protector body; a lightning arrester is arranged on the upper side of the baffle, and a supporting rod is arranged between the baffle and the base; the upper end of the overvoltage protector body is provided with a junction plate and a connecting wire, and the output end of the overvoltage protector body is electrically connected with the junction plate; the connecting wire is electrically connected with the aggregation plate; and a grounding electrode is arranged below the base. The lightning arrester is used for protecting a building or equipment from being damaged by lightning stroke, and can introduce lightning current into the ground so as to reduce the damage of the lightning stroke; the grounding electrode is installed underground and electrically connected with the ground wire of the overvoltage protector body, and redundant electric power can be introduced into the underground so as to ensure safe operation and personal safety of equipment.

title_en: Stator support of electric vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to an electric vehicle stator bracket, which comprises two bracket bodies, wherein the bracket bodies comprise an assembly bracket and a supporting surface which is arranged at the edge of the assembly bracket and extends to one side, the assembly bracket is provided with an assembly front surface and an assembly back surface, and the two bracket bodies are fixedly assembled through the assembly front surface of the assembly bracket; the center of the assembly bracket is provided with a mounting hole, the front surface of the assembly bracket is convexly provided with a first reinforcing rib, and the first reinforcing rib is arranged around the mounting hole; the assembly support is provided with a plurality of second reinforcing ribs in a protruding mode on the front assembly surface of the assembly support, the plurality of second reinforcing ribs are distributed in a radial mode with the mounting holes as the center, and one end of each second reinforcing rib is connected with each first reinforcing rib. The application has the effect of improving the structural strength.

title_en: Multi-interface compatible charger
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of chargers, and particularly relates to a multi-interface compatible charger. The problem of among the prior art can't fix a position the circuit of inserting in the interface, phenomenon such as crisscross, winding probably take place is solved. Including the shell, the multiunit socket that is used for connecting the circuit and symmetrical evenly distributed in the both sides of shell are all offered to the outer wall of shell, limit structure that is used for fixed control circuit position is installed on the top of socket, the externally mounted of socket has the dustproof construction that is used for preventing dust entering device inside, limit structure and dustproof construction all install the outer wall at the shell, the inner chamber of shell is installed the heat radiation structure that is used for the inside heat energy of diffusion device, it is spacing fixed to promote clamp ring relatively to be close to by utilizing the elasticity of a spring self, avoid multiunit circuit to interweave together, and the circuit promotes clamp ring to both sides and remove, extrusion spring one drives the axostylus axostyle and removes in the movable groove in the fly leaf, adjust the space between the clamp ring of two sets of clamp rings, in order to adapt to the circuit of different models.

title_en: Motor
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model relates to the technical field of motors, and particularly discloses a motor, which comprises a shell, a motor cover and a motor cover, wherein a containing cavity is formed in the shell; the rear end cover is covered on the rear end opening of the accommodating cavity, a first mounting groove is formed in the rear end cover, and a mounting through hole is formed in the bottom of the first mounting groove; the rotor assembly comprises a rotating shaft and a first bearing, the rotating shaft is installed in the accommodating cavity, one end of the rotating shaft extends out of the installation through hole, and the first bearing is sleeved at one end of the rotating shaft and is installed in the first installation groove; the limiting ring is fixedly arranged at the rear end of the rear end cover, one side of the limiting ring is abutted to one side of the first bearing, which is away from the bottom of the first mounting groove, and the other side of the limiting ring or the rear end face of the rear end cover is used for mounting the encoder body. Through the mode, the embodiment of the utility model can reduce the displacement of the rotating shaft in the axial direction.

title_en: Comprehensive protection type mutual inductor temperature control module and mutual inductor temperature protection device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of transformer maintenance equipment, in particular to a comprehensive protection type transformer temperature control module and a transformer temperature protection device. Comprises a power supply control circuit for providing power supply; the temperature control circuit is used for setting a temperature upper limit, and outputting a voltage signal to control the electronic switch VT1 to be turned on when the temperature upper limit is exceeded; the temperature indication circuit is used for sending out a light alarm indication when the electronic switch VT1 is turned on and transmitting a signal to the voice integrated circuit I C; and the alarm circuit controls the triode VT2 to be conducted through the voice integrated circuit I C to enable the loudspeaker BL to be electrified to send out an audible alarm indication, so that the comprehensive protection of the temperature of the transformer is realized.

title_en: Be used for bullet train temperature sensor testing arrangement
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a testing device for a temperature sensor of a motor car, which comprises a tool seat with a heat conduction function, wherein a heating pipe for heating the tool seat is arranged in the tool seat, a cooling water channel for cooling the tool seat is arranged in the tool seat, the tool seat is provided with a cooling water outlet and a cooling water inlet which are communicated with the cooling water channel, the top of the tool seat is uniformly provided with a sensor mounting seat with the heat conduction function, the lower part of each sensor mounting seat extends into the tool seat, and the top of the tool seat is uniformly provided with a sensor pressing mechanism for fixing a temperature sensor to be tested. The utility model solves the technical problems that the existing temperature sensor has low detection efficiency and can not realize multi-temperature simulation correspondence, and is suitable for temperature sensor maintenance operation.

title_en: Photovoltaic module installing support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a photovoltaic module mounting bracket, wherein the lower end of a clamp in the mounting bracket is provided with a pull rod, the pull rod penetrates through a cross rod and is in sliding fit with the cross rod, the lower part of each pull rod is connected to a movable plate, and the pull rod is synchronously driven to stretch and retract on the cross rod through the movable plate; the solar panel fixing device has the advantages that the clamping devices can synchronously extend out through adjusting the positions of the movable plates when the solar panel fixing device is installed, after the solar panel fixing device is placed into a solar panel, the clamping devices can be simultaneously pressed on the solar panel to be fixed through locking and fixing the single movable plate, and compared with a traditional mode that a plurality of bolts are required to be disassembled and assembled to be fixed, the solar panel fixing device can greatly save installation time and improve efficiency.

title_en: Intelligent dampproofing electrical control cabinet of short circuit prevention
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent dampproof electrical control cabinet capable of preventing short circuits, which comprises a steel cabinet body, wherein a program controller is arranged at the top of one side of the rear end inside the steel cabinet body, and an intelligent dampproof mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the front end of the cabinet door. This prevent dampproofing electrical control cabinet of intelligence of short circuit is through being provided with casing, humidity transducer, suction inlet, closing plate, support frame, bar drier polymerization stick and miniature fan, during the use, the humidity transducer of casing bottom keeps detecting the humidity of the internal portion of steel cabinet, when humidity exceeds standard, miniature fan starts and with the inside air of casing constantly discharges, forms air cycle, at the circulation in-process, multiunit bar drier polymerization stick is continuous catches the hydrone in the flowing air, makes the inside air humidity of steel cabinet drop fast, has realized intelligent initiative dampproofing function, and what the device was solved does not possess intelligent initiative dampproofing function's problem.

title_en: Electromagnetic heating stove protection system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electromagnetic heating, in particular to an electromagnetic heating furnace protection system, which comprises a heating furnace body and an electromagnetic heating coil, wherein the outer side of the heating furnace body is fixedly connected with the electromagnetic heating coil through a fixed block, the top of the heating furnace body is clamped with a sealing cover, the bottom of the heating furnace body is fixedly connected with a first heat preservation layer, the top of the first heat preservation layer is fixedly connected with a second heat preservation layer, and the bottom of the first heat preservation layer is fixedly connected with a base through a fixed groove; the sensor and the protector are integrated through the fixed shell, so that the maintenance and the maintenance are convenient, and the maintenance cost and the time cost are reduced; the service life of the equipment can be prolonged through the protector assembly, and the use cost and the time cost are reduced; the intelligent recognition monitoring device can realize quick response.

title_en: Photovoltaic panel power generation and distribution equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of power generation and distribution equipment, and discloses photovoltaic panel power generation and distribution equipment, which comprises a mounting box body, wherein a mounting frame is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the mounting box body, a plurality of photovoltaic panels are fixedly arranged on the top surface of the mounting frame, two grooves are formed in the top surface of the mounting frame, an external liquid supply pump is started by a user firstly to enable external clear water to enter the inside of a connecting pipe and be sprayed out through a plurality of spray heads, so that the surface of the photovoltaic panels is conveniently washed, a screw is driven to rotate by a driving motor, so that a sliding block and a mounting plate are conveniently moved left and right, dust attached to the surface of the photovoltaic panels is conveniently cleaned, the residual of the dust is avoided as much as possible, a double-shaft telescopic cylinder drives a connecting rod and a round rod to move towards directions opposite to each other, so that the round rod is conveniently extrudes the water in the sponge pads, and the dust on the surface of the round rod is conveniently brought out together when the water is discharged, and the cleaning of the sponge pads is realized.

title_en: Negative plate, winding cell and battery
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a negative plate, a winding cell and a battery. The negative electrode plate comprises a current collector and a coating layer, wherein the coating layer comprises a first coating layer and a second coating layer, and the first coating layer and the second coating layer are respectively arranged on two sides of the current collector along the thickness direction; the negative electrode sheet comprises a corner area, the corner area is configured to be positioned at a corner of a winding cell after winding, a through hole is formed in the first coating layer at the corner area, and the through hole at least penetrates through the first coating layer and the current collector in the thickness direction of the current collector. According to the negative electrode plate, the through holes are formed in the corner areas, so that lithium ions can move to the second coating layer through the through holes, free lithium ions are absorbed and attached by means of the lithium intercalation sites on the second coating layer, the probability of lithium precipitation on the first coating layer is reduced, and the lithium precipitation problem in the lithium ion battery is effectively relieved.

title_en: Electric core stacking mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a battery cell stacking mechanism, and relates to the field of battery cell processing auxiliary equipment. The precision requirement of the electric core stacking can be met, the clamping force is controlled, and the electric core can not be ejected in the height direction and the blue film on the surface of the electric core is not scratched. The battery cell stacking mechanism comprises a grouped table datum plate, a battery jar and a hard limiting seat which are respectively arranged at two ends of the grouped table datum plate, and a plurality of loading mechanisms which are connected to the grouped table datum plate in a sliding manner; the electric cylinder is arranged along the length direction of the grouped table datum plate, a movable plate base plate is arranged on a cylinder rod of the electric cylinder, a pressure detection mechanism is arranged between the cylinder rod of the electric cylinder and the movable plate base plate, and a plurality of loading mechanisms are arranged between the movable plate base plate and the hard limiting seat. The utility model has simple structure and flexible operation, can realize stacking of groups of cells, and solves the problems of low stacking precision of most side cells and damage of blue films.

title_en: Multifunctional vehicle-mounted charger
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multi-functional on-vehicle charger, relates to on-vehicle charger equipment technical field, and it contains the charger body, charges the head and sets up in the charger body back to be connected with the charger body through the wire, be provided with at least one cigar lighter interface on the charger body, still be provided with TYPE-C port, TYPE-C flexible data line on the charger body, this internal control mainboard that is provided with of charger, control mainboard and TYPE-C port, TYPE-C flexible data line electric connection, through setting up the charger to extending structure, need not to insert in cigar lighter port department and use, can place the charger in vehicle optional position through charging the head connection and charge to set up the cigar lighter interface and can use when charging on the charger, multiple interface extension is convenient to charge to different equipment, has promoted user's use experience.

title_en: Frequency converter with bandpass device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of frequency converters, and discloses a frequency converter with a frequency-passing device, which comprises a mounting cabinet, wherein mutually symmetrical support posts are fixedly arranged at corners of the bottom surface of the mounting cabinet, gaskets are arranged on the bottom surface of the support posts, the front side surface of the mounting cabinet is hinged with a door plate, the lower end of the front side surface of the door plate is provided with a warning sign, and an observation port is formed above the warning sign. According to the utility model, through the operation of the vertical fan group, heat dissipation can be carried out on the inside of the installation cabinet, so that heat accumulation caused by long-time use is avoided, part of dust on the surface of the dust-proof plate can be blown down by cold air, so that the cleaning of the net surface of the dust-proof plate is kept, the replacement frequency of the dust-proof plate is reduced, and the frequency converter body can be installed in a suspended manner through the supporting rod, so that the outer side surface of the frequency converter body is contacted with air, the heat dissipation effect is improved, the electronic elements in the inside are protected, and the service life of the frequency converter body is prolonged.

title_en: Support cup and electric core processing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a support cup and battery cell processing equipment, the support cup comprises: the cup body is provided with a containing groove for containing the battery cell; an inner bushing arranged in the accommodating groove and positioned between the battery cell and the inner wall of the accommodating groove, wherein at least part of the inner bushing has the capacity of elastic deformation inwards from the peripheral side wall of the accommodating groove; the driving piece is at least partially positioned between the cup body and the inner bushing, and acts on the inner bushing to drive the inner bushing to elastically deform inwards from the peripheral side wall of the accommodating groove so as to lock the battery cell; the inner wall of inner liner has disposed locking face and holding surface in proper order along the axial of inner liner, wherein: the locking surface is matched with a cylindrical cavity surrounded by the supporting surface to form a locking groove for assembling and locking the battery cell. The driving piece provided by the utility model can be matched with the inner bushing with elastic deformation capability to realize quick positioning, fixing and unlocking of the battery cell.

title_en: Low-temperature radiator assembly for electric motorcycle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a low-temperature radiator assembly for an electric motorcycle, which relates to the field of electric motorcycle accessories and comprises a core component, wherein the left side surface of the core component is fixedly connected with a first water chamber component, the right side surface of the core component is fixedly connected with a second water chamber component, a second side plate component is arranged on the upper side of the core component, and a first side plate component is arranged on the lower side of the core component. According to the utility model, the first water chamber component and the second water chamber component are connected with the core component, so that the device can be integrally installed at the corresponding position of the electric motorcycle by using the bushing when the device is used, and the device can radiate heat of the battery by using the cooperation of the first water chamber component, the second water chamber component and the core component when the device works, thereby avoiding faults caused by overheat of the battery in the charging and working processes, and effectively improving the driving and using safety of the electric motorcycle.

title_en: Self-locking cable bridge
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a self-locking cable bridge which comprises a bridge body, wherein a cover plate is arranged at the top end of the inside of the bridge body, a group of connecting grooves are respectively and fixedly connected to two sides of two ends of the bottom of the bridge body, and the connecting grooves at two sides of the bottom end of the bridge body are symmetrically distributed. This from locking-type cable testing bridge is through being provided with apron, curb plate, location draw-in groove, location fixture block, empty slot and activity shell fragment, at first with the inside of pencil income testing bridge main part, later with the apron lid on the top of testing bridge main part, the curb plate laminating of apron both sides is in the inside both sides of testing bridge main part simultaneously, later promote the apron downwards and drive the inside that the curb plate inserted the testing bridge main part, the curb plate promotes location fixture block and activity shell fragment motion, the quick rebound of activity shell fragment drives the location draw-in groove block of location fixture block and curb plate one side, thereby fix a position curb plate and apron through the location draw-in groove, the problem that is unable convenient equipment is fixed is solved.

title_en: Self-locking wiring device for explosion-proof motor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a self-locking wiring device for an explosion-proof motor, and relates to the technical field of explosion-proof motors. The anti-explosion motor comprises an anti-explosion motor main body, wherein a junction box is fixedly connected to the top of the anti-explosion motor main body, a junction assembly is arranged above the junction box, a power-on seat is fixedly connected to the bottom of the inner wall of the junction box, an electric wire is arranged on the front surface of the junction box, a wire connecting ring is fixedly connected to the back surface of the electric wire, the junction assembly comprises a rotating handle, and a thread block is fixedly connected to the bottom of the rotating handle. According to the utility model, the wiring assembly is arranged, specifically, after an electric wire is inserted into the junction box, the rotating handle is rotated to drive the threaded block to rotate clockwise, the threaded block drives the pressing ring to move downwards, the pressing ring is contacted with the wiring ring and pushes the wiring ring downwards to press, so that the wiring ring is tightly attached to the gasket, the electric wire can be rapidly wired, meanwhile, a tool is not required, the operation of a worker is facilitated, and the wiring assembly is applicable to different positions.

title_en: Internal component mounting structure of frequency conversion cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an internal component mounting structure of a frequency conversion cabinet, which comprises a cabinet body, a mounting rod, a mounting plate and a guide rail, wherein the mounting plate and the guide rail are arranged on the mounting rod, the guide rail respectively forms protruding parts at two ends of a main body in a manner that the guide rail can be contacted with the mounting rod, a T-shaped screw is rotatably arranged on one side of the protruding parts, a plurality of limiting holes for accommodating the T-shaped screw are uniformly distributed on the side wall of the mounting rod, a limiting sleeve is in threaded connection with the T-shaped screw, one end of the limiting hole is provided with a circular groove matched with the limiting sleeve, and the guide rail can be quickly locked on the mounting rod by screwing the limiting sleeve into the circular groove. According to the utility model, through the assembly of the mounting rod, the guide rail, the T-shaped screw and the limiting sleeve, the components are convenient to assemble and disassemble in the cabinet body and flexibly adjusted, the locking of the guide rail can be released by unscrewing the limiting sleeve and rotating the T-shaped screw, a special tool is not required in the assembling and disassembling process, the assembly guide rail is convenient to adjust by a user, the structure is simple, the operation is convenient, and convenience is brought to the assembly of the components.

title_en: Cable erection supporting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cable erection supporting device, and relates to the technical field of cable erection. This cable erection strutting arrangement, which comprises a bracket, the inner wall of support rotates and is connected with the connecting plate, the outer wall fixed connection fixed plate of connecting plate, the top of fixed plate rotates and is connected with the pivot, the left end inner wall of pivot is through reset spring elastic connection's stopper, the left end inner wall fixedly connected with stand pipe of pivot, the outer wall fixedly connected with longeron of pivot, the top of longeron is articulated with splint through articulated lever, the inner wall of support runs through and rotates and be connected with the pipe, the bottom inner wall of pipe is through movable spring elastic connection's pressing plate, the right-hand member fixedly connected with voussoir of pressing plate. According to the utility model, multiple groups of cables can be simultaneously fixed, the cables do not need to be fixed one by one, and the supporting efficiency is improved to a certain extent.

title_en: Energy storage cabinet liquid cooling pipe dehydrating unit and energy storage cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model provides a liquid cooling pipe dehumidifying device of an energy storage cabinet and the energy storage cabinet, which belong to the field of integrated energy storage systems, and comprise pipe bodies, wherein two ends of each pipe body extend along the vertical direction of the ground and are communicated in a liquid cooling pipeline; the at least two condensing sheets are arranged outside the tube body, and the two ends of the condensing sheets extend along the axial direction of the tube body; the bottom plate is arranged on the pipe body and is positioned at one end of the condensing sheet close to the ground; at least two condensing sheets are uniformly distributed around the axial direction of the pipe body, and condensation is generated on the condensing sheets; the bottom plate and the end part of the condensing sheet, which faces the ground, are arranged at intervals, a drain pipe is arranged on the bottom plate, and the bottom plate is used for receiving the condensation dropped from the condensing sheet and discharging the condensation through the drain pipe; the utility model combines and integrates the dehumidification facility and the liquid cooling pipeline, thereby realizing fixed-point dehumidification and improving the space utilization rate; the dehumidification work can be completed without an additional refrigerating unit by using the scheme; the existing liquid cooling pipelines in the energy storage cabinet are utilized for arranging dehumidification equipment, so that the space dehumidification effect is more uniform.

title_en: Positive and negative ion generator with long service life
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a long-life positive and negative ion generator, which belongs to the technical field of positive and negative ion generators and aims at solving the problems that the positive and negative ion generator has poor protection effect when in use, dust is easy to accumulate at a vent and is inconvenient to clean, so that the service life of the generator is influenced; the utility model protects the chassis by arranging the cover plate and the protective cover, can prevent the positive and negative ion generator from being directly damaged when being collided, has better protective effect, prevents dust from being separated from the plurality of air inlets and the ventilation openings by the air inlet filter plate and the ventilation filter plate, and prolongs the service life of the positive and negative ion generator.

title_en: Photovoltaic inverter protection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of photovoltaic inverters, in particular to a photovoltaic inverter protection device which comprises a photovoltaic inverter main body, wherein a sealing front cover is fixedly arranged on the front surface of the photovoltaic inverter main body through bolts, an electric element is arranged in the photovoltaic inverter main body, a plurality of radiating fins are arranged on the back surface of the photovoltaic inverter main body, a plurality of inner radiating air channels are fixedly arranged in the photovoltaic inverter main body, an outer radiating air channel is fixedly arranged at one end of each inner radiating air channel, an electric radiating fan is fixedly arranged at the top of the photovoltaic inverter main body, and an air inlet of the electric radiating fan is fixedly communicated with the outer radiating air channel. Through set up a plurality of interior heat dissipation wind channels and heat conduction copper pipe on photovoltaic inverter main part, can form sealed heat dissipation wind channel, realize radiating gas and the isolation of the inside electrical component of dc-to-ac converter, when guaranteeing the radiating effect, play the guard action to electrical component, avoid the dust to adhere to at electrical component surface, be favorable to prolonging electrical component's life.

title_en: Car light power supply bracket and power supply assembly
abstract_en: The utility model provides a car light power supply bracket and a power supply component, which are used for fixing a power supply on a helmet, wherein the car light power supply bracket comprises: the fixing piece comprises a fixing seat and a plurality of screws, a plurality of through holes are formed in the direction of the fixing seat facing the power supply, and the screws are respectively arranged in the through holes in a penetrating mode and are in threaded connection with the power supply; the connecting piece, the connecting piece includes connecting band and go-between, and the go-between is connected to connecting band one end, and the other end of connecting band wears to establish between mounting and power and can dismantle with the go-between and be connected to form the installation space that supplies the helmet embedding between go-between and the connecting band. The problem of among the prior art bulky portable power source fix behind the helmet inconvenient dismantlement is solved.

title_en: Movable wall plug
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a movable wall plug, which comprises a cover plate and a base which is in cover connection with the cover plate, wherein a plurality of groups of conductive plug bushes are arranged in an accommodating space formed by the cover plate and the base; the cover plate is provided with jacks with the same number as the plug bush, and the bottom of the base is provided with plug pins electrically connected with the plug bush; a handle groove is formed between the cover plate and the base. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the beneficial effects that: the handle groove is arranged on the wall plug shell, so that the force application habit of a user is adapted, and the user can more conveniently and easily plug the wall plug; the insulating sleeve is arranged, the insulating sleeve is limited and supported, and then the conductive sleeve is limited, so that the influence on the internal conductive part in the process of applying force to the wall plug shell is avoided.

title_en: Portable photokinetic energy battery test light box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable optical kinetic energy battery test light box, which belongs to the technical field of detection equipment and is characterized in that: the LED light source is characterized in that a light source area and a control area are arranged in a box body of the light box, an LED lamp panel is arranged at the bottom in the light source area, an aluminum foil reflecting film is arranged on the side face of the light source area, a light transmission test board is covered on the light source area, an illuminance sensor is attached to the light transmission test board, a control module, a display module and an adjusting module are arranged in the control area, the illuminance sensor, the LED lamp panel, the display module and the adjusting module are connected to the control module, the adjusting module is used for adjusting the illuminance of an initial light source before testing, the control module is used for compensating and adjusting the illuminance of an LED lamp bead to the appointed illuminance after measuring the illuminance by the illuminance sensor in testing, and the display module is used for displaying the illuminance, the temperature and the lamp panel current in real time.

title_en: Low glare industrial and mining lamp
abstract_en: The utility model provides a low glare industrial and mining lamp, includes lamp stand and luminescent substrate, is equipped with the multiturn light-emitting pole on the upper portion surface of lamp stand, and the semicircle form protrusion of light-emitting pole forms the arc light-emitting face at its medial surface, and the multiturn light-emitting pole uses the centre of a circle of lamp stand to set up as the center with one heart, is equipped with a plurality of lamp slots that correspond to the ring form setting of light-emitting pole at the lower part surface of lamp stand, and the roof of lamp slot is equipped with a plurality of transmission portions that encircle in the centre of a circle of lamp stand, is equipped with tangential spotlight incident surface on the transmission portion, and multiturn lamp pearl on the surface of luminescent substrate, and lamp pearl one-to-one corresponds transmission portion, and luminescent substrate installs behind the lamp stand, the lamp light of lamp pearl forms first spotlight transmission effect from the lamp slot through the tangential spotlight incident surface of transmission portion, and the arc light-emitting face of first spotlight transmission forms the second spotlight transmission effect again. The utility model effectively solves the problem of visual glare caused by more stray light of the existing industrial and mining lamp in the circumferential tangential direction, thereby improving the lighting environment of the industrial and mining lamp.

title_en: Oil inlet pipe of oil immersed transformer with filtering function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an oil inlet pipe of an oil immersed transformer with a filtering function, which comprises the following components: the installation shell, the valve is installed to the left end of installation shell, and the right-hand member of valve is connected with annular seat to the right-hand member of annular seat is connected with thick filter tube, the right-hand member of thick filter tube is connected with circular filter, and the right-hand member downside of thick filter tube is provided with into oil pipe, the right-hand member of circular filter is connected with the siphunculus, and installs the fixed block in the outside of siphunculus, and the both ends is provided with the bolt about the fixed block, the upper and lower both ends of siphunculus are provided with the spray gun. This oil-immersed transformer oil feed pipe with filtering capability, the filtration of being convenient for is more thorough, and the impurity in the gasoline has been reduced to the maximum extent, has improved the cleanliness factor of gasoline, is convenient for to built-in clearance under the condition of not dismantling, and simple high-efficient, convenient to detach with change part, extension the live time of the device, avoid appearing a damage just condemned condition.

title_en: Three-phase electromagnetic interference filter circuit and switching power supply
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a three-phase electromagnetic interference filter circuit and a switching power supply, wherein the three-phase electromagnetic interference filter circuit comprises the following components connected in sequence: the port EMI circuit comprises a first three-Y capacitor group and a first three-X capacitor group which are connected in sequence; the second-level EMI circuit comprises a second three-X capacitor group, a first three-differential mode inductor group, a second three-Y capacitor group and a first common mode inductor which are connected in sequence; the first-stage EMI circuit comprises a third three-X capacitor group, a second three-differential mode inductor group, a third three-Y capacitor group, a second common mode inductor and a fourth three-X capacitor group which are connected in sequence; the fourth three-X capacitor group is perpendicular to the second common-mode inductor, the second common-mode inductor is larger than the first common-mode inductor, the third three-Y capacitor group is larger than the second three-Y capacitor group, the second three-differential-mode inductor group is larger than the first three-differential-mode inductor group, and the third three-X capacitor group is larger than the second three-X capacitor group. The utility model can reduce the cost and volume of the product.

title_en: UV lamp support
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of optical fiber sensing components and parts, and particularly relates to a UV lamp bracket, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein an end replacement component comprises a vertical rod arranged on the top surface of the bottom plate, a fixing ring is rotated, UV irradiation at any position in the range of an optical platform can be realized, then, if multi-head irradiation is required, clamping blocks can be replaced or the number of inner holes is increased, other parts are not required to be replaced, the clamping blocks are flexible and convenient, so that the clamping blocks are arranged on a cross rod, the clamping blocks with different numbers of mounting holes can be replaced conveniently, the mounting holes can be formed in the same clamping block, when the vertical rod is mounted, a fixing plate at the bottom surface of the vertical rod is inserted into a through hole formed in the surface of the bottom plate, so that the rotating block can push an extruding plate to move downwards, the extruding plate pushes an air bag with an annular structure, after the air bag is deformed, the top surface of the extruding plate is flush with the top surface of the bottom plate, the vertical rod is fixed, shaking of the vertical rod is prevented after the vertical rod is mounted in the bottom plate, and the stability after the vertical rod is mounted is improved.

title_en: Remove drive assembly and optical lens
