abstract_en: The utility model relates to a movable driving assembly and an optical lens, which comprise a mounting plate, a driving motor, a screw rod transmission piece and a lens group, wherein the driving motor is connected with the mounting plate, the screw rod is connected with a rotating power output end of the driving motor, the screw rod transmission piece is sleeved on the screw rod and matched with the screw rod, the screw rod transmission piece is simultaneously connected with the lens group, the driving motor drives the screw rod transmission piece to linearly move along the screw rod through rotating action, and the lens group is further driven to linearly move along the axial direction so as to realize zoom/zoom adjustment of the lens. The utility model has small volume, light weight, compact structural design and convenient carrying.

title_en: Winding mechanism for on-load offshore transformer and on-load offshore transformer comprising winding mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of transformer manufacturing, and particularly relates to a winding mechanism for a loaded marine transformer and the loaded marine transformer comprising the winding mechanism, wherein the winding mechanism comprises a low-voltage coil, a high-voltage coil, a voltage regulating coil and an auxiliary coil which are sequentially wound outside an iron core; the low-voltage coil and the high-voltage coil are configured to bear low load, the auxiliary coil is configured to increase the number of turns to enhance the impedance of the winding mechanism, and one end of the auxiliary coil is selectively connected/disconnected and used for carrying/not carrying load. The utility model can reduce the volume and the weight of a winding mechanism by changing the wiring mode of the auxiliary winding, meets the light-weight use requirement of the offshore transformer station, is used as a balance winding for improving voltage waveforms and a working winding for standby maintenance power supply in the transformer, obviously reduces the fault current of the balance winding by a special winding arrangement mode, and simultaneously reduces load loss.

title_en: Comprehensive power-saving cabinet for power grid
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of comprehensive power-saving cabinets and discloses a comprehensive power-saving cabinet for an electric network, which comprises a base, wherein an inner shell is fixedly connected in the middle of the upper end of the base, two ends of the upper part of the base are fixedly connected with fixing plates, the inner parts of the side ends of the fixing plates are elastically connected with clamping blocks through springs, the outer parts of the clamping blocks are slidably connected with slots, the side parts of the slots are fixedly connected with baffle plates, the side parts of the baffle plates are fixedly connected with hinging rods, the inner parts of the side ends of the fixing plates are fixedly connected with magnets, the outer parts of the baffle plates are fixedly connected with handles, and the side parts of the fixing plates are fixedly connected with cooling assemblies. According to the utility model, the possibility that the electronic element in the inner shell is corroded by rainwater can be reduced through the blocking of the fixing plate and the baffle plate, and when the temperature is higher, the baffle plate can be rotated to open the external device through the upper sliding clamping block, so that the radiating effect is improved, and the operation is simple.

title_en: Integrated energy storage terminal
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrated energy storage terminal which comprises a plugging section and a crimping section, wherein a crown spring is matched in the plugging section, the plugging section and the crimping section are two end parts of a cylindrical part, and the middle section part of the cylindrical part is flattened and then bent to form a flat bending structure. Compared with the split structure of the energy storage terminal in the prior art, the energy storage terminal is integrally formed and is of an integral structure. The integrated terminal can further ensure stability and safety after temperature rise and prevent failure due to overhigh temperature in the use process.

title_en: Rotating structure of folding table lamp and double-sided folding table lamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotating structure of a folding table lamp and a double-sided folding table lamp, which comprise a first rotating part and a second rotating part, wherein the first rotating part is provided with a first cylinder, the second rotating part is provided with a second cylinder, the first cylinder is provided with a containing cavity, the second cylinder is provided with a plug-in column, a positioning column is arranged in the containing cavity, the second cylinder is provided with a mounting cylinder part, the mounting cylinder part is provided with a positioning hole, the positioning column penetrates through the positioning hole and is partially positioned in the mounting cylinder part, a reset spring is sleeved on the positioning column, the right end of the positioning column is provided with a limiting part, the first cylinder is provided with a first latch, and the second cylinder is provided with a second latch. Therefore, the folding desk lamp has the advantages of being simple and ingenious in structure, convenient to assemble, convenient to use, stable in work and the like, and meanwhile, the folding desk lamp well takes the illumination effectiveness of the storage convenience box into consideration through the desk lamp with the three-section structure.

title_en: Electric connector
abstract_en: An electric connector comprises a signal terminal, a grounding terminal and a shielding part, wherein the signal terminal comprises a signal main body part, a signal contact part and a signal elastic part for connecting the signal main body part and the signal contact part, the signal elastic part comprises two opposite signal sides, the grounding terminal comprises a grounding main body part, a grounding contact part, a grounding elastic part for connecting the grounding main body part and the grounding contact part, and the shielding part bending and extending from the grounding main body part, the grounding elastic part comprises a notch penetrating along the arrangement direction of a plurality of signal terminals and a plurality of grounding terminals and two opposite grounding sides, the distance between the two grounding sides is larger than the distance between the two signal sides when being observed along the arrangement direction of the plurality of signal terminals and the plurality of grounding terminals, the notch corresponds to part of the signal elastic part, the shielding part shields the notch, and the projection of the signal elastic part is positioned in the common projection of the shielding part and the grounding elastic part, so that the shielding effect of the grounding terminal can be improved, and the forward force of the grounding elastic part of the grounding terminal can be prevented from being increased.

title_en: Charging bin with spring reconnection function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a charging bin with a spring back connection function, which comprises a bin tray, a bin protection bottom shell and a bin cover, wherein the bin tray consists of a tray frame and a charging bin inner support arranged at the bottom of the tray frame, the tray frame and the bin protection bottom shell are clamped and fixed together, a cover turnover frame is fixedly arranged on a cover bottom ring edge of the bin cover, a rotating shaft is arranged on the cover turnover frame, a shaft rotation earmuff is fixedly arranged on the tray frame, two ends of the rotating shaft are rotatably inserted and arranged on the shaft rotation earmuff, a reset spring frame is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the cover turnover frame, a tray bottom torsion spring frame is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the tray frame, and the reset spring frame and the tray bottom torsion spring frame are connected together through a normally closed torsion spring. The beneficial effects lie in that adopt normally closed type structure setting for bin cover and casing can close constantly, need not the buckle setting, conveniently open and shut the operation, carry out hall response through the magnetic field micro-variation that three magnetic path is constituteed simultaneously, realize that earphone links back.

title_en: Power supply circuit and remote controller
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a power supply circuit and a remote controller, wherein the power supply circuit comprises a power supply output end, a first power supply branch, a second power supply branch, a first switch and a second switch, wherein the power supply output end is used for being connected with a load of at least one remote controller, the input end of the first power supply branch is used for being connected with a battery pack, the output end of the first power supply branch is connected with the power supply output end and used for outputting battery voltage through the power supply output end when the battery voltage output by the battery pack reaches a preset reference voltage, the first switch is connected between the battery pack and the second power supply branch in series and used for being closed when the battery voltage is lower than the reference voltage so as to connect the battery pack with the input end of the second power supply branch, and the second power supply branch is also used for boosting the connected battery voltage when the battery pack is connected with the battery pack and outputting the boosted battery voltage through the power supply output end.

title_en: Sensing controllable start-stop driving circuit and lamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sensing controllable starting and stopping driving circuit and a lamp, which comprise an energy supply module, a human body sensing module, a control driving module, a control module and a first switch module, wherein the human body sensing module is used for detecting human body reaction signals in the environment, the control driving module is used for being connected with a load, the control driving module is connected with the human body sensing module to control the load to operate according to the human body reaction signals, the energy supply module is connected with the control driving module to supply power for the control driving module, the control module is used for forming control signals, the control driving module is connected with the control driving module, the energy supply module is connected with the human body sensing module through the first switch module to supply power for the human body sensing module, and the control driving module is connected with a controlled end of the first switch module to control the first switch module to be switched on or off according to the control signals.

title_en: High-speed fan
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-speed fan which comprises a handle assembly, a barrel assembly and a nozzle assembly, wherein the handle assembly is arranged on one side below the barrel assembly, the nozzle assembly is arranged at the front end of the barrel assembly, the handle assembly comprises a key board, a battery pack, a control board, a handle and a tail cover, the battery pack is fastened with the tail cover through the handle and then fixed in the handle, the control board is fixed on the tail cover, the key board is fixed on a key board support, and the key board support is connected with the barrel. The utility model reduces the weight and has the effects of shock absorption and noise reduction.

title_en: LED industrial and mining lamp that sealing performance is strong
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an LED industrial and mining lamp with high sealing performance, which relates to the technical field of industrial and mining lamps, and comprises an upper shell, a lower shell, an LED lamp arranged on the upper shell, a clamping frame arranged on the side surface of the upper shell, an inserting piece hinged on the lower shell and detachably arranged on the side surface of the lower shell, wherein the inserting piece is in a T shape which can be matched with the clamping frame, and is tightly clamped with the clamping frame and used for tightly fitting the joint of the upper shell and the lower shell. The utility model has the advantages that the upper shell and the lower shell are sealed and fixed in a clamping way, so that the sealing is not embedded by the screw, and the problem that the sealing performance between the upper shell and the lower shell is reduced because the screw is easy to corrode and rust in the outside and the sealing performance is reduced because the screw is easy to corrode and rust in the outside is solved.

title_en: Waterproof wall switch
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waterproof wall switch, which comprises a plastic shell and a waterproof cover sleeved on the front surface of the plastic shell, wherein a waterproof bearing is fixedly penetrated in the middle of the waterproof cover, a rotating rod is fixedly penetrated in the middle of the waterproof bearing, a twisting block and a butt joint sleeve are respectively fixed at two ends of the rotating rod, two junction boxes are embedded in the back surface of the plastic shell, two conducting plates and a fixed bearing are fixedly arranged on the back surface of the plastic shell, a metal rod is movably penetrated in the conducting plates, a metal plate is fixedly arranged at the end part of the metal rod, a spring is arranged between the metal plate and the conducting plates, a clamping disc is embedded in the middle of the fixed bearing, and two rotating blocks are integrally formed on the side surfaces of the clamping disc. The spring in the utility model pushes the metal plate to prop against the cylinder formed by the rotating block and the metal block, the spring can not be compressed in the synchronous rotation process of the rotating block and the metal block to always keep the elasticity of the spring to the metal plate, so that the metal plate and the metal block are contacted stably, and the utility model has the advantage of wiring stability.

title_en: Car light assembly and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model particularly discloses a car lamp assembly and a vehicle, and belongs to the technical field of vehicle illumination. The car lamp assembly comprises a light emitting piece, a first reflecting bowl and a second reflecting bowl, wherein the first reflecting bowl is arranged on the front side of the light emitting piece and is configured to reflect light rays from the light emitting piece backwards, the second reflecting bowl is arranged on the rear side of the light emitting piece, the optical axis of a reflecting surface of the second reflecting bowl is higher than the top end of the first reflecting bowl, and the second reflecting bowl is configured to reflect light rays from the light emitting piece and from the first reflecting bowl forwards. The utility model can greatly improve the utilization rate of the light rays emitted by the luminous element, and improves the illumination brightness of the car lamp assembly under the condition of not increasing the luminous element, thereby reducing the energy waste and saving the use cost.

title_en: Button cell and power consumption device
abstract_en: The application discloses a button battery and an electric device, wherein the button battery comprises a preset direction, the button battery comprises a battery body, a pole piece, an insulating film and at least two insulating films, the battery body is provided with a first end face, a second end face and a side wall, the side wall is connected between the first end face and the second end face, the pole piece comprises a connecting part and an extending part, the connecting part is electrically connected with the first end face or the second end face, the extending part is connected with the connecting part and is arranged opposite to the side wall, the insulating film is at least attached to the area, opposite to the extending part, of the side wall, the insulating film comprises at least two insulator parts, the insulator parts are distributed along the circumferential direction of the battery body and are of a split structure, and the adjacent outer edges of the insulator parts, which are close to each other, are adjacent to each other and/or are spaced from each other. The insulating film is convenient to paste, wrinkles during pasting are avoided, bubbles can be effectively avoided in the process of pasting the insulating film, and the insulating film is ensured to be attached in place.

title_en: Grounding rod
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a grounding rod, which belongs to the technical field of power engineering and comprises a wire clamp, wherein the side surface of the wire clamp is connected with a shell seat, a trigger block is rotatably connected with the shell seat, the trigger block is connected with a pressing column, the pressing column is abutted with a pressing power generation module, the pressing power generation module is connected with a communication module through a wire, and the pressing power generation module and the communication module are both connected in the shell seat.

title_en: Building electrical power distribution cabinet structure convenient to overhaul
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a building electrical power distribution cabinet structure convenient to overhaul, which comprises a power distribution cabinet body and a cabinet door, wherein the power distribution cabinet body is connected with the cabinet door through a rotating shaft, a lining plate is arranged in the power distribution cabinet body, the top of the lining plate is fixedly connected with a strip-shaped plate, a movable plate is arranged on the outer side of the strip-shaped plate and is in sliding connection with the power distribution cabinet body, a bottom plate is arranged in the power distribution cabinet body, and a threading hole is formed in the top of the bottom plate. This building electrical power distribution cabinet structure convenient to overhaul through the both sides sliding connection switch board body at the strip shaped plate, consequently when the inside circuit of switch board body breaks down, the staff need open the cabinet door earlier, pulls the bottom plate outside, then pulls out the metal pole from the welt outside, holds the handle and just can stimulate the welt and move down afterwards, until the welt pulls out completely, so not only does not receive the restriction in narrow and small space, and is comparatively convenient in the time of the operation moreover.

title_en: Outdoor integrated equipment that sends out and store up
abstract_en: The utility model discloses outdoor integrated equipment for generating and storing, which comprises a solar cell panel and a zinc-aluminum-magnesium upper cover, wherein the solar cell panel is arranged on the zinc-aluminum-magnesium upper cover through a fixing piece, a cast aluminum cell bin is arranged below the zinc-aluminum-magnesium upper cover through bolting and matching, cells are arranged in the cast aluminum cell bin, the number of the cells is two, the cells are symmetrically distributed on two sides by taking the central line of the cast aluminum cell bin as the center, a circuit board module is arranged in the middle of the cast aluminum cell bin, the circuit board module is arranged between the cells, the circuit board module is electrically connected with the cells, and a fan is electrically connected in the middle of the circuit board module. The utility model relates to the technical field of solar panels, and solves the problem that in the prior art, due to the fact that a circuit board control module is arranged in integrated equipment for storing and sending, the circuit board control module can burn out at high temperature under the condition that the whole equipment works for a long time due to lack of overheat protection.

title_en: Combined greenhouse for planting watermelons and melons
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of greenhouses, and discloses a watermelon and melon planting row greenhouse which comprises a greenhouse body, wherein a guide plate is arranged in an inner cavity of the greenhouse body, a water storage tank is arranged at the bottom of the inner cavity of the greenhouse body, an installation seat is fixedly connected in the inner cavity of the greenhouse body, a servo motor is fixedly connected in the inner cavity of the installation seat, the front surface of an output shaft of the servo motor is fixedly connected with a one-way screw rod, an outer ring thread of the one-way screw rod is connected with a connecting block, one side of the connecting block is fixedly connected with an irrigation nozzle, and the irrigation nozzle is connected with the water storage tank through a water pipe. This row greenhouse is united in watermelon melon planting passes through guide plate and aqua storage tank, and the cultivation box is echelonment, consequently rivers can flow in from top to bottom, can carry out moisturizing to the lower seed in position, avoid appearing the inhomogeneous condition of watering process. The guide plate is arranged in the inner cavity of the shed body, so that the wasted clean water flows into the water storage tank from the inclination of the guide plate, the effect of water flow circulation is achieved, and meanwhile, the waste of water sources is avoided.

title_en: Gas producing cover and breaker shell
abstract_en: A gas generating cover and a breaker shell are sleeved at the top end of a left headquarter or a right headquarter of a U-shaped magnetic increasing plate and form a magnetic blowing structure with the U-shaped magnetic increasing plate, and the gas generating cover comprises a sleeving part, a connecting part and a connecting part, wherein the sleeving part is provided with a cavity, and one side of the sleeving part is provided with an opening communicated with the cavity; and the matching part is formed by extending the sleeving part towards the direction of the adjacent breaker shell, and can be embedded into the outer wall of the breaker shell. Utilize the portion of cup jointing to cover the magnetic increasing sheet, utilize cooperation portion and circuit breaker casing cooperation to realize the spacing to the axis direction of producing the gas hood, realize producing the omnidirectional of gas hood and fix, can guarantee under the environment of high temperature and vibration, also can not make the phenomenon that produces the gas hood and take place to drop, improve the security, adopt embedded cooperation simultaneously, it is very convenient when equipment and dismouting, and can not cause the damage to producing the gas hood.

title_en: Photovoltaic board dry-type dust absorption dust collector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dry dust collection and removal device for a photovoltaic panel, which comprises two slide rails and a control box, wherein a transmission assembly is jointly assembled on the two slide rails, the transmission assembly is provided with a dust removal assembly, one side of the slide rail is provided with a guide pipe limiting frame, when the device is used, if the photovoltaic panel has excessive dust accumulation, a starting signal of the device is sent into the control box, the control box controls the transmission assembly to start, the dust removing assembly is driven to repeatedly move on the sliding rail, the dust removing assembly is controlled to start at the same time, the photovoltaic plate is wiped, and meanwhile, the floating ash is adsorbed, so that the dust removing device does not need water, has a wider application range, can adsorb the floating ash, avoids floating up when cleaning, and falls onto the photovoltaic plate after cleaning is finished, so that the problem of poor cleaning dust is solved.

title_en: Mute alternating current controller
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of alternating current controllers and discloses a mute alternating current controller which comprises a mounting plate, an alternating current controller main body and a sound-proof cover, wherein the alternating current controller main body is fixedly arranged in the middle of the top end of the mounting plate, the bottom end of the sound-proof cover is abutted against the top end of the mounting plate, the sound-proof cover completely covers the alternating current controller main body, two sides of the sound-proof cover are adhered with a square frame, and two ends of the top of the mounting plate are welded with supporting shafts. This scheme establishes the sound proof housing cover in the outside of exchanging the controller main part and makes two rotating blocks can run through two and return the shape frame, then stirs two rotating blocks for the bottom of two rotating blocks respectively with the top laminating of two shape frames that return, and rotatory two first bolts, make two first bolts respectively with the both ends threaded connection at mounting panel top, and then can fix the sound proof housing on the mounting panel, make the real-time cage of sound proof housing cover exchanging the controller main part.

title_en: Fireproof isolation device for whole ladder-shaped power battery pack
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of protection of echelon power batteries, in particular to a fireproof isolation device of an entire package of the echelon power batteries, which comprises a fireproof box, wherein the fireproof box is provided with a heat radiation opening, the heat radiation opening is provided with a baffle, the fireproof box is provided with an entire package main body of the echelon power batteries, the heat radiation opening is provided with an isolation fireproof door, the fireproof box is provided with a water tank, the water tank is provided with a supporting plate, the supporting plate is provided with a water pump, the water pump is provided with a water suction pipe, the water supply pipe is provided with a water tank, the fireproof box is provided with a liquid, the fireproof storage box is provided with gravel, the entire package main body of the echelon power batteries is provided with a connecting wire, and the fireproof isolation device of the entire package of the echelon power batteries solves the problem that the existing spark can still ignite external objects through the heat radiation opening and the connecting wire of the echelon power batteries through the matching of the gravel and the exhaust pipe.

title_en: Connect stable cell-phone interface assembly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a mobile phone interface component with stable connection, which comprises a mobile phone main body, wherein an auxiliary component is arranged at the charging end of the mobile phone main body, a connection disassembly mechanism is arranged on the left side of the mobile phone main body, the auxiliary component is matched with the connection disassembly mechanism to keep stable connection, the auxiliary component comprises a first connection block fixedly connected with the left side surface of the mobile phone main body, an interface groove and a connection clamping groove are formed in the left side surface of the first connection block, the connection disassembly mechanism comprises a second connection block, a connection interface and a connection buckle are arranged on the right side surface of the second connection block, the connection interface and the interface groove are connected in an inserted mode and used for transmitting and charging, the connection buckle is matched with the connection clamping groove and used for stabilizing connection, the function of stabilizing mobile phone charging can be achieved, and meanwhile, the interface of a charging wire connector and a mobile phone is prevented from being damaged.

title_en: Stator special fixture
abstract_en: The utility model provides a special stator clamp, which belongs to the technical field of motor stators and comprises a control console, wherein the top of the control console is fixedly connected with a control panel, one side of the control panel is provided with a switch, one side of the control console is fixedly connected with a workbench, the special stator clamp is provided with a clamping assembly on a first rotating base and a first electric telescopic column at the back, various angles and positions can be flexibly adjusted according to the size of a stator and the type of operation required to be operated, the flexibility of the device is further improved, a movable camera can be controlled through the control panel and the seen picture is transmitted to a display screen, the control panel is helped to adjust the position and operation at any time through the display screen, the working fineness is further improved, the winding operation can be carried out through a winding assembly while the adjustment is carried out, and the working efficiency of the staff is improved.

title_en: Butterfly-shaped induced draft fan of automobile seat
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a butterfly-shaped induced draft fan of an automobile seat, which comprises an upper shell, a lower shell, fan blades and a PCB (printed circuit board), wherein the upper shell is connected with the lower shell, the fan blades are arranged between the upper shell and the lower shell, an air inlet is formed in the upper shell, the fan blades comprise an upper fan blade ring, a lower fan blade ring, a mounting groove and a central shaft, the upper fan blade ring and the lower fan blade ring are coaxial, the mounting groove is formed in the middle of the upper fan blade ring and the lower fan blade ring and fixedly connected with the lower fan blade ring, a plurality of blades uniformly distributed along the circumferential direction are arranged between the upper fan blade ring and the lower fan blade ring, the upper fan blade ring, the lower fan blade ring, the mounting groove and the blades are of an integral injection molding structure, the central shaft is pre-buried and fixed in the center of the mounting groove, the coaxial center of the mounting groove is fixedly arranged in a magnetic ring rotor, the PCB is mounted on the lower shell, a fan stator is fixedly arranged on the PCB, the fan stator is coaxially arranged in the magnetic ring rotor, and the central shaft passes through the fan stator to be rotationally connected on the lower shell. The utility model can improve the air quantity, reduce noise and improve the driving comfort.

title_en: Control and protection switch electric appliance
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of switching devices, in particular to a control and protection switching device. The technical scheme includes that the shielding assembly comprises a side shell, an electromagnet, a metal sheet, a shielding plate and a heat radiation opening, wherein the electromagnet is fixedly installed in the side shell, the metal sheet is connected to the inside of the side shell in a sliding mode and located on an extension line of the electromagnet, an adsorption assembly is arranged on the side portion of the metal sheet, and the shielding plate is arranged on one side, far away from the metal sheet, of the adsorption assembly. According to the utility model, through the increase of the temperature inside the shell, the magnetic force of the electromagnet is reduced and is smaller than the gravity of the metal sheet and the shielding plate, the shielding plate opens the heat dissipation opening to ventilate under the action of gravity so as to reduce the temperature inside the shell, and when the temperature inside the shell is normal, the magnetic force of the electromagnet is larger than the gravity of the metal sheet and the shielding plate, at the moment, the shielding plate blocks the heat dissipation opening, and the shielding plate is opened when the temperature needs to be reduced so as to prevent dust normally entering the heat dissipation opening continuously.

title_en: Telescopic connection structure of groove type cable bridge
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a telescopic connection structure of a groove type cable bridge, and relates to the technical field of cable laying. The utility model comprises a connecting channel, a telescopic channel and an isolation frame, wherein the connecting channel comprises a regular hexagonal transfer shell and outer channels symmetrically fixed on two opposite surfaces of the transfer shell, the transfer shell is communicated with the two outer channels, the telescopic channels with U-shaped sections are connected in each outer channel in a sliding manner, two ends of each telescopic channel are adhered with U-shaped sealing strips, two groups of clamping grooves are formed in two opposite surfaces of each telescopic channel, the isolation frame is inserted into the two clamping grooves on the same horizontal plane, and an isolation net is fixed in an inner cavity of the isolation frame. The utility model solves the problems that the groove type cable bridge connection structure lacks a telescopic function, has insufficient tightness, cannot be separated after cables are laid, and is easy to generate interference and poor in heat dissipation by arranging the connection channel, the telescopic channel, the U-shaped sealing strip, the partition plate, the isolation frame and the isolation net.

title_en: Docking station and electronic device
abstract_en: The application discloses a docking station and an electronic device, the docking station provided by the application comprises a main circuit board and an adapter power supply, wherein the adapter power supply is electrically connected with the main circuit board. The main circuit board comprises a first circuit and a second circuit, wherein the input end of the first circuit and the input end of the second circuit are connected with the adapter power supply, the first circuit receives the power supply voltage of the adapter power supply and outputs first voltage, and the second circuit receives the power supply voltage of the adapter power supply and outputs second voltage, and the first voltage is larger than the second voltage. Through integrating adapter power and main circuit board, reduced the independent space that occupies of adapter power, promoted the clean and tidy degree of desktop to promote the user and experience the use of docking station. And the adapter power supply uses the first circuit and the second circuit to output the voltages with different voltage values at one time, so that the power supply requirement of the expansion dock on the power utilization device is met, the expansion dock does not need to convert the voltages for the second time, and the conversion efficiency of the power supply voltage is improved.

title_en: Driving motor and vehicle
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of motors, and discloses a driving motor and a vehicle, wherein the motor comprises a rotor core, the rotor core is provided with a plurality of mounting hole groups which are centrosymmetric, and permanent magnets are arranged in the mounting hole groups. Each mounting hole group comprises a first mounting hole and a second mounting hole, and a magnetism isolating bridge is formed between the first mounting hole and the second mounting hole. One end of the first mounting hole, which is close to the magnetism isolating bridge, is provided with a first magnetism isolating hole, and one end of the second mounting hole, which is close to the magnetism isolating bridge, is provided with a second magnetism isolating hole. The inner walls of the first magnetism isolating hole and the second magnetism isolating hole at least comprise three circular arc sections, and two adjacent circular arc sections are connected in a tangent mode. The stress concentration of the magnetism isolating bridge can be effectively reduced or avoided, so that the stress of the rotor is more uniform, and the maximum stress can be effectively reduced. Therefore, the breakage of the rotor punching sheet in the rotor can be effectively reduced or avoided, and the service life of the motor can be effectively prolonged.

title_en: Control and protection switch
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a control and protection switch, which comprises a switch body, an operation hole arranged on the switch body, a rotating shaft arranged in the operation hole, and a cylinder arranged outside the rotating shaft, wherein one end of the cylinder is provided with a lower knob, one side of the lower knob is provided with a plurality of transmission grooves which are distributed in an annular equidistant manner, the outer side of the lower knob is rotatably provided with an upper knob, the inside of the upper knob is provided with a plurality of transmission blocks matched with the transmission grooves, the middle part of the inside of the lower knob is fixedly connected with a limit column, the outer side of the limit column is sleeved with a spring, and the middle part of the inner side of the upper knob is provided with a sleeve matched with the limit column.

title_en: Electrochemical energy storage thermal management system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electrochemical energy storage thermal management system which comprises a refrigerating unit and a plurality of energy storage containers, wherein the refrigerating unit is provided with a water inlet and a water outlet, the water inlet and the water outlet are respectively communicated with a first pipeline for the circulation of a first cooling medium, the refrigerating unit is used for adjusting the temperature of the first cooling medium, the plurality of energy storage containers respectively comprise an energy storage module and a heat exchanger, the energy storage module and the heat exchanger are respectively communicated with a second pipeline for the circulation of a second cooling medium, and the heat exchanger is respectively communicated with the first pipeline so that the first cooling medium flowing out along the water outlet flows to the water inlet after passing through the heat exchanger and is used for exchanging heat with the second cooling medium passing through the heat exchanger.

title_en: Heavy truck electric vehicle battery thermal management cooling system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a battery thermal management cooling system of a heavy truck electric vehicle, which belongs to the technical field of battery thermal management cooling and comprises a first water-cooling unit, a second liquid flow regulating valve, a first power battery unit, a third liquid flow regulating valve, a fourth liquid flow regulating valve, a second water-cooling unit, a second liquid flow regulating valve, a second power battery unit and a fourth liquid flow regulating valve. The battery thermal management cooling system for the heavy truck electric vehicle effectively prevents excessive cold energy, provides a standby cold energy source, ensures normal operation of the power battery and improves cooling effect.

title_en: Quick connector
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electric blankets and discloses a quick connector which comprises a plug, wherein a power connection port is fixedly arranged at the left end of the plug, a socket is movably sleeved on the surface of the power connection port, and limit grooves are formed in the front end and the rear end of the socket. According to the electric blanket connector, the power supply connection port is inserted into the socket, the push block can be pushed to move, the push block can drive the limiting block to move, the spring can be compressed in the moving process of the limiting block, the right end of the socket can be contacted with the left end of the plug, the limiting groove can be aligned with the limiting block, the push block can be loosened, the limiting block and the push block are pushed to move by means of the resilience of the spring, the limiting block can enter the limiting groove, the power supply connection port is fixed, the fact that the power supply connection port falls off from the inside of the socket when the electric blanket works is avoided, and therefore stability of the connector is improved.

title_en: Heat-proof bridge closed type connection structure of battery installation pipeline in concrete slab
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of green buildings, in particular to a heat-proof bridge closed type connecting structure of a battery installation pipeline in a concrete slab, which comprises a prefabricated battery installation pipeline, an installation lug plate, a heat insulation structure and a plugging plate, wherein the prefabricated battery installation pipeline is arranged in a building floor, the installation lug plate is arranged on the inner wall of the end part of the prefabricated battery installation pipeline, and the plugging plate is arranged at the bottom of the installation lug plate; the heat insulation structure comprises a heat insulation table and a first heat insulation layer, wherein the first heat insulation layer is arranged between the plugging plate and the installation lug plate, and the heat insulation table is arranged in the installation lug plate through a connecting bolt. The heat insulation structure comprising the heat insulation table and the first heat insulation layer is arranged to cut off heat transfer between the battery installation pipeline and the plugging plate, so that the problem that mildew and condensation are easy to occur between the battery installation pipeline and the floor slab due to a heat bridge is solved.

title_en: LED tunnel lamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an LED tunnel lamp, which comprises a mounting plate, wherein a transparent cover is arranged below the mounting plate, the upper surface of the transparent cover is fixedly connected with a connecting cover, the bottom surface of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with an inner cover, the bottom surface of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with two fixing plates, one side surfaces of the two fixing plates, which are far away from each other, are fixedly connected with springs, one ends of the two springs, which are far away from each other, are fixedly connected with sliding clamping blocks, two sliding holes are formed in the inner side wall of the inner cover, two fixing clamping grooves are formed in the inner wall of the connecting cover, one ends of the two sliding clamping blocks, which are far away from each other, penetrate through the sliding holes and extend into the inner parts of the fixing clamping grooves, and the outer surfaces of the two sliding clamping blocks are respectively contacted with the inner walls of the two fixing clamping grooves. This LED tunnel lamp can make the outside of connecting cover and transparent cover at the inner cover install fast to it is simpler when dismantling, improves the dismouting efficiency to connecting cover and transparent cover in this LED lamp.

title_en: Electrical cabinet convenient to installation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electrical cabinet convenient to install, which comprises a top cover, an electrical cabinet and a supporting device, wherein a box door is arranged at the front side of the electrical cabinet, a handle is arranged on the box door, ventilation openings are arranged at positions, close to the top, of side plates at the two sides of the electrical cabinet, a temperature sensor is arranged at the center position of the inner side walls of the side plates at the two sides of the electrical cabinet, a power supply line pipe is arranged at the bottom of the inner side walls of the side plates, a partition plate is arranged at the middle position of the electrical cabinet, fixing rods are arranged on the two sides of the partition plate on a rear cover plate of the electrical cabinet, exhaust fans are arranged on the bottoms of the electrical cabinet at the two sides of the partition plate, the supporting device comprises four supporting legs and four pad legs, stabilizing frames are sleeved on the four supporting legs, pin holes corresponding to the pin holes on the stabilizing frames are arranged at equal intervals on the supporting legs. The utility model has reasonable structural design, so that the electric cabinet is convenient to operate during installation and disassembly, and the installation and the positioning of the electric cabinet body are stable.

title_en: LED light mixing circuit
abstract_en: An LED light mixing circuit comprises three power input ends, a diagnosis end, three LED lamp bead driving circuits and a diagnosis circuit. Each LED lamp bead driving circuit comprises an LED lamp bead and a triode constant current circuit, first and second input ends of the triode constant current circuit are respectively connected with an anode and a cathode of the LED lamp bead, three power input ends are respectively connected with common connection points of the anode of the three-way LED lamp bead and the first input end of the triode constant current circuit, the diagnosis circuit comprises resistors R5, R11, R17 and R19, first ends of the resistors R5, R11 and R17 are respectively connected with common connection points of the cathode of the three-way LED lamp bead and the second input end of the triode constant current circuit, first ends of the resistors R19 are respectively connected with second ends of the resistors R5, R11 and R17, and second ends of the resistors R19 are grounded. The utility model can realize the diagnosis of the open circuit and the short circuit of one LED lamp bead of the LED light mixing circuit under the condition of using one diagnosis line.

title_en: Cable lifting equipment of electric power rush-repair tower
abstract_en: The utility model provides cable lifting equipment of an electric power rush-repair tower. Relates to the technical field of electric power rush-repair. The cable lifting equipment of the power rush-repair tower comprises a bearing plate, a first frame body is arranged at the top of the bearing plate, a first lifting screw rod is rotatably installed in the first frame body, a lifting arm is installed on the first lifting screw rod through threads, a second frame body is fixedly installed on one side of the lifting arm, a rotating shaft is rotatably installed at the top of the second frame body, a rotating table is fixedly installed at the top of the rotating shaft, a plurality of wire boxes distributed in an annular array are fixedly installed at the top of the rotating table, two 匚 type frames are fixedly installed at the top of the bearing plate, and a second lifting screw rod is installed in the 匚 type frames through threads. The utility model has the advantages of no need of personnel to bear the cables, reduced physical expenditure and capability of rapidly conveying cables of different types to high-altitude personnel.

title_en: Linear motor, suspension system and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a linear motor, a suspension system and a vehicle, wherein the linear motor comprises a conductive component, a stator winding and a stator mandrel, a middle cavity for accommodating the conductive component is arranged in the stator mandrel, the stator winding is arranged on the outer peripheral wall of the stator mandrel, the middle cavity comprises a middle hole and a plurality of side holes, the side holes are arranged at intervals in the circumferential direction of the stator mandrel, the side holes are communicated with the middle hole in the radial direction of the stator mandrel, the conductive component comprises a base and a plurality of conductive pieces arranged on the base, the base is at least partially positioned in the middle hole, the conductive pieces are respectively at least partially positioned in the side holes, one end of each conductive piece is connected with the stator winding, and the other end of each conductive piece is suitable for being connected with a motor controller. Therefore, the middle cavity can circumferentially limit the conductive component, and the installation stability of the conductive component is improved.

title_en: Stator mechanism and traction machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stator mechanism and a traction machine, which belong to the technical field of elevator equipment, and comprise a machine base, an iron core assembly and a limiting assembly, wherein the iron core assembly is sleeved on the machine base and extends along the circumferential direction of the machine base, the limiting assembly is arranged on the machine base and is respectively matched with the iron core assembly and the machine base in a first direction, the first end of the iron core assembly is propped against the machine base, and at least part of the limiting assembly is propped against the second end of the iron core assembly in a second direction. And in addition, when in installation, only the iron core component is required to be installed first, and then the limiting component is installed, so that the limiting component can fix the iron core component without arranging a plurality of bolts along the circumferential direction of the machine base, thereby improving the assembly efficiency of the stator mechanism.

title_en: Single-core glass fiber reinforced plastic cable joint gasket
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of cable fixation and discloses a single-core glass fiber reinforced plastic cable joint gasket which comprises a bottom mounting seat, wherein a lower side soft rubber mat is fixedly connected to the inside of the top end of the bottom mounting seat, limiting sliding plates are fixedly connected to the two sides of the top end of the bottom mounting seat, a top mounting seat is connected to the outside of the limiting sliding plates in a sliding mode, threaded rods are fixedly connected to the middle of the top end of the limiting sliding plates, a synchronous rotation adjusting assembly is mounted on the top end of the top mounting seat, an upper side soft rubber mat is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the top mounting seat, fixing plates are fixedly connected to the two sides of the top end of the top mounting seat, and rotating notches are formed in the two sides of the inside of the top mounting seat. In the utility model, the damage of the connector caused by external impact is avoided, the installation is more convenient, the fixing effect of the connector cable is better, and the installation stability is further improved.

title_en: Power supply switching circuit utilizing super capacitor for charging and discharging
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a power supply switching circuit utilizing super capacitor charge and discharge, which comprises current limiting resistors R1, R2 and R3, chip porcelain piece capacitors C1, C2, C3 and C4, chip double diodes D1 and D2, power supply chips U1 and U2, an energy storage unit super capacitor E1, one end of the chip porcelain piece capacitor C1 is connected with a system GND and the other end is connected with a circuit input power supply MHVDD, an input end VIN of the power supply chip U1 is connected with an input power supply MHVDD, the GND end is connected with the system GND, an output end VOUT is connected with the diode D1, one end of the chip porcelain piece capacitor C2 is connected with the D1 and the other end is connected with the system GND, and the other end of the chip double diode D1 is connected with the current limiting resistor R1.

title_en: Inverter circuit for special communication
abstract_en: The application discloses an inverter circuit for special communication, which comprises a DC-DC boosting module, a DC-AC inversion module and an auxiliary power module, wherein the DC-DC boosting module comprises a boosting power circuit and a boosting control circuit, and the DC-AC inversion module comprises an inversion power circuit and an inversion control circuit. The first direct current power supply is boosted and rectified through the boosting power circuit, the boosted first direct current power supply is input into the inverting power circuit, the boosted first direct current power supply is subjected to high-frequency inversion, the high-frequency pulse voltage is obtained, the high-frequency pulse voltage is filtered, and finally the target alternating current power supply is obtained, so that the function of converting direct current into alternating current is realized. The power supply system has the advantages that the power supply system is simple in structure, convenient to use, high in efficiency and convenient to use, the auxiliary power supply module is used for auxiliary power supply, the reliability of power supply is improved, the protection circuit is used for protecting the circuit, the overall safety performance of the inverter is improved, the boost control circuit and the inversion control circuit are used for feedback control of the whole circuit, and the output target alternating current power supply is high in dynamic characteristic and static characteristic and high in environmental adaptability.

title_en: Auxiliary device for hanging ground wire on power transmission line
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of power transmission lines, and particularly relates to an auxiliary device for hanging an earth wire of a power transmission line, which comprises a sleeve, wherein the lower end of the sleeve is rotationally connected with a rotating handle, the upper end of the rotating handle is fixedly connected with a threaded rod, the upper end of the threaded rod is in threaded sleeve connection with a connecting rod, the cylindrical surface of the connecting rod is fixedly connected with two rectangular sliding blocks which are correspondingly arranged front and back, the inner wall of the cylindrical surface of the sleeve is provided with two sliding grooves which are correspondingly arranged front and back, and the two rectangular sliding blocks are in sliding connection in the corresponding sliding grooves. The length of the utility model can be adjusted, the utility model is hung at a higher and farther position, and the power transmission wire can be clamped by only pressing and loosening the pressing handle, thereby being convenient and fast and having strong practicability.

title_en: Warning signal lamp for vehicle exterior
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of warning lamps, and particularly discloses a warning signal lamp for the exterior of a vehicle. The lampshade is fixedly connected with the bottom shell; the utility model adopts the reflective cup with a bowl-shaped structure, designs the reflective surface into a stripe-shaped pattern structure, and designs the baffle plate to divide the reflective cup into a plurality of reflective areas, and the multi-lamp-bead reflective cup designed by combining the stripe-shaped pattern and the baffle plate can better utilize the LED light source to reflect light more intensively, so that the light angle is concentrated in the range required by regulations, the brightness is more obvious, and further the striking effect is achieved.

title_en: Acid filter sheet fixture
abstract_en: The utility model provides a hot-filtering acid piece tooling, which comprises a base and is characterized in that at least three backup seats are arranged on the base, backup for limiting a storage battery cover is horizontally and slidably connected on the backup seats, a first locking screw capable of locking the backup is further connected on the backup seats in a threaded manner, a vertical frame is further arranged on the base, a mounting table is fixedly arranged on the vertical frame, a lifting cylinder is arranged on the mounting table, a piston rod of the lifting cylinder is vertically downward, the end part of the piston rod of the lifting cylinder is connected with an adjusting plate, two connecting rods with adjustable positions are horizontally and slidably connected on the adjusting plate, the connecting rods are connected with a tooling mounting plate, a heating tooling is arranged on the tooling mounting plate, a working head is arranged on the heating tooling, a second locking screw is arranged on the adjusting plate, and the second locking screw is in threaded connection with the connecting rods.

title_en: Refrigerant pump and sealing device for connecting terminal and sealing terminal in shell of refrigerant pump
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of refrigerant pumps, in particular to a sealing device for a wiring terminal and a sealing binding post in a refrigerant pump shell and a refrigerant pump comprising the sealing device, wherein the sealing binding post is provided with a wiring seat which is in sealing connection with a mounting hole on the shell of the refrigerant pump and a metal rod which is arranged on the wiring seat and at least partially positioned in the shell, the wiring terminal is connected with the metal rod in the shell, the sealing device comprises a plug arranged in the shell, one end of the plug is fixed with the wire holder and seals the wire holder, the other end of the plug is provided with a sealing cavity, a metal rod is arranged in the plug to pass through and lead to a through hole in the sealing cavity, the sealing cavity accommodates the wire connecting terminal and is provided with a lead-out hole for the lead-out wire of the wire connecting terminal to extend out of the sealing cavity, and the lead-out hole is in sealing fit with the lead-out wire. The terminal and the sealing post which are exposed in the shell can be isolated from the refrigerant in the shell.

title_en: Auxiliary collector for cable stripper
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an auxiliary collector for a cable stripper, which comprises a jaw fixing piece, a collecting member, a storage box and a movable gate, wherein the jaw fixing piece is fixedly arranged at the jaw position of the cable stripper, the collecting member is fixed on the jaw fixing piece, a transparent film is arranged at the front end of the collecting member so as to form a collecting opening, the collecting opening is opposite to the jaw position, the storage box is fixed on the collecting member, an opening of the storage box is opposite to the collecting opening, and the back of the storage box is provided with the movable gate. The product is reasonable in design, easy to clean and topple over, and can effectively lead the peeled wire skin to fall into the storage box and collect the wire skin in time, thereby ensuring the neatness and order of the field working environment and improving the quality of vehicle products and environmental sanitation.

title_en: Guide tool, motor mounting shaft, motor and vehicle
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a guide tool, a mounting shaft of a motor, the motor and a vehicle. The guide tool is used for assisting a mounting shaft of a motor to mount a power assembly, the mounting shaft comprises a power shaft part used for mounting the power assembly, a guide shaft part coaxially connected with the power shaft part and a positioning part arranged on the guide shaft part, the guide shaft part is provided with a guide surface, and the guide tool comprises a body and a positioning matching part. The body has annular outer peripheral face, and location cooperation portion is connected in the body, and location cooperation portion is used for being connected with location portion location for cup joint in the power shaft part after guiding the power module to pass annular outer peripheral face, the guide face of guide shaft part. The guide length of the axial direction of the installation shaft is increased through the external guide tool, and then when the axial dimension of the guide shaft part on the installation shaft is designed, the axial length of the guide shaft part can be reduced compared with the axial dimension of the guide shaft part which can be designed in the related art, so that the axial length of the installation shaft of the motor is reduced, and the volume and the weight of the motor are reduced.

title_en: Voltage equalizing circuit
abstract_en: The application discloses a voltage equalizing circuit, wherein a first voltage equalizing object is arranged between a first node and a fourth node, a second voltage equalizing object is arranged between a second node and a fourth node, a first resistor is arranged between the first node and a third node, a second resistor is arranged between the second node and the third node, a first end of a first combined tube is connected with the third node, one end of the third resistor is connected with the first node, the other end of the third resistor is connected with a second end of the first combined tube, the third end of the first combined tube is connected with the fourth node, a first end of a second combined tube is connected with the third node, one end of the fourth resistor is connected with the second node, the other end of the fourth resistor is connected with a second end of the second combined tube, and the third end of the second combined tube is connected with the fourth node. The voltage equalizing circuit provided by the application solves the problems of difficult device shape selection and poor voltage equalizing effect in the high-voltage application scene in the existing voltage equalizing circuit.

title_en: Track spotlight
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of lamps, in particular to a track spot lamp, which comprises a spot lamp assembly, a driving box, a bolt assembly and a mounting bracket, wherein the driving box is connected with the mounting bracket, the spot lamp assembly is connected with the driving box through the bolt assembly, the spot lamp assembly comprises a lamp cylinder body, a first rotary cover is fixedly arranged on the lamp cylinder body, the driving box comprises a shell and a cover plate, a second rotary cover is arranged on the cover plate, the spot lamp assembly and the driving box rotate in a matched manner through the first rotary cover and the second rotary cover, and the irradiation direction adjustable range of the track spot lamp is greatly increased through the matching of the first rotary cover and the second rotary cover, so that the track spot lamp can meet more use requirements of users.

title_en: Screw rod pressing device for helium-back glue pressing screw
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of screw pressing rods, and discloses a helium glue pressing screw pressing rod device which comprises a screw pressing rod main body and a supporting rod, wherein the supporting rod is detachably fixed at the top of the screw pressing rod main body, an auxiliary guide plate is arranged on the side edge of the screw pressing rod main body, a connecting cushion block is fixed on one side, close to the supporting rod, of the top of the auxiliary guide plate, a movable sliding block is fixed on one side, far away from the auxiliary guide plate, of the connecting cushion block, and the movable sliding block is inserted in the supporting rod in a sliding manner.

title_en: Refrigerant pipeline structure, thermal management unit and electric loader
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of heat management, and particularly relates to a refrigerant pipeline structure, a heat management unit and an electric loader. The utility model provides a refrigerant pipeline structure which comprises a first refrigerant pipeline, a second refrigerant pipeline, a third refrigerant pipeline and a third refrigerant pipeline, wherein the first refrigerant pipeline is connected between a condenser and a compressor, the first refrigerant pipeline is provided with a first shock absorption pipe, the second refrigerant pipeline is connected between the compressor and a heat exchanger, the second refrigerant pipeline is provided with a second shock absorption pipe, and the third refrigerant pipeline is connected between the condenser and the heat exchanger. In the refrigerant pipeline structure provided by the utility model, when the compressor vibrates during working or the vehicle body vibrates, the damping pipe can play a role in buffering and damping, and the influence of the vibration of the compressor and the vehicle body on the refrigerant pipeline can be reduced, so that the overall shock resistance of the refrigerant pipeline is improved.

title_en: Lamp set
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a lamp, and relates to the field of lighting fixtures. The lamp comprises a mounting seat and a plurality of lighting modules, wherein the lighting modules are arranged on the mounting seat. The lamp is provided with a light emitting side, and the light emitting side is positioned at one side of the plurality of lighting modules, which is away from the mounting seat. Each lighting module comprises a light-emitting unit and a lens system, wherein the light-emitting unit is connected to the mounting seat, and the light-emitting surface of the light-emitting unit faces the light-emitting side so as to emit emergent light rays to the light-emitting side. The lens system is arranged on the light path of the emergent light, the emergent light continuously propagates after penetrating through the lens system, and an emergent angle is formed at the light emergent side under the action of the lens system, and the emergent angles of at least two of the plurality of lighting modules are different. By arranging the lamp, emergent light rays with various emergent angles can be formed, linkage illumination with various different emergent angles is formed or different illumination areas are covered, and the installation and maintenance time in the use process of the lamp is saved, so that the use cost of the lamp is reduced.

title_en: Lighting lamp capable of rotating and adjusting light distance
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a lighting lamp capable of adjusting light distance in a rotating way. The novel lighting lamp solves the problems that in the prior art, the structure of the lighting lamp is complex and the light distance adjusting range is small. The lens holder is connected with a lamp holder, a battery loading shell is arranged at one end, far away from the lens holder, of the lamp holder, a lens sliding adjusting mechanism is arranged in the lens holder, a rotation driving mechanism is arranged between the battery loading shell and the lamp holder, a lighting lamp set structure which is connected with the rotation driving mechanism and driven to move by the rotation driving mechanism is arranged in the lamp holder, and a travel limiting assembly used for limiting the movement of the lighting lamp set structure is arranged in the lamp holder. The utility model has the advantages of simple structure, wide range of light distance adjustment and good use effect, and meets the requirement of diversified light distance adjustment.

title_en: Soft rubber insulation bus joint
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a soft rubber insulation bus joint, and relates to the technical field of power accessories. The utility model comprises a joint ring, wherein two ends of the joint ring are connected with a matched threaded sleeve in a threaded manner, the side wall of the other end of the matched threaded sleeve is welded with the assembled ring, an adhesive plate is adhered to the inner wall of the assembled ring, a rubber balloon is adhered to the inner wall of the adhesive plate, a sealing assembly is arranged between the matched threaded sleeve and the joint ring and comprises a sealing ring, the sealing ring is connected with a second spring through a connecting sleeve, an abutting assembly is arranged on the outer wall of the assembled ring and comprises a sliding rod and a first spring inserted in the sliding rod. The utility model can improve the tightness of the soft rubber insulation bus connector fitting by utilizing the sealing component, and can improve the tightness between the soft rubber insulation bus connector fitting and the soft rubber insulation bus by utilizing the rubber balloon on the inner wall of the assembly ring and the abutting component on the outer wall, and the assembly area for the soft rubber insulation bus is adjustable.

title_en: Battery cell inserting mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of battery cells, in particular to a battery cell plug-in mounting mechanism. Including the workstation, the workstation on be equipped with electric core cartridge unit, electric core cartridge unit one side is equipped with support material loading unit, support material loading unit one side is equipped with support storage unit, electric core cartridge unit include cartridge manipulator, electric core absorber, deflector, cartridge manipulator lower extreme is connected electric core absorber, electric core absorber below is equipped with the deflector, is equipped with a plurality of electric core through holes on the deflector, is equipped with the jacking cylinder on the workstation of deflector below, jacking cylinder one side is equipped with the limiting valve. Compared with the prior art, the battery cell plug-in unit, the bracket feeding unit and the bracket storage unit are matched to plug-in the battery cell into the battery bracket, so that the production efficiency is improved, and the requirement of mass production is met. Meanwhile, the assembly line unit is modularized, so that subsequent maintenance, whole-group replacement and adjustment are convenient.

title_en: Stirring equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides stirring equipment which comprises a shell, a stirring barrel, a lifting assembly and a stirring assembly, wherein the stirring barrel is detachably arranged on the shell, the lifting assembly comprises a lifting platform and a lifting transmission part, the lifting platform is movably connected to the shell along the height direction of the shell, the lifting transmission part is connected to the lifting platform to drive the lifting platform to lift, the stirring assembly comprises a stirring transmission part, a stirring shaft and a stirring piece, the stirring piece is positioned in the stirring barrel, the stirring transmission part is connected to one end of the stirring shaft, the other end of the stirring shaft is connected to the stirring piece when the stirring equipment is in a use state so as to drive the stirring piece to rotate, and the stirring transmission part is arranged on the lifting platform so as to enable the stirring shaft to lift along with the lifting platform. Like this, stirring drive part and lift drive part are all installed in lift platform, help improving agitated vessel's degree of integrating for the staff more conveniently debugs and assembles stirring drive part and lift drive part.

title_en: Conductive ring for shaft
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a conductive ring for a shaft, which comprises a ring body, a conductive cluster, a wiring plug spring, a crimping structure and a connecting structure, wherein the ring body comprises a conductive upper ring, a conductive lower ring connected with the conductive upper ring, and a shaft hole into which a rotating shaft of a power supply motor is inserted, the conductive cluster protrudes from the side wall of the shaft hole to be abutted against the rotating shaft of the motor, the crimping structure is arranged on the main body and is used for being connected with the conductive lower ring, and the crimping structure is used for being crimped with the conductive cluster to fix the conductive cluster. The utility model provides a conductive ring for a shaft, which is characterized in that a conductive cluster is pressed on a main body through a pressing structure, the main body is arranged on a conductive lower ring through a connecting structure, and finally, the conductive upper ring is connected with the conductive lower ring. When the conductive clusters are in contact with the motor shaft in the shaft hole, the conductive clusters provide a low-impedance path for guiding the current of the motor shaft to the outside, thereby protecting the motor.

title_en: Input/output protection circuit and circuit protection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of circuits, in particular to an input/output protection circuit and a circuit protection device. An input/output protection circuit comprises an isolation element, a switching element, an input protection unit and an output protection unit, wherein the isolation element is provided with an input end and an output end and is used for realizing electrical isolation between an input signal and an output signal in a photoelectric coupling mode, the switching element is connected with the input end of the isolation element and is used for controlling the working state of the isolation element, the input protection unit is used for limiting the voltage or the current of the input signal, and the output protection unit is connected with the output end of the isolation element and is used for carrying out current limiting protection on the output signal and providing a signal output port isolated by the isolation element. The scheme can realize the isolation protection of the circuit.

title_en: Wire welding structure and wire welding device
abstract_en: The application discloses a wire welding structure and a wire welding device, which are applied to wire ultrasonic welding, wherein the wire welding structure clamps a wire along a first direction by arranging a first welding component and a second welding component, clamps the wire along a second direction by arranging a third welding component and a welding head in a matching way, so that the positioning welding of the wire is realized, wherein the second welding component is detachably connected with a second welding part by arranging a second bracket, and at the moment, the second welding part can be timely detached and replaced after being worn and failed in the welding process, and compared with the case of directly replacing the second welding component, the service life of the whole second welding component can be correspondingly prolonged, and meanwhile, the use cost of equipment is effectively reduced by replacing the worn second welding part.

title_en: Double-end panel light subassembly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-head panel lamp assembly, in particular to the technical field of panel lamps, which comprises a front panel, wherein two fixing rings are integrally formed on the front panel, a flame-retardant rear plate is sleeved outside the two fixing rings together, the flame-retardant rear plate is detachably connected with the front panel, the two fixed ring tops are all fixedly mounted with the spacing ring, and the spacing ring is equipped with the lamp body with the common cover that can dismantle in the fixed ring inner chamber, is connected with the power bus on the lamp body, and the power bus outer end is connected with the power pack, and the front panel both sides all are provided with two spring clamp, and every two spring clamp symmetry sets up in the spacing ring both sides. According to the utility model, the fixing ring is arranged on the front panel, so that the front panel can conveniently assemble the lamp body and the front panel to form the panel lamp through the limiting ring, the angle between the clamping surface of the spring clamp and the lamp body is adjusted when the panel lamp is installed, the panel lamp can be conveniently and rapidly installed through the mounting hole, and the mounting efficiency is effectively improved.

title_en: Energy-saving transformer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of transformers and discloses an energy-saving transformer, which comprises a shell, wherein the outer surface of the upper end of the shell is fixedly connected with a low-voltage sleeve and a high-voltage porcelain sleeve, the low-voltage sleeve is positioned at the front end of the high-voltage porcelain sleeve, the outer surface of the lower end of the shell is fixedly connected with a base, the outer surface of the upper end of the shell is fixedly connected with a connecting side plate, the outer surface of the upper end of the connecting side plate is fixedly connected with a radiating component, and the outer surface of the periphery of the shell is fixedly connected with radiating fins.

title_en: Open stepping motor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an open stepping motor which comprises a fixed seat and a motor main body, wherein the motor main body comprises a motor shell, a stator assembly and a rotor assembly which are respectively arranged in the motor shell, the rotor assembly comprises a plastic part and a magnet, the plastic part and the magnet are in an injection molding integrated structure, a shell positioning groove is formed in the fixed seat corresponding to the motor shell, a rotor positioning shaft which extends in a protruding mode is arranged on the bottom surface of the shell positioning groove, the rear end portion of the motor shell is embedded and positioned in the shell positioning groove of the fixed seat, a shaft hole which extends along the axis direction of the plastic part and faces to the rear opening is formed in the core portion of the plastic part, the rotor positioning shaft of the fixed seat is embedded and inserted in the shaft hole of the plastic part, and the rotor positioning shaft is in clearance fit with the plastic part. Through the structural design, the utility model has the advantages of novel design, simple structure and convenient and fast installation.

title_en: Miniature inductive brushless motor
