abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of intelligent robots and discloses a miniature inductive brushless motor, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a fixing component for installing a device is connected to the periphery of the bottom plate in a threaded manner, a limiting component for positioning a subsequent workpiece is fixedly connected to the top of the bottom plate, a customized shell is connected to the inside of the limiting component in a sliding manner, a customized rear cover is fixedly connected to the left end of the customized shell, a customized Hall reversing circuit is fixedly connected to the left side of the inside of the customized rear cover, three pins are fixedly connected to the left end of the customized Hall reversing circuit, and five wires are fixedly connected to the front end of the left side of the customized rear cover. According to the utility model, the three-pin five-wire structure is realized, the three phase wires with larger current quantity are provided with the 0.64mm pins, the current bearing capacity is greatly improved, the five wires related to the Hall are provided with the 1.25-5P terminals, and the 3-pin five-wire structure is not easy to deform during production due to thickening and shortening of the pins.

title_en: Anti-interference motor protector
abstract_en: The utility model adopts an anti-interference motor protector, which comprises a shell, three magnetic rings and a PCB board, wherein the three magnetic rings respectively comprise pins, the three magnetic rings are welded on the PCB board through the three pins, the PCB board comprises three wiring lines with the same wiring length, the three magnetic rings of the motor protector are ensured to have the same wavelength through the three wiring lines with the same wiring length, when radio frequency equipment approaches, the three magnetic rings can sense the same wavelength, the situation that the radio frequency equipment is similar to the prior art because of unreliable design of the internal circuit of the motor protector, and when the radio frequency equipment senses signals, the wavelength input into the motor protector enters and exits, so that the motor protector is interfered, and the situation of overload, phase failure, locked-rotor or underload and other alarm signals are caused.

title_en: Fixing device for aerial cable installation
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fixing device for installing an overhead cable, which relates to the technical field of cable fixing and comprises a trapezoid plate, wherein an L-shaped plate is fixedly connected to the surface of the trapezoid plate and close to the bottom of the trapezoid plate, and a first square groove and three grooves are formed in the top of the L-shaped plate; according to the utility model, the cable is embedded into the groove, the convex plate is covered, the convex plate is extruded by the convex plate, the trapezoidal clamping plate is embedded into the cross hole, after the clamping groove is flush with the trapezoidal clamping plate, the cross plate is pushed by the spring to be embedded into the clamping groove by the trapezoidal clamping plate, the effect of conveniently fixing the convex plate can be achieved, the rotating disc is rotated to drive the screw to rotate, the clamping plate is lowered into the first square groove by the rotation of the screw, the effect of clamping and fixing the cable in the groove can be achieved, and therefore the effect of conveniently installing and fixing the cable without tools can be achieved, and the effect of improving the operation safety can be achieved.

title_en: High-efficiency conduction type composite insulating sheet
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of composite insulating sheets and discloses a high-efficiency conduction type composite insulating sheet, which comprises a heat conducting layer, wherein an adhesive layer is arranged on the upper end surface of the heat conducting layer, a first waterproof layer is adhered to the end surface of the heat conducting layer, which is far away from the adhesive layer, a first corrosion-resistant layer is adhered to the end surface of the first waterproof layer, a plurality of heat dissipation through holes are formed in the first corrosion-resistant layer, the end surface of the first corrosion-resistant layer, which is far away from the first waterproof layer, is adhered to a buffer layer, a middle layer is adhered to the bottom layer through the adhesive layer, and a top layer is adhered to the end surface of the middle layer, which is far away from the bottom layer. According to the utility model, the first waterproof layer, the first corrosion-resistant layer and the buffer layer are arranged, so that the bottom layer structure of the insulating sheet body is not single any more, and the corrosion of the external environment to the insulating sheet body is avoided, thereby prolonging the service life of the insulating sheet body.

title_en: Junction box for electric automation
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of junction boxes, and discloses a junction box for electric automation, which comprises a junction box body, wherein a junction terminal is fixedly arranged in the junction box body, one side of the junction box body is fixedly provided with a wire inlet connector, the other side of the junction box body is fixedly provided with a connecting block, the outer wall of the connecting block is rotatably connected with a plurality of rotary sleeves, and the outer wall of the rotary sleeve is fixedly provided with a wire outlet connector.

title_en: Multifunctional sounding alarm clock
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional audible alarm clock, which comprises a micro-current bracelet and a shell provided with a touch screen, wherein a loudspeaker module, a power module and a control system are arranged in the shell, the touch screen is arranged on the front side of the shell, a cavity for accommodating the micro-current bracelet is arranged on the rear side of the shell, a cover plate is rotatably arranged on one side of the cavity, a hanging plate is slidably arranged in the cavity, an extending lug is integrally formed at the top of the hanging plate, and a pressing plate is rotatably arranged below the extending lug through an elastic member, so that the pressing plate clamps the micro-current bracelet between the extending lug and the pressing plate through the cooperation of the elastic member. According to the utility model, the functions of sound, alarm clock, charger and micro-current bracelet reminding are integrated, a user can store the micro-current bracelet and the power line in the shell, multiple functions are integrated, the user can meet multiple requirements through one device, such as music listening, device charging and alarm clock reminding, and the convenience of using the alarm clock is improved while the user is helped to manage time better.

title_en: Live working insulating lock rod
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electric power facility maintenance, in particular to an insulating lock rod for live working, which comprises a main rod and a pull rod, wherein the head end of the main rod is provided with a clamp, the tail end of the main rod is provided with a first handle, the clamp is connected with the head end of the pull rod, the tail end of the pull rod is provided with an operation part, the operation part is positioned on the main rod, the clamp comprises a fixed clamp and a movable clamp which are hinged with each other, and the tops of the movable clamp and the fixed clamp are respectively provided with a guide end for guiding a clamped wire to enter the clamp. Compared with the jaw structure of the traditional lock rod, the movable clamp and the fixed clamp are respectively provided with the corresponding guide ends at the tops, so that the jaw structure presents an opening expanding trend and the clamping space is unchanged, and the guide of the clamped wire and the convenient guide of the wire are realized, and the conditions of difficult wire entering and the like caused by smaller jaws are avoided.

title_en: Anti-winding wire harness
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of wire harnesses, and discloses an anti-winding wire harness which comprises a plurality of wire harnesses, wherein an anti-winding mechanism is arranged on each wire harness, each anti-winding mechanism comprises a head wire harness plate, a tail wire harness plate, an auxiliary wire harness plate, a first bottom plate, a second bottom plate, an inserting block, a binding belt and a magic tape, the head wire harness plate, the tail wire harness plates and the auxiliary wire harness plates are sleeved on the outer sides of the wire harnesses, T-shaped splicing blocks are fixedly arranged on the tail wire harness plates and the auxiliary wire harness plates, T-shaped splicing grooves are formed in the head wire harness plates and the auxiliary wire harness plates, the T-shaped splicing blocks are clamped with the T-shaped splicing grooves, the first bottom plate and the second bottom plate are fixedly arranged on the head wire harness plates and the tail wire harness plates respectively, the inserting block is clamped with the first bottom plate, the binding belt is fixedly arranged on the inserting block, and the magic tape is fixedly arranged on the binding belt. The utility model has the advantages that the number of the auxiliary wire harness plates can be increased or reduced according to different wire harnesses, and the use is convenient.

title_en: Housing assembly and motor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a shell component and a motor, and relates to the technical field of motors, wherein the shell component comprises a shell and a fan cover; the shell is provided with an air inlet and an air outlet which are communicated with the inner cavity of the shell, the fan cover is arranged on at least part of the outer side wall of the shell, a first ventilating duct is formed by enclosing the fan cover and the shell, and the first ventilating duct is communicated with the air inlet and the air outlet. The technical scheme provided by the utility model can reduce the wind resistance of the wind path in the shell assembly so as to improve the heat dissipation effect.

title_en: PE communication pipe for municipal engineering construction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a PE communication pipe for municipal engineering construction, the end of the communication pipe is provided with four spiral arc grooves, the inner sides of the four spiral arc grooves are provided with movable grooves, the inside of a connecting sleeve is provided with a sliding groove, a limiting ring is arranged in the sliding groove in a sliding way, the inner side of the limiting ring is fixedly connected with four guide bulges matched with the four spiral arc grooves, along with the propulsion of communication tube, the spacing ring takes place to rotate in the spout, until the direction arch breaks away from with spiral arc groove, and the one section of seting up spiral arc groove on the communication tube all inserts the inboard of spacing ring, rotates the communication tube afterwards for direction arch and spiral arc groove no longer to it, realize the joint of communication tube and adapter sleeve in axial in succession, promote the communication tube and adapter sleeve in axial bearing tensile ability in succession, promote the application scope of communication tube greatly.

title_en: Power supply control circuit and vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides a power supply control circuit and a vehicle. The vehicle comprises a control module and electric equipment, wherein the control module is used for outputting working signals, the working signals are used for driving the electric equipment to work, and the power supply control circuit comprises a lamp and a switch circuit. The first end of the switching circuit is used for being connected with the vehicle-mounted power supply voltage, the second end of the switching circuit is electrically connected with the lamp, the third end of the switching circuit is used for being electrically connected with the control module, and the working signal is also used for controlling the on/off of the first end and the second end of the switching circuit. The application controls the on/off of the first end and the second end of the switch circuit through the working signal output by the control module, thereby controlling the power on/off of the lamp, realizing that the lamp can be started or not started when the electric equipment runs, meeting the use requirement of adding the lamp, and needing no modification of software and hardware of the controller.

title_en: Energy storage battery cell temperature control system
abstract_en: The utility model provides an energy storage battery core temperature control system which can better realize cold and hot temperature control on an energy storage battery core, ensure uniform cooling, improve cooling efficiency and avoid larger temperature fluctuation of a battery core cold plate during heating operation; the condenser is provided with a condensing fan, the heat exchanger comprises a first inlet, a second inlet, a first outlet and a second outlet, the first outlet is connected with the inlet of the compressor, the outlet of the condenser is connected with the second inlet, the condenser further comprises a one-way valve and a primary throttling mechanism, the second outlet is connected with the primary throttling mechanism after passing through the one-way valve, the inlet of the cold plate is connected with a secondary throttling mechanism, the primary throttling mechanism is connected with the secondary throttling mechanism, the outlet of the cold plate is connected with the first inlet, the output of the compressed refrigerant of the compressor is divided into two paths after passing through a connecting control valve assembly, one path enters the condenser, and the other path is connected to a connecting pipeline between the one-way valve and the primary throttling mechanism.

title_en: Tiny flat enamelled wire painting device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fine flat enamelled wire painting device, and belongs to the technical field of enamelled wire production equipment. The novel anti-theft device comprises a base, wherein a first mounting groove and a second mounting groove are formed in the upper surface of the base, a sponge group is arranged in each of the first mounting groove and the second mounting groove, each sponge group comprises two sponges which are stacked together, a first balancing weight is arranged at the top of the sponge group in the first mounting groove, a second balancing weight is arranged at the top of the sponge group in the second mounting groove, strip-shaped through holes are formed in the first balancing weight, a plurality of blocking rods used for blocking the sponge group, the first balancing weight and the second balancing weight are arranged on one side of each of the first mounting groove and the second mounting groove at intervals, a first painting channel is formed in the base below the first mounting groove, and a plurality of overflow holes are formed between the first painting channel and the first mounting groove. The utility model has the advantages of simple structure, low cost, uniform painting, etc.

title_en: Robot joint motor
abstract_en: The application provides a robot joint motor, which belongs to the technical field of robots and comprises a shell and a circuit board fixedly connected to the side wall of the shell, wherein the inner wall of the shell is fixedly connected with a partition plate, the side wall of the partition plate is fixedly connected with cycloidal pins which are uniformly distributed, the side wall of the partition plate is fixedly connected with a stator, the inner wall of the stator is fixedly connected with a sleeve, the inner wall of the sleeve is fixedly connected with a toothed ring, the inner wall of the shell is connected with a centralizing part for improving the compactness of the structure, the side wall of the partition plate is connected with a transmission part for reducing the precision of a processed part, the centralizing part comprises a stabilizer bar fixedly connected to the side wall of a first planetary plate, the outer wall of the stabilizer bar is fixedly connected with a first eccentric wheel and a second eccentric wheel, the outer rotor motor and a speed reducer can be integrally designed through the centralizing part, the compactness of the structure is improved, the transmission clearance is compensated through software under the action of the transmission part, and therefore the effect of zero transmission clearance is created, and the practicability is stronger.

title_en: Ion beam control device and ion implantation equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ion beam flow control device and ion implantation equipment, wherein the ion beam flow control device comprises a motor amplifier of a wafer scanning mechanism and a high-voltage interlocking unit for controlling a high-voltage power supply of the ion implantation equipment, and further comprises a control unit, wherein the input end of the control unit is electrically connected with an enabling signal output end of the motor amplifier, the enabling signal of the motor amplifier is effective when the wafer scanning mechanism works normally, the enabling signal of the motor amplifier is invalid when the wafer scanning mechanism fails abnormally, a first control end of the control unit is connected with a power supply voltage, a second control end of the control unit is electrically connected with the power supply input end of the high-voltage interlocking unit, and the control unit is used for disconnecting the power supply voltage from the high-voltage interlocking unit when the enabling signal of the motor amplifier is invalid. The utility model can rapidly stop the ion beam current when the wafer scanning mechanism is abnormally dropped, thereby improving the production efficiency and reducing the cost.

title_en: Energy storage converter
abstract_en: The application relates to an energy storage converter which comprises a cabinet, an inversion power unit, a power inductor, a first heat dissipation component and a second heat dissipation component, wherein an inductance cabin is arranged at the bottom of a cavity of the cabinet, the power inductor is arranged in the inductance cabin, the first heat dissipation component, the inversion power unit and the inductance cabin are sequentially arranged in the cavity of the cabinet from top to bottom, the inversion power unit comprises a first inverter and a second inverter which are oppositely arranged, a preset distance is arranged between the first inverter and the second inverter to form a heat dissipation air channel, the blowing end of the first heat dissipation component faces the heat dissipation air channel between the first inverter and the second inverter, the blowing end of the first heat dissipation component is communicated with the inside of the cavity of the inductance cabin through the heat dissipation air channel, the second heat dissipation component is arranged on one side of the first heat dissipation component, the second heat dissipation component is suitable for absorbing hot air in the cabinet, and discharging the hot air back into the cabinet after heat absorption and cooling, and the double heat dissipation design improves the whole heat dissipation efficiency.

title_en: Docking station capable of preventing wire from coming off
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-off-line docking station, and relates to the technical field of docking stations. The anti-off-line docking station comprises a docking station body, a connecting plate, an anti-off-line structure and an adjusting structure, wherein the connecting wire is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the docking station body, the connecting plate is arranged at the bottom of the docking station body, two groups of wear-resistant anti-slip rubber mats which are distributed left and right are arranged at the bottom of the connecting plate, the anti-off-line structure is arranged between the connecting plate and the docking station body, and the adjusting structure is arranged on the anti-off-line structure and the connecting plate. The expansion dock with the anti-off line can keep the connector between the anti-off line structure and the expansion dock body when the data line is inserted into the expansion dock body, can prevent the data line from being accidentally separated from the expansion dock body, ensures connection stability, avoids the situation of accidental off-line, is simultaneously applicable to different data lines, and is convenient to adjust the distance between the anti-off line structure and the expansion dock body, so that the data line can be matched according to the length of the connector of the data line.

title_en: Novel rectangular bus fixing fitting
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel rectangular bus fixing fitting, which comprises a base, wherein a first mounting hole is formed in the upper end of the base, a second mounting hole is formed in the side face of the base, the first mounting hole and the second mounting hole are used for mounting a main clamping piece, two aluminum pipes are parallelly fixed on the side face of the main clamping piece, threads are formed in the end parts, away from the main clamping piece, of the two aluminum pipes, a secondary clamping piece is connected to the end parts in a threaded mode, and the upper end and the side face of the base are respectively provided with the mounting holes, so that copper bars can be vertically placed or laterally placed when clamped, spacers are arranged between the parallel aluminum pipes, and multiple groups of copper bars can be placed.

title_en: Case lid of transformer tank
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of transformers, in particular to a tank cover of a transformer tank, which comprises a tank body, wherein the top of the tank body is movably connected with a cover body, the top of the cover body is fixedly connected with a mounting block, the inside of the mounting block is in penetrating sliding connection with a sliding rod, the bottom end of the sliding rod extending to the inside of the tank body is fixedly connected with a base, the side wall of the base is fixedly connected with a rotating seat A, the inside of the rotating seat A is rotatably connected with a connecting rod A, the two ends of the bottom of the cover body are fixedly connected with rotating seats B.

title_en: Motor wiring board mounting structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a motor wiring board mounting structure which comprises a heat dissipation base and a wiring board, wherein a wiring board fixing area is arranged on the heat dissipation base, a connecting window is arranged on the wiring board fixing area, an inserting protrusion is arranged on the back surface of the wiring board, wiring pins on the wiring board are exposed out of the inserting protrusion, a sealing plug is embedded in the connecting window, the sealing plug comprises an embedded ring part plugged into the connecting window and a flange edge part in contact with and matched with the surface of the connecting window, the inserting protrusion is inserted into the embedded ring part to extrude the embedded ring part and detachably fix the embedded ring part and the heat dissipation base, and the back surface of the wiring board extrudes the surface of the flange edge part so that the wiring board and the connecting window are in sealing fit through the sealing plug. This wiring board mounting structure can be better make heat dissipation base and wiring board seal fit, further improves waterproof performance.

title_en: Battery cover plate assembly and single battery
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of batteries, and discloses a battery cover plate assembly and a single battery. The battery cover plate assembly comprises a cover plate body, a lower plastic part, an electrode assembly and a heat insulating part, wherein the lower plastic part is arranged on one side of the cover plate body, the electrode assembly is sealed and insulated on the cover plate body, the heat insulating part is arranged on one side, deviating from the cover plate body, of the lower plastic part, the heat insulating part is used for weakening heat conduction between the cover plate body and the battery cell, and the electrode assembly is separated from the battery cell by the heat insulating part when the electrode assembly generates heat, so that heat transfer to the battery cell is reduced, the influence of heat of the battery cover plate assembly on the battery cell is reduced, the reliability of the battery cover plate assembly is improved, the performance of a single battery provided with the battery cover plate assembly is ensured, and the attenuation speed of the performance is slowed down.

title_en: Construction device for electromechanical pipeline of building
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of building electromechanics and discloses a building electromechanics pipeline construction device which comprises a bottom shell and a protective shell, wherein the protective shell is positioned above the bottom shell, plugboards are symmetrically arranged at the bottom of the protective shell, guide grooves for the plugboards to move are formed in the upper surface of the bottom shell, fixing components are respectively arranged on the front end surface and the rear end surface of the bottom shell, and a plurality of connecting plates are fixedly connected to the upper surface of the bottom shell. According to the utility model, through the fixed assembly, the whole assembly treatment of the device can be conveniently carried out by a worker without tools such as bolts, the whole assembly efficiency of the device is effectively improved, the workload of the worker is lightened, and through the arranged installation assembly, the specification of the arc clamp can be conveniently replaced by the worker, so that the arc clamp can effectively fix and treat wires with different specifications, and the whole practicability of the device is effectively improved.

title_en: Connection tool for photovoltaic module test and photovoltaic module test equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a connecting tool for testing a photovoltaic module and photovoltaic module testing equipment. The connecting tool for testing the photovoltaic module comprises a connecting seat, and an anode connecting piece, an anode conducting piece, a cathode connecting piece, a cathode conducting piece and a magnetic attraction piece which are arranged on the connecting seat. The positive electrode connecting piece is electrically connected with the positive electrode conducting piece, the negative electrode connecting piece is electrically connected with the negative electrode conducting piece, and the magnetic attraction piece is used for being attached to the IV testing device in an adsorption mode, so that the positive electrode conducting piece is contacted with the first electrifying piece, and the negative electrode conducting piece is contacted with the second electrifying piece. The mode that adopts magnetism to inhale is in the same place IV testing arrangement and is connected the frock absorption, realizes the location of IV testing arrangement and connection frock, and during each time test, the contact position and the contact dynamics between first circular telegram spare and the anodal electrically conductive piece and between second circular telegram spare and the negative pole electrically conductive piece keep unanimous, and the wearing and tearing degree of every connection frock is unanimous basically, so can reduce the test error that the difference of connecting the frock brought, guarantees the accuracy and the stability of test.

title_en: Cable bridge with branching structure
abstract_en: The application relates to a cable bridge with a branching structure, and relates to the field of cable bridges, which comprises a bridge body, wherein the bridge body comprises side plates positioned at two sides, a plurality of wire arranging brackets are detachably arranged on the inner side walls of the two side plates respectively, a plurality of wire branching cards are fixedly arranged on the wire arranging brackets, and placing grooves for placing cables are formed in the wire branching cards. The application can orderly fix the cables in the cable bridge through the wire arranging bracket in the bridge body, thereby reducing the occurrence of winding and knotting of the cables in the bridge body.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant and wear-resistant automobile wire harness
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-temperature-resistant and wear-resistant automobile wire harness, which belongs to the technical field of automobile wire harnesses and comprises a plurality of wire harness connecting wires, wherein the right ends of the wire harness connecting wires are fixedly connected with insulating connectors together, the front surfaces of the insulating connectors and the back surfaces of the insulating connectors are fixedly connected with connecting plates, the left side surfaces of the connecting plates are respectively provided with a limiting chute, the inside of each limiting chute is connected with a positioning bolt in a sliding manner, and the right sides of the insulating connectors are provided with partial automobile terminals. This high temperature resistant wear-resisting car pencil through being provided with the cooperation of insulating connector, connecting plate, spacing spout, positioning bolt and screw barrel, can make insulating connector and some car terminals prepositioning through the connecting plate, and reuse positioning nut can be connected insulating connector and some car terminals steadily, reduces and causes the poor problem of even coming off of this car pencil and car terminal connection, plays and can use this car pencil steadily.

title_en: Current transformer and electric energy meter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a current transformer and an electric energy meter, wherein the current transformer comprises a transformer body, a voltage sampling needle and a limiting piece, the transformer body comprises a shell and a conducting plate, the voltage sampling needle is connected with the conducting plate, a part of the voltage sampling needle extends along a first direction, the limiting piece comprises a first wallboard and a first buckle, the first wallboard extends along the first direction, the first buckle is connected with the first wallboard and comprises a first clamping hook part, the first clamping hook part and the first wallboard are arranged at intervals along a second direction, a part of the voltage sampling needle is limited between the first wallboard and the first clamping hook part, the limiting piece is provided with a through hole penetrating through the first wallboard along the second direction, and the first clamping hook part and the through hole are arranged oppositely. According to the utility model, the through hole is arranged opposite to the first clamping hook part, and after the limiting piece is injection molded, part of the die structure can be withdrawn from the through hole, so that the die is favorable for stripping, a complex stripping mechanism is not required to be designed, the die design is simplified, and the production cost is reduced.

title_en: Charging station of shell assembly and photovoltaic cleaning robot
abstract_en: The application provides a shell assembly and a charging station of a photovoltaic cleaning robot, wherein the shell assembly comprises a charging station shell, a support and a guide bridge, the charging station shell is provided with a machine bin, the machine bin is provided with an opening used for allowing the photovoltaic cleaning robot to go in and out, the machine bin is used for accommodating the photovoltaic cleaning robot, the charging station shell comprises a plurality of protection plates, the machine bin is formed by the protection plates and is used for protecting the photovoltaic cleaning robot in a plurality of directions, the photovoltaic cleaning robot is protected based on the protection plates in the plurality of directions, the charging station shell is compatible with the accommodating effect and the protecting effect of the photovoltaic cleaning robot, the photovoltaic cleaning robot is prevented from being exposed to the external environment, the protecting effect of the shell assembly on the photovoltaic cleaning robot is improved, and the machine bin is used for being used for moving the photovoltaic cleaning robot to overcome the height difference of the support and the charging station shell.

title_en: High-efficiency secondary dust removing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-efficiency secondary dust removal device, which relates to the technical field of electronic product dust removal and aims at solving the problems that electrostatic adsorption dust is difficult to completely remove and secondary damage is possibly caused to the surface of a product in the prior art, the utility model provides a scheme which comprises a shell, an ion wind nozzle and a safety grating, wherein the interior of the shell is of a hollow structure, the upper part of the interior of the shell is connected with the ion wind nozzle, the number of the ion wind nozzles is two, the device comprises a shell, an ion wind nozzle, a safety grating, an integrated mechanism, a dust separation mechanism and a dust separation mechanism, wherein the ion wind nozzle is used for releasing ion wind to neutralize and separate electrostatic dust on the surface of a product, the safety grating is connected to one side above the shell, the integrated mechanism is arranged below the ion wind nozzle at intervals and is used for generating directional wind flow to match with the ion wind nozzle for dust separation.

title_en: Protection board supporting photovoltaic charging
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a protection board supporting photovoltaic charging, which comprises a solar photovoltaic module, an asynchronous boost charging control circuit and a lithium battery protection circuit, wherein the output end of the solar photovoltaic module is electrically connected with the asynchronous boost charging control circuit, the output end of the asynchronous boost charging control circuit is electrically connected with the lithium battery protection circuit, and the lithium battery protection circuit is used for being electrically connected with a battery cell group and load equipment respectively. The utility model relates to a protection board supporting photovoltaic charging, which can charge a battery pack by utilizing a small solar photovoltaic panel through arranging an asynchronous boosting charging control circuit, so that clean energy conversion and utilization are realized, and the protection board is more environment-friendly and energy-saving.

title_en: Cable unreeling and winding structure of photovoltaic junction box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of photovoltaic junction boxes, in particular to a cable winding structure of a photovoltaic junction box, which aims to solve the technical problem that cables of the photovoltaic junction box in the prior art cannot be stored and can be dragged and dropped on the ground. Through pulling the cable, the cable drives the reel and rotates, and the reel rotates and drives the driving disc and rotate together for the driving disc drives traction mechanism and pulls the cable, thereby accomplishes the release of cable, and when the cable needs to be reeled, the driving disc drives the reel under the torsion of torsion spring of self and rotates and take up the cable, and at this in-process, it is noted that traction mechanism can pull the cable, makes the cable twine on the reel in the slope of a direction of preface.

title_en: Crystal ceiling lamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a crystal pendant lamp which comprises a hanging plate, a hanging wire assembly, a mounting structure, a light source assembly and a lamp shade assembly, wherein the hanging wire assembly is used for connecting the hanging plate and the mounting structure, the mounting structure comprises a mounting plate and an upper mounting ring and a lower mounting ring which are arranged below the mounting plate at intervals, the light source assembly comprises a plurality of light source pieces, the light source pieces are fixed on the mounting plate along the circumferential direction of the mounting plate, the lamp shade assembly comprises a plurality of crystal pieces, the crystal pieces are arranged around the inner circumferential surface between the upper mounting ring and the lower mounting ring, the outer circumferential surface between the upper mounting ring and the lower mounting ring and the position of the bottom of the lower mounting ring, a plurality of reinforcing ribs are arranged between the upper mounting ring and the lower mounting ring, and the reinforcing ribs are used for reinforcing the structural strength of the upper mounting ring and the lower mounting ring. According to the utility model, the upper mounting ring, the lower mounting ring and the reinforcing ribs are arranged to be matched and fixed with each crystal piece, so that the stability of the crystal pendant lamp is improved.

title_en: Automatic correcting machine for cylindrical lithium battery
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of lithium battery production, in particular to an automatic cylindrical lithium battery straightening machine, which comprises a conveying part and a guide rail, wherein a conveying area is formed above the conveying part, the conveying part is used for conveying a tray containing batteries and arranged in the conveying area along a first direction, the guide rail is arranged above the conveying area, the guide rail extends along a second direction, and a sliding table is arranged on the guide rail and can move along the length direction of the guide rail. According to the utility model, through two steps of photographing and obtaining the angles of the battery electrodes and correcting each battery angle, a plurality of unordered batteries in the supporting plate are corrected to be consistent in angles of all the batteries, the sliding table reciprocates once above the supporting plate, the image obtaining device obtains the angle information of all the battery electrodes, and the correction device corrects all the batteries one by one in a line manner, so that the degree of automation is high, the correction is accurate, and the test requirement before DCIR test can be met.

title_en: Novel battery pack frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel battery pack frame which comprises a frame body, wherein a plurality of upright posts are arranged on the frame body, flow channels are arranged in the middle of the upright posts, openings are formed in the top ends of the flow channels, a plurality of spray holes are formed in the inner side surfaces of the upright posts from top to bottom, a flow guide box is arranged at the top end of the frame body, heat dissipation fans are arranged at the front end and the rear end of the flow guide box, cooling coils are arranged at positions, close to the front end and the rear end, inside the flow guide box, of the flow guide box, flow guide pipes are arranged at two sides of the top end of the frame, the two flow guide pipes are respectively connected with the corresponding flow channels, and the air inlet ends of the flow guide pipes are communicated with the inside of the flow guide box. According to the utility model, the upright posts of the frame body are arranged into a hollow structure, the inner side surfaces of the upright posts are provided with spray holes, the top ends of the upright posts are connected with the diversion box through the diversion pipe, the cooling coil is arranged in the diversion box, and the front end and the rear end of the diversion box are provided with a plurality of cooling fans which suck ambient air flow into the diversion box for cooling.

title_en: Prevent locking structure of mistake pulls out
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of wire sockets, in particular to an anti-false locking structure, which comprises a middle connecting socket, wherein a socket arranged on the left side of the middle connecting socket is connected with a left end plug, a socket arranged on the right side of the middle connecting socket is connected with a right end plug, a first locking mechanism is arranged between the left end plug and the middle connecting socket, after a person inserts the left end plug into the middle connecting socket, the connection pothook that sets up can carry out the lock joint with the connection fixture block in the locking frame to will connect the fixture block and push down, then personnel again with intermediate junction socket and right-hand member plug from the other end when pegging graft, the right plug buckle that sets up can be with connecting the fixture block jack-up when connecting the fixture block lock joint, the connection pothook that the cooperation compresses tightly downwards like this can improve the stability of being connected between left-hand end plug, intermediate junction socket and the right-hand member plug, reduces the circumstances that the malocclusion appears.

title_en: Alternating current series excited motor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of motors, in particular to an alternating current series excited motor which comprises a bracket and a carbon brush assembly, wherein a stator mounting seat and a stator mounted on the stator mounting seat are arranged on the bracket, the carbon brush assembly is mounted on the top of the stator, at least two insulating seats are further arranged on the stator, two sides of the carbon brush assembly are provided with two carbon brush mounting holes in a corresponding mode, one side of each carbon brush mounting hole is provided with the mounting seat, a wiring terminal groove and a connecting terminal groove are formed in the insulating seats, the wiring terminal groove is adjacent to the mounting seat, the connecting terminal groove is located under the carbon brush mounting holes, and wiring terminals are mounted in the wiring terminal groove and the connecting terminal groove. An insulating seat is arranged on the stator, a wiring terminal is arranged on the insulating seat, and the stator winding and the rotor winding are connected through the wiring terminal, so that connecting wires in the motor are reduced. The motor is simpler to assemble by connecting in a clamping manner and in a contact manner, and the production cost is lower.

title_en: Inflatable soft light accessory for film and television lamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an inflatable soft light accessory for a film and television lamp, which comprises a supporting shell, an interface, a lens plate and an airtight transparent part, wherein the supporting shell is provided with a cavity with openings at the front end and the rear end, the interface is fixed on the rear side of the supporting shell and is communicated with the opening at the rear end of the cavity, the lens plate is covered in the opening at the front end of the cavity, the airtight transparent part is fixed on the front side of the supporting shell and is used for sealing and covering the opening at the front end of the cavity, and the airtight transparent part is positioned on the front side of the lens plate and is used for covering the lens plate. Through setting up airtight printing opacity spare for this product can be directly hard with film and television lamps and lanterns and connect, can't use standard cover, the cooperation sets up the lens board simultaneously, makes the light that film and television lamps and lanterns produced can be through airtight printing opacity spare and lens board processing back reentrant inflatable soft light case/ball/bucket in, lets light be full of inflatable soft light case/ball/bucket better, in order to obtain better soft light effect, the interface is interchangeable simultaneously, brings convenience for the use.

title_en: Explosion-proof intelligent charging cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an explosion-proof intelligent charging cabinet, which relates to the field of charging cabinets and solves the problem that the existing device is difficult to efficiently dissipate heat when a lithium battery is charged according to requirements; the intelligent explosion-proof charging cabinet can convey wind bodies into the heat dissipation assembly by using the air exhaust assembly through the arrangement of the air exhaust assembly at the top of the charging cabinet, and the wind bodies are uniformly output onto lithium batteries from the two sides of the top and the bottom through the air holes on the heat dissipation assembly, so that the effect of targeted heat dissipation of the lithium batteries is achieved.

title_en: Safety fire control module suitable for battery management system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safe fire-fighting module suitable for a battery management system, which can be installed in independent battery packs, so that independent gas and temperature detection is carried out on each battery pack, a detection cavity is formed in an upper shell through a partition plate, a gas sensor positioning hole and an environment temperature sensor positioning hole are formed in the partition plate, a hydrogen sensor, a carbon monoxide sensor, smoke and organic matter sensor are all semiconductor sensors and penetrate through the gas sensor positioning hole of the partition plate, the environment temperature sensor is a semiconductor sensor and penetrates through the temperature sensor positioning hole of the partition plate, a first ventilation hole is formed in the side face of the upper shell and is positioned at the detection cavity, a plurality of second ventilation holes are formed in a cover plate, the detection cavity is completely independent from the interior of the upper shell, and devices such as a circuit board in the upper shell cannot be burnt out due to internal fire of the battery packs, so that the reliability of the safe fire-fighting module is greatly improved.

title_en: Temperature control national standard plug wire
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of plug wire manufacturing, in particular to a temperature control national standard plug wire which is formed by connecting a tripolar plug and a cable. The cable is formed by compounding a cable core and an insulating plastic sleeve. The cable core is formed by bundling a live wire, a zero wire and a ground wire. The steady shape frame is used as the root planting fixed foundation of live wire inserted sheet, zero line inserted sheet, ground wire inserted sheet, and it is used as the injection molding growth foundation of plastic insulator. The zero line inserting piece and the ground wire inserting piece are respectively and directly electrically conducted with the zero line and the ground wire, and the live wire inserting piece is electrically conducted with the live wire by means of the temperature switch. Therefore, the temperature switch is connected between the live wire and the live wire inserting piece in series, so that the temperature switch can effectively control the on/off process of the power supply circuit, and can immediately cut off the circuit under the condition that the working temperature exceeds the limit, thereby playing a role of thermal protection.

title_en: Vacuum arc-extinguishing chamber with insulating porcelain ring
abstract_en: The utility model provides a vacuum arc-extinguishing chamber with an insulating ceramic ring, which relates to the technical field of vacuum arc-extinguishing chambers and comprises a movable end conducting rod, a static end conducting rod, a movable contact, a static contact, a movable end cover plate, a corrugated pipe shielding case, a main shielding case, an insulating ceramic shell, a movable end shielding case, a static end cover plate and a static end shielding case.

title_en: Multi-layer modularized controller
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-layer modularized controller, which belongs to the technical field of motor controllers and comprises a controller bottom shell, wherein a layer of aluminum substrate is closely arranged on the controller bottom shell, a central control board is arranged above the aluminum substrate at intervals, and a layer of functional board is arranged on the upper side of the central control board. The electric components of the central control board are differentiated into the multi-layer board structure by the multi-layer modularized controller, the multi-layer board is provided with different electric components, and the multi-layer board has different functions, so that the integrated layout of a circuit is more reasonable, the spatial layout of the controller is better, the heat dissipation effect is better, the multi-layer modularized board structure is more convenient to process and produce, and the processing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Automobile battery assembling equipment with calibration function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of automobile battery assembly and discloses automobile battery assembly equipment with a calibration function, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a frame body is arranged on the outer wall of the bottom plate, a lifting assembly is arranged on the outer wall of the bottom plate, before battery boxes with different sizes are transmitted to a blocking plate, the blocking plate is lowered by the lifting assembly to block the movement of the battery boxes, a motor II can start to drive a bidirectional threaded rod to rotate at the moment, so that an inclined plane insert block can be stably calibrated and clamped towards the center, a sliding head can synchronously displace on the inner wall of a guide groove at the moment, a touch head can periodically touch and press a synchronous belt, the battery boxes can easily enter the inclined plane insert block when floating upwards through vibration, the problem that the battery boxes can still be horizontally limited and calibrated when being transmitted on the flexible synchronous belt is solved, and the problem that the battery boxes are not accurately inserted due to slight collapse on the synchronous belt is prevented.

title_en: Auxiliary alignment fixing device for installing wiring box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of auxiliary tools for electric engineering construction and discloses an auxiliary alignment fixing device for installing a wiring box, which comprises an auxiliary alignment fixing box and an auxiliary alignment structure, wherein the auxiliary alignment fixing box is rectangular, the auxiliary alignment structure comprises an adjusting part and a limiting part, the adjusting part comprises a fixing sleeve fixedly installed on the outer walls of two sides of the auxiliary alignment fixing box, a first thread groove is formed in the fixing sleeve, two groups of first limiting plates are arranged outside the auxiliary alignment fixing box, a knob is fixedly installed on the outer wall of one side of each first limiting plate, a threaded rod is fixedly installed at one end of each knob, the threaded rod is spirally installed in the first thread groove, the limiting part comprises a second fixing plate fixedly installed at the front side of the auxiliary alignment fixing box, the purpose of adjusting the device position is achieved, the device is convenient to install in the wiring box with different sizes, workers can replace manual auxiliary support on electric wires, and the convenience of the device is improved.

title_en: Shell sealing structure and energy storage device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of energy storage devices and discloses a shell sealing structure and an energy storage device, wherein the shell sealing structure comprises a lower shell, a shell body and a shell body, wherein the peripheral surface of the inner wall of the lower shell is a curved surface extending along the vertical direction; the upper cover is provided with an inserting part which is used for being inserted into the lower shell along the vertical direction, the periphery of the inserting part is provided with an annular protruding part, the annular protruding part is connected with an elastic annular check ring which is used for abutting against the peripheral surface of the inner wall of the lower shell, and when the upper cover is inserted into the lower shell, a glue storage groove which is used for storing sealing glue is formed among the peripheral surface of the upper cover, the peripheral surface of the inner wall of the lower shell, the annular protruding part and the elastic annular check ring. The shell sealing structure and the energy storage device are beneficial to keeping the energy storage device to have good sealing effect in a longer time period.

title_en: Waterproof button structure and intelligent door lock thereof
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of intelligent locks, in particular to a waterproof key structure and an intelligent door lock thereof, wherein the waterproof key structure comprises a shell, a trigger, a circuit board, a waterproof piece and a bottom plate, an electronic key is integrated on the circuit board, the waterproof piece is made of soft silica gel materials, the waterproof piece is sleeved on the electronic key, the bottom plate seals the circuit board in the shell, and the waterproof piece is clamped and installed through the circuit board and the shell, so that a closed waterproof space is formed on the electronic key. The intelligent door lock with the waterproof key structure meets the IPX5 level requirement of the whole machine waterproof and salt spray test, does not influence the appearance effect of the whole machine, has good key hand feeling experience, simultaneously eliminates the sealing electronic key of the dispensing process, and has good assembly maintainability.

title_en: Wire fixing device and underwater cleaning robot
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a wire fixing device and an underwater cleaning robot, the wire fixing device comprises a fixing column and a wire pressing piece, the fixing column comprises a connecting end connected with a mounting surface of the fixing column and a wire sleeving end far away from the connecting end, the wire pressing piece comprises a connecting part and a wire pressing part which are connected with each other, the connecting part is rotationally connected with the fixing column so as to drive the wire pressing part to move between a first position and a second position, when the wire pressing part is located at the first position, the wire pressing part is used for limiting a fixing ring sleeved on the fixing column to be separated from the fixing column in a mode of being clamped on the wire sleeving end, and when the wire pressing part is located at the second position, the wire pressing part allows the fixing ring to be separated. This scheme has improved the efficiency for line fixing device dismouting wiring.

title_en: Novel variable frequency motor structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel variable frequency motor structure, including the bent axle from last shaft hole and the mounting hole interference fit of motor rotor of cylinder block of passing down in proper order, motor stator inner circle and the installation of cylinder block shaft hole excircle interference, around the stator in the stator wire winding groove that runs through from top to bottom of seting up on it outside the stator hole, the outer wire winding groove of stator has all been seted up to the outer correspondence of wire winding groove in every stator, the outer wire winding groove of stator and the outer wire winding groove of stator that corresponds communicates through circular opening, the annular stator U groove of invagination has been seted up on the bottom side of the final inspection of the outer wire winding groove of motor stator, the stator U groove is to running through each circular opening. The novel variable frequency motor is simple and convenient in structure installation and high in universality, the motor stator structural silicon steel is high in utilization rate, meanwhile, an inner-outer double-layer winding groove is adopted, space is saved, efficiency is improved, the correction of a motor air gap is avoided by controlling the inner-outer coaxiality of a shaft hole of a cylinder seat, labor cost is greatly reduced, and the cost of a compressor is reduced due to the fact that a machine foot is not required to be installed on the cylinder seat of the structure.

title_en: Automatic clutch executing device of motorcycle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic clutch actuating device of a motorcycle, wherein a motor seat is arranged on the outer side of a motor, a gear carried by the motor and a primary speed reducing assembly form a first-stage speed reduction, a big gear and a small gear on the primary speed reducing assembly are formed by interference welding, shafts are arranged at two ends of the small gear and are used for supporting bearings, the two bearings are embedded on an upper shell and a lower shell, a secondary speed reducing gear set adopts a connecting supporting mode of the primary speed reducing gear assembly, one half of the big gear of the secondary speed reducing gear set is provided with the shaft, the other end face of the secondary speed reducing gear set is embedded with a magnet, the magnet and a sensor circuit board form a Hall sensor, the rotating angle is identified, and the digital signals are converted into digital signals and transmitted to an electric control unit, so that the effective and accurate combination and separation of the clutch are realized, the small gear on the secondary speed reducing gear set is meshed with the big gear of the tertiary speed reducing gear set, and a self-locking adjusting assembly is arranged on the tertiary speed reducing gear set. The clutch automatic separating and combining device has the characteristics of novel structure, safety, reasonability, simplicity and convenience in installation, reliability in transmission, low cost and the like.

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation controller installing support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a photovoltaic power generation controller mounting bracket which comprises a mounting bottom plate, wherein two supporting rods are symmetrically and fixedly connected to the top end of the mounting bottom plate, lifting plates are slidably connected to the middle parts of the two supporting rods, threaded rods are connected to the middle parts of the lifting plates in a threaded manner, the middle parts of the top ends of the mounting bottom plates are fixedly connected to the bottom ends of the threaded rods, two positioning nuts are symmetrically and fixedly connected to the rod bodies of the threaded rods, the two positioning nuts are distributed at the two ends of the lifting plates, a fixing plate is fixedly connected to the front face of the lifting plate, positioning assemblies are rotatably connected to the four corners of the fixing plate, a connecting bottom plate is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the fixing plate, a plurality of wire arranging assemblies are fixedly connected to the front face of the connecting bottom plate in an equidistant manner, a central positioning column is fixedly connected to the middle parts of the front face of the fixing plate, the controller is convenient to horizontally mount, the height of the controller is convenient to adjust, the control cables are reasonably planned and the influence of the disordered arrangement of the cables is reduced.

title_en: Auxiliary device for erecting high-voltage power transmission and transformation line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an auxiliary device for erecting a high-voltage power transmission and transformation line, which belongs to the technical field of circuit erection and comprises a main rod, wherein a sub rod is slidably arranged in the main rod, a first sealing sleeve is arranged between the main rod and the sub rod, the first sealing sleeve is sealed outside the sub rod, the first sealing sleeve is in threaded sealing arrangement on the main rod, an insulator is fixedly sleeved outside the main rod, a blocking cover is in threaded sealing arrangement at the tail part of the main rod, the root part of the sub rod is in threaded arrangement matching with the inner wall of the head part of the main rod, and the root part of the sub rod is in sliding matching with the inner wall of the main rod. The female rod comprises a rod body, the secondary rod is pulled outwards, the secondary rod is screwed, the root of the secondary rod is screwed at the head of the female rod, then the secondary rod is held by a hand to operate a target electric wire, the primary rod is sealed between the primary rod and the secondary rod by a first sealing sleeve to prevent water from entering the primary rod, the secondary rod is screwed outwards, and the secondary rod is retracted into the primary rod, so that the primary rod and the secondary rod can be conveniently retracted and extended.

title_en: Frequency converter and power adjusting equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a frequency converter and power regulating equipment. The frequency converter comprises a sealed cabinet, a heat exchanger, a fan unit and a plurality of power units, wherein the sealed cabinet comprises a first cavity and a second cavity, the power units are located in the first cavity, ventilation gaps exist between two adjacent power units, the fan unit is located in the second cavity, at least part of the heat exchanger is located in the second cavity, a shared cavity wall, a first ventilation opening and a second ventilation opening are arranged between the first cavity and the second cavity, the first ventilation opening and the second ventilation opening are located on two opposite sides of the shared cavity wall respectively, an air outlet of the fan unit is communicated with the first ventilation opening, the first ventilation opening is communicated with the second ventilation opening, the second ventilation opening is communicated with an air inlet of the heat exchanger, and an air outlet of the heat exchanger is communicated with the air inlet of the fan unit.

title_en: Flexible mineral insulated cable
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cables and discloses a flexible mineral insulated cable which comprises a plurality of conductive cores, a filling layer and a sheath, wherein the conductive cores are arranged in the filling layer, the sheath is arranged on the outer side of the filling layer, the sheath comprises a fire-resistant layer, the fire-resistant layer is arranged on the outer side of the filling layer through an extrusion process, the outer side of the fire-resistant layer is provided with a flexible mineral layer through the extrusion process, and the outer side of the flexible mineral layer is provided with a protective layer through the extrusion process. The utility model not only can prevent the cable from being corroded by the external environments such as humidity, chemical substances and the like, so that the cable has better flexibility, the cable can be wired in a complex environment, but also can realize flame retardance of the cable, the phenomenon of spontaneous combustion of the cable is avoided, the use safety is improved, the elasticity and toughness of the cable can be increased, and the use effect of the cable is improved.

title_en: Energy storage battery induction acquisition line fixing structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides an energy storage battery induction acquisition line fixing structure, which relates to the technical field of lithium batteries, and comprises a bracket, wherein limiting parts are arranged at the upper end and the lower end of the bracket, clamping grooves are formed between opposite surfaces of the limiting parts, the number of fixing hooks is a plurality of groups, the fixing hooks are arranged at the top of the limiting parts at the upper end, clamping grooves are formed in the inner sides of the fixing hooks, the clamping grooves of the same group of fixing hooks correspond to each other front and back, the bracket and the limiting parts are integrally made of insulating materials, the two ends of the limiting parts are L-shaped, the inner sides of the limiting parts are provided with corner grooves corresponding to corners of a battery cell, acquisition lines are adjusted and clamped into the fixing hooks, the same group of fixing hooks are sequentially distributed from front to back to left and right, so that the main lines of the acquisition lines are positioned at the two sides of the same group of fixing hooks, the main lines are prevented from being separated from one side, the structure is fixed by adopting two fixing hooks, the structure is simple, firm and not easy to loose, and the acquisition lines are convenient to replace and overhaul.

title_en: Magnetic shielding structure is gathered to wireless power transmission coil
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wireless power transmission coil magnetic gathering shielding structure, which comprises a mounting shell, wherein a plurality of electromagnetic coils are inserted into the mounting shell, the top end of the mounting shell is detachably connected with a shielding cover, the bottom end of the shielding cover is inserted with a limiting column for fixing the plurality of electromagnetic coils, the inner side of the mounting shell is inserted with a plurality of elastic pieces for limiting the plurality of limiting columns, the bottom ends of the plurality of elastic pieces are fixedly connected with a receiving column, the position, adjacent to the bottom end, of the mounting shell is rotationally connected with a turntable for driving the plurality of elastic pieces to simultaneously lose limiting the limiting column, the plurality of receiving columns penetrate through the turntable, the plurality of elastic pieces limit the plurality of limiting columns under the cooperation of the elastic pieces and the turntable, and the turntable is used for driving the plurality of elastic pieces to lose limiting the limiting columns, so that the shielding cover is rapidly installed and detached under the cooperation of the elastic pieces and the turntable.

title_en: Cable bridge rail mounting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of bridge hoisting and discloses a cable bridge track installation device which comprises a cross beam, wherein connecting blocks are rotatably connected to two ends of the cross beam, connecting rods are fixedly connected to the outer walls of the connecting blocks, anti-seismic components are arranged inside the connecting rods, each anti-seismic component comprises a first limiting block, the first limiting block is connected inside the connecting rods in a sliding mode, a spring damper is fixedly connected to the bottom of the first limiting block, the output end of the spring damper is connected with the inside of the connecting rods, and a first telescopic rod is fixedly connected to the top of the first limiting block. According to the utility model, one end of the connecting plate is connected with the spring damper to enable the connecting plate to compress the first spring during vibration, and the output end of the spring damper props against the inside of the connecting rod to absorb and buffer when the tension of the first spring returns, so that the anti-vibration effect is achieved, the problem that the connecting plate is directly fixed on a ceiling through the bracket during installation of a bridge rail and is easy to loose and drop when the connecting plate is subjected to vibration is solved, and the stability of the bridge rail is improved.

title_en: Multi-angle adjustable cable dragging auxiliary device for building construction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-angle adjustable cable dragging auxiliary device for building construction, which relates to the technical field of cable dragging equipment and comprises a first fixing frame positioned at one end of a corner, wherein a second fixing frame which is rotationally connected with the first fixing frame is arranged on the first fixing frame, an angle limiting component used for determining the angles of the first fixing frame and the second fixing frame is arranged between the first fixing frame and the second fixing frame, a first movable wheel component is arranged on the first fixing frame, a second movable wheel component is arranged on the second fixing frame, a rotating wheel component matched with the first movable wheel component and the second movable wheel component is arranged on the angle limiting component, and the structure of the second movable wheel component is consistent with that of the first movable wheel component. The utility model effectively solves the difficulty of dragging long-distance cables in long and narrow spaces such as underground corridor and the like through the unique component structure, has obvious technical advantages and beneficial effects, and provides powerful support for efficient and safe construction of building electrical systems.

title_en: Intelligent substation with adjustable ventilation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an intelligent substation with adjustable ventilation, which comprises a box body, a base, a baffle plate and a driving assembly, wherein the box body is fixedly connected to the upper end of the base, an interlayer is arranged between the box body and the base, a ventilation opening which is communicated with the box body and the base is arranged on the interlayer, a cover plate with a net structure is arranged on the ventilation opening, a ventilation opening is arranged on the side surface of the base, two ends of the top of the baffle plate are hinged in the ventilation opening, the driving assembly is arranged in the base, the output end of the driving assembly is in transmission connection with the baffle plate, and the baffle plate can rotate to open and close the ventilation opening. The driving component can control the opening degree of the baffle plate so as to control the ventilation quantity, external natural wind enters the base, and exchanges with air in the box body through the ventilation opening, so that the air exchange rate is limited, the temperature in the box body is changed linearly, and the damage of power transformation equipment caused by short-time large-span change of the ambient temperature is avoided.

title_en: Double invisible fan living room lamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-invisible fan living room lamp which comprises a ceiling mounting plate, wherein one end of the ceiling mounting plate is connected with a first fan assembly, the other end of the ceiling mounting plate is connected with a second fan assembly, the lower ends of the first fan assembly and the second fan assembly are connected with a mounting base plate, a mounting groove is concavely formed in the ceiling mounting plate, an atmosphere lamp panel, a driving device and a control device are respectively arranged in the mounting groove, the driving device and the control device are respectively arranged on the left side and the right side of the atmosphere lamp panel, a mounting groove is concavely formed in the mounting base plate, and a light source main board is mounted in the mounting groove. The whole fan lamp of the double invisible fan living room lamp adopts double-fan symmetrical arrangement and combines atmosphere illumination and main illumination into a whole, thereby not only having excellent air circulation function, but also improving the aesthetic feeling and illumination quality of space, and being particularly suitable for large space areas such as living rooms.

title_en: Cable connector
abstract_en: The utility model provides a cable connector which comprises an insulating shell, an electric module and a gasket, wherein a storage chamber is formed inside the insulating shell, the electric module is arranged in the storage chamber and comprises a tongue plate, a plurality of butt joint parts, a plurality of welding parts and a plurality of cable cores welded on the plurality of welding parts, the gasket is arranged outside the electric module, the gasket is used for coating and fixing the tongue plate and the plurality of cables and filling gaps between adjacent cables, glue produced during in-mold injection processing outside the electric module can be prevented from flowing into the welding parts of the tongue plate and the cables, and glue can be prevented from flowing into the welding parts of the tongue plate and the cable welding parts during in-mold injection of the glue through the gasket.

title_en: LED light double refraction structure of electric vehicle tail lamp
abstract_en: The utility model provides an electric vehicle tail lamp LED light double-refraction structure which comprises a packaging shell, wherein the front part of the packaging shell is connected with a front shell in a clamping mode, a through groove is formed in the middle of the front shell, a first prismatic reflecting plate is connected inside the through groove in a nested mode, an LED lamp strip is fixedly arranged at the bottom end inside the packaging shell, and a second corrugated reflecting plate aligned with the position of the LED lamp strip is arranged at the top of the packaging shell. According to the electric vehicle tail lamp, the first prismatic reflecting plate and the second corrugated reflecting plate are matched, so that the light source generated by the LED light bar can be subjected to multistage reflection, the irradiation area is effectively increased, a rider can be found from a longer distance in the process of riding the electric vehicle at night, and the safety of the rider is effectively improved.

title_en: Rail lamp quick connector
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of track lamps, in particular to a track lamp quick connector which comprises a shell and a main control lock rod, wherein two side walls of the shell are respectively provided with an action groove communicated with an inner cavity of the shell, a swing arm is arranged in the action groove, a first end of the swing arm is rotationally connected with the shell, a second end of the swing arm is provided with a conductive piece, the main control lock rod vertically and rotatably penetrates through the shell, the main control lock rod is provided with a transmission piece, the transmission piece is respectively matched with the second ends of the two swing arms, and the main control lock rod drives the transmission piece to rotate so as to push the two swing arms to respectively extend towards the outer sides of the shell.

title_en: Anti-loosening structure of SMA connector
abstract_en: The utility model provides an anti-loosening structure of an SMA connector, which comprises an SMA connector assembly, a cable assembly, a rotating mechanism, an elastic compression assembly and a locking plate, wherein the rotating mechanism is arranged on the surface of the SMA connector assembly, the elastic compression assembly is arranged on the surface of the SMA connector assembly, the locking assembly is arranged on the top side of the elastic compression assembly, the locking assembly is arranged on the surface of the elastic compression assembly, and the locking plate is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the locking assembly. Under the effect of elastic compression assembly, improve limiting plate to fixed barrel's anticreep fixed effect, strengthen the cable and be connected stably with the SMA connector, guarantee signal stable transmission reduces external force to the cable with be connected with the SMA connector.

title_en: UPS power supply device and installation assembly thereof
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of UPS power supplies and discloses a UPS power supply device and a mounting assembly thereof, wherein the mounting assembly comprises a chassis, a mounting plate and a connecting piece, wherein a containing cavity is formed in the chassis, the mounting plate is arranged in the chassis in an extending mode along the length direction of the chassis, the containing cavity is divided into a mounting space and a wiring space positioned below the mounting space along the height direction of the chassis, the mounting plate is further provided with the connecting piece for sliding connection with a power supply module, the mounting plate divides the interior of the chassis into the mounting space and the wiring space, the mounting space of the mounting plate is divided into a first mounting area and a second mounting area by a partition plate, the modularized partition is realized, meanwhile, the power supply module is arranged on the mounting plate in a sliding mode through the connecting piece, and the power supply module can be quickly and conveniently moved out when maintenance or replacement of the power supply module is required, so that maintenance/replacement efficiency and flexibility are improved, and reliability of the UPS power supply device are further guaranteed.

title_en: Cathode device and X-ray tube
abstract_en: The present utility model relates to a cathode arrangement and an X-ray tube.
