The cathode arrangement for an X-ray tube according to the utility model has-a focusing head and-an electron emitter, wherein a high pressure can be applied between the focusing head and the electron emitter, -wherein the focusing head has at least one emitter well, -wherein the electron emitter is arranged centrally above or in the emitter well, -wherein an emitter well taper is formed as part of the focusing head such that the width of the emitter well at the height of the electron emitter is smaller than the width below the emitter well taper, -wherein the varying cross-section of the emitter well is configured for reducing the coulomb force acting on the electron emitter due to the applied high pressure.

title_en: Fan circuit applied to server
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fan circuit applied to a server, which comprises an MCU module, a high-voltage hot-plug slow switch circuit, a pi-type filter circuit, a three-phase inverter bridge circuit, a motor and a bus detection overcurrent protection circuit, wherein the input end of the high-voltage hot-plug slow switch circuit is externally connected with a power supply, the output end of the high-voltage hot-plug slow switch circuit is connected with the input end of the pi-type filter circuit, the output end of the pi-type filter circuit is connected with the power supply input end of the three-phase inverter bridge circuit, the bridge arm upper bridge of the three-phase inverter bridge circuit is connected with the bridge arm control end of the MCU module, the bridge arm lower bridge of the three-phase inverter bridge circuit is connected with the input end of the motor, the voltage sampling output end of the motor is connected with the voltage sampling input end of the MCU module, the input end of the bus detection overcurrent protection circuit is connected with the bus current output end of the three-phase inverter bridge circuit, and the bus detection overcurrent protection circuit is connected with the bus current detection end of the MCU module. The fan circuit provided by the utility model has the advantages of high efficiency, energy conservation, noise reduction, environmental protection and high stability.

title_en: Network computer lab wiring equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a network computer lab wiring equipment, includes elasticity buckle, mount pad, wire cloth disk, wiring section of thick bamboo, lock seat, location branch, fly leaf, elasticity buckle internal connection cushion, cushion connection cable, elasticity buckle external connection installation cover, installation cover connection mount pad, mount pad both sides have the draw-in groove, and the installation cover both sides have the card strip, and the card strip suits with the draw-in groove, the draw-in groove is connected to the card strip, the mount pad divide into outer mount pad, interior mount pad, and the installation cover divide into outer installation cover, interior installation cover, and outer installation cover is connected to outer mount pad, interior installation cover is connected to interior mount pad, the inside a plurality of interior mount pads that have of wiring section of thick bamboo, the wiring section of thick bamboo outside has the wire cloth disk, and the wire cloth disk has a plurality of outer mount pads.

title_en: False cell and power battery
abstract_en: The application discloses a false battery core and a power battery, wherein the false battery core comprises a false battery core body, connecting parts and end covers, wherein the false battery core body is provided with a cavity, the connecting parts are arranged in the cavity and extend along the length direction of the false battery core body, the connecting parts are respectively connected with the outer surfaces of the connecting parts and the inner walls of the cavity, the two end covers are respectively connected with the two ends of the false battery core body. According to the application, the connecting part and the connecting piece are arranged in the false cell body, and the connecting piece is respectively connected with the outer surface of the connecting part and the inner wall of the cavity, so that the end covers are connected with the two ends of the false cell body, and the anti-extrusion strength of each side part and each end part of the false cell can be improved, and the power battery is prevented from being easily damaged in use.

title_en: Safety early warning device for overhead operation of power distribution tower
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safety early warning device for overhead operation of a power distribution tower, wherein a control device is arranged in a fixed box, a remote confirmation mechanism and a close confirmation mechanism which are respectively and electrically connected with the control device are arranged on the front side of the fixed box, an audible and visual alarm mechanism which is electrically connected with the control device is arranged on the top of the fixed box, one end of a pipe clamp is detachably connected with the rear side of the fixed box, and the other end of the pipe clamp is used for realizing detachable connection between the fixed box and an installation pipe.

title_en: Fuel-saving switch
abstract_en: A fuel-saving switch. Mainly solves the problem that the installation is not stable only through the bolt cooperation between the knob and the turntable of the conventional fuel-saving switch. The rotary table is characterized by further comprising a buckle (42) which is arranged on the rotary table or the rotary table, a clamping groove (21) which is arranged on the rotary table or the rotary table, and the buckle is in clamping fit with the clamping groove. The utility model provides a fuel-saving switch which is convenient to assemble, has a very stable structure after being installed in a buckling and clamping groove mode, can not deviate from, and has a gear groove and ball structure, so that the structure is more obvious when the gear is switched.

title_en: Quick-charging type vehicle-mounted charger
abstract_en: The utility model provides a quick charging type vehicle-mounted charger in the technical field of vehicle-mounted charging equipment, which comprises a power input module, a filtering module, a DCDC module, a quick charging control module, a communication module, a power amplification module, a human body sensing module, an LED lighting module, a first depressurization module, a second depressurization module, a double-USB output module and a TypeC output module, wherein the power input module, the filtering module, the DCDC module, the quick charging control module and the communication module are sequentially connected, the first depressurization module is connected with the DCDC module, the power amplification module and the second depressurization module, the second depressurization module is connected with the human body sensing module and the LED lighting module, the communication module is connected with the power amplification module, the human body sensing module and the LED lighting module, the double-USB output module is connected with the filtering module, and the TypeC output module is connected with the quick charging control module. The utility model has the advantages of greatly reducing the power consumption of the vehicle-mounted charger and greatly improving the use stability, durability and user experience of the vehicle-mounted charger.

title_en: Charging pile capable of protecting charging interface
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to charging piles, and particularly to a charging pile with a charging interface. The utility model provides a charging pile with a charging interface protection function and capable of protecting a charging interface. A charging pile capable of protecting a charging interface comprises a bottom plate, a charging device, a connecting wire, a charging gun, a fixing clamping seat and the like, wherein the charging device is connected to the bottom plate, the connecting wire is fixedly connected to the charging device, the end part of the connecting wire is fixedly connected with the charging gun, the charging device, the connecting wire and the charging gun are electrically connected, and the fixing clamping seat is fixedly connected to the side edge of the charging device. Carry out the joint fixedly to the rifle that charges through fixed cassette and slip cassette to and the protective housing protects the interface that charges of rifle, thereby improves the safety in utilization of charging pile, guarantee charging pile is not fragile and influence life.

title_en: Wire harness connector for automobile
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wire harness connector for an automobile, which comprises a mounting shell, wherein an inner thread is arranged at the inner side of one end of the mounting shell, the wire harness connector also comprises a connecting mechanism for forming an assembled connecting structure, an end head mechanism for forming a plug-in type end head structure and a protection mechanism for forming a built-in protection structure, the connecting mechanism is arranged at one end of the mounting shell, which is provided with the inner thread, the end head mechanism is assembled at one end of the connecting mechanism, which is far away from the mounting shell, and the protection mechanism is arranged inside the connecting mechanism.

title_en: Industrial control cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model provides an industrial control cabinet, and belongs to the technical field of industrial control cabinets; the technical scheme adopted for solving the technical problems is that the UPS cabinet comprises a cabinet body, a bearing structure is detachably connected in the cabinet body, the bearing structure is detachably connected with the UPS cabinet, the UPS cabinet comprises a shell, a cabinet door is hinged to the shell, a first filter screen is embedded in the cabinet door, a second filter screen is embedded in the side wall, opposite to the cabinet door, of the shell, a plurality of cushion ribs are fixedly connected to a bottom plate of the shell, each cushion rib is provided with an anti-slip strip, a UPS power supply is placed on the anti-slip strip, at least one through hole is formed in the bottom plate, a UPS cable is in clearance fit in the through hole, an air conditioner is installed on the side wall of the cabinet body, and the air conditioner is mutually matched with the UPS cabinet.

title_en: Energy-saving motor with self-radiating structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of motor equipment and discloses an energy-saving motor with a self-radiating structure, which comprises a box body and a motor body, wherein a radiating mounting plate is obliquely arranged on the inner upper side of the box body, a plurality of spoilers are fixedly connected to the upper side of the radiating mounting plate, a plurality of radiating fins are fixedly connected to the upper side of each spoiler, a baffle plate is fixedly connected to one side of the radiating mounting plate, a lower drain opening is formed in the baffle plate and is positioned above the radiating mounting plate, and a motor fixing mechanism is arranged on the lower side of the inner part of the box body.

title_en: Battery pack
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a battery pack, which comprises a shell, a plurality of battery cell groups and an insulating assembly, wherein the battery cell groups are arranged in the shell at intervals along a first direction, the insulating assembly comprises a top sheet, a first liquid collecting piece and a plurality of second liquid collecting pieces, the top sheet is arranged on one side of the battery cell groups, on which an explosion-proof valve is formed, the first liquid collecting piece is arranged at the end part of the top sheet along the first direction and is positioned at the outer side of the battery cell groups, the first liquid collecting piece is provided with a first channel and a first opening which are mutually communicated, the first opening is arranged towards the battery cell groups, the second liquid collecting piece is connected with the top sheet and is positioned between the adjacent battery cell groups, the second liquid collecting piece is provided with a second channel and a second opening which are mutually communicated, and the second opening is towards the adjacent battery cell groups. The battery pack aims to solve the problems that when the battery pack is out of control, high-temperature electrolyte rushes out of an explosion-proof valve and splashes, faults such as internal short circuit and the like of the battery pack are caused, and the internal insulating performance of the battery pack is reduced.

title_en: Novel transformer oil pump front bearing mounting structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel transformer oil pump front bearing mounting structure, which relates to bearing mounting and comprises a fixing part, wherein the fixing part comprises a fixing frame which is used as a basic frame, a supporting structure for mounting and fixing other parts is provided, the stabilizing effect of the whole framework is achieved, a bidirectional screw rod is arranged on the fixing frame and is rotationally connected to the fixing frame through a bearing, and two ends of the fixing frame extend to the outer side of the fixing frame. This novel bearing mounting structure before transformer oil pump is when installing the oil pump bearing, through rotating two-way lead screw for two fixed blocks are close to each other, and then fix fixed frame and mounting panel on the transformer oil pump, remove post and contact block and lie in transformer oil pump and oil pump bearing center directly over this moment, remove the bearing frame on the direction of movement perpendicular to transformer oil pump of post, can apply the power of perpendicular to bearing frame to the oil pump bearing through hammering knocking the piece this moment, the installation of being convenient for.

title_en: Power isolation circuit, power sequencer and power sequencer case
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a power isolation circuit, a power sequencer and a power sequencer case, and relates to the technical field of electronic equipment. The power supply isolation circuit comprises a plurality of isolation transformers, each isolation transformer comprises a first coil, a second coil and a magnetic core, the first coil and the second coil are wound on the magnetic core, two ends of the first coil serve as input ends of the isolation transformers and are used for correspondingly connecting power supply output channels of the power supply time sequence circuit, and two ends of the second coil serve as output ends of the isolation transformers and are used for outputting power supply. The embodiment of the utility model can enhance the power isolation performance and reduce the interference between devices.

title_en: Battery cell rubberizing positioning mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a battery cell rubberizing positioning mechanism which comprises a fixing unit, a moving unit, a first driving device and a positioning and separating mechanism, wherein the bottom of the fixing unit is fixed on a battery cell conveying device, the bottom of the moving unit is arranged on the battery cell conveying device and forms a horizontal moving pair with the battery cell moving device, the first driving device is connected with the moving unit, the positioning and separating mechanism is arranged at the top of the fixing unit, and the positioning and separating mechanism is used for pushing the battery cell which is rubberized towards the direction of the moving unit and clamping the battery cell which is not rubberized behind when the battery cell which is continuously conveyed by the battery cell conveying device. According to the utility model, the mobile unit and the fixed unit relatively move to clamp the battery core when the battery core is rubberized, the battery core is directly conveyed after rubberizing is finished, and the battery core is conveyed by the same battery core conveying device before and after rubberizing.

title_en: SiPM detection array module with highly integrated front end
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a front-end highly-integrated SiPM detection array module which is characterized by comprising a circuit board, an SiPM array, a front-end electronic system, a connector and a connecting tube, wherein the front-end electronic system comprises an ASIC chip and a matched electronic element, a plurality of bonding pads are arranged on the upper surface and the lower surface of the circuit board and are used for connecting the SiPM array, the ASIC chip, the matched electronic element and the connector, the circuit board comprises a plurality of layers of circuit structures, the circuit structures of different layers are interconnected through metallized through holes, the connector supplies power for the SiPM array and the front-end electronic system through the circuit structures and the metallized through holes and is connected with the rear-end electronic system, a micro-channel is embedded in the circuit board, and an inlet and an outlet of the micro-channel are respectively connected with the connecting tube and are used for inputting and outputting circulating cooling media to transfer heat to the external environment. The utility model can improve the detection performance and reliability of the detector and reduce the volume and quality of the equipment.

title_en: Stainless steel wire harness box fixing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stainless steel wire bundle box fixing device, which belongs to the technical field of wire bundle storage and comprises a lower shell, an upper shell arranged above the lower shell, an installation groove formed in the lower shell and a loading and unloading mechanism arranged in the installation groove and used for conveniently installing and detaching the lower shell and the upper shell, wherein through the arrangement of the loading and unloading mechanism, an insert ring is inserted into the bottom of the installation groove and then pushes a push rod downwards to move the push rod from a control groove into a fixing cylinder, the top end of the push rod contacts with inclined planes of a plurality of insert blocks, the insert blocks are extruded outwards, the insert blocks move along a sliding groove and drive a connecting plate to synchronously move, a first spring is extruded until the insert blocks are inserted into the insert ring, and the upper shell and the lower shell are fixed.

title_en: Photovoltaic stand sand-blast protection device and photovoltaic stand unit based on brush form net rope
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a photovoltaic column sand-blast protection device based on brush-shaped net ropes and a photovoltaic column unit. This photovoltaic stand sand-blast protector based on brush form net rope includes x vortex structure, x vortex structure is along the axial of photovoltaic stand in proper order the range upon range of setting, each vortex structure with photovoltaic stand in close contact, each vortex structure includes y net rope that has brush form structure, y the net rope is followed the radial direction of photovoltaic stand sets gradually, each net rope is all encircleed the photovoltaic stand sets up, adjacent two in close contact between the net rope to the quantity of the net rope that x vortex structure contained is along keeping away from the direction of ground and is progressively reduced in proper order, x is greater than or equal to 2, y is greater than or equal to 1. Through x vortex structures, the problem of cavitation facing the photovoltaic upright post can be effectively improved, and the stability and reliability of the whole operation of the photovoltaic power station are obviously improved.

title_en: Retarder power supply main switch
abstract_en: The application relates to a retarder power supply master switch which comprises a shell and a support, wherein an accommodating cavity is formed in the shell in a hollow mode, two static contacts are arranged on the bottom wall of the accommodating cavity, the two static contacts extend out of the shell and are provided with a first contact pin and a second contact pin, the shell is fixedly connected with the support, a fixed block is arranged on the support, a safety piece and a protective shell are arranged on the fixed block, a plurality of standby safety pieces are arranged on the protective shell, a third contact pin and a fourth contact pin are arranged on the fixed block, two ends of the safety piece are fixedly connected with the third contact pin and the fourth contact pin, a power wire is arranged between the first contact pin and the third contact pin, the fourth contact pin is used for fixedly connecting an anode or a cathode of a storage battery, and the second contact pin is used for connecting with a master circuit of electric equipment or a relay control end of an automobile. The application effectively solves the problem that the electric system of the vehicle cannot quickly recover the power supply after the safety of the traditional power supply main switch is fused through the protective shell and the standby safety piece.

title_en: Wire hooking device and winding machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wire hooking device and a wire winding machine. The wire hooking device comprises a horizontal mounting plate and a vertical mounting plate which are arranged vertically, and further comprises a moving assembly, a crochet hook driven by the moving assembly and a protective frame fixed on the horizontal mounting plate, wherein the moving assembly drives the crochet hook to horizontally reciprocate in the protective frame or drives the crochet hook to horizontally reciprocate and vertically lift in the protective frame. The wire hooking device provided by the utility model comprises the protective frame, the movable space of the wire rod pulled by the hooked needle in the wire hooking device is controlled by limiting the space of the protective frame, and the wire hooking device further comprises the moving assembly, wherein the control of the moving track of the hooked needle is realized by the moving assembly, so that the collision and contact between the hooked needle and the wire rod in the protective frame are reduced, and the phenomena of deformation, breakage and winding of the wire rod caused by the movement of the hooked needle are reduced.

title_en: Battery bale breaker
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of battery recycling and processing and discloses a battery bale breaker which comprises a shell opening mechanism, a rubber cutting mechanism and a cutting mechanism, wherein the shell opening mechanism comprises a fixing frame, a lifting frame and a shell opening unit, the lifting frame can move up and down in the fixing frame, the shell opening units are respectively arranged on the front side and the rear side of the lifting frame, a plurality of shell opening units are respectively provided with a claw capable of moving back and forth, the rubber cutting mechanism is arranged on the top side of the fixing frame, a plurality of rubber cutting cutters inserted into the top side of the fixing frame are arranged on the rubber cutting mechanism at intervals along the front-back direction, the cutting mechanism is arranged on the rear side of the fixing frame and provided with a shell cutting cutter capable of moving up and down, and a positioning mechanism is provided with a positioning jig capable of moving back and forth.

title_en: Axial flux motor with double rotors and double stators
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an axial flux motor with double rotors and double stators, which is characterized by comprising a motor shaft, wherein a front end cover and a rear end cover are respectively arranged on the motor shaft through a front bearing and a rear bearing, the front end cover and the rear end cover are distributed at intervals, a first stator structure and a second stator structure are respectively connected on the front end cover and the rear end cover, the first stator structure comprises a stator yoke part, a stator tooth part is arranged on the stator yoke part, a stator coil is arranged on the outer side of the stator tooth part, a rotor structure is fixedly connected on the motor shaft, the rotor structure comprises a rotor yoke part, and both ends of the rotor yoke part are respectively provided with a first magnetic steel and a second magnetic steel. The two stators and the two rotors share the same axis, the magnetic circuit is shorter, the radial space is effectively utilized, and the magnetic flux simultaneously acts in the two air gaps, which is equivalent to realizing the power output of two motors in one axial length, and obviously improving the power and torque output of unit volume or unit mass.

title_en: Power converter module and power converter
abstract_en: A power converter module and a power converter relate to the technical field of power electronics and comprise a first power unit, a second power unit, a third power unit, a first capacitor and a second capacitor, wherein the first power unit comprises a three-level conversion circuit, the second power unit and the third power unit comprise two-level conversion circuits, the alternating current side of the first power unit is connected with three-phase alternating current voltage, the first capacitor is connected between a positive direct current bus and a direct current bus midpoint of the direct current side of the first power unit in parallel, the second capacitor is connected between a negative direct current bus and a direct current bus midpoint of the direct current side of the first power unit in parallel, the direct current side of the second power unit is connected with the first capacitor, the direct current side of the third power unit is connected with the second capacitor, and the alternating current sides of the second power unit and the third power unit are connected in cascade. The scheme can reduce the number of cascaded power modules and reduce the volume of equipment and the cost of hardware.

title_en: Insulation protection structure for motor stator slot coil
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an insulation protection structure of a motor stator slot coil, which comprises a copper flat wire coil penetrating through a stator winding slot and wound in a fold line shape on a stator, wherein an effective side is formed by the part of the copper flat wire coil positioned in the stator winding slot, an insulation baffle clamped between adjacent copper flat wire coils in the same slot, a U-shaped insulation plate embedded in the stator winding slot, the notch of the U-shaped insulation plate and the notch of the stator winding slot face the same direction, and an insulation plug positioned at the notch of the stator winding slot, wherein the insulation plug seals the notch of the U-shaped insulation plate so as to insulate and surround the effective side of the copper flat wire coil with the U-shaped insulation plate, and a plug body of the insulation plug is embedded in the notch of the U-shaped insulation plate and compresses the effective side. According to the utility model, the U-shaped insulating plate and the insulating plug form an insulating cavity, and the soft plug compacting structure is matched, so that the problems of insufficient insulation protection and unreliable effective side fixation of coils in the stator slots are solved.

title_en: Socket with outage function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a socket with a power-off function, which comprises an intelligent socket body, a wiring mechanism and a mounting mechanism, wherein storage grooves are formed in two sides of the intelligent socket body, the wiring mechanism is electrically connected to a power-on end of the intelligent socket body and is used for conducting power connection between the intelligent socket body and an external power supply, the mounting mechanism is arranged in the storage grooves and comprises a connecting piece and a mounting piece, the connecting piece is connected with the storage grooves in a penetrating mode, the mounting piece is connected to one end, far away from the storage grooves, of the connecting piece in a rotating mode, and the connecting piece is used for achieving multi-angle adjustment through rotating connection. The utility model has the advantages that the structure of the installation mechanism is arranged, and the installation part can adjust the directions in multiple angles in the use process through the rotary connection of the connection part and the installation part, so that the whole socket is very convenient to install and mount, and the safe use of the socket is ensured.

title_en: Power protection circuit and power protection system
abstract_en: The application discloses a power supply protection circuit and a power supply protection system, wherein the power supply protection circuit comprises a first-stage protection circuit and a second-stage protection circuit, the first-stage protection circuit comprises a bidirectional transient voltage suppression diode which is connected with a power supply input end in parallel, the second-stage protection circuit comprises a voltage comparator and an electronic switch, a positive input end of the voltage comparator is connected with a positive electrode of the power supply input end and a common end of the bidirectional transient voltage suppression diode, an opposite input end of the voltage comparator is connected with a reference voltage source with a preset voltage threshold value, a control end of the electronic switch is connected with an output end of the voltage comparator, and a controlled passage is connected between the power supply input end and protected equipment in series and is used for responding to a voltage abnormality signal output by the voltage comparator to cut off connection between the power supply and the protected equipment. The primary protection circuit is focused on transient overvoltage suppression, the secondary protection circuit is responsible for continuous overvoltage monitoring and rapid cutoff, and the two are complementary in function, so that reliable protection of protected equipment can be realized.

title_en: Stator punching structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stator punching sheet structure, which relates to the technical field of stator punching sheets and comprises a punching sheet main body, a positioning structure, a first heat dissipation structure, a second heat dissipation structure and a wiring structure, wherein the positioning structure is arranged on the outer wall of the punching sheet main body, the first heat dissipation structure is arranged on the outer wall of the punching sheet main body, the second heat dissipation structure is arranged on the outer wall of the punching sheet main body, and the wiring structure is arranged on the outer wall of the punching sheet main body. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the positioning structure, the alignment of the punching main bodies during stacking is ensured, the manual adjustment time is reduced, the assembly efficiency is improved, meanwhile, the stress between the punching main bodies can be dispersed through the interlocking design of the concave-convex structure, the deformation risk is reduced, the service life of the punching main bodies is prolonged, and the inner groove and the outer protruding part are obtained in a punching mode, so that the inner groove and the outer protruding part can be obtained at the same time, namely, positioning and heat dissipation are integrated, the convenience of processing the punching main bodies is improved, and meanwhile, the damage rate of the stator punching in the processing process is reduced.

title_en: Switch board base structure with shock-absorbing function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of power distribution cabinet base structures and discloses a power distribution cabinet base structure with a damping function, which comprises a cabinet body, wherein a base body is fixedly connected to the lower surface of the cabinet body, a U-shaped base I is fixedly connected to the lower surface of the base body, a connecting plate I is rotatably connected to the outer wall of the U-shaped base I, an I-shaped frame is rotatably connected to the inner part of the connecting plate I, a connecting plate II is rotatably connected to the outer wall of the I-shaped frame, a U-shaped base II is rotatably connected to the inner part of the connecting plate II, a bottom plate is fixedly connected to the lower surface of the U-shaped base II, and a limiting rod is slidably connected to the inner part of the I-shaped frame. According to the utility model, through the cooperation among the U-shaped seat I, the connecting plate I, the I-shaped frame, the connecting plate II, the U-shaped seat II, the conical spring, the fixed block, the limiting rod and the limiting component, the front, back, left and right shaking of the cabinet body and the base body is slowed down, so that the shaking and shaking of the cabinet body and the base body are effectively slowed down, and the stability of the equipment is improved.

title_en: Circuit interrupting device having printed circuit board coils
abstract_en: A circuit interrupter including a line conductor, a neutral conductor, a printed-circuit board coil, and a test circuit. The printed-circuit board coil has an aperture configured to receive the line conductor. The test circuit is electrically connected to the printed-circuit board coil. The test circuit is configured to determine an arc fault condition based on a signal of the printed-circuit board coil.

title_en: Light apparatus comprising a light guide plate with grooves and methods for using the same to direct light
abstract_en: A light apparatus can comprise a light source and a light guide plate, which can further comprise a major surface comprising a plurality of grooves. Each groove of the plurality of grooves may comprise a first surface and an opposed second surface. Each groove can have a maximum depth that may be defined between the second major surface and a base of the corresponding groove. In some embodiments, one or more surfaces of each groove may comprise a first convex portion. In other embodiments, the maximum depth of each groove of the plurality of grooves can be from about 1 micrometer to about 50 micrometers. In still other embodiments, the light apparatus may be used to direct light out of the light guide plate with a peak radiance oriented from 0° to 30° from a direction normal to the first major surface of the light guide plate.

title_en: Transformer arrangement
abstract_en: The invention is concerned with a transformer arrangement (10) having a primary and a secondary winding (12P, 12S), a current regulator (20) and an output handling module (14) comprising a voltage regulator portion (16) and a circuit breaker portion (18), said output handling module (14) being connected to the secondary winding (12S) and connectable in series between said winding (12S) and a load (L) via an alternating current link (ACL) and said current regulator (20) being connected in parallel with at least a part of at least one winding (12S) magnetically coupled to the primary winding (12P) and said current regulator being connected to the voltage regulator portion of the output handling module via at least one direct current link such that active and/or reactive power can be injected in the alternating current link (ACL) using the current regulator (20) and voltage regulator portion (16).

title_en: Power adapter for an electronic device
abstract_en: A power adapter (100) is provided. The power adapter comprises a power module (106), a main control module (107), a potential adjusting module (108), a current detection module (109), a voltage detection module (110) and an output switch module (111). When a conventional charging or a quick charging is performed on the battery (201) in an electronic device (200), the main control module (107) determines whether the output current of the power adapter (100) is greater than a current threshold according to the current detecting signal and determines whether the output voltage of the power adapter (100) is greater than a voltage threshold according to the voltage detecting signal; if the output current of the power adapter (100) is greater than the current threshold and/or the output voltage of the power adapter (100) is greater than the voltage threshold, the main control module (107) controls the output switch module (111) to turn off the direct current output of the power adapter (100).

title_en: Hazardous location compliant circuit protection devices having enhanced safety intelligence, systems and methods
abstract_en: Compliant electrical circuit protection devices are described for use in hazardous environments without presenting ignition risks for potentially explosive environmental conditions. Sensing features and systems may evaluate wiring limits and user selected settings for compatibility, detect loose connections and operating parameters to ensure safe operation of the device, and to intelligently diagnose and manage issues of concern for the circuit protection devices as well as the larger electrical power system.

title_en: Storage battery device
abstract_en: A storage battery device of an embodiment is to be mounted on a vehicle for power supply to an on-vehicle device, and includes: a first battery unit including battery cells connected in series between a first input output voltage charge-discharge terminal pair to supply low-voltage power via the first input output voltage charge-discharge terminal pair; a second battery unit connected in series to a high potential side of the first battery unit, including battery cells connected in series between the first battery unit and a second input output voltage charge-discharge terminal to supply high-voltage power in cooperation with the first battery unit via the first input output voltage charge-discharge terminal on a low potential side and the second input output voltage charge-discharge terminal; and a direct-current voltage converter that performs DC voltage conversion of a power supply from the second battery unit, to be able to supply power via the first input output voltage charge-discharge terminal pair. The storage battery device can thus simultaneously supply low-voltage power and high-voltage power with maintained reliability.

title_en: Method for producing material with modified carbon allotrope surface, method for producing material with carbon allotrope surface to which functional group is introduced, method for producing grid for cryo-electron microscopy, organic material, and grid for cryo-electron microscopy
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for producing a substance with a modified carbon allotrope surface that can suppress or prevent uneven distribution, uneven orientation, and the like of a structural analysis target substance in a structural analysis by cryo-electron microscopy. A method for producing a substance with a modified carbon allotrope surface of the present invention includes: the step of surface-treating by reacting a carbon allotrope surface with a halogen oxide radical, wherein the carbon allotrope surface is modified by the surface-treating.

title_en: Luminous respiratory ventilation device
abstract_en: Respiratory ventilation device (1) intended to send an air flow, generated by a fan, into a duct (2), the duct extending between the device and a breathing mask (3) intended to be worn by a user, the device comprising: - an air inlet (10i) intended to admit air into the device (10); - a fan; - an air outlet (10o), the air outlet being configured to be connected to the duct (2); - in such a way that when the fan is in operation, the air flows from the air inlet successively toward the fan and then toward the air outlet; - the device also comprising: - a flow rate sensor (25) measuring a flow rate of air circulating through the device, and/or a pressure sensor (26) measuring a pressure between the fan and the air outlet; - a control unit (18), connected to the flow rate sensor (25) and/or to the pressure sensor (26); the device being characterized in that it comprises at least one source of light (41).

title_en: Method for metallizing plastic by pre-plating for electroplating
abstract_en: A method for metallizing plastic by pre-plating for electroplating, forming a metal bonding layer and a metal transition layer using electro arc ion plating or magnetron sputtering in series, and then forming a metal conductive layer on the metal transition layer using the electro arc ion plating. At least forming the metal conductive layer comprises: disposing a magnetic filter device between a metal target and a vacuum chamber in which the plastic workpiece is placed, so that positively charged metal ions generated by the metal target are deflected by the magnetic filter device and then enter the vacuum chamber to be deposited on the surface of the plastic workpiece. In this disclosure, the particles evaporated from the metal target pass through the magnetic filter device with electromagnetic field deflection. Neutral particle clusters cannot be deposited on the surface of the workpiece. No metal particle clusters (large particles) are deposited on the surface of the film layer like in the traditional PVD process, the film is flatter, and the metalized plastic workpiece can be electroplated to obtain a high-quality mirror appearance.

title_en: Application device and corresponding application method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an application device for introducing an application agent (e.g. heat-conducting paste) into a cavity, in particular in a battery module (1) of an electrical battery. The application device according to the invention comprises a nozzle (2) for discharging the application agent through the nozzle (2) and a first pressure sensor (8, 9) for measuring a first pressure measurement value (p A , p B ) of the application agent upstream of the nozzle (2). The invention additionally provides a second pressure sensor (10) for measuring a second pressure measurement value (p D ) of the application agent downstream of the first pressure sensor (8, 9) in particular in the nozzle (2). The invention also relates to a corresponding application method.

title_en: Mechanical grounding clamp
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides descriptions of configurations for bonding clamps used to assemble photovoltaic (PV) arrays and provide an electrical bond between PV module frames and a rail system forming the PV arrays. The bonding clamp includes an electrically conductive body, first and second compression arms extending from body and a tab extending from the body in a direction away from a bottom side of the body. The first and second compression arms extend at an angle relative to the body.

title_en: Method of measuring aberration and electron microscope
abstract_en: A method of measuring an aberration in an electron microscope (100) includes: acquiring an image for measuring an aberration in the electron microscope (100); and measuring an aberration by using the image, and in measuring an aberration, a direction of defocusing is specified based on a residual aberration that is uniquely determined by a configuration of an optical system (20) of the electron microscope (100) and an optical condition of the optical system (20).

title_en: Method for producing sulfide-based inorganic solid electrolyte material
abstract_en: Provided is a method of manufacturing a sulfide-based inorganic solid electrolyte material, the method including: a step (A) of preparing a sulfide-based inorganic solid electrolyte material in a vitreous state; and a step (B) of annealing the sulfide-based inorganic solid electrolyte material in the vitreous state using a heating unit, in which the step (B) includes, in the following order, a step (B1) of disposing the sulfide-based inorganic solid electrolyte material in the vitreous state in a heating space, a step (B2) of annealing the sulfide-based inorganic solid electrolyte material in the vitreous state disposed in the heating space while increasing a temperature of the heating unit from an initial temperature T 0  to an annealing temperature T 1 , and a step (B3) of annealing the sulfide-based inorganic solid electrolyte material in the vitreous state disposed in the heating space at the annealing temperature T 1 , and a temperature increase rate from the initial temperature T 0  to the annealing temperature T 1  in the step (B2) is 2 °C/min or higher.

title_en: Method for manufacturing stator
abstract_en: This method of manufacturing a stator includes a step of removing insulating coatings on first surfaces of lead wire portions that are surfaces to be welded, and a step of welding together the first surfaces by a green laser with the insulating coatings on the first surfaces being removed and with insulating coatings on second surfaces opposite the first surfaces being unremoved.

title_en: Electric vehicle, and control system and electric heating device thereof
abstract_en: The present application discloses an electric vehicle, and an electric heating device and a control system thereof. The electric heating device includes: n resistance heating units, independently electrically connected in parallel with each other; n switches, electrically connected in series with respective resistance heating units for independently controlling power-on or power-off of the respective resistance heating units; and a controller, configured to selectively turn on or turn off any at least one of the n switches according to a working condition of the electric vehicle, wherein n is a natural number equal to or greater than 2.

title_en: Backlight unit and image display device
abstract_en: There is provided a backlight unit excellent in brightness uniformity. The backlight unit includes: a light source; a light guide plate that is arranged to face the light source, having an end surface that light from the light source enters; and an emitting surface from which the entered light is emitted; a reflective plate bonded to a back surface side of the light guide plate via a double-sided pressure-sensitive adhesive film; and a casing having a front portion and a back portion, the casing being configured to store the light source, the light guide plate, and the reflective plate. The backlight unit is configured so that the light from the light source is free from entering a space between the low-refractive index layer and the reflective plate, or so that the light that has entered the space between the low-refractive index layer and the reflective plate from a light source is free from being emitted from the emitting surface of the light guide plate.

title_en: Method of and system for monitoring and diagnosing a grounding system, use of rotating electrostatic motor to diagnosing
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system and a method of diagnosing a grounding system of a structure comprising a charge collecting structure conductively connected to ground via a grounding path, wherein diagnosing involves an act of monitoring an output of an electrostatic motor connected to the grounding path. Further disclosed is a system and method of diagnosing a grounding system by means of voltage detectors in combination with the electrostatic motor or alone.

title_en: Outer rotor motor with integrated cooling ventilator
abstract_en: An outer rotor motor is provided. The outer rotor motor according to an aspect of the present disclosure may comprise a frame, a stator disposed on the frame, a coil disposed on the stator, a rotating shaft rotatably coupled to a central region of the frame, a cover coupled to the rotating shaft and surrounding the stator, and a magnet disposed on the cover and facing the stator. In this case, the cover may include a fan bracket projecting in a radial direction from a radially outer surface, and a plurality of blades extending in an axial direction from the radially outer surface.

title_en: Disconnect device with interlock mechanism
abstract_en: A fusible disconnect switch includes a switch housing, and a first fuse contact member and a second fuse contact member coupled to the switch housing, each of the first fuse contact member and the second fuse contact member configured to engage and complete an electrical connection through an overcurrent protection fuse. The fusible disconnect switch further includes a switch contact including a parallel contact configuration. An interlock is operatively coupled to the first fuse contact member and a switch that operates the switch contact, the interlock configured to inhibit movement of the switch from the OFF position to the ON position when the first fuse contact member is unsecured to the switch housing, and inhibit movement of the first fuse contact member relative to the switch housing when the switch is in the ON position.

title_en: Battery pack and vehicle including same
abstract_en: A battery pack according to an embodiment of the present disclosure includes at least one battery cell including a vent portion to force gas out; and a pack case which accommodates the at least one battery cell such that the vent portion faces a lower side of the battery pack, with the vent portion exposed from the battery pack.

title_en: Cell, cell stack device, module, and module accommodating device
abstract_en: A cell includes an element portion including a fuel electrode, a solid electrolyte layer, an air electrode, and an intermediate layer. The intermediate layer is located between the solid electrolyte layer and the air electrode. In a plan view, a porosity in an end portion of the air electrode is greater than a porosity in a center portion of the air electrode.

title_en: Power transmission device
abstract_en:
[Problem] To reduce the decrease in the discharge amount of a pump at a low temperature. 
     [Solution] A power transmission device includes a motor, a gear mechanism connected downstream of the motor; and a pump that sucks oil through a pump inlet. A shortest distance between an open end of the pump inlet and a surface of a stator of the motor is shorter than a shortest distance between the open end of the pump inlet and a surface of the gear mechanism.

title_en: A positive electrode active material for rechargeable lithium-ion batteries
abstract_en: A positive electrode active material for batteries which comprises Li, M', and oxygen, wherein M' comprises: Ni in a content a between 60.0 mol% and 75.0 mol%; Co in a content x between 0.0 mol% and 20.0 mol%; Mn in a content y between 0.0 mol% and 35.0 mol%, a dopant D in a content z between 0.0 mol% and 2.0 mol%, Al, B and W in a total content c between 0.1 mol% and 5.0 mol%, wherein the active material has an Al content Al A , a B content B A , and a W content W A , wherein a, x, y, z, c, Al A , B A  and W A  are measured by ICP, wherein Al A , B A  and W A , wherein the positive electrode active material, when measured by XPS analysis, shows an average Al fraction Al B , an average B fraction B B  and an average W fraction W B , wherein Al B /Al A , B B /B A , and W B /W A  are all larger than 1.0, and wherein the positive electrode active material is a single crystalline powder.

title_en: Heat-not-burn device and method
abstract_en: A device for converting a consumable into an aerosol with high heat without burning the consumable by packaging the consumable containing an internal susceptor inside an encasement having a plurality of holes with an induction heating element wrapped around the consumable-containing package to heat the susceptor using a magnetic field generated by the induction heating element. Combustion of the consumable-containing package is minimized by limiting air inside the consumable-containing package by coating the encasement material that melts at high temperatures. The coating may also include a flavoring. Efficiency of the device can be enhanced with a self-resonant oscillator, moving coils, multi-prong susceptors, sensors, heat dissipation, air flow control, alignment mechanisms, and the like.

title_en: Electrical connector
abstract_en: An electrical connector (10) comprises a base (50) supporting electrical terminals (52a to 52g). Guide pins (54L, 54R) are mounted on the base. Recesses (86) recessed inward of the guide pins are formed in side walls of the guide pins (54L, 54R). The base is embedded in the recesses. The guide pins are held on the base by the embedding.

title_en: Direct-current relay resistant to short-circuit current
abstract_en: A DC relay having a function of extinguishing arc and resisting short-circuit current includes two stationary contact leading-out terminals (11, 12), a straight sheet type movable spring (2), a push rod component (3), and four permanent magnets (71) respectively arranged on the two sides in the width direction of the movable spring (2), and magnetic poles on a side facing to the movable and stationary contacts are opposite. Two permanent magnets (71) corresponding to a same side have opposite magnetic poles. A yoke clip (72) is connected between the two permanent magnets (71). Upper and lower magnetizers (61, 62) arranged in a width direction and can approach or contact with each other through the through hole (22) of the movable spring (2); At least two independent magnetically conductive loops are formed in the width direction of the movable spring (2) by the upper and lower magnetizers (61, 62).

title_en: Electrode active material precursor and preparation method therefor, electrode active material and battery
abstract_en:
Provided are an electrode active material precursor, a method for preparing the same, an electrode active material, and a battery. The electrode active material precursor includes carbon-composite oxide particles. The oxide satisfies a formula (1): 
 
        M a O b      (1), 
 
where element M is selected from one or more of transition metal elements having a relative atomic mass smaller than 65, and optionally being selected from one or more of Ni, Co, Fe, Mn, Zn, Mg, Ca, Cu, Mn, Sn, Mo, Ru, Ir, V, Nb, or Cr, a>0, and b>0. The carbon-composite oxide particles have a powder resistivity smaller than 100 Ω·cm.

title_en: Venting device and prismatic secondary battery provided with same
abstract_en: A venting device includes a fixed member provided with a through-hollow body, and provided with a first stepped part on an inner circumferential surface of an upper portion of the body; and a movable member inserted into and coupled to the inside of the fixed member, and provided with a plurality of venting holes; and a second stepped part on a lower outer circumferential surface facing the first stepped part; and a gap-maintaining member exerting a repulsive force between the fixed member and the movable member. The movable member is movable relative to the fixed member between a first position maintained by the repulsive force exerted by the gap-maintaining member, and a second position when an external force exceeding the repulsive force is applied. The number of venting holes in the movable member connecting with the outside in the first and second positions is different.

title_en: Sulfur-loaded conductive polymer for high energy density lithium sulfide battery
abstract_en: Methods of making a cathode active material, including steps of: a) mixing a conductive polymer, a nitrogen containing polymer or a combination of a conductive polymer and a nitrogen-containing polymer with sulfur in the presence of a solvent to form a mixture, using a weight ratio of the conductive polymer and/or nitrogen containing polymer to the sulfur of from about 1:2 to about 1:8; and b) heating the mixture to a temperature of from about 250⁰C to about 400⁰C under a pressure of from about 0.05 bar to about 2.0 bar to form the cathode active material. A cathode active material formed by the method and cells and batteries employing the cathode active material.

title_en: Electrodes configuration in a battery
abstract_en: The invention relates to a battery comprising at least a cathode (10) and an anode (20), the anode comprising a foil (20) covered by an anode coating layer (21), the cathode comprising a foil (10) facing the anode foil (20) and a flexible tab (14) which projects beyond the cathode foil (10) along a vertical direction (X) parallel to the cathode foil plan. Said cathode tab (14) is covered with an electrical insulation cover (12). The anode comprises an extension (22) of the coating layer (21) beyond the anode foil (20), along the vertical direction (X). Said extension (22) is designed so that the cathode tab insulation cover (12) overlaps the extremity of said extension (22) of the anode coating layer (21).

title_en: Opening key and electronic device
abstract_en: This application provides an open button of an electronic device. The electronic device includes a first part and a second part that can be opened and closed, one of the first part and the second part is a cover of the electronic device, and the other is a body of the electronic device. The open button is configured to be mounted to the second part, and the open button includes a cap, an elastic member, and a touch-sensitive spring. The cap is configured to form a detachable connection with the first part, and the cap has a bump. The touch-sensitive spring and the bump are disposed at a spacing, and the touch-sensitive spring can generate elastic deformation when being squeezed. The cap can move towards the touch-sensitive spring when being pressed, so that the detachable connection is released, and the bump of the cap squeezes the touch-sensitive spring. The elastic member presses against the cap, and is configured to provide a rebound force for the cap when the cap moves towards the touch-sensitive spring. This application further provides an electronic device, and the electronic device has the open button. According to the solutions of this application, when a user presses the open button, a touch feeling feedback is provided for the user, so that a user requirement can be met, and user experience can be improved.

title_en: A wirelessly powered, battery-less closed loop biopotential recording ic for implantable medical applications
abstract_en: Systems and methods for biopotential recording integrated circuits are illustrated. One embodiment includes a wireless receiver configured to receive a first radio frequency (RF) signal; one or more wireless transmitters; and a processing circuitry, comprising: a power harvesting circuit configured to harvest energy from the first RF signal; a clock recovery circuit configured to extract a clock signal from the first RF signal; at least one sensing electrode configured to record an electric signal as at least one of a voltage, current, and electric charge; and an analog-to-digital converter (ADC) communicatively coupled to the clock recovery circuit.

title_en: Fuel cell installation comprising a solid oxide fuel cell system and method of operating the same
abstract_en:
The invention relates to a fuel cell installation (10) comprising: 
- a solid oxide fuel cell unit (30) comprising a first inlet for introducing a heated fuel feed flow (50), a second inlet for introducing a heated oxygen-rich gas flow (52), a first outlet for recovering an anodic gas flow (18), and a second outlet for recovering a cathodic gas flow (20), 
- a first heat exchanger system (42) for heating a fuel feed flow and a second heat exchanger system (44) for heating the oxygen-rich gas flow, each heat exchanger system comprising an enclosure (420, 440) defining a vertical circulation pipe (422, 442) and a tube bundle system arranged in the circulation pipe. 
     Each of the first and second outlet emerges at the bottom of the circulation pipe of the first, respectively second, heat exchanger system so that the anodic, respectively cathodic, gas flow circulates from bottom to top in crossflow through the or each tube bundle (74) of the first, respectively second, heat exchanger system.

title_en: A method for charging a battery in an electric marine vessel
abstract_en: A computer system (222, 322, 422, 500) comprising a processor device (502) configured to: identify a charging start of the battery (202, 302, 402) provided in an electric marine vessel (200, 300, 400), actuate a switch (220, 320, 420) on a protective earth (PE) cable (210, 310, 410) from a disconnected state to a connected state, wherein the PE cable (210, 310, 410) is provided between a PE shore connection point (214, 314, 414) on shore (208, 308, 408) and a PE hull connection point (212, 312, 412) on the vessel (200, 300, 400), initiate charging of the battery (202, 302, 402) via a charging cable (204, 304, 404) connecting the battery (202, 302, 402) on the vessel (200, 300, 400) to a power supply connection point (206, 306, 406) on the shore (208, 308, 408), identify a charging end of the battery (202, 302, 402), and actuate the switch (220, 320, 420) on the PE cable (210, 310, 410) from the connected state to the disconnected state.

title_en: Support device
abstract_en: Provided is a support apparatus configured to support a photovoltaic assembly. A first plate body and a second plate body included in the photovoltaic assembly are sequentially connected in a preset direction. A first support assembly engages between the first side of the first plate body and the first side of the second plate body and is configured to support the first side of the first plate body and the first side of the second plate body above a baseplate. Two second support assemblies are inserted between the second side of the first plate body and the baseplate and between the second side of the second plate body and the baseplate respectively. The two second support assemblies are connected to the second side of the first plate body and the second side of the second plate body respectively so that an isosceles triangle can be formed between the first plate body, the second plate body and the baseplate.

title_en: Positive electrode material for lithium-ion batteries
abstract_en: The present invention provides a positive electrode material for lithium-ion batteries. The positive electrode material for lithium-ion batteries comprises a polymer additive as shown in Formula I or II, the polymer additive has an average molecular weight of 10,000 to 1,000,000, preferably 100,000 to 500,000, and more preferably 300,000, and an addition amount of the polymer additive is 0.001 wt% to 0.1 wt%, preferably 0.01 wt%. By adding the polymer additive as shown in Formula I or II, lithium carbonate in the positive electrode material is better dispersed, a CID is turned on faster, and the lithium-ion batteries thus have better protection against overcharge.

title_en: Active material, electrode, secondary battery, battery pack, and vehicle
abstract_en: An active material includes a composite oxide represented by the general formula Li a Ti b Nb 2 W c O 2b+3c+5+δ  and satisfying 0 ≤ a ≤ b + 3c + 4, 0 < b < 2, 0 < c < 2, 1.9b + 2.85c + 4.75 ≤ δ ≤ 2.1b + 3.15c + 5.25. A crystal structure of the composite oxide is at least one of a monoclinic structure and an orthorhombic structure.

title_en: Lighting device having a lighting module with a flexible guide sheet and arranged in front of an illumination module
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lighting device (300), such as one for a motor vehicle, comprising at least one illumination module (301.1; 301.2) suitable for projecting light rays in order to carry out a lighting function and also comprising a lighting module (400; 500; 600) comprising a flexible guide sheet suitable for receiving light rays and for reflecting the light rays in a direction substantially normal to a surface of the flexible guide sheet, at least one light injection element suitable for receiving light and distributing the light in the flexible guide sheet and at least one light source suitable for injecting light into the light injection element. The lighting module is arranged such that the light rays from the illumination module pass through the flexible guide sheet, and the light source is activated when the illumination module is deactivated.

title_en: A compensation system integrated with an active harmonic filter and static compensator systems
abstract_en: The invention is a hybrid reactive power compensation system (100) which can work integrated with existing compensation panels, preferably sized as the smallest capacitor step power and can control the compensation steps very quickly, characterized in that the hybrid system (1) relates to at least one inverter (3) which controls the capacitor steps (2) used in existing compensation systems and includes an active harmonic filter with high dynamic speed, a static VAr generator and STATCOM.

title_en: Magnet wire
abstract_en: An electromagnetic device includes a magnet wire assembly and a stator component. The magnet wire assembly includes a conductive wire and an insulating member overlaying the conductive wire, where the insulating member includes expanded polytetrafluoroethylene (ePTFE). The stator component includes a plurality of stator slots each having a dielectric material. The magnet wire assembly is located at each of the plurality of stator slots of the stator component to provide a magnetic circuit that includes the magnet wire assembly applied at the dielectric material of the plurality of stator slots.

title_en: Micro high-frequency rf connector receptacle, connector and assembly method
abstract_en: Micro high-frequency RF connector receptacles and related components are described. The receptables include an outer conductor having integrally molded first and second outer bodies, an insulator arranged inside the outer conductor and having first and second insulation bodies, a linear inner conductor having integrally molded first and second inner bodies, and a sleeve sleeved over the outer conductor and configured to cover a protection layer of a cable. Methods of assembling such receptacles and connectors associated therewith are described.

title_en: A method for inductive charging of a rechargeable hearing instrument
abstract_en: Invention regards a method for inductively charging a rechargeable hearing instrument (4) having an inductive coil (16) by means of a charging kit (2). The charging kit (2) comprises a current-generating base unit (6) comprising a first cavity (8), an adapter (10) adapted to be received in said first cavity (8), wherein the energy is transferrable from the base unit (6) to the adapter (10) when the adapter (10) is received in the first cavity (8), the adapter (10) further being provided with an inductive coil (14). The adapter comprises a second cavity (12) adapted to receive the rechargeable, inductively-charged hearing instrument (4). The method comprises the steps of determining (70) characteristics of the inductive coil (16) of the hearing instrument (4), and on the basis of the determined characteristics of the inductive coil (16), configuring (80) characteristics of the current generated by the base unit (6) so as to correspond to the characteristics of the inductive coil (16) of the hearing instrument (4).

title_en: Method of determining a maximum operating speed of an electric motor
abstract_en: The disclosed method involves determining the maximum operating speed of an electric motor (M) under varying torque conditions, specifically at speeds surpassing its rated speed. Initially, the motor is operated at its highest speed across different torque values, establishing a data set of real measurement points. These points illustrate the relationship between the maximum motor speed and the applied torque. A coefficient ( COF ), ranging from 0 to 1 and dependent on motor characteristics, is selected. Two curves are then established: the first for lower maximum speeds, represented by        Ω   ref     =       COFP   nom       T   meas           , and the second for torques below a defined limit torque  T lim    xressed as  Ω ref    =          COFP   nom       f       T   meas               , where  f  is a polynomial function derived from the measurement points. The appropriate curve is then used to ascertain the maximum motor speed for a given torque, based on whether the torque is greater or lesser than  T lim

title_en: Electronic component, in particular a three-phase transformer for an isolated voltage converter
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electronic component (15) comprising: - a magnetic circuit (22), - two electrical conductors (31, 32) each having a portion arranged around a single part (27) of the magnetic circuit (22), each of the portions forming a winding between a first and a second end, these two windings being inductively coupled to each other via the magnetic circuit (22), and - a support (30) for the two electrical windings (31, 32), which is arranged between the electrical conductors and the part (27) of the magnetic circuit, characterised in that the support (30) incorporates a guiding system (85) for guiding at least one of the two electrical conductors (31, 32) outside the electrical winding that it defines.

title_en: Cooking appliance
abstract_en:
Disclosed is a cooking appliance including a main body with a cavity defined therein, and a door that opens and closes the cavity. The main body includes a lighting unit that is installed in a bottom panel and irradiates light in a downward direction of the cooking appliance. The lighting unit irradiates light toward a heating cooking apparatus located below, thereby providing convenience to a user. 
     The lighting unit includes a light source board where a plurality of light sources are aligned to be spaced apart from each other, and a diffusion plate that is disposed under the light source board and diffuses light irradiated from the light sources.

title_en: Power distribution management for extended light fixtures
abstract_en: A printed circuit board (PCB) assembly for an extended light fixture can include: a PCB having a body; a first and second connector portion positioned proximate to an outer perimeter of the body; multiple electrical conductors coupled to the first and second connector portions, where each of the electrical conductors runs continuously between the first connector portion and the second connector portion; a light source receiving feature disposed on the body, connected to one of the plurality of electrical conductors, and configured to receive a light source; and a switching apparatus in communication with the electrical conductors, where the switching apparatus has a first configuration and a second configuration, where the switching apparatus enables a first subset of the electrical conductors when in the first configuration, and where the switching apparatus enables a second subset of the electrical conductors when in the second configuration.

title_en: Container module
abstract_en: Disclosed is a container module. The container module includes a case providing an inner space; a battery pack accommodated inside the case; a pipe positioned inside the case and having a flow path; and a drain case positioned below the pipe and providing an inner space.

title_en: Lithium battery
abstract_en: Disclosed are a binder, an anode having a protective layer comprising same, and a lithium battery comprising same, the binder comprising a third polymer, which is a crosslinking reaction product of at least one first polymer that has a first functional group and is selected from a polyamic acid and a polyimide in which fluorine is substituted, and a water-soluble second polymer that has a second functional group, wherein the first functional group and the second functional group react to form an ester bond such that the first polymer and the second polymer become crosslinked.

title_en: Switching element drive circuit and power conversion device
abstract_en: Disclosed herein is a technique for increasing the voltage across a first capacitor. In a switching element driver circuit (2), a first bootstrap circuit (71) includes a first capacitor (C1) and a first diode (D11) connected to the first capacitor (C1). A second bootstrap circuit (72) includes a second capacitor (C2) and a second diode (D12) connected to the second capacitor (C2). A third bootstrap circuit (73) includes a third capacitor (C3) and a third diode (D13) connected to the third capacitor (C3). A power supply unit (9) is connected to a fourth gate driver (64) in parallel. The third diode (D13) has an anode connected to the power supply unit (9). The second diode (D12) has an anode connected to a cathode of the third diode (D13). The first diode (D11) has an anode connected to the cathode of the third diode (D13) not via the second diode (D12).

title_en: Furnace power supply apparatus with a cooling system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a furnace power supply apparatus (20) for the supply of an electric furnace with electric energy, wherein the furnace power supply apparatus (20) is connectable to a three-phase power network (10) and at least one electrode (30) of the electric furnace, wherein the furnace power supply apparatus (20) comprises at least one power module (100), wherein the power module (100) comprises a rectifier stage (110), connectable to a three-phase power network (10), and a converter stage (120), connectable to at least one electrode (30) of the electric furnace, wherein the furnace power supply apparatus (20) comprises at least one DC bus (130), wherein the DC bus (130) connects the rectifier stage (110) to the converter stage (120) of the at least one power module (100), wherein the furnace power supply apparatus (20) comprises a cooling system (140).

title_en: Pulsed electric machine control
abstract_en: A variety of methods, controllers and electric machine systems are described that facilitate pulsed control of electric machines (e.g., electric motors and generators) to improve the machine's energy conversion efficiency. Under selected operating conditions, the electric machine is intermittently driven (pulsed). The pulsed operation causes the output of the electric machine to alternate between a first output level and a second output level that is lower than the first output level. The output levels are selected such that at least one of the electric machine and a system that includes the electric machine has a higher energy conversion efficiency during the pulsed operation than the electric machine would have when operated at a third output level that would be required to drive the electric machine in a continuous manner to deliver the desired output.  In  some embodiments, the second output level is zero torque.

title_en: Pseudo-exponential encoding for light-emitting devices and related methods
abstract_en: Light-emitting devices and, more particularly, light-emitting devices with pseudo-exponential encoding and related methods are disclosed. Pseudo-exponential encoding or pseudo-exponential transformation refers to encoding and decoding techniques that include placement of certain data bits while at least one data bit is introduced in a manner that deviates from exponential transformation. The deviation involves introducing the at least one data bit to avoid duplicate zero values that may otherwise be present during decoding. Exemplary light-emitting devices include light-emitting diode (LED) packages and/or LED displays. Pseudo-exponential encoding as described herein provides bit shifting and manipulation for increased dynamic range with reduced complexity and size of hardware resources.

title_en: An illuminated strap assembly and a method for illuminating a strap structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to an illuminated strap assembly (1) and a method for illuminating a strap assembly. The assembly (1) comprises a housing (3), a rotatable strap spool (2) connected rotatably to the housing (3), a light emitting strap structure (4) arranged to and fixed to the rotatable strap spool (2). The assembly (1) comprises a light source (10) arranged to radiate light towards the rotatable strap spool (2) and to illuminate the light emitting strap structure (4) arranged to the rotatable strap spool (2).

title_en: Protection cover device and arrangement structure for wiring/piping materials
abstract_en: To make it possible, in a structure in which a protection cover is arranged in a state of causing an irregular gap with respect to an external surface of an apparatus or a structure body, to cover and hide wiring/piping materials exposed from the gap regardless of the size of the gap.SOLUTION: A protection cover device comprises: a communication path formation cover C11 comprising a parallel plate part 42 arranged along a side plate part 81a of a piping cover 81 and a communication path formation part 41 that is extended in a direction away from the side plate part 81a and includes a pair of side plate parts 41a arranged so as to face each other and a top plate part 41b connecting the pair of side plate parts 41a; and a protection cover C1 arranged beside the side plate part 81a with a predetermined gap G1 between the side plate part 81a and the protection cover. Insertion of part of the communication path formation part 41 of the communication path formation cover C11 into the protection cover C1 makes fluid pipes P1 to P4 exposed from the gap G1 be covered with the communication path formation part 41 of the communication path formation cover C11.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Semiconductor switching unit
abstract_en: To provide a semiconductor switching unit capable of suppressing a surge voltage generated at current cutoff and increasing a current that can be cut off.SOLUTION: A semiconductor switching unit comprises: a plurality of semiconductor switching elements arranged in a predetermined direction and connected in series with each other; and a plurality of snubber circuits arranged in the predetermined direction adjacently to the plurality of respective semiconductor switching elements and connected in parallel to the plurality of respective semiconductor switching elements. The plurality of snubber circuits apply an axial loop-like current with an axis in the predetermined direction when the plurality of semiconductor switching elements are turned off, and are wired so that directions of the loop-like currents of a pair of snubber circuits adjacent to each other are reversed to each other.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method of manufacturing laminated optical film
