abstract_en: To provide a method of manufacturing a laminated optical film which offers reduced reflectance from external light and superior visibility.SOLUTION: Provided is a method of manufacturing a laminated optical film comprising a first optical film and a second optical film different from the first optical film laminated together via an adhesive layer. The adhesive layer comprises a first cured product layer of a first adhesive composition and a second cured product layer of a second adhesive composition. The method comprises a first step for coating a laminating surface of the first optical film with the first adhesive composition, and a second step for coating a laminating surface of the second optical film with the second adhesive composition, where the first cured product layer is cured first in the first step before the second cured product layer is cured.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Storage control device and storage system
abstract_en: To provide a storage control device reducing a time required for a cell balance, and provide a storage system.SOLUTION: In a straight device, a SCU controlling a storage device comprises: a plurality of lithium ion capacitors 164-1 to 164-6 which is a backup power supply; a determination part that measures a residual charge amount of each of the plurality of lithium ion capacitors, and determines an abnormal capacitor and a normal capacitor; and a CPU having a primary cell balance processing part that executes a primary cell balance processing making a discharge until a first charging amount to the normal capacitor, an auxiliary charge processing part that executes an auxiliary charge processing making a charge until the first charging amount to the abnormal capacitor, and a secondary cell balance processing part that executes a secondary cell balance processing making the charging until a second charing amount larger than the first charging amount to the normal capacitor to which the primary cell balance processing has been executed and the abnormal capacitor to which the auxiliary charge processing has been executed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Reel rack
abstract_en: To provide a reel rack capable of stably storing a reel body which a tape body for holding electronic component is wound.SOLUTION: A reel rack is provided with at least two support rods spaced apart, an edge of a reel body around which a tape body for holding an electronic component is wound is brought into contact with a contact portion on an outer circumference of each support rod so that reel body is place, a contact portion is provided with a static eliminator that removes static electricity from the reel body, and the static eliminator is provided so as to come into contact with the reel body and suppress misalignment in a longitudinal direction. Since the static eliminator can reliably contact an edge of the reel body to remove the static electricity and suppress a displacement of the reel body in the longitudinal direction, the reel body placed on the support rod is stable, and damage due to tipping can be reduced.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Device for vehicle drive
abstract_en: To secure a power supply voltage of a backup power source required for maintaining an active short-circuited circuit state even in the case where a period of the active short-circuited circuit state becomes relatively long.SOLUTION: A device (2) for vehicle drive includes: backup power supply circuits (550, 550A, 550B and 550C) each generating a backup power source on the basis of power extracted from a power converter in the case where a first power source is abnormal, the backup power supply circuit including a smoothing capacitor (11), a power converter (30) and a booster circuit (5501); and first drive circuits (530-535) each for turning on only a high potential side or low potential side switching element among a plurality of switching elements of the power converter on the basis of the backup power source in the state where the smoothing capacitor and a battery for motor drive are disconnected in the case where the first power source is abnormal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Superconducting coil device
abstract_en: To improve the thermal stability of a superconducting coil.SOLUTION: A superconducting coil device 10 includes a superconducting coil 12, and a coil reinforcement case 14 that is arranged around the superconducting coil 12 so as to reinforce the superconducting coil 12 and airtightly accommodates cooling gas 16 together with the superconducting coil 12. The coil reinforcement case 14 may be thermally coupled to a cryogenic refrigerator outside the coil reinforcement case 14 and the superconducting coil 12 may be cooled by the cryogenic refrigerator via the coil reinforcement case 14 and the cooling gas 16.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Cooking device
abstract_en: To report a calorie value by operation from the side of a rice cooker.SOLUTION: When third input operation means is operated, a rice cooking unit transmits a calorie report command from a second communication part. When the calorie report command of the second communication part is received by a first communication part, an induction heating cooker transmits information indicating the weight of the rice cooking unit measured by weight measurement means, from the first communication part. The rice cooking unit calculates a calorie value by calculation processing means from weight measurement data of cooked rice transmitted from the side of the induction heating cooker 1, and reports the calculation result by report means.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Anisotropic conductive adhesive film, connection structure, and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: To provide an anisotropic conductive adhesive film capable of obtaining a connection structure having excellent adhesive strength, peel strength, and connection resistance after being placed in a high temperature and high humidity environment in the connection of electronic components each having a plastic substrate.SOLUTION: An anisotropic conductive adhesive film according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a thermosetting component and conductive particles, and a cured product obtained by thermosetting the anisotropic conductive adhesive film at 200°C for one hour has a storage elastic modulus of 0.7 GPa to 1.5 GPa at 40°C.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Box for storing electric device
abstract_en: To make a roof cover covering a side part of a roof less likely to deform even if a load is applied from above.SOLUTION: A box 1 for storing an electric device includes: a door 11; a side plate 12; a roof 30 which covers an upper surface; and a roof cover 2 which covers a side part of the roof. A supported part provided within the roof cover is supported by an upper surface of the side plate.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Zinc battery
abstract_en: To provide a zinc battery that can give an excellent short circuit resistance.SOLUTION: A zinc battery comprises: a positive electrode 10; a negative electrode 20; and a separator 30A arranged between the positive electrode and the negative electrode. The separator 30A has a first porous body layer 31, and a second porous body layer 32 located between the first porous body layer 31 and the positive electrode 10. The density of the second porous body layer 32 is larger than that of the first porous body layer 31.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Solar panel holder
abstract_en: To provide a solar panel holder that can adjust the angle of a solar panel and expand and contract.SOLUTION: A solar panel holder includes a fixed frame 1 that is vertically fixed to a balcony, a swing frame 2, and a telescopic frame 3, wherein: an upper end of the swing frame 2 is connected to the fixed frame 1 by a hinge pin; the telescopic frame 3 is slidably connected to the swing frame 2; a rotatable spindle is connected to the fixed frame 1 along a lateral direction; a transmission mechanism is installed between the spindle and the telescopic frame 3; a position regulation component is installed on the fixed frame 1; a drive sleeve, a positioning sleeve, and a transmission sleeve are externally mounted on the spindle; the telescopic frame 3 has a push rod 33 that abuts on the transmission sleeve and positions the transmission sleeve and the drive sleeve in a circumferential direction; and the transmission sleeve can be pushed up so as to form a circumferential positioning between the transmission sleeve and the positioning sleeve when the push rod 33 is detached from the transmission sleeve.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Sticking force evaluation method
abstract_en: To provide a sticking force evaluation method for evaluating sticking force of insulation paper without destroying a stator.SOLUTION: A sticking force evaluation method includes: a natural frequency measuring step P1 for measuring a natural frequency NF of a stator 10 to which a tooth unit 12a and a stator coil 14 are stuck by insulation paper 20; and a sticking force evaluation step P2 for evaluating that, when the natural frequency NF of the stator 10 measured in the natural frequency measuring step P1 is equal to or larger than a predetermined determination frequency NFJ, sticking force FS of the insulation paper 20 is larger than a case where the natural frequency NF is lower than the determination frequency NFJ. Therefore, since the sticking force FS of the insulation paper 20 is evaluated in the sticking force evaluation step P2 based on the natural frequency NF of the stator 10 measured in the natural frequency measuring step P1, the sticking force FS of the insulation paper 20 can be evaluated by measuring the natural frequency NF of the stator 10 without destroying the stator 10.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Igniter of internal combustion engine
abstract_en: To provide an igniter of an internal combustion engine capable of improving combustion efficiency.SOLUTION: An igniter of an internal combustion engine has: a spark plug with an auxiliary combustion chamber in which a discharge gap is arranged; an ignition coil that applies voltage to the spark plug; and a control unit that controls discharge in the spark plug. The control unit is configured to be able to execute a plurality of discharge modes in which a plurality of discharges are generated in the discharge gap with a discharge pause period DP sandwiched between a compression stroke and an expansion stroke of the internal combustion engine.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Motor device and manufacturing method of the same
abstract_en: To provide a motor device which can be easily assembled by preventing a wire harness from being nipped even if a wire harness is used for a wiring member, and a manufacturing method of the same.SOLUTION: A wire harness 66 for a sensor to be connected to a sensor substrate 62 is laid in a space (a wiring housing part 69) in an inner side of a cover member 61 surrounded by a bottom wall part 61a, a sensor substrate 62, and a support part 61c, and a side wall part 61b projects from the bottom wall part 61a toward a rear side housing 23 more than the support part 61c. When the cover member 61 is viewed from its side with the sensor substrate 62 and the wire harness 66 for the sensor being assembled to the cover member 61, the wire harness 66 for the sensor (a plurality of wiring lines 68) is hidden by the side wall part 61b. Thus, a brushless motor 10 can be easily assembled while using the wire harness 66 for the sensor made of the plurality of wiring lines 68.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Active substance material, electrode, secondary battery, battery pack and vehicle
abstract_en: To provide an active substance material, having a high energy density and also capable of achieving both excellent high temperature durability and rapid charge/discharge performance.SOLUTION: An active substance material includes a first niobium-titanium composite oxide represented by general formula (I) and a second niobium-titanium composite oxide represented by general formula (II), the second niobium-titanium composite oxide having a rutile crystal structure. The first niobium-titanium composite oxide belongs to the crystal structure of a C2/m space group, and a difference Δp between the maximum and the minimum of a Nb occupancy in a 4i site satisfies 0.50≤Δp≤0.80. KaNb2-bMb+1-cTicO7...(I) Ti1-yNbyOz...(II) [In the general formula (I), M represents at least one element selected from the group consisting of P, Mo, W, Fe and Ta, a satisfies 0≤a≤1, b satisfies 0≤b≤1 and c satisfies 0<c≤1. In the general formula (II), y satisfies 0<y<0.5, and z satisfies 2.0≤z<2.5.]SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Electrical connector with flat conductor, mating electrical connector, and electrical connector assembly
abstract_en: To provide an electrical connector with a flat conductor, a mating electrical connector, and an electrical connector assembly that do not increase the size of the connector in the thickness direction of the flat conductor when two flat conductors are arranged in parallel facing each other.SOLUTION: The inner side surfaces of flat conductors C1 and C2 face each other at a position at which the conductors are separated from each other in the thickness direction of the flat conductors C1 and C2 with one side on which contact portions C1A-1 and C2A-1 are arranged as the inner side surface. A receiving space 10D for receiving a fitting portion 54 of the mating electric connector 2 is formed between the inner side surfaces thereof, and a housing 10 includes a fitting portion 10A that can accommodate and support the front end side portions of the flat conductors C1 and C2, and mates with the mating housing 50, and the fitting portion 10A can support the outer side surface by a fitting wall 11 or 12 facing the outer surface of the front end side portion of the flat conductors C1 and C2.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 11

title_en: Protector, high voltage wire harness with protector, wiring structure and wiring method
abstract_en: To provide a protector which can prevent radiation of electromagnetic waves from a high voltage wire harness and infiltration of the electromagnetic waves to the high voltage wire harness, and easily protect the high voltage wire harness.SOLUTION: A protector 10 for protecting a wire harness 100 comprises a protector body 20 constituted of aluminum, in which the protector body 20 is provided with a housing part 24 which houses the wire harness 100 inside, and the housing part 24 is provided with an opening 25 continuously opening in a longitudinal direction, and into which the wire harness 100 can be inserted.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Terminal unit and compressor
abstract_en: To improve an insulation property.SOLUTION: A terminal unit 30 includes: a plate-like base part 40; a plate-like insulation part 51 and a fitting insulation part 52 that cover a plate surface of the base part; a terminal 70 extending in a Z-axis direction which is a direction crossing the plate surface of the base part 40 and extending through the base part 40 and the plate-like insulation part 51; and an upper cylindrical insulation part 53 extending from the plate-like insulation part 51 in the Z-axis direction and covering a side surface of the terminal 70. The plate-like insulation part 51 and the upper cylindrical insulation part 53 are molded integrally.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: cable system
abstract_en: To provide a cable system which allows for identifying a state of connection between a cable and a connection part.SOLUTION: A cable system 10 comprises: a cable 12; a connector 13 provided at an end of the cable 10; and an identification unit 42 which identifies a state of the connector 13. The connector 13 comprises: an opening/closing part 18; a contact part 19 which is disposed on the opening/closing part 18 and is to be brought into electrical contact with a connection part; and a pressure detection unit 23 which detects a pressure applied from the connection part. On the basis of a signal from the pressure detection unit 23, the identification unit 42 identifies which state the connector 13 is in, of an open state where the opening/closing part 18 is open and the contact part 19 is not in contact with the connection part, a closed state where the opening/closing part 18 is closed and the contact part 19 is not in contact with the connection part, or a conduction state where the contact part 19 contacts the connection part.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Tin-containing lithium phosphorus sulfide and method for producing the same
abstract_en: To provide a compound which can be used as a solid electrolyte for a lithium ion secondary battery capable of improving ion conductivity and reducing hydrogen sulfide generation.SOLUTION: A tin-containing lithium phosphorus sulfide has a composition represented by the general formula (1): xLin1SnSm1 (1-x)Lin2 PSm2] (1), where n1, n2, m1, m2 and x satisfy 3.0≤n1≤5.0; 2.0≤n2≤4.0; 3.0≤m1≤5.0; 3.0≤m2≤5.0; and 0.00<x<0.40.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: actuator
abstract_en: To increase the output of an actuator.SOLUTION: An actuator 1 includes a plate-like flexible electrode 10, and a base electrode 20 having facing surfaces 22 and 27 facing the flexible electrode 10 covered with insulating layers 23 and 28, the flexible electrode 10 deforms so as to approach the facing surfaces 22 and 27 by applying a voltage between both electrodes. The base electrode 20 is provided with an attachment member 30 for the flexible electrode 10. One ends 11a and 12a of the flexible electrode 10 are supported by the attachment member 30. When a voltage is applied, the other ends 11b and 12b of the flexible electrode 10 rotate about a support position P of the attachment member 30 as a fulcrum to output work to the outside, and are restored to the position before the rotation. The length from the support position P to the other ends 11b and 12b of the flexible electrode 10 is longer than the length from the support position P to the ends 21b and 26b of the base electrode 20.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Sensor installation device
abstract_en: To provide a sensor installation device applicable to various structures and capable of easily installing a sensor at an arbitrary position.SOLUTION: A sensor installation device includes a strut rail part which can be fixed and disposed on a structure, a lifting stage which is slidably movable to the strut rail part and can be stopped at an arbitrary position of the strut rail part, a sensor which can be installed at an arbitrary position of the lifting stage, and a wire pulley part and a wire winding part which can slidably move the lifting stage.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Open winding motor driving device and refrigeration cycle device
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an open winding motor driving device that can suppress occurrence of a zero-axis current. 
     SOLUTION: In an embodiment of the present invention, six output terminals of an open-winding-structured motor are connected to the output terminals of primary and secondary side inverters. A control unit controls an electric current for energizing a motor and a rotational speed based on each line-to-line duty ratio of the primary and secondary side inverters in PWM control, and has a zero-axis current suppression unit for suppressing a zero-axis current flowing in the same direction of three phases between the primary and secondary side inverters. The zero-axis current suppression unit performs: generating each zero-axis voltage between the output of a first switching pattern for generating a voltage to be applied to the motor without generating the zero-axis voltage acting equally on three phases of the motor and the output of the first switching pattern again, and between the output of the first switching pattern and the output of a second switching pattern for not generating a voltage acting on the phases of the motor, nor generating the zero-axis voltage; and inserting a third switching pattern for generating a voltage acting on the phases of the motor. 
     SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Heater, lens unit, camera module, on-vehicle system, mobile body, and method for incorporating heater
abstract_en: To provide a heater, a lens unit, a camera module, an on-vehicle system, a mobile body, and a method for incorporating the heater capable of securing easy assembly and high electric reliability without causing an increase in the number of components and a decrease in integration accuracy.SOLUTION: A heater 30 of the present invention includes: a heating unit 32 as an annular body that is arranged between lenses and generates heat by power supply; a connector 34 electrically connected to a power source side; and a power supply unit 36 that extends so as to electrically connect the connector 34 and the heating unit 32 to supply electric power to the heating unit 32. The heating unit 32, the power supply unit 36, and the connector 34 are integrally formed, and part of an annular body of the heating unit 32 is divided.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Conductive membrane and fuel cell
abstract_en: To improve the proton conductivity of a conductive membrane including a proton conductor and a resin filler, the proton conductor being configured of a coordination polymer.SOLUTION: The conductive membrane includes a proton conductor and a resin filler. The proton conductor includes a metal ion, an oxoanion, and a proton-coordinating molecule. At least one of the oxoanion and proton-coordinating molecule is coordinated to the metal ion to form a coordination polymer. The resin filler is a resin material having at least one of acidic or basic substituents on at least one of the main and side chains.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Steering machine and robot
abstract_en: To provide a steering machine applied to a relatively small internal space of a robot, and a small-size robot.SOLUTION: A steering machine and a robot thereof are provided. The steering machine comprises a steering machine body (1), an upper cover (2), a lower cover (3), and a gear train having a plurality of gears meshing with each other. The gear train is located in the steering machine body (1), and comprises an output gear (20) located in the center of the steering machine body (1) as seen from the cross section of the steering machine body (1).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Device for inspecting runway floodlight and method for inspecting runway floodlight
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an inspection device for a runway floodlight which requires a necessary minimum for a data amount and can determine the presence/absence of abnormality of the a runway floodlight in a short period of time.

title_en: Manufacturing method of terminal-equipped wire and terminal-equipped wire
abstract_en: To prevent a core wire of an electric wire from coming loose, adhere the core wires to each other, stabilize conduction by avoiding an increase in contact resistance, and ensure the reliability of conduction.SOLUTION: A manufacturing method of a terminal-equipped wire 100 in which a crimp terminal 10 is attached to a terminal portion of a coated wire 1 in which a plurality of core wires 2 are coated with an insulating coating portion 3 includes a pressure contact step of press-fitting the coated wire 1 into a wire receiving portion 12 of the crimp terminal 10 by an assembly jig 20, and cutting the insulation coating portion 3 of the coated wire 1 by a pair of press-contact blades 14 to expose the plurality of core wires 2 and conduct with the pressure contact blades 14, and a crimping step of crimping the pair of press-contact blades 14 onto the coated wire 1 while pushing the plurality of exposed core wires 2 into the wire receiving portion 12 with the pair of press-contact blades 14 by pressing a pair of crimping portions 13 with the assembling jig 20, and in the crimping step, the opposing ends 14a of the pair of press-contact blades 14 are brought into contact with each other and crimped.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8

title_en: Polarizing plate, and organic electroluminescence display device
abstract_en: To provide a polarizing plate which significantly suppresses discoloration when used in organic EL display devices.SOLUTION: A polarizing plate according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises a polarizer having first and second principal surfaces opposing each other, and a laminated film disposed on the first principal surface side of the polarizer, the laminated film comprising a base material and a hard coat layer arranged in order from the polarizer side, having a moisture permeability of 300 g/m2/24h or greater, and exhibiting a moisture permeability variation rate of 1.4 or grater when exposed in an environment of 65°C and 95%RH for 48 hours.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Abnormal diagnosis device
abstract_en: To provide an abnormal diagnosis device that can properly diagnose the content of an abnormality that occurs in a fuel cell device.SOLUTION: A abnormal diagnosis device determines that an abnormality has occurred in a cell stack when a first determination condition is satisfied that a resistance value of a cell stack derived on the basis of an output current and an output voltage is equal to or greater than a set resistance value, and the boosted voltage is equal to or less than a set lower limit value with reference to the boosted voltage measured by a boosted voltage measuring device, an output current measured by an output current measuring device, and the output voltage measured by an output voltage measuring device, which are received from a fuel cell device via an information communication line.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: battery module
abstract_en: To provide a battery module that applies appropriate pressure to a laminate, absorbs the displacement of the pressurized load that accompanies charging and discharging of a stacked battery cells when using a lithium-ion battery, can fix a pressure plate at the end of the stacking direction of the lithium-ion battery stack to a case.SOLUTION: A battery module includes a cell laminate in which a plurality of battery cells are stacked, each having a power generation element and an outer body covering the power generation element, a fastening member that fastens the cell laminate, end plates arranged at both ends of the cell laminate in the stacking direction, a fastening nut that fastens the fastening member and the end plate on the outside of the cell laminate, a stay fastened by the fastening nut, and a case containing the cell laminate, and the cell laminate is fixed to the case by the stay.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Polymer porous film, separator for battery, electrode unit, electrode frame work, battery, and manufacturing method of polymer porous film
abstract_en: To provide a nobel polymer porous film.SOLUTION: A polymer porous film includes a first layer and a second layer. The first layer is porus. The first layer has a three-dimensional network structure. The second layer is non-porus in an image at a magnification of 50,000. A rate of the second layer is larger than 0% and lower than 10%. A rate of the second layer can be obtained by a formula; the rate of the second layer (%)=(t2/t0)×100. t0 shows a thickness of the polymer porous film. t2 shows a thickness of the second layer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Carbon fiber electrode material, gas diffusion electrode base material for fuel cell, method for manufacturing fuel cell and carbon fiber electrode material
abstract_en: To provide: a carbon fiber electrode material made of a carbon fiber knit that can be suitably used as an electrode material; and a gas diffusion electrode base material for a fuel cell and a fuel cell using the same.SOLUTION: A carbon fiber electrode material is made of carbon fiber spun yarn with a metric count of less than 1/60 Nm, a twist angle of 40° or less, and a yarn width of 200 μm or less, and is made of carbon fiber knitted fabric with a basis weight of 150 g/m2 or less and a thickness of 230 μm or less when pressed under 1 MPa.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1A

title_en: Spacer for battery cell and battery pack using the same
abstract_en: To prevent a rapid increase in weight in a spacer used for a battery pack when the spacer is wrapped to a certain level.SOLUTION: A spacer 51 for a battery arranged between two battery cells 11 (11A and 11B) which face each other comprises a plate-like base part 52 in surface contact with one battery cell 11A, and fixes a plate-like buffer part 53 in contact with the other battery cell 11B to the base part 52. The buffer part 53 includes: a top part 111 that is provided between a pair of fixing parts 101 fixed to the base part 52, and is in contact with the battery cell 11B on a first line L1 to apply a pressure; and a pair of regulation parts 131 that rise on the side of the pair of fixing parts 101. A pair of elastic deformation parts 151 are provided in a region between the regulation part 131 and the top part 111. Each elastic deformation part 151 is elastically deformed to an inward direction at the pressure of the top part 111, and comes into contact with the base part 52 on a second line parallel to the first line L1 and slides with respect to the base part 52.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Power receiving device and control method
abstract_en: To provide a power receiving device that causes a power transmitting device to grasp the position of the power receiving device without including a power supply.SOLUTION: For example, a power receiving device 20 comprises: an antenna (first antenna 21) for receiving a first radio wave and a second radio wave; a first circuit (first rectification circuit 22) that converts the first radio wave into first power and outputs the power; an output unit 24 for outputting, by using the first power, a first signal for causing a power transmitting device to output the second radio wave; and a second circuit (second rectification circuit 23) that converts the second radio wave from the power transmitting device into second power and outputs the power.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: drive unit
abstract_en: To provide a new drive unit and a new electric vehicle.SOLUTION: A drive unit 20 includes an electric machine 30 and a cooling system 50. A stator housing of the electric machine includes a stator housing inlet 41 and a stator housing outlet 42. The cooling system includes a first cooling circuit 51 connected to the stator housing inlet and outlet. Further, the first cooling circuit includes an expansion tank assembly 60. The expansion tank assembly includes an expansion tank 62, at least one expansion tank inlet 65, one expansion tank outlet 66, and a pressure equalization assembly 64. The expansion tank is connected to the first cooling circuit. The pressure equalization assembly 64 enables at least a temporal fluid connection between the expansion tank and an ambient environment 61 of the drive unit in order to cause a pressure equalization at least partially between the expansion tank and the ambient environment.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Nonaqueous electrolyte power storage element and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: To provide a nonaqueous electrolyte power storage element, low in initial resistance under low temperatures and suppressed in an increase of resistance under low temperatures after charge/discharge cycles, and a method for manufacturing such a nonaqueous electrolyte power storage element.SOLUTION: A nonaqueous electrolyte power storage element according to one aspect of the present invention includes: an electrode body including a positive electrode including a positive electrode active material layer and a negative electrode including a negative electrode active material layer that is at least partially disposed to face the positive electrode active material layer; and a nonaqueous electrolyte. The negative electrode active material layer contains a negative electrode active material containing solid graphite. The nonaqueous electrolyte contains oxalate complex anions having boron elements, the amount (mmol) of the oxalate complex anions contained in the nonaqueous electrolyte being more than 0 mmol/kg and 80 mmol/kg or less per total mass (kg) of a negative electrode active material contained in a negative electrode active material layer facing the positive electrode active material layer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Power supply device for thermal processing
abstract_en: To provide a power supply device for thermal processing that can prevent an electric mobile object from being unable to move to a charging facility due to a decrease in the remaining amount of charge of a storage battery.SOLUTION: A welding power supply device A1 includes: a power conversion unit 1 that performs power conversion of DC power input from an electric vehicle 9 having a storage battery 91; a control unit 2 that controls the power conversion unit 1; and a communication unit 5 that communicates with the electric vehicle 9 and receives information on the remaining amount of charge of the storage battery 91. The control unit 2 includes: a threshold setting unit 24 that sets a threshold for comparison with the information on the remaining amount of charge received by the communication unit 5; and a comparison unit 25 that detects a low remaining amount state when the information on the remaining amount of charge becomes equal to or less than the threshold value.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Coat material raw material for secondary battery separator, coat material for secondary battery separator, secondary battery separator, and second battery
abstract_en: To provide a coat material raw material for a secondary battery separator which can exhibit excellent heat resistance, low water absorption property, air permeability and adhesion, a coat material for a secondary battery separator containing the coat material raw material for the secondary battery separator, a secondary battery separator having a coating film of the coat material raw material for the secondary battery separator, and a secondary battery having the secondary battery separator.SOLUTION: A coat material raw material for a secondary battery separator contains a modified-methylol melamine condensation resin having an acidic group, and acrylic resin particles.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: coil device
abstract_en: To provide a coil device which allows size reduction of the device.SOLUTION: A coil device 1 has: a bobbin 10 having a hollow-cylindrical winding core part 12; a core 50 at least part of which is disposed inside the winding core part; a wire 60 having a coil part 610 which is wound around the winding core part, and a lead part 611 which has a wire connection part led out from the coil part and extending substantially in parallel to a winding axis O of the coil part; and a terminal part 70 having a connection part which is connected to the wire at the wire connection part. A center part 611a of the lead part 611 is disposed, along an X-axis, closer to the winding axis O than a first outer end 36 which is on an outer edge of a device body 2 including the bobbin 10 and the core 50, and which is at a position farthest from the winding axis O in the X-axis direction perpendicular to the winding axis O. Further, the center part of the lead part is disposed, along a Y-axis, closer to the winding axis O than a second outer end 561 which is on the outer edge of the device body 2, and which is at a position farthest from the winding axis O in the Y-axis direction perpendicular to the winding axis O and the X-axis.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Voltage adjustment device
abstract_en: To provide a voltage adjustment device that can efficiently derive a tap position.SOLUTION: A voltage adjustment device 100 is provided with series transformers 11 and 12 whose secondary windings 112 and 122 are connected in series to electricity distribution lines 1u and 1v through which alternate currents are distributed from a power source to loads, an adjustment transformer 2 whose primary windings 111 and 121 are connected in parallel to the electricity distribution lines, and changeover switches Th1-ThC that changeover and select taps t1-t3 which one or a plurality of windings 20a and 20b of the adjustment transformers have, the voltage adjustment device further including a load-time tap switcher 3 that wire-connects the taps selected of the windings and outputs alternate currents. The load-time tap switcher comprises a control part. The control part obtains a primary-side voltage value showing a voltage at the power source side and a secondary-side voltage value showing a voltage at the load side, calculates detection voltage ratio of the obtained primary-side voltage value and the obtained secondary voltage value, and derives tap positions corresponding to the detection voltage ratios, using transfer function including a deviation by a turn ratio of the adjustment transformer corresponding to a tap position determined by switching the taps.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Solid oxide fuel cell and manufacturing method of them
abstract_en: To provide a solid oxide fuel cell capable of suppressing a cracking of an electrolyte layer while having a humidification atmosphere durability to a metal substrate, and provide a manufacturing method of them.SOLUTION: A solid oxide fuel cell comprises: a metal substrate having a penetration hole of a thickness direction; a porous-like porous metal layer that is provided onto the metal substrate and contains a metal as a main component; an anode that is provided onto the porous metal layer; and an electrolyte layer that is provided onto the anode. A Ni concentration in the porous metal layer is lower than that of the metal substrate.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Coil device
abstract_en: To provide a coil device which is small and has high mounting stability for a terminal fixture to a flange portion.SOLUTION: A coil device 1 includes a coil 10 having a winding portion 11 and a drawn-out portion 12a drawn out from the winding portion 11, a core 20 having a winding core portion 21 on which the winding portion 11 is provided and a flange portion 22a formed at an end portion in a first direction parallel to the axis of the winding core portion 21, and a terminal device 30a having a fitting portion 31 that fits into the flange portion 22a. The flange portion 22a has a first side surface 225 located on one side in a second direction parallel to a mounting surface 221 of the flange portion 22a and a second side surface 226 located on the other side. The fitting portion 31 is arranged from the first side surface 225 to the second side surface 226 and is connected to the drawn-out portion 12a.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1A

title_en: Barrel processing device and electronic component manufacturing method
abstract_en: To provide a barrel processing device that reduces vibration occurring in the device.SOLUTION: A barrel processing device 100 performs barrel processing on a plurality of workpieces WK, and the barrel processing device comprises: a first container 111 that accommodates a plurality of media MD; a second container 112 that accommodates the plurality of media MD; a crank shaft 130 that is connected with a motor 140; a first link mechanism 121 that connects the first container 111 to the crank shaft 130; and a second link mechanism 122 that connects the second container 112 to the crank shaft 130. The first container 111 and the second container 112 are arranged at positions across the crank shaft 130.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Coil device
abstract_en: To provide a coil device compatible with high voltage and surface mount.SOLUTION: A coil device comprises: a first wire 20 that is connected to first terminals 41a, 41b; a second wire 30 that is connected to second terminals 42a, 42b; terminal blocks 50a, 50b that fix the first terminals 41a, 41b and the second terminals 42a, 42b, respectively; a bobbin 60 that comprises a first drum 61 on which the first wire 20 is wound and which extends along a first axis, a second drum 62 on which the second wire 30 is wound and which extends along the first axis, and flange parts 63a, 63b that connect the first drum 61 and the second drum 62; and a core 10 that is stored in the bobbin 60. The terminal blocks 50a, 50b at least partially cover the flange parts 63a, 63b of the bobbin 60, respectively.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Nonaqueous gel electrolyte, nonaqueous electrolyte storage element, and method for manufacturing nonaqueous electrolyte storage element
abstract_en: To provide a nonaqueous gel electrolyte that can be manufactured by a relatively simple process and has high oxidation resistance and stability in a gel state, a nonaqueous electrolyte storage element including such a nonaqueous gel electrolyte, and a method for manufacturing such a nonaqueous electrolyte storage element.SOLUTION: A nonaqueous gel electrolyte according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a crosslinked polymer having a polyethylene oxide skeleton, a base catalyst, and a nonaqueous solvent, the nonaqueous solvent is primarily composed of at least one component selected from the group consisting of sulfones and carbonates including propylene carbonate, and has a solubility parameter of 10.0 (cal/cm3)1/2 or more.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Cooling device
abstract_en: To provide a cooling device capable of quickly solving clogging of a filter without causing failure.SOLUTION: A cooling device has: a case 3 in which an apparatus 2 cooled by a fluid which is a liquid is stored; a circulation passage 4 formed at the case 3 and connected to a supply port 10 for supplying a fluid into the case 3 and to a discharge port 11 for discharging the fluid from the case 3, respectively; a normal rotation side filter 6 provided at the discharge port 11; a pump 7 provided at the circulation passage 4; and a control device 8 for controlling an operation of the pump 7. By switching a fluid discharge direction of the pump 7 by the control device 8, switching is possible between a normal mode for delivering the fluid discharged from the discharge port 11 to the supply port 10 via the circulation passage 4 and a reverse rotation mode for delivering the fluid into the case 3 from the discharge port 11.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Mixture sheet for electrochemical device, electrochemical device, and method for manufacturing mixture sheet for electrochemical device
abstract_en: To provide a mixture sheet for electrochemical devices, which can improve sheet strength while maintaining good electrochemical properties, an electrochemical device, and a method for manufacturing a mixture sheet for electrochemical devices.SOLUTION: A solid-state battery mixture sheet includes a silicone compound that is liquid at 25°C, a binder, and an electrochemical device material, wherein the content of the silicone compound is 0.5 to 20 mass% relative to the solid content of the solid-state battery mixture sheet, and the silicone compound has a kinetic viscosity at 25°C of 5 cSt to 60,000 cSt.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: On-vehicle battery
abstract_en: To provide an on-vehicle battery in which the damage due to an external input is suppressed.SOLUTION: An on-vehicle battery according to the art disclosed herein includes a case 30, an electrode body 2 incorporated in the case 30 and having a positive electrode and a negative electrode, a positive terminal member 5 disposed in the case 30 and connected to the positive electrode, and a negative terminal member 6 disposed in the case 30 and connected to the negative electrode. In at least one of the positive terminal member 5 and the negative terminal member 6, an outward surface 52 facing outside is provided, and a hole 53 in a direction to the inside is formed on the outward surface 52. An external terminal member 7 is inserted into the hole 53 from the outside. The external terminal member 7 includes an insertion part inserted into the hole 53, and an external connection part provided connecting to the outside with respect to the insertion part. The insertion part includes a branch section that is branched into a plurality of branch parts, and each branch part is in close contact with a wall surface 54 of the hole 53.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Electrostatic capacitive sensor
abstract_en: To provide an electrostatic capacitive sensor capable of selecting the position of a detection electrode at manufacture.SOLUTION: An electrostatic capacitive sensor includes a first substrate 10, and a second substrate 20 smaller than the first substrate 10 in a plan view. The first substrate 10 includes a first base material 11 with a plate shape, and a plurality of conductive parts 12 each including a conductive part 12a disposed on the base material 11 and a conductive part 12b having a first end electrically connected to the conductive part 12a and a second end electrically connected to a terminal 13 connected to a driving circuit. The second substrate 20 includes a second base material 21 with a plate shape, and a detection electrode 23 disposed on the second base material 21, and is disposed on the first substrate 10 in a state in which the conductive part 12a of one conductive part 12 selected from the plurality of conductive parts 12 and the detection electrode 23 are in electric connection.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Radiographic system, radiographic apparatus, power supply apparatus, method of controlling radiographic system, method of controlling radiographic apparatus, and program
abstract_en: To reduce the influence of whether or not noncontact power supply is performed on a radiographic image in a radiographic apparatus.SOLUTION: A radiographic system includes: a radiographic apparatus including a sensor unit configured to detect radiation emitted from a radiation source and acquire information about a radiation image based on set imaging information, the radiographic apparatus being capable of being supplied with power in a non-contact manner; a power supply apparatus capable of supplying power to the radiographic apparatus in a non-contact manner; and a control unit configured to generate, based on the imaging information, control information for changing a state of supply of the power of the power supply apparatus so as to reduce an influence of the supply of the power on the radiographic image, wherein the power supply apparatus changes a state of supply of the power on the basis of the control information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Carbon carrier material
abstract_en: To provide a carbon carrier material that achieves both durability and power generation efficiency at high levels.SOLUTION: A carbon carrier material 1 according to the present disclosure is a material that comprises a plurality of carbon particles 10. In this carbon carrier material 1, large-diameter particles 10L account for 70% or more in number, and internal pores 12 with a pore diameter of 10 nm or less are formed inside the large-diameter particles 10L. In the carbon carrier material 1 as disclosed herein, the plurality of carbon particles 10 are connected by cross-link parts 20 whose average thickness is between 70 nm and 150 nm inclusive, and external pores 30 are provided in regions defined by the plurality of carbon particles 10 and the cross-link parts 20. This structure of the carbon carrier material achieves both durability and power generation efficiency at high levels.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Vibration type actuator and imaging apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a vibration type actuator that can prevent a reduction in drive characteristics.SOLUTION: A vibration wave motor comprises: a driving member having a vibrator that has an electrical-mechanical energy conversion element and an elastic body to which the electrical-mechanical energy conversion element is fixed, a holding member that holds the vibrator, and a guide member that guides the vibrator and holding member in a first direction; a contact body that is in contact with the vibrator; and a pressure member that applies pressure to the vibrator and contact body in a second direction intersecting the first direction. The holding member has an engaging part that engages with the guide member rotatably in a third direction as an axis intersecting the first direction and second direction, and an output part that transmits power generated through the drive of the driving member to a member to be driven. The output part has an output point. The output point is gripped by a grip member of the member to be driven to transmit the power to the member to be driven. The output point is arranged closer to the vibrator than a bottom face of the holding member.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Light source device, exposure device and manufacturing method of article
abstract_en: To efficiently cool a plurality of light sources.SOLUTION: A light source device includes: a first measurement part configured to measure a temperature of a first light source part; a cooling device configured to supply a cooling medium to the first light source part and a second light source part; a first adjustment part configured to adjust an aperture so as to adjust an amount of the cooling medium supplied from the cooling device to the first light source part; a second adjustment part configured to adjust an aperture so as to adjust an amount of the cooling medium supplied from the cooling device to the second light source part; and a control part configured to control the apertures of the first adjustment part and the second adjustment part. The control part decreases the aperture of the second adjustment part in a state where the aperture of the first adjustment part reaches an upper limit thereof, thereby incrementing the amount of the cooling medium to be supplied to the first light source part.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Dc power distribution network
abstract_en: To allow efficient use of power in a DC power distribution network whose construction cost is suppressed.SOLUTION: A DC power distribution network for a residence comprises a power distribution unit provided with: a supply unit which acquires request voltage and request power of loads such as at least one or more home appliances and electronic appliances connected with the DC power distribution network and supplies power to the loads; a first connection unit which is connected with the supply unit and can bidirectionally supply power with a power system; and a second connection unit which is connected with the supply unit, similarly as the first connection unit, and can bidirectionally supply power with the power system. The power distribution unit controls power to be bidirectionally supplied between each of the first connection unit and the second connection unit according to the acquired request voltage and request power of the loads.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Electrostatic Chuck Device
abstract_en: To provide an electrostatic chuck device in which charging of a base body constituting a mounting surface is suppressed.SOLUTION: An electrostatic chuck device includes: a first substrate that is formed of a dielectric material and supports a plate-shaped sample; a second substrate; and an electrostatic chucking electrode sandwiched between the first substrate and the second substrate. A relative dielectric constant of the first substrate is 10 or more, the first substrate has a plurality of convex parts that protrude upward from an upper surface of the first substrate and support the plate-shaped sample at the upper end. The upper surface of the first substrate is continuous from an inner peripheral side of the first substrate to an outer edge of the first substrate in a plan view. A planar view area of the plurality of convex parts is 5% or less of the planar view area of the first substrate. A diameter of a circumscribed circle is 0.5 mm or less when a minimum circumscribed circle in the plan view of each convex part is assumed, a separation distance between adjacent convex parts is 20 times or more the diameter of the circumscribed circle. A distance from an outermost convex part closest to an outer edge of the first substrate among the plurality of convex parts to the outer edge of the first substrate is shorter than a separation distance.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Polyester film and method for producing the same
abstract_en: To provide a polyester film having excellent puncture resistance.SOLUTION: A polyester film contains polybutylene terephthalate and polyethylene terephthalate, where an absolute value of a difference between a transverse orientation degree (Δnv) and a longitudinal orientation degree (Δnp) of the polyester film is 57 or less.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: connector
abstract_en: To realize an application to an inner housing in which a connector fitting direction is a die-cutting direction.SOLUTION: An inner housing 30 has a first holding part 33 protruding from each of a pair of side wall surfaces 32 and a pair of second holding parts 34 protruding from each of a pair of side wall surfaces without being disposed to face each of the first holding part in a connector insertion/extraction direction and an assembly direction. An outer housing member 50 has a sandwiched part 52 protruding from each of an inner wall surface 51a of a pair of side wall parts 51 and extending in the assembly direction and sandwiched between the first holding part and the pair of second holding parts for each of the side wall surfaces. The first holding part has a reference locking part 33a that locks a first locking part 52a of a clamped part to the reference position, the pair of second holding parts has a crushing rib 34a that is crushed by a second locking part 52b of the clamped part, and the first holding part and the pair of second holding parts clamp the clamped part by the reference locking part and the crushing rib.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Flat wiring member holding member and wiring module
abstract_en: To easily hold a flat wiring member even if the shape of the flat wiring member is changed.SOLUTION: A flat wiring member holding member 40 is a flat wiring member holding member for holding a flat wiring member 30, and includes a holding base 44 including a base body 46 and a through locking part 48 projecting from the base body, and a pressing part 50 for sandwiching the flat wiring member with the base body. The pressing part includes a mating locking part 52 to which the penetrating locking part can be locked, and the penetrating locking part is locked to the mating locking part while penetrating the flat wiring member to sandwich the flat wiring member between the base body and the pressing part.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Control apparatus for electrically heated catalyst
abstract_en: To suppress deterioration of a surface electrode of an electric heating type catalyst.SOLUTION: An electric control unit (17) for controlling electric power supplied to a EHC10 includes a carrier (12) carrying a catalytic material, a pair of electrodes (13) formed on outer surfaces of the carrier (12), and a pair of metallic wires (14) connected to the pair of electrodes (13), respectively. The electric control unit (17) sets a power limit based on a temperature of the pair of electrodes (13) and controls the electric power supplied to the EHC10 to be equal to or lower than the power limit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Earphone set and charging case
abstract_en: To provide an earphone set capable of guiding an earphone to a correct position in a cavity.SOLUTION: An earphone set 1 includes an earphone 2, and a charging case 3 including a housing 31 having a cavity 35 for housing the earphone and a lid for covering an opening of the cavity in an openable / closable manner. The earphone has an earphone side magnet 23. The charging case includes a first case-side magnet 33 that is located near the earphone-side magnet in a state in which the earphones are housed in a correct position P1 in the cavity and generates magnetic attraction with the earphone-side magnet, and a second case-side magnet 34 that is located near the earphone-side magnet in a state in which the earphones are housed in a position P2 shifted from the correct position in the cavity and generates magnetic repulsion with the earphone-side magnet.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Polycrystalline 18h hexaferrite, method for the production thereof and use thereof
abstract_en: There remains a need for a ferrite material with low magnetic loss, high permeability, and low permittivity and dielectric loss in the gigahertz range, and a method of making the ferrite material.SOLUTION: The polycrystalline ferrite composition is represented by the M5Me2Ti3Fe12O31 formula, wherein M is Ba2 +, Sr2 +, or a combination thereof; Me is Mg2 +, Zn2 +, Cu2 +, Co2 +, or a combination thereof; and has an average grain size of 1 micrometer to 100 micrometers. The composite comprises a polymer matrix and the polycrystalline ferrite composition described above. Methods of making the polycrystalline ferrite compositions and composites thereof are also disclosed.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Carbon material and method for manufacturing same, conductive auxiliary agent, dispersion liquid, composition for electrode, slurry for electrode, electrode, and lithium ion secondary battery
abstract_en: To provide a carbon material having excellent conductivity and excellent rapid discharge characteristics, battery capacity characteristics and charge/discharge characteristics when manufacturing an electrode for an electrochemical element.SOLUTION: The carbon material according to the present invention is formed of a carbonaceous outer shell having a graphene structure, has a BET specific surface area in a range of 100m2/g or more and 2500m2/g or less, has a total pore volume measured by nitrogen adsorption and desorption measurement of 0.30 cc/g or more, has a volume ratio of pores having a pore diameter of 10 nm or more to the total pore volume of 30% or more, has a volume ratio of macropores having a pore diameter of more than 50 nm to the total pore volume of 5% or more, and has a mesopore region having a mode pore diameter of 2 nm or more and 50 nm or less.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Installation and removal apparatus for 3-phase power cable
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a cable installation and removal device, and more specifically, to a cable installation and removal device for installing and removing three-phase underground cables in underground power outlets or pipelines. The cable installation and removal device for installing or removing cables for transmission and distribution includes: a pair of support units (800) which are installed to be spaced apart from each other; a drum unit (500) supported by the pair of support units (800) and recovering by unwinding or winding the cable (2) wound through rotation; and a drum driving unit (1100) for rotating the drum unit (500). According to the present invention, the cable can be wound or unwound through the smooth rotation of the cable.

title_en: Method for patterning the surface of polar plates for lead acid batteries
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for patterning a surface of an electrode plate for a lead-acid battery, and more specifically, to a method for patterning a surface of an electrode plate for a lead-acid battery, which increases the chargeability and durability of a lead-acid battery by firmly attaching an active material to a grid of an electrode plate by increasing an active material reaction surface area and applying pressure by performing an X-shaped patterning forming step (S200) and an electrode grid pressing step (S300). According to the present invention, the chargeability and durability of a lead-acid battery are increased by firmly attaching an active material to a grid of an electrode plate by increasing an active material reaction surface area and applying pressure.

title_en: Supporting structure for solar power apparatus
abstract_en: One embodiment of the present invention relates to a supporting structure for a solar power generation apparatus, which is a supporting structure supporting a solar power generation apparatus such that the same is located at predetermined height. The supporting structure of the present invention comprises: a settling unit seated on the ground to have a settling groove with an upper part opened; a buffering unit fixed to the settling unit while seated into the settling groove; a mediating unit stacked on an upper part of the settling unit to have a mediating hole passing through the center such that at least a part of the buffering unit passes therethrough to be exposed; a support unit stacked on an upper part of the mediating unit to support a lower part of the solar power generation apparatus, wherein at least a part thereof is connected to the buffering unit while inserted into the mediating hole; and an anchor unit fixed to the ground to mediate the settling unit, the mediating unit and the support unit, wherein the support unit has an insertion groove recessed upward from a lower part surface to make at least a part of the buffering unit passing through the mediating hole inserted thereinto and the buffering unit is made from an elastic material to enable the support unit to be tilted toward the settling unit by external force applied in a horizontal direction. Accordingly, when external force generated by earthquake and the like is applied, the supporting structure for supporting a solar power generation apparatus can withstand the external force.

title_en: LED Lighting Module Containing Phase Change Material
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an LED lighting module containing a phase change material, which is detachably installed in a street light or an indoor lighting device so as to be easily replaced in case of a failure, has an excellent heat radiation effect due to a heat radiation passage and heat radiation wings provided in a module body, and maintains the temperature of a heat radiation edge at a set level or more due to the phase change material provided at the heat radiation edge forming the heat radiation passage to smoothly maintain the flow of external air due to convection and prevent condensation due to abrupt cooling. The LED lighting module comprises: a module body (120) provided with a plurality of heat radiation wings (124) to be rounded outward along the outer surface of the heat radiation edge (123) disposed vertically in the center so as to form a heat radiation passage (122) in the form of a long hole, provided with a power connection unit (126) at one side thereof and having an LED seating surface (128) formed on a lower opening; an LED substrate (140) provided with one or more LED modules and seated and fixated on the LED seating surface (128) of the module body (120); and a lower case (160) coupled to the module body (120) and fixated such that the module body (120) and the LED substrate (140) are mutually sealed, and provided with a heat radiation hole (162) corresponding to the heat radiation passage (122) of the module body (120), wherein the heat radiation edge (123) is provided with a hollow part (123') formed continuously over the entire surface, and the phase change material, performing the phase change of solid and liquid, is filled in the hollow part (123').

title_en: A case for a connection panel having an embossing pattern formed on the outer surface to expand the surface area and improve heat dissipation, and a connection panel including the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a case for a connection board with improved heat dissipation and a connection board including the same, in which a plurality of embossings protruding toward an external space are provided on the outer surface to form a repetitive pattern, so that heat dissipation is improved, to dissipate the heat generated inside quickly to the outside.

title_en: Smart power management apparatus in building
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a smart power management device in a building. The smart power management device in a building of the present invention is characterized by comprising: a master device which is placed on a power line within a building and performs power line communication through a PLC network within the building through a gateway function and performs Ethernet communication through a PHY network with a management server, thereby routing the PHY network based on the PLC network and providing data received from a terminal device to the management server; and the terminal device which is connected to the master device as a slave through power line communication, modulates packets transmitted through the power line and Ethernet packets to provide Ethernet communication, switches power supplied to a power facility, measures the amount of power supplied to the power facility, and transmits the measured amount of power to the master device along with the operating status. Accordingly, the present invention not only collects and provides power, but also enables smart power management for individual power products based on the Internet of Things.

title_en: Display device using optical fiber
abstract_en: A display device utilizing optical fiber is disclosed. The display device utilizing optical fiber includes a display unit that displays light to a user; and a power unit that is connected to the display unit and supplies power to the display unit, wherein the power unit includes a power generation unit that includes a solar panel and produces electricity; a battery unit that stores electricity produced from the power generation unit; and a processor embedded in the power unit that controls the power unit. The display unit includes a light emitting unit that is connected to the battery unit and produces light with electricity transmitted from the battery unit; and an optical fiber that is arranged on one side of the display unit and transmits light produced from the light emitting unit to one side of the display unit. Thus, the present invention can provide the display device utilizing optical fiber with improved display stability and structural stability.

title_en: Detector for failure section of underground distribut
abstract_en: The present invention comprises: a first subsidence notification unit disposed inside an opening of an underground power port to detect subsidence of a distribution line; a distribution line holding member connected to the first subsidence notification unit to be inserted into the ground and holding and supporting the distribution line; a second subsidence notification unit installed on an inner bottom surface of the underground power port and including an upper plate on which the distribution line holding member is seated and an elastic spring installed between the upper plate and the lower plate; a restraint unit restraining or releasing the distribution line held by the holding member; a first connection unit connecting or separating the first subsidence notification unit and the distribution line holding member; a second connection unit connecting or separating the second subsidence notification unit and the distribution line holding member; and a release unit simultaneously releasing a connection state of the restraint unit, the first connection unit, and the second connection unit to separate a detection device from the distribution line.

title_en: A pile hammer with motor control system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pile hammer to which a motor control method is applied. Instead of an engine applied to an existing pile hammer, a driving motor for individually operating each driving unit is connected in parallel to individually supply power to a corresponding motor according to each driving operation such as track driving, direction switching, reader driving, and hammer driving, so that a required operation can be performed with only minimal power, thereby minimizing unnecessary power consumption.

title_en: Pipe for protecting underground cables
abstract_en: The present invention is to provide an underground cable protection pipe capable of facilitating the maintenance and repair of the underground cable protection pipe by further including a coupling member for detachably coupling a cable pipe and a flexible tube. An underground cable protection pipe comprises: a cable pipe in which an underground cable is accommodated; and a notification means for expressing the buried position of the underground cable, wherein the notification means comprises: a flexible tube of a predetermined length whose shape is deformed by an external force; a support spring for supporting the flexible tube so that the shape of the flexible tube is not deformed when the external force is not applied; a glass pipe which is damaged when the shape of the flexible tube is deformed to discharge a second material; and an outlet for visually expressing the buried position of the underground cable. The underground cable protection pipe of the present invention generates steam by a chemical reaction of a plurality of different materials, thereby safely and visually expressing the position of the underground cable without the risk of fire due to electrical connection.

title_en: Weaktube bus bar
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wick-tube busbar, and more specifically, to a busbar in which a support wick is provided within a current-carrying tube to provide high-current repulsion resistance, thereby enhancing the high-current repulsion resistance of the tube busbar. That is, the busbar of the present invention comprises: a current-carrying tube formed into a tubular body that is electrically conductive and provides supportive rigidity; a support wick provided within the current-carrying tube to provide high-current repulsion resistance; a wick clamping member provided at both ends of the current-carrying tube to engage the support wick; an insulating space formed between the outer surface of the support wick and the inner surface of the current-carrying tube; and a tube heat-conducting coating provided on the outer surface of the current-carrying tube for insulation.

title_en: Angle adjustable multistage solar power generation system and Control method of solar panel angle using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an angle-adjustable multi-stage solar power generation system and a method for controlling the angle of a solar panel using the same. According to the present invention, the angle-adjustable multi-stage solar power generation system comprises: an electric motor (11); a rotary shaft (12) of the electric motor (11); a first pulley (13) inserted into the rotary shaft (12) to rotate according to the rotation of the rotary shaft (12); a second pulley (15); a first load balancer (16); a third pulley (53); a fourth pulley (55); and a second load balancer (56). According to the present invention, power generation efficiency can be increased.

title_en: Color, position and brightness adjusting smart brake lamp and its control method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a brake lamp for a vehicle and a control method thereof which controls a brake lamp such that the color and light position of the brake lamp change and brightness thereof gradually increases or rapidly flickers in accordance with changes in the amount of pressure applied to a brake pedal and the speed of a vehicle, thereby enabling a driver of a following vehicle to accurately recognize a change in the speed of the forward vehicle and take proper action and uses a sensor for a front or rear distance to make the brake lamp slowly flicker, thereby giving a caution signal to the driver at the following vehicle when a distance between vehicles decreases to no more than a given level relative to a speed. The brake lamp of the present invention comprises: a sensor unit for sensing a change in the pressure and speed, wherein changes in the pressure applied to the brake pedal and speed of a vehicle are sensed; a sensor unit for sensing the distance between the vehicle and a forward vehicle or a following vehicle; a control unit for issuing a command for operating a brake lamp in accordance with the signals received from each sensor unit; and a brake lamp whose color, light position, and brightness change in accordance with the command. In accordance with the present invention, when there is a risk of collision with a following vehicle due to rapid deceleration, a warning signal from a forward vehicle collision avoidance system is used to make the brake lamp rapidly flicker, thereby sending a warning signal to the following vehicle's driver.

title_en: Triboelectric and Pyroelectric Multimodal Sensor
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a triboelectric and pyroelectric multimodal sensor. The triboelectric and pyroelectric multimodal sensor according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a first electrode; a first ferroelectric copolymer layer which is positively polarized and formed on the first electrode; a second ferroelectric copolymer layer which is negatively polarized and formed on the first ferroelectric copolymer layer; and a second electrode which is formed on the second ferroelectric copolymer layer.

title_en: Oven having multiple chokes
abstract_en: The present invention discloses an oven having optimal radio wave shielding efficiency in a plurality of frequency bands. The oven according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a plurality of choke rooms, some of which are formed to partially face a cavity, which is a space in which cooking materials are accommodated in the oven. Accordingly, it is possible to have optimal radio wave shielding efficiency in a plurality of frequency bands and to increase the capacity of the cavity.

title_en: Device for automatically switching on and off of electric switches
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic on-off switching device of an electric switch so as to be easily installed by attaching and detaching to the existing electric switch, and designed to operate electromechanically to implement the simpler structure, simplify the resulting parts for easier manufacturing, and automatically switch an on-off state of the corresponding electric switch after setting the time of each electric switch. The present invention discloses the automatic on-off switching device of an electric switch, which includes, for example, a switch body unit covering at least one electric switch and having a switch opening exposing the electric switch; a switch button unit formed with a plurality of blocks installed on the switch opening and corresponding to the electric switch to manually turn on or off the electric switch by directly pressing each of the electric switches when directly pressed by a user; a switch cover unit covering the switch button unit; a button driving unit for automatically turning on or off the electric switch by operating to press each block of the switch button unit upon reception of a control signal; a reservation switch unit that receives a turn-on or turn-off reservation command for each of the electric switches from the user; and a button control unit outputting the control signal to the button driving unit after a preset time according to the input of the reservation switch unit.

title_en: Electrode assembly and manufacturing method of the same
abstract_en: An electrode assembly according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a negative electrode; a positive electrode; and a separator disposed between the negative electrode and the positive electrode, wherein the negative electrode, the positive electrode, and the separator are wound together to form a jelly roll structure. The negative electrode includes: a negative electrode current collector; and a negative electrode active material part formed by coating a negative electrode active material on the negative electrode current collector. The positive electrode includes: a positive electrode current collector; and a positive electrode active material part formed by coating a positive electrode active material on the positive electrode current collector. A negative electrode uncoated part to which the negative electrode active material is not applied among the negative electrode current collector extends in a first direction. A positive electrode uncoated part to which the positive electrode active material is not applied among the positive electrode current collector extends in a second direction opposite to the first direction. The positive electrode active material part includes a loading-reducing part having a smaller loading amount of the positive active material than adjacent regions, and the loading-reducing part is located at one end of the positive electrode in the first direction. The energy density of the electrode assembly can be enhanced.

title_en: Transformer with Integrated Inductor
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a transformer with an integrated inductor. The transformer with an integrated inductor according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises a transformer and an inductor stacked on the transformer. The transformer includes: a primary coil; a secondary coil; and a transformer core providing a path for a line of magnetic force, wherein the path passes through the primary and secondary coils, diverges to both sides, and then returns to the opposite side of the coils. The inductor, includes: an inductor coil; and an inductor core providing a path for a line of magnetic force, wherein the path passes through the inductor coil, diverges to both sides, and then returns to the opposite side of the inductor coil. Here, outer surfaces of the transformer core and the inductor core are surrounded by a ribbon of a material having a higher saturation magnetic flux density than a corresponding core to expand a path of a magnetic force line thereof. The OCP can be effectively increased.

title_en: Battery module with improved fire protection performance
abstract_en: According to the present invention, disclosed is a battery module capable of effectively preventing the occurrence or spread of a fire. The battery module according to one aspect of the present invention includes: a cell assembly including a plurality of secondary batteries stacked on each other; a module case that accommodates the cell assembly in an inner space and has a venting path and a discharge unit therein so that venting gas generated from the cell assembly can be discharged; and a blocking member provided in the venting path of the module case and having a plurality of holes therein to filter a material flowing through the venting path.

title_en: Building-integrated solar power generation system and building-attached solar power generation system with intelligent DC ground fault blocking function
