abstract_en: The present invention relates to a building-integrated photovoltaic power generation system and a building-attached solar power generation system with an intelligent DC ground fault blocking function and, more specifically, to a building-integrated photovoltaic power generation system and a building-attached solar power generation system with an intelligent DC ground fault blocking function, which can prevent fire in a building and fix an overall system by completely blocking only a string with a ground fault accident by having a function of predicting and preventing fire caused by a shadow or surface contamination and a ground fault current blocking function. According to the present invention, the building-integrated photovoltaic power generation system and the building-attached solar power generation system with an intelligent DC ground fault blocking function individually separate only solar cell strings with a ground fault from a solar cell array through a ground fault detection and blocking circuit to stop the power generation of only the corresponding solar cell strings and allow the power generation of the remaining normal solar cell strings to continue to minimize power generation loss.

title_en: Actuator motor and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The present invention provides an actuator. The actuator includes a bracket, a motor unit installed on one side of the bracket, and a driving unit which receives power from the motor unit and which is disposed on the bracket. Both ends of a lead screw are rotationally supported by the bracket, and a coupling is installed between one end of the lead screw adjacent to the motor unit and a motor shaft of the motor unit. One side of the coupling is rotatably connected to the motor shaft of the motor unit, and the coupling indirectly transmits rotational force to the lead screw connected to the other side of the coupling. In addition, the present invention also provides an electronic device including the actuator. Therefore, the present invention can effectively reduce noise and vibration generated during the operation of the motor unit and the driving unit.

title_en: Apparatus and method for diagnosing battery
abstract_en: An apparatus for diagnosing a battery according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a voltage measuring unit configured to measure a voltage of each of a plurality of battery cells and measure a voltage variation of each of the plurality of battery cells at predetermined time intervals; and a control unit which is configured to calculate a voltage deviation for each of the plurality of battery cells based on a plurality of voltage variations measured by the voltage measuring unit, calculate a cumulative deviation obtained by integrating voltage deviations for each of the plurality of battery cells for each of the plurality of battery cells, set a standard deviation interval based on the calculated plurality of cumulative deviations, determine one or more target cells from among the plurality of battery cells, and diagnose the state of each target cell based on a result of comparing the standard deviation interval with the cumulative deviation of each determined target cell. The present invention diagnoses the condition of a plurality of battery cells in a non-destructive way.

title_en: System and method for light field illuminator sheet-based dynamic lighting output
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a digital controlling-type LED illuminator sheet which generates a far-field illumination pattern or a bright-field distribution that increases light utilization and application efficiency. A dynamic directional LED (or other type of solid-state light source) sheet is placed beneath each lenslet of a microlens array. An individual LED beam pointing direction depends on an off-axis position with respect to the optical axis of the lenslet. Individual beams from independent LEDs form an illumination pixel in an illumination plane or within a volumetric space and the intensity can be adjusted. The illumination pixel partially overlaps in a far-field illumination plane and an illumination volume. Over a large lighting space, many lighting pixels will partially overlap on neighboring lighting pixels, and at this time, the overlap becomes an increment smaller than the size of the pixel. The LEDs can be digitally turned on or off and/or pulse width or amplitude adjusted to generate the far-field illumination pattern or the bright-field distribution with spectral efficiency and effective intensity.

title_en: Systems and methods for controlling inverter having shutoff circuit
abstract_en: A system includes: a control board comprising: a microprocessor configured to output a PWM signal; a primary shutoff path circuit, an upper MOSFET shutoff circuit, and a lower MOSFET shutoff circuit, wherein each of the circuits is configured to receive the PWM signal; a first buffer provided at an output of the primary shutoff path circuit; a second buffer provided at an output of the upper MOSFET shutoff circuit; a third buffer provided at an output of the lower MOSFET shutoff circuit; a first resistor and a second resistor provided in parallel at the first buffer and configured to provide a first feedback signal; a third resistor and a fourth resistor provided in parallel at the second buffer and configured to provide a second feedback signal; and a fifth resistor and a sixth resistor provided in parallel at the third buffer and configured to provide a third feedback signal.

title_en: Parallel tasking multiple passage charge controller
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the development of a device using a device adding an element for increasing the usage of specific electric energy in the middle of a process of using electric energy by storing or converting a power generation source and a method of using the same. More specifically, a charge control device with a maximum power point charge controller (MPPT CC) having one or multiple parallel passages is used to store electric energy in an energy storage battery at high efficiency to convert electric energy into direct current or alternating current to use the direct current or the alternating current. A line resulting from weaving a copper wire coated with an insulator can use organized and connected electronic components such as a circuit line wound on various cores such as ferrite and a capacitor for maintaining a high voltage on the upper end of a parallel-tasking multi-passage CC (PTMPCC). Also, the device and the method of using the same can maximally improve the usage of electricity by additionally using electric energy by connecting a new passage to the lower end of a power generation source when charging electric energy in a battery.

title_en: Multilayer Ceramic Capacitor
abstract_en: One embodiment of the present invention provides a multilayer ceramic capacitor which comprises: a body which includes a dielectric layer, and first and second internal electrodes alternately disposed with the dielectric layer interposed therebetween; and a first external electrode connected to the first internal electrode and a second external electrode connected to the second internal electrode, the first and second external electrodes are disposed on the outside of the body. The first and second external electrodes include: a first electrode layer which is disposed on the body and includes Ni and Cr; a second electrode layer which is disposed on the first electrode layer and includes Cu; and a plating layer which is disposed on the second electrode layer.

title_en: Novle additives for nonaqueous electrolyte and lithium secondary battery containing the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a novel additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte and a lithium secondary battery including the same. The additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte contains an ionic compound represented by chemical formula 1 to form a film on an electrode surface when the secondary battery is activated so that large amounts of gas can be prevented from being generated under high temperature conditions, and metal ions are eluted from an electrode to prevent a decrease in the OCV of a cell and a decrease in a capacity maintenance rate so that battery durability, performance, and high-temperature safety can be effectively improved.

title_en: Reactor for manufacturing vanadium electrolyte
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a reactor for producing a vanadium electrolyte and a method for producing a vanadium electrolyte. The method of the present invention requires no catalyst support. The method of the present invention has no loss of a catalyst. The method of the present invention has a fast production rate. The present invention includes: a discharge unit for discharging a mixture; and a filtration unit positioned on the side of the discharge unit and including a plurality of pores to separate a solid catalyst.

title_en: Electronic device including a battery, method for operating thereof and storage medium therefor
abstract_en: According to various embodiments, an electronic device comprises: a battery; a charging circuit; at least one sensor; a plurality of temperature sensors each disposed at different locations; at least one processor operatively coupled to the battery, the charging circuit, the at least one sensor, or the plurality of temperature sensors; and a memory. The memory may store instructions that, when executed, cause the at least one processor to: measure temperature values using the plurality of temperature sensors at specified intervals upon initiation of charging; identify a heating state based in part on the measured temperature values; identify a state of contact of a user using the at least one sensor; and based on the heating state and the state of contact of the user, adjust a charging power to the battery through the charging circuit. Accordingly, performance limitations caused by heat generation are minimized to guarantee smooth operation performance and stable charging. Various other embodiments may be provided.

title_en: Substrate support unit of plasma processing chamber
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present invention provides a substrate support unit of a plasma processing chamber capable of forming uniform plasma distribution from the center to the edge of the substrate. The substrate support unit of the plasma processing chamber according to the present invention includes: a chuck body installed at the lower part of the plasma processing chamber; a first electrostatic chuck provided on the upper part of the chuck body to support the lower part of the substrate and equipped with a first lower electrode for forming plasma therein; a second electrostatic chuck provided on an upper side of the chuck body outside the first electrostatic chuck and having a second lower electrode mounted therein; and a focus ring provided on the upper part of the second electrostatic chuck.

title_en: Heating device having heating mat for stairs
abstract_en: Proposed is a heating device comprising a heating mat for a stair according to one embodiment of the present invention. The heating device according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises: a plurality of heating mats comprising a base part that adheres to an upper part of a stair, an insulating part located at an upper part of the base part, a heating part located in the insulating part and generating heat by supply-receiving power, an iron mesh located at an upper part of the heating part, and a coil mat located on an upper part of the iron mesh; and at least one or more power supply connection modules in close contact with a left-side or a right-side side-wall of the stair and supply-receiving electric power from a power supply part to supply a power supply to each heating mat. Therefore, the present invention is capable of preventing accidents.

title_en: Tracking system for photovoltaic generation and tracking method for photovoltaic generation using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an intelligent photovoltaic generation tracking system and method which improve photovoltaic generation efficiency by giving a tilting angle of a light collection plate according to a movement path of the sun using a location, a date, and a time of a place in which photovoltaic facilities are installed and a horizontal reference angle of the light collection plate which is always kept constant. More specifically, the photovoltaic tracking system comprises: a base frame fixed and supported at an installed location; a plurality of light collection plates installed on the base frame, connected to a driving frame located on one side lower part, and coupled to be tilted according to forward and backward movement of the driving frame; an information collection unit collecting first information, which is information on a movement path of the sun according to a location, a date, and a time, and second information, which is horizontal tilt information of the light collection plate linked to the first information; a processing unit calculating a driving tilt of the light collection plate based on the first information and the second information and generating a tilting angle control command of the light collection plate; and a driving unit connected to the driving frame and moving the driving frame forward and backward according to the tilting angle control command. Accordingly, high efficiency photovoltaic generation can always be maintained.

title_en: Bleed valve
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a discharge valve, which is coupled to a mounting hole of a valve assembly for controlling the charge and discharge of a hydrogen fuel cell vehicle to control pressure of a transfer flow path, includes: a hollow mounting member having a screw thread formed on an outer circumference surface to be screwed to the mounting hole and having a screw thread formed on the inside; and a valve unit screwed to the inside of the mounting member to be moved forward and backward and opening or closing the transfer flow path. Therefore, the discharge valve is capable of minimizing the number of components and preventing hydrogen leakage.

title_en: conductive paste
abstract_en: According to embodiments of the present invention, a conductive paste may be provided, which comprises a first particle including a polymer material and conductive second particles arranged on a surface of the first particle and surrounding the first particle, wherein each of the second particles has ligands bonded to the surface of the second particle, and the second particles adjacent to each other on the surface of the first particle are connected to each other through the ligands. Accordingly, the present invention provides the conductive paste having high conductivity by a low-temperature process.

title_en: Fuel cell manufacturing system
abstract_en: Disclosed is a fuel cell manufacturing system capable of contributing to the improvement of the product quality of a battery. The fuel cell manufacturing system according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises: a sub-gasket supply device which supplies a sub-gasket through a process to manufacture an assembly that is formed as one body by bonding an anode layer, an electrolyte layer, and a cathode layer; an overlap layer zone welding device which is disposed at one side of a process line, to which the sub-gasket is supplied, aligns the anode layer or the cathode layer with the electrolyte layer attached thereon so as to arrange the anode layer or the cathode layer in a hole area of the sub-gasket, and then welding an overlap layer zone, which is an edge portion of the sub-gasket, so as to make the anode layer, the electrolyte layer, and the cathode layer come in contact with each other; and an active area zone main welding device which is disposed at a rear of the process of the overlap layer zone welding device, and manufactures the assembly by main-welding an active area zone, which is the hole area of the sub-gasket.

title_en: Operation method and apparatus of on-load tap changer on main transformer considering reverse power flow in distribution system connected with high penetration on photovoltaic system
abstract_en: A method for controlling the voltage of a main transformer considering a reverse current situation in a line connected to a solar power generation system and a device thereof are disclosed. The method for controlling the voltage of a main transformer in a system line connected to a solar power generation system includes: (a) a step of measuring the voltage of each node of each feeder; (b) a step of deriving a reference voltage of each node for each direction of current; (c) a step of determining a direction of current of a main transformer using the measured voltage of each node and the reference voltage; and (d) a step of differently selecting a target feeder for an operating reference point according to the determined direction of current of a main transformer, and selecting the operating reference point from the selected target feeder to determine whether to adjust a tap position.

title_en: Negative eleectrode for a lithium secondary battery, a method for preparing the same and a lithium secundary battery comprising the same
abstract_en: The cathode for the lithium secondary battery comprises the lithium (Li)-magnesium (Mg)-aluminum (Al) alloy. A lithium secondary battery such as a lithium sulfur battery including a negative electrode according to the present invention exhibits excellent battery life characteristics compared to such a battery using a negative electrode of the prior art.

title_en: A lens driving device, a camera device and an optical apparatus
abstract_en: The present embodiment relates to a lens driving device which comprises: a fixing unit; a first moving unit disposed in the fixing unit; a second moving unit disposed in the first moving unit; a third moving unit disposed in the second moving unit; a first driving unit moving the first moving unit in a first direction perpendicular to an optical axis direction; a second driving unit moving the second moving unit in a second direction perpendicular to the optical axis direction and the first direction; and a third driving unit moving the third moving unit in the optical axis direction.

title_en: Battery pack
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a battery pack accommodating a battery module. More specifically, the battery pack of the present invention comprises: a pack case including a plurality of module areas on which a battery module is mounted, wherein the pack case includes: a base plate; a side wall coupled along an edge of the base plate; and a support wall coupled to an inner side of the side wall, the support wall includes a coupling part protruding in a rib shape from one side facing the side wall, and the side wall includes an insertion groove recessed therein to allow the coupling part of the support wall to be inserted thereinto.

title_en: Negative electrode for lithium secondary battery and lithium secondary battery comprising the same
abstract_en: The present invention includes a negative electrode active material including natural graphite and a coating layer disposed on the surface of the natural graphite. 1. 40 g/cc to 1. In the compression density of 80g / cc, the area ratio (i110/i004) of the orientation peak intensity of the xrd pattern is 0. 08-0. The present invention relates to a negative electrode for a 16-person lithium secondary battery and a lithium secondary battery including the same. By using the negative electrode of the present invention in a lithium secondary battery, it is possible to improve the charging output characteristics of the lithium secondary battery.

title_en: Hydrogel-based wrinkled nanomembrane electrode and preparing method for manufacturing of the same
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a wrinkled nanomembrane electrode including: a hydrogel in which an organic molecule including an amine group is permeated; and a nanomembrane in which nanoparticles are assembled and sintered on the surface of the hydrogel. The present invention provides a wrinkled nanomembrane electrode including: a hydrogel in which an organic molecule including an amine group is permeated; and a nanomembrane in which nanoparticles are assembled and sintered on the surface of the hydrogel. The present invention has advantages of having excellent electrical performance and stable electrical characteristics even under mechanical deformation.

title_en: Multilayer electronic component
abstract_en: A multilayer electronic component according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a body which includes a dielectric layer and an internal electrode; and an electrode layer which is arranged on the body and is connected to the internal electrode. the electrode layer includes cu particles and glass.

title_en: Etching method and plasma processing apparatus
abstract_en: A disclosed etching method comprises a process (a) of preparing a substrate on a substrate support unit in a chamber. The substrate comprises a multilayer film including a plurality of first films and a plurality of second films stacked alternately with the plurality of first films, and a mask provided on the multilayer film. The etching method further comprises a process (b) of etching one or more first films among the plurality of first films. The etching method further comprises a process (c) of etching one or more second films among the plurality of second films. In each of the processes (b) and (c), a pulse of source high-frequency power for generating plasma and a pulse of electrical bias for attracting ions are supplied intermittently or periodically.

title_en: Apparatus for compensating lead power factor of transformer
abstract_en: According to an aspect of the present invention, an apparatus for compensating a power factor of a transformer comprises: a database storing a line constant unique to a distribution line; a transformer selection module selecting a target transformer to be compensated for a power factor among a plurality of transformers supplying power to the distribution line; and a power factor compensation module determining a target section of the distribution line for compensating the power factor of the target transformer based on the line constant stored in the database, and compensating the power factor of the target transformer by linking the target transformer to the target section.

title_en: Power line control multi power strip
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to prevent disconnection caused by force generated when arranging a lead wire of a multi-tap and winding and unwinding the lead wire of the multi-tap by comprising: a multi-tap body; a plurality of socket units formed on one side of the multi-tap body; a winding unit on which a lead wire for connecting power to the socket unit is wound; the lead wire wound and unwound on the winding unit; and a buffer unit for buffering pulling force generated when winding and unwinding the lead wire on the winding unit.

title_en: Cathode active material for lithium secondary battery doped with heterogeneous elements, method for manufacturing the same, and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a positive electrode active material for a lithium secondary battery doped with a heterogeneous element, a positive electrode active material for a lithium secondary battery manufactured using the same, and a lithium secondary battery including the same. More specifically, provided is a lithium secondary battery which structurally stabilizes a positive electrode active material by doping a positive electrode active material which is a lithium layered structure solid solution compound including a metal of three or more elements with a heterogeneous element, and has excellent cycle life and rate limiting properties.

title_en: Electronic device comprising a connector
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an electronic device comprises: a first housing including a first surface; a plurality of first terminals provided on the first surface; a first magnetic body surrounding the plurality of first terminals; a first connector including a first barrier surrounding an inner surface of the first magnetic body; a second housing including a second surface; a plurality of second terminals provided on the second surface; a second magnetic body detachable from the first magnetic body and surrounding the plurality of second terminals; and a second connector including a second barrier surrounding an inner surface of the second magnetic body and connectable to the first connector. In an embodiment, the first barrier may extend higher than the first magnetic body from the first surface in at least a partial area. In an embodiment, the second barrier may extend higher than the second magnetic body from the second surface in at least a partial area. In addition, various embodiments are possible.

title_en: Power device fixing apparatus
abstract_en: An apparatus for fixing a power device is disclosed. According to one aspect of the present invention, a power device fixing device comprises: a body unit accommodating a power device; a coupling unit protruding from one side surface of the body unit and having a coupling space; and a cover unit fixed to the body unit and including a coupling protrusion protruding. The coupling protrusion can be inserted into the coupling space.

title_en: Molded Case Circuit Breaker
abstract_en: A molded-case circuit breaker is disclosed. The molded-case circuit breaker is characterized in that the insulation performance of the case is constantly maintained even when the inside of the case is contaminated by the introduced oxide. A molded-case circuit breaker according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a case, a case cover, and a plurality of base assemblies. The case cover covers the case. A plurality of base assemblies is accepted to the case. The base assembly comprises the base cover The space is formed in inside and the base cover accepts the fixed contact, and the movable contact and arc extinguishing part. If the base cover is inserted into the case, the insulating coating part is formed in the inner surface of the case in which the exterior of the base cover is opposite. The inner surface of the case is to the insulating material the coating and the insulating coating part is formed.

title_en: Display device for outdoor
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an outdoor display device. The outdoor display device comprises: a device body; a protection member disposed on a front surface portion of the device body; a rear frame disposed on a rear surface portion of the device body; a display module disposed between the protection member and the rear frame; and a cooling means disposed on the device body and cooling the display module. The cooling means includes: a suction unit disposed on the rear frame and sucking air; a front channel formed between the protection member and the front surface portion of the display module and communicating with the suction unit through a communication flow path; a rear channel formed between the rear frame and the rear surface portion of the display module and communicating with the suction unit; and a discharge unit disposed to be spaced apart from the suction unit, communicating with the front channel or the rear channel, and discharging air. According to the present invention, the flow of air supplied to the front surface portion or the rear surface portion of the display module is improved, thereby improving the cooling capacity of the display module.

title_en: Power storage stack
abstract_en: The power storage stack includes: a plurality of power storage modules arranged in a first direction; and a conductive member arranged between each of the power storage modules adjacent to each other. The conductive member has a first surface and a second surface. The first surface is fixed to the power storage module located on one side in the first direction by a first conductive adhesive, and the second surface is fixed to the power storage module located on the other side in the first direction by a second conductive adhesive. The first conductive adhesive includes a plurality of first coating portions arranged side by side at intervals in the second direction, and the second conductive adhesive includes a plurality of second coating portions arranged side by side at intervals in the second direction. When viewed in the first direction, the plurality of first coating portions and the plurality of second coating portions are disposed so as not to overlap each other.

title_en: Power distribution board
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a distribution board for distributing supplied power. The distribution board comprises: a distribution box manufactured in a partially openable and closable enclosure shape; a current supply unit provided in the distribution box to receive and distribute a current from the outside; and a controller provided in the distribution box and connected to the current supply unit to control the operation of the current supply unit. The current supply unit includes: a supply module provided to communicate with the outside in the distribution box to receive power from the outside; and a distribution module connected to the supply module to distribute the power supplied from the supply module and transmit the power to each set area.

title_en: Power transmission structure of media separation unit
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a power transmission structure of a medium separation unit comprises: a pickup pulley and a feed pulley provided at positions spaced apart from each other on both sides; a medium separation belt driving on the pickup pulley and the feed pulley, holding and conveying a medium, supporting the medium on a lower side of the pickup pulley, and changing an inclination by contact with a bill press lifted and lowered; a motor providing a driving force to rotate the medium separation belt in one direction or in the opposite direction; at least one relay gear transmitting the driving force of the motor; a swing arm interlocked with the rotation of the relay gear to swing in both directions within a predetermined angle range; a planetary gear connected to the swing arm and rotating in conjunction with the rotation of the relay gear to transmit power to swing the swing arm; and a clutch gear intermittently gear-coupled or gear-coupled disengaged from the planetary gear in accordance with a swing direction of the swing arm, and transmitting power to the pickup pulley through a connection belt whose inclination is changed in conjunction with a change in the inclination of the medium separation belt.

title_en: Winding appratus
abstract_en: An invention for a winder is disclosed. The disclosed invention comprises: a camera photographing an input unit arranged on an inlet side of a rewinder winding an electrode and a separation membrane; and a guide member arranged between the input unit. The guide member comprises: an input guide unit spraying air in a direction in which the electrode is in close contact with the separation membrane; and a photographing passage unit opening a portion of the guide member so that at least a portion of the input unit can be opened toward the camera.

title_en: Light buoy ship collision prevention guidance device
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present invention is to provide a light buoy ship collision prevention guide device capable of preventing a ship from colliding with a light buoy by using a light reflection unit including a light reflection sensor installed in the light buoy and a light emitting unit including a surface light emitting chip-on-board LED. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a light buoy ship collision prevention guide device comprises: a light emitting unit provided on an upper portion of a light buoy; a light reflection unit selectively operated according to weather conditions around the light buoy; and a power supply unit supplying power to the light emitting unit and the light reflection unit. The light reflection unit is connected to a circuit between the power supply unit and the light emitting unit to implement a switching function.

title_en: Anode Assembly, Manufacturing Method of The Same and All-Solid-State Battery Comprising The Same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a negative electrode assembly comprising: a first layer including lix; a second layer including amorphous carbon; and a negative electrode current collector, wherein x is a halogen element, a method for manufacturing the same, and an all-solid-state battery including the same. According to the present invention, it is possible to provide a negative electrode assembly having excellent charging/discharging efficiency and capacity retention rate, a method for manufacturing the same, and an all-solid-state battery including the same.

title_en: Construction Apparatus for Electric Pole of Bypass Cable and Construction Method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for installing a column of a bypass cable and an installation method thereof. The apparatus for installing a column of a bypass cable of the present invention has a function of being easily attached to and detached from a suspension wire (50) while handling a horizontal load of three-phase bypass cables (30a, 30b, 30c) supported by the suspension wire (50), a function of supporting the three-phase bypass cables (30a, 30b, 30c) not to be easily mounted and sagged, and a function of protecting the three-phase bypass cables (30a, 30b, 30c) from escaping from supports (63a, 63b, 63c) of a hanger (60) divided into upper, middle, and lower parts. Therefore, the apparatus for installing a column of a bypass cable of the present invention is easy to install the three-phase bypass cables (30a, 30b, 30c) in a place where it is impossible to install the three-phase bypass cables (30a, 30b, 30c) on the ground when crossing a road. The apparatus for installing a column of a bypass cable of the present invention solves a problem of an abnormal method through the development of the hanger (60) and a column installation method. The apparatus for installing a column of a bypass cable of the present invention prevents an accident such as a collision due to contact electric shock and incomplete fixing of other facilities (a suspension wire, etc.), and reduces a burden on the development of new materials and manufacturing costs by maximally utilizing existing materials.

title_en: An inverter heat dissipation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power generation equipment, it discloses an inverter heat dissipation system. Including a detection module, it is used for detecting the running state of the inverter; a vibration device, it is used for vibrating the dust-proof net of the inverter box; a cooling fan, it is used to forward rotation or backward rotation according to the running state of the inverter; an acquisition module, it is used to obtain the operating temperature of the inverter. The present invention can effectively reduce the dust accumulation of the dust-proof net in the inverter box through the vibration device, it can reduce the operating temperature of the inverter through the cooling fan, it can improve the service life of the inverter and change the working environment of the inverter.

title_en: Bridge inverter
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electrical engineering, in particular to inverters made on the basis of transistors.The bridge inverter comprises a voltage terminal (U), connected to the positive pole of a capacitor (C1), to the middle terminal of a power transformer (Tr), consisting of two identical windings (W1, W2), and to the input of a power supply (1), the output of which is connected to the inputs of a pulse generator (2) and of drivers (3, 4), at the same time the outputs of the pulse generator (2) are connected, respectively, to the inputs of the drivers (3, 4), a voltage terminal (2U), connected to the positive pole of a capacitor (C2) and to the drains of field-effect transistors (Q1, Q2), at the same time the lower lead of the power supply is connected to the lower lead of the pulse generator (2), the lower leads of the drivers (3, 4), one of the outputs of the drivers (3, 4), sources of field-effect transistors (Q3, Q4), negative poles of the capacitors (C1, C2 ) and to a common terminal (COM). The drain of the field-effect transistor (Q3) is connected to the lead of the winding (W2), one output of the driver (4) and to the source of the field-effect transistor (Q2), and the drain of the field-effect transistor (Q4) is connected to the lead of the winding (W1), one output of the driver (3) and to the source of the field-effect transistor (Q1). At the same time, the other two outputs of the driver (3) are connected to the gate of the field-effect transistor (Q1) and the gate of the field-effect transistor (Q3), respectively, and the other two outputs of the driver (4) are connected to the gate of the field-effect transistor (Q2) and the gate of the field-effect transistor (Q4), respectively.

title_en: Well intervention apparatus and method.
abstract_en: Well intervention apparatus comprising a flexible hose (2) to be lowered into a well, a stuffing seal (12) which engages around the hose (2) during lowering, at least one tool (28, 30, 32) provided at a downhole end portion of the hose (2), and a plurality of individual tubes (38, 40, 42) extending along an inside region of the hose (2) and connecting to the at least one tool (28, 30, 32), each individual tube (38, 40, 42) providing a fluid path for fluid communication between outside of the well and the at least one tool (28, 30, 32) inside the well, and each individual tube being laterally supported in said inside region such that its lateral movement is restricted.

title_en: Commissioning load control systems.
abstract_en: A load control system may include control devices for controlling power provided to an electrical load. The control devices may include a control-source device and a control-target device. The control-target device may control the power provided to the electrical load based on digital messages received from the control-source device. The control devices may include a load control discovery device capable of sending discovery messages configured to discover control devices within a location. The discovered control devices may be organized by signal strength and may be provided to a network device to enable association of the discovered control devices within a location. The discovery messages may be transmitted within an established discovery range. The discovery range may be adjusted to discover different control devices. Different control devices may be identified as the load control discovery device for discovering different control devices.

title_en: Operating lamp
abstract_en: An operating lamp (1) comprises a lamp body (4) comprising a central region (10a) and an annular region (10b) extending around said central region (10a); at least a first light source (15a); at least a second light source (15b); a heat sink (12); at least one first type reflector (20) configured to reflect a first light beam (F1) emitted by said at least a first light source (15a) and to focus said first light beam (F1) along a first light axis (A1); at least one second reflector (22) configured to reflect a second light beam (F2) emitted by said at least one second light source (15b) and to focus said second light beam along a second light axis (A2); wherein said at least one first light source (15a) and at least one second light source (15b) are selectively activatable, wherein said at least one first light source (15a), at least one second light source (15b) and heat sink (12) are arranged in said central region (10a), and wherein said at least one first type reflector (20) and at least one second type reflector (22) are arranged in said annular region (10b).

title_en: System for internal energy and power generation, especially self-powered motor-generator system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an energy and power generation system, especially self-powered motor and generator/alternator set-up. The system has at least one upsized drive shaft adapted as one of the main elements thereof comprising an upsized main body of non-typical size having substantially and proportionately enlarged diameter and/or length based on typical standard drive shaft sizes normally and correspondingly adapted for power generation systems or devices of commensurate capacity ratings, preferably motor-generator system, generator or alternator, or electric motor. When in inertial rotation, the upsized shaft inertially produces/generates and adds input power/energy to the subsequent electrical input power/energy derived from the motor resulting in an overall input power/energy that is efficiently converted/transformed by the generator/alternator into electrical output power/energy that is greater than the electrical input power/energy supplied to the motor. The excess useful electrical output power/energy is used for other loads and/or charging/recharging a power source or battery pack that is used to initially start up the motor.

title_en: Process for metallic covering meant for photovoltaic panels and apparatus for their optimization
abstract_en: The invention relates to a process for manufacturing a metallic covering for photovoltaic panels and to an apparatus for cleaning the panels. According to the invention, the apparatus comprises two rails with racks (3), two gear wheels (5) driven by a motor, mounted on the lateral ends of a photovoltaic panel (2) placed on a metal cover (4) and fixed at the top in a sheet metal strip, by means of clamps (1), and a cleaning device (6), which moves on the two rails with racks (3) operated by an electric motor, the apparatus being equipped with an upper travel limiter (8), which, when touched by the cleaning device (6), reverses the direction of rotation of the electric motor making the cleaning device (6) move until it meets a lower travel limiter (8), the cleaning device being triggered automatically by a microcontroller (17).

title_en: Ac-to-dc converter
abstract_en:
FIELD: electrical engineering. 
     SUBSTANCE: invention relates to AC to DC voltage converters that can be used in secondary power supply systems for power factor correction, converting, regulating and stabilizing a DC output voltage. The device contains a control key (3) implemented in the form of an anti-series connection of field-effect transistors (MOSFET), the control electrodes of which are combined into a common point connected to the control circuit (10). Power transformer (2), the primary winding (1) of which is connected to an AC voltage source through a control key (3), and the secondary winding (4) through rectifier diodes (5, 8) is connected to the filter capacitors (6, 7) connected in series parallel to which the load (9) is connected. In the proposed AC-to-DC converter, the beginning of the primary winding (1) of the transformer (2) is connected to the first pole of the input AC voltage source, and the end of the primary winding (1) is connected to the second pole of the input AC voltage source through a controlled counter-serial key (3). With the beginning of the secondary winding (4) of the transformer (2), the anode of the rectifier diode (5) is connected, the cathode of which is connected to one of the terminals of the capacitor (6). The second terminal of the capacitor (6) is connected to the winding end (4). The winding end (4) is connected to one of the terminals of the capacitor (7), the second terminal of which is connected to the anode of the rectifier diode (8), the cathode of which is connected to the beginning of the winding (4). A load (9) is connected in parallel with the capacitors (6) and (7) connected in series. 
     EFFECT: formation of a constant output voltage from an alternating input voltage, the implementation of galvanic isolation between the input and output circuits, the combination of the control circuit of counter-serial controlled switches, the improvement of the performance of the power factor corrector, the simplification of the control circuit. 
     2 cl, 2 dwg

title_en: Thermal regulator, substrate processing apparatus, and method of controlling temperature of stage
abstract_en: A thermal regulator for controlling temperature of a substantially circular stage comprising a plurality of first segments and a plurality of second segments in a radial direction and in a circumferential direction, each of the first segments and at least two adjacent second segments defining a set of segments, the thermal regulator includes heaters disposed in the first and second segments, respectively, thermal sensors disposed in the first segments, respectively, a controller configured to control the heaters in response to temperatures determined by the thermal sensors, and a segment switch to switch the second segments to be controlled in conjunction with the first segment in each set of segments.

title_en: Optical laminate and display device capable of suppressing bubble generation in an adhesive agent layer during bending
abstract_en: This invention provides an optical laminate capable of suppressing bubble generation in an adhesive agent layer during bending and a display device comprising the optical laminate. This invention provides an optical laminate, comprising a front surface panel, a first adhesive agent layer, a polarizing plate, a second adhesive agent layer, and a back plate in this order. When the slope from the origin to the maximum stress value in the stress [Pa]-strain [%] curve of the first adhesive agent layer and the second adhesive agent at a temperature of 60 degree Celsius and a humidity of 90%RH are respectively set as G.sub.L1' and G.sub.L2', the following equation (1) and equation (2): 70 ≤G.sub.L1' ≤250 (1) and 70 ≤G.sub.L2' ≤250 (2) can be satisfied.

title_en: Light source device and instant uniformity monitoring system for a light source device
abstract_en: This disclose provides a light source device. The light source device includes a light source unit; a light guide plate including a light incident surface and a light emitting surface, the light incident surface is disposed in a light emitting direction of the light source; and at least one light uniform plate, the uniform light plate The light plate is disposed facing the light emitting surface of the light guide plate; the at least one light uniforming plate includes a light receiving surface facing the light emitting surface, the light receiving surface defines a plurality of partitions, and each partition is provided with a photosensitive element. The invention also relates to an instant uniformity monitoring system for a light source device.

title_en: Method of etching film on substrate
abstract_en: Methods of an etching film on a substrate are disclosed. In some embodiments, the method comprising a plurality of etching cycles, each etching cycle comprising: exposing the substrate to a first vapor-phase non-metal oxyhalide reactant; and moving the substrate to remove excess first vapor-phase non-metal oxyhalide halide reactant and byproducts from the vicinity of the substrate, wherein the substrate is not contacted with a plasma reactant during the etching cycle.

title_en: Multi-beam microscope and method for operating a multi-beam microscope using settings adjusted to an inspection site
abstract_en: Multi-beam effects which reduce the accuracy, or the speed of a wafer inspection are corrected dependent on an inspection position using an improved multi-beam system and an improved wafer inspection method using the multi-beam system. To this end, the improved multi-beam system comprises means for influencing and homogenising an extraction field dependent on the inspection position, for example dependent on a distance from a wafer edge.

title_en: Photovoltaic junction box
abstract_en: The present application discloses a photovoltaic junction box, comprising: a box body having an accommodating portion and a fixing portion, the accommodating portion having an accommodating slot, and the fixing portion having a fixing slot, a first wire slot, a first groove and a first fixing column. The accommodating slot and the fixing slot communicate with each other. The first wire slot is arranged at the slot bottom of the fixing slot. The first groove is arranged at the slot bottom of the first wire slot. The first fixing column is arranged at the first slot. The first fixing column is arranged at the bottom of the first slot. One end of first fixing column protrudes from the bottom of the first wire groove. The electrical component is arranged in the accommodating slot. The fixing piece has a second wire groove, a second groove and a second fixing column. The second groove is arranged at the bottom of the groove of the second wire groove. One end of the second fixing column protrudes from the bottom of the second wire groove. The fixing piece is embedded in the fixing groove. The first wire groove corresponds to the second wire groove. One end of the cable is connected to the electrical component by passing between the first wire slot and the second wire slot. The first fixing post and the second fixing post are against the surface of the cable.

title_en: Discharge lamp and method for producing discharge lamp
abstract_en: The present invention provides a discharge lamp and a method of manufacturing the discharge lamp. In a short arc discharge lamp or the like, a mounting member is sealed without generating wrinkles orthe like in a metal foil. A plurality of metal foils (36) are disposed on the outer surface of a columnar glass member (34) in the lamp axis direction. A discharge lamp (10) is obtained by welding a metal foil (36) to the outer peripheral surface (26S) of an inner metal ring (26) connected to an electrode support rod (22). An annular crimping member (50) presses the metal foil (36) toward the center side of the inner metal ring (glass member) on and near the outer peripheral surface (26S) of the inner metal ring (26), thereby fastening the metal foil (36).

title_en: Secondary battery positive electrode and secondary battery
abstract_en: A positive electrode (11) has a positive electrode first area (30) positioned at one end portion (11a) side of the positive electrode in a short direction, and a positive electrode second area (32), which is an area from a positive electrode central end portion (30a) of the positive electrode first area (30) to another end portion (11b) in the short direction. The positive electrode (11) is characterized in that: the positive electrode first area (30) has an uncoated portion (30b) at which a positive electrode mixture layer is not disposed on a positive electrode core body, and a first area coated portion (30c) at which the positive electrode mixture layer is disposed on the positive electrode core body; the positive electrode second area (32) has a second area coated portion (32a) at which the positive electrode mixture layer is disposed on the positive electrode core body; and a mass per unit area of the positive electrode mixture layer in the first area coated portion (30c) is at least 4% greater than the mass per unit area of the positive electrode mixture layer in the second area coated portion (32a).

title_en: Low-voltage three-phase alternating current wireless power monitoring module has low cost and faster transmission speed in electrical parameter
abstract_en: The invention relates to a low-voltage three-phase alternating current wireless power monitoring module. Its working process includes that several voltage and current sensors sense the analog signals of the voltage and current of the three-phase alternating current, and then two analog-to-digital converters convert the analog signals into the Inter-Integrated Circuit (I2C) digital signals and transmit them to the MCU in the WiFi module to calculate the electrical parameter data such as the instantaneous electric power, accumulated electric energy, power factor, frequency or their combination, and then forward them through the WiFi unit wireless communication network, thereby remotely monitoring the condition of power generation or usage.

title_en: Current control module, and battery and electronic device having the same
abstract_en: The invention provides a current control module with a shortened current path. The current control module 10 of the invention comprises: a multilayer circuit board 100, a switching element 200 embedded in the multilayer circuit board 100, an external terminal 331 connected to a current port P1 of the switching element 200 and exposed on one surface 101 of the multilayer circuit board 100, and an external terminal 382 connected to a current port P2 of the switching element 200 and exposed on the other surface 102 of the multilayer circuit board 100.

title_en: Fan wheel and fluid driving part with the fan wheel
abstract_en: A fan wheel is used to solve the problem of contact between magnet and non-conductive liquid. Includes: a fan wheel body with a hub, and several fan blades arranged around the hub. The fan wheel body has a permanent magnet, and the permanent magnet is combined with the hub, so that the permanent magnet has a surface that is not in contact with the hub. The exposed part; and an insulating film covering at least the exposed part of the permanent magnet. This allows the non-conductive liquid to maintain better quality and efficacy.

title_en: Plasma equipment for treating exhaust gas of semiconductor manufacturing facility
abstract_en: According to the present invention, there is provided plasma equipment for treating an exhaust gas of a semiconductor manufacturing facility, as equipment which treats the exhaust gas discharged from a semiconductor process chamber in which a semiconductor manufacturing process using process gases is to be performed, through a chamber exhaust pipe for connecting the semiconductor process chamber to a vacuum pump, by using the vacuum pump, the plasma equipment including an exhaust pipe plasma reactor, which is installed on the chamber exhaust pipe, generates plasma in the exhaust gas and removes ingredients to be removed, contained in the exhaust gas, a remote plasma reactor, which generates plasma, decomposes a remote plasma source gas and generates remote plasma including remote reactive species, a public power supply unit, which produces alternating current power required for an operation of the exhaust pipe plasma reactor and the remote plasma reactor, and a power distributor, which distributes the alternating current power produced by the public power supply unit and supplies the distributed alternating current power to the exhaust pipe plasma reactor and the remote plasma reactor, respectively.

title_en: Surface modified depth controlled deposition for plasma based deposition
abstract_en: A method for performing gap fill of a feature on a substrate includes the following operations: (a) moving the substrate into a process chamber; (b) performing a plurality of cycles of an ALD process; (c) purging process gases from the ALD process from the process chamber; (d) performing a plasma treatment on the substrate by introducing a fluorine-containing gas into the process chamber and applying RF power to the fluorine-containing gas to generate a fluorine plasma in the process chamber; (e) purging process gases from the plasma treatment from the process chamber; (f) repeating operations (b) through (e) until a predefined number of cycles has been performed.

title_en: Vehicle composition, slurry composition, and electronic component
abstract_en: The present invention provides a vehicle composition which can be decomposed at a low temperature, has particularly excellent dispersibility of fine inorganic particles, and can produce an electronic component having excellent characteristics. Moreover, the present invention provides: a slurry composition comprising said vehicle composition; and an electronic component obtained using said slurry composition. The present invention pertains to a vehicle composition comprising a (meth)acrylic resin and an organic solvent, wherein: the organic solvent includes a terpene-based organic solvent and an organic solvent A; the organic solvent A has a boiling point of at most 130 DEG C under normal pressure; and the content of the organic solvent A is 0.01-10 wt% in 100 wt% of the organic solvent.

title_en: Pecvd silicon nitride trench bottom profile control with pulsed dual rf frequency plasma
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to an apparatus and method utilized in the manufacture of semiconductor devices. In one embodiment, a method of forming a layer, including positioning a substrate in a processing chamber; introducing at least one precursor gas into the processing chamber; generating a dual RF plasma with the at least one precursor gas by pulsing a first RF power source and a second RF power source, the first RF power source and the second RF power source having different frequencies; depositing a layer on the substrate with the dual RF plasma; introducing at least one additional precursor gas into the processing chamber; generating an etching plasma by applying the first RF power source to the at least one additional precursor gas; and etching the layer with the etching plasma.

title_en: Power converter
abstract_en: A power converter is provided. A driving circuit is connected between a control circuit and a switch circuit. The switch circuit is connected to an inductor. The inductor is connected in series with a first capacitor and is grounded through the first capacitor. The first comparison input terminal of the first comparator is connected to an output terminal between the inductor and the first capacitor. The second comparison input terminal of the first comparator is grounded through a second capacitor. The control circuit outputs a control signal for controlling the driving circuit to drive the switch circuit according to a comparison signal outputted by the first comparator. A reference current source provides a reference current to the second capacitor. A first terminal of a first resistor is connected to the second capacitor. A second terminal of the first resistor is coupled to a reference potential.

title_en: Transformer
abstract_en: The present disclosure is related to a transformer. The transformer includes a core group, a first coil and a second coil. The core group includes two external portions and a middle portion. The middle portion is located between the two external portions. The middle portion has an upper section, a middle section and a lower section. Each of the upper section and the lower section has a first gap between one of the two external portions. The middle section has a second gap between one of the two external portions. The first gap is different from the second gap. The first coil surrounds the lower section of the middle portion. The second coil surrounds the upper section of the middle portion.

title_en: Electrical connector
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides an electrical connector. The electrical connector comprises a connector body, a cable, a connector housing, a limit piece, and a housing. The connector body has a plug-in side and a connection side. One end of the cable is electrically connected to the connector body, and the other end of the cable passes through the connection side of the connector body. The connector housing is deposed on one side of the connector body, and the cable passes through the side of the connector housing close to the connection side. The limit piece is deposed on the side of the connector housing close to the plug-in side. The plug-in side of the connector body is located in the housing. The limit piece is deposed on the side of the connector housing close to the plug-in side. The connector housing is assembled to the housing through the cooperation of the limit piece and the housing, realizing the function of positioning the connector body on the housing, and effectively improving the overall assembly accuracy.

title_en: Electronic device and grounding assembly thereof
abstract_en:
An electronic device and a grounding assembly thereof are disclosed. The electronic device comprises a casing, a circuit board and a grounding assembly. The casing has a receptacle. The circuit board is disposed within the receptacle and has a first surface and a second surface, an input terminal and an output terminal are disposed on the second surface. The grounding assembly comprises a guiding terminal, a first grounding element and a second grounding element, the guiding terminal is disposed on the first surface of the circuit board, and the first grounding 
element is disposed adjacent to the guiding terminal. The first grounding element penetrates the circuit board and electrically couples with the guiding terminal and the casing. The second grounding element correspondingly penetrates the circuit board and the guiding element, wherein a first portion of the second grounding element electrically couples with the input terminal and the output terminal of the circuit board, and a second portion of the second grounding element electrically couples with the guiding terminal.

title_en: Fan motor
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a fan motor that includes a housing, a stator assembly installed inside the housing, a rotor assembly rotatably mounted inside the stator assembly, an impeller configured to generate a flow of air by receiving power from the rotor assembly, a first housing cover installed on one side of the housing and provided therein with a first bearing, a second housing cover installed on another side of the housing and provided therein with a second bearing, and a vane installed at a lower portion of the second housing cover to guide flowing of air introduced from the second housing cover. The impeller is configured as a diagonal flow type and the second housing cover is configured as an axial flow type, thereby allowing the impeller and the second housing cover to be arranged vertically.

title_en: Systems and methods for nitride-containing film removal
abstract_en: Exemplary etching methods may include flowing an oxygen-containing precursor into a remote plasma region of a semiconductor processing chamber while striking a plasma to produce oxygen plasma effluents. The methods may include contacting a substrate housed in a processing region with the oxygen plasma effluents. The substrate may define an exposed region of titanium nitride. The contacting may produce an oxidized surface on the titanium nitride. The methods may include flowing a halogen-containing precursor into a remote plasma region of a semiconductor processing chamber while striking a plasma to produce halogen plasma effluents. The methods may include contacting the oxidized surface on the titanium nitride with the halogen plasma effluents. The methods may include removing the oxidized surface on the titanium nitride.

title_en: Process chamber lid and processing method for high temperature chemical vapor deposition
abstract_en: Process chamber lids, processing chambers and methods using the lids are described. The lid includes a pumping liner with a showerhead, blocker plate and gas funnel positioned therein. A liner heater is positioned on the pumping liner to control temperature in the pumping liner. Gas is flowed into the gas funnel using a dead-volume free one-way valve with a remote plasma source.

title_en: Plasma processing apparatus
abstract_en: A plasma processing apparatus includes a plasma processing chamber; a substrate support disposed in the plasma processing chamber and including an electrostatic chuck; a first ring disposed on the electrostatic chuck to surround a substrate on the electrostatic chuck and including an inner annular portion, an intermediate annular portion, and an outer annular portion, a top surface of the inner annular portion being higher than that of the intermediate annular portion, a top surface of the outer annular portion being higher than that of the inner annular portion; a second ring disposed on the intermediate annular portion; and an actuator configured to vertically move the second ring to maintain a top surface of the second ring at a first height greater than a height of the top surface of the inner annular portion and less than a height of the top surface of the outer annular portion.

title_en: Connector assembly and its main-side connector and secondary-side connector
abstract_en: A connector assembly and its main-side connector and secondary-side connector are provided. The main-side connector and the secondary-side connector have a guided insertion structure that ensures the alignment of conductive terminals. They also feature a latching structure that maintains the engagement of the conductive terminals, thereby improving the reliability of signal transmission for the connector assembly and meeting the signal transmission requirements of electronic devices. Additionally, the main-side connector may optionally include a waterproof seal to protect the electrical characteristics of the connector assembly from the influence of water.

title_en: Receiving device and transmission system
abstract_en: A receiving device for a transmission system includes a demodulation module, configured to receive a modulated signal through a digital isolator of the transmission system and demodulate the modulated signal into a demodulated signal; a comparator, coupled to the demodulation module, configured to compare a signal component of the demodulated signal with a dynamic threshold voltage to generate an output logic signal; and a threshold voltage adjustment module, coupled to the demodulation module and the comparator, configured to determine a peak voltage level and a common-mode voltage level of the demodulated signal, and dynamically determine the dynamic threshold voltage based on the peak voltage level and the common-mode voltage level; wherein the dynamic threshold voltage is an average level of the peak voltage level and the common-mode voltage level.

title_en: Power connector with integrated status monitoring
abstract_en: An electronic power connector. The electronic power connector includes at least one contact configured to electrically connect a power supply to a load, an insulating sleeve, and an electronic assembly. The insulating sleeve includes a sensor slot configured to receive a sensor and is configured to receive the at least one contact. The electronic assembly including a transformer winding configured to receive the at least one contact and sense a current.

title_en: Lighting fixture with high structural integrity
abstract_en: Tenon-mounted lighting fixtures with high structural integrity are provided. In one embodiment, the lighting fixture has a housing that has an integrally formed tenon cradle, which is configured to receive a tenon of a light pole. A light source is also mounted on a bottom side of the housing. The tenon cradle is between a first bolt boss and a second bolt boss, and is in communication with a rear opening of the housing. The first and second bolt bosses may be integrally formed in the housing. The tenon cradle includes multiple ribs. An arcuate cross rib resides in a first plane in which a first bolt shaft of the first bolt boss and a second bolt shaft of the second bolt shaft reside. An axial rib intersects the arcuate cross rib and runs perpendicular to the first plane.

title_en: Separator for rechargeable lithium battery and rechargeable lithium battery including same
abstract_en: A separator for a rechargeable lithium battery includes a porous layer; an inorganic layer including inorganic particles and formed on at least one surface of the porous layer; and a resin layer formed on the inorganic layer, wherein the resin of the resin layer penetrates between the inorganic particles on the surface of the inorganic layer, and the inorganic layer is integrated with the resin layer. A rechargeable lithium battery including the same is also provided.

title_en: Power converter module
abstract_en: A power conversion system comprises a plurality of power converter modules, each including a bi-directional DC to DC converter and a current controller, wherein the bi-directional DC to DC converter is connected to the current controller, for charging or discharging a DC power source according to a distribution command received from the current controller, and a voltage controller, connecting to the plurality of power converter modules, for generating a current command to the current controller, wherein the voltage controller generates a current command to the current controller of the power converter module according to the detected capacity and voltage of the DC power source, whereby the current controller generates the distribution command to the bi-directional DC to DC converter with the received current command.

title_en: Kinetic energy recovery system with flywheel
abstract_en: A kinetic energy recovery system with flywheel includes a flywheel doubly-fed electric machine, an electric motor, a drive circuit and a controller. The flywheel doubly-fed electric machine has a primary side coil and a secondary side coil. The electric motor has a phase coil connected in series with the primary side coil. The drive circuit has an AC/DC circuit and a DC/AC circuit, wherein the AC end of the AC/DC circuit is coupled to the primary side coil; the AC end of the DC/AC circuit is coupled to the secondary side coil. The controller is configured to manipulate a frequency and a phase of output voltage and output current of the secondary side coil, thereby controlling the frequency and phase of a voltage and a current output from the primary side coil, thereby recovering a kinetic energy of the electric motor or providing the kinetic energy to the electric motor.

title_en: Microwave cooking package
abstract_en: Microwave cooking packages suitable for use as microwave popcorn packages include at least one panel (e.g., first and second panels) formed of a vertically rigid material. A flexible portion is attached to the panels. The flexible portion may be formed of a polyester film material such as a biaxially-oriented polyethylene terephthalate (PET) film, which may be at least partially transparent. The flexible portion (and panels) defines a bag construction configured to contain a popcorn charge and to be expandable between a collapsed configuration and an expanded configuration when the popcorn charge is subjected to a popping operation. The microwave cooking package may include a vent assembly configured to at least partially open when the bag configuration is in an expanded configuration to vent the bag construction. The vent assembly includes a first portion a second portion of the bag construction that is configured to be folded against the first portion.

title_en: Stop control method for fuel cell system
abstract_en: A stop control method for a fuel cell system of a vehicle can include: determining whether a fuel cell of the fuel cell system is shut down when a key-off signal is received; comparing a voltage of the fuel cell with a first set voltage when it is determined that the fuel cell is not shut down; controlling a voltage of a high-voltage terminal downwardly when the voltage of the fuel cell is larger than the first set voltage; turning on a cathode oxygen depletion (COD) relay a first time after controlling the voltage of the high-voltage terminal downwardly; turning off a high-voltage terminal relay a first time after turning on the COD relay, the high-voltage relay disposed between the fuel cell and the high-voltage terminal; and shutting down the fuel cell and performing key-off control after turning off the high-voltage terminal relay.

title_en: Battery holder for a vehicle
abstract_en: The disclosure comprises a battery holder for receiving at least one electric battery in a vehicle that includes a hollow chamber profile with a hollow chamber that is defined by a base wall and a cover wall, where the electric battery is configured for placement on the cover wall. The battery holder also includes a heat exchanger structure configured for tempering the electric battery, where the heat exchanger structure is formed within a cover wall section of the cover wall and includes at least one hollow channel that intersperses the cover wall.

title_en: Fuel cell unit
abstract_en: The fuel cell unit includes: a fuel cell stack; a cell monitor configured to detect voltage or current of the fuel cell stack; wire harness configured to connect the fuel cell stack and the cell monitor to each other; a power conversion unit configured to include a switching element and to perform conversion of output power of the fuel cell stack or conversion of supplied power to auxiliary machines used for operation of the fuel cell stack by using the switching element; and a bulkhead part that is made of metal and is configured to partition the wire harness and the power conversion unit from each other, the bulkhead part being grounded, wherein the wire harness and the power conversion unit are placed next to each other with the bulkhead part interposed therebetween. Thus, it becomes implementable to downsize the fuel cell unit while satisfying both the prevention of physical contact between the wire harness and the power conversion unit and the suppression of influences of switching noise on analog data.

title_en: Fibrous carbon nanostructure dispersion liquid
abstract_en: A fibrous carbon nanostructure dispersion liquid having excellent dispersibility of fibrous carbon nanostructures is provided. A fibrous carbon nanostructure dispersion liquid comprises: fibrous carbon nanostructures with a tap density of 0.024 g/cm 3  or less; and a solvent.

title_en: Rotor, motor, and air conditioning apparatus
abstract_en: A rotor includes a shaft extending in the direction of an axis, and a rotor core including a central hole in which the shaft is inserted. The central hole includes a first central hole, a second central hole, and a third central hole in the direction of the axis. A distance from the axis to an inner circumferential surface of the third central hole is larger than a distance from the axis to an inner circumferential surface of the second central hole. The distance from the axis to the inner circumferential surface of the second central hole is larger than a distance from the axis to an inner circumferential surface of the first central hole.

title_en: Fuse pad, printed circuit board having the fuse pad, and method of the printed circuit board
abstract_en: Disclosed are a fuse pad, a printed circuit board having the fuse pad, and a method of manufacturing the printed circuit board. The fuse pad includes a first pad provided at one side of a fuse, a second pad provided at an opposite side of the fuse, and a measurement pad electrically connected to the second pad to measure whether the fuse is detached.

title_en: Stack-type stator using multi-layer substrate, slim motor using same, and blower for air purification system
abstract_en: Provided are a stack-type stator having coil patterns patterned on a multi-layer substrate, and a motor and a blower for an air purification system using the stator. A stack-type stator includes: a multi-layer substrate having first through holes; coil patterns formed on the respective substrates of the multi-layer substrate and spirally patterned to surround the first through holes and to form a plurality of turns; a stator yoke disposed at a lower portion of the multi-layer substrate and having second through holes at positions corresponding to the first through holes; and divided cores each having one side protruding above the coil patterns formed on the uppermost layer of the multi-layer substrate and the other side being coupled to one of the second through holes through one of the first through holes.

title_en: Power distribution system for DC network
abstract_en: A power distribution system for a DC network, the DC network comprising electrical loads, the power distribution system being boarded on an aircraft and comprising: a plurality of AC/DC converters, and at least one AC power source. The power distribution system comprises: an “n” number of AC/DC converters, each one comprising an “(n−1)” number of first outputs and at least an additional output, and an “(n−1)·n” number of electrical loads. Each electrical load comprises two inputs: a first input for being connected with a corresponding first output, and a second input for being connected with any of the additional outputs. The power distribution system is configured to continue supplying electrical power to the DC network in case an AC/DC converter is not energized, such that the second input of such electrical load is connected to any additional output of another AC/DC converter, being the first input disconnected.

title_en: Metal panel electrical bonding clip
abstract_en: A clip for electrically bonding a pair of adjacently-disposed metal panels is disclosed. One embodiment entails such a clip ( 104 ) including a first clip member ( 112 ) and an oppositely disposed second clip member ( 116 ). The surface ( 114 ) of the first clip member ( 112 ) that faces the second clip member ( 116 ) includes at least one grounding projection ( 128 ), while the surface ( 118 ) of the second clip member ( 116 ) that faces the first clip member ( 112 ) also includes at least one grounding projection ( 128 ). The clip ( 104 ) may be installed on a standing seam ( 102 ) of a panel assembly ( 100 ), with its first clip member ( 112 ) engaging one of the metal panels  82 ″ that define this stand seam ( 102 ) and with its second clip member ( 116 ) engaging the other of the metal panels  82 ″ that define this same standing seam ( 102 ).

title_en: Devices for limiting switch positions for electrical devices
abstract_en: A device for limiting movement of an operator of at least one switch of a light fixture can include a body. The device can also include at least one fixture coupling feature disposed on the body, where the at least one fixture coupling feature is configured to couple to at least one device coupling feature of the light fixture. The body, when coupled to the light fixture, can be configured to limit the movement of a first operator of a first switch of the at least one switch.

title_en: Concentrator photovoltaic module, concentrator photovoltaic panel, and concentrator photovoltaic apparatus
