dequantizing and inverse-transforming the bitstream, so as to obtain a decoded 
image; and reconstructing the decoded image into a 360-degree image according to 
a projection format. Here, the step of generating the prediction image comprises the 
steps of: obtaining, from motion information included in the syntax information, a 
motion vector candidate group including a motion vector of a block adjacent to a 
current block to be decoded; deriving a prediction motion vector from the motion 
vector candidate group, on the basis of selection information extracted from the 
motion information; and determining a prediction block for the current block to be 
decoded, using a fmal motion vector derived by adding the prediction motion vector 
to a differential motion vector extracted from the motion information.

title_en: Call noise cancellation methods and headphones
abstract_en: The present application relates to noise reduction methods and an earphone. The methods may be applied to telephone calls to reduce wind noise interference. A method comprises: determining energy of a first voice signal received by a first microphone, and determining energy of a second voice signal received by a second microphone. The method further comprises determining, based on whether a difference between the energy of the first voice signal and the energy of the second voice signal is greater than a preset threshold, one of the first voice signal or the second voice signal as a target voice signal. In addition, the method comprises performing wind noise reduction processing on the target voice signal.

title_en: Light field projectors and methods
abstract_en: Undesirably high energy-consumption in illuminating devices can be caused at least in part by wasted (attenuated) light. Optically efficient illumination systems that may be used to project light, including images, use light redirection. Phase modulating devices may be applied to create desired light fields. Some embodiments provide dual or multiple modulation display or projection systems in which some or all of the modulators not only attenuate amplitude, but also amplify amplitude, or change the phase, frequency and polarization of the light provided by the light source.

title_en: Rights management and syndication of content
abstract_en: Systems, devices, and methods are described herein for distributing syndicated content or content with one or more distribution restrictions. In one aspect, a method may include assigning a unique ID to a plurality of content items, where the unique ID of at least one of the content items is associated with one or more property distribution restrictions. The method may further include streaming in a video stream the content items to at least two properties and monitoring the unique IDs of the plurality of content items streamed in the video stream to detect least one content item associated with the one or more property distribution restrictions. The distribution of the least one content item associated with the one or more property distribution restrictions may be blocked from the one or more properties concurrently with streaming the video stream, based on the one or more property distribution restrictions.

title_en: Virtual parking lots
abstract_en: A central computing system is configured to monitor quotas for multiple different classifications of vehicles that park in a parking facility. License plate reading (LPR) cameras read the license information of each vehicle entering and exiting a parking facility. The vehicle images or identifications are communicated to the central computing system which updates its database and monitors each virtual lot in the parking facility according to quotas, prices and other parameters for each corresponding class of vehicles. Control gates can be provided at entrances and exits to the parking facility. A parking kiosk can be provided to the parking facility that is networked with the central computing system.

title_en: Mounts
abstract_en: A display wall mount, comprising a wall bracket for attachment to a wall or planar structure, the wall bracket comprising a planar back plate, side panels extending from respective opposing sides of the of the back plate, wherein at least one of the side panels includes a cam portion to receive a follower, the cam portion configured to translate motion of the follower relative and parallel to the back plate to perpendicular motion relative to the back plate.

title_en: Multiview backlight, mode-switchable backlight, and 2d/3d mode-switchable display
abstract_en: A multiview backlight and mode-switchable backlight employ a planar backlight to emit scattered light and light-blocking layer having a plurality of apertures to provide a plurality of directional light beams from the scattered light. The mode-switchable backlight further includes another planar backlight configured to provide diffuse light in a two-dimensional (2D) operational mode, the plurality of directional light beams being provided in a three-dimensional (3D) mode. A 2D/3D mode-switchable display includes the mode-switchable backlight and a light valve array. A method of backlight operation includes directing scattered light from a planar backlight toward a light-blocking layer having a plurality of apertures and providing a plurality of directional light beams using an aperture of the aperture plurality.

title_en: Selection of playback devices
abstract_en: Example techniques involve selection of playback devices within a media playback system for outputting a media stream based on user input. An example implementation involves a controller causing a plurality of first representations of at least some of a plurality of playback devices to be displayed on a first portion of a display. The controller causes a plurality of second representations of at least some of one or more groups playback devices to be displayed on a second portion of the display, each group having at least two associated playback devices of the plurality of playback devices. The controller receives an input indicative of a particular group of the one or more groups and adjusts a selected status of the particular group. The controller also determines which playback devices are associated with the particular group, and adjusts a selected status of the playback devices that associated with the particular group.

title_en: Method and systems for optimized content encoding
abstract_en: An encoder (e.g., a Versatile Video Coding (VVC) encoder, etc.) may make real-time encoding decisions to vary a bitrate of a content item (e.g., high-resolution video, streaming content, a movie, a show/program, etc.) by upsampling and/or downsampling portions (e.g., frames/slices, group of pictures (GOP), coding units (CU), coding tree units (CTU), etc.) based on a cost function that utilizes a versatile Lagrangian multiplier (denoted as 4 to denote the versatility). The versatile Lagrangian multiplier may not only account for the effects of quantization (e.g., a quantization parameter (QP), etc.) on portions of the content item, instead, the versatile Lagrangian multiplier may also be based on adjustment parameters associated with content resolution and/or playback quality of experience (QoE). The versatile Lagrangian multiplier enables a substantial decrease in transmission bitrate for portions of a content item without reducing the visual presentation quality and keeping an end-user quality of experience (QoE) at an optimal level.

title_en: Geometric partitioning mode in video coding
abstract_en: A method of video decoding including receiving a syntax element from a bitstream of a coded video associated with a current coding block that is partitioned into a first part and a second part along a partition edge for prediction in a geometric partitioning mode, and determining a weight index at a sample position of the current coding block. A stored motion vector type for a first motion storage unit in a motion field of the current coding block is determined based on a motion index of the first motion storage unit. The weight index at the sample position of the current coding block is used as the motion index of the first motion storage unit. The motion field of the current coding block can be stored based on the stored motion vector type determined for the first motion storage unit in the motion field of the current coding block.

title_en: Speaker-element and speaker comprising such a speaker-element
abstract_en: The invention relates to a speaker-element for a speaker, comprising two substantially mutually opposing spaced apart membrane planes, wherein each membrane plane comprises at least one electromagnetic wire arranged for creating a magnetic field upon an electric current passing through said electromagnetic wire, wherein at least one permanent magnet is arranged between the two membrane planes, wherein the electromagnet wires of the two membrane planes are connectable to an electric power source in such a manner, that the electric current passes there trough in substantially mutually opposing directions and thereby creating substantially mutually opposing magnetic fields, such that upon passing an electric current through the electromagnetic wire of each membrane plane said membrane planes are both either attracted towards or repulsed from the permanent magnet and thereby moved towards or away from each other, respectively, thereby producing a sound wave.

title_en: Digital pathology artificial intelligence quality check
abstract_en: Techniques of automated quality control for dig¬ ital pathology whole slide images are presented. The techniques include obtaining a thumbnail image derived from a whole slide image of a pathology slide; determining whether the whole slide image includes an artifact ina first class of artifacts by providing the thumbnail image to an electronic neural network trained to detect artifacts in the first class of artifacts by analyzing a plu¬ rality of labeled training thumbnail images; generating a tissue mask representing tissue depicted in the thumbnail image; deter¬ mining whether the whole slide image includes an artifact in a second class of artifacts by performing a comparison using the tissue mask; and providing an indication of whether the whole slide image includes an artifact in the first class of artifacts or an artifact in the second class of artifacts.

title_en: Electrical control device with multilayer shielding structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric control device with a multilayer shielding structure, which comprises a driving module, wherein the driving module comprises a driving module shielding shell and a driving module end cover, the driving module shielding shell is provided with a first opening, an assembly containing cavity and a second opening which are communicated with each other, the driving module end cover is covered at the second opening, the inner wall of the assembly containing cavity is convexly provided with a driving piece shielding shell, and the driving piece shielding shell partitions the assembly containing cavity into at least a first shielding cavity; and the control module comprises a control module end cover and a control module shielding shell which are mutually connected, the control module shielding shell is nested in the first shielding cavity, and the control module end cover is covered at the first opening. So through above-mentioned drive module shield shell, control module shield shell and drive piece shield shell formation inside and outside three-layer shielding structure that the stromatolite was arranged, can shield the control signal that the during operation was revealed completely in three-layer shielding structure to furthest's reduction is to the influence of antenna intermodulation, and then improves the intermodulation level of antenna product.

title_en: Image exposure compensation method and device and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an image exposure compensation method, an image exposure compensation device and a computer-readable storage medium, which can divide a shooting preview image into a plurality of exposure compensation sub-areas according to the pixel distribution characteristics of the shooting preview image in the image shooting process; acquiring exposure compensation parameters corresponding to each exposure compensation sub-area according to the pixel distribution characteristics of each exposure compensation sub-area; and respectively carrying out exposure compensation on the exposure compensation parameters according to the exposure compensation parameters corresponding to the exposure compensation sub-regions. Compared with the image global exposure compensation in the prior art, the image global exposure compensation method has the advantages that the exposure compensation subareas are divided according to the pixel distribution characteristics of the image, and the corresponding exposure compensation parameters are respectively arranged in each subarea, so that each exposure compensation subarea can obtain appropriate exposure compensation with different degrees, the possibility of occurrence of overexposure and underexposure is effectively reduced, the outline and the stereoscopic impression of the image are enhanced, the imaging quality of the image is improved, and the shooting experience of a user is improved.

title_en: Surrounding view monitoring system and method for vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method of illustrating the ground beneath a vehicle (10) using a surrounding field monitoring system (20). The surrounding view monitoring system (20) comprises at least one camera (21,22,23,24), a processing unit (100) and a display unit (140). The method comprises the following steps: at least one image is taken on the ground (21 ', 22', 23', 24') with at least one camera (21,22,23,24), the ground position relative to the vehicle (10) is tracked and the ground is visualized as an under-vehicle field of view and as a function of vehicle speed if the vehicle (10) moves over at least a portion of the ground (21 ', 22', 23', 24'). An ambience monitoring system is also provided.

title_en: Motor vehicle system with motion detection capability
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a motor vehicle system with motion detection capability. An automobile may be equipped with a camera for detecting movement of objects in the vicinity of the automobile. The camera may be used to capture a series of images. Several target sample points may be defined in each image. The location of the target sample point may correspond to the driver's blind spot or other region(s) of interest. The camera may also include separate filters for generating a long-term pixel intensity output and a short-term pixel intensity output at each of the target sample points. These long-term and short-term average outputs may be compared to determine whether a large change in intensity has occurred over a short period of time. The order of target activation may then be used to determine the direction of vehicle movement while filtering out noise or other road markings.

title_en: FPCB board, smart card and packaging method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an FPCB board, a smart card and a packaging method thereof, wherein a first component and a second component are arranged on the FPCB board, a through groove is formed in the FPCB board at the position of the second component, and the through groove is used for providing a deformation space when the second component and the first component are positioned on the smart card. The processing error between the two components is adjusted through the deformation, so that the two components on the FPCB board are positioned and fixed on the correct position of the smart card, the phenomenon that the two components are offset due to the production processing error, so that poor appearance or poor function of the smart card is caused is avoided, the appearance and function requirements of the components on the smart card are further ensured, and the yield of smart card production is improved.

title_en: Electronic equipment and heat dissipation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electronic device and a heat dissipation method thereof, wherein the heat dissipation method comprises the following steps: receiving a control instruction, wherein the control instruction is used for controlling the heat dissipation of the electronic equipment, and the electronic equipment is deformable equipment; responding to the control instruction, and determining a heat dissipation mode of the electronic equipment; and controlling the electronic equipment to deform based on the heat dissipation mode, wherein the deformation is matched with the heat dissipation mode.

title_en: Flexible electronic device with fluid chamber design
abstract_en: The present invention is a flexible display comprising a fluid chamber, a fluid within the fluid chamber, and a strain/stress sensitive module positioned within the fluid chamber. The strain/stress sensitive module includes a flexible substrate, a flexible encapsulation layer, and an OLED layer positioned between the flexible substrate and the flexible encapsulation layer.

title_en: Segmented video recording method and automobile data recorder
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for recording segmented videos and a vehicle event data recorder, wherein the method comprises the following steps: reading the 1 st frame data of the 1 st segmented video stored in advance after the recording time of the N-1 st segmented video is finished; the 1 st frame data carries video coding information; and recording the Nth segmented video according to the video coding information, wherein N is a positive integer greater than 1. In this way, except that the encoder needs to be configured when the video recording thread is started for the first time, each subsequent segmented video recording thread only reads the stored 1 st frame data, thereby avoiding the process of repeatedly carrying out the initialization configuration of the video coding information; therefore, the embodiment of the invention can effectively avoid the loss of video frames in the segmented video recording.

title_en: Waterproof shell structure of electronic product
abstract_en: The invention relates to a waterproof shell structure of an electronic product, which comprises a containing box, a water plugging mould and a top cover, wherein a first annular baffle, a second annular baffle and a third annular baffle are sequentially arranged at the top of the containing box from outside to inside, annular grooves are formed between the first annular baffle and the second annular baffle and between the second annular baffle and the third annular baffle, the water plugging mould is provided with two annular plugboards corresponding to the annular grooves, the outer wall of the annular plugboards is provided with a silica gel sealing layer, the annular plugboards are clamped in the annular grooves, a pressing block is connected to the center of the bottom of the water plugging mould, a first supporting block is connected to the periphery of the bottom of the pressing block through springs, the top cover is connected with the outer wall of the first annular baffle in a threaded manner, and a first annular water storage groove and a second annular water storage groove are respectively arranged on the top cover and the top cover.

title_en: Component carrier with integrated strain gauge
abstract_en: A component carrier (100) for carrying electronic components on and/or in the component carrier (100), wherein the component carrier (100) comprises an interconnected stack (102) of a plurality of electrically conductive layer structures (104) and a plurality of electrically insulating layer structures (106, 106'), wherein at least a part of at least one of the electrically conductive layer structures (104) is configured as at least a part of an integrated strain gauge (108) configured for detecting a strain exerted on at least a part of the component carrier (100).

title_en: Image stabilization apparatus, control method thereof, and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to an image stabilization apparatus, a control method thereof, and a storage medium. The image stabilization apparatus includes: a holding unit for holding the image pickup unit; a rotating unit for rotating the holding unit; a calculation unit that calculates a residual correction amount of the image blur after the image blur correction by the first image blur correction unit; a second image blur correction unit for correcting a residual correction amount of the image blur using a method different from that of the first image blur correction unit; and a changing unit that changes an allocation between a correctable range in which the second image blur correcting unit corrects the image blur in the horizontal or vertical direction on the image pickup surface and the correctable range of the second image blur correcting unit, based on a rotation angle of the rotating unit and a residual correction amount of the image blur.

title_en: Circuit board with double-row welding part and SMT and DIP structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a circuit board with double-row welding parts and an SMT and DIP structure, which can be used for welding and assembling a USB Type-C connector on the circuit board, wherein the top surface of the circuit board is provided with two rows of welding parts, and each row of welding parts respectively comprises a plurality of welding pins.

title_en: Rotating device for processing circuit board
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rotating equipment, in particular to a rotating device for processing a circuit board, which comprises a box body and a first motor, wherein the inner side of the left end surface of the box body is fixedly connected with the first motor, the tail end of a main shaft of the first motor is fixedly connected with a rotating disc, the left end of the rotating disc is fixedly connected with a fixed plate, the fixed plate is fixedly connected with the first motor, the right end of the fixed plate is fixedly connected with a fixed column, the inner side of the left end of the box body is rotatably connected with a rotating rod, the right end of the rotating rod is fixedly connected with a grooved pulley, the inner side of the grooved pulley is provided with a groove, the right end of the grooved pulley is fixedly connected with a shell, and the top end of the shell is fixedly connected with a second motor. Is worthy of popularization and application.

title_en: Switching method and device for video enhancement, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a video enhancement switching method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of electronic equipment. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: receiving a pressing operation acting on a video playing area in a video playing process; judging whether the pressing operation meets a preset condition or not; and if so, switching the video once between starting enhancement processing and canceling the enhancement processing. In the scheme, the video enhancement is switched between the starting and the canceling according to the pressing operation acting on the video, so that a user can start the video enhancement or cancel the video enhancement through the pressing operation, and the user experience is improved.

title_en: Information medium, method of manufacturing the same, method of verifying the same, and verification system
abstract_en: The present invention provides an information medium (100) having: a base (e.g., a peeling-disintegrating layer (10)) having an information code (20) that can be optically read; and a retro-reflective layer (30) that is located on a region of the base where the information code (20) is arranged and exhibits retro-reflection under retro-reflection conditions, wherein the information code (20) can be optically read through the retro-reflective layer (30) under non-retro-reflection conditions.

title_en: Speaker and electronic device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a loudspeaker and electronic equipment, wherein the loudspeaker comprises a loudspeaker monomer and a shell for accommodating the loudspeaker monomer, the shell is provided with a sound outlet, the outer surface of the shell is coated with elastic colloid, the elastic colloid is arranged along the sound outlet to be annular, and the elastic colloid is used for being in sealing abutting connection with the electronic equipment. The technical scheme of the invention can ensure the matching tightness of the loudspeaker and the whole machine.

title_en: Interaction method, medium and device for intelligent loudspeaker box and computing equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an interaction method for an intelligent sound box, which comprises the following steps: recognizing voice information input by a user to obtain a recognized sentence text; matching in a preset song word library based on the sentence text; and when the lyrics matched with the sentence text exist in the preset lyric library, playing the song corresponding to the matched lyrics. The method does not make any limitation and requirement on the input of the user, the intelligent sound box plays the song according to the situation associated with the voice information input by the user instead of playing the song according to the instruction of the user, the interaction mode that the intelligent sound box plays the song in response to the instruction of the fixed structure input by the user in the prior art is changed, namely the man-machine interaction mode that the user sends the instruction and the machine executes the instruction is changed, and the more natural and more interesting interaction process is realized. The embodiment of the invention also provides an interaction device, a medium and computing equipment for the intelligent loudspeaker box.

title_en: Sound output device
abstract_en: A sound output apparatus, a display apparatus and a control method thereof are provided. The sound output device includes: a housing; and at least one speaker disposed at one side of the housing, wherein the housing includes a receiving portion provided with a slot for inserting and mounting the at least one speaker, wherein the at least one speaker includes: a sound generator configured to generate sound; and a guide tube having the same cross-sectional area or a cross-sectional area varying from a first end of the guide tube to a second end of the guide tube, and wherein the guide tube receives the generated sound through the first end, and the guide tube includes an outer surface having a plurality of radiation holes arranged in at least one row.

title_en: Automatic focus adjusting method and device for ultrasonic image
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ultrasonic diagnostic equipment, and particularly discloses an automatic focus adjusting method of an ultrasonic image, wherein the method comprises the following steps: setting an initial proportion parameter according to an image parameter, wherein the image parameter comprises image depth, focal position depth and focal quantity; calculating the depth of the focus position corresponding to all the image depths according to the initial proportion parameters, and forming a mapping relation table corresponding to the image depths and the depth of the focus position; and when the image depth changes, acquiring the depth of the focus position corresponding to the current image depth according to the mapping relation table. The invention also discloses an automatic focus adjusting device of the ultrasonic image, which is used for medical diagnosis, such as breast detection and the like. The automatic focus adjusting method for the ultrasonic image solves the problem that the focus of the ultrasonic image in the prior art can not follow the depth change, meets the requirements of customers, and is simple and easy to realize.

title_en: Image compression sensing method based on graph model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an image compression sensing method based on a graph model. The invention comprises the following steps: 1: setting a QP factor, compressing the test image X to obtain an image X', and comparing the PSNR value of the compressed image with the PSNR value of the original image; 2: dividing the compressed picture X' into a plurality of overlapped small blocks, constructing a similar block group for each small block, and averaging; and step 3: each pixel in the compressed average block to be reconstructed is regarded as a node, and a corresponding graph model is constructed; 4: taking the graph as a regular term, taking the deviation of an original block and a compressed average block to be reconstructed as a quadratic term, and carrying out convex optimization processing on the expression to solve; 5: and after each overlapped small block is processed, updating the picture by adopting weighted average to obtain a compressed and reconstructed picture Y, calculating the PSNR values of the original picture and the processed picture, and comparing the PSNR values with the traditional image compression sensing method. The invention improves the compression efficiency and the reconstruction rate of the image.

title_en: Camera module, manufacturing method, and electronic device
abstract_en: The present technology relates to a camera module, a manufacturing method, and an electronic apparatus that can prevent degradation of positioning accuracy or heat dissipation performance of an optical module. An image pickup element is bonded on one face of a flexible board so that a light receiving surface of the image pickup element is exposed through an opening portion of the flexible board, and an optical module is bonded on the other face of the flexible board so that light enters the image pickup element through the opening portion. The reinforcing member is joined to the one surface of the flexible board at a circumference of the image pickup element, and reinforces a joining portion of the flexible board to which the optical module is joined. The reinforcing member is joined to face a region including at least a part of the joint portion, and is shaped so that a part of the circumference of the image pickup element remains open. The present technology is applicable to, for example, a camera module in which the image pickup element and the optical module are integrated.

title_en: Constant current drive protection circuit, protection device and television
abstract_en: The invention discloses a constant current drive protection circuit, a protection device and a television, wherein the constant current drive protection circuit comprises a constant current drive module, a control module and a protection module; the control module is used for detecting the working current of the LED lamp string, outputting a driving signal to the constant current driving module and the protection module when the working current is less than a preset current, and stopping outputting the driving signal when the working current is greater than or equal to the preset current; the protection module is used for being opened when receiving a driving signal to control the constant current driving module to be closed, and is closed when not receiving the driving signal to control the constant current driving module to be opened; the constant current driving module is used for outputting constant driving current to the LED lamp string according to the driving signal when the LED lamp string is closed. The protection module is added to control the constant current driving module to be switched on and off according to the current of the LED lamp string, so that the stability and the safety of the constant current driving circuit are greatly improved.

title_en: Real-time code stream encryption method based on two-dimensional codebook
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time code stream encryption method based on a two-dimensional codebook, and relates to the technical field of code stream encryption. The invention comprises the following steps: respectively adding an H codebook and a T codebook at the head and the tail of an original code stream, calculating an encryption key K, obtaining an encryption length L according to the type of the code stream, carrying out encryption operation on the code stream with the length L by using the key K, and finally outputting data of the H codebook, the encryption code stream with the length L' and the rest unencrypted code stream and the T codebook. The invention stores the random key information and the position information of the key position in the T code book by using the H code book, and stores the position information of the key in the H code book by using the T code book to form a mutually protected two-dimensional code book, and simultaneously encrypts the data of the key part according to the characteristics of different types of code streams, thereby ensuring the real-time performance of the code streams in the transmission and improving the safety of the code streams in the transmission.

title_en: Heat dissipation device
abstract_en: The application provides a heat dissipating device, which comprises a condenser, an evaporator, a steam pipe and a liquid pipe; the condenser is used for condensing the vapor state working medium into a liquid state working medium and comprises a flat tube and a current collector; the method comprises the steps of dividing a cavity in a current collector into an upper cavity and a lower cavity which are independent of each other through a spacer, bending a flat pipe into an upper section and a lower section which are communicated with each other, communicating the upper section with the upper cavity through an upper jack, connecting the lower section with the lower cavity through a lower jack, communicating a steam pipe of a heat dissipating device with the upper cavity, and communicating a liquid pipe of the heat dissipating device with the lower cavity to form a loop; only one current collector is arranged at one end of the condenser, so that the assembly and welding processes can be effectively reduced, the labor cost is saved, and the assembly efficiency is improved; the mode of dividing the cavity in the current collector into the upper cavity and the lower cavity with different functions enables the steam pipe and the liquid pipe to be capable of arranging pipelines from the same end of the condenser, the number of electronic components which are bypassed is small, and the pipeline arrangement is more convenient and flexible.

title_en: Display device, temperature sensor and temperature sensing method
abstract_en: The application discloses a display device, a temperature sensor and a temperature sensing method. The temperature sensor comprises a transmission unit, wherein the transmission unit comprises at least one first transistor which is connected between an input end and an output end, the control end of each first transistor is connected with a first path end, when the number of the first transistors is multiple, a second path end of a previous first transistor is connected with a first path end of a next first transistor, the threshold voltage of the first transistor changes along with the temperature, and when the transmission unit receives an effective input signal, the transmission unit generates an output signal according to the threshold voltage of the first transistor and the effective input signal. By manufacturing the temperature sensor composed of the transistor in the display device, the temperature sensor generates an output signal based on the characteristics of the transistor, the temperature sensing device in the prior art is replaced, temperature detection is realized, and the problem that the cost of the display device is overhigh is solved.

title_en: Personnel monitoring method, device, server and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a personnel monitoring method, a device, a server and a storage medium, wherein the method is applied to the server of a public security information network, the server stores the portrait data of the public security information network, the portrait data comprises portrait pictures and personnel types corresponding to the portrait pictures, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring portrait data, and classifying the portrait pictures according to the personnel types; setting a unique identity code for the portrait picture, and generating desensitization portrait data of the portrait picture named by the identity code, wherein the identity code comprises a personnel type identifier corresponding to the portrait picture; receiving a desensitization portrait data synchronization request sent by a monitoring private network, and synchronizing the generated desensitization portrait data to the monitoring private network; and receiving alarm information sent by the monitoring private network, wherein the alarm information is generated by comparing the acquired portrait snapshot data with desensitized portrait data through a server of the monitoring private network. The leakage of personnel information in the portrait data is effectively avoided, the data transmission speed is improved, and the load of a public security information network is reduced.

title_en: Imaging device and imaging method
abstract_en: According to some aspects, an imaging device is presented, comprising: a polarizer configured to linearly polarize light along a polarization direction; a filter layer configured to receive polarized light from the polarizer and to selectively filter the light according to a wavelength of the polarized light; and a photoelectric conversion layer configured to receive the light filtered by the filter layer and generate electric charges in response to the received light, wherein the filter layer includes a plurality of through holes formed in the filter layer, and a cross-sectional shape of the through holes of the plurality of through holes extends in a polarization direction by an amount greater than an amount extending in a direction perpendicular to the polarization direction.

title_en: Variable iris and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an iris diaphragm and a control method, wherein the iris diaphragm comprises the following components: the first substrate and the second substrate are oppositely arranged; the light detection element is positioned on one side of the first substrate, which is far away from the second substrate, and is used for detecting the light intensity of incident light and generating a first signal; an electrowetting microfluidic dielectric layer located between the first substrate and the second substrate and comprising a light-transmissive fluid medium and a light-opaque fluid medium immiscible with the light-transmissive fluid medium; one of the light-transmitting fluid medium and the light-tight fluid medium is a conductive medium, and a wetting angle is formed between the conductive medium and the first substrate or the second substrate; a drive electrode configured to receive a drive voltage corresponding to the first signal for driving the electrowetting microfluidic dielectric layer to change the wetting angle.

title_en: Method and system for real-time switching of double MICs of Android advertisement machine, advertisement machine and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for switching double MICs of an Android advertisement player in real time, which comprises a recording module, a recording interface module, an audio mixing module and an audio equipment management module which are sequentially connected, wherein the audio equipment management module is respectively connected with an MIC1 module and an MIC2 module, and the method comprises the following steps: the audio mixing module defaults that two channels respectively receive sound input data from an MIC1 module and an MIC2 module; when data is input into one of the two sound channels of the audio mixing module, the data of the other sound channel is emptied, and then the two sound channels are converted into a single sound channel and returned to the recording interface module; the recording interface module transmits the data to the recording module in a single sound channel mode; for the recording module, the switching of the equipment cannot be sensed, and the switching is realized in real time, so that a series of operations of turning off the equipment, turning on the equipment for initialization and the like are not needed.

title_en: Method and system for synchronizing analysis and rendering of video file
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for synchronizing the analysis and rendering of a video file, which take the image analysis progress as a reference, synchronize the image rendering with the image analysis by controlling the progress of the image rendering, calculate and predict the progress of the image analysis and the rendering before rendering a subsequent frame each time, control the progress of the image rendering, adjust the image rendering period and synchronize the image analysis and the image rendering. When the technology is applied to the screening analysis of the monitoring video, the analyst checks each frame of image and the frame of image is also intelligently analyzed by the system, thereby realizing the synchronization of checking and analyzing the monitoring video. The method has the advantages that the method can simultaneously combine two means of manual viewing and intelligent analysis to analyze the same frame of image, and the analysis accuracy of the monitoring video is improved. The technical scheme of the invention is particularly suitable for the fields of public safety, security and the like, and can improve the case detection efficiency in the fields.

title_en: Compression processing method and system for capsule endoscope bayer image
abstract_en: The invention provides a compression processing method and a processing system for a bayer image of a capsule endoscope, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, collecting image data in an original bayer format; s2, separating the RGB data in the image data in the bayer format and rearranging the RGB data; s3, filtering the rearranged image data; and S4, compressing the image data after the filtering processing and outputting the image data. The capsule endoscope bayer image compression processing method and system provided by the invention rearranges the image data in bayer format, and increases the continuity of the image by utilizing the correlation among the color channels, thereby improving the data compression efficiency, increasing the service time of the battery, and obtaining more digestive tract images for more comprehensive diagnosis.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a display device, including: a display panel configured to display an image; a sound element configured to generate sound; and a rear frame configured to receive the display panel and protect a rear side of the display panel, wherein the sound member is attached to the rear frame, and at least one opening portion is provided around the sound member.

title_en: Coordinate data generating device and coordinate data generating method
abstract_en: The coordinate data generating device is used for a component mounting machine which can perform processing for mounting electronic components on substrates of different sizes, and executes processing for imaging a substrate controlled to be conveyed and stopped at a target position, correcting a deviation between a stop position of the substrate determined from an imaged image and the target position, and mounting the electronic components on the substrate, and specifies an imaging area when imaging the substrate stopped at the stop position. The coordinate data generation device is provided with: a target position information input unit for inputting information relating to a target position that is set commonly for substrates of different sizes that can be handled in the component mounting machine; a substrate information input unit that inputs substrate information including at least the size of a substrate in a first direction parallel to a conveyance direction of the substrate and the size of a substrate in a second direction orthogonal to the conveyance direction; and a coordinate data generation unit that generates coordinate data so that the edge of the substrate is included in the imaging area, based on the information on the target position, the size of the substrate in the first direction, and the size of the substrate in the second direction.

title_en: Wi-Fi video acquisition equipment detection method and system based on encrypted stream identification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Wi-Fi video acquisition equipment detection method and a system based on encrypted stream identification, which are used for detecting video acquisition equipment through the flow of identification equipment in an encrypted Wi-Fi environment, and the method comprises the following steps: continuously sniffing all Wi-Fi data packets in the environment, extracting data frames and grouping according to equipment; dividing the flow of each device into a plurality of samples according to a sliding time window, and extracting the statistical characteristics of the data frame in each sample; predicting the classification label of each sample through the trained classification model, predicting the sample with the statistical characteristics conforming to the video acquisition activity flow as a positive sample, and otherwise, predicting the sample as a negative sample; accumulating the prediction results of all samples in each device, and judging the device to be video acquisition equipment when the prediction results meet the judgment rule; the invention can detect the video acquisition equipment without decrypting the encryption by identifying whether the traffic statistical characteristics of the equipment accord with the traffic statistical characteristics of the video acquisition activity.

title_en: Image sensor, electronic system including the same, and method of operating the same
abstract_en: The image sensor includes a pixel array, an analog-to-digital conversion block, and an output block. The pixel array includes a plurality of unit pixels, and generates a plurality of analog pixel signals in response to incident light. The analog-to-digital conversion block includes a plurality of analog-to-digital converters connected to a plurality of columns of the pixel array and converting a plurality of analog pixel signals into a plurality of digital signals. The output block includes a plurality of output circuits that are connected to the plurality of analog-to-digital converters and control output timings of the plurality of digital signals. Each of the plurality of output circuits is connected to two or more output lines to output two or more bits among the plurality of digital signals at the same time.

title_en: Neutralization circuit and display panel
abstract_en: The invention provides a neutralization circuit and a display panel, wherein the neutralization circuit comprises a data voltage input end, a test control end, a power supply and a plurality of test switching tubes; the output end of each test switch tube is electrically connected with a data line, the control ends of a plurality of test switch tubes are electrically connected to the test control end, and the input end of each test switch tube is connected with the data voltage input end; the neutralizing circuit further comprises an electric storage module, the electric storage module is electrically connected with the test control end and the power supply and used for providing discharge voltage to the test control end when the power supply stops providing voltage, so that the test switch tube is connected with the charge-discharge voltage through the test control end and is opened, the data line is mutually communicated through the conducted test switch tube, the neutralization and discharge of residual charges on the data line are completed, when the display panel is suddenly powered off unexpectedly, the phenomenon of power-off picture residue is effectively improved, and the watching experience of a user is greatly improved.

title_en: Bus sheet for printed circuit board and printed circuit board
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of printed circuit board manufacturing, in particular to a bus sheet for a printed circuit board and the printed circuit board. The bus sheet has the advantages of simple mounting process and good competitiveness, and can integrate heating electronic elements on a printed circuit board, so that the printed circuit board tends to be more miniaturized and high-density.

title_en: Drive control method and device and display device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a driving control method, a driving control device and a display device, and belongs to the field of panel driving control. The method can be applied to a controller, and comprises the following steps: adding at least one configuration instruction in a target area of first data in a current data frame to obtain target line data, wherein the target area comprises at least one of an idle area and a data packet, the current data frame comprises a plurality of rows of data, each row of data comprises data to be executed of a plurality of driving chips, the first data is one row of data in the plurality of rows of data, the at least one configuration instruction corresponds to the at least one target data to be executed, and the target data to be executed is located in at least one row of data of the current data frame starting from the first data; and respectively sending target line data to the plurality of driving chips, wherein the target line data is used for the plurality of driving chips to execute corresponding configuration instructions on at least one target data to be executed. The invention can solve the problem of lower flexibility of sending the configuration instruction. The invention is used for driving control of the display device.

title_en: Lens focusing method, device and equipment of infrared imaging equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lens focusing method of an infrared imaging device, which comprises the steps of receiving an induction signal output by an infrared detection chip according to incident infrared light; the infrared light is obtained by pre-modulating infrared parallel light and passing through a lens to be fixed; controlling the lens to move along the optical axis direction of the lens through a driving device, and generating infrared images of the corresponding lens at a plurality of position points; and selecting the position point corresponding to the infrared image with the best definition as the fixed position point of the lens. Through the infrared parallel light that obtains of modulation in this application, as the light source of relative position between adjustment lens and the infrared detection chip, the infrared parallel light in this application is more stable, is difficult for receiving external environment's interference, is favorable to stabilizing the distance of modulation lens and infrared detection chip, reduces the camera lens modulation degree of difficulty. The application also provides a lens focusing device and equipment of the infrared imaging equipment, and the lens focusing device and the equipment have the beneficial effects.

title_en: Blind-plugging ground clamping piece structure of electric cabinet
abstract_en: A blind-plugging ground clamping piece structure of an electric cabinet comprises a plastic cabinet shell, a PCB, a cabinet ground wire interface column, a ground conductive clamping piece, an elastic power-assisted reed and a fastening nut; the PCB board is installed in the inboard of plastics machine case casing, be equipped with PCB board ground electrode on it, machine case ground wire interface post is installed in the through-hole of seting up on plastics machine case casing, the one end of the electrically conductive clamping piece of ground connection and elasticity helping hand reed is connected with the one end of machine case ground wire interface post in plastics machine case casing, the other end and the PCB board ground electrode contact of the electrically conductive clamping piece of ground connection are connected, elasticity helping hand reed laminating ground connection electrically conductive clamping piece sets up, fastening nut sets up in the outside of plastics machine case casing and threaded connection on machine case ground wire interface post. The plastic case shell is adopted, the cost, weight and production period of the case are reduced, the case grounding wire interface column is connected with the grounding conductive clamping piece and the elastic power-assisted reed to form a grounding assembly, the number of parts is reduced, the production and the installation are convenient, and the assembly efficiency is improved.

title_en: Electronic component and method for manufacturing electronic component
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electronic component (E) comprising at least one circuit carrier (1) which is filled with a plurality of mechanical and/or electronic component parts (2 to 4), and-has at least one contact opening (1.3) to form a mechanical and/or electrical contact connection point (KS) to at least one of the component parts (2 to 4), wherein at least one of the component parts (4) -at a distance from the circuit carrier (1) -comprises: at least one electrically conductive housing (4.1), and-at least one electrical contact element (4.2) protruding from the housing (4.1), said contact element being insulated from the housing (4.1) and being connected at least in a material-bonded manner to a contact opening (1.3) of the circuit carrier (1), wherein-at least one sealing element (5) is arranged in the region of the contact connection point (KS), in particular between the circuit carrier (1) and the housing (4) of the component part (4). The invention relates to a method for producing such an electronic component (E).

title_en: Power conversion device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a power conversion apparatus, including: an insulation transformer (107) having a first winding and a second winding; switching elements (101-104) connected to a first winding of an insulation transformer (107); a first conductor (105) connecting one end of a first winding of an insulation transformer (107) to switching elements (101, 102), and a second conductor (106) connecting the other end of the first winding of the insulation transformer (107) to the switching elements (103, 104), are provided in parallel with each other on an insulation substrate (301) so as not to overlap with each other.

title_en: Detection system and method for detecting display unit by using same
abstract_en: A detection system for a display unit and a method of detecting a display unit are provided, the display unit having a display section including a first pixel unit and a second pixel unit adjacent to the first pixel unit, and a plurality of data lines connected to the first pixel unit and the second pixel unit of the display section. The array test part and the light emitting test part are located in a peripheral region surrounding the display part. The detection device is configured to: during a driving reliability test mode for displaying a test image including a black image and a white image, providing an array control signal to an array test section to prevent an array data signal from being applied to a plurality of data lines in a period in which the white image is displayed; and providing a light emission control signal to the light emission test part to prevent the light emission data signal from being applied to the plurality of data lines during a period in which the black image is displayed.

title_en: Method and apparatus for encoding and decoding using high-level syntax architecture
abstract_en: A method and apparatus for decoding a video stream, the video stream comprising at least two encoded video sequences, each of the at least two encoded video sequences using a sequence parameter set that is at least one value different from a sequence parameter set used by other encoded video sequences, each of the at least two encoded video sequences comprising at least two encoded pictures. The method includes, prior to decoding any of the encoded pictures of the at least two encoded video sequences, the decoder decoding and enabling a single set of decoder parameters associated with the at least two encoded video sequences. The method further includes the decoder decoding at least one encoded image of the at least two encoded video sequences.

title_en: Backlight system and method for electronic device display
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to backlighting systems and methods for electronic device displays. Aspects of the subject technology relate to control circuits for Light Emitting Diodes (LEDs). The control circuit may include an LED timing controller integrated circuit configured to receive data from a host circuit of the electronic device; an LED row driver integrated circuit configured to connect a high voltage power rail to a light emitting diode via a plurality of switches; and LED column driver integrated circuits, each LED column driver integrated circuit configured to regulate current through at least one of the light emitting diodes.

title_en: Imaging apparatus, image processing method, and program
abstract_en: The present invention provides an apparatus and method capable of outputting a display image even during an exposure period of a recording image and generating a high-quality recording image. During an exposure period of a recorded image having a high number of pixels, the imaging element outputs a display image having a low number of pixels obtained as a result of thinning out constituent pixels of the imaging element. The recording image correction unit inputs a recording image from the frame memory after an exposure period elapses, and corrects a pixel value of a defective pixel resulting from output of the display image from the imaging element among constituent pixels in the recording image using an added value of pixel values of the display image output during the exposure period of the recording image, thereby correcting the pixel value of the defective pixel to the same pixel value as that in a case where exposure processing is performed for the exposure period of the recording image.

title_en: Cover plate manufacturing method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method for manufacturing a cover plate, including: bending an edge area of at least one side of a metal plate towards a first side of the metal plate to form a bent part and an unbent straight part, wherein the bent part and the straight part meet a vertical condition; extruding the bent part to form a boss on a second side of the straight part; and machining the bent part and the boss to target dimensions. The present disclosure also provides an electronic device.

title_en: Bionic optimization design method for liquid cooling runner
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bionic optimization design method of a liquid-cold runner, which comprises the steps of firstly, arranging a design domain in a plane, arranging an inlet and an outlet, and carrying out topological optimization on the design domain by taking the maximum heat exchange target based on a variable density method to obtain the distribution form of a macroscopic runner of the design domain; then, based on the microstructure morphology of the aeration tissue in the aquatic plant in the nature, micro porous structure flow channels are distributed in the design domain; and superposing the two flow channels to form a macro-micro two-scale liquid cooling flow channel distribution form, stretching the two-dimensional liquid cooling flow channel distribution form along the normal direction of a design domain to obtain the 3D structure liquid cooling plate, wherein the stretching thickness is determined according to the design space requirement and the manufacturing constraint condition. The invention relates to a macro-micro two-scale bionic optimization design method, and the heat dissipation structure designed according to the method improves the heat exchange efficiency, and achieves uniform heat dissipation while controlling the highest temperature.

title_en: Correction method and correction device for pixel circuit and display device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a correction method, a correction device and a display device of a pixel circuit, which aim to solve the problem that an OLED display panel in the prior art cannot be accurately compensated, and the display image quality is affected due to uneven brightness. The correction method of the pixel circuit comprises the following steps: loading a first preset voltage on each sensing compensation line of the pixel circuit, and acquiring first information fed back by each sensing compensation line; loading a second preset voltage on each sensing compensation line, and acquiring second information fed back by each sensing compensation line; and determining the corresponding relation between the feedback information and the correction information of each sensing compensation line according to the first information and the second information.

title_en: Method and system for lens shading color correction using block matching
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system for providing lens shading color correction using block matching. The system comprises at least one Lens Shading Correction (LSC) unit configured to select a block to be included in at least one cluster of blocks, and to select candidate blocks in such a way that at least a difference in luminance or color ratio between the candidate block and a reference block meets a criterion to form a comprehensive LSC table.

title_en: Method for removing selective electroplating edge at specific position on PCB
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for removing selective electroplating edges at specific positions on a PCB, which comprises the following steps: routing an electroplating edge, namely routing the electroplating edge between the PCB and the broken edge after finishing the steps of manufacturing the inner layer of the PCB, drilling holes on the pressing plate and the inner side of the PCB, removing glue by plasma and plating copper plates; electroplating the copper-clad plate, wherein the electroplating edge milled out of the outer side is subjected to copper-clad plate electroplating treatment together with the copper-clad plate electroplating treatment in the processes of copper-clad plate electroplating, film drying and image electricity treatment on the inner side of the PCB; the routing processing, namely routing the metal layer of the copper plating plate on the electroplating side and the circuit on the PCB at the position of the PCB side, and controlling the depth of a routing tool during routing; and (3) line etching, namely carrying out line etching treatment on the broken line on the PCB, so that the distance between the broken line and the electroplated edge meets the requirement. The invention is used for processing the PCB when the distance between the electroplating edge and the circuit is smaller.

title_en: Method for coding and decoding video image and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The present application provides a combined prediction mode for encoding or decoding a block of pixels of a video image. When it is determined to use the combined prediction mode, the video codec generates an intra-picture predictor of the current block based on the selected intra-picture prediction mode, and generates a merge index predictor of the current block based on the selected merge candidate from the merge candidate list. The video codec then generates a final predictor for the current block based on the intra-picture predictor and the merge index predictor. The current block is then encoded or decoded using the final predictor.

title_en: Image processing method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an image processing method and electronic equipment, relates to the technical field of communication, and aims to solve the problems that the electronic equipment is complex in operation and not convenient enough in the process of processing a food image. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first image, wherein the first image comprises a first object of a food type and a second object of a preset type, and the preset type is different from the food type; determining a target recommendation object according to the first object; and replacing the second object with the target recommended object to obtain a target image.

title_en: Equipment control method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an equipment control method and electronic equipment, relates to the technical field of communication, and aims to solve the problems of high difficulty and low operation convenience when a user operates a household appliance according to a paper specification. The scheme comprises the following steps: identifying target equipment displayed in a shooting preview interface; in the shooting preview interface, operation guide information of the target device is displayed, and the operation guide information comprises at least one of the following items: an operation menu of the target device and an operation flow of the target device. The method is applied to a scene of controlling the equipment through the electronic equipment.

title_en: Preview mode preview image generation method, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a preview mode preview image generation method, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: if the camera application is in a preview mode, obtaining a target exposure value aiming at the current photographing scene; wherein the target exposure value is an exposure value determined for the captured image based on at least three different exposure values; obtaining a preview image based on the target exposure value; and displaying the preview image.

title_en: Display apparatus
abstract_en: The invention provides a display device. The display device comprises a backlight module, at least one adhesive piece arranged on the backlight module and a panel adhered by the adhesive piece. The backlight module comprises a back plate, a light guide plate arranged on the back plate and a frame arranged around the back plate, wherein the frame is provided with a bearing part and a side wall part extending upwards from the periphery of the bearing part, and the frame is spliced by at least two frames. The adhesive piece is arranged on the bearing part of the frame. The panel is adhered to the bearing part of the frame by the at least one adhesive piece and is not shielded by any part of the frame. By means of the structural design, the connecting sheet is not required to be additionally used between the frames, and the number of assembly components is reduced. The panel is not shielded by the frame, so that the requirement of a narrow frame is met.

title_en: Audio interface circuit, circuit group, automobile and audio access method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an audio interface circuit, which comprises an input end, a main output end, an auxiliary output end, a first filtering module, a first conversion module, a second filtering module and a second conversion module; the first filtering module filters the differential signal accessed by the input end and outputs the filtered differential signal to the first conversion module; the first conversion module converts a signal into a first common-mode signal and outputs the first common-mode signal to the second filtering module; the first conversion module outputs the first common-mode signal through the main output end; the second filtering module filters the first common-mode signal to obtain a second common-mode signal, and outputs the second common-mode signal to the second conversion module; and the second conversion module converts the second common-mode signal into a differential signal and outputs the differential signal through the auxiliary output end. The invention also discloses an audio interface circuit group, an automobile and an audio access method, which can effectively improve the signal quality of the vehicle-mounted equipment sharing the same sound source in multiple paths.

title_en: Video decoding method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a video decoding assembly method and device. The method is applied to an electronic device with a GPU, the electronic device comprises a plurality of decoding components, each decoding component is generated based on decoding configuration corresponding to the decoding component and is used for realizing a decoding process, and the decoding configuration is used for configuring the decoding process realized by the decoding component, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the type of a GPU of the electronic equipment; determining, based on the model, a decoding configuration supported by the GPU; screening out decoding components corresponding to the decoding configuration supported by the GPU from the plurality of decoding components as target decoding components; and decoding the video to be decoded by utilizing the target decoding component. The method and the device can enable a user to conveniently determine the target decoding component suitable for the electronic equipment on the premise of unfamiliarity with software and hardware environments of the electronic equipment, and improve the efficiency of determining the video decoding component.

title_en: display device
abstract_en: Disclosed is a display device including: a window; an anti-reflector disposed below the window, the anti-reflector including a first region having a first transmittance and a second region having a second transmittance higher than the first transmittance; and a display panel disposed under the anti-reflector, the display panel including a first display region having a first resolution and a second display region having a second resolution lower than the first resolution. The second region overlaps the second display region in a plan view.

title_en: Headset and implantable cochlear stimulation system including the same
abstract_en: A headset includes a housing, a headset magnet carried by the housing, and a headset antenna carried by the housing.

title_en: Loudspeaker box frame comprising a further loudspeaker box connection device and loudspeaker box comprising such a frame
abstract_en: The sound box frame (2) comprises a connecting device (21) connected with another sound box, the connecting device (21) comprises a ring eye (210) and a locking system (3), the locking system (3) comprises a front claw piece (31 a) and a rear claw piece (31 b), a sliding piece (32) which is arranged between the two claw pieces (31 a;31 b) and is configured to slide between a high position and a low position under the action of a first elastic component connected to the sliding block (32), and an actuator (38) which is configured to be in a pulling position and a pushing position. The locking system (3) is configured to be able to be in a locked configuration and an activated configuration, the locking system (3) being switched from the locked configuration to the activated configuration by movement of the actuator (38) and from the lowered position to the raised position by movement of the slider (32).

title_en: Method for processing an audio signal and audio processing device
abstract_en: A real-time audio signal processing system includes an audio signal processor configured to process an audio signal using a modified Generalized Eigenvalue (GEV) beamforming technique to generate an enhanced target audio output signal. The digital signal processor includes a sub-band decomposition circuit configured to decompose the audio signal into sub-band frames in the frequency domain and a target activity detector configured to detect whether target audio is present in the sub-band frames. Based on the information related to the sub-band frame and the determination of whether the target audio is present in the sub-band frame, the digital signal processor is configured to estimate a Relative Transfer Function (RTF) of the target audio source using a modified GEV technique, and to generate a filter based on the estimated RTF. A filter may then be applied to the audio signal to generate an enhanced audio output signal.

title_en: Solid-state imaging device, signal processing method for solid-state imaging device, and electronic apparatus
abstract_en: The application relates to a solid-state imaging device, a signal processing method of the solid-state imaging device, and an electronic apparatus. Wherein the solid-state imaging device may include: a pixel unit in which one microlens is formed for a plurality of pixels; and a correction circuit configured to correct a sensitivity difference between pixels within the pixel unit based on a correction coefficient, wherein the correction coefficient is calculated based on a summation signal obtained by summing pixel signals of respective pixels in the pixel unit, wherein the correction coefficient is calculated based on a pixel average value obtained by dividing the summation signal by the number of pixels in the pixel unit, and wherein the correction coefficient is calculated using a ratio between the pixel average value and the pixel signals of respective pixels in the pixel unit.

title_en: Shift register unit, control method thereof and grid drive circuit
abstract_en: The invention provides a shift register unit, a control method thereof and a gate drive circuit, wherein the shift register unit comprises a first control circuit and a tank circuit which directly control the potential of a first node, a pull-down control circuit which indirectly controls the potential of the first node, a second control circuit and a first pull-down circuit, and an output circuit which outputs a first voltage signal provided by a first voltage end to a signal output end under the control of the potential of the first node. The shift register unit, the control method thereof and the grid driving circuit provided by the invention can realize the adjustment of the pulse width of the grid scanning signal and meet various display requirements.

title_en: Solid-state imaging device and camera system
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a solid-state imaging device and a camera system capable of recording a still image without using a recording medium. A photodiode (35), a transfer transistor (36), a reset transistor (37), and an amplification transistor (38), and a memory element (39) having a function of a selection transistor are provided in a pixel P of an image sensor. In the memory element (39), a Memory Transistor (MT) is formed integrally with a drain-side selection transistor (DST) and a source-Side Selection Transistor (SST). The Memory Transistor (MT) stores charge of an amount corresponding to the amount of light received by the photodiode (35) in the charge storage layer (42) by applying a write voltage as a gate voltage to the memory gate electrode (41).

title_en: Image processing method and related product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an image processing method and a related product, which are characterized in that the method is applied to electronic equipment; the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that an electronic device obtains an initial image, then mapping processing is carried out on the initial image to obtain a first image, then the first image is processed according to a preset strategy to obtain a second image, the preset strategy is used for adjusting the contrast of the first image to optimize an image display result, and finally sharpness enhancement processing is carried out on the second image to obtain a target image; the global contrast and the local contrast are adjusted through a preset strategy, so that high-dynamic-range scenes can be better displayed on equipment with a low dynamic range, the existing image processing method can be optimized, and the high efficiency and convenience of image processing can be improved.

title_en: Video shooting method and device and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a video shooting method, video shooting equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving a video shooting instruction, and acquiring a plurality of groups of shot images through a preset shooting assembly within preset shooting time; then, carrying out image fusion processing on the multiple groups of shot images according to preset video processing parameters; and finally, compressing the processed shot image into a video and outputting the video. The humanized video shooting scheme is realized, so that the user can obtain video contents with diversified special effects without performing subsequent processing on the video, the video shooting difficulty of the user is reduced, and the user experience is improved.

title_en: Hand-held three-dimensional camera
abstract_en: The invention discloses a handheld three-dimensional stereo camera which structurally comprises a case, an annular lamp support, a control panel, a diffusion plate, a rotary disc, a soft light lampshade and a shooting unit, wherein the shooting unit is arranged in front of the soft light lampshade through the annular lamp support, the case comprises a cover body and a main body, the annular lamp is fixedly connected with the case through the annular lamp support, the control panel is arranged at the front end of the case, the diffusion plate is installed in the cover body and the main body, the rotary disc is arranged in the case, the rotary disc is arranged above the diffusion plate, the soft light lampshade is placed on the upper portion of the main body, the soft light lampshade is arranged outside the soft light lampshade, the carrying difficulty is small, and easily damaged parts such as the shooting unit can be individually packaged and carried.

title_en: Method and system for processing 360-degree image content
abstract_en: An apparatus and method for processing 360 degree image content captured by a 360 degree camera is provided.
