One method comprises the following steps: obtaining, by an electronic device, a sequence of 360-degree projection format image frames associated with the 360-degree image content and Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) rotation data associated with the 360-degree image content; calculating, by the electronic device, a relative rotation of the 360 degree image content; and applying, by the electronic device, the relative rotation to at least one of the 360 degree projection format image frames, thereby stabilizing 360 degree image content.

title_en: Lens transmission device and mobile terminal
abstract_en: The invention provides a lens transmission device, which comprises a transmission component, a driving component and a lens module; the transmission assembly comprises a pushing support, a limiting support, a lifting rotating shaft, a gear transmission mechanism, a guide rod and a spring; the driving assembly is arranged on one side of the transmission assembly at intervals along a direction perpendicular to the first direction and comprises a driving device, a screw rod, a push block mechanism and a connecting rod; the driving device drives the screw rod to rotate so as to drive the push block mechanism to move along a first direction, so that the push block mechanism drives the spring, the pushing support, the lifting rotating shaft and the gear transmission mechanism to move along the first direction, and the lens module moves linearly along the first direction; when the pushing support moves to be limited by the limiting support, the push block mechanism continues to move along the first direction, and the gear and the rack form gear transmission so as to drive the rotating shaft to rotate and drive the lens module to rotate. Compared with the prior art, the lens transmission device and the mobile terminal have the advantages of high control precision, good stability and simple structure.

title_en: Method and system for driving thermoacoustic device by using digitized real-time audio signal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for driving a thermal sound generating device by utilizing a digital real-time audio signal, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly converting, filtering and denoising an analog audio signal in front of the thermal sound generating device; converting the converted, filtered and noise-reduced analog audio signal into a 10-16-bit high-precision digital signal stream in an oversampling manner; after the obtained digital signal stream is subjected to digital filtering, a digitized audio signal stream which can change along with a clock signal is obtained through two-stage digital modulation of the signal; and shaping and power amplifying the digital audio signal stream obtained by modulation to obtain a digital audio signal stream for driving the thermal sound generating device to play audio. The system comprises an input module, an analog-to-digital conversion module, a modulation module, an output module and a power management module. The invention realizes the real-time digital conversion of the audio signal and drives the thermal sounding device, effectively eliminates the frequency doubling effect of the thermal sounding device and obviously reduces the power consumption of the device during sounding.

title_en: Bone sawing machine for processing pork shavings and processing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of food processing, and discloses a bone sawing machine for processing pork and a processing method thereof, wherein the bone sawing machine comprises a machine base, the top of the machine base is fixedly provided with a workbench, the top of the back of the machine base is fixedly provided with a saw wheel box, an inner cavity at the top of the saw wheel box is movably provided with an upper wheel, the inner part of the machine base, which is close to one side of the saw wheel box, is movably provided with a lower wheel corresponding to the upper wheel, a saw blade is movably sleeved between the outer rings of the upper wheel and the lower wheel, the inner part of the machine base, which is positioned at the lower half part of the lower wheel, is provided with a containing cavity, the lower wheel comprises a front wheel plate and a rear wheel plate, the front wheel plate and the rear wheel plate are coaxially combined, an annular saw groove is formed at the middle part of the outer ring, a scraping ring is movably arranged at the position of the inner ring of the annular saw groove, which is positioned between the front wheel plate and the rear wheel plate, the cutting effect and the efficiency are improved by utilizing the separate design of the lower wheel and matching with the structures of internal transmission and the like, and meanwhile, the service life of the saw blade can be longer.

title_en: Detection substrate and ray detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection substrate and a ray detector, which comprises a substrate; a plurality of detection pixel circuits located over the substrate; the first passivation layer is positioned on one side of the detection pixel circuits, which is away from the substrate; the flat layer is positioned on one side of the first passivation layer, which is away from the substrate, and the surface of one side of the flat layer, which is away from the first passivation layer, is a plane; the plurality of photosensitive devices are electrically connected with the plurality of detection pixel circuits in a one-to-one correspondence manner through the through holes penetrating through the first passivation layer and the flat layer, and each photosensitive device comprises a first part and a second part, wherein the orthographic projection of the first part on the substrate base plate is overlapped with the orthographic projection of the corresponding detection pixel circuit in an electric connection manner, and the orthographic projection of the second part on the substrate base plate is not overlapped with the orthographic projection of the corresponding detection pixel circuit in an electric connection manner.

title_en: Intelligent automobile fault detection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent detection system for automobile faults, which has the technical scheme that: the system comprises an image acquisition device, an image processor, an application server, a database cluster, a relational database, a user terminal and a storage module; the image acquisition device is used for acquiring a fault image of the vehicle; the image processor is used for carrying out image recognition on the fault image so as to determine the name of the part with the fault of the vehicle and the fault type; the application server is used for generating a fault according to the name of the failed part and the fault type; the automobile fault intelligent detection system changes the fault judgment mode which is mainly based on the experience of a master automobile repair worker in the past, analyzes the faults of the automobile by adopting visual analysis, comparison and judgment, can achieve good judgment effect on most faults, can greatly improve the efficiency of automobile repair, reduces the cost input in the automobile repair process, and can reduce the operation cost.

title_en: Image processing method, device and system and computer readable medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an image processing method, an image processing device, an image processing system and a computer readable medium. The image processing method comprises the following steps: caching image data of a plurality of input image layers; caching point-by-point transparency data of the plurality of input layers; under the drive of an output time sequence, synchronously reading and merging target pixel data in the image data of each target input layer in the plurality of input layers and target point-by-point transparency data in the point-by-point transparency data to obtain merged image data of the target input layers, and combining the global transparency coefficient of the target input layers to perform superposition processing on the merged image data to obtain image data of corresponding positions of output images. The embodiment of the invention can realize transparent superposition and window display in any shape, and improves the display effect.

title_en: Loudspeaker and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a loudspeaker and a manufacturing method thereof, relates to the technical field of loudspeakers, and aims to improve the structural compactness of an electromagnetic loudspeaker and facilitate the manufacturing by adopting a micro-electronic machining technology. The speaker includes a substrate, a vibration part, a coil, and a magnetic material part; the substrate is provided with a supporting surface; on the supporting surface, a shallow groove structure and a barrier structure positioned below the shallow groove structure are arranged in the substrate; at least one vent hole is formed in the blocking structure; the vibration part is formed above the supporting surface and comprises a vibrating diaphragm structure positioned above the shallow groove structure; the coil is positioned on one side of the vibrating diaphragm structure far away from the substrate; the magnetic material part is positioned on the surface of the blocking structure far away from the vibration part.

title_en: Image monitoring system of escalator
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide an image monitoring system (10) capable of monitoring a wider range of an escalator (1). An image monitoring system (10) is provided with an imaging device (12) and a mirror (11). The imaging device (12) faces the ceiling (3) above the steps (5) of the escalator (1). The escalator (1) is erected between an upper floor and a lower floor. The imaging device (12) is arranged on the upper floor. The reflector (11) has a reflection section (15). The reflection unit (15) reflects incident light so as to disperse the incident light. The mirror (11) is supported by the ceiling (3) such that the reflection unit (15) faces downward, and the reflection unit (15) is reflected on the captured image captured by the imaging device (12).

title_en: Television with set-top box bracket
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of televisions, in particular to a television with a set-top box support, wherein a first concave shape is arranged at the bottom of a television body; a guide hole is arranged in the first concave part; the guide hole extends along the height direction of the television body; the turning plate structure comprises a turning plate and a folding rod structure; the turning plate is hinged with the second concave side wall; the turning plate is embedded into the second concave part after being folded; the second swing rod and the first swing rod are folded and are placed in the second concave shape; a plurality of semicircular grooves are formed in one end face, far away from the end face hinged with the second concave part, of the turning plate; the pulling plate is provided with a plurality of through holes; the surface of the rubber pad is evenly distributed with particles. When the television set structure is used, the television set structure provides a mounting structure integrated with a television for the set-top box, and the mounting structure can be hidden in the television set under the condition of nonuse, so that the television set is convenient to package, and meanwhile, a remote controller can be placed.

title_en: Electroplating solution for electroplating through hole of circuit board with high aspect ratio and electroplating method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of copper electroplating, in particular to an electroplating solution for electroplating a through hole of a circuit board with a high aspect ratio and an electroplating method thereof, wherein the electroplating solution comprises 0.1-100 g/L of divalent manganese and 0.1-10 g/L of hexavalent manganese, 1-100 g/L of divalent manganese and 0.5-10 g/L of hexavalent manganese, 15-100 g/L of copper, 50-350 g/L of sulfuric acid and 5-200 mg/L of chloride, 0.2-10 ppm of additive A and 0.01-0.3% of additive B, a quasi-reversible oxidation reduction system can be formed by the added divalent manganese and hexavalent manganese, the hexavalent manganese in the oxidation reduction system is reduced by the divalent copper, compared with a divalent iron/trivalent iron system in the prior art, the situation that metal ions of high titanium oxide caused by concentration polarization are difficult to supplement in an electron transfer mode is avoided, therefore, a better electroplating effect can be obtained, the electroplating solution is suitable for an unnecessary anode (iridium oxide coating is coated on a titanium material), and the electroplating solution has higher efficiency for a circuit board with high aspect ratio when used with a pulse rectifier.

title_en: Portable mobile television
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable mobile television, which comprises a body, a shell, a signal receiving wire, a handle and a mounting device, wherein the shell is mounted on the outer side of the body, the shell comprises a heat insulation layer, a through hole, a heat absorption layer and a cooling layer, the heat insulation layer penetrates through the top and bottom ends and is provided with the through hole, the top end of the heat insulation layer is provided with the heat absorption layer, the portable mobile television is scientific and reasonable in structure and safe and convenient to use, the portable mobile television is provided with components such as the heat absorption layer and the like, the heat absorption layer absorbs heat generated by the body through the through hole on the heat insulation layer and is cooled through the cooling layer, the heat dissipation is facilitated, the components such as a telescopic rod and the like are arranged, the adjustment of the angle and the height after the mounting is facilitated through the expansion and contraction of the telescopic rod and, the stability after being convenient for install is provided with the hand (hold), is convenient for further increase the stability after the installation.

title_en: Encoding method, encoding device, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an encoding method, an encoding device, electronic equipment and a storage medium; wherein, this application scheme includes: determining a macro block to be coded, wherein the macro block to be coded is obtained by macro block division of a target video frame of video data; acquiring an associated macro block corresponding to the macro block to be encoded, wherein the associated macro block is determined from at least one encoded video frame before the target video frame in the video data; acquiring a macro block mode corresponding to the associated macro block; and determining the target quantization parameter of the macro block to be coded at least based on the macro block mode corresponding to the associated macro block. Therefore, the quality of the macro block to be coded can be optimized on the basis of not increasing the computational complexity, and the video quality of the video data can be further optimized.

title_en: Temporary covering type traffic indicating device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a temporary covering type traffic indicating device which can be detachably arranged on the existing traffic indicating board, comprising: the control assembly comprises a control box and a strip-shaped connecting piece; the display assembly comprises a central flexible screen and a plurality of peripheral flexible screens, the radiuses of the peripheral flexible screens are sequentially increased, and the peripheral flexible screens are sequentially sleeved in a ring mode by taking the central flexible screen as a center; the fixing component comprises a rope body and two second fixing pieces which are arranged at two ends of the rope body respectively. The invention depends on the existing traffic sign, the structure is more stable, the influence of external factors such as wind, rain and the like is small, the temporary replacement of the information of the existing traffic sign is realized conveniently through the device, the information display also depends on the plane structure of the existing traffic sign, the information display is smoother, the view is clearer and more convenient, and the device can be fixed with the existing traffic sign by lifting the device step by step through the rod body, does not need to climb by people, has high safety and is convenient to set.

title_en: High-speed scanning camera for detection and identification
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-speed scanning camera for detection and identification.A image acquisition chip converts acquired image data into serial data in an LVDS format and sends the serial data to a serial-parallel converter; the serial-parallel converter converts LVDS serial data into parallel data and then sends the parallel data to the preprocessing module through a data bus; the preprocessing module carries out binarization, filtering, white balance, color correction and distortion correction on the parallel data and then sends the image data to the VDMA module; the VDMA module sends the image data to the DDR memory module after realizing the cache function of the image data; the DDR memory module provides the stored data image for the embedded processor to be called; the embedded processor sends corresponding instruction content to the chip initialization module; the invention can provide the high-speed scanning camera for detection and identification, which has strong anti-interference performance, high image acquisition efficiency, wide application range and high acquisition and processing speed.

title_en: Protection device that ETC theftproof brush prevented forced-open
abstract_en: The invention discloses a protection device for preventing ETC from being stolen and forcibly dismantled, which comprises a box body, wherein a processing cavity is arranged in the box body, an anti-dismantling device is arranged in the processing cavity and comprises a supporting plate fixedly connected with the inner wall of the lower side of the processing cavity.

title_en: Display panel, display device and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a display panel, a display device and a control method thereof. The display device comprises a display screen, a camera module, a micro optical element and a fast moving type display device. The camera module is arranged on the non-display side of the display screen and corresponds to the transparent area in position. The fast moving display equipment is arranged between the micro optical element and the camera module. When the display screen is used for displaying the picture in a full screen mode, the fast moving type display equipment moves to the transparent area and synchronously displays the picture corresponding to the transparent area, and the picture displayed by the fast moving type display equipment is positioned on the same plane with the picture displayed by the main display area after passing through the micro optical element. When the camera module is in the front shooting mode, the fast moving type display device moves out of the transparent area and stops at a position where the camera module is not shielded, and the camera module shoots images through the micro optical element. The invention can realize optimized full-screen display and improve the shooting effect of the camera under the screen.

title_en: Multi-system fusion communication system and method based on CAD mapping map
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of safety information, and relates to a multi-system fusion communication system and method based on a CAD (computer-aided design) mapping map, which comprises a map management server, a communication server and a communication server, wherein the map management server is used for uploading the CAD mapping map and converting the CAD mapping map into vector graphic data in a JSON (Java Server open) format; the map management server is also used for receiving the terminal equipment information and the roadway distance data, carrying out adaptive processing and displaying the processing result through the map display module; the adapting comprises: judging whether the roadway distance data corresponding to the terminal equipment received this time is changed relative to the roadway distance data corresponding to the terminal equipment received last time, if not, not carrying out any treatment; and if the distance changes, converting the roadway distance received this time into a plane coordinate and sending the plane coordinate to the map display module. The method realizes multi-system linkage on a graph.

title_en: Component mounting device and component mounting method
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a component mounting device and a component mounting method for picking up and mounting a light emitting component on a substrate by using a mounting head. The component mounting method includes: a reference portion recognition step of recognizing a reference portion formed on the substrate; a light emitting part recognition step of recognizing a light emitting part of the light emitting part by imaging the light emitting part held from below by the holding mechanism from above; a pickup step of picking up the held light emitting component by the mounting head based on a recognition result of the light emitting component obtained in the light emitting component recognition step; and a mounting step of mounting the picked light emitting component on the substrate based on a recognition result of the reference portion and a recognition result of the light emitting portion.

title_en: Ultra-wideband power amplifier special for communication jammer
abstract_en: The application discloses a special ultra-wideband power amplifier for a communication jammer, which comprises a radiating fin, a radiating mechanism, a dustproof mechanism and a protection mechanism, wherein the radiating fin is arranged on the side wall of a shell; the heat dissipation mechanism comprises a hollow shell, a phase change filling material, a mounting plate and a fan; the dustproof mechanism comprises a connecting plate, a top plate and dustproof cotton; the protection mechanism comprises a control unit, a power amplifier processing unit and a protection unit. The front-end power amplifier module and the rear-end power amplifier module are arranged, so that amplification of transmission signals is facilitated, efficient operation of ultra-wideband power amplifiers is realized, and normal work of an interference machine is guaranteed; the fan is convenient to mount by arranging the mounting plate, the effective circulation of air in the shell can be realized, and the heat dissipation performance can be improved by arranging the heat dissipation fins; can realize the circulation of the inside air of shell through being provided with the roof to be provided with the effective filtration that dustproof cotton realized the dust, be provided with the effective control that phase transition filler material can realize the temperature simultaneously, improve ultra wide band power amplifier's life.

title_en: Image display method, device, equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of terminals and discloses an image display method, device and equipment and a computer readable storage medium. When the definition of the current image to be displayed is monitored to be lower than a preset threshold value, acquiring an intermediate display image from a first image cache region, wherein the intermediate display image is obtained according to the current display image and the current image to be displayed, further displaying the intermediate display image, and displaying the buffered image to be displayed after the intermediate display image is displayed for a preset buffer time; the problem of among the correlation technique intelligent TV set appear the picture flickering messy code when signal source switches or different resolution ratio pictures switch is solved, user's puzzlement has been reduced, user's watching experience has been promoted, and is intelligent, humanized more.

title_en: LED display screen
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of display screens, in particular to an LED display screen, which comprises a mounting plate and a display screen body, wherein a containing groove is formed in one side, close to the display screen body, of the mounting plate, two vertical rods are vertically fixed in the containing groove, a pressing mechanism is arranged between the lower ends of the two vertical rods and the lower end of the display screen body, a lifting mechanism is arranged between the upper ends of the two vertical rods and the upper end of the display screen body, an extruding mechanism is arranged between the pressing mechanism and the lifting mechanism, two first fixing blocks are symmetrically arranged on the pressing mechanism, and a pushing mechanism is arranged between the two first fixing blocks and the bottom wall. Pass through-hole and connecting hole through the bolt, fix the position of lifter plate to install the display screen body, be convenient for very install and dismantle the display screen body, meet unexpected circumstances can be timely dismantle the display screen body get off, simultaneously, do not need a plurality of bolts to fix the display screen body, prevent that the display screen body is impaired, guarantee the life of display screen body.

title_en: Template generating device and component mounting machine
abstract_en: The template generation device is provided with: an electrode information acquiring unit that acquires electrode information that is information on electrodes included in a component that is requested to be mounted at a predetermined mounting position on a substrate positioned inside a component mounting machine; and a template generating unit configured to generate a template for searching for a position of an electrode pad arranged at the mounting position of the substrate and connected to the electrode, based on the acquired electrode information.

title_en: Intelligence maintenance system cultivated in a pot based on Arduino platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent potted plant maintenance system based on an Arduino platform, which comprises a flowerpot, an Arduino main control board, an optical sensor, a temperature and humidity sensor, a soil temperature sensor, a WIFI module and a terminal, wherein the flowerpot comprises a top layer and a main body part; the optical sensor and the temperature and humidity sensor are arranged on the top layer of the flowerpot; the bottom of the main body part is provided with a storage layer, a control layer is arranged above the storage layer, a water tank and a nutrient solution tank are arranged above the control layer, and a space for storing soil in a flowerpot is arranged above the water tank and the nutrient solution tank; the Arduino main control board and the WIFI module are arranged in a control layer of the main body part; the soil humidity sensor and the soil temperature sensor are both arranged on the inner wall of a space for storing soil in the flowerpot, and the Arduino main control board adjusts an illumination system and an irrigation system arranged in the potted plant through data collected by the sensors, so that automatic maintenance of the potted plant is realized.

title_en: Safe anticreep plug assembly of new energy automobile PCU controller
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safe anti-drop plug-in assembly which comprises a socket opening and a plug, wherein a fastener rotating column is a rotating center and can be rotatably connected to the plug. When the plug is inserted into the socket opening, the buckling piece rotates to lock the plug on the socket opening; the fastening piece is further provided with a detection mechanism, the detection mechanism comprises a heat conduction probe and an observation part, the observation part is arranged on the outer side of the fastening piece, the heat conduction probe is arranged on one side, close to the plug, of the fastening piece, and the heat conduction probe is connected with the observation part. The plug and socket plug provided by the invention are added with components for plug connection, so that the plug can be more stably inserted into the socket, the loosening of the connector due to long-time non-directional vibration and the like is avoided, and maintenance personnel can observe the temperature of the plug through the observation part, thereby avoiding the occurrence of potential safety hazards.

title_en: Combined heat dissipation device for multiple high-power chips
abstract_en: The invention provides a combined heat dissipation device for a plurality of high-power chips, which comprises a box body, wherein a plurality of heat dissipation fans are arranged on the side wall of the box body, a plurality of support columns, a plurality of bosses and a plurality of baffles are arranged on the bottom surface inside the box body, and the top surface of the box body is sealed by an outer cover plate; the heat dissipation chip assembly is fixed on the bottom surface of the box body and comprises a printed circuit board, a plurality of chips, heat dissipation silicone grease, a heat conduction frame and a soaking plate which are sequentially stacked and connected; the interior apron, the interior apron is fixed inside the box body with soaking board fixed connection on support column, the boss, and with lateral wall, boss, the baffle of box body are with the inside two independent spaces of cutting apart into of box body, and one of them space holds the radiator chip subassembly, and another space forms the heat dissipation gas path. The heat dissipation structure is simple, the thermal resistance is small, heat can be efficiently conducted out of the chip, the inner cover plate is provided with a plurality of interference flow columns, and the heat dissipation capability is enhanced by the spoiler.

title_en: Cover plate and display screen
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a apron and display screen relates to and shows technical field, can reduce the thickness of display screen. The cover plate comprises a body and a shading layer; the body comprises a first part and a second part, the first part is used for transmitting light, the second part is used for shading light, the lower surface of the second part is covered with a shading layer, flat layers are arranged on the lower surface of the first part and the lower surface of the shading layer, the lower surface of each flat layer is a plane, and the flat layers are made of non-compressible materials. The cover plate provided by the embodiment of the application is used for covering the surface of the display panel.

title_en: Phase change heat radiator easy for bubble generation and escape
abstract_en: The invention relates to a phase change radiator easy for bubble generation and escape, which comprises a radiating cold plate, a radiating table top cover plate and a water-vapor separation membrane; the heat dissipation cold plate is provided with corrugated arc structures which are arranged in a staggered mode, each corrugated arc structure comprises a wave trough and a wave crest, cooling liquid enters the wave trough and is positioned at the wave trough to generate bubbles, and the bubbles escape to the wave crest along the wave surface between the wave troughs and the wave crests and rise to the water-vapor separation membrane; the heat dissipation table top cover plate is in sealing fit with the heat dissipation cold plate; the water-vapor separation membrane is arranged between the upper outlet of the heat dissipation cold plate and the channel of the heat dissipation cold plate and is used for blocking liquid so that gaseous cooling liquid can smoothly flow out; gaseous state coolant liquid overflows from the last export of heat dissipation cold drawing, and liquid coolant liquid gets into from the lower import of heat dissipation cold drawing, goes up export high position and is higher than import down, and this radiator has and accelerates bubble generation and escape, is showing improvement heat transfer ability, simple structure, need not the advantage of outside circulating pump.

title_en: Liquid crystal display television with anti-striking capability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a liquid crystal television with anti-striking capability, which relates to the field of liquid crystal televisions and comprises a screen backboard connecting seat at the back of a liquid crystal television body, wherein the screen backboard connecting seat is connected with a mounting plate through a splitting mechanism, mounting holes for mounting the screen backboard connecting seat on the mounting plate through screws are formed in the mounting plate, a protective enclosure frame is sleeved on the periphery of the liquid crystal television body, a curtain blocking component for protecting a liquid crystal screen is further arranged on the liquid crystal television body, the curtain blocking component is in a storage state after the liquid crystal screen is played, and the curtain blocking component is manually adjusted to a use state for blocking the front side of the liquid crystal screen after the liquid crystal screen is closed. The invention can block objects smashing towards the screen from the front side of the liquid crystal television body, thereby having a certain anti-shooting effect, reducing the breakage probability of the liquid crystal screen, and being beneficial to reducing the damage probability of the peripheral side of the liquid crystal television body through the protective enclosure frame.

title_en: Panoramic video transmission optimization method for cloud VR platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a panoramic video transmission optimization method for a cloud VR platform, which comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring a panoramic video, and processing the panoramic video to obtain a saliency map and a motion map; s2: extracting a user attention object according to the saliency map and the motion map, and calculating the motion speed of the user attention object; s3: establishing a FoV prediction model of the user based on the movement speed of the object concerned by the user; s4: and compressing video frames to be transmitted in the panoramic video by adopting a video image block definition selection algorithm in combination with a user FoV prediction model, and transmitting the compressed video frames through a cloud VR platform. The invention provides a panoramic video transmission optimization method for a cloud VR platform, which can reduce the required transmission bandwidth, reduce the end-to-end time delay, realize the transmission optimization of panoramic video and solve the problem of poor fluency of panoramic video transmission of the current cloud VR platform.

title_en: Imaging apparatus, electronic device, and notification method
abstract_en: An image forming apparatus (100) is provided with: a signal processing unit (130) that generates image data based on an image capturing result from the image capturing element (110); and a data transmission state notification unit (180), when the image data has been output to the outside, the data transmission state notification unit (180) controls the data transmission state display unit (181) to notify that the image data has been output to the outside.

title_en: Electrical control box of vehicle-mounted concrete pump
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electrical control box of a vehicle-mounted concrete pump, which comprises a box body, wherein a sunken operation panel is arranged at the top of the box body, the periphery of the operation panel is hermetically connected with the inner wall of the box body, the operation panel is obliquely arranged, a plurality of first drainage holes are formed in the oblique bottom of the operation panel, and each first drainage pipe is connected with a drainage pipe for draining water in the box body; a groove-shaped baffle is arranged below the operation panel in the box body, the groove-shaped baffle is obliquely arranged, and a plurality of second drain holes for draining water in the box body are formed in the oblique bottom of the groove-shaped baffle; the operation panel sinks to leave installation space for the switch and other operation panel electric devices; the water is directly led out of the box body through the pipeline in the box body and is discharged, so that the appearance is attractive and effective; when the electric control box can cause water to fall down from the operation panel due to the reasons of switch shortage, screw looseness and the like, the groove-shaped baffle plate achieves the purpose of secondary water prevention, and electric devices in the electric control box are protected.

title_en: Display screen brightness adjusting method and notebook computer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent terminals and discloses a display screen brightness adjusting method and a notebook computer. The display screen brightness adjusting method comprises the following steps: assigned value i to 1 according to the brightness L i Lightening the display screen, and delaying preset jitter duration, wherein i is a positive integer, and the brightness L is i Adjusting the brightness for the ith time; delaying the preset jitter duration, and reducing the brightness L according to the preset descending gradient i To obtain a luminance L i+1 And according to the brightness L i+1 Lighting the display screen; judging whether the key operation of the brightness adjusting key is detected within the preset lighting time;if not, assigning i to i +1, returning to reduce the brightness L according to a preset reduction gradient i To obtain a luminance L i+1 Thus, with the present method, it is possible to intelligently and gradually reduce the brightness, thereby saving power consumption.

title_en: Voice coil with outwardly extending leads and related transducers, systems and methods
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to voice coils having outwardly extending leads and related transducers, systems, and methods. The voice coil has an inner layer of wound filaments and an outer layer. The wound filament extends from a first end to a second end. A segment of the wound filament adjacent the first end extends outwardly from the outer layer to the first end. A section of the wound filament adjacent the second end extends outwardly from the outer layer to the second end. The voice coil may be coupled with the acoustic diaphragm to define an acoustic transducer.

title_en: Novel energy-saving confirmation method for machine room
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel method for confirming energy saving of a machine room, which comprises the following steps: acquiring the total energy consumption of the machine room before modification before energy-saving modification and the total energy consumption of the machine room after modification after energy-saving modification in the same ratio; the energy consumption variation of the heat load after the energy-saving transformation is calculated in the computer room; and adjusting the difference between the total energy consumption before modification and the total energy consumption after modification according to the heat load energy consumption variable quantity to obtain the final energy saving amount of the machine room. The energy-saving amount determining method provided by the embodiment of the invention can be better suitable for the complex and changeable environment of the operator computer room, and the accuracy of the energy-saving amount calculating method is improved by considering the condition of equipment heat load change caused by equipment increase and decrease.

title_en: Pixel driving circuit, pixel unit, driving method, array substrate and display device
abstract_en: The application provides a pixel driving circuit, a pixel unit, a driving method, an array substrate and a display device, relates to the technical field of display, and aims to improve the phenomenon of uneven brightness caused by drift of threshold voltage of an LED. A pixel drive circuit comprising: the data writing-in sub-circuit is used for respectively transmitting signals input by the first data voltage end at different moments to the first node under the control of the first scanning signal end; the input and reading sub-circuit is used for transmitting the signal of the signal transmission end to the second node under the control of the first signal end, or reading the electric signal of the second node to the signal transmission end; the driving sub-circuit is used for outputting a driving signal under the control of a signal of a first node, a signal of a second node and a signal of a first voltage end; and the output control sub-circuit is used for transmitting the signal of the first voltage end to the driving sub-circuit and transmitting the driving signal output by the driving sub-circuit to the element to be driven under the control of the enable signal end.

title_en: Imaging apparatus, imaging system, imaging method, and imaging program
abstract_en: The image forming apparatus is provided with: an imaging section (10) that includes a pixel region in which a plurality of pixels are arranged, and that reads pixel signals from the pixels included in the pixel region and outputs the pixel signals; a readout unit control unit (123) that controls a readout unit provided as a part of the pixel region; a recognition unit (12) which has learned training data for each readout unit; a first output unit (124) that outputs the recognition result of the recognition performed by the recognition unit for each readout unit; a second output unit (143) that outputs the pixel signal to a subsequent stage; and a trigger generation unit (16a) that generates a trigger signal for controlling a first timing at which the first output unit outputs the recognition result and a second timing at which the second output unit outputs the pixel signal.

title_en: Scratch-resistant flexible bendable display substrate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scraping-resistant flexible bendable display substrate which comprises a flexible substrate (5) made of a transparent organic material and is characterized in that a buffer layer (1), a transition layer (2), a hardness layer (3) and a wear-resistant layer (4) are sequentially arranged on the flexible substrate (5). The invention has the beneficial effects that: the flexible substrate is coated on the surface of the flexible substrate based on a flexible coating technology and by designing a reasonable film layer structure, so that the friction resistance of the flexible substrate is improved, the display life is effectively prolonged, and the use experience is effectively improved.

title_en: Electric drive and electric control integrated device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-density electric drive and control integrated device, which adopts a multilayer stacked structure, wherein a control module (1), a drive module (2) and a switch module (3) are respectively assembled on an upper layer substrate (5), a middle layer substrate (7) and a lower layer substrate (8), and the substrates are electrically interconnected and mechanically supported through an interconnection pillar (6); a lower-layer radiator (4) is arranged below the switch module (3), and an upper-layer radiator (9) is arranged above the control module (1); radiating side walls (10) are arranged on two sides between the lower-layer radiator (4) and the upper-layer radiator (9); the upper layer substrate (5) and the lower layer substrate (8) are made of AlN gem ceramic substrates or tungsten copper, and the middle layer substrate is made of organic substrates or AlN gem ceramic substrates. The invention improves the power density of the drive and control integrated module product and reduces the packaging volume.

title_en: Electric control cabinet device of rotary drilling rig and installation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric control cabinet device of a rotary drilling rig and an installation method, wherein the electric control cabinet device comprises an electric control cabinet main body, a heat insulation device and an air-cooled heat dissipation system; the electric control cabinet main body is arranged on a main machine of the rotary drilling rig and is arranged among the engine, the auxiliary hydraulic oil tank and the counterweight assembly; the heat insulation sponge is respectively arranged on the engine facing the electric control cabinet main body and the auxiliary hydraulic oil tank facing the electric control cabinet main body, so that the heat radiation of the high temperature of the engine and the auxiliary hydraulic oil tank to the electric control cabinet elements is blocked, and the temperature rise of the surrounding environment of the electric control cabinet caused by the mutual radiation between the engine and the auxiliary hydraulic oil tank is reduced; set up cooling fan and temperature sensor in automatically controlled cabinet main part, the temperature signal direct transmission that temperature sensor responded gives and digs the rig controller soon, and dig the rig controller soon and can control cooling fan's rotational speed according to the actual temperature condition, effectively protected in the automatically controlled cabinet main part various electrical components's performance and life-span, reduced construction cost.

title_en: Outdoor advertising board
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of billboards, in particular to an outdoor billboard. The key points of the technical scheme are as follows: the device comprises a stand column, a bearing part, an installation part and a buffer part; the bearing part is sleeved on the upright post and fixedly connected with the upright post; the mounting part is sleeved on the upright post and positioned above the supporting part, the bottom of the mounting part is connected with the supporting part in a sliding manner, a closed-loop cavity is formed between the mounting part and the upright post, and the mounting part is used for poster sticking; buffering portion includes a plurality of bolster, and the bolster is located closed ring cavity, and the bolster links to each other with stand and installation department respectively, and a plurality of bolster evenly arranges between stand and installation department along the circumference direction of stand, and the bolster is used for buffering the installation department, and this application has the effect that reduces the possibility of bill-board structure fracture damage.

title_en: Electronic equipment and heat dissipation device thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a heat dissipation device, which is used for dissipating heat for electronic equipment and is characterized in that the heat dissipation device comprises a heat dissipation mechanism and a driving mechanism, wherein the heat dissipation mechanism is arranged on the electronic equipment; the driving mechanism drives the heat dissipation cover to be fully or partially retracted into the shell of the electronic equipment, so that the heat dissipation holes are fully or partially stored in the shell. The radiating holes are closed, so that dust or liquid in the external environment can be prevented from entering the inner cavity of the shell through the radiating holes, and the probability that the dust or liquid in the external environment enters the electronic equipment is reduced; the heat dissipation hole is opened to dissipate heat normally. The application also provides an electronic device with the heat dissipation device.

title_en: Driving chip, display panel and driving method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a driving chip, a display panel and a driving method thereof, the driving chip comprises a data signal input module, a pulse width modulation module and a pulse amplitude modulation module, the waveform and the size of a data signal are respectively controlled by the pulse width modulation module and the pulse amplitude modulation module, so that under the common control of the pulse width modulation module and the pulse amplitude modulation module, more display gray scales can be obtained, the brightness to be displayed of a light-emitting unit is more, the gradient level of the light-emitting unit is better, and the size of the data signal can be modulated by the pulse amplitude modulation module, pixels can be compensated, and the display quality of the display panel is improved.

title_en: Apparatus, method and computer program for enabling remote user access to mediated reality content
abstract_en: An apparatus includes means for simultaneously controlling content presented by a handheld portable device and content presented by a spatial audio device and providing a user with a presentation of a first portion of the spatial audio content but not a second portion of the spatial audio content via the handheld portable device but not the spatial audio device in response to a user action.

title_en: Wisdom city is with multi-functional wisdom street lamp
abstract_en: The application discloses a multifunctional smart street lamp for a smart city, which comprises a lamp post, a lamp holder bracket connected with the lamp post and a lamp holder fixed on the lamp holder bracket, wherein a functional module is fixed at the top end of the lamp post, and a top cover part is fixed at the top end of the functional module; the side wall of the lamp post is provided with an air inlet hole; the functional module comprises a hollow lower connecting rod fixed at the top end of the lamp post, a lower connecting cover connected with the lower connecting rod and a cuboid-shaped shell unit connected with the lower connecting cover, and a cooling fan is installed in the lower connecting rod; the top cover part comprises an upper connecting cover connected with the shell unit, a hollow upper connecting rod connected with the upper connecting cover and a top cover connected with the upper connecting rod, the top cover is provided with a cavity and a plurality of air outlet holes for connecting the cavity and the lower surface of the top cover, the top cover is provided with a mounting box, and a controller and a wireless communication unit are mounted in the mounting box. The utility model provides a wisdom street lamp can realize multi-functionally, is fit for being used for constructing wisdom city.

title_en: Multifunctional pin bending mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic element pin folding, in particular to a multifunctional pin bending mechanism which comprises a base, a first lifting driving device arranged on the base, a rotary driving device arranged on the first lifting driving device, a second lifting driving device arranged on the first lifting driving device, and a pin folding clamping device arranged on the second lifting driving device and connected with the rotary driving device, wherein the first lifting driving device is connected with the first lifting driving device; the folding leg clamping device comprises a fixed bushing arranged on the first lifting driving device, a folding leg base arranged on the fixed bushing, a folding leg driving block movably arranged in the fixed bushing and connected with the second lifting driving device, and a folding leg clamping plate arranged on the folding leg base and connected with the folding leg driving block; according to the invention, a plurality of actions are arranged on one mechanism to fold the pins, so that the pins are conveniently clamped and fixed, the pins are conveniently folded, and the structure is reliable.

title_en: Data acquisition, storage and display method for vehicle-mounted video
abstract_en: The invention provides a data acquisition, storage and display method of a vehicle-mounted video, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a video stream data acquisition signal, and executing the creation of a capturer, a parser, a memory and a decoder for capturing data from a preset interface, wherein the parser, the memory and the decoder adopt asynchronous communication and asynchronous operation. The capturer comprises a capturing thread, and the resolver is created by the capturing thread; the analyzer comprises an analysis thread, the analyzer calls the interface to send data to the analysis thread, and the analyzer asynchronously executes analysis operation in the analysis thread. By adopting asynchronous communication, asynchronous processing and chained creating operation, the processing efficiency of data can be improved, time is saved, and the acquisition, decoding and storage of video data can be ensured to be completed before cached video data is automatically cleared in a video cache space.

title_en: Broadcasting directing method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a broadcasting guide method, which comprises the following steps: obtaining guest information of a target studio, wherein the guest information comprises a room identification number of a guest room; generating a broadcasting guide configuration file according to the guest information of the target studio; and sending the director configuration file to a director terminal so that the director terminal can conduct the director operation based on the director configuration file. The embodiment of the invention generates the director configuration file of the target studio by obtaining the guest information and the like, can execute the director operation in the director terminal based on the director configuration file, has simple operation flow and high director efficiency, does not need multi-person cooperative work, and effectively realizes the director transition switching function with low cost and pure software mode. And the equipment cost and the labor cost are reduced without depending on the physical equipment.

title_en: Machine box
abstract_en: The invention provides a case which comprises an upper cover and a lower cover, wherein the upper cover comprises an upper cover body, two first vertical parts and a second vertical part, the two first vertical parts are respectively formed on two opposite first sides of the upper cover body, the second vertical part is formed on a second side of the upper cover body, the lower cover comprises two first side walls, a second side wall and a third side wall, the two first side walls are opposite, the second side wall is opposite to the third side wall, one of the two first vertical parts and the two first side walls is respectively provided with a first clamping piece, the other one of the two first vertical parts and the two first side walls is respectively provided with a first sliding groove, and the first sliding grooves comprise a penetrating part and a clamping part which are mutually communicated; a second clamping piece is arranged on the third side of the upper cover body, and a second sliding groove is formed in the third side wall; the second vertical part is provided with a first fastener, and the second side wall is provided with a second fastener; the first fastener and the second fastener are matched so as to realize the locking of the upper cover and the lower cover. The invention can quickly assemble the upper cover and the lower cover together, thereby saving time and labor.

title_en: Wild domestication system and domestication method for seawater fish proliferation and releasing seedlings
abstract_en: The invention provides a wild domestication system and a wild domestication method for seawater fish proliferation and releasing seedlings, and belongs to the technical field of marine organism resource maintenance. The system is used for domesticating the feeding and predation avoiding capabilities of released fries, enhancing the capability of artificially propagated and proliferated released fries to adapt to the marine natural environment, improving the survival rate of released fries and further improving the proliferation effect of released seawater fishes.

title_en: Fan speed regulating circuit, fan device and display system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fan speed regulating circuit, a fan device and a display system. This fan speed control circuit includes: the temperature detection module is used for detecting the ambient temperature and outputting the adjusting voltage according to the ambient temperature; a square wave generation module comprising: a triangular wave unit for generating a triangular wave voltage; the square wave generating unit is connected with the temperature detection module and the triangular wave unit and used for comparing the triangular wave voltage with the regulating voltage to generate a PWM square wave signal; and the switch module is connected with the square wave generating unit and the fan. The fan speed regulating circuit sets the output end of the temperature detection module as a comparison end for comparing with the triangular wave unit, so that a PWM (pulse width modulation) square wave signal capable of controlling the on-off of the switch module is generated in the square wave generation unit. The switch module can provide power supply voltage with corresponding duty ratio for the fan under the control of the PWM square wave signal, so that the rotating speed of the fan can be controlled, and electric energy is saved.

title_en: Display device and method of driving the same
abstract_en: A display device and a method of driving the display device are provided. The display apparatus includes a first pixel divided into a plurality of blocks, each of the plurality of blocks being classified as either a first block or a second block, a sensor configured to generate first sensing data of at least two first pixels among the first pixels in each of the plurality of blocks during a first period, and a sensing controller; and the sensing controller is configured to generate interpolation data of the first pixels not sensed by the sensor by interpolating the first sensing data for the first block and configured to forgo interpolating the first sensing data for the second block. During a second period after the first period, the sensor generates second sensing data of the first pixels not sensed by the sensor for the second block.

title_en: Device with coil
abstract_en: A device having a coil includes a device housing, a first antenna configured to transmit and/or receive electromagnetic energy, the first antenna having a first operating frequency, a wireless interface configured to communicate with one or more external hearing aid devices via the first antenna, a first element configured as a ground plane for the first antenna, a coil configured to receive signals at a second operating frequency, the second operating frequency being lower than the first operating frequency, a second element configured as a ground plane for the coil, wherein a decoupling element is disposed between the first element and the second element, the decoupling element configured to attenuate a third frequency.

title_en: VR operation stereoscopic image output device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a VR operation stereoscopic image output device which comprises at least one projection unit and a detachable support, wherein the projection unit comprises an aluminum plastic-sprayed shell, an output lens and a rear wiring board, a fixed groove is formed in the middle of the aluminum plastic-sprayed shell, the outer wall of the bottom end of the output lens is connected to the inner wall of the fixed groove, the rear wiring board is located on the outer wall of one side, far away from the output lens, of the aluminum plastic-sprayed shell, a connecting rotating shaft is arranged outside one end of each projection unit, and the opposite sides of the two projection units are connected through the connecting rotating shaft. The two projection units can rotate to adjust the angle, so that the output image can have different polarization effects by utilizing the symmetrical effect, the amplification of different parts and the image switching effect of local areas are further realized, and the adjustment of the output device is more diversified by matching with the detachable support.

title_en: Multilayer electromagnetic shielding composite material based on isolation structure and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an electromagnetic shielding composite material, which comprises an absorption layer and a reflection layer compounded on the absorption layer; the absorbent layer includes a modified resin layer; the modified resin layer has an isolation structure; the reflective layer includes a metal nanowire film layer. The electromagnetic shielding composite material with the specific structure and the composition is obtained by adopting the specific layer material and combining the laminated structure of the absorption layer and the reflection layer, wherein the absorption layer is of a special isolation structure. The composite material has the advantages of high electromagnetic shielding efficiency, low electromagnetic wave reflection, excellent mechanical property and the like, and the absorption layer is a special isolation structure which can promote the fillers in the absorption layer to be mutually overlapped to form a filler network, so that the shielding efficiency of the absorption layer is improved to the greatest extent, and the reflection of the composite material to the electromagnetic wave is further reduced. The electromagnetic shielding composite material can replace the traditional electromagnetic shielding composite material and is applied to the emerging 5G communication field and the aerospace field.

title_en: Monitoring system for mining area production and real-time monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring system for mining area production, which comprises a server terminal, an exchanger, a substation, a plurality of cameras and a plurality of sensors arranged in each device, wherein the server terminal is respectively connected with the signal output ends of the exchanger, the cameras and the substation according to different communication protocols, the signal output end of each sensor is connected with the corresponding signal input end of the server terminal so as to receive device alarm information input by the sensors, and the server terminal is also wirelessly connected with a plurality of mobile receiving ends so as to transmit state information output by the sensors and the substation to the mobile receiving ends.

title_en: Imaging module, camera assembly and electronic device
abstract_en: The application provides an imaging module, camera subassembly and electron device. The imaging module comprises a shell; and a reflective element, an image sensor, a lens assembly, a motion element, and a drive mechanism all disposed within the housing; the imaging module further comprises a module circuit board, the module circuit board is fixed on the shell and comprises a reinforcing plate, and the reinforcing plate is communicated with a grounding pin of the module circuit board so that the shell is grounded. In the imaging module, camera subassembly and the electron device of this application embodiment, the module circuit board is fixed on the shell, and is limited at the imaging module volume, when not having the space to increase electrically conductive cloth and carry out ground connection processing, utilizes the stiffening plate that sets up at the module circuit board as the bridge, and the ground connection pin and the shell of intercommunication module circuit board realize that the ground connection of shell is handled.

title_en: Camera module and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses module and electronic equipment make a video recording belongs to the technical field of making a video recording. This module of making a video recording includes module support, camera and anti-shake cloud platform, and the camera includes camera lens and sensitization chip, and the camera lens passes through the anti-shake cloud platform and sets up in the module support movably, and the sensitization chip is fixed on the module support, is equipped with first track on the module support, and the anti-shake cloud platform is movably to be cooperated with first track, and the anti-shake cloud platform drives the camera lens and removes between primary importance and second place. The distance between the lens and the photosensitive chip is a first distance under the condition that the lens is at the first position, and the distance between the lens and the photosensitive chip is a second distance under the condition that the lens is at the second position, wherein the first distance is smaller than the second distance. This scheme can solve the camera module that possesses the anti-shake function and can't zoom at the shooting in-process problem.

title_en: Optical detection and ranging apparatus and method of increasing dynamic range thereof
abstract_en: Systems and methods for capturing objects having different reflectivity levels are disclosed. In one embodiment, a LiDAR device may sequentially illuminate objects with high reflectivity and scenes with low reflectivity using laser pulses that differ by one or more orders of magnitude. The LiDAR device may use cross-correlation to combine an image frame with one or more image frames captured at a reduced illumination to obtain a composite image frame. As the dynamic range increases, the composite image frame is able to simultaneously display high-reflectivity objects and low-reflectivity objects at a desired size.

title_en: Adjustable lobe shape for array microphone
abstract_en: The invention provides an array microphone system and method with adjustable lobe shape. The lobe shape of the pick-up pattern in the array microphone may be adjusted by weighting the audio signals of the subset of microphone elements that make up the array. The lobe shape may be adjusted in a direction independent of the steering vector of the lobe. The user may have greater control over the lobes, which may result in more efficient and optimal coverage of the audio sources in the environment.

title_en: Inverted phase hole puncher for sound production
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hole digger, in particular to an inverted hole digger for sound production. The technical problem is how to design a phase reversal hole tapper for sound production, which can replace manual work to tap a hole on a wood board, is convenient to operate and prevents hands from being injured. An inverted hole tap for sound production, comprising: the device comprises a worktable with holes, wherein an n-type mounting plate is fixedly connected to one side outside the worktable with holes; the baffle, the rigid coupling of baffle symmetry formula is in be close to n type mounting panel the outer side of foraminiferous workstation. According to the wood board punching machine, the wood board is placed on the workbench with the holes between the two baffle plates, the rotating mechanism is started to drive the hole punching part of the hole punching mechanism to rotate, then the hole punching mechanism is started, the hole punching mechanism is operated to be in contact with the wood board to punch the hole, and the wood board is punched with the phase inversion holes, so that the wood board does not need to be punched manually, the operation is convenient, and the hand can be prevented from being injured.

title_en: Earphone charging box, charging control method and charging equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an earphone charging box, a charging control method and charging equipment, wherein the earphone charging box comprises an upper charging box shell, a lower charging box shell, a charging bin positioned in an inner cavity of the lower charging box shell, a main control circuit board and a charging box charging battery, the main control circuit board is fixed on one side of the outer surface of an earphone accommodating cavity, and a heating coil is fixed between the earphone accommodating cavities; the main control circuit board is electrically connected with a temperature detector and a control switch, the control switch is electrically connected with the heating coil, the temperature detector is used for detecting the ambient temperature or/and the battery temperature of the charging box, and the control unit MCU judges whether the control heating coil is connected with or disconnected from the control switch according to the comparison condition of the detected ambient temperature or/and the battery temperature of the charging box and the preset optimal temperature. This application can ensure to provide the best temperature of charging for the box that charges to guarantee that the charging current of earphone charging box can be in enough big state and charge, very big improvement charging speed to the earphone.

title_en: Energy-concerving and environment-protective type solar energy culture media display device of multi-angle show
abstract_en: The invention relates to multi-angle display energy-saving and environment-friendly solar culture media display equipment which comprises a supporting upright post, a solar panel, a plurality of display screens and a lifting device, wherein the lifting device is arranged corresponding to the display screens and used for adjusting the height positions of the display screens, the solar panel is arranged at the upper part of the supporting upright post and is electrically connected with the display screens, the display screens are respectively distributed on the outer sides of the supporting upright post in a staggered mode, the lifting device comprises a sliding rail and a winding drum, the sliding rail is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the supporting upright post along the axial direction of the supporting upright post, the display screens are in sliding connection with the sliding rail, and the winding drum is used. The plurality of display screens are respectively distributed on the outer sides of the supporting stand columns in a staggered manner, so that consumers can watch the content of the display screens at a plurality of angles, the display screens are connected to the sliding rails of the supporting stand columns in a sliding manner through the lifting devices, the winding drums adjust the height positions of the display screens on the sliding rails, the traction ropes of the winding drums are fixed after adjustment, and the beneficial effect of multi-angle advertising is achieved.

title_en: Charging seat, battery system and electric tool
abstract_en: The invention discloses a charging seat, a battery system and an electric tool, wherein the charging seat comprises: the casing, the casing including be used for supporting the bottom that the charging seat stood and with the top that the bottom set up relatively, the inside accommodation space that is used for holding electrical components that is provided with of casing, the casing is provided with a plurality of circulation of air passageways that run through the casing wall thickness, circulation of air passageway have with the first opening of accommodation space intercommunication and with the second opening of exterior space intercommunication, first opening ratio the second opening is close to the top. The charging seat has good heat dissipation effect, can effectively reduce rain, snow, dust, foreign matters and the like from entering the shell, and has good dustproof and rainproof effect.

title_en: Detection device and detection method thereof
abstract_en: A detection device and a detection method thereof, the detection device comprising: the detection assembly is used for detecting the overlay mark of the object to be detected, and the overlay mark comprises a first mark and a second mark; the motion platform is used for enabling the detection assembly and the object to be detected to move relatively; the detection method comprises the following steps: the detection component acquires a first image containing a first mark; the motion acquisition device acquires the vibration value of the motion platform within a first exposure time to obtain a first jitter value sequence; the detection component acquires a second image containing a second mark; the motion acquisition device acquires a second jitter value sequence within a second exposure time; acquiring a first jitter compensation value of the first mark and a second jitter compensation value of the second mark according to the first jitter value sequence and the second jitter value sequence; and acquiring the alignment error of the first mark and the second mark in the detection plane according to the first image, the second image, the first jitter compensation value and the second jitter compensation value. By adopting the scheme, the accuracy of the alignment error detection result can be improved.

title_en: Image processing method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure discloses an image processing method and device and electronic equipment. One embodiment of the method comprises: acquiring images to be processed shot by a camera under different shooting poses, wherein the images to be processed comprise a first image and a second image, the first image comprises a target object image and a scene image, and the second image comprises a scene image, the first image and the second image are shot in the same scene; the shooting pose of the camera is adjusted according to the automatic adjustment of the pose of the preset mechanical arm; determining a target mask for segmenting an image of the scene and an image of the target object from the first image and the second image; an image of the target object is cropped from the first image using the target mask. The camera capable of automatically adjusting the shooting pose shoots the image to be processed, so that the cost is saved, the target mask corresponding to the image of the target object in the first image is automatically marked, the image of the target object in the first image can be cut out, the marking process is reduced, and the burden of workers is reduced.

title_en: Microphone and electronic device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microphone and an electronic device. The microphone comprises a shell, wherein a cavity is formed in the shell, and the shell is also provided with a sound hole communicated with the cavity; the circuit board is arranged at one end of the accommodating cavity far away from the sound hole; the annular magnet is accommodated in the cavity and fixedly connected with the cavity wall of the cavity; and the vibration component is connected with the annular magnet and electrically connected with the circuit board, at least part of the vibration component is positioned at the inner side of an annular space formed by enclosing the annular magnet, the vibration component faces towards the sound hole, audio can pass through the sound hole to enter the accommodating cavity and drive the vibration component to vibrate in the accommodating cavity so as to enable the vibration component to cut a magnetic induction line to generate a current signal. The technical scheme of the invention aims to improve the acoustic performance and the service life of the microphone.

title_en: Display device and driving method of display device
abstract_en: A display device and a driving method of the display device are provided. The display device includes a display panel having a plurality of pixels, a display panel driver, and a region compensation circuit that divides the display panel into a plurality of unit blocks, obtains a load value of input image data for the unit blocks, and generates corrected image data by correcting the input image data based on the load value. Each of the load values corresponds to one of the cell blocks. The display panel driver generates a data signal for displaying an image on the display panel based on the corrected image data. When the gradation values included in the input image data are the same, the brightness of the image displayed on the display panel decreases as being away from the center of the reference block having the largest load value among the unit blocks based on the corrected image data.

title_en: Display device and control method of display device
abstract_en: A display device and a control method of the display device. When the image is restored from the standby state, the image can be displayed in a short time. A projector (1) comprises: a CPU (10); a volatile 1 st memory (11) which is reset when the projector (1) shifts to a standby state; and a volatile 2 nd memory (12) capable of maintaining data in a standby state of the projector (1). When the projector (1) shifts to a standby state, the CPU (10) stores OSD data (17) in the 2 nd memory (12).

title_en: Cartoon image quality evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cartoon image quality evaluation method, which comprises the steps of extracting a structure feature vector and a color feature vector to form a feature vector in consideration of the influence of saturation, contrast and brightness adjustment on cartoon image quality in a training stage, then training the feature vectors of all adjusted cartoon images by using support vector regression, and constructing a support vector regression training model of the adjusted cartoon images; in the testing stage, the objective quality evaluation predicted value of the adjusted cartoon image in the testing set is obtained through calculating the feature vector of the adjusted cartoon image in the testing set and regressing the training model according to the support vector of the adjusted cartoon image constructed in the training stage, and the obtained feature vector can better reflect the influence of saturation, contrast and brightness adjustment on the quality of the cartoon image, so that the correlation between the objective evaluation result and human eye subjective perception is effectively improved.

title_en: Electric control box assembly and air conditioner with same
