abstract_en: The invention provides an electric control box assembly and an air conditioner with the same, wherein the electric control box assembly comprises a circuit box and a junction box, the circuit box is fixedly connected with the junction box, a circuit board is arranged in the circuit box, a junction plate is arranged in the junction box, the circuit box comprises an outer side plate, a detachable cover of the outer side plate is arranged at an opening of the circuit box, the junction box comprises an upper cover, and the detachable cover of the upper cover is arranged at the opening of the junction box. According to the invention, through the arrangement of the detachable upper cover and the outer side plate, the overhaul of the wiring board and the circuit board is not affected, more sufficient operation space is provided especially when the circuit board is overhauled, the steps of disassembling and installing the wiring board are omitted, the overhaul time of the circuit board is greatly saved, the risk of damaging the wiring board is avoided to a certain extent, meanwhile, the first box body and the outer side plate are made of metal materials, and the fireproof performance of the electric control box is greatly improved due to the arrangement of the fireproof plate.

title_en: Flow state video monitoring-based method and system for diagnosing structural damage of water passing building
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for diagnosing structural damage of a water passing building based on flow state video monitoring, wherein the system comprises a high-definition fog-penetrating camera, a base, a special workstation and a computer display; the high-definition fog-penetrating camera is arranged on the base; a cavity is arranged in the base; the network interface and the power interface of the high-definition fog-penetrating camera are arranged in the cavity; an intelligent wiper module is arranged on the high-definition fog-penetrating camera; the power interface, the computer display and the special workstation are respectively connected with a power supply through a power line; the network interface is connected with the special workstation through a data transmission line; the special workstation comprises an image analysis module, a background database and an alarm module. The invention innovates a method for diagnosing whether the structure of the water passing building is damaged by adopting video monitoring of the drainage flow state and the water surface line, can timely find out the abnormal flow state in the drainage process, timely take measures to stop damage, and can be widely applied to the fields of drainage facility safety monitoring, teaching and research and the like.

title_en: Pixel value correction method and pixel value correction device
abstract_en: The application relates to a pixel value correction method and a pixel value correction device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining input image data generated by a plurality of pixels, wherein the input image data comprises a first group of pixel values of a first color plane and a second group of pixel values of a second color plane which are respectively output by a first part and a second part of the plurality of pixels; determining a difference function between a plurality of groups of filter response values and a plurality of groups of target values, wherein the plurality of groups of filter response values are generated by filtering a plurality of first estimation pixel values and a plurality of second estimation pixel values which respectively correspond to the first color plane and the second color plane of the estimated image data by using a plurality of groups of characteristic filter coefficients; determining a set of correction filter coefficients by solving a solution for the estimated image data when the difference function has a minimum value; and causing a filter circuit to filter the input image data using the set of correction filter coefficients to correct the first set of pixel values.

title_en: Display control device, method, and computer program
abstract_en: The easiness of viewing an actual scene in front of the driver's visual field and an image displayed so as to overlap with the actual scene is improved. A display control device controls an image display unit that displays an image in a region overlapping with a foreground when viewed from a driver of a vehicle, the display control device displaying a 1 st information image (210) and a 2 nd information image (220), and when detecting a line-of-sight direction of the driver of the vehicle, determining that the 1 st information image (210) has been recognized, reducing visibility; when it is determined that the 2 nd information image (220) has been recognized, the recognition is made not lower than the 1 st information image (210).

title_en: Internet of things-based impact detection method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to an impact detection method and system based on the Internet of things. The video file sent by the monitoring equipment is a video file which is T seconds before and after the triggering time after the signal of the triggering time is received, the requirement on the storage space of the video file is reduced, the data transmission quantity is small, the data processed by the server side is also small, and the power consumption of the outdoor equipment is reduced on the whole.

title_en: Remote data acquisition control device
abstract_en: The invention provides a remote data acquisition control device, and relates to the technical field of data acquisition control. This remote data acquisition control device, including mounting substrate, the symmetry has seted up mounting hole, four around being between the both sides wall about mounting substrate middle part both sides mounting substrate roof is the rectangle form setting, the mounting substrate roof has the controller through four screw fixed mounting, and the accessible controller carries out remote data acquisition control work, the controller roof is provided with control panel. Through being provided with liftable formula installation mechanism, can carry out convenient nimble installation, and set up the dustproof wind guiding mechanism of good controller, be provided with good controller connection wire in addition and accomodate the structure.

title_en: Ecological agriculture tourism indicating device
abstract_en: The invention provides an ecological agriculture tourism indicating device, which belongs to the technical field of ecological tourism indication and comprises an indicating main body and a top cover, wherein a map sample is arranged on the right side of the front surface of the indicating main body, an indicating sample is arranged on the left side of the front surface of the indicating main body, a solar panel is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the top cover, and a supporting column is fixedly connected to the top of the top cover. This ecological agriculture tourism indicating device, in the use, through the setting of map sample, the visitor can refer according to the map sample, so that the visitor arrives the assigned position, through the setting of instructing the sample, the visitor can look over according to instructing the sample, so that the visitor can confirm the direction, and detailed content, setting through solar panel, make this indicating device can the energy saving, reduce the cost, through the setting of aeolian bell, when wind blows the aeolian bell, can be according to the rotational speed of aeolian bell, judge the size of wind-force.

title_en: Converter box body assembly
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of frequency converters, and particularly relates to a frequency converter box body assembly which comprises a box body and a base; a first groove is formed in the side wall of one side of the box body, and a second groove is formed in the side wall of the other side of the box body; a group of heat dissipation holes are formed in the bottoms of the first groove and the second groove; a first annular groove is formed in the side wall of the first groove, and a first filter screen is rotatably connected in the first annular groove; a second filter screen is fixedly connected to the side wall of the second groove; a protective shell is connected to the inner wall of the first groove in a threaded manner; the invention provides a frequency converter box body assembly which aims to solve the problems that a fan is generally arranged on a frequency converter box body to blow air for heat dissipation, but in winter, the outside temperature is low, the inside of the frequency converter box body can exchange heat energy with the outside rapidly for rapid heat dissipation, and at the moment, the fan is not needed to provide additional heat dissipation energy, but the fan can block natural heat dissipation of heat dissipation holes.

title_en: Full-automatic intelligent grouting machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-automatic intelligent grouting machine, which comprises: the right end of the main body is connected with a motor, the output end of the motor is connected with a belt, and the motor is connected with the first fixed block through the belt; the inner side of the intelligent grouting machine head is connected with a pneumatic hydraulic machine, and the output end of the pneumatic hydraulic machine is in lap joint with a grouting material nozzle; the inner side of the second fixed block is connected with the tray in a clamping manner, the outer side of the second fixed block is connected with a second extension spring for resetting the tray, and the second fixed block slides in the main body; the pneumatic box is provided with a monitoring system on a main body, monitors the working state of the full-automatic intelligent grouting machine and sends a monitoring result to the cloud server; the main body is also provided with a relay; and the cloud server is used for analyzing the monitoring result and controlling the relay to be opened or closed according to the analysis result. This full-automatic intelligent grouting machine, the automatic intelligent grout of not only being convenient for, work efficiency is high, and the convenience is fixed the tray moreover to be convenient for fill full even.

title_en: Control system based on integrated controller and engineering machinery
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an integrated controller-based control system and engineering machinery. Belonging to the field of engineering machinery control. The equipment control end comprises a lower end integrated controller, and the lower end integrated controller is used for acquiring and sending working parameters of the engineering machinery, engine operation data and video information of a working area through a wireless network; the remote operation end comprises an upper end integrated controller and audio and video display equipment, and the upper end integrated controller is used for receiving and sending the received working parameters of the engineering machinery, the engine operation data and the video information of the working area through the wireless network; and the sound and video display equipment is used for receiving and displaying the working parameters of the engineering machinery, the engine operation data and the video information which are sent by the upper end integrated controller. The invention reduces components through the function integration of the lower end integrated controller and the upper end integrated controller, saves cost and improves reliability.

title_en: Filter equipment and rack that ecological photoelectricity rack of intelligence was intake
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air inlet filtering device of an intelligent ecological photoelectric cabinet, which is arranged on the vertical surface of a shell of the cabinet and filters outside air through a fan structure and then sucks the air inwards; the filter comprises a filter structure and a pressing mechanism, wherein the filter structure comprises a fine filter body and a coarse filter grid, and the fine filter body and the pressing mechanism are arranged at an air inlet of a shell; the coarse filter grid is arranged outside the fine filter body, and outside air firstly passes through the filter grid and then enters the shell through the fine filter body; the coarse filter grid is provided with a third power part, and the coarse filter grid is pushed to turn over by the third power part. Still disclose a rack simultaneously, adopt above-mentioned filter equipment, guarantee the radiating efficiency of taking a breath of this dustproof rack through filter equipment's change.

title_en: Drive control circuit, drive method, shift register and display device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a drive control circuit, a drive method, a shift register and a display device, relates to the technical field of display, and aims to effectively avoid the phenomenon of screen flashing during starting. The drive control circuit includes: the control module is used for responding to the first clock signal and the second clock signal and transmitting voltage signals to the first node and the second node; the output module comprises a first potential signal line, a second potential signal line, an output wiring, a first node and a second node, and is used for responding to control signals of the first node and the second node and transmitting a voltage signal to the output wiring; a first state and a display state, the first state preceding the display state; and the protection module is used for responding to the control signal to transmit the effective voltage signal to the first node under the first state so that the output module transmits the ineffective voltage signal to the output wiring.

title_en: Remote-control electronic commerce information interaction equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention provides remote control electronic commerce information interaction equipment and a remote control electronic commerce information interaction method, the remote control electronic commerce information interaction equipment comprises interaction equipment, wherein the inner side of the interaction equipment comprises a display screen, a switch, a camera, a controller, a processor, a signal receiver and a signal transmitter, a transmission mechanism capable of moving vertically and a cleaning mechanism capable of cleaning automatically are arranged in the interaction equipment, the controller, the processor, the signal receiver and the signal transmitter are all arranged in the interaction equipment, the switch and the camera are arranged in a vertical corresponding mode, the display screen is inlaid in the inner side of the interaction equipment, when a gear rotates, a tooth plate and the tooth plate are rotationally jogged, a rotating disc rotates by taking an axle center as a fulcrum, the rotating direction of the rotating disc is opposite to the rotating direction of the tooth plate, a push rod is driven to move in an inclined mode when the rotating disc rotates, the push rod pushes a sliding block to slide in a sliding rail, and a folding plate is integrally extruded downwards, so that the folding plate can drive a scraping plate to clean and scrape the surface of the camera.

title_en: Page display processing method and device based on special-shaped screen and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a page display processing method and device based on a special-shaped screen and computer equipment. The method comprises the following steps: displaying a main page based on a shaped screen including sensor holes; receiving triggering operation acting on a preset area of the main page, wherein the preset area is an area corresponding to the sensor hole; responding to the triggering operation, and displaying a sub page on the main page; and starting the front camera according to the triggering operation, and displaying the image data acquired by the front camera through the sub-page. By adopting the method, the page of the image acquired by the front camera can be displayed on the sub-page, the main page is not influenced, and the convenience of page display is effectively improved.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: A display device comprises a display panel, a conductive pad, an external circuit board and an adhesive layer. The display panel includes inner pins exposed at the side edges. The conductive pads are arranged on the side edge of the display panel and connected with the inner pins. The external circuit board is arranged at the side edge of the display panel and comprises an outer pin, wherein a conductive protruding structure is arranged on the outer pin and at least contacts the conductive pad, so that the external circuit board is electrically connected to the display panel. The adhesive layer is arranged between the external circuit board and the display panel.

title_en: Biological diversity protection system for wild animals and plants
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wild animal and plant biodiversity protection system, which comprises a heat insulation shell, wherein both sides of the top of the heat insulation shell are provided with a camera shooting expansion port and a chute, an arc-shaped sliding plate is arranged above the camera shooting expansion port, a waterproof sleeve is arranged below the camera shooting expansion port, the camera shooting expansion port can be conveniently moved through an arranged roller to replace manual long-distance trekking, the arc-shaped sliding plate can be moved when a motor in a third motor box is started through an arranged tooth meshing groove and a tooth grinding wheel, so that the arc-shaped sliding plate is far away from the top of the camera shooting expansion port to further communicate the top of the camera shooting expansion port with the outside, then a first camera extends out of the heat insulation shell through the camera shooting expansion port through an extending sealing ring, then the first camera is rotated to observe the periphery by starting the motor in the first motor box to replace manual observation, the waterproof sleeve can prevent the first camera from water inflow.

title_en: Crease detection method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of display screen body detection, and discloses a crease detection method, which comprises the following steps: obtaining a test image when a folding screen is in a flat state, and determining a crease effect parameter value of the folding screen according to the test image, wherein the test image at least comprises a pure color display picture of the folding screen; the determining a crease effect parameter value of the folded screen according to the test image comprises: determining a crease area and a reference area of the folded screen in the test image; acquiring a first display parameter value of the crease area and a second display parameter value of the reference area; and determining a crease effect parameter value of the folding screen according to the first display parameter value and the second display parameter value, wherein the crease effect parameter value is used for representing the display effect difference between the crease area and the reference area. The crease detection method and the crease detection device provided by the invention provide an objective, accurate and reproducible crease detection method.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: The display device includes: a first region and a second region each including a plurality of pixels; and a plurality of wirings respectively connected to the plurality of pixels to transmit signals; wherein the number of pixels per unit area in the second region is smaller than the number of pixels per unit area in the first region, and the number of wirings per unit area in the second region is smaller than the number of wirings per unit area in the first region.

title_en: Middle frame assembly and display device
abstract_en: A middle frame assembly and a display device relate to the field of display devices, and the middle frame assembly comprises a first frame body, a second frame body and a transmission assembly connected between the first frame body and the second frame body; the transmission assembly is arranged in such a way that the second frame body can rotate relative to the first frame body so as to be switched between a first folding state and a first flattening state; the transmission assembly is further arranged to drive the second frame body to move towards the direction close to the first frame body in the process that the second frame body rotates to the first folding state along the first direction. The middle frame assembly of the embodiment of the disclosure can reduce the size of the frame.

title_en: Can accomodate formula electronic information communication equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a storable electronic information communication device, which comprises a box body, universal wheels, a control switch, a power line, a heat dissipation fan, a clamping groove and a box cover, wherein auxiliary fixing devices are horizontally and oppositely arranged on the left side and the right side of the top of a bearing plate, a driving mechanism is arranged at the right end of a first shell, the driving mechanism drives a connecting rod group to drive a fixing plate to move through a rotary plate and a first sliding block, so that the fixing plate is abutted against the outer surface of the communication device, the effect of auxiliary fixing of the communication device is achieved, and the collision and damage of the communication device are prevented.

title_en: Outdoor network cabinet for 5G-based communication and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication. The outdoor network cabinet based on 5G communication comprises a base and a cabinet body arranged on the base, wherein a heat insulation layer is arranged on the outer surface of the cabinet body; the base comprises a base plate and a pre-buried radiating pipe, a mounting groove which is sunken downwards and matched with the cabinet body is formed in the center of the base plate, and a plurality of positioning holes are formed in the bottom surface of the mounting groove in a matrix shape; the pre-buried radiating pipe is installed in the locating hole and stretches into soil, and the upper end of the pre-buried radiating pipe is connected with the cabinet body. The invention can fully utilize soil as a heat exchange source, thereby realizing the heat dissipation of the interior of the cabinet body, solving the problem of heat dissipation of the cabinet body under the extreme temperature condition and ensuring that the network cabinet is always in a better working condition.

title_en: Convertible workstation and wicking device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a turnover type workbench which comprises an installation platform and a workbench, wherein the workbench is connected to the installation platform through a rotating shaft, and the axis of the rotating shaft is parallel to the horizontal plane of the installation platform, so that the workbench can turn over along with the rotating shaft under the action of external force, a workpiece or a workpiece and a clamp thereof are placed on the workbench, the workpiece turns over along with the rotating shaft when the workbench turns over under the action of external force, and the workpiece or the clamp thereof is not subjected to the external force. The invention also discloses a tin immersion device comprising the turnover type workbench. The turnover worktable of the invention has simple and easily controlled turnover motion, is easy to realize the function of inclining a workpiece on the worktable for a certain angle relative to the initial placement state, realizes automatic operation in tin immersion application, and improves the working efficiency.

title_en: Video processing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a video processing method, a video processing apparatus, an electronic device, and a storage medium. The video processing method comprises the following steps: acquiring a low-resolution video; labeling the low-resolution video with a quality label through a quality grading model; and performing super-resolution processing on the low-resolution video by utilizing a super-resolution model corresponding to the quality label according to the quality label of the low-resolution video. Therefore, the appropriate super-resolution model can be selected according to the video quality to perform the super-resolution processing, and the appropriate super-resolution processing can be performed on the low-resolution video.

title_en: Multi-sense viewing experience enhancement method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for enhancing multi-sensory viewing experience, firstly, a multi-sensory viewing request (at least comprising a video ID of a video to be viewed) sent by a user is received and analyzed, and a video ID corresponding to the multi-sensory viewing request is obtained; then obtaining a dynamic effect configuration file (comprising a preset time point location, a special effect type and/or a dynamic effect resource file downloading address) of the video to be watched from a preset database according to the video ID; finally, calling a dynamic effect engine, and performing special effect rendering on the video to be viewed according to the dynamic effect configuration file so as to enhance multi-sense viewing experience. The method and the device can provide an all-around, multi-sense and three-dimensional film watching mode, and enable a user to fully utilize the equipment capability and the interaction mode to further meet the film watching experience, so that the purposes of multi-sense mobilization and enhancement of the film watching experience of the user are achieved.

title_en: Test method and noise reduction test device for noise reduction equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a test method of noise reduction equipment, which is applied to a noise reduction test device and comprises the following steps: presetting a plurality of noise reduction gain values; in a preset noise environment, acquiring noise data of the to-be-tested noise reduction equipment under each noise reduction gain value, wherein the noise data comprises first noise data of the to-be-tested noise reduction equipment when noise reduction is started and second noise data of the to-be-tested noise reduction equipment when noise reduction is closed; obtaining a first frequency response curve according to the first noise data under each noise reduction gain value, obtaining a second frequency response curve according to the second noise data under the noise reduction gain value, and calculating the variation between the first frequency response curve and the second frequency response curve; and determining the noise reduction gain value corresponding to the maximum variation as the optimal noise reduction gain value of the noise reduction equipment to be tested. The method and the device can determine the optimal noise reduction gain value of the noise reduction equipment to be tested, ensure the optimal noise reduction effect of the noise reduction equipment to be tested, and improve the accuracy of the test result. The application also discloses a noise reduction testing device.

title_en: Building electrical construction safety device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a building electrical construction safety device, includes base (4), regulator cubicle (5), its characterized in that: the base (4) is arranged at the lower end of the electric cabinet (5), a cabinet door (3) is arranged at the front end of the electric cabinet (5), the electric cabinet (5) and the two partition plates (10) are fixedly connected through two connecting blocks (8) respectively, two rotating shafts (9) are arranged inside the two connecting blocks (8) respectively, and a first gear (11) is fixed at the upper end of the rotating shaft (9) on the left side of the fan blade (23). The safety protection device for building electrical construction has the advantages of preventing corrosion, prolonging the service life, preventing rainwater from entering the interior of the protection cover and protecting electrical elements due to the fact that the protection cover is provided with the solar cell panel.

title_en: Image display device, method, chip, liquid crystal display and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an image display device, method, chip, liquid crystal display and storage medium, the device includes: the acquisition module is used for acquiring pixel data in the image data, wherein the pixel data has a first bit depth which is higher than the driving bit depth of the liquid crystal display; the data mapping module is used for increasing the pixel data from the first bit depth to the second bit depth by searching a first preset table, and the first preset table is used for representing the corresponding relation of the pixel data with different bit depths; the first dithering module is used for dithering the pixel data with the second bit depth by searching a second preset table, so that the pixel data is reduced from the second bit depth to the driving bit depth, and the second preset table is used for representing whether the value of the pixel data with the reduced bit depth is modified or not; and the driving module is used for displaying based on the pixel data after the dithering, and can realize that the dithered image achieves the display effect of full color gradation.

title_en: Method, device and storage medium for judging video scene switching
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a method, a device and a storage medium for judging video scene switching. The method comprises the following steps: respectively extracting subimages comprising image center pixel points aiming at a first frame image and a second frame image which are continuous in a video to obtain a first center subimage and a second center subimage; calculating to obtain a pixel mean value of the first central subimage according to the pixel value of each pixel point in the first central subimage; calculating to obtain a pixel mean value of the second central sub-image according to the pixel value of each pixel point in the second central sub-image; and determining whether video scene switching occurs when the first frame image is switched to the second frame image in the video according to the magnitude relation between a first absolute difference value of the pixel mean value of the first central sub-image and the pixel mean value of the second central sub-image and a preset threshold value. By adopting the method disclosed by the invention, the calculated amount for judging the video scene switching can be reduced so as to achieve the purpose of processing the video in real time.

title_en: Circuit board, semiconductor device, power conversion device, and moving object
abstract_en: Whether or not the 1 st electronic component generates heat can be easily confirmed by visual observation independently of whether or not the 2 nd electronic component generates heat. Alternatively, whether or not the circuit board is exposed to heat can be easily confirmed by visual inspection. The 1 st electronic component and the 2 nd electronic component are mounted on the printed board. The temperature indicating resin is in contact with the 1 st electronic component but not in contact with the 2 nd electronic component. When the temperature rises, the temperature indicating resin changes visually. Alternatively, the electronic component is mounted on the printed board. The temperature indicating resin is in contact with the printed circuit board but not in contact with the electronic component. When the temperature rises, the temperature indicating resin changes visually.

title_en: Video interface female and male, electronic equipment, patch cord and external equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a female and male video interface, electronic equipment, an adapter wire and external equipment, and belongs to the field of intelligent equipment. The video interface female head is provided with a universal serial bus interface, a digital component serial interface, an analog high-definition camera interface and a registered socket interface, the video interface female head is provided with pins, the pins form the universal serial bus interface, the digital component serial interface, the analog high-definition camera interface and the registered socket interface, the plug detection pins are used for detecting plug events generated by plugging the video interface female head and the video interface male head, and the type detection pins are used for detecting camera type information in external equipment electrically connected with the video interface female head through the video interface male head. The application greatly improves the compatibility, diversity and flexibility of the external camera by integrating various common interfaces.

title_en: Image automation debugging method, system, medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an image automatic debugging method, a system, a medium and equipment, comprising the following steps: step 1: connecting the PC to the lamp box through the USB interface, and switching the color temperature of the lamp box according to the lamp box control command through an image debugging tool on the PC; step 2: after the color temperature of the lamp box is switched, the camera equipment is controlled to capture images by using the socket server through the Ethernet connection equipment, and the image data is transmitted to an image debugging tool; and step 3: calculating image brightness and color information according to the image data to obtain debugging parameters of automatic exposure and color; and 4, step 4: and sending the debugging parameters obtained by calculation to the camera equipment and the PC for image display. The method has simple steps, more automatic image debugging and no need of manually operating the lamp box and repeatedly iterating and configuring parameters.

title_en: Double-flow time sequence self-adaptive selection video quality evaluation method for original video of user
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of video processing of original user content, and discloses a double-flow time sequence self-adaptive selection video quality evaluation method for original user video, which comprises the following steps of 1: distributing an intra-frame quality perception module based on the content weight; 2: double-flow global time domain modeling; 3: dual stream deeper level loss function weight allocation. The method extracts video quality features from two dimensions of a time domain and a space domain, extracts a multi-scale feature map in the space domain, and performs weight redistribution on the feature map by combining human eye visual saliency perception. In the aspect of time domain, a double-flow deeper RNN structure is introduced, and the forward and backward time sequence information is iterated to extract the deeper double-time sequence information. Finally, the last score is regressed after the distribution of the loss functions of different perception levels and sequences by the depth supervision module. On four UGC-VQA databases, further performance improvement is achieved compared with the current best deep learning method.

title_en: Optical film and flexible display device
abstract_en: Provide a liquid crystal display device which is excellent in wide-angle visibility and visibility of a projected image and has a low in-plane retardation R 0 And a flexible display device provided with the same. The optical film contains at least one selected from polyimide resin and polyamide resin1 type having a total light transmittance of 85% or more, a haze of 0.5% or less, a tensile modulus of 5.1GPa or more at 25 ℃ and an in-plane retardation R 0 40 to 300nm, and a 1 st reflection image value C obtained according to JIS K7374 in a direction inclined by 60 DEG from the perpendicular direction to the MD direction with respect to the plane of the optical film, wherein the MD direction is a direction parallel to the machine traveling direction during production, and the TD direction is a direction perpendicular to the machine traveling direction, and the slit width of an optical comb is 0.125mm, on at least any one surface of the optical film MD And a 2 nd reflection image characteristic value C in a direction inclined by 60 DEG from the vertical direction toward the TD direction TD Satisfies the following conditions: formula (1): c is more than or equal to 45% MD Less than or equal to 100% (1), formula (2): c is more than or equal to 30 percent TD Less than or equal to 100% (2), formula (3): 35 percent to less than or equal to (C) MD +C TD )/2≤100％(3)。

title_en: Exposure control method and system of real-time high dynamic range image based on cloud rendering platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an exposure control method and system of a real-time high dynamic range image based on a cloud rendering platform, wherein the cloud rendering platform of a server executes rendering operation based on a received rendering request, and the high dynamic range image obtained by rendering is compressed and uploaded to cloud storage; and after downloading the compressed high dynamic range image from the cloud storage, the client adjusts the exposure effect of the high dynamic range image through an image exposure control algorithm. And (4) setting the exposure control of the high dynamic range image in the client for adjustment so as to meet the design requirement.

title_en: Video preview method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a video preview method, a video preview device and electronic equipment. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving an on-demand request sent aiming at a target monitoring video, wherein a video index corresponding to the video data is generated aiming at each video data in the target monitoring video in advance, and the video index is used for representing the shooting time of the corresponding video data; acquiring a video index corresponding to each video data in the target monitoring video; determining a target time period in which a target event is expected to occur; determining a video index of which the represented shooting time belongs to the target time period from all the obtained video indexes as a target video index; acquiring video data corresponding to the target video index according to the target video index, and using the video data as target video data; and extracting a preview picture from the target video data and displaying the preview picture. The system resource consumed by video preview can be effectively reduced.

title_en: Panoramic single-pixel imaging device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a panoramic single-pixel imaging device and a method, comprising a digital projector for projecting a target object, a plane mirror group for carrying out back reflection on the target object, a first photoelectric detector for detecting the light intensity value in front of the target object, a second photoelectric detector for detecting the light intensity value in back of the target object, a digital signal acquisition device for acquiring the light intensity values acquired by the first photoelectric detector and the second photoelectric detector, and a computer for image generation and single-pixel image restoration; the digital projector is arranged in front of the target object, the plane mirror group is arranged on the back of the target object, and the output ends of the first photoelectric detector and the second photoelectric detector are connected to the digital signal acquisition device; the front and rear of the target object in the panoramic single-pixel imaging device are respectively provided with a photoelectric detector, and the photoelectric detectors are combined with the digital signal acquisition device, the digital projector and the plane mirror group to achieve synchronous projection and realize automatic synchronous imaging.

title_en: Light intensity self-adaptive camera system based on IR-CUT
abstract_en: The invention provides an IR-CUT-based light intensity self-adaptive camera system which is characterized by comprising a processor, an imaging subsystem and a filtering subsystem, wherein the filtering subsystem is used for detecting and improving incident light, the imaging subsystem is used for forming an image according to the incident light, the processor is used for processing data detected by the filtering subsystem and controlling the filtering subsystem, the filtering subsystem comprises an illumination sensor, a wavelength filtering module and a polarization filtering module, the illumination sensor is used for detecting the illumination intensity of light entering the camera system, the wavelength filtering module is used for controlling the wavelength range of the light entering the imaging subsystem, and the polarization filtering module is used for controlling the illumination intensity entering the imaging subsystem; the system makes the light used for imaging closer to the ideal situation by controlling two aspects of the wavelength range and the illumination intensity.

title_en: Point cloud geometric lossless compression method based on sparse convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a point cloud geometric lossless compression method based on a sparse convolutional neural network. The method comprises the following steps: s1, converting the point cloud data into a sparse tensor form, and generating point cloud data of multiple scales through voxel down-sampling; s2, establishing a probability prediction model based on the sparse convolution neural network, wherein the probability prediction model is used for estimating the occupation probability of the voxels; the probability prediction model adopts a probability prediction model based on hidden layer characteristics or a probability prediction model based on neighbor context; and S3, inputting the low-scale point cloud into a probability prediction model, predicting the probability of each voxel in the high-scale point cloud, performing lossless compression on the actual occupation symbol of the voxel according to the probability by using entropy coding, and outputting a final coding code stream. The invention can reduce the complexity of coding and decoding and has better compression performance.

title_en: TWS master and slave device, audio device and system
abstract_en: The invention provides TWS (two way communication) master and slave equipment, audio equipment and a system. The main device comprises a data writing control circuit, an audio superposition cache, a counter and a controller; the controller is used for sending an alignment instruction to the slave equipment and sending information of a reference sampling period of each initial path of synchronous audio data in the multiple paths of synchronous audio data to the slave equipment; the data write control circuit is used for controlling the time for writing the audio data segment with the first fixed sampling length into the audio superposition cache according to the initial reference sampling period information of each path of synchronous audio data, and then writing the audio data segment with the next fixed sampling length into the audio superposition cache according to the playing sequence when the audio data segment in the audio superposition cache completes the audio sampling. The invention is beneficial to reducing the complexity of audio data processing when the multi-channel audio data are synchronously played.

title_en: Integrated position servo motor actuating device
abstract_en: The invention provides an integrated position servo motor actuating device, which belongs to the technical field of servo devices and comprises a circuit part, a motor part, a screw rod component and a front movable end part; the circuit part comprises a power panel cover plate, a power panel, a main support shell, a power device cover plate, a control panel cover plate, a capacitor panel and a capacitor panel cover plate, wherein a power panel mounting hole and a power panel connector are formed in the power panel, a power device power supply and a power device driving signal pin are arranged on the power device, a control panel mounting hole and a control panel connector are formed in the control panel, and a capacitor panel mounting hole and a capacitor panel output end are formed in the capacitor panel; the motor part comprises a multi-turn rotor position sensor, an external connector assembly, a rear end cover of the actuating device, a rear support lug and a motor; the front movable end portion includes an actuator front end cap, a front lug, and a movable end assembly. The servo motor actuating device solves the problems of large volume, heavy weight and limited heat dissipation performance of the existing servo motor actuating device.

title_en: Pixel driving system and pixel driving method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of pixel driving, and particularly discloses a pixel driving system and method. The system comprises an array of X rows and Y columns formed by a plurality of pixel driving devices, wherein each device comprises a pixel driving module and n data transfer modules corresponding to n-bit gray scale data; each data transfer module comprises a static random access memory and a data driving unit; the static random access memory is used for accessing and storing corresponding gray scale data when the gating signal line is gated; each data driving unit responds to the driving signals in the preset sequence and sequentially transmits corresponding gray scale data to the pixel driving module so as to drive the pixel driving module to light the pixel units. And the driving signal lines corresponding to the ith data driving unit of each pixel driving device in the same row are interconnected, and the n driving signal lines in at least one row are correspondingly connected with the n driving signal lines in at least one adjacent row. The duty ratio and the display brightness of each subframe display time are effectively improved, and the display tearing feeling is reduced.

title_en: Display panel, preparation method thereof and foldable display device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a display panel, a preparation method thereof and a foldable display device, relates to the technical field of display, and aims to improve the hardness of the display panel while ensuring the bending performance of the display panel. The display panel comprises ultra-thin glass; the ultrathin glass comprises a bending area and a non-bending area, and the hardness of the ultrathin glass in the non-bending area is greater than that of the ultrathin glass in the bending area.

title_en: Photomask, substrate and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a photomask, a substrate and a preparation method thereof, wherein the photomask comprises a light blocking area, a light transmitting area and a partial light transmitting area, the partial light transmitting area and the light blocking area are separated by the light transmitting area, the partial light transmitting area allows partial ultraviolet rays to transmit, and comprises a first partial light transmitting area and a second partial light transmitting area, wherein: the first partial light-transmitting area is connected with the edge of the light-transmitting area and has gradually changed ultraviolet transmittance; the second part printing opacity district is connected in the edge that first part printing opacity district kept away from the printing opacity district, and second part printing opacity district has fixed ultraviolet transmittance to make the thickness of the protective layer that second part printing opacity district corresponds even and be less than the thickness of the protective layer that printing opacity district corresponds, thereby form the protective layer of different thickness, and first part printing opacity district intercommunication printing opacity district and second part printing opacity district, thereby can make to have the smooth slope between the protective layer, improve visual effect.

title_en: Image generation device and image generation method
abstract_en: In the image generating apparatus 10, the input information acquiring unit 50 acquires the content of the user operation from the input apparatus 14. When two images are synthesized, the image data generation unit 52 switches the space of the image data according to the situation, and stores the data of the image synthesized in the space in the frame buffer 56. In the frame buffer 56, the format control unit 54 sets a data format corresponding to the determined space. The output unit 58 outputs the data read from the frame buffer 56 as a video signal corresponding to the display 16.

title_en: Driver for reducing standby power consumption of power supply system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a driver for reducing standby power consumption of a power supply system, which structurally comprises: anticreep connects groove, the control unit, fin, radiator fan, location curb plate, and the anticreep connects the front end that the groove is nested at the control unit, and the internal contact passes through interference fit, and the fin middle part is equipped with the recess, and fixes radiator fan at the middle part of recess, beneficial effect through the bolt: the user's accessible is equipped with the front groove and cooperates with the instruction dental lamina, can more conveniently look over the state of current wire when instructing the clamp plate roll-off, avoids the wire branching to appear, causes contact failure's condition to take place after the wiring.

title_en: Method for receiving MIPI signal based on FPGA, terminal and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for receiving MIPI signals based on an FPGA, the FPGA, a terminal and a medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: in the process that the FPGA receives the MIPI signal, when the LVDS interface determines that the MIPI signal is switched from a high-speed transmission mode to a low-power transmission mode, the LVDS interface determines that the received MIPI signal is blanking data in the low-power transmission mode; when the GPIO interface determines that the MIPI signal is switched from a low-power transmission mode to a high-speed transmission mode, the LVDS interface receives and decodes a row of serial valid image data of the MIPI signal in the high-speed transmission mode; and repeatedly executing the steps until the last row of serial effective image data of the MIPI signal is received and decoded, and then converting the serial effective image data of each row into parallel image data by the FPGA. The method can be used for receiving MIPI signals by the FPGA without other chips.

title_en: Card-centered abnormality detection system using camera and dealer
abstract_en: The conventional system has a problem that, in a card game, it is impossible to detect an error when a dealer hands out cards to a player side and a dealer side after the dealer has drawn the cards onto a table, an error when the dealer hands out the cards to a player side and an error when the dealer hands out the cards to a game participant after the dealer hands out the cards. The abnormality detection system of the present invention can detect abnormal states and cheating behaviors such as errors when a dealer draws a card onto a table and then delivers the card to a player side and a banker side, errors when delivering the card to a guest after distribution, and the like, using the image analysis result of the image analysis device (12), and can warn or prevent them.

title_en: Radiating assembly with good radiating effect for medical communication device
abstract_en: The invention provides a heat dissipation assembly for a medical communication device, which has a good heat dissipation effect. The medical communication device that the radiating effect is good uses radiator unit includes: the heat dissipation case, the ventilation groove has been seted up to the bottom of heat dissipation case, and the mounting groove has been seted up at the top of heat dissipation case, and the inside of through-hole communicates each other with the inside of ventilation groove and the inside of mounting groove respectively. The heat dissipation assembly for the medical communication device, which is good in heat dissipation effect, has the advantages that heat can be conveniently spread and dissipated through air, meanwhile, the heat dissipation fins can be directly connected with the outside air after passing through the inside of the through holes, the heat exchange quality and efficiency of the heat dissipation fins are guaranteed, the heat conduction plates and the heat conduction connecting plates are in clamping connection, the assembly and the use are convenient, the assembly structure is simple and convenient, the convenience of equipment installation and use is improved, the installation height of the heat conduction connecting plates on the heat conduction connecting plates can be finely adjusted according to the use requirements, the connection tightness between the heat conduction connecting plates and the heat exchange chips is increased, and therefore the heat exchange efficiency is improved.

title_en: Playback switching between audio devices
abstract_en: Examples described herein relate to transitioning playback sessions between portable playback devices, such as "smart" headphones, earpieces, and handheld speakers, and playback devices of zone-based media playback systems. When transitioning between locations (e.g., from home to out, or vice versa) or between listening paradigms (e.g., personalized or loud playback of audio content), the exemplary techniques facilitate continuity of playback. Example embodiments include: detecting a switching trigger; determining a source playback device and a target playback device; and performing a playback session exchange between the source playback device and the target playback device.

title_en: Supporting component, display screen and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a supporting component, a display screen and electronic equipment. Wherein, this supporting component includes: the support plate, the double-faced adhesive tape and the isolation structure; the supporting plate comprises a first plate surface, and the double-sided adhesive tape is arranged on the first plate surface; the support plate comprises a bending area, and the support plate is used for bending along a preset axial lead in the bending area; the backup pad is provided with mesh structure in the district of buckling, and isolation structure sets up between mesh structure and double faced adhesive tape, and isolation structure is used for keeping apart the glue film towards first face of double faced adhesive tape and bar hole, makes the double faced adhesive tape can not contact with mesh structure, like this, when the backup pad is buckled, because isolation structure's isolation effect, the glue film can not be excessive to mesh structure in, can not produce local accumulation, consequently adopt the display screen of the supporting component preparation that this application embodiment provided can not appear the die mark after buckling repeatedly.

title_en: Automatic control machine cabinet
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic control cabinet, which comprises a cabinet, wherein the cabinet comprises a cabinet door, and a mounting through hole is formed in the cabinet door; the heat dissipation assembly is fixedly arranged in the mounting through hole; a motor is arranged on the cabinet door, an output shaft of the motor is connected with a first gear, and the first gear drives the heat dissipation assembly; when the deflection angle of blade and then adjust the radiating effect when needs are adjusted, practical outer hexagonal spanner stretches into hexagonal hole and promotes spacing face of second and the separation of first spacing face, alright adjusted the blade angle with rotatory outer hexagonal spanner this moment to can close radiator unit when not using, prevent that the dust from getting into.

title_en: Low-shrinkage matte polyester film master batch, polyester film and preparation method of polyester film
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of high polymer materials, and discloses a low-shrinkage matte polyester film master batch, a polyester film and a preparation method thereof, wherein the polyester film master batch comprises the following raw material components: 70-80% of polyester and 20-30% of modified matte mixed powder; the modified matte mixed powder comprises 40-58% of barium sulfate; 30 to 48 percent of kaolin; 8 to 12 percent of alkali-free glass fiber; 0.1 to 0.3 percent of coupling agent; the modified matte mixed powder designed by the invention contains barium sulfate, kaolin, alkali-free glass fiber and a coupling agent, can reduce the heat shrinkage rate and the glossiness of a polyester material, improve the tensile strength of a polyester film, improve the interface bonding force of an inorganic material and polyester, and promote the internal stress transfer of a composite material and the uniform dispersion of the powder. The finally prepared low-shrinkage matte polyester film has lower thermal shrinkage, lower glossiness, higher strength and haze through the synergistic effect of multiple components.

title_en: Image processing method and device
abstract_en: The application provides an image processing method and device, relates to the technical field of multimedia processing, and is used for solving the problem that a motion track special-effect video of a target shooting object cannot be generated in real time in the prior art. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a current frame and N historical action frames, wherein the current frame and the N historical action frames comprise target bodies, scenes of the current frame and the N historical action frames are overlapped, and the positions of the target bodies in the N historical action frames are different; performing image segmentation on the N historical action frames to obtain images of N target bodies corresponding to the N historical action frames respectively; determining N reference positions in the current frame according to the positions of the N target main bodies in the scenes of the N historical action frames and the scene of the current frame; and respectively fusing the images of the N target subjects on the N reference positions of the current frame to obtain the target frame.

title_en: Noise cancellation signal saturation control
abstract_en: A noise cancellation system includes a noise cancellation filter in communication with at least one speaker, the noise cancellation filter generating a noise cancellation signal that cancels noise within at least one cancellation zone when actuated by the at least one speaker; and an amplifier disposed between the noise cancellation filter and the speaker, the amplifier applying a first scaling gain to the noise cancellation signal and outputting a scaled noise cancellation signal, the scaled noise cancellation signal being a linear reduction of the noise cancellation signal when the first scaling gain is less than one, wherein the first scaling gain is set to be less than one in response to the signal representing the noise cancellation signal exceeding a threshold.

title_en: Time delay integration method, device and equipment of pseudo color line scanning camera
abstract_en: The invention discloses a time delay integration method, a device and equipment of a pseudo color line scanning camera, belonging to the technical field of image processing and comprising the following steps: continuously acquiring image data by using a line scanning image sensor; combining and overlapping image data of each line according to a line scanning direction and a movement speed by adopting a time delay integration method to obtain red and green channel data or blue and green channel data of each pixel; and carrying out color interpolation processing on each pixel by using red and green channel data or blue and green channel data of the left and right pixels of each pixel to obtain missing blue channel data or red channel data so as to output complete RGB data.

title_en: Display panel and display device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a display panel and a display device, wherein the display panel comprises a plurality of sub-pixels; the first region and the second region are arranged along a first direction; the plurality of first sub-pixel groups of the first area and the plurality of second sub-pixel groups of the second area are arranged along a first direction; the first sub-pixel group and the second sub-pixel group respectively comprise a plurality of sub-pixels which are arranged along a second direction; the number of the sub-pixels included in the second sub-pixel group close to the first region is greater than that of the sub-pixels included in the second sub-pixel group far away from the first region; the first subregion of the second region is closer to the first region than the second subregion; in a direction from the first region to the second region, a rate of change of the number of sub-pixels included in the second sub-pixel group in the first sub-region is larger than a rate of change of the number of sub-pixels included in the second sub-pixel group in the second sub-region. And reducing the display brightness difference to enable the display width of the second area to quickly reach the preset width.

title_en: Frequency converter with water cooling system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of frequency converter cooling equipment, in particular to a frequency converter with a water cooling system, which comprises a bottom plate and a top plate, wherein a frequency converter main body and a water cooling assembly are arranged on the top plate, the water cooling assembly is arranged on the outer side of the frequency converter main body, a flow guide assembly is arranged at the lower end of the water cooling assembly and comprises two groups of first flow guide plates, a collecting cavity is formed in the upper end surface of the bottom plate, the two groups of first flow guide plates are in mirror symmetry with respect to the collecting cavity, one end of each first flow guide plate is rotatably arranged at an opening of the collecting cavity, a push plate is connected to the bottom of the other end of each first flow guide plate in a contact mode, a collecting box is arranged at the lower end of the bottom plate, a flow collecting box is arranged in the middle of the lower end of the collecting cavity, a buoyancy lever mechanism is arranged inside the collecting box, and the buoyancy lever mechanism is connected with an alarm through a wire. The invention greatly enhances the safety performance of the device.

title_en: Video processing method, video processing device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a video processing method, a video processing device, a computer device and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a video stream to be processed; according to the video stream, identifying a target object contained in the video stream; determining the magnification factor aiming at the target area according to the size information of the target area where the target object is located, the size information of the image picture of the video stream and the size information of the current displayable area; and displaying the video stream in the current displayable region by taking the target region as the center according to the magnification. By adopting the method, the display effect of the shot video on different display screens can be improved, and the effectiveness of video monitoring is further ensured.

title_en: Humidity relay protector for transformer box
abstract_en: The application discloses a humidity relay protector for a transformer box, which belongs to the technical field of power equipment and comprises a base plate, a main machine frame plate, an auxiliary machine frame plate, an armature plate rotatably arranged on the main machine frame plate, a controller, a humidity sensor, an electric driving assembly and a protection circuit assembly; the humidity sensor is electrically connected with the controller, the controller is electrically connected with the electric driving assembly, and the electric driving assembly is used for driving the armature plate to rotate; the armature plate is fixed with an insulating tube, and a movable terminal is fixed on the insulating tube; the protection circuit component comprises a working circuit, a warning circuit and a protection circuit; the working circuit comprises a working power supply, a transformer box electric device and a working terminal which are sequentially connected through wires, and wires are connected between the working power supply and the mobile terminal; the warning circuit comprises a buzzer, a warning lamp and a warning terminal which are sequentially connected, and the buzzer is connected with a working power supply; the protection circuit includes a break terminal. This application has the effect that promotes the security of transformer case.

title_en: Noise reduction parameter setting method and device, earphone equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a noise reduction parameter setting method, a device, earphone equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the earphone equipment acquires an environment signal picked up by a feedforward microphone and a noise signal picked up by a feedback microphone; calculating an energy difference between the ambient signal and the noise signal; and acquiring a target noise reduction parameter value corresponding to the energy difference value, and setting noise reduction parameters of an active noise reduction mode in the earphone equipment according to the target noise reduction parameter value. According to the invention, even if the coupling state of the earphone equipment and the auditory canal of the user is different due to the difference of wearing habits of the user and the difference of the auditory canal, the expected active noise reduction effect can be achieved through the corresponding noise reduction parameter value, and the experience of the user using the active noise reduction function of the earphone is improved.

title_en: Cable trench cover plate of transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cable trench cover plate of a transformer substation, which comprises a body and a bracket, wherein the bracket comprises a horizontal part and a vertical part, the horizontal part is arranged at the top end of the vertical part, the horizontal part is movably connected to the body, an image acquisition component for acquiring image information in a cable trench is arranged on the horizontal part or/and the vertical part, a storage battery connected with the image acquisition component is arranged on the horizontal part, the storage battery is positioned between the body and the bracket, and a solar photovoltaic component connected with the storage battery is arranged on the body; the invention has the advantages that: image information in the cable pit is acquired through the image acquisition assembly, so that clear pictures in the cable pit can be provided for management personnel or operation and maintenance personnel in real time, the situation in the cable pit can be visually known under the condition that the cover plate is not opened, the working intensity of the operation and maintenance personnel is reduced, the opening and closing times of the cover plate are also reduced, and the service life of the cover plate is prolonged.

title_en: Video processing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a video processing method, a video processing device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, belongs to the technical field of information processing, and is used for solving the problem that video instability is generated after a certain local element is replaced in video due to the variation diversity of face angles in the related technology. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a video to be processed and a local replacement element of a target object in the video to be processed; replacing a local original element of the target object in each frame of the video to be processed with the local replacement element; and according to the position mapping relation of every two adjacent frames in the video to be processed, the positions of the pixel points of each frame after the local elements of the video to be processed are replaced are adjusted, and the target video is obtained.

title_en: Display control device and display control method
abstract_en: The present technology relates to a display control apparatus and a display control method capable of further improving operability. There is provided a display control apparatus including a control unit that displays a plurality of items associated with a display screen, and in a case where a desired item is selected from the plurality of display items by a user operation, the selected display screen corresponding to the selected selection item is displayed together with the display screen, the selected display screen being displayed in a position relative to a display position of the selected item. The present technique may be applied to, for example, television receivers.

title_en: High-precision double-light-source redundant triaxial integrated fiber-optic gyroscope measuring device
abstract_en: The high-precision double-light source redundant triaxial integrated fiber-optic gyroscope measuring device structure adopts a cube-type body, a circuit board and other structures are placed in the body, the structure has enough natural frequency and good resistance and mechanical properties, and a triaxial gyroscope is orthogonally arranged in the body structure; meanwhile, the heat dissipation requirement is considered, and circuit components with large mass and large heat consumption are placed at the bottom of the combination, and the heat dissipation design is carried out; two fiber optic gyroscopes are arranged on two sides of the body, the other fiber optic gyroscopes are arranged on the middle partition plate of the body, the circuit and the light path are divided into two parts by the middle partition plate, so that the assembly of the optical and electric sub-areas is realized, the assembly has good assembly manufacturability, meanwhile, the side edges are grooved, the visual assembly is realized, and the assembly reliability is ensured.

title_en: Display module, display device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a display module, a display device and an electronic device, wherein the display module comprises a display panel, an optical adhesive layer and a cover plate, and the display panel is provided with a first surface; the optical adhesive layer is connected to the first surface, a second surface is arranged on one side of the optical adhesive layer, which is far away from the display panel, the orthographic projection of the optical adhesive layer on the first surface completely covers the first surface, and at least part of the optical adhesive layer protrudes out of the first surface, so that a bonding area is formed on one side of the optical adhesive layer, which faces the display panel; the cover plate is connected to the second surface, and the orthographic projection of the cover plate on the second surface completely covers the second surface. The utility model provides an optical glue layer protrusion forms bonding area in the display module assembly outside the first surface one side towards display panel, can wholly bond display module assembly fixedly through this bonding area, and need not additionally glue on the apron, has simplified display module assembly and has connected required process when fixed, has reduced display module assembly's assembly cost, and has avoided display module assembly to appear the risk of overflowing gluing.

title_en: Light machine illumination system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an optical machine lighting system which comprises a laser light source, a first spatial light modulator, a second spatial light modulator, a first light splitting and combining device and a second light splitting and combining device, wherein the laser light source is used for emitting three primary colors of light, the three primary colors of light comprise first color light, second color light and third color light, the light power of the third color light is larger than that of the first color light and larger than that of the second color light, the third color light comprises first polarized light and second polarized light, the first light splitting and combining device is used for guiding the first polarized light to the first spatial light modulator to be modulated, the second polarized light to the second spatial light modulator to be modulated, the first color light and the second color light to be guided to the first spatial light modulator or the second spatial light modulator to be modulated, and the second light splitting and combining device is used for combining the modulated light beams to be emitted. The optical engine lighting system provided by the embodiment of the application realizes light power balance under wide color gamut, balances heat load and improves the light output of projection.

title_en: Emergency Bluetooth headset with battery power supply capable of being attached
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earphones, in particular to an emergency Bluetooth earphone capable of being additionally supplied with power by a battery. When pushing away the frame in the inside lapse of stop collar, push away the frame and promote the lug and drive the slider and slide in the inside of slide rail, the lug slides to the direction in the outside of casing this moment, along with the slip of lug, under spring link self elastic force effect, the inside slip of spout of spring link on the extension rod, open the extension rod on the lug simultaneously, the extension rod that the extension was opened this moment is more extensive with the signal reception scope of earphone, make signal reception's intensity higher simultaneously, make the user avoid appearing the unstable condition of signal when using the earphone.

title_en: Composite cover plate and display device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a composite cover plate and a display device comprising the same. The composite cover plate comprises a substrate layer, an adhesive layer and a porous material layer; wherein the adhesive layer is located between the substrate layer and the porous material layer; and the porous material layer has a void ratio of 40-50%. The composite cover plate provided by the embodiment of the disclosure can effectively absorb shock waves and effectively reduce the impact quantity through the porous structure of the porous material layer, thereby reducing the average deformation quantity.

title_en: Voice processing method, device, electronic equipment, medium and program product
abstract_en: The application relates to a voice processing method, a voice processing device, an electronic device, a medium and a program product, which are applied to the technical field of voice recognition, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring voice data containing a plurality of speakers, performing voice recognition on the voice data, and generating and presenting original recognition text information comprising a plurality of text segment information; each text segment information associatively displays the text segment content and the speaker of the voice segment corresponding to the text segment content; and in response to the editing operation aiming at any text segment information, re-determining the speaker corresponding to the content of each text segment based on the type of the editing operation and the voice segment corresponding to the text segment information. The method and the device can improve the accuracy of speaker determination.

title_en: Speaker module and portable electronic device using the same
abstract_en: The invention provides a loudspeaker module comprising a loudspeaker, which comprises an acoustic port, a front cavity, a rear cavity and a driver, wherein the front cavity and the rear cavity are communicated with the acoustic port, the driver is positioned between the front cavity and the rear cavity and is used for separating the front cavity and the rear cavity, the loudspeaker module comprises an input port, a pair of output ports and a pair of channels, the input port and the output port are communicated with the outside of the acoustic horn, each channel is connected with the corresponding channel, the cross section of each channel is gradually increased in the direction from the input port to the corresponding output port, and the cross section of each channel on the same plane is equal. The loudspeaker module improves the high-frequency performance of sound waves and reduces the distortion of low-frequency sound waves. The invention further provides portable electronic equipment using the loudspeaker module.

title_en: Power module system
abstract_en: A power module system (1) for use in an electric vehicle (21), comprising: a base module comprising a cooling channel for a fluid coolant and a coolant connection for supplying the fluid coolant to the cooling channel, the base module further comprising at least one external electrical connection for inputting power to and/or outputting power from the power module system; an additional module configured to be mounted to and electrically connected to the base module such that the additional module can be cooled and powered via the base module when mounted.
