When the additional module is mounted, the cooling passage is delimited by at least a first delimiting surface provided on the base module and a second delimiting surface provided on the additional module, so that the fluid coolant supplied via the coolant connection of the base module is in contact with both said delimiting surfaces.

title_en: Camera module using small reflection unit and optical device for augmented reality using the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a camera module using a small reflection part including a lens part configuring at least one lens and an image sensor converting image light incident through the lens part into an electric signal and outputting the electric signal, and an optical apparatus for enhancing reality using the same, the camera module using the small reflection part including a reflection part reflecting the incident image light to be transmitted to the lens part, and a reflection surface of the reflection part being arranged to be inclined with respect to an optical axis of the incident light to reflect the incident image light to the lens part and serve as a diaphragm for the incident light.

title_en: Electronic equipment and wrist wearing equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an electronic equipment and wrist wearing equipment, electronic equipment includes: the microphone comprises a shell, wherein a functional interface is arranged on the shell, a microphone is arranged in the shell, a first sound pickup hole is formed in the shell, a second sound pickup hole is formed in the side wall of the functional interface, and the second sound pickup hole is communicated with the outside through the functional interface; the wind noise reduction device is fixedly arranged in the shell, a communication channel is formed inside the wind noise reduction device, the communication channel is communicated with the microphone, and the communication channel is communicated with the first sound pickup hole and the second sound pickup hole. According to the electronic equipment provided by the application, wind noise can be reduced, and conversation experience is improved.

title_en: Automatic balance vertical display for image department
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of images, and discloses an automatic balancing vertical display for an image department, which comprises a working platform, wherein the bottom of the working platform is fixedly connected with a supporting column, the top of the working platform is movably connected with a supporting frame, the outer side of the supporting frame is fixedly connected with a shell, the back of the shell is movably connected with a balancing mechanism, the inner wall of the shell is provided with a sliding chute, the automatic balancing vertical display for the image department is characterized in that in the working process, through an electric contact and a static contact which are arranged and a conductive block which is arranged in a matching way, when in use, the electric contact is contacted with the conductive block through the electric contact, an electric push rod contracts, the conductive block is contacted with the static contact, the electric push rod extends, the connection part of the display and the supporting frame is not inclined any more, the integral inclination of the display is avoided, a doctor can conveniently watch the display, and the stability of the image display is improved, the phenomenon that the image display can topple over when being shaken again is prevented, and the damage of the image display is avoided.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: A display device is provided. The display device includes a pixel, a scan driver configured to supply a scan signal to the pixel through a scan line, an emission driver configured to supply an emission control signal including a plurality of gate-on level signals to the pixel through an emission control line in one frame, the plurality of gate-on level signals being used to generate a plurality of emission periods of the pixel, a data driver configured to supply a data signal to the pixel through a data line, and a controller configured to control a waveform of the emission control signal, wherein a length of a first emission period of the plurality of emission periods is longer than a length of another emission period of the plurality of emission periods.

title_en: Flexible display module
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible display module, which comprises a flexible screen, a supporting component and a connecting component, wherein the supporting component comprises two supporting plates which are arranged at intervals along the length direction of the flexible screen, two end faces of the two supporting plates which are positioned on the same side are used for fixing two ends of the flexible screen respectively, and an included angle between the two supporting plates is adjustable; the connecting assembly comprises two elastomers arranged between the supporting plates, the end faces of the elastomers are fixedly connected with the flexible screen, one side face of each elastomer is provided with a plurality of mounting holes spaced along the length direction of the flexible screen, a plurality of reinforcing rib plates are arranged in the mounting holes respectively, and at least one reinforcing rib plate is arranged along the axis extending along the width direction of the flexible screen in a rotating mode. Therefore, the unfolding state has a good supporting effect, the problem that the screen is difficult to bend due to overlarge resistance is avoided, the damage to the screen caused by improper operation of a user is prevented, and good experience is brought to the user.

title_en: Sound reproduction system and head-mounted device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sound reproduction system and a head-mounted device. A headphone sound reproduction device is provided in the form of left and right headphones that can be clipped to each ear or mounted on other headbands. Headphones deliver high-fidelity audio from the near-ear region to the user's eardrum in a lightweight form factor, which is completely "non-blocking. Each earphone has a woofer assembly producing bass frequencies and a tweeter assembly producing treble frequencies. The woofer outputs bass frequencies from a location near the ear canal and the tweeter outputs treble frequencies from a location near or remote from the ear canal. In some embodiments, the tweeter is significantly farther from the ear canal than the woofer, resulting in a broader perceived "sound field", but still having a "clean" listening experience.

title_en: Circuit board manufacturing method and circuit board
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of circuit board manufacturing, and provides a circuit board manufacturing method, which comprises the following steps: providing a core board, wherein the core board comprises a first copper layer, a second copper layer and a base material arranged between the first copper layer and the second copper layer; drilling: drilling a blind hole in the core plate, wherein the blind hole penetrates through the first copper layer and the base material; manufacturing a pattern circuit: manufacturing a pattern circuit on the first copper layer and the second copper layer; blind hole electroconduction: conducting the hole wall of the blind hole with the pattern circuits on the two sides of the core plate; electroplating and hole filling: carrying out local electroplating on the core plate to fill the blind holes with electroplated copper; and performing post-processing on the core board. The circuit board manufacturing method provided by the invention can manufacture fine lines on the circuit board, and is low in cost; the invention also provides a circuit board.

title_en: Image processing device, image processing method, program, and storage medium
abstract_en: An image processing apparatus according to the present invention includes an input section for inputting a distance information distribution calculated from an image captured by using an optical system for forming a field image on an image pickup element of an image pickup section, an estimation section for estimating a depth direction in the image based on an image pickup condition of the image pickup section, and a decision section for deciding an evaluation value indicating a degree of deviation of the optical system and the image pickup element with respect to a design position based on a relationship between the distance information distribution and the estimated depth direction.

title_en: Method, system, electronic device and storage medium for determining sound channel role of sound box
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium for determining a sound channel role of a sound box, and relates to the technical field of sound boxes. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring first distance information between a first sound box and M second sound boxes; acquiring second distance information between one second sound box in the M second sound boxes and at least two other second sound boxes; determining the sound channel role information of the first sound box and the M second sound boxes according to the first distance information, the second distance information and the first indication information; the first indication information is used for indicating the relative position of the first sound box and any one of the M second sound boxes, and M is an integer greater than 1. According to the scheme, the sound channel configuration operation of the stereo sound box system formed by the plurality of sound boxes can be simplified, the sound box sound channel roles do not need to be set in a factory, and the use flexibility of the sound boxes is improved.

title_en: Working method of display device
abstract_en: A display device in which a pixel defect is not easily visible is provided. The display device includes a display portion in which pixels are arranged in a matrix and a sensor portion provided with a photoelectric conversion element. First, the display portion is divided into a first region and a second region. Next, first light is emitted from the pixels included in the first region and the luminance of the first light is detected by the photoelectric conversion element. In addition, the second light is emitted from the pixels included in the second region and the luminance of the second light is detected by the photoelectric conversion element. Then, the brightness of the first light and the brightness of the second light are compared, and one of the first region and the second region is divided into a third region and a fourth region according to the result of the comparison. The above operation is repeated to detect a defective pixel. The luminance represented by the image data can be corrected based on the detection result of the defective pixel.

title_en: Stable CCTV detects with peeping appearance
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pipeline detection, and discloses a stable CCTV (continuous casting television) detection endoscope, which comprises a main body tube, wherein a sealing cover is fixedly sleeved on the outer surface of the main body tube, a connecting rod is movably sleeved on the inner surface of the main body tube, the bottom surface of the connecting rod is fixedly connected with a connecting plate, a detection shooting mechanism is fixedly installed on the bottom surface of the connecting plate, and a gear positioned in the sealing cover is fixedly sleeved on the outer surface of the connecting rod. According to the invention, the detection shooting mechanism is enabled to stably rotate by driving the connecting rod to rotate, the endoscope device does not generate relative motion with the pipeline in the rotating process, the rotation stability of the detection shooting mechanism is ensured, the picture acquisition effect is improved, continuous detection can be carried out on the position after fixed rotation by pulling the pull ring and keeping pause in the actual operation process, the pulling effect is kept unchanged in the continuous detection process, the stability can be kept, the actual control difficulty is small, the operation is simple, and the stability of the rotation detection of the endoscope is greatly improved.

title_en: Liquid cooling plate structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a liquid cooling plate structure, comprising: the plate body is provided with a fluid concave cavity; the heat dissipation ribs are arranged in the fluid concave cavity at intervals along a first direction, each heat dissipation rib extends along a second direction, and a flow guide channel is formed between every two adjacent heat dissipation ribs; at least one of the two adjacent heat dissipation ribs is bent, so that the flow guide channel is a bent flow channel. The liquid cooling plate structure solves the problem that the liquid cooling plate in the prior art is poor in heat dissipation effect.

title_en: Heat sink shield with thermal contact recess for thermal energy spreading in radar assembly
abstract_en: A heat sink shield with thermal contact recesses may improve thermal energy spreading in the radar assembly. The radar assembly includes a Printed Circuit Board (PCB), a heat sink shield, a radome, and a housing. The PCB may include integrated circuits and other components, as well as thermally conductive material covering at least a portion of a surface of the PCB. The heat sink shield includes a plurality of recesses in thermal contact with the thermally conductive material. The heat sink shield is configured to spread thermal energy generated at least in part by the PCB components to the housing. In this manner, the described techniques and systems allow the radar assembly to better spread thermal energy from the PCB components to the rest of the PCB and through the housing.

title_en: MEMS driven optical package with micro-LED array
abstract_en: An optical light package, comprising: an optical output lens; a filter positioned below the output lens and between the output lens and the LED; a tray of LEDs arranged on a stage mounted on a linear comb-based MEMS device, the MEMS device being distributed in such a way that the stage is movable; and a driver controlling the movement of the stage.

title_en: Cover plate assembly, cover plate assembly preparation method and display device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cover plate assembly, a cover plate assembly preparation method and a display device, wherein the cover plate assembly is provided with a bending area and comprises: the surface of the cover plate body positioned in the bending area is provided with a slot; and the filling medium is filled in the slot and comprises a plurality of magnetic units with the same magnetism. Can reserve the deformation space for apron body bending deformation through the fluting, avoid stress concentration. The invention further arranges a filling medium in the slot, and the filling medium can absorb a part of bending stress through the deformation of the filling medium. However, the filling medium absorbs a part of bending stress through the deformation of the filling medium, and in order to further reduce the stress generated by bending, the filling medium in the embodiment of the invention comprises a plurality of magnetic units with the same magnetism, and the magnetic units with the same magnetism have repulsive force, so that the repulsive force between the magnetic units can reduce the risk of the cover plate body being broken due to the rapid concentration of the stress generated by bending.

title_en: Composite adhesive tape and display module
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a composite adhesive tape and a display module. The composite adhesive tape is used for being attached to the surface of an object, the surface of the object comprises at least one bent part, and the surface of the bent part is an arc surface; the composite tape comprises a buffer layer and a protective layer which are stacked; when the composite adhesive tape is attached to the surface of an object, the protective layer is positioned on one side of the buffer layer, which is far away from the surface of the object; the composite tape comprises a first area, a second area and a third area, wherein the first area is used for being attached to the surface of the bent part; the protective layer includes at least one opening, and the opening is located in the first area. The invention can reduce the rebound stress when the first area is bent and improve the fitting degree of the composite adhesive tape and the surface of an object.

title_en: Data center switch with protection performance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data center switch with protection performance, and relates to the technical field of data center switches. According to the invention, the blower mechanism is arranged, so that the air flow between two adjacent data exchange modules can be accelerated, and the heat dissipation performance of the data exchange modules is improved; static electricity is released into water through the water mist, and meanwhile, the water mist can increase the relative humidity inside the shell, so that the generation of static electricity is further reduced; through setting up condensation mechanism, can condense vapor, realize the cyclic utilization of water to can adjust air's relative humidity.

title_en: Video storage method, computer equipment and storage medium of national standard camera
abstract_en: The application discloses a video storage method, computer equipment and a storage medium of a national standard camera, wherein the method comprises the following steps: storing the received video stream data to a video data queue in a local operation memory; continuously writing the video stream data stored in the video data queue into the mounted network attached storage equipment; the length of a video data queue is obtained regularly; if the change trend is an increasing trend, judging that the write operation aiming at the network attached storage equipment is abnormal; and when the write operation is abnormal, stopping storing the received video stream data to the video data queue, and storing the received video stream data to a local disk. According to the embodiment of the application, whether the writing of the network attached storage equipment is abnormal is judged according to the length of the video data queue, and the video stream data is written into the local disk when the writing is abnormal, so that the situation that the local running memory where the video data queue is located is exhausted to lose data is avoided, and the reliability of video storage is improved.

title_en: System and method for adjusting positioning plate with four Charge Coupled Device (CCD) lenses
abstract_en: A positioning plate adjusting system with four Charge Coupled Device (CCD) lenses comprises a processor, a first CCD lens, a second CCD lens, a third CCD lens, a fourth CCD lens, a whole plate platform, a driving motor and a controller. The first CCD lens is used for collecting a first coordinate of the plate to be processed and transmitting the first coordinate to the processor, the second CCD lens is used for collecting a second coordinate of the plate to be processed and transmitting the second coordinate to the processor, the third CCD lens is used for collecting a third coordinate of the plate to be processed and transmitting the third coordinate to the processor, and the fourth CCD lens is used for collecting a fourth coordinate of the plate to be processed and transmitting the fourth coordinate to the processor. The processor obtains an average center coordinate and an average offset angle through the calculation of the first coordinate, the second coordinate, the third coordinate and the fourth coordinate, and performs angle adjustment and then displacement adjustment on the plate to be processed through the controller, the driving motor and the whole plate platform.

title_en: Display panel driving method and display device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure discloses a driving method of a display panel and a display device, comprising the following steps: acquiring display data of a current display frame; determining a voltage difference value between target data voltages corresponding to sub-pixels electrically coupled to the same data line and to every two adjacent gate lines according to the display data; judging whether absolute values of all voltage difference values corresponding to sub-pixels electrically coupled with at least one data line are not smaller than a set threshold value; if yes, inputting a first control pulse signal to the grid driving circuit, loading a first grid scanning signal to the grid line, inputting display data to the source driving circuit, and loading data voltages to the data line so as to charge each sub-pixel with corresponding data voltages; if not, a second control pulse signal is input to the gate driving circuit, a second gate scanning signal is loaded to the gate line, display data is input to the source driving circuit, and data voltages are loaded to the data lines so that each sub-pixel is charged with the corresponding data voltage.

title_en: Method and device for automatically adjusting signal synchronization of PCB via hole and bonding pad
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for automatically adjusting the signal synchronization of a PCB via hole and a bonding pad, belonging to the technical field of PCB design, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a via hole pad signal automatic synchronization module, and establishing an interface between PCB design software and the via hole pad signal automatic synchronization module; adding via holes and routing wires for the designed existing chip or connector through PCB design software; starting a via hole pad signal automatic synchronization module, acquiring a working mode selected by a user, and executing signal synchronization on a pad of an existing device or connector and a corresponding via hole thereof under the selected working mode; the through hole pad signal automatic synchronization module performs short circuit inspection between pads of the existing device or connector and performs open circuit inspection on the pads of the existing device or connector and corresponding through holes. The invention modularizes the synchronous process of mass via holes and bonding pad signals, reduces the manual work of PCB design engineers, saves time and greatly improves the research and development efficiency.

title_en: Hole plugging device and PCB resin hole plugging method
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of printed circuit boards, and provides a hole plugging device and a PCB resin hole plugging method. The hole plugging device comprises at least two layers of processing spaces which are sequentially arranged from top to bottom, each layer of processing space is used for installing one PCB, the PCB is provided with a plurality of hole plugging holes, and the hole plugging holes of two adjacent PCBs are arranged in a one-to-one correspondence manner; the plug holes of the upper PCB are filled with resin ink, and the excess resin ink flows into the plug holes of the lower PCB. In this application, when the jack is handled, overlap about with each PCB and place on the jack board, and make the setting of the jack one-to-one of each PCB, then utilize the scraper to make resin ink flow in the jack of the PCB that is located the top, until the jack with the PCB that is located the top is filled up, unnecessary resin ink will flow in the jack of the PCB that is located the below this moment to reach the effect that the jack can accomplish the jack and handle once the jack.

title_en: Central control equipment for smart home
abstract_en: The application discloses central control equipment for intelligent home use, which comprises a setting plate, central control equipment and a protective shell, wherein the central control equipment is positioned at the front side of the setting plate. According to the application, through the matching use of the setting plate, the central control equipment, the protecting shell, the buffer component, the supporting rod, the shell, the positioning component and the control component, a user can retract the positioning rod into the shell through the matching between the control component and the positioning component, then the rotating block can be rotated around the rotating rod, so that the position of the central control equipment is adjusted, meanwhile, the matching between the protecting shell and the buffer component can also protect the central control equipment, the problem that the conventional central control equipment does not have the function of adjusting the angle of the central control equipment, using obstacles are caused by different users due to different heights, meanwhile, the central control equipment does not have the protection function, and some household articles fall off to easily crush the central control equipment is solved.

title_en: Scalable nested SEI message management
abstract_en: The invention discloses a video decoding mechanism. The mechanism includes encoding a codestream that includes one or more Output Layer Sets (OLS). The sub-stream extraction process is performed by a Hypothetical Reference Decoder (HRD) to extract a target OLS from the OLS. When no telescopically nested Supplemental Enhancement Information (SEI) message in a SEI message references the target OLS, a SEI Network Abstraction Layer (NAL) unit including the telescopically nested SEI message is removed from the codestream. And executing a group of code stream consistency tests on the target OLS. And storing the code stream to send to a decoder.

title_en: Acoustic testing method, device and equipment for hearing aid
abstract_en: The invention discloses an acoustic testing method, device and equipment of a hearing aid, wherein the acoustic testing method of the hearing aid comprises the following steps: receiving audio data played by a plurality of hearing aids after pickup in a noisy environment; converting the audio data of each hearing aid into a frequency domain map; analyzing the time domain spectrum and/or the frequency domain spectrum of each hearing aid to obtain a bad hearing aid; reject the bad hearing aid and analyze the noise reduction stability of the first remaining hearing aid. The invention tests the acoustic treatment effect of the hearing aid to evaluate the acoustic performance of the hearing aid and provide a data base for quality control of the hearing aid.

title_en: Control circuit, control method and display device
abstract_en: The application provides a control circuit, a control method and a display device. The control circuit comprises a sampling module, a switching module and a working power supply, wherein the sampling module is used for collecting level signals corresponding to pulse width modulation signals, one end of the switching module is connected with the sampling module, the other end of the switching module is connected with at least one group of signal feedback ends, each signal feedback end comprises at least two feedback points, each feedback point is connected with a light-emitting unit, and the switching module can switch between a first mode and a second mode based on the relation between the level signals and a preset threshold value; in the first mode, the switching module can control each feedback point in the signal feedback end to be independent; in the second mode, the switching module can control each feedback point in the signal feedback end to be related to each other; the working power supply is connected with the sampling module and the switching module and supplies power to the sampling module and the switching module. According to the technical scheme, continuous flicker of the light emitting diode can be reduced when the PWM signal of the low level signal is generated.

title_en: Image encoding/decoding method and apparatus, and recording medium storing bit stream
abstract_en: In the present disclosure, there is provided a video decoding method, including the steps of: acquiring a transform skip mode flag indicating whether a transform skip mode is applied to the current block; determining that a secondary transform/inverse transform is not applied to the current block when a transform skip mode is applied to the current block according to the transform skip mode flag; and when a transform skip mode is not applied to the current block according to the transform skip mode flag, acquiring a transform matrix index for a secondary transform/inverse transform of the current block, and determining whether the secondary transform/inverse transform is applied to the current block according to the transform matrix index.

title_en: On-site positioning and restoring method for fire point of surveillance video
abstract_en: The invention relates to the fire scene investigation technical field, in particular to a monitoring video fire point scene positioning and restoring method, which leads out the monitoring video into a video format which can be identified by a PC, searches a characteristic frame, records the characteristic frame of the initial flame or smoke, converts the characteristic frame into a picture A, records the coordinates of the leftmost pixel point and the rightmost pixel point of the flame, is connected with a scene positioning device, acquires the video of an online video reading monitoring camera, draws a scene position picture, determines the possible distances between the flame position of the fire scene and the camera, the closest and the farthest, finds a scene position corresponding to the coordinate points and marks the scene position in a plane picture, marks the fire point range in the video, namely the range formed by projecting all the possible positions to the ground, compared with the prior art, the invention calculates and leads out the fire point in the original video, and loads the video signal of the video camera at the same scene position into the device, the fire point is positioned on the actual site, so that the high-precision positioning on the site is realized.

title_en: POS machine with heat radiation assembly
abstract_en: The invention discloses a POS machine with a heat dissipation assembly, and relates to the technical field of fund transaction terminal equipment. The air inlet and outlet grid is arranged on two opposite side surfaces of the front shell or the rear shell, the air inlet and outlet grid is communicated with the cavity, the cavity comprises a printing bin and an equipment installation bin, the front shell is provided with two openings, a printing bin cover is arranged on the opening communicated with the printing bin in a matched mode, a touch display screen is arranged on the opening communicated with the equipment installation bin in a matched mode, a printing assembly is arranged in the printing bin in a matched mode, a protection part is arranged in the equipment installation bin, a main board, a magnetic head sensor and a power supply are arranged in the protection part, and a sensing area corresponding to the magnetic head sensor is arranged on the rear shell. According to the POS machine, the cushioning part is contacted with the inner wall of the front shell, the box body is contacted with the inner wall of the rear shell through the cushioning part, and in the vibration process of the POS machine body, vibration is reduced and transmitted to the box body through the cushioning part, so that core components installed in the box body are protected.

title_en: Micro-speaker monomer with better waterproof effect
abstract_en: The invention provides a micro-speaker unit with a better waterproof effect, which comprises an outer shell with an accommodating space and at least one sound hole, and a micro-speaker arranged in the accommodating space. The micro loudspeaker is composed of a vibrating diaphragm component and a magnetic component which is mutually assembled with the vibrating diaphragm component, the vibrating diaphragm component is used for separating the containing space into a front cavity and a rear cavity which are not communicated with each other, the front cavity is communicated with the sound hole and is used for preventing external water vapor from entering the rear cavity and the micro loudspeaker through the vibrating diaphragm component, and therefore the integral waterproof effect of the micro loudspeaker is improved.

title_en: Brightness adjusting method and device, storage medium and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a brightness adjusting method, a device, a storage medium and terminal equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an ambient light brightness value corresponding to a video signal to be processed; determining a brightness adjustment factor corresponding to the video signal based on the ambient light brightness value; and adjusting the brightness mapping curve corresponding to the video signal based on the brightness adjustment factor to obtain an adjusted brightness mapping curve. When the video signal is obtained, the brightness adjustment factor corresponding to the video signal is determined based on the ambient light brightness value, so that the brightness mapping curve corresponding to the video signal is adjusted, the influence of the ambient light on the video signal can be reduced, and the playing effect of the video signal is improved.

title_en: Electroplating pretreatment process for aluminum base material PCB circuit board and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electroplating, in particular to an electroplating pretreatment process for an aluminum base material PCB circuit board and application thereof, and provides the electroplating pretreatment process for the aluminum base material PCB circuit board. The electroplating pretreatment process for the aluminum-base PCB circuit board has concise steps, replaces the traditional secondary zinc dipping step, has less corrosion to the PCB circuit board, furthest keeps the precision of the PCB circuit board, solves the problem that the quality is reduced because bubbles are easily generated on the surface of a plating layer in the electroplating process, improves the yield and improves the economic benefit.

title_en: Lens control method, camera module and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a lens control method, a camera module and electronic equipment. The camera module comprises a focusing motor and a lens, wherein the focusing motor is used for driving the lens to move along the direction of an optical axis. The lens control method can control the lens to realize automatic focusing when the electronic equipment is in a photographing mode or a video recording mode, and can also control the lens to be arranged at the bottom when the electronic equipment is in a super-stable video recording mode to keep the lens stable so as to improve the video recording quality.

title_en: Earphone wind noise identification method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for recognizing wind noise of an earphone. The headset comprising a first microphone located outside the ear and a second microphone located inside the ear, the method comprising: acquiring a first microphone signal acquired by the first microphone and a second microphone signal acquired by the second microphone; obtaining a first frequency domain filtered signal based on the first microphone signal and the second microphone signal; and obtaining an earphone wind noise identification result based on the signal coherence of the first microphone signal and the first frequency domain filtering signal. According to the earphone wind noise identification method, the existing first microphone located outside the ear and the existing second microphone located inside the ear of the earphone are used for wind noise identification, other microphones do not need to be additionally arranged, the hardware cost is reduced, a good wind noise identification effect is achieved, and the earphone wind noise identification method is suitable for different wind noise identification scenes.

title_en: Airflow organization adjusting system and method for eliminating local hot spots of modular machine room
abstract_en: The invention discloses an airflow organization regulating system and a regulating method for eliminating local hot spots of a modular machine room, which comprises a plurality of machine cabinets and a control terminal, wherein the plurality of machine cabinets are respectively connected with the control terminal, the top of each machine cabinet is provided with an airflow regulating device, the bottom of each machine cabinet is provided with an inlet shutter, the airflow regulating device and the inlet shutter are respectively connected with the control terminal, the airflow inlet is provided with a first temperature sensor, a first humidity sensor, a first speed sensor and a first alarm, the airflow outlet is provided with a second temperature sensor, a second humidity sensor, a second speed sensor and a second alarm, the top of each machine cabinet is provided with a unified adjustable airflow regulating device, the bottom of each machine cabinet is provided with an independently adjustable inlet shutter, the airflow organization in each machine cabinet is regulated by utilizing the thermal plume in each machine cabinet, and the balance is realized by changing the resistance of each machine cabinet, local hot spots are avoided, and the balance of the airflow organization is promoted.

title_en: Component mounting system, mounting head, and component mounting method
abstract_en: The component mounting system includes a mounting head, a holding member, and a characteristic measuring device. The holding member is provided to the mounting head and configured to hold the component. The characteristic measuring device measures an electrical characteristic of the member held by the holding member. The characteristic measurement device includes a measurement unit electrically connected to the component held by the holding member, and the measurement unit is provided to the mounting head.

title_en: Mobility emergency base station for 5G network communication
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of base stations, and particularly relates to a mobility emergency base station for 5G network communication, which comprises a base and a base station main body, wherein a fixed cylinder is fixedly arranged on the base, a lifting column is slidably arranged in the fixed cylinder, a cylinder is arranged in the fixed cylinder, the output end of the cylinder is connected with the bottom of the lifting column, a positioning support mechanism is arranged on the outer side wall of the fixed cylinder, a sunshade mechanism is arranged at the upper end of the lifting column, and a cooling mechanism for cooling the base station main body is arranged on the lifting column. According to the invention, the lifting adjustment of the base station main body and the deflection adjustment of the supporting legs are synchronously carried out, the base station main body is tightly matched, the base station is convenient to operate and use, the rapid deployment and use of the emergency base station are facilitated, the sun is shielded by the sun shading mechanism, the temperature inside the base station main body can be rapidly led out, the cooling and heat dissipation of the base station main body are realized, and the stability of a network and the service life of equipment are prevented from being influenced by the excessive temperature.

title_en: Image pickup support device, image pickup system, image pickup support method, and storage medium
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an image pickup support apparatus, an image pickup system, an image pickup support method, and a storage medium. The image pickup support device includes: a processor; and a memory connected to or built in the processor, the processor performing the following: deriving information on a tilt of the imaging device with respect to a rotation mechanism capable of rotating the imaging device about each of a1 st axis and a2 nd axis intersecting the 1 st axis, and in a rotation direction about a 3 rd axis intersecting the 1 st axis and the 2 nd axis, based on a time-series change in a rotation angle of the imaging device; the position of an image captured by the imaging device is adjusted based on the information on the tilt.

title_en: Method and apparatus for removing electronic component
abstract_en: An electronic component removing method and an apparatus thereof, which can remove the electronic component from a circuit substrate even if the area of a metal terminal is small. A circuit board (10) is joined to a plurality of electronic components (20) via solder (30). The device comprises: an adsorption part (60) which comprises an adsorption nozzle (50) with a hollow part (51), and the head end of the adsorption nozzle adsorbs the electronic component (20); a heating unit (70) which includes a heating element (71) provided below the adsorption nozzle and heats the heating element (71) by electromagnetic induction heating; a conduction part (50) for conducting the heat generated by the heating element (71) to the tip end of the adsorption nozzle (50). Heat is conducted from the heating body (71) to the electronic component (20) and the solder (30) through the nozzle (50). The solder (30) melts, and the connection between the circuit-side terminal (12) and the electronic component-side terminal (21) is released. On the other hand, the electronic component (20) and the nozzle (50) are maintained in a suction state, and the electronic component (20) can be removed from the circuit board (10) when the nozzle (50) is separated from the circuit board (10).

title_en: Electronic product shell based on continuous ceramic fibers and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electronic product shell based on continuous ceramic fibers and a preparation method thereof; according to the scheme, biphenyl epoxy resin and epoxy resin are used as main materials of a resin glue solution, a curing agent and other components are added to prepare the resin glue solution, a ceramic fiber grid sheet-shaped framework is doped in the resin glue solution and is cured to prepare a continuous ceramic fiber doped resin plate, and then the continuous ceramic fiber doped resin plate is cut, processed and molded to obtain an electronic product shell; in this scheme this application selects to dope biphenyl epoxy, dopes double-deck composite ceramic fibre simultaneously and strengthens the individual layer substrate for the electronic product shell that the preparation obtained has more excellent mechanical properties, and simultaneously, traditional carbon fiber reinforced material is applied to and can influence the transmission of signal on the electronic product, produces the interference, and the composite ceramic fibre that this scheme was doped has light in weight, non-conducting, the advantage of no interference, but the wide application has higher practicality in the shell preparation of electronic product.

title_en: Data encryption device for 35KV line fault positioning system equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of electric power systems, and provides a data encryption device for 35KV line fault positioning system equipment, which comprises a base, a protective shell and a data encryption device, wherein both sides of the data encryption device are provided with a moving groove and a receiving groove, an inner cavity of the receiving groove is fixedly connected with a folding tube, one end of the folding tube is fixedly connected with a data mounting head, the folding tube enables a connecting line to be electrically connected with the data mounting head, a drawing groove is arranged below the receiving groove, a sliding block is arranged in the inner cavity of the drawing groove in a sliding manner, one end of the sliding block is connected with a moving plate, the moving plate is connected with the data mounting head through a hinge, translation sliding grooves are arranged in the data encryption device and are positioned on the front side and the rear side of the inner cavity of the drawing groove, the translation sliding grooves are matched with the sliding block, when the sliding block is parallel to the translation sliding grooves, the slidable data mounting head enables the sliding block to enter the inner cavity of the translation sliding grooves to move, and then adjusts the data mounting head position, adjusts the wiring position.

title_en: Flexible circuit board convenient to flexible protection equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible circuit board convenient for flexible protection assembly, belonging to the field of flexible circuit boards, wherein a flexible sheath and an insulating support body connected with the interior of a conductive contact piece are additionally arranged, before the circuit board body is electrically assembled, a hollow flexible sleeve on the insulating support body is embedded in the conductive contact piece, a driving piece is utilized to push a supporting piece into the hollow flexible sleeve, the hollow flexible sleeve is expanded and propped to support the conductive contact piece and the flexible sheath, so that the mechanical connection between the insulating support body and the flexible sheath is realized, a technician can electrically assemble the conductive contact piece and a connector by holding an insulating hand-held part without touching the circuit board body and the conductive contact piece, after the assembly is finished, the driving piece is reversely slid, the supporting piece is separated from the hollow flexible sleeve, and the hollow flexible sleeve can be easily pulled out from the flexible sheath by lifting the insulating support body upwards according to the flexibility degree at the joint of the hollow flexible sleeve and the flexible sheath, i.e. without considering the lateral space at the assembly.

title_en: Video encoding and decoding method and device, computer readable medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a video encoding and decoding method, a video encoding and decoding device, a computer readable medium and electronic equipment. The video decoding method comprises the following steps: decoding a coding block of a video image frame to obtain a target intra-frame prediction mode corresponding to the coding block; if the target intra-frame prediction mode is a specified intra-frame prediction mode, updating the statistical value of the target intra-frame prediction mode to obtain the updated statistical value of the specified intra-frame prediction mode, wherein the number of the specified intra-frame prediction modes is smaller than the total number of the intra-frame prediction modes; updating the maximum possible intra-frame prediction mode list according to the updated statistical value of the appointed intra-frame prediction mode; and decoding other coding blocks of the video image frame based on the updated maximum possible intra prediction mode list. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the application can reduce the hardware realization cost and improve the coding and decoding performance to a certain extent.

title_en: Chip placing device and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chip placement device, which comprises a bottom plate, a placement frame, a cover body and a control mechanism, wherein the bottom plate is provided with a bottom plate; the bottom plate is connected with the PCB, the placing frame is positioned on the bottom plate, and a plurality of openings are formed in two opposite sides of the placing frame; the cover body is positioned at the top of the placing frame and used for fixing the chip; the control mechanism is positioned on the bottom plate, is connected with the cover body and is used for controlling the rotation of the cover body; the use method comprises the following steps: 1) the mounting method of the chip placing device comprises the following steps: s1: mounting the bottom plate on the PCB, and mounting the placing frame on the bottom plate; s2: mounting the cover body above the placing frame; s3: mounting a control mechanism on the base plate and connecting the control mechanism to the cover, 2) the method of use comprising: a1: operating the control mechanism, a 2: placing the chip in a placing frame, a 3: the control mechanism is operated in reverse. The chip placing device has the advantages that the chip can be placed inside, and the chip is fixed inside the chip placing device, so that the chip is convenient to replace.

title_en: LED display unit bright and dark line correction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for correcting bright and dark lines of an LED display unit, which calculates correction coefficients at two sides of a gap by carrying out Gaussian filtering on an area integral value meeting the conditions according to the rule that the area integral value of the brightness of the LED display screen is in approximate periodic fluctuation, so as to compensate abnormal values of the area integral value of the brightness of the gap. The invention can accurately position the bright and dark lines in the bright and dark line correction process, reduces bright and dark line correction errors, is suitable for the visual difference of the bright and dark lines at two sides of a gap caused by a physical splicing gap of an LED display screen of an automatic correction system, and improves the screen display effect.

title_en: Projection fusion method based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to a projection fusion method based on a neural network, which comprises the following steps: acquiring an illumination image, a projection image and a target image, acquiring a projection superposition area according to the illumination image, acquiring a homography matrix of each first pixel according to the projection image, acquiring a homography matrix and accuracy of each second pixel according to the homography matrix of each first pixel, acquiring a first fusion target image and a second fusion target image of each second pixel according to the homography matrix and a sub-projection image of the second pixel, and finally acquiring a projection offset characteristic vector; and obtaining projector adjustment parameters by using a neural network according to the projection offset characteristic vector, and adjusting the projector. According to the method for adjusting the parameters of the projector, the parameters of the projector are obtained through the projected image and the target image, so that the adjustment process is simple and quick, an accurate projection fusion result can be obtained on the arc-shaped screen, and the projected image is prevented from generating wrong texture information.

title_en: Cloud computing system with water-cooling heat dissipation mechanism and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloud computing system with a water-cooling heat dissipation mechanism and a method, and particularly relates to the field of water-cooling heat dissipation. According to the invention, the plurality of heat-radiating copper plates connected with the heating parts are fixed, so that heat generated by the parts is absorbed by the heat-conducting copper sheets and then is conveyed to the heat-radiating copper plates through the heat-conducting copper pipes, and then a uniform water-cooling environment is provided for the heat-radiating copper plates through water-cooling circulation, so that the synchronous cooling of the plurality of parts is realized, and the overall heat-radiating effect is improved.

title_en: Automatic pre-stacking equipment for double-spliced boards and technological method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses automatic pre-stacking equipment for double spliced plates, which comprises a PP feeding conveyor, a core plate feeding conveyor, a PP correction table, a core plate correction table, AGV feeding trolleys, a combined clamping crane, a PP core plate forming table, a combined table, a steel plate pushing machine, a double-layer copper foil conveyor sandwich forming table and a double-roll copper foil cutting machine, wherein the AGV feeding trolleys are arranged on two sides of the PP correction table and the core plate correction table, the PP correction table and the core plate correction table are arranged on two sides of the combined clamping crane, the PP core plate forming table is arranged below one end of the combined clamping crane, and the sandwich forming table is arranged below the other end of the combined clamping crane. The double-jointed board laminating machine has the beneficial effects that the full-automatic lamination of double jointed boards is realized, the production efficiency is greatly improved for customers, the production energy is increased, the error rate is reduced, and the product quality is improved; the labor cost is reduced, the intelligent production is realized, and the process is closer to future factories.

title_en: Electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses an electronic device, which comprises a first shell, a second shell, a movable plate and a driving assembly; the first shell comprises a supporting surface; the second shell is slidably connected with the first shell and at least partially embedded in the first shell; the movable plate is movably arranged on the second shell; the driving component is arranged between the movable plate and the second shell and drives the movable plate to move. The first shell is provided with a first state and a second state relative to the second shell, in the first state, at least part of the second shell is embedded in the first shell, and the orthographic projection of the supporting surface on the plane of the second shell is overlapped with the movable plate; in the second state, the orthographic projection of the supporting surface on the plane of the second shell is not overlapped with the movable plate, and the movable plate is in the same plane with the supporting surface under the drive of the driving assembly. Therefore, no matter the flexible screen is curled or unfolded, the surface support can be realized, the supporting force is more uniform, and the supporting strength of the flexible screen is ensured, so that the supporting reliability of the electronic equipment is improved.

title_en: Display driving device and method with low power consumption
abstract_en: The invention discloses a display driving device and method with low power consumption. The display driving device with low power consumption comprises a source electrode driving circuit, a display content detecting circuit and a display time sequence driving circuit. A plurality of pixel switches are arranged between the output end of the source electrode driving circuit and a plurality of sub-pixels of the display panel. The display time sequence driving circuit is coupled with the source electrode driving circuit and the display content detecting circuit and is used for changing the driving sequence according to the display content detected by the display content detecting circuit, and controlling the on time of at least two pixel switches in the plurality of pixel switches to overlap with each other so as to simultaneously drive at least two sub-pixels corresponding to the at least two pixel switches in the plurality of sub-pixels.

title_en: Volume adjusting method, mobile terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a volume adjusting method, which is applied to a mobile terminal and comprises the following steps: acquiring preset information in a preset playing mode; determining or generating a corresponding volume level according to preset information; and adjusting the output volume of the mobile terminal according to the volume level. The volume of the audio signal is adjusted according to the preset information during audio playing, various noise environments can be automatically matched, and intelligent volume adjustment is achieved.

title_en: MEMS device and electronic apparatus
abstract_en: The application discloses a MEMS device and an electronic apparatus. The MEMS device includes a substrate and a vibrating assembly disposed on the substrate; the vibration assembly comprises a back electrode plate and a first vibrating diaphragm, and the first vibrating diaphragm is positioned on a first side of the back electrode plate; a first through hole is formed in the center of the back electrode plate, and the first vibrating diaphragm is provided with a working area and a non-working area; wherein the working area is configured to enable acoustic performance of the first diaphragm by vibration; the non-working area is located at a position opposite to the first through hole, and the non-working area is provided with a plurality of micropores. The MEMS device provided by the application can prevent water vapor or impurities in the air from passing through to a great extent, realizes good waterproof and dustproof effects, and has small influence on the acoustic performance of the vibration component by arranging the micropores in the non-working area.

title_en: Real-time monitoring and early warning device and method for land transportation roadblock
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time monitoring and early warning device and a real-time monitoring and early warning method for a land transportation roadblock, which comprise the following steps: a monitoring device and an early warning device; the monitoring device comprises a limiting guide rail arranged along the road direction and a guide block arranged on the limiting guide rail in a sliding manner, a monitoring camera A for monitoring a reverse lane and a monitoring camera B for monitoring a forward lane are arranged on the guide block, and the monitoring camera A and the monitoring camera B are both connected with the PLC through a data converter; the early warning device comprises a display screen A and a display screen B, wherein the display screen A is positioned at one end of the monitoring device and is arranged above the reverse lane, and the display screen B is positioned at the other end of the monitoring device and is arranged above the forward lane; the PLC controller is respectively connected with the display screen A and the display screen B through the wireless data transceiving module. The invention can monitor the road in real time, and display the monitored roadblock information on the early warning device to remind the driver about entering the road.

title_en: Plane display device with medical and beauty efficacy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flat display device with medical and beauty effects, which comprises: the power supply management module: providing power and power management for the whole device; the menu function identification module: the menu function mode is switched into a medical and beauty mode by the self selection of a user, and an instruction is sent to the central processing unit for processing; a central processing unit: managing the work of the whole device; the liquid crystal display mode processing module: processing the liquid crystal display screen, and adjusting the liquid crystal display screen to be in a medical and American mode; and the picture display module is used for displaying pictures. The invention can adjust the display screen into a laser processing mode, reduce the radiation of the display screen, thereby reducing the damage of the flat display device to the skin and eyes of the human body, treating the spots and acne marks on the skin of the human body and having the medical and aesthetic effects of protecting the vision and the like.

title_en: Wireless record player system and record player using the same
abstract_en: The invention provides a wireless record player system and a record player using the same, wherein the wireless record player system for the record player comprises a preamplifier, a radio frequency module, an electric energy storage element and a wireless power receiving module. The front stage amplifier is used for amplifying an analog signal from a record head, the radio frequency module is used for receiving the analog signal from the amplifier and sending the analog signal to a device matched with the amplifier by a wireless communication technology, the electric energy storage element is used for providing direct current to a wireless record head system or storing electric energy, and the wireless power receiving module is used for receiving and converting wireless power into direct current and providing the direct current to the radio frequency module. The preamplifier, the electric energy storage element and the wireless power receiving module are electrically coupled to the radio frequency module. The invention has the effect of charging the record head and transmitting signals in a wireless mode.

title_en: Processing method for deep hole control metallization of printed circuit board
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing method for deep hole control metallization of a printed circuit board, which comprises the steps of pre-setting copper sheet hollow areas, deep hole control drilling, hole guiding, first copper deposition treatment, first thickening treatment, pattern transfer (positive film), tin plating electrodeposition thickening treatment, alkaline etching, silk screen printing resistance welding and the like on each circuit layer. The method has reasonable design, the arrangement of the leading holes can ensure that the deep control holes can be communicated, the poor situation of hole copper can not be generated when the chemical deposition and the electrodeposition are thickened, and a positive process can be selected when the pattern is transferred, thereby being beneficial to the processing of fine lines.

title_en: Manufacturing method of HTCC multilayer ceramic tube shell
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing method of an HTCC multilayer ceramic tube shell, which mainly comprises the steps of providing a green ceramic chip, printing a metallized pattern on the green ceramic chip, punching a cavity, forming a multilayer ceramic tube shell green body with a cavity structure inside through lamination and isostatic pressing processes, hot cutting the multilayer ceramic tube shell green body to form a single multilayer ceramic tube shell green body unit, opening a cavity on the side wall of the green body unit through laser to form a green body unit with a side wall cavity, and sintering the green body unit with the side wall cavity after side printing to form the HTCC multilayer ceramic tube shell. In the manufacturing method, the formation of the side wall cavity is carried out after the isostatic pressing process in the molding process of the HTCC multilayer ceramic tube shell and the laser perforation mode is combined, so that the problem that the side wall cavity of the HTCC multilayer ceramic tube shell is easy to collapse and deform in the molding process of the side wall cavity in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Image sensor and imaging system
abstract_en: An image sensor according to an aspect of the present disclosure includes: a functional layer including a photoelectric conversion region including a plurality of semiconductor-type carbon nanotubes; a transparent electrode that traps first charges, which are one of positive charges and negative charges generated in the photoelectric conversion region due to incidence of light; a first collecting electrode that collects a second charge having a polarity opposite to the first charge, from among the positive charge and the negative charge; a second collecting electrode for collecting the second electric charge; a first control electrode that controls movement of the second electric charges to the first collecting electrode; a second control electrode that controls movement of the second electric charge to the second collecting electrode; and a charge accumulation unit that accumulates the second charge trapped by the first trapping electrode.

title_en: Virtual image distance detection method of electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a virtual image distance detection method of electronic equipment, which comprises the following steps of focusing a camera, shooting a target through a standard component by using the camera to form an image with a corresponding distance, detecting the definition of the image so as to obtain a relation curve of the definition and the distance, taking down the standard component, shooting a pattern displayed by a sample by using the camera, focusing the camera, locking a focusing ring of the camera, taking down the sample, shooting the pattern displayed by the standard component by using the camera before the standard component is placed on the camera so as to form a corresponding test image, detecting the definition of the test image, and obtaining the corresponding distance according to the definition and the relation curve of the test image, wherein the distance is the virtual image distance of the sample. The invention effectively solves the problem of difficult detection of the virtual image distance of the electronic equipment, and the virtual image distance of the electronic equipment is detected to avoid the fluctuation of the virtual image distance, improve the processing precision, improve the experience of a user, avoid dizziness of the user when the user uses the electronic equipment for a long time and ensure the vision health of the user.

title_en: Display device and tiled display device including the same
abstract_en: Disclosed are a display device and a tiled display device including the same. The display device includes a display region including pixels, a non-display region adjacent to the display region, and a display driver electrically connected to the non-display region. The display region includes a data line supplying a data voltage received from the display driver to the pixels, a gate input line electrically connected to the display driver and extending in a first direction, a gate driver electrically connected to the gate input line, and a gate line electrically connected to the gate driver and extending in a second direction intersecting the first direction.

title_en: Video camera
abstract_en: The application discloses a camera. According to the application, the fixed base shell and the mounting housing of the camera are in transmission connection through the first motor, and the movement assembly of the camera is rotatably arranged on the mounting housing through the second motor, so that the transmission connection between the fixed base shell, the mounting housing and the movement assembly by taking the motors as transmission media can be realized, and the view angle adjustment of the view of the lens of the imaging module in two directions can be respectively realized under the condition that additional shaft transmission assemblies such as a rotating shaft and a bearing are omitted, thereby being beneficial to reducing the cost of the camera and simplifying the assembly of the camera.

title_en: Method, device and storage medium for reproducing dynamic binaural sound of multiple virtual sources
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a storage medium for reproducing dynamic double-sound with a plurality of virtual sources, which are based on tensor decomposition of near-field head related impulse response, the invention adopts a group of common convolvers or equivalent filters which are irrelevant to the target virtual source position to implement binaural sound signal synthesis, and realizes dynamic binaural sound signal processing by changing the weight of each filter. The method of the invention can independently control the direction and the distance of the perception virtual source, obviously reduce the operation amount and the required storage space for simultaneously generating a plurality of virtual sources, thereby improving the signal processing efficiency and the performance of the dynamic virtual binaural sound replay system. The binaural sound signal obtained by the invention is fed to the earphone for playback, and realistic space auditory perception can be generated. The invention can be widely applied to the field of virtual reality and electroacoustic technology.

title_en: Sound device and sound producing device
abstract_en: An acoustic device (3) is provided with a piezoelectric element and a housing (30). The housing (30) has a main body (31) and a rib (35). The main body (31) includes a vibrating portion (32) and a plurality of support portions (33). The rib (35) is connected to the main body (31). The rib (35) extends in the third direction between a pair of the support portions (34 a, 34 b) facing each other and separated from each other in the third direction intersecting the second direction, as viewed in the second direction along the vibration plane. The hollow region (V) is defined by a vibration part (32) and a plurality of supporting parts (33). The opening (S1) is defined by the rib (35) and the body (31), and communicates with the hollow region (V). The rib (35) covers the center of the hollow region (V) as viewed from the second direction.

title_en: Motor controller and vehicle
abstract_en: The application discloses machine controller and vehicle, this machine controller includes: the box body is provided with a power interface; the motor power module is arranged in the box body and is used for being connected with a motor in a vehicle to drive the motor; the installation position is reserved in the box body and used for installing the boosting assembly, and when the boosting assembly is installed in the box body, the boosting assembly is electrically connected between the power interface and the motor power module, so that the electric signal input from the power supply to the motor power module is boosted. Therefore, the installation position is reserved in the motor controller provided by the application, the boosting component can be installed, boosting can be achieved through the installation of the boosting component when boosting is needed, and then matching of boosting functions is achieved.

title_en: Electronic equipment
abstract_en: An electronic device provided by an embodiment of the present application includes: the flexible display screen comprises a rotating shaft, a flexible display screen and a screen body rolling assembly. One end of the flexible display screen is connected with the rotating shaft, and the flexible display screen can be wound on the rotating shaft or can be unfolded relative to the rotating shaft. The flexible display screen can be unfolded or wound on the rotating shaft relative to the rotating shaft through the screen body rolling assembly; the screen rolling assembly applies an acting force to the surface of the flexible display screen in the process that the flexible display screen moves relative to the screen rolling assembly. Through set up the screen body and roll the subassembly on flexible display screen expansion and the route of coiling when in the pivot, by the screen body rolls the subassembly and is in flexible display screen expansion and the in-process of coiling in the pivot to the surface application effort of flexible display screen to can offset flexible display screen and glue the problem because of coiling produces when in the pivot.

title_en: CIS image sensor chip with large dynamic range
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image sensors, in particular to a CIS image sensor chip for a large dynamic range. The CIS image sensor chip with large dynamic range of the embodiment of the invention solves the following contradiction through the design of the double photosensitive areas of the common readout circuit of the photosensitive units: the low illumination requires a large photosensitive area, which is proportional to the received light energy and signal electrons; noise is proportional to non-signal electrons and inversely proportional to process level. High dynamic range requires a large electron trap/photosensitive area, the electron trap being proportional to the capacitance holding the signal electrons, and proportional to the amplitude of the number of electrons from 0 to the full well. According to the invention, through the design of two large and small photosensitive areas, the CIS sensor can obtain imaging capability of 120dB of dynamic range from 0.001LUX illumination environment.

title_en: TOF camera capable of automatically exposing
abstract_en: The invention provides a TOF camera capable of automatically exposing, which comprises a light projector, an infrared camera and a processor module, wherein the light projector is used for projecting infrared light to a target, the infrared camera is used for receiving infrared light reflected by the target to generate infrared images, the processor module is used for calculating a first exposure index according to the proportion that the pixel value in each infrared image exceeds a preset first pixel value threshold value, calculating a second exposure index according to the average value of the amplitude values of each infrared image, judging the exposure state of each infrared image according to the first exposure index, the upper limit pixel threshold value and the lower limit pixel threshold value corresponding to the first exposure index and the amplitude threshold values corresponding to the second exposure index and the second exposure index, and adjusting the exposure time of the TOF camera according to the exposure state. The invention can quickly adjust the exposure time to a proper range, prevent the overexposure and underexposure of the picture and improve the precision and the working distance range of the depth map.

title_en: Electronic module
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electronic module, which comprises: a circuit board; a plurality of electronic elements arranged on the circuit board and electrically connected to the circuit board; a package body disposed on the circuit board for packaging the electronic components, wherein a first groove is formed in the package body; a first electrode, wherein at least a portion of an electrode of an external component is disposed in the first recess and electrically connected to the first electrode of the electronic module.

title_en: Thing networking image acquisition device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of image acquisition, in particular to an internet of things image acquisition device, which comprises an image acquisition device, a charging bin and a supporting assembly, wherein the supporting assembly can form a rail for the image acquisition device to move in the air and support the charging bin, the image acquisition device comprises a shell, photographing equipment is mounted on the shell and can collect surrounding images, a storage battery, a cover plate assembly, a connecting assembly, a speed reduction assembly and a moving assembly are arranged in the shell, the moving assembly can drive the image acquisition device to move on the supporting assembly by utilizing the electric energy of the storage battery, the speed reduction assembly can reduce the moving speed of the image acquisition device when the image acquisition device enters the charging bin, the cover plate assembly can enable the image acquisition device to be automatically opened when the image acquisition device enters the charging bin, the connecting assembly can be connected with the charging bin, the charging bin charges the storage battery, and enables the image acquisition device to be more flexible than a traditional camera, so that patrol security personnel can be replaced or assisted.

title_en: Safety monitoring device based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of safety monitoring devices, and particularly relates to a safety monitoring device based on artificial intelligence, which comprises a device main body, wherein a lifter is arranged in the device main body, a camera is arranged at the bottom of the lifter, an electric heating fan is arranged on the front surface of the device main body, a protective cover is arranged at the top of the device main body, and smoke bomb starters are arranged on two sides of the device main body; according to the safety monitoring device based on artificial intelligence, the camera can be stored into the device main body for protection when the device is in standby or bad weather such as hail occurs by using the lifter, the camera can be dried by using hot air when the surface of the screen of the camera is fogged by using the electric heating fan, the device main body and the monitoring host can be effectively protected by using the buffer shaft and the protective cover, and the device can give an alarm to the surroundings in time for warning when a potential safety hazard is found by using the loudspeaker and the smoke bomb starter, and can also send signal smoke to the sky in cooperation with the signal smoke bomb.

title_en: Polarizing plate with retardation layer and adhesive layer, and image display device using same
abstract_en: The invention provides a polarizing plate with a phase difference layer and an adhesive layer, which can realize an image display device capable of restraining uneven phase difference under a high-temperature environment and restraining uneven color under the high-temperature environment. The polarizing plate with a retardation layer and an adhesive layer of the present invention comprises: a polarizing plate comprising a polarizer; a phase difference layer bonded to the polarizer via the first adhesive layer; and a second adhesive layer provided as an outermost layer on the side of the retardation layer opposite to the polarizing plate. The retardation layer is composed of a stretched film of a resin film, satisfies the relationship of Re (450) < Re (550), and has a shrinkage ratio in the slow axis direction of 4% or less when heated at 80 to 125 ℃ for 180 minutes. The paste offset of the first pressure-sensitive adhesive layer after a heating test at 85 ℃ for 500 hours is 300 [ mu ] m or more.

title_en: Triphibian unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring devices of land, water and air
