abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring, in particular to a land, water and air triphibian unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring device which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle main body, wherein a chute is formed in the lower surface of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, a connecting plate is arranged on the upper surface of a monitoring box, which corresponds to the chute, a baffle is arranged at the end part of the chute, a storage bin is formed in the monitoring box, transparent plates are embedded on the side walls of the monitoring box, a mounting plate is arranged at the bottom of the storage bin, and a monitoring camera is arranged on the upper surface of the mounting plate; this triphibian type unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring devices of land, water and air has the monitoring box of connecting plate through setting up, can with the quick cooperation of pegging graft of spout in the unmanned aerial vehicle main part, and carry out the rigidity through first gim peg under the baffle effect, inlay on monitoring box outer wall and establish a plurality of transparent plates, a plurality of surveillance cameras of installation can realize multi-direction monitoring operation on the mounting panel, sealed lid can increase the leakproofness of monitoring box under the cooperation of rubber pad, reduce external dust granule and water droplet entering monitoring incasement portion, reduce inside damage.

title_en: Switch dimming driving device of narrow-voltage LED lamp
abstract_en: The invention discloses a switch dimming driving device of a narrow-voltage LED lamp, which comprises a dimming driver shell, wherein a bottom opening is formed in the lower surface of the dimming driver shell, an installation device is arranged at the bottom opening of the dimming driver shell, and a heat dissipation mechanism is arranged on the surface of one side of the dimming driver shell. The switch dimming driving device of the narrow-voltage LED lamp belongs to the technical field of dimming, can adapt to the situation that foreign matters are blocked on an object to be installed and normal installation cannot be carried out, and the dustproof grid blocking net is blocked in front of the ventilation opening, so that the trouble of entering of the foreign matters can be reduced, and the problem that the ventilation opening is exposed and is poked and inserted by sharp objects is also avoided.

title_en: Self-adhesive sheet
abstract_en: The present invention provides a self-adhesive sheet comprising a 4-methyl-1-pentene polymer, wherein the self-adhesive sheet preferably has a temperature at which a maximum value of loss tangent (tan delta) obtained by dynamic viscoelasticity measurement at a temperature rise rate of 4 ℃/min, a frequency of 1.59Hz and a strain amount of 0.1% is at least 1 or more in a range of 10 ℃ to 100 ℃ and the maximum value of loss tangent is 0.5 to 3.5, wherein the arithmetic average roughness Ra of one surface of the self-adhesive sheet is in a range of 0.01 to 10 mu m, and the ten-point average roughness Rz is in a range of 0.1 to 50 mu m.

title_en: Image processing apparatus and method, image capturing apparatus, control method therefor, and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an image processing apparatus and method, an image capturing apparatus, a control method thereof, and a storage medium. The image processing apparatus includes an acquisition section configured to acquire a plurality of different viewpoint images obtained by capturing the same scene from different viewpoints, and configured to acquire at least one parallax image pair having parallax by pupil division, a first generation section configured to generate a first distance image from the parallax image pair, a second generation section configured to generate a second distance image from the plurality of different viewpoint images, and an integration section configured to integrate the first distance image and the second distance image and generate an integrated distance image.

title_en: Pixel circuit, display panel and display device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pixel circuit, a display panel and a display device, comprising a data writing circuit and a driving transistor; the data write circuit includes: a first data write transistor, a second data write transistor, and a distributed capacitance; a gate of the first data writing transistor is coupled to the first scan signal terminal, a gate of the second data writing transistor is coupled to the second scan signal terminal, a first pole of the first data writing transistor is coupled to the data line, a second pole of the first data writing transistor is coupled to the first pole of the second data writing transistor, and a second pole of the second data writing transistor is coupled to the first pole of the driving transistor; the first electrode of the distributed capacitor is coupled to the second electrode of the first data writing transistor, and the second electrode of the distributed capacitor is coupled to the fixed voltage signal terminal.

title_en: Imaging element, stacked imaging element, and solid-state imaging device
abstract_en: The invention relates to an imaging element, a stacked imaging element, and a solid-state imaging device. Wherein the imaging element may include: a photoelectric conversion unit including a first electrode, a photoelectric conversion layer, and a second electrode that are laminated, wherein the photoelectric conversion unit further includes a charge storage electrode that is arranged to be separated from the first electrode and to face the photoelectric conversion layer via an insulating layer, and that is formed with a charge motion control electrode in a region where: the region faces a region of the photoelectric conversion layer between the imaging element and an adjacent imaging element via the insulating layer.

title_en: Video image information sharing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a video image information sharing system, which comprises a user module, wherein the user module is connected with a video image information sharing module, the video image information sharing module is connected with a video image information database, and the video image information database is connected with a video image information acquisition module; the user module is responsible for: a user extracts and applies for video image data to be submitted to a video image information sharing module through a user module; the video image information sharing module is responsible for: and calling corresponding video image information from the video image information database and pushing the video image information to the user module. The video image information sharing system realizes unified management, analysis, calling and application of video image information through the system, realizes visualization, management, availability and storage of all video resources of a database, takes a video image information integration system as a core, provides a high-efficiency and safe guarantee mechanism for video sharing, and finally realizes video networking sharing and application.

title_en: Magnetic recording/reproducing apparatus and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a magnetic recording/reproducing apparatus and a method of manufacturing the same. An object of an embodiment is to adsorb a contaminant gas in a magnetic recording and reproducing apparatus by incorporating an irreversible adsorbing member in a case. The magnetic recording and reproducing device and the method of manufacturing the same according to the present embodiment include an irreversible adsorption member in a sealed case for the magnetic recording and reproducing device.

title_en: Preparation method of circuit board with heat dissipation function
abstract_en: A preparation method of a circuit board comprises the following steps: laminating a first peelable film and a second peelable film, and laying down the fluffy carbon nanotube between the first peelable film and the second peelable film to form a carbon nanotube layer; pressing the first peelable film, the carbon nanotube layer and the second peelable film, so as to compact the fluffy carbon nanotube to obtain a heat conducting layer; removing the first peelable film, and forming a first adhesive layer, a first dielectric layer and a first circuit layer on one side of the heat conduction layer away from the second peelable film; removing the second peelable film, and forming a second adhesive layer, a second dielectric layer and a second circuit layer on one side of the heat conduction layer away from the first adhesive layer; and mounting an electronic component on the first circuit layer. The heat generated by the electronic element can be quickly dissipated, and the preparation process is simple in flow and low in energy consumption and cost.

title_en: Rear cover assembly and mobile terminal
abstract_en: The application provides a rear cover assembly and a mobile terminal. Rear cover subassembly includes mainboard support, back lid, camera decoration and mounting. The mainboard support comprises a support body and a clamping body, and the clamping body is fixed on the surface of the support body. The back lid is equipped with first mounting hole, and the camera decoration is equipped with the mounting groove, and the tank bottom wall of mounting groove is equipped with the second mounting hole, and back lid closes the surface that is equipped with the card and holds the body at the mainboard support. The camera decoration is installed in the surface that the back lid dorsad mainboard support, and the tank bottom wall of mounting groove is located first mounting hole, and the card is held the body and is located first mounting hole, and passes in the second mounting hole extends to the mounting groove. The fixing piece is arranged in the mounting groove and clamped with the clamping body. The application provides a rear cover subassembly can solve the fixed mode of camera decoration among the prior art complicacy, the technical problem of easily warping.

title_en: Earphone-based control method and device, earphone and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a control method and device based on an earphone, the earphone and a computer readable storage medium. The method is applied to the earphone and comprises the following steps: when the earphone detects a trigger operation, generating a control instruction according to the trigger operation; acquiring the current wearing state of the earphone; and under the condition that the current wearing state is a target wearing state, controlling terminal equipment in communication connection with the earphone to delay a first time period according to the control instruction, and then executing operation corresponding to the control instruction. The earphone-based control method, the earphone-based control device, the earphone and the computer-readable storage medium disclosed by the embodiment of the application can perform delay control on the operation executed by the terminal equipment in combination with the wearing state of the earphone, meet the requirement of a user on the delay control in practice, and enrich the control mode of the earphone on the terminal equipment.

title_en: Consultation platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of consultation platforms, in particular to a consultation platform, which comprises a platform body, wherein a table support leg is fixedly arranged at the corner of the lower end face of the platform body, a foot pad is fixedly arranged at the lower end face of the table support leg, three groups of display frames are linearly arranged at the front edge of the upper end of the platform body, a unfolding piece is arranged between the three groups of display frames, a clamping piece is arranged between the lower end of the front display frame and the platform body, and a paper pulling piece is arranged at the front end of the display frame. The invention improves the protection force of the display frame in the use process, meets the recruitment requirement, and facilitates the replacement of recruitment paper in the display frame.

title_en: Projection apparatus and driving method of light source thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a projection device and a driving method of a light source thereof. Each light source driving circuit can provide driving current for the light source connected with the light source driving circuit based on the light source driving signal provided by the display control circuit under the driving of the driving voltage provided by the power circuit so as to drive the light source to emit light. Since the second ends of the plurality of light sources are all connected with the grounding end, the driving current flowing through the plurality of light sources can directly flow into the grounding end. Therefore, the area of a current loop of the driving current in the transmission process is smaller, so that the electromagnetic disturbance generated by the driving current in the transmission process is ensured to be smaller, and the influence of the electromagnetic wave radiated by the projection equipment on the working state and performance of the internal device and other electronic equipment around the projection equipment is avoided.

title_en: Novel display circuit and driving method
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel display circuit and a driving method, wherein the circuit comprises a plurality of GIP circuit units, the Q point of each GIP circuit unit is respectively connected with a transistor J, the grid electrode of the transistor J is connected with a graphic signal SW _ Q, and the drain electrode of the transistor J is connected with a VGL. By adding the transistor of the graphic signal SW _ Q, when the blank stage is started, the graphic signal SW _ Q is pulled high, the charge of the Q point is released, the T4 is closed, and the phenomenon of wrong charging such as ghost image and the like is avoided. The invention also provides a novel display circuit driving method, in the stage t1, the STV keeps high level, and the CK, the CKB, the RST and the SW _ Q keep low level; in the stage t2, the CK high level CKB low level of the first state and the CK low level CKB high level of the second state cyclically alternate, and the STV, the RST and the SW _ Q are kept at low levels; in the t3 stage, RST and CKB are kept at high level, and STV, CK and SW _ Q are kept at low level; at stage t4, signal SW _ Q is pulled high, and STV, CK and CKB, RST remain low.

title_en: Ultrasonic array transducer with heat dissipation mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to an ultrasonic array transducer with a heat dissipation mechanism, which comprises a substrate, an acoustic matching layer and a piezoelectric wafer connected between the substrate and the acoustic matching layer, wherein a plurality of first cutting grooves penetrating in the thickness direction are formed in the piezoelectric wafer to divide the piezoelectric wafer into a plurality of array elements connected on the substrate, a plurality of second cutting grooves extending in the thickness direction are formed in the acoustic matching layer, the heat dissipation mechanism is further arranged between the substrate and the piezoelectric wafer, and the heat dissipation mechanism extends out from the space between the substrate and the piezoelectric wafer and is connected with a heat conduction mechanism. The heat on the substrate and the piezoelectric wafer is led out by the heat dissipation mechanism and dissipated by the heat leading-out mechanism, and the heat dissipation mechanism is in large-area contact with the piezoelectric wafer so as to lead out most of heat on the piezoelectric wafer, so that the heat dissipation capacity of the piezoelectric wafer is improved, the excitation power of the ultrasonic probe is reduced under the temperature limitation, the excitation power can be further increased, and the detection depth is increased.

title_en: Shooting method, graphical user interface and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a shooting method, a graphical user interface and an electronic device. The shooting method can support the user to realize the switching of the shooting modes such as single-mirror shooting and multi-mirror shooting through the air isolating gesture without touching the display screen, so that the user operation is convenient.

title_en: Adhesive sheet for display and display including the same
abstract_en: The invention provides a bonding sheet for display, which comprises a variable bonding layer formed by bonding compositionThe adhesive composition includes an acrylic host resin, a crosslinking agent, a photoinitiator, and a photocurable monomer represented by the following chemical formula 1, wherein in the chemical formula 1, R1 is hydrogen or a C1-C4 alkyl group, R2 is hydrogen, a C1-C4 alkyl group, or a C6-C10 aryl group, and n is an integer of 1 to 8. Chemical formula 1: 。

title_en: Transmission method and circuit of driving data of backlight module and display device
abstract_en: The application discloses a transmission method and circuit of driving data of a backlight module and a display device. The method can determine the data type of the effective data in the backlight data packet based on the type parameter in the backlight data packet. The data type includes partition mapping data and backlight driving data of the backlight module. In addition, the method provided by the application can update the partition mapping relation of the backlight module through the partition mapping data in the backlight data packet, and can process the backlight driving data in the backlight data packet based on the partition mapping relation. Therefore, accurate transmission of driving data of each backlight partition of the backlight module can be ensured. That is, the method provided by the application can be applied to backlight modules with different backlight partition dividing modes, and the application flexibility is high.

title_en: End-to-end high quality achromatic imaging system based on depth calculation optical element
abstract_en: The invention discloses an end-to-end high-quality achromatic imaging system based on a depth calculation optical element, which sequentially comprises a physical lens PL, a sensor and a digital lens DL from an image input end to an output end; firstly, convolving an input image with a physical lens to generate a chromatic aberration image; the chromatic aberration image is collected by a camera and is used as an input image of a digital lens to be convolved with DL (digital lens) to generate an output image; and the output image generates a reconstructed image through a neural network AANet. The optical system is simple in design, low in cost and easy to integrate, and the end-to-end linkage optimization method enables the algorithm and the optical hardware to be deeply coupled and can realize software and hardware linkage optimization; compared with an input image, the quantization improvement of the peak signal-to-noise ratio of the reconstructed image reaches 14.2dB, high-precision achromatic imaging can be realized, and the flexibility of the frame provides possibility for high-quality, large-depth-of-field and large-field-of-view imaging.

title_en: Anti-radiation foot pad and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of automobile accessories and discloses a radiation-resistant foot pad which comprises a foot pad body and a radiation-resistant layer, wherein the radiation-resistant layer covers the surface of the foot pad body, and is made of silver-containing fiber yarns. The invention also discloses a manufacturing method of the anti-radiation foot pad, silver ions are sputtered by adopting a sputtering method so that the silver ions are loaded on the fiber yarns to form silver-containing fiber yarns, and the silver-containing fiber yarns are woven into silver-containing fiber fabrics and then are fixed on the surface of the foot pad body to manufacture the anti-radiation foot pad. The invention can effectively shield the electromagnetic radiation emitted in the automobile and is beneficial to preventing the electromagnetic radiation leaked in the automobile from influencing the body health of drivers and passengers.

title_en: Electromagnetic shielding heat conduction PBT/PET (polybutylene terephthalate/polyethylene terephthalate) based composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electromagnetic shielding heat-conducting PBT/PET-based composite material and a preparation method thereof, wherein the electromagnetic shielding heat-conducting PBT/PET-based composite material is prepared from the following raw materials: PBT, PET, flake graphite, zinc oxide, barium ferrite, POE-g-GMA, gamma- (2,3-epoxypropoxy) propyl trimethoxy silane, and beta- (4-hydroxyphenyl-3,5-di-tert-butyl) n-octadecyl propionate. The PBT/PET-based composite material has excellent electromagnetic shielding performance and heat conduction performance, and can be widely applied to the field of electronic components needing shielding and heat conduction functions.

title_en: Portable electric power storage power generation facility of movable
abstract_en: A movable portable power storage and generation device relates to a vehicle-mounted power device and aims to solve the problem that energy is wasted due to the fact that charging and power utilization of an existing vehicle-mounted power supply device cannot be accurately controlled. The singlechip is connected with the touch display screen; the touch display screen is used for inputting a control instruction; the electric quantity monitor is used for monitoring the electric energy of the electric energy storage unit and is connected with the single chip microcomputer; the singlechip is connected with the current converter; the converter is connected with the converter transformer; meanwhile, the current converter is connected with the driving module; the driving signal output end of the driving module is connected with the driving signal input end of the generator; the high-voltage signal output end of the converter transformer is connected with the high-voltage signal input end of the high-voltage vacuum switch, and the converter transformer is used for controlling the voltage of the output current of the electric energy storage unit; the electric energy storage unit supplies power to the vehicle-mounted electric appliance through the high-voltage vacuum switch; the bottom of the power device body is provided with universal wheels. The beneficial effect is that the control is accurate with the electric voltage.

title_en: Image compression method, restoration method, computing device and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an image compression method, an image restoration method, computing equipment and a readable storage medium, and relates to the field of image processing. The image compression method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a data file of an image to be compressed, wherein a pixel buffer area of the data file comprises transparency data of transparency channels of all pixels and color data of a plurality of color channels. Then, based on the color data of each color channel of each pixel, it is detected whether the image to be compressed is a pure color image. If so: extracting pure color data of an image to be compressed and storing the pure color data to a preset position; converting the transparency data of each pixel to be compressed into color data of a single-channel image; deleting the transparency data of each pixel and the color data of each color channel in the pixel buffer area, and reducing the size of the pixel buffer area to the width of a single channel; and writing the color data converted from the transparency data of each pixel to be compressed into the corresponding pixel buffer area. The invention can greatly improve the compression ratio of the pure color image and can realize lossless restoration.

title_en: Display panel and driving method thereof, compensation data compression method and decompression method
abstract_en: A display panel and a driving method thereof, a compensation data compression method and a decompression method. The display panel comprises a data compression unit (1) and a data decompression unit (2). The data compression unit (1) is used for acquiring a plurality of first compensation data and common parameters, compressing each first compensation data into second compensation data according to a preset compression rule according to the first compensation data and the common parameters, wherein the bit width of the second compensation data is smaller than that of the first compensation data corresponding to the second compensation data, the difference value between each first compensation data and the second compensation data corresponding to the first compensation data is equal to the common parameters, and the data decompression unit (2) is used for acquiring a plurality of second compensation data and the common parameters, and decompressing each second compensation data into the first compensation data according to the preset decompression rule according to the second compensation data and the common parameters. The display panel can reduce the amount of memory transmission of compensation data.

title_en: Heterogeneous substrate structure and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heterogeneous substrate structure and a manufacturing method thereof. The heterogeneous substrate structure comprises a glass substrate, an electrode layer, a first sub-circuit board and a first rewiring layer. The electrode layer is located on the glass substrate. The first sub circuit board is positioned on the glass substrate and the electrode layer. The first sub-circuit board has a conductive via. The conductive through hole is positioned in the first sub-circuit board and positioned on the electrode layer. The first rewiring layer is located on the first sub-circuit board and the conductive through holes. The conductive through hole is electrically connected with the electrode layer and the first rewiring layer.

title_en: Back drill deviation detection auxiliary device, printed circuit board and back drill deviation detection system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a back drilling deviation detection auxiliary device, a printed circuit board and a back drilling deviation detection system, wherein the device comprises: a controller and at least one back drill detection module; the back drilling detection module is arranged on the plate edge on the front side of the printed circuit board; the back drilling detection module comprises at least one back drilling detection hole and a circular deviation indication unit surrounding the back drilling detection hole; the diameter of the circular deviation indicating unit is a preset size and is larger than the diameter of the matched back-drilled detection hole; before back drilling deviation detection, the circle center of the circular deviation indicating unit is the same as the circle center of the matched back drilling detection hole, and the diameter of the back drilling detection hole is smaller than that of the back drilling hole; the controller is used for controlling the back drill to drill through the printed circuit board from the back drill positioning hole when the back drill deviation is detected, so that the diameter of the back drill detection hole is the same as that of the back drill hole. The auxiliary device for back drilling deviation detection provided by the embodiment of the invention improves the efficiency of back drilling deviation detection.

title_en: Remote imaging method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of imaging, in particular to a remote imaging method, a remote imaging device, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the remote imaging method comprises the following steps: generating a light irradiation instruction, and sending the light irradiation instruction to a preset laser projector; acquiring the projection size of a light beam projected by the laser projector on the outer wall of the building, and acquiring a preset light beam calibration size from the light irradiation instruction; comparing the size of the projected light beam with the calibrated size of the light beam, and if the size comparison is inconsistent, sending a light beam adjusting instruction to the laser projector; and after the adjustment response sent by the laser projector is obtained, presenting a corresponding image on the outer wall of the building according to the lamplight irradiation instruction. This application has the effect of improving the imaging means of building outer wall.

title_en: Automatic focusing device, camera and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic focusing device, a camera and a control method, and belongs to the technical field of camera shooting. The automatic focusing apparatus includes: a lens assembly; a chip assembly opposite to the lens assembly; at least one adjustment assembly comprising a magnetic member and an electromagnetic member opposite the magnetic member; one of the lens component and the chip component is provided with a magnetic part, the other one of the lens component and the chip component is provided with an electromagnetic part, and when the electromagnetic part is electrified, the electromagnetic part generates magnetic force to act on the magnetic part to adjust the distance between the lens component and the chip component. The automatic focusing device, the camera and the control method can quickly realize automatic focusing, improve the working efficiency, reduce the erection of devices such as a dispenser, a debugging jig and the like, simplify the working procedures of focusing and saving the cost.

title_en: PCB assembly detection system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PCB assembly detection system based on the Internet of things, which is used for acquiring data information of an assembled PCB by utilizing a data acquisition module, wherein the data information comprises type information, size information and coordinate information of the PCB, a data processing module is used for receiving and processing the data information to obtain data processing information and sending the data processing information to a data analysis module, the data analysis module is used for receiving and analyzing the data processing information to obtain data analysis information, a marking module is used for receiving and analyzing and marking the data analysis information and a warning module is used for receiving and warning the marking data.

title_en: Wireless earphone with pressure sensing module and pressure sensing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless earphone with a pressure sensing module and a pressure sensing method, wherein the wireless earphone with the pressure sensing module comprises an earphone rear shell, a Bluetooth mainboard, a pressure sensing bracket and a pressure sensing device, wherein the earphone rear shell comprises a cylindrical shell part, a mainboard mounting position is arranged in the cylindrical shell part, and a pressure sensing pressing part is arranged on the left side and/or the right side of the cylindrical shell part; the Bluetooth mainboard is arranged on the mainboard mounting position; the pressure-sensitive support is arranged on the Bluetooth mainboard, and a pressure-sensitive mounting position is arranged on the upper side of the pressure-sensitive support; the pressure-sensitive device is arranged on the pressure-sensitive mounting position, the upper side of the pressure-sensitive device is in interference fit with the inner wall of the upper end of the cylindrical shell part, and a conductive circuit is connected between the pressure-sensitive device and the Bluetooth mainboard. The invention has convenient assembly, sensitive induction and difficult mechanical damage to the pressure sensing device.

title_en: Metal audio speaker cover with multi-color cloth-shaped appearance and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: A metal audio speaker cover having a cloth-like appearance surface and related method of manufacture is disclosed. The metal audio speaker cover has a base of a metal mesh through which sound can pass; a pre-treatment film attached to the base of the metal mesh; and one or more multi-color powder coating films attached to the pretreatment film. In some embodiments, the surface also has antimicrobial properties.

title_en: Video input interface verification system and verification method
abstract_en: The application provides a video input interface verification system and a verification method, wherein the video input interface verification system comprises: the verification excitation generating module is used for superposing verification excitation in first video data for verifying the video input interface control module and inputting second video data superposed with the verification excitation into the video input interface control module; the video input interface control module is used for receiving the second video data sent by the verification excitation generating module, then performing deactivation processing on the second video data to generate third video data, and outputting the third video data to the verification module; and the verification module is used for receiving the third video data and acquiring a verification result of the video input interface control module. The removal capability of the video input interface control module to the verification stimulus is verified through the verification stimulus of the verification stimulus generation module to the video data superposition, so that the scene coverage rate in the verification process of the video input interface is greatly improved.

title_en: Playback testing device
abstract_en: The invention provides a playback test device, comprising: the parallel-serial module is connected with a camera module of the camera to be tested; the data acquisition module comprises a serial-to-parallel conversion module and is used for deserializing the serial data into two groups of same video data; the processor is used for processing one group of the deserialized video data and the vehicle body data; the storage module is used for storing the data processed by the processor; the playback module comprises a video output module for outputting video data and a vehicle body data simulation module for outputting vehicle body data; and the power supply module is used for supplying power to the playback testing device, wherein the image processing controller of the camera to be tested can operate an algorithm according to the data output by the playback module and can also operate an algorithm according to another set of deserialized video data and vehicle body data. By applying the technical scheme of the invention, the problems of large volume, high use requirement and low functional value of the playback test device in the prior art can be effectively solved.

title_en: Sub-bitstream extraction of multi-layer video bitstream
abstract_en: Examples of video encoding methods and apparatus and video decoding methods and apparatus are described. An example method of video processing includes: performing a conversion between a video and a bitstream of the video according to a rule, wherein the bitstream includes Network Abstraction Layer (NAL) units for a plurality of video layers according to the rule; wherein the rule defines that a sub-bitstream extraction process that generates an output bitstream comprising an Output Layer Set (OLS) includes one or more operations that are selectively performed in response to: (1) The list of NAL unit header layer identifier values in the OLS does not include all values of NAL unit header layer identifiers in all Video Coding Layer (VCL) NAL units in the bitstream, and (2) the output bitstream contains Supplemental Enhancement Information (SEI) NAL units that contain scalable nesting SEI messages.

title_en: Sausage filler machine body ventilation system and sausage filler
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sausage stuffer equipment, in particular to a sausage stuffer and a ventilating system of a sausage stuffer body, which comprises a case, wherein an air inlet is formed in the lower part of one side of the case, an air outlet is formed in the upper part of one side of the case, which is far away from the air inlet, a fan is arranged in the case and used for sucking external air into the case through the air inlet, a plurality of air guide plates are arranged in the case at intervals and matched with the fan to guide the air sucked into the case by the fan and discharge the air through the air outlet, food to be processed enters the sausage stuffer body through a feed inlet and is processed by the sausage stuffer body, the processed food is discharged through a discharge outlet, when the sausage stuffer body works, the external air is sucked into the sausage stuffer body through the air inlet by a side-flow blower, the interior of the sausage stuffer body is cooled, and the air is discharged through exhaust under the flow guide of the plurality of the air guide plates.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a display device. The display device includes a first substrate, a second substrate, a red filter layer, a green filter layer, and a blue filter layer, a first light emitting diode, and a Rich ray Dirichter. The second substrate is arranged opposite to the first substrate. The red filter layer, the green filter layer and the blue filter layer are arranged between the first substrate and the second substrate, wherein a part of the red filter layer, a part of the green filter layer and a part of the blue filter layer are stacked to form a light shielding structure. The first light-emitting diode and the second light-emitting diode are adjacent to each other and arranged between the first substrate and the second substrate, and the orthographic projection of the light-shielding structure on the second substrate is positioned between the orthographic projections of the first light-emitting diode and the second light-emitting diode on the second substrate.

title_en: Switched reluctance motor controller
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of motor controllers, in particular to a switched reluctance motor controller, which comprises: the top of the controller is provided with a radiating fin; the controller comprises a screw joint ring, wherein a vertical rod is arranged at the bottom of the screw joint ring, a rubber ball is arranged at the bottom of the vertical rod, a ball is arranged at the bottom of the rubber ball, a circular groove is formed in the top of the controller, an arc-shaped plate is arranged at the top of the controller, and a gap is formed between the arc-shaped plates; the exhaust hole is arranged on the surface of the controller; the beneficial effects are that: the top of the controller provided by the invention is provided with a circular groove, the screw connection ring is screwed in the arc-shaped plate, the rubber ball is supported in the arc-shaped plate, the ball rotates in the circular groove in the process of rotating the screw connection ring, when the rubber ball is clamped in the groove, the screw connection ring is prevented from loosening in the arc-shaped plate, air flows through the radiating fin through the rotation of the fan blades, the top of the controller is radiated, and the air in the radiating fin enters the bottom of the controller from the through groove.

title_en: Public traffic early warning method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a public traffic early warning method and a public traffic early warning system based on the Internet of things, wherein the public traffic early warning method comprises the following steps: acquiring a facial image of a vehicle driver through an imaging device, acquiring the driving state of the driver according to the facial image, and assigning and outputting the driving state of the driver; selecting vehicles in a certain vehicle driving road section to perform triangle fitting so as to obtain a position set of all triangle areas in the vehicle driving road section, wherein each triangle area takes three vehicles as three vertexes of a triangle; acquiring the driving risk of each triangular area in a certain vehicle driving road section, and acquiring area risk prompt information; and generating driving prompt information according to the regional risk prompt information, and sending the driving prompt information to the vehicle drivers in the corresponding regions. The invention can be combined with the quantized driving state of the driver to carry out quantitative and visual processing on the driving risk of the vehicle in the area so as to achieve the aim of overall and accurate early warning.

title_en: Identification method of target frequency light source of imaging system and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an identification method of a target frequency light source of an imaging system and terminal equipment. The identification method comprises the following steps: the image sensor respectively carries out long exposure and short exposure on the same scene in the same frame interval under a light source, and correspondingly outputs a long exposure image and a short exposure image; analyzing the long exposure image and the short exposure image to generate an image brightness difference signal; performing Fourier transform on the image brightness difference signal to obtain energy spectrum distribution in a frequency domain; and judging whether a light source with a specified target frequency exists in the current environment or not according to the energy spectrum distribution analysis. According to the invention, the image brightness difference signal is generated according to the images of the long exposure and the short exposure in the same frame, and Fourier transform is carried out, so that whether the light source with the target frequency is included in the current environment or not can be efficiently and accurately identified. The long exposure and the short exposure differ in exposure duration, and flicker is still detected when the frame interval time is an integer multiple of the ambient light source flicker period. Normal striped objects can be distinguished from flicker.

title_en: Connection protection piece, circuit board assembly, power module and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a connect protection piece, circuit board subassembly, power module and electronic equipment can be used for cooperating the circuit board and realize the protective effect. The connecting protection piece comprises a protection shell, a protection cap and a fixing ring; the protective shell comprises a bottom plate and a protective plate arranged around the edge of the bottom plate, the bottom plate and the protective plate form an open slot, and the bottom plate is provided with a mounting hole; the protective cap is used for buckling the opening of the open slot to form an accommodating space with the protective shell; the fixing ring is arranged on the protective shell and is provided with a connecting part which extends out of the protective shell from the mounting hole. When the protective device is applied to a scene without electrical connection, the connecting piece can penetrate through the protective shell to fix the circuit board to other structures, and the connecting protective piece shields the connecting piece to play a protective role on the connecting piece; when the connecting protection piece is applied to a scene needing electrical connection, whether the connecting protection piece is electrically connected with other electronic equipment or a circuit board, the connecting protection piece can play a role in protecting part of an electrical connection structure.

title_en: Sub-bitstream extraction
abstract_en: Several techniques for video encoding and video decoding are described. One example method includes performing a conversion between a video and a bitstream of the video according to a rule, wherein the rule specifies that a variable indicating a number of sub-layers in each codec layer of each output layer set is derived based on syntax elements included in a Video Parameter Set (VPS); and wherein the rule further specifies that information from the variable is used to remove video codec layer network abstraction layer units from the bitstream during the sub-bitstream extraction process.

title_en: Fire engine intelligent recognition system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an intelligent fire fighting truck identification system based on edge calculation, and relates to the technical field of image identification. The system comprises: the camera is arranged on the fire fighting truck and used for acquiring a target area image; and the edge calculation module is connected with the camera and used for identifying the fire in the target area image acquired by the camera based on a preset fire identification algorithm and determining the distribution scheme of firemen for each identified fire area. The fire extinguishing system can intelligently identify the fire condition of a fire area and automatically determine the distribution scheme of firemen according to the fire condition information, thereby effectively improving the fire extinguishing efficiency and ensuring the personal safety of the firemen.

title_en: Pattern optical anti-counterfeiting structure, manufacturing method thereof and coin seal
abstract_en: The invention provides an image optical anti-counterfeiting structure, a manufacturing method thereof and a coin and stamp, which are used for the coin and stamp, wherein the image optical anti-counterfeiting structure comprises a relief pattern arranged on the coin and stamp; the relief pattern comprises a plane relief pattern or a three-dimensional relief pattern or a combination of the plane relief pattern and the three-dimensional relief pattern, wherein the outline of the relief pattern comprises characters and/or graphic elements, and the outline of the relief pattern is filled with grating microstructures with preset graphics or character elements, wherein the grating microstructures enable the relief pattern to present three-dimensional relief patterns with different colors when being watched from different viewing angles. The pattern optical anti-counterfeiting structure provided by the invention not only can enhance the stereoscopic effect of the embossment and generate richer optical visual effects, but also can combine the planar embossment with the three-dimensional embossment to present unique visual effects.

title_en: Artificial intelligent following type projection sand table and projection method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses an artificial intelligent following type projection sand table and a projection method thereof, belonging to the technical field of digital sand tables, wherein the sand table comprises a data acquisition device, a data processing terminal and a projector; the data processing terminal is used for carrying out data processing on the data information of the observer and the distance information, calculating projection data by using a projection display prediction model and sending the projection data to the projector, and the projector is used for projecting images according to projection parameters of projection data adjusting equipment. According to the scheme, the sensor in the sand table is matched with a corresponding analysis algorithm to perform data processing, so that the direction and effect of projection display of the sand table can be dynamically adjusted based on the position change of an observer.

title_en: Electronic device
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electronic device, which comprises a back frame, a first heat source, a second heat source, a guide piece and a fan. The first heat source is arranged on the first side of the back frame, the second heat source is arranged on the second side of the back frame, the guide piece is arranged on the second side of the back frame, and the fan is arranged corresponding to the guide piece. Wherein at least a portion of an airflow path is formed between the first heat source and the second heat source.

title_en: Patch tooling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a patch fixture, which belongs to the technical field of mounting and comprises a driving mechanism, a transmission piece and a clamping device, wherein the clamping device is connected with the driving mechanism through the transmission piece and is used for enabling the clamping device to rotate, clamp and rotate and loosen. The invention can solve the problems of complicated paster flow and low paster efficiency.

title_en: Tape control system and tape control device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a tape control system and a tape control device, the tape control system implements: before rewinding, storing the magnetic tape in a state of being wound on a reel; and a storage after rewinding, wherein the tape is stored in a state of being rewound on a reel different from the reel or on the same reel after the storage before rewinding, so that the end which is the tape outside end in the storage before rewinding is the tape inside end, and the end which is the tape inside end in the storage before rewinding is the tape outside end, and the tape control device comprises: a rewinding control unit that transmits rewinding implementation information; and a driving unit for receiving the rewinding information and starting the travel of the stored magnetic tape in a state of being wound on the reel, thereby rewinding the magnetic tape.

title_en: Playback method, recording method and related equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a playback method, a recording method and related equipment, which are applied to the field of automation and provide a basis for adding time information into semantics for realizing automation as server scheduling and distributing a plurality of semantics. After the server acquires the plurality of semantics, the server can distribute the plurality of semantics to the corresponding playback devices according to the time information of each semantic in the plurality of semantics and the time sequence, so that each playback device can orderly execute the semantics from the server, and further orderly play back is realized. Because the server can replace manual implementation to issue the semantics in sequence, disorder of the sequence of executing the semantics by each playback device in the system can be avoided, and further, the automation flow of the system comprising a plurality of devices can be ensured to be realized.

title_en: Circuit board and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The utility model provides a circuit board, includes first substrate layer, inboard circuit layer, circuit substrate and a plurality of first conductor, inboard circuit layer set up in one side of first substrate layer, the substrate layer run through and be provided with first trompil, part inboard circuit layer in the bottom of first trompil exposes, first conductor is located in the first trompil, first conductor electric connection inboard circuit layer, every first conductor has the connection terminal surface of keeping away from inboard circuit layer, a plurality of the connection terminal surface expose in first substrate layer, every two the difference in height of connection terminal surface is no more than 3 microns, circuit substrate set up in on the connection terminal surface. The circuit board provided by the application can reduce the risk of empty soldering and improve the stability of the electrical connection between the first conductive body and the circuit substrate. In addition, the application also provides a manufacturing method of the circuit board.

title_en: Cooling system of energy storage device and energy storage device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooling system of an energy storage device and the energy storage device, wherein the cooling system comprises a water side loop and a refrigerant loop, the water side loop comprises a first water flow path, and the refrigerant loop comprises: a compressor; the condenser is connected with the compressor; the first heat exchanger comprises a first refrigerant flow path and a second water flow path, the first refrigerant flow path is connected with the compressor, the first refrigerant flow path is connected with the throttling element, and the throttling element is connected with the condenser through the second refrigerant flow path; the pressure regulating valve is connected in series on the second refrigerant flow path; and a bypass flow path, one end of which is connected between the condenser and the exhaust port of the compressor, and the other end of which is connected between the pressure regulating valve and the throttling element, and the bypass flow path is connected in series with a first control valve. Therefore, by arranging the refrigerant loop, the cooling system can be ensured to run smoothly under the condition of low-temperature refrigeration, the structure of the cooling system can be simplified, and the safety of the cooling system can be improved.

title_en: Privacy protection method under camera
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a privacy protection method under a camera. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring spectrum band information of ground objects in a preset area; determining a target ground object with the wavelength outside a target spectrum range in the preset area according to the spectrum band information; the target spectrum range is a range which can be imaged by the target camera; and protecting a protection target by using the target ground object under the target camera. According to the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the object which can not be captured by the camera is searched for to protect the object based on the difference of the reflection frequency spectrums of different objects from the optical perspective, so that the privacy invasion behavior of the camera is fundamentally solved, the complex equipment installation process is avoided, the applicability of the method is enhanced, and the protection effect is also improved.

title_en: Semiconductor condensation preventing device of rack-mounted liquid cooling server and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a semiconductor condensation preventing device of a rack-mounted liquid cooling server and a control method thereof, wherein a functional module, a power module and the semiconductor condensation preventing device are arranged in a server case of the rack-mounted liquid cooling server; the server case is of a cuboid structure, a liquid cooling frame is arranged in the server case, a bottom plate is arranged at the bottom of the server case, and a front panel is arranged on the side face of the server case; the semiconductor condensation preventing device is used for monitoring the condensation condition of the wet air in the server case and judging whether condensation risks exist or not; when the preset condition occurs, the semiconductor condensation preventing device performs dehumidification work and sends alarm information, and an operator is requested to take necessary dehumidification measures or turn off a power switch of the liquid cooling server. The method and the device can prevent the wet air from condensing into liquid drops on the side wall of the server case and the functional module and the like to endanger the electrical safety of the liquid cooling server; the environment adaptability is strong, the configuration is convenient, and the environment adaptability requirement of the rack-mounted liquid cooling server can be met.

title_en: Soldering device, in particular reflow soldering device, comprising a drawer in the cooling zone
abstract_en: A soldering apparatus (10), in particular a reflow soldering apparatus, for continuously soldering printed circuit boards in a transport direction (18) is disclosed, comprising a process channel (16) comprising a preheating zone (20), a soldering zone (22) and a cooling zone (24), comprising a base body (60) and a cover (25) which can be displaced between a closed position and an open position, wherein a nozzle plate (118), a fan unit (100) with a fan motor (102), air ducts (114, 122) for guiding process gases, a filter element (142) and/or a cooling element are provided in the base body, characterized in that a drawer is provided in the base body, which drawer extends in a pull-out direction extending transversely to the transport direction, having a bottom, a front wall and a rear side, wherein an air duct for guiding process gases, at least one exchangeable filter element in the filter zone and at least one cooling device are provided in the drawer.

title_en: Display panel debugging method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a debugging method and a debugging device of a display panel, wherein the debugging method comprises the following steps: acquiring actual display brightness of the display panel corresponding to a plurality of preset gray scales under preset display brightness levels; determining an actual normalization value corresponding to the actual display brightness according to the maximum display brightness under the preset display brightness level and the actual display brightness; determining a normalized difference value between the actual normalized value and the standard normalized value under the preset gray level; the standard normalization value is determined according to the target display brightness under the preset gray scale; and adjusting driving data corresponding to at least part of the preset gray scales according to the normalized difference value under the preset gray scales, so that the normalized difference value under each adjusted preset gray scale is in a set range. The invention can improve the debugging efficiency of the display panel and also can improve the display effect of the display panel after debugging.

title_en: Tripod head device
abstract_en: The present disclosure proposes a pan-tilt device. The cradle head device is used for bearing an external shooting device and comprises a depth camera, a control unit and an actuating piece. The depth camera is arranged to acquire spatial coordinates of a subject. The control unit is used for determining a direction adjustment value of the cradle head device according to the space coordinates. The actuating piece is used for receiving the direction adjustment value transmitted by the control unit and adjusting the space orientation of the cradle head device according to the direction adjustment value so that the external shooting device can track the shot object. The control unit is further configured to obtain initial triaxial data of the pan-tilt device and triaxial data set by the pan-tilt device, so as to determine an angle difference between the initial triaxial data and the triaxial data set by the pan-tilt device, and the actuating element is further configured to receive the angle difference transmitted by the control unit.

title_en: Control method and device of liquid cooling cabinet, controller and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method and device of a liquid cooling cabinet, a controller and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of communication equipment. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining the operation information of the server, and accordingly predicting the current temperature information of the server according to the operation information of the server. And then generating an adjustment strategy according to the current temperature information. And finally, according to the regulation strategy, sending control signals to the first compressor and the second compressor so as to control the first compressor and the second compressor. Therefore, the working states of the first compressor and the second compressor are accurately controlled according to the running state of the server, so that the liquid cooling power passing through the first compressor and the second compressor can be regulated, the energy consumption can be reduced when the running rate of the server is low, and the cabinet performance is optimized.

title_en: Rubber frame, rubber frame forming die and display device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rubber frame which is arranged on the periphery of a display module in a surrounding mode, wherein the display module comprises a binding side and a non-binding side, the rubber frame comprises a first part and a second part which are arranged in a surrounding mode to form an annular structure, the first part is directly formed on the outer side of the display module by adopting an injection molding process, and the first part is arranged towards the binding side of the display module. The invention also relates to a rubber frame forming die and a display device.

title_en: Light source device and endoscope system
abstract_en: While avoiding the generation of distortion and artifacts caused by the rolling shutter, a sufficient amount of light is ensured, and uneven brightness and lateral stripes are not noticeable even if the change of the pulse light emitting organ involves the rolling shutter period. Accordingly, the present disclosure proposes a light source device that generates illumination light for illuminating an object, the light source device including: a plurality of semiconductor light emitting elements for emitting light having different wavelength bands; and a control section for controlling the light emission profiles of the plurality of semiconductor light emitting elements and driving the plurality of semiconductor light emitting elements; the light emission profile includes a strong light emission period in which light is emitted at a predetermined light intensity and a weak light emission period in which light is emitted at a light intensity lower than the predetermined light intensity, and the control unit executes a reduction control process for replacing the light emission amount in the weak light emission period with the light emission amount in the strong light emission period while maintaining the total amount of the light emission amount in the strong light emission period and the light emission amount in the weak light emission period to be constant (see fig. 3).

title_en: Image processing method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an image processing method and device, which are used for obtaining a clearer image. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring motion information, wherein the motion information comprises information of a motion track of a target object when the target object moves within a detection range of a motion sensor; generating an event image according to the motion information, wherein the event image comprises an image representing a motion track of the target object when the target object moves within the detection range; obtaining a first reconstructed image according to at least one event included in the event image, wherein the color types of a first pixel point and at least one second pixel point are different, the first pixel point is a pixel point corresponding to any one event in the at least one first reconstructed image, and the at least one second pixel point is included in a plurality of pixel points adjacent to the first pixel point in the first reconstructed image.

title_en: Method, system, and non-transitory computer readable medium for rendering audio content
abstract_en: A system for presenting audio content to a user. The system includes one or more microphones (210) coupled to a frame (110) of a head-mounted viewer (100). The one or more microphones (210) pick up sound from a localized area. The system also includes an audio controller (150) integrated into the head-mounted viewer (100) and communicatively coupled to an in-ear device (185) worn by the user. An audio controller (150) identifies one or more sound sources in the local area based on the acquired sounds. The audio controller (150) also determines a target sound source of the one or more sound sources and determines one or more filters to apply to a sound signal associated with the target sound source of the collected sound. The audio controller (150) also generates an enhanced sound signal by applying the one or more filters to the sound signal and provides the enhanced sound signal to the in-ear device (185) for presentation to a user.

title_en: Circuit board and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps of laminating a GCPW structure and a wave-absorbing composite structure to form the circuit board, wherein the GCPW structure comprises a first single panel and a double-sided board, the first single panel comprises a second surface and two side surfaces, the double-sided board comprises two groups of first wave-absorbing units and signal wires, the double-sided board is coated on the second surface and the two side surfaces of the first single panel, the two groups of first wave-absorbing units are respectively positioned on the two side surfaces of the first single panel, the signal wires are positioned on the second surface, and the wave-absorbing composite structure is positioned on one side of the signal wires far away from the second surface. The manufacturing method of the circuit board provided by the invention has the advantages that the metamaterial structure is arranged in the three directions of the signal line, so that the electromagnetic wave absorption range is effectively increased, the signal transmission gain value is further reduced, the structural design flexibility is strong, the process is simple, the requirements on equipment are low, the implementation is easy, and the manufacturing cost is low.

title_en: SMD welding pad and circuit board thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a welding disc for SMD welding and a circuit board thereof, and belongs to the technical field of welding discs. The invention comprises at least two bonding pads connected to the same electronic component, wherein each bonding pad comprises a copper foil bonding pad and a windowing lead wire, each windowing lead wire comprises a second lead wire and at least two first lead wires, one end parts of all the first lead wires are connected to the same end of the second lead wire, the other end parts of all the first lead wires are connected with the copper foil bonding pad, the sum of the widths of all the first lead wires is smaller than that of the second lead wires, the copper foil bonding pad and the windowing lead wires are integrated, the first lead wires are exposed when the bonding pads are windowed, and the widths of at least two external connection wires in external connection wires connected to different pins of the same electronic component are different. According to the invention, the windowing lead is arranged at the edge of the copper foil of the SMD bonding pad, so that the actual windowing of the external bonding pad of an electronic component is the same, and the Manhattan phenomenon of soldering is reduced.

title_en: Shooting method, intelligent terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a shooting method, an intelligent terminal and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: responding to the current shooting scene as a motion scene, and entering a target shooting mode; responding to a shooting instruction, and determining or generating a corresponding target frame number; acquiring a single-frame picture of a target frame number through a target shooting mode; and carrying out preset processing on the single-frame picture of the target frame number to obtain a shot picture. According to the technical scheme, when the moving scene is shot, the proper number of pictures are selected for synthesis, and the definition of moving objects in the shot pictures can be effectively improved.

title_en: Method for manufacturing circuit board
abstract_en: The method comprises providing a copper-clad plate comprising a substrate layer and a metal layer arranged on the surface of the substrate layer; arranging a screen on the surface of the metal layer, wherein the screen comprises a plurality of connecting parts and openings positioned between two adjacent connecting parts, and the metal layer is exposed out of the openings; forming a protective layer in the opening; removing the screen plate to expose the metal layer corresponding to the connecting part from the gap of the protective layer; removing part of the metal layer exposed from the gap of the protective layer to form a circuit opening and a circuit, wherein the substrate layer is exposed from the circuit opening; and removing the protective layer to obtain the circuit board. The manufacturing method provided by the invention adopts the screen printing and etching modes to form the circuit, simplifies and shortens the circuit forming process, reduces the cost, improves the efficiency, reduces the management items in the forming process, and increases the stability of the control of the forming process.

title_en: Control method for realizing control of Bluetooth headset and intercom network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of Bluetooth communication, and discloses a control method for realizing control of a Bluetooth headset and an intercom network, which comprises that a sensor and a Bluetooth radio frequency module are arranged in the Bluetooth headset; the method comprises the steps that a sensor detects acceleration values of an x axis, a y axis and a z axis in real time, when the acceleration values of one or more axes of the x axis, the y axis and the z axis exceed a threshold value, the process of changing the acceleration values is identified as a specific operation action, an operation function corresponding to a Bluetooth headset is started, when the threshold value is a first threshold value, the Bluetooth headset starts a Bluetooth pairing function, when the threshold value is a second threshold value, the Bluetooth headset starts a Bluetooth team function, and when the threshold value is a third threshold value, the Bluetooth headset switches chat groups. The invention realizes the pairing and intercom functions of the Bluetooth headset to be controlled rapidly and accurately, and improves the user experience effect.

title_en: Intelligent inspection equipment for wind power substation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of inspection equipment, and in particular discloses intelligent inspection equipment for a wind power substation, which comprises the following components: and (3) integrating a base: a control module is arranged in the integration, one side of the integration base is provided with a camera shooting assembly, and the camera shooting assembly is used for inspecting the power equipment; and a driving assembly: the driving component is fixedly connected with the integrated base through a fixing frame; and (3) a track: the integrated base of drive assembly cooperation can remove on the track to the cooperation subassembly of making a video recording carries out continuous fixed point to the target and observes, and the array is provided with the subassembly that opens ice on the track, opens the subassembly that opens ice and is used for cooperating the drive assembly with the track surface department of icing, drives integrated base and removes on the track through the control module control drive assembly in the integrated base, and integrated base is at the in-process of removing, and the subassembly that opens ice on the track cooperation track can be broken with the ice layer on track surface, thereby avoids equipment to skid or derail.

title_en: Display device and method of compensating for change in pixel performance
abstract_en: The invention relates to a display device and a method of compensating for a change in pixel performance. The method comprises the following steps: dividing pixels into groups, the groups including a previous group (L-1), a current group (L), and a next group (L+1); determining a first convergence value A for each pixel in the current group (L)  converged  [L]And a second convergence value B  converged  [L]The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the For each pixel in the current group (L), a first moving average A is determined as follows  mean  [L]And a second moving average B  mean  [L]： Wherein A is  mean  [L‑1]Is the first moving average of pixels in the corresponding column in the previous group (L-1), B  mean  [L‑1]Is a second moving average of pixels in a corresponding column in the previous group (L-1), and K is a moving average window; and for the next group (L+1), a first initial value A of each pixel  0  [L+1]And a second initial value B  0  [L+1]Set as A  mean  [L]And B  mean  [L]。

title_en: Coal pile unmanned automatic operation system and method based on multi-view stereoscopic vision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-view stereoscopic unmanned automatic operation system and method for a coal pile, which relate to the technical field of automatic operation of the coal pile, and mainly comprise the following steps: after receiving a material taking request sent by an automatic operation device, a remote control center acquires the position information and the working condition information of the automatic operation device in the coal yard area at the current stage, and determines a point cloud data updating change area according to the position information and the working condition information of a material taking machine in the coal yard area at the current stage; the data processing device processes the image data of the point cloud data updating and changing area acquired by the multi-view image acquisition device to generate a coal pile three-dimensional model corresponding to the point cloud data updating and changing area; and the remote control center updates the three-dimensional model of the coal pile corresponding to the change area according to the point cloud data, and determines the ROI rectangular area point cloud corresponding to the automatic operation device so as to control the automatic operation device to take materials. The invention can realize unmanned automatic operation of the coal pile in real time with high efficiency and high precision.

title_en: Nondestructive installation vehicle-mounted subwoofer system based on FM audio communication
abstract_en: The invention provides a nondestructive installation vehicle-mounted subwoofer system based on FM audio communication, which comprises a control unit, a subwoofer unit, a middle-mounted sound box and a high-pitched sound box, wherein the subwoofer unit is connected with a 12V standard interface of an automobile through a wire harness to acquire a power supply, the subwoofer unit is connected with the control unit through a wireless signal to realize volume and pause play control, an FM module in the subwoofer unit is connected with an automobile FM radio to realize audio synchronous sounding, so as to realize enhancement of heavy bass sound effects in the sound effect of the whole automobile, and the subwoofer unit is connected with the middle-mounted sound box and the high-pitched sound box through the wire harness to realize medium-high frequency supplementary optimization of the sound effect of the whole automobile. The bass loudspeaker unit provided by the invention realizes the enhancement of the bass effect of the whole car, effectively improves the heavy bass part which cannot be realized by the loudspeaker of the car, and can compensate the middle and high tones of the whole car if being connected with the middle-set loudspeaker box and the high-tone loudspeaker box, thereby meeting the requirements of different users and improving the restoration degree of music.

title_en: Display screen area testing method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the field of terminal display, in particular to a display screen area test method, a device, a storage medium and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a virtual test area based on the resolution of a display screen, generating a first test image according to a maximum width value and a test value, generating a second test image according to a maximum height value and a test value, traversing the first test image along a vertical axis to obtain a first display image, traversing the second test image along a horizontal axis to obtain second display images, matching the first test image with each first display image to obtain first safety display pixels, matching the second test image with each second display image to obtain second safety display pixels, and obtaining the safety display area of the display screen by taking the union of the first safety display pixels and the second safety display pixels. The display screen area testing method provided by the disclosure can test the safe display area of the display screen so as to improve the display integrity of information.

title_en: Image encoding and decoding method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an image coding and decoding method, an image coding and decoding device and a storage medium, and relates to the field of video coding and decoding, wherein the coding method comprises the following steps: acquiring a coding unit; the coding unit is an image block in the image to be processed; the coding unit comprises coding blocks of a plurality of channels; the plurality of channels includes a first channel; the first channel is any one of a plurality of channels; encoding the encoding block of the first channel according to a first encoding mode; the first coding mode is a mode for coding sample values in a coding block of the first channel according to a first fixed length code; the code length of the first fixed length code is smaller than or equal to the image bit width of the image to be processed; the image bit width is used to characterize the number of bits required to store each sample in the image to be processed.
