The method is suitable for the image encoding and decoding process and is used for solving the problem of overlarge setting of the sub-stream buffer.

title_en: Portable small-sized charge-discharge instrument
abstract_en: The invention relates to a small portable charge-discharge instrument in the field of charge-discharge equipment, which comprises a protection case, a battery assembly, a charge-discharge assembly and a temperature control assembly, wherein an external power supply can enter the battery assembly through an input socket for power storage, and can be output to the outside through a plurality of output plugs during output, and electric power is allocated by an electric control main board during output, and a control panel can control the temperature control assembly and the power output; when the dust deposit at the heat dissipation opening needs to be cleaned, the temperature control shell can be pulled out along the limiting guide rail, and the cooling cavity, the heating cavity and the electric control fan can be directly cleaned, so that the maintenance rapidness is improved.

title_en: Surface-mounted photoelectric inclined induction switch and production process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a patch type photoelectric inclined induction switch and a production process thereof, wherein the patch type photoelectric inclined induction switch comprises an upper plate, a middle plate, balls, a base plate, a lower plate, a transmitting transistor component and a receiving transistor component, wherein the balls block a channel between the transmitting transistor component and the receiving transistor component when the switch is horizontally placed, and light signals emitted by the transmitting transistor component are transmitted by the balls; the receiving transistor can not receive the light signal, and when the switch is inclined, the ball can not block the channel between the transmitting transistor component and the receiving transistor component any more, and the transmitting transistor component emits the light signal; the receiving transistor receives the signal, the inclined switch sends out the signal, so as to realize the triggering function, the structural design of the transmitting transistor component and the receiving transistor component is reasonable, the lens effectively protects the wafer, in addition, the upper plate, the middle plate, the backing plate and the lower plate are pressed together through the composite laminated plate technology, and the patch type LED lamp is mounted on the circuit board for use very conveniently.

title_en: Data compression method and device for selecting one of multiple motion vector candidate sets in coding mode
abstract_en: The present invention provides a data compression method and apparatus using a plurality of motion vector candidate sets, which are associated with each other in a coding mode, and one of the plurality of candidate sets is selected as a current candidate set of a current data unit according to the coding mode of the current data unit when the current data unit is coded. Thus, there is no need to consume any number of bits to indicate which candidate set is selected, thereby improving coding efficiency.

title_en: Virtual bass method, device and loudspeaker system based on auditory perception
abstract_en: The application relates to a virtual bass method, a device and a loudspeaker system based on auditory perception, wherein the method comprises the following steps: separating the audio input signal into a high-frequency signal and a low-frequency signal according to a preset loudspeaker cut-off frequency; generating odd harmonics and even harmonics containing the fundamental frequency signal according to the low frequency signal; the amplitude values of the odd harmonics and the even harmonics are adjusted and added to obtain a plurality of harmonic components containing fundamental frequency signals; performing gain processing on the low-frequency signal after delay processing, subtracting the signal after gain processing from a multi-harmonic component containing a fundamental frequency signal, and performing low-pass filtering on the obtained multi-harmonic signal to obtain a low-frequency harmonic signal; and (3) carrying out delay processing on the high-frequency signal and then superposing the high-frequency signal and the low-frequency harmonic signal to obtain an audio output signal. The method reduces the calculated amount and complexity by adjusting the amplitude ratio between the harmonic waves, is easy to realize, and can restore original fundamental frequency signals on tone and loudness well.

title_en: Transduction driver
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transduction driver, which comprises a transduction driving part, wherein the transduction driving part comprises a phase plug assembly, a sound film assembly, a positioning center, a washer, neodymium magnet and U iron, wherein the phase plug assembly, the sound film assembly, the positioning center, the washer, the neodymium magnet and the U iron are sequentially arranged from bottom to top, the neodymium magnet is arranged in the middle of the U iron, the washer is arranged on the neodymium magnet, the sound film assembly comprises a silica gel layer, a silicone grease layer and a blocking layer which are stacked, the sound film assembly comprises a fixing part, a bending part and a connecting part, the bending part is provided with a plurality of blocking layers, the blocking layers are arranged on the surface of the silica gel layer and/or the silicone grease layer, the sound film assembly formed by stacking the silica gel layer and the silicone grease layer has stable structure and good heat dissipation, and the blocking layer is arranged on the surface of the silica gel layer and/or the silicone grease layer, so that the sound film assembly has good blocking performance and the safety performance is improved.

title_en: Alignment bonding device for manufacturing multilayer flexible circuit board
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alignment bonding device for manufacturing a multilayer flexible circuit board, which comprises a clamping alignment module, an adaptive clamping module, a gluing bonding module and a device leveling module, wherein the clamping alignment module is used for clamping two wide sides of a Ji Duoceng flexible circuit board, the adaptive clamping module comprises a driving mechanism, a connecting mechanism and a clamping mechanism, the driving mechanism is used for providing transmission power for the adaptive clamping module, the connecting mechanism is matched with the driving mechanism to adapt to flexible circuit boards with different sizes, the clamping mechanism clamps the flexible circuit boards and simultaneously can stack the multilayer flexible circuit boards, the module is used for clamping two long sides of the Ji Duoceng flexible circuit board and performing adaptive fixing and clamping, the gluing bonding module is used for finishing gluing and hot melting bonding operations on the flexible circuit board, and the device leveling module is used for balancing skew generated in the gluing process due to uneven stress.

title_en: Data center test equipment, control method thereof and data center test system
abstract_en: The application discloses data center test equipment, a control method thereof and a data center test system. The data center test equipment comprises a liquid cooling module and a heating module. The liquid cooling module comprises a heat exchanger, a liquid inlet pipeline and a liquid outlet pipeline, wherein a liquid cooling channel and a waterway channel are arranged on the heat exchanger, a liquid inlet port of the liquid cooling channel is communicated with the liquid inlet pipeline, and a liquid outlet port of the liquid cooling channel is communicated with the liquid outlet pipeline; the heating module comprises a thermal resistance box, a circulating water pipe is arranged in the thermal resistance box, and the circulating water pipe is communicated with the waterway channel to convey water to the heat exchanger so as to exchange heat with cooling liquid in the liquid cooling channel. The data center test equipment and the control method thereof and the data center test system at least solve the problem that the dummy load in the prior art can not meet the liquid cooling test requirement only by means of air cooling heat dissipation.

title_en: Micron-sized sound field generating device based on artificial structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a micron-sized sound field generating device based on an artificial structure and a preparation method thereof, wherein the micron-sized sound field generating device based on the artificial structure comprises a surface acoustic wave chip and at least one artificial structure coupled with the surface acoustic wave chip, the surface acoustic wave chip is used for generating a surface acoustic wave sound field, the artificial structure is used for regulating and controlling the surface acoustic wave sound field generated by the surface acoustic wave chip, so that the surface acoustic wave sound field range is smaller than the sound wave wavelength, and a micron-sized sound field is formed.

title_en: Video decoding using neural networks
abstract_en: A data stream includes an Indicator (IND) and data (Fnn) representing video or audio content. A method for decoding the data stream comprising the steps of-decoding (E60) the Indicator (IND) to determine whether an artificial neural network to be used for decoding the representative data (Fnn) is encoded into the data stream or forms part of a predetermined set of artificial neural networks, -decoding (E70) the representative data (Fnn) by means of the artificial neural network. If it is determined by decoding the Indicator (IND) that the artificial neural network forms part of the aforementioned predetermined set, the method comprises decoding (E62) the identifier (Inn) of the neural network. An associated decoding device and an associated data stream are also described.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting system with recognition function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent fire protection and discloses an intelligent fire protection system with an identification function, which comprises a base device, wherein a cover plate device is arranged on one side of the outer surface of the base device, a storage device is arranged inside the base device, the cover plate device comprises a cover plate, a device box is arranged on one side of the outer surface of the cover plate, a device pipe is arranged inside the device box, a camera is arranged inside the device pipe, an auxiliary pipe is arranged inside the device box, a plug rod is arranged inside the auxiliary pipe, a movable rod is arranged on one side of the outer surface of the plug rod, and a movable plate is arranged at one end of the movable rod. According to the invention, when the threaded rod rotates, the threaded plate drives the movable plate to move up and down, so that the movable rod drives the inserting rod to move left and right, when the inserting rod is inserted into the camera, the position of the camera is fixed, and when the inserting rod is disconnected from the camera, the camera can be taken down, and the effect of replacing the camera is realized.

title_en: Online conference method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment provides an online conference method, an online conference device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, and relates to the field of network conferences. The method comprises the steps that speaking voice of a target participant in a current conference is converted into a first speaking text, and if the first speaking text comprises a first word which is recognized by mistake, the first word in the first speaking text is replaced by a correct second word, so that a second speaking text is obtained; the corresponding relation between the first vocabulary and the second vocabulary is obtained by responding to the correction operation of the editorial staff on the historical speaking text of the target participants; and finally, recording the second speaking text and the corresponding relation between the second speaking text and the target speaking person. Therefore, the wrongly recognized vocabulary in the conference speaking text can be corrected in time, so that a conference summary with better legibility can be obtained.

title_en: Leveling device for PCB production
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of PCB production, in particular to a leveling device for PCB production, which comprises a first conveying belt and a second conveying belt, wherein a turnover mechanism for turning over a PCB is arranged between the first conveying belt and the second conveying belt, and leveling mechanisms for leveling the PCB are arranged on the first conveying belt and the second conveying belt; the turnover mechanism comprises two baffles and a supporting frame, a plurality of poking frames are fixedly connected between the baffles along the circumferential direction, one sides, away from each other, of the baffles are fixedly connected with connecting columns, fixing plates are fixedly connected onto the connecting columns, rotating shafts are fixedly connected onto the fixing plates, and the rotating shafts are rotationally connected with the supporting frame. Through the setting of first conveyer belt and second conveyer belt, can be at the in-process to the PCB board is carried, through leveling mechanism and tilting mechanism's cooperation use, improve PCB board leveling's efficiency and quality to save production time, be convenient for batch production.

title_en: Aluminum plate lamination equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of PCB (printed circuit board) processing, in particular to aluminum plate laminating equipment, which comprises a punching machine and a rotary disc arranged on a workbench of the punching machine, wherein a first station positioned at the outer side of the workbench of the punching machine and a second station positioned at the top of the workbench of the punching machine are arranged on the rotary disc, positioning clamps are arranged on the first station and the second station, the positioning clamps are provided with through holes which are opened along the vertical direction, limiting pieces which are abutted against the bottom edges of the material plates are arranged on the side surfaces of the through holes, and when the working end of the punching machine moves downwards, the limiting pieces at the second station are separated from the bottom edges of the material plates so that the material plates are punched after falling on the workbench of the punching machine.

title_en: Single-phase cooling liquid for immersed cooling thermal management, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of immersed liquid cooling, and particularly relates to single-phase cooling liquid for immersed cooling thermal management, a preparation method and a corresponding single-phase immersed cooling system. Single-phase cooling liquid with kinematic viscosity of less than 10 mm at 100 DEG C  2  The main component of the single-phase cooling liquid is one or more mixed liquid polyolefin; the low-viscosity liquid polyolefin is metallocene polyolefin or conventional polyolefin, and is prepared from a metallocene or non-metallocene-based catalyst system, wherein the kinematic viscosity of the low-viscosity liquid polyolefin is less than 10 mm at 100 DEG C  2  And/s. By using such liquid polyolefin as the main component of the immersed single-phase coolant, it is possible toObtaining the immersed single-phase cooling liquid with high heat conductivity and high specific heat capacity.

title_en: Sound apparatus and vehicle apparatus
abstract_en: A sound apparatus and a vehicle apparatus including the same are disclosed. The sound device includes: a housing at a rear surface of the vibration member; a connection member between the vibration member and the housing; and a vibration device that vibrates the vibration member.

title_en: Appearance part, household appliance and mold
abstract_en: The invention provides an appearance part, a household appliance and a mold, wherein the appearance part comprises an appearance part body, the appearance part body is provided with an appearance surface and a non-appearance surface, the appearance part is a spraying-free injection molding part, and the appearance part further comprises: the flow guiding structure is arranged on the non-appearance surface and protrudes out of the non-appearance surface; and/or, the choke structure is arranged on the non-appearance surface, and the choke structure is a groove or a through hole. The appearance part solves the problem that the spraying-free injection molding part in the prior art is easy to generate appearance defects.

title_en: Amplitude shift keying low frequency signal-transmitting antenna based on magnetic phase-change material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a magnetic phase change material-based amplitude shift keying low-frequency transmitting antenna, which comprises an electromagnetic shielding box, wherein a magnetic phase change cover plate is arranged on the top surface of the electromagnetic shielding box, a control mechanism is arranged on one side of the electromagnetic shielding box, and a rotary antenna is connected in the electromagnetic shielding box through a driving mechanism in a transmission way. The invention realizes the independent and high-speed modulation of the amplitude of the low-frequency electromagnetic wave, thereby realizing the amplitude shift keying low-frequency transmitting antenna with excellent signal readability and high modulation rate.

title_en: Pixel circuit, image sensor and method for reducing pixel fixed image noise
abstract_en: The invention provides a pixel circuit, an image sensor and a method for reducing pixel fixed image noise, comprising the following steps: performing global exposure on each pixel; resetting a capacitance storing a signal representing an image; sampling signals for characterizing the image based on the corresponding capacitances, respectively; reading out a signal representing the image; in the sampling phase, the control signal of the transistor for sampling the signal representing the image is a step level, having at least two steps, the voltage of each step decreasing in turn. According to the invention, the control signal of the sampling transistor is set to be a step level, so that the difference value between the gate terminal voltage and the threshold voltage when the transistor is turned off is reduced, the influence of channel charge injection effect on each pixel is further reduced, and the fixed image noise is reduced; in the case where the threshold voltage is unknown, a plurality of steps are provided to capture the position of the threshold voltage so that the difference between the gate terminal voltage and the threshold voltage decreases when the transistor is turned off.

title_en: Adaptive frequency division surround sound upmixing method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of audio processing, and discloses a self-adaptive frequency division surround sound upmixing method, device and equipment and a storage medium. The invention constructs a low-pass filter and a high-pass filter according to the initial frequency division point; filtering the surround sound signal through the low-pass filter and the high-pass filter to obtain a low-frequency signal component and a high-frequency signal component; the low-frequency signal component is transmitted to a surround sound loudspeaker for playing, the high-frequency signal component is transmitted to a sky loudspeaker for playing, and energy dividing points are adaptively given out for filtering and channel distribution through energy analysis of each frame signal of different audios.

title_en: Outdoor mobile power supply
abstract_en: The invention provides an outdoor mobile power supply, which belongs to the technical field of outdoor electric quantity storage and comprises a shell and an end cover, wherein the shell is hinged and fixed with the end cover, and an inversion module and a battery module are arranged in the shell; the photovoltaic charging module is formed by connecting a plurality of photovoltaic plates in series through connecting pieces and is folded and stored, and the photovoltaic charging module is connected with the inversion module to be used for charging the battery module outdoors; the sound system is distributed and arranged on the photovoltaic charging module and is connected with the inversion module; the connecting piece is used for fixing the adjacent photovoltaic plates and fixing the terminals of the photovoltaic charging module and the adjacent photovoltaic plates; the foldable photovoltaic charging module is carried for supplementing electric quantity in outdoor use, and sound systems are distributed around the photovoltaic charging module, so that the sound systems can be separated when the photovoltaic panel is unfolded in the photovoltaic charging module, the range of the sound box is conveniently enlarged, and 3D sound effects are fully projected.

title_en: Pulsating heat pipe refrigerating device for cooling while-drilling electronic components in petroleum exploitation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pulsating heat pipe refrigerating device for cooling electronic components while drilling in petroleum exploitation. At present, high-pressure cooling liquid is adopted to cool a drilling tool in petroleum exploitation operation, so that the difficulty of construction and operation is high, and long-time efficient operation cannot be realized. The outer surface of the compression-resistant cylinder is covered with a heat insulation layer, and is divided into an upper heat exchange cavity and a lower cooling cavity by a partition wall, and the while-drilling electronic equipment is arranged in the cooling cavity. The refrigeration mechanism comprises a turbine, a compressor, a condenser pipe, an expansion mechanism, an evaporator and a heat exchange assembly. The turbine and the compressor are arranged outside the compression-resistant cylinder, the drilling fluid drives the turbine to rotate, and the turbine drives the compressor to work. The heat exchange assembly comprises a plurality of pulsating heat pipes which are arranged in parallel, the pulsating heat pipes are serpentine copper pipes with two closed ends, working medium n-octane is filled in the pulsating heat pipes, the pulsating heat pipes penetrate through the partition plates, and heat exchange is carried out between the pulsating heat pipes and the evaporator through the heat exchange metal plates. The invention does not need an external power supply, has higher energy utilization rate and good cooling effect on the electronic equipment in the pressure cylinder.

title_en: Display device and driving method of display device
abstract_en: The invention provides a display device and a driving method of the display device. The display device may include: a display panel including a first display region and a second display region in which pixels are arranged; a power supply section generating a first initialization voltage and a second initialization voltage, and supplying the first initialization voltage and the second initialization voltage to the pixel; a low frequency offset compensation section selectively applying an offset to the second initialization voltage when the second display region is driven at a low frequency; and a high frequency data compensation unit that compensates for the gradation of a part of the pixels arranged in the first display region when the offset is applied to the second initialization voltage.

title_en: Headset device
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a headset. The head-mounted device comprises a head-mounted device body and a first sound generating unit, wherein the first sound generating unit is detachably arranged on the head-mounted device body, a first sound outlet of the head-mounted device body is formed, the first sound outlet of the body is communicated with the external environment, and when the first sound generating unit is arranged on the head-mounted device body, the first sound generating unit is communicated with the first sound outlet of the body, and the first sound generating unit is configured to be in-ear.

title_en: Shooting method, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of image processing and discloses a shooting method, electronic equipment and a medium. Therefore, the electronic equipment can directly shoot the virtual image, and the intelligent shooting requirement can be met.

title_en: Whole machine dormancy method and equipment for bone conduction earphone
abstract_en: The invention provides a whole machine dormancy method and equipment for bone conduction headphones. The method comprises the following steps: when the bone conduction earphone starts the whole machine dormancy function, determining whether the bone conduction earphone receives a whole machine dormancy voice command; if the bone conduction earphone receives the whole machine dormancy voice command, dormancy of the bone conduction earphone is performed; determining whether the overall sleep voice command matches a preset voice command for a peripheral device that is used to sleep the bone conduction headset and is connected to the bone conduction headset; and if so, sending the complete machine dormancy voice command to the peripheral equipment to dormant the peripheral equipment. According to the invention, by determining that the bone conduction earphone receives the complete machine sleep voice command and is matched with the preset voice command of the peripheral equipment, the bone conduction earphone and the peripheral equipment can be parked when the user needs to rest briefly, so that the service life and the endurance of the bone conduction earphone are prolonged.

title_en: Multilayer circuit board hot pressing coincide device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of multilayer circuit board production, in particular to a multilayer circuit board hot-pressing superposition device which comprises a bottom plate, wherein two front-back symmetrical support connecting legs are fixedly connected to the left side of the upper surface of the bottom plate, support mounting frames are fixedly connected to the top ends of the two support connecting legs together, a fixed frame is fixedly connected to the inner side of the support mounting frames, two front-back symmetrical raw material placing frames positioned on the left side of the fixed frame are fixedly connected to the inner side of the support mounting frames, after raw materials are cut and stacked in the fixed frame, a plurality of stacked raw materials can be aligned rapidly, and the plurality of raw materials are concentrated at the left and the rear of the fixed frame, so that the left and the rear top angles of the plurality of raw materials are aligned with the left and the rear Fang Dingjiao in the fixed frame, the mutual alignment of the plurality of raw materials is more accurate, the yield of the hot-pressing of the raw materials is improved, and meanwhile the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Conference system with voiceprint registration function and voiceprint registration method
abstract_en: The invention provides a conference system with voiceprint registration function and voiceprint registration method, the conference system has: the text box is used for displaying the transfer words corresponding to the voices of the conference records, performing sliding operation on the transfer words, selecting the corresponding transfer words, popping up a voice evaluation registration popup when a preset operation is executed after the sliding operation, wherein the voice evaluation registration popup comprises an audio evaluation and voiceprint registration option and is provided with a plurality of voiceprint tag refinement items, and each voiceprint tag refinement item comprises a plurality of selectable items; when voice registration is carried out, selecting an audio evaluation option to evaluate the voice corresponding to the selected transcription text; after the voice print label is evaluated to be qualified, selecting corresponding selectable items from a plurality of voice print label refinement items to form a user portrait, and storing the user portrait and voice print identification features of corresponding voices into a voice print library; user name input is performed by selecting voiceprint registration options, so that voiceprint registration of the user is efficiently and accurately realized.

title_en: Image processing method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an image processing method, an image processing device and image processing equipment, wherein the method is applied to electronic equipment, an image pickup device is arranged in the electronic equipment, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring feedback information of a first image, wherein the first image is obtained by shooting the electronic equipment through the camera device, and the feedback information comprises voice evaluation information and/or image editing information; according to the feedback information, determining a first shooting parameter of the first image and a target image processing algorithm corresponding to the first shooting parameter; and updating the image processing algorithm corresponding to the first shooting parameter into the target image processing algorithm. The method can adjust the image processing algorithm according to the feedback information, so that the image processing flexibility is better.

title_en: Sampling point self-adaptive compensation mode decision method, device, medium and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of video coding, and particularly relates to a sampling point self-adaptive compensation mode decision method, a sampling point self-adaptive compensation mode decision device, a computer-readable storage medium and terminal equipment. In the above method, an optimal non-parameter fusion compensation mode may be selected from various non-parameter fusion compensation modes according to the division depth of the tree coding unit, and then, the optimal compensation mode may be selected from the optimal non-parameter fusion compensation mode and the parameter fusion compensation mode. By the method, the optimal non-parameter fusion compensation mode can be selected according to the division depth of the tree-shaped coding unit, so that the decision time in the non-parameter fusion compensation mode is saved, the efficiency of the sample point self-adaptive compensation mode decision method is improved, and the method has strong usability and practicability.

title_en: Transformer removes auxiliary device that patrols and examines
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a transformer mobile inspection auxiliary device, which comprises: the base is provided with a walking driving motor which is connected with a walking bottom wheel through a transmission mechanism, and the base moves under the driving of the walking bottom wheel; the base is also provided with a lifting frame, the bottom end of the lifting frame is fixed on the base, and the top end of the lifting frame is fixed at the bottom of the carrying platform; the lifting frame is connected to a lifting driving motor through a lifting driving mechanism; the object carrying platform is provided with monitoring equipment; the monitoring equipment is connected with a local controller, the local controller is connected with a wireless communication module, and the local controller is in data communication with the remote controller through the wireless communication module; the local controller is connected with the walking driving motor and the lifting driving motor, and controls the running of the walking driving motor and the lifting driving motor according to the received instruction information of the remote controller; the local controller transmits the data information acquired by the monitoring equipment to the remote controller through the wireless communication module.

title_en: Image encoding/decoding apparatus and apparatus for transmitting data of image
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an image encoding/decoding apparatus and an apparatus for transmitting data of an image. The picture decoding method performed by the decoding apparatus according to the present application includes the steps of: deriving neighboring chroma reference samples for a chroma block when an intra prediction mode of the chroma block is a cross-component linear model (CCLM) mode; deriving neighboring luminance reference samples of a luminance block corresponding to the chrominance block and luminance samples in the luminance block; deriving a downsampled neighboring luminance reference sample and a downsampled luminance sample by downsampling the neighboring luminance reference sample and the luminance sample, respectively; deriving linear model parameters based on the downsampled neighboring luminance reference samples and neighboring chrominance reference samples; generating prediction samples for the chroma block based on the linear model parameters and the downsampled luma samples of the luma block; and reconstructing the chroma block based on the prediction samples for the chroma block.

title_en: Method and device for adjusting frame interval
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of terminal shooting, and provides a method and a device for adjusting a frame interval, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the AE module obtains a first frame shot by a main camera and N second frames shot by N auxiliary cameras, wherein N is a positive integer; the AE module determines whether the frame interval of the first frame and the frame intervals of the N second frames are integer multiples of an ambient light brightness change period; when the frame interval between the first frame and a target frame in the N second frames is not an integral multiple of the ambient light brightness change period, the AE module determines whether the target frame is a synchronous frame; when the target frame is an unsynchronized frame, the AE module adjusts a frame interval of the target frame based on an anti-flicker algorithm. The method can avoid the severe frame rate change after the function for eliminating flicker is started.

title_en: Dy (Dy) 3+ Fluorescent powder material doped with temperature-responsive color change and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to Dy  3+  A fluorescent powder material doped with temperature responsive color change and a preparation method thereof belong to the technical field of temperature sensitive materials. It provides a chemical structural formula of SrGa  12‑x  Al  x  O  19  ：Dy  3+  Wherein 0 is<x is less than or equal to 7. In the concrete preparation, srCO  3  、Ga  2  O  3  、Al  2  O  3  And Dy  2  O  3  Mixing in absolute ethyl alcohol according to a certain proportion, ball milling uniformly, drying, and pressing part of uniformly mixed white powder into tablets to obtain a circular flaky reactant; sintering at high temperature in air atmosphere, and air cooling to room temperature to obtain Dy  3+  Doping temperatureA fluorescent powder material with a degree of responsive color change. The raw materials adopted by the invention are widely available, the cost is low, the preparation process is simple, only mixed grinding and sintering are needed, the operation environment is simple, the protection of reducing atmosphere is not needed, the proportioning accuracy and the repeatability are high, and the method is suitable for large-scale production. The prepared material has yellow fluorescence under irradiation of 254nm ultraviolet and the like at room temperature, becomes green after heating, becomes red when heated to more than 250 ℃, and has excellent energy storage property at low temperature.

title_en: Dot matrix display circuit structure, display control method and intelligent protective shell
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of protective cases, and provides a dot matrix display circuit structure, a display control method and an intelligent protective case, wherein the dot matrix display circuit structure comprises: a circuit board; the LED lamp comprises a circuit board, a plurality of luminous lamp beads, a control chip and a luminous chip, wherein the luminous lamp beads are arranged on the circuit board in a dot matrix mode, and are sequentially connected in series to form a serial passage; the main control chip is electrically connected with the serial passage and is used for sending a control signal to the serial passage; the control chip of each luminous lamp bead is used for acquiring a control signal matched with the control chip to control the luminous chip to emit light or release a control signal not matched with the luminous chip. The technical problems that in the prior art, a scanning control mode needs to adopt high-current driving to emit light, so that components work unstably, electromagnetic interference is caused, and a large amount of heat is generated are solved.

title_en: Information conversion system based on neural network algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to an information conversion system based on a neural network algorithm. The system comprises: the coding judging mechanism is used for judging the coding time length required by the video segment to be coded by adopting the coding type of the video segment to be coded configured to execute video coding based on the multiple copies of conversion data and the coding type identification of the video segment to be coded; the model extraction mechanism is connected with the code judgment mechanism and is used for providing the deep neural network model, and the deep neural network model is a deep neural network after the deep neural network model is learned for a plurality of times. According to the system, the intelligent prediction model which is designed in a targeted manner can be adopted to execute the prediction operation of the corresponding video coding time length based on the video coding standard and each parameter of the video data to be compressed on each video coding standard, so that different coding time lengths corresponding to different coding standards are predicted in advance, and valuable reference information is provided for selecting the corresponding coding standard according to specific application requirements.

title_en: Imaging resolution configurable multi-band TDI-CMOS image sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses an imaging resolution configurable multi-band TDI-CMOS image sensor which comprises a multi-band pixel array, a time sequence driving circuit, a digital binding readout circuit and a configuration circuit, wherein the multi-band pixel array converts optical signals into image electric signals and transmits the image electric signals to the digital binding readout circuit, the digital binding readout circuit receives the image electric signals, carries out digital quantization and horizontal digital binding operation on the image electric signals and outputs processed digital images, the time sequence driving circuit provides normal working time sequence for the multi-band pixel array, and the configuration circuit sets working modes of the time sequence driving circuit and the digital binding readout circuit and detects working states of the circuits. The invention meets the requirements of the system on resolution and signal to noise ratio, and reduces the resource occupation of off-chip data storage and data processing.

title_en: Composite substrate, preparation method thereof and circuit board
abstract_en: The invention relates to a composite substrate, a preparation method thereof and a circuit board, wherein the composite substrate comprises a basal layer and a first resistance layer arranged on at least one surface of the basal layer; the thickness of the first resistance layer satisfies the following relation: d=1.2/R+K, wherein d is the thickness of the first resistance layer, R is the sheet resistance, and the value range of K is-0.3-3. According to the invention, the resistance R of the resistance layer and the thickness d of the resistance layer are controlled to meet a certain linear relation, so that the composite substrate meeting the equation has good resistance stability, and the preparation of the composite substrate by the method disclosed by the invention has the advantages of simple process flow, simplified preparation process and improved production efficiency of the composite substrate.

title_en: Privacy protection security system for office area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a privacy protection security system for an office area, which belongs to the technical field of security systems and comprises a privacy protection device, wherein a security protection control board and a privacy protection control board are arranged in the privacy protection device, the privacy protection device is electrically connected with a computer terminal through a communication network port, the privacy protection device is electrically connected with a monitoring camera through the communication network port, the monitoring camera is typically connected with the computer terminal, the computer terminal is electrically connected with an alarm, and finally, the security protection of the office area can be realized under the condition of guaranteeing the privacy of staff, psychological pressure caused by monitoring of the staff is prevented, and the property safety of the staff is also guaranteed.

title_en: Stereoscopic image comfort degree prediction method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of stereoscopic image comfort level, and in order to solve the problem of evaluating stereoscopic image perception discomfort, the invention adopts a stereoscopic image comfort level prediction method based on deep learning to predict the stereoscopic image comfort level. According to the invention, through independently calculating the single eye pattern of the three channels of red, green and blue, the color information of the stereoscopic image is reserved, and the stereoscopic image is subjected to image clipping based on significance, so that a sample for model training is expanded, and the most focused image area of a viewer is reserved to the greatest extent. The CSP-Net model is creatively improved and optimized by adding the grouping weighted attention module, and the calculation efficiency is improved.

title_en: System and method for matching circuit boards according to event management and control identification data of chip mounter
abstract_en: A system and method for matching circuit board based on event management and control identification data of chip mounter is disclosed, wherein after receiving the identification data of circuit board, the production management and control device scans the storage area to store the received identification data, and when the chip mounter generates a production start event, the operation storage area is used to store the identification data, and when the chip mounter generates a production completion event, the operation storage area is used to take out the identification data to match with the circuit board of completed chip, so as to achieve the technical effect of improving the accuracy of the identification data of the circuit board of completed chip.

title_en: Video signal decoding and encoding method, and bit stream transmission method
abstract_en: The application relates to a video signal decoding and encoding method and a bit stream transmission method. The video signal processing method for performing division and encoding on an input image in block units includes determining whether to perform division on a current block, dividing the current block into a plurality of sub-blocks according to the determination result, generating block division information related to division of the current block, and performing encoding on the block division information, the current block, or the sub-blocks. The block segmentation to which the present application is applicable includes quadtree structure, binary tree structure and/or trigeminal tree structure, and also includes segmentation using n-ary tree structure.

title_en: Road bump detection and classification method
abstract_en: The application relates to a method for detecting and classifying road surface jolts, which comprises the steps of loading a vibration sensor on a vehicle, collecting triaxial acceleration recorded by the vibration sensor on the vehicle in real time, searching the position of the road surface for generating abnormal jolts by utilizing convolution and waveforms through the collected acceleration, simultaneously, automatically controlling a cradle head camera to rotate and a stretching lens to be far and near on the basis of setting a basic preset position by utilizing a machine vision and deep learning method, and realizing the collection of road surface information such as telescopic joints, deceleration strips, repairing, well covers, pits and the like on the road surface, and analyzing the intersection of the two to obtain the reason for generating the abnormal jolts. The road surface can be efficiently and conveniently detected, so that the problem that the safety and the comfort of the vehicle are easily reduced because no limiting measures are taken on the vehicle under the condition of bumpy road surface is found and analyzed. The system is operated without manual interference, and the analysis result can be directly uploaded to a background data end.

title_en: Access control management method based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an access control management method based on multi-source data, which relates to the technical field of access control management and comprises the following steps: s101, acquiring information of a camera in the access control system during operation, wherein the information comprises camera data acquisition information and camera image processing information, and processing the acquired camera data acquisition information and the camera image processing information. According to the invention, the running state of the camera in the access control management system is monitored, so that the access control management system intelligently senses the condition that the recognition accuracy of the camera is influenced, the condition that the recognition is wrong or misrefused is effectively prevented, the condition that a legal user is possibly mistakenly recognized as an illegal user and cannot enter a limited area is effectively prevented, the condition that the user is not full, work is interrupted or other inconvenience is possibly caused, and the practicability of the access control management system is improved.

title_en: Six-sided flexible connection circuit board pasting tool and six-sided flexible connection circuit board pasting method
abstract_en: A six-sided flexible connection circuit board pasting tool and a six-sided flexible connection circuit board pasting method relate to the technical field of MEMS assembly. The fixture comprises a fixture tool part for clamping an incoming circuit board, an incoming core is arranged in an inner cavity of the fixture tool part, fixed clamping parts for assisting in fixing the fixture tool part are arranged at the upper end and the lower end of the fixture tool part, and an opening and closing mechanism for facilitating workers to detach the fixed clamping parts is arranged at the outer end of the fixed clamping parts. The invention has the beneficial effects that: according to the tool and the pasting method, the circuit board is driven to be precisely pasted on the core body through the six overturning plates, meanwhile, the fixed clamping part can fix the pasted circuit board and the core body, the circuit board and the core body are prevented from being shifted in the assembling and carrying processes, the manual operation difficulty is effectively reduced, the manual glue curing operation is avoided under the high-temperature environment, meanwhile, the assembling precision and the assembling consistency of the circuit board and the core body are guaranteed, the manual production efficiency is improved, and the assembling quality of products is guaranteed.

title_en: Image quality adjustment method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses an image quality adjusting method, an image quality adjusting device, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the image quality adjusting method comprises the following steps: determining a target image mode according to a selection instruction of a user on an image mode menu, wherein a plurality of image modes are provided on the image mode menu, and the image modes comprise a custom mode; when the target image mode is a custom mode, providing a custom mode menu, wherein a plurality of image quality parameters are provided on the custom mode menu; determining a modified image quality parameter value according to an operation instruction of a user on the user-defined mode menu; and adjusting the image quality according to the modified image quality parameter value. The application enables the user to adjust the image quality according to the preference of the user, and improves the display competitiveness of the product.

title_en: Motor controller, electric drive assembly and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a motor controller, an electric drive assembly and a vehicle, wherein the motor controller comprises a controller shell, and a main board, a heat dissipation piece, a power module and a drive plate which are arranged in the controller shell, wherein the heat dissipation piece is connected with the power module and is positioned between the main board and the drive plate, the heat dissipation piece is provided with a heat dissipation water channel, the controller shell is provided with a first water inlet and a first water outlet which are communicated with the heat dissipation water channel, and the drive plate is respectively and electrically connected with the main board and the power module.

title_en: Active noise reduction method, device, electronic equipment and computer readable medium
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure disclose active noise reduction methods, apparatus, electronic devices, and computer readable media. One embodiment of the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an original noise signal and a target noise signal acquired by an error microphone; performing first filtering processing on the original noise signal based on the first filtering parameter to obtain a first noise reduction signal; performing second filtering processing on the target noise signal based on the second filtering parameter to obtain a second noise reduction signal; performing superposition processing on the first noise reduction signal and the second noise reduction signal to obtain a noise reduction total signal; and sending the noise reduction total signal to a loudspeaker terminal for audio playing. This embodiment may increase noise reduction comfort.

title_en: Earphone control method, earphone, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an earphone control method, an earphone, an apparatus and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: collecting environment information, and determining key sound detection sensitivity according to the environment information; detecting key sounds in the environment information according to the key sound detection sensitivity; and if the key sound exists in the environment information, adjusting the earphone to a transparent mode, or playing the key sound. The earphone acquires environment information, determines key sound detection sensitivity according to the environment information, and then detects key sound in the environment information according to the key sound detection sensitivity; if the key sound exists, the earphone is adjusted to be in a transparent mode, or the key sound is played. The scheme determines key sound detection sensitivity corresponding to the environmental information based on the environmental information to perform key sound detection. By adopting the means, the detection sensitivity of the key sound is different under different scenes, and the user experience can be improved.

title_en: Underwater high-power electronic bin and disassembly method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater high-power electronic bin and a disassembly method thereof, wherein the electronic bin comprises a barrel, electronic components and an in-cabin heat dissipation device, the in-cabin heat dissipation device comprises a heat dissipation pipe and a mounting plate, the heat dissipation pipe is a hollow pipeline arranged in the middle of the barrel, and the mounting plate is attached to the inner wall of the barrel at one side and is provided with the electronic components at the other side; and a movable connecting piece which can enable each mounting plate to move towards the radiating pipe to gather is arranged between the mounting plates and the radiating pipe. The method is applied to the electronic bin. The mounting panel is direct in this device and the barrel inner wall contact, dispels the heat with the heat transfer to the barrel, simultaneously through setting up the cavity cooling tube at the middle part of barrel, makes the heat of a part in the barrel also accessible cavity cooling tube dispels the heat, further increases holistic heat dispersion in the storehouse, and can carry out the dismouting of integral type to mounting panel and cooling tube, is convenient for overhaul electronic components.

title_en: Preparation method of electromagnetic wave-absorbing material
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electromagnetic wave-absorbing materials, and particularly relates to a preparation method of an electromagnetic wave-absorbing material, which comprises the following steps: mixing alkenylsilane, trichlorosilane and propenyl magnesium chloride for alkenylation to obtain multi-branched alkenylsilane compound containing three functional groups, performing hydroboration with 9-BBN and then H  2  O  2  /OH  ‑  Oxidation is carried out to convert the carbon dioxide into a tree carbosilane polyol; according to the requirements, placing the silicon dioxide ball sol with different grain diameters into two containers, respectively adding a silane coupling agent and a tree carbosilane polyol under alkaline conditions to perform condensation reaction to respectively prepare tree carbo (small amount of silicon) -silicon dioxide balls and silicon carbide-silicon dioxide ball precursors, and decomposingThe problems that the carbon nano material is extremely easy to agglomerate, difficult to disperse and the like are solved, the performance of the carbon nano material is greatly limited, the requirements of strong absorption, wide frequency band, small density and thin thickness of the wave-absorbing material cannot be met, and the existing carbon-based wave-absorbing material has the defects of uncontrollable preparation, poor wave-absorbing effect and the like.

title_en: Multifunctional thermal imaging camera
abstract_en: The invention provides a multifunctional thermal imaging camera, which particularly relates to the technical field of monitoring devices, and comprises a camera body, wherein the camera body is connected with a swinging mechanism through a limiting component, the swinging mechanism is connected with a worm and gear mechanism, a ventilation and heat dissipation mechanism is arranged on the swinging mechanism and is connected with the worm and gear mechanism, the ventilation and heat dissipation mechanism is arranged close to the camera body, and the ventilation and heat dissipation mechanism is connected with a spraying structure; the swing mechanism and the worm and gear mechanism are arranged inside the protective cover, and the back side surface of the protective cover is provided with a nail-free rubber plate. The multifunctional thermal imaging camera provided by the invention can conveniently and quickly perform angle adjustment on the thermal imaging camera, is beneficial to removing dust and accelerating the heat dissipation, and has the multifunctional technical effect.

title_en: Self-adjusting high-definition display suitable for video conference
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of displays, and particularly relates to a display device, which comprises: the utility model provides a self-interacting formula high definition display suitable for videoconference, includes the display and places the case rather than being connected, place the tip of case and seted up with display assorted opening, the spout has been seted up to the interior bottom of placing the case, spout internal fixation has telescopic link one, telescopic link one's drive end fixedly connected with telescopic link two, telescopic link two's drive end is vertical upwards to be fixed with the motor, the lower lateral wall of display is equipped with heat dissipation mechanism, the drive end and the heat dissipation mechanism of motor are connected. The invention realizes the storage and placement of the display by arranging the placement box, avoids the problems that the display is always exposed, dust is easy to adhere and is damaged by collision, can automatically adjust the angle and the height of the display, increases the applicability, and can absorb the heat of the heat-conducting plate out through the flow of water body in the use process of the display, thereby ensuring the normal and efficient operation of the display.

title_en: Processing method of side-lighting surface-mounted nixie tube
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of display devices, and particularly relates to a processing method of a side-emitting surface-mounted nixie tube, which specifically comprises the following steps of S100: providing a row of needle bases, wherein each row of needle bases comprises a plastic needle base formed by integral injection molding and a plurality of row of needles fixed on the plastic needle base, and the stitches of each row of needles are bent to form a mounting surface; s200: providing a circuit board, wherein the circuit board is provided with a connecting surface and a luminous surface which are oppositely arranged, the connecting surface is welded and fixed with the needle heads of the row needles, and then a luminous structure is arranged on the luminous surface; s300: providing a REF shell, and fastening the REF shell on the outer side of the luminous surface to form a semi-finished nixie tube; s400: providing a stainless steel shielding cover, and arranging the stainless steel shielding cover outside the semi-finished nixie tube to form the finished nixie tube. The method can ensure that the assembled nixie tube can be installed in a region with narrow spacing, and the installation and use effects are greatly superior to those of the traditional nixie tube.

title_en: Copper-plating semicircular anti-warping processing technology for PCB (printed circuit board) edge
abstract_en: The invention relates to a copper-plating semicircular anti-warping processing technology for a PCB edge, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of negative film data design, drilling of interconnection holes, overall copper plating of the inner walls of the interconnection holes, copper plating of the upper surface and the lower surface semicircular ring area of a finished product area of a PCB substrate, negative film data transfer, anti-welding printing, left-handed milling cutter assembly, PCB substrate compacting, separation of the right-end inner corners of the interconnected semicircular copper rings on the PCB substrate and a waste area, right-handed milling cutter replacement, separation of the left-end inner corners of the interconnected semicircular copper rings on the PCB substrate and the waste area, and overall removal and cleaning of the waste area of the PCB substrate. The processing technology can ensure normal copper plating residue without copper tilting and increase soldering tin effect, and can greatly improve the yield of products and the production efficiency.

title_en: Power management circuit and display device
abstract_en: The application provides a power management circuit and a display device. The power supply end of the power supply management circuit is used for receiving a power supply signal provided by the power supply module, the booster circuit is used for performing boosting processing on the power supply signal received by the power supply end and outputting the power supply signal from the output end, the booster circuit comprises a booster control circuit, a delay circuit, a first sub-booster circuit and a second sub-booster circuit which are connected in parallel, the booster control circuit is electrically connected to the delay circuit, and a booster trigger signal is output to trigger the delay circuit to output the booster control signal to the first sub-booster circuit and the second sub-booster circuit at intervals of a first delay time. The first sub-booster circuit and the second sub-booster circuit are controlled by the boost control signal to boost the power supply signal at intervals of a first delay time period and then are matched with each other to output the power supply signal from the output end.

title_en: Quick upper plate clamping device of printed circuit board and electroplating equipment thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid upper plate clamping device of a printed circuit board, which comprises two fixed plates, wherein the two fixed plates are oppositely arranged; further comprises: the clamping mechanisms are divided into four groups which are arranged on the opposite surfaces of the two fixing plates at equal intervals. This quick upper plate clamping device of improved generation printed wiring board inserts the both sides of printed wiring board and can accomplish printed wiring board clamping and straighten the operation to accomplish the connection between printed wiring board and the electroplating bath negative pole joint voluntarily afterwards, the installation easy operation of printed wiring board, and the circuit connecting piece is stored in the closed space of shrink when not using, dust and steam in the outside air can not contact and adhere to on the circuit connection inspection, and the circuit connection between printed wiring board and the electroplating bath is stable, and device degree of automation is high, and the even adhesion of metal ion has been made things convenient for to the printed wiring board after the stretching.

title_en: Adjustable high-efficient LED display screen
abstract_en: The invention discloses an adjustable high-efficiency LED display screen, which comprises: the framework, the display module assembly is equipped with a plurality ofly, and every display module assembly is all installed and is located in the framework, and the installation frame is equipped with a plurality ofly, and every installation frame is all fixed to be set up in display module assembly's outer wall one side, and installation mechanism is equipped with the multiunit, and every group installation mechanism all locates display module assembly's outer wall one side. This adjustable high-efficient LED display screen, through installation mechanism and elastic mechanism, can be in the same place every display module assembly fast, when avoiding local display module assembly to damage, be difficult to take out display module assembly from the display module assembly around it to need promote all display module assemblies, it is inconvenient to lead to the display module assembly to change, influences the normal use of LED display screen, stretches out and draws back in fixed section of thick bamboo through the telescopic shaft, cooperation elastic component, can drive the display module assembly and pop out, thereby be convenient for maintain and change the display module assembly, fixed part can fix the position of telescopic shaft.

title_en: Method for improving LED display effect by using seamless packaging technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of LED display screens, in particular to a method for improving the LED display effect by using a seamless packaging technology, which comprises the following steps: the high-density packaging design integrates a plurality of LED chips into one package through a compact packaging form to improve pixel density and resolution, the optimized optical design comprises a lens and a reflecting structure to ensure uniform focusing and diffusion of LED light rays, improve uniformity of brightness and light ray distribution, accurate circuit layout, realize shorter circuit paths and low-resistance connection through a seamless packaging technology, improve circuit performance and driving capability, ensure effective heat dissipation, maintain stability and performance of the LED chips, and realize accurate brightness adjustment and color management through advanced driving circuits and control algorithms. According to the invention, a three-dimensional packaging technology is adopted, so that the integration level of the LED chips is improved, more LED chips can be integrated on the panel with the same size, and the display effect is improved.

title_en: Ultra-wideband energy selection surface with wide angle and high shielding effectiveness
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-wideband energy selection surface with wide angle and high shielding effectiveness, which comprises a first layer of dielectric substrate, a second layer of dielectric substrate and a bottom layer of dielectric substrate which are sequentially stacked, wherein two adjacent layers of dielectric substrates are separated through an air gap layer, a top layer metal unit is arranged on the first layer of dielectric substrate, a middle layer metal unit is arranged on the second layer of dielectric substrate, and a bottom layer metal unit is arranged on the bottom layer of dielectric substrate. The invention realizes that when the active super surface is irradiated by a low-power signal, the transmission frequency band is overlapped with the transmission frequency band of the band-pass super surface, when the HPM is incident, the resonance frequency of the active super surface moves to the stop band of the band-pass super surface, and the band-pass super surface has the functions of wide angle, high shielding efficiency and selective energy transmission, low insertion loss transmission under low power and ultra-wideband protection under high power.

title_en: Display device, dynamic effect display method and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a display device, a dynamic effect display method and a storage medium, which are applied to the dynamic effect display field, can realize the diversity of dynamic effect and improve user experience. The display device includes: the dynamic effect display assembly comprises a management module, a basic technology module and a display module; a controller configured to: responding to the selection operation of a user on the target dynamic component, and sending target dynamic information corresponding to the target dynamic component to a basic technology module through a management module, wherein the target dynamic information comprises a target dynamic identifier of the target dynamic component and target dynamic material information; determining a target technical identifier matched with the target dynamic effect identifier from a plurality of preset technical identifiers through a basic technical module, calling a target bottom dynamic effect scheme corresponding to the target technical identifier based on target dynamic effect material information, and drawing target dynamic effects corresponding to a target dynamic effect component at a display module; and displaying the target dynamic effect on a user interface through a display module.

title_en: Frequency converter fault protection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault protection device for a frequency converter, which relates to the technical field of frequency converters and comprises a frequency converter body, wherein the frequency converter body comprises a frequency converter shell, a groove body is formed in the frequency converter shell, a power-off protection mechanism and a wiring terminal are arranged in the groove body, a high-temperature power-off protector, a humidity power-off protector and a high-voltage power-off mechanism are arranged in the power-off protection mechanism, induction probes of the high-temperature power-off protector and the humidity power-off protector are arranged in the frequency converter shell, and the like.

title_en: Plug structure of low-voltage SVG/APF module convenient to maintain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plug structure of a low-voltage SVG/APF module convenient to maintain, which comprises a module body and a module installation seat, wherein the module body is installed in the module installation seat in a plug mode, a first plug device group is arranged on the rear side face of the module body, a second plug device group matched with the first plug device group is arranged on the module installation seat, the first plug device group and the second plug device group are plug sockets and plug plugs matched with each other, at least two guide pins are arranged on the rear side face of the module body, and guide holes matched with the guide pins are formed in the module installation seat. The invention not only can realize plug-in assembly and disassembly of the whole machine, but also can realize assembly and disassembly of the devices in the machine, and the assembly adopts plug-in assembly and disassembly of the vulnerable assembly and the machine cover, so that once a product fails, the product can be quickly taken down from the machine frame, the machine cover is opened for replacing the failure assembly, the failure shutdown time of the product is greatly reduced, and the operation effect of the product is improved.

title_en: Display module and mobile terminal equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a display module and mobile terminal equipment. Relates to the technical field of display. By changing the layout positions of the display connection areas for setting the display driving chips, more space is reserved for some electronic devices, and design requirements of different layout positions on the display connection areas are given. The display module includes: the display device comprises a flexible display screen, a first display driving chip, a second display driving chip and an electric connection structure; the flexible display screen comprises a first display connection area and a second display connection area which are connected with the non-display area, and the first display connection area and the second display connection area are bent to the side opposite to the light emitting surface of the display area; the electrical connection structure includes a flexible circuit board disposed at a rear surface of the display area; or, a wiring structure formed in the display region or the non-display region. Namely, larger setting space is reserved for other structural members by changing the arrangement mode of the first display connection area and the second display connection area.

title_en: Remote teaching eye movement switching system and method for network intelligent training room
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent teaching, and discloses a system and a method for switching eye movements in network intelligent training room remote teaching, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the system comprises a main lecture classroom and an on-hearing classroom, wherein a first main screen is arranged on the front side wall of the main lecture classroom, video acquisition devices are arranged on the lecture table of the main lecture classroom and each wall, a data switching processing module is arranged in the lecture table of the main lecture classroom, a plurality of all-in-one machines are arranged in the main lecture classroom, and eye movement data acquisition modules are integrated on all the all-in-one machines; the video acquisition device, the integrated machine and the first main screen are electrically connected with the data switching processing module; a second main screen is arranged on the front side wall of the hearing classroom, auxiliary screens are arranged on the left side wall and the right side wall of the hearing classroom, a data receiving module is arranged in the platform of the hearing classroom, the second main screen and the auxiliary screens are electrically connected with the data receiving module, and the data receiving module is in communication connection with the data switching processing module. The technical scheme of the invention can improve the learning effect of the intelligent outdoor online learner.

title_en: Data acquisition device shell buckling structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a buckling structure of a data acquisition unit shell, and relates to the technical field of data acquisition units. The invention comprises an outer shell, wherein an upper opening is formed in the upper surface of the outer shell, an upper cover plate is arranged on the surface of the upper opening, one side of the upper cover plate is connected with a first roller shaft, the side surface of the first roller shaft is movably connected with the outer shell, one side, opposite to the first roller shaft, of the upper cover plate is connected with a buckle, the side surface of the buckle is connected with a distance sensor, a clamping groove is formed in one side of the upper opening, an induction receiving module is arranged on the surface of the clamping groove, the distance sensor is matched with the position of the induction receiving module, one end of the outer shell is provided with a mounting plate, and the surface of the mounting plate is provided with a fixing notch; according to the shell buckling structure of the data acquisition unit, the installation stable structure of the data acquisition unit is separated from and matched with the shell protection structure, so that the data acquisition unit can be disassembled and taken under the condition that the head locking mechanism is not disassembled, the maintenance is convenient, and the operation controllability is high.

title_en: Intelligent indicator light screen capable of changing colors one by one based on using time
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent indicator light screen capable of changing colors one by one based on using time, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: a screen and display assembly; the screen is internally provided with a main control board and a time timer, and the time timer is electrically connected with the main control board; the display component comprises a PCBA board, a group of indicator lamps, an infrared sensing head, a startup and shutdown terminal and an indicator lamp end; the PCBA board is arranged in the screen and fixedly connected with the screen; the group of indicator lamps are arranged in the middle of the front side of the PCBA board and fixedly connected with the PCBA board; the infrared inductive head is arranged at one end of the front side of the PCBA board and is fixedly connected with the PCBA board. The invention relates to the technical field of display, in particular to an intelligent indicator lamp screen capable of changing colors one by one based on using time. The invention aims to solve the technical problem of providing an intelligent indicator lamp screen with colors changed one by one based on the use time, enriching the indication colors of a television, increasing the color function of the indicator lamp of the television and meeting the freshness of consumers on novel things.

title_en: High-efficient integrated flexible line way board of multilayer structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of circuit boards, in particular to a high-efficiency integrated flexible circuit board with a multilayer structure, which aims to improve the heat dissipation performance of the circuit board, a heat dissipation layer is arranged between every two layers of circuit boards, a heat dissipation plate is arranged in the heat dissipation layer, a plurality of air exchange channels are arranged on the heat dissipation plate and are communicated with an external space to exchange air, then the heat conduction is rapidly carried out through two heat conduction layers, two bonding layers are convenient to connect with adjacent circuit boards, so that the heat dissipation capacity of the circuit board is improved, in addition, a joint assembly is used for fixing the junction between every two layers of circuit boards, so that the connection is more stable, in particular, the connection is carried out through a mounting frame and a bottom plate, then the mounting frame is clamped through a plurality of supporting heads, the wiring is carried out on every two layers of circuit boards, and then the connection is pressed, so that the connection is more stable.

title_en: Multilayer PCB circuit board preparation equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for preparing a multilayer PCB (printed Circuit Board), which relate to the technical field of multilayer PCB preparation and comprise a workbench, wherein a pressing regulator is arranged on a second support frame, and the second support frame is connected with a pressing plate positioned above a supporting plate through the pressing regulator.
