According to the invention, the pressing regulator is arranged, the motor is started through the external controller, the connecting plate drives the pressing plate to move downwards through the operation of the motor, when the pressing plate is in contact with the circuit boards stacked on the supporting plate, the motor is closed when the connecting plate is attached to the pressing plate, at the moment, the pressing plate presses the stacked circuit boards through the elastic restoring force of the second restoring spring, when the pressing plate presses the stacked circuit boards to the specified thickness, the limiting plate is in contact with the sliding sleeve, at the moment, the sliding sleeve can prevent the pressing plate from moving downwards continuously through limiting the limiting plate, so that the elastic force of the second restoring spring acts on the sliding sleeve, and the pressing plate can be prevented from continuously pressing the circuit boards, thereby protecting the multilayer circuit boards.

title_en: Signal processing apparatus, method and storage medium
abstract_en: The present technology relates to a signal processing apparatus, method, and storage medium capable of improving coding efficiency. The signal processing device includes: an acquisition unit configured to acquire reverberation information including at least one of spatial reverberation information inherent in a space around an audio object and object reverberation information inherent in the audio object; and a reverberation processing unit for generating a signal of a reverberation component of the audio object based on the reverberation information and the audio object signal. The technology is suitable for a signal processing device.

title_en: Color holographic diffraction waveguide display device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a color holographic diffraction waveguide display device which comprises a display screen main body, a guide frame, a light source spot lamp and a guide frame, wherein the end part of the light source spot lamp is hinged with a middle connecting lug on one side of the guide frame through a hinge frame, both ends of the guide frame are fixed with lug bolts, the end part of the guide frame is provided with the display screen main body, the inner side of the display screen main body is provided with an inner frame, and the inner side of the inner frame is provided with an angle-adjustable diffraction column. The invention is provided with the guide frame, the middle part of the side surface of the guide frame is provided with the guide rod, the two ends of the guide frame are respectively provided with the ear frames, the end parts of the ear frames are provided with the guide lugs, the guide lugs can be connected with the guide rod in a sliding embedded manner, the telescopic ends of the electric push rods can be connected with the guide frame, the end parts of the light source spot lamps are hinged with the connection through the ear frames, the connection lugs are connected with the guide frame, the position of the light source spot lamps can be automatically controlled through the electric push rods, so that the light source spot lamps can be used more flexibly, and diffraction can be carried out in different ranges.

title_en: Automatic focusing triggering method, system, terminal and medium
abstract_en: The application provides an automatic focusing triggering method, an automatic focusing triggering system, a terminal and a medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting object distance information of a target object at each collecting moment to construct an object distance information set corresponding to each collecting moment; extracting object distance change characteristic values corresponding to the object distance information sets according to preset object distance change characteristic parameters so as to obtain the object distance change characteristic values corresponding to the acquisition moments; and when the object distance information is acquired, repeatedly executing the motion state detection of the target object based on the object distance change characteristic value so as to execute a corresponding focusing triggering process when the motion state is detected to be the target motion state, thereby realizing focusing triggering based on the motion state and improving the flexibility and accuracy of focusing triggering.

title_en: Film tearing device and method and packaging method of MEMS microphone
abstract_en: The invention relates to a film tearing device and method and a packaging method of an MEMS microphone, wherein the film tearing device comprises a base, a film tearing device and a packaging device, wherein the base is provided with a target object accommodating area, the target object accommodating area is provided with at least two empty avoidance grooves, and the base also comprises reinforcing ribs positioned between the adjacent empty avoidance grooves; and the pressing mechanism is arranged at the edge of the object accommodating area and used for fixing the object on the base through pressing the object. According to the invention, the target is fixed on the base through the pressing mechanism and then the film is torn, so that the target is not required to be fixed by hands directly, and the pollution or damage of the fixed hands to the target caused by contacting the target is avoided. The sensing structure on the lower surface of the target object is avoided through the clearance groove, the sensing structure is prevented from being crushed, the supporting force on the target object is enhanced through the reinforcing rib, and the deformation of the target object is prevented.

title_en: Encoding device, decoding device, encoding method, decoding method, encoding program, and decoding program
abstract_en: The encoding device is provided with: a correction unit that performs gradation correction on RAW image data from an image pickup element having an optical black based on a gamma coefficient and a value of the optical black; and an encoding unit that encodes the gradation-corrected RAW image data obtained by the gradation correction by the correction unit. The decoding device is provided with: an acquisition unit that acquires encoded RAW image data obtained by encoding gradation-corrected RAW image data subjected to gradation correction based on the values of the gamma coefficient and the optical black; a decoding section that decodes the encoded RAW image data acquired by the acquisition section into the gradation correction RAW image data; and a reverse correction unit that performs reverse gradation correction on the gradation-corrected RAW image data decoded by the decoding unit based on the gamma coefficient and the value of the optical black, and outputs RAW image data before gradation correction.

title_en: Electromagnetic shielding film and circuit board
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electromagnetic shielding functional materials, and particularly relates to an electromagnetic shielding film and a circuit board. The electromagnetic shielding film comprises insulating layers and shielding layers which are arranged in a laminated mode, wherein the surface resistance of the insulating layers is larger than 10  2  omega, and the insulating layers at least comprise a first insulating layer and a second insulating layer; the ratio of the thickness of the first insulating layer to the thickness of the second insulating layer is 0.5-10:20. According to the invention, through a large number of experimental researches, when the surface resistance of the insulating layer of the electromagnetic shielding film is larger than 10  2  omega, the shielding performance of the shielding film can be improved by combining the limitation of the thickness proportion of the first insulating layer and the second insulating layer, the excellent grounding performance can be realized, and the high-frequency requirement can be met. When the shielding film is used for sealing off the FPC board, the problem of poor wave leakage of the side face of the FPC board can be effectively solved.

title_en: Intelligent emergency lighting controller communicating by multiple protocols
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent emergency lighting controller communicating by multiple protocols, wherein a main control MCU is arranged in a box body, the periphery of the main control MCU is respectively connected with a protocol forwarding unit, an active/passive input node, a normally open/normally closed output node, a serial port USB interface, a wireless communication module, a wireless/wired selectable communication module and a CAN/RS85 communication interface through a multi-protocol conversion module, the protocol forwarding unit, the active/passive input node and the normally open/normally closed output node are used for communicating with other fire alarm products of different manufacturers, the wireless communication module is in communication connection with an OTA upgrading cloud platform, the wireless/wired selectable communication module is in communication connection with an intelligent fire APP or an intelligent fire platform, and the CAN/RS85 communication interface is in communication connection with a control room graphic unit or an alarm control unit. The emergency lighting controller designed by the invention provides various interfaces for communication with fire alarm products of other factories, can integrate other fire alarm products in a centralized way more optimally, and can display fire alarm information in a smart fire control cloud platform and a smart fire control APP of a fire control center or a smart city big data monitoring center in a summarized manner.

title_en: Reconstruction techniques for video frames
abstract_en: A system for reconstructing video frames.

title_en: Display screen module
abstract_en: The invention relates to a display screen module, comprising: a back plate; the metal plate pressing plate is arranged on the inner side of the backboard; the frame is arranged on the outer side of the metal plate pressing plate and is fixedly connected with the back plate, and the frame is made of plastic materials; the infrared PCB is arranged on the metal plate pressing plate; and the filter strip is respectively connected with the metal plate pressing plate and the frame, and is arranged opposite to the illuminant on the infrared PCB. Compared with the prior art, because the frame adopts the plastic material, the weight is lighter, is favorable to alleviateing the complete machine weight of infrared touch-control all-in-one, and then promotes user's use and experience to the frame of plastic material is easier to process and manufacture, and with low costs, can reduce complete machine manufacturing cost by a wide margin, promotes the economic nature, and simultaneously the panel beating clamp plate can compensate the intensity loss of plastic frame, supports steadily to the plastic frame.

title_en: Server heat dissipation control method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a server heat dissipation control method and a system, which relate to the technical field of intelligent control, wherein the method comprises the following steps: setting a multi-stage temperature change grade determining mode regulation mechanism, supervising and training a self-adaptive heat dissipation regulation model, reading heat dissipation record data and determining a target temperature change grade, activating a target regulation branch mapped to the target temperature change grade, if the target regulation branch is an advanced regulation branch, analyzing and determining the heat dissipation regulation scheme to perform scheme expansion and competitive assimilation optimizing to determine a target heat dissipation scheme, feeding the target heat dissipation scheme back to a server heat dissipation system, returning heat dissipation feedback data, generating a feedback regulation command if the target heat dissipation scheme does not meet an expected heat dissipation standard, and transmitting the feedback regulation command and the heat dissipation feedback data back to the self-adaptive heat dissipation regulation model, so that heat dissipation control analysis is repeatedly performed, the technical problems of insufficient heat dissipation control of a server and low operation efficiency of the server in the prior art are solved, the adaptive regulation of heat dissipation of the server is realized, and the operation efficiency of the server is further improved.

title_en: CIS cascade-based scanning imaging system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CIS cascade-based scanning imaging system and a CIS cascade-based scanning imaging method, wherein the CIS cascade-based scanning imaging system comprises a CIS array module, a plurality of CIS arrays, a plurality of CIS sensors and a plurality of CIS detection units, wherein each CIS array comprises N contact image sensors which are sequentially arranged, and each contact image sensor is used for acquiring image data of an object to be detected in a visual field range corresponding to the current contact image sensor; the node driving array comprises M sequentially cascaded node driving units, each node driving unit is provided with a different node serial number, and each node driving unit is electrically connected with one contact image sensor; and the terminal node units are electrically connected with the node driving unit array and are used for receiving the effective data inserted into the data transmission link by each node driving unit. The invention can be arranged in a modularized way on the basis of keeping the original application to the detection of medium-width and above-width embryonic cloth, is easier and simpler to install and greatly reduces the investment of cost.

title_en: PCB and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PCB and a manufacturing method of the PCB, wherein the manufacturing method of the PCB comprises the following steps: providing an inner core board, an outer layer board and a GND layer board; hollowing out the GND laminate at a preset position to form a mounting groove; embedding a resistor in the mounting groove to fill the mounting groove; laminating the inner core plate, the outer layer plate and the GND layer plate; laminating the inner core board, the outer layer board and the GND layer board; preparing a golden finger at a position of the outer layer plate corresponding to a preset position; and obtaining the PCB. According to the invention, the lower GND layer plate is hollowed by the golden hand, and the resistor is arranged in the GND layer, so that the impedance of the golden finger is improved, the impedance of the golden finger is controllable by adjusting the resistance value of the resistor, meanwhile, the hollowed space of the adjacent GND layer plate close to the golden finger is reduced, the impedance continuity of signals and the golden finger is improved, and the risk of signal quality deterioration caused by impedance mutation is reduced.

title_en: Folding assembly and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a folding component and electronic equipment. The electronic equipment comprises a folding device and a flexible display screen, wherein the flexible display screen is arranged on the folding device, and the folding device comprises a first shell, a second shell and a folding assembly connected between the first shell and the second shell. The folding assembly comprises a main shaft, a rotating arm, a fixing frame, a first connecting arm and a second connecting arm, wherein the first shell is connected with the main shaft through rotation of the rotating arm, the fixing frame is fixed on the second shell, and the fixing frame is movably connected with the main shaft through the first connecting arm and the second connecting arm. The folding assembly has the advantages of fewer parts, simpler structure and lower cost.

title_en: Pixel circuit, driving method thereof, display panel and display device
abstract_en: A pixel circuit (100) and a driving method thereof, a display panel (1000) and a display device, wherein the pixel circuit (100) comprises a data writing sub-circuit (110), a driving sub-circuit (120) and at least one potential maintaining sub-circuit (130). The Data writing sub-circuit (110) is coupled with at least a first voltage signal terminal (VDD), a Data signal terminal (Data), a first scan signal terminal (Pgate) and a first node (N1), and writes the Data signal provided by the Data signal terminal (Data) into the first node (N1) under the control of the first scan signal provided by at least the first scan signal terminal (Pgate); the driving sub-circuit (120) is coupled with the first node (N1), the second node (N2) and the third node (N3), and forms a path between the second node (N2) and the third node (N3) under the control of the potential of the first node (N1); a potential maintaining sub-circuit (130) is coupled to a circuit node and a reference signal terminal (Vref) for maintaining the potential of the corresponding circuit node via the reference signal provided by the reference signal terminal (Vref).

title_en: Identity recognition method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an identity identification method, an identity identification device, a storage medium and electronic equipment. Firstly, acquiring historical driving data of a target vehicle, wherein the historical driving data comprise driving speed and driving position of the target vehicle in a preset time period; when the snapshot is determined to be executed according to the historical driving data, a snapshot instruction is issued to the target vehicle, and the snapshot instruction is used for indicating the target vehicle to take a picture of the current driver; then receiving a driver image returned by the target vehicle in response to the snapshot instruction; and then matching the driver image with the face image in the driver information base to obtain the identity recognition result of the current driver. According to the method and the device for determining the face image matching, whether the vehicle is snapped or not is determined according to the driving data of the vehicle, and the photos of the driver are obtained to be subjected to face image matching when the vehicle is determined to be snapped, so that the actual driver of the vehicle can be determined, and effective supervision of the vehicle is achieved.

title_en: Eye protection method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses an eye protection method, device, equipment and medium, belonging to the technical field of eye protection display. According to the application, the eye protection device is additionally arranged on the display device, the rotating shaft is arranged in the sealing film barrel in the eye protection device, the opening is arranged on the side wall of the sealing film barrel, meanwhile, the spliced soft film roll formed by splicing the eye protection films is wound on the rotating shaft, then, the potential eye risk of the user is determined according to the eye pattern data of the acquired user when the display device is used, the target eye protection film capable of avoiding the potential eye risk is determined, the target eye protection film is pulled out from the opening on the eye protection device, the pulled target eye protection film is positioned between the display device and the user, and therefore, the potential eye risk from the display device is avoided through shielding of the target eye protection film, and further, the burden on eyes caused when the display device is used is relieved.

title_en: Disk device
abstract_en: Provided is a disk device capable of reducing the occurrence rate of failures caused by contaminants. According to an embodiment, a magnetic disk device includes a rotatable magnetic disk, an actuator for supporting and driving a head, a ramp for holding the head at an unloading position, a motor for rotating the magnetic disk, and a controller for performing a loading operation for loading the head onto the magnetic disk from the ramp and a seek operation for moving the head from an outer periphery to an inner periphery of the magnetic disk after the loading. If the radial moving speed of the head during the loading operation is Vr1, the circumferential moving speed of the head is Vt1, the radial moving speed of the head during the seek operation is Vrs, and the circumferential moving speed is Vts, the controller controls at least one of the radial moving speed of the head and the rotational speed of the disk so as to satisfy the relation of (Vr 1/Vt 1) < (Vrs/Vts).

title_en: Display module, display device and drive circuit board
abstract_en: A display module (300) includes a display panel (310), a driving circuit board (100), a flexible circuit board (210), and a driving chip (220). The driving circuit board (100) includes a circuit board main body (110) and a binding assembly (130). The circuit board body (110) has opposite first (111) and second (112) major surfaces, and opposite first (L1) and second (L2) edges. The first edge (L1) is closer to the binding side of the display panel (310) than the second edge (L2). A binding assembly (130) is located on the first major surface (111). The circuit board main body (110) is provided with a containing structure (120), the containing structure (120) is provided with an opening (121) at least on the first main surface (111), and the opening (121) of the containing structure (120) is closer to the first edge (L1) than the binding assembly (130). One end of the flexible circuit board (210) is in binding connection with the binding side of the display panel (310), and the other end of the flexible circuit board is in binding connection with the binding assembly (130). The driving chip (220) is mounted on the flexible circuit board (210) and is located at a side close to the driving circuit board (100). Wherein, the orthographic projection (Q2) of the driving chip (220) on the first reference surface is positioned at the inner side of the orthographic projection (Q1) of the opening (121) on the first reference surface. The first reference plane is a plane parallel to the first main surface (111).

title_en: Hierarchical heat dissipation liquid crystal display
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of liquid crystal display screens, in particular to a hierarchical heat dissipation liquid crystal display screen, which comprises a liquid crystal display screen, wherein the back surface of the liquid crystal display screen is fixedly connected with a fixed shell, the bottom end of the fixed shell is fixedly connected with a supporting seat, one side of the inside of the fixed shell is provided with a heat exhausting mechanism, one side of the heat exhausting mechanism is provided with a refrigerating mechanism, one side of the refrigerating mechanism is provided with a cooling mechanism, the outer side of the back surface of the fixed shell is fixedly connected with a control mechanism, water is conveniently circulated through a high-pressure water return pipe on a fixed backup plate, the back surface of a screen is refrigerated through a surface cooler, heat in the liquid crystal display screen is exchanged through a high-low-pressure heat exchanger, the refrigerating effect of the liquid crystal display screen is prevented from being influenced by overhigh temperature of refrigerating equipment, and the heat generated by a surface cooler fan is dissipated through the surface cooler.

title_en: Audio processing method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an audio processing method and an audio processing system, wherein the audio processing method comprises the following steps: determining standard audio synthesis parameters from first header data by obtaining the first header data; acquiring second header data, and determining the offset of the header according to the first header data and the second header data; adjusting the standard audio synthesis parameters according to the offset to obtain target audio synthesis parameters; and processing the audio data according to the target audio synthesis parameters to output the surround sound effect. Therefore, by continuously synchronizing the target audio synthesis parameters with the offset value of the gesture data of the head, the human can feel the space audio which is relatively fixed with the real world coordinates when wearing the earphone, and the aim of simulating a plurality of surrounding channels in the stereo earphone according to the gesture of the head is fulfilled.

title_en: Processing method, processing device and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a processing method, a processing device and a computer storage medium, comprising the following steps: acquiring a shooting instruction sent by a cloud server and used for shooting a target object, wherein the shooting instruction is generated after the cloud server detects that a voice shooting request input by a user history is triggered, and the voice shooting request is acquired by a vehicle and sent to the cloud server; and controlling the vehicle-mounted image pickup device to pick up according to the shooting instruction so as to obtain a target image comprising the target object. Therefore, the vehicle-mounted camera device of the vehicle is controlled by the cloud server to automatically shoot the target object according to shooting requests input by historical voice of the user, the operation is convenient, and shooting effect and driving safety are improved.

title_en: Display structure including dielectric and electronic device including the same
abstract_en: An electronic device according to an embodiment may include: a housing including a first housing forming a first side surface of the electronic device, a second housing forming a second side surface corresponding to the first side surface, and a hinge connecting the first housing and the second housing, wherein the housing is switched between a folded state or an unfolded state based on the hinge; a wireless communication circuit that transmits and receives signals of a specified frequency band by supplying power to at least a portion of the housing; and a display structure connected with the housing. The display structure includes: a cover glass for forming at least a portion of a front surface of the electronic device; a display panel disposed adjacent to one surface of the cover glass; and a first layer disposed under the display panel and including a dielectric. The first layer may include: adjacent to the hinge and comprising a first area of the grid pattern and a second area other than the first area. The first edge of the first region may be spaced apart from the first side surface by a first distance, the second edge of the second region may be spaced apart from the first side surface by a second distance greater than the first distance, and at least a portion of the housing may be connected to ground by a conductive connection member disposed at a first point spaced apart from the first side surface by a third distance less than the second distance. Other embodiments obtained by the present description are possible.

title_en: Power switch module test fixture
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of test tools, in particular to a power switch module test tool which comprises a shell, two cold and hot mechanisms, two fixing mechanisms, two workpieces, a test host and a conductive column, wherein the shell is provided with a plurality of cold and hot mechanisms; the two fixing mechanisms are arranged on the shell and are used for fixing workpieces on the cold and hot mechanism; the two cold and hot mechanisms are respectively arranged on the two fixing mechanisms and are used for heating and cooling the workpiece; the two workpieces are respectively arranged on the upper surfaces of the two cold and hot mechanisms; in the using process, the invention can realize rapid heating and cooling of the switch module through the arrangement of the cold and hot mechanism, and can well meet the requirement of testing the temperature difference between the chip and the base plate DBC of the larger shell, thereby enabling the second-level and minute-level power circulation to be tested simultaneously, shortening the testing time by 50%, greatly improving the verification efficiency and the verification effect and being beneficial to the testing and use of the switch module.

title_en: Earphone
abstract_en: The application discloses a headset. The earphone comprises a loudspeaker assembly and a shielding piece, wherein the shielding piece comprises a first shielding piece, the first shielding piece is arranged on one side of the loudspeaker assembly, and in a wearing state, the first shielding piece at least partially extends towards the direction from the loudspeaker assembly to an auditory canal. Through the mode, the earphone provided by the application can increase the volume heard by the ears of the user, so that the user can hear the content by using smaller earphone volume, the leakage is reduced, and the hearing effect of the user is improved.

title_en: Multilayer structure comprising insulating layer
abstract_en: A multilayer structure comprising one or more insulating layers, one or more resin layers, and one or more copper foils having smooth surfaces and roughened surfaces, wherein the insulating layers comprise an olefin-aromatic vinyl compound-aromatic polyene copolymer and a surface modifier, the resin layers comprise one or more selected from the group consisting of Polyimide (PI), liquid Crystal Polymer (LCP), polyphenylene ether (PPE), polyfunctional aromatic vinyl resin (ODV), epoxy resin, and the same composition as the insulating layers, at least one surface of each of the insulating layers is bonded to the smooth surface of the copper foil, and at least one surface of each of the resin layers is bonded to the roughened surface of the copper foil and the resin layers are not bonded to the smooth surface of the copper foil, or both surfaces of the resin layers are not bonded to the copper foil.

title_en: Display module and near-to-eye display device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a display module and a near-to-eye display device, wherein the display module comprises a display panel, and the display panel comprises a display area and a non-display area; the display area comprises a plurality of light emitting elements, the light emitting elements comprise a first electrode and a second electrode, the non-display area comprises a second electrode signal line, and the second electrode signal line is electrically connected with the second electrode; the plurality of light emitting elements comprise a first light emitting element and a second light emitting element, the image heights of the first light emitting element and the second light emitting element are different, and the second electrode in the first light emitting element is different from the second electrode in the second light emitting element; at the same driving voltage, the display brightness L1 of the first light-emitting element and the display brightness L2 of the second light-emitting element meet the requirement of |L1-L2|/L2 less than or equal to 20 percent. By adopting the technical scheme, the display brightness of the first light-emitting element is ensured to be equivalent to that of the second light-emitting element through the differential design of the second electrode of the first light-emitting element and the second electrode of the second light-emitting element, and the display uniformity of the display module is ensured.

title_en: High-reliability negative pressure liquid cooling system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of liquid cooling and heat energy engineering preparation, and particularly relates to a high-reliability negative-pressure liquid cooling system and a control method thereof. By applying the energy accumulator in the negative pressure liquid cooling system, the invention avoids the misjudgment of the normal fluctuation of the system pressure by the controller, and the return program is started by mistake, thereby reducing the noise caused by frequent starting of the vacuum pump.

title_en: Cooking equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses cooking equipment, which comprises a cooking cavity, an electric device and a forced-exhaust module, wherein the forced-exhaust module comprises a blower, a first air passage and a second air passage, the blower is connected with the cooking cavity through the first air passage, the forced-exhaust module is used for exhausting gas in the cooking cavity when the first air passage is conducted, the blower is in fluid connection with the electric device through the second air passage, and the forced-exhaust module is also used for radiating heat of the electric device when the second air passage is conducted. According to the cooking equipment provided by the embodiment of the invention, when the first air passage is communicated, cold air generated by the air blower can enter the cooking cavity through the first air passage, so that air in the cooking cavity is rapidly discharged, and the exhaust efficiency of the cooking cavity is improved; when the second air passage is conducted, cold air generated by the air blower or external cold air flows through the electric device, so that heat of the electric device can be dissipated, the temperature of the electric device is effectively reduced, and the service life and stability of the electric device are improved while strong exhaust is realized.

title_en: Vapor chamber, vapor chamber manufacturing method and intelligent terminal
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of heat conduction and heat dissipation, and discloses a soaking plate, a soaking plate manufacturing method and an intelligent terminal, wherein the soaking plate comprises: a body, a protruding structure, and a capillary structure; the convex structure body is arranged on one side surface of the main body close to the heat source; the capillary structure is arranged in the protruding structure body; there is a region of overlap between the projection of the protruding structure onto the body and the projection of the heat source onto the body. The projection structure body is arranged on the surface of one side of the main body, which is close to the heat source, and the projection of the projection structure body on the main body and the projection of the heat source on the main body are overlapped to realize the position correspondence of the projection structure body and the heat source, and the projection structure body receives the heat of the heat source to transfer, so that the gap between the vapor chamber and the heat source is reduced, the thermal resistance between the heat source and the vapor chamber is further reduced, and the heat dissipation and temperature reduction performance of the vapor chamber is effectively improved.

title_en: Visual material throwing system based on drilling rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visual material throwing system based on drilling rescue, which consists of a ground support system, a portable computer terminal system, a video information collecting and transmitting system, a material throwing pod and a visual detection system, wherein the material throwing pod is hung below the ground support system; the video information collecting and transmitting system is arranged in an inner cavity at the middle upper part of the material throwing nacelle; the visual detection system is arranged in an inner cavity at the bottom of the material delivery nacelle; the visual detection system is in communication interconnection with the video information collection and transmission system, and the video information collection and transmission system is in communication interconnection with the portable computer terminal system through a signal cable. The invention can provide necessary materials for underground stranded personnel, establish a life line between the ground and the deep underground stranded personnel, and ensure the basic requirements of the stranded personnel.

title_en: Television supporting base
abstract_en: The invention discloses a television supporting base, which comprises a storage box, a mounting rack and a mounting and adjusting assembly, wherein the front side of the storage box is provided with an opening, the rear side of the storage box is provided with a mounting opening, both ends of the front side of the storage box are provided with sliding grooves, the front side of the storage box is provided with an opening and closing assembly, and both ends of the opening and closing assembly are in sliding connection with the sliding grooves; the mounting rack is arranged in the storage box and used for mounting and fixing the television, and the storage box, the mounting rack, the opening and closing assembly and the push-pull assembly are additionally arranged to realize storage protection of the television, so that dust accumulation caused by naked placement of the television is avoided, the neatness of placement of the television is improved, the opening and closing device is opened when the television is used, the push-pull assembly pushes the television out, a user can conveniently watch the television, the push-pull assembly pulls the television back into the storage box and shields the television by the opening and closing assembly when the television is closed, the naked placement of the television is avoided, collision damage to the television is reduced, and the safety of placement of the television is improved.

title_en: Quick coding mode decision method suitable for VVC SCC
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of video coding, and particularly relates to a fast coding mode decision method suitable for a VVC SCC, which comprises the following steps: dividing the brightness component of the video frame into sub-blocks with different sizes and dividing the sub-blocks into four groups; four pattern classifiers based on convolutional neural networks are respectively designed for four groups of CUs, and loss functions are designed for training; predicting the coding mode probability of each sub-block in parallel through a trained mode classifier; and sequencing the coding mode probability of each sub-block, selecting the probabilities of the first n modes from large to small, summing, and stopping selecting when the probability sum of the selected modes is larger than a set threshold value to obtain the optimal coding mode. The method optimizes the VVC complex partition structure, realizes the mode rapid prediction of the Coding Unit (CU) by using the convolutional neural network, can effectively skip the impossible mode, and obviously reduces unnecessary mode checking, thereby greatly improving the coding speed.

title_en: Lens module and electronic device
abstract_en: A lens module comprises a circuit board, a sensor, a lens assembly and a supporting piece, wherein the circuit board comprises two hard boards and a soft board, a channel is formed between the two hard boards, and the soft board is connected with the two hard boards; the sensor is positioned in the channel, and the lens component is connected to one side of the two hard plates, which is away from the soft plate; the support piece is connected to the circuit board, and the support piece includes first supporting part, second supporting part and third supporting part, and first supporting part is connected in the soft board, and the week side of first supporting part is connected to second supporting part and third supporting part, and in second supporting part and third supporting part stretched into the passageway. The application also provides an electronic device. Among above-mentioned camera lens module and the electron device, form the passageway through the hard board that two intervals set up, the sensor is arranged in the passageway, has reduced the ascending module height of camera lens module in the second direction to reduce the size of camera lens module, through setting up the sensor on the support piece parcel live the soft board simultaneously, reduce the outside foreign matter of circuit board and get into the risk in the passageway.

title_en: System and method for interpolating reconstructed feature data in encoding of multi-dimensional data
abstract_en: A method of interpolating inferred data corresponding to reconstructed feature data is disclosed. The method comprises the following steps: receiving reconstructed feature data, wherein the reconstructed feature data corresponds to video data that has been time downsampled; generating a bounding box for the reconstructed feature data; and a partially interpolated bounding box for temporal downsampling of the video.

title_en: High-broadband light-weight wave-absorbing material for satellite communication and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-broadband light-weight wave-absorbing material for satellite communication, which comprises 4.22-30.72% of raw silicone rubber, 0.1-0.5% of graphene, 0.5-1% of multi-wall carbon nanotubes, 5-10% of ferrosilicon alloy powder, 8-15% of vacuum ceramic powder, 50-60% of carbonyl iron powder, 5-8% of cross-linking agent, 0.08% of curing agent, 0.5-1% of reinforcing agent and 0.1-0.2% of curing retarder. The absorption frequency of the invention covers the Ku frequency band of 10 GHz-15 GHz and the Ka frequency band of 20 GHz-30 GHz of satellite communication, the effective absorption bandwidth is 10GHz, the absorption efficiency is more than 10dB, and the highest absorption efficiency of the center frequency is more than 40 dB. The absorption efficiency of the ultra-high frequency band of 26.5 GHz-40 GHz is more than 10 dB.

title_en: Solder paste printing device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solder paste printing device and a solder paste printing method, which relate to the technical field of circuit board printing equipment, and comprise solder paste printers, a conveying unit and a program control unit, wherein the two solder paste printers are connected in series, the conveying unit is arranged on the two solder paste printers in a penetrating way, a first steel mesh structure is detachably arranged in one solder paste printer, a second steel mesh structure is detachably arranged in the other solder paste printer, a tin brushing unit and a tin spraying unit are arranged in each solder paste printer, the first steel mesh structure and the second steel mesh structure are respectively arranged below the tin brushing unit correspondingly, a carrier unit is arranged on the conveying unit, the carrier unit is movably arranged below the first steel mesh structure and the second steel mesh structure through the conveying unit, and a lifting unit is further arranged between the conveying unit and the carrier unit; the invention can process the front and the back of the PCB by adopting the same production line, thereby improving the printing efficiency.

title_en: Display panel, driving method of display panel and display device
abstract_en: The invention provides a display panel, a driving method of the display panel and a display device. The display panel comprises a first display area and a second display area, wherein the first display area and the second display area comprise a plurality of first pixel rows and a plurality of second pixel rows, the first pixel rows comprise first sub-pixels and second sub-pixels which are alternately arranged along a first direction, the second pixel rows comprise a plurality of third sub-pixels which are alternately arranged along the first direction, the first pixel rows and the second pixel rows are alternately arranged along a second direction, the first direction and the second direction are intersected, and the first sub-pixels, the second sub-pixels and the third sub-pixels emit light with different colors; the distance between adjacent first and second pixel rows in the first display area is a first distance, and the distance between adjacent first and second pixel rows in the second display area is a second distance, which is smaller than the first distance. The display panel can improve the display effect.

title_en: Control assembly and electric tool
abstract_en: The invention relates to a control assembly, which comprises a packaging box and a circuit board arranged on the packaging box, wherein an electronic element is arranged on the circuit board, the control assembly comprises a wiring part arranged on the circuit board, the wiring part and the electronic element are respectively arranged on two sides of the circuit board, and an electric tool using the control assembly has the advantages of high wiring efficiency and good safety performance.

title_en: High-low voltage switch cabinet with intelligent monitoring function
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-low voltage switch cabinet with an intelligent monitoring function, which comprises a cabinet body, wherein a cabinet door is hinged to the front side of the cabinet body, a monitoring structure is arranged on the cabinet door, the monitoring structure comprises a monitoring camera and a far-distance infrared thermometer positioned in a monitoring picture, the monitoring camera and the far-distance infrared thermometer are fixedly connected with a device plate, the device plate is connected with a swinging mechanism which drives the device plate to swing transversely, the swinging mechanism is connected with a vertical screw rod module which drives the device plate to move vertically up and down, and the device plate is driven to move in a scanning mode by utilizing the vertical screw rod module and the swinging mechanism which is linked with the vertical screw rod module, so that the monitoring camera and the far-distance infrared thermometer on the device plate can comprehensively monitor and monitor electrical equipment and cable joints in the cabinet body.

title_en: Video processing method, device and medium
abstract_en: The present invention provides a solution for media data transmission. A media data transmission method is provided. The method comprises the following steps: the first device receives a metadata file from the second device; and determining an indication from the metadata file indicating whether the first set of decoded video data units representing the target picture-in-picture region in the first video can be replaced by the second set of decoded video data units in the second video.

title_en: Electronic equipment, camera module, laser measuring device and control method of laser measuring device
abstract_en: The application provides electronic equipment, a camera module, a laser measuring device and a control method thereof; the laser measuring device includes: the shell is internally provided with a laser light source, a reflection module and a receiving sensor; the laser light source is used for emitting a first laser signal and a second laser signal, the first laser signal is directly emitted through a first signal port on the shell, and the second laser signal is refracted through the reflection module and emitted from a second signal port on the shell; the receiving sensor is arranged corresponding to a third signal port on the shell and is used for receiving the returned first laser signal and/or second laser signal. According to the laser measuring device, the laser emitted by the laser source is divided into two parts, the far target is measured by using projection laser, the near object is measured by using reflection laser, the problem that the short-distance test precision of the traditional scheme D TOF is insufficient is solved, the device is applied to electronic equipment such as mobile phones, and the short-distance auxiliary focusing and camera switching experience can be improved.

title_en: Soybean milk machine with detachable cup body
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of soymilk machines, in particular to a soymilk machine with a detachable cup body, which comprises a base, wherein a smashing cabin is arranged at the top of the base, a motor assembly is arranged in the base, a connecting seat is arranged at the top of the base, a fastening structure which enables the outer wall of the connecting seat and the inner wall of the bottom of the smashing cabin to be detachably assembled together is arranged between the outer wall of the connecting seat and the inner wall of the bottom of the smashing cabin, a baffle plate which separates the smashing cabin from the base up and down is arranged at the inner side of the connecting seat, a through hole is formed in the middle of the baffle plate, a motor shaft of the motor assembly upwards passes through the through hole to enter the smashing cabin and is provided with a smashing knife, a shell of the motor assembly is fixed in the base at the bottom of the baffle plate, the soymilk machine can be well cooled on the premise that a fan is not required, the cooling efficiency is better than that the fan is arranged, and the service life of the soymilk machine is prolonged.

title_en: Real-time video stitching system based on ZYNQ
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of video stitching, and particularly discloses a real-time video stitching system based on ZYNQ, which comprises an FPGA and an ARM processor, wherein the FPGA comprises a data acquisition module, a gray level conversion operation module, a DDR read-write controller and an image stitching module, the ARM processor comprises a DDR memory, and the data acquisition module acquires a first original image and a second original image; the gray level conversion operation module performs gray level conversion operation on the first original image and the second original image to obtain a first gray level image and a second gray level image; the DDR read-write controller stores the first original image, the second original image, the first gray image and the second gray image into the DDR memory; the image stitching module is used for stitching the first original image and the second original image according to the real-time homography matrix between the first gray level image and the second gray level image. The ZYNQ-based real-time video splicing system provided by the invention has the advantages of flexibility, high performance, low power consumption and the like.

title_en: Active laser illumination-based distance gating imaging method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of image gating imaging, in particular to a distance gating imaging method and system based on active laser illumination. The method comprises the following steps: providing a range gated imaging device comprising: the laser is connected with the transmitting module and the receiving module of the laser; generating a laser signal for exciting the emission module by a laser; calculating a control signal for controlling the camera according to the laser signal and a time sequence calculation model based on multi-factor fusion; the camera is controlled by a control signal to acquire an image sequence, wherein the image sequence comprises: at least one depth image having depth information including: distance information between the target object and the camera. The invention provides a novel gating method based on the cooperation of a multi-factor fusion time sequence calculation model and depth information, wherein the time sequence calculation model can be dynamically adjusted based on the characteristics of the depth information in real time so as to further improve the accuracy of the gating method.

title_en: Display control device, display control method and display panel
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of display driving, and particularly relates to a display control device, a display control method and a display panel, wherein the display control device comprises a picture detection module and a grid control module comprising a plurality of grid control units; judging whether the next frame of display picture is a special picture or not through a picture detection module, and driving a scanning line in a mode of opening row by row when the next frame of display picture is detected to be not the special picture, so that the display effect of a normal picture is not affected; when a special picture is detected, the scanning lines are driven by controlling the two adjacent lines to be opened simultaneously through the grid control units, so that the upward and downward couplings between the two adjacent lines are mutually offset, and the common voltages of the two adjacent lines cannot deviate, thereby solving the problem that the common voltages deviate to cause color cast or crosstalk of the whole picture and improving the display effect of the picture.

title_en: Video processing method, system, terminal and storage medium based on splicing technology
abstract_en: The application relates to a video processing method, a system, a terminal and a storage medium based on an assembly technology, which relate to the technical field of video processing, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a video processing task, video data and feedback information of connected display equipment; the feedback information of the display devices comprises the number, the splicing relation and the resolution of the display devices; the video processing task comprises the number and layout of the display devices and index numbers of corresponding video data; checking whether the number of display devices in the feedback information of the display devices and the splicing relation are matched with the number and layout of the devices in the video processing task; after verification is passed, corresponding video data is called according to the index number; processing the video data according to the number of display devices, the splicing relation and the resolution ratio to obtain a processed result video; and respectively sending the result videos to corresponding display equipment. The application has the effect of accurately distributing video data to each display when the spliced displays are connected.

title_en: Anti-drop high-performance mobile power supply
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mobile power supplies, in particular to an anti-falling high-performance mobile power supply, which comprises: the battery comprises a shell, a high-capacity battery core and a PCB. The shell comprises two symmetrical covers, the shell is in a calabash shape, the large-capacity battery cell is arranged on the larger side, a gripping groove is formed in the smaller side, and the gripping groove is in an inward convergent arc shape; the shell is sleeved with a detachable buffering anti-skid belt with elasticity, and the surface of the buffering anti-skid belt is provided with uniformly distributed bumps. The outer side of the shell is provided with a double-layer energy absorbing plate, and filling software is installed in the cavity. And each piece of housing is internally provided with a battery core stabilizing bracket, and the symmetrical arc notch plates are clamped with the high-capacity battery cores. The invention can accommodate a large-capacity battery core, simultaneously reduce the volume of a mobile power supply as much as possible, and is provided with a double-layer energy absorption plate, a rubber cushion layer with holes and a battery core stabilizing support, thereby reducing the influence of falling on main electronic components of the mobile power supply.

title_en: Point cloud sequence coding method based on bidirectional prediction and composite context
abstract_en: The invention provides a point cloud sequence coding method based on bidirectional prediction and composite context, firstly, voxelization of the point cloud sequence is carried out, secondly, type division is carried out on points Yun Zhen, different types of frames can be provided with coding modes which are suitable for the actions of the points, wherein a bidirectional reference frame is based on left and right coding dependence, an occupancy map auxiliary motion estimation algorithm is used for searching, the composite context of minimized conditional entropy is established, and obvious coding gain is achieved under the condition that coding complexity is not improved; compared with the prior art, the method provided by the invention fully utilizes redundant information among the point cloud frames, performs lossless compression on the point cloud sequence, and effectively reduces the transmission bandwidth consumption of the point cloud sequence; redundant information transmission is reduced; in addition, the invention uses the two-way reference frame to enlarge the generation range of the context, so that the effect of motion estimation is more excellent; compared with the prior art, the method has obvious advantages in the compression performance of the point cloud sequence.

title_en: High-efficient forced air cooling heat dissipation energy storage cabinet
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy storage cabinets, and discloses a high-efficiency air-cooled heat dissipation energy storage cabinet, which comprises: the refrigerator comprises a refrigerator body, wherein two ends of the refrigerator body are respectively and fixedly connected with a first refrigerator, a plurality of equidistant connecting frames are fixedly connected inside the refrigerator body, a power supply is arranged inside the connecting frames, and two radiating holes are formed in the bottoms of two sides of the refrigerator body; the surface of the cabinet body is provided with a discharge device. According to the exhaust device, the exhaust gas filtered by the equipment is effectively exhausted, so that the exhaust gas is exhausted, the air in the cabinet body is difficult to circulate when the equipment is used, hot gas in the cabinet body is accumulated and cannot be exhausted, the power supply is damaged, and the practicability of the equipment is improved.

title_en: High-efficiency isolation and convenient-tuning multi-signal filter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-signal filter which is high-efficient in isolation and convenient to tune, comprising a metal shell, a metal cover plate, an inductance component and a capacitance component, wherein a plurality of subchambers are arranged in the metal shell, a filtering unit is arranged in each subchamber, each filtering unit at least comprises an inductance component and a capacitance component, the inductance component comprises an annular inductor, a metal slip ring and a movable metal rod, two sides of a T-shaped end of the movable metal rod are respectively contacted with the inner wall of the metal slip ring and corresponding enamelled coils on the annular inductor and can circumferentially slide, and the capacitance component comprises a plurality of capacitors and metal sockets. The invention has good electromagnetic shielding effect, is convenient to implement and reduces the weight, volume and cost of the product, can adjust the inductance value only by sliding the movable metal rod during tuning, can adjust the capacitance value only by increasing or decreasing the capacitance, can realize the purposes of convenient, quick and efficient tuning, improves the adaptability and the universality of the product and reduces the application cost.

title_en: Intelligent optimization method for network appointment vehicle image recognition system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent optimization method of a network bus image recognition system, which relates to the technical field of image recognition system optimization, and is characterized in that the optimization system is used for acquiring video streams of all auxiliary driving cameras at regular time, dividing the video streams into a plurality of video frames, analyzing the plurality of video frames through an image analysis model, outputting management assignment for each auxiliary driving camera, carrying out abnormal grading treatment on the auxiliary driving cameras according to the comparison result of the management assignment and a gradient management threshold value, dividing the auxiliary driving cameras with abnormality into a first-stage abnormality set and a second-stage abnormality set respectively, restarting the auxiliary driving cameras in the first-stage abnormality set, continuing monitoring, closing the auxiliary driving cameras in the second-stage abnormality set, and sending a control result to a driver. According to the optimization method, whether the future use of the auxiliary driving camera is faulty or not is predicted by analyzing the video stream, and corresponding optimization management is performed when the auxiliary driving camera is predicted to be abnormal, so that the intelligent degree is high.

title_en: Cable connector assembly of high-speed signal relay scheme and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cable connector assembly of a high-speed signal relay scheme and a manufacturing method thereof, and relates to the field of cable connectors. In the invention, RETIMER signal transmission chips are adopted for relay transmission, RETIMER chips can reshape input signals and restore the input signals to original waveforms, so that the quality and stability of the signals are improved, the link attenuation compensation exceeding 5M length can be satisfied, the signal integrity transmission is realized, meanwhile, the cost of signal connector components is reduced due to the reduction of the number of chips, the signal connector components are conveniently used in batches in the circuit laying process, the problem of high circuit laying cost is solved, and the link transmission cost is reduced; signal wires and electronic wires in the connector assembly are respectively arranged on two sides of the PCB, so that heat is dispersed during operation of the signal connector assembly, rapid heat dissipation and temperature reduction of the connector assembly are facilitated, the heat generated by the connector assembly is prevented from affecting the stability of signal transmission, and normal operation of the connector assembly is guaranteed.

title_en: Display substrate, driving method thereof and display device
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a display substrate, a driving method thereof, and a display device. The display substrate includes: a substrate base plate, and a plurality of repeating units and a plurality of data lines arranged on the substrate base plate, wherein the plurality of repeating units are divided into a plurality of repeating unit columns; each repeating unit includes a plurality of sub-pixels including a sub-pixel driving circuit including a data writing transistor, a writing control transistor, and a driving transistor; the first pole of the data writing transistor is coupled with the corresponding data line, the second pole of the data writing transistor is coupled with the first pole of the writing control transistor, and the second pole of the writing control transistor is coupled with the grid electrode of the driving transistor; the display substrate further includes: a plurality of control zones and a plurality of zone control lines; the control zone includes at least one column of repeating units; the partition control lines are respectively coupled with the gates of the write control transistors included in each of the repeated unit columns in the corresponding control region.

title_en: PCB frame, PCB board and manufacturing method of PCB board
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PCB frame, a PCB board and a manufacturing method of the PCB board, wherein the PCB frame comprises: the plate body is provided with at least one accommodating groove; at least one embedded module, at least one embedded module is arranged in at least one containing groove and is connected with the plate body; wherein, the embedding module includes: the power chip is attached to the copper-clad substrate and is electrically connected with the copper-clad substrate, and at least two radiators are arranged on two sides of the embedded module. The embedded module and the board body form a whole, so that the integration level of the PCB is improved; the heat radiator is arranged on the two sides of the embedded module, so that the area of a heat radiation area of the power chip can be increased, and the heat radiation capacity of the power chip is improved.

title_en: Intelligent campus security management method and system based on face recognition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of campus management, in particular to a smart campus security management method and system based on face recognition, comprising the following steps: acquiring real-time video streams of all areas in a campus; preprocessing a video stream; detecting and identifying the human face in the preprocessed video frame by using a deep learning algorithm; the face information of students and teaching staff is input into a storage library in advance, and the detection and identification results in the step S3 are input into the storage library for comparison; if an unauthorized person is detected, immediately triggering an alarm and recording related information; continuously analyzing the behavior track of the authorized personnel to identify an abnormal track; aiming at the problem of differential recognition, reconstructing a paravirtual three-dimensional face by using a three-dimensional face reconstruction technology through partial face information, and comparing the reconstructed paravirtual three-dimensional face with a storage library. According to the method, the behavior track analysis is continuously carried out on authorized personnel, so that abnormal behaviors are found and responded in time, and the security protection capability of the campus is further enhanced.

title_en: Flexible circuit board connector welding method, circuit board assembly and flexible circuit board
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of welding processing of flexible circuit boards, and provides a flexible circuit board connector welding method, a circuit board assembly and a flexible circuit board, wherein the flexible circuit board connector welding method comprises the following steps: providing a substrate, wherein the substrate comprises a base material and a copper foil, and through holes are etched on the copper foil; covering an insulating film on one side of the copper foil, which is back to the base material, wherein a window is arranged at the position of the insulating film corresponding to the through hole, so that a bonding pad is formed at the window of the copper foil; processing a plurality of slits which are communicated with each other at the positions corresponding to the through holes on the substrate, wherein the slits are arranged at intervals along the circumferential direction of the through holes; pins of the connector are inserted into the through holes through a plurality of slits, and are welded on the bonding pads in a selective wave soldering mode. In the welding method of the flexible circuit board connector, after the pins are inserted into the kerfs, the substrate parts between two adjacent kerfs are stressed downwards and are clung to the pins so as to seal the annular gap surrounded by the pins and the through holes, and therefore soldering flux is not easy to scatter on the non-welding surface of the flexible circuit board.

title_en: Remote sensing control's multi-functional surveying instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing controlled multifunctional surveying instrument, which belongs to the technical field of surveying instruments and comprises a sliding component, wherein a remote sensing device is arranged on one side of the sliding component, a platform is arranged above the sliding component, a power supply component is arranged above the platform, the surveying component is arranged above the power supply component, a plurality of support leg components are arranged below the sliding component, the platform is connected with the power supply component through a protection buffer device, and the sliding component is connected with the support leg components through auxiliary fixing devices; according to the invention, the protection buffer device is arranged, so that the surveying instrument can protect structures such as the surveying assembly and the like to a certain extent when the surveying instrument is needed, the possibility of accidental damage of the structures such as the surveying assembly and the like is reduced, in addition, the surveying instrument can carry out auxiliary illumination through the illuminating lamp when the surveying instrument is needed, and the working capacity of the surveying instrument is further improved.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: According to one aspect of the present disclosure, a display device includes: a display unit including a display panel and a rear cover supporting a rear surface of the display panel; an outer drum configured to wind or unwind the display unit and having a spiral groove provided on an inner circumferential surface; an inner drum accommodated in the outer drum and having a straight groove provided on an outer circumferential surface; a plurality of conductive balls disposed between the outer drum and the inner drum and configured to move along the spiral groove when the display unit is wound or unwound; and a drum connecting unit linking the rotations of the outer drum and the inner drum to each other.

title_en: Video encoding/decoding method and apparatus for constructing merge candidate list by generating paired merge candidates
abstract_en: A video encoding/decoding method and apparatus are provided. The video decoding method according to the present invention may include the steps of: generating one or more spatial merging candidates; generating a time merging candidate; generating one or more history-based merge candidates; generating a first merge candidate list based on the one or more spatial merge candidates, the temporal merge candidate, and the one or more history-based merge candidates; generating one or more paired average merge candidates if all merge candidates in the first merge candidate list are not filled; generating a second merge candidate list based on the one or more paired average merge candidates and the first merge candidate list; and generating a prediction block of the current block based on the second merge candidate list.

title_en: Strip lamp membrane and lamp house installation design structure of easy change
abstract_en: The invention discloses an easy-to-replace strip-shaped lamp film and lamp box installation design structure, which comprises: the lamp is assembled in the first cavity of the lamp box bracket, and a light transmission port is formed in the bottom of the lamp box bracket; the first strip-shaped lamp film and the second strip-shaped lamp film are adhered to the bottom surface of the lamp box bracket at intervals in a staggered layer; the outer side of the connecting piece is connected with the end part of the strip-shaped lamp film, and the connecting piece is inserted into the clamping groove on the side surface of the lamp box bracket in a sliding manner; an elastic pull rope is arranged on the inner side of the sleeve, the outer ends are connected and connected the binding post is arranged on the inner side of the piece; and the pre-tightening structure pre-tightens the elastic pull rope. The strip-shaped lamp films are distributed in a staggered mode at intervals, so that the replacement of the partial lamp films is facilitated when the partial lamp films are obviously deformed, and the use cost of the lamp films is reduced; the connecting piece is connected to the lamp box support in a sliding mode, the lamp film and the elastic pull rope are detachably connected, the elastic pull rope is connected with the pre-tightening structure, the full tensioning pre-tightening effect on the strip-shaped lamp film is achieved, the strip-shaped lamp film is guaranteed to be in a tightening state all the time, and therefore stable light transmission and isolation effects are achieved.

title_en: Method of decoding image, method of encoding image, and method of transmitting bit stream generated by encoding method
abstract_en: A method of decoding an image, a method of encoding an image, and a method of transmitting a bitstream generated by the encoding method are disclosed. The method for decoding the image includes: decoding residual coefficients of a current block in an image from a bitstream; performing inverse quantization on the residual coefficient by using the quantization parameter; and reconstructing residual samples of the current block by performing inverse transform on the inverse quantized residual coefficients, wherein the inverse transform is performed by a first inverse transform and a second inverse transform, the second inverse transform being performed before the first inverse transform, wherein the second inverse transform is applied only to a partial region of the current block, and wherein the quantization parameter is derived based on a quantization parameter predictor of the residual block, the quantization parameter predictor being derived based on quantization parameters of neighboring blocks adjacent to the residual block.

title_en: Partition heat-insulation combined type sales counter
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of sales counter, in particular to a partition heat-preservation combined sales counter, which comprises a counter body, wherein the rear end of the counter body is connected with a compressor module for refrigerating, one side of the counter body is connected with a control console, the front end of the control console is connected with a touch screen and a coin-feed table, the counter body is formed by splicing a plurality of unit cabinets, the front end of the compressor module is connected with a plurality of refrigerant pipes for transmitting refrigerants, a plurality of kinds of objects are placed into a storage assembly of the unit cabinets for storage through the arrangement of the unit cabinets, a plurality of independent compressors are arranged in the compressor module, and are respectively connected with different refrigerant pipes, so that the temperature of the plurality of refrigerant pipes can be freely adjusted, different commodities such as meat or ice sticks needing to be refrigerated can be stored in different unit cabinets, or vegetables and cold drinks needing to be kept at more than zero degrees in different temperature environments, and the application range of the device is effectively improved.

title_en: High-flame-retardance expanded graphite-containing polymer foam wave-absorbing material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-flame-retardance expanded graphite-containing polymer foam wave-absorbing material and a preparation method thereof, which belong to the technical field of wave-absorbing materials, wherein the wave-absorbing material comprises, by volume, 0-90 parts of conductive polymer foam particles and 10-100 parts of expanded graphite-containing composite resin foam particles; the expanded graphite-containing composite resin foam particles comprise 30-95 parts of conductive polymer foam particles and 5-70 parts of coating paint. The phosphorus flame retardant and the expanded graphite have a synergistic effect on the polymer foam wave absorbing material, the expanded graphite is coated on the surface of the conductive polymer foam particles in the form of an adhesive to obtain the expanded graphite-containing composite resin foam particles, the expanded graphite-containing composite resin foam particles and the conductive polymer foam particles are mixed according to a certain proportion and molded into the wave absorbing material, and the problem that the oxygen index of the polymer foam wave absorbing material for electromagnetic wave darkrooms is required to be more than 28, particularly the oxygen index is required to be more than 32, and 1, 2 and 3 indexes meeting NRL Report8093 standard are met is solved.

title_en: Automatic detection system for law enforcement personnel behavior normalization
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic detection system for behavior normalization of law enforcement officers, which comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module and an alarm module; the system architecture is designed to integrate and process abnormal limb conflict data as a core, and comprises data acquisition, storage, verification analysis and data sharing, wherein Talcnd, APACHE NIF and Kafka are adopted for data acquisition, the data source is camera flow, manual addition is adopted, the data sharing comprises training and analysis, and REDIS MYSQL is adopted for data storage; the data acquisition uses various flexible and efficient methods to intensively transmit prescription data captured by cameras of a plurality of monitoring rooms to the management platform; the shared service layer performs careful timing task scheduling planning according to specific service requirements and data updating periods; compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages that: the intelligent law enforcement monitoring system can collect data in the law enforcement process in real time, identify irregular law enforcement behaviors through an intelligent analysis algorithm, and provide corresponding alarming and recording functions.

title_en: Camera module and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a camera module and electronic equipment, which comprises a lens, wherein the lens comprises a light inlet side and a light outlet side which are oppositely arranged; the light reflecting piece is arranged on the light inlet side and is used for reflecting light rays incident to the light reflecting piece to the lens; the photosensitive assembly is movably arranged on the light emitting side and can convert the acquired optical signals into electric signals; and a driving mechanism for driving the photosensitive assembly to move along a direction perpendicular to the optical axis of the lens. The driving mechanism drives the photosensitive component to move along the direction perpendicular to the optical axis of the lens, so that the optical anti-shake function can be realized.
