The photosensitive assembly is smaller in size and weight than the light reflecting member, and thus, requires less power to move by driving the photosensitive assembly than by driving the light reflecting member. In addition, because the power consumption is smaller, the size of the driving mechanism can be correspondingly reduced, and the size of the camera module can be further reduced.

title_en: Bidirectional inverter circuit and bidirectional inverter circuit board
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bidirectional inverter circuit boards, and discloses a bidirectional inverter circuit and a bidirectional inverter circuit board, comprising a protective shell, wherein a driving mechanism is arranged on the outer side of the protective shell and comprises a protective box, a cover plate, a dust cover, a driving motor and a driving shaft, the protection box is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the protection shell, the cover plate is clamped and arranged on the top of the protection box, the dust cover is arranged on the surface of the cover plate, and the driving motor is arranged in the inner cavity of the protection box. According to the bidirectional inverter circuit and the bidirectional inverter circuit board, through the design of the heat dissipation mechanism, the heat dissipation performance of the bidirectional inverter circuit board can be effectively improved, the working temperature is reduced, the stability and the reliability of equipment are improved, the action of the heat dissipation fan can accelerate the flow of air, heat generated in the circuit board is effectively taken away, and the equipment can keep a lower temperature when in high-load working.

title_en: Anti-drop equipment for electronic component installation
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of anti-falling devices, and discloses anti-falling equipment for mounting electronic components, which aims to solve the problem that the electronic components in a shell are damaged due to collision caused by falling of the shell. According to the application, through the arrangement of the contact piece and the fixed block, after the screw is screwed, the contact piece is pressed on the screw head groove of the screw, so that the contact piece is partially sunk into the screw head groove, and then the contact piece is fixed at the current position through the fixed block, and through the actions, the screw is further rotated and limited, the rotation action of the screw subjected to vibration is prevented, and the probability of loosening the screw is reduced.

title_en: CMOS image sensor chip packaging structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electrical elements, in particular to a CMOS image sensor chip packaging structure, which comprises a CMOS image sensor chip and a packaging assembly, wherein the packaging assembly comprises a substrate, a plurality of positioning blocks and two limiting parts; the limiting part comprises a side seat, a first spring, a connecting block and a packaging shell; when the CMOS image sensor chip is packaged, the CMOS image sensor chip is placed on a substrate, the packaging shell moves to the side edge of the CMOS image sensor chip under the drive of the first spring, and the positions of the CMOS image sensor chip are limited and fixed by utilizing a plurality of positioning blocks and two packaging shells; when the CMOS image sensor chip needs to be disassembled, the limit of the CMOS image sensor chip can be relieved by pulling the two packaging shells away from the CMOS image sensor chip, and then the CMOS image sensor chip can be taken down from the substrate, so that the CMOS image sensor chip can be conveniently disassembled and replaced after being packaged.

title_en: Self-triggering liquid-gas phase change heat dissipation module
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-triggering liquid-gas phase-change heat dissipation module, which relates to the field of heat dissipation of missile-borne electronic equipment and comprises a shell, a self-triggering material and a phase-change material, wherein a phase-change material cavity is formed in the shell, the phase-change material is positioned in the phase-change material cavity, an exhaust port is formed in the outer wall of the shell, the exhaust port is communicated with the phase-change material cavity through a self-triggering channel, the self-triggering material is blocked in the self-triggering channel, the liquefaction temperature of the self-triggering material is higher than the vaporization temperature of the phase-change material, and the phase-change material is in a liquid state at normal temperature. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the self-triggering function of long-time quick thermal response capability and liquid-gas phase change heat dissipation in the phase change heat dissipation process is realized, the limit heat dissipation capability in the phase change process is improved, and the long-time quick thermal response requirement of the high-power phase change heat dissipation module is ensured.

title_en: Water level measuring equipment for water source
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of geological exploration, and particularly discloses water level measuring equipment for a water source area, which comprises a moving vehicle, wherein a first paying-off mechanism is arranged at the top of the moving vehicle, a control console is fixedly connected to the top of the moving vehicle through a supporting frame, the water level measuring equipment also comprises an adjusting arm, the adjusting arm is arranged at the top of the moving vehicle, an adjusting wheel group is arranged at one end of the adjusting arm, a positioning plate is fixedly connected to the bottom of one end of the adjusting arm, a reflecting surface is arranged at the bottom of the positioning plate, a first pull rope is wound between the first paying-off mechanism and the adjusting wheel group, a positioning sleeve is sleeved outside the first pull rope in a penetrating mode and fixedly connected with the first pull rope, and a distance measuring assembly is arranged at one end, far away from the first paying-off mechanism, of the first pull rope.

title_en: Vibration device and imaging device
abstract_en: The vibration device of the present disclosure includes: a light transmitting body; a vibrator that supports the light-transmitting body; a piezoelectric element disposed on the vibrator to vibrate the vibrator; and a1 st metal body disposed in a compressed state between the light-transmitting body and a member supporting the light-transmitting body, the Young's modulus being smaller than the Young's modulus of the light-transmitting body and the member supporting the light-transmitting body.

title_en: Display structure
abstract_en: The present invention provides a display structure comprising: the anti-reflection layer comprises a plurality of layers of media with refractive index gradient, the refractive index of the plurality of layers of media is changed from top to bottom, the K value of the plurality of layers of media is smaller than 0.5, and the total thickness and the equivalent refractive index of the anti-reflection layer meet certain conditions in the three primary colors of red, green and blue, so that the upper electric field and the lower electric field of the position of the phase change layer below the anti-reflection layer are 0; the optical loss of the used phase change material is smaller than a first preset threshold value, the refractive index of the used phase change material is larger than a second preset threshold value, and the phase change layer is positioned below the anti-reflection layer; a first metal layer, which is a lossy metal providing K value compensation, and is positioned below the phase change layer; the second metal layer is used for forming an FP cavity and is positioned below the first metal layer; and the dielectric layer is positioned below the second metal layer. The invention realizes the reflective phase change display structure with high reflectivity, high color saturation, angle insensitivity, dynamic adjustability and simple structure.

title_en: Processing method for improving extrusion deformation of rigid curved printed board
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing method for improving extrusion deformation of a rigid curved printed board, which belongs to the technical field of rigid curved printed circuit board processing, and comprises the following steps: preparing a flexible female die according to the temperature and pressure required by pressing the printed board; manufacturing a rigid female die according to the shape of the lower end surface of the flexible female die, and embedding the flexible female die into the rigid female die; manufacturing a male die according to the shape of the upper end surface of the flexible female die; and placing the planar printed board between the rigid female die and the male die, and applying required temperature and pressure to enable the planar printed board to be thermally deformed into a curved printed board. The whole pressing structure is unchanged, the curved surface forming precision is guaranteed, and meanwhile, a containing space is provided for the extruded printed board, so that the extruded printed board is effectively prevented from being deformed.

title_en: Video recording implementation method based on A0V camera
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of video recording methods of AOV cameras, and discloses a video recording implementation method based on an A0V camera, which comprises a system terminal, a detection module, a network broadband detection module, an adjustment module, a frame rate adjustment playback module, a management module, a file list maintenance and storage module, a video file storage and triggering module, a video stream real-time monitoring module, an alarm and identification module and a triggering module alarm video file identification module. The video state is changed without cutting files, so that fragmented files can be reduced, and video playback and playing are smoother.

title_en: Portable electric power communication emergency power supply
abstract_en: The invention discloses the technical field of power communication emergency power supplies, in particular to a portable power communication emergency power supply, which comprises an emergency power supply mechanism, a branching switching mechanism arranged on the emergency power supply mechanism and a line in-out broken protection mechanism arranged on the branching switching mechanism. Through setting up the business turn over line absolutely and protect the mechanism in quick-assembling and forming the passageway between input line and output line and emergency power source cabinet to set up the separated time switching mechanism between business turn over line absolutely protect the mechanism and emergency power source cabinet, utilize the separated time switching mechanism to carry out the switching towards the component in the emergency power source cabinet with the electric current of input, after rising and emergency power source cabinet output current suddenly increases because of ambient temperature, the protective tube of rated protection alright direct disconnection with the electric current, and outwards pop out by tripping operation outage subassembly in the moment of breaking power supply, the high frequency switch in the emergency power source cabinet can obtain effective protection this moment, and lead to the temperature that the circuit climbed because of the electric current suddenly increases can obtain effective control.

title_en: High-frequency circuit board structure and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-frequency circuit board structure and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the high-frequency circuit board structure comprises a high-frequency substrate, and the high-frequency circuit board structure comprises: the lower plate surface of the high-frequency substrate is provided with at least one first blind hole, and a first blind hole electroplated layer is formed by electroplating the first blind hole; the upper plate surface of the high-frequency substrate is provided with second blind holes corresponding to the first blind holes, and a second blind hole electroplated layer is formed by electroplating the second blind holes; the second blind hole and the first blind hole are complementary in depth; the second blind hole electroplated layer is contacted with the first blind hole electroplated layer, so that the first blind hole and the second blind hole form conductive connection; the depth of the first blind hole is 20-80% of the thickness of the high-frequency substrate material, the problem of risk of separation reliability of the blind holes is solved, meanwhile, the combined area of the blind holes is increased, and the reliability of blind hole connection is improved.

title_en: Silicon-based liquid crystal display device and waterproof sealing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a silicon-based liquid crystal display device and a waterproof sealing method thereof, comprising a chip substrate, a silicon-based liquid crystal display chip and a shell, wherein the silicon-based liquid crystal display chip is arranged on the chip substrate, the chip substrate is provided with an internal circuit electrically connected with the silicon-based liquid crystal display chip, and the internal circuit of the chip substrate is electrically connected with an external flat cable; the shell comprises a lower shell and an upper shell which are spliced up and down, the lower shell is provided with a mounting groove, the upper shell is provided with a containing groove communicated with the mounting groove, the upper wall of the containing groove is transparent, and a wire passing hole is arranged between the upper shell and the lower shell; the chip substrate is arranged in the mounting groove, the silicon-based liquid crystal display chip is positioned in the accommodating groove, the external flat cable penetrates through the wire through hole, the upper shell is in sealing connection with the lower shell, and the external flat cable is sealed with the upper shell and the lower shell through glue. The silicon-based liquid crystal display device provided by the invention can improve the waterproof performance to meet the requirements of vehicle regulations, and simultaneously ensures that the external flat cable is convenient to set during waterproof sealing so as to facilitate mass production.

title_en: Encoder and decoder, encoding method and decoding method for complexity processing of flexible size picture partitions
abstract_en: Provided are an encoder and decoder, an encoding method and a decoding method for complexity processing of flexible size picture segmentation. Disclosed is a hardware apparatus for video decoding configured to: decoding a first flag for a slice of a current picture from a data stream, the first flag indicating whether to predict a block of the slice based only on reconstructed samples of the current picture; decoding a second flag from the data stream in response to the first flag indicating that prediction is based only on reconstructed samples of the current picture, the second flag indicating whether to predict the current block by copying samples of a reference block from the reconstructed samples of the current picture; determining, in response to the second flag indicating prediction by copying samples of the reference block from reconstructed samples of the current picture, prediction of the current block by copying samples from the reference block; and reconstructing the current block based on the prediction of the current block and the prediction residual decoded from the data stream. Corresponding methods and non-transitory digital storage media are also provided.

title_en: Display control method, control device and display system of LED link
abstract_en: The application provides a display control method, a control device and a display system of an LED link, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring display modes of a plurality of cascaded LED lamp beads in each LED link; the display mode is used for defining the display state of each LED lamp bead in one LED link; assigning a bit for driving each lamp bead based on the display mode to obtain a display control signal of each LED lamp bead in the LED link; and sending each display control signal to the driving chip of the corresponding LED lamp bead in the LED link at one time. The application supports the display control of the multi-path LED links, and reduces the complexity and hardware cost of the system. In addition, the serial port of the singlechip can automatically transmit display control signals to the LED link by adopting a first-in first-out mode or a direct memory access mode, so that the full utilization of singlechip resources is realized. Meanwhile, microsecond display control can be realized, the time delay is low, and the working efficiency is remarkably improved.

title_en: Processing method of Hall switch circuit board
abstract_en: The application relates to a processing method of a Hall switch circuit board, which comprises the following steps: cutting the prepreg, namely the PP sheet, into the same size as the substrate; drilling a prefabricated hole on the PP working piece; fusing and fixing a target graph on the PP working piece; copper foil is covered on the PP working piece up and down, and a copper-clad substrate is pressed; identifying a hot-melt target pattern on the copper-clad substrate, drilling a positioning hole, and then carrying out edge fishing and milling to obtain the size of the substrate; positioning by using a positioning hole, adopting an LDI laser direct imaging exposure machine to finish the inner layer circuit pattern manufacturing, and monitoring and confirming the alignment precision of the prefabricated hole of the Hall part after etching; fixing the core plate and the drilled PP working piece by hot riveting, and pressing by a press; and carrying out numerical control drilling production on the semi-finished plate. The processing method can effectively improve the CAF resistance of the circuit board with the Hall switch components, improve the utilization rate of the substrate material and reduce the application cost of the material.

title_en: Digital audio interface based on RISC-V chip
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a digital audio interface based on a RISC-V chip. The digital audio interface based on the RISC-V chip is characterized in that an FM radio and a microphone are respectively connected to the RISC-V chip, and the RISC-V chip outputs audio information to a PWM-DAC conversion module in a pulse width modulation signal PWM mode through the digital interface; after being converted into corresponding analog conversion signals DAC by the PWM-DAC conversion module, the signals are connected to the inverting input end of the sound effect power amplification module, and after being amplified, the signals are output through the loudspeaker module; the RISC-V chip is also connected with an FM key, and the FM key is used for sending a control signal to the RISC-V chip, turning on or off an FM radio and performing frequency modulation and volume setting. The digital audio interface based on the RISC-V chip has simple design circuit, is convenient to transplant, only needs to process digital signals by the main chip, is applied to scenes with low tone quality requirements, and can meet different customer requirements.

title_en: Circuit board copper deposition processing device and processing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a circuit board copper deposition processing device and a processing method, which belong to the technical field of circuit board copper deposition processing, and comprise a base, wherein the inner wall of the base is fixedly connected with a support column, and the circuit board copper deposition processing device further comprises: the liquid inlet box is fixedly connected to the top wall of the support column. According to the invention, the copper depositing boxes are mutually nested and installed through the arrangement of the sealing clamping blocks and the sealing clamping holes, and the copper depositing boxes are connected with the concave head bolts in a reinforcing manner through the top connecting blocks and the bottom connecting blocks, so that the number of the copper depositing boxes can be added freely according to requirements, the L-shaped plates are connected and added freely through the long screw rods, the installation frame and the folding filter plates can be detached freely, the equipment can be moved freely through the universal wheels, the equipment can be detached and moved, the movable design is realized, most of the use requirements of the existing scene are met, the installation is convenient, the independent detachment and replacement can be carried out when the equipment is damaged, the use cost is reduced, and the problems that the copper depositing device of the circuit board is inconvenient to detach and move and the installation are troublesome in the prior art are solved.

title_en: Manufacturing method of automobile electronic module unit and electronic module unit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automobile manufacturing, in particular to a manufacturing method of an automobile electronic module unit and the electronic module unit, which are characterized in that PP glass fiber fabric prepreg is paved according to a paving table and is processed into a material plate, the material plate is arranged on a clamp, the material plate is heated and softened, the softened material plate and the clamp are arranged in a horizontal injection molding machine, a mold is locked to enable the material plate to be deformed into a bracket, PP-GF40 is synchronously injected into the horizontal injection molding machine, reinforcing ribs are formed on the surface of the bracket in an injection molding mode, the formed bracket is taken out, cooled and shaped, and an electronic module is arranged at a designated position of the bracket to form the electronic module unit. According to the method, the hot pressing process and the injection molding process are synchronously carried out, the processing period is shortened, the processing efficiency is improved, and meanwhile, the material plate is fixed by the spring clamp during hot pressing injection molding, so that wrinkles are reduced.

title_en: Display module and display device
abstract_en: The application relates to a display module and a display device. The display module includes: the display panel comprises a display part, a bending part and a binding part which are sequentially connected; the display part is provided with a light emitting side and a backlight side which are oppositely arranged; the bending part can bend to bend the binding part to the backlight side of the display part; the light-transmitting layer is positioned on the light-emitting side of the display part and is bent and extended to the binding part along the bending part; wherein, the light-transmitting layer at the bending part is provided with a plurality of groove structures. Based on the scheme, the display panel can be prevented from being damaged by the protruding structure, the display panel can be prevented from being damaged in the process of bending the display module, the bending part of the display panel is protected through the light-transmitting layer, and the number and the duration of the manufacturing process are shortened.

title_en: Manufacturing method of embedded circuit board and embedded circuit board
abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing method of an embedded circuit board and the embedded circuit board in the technical field of circuit boards, and aims to solve the problems that in the prior art, chips are of a single type, different requirements generated by power improvement cannot be met economically, the size of the chips is smaller and smaller along with the improvement of the performance requirements of semiconductors, and bare chips are difficult to be directly embedded into the circuit board, so that the actual processing of the circuit board is affected. The invention provides the idea of simultaneously embedding various packaging devices into product development, and realizes the possibility of packaging the hybrid power module, thereby accurately meeting the requirements of different powers and realizing the economical efficiency of packaging; according to the invention, the bare chip is embedded into the first prepreg in advance, the first device is obtained through processing, the embedding work of the bare chip is realized through embedding the first device, the influence of undersize of the bare chip on the actual processing of the circuit board is reduced, and the practicability of the circuit board is ensured.

title_en: Fire-resistant nameplate that burns
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire-resistant nameplate which comprises a stainless steel nameplate piece, wherein the front surface of the stainless steel nameplate piece is provided with character information through laser, the front surface or all surfaces of the stainless steel nameplate piece are coated with fire-resistant layers, the processing technology comprises the following steps of (1) cutting the stainless steel nameplate piece with a set size on the stainless steel plate piece, deburring, (2) laser engraving the stainless steel nameplate piece, (3) ultrasonic cleaning, drying and corona treatment, (4) spraying by adopting a fire-resistant material, (5) heating and solidifying, wherein the fire-resistant material comprises the following components in parts by weight of ceramic resin 90 parts, wetting agent 0.2-0.5 part, leveling agent 0.2-0.5 part and absolute alcohol 10 part. The nameplate is fire-resistant, and when a fire disaster occurs, the information on the nameplate is not easy to burn, so that convenience is brought to later analysis of fire disaster causes and tracing.

title_en: Stripe camera with self-detection function and self-detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a stripe camera with a self-detection function and a self-detection method thereof, relates to the technical field of stripe camera detection methods, and aims to rapidly judge the performance of a camera through a convenient detection system, wherein a camera lens and a self-detection module are arranged at the front end of a camera case; the synchronous trigger signal output connector is used for outputting a trigger signal for the long pulse light source module, an optical imaging lens is arranged at the front end of the camera case, a slit is arranged at the center position of the front end of the optical imaging lens, the front end of the slit is clung to a detachable resolution plate, the long pulse light source module is arranged above the middle section position of the optical imaging lens, an input optical module is arranged at the front end of the optical imaging lens, an optical fiber connector is arranged at the center position of the front end of the input optical module, a collimation module is arranged at the rear end of the optical fiber connector, and an output interface of the long pulse light source module is connected with the optical fiber connector through optical fibers. The invention has the advantages of convenient detection of camera performance and simple structure.

title_en: Display screen
abstract_en: The invention discloses a display screen, which comprises a hollow base, wherein the base is fixedly arranged in the ground, the top wall of the base is fixedly connected with a sliding sleeve in a penetrating manner, the sliding sleeve is internally and hermetically connected with a sliding block, the upper surface of the sliding block is fixedly connected with a fixed frame, the inner wall of the fixed frame is fixedly connected with the display screen, an interaction mechanism is arranged in the base, the interaction mechanism comprises a connecting rod, the connecting rod is rotatably connected with the inner side wall of the base through a bearing, the connecting rod is fixedly connected with a lever plate in a penetrating manner, the top wall of the base is provided with a through hole, a T-shaped floor tile is connected in a sliding manner in the through hole, the lower surface of the T-shaped floor tile abuts against the upper surface of the lever plate, and a plurality of jacking columns are connected in a penetrating manner. The display screen has the advantages that the display screen has better advertisement display effect, attracts pedestrians to pay attention, can automatically clean, and is more energy-saving.

title_en: Display module and display device
abstract_en: The application discloses a display module and a display device, wherein the display module comprises a bending area, the display module further comprises a display panel, a supporting piece and an elastic body, the supporting piece is arranged on a backlight surface of the display panel and used for supporting the display panel, and the elastic body is arranged on one side, away from the display panel, of the supporting piece and is positioned in the bending area. According to the application, the elastic body is arranged in the bending area, so that the display module can play a role in buffering when falling and being impacted, the display panel is prevented from being damaged, and in addition, the elastic body supports the bending area in the unfolding state of the display module, so that the generation of folds is reduced or even avoided.

title_en: Optical compensation device and method for display panel
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical compensation device and method of a display panel. The optical compensation device of the display panel comprises a bearing platform, a first measuring unit, a second measuring unit, a first data processing unit and a second data processing unit, wherein the bearing platform is used for bearing the display panel, the first measuring unit is used for acquiring first brightness data when the display panel displays a preset picture under a front view angle, the second measuring unit is used for acquiring image data when the display panel displays the preset picture under the front view angle, the first data processing unit is connected with the first measuring unit and used for receiving the first brightness data and generating first brightness compensation data according to the first brightness data to carry out brightness compensation, the second data processing unit is connected with the second measuring unit and used for receiving the image data and generating pixel-level brightness compensation data according to the image data to carry out pixel brightness compensation, and the first measuring unit and the second measuring unit are started to work simultaneously so as to compensate the brightness of the whole surface brightness of the display panel and brightness between pixels at the same time, and the compensation cost is reduced.

title_en: Circuit board of automobile steering lamp controller
abstract_en: The invention discloses a circuit board of an automobile steering lamp controller, which relates to the technical field of circuit boards of controllers and comprises a mounting foot plate, wherein supporting feet are symmetrically arranged at the left end and the right end of the top of the mounting foot plate, a shielding cover is arranged at the top of the supporting feet, a protection frame body is arranged at the side of the shielding cover, the optimal electromagnetic shielding effect is realized by dynamically adjusting the distance between a carbon nano tube film shielding plate and a circuit board structure according to the electromagnetic interference condition under the cooperation of a dynamic electromagnetic shielding assembly, and heat is quickly transferred from a semiconductor radiating fin to a small liquid cooling structure under the cooperation of the dynamic temperature regulating assembly.

title_en: Forestation planting system of three north protection forests
abstract_en: The invention provides a forestation planting system of three north protection forests, which relates to the technical field of forestation planting and comprises a forestation planting area, wherein the forestation planting area is provided with planting pits with plant row spacing of 3 multiplied by 3m, an irrigation canal is longitudinally designed and supplied to the forestation planting area, and a water source irrigation pipe is arranged on the irrigation canal. The water source link is carried at the water source irrigation pipe, can carry out timely supply treatment to break the grafting between two water source irrigation pipes, two sealed spacing plugs of water source irrigation pipe grafting position contact then carry out the transportation that resets the inside water source of processing blocking the water source irrigation pipe through reset spring piece respectively, can also avoid the inside water source of water source irrigation pipe to overflow and cause extravagant. The planting method solves the problems that the existing planting method of the three-north protective forest mainly depends on manual work, has low efficiency, is limited by factors such as topography, climate and the like, is difficult to realize large-scale and high-efficiency planting, and has limitation in irrigating sapling.

title_en: Vehicle screen adjusting method and device and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of vehicle control, and provides a method and equipment for adjusting a vehicle screen, and a vehicle, wherein the vehicle screen comprises a first screen and a second screen which are being displayed; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a current first refresh rate of a first screen, controlling the refresh rate of the first screen to be adjusted to be a target refresh rate, comparing the first refresh rate with the target refresh rate to obtain a first comparison result, and adjusting the refresh rate of a second screen according to the first comparison result. The refresh rate of the second screen is adjusted according to the first comparison result, the problem that the refresh rate of the second screen is directly linked with the refresh rate of the first screen to cause damage to vehicle hardware when the vehicle hardware is lifted simultaneously is avoided, the damage to the vehicle hardware is reduced while the user requirement is met, and the service life of the vehicle hardware is prolonged.

title_en: Single-hole existing tunnel reconstruction and extension permanent temporary combination structure
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a single-hole existing tunnel reconstruction and extension permanent temporary combination structure, and relates to the field of tunnel construction. The single-hole existing tunnel reconstruction and extension permanent temporary combination structure comprises a fixing frame, wherein one side of the fixing frame is fixedly connected with an existing tunnel support frame, the other side of the fixing frame is fixedly connected with a newly-built tunnel support frame matched with the existing tunnel support frame, the inner cavity of the fixing frame is fixedly connected with a sealing frame, and an air supply assembly, a conveying assembly and a reinforcing assembly matched with the existing tunnel support frame and the newly-built tunnel support frame are respectively arranged in the inner cavity of the fixing frame. The single-tunnel existing tunnel reconstruction and extension permanent temporary connection structure has the advantages of being simple to operate, low in construction and disassembly difficulty, capable of realizing a flexible permanent temporary support conversion effect on an existing tunnel and a newly-built tunnel connection hole according to construction and traffic requirements, and capable of meeting traffic requirements of the existing tunnel or the newly-built tunnel so as to prevent traffic jam.

title_en: Control system and method for energy-saving liquid crystal display
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control system and a control method of an energy-saving liquid crystal display, which belong to the technical field of liquid crystal display control, wherein the control system of the energy-saving liquid crystal display comprises a photosensitive sensor module, a microcontroller module, a liquid crystal display and a driving chip module, wherein the photosensitive sensor module is used for detecting the external illumination intensity and outputting an analog electric signal, the analog electric signal is arranged at a specific position of a frame of the liquid crystal display so as to accurately sense the ambient light, the microcontroller module is connected with the photosensitive sensor module to receive the analog signal and convert the analog signal, a first brightness adjustment algorithm is operated, a control instruction is sent to a driving chip of the liquid crystal display according to the result, and the liquid crystal display and the driving chip module are used for adjusting a backlight source of the liquid crystal display according to the instruction of the microcontroller so as to realize multi-stage smooth adjustment of brightness. The invention has the advantages of improving the practicability and the energy utilization efficiency of the equipment, and solves the problem that the prior equipment cannot be intelligently adapted to different brightness under different illumination environments.

title_en: Machine room and control method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a machine room and a control method of the machine room, wherein the machine room comprises a machine room main body, a machine room bottom wall and a machine room control device, wherein the machine room main body is arranged on a peripheral board; the machine room air conditioner is arranged in the equipment accommodating space, the heat-insulating plate is arranged in the equipment accommodating space, a heat exchange cavity is formed between the heat-insulating plate and the peripheral plate, the heat exchange cavity is provided with a hot air inlet and a cold air outlet, the first adjusting plate can be arranged at the hot air inlet in an opening and closing manner, the second adjusting plate can be arranged at the cold air outlet in an opening and closing manner, the driving mechanism is in driving connection with the first adjusting plate and the second adjusting plate, the driving mechanism can open or close the hot air inlet, and the driving mechanism can open or close the cold air outlet. According to the technical scheme provided by the application, the problems that in the related art, the heat dissipated by the communication equipment is still discharged by the air conditioner due to the fact that the heat insulation and sealing performance of a machine room are good in winter, and energy waste is caused because the air conditioner still operates and refrigerates can be solved.

title_en: Preparation method and application of shape-controllable high-performance carbon wave-absorbing material
abstract_en: A preparation method and application of a shape-controllable high-performance carbon wave-absorbing material. The invention belongs to the technical field of wave-absorbing materials. The invention aims to solve the technical problems of unbalance between the impedance matching characteristic and the attenuation characteristic of the existing pure carbon absorbent and limited effective absorption band. The method comprises the steps of firstly, respectively dissolving melamine and cyanuric acid in deionized water or ethanol water under a heating condition, then, dropwise adding the melamine solution into the cyanuric acid solution, heating and stirring for reaction to obtain a hydrogen bond organic framework, then, adding the hydrogen bond organic framework into the absolute ethanol solution of phenolic resin, stirring for reaction, and calcining to obtain the carbon wave-absorbing material. The method has simple process and low cost. The obtained wave absorbing material has excellent electromagnetic wave absorption performance and almost covers all X and Ku wave bands. The application requirement of thin, light, wide and strong is realized.

title_en: Rotating shaft mechanism and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a rotating shaft mechanism and an electronic device. The rotating shaft mechanism comprises a first base, a second base, a first shell fixing frame, a second shell fixing frame, a third shell fixing frame, a first rotating mechanism, a second rotating mechanism and a linkage gear piece. The second casing mount rotates to be connected between first base and second base, and first casing mount rotates to be connected in first base one side that deviates from the second casing mount, and the third casing mount rotates to be connected in second base one side that deviates from the second casing mount. The first rotating mechanism is arranged on the first base, and the second rotating mechanism is arranged on the second base. The linkage gear piece is arranged on the second shell fixing frame and is respectively meshed and driven with the second gear connecting rod and the third gear connecting rod. Whether the first shell fixing frame is folded first or the third shell fixing frame is folded first, the linkage gear piece can realize the rotation linkage of the first shell fixing frame and the third shell fixing frame, so that the linkage folding of the electronic equipment is realized.

title_en: Multi-angle adjustment multi-screen display for conference
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-angle adjusting multi-screen display for a conference, and relates to the field of conference display screens. This multi-angle regulation multi-screen display ware, including rotary device, turning device, two bending device and two adjusting device, turning device sets up on rotary device's top, two the bending device sets up respectively in turning device's both sides, two adjusting device sets up respectively at two bending device's rear end, rotary device includes the backup pad, the top middle part rotation of backup pad is connected with the worm wheel. Through setting up rotary device, can improve rotary device wholly to the supporting stability of equipment, through setting up turning device, can make equipment when using, improve user's comfort level, through setting up the device of buckling, can enlarge the broadcast range of device, the holistic functionality of effectual improvement equipment, through setting up adjusting device, the holistic needs that satisfy different crowds of effectual messenger's device, the holistic application scope of improvement device.

title_en: LED display screen with protective performance
abstract_en: The invention discloses an LED display screen with protective performance, and belongs to the technical field of LED display screens. The LED display screen comprises two bottom plates which are symmetrically arranged, a protective shell is arranged between the two bottom plates, supporting foot frames are movably arranged on two side parts of the bottom plates, a driving assembly used for adjusting the supporting foot frames is arranged at the top of the bottom plates, a connecting assembly used for driving the supporting foot frames to be adjusted under the driving of the driving assembly is arranged between the output end of the driving assembly and the supporting foot frames, a transmission assembly is arranged in the driving assembly, a mounting plate is arranged at the top of the transmission assembly, a mounting frame is arranged on the inner side of the mounting plate, and an LED display screen is detachably arranged on the mounting frame; according to the invention, the display screen can be stored in the protective shell and cleaned when the protective shell is not used, so that a good protective effect is achieved, and the display screen can be moved out of the protective shell to be convenient to use when the protective shell is matched with the driving assembly and the transmission assembly.

title_en: Signaling of information indicative of transform kernel sets in image compilation
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to signaling of information indicative of a transform kernel set in image compilation. The image decoding method according to the present document includes a step of generating residual samples of a current block based on residual information, wherein the residual information includes a Multiple Transform Selection (MTS) index and information on transform coefficients, generating residual samples from the transform coefficients according to the information on the transform coefficients by using a transform kernel set, the transform kernel set being determined from transform kernel set candidates by the MTS index, deriving at least one bin of a bin string of the MTS index based on context coding, and performing context coding based on a value of the context index with respect to the MTS index.

title_en: V-CUT processing method of circuit board
abstract_en: The application discloses a V-CUT processing method of a circuit board, which comprises the steps of obtaining information of the circuit board, determining production parameters stored correspondingly in a target information platform, controlling a V-CUT machine to automatically arrange cutters according to the production parameters so as to process the V-CUT on the circuit board, measuring the residual thickness of the circuit board, controlling the V-CUT machine to correct according to a measurement result, and controlling the V-CUT machine to CUT the circuit board in batches. According to the V-CUT processing method of the circuit board, the production parameters stored correspondingly in the target information platform can be determined by acquiring the data information of the circuit board, so that the V-CUT machine is controlled to automatically arrange the cutters according to the production parameters, manual cutter arrangement is not needed, size conversion input is not needed, error risks of production parameter acquisition and use are effectively reduced, working efficiency is improved, residual thickness of the circuit board is measured, the V-CUT machine can be controlled to correct according to the measurement result, cutting quality is improved, and product quality is guaranteed.

title_en: Photoelectric conversion method and system for Micro-LED Micro display device with ultra-high pixel density
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of Micro display devices, and discloses a photoelectric conversion method and a photoelectric conversion system for an ultra-high pixel density Micro-LED Micro display device. The method comprises the steps of carrying out photoetching and etching on III-V semiconductor materials to obtain an LED pixel array structure and an equivalent circuit model thereof, carrying out light intensity response measurement on the equivalent circuit model to obtain response characteristic data, carrying out light intensity modulation on the LED pixel array structure according to the response characteristic data to obtain PWM driving control parameters, carrying out time scale coordination on the LED pixel array structure based on the PWM driving control parameters to obtain real-time control parameters, carrying out power distribution on the LED pixel array structure according to the real-time control parameters to obtain pixel power compensation parameters, and carrying out control optimization on the pixel power compensation parameters to obtain display performance parameters.

title_en: Image display method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to an image display method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining pixel information and environment brightness of each pixel in each frame of picture of an image to be projected, carrying out simulated projection on the image to be projected to obtain a first position of each pixel in each frame of picture in a spectroscope equipment range, determining a target pixel in each frame of picture based on the environment brightness and the pixel information, obtaining a monitoring image in an exhibition hall, determining the height and a second position of each person in the exhibition hall based on the monitoring image, determining a third position on a background wall in the exhibition hall based on the height, the second position and the first position of the target pixel, obtaining position information of the third position, determining an enhanced display strategy of the target pixel based on the position information of the third position and the pixel information of the target pixel, and adjusting the target pixel in each frame of picture based on the enhanced display strategy. The application can enhance the display effect of holographic projection in scenes with complex light rays and the like.

title_en: Energy-saving temperature and humidity regulating air conditioner and regulating method
abstract_en: The invention provides an energy-saving temperature and humidity regulation air conditioner and a regulation method, wherein the method is applied to fresh air temperature and humidity regulation of indoor air entering a data center and comprises the steps of monitoring real-time air mass flow rate, dry bulb temperature and relative humidity of a return air inlet part, a return air outlet, a fresh air inlet and a fresh air outlet part in real time; the method comprises the steps of calculating the dry bulb temperature, the moisture content and the relative humidity of the mixed air after heat exchange of a gas cross flow exchange part, determining an ideal dry bulb temperature threshold value and an ideal relative humidity threshold value of indoor air, judging the positions of the dry bulb temperature and the relative humidity of the mixed air in different temperature threshold value ranges respectively, further judging which humidity threshold value range formed by the relative humidity threshold values of the mixed air is in, further determining the mixed air state according to the different positions of the dry bulb temperature and the relative humidity of the mixed air, selectively starting a hot water coil, a cold water coil or a spraying system or any one or two combinations, further performing temperature and humidity treatment on the mixed air, and then flowing out from a fresh air outflow part, or alternatively not starting the mixed air, and directly flowing out from the fresh air outflow part and conveying the mixed air into a room. According to the invention, the indoor environment is accurately regulated by optimizing the temperature and humidity control method and the equipment operation mode, so that the energy consumption of the air conditioner is reduced, the energy utilization efficiency is improved, and the operation cost is reduced.

title_en: Temperature adjusting method and camera device
abstract_en: The application provides a temperature adjusting method and a camera device, and relates to the technical field of photography. The temperature regulation method is applied to a controller in a camera device, the camera device comprises an imaging sensor, the controller and a temperature modulation device, the controller is connected with the imaging sensor and the temperature modulation device, the temperature modulation device is arranged on a non-sensing surface of the imaging sensor in a fitting mode, the method comprises the steps of determining target temperature of shooting by the imaging sensor according to brightness conditions of a shot target object, determining temperature difference data according to the target temperature and detection temperature of the imaging sensor in a detected period, determining control signals of an undetected period according to the temperature difference data and initial parameters of the controller, and regulating temperature modulation power of the temperature modulation device based on a plurality of control signals. The temperature modulation process is controlled in real time according to the actual and required temperature, so that the fogging condition caused by the excessively high temperature regulation rate is reduced, and the quality of the shot image is effectively improved.

title_en: Display control console structure
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of display consoles, and particularly relates to a display console structure. The invention provides a display control console structure which comprises a shell and a shock absorber component arranged below the shell, wherein a display control module, a control module, an expansion interface module and an article placement module are arranged on the upper surface of the shell, the shell is in a flat shape, the display control module is located in the middle of the upper surface, the control module is arranged on two sides of the display control module, the expansion interface module and the article placement module are respectively arranged on the upper side of the control module, the control module is used for sending an operation instruction according to the content of the display control module, and the expansion interface module is used for connecting external equipment.

title_en: Video variable code rate coding method and device based on implicit neural characterization model
abstract_en: The invention provides a video variable code rate coding method and device based on an implicit neural characterization model. The method comprises the steps of 1, constructing and training an implicit nerve characterization model, 2, calculating possible quantization parameter combinations by using the trained implicit nerve characterization model according to a specified target code rate, 3, calculating quantization sensitivity aiming at all quantization parameter combinations and selecting the combination of minimum quantization sensitivity for calibration, and 4, encoding calibrated model parameters by using an entropy encoder. The invention realizes variable code rate coding by adjusting quantization parameters instead of retraining a model, thereby greatly reducing training cost and improving coding efficiency.

title_en: Image processing method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an image processing method, an image processing device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein a first image of the interior of cooking equipment in a first temperature environment is acquired, the first image comprises at least one target food material, first color data corresponding to the first image is determined, the first color data is compared with second color data of at least one target food material in a second temperature environment to determine an initial color difference value corresponding to each target food material, the target color difference value is determined according to the initial color difference value of at least one target food material and a coefficient corresponding to each target food material, and color correction is performed on the first image based on the target color difference value to obtain a target image.

title_en: Sound control system, sound control method and vehicle-mounted sound
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of vehicle-mounted sound equipment, in particular to a sound equipment control system, a sound equipment control method and a vehicle-mounted sound equipment. The connecting module is connected with the vehicle-mounted system through a circuit or a communication module and is connected with an external system through wireless communication, so that the sound control system can acquire signals of the vehicle-mounted system and the vehicle-mounted system. The judgment module is used for judging the signal source of the connection module, and the decision module is used for determining the sounding strategy according to the signal source. After the control module obtains the sounding strategy instruction, the first sounding module and the second sounding module work according to the sounding strategy, so that the vehicle-mounted sounding system adopts different sounding strategies according to different signal sources, and the vehicle-mounted sounding system meets diversified requirements.

title_en: HDI high-speed circuit board production technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an HDI high-speed circuit board production technology which comprises the following production steps of S1, cutting, namely setting the size of a working board according to the equipment process capability and the board utilization rate, cutting the board into corresponding sizes, S2, inner-layer wet film, namely enabling a wet film resist to receive ultraviolet irradiation, and decomposing a photoinitiator into free radicals. The production technology of the HDI high-speed circuit board utilizes the existing HDI high-speed circuit board, performs local operation through embedded materials, synchronously adopts a differential method to partition on the same layer, manages and controls copper thickness in different layers, does not have a high operation area, adopts copper thickness technology to process a power supply part, meets requirements through various tests, and delivers the power supply part to customers, so that the produced HDI high-speed circuit board has the effects of good heat dissipation and good signal transmission performance, and adopts a lamination process, thereby improving the overall strength and the compression resistance of the HDI high-speed circuit board.

title_en: Process control method and device for PCB spray etching procedure
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a process control method and a process control device for a PCB spray etching process, which comprise the steps of obtaining micro-bubble parameters of etching liquid, obtaining array positions of a spray header, obtaining a size distribution diagram of a PCB substrate, calculating to obtain spray array flow distribution data according to the array positions of the spray header and the size distribution diagram of the PCB substrate, adjusting the spray array flow distribution data according to the micro-bubble parameters to obtain spray array flow, performing etching operation of the PCB substrate according to the spray array flow to obtain an etched PCB substrate, controlling to prevent a 'pool effect' generated in the etching process, enabling a wire to face downwards to overetch a line, fundamentally solving the problem of the pool effect, meeting the special requirements of products with strict line width impedance and strict tolerance, and fundamentally solving the problem of the pool effect when the PCB is produced in the spray etching process by using a novel film pressing, exposure process, etching method and process, and improving the uniformity of the line width.

title_en: Preparation method of wave-absorbing aerogel, wave-absorbing aerogel and wave-absorbing device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a preparation method of wave-absorbing aerogel, the wave-absorbing aerogel and a wave-absorbing device. Providing a Ti  3 C 2 T x  dispersion liquid and a bacterial cellulose liquid, and mixing the Ti  3 C 2 T x  dispersion liquid and the bacterial cellulose liquid to obtain a first mixed liquid. Providing a magnetic metal salt solution, and adding the magnetic metal salt solution into the first mixed solution to obtain the Ti  3 C 2 T x  hydrogel. And performing freeze drying treatment on the Ti  3 C 2 T x  hydrogel to obtain Ti  3 C 2 T x  aerogel. Providing ammonium molybdate and thiourea, and dissolving the ammonium molybdate and the thiourea in a first solvent to obtain a second mixed solution. And carrying out hydrothermal treatment on the Ti  3 C 2 T x  aerogel and the second mixed solution to obtain a compound. And carbonizing the compound to obtain the wave-absorbing aerogel. The wave-absorbing aerogel prepared by the method reduces impedance mismatch, enriches the loss form of the wave-absorbing aerogel and enhances the wave-absorbing performance of the wave-absorbing aerogel.

title_en: Monitoring device and control method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a monitoring device and a control method thereof, and relates to the technical field of monitoring, wherein the monitoring device comprises a camera, an inertial measurement unit, a PIR sensor and a processor; the processor is used for acquiring a first signal acquired by the inertial measurement unit and a second signal acquired by the PIR sensor, monitoring whether the camera vibrates according to the first signal, shielding the second signal when the camera vibrates, and adjusting a pitch angle corresponding to a shooting optical axis of the camera according to the acquired first signal and second signal when the camera does not vibrate. The technical scheme provided by the application can effectively avoid false alarm generated by the PIR sensor and improve the reliability of the monitoring device.

title_en: Interframe prediction method and device based on merging mode
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a video encoding/decoding method and apparatus, which are characterized by comprising a step of constructing a merge candidate list of a current block, deriving motion information of the current block from the merge candidate list, and performing inter prediction of the current block using the motion information, wherein the merge candidate list includes at least one of spatial merge candidates, temporal merge candidates, and combination merge candidates, and the combination merge candidates are derived by combining n merge candidates belonging to the merge candidate list, and thus have an effect of improving accuracy of the motion information by using not only the spatial/temporal merge candidates but also the combination merge candidates.

title_en: Subway passenger information optical fiber transmission system based on MEMS optical switch
abstract_en: The application discloses a subway passenger information optical fiber transmission system based on an MEMS optical switch, which comprises a broadcasting control end, a PIS optical terminal machine transmitting end, a plurality of PIS optical terminal machine receiving ends and a plurality of display screens, wherein MEMS modules are integrated in the PIS optical terminal machine receiving ends, the PIS optical terminal machine receiving ends are in one-to-one correspondence with the display screens, the broadcasting control output end is electrically connected with the input end of the PIS optical terminal machine transmitting end, the output end of the PIS optical terminal machine transmitting end is electrically connected with the input ends of the MEMS modules through a plurality of groups of main link optical fibers and backup link optical fibers, the output end of each MEMS module is electrically connected with the input end of each PIS optical terminal machine receiving end, and the output end of each PIS optical terminal machine receiving end is electrically connected with the input end of each display screen. The MEMS module is added to the receiving end of the PIS optical transceiver, so that the video content played by the display screen is not affected, the high stability and the high reliability of the system are ensured, and the cost is low.

title_en: Method, device and medium for controlling scanning of cradle head
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of security monitoring, in particular to a scanning control method, a device and a medium for a cradle head. The method comprises the steps of firstly calibrating a scanning area by adopting a clockwise four-point calibration mode, covering the monitoring range of various required shapes by a four-point method, conveniently scanning the area calibrated by the method, reducing a scanning blind area, setting a corresponding scanning mode according to the summarized three types of monitoring areas, and aiming at each shape, so that the scanning of the delimited area can be realized, whether the monitoring blind area exists in the delimited area can be judged according to the delimited graph shape, important attention is paid when the user runs to the blind area, omission is avoided, the scanning speed is determined based on the angle of view and the zoom speed, and the scanning speed and the scanning quality are considered.

title_en: Production and processing method of fine pen electric luminous LOGO product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production and processing method of a fine pen electro luminescence LOGO product, which comprises the following steps of S1, material preparation and pretreatment, S2, plasma treatment, dispensing and bonding of S3, PET and PC, S4, UV light curing, bonding of S5, PC and a diffusion film, S6, processing design, S7, processing operation and S8, quality detection. In step S1, the nanoimprint technique produces a specific micro-texture structure on the surface of a material. The invention can increase the roughness of the material surface by micro texture treatment, so that the glue can fill the surface gap better when being coated, and the formation of bubbles caused by tiny air gaps between the glue and the material due to the too smooth surface is avoided, on the other hand, when the glue is attached, the texture structure can play a role similar to 'mortise and tenon', so that the contact between adjacent material layers is more compact, the mechanical occlusion effect is enhanced, and the layering is reduced.

title_en: Software analysis method and system for analog television signals
abstract_en: The invention relates to a software analysis method and a system for analog television signals, wherein the method comprises the steps of 1, detecting and collecting wireless analog television signals transmitted in air, 2, carrying out carrier detection, modulation identification and signal demodulation on the collected wireless analog television signals, 3, extracting PAL and NTSC signals through synchronous signals, separating light and color, and analyzing chroma demodulation, and 4, carrying out video playing on the selected analog television signals according to the analysis result of the step 3. The invention demodulates, analyzes parameters and plays the mode by detecting and collecting the wireless analog television signal transmitted in the air, reduces the hardware cost, improves the analysis efficiency, and realizes the high-efficiency and accurate analysis and processing of the analog television signal by a software means.

title_en: High-power active beam splitter with built-in heat dissipation module
abstract_en: The application provides a high-power active beam splitter with a built-in heat dissipation module, which relates to the field of beam splitters, and comprises a machine body, a heat dissipation mechanism arranged on the machine body and a shielding mechanism arranged on the machine body; the heat dissipation mechanism comprises a blocking plate arranged on the machine body, a motor arranged on the machine body, a blocking part arranged on the machine body, a matching part arranged on the machine body and a triggering part arranged on the machine body; this application is in order to solve among the prior art light splitter and need install outdoor when, receives the irradiation of sunshine and moist problem that can lead to light splitter life to reduce, and this application has realized that the organism can be sunshade and isolated rainwater's entering in outdoor normal during operation through the radiating mechanism that sets up with shielding mechanism that sets up, through the radiating mechanism that sets up, has solved among the prior art establish multiunit heat abstractor in the organism and lead to the problem that cost and energy consumption are high.

title_en: Building construction safety monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention provides a building construction safety monitoring method, which relates to the technical field of construction safety and comprises the following steps of S1, storing preset information before construction, S2, enabling two reference probes on a monitoring rod to have the same distance with a construction unit during construction, S3, enabling the reference probes to acquire actual information of the construction unit in real time, S4, judging whether the matching degree of the preset information and the actual information of the two reference probes is higher than a preset threshold value, if so, not executing operation, otherwise, executing S5, and S5, enabling an auxiliary probe and rotating the monitoring rod to evaluate the progress safety degree of the construction unit. The invention is simple and convenient, the inspection robot is not required to inspect, remote monitoring is directly adopted, triangular monitoring is formed by the two reference probes and at least one displaced auxiliary probe, the monitoring precision is effectively improved, hidden dangers of the current construction unit are effectively found out by the preset construction information, and the safety is high.

title_en: Inverted structure of radio frequency power amplifier
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a flip structure of a radio frequency power amplifier. The flip-chip structure of the radio frequency power amplifier comprises a main board, a power amplifier daughter board, a digital intermediate frequency device, a power amplifier device, a Printed Circuit Board (PCB) connector and a radiator, wherein the PCB connector is configured between a first surface of the main board and a third surface of the power amplifier daughter board, the interconnection line is connected with the first surface and the third surface, the first surface of the main board is provided with the digital intermediate frequency device, the second surface of the main board is used for configuring an antenna array, the third surface of the power amplifier daughter board is provided with the power amplifier device, and the fourth surface of the power amplifier daughter board is provided with the radiator. The scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention can solve the problems of larger weight and higher cost of base station equipment.

title_en: VR intelligent data caching method and system based on visual port predictability
abstract_en: The invention provides a VR intelligent data caching method and system based on visual port predictability, comprising the following steps of S1, setting a distributed intelligent storage management caching architecture based on a VR environment, dividing edge nodes into edge servers and data consumers by the intelligent storage management caching architecture according to functions, S2, predicting future visual points of users according to a visual point attenuation mechanism and parameter information of the users, generating a FOV of the users by the visual point attenuation mechanism, wherein the parameter information of the users comprises historical head track information of the users, and S3, caching popular user tiling based on a dynamic tiling caching method. The invention can efficiently manage and store data on the edge server, simultaneously provides high response support for the data-intensive VR application program, remarkably improves the accuracy and reliability of viewpoint prediction and an average caching algorithm, and saves response time and bandwidth required by a user when requesting data.

title_en: Method, apparatus and medium for video processing
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a scheme for video processing. A method for video processing is provided. The method includes performing a conversion between a current video unit of the video and a bitstream of the video, wherein the bitstream includes information for acquiring a downsampling filter of the current video unit.

title_en: Dustproof filter easy to assemble
abstract_en: The invention discloses an easy-to-assemble dustproof filter, which relates to the technical field of filters and comprises a shell, wherein a radiating hole is formed in the top of the shell in a penetrating way, circular grooves are formed in the top of the shell, mounting grooves are formed in the two sides of the top of the shell, a bottom shell is connected with the bottom end of the shell in a propping way, the dustproof barrel is in a cylindrical shape and is in sliding connection with the inner wall of the radiating hole, a plurality of dustproof holes are formed in the periphery and the bottom of the dustproof barrel around an axial lead, the inner wall of the circular ring is fixedly connected with the top of the dustproof barrel, the circular ring is in propping connection with the inner wall of the circular groove, mounting plates are respectively fixedly connected with the two sides of the circular ring, the top of the circular ring is higher than the top of the shell, the mounting plates are propping connection with the inner wall of the mounting grooves, and the mounting plates slide the dustproof barrel along the inner wall of the radiating hole through the circular ring, so that the dustproof barrel is taken down from the shell, and vibration is prevented from being transmitted to electronic elements of the filter when the dustproof barrel is cleaned.

title_en: Output of audio signals
abstract_en: Example embodiments relate to the output of audio signals, and in particular to the use of two or more physical speakers to render one or more sound sources represented by such audio signals. In an example method, a method is disclosed that includes rendering at least a first sound source through output of audio signals from two or more physical speakers having different respective locations such that the first sound source is intended to be perceived as having a first direction that is different from a physical speaker direction relative to a user. The method may further include detecting that an audio capture device of the user is operating in a directional mode for steering a sound capture beam in a first direction. The method may further include performing, in response to the detecting, a modified rendering by outputting the audio signal of the first sound source from a selected physical speaker of the two or more physical speakers but not from the other physical speakers such that the first sound source will be perceived from the direction of the selected physical speaker such that the sound capture beam of the audio capture device will be steered to the selected physical speaker.

title_en: Electronic device, controller and vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides an electronic device, a controller and a vehicle. The electronic device comprises a first connecting terminal and a second connecting terminal, wherein the polarity of the second connecting terminal is opposite to that of the first connecting terminal, the second connecting terminal and the first connecting terminal are arranged at intervals, and the projection of the first connecting terminal falls into the projection of the second connecting terminal in a projection plane perpendicular to the thickness direction of the second connecting terminal. Through arranging first connecting terminal and second connecting terminal as, in the projection plane of the thickness direction of perpendicular to second connecting terminal, the projection of first connecting terminal falls into in the projection of second connecting terminal, compare with setting up both side by side along connecting terminal's length or width, can make the center of first connecting terminal and the center of second connecting terminal more close to make the overlapping part of magnetic field around first connecting terminal and the magnetic field around the second connecting terminal cancel each other because of the magnetic field opposite direction in the circular telegram in-process, this helps reducing stray inductance, improve the stability of electronic device operation.

title_en: Quantization matrix encoding/decoding method and apparatus, and recording medium storing bit stream
abstract_en: A quantization matrix encoding/decoding method and apparatus and a recording medium storing a bitstream are provided. The image decoding method according to the present invention includes the steps of decoding information on a quantization matrix from a bitstream, acquiring the quantization matrix of a current block based on the information on the quantization matrix, and dequantizing the current block by using the quantization matrix of the current block, wherein the step of acquiring the quantization matrix of the current block includes the steps of deriving a single identifier by using at least one of a size, a prediction mode, and a color component of the current block, and acquiring the quantization matrix of the current block based on the single identifier.

title_en: Gate driving circuit and display panel
abstract_en: The application discloses a gate driving circuit and a display panel, wherein the gate driving circuit comprises a plurality of cascaded gate driving units, each gate driving unit at least comprises a first output unit used for outputting a first pulse signal, a second output unit used for outputting a second pulse signal, a cascading unit connected with the first output unit of the gate driving unit at the previous stage and used for receiving the first pulse signal at the previous stage, a first driving unit arranged between the cascading unit and a control end of the first output unit, and a second driving unit arranged between the cascading unit and the control end of the second output unit and used for enabling the second output unit to output a high-potential pulse of the second pulse signal when the first output unit outputs a low-potential pulse of the first pulse signal. Through the circuit, the output of different scanning signals is realized.

title_en: Video processing device, method, electronic equipment, storage medium and computer program product
