abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to the field of computer technology, and in particular, to a video processing apparatus, a method, an electronic device, a storage medium, and a computer program product, where the video processing apparatus includes a motion and optical flow fusion processing module; the motion and optical flow fusion processing module comprises a downsampling unit, a sharing calculation unit and a sharing calculation unit, wherein the downsampling unit is used for downsampling the video to be processed to obtain an image pyramid of each video frame to be processed in the video to be processed, the sharing calculation unit is used for executing an optical flow calculation task to obtain an optical flow vector of the video to be processed based on the image pyramid of each video frame to be processed in the video to be processed when the motion and optical flow fusion processing module is in an optical flow calculation mode, and the sharing calculation unit is used for executing a motion estimation task to obtain a motion vector of the video to be processed based on the image pyramid of each video frame to be processed in the video to be processed when the motion and optical flow fusion processing module is in a motion estimation mode. According to the embodiment of the disclosure, the hardware utilization rate can be improved.

title_en: Image centroid coordinate extraction circuit without divider
abstract_en: The invention discloses an image centroid coordinate extraction circuit without a divider, which is realized by a Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA), and has the core that division operation in a centroid calculation formula is converted into addition, subtraction and multiplication operation so as to avoid trial division and remainder taking processes required by division. In order to further optimize the area of the circuit and enhance its functionality, an adder unit in the multiplier is extended so that it can support not only multiplication operations but also subtraction operations. By this design, in combination with time-division multiplexing techniques, the multiplier circuit is able to perform the full arithmetic flow of the centroid extraction iterative approximation. The invention optimizes the processing speed of the centroid extraction circuit, realizes the rapid centroid extraction of the large target surface image through less clock period and controllable circuit area, and has wide application potential in a plurality of fields such as image recognition, target tracking, artificial intelligence and the like.

title_en: Display method, device, equipment and medium based on intelligent paperless conference system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of paperless conferences, in particular to a display method, a device, equipment and a medium based on an intelligent paperless conference system. The method comprises the steps of displaying a management main interface, responding to a triggering instruction of a functional control, lighting the functional control and displaying a management sub-interface, responding to the triggering instruction of the functional sub-control, lighting the functional sub-control in the management sub-interface and displaying conference content and conference operation sub-controls, and responding to the triggering instruction of any conference operation sub-control to adjust conference content corresponding to the conference operation sub-controls. The application can improve the functional diversity and richness of the intelligent paperless conference system, so that conference managers can simply and conveniently establish, manage and other operation matters on the conference, can acquire detailed conference information and content, effectively manage the conference, ensure the conference order of the paperless conference, and can improve the intuitiveness, transparency and traceability of the paperless conference.

title_en: Display panel and display device
abstract_en: The application discloses a display panel and a display device, which are used for relieving moire. The display panel comprises a display substrate and a touch conducting layer, wherein the display substrate comprises a plurality of sub-pixel groups, the sub-pixel groups comprise a plurality of sub-pixel opening areas and non-opening areas which are arranged along a first direction, the touch conducting layer comprises a plurality of touch electrodes, the touch electrodes comprise a plurality of hollowed-out areas which are arranged in an array mode and non-hollowed-out areas which are arranged among the hollowed-out areas, orthographic projections of the hollowed-out areas and the non-hollowed-out areas on the display substrate overlap with the sub-pixel groups, the hollowed-out areas comprise strip-shaped hollowed-out areas, the maximum widths of the same sub-pixel opening areas of different sub-pixel groups in the first direction are not identical, and/or the widths of the hollowed-out areas in the first direction, the widths of the non-hollowed-out areas between two adjacent hollowed-out areas and the included angles between the extending directions of the strip-shaped hollowed-out areas and the first direction are not identical.

title_en: Video encoding and decoding method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: Aspects of the present disclosure provide methods and apparatus for video encoding/decoding. In some examples, an apparatus for video decoding includes processing circuitry. The processing circuitry decodes prediction information from a current block in the encoded video stream. The prediction information indicates a coding mode for coding the current block based on reconstructed samples, which are in the same picture as the current block. The processing circuit determines a candidate vector for reconstructing at least a portion of a block having a predetermined spatial relationship with the current block and then determines a displacement vector for reconstructing at least a portion of the current block from a candidate list comprising candidate vectors. Further, the processing circuit reconstructs the at least a portion of the current block based on the displacement vector.

title_en: Solder paste printing equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of solder paste printers, and particularly relates to solder paste printing equipment; the Y-direction driving piece is used for driving the clamping mechanism to move along the Y direction so that the clamping mechanism clamps the supporting pin from the first inserting groove and is placed in the second inserting groove, the conveying mechanism conveys the circuit board to the upper side of the workbench along the X direction, the workbench is driven to move upwards by the second Z-direction driving piece, the workbench pushes the circuit board away from the conveying mechanism through the supporting pin, and the Y-direction driving piece is also used for driving the scraper mechanism to move along the Y direction so that the scraper mechanism prints solder paste on the steel mesh on the circuit board. According to the invention, the workbench supports the circuit board through the supporting pin, and the circuit board is not in direct contact with the workbench, so that the circuit board is convenient to transfer between the workbench and the conveying mechanism, solder paste on the circuit board cannot be adhered to the workbench, and the cleanliness of the workbench and the printing quality of the circuit board are ensured.

title_en: Gate driving circuit, manufacturing method and display panel
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of display driving, and particularly relates to a gate driving circuit, a preparation method and a display panel, wherein the gate driving circuit comprises N cascaded GOA circuit units; the application provides a high-temperature high-humidity gate driving circuit, which comprises a reset signal line, a cathode signal line, a plurality of clock signal lines and a gate driving circuit, wherein the reset signal line is arranged near any side of a GOA circuit unit, is electrically connected with a gate of a reset transistor and is positioned on the same metal layer with the gate of the reset transistor, the cathode signal line is positioned on the same side of the reset signal line and is far away from the GOA circuit unit, the cathode signal line is electrically connected with a drain electrode or a source electrode of the reset transistor and is positioned on the same metal layer with the drain electrode or the drain electrode of the reset transistor, the plurality of clock signal lines are arranged between the reset signal line and the cathode signal line and are electrically connected with the clock signal line of the GOA circuit unit.

title_en: Defrosting type communication equipment box adaptable to colder environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a defrosting type communication equipment box adaptable to a colder environment, which is applied to the technical field of communication equipment boxes and has the technical scheme that the defrosting type communication equipment box comprises a box body and an installation cavity arranged in the box body; the box body is provided with at least one air inlet and at least one air outlet communicated with the installation cavity, the box body is provided with a fan assembly and a one-way ventilation assembly on the air inlet and the air outlet, the box body is internally provided with an air inlet channel communicated with the air inlet and the installation cavity, the side wall of the air inlet channel is uniformly and fixedly connected with a plurality of heating assemblies and a molecular sieve drying agent for separating water and gas in air, and the air inlet channel is internally provided with a regeneration assembly for automatically separating moisture in the molecular sieve drying agent and guiding out of the box body.

title_en: Circuit board processing method with plug-in hole step groove
abstract_en: The application provides a circuit board processing method of a step groove with an insert hole, which belongs to the technical field of printed circuit board production and comprises the steps of processing a first core board and a second core board, pasting a glue blocking film at the position of the step groove preset on the first core board, laminating the first core board, a prepreg and the second core board after stacking the first core board from bottom to top in sequence, drilling the insert hole downwards at the preset position of the first core board, milling the step groove at the position of the step groove preset on the first core board, exposing the glue blocking film, stripping the glue blocking film, carrying out copper plating, copper plating and tin plating on the circuit board processed in the steps, removing tin layers and copper surfaces on the side wall of the step groove, removing the tin layers at the position of a base material on the first core board at the bottom of the step groove, exposing the copper surfaces, and removing the rest tin layers. The processing method can avoid excessive copper reduction when removing redundant copper surfaces in the step groove, and can avoid biting the core plate pattern and the plug-in holes Kong Tong at the bottom of the step groove.

title_en: Millimeter wave transceiver chip and connection method thereof with PCB, millimeter wave transceiver array and human body security inspection system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chip packaging and provides a millimeter wave transceiver chip which comprises a bare chip, a packaging carrier and a packaging carrier, wherein a plurality of bonding pads are arranged on the first surface of the bare chip, the packaging carrier comprises a first PI layer, a first RDL layer, at least one part of the plurality of bonding pads is electrically connected with the first RDL layer through the first bonding pads so as to realize vertical extraction of signals, the first RDL layer is also used as a wiring layer of a horizontal expansion transmission line, a second PI layer is provided with a second bonding hole, the second bonding hole is farther from the center than the first bonding pad, one side of the UBM layer, which is far away from the bare chip, is provided with a ball-planting welding point, and the signal point on the first RDL layer is electrically connected with the ball-planting welding point of the UBM layer through the second bonding hole so as to realize vertical extraction of signals. The distribution profile of the plurality of pads is rotated at an angle relative to the package carrier such that corners of the distribution profile having a rectangular shape are not aligned with corners of the package carrier. The transceiver chip can shorten the signal transmission wiring and further improve the signal transmission performance.

title_en: Porous laminate and flexible multilayer circuit board
abstract_en: The porous laminate (1) is provided with a conductor layer (2) and an insulating layer (3) in this order on one side in the thickness direction. The insulating layer (3) is provided with a base resin layer (4), a porous resin layer (5), and a bonding layer (6) in this order on one side in the thickness direction. The thickness of the porous resin layer (5) is 50 [ mu ] m or less, and the maximum height (Rz) of one surface of the porous resin layer (5) in the thickness direction is 16 [ mu ] m or less. The maximum height (Rz) of one surface in the thickness direction of the porous resin layer (5) is greater than the maximum height (Rz) of one surface in the thickness direction of the base resin layer (4).

title_en: Display module and display device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a display module and a display device, in the display module of the embodiment of the application, a cavity is defined between the inner side surface of the bending part and the side surface of the composite supporting layer, the embodiment of the application fills the whole cavity by adopting the filling piece with the hole structure, so as to reduce the risk of insufficient support in the middle area of the cavity, thereby better protecting the metal wiring of the bending part. Secondly, the hole structure of the filling piece can better absorb external stress, so that the filling piece can support the bending part, and the risk of metal wiring breakage on the bending part caused by external force deformation of the bending part can be reduced.

title_en: Image storage method, apparatus, electronic device, medium, and program product
abstract_en: The application discloses an image storage method, an image storage device, electronic equipment, a medium and a program product, which belong to the technical field of electronic products, wherein the image storage method comprises the steps of determining a first numerical value under the condition of continuously shooting a plurality of pictures, wherein the first numerical value is the number of shot pictures which are not stored in the continuous shooting process; and determining a storage mode for storing the non-stored shot pictures based on the first numerical value and the first threshold, wherein the storage mode is used for storing the non-stored shot pictures through a first process when the first numerical value is smaller than or equal to the first threshold, and storing N pictures before queuing in the non-stored shot pictures through the first process when the first numerical value is larger than the first threshold, and storing the rest shot pictures in the non-stored shot pictures through a second process when the N is equal to the first threshold.

title_en: Processing method, processing apparatus, and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a processing method, processing equipment and storage medium, wherein the processing method can be applied to the processing equipment and comprises the steps of determining or obtaining a target prediction mode of a current block according to a candidate mode in at least one mode list. The technical scheme of the application can match a proper target prediction mode for the current block, and further can support the improvement of the prediction accuracy of the current block.

title_en: Volume control method and device of wireless earphone and wireless earphone
abstract_en: The invention discloses a volume control method and device of a wireless earphone and the wireless earphone, and relates to the technical field of wireless earphones, wherein the wireless earphone comprises a rotatable part arranged on a wireless earphone shell and a rotation detection part arranged in the wireless earphone shell; the invention utilizes the rotation detection component to detect the rotation parameter information of the rotatable component, can detect the rotation direction of the rotatable component, thereby realizing the rotation detection of the rotatable component, enabling a user to adjust the volume of the wireless earphone through rotating the rotatable component, adding a more accurate and stable volume control mode for the wireless earphone, and improving the user experience.

title_en: Magnetic type desktop conference terminal base structure
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of desktop conference terminals, and particularly relates to a magnetic type desktop conference terminal base structure, which comprises a mounting seat, wherein a display component is fixedly arranged on the left side of the upper part of the mounting seat, a supporting plate is arranged on the right side of the upper part of the mounting seat in a sliding way, an audio component is arranged on the upper part of the supporting plate, the display component comprises a video base fixedly arranged on the left side of the upper part of the mounting seat, a display screen is fixedly arranged on the upper part of the video base, the audio component comprises an audio base arranged on the upper part of the supporting plate, a limiting block is fixedly arranged on the upper part of the audio base, a limiting groove is formed in the upper part of the limiting block, and a sliding block is arranged in the limiting groove in a sliding way. The invention can also facilitate the separation of the display component and the audio component under the condition of ensuring that the display component and the audio component can be integrally connected and separated, and can accurately align the display component and the audio component when being connected, thereby ensuring the connection stability of the display component and the audio component.

title_en: Display apparatus
abstract_en: The display device comprises a stretchable panel, a telescopic mechanism, a first adhesive layer and a second adhesive layer, wherein the stretchable panel is provided with an operation surface, the telescopic mechanism is arranged on one side of the stretchable panel, which is opposite to the operation surface, and is provided with a bearing surface facing the stretchable panel, the telescopic mechanism is suitable for driving the stretchable panel to deform along a direction intersecting the operation surface, the first adhesive layer is connected with the bearing surface of the stretchable panel and the telescopic mechanism, the second adhesive layer is arranged between the edge of the bearing surface and the first adhesive layer, and the Young modulus of the second adhesive layer is larger than that of the first adhesive layer.

title_en: Electronic device comprising a loudspeaker
abstract_en: According to one embodiment, an electronic device may include a housing including a speaker aperture and a speaker module within the housing. The speaker module may include a speaker including a first surface, a second surface opposite the first surface, and a third surface connecting the first surface and the second surface. The speaker module may include a first housing including a first portion including a first opening overlapping the first surface when viewed from above and a second portion disposed on the first portion, a second housing attached to the first housing and including a duct extending from the first opening into the speaker hole, a first space extending from the first opening through the duct to the speaker hole, and a second space separated from the first space by a speaker within the first housing. The second portion may seal the second space.

title_en: Reflective display device and driving method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reflective display device and a driving method, wherein the reflective display device comprises a bistable liquid crystal box, the bistable liquid crystal box comprises a color film substrate, an array substrate and a liquid crystal layer, the liquid crystal layer comprises bistable liquid crystal molecules and black dye molecules which are mixed with each other, all bistable liquid crystal molecules reflect invisible light rays in a reflective state, a reflective pixel electrode is arranged on the array substrate, a common electrode is arranged on the color film substrate, the bistable liquid crystal box is provided with a plurality of pixel units distributed in an array, the reflective pixel electrode is correspondingly arranged in each pixel unit, and the color film substrate is provided with a color resistance layer in a region corresponding to the pixel unit. The black dye molecules and the bistable liquid crystal molecules reflecting invisible light rays in the reflection state are mixed with each other and matched with the reflective pixel electrode and the color film substrate, so that the reflective display device can realize color reflection display with good display effect, and the reflective display device has the advantages of simple structure, small box thickness and low manufacturing cost.

title_en: Electromagnetic shielding film and circuit board
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electromagnetic shielding film and a circuit board, wherein the electromagnetic shielding film comprises a protective layer and a shielding layer which are sequentially stacked, one side surface of the protective layer is provided with a plurality of first protruding parts, and the hardness of the first protruding parts is smaller than that of the shielding layer. According to the electromagnetic shielding film, the plurality of first protruding parts are arranged on one side face of the protective layer, so that when the electromagnetic shielding film is bent, the first protruding parts can relieve external stress, damage of the external stress to the shielding layer is relieved, and the bending performance of the electromagnetic shielding film is improved. Through set up a plurality of hardness and be less than one side of protective layer the first bellying of hardness of shielding layer for electromagnetic shield membrane is when receiving to buckle, avoids the extrusion puncture shielding layer because of first bellying hardness is too big, thereby guarantees the integrality of shielding layer, and then can guarantee the stability of shielding property.

title_en: Display device and display panel thereof
abstract_en: The display panel comprises a display layer, a back film layer and a supporting structure, wherein a non-display area of the display layer is provided with a first plane area, a bending area and a second plane area which are sequentially arranged along the direction far away from the display area, the second plane area is positioned on the backlight side of the display layer, the back film layer is positioned on the backlight side of the display layer and between the second plane area and the display area of the display layer, the elastic modulus of the supporting structure is not less than 1Gpa, the first surface of the supporting structure is at least connected with the back surface of the bending area, the supporting structure is at least in a bending state, the first surface is provided with a first subsurface and a second subsurface which are sequentially arranged along the direction far away from the display area in the bending state, the central angle of the first subsurface is not less than 90 degrees, and the curvature radius of the first subsurface is smaller than the curvature radius of the second subsurface. The display panel can improve the crack deterioration effect caused by malformed bending.

title_en: Method for generating HDR image and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of terminals, in particular to a method for generating an HDR image and electronic equipment, which can improve the display effect of the HDR image. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a first HDR image, performing tone mapping on the first HDR image to obtain a second HDR image, wherein the first HDR image comprises a first highlight region, the first highlight region comprises a highlight object, the second HDR image comprises a second highlight region, the second highlight region corresponds to the first highlight region, the gradient direction of a first pixel in the second highlight region is corrected to the gradient direction of a second pixel in the first highlight region to obtain a third HDR image, the second pixel corresponds to the first pixel, the gradient direction of one pixel is positive or negative of the difference value between the brightness value of the next pixel of the pixel on a first direction axis and the brightness value of the pixel, the first direction axis comprises an x axis and a y axis, the dynamic imaging range of the third HDR image is smaller than that of the first HDR image, and the third HDR image is used for displaying.

title_en: Preparation method of infrared transparent broadband electromagnetic shielding material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preparation method of an infrared transparent broadband electromagnetic shielding material, which comprises the following steps of S1, selecting a substrate with infrared light transmittance of more than 85%, spin-coating an infrared transparent high molecular polymer on the surface of a clean substrate, forming an adhesion enhancement layer with thickness of 2-10 mu m through solidification, S2, designing a grid pattern, S3, printing a first layer of conductive grid, S4, grounding protection and a covering layer, S5, printing a second layer of conductive grid, S6, packaging, forming a fine grid structure through a 3D printing technology, realizing balance of high light transmittance of an infrared band and high shielding effectiveness of a broadband band, ensuring normal operation of a working system in a complex electromagnetic environment, playing infrared stealth capacity, ensuring uniform light distribution through irregular design of the grid pattern, not affecting detection and mapping effects, optimizing design printing through a double-layer structure, and saving material cost of slurry.

title_en: Agriculture and forestry plant diseases and insect pests intelligent early warning system based on monitored image
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agriculture and forestry pest control and provides an intelligent agriculture and forestry pest early warning system based on a monitoring image, which comprises an area monitoring module, an unmanned aerial vehicle base station control module and an unmanned aerial vehicle base station control module, wherein the area monitoring module is connected with local equipment such as a humidity sensor, a temperature sensor and a monitoring camera, the number of the local equipment is multiple, the local equipment is equidistantly arranged in an agriculture and forestry area, the area monitoring module acquires environment data of the arranged area through the local equipment, and the unmanned aerial vehicle base station control module is carried on an unmanned aerial vehicle base station. Environmental data and image information of agriculture and forestry areas can be obtained in real time, the risk of diseases and insect pests is judged rapidly, early warning signals are sent out timely, the efficiency of monitoring the diseases and insect pests is improved, the types and positions of the diseases and insect pests can be identified accurately, relevant data of all areas are collected, and relevant personnel of agriculture and forestry can trace back the root cause of the diseases and insect pests of agriculture and forestry better through the relative comparison of intelligent entries.

title_en: Integrated sound device of electric sofa
abstract_en: The application discloses an integrated sound device of an electric sofa, which relates to the field of electric chairs or sofas, and comprises a power amplifier, a small loudspeaker, a low-frequency vibrator and a line collecting box, wherein the small loudspeaker, the low-frequency vibrator and the line collecting box are arranged in each seat of the electric sofa; the power amplifier is connected with any line concentration box, each line concentration box is also connected with the small horn and the low-frequency vibrator respectively, and the line concentration boxes in each seat are connected through connecting lines.

title_en: Brightness peak clipping method for backlight partition liquid crystal display television
abstract_en: The invention provides a brightness peak clipping method of a backlight partition liquid crystal television, which relates to the technical field of brightness control of liquid crystal televisions, and is used for solving the problem of low visual experience caused by abrupt change of a peak brightness curve by acquiring the total white field current and the peak current of the backlight of the liquid crystal television, the brightness peak curve of the current state and an APL value corresponding to the peak clipping starting point position of the brightness peak curve, determining the parameter of a peak clipping function as a primary function, performing peak clipping treatment on the brightness peak curve of the current state by adopting the primary function to obtain a corrected peak brightness curve, thereby avoiding abrupt change of the peak brightness curve caused by a backlight partition algorithm, and controlling the brightness of the liquid crystal television according to the corrected peak brightness curve.

title_en: Decoding method, encoding method, decoder and encoder
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a decoding method, an encoding method, a decoder and an encoder, wherein the decoding method comprises the steps of determining a residual block of a current block in a current sequence based on a code stream, determining a first prediction block of the current block based on an intra-frame template matching prediction IntraTMP mode, determining a second prediction block of the current block based on a first prediction mode, wherein the first prediction mode is different from the IntraTMP mode, determining a target prediction block of the current block based on the first prediction block and the second prediction block, and obtaining a reconstruction block of the current block based on the residual block of the current block and the target prediction block. Compared with the scheme that the best matching block obtained based on IntraTMP modes is directly used as the target prediction block, the decoding method is equivalent to correcting the first prediction block based on the second prediction block, improves the accuracy of the target prediction block, and further can improve the decoding performance.

title_en: Radiator for realizing coupling heat radiation by utilizing heat pipe and liquid cooling structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heat dissipation of new energy power modules and discloses a radiator for realizing coupled heat dissipation by utilizing a heat pipe and liquid cooling structure, which comprises a radiator box, a heat pipe and a heat pipe, wherein a relieved tooth radiator is fixed on the top of the radiator box in a sealing way, and the relieved tooth radiator consists of a heat dissipation bottom plate, a plurality of gantry-shaped relieved tooth sheets vertically arrayed on the lower wall of the heat dissipation bottom plate, a cold liquid spraying assisting assembly and a cold liquid flow control assembly; the heat-radiating bottom plate is exposed out of the top plate of the radiator box to serve as a heating element mounting base surface, the tooth plates are vertically immersed in the inner cavity of the radiator box, the cold liquid control flow component is arranged at the liquid inlet end of the radiator box and is configured to split cooling liquid into upper stable state liquid supplementing flow and lower pulse jet flow dual-channel input, and the heat-radiating efficiency of the high-power heating element is remarkably improved through the cooperative design of the heat pipe-liquid cooling coupling structure and the three-stage heat radiating mechanism.

title_en: Image encoding/decoding method and apparatus, and recording medium storing bit stream
abstract_en: The image encoding method and apparatus according to the present disclosure may obtain residual information from a bitstream, derive transform coefficients of a current block based on the residual information, determine a transform kernel of the current block based on a transform index of an inverse transform of the current block, derive residual samples by applying inverse transform based on at least one of the transform coefficients of the transform kernel, and reconstruct the current block based on the residual samples of the current block.

title_en: Soft oxygen cabin control device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soft oxygen cabin control device, and relates to the field of control devices. A soft oxygen cabin control device comprises a box body, and further comprises a supporting frame fixedly connected to the box body, ventilation openings are formed in two sides of the box body, a base is fixedly connected to two sides of the box body, a cooling fan is fixedly connected to one side of the ventilation openings, an air pipe is inserted into the base, a splicing assembly is arranged between the two air pipes, the base, the air pipe and the splicing assembly jointly form an air return passage, a piston cylinder is fixedly connected in the air pipe far away from the cooling fan, a water return pipe is communicated with the piston cylinder, a push plate is connected in the water return pipe in a sliding mode, a through hole is formed in the push plate, and a one-way valve is arranged in the through hole.

title_en: Gate driving circuit, driving method, display panel and display device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a gate driving circuit, a driving method, a display panel and a display device, wherein the gate driving circuit comprises a plurality of cascaded shift registers, at least one initial signal gating module, a first input end of the initial signal gating module and a second initial signal wire, the second input end of the initial signal gating module is electrically connected with the output end of an ith shift register, the output end of the initial signal gating module is electrically connected with the input end of the jth shift register, and the gate driving circuit is configured to provide effective pulses for the input end of the jth shift register under the condition that the output end of the second initial signal wire or the output end of the ith shift register outputs the effective pulses so that the jth shift register provides gate driving signals for corresponding sub pixels according to the effective pulses. According to the embodiment of the application, the problem of power consumption waste in the display work of the display panel can be effectively solved.

title_en: Server and cabinet
abstract_en: The application relates to a server and a cabinet, which comprises a bottom shell, wherein the bottom shell is divided into a first installation area and a second installation area, a first functional module is arranged in the first installation area, a second functional module is arranged in the second installation area, a liquid outlet is further formed in the bottom shell, the liquid outlet is communicated with the first installation area, a liquid cooling module is in installation fit with the first functional module and is used for radiating heat of the first functional module, a first baffle structure is arranged on the bottom shell and is used for separating the first installation area from the second installation area, and a drainage structure is further arranged on the bottom shell and is used for guiding liquid leakage generated by the liquid cooling module to flow towards the liquid outlet. The liquid leakage can flow towards the liquid outlet and finally be discharged from the liquid outlet under the guiding action of the drainage structure, so that the phenomenon that the liquid leakage damages the second functional module is avoided, potential safety hazards are eliminated, and the safety of the server is protected.

title_en: Building construction real-time monitoring system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building construction real-time monitoring system based on the Internet of things, which relates to the technical field of construction monitoring, firstly, each construction area and each movable rest area in a construction site are obtained, then the environment data of each construction area are monitored, each construction area is classified according to whether the environment data has influence on the outside, then each labeling area is subjected to environment adjustment, each target area is subjected to construction period adjustment and environment adjustment, then, the adjusting effect is monitored, the influence of construction on the surrounding environment is reduced, the possibility of complaining of construction is reduced, public praise of building developers is guaranteed, meanwhile, when the environment is adjusted, the influence of environment adjusting equipment on an active area nearby a construction area is combined, the rationality of environment adjustment is guaranteed, the influence of the operation of the environment adjusting equipment and the construction environment on the active area is also reduced, the comfort of a rest active area is guaranteed, and the environment management effect of a construction site is improved.

title_en: Online detection system and method for gas leakage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas leakage online detection system and method, wherein the system comprises a sensing layer, a supporting layer and a protective layer which are sequentially connected, the sensing layer comprises an infrared multispectral intelligent imaging sensor, a light filtering component and a wireless communication module, the supporting layer comprises an image storage processing server, a database component and a target detection module, the image storage processing server stores and processes images transmitted by the sensing layer, the target detection module detects gas leakage and compares the images with data in the database component, and the protective layer comprises a local alarm, a remote control interface and a user application platform. The invention designs an online intelligent detection system for gas leakage with long service life and high stability, and skillfully solves the bottleneck problems of short service life and instability in the prior art.

title_en: Method for manufacturing flexible printed circuit board and flexible printed circuit board
abstract_en: The application discloses a preparation method of a flexible printed circuit board and the flexible printed circuit board. Comprises a first copper layer, a first liquid crystal polymer layer, a second copper layer, a second liquid crystal polymer layer and a third copper layer which are sequentially stacked along a first direction. The flexible printed circuit board is provided with a hollowed-out opening, and the hollowed-out opening penetrates through the first copper layer, the first liquid crystal polymer layer and the second copper layer along the first direction. Along the second direction, the first copper layer comprises a first wall part facing the hollowed-out opening, and the second copper layer comprises a second wall part facing the hollowed-out opening. The first wall part and the second wall part extend towards the center of the hollowed-out opening along the second direction, and the second wall part exceeds the first wall part. The second copper layer comprises a first surface facing the first copper layer, and the first wall portion, the first surface and the second wall portion together form a first step structure. The step structure receives the liquid crystal polymer of the cast first liquid crystal polymer layer. And the glue overflow amount accumulated to the third copper layer is reduced, and the influence of glue overflow on the circuit board is reduced.

title_en: Loudspeaker and cone thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a loudspeaker and a cone thereof. The cone of the loudspeaker comprises a main body and a surrounding piece, wherein the surrounding piece surrounds the main body, the surrounding piece comprises an inner connecting edge, a reinforcing ring and an outer hanging edge, the inner connecting edge, the reinforcing ring and the outer hanging edge are sequentially arranged from inside to outside, the reinforcing ring is provided with a plurality of peaks and a plurality of valleys, the peaks and the valleys are respectively positioned at the upper side and the lower side of the outer hanging edge, the peaks arch upwards along the vibration axis of the loudspeaker, the valleys are recessed downwards along the vibration axis, the peaks and the valleys are staggered and connected into a ring shape, the peaks and the valleys are formed by elastic sheets, a connecting wall is arranged between the adjacent peaks and the adjacent valleys, the connecting wall extends outwards from the outer edge of the main body as viewed along the vibration axis, and the extending direction of the connecting wall deviates from the center point of the main body. The surrounding piece of the cone has good elasticity and good strength, ensures the stability of the cone in the vibration process, and improves the distortion caused by the split vibration.

title_en: Cooling control method, cooling control system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooling control method, a cooling control system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining the working mode of a charger to be a charging mode, and acquiring real-time temperature data of the charger and a preset step temperature threshold interval; determining a target step temperature threshold interval corresponding to the real-time temperature data in a preset step temperature threshold interval according to the temperature value of the real-time temperature data, and acquiring a target cooling strategy associated with the target step temperature threshold interval in a preset strategy library based on the target step temperature threshold interval. According to the method, the charging state of the charger is identified, the target cooling strategy can be accurately allocated, the problem of energy waste caused by excessive heat dissipation in the traditional method is solved, the cooling energy consumption is effectively reduced, the rapid matching of the cooling strategy is realized through the stepped temperature threshold interval, and the cooling efficiency is improved.

title_en: Driving chip and clock signal processing method and device thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a driving chip and a method and a device for processing clock signals of the driving chip, wherein a target functional module to be operated is determined according to a target working scene of the driving chip, a target clock signal with target clock frequency is obtained according to a reference clock signal corresponding to the target functional module, and the target clock signal is provided to the corresponding target functional module, so that the target clock signal with the corresponding target clock frequency can be provided to the target functional module according to different target working scenes, the frequency of the clock signal in the driving chip can be adaptively adjusted, the power consumption of the functional module under at least partial working scenes is saved, and the power consumption of the driving chip and a display panel is further saved.

title_en: Microphone main body and desktop microphone
abstract_en: The application discloses a microphone main body and a desktop microphone, wherein the microphone main body is applied to the desktop microphone, the desktop microphone further comprises a wireless communicator used for being connected with a terminal, and the microphone main body comprises a shell, a main control module, a wired interface module and a wireless module. The shell is provided with a containing cavity, at least part of the main control module is positioned in the containing cavity and connected with the shell, the main control module is used for controlling the receiving and transmitting of audio signals, at least part of the wired interface module is positioned in the containing cavity, the wired interface module is electrically connected with the main control module, at least part of the wireless module is positioned in the containing cavity, the wireless module is electrically connected with the main control module, and the wireless module is used for wirelessly communicating with the wireless communicator. The design thoroughly solves the problem that the stability of the wired desktop microphone and the flexibility of the wireless desktop microphone cannot be achieved by integrating the wired interface module and the wireless module in the shell of the same desktop microphone main body.

title_en: SMT paster printing system of real-time supervision solder paste quality
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of equipment for manufacturing printed circuits, in particular to an SMT patch printing system for monitoring solder paste quality in real time. The system comprises an image acquisition module, a frequency domain feature extraction module, a three-dimensional morphology reconstruction module, a structure consistency analysis module, a defect judging module and a result output module, wherein a solder paste printing image is subjected to fine processing by combining a frequency domain-airspace double-branch feature extraction network to generate a defect significance heat map, potential defects are subjected to space positioning and contour calibration based on a region growing and connected domain analysis method, typical printing defects such as solder paste fracture, migration, edge collapse, multiple tin, fewer tin and the like are identified, the key quality problems are processed preferentially, and the quality control efficiency is improved.

title_en: Distribution device and distribution method
abstract_en: The invention provides a distribution device and a distribution method, which can optimally edit a captured image and distribute the edited captured image. The delivery device (100) is provided with an operation unit (30) that receives an operation, an acquisition unit (81) that acquires a second captured image (130) captured by a second camera (20) mounted on a vehicle (3) and a first captured image (120) captured by a first camera (10) mounted on the vehicle (3), an image editing unit (83) that edits the second captured image (130) based on the first captured image (120) when a predetermined operation is received by the operation unit (30), and a delivery unit (85) that delivers an edited image obtained by editing the second captured image (130).

title_en: Naked eye 3D display optimization method based on real-time eyeball tracking
abstract_en: The invention discloses a naked eye 3D display optimization method based on real-time eyeball tracking, which particularly relates to the technical field of naked eye 3D display, and comprises the steps of capturing eyeball motion data in real time through a visual angle tracking sensor and collecting illumination information by combining an ambient light sensor; the method comprises the steps of calculating depth perception parameters based on pupil diameter variation and frequency, generating a time sequence prediction type dynamic compensation coefficient by combining eyeball motion acceleration, obtaining initial fixation point coordinates by utilizing an improved spherical projection mapping model, obtaining real-time coordinates by correction of the compensation coefficient, and finally dynamically adjusting optical modulation parameters such as refractive index distribution of a nano-structure layer, rotation angle of a polarizer, focal length of an optical lens and the like according to the real-time coordinates. According to the invention, the real-time distance is calculated through the binocular parallax algorithm, and the depth mapping value is generated by combining the focal length of the camera and the base line distance, so that the illumination change and the user visual angle can be self-adapted, and the 3D display effect is optimized.

title_en: Fall detection method, wearable device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a fall detection method, a wearable device and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of fall detection, and discloses a fall detection method which is applied to the wearable device, wherein the wearable device comprises an acceleration sensor and at least one other sensor except the acceleration sensor, and the fall detection method comprises the steps of acquiring acceleration data acquired by the acceleration sensor based on time sequence; if the acceleration data accords with the free falling acceleration performance in the first period and accords with the impact rebound acceleration performance in the second period, the falling impact event is judged to be detected, the falling detection result determined based on the detection data acquired by other sensors is obtained in response to the falling impact event, and if the falling detection result is that the falling event exists, the falling event response process is triggered. Based on the above, when falling collision is detected, detection and identification are performed based on other sensor parameters, so that the falling detection accuracy of collision caused by falling is improved.

title_en: Audio processing method and audio equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses an audio processing method and audio equipment, and relates to the technical field of audio signal processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining target acoustic parameters and actual acoustic parameters of an audio channel for calibrating a filter to be calibrated under the condition that audio equipment plays an audio signal through the audio channel corresponding to the filter to be calibrated, wherein the audio channel comprises an amplitude compensation filter, a scale adjustment filter and a phase compensation filter which are sequentially connected, the filter to be calibrated is at least one of the amplitude compensation filter, the scale adjustment filter and the phase compensation filter, determining the target filtering parameters of the filter to be calibrated according to the sequence of the filter to be calibrated in the audio channel, sequentially according to the target acoustic parameters and the actual acoustic parameters of the filter to be calibrated, updating the filtering parameters of the filter to be calibrated to the target filtering parameters to obtain the calibrated filter, and executing audio playing processing according to the audio channel corresponding to the calibrated filter.

title_en: Porous ceramic skeleton-PTFE composite membrane and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a porous ceramic skeleton-PTFE composite membrane, a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of new materials. The porous ceramic skeleton-PTFE composite membrane comprises a ceramic skeleton and a PTFE layer, wherein the PTFE layer is attached to the surface of the ceramic skeleton, and the ceramic skeleton has a network-shaped structure. The porous ceramic skeleton-PTFE composite film has lower linear thermal expansion coefficient and higher thermal conductivity, the linear thermal expansion coefficient can be reduced to below 50% of the conventional PTFE material, the thermal conductivity can be improved to above 15 times of the conventional PTFE material, and the lower dielectric constant and dielectric loss are maintained.

title_en: Sports evaluation intelligent ai detection method and system thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a sports evaluation intelligent ai detection method and a system thereof, which solve the problem of poor interference resistance to external factors, and comprise the steps of acquiring first image information and second image information, wherein a first camera and a second camera are synchronously started and stopped; the first shooting area and the second shooting area are overlapped and defined as overlapping areas, the first testing area and the second testing area are both positioned in the overlapping areas, whether a fuzzy area exists in the first image information or the second image information is judged, if the fuzzy area exists in the first image information, the second image information corresponding to the first image information is called based on a time axis, and the first image information and the second image information are combined to serve as evaluation data to perform evaluation. According to the application, the two cameras are used for data acquisition, the data acquired by any one camera has problems, and the data acquired by the other camera can be complemented, so that the anti-interference capability is improved.

title_en: Electromagnetic shielding film and circuit board
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electromagnetic shielding, and discloses an electromagnetic shielding film and a circuit board, wherein the electromagnetic shielding film comprises a glue film layer, an electromagnetic shielding layer and an insulating layer, the electromagnetic shielding layer is arranged on one side surface of the glue film layer, the insulating layer is arranged on one side of the electromagnetic shielding layer, which is far away from the glue film layer, the insulating layer comprises an insulating body and first fillers dispersed in the insulating body, the first fillers have maximum transverse dimensions in the extending direction of the first fillers and maximum longitudinal dimensions in the direction perpendicular to the extending direction, the ratio of the maximum transverse dimensions to the maximum longitudinal dimensions of at least part of the first fillers is 2-35, and the extending direction of the first fillers is parallel to or forms an acute angle with the extending direction of the insulating layer. The first filler is capable of dispersing local stresses applied to the insulating layer, thereby improving the tear resistance of the insulating layer, and even the tear resistance of the electromagnetic shielding film as a whole.

title_en: Circuit board and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a circuit board and a manufacturing method thereof. The circuit substrates are stacked on each other, and each circuit substrate comprises an insulating substrate and a conductive through hole arranged in the insulating substrate. The conductive through holes are communicated with two opposite sides of the insulating substrate. The conductive layers are arranged between the conductive through holes and are electrically connected through the conductive layers, and the conductive layers comprise nano hole structures. Therefore, the connection strength between the conductive through holes of each circuit substrate is increased under the condition that the electrical connection is not affected, so that the reliability of the circuit board is improved.

title_en: Preparation method and application of carbonized fabric
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbonized fabric and a preparation method thereof. By introducing metal chloride salt solution (such as cobalt chloride, nickel chloride and other metal chloride salts) as the char-forming coating, the conductive network can be stabilized in the carbonization process, the microstructure regulation and control capability can be improved, and the high temperature resistance and oxidation resistance of the material can be enhanced. The material takes renewable fibers as raw materials, realizes carbon conversion through a green low-energy-consumption process, has good electromagnetic shielding performance and flexible structure, and has corrosion resistance and practicality, and can be widely applied to the fields of intelligent electronics, wearable equipment, building protection and the like.

title_en: Test assembly and test system
abstract_en: The invention provides a test assembly which comprises a substrate, an interface conversion card, a cable and a light guide column. The interface conversion card is provided with a first end and a second end, and the first end of the interface conversion card is arranged on the substrate. The cable has a first end and a second end, the first end of the cable is electrically connected with the second end of the interface conversion card, and the second end of the cable is arranged on the substrate. The light guide column is arranged on the substrate, and one side of the light guide column is arranged adjacent to the interface conversion card or the cable. The substrate has a first surface, the interface conversion card has a second surface, and the second surface is substantially perpendicular to the first surface.

title_en: Method and apparatus for image encoding and decoding
abstract_en: Techniques are provided for improving the efficiency of indication in a rate control context that manages a desired ratio of bit rate load and quality in image compression. There is provided a method for encoding an image comprising obtaining the image, encoding the image into a bitstream based on a first coding parameter, wherein the first coding parameter represents a first displacement between a first target rate control parameter and a first reference rate control parameter, and encoding the first coding parameter into the bitstream. Further, a method for decoding an image is provided, comprising receiving a code stream comprising coded data of the image, parsing the code stream to obtain a first coding parameter, wherein the first coding parameter represents a first displacement between a first target rate control parameter and a first reference rate control parameter, reconstructing the image based on the first coding parameter.

title_en: Ward monitoring method, system, terminal and storage medium based on multi-mode large model and edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing and discloses a ward monitoring method, a ward monitoring system, a ward monitoring terminal and a ward monitoring storage medium based on a multi-mode large model and edge calculation, wherein the method comprises the steps of inputting query voice of a user into a target large language model and outputting a response result; the method comprises the steps of inputting preprocessed video stream data into a fall detection model, outputting a fall detection result, constructing an abnormal behavior classification model, inputting the preprocessed video stream data into the abnormal behavior classification model, outputting an abnormal behavior classification result, carrying out face key point recognition and emotion state classification processing on the preprocessed video stream data to obtain an emotion state assessment result, and carrying out standardization processing and risk early warning processing on a response result, the fall detection result, the abnormal behavior classification result and the emotion state assessment result to obtain a ward monitoring early warning result. The invention can effectively improve the timeliness and accuracy of ward monitoring by constructing the multi-mode large model to detect the state of the patient in real time.

title_en: Quantum dot, composition containing quantum dot and display panel
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a quantum dot, and a composition and a display panel containing the same. The quantum dot comprises a first ligand and a second ligand, wherein the first ligand is one or two selected from phosphate acrylic ester and phosphite acrylic ester, and the second ligand comprises a sulfhydryl ligand and a carboxyl ligand. The first ligand and the second ligand of the quantum dot can react with carbon-carbon double bonds under the condition of light or heat, so that the first ligand and the second ligand are chemically crosslinked on the surface of the quantum dot, and the ligand is locked on the surface of the quantum dot, thereby better protecting the quantum dot. The quantum dots having the above ligands have good solubility in highly polar acrylates.

title_en: Heat radiation structure of high-efficient dc-to-ac converter
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of heat dissipation of inverters, in particular to a heat dissipation structure of a high-efficiency inverter, which comprises a mounting shell, wherein a shell is arranged in the mounting shell, an inverter body is arranged in the shell, the inner wall of the mounting shell and the outer wall of the shell are arranged at intervals and jointly enclose a heat dissipation air cavity, a first air inlet, a second air inlet and a first air outlet which are communicated with the heat dissipation air cavity are arranged on the mounting shell, a heat dissipation fan is arranged in the first air inlet, a dust filtering net is arranged in the second air inlet, the second air inlet is communicated with the interior of the shell through an air guide channel, a cooling main pipe, an air outlet unit and a second air outlet are arranged on the shell, the cooling main pipe is positioned in the shell and provided with a third air inlet corresponding to the first air inlet, the air outlet unit is communicated with the cooling main pipe and provided with a third air outlet, and the second air outlet and the third air outlet are both communicated with the heat dissipation air cavity. The application can improve the heat dissipation effect on the inverter body.

title_en: Display with good heat dissipation effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of displays, in particular to a display with good heat dissipation effect, two U-shaped bellows are symmetrically arranged on two sides of a fixed seat, a cross rod inserted into a cavity is arranged at the middle part of the U-shaped bellows, a thread groove is arranged in the cross rod, the threaded rod is inserted into the thread groove and is in threaded connection with the cross rod, a first heat dissipation fan is arranged on one side of the U-shaped bellows, an air inlet pipe inserted into the U-shaped bellows is arranged at the air outlet end of the first heat dissipation fan, and the dynamic adjustment of a heat dissipation path is realized through the linkage of a temperature sensor, a motor and the heat dissipation fan.

title_en: Nickel stripping agent for IC carrier plate and preparation method and nickel stripping method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nickel removing agent for an IC carrier plate, a preparation method thereof and a nickel removing method thereof, and relates to the technical field of semiconductor packaging. The IC carrier plate nickel removing agent comprises, by mass, 3.0-8.0% of a main reactant, 1.0-5.0% of a complexing agent, 1.0-5.0% of a wetting agent, 1.0-5.0% of an accelerator and 0.5-2.5% of a stabilizer, wherein the main reactant is one or more of phenethylperoxy acid 1, 1-dimethylethyl ester, methyl peroxy acid 1, 1-dimethylethyl ester and perisononic acid 1, 1-dimethylethyl ester, and the complexing agent is one or more of N, N-dimethylimidazole-1-sulfonamide, N-cyclohexyl-p-toluenesulfonamide and 2-acrylamido-2-methylpropanesulfonic acid. The invention provides a nickel removing agent for an IC carrier plate, a preparation method thereof and a nickel removing method thereof.

title_en: Compact modularized high-power thyristor converter with bypass
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compact modularized high-power thyristor converter with bypass, which relates to the field of high-power converter systems of nuclear fusion devices, wherein a bypass module is arranged in a converter cabinet body and is directly connected with a direct current positive bus and a direct current negative bus of the converter in parallel to form a shortest impedance energy discharging channel to realize microsecond-level fault current transfer and protect a thyristor and a superconducting magnet, the thyristor of an in-phase upper bridge arm and a low-phase thyristor are led in from the bottom of a double-alternating current bus with a phase difference of 180 degrees, are intensively arranged along a high degree, are connected with a quick fuse on a quick melting row through a long and short aluminum arc-shaped flexible connection, so that bridge arm current is reversely counteracted, the theoretical value of the magnetic flux density of the cabinet body is zero, the eddy current loss is obviously reduced, a cooling water loop is connected with the thyristor row and the bypass module in series to share one path, the design of the cooling water loop is simplified, the buffer loop is arranged close to the direct current bus, the voltage and current mutation is restrained, and a non-magnetic steel frame can open a heat dissipation door, so that the bridge is small in occupied area, the expansion is easy, and the cost is low.

title_en: Human-vehicle interaction intelligent experience method and system based on UWB
abstract_en: The invention provides a human-vehicle interaction intelligent experience method and system based on UWB, wherein the human-vehicle interaction intelligent experience method comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional positioning network, analyzing UWB labels carried by target users, outputting coordinate data of the UWB labels, eliminating signal jitter of the coordinate data through Kalman filtering, normalizing the coordinate data to generate a coordinate track, matching the coordinate track with a preset template, generating a control instruction, controlling a digital projection headlight to project images according to the control instruction, and activating vehicle-mounted sound to play feedback sound effects. The invention solves the technical problem that the current man-vehicle interaction is more dependent on manual triggering of a vehicle-machine end, and is inconvenient when a user who needs to carry out man-vehicle interaction on the rear row of the vehicle or outside the vehicle is required.

title_en: Backlight power supply circuit and display device
abstract_en: The application discloses a backlight power supply circuit and a display device, which are characterized in that power supply lines of a first color light-emitting source and a second color light-emitting source are combined to supply power, a first driving current signal for driving the first color light-emitting source is adjusted, the amplitude of the first driving current signal is increased, current flowing through the first color light-emitting source when being lightened is increased, the duty ratio of the first driving current signal is reduced, so that the voltage of pins of a driving circuit corresponding to the first color light-emitting source is reduced, the pin voltages of driving circuits corresponding to other color light-emitting sources are not changed, and then the difference of the pin voltages of the driving circuits is not large, namely the problem of temperature rise caused by the increase of the pin voltages corresponding to the first color light-emitting source when the backlight power supply circuit is combined with a power supply line is effectively solved.

title_en: Data processing method, transmitting end, data processing system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a data processing method, a sending end, a data processing system and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of data processing. The data processing method comprises the steps of carrying out coding processing on collected visual data through an encoder to obtain coded data, sending transmission data determined based on the coded data to a connected receiving end based on a push stream service provided by a push stream server, and adjusting coding parameters of the encoder according to feedback information sent by the receiving end. The data processing system comprises a sending end, a push server and a receiving end, wherein the push server is used for providing push service for the sending end, the sending end is used for conducting coding processing on collected visual data through an encoder to obtain coded data, based on the push service, transmission data determined based on the coded data are sent to the receiving end, the receiving end is used for determining feedback information based on the playing state of the received transmission data, and the sending end is used for adjusting coding parameters of the encoder according to the feedback information.

title_en: Energy-adjustable customized power supply
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vehicle-mounted charging, in particular to an energy-adjustable customized power supply, which comprises a shell, a first mounting plate and the like, wherein the first mounting plate is arranged on the shell, the shell is arranged in a circular tube shape, and the first mounting plate is used for plugging an electric plug. Compared with a conventional vehicle-mounted mobile power supply, the space occupied by the roller is mostly overlapped with the space occupied by the shell, the space occupied by the roller in the vehicle is reduced, and because the diameter of the roller is far larger than that of a conventional pulley, the roller can easily stride over structures with height differences such as steps, and the like, without the need of personnel to actively lift and carry the vehicle-mounted mobile power supply, so that the difficulty of personnel carrying the vehicle-mounted mobile power supply is greatly reduced, and meanwhile, when the vehicle-mounted mobile power supply is transferred, the first mounting plate and the second mounting plate are protected through the protective cover, so that the damage to internal parts caused by the entry of impurities such as accumulated water, sediment and the like into the inner cavity is prevented, and the safety and reliability of the vehicle-mounted mobile power supply are improved.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: In an embodiment of the present invention, a display device is disclosed in which a conductive layer disposed under a semiconductor layer of a driving transistor corresponds to at least a channel region of the semiconductor layer, thereby preventing disconnection of the semiconductor layer due to a lower step, and a capacitor is formed by a plurality of conductive layers overlapping the channel region of the semiconductor layer and disposed under and on top of the semiconductor layer to secure a large capacitance. The display device according to one embodiment includes a first conductive line, a first electrode disposed on and overlapping the first conductive line, a semiconductor layer disposed on and overlapping the first electrode, a second electrode disposed on and overlapping the semiconductor layer, and a third electrode disposed on the second electrode, the third electrode overlapping the second electrode and electrically connected to the semiconductor layer and the first electrode, wherein a region of the semiconductor layer overlapping the second electrode overlaps the first conductive line.

title_en: Physical training equipment with posture monitoring and correcting functions
abstract_en: The invention discloses physical training equipment with a posture monitoring and correcting function, and relates to the technical field of physical training. The intelligent training device comprises a training bottom plate, a physical training unit circumferentially arranged on the training bottom plate and a gesture monitoring unit arranged at the upper end of the training bottom plate, wherein a sensor detection module is used for realizing omnibearing monitoring of training actions through combination application of a pressure sensor, a gyroscope sensor and an acceleration sensor, multidimensional data are combined with image analysis of a camera module, gesture deviation is accurately identified, a projection module is matched with a display screen assembly, correction guidance can be projected to a training area or displayed on a screen in real time, a trainer can instantly adjust actions, and motion damage caused by gesture errors is avoided.

title_en: Low-voltage wireless flexible electrotactile feedback system based on conductive hydrogel electrode and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flexible electronics and man-machine interaction, in particular to a low-voltage wireless flexible electrotactile feedback system based on a conductive hydrogel electrode and application thereof, wherein a flexible tactile interface formed by using a PDMS packaging layer and a conductive hydrogel electrode array has Young modulus matched with human skin, and the flexible tactile interface has stable conductivity after stretching circulation and excellent biomechanical matching property and interface stability; meanwhile, the Bluetooth chip receives the instruction, the power management module supplies power, the isolation module ensures safety, the voltage amplification module enhances signals, the inversion module converts direct current into periodic alternating current, voltage lower than 20V is output to be electrically stimulated to the hydrogel electrode array, and touch perception can be effectively triggered.

title_en: Speaker testing mechanism and speaker parameter testing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a loudspeaker testing mechanism and a loudspeaker parameter testing method, and relates to the technical field of loudspeaker testing. The loudspeaker testing mechanism comprises a mounting frame, a profiling module, a laser detection module and a power-on module, wherein the profiling module is arranged on the mounting frame, a profiling groove is formed in the top of the profiling module, the profiling groove is used for adapting to the shape of one end, far away from the magnetic circuit system, of the basin frame, a signal acquisition hole is formed in the bottom wall of the profiling groove, the laser detection module is located on one side, far away from the basin frame, of the profiling module, outgoing light of the laser detection module is arranged towards the signal acquisition hole, and the power-on module is used for being electrically connected with a terminal.

title_en: Power module
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a power module including a circuit board, a power device, an output capacitor, a positive output terminal, and a magnetic piece. The power device is arranged on the upper surface of the circuit board. The output capacitor is respectively arranged on the upper surface and the lower surface of the circuit board and comprises a positive electrode connecting terminal which is electrically connected into the circuit board. The positive output terminal is arranged on the circuit board. The winding of the magnetic piece is arranged in the circuit board. In the first direction, the positive output terminal and the positive connection terminal do not overlap in vertical projection. The outflow end is electrically connected with the positive electrode connection terminal and the positive output terminal respectively, and the winding current is configured to pass through a common part of the winding, and the winding current comprises a direct current component and at least one alternating current component. The direct current component flows in from the inflow end of the common portion, flows through the outflow end of the common portion, and flows to the positive output terminal. The at least one ac component includes a first ac component flowing in from the inflow end of the common portion, through the outflow end of the common portion, and toward the positive connection terminal of the output capacitor.

title_en: Self-locking split-flow micro-channel liquid cooling plate
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of micro-channel liquid cooling, in particular to a self-locking split-flow micro-channel liquid cooling plate. Including mainboard and subplate, the surface of mainboard and subplate has all been overlapped the bottom plate, the internal surface of mainboard, subplate and two bottom plates is inserted and is equipped with upper plate and hypoplastron, hypoplastron cover is on the surface of upper plate, the internal surface of hypoplastron and upper plate is inserted and is equipped with the fin, the upper surface of mainboard and subplate is fixedly connected with inlet tube and outlet pipe respectively, the surface of inlet tube is equipped with filter equipment, filter equipment is including the sleeve of cover at inlet tube surface, the inside partial structure of sleeve and inlet tube inner wall threaded connection, through the mainboard, the subplate, the bottom plate, the multiple plates nest of upper plate, the hypoplastron insert and establish the structure, cooperate the built-in design of fin, form firm whole assembly system, promote liquid cooling plate structure intensity, simultaneously from locking-type structure can be convenient when damage appears in a certain part, in time change damaging the part.

title_en: Manufacturing process of thermoelectric separation substrate and thermoelectric separation substrate
