abstract_en: The invention discloses a manufacturing process of a thermoelectric separation substrate and the thermoelectric separation substrate, wherein the manufacturing process of the thermoelectric separation substrate comprises the following steps of S1, providing a metal substrate, S2, manufacturing a via hole, a thermoelectric separation area groove and a preliminary circuit pattern on the metal substrate, S3, cutting a blind groove in the thermoelectric separation area groove on the metal substrate, S4, performing electroplating hole filling operation on the via hole formed in the step S2, S5, performing second pattern transfer on a plate surface processed in the step S4, performing electroplating filling treatment on the blind groove, and S6, manufacturing an outer layer circuit on the plate surface of the electroplated metal substrate. The thermoelectric separation substrate is manufactured by the manufacturing process of the thermoelectric separation substrate.

title_en: Wide temperature range cooling system
abstract_en: The invention provides a wide-temperature-range heat radiation system which comprises a compressor, a condenser, an electronic expansion valve, a heat exchanger, a radiator, a cold source box and a cold flow pump, wherein the condenser and the heat exchanger are arranged in a load, the compressor, the condenser, the electronic expansion valve and the heat exchanger are sequentially connected in series by pipelines to form a closed-loop external circulation heat radiation flow path, an epitaxial flow path is arranged in the radiator, an internal circulation flow path is further arranged in the load, the epitaxial flow path, the cold source box, the cold flow pump and the internal circulation flow path are sequentially connected in series by pipelines to form a closed-loop internal circulation heat radiation flow path, a fan is further arranged in the load, an air outlet of the fan is respectively aligned with the radiator and the condenser, and the fan, the compressor, the electronic expansion valve and the cold flow pump are further electrically connected with a controller. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, when the compressor cannot be started and operated normally, the controller adjusts the rotating speed of the fan, so that the cold source maintains circulating flow in the external circulating heat dissipation flow path or the internal circulating heat dissipation flow path, and the requirement of continuous heat dissipation of the load is met.

title_en: LNG loading sled of automatic butt joint tank car
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of LNG receiving stations, in particular to an LNG truck-loading sled for automatically docking a tank truck, which comprises a connecting component, wherein the LNG truck-loading sled further comprises a long-range camera and a short-range camera, the long-range camera is positioned at the highest position of the LNG truck-loading sled, the end part of the long-range camera is used for shooting towards a fixed direction, a shooting area is preset by taking the long-range camera as an origin, the shooting area is of a semicircular structure, the shooting area is used for detecting the relative position between a vehicle and the LNG truck-loading sled, the short-range camera is arranged at the upper part of the connecting component, and the short-range camera is used for capturing a vehicle interface. The invention improves the accuracy of butt joint alignment and effectively reduces the operation interruption caused by positioning failure.

title_en: Sampling cone with autonomous cooling function for plasma mass spectrometer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sampling cone for a plasma mass spectrometer with an autonomous cooling function, which comprises a sealing surface, wherein the sealing surface is provided with a cone, the interior of the cone is provided with a spiral cooling flow channel, and the preparation method of the sampling cone for the plasma mass spectrometer with the autonomous cooling function comprises the following steps of processing a cooling flow channel core, performing compression forming, performing high-temperature sintering, performing contour processing, and processing the inner surface of the flow channel. According to the design principle of active cooling, the invention determines an optimal structural form, designs a spiral cooling flow passage, realizes effective control of service temperature of the sampling cone in the operation process, eliminates temperature impact of the ionization process on the sampling cone, improves strength and corrosion resistance of the sampling cone in service, has simple preparation process, does not change the assembly form of the existing sampling cone, has service life far longer than that of the existing structure, and has wide application prospect in equipment such as an inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometer and the like.

title_en: Control circuit board suitable for endoscope lens module and assembly method
abstract_en: The invention provides a control circuit board and an assembly method suitable for an endoscope lens module, wherein the control circuit board comprises a flexible circuit board and supporting pieces, the supporting pieces comprise a first supporting piece, a second supporting piece and a third supporting piece, the flexible circuit board comprises a first side face and a second side face opposite to the first side face, and the first supporting piece, the second supporting piece and the third supporting piece are arranged on the second side face at intervals. The invention can greatly reduce the welding difficulty, greatly reduce the processing difficulty, improve the production efficiency and is easy to assemble and maintain in the later period.

title_en: Connector, connector module and communication equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a connector, a connector module and communication equipment. The connector includes a first signal transmission unit including a first signal transmission portion and a cable. The first signal transmission part is provided with two signal transmission terminals which are arranged at intervals in the first direction, and the cable is provided with two signal wire cores which are in one-to-one correspondence with the two signal transmission terminals. Each signal transmission terminal only comprises a first part which is connected with the other connector in sequence in the second direction and a second part which is fixed with the corresponding signal wire core of the cable and is electrically connected with the corresponding signal wire core of the cable, and the relative positions of the first parts of the two signal transmission terminals are ensured to be unchanged by the second part. Through setting up the connector into this kind of structure, saved the space of fixed part, can effectively reduce the space occupation of connector in the communication equipment direction of height, also be favorable to the further promotion of communication equipment speed.

title_en: Display panel, display module and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of electronic equipment, and discloses a display panel, a display module and electronic equipment, so as to improve the display effect of the display panel. The display panel comprises a display area and a non-display area, wherein the display area comprises a first sub-display area and X second sub-display areas, the length of a metal wire in the first sub-display area is different from that of a metal wire in the second sub-display area, the non-display area is provided with a grid driving circuit, the grid driving circuit comprises a first shift register group and X second shift register groups, the signal output end of each first shift register in the first shift register group is connected with each metal wire in the first sub-display area in a one-to-one correspondence manner, the signal output end of each second shift register in each second shift register group is connected with each metal wire in the corresponding second sub-display area in a one-to-one correspondence manner, and the width-to-length ratio of a channel region of a transistor of the first shift register is different from that of a channel region of a transistor of the second shift register.

title_en: Image processing method and display device
abstract_en: The application provides an image processing method and a display device, wherein the image processing method comprises the steps of identifying image data to obtain an identification result, adjusting the image data according to the identification result to obtain new image data, dividing the new image data into a plurality of bit planes, respectively storing the bit planes in a plurality of block caches of at least one frame cache, wherein each block cache is used for storing a plurality of lines of data in each bit plane, transmitting the plurality of lines of data of the block caches to the plurality of line caches, loading the plurality of lines of data of the line caches to a display unit, adjusting an original dimming factor of the image data according to the identification result to obtain the new dimming factor, and generating a plurality of parallel luminous control signals according to the new dimming factor to control luminous time of a plurality of pixels of the display unit.

title_en: Method for operating a hearing device and hearing device
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for operating a hearing device (1). The hearing device (1) comprises an internal energy source (12) and a receiver (6) configured to be worn in the ear canal of a user and to generate air-conducted sound by using a receiver coil. The method comprises activating a drying mode of the receiver (6), in which drying mode a drying voltage (Ud) having a drying voltage value of at most 10V is fed to the receiver coil, and heating the receiver (6) by resistive heating with the receiver coil fed with the drying voltage (Ud).

title_en: Remote duty monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a remote duty monitoring method and a remote duty monitoring system, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out geometric analysis on an included angle of a door body orientation angle and an airflow speed vector according to environment interaction parameters, combining a gap width interval to determine potential smoke diffusion risk levels, extracting feature data of similar scenes from a pre-established historical case matching database according to a judging result of high-risk combination to generate corresponding risk scene tags, determining treatment priority, merging airflow interaction intensity and smoke concentration readings according to a judging result of an accelerating smoke diffusion channel to determine a high-risk scene judging result, if the high-risk scene is judged, retrieving a treatment protocol sequence corresponding to the treatment priority and the risk scene tags from the database to generate a real-time response instruction, and automatically adjusting a fireproof door state to obtain an optimized safety configuration state.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: Provided is a roll-up display device capable of mounting electronic components such as a camera. The display device includes a case, a display panel which is provided so as to be capable of being advanced and retracted with respect to one surface of the case and is capable of being wound up, a wound up body which is accommodated in the case and winds up the display panel, an electronic component unit which is provided at an end portion of the display panel in an unreeling direction, and a control board which is accommodated in the case, the electronic component unit having a 1 st terminal portion at a position opposed to the one surface of the case, a 2 nd terminal portion being provided on the one surface of the case, the 2 nd terminal portion being connected to the control board, and the 2 nd terminal portion being in contact with the 1 st terminal portion in a state in which at least the display panel is wound up with respect to the wound up body to the maximum extent.

title_en: Electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses electronic equipment which comprises a first body, a second body and a power management piece, wherein the first body comprises a display part, the second body comprises a shell part and a carrier arranged on the shell part, the carrier is used for carrying and conducting electronic elements, the carrier is connected with the display part through a flexible circuit board, and the power management piece is arranged on the shell part and is connected with the flexible circuit board through a wire harness assembly.

title_en: Photovoltaic inverter structure capable of improving anti-interference capability
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of anti-interference photovoltaic inverter structures, in particular to a photovoltaic inverter structure for improving the anti-interference capability, which comprises a wall body, wherein a fixing bolt is fixedly connected to the side wall of the wall body and symmetrically arranged, a photovoltaic inverter body is arranged in the middle of the fixing bolt, a connecting mechanism is arranged on a side wall mounting table of the photovoltaic inverter body, the end part of the connecting mechanism is connected with a bearing frame and is arranged on one side of the photovoltaic inverter body in a surrounding mode, a supporting frame is fixedly connected to the side wall of the bearing frame, an anti-interference plate is arranged on the side wall of the bearing frame and the side wall of the supporting frame, buckling blocks are distributed on the side wall of the anti-interference plate in a matrix mode, the buckling blocks are buckled with the supporting frame and the anti-interference plate, a shielding space can be provided for the inverter through the structure, internal electromagnetic energy is prevented from leaking out, and meanwhile, external electromagnetic interference can be prevented from entering the inside of the inverter, so that the whole operation is more stable.

title_en: Estimating weighted prediction parameters
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for estimating weighted prediction parameters intended for predicting an image block.

title_en: Blind hole filling method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of circuit board manufacturing, and particularly relates to a blind hole filling method. The method comprises the steps of firstly electroplating and filling holes of blind holes at a first time by adopting a first current density when the blind holes are filled to form a conductive substrate, secondly electroplating and filling holes of the blind holes at a second time by adopting a second current density, gradually increasing the second current density in a lifting trend in the second time to gradually fill the blind holes, thirdly electroplating and filling holes at a third time by adopting a third current density, closing hole filling gaps and dissolving a loose copper layer by pulses, and fourthly electroplating and filling holes of the blind holes at a fourth time by adopting a fourth current density, and smoothing the copper layer by adopting a fourth current density with a low density. So as to avoid the problem that cavities appear in the blind holes in the electroplating process when the blind holes with larger deep diameter are filled.

title_en: Air conditioner with anti-freezing energy-saving machine room and control method
abstract_en: The air conditioner comprises an indoor side unit, an outdoor side unit and a soil source side unit, wherein the outdoor side unit is respectively connected with the indoor side unit and the soil source side unit, the indoor side unit comprises an evaporator, the outdoor side unit comprises an outdoor unit, the soil source side unit comprises a ground buried pipe, the outdoor unit is respectively connected with the evaporator and the ground buried pipe, the evaporator is used for carrying out heat exchange and refrigeration on air in the machine room, the ground buried pipe is used for providing a cooling water source for heat exchange with soil, and the outdoor unit is used for carrying out heat exchange between the evaporator and the ground buried pipe. The invention adopts the water-cooling and air-cooling machine room air conditioner outdoor unit, the cooling water of the soil source side unit is directly sprayed onto the heat exchange coil pipe of the condenser to exchange heat and take away heat, and the outdoor fan also carries out air-cooling heat exchange to take away heat. The air cooling and the water cooling are optimally switched, so that the problem of low energy efficiency of the air conditioning unit of the air cooling machine room in summer high-temperature severe weather is solved, and the best selection of the cold source is realized all the year round, so that the unit can be operated efficiently.

title_en: Pixel circuit and electronic device
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a pixel circuit and an electronic device. The pixel circuit includes a driving transistor including a control electrode connected to a first node, a first electrode receiving a first power voltage, and a second electrode connected to a second node, the driving transistor generating a driving current based on the voltage of the first node, a writing transistor applying a data voltage to the driving transistor in response to a writing gate signal, a control transistor including a control electrode receiving a control signal, a first electrode connected to the second node, and a second electrode connected to a fourth node, an emission transistor connecting the fourth node and the fifth node to each other in response to an emission signal, a light emitting element initializing transistor applying an initializing voltage to the fifth node in response to a bias signal, and a light emitting element including the first electrode connected to the fifth node and the second electrode receiving the second power voltage. The control signal is a direct voltage.

title_en: Nonlinear term cancellation moving magnet moving coil hybrid vibrator design method, device and application
abstract_en: The design method of the nonlinear item cancellation moving magnetic coil hybrid vibrator comprises the steps of (1) arranging a vibrator body, wherein the vibrator body comprises an outer barrel, a first vibration transmission sheet and a second vibration transmission sheet, a first rotor component and a second rotor component, the first rotor component comprises a magnet combination structure, the second rotor component comprises a coil combination structure, and (2) the first rotor component and the second rotor component are respectively subjected to electromagnetic acting forces of pushing force and pulling force in pairs at the same time, and the design method has the structural characteristics of push-pull, so that linear items in acting forces applied to the first rotor component and the second rotor component are overlapped and become larger, and nonlinear items in acting forces applied to the first rotor component and the second rotor component are partially or completely cancelled and reduced, so that the nonlinear item cancellation moving magnetic coil hybrid vibrator is obtained.

title_en: Touch-proof loudspeaker
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-touch loudspeaker, which comprises an upper shell, a lower shell, a voice coil, a ring magnet, an iron core column, a position adjusting mechanism, a gap control ring and a driving column, wherein the upper shell is provided with a plurality of grooves; according to the invention, during assembly, a structure with the position of the iron core column being adjustable is designed, when the position of the iron core column is adjusted, the adjusting column is moved in the adjusting channel by stirring, and meanwhile, the annular limiting disc moves in the annular limiting groove, so that the planar position of the iron core column is adjusted, and after the adjustment is finished, the locking is realized by rotating and pressing the peripheral end face of the lower end of the adjusting channel through the locking ring, so that the positioning of the iron core column is ensured.

title_en: Integrated device based on multi-vision collaborative small screen paste AC, flat cable and dispensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated device for small screen paste AC, flat cable and dispensing based on multi-vision cooperation, and relates to the technical field of screens; the invention comprises a plurality of units of the device, wherein a plurality of multi-vision cameras and a central controller are respectively arranged, a camera linkage system is formed among the plurality of multi-vision cameras, the central controller is used for analyzing data collected by the camera linkage system and collecting data of AC positions, winding displacement welding points and waterproof glue dispensing track data in real time.

title_en: Wearable device
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a wearable device capable of further improving user friendliness. The front unit includes at least an optical engine block and a light guide plate, and is disposed in front of both ears of a user when the user wears the wearable device. The rear unit includes at least a main base plate block and a battery block, and is disposed behind both ears of the user when the user wears the wearable device. Among the front units, a right front unit disposed in front of the right ear of the user and a left front unit disposed in front of the left ear of the user are separately provided, and the right front Fang Shanyuan and the left front unit are coupled through the rear unit. The present technology may be applied, for example, to wearable devices for AR.

title_en: Interaction between MV precision and MV difference codec
abstract_en: The interaction between MV precision and MV difference codec is described. In one exemplary aspect, a method for video processing includes determining whether a Symmetric Motion Vector Difference (SMVD) mode of a first block is enabled or disabled and/or how to apply a SMVD mode of the first block for a transition between the first block and a bitstream representation of the first block based on at least one of motion information, motion Vector Difference (MVD) precision, and Motion Vector (MV) precision of the first block of video, and performing the transition based on the determination.

title_en: Face white balance processing method, device, chip and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a face white balance processing method, a device, a chip and computer equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of extracting skin color pixel points from a face area of an image to be processed; the method comprises the steps of determining chromaticity data of skin color pixels under corresponding calibration color temperatures according to calibration white balance parameters of environment brightness corresponding to an image to be processed under different calibration color temperatures, determining target white balance parameters of the skin color pixels under the environment brightness according to deviation degrees between the chromaticity data of the skin color pixels under the calibration color temperatures and a target chromaticity range, and performing white balance processing on a face area according to the target white balance parameters. The application can improve the white balance effect.

title_en: Automatic focusing method, focusing system, computer readable storage medium and electronic device for wafer detection
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic focusing method, a focusing system, a computer readable storage medium and electronic equipment for wafer detection, wherein the automatic focusing method comprises the steps of collecting original images with different exposure times through a camera for a wafer surface focusing area, performing high dynamic range HDR synthesis and nonlinear correction to obtain a preprocessed image, calculating at least one quality evaluation index of the preprocessed image, judging that a current image is invalid and abandoned if the index does not reach a preset threshold value, executing subsequent steps if the index passes verification, extracting at least one focusing definition characteristic from the preprocessed image passing verification, calculating to obtain a comprehensive focusing score of the current image based on the extracted focusing definition characteristic, searching in the Z-axis direction, repeatedly executing the steps at different Z-axis positions to obtain the comprehensive focusing score corresponding to each position, and searching for a Z-axis position which enables the comprehensive focusing score to reach the maximum as an optimal focusing position.

title_en: Heterogeneous carbon-based heat conduction and wave absorption integrated material anchored by magnetic nanoparticles and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heterogeneous carbon-based heat conduction and wave absorption integrated material anchored by magnetic nano particles and a preparation method thereof, which belong to the field of functional composite materials, wherein after being subjected to acidification treatment, melamine foam is immersed into zinc salt, cobalt salt and 2-methylimidazole methanol solution, the obtained MF@ZnCo-ZIF is subjected to high-temperature calcination to obtain the heterogeneous carbon-based heat conduction and wave absorption integrated material anchored by Co magnetic nano particles, according to the invention, the prepared Co magnetic nanoparticle anchored heterogeneous carbon-based heat conduction wave-absorbing integrated material has the advantages of controllable morphology, high heat conductivity, strong wave-absorbing performance, adjustable performance and the like through the synergistic strengthening effect of the high graphitization heterogeneous carbon material with high heat conductivity and high dielectric loss and the Co magnetic nanoparticles with high magnetic conductivity and high magnetic loss, so that the actual requirements of different scenes can be met, and a new thought is provided for developing the high-performance heat conduction wave-absorbing integrated material.

title_en: Power distribution device, battery device and power utilization device
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of batteries, and particularly relates to a power distribution device, a battery device and an electric device, wherein an adapter is arranged in a shell of the power distribution device and is electrically connected with electrode pins and control boards of all electric elements, the control boards and the electric elements are arranged at intervals along a first direction, each electric element is provided with a first side surface opposite to the control boards and a second side surface adjacent to the first side surface, the electrode pins of the electric elements are arranged on the second side surface, so that the electrode pins do not occupy the space in the first direction, the interval space between the control boards and the electric elements can be relatively small, the size of the power distribution device is reduced, the electrode pins are electrically connected with the control boards through the adapter, the connection requirements of the electric elements at different positions can be met by controlling the structural form of the adapter, the position arrangement of the electric elements can be more flexible, the whole structural design of the power distribution device is optimized, and the whole size of the power distribution device is further reduced.

title_en: Intra-frame prediction method, device, electronic equipment, storage medium and product
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides an intra-frame prediction method, an intra-frame prediction device, an electronic device, a storage medium, and a product. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-dimensional characteristic data of a current coding unit, wherein the multi-dimensional characteristic data are used for representing texture characteristics and time domain coding rules of the current coding unit, performing mode analysis on the multi-dimensional characteristic data by utilizing a target classification model to obtain an angle prediction mode classification result corresponding to the current coding unit, determining a candidate angle prediction mode set according to the angle prediction mode classification result, determining a target angle prediction mode from the candidate angle prediction mode set to complete intra-frame prediction, and combining accurate mode analysis of the target classification model to achieve efficient screening of the candidate angle prediction mode set, so that the traversing quantity of the prediction modes is greatly reduced, the calculation complexity is reduced, and coding delay is further shortened.

title_en: Filtering method, device, electronic equipment, storage medium and product
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a filtering method, a filtering device, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a product. The method comprises the steps of obtaining gradient spatial distribution data and pixel change degree data of a coding unit in a video image, determining gradient distribution type of the coding unit based on the gradient spatial distribution data and pixel change type of the coding unit based on the pixel change degree data, determining a target filtering strategy corresponding to the coding unit according to a combination result of the gradient distribution type and the pixel change type, and performing filtering treatment on the coding unit by utilizing the target filtering strategy, so that limitation of single-dimension judgment in a traditional method can be avoided, the filtering strategy is accurately adapted to actual characteristics of the coding unit, and further the filtering effect of the video image can be improved.

title_en: High-temperature-resistant phosphorescent material, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-temperature-resistant Wen Linguang material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the phosphorescent material consists of a doped host and a luminescent object, the doped host has a chemical structure shown in a general formula (I), M  2 B 4 O 7 ·nH 2  O (I), wherein M is selected from sodium or potassium, n is greater than or equal to 0, the luminescent object is selected from at least one of aromatic carboxylic acid, aromatic carboxylic acid potassium or aromatic carboxylic acid sodium with a conjugated structure, and the high-temperature-resistant phosphorescent material has phosphorescence emission characteristics in a temperature range of-80 ℃ to 300 ℃. The invention solves the problem that the existing organic phosphorescent material cannot keep long-life luminescence at extremely high temperature of 200-300 ℃.

title_en: Drosophila platform for screening anti-aging drugs and drug screening method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drosophila platform for screening anti-aging drugs and a drug screening method thereof, wherein the drosophila platform comprises a pore plate, a plurality of holes, a plurality of drug screening device and a drug screening device, wherein each hole is configured to be loaded with the anti-aging drugs and drosophila feed and accommodate a plurality of drosophila; the anti-aging device comprises a cover plate, a camera assembly, a control module and an anti-aging module, wherein the cover plate is provided with a vent hole, the camera assembly is used for shooting videos of fruit flies, the control module is used for extracting movement tracks of the fruit flies based on the videos and outputting health life indexes, the health life indexes comprise total movement distance, maximum movement speed and central edge preference indexes in unit time, and a health life decline curve is constructed according to the health life indexes so as to evaluate the anti-aging drugs. Because the pore plate has a plurality of hole sites, and each hole site can hold a plurality of drosophila, can once only raise more drosophila, conveniently feed different medicines and adopt different doses to feed to through the healthy life index of video analysis, build healthy life decline curve in order to evaluate anti-aging medicine, thereby screening a large amount of anti-aging medicines fast.

title_en: Imaging enhancement method and imaging enhancement device under illumination mutation condition
abstract_en: The application provides an imaging enhancement method and an imaging enhancement device under an illumination abrupt change condition, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a brightness value and a contrast value of each pixel forming a current frame image, determining an exposure time adjustment amount required by each pixel according to the difference between the brightness value and the contrast value of each pixel and respective preset values, updating the exposure time of each pixel according to the exposure time adjustment amount, and collecting a next frame image by adopting the updated exposure time of each pixel. According to the application, pixel-level real-time exposure regulation and control are realized at an imaging end, the problems of local overexposure and underexposure under abrupt illumination are solved, and the image quality is improved.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted illumination acquisition and analysis system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of buildings, and particularly relates to a vehicle-mounted illumination acquisition and analysis system and method. The invention stably integrates the universal illuminometer and the motion camera through the special box-type bracket structure to form a set of independent, portable and low-cost vehicle-mounted acquisition structure, can automatically and continuously record the readings of the illuminometer in the normal running process of the vehicle, and can realize the automatic and synchronous acquisition of the illuminance data and the GPS geographic coordinates in the running process of the vehicle by matching with the GPS acquisition equipment. The collected data can be conveniently corrected and corrected by self-grinding software, and a standard structured table file corresponding to time-illuminance-longitude and latitude is integrated and output, so that direct and efficient data support is provided for urban illumination quality evaluation, spatial distribution research of night illumination data and the like.

title_en: Display screen configuration method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a configuration method and device of a display screen, computer equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of box configuration. The method comprises the steps of obtaining box topology configuration information, displaying a box topology structure on a display interface according to the box topology configuration information, obtaining display configuration information, displaying an initial display picture on the display interface according to the display configuration information, determining a target display picture according to the box topology structure and the initial display picture, and displaying the target display picture on the display interface. Therefore, in the same interface, the box topological structure, the initial display picture and the target display picture after the two are fused are displayed at the same time, and after the box topological structure and/or the initial display picture are changed, the target display picture is correspondingly changed, so that a user can intuitively see the debugging result (namely the target display picture) of the box screen in real time, and the debugging efficiency is improved.

title_en: Wireless low-delay video receiving end line block compression and linkage recovery system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless low-delay video receiving end row block compression and linkage recovery system, and belongs to the technical field of wireless video transmission and display. The system performs line block level visual lossless compression storage on the image after decoding at a receiving end to replace the traditional whole frame storage, and a display side reads the compressed line blocks as required and decompresses the compressed line blocks to enter a small-capacity display buffer. The technical innovations of self-adaptive line block compression strategy, intelligent prefetching mechanism, multi-level error detection, dynamic buffer management, frame rate linkage control and the like are combined, so that display delay is obviously reduced, and the recovery capacity and display fluency of the system under the interference of a wireless channel are improved. On the premise of ensuring visual nondestructive, the display delay can be reduced by more than 50%, the storage bandwidth requirement can be reduced by more than 65%, and the method is suitable for delay-sensitive application scenes such as wireless screen projection, remote control and video conference.

title_en: MEMS device and electroacoustic conversion device
abstract_en: The invention provides a MEMS device capable of suppressing the reduction of electroacoustic conversion characteristics. A MEMS device includes a chip having a movable portion, a first frame surrounding the movable portion, and a first connection portion connecting the movable portion to the first frame, and a piezoelectric element stacked on the first connection portion in a first direction from a position of the movable portion with respect to the first frame when no drive signal is applied to the piezoelectric element to a position of the movable portion with respect to the first frame when a bias voltage of the drive signal is applied to the piezoelectric element, and in a second direction opposite to the first direction when a minimum value of the drive signal is applied to the piezoelectric element.

title_en: Smart city guiding identification device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of guide marking devices and discloses a smart city guide marking device which comprises a first supporting rod, wherein the inner wall of the first supporting rod is slidably connected with a second supporting rod, the outer wall of the second supporting rod is fixedly connected with an upper display board, the inner wall of the upper display board is slidably connected with a lower display board, the top of the upper display board is provided with a second guide groove, the outer wall of the upper display board is provided with a cleaning mechanism, the cleaning mechanism comprises a first guide block, the bottom of the first guide block is slidably connected with the wall of the second guide groove through a sliding block, the bottom of the first guide block is fixedly connected with a sleeve, the inner wall of the sleeve is slidably connected with a sliding rod, and the outer wall of the sleeve is fixedly connected with a second scraping plate. According to the invention, the dust attached to the upper display board and the lower display board is cleaned by arranging the cleaning mechanism, so that dust accumulation is prevented from affecting the definition of the guide mark, the manual ascending work load is reduced, and the guide mark device can keep clear guide of the guide mark.

title_en: Power supply circuit and display device
abstract_en: The application discloses a power supply circuit and display equipment, wherein the power supply circuit comprises a power supply conversion module and a current regulation module, the power supply conversion module comprises a transformer, the transformer is provided with a primary winding, a first secondary winding and a second secondary winding, one end of the first secondary winding is connected with the positive end of a lamp string, the other end of the first secondary winding is grounded, one end of the second secondary winding is connected with the negative end of the lamp string, the primary winding is used for being connected with input voltage, the current regulation module is connected between the other end of the second secondary winding and the ground, and the current regulation module is used for regulating current flowing through the lamp string. The application distributes the voltage of the high-voltage lamp string to the two windings by adding the secondary windings in series with the lamp string, and the plurality of secondary windings supply power to the lamp string, so that each winding and other devices in the circuit bear partial voltage, thereby adopting low-voltage-resistant and low-cost devices, being beneficial to reducing the system cost and improving the reliability.

title_en: Lighting assembly control method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for controlling a lighting assembly, and relates to the technical field of Internet of things. The lighting assembly comprises a plurality of lamp beads, and each lamp bead corresponds to the respective abscissa. The equipment end determines the abscissa and the ordinate of each lamp bead and the target color parameter according to the display service instruction under the condition of receiving the display service instruction, generates a control signal sequence according to a preset mapping relation, wherein the preset mapping relation is the mapping relation between the abscissa and the ordinate of the lamp bead and the control sequence number, and controls each lamp bead to light and display the corresponding color according to the control signal sequence. According to the application, the equipment end controls each lamp bead on the lighting assembly to display corresponding colors according to the color requirement of the lighting assembly of the client, so that the free color matching of the lighting assembly is realized for users, and the light display modes of the lighting assembly are enriched.

title_en: Multi-camera shooting control method and system based on collaborative scheduling optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-camera shooting control method and system based on collaborative scheduling optimization, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring real-time images and equipment positions of a plurality of shooting equipment in a shooting area; the method comprises the steps of identifying shooting object data corresponding to a shooting area based on an object identification algorithm according to the real-time image, determining a scheduling path corresponding to each shooting device according to the shooting object data and the device position, and determining a collaborative scheduling scheme corresponding to at least two shooting devices based on a dynamic planning algorithm according to the scheduling paths corresponding to all the shooting devices. Therefore, the intelligent optimization of the multi-equipment collaborative shooting path can be realized, the shooting coverage efficiency and the synergy are improved, and the risk of shooting quality degradation caused by path conflict or insufficient coverage is reduced.

title_en: Headset and audio data processing method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a head-mounted device and an audio data processing method. The head-mounted device comprises a pickup assembly, an eye tracking assembly and a control unit, wherein the pickup assembly is used for collecting mixed audio data, the eye tracking assembly is used for determining the sight direction of a wearer, the control unit is used for determining a target object according to the sight direction and environment data, extracting characteristic data of the target object and extracting audio data of the target object from the mixed audio data according to the characteristic data so as to achieve directional tracking of the target object. According to the embodiment of the invention, after the fixation object of the wearer is locked, the audio data of the specific object is separated from the mixed audio data according to the characteristic data of the fixation object, so that the difficulty of the wearer in distinguishing the speaking of the specific object is reduced, and the use experience of the wearer can be effectively improved.

title_en: Chip packaging structure, circuit board assembly, electronic equipment, substrate and manufacturing method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a chip packaging structure, a circuit board assembly, electronic equipment, a substrate and a manufacturing method, relates to the technical field of chip processing, and solves the problems that the reliability of a packaging glass substrate is reduced and the reliability failure is easy to occur due to the fact that microcracks of an existing glass core board are easy to expand. The substrate comprises a core plate, a first wiring layer and an edge sealing structure. Wherein the core plate has corners. The first wiring layer is laminated on one side of the core board. The edge sealing structure wraps part of the side walls or all the side walls of the core plate at the corners. In the cooling process after the first wiring layer is manufactured, the edge sealing structure can absorb the transverse shearing force of the first wiring layer shrinkage to the core plate, so that the problems that the glass core plate is damaged by a cutting surface and is hidden and cracked in cutting can be reduced, and the glass strength is improved. In the subsequent packaging process or the placement process, the edge sealing structure can also prevent the glass substrate from being broken or layered due to the fact that microcracks of the glass core plate at the cutting surface continue to be expanded.

title_en: Multi-functional intelligent exhibition frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-functional intelligent exhibition frame relates to display device technical field, to the not good problem of present exhibition frame working property, now proposes following scheme, and it includes the cabinet body, the inside of the cabinet body is equipped with first base, one side of first base is equipped with the second base, the both ends at first base and second base top all are fixed with the backup pad of vertical setting, the top of first base and second base is along the vertical loading board that is equipped with a plurality of horizontal settings, the both ends of loading board are fixed with corresponding backup pad respectively, the top of cabinet body left end is fixed with step motor. The utility model discloses can carry out effectual show that bears to the product, and can be according to user's show demand, quick convenient receive and release the product on exhibition frame and exhibition frame to can be nimble adjust the angle to the exhibition frame, the bandwagon is wide, and the working property is high, convenient to use.

title_en: Low-voltage variable frequency control cabinet with high heat dissipation structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high heat radiation structure's low pressure variable frequency control cabinet, including switch board main part, inlet wire, drying cabinet and universal wheel, the left and right sides inner wall of switch board main part all is provided with first slip track, and just first slip orbital inside pulley all is connected with the diaphragm, the top of diaphragm all is provided with electrical component, and the rear outside of diaphragm all is provided with the label subsides, the inlet wire all sets up in the inside below of switch board main part, and the top of switch board main part all is provided with heat radiation structure, the left and right sides of switch board main part all is provided with the vent. The utility model provides a high heat radiation structure's low pressure variable frequency control cabinet, through setting up heat radiation structure, can drive the fan through the motor operation like this and move, dispel the heat to the device inside through the operation of fan, avoids the device radiating effect lower, leads to inside high temperature, causes the damage to electrical element, can dispel the heat to the motor through the radiator-grid simultaneously, improves the device's radiating effect.

title_en: Compact shelf with passageway protection device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of compact shelving, and discloses a compact shelving with a passageway protection device, which comprises a plurality of compact shelving main bodies and a first passageway protection device, wherein the first passageway protection device comprises a first light emitting device arranged on the compact shelving main body at the head end, a first light receiving device arranged on the compact shelving main body at the tail end and a control device, the first light emitting device and the first light receiving device are both positioned on the same horizontal plane, and when no person enters the passageway formed by adjacent compact shelving, the light signal sent by the first light emitting device can be received by all the first light receiving devices, and the control device can control the adjacent compact shelving bodies to move relatively; when people enter the passageway, the optical signals sent by the first light emitting devices cannot be received by all the first light receiving devices, and the control device controls all the compact shelving bodies to keep static. The utility model discloses can ensure the safety of the personnel in passageway economically.

title_en: Single-phase AC-DC-DC bidirectional power supply based on DSP
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a single-phase AC-DC-DC bidirectional power supply based on DSP, including the shell body and locate the circuit board in the shell body, the circuit board is installed on a base plate and this base plate is up, is equipped with a plurality of electronic component on the circuit board, the base plate closes with an upper seal plate lid and is formed with a plurality of discontinuous oil ducts in inside, the oil duct distributes in the electronic component area that easily generates heat, and each oil duct both ends all are equipped with the via hole, and this via hole extends to the up end of upper seal plate and sets up corresponding socket post in drill way department; the bidirectional power supply further comprises a plurality of air cooling devices and a plurality of switching pipes, wherein the air cooling devices are provided with air cooling pipelines, and two ends of each air cooling pipeline and two ends of each switching pipe are inserted into the insertion columns, so that each oil duct, each air cooling pipeline and each switching pipe form a series structure. The utility model discloses aim at making two-way power supply have a stable temperature interval.

title_en: Instrument fixing device for environmental monitoring
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an instrument fixing device for environmental monitoring, including fixed case, fixed knot structure and buffer structure, the inner chamber of fixed case is provided with fixed knot structure and buffer structure, and fixed knot structure sets up in buffer structure's top, the chamber door is installed through hinge and hasp to the preceding terminal surface of fixed case, the top integrated into one piece of fixed case has the brim of a hat of sheltering from, the first half of chamber door digs the horizontal passageway that is equipped with the rectangle, and passageway inner wall fixed mounting has perspective window, the bottom mounting welding of fixed case has the supporting leg of two sets of position symmetry, the vent of barb type has been seted up to the rear end face of fixed case, just the vertical inner wall of fixed case has the filter screen at vent department fixed mounting. This instrument fixing device for environmental monitoring, overall structure is stable not only, makes things convenient for the field operation moreover.

title_en: Desktop intelligent integrated terminal
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrative terminal of desktop intelligence, including multimedia display screen, the table, upset body and controller, the upset body is including the cabinet body that is fixed in the table bottom, the open-top of the cabinet body, its inside fixed block that is provided with, the movable plate goes up the movable plate, move down movable plate and backup pad, the bottom rear end of bolted fixation table is passed through at the top both ends of fixed block, and the top of fixed block is provided with rectangular recess, be provided with first slide rail in the rectangular recess, the rear end of table is provided with the rectangular opening corresponding with rectangular recess, sliding connection has first slider in the first slide rail, rectangular opening is stretched out at the top of first slider, and its top is rotated and is connected with the connecting rod. The utility model discloses can adjust multimedia display screen's inclination, position and rotation angle, the user of the different positions of being convenient for and different heights uses.

title_en: Circuit board for communication equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of communication equipment circuit boards, in particular to a circuit board for communication equipment, which comprises a circuit board body, wherein pressing grooves are arranged on both sides of the circuit board body, storage grooves are arranged on both sides of the bottom of the circuit board body, through grooves are arranged on the top of the inner wall of the storage grooves, connecting grooves are arranged between the through grooves and the pressing grooves, a control rod is clamped in the through grooves, a pressing sheet is clamped in the pressing grooves, connecting rods are welded between the top of the control rod and the pressing sheet, the connecting rods are clamped in the connecting grooves, springs are sleeved on the connecting rods, the springs are arranged in the pressing grooves, a tip is arranged at one end of the control rod, the tip is arranged in the storage grooves, plastic sheets are welded in the storage grooves, glue is arranged between the plastic sheets and the inner wall of the storage grooves, the tip is arranged at the top of the plastic, the rotating sheet is arranged in the groove through the rotating shaft, and the groove has the characteristic of accurate positioning.

title_en: Magnetic suspension sound box
abstract_en: The utility model provides a magnetic suspension audio amplifier. The magnetic suspension sound box comprises a sound box body, an electromagnetic induction module and suspended matters. Wherein, a main control panel is arranged in the sound box body; the electromagnetic induction module comprises an electromagnet assembly and a sensor which are respectively and electrically connected with the main control board; the suspended matter is arranged above the electromagnet assembly, a permanent magnet is arranged in the suspended matter, the magnetic pole of the permanent magnet close to the electromagnet assembly is the same as the magnetic pole of the permanent magnet generated after the electromagnet assembly is electrified, and the suspended matter can float up and down relative to the electromagnet assembly; the sensor is used for detecting the distance that the suspended solid floated from top to bottom for the electromagnet assembly and outputting an electric signal to the main control board, and the main control board carries out the play control of the sound box body according to the electric signal. The utility model discloses a magnetic suspension audio amplifier, the suspended solid that can solve current magnetic suspension audio amplifier does not have interactive operation's technical problem with the user to improve user experience.

title_en: Optical imaging system, image capturing device, electronic equipment and vehicle-mounted surround system
abstract_en: The utility model provides an optical imaging system, getting for instance device and electronic equipment. The utility model discloses an optical imaging system, include: a lens group and a diaphragm; the diaphragm is arranged on the object side of the lens group or in the lens group; the diaphragm is elliptical so that an imaging circle of the optical imaging system is elliptical. The utility model discloses an optical imaging system, its formation of image circle inscribe photosensitive element under the condition that does not sacrifice the horizontal angle of vision, has improved optical imaging system's perpendicular angle of vision.

title_en: Multi-angle showing and anti-collision showing stand for conference exhibition service
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the show shelf, especially, but show shelf for conference exhibition service of multi-angle show and anticollision, including support body and pivot, the universal wheel is installed to the bottom of support body, and the outside of universal wheel is provided with the spout to the below of spout is provided with the base, the internally mounted of base has the motor, and the avris of motor is connected with first awl tooth to the avris of first awl tooth is provided with the second awl tooth, the top of second awl tooth is provided with the link, and the outside of link is provided with the gasbag to the outside of gasbag is provided with the light filling lamp, the pivot runs through in the inside of light filling lamp, and the avris of light filling lamp is provided with the draw-in groove to the inside of draw-in groove is provided with the connecting block. This but meeting exhibition service of multi-angle show and anticollision is provided with the gasbag with the show shelf, and the gasbag passes through glue to be fixed in the both sides of show shelf, protects the show shelf, has improved the crashproof ability of show shelf, has guaranteed the normal use of show shelf.

title_en: Multifunctional atmosphere pollution monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-functional atmospheric pollution monitoring devices, including the dead lever, the top of dead lever is rotated and is connected with the roating seat, the equal fixedly connected with handle in both sides of roating seat, the top fixedly connected with fixed block of dead lever, the top fixedly connected with threaded sleeve of roating seat, the top of fixed block is provided with the threaded rod, threaded rod and threaded sleeve looks adaptation, the top of threaded rod runs through threaded sleeve and extends to the telescopic outside of screw. The utility model provides a multi-functional atmospheric pollution monitoring devices has, and the threaded rod drives by the roating seat and reciprocates, and the threaded rod can be used for the holistic height of controlling means, and convenient free regulation, heat dissipation fan can accelerate the heat dissipation for the atmosphere detector and prevent that the atmosphere detector temperature is higher under the hot day from causing inside components and parts to damage, insert can assist ground awl use increase device grab the land fertility and let the dead lever more firm.

title_en: MEMS microphone and MEMS structure thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a MEMS microphone and a micro-electromechanical structure thereof. The micro-electromechanical structure comprises: a back plate; the vibrating membrane is provided with at least one through hole and forms a variable capacitor with the back plate; one end of each connecting column is fixedly connected with the back plate; and at least one movable structure respectively located in the corresponding through hole to be separated from the diaphragm, each movable structure being fixedly connected with the other end of the corresponding connecting column, wherein a gap between the movable structure and the through hole is used for gas circulation. abstract_en: The invention relates to an underwater suction head with a detection function, in particular to a head of the suction head, which relates to an underwater suction device; the problem that the length of the suction tube is increased or decreased by a simple structure and a convenient dismounting mode at the lower end of the suction tube of the suction fishing device is solved; the probe is fixed with the detachable part and can be detached independently and conveniently; the collision buffer protection is simultaneously realized only with the parts related to the suction function. To solve the technical problem of (1). The invention is fixed at the lower end of the suction tube of the suction device, and is convenient to disassemble and assemble through the structures of the ring groove and the lock catch; the suction head is provided with the probe, so that more accurate underwater fishing operation can be realized, and the probe with a fault can be disassembled and assembled under the condition that the fastener for fixing the probe is not completely disassembled, so that the operation difficulty is reduced; still be equipped with the horn mouth on the suction head, connect on the suction head through flexible hose, have the cushioning effect when having increased the effect of catching. The invention is mainly used for the suction fishing device to carry out the undersea fishing operation.

title_en: Integrated touch control all-in-one machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrated touch control all-in-one machine, which belongs to the technical field of all-in-one machines, and comprises a rear cover, and is characterized in that: the touch control integrated machine comprises a rear cover, a mainboard, a fixing frame, a liquid crystal screen, a panel, a touch screen and a main board, wherein the main board is arranged in the rear cover and fixedly connected with the rear cover, the CPU is an onboard ARM Cortex-A17Quad Core SOC (RK3288), the fixing frame is arranged on one side of the rear cover and fixedly connected with the rear cover, the liquid crystal screen is arranged on the inner side of the fixing frame and fixedly connected with the fixing frame, the panel is arranged on one side of the fixing frame, which is far away from the rear cover, and fixedly connected with the fixing frame, the touch screen is arranged on one side of the liquid crystal screen, which is far away from the rear cover, and both the liquid crystal screen and the touch screen are electrically connected with the main board.

title_en: Headset noise reduction earphone
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model provides an earphone, in particular to a head-wearing noise reduction earphone, which comprises: the earphone comprises a connecting band and earphone bodies which are connected and arranged at two ends of the connecting band; the earphone main body is sleeved with a noise reduction ring sleeve; the limiting belt is provided with support rods at two ends of the limiting belt in an integrated manner, and adjusting seats are fixedly arranged at the end parts of the two support rods; a through hole matched with the connecting rod is formed in the adjusting seat, a supporting cavity is formed in one side of the adjusting seat, and a rectangular sliding block is arranged in the supporting cavity in a supporting and sliding mode through a supporting spring; and a tooth block is fixedly arranged on one side of the rectangular sliding block, extends into the through hole, and is provided with a rack towards one side of the connecting rod of the tooth block. The embodiment of the utility model effectively solves the problem that the existing headset easily causes the dropping of the earmuffs; and the purpose of effectively reducing noise is achieved through the arranged noise reduction ring sleeve.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring device for urban system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent monitoring device for a city mooring system, which comprises a first fixed block, wherein the top of the first fixed block is fixedly connected with a first vacuum chuck, the left side of the first fixed block is uniformly and fixedly connected with two groups of sliding cylinders which are arranged in front and back, a group of sliding rods are respectively and slidably connected inside the two groups of sliding cylinders, the left side ends of the two groups of sliding rods are respectively and fixedly connected with a group of first vacuum chucks, the top of the first vacuum chuck is fixedly connected with a second vacuum chuck, and the bottom walls of the second vacuum chuck and the first vacuum chuck are respectively and fixedly connected with a group of gas transmission end pipes. According to the vacuum sucker fixed by the first fixing block, the motor drives the driving screw fixed by the output shaft of the motor to rotate in the driving cylinder, the screw rotates to drive the hexagonal pushing rod in threaded connection to slide inwards in the driving cylinder and push the vacuum sucker fixed by the first fixing block to move inwards, so that the area between the two suckers is reduced, the capacity of adapting to different installation areas is realized, and the vacuum sucker fixed by the first fixing block is worthy of great popularization.

title_en: Video processing system with video picture automatic analysis processing function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a video processing system with a video picture automatic analysis processing function, which comprises a video collector, a video image analysis module, a DSP (digital signal processor) and an FPGA (field programmable gate array) chip, wherein the output end of the video collector is connected with the input end of the video image analysis module, the output end of the video image analysis module is connected with the input end of a video compression module, the output end of the video compression module is connected with the DSP, the DSP is connected with the FPGA chip, and the FPGA chip is connected with a coding/decoding module.

title_en: Thing networking sensor protection strutting arrangement
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of sensor protection supporting devices, and provides an Internet of things sensor protection supporting device, which comprises a base, a device body and a mounting device, wherein the base and the device body are connected through a rotating assembly, and the Internet of things sensor protection supporting device further comprises: the rope protection mechanism is movably connected with the device body and used for protecting the sensor rope, the rope protection mechanism comprises a pressing component and a rotating component, the pressing component is used for pressing the rope moving outwards, and the rotating component is used for resetting the rotating rope. The utility model can prevent the cord from separating from the sensor and can perform reset protection on the cord.

title_en: Inverter with a voltage regulator
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the field of inverters and provides an inverter, which comprises a cabinet and an inverter main body arranged in the cabinet, wherein a door plate is arranged on the cabinet, and a fan installation component is assembled on the door plate; the fan mounting assembly comprises a mounting frame connected with one side, close to the rotating shaft, of the door panel, and at least one fan is arranged on the mounting frame. The inverter of this embodiment, through installing fan installation component on the door plant of inverter cabinet, the inside two-phase flow of cabinet and the position of two-phase flow radiator are unchangeable, compare in current inverter, when carrying out the maintenance of two-phase flow radiator open the door plant can, do not need dismouting fan installation component, improved dismouting efficiency, the effectual space that utilizes the cabinet.

title_en: Wearable equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wearable device, comprising: the left earphone is provided with a left control module, a left display screen and a left energy storage module; the right earphone is provided with a right control module, a right display screen and a right energy storage module; the charging box is provided with a main control module, a main communication module, a charging module and a containing groove; the wrist strap is detachably connected with the charging box; the left earphone and the right earphone are detachably mounted in the accommodating groove, and the left display screen and the right display screen form a display screen of the wearable device; the main control module is communicated with the left control module through the main communication module, and the left control module is electrically connected with the left display screen; the main control module is communicated with the right control module through the main communication module, and the right control module is electrically connected with the right display screen. According to the wearable device, the charging box is worn on the wrist through the wrist strap, so that the earphone can be timely stored and charged, and the charging convenience is improved; when two earphones are stored in the charging box, the display function can be achieved, and the use experience of a user is improved.

title_en: High wear-resisting washer for speaker
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of loudspeakers and discloses a washer for a high-wear-resistance loudspeaker. Including T piece, magnet, iron sheet, basin frame, vibrating diaphragm and voice coil loudspeaker voice coil, the T piece includes chassis and arch, the voice coil loudspeaker voice coil cover is established in the arch, supreme cover in proper order is established in the voice coil loudspeaker voice coil outside down to magnet, iron sheet, the iron sheet is including the through-hole, be equipped with wear-resisting subassembly on the through-hole, wear-resisting subassembly is including laminating the installing support on the through-hole lateral wall, be equipped with the wear-resisting ring that supplies the arch to pass on the installing support. Through establish wear-resisting subassembly on the through-hole at the iron sheet for the play power about the production is applyed on wear ring when the voice coil loudspeaker voice coil reciprocates, ensures that the cladding material on the iron sheet is not scratched, remains the best magnetic conduction user state that the iron sheet had. The wear-resistant component is convenient to install and low in cost.

title_en: PCB circuit board surface treatment equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides PCB circuit board surface treatment equipment, which comprises an air cylinder and a strip-shaped brush for cleaning dust on the surface of a PCB circuit board, wherein a connecting piece capable of adjusting the relative position of the brush and the PCB circuit board is arranged at the movable end of the air cylinder, a wind-collecting cover fixedly connected with the connecting piece is arranged on the upper side of the brush, the wind-collecting cover is arranged along the length direction of the brush, a manifold pipe arranged along the length direction of the wind-collecting cover is arranged on the upper side of the wind-collecting cover, a plurality of branch pipes communicated with the wind-collecting cover are equidistantly arranged at the lower part of the outer surface of the manifold pipe, one end of the manifold pipe is connected with a filter box for filtering floating objects through a hose, one end of the manifold pipe, which is far away from the hose, is closed, and an air suction pump is arranged on the upper surface of the filter box, therefore, compared with the PCB circuit board surface treatment equipment disclosed by the utility model, the utility model has the following beneficial effects: the floating objects can be collected, and the cleanness of the working environment can be maintained.

title_en: Solar panel cleaning device and unmanned aerial vehicle internet of things layout system sprinkles
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a solar panel cleaning device and a sprinkling unmanned aerial vehicle Internet of things layout system, which comprises: the system comprises a solar panel cleaning device, a sprinkling unmanned aerial vehicle, an Internet of things cloud server and a terminal interaction device, wherein the solar panel cleaning device is arranged on a solar panel and used for shooting image data of the solar panel, receiving a sprinkling instruction, sprinkling and forwarding the cleaning instruction, sending the cleaning instruction to the sprinkling unmanned aerial vehicle or the solar panel cleaning device, sending the sprinkling instruction to the sprinkling unmanned aerial vehicle, analyzing and processing the image data based on the Internet of things cloud server, and monitoring the solar panel cleaning device and the sprinkling unmanned aerial vehicle; thing networking cloud server respectively with terminal interaction device, watering unmanned aerial vehicle, solar panel cleaning device wireless connection, watering unmanned aerial vehicle still with solar panel cleaning device wireless connection. The solar panel cleaning system does not need to replace old equipment, is strong in adaptability, convenient to maintain and low in power consumption, and achieves efficient solar panel cleaning operation through large data acquisition and analysis of the solar panel.

title_en: Power management controller
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a power management controller in the field of electric appliances, which comprises a shell, a display, a current controller and a power switch, wherein the current controller is positioned inside the shell, the display is positioned on the surface of the shell, one end of the shell is provided with an adjusting button capable of regulating and controlling current, a power connector is arranged below the adjusting button, a heat radiating seat is arranged inside the shell, one end of the shell, which is close to the heat radiating seat, is provided with a heat radiating groove, the power switch is positioned on the surface of the shell, a current feedback device is arranged inside the shell, and a signal fed back by the current feedback device is displayed by the display; the one end that the casing is opposite with the display is equipped with the take-up unit, and the take-up unit includes jack catch, first bullet piece and magnet piece, and the one end and the magnet piece active link of jack catch, first bullet piece are located the middle part of magnet piece.

title_en: Standby tower number plate with convenient replacement content
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of tower number plates, in particular to a spare tower number plate with convenient content replacement, which comprises a first plate body and a second plate body, wherein the bottom of the first plate body is connected with the second plate body, the surface of the first plate body is provided with a limiting slot, and an inner cavity of the limiting slot is limited and inserted with a movable plate body; the surface of the second card body is provided with a word strip capable of being coated. The tower number plate can be rapidly eliminated by using the novel standby tower number plate, the defects of tower number plate loss, damage and the like can be rapidly eliminated, a large number of spare parts are not needed, the tower number plate can be rapidly provided when any one base rod tower has the tower number plate defect, the fund and the storehouse space required by material storage can be reduced while the defect elimination efficiency is ensured, the fund is saved, the efficiency is improved, and the tower number plate is practical and suitable for wide popularization and use.

title_en: Novel servo driver
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of servo drivers, and relates to a novel servo driver which comprises a shell, wherein a first through hole is formed in the surface of the shell, a movable plate is arranged on the inner wall of the first through hole, a first groove is formed in the surface of the movable plate, and a first sliding groove is formed in the inner wall of the first groove. Its beneficial effect is, this novel servo driver, through setting up the fly leaf, when people need maintain and clear up the shell inside, people at first stimulate the pull rod, thereby can drive the gag lever post and remove, and then can be with gag lever post and draw-in groove phase separation, then people are removing the movable block through external instrument, thereby can drive the shelves pole and remove, and then can remove the movable rod out of first recess, people become flexible pull rod afterwards, and then can carry out the gag lever post to the movable rod, people can remove the fly leaf, and then can maintain and clear up the shell inside, thereby people are more swift when maintaining and clearing up the shell inside.

title_en: Circulated water-cooling radiator convenient to wash
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a recyclable water-cooled radiator convenient to clean, which belongs to the technical field of water cooling and is technically characterized by comprising two positioning plates, wherein a controller and a plurality of controllable LED lamp strips are fixedly arranged on the front surface of each positioning plate on the front surface, a plurality of positioning rings are fixedly arranged inside each positioning plate on the back surface, a heat dissipation pipe group is inserted into each positioning ring, the left end and the right end of each heat dissipation pipe group are communicated with a circulating pipe group, a circulating box is arranged at the bottom of each positioning plate, and a water tank and a water pump are fixedly arranged inside each circulating box. The utility model discloses a, when needs wash, after taking off four holding rings in the middle of, can break off cooling tube group into two halves with the fingers and thumb, can wash to the radiating main part of needs, the impurity or the dirt that long-term operation produced of taking off that can be very easy, and after taking off the holding ring on both sides, can wash convenient and fast with whole cooling tube group is whole to be taken off.

title_en: Image projection apparatus
