abstract_en: The utility model provides an image projection apparatus capable of projecting a projected image in a balanced shape regardless of whether the projected image is a portion closer to a vehicle body or a portion farther from the vehicle body. The image projection device for a vehicle is provided with a plurality of light sources (2), a plurality of lenses (4) respectively facing the plurality of light sources (2), and a plate-shaped light blocking member (3) interposed between the light sources (2) and the lenses (4). The light-blocking member (3) is provided with a plurality of openings (31) through which light (L) from the plurality of light sources (2) passes toward the plurality of lenses (4), respectively. The opening is formed in a trapezoidal shape.

title_en: Lifting device of vehicle-mounted loudspeaker and loudspeaker system with same
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lifting device of a vehicle-mounted loudspeaker and a loudspeaker system with the same, wherein the lifting device of the vehicle-mounted loudspeaker comprises: the mounting bracket is provided with at least one guide post; the mounting seat can move up and down along the guide post; the loudspeaker is arranged on one side of the mounting seat in the thickness direction; drive assembly, drive assembly includes driver, two belt pulleys and belt, the driver with one of them the belt pulley links to each other, two the belt pulley is the interval from top to bottom set up, the belt is around establishing two outside the belt pulley, the mount pad with the belt is fixed, works as the driver during operation the belt motion drives the mount pad is followed the guide post reciprocates. According to the lifting device disclosed by the utility model, the structure of the lifting device is simple, the cost of the lifting device can be reduced, and meanwhile, the noise generated when the mounting seat moves up and down can be reduced, so that the user experience can be improved.

title_en: LED drive power supply box convenient for wire arrangement
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of LED lamps, in particular to an LED driving power supply box convenient for wire arrangement. According to the utility model, the slide bars are arranged in the lower shell, the abutting blocks for fixing the circuit board are arranged on the slide bars, the circuit boards with different sizes can be fixed by adjusting the positions and the intervals of the abutting blocks and arranging the abutting blocks on the slide bars at different positions, the wires on the circuit board can be placed in the spaces between the adjacent slide bars, the wires can be led out of the wire holes of the upper shell in a regular manner by the guide of the guide blocks, and meanwhile, the upper spaces of the slide bars can be blocked by the clamping pins arranged at the side ends of the upper shell, so that the influence of the elastic upwarp of the wires on assembly is avoided.

title_en: Heat radiator for information engineering rack is used
abstract_en: A heat dissipation device for information engineering machine cabinet comprises an air cooling mechanism, a dust removal mechanism and a water cooling mechanism, the air cooling mechanism is arranged in the heat dissipation box, the first heat dissipation fan and the second heat dissipation fan are arranged to improve the internal circulation flow guiding effect on the air flow, the electromagnetic one-way valve and the third heat dissipation fan are arranged to improve the flow guiding effect on the external circulation of the air flow, the driving motor and the filtering rotary disc are arranged to improve the filtering effect on the air flow, the dust removing mechanism is arranged at the top of the heat dissipation box, and the electric slide block and the roller are arranged, so that the driving effect of the dust removing block is improved, through having set up inside water cooling mechanism rack box, set up refrigerator and booster liquid pump, be favorable to improving temperature control and the water conservancy diversion effect to the coolant liquid, set up rubber liquid bag and condenser pipe, be favorable to carrying out the heat transfer effect to electric elements and carrying out the cooling effect to the air current.

title_en: Ultrathin plane type video exhibition stand
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ultrathin plane type video exhibition stand, which comprises a video exhibition stand main body, wherein two sides of the video exhibition stand main body are provided with illuminating mechanisms, each illuminating mechanism comprises a rotating rod which is rotatably connected to two sides of the video exhibition stand main body, the front end of each rotating rod is provided with a bayonet, the front end of each rotating rod is rotatably connected with an installation rod, the inner side of the bayonet at the rear end of each installation rod is fixedly connected with an illuminating lamp, the upper end of each illuminating lamp is provided with a rotating assembly, each rotating assembly comprises a fixing plate, the lower end of each illuminating lamp is provided with a fixing assembly, the inner side of each fixing plate is rotatably connected with a connecting shaft, the upper end of each connecting shaft is fixedly connected with a baffle, the outer side of each connecting shaft is fixedly connected with four groups of clamping plates, the outer side of each connecting shaft is slidably connected with a sliding ring, and the lower end of each sliding ring is fixedly connected with four groups of inserting rods, the utility model can adjust the angles of the illuminating lamps, the illumination effect is enhanced, and the best demonstration of the displayed object is facilitated.

title_en: Distributed network architecture of paste filling system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a distributed network architecture of a paste filling system, which comprises a ground part and an underground part; the ground part comprises a ground network center, a filling station centralized control room, ground network substations, a ground control box and a ground camera; the ground network substation is in wired communication connection with the ground network central center, the ground control box is in wired communication connection with the ground network substation, and the ground cameras are respectively in wired communication connection with the corresponding ground control boxes; the underground part comprises an underground network center, an underground network substation, a pipeline area along the pipeline, a filling working surface area and an explosion-proof control box; the underground network center is in wired communication connection with the ground network center, the underground network substation is connected with the underground network center, and the pipeline area along the pipeline, the filling working surface area and the explosion-proof control box are respectively in wired communication connection with the underground network substation. The network architecture designed in this way is more standardized, and the interconnection sharing is more stable.

title_en: Laser projector driving device and laser projector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a laser projector driving device and a laser projector, and belongs to the technical field of laser projection. The laser projector driving device includes: the device comprises a control component, an image processing component, a display panel, a color wheel driving component and a laser driving component; the control component is respectively connected with the image processing component, the color wheel driving component and the display panel, the image processing component is connected with the display panel, and the display panel is connected with the laser driving component. The utility model sets independent control component and image processing component in the laser projector driving device, and obtains color control signal based on video signal through the control component and image processing component, and then the display panel controls the optical engine and laser driving component based on the color control signal. Thus, the image processing capacity can be improved by upgrading the image processing assembly. An effect of facilitating the improvement of the image processing capability of the laser projector driving apparatus is achieved.

title_en: Flexible screen wall hanging device capable of being curled
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wall hanging device for a flexible screen capable of being curled, which comprises a base, a wall hanging and a hook, wherein the base and the wall hanging are made of permanent magnetic materials, the hook is a conductor and penetrates through the wall hanging, the hook and the wall hanging are fixed through an insulating layer, a hanging groove through hole in clearance fit with the hook is formed in the base, the insulating layer is arranged on the inner wall of the hanging groove through hole, the plane where the hook is located and the plane where the hanging groove through hole is located are both planes, and a second mounting hole matched with a mounting support behind the flexible screen capable of being curled is formed in the wall hanging. The base and the wall hanging are made of permanent magnetic materials, and the installation is simpler and more convenient due to the adoption of magnetic attraction, and the traditional rigid support is not needed. The whole installation process can be transparent and visual by using the magnetic attraction technology, the installation can be completed by self-absorption only by ensuring that the two electrodes are kept horizontal and the hook is aligned with the hanging groove through hole during the installation, and the whole installation is more attractive.

title_en: Double-lens camera module
abstract_en: A double-lens camera module comprises a first lens assembly, a second lens assembly, a collecting assembly and a reflecting assembly. The first lens assembly includes a first lens. The second lens assembly includes a second lens. The collection assembly is used for receiving light rays from the first lens and the second lens. The reflection assembly comprises an installation part, a first reflection part and a second reflection part, the installation part is arranged between the first lens and the second lens, the installation part is connected with the first reflection part and used for driving the first reflection part to shield or conduct a light path between the first lens and the collection assembly, and the second reflection part is used for reflecting light rays from the second lens to the collection assembly by matching with the first reflection part when the light path between the first lens and the collection assembly is shielded. Above-mentioned twin-lens module of making a video recording is through setting up the installed part in order to drive the motion of first reflector, realizes the switching of first camera lens subassembly and second camera lens subassembly, and only needs to set up one and gathers the subassembly, practices thrift the cost, and occupation space is little.

title_en: Safety protection device for smart city Internet of things data acquisition terminal
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of data acquisition terminals, and discloses a safety protection device for a smart city Internet of things data acquisition terminal, which comprises a data acquisition terminal and a support, wherein the support comprises a panel, a fixing plate and an inclined support, the panel is installed on a wall body through an expansion bolt, the fixing plate is installed at the top of the other side of the panel, the inclined support is a right-angle triangular plate, two right-angle sides are fixedly connected with the panel and the fixing plate respectively, limiting blocks are installed at four corners of the upper surface of the fixing plate, and the data acquisition terminal is installed among the four limiting blocks. The wall-mounted type installation structure of the data acquisition terminal can realize the wall-mounted type installation of the data acquisition terminal, avoids the damage caused by treading on the ground due to direct placement, is stable in installation, avoids the damage caused by dropping, can also improve the heat dissipation effect of the data acquisition terminal, is simple in structure and convenient and fast to disassemble and assemble, brings convenience for actual maintenance and replacement, has wide market prospect, and is beneficial to popularization.

title_en: A multilayer circuit board for new energy automobile BMS
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multilayer circuit board for a new energy automobile BMS, and relates to the technical field of multilayer circuit boards. According to the utility model, the circuit board body is placed in the first groove formed in the top end of the second top plate through the arrangement of the first top plate and the second top plate, the first top plate is covered on the circuit board body, the circuit board body is packaged through the first top plate and the second top plate, the heat dissipation plate is arranged at the top end of the first top plate, the micro motor drives the fan blades to rotate, the circulation of air is accelerated, the external air enters the circuit board body through the dust screen, and the heat in the circuit board body is dissipated.

title_en: Cabinet capable of achieving partitioned heat dissipation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cabinets, in particular to a cabinet capable of dissipating heat in a partitioned mode, which comprises a cabinet body and partition plates, wherein three partition plates are arranged, the three partition plates are uniformly fixed on the right side of the inner wall of the cabinet body, a vertical groove is formed in the right side of the interior of the cabinet body, a baffle is movably connected in the vertical groove, a motor groove positioned above the vertical groove is formed in the right side of the cabinet body, a first motor is installed in the motor groove, a threaded groove is formed in the middle of the upper portion of the baffle, a screw rod is connected in the threaded groove in a threaded mode, four groups of through grooves are formed in the side wall of the baffle in a penetrating mode, four groups of heat dissipation holes penetrating through the right side of the cabinet body are formed in the right side of the inner wall of the vertical groove, and four heat dissipation grooves penetrating through the inner cavity of the cabinet body are formed in the left side of the inner wall of the vertical groove: can carry out the subregion heat dissipation according to regional heat is automatic, and the fan can carry out horizontal migration, improves the radiating effect to the size of louvre is adjustable, so that satisfy multiple use needs, can seal the louvre when not using the cabinet body moreover, reaches dustproof effect.

title_en: Can waterproof miniature microphone of capacitanc
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waterproof capacitive miniature microphone which comprises a radio receiving structure, wherein the radio receiving structure comprises a shell, a condenser microphone body is arranged in the shell, a protective sleeve structure is arranged at the top end of the radio receiving structure, an inserting structure is arranged at the bottom end of the radio receiving structure, and a connecting mechanism is sleeved on the surface of the bottom end of the inserting structure. The utility model is provided with a sound receiving structure, a plug-in structure, a collar clamp, a connecting mechanism, an input plug and a connecting wire, when the plug-in structure is in butt joint with the connecting mechanism, the microphone can be directly inserted into a butt joint hole of equipment through the input plug-in connector, the microphone is fixed at the butt joint hole, if the microphone is required to be clamped on the collar, the plug-in mechanism is pulled out of the connecting mechanism, then the plug-in mechanism is clamped on clothes through the collar clamp, and the connecting wire is pulled out of a containing cavity of the connecting structure, so that the microphone can be separated from the equipment.

title_en: Categorised storing compartment of many interlayers file
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-interlayer file classification storage cabinet which comprises a main body cabinet and a placement mechanism, wherein a turnover mechanism for opening and closing the main body cabinet is arranged in the front and at the back of the outer part of the main body cabinet, and the placement mechanism for placing files in the main body cabinet is arranged in the main body cabinet. This categorised storing compartment of many interlayers file, compare with current device, through first hot plate and second hot plate, it is constant temperature, and the lower heating device of temperature, can heat the intensification to the inside air of main part cabinet, thereby can dry the moisture of the moisture in the device and file self, with this can avoid the problem that the file wets and becomes mouldy and the live insect, through ventilative board, be favorable to improving the diffusion of steam, through the fan, can discharge the inside air of device, thereby can discharge the steam after the stoving of heating, can make the inside air of device circulate simultaneously, through the blow vent, can keep the air permeability of placing the board.

title_en: Model airplane power socket
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an aeromodelling power socket in the technical field of power sockets, which comprises a plastic main body and a metal shell, wherein radiating fins which are uniformly distributed are arranged in the metal shell, one end of each radiating fin is connected with the metal shell, the other end of each radiating fin is tightly attached to the plastic main body, the top surface of the plastic main body is provided with a socket, a plurality of terminals are arranged in the plastic main body, clamp springs are arranged on two sides of each terminal, the clamp springs are tightly attached to one ends of the terminals, and two ends of the metal shell are provided with positioning columns. The radiating fins are arranged on the periphery of the plastic main body, so that the radiating effect is ensured, and the socket can be better protected. According to the utility model, the positioning columns are arranged at two ends of the metal shell, and the extension lengths of the positioning columns are greater than that of the pins, so that the positioning columns can play a role in guiding and positioning when being inserted, the pins are prevented from being damaged due to the fact that the inserting angles are not right, and the pins are prevented from being damaged due to external influences after the pins are installed.

title_en: Light signal source device easy to adjust
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of optical signal sources, in particular to an optical signal source device easy to adjust. The technical scheme comprises the following steps: light signal lamp, casing and box, the internally mounted of casing has the voltage regulator, and photosensitive switch is installed at the top of casing, and three groups light signal lamp are installed to the positive equidistance of casing, and the protection casing is installed in the outside of light signal lamp, and the air current seat is installed to the inboard of protection casing, and the internally mounted of light signal lamp has radiator unit. According to the utility model, the heat dissipation airflow can be blown to the front side of the optical signal lamp through the airflow seat, the airflow wall can be formed on the front side of the optical signal lamp, dust is effectively prevented from falling on the surface of the optical signal lamp, the cleanness of the surface of the optical signal lamp is ensured, meanwhile, the heat dissipation airflow can also prevent the surface of the optical signal lamp from being fogged, so that the optical signal lamp keeps the definition, and the airflow wall can blow away the dust on the surface of the optical signal lamp, so that the automatic cleaning function of the device is increased, the workload of manually cleaning the optical signal lamp is reduced, and the practicability of the device is improved.

title_en: Loudspeaker support pad structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of loudspeakers, in particular to a loudspeaker support pad structure. The technical scheme comprises the following steps: run through on the support and seted up the mounting groove, the inside of mounting groove is equipped with the clamp splice, spacing the installing voice coil loudspeaker voice coil in the mounting groove of support, the spacing groove has been seted up to the one end of support, the spacing inslot is inlayed and is had the pad, the support is located the spacing groove and is equipped with fixed muscle directly over, the pad is pressed through fixed muscle and is attached fixedly. The welding disc is fixed through the fixing ribs, so that the welding disc is prevented from falling off from the loudspeaker support, and the performance of the loudspeaker is ensured.

title_en: Heat-resisting individual layer circuit board
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heat-resistant single-layer circuit board, which comprises a circuit board body and a bottom box, wherein the bottom box is arranged in an open manner, a grid plate is arranged on the top surface of the bottom box, a pair of fixed blocks are fixedly arranged at two ends of the top surface of the grid plate, a threaded rod is rotatably arranged on the top surface of each fixed block, a pair of through holes are formed in two ends of the top surface of the circuit board body, a threaded cylinder is fixedly arranged in each through hole, each threaded cylinder is sleeved on the corresponding threaded rod and is in threaded connection with the threaded rod, and a plurality of heat conduction assemblies are uniformly arranged on the bottom surface of the circuit board body; the bottom surface middle part of net board has set firmly the slide rail, and the both ends of slide rail have set firmly a pair of stopper, evenly is provided with a plurality of air supply subassembly between the interior bottom surface of slide rail and bottom case. The utility model not only facilitates the adjustment operation of the circuit board body, but also facilitates the heat dissipation operation of the circuit board body, and simultaneously facilitates the installation and disassembly operation.

title_en: Common ground noise processing circuit and audio system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a common ground noise processing circuit and an audio system, which comprise a signal coding and decoding module, an operational amplifier signal conditioning module, an AP signal amplification module and a loudspeaker output module, wherein the signal coding and decoding module is used for accessing an external signal, the signal coding and decoding module is provided with a signal output end and a grounding end, the signal output end is used for outputting an analog signal, the grounding end is arranged close to the signal output end, and the grounding end is used for grounding; the signal amplifying and conditioning module is used for being connected with the signal coding and decoding module; the AP signal amplification module is used for being connected with the operational amplifier signal conditioning module; and the horn output module is used for being connected with the AP signal amplification module. The utility model carries out grounding processing on the grounding end at the signal output end of the signal coding and decoding module, and absorbs the common ground noise at the original end close to the signal output end according to the minimum return current path in a floating mode, thereby effectively inhibiting the common ground noise.

title_en: Classification device based on hyperspectral remote sensing images
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of image devices, in particular to a hyperspectral remote sensing image-based classification device which comprises a device shell, wherein the device shell comprises a groove, a protective cover, a supporting plate and a solar panel, the groove is formed in the front of the device shell, and the protective cover is movably connected to the middle of the right side of the groove; through installing the loose axle, when the exhaust fan when functioning with the interior steam of spectrum remote sensing image main part take out to the heat extraction mouth when discharging, the air current that the exhaust fan drove can promote the closing plate and pass through the loose axle rotation and be in horizontal plane for steam evenly discharges through the thermovent, and when need not use a plurality of closing plates do not receive wind-force to promote the left side and can laminate each other downwards through the loose axle, and is sealed to the thermovent, makes impurity difficult in getting into spectrum remote sensing image main part through the thermovent.

title_en: Withstand voltage copper sheet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pressure-resistant copper element sheet, which has the technical scheme that: comprises a first copper sheet and a supporting frame for mounting the first copper sheet, a heat conducting sheet is arranged above the first copper sheet, a connecting sheet is arranged above the heat conducting sheet, a second copper sheet is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the connecting sheet, the upper surface of the second copper sheet is provided with a rectangular groove, a radiating pipe is arranged in the rectangular groove, the upper surface of the second copper sheet is provided with a pressure-resistant sheet, a plurality of radiating fins distributed at equal intervals are fixedly arranged on the pressure-resistant sheet, a plurality of stepped holes are arranged on the supporting frame, fixing components are arranged in the stepped holes, the pressure-resistant sheet is favorable for improving the impact strength of the outside, protecting the safety of the radiating pipe and avoiding the damage, the fixing component installed in the stepped hole is favorable for firmly fixing the pressure-resistant sheet in the supporting frame, and the contact between heat and air can be improved through the plurality of radiating sheets.

title_en: Motor controller and vehicle power system with same
abstract_en: The utility model provides a controller for a motor and a vehicle power system with the same. The controller for a motor includes: a housing; the laminated busbar assembly comprises an alternating current output busbar, a positive busbar and a negative busbar which are arranged in sequence; the power module comprises a cooling structure and a semiconductor element positioned on one side of the cooling structure, wherein the semiconductor element is vertically placed and connected with the cooling structure; the laminated busbar assembly and the cooling structure are fixedly connected through the locking piece, so that the laminated busbar assembly and the power module form a modular structure, and the modular structure is installed inside the shell. The controller for the motor is convenient to install and high in assembly efficiency.

title_en: SVG-based chart data display device for transformer substation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a diagram data display device of a transformer substation based on SVG, which comprises a rotating component and a display component, wherein the rotating component comprises a rotating column, and the display component comprises a supporting plate, a mounting plate, a fixing plate, a lead screw, a second motor and a nut seat; the top welding of rotation post has the backup pad, one side welding of backup pad has the mounting panel, one side welding of mounting panel has the fixed plate, it is connected with the lead screw to rotate between the adjacent one side of fixed plate and backup pad. The utility model discloses the output shaft one end of second motor is rotated, drives the lead screw and rotates, makes the nut seat slide in the lateral wall of lead screw, and the slide can slide in the lateral wall of slide bar, and the nut seat removes, and drive the show board with the slide and reciprocate together, and the output shaft one end of first motor rotates, drives the initiative bevel gear and rotates, drives driven bevel gear and rotation post rotation then, reaches the purpose of adjusting the show board angle to reach better bandwagon effect.

title_en: Portable device for measuring underground stress of coal mine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable device for measuring underground stress of a coal mine, which comprises a carrying box, wherein the inner side of the carrying box is provided with radiating holes in a penetrating way; the top of the carrying box is provided with a top cover, a through hole is formed in the box body of the carrying box, an observation window is arranged in the center of the upper surface of the top cover, a rectangular measurer is arranged inside the carrying box and comprises an upper shell and a lower shell, a display screen is arranged at the position, matched with the observation window, of the surface of the upper shell of the measurer, and a flexible pipe is arranged at the bottom of the measurer and penetrates through the through hole to extend to the outside of the carrying box; one end of the flexible pipe is connected with a stress inductor, and a detection ring is arranged at the center of the stress inductor. The utility model discloses in, through the combined action that carries incasement structure, utilize mutually supporting of its caliber and stress inductor, can conveniently measure the environment size in its different colliery wells, and can be through accurate detection out colliery pressure and stress in the pit of stress inductor.

title_en: Heat abstractor for network desktop level storage device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heat dissipation device for a network desktop storage device, which comprises a bottom plate and two side plates, wherein one side of each side plate is provided with a rectangular through hole, the inner sides of the rectangular through holes are respectively provided with two dustproof nets and two heat dissipation fans, the upper surfaces of the side plates are provided with accommodating grooves, the lower surfaces of inner cavities of the accommodating grooves are provided with movable grooves, the lower surfaces of the inner cavities of the movable grooves are fixedly provided with springs, and the upper ends of the springs are fixedly connected with limiting clamping sleeves clamped with the accommodating grooves. According to the utility model, the dustproof nets are arranged on the two sides of the radiating fan, so that the radiating fan can be prevented from being polluted by dust, the spring is stretched by pulling up the limiting clamping sleeve, and the limiting clamping sleeve is separated from the limit of the position of the dustproof net, so that the dustproof net is conveniently detached from the inside of the rectangular through hole, the cleaning is convenient, and the radiating effect is not influenced.

title_en: Inflatable cubical switchboard
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of switch cabinets, and particularly relates to an inflatable switch cabinet which comprises a switch cabinet body, wherein a photosensitive switch is installed on the lower end face of an installation shell seat, and an outer cover and a motor are installed in the middle of the upper end face of the switch cabinet body. The up end of lower mounting panel installs the printing opacity shell, and the lateral wall fixedly connected with of printing opacity shell warns the placard for four. The mounting panel is installed to the up end of printing opacity shell, goes up the LED lamp that a plurality of evenly distributed all are installed to the one end that the mounting panel is relative with lower mounting panel, and a plurality of LED lamps all are located the inside of printing opacity shell, and the controller is still installed to the up end of cubical switchboard body. The light-transmitting shell capable of being brightened by rotation has the effects that when a pedestrian approaches the switch cabinet body at night, the pedestrian can find the content displayed by the warning slogan board in time and stop walking in time, and accidents caused by the fact that the pedestrian approaches the switch cabinet body due to the fact that the pedestrian is difficult to find in time when the switch cabinet body is used at night are avoided.

title_en: Unattended system of power station
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of power station video monitoring, in particular to a power station unattended system, which comprises a camera, a main sound sensor, a processor, a communicator and a server, wherein the camera is connected with the processor through a signal; the system also comprises a plurality of sub-sound sensors in signal connection with the processor, the sub-sound sensors are positioned at a plurality of measuring points in the power station, the sub-sound sensors detect the supplementary sound in the power station and send the supplementary sound to the processor, and the processor sends the supplementary sound to the server through the communicator for abnormal recognition. The utility model avoids the omission of abnormal condition monitoring caused by equipment shielding or the arrangement position of the sensor in the power station.

title_en: Agricultural facility environment intelligent control device based on thing networking
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an agricultural facility environment intelligent regulation and control device based on the Internet of things, which relates to the technical field of intelligent control and comprises a base, wherein a protection box is arranged at the top end of the base, a regulation and control device is arranged in an inner cavity of the protection box, fixed boxes are respectively arranged on two sides of the outer wall of the protection box, an angle regulation component is arranged in the inner cavity of each fixed box, a plurality of rod sealing plates are respectively arranged on one side of each angle regulation component, each sealing plate is embedded in one side of the fixed box, through holes are respectively formed in two sides of the outer wall of the fixed box, fixing components are respectively arranged on two sides of the inner cavity of the fixed box, and a fixing frame is detachably arranged on the inner side of each fixing component. The utility model solves the problem that when the debugging device is used, a large amount of dust can enter the inner cavity of the protection box through the heat dissipation holes of the protection box and is attached to the regulation and control device, and the normal use of the debugging device can be influenced when the debugging device is seriously used.

title_en: Camera structure and mobile terminal
abstract_en: The utility model provides a camera structure and a mobile terminal. The camera structure comprises a camera body and a flexible conductive piece; the camera body comprises a camera gland, a supporting seat and a circuit board, the camera gland is sleeved on the supporting seat, an electric connection part is arranged on the end face, facing the supporting seat, of the camera gland, the circuit board is located on the face, deviating from the camera gland, of the supporting seat, and the circuit board is connected with the supporting seat; the flexible conductive piece is electrically connected with the electric connection part and is also connected with one surface of the circuit board, which is far away from the supporting seat; the flexible conductive piece is also used for being electrically connected with the copper exposing area of the mainboard. The camera structure provided by the utility model has high reliability, the camera is not easy to be burnt, and the reduction of resolving power is avoided.

title_en: Forestry meteorology auxiliary device operation panel
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of forestry weather observation, in particular to a forestry weather auxiliary device operating platform. This application, including the operation panel body, a plurality of louvre has been seted up on the surface of operation panel body, the surface of operation panel body is equipped with protective structure, protective structure includes four risers, four the surface of riser all with operation panel body fixed connection, four two liang of risers are a set of, same group one side that the riser is close to each other all rotates and is connected with the round bar, the arc surface fixedly connected with dust screen of round bar, the fixed surface of operation panel body is connected with four square boards, the fixed surface of square board is connected with the baffle, the baffle is close to one side fixedly connected with spring of square board, and two liang of a set of four springs, the equal fixedly connected with clamp plate of one end that the baffle was kept away from to same group spring. The problem of the staff inconvenient to the louvre protection on the operation panel, louvre department accumulates the dust easily is solved.

title_en: Meteorological data display device based on satellite remote sensing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of meteorological data display, and discloses a meteorological data display device based on satellite remote sensing, which comprises a bottom plate and a display body, wherein the display body is arranged on the outer wall of the top of the bottom plate, the top end of the display body is fixedly connected with a top plate, two sides of the top plate are fixedly connected with symmetrically arranged fixed plates, the outer wall of one side of the fixed plate on the right side is rotatably connected with a rotating rod, the outer wall of the rotating rod is provided with a shielding curtain, one side of the fixed plate on the left side is provided with an opening, one end of the rotating rod is positioned on the inner side of the opening, and one end of the rotating rod is fixedly connected with a shaft rod. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the top plate, the fixed plate, the rotating rod, the shielding curtain, the protective box, the rotating shaft, the driving wheel, the driven wheel, the driving belt and the driving motor, a large amount of pollutants such as dust can be prevented from falling into the display body, so that an effective dustproof effect can be achieved, and the dustproof display is practical and suitable for wide popularization and use.

title_en: Edge sealing structure for chemical plating of circuit board
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a chemical plating edge sealing structure of a circuit board. The edge sealing efficiency of the electrophoresis edge sealing structure is high, and the shielding effect can reach 100%; the electrophoresis edge sealing structure does not need to be processed again after gold melting, and the operation is simple and convenient.

title_en: Digital screen with novel light guide structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a digital screen with a novel light guide structure, which comprises a shell, wherein an accommodating cavity and a display window communicated with the accommodating cavity are arranged in the shell; at least one optical fiber arranged in the cavity; the LED lamp is arranged in the containing cavity, and light emitted by the LED lamp can be irradiated into the optical fiber from one end of the optical fiber; the display film is arranged on the display window, display information is arranged on the display film, and the optical fiber can refract and/or reflect light emitted by the LED lamp to the display film; the PCB is arranged on the bottom surface of the accommodating cavity and is electrically connected with the LED lamp; the quantity of LED lamps can be greatly saved through the structure, the power consumption of the digital screen is also reduced, the digital screen can have softer and more uniform light emitting effect, and the practicability is very good.

title_en: Computer software safety management device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a computer software safety control device relates to computer technology field, which comprises an outer shell, storage module is installed to the inside one end of shell, and one side of storage module is provided with control module, control module's one end is provided with cryptographic module, first fixed block is installed to one side of shell, and the opposite side of shell installs the second fixed block, fingerprint identification module is installed to the one end of second fixed block, and one side of second fixed block has seted up two slots, the baffle is all installed to the inside one end of slot, one side intermediate position department of second fixed block installs the bayonet joint, and one side of bayonet joint is provided with the mounting panel. The utility model provides a relevant device security among the prior art strong, appear damaging and to the not good enough problem of computer suitability of different grade type inadequately easily.

title_en: Microphone head sealing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a microphone miaow head closing device, comprising a base plate, the vibration dish is installed in the outside of bottom plate, the outside fixedly connected with processing board of bottom plate, clamping device is installed at the top of processing board, actuating mechanism is installed in the outside of bottom plate, the rotating head is installed in the actuating mechanism outside, the tucking is installed in actuating mechanism's the outside, the internally mounted of bottom plate has the ejector pin, the ejector pin runs through bottom plate and vibration dish and extends to clamping device's inside, the outside of bottom plate is provided with motor drive device, motor drive device's the outside is provided with the sloping block, the outside and the ejector pin contact of sloping block. The utility model discloses a, be convenient for guarantee the centre gripping effect of miaow head, reduce and take place to beat the phenomenon of changeing sealing the in-process, guarantee to seal the effect, be difficult for taking place the phenomenon of running disorderly of miaow head when the unloading simultaneously, convenient to popularize and use.

title_en: High-efficient radiating high-voltage pulse power supply
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-efficiency heat-dissipation high-voltage pulse power supply, which comprises a shell, ventilation holes, side plates, a square groove and heat dissipation holes, wherein the two sides of the shell are fixedly connected with the side plates, the top of the shell is provided with the square groove, the top of the shell is equidistantly provided with the heat dissipation holes in the square groove, one side of the shell is provided with the ventilation holes, and the top of the shell is provided with a heat dissipation mechanism which can enhance the heat dissipation effect, the high-voltage pulse power supply of the utility model can take down a shielding plate through the heat dissipation mechanism at the top of the shell when the power supply temperature is higher and the heat dissipation is insufficient, increase the internal air circulation and enhance the heat dissipation, can shield the heat dissipation holes at the top to prevent ash falling when the heat dissipation is sufficient, can reduce the damage of the power supply in the shell when bumping and vibrating through a supporting mechanism so as to protect the internal parts, and an auxiliary mechanism can accelerate the internal air circulation by opening the square hole which closes the bottom, the heat dissipation effect becomes better.

title_en: Heat dissipation type solid state hard drives
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heat dissipation type solid state hard disk, which comprises a hard disk body, wherein an upper heat dissipation plate and a lower heat dissipation plate are respectively arranged on the upper side and the lower side of the hard disk body, transverse heat dissipation fins are arranged on the outer surfaces of the upper heat dissipation plate and the lower heat dissipation plate, longitudinal heat dissipation fins are arranged on the side surfaces of the upper heat dissipation plate and the lower heat dissipation plate, hook plates are arranged on two sides of the edge of the upper heat dissipation plate, hooks are arranged on the inner sides of the lower ends of the hook plates, hook connecting seats are arranged on two sides of the edge of the lower heat dissipation plate, the hook connecting seats correspond to the hook plates, hook grooves are formed in the hook connecting seats, and the hooks are clamped in the hook grooves. According to the heat dissipation type solid state disk, the upper heat dissipation plate and the lower heat dissipation plate are arranged, and the transverse heat dissipation fins and the longitudinal heat dissipation fins are arranged on the outer surfaces and the side faces of the upper heat dissipation plate and the lower heat dissipation plate, so that the heat dissipation effect is greatly improved, and the upper heat dissipation plate and the lower heat dissipation plate are connected and fixed with the clamping hook connecting seat through the clamping hook plate, so that the heat dissipation type solid state disk is very convenient to install; the heat dissipation fan further improves the heat dissipation effect.

title_en: Magnesium alloy die casting
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of die castings, and discloses a magnesium alloy die casting which comprises a mounting plate, wherein guide rails are fixed at two ends of the top of the mounting plate, and an LED box body is arranged above the mounting plate. This magnesium alloy die casting, through setting up the guide rail, the fixed plate, the slider, the ball, the jack, the U-shaped frame, spacing spout, the mounting, the reinforcing plate, threaded rod and turning handle, two sliders that the LED box passes through the fixed plate bottom respectively with two guide rail sliding connection, can transmit the bottom of slider through the ball, the turning handle rotates, drive the mounting through the screw thread post and move down under the effect of two spacing spouts, thereby peg graft with two jacks at fixed plate top, and then fix the top at the mounting panel with the LED box, need not to set up the screw hole at the top of mounting panel, in order to avoid causing the influence because of setting up the screw hole to the structural strength of mounting panel, the reinforcing plate can effectual structural strength who strengthens the mounting.

title_en: New energy automobile signal metal casing for shielding
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a metal shell for signal shielding of a new energy automobile, which relates to the technical field of new energy automobiles, and particularly relates to a metal shell for signal shielding of a new energy automobile. This metal casing for new energy automobile signal shielding uses through joint strip and seal groove's cooperation, will be metal casing and last metal casing closedly be in the same place the back down, utilizes joint strip and seal groove to seal metal casing and last metal casing down, improves metal casing's leakproofness, avoids inside machine controller to wet.

title_en: Electrical control system for fuel supply of thermal power generation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electrical control system for supplying thermal power generation fuel, which comprises a control cabinet, a dust filtering mechanism, a lifting mechanism, a dust removing mechanism and a discharging mechanism, wherein an air inlet and an air outlet are formed in the control cabinet, the dust filtering mechanism is arranged corresponding to the air inlet, the discharging mechanism is arranged corresponding to the air outlet, the lifting mechanism is arranged in an inner cavity of the control cabinet, the dust removing mechanism is arranged on one side, corresponding to an operating panel, of the lifting mechanism, the dust removing mechanism removes dust on the operating panel, and the cleaned dust is discharged to the outside of the control cabinet through the discharging mechanism, so that dust can be prevented from accumulating in the control cabinet, and the safety of the electrical control system is ensured.

title_en: 360-degree panoramic monitoring device for vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of in-vehicle monitoring, in particular to a 360-degree panoramic monitoring device for a vehicle, which comprises a punching-free mounting assembly, a fixed seat, a rotating pan-tilt, a 360-degree panoramic camera and an anti-falling assembly, wherein the punching-free mounting assembly penetrates through and is fixed on the fixed seat, the bottom of the fixed seat is fixedly connected with the rotating pan-tilt, the rotating pan-tilt is positioned between the punching-free mounting assemblies, the 360-degree panoramic camera is mounted on the rotating pan-tilt, the bottom of the rotating pan-tilt is fixedly connected with the anti-falling assembly, a control host is arranged inside the 360-degree panoramic camera, a driving motor is arranged inside the rotating pan-tilt, the driving motor is in driving connection with the 360-degree panoramic camera, and the punching-free mounting assembly and the driving motor are both electrically connected with the control host. The utility model provides a 360 degrees panorama monitoring device of vehicle can realize exempting from to punch the installation, prevents simultaneously that falling protective capacities is strong.

title_en: Circuit board of LED lamp that steadiness is high
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a circuit board of an LED lamp with high stability, which comprises a flexible circuit board, a plurality of lamp bodies arranged on the flexible circuit board and a hard fixing plate which can be connected to the flexible circuit board in a matching way; the hard fixing plates are trapezoidal in section, and the fixing parts are arranged on the hard fixing plates and connect the adjacent hard fixing plates; compared with a hard circuit board, the flexible circuit board has good flexibility, so that the flexible circuit board can be attached to various cambered surfaces; the flexible circuit board can not be damaged due to the bumping of the automobile and the like; after connecting various lamp bodies on the flexible circuit board, sticking the flexible circuit board on the light-transmitting panel or other support structures; utilize the stereoplasm fixed plate to fix, the stereoplasm fixed plate utilizes its self structural strength to carry out moulding to the flexible circuit board, avoids fixed back flexible circuit board to take place to buckle, drop etc..

title_en: LED display module
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides an LED display module, which comprises a circuit board, a wiring terminal for connecting the circuit board and an external driving circuit, and a template arranged on the light-emitting side of the circuit board; the circuit board is provided with an LED light-emitting unit; the template formula structure as an organic whole, the template towards one side of circuit board is enclosed through first strengthening rib and is established the formation cavity be provided with LED luminescence unit in the cavity and hold the board, be provided with on the LED luminescence unit holds the board and is used for holding the chamber that holds of LED luminescence unit. According to the embodiment of the disclosure, the template is arranged in the LED display module to be of a structure capable of accommodating the LED light-emitting unit, so that the use of parts in the LED display module is saved, and the production cost is saved.

title_en: Fire safety exit indication board
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire control exit indicator, which comprises an indicator main body and an indicator lamp, wherein a protective cover is arranged at one end of the indicator lamp, three groups of cylinders are arranged on the right side of the indicator lamp, a long column is arranged at one end of the protective cover, a connecting plate is arranged at one end of each cylinder, an adjusting rod is arranged at one end of the connecting plate, a limiting groove is formed in one end of each cylinder, a circular groove is formed in one end of each long column, the limiting column is welded at one end of the connecting plate, a spring is sleeved on the outer side of each adjusting rod, the spring is arranged inside the circular groove, and the limiting groove is matched with the limiting column. Can protect the pilot lamp, prevent that the pilot lamp from suffering damage, prevent that unable to guide the people, can also install and dismantle the protection casing to maintain the pilot lamp or change, in order to prevent the consequence that can not estimate, secondly prevent that the spring from breaking away from adjusting the pole outside, prevent that the spring can't drive and adjust the pole and remove.

title_en: Mobile application system based on micro-service
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mobile application system based on micro-servitization, which relates to the technical field of mobile application and comprises a device shell and an electronic element body, wherein the bottom of the electronic element body is fixedly connected with a fixed rod, the inner wall of the bottom of the device shell is provided with a placing groove which is in sliding fit with the fixed rod, the inner walls of two sides of the placing groove are respectively provided with a limiting groove, the inner wall of one side of each limiting groove is fixedly connected with a plurality of uniformly distributed limiting springs, one end of each limiting spring is fixedly connected with a limiting block which is in sliding fit with the limiting groove, the opposite surfaces of the two limiting blocks are contacted with the fixed rod, the inner wall of the bottom of the placing groove is fixedly connected with a fixing mechanism, the fixing mechanism comprises a plurality of uniformly distributed fixing springs, and one end of the bottom of each fixing spring is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the bottom of the placing groove. The utility model can facilitate the installation and the disassembly of the electronic element body by workers.

title_en: Up-conversion module for limiting based on balanced installation
abstract_en: The application discloses spacing up-conversion module of using based on balanced installation belongs to the up-conversion technology field, include the module body and be located module body one side and be the installation piece of L shape, the mounting groove has been seted up to one side of installation piece, the threaded rod is installed through the mounting groove to the installation piece, the fixed cover in the outside of threaded rod is equipped with the nut, the top of threaded rod and the detachable installation in bottom of module body, be provided with on the module body and be used for the real-time supervision module body whether horizontally to detect the module. This based on spacing up-conversion module of using of balanced installation through installing the installation piece at quick-witted incasement portion, places the module body on the installation piece, uses the spanner to rotate the nut this moment to driven the threaded rod and moved up or moved down, and then reached and carried out angle modulation's effect to the module body, helped the balanced installation of module body, conveniently with other parts installation or connection on the module body.

title_en: Heat dissipation air-out structure of electromagnetic stove
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electromagnetic cookers, and discloses a heat dissipation air-out structure of an electromagnetic cooker, which comprises a shell, wherein a cover plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the shell, a heat dissipation port is arranged at the side surface of the shell, side supporting plates are fixedly arranged at both ends of the inner side of the cover plate, an air inlet flow guide processing plate is movably arranged between the two side supporting plates, a filtering structure is arranged at one side of the bottom of the shell, the heat dissipation air-out structure of the electromagnetic cooker enables the bottom to form a relatively closed space by arranging the cover plate at the periphery of the bottom of an electromagnetic cooker body, then the air inlet flow guide processing plate with a corrugated shape is arranged for air flow guide, an oil smoke adsorption layer on the air inlet flow guide processing plate can adsorb the air containing oil smoke in a kitchen during heat dissipation, thereby greatly reducing the deposition condition that the oil smoke enters the shell, the service life of the device is ensured.

title_en: Plastic shell for protecting camera
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plastic casing for protecting camera, including positive solid fixed glue shell, back solid fixed glue shell, camera lens waterproof gasket and wire rod waterproof gasket. This a plastic casing for protecting camera, during the use, with camera lens waterproof gasket card in the camera lens wearing hole, with wire rod waterproof gasket card in the wearing hole, to glue in shell waterproof gasket embedding recess this moment, wear out positive stationary glue shell with the camera lens part of camera this moment in the camera lens waterproof gasket, wear out the back stationary glue shell with the connecting wire of camera in by wire rod waterproof gasket simultaneously, the recess on the shell with positive stationary glue is just right with the boss on the shell with back stationary glue shell this moment, and insert the boss in the recess, the screw waterproof gasket of taking this moment puts into the counter bore portion in proper order, and the bolt of taking, in threading threaded connection portion with bolt through screw waterproof gasket and counter bore portion, make front stationary glue shell and back stationary glue shell reciprocal anchorage, the protection of completion camera lens is kept apart.

title_en: MODBUS transparent transmission equipment using zigbee wireless protocol
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an use MODBUS of zigbee wireless protocol to pass equipment thoroughly involves the information transmission field, including fuselage and first gear, the tensile fixed part that is connected is installed to the top and the both sides of fuselage, wire winding parts is installed at the top of fuselage. An object of the application is to provide an MODBUS that uses zigbee wireless agreement passes equipment thoroughly, can enlarge the installation scope of fuselage through stirring the mounting of stirring forward or backward, with adapt to not unidimensional quick-witted case, install mounting and the mount of quick-witted incasement through the mounting hole, the installation is accomplished the back, under the spring action of first spring and second spring, the fuselage can be automatic placed in the middle part to four fixed points placed in the middle of, make the fuselage can unsettled place through this fixed mode simultaneously, and then make the fuselage effectively dispel the heat through the bottom louvre, the radiating effect of fuselage has been improved, and then the life of fuselage has been prolonged.

title_en: Spacing rotary mechanism and wireless earphone box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a spacing rotating mechanism and a wireless earphone box, which is provided with a first rotating body component connected with a first main body and a second rotating body component connected with a second main body; the first rotating body assembly and the second rotating body assembly are matched with each other and form relative rotation; the method is characterized in that: also has a middle rotator; the first rotor assembly includes a sleeve body connected to a first body; the second swivel assembly includes a driving shaft connected to the second body, and a swivel; the driving shaft and the rotating body are fixed in the circumferential direction and form transmission fit; the sleeve body and the middle rotating body form limiting rotation fit through a first limiting block which is arranged in the first arc-shaped groove in a sliding mode; the middle rotating body and the rotating body form a limiting rotation fit through a second limiting block which is arranged in the second arc-shaped groove in a sliding mode. The utility model can realize bidirectional rotation, and both directions have the limiting function of preventing over rotation; meanwhile, the full-open and full-close alarm has in-place reminding effect and excellent hand feeling.

title_en: Electrical engineering and automation equipment protector thereof
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electrical engineering and automatic equipment protection device thereof, which comprises a box body, wherein an air inlet protective cover is arranged at the outer side of an air inlet at one side of the box body, a dustproof net is arranged in the air inlet protective cover, a cleaning component is arranged at one side of the dustproof net, a motor protective cover is arranged at one side of the air inlet protective cover, a driving component is arranged in the motor protective cover, a fixing plate fixedly connected to the outer side of the box body is arranged at the lower side of the driving component, a transmission component is arranged at the lower side of the box body, a fan cover is arranged at the bottom of the box body, a heat dissipation component is arranged in the fan cover, a mounting plate is arranged in the box body, and an air outlet is arranged at the other side of the box body.

title_en: Charging cabinet

Through installation flash light and support frame, the light scintillation of flash light can dispel the flying bird, prevents that the flying bird from damaging the insulator, increases insulator life.

Including L type mounting panel and slip locate the collection box of L type mounting panel upper end, collection box lower extreme symmetry is equipped with two T type sliders, L type mounting panel up end has been seted up and is used for the gliding spout of T type slider, collection box one side lower extreme is equipped with the clearance mouth, clearance mouth middle part is equipped with the sealing plug, collection box upper end is equipped with the blanking mouth, collection box upper end rotation is equipped with  template with blanking mouth matched with,  template internal fixation is equipped with the slope slide bar, collection box internal sliding is equipped with the movable plate, the movable plate upper end is fixed and is equipped with the adapter sleeve with slope slide bar matched with, collection box lateral wall middle part is equipped with drive assembly. title_en: Antistatic mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of ITO electrode antistatic, in particular to an antistatic mechanism, which comprises a liquid crystal panel and a backlight module, wherein the liquid crystal panel sequentially comprises a polarizing plate, a glass substrate, a color filter, an ITO electrode layer, an alignment film, liquid crystal, an alignment film, an ITO electrode layer, a color filter, a glass substrate and a polarizing plate from top to bottom, and the backlight module sequentially comprises an optical diaphragm, a lamp tube reflecting plate, a cold cathode lamp tube, a light guide plate and an optical diaphragm from top to bottom; the ITO electrode layer is provided with a discharge tip (I) and an outer ring antistatic design (II). According to the utility model, by properly adjusting the sharpness of the discharge tip [ I ] and the distance between the two tips, the discharge trend between the electrodes is preferentially guided to the ITO discharge tip which is designed intentionally, and the discharge tip [ I ] is designed to be in a state easier to discharge than other ITO electrodes; the outer ring antistatic design [ II ] can play roles of electrostatic discharge and electrostatic shielding.

title_en: Spliced universal circuit board
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a spliced universal circuit board, which belongs to the technical field of circuit board splicing, and comprises a first circuit board and a second circuit board, wherein the first circuit board and the second circuit board are respectively 3.00-6.40 mm thick circuit boards, splicing parts are integrally formed at the left end and the right end of the first circuit board and the second circuit board, a splice plate is inserted between the first circuit board and the second circuit board, a first soldering tin hole is formed in the splicing parts, second soldering tin holes with the number being matched with that of the first soldering tin holes are formed in the splice plate, the splice plates can be arranged at two ends of the circuit board, then the splice plates are arranged between a pair of splicing parts, the splice plates are primarily connected through deformation buckles on the splicing plates, the splice plates are aligned with the soldering tin holes on the splicing parts, and finally the soldering tin holes are in soldering tin connection, so that the stability of the connection of the two circuit boards can be ensured.

The sound insulation plate frame is detachably arranged on the base, so that parts are convenient to carry, convenient and rapid to assemble during construction, and convenient to disassemble and maintain in the later period; the utility model is provided with the display screen, so that reasonable utilization of resources is realized; in addition, the utility model has good sound insulation effect and stronger practicability.

According to the utility model, the elastic structure supporting component arranged on the inner wall of the mounting seat of the power management module can play a role in elastic buffering and damping on the periphery of the power management module body, reduce impact influence on the power management module body, and separate the power management module body from the inner opening of the ventilation hole, so that a sufficient and smooth flowing space is provided for heat, and further the heat dissipation effect of the power management module body is improved.

abstract_en: The utility model provides an electric appliance remote controller, which comprises a surface shell, a bottom shell, a circuit board and a first key structure, wherein the peripheral wall of the bottom shell comprises a first side wall, a first key hole is formed in the first side wall, a first touch switch is arranged on the circuit board, the first key structure comprises a first key cap, a first keyboard and a first elastic cantilever, the first key cap is arranged on the first keyboard and can slidably penetrate out of the first key hole, the first keyboard can be abutted to the inner wall surface of the first side wall, a first touch part is convexly arranged on the first keyboard, the first touch part and the first touch switch are correspondingly arranged and can be abutted to the first touch switch, the first end of the first elastic cantilever is connected with the first touch part, and the first elastic cantilever extends from the first touch part to the first clamping part along the outline of the bottom shell. The electric appliance remote controller can reduce the thickness of the bottom shell and the area of the face shell, so that the whole volume of the electric appliance remote controller is effectively reduced, and the electric appliance remote controller is simple and compact in structure and stable and reliable in key structure.

abstract_en: The utility model provides an adjustable publicity board, and mainly relates to the technical field of production publicity equipment. The utility model provides an adjustable publicity board, includes the mounting panel, the mounting hole has all been seted up respectively in the top surface four corners of mounting panel, the bottom of mounting panel passes through rotary mechanism and rotates mounting plate, the preceding and the back of bottom plate respectively fixed mounting have the information display board, the place ahead of bottom plate and the back all are equipped with the scraping device that can vertical reciprocating motion. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: this device can hang the information display board installation through the mounting panel in workshop eminence and publicize, has solved ground and has put the problem that propaganda device is easily sheltered from, improves the propaganda effect.

title_en: Heat radiation system of power module
abstract_en: The utility model provides a heat dissipation system of a power module, comprising: the heat pipe system comprises an evaporation section and a condensation section, the condensation section can exchange heat with a refrigerant in the fluorine pump air conditioning system to release heat to the refrigerant, the evaporation section can exchange heat with the power module to absorb heat and cool the power module, the adjustable heat conduction module is arranged between the evaporation section and the power module, and the adjustable heat conduction module can increase heat transfer thermal resistance when the fluorine pump air conditioning system operates in a fluorine pump refrigeration mode and reduce or prevent heat exchange between the power module and the evaporation section. According to the utility model, the adjustable heat conduction module can be selectively controlled to increase heat transfer resistance particularly in a fluorine pump refrigeration mode, so that the condensation phenomenon formed at the power module by low-temperature cold energy conduction is effectively prevented, and the problem of safety is avoided.

title_en: Novel traffic signal sign for urban road
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel traffic signal sign board for an urban road, which comprises a fixed rod, wherein the top end of the fixed rod is provided with an adjusting structure, the top end of the adjusting structure is provided with a mounting rod, one end of the outer side wall of the mounting rod is movably provided with a sign board main body, a connecting seat is arranged at the top end of the mounting rod, the top end of the connecting seat is provided with a solar panel, and one end of the connecting seat is provided with an illuminating lamp. According to the traffic signal board, the illuminating mechanism is arranged at the top end of the mounting rod, when the traffic signal board is installed on the roadside and used at night, when the environment on the roadside is dim, the solar cell panel in the illuminating mechanism absorbs solar illumination and converts the solar illumination into a computer for storage, and then the computer is supplied to the illuminating lamp for illuminating the illuminating lamp, so that the traffic signal board is convenient for people to observe the indicating board at night and has a better use effect.

title_en: Touch control pen, display module assembly and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a touch pen, a display module and a vehicle, wherein the touch pen comprises a trigger and a photoelectric sensor; the trigger is used for starting or waking up the touch pen so as to enable the touch pen to be in first interconnection with the controlled device, and the photoelectric sensor is used for emitting light rays to the controlled device so as to enable the touch pen to be in second interconnection with the controlled device under the condition that the touch pen is in first interconnection with the controlled device; in the case of the first interconnect, the stylus is in bluetooth mode, and in the case of the second interconnect, the stylus is in light sensing mode; in the Bluetooth mode, the touch pen is used for controlling the controlled device in a contact mode, and in the light sensing mode, the touch pen is used for controlling the controlled device in a non-contact mode. The stylus pen can freely select the use mode of the stylus pen according to the use scene, so that the problem that the current stylus pen is low in flexibility and limited in user operation is effectively solved.

title_en: Fluorescent signboard
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fluorescent signboard which comprises a signboard slot and a signboard body, wherein the signboard slot is a box slot which is vertically arranged and is provided with an upper end and a front end, the middle part of the upper end is open, the front side of the signboard body is provided with a fluorescent display layer, the fluorescent display layer displays warning words, the signboard body is inserted into the signboard slot through the upper end of the signboard slot, and the warning words on the front side of the signboard body are exposed out through the opening part in the middle part of the front end of the signboard slot, so that the signboard body can be replaced according to the requirement, in addition, the signboard slot can be arranged on the front side of an electric cabinet, meanwhile, because the warning words on the signboard body are displayed by the fluorescent display layer, the fluorescent display layer does not need energy consumption, and fluorescent display warning words are sent out at dark places (especially at night), the warning effect is obvious, and the operation is stable and good.

title_en: Transceiver shell structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of transceivers and provides a transceiver shell structure, which comprises a transceiver, wherein the top end of the transceiver is fixedly connected with a support frame, the bottom end of the transceiver is provided with a support plate, the middle parts of the support frames are respectively provided with a protective cover, the middle parts of the top ends of the support frames are respectively provided with a top groove, and the top grooves are fixedly connected with the protective covers; the utility model is beneficial to radiating the transceiver by arranging the fan blades and the protective shell, is convenient for a worker to gradually increase the working intensity due to long-time working when working indoors or outdoors, so that the temperature inside the transceiver gradually rises, part of hot air is radiated through the radiating holes, part of the hot air is radiated through the radiating fins, and the fan blades are started by the worker to quickly discharge the hot air radiated by the radiating fins, so that the internal hot air is radiated more quickly, and the protective shell can protect the fan blades.

title_en: Well lid intelligent monitoring terminal based on thing networking
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent well lid monitoring terminal based on the Internet of things, which comprises an intelligent well lid detection terminal body, wherein one end of the intelligent well lid detection terminal body is provided with a mounting plate, one end of the mounting plate, which is close to the intelligent well lid detection terminal body, is provided with a drying cylinder, and a drying cavity is arranged in the drying cylinder. According to the utility model, the drying cylinder is arranged, so that moist vapor in the main body of the well lid intelligent detection terminal can be adsorbed by the action of the drying agent bag in the drying cylinder in the use process, the influence of the vapor on electronic elements in the terminal is reduced, the service life of the main body of the well lid intelligent detection terminal in a moist environment is prolonged, when the drying agent bag is used for a long time, the rotating block is driven by the cross groove to rotate, and the rotating block drives the internal thread to synchronously rotate in the external thread, so that the drying cylinder is detached from the main body of the well lid intelligent detection terminal, and at the moment, the mounting cover can be removed by the separation of the fixing ring and the fixing groove, so that the drying agent bag can be replaced conveniently.

title_en: Chemical liquid supply device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model provides a chemical liquid supply device, and relates to the technical field of chemical conveying. The chemical liquid supply apparatus includes a support and a flow path assembly. The support includes four supporting legs, lateral platform and base frame, and four supporting legs are connected with the base frame, and the lateral platform is connected with one side that the supporting leg was kept away from to the base frame, and the support that supporting leg, lateral platform and base frame formed is approximately "taijiu" form, has stronger stability, consequently, installs the flow path subassembly on the support and has stronger stability, consequently the shock wave of liquid to the support is difficult to cause the shake of support when the feed liquor entry of outside liquid input flow path subassembly, guarantees that whole device is in steady state, and then avoids causing the instrument and meter to receive the influence, and then avoids appearing reading error.

title_en: LED box of pedal type display device and pedal type display device with same
