abstract_en: The utility model provides an LED box and a pedal type display device with the same, wherein the LED box comprises: the corner of the first frame is provided with a fixing seat extending downwards; the power installation department is located the middle part of first frame, and the both ends of power installation department are connected between two opposite sides of first frame, and power installation department has the roof and connects in the bottom surface of roof and enclose the second frame of establishing in the periphery of roof, and roof and second frame form opening decurrent installation space, and the second frame includes first peripheral board, is located the inboard first internal coaming of first peripheral board and connects a plurality of first strengthening ribs between first peripheral board and first internal coaming. The technical scheme of the application can effectively solve the problem that the middle part of the LED box body in the related technology is easy to break after being stressed too much.

title_en: Security protection camera capable of performing angle adjustment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a security camera capable of adjusting an angle, which comprises a vertical guide rail plate, a transverse guide rail plate and a camera main body, wherein the camera main body is hinged with a hinge lug through an ear bracket, an electric push rod is arranged on the inner side of the hinge joint, a camera cover is arranged on the top of the camera main body, the hinge lug is connected with a third motor through a rotating shaft, the bottom of the third motor is connected with the transverse guide rail plate through a second guide clamping plate, one end of the transverse guide rail plate is connected with the vertical guide rail plate through a first guide clamping plate, and a control panel is arranged at the position, close to the lower side, of one side of the vertical guide rail plate. The camera body is hinged with the hinge lug through the lug frame, the electric push rod is arranged on the inner side of the hinge joint, so that the angle of the camera body can be adjusted, the hinge lug is rotationally connected with the motor cover through the rotating shaft, the camera body can be automatically adjusted to turn, and the flexibility is high.

title_en: Head-mounted display device
abstract_en: The present utility model provides a head-mounted display device, comprising: the display device comprises an inner mirror frame, an outer mirror frame and a display device, wherein the outer mirror frame and the inner mirror frame form a containing cavity, and the display device is arranged in the containing cavity; a soaking film is arranged on the outer mirror frame and is positioned in the accommodating cavity; the display device comprises a connecting beam, a main board and two optical machine components, wherein a first heat conduction piece is arranged on one side of the connecting beam, which faces the outer mirror frame, and a plurality of heat source devices are arranged on the main board; and the connecting cross beam is positioned in the projection range of the soaking film in the projection direction from the inner lens frame to the outer lens frame. Compared with the prior art, the head-mounted display device disclosed by the utility model has the advantages that the heat emitted by the heat source device is transferred to the uniform heat film by the heat conduction piece, and then the heat is diffused to the outer mirror frame by the uniform heat film, so that the local accumulation of the heat is avoided, and the heat dissipation effect of the outer mirror frame is improved.

title_en: Mobile phone liquid crystal display screen assembly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a mobile phone liquid crystal display assembly, which comprises a display assembly, a mobile phone main board and a screen seat, wherein a fixing groove for accommodating the display assembly and the screen seat is formed in the top of the mobile phone main board; the screen seat is provided with a sliding block positioned in the sliding groove, wherein the sliding block is provided with a clamping block embedded in the corresponding U-shaped notch, and the sliding block is also provided with a bolt in threaded connection with the screw tube; a circle of sealing layer is arranged in the accommodating groove, a filling layer extending into the corresponding sliding groove is arranged at the bottom of the sealing layer, and a hot melt adhesive layer is adhered in the accommodating groove above the sealing layer. The utility model has simple structure and convenient use.

title_en: Anti-interference access control power supply
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an anti-interference access control power supply, which comprises a box body, wherein the box body is divided into a first half shell, a second half shell and a center shell, the first half shell and the second half shell are respectively positioned at two ends of the center shell and are fixedly connected, one surfaces of the first half shell and the second half shell are arranged in an opening way, a shielding window is arranged at the opening part, the outward surface of the shielding window is covered with a dust screen, the inward surface of the shielding window is provided with a fan, a convection heat dissipation structure and a heat conduction structure are adopted to conduct heat dissipation simultaneously, waveguide windows arranged at two ends of the box body can be matched with the shell to avoid the interference of external electromagnetic signals in the power supply, and a plurality of honeycomb holes arranged on the waveguide windows can be matched with the fans in the power supply to form air flow, so that the inside is rapidly dissipated by using external air.

title_en: Outdoor public broadcasting stereo set
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of broadcasting sound and discloses an outdoor public broadcasting sound, which comprises a sound, wherein a sliding plate is fixedly connected to the surface of the sound, a pull rod assembly is fixedly connected to the inside of the sliding plate, a sound outlet is formed in the side face of the sound, a dust-proof assembly is fixedly connected to the surface of the sound outlet, a support column is fixedly connected to the bottom of the sound, and a universal wheel is fixedly connected to the bottom of the support column. This outdoor public broadcasting stereo set, through the setting of pull rod subassembly, when carrying out outdoor broadcast stereo set, push button downwards, the button this moment drives the slip post and moves downwards, and then drives spacing button and stretches out and draws back, upwards mentions the pull rod handrail this moment, according to required height with spacing Niu Tingzhu spacing hole on spacing loop bar can, convenient removal stereo set, for removing stereo set labour saving and time saving, played the effect that alleviates user's burden and convenient and fast's removal stereo set.

title_en: Handle for supporting wireless microphone
abstract_en: The application provides a handle for supporting a wireless microphone, comprising: the device comprises a control chip, a distance sensing device, a contact device and a power supply device, wherein the distance sensing device and the power supply device are respectively and electrically connected with the control chip, and the contact device is electrically connected with the power supply device; the distance sensing device is used for detecting the distance between the wireless microphone and the handle and outputting the distance to the control chip; and the control chip controls the handle to be automatically opened when the distance meets a preset threshold value, so that the handle enters a working state from a closing state, and controls the power supply device to charge the wireless microphone when the wireless microphone is connected with the contact device. The handle not only can provide a supporting function for the wireless microphone, but also can be automatically opened under the condition that the electric quantity of the wireless microphone is insufficient so as to realize the charging of the wireless microphone, so that the functions of the handle are more diversified.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted host heat dissipation system and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vehicle-mounted host heat dissipation system, which comprises: radiating unit, radiator, hold liquid container, liquid pump and cooling pipeline, cooling pipeline includes: the circulating branch is connected with the heat radiating unit, the liquid pump, the radiator and the liquid storage container, and heat conduction connection is formed between the circulating branch and the cooling assisting branch; a vehicle comprises an evaporator and the host heat radiation system, wherein a cooling auxiliary branch is connected with the evaporator to obtain condensed water generated by the evaporator. The utility model reasonably utilizes the cooling liquid and the condensed water, and realizes the rapid cooling of the host machine: the circulation flow of the cooling liquid takes away heat, so that the heat dissipation unit continuously dissipates heat; the cooling auxiliary branch and the radiator can reduce the temperature of the cooling liquid, and compared with a single cooling mode, the cooling efficiency is improved; the condensed water temperature is lower, and the cooling water is used for cooling the cooling liquid, so that the heat dissipation effect is enhanced; the condensed water which is originally directly discharged is reused, so that water resources are saved.

title_en: Energy-saving heating control equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of heating control equipment, in particular to energy-saving heating control equipment, which comprises a shell, a heating control equipment body and a heat dissipation mechanism, wherein the heat dissipation mechanism comprises a driving component, fan blades, a refrigerating sheet, a water cooling pipe and a circulating water tank, and can transfer heat to a warmer of a client through the heating control equipment body.

title_en: Solder paste printer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a solder paste printer, which comprises a shell, wherein an inlet is formed in one side of the shell, a dust removing device is arranged on the inlet, the dust removing device comprises a base pipe and a row of air nozzles arranged below the base pipe, a positive pressure cavity, a negative pressure cavity and a plurality of connecting cavities are formed in the base pipe, an air inlet and an air outlet are respectively formed in the positive pressure cavity and the negative pressure cavity, the air inlet and the air outlet are respectively connected with an air blowing fan and an air extracting fan, a three-way pipe is arranged between the positive pressure cavity, the negative pressure cavity and the connecting cavities, a switching valve is arranged on the three-way pipe and used for switching the communication among the positive pressure cavity, the connecting cavities, the negative pressure cavity and the connecting cavities, and the connecting cavities are communicated with the air nozzles. The switching valve can be switched to realize that the tuyere has the function of air suction or blowing. The blowing or air suction function is arranged on the row of air nozzles at different positions below the base pipe, so that more personalized solutions can be provided for removing sundries on the circuit board.

title_en: Date-adjustable signboard
abstract_en: The application discloses a signboard of adjustable date belongs to medical supplies technical field. The date adjustable sign includes a base assembly and a date adjustment assembly. The base assembly comprises: the utility model provides a portable electronic device, including marking portion and binding portion, binding portion sets up on the marking portion, date adjusting component includes rotation portion and fixed part, rotation portion with fixed part all sets up on the marking portion, during the use, under the effect of frictional force, make the digit wheel fixed in the mounting groove, then utilize the soft area to tie up square board on the apparatus basket or on the shelf, the marking plate of this adjustable date is deposited and is no longer arranged far and near date in order, only need take out the date of the day when depositing, then insert the sterilization package empty put, both can labour saving and time saving, the date has been accomplished clearly again, conveniently deposit also conveniently to issue, reach striking clear, the purpose at a glance, bring better user experience for the user.

title_en: Portable direct current mobile power supply vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides a portable direct current mobile power supply vehicle, which comprises a carriage, a rectifying module and a storage battery module, wherein a transverse partition board is arranged in the carriage to divide the carriage into two layers, the rectifying module is positioned on the upper layer, the storage battery module is positioned on the lower layer, and an alternating current power supply input module and a direct current power supply output module are arranged on the outer surface of the carriage; the input end and the output end of the rectifying module are respectively and electrically connected with the alternating current power supply input module and the direct current power supply output module; the storage battery module is connected with the rectifying module in parallel. This application is through setting up rectifier module and battery module to with its parallelly connected setting, make direct current portable power source car can directly link to each other with alternating current power supply and convert into direct current, still can store the electric energy through battery module, provide the electric energy when being convenient for do not have external power source, promote the flexibility of use, the suitability is stronger.

title_en: Electric automatization signal generator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric automatic signal generator, which comprises a signal generator body, wherein the left side surface of the signal generator body is fixedly connected with a protective cover, the inner wall of the signal generator body is fixedly provided with an electric element plate, the left side surface of the electric element plate is fixedly connected with a heat conducting plate, the left side surface of the signal generator body is provided with a heat radiating opening, the inner wall of the heat radiating opening is fixedly connected with a refrigerating sheet, the right side surface of the refrigerating sheet is contacted with the left side surface of the heat conducting plate, the right side of the signal generator body is provided with a sealing plate, the left side surface of the sealing plate is provided with two ventilation openings, the inner walls of the two ventilation openings are respectively fixedly provided with a ventilation fan, the right side surface of the sealing plate is fixedly connected with a dustproof net, and the right ends of the two ventilation openings are contacted with the left side surface of the dustproof net. The utility model provides high signal generator's heat dissipation cooling effect to the low temperature demand when having satisfied signal generator work operation.

title_en: Anti-galactorrhea absorbing element and protective element
abstract_en: The present utility model relates to an anti-galactorrhea absorbent element and a protective element, the anti-galactorrhea absorbent element comprising a body having a substantially flat extension and the body having an inner surface and an outer surface, the inner surface being configured to contact a nipple; wherein at least the inner surface is made of a soft, contractible absorbent material to retain liquid leaving the nipple; and wherein the outer surface has a fluorescent pattern presentation corresponding to a respective state of the breast for feeding. The anti-galactorrhea absorbent element indicates which chest is ready for feeding and is simple in construction, inexpensive and easy to use.

title_en: Liquid crystal display with heat radiation structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a liquid crystal display screen with a heat radiation structure, which comprises a display screen frame and a display screen cover, wherein an external heat radiation mechanism is arranged at the top end of the display screen frame, an external fan mechanism is arranged at the top end of the external heat radiation mechanism, the display screen cover is arranged at the front end of the display screen frame, the upper side and the lower side of the display screen cover are provided with heat radiation frames, the external fan mechanism comprises an embedded rail and a heat radiation fan group, the two sides of the heat radiation fan group are provided with embedded rails, and the two sides of the display screen frame are provided with two side heat extraction mechanisms. This liquid crystal display with heat radiation structure, heat dissipation fan group is outside at display screen frame and outside heat dissipation mechanism through embedding rail slidable mounting, effectually with heat dissipation fan group slip laminating on liquid crystal display, liquid crystal display also slides the dismantlement through embedding rail to heat dissipation fan group simultaneously, does benefit to liquid crystal display and simply changes the fan as required, and the collocation adopts built-in heat radiation structure to dispel the heat.

title_en: Sign for rural tourist attraction convenient to change content
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sign board for a rural tourist attraction, which is convenient for replacing content, and comprises a stand column and an illumination assembly arranged at the top of the stand column, wherein the stand column is provided with a direction board, an indication assembly is arranged below the direction board, the indication assembly comprises an indication board, the indication board is arranged on the stand column through a rotation assembly, one side wall of the indication board is provided with a slot, and the front surface of the indication board is provided with an observation window; the inside of slot is equipped with buffer unit, has inserted the setting plate in the slot, and the one end top of setting plate is on buffer unit, and the other end is arranged in the external world and through setting up the locking component restriction position on the pilot board, and the outside of slot opening one end is equipped with the protection casing, sets up flutedly on the setting plate openly, and the recess internal fixation has the show board of material for iron, has adsorbed magnet on the show board. When the utility model is used, the slot opening is downward, and the protective cover is reused, so that dust can be effectively prevented from being directly blown into the indication board, and the content poster is fixed by utilizing the magnetism of the magnet, so that the utility model is very convenient.

title_en: Solid state disk main control chip and solid state disk
abstract_en: The utility model provides a main control chip of a solid state disk and the solid state disk, which relate to the technical field of hard disks and comprise a solid state disk body, wherein the main control chip, a micro-pressure chip and a plurality of storage particles are integrated on the solid state disk body.

title_en: Equipment support
abstract_en: The present utility model provides an equipment rack comprising: the equipment component is used for being connected with the electronic equipment; the fixing component is used for fixedly connecting the equipment bracket to a carrier; the two ends of the connecting component are respectively connected with the equipment component and the fixing component so as to fixedly support the equipment component on the fixing component; wherein the device assembly comprises: a first housing having a first adsorption surface facing away from the stationary assembly; a first electromagnet mounted within the first housing and responsive to energization generates a magnetic force that magnetically attracts the electronic device to the first attraction surface.

title_en: Switch with heat dissipation function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a switch with a heat dissipation function, which comprises a switch body, wherein fixing strips are arranged on the top surface of the switch body near the front and rear parts, connecting strips are connected between the two fixing strips near the middle positions, two sides of each connecting strip are movably connected with turning covers through rotating shafts, one side, far away from each other, of each turning cover is connected with a side plate, dust screens are arranged on the top surface of the switch body near the positions, below the two turning covers, of each side plate, two fixing seats which are arranged in parallel are arranged outside the side plates, and screw holes are formed in the side plates in a penetrating manner; the switch with the heat radiation function can be opened at the upper part during the use period of the switch, so that the heat radiation range of the switch is enlarged, and the heat radiation performance of the switch is further promoted.

title_en: Panel component of intelligent home
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of intelligent home components and discloses a panel component of an intelligent home, which comprises an operation panel mechanism, a frame mechanism and a supporting plate mechanism, wherein the operation panel mechanism is clamped and arranged in the frame mechanism through a plurality of fixing and clamping mechanisms, the frame mechanism is magnetically arranged at the front end surface position of the supporting plate mechanism, the frame mechanism comprises a plurality of fixing and clamping mechanisms, an outer frame supporting plate and an inner frame, a buffer rubber cushion layer is fixedly arranged between the outer frame supporting plate and the inner frame, and anti-falling rubber pads are fixedly arranged at four corners of the outer frame supporting plate. According to the utility model, the assembly can be quickly assembled and disassembled, so that the assembly is convenient to maintain and debug later, and meanwhile, the arranged frame mechanism can protect the internal operation panel mechanism, so that the probability of damage of the assembly when the assembly is bumped with the outside and falls accidentally is reduced, and the protection effect is provided for the panel assembly.

title_en: Cooling system of frequency converter operation machine room
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cooling system of a frequency converter operation machine room, which comprises a refrigerator, a draught fan and a heat exchanger, wherein the machine room is provided with an air outlet channel communicated with the refrigerator through a cold air pipeline, the air outlet channel comprises a wind power collecting section, a wind power extrusion section and a wind power emission section, the wind power collecting section is connected with an inlet of the cold air pipeline, and cold air which is accessed into the wind power collecting section is extruded by the wind power extrusion section and then emitted by the wind power emission section. According to the frequency converter operation machine room cooling system disclosed by the utility model, cooling air is conveyed into the machine room through the arranged refrigerator to reduce the air temperature in the machine room, and the induced draft fan is used for conveying hot air in the machine room to the heat exchanger through the pipeline after leading out the hot air, so that a cooling mode of circulating air is formed in the machine room, the air temperature in the machine room is quickly reduced, the wind power flow rate can be increased through the arranged air outlet channel, the cooling speed in the machine room is accelerated, and the problems of poor cooling effect and cooling through an air conditioner in the prior art are solved.

title_en: Civil combustible gas detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a civil combustible gas detector, which relates to the technical field of combustible gas detection and comprises an assembly box and a sealing cover, wherein a uniformly distributed fixing plate is fixedly connected to the outer part of the sealing cover. This civilian combustible gas detector uses through the cooperation of heat-conducting plate and fin and fan group and injection pipeline for this civilian combustible gas detector assembles wireless module, siren, detector on the heat-conducting plate, and wireless module, siren, detector heat conduction to the fin through the heat-conducting plate when lasting work distributes through the outside part of fin extension to the assembly box, and fan group work and preparation wind beam simultaneously, and the wind beam is spouted through the jet orifice on the injection pipeline at assembly box rear, acts on the fin, and the heat dissipation of auxiliary cooling piece, thereby promotes the holistic radiating effect of this civilian combustible gas detector, provides good operational environment for wireless module, siren, detector.

title_en: Reinforcing structure for improving durability of subwoofer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reinforcing structure for improving durability of a subwoofer, which comprises a subwoofer main body, a reinforcing protecting cover and a sealing ring gasket, wherein the front end of the subwoofer main body extends outwards along the edge of a horn mouth of the subwoofer main body to form a mounting edge, connecting holes for screws to pass through are formed in the mounting edge at intervals, the reinforcing protecting cover is arranged in front of the subwoofer main body, a sealing cover section is formed on the reinforcing protecting cover corresponding to the mounting edge of the subwoofer main body, a cover wall extends backwards along the outer edge of the sealing cover section to form a cover cavity, the rear of the sealing cover section is surrounded by the cover wall to form a cover cavity for the front end of the subwoofer main body to be clamped in, and the edge of the mounting edge is propped against the inner side surface of the cover wall; the sealing gasket is arranged between the sealing cover section and the mounting edge and covers the screw penetrating through the connecting hole of the mounting edge. The utility model can prevent the screw from being oxidized by the outside, thereby improving the durability of the subwoofer.

title_en: A show stand for cigarette exhibition
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a display stand for cigarette exhibition, which relates to the technical field of display stands and comprises a display stand and a cigarette plate, wherein the surface of the display stand is fixedly connected with the surface of the cigarette plate, the display stand comprises a counter and a trapezoid table, the surface of the counter is fixedly connected with the surface of the cigarette plate, the bottom of the counter is in sliding connection with the inside of the trapezoid table, the side surface of the counter is fixedly connected with a handle, the surface of the trapezoid table is fixedly provided with a glass plate, and the inner bottom surface of the trapezoid table is provided with a movable cavity. According to the utility model, the trapezoid table and the glass plate are designed through inclined plane display, so that a customer buying cigarettes can select the types of the cigarettes, when the cigarettes are required to be taken, the counter is pulled to move on the sliding rail through the sliding block by pulling the handle, so that the counter is pulled out, the damping spring is stretched in the pulling-out process, and after the cigarettes are taken out from the cigarette plate, the handle is released to slowly rebound.

title_en: High-power mining explosion-proof frequency converter module
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-power mining explosion-proof frequency converter module, and belongs to the technical field of frequency converters; the problems that the existing combined mining high-power frequency converter is large in occupied area and inconvenient to install and overhaul are solved; the power supply module comprises a module box body, wherein an input power supply plug and an output power supply plug are arranged on one side of the module box body; the power module comprises a power panel, a rectifier diode, a silicon controlled rectifier and a silicon controlled rectifier trigger plate; the main control unit comprises a main control board; the power unit comprises a power board, a driving board, an IGBT module, a direct-current support capacitor module, a laminated busbar and a water-cooling heat dissipation device; the power panel is arranged on one side close to the input power plug and the output power plug, and the main control panel and the power panel are arranged on one side of the power panel; the water-cooling heat dissipation device comprises a heat radiator and a water-cooling plate, wherein the rectifier diode, the silicon controlled rectifier and the IGBT module are all attached to the water-cooling plate; the utility model is applied to the high-power mining combined frequency converter.

title_en: Bluetooth sound with cell phone stand
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sound equipment, and discloses a Bluetooth sound equipment with a mobile phone support, which comprises a sound equipment body, wherein the upper end of the sound equipment body is provided with a mounting seat, the upper end of the mounting seat is provided with a support body, the upper end of the sound equipment body is fixedly connected with a fixed block, the side wall of the fixed block is provided with a fixing device, and the fixing device comprises: connecting block, locating piece, connecting rod, device groove, supporting spring, arc piece, device piece, arc groove, extrusion spring, carriage release lever, limiting plate, notch, first elastic block, gag lever post, spacing groove, second elastic block, extrusion lever, thereby the user only need remove the spacing of arc piece through inwards extrusion carriage release lever when dismantling, thereby extrusion arc piece makes the arc piece remove to the device groove when the carriage release lever moves to arc inslot portion this moment to remove the joint of arc piece and device piece, then upwards pulling the connecting block can separate, thereby make things convenient for the device to use.

title_en: Outdoor sound amplifying equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses outdoor sound amplifying equipment which comprises a base, wherein the top of the base is fixedly connected with a vertical rod, the inside of the vertical rod is hollow, a vertical through groove is formed in the outer side of the vertical rod, a driving assembly is arranged in the space between the vertical rod and the base, the outer side of the vertical rod is connected with a lifting frame in a sliding mode, and the inside of the lifting frame penetrates through the vertical through groove to be matched with the driving assembly. According to the utility model, the vertical rod is supported by the base, the rapid loading and unloading of the sound amplifying body are conveniently realized by the installation component, the lifting frame is driven by the starting driving component to vertically run along the vertical rod through the vertical through groove, the lifting frame is driven to lift, the sound amplifying body is driven to realize the highly flexible adjustment, and the equipment can be overhauled and replaced conveniently by personnel on the ground, so that the device has the advantages of being capable of flexibly adjusting the height of the equipment, enabling maintenance personnel to conveniently maintain the equipment on the ground, and being more flexible and convenient to operate in loading and unloading.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a display device. The display device includes: the data driving module is configured with a PCR function; the PCR function groups the data lines and writes data signals into the data lines of different groups in a time-sharing way; a plurality of photosensitive sensors distributed in a display area of the display device; the photosensitive sensors can detect brightness information at different positions in the display area; the difference calculation module is electrically connected with the plurality of photosensitive sensors; the difference calculation module can calculate the brightness difference information of the display area according to a plurality of brightness information; the input end of the judging module is electrically connected with the difference calculating module, and the output end of the judging module is electrically connected with the data driving module; the judging module can compare the brightness difference information with a set threshold value and generate a PCR control signal so as to control whether the PCR function of the data driving module is started.

title_en: Novel multifunctional loudspeaker device applied to weak current engineering security protection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a novel multifunctional loudspeaker device applied to weak current engineering security, which comprises an outer cover and a loudspeaker body arranged in the outer cover; the bottom of the outer cover is provided with a sound amplifying hole corresponding to the loudspeaker body, the sound amplifying hole is positioned in the middle of the bottom of the outer cover, the bottom of the outer cover is sequentially provided with a first ring body and a second ring body from inside to outside, the first ring body and the second ring body are both rotationally connected with the outer cover, the sound amplifying hole is positioned at the inner side of the first ring body, the first ring body is provided with a marking projection lamp, and the second ring body is provided with an inductor for sensing the approach of a person; the device also comprises a controller arranged in the outer cover, and the identification projection lamp and the sensor are electrically connected with the controller; this device overall structure is simple, fixes it on corridor ceiling during the actual installation, and when the backstage security protection system detected the accident emergence, not only accessible speaker body was reported evacuation information and relevant content to personnel around, and accessible inductor and sign projection lamp throw out the evacuation direction on the bottom surface simultaneously, and the function is richer.

title_en: Water channel plate for heat dissipation of power semiconductor module
abstract_en: The water channel plate for heat dissipation of the power semiconductor module comprises a water channel plate main body and a separated type flow disturbing column plate, wherein the top surface of the water channel plate main body is a placement plane which is tightly attached to and fixes the power module, a concave water cooling groove is formed in the middle of the placement plane, and the separated type flow disturbing column plate is detachably embedded in the water cooling groove; the water channel plate main body is provided with a water inlet and a water outlet, and the water inlet and the water outlet are respectively communicated to the water cooling groove. The water channel plate for heat radiation of the power semiconductor module can enable the water channel plate main body and the separated type flow disturbing column plate to be combined with the power module with the bottom without the integrated flow disturbing column plate, and the power module with the bottom with the integrated flow disturbing column plate can be installed when the water channel plate main body is used singly, so that the water channel plate main body is not required to be disassembled and assembled when different types of power modules are replaced, the assembly is convenient, the cost is saved, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Piezoelectric ceramic pickup
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a piezoelectric ceramic pickup, which comprises a pickup base, a piezoelectric ceramic plate, an FPC board and a pressing block, wherein one end of the top of the pickup base is provided with a mounting groove, the pressing block, the FPC board and the piezoelectric ceramic plate are sequentially arranged in the mounting groove from top to bottom, the top surface of the FPC board is mutually abutted with the bottom surface of the pressing block, the bottom surface of the FPC board is mutually abutted with the bottom surface of the piezoelectric ceramic plate, and the FPC board is electrically connected with the piezoelectric ceramic plate; above-mentioned piezoceramics adapter, briquetting, FPC board, piezoceramics piece from the top down installs in the mounting groove in proper order to the top surface of FPC board and the mutual butt of bottom surface of briquetting, the bottom surface of FPC board and the mutual butt of bottom surface of piezoceramics piece because the FPC board is very fine thin, and the briquetting is equivalent to directly pressing on piezoceramics piece, makes vibration signal's transmission distance obviously shorten, and the conduction of signal just is very direct, leads to the sound effect that the stereo set sent very good.

title_en: Light and thin display module structure applying ceramic antenna element and display screen
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of display modules, in particular to a light and thin display module structure and a display screen using ceramic antenna elements, wherein the module structure sequentially comprises a cover plate, a transparent optical layer, a display screen, a backing plate, a flexible circuit board and the ceramic antenna elements from top to bottom, an antenna bonding pad for mounting the ceramic antenna elements is arranged at the edge of the flexible circuit board, ground wires are arranged between the antenna bonding pad and other circuits on the flexible circuit board for separation, the ground wires are used for shielding the interference of the other circuits on the flexible circuit board on the antenna performance, the packaging size of the ceramic antenna elements is the same as the packaging size of conventional ceramic capacitors or resistors, the ceramic antenna elements are assembled on the antenna bonding pad through the surface, and the height of the ceramic antenna elements is smaller than or equal to the height of the highest element on the flexible circuit board.

title_en: Inter-row cooling core air conditioner
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an inter-row cold core air conditioner, which comprises an inner cabinet and a cold core assembly inserted in the inner cabinet, wherein the cold core assembly comprises a cold core frame, and an air supply fan, an evaporator, an electromagnetic expansion valve and a compressor are sequentially and fixedly arranged in the cold core frame; the bottom of the inner cabinet has a pair of support rails for mating with the cold core frame. The inter-row cold core air conditioner is composed of the modularized inner cabinet and the cold core component, the cold core component is inserted into the inner cabinet in a push-pull mode, later-stage transformation maintenance and replacement are convenient, replacement maintenance efficiency is relatively higher, time cost of a user is saved, labor force in the replacement process is saved for the user, and replacement maintenance operation is convenient.

title_en: Circuit board convenient to peg graft
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a circuit board convenient to plug, which comprises a circuit board main body, a pin seat fixedly arranged at the top of the circuit board main body, and pins arranged on the pin seat, wherein a box body is fixedly arranged at the top of the circuit board main body, the pins and the pin seat are both positioned in the box body, four guide posts which are in rectangular distribution are fixedly connected in the box body, guide plates are slidably arranged at the outer sides of the guide posts, grooves are arranged at the top of the guide plates, and springs are sleeved at the outer sides of the four guide posts.

title_en: Adjustable fixing support for LED large screen
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of LED large screens, and discloses an adjustable fixing support for an LED large screen, which comprises side baffles fixedly arranged on the left side and the right side of the surface of the fixing support, a chute is arranged at the central position of the surface of the fixing support, a sucker slider is slidably connected to the surface of the chute, a sliding plate is fixedly arranged on the upper side and the lower side of the surface of the fixing support, through grooves are arranged on the upper side and the lower side of the surface of the chute, a notch is arranged at the central position of the surface of the fixing support, and a clamping block is arranged at the central position of the surface of the through grooves. The sucker slider and the clamping block arranged in the utility model can move to one side of the inside of the adjusting plate on the inner plate, push the LED large screen fixedly arranged on the top surface of the sliding plate in position, facilitate a worker to push the LED large screen out of the surface of the fixed support directly through the sliding plate, avoid the need of a large number of bolts for fixing and clamping, greatly search for the effect of convenient disassembly and assembly, and have convenient and simple operation.

title_en: Loudspeaker
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of loudspeakers, and provides a loudspeaker, which comprises a shell, a diaphragm, a voice coil, a magnetic circuit unit and foam, wherein the shell comprises a base frame, an upper cover and a rear cover; the upper cover is provided with a pull edge, the top surface of the base frame is provided with a placing groove, the bottom edge of the placing groove is provided with a bulge for bearing the pull edge, and the middle part of the placing groove is provided with a through hole for installing the rear cover; the foam is arranged on the top surface of the upper cover and is positioned between the upper cover and the notch of the placing groove. The upper cover in the loudspeaker is optimized to form a structure with a pull edge so as to be adhered to the edge of the membrane in a fitting way to form an integrated structure so as to be assembled and installed subsequently. Further, the two sides of the base frame are open and structurally designed, so that the assembly can be completed by only adopting a mode of stacking and placing, the placing groove is bonded through foam, the purposes of sealing and shock absorption are achieved, the loudspeaker can be rapidly assembled and produced through mechanical equipment, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Sound equipment device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an acoustic device, which comprises a shell and a loudspeaker positioned in the shell, wherein the shell comprises an upper shell and a lower shell, the upper shell is provided with a snakelike first runner, the lower shell is provided with a second runner matched with the first runner, a runner chamber is formed after the first runner and the second runner are jointed, the runner chamber is positioned at one side of the loudspeaker, the runner chamber is provided with a first opening and a second opening, the first opening is positioned at one side of the loudspeaker, and the second opening is positioned at one side of the shell and is communicated with the outside. According to the sound device, after sound is generated by the loudspeaker, air flow generated by the loudspeaker enters from the first opening of the runner chamber, and as the runner chamber is S-shaped, part of the air flow can be counteracted in the process of passing through the runner chamber, and the rest of the air flow flows out from the second opening of the runner chamber, so that vibration of the shell is reduced, loosening or damage to peripheral parts after sound is generated by the sound device is effectively prevented, and the service life of the sound device is prolonged.

title_en: Quick tuning device for optical fiber grating wavelength
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fiber bragg grating wavelength rapid tuning device, which comprises a fiber bragg grating tuner body and a control box, wherein two groups of symmetrical anti-interference fiber interfaces are arranged on the outer walls of two sides of the fiber bragg grating tuner body, each anti-interference fiber interface comprises a fiber conduction shell and an anti-electromagnetic interference structure, two groups of mirror symmetry cavities are arranged in the fiber conduction shell, an anti-electromagnetic interference structure is arranged in each cavity, and optical fibers are led in and led out of the fiber bragg grating tuner body from the anti-interference fiber interfaces and the anti-electromagnetic interference structure. The anti-electromagnetic interference structure can effectively resist the influence of external electromagnetic interference, reduce electromagnetic interference and reduce the error of an optical fiber interface caused by interference, thereby reducing the frequency offset of an optical signal and ensuring the selection precision and the tuning precision of the optical signal.

title_en: Multifunctional noise-reducing and sound-absorbing protective sleeve
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of headphones, in particular to a multifunctional noise-reducing and sound-absorbing protective sleeve. Including the earphone shell, the outside of earphone shell has cup jointed the cloth cover, the inboard of cloth cover is fixed with the card frame, the one end that the earphone shell was kept away from to the cloth cover still is fixed with the link, the inboard of link is fixed with the filter tip cotton, the one end that the cloth cover was kept away from to the link is provided with the soundproof cotton cover, the inboard that the soundproof cotton cover is close to link one end is fixed with the link, the link is located the link inboard and with link swing joint, the inside upper end of link and lower extreme and the outside that is located the link are all threaded connection has the double-screw bolt, two double-screw bolts are close to the one end of link and all laminate mutually with the link. According to the utility model, through the integral structure matching design, the cloth cover and the earphone shell are convenient to mount or dismount, so that the earphone protective sleeve is convenient to replace, and the earphone shell and the cloth cover are more firmly mounted through the clamping assembly.

title_en: Automatic plug-in equipment and feeding device thereof
abstract_en: An automatic plug-in device and a feeding device thereof are provided, wherein the feeding device comprises a base, a top shell, a clamping unit and a cutter. A track is formed between the base and the top shell, and a braid is movable along the track. The clamping unit is arranged on the base and used for fixing an electronic element on the braid. The cutter has an inclined blade part for cutting off the pins of the electronic element, so that the tail ends of the pins form an inclined plane.

title_en: Road information display device and road information display system
abstract_en: The utility model provides road information display equipment and a road information display system, which relate to the technical field of intelligent transportation, wherein the road information display equipment can acquire road information in real time by utilizing a built-in data acquisition device, acquire a real-time display control instruction after being transmitted to a data processor through a transmission component, control a display screen to display current road information in a mode of characters, pictures, videos and the like by utilizing the display control instruction, and can broadcast the road information in real time by utilizing a loudspeaker at the same time, so that the problems of single display content, delayed information release, single function and the like of the road information display equipment in the prior art are solved.

title_en: Communication equipment with high plugging precision
abstract_en: The utility model discloses high-insertion-precision communication equipment, which comprises a first machine disc, an opposite-insertion assembly and at least one screw rod, wherein the first machine disc is provided with a first insertion hole; one end of the first machine disc is provided with a male end of a connector, the opposite-plug assembly is provided with a female end of the connector, and the male end of the connector is matched with the female end of the connector; the other end of first chassis is provided with the bulge, is provided with axial fixed orifices on the bulge, the one end setting of screw rod is in on the preset position of inserting the subassembly, the other end of screw rod runs through the fixed orifices, and the screw rod can drive first chassis is moved along the screw rod axial to close up for inserting the subassembly and is set up, so that with the male end of connector with the pin accuracy of inserting of female end of connector is adjusted to preset target value.

title_en: Pressing machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pressing machine. The laminating machine comprises a frame, a detection mechanism, a laminating mechanism and a conveying mechanism which are arranged on the frame, wherein the frame is provided with a detection station and a laminating station; the detection mechanism is correspondingly positioned at the detection station; the pressing mechanism comprises a first pressing structure and a second pressing structure which are arranged at opposite intervals, the first pressing structure and the second pressing structure are provided with movable strokes which are close to each other and far away from each other, and the first pressing structure and the second pressing structure are close to each other so as to form a pressing area; the conveying mechanism is used for conveying the to-be-pressed piece from the detection station to the pressing station, and at least part of the conveying mechanism is positioned between the intervals of the first pressing structure and the second pressing structure; the stitching region may cover at most half of the area of the part to be stitched at the stitching station in the transverse direction of the frame. The press-fit machine provided by the utility model can realize large-area rapid press-fit of the to-be-pressed piece, has high press-fit efficiency and ensures press-fit quality.

title_en: Circuit board of low-power consumption composite switching switch using intelligent reactive compensation capacitor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a circuit board applying an intelligent reactive compensation capacitor low-power consumption composite switching switch, and relates to the field of circuit boards, wherein the circuit board comprises a first mounting plate and a second mounting plate; the first detachable connecting portion that is connected with of mounting panel, connecting portion one be located the one end that mounting panel one is close to mounting panel two, the second detachable connecting portion that has of mounting panel two, connecting portion are located the one end that mounting panel two is close to mounting panel one, and connecting portion one connection connecting portion two is through above-mentioned technical scheme, sets up mounting panel one and mounting panel two, installs the on-off switch module in mounting panel two through soldering, in the in-service use, and mounting panel two is equipped with a plurality ofly, and different mounting panel two are provided with different control module quantity, connect through the winding displacement and carry out the connection of mounting panel one and mounting portion two, be convenient for follow-up change for the use of circuit board is more convenient.

title_en: Capacitor charge and discharge testing device before delivery
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of capacitors, in particular to a capacitor charging and discharging testing device before delivery, which solves the problems that in the prior art, charging and discharging testing equipment is not compact in structure and poor in heat dissipation, and the service life and testing accuracy of the testing equipment are reduced. The utility model provides a charge and discharge testing arrangement before electric capacity leaves factory, is including placing the box and setting up a plurality of standing groove at placing the box top, and the inside of every standing groove all is provided with the test board, and ventilation supporting component and the internal connection of standing groove are passed through to the bottom of test board, and the opening of a plurality of and the inside intercommunication of standing groove has been seted up to one side of placing the box, and the opening part is provided with cooling module. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the placement box, the placement groove, the ventilation supporting component and the heat dissipation component, each test board can be conveniently and independently dissipated, so that the heat dissipation efficiency is ensured, the heat dissipation quality can be improved, the test board is prevented from aging due to high temperature acceleration, and the test accuracy is ensured.

title_en: Self-coupling voltage-reducing starter with remote monitoring function
abstract_en: The utility model provides an auto-coupling voltage-reducing starter with remote monitoring, which relates to the technical field of energy-saving voltage-reducing starting control instruments of three-phase asynchronous motors and comprises an auto-coupling voltage-reducing starter and a ventilation mechanism, wherein the auto-coupling voltage-reducing starter comprises a fixed cabinet, an auto-coupling voltage-reducing starter body is installed inside the fixed cabinet, the ventilation mechanism comprises a monitoring probe, the monitoring probe is installed on one side of the fixed cabinet, a plurality of ventilation grooves are symmetrically formed in the outer side of the fixed cabinet, a containing groove is formed in the bottom of each ventilation groove, a sliding groove is formed in one side of each ventilation groove, a motor is installed at the top of each sliding groove, the bottom of each sliding groove is connected with a threaded rod through a bearing, the output end of each motor is in transmission connection with each threaded rod, and a sliding block is connected to the outer side of each threaded rod in a meshed mode. The utility model can lead a user to know the weather condition of the place where the self-coupling voltage reduction starter is located in real time, thereby being capable of determining whether the ventilation groove is blocked according to the weather, and further reducing the possibility of short circuit of the self-coupling voltage reduction starter body.

title_en: Jig placing plate
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of jigs and discloses a jig placing plate which comprises a bottom plate, wherein positioning blocks are movably connected to two sides of the top of the bottom plate, a clamping assembly is arranged on one side of the bottom plate, a limiting assembly is arranged on the other side of the bottom plate, grooves are formed in two sides of the top of the positioning blocks, and one side of each groove penetrates through the outer side of each positioning block. This kind of jig places board, through setting up rotating assembly, remove subassembly and drive assembly, two locating pieces remove in opposite directions and fix a position the back to the circuit board of placing at the bottom plate top, four dogs rotate respectively, it is spacing to carry out the top of circuit board, can also carry out spacing to the avris at circuit board top when carrying out centre gripping location to the circuit board, prevent that the circuit board from appearing the condition of perking the limit in carrying out processing procedure for the positioning effect of circuit board is better, and when realizing the centre gripping function, also satisfied the demand that can fix a position the circuit board of equidimension.

title_en: Circuit board positioning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of circuit board processing and discloses a circuit board positioning device which comprises a bottom shell, wherein a positioning assembly is arranged in the bottom shell, an adjusting assembly in threaded connection with the positioning assembly is arranged on the outer surface of the positioning assembly, a clamping assembly is arranged in the adjusting assembly, a supporting plate is fixedly connected above the bottom shell, a bidirectional threaded rod extending to the front surface of the bottom shell is rotatably connected in the bottom shell, sliding blocks which are symmetrically distributed in the front-back direction are in threaded connection with the outer surface of the bidirectional threaded rod, and mounting seats are fixedly connected to the tops of the two sliding blocks. This circuit board positioner possesses advantages such as adaptation multiple model circuit board, has solved the circuit board positioner of present common circuit board, and the circuit board of most unable adaptation size is different to lead to when processing the circuit board of different models, the multiple positioner that needs to correspond is to its location, very inconvenient problem.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted liftable loudspeaker
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a vehicle-mounted liftable loudspeaker, which comprises a sounding component and a shell, wherein the shell is provided with a lifting channel with an opening at the top, the sounding component is positioned at the top of the lifting channel, a driving component and a lifting component which are distributed in parallel are arranged in the shell, the top of the driving component is provided with a transmission structure, one end of the transmission structure is connected with the driving component, the other end of the transmission structure is connected with the lifting component, the lifting component is positioned in the lifting channel, the sounding component is fixedly connected at the top of the lifting component, the lifting component comprises damping structures, and the damping structures are positioned at two sides of the lifting component. Compared with the prior art, the vehicle-mounted liftable loudspeaker has the advantages of simple structure, adjustable lifting, stability, no shaking and the like.

title_en: Light supplementing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to light supplementing equipment which comprises a fixed cylinder, wherein the top end of the fixed cylinder is fixedly connected with a support rod, the top end of the support rod is fixedly connected with a sliding frame, the inner side wall of the sliding frame is connected with a sliding block in a sliding manner, the top end of the sliding block is fixedly connected with a mounting frame, and the outer side wall of the mounting frame is provided with a thread groove. According to the utility model, the bolt, the thread groove, the empty groove, the spring plate, the rotating rod, the rotating block and the rotating gear are arranged, the anchor can extend to the inside of the empty groove through the bolt which is in threaded connection with the inner side wall of the rotating thread groove, the spring plate can be extruded by the bolt, the rotating gear is driven to rotate by sliding of the spring plate, the rotating rod with one end fixedly connected with the rotating gear rotates, the rotating block can be overturned through the outer part fixedly connected with the rotating rod, and therefore, the angle of the lamp base with the rotating block fixedly connected with the bottom end can be adjusted.

title_en: Combined circuit board and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a combined circuit board, a connector and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of electronic circuits. A combination circuit board comprising: the circuit board comprises a first circuit board, a second circuit board and two connectors, wherein each connector is used for connecting the first circuit board and the second circuit board, the first circuit board and the second circuit board are used for signal transmission through the two connectors, the connection positions of the different connectors with the first circuit board and the second circuit board are different, and the two connectors are oppositely arranged on two sides of the first circuit board. According to the scheme, the return paths of noise signals between the first circuit board and the second circuit board are increased, the ground return speed of the noise signals in the two circuit boards is improved, and the effects of reducing the noise radiated to the air by the combined circuit board and reducing electromagnetic interference formed by the combined circuit board are achieved.

title_en: Energy storage device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses energy storage equipment which comprises an equipment body and a lighting device, wherein the equipment body is provided with a vehicle charging output interface, and a containing groove is formed in the position of the vehicle charging output interface. The lighting device is detachably mounted in the accommodating groove. The lighting device comprises a lighting structure and a power supply structure electrically connected with the lighting structure, wherein the power supply structure is at least partially accommodated in the accommodating groove and is electrically connected with the vehicle charging output interface. The illumination device is detachably arranged in the accommodating groove at the original vehicle charging output interface, so that the use function of the vehicle charging output interface is expanded, the illumination device is convenient to store, the storage area is not required to be additionally arranged on the energy storage equipment, and the space is reasonably utilized. The lighting device is provided with the power supply structure, not only can illuminate on energy storage equipment, but also can illuminate for the lighting structure through the power supply structure power supply when dismantling to make lighting device can exclusive use, promote movable performance, facilitate the use.

title_en: Easily clean server rack
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an easy-to-clean server cabinet, which belongs to the technical field of servers and comprises a server cabinet, wherein a bottom plate is arranged on the inner bottom surface of the server cabinet, a cabinet door is arranged on one side of the surface of the server cabinet, a sliding component is arranged on the inner side surface of the server cabinet, a fixing component is arranged on the upper surface of the sliding component, a sliding groove is arranged on one side of the inner part of the bottom plate, and the bottom of the sliding component slides in the sliding groove of the inner part of the bottom plate; according to the utility model, by arranging the fixing component, a worker can fix the server on the horizontal supporting plate only by pulling the clamping plate to clamp the server, so that the server is prevented from being damaged when the horizontal supporting plate shakes, and the stability of the server is improved.

title_en: Color-changeable integrated water-cooling radiator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a color-changeable integrated water-cooling radiator, which comprises a water cooling head, a water inlet pipe, a water outlet pipe, a cold row and a water pump, wherein a heat absorption water cavity is arranged in the water cooling head, a water tank is arranged on the cold row, a water outlet end of the heat absorption water cavity is communicated with a water inlet on the water tank through the water outlet pipe, a water inlet end of the heat absorption water cavity is communicated with a water outlet on the water tank through the water inlet pipe, the water pump enables water to circularly flow among the heat absorption water cavity, the water outlet pipe, the water tank and the water inlet pipe, the water pump is provided with a temperature-sensitive color-changing layer capable of changing color along with water temperature change, when the water temperature is higher than alpha degree, the temperature-sensitive color-changing layer is blue, when the water temperature is lower than beta degree, the temperature-sensitive color-changing layer is black, and each part presents different color effects according to water temperature change, so that the cold and hot states of the water can be visually seen, and the rising and falling of the water temperature can be intuitively perceived.

title_en: Wisdom release's cultural propaganda screen
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cultural propaganda and discloses a cultural propaganda screen capable of being intelligently released, which comprises a main body mechanism, an adjusting mechanism and a supporting mechanism, wherein the adjusting mechanism is positioned at the upper end of the main body mechanism, the supporting mechanism is positioned at the bottom end of the main body mechanism, the main body mechanism comprises a box shell, a box door, a fixed handle, a groove, a telescopic rod, a display screen, a switch button, a storage cabinet and a placing plate, the box door is hinged to the front surface of the box shell through a hinge, the fixed handle is fixedly connected to the right side of the box door, the groove is formed in the middle of the upper end of the box shell, the number of the telescopic rods is two, the bottoms of the telescopic rods are fixedly connected with the groove, the bottoms of the display screen are fixedly connected with the top of the telescopic rod, the switch button is arranged below the right side of the display screen, and the storage cabinet is formed in the box shell. This wisdom is published cultural propaganda screen, through the structure of telescopic link, it is more convenient to make this wisdom published cultural propaganda screen go up and down.

title_en: E61 is from taking magnetism to inhale line portable power source
abstract_en: The utility model provides an E61 self-contained magnetic attraction line mobile power supply, and belongs to the technical field of mobile power supplies. The E61 self-contained magnetic wire-sucking mobile power supply comprises a mobile power supply body and a placement mechanism, wherein a charging socket is arranged at the top of the mobile power supply body, a circuit board is arranged at the front top of the mobile power supply body, a data wire is arranged at the left side of the mobile power supply body, a groove is formed in the left side of the mobile power supply body, a cover plate is arranged at the front top of the mobile power supply body, and an adsorption component is inlaid in the groove.

title_en: Sinking plate type back-off surface cover
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of back-off covers, in particular to a sinking plate type back-off cover. The technical proposal comprises: the base is internally provided with a cavity, one side of the base is provided with two rectangular grooves I, the other side of the base is provided with two rectangular grooves II, the rectangular grooves I and the rectangular grooves II extend into the cavity to form a through hole I and a through hole II which are communicated with the cavity, and one side of the surface cover is provided with two protruding blocks I, and the other side of the surface cover is provided with two protruding blocks II. According to the utility model, the first lug penetrates through the second through hole to enter the second rectangular groove, so that the first lug is clamped with the second through hole, and then the face cover rotates in the direction of the base by taking the second through hole as the center of a circle, so that the second lug penetrates through the first through hole in a pressing and deforming way along a chamfer angle to be clamped with the first rectangular groove, the working performance is improved, the manufacturing cost and the energy loss are reduced, the stability is improved, the face cover is not collided by external force due to the fact that the face cover leaks outside, and meanwhile, the operation, the control and the use are simpler and more convenient.

title_en: Display hanger
abstract_en: The utility model provides a display hanger. The display hanger comprises: a connection member configured to be fixedly connected with a base surface to be installed; a mounting structure configured to mount the display, and to swing up and down about a preset axis with respect to the connection member; the adjusting bracket, one end of the adjusting bracket is rotatably connected with the connecting member, the other end of the adjusting bracket is rotatably connected with the mounting structure, and the adjusting bracket is configured to be adjustable in length so as to adjust the distance between the mounting structure and the base surface to be mounted. According to the technical scheme, when the display is retracted, the distance between the display and the base surface to be installed is smaller, the space occupied by the display hanging frame is smaller, and the display hanging frame is attractive.

title_en: Communication display device based on 5G signal
abstract_en: The application provides a communication display device based on 5G signal, including the casing, locate circuit board and mutual data connection's in the casing cloud storage module, emission module, charge-discharge module and control module, display device still includes: the metal heat dissipation piece is attached to the circuit board; the bearing structure is sleeved on the metal heat dissipation piece and fixed on the circuit board; the metal heat dissipation piece extends out of the bearing structure and is used for supporting the circuit board by matching with the bearing structure and conducting out heat on the circuit board. The communication display equipment provided by the utility model is characterized in that the metal heat dissipation piece is attached to the circuit board and is in close contact with the circuit board, so that heat on the circuit board is effectively conducted, and the heat dissipation efficiency of the communication display equipment is improved. And the bearing structure is sleeved on the metal heat dissipation piece and fixed on the circuit board to form a stable supporting system, and the stability and durability of the communication display device are enhanced by the structural support.

title_en: Project video conference server
abstract_en: The utility model provides a server for an item video conference, which comprises a base, a lifting assembly, a protective cover and a video conference server, wherein the lifting assembly is positioned in the base, supporting rods are fixedly connected to four corners at one end of the lifting assembly, the video conference server is positioned at the top of the lifting assembly, the protective cover is sleeved on the surface of the video conference server, the bottom end of the protective cover is embedded into the surface of the supporting rods, and supporting assemblies are arranged at four corners in the base. According to the video conference server, the protective cover and the base are arranged, so that the protective cover can protect the external structure of the video conference server, the external structure is prevented from being knocked and damaged, the base can increase the height of the video conference server, the corrosion of the internal elements of the video conference server due to the fact that the ground or the desktop is wet is avoided, and the problems that the external part of the video conference server is not provided with the protective structure and the video conference server is extremely easy to knock and damage are solved.

title_en: Emergency button device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergency button device in the technical field of emergency buttons, which comprises a fixed bottom plate, wherein one side of the fixed bottom plate is fixedly connected with a limiting sleeve groove, a fixed base is sleeved in the limiting sleeve groove, one end of the fixed base is fixedly connected with a button device, the upper end of the limiting sleeve groove is provided with a fixed jack, and a limiting plug pin is inserted in the fixed jack. This setting can preset the inside at the wall body through the fixed baseplate who sets up, cup joints unable adjustment base through the stop collar groove that sets up to can cup joint spacing button device, the spacing bolt of rethread setting can peg graft fixed stop collar groove and unable adjustment base, thereby conveniently dismantle and install button device, neither can destroy the wall body, conveniently dismantle again and install, fixed effectual.

title_en: Intelligent screen liquid crystal television system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of internet of things liquid crystal televisions and provides an intelligent screen liquid crystal television system based on the internet of things, which comprises a liquid crystal television body, wherein one side of the liquid crystal television body is fixedly connected with a driving box, the inner side wall of the driving box is fixedly connected with a micro motor, and the output end of the micro motor is fixedly connected with a driving bevel gear. According to the utility model, when the liquid crystal television body is not used, the two movable blocks of the miniature motor are moved to corresponding positions in opposite directions by controlling the miniature motor to rotate the bidirectional screw rod, then the electric telescopic rod is started to move to one side of the movable protective plate, and then the miniature motor is reversely rotated, so that the two protective plates protect one side of the liquid crystal television, the two protective plates are fixed through the reinforcing structure, and one side of the liquid crystal television body is protected, and when the liquid crystal television body is collided, the damage probability of the liquid crystal television body is reduced, the risk of economic loss is reduced, and the practicability is further improved.

title_en: Drawer type shockproof switching power supply
abstract_en: A drawer type shockproof switch power supply is characterized in that a first fixed column is arranged on the rear side plate of an upper shell, a first spring is sleeved on the first fixed column, a second fixed column is arranged on the vertical plate of a lower shell, and a second spring is sleeved on the second fixed column, so that the first spring and the second spring are propped against a mounting column block of a power supply module in a compressed state after the switch power supply is assembled, vibration is buffered through elasticity of the springs, and influence on the internal power supply module is reduced. The bottom plate of the shell is provided with a slot, the inner wall of the plug bush is provided with a shock pad, and when the installation block is inserted into the slot, the shock pad plays a role in buffering the shock received by the installation block. The riser and the bottom plate of lower casing pass through hinge swivelling joint, and when lower casing riser rotated to with the bottom plate at the coplanar, switching power supply's power module can follow the casing and take out, need not dismantle switching power supply casing, overhaul the convenience.

title_en: Control cabinet for electromechanical equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electromechanical equipment, in particular to a control cabinet for electromechanical equipment. The technical proposal comprises: switch board body, cabinet door and base, the inside fixed mounting of switch board body has the mounting bracket, and the bottom fixed mounting of mounting bracket has the reason line frame, and the spacing groove has been seted up to the inboard of reason line frame, and the inside sliding mounting of spacing groove has spacing stake, and hinge movable mounting has the cabinet door through the front end of switch board body, and the front end of cabinet door has the protection casing through spout slidable mounting. The utility model can avoid the situation that the control button is collided to be touched by mistake when not in use by the mutual matching of the protective cover, the sliding groove and the reset spring, and can more conveniently carry out independent wire arrangement operation on a plurality of wires by the mutual matching of the wire arrangement frame, the limiting groove and the limiting pile, so that a worker can quickly find the corresponding wires when overhauling, and the trouble brought by finding the wires when maintaining is reduced.

title_en: Terminal acquisition equipment
