abstract_en: The terminal acquisition equipment comprises an acquisition equipment shell, a terminal interface, an auxiliary terminal, a 4g communication module, a PC communication module and a battery module for carrying out auxiliary power supply on each circuit board, wherein the terminal interface is arranged on the acquisition equipment shell, an auxiliary board installation cavity is arranged on the terminal interface, the auxiliary terminal is arranged on the terminal interface through the auxiliary board installation cavity, and a waterproof structure for draining water at the auxiliary terminal is adapted to the auxiliary terminal; a rotary sealing piece is arranged at a PC interface (usb interface/PS 2 interface) of the PC communication module and is used for sealing the PC interface; an anti-ant structure is arranged at the battery mounting structure of the battery module and used for preventing insects and ants from invading the acquisition equipment shell; and a flip cover structure is arranged outside the rotary sealing piece and the ant preventing structure and used for providing protection for the rotary sealing piece and the ant preventing structure.

title_en: Portable propaganda display board device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of display cards and discloses a portable propaganda display card device which comprises a connecting table and a box body, wherein a connecting rod is connected with the inside of the connecting table in a threaded manner, a sliding rod is connected with the inside of the connecting rod in a sliding manner, a telescopic rod is fixedly connected with the top of the sliding rod, an auxiliary locking mechanism is arranged at the top of the connecting rod, a movable adjusting mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the connecting table, in the using process, a movable plate is enabled to move through rotation of a gear column, a spring is matched, the rotation angle of the gear column is enabled to be fixed, the propaganda cloth with different widths is convenient to use, the using effect is improved, the supporting block is enabled to move through rotation of a first bevel gear and the limit rod, the situation that collision or wind blows down is avoided, the position of the sliding rod is enabled to be fixed through rotation of a bolt, the propaganda cloth with different heights is convenient to meet, and the using cost is reduced when the using efficiency is increased.

title_en: Lamp strip subassembly and lamp strip display screen
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a lamp strip assembly and a lamp strip display screen, wherein the lamp strip assembly comprises a plurality of lamp strips and a plurality of flexible connecting bands perpendicular to the lamp strips; the lamp strips are fixed on the front surfaces of the flexible connecting strips and form a net structure with the flexible connecting strips; the back of each flexible connecting belt is provided with a mounting part corresponding to each lamp strip, and the mounting parts are provided with magnetic blocks. The lamp strip assembly has the advantages that the plurality of lamp strips are connected by the plurality of flexible connecting strips perpendicular to the lamp strips, so that the lamp strip assembly can be rolled up, and the lamp strip assembly is convenient to transport and store; meanwhile, the installation part and the magnetic attraction block are arranged at the joint of each light bar and the flexible connecting belt, the magnetic attraction block can be directly utilized to be matched with the magnetic attraction block on the installation surface during installation, the installation is rapid and convenient, the efficiency is improved, and the light bar assembly can be directly torn off from the magnetic attraction block during disassembly, so that the operation is convenient.

title_en: Testing device and testing system for two-section-distance three-camera module
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a testing device and a testing system for a two-distance three-camera module. The testing device comprises a base, wherein a connecting plate is arranged on the base, and an electric signal connecting module is arranged on the connecting plate; one end of the connecting transmission shaft is fixedly connected with the base, and the other end of the connecting transmission shaft is in sliding fit with the sliding rail; the electric signal connection module is provided with a placing groove for placing the three-camera module to be tested, the electric signal connection module is covered with an upper cover, a light passing hole is formed in a position, corresponding to the camera of the three-camera module to be tested, of the upper cover, and the electric signal connection module is connected with the three-camera module to be tested and the test computer. The utility model also provides a test system which comprises the test device and a test platform, wherein the sliding track of the test device is fixed on the test platform. The utility model can realize the calibration and the splice diagram detection of the three-camera module for two-section distance shooting, thereby judging whether the performance of the three-camera module meets the factory requirement.

title_en: Novel citizen card reader
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel citizen card reader which comprises a mounting bracket, wherein a card reader is arranged on one side of the mounting bracket, a card reading area is arranged on the outer wall of the card reader, and an identity card reading area is arranged at the lower end of the card reading area; this novel citizen's card reader through the cooperation use between heat radiating panel and the radiator fin, can derive through heat radiating panel the heat that the card reader is inside to produce under the circumstances of card reader long-time work, then cooperate radiator fin to dispel the heat of heat radiating panel derivation, prevent to use inside temperature for a long time to cause inside electronic component to damage easily, and cause the influence to follow-up card reading effect, the setting of shield can be fine plays dirt-proof effect to the card reader, protect the card slot of punching the card reader under the circumstances that the card reader does not use, prevent to brush the inside attached dust of card slot, cause the influence to the flexibility of punching the card.

title_en: Property maintenance rail guard
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a property maintenance protective guard, which comprises a base and a stand column, wherein a groove is formed in the upper part of the base, the lower end of the stand column is screwed into the groove, a cavity is formed in the stand column, a plurality of railings are arranged in the cavity, splicing mechanisms are arranged on the railings, an upper cover is screwed at the upper end of the cavity, and a plurality of connecting mechanisms with the same structure are arranged on the outer side wall of the stand column.

title_en: Intelligent oil quantity actuator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an intelligent oil quantity actuator. The utility model comprises an actuator upper shell; the actuator intermediate comprises an insulating sealing structure, and a sealing cavity is formed between the upper end of the insulating sealing structure and the upper shell of the actuator; the integrated control circuit board is arranged in the sealing cavity; the lower shell of the actuator is communicated with the inner cavity of the oil pump body; the driving assembly is arranged in the lower shell of the actuator and comprises a driving cable which penetrates through a wire hole of the intermediate body of the actuator and is connected with the integrated control circuit board; the sealing assembly is arranged between the driving circuit and the wire hole and comprises an upper compression gasket, a sealing ring, a lower compression gasket and a compression nut which are respectively arranged in the wire hole, the lower compression gasket, the sealing ring and the upper compression gasket are sequentially propped against and compressed through the compression nut, and a channel for driving a cable to pass through is formed among the lower compression gasket, the sealing ring and the upper compression gasket. Has the advantages of simple structure, convenient installation, good sealing effect, strong compression resistance and the like.

title_en: Wireless earphone of wear-type
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wireless headset, and relates to the technical field of headset. The utility model provides a wireless earphone of wear-type, includes FPC circuit board and two earphone units, and above-mentioned FPC circuit board middle part cover is equipped with the head roof beam, and the equal slip cap in above-mentioned head roof beam both ends is equipped with adjusts the auricle, and two above-mentioned regulation auricles are passed respectively at the both ends of above-mentioned FPC circuit board and are connected in the above-mentioned earphone unit that corresponds, and the above-mentioned FPC circuit board both ends are close to above-mentioned head roof beam department interval bending formation two snakelike adjustment portion many times, all are equipped with positioning mechanism between two above-mentioned regulation auricles and the above-mentioned head roof beam. The utility model aims to provide a wireless headset, which can realize the telescopic function of the headset and simultaneously avoid the problem of wire winding breakage in the headset.

title_en: Dustproof structure of loudspeaker
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dustproof structure of a loudspeaker, and relates to the technical field of loudspeakers. The dustproof structure of the loudspeaker comprises a dustproof shell, the top fixedly connected with ventilation hood of dustproof shell, the inner wall of ventilation hood passes through torsional spring elastic connection has the bull stick, the outer wall fixedly connected with fixture block of bull stick, the inner wall of ventilation hood runs through and sliding connection has the filter frame, the left end lateral wall fixedly connected with handle of filter frame, the inside of dustproof shell is provided with the loudspeaker, the inner wall of ventilation hood runs through and sliding connection has the sunshade, the bottom inner wall of ventilation hood passes through reset spring elastic connection has the stopper. According to the utility model, the filter screen on the filter frame is arranged, so that dust is blocked on the filter screen, the influence on the loudspeaker caused by entering the dustproof shell is avoided, the filter frame can be detached and replaced according to actual requirements, and the influence on the use of the subsequent loudspeaker caused by the blocking of the filter screen is avoided to a certain extent.

title_en: Intelligent runway device capable of monitoring air quality in real time
abstract_en: The utility model provides an intelligent runway device capable of monitoring air quality in real time, which relates to the technical field of intelligent runway devices and comprises an equipment installation bench and a runway main body, wherein a sunlight sensor is arranged on the top surface of the equipment installation bench, solar panels are uniformly and circumferentially distributed on the outer surface of the equipment installation bench, an equipment installation rod is arranged on the bottom surface of the equipment installation bench, an air quality detector and a wireless transmitting device are arranged at one end of the equipment installation rod, which is close to the equipment installation bench, a vacuum pipeline is embedded on the bottom surface of the equipment installation rod, a storage battery is arranged on one side of the vacuum pipeline, the solar panels can serve as energy-consuming equipment in daytime, redundant electric energy can exist in the storage battery, the air quality detector and the wireless transmitting device are in linkage connection and are powered by the storage battery, and detection information can be rapidly transmitted to a user through the wireless transmitting device after the air quality detector is detected, so that all-weather real-time monitoring of the air quality under any conditions is realized.

title_en: Multifunctional display board
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of information display, in particular to a multifunctional display board, which comprises a display board, a bottom board and an auxiliary device, wherein the bottom board is in sliding connection with the surface of the display board, advertisement paper is placed on the surface of the display board, the auxiliary device is arranged on the surface of the bottom board, the auxiliary device comprises a guide ring, the guide ring is fixedly connected with the surface of the bottom board, the guide ring is positioned below the display board, a chuck is in sliding connection with the inner surface of the guide ring, the chuck is positioned above the bottom board, a linkage bar is fixedly connected with the surface of the chuck, and the linkage bar is positioned above the bottom board. According to the utility model, the auxiliary device is arranged to effectively carry the display board, when the display board is used, the device is used, the chuck is adjusted to limit the sliding of the display board, so that the situation that a worker collides with a hard object when carrying the display board is avoided, the practicability of the display board is improved, the auxiliary performance of the display board is improved, the convenience of carrying by the worker is improved, and the damage rate of the display board is reduced.

title_en: Data transmission device convenient to installation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a data transmission device convenient to install, which belongs to the field of data transmission, and comprises a device main body, wherein an installation seat is arranged below the device main body, a convex seat is fixedly connected above the installation seat, one side of the convex seat is provided with a movable clamping plate, a moistureproof plate is connected below the installation seat through bolts, the inner side of the movable clamping plate is in threaded connection with an adjusting rod, a laminating seat is arranged below the device main body, one side of the laminating seat is fixedly connected with an arc column, and a limiting plate is fixedly connected above the arc column; through setting up mount pad cooperation movable splint and installing fixedly to the device main part, at first utilize the arc post card on the bottom plate to advance the arc mouth, the inserts of reuse both sides inlay in the inlayer, compare in traditional bolt installation, can not appear rustting, blocking and duning, can effectually carry out quick assembly disassembly to the device main part.

title_en: Lens driving device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lens driving device, which comprises a carrier, a base, a frame and a driving mechanism, wherein the frame is arranged on the base, the carrier is arranged in the frame and is used for installing a lens, balls are arranged between the frame and the base and support the frame on the base through the balls, a plurality of first ball mounting grooves are formed in the bottom of the frame, a plurality of second ball mounting grooves are formed in the upper surface of the base, the first ball mounting grooves are mutually matched with the second ball mounting grooves and are used for installing balls, and when the driving mechanism drives the frame to move relative to the base, the balls are provided with two contact points with the first ball mounting grooves, and the balls are provided with one contact point with the second ball mounting grooves. According to the lens driving device, the frame is supported on the base through the balls, and the friction force of the balls in the movement process is smaller and the service life of the balls is prolonged through the ingenious design of the first ball mounting groove and the second ball mounting groove.

title_en: Integrated PCB processing equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrated PCB processing device, comprising: the device comprises a concave conveyor, a processing table, a longitudinal-transverse screw module, a processing bracket, a carrying mechanical arm and carrying hydraulic clamping jaws, wherein the concave conveyor is respectively arranged on two sides of the processing table; the circuit board on the concave conveyor is conveyed to the clamping moving structure shaft through the cooperation of the longitudinal and transverse screw rod module and the conveying mechanical arm, the circuit board is sleeved with the die, and the die is extruded and pushed and lifted, expanded and extruded to be limited, so that the circuit board is conveyed, limited and processed rapidly, and the phenomenon that the circuit board is difficult to fix is avoided.

title_en: Surface treatment device for printed circuit board
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of printed circuit boards and discloses a surface treatment device for a printed circuit board, which comprises a main body mechanism and a limiting mechanism, wherein the limiting mechanism is positioned in the main body mechanism, the main body mechanism comprises a bottom plate and a treatment supporting frame, and the treatment supporting frame is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the bottom plate; the main body mechanism further comprises a supporting frame, a driving motor and a double-sided adjusting and cleaning assembly, the supporting frame is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the processing supporting frame, the driving motor is fixedly arranged at the left end of the upper end of the supporting frame, and the double-sided adjusting and cleaning assembly is fixedly arranged at the middle part of the processing supporting frame. This printed circuit board surface treatment device, through installing two-sided regulation clearance subassembly, be convenient for make this surface treatment device when clearing up the surface of printed circuit board, can clear up the two sides of vertical spacing printed circuit board simultaneously, and the adaptation is in the printed circuit board of different specifications during the clearance, flexibility and suitability are high during the use.

title_en: Protection device of 5G communication module
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a 5G communications facilities technical field specifically is a protector of 5G communication module, the inside of protection box is provided with fixed subassembly, the radiating subassembly is installed on the upper portion of protection box, fixed subassembly is including installing in the inside support frame of protection box, the front portion of support frame rotates and is connected with the mounting bracket, the anterior symmetry sliding connection of mounting bracket has fixed splint, link to each other through adjustment mechanism between mounting bracket and the fixed splint, radiating subassembly is including installing in the radiating box on protection box upper portion, the outside fixed mounting of protection box has the controller, the top cap is installed to the top of radiating box detachable, the fan is installed to the inboard equidistance of top cap, the circular telegram seat is installed to the inner wall bilateral symmetry of radiating box. The protection device of the 5G communication module can enable the whole device to clamp and fix communication equipment with different specifications, and improves convenience in protection.

title_en: Customer service information acquisition device for power supply business hall
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a customer service information acquisition device of a power supply business hall, which comprises: the main part, place subassembly, coupling assembling and ejecting mechanism, the main part includes the box body, the box body rear side is open, the box body front side is opened along the horizontal direction has the paper outlet, open at the box body top has the slide opening, place the subassembly including placing the board, spring and U-shaped presses the handle, place the board level setting in the box body, the spring is placing board bottom fixedly connected with four groups, four groups of spring bottom all with box body bottom inner wall fixed connection, U-shaped presses the handle both ends all with box body sliding connection and run through the box body after with place board top fixed connection, place the board top and stacked a plurality of collection tables, its beneficial effect is: through setting up subassembly, coupling assembling and ejecting mechanism cooperation of placing for the device can be through promoting the grab handle and take out an acquisition table at every turn, has avoided the acquisition table to simply stack and has taken by the people at will, simultaneously through the setting of box body, has avoided acquisition table to be scattered because of factors such as wind-force or striking easily.

title_en: Rare plant electronic tag with monitoring and protecting functions
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rare plant electronic tag with a monitoring and protecting function, which comprises a mounting sleeve and an electronic tag body: the installation sleeve comprises an adapter block, a buckle assembly and four adapter pieces, two spring holes are formed in two sides of the adapter block, the buckle assembly and the adapter pieces, and the adapter pieces on two sides, the buckle assembly and the adapter pieces on two sides and the adjacent two adapter pieces are fixedly connected through two springs, so that the installation sleeve has the beneficial effects that: the device simple structure, it is with low costs, through real-time supervision's mode, whether the monitoring has someone maliciously damaged trees, if so give the pronunciation warning, increase its psychological pressure for personnel that have maliciously damaged trees initiatively leave, with the action of stopping not civilization, protect ancient and famous trees, the device binds the retainer plate adoption of the trunk and can expand automatically along with trees grow, and the locking position does not drop.

title_en: Portable wireless dust blower heat dissipation air duct hole structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of dust blowers and discloses a portable wireless dust blower heat dissipation air duct hole structure, which comprises a holding part, wherein the top of the holding part is fixedly connected with a shell, one side of the shell is fixedly connected with a pressurizing cover, the other side of the shell is fixedly connected with a protecting cover, the inside of the shell is fixedly connected with a dust blowing device, the inside of the holding part is fixedly connected with a battery, and one side of the inside of the holding part is fixedly connected with a control board.

title_en: Auxiliary device for operation maintenance of substation equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an auxiliary device for operation maintenance of transformer substation equipment, which relates to the technical field of turbo generators and comprises a box transformer component and a warning component, wherein when a worker operates and maintains a box transformer body, the warning component can be placed around the box transformer body, when the heights of a fixed frame plate and a transparent plate are required to be adjusted, a forward and reverse screw rod can be rotated to drive a movable nut to carry out movement adjustment, when the movable nut moves, a first lifting rod and a second lifting rod are driven to carry out movement adjustment, and along with the movement of the first lifting rod and the second lifting rod, the first lifting rod and the second lifting rod drive the fixed frame plate and the transparent plate to carry out height adjustment at the lower end of a positioning plate, a supporting rod can adjust the angle of the transparent plate according to requirements, the supporting rod is only required to be unfolded, finally the transparent plate is required to incline in angle, and after the transparent plate reaches the required angle position, one side of the supporting rod is only required to be inserted into a clamping groove in the middle of the straight plate to carry out limit fixation.

title_en: Building visitor doorbell device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a building visitor doorbell device, which belongs to the field of building visitor doorbell devices and comprises a receiver and an outdoor doorbell, wherein a first display screen is arranged on the front surface of the receiver, a back plate is fixedly connected to the back surface of the receiver, a placing rack is arranged on the outer surface of the back plate, a fixed plate is fixedly connected to the back surface of the placing rack, a camera is arranged on the front surface of the outdoor doorbell, an operation panel and a second display screen are respectively and fixedly connected to the front surface of the outdoor doorbell.

title_en: Novel radiator suitable for PTC electric heater
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a brand new radiator suitable for a PTC electric heater, which comprises a surrounding substrate assembly and radiating fin assemblies arranged between the surrounding substrate assemblies; the surrounding substrate assembly comprises an upper outer wrapping substrate and a lower outer wrapping substrate which are symmetrically arranged; the fin group package consists of at least one fin unit, the fin unit consists of a plurality of fins with rectangular wave structures, the length arrangement direction of the fins is consistent with the length direction of the upper wrapping baseplate, and a plurality of fins are sequentially arranged side by side; and the wave crests and wave troughs of two adjacent fins are arranged side by side. The surrounding substrate assembly formed by the upper surrounding substrate and the lower surrounding substrate is matched with the radiating fin assembly formed by the fin units to form a brand new radiator, and the fin unit assembly is placed in the area formed by the surrounding assembly, so that the purposes of optimizing the whole structure of the radiator, reducing the manufacturing cost of the radiator and improving the radiating efficiency of the radiator are achieved.

title_en: Low-noise dustproof outdoor cabinet air conditioner shell
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cabinet air conditioners and discloses a low-noise dustproof outdoor cabinet air conditioner shell which comprises a shell body, wherein a fixing frame is fixedly connected to the left part of the outer part of the shell body, a screw is connected to the inner thread of the fixing frame, a knob is fixedly connected to one end of the screw, a push block is fixedly connected to the other end of the screw, a sliding plate is fixedly connected to one part of the push block, a filter plate is connected to the inner part of the shell body in a sliding manner, limit grooves are formed in two sides of the inner part of the filter plate, limit assemblies are formed in two sides of the inner part of the limit grooves, a fixing plate is fixedly connected to the upper part of the filter plate, and a handle is fixedly connected to the upper part of the fixing plate. The utility model realizes the convenient installation and disassembly of the filter plate, makes the maintenance and cleaning easier, can effectively isolate and reduce the noise generated by the operation inside the air conditioner, and is beneficial to reducing the noise pollution in the environment.

title_en: PCB printing ink illumination device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a PCB (printed circuit board) printing ink illumination device, and relates to the field of PCB processing. The utility model provides a PCB printing ink illumination device, includes the casing, the luminous fluorescent tube a that is equidistant is installed to the inner wall of casing, still includes: the connecting cylinder is arranged in the shell, and the outer wall of the connecting cylinder is provided with a luminous lamp tube b for illuminating the PCB; the hanging component is arranged on the connecting cylinder and used for driving the PCB hung in the shell to lift; the rotating component is arranged at one end of the hanging component, and one end of the rotating component penetrates through the shell and extends to the outside; according to the utility model, the plurality of luminous lamp tubes b arranged in the shell correspond to the luminous lamp tubes a in the shell, the PCB to be irradiated is placed in the middle position, the trouble of manual turn-over irradiation is omitted, and the irradiation is more uniform by the mutual cooperation of the hanging component and the rotating component, so that the irradiation effect of the device is further improved, and the device is convenient and quick to use.

title_en: Adapter base
abstract_en: The utility model provides a transfer base for installing a converter on a mine car platform, the transfer base comprises: the frame body comprises two mounting beams which are arranged at intervals, and each mounting beam comprises a first mounting part; the mounting seats are arranged on the mounting beams at intervals, each mounting seat comprises a second mounting part, and each second mounting part protrudes towards the direction away from the mounting beam; wherein, the first installation department on each mounting beam is used for selectively connecting with converter or mine car platform, and the second installation department on each mount pad is used for selectively connecting with mine car platform or converter. The adapter base solves the problem of poor interchangeability of connection between the converter cabinet body and the mine car platform in the prior art.

title_en: Building engineering safety monitoring supervision device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of constructional engineering and discloses a constructional engineering safety monitoring and supervising device which comprises a supporting plate, wherein a transverse column is sleeved on the outer surface of the supporting plate, a fixing plate is fixedly arranged at the top of the supporting plate, a connecting plate for fixing is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the fixing plate, a hydraulic cylinder for lifting is fixedly arranged on the surface of the connecting plate, and a camera for detection is fixedly arranged at the top of the hydraulic cylinder. This building engineering safety monitoring supervisory equipment, cooperation through diaphragm, backup pad and mounting panel sets up, can make the device more convenient and practical, the setting of mobile device on the diaphragm can make the device get up more smooth in the removal, increases the practicality of device, power device's setting in the backup pad can make the device realize automatic movement, does not need manual promotion to reduce workman's amount of labour, increases the practicality of device, the setting of mounting panel can make the fixed comparatively firm of top part, increases the stability of device.

title_en: Solid state disk with interface protector
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of solid state disks, in particular to a solid state disk with an interface protection device, which comprises a hard disk body, wherein the front end of the hard disk body is provided with a mounting opening, an upper shell is arranged in the mounting opening, the bottom of the upper shell is provided with a lower shell, the front ends of the upper shell and the lower shell are provided with interfaces, both sides of the mounting opening are provided with first sliding grooves, the inside of the first sliding grooves is provided with sliding plates, one side of each sliding plate, which is close to the other, is provided with a first mounting groove, the inside of each first mounting groove is provided with a spring and a mounting plate, and one side, which is close to the two groups of mounting plates, is provided with a mounting block.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a display device, which relates to the technical field of display equipment, and comprises: a panel assembly, a curved plate comprising oppositely disposed bonding surfaces and a curved surface, the bonding surfaces being bonded to a non-display surface of the panel assembly; a feed bar located on the curved surface and extending in a direction away from the curved surface; a feed block fixed to the feed bar; the end parts of the support rods are connected with the bending plate, and the support rods extend towards the edge direction of the bending surface; the front projection of one end of the support rod, which is close to the chip in the panel assembly, on the bending surface is provided with a space between the front projections of one side of the support rod, which is close to the chip in the panel assembly, on the bending surface. Through the scheme, when the panel assembly is bent, the chip is not easy to damage.

title_en: Student pick-up supervision equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a student picking and sending supervision equipment, which comprises a mounting seat, a connecting column, a circuit box, a supervision probe and a wire socket, wherein the connecting column is arranged, when the surface of the supervision probe is not clean enough, a person can start a driving machine through remote operation, a rotating shaft is driven by a driving force so as to drive a cam to rotate, the shape structure of the cam rotates around a fixed ring as a rotating pivot through a clamping sliding block, the top action force applied to the cleaning device is different from the contact surface at the lower end of the cleaning device in the rotating process, the cleaning device can conveniently and circularly move up and down, a vertical rod passes through a penetrating plate and is movably clamped, and the penetrating plate provides a directional reverse effect for the up and down displacement of the vertical rod, so that a wiping block is driven to wipe back and forth on the front end face of the supervision probe, and the effect of dust cleaning the supervision probe is achieved.

title_en: Sensor-induction-based anti-collision monitoring and shooting device for construction site
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of construction assistance, in particular to a construction site anti-collision monitoring and shooting device based on sensor induction, wherein a monitoring component is arranged on the upper part of a patrol car body, a solar component is arranged on the upper part of the patrol car body corresponding to the position of the monitoring component, the monitoring component comprises cameras arranged in the middle of the upper part of the patrol car body, fixing seats are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the front part of the patrol car body, inductive radars are arranged on the inner sides of the two fixing seats, a controller is arranged on the upper part of the patrol car body close to the position of the cameras, and the fixing seats are connected with the inductive radars through an adjusting mechanism. The anti-collision monitoring and shooting device for the construction site based on sensor induction can enable the whole device to realize robot inspection monitoring, shooting and archiving after monitoring, improves the practicability of the whole device, and brings better use prospects.

title_en: Spliced screen convenient to install and detach
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a spliced screen convenient to mount and dismount, which relates to the technical field of spliced screens, and comprises a spliced screen body, wherein the other end of a telescopic rod is fixedly connected with the side surface of a mounting plate, the side surface of the connecting plate is fixedly connected with a positioning plate which is semicircular, the outer side of the positioning plate is provided with a positioning groove, the inner wall of the positioning groove is clamped with a positioning block, and the positioning block is slidably connected with the side surface of the telescopic rod, and the spliced screen has the advantages that: the adjusting plate is rotated through rotating, the threaded rod is convenient to rotate in the inner wall of the supporting rod, then the threaded rod drives the mounting plate to move, the clamping block at one end of the positioning block is moved out of the inner wall of the positioning groove through the rotating positioning block, then the angle adjustment is carried out on the spliced screen body and the connecting disc, the angle of the spliced screen body is fixed through the positioning block and the positioning groove, and the effect of conveniently adjusting the mounting angle of the spliced screen body is achieved.

title_en: High-strength heat dissipation type aluminum sheet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-strength heat-dissipation type aluminum sheet, which comprises an aluminum sheet main body, a heat-dissipation aluminum sheet detachably arranged on the aluminum sheet main body, a first fixing piece, a second fixing piece and reinforcing columns, wherein the first fixing piece, the second fixing piece and the reinforcing columns are arranged on the aluminum sheet main body; the aluminum sheet can be pulled out from the heat dissipation aluminum sheet according to the requirement through setting up the extension aluminum sheet to this increases heat dissipation area, thereby improves the radiating effect.

title_en: Propaganda column
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a propaganda column, which comprises a frame body and a propaganda frame arranged on the frame body in a sliding way, wherein the frame body comprises two upright posts which are symmetrically arranged, the top ends of the two upright posts are connected through a first cross rod, the middle part of the two upright posts are connected through a second cross rod, a rotating rod is arranged in the second cross rod along the length direction, one end of the rotating rod penetrates through the side wall of the upright post and is provided with a locking disc, a handle is arranged on the locking disc, the locking disc is further connected with a first locking screw in a threaded way, the first locking screw is abutted against the upright post, a steel wire rope is wound on the part of the rotating rod, which is positioned in the upright post, a fixed pulley is arranged at the upper end of the upright post, sliding grooves are formed in the vertical direction of the inner side of the upright post, sliding blocks are arranged on the two sides of the propaganda frame in the sliding way, and the steel wire rope is connected with the sliding blocks after bypassing the fixed pulley. The propaganda panel can be lifted, and the propaganda panel can be directly fallen to be replaced by propaganda poster, so that the defect that the traditional propaganda board is high in height and needs to be assisted by a climbing tool when the poster is replaced is avoided.

title_en: Switch power supply convenient to maintain
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a switch power supply convenient to maintain, which comprises a first shell, a heat radiation plate, a first spring, a second shell, a base body, a connecting sheet, a motor, a rotary blade and a filter screen, wherein the first spring is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the interior of the first shell, the heat radiation plate is fixedly arranged at the top end of the first spring, the second shell is slidingly connected with the side surface of the first shell, the base is fixedly arranged in the second shell, the base body is inserted into the base, the connecting sheet is fixedly arranged in the base, the motor is inserted into the connecting sheet, the rotary blade is detachably arranged on an output shaft of the motor, and the filter screen is detachably connected with the surface of the second shell. This switching power supply convenient to maintenance makes the fixture block not correspond with the draw-in groove on second casing surface through removing the handle, shifts out the second casing completely, reaches the purpose of taking out the switching power supply body and maintaining it, easy operation.

title_en: Substrate filter with quick mounting and dismounting structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a substrate filter with a quick mounting and dismounting structure, which comprises a mounting bottom plate, a filter body and a lock catch assembly, wherein the filter body and the lock catch assembly are assembled on the mounting bottom plate, the lock catch assembly is arranged on two sides of the filter body, and the lock catch assembly is in nested clamping connection with a test substrate. In the lock catch assembly, a positioning piece is fixed on an installation bottom plate, assembly grooves are formed in two sides of the positioning piece, a retractable sliding key is slidably installed in each assembly groove, two ends of a reset spring are respectively in butt joint with the inner wall of the assembly groove and the side wall of the retractable sliding key, an adjusting guide groove is formed in the retractable sliding key, an adjusting clamp key is slidably installed in the adjusting guide groove, an acting part of the adjusting clamp key is arranged to be in a wedge-shaped structure and exposed out of the positioning piece, an adjusting screw is rotatably installed in the adjusting guide groove and is arranged in the vertical direction, and the adjusting clamp key is in rotary connection with the adjusting screw. The utility model can rapidly disassemble and assemble the filter on the test substrate, and meets the application requirements of the substrate filter in the research and development stage and the test stage.

title_en: High-voltage power cable disconnection alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-voltage power cable disconnection warning device which comprises a support, wherein regulating grooves are symmetrically formed in two sides of the support, regulating devices are arranged on the surface of the support, monitoring boxes are arranged on the surface of the regulating devices, monitoring devices are arranged on the surface of the monitoring boxes, radiating devices are arranged on the surface above the monitoring boxes, each radiating device comprises a radiating box fixedly installed on one side of the monitoring box, a radiating ring is fixedly arranged on the surface above each radiating box, a dustproof net is arranged on one side surface of each radiating ring, a radiating motor is fixedly arranged on one side surface of each radiating box, a radiating shaft is arranged at an output end of each radiating motor, radiating fans are arranged on the surface of each radiating shaft, warning lamps are symmetrically arranged on the surface of each monitoring box, cables are arranged in the monitoring boxes, damping rubber is symmetrically arranged at two ends of each monitoring box and matched with the cables, and radiating holes are symmetrically arranged on two sides of each monitoring box.

title_en: Laminated plate hot pressing and blanking device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of blanking devices, and discloses a hot pressing blanking device for a laminated plate, which comprises a hot press used for processing the laminated plate, wherein one side of the hot press is fixedly provided with a box body, a limit groove is formed in the box body, a filter screen is embedded into one side of the top of the inner side of the limit groove, one side of the top of an operating platform of the hot press is fixedly provided with a sliding rail, a pushing component is arranged on one side of the hot press, when a first conical tooth rotates, a second conical tooth which is meshed and connected is driven to rotate, at the moment, the second conical tooth drives a first rotating shaft and fan blades to rotate, when the fan blades rotate, outside air is blown to one side of the blanking plate through the filter screen, so that the air blows and cools the laminated plate after hot pressing, and the fan blades blow and cool the laminated plate after hot pressing, so that deformation or damage of the laminated plate due to high temperature is prevented, and the blanking quality is improved.

title_en: Mining intrinsic safety type auxiliary display terminal
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mining intrinsic safety type auxiliary display terminal, which belongs to the technical field of display terminals and comprises a mounting plate, wherein a fixing lug is arranged at the edge of the mounting plate, a mounting hole is formed in the fixing lug, an explosion-proof packaging shell is arranged at the side edge of the mounting plate, the explosion-proof packaging shell is fixedly connected with the mounting plate through a display terminal fixing mechanism, and an explosion-proof packaging cover is arranged at the side edge of the explosion-proof packaging shell.

title_en: Heat radiation fan for exchanger
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heat radiation fan for a switch, which comprises a fan bottom plate, wherein the front surface of the fan bottom plate is provided with a fan bottom plate, four corners of the fan bottom plate are respectively provided with a clamping groove, the four corners of the front surface of the fan bottom plate are respectively provided with a clamping piece, the clamping pieces are in clamping connection with the clamping grooves, the front surface of the fan bottom plate is fixedly connected with a fan barrel, the front surface of the fan barrel is fixedly provided with a fan top shell, the center position inside the fan barrel is provided with an inner mounting plate, one end of the inner mounting plate is fixedly provided with a fan motor through a bolt, the top end of an output shaft of the fan motor is provided with an external thread part, and the output shaft of the fan motor penetrates through the inner mounting plate to be in threaded connection with a thread sleeve.

title_en: Reation kettle status display device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reaction kettle state display device which comprises a fixed frame, wherein a first groove is formed in the side wall of the fixed frame, a display screen is connected in the first groove in a sliding mode, a supporting rod is fixedly arranged on the lower surface of the fixed frame, one end of the supporting rod is rotatably connected with an angle adjusting assembly, and one end of the angle adjusting assembly is fixedly provided with a fixing assembly. The utility model has the advantages that the display screen is arranged near each reaction kettle, the display screen is linked with the DCS system of the reaction kettle, and corresponding output is carried out on the display screen after programming is carried out by an instrument engineer according to the running state of each relevant device of the DCS reaction kettle, so that the reaction kettle has actual running state display, great convenience is brought to relevant personnel, test personnel can know whether the sample is taken or not, or can take samples for a few minutes, maintenance personnel can know whether the running state of the device is normal, and the like, and the working convenience and the production efficiency can be greatly improved.

title_en: Camera view field detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a camera view field detection device, which comprises a turntable, a driving box, a hand wheel and a control box, wherein the turntable is arranged on the driving box; the hand wheel is connected with the rotary table through the control box and the driving box; the turntable comprises a vertical turntable, an installation table and a horizontal turntable; the vertical turntable comprises a first connecting plate, a second connecting plate, a third connecting plate, a vertical motor, a balancing weight and a rotating shaft, wherein the second connecting plate and the third connecting plate are arranged at two ends of the first connecting plate and are in vertical states with the first connecting plate, the second connecting plate and the third connecting plate are hollow plates, the rotating shaft is arranged at the hollow part of the third connecting plate, the outer shaft of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with the third connecting plate, the inner shaft of the rotating shaft is connected with the second end of the mounting table, the vertical motor is arranged at the hollow part of the second connecting plate, and the output end of the vertical motor is connected with the first end of the mounting table. The utility model meets the testing requirements of various angles of the camera by the mutual matching of the vertical turntable and the horizontal turntable on the turntable.

title_en: Frequency converter binding post mounting structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of wiring terminal installation, and discloses a frequency converter wiring terminal installation structure, which comprises the following components: the frequency converter comprises a frequency converter shell, wherein a circuit board is fixedly arranged in the frequency converter shell, a plurality of elastic clamping pieces are electrically connected to the circuit board, inserting pieces are inserted into the elastic clamping pieces, and wiring terminals are fixedly arranged at the bottoms of the inserting pieces; the installation component, the installation component sets up on the converter casing, the installation component includes installation piece, clamp plate, square frame, fixed block, movable block and regulation and control axle, rectangular channel has been seted up to the converter casing bottom, installation piece and clamp plate all block mutually with rectangular channel, a plurality of draw-in grooves one have been seted up to the installation piece bottom, binding post blocks mutually with draw-in groove one, two square channels have been seted up at the clamp plate top and square frame fixed connection to the installation piece bottom. The utility model has the following advantages and effects: the installation of a plurality of binding posts can be accomplished fast, binding post's installation effectiveness is effectively improved.

title_en: Rotatable surveillance camera head
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotatable monitoring camera which comprises an antenna, wherein a solar panel is arranged on the side of the antenna, a camera main body is arranged below the solar panel, and a stable structure is arranged below the camera main body. The utility model is internally provided with the stabilizing structure, can keep the stabilizing structure after rotating, can avoid the shaking and other conditions caused by the influence of external factors, is internally provided with the contact pad which can be matched with the contact groove, is internally provided with the telescopic rod which can drive a plurality of cushion blocks in the contact pad to move, and the cushion blocks adopt special-shaped design and can be combined with a plurality of grooves in the contact groove to keep the positions of the cushion blocks fixed, and is internally provided with the telescopic plate which can be matched with the anti-moving pad, the telescopic plate can drive the anti-moving pad to move up and down, and the anti-moving pad adopts special-shaped design and is made of flexible materials with high wear resistance and friction force, and can be combined with the anti-moving groove to fix the positions of the rotating rod, so that the anti-moving rod is kept stable.

title_en: Fixing mechanism of drilling target machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fixing mechanism of a drilling target machine, which comprises a mounting seat and a display, wherein a cantilever is arranged at the top of the mounting seat, symmetrically distributed extension plates are arranged at the top of the cantilever, U-shaped limiting seats are arranged at the top of the extension plates, fixing parts are arranged on the U-shaped limiting seats, and the display is inserted into the inner sides of the two U-shaped limiting seats and is erected at the top of the extension plates; the fixing part comprises a fixing groove and a movable block, the fixing groove is formed in the inner side surface of the U-shaped limiting seat, one end of the movable block is embedded into the fixing groove, the other end of the movable block extends out of the fixing groove and is connected with a clamping plate which is abutted to the display, and a telescopic spring is arranged at the bottom of the fixing groove; the beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows: the limiting of the display when being placed is increased through the U-shaped limiting seat, and the fixing performance of the display placed on the U-shaped limiting seat is further increased through the designed fixing part, so that the display is prevented from falling down due to collision.

title_en: Cell-phone fills electric pile
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of charging devices, in particular to a mobile phone charging pile, which comprises a cabinet door, wherein a cabinet body is arranged at the rear of the cabinet door, the cabinet body comprises a base, side plates are arranged at the left side and the right side of the upper surface of the base, a plurality of heat dissipation openings are arranged at the top of each side plate, a cold air plate is arranged below the heat dissipation openings, the cold air plates are arranged on the inner walls of the side plates, a plurality of air outlet grooves are arranged on the surfaces of the cold air plates, a top plate is arranged between the tops of the two side plates, bearings are arranged at four corners of the lower surface of the top plate, threaded shafts are arranged below the two bearings at the rear side, sliding rods are arranged below the two bearings at the front side, and lifting assemblies are arranged between the threaded shafts and the sliding rods at the same side.

title_en: Lens circuit board structure matched with E bayonet, Z bayonet and X bayonet cameras
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lens circuit board structure matched with an E bayonet, a Z bayonet and an X bayonet, which comprises a hard circuit board, a first type of flexible flat cable and a second type of flexible flat cable, wherein a socket is arranged on the hard circuit board; the first type of flexible flat cable comprises a first type of flat cable golden finger part and a first type of contact flat cable part which is arranged corresponding to the structure position of the contact group on the first type of lens; the second type of flexible flat cable comprises a second type of flat cable golden finger part and a second type of contact flat cable part which is arranged corresponding to the contact group structure position on the second type of lens; the first type of wire-arranging golden finger part and the second type of wire-arranging golden finger part have equal wire-arranging widths and are alternatively and electrically connected to the socket. So set up, connect the soft winding displacement of first class and the soft winding displacement of second class of different camera lenses of many types can share same socket and stereoplasm circuit board, be favorable to vice factory's camera lens producer to reduce electronic parts kind, shorten research and development test and do the cycle, reduce purchase, storage and detection cost, improve production efficiency.

title_en: Security protection is with adjustable video monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an adjustable video monitoring device for security and protection, which belongs to the technical field of security and protection monitoring devices and comprises a mounting top shell and a monitor body, wherein a stepping motor is fixedly connected to the center of the inner top wall of the mounting top shell, a rotating rod which is vertically arranged is fixedly connected to the main shaft end of the stepping motor, a mounting hole is formed in the side wall of the lower end of the mounting top shell, a rotating disc is rotatably connected to the inner wall of the mounting hole through a bearing ring, the lower end of the rotating rod is fixedly connected with the center of the rotating disc, a supporting rod is fixedly connected to the center of the lower side of the rotating disc, and an adjusting plate is rotatably connected to the lower end of the supporting rod through a first rotating shaft. According to the utility model, by arranging the stepping motor and the reciprocating lifting mechanism, when the stepping motor works, the horizontal 360-degree rotation of the monitor body can be realized, and meanwhile, the monitor body is driven to tilt and reciprocate, so that the monitoring range is improved, and the security monitoring effect is improved.

title_en: Thermal management system and energy storage device
abstract_en: The application provides a thermal management system and an energy storage device. The energy storage device includes a battery module and a power conversion module. The heat management system comprises a water tank, a heat exchange group, a heat dissipation group and a reversing valve. The heat exchange group comprises a first heat exchange piece and a second heat exchange piece. The first heat exchange member exchanges heat with the battery module. The second heat exchange member exchanges heat with the power conversion module. The heat dissipation group comprises a first heat radiator and a second heat radiator. The reversing valve is connected with the first heat exchange piece, the second heat exchange piece, the first radiator and the second radiator. The reversing valve has a first state and a second state. When in the first state, the first heat exchange piece, the reversing valve, the second heat exchange piece and the water tank are sequentially communicated to form a loop for circulation of heat exchange medium. When in the second state, the first heat exchange piece, the reversing valve, the first radiator and the water tank are sequentially communicated to form a loop for the circulation of heat exchange medium, and the second heat exchange piece, the reversing valve, the second radiator and the water tank are sequentially communicated to form another loop for the circulation of heat exchange medium.

title_en: Network card support and server
abstract_en: The application provides a network card bracket and a server, and belongs to the technical field of servers. The network card support includes: comprises a bracket body, a pressing and clamping assembly and at least one clamping piece; the clamping assembly is rotationally connected with the bracket body and comprises a flexible bending piece which can elastically deform; the clamping piece is connected with the bracket body and is provided with a clamping groove; the card pressing assembly is provided with a locking state and an unlocking state, wherein in the locking state, the flexible bending piece is elastically clamped in the clamping groove and is propped against the network card; in the unlocking state, the flexible bending piece is separated from the clamping groove so as to allow the network card to be disassembled. The network card bracket can realize tool-free installation of the network card.

title_en: Bluetooth headset is with box that charges
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a charging box for a Bluetooth headset, which comprises a charging box main body, wherein both sides of the upper end of the charging box main body are provided with headset charging bins, the inner wall of one side of the charging box main body is detachably connected with a dust collection mechanism, and the dust collection mechanism comprises a dust collection brush storage hole, a positioning threaded hole, a control dust collection pipe, a connecting threaded hole, a connecting handle, an air vent, a connecting external threaded ring block, a connecting internal threaded ring block, a limiting fixed block, a dust collection filter screen, a fixed connecting block, a control motor, a connecting rotary rod, a suction fan, a connecting threaded block, a dust collection filter element, a dust collection bin, a dust collection opening and a cleaning brush. According to the charging box for the Bluetooth headset, the dust collection mechanism is convenient for cleaning and brushing the inside of the charging bin of the headset, dust and impurities in the charging bin of the headset can be collected and cleaned, the overall cleanliness of the charging box main body is improved, and the charging box is convenient to store and detach.

title_en: High-strength prefilter diaphragm device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-strength prefilter diaphragm device which comprises a partition plate, wherein the upper surface of the partition plate is fixedly connected with a fixing frame, the back surface of the fixing frame is fixedly connected with a fixing plate, the back surface of the fixing plate is provided with a limiting groove, the inner wall of the limiting groove is provided with a fixing groove, the lower surface of the partition plate is fixedly connected with a supporting plate, the lower surface of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with a working plate, the lower surface of the working plate is fixedly connected with a bottom plate, the lower surface of the bottom plate is provided with a second threaded hole, and the high-strength prefilter diaphragm device is characterized in that an electronic part to be installed is installed in the limiting groove, wires of the electronic part to be installed are fixed in the fixing groove, the wires are collected through wire holes and are limited in the device, and finally guided out through a second notch at the bottom of the device, so that the wires are prevented from being messly placed and broken when the high-strength prefilter diaphragm device is used.

title_en: Fan-out type double-sided plastic package structure with overhang array pins
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fan-out type double-sided plastic package packaging structure with an overhang array pin, which comprises a PCBA substrate, a plastic package body and an overhang array pin assembly. A plurality of single modules are simultaneously encapsulated on the PCBA substrate; the upper die surface and the lower die surface to be molded, which are positioned at two sides of the PCBA substrate, respectively comprise a functional area and a nonfunctional area surrounding the functional area; the single plastic package module is arranged on the substrate, the upper surface is completely plastic-packaged, and the lower surface comprises a plastic package area and a non-plastic package area; wherein the interface contacts are located on a overhanging surface of the non-molding region. And cutting the PCBA substrate by a mechanical blade to obtain a single plastic-packaged module, and finally welding the suspension array pin assembly to the interface contact on the suspension surface to obtain the final module power supply product. The packaging structure has the advantages of small size, double-sided heat dissipation, simplicity and reliability in installation, large-scale industrialization and the like, thereby improving the reliability of the electronic product in the use process.

title_en: External display device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an external display device. The external display device comprises a first display screen and a second display screen which are movably connected with each other, wherein the first display screen is provided with a supporting component, the supporting component comprises a first supporting connecting piece, a second supporting connecting piece and a U-shaped supporting frame, and the supporting frame is matched with the first display screen to support the first display screen and the second display screen to display at a preset angle. According to the utility model, by adjusting the support frame, various collocation and combination display modes can be formed according to different use requirements of users, and the flexibility and the universality of the external display device are greatly improved.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted chip brushing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vehicle-mounted chip brushing device which comprises a bottom plate and two meter pens, wherein the top of each meter pen is fixedly connected with a data line, the top of the bottom plate is provided with a mounting assembly for bearing the meter pen, the top of the bottom plate is provided with a bearing assembly, the mounting assembly comprises a mounting frame, two mounting plates capable of sliding forwards and backwards are arranged in the mounting frame in a sliding mode, mounting blocks capable of sliding left and right are arranged on the mounting plates, the outer walls of the meter pens are fixedly sleeved with the mounting blocks in a penetrating mode, the top of each mounting block is provided with a first braking plate, and one side of each connecting block is provided with a second braking plate. According to the utility model, the outer wall of the watch pen is fixedly inserted and sleeved with the mounting block by utilizing the matched use mode of the bottom plate, the watch pen and the mounting assembly, the mounting block can move left and right relative to the mounting plate, and the mounting plate can slide back and forth relative to the mounting frame, so that the watch pen moves in a plane, and the watch pen is contacted with contacts at different positions of the computer board.

title_en: Fixing mechanism for punching LCP (liquid crystal display panel)
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of LCP plate processing equipment, in particular to a fixing mechanism for punching an LCP plate, which comprises a U-shaped half frame I and a U-shaped half frame II which are butted, wherein openings of the U-shaped half frame I and the U-shaped half frame II are oppositely connected to form a rectangular full frame, the inner periphery of the rectangular full frame is sunken and provided with an adhesive layer for fixing the LCP plate, and the periphery of the rectangular full frame is clamped by clamping jaws; a plurality of in-line butt joint holes with equal intervals are formed in the two ends of the openings of the first half frame and the second half frame, a movable lock catch is inserted between the two in-line butt joint holes which are overlapped up and down for fixing, and the distance between the inner edge and the outer edge of the rectangular full frame is less than or equal to 30mm; according to the fixing mechanism for punching the LCP plate, provided by the utility model, through the assembly design of the movable lock catch and the in-line butt joint holes, the size of a rectangular full frame formed by two half frames is adjustable, so that the punching requirements of products with different sizes are met; the four edges of the product can be fixed, the impact deflection caused by sliding is avoided, the stress of the product is uniform, the product is stabilized to be pulled and expanded, and the design and typesetting difficulty is reduced.

title_en: Control cabinet convenient to installation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a control cabinet convenient to install, which relates to the technical field of subway electromechanical engineering and comprises a base, a groove, a limiting block, a machine body and a heat radiation port, wherein the top end of the base is provided with the groove, and the inside of recess is provided with the stopper that extends to the outside, the top welding organism of stopper, the inside of base is located the both sides of recess and all rotates and be connected with the lead screw, and two the one end cover in the lead screw outside is equipped with the belt pulley group. This control box cabinet convenient to installation inserts the organism through stopper and base through being provided with block mechanism, drives two lead screws together through motor, belt pulley group and bevel gear group and rotates to promote fixture block and bayonet socket block through supporting shoe and bracing piece, thereby make the stopper by spacing, and then make the organism install firmly, need not to use the manual installation of bolt, comparatively loaded down with trivial details problem when having solved installation and dismantlement control box cabinet.

title_en: Building engineering management safety warning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of constructional engineering and discloses a safety warning device for constructional engineering management, which comprises a main body mechanism, an adjusting mechanism and a fixing mechanism, wherein the adjusting mechanism is positioned on the upper side of the main body mechanism, the fixing mechanism is positioned on the right side of the main body mechanism, the main body mechanism comprises a supporting bottom plate, a movable base and a stabilizing assembly, the movable base is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the supporting bottom plate, the stabilizing assembly is fixedly arranged at the front end and the rear end of the supporting bottom plate, and the stabilizing assembly comprises a stable supporting plate, a first electric push rod, a first push rod and a fixing cone, and the stable supporting plate is fixedly arranged at the front end and the rear end of the supporting bottom plate. This building engineering management safety warning device through installing main part mechanism, can make people when using this building engineering management safety warning device, can fix the device through the downward fixed awl of first push rod of first electric putter promotion, has improved the stability performance when the device removes to place.

title_en: Inertial sensor
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of inertial sensors, and particularly relates to an inertial sensor which comprises a bottom sealing cover plate, a cover shell and a sensor integrated plate, wherein the cover shell is matched with the bottom sealing cover plate, the sensor integrated plate is arranged in a combined cavity of the bottom sealing cover plate and the cover shell, the sensor integrated plate is fixedly connected to the bottom sealing cover plate, and two groups of connecting pieces are symmetrically and slidably connected to the bottom sealing cover plate. According to the inertial sensor designed by the utility model, the connecting piece is arranged on the bottom sealing cover plate, so that the bottom sealing cover plate can be conveniently and quickly installed on the housing, the inertial sensor can be conveniently detached, overhauled and used after being damaged in the later period, the assembly and disassembly are convenient, the inertial sensor of the scheme can be conveniently and quickly adjusted through the matching design of the fixing seat on the bottom sealing cover plate, and the inertial sensor is suitable for being installed and used on installation holes of installation objects with different sizes, and the installation applicability of the inertial sensor of the scheme is improved.

title_en: Electronic paper display device with variable-price display function
abstract_en: The present application relates to an electronic paper display device having a variable-price display function. The electronic paper display device includes: the shell is provided with a first plane and a second plane which is opposite to the first plane; the first electronic paper display module is used for dynamically displaying the patterns, and the second electronic paper display module is used for displaying the price information of the commodity; the first electronic paper display module and the second electronic paper display module are arranged on the first plane; a display control board arranged on the second plane; the display control board is respectively and electrically connected with the first electronic paper display module and the second electronic paper display module; and the price controller is arranged on the display control panel and is used for adjusting the price information of the displayed commodity of the second electronic paper display module. According to the scheme provided by the application, the price controller capable of adjusting the price information of the commodity is arranged, so that the flexible adjustment of the price information of the commodity displayed in the electronic paper display equipment is realized, and the propaganda effect of electronic paper display is improved.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted screen protective sleeve
abstract_en: The application provides a vehicle-mounted screen protective sleeve, which comprises a back plate and an edge-covering fixing part formed at the edge of the back plate; the backboard is provided with an avoidance hole which is used for the screen supporting piece to pass through; the edge-covering fixing part is used for wrapping the edge of the screen and fixing the vehicle-mounted screen protective sleeve on the screen; the backboard is provided with a breakable splicing structure, and the avoidance hole is communicated with the outside when the splicing structure is broken; the splicing structure is used for allowing the screen support to pass through when the vehicle-mounted screen protective sleeve is sleeved on the back of the screen. Therefore, the problem that the rear shell of the vehicle-mounted screen cannot be effectively protected is solved.

title_en: Building block type stacked spliced screen cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of spliced screen cabinets, in particular to a building block type stacked spliced screen cabinet which comprises a cabinet body and a display screen, wherein a through hole is formed in the middle of the front end face of the cabinet body in a way of being inclined upwards, a mounting frame body is fixedly arranged in the middle of the through hole, a plurality of placing through holes are formed in the front end face of the mounting frame body in an equidistant manner, sliding cavities are formed in the mounting frame body and above and below the placing through holes, a mounting sliding block is mounted in the sliding cavities in a sliding mode, a limiting plate is connected with the front end face of the mounting sliding block in a penetrating way, and an L-shaped mounting plate is mounted in the middle of the top of the limiting plate. According to the utility model, the mounting frame body, the mounting slide block and the L-shaped mounting plate are used for realizing convenient disassembly and assembly of the display screen and convenient maintenance, and the heat emitted by the display screen during operation is convenient to disperse to the heat dissipation through holes of the cabinet body and the heat dissipation holes of the rear cabinet door through the heat dissipation fan.

title_en: Electric bicycle fills electric pile power conversion controller
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a power supply conversion controller of a charging pile of an electric bicycle, which comprises a controller body, wherein a connecting contact is fixed on the left side of the controller body, a fixing mechanism is arranged on the left side of the controller body, a containing box is fixed on the right side of the controller body, a wire collecting mechanism is arranged in the containing box, and the fixing mechanism comprises a fixing plate fixed on the left side of the controller body. This electric bicycle fills electric pile power conversion controller, cooperation through the stand pipe can lead the wire of connecting to make wire lug insert corresponding contact, cooperation through the splint can be when the joint of wire gets into the stand pipe inside, with splint outside extrusion, splint removal drive locating lever removal, the locating lever removal drives the stopper and removes, and the stopper removes and stretches the spring, and the spring exerts reaction force to the stopper, thereby makes splint fix the wire, avoids the unexpected disconnection of wire.

title_en: Indicating sign for traffic management
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of traffic and transportation management, and provides an indication sign for traffic and transportation management, which comprises the following components: the utility model provides an indicating plate, the containing box, containing plate, expansion mechanism and supporting mechanism, the indicating plate is equipped with a plurality ofly, rotate between a plurality of indicating plates and connect, the export has been seted up on the containing box, the containing plate is equipped with two, two containing plates all set up in the containing box, a plurality of indicating plates all set up in two containing plates, expansion mechanism sets up on the containing box, a plurality of indicating plates are used for expanding, supporting mechanism is equipped with a plurality of, a plurality of supporting mechanism all set up on the containing box, be used for carrying out stable support to the containing box, through above-mentioned technical scheme, an holistic monoblock panel of indicating plate in the correlation technique has been solved, the volume is great, thereby easily influence the transportation space and the containing space of indicating plate, and then the transportation of indicating plate and the problem of accomodating have been reduced.

title_en: Hanger structure of photovoltaic inverter
abstract_en: The utility model provides a hanger structure of a photovoltaic inverter, which comprises a left hanger, a right hanger, a left supporting piece and a right supporting piece, wherein the left hanger and the right hanger are respectively positioned at the left side and the right side of the top of the rear side surface of a photovoltaic inverter shell; the left hanging lug and the right hanging lug comprise a first extending wall, a second extending wall and a hooking wall, and the hooking wall is provided with a round hole part and a waist hole part which are communicated.
