The left and right hanging lugs are hung with the hanging nails of the wall surface to be installed, and the hanging lugs are positioned at the top of the rear side surface of the inverter, so that the hanging state is convenient to confirm, and the installation and maintenance are convenient; the left support piece and the right support piece are used for supporting, and the installation angle of the photovoltaic inverter is kept. The hanger structure can be suitable for stable installation of the low-power inverter, and is simple in structure and low in cost.

title_en: Advertisement dining plate with online payment function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of advertising billboards and discloses an advertising billboards with an online payment function, which comprises a main body mechanism and a stabilizing mechanism, wherein the stabilizing mechanism is positioned in the main body mechanism, the main body mechanism comprises a bottom plate, a main advertising billboards, a movable baffle, an adjusting electric push rod, a push plate, a push adjusting rod, an auxiliary advertising billboards, a limiting connecting rod, a first fixing block, a second fixing block and a rotating connecting rod, and the main advertising billboards are fixedly arranged at the upper end of the bottom plate. This take bill-board of payment on line function, through adjusting electric putter and fixed block one in the installation main part mechanism with fixed block two and swivelling joint pole, the auxiliary advertisement dining tablet of two sets of activities that make this bill-board inside set up can expand simultaneously and keep away from the inside of main advertisement dining tablet for former advertisement dining tablet's area grow realizes the advertising range regulation of bill-board, and the practicality and the flexibility of reinforcing advertisement dining tablet when using.

title_en: Sunshade device for total powerstation
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sunshade device for a total station, and belongs to the technical field of total stations. The sunshade device for the total station comprises a total station, a sunshade mechanism and an adjusting mechanism, wherein a support is arranged at the lower part of the total station, the sunshade mechanism comprises a containing box, a first sunshade plate and a locking bolt, the containing box is symmetrically and fixedly arranged on the side wall of the total station, a driving block is slidably arranged in an inner cavity of the containing box, and a thread block is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the driving block. According to the utility model, the sunshade mechanism is arranged, the rotating shaft is driven to rotate through the rotating knob, the two screw rods are driven to synchronously rotate through the two meshed first gears and the second gears, and the driving screw block is driven to drive the driving block to move forwards, so that the first sunshade plate is pushed out of the accommodating box to sunshade the operation panel of the total station, and meanwhile, the second sunshade plate can be pulled out of the first sunshade plate and limited through the locking bolt, so that the sunshade range is increased, and normal measurement work is ensured.

title_en: Two-wheeled scooter controller convenient to install
abstract_en: The utility model provides a two-wheel scooter controller convenient to install, which comprises an installation box, wherein sealing gaskets are glued at the periphery of the upper part of the installation box; the controller body is arranged on the inner side of the mounting box; the upper part of the mounting box is provided with a structure for conveniently disassembling the protecting cover. According to the utility model, the sponge protection pad can play a role in supporting the controller body tightly, so that the buffer protection effect can be achieved when the two-wheeled scooter is oscillated, and meanwhile, the two-wheeled scooter is in threaded connection with the mounting box through the screw hole, so that the sealing baffle is convenient to detach, and the controller body in the mounting box is convenient to disassemble and assemble.

title_en: Main control box assembly and LED all-in-one machine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of LED integrated machines, and discloses a main control box assembly and an LED integrated machine. The main control box assembly comprises a box body, a face shell and an interaction module. The surface shell is detachably connected with the box body, and a through hole is formed in the surface shell; the interactive module is detachably mounted on the box body, the interactive module passes through the through hole and is exposed out of the surface shell, no fixed assembly connection relation exists between the interactive module and the surface shell, and line maintenance can be carried out on the inside of the main control box assembly only by dismantling the surface shell when maintenance personnel examine and repair the surface shell, so that the interactive module cannot fall along with the disassembly of the surface shell, the line connection of the interactive module cannot be loose, the fault and other conditions are caused, and the maintenance operation is convenient. The LED all-in-one machine comprises the main control box assembly, when the main control box surface shell is disassembled for line maintenance, the interaction module cannot be disassembled along with the surface shell, and accidents such as loosening and tearing are not easy to occur at the line connection part of the interaction module, so that line maintenance is facilitated.

title_en: Infrared induction device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an infrared sensing device which comprises a sensor shell and a circuit board arranged in the sensor shell. The circuit board comprises a circuit board body, an infrared sensing device body, a light sensor, a connecting terminal and a plurality of electronic elements, wherein the infrared sensing device body, the light sensor and the connecting terminal are arranged on the circuit board body. The light sensor, the connecting terminal and the electronic element are all arranged at the bottom of the circuit board body, the circuit board body is provided with a light passing hole, the light sensor is installed towards the circuit board body, and the light sensing part is arranged in the light passing hole.

title_en: PCBA integrated circuit board with waterproof capability
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of circuit boards and discloses a PCBA integrated circuit board with waterproof capability, which comprises a circuit board main body, wherein a protective shell is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the circuit board main body, wiring pipes extending to the outer part of the protective shell are fixedly arranged on the two sides of the circuit board main body, and waterproof heat dissipation components are arranged on the two sides of the protective shell and positioned outside the wiring pipes; the waterproof heat dissipation assembly comprises two ventilation pipes fixedly installed inside the protective shell. This PCBA integrated circuit board that possesses waterproof ability through set up a plurality of louvre on the ventilation board, can the protecting crust carry out normal ventilation heat dissipation to the circuit board main part, and can prevent very big that external steam from entering into the protecting box inside through setting up waterproof ventilated membrane, can also prevent that outside steam from entering into the protecting crust inside when realizing ventilation, can effectually improve the waterproof performance of circuit board body, prevents that the integrated circuit board body from meeting the situation that water burns out from appearing.

title_en: Shell assembly and inverter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a housing assembly and an inverter, the housing assembly comprising: the bottom shell comprises a cavity with an opening; the upper cover is detachably arranged on the bottom shell; the locking positioning mechanism comprises a first fixing piece, a second fixing piece and a positioning structure, wherein the first fixing piece is arranged on the bottom shell and located at the outer edge of the opening, a first fixing hole is formed in the first fixing piece, the second fixing piece is arranged at the position, opposite to the first fixing piece, of the upper cover, a second fixing hole is formed in the second fixing piece, the positioning structure comprises a first positioning portion and a second positioning portion, the first positioning portion is arranged at one end, close to the second fixing piece, of the first fixing piece, the second positioning portion is arranged at one end, close to the first fixing piece, of the second fixing piece, and in the state that the upper cover is covered on the bottom shell, the first fixing hole is communicated with the second fixing hole, and the first positioning portion is matched with the second positioning portion in a positioning mode. The utility model improves the assembly efficiency between the upper cover and the bottom shell and reduces the production cost.

title_en: Voice interaction equipment based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The utility model discloses voice interaction equipment based on artificial intelligence, which belongs to the technical field of voice interaction equipment based on artificial intelligence, and the technical scheme is characterized in that the voice interaction equipment comprises an anti-skid pad, wherein an adjusting component is arranged at the top of the anti-skid pad, and an interactive display body is clamped at the inner side of the adjusting component; the adjusting part includes the backup pad, the top fixedly connected with connecting block of backup pad, the left side and the right side of connecting block all rotate and are connected with the fixed plate, the front side fixedly connected with link of fixed plate, two spliced slots have been seted up at the front side fixedly connected with frame of link, the auxiliary tank has been seted up at the top of frame, the spliced eye has all been seted up on the left side and the right side of frame inner wall, current voice interaction equipment for artificial intelligence based on, a plurality of supports interactive display body through the fixed bolster, in-process at daily use, inconvenient user adjusts the problem of viewing angle of interactive display body according to the condition.

title_en: Portable audio and video evidence obtaining equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses portable audio and video evidence obtaining equipment, which relates to the technical field of evidence obtaining equipment and comprises a portable device, wherein two clamping blocks capable of being mutually clamped at any position of clothes are arranged on one side of the portable device, a control cavity capable of controlling the two clamping blocks to do clamping work is arranged in the portable device, and an evidence obtaining device capable of automatically adjusting shooting angles is arranged on one side surface of the portable device. According to the portable device, the two clamping blocks can be controlled to move mutually by the control handle arranged at the top of the portable device, so that the portable device can be clamped at any part of a law enforcement body, meanwhile, the evidence taking camera in the evidence taking device can automatically perform angle adjustment for a circle at the circumference opening, so that most of devices can miss the optimal evidence taking time when the angle is improper, meanwhile, the law enforcement is not required to excessively adjust the evidence taking angle, hands are liberated, the success of evidence taking is improved, and the portability of the portable device is also improved.

title_en: Head-mounted type high-altitude operation communication structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of communication and discloses a head-mounted high-altitude operation communication structure which comprises a head-mounted beam, wherein fixed blocks are fixedly connected to the right two ends of a head Dai Liangzuo, an adjusting assembly is arranged in each fixed block, binding bands are fixedly connected to the bottoms of the fixed blocks, one of the other ends of the binding bands is fixedly connected with a connecting block, the other end of the binding band is fixedly connected with a mounting block, two moving blocks are slidably connected in each connecting block, a limiting plate II is fixedly connected to one side of each moving block, a spring II is fixedly connected to one side of each limiting plate II, and one end of each spring II is fixedly connected in each connecting block. According to the utility model, the binding band can fix the head-wearing beam on the head of a wearer to prevent the communication device from falling, and the length of the head-wearing beam can be adjusted by pulling the left end and the right end of the head-wearing beam, so that the communication device can adapt to the use requirements of different wearers.

title_en: Multifunctional console with double sound cards, wireless noise reduction and video acquisition card
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional console with a double sound card, wireless noise reduction and a video acquisition card, and belongs to the technical field of multimedia equipment. The utility model comprises a main chip, a control panel, a power supply unit and an interactive panel, wherein at least 2 sound cards are arranged in the main chip, the main chip is sequentially connected with a microphone amplifying circuit and a microphone input circuit, and the microphone input circuit is connected with a noise reduction module, a wireless microphone receiving circuit and a composite interface; the control panel is provided with a plurality of knobs, keys and indicator lamps which are electrically connected with the main chip, the interactive panel is provided with a plurality of input and output sockets which are electrically connected with the main chip, and the main chip is also connected with the storage module and the wireless communication module. The utility model integrates the double sound card, the wireless communication function, the noise reduction function and the video acquisition function to a high degree, meets the requirements of the existing users and improves the use experience of the users.

title_en: Outdoor splice type cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an outdoor spliced cabinet which is characterized by comprising a cabinet frame and a shell, wherein the cabinet frame comprises transverse square tubes, longitudinal square tubes, vertical square tubes and connecting pieces connected between the square tubes, the transverse square tubes, the longitudinal square tubes and the vertical square tubes are respectively provided with four frame structures which are built into a rectangular cabinet body through the connecting pieces, a supporting frame used for supporting the cabinet frame is arranged in the cabinet frame and comprises transverse supporting tubes, vertical supporting tubes and connecting pieces connected between the supporting tubes, one supporting frame comprises a transverse supporting tube, two vertical supporting tubes and a U-shaped frame structure which is built through the connecting pieces, the inner side wall of each longitudinal square tube is provided with a socket for embedding the edge part of the supporting frame, the supporting frame is connected with the cabinet frame through L-shaped connecting pieces, the transverse supporting tubes are positioned at the top end of the cabinet frame, and the bottom end of the cabinet frame is provided with the longitudinal supporting tubes connected between the two transverse square tubes. The cabinet frame can be conveniently disassembled and assembled.

title_en: Data center liquid cooling system with ultrapure water constant pressure moisturizing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a data center liquid cooling system with ultrapure water constant-pressure water supplementing, which comprises a plurality of server cold plates, a cooling water supply pipe network, a cooling water return pipe network, a plurality of heat exchange modules and an ultrapure water constant-pressure water supplementing redundancy module, wherein the water inlet end of the ultrapure water constant-pressure water supplementing redundancy module is communicated with a municipal water supply pipe network, the water outlet end of the ultrapure water constant-pressure water supplementing redundancy module is communicated with the cooling water return pipe network, the water inlet end of the cooling water return pipe network is communicated with water outlets of the plurality of server cold plates, the water outlet end of the cooling water return pipe network is communicated with water inlets of the plurality of heat exchange modules, the water outlet end of the cooling water supply pipe network is communicated with water inlets of the plurality of server cold plates. The liquid cooling secondary side water supplementing constant pressure and online ultra-pure water supplementing are combined together and are arranged on the outer side of a machine room of the liquid cooling system, so that CDU design is simpler, and the cost of the whole liquid cooling system is saved.

title_en: Integrated high-power electric propeller
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of motors, in particular to an integrated high-power electric propeller which comprises a paddle rod, paddles and a brushless motor, wherein the brushless motor comprises a shell, a main shaft, a controller and a transmission assembly, the shell is cylindrical, the main shaft, the transmission assembly and the controller are all arranged in the shell, one end of the main shaft is fixedly connected with a fan, a heat dissipation plate is fixedly connected in the shell, the heat dissipation plate is positioned on one side of the transmission assembly far away from the fan, the controller is annular and is arranged on the side surface of the heat dissipation plate far away from the transmission assembly, a gap is reserved between the inner wall of the shell and the transmission assembly, the shell is provided with a wind hole communicated with the gap, the paddle rod is positioned between the shell and the paddles, the paddles are hollow in the paddle rod and are provided with transmission shafts for the transmission of the paddles in the main shaft direction, and the paddles are rotationally connected with the paddle rod. The controller is designed to be installed in the shell in a ring shape, heat generated by the controller is conducted to the heat dissipation plate, and meanwhile heat dissipation of the motor and the controller is achieved, and heat dissipation effect is guaranteed.

title_en: Ventilating structure for electromechanical equipment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of ventilation and heat dissipation, and particularly discloses a ventilation structure for electromechanical equipment, which comprises an equipment body, wherein a ventilation hole is formed in the outer surface of the equipment body, a small fan is arranged in the ventilation hole, an activated carbon pool is arranged at the bottom of the inner wall of the equipment body, an air bag is arranged at the top of the inner wall of the equipment body, a slideway is arranged on the inner wall of the equipment body, a dehumidifying mechanism for improving the internal humid environment of the equipment body is arranged in the equipment body, and a proper amount of activated carbon particles are put in the activated carbon pool. The ventilation structure for the electromechanical equipment has the advantages that the characteristics of accelerating airflow flow and moisture absorption of the activated carbon are combined by the extrusion air bag, moisture invasion can be effectively prevented in a humid environment, the fast airflow flow rapidly takes away the humid air, and the activated carbon absorbs and holds the moisture, so that a synergistic effect is formed, the ventilation and heat dissipation effects are improved, and the reliability and stability of the equipment are improved.

title_en: DC battery discharging device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of automobile battery management, in particular to a direct current battery discharging device, which comprises a shell, wherein a power inverter with a self-powered wire is fixedly arranged in the shell, the power inverter is electrically connected with a control circuit board, the control circuit board is respectively and electrically connected with a voltmeter and a change-over switch, the change-over switch is respectively and electrically connected with a switch a, a switch b and a switch c, the switch a is respectively and electrically connected with a first heating wire and a second heating wire, the switch b is respectively and electrically connected with a third heating wire and a fourth heating wire, the switch c is respectively and electrically connected with a fifth heating wire and a sixth heating wire, and the change-over switch is also electrically connected with a discharged source positive clamping jaw and a discharged source negative clamping jaw. The direct current battery discharging device adopts multi-specification discharging, can meet the discharging requirements of batteries with different voltage levels, can realize semi-automatic operation, can set discharging voltage, is controllable in device temperature, and is intelligent and efficient.

title_en: Positioning pin structure on pressing jig
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a locating pin structure on a pressing jig, which comprises a fixed support base, wherein locating pin bodies are fixedly connected to four corners of the top of the fixed support base, an adjusting locating plate is sleeved on the top of the surface of the locating pin body, mounting blocks are arranged at four corners of the top of the adjusting locating plate, and the bottoms of the mounting blocks penetrate into the locating pin bodies. According to the utility model, the sliding rod is pulled to move upwards, the tapered column is driven to move upwards by the sliding rod, the tapered column loses support to the inclined block, the push plate and the bayonet lock are driven to move inwards by the elastic force of the spring, the bayonet lock exits from the inside of the bayonet lock groove, the mounting block is moved upwards, the mounting block is separated from the locating pin body, the locating pin body and the adjusting locating plate lose fixation, the advantage of convenient operation is achieved, the locating pin structure is clamped by using a buckling and pulling mode, slipping is avoided in the operation process of the locating pin structure, and the use convenience of the locating pin structure of the pressing jig is improved.

title_en: Art derivative exhibiting guide mark with region national culture symbol
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of guide marks, in particular to an art derivative display guide mark with regional ethnic culture symbols; the technical scheme includes that the art derivative display guide mark with regional national culture symbols comprises a driving component, a lifting component, a guide frame component and a limiting component, and compared with the traditional art derivative display guide mark, the utility model can reduce the height of a guide plate when the information of the guide plate needs to be changed and modified by the mutual matching of the lifting structure and the limiting structure, thereby enabling workers to more conveniently take the guide plate out of the device and complete the internal modification and replacement of the guide plate.

title_en: Stepped inverter housing
abstract_en: The utility model provides a stepped inverter shell for solving the problem of low heat dissipation efficiency of the existing inverter. The stepped inverter shell comprises a base frame, a concave cavity for accommodating electronic components is formed in the base frame, the concave cavity is divided into a first area and a second area, and the base frame corresponding to the first area and the second area is arranged in a stepped mode. The stepped structure is adopted, so that the volume of the inverter is reduced on the whole, and meanwhile, compared with the prior art, the stepped structure is larger in heat dissipation area and better in heat dissipation effect, and the heat dissipation efficiency of the inverter is further improved.

title_en: PCB bonding pad convenient for tin melting
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of bonding pads, in particular to a PCB bonding pad convenient for tin melting, which comprises a substrate, wherein a bonding pad area is formed in the substrate, a plurality of bonding holes are formed in the bonding pad area, concave inclined planes are formed in the bonding holes, raised blocking rings are arranged at the edges of bonding Kong Waijing and fixedly connected to the bonding pad area, the bonding holes are distributed at intervals along the periphery of the edge of the bonding pad area, cross flower grooves are formed in the inclined planes of the bonding holes, heat dissipation holes are formed in the periphery of the bonding holes, and a separation strip is arranged between the bonding holes and the heat dissipation holes.

title_en: Shell cooling structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a shell cooling structure which comprises a shell and stainless steel cooling pipes, wherein the shell is provided with two mounting holes, the stainless steel cooling pipes are integrally formed in the shell, and two ends of each stainless steel cooling pipe extend out of the two mounting holes in a one-to-one correspondence manner. The shell cooling structure has low processing cost and can prevent pipeline blockage.

title_en: PCB circuit board convenient to position
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of circuit boards and discloses a PCB (printed circuit board) convenient to position, which comprises a PCB, wherein positioning components are arranged on the periphery of the top of the PCB, each positioning component comprises a mounting seat, the bottom of each mounting seat is fixedly connected to the top of the PCB, a first damping rod is fixedly connected to the inside of each mounting seat, one end of each damping rod is fixedly connected with a deflector rod, one side, away from the first damping rod, of each deflector rod is fixedly connected with a connecting rod, a spring is sleeved in the inner part of each damping rod, one end, away from the corresponding deflector rod, of each connecting rod is fixedly connected with a positioning block, and buffer components are arranged on the front side and the rear side of the bottom of the PCB. According to the utility model, the mounting seat, the first damping rod, the deflector rod, the spring, the connecting rod and the positioning block are mutually matched, the deflector rod drives the positioning block to move through the connecting rod, then the deflector rod is loosened, the first damping rod is reset, the positioning block can be pushed to move, the PCB can be positioned through the movement of the positioning block, and the operation of personnel is facilitated.

title_en: Network memory
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of network storage, in particular to a network storage. The network memory comprises a shell, wherein the shell comprises a side shell, a front cover and a rear cover, buckling parts are arranged at edges of inner side surfaces of the front end and the rear end of the side shell, buckling grooves are formed in inner side surfaces of one outward ends of the buckling parts, buckling slots are formed in the edges of the front cover and the rear cover, corresponding buckling parts are provided with limiting edges to form an inserting cavity, the buckling parts are inserted into the buckling slots to enable one outward ends of the buckling parts to be inserted into the inserting cavity, and the limiting edges are embedded into the buckling grooves to form blocking for the buckling parts. The front cover and the rear cover are positioned on the front end and the rear end of the shell, the assembly operation is simple, and the assembly efficiency of the network memory shell is high.

title_en: Microphone bracket for live webcast
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a microphone bracket for network live broadcasting, which relates to the field of microphone brackets and comprises an installation seat, wherein the top end of the installation seat is provided with a placing groove, the top end of the installation seat is provided with two groups of fixed boxes, the bottom end of the installation seat is provided with a rotating block, the inner wall of the rotating block is rotationally connected with an adjusting rod, the bottom end of the adjusting rod is rotationally connected with the rotating seat, the bottom end of the rotating seat is provided with a U-shaped seat, the inner walls of the two groups of fixed boxes are slidingly connected with push rods, and the end parts of the two groups of push rods are provided with fixing strips. According to the utility model, by arranging the two groups of fixing strips and utilizing the arc-shaped arrangement of the fixing strips, when the microphone is installed, the microphone is only required to be pressed down in the placing groove, the fixing strips are extruded towards the direction of the fixing box by utilizing the arc surface of the upper arc-shaped strips, and when the microphone is placed in the placing groove, the limiting spring can push the push rod to reset, so that the two groups of lower arc-shaped strips clamp the microphone and prevent the microphone from falling.

title_en: Arc-shaped splicing seam control device for LED front maintenance box body
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of LED box installation, in particular to an arc splicing seam control device for an LED front maintenance box, which comprises an installation backboard, wherein an extension supporting rod is fixedly connected to the outer side wall of the installation backboard, a first arc connecting plate is fixedly connected to one end of the extension supporting rod, a first LED arc box is connected to the first arc connecting plate, front and rear adjusting components are respectively arranged at two ends of the outer side wall of the installation backboard, a left and right adjusting component is fixedly arranged on the front and rear adjusting component, a second LED arc box is arranged on the left and right adjusting component, and after the first LED arc box is fixed, the position of the second LED arc box can be changed through the cooperation of the front and rear adjusting component and the left and right adjusting component, so that the second LED arc box approaches to the first LED arc box, the seam control purpose is achieved, the structure is simple, the practicability is strong, and the attractiveness is improved.

title_en: Miniature loudspeaker and assembly jig
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a miniature loudspeaker and an assembly jig, which comprises a support, a voice coil and a diaphragm, wherein the support is a support with two open ends, the support comprises a first annular wall and a second annular wall, the first annular wall and the second annular wall form a containing cavity, a magnetic circuit assembly is further arranged in the containing cavity and comprises an inner ring magnetic circuit, an outer ring magnetic circuit and a magnetic conduction plate, the inner side wall of the containing cavity is further provided with a limiting step, the total size of the loudspeaker can be reduced, and the limiting step on the support is used for limiting the outer ring magnetic circuit so as to prevent the outer ring magnetic circuit from falling off due to severe vibration or strong impact force for a long time.

title_en: Explosion-proof PLC switch board
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of PLC control cabinets, and provides an explosion-proof PLC control cabinet which comprises a control cabinet body, wherein a base is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the control cabinet body, a first rotating shaft is movably embedded near the top at the center of the right side of the base, a crank is fixedly arranged on the right side of the first rotating shaft, a forward rotating screw rod is fixedly arranged at the left side of the first rotating shaft and positioned in the base, a second rotating shaft is fixedly arranged at the left side of the forward rotating screw rod, a reverse rotating screw rod is fixedly arranged at the left side of the second rotating shaft, and the left outer surface of the reverse rotating screw rod is movably embedded at the center of the left side of the inner wall of the base.

title_en: FPC flexible line way board water trap
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water removing device for an FPC flexible circuit board, which belongs to the technical field of circuit boards and comprises a workbench, wherein the top end of the workbench is fixedly connected with a rotating assembly, the rotating assembly comprises an outer circular groove and an inner circular groove which are formed in the top end of the workbench, the top end of the workbench is provided with a circular ring in a fitting manner, and the inner surface and the outer surface of the circular ring are fixedly connected with teeth. According to the utility model, the motor, the driving gear, the rotating assembly, the fan and the electric heating wire are arranged, and the motor drives the driving gear to rotate, so that the driving gear drives the circuit board to revolve and automatically, meanwhile, the wind blown by the fan is heated by the electric heating wire, the circuit board is dried, a worker is not required to turn over the circuit board, and a plurality of circuit boards can be dehydrated, so that the effect of dehydrating the two sides of the circuit board is achieved, the circuit board is dried, the wet surface of the circuit board is prevented, time and labor are saved, and the dehydrating efficiency of the circuit board is improved.

title_en: Shielding structure and electronic device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a shielding structure and an electronic device. The electronic device comprises a substrate, an electronic element and a shielding structure. The electronic element is arranged on the substrate. The shielding structure comprises a frame body, a cover body and a conductive adhesive material. The frame body is suitable for surrounding the electronic element and comprises an annular side wall and an annular top wall, the annular top wall is connected with the annular side wall, the top surface of the annular top wall comprises a groove, the cover body is assembled on the frame body and covers the groove, and the conductive adhesive material is filled in the groove so as to fix the cover body on the frame body and seal the electronic element in the shielding structure, thereby achieving excellent electromagnetic shielding effect.

title_en: Network switch
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a network switch, which comprises a switch body, wherein an inserting port is arranged at the rear end of the switch body, a fixing frame is arranged at the rear of the switch body, two groups of mounting frames are symmetrically arranged on the fixing frame and are matched with the mounting frames to form a synchronous opposite moving structure, clamping seats are arranged on the inner sides of the mounting frames and are matched with the inserting port, a wire fixing groove is formed in each clamping seat, a plurality of groups of locking sheets are arranged on the outer sides of the clamping seats, locking rings are arranged on the outer sides of the plurality of groups of locking sheets in a threaded manner, wire clamping ports are formed in the locking rings, the switch body comprises a shell, a heat dissipation groove is formed in the shell, a protection screen is arranged at the position of the heat dissipation groove, a clamping seat is arranged on the outer side of the shell, and a filter screen is arranged on the clamping seat in a sliding clamping manner.

title_en: Road monitoring ball machine with weather detection function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a road monitoring ball machine with weather detection, which comprises a sphere main room with a downward opening, wherein an annular weather detection assembly for detecting weather is sleeved on the outer wall of the opening of the sphere main room and fixedly connected with the outer wall of the opening of the sphere main room, a wire harness is arranged at the top end of the sphere main room, a camera with an execution end extending out of the opening of the sphere main room is arranged in the sphere main room, the camera is rotatable, the wire harness is respectively connected with the sphere main room, the annular weather detection assembly and the camera.

title_en: Microphone control device and microphone
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of broadcasting microphones, and particularly relates to a control device of a microphone and the microphone, which comprises a control panel, wherein a C-shaped clamping block is detachably arranged on the control panel, a telescopic rod which can be adjusted in a telescopic way is rotationally connected to the upper end surface of the C-shaped clamping block, the telescopic rod and the C-shaped clamping block can move, the telescopic rod can be telescopic and the telescopic rod and a clamping circular arc block can rotate only by rotating a deflector rod, so that the effect of conveniently adjusting the position of the microphone relative to a speaker is achieved, the length of the telescopic rod, the fixation between the C-shaped clamping block and the telescopic rod and the fixation between the telescopic rod and the clamping circular arc block can be achieved by loosening the elastic reset of the deflector rod, the effect that the microphone is quickly adjusted to the most suitable position only by holding the deflector rod below the microphone by one hand under the condition that the speaker keeps the speaking posture.

title_en: Heat dissipation device and edge computing device
abstract_en: The application provides a heat dissipating device and edge computing equipment, which comprises a central processing unit, a temperature detection module, a current detection module, a heat dissipating component driving circuit and a heat dissipating component, wherein the heat dissipating component comprises an inner heat dissipating component, the outer heat dissipating component is positioned on a pole holding box outside the edge computing equipment and used for dissipating heat inside the pole holding box of the edge computing equipment, one ends of the inner heat dissipating component and the outer heat dissipating component are connected with the heat dissipating component driving circuit, and the other ends of the inner heat dissipating component and the outer heat dissipating component are connected with the central processing unit. According to the application, the internal structure of the edge computing equipment is radiated through the internal radiating component, the internal part of the holding pole box where the edge computing equipment is located is radiated through the external radiating component, so that the radiating efficiency of the edge computing equipment is improved, the system temperature of the edge computing equipment is in a reasonable range, the system heat of the edge computing equipment can be effectively discharged, and the working temperature performance of the edge computing equipment is improved.

title_en: Microphone front-end circuit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a microphone front-end circuit which comprises a signal input circuit, a first switch unit, a second switch unit and a signal output circuit, wherein the signal input circuit is used for receiving audio input and power supply input of a microphone and converting the audio input into single-ended signals, a first end of the first switch unit is connected with the power supply input, a second end of the first switch unit is connected with the signal output circuit, a control end of the first switch unit is connected with the signal input circuit and is used for conducting when the single-ended signals are positive, a first end of the second switch unit is connected with the signal output circuit, a second end of the first switch unit is grounded, a control end of the first switch unit is connected with the signal input circuit and is used for conducting when the single-ended signals are negative, and the signal output circuit is connected with the second end of the first switch unit and the first end of the second switch unit and is used for converting received signals into balanced signals. By implementing the utility model, noise generated in the microphone sound processing process can be avoided, and the sound quality is improved.

title_en: Fitment design effect display device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a decoration design effect display device which comprises a base, wherein first vertical plates are respectively arranged at the front end and the rear end of the left side and the right side of the top surface of the base, first rotating shafts are rotatably arranged at the upper parts of the first vertical plates, a turnover plate is fixedly connected between the two first rotating shafts at the same side, a hydraulic cylinder is arranged on the turnover plate, a lifting plate is fixedly connected downwards by a piston rod of the hydraulic cylinder, through grooves are formed in the base corresponding to the lifting plate, casters are rotatably arranged at the front end and the rear end of the bottom of the lifting plate, supporting sleeves are fixedly arranged in the centers of the top surfaces of the base, supporting columns are coaxially arranged in the supporting sleeves, the supporting columns are sleeved with the tops of the supporting sleeves in a vertically sliding mode, the top ends of the supporting columns extend out of the supporting sleeves and are fixedly connected with supporting plates, clamping grooves are formed in the front end and the rear end of the left side and the right side of the bottom of the supporting plates, a second motor is arranged in the supporting plate, and an output shaft of the second motor extends upwards and is fixedly connected with a rotary plate. The utility model can realize flexible movement of the device and flexibly adjust the height, the azimuth and the angle of the display, and has better display effect.

title_en: Circuit board body mounting bracket convenient to detach for induction cooker
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a circuit board body mounting bracket for an electromagnetic oven, which is convenient to detach, and belongs to the technical field of circuit board body mounting brackets, and comprises a mounting bracket body, wherein side plates are uniformly formed on four sides of the top of the mounting bracket body, the top of the mounting bracket is provided with a circuit board body between three groups of side plates, and the top of the circuit board body is provided with a positioning assembly for fixing the circuit board body on the top of the mounting bracket body; according to the utility model, the circuit board body can be firstly arranged in the mounting bracket body through the arrangement of the independent mounting bracket body, then the circuit board body is arranged and fixed in the electromagnetic oven through the mounting bracket body, so that the circuit board body is prevented from being damaged by punching and mounting the circuit board body, in addition, the circuit board body can be arranged at the top of the mounting bracket body through one of the positioning component and the abutting component in the device, the circuit board body is positioned and fixed in a clamping manner, and the mounting and the dismounting are convenient.

title_en: Clamping device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a clamping device which comprises a device main body, a vacuum chuck and an equipment box, wherein the vacuum chuck is arranged on the inner side of the device main body, the equipment box is arranged on the outer side of the device main body, a chuck air pipe is arranged on the other side of the vacuum chuck, the other end of the chuck air pipe is in through connection with an air duct, the other end of the air duct is in through connection with a negative pressure air pump, the upper end of the device main body is provided with a placing groove, the placing groove penetrates through the upper half part of the device main body, a piece taking groove is formed in the side surface of the device main body in a through manner, and a sponge cushion is fixedly connected to the inner side surface of the device main body. Through setting up standing groove and vacuum chuck, make the fixture of this device can not influence the work of taking of circuit board, and set up push pedal and hydraulic pump, make this device can avoid appearing the negative pressure pump and stop the back of operation, the leakproofness between vacuum chuck and the circuit board is too good to lead to the circuit board still to adsorb the condition on vacuum chuck surface.

title_en: Cold water circulating device with electrode capable of refrigerating rapidly
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cold water circulating device for rapidly refrigerating an electrode, which comprises a supporting device, wherein a cooling device is arranged in front of the supporting device, the cooling device comprises a cooling cylinder, two sealing rings are symmetrically arranged at the upper end and the lower end of the cooling cylinder, a first partition plate is fixedly arranged at the top of the cooling cylinder, the design of combining three sections of cooling electrode columns through the first partition plate and a second partition plate is adopted for the cold water circulating device for rapidly refrigerating the electrode, the defect of insufficient cooling water flow when a linear pipeline is cooled is prevented, no cooling water flows through the area at the top of the pipeline, the cooling effect of the part of the electrode columns is influenced, the cooling comprehensiveness is improved, the whole cooling of the electrode columns is more uniform, the cooling water firstly contacts the top end of the electrode columns, finally, the cooling water with lowest unabsorbed heat temperature firstly contacts the highest temperature part of the electrode columns through the design of the bottom end of the electrode columns, the cooling water cooling pertinence is improved, and the cooling effect is better.

title_en: Liquid crystal display with dustproof protection architecture
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of dust prevention of display screens, and discloses a liquid crystal display screen with a dust prevention protection structure, which comprises a display screen body, wherein side plates are arranged on the left side wall and the right side wall of the upper end and the lower end of the display screen body, a transparent film is arranged on the front side of the display screen body, a stepping motor is arranged on the outer side of the side plates, a driving wheel is arranged at the output end of the stepping motor, and a belt is sleeved on the driving wheel. The transparent film is arranged on the periphery of the display screen body from top to bottom, the transparent film can effectively prevent dust on the display screen body, when the stepping motor is started, the driving shaft can be driven to rotate through the driving wheel, the belt and the driven wheel, the driving shaft rotates to drive the transparent film to convey, and the floating dust attached to the transparent film can be effectively cleaned by the clamping type cleaning cotton sliver in the process of conveying the transparent film, so that the dust prevention effect of the transparent film is effectively improved, and the display effect of the liquid crystal display screen is not influenced.

title_en: Earphone and earphone assembly
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an earphone and an earphone assembly. The earphone comprises an earphone main body, an energy storage component and a main board, wherein the battery compartment is arranged on the earphone main body, the energy storage component is detachably arranged in the battery compartment, the energy storage component comprises an energy storage component and a box body, the energy storage component is arranged in the box body, the box body is provided with an extraction component, the extraction component is electrically connected with the energy storage component, and the main board is provided with an electric connection component, and the extraction component is detachably and electrically connected with the electric connection component.

title_en: Novel automatic chip mounter flies to reach mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel automatic chip mounter flying device mechanism which comprises a mounting plate, a material tearing assembly, a material winding assembly, a control assembly, an adjusting assembly and a pull rod assembly, wherein the material tearing assembly, the material winding assembly, the control module, the adjusting assembly and the pull rod assembly are all mounted on the mounting plate, the material tearing assembly, the adjusting assembly and the material winding assembly are electrically connected with the control assembly, and the adjusting assembly is used for controlling the material tearing assembly and the material winding assembly through the control assembly. The utility model replaces the double motor drive of the tearing component and the coiling component with higher pneumatic precision, can realize more accurate component supply and positioning, is beneficial to improving the patch quality, has more flexible control, can carry out finer parameter adjustment and action control through an electronic control system, has lower noise, is relatively quiet in operation and stable in performance, is less influenced by environmental factors, and can automatically adjust gears through an adjusting component to improve the production efficiency, improve the precision and the stability, reduce the operation difficulty and facilitate the production management.

title_en: Vehicle parking position reminding device for microwave detection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a vehicle parking position reminding device for microwave detection, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a pair of supporting rods are vertically arranged at the front and rear positions of the upper end of the bottom plate, a pair of sliding rods are transversely fixed between the pair of supporting rods, the pair of sliding rods are connected with the same electric sliding block in a sliding manner, a microwave detector is arranged on the inner side of the electric sliding block, a corresponding ultraviolet transmitter and a corresponding ultraviolet receiver are respectively arranged on the right side of the pair of supporting rods at the right end of the electric sliding block, a box body is embedded in the left side of the upper end of the bottom plate, a reminding board is hinged to the right side of the upper end of the box body, and a lifting assembly connected with the reminding board is arranged in the box body. The utility model has the advantages that the ultraviolet emitter, the ultraviolet receiver, the lifting assembly and the reminding board are matched with an external control system, so that the goods van is in a detection range when the goods van is parked, the places which cannot be detected are prevented from being detected, the goods van does not need to be manually adjusted to be backed up or moved in, and the use is simple and convenient.

title_en: Cover plate with binding positioning double-sided adhesive tape
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cover plate with binding positions and double-sided adhesive, which comprises a cover plate main body, a plurality of protective films and binding positions, wherein the cover plate main body is used for being connected with a film structure binding an FPC, the protective films are respectively arranged on two side surfaces of the cover plate main body, binding positions are arranged on the binding surfaces between the protective films and the cover plate main body and are adhered with the corresponding protective films, and the binding positions can be used for adhering the protective films to the set positions on the surface of the cover plate main body. The method is changed into sticking the protective film with binding positions on the cover plate main body, and the machine suction nozzle can completely adsorb the protective film because the area of the protective film is large, so that the problems are avoided.

title_en: Lens driving mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lens driving mechanism which comprises a base, a plurality of supporting rods, a frame and a carrier, wherein a first lug is arranged on the top surface of the base. The bottom ends of the supporting rods are respectively connected with the base. The frame is located the top of base and with the top of bracing piece is connected, the frame is set up to the horizontal direction motion, the bottom surface of frame is equipped with holds the first recess of first lug, the roof of first recess with be equipped with damping gel between the first lug. The carrier is positioned in the frame, is elastically connected with the frame and is arranged to be movable in the vertical direction, and is used for mounting a lens.

title_en: Connector and microphone bracket using same
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a connector and a microphone bracket using the same, comprising a connector main body, a transfer main body, a conical pressure plate and a locking screw, wherein the connector main body comprises a tubular body, a first clamping plate and a second clamping plate which are integrally formed by die casting, the transfer main body comprises a connector head and a connecting plate which are integrally formed by die casting, the connecting plate is positioned between the first clamping plate and the second clamping plate, the first clamping plate is provided with a through hole for the conical pressure plate to pass through, the connecting plate is provided with a conical concave hole towards the first side surface of the first clamping plate, the conical pressure plate falls into the conical concave hole, an elastic friction plate is arranged between the connecting plate and the second clamping plate, and the locking screw sequentially passes through the central holes of the conical pressure plate, the connecting plate and the friction plate and the second clamping plate and locks all the components so as to provide enough fastening force and stable support to meet the use requirement of larger bearing.

title_en: Testing device
abstract_en: The application discloses a testing device, and relates to the field of image sensor testing. The testing device comprises a glass panel, a light source and a bearing part. The glass panel has light transmittance, the light transmittance of the glass panel is uneven, and the glass panel can move in a plane where the glass panel is located. The light source is arranged on one side of the glass panel, and the light source emits test light to the glass panel. The bearing part is arranged on the other side of the glass panel and is used for bearing equipment to be tested, and the bearing part can move along the direction close to or far away from the glass panel.

title_en: Temperature control device of double evaporators
abstract_en: The application provides a temperature control device of a double evaporator, which comprises a temperature controller shell, wherein a connecting wire is connected to the lower side of the temperature controller shell, an adjusting mechanism is arranged between the connecting wire and the lower surface of the temperature controller shell, heat dissipation mechanisms are arranged on the two side surfaces of the temperature controller shell, a back plate is arranged on the rear side of the temperature controller shell, and a connecting mechanism is arranged between the back plate and the temperature controller shell. The application can realize flexible adjustment and stable fixation of the length of the connecting wire through the use of the adjusting mechanism. Winding cylinder cooperation knob among the adjustment mechanism can easily realize receiving of connecting wire and release, and accurate adjustment length avoids overlength disordered or too short limited, and the design of fixed section of thick bamboo, hole and screw provides dual fixed guarantee again for the connecting wire, effectively prevents not hard up droing, has greatly promoted the stability that the connecting wire is connected, has ensured temperature control device's normal operating under various complex environment.

title_en: High-brightness energy-saving LED display screen
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-brightness energy-saving LED display screen, which comprises an LED display screen and a U-shaped bracket, wherein the U-shaped bracket is sleeved outside the LED display screen, both sides of the U-shaped bracket are respectively provided with a first solar cell panel in a sliding manner, the back surface of the U-shaped bracket is provided with a second solar cell panel in a sliding manner, the top surface of the U-shaped bracket is provided with a third solar cell panel which is used for tightly pressing and limiting the first solar cell panel and the second solar cell panel, and the first solar cell panel, the second solar cell panel and the third solar cell panel are combined to form an outer protective shell. The LED display screen is simple in structure, the first solar panel, the second solar panel and the third solar panel are combined to form the outer protective shell, the external protection function of the LED display screen is increased, the power supply quantity can be increased through the plurality of solar panels, municipal power consumption is reduced, and the first solar panel, the second solar panel and the third solar panel are convenient to install and detach.

title_en: Air tightness single-core armored cable plug
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of single-core cable plugs and discloses an airtight single-core armored cable plug which comprises a main shell and a butt joint shell, wherein the butt joint shell is fixedly arranged on one side of the main shell, an annular groove is formed in the outer side of one end of the butt joint shell, a movable ring is slidably connected to the inner cavity of the annular groove, a plurality of groups of springs are fixedly connected between the side wall of the movable ring and the inner cavity of the annular groove, a sealing ring is fixedly connected to one side of the movable ring, four groups of heat conducting rods are inlaid in the inner side wall of the butt joint shell, heat radiating fins are fixedly connected between the butt joint shell and the main shell, a single-core cable is arranged in the inner cavity of the main shell, one end of the single-core cable penetrates through the inner cavity of the main shell and extends to the inner cavity of the butt joint shell, and the novel scheme can prevent a guide pin from being corroded and oxidized, prolongs the service life of the single-core armored cable plug, and is convenient to radiate and convenient to use.

title_en: Mounting structure for square radio frequency coaxial switch and PXI switch module
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mounting structure for a square radio frequency coaxial switch and a PXI switch module, which comprise a fixed base, a first fixing piece and a second fixing piece, wherein a first mounting hole parallel to a mounting seat of the square radio frequency coaxial switch and a second mounting hole perpendicular to the fixing hole of the square radio frequency coaxial switch are formed in the fixed base, the first fixing piece passes through the first mounting hole and the fixing hole on the mounting seat to fix the square radio frequency coaxial switch and the fixed base together, and the second fixing piece is used for fixing the fixed base on a radio frequency coaxial switch mounting groove plate of the PXI module through the second mounting hole. And a fixed base is added, so that the square radio frequency coaxial switch is fixed on the fixed base, and then the fixed base is fixed on a radio frequency coaxial switch mounting groove plate of the PXI switch module, so that the fixation of the square radio frequency coaxial switch is realized.

title_en: Intelligent circuit board with self-repairing function
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of circuit boards, in particular to an intelligent circuit board with a self-repairing function, which comprises a board body, a circuit component and a repairing component, the circuit assembly is welded at the top of the plate body, the repairing assembly is arranged at the bottom of the plate body, and one side of the plate body, which is close to the repairing assembly, is provided with a repairing flow channel. The repair assembly comprises a repair track, a repair sliding frame and a detection probe rod, wherein the repair track is symmetrically arranged at the bottom of the plate body, the repair sliding frame is in sliding connection with the repair track, the detection probe rod is arranged in the middle of the repair sliding frame, and the problems that an air conditioner circuit board in the prior art is frequently used, is easy to break down or is damaged in circuit, and needs to replace the whole circuit board are solved.

title_en: Earphone box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an earphone box, which comprises a base body and a cover body which is arranged on the base body in an openable mode, wherein a placement position for placing an earphone is arranged on the base body, the placement position is provided with a picking and placing side which faces the cover body, the cover body can rotate between an opening position and a closing position relative to the base body through a rotating assembly, the rotating assembly at least comprises an elastic piece which can provide the cover body with the cover body to be overturned and opened around the base body, the cover body is connected to the base body through an openable lock catch of a locking structure, mutual unlocking between the base body and the cover body is achieved through the locking structure, after unlocking, the cover body rotates around the base body, and the cover body is automatically overturned and opened by utilizing the elastic piece under the restoring force and is kept in the opening state, so that the picking and placing side faces one side of a user, the earphone is conveniently taken out of the placement position by the user, and the earphone box is simple in structure and convenient to operate.

title_en: Antireflection film
abstract_en: The application discloses an antireflection film, which has a basic film system structure of SUB/HC/(a  i Hb i L) n /AF m /AIR, i=1, 2.. The number of times, n, 1≤n≤5, m=0 or 1, wherein SUB represents a substrate layer, HC represents a hard coating layer, H represents a high refractive index layer, L represents a low refractive index layer and is selected from an organic material layer, AF represents an antifouling layer, AIR represents AIR, a  i 、b i  respectively represents a coefficient of 1/4 wavelength optical thickness, and n and m represent repeated periods.

title_en: Waterproof flexible earphone PCBA board
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waterproof flexible earphone PCBA board, which belongs to the technical field of PCBA boards and comprises a substrate, wherein an element block substrate is arranged on the substrate, waterproof layers are coated on the element blocks, an elastic part is arranged between the substrates, the bottoms of the substrates are electrically connected through flexible flat cables, a wire supporting frame is arranged outside the flexible flat cables, the elastic part comprises a bottom plate fixed on the substrate, one end of the bottom plate is fixedly provided with an inclined folded plate, an elastic rubber piece is connected between the inclined folded plates, a shrinkage notch is formed in the bottom of the elastic rubber piece, the elastic part is positioned on two sides above the wire supporting frame, the substrate is provided with more than three, a pair of substrates further comprises fixing rods fixed on the substrate, the top ends of the fixing rods extend obliquely upwards, two fixing rods are arranged on the substrate on the same side, and shaft rods are connected between the fixing rods.

title_en: Camera belt cleaning device and control circuit thereof
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a camera cleaning device, which comprises a camera body and window glass, wherein the cleaning device can automatically clean the window glass of the camera by using fresh water, and comprises a cleaning mechanism and a spraying mechanism, the cleaning mechanism comprises a cleaning motor, an elastic connecting piece, a swinging arm and a scraping blade, the cleaning motor is arranged in the camera body, the output end of the cleaning motor is connected with the swinging arm and drives the swinging arm to swing reciprocally, the scraping blade is connected onto the swinging arm through the elastic connecting piece, the scraping blade is pressed onto the window glass of the camera, and the spraying mechanism can spray the fresh water onto the window glass of the camera.

title_en: Dismounting structure for circuit board carrier
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a disassembly and assembly structure for a circuit board carrier, which belongs to the technical field of circuit board manufacture and comprises two groups of mounting seats, a circuit board body and a disassembly and assembly, wherein the disassembly and assembly comprises a fixing seat, a first channel is formed in one side of the fixing seat, a transverse block is arranged on one side of the fixing seat and positioned at the top of one group of the mounting seats, a second channel is formed in one side of the transverse block, a mounting block is arranged at a position corresponding to one side of the fixing seat, a third channel is formed in one side of the mounting block, and a sliding mechanism is arranged between the other side of the mounting block and the tops of the two groups of the mounting seats.

title_en: Network equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses network equipment, and relates to the technical field of antennas. The volume of the network device is intended to be reduced. The network equipment comprises a shell, a single board, a conductive bracket, an antenna and an electric connecting piece. The single board is positioned in the shell. The conductive bracket is used for supporting the shell and is electrically isolated from the shell. The conductive bracket is electrically connected with the single board through the electric connecting piece. The antenna includes a feeding portion for feeding a radiator and a radiator. The conductive bracket is used as the radiator, and the electric connector is used as the feed part. The conductive bracket supporting the shell is used as a radiator of the antenna, so that the performance of the antenna can be improved under the condition of not increasing the size of the whole antenna. The performance of the antenna does not change with the change of the size of the single board, and the antenna has universality. The network device may be a router, which may be applicable to fiber-to-room scenarios, etc.

title_en: Sound equipment based on infrared identification automatically regulated volume
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sound box capable of automatically adjusting volume based on infrared identification, which relates to the field of sound boxes, and comprises a sound box outer cover, a sound box body and a sound box screen plate, wherein one side of the sound box body is provided with a mounting groove for mounting the sound box screen plate, the utility model discloses a sound equipment enclosing cover, including stereo set enclosing cover, sound equipment enclosing cover outer wall has seted up the spacing groove, sound equipment enclosing cover both sides activity is provided with multiunit block subassembly, block subassembly is including outer pole, knob and horizontal pole, outer pole one side is fixed with the knob. According to the utility model, the problem that the outer cover of the sound equipment is troublesome to detach is solved through the clamping assembly, when the sound equipment needs to be maintained and cleaned, the knob is rotated, the outer rod is driven to rotate when the knob rotates, the cross rod can be driven to rotate by the outer rod, when the cross rod rotates, the rubber pad sleeved on the surface of the cross rod can be extruded to deform, and after the rubber pad rotates to a certain angle, the rubber pad can be attached to the limiting groove on the outer wall of the outer cover of the sound equipment, so that the friction force between the outer rod and the outer cover of the sound equipment is increased, and the outer rod cannot easily move through the rubber pad.

title_en: Neck hanging fan
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a neck hanging fan which comprises a shell, a fan and a circuit component, wherein the shell comprises a connecting part and two mounting parts which are respectively arranged at two ends of the connecting part, the two mounting parts are oppositely arranged, an air channel and an electric control cavity are arranged in the mounting parts, the air channel and the electric control cavity are separated by a partition plate, the mounting parts are also provided with a first air outlet and an air inlet, the first air outlet and the air inlet are both communicated with the air channel, the partition plate is provided with a vent, the vent penetrates through the partition plate, the electric control cavity is communicated with the air channel through the vent, the cavity wall of the electric control cavity is provided with a heat dissipation outlet, the electric control cavity is communicated with the external environment through the heat dissipation outlet, the fan is rotatably arranged in the air channel and used for driving external air flow to flow out from the air outlet after flowing into the air channel through the air inlet, and the circuit component is arranged in the electric control cavity and is electrically connected with the fan. According to the technical scheme, the neck hanging fan can improve heat dissipation performance.

title_en: Foldable electronic equipment and bending structure
abstract_en: The application provides a foldable electronic device and a bending structure, the foldable electronic device comprises a flexible circuit board, a rotating shaft mechanism, a first middle frame and a second middle frame. The flexible circuit board can penetrate through the rotating shaft mechanism along the first direction, so that part of the flexible circuit board is positioned in the rotating shaft mechanism. The first middle frame and the second middle frame are respectively positioned at two sides of the rotating shaft mechanism in the first direction, and are respectively connected with the rotating shaft mechanism in a rotating way. According to the application, the first middle frame is thinned to a certain height by changing the matching relation between the first middle frame and the first pressing support, so that the first middle frame has a step structure, the first connecting part of the first pressing support is conveniently overlapped with the first middle frame, the thickness dimension of the foldable electronic equipment in the second direction is reduced, and the thinning trend of the whole thickness of the foldable electronic equipment is further realized.

title_en: Fixed frequency circuit board
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fixed-frequency circuit board in the technical field of circuit boards, which comprises a first circuit board, wherein a limiting block is arranged at the top of the first circuit board, the limiting block is fixedly connected with the first circuit board, a sliding plate is arranged in the limiting block, the sliding plate is in sliding connection with the limiting block, a limiting plate is arranged on one side of the sliding plate, the limiting plate is fixedly connected with the sliding plate, a compression spring is arranged between the limiting block and the limiting plate, the compression spring is fixedly connected with the limiting plate, a mounting plate is arranged on the surface of the limiting plate, the mounting plate is detachably connected with the limiting plate, a connecting block is arranged on one side of the sliding plate, and a connecting plate is arranged at the top of the connecting block.

title_en: Industrial automation wireless sensing network device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an industrial automation wireless sensor network device, and relates to the technical field of industrial automation. The utility model relates to an industrial automatic wireless sensing network device, which comprises a wireless sensing network device main body and an air filter screen main body, wherein fixing blocks are fixedly arranged at the upper ends of the left side and the right side of the wireless sensing network device main body, a placement frame is fixedly connected with the lower ends of the left side and the right side of the wireless sensing network device main body, heat dissipation grids are arranged on the outer sides of the placement frame, connecting plates are movably arranged at the tops of the placement frame, and the bottoms of the connecting plates are fixedly connected with supports in the placement frame.

title_en: Energy storage heat management system and energy storage heat exchange unit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an energy storage heat management system and an energy storage heat exchange unit, wherein the energy storage heat management system comprises a plate heat exchanger, a first variable frequency compressor, a first condenser assembly, a first drying filter and a first electronic expansion valve which are sequentially connected through fluorine pipes to form a first refrigeration cycle loop, the plate heat exchanger, a second variable frequency compressor, a second condenser assembly, a second drying filter and a second electronic expansion valve are sequentially connected through fluorine pipes to form a second refrigeration cycle loop, a water return pipe, a water tank, a pressure container, a circulating water pump, the plate heat exchanger, a PTC heater and a water outlet pipe are sequentially connected through water pipes to form a water cycle loop, and the energy storage heat management system further comprises an electric cabinet, wherein the electric cabinet controls the first refrigeration cycle loop, the second refrigeration cycle loop and the water cycle loop to work. The utility model adopts two variable frequency compressors to respectively realize two refrigeration circulation loops, increases the refrigeration capacity range and the refrigeration range of the system, and improves the cooling speed of the system.

title_en: Master control circuit board cuts out board ware
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a master control circuit board cutting device, which belongs to the field of circuit board processing devices and comprises a base, wherein upright posts are arranged at four corners of the bottom end of the base, a first mounting plate and a second mounting plate are respectively and fixedly arranged at two sides of the base, a first air cylinder is fixedly arranged at the top end of the first mounting plate, a pushing limiting assembly is arranged at the end part of a piston shaft of the first air cylinder, a supporting frame is fixedly arranged at the top end of the base, a through groove is formed in the top end of the base, the through groove is positioned below the supporting frame, a ranging assembly is arranged between the second mounting plate and the supporting frame, and a clamping assembly is arranged in the supporting frame. The utility model plays a role in limiting and positioning the circuit board by pushing the setting of the limiting component, is favorable for keeping the stability of the movement of the circuit board, plays a role in clamping and fixing the circuit board by the setting of the clamping component, and is favorable for keeping the stability of the circuit board during cutting.

title_en: Forced air cooling structure of high radiating fin
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of forced air cooling structures of high radiating fins, in particular to a forced air cooling structure of a high radiating fin, which can greatly improve the radiating efficiency of the structure after forced air cooling intervention of a fan.

title_en: Suspension door with wisdom recognition function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a floating door with an intelligent recognition function, which comprises a floating door body and a control system, wherein the control system comprises a face recognition module, a control module, a remote communication module and a communication module, the face recognition module, the remote communication module and the communication module are all connected with the control module, the control module is connected with a driving motor of the floating door body, the control module controls the driving motor to open or close the floating door body, the face recognition module and the remote communication module are both arranged on a door frame of the floating door body, and the control module is connected with a monitoring terminal in a control room through the communication module. The floating door with the intelligent recognition function provided by the utility model has the functions of automatic release and remote control of face recognition and high automation and intelligent degree.
