title_en: Monitoring system for controlled landslide
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of landslide treatment monitoring and monitoring, and particularly discloses a landslide treatment monitoring system which comprises a treated landslide, wherein a rain gauge, a crack gauge, a displacement gauge and a data acquisition instrument are sequentially arranged on the top surface of a treated landslide section, two displacement gauges, a soil moisture gauge and an inclinometer are sequentially arranged on the surface of the slope of the treated landslide section, a video monitor is arranged at the bottom of the treated landslide section, the rain gauge, the crack gauge, the displacement gauge, the soil moisture gauge, the inclinometer and the video monitor are connected with the data acquisition instrument through wires, and the data acquisition instrument is connected with a communication base station through signal transmission.

title_en: A multilayer circuit board for new energy automobile BMS
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multilayer circuit board for a BMS of a new energy automobile, which comprises a substrate, wherein a group of golden fingers are movably inserted and installed on the front side and the rear side of the substrate respectively, a group of outer plates are respectively and adhesively installed on the upper end and the lower end of the substrate, welding grooves are formed in the outer sides of the outer plates, a group of first positioning frames are movably installed on the outer sides of each group of outer plates, and a fan module is embedded in the middle of each first positioning frame. Through come spacing to first locating rack in planking outside installation limiting plate, make the staff can select fan module mounted position to the heat concentration district when the use of circuit board, come the pertinence to cool down the processing to the circuit board, make the circuit board can keep high-efficient use frequency, and the welding groove of planking surface seting up, make each inseparable original paper can be located the inside welding of welding groove, avoid in the use or carry in-process welded electrical components and external friction and lead to the welding point to appear damaging, further promote circuit board safety in utilization.

title_en: Outdoor photovoltaic inverter
abstract_en: The utility model provides an outdoor photovoltaic inverter, which belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic inverters, and structurally comprises an outer box group, wherein a flow guide plate is transversely arranged in the middle of a cavity of the outer box group, an inverter main body is arranged on the top surface of the flow guide plate in a suspended manner, a heat radiation assembly is arranged in the middle of the bottom surface of the flow guide plate in a communicating manner, the lower end of the heat radiation assembly is communicated with the bottom of the cavity of the outer box group, a current collection exhaust group is arranged above the inverter main body, air pumped in during heat radiation of the device can be filtered first, and then the filtered air can be blown to the front, rear, left, right and lower sides of the inverter main body in a targeted manner through guiding and shunting of the flow guide plate to perform active air blowing and heat radiation, and the current collection exhaust group is used for performing active air suction above the inverter main body and also can be used for extracting heat energy from the top surface of the inverter main body, so that all sides of the inverter main body perform active air blowing and the heat radiation is more uniform and efficient, and has strong practicability.

title_en: Portable chip pressing device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a portable chip pressing device which comprises a supporting seat, a base, a connector, a pressing rod and a pressing unit, wherein the base is detachably connected with the supporting seat, the connector is arranged at the bottom of the base and forms a containing position with the base, the pressing rod is rotatably arranged on the supporting seat, a first arc pressing angle and a second arc pressing angle are arranged at the first end of the pressing rod, which is close to a rotation axis of the pressing rod, the pressing rod is provided with a decompression position and a pressing position, the pressing unit is movably connected with the supporting seat in the height direction of the supporting seat, the pressing unit is provided with a follower wheel, when the pressing rod rotates from the decompression position to the pressing position, the follower wheel is meshed with the first arc pressing angle to the second arc pressing angle, and the pressing unit is forced to move towards the base. The chip detection system is provided with the portable chip pressing device, and the device is convenient to operate, labor-saving, long in service life and good in chip pressing stability.

title_en: Displacement sedimentation monitoring device convenient to maintain
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of settlement monitoring equipment and discloses a displacement settlement monitoring device convenient to maintain, which comprises an upper shell, and further comprises a lower shell arranged at the bottom of the upper shell, wherein the bottom of the lower shell is fixedly connected with a fixed block, the fixed block is fixedly connected with a fixed belt through a bolt, the fixed belt is fixedly arranged on a tower body which needs to be fixed outside, the upper shell is of a polycarbonate shell structure, the top of the lower shell is provided with an installation cavity, firstly, the upper shell is made of polycarbonate, the displacement settlement monitoring device has good corrosion resistance and impact resistance, and can adapt to the work of various outdoor environments, a slide block integrally formed at the bottom of the installation block enters a slide groove formed in the lower shell through a limiting hole, and the slide block is abutted against a limiting block by rotating a shell, and is secondarily fixed through the bolt, so that the installation and the disassembly are more convenient, and workers can quickly maintain and maintain the device.

title_en: PCB crimping jig
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of crimping jigs and discloses a PCB crimping jig which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a PCB is arranged on the upper surface of the bottom plate, a first rotating seat and a second rotating seat are arranged on one side of the upper surface of the bottom plate, crimping assemblies for crimping the PCB are arranged in the first rotating seat and the second rotating seat, each crimping assembly comprises a connecting shaft, the outer wall of each connecting shaft is arranged in the first rotating seat and the second rotating seat in a penetrating mode, and a rotating frame is fixedly connected to the outer wall of each connecting shaft. According to the utility model, the positioning column penetrates through the inner wall of the PCB, the PCB can be accurately positioned, the position of the PCB on the bottom plate is ensured to be accurate, the compression joint assemblies in the first rotating seat and the second rotating seat work cooperatively through the connecting shaft, the rotating frame and the pressing plate to realize stable compression joint, the mounting groove provides a mounting space for the pressing plate and allows the pressing plate to slide, the compression joint accuracy is ensured, and the production efficiency and the connection quality are improved.

title_en: Data acquisition storage device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses data acquisition and storage equipment which comprises an installation assembly, wherein the installation assembly comprises limiting plates, movable grooves, installation grooves and guide plates, the limiting plates are fixed on the inner surface of the top end of the network data processing and storage equipment, the limiting plates are provided with four groups in total, the movable grooves are formed in the four corners of a cover plate, the installation grooves are formed in any group of the limiting plates, and the guide plates are movably connected in the movable grooves and the installation grooves. According to the utility model, through the installation assembly, when the equipment is required to be disassembled, the outwards pulling force is applied to the guide plate, the limit column is driven to slide in the limit groove, when the magnet column moves to the outer side of the installation groove, the guide plate is attached to the surfaces of the installation groove and the movable groove, the cover plate can be disassembled by applying the upward force to the cover plate, and the equipment can be disassembled without disassembling parts on the equipment, so that the equipment can be disassembled and assembled efficiently.

title_en: Telescopic positioning frame and electronic screen
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model provides a telescopic positioning frame and an electronic screen, the electronic screen comprises a telescopic positioning frame and a screen body arranged on the telescopic positioning frame. The telescopic positioning frame comprises a frame body and telescopic positioning components, wherein the frame body is provided with two opposite side surfaces, the telescopic positioning components comprise telescopic components and limiting components which are matched with each other, one side surface is provided with the telescopic components, the other side surface is provided with the limiting components, and the telescopic components can be switched between a first state limited by the limiting components and a second state separated from the limiting components. When the downstream electronic screen is installed, the telescopic component can be operated to be switched to a first state locked with the limiting component on the upstream electronic screen so as to limit the position of the downstream electronic screen and facilitate the locking with the upstream electronic screen. When one of the electronic screens needs to be disassembled, the telescopic component is operated to be switched to a second state separated from the limiting component while the locking component is operated to be unlocked, and at the moment, the electronic screen can be taken down for maintenance, so that the operation is convenient.

title_en: Electronic equipment, display screen assembly, supporting assembly and reinforcing plate
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides electronic equipment, a display screen assembly, a support assembly and a reinforcing plate, relates to the technical field of electronic equipment, and aims to solve the problems of bright spots and poor black spots of the display screen. The electronic equipment comprises a display screen, a supporting piece, a reinforcing plate and a rotating shaft mechanism which are arranged in a stacked mode. The support is arranged on the side facing away from the light emitting surface of the display screen. The support piece comprises a bendable part, a first non-bending part and a second non-bending part. The bendable part is arranged opposite to the rotating shaft mechanism. The bendable portion includes a first region including a first opening. The rotating shaft mechanism comprises a rotating shaft door plate, and the rotating shaft door plate comprises a second area opposite to the first area. The second region includes a second aperture. The first region is opposite to the second region. The stiffening plate includes a first portion. The first portion is disposed between the first region and the second region in a stacked manner, and the first portion is configured to cover the first aperture and the second aperture. The electronic equipment can improve the situation of bright spots and bad black spots of the display screen.

title_en: Cushion with Tifo picture and text show function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a cushion with Tifo graphic display function, which consists of four small plates with the same size, wherein the cushion body is provided with cross folds, the four small plates are respectively positioned at four corners of the cross folds and connected by the cross folds, the four small plates can be folded up and down and left and right twice by the cross folds, and the inner side of each small plate is provided with a transparent display bag for placing a drawing. The cushion with Tifo image-text display function has the advantages of simple structure, low cost, portability, high practicability and the like, is convenient for users to use as a multi-size cushion in activities such as sports events, concerts and the like, is convenient for carrying out diversified Tifo display, and is beneficial to promoting the development of Tifo culture and the successful holding of various activities of assistance.

title_en: Digital video monitoring tester suitable for high-definition network camera
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a digital video monitoring tester suitable for a high-definition network camera, which belongs to the technical field of monitoring testers and comprises a monitoring tester body, wherein two side plates are symmetrically and fixedly arranged at the back of the monitoring tester body, the inner walls of the two side plates are fixedly connected with connecting rods, torsion springs are sleeved on the outer edges of the connecting rods, the outer edges of the connecting rods are rotatably connected with supporting plates, the device can be held to different using places by the supporting plates in a hand manner through matching with holding grooves, a pulling plate can drive a bolt to drag a moving disc to move on the inner wall of a containing groove, further, the movement of the bolt close to one end of a slope can be realized until the bolt is separated from the inner wall of a positioning hole, and the supporting plates can be rotated to an unfolding state by means of the acting force of the torsion springs, so that the monitoring tester body can be supported by the supporting plates, the monitoring tester body can be conveniently placed in an inclined state, and the content displayed by the monitoring tester body can be conveniently observed.

title_en: Wireless charging base
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of wireless charging equipment and discloses a wireless charging base, which comprises a charging seat and a placing seat, wherein one end of the charging seat is connected with the placing seat through a rotating shaft, a sinkable avoiding pad is arranged on the upper surface of the charging seat, a heat dissipation mechanism is arranged in the placing seat and used for reducing the temperature of the charging seat, the heat dissipation mechanism comprises a diversion trench, an air inlet hole and an exhaust fan, the diversion trench is arranged on the surface of the placing seat and penetrates through two sides of the surface of the placing seat, and the air inlet hole is arranged at the bottom of the placing seat and is communicated with the diversion trench. The utility model provides a wireless charging base, wherein an avoidance pad is arranged on a charging seat, when a mobile phone is placed on the charging seat for charging, if a mobile phone module is large, the avoidance pad can be pressed down, so that the back surface of the mobile phone is better attached to the charging seat, and the charging efficiency is improved.

title_en: Charging box and electronic product suite
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a charging box and an electronic product kit, and relates to the field of charging accessories, wherein the charging box comprises a first box part, a second box part, a power supply component and a wireless charging component, wherein the second box part is provided with a containing cavity for containing a first product to be charged, the first box part is movably connected with the second box part to open or close the containing cavity, the power supply component is arranged in the containing cavity and is used for supplying power for the first product to be charged, and the wireless charging component is integrated in the first box part and is electrically connected with the power supply component to be used for supplying power for a second product to be charged. The electronic product kit comprises a product body and the charging box, wherein the product body forms the first product to be charged.

title_en: Waterproof liquid crystal display
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waterproof liquid crystal display screen, which comprises a liquid crystal display screen body, wherein a back reinforcing plate is fixedly arranged on the back of the liquid crystal display screen body, a waterproof mechanism for waterproofing is arranged outside the liquid crystal display screen body, a reinforcing mechanism for preventing the waterproof mechanism from leaking water due to gaps is arranged at the outer corner position of the waterproof mechanism, and a locking mechanism for preventing the reinforcing mechanism from being separated from the corner of the waterproof mechanism is arranged between the back reinforcing plate and the reinforcing mechanism. The waterproof mechanism is arranged outside the liquid crystal display screen body, so that external water stains can be prevented from entering the liquid crystal display screen body, the reinforcing mechanism is arranged at four corners of the waterproof mechanism, loosening of the waterproof mechanism can be prevented, and the locking mechanism arranged between the back reinforcing plate and the reinforcing mechanism can be used for reinforcing the reinforcing mechanism for the second time, so that the liquid crystal display screen body can be effectively protected from water in a double protection mode.

title_en: Electrical stimulation therapeutic instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric stimulation therapeutic apparatus, which relates to the technical field of medical appliances and comprises an upper protective shell (4) and a lower protective shell (1) which are connected with each other and internally form a cavity, a circuit board (2) and a storage battery (3) which are connected in the cavity, and a mounting frame body (8) which is detachably connected with the outer surface of the upper protective shell (4), wherein the mounting frame body (8) is provided with a mounting groove at one side far away from the upper protective shell (4), a fixing plate (9) is connected in the mounting groove, the fixing plate (9) is provided with a groove at one side far away from the upper protective shell (4), the inner wall of the groove is connected with an elastic device, the elastic force of the elastic device is perpendicular to the inner wall of the groove, and a display screen (13) is arranged in the groove and the side wall of the display screen is in compression connection with the elastic device. Touch display screen is dismantled with the casing and is connected in this electric stimulation therapeutic instrument, when the display screen appears damaging, can directly dismantle the display screen and change and not fragile.

title_en: Anticollision structure of transformer rectifier for loom
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-collision structure of a transformer rectifier for a loom, which relates to the technical field of rectifiers and has the technical scheme that the anti-collision structure comprises a protection shell, wherein an opening is formed in the top of the protection shell, an anti-collision top plate is covered on the opening, a protective cover is arranged between the anti-collision top plate and the top of the protection shell, the protective cover has plastic deformation performance, the bottom of the anti-collision top plate is connected with an X-shaped folding frame in a sliding manner, a sliding groove is formed in the inner side wall of the protection shell, a damper is arranged in the sliding groove, and a rotating shaft of the X-shaped folding frame is fixedly connected with an outer shell of the damper. According to the anti-collision structure of the transformer rectifier for the loom, the protection effect of the rectifier is improved through the anti-collision structure, equipment damage caused by external collision is reduced, and the stability and the service life of the rectifier are improved.

title_en: Spliced LED display screen
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a LED display screen technical field, an embodiment of the disclosure provides a concatenation formula LED display screen, including the splice plate, the top of splice plate is provided with diversified splicing apparatus, the recess is seted up on the top of splice plate, the jack has been seted up to the side of recess, another embodiment of the disclosure provides a concatenation formula LED display screen in problem, still includes the side of jack is located the displacement orbit of picture peg. The alignment design of the jack side surface and the plugboard displacement track is beneficial to improving the precision, stability and use convenience of the system. Through above-mentioned technical scheme, the problem of LED display screen in the prior art can't diversified concatenation has been solved.

title_en: Multifunctional accompanying and diagnosing identification tool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional accompanying and diagnosis tool, which belongs to the technical field of medical appliances, solves the problems that the prior device displays limited information, and a bracelet is worn on the wrist of a patient and is inconvenient for medical staff to read, and comprises a mounting plate, wherein the top surface and the bottom surface of the mounting plate are both provided with fixing components, the top of the front side of the mounting plate is fixedly provided with an LED electronic display screen, the bottom of the front side of the mounting plate is fixedly provided with uniformly distributed notepaper boxes, the middle part fixed mounting of LED electronic display screen top surface has the mount pad, rectangular groove has been seted up to the front side of mount pad, rectangular groove inside is provided with the battery, LED electronic display screen is linked together with the battery through the wire, can show different patient's identity information and accompany the diagnosis progress etc. through LED electronic display screen to medical personnel read patient's information fast, are favorable to avoiding the patient to be collided by the people and fall down the injured condition and take place.

title_en: Weather information broadcasting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a weather information broadcasting device, which belongs to the technical field of weather broadcasting, wherein a broadcasting sound box is connected with a printing plate Bluetooth in a screen shell through a wireless technology, a through groove is formed in the outer side of a storage type mounting frame, a plurality of wire body storage devices are arranged in a cavity of a storage cavity, an expansion data wire is connected in each wire body storage device, passes through the through groove and is connected with the broadcasting sound box in a wired mode, and the plurality of expansion data wires are arranged in a surrounding mode. The storage type mounting frame of design allows broadcasting sound equipment to be easily installed and detached, and flexibility and maintainability are improved. The user can add or remove devices as required to adapt to different scenes. The accommodating cavity and the wire body accommodating device ensure that the wire cable is orderly fixed, so that abrasion and faults are reduced, and the service life is prolonged. The plurality of broadcasting sound boxes are arranged in a surrounding mode, comprehensive audio coverage is provided, and the clear hearing of information at all positions of a user is ensured. This design enhances the user experience and device applicability.

title_en: Temperature regulation and control device for testing photovoltaic garden lamp
abstract_en: The utility model provides a temperature regulation and control device for testing a photovoltaic garden lamp, which belongs to the technical field of temperature regulation and control and comprises a first shell, a supporting seat, compressors, a movable structure and a protection structure, wherein the supporting seat is fixed on two sides of the bottom end of the first shell, the compressors are arranged at the bottom end inside the first shell, the movable structure comprises a connecting frame fixed on one side of a wind guide port, a housing sleeved on the outer side of the movable seat, and a power assembly arranged inside the housing, and the protection structure is arranged at the bottom end of a second shell. According to the utility model, the screw is driven by the driving motor to rotate, so that the movable seat drives the air guide opening to move up and down, and the pneumatic push rod extends to further move the position of the air guide opening, thereby realizing the wind direction adjusting function of the device, ensuring that the photovoltaic garden lamp is heated uniformly, reducing the thermal stress of materials caused by temperature difference, being beneficial to more accurately evaluating the performance of the lamp under different temperature conditions, and further ensuring the reliability of test results.

title_en: Motor simulator host and shell
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a motor simulator host and a shell, relates to the technical field of motor simulators, and in particular relates to a motor simulator host, wherein the motor simulator host consists of a plurality of simulation mainboards, and a heat radiating unit is arranged at the bottom of each simulation mainboard; the radiating unit comprises a radiating bracket which is detachably connected to the bottom of the simulated main board, one side of the radiating bracket is clamped with radiating fins, the top of each radiating fin is fixedly connected with a heat conducting strip, and the heat conducting strips extend to the central position of the radiating bracket and are in interference fit with the simulated main board. The motor simulator host and the shell are characterized in that the host dissipates heat through a plurality of heat dissipation units, when the heat dissipation is carried out, firstly, heat conduction strips transfer heat to the heat dissipation fins, the heat dissipation fan works to drive air flows to meet, air-cooled heat dissipation is carried out on the heat dissipation fins and the heat conduction strips, a certain number of heat dissipation holes can be opened according to use requirements when the heat dissipation is carried out, and when the heat dissipation is not needed, the magnetic attraction baffle can be capped on the heat dissipation holes for blocking.

title_en: Electromagnetic transmitter with magnetic shielding function and electromagnetic induction eddy current heating function and electronic cigarette containing electromagnetic transmitter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electromagnetic transmitter for electromagnetic induction eddy current heating with magnetic shielding, which comprises a magnetic shielding cover (1), a coil (2) and a coil bracket (3), wherein the coil (2) comprises a coil main body (21) formed by wires and a pair of coil pins (22), the coil bracket (3) comprises a bracket wall (31) connected with each other, a bracket bottom (32) positioned at the lower end of the bracket wall (31) and a pin through hole (33), the coil main body (21) is arranged on the coil bracket (3), the coil pins (22) penetrate out of the pin through holes (33), and the coil main body (21) is positioned in a coil space (14) surrounded by the coil bracket (3) and the magnetic shielding cover (1). The electromagnetic transmitter provided by the utility model has the advantages of simplifying the structure of the magnetic induction coil assembly, improving the magnetic shielding efficiency, being high in integration degree, being convenient for large-scale assembly production and effectively improving the production efficiency of electronic cigarette appliances.

title_en: Domestic lifting storage basket drag chain wiring structure
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of intelligent home furnishing, and discloses a drag chain wiring structure of a household lifting storage basket, which comprises a fixed frame body, a lifting movable basket body, a drag chain, a controller, a control terminal and electric equipment, wherein the fixed frame body is fixedly connected with a wall surface or a fixed plane, the lifting movable basket body is connected with the fixed frame body in a sliding manner, the lifting movable basket body moves up and down relative to the fixed frame body in a lifting manner, one end of the drag chain is fixed on the upper part of the fixed frame body, one end of the drag chain is fixed on the upper part of the lifting movable basket body, one end of the connecting wire is connected with the controller, the other end of the connecting wire penetrates through a channel in the drag chain and is electrically connected with the control terminal and the electric equipment on the lifting movable basket body, the drag chain and the connecting wire in the drag chain are arranged in a foldback line shape, an upward U-shaped bend with an opening is formed, and then the U-shaped bend is connected with the lifting movable basket body, and the lowest point of the U-shaped bend is lifted or lowered along with the lifting of a second frame body. The drag chain achieves the purpose that the connecting wire path is unique in the movement process, solves the problem that the connecting wire is knotted or wound in the lifting process of the lifting movable basket body, and improves the use feeling of a user.

title_en: Cabinet radiator fan with arc-shaped air outlet channel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cabinet cooling fan with an arc-shaped air outlet channel, which belongs to the technical field of cabinet cooling fans and comprises a cooling fan with a fixed outer frame, wherein a connecting channel is detachably arranged on one side of the fixed outer frame, a fixed end part is arranged on one side of the connecting channel, an arc-shaped channel is arranged on one side of the fixed end part, a flange clamp is arranged between the fixed end part and the arc-shaped channel and is fixedly connected with the fixed end part through the flange clamp, and a clamping groove for clamping the connecting channel is formed in the edge position of the fixed outer frame.

title_en: Lifting type man-vehicle verification data acquisition equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses lifting type man-vehicle verification data acquisition equipment which comprises a storage box, a man-vehicle verification mechanism and a lifting mechanism, wherein the man-vehicle verification mechanism comprises a camera and a control panel, the camera and the control panel are arranged in the storage box, the lifting mechanism is arranged in the storage box, the camera and the control panel are arranged on the lifting mechanism, and the lifting mechanism is used for extending the camera and the control panel out of the storage box. The lifting type human-vehicle verification data acquisition equipment can control automatic lifting of the human-vehicle verification mechanism through the lifting mechanism, and is convenient for storage, transportation and storage of the lifting type human-vehicle verification data acquisition equipment.

title_en: Breeze vibration on-line monitoring device for power transmission line
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an online monitoring device for breeze vibration of a power transmission line, which belongs to the technical field of power transmission line monitoring and comprises an upper shell and a lower shell, wherein a fixing assembly is arranged in the upper shell, and reinforcing assemblies are clamped on the left side and the right side of the upper shell and the right side of the lower shell. Through the fixed subassembly that sets up on the casing, can be in the same place electric wire and breeze vibration on-line monitoring device zonulae occludens, thereby guarantee that the device can not be by blowing askew blowing to incline in bad weather, guarantee its normal use, improve the degree of accuracy of monitoring result, pressure between electric wire and the arc cardboard can automatically regulated, improve frictional force through the mode of increasing pressure, thereby make the device be difficult for the slope or hang down on the electric wire, and through strengthening the subassembly, adjust fixed subassembly at the area of contact of installation with the power transmission line surface, can form the linkage effect with fixed subassembly cooperation, thereby further increase contact surface improves fixed effect, make the device more stable in the use.

title_en: Anti-static capacitance type level meter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-static capacitance type level meter, which relates to the field of level meters and aims at solving the problems that the existing capacitance type level meter is generally provided with a grounding wire, the capacitance type level meter is connected with the ground through the grounding wire, static electricity on the capacitance type level meter is led back to the earth, the anti-static effect of the capacitance type level meter is poor, the phenomenon of static electricity accumulation can occur in the use process, the capacitance type level meter is influenced and the use effect is reduced, the utility model discloses a level meter, including fixed plate, connecting convex ring, protection casing, sensing element pole subassembly, connecting convex ring, protection casing and earth connection, the top of fixed plate is provided with the level meter main part, be provided with the thread groove on the inner wall of protection casing lower extreme, protection casing and connecting convex ring threaded connection, one side of fixed plate is provided with the earth connection.

title_en: Wall-mounted sound equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wall-mounted sound box, which belongs to the technical field of sound equipment and comprises a fixed frame, wherein a lifting mechanism is arranged above the fixed frame, a protection component is arranged, a movable moving plate drives a fixed column to move and a return spring to compress, an external frame is moved and placed in a bottom frame, then a pull rod is loosened, the return spring loses the action of external force to restore the original appearance, the movable plate and the fixed column are driven to move, the fixed column is used for fixedly inserting the external frame and the bottom frame, the dismounting operation of a ventilation net is conveniently realized, a protection cover is moved to be attached to the top of the bottom frame, one of fixing nuts is rotated to be attached to the top wall of the protection cover, under the action of the bottom frame and the protection cover, protection operation can be provided for a motor, sundries such as dust in the external environment are prevented from falling onto the motor, and meanwhile, under the action of the ventilation net, the inside air circulation of the bottom frame and the protection cover is ensured, and the normal service life of the motor is ensured.

title_en: Quick connection structure of transparent screen die-casting box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quick connection structure of a transparent screen die-casting box body, which comprises a frame and a plurality of LED display modules, wherein the LED display modules are detachably arranged on the frame, a quick connection lock is arranged on the upper side of the frame, a connection part is arranged on the lower side of the frame, when two transparent screen die-casting box bodies are spliced together up and down, the quick connection lock of the lower transparent screen die-casting box body and the connection part of the upper transparent screen die-casting box body are detachably connected together, the quick connection lock comprises a hook, a handle and a locking mechanism, the lower end of the hook is connected with the upper end of the handle, the locking mechanism is arranged on the handle and matched with the hook and the handle, and can realize quick connection between the upper transparent screen die-casting box body and the lower transparent screen die-casting box body, so that the quick connection structure is relatively time-saving and labor-saving.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: The present utility model relates to a display device. The display device includes a display panel, a main frame to which the display panel is coupled, a rear cover coupled to the main frame and located at an opposite side of the display panel with respect to the main frame, a side frame covering a side of at least one of the display panel and the main frame, and an insertion coupler coupled to the side frame, the side frame including a coupling slot into which the insertion coupler is inserted, the insertion coupler including an insertion body inserted between the main frame and the rear cover through the coupling slot, and an outer wall forming an end of the insertion body covering the coupling slot. According to the display device of the present utility model, the support cover can be easily attached and detached.

title_en: LED screen convenient to installation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an LED screen convenient to install, which comprises a base and an LED screen, wherein a stand column is fixedly arranged in the middle of the outer surface of the upper end of the base, supporting legs are fixedly arranged on two sides of the outer surface of the lower end of the base, universal wheels are fixedly arranged on the outer surfaces of the lower ends of the supporting legs, a reinforcing block is fixedly arranged between the bottoms of the outer surfaces of the two sides of the stand column and the outer surface of the upper end of the base, a convex slot is formed in the top of the outer surface of the front end of the stand column, a locking hole is formed in the upper part of the outer surfaces of the two sides of the stand column, one end of the locking hole is communicated with the convex slot, a convex inserting block is fixedly arranged in the middle of the rear end of a frame body in the LED screen, and a locking structure is arranged in the middle of the outer surfaces of the two sides of the convex inserting block. According to the LED screen convenient to install, the convex inserting blocks and the convex inserting grooves are arranged, so that the LED screen is convenient to install in an inserting mode, the LED screen is convenient to detach, and the limiting after the convex inserting blocks are inserted is facilitated through the locking structure.

title_en: Ear hook, earphone and earphone assembly
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an ear hook, an earphone and an earphone assembly. The ear hook comprises a plastic deformation section and an elastic deformation section, wherein the plastic deformation section and the elastic deformation section are arranged in the extending direction of the ear hook, the plastic deformation section can be subjected to plastic deformation under the action of external force, and the elastic deformation section can be subjected to elastic deformation under the action of external force. Above-mentioned ear-hook can satisfy multiple deformation demand for earphone can adapt to different ear types better, and user's wearing experience is better.

title_en: Highway construction safety control system based on tethered unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safety management and control system for expressway construction based on a tethered unmanned aerial vehicle, which belongs to the field of expressway construction management and control and comprises the tethered unmanned aerial vehicle and a visual platform, wherein a communication module is arranged in the tethered unmanned aerial vehicle, a communication and data storage module is arranged in the visual platform, the tethered unmanned aerial vehicle is in communication connection with the visual platform, an intelligent monitoring and identification module, a high-precision measurement module, a topographic mapping module, a remote safety inspection module and a construction progress monitoring module are arranged in the tethered unmanned aerial vehicle, and a task management module, a task planning module, a traffic flow analysis module, an intelligent traffic flow analysis algorithm module, a construction quality management module, an early warning module, a remote control module, a thermal imaging linkage module and a voice interaction module are arranged in the visual platform. The utility model greatly increases the monitoring range, improves the working efficiency, and can rapidly deploy and realize automatic task scheduling.

title_en: PCB board resin hole plugging structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a PCB resin plug hole structure, which belongs to the technical field of PCB printed circuit boards and comprises a substrate layer and a via hole, wherein the via hole is formed in the substrate layer, a plug hole component is arranged in the substrate layer, a copper foil circuit is arranged on one side of the plug hole component, a bonding pad is arranged on one side of the copper foil circuit, and a solder mask layer is arranged on the surface of the substrate layer. According to the utility model, under the combined action of the hole plugging component, the mounting groove, the bonding PAD and the solder mask, the via hole and the copper foil circuit are positioned at the bottom of the solder mask, and the via hole and the hole plugging resin are protected by the solder mask when the surface of the solder mask is welded, so that the SMT welding is prevented from being influenced by oil leakage, the via hole and the copper foil circuit are positioned in the substrate layer and are protected by the solder mask, the hole plugging resin is prevented from being exposed to oxygen for a long time, the service life of the via hole and the hole plugging resin is prolonged, the PAD is formed by the hole surface covers at the two ends of the fixing ring, and the hole surface covers can be connected with the bonding PAD as shown in fig. 6, so that the mounting flexibility of the PCB is increased.

title_en: Handheld rotary table based on persistence of vision principle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a handheld turntable based on a persistence of vision principle, which relates to the technical field of education display and comprises a turntable and a display mechanism, wherein a supporting mechanism is arranged below the turntable, a rotating mechanism is arranged between the turntable and the supporting mechanism, the display mechanism is arranged at the top end of the turntable and is used for displaying the persistence of vision principle, the display mechanism comprises a slot, the slot is arranged at the top end of the turntable, and the inner wall of the slot is movably inserted and connected with a card. The utility model uses the arrangement of the slot and the card to insert the card with the pattern into the slot, then the turntable rotates by the cooperation of the rotating mechanism, thereby driving the card inserted into the slot to rotate, along with the rotation of the card, the child can always see the image on the card in one direction, thereby clearly knowing the principle of persistence of vision, being easy to operate and convenient to carry, and having both interactivity and education.

title_en: Heat abstractor is arranged to power module busbar
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a power assembly busbar heat dissipation device, and relates to the technical field of power electronic devices. The device comprises a busbar, a water cooling plate and a power assembly, wherein the busbar comprises a first busbar and a second busbar, the water cooling plate comprises a first water cooling plate and a second water cooling plate, the first water cooling plate is arranged between the power assembly and the first busbar, and the second water cooling plate is arranged between the second busbar and the first busbar. The utility model provides a busbar heat dissipation device for a power component, which is characterized in that a busbar is directly contacted with a water cooling plate through the arrangement of the busbar and the water cooling plate, so that the busbar heat dissipation efficiency can be accelerated, and the water cooling plate is close to the power component at the same time, so that the direct heat dissipation of the power component can be accelerated.

title_en: Auxiliary management component for server operation and maintenance
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of servers and discloses an operation and maintenance auxiliary management assembly of a server, which comprises a cabinet, wherein a transparent baffle door is hinged to the front side of the cabinet in a sealing manner, a heat dissipation assembly is arranged in the cabinet, the heat dissipation assembly comprises a circulation assembly capable of driving air in the cabinet to circulate and a cooling assembly capable of cooling the air, the circulation assembly comprises a guide fan connected to the top of the cabinet, the guide fan drives the air in the cabinet to circulate, the cooling assembly comprises a heat conduction pipe extending to the lower part of the guide fan in the cabinet, the end part of the heat conduction pipe is connected with a heat dissipation pipe extending out of the cabinet and used for dissipating heat, and the back side of the cabinet is connected with a plurality of positioning assemblies capable of positioning and accommodating cables. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages of facilitating heat dissipation under the condition of avoiding external dust introduction, facilitating positioning and storage of cables and avoiding safety risks.

title_en: Circuit manufacturing plate structure of integrated monitoring module
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a circuit manufacturing plate structure of an integrated monitoring module, which belongs to the technical field of circuit boards and comprises a protection box, wherein a pair of limiting frames are fixedly connected to the bottom of the protection box, and a circuit board is arranged between the pair of limiting frames. The circuit board protection box is provided with the protection box, the limiting frame and the box cover, the circuit board is placed on the limiting frame in the protection box, the limiting frame can transversely limit the circuit board, the damage to the element caused by shaking is prevented, the box cover can be opened and closed at the top of the protection box, the box cover is matched with the protection box to block external interference, the circuit board is prevented from being scratched by daily slight touch, the stable signal transmission is effectively ensured, the limiting assembly and the transmission assembly are arranged, when the box cover is rotated and closed, the linked transmission assembly skillfully operates, the limiting assembly is driven to work, the limiting block rapidly slides out of the limiting frame and is stably blocked at the top of the circuit board, the circuit board can be further stabilized, the circuit board is prevented from being damaged in the protection box due to vibration or displacement, and the integral reliability of equipment is improved.

title_en: Precise positioning device for circuit board element arrangement
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a circuit board element arrangement precise positioning device, which relates to the technical field of precise machinery manufacturing and comprises a main board, wherein a plurality of sliding rails are fixedly connected to the top outer wall of the main board, a positioning mechanism is arranged on the outer wall of the main board, the positioning mechanism comprises a motor board, the outer wall of the motor board is fixedly connected with the outer wall of the main board, a controller is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the motor board, a self-locking motor is fixedly connected to the outer wall of one end of the motor board, which is close to the controller, and a buffer mechanism is arranged on the outer wall of the main board.

title_en: Cabinet with high heat dissipation performance
abstract_en: The cabinet with high heat dissipation performance comprises a frame, cabinet doors, side plates, a bottom plate, mounting plates, a power distribution system and a heat dissipation system, wherein the cabinet doors are arranged on the front side and the rear side of the frame, the side plates are arranged on the two sides of the frame, the bottom plate is arranged at the bottom end of the frame, the mounting plates are arranged in the frame, the power distribution system is fixed on the cabinet doors on the rear side, the top end of the heat dissipation system is arranged on the top end of the frame, and the side ends of the heat dissipation system are fixed on the side plates. The heat dissipation system comprises a fan system, a longitudinal air pipe and a longitudinal transverse air outlet. Compared with the prior art, the novel cooling system has the advantages that the novel cooling system is designed, the longitudinal air pipes are utilized to introduce fresh air into the transverse air outlets, and fresh air can be injected into gaps among equipment with different heights in the cabinet, so that the cooling treatment effect of the equipment is achieved.

title_en: Portable cable insulation fault quick positioning instrument
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of cable fault positioning, and discloses a portable cable insulation fault rapid positioning instrument which comprises a first shell, wherein one side of the first shell is rotatably connected with a first elastic wristband through a rotating shaft. This quick locater of portable cable insulation trouble, the user can wear this locater on the arm firmly through first elasticity wrist strap, and can let the user install equipment on the waistband or other portable device firmly through the first clip of first casing one end, further increased the convenience of use, when the user need carry out insulation trouble location to the cable, only need the simple operation through first clip, can hang the locater in suitable position fast, can give the effectual protection of trouble locater body through second casing and first control top cap, avoid receiving damage or external interference in carrying or use, durability and stability of equipment have been strengthened.

title_en: Emergent material receiving cabinet with dampproofing effect
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergency material picking cabinet with a dampproof effect, which comprises a cabinet body, and a cabinet door hinged on the front face of the cabinet body, wherein four corners of the front face of the cabinet door are fixedly connected with connecting blocks, the surfaces of the connecting blocks are spliced with shaft rods, two ends of each shaft rod penetrate through the outer sides of the connecting blocks and are fixedly connected with sealing frames, the sealing frames are arranged around the outer edges of the cabinet door, and the front face of the cabinet door is provided with a transmission structure which can control the sealing frames to swing. According to the utility model, the sealing frame can be additionally controlled to swing when the cabinet door body is closed to provide basic sealing. This is equivalent to having increased the secondary sealing barrier of round dynamic at the whole outward flange of cabinet door, when the cabinet door closed the back, control sealing frame swing makes its and the inseparable laminating of cabinet body, can effectively fill the gap that probably exists originally between cabinet door and the cabinet body because of reasons such as cabinet door manufacturing error, hinge looseness, slight deformation or foreign matter block.

title_en: Main unit
abstract_en: The utility model provides a host, and belongs to the technical field of beauty equipment. The host comprises a shell, a detection module, a lifting device, a control module and a power board, wherein the shell defines an accommodating cavity with an opening, the detection module is arranged in the accommodating cavity and is in sliding connection with the shell, the output end of the lifting device is in transmission connection with the detection module so as to drive the detection module to slide relative to the shell and can slide out of the accommodating cavity through the opening, the control module and the power board are respectively accommodated in the accommodating cavity, and the power board and the detection module are respectively and electrically connected with the control module. According to the host provided by the utility model, the detection module, the control module and the power board are respectively accommodated in the accommodating cavity, so that the space utilization rate of the host is improved, the detection module is driven to slide relative to the shell through the lifting device, the detection module can be prevented from being exposed out of the shell for a long time, the detection module is protected through the shell, and the quality and the accuracy of skin detection by the detection device can be improved through increasing the power.

title_en: Water cooling system and laser direct imaging equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model provides a water cooling system and laser direct imaging equipment, and relates to the technical field of laser direct imaging equipment. The water cooling system of the laser direct imaging device comprises a water cooling machine, a water cooling piece and a temperature adjusting device. The water cooling machine is connected with a water outlet main pipe and a water inlet main pipe. The plurality of water cooling pieces are respectively arranged on the plurality of heating pieces. The water cooling piece is communicated with the water outlet header pipe through the first branch pipe. The water cooling piece is also communicated with the water inlet main pipe through a second branch pipe. The temperature adjusting device is arranged on the water cooling piece. The temperature adjusting device is used for adjusting the temperature of cooling water entering the water cooling piece. According to the utility model, a set of water cooling machine can be adopted to accurately control the temperature of a plurality of heating components in the laser direct imaging equipment at the same time, so that the equipment stability is improved, a plurality of sets of water cooling machine equipment are not needed, and the equipment cost is reduced.

title_en: Connecting arm structure of ear-clamping earphone
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a connecting arm structure of an ear-clamping earphone, which comprises first connecting hardware, second connecting hardware, an elastic soft adhesive layer and a first wire, wherein a first connecting part is formed on the first connecting hardware, an elastic hook body is also formed on the first connecting part, and a second connecting part for being matched and clamped with a second convex part is formed on the second connecting hardware. According to the utility model, the first convex part with larger mass is connected in a shaft hole matching way, the first connecting part is inserted into the first connecting hole and is clamped and fixed through the elastic hook body, so that the reliability of the connecting part is enhanced, the problem of unbalanced stress is effectively solved, the clamping stability is improved, and the service life of a product is greatly prolonged.

title_en: MEMS microphone
abstract_en: The utility model provides an MEMS microphone, which comprises a shell with an accommodating space, an ASIC chip accommodated in the accommodating space and an MEMS chip with a back cavity, wherein the shell is provided with an acoustic hole communicated with the accommodating space, the shell comprises a shell body and a substrate which is covered with the shell body to form the accommodating space, the MEMS microphone also comprises a baffle plate fixed on the shell, the accommodating space is divided into a front cavity and a back cavity which are mutually independent, the MEMS chip is fixed on the baffle plate and accommodated in the front cavity, a first air vent communicated with the back cavity and a second air vent communicated with the front cavity and the back cavity are arranged on the baffle plate, the first air vent and the second air vent are circular, the diameter of the first air vent is larger than that of the second air vent, and the diameter of the second air vent is between 5um and 50 um. The MEMS microphone structure of the design can realize larger attenuation of low-frequency response below 1kHz relative to 1kHz without re-optimizing and adjusting the structure of the MEMS chip under a specific packaging size, and saves research and development cost and period.

title_en: Integrated cabinet body of flywheel converter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrated cabinet body of a flywheel converter, which is divided into a power area and a control area by a separation structure, wherein at least one drawable box body is arranged in the control area and is used for installing a control assembly and facilitating drawing maintenance, the separation structure comprises a separation frame and a separation plate which is arranged on the separation frame in a covering manner so as to realize physical separation of the power area and the control area, the power area and the control area are integrated in the same cabinet body, the separation of functions is realized by the separation plate, the overall occupied area is greatly reduced, and the space utilization rate of a single cabinet is improved, so that the integrated cabinet body is particularly suitable for scenes with higher space compactness requirements such as a machine room and an energy storage power station. Through the setting of drawable box to can directly pull out the cabinet body operation, need not to dismantle fixing bolt or wholly demolish peripheral subassembly, shorten the maintenance time.

title_en: Gas sensor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gas sensor, relates to the technical field of gas detection, and mainly solves the problems of large thickness, large volume, complex production process, high production cost and poor circuit safety and heat dissipation performance of the existing laser gas sensor. The device comprises a rectangular back-off cavity, a first control board and a second control board. The rectangular back-off cavity is provided with a reticular air inlet at the top, a first baffle and a second baffle at two ends to form a hollow cavity, a first control board and a second control board are vertically arranged at two ends of the cavity respectively, an external circuit interface is arranged at the bottom, and the first control board and the second control board are encapsulated and fixed through insulating materials. The utility model obviously reduces the volume and thickness of the sensor by optimizing the structural design and the production process, improves the safety, the heat radiation performance and the detection precision of circuit connection, reduces the production cost and has important application value and market prospect.

title_en: Bone conduction earphone
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bone conduction earphone, which relates to the technical field of earphones, wherein a functional bin of the bone conduction earphone comprises a shell component, a control circuit board and a light guide piece, wherein the control circuit board is provided with lamp beads, the light guide piece is provided with an embedded part positioned in a light emitting hole of the shell component, and the embedded part is bonded with the inner wall of the light emitting hole through an opaque adhesive layer. The light-tight glue film can prevent that light from sending out from the side of embedded portion on the one hand, plays the effect of preventing light leakage, on the other hand can also improve the connection force and the water-proof effects of embedded portion and shell subassembly.

title_en: Flexible screen with waterproof effect
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flexible screen with a waterproof effect, which comprises a base and a lamp panel, wherein one side of the base is provided with a wiring opening penetrating through the base, a first water blocking curtain covered on the wiring opening is extended on the base, the bottom of the first water blocking curtain is provided with a first opening, one side of the base is provided with a plurality of magnetic pieces, the magnetic pieces are distributed at intervals along the edge of the base, the base is provided with a plurality of radiating grooves distributed at intervals, the radiating grooves are internally provided with radiating openings penetrating through the base, the base is provided with a plurality of second water blocking curtains, the second water blocking curtains are close to the upper part of the radiating openings, the lamp panel is covered on the other side of the base, and the lamp panel is provided with a connecting component which penetrates through the base and is fixedly connected with the magnetic pieces. The utility model provides a flexible screen with a waterproof effect, which ensures that a waterproof structure still has waterproof performance after the flexible screen is bent, and a base is adsorbed on a mounting surface of a mounting bracket through a magnetic piece.

title_en: Sliding rail rear support lock device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a sliding rail rear support locking device which comprises a support main body, a locking assembly, a pin, an elastic piece and a connecting piece, wherein the locking assembly comprises a top plate, two first waist-shaped holes are formed in the top plate, one first waist-shaped hole is formed in the front end of the other first waist-shaped hole, two connecting rods are arranged at the lower ends of two sides of the top plate, the front ends of the connecting rods protrude out of the upper sides of a part of the front ends of the support main body, the pin is fixed on the support main body through the two first waist-shaped holes, the width of the first waist-shaped holes is smaller than the outer diameter of a pin head, the elastic piece is sleeved on the pin at the front end, the first ends are connected with the top plate, the second ends are connected with the upper end of the support main body or the extending part of the pin, and when the locking state is achieved, the front end of the support main body, the connecting rods and the hook parts are enclosed into a clamping groove, the rear support locking device is limited to slide forwards and backwards relative to a stand column, the rear support locking device is mounted, the structure is simple, and the rear support locking device is convenient to use.

title_en: Money collecting cloud sound box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a money receiving cloud sound box, which relates to the technical field of money receiving sound boxes, wherein the money receiving cloud sound box comprises a shell and a display module, the shell is provided with a first side and a second side which are oppositely arranged in the thickness direction of the shell, the top side of the shell is inclined towards the bottom of the shell in the direction of the first side towards the second side, a battery mounting seat is arranged in the shell, the battery mounting seat is provided with a first mounting position and a second mounting position, the first mounting position is used for mounting a first battery, the second mounting position is used for mounting a second battery, the display module comprises a main control board, a display screen and a two-dimensional code display piece, the display screen is arranged on the top side of the shell, the main control board is electrically connected with the display screen and is arranged in the shell, the two-dimensional code display piece is arranged on the side of the shell, which is close to the first side, and a wireless network connection module is arranged on the main control board. The technical scheme provided by the utility model can improve the accuracy of confirmation of the collection information of merchants, and can be compatible with batteries with different capacities so as to improve the compatibility of the collection broadcaster.

title_en: Household energy storage power supply convenient to carry
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of energy storage power supplies, and discloses a portable household energy storage power supply, which comprises a power supply installation box, a box cover arranged on the upper part of the power supply installation box, a movable wheel arranged on the lower part of the power supply installation box, and a connecting component arranged on one side of the power supply installation box, wherein a radiating mechanism is arranged on the side part of the connecting component, an auxiliary mechanism is arranged on the outer side of the power supply installation box, an air duct is arranged in the power supply installation box, an inclined-plane clamping block movably penetrates through a movable groove, the inclined-plane clamping block is clamped with the clamping groove, one end of a first spring is fixedly connected with the movable block, the outer end of a connecting rod movably penetrates through the movable groove, the outer end of a second spring is fixedly connected with an anti-collision plate, and the second spring is sleeved outside a damper. The utility model solves the problem that the heat conduction type heat dissipation is carried out only through the heat dissipation fins in the existing device, and the ventilation in the box body is poor, so that the heat dissipation effect is affected.

title_en: Streaming media player protection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a streaming media player protection device which comprises a first shell, a second shell and an unlocking piece, wherein one end of the first shell is hinged with one end of the second shell, the other end of the first shell is provided with a clamping assembly, the other end of the second shell is provided with a clamping hole assembly, when the clamping assembly is configured on the clamping hole assembly, the first shell is connected with the second shell and encloses a closed space for accommodating a streaming media player, the unlocking piece is arranged on one side, far away from the first shell, of the second shell, the unlocking piece comprises an unlocking protrusion, and the unlocking protrusion is used for moving towards the clamping hole assembly until the clamping assembly configured in the clamping hole assembly is unfolded, so that the first shell and the second shell are unfolded. The utility model realizes rotary opening and closing through the hinge joint of the first shell and the second shell, realizes quick locking through the matching of the buckle component and the clamping hole component between the first shell and the second shell, simplifies the operation flow, and can open and close without complex operation by opening the buckle component through the unlocking protrusion.

title_en: Waterproof control box for lifter and supporting cage wall thereof
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waterproof control box for an elevator and a cage wall matched with the waterproof control box, which comprise a cage wall shell, wherein the control device is fixedly arranged on the inner end face of the cage wall shell, a waterproof device is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the side end face of the control device, and a fixed wire is fixedly connected to the waterproof device and the bottom of the control device in a penetrating way. According to the utility model, the cage wall shell enters the upper shell of the control box in a lead mode at the lower side of the waterproof box shell, when water enters the well, the water can drop into the well pit of the channel along the cage wall shell and the waterproof box shell at the bottom of the cage wall shell, and cannot enter the cage wall shell, so that the water enters the upper shell of the control box, a short circuit fault is caused, and the waterproofness and the subsequent service life of the upper shell of the control box are effectively improved.

title_en: Portable deep-light K sings stereo set
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable deep-seated light K song sound box, which comprises a shell, a loudspeaker assembly and a deep-seated light assembly, wherein the loudspeaker assembly and the deep-seated light assembly are arranged on the shell, the deep-seated light assembly comprises a deep-seated light shell, an upper cavity body which is arranged at the top of the shell and is particularly provided with an upper opening, a reflector which is arranged at the cavity bottom of the upper cavity body, the reflecting surface of the reflector faces upwards, a luminous light band which is arranged around the side wall of the upper cavity body, a semi-transparent semi-reflecting mirror which is arranged above the luminous light band, and a sealing ring which is arranged between the luminous light band and the semi-transparent semi-reflecting mirror and is matched with the semi-transparent semi-reflecting mirror to seal the upper opening of the upper cavity body. The utility model effectively solves the problem of poor light-emitting effect of the deep-light mirror group light source in the prior art.

title_en: Head-up display and vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides a head-up display and a vehicle, the head-up display includes: signal port, signal conversion device, controlling means and display device. The signal port is electrically connected with the first end of the signal conversion device, the second end of the signal conversion device is electrically connected with the first end of the control device, the second end of the control device is electrically connected with the display device, the signal port is further used for being electrically connected with the vehicle-mounted host, the signal conversion device is configured to receive a first video signal sent by the vehicle-mounted host through the signal port and convert the first video signal into a second video signal, the control device is configured to adjust the second video signal to obtain a third video signal and output the third video signal to the display device, and the display device generates a light beam based on the third video signal. By setting the signal port, connection between the head-up display and the vehicle-mounted host can be established, so that the head-up display can display based on a first video signal sent by the vehicle-mounted host.

title_en: Heat dissipation fan and power electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a heat radiation fan and power electronic equipment, which comprises a fan frame, heat radiation blades and a wind protection ring, wherein the fan frame is provided with a mounting hole, and a plurality of heat radiation blades are circumferentially arranged around a hub and rotatably arranged in the mounting hole and used for driving airflow to flow. The wind protection ring comprises an annular main body part and an extension part, wherein the annular main body part is arranged between the fan frame and the radiating blades and is connected with the tops of the radiating blades for reducing the gaps of the tops of the radiating blades. The extension part is arranged on the outer ring of the annular main body part, is connected with the annular main body part, is at least partially arranged opposite to the fan frame along the axial direction of the annular main body part, forms an air inlet gap between the extension part and the fan frame, and is communicated with the blade top gap. The wind protection ring is rotatably arranged on the fan frame, and the wind protection ring is in concave-convex fit with the surface opposite to the fan frame, and the concave-convex fit structure can effectively inhibit the flow of air flow in the blade top gap, so that the vortex noise of the blade top gap is reduced.

title_en: 220KV boost collecting station indoor rail-hanging type inspection robot
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of inspection robots, and discloses a 220KV boost collecting station indoor rail-hanging type inspection robot which comprises a guide rail and a mechanical arm, wherein a driving assembly for driving the mechanical arm to move is connected inside the guide rail in a sliding manner, a storage box is arranged at the lower end of the driving assembly, a base is arranged at the top of the inner wall of the storage box, the mechanical arm is arranged on the lower surface of the base, an adjusting assembly for multi-angle inspection equipment is arranged at one end of the mechanical arm far away from the storage box, the cleaning component for cleaning particles accumulated on the outer surface of the adjusting component is installed at the top of the inner wall of the storage box, the filter component is connected to the cleaning component in a rotating mode, the adjusting component is started to drive the inspection equipment inside the adjusting component to rotate, the shooting angle can be adjusted when the adjusting component is used, the inspection range of the adjusting component is enlarged, dead angles of the adjusting component are avoided when the inspection equipment is inspected, and therefore the reliability of the device is improved when the device is used.

title_en: Composite refrigeration system for data center
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a composite refrigeration system for a data center, which comprises an outdoor cold source module, an indoor air cooling module and an indoor liquid cooling module, wherein an outlet of the outdoor cold source module is communicated with an inlet of the indoor air cooling module and an inlet of the indoor liquid cooling module in parallel, an outlet of the indoor air cooling module and an outlet of the indoor liquid cooling module are communicated with an inlet of the outdoor cold source module in a mixed mode, the outdoor cold source module comprises a condenser, a liquid storage, a first compressor, a second compressor, a refrigerant pump and a water fluorine heat exchanger, an outlet of the condenser is communicated with the liquid storage, an outlet of the liquid storage is communicated with the water fluorine heat exchanger through a refrigerant transmission pipe, a water side outlet of the water fluorine heat exchanger is communicated with the indoor air cooling module through a wind side water supply pipe, and the refrigerant pump is connected to the refrigerant transmission pipe.

title_en: Integrated heat radiation structure and optical module
abstract_en: The utility model provides an integrated heat dissipation structure which comprises a first heat dissipation plate, a second heat dissipation plate and a third heat dissipation plate, wherein an integrated heat dissipation plate radiator is formed, a heat dissipation cavity is formed between the first heat dissipation plate and the second heat dissipation plate, a heat dissipation assembly is arranged in the heat dissipation cavity, and the second heat dissipation plate is fixedly connected with the third heat dissipation plate to form a heat dissipation space. When heat is generated, the heat enters the heat dissipation cavity through the first heat dissipation plate, is diffused to the second heat dissipation plate through the heat dissipation assembly, and is diffused to the heat dissipation space through the second heat dissipation plate, the heat transfer process is not limited by the multi-layer partition plates in the independent installation of the vapor chamber and the radiator in the prior art, and the heat can be transferred timely, so that the heat dissipation efficiency and the heat dissipation capacity are improved.

title_en: Folding display board
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a folding display board, which comprises two frame bodies, display boards and pulleys, wherein one ends, close to each other, of the two frame bodies are connected in a rotating mode, the two display boards are respectively arranged in the two frame bodies, and the four pulleys are respectively and uniformly arranged on the left side and the right side of the lower ends of the two frame bodies. According to the folding display board, the frame body, the display board, the pulleys, the fixed adjusting device, the supporting component, the first supporting rod, the telescopic rod, the second supporting rod, the adjusting component, the box body, the tension spring, the positioning component, the moving rod, the clamping head, the pushing spring and the adjusting groove are matched for use, so that the problem that the frame body cannot be fixed to slide randomly due to the fact that the unfolding angle of the existing folding display board is not supported and fixed when the existing folding display board is unfolded is solved, and accordingly the problem that the unfolding angle is overlarge and topples is solved.

title_en: Pressing device
abstract_en: The application discloses a pressing device, and belongs to the technical field of display. The pressing device can comprise a bearing platform and a pressing assembly. According to the embodiment of the application, the first exhaust groove communicated with the second avoidance groove is arranged in the pressing head, so that air between the protective adhesive tape and the electronic component can be exhausted through the first exhaust groove, and therefore, the air between the protective adhesive tape and the electronic component cannot flow to one side of the driving chip of the binding area, and wrinkles cannot appear on one side of the driving chip facing the bending area of the display panel. Furthermore, in the process of performing the Lipo process, the problem that the air tightness of the display module is affected by wrinkles does not occur.
