abstract_en: To provide a component data management method, a component data management device, a component data management program, and a component data management system capable of appropriately returning changed component data to a past state.SOLUTION: A component data management method for managing component data includes: acquiring component data used by a component mounting device, creation date and time on the component data, and performance data obtained when the component is mounted by the component mounting device using the component data (ST2); storing the obtained component data, creation date and time, and performance data in the database in association with one another (ST3); receiving component information on a first component (ST7); extracting the component data that matches the received component information on the first component and the stored component information from the database (ST8); and outputting an operating parameter of the extracted component data (ST9).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Display device for vehicles
abstract_en: To realize a display device for vehicles with which, while responding to a display body and the solar radiation state of occupants in display control by a self-luminous display body, it is possible to both improve visibility and suppress an increase in power consumption.SOLUTION: This display device for vehicles comprises a solar radiation estimation unit 12, an illuminance acquisition unit 13, an occupant information acquisition unit 14, and a display control unit 15. The display control unit 15 changes the display size and/or the display luminance of the content displayed on a display body, on the basis of the solar radiation region of a display body 4 that is estimated by the solar radiation estimation unit 12, the environment illuminance of the display body 4 that is acquired by the illuminance acquisition unit 13 and the solar radiation state of occupants that is acquired by the occupant information acquisition unit 14.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Image display system, control unit, and data processing method
abstract_en: To perform three-dimensional display with a plurality of screens by using three-dimensional shape data.SOLUTION: A data processing method includes: receiving the number of data sets in processing of generating cross-sectional shape data from three-dimensional shape data; generating a plurality of pieces of cross-sectional shape data from the three-dimensional shape data based on the number of data sets; generating a plurality of pieces of image data based on the plurality of pieces of cross-sectional shape data; and transmitting the plurality of pieces of image data to projectors projecting images on screens with light transmissivity.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Laminated piezoelectric element and electroacoustic transducer
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a laminated piezoelectric element capable of preventing short circuits between adjacent piezoelectric films, and an electroacoustic transducer using this laminated piezoelectric element. 
     SOLUTION: A laminated piezoelectric element includes an adhesive layer in which piezoelectric films having piezoelectric layers sandwiched between two thin-film electrodes, which are polarized in the thickness direction and have no in-plane anisotropy in the piezoelectric properties, are laminated in multiple layers, and the adjacent piezoelectric films are adhered, and the polarization directions of adjacent piezoelectric films are opposed to each other. 
     SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method and apparatus for video encoding/decoding
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method and apparatus for video encoding/decoding. 
     SOLUTION: In some examples, the apparatus includes processing circuitry for video decoding. The processing circuitry decodes prediction information of a current block from an encoded video bitstream. The prediction information is indicative of an intra-frame block copy mode. The processing circuitry selects, from a set of multiple candidate resolutions, a resolution of a block vector difference for the current block, and determines a block vector of the current block according to the selected resolution of the block vector difference and a block vector predictor of the current block. Then, the processing circuitry reconstructs at least one sample of the current block according to the block vector.

title_en: Vehicle overhead view image generation device, monitoring system, and vehicle overhead view image generation method
abstract_en: To provide a vehicle overhead view image generation device and a vehicle overhead view image generation method which can generate image information for accurately monitoring the state of the periphery of a vehicle that enters/leaves a building.SOLUTION: A vehicle overhead view image generation device comprises: a viewpoint position information holding unit 32 which is connected to a plurality of monitoring camera devices 10-1 to 10-3 that image a monitoring area near a gateway of a building being a monitoring object and holds information on a plurality of viewpoint positions looking down at the inside of the monitoring area; an imaging information acquisition unit 33 which acquires imaging information imaged by the plurality of monitoring camera devices; a vehicle position information acquisition unit 34 which acquires position information of the vehicle; a viewpoint position specification unit 35 which specifies a corresponding viewpoint position on the basis of the position information of the vehicle when the vehicle enters the monitoring area; and an overhead view image generation unit 36 which generates image information looking down at the vehicle that has entered the monitoring area from the specified viewpoint position by using the imaging information acquired by the imaging information acquisition unit 33.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

abstract_en:

title_en: Method for encoding and decoding images, encoding and decoding device, and corresponding computer programs
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an encoder/decoder proposed to apply two different prediction modes at a current time point to an image at the current time point derived from a video content in a given type or format while enabling optimization of the performance and complexity of encoding/decoding of the image at the current time point and reduction of a memory resource in an encoder and decoder. 
     SOLUTION: There is provided a method of encoding an image including two separate zones. Said encoding method is characterized in that it implements the following: only in the event where the current block pertains to one of the zones of the image: encoding the current block using a prediction, the current block being predicted using a previously encoded and then decoded block; encoding information indicating the application of said prediction; and for any decoded block pertaining to another zone of the image, storing the decoded block data.

title_en: Video processing device, video processing system and video processing method
abstract_en: To provide a video processing device, a video processing system and a video processing method that can suppress video and audio from being mutually out of timing.SOLUTION: In a video processing system S, a tablet terminal 30 receives a video and a video transmission time of the video from a mobile terminal 70, acquires a video processing completion time when processing on the received video is completed, and calculates and transmits to an audio processing device 1, a delay time which is a time difference between the video processing completion time and the video transmission time. The audio processing device 1 generates a delayed audio obtained by delaying the acquired audio by the delay time, and transmits the generated delayed audio to the tablet terminal 30. The tablet terminal 30 outputs the processed video and the delayed audio. Consequently, even when the video of one object received from the mobile terminal 70 and the audio which is acquired by the audio processing device 1 and generated by the one object are output, those video and audio can be suppressed from being mutually out of timing.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing device, information processing method, and program
abstract_en: To suppress a misalignment of the display position of information regarding the sound emanated from a sound source with respect to a position corresponding to the direction of the sound source to a display device.SOLUTION: This information processing device comprises: means for acquiring user input regarding the position and/or the bearing of a multi-mike device provided with a plurality of microphones; means for determining the position and bearing of the multi-mike device in a reference coordinate system, in accordance with user input; means for a second direction that represents the direction of a sound source to a display device, on the basis of the estimation result of a first direction that represents the direction of the sound source to the multi-mike device and the position and bearing of the multi-mike device in the reference coordinate system; and means for causing information regarding the sound emanated from the sound source to be displayed at a display position that corresponds to the second direction in a display unit of the display device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Video encoder, video decoder and corresponding methods
abstract_en: To provide an encoding and decoding apparatus, as well as an encoding and decoding method.SOLUTION: In particular, the present disclosure relates to block partitioning and signaling the partitioning parameters in a bitstream. An override flag in an image region header indicates whether or not a block is to be partitioned according to first partition constraint information. title_en: Thermally conductive member
abstract_en: To provide a technique that can manufacture a thermally conductive member comprising a joint part joining metal plates, easily at low cost.SOLUTION: A thermally conductive member 1 comprises a case 2 internally comprising a space, a wick structure 3 arranged in the space, and working liquid 4 housed in the space. The case comprises one or a plurality of metal plates 20, and a joint part 21 joining the metal plates. The joint part comprises a first layer and a second layer constituted of a portion of the metal plate, a joint layer arranged between the first layer and the second layer, a first boundary part between the first layer and the joint layer, and a second boundary part between the second layer and the joint layer. The first boundary part comprises a first region constituted of at least one first crystal grain existing over the first layer and the joint layer. The second boundary part comprises a second region constituted of at least one second crystal grain existing over the second layer and the joint layer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Active noise control system
abstract_en: To provide an active noise control (ANC) system having a structure suitable for attenuating sound from speakers attached to a structure at the back of the structure when viewed from a speaker.SOLUTION: An ANC system in which a surface space 95A, a surface 80a, a back face 80b and a back space 95B are arranged in this order includes: a structure 80; a first piezoelectric speaker 10A; and a second piezoelectric speaker 10B. The first piezoelectric speaker 10A is arranged on the surface 80a. The first piezoelectric speaker 10A radiates a sound wave for silencing. The second piezoelectric speaker 10B is arranged on the back face 80b. The second piezoelectric speaker 10B radiates the sound wave for silencing.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 79

title_en: Analytical system for surface mount technology (smt) and method thereof
abstract_en: To provide a method, apparatus, and computer readable medium for Surface Mount Technology (SMT).SOLUTION: The system comprises a Data Integration (DI) platform configured to collate data from one or more units in an assembly line and an Artificial Intelligence (AI) platform configured to process the collated data, using one or more machine learning techniques, to generate predictive and preventive analysis for the one or more units present in the assembly line. The system further disclose a Digital Twin Simulation (DTS) platform configured to simulate an exact replica of all the units present in the assembly line, provide visual representation, allow one or more operators in the assembly line to take at least one action, and provide the at least one action taken by the one or more operators in the assembly line as a feedback signal to the AI platform to improve a prediction rate of the system.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Estimation apparatus, estimation method, and estimation program
abstract_en: To maintain accuracy of authentication processing even for image data including only a part of a human body.SOLUTION: An estimation apparatus 10 acquires image data of a human body partially lost, and restores a lost part of the human body in the image data with a full-body restoration model for restoring a lost part of a human body in image data, by using the acquired image data as input. The estimation apparatus 10 estimates skeleton data with a skeleton estimation model for estimating skeleton data relating to a human skeleton, by using the restored image data as input.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Vehicle electroacoustic transducer
abstract_en: To inhibit entry of water.SOLUTION: A vehicle electroacoustic transducer 10 includes a main baffle 12 which is formed in a box shape and formed with a first through hole 12C. Further, the vehicle electroacoustic transducer 10 includes a vibration part 32 which is disposed within the main baffle 12 and provided so as to close the first through hole 12C and vibrates to generate sound. The vibration part 32 includes: an outer periphery part 60 forming an outer periphery portion thereof and formed in an annular shape; and an inner periphery part 62 which closes a center portion of the outer periphery part 60 and is integrally formed with the outer periphery part 60.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Head-mounted display
abstract_en: To provide a head-mounted display which has the high display quality.SOLUTION: A head-mounted display 100 according to an embodiment comprises: an optical system 103L for left eye which guides display light PL11 for forming a display image for left eye to the left eye of a user; an optical system 103R for right eye which guides display light PR11 for forming a display image for right eye to the right eye of the user; a polarizing plate 180 which is arranged between a left front space 160L and a right front space 160R; and a display element part 101 which generates the display light PR11 in the right front space 160R and generates the display light PL11 in the left front space 160L. The polarizing plate 180 is arranged so as to be in parallel to the direction to which the display surface of the display element part 101 faces. The left front space 160L and the right front space 160R are partitioned by the polarizing plate 180.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Imaging apparatus
abstract_en: To provide an imaging apparatus that can obtain a good image by suppressing positional deviation in an optical axis direction of an imaging element during imaging.SOLUTION: A digital camera 100 includes: an imaging unit 200 having an imaging element holder 232; a support portion 214 that is in contact with the imaging element holder 232 and has three or more support points for movably supporting the imaging unit 200; and a lock plate 252 that comes into contact with the imaging unit 200 to generate regulation force for regulating the movement of the imaging unit 200. The imaging unit 200 has a plate 234 for receiving the regulation force, and the plate 234 is in contact with the imaging element holder 232 at a plurality of portions. A contact center 256 of the lock plate 252 with the imaging unit 200 is positioned inside a triangle 377. One contact point of the plate 234 with the imaging element holder 232 is positioned in each of a plurality of regions divided by a half line segment 2751 to a half line segment 2753.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Method and apparatus for intra-prediction coding of video data
abstract_en: To provide a method and apparatus for intra-prediction coding of video data.SOLUTION: An apparatus for decoding video data comprises: a decoder configured to decode, from a bitstream, a syntax element indicating an intra-prediction type of a current block of the video data; and an intra-predictor configured to generate a prediction block for the current block by selectively performing matrix based intra-prediction or regular intra-prediction based on the intra-prediction type of the current block indicated by the syntax element.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 11

title_en: Wiring circuit board and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: To provide a method for manufacturing a wiring circuit board in which a defect such as a void hardly occurs in an insulation layer and a through hole can be formed while suppressing a resin residue.SOLUTION: A method for manufacturing a wiring circuit board includes the steps of: forming a layer of a photosensitive resin material for forming an insulation layer on a support substrate; forming a through hole and an insulation layer in which a groove unit is formed from a layer of a photosensitive resin material for forming the insulation layer including forming the through hole for forming a via by photolithography and forming the groove unit for forming wiring by imprint lithography; forming a conductor layer on a surface of the insulation layer; and preparing a wiring layer in which the wiring and the via are formed in the insulation layer by removing a part of the conductor layer to form the wiring and the via.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1J

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle, and, inspection system of wind power generation equipment, and inspection method of wind power generation equipment
abstract_en: To provide an unmanned aerial vehicle, an inspection system of wind power generation equipment and an inspection method of the wind power generation equipment, each enabling wind power generation equipment to be inspected without stopping or limiting the rotation of a blade of a wind turbine.SOLUTION: After recognition of a rotational speed of a blade by photographing the blade by a wide-angle camera 25 installed in an aerial vehicle 2, the blade is photographed by a telephoto camera 26 at timing at which the blade being an inspection object arrives at a front position of the telephoto camera 26, and the information of a photographed image is utilized as information for recognizing the presence or absence of the damage of the blade. Therefore, the blade can be inspected without stopping or limiting the rotation of the blade. As a result, even during the inspection, the power generation of wind power generation equipment can be continuously performed, and an operation rate of the wind power generation equipment can be maintained high.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Adjustment device and electronic apparatus system
abstract_en: To provide an adjustment device that comes with a member capable of adjusting an adjustment member of an electronic apparatus and that can be easily attached to the electronic apparatus, and an electronic apparatus system.SOLUTION: An adjustment device comprises: a base member 152 that includes a pair of rotors 152b that are press-contacted to an adjustment ring 30 provided to a lens barrel 80 and rotate the adjustment ring 30, and a pair of electric drive motors M that drive the rotation of the pair of rotors 152b; and a first frame 153 and a second frame 154 that are connected to the base member 152 and that hold, between the base member 152 and themselves, a housing 20 in which the lens barrel 80 is accommodated. The first frame 153 and the second frame 154 include a pair of spring members 159 that add a restoring force to the first frame 153 and the second frame 154, and are secured to the housing 20 holding the housing 20 by the restoring force of the pair of spring members 159.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 11

title_en: work management system
abstract_en: To provide a work management system that identifies a work main body of a predetermined work executed in a work region, and manages management information on the basis of the work main body.SOLUTION: A work management system comprises: an identification part that identifies whether or not a work main body of a predetermined work is an operator or a robot in the case where the predetermined work against an exchange element is executed; and an information management part that manages management information associated with the exchange element on the basis of an identification result by the identification part. The management information contains information associated with information indicating a type of an article held by the exchange element in each identification coding of the exchange element.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Sound field reproduction device and program
abstract_en: To improve installation properties of a loudspeaker and also ease restrictions on the arrival direction of a sound wave when reproducing a desired sound field.SOLUTION: A sound field reproduction device 1 outputs a speaker drive signal, found by a drive signal calculation unit 10, a spatial frequency domain reverse Fourier transformation unit 11, and a time frequency domain reverse Fourier transformation unit 12 to individual loudspeakers constituting a cylindrical array loudspeaker 101 in a state in which the cylindrical array loudspeaker 101 composed of a plurality of line array loudspeakers 102 arranged in parallel with a length direction on a cylinder are arranged surrounding a listener 103. The drive signal calculation unit 10 inputs a cylinder harmonic spectrum Pd∼m(kx,ω) of a desired sound field to find a cylindrical harmonic spectrum D∼m(kx,ω) from the equation.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Information related method of production item, processing method of production item, electronic device, and production system
abstract_en: To provide an information related method for producing an item, a processing method, an electronic device, and a production system.SOLUTION: An information related method of a production item includes: acquiring item information of production items; binding great spot information and the item information; acquiring processing information corresponding to the great spot information; and associating the processing information with the item information bound to the great spot information. After acquiring the item information and the great spot information, a processed item used during processing is associated with the production item by binding the great spot information with the item information, and binding the processing information with the item information. At retroaction of items, it is possible to retroact to processed items corresponding to great spots during processing of a motherboard through the item information of the motherboard, so that the retroaction of the items is made easy.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Information processing device and information processing program
abstract_en: To obtain an information processing device and an information processing program that can improve ease of communication in a target space.SOLUTION: An information processing device 10 includes: an acquisition unit 11A that acquires audio information indicating a voice uttered by a person present in a target space in which a predetermined background sound is played; an estimation unit 11B that, in parallel with the acquisition of the audio information by the acquisition unit 11A, estimates, from the audio information, at least one of a type-specific emotion value indicating intensity of multiple predetermined types of emotions by the person and an overall emotion value indicating overall intensity of the emotion by the person; a derivation unit 11C that derives selection information for selecting a filter that guides the person present in the target space into a target psychological state by causing at least one of the type-specific emotion value and the overall emotion value to act on the background sound; and an execution unit 11D that performs filtering on the background sound using a filter corresponding to the selection information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Diagnostic device, imaging device, diagnostic data generation method, and diagnostic program
abstract_en: To provide a diagnostic device for diagnosing a decrease in imaging accuracy in an imaging device.SOLUTION: A processor of a diagnostic device for diagnosing an imaging device for optically capturing an image of external space from an internal space through a light transmissive panel is configured to execute: receiving, as a reflected beam with respect to a diagnostic beam Bd emitted from a light emission fixed point in the internal space, an inner surface reflected beam at a panel inner surface facing the internal space in the light transmissive panel at an inner surface reflected beam receiving position of an imaging element to acquire an inner surface reflection intensity Ii on the panel inner surface; receiving, as a reflected beam, an outer surface reflected beam at a panel outer surface facing the external space in the light transmissive panel at an outer surface reflected beam receiving position of the imaging element to acquire an outer surface reflection intensity Io on the panel outer surface; and generating diagnostic data Dd representing a deterioration state that depends on a relative intensity ratio between the inner surface reflection intensity Ii and the outer surface reflection intensity Io as a state of the panel outer surface on which a light transmissive outer surface coat layer is provided.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Imaging apparatus
abstract_en: To provide an imaging apparatus which is high in visibility of a tally lamp.SOLUTION: An imaging apparatus includes: a rotational part that rotates an imaging direction of an imaging part to a pan direction or a tilt direction; and a plurality of tally lamps that indicates any one of an imaging state indicating whether or not an image by the imaging part is performed and a distribution state indicating where or not the image captured by the imaging part is distributed. In a first tally lamp among the plurality of tally lamps, at least one part of the first tally lamp is arranged on a surface positioned in the imaging direction of the imaging part. In a second tally lamp among the plurality of tally lamps, at least one part of the second tally lamp is arranged on the surface positioned in a direction that is reversed to the imaging direction of the imaging part. In a direction orthogonal to the imaging direction of the imaging part, the imaging apparatus is arranged at a position where the imaging part is sandwiched.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Polyimide precursor, polyimide, and flexible printed circuit board
abstract_en: To provide a polyimide excellent in dielectric characteristics and breaking elongation, and a polyimide precursor for obtaining the polyimide.SOLUTION: A polyimide precursor comprising structural units derived from diamines and structural units derived from tetracarboxylic acid dianhydrides, and containing 10 mol% or more and 80 mol% or less of structural units derived from dimer diamine in relation to all units of the structural units derived from diamines, with a weight average molecular weight of 15,000 or more and 130,000 or less, is provided for use as a base film for flexible printed circuit boards. Also provided are a resin composition containing this polyimide precursor and polyimide obtained using this polyimide precursor.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Wire grid polarization element, manufacturing method of wire grid polarization element, projection display device and vehicle
abstract_en: To improve optical characteristics by inhibiting protrusions of a grid structure from being inclined due to deposition of a functional film.SOLUTION: A wire grid polarization element 1 comprises: a substrate 10; a grid structure 20 obtained by integrally forming a base part 21 and a plurality of protrusions 22; a functional film 30 covering a part of the protrusion 22; and a reinforced film 51. The reinforced film 51 includes inorganic oxide, is interposed between the part of the protrusion 33 covered by the functional film 30 and the functional film 30 to reinforce the protrusion 22. The reinforced film 51 covers and envelopes at least a tip 22a and an upper side of both side faces 22b of the protrusion 22. The functional film 30 covers and envelopes a top of the protrusion 22 via the reinforced film 51 while does not cover a bottom side of the protrusion 22 and the base part 21, and has a coverage factor (Rc) of 30% or more and 70% or less.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 25

title_en: Image sensor, device including the same, and operating method for image sensor
abstract_en: To provide an image sensor, a device including the image sensor, and a method for operating the image sensor.SOLUTION: An image sensor according to the present invention is an image sensor that operates in a global shutter mode and includes a pixel array including a plurality of pixels, a timing controller configured to control the period of an output signal corresponding to N pieces of frame data output from the pixels, and (N-1) frame buffers configured to save (N-1) pieces of frame data.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Imaging system, control method of imaging system, and program
abstract_en: To realize photographing under a predetermined relative position between an illumination part for illuminating a subject area and an imaging part for imaging a subject area, even when the relative positions among the illumination part, the imaging part, and the subject area are not identical for each shot.SOLUTION: An imaging system includes: an illumination part for irradiating a terahertz wave; an imaging part for photographing an image of a subject; and a control part for controlling either the illumination part or the imaging part so that a positional relationship between the illumination part irradiating the subject area and the imaging part photographing the subject area satisfies a predetermined condition, in accordance with a positional relationship between a subject area photographed by the imaging part and the imaging part.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing system, information processing method, and program
abstract_en: To properly grasp the situation of a remote conference.SOLUTION: A ratio information acquisition unit acquires ratio information indicating the utterance ratios of participants in a conference. A concentration degree calculation unit calculates concentration degrees of the participants in the conference. An output control unit outputs information based on the ratio information and the concentration degrees.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Information processing system, information processing apparatus, and control method
abstract_en: To ensure consistent image quality and responsiveness according to display content.SOLUTION: A controller drives, with 1-bit driving, pixels in a steady dynamic region where the display content changes continuously, and drives, with 2-bit or higher-bit driving, pixels in a non-steady dynamic region of the electrophoretic display panel. A host system determines, for each element of a display image to be displayed on a display unit, whether a display region of the element is to be defined as the steady dynamic region, on the basis of information relating to the dynamic characteristic of the element. The present embodiment can be realized in any of the forms of an information processing system, an information processing apparatus, or a control method.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Tracking monitoring device, tracking monitoring system, tracking monitoring method, and tracking monitoring program
abstract_en: To provide a tracking monitoring technique capable of monitoring an object to be tracked for a longer time.SOLUTION: A tracking monitoring device includes: a video receiving unit configured to receive video data captured by a first camera; a target detecting unit configured to detect a target from received video data and measure a moving speed of a detected target; a subsequent-stage camera comparing unit configured to calculate a predicted arrival time at which the target reaches an imaging range of a second camera based on the measured moving speed; and a control unit configured to transmit a calculated predicted arrival time to a second camera.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Display adjustment method and apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a display adjustment method and device for improving the accuracy of adjusting the position of a display.SOLUTION: The display adjustment apparatus may obtain the sensing information, where the sensing information is used to determine the facial area of the target user. The display adjustment apparatus further adjusts, based on the location of the facial area, the location of the display corresponding to the target user, so that the adjusted location of the display can be an easy-to-view location for the user. This may improve a visual effect of the target user, and therefore improve accuracy of adjusting the position of the display.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Reuse support device and control method thereof
abstract_en: To provide a reuse support device and its control method capable of reducing the burden of a worker required for reuse of a substrate, thereby shortening the working time required for reuse and improving the working efficiency.SOLUTION: Detection information of various sensors provided in the substrate is collected by communication with the substrate, the remaining life of the substrate is diagnosed based on the history of the collected detection information, discarding of the substrate is designated when the diagnosed remaining life is less than a threshold value, and execution of rework which is a process of restoring an electrical component or a mounting component in the substrate to a state of normally functioning is appropriately designated when the diagnosed remaining life is equal to or more than the threshold value.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Sound bar speaker
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sound bar speaker capable of properly supporting a flat panel display device that improves an aesthetic look by going well, as a whole, with the flat panel display device while having a support function. The present sound bar speaker comprises: a mounting bracket (10) mounted on a back of the flat panel display device; a vertical support (20) formed at a lower end of the mounting bracket (10); and a support speaker (30) mounted on a lower end of the vertical support (20) and outputting sound while being supported on a flat surface.

title_en: System for providing golf putting simulation servie using virtual mesh form
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system for providing a golf putting simulation service using a virtual grid pattern, which provides a platform capable of determining and outputting data including golf putting and a moving track of a golf ball. According to the present invention, the system comprises a simulation device collecting and outputting putting content including a moving object corresponding to a golf ball and a simulation service providing server. The simulation service providing server includes: an overlay unit overlaying a virtual grid pattern on at least one image frame forming the putting content received from the simulation device; a measuring unit measuring the direction and speed of the golf ball generated by a virtual contact detection window on the virtual grid pattern; a separation unit separating an object of interest corresponding to the golf ball included in the at least one image frame forming the putting content from a background image; an acquisition unit acquiring morphological characteristics of the object of interest; a tracking unit tracking movement of the object of interest; and an output unit outputting results on the basis of the direction and speed of the golf ball and the trajectory of the object of interest.

title_en: Tape Reel Chip Counter System
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a chip counter that counts the remaining amount information of parts wound on a tape reel and, more specifically, to a chip counter system of a tape reel which photographs a tape reel placed on an examination table with an X-ray irradiating unit to obtain the remaining quantity information of parts and recognizes unique information of the corresponding tape reel through an internal camera to connect the remaining quantity information of parts of the tape reel to the unique information to be managed through a controller, thereby quickly and accurately managing inventory of the tape reel.

title_en: Microspeaker containing porous block
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a micro speaker containing a porous block and, in particular, to a micro speaker containing a porous block having a curvature that does not generate a collision sound. The micro speaker containing a porous block according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises: an upper case; a lower case; a speaker module that is installed between the upper case and the lower case; at least one porous block that is installed to be spaced apart from the speaker module and surround a part of an outer side of the speaker module; and an attachment member that has a curvature to which the porous block is attached. Accordingly, the present invention may improve sound quality without a collision sound by a porous substance.

title_en: Method of correcting angle error of gimbal mounted on drone
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method capable of correcting an angle error occurring on a gimbal by calculating an angle error value of the gimbal based on a calibration value, which is checked when the gimbal is controlled in rotation in a state in which a specific target for a vertically downward image photographed by a camera mounted in a drone is being checked and tracked, and using the value for the correction. The method includes: an image photographing step of causing a camera mounted on a gimbal to photograph a vertically downward image by adjusting the gimbal in angle in a state in which a drone is hovering; a target check step of checking a specific target located on an image center point which can be the center of the image being photographed; a primary adjustment value check step of checking a primary adjustment value by an automatic adjustment of the gimbal occurring when the gimbal is controlled in rotation around a rockshaft in a state in which the image of the checked target is being tracked; a secondary adjustment value check step of checking a secondary adjustment value by an automatic adjustment of the gimbal occurring when the gimbal is controlled in rotation around a rockshaft in a direction opposite to the previous rotation in a state in which the image of the checked target is being tracked; an error calculation step of calculating an angle error value of the gimbal using the checked primary and secondary adjustment values; and a correction step of correcting the angle error of the gimbal based on the calculated angle error value.

title_en: Customizable hearing aid deivce
abstract_en: A user-customizable hearing aid is disclosed. According to one aspect of the present invention, a user-customizable hearing aid may be provided, which includes a hearing aid body formed in a curved shape so as to be hung between a user's head and an auricle, and having a first inner surface having a concave curvature and a first outer surface having a convex curvature; a sound tube coupled to one end surface of the hearing aid body in the longitudinal direction; an ear tip coupled to an end of the sound tube and inserted into the user's ear canal; and a body protective cover made of an elastic material coupled to the hearing aid body so as to surround the first inner surface.

title_en: Golf round management system for no-caddie operation
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a golf round management system for no-caddie management, which can achieve efficient management by a no-caddie golf round, and improvement in performance of a golfer, and enabling the golfer to use a mobile terminal. The purpose of the present invention is to provide the golfer performing golf rounding in a golf course in a no-caddie state with various information related to a golf round of the corresponding golf course. The golfer includes a mobile terminal by a portable tablet PC or smartphone during golf rounding. The mobile terminal is equipped with a base information providing unit, a first information providing unit, a second information providing unit, and a third information providing unit.

title_en: Printed circuit board manufacturing method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a printed circuit board, and more specifically, to a method for manufacturing a printed circuit board, which minimizes damage to residual foreign substances or products to increase process efficiency, thereby saving process time, and furthermore, can help improve yield and reliability of products. To this end, the method for manufacturing a printed circuit board comprises the steps of: manufacturing a pcb panel in which a plurality of unit substrates are arranged in a grid shape; attaching a double-sided tape on one surface of a reinforcing plate; forming an empty space spaced apart from each other by punching a plurality of holes by performing a pressing process on the reinforcing plate; attaching the other surface of the double-sided tape to which the reinforcing plate is attached to the lower surface of the pcb panel; performing a dicing process for processing the outer edges of the unit substrates arranged on the pcb panel, respectively; mounting a component on a via hole on the surface of the pcb panel; and separating the plurality of unit substrates from the reinforcing plate, respectively.

title_en: Display Device Having Narrow Bezel
abstract_en: A display device according to an embodiment of the present specification comprises: a display panel including a plurality of data lines extending in a first direction driven by a data voltage, a plurality of horizontal gate lines driven by a gate pulse synchronized with the data voltage and extending in a second direction perpendicular to the first direction, and a plurality of vertical gate lines overlapping the data lines and connected to the horizontal gate lines respectively, through a plurality of contact holes at different positions; a source driver IC for generating the data voltage and supplying the data voltage to the data line; a gate driver IC for generating the gate pulse and supplying the gate pulse to the vertical gate line; and a flexible circuit board which is bonded to one side of the display panel and on which the source driver IC and the gate driver IC are mounted together. The length of the vertical gate line extending from the gate driver IC to the contact hole is the same at all positions of the display panel regardless of the position of the contact hole. According to the present invention, a bezel width can be minimized by changing the mounting position of the gate driver through the vertical gate line.

title_en: An electronic device for storing an external electronic device
abstract_en: An electronic device is disclosed. According to an embodiment, an electronic device for accommodating a pair of earbuds comprises: a housing in which a first portion of a bracket is accommodated; the bracket for providing a seating space in which at least portions of the earbuds can be accommodated; and a cover which is rotatably connected to the housing and can cover the seating space or an upper portion of the bracket so that the earbuds accommodated in the seating space are not exposed to the outside. A second portion of the bracket is exposed to the outside of the housing while covering a portion of the edge of the housing, and includes at least one protrusion protruding inward toward the edge of the housing. The edge of the housing has at least one groove which corresponds to the at least one protrusion and provides a space in which the at least one protrusion can move. The bracket can move between a first position and a second position according to the positions of the at least one groove and the at least one protrusion. Therefore, a user can easily take an external electronic device out of the electronic device. Other embodiments are also possible.

title_en: Method and apparatus for controlling vehicle stereo camera
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for controlling a stereo camera for a vehicle and a device. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the method for controlling the stereo camera for the vehicle includes the following steps of: measuring vehicle speed when start of the vehicle is ON; and comparing measured vehicle speed with a preset speed value and adjusting an interval between a first camera and a second camera provided in the stereo camera. Therefore, the present invention reduces advanced driver assistance system (ADAS) implementation cost through a simplification of sensor configuration contributes to popularization of ADAS.

title_en: Apparatus, method and computer program for generating 3d image of target object
abstract_en: Provided is a device for generating a stereoscopic image for a target object, which includes: an acquisition unit which acquires a plurality of input images acquired by photographing a target object through a plurality of cameras; a target viewpoint image generation unit which groups the plurality of input images into a plurality of groups, and generates a plurality of target viewpoint images including viewpoint information on the target object based on at least two images included in each group; a synthesized viewpoint image generation unit which generates a synthesized viewpoint image by synthesizing the plurality of target viewpoint images and the background image; and a stereoscopic image generation unit which generates a stereoscopic image based on the synthesized viewpoint image.

title_en: Clip apparatus for hearing aid
abstract_en: Disclosed is a clip device for a hearing aid. The clip device for a hearing aid, which is used to combine an eyeglass frame with a hearing aid having a hardware module and a receiver connected through an electric wire, includes: an engaged part formed into an elastic body having an open lower part so as to surround the eyeglass frame, having an engaged protrusion protruding from one side of the open part to be engaged with a lower part of the eyeglass frame, and provided to be combined with an eyeglass frame area corresponding to the earflap of an ear; and an elastic fixing part comprising a support protrusion protruding from the surface of one side of the engaged part in an outward direction of the eyeglass frame, and a pressing protrusion expanded from an end of the support protrusion to be inclined so as to be close to the eyeglass frame and formed into an elastic body, and provided to press and fix the hardware module with an elastic force of the pressing protrusion after bringing the same into tight contact with the eyeglass frame. According to the present invention, since the hearing aid can be integrated with the eyeglasses through the engaged part combined with the eyeglass frame and the elastic fixing part elastically fixing the hardware module of the hearing aid with the eyeglass frame, the hearing aid can be prevented from being lost when the eyeglasses are removed, and consumer satisfaction can be increased due to user convenience.

title_en: Apparatus and method for video conferencing service
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device and method for providing a video conferencing service. The present invention is enabled in accordance with one embodiment of the present invention. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the device for providing the video conferencing service may automatically generate a conferencing log by organizing the speech contents through voice recognition and text conversion. The device for providing the video conferencing service comprises: a communication part; a conferencing content part; a conferencing log generation part; and a storage part.

title_en: Tiled display device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a tiled display device. A tiled display device according to an embodiment comprises a plurality of display devices disposed to be adjacent to each other and each comprising a plurality of first pixels and a plurality of second pixels. The tiled display device includes a first boundary area where longer sides of at least two of the display devices are adjacent to each other, and a second boundary area where shorter sides of at least two of the display devices are adjacent to each other. Each of the first pixels and the second pixels comprises a plurality of sub-pixels. The first pixels are disposed in the first boundary area. The plurality of sub-pixels of the first pixels are parallel to the longer sides of the display devices. The second pixels are disposed in the second boundary area, and the plurality of sub-pixels of the second pixels are parallel to the shorter sides of the display devices. According to the present invention, an attachment margin and a cutting margin can be secured in boundary areas of the display devices.

title_en: Camera system with offset pixel aperture for increasing baseline structure
abstract_en: A camera system using an OPA structure for increasing a baseline is disclosed. According to one embodiment, a camera system comprises a single lens; and an image sensor comprising at least one 2x2 pixel array consisting of a first pixel, a second pixel and two third pixels. Each of the two third pixels is disposed at a position opposite to each other in the pixel array. A light blocking film for forming an offset pixel aperture (OPA) is disposed in the upper part of each of the two third pixels. The OPAs formed in the upper part of each of the two third pixels are formed using the light blocking layer to maximize a distance from each other.

title_en: Component supply device and component mounting device
abstract_en: The present invention is to suppress a decrease in the types of components that can be supplied to a component mounting device when scattered components are supplied to the component mounting device. The component mounting device includes: a motor; a first conveying belt which is driven by the motor, to convey a component put to an input position in a first direction; a vibrating body; and a conveying member which is vibrated by the vibrating body, to convey the component from the first conveying belt in the first direction and supply the same to a pickup position of a mounting head.

title_en: Base film for felxible printed circuit substrate
abstract_en: A substrate for a flexible printed circuit board according to an embodiment comprises: a first material of an acid anhydride having an ester group of TAHQ or BP-TME; and at least one second material of m-tolidine and flexible diamine.

title_en: Display apparatus and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a display apparatus and a method for manufacturing the same. In order to reduce the area of a non-display area and increase the area of a display area, images can be displayed on a side and/or corner, and defects that can occur when a display panel and a window cover are attached to each other can be minimized. The display apparatus includes: a display panel including a display area, a peripheral area outside the display area, a bending area disposed at one side of the peripheral area, and a pad area spaced apart from the peripheral area to have the bending area therebetween; and a lower protection layer arranged on a rear surface of the display panel and including a first portion and a second portion, wherein the first portion corresponds to the display area and the peripheral area, and the second portion corresponds to the pad area, and the first portion of the lower protection layer includes a material different from a material of the second portion.

title_en: Up-sampling system and method using one image
abstract_en: Provided are an upsampling system using a single image and a method thereof. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the upsampling system using a single image comprises: an image information acquisition unit formed to acquire image information which is an image photographed for an object by using a photographing device; a displacement signal generation unit conducting the pre-processing for the image information, and generating a displacement signal including a position change information of the object in the image; a displacement signal processing unit processing the displacement signal and acquiring optimal delay information; and a processing result output unit using the optimal delay information and outputting a final interpolation signal. The displacement signal is acquired by using a converted image generated by applying a geometric conversion to the photographed image. The present invention is able to photograph by using a low-frame camera and acquire a result similar to a result of photographing with a high-frame camera.

title_en: Fire evacuation system and operaion method of fire evacuation system
abstract_en: A fire escape system according to one embodiment of the present invention may include: a plurality of complex detectors which detect fire occurrence to generate a fire alarm, receive positioning signals from each of a plurality of terminals, and communicate with each other; a repeater which communicates with each of the plurality of complex detectors and receives the fire alarm and the positioning signal; a server which communicates with the repeater; and a plurality of display modules each displaying a first escape route of a first color, a second escape route of a second color different from the first color, or the first and second escape routes.

title_en: Electronic device communicating directly with external electronic device and method for thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electronic device for communicating directly with an external electronic device to reduce data traffic within a server and an operation method thereof. According to various embodiments of the present invention, the electronic device comprises a communication module and at least one processor connected to the communication module. The at least one processor is configured to transmit identification information and communication information of the electronic device to a first server for video communication with a device group including a plurality of external electronic devices; receive communication information about the device group from the first server; determine whether there is at least one external electronic device belonging to the device group and capable of direct communication with the electronic device based on the communication information for the device group; when the at least one external electronic device capable of direct communication with the electronic device exists, check at least one of a first path for data communication with the at least one external electronic device and a second path for data communication with another electronic device through the at least one external electronic device; and transmit and receive a data stream on the basis of at least one of the first path and the second path.

title_en: Server and controlling method thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed is a server. The server receives, through the communication interface, an image quality setting value of each display device, a sensing value for vicinity environments obtained from each display device, and information on an image quality mode of each display device from a communication interface and each of a plurality of display devices; based on the received image quality setting value and sensing value, identifies an optimum image quality setting value for each sensing value; based on the received information on the image quality mode, identifies a display device having an image quality mode set as a pre-set mode among a plurality of display devices; and based on the optimum image quality setting value for each sensing value, transmits the optimum image quality setting value, corresponding to the sensing value for a vicinity environment sensed by the identified display device, to the identified display device through the communication interface. Accordingly, the server can control image quality of a display device.

title_en: Navigation server for guiding safe route and navagating method using the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a safe route guide server capable of effectively monitoring real-time route information of a user. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the safe route guide server comprises: a map database storing map information; a safety information database storing safe location information including CCTV installation location information, emergency bell installation location information, police patrol route information, and 24-hour-open convenience store location information; a route generation part receiving route guide request information including starting point and destination information from a user terminal to generate a safe route between the starting point and the destination via at least one location in the safe location information based on the map information; a movement analysis part analyzing the movement of a user based on sensor information received from the user terminal; an abnormality detection part determining whether a dangerous situation occurs for the user based on movement information of the user analyzed by the movement analysis part; and a dangerous situation transmission part transmitting dangerous situation occurrence information to a preset external terminal if the abnormality detection part determines that a dangerous situation has occurred.

title_en: Led driving device and backlight driving device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the present invention relates to an LED driving technology and a backlight driving technology. By alternating the offset of a current source included in an LED driving device or a backlight driving device, the average of the offset appearing in the output current of the current source is minimized. The LED driving device includes: a current source circuit which changes the size of the offset current appearing in the output current according to a change in settings; a switch circuit which controls the connection between the current source circuit and the LED; and a control circuit which changes the settings of the current source circuit at least once in the predetermined time period so that the average of the offset current supplied to the LED in the predetermined time period is within a certain range.

title_en: Massage chair control system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a massage chair control system. One embodiment of the present invention comprises: a massage chair main body performing a massage motion in a preset or selected mode by a user while the user is seated; a camera capturing an image of the user's face while the massage chair main body performs the massage motion; an AI calculation unit communicating with the camera to receive the user's facial image and applying an artificial intelligence image analysis algorithm to the image to determine the user's facial expression as one of a plurality of predefined expressions; and a control unit receiving the facial expression determined by communicating with the AI calculation unit and controlling the massage main chair body to change the massage motion based on the determined facial expression. According to the present invention, the massage intensity can be changed without any separate manipulation or change in posture by the user.

title_en: Top notch slit profile for mems device
abstract_en: Various embodiments of the present invention relate to a microelectromechanical system (MEMS) device in which a slit in a movable mass of a MEMS device has a top notch slit profile. The MEMS devices can be, for example, speakers, actuators, etc. The slit extends from the top to the bottom through the movable mass and has a uniform or substantially uniform width from the bottom of the movable mass to near the top of the movable mass. Additionally, according to the top notch slit profile, the upper corner part of a MEMS substrate at the slit is notched, such that the width of the slit bulges at the top of the movable mass. For example, the top notch slit profile can increase a process window for removing adhesive from the slit during forming a MEMS device.

title_en: Organic light emitting display panel including temperature sensor
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention may provide an organic light emitting display panel comprising: a substrate wherein a plurality of pixels are disposed; a temperature sensor disposed so as to correspond to the plurality of pixels and outputting a current according to a temperature; an insulating layer disposed on the plurality of pixels; and a touch sensor disposed on the insulating layer, wherein the temperature sensor is disposed on a first surface of the insulating layer and disposed between the insulating layer and the substrate, and the touch sensor is disposed on a second surface of the insulating layer. Therefore, the present invention is capable of providing the organic light emitting display panel comprising the temperature sensor that can measure the temperature.

title_en: Smart Video Display For Preventing Traffic Accidents Between Pedestrians And Right-turning Vehicles At crosswalks Based On Deep Learning Technology
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart video providing display board for preventing traffic accidents between pedestrians and right-turning vehicles on a crosswalk based on deep learning technology. The present invention prevents a driver driving a large vehicle from hitting a pedestrian directly in front when making a right turn. This smart video providing display board for preventing traffic accidents between pedestrians and right-turning vehicles on a crosswalk based on deep learning technology includes a traffic light unit, a screen output module, a video shooting output unit, and a sound unit.

title_en: Stained Broadcast Advertising with Extensions
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a stand type billboard having an extension function, comprising: a frame (101) in which elbows (12, 13) are respectively installed at upper ends of both longitudinal frames (1, 11) spaced apart at a certain interval to connect an upper transverse frame (2), and connecting pipe bodies (3, 31) having a horizontal pipe (P) on one side are respectively installed at lower ends of the longitudinal frames (1, 11) to connect a lower transverse frame (21); rotating connection pipe bodies (4, 41, 42, 43) installed on upper and lower lines of the longitudinal frames (1, 11), respectively, and having a horizontal tube (P) protruding from one side thereof; and a base (102) installed on an end extending downwardly from the lower end of the longitudinal frame (1, 11), wherein the elbows (12, 13), connection pipe bodies (3, 31), and rotating connection pipe bodies (4, 41, 42, 43) each comprise a fixing piece (201) on one side, and a hanging hole (202) on the other side. The present invention provides multi-directional advertisement visibility and allows simultaneous advertisement effects to passersby in multiple directions.

title_en: Method for Image Data Preprocessing and Neural Network Model for virtual space sound of realistic contents and computer program thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method, neural network model, and computer program for pre-processing data and more specifically, relates to the method, neural network model, and computer program for processing data for pre-processing data for a neural network model that pre-process analysis data for a space and perform learning, and enable to implement a virtual space sound for a realistic content. In the present invention, disclosed is the method for processing a space sound neural network comprising: a data calculating step of calculating, by a space sound neural network processing device, data for the space or one or more objects equipped in the space from one or more images for the space; a pre-processing performing step of performing pre-processing for one part or all among the calculated data; and a neural network learning step of learning a neural network for space sound processing using the pre-processed data.

title_en: Electronic device including indicator label
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electronic device including an indicator label, which can enable a user to easily check whether moisture is introduced into the electronic device. The electronic device according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises: a housing which includes a through-hole connecting the outside of the electronic device and an inside of the electronic device; a printed circuit board which is disposed in the housing; an interface bracket which has one portion disposed in the through-hole and has the other portion facing one surface of the printed circuit board; a sealing member which covers the one portion of the interface bracket and comes in contact with an inner surface of the through-hole; and an indicator label which covers the one surface of the printed circuit board and a side of the printed circuit board facing the through-hole. The indicator label can be deformed by moisture introduced through the through-hole from the outside of the electronic device.

title_en: Display apparatus
abstract_en: A display apparatus according to an embodiment of the present specification comprises: a display panel including a display area displaying an image and a non-display area surrounding the display area; a sound-generating device disposed on the rear side of the display panel and generating sound by vibrating the display panel. The sound-generating device comprises a first structure, and a second structure disposed above or under the first structure. The second structure is configured to have a first part having piezoelectric properties and a second part disposed between the first parts and having flexibility. The present invention provides a sound-generating device capable of reducing the impact of an external shock and improving flexibility and sound pressure.

title_en: Wireless charging device with USB-PD function
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a wireless charging device comprises: a rectangular shielding assembly in which a primary coil for transmitting power to a terminal including a secondary coil by magnetic induction coupling with a shielding unit is formed; a main PCB including an inverter for converting DC power into AC power and supplying the AC power to the primary coil; and a sub PCB attached to one corner of the shielding assembly and including a C-type USB port. The sub PCB may be disposed outside the primary coil. The C-type USB port may be exposed in a direction perpendicular to a plane on which the terminal is placed.

title_en: Inverter circuit, scan driving circuit and display device
abstract_en: An inverter circuit in a scan driving circuit of a display device includes an output transistor connected between a first voltage line and an output terminal outputting a second start signal and having a gate electrode connected to an input terminal receiving the first start signal, a first switching transistor connected between the first voltage line and the output terminal and having a gate electrode connected to a first switching line receiving a first switching signal, a second switching transistor connected between the output terminal and a first node and having a gate electrode connected to a second switching line receiving a second switching signal, and a discharge circuit that discharges the first node with the second bias clock signal in response to the first start signal, the first bias clock signal, and the second bias clock signal.

title_en: Video surveillance device capable of capturing clear images without being affected by external light
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a video surveillance apparatus. The video surveillance device according to an embodiment of the present invention may record a clear video without being affected by external light. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the video surveillance device comprises: a camera unit recording a video; an illuminance sensor unit including one or more illuminance sensors; a light source position estimation unit estimating a position of a light source based on illuminance output from the illuminance sensor, and determining back light or plain light in accordance with the position of the light source; a recording control unit changing a recording setting of the camera unit in accordance with whether the back light or the plain light is present; and a posture control unit rotating the camera unit up, down, left, and right.

title_en: Scan Signal Generation Circuit and Display Device including the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides a scan signal generation circuit which comprises: a shift register including a first scan signal generation unit outputting a first scan signal and a second scan signal generation unit outputting a second scan signal; and a modulation transistor included in the shift register. the modulation transistor modulates a level of the first scan signal outputted from the first scan signal generation unit in response to a signal supplied from the outside.

title_en: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR DISPLAY FIELD COMMUNICATION PERFORMING image correction based on A deep learning algorithm AND COMPUTER PROGRAM FOR THE SAME
abstract_en: The present specification relates to a screen-based communication method performed by a receiving device for a screen-based communication, which comprises the steps of: receiving, by the receiving device, an input image obtained by photographing a screen on which an image including a data insertion image frame into which input data is inserted and a reference image frame is displayed; correcting, by the receiving device, an image distorted from the input image based on a deep learning algorithm; converting, by the receiving device, the corrected input image into frequency domain information; and restoring, by the receiving device, the input data by subtracting the reference image frame converted into the frequency domain information from the data insertion image frame converted into the frequency domain information.

title_en: Sound generating device
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present specification, a display device comprises: a display module having a display panel displaying an image; and a first sound generating device disposed on a rear surface of the display panel. the first sound generating device includes a first vibration generating element and a second vibration generating element disposed adjacent to the first vibration generating element. the first vibration generating element vibrates a central area of the first sound generating device by a signal applied to the first sound generating device, and the second vibration generating element vibrates an edge of the display panel.

title_en: A method and an apparatus for processing a video signal
abstract_en: The present invention is to improve the coding efficiency of a video signal. The present invention provides a simplified method for determining motion vector precision. The method and device for processing a video signal according to the present invention may improve image encoding/decoding efficiency.

title_en: Actuator for optical image stabilization and camera module including the same
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an actuator for shake correction comprises: a sensor substrate on which an image sensor having an imaging surface is disposed; a fixed frame accommodating the sensor substrate; a moving frame accommodated in the fixed frame and movable in a direction parallel to the imaging surface; a first ball member disposed between the fixed frame and the moving frame and supporting the movement of the moving frame; and a first driving unit disposed on the moving frame and the fixed frame and providing a driving force to the moving frame. The sensor substrate includes a moving unit coupled to the moving frame, a fixing unit coupled to the fixed frame, and a plurality of bridges movably supporting the moving unit. the plurality of bridges extend along the circumference of the moving unit. The sensor substrate can include a first support unit connecting the plurality of bridges and the fixing unit, and a second support unit connecting the plurality of bridges and the moving unit.

title_en: A kit for measuring the dimensions of window frames
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a window frame diagnosis kit capable of diagnosing the size of a window frame by using a diagnosis card on which window frame information is printed even if the size of the window frame constructed on a wall is not known. The window frame diagnosis kit comprises one or more diagnosis card having diagnostic information printed on one side thereof, the diagnostic card having a lower side thereof adapted to match the bottom of a window frame corresponding to the printed window frame information.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a display device comprising: first pixels located in a first pixel area and connected to first scan lines; first scan stage circuits located in a first peripheral area existing outside the first pixel area and supplying a first scan signal to the first scan lines; second pixels located in a second pixel area and connected to second scan lines; and second scan stage circuits located in a second peripheral area existing outside the second pixel area and supplying a second scan signal to the second scan lines, wherein an interval between the second scan stage circuits is larger than an interval between the first scan stage circuits.

title_en: Printed circuit board
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a printed circuit board comprising: a first insulating layer having a first surface and a second surface facing each other in a first direction; a first wiring layer disposed on the first surface side of the first insulating layer; a second wiring layer disposed on the second surface side of the first insulating layer; a second insulating layer having a third surface and a fourth surface facing each other in the first direction, and disposed on the first insulating layer so that the third surface is connected to the second surface; a third wiring layer disposed on the fourth surface side of the second insulating layer; a first cavity penetrating at least a part of the first insulating layer from the first surface or the second surface in the first direction; and a second cavity penetrating at least a part of the second insulating layer in the first direction and connected to the first cavity, wherein the first and second cavities have different slopes of a wall surface, and the depth of the first cavity with respect to the first direction is smaller than the thickness of the first insulating layer and thicker than the thickness of each of the first and second wiring layers.

title_en: Antenna module implemented in multi-layer package
abstract_en: An antenna module includes: a PCB including a plurality of layers; an array antenna unit including a plurality of antenna elements disposed on the PCB, and a plurality of signal connection lines configured to electrically connect from an RFIC chip to the array antenna unit. Each of the plurality of antenna elements may have a two-patch antenna structure, and first and second groups of second patch antennas disposed inside the PCB may be disposed in first and second regions with respect to a center line of an inner layer in which the second patch antennas are disposed.

title_en: Original plate cell inspection system of IT OLED
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system for inspecting OLED cells on a substrate, capable of performing lighting inspection and aging on OLED cells on a substrate. The present invention relates to a system for inspecting cells within an OLED substrate, wherein a plurality of OLED cells are arranged in row and column directions. The system comprises: an operating terminal configured to determine and command a lighting inspection or aging inspection mode for the OLED cells, wherein the OLED cells are formed with a plurality of common pads for signal input, the common pads having a plurality of pins to which AC/DC signals, positive/negative power, and RGB signals are input; a plurality of signal generators that generate and provide AC/DC signals, positive/negative power, and RGB signals for cell inspection according to the operating terminal operation mode; a plurality of stick bars; and a switching block coupled to the side of the stick bars and distributing the signals provided by the signal generators to each probe block of the stick bars. According to the present invention, lighting inspection and aging can be performed on a substrate on which a plurality of OLED cells are formed, and inspection can be performed without equipment replacement, regardless of the size of the OLED cells formed on the substrate or the number of common pads formed in each cell.

title_en: A Method for manufacuturing and displaying a real type 2D video information program including a video, a audio, a caption and a message information
abstract_en: Provided is a method for producing real-type 2D video information, which comprises the steps of: photographing a real person or a video of a real subject in 2D; extracting motion information from the photographed real-type 2D video; producing audio information, message information, subtitle information, and message information of an MP3 method synchronized with the motion information, respectively; producing independent real-type 2D video information including at least one of the motion information, the audio information, the message information, and the subtitle information together or producing each independent real-type 2D video information; and producing a meta file including information necessary for producing and executing the motion information, music information, subtitle information, or message information of the real object included in the real-type 2D video information.
