abstract_en: A system for wireless communication is provided, the system comprising at least one unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) and two or more transceivers, of which at least one is a handheld transceiver (HTT), - the UAV including: a housing which includes a lower end, an upper end and a body therebetween; a first antenna proximate to a lower end; a second antenna proximate to the upper end; and a drone control system which is housed in the body, the drone control system including a drone microprocessor, a repeater module, a flight control module, a transceiver module and onboard sensor modules, the modules in electronic communication with the drone microprocessor, a receiving antenna and a transmitting antenna in electronic communication with the repeater module, and - the HTT including: a body, which includes at least one button or knob or keyboard and an antenna; an HHT microprocessor; an HHT module, which includes an HTT  antenna;  and a transceiver module, which include a transceiver antenna, the modules in electronic communication with the HTT microprocessor, wherein the HHT module is configured for radio communication with the repeater module of the UAV and the transceiver module is configured for separate radio communication with the transceiver module of the UAV.

title_en: Improving network transmit power profile by randomizing resource grants on a multi-user communications network
abstract_en: Schedulers that allocate resource grants on a slot-by-slot basis within a scheduling epoch or frame can create a front-loading effect where allocations occur more frequently in slots earlier in frames. To address these and other issues, systems and methods are disclosed for scheduling resource grants in a network to improve network transmit power profiles. For example, a scheduler is configured to randomize the order of slots in a scheduling epoch or frame, with different randomizations for different schedulers, to more evenly distribute slots with resource grant allocations to prevent or reduce a front-loading effect. As another example, the scheduler is configured to randomize start times of resource blocks within a slot to prevent or reduce the front-loading effect.

title_en: Coordinating user equipment selection
abstract_en: Methods, devices, systems, and means for selection of a coordinating user equipment, UE, (111) in a user equipment-coordination set, UECS, that facilitates selection of the coordinating UE (111) by the UEs (110) in the UECS are described herein. Sharing of the role of coordinating UE (111) by UEs (110) in the UECS can be scheduled in a round-robin manner. Selection criteria can be used to determine which one or more UEs (110) in the UECS will offer better performance in the role of coordinating UE (111).

title_en: Magnetic-inductive wireless detonator with quantum receiver
abstract_en: There are currently two types of electronic detonators: wired and wireless. Wired detonators are very bulky, particularly in underground mines. Current wireless detonators, referred to as magnetic-inductive detonators, have a much greater diameter than wired detonators, are much more costly to produce, and the process of drilling into rock in order to place them in position is much longer and more expensive. The present invention relates to a wireless, magnetic-inductive detonator provided with a quantum radio incorporating a micro diamond (2) doped with nitrogen. Said quantum radio consists of a quantum receiver comprising one or more integrated circuits, incorporating in particular the micro diamond (2) and a microwave antennae system (5) that enables an increase in the magnetic field detection sensitivity in the picotesla range.

title_en: Dosing ink for digital printing on reflective substrates
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method is provided for dosing ink in a digital printing device with multiple ink channels, when printing on a reflective substrate. A digital printing system configured with the method is also provided. Target color data of a target color to be printed on the reflective substrate is captured, including both color data and spectral reflectance data. The captured color data is processed with a printer model to output a preliminary dosing ratio for each ink channel. A digital opacity value for the target color is computed from the dosing ratio of each ink channel. A natural opacity value for the for the target color is computed from the captured spectral reflectance data, and a difference between the digital and natural opacity values is calculated. A predicted dosing ratio for each ink channel is obtained by interpolating the difference against an ink step of a diffuse ink component of the target color.

title_en: Method for generating image and image processing equipment
abstract_en: A method for generating an image includes the steps of: sequentially obtaining 1 st to Nth scanning images, wherein N is a positive integer greater than 2; processing the 1 st to Nth scanned images to obtain the sizes of the 1 st to Nth document images and the 1 st to Nth document images; and performing sequential file layout according to the sequential accumulation sizes of the 1 st to Nth document images to generate image data corresponding to the plurality of output pages. An image processing apparatus is also provided. Therefore, the waste caused by printing the small-size document image on the large-size paper can be avoided, and the user can know the arrangement sequence of the documents according to the arrangement sequence of the output pages, so the invention can provide a direct copying technical scheme meeting the environmental protection requirement, and can further adjust the output result.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted 4G active integrated gain antenna
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle-mounted 4G active integrated gain antenna which comprises a PCB antenna module, an active gain amplification module and a terminal radio frequency input RF IN module. The vehicle-mounted 4G active integrated gain antenna provided by the invention has the advantages that the PCB antenna module and the active gain amplification module form an integrated structure, so that the gain is improved, the signal strength of the 4G communication network signal in transmitting and receiving is improved, and the installation is convenient; the problem of unstable signal reception of the vehicle-mounted 4G communication network is solved, the reception and the transmission of the 4G communication network signals can be enhanced under the vehicle-mounted environment, and the method has an application prospect.

title_en: Pin control method and intelligent terminal
abstract_en: The application provides a pin control method, wherein a switch control circuit and a charging control circuit are arranged in an intelligent terminal, and the charging control circuit is positioned between a volume key switch and a volume interface of the intelligent terminal and is connected with the switch control circuit; the switch control circuit is positioned between the forced download control pin of the intelligent terminal and the control power supply. When the volume key switch is in a closed state, the charging control circuit discharges, and the switch control circuit is switched on after the discharging is finished, so that the forced downloading control pin is in short circuit with the control power supply. Therefore, according to the technical scheme, the intelligent terminal can enter the forced downloading mode only through the volume key switch, so that a complex whole machine dismounting process in the prior art is avoided, and the cost in the process of repairing the mobile phone is reduced.

title_en: Electrical appliance for wireless transmission of measurement signals between base and machine body
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric appliance for wireless transmission of measurement signals between a base and an appliance body, which comprises an appliance body, a base, a sensor module arranged on the appliance body and used for detecting physical signals when the appliance body works, a signal composite circuit arranged on the appliance body, a wireless transmitting end, a main control module arranged on the base and a wireless receiving end, wherein the signal composite circuit is respectively electrically connected with the sensor module and the wireless transmitting end, the wireless receiving end is electrically connected with the main control module, the signal composite circuit is used for sampling one or more signals output by the sensor module and compounding the signals into pulse signals, the signal composite circuit transmits the detection signals to the wireless transmitting end for wirelessly transmitting the detection signals to the wireless receiving end, and the design directly compounds analog signals transmitted by the sensor module into the pulse signals and then transmits the pulse signals through the wireless transmitting end, simple structure, transmission is swift.

title_en: Ka-band MIMO (multiple input multiple output) transceiver for cloud target detection experiment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Ka-band MIMO (multiple input multiple output) transceiver for a cloud target detection experiment, which comprises a signal sending module and a signal receiving module, wherein the signal sending module is used for sending a signal to a target; the signal sending module comprises an up-conversion mixer, a Ka-band-pass filter and a multi-channel switch selection output unit which are sequentially connected; the multi-channel switch selection output unit comprises an output selection switch, a first switch driving unit and at least 2 signal output branches; the signal receiving module comprises a multi-channel switch selection input unit, a low-noise amplifier, a down-conversion mixer, a low-pass filter and an intermediate frequency amplifier which are connected in sequence; the multi-channel switch selection input unit comprises an input selection switch, a second switch driving unit and at least 2 signal input branches. The invention can receive and transmit electromagnetic waves from a plurality of receiving channels, and convert received echo signals from millimeter wave signals into intermediate frequency signals, thereby facilitating the subsequent processing of the echo signals.

title_en: Electromagnetic wave left-right-handed circular polarization converter with planar structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plane structure electromagnetic wave left-right circular polarization converter, wherein first resonance units are arranged on the top surface of a first dielectric layer at intervals, the bottom surface of the first dielectric layer, a transmission preventing layer and the top surface of a second dielectric layer are sequentially connected, and the second resonance units and the first resonance units are correspondingly arranged on the back surface of the second dielectric layer at intervals; the first resonance unit and the second resonance unit are both provided with open metal rings, two metallized through holes are symmetrically arranged at the openings of the open metal rings, through holes are formed in positions, corresponding to each group of metallized through holes, on the transmission-preventing layer, of the first resonance unit, and the two metallized through holes sequentially penetrate through the first dielectric layer, the through holes on the transmission-preventing layer, the second dielectric layer and the two metallized through holes on the second resonance unit. Compared with the traditional polarization converter, the invention has simple structure and high efficiency.

title_en: Card holder, plug-in device and terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a card holder, a plug-in device and a terminal. The card holds in the palm and is used for installing the data card, and the card holds in the palm including chuck, slider and elastic component. The chuck is formed with draw-in groove and spout, and the draw-in groove is used for holding the data card, spout and draw-in groove intercommunication. The sliding block can slide along the sliding groove. The elastic piece is connected with the sliding block, the elastic piece is fixed on the chuck, and the elastic piece extrudes the sliding block in a deformation state so that the sliding block abuts against the data card. The plug-in device comprises a card seat and a card holder. The terminal includes a card holder. In foretell card holds in the palm, grafting device and terminal, the elastic component can extrude the slider under deformation state to make the slider can support when the data card holds in the draw-in groove and hold the data card, and then the data card can install on the card holds in the palm more firmly, and the data card can not break away from the card when the upset card holds in the palm.

title_en: Door entering and exiting voice intelligent playing system based on user identification
abstract_en: The invention provides a voice intelligent playing system based on user door entrance and exit, which is characterized in that a user personal information or interest list is preset; when the door is opened, the monitoring device identifies the electronic equipment entering the door through the monitoring information of the electronic equipment in the door opening process, identifies the user information entering the door according to the information of the electronic equipment entering the door, and controls the voice output device to play the voice information related to the user interest list; or when the door is opened, the monitoring device identifies the electronic equipment through the monitoring information of the electronic equipment in the door opening process, identifies the user information according to the information of the electronic equipment, and controls the voice output device to play the voice information related to the user interest list. According to the invention, in the process of entering and exiting the home, the corresponding voice information is automatically played according to the interest and hobby of the family, and the voice playing is integrated into the scene of entering and exiting the home, so that the utilization of fragmentation time is improved, and the experience of smart life is brought.

title_en: Suspension device
abstract_en: A suspension device comprises a shell, a suspension belt and at least one rotating assembly, wherein the shell is provided with at least one first accommodating cavity for accommodating the at least one rotating assembly, one end of the suspension belt is fixed on the rotating assembly and wound on the rotating assembly, and the rotating assembly can rotate relative to the shell under the driving of the suspension belt and has resilience. The side wall of the first accommodating cavity is provided with a first through hole, the side wall of the shell is provided with a first opening, and the other end of the suspension belt penetrates through the first through hole and passes through the first opening to be connected with the shell. The suspension device can facilitate a user to pull out the suspension band at any time for use or withdraw the suspension band at any time, has a unique structure and can bring great convenience to the user.

title_en: Method and system for controlling sensitive data request
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for controlling a sensitive data request, wherein when an application program needs to access sensitive data, the method can select the accessed sensitive data, select the sensitive data which can not be accessed, and shield the sensitive data which can not be accessed, so that the application program can not obtain shielded sensitive data, therefore, the application program can selectively obtain some sensitive data, and the privacy of a user is protected from being disclosed.

title_en: Control method and system for 3D cube mobile terminal desktop and mobile terminal
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a system for controlling a 3D cube mobile terminal desktop and a mobile terminal, wherein the method for controlling the 3D cube mobile terminal desktop comprises the following steps: dragging a plurality of virtual cubes to be arranged and combined, establishing at least one 3D virtual cube model, and storing the 3D virtual cube model in a model library; calling a 3D virtual cube model from the model library; and respectively setting application icons on the exposed surfaces of the 3D virtual cube model, generating a 3D cube desktop with the 3D cube application model, and clicking different application icons to enter corresponding application interfaces. According to the invention, the plurality of virtual cubes are dragged to be arranged and combined to establish the 3D virtual cube model, the 3D cubes are used for replacing the 3D magic cube, various cubes can be generated to serve as carriers of application icons, a user is supported to carry out self-definition, and the user can directly and freely edit and operate the cubes from the number, the shape, the arrangement and combination and the appearance color style, so that the individual requirements of the user are met.

title_en: Interference-based resource allocation
abstract_en: It is desirable to mitigate the effects of uplink interference, particularly in indoor systems. According to a first aspect, a method performed in a wireless communication network is provided. The method comprises the following steps: during a time period Ti, a cumulative uplink interference is obtained over a frequency spectrum associated with an uplink communication channel of the wireless communication network. The method further comprises dividing the frequency spectrum into at least a first range and a second range based on the obtained characteristics of the accumulated interference. The method also includes applying different rules to allocate resources to the wireless device in the first range and the second range for uplink communication in the channel.

title_en: Apparatus, computer readable medium, and method for changing service using advanced data collection capability
abstract_en: A method for presenting services to a subscriber includes a specific process. The method includes collecting usage data associated with an account of a subscriber associated with a portable device. The method includes storing the usage data in an information repository. The method includes determining whether the usage data satisfies a condition. The method includes determining whether there is data for an actionable category. The method includes determining an action based on the actionable category of data and a set of rules. The method includes receiving a first message from a portable device, the first message indicating that a communication function of the portable device has terminated. The method includes sending a second message to the portable device, the second message requesting input from the subscriber via the portable device, and the second message being based on an action. The method includes receiving a third message from the portable device, the third message including a response to the second message.

title_en: Miniaturized dual-frequency dual-polarized filter antenna with high isolation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a miniaturized dual-frequency dual-polarized filter antenna with high isolation, which comprises a reflecting floor, a filter patch antenna unit and bowl-shaped filter symmetrical array antenna units, wherein the filter patch antenna unit comprises a first layer of metal sheet and a second layer of metal sheet, and the first layer of metal sheet is arranged above the reflecting floor; the bowl-shaped filtering symmetrical array antenna unit comprises four symmetrical array antenna units, and the four symmetrical array antenna units have the same structure and are respectively positioned at the edges of the first layer of metal sheet. By using the filter antenna unit without external loss circuit as the basic component unit of the dual-frequency dual-polarized filter antenna, the mutual coupling between the two frequency band antennas can be reduced by utilizing the filter characteristic, the isolation between the two working frequency bands is improved, the insertion loss introduced by the filter is eliminated, and the gain of the antenna is further improved.

title_en: Method, system, and medium for checking the frequency spectrum of at least one other radio frequency signal
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and media for checking the spectrum of at least one other radio frequency signal. A method (600) for removing an extracted RF signal (122) to examine the spectrum of at least one other RF signal comprises: the mixed signal (108) is received (602) by the ADC (112). The mixed signal includes a plurality of individual source signals (104a-104n) from different signal sources (106a-106 n). The mixed signal is digitized by the ADC (606). The same first digitized signal (116) and second digitized signal (120) are generated. The first digitized signal is delayed (608) by a predetermined time delay and the second digitized signal is processed (610) in a neuromorphic signal processor (118) to extract the extracted signal (122). The predetermined time delay corresponds to a delay embedded (204) in a neuromorphic signal processor. The phase delay and amplitude of the extracted signal are adjusted (614) based on the phase delay and amplitude of the first digitized signal. The conditioned extracted signal (130) is canceled (616) from the first digitized signal to provide an input check signal (134) for checking.

title_en: 5G broadband notch circularly polarized antenna
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 5G broadband notch circularly polarized antenna, which comprises a dielectric substrate, a metal reflecting plate, a metal radiation patch group and a coaxial line feed structure, wherein the dielectric substrate is arranged on the dielectric substrate; the metal reflecting plate is positioned below the dielectric substrate, and the metal radiation patch group consists of 2  n  The same rectangular patches with a chamfer are formed, n is a natural number except zero, one half of the rectangular patches are distributed on the upper surface of the medium substrate in a half-circumference array mode, the other half of the rectangular patches are distributed on the lower surface of the medium substrate in a half-circumference array mode, the two half-rectangular patch groups can be combined to form a whole circle distribution, the chamfer of each patch is just overlapped on the circumference, two adjacent patches in each half-rectangular patch group are connected through a microstrip line, and each patch is etched with a thin seam and a notch; the coaxial line feed structure feeds the metal radiation patch group through the metal reflecting plate. The invention has the advantages of wide frequency band, simple structure, easy processing, low cost and the like.

title_en: Antenna assembly and electronic device
abstract_en: The invention provides an antenna assembly which comprises at least one section of frame body on a metal middle frame, a display screen supporting frame and at least one radio frequency circuit electrically connected with the at least one section of frame body, wherein a plurality of partitions are arranged on the metal middle frame and divide the metal middle frame into the at least one section of frame body, the display screen supporting frame is arranged in a space enclosed by the metal middle frame, a display screen is arranged on the display screen supporting frame, and the end face, facing the at least one section of frame body, of the display screen supporting frame is closer to the at least one section of frame body than the end face, facing the at least one section of frame body, of the display screen supporting frame is closer to the at least one section of frame body. The invention also provides an electronic device provided with the antenna assembly.

title_en: High-power MBUS master controller circuit
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-power MBUS master controller circuit which comprises a host sending circuit and a host receiving circuit, wherein the host sending circuit comprises a direct current power supply and a sending control circuit, the host receiving circuit comprises a sampling resistor, a pre-stage filtering differential amplifying circuit and a signal output circuit, the pre-stage filtering differential amplifying circuit comprises a pre-stage filtering circuit and a differential amplifying circuit, the differential amplifying circuit comprises an operational amplifier, the pre-stage filtering circuit comprises a first filtering circuit and a second filtering circuit, and the first filtering circuit and the second filtering circuit respectively output to the operational amplifier and provide voltage output differential amplifying signals through the operational amplifier. The circuit has simple design, the power supply current is more than 3A, the sampling resistor with low resistance value and the high-precision differential amplifying circuit are adopted to inhibit the interference of common mode signals, improve the stability of received signals and increase the load number of slave nodes.

title_en: Voice verification method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a voice verification method, a voice verification device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of identifying first voice data by acquiring the first voice data, intercepting voice password data containing a preset voice password from the voice data when the first voice data is identified to contain the preset voice password, extracting voiceprint characteristics of the voice password data, matching the voiceprint characteristics with the preset voiceprint characteristics, acquiring second voice data corresponding to a preset rule when matching is successful, identifying the second voice data, and when the second voice data is consistent with a preset target identification result, enabling the passing state of voice verification to be passed, otherwise, enabling the passing state of voice verification to be not passed. The voice data acquired for the first time is subjected to password verification and voiceprint verification, after the verification is passed, the corresponding voice data is acquired again according to the rule, the voice data is verified, whether the voice data passes or not is determined according to the verification result, and the safety of voice verification can be improved.

title_en: Method and apparatus for beam management in wireless communication system
abstract_en: Method and apparatus for beam management in a wireless communication system. In one embodiment, the method includes receiving a configuration, wherein the configuration indicates whether the user equipment performs beam management at a particular time interval. The method also includes determining whether to perform beam management at a particular time interval based at least on the configuration.

title_en: Message prompting method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a message prompting method and a device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: classifying the unread messages of the application program according to a preset class to generate application messages of at least one class; obtaining a display color corresponding to each category in the at least one category; counting the message quantity of the application messages of each category, and determining the display proportion of each category in a message prompt box of the application program according to the message quantity of the application messages of each category; and filling the message prompt box by adopting the display color corresponding to each category and according to the display proportion corresponding to each category, and displaying the filled message prompt box. By adopting the invention, the unread messages are prompted according to the categories, so that the effective prompt of the unread messages can be improved.

title_en: Transmit-receive radio frequency module with duplex half-duplex compatible mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a duplex half-duplex compatible mode transceiver radio frequency module, and belongs to the technical field of electronic information. It includes two modes of receiving and transmitting duplex and duplex half-duplex, and both modes can work simultaneously. The radio frequency module firstly separates frequencies of a duplex mode and a half duplex mode, and in a duplex mode radio frequency circuit, the receiving and transmitting frequencies are subjected to frequency diversity through a duplexer and enter respective radio frequency branches respectively; in the half-duplex radio frequency circuit, the receiving and transmitting signals are subjected to receiving and transmitting circuit diversity through a circulator or a switch, and signal switching is performed according to the working requirement. The transceiver radio frequency module can be used in the development of a phased array antenna array surface integrating communication and radar, effectively compatible with two types of signals of different working systems, and has important significance in practical engineering application.

title_en: Filtering wind noise in video content
abstract_en: Embodiments disclose filtering wind noise in video content. A method includes receiving video content comprising an audio component and a video component; detecting, by a processing device, an occurrence of a wind noise artifact in a segment of an audio component; identifying a duration of the wind noise artifact and a strength of the wind noise artifact; selecting, by the processing device, a wind noise substitution operation based on the identified duration and intensity of the wind noise artifact; and applying, by the processing device, the selected wind noise substitution operation to the segment of the audio component to remove wind noise artifacts from the segment.

title_en: Millimeter wave transceiver of ground base station for wireless communication of rail transit vehicle and ground
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of millimeter wave communication, and relates to a millimeter wave transceiver of a ground base station for wireless communication of a rail transit vehicle. The ground millimeter wave transceiver of the invention has a signal bandwidth of 1GHz, and provides effective and reliable support for realizing a vehicle-ground high-speed communication system with the speed reaching Gbit/s. The modularized and generalized design is adopted, the functional modules are shared to the greatest extent, and the number and the power consumption of equipment on the rod are reduced, so that the system construction cost is reduced, and the integrated design, the test and the productization of the system are convenient; the millimeter wave module and the microwave module which are arranged on the rod are vertically interconnected, so that the structure is compact, and the size is reduced; the system can be monitored in real time during operation, system calibration, fault early warning and fault rapid positioning are supported, signal power of a transmitting end and AGC of a receiving end can be dynamically adjusted, adaptability under different climates and environmental conditions is stronger, a certain engineering value is achieved, and the system can be popularized to solutions of high-speed communication of other rail traffic vehicles such as subways and the like.

title_en: Array antenna device and calibration method thereof
abstract_en: In the array antenna device of the present invention, a plurality of element antennas are connected to a transmission/reception module having a transmission circuit, a reception circuit, and a transmission/reception switching unit, and a transmission/reception control device controls the amplitude and phase of a signal passing through the transmission circuit and the reception circuit of each of the transmission/reception modules and switches transmission/reception, thereby, the signal for transmission from the signal transmitter is distributed to each of the transmission circuits by the distributor and transmitted, and the received signals from each of the reception circuits are combined by the combiner and the combined signal is received by the receiver, during the correction of each transceiver module, the detection signal obtained by detecting the amplitude and phase of the signal received by the receiver is corrected by using the mutual coupling amplitude and phase information in the space between the element antennas, and the correction is performed according to the corrected value.

title_en: Management system, management method, operation terminal, and control device
abstract_en: A management system, comprising: an operation terminal configured to perform remote operation of the device; and a control device configured to receive an access request from the operation terminal and to transmit a request command to the apparatus in response to receiving the access request. The operation terminal includes a user interface configured to notify a user of information specifying an expiration timing of a response waiting timer, which is a timer defining a transmission interval or a reception interval of the request command.

title_en: Downlink time-frequency synchronization method for low-earth-orbit satellite mobile communication system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a downlink time-frequency synchronization method of a low earth orbit satellite mobile communication system, which can solve the problem of time-frequency asynchronism caused by factors such as large frequency deviation, low signal-to-noise ratio and the like when an OFDM technology is applied to a low earth orbit satellite mobile communication scene; the method can use the main synchronization sequence specified by the LTE protocol to realize the downlink time-frequency synchronization of the low-orbit satellite mobile communication system; the method firstly carries out large-range time offset search according to a time offset estimation formula, then carries out small-range time-frequency two-dimensional search near a certain time offset peak value, and reduces the complexity compared with the method of directly carrying out time-frequency two-dimensional search on a likelihood function; the method uses the local synchronization sequence multiplied by the weight coefficient to carry out correlation operation with the receiving sequence to realize time offset search, when the frequency offset estimation range of the synchronization scene changes, only the weight coefficient needs to be correspondingly modified in the correlation operation, and the adaptability of the algorithm is greatly improved.

title_en: Ultra-large-caliber light-weight achromatic plane electromagnetic lens based on generalized catadioptric law
abstract_en: The invention provides an ultra-large-caliber light-weight achromatic plane electromagnetic lens based on a generalized catadioptric law, which comprises a horn feed source and a metamaterial electromagnetic modulation layer above the feed source; wherein, each layer of metamaterial comprises a dielectric film and non-periodically arranged metal resonance units printed on the front surface of the dielectric film. By utilizing the advantage that the electromagnetic response of the metamaterial to incident electromagnetic waves can be manually modulated, phase distribution required by achromatic focusing in a certain frequency band is obtained through an optimization algorithm, and then the response of the incident broadband electromagnetic waves is changed by utilizing metal resonance units with the same/different structures according to the phase distribution, so that the continuous achromatic focusing of the broadband is realized. The antenna adopts a light-weight thin-film metamaterial structure, and has the advantages of simple structure, large caliber, small thickness, light weight, large working bandwidth, low cost and the like. The distribution of the metal resonance units on the multilayer metamaterial is obtained through an optimization algorithm, and the calculation process is programmed and coded, so that the large-scale popularization is facilitated.

title_en: Device for performing polarization adjustment by using 180-degree dielectric phase shifter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for performing polarization adjustment by using a 180-degree dielectric phase shifter, which comprises the 180-degree phase shifter, a driven gear, a servo motor and a driving gear, wherein a motor shaft of the servo motor is connected with the driving gear, the driving gear is meshed with the driven gear, the 180-degree phase shifter is arranged on the driven gear, and circular waveguide joints are arranged at two ends of the 180-degree phase shifter. The present invention utilizes a circular waveguide 180 phase shifter to achieve polarization adjustment. The direct type transceiver converter can be guaranteed not to rotate, and cross polarization of transmitting and receiving frequency bands can be well guaranteed. And further reduces the polarization control gear and the motor, so that the whole antenna layout is more reasonable. The miniaturization of the communication-in-motion antenna is realized very easily.

title_en: Automatic change high-efficient answer sheet scanning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic high-efficiency answer sheet scanning device which comprises a control system, an information acquisition system, an adsorption moving mechanism, a clamping moving mechanism, a page turning trowelling mechanism, an anti-re-suction mechanism and a collecting device. Firstly, the adsorption moving mechanism moves to the upper part of the answer sheet, and a user sucks up the answer sheet to a clamping position. The clamp moving mechanism then moves to the clamp position, clamps the hard edge and moves to the scan area. The information acquisition system scans the page, the adsorption moving mechanism works again, the scanned page is lifted, meanwhile, the anti-re-adsorption mechanism works, and the pressing plate touches the lifted page answer sheet. When the trowelling frame moves to the clamping position, the sucker is loosened, and the trowelling frame continues to move rightwards. The second anti-re-sucking mechanism presses the turned page, the trowelling frame resets the first anti-re-sucking mechanism presses the answer sheet, the answer sheet is scanned again, the adsorption moving mechanism resets after the scanning of the answer sheet is completed, and the clamping moving device transfers the answer sheet to the automatic collecting device.

title_en: Base station sending method, terminal receiving method and random access method
abstract_en: A transmission method of a base station is provided. A base station configures a first resource for a Physical Downlink Control Channel (PDCCH). The base station includes configuration information of a first resource in a first Physical Broadcast Channel (PBCH). In addition, the base station transmits the first PBCH.

title_en: Magnetic antenna device for receiving underwater ultralow frequency signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a magnetic antenna device for receiving underwater ultralow frequency signals, which comprises an upper layer antenna array and a lower layer antenna array which are parallel up and down and are arranged at intervals; the upper antenna array comprises a first magnetic antenna, a second magnetic antenna, a third magnetic antenna and a fourth magnetic antenna which are distributed in a square shape in the same horizontal plane; the lower antenna array has the same structure as the upper antenna array, and slow wave materials are filled among the magnetic antennas. The invention adopts the design of array antennas, which are divided into an upper layer and a lower layer, can realize the omnidirectional receiving of signals, simultaneously, determines the incoming wave direction of the ultra-low frequency signals according to the directional filtering characteristics of the magnetic antennas and the difference of the output waveform intensity and the frequency spectrum intensity of each magnetic antenna, determines incoming wave signals collected by the upper magnetic antenna and the lower magnetic antenna close to the incoming wave as more credible samples at the moment, and processes the obtained samples through filtering and noise cancellation to obtain the ultra-low frequency signals.

title_en: Compact dual-linear polarization improved GREINACHER rectenna structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compact dual-linear polarization improved GREINACHER rectenna structure in wireless power transmission applications. The dual-linear polarized antenna comprises a dual-linear polarized antenna, an improved GREINACHER charge pump and a directional coupler; the improved GREINACHER charge pump comprises a first voltage multiplier and a second voltage multiplier which have the same circuit structure; the negative voltage V-output by the first voltage multiplier is equivalent to the positive voltage V+ output by the second voltage multiplier; the input and isolation ports of the directional coupler are connected with the horizontal polarization and vertical polarization ports of the dual-linear polarization antenna; the directional coupler is directly connected, and the coupling port is connected with the input ports of the first voltage multiplier and the second voltage multiplier. The invention has the beneficial effects that the problem of polarization mismatch among antennas in the wireless power transmission technology is effectively solved by combining the dual-line polarized antenna, the improved GREINACHER charge pump and the directional coupler. The invention can be applied to high-efficiency wireless power transmission system application.

title_en: Dual-frequency feed source assembly and dual-frequency microwave antenna
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-frequency feed source assembly and a double-frequency microwave antenna, wherein the double-frequency feed source assembly mainly comprises two coaxially arranged wave guide tubes, and the two wave guide tubes respectively provide microwave energy of two different frequency bands for radiation parts of feed so that the antenna can work in different frequency bands at the same time. The combination of two coaxial waveguides, reflecting surfaces and other structures can form different microwave antennas, such as a feedforward double-frequency microwave antenna, a feedback Cassegrain double-frequency microwave antenna and the like. The invention feeds microwave energy through the two waveguides, so that the antenna can work in two frequency bands at the same time, thereby greatly expanding the application range of the microwave antenna.

title_en: Method and device for detecting reverse connection of antenna feeder of base station
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a device for detecting the antenna feed reverse of a base station, relates to the field of antenna detection, and can simply and quickly detect the antenna feed reverse condition of the base station. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring the work parameters of a base station and call record data of each cell corresponding to the base station; acquiring longitude and latitude of an MR sampling point of each cell by using a fingerprint database positioning method according to the working parameters of the base station and the call record data of each cell; calculating the simulation azimuth angle of the MR sampling point of each cell and the simulation azimuth angle of each cell according to the longitude and latitude of the MR sampling point of each cell; determining whether the antenna feeder of the base station is connected reversely and the type of the antenna feeder of the base station is connected reversely according to a preset rule according to an included angle between the direction corresponding to the simulated azimuth angle of the target cell and the direction corresponding to the working parameter azimuth angle in the working parameters of each cell; and when the antenna feeder of the base station is determined to be reversely connected, calculating the confidence coefficient of the reverse antenna feeder of the target cell according to a preset formula.

title_en: Method and device for transmitting flight information
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for transmitting flight information. The method comprises the following steps: generating a switching request related signaling, wherein the switching request related signaling carries the flight path related information of the unmanned aerial vehicle; and sending the switching request related signaling to a target base station.

title_en: Method and device for configuring synchronization signal block in RMSI, storage medium, base station and user equipment
abstract_en: A method and device for configuring a synchronization signal block in an RMSI, a storage medium, a base station and user equipment, the method comprising the following steps: configuring time-frequency resource configuration information of a plurality of synchronous signal blocks in RMSI, wherein the time-frequency resource configuration information is used for indicating the time-frequency resource information of the plurality of synchronous signal blocks; and sending the RMSI to user equipment to enable the user equipment to determine the time-frequency resource information of each synchronization signal block based on the time-frequency resource configuration information in the RMSI. The scheme of the invention can set how to configure the time-frequency resources of a plurality of synchronous signal blocks in the RMSI, and in the configuration process, the bit number is adopted as little as possible to reduce the signaling overhead.

title_en: Configuration method of time frequency tracking reference signal, base station and computer readable medium
abstract_en: A configuration method of a time frequency tracking reference signal, a base station and a computer readable medium are provided. The configuration method comprises the following steps: configuring the time-frequency tracking reference signal and a CSI-RS quasi-common site or corresponding to the same antenna port; configuring a first portion of the time-frequency tracking reference signal to multiplex the CSI-RS; and configuring the second part of the time frequency tracking reference signal not to conflict with other reference signals of non-co-site-like sites. By applying the scheme, the time frequency tracking reference signal and the CSI-RS are configured to be quasi-co-sited or correspond to the same antenna port, and the first part of the time frequency tracking reference signal is further configured to multiplex the CSI-RS, so that the cost of the reference signal can be reduced, and the utilization rate of system resources is improved; by configuring that the second part of the time frequency tracking reference signal does not conflict with reference signals of other non-co-site sites, the UE can carry out accurate time frequency estimation, thereby obtaining better receiver performance.

title_en: Reminding method and mobile terminal
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a reminding method and a mobile terminal, relates to the technical field of communication, and aims to solve the problems that the safety coefficient of a user cannot be improved and the user experience is poor by the reminding method in the prior art. The reminding method comprises the following steps: receiving a first input of a user; responding to the first input, and controlling a TOF camera to acquire environmental data within a preset range; generating a dynamic 3D model diagram according to the acquired environment data; and if the dynamic 3D model graph is detected to comprise the preset dangerous object, sending a reminding signal. The reminding method in the embodiment of the invention is applied to the mobile terminal.

title_en: Data processing apparatus and data processing method
abstract_en: The present technology relates to a data processing apparatus and a data processing method that make it possible to operate digital TV broadcasting more flexibly. A data processing apparatus installed in a facility related to a broadcasting station and a data processing apparatus installed in a transmitting station exchange data obtained by processing a stream including control information, components, and variable length information and adding variable length information presence information indicating the presence or absence of the variable length information as transmission data transmitted via a communication line. The present technology is applicable to, for example, an inter-station transmission system between a broadcast station and a transmitting station.

title_en: Strip transmission line applied to L and S wave bands
abstract_en: The invention discloses a strip transmission line applied to L and S wave bands, which is characterized in that: contain metal casing, bottom metal level, medium basic unit, top layer metal level and metallization through-hole, the medium basic unit is fixed at the metal casing inboard, and the bottom metal level is fixed at medium basic unit downside, and the top layer metal level is fixed at medium basic unit upside, and a plurality of metallization through-holes set up in the middle of the medium basic unit and metallization through-hole both ends are connected with bottom metal level and top layer metal level respectively. The invention has simple structure, lower cost, convenient circuit design and debugging, easier processing and assembly, good electromagnetic wave transmission characteristic and lower circuit loss in L wave band and S wave band. The problems of high processing precision requirement, high cost or complex structure in the traditional scheme and the literature scheme are solved.

title_en: Antenna assembly and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an antenna module and electronic equipment, the antenna module includes: a first antenna for transmitting a first wireless fidelity signal and a second wireless fidelity signal; the second antenna is used for transmitting the wireless positioning signal and the third wireless fidelity signal; and the third antenna is used for transmitting the radio frequency signal of the first frequency band and transmitting a fourth wireless fidelity signal or the radio frequency signal of the second frequency band. In the antenna assembly, the first antenna may be configured to transmit wireless fidelity signals of two different frequencies, the second antenna may be configured to transmit one wireless fidelity signal, and the third antenna may be configured to transmit one wireless fidelity signal, so that the antenna assembly may form a MIMO (Multiple-Input Multiple-Output) antenna for wireless fidelity signals, thereby improving stability of an electronic device in transmitting wireless fidelity signals.

title_en: Ultra-wide bandwidth wave beam low-profile cavity-backed antenna structure
abstract_en: The invention provides an ultra-wide bandwidth beam low-profile cavity backed antenna structure which comprises a guide dielectric substrate, a feed substrate and a reflection cavity, wherein the guide dielectric substrate, the feed substrate and the reflection cavity are sequentially arranged from top to bottom, the feed substrate is of a multi-layer laminated substrate structure, and an upper feed substrate layer, a middle feed substrate layer and a lower feed substrate layer are laminated into a whole through a laminating process. The antenna structure breaks through the limitation of the working bandwidth of the existing low-profile cavity-backed slot antenna, the relative bandwidth can reach 40% -78%, higher gain can be achieved in the +/-65-degree direction, and the application occasions of the low-profile cavity-backed antenna are widened.

title_en: Adjustable mobile phone support
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of mobile phone fixing equipment, and provides an adjustable mobile phone support which comprises a base, a three-dimensional adjusting component, a telescopic clamping plate and a telescopic clamping plate, wherein the base can be placed on a platform, a magnifying glass is arranged on the base, one end of the three-dimensional adjusting component is rotatably connected with the base, one end of the telescopic clamping plate is rotatably connected with the three-dimensional adjusting component, the telescopic clamping plate is used for fixing a mobile phone, and when the three-dimensional adjusting component works, the relative positions of the telescopic clamping plate on an X axis, a Y axis and a Z axis can be changed. Compared with the prior art, the mobile phone bracket has the advantages that the telescopic clamping plate can clamp the mobile phone, the three-dimensional image adjusting assembly can change the relative positions of the mobile phone on the X axis, the Y axis and the Z axis according to the requirements of a user, so that the mobile phone bracket can be suitable for more scenes, the practicability of the mobile phone bracket is improved, and the use requirements of the user are met.

title_en: Detachable flexible screen mobile phone
abstract_en: The utility model provides a flexible screen cell-phone of detachable, including casing and flexible screen, the casing comprises last casing and lower casing, still be provided with positioning mechanism on the casing, it sets up the top surface at last casing to go up the flexible screen, lower flexible screen sets up the bottom surface at casing down, this cell-phone still includes and presss from both sides N additional casing of location between last casing and lower casing when last casing and lower casing left and right sides are connected, all be provided with additional flexible screen on the top surface of every additional casing, be provided with the coupling mechanism that can be connected with casing or another additional casing on the lateral part of every additional casing, when last casing and lower casing are connected from top to bottom, leave the logical chamber that can fold additional casing between the top surface of the bottom surface of last casing and lower casing. The invention has the advantages that: when the upper shell and the lower shell are arranged left and right, the additional shell can be clamped and fixed between the upper shell and the lower shell, and a screen larger than the original large-screen mobile phone is obtained.

title_en: Magnetic coupling device with reflective plate and method of use thereof
abstract_en: Aspects of the present disclosure may include, for example, a coupling device including a receiving portion that receives a radio frequency signal conveying data from a transmitting device. A magnetic coupler magnetically couples the radio frequency signal to a transmission medium as a guided electromagnetic wave confined by an outer surface of the transmission medium. The cap includes a dielectric portion that secures the transmission medium adjacent to the magnetic coupler and a reflective plate that reduces electromagnetic emissions from the magnetic coupler. Other embodiments are disclosed.

title_en: Rotary joint and microwave universal test cable assembly
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rotary joint and a microwave universal test cable assembly, wherein the rotary joint comprises a hollow first fixed side main body, a rotatable hollow second fixed side main body is coaxially sleeved in the first fixed side main body, the first fixed side main body and the second fixed side main body are both made of conductor materials, a first central conductor is penetrated in the first fixed side main body, a second central conductor is penetrated in the second fixed side main body, insulating rings are fixedly arranged at gaps between the first fixed side main body and the first central conductor and between the second fixed side main body and the second central conductor, a plurality of through holes penetrating the insulating rings along the axial direction are formed in the insulating rings, and the first central conductor and the second central conductor are in rotary contact. 360-degree rotation can be realized through the rotary joint, and then universal adjustment of the microwave universal test cable assembly can be realized, so that the test requirements of various tested pieces can be met.

title_en: Method and device for measuring wireless link, terminal, base station and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for measuring a wireless link, a terminal, a base station and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the terminal receives configuration information of a downlink reference signal, wherein the configuration information comprises at least one of the following: information of configuration parameters, coupling relation between different configuration parameters; and the terminal carries out the measurement of the wireless link according to the configuration information. The problem that in the related art, the complexity and power consumption of the terminal for measuring the wireless link are increased due to the fact that the base station configures a plurality of reference signal resources for the terminal to detect the link quality of the terminal is solved.

title_en: Recognition device and recognition method for whether vehicle-mounted interphone hand microphone is placed into hanging rack
abstract_en: The invention provides a recognition device and a recognition method for whether a vehicle-mounted interphone hand microphone is placed in a hanger or not, wherein one end of a first filter capacitor and a pin of a voltage stabilizing chip are connected with a VCC (virtual center) port of a vehicle-mounted radio station CPU (central processing unit) through pins of a socket connector, the pin of the voltage stabilizing chip is respectively connected with one end of a fourth filter capacitor and one end of a bias resistor, the other end of the bias resistor, one end of a reed switch and one end of a third filter capacitor are connected with a GPIO port of the vehicle-mounted radio station CPU through pins of the socket connector, the other end of the reed switch is grounded, the pin of the socket connector is connected with a GND port of the vehicle-mounted radio station CPU and the other end of the second filter capacitor is connected with a PTT port of the vehicle-mounted radio station CPU through pins of the socket connector. The invention realizes lower cost and strong reliability in two states of putting the hand into the hanging buckle and taking out the hanging buckle, and components can prevent the CPU chip from being burnt out by static electricity in the hand.

title_en: Object processing method and terminal
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a terminal for processing an object. The terminal displays a first display interface, wherein the first display interface comprises at least two objects. And the terminal receives an operation instruction and enters a selection mode according to the operation instruction. In the selection mode, the terminal receives a first selection instruction and determines a first position according to the first selection instruction. And the terminal receives a second selection instruction and determines a second position according to the second selection instruction. The terminal determines an object between the first position and the second position as a first target object. According to the technical scheme, the target object is flexibly determined according to the position of the selection instruction, so that the rapidness of batch selection of the terminal is increased, and the efficiency of batch processing of the terminal is improved.

title_en: Portable energy efficiency monitoring system for direct current power supply system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable energy efficiency monitoring system and method for a direct current power supply system. The energy efficiency monitoring system of the portable direct current power supply system comprises a wireless data acquisition module, a wireless communication relay module, a valve side merging communication acquisition box and an upper machine function efficiency monitoring system; the invention adopts the technical means of combining wireless and wired communication and combines a GPS-based wide-area synchronous time service data synchronous acquisition method, and can realize real-time accounting of loss and efficiency, system electric energy metering, electric energy quality evaluation of each measuring point, waveform vector diagram display of each measuring point, historical data processing and analysis and the like of the direct current power supply system and each component thereof by synchronously acquiring voltage and current signals of a network side, a valve side, a filtering side and a direct current side of the direct current power supply system in real time, packaging and then uploading all the acquired data to the upper computer function efficiency monitoring system for processing, thereby providing necessary basis for improving the equipment efficiency and energy saving of the direct current power supply system.

title_en: Functional assembly, electronic device and control method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a functional assembly, an electronic device and a control method thereof. The functional component comprises a base, a sliding seat and a driving mechanism. The sliding seat is provided with a camera module. The driving mechanism comprises a movable piece and a fixed piece, and magnetic force is arranged between the movable piece and the fixed piece so as to enable the movable piece to be close to or far away from the sliding seat. The movable member has an inclined surface. When the moving part repulses each other with the fixed part, the moving part is gradually close to the sliding seat until the inclined plane of the moving part is abutted against the sliding seat, so that the sliding seat climbs in the sliding groove relative to the inclined plane under the pushing of the moving part, the camera module extends out of the base, and the elastic part is in a stretching state. When moving part and mounting inter attraction, the moving part is kept away from the sliding seat gradually, and the sliding seat climbs down at the relative inclined plane of the effect of elastic component to drive camera module withdrawal base, improved user experience.

title_en: ISGW broadband band-pass filter with double transmission zero points and wide stop band
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ISGW broadband bandpass filter with double transmission zero points and wide stop bands, which comprises an upper dielectric plate, a lower dielectric plate and a spacing dielectric plate arranged between the upper dielectric plate and the lower dielectric plate; the upper surface of the upper dielectric plate is printed with a first copper-clad layer, the lower surface is printed with a round metal patch, a first metal via hole is formed in the round metal patch to form an artificial magnetic conductor structure, the upper surface of the lower dielectric plate is printed with a second copper-clad layer, 3 pairs of U-shaped gaps are formed in the second copper-clad layer, two ends of the second copper-clad layer are respectively connected with a transition gradient line and a feed microstrip line for realizing impedance matching, the lower surface is printed with a grounded second copper-clad layer, and two sides and the middle of the second copper-clad layer are respectively provided with a second metal via hole and a third metal via hole which are periodically arranged to realize a filtering function. The invention can effectively restrain space radiation and plane waves, realize high integration and miniaturization, and has the advantages of small size, easy integration, stable structure and the like.

title_en: Frequency response calibration for synchronized MIMO measurement receivers and local and remote transmitters
abstract_en: Techniques related to calibrating and operating a multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) radio system are disclosed. Some embodiments include a method wherein a single calibration signal is used to calibrate a MIMO radio system by performing each of time synchronization, phase synchronization, and frequency response correction on a plurality of receivers. A Remote Transmitter (RT) may be calibrated using dual mode calibration. During a first Sparse Full System Calibration (SFSC) mode, the RT may be physically connected to the MIMO radio system. In some embodiments, first and second equalizers may be derived for each of the RT and Local Transmitter (LT), respectively. During a subsequent real-time calibration (RTC) mode, the RT may be located remotely from the MIMO radio system and a third equalizer may be derived for the LT. The RT may then be calibrated based on the equalizer derived from each of the first, second, and third equalizers.

title_en: Method and device for protecting user privacy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for protecting user privacy, which are used for solving the problem of resource waste of virtual numbers. The method comprises the following steps: a server for providing an electronic commerce service receives an order request submitted by a first user, wherein the order request comprises a real telephone number of the first user and a real telephone number of a second user associated with the order; the server generates an order number according to the order request and distributes a virtual number for the generated order number; the server takes the distributed virtual number as a contact telephone number of the first user and sends the contact telephone number to the second user; and after the order is completed, the server withdraws the virtual number allocated to the order number.

title_en: System and method for reference crystal oscillator switching for wireless device transceivers
abstract_en: Systems and methods are disclosed herein that relate to a wireless device that intelligently uses different reference crystal oscillators (XOs) for Phase Locked Loops (PLLs) in a transceiver of the wireless device. Embodiments of a method of operation of a wireless device including a first XO operating at a first reference frequency and a second XO operating at a second reference frequency greater than the first reference frequency are disclosed. In some embodiments, a method of operation of a wireless device comprises: a determination is made as to whether the receiver of the wireless device is configured to use the first XO or the second XO, and the receiver of the wireless device is configured to use the first XO or the second XO based on the determination.

title_en: Differential feed three-frequency dual-polarized antenna
abstract_en: The invention discloses a differential feed three-frequency dual-polarized antenna, which comprises a dielectric substrate and is characterized in that a first microstrip line and a second microstrip line which are mutually orthogonal are arranged on the upper surface of the dielectric substrate, an intersection point is positioned at the center point of the dielectric substrate, a gap radiation structure and a SIW back cavity structure are arranged on the lower surface of the dielectric substrate, and the gap radiation structure is positioned between the dielectric substrate and the SIW back cavity structure and is connected with the SIW back cavity structure; the slot radiation structure comprises four slot structure units and four pairs of parasitic slot units, and the four slot structure units and the four pairs of parasitic slot units are respectively positioned in four quadrants formed by the first microstrip line and the second microstrip line. The invention has simple structure, low profile, easy processing and integration, and has good application prospect in the fields of WiFi and 5G mobile communication.

title_en: Wireless communication device
abstract_en: The invention provides a wireless communication device which comprises a host module and at least one sub-module. The host module comprises a first shell and a host communication unit. The first shell is provided with a bearing surface. The host communication unit is arranged in the first shell and provides host signals. The sub-machine module comprises a second shell and a sub-machine communication unit. The sub-machine communication unit is arranged in the second shell and provides a sub-machine signal. When the sub-machine module is arranged on the main machine module, the bearing surface of the first shell bears the second shell. The wireless communication device provides a wireless signal with a host signal and a sub-machine signal within a wireless communication range, and the sub-machine signal is transmitted substantially along a first direction. When the sub-machine module is far away from the bearing surface, the distance between the sub-machine module and the main machine module and/or the first direction of the sub-machine signal are/is selectively adjusted to change the wireless communication range. The present invention adjusts the signal distribution range and signal intensity by different position relationships between the host module and the sub-module.

title_en: Method for slot antenna design for wearable electronic devices and conductive housings
abstract_en: A wearable computing device may include a slot antenna formed from: a gap between a housing (such as a highly conductive housing) and a PCB within the highly conductive housing, and a back cavity between the highly conductive bracket and the PCB or between the highly conductive bracket and the highly conductive housing. The printed circuit board is coupled to the highly conductive bracket or the highly conductive housing through the matching circuit and the direct feed. The PCB is positioned adjacent to a display window of the device, above the battery and the highly conductive support. This configuration allows for a relatively small dead space in the display window, a larger PCB, a compact and mechanically simple configuration, and excellent water resistance.

title_en: Multi-coil non-contact energy and signal synchronous transmission system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-coil non-contact energy and signal synchronous transmission system, which comprises: the device comprises a direct-current voltage module, a high-frequency inversion module, a multi-coil energy coupling module, a secondary energy conversion module, a signal modulation module and a secondary signal demodulation module. The relay coil of the multi-coil energy coupling module is connected with the signal modulation module; the output end of the multi-coil energy coupling module is connected with the secondary side energy conversion module; the secondary side energy conversion module and the secondary side signal demodulation module are in coupling connection with the secondary side signal pickup coil through a secondary side signal emission coupling coil, and the output end of the secondary side energy conversion link is connected with a load. According to the invention, through a coil coupling resonance principle of non-contact charging, a multi-coil energy coupling mechanism is utilized to transfer non-contact charging electric energy, so that the energy transmission distance can be effectively increased, the energy loss of energy transmission in a long distance is reduced, the circuit volume is small, the efficiency is high, and the electromagnetic isolation is easy to realize.

title_en: Detection and positioning device and method for ETC (electronic toll Collection) interference unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for detecting and positioning an ETC (electronic toll collection) interference device, which comprise the following steps: setting a signal power threshold value; sensing passing vehicles through a phased array antenna and triggering an interference recognition device; the interference identification device receives a signal containing an ETC frequency band through a radio frequency signal receiver and performs band-pass filtering on the signal; performing analog-to-digital conversion on the filtered signal; calculating the converted signal power through a signal power algorithm; judging whether the calculated signal power is greater than a threshold value; when the interference signal is judged, accurately positioning the vehicle generating the interference through image acquisition equipment; the power of the signal outside the passband is calculated and compared with the preset threshold value to judge whether the signal is an interference signal, so that whether the received signal is the interference signal can be accurately identified; through the cooperation of the image acquisition device and the phased array antenna, the vehicle information which sends out interference signals can be accurately positioned and recorded.

title_en: Method and system for removing influence of frequency offset on receiving performance in wireless communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for removing the influence of frequency offset on receiving performance in wireless communication.

title_en: Method and apparatus for measuring synchronous signal block
abstract_en: A method of measuring a Synchronization Signal Block (SSB) by a terminal in a wireless communication system is disclosed. Specifically, the present invention may comprise the steps of: receiving a cell list including information on one or more first cells, first SSB transmission periodicity information of the one or more cells, and second SSB transmission periodicity information of a second cell not included in the cell list; measuring Reference Signal Received Power (RSRP) of SSBs of the one or more first cells based on a first SSB measurement window set using first SSB transmission periodicity information; and measuring RSRP of the SSBs of the second cell based on a second SSB measurement window set using the second SSB transmission periodicity information.

title_en: Multi-floor indoor positioning method based on Softmax regression multi-classification recognizer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-floor indoor positioning method based on a Softmax regression multi-classification recognizer, which comprises an offline stage and an online stage. The off-line stage comprises an off-line fingerprint database acquisition stage and an off-line multi-floor judgment classifier construction stage, wherein the off-line fingerprint database acquisition stage is used for establishing an off-line RSS fingerprint database by acquiring RSS values of all APs sensed by all sampling points; and in the off-line multi-floor discrimination classifier construction stage, training the multi-floor discrimination classifier, minimizing a cross entropy loss function of the multi-floor discrimination classifier through a gradient descent algorithm, and constructing an optimal multi-floor discrimination classifier by using a model parameter corresponding to the minimum cross entropy loss function value. When positioning a target to be positioned in an online stage, firstly, a multi-floor discrimination classifier is adopted to calculate the probability that the target belongs to each floor, the floor corresponding to the maximum probability is the floor where the target to be positioned is located, and then an improved KNN algorithm is utilized to calculate the coordinate position where the target to be positioned is located.

title_en: Ring processing method, device, mobile terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a ring processing method, a ring processing device, a mobile terminal and a storage medium. When the mobile terminal outputs a ring, an ultrasonic signal is sent through an ultrasonic sending device, an ultrasonic receiving device receives the ultrasonic signal returned after the ultrasonic signal is reflected by an object, an infrared signal is sent through an infrared sending device, an infrared receiving device receives the infrared signal returned after the infrared signal is reflected by the object, data of the ultrasonic signal in the transmission process are obtained and serve as first data, data of the infrared signal in the transmission process are obtained and serve as second data, the change of the distance between the mobile terminal and the object is determined based on the first data and the second data, and the ring volume of the mobile terminal is adjusted according to the change of the distance. This application is when mobile terminal output jingle bell, through ultrasonic signal and infrared signal monitoring object and mobile terminal's interval change to adjust jingle bell volume according to the interval change, promote mobile terminal's jingle bell volume control's convenience and accuracy.

title_en: Electronic combinable modular system
abstract_en: An electronically composable modular system based on multiple multi-dimensional geometric forms for locating the position of multiple transponder RFIDs in a multi-dimensional space and reading and writing the information contained. The system comprises: a plurality of composable modular local units, a plurality of composable modular subsystems, at least a microcontroller, and at least a radiating antenna connected to the modular subsystems for communicating any of the modular local units with at least a reader receiver of the transponder RFID. The innovations of the present invention allow for significant improvements and cost-effectiveness in the construction of a matrix or series of antennas, as well as new modes of operation in the entertainment, education, and communications fields. This innovation is significant because it facilitates even interaction with unintuified children and disabled persons of any age.

title_en: Reliability test system for synchronous wireless channel of wireless expander
abstract_en: The invention provides a system and a method for testing the reliability of a synchronous wireless channel of a wireless expander, belonging to the field of testing of wireless expanders.
