The reliability test system comprises a first shielding box and a second shielding box, wherein the first shielding box is provided with a network port and a radio frequency port, a wireless router is arranged in the first shielding box, the second shielding box is provided with an interface and a radio frequency port, a wireless network card and a wireless expander to be tested are arranged in the second shielding box, the wireless expander and the wireless router are in wired connection through the radio frequency port and a feeder line, the reliability test system further comprises a first client side in wired connection with the wireless router through the network port and the network line, a second client side in wired connection with the wireless network card through the interface, and test tools are arranged on the first client side and the second client side. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the interference of the external environment is reduced, the test time is greatly shortened, and the test efficiency is improved.

title_en: High-precision time synchronization method and system for process layer Ethernet switch system
abstract_en: A high precision process level Ethernet switch system time synchronization method and system, the method,the method comprises the following steps: A. acquiring data, namely acquiring the value of a counter and a register of a hardware timestamp processing module when a time setting message enters and acquiring time information in the time setting message; acquiring N groups of data; B. carrying out data filtration and data fitting on the acquired N groups of data by adopting a multiple data processing mode to obtain an optimal value C; C. calling relevant time synchronization process by applying a round-robin function, and randomly acquiring time information sync in a certain frame of time alignment message time Calculating a time difference value Cdvue by a software response deviation method for the frame message; D. combining the error values calculated in the step B and the step C, calculating and setting the system synchronization time of the Switch as Switch time ＝sync time + C + Cdvaue. The invention effectively solves the problem that the network card cache effect and the response factor of the operating system influence the system time synchronization.

title_en: Method and device for realizing three-party call
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for realizing three-party call. The method comprises the following steps: when an active application program in a first calling party is detected to be called by a third-party application program in the first calling party, sending a takeover request to the third-party application program; the active application takes over call control rights that have been established by the third-party application; the active application program sends a call request to a third calling party; the active application program receives a response from the third calling party and enables the third calling party to join the established call; and the active application program mixes the contents from the second calling party, the third calling party and the first calling party and then displays the contents back locally and forwards the contents. The method can realize three-party communication by transferring the communication control right even if the third communication party, the first communication party and the second communication party belong to different communication networks.

title_en: Antenna structure and wireless communication device with same
abstract_en: The invention provides an antenna structure which is arranged on a circuit board and comprises a first array antenna, a second array antenna and a control circuit, wherein the circuit board comprises an upper surface and a lower surface which are oppositely arranged, the circuit board also comprises a side wall for connecting the upper surface and the lower surface, the first array antenna is arranged on the upper surface or the lower surface, the second array antenna comprises a plurality of antenna units, each antenna unit is partially arranged on the side wall, other parts of each antenna unit are bent and arranged on the upper surface and/or the lower surface, and the control circuit is used for exciting the first array antenna and the second array antenna to generate a plurality of polarization directions. The invention also provides a wireless communication device with the antenna structure, which comprises a circuit board and the antenna structure, wherein the circuit board is used for bearing the antenna structure.

title_en: Switching and packet scheduling method suitable for satellite communication system beam hopping
abstract_en: The invention discloses a switching and grouping scheduling method suitable for beam hopping of a satellite communication system, which comprises the following steps: (1) performing two-stage addressing label switching in the beam hopping; (2) and dynamically scheduling the hopping mode of the hopping beam according to the queue state of the wave position port. The invention solves the problems of more corresponding ports and difficult addressing of the hopping beam by using a two-stage addressing label switching method, improves the resource utilization rate of the hopping beam by using a dynamic grouping scheduling method based on a queue state, improves the service quality of a system, and better meets the communication requirements of users.

title_en: Intelligent thunder and lightning counter with ad hoc network function
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent lightning counter with an ad hoc network function, which consists of a lightning stroke data receiving unit, a main control unit, a LoRa communication unit, an equipment low-power consumption control unit and a power supply unit, changes the traditional mode of reading the action data of a lightning arrester by climbing a tower, reduces the work load of workers in a team and reduces the risk of high-altitude operation; the usable Lora communication unit of intelligent thunder and lightning counter on same circuit carries out free network deployment, realizes the sharing of thunderbolt monitoring information, and the operation is maintained more conveniently, and an intelligent thunder and lightning counter that possesses ad hoc network function is small, standardized module, can install with electricity, need not the operation that has a power failure, and simple installation to guarantee to overhaul fast, high efficiency and maintain power transmission and transformation lightning protection equipment.

title_en: Method for improving communication connection success rate of vehicle-mounted intelligent equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving the success rate of communication connection of vehicle-mounted intelligent equipment, which relates to the technical field of communication and avoids the condition that a larger data packet cannot be successfully transmitted to cause request failure by splitting a user request under the condition of weak network. When the user request is unsuccessful, the user request is put into a re-request queue, and when the network is normally connected, the user request in the re-request queue is executed in a traversing manner, so that the success rate of the user request in the weak network environment is improved.

title_en: Cover plate and display device
abstract_en: The invention provides a cover plate and a display device, wherein a light-gathering component is formed on the cover plate in an electronic element arrangement area corresponding to the arrangement position of an electronic element, and a light-gathering path of the electronic element penetrates through the light-gathering component; through set up the spotlight component in electronic component setting area for external light can be gathered when passing through the apron, thereby has improved electronic component's visual angle, has solved current camera under the screen and has had the less technical problem of visual angle.

title_en: Information transmission method, information reception method, terminal, and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of information processing, and discloses an information sending method, an information receiving method, a terminal and a storage medium. In the invention, in the call waiting process, first information input in a call interface is received; and sending the first information to the communication opposite end for the communication opposite end to display in the call interface. Therefore, the user can know the reason for the opposite terminal user to make a call or not answer the call, the intercommunication information of the two communication parties in the call waiting process is realized, and the interactivity of the two communication parties in the call waiting process is increased.

title_en: Downloading method, system, storage medium and terminal based on safe electric quantity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a downloading method, a downloading system, a storage medium and a downloading terminal based on safe electric quantity, which relate to the technical field of intelligent systems and comprise the following steps: acquiring the size of a data packet to be downloaded, a current electric quantity value and a charging heating data packet threshold value; analyzing whether the current electric quantity value is larger than a safe downloading electric quantity threshold value or not, and detecting whether the current state is a charging state or not; when the current electric quantity value is detected to be larger than the safety downloading electric quantity threshold value and the current state is detected to be a charging state, analyzing whether the data packet to be downloaded is larger than the charging heating data packet threshold value or not; and when the data packet to be downloaded is larger than the threshold value of the charging heating data packet, the charging is disconnected, and the data packet to be downloaded is downloaded. The invention guarantees the performance of the telephone watch on the premise of effectively guaranteeing the successful safe downloading, and avoids the abnormity of overhigh heating and the like caused by overlarge downloaded data packets in the charging process.

title_en: Wafer level package with integrated antenna structure
abstract_en: The present application relates to wafer level packaging with integrated antenna structures, radio Frequency (RF) semiconductor chips can be packaged on a wafer level based on a two-step process for providing a packaging material, thereby providing very short electrical connections between the antenna structures formed in the packaging material and the semiconductor chips. In some illustrative embodiments, the antenna structure may be disposed above the semiconductor chip, thereby forming a highly space efficient overall configuration.

title_en: Method and device for RRM (radio resource management) measurement and channel estimation based on RS (Reed-Solomon) of coexisting communication system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for RRM measurement and channel estimation based on RS of a coexisting communication system. Wherein the method may include receiving, by a user equipment, a first reference signal of a first system in a wireless communication network; receiving, by the user equipment, a second reference signal of a second system in the wireless communication network; receiving a quasi-parity configuration from one of the first system and the second system, wherein the quasi-parity configuration indicates that the first reference signal and the second reference signal are quasi-parity; and performing radio resource management measurements based on a combination of the first reference signal and the second reference signal of quasi co-location. By utilizing the invention, RRM measurement and/or channel estimation can be better carried out.

title_en: Interference intensity acquisition method, device, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses an interference intensity obtaining method, an interference intensity obtaining device, a terminal and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of communication. The method is executed by a terminal, and comprises the following steps: acquiring test parameters, wherein the test parameters comprise a network type of the antenna to be tested when the interference strength of a test interference source to the antenna to be tested is indicated; under a non-signaling mode, configuring the network standard of the antenna to be tested as the network standard indicated by the test parameters; acquiring first interference strength received by an antenna to be tested; when the test parameters indicate that the network standard of the antenna to be tested comprises a second network standard when the test parameters indicate the interference strength of a test interference source to the antenna to be tested, automatically configuring the network standard of the antenna to be tested into the second network standard in a non-signaling mode; and acquiring the second interference strength received by the antenna to be tested. According to the method and the device, an additional comprehensive tester is not needed, the operation process of establishing signaling connection is avoided, and the efficiency and the automation rate of the interference intensity acquisition process are improved.

title_en: Multimode antenna, terminal, communication method and device of multimode antenna and processor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multimode antenna, a terminal, a communication method and device of the multimode antenna and a processor. The method comprises the following steps: receiving radio frequency signals from a base station through an antenna, wherein the antenna is provided with a plurality of feeding points, and the working frequency bands of antenna arrays corresponding to each feeding point in the plurality of feeding points are different; determining a feeding point to be used from a plurality of feeding points based on a transmission frequency of a radio frequency signal; and carrying out communication interaction with the base station by using the feeding point to be used. The invention solves the technical problems that the communication antenna design mode provided by the related technology occupies too much terminal space, so that the terminal clear space is smaller and dynamic switching among a plurality of feed points cannot be carried out.

title_en: Charging session management method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the field of mobile communication, in particular to a charging session management method and device. The invention provides a charging session management method for solving the problem of resource waste on OCS, PCEF and other network nodes in the existing session establishment mode, which comprises that when UE is in an access network state, an IP connection bearer exists between a gateway and the UE, wherein the IP connection bearer is used for transmitting data flow of the UE, and a charging session exists between the gateway and a charging system, and is characterized by comprising the following steps: when a charging session established for the IP connection bearer exists between the gateway and the charging system; and if the gateway confirms that no data stream transmission exists on the IP connection bearer within the time threshold, interrupting the charging session, and establishing a new charging session for the IP connection bearer when the gateway monitors the start of the data stream transmission on the IP connection bearer.

title_en: Arrival reminding method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method and a device for reminding of arriving at a station, a storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein a processor is used for receiving a request for reminding of arriving at the station, determining a target public transport station needing to be reminded of arriving at the station according to the request for reminding of arriving at the station, then sleeping the processor, obtaining the number of the target stations of the public transport stations which the electronic equipment needs to pass through when the electronic equipment arrives at the target public transport station through a low-power chip, then controlling a microphone through the low-power chip to collect external audio signals, identifying the collected audio signals through the low-power chip to obtain the number of the stations of the electronic equipment which have passed through the public transport station, and finally awakening the processor through the low-power chip when the number of the passed stations is consistent with the number of the target stations, and executing preset operation for reminding of arriving at the station through the. Compared with the related technology, the method does not need continuous operation of a processor, and even does not need satellite positioning, so that the power consumption of the electronic equipment for realizing arrival reminding can be effectively reduced.

title_en: Wide-angle conformal linear phased array antenna based on FSS structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wide-angle conformal linear phased array antenna based on an FSS structure, and belongs to the field of wireless communication and the technical field of radars. The antenna unit comprises a metal floor, a common ground wire, a short circuit probe, a Marchand balun, a dipole antenna, a conformal Frequency Selective Surface (FSS) and a director. The antenna is attached to the surface of the structure, the dipole antenna is fed through the balun, the short-circuit probe is placed between the two dipole units, the FSS structure is placed at the front end of the dipole antenna, and the director is placed at the structural end. The antenna can be conformal on the surface of the structure, the space volume occupied by the antenna is greatly reduced, good radiation characteristics can be guaranteed, and the antenna has high directivity. The invention has compact structure, simple installation and high conformal characteristic, and can be applied to practice.

title_en: Satellite self-organizing network route anti-damage method based on link survival time
abstract_en: The invention discloses a satellite self-organizing network route survivability method based on link survival time, which comprises the steps of generating a neighbor table according to Hello packet messages of satellite nodes and neighbor nodes of the satellite nodes, and then predicting the link survival time between each satellite node and the neighbor nodes in the satellite self-organizing network; selecting an MPR node of each satellite node, and establishing a satellite self-organizing network topological graph through MPR node full-network broadcasting TC information of the satellite nodes; calculating a main route and an alternative route from a source node to a destination node in the satellite self-organizing network topological graph/temporary network topological graph A by adopting a Dijkstra algorithm based on hop count and link survival time; the temporary network topology graph A is obtained by deleting all satellite nodes of non-source nodes and destination nodes in the main route in the satellite self-organizing network topology. The route survivability method solves the problem that the traditional OLSR routing protocol is easy to cause link failure in the application of the satellite self-organizing network.

title_en: Solar infrared remote control CT polarity detection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a solar infrared remote control CT polarity detection device, which comprises a power circuit, a voltage stabilizing circuit, an infrared remote control circuit and an output circuit, wherein the power circuit comprises a solar panel and a storage battery pack, a positive lead-out wire of the storage battery pack is respectively connected with the voltage stabilizing circuit and the output circuit, the infrared remote control circuit comprises an infrared receiving special chip CX20106, a 7 pin of the chip CX20106 is respectively connected with a resistor R2 and an input end of a NOR gate U1A, the other end of the resistor R2 is respectively connected with an output end and VCC of a sliding rheostat, the other input end of the NOR gate U1A is connected with a low-power relay JR, the output end of the NOR gate U1A is connected with an input end of a diode D2, the output end of the diode D2 is respectively connected with a resistor R3, a capacitor C4 and an input end of a NAND gate U2A, the other end of the resistor R3 is respectively connected with a resistor R4 and a grounding end, and the other end of the resistor R4 is connected with the other end of the capacitor C4; the invention has the advantages of detecting the secondary circuit, checking the cable core and correcting the CT polarity.

title_en: Barium niobate system microwave dielectric ceramic material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of microwave dielectric ceramic materials, and particularly relates to a barium niobate system microwave dielectric ceramic material. The barium niobate system microwave dielectric ceramic material is prepared by using BaCO 3 、Nb 2 O 5 ZnO, CoO and NiO are used as raw materials to synthesize a main burning block, and SiO is used 2 、BaO、CaO、B 2 O 3 、Li 2 And O is used as a raw material to synthesize low-melting-point glass powder, and the main burning block and the low-melting-point glass powder are mixed and dispersed to obtain the required barium niobate system microwave dielectric ceramic material. The dielectric constant of the microwave dielectric ceramic material reaches 33-36, fQ at 25 ℃ is larger than 80000, the frequency temperature coefficient calculated by testing the resonance frequency f at-40 ℃ and 25 ℃ and 110 ℃ is lower and is only-5 ppm/DEG C, and the performance of the microwave dielectric ceramic material meets the requirements of a microwave dielectric ceramic device; meanwhile, the material has better dielectric property under the millimeter wave frequency band; can be used for producing filtersAnd a ceramic device such as a resonator.

title_en: Communication device, dielectric waveguide filter and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a communication device, a dielectric waveguide filter and a manufacturing method thereof. The dielectric waveguide filter includes a dielectric block. The surface of the medium block is provided with a cutting groove. The cutting groove is arranged on the end face of the end part, closest to the isolation groove, of the medium block, and the cutting groove is arranged corresponding to the isolation groove. The dielectric block is processed into the isolation groove, the coupling input hole and the coupling output hole through a forming die before sintering and forming, and is processed into the cutting groove through a cutting device after sintering and forming, so that the defect that cracking deformation is easy to occur at the coupling position between the coupling input end and the coupling output end in the sintering and forming process of the dielectric block can be avoided, and meanwhile, the wall thickness from the end face of the isolation groove to the end face of the dielectric block can be correspondingly reduced due to the fact that the cutting groove is processed after sintering and forming of the dielectric block, namely, the coupling between the coupling input hole and the coupling output hole can be reduced, the far-end inhibition can be improved, and the product performance is guaranteed.

title_en: Anti-adhesion radio frequency mechanical switch and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-adhesion radio frequency mechanical switch and a preparation method thereof, wherein the anti-adhesion radio frequency mechanical switch comprises a substrate; the coplanar waveguide structure is arranged on the substrate and is used for transmitting radio frequency and microwave signals; the cantilever beam structure comprises a cantilever beam, an inductance array and a contact; one end of the cantilever beam is connected with the coplanar waveguide structure through a support, and the other end of the cantilever beam is provided with a contact; the inductor array is arranged on the cantilever beam; the driving structure comprises an inductor and a bonding pad, and the inductor is arranged on the substrate; the inductor is connected with the bonding pad through a metal wire. According to the invention, the radio frequency mechanical switch is actively separated from the adhesion state through the cantilever beam structure, and the problem of switch failure caused by the contact adhesion problem along with the increase of power in the use process of the radio frequency mechanical switch is avoided.

title_en: Motion detection based on beamformed dynamic information
abstract_en: In a general aspect, wireless signals are used to detect motion. In one example, beamforming dynamic information is obtained based on a set of wireless signals spatially transmitted from a first wireless communication device to a second wireless communication device. Motion of an object in space is detected based on the beamformed dynamic information.

title_en: Lens driving device, camera module, and camera mounting device
abstract_en: The invention provides a lens driving device, a camera module and a camera carrying device which have favorable structures on the basis of realizing miniaturization and power saving and are useful in the case of carrying out automatic focusing by a closed-loop control mode. The lens driving device includes an autofocus driving unit including: a coil section for auto-focusing; and an autofocus magnet unit that moves an autofocus movable unit including the autofocus coil unit in the optical axis direction relative to an autofocus fixing unit including the autofocus magnet unit, the autofocus fixing unit including: a Hall element disposed at a distance from the autofocus magnet unit, the autofocus movable unit including: a first position detection magnet disposed adjacent to the hall element; and a second position detection magnet having the same configuration as the first position detection magnet and disposed at a position point-symmetrical to the first position detection magnet with respect to the optical axis direction.

title_en: Monitoring method, instruction issuing method and device, communication equipment and storage
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a PDCCH monitoring method and device, an indication issuing method and device, communication equipment and a non-transitory computer readable storage medium. The PDCCH monitoring method comprises the following steps: switching from a source cell to a target cell, and if the monitoring time of the WUS in the target cell is missed, monitoring the PDCCH according to the monitoring result of the WUS according to a monitoring strategy.

title_en: Wiring board and method for manufacturing wiring board
abstract_en: The wiring substrate is provided with: a substrate having transparency; a plurality of first wirings disposed on an upper surface of the substrate and extending in a first direction, the first wirings having a back surface contacting the substrate and a surface facing an opposite side of the back surface; and a second wiring which is arranged on the upper surface of the substrate and extends in a second direction intersecting the first direction, and has a back surface in contact with the substrate and a surface facing the opposite side of the back surface. The first wiring has a pair of side surfaces extending in the first direction and adjacent to the back surface of the first wiring, and the pair of side surfaces of the first wiring are recessed toward the inside. The second wiring has a pair of side surfaces extending in the second direction and adjacent to the back surface of the second wiring, and the pair of side surfaces of the second wiring are recessed toward the inside.

title_en: Voice call real-time monitoring method and device based on VOIP network
abstract_en: The application relates to a voice call real-time monitoring method and a voice call real-time monitoring device based on a VOIP network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the device is arranged on a communication transceiving link of a first terminal and a second terminal, is respectively connected to a mixer through a first RSP and a second RSP, and is also arranged on the mixer to be connected to an FXS user through an LSP; when the media stream of the user needs to be monitored, controlling the media streams transmitted and received by the first terminal and the second terminal to respectively pass through the first RSP and the second RSP to send the mixer; the mixer superposes the first RSP and the second RSP voice streams and then sends the superposed voice streams to the LSP; and networking to a monitored FXS user through the time slot of the LSP user, wherein the FXS user realizes voice monitoring on both the first terminal and the second terminal. The invention can realize bidirectional voice monitoring, and has simple structure, convenient operation and high monitoring efficiency.

title_en: Large-scale performance control system based on time code synchronization
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a large-scale performance control system based on time code synchronization. The large-scale performance control system comprises: the system comprises a time code synchronization/audio playing unit for outputting uniform synchronization time codes and multichannel audio signals, an audio control unit for inputting the multichannel audio signals and the audio signals of all servers of a video playing unit, a video control unit for synchronously controlling and playing the video output of all the playing units according to the received synchronization time codes, a video pre-monitoring unit for monitoring the video pictures output by all the video playing units and receiving and displaying the synchronization time codes, and a control unit for synchronously outputting the corresponding special effects of lamplight, laser, water show and the like through a pre-coding program according to the received synchronization time codes. The method has the characteristics of high integration, modularization and safety, forms a uniform control protocol for the performance control system, and realizes the nonlinear real-time code synchronization of the whole system.

title_en: Method, system, device, server and storage medium for managing video color ring
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of Internet and discloses a method, a system, a device, a server and a storage medium for managing video color ring. The method for managing the video color ring comprises the following steps: responding to a call request of a calling terminal for a called terminal, determining whether the calling terminal and/or the called terminal are/is located in a preset area, and if at least one of the calling terminal and the called terminal is determined to be located in the preset area, determining whether a first terminal which does not open a video color ring service exists in the calling terminal and the called terminal; if the first terminal is determined to exist, temporarily opening the video color ring service of the first terminal; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a temporary video color ring corresponding to a preset area, and sending the temporary video color ring to a video color ring platform so that the video color ring platform can send the temporary video color ring to a calling terminal and/or a called terminal, and is not limited by whether a user opens a video color ring service to a certain extent, so that the method is favorable for popularization of the video color ring.

title_en: Audio control method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to an audio control method and device and electronic equipment. The electronic equipment comprises magnetic liquid, the magnetic liquid is contained in the containing part on the permanent magnetic piece, and the magnetic liquid can optimize the audio playing function of the electronic equipment by utilizing the electromagnetic performance, the heat conducting performance and the damping performance of the magnetic liquid. In the use process of the electronic equipment, the magnetic liquid may splash and adhere to the structures such as the voice coil and the vibrating diaphragm due to shaking, voice coil vibration and the like, so that the audio playing function is influenced. This openly can be based on received to predetermine abnormal signal and send the supersound sound source to audio frequency coding and decoding chip to make audio frequency coding and decoding chip control voice coil loudspeaker voice coil and vibrating diaphragm produce ultrasonic vibration, and then will adhere to in the magnetic fluid of voice coil loudspeaker voice coil, vibrating diaphragm equipotential position shakes back the containing part of permanent magnetic component, has solved the magnetic fluid and has splashed the interference problem to electronic equipment audio playback function, has promoted electronic equipment's audio playback function's use reliability.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted network system
abstract_en: An in-vehicle network system comprising: a first device and a second device configured to transmit or receive between each other; an intermediate node connected between the first apparatus and the second apparatus, the intermediate node configured to output the buffered messages in an order determined by a relative priority scheme. The first apparatus includes a control unit configured to: the communication delay is measured for each of a plurality of different priority messages, a delay representative value that is less than a maximum value of the plurality of communication delays is set, and the time managed by the time management unit is adjusted based on the time managed by the first device, the time managed by the second device, and the delay representative value.

title_en: High-isolation high-gain large-scale MIMO antenna applied to wireless local area network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-isolation high-gain large-scale MIMO antenna applied to a wireless local area network, which comprises a first medium substrate, a second medium substrate and a third medium substrate, wherein the first medium substrate comprises 4 symmetrical H-shaped metal patches and 4 windmill-shaped metal patches, the 4H-shaped metal patches are arranged in a central symmetry manner, and the 4 windmill-shaped metal patches are arranged in a central symmetry manner; the lower surface of the first medium substrate comprises 4 windmill type patches which are arranged in a central symmetry manner; the second dielectric plate is sleeved in the circular through hole of the first dielectric plate in a clearance mode, and a Bluetooth antenna is paved on the surface of the second dielectric plate; the reflector is printed on the upper surface of the third medium substrate, and four sides of the reflector are provided with T-shaped grooves; the short-circuit arms of the metal radiating array terminals are connected to the third dielectric plate, and the centers of the 4 metal radiating arrays are symmetrically arranged. The invention covers wifi frequency band, has high antenna isolation, good performance and low whole antenna section, and is suitable for being applied to ceiling or wall-mounted AP equipment.

title_en: Short physical uplink control channel (sPUCCH) structure
abstract_en: A wireless transmit/receive unit (WTRU) may modulate the first sequence or the first and second sequences based on a number of uplink control bits. The WTRU may extend the first sequence and the second sequence with complementary sequence pairs, concatenate portions of the first sequence and the second sequence in interleaved Resource Blocks (RBs), and perform an Inverse Discrete Fourier Transform (IDFT) on the interleaved portions. The WTRU may transmit the signal output by the IDFT on a Physical Uplink Control Channel (PUCCH).

title_en: Radiation protection silver powder cell-phone shell preparation equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for manufacturing a radiation-proof silver powder mobile phone shell, which comprises a machine body, wherein an injection molding cavity is arranged in the machine body, a manufacturing mechanism is arranged in the injection molding cavity, a lifting slide block is arranged on the right side in the injection molding cavity in a sliding manner, a first motor is fixedly arranged in the bottom end wall of the injection molding cavity on the lower side of the lifting slide block, an internal thread cavity is arranged in the lifting slide block, and a first rotating shaft is rotatably arranged on the top end surface of the lifting slide block.

title_en: Electronic device
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present application provides an electronic device, including: a housing; the display screen is arranged in the shell; the exciter is arranged in the shell, is arranged below the display screen and is arranged at intervals with the display screen; the vibration conductor is arranged in the shell, connected with the exciter and arranged at intervals with the display screen; the vibration sounding body is arranged in the shell and fixedly connected with the vibration conductor, and the vibration sounding body and the display screen are arranged at intervals; the exciter is used for converting call information into vibration information, the vibration conductor is used for transmitting the vibration information generated by the exciter to the vibration sounding body, and the vibration sounding body is used for transmitting the vibration information to the outside of the electronic equipment. The embodiment of the application can improve the screen occupation ratio of the electronic equipment.

title_en: Mobile terminal control method and device, mobile terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to the field of computer technologies, and in particular, to a method and an apparatus for controlling a mobile terminal, and a storage medium. The method for controlling the mobile terminal comprises the following steps: responding to the lightening of a screen of the mobile terminal, and acquiring first detection information through a first distance sensor; if the first detection information is smaller than or equal to a first threshold value, locking a screen of the mobile terminal; if the first detection information is larger than or equal to a second threshold value, second detection information is obtained through a second distance sensor; if the second detection information is less than or equal to the third threshold value, outputting prompt information to remind the user; the first threshold value is smaller than or equal to a second threshold value, and the second threshold value is smaller than a third threshold value. Like this, can the high-efficient data that utilize first distance sensor to record, practice thrift the energy consumption of second distance sensor, prevent that screen terminal from taking place the mistake because of the mistake lights and touching the incident to and protect user's eye health.

title_en: Rotating shaft system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a pivot system and electronic equipment, the pivot system is applied to in the electronic equipment, the first body of electronic equipment corresponds with the second body and is equipped with the recess that is used for the cooperation to form the accommodation space, the pivot system includes: the shell is arranged in the accommodating space; the rotating shaft mechanism is arranged in the shell, one end of the rotating shaft mechanism extends out of the first end of the shell and is connected with the first body and the second body so as to be used for rotatably connecting the first body and the second body; and the two ends of the limiting piece are respectively connected with the first body and the second end of the shell, so that the shell is fixed relative to the accommodating space under the matching limiting of the rotating shaft mechanism and the limiting piece. The rotating shaft system can effectively prevent the shell from being inclined and deformed, and the appearance of the electronic equipment is guaranteed to be fixed.

title_en: Multifunctional intelligent pole system based on high-speed wireless communication and installation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional intelligent rod system based on high-speed wireless communication, which comprises a rod body, a gateway, a power supply, a wireless communication module, a main power supply cable, mounting equipment and auxiliary materials. According to the invention, the connection between the mounting equipment on the multifunctional intelligent pole and the gateway is realized by adopting wireless communication, so that the mounting cost is reduced, the system safety is improved, and the risk of interference on communication is reduced; in addition, through the network configuration of reasonable setting equipment, the mounting equipment and the corresponding wireless communication module are automatically connected to the gateway after the power is turned on, so that a local area network is formed, the installation efficiency is improved, and the installation faults are reduced.

title_en: RDSS (radio frequency identification) and VSAT (vertical seismic spread spectrum) composite parabolic antenna device
abstract_en: The invention provides an RDSS (radio frequency identification) and VSAT (virtual dish) compound parabolic antenna device which comprises a VSAT antenna feed source, an RDSS antenna feed source and a parabolic antenna, wherein the parabolic antenna, the RDSS antenna feed source and the VSAT antenna feed source are sequentially overlapped, the VSAT antenna feed source comprises a feed waveguide tube, a coaxial multi-ring choke coil, a secondary reflecting surface support and a secondary reflecting surface, the feed waveguide tube, the coaxial multi-ring choke coil, the secondary reflecting surface support and the secondary reflecting surface are sequentially overlapped, the RDSS antenna feed source comprises an S-band spiral line, an S-band spiral line coaxial connector, a feed source mounting disc, an L-band spiral line coaxial connector and an L-band spiral line, the S-band spiral line is arranged on a first side of the feed source mounting disc, the L-band spiral line is arranged on a second side opposite to the first side of the feed source mounting disc, the S-band spiral line is fixedly connected with the feed source mounting disc through the S-band spiral line coaxial connector, and the L-band spiral line is fixedly connected with the feed source mounting disc through the L-band spiral line coaxial connector.

title_en: Control method and device for security antenna device, anti-theft system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of security and protection, and discloses a control method and device of a security and protection antenna device, an anti-theft system and a storage medium.

title_en: Lockable solar TWS Bluetooth headset
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lockable solar TWS Bluetooth headset, which comprises a left Bluetooth headset and a right Bluetooth headset, wherein the left Bluetooth headset and the right Bluetooth headset both comprise earplugs and straight rod-shaped headset bodies which are connected with the earplugs and extend in the axial direction of the earplugs, the headset bodies are provided with a circuit control unit and a headset battery, a loudspeaker is arranged in each earplug, and the headset battery and the loudspeaker are electrically connected with the circuit control unit; each earphone body is divided into two sections which can be rotatably connected, and the earphone body of the left Bluetooth earphone and the earphone body of the right Bluetooth earphone can be locked and connected; and the surface of each earphone body is provided with a solar panel which is electrically connected with the circuit control unit. The TWS Bluetooth headset can be locked together when not in use, is convenient to carry and find, can charge the headset battery by utilizing solar energy for cruising, and does not need to carry a headset box.

title_en: Call data processing method and device, electronic equipment and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a call data processing method, a call data processing device, electronic equipment and a computer storage medium, wherein the call data processing method comprises the following steps: by acquiring a historical call data sample set, each call data sample comprises a plurality of different outbound influence factor parameters and a connection state corresponding to the call, the outbound influence factor parameters can describe whether the call can be connected by a target object from a plurality of dimensions, and the connection state can clearly indicate whether the call is connected or not. The accuracy of a processing result obtained after the historical call data is processed is improved, and the outbound coefficient can be used for predicting the call completing rate of the call to be dialed out in the follow-up process, so that the call completing rate predicted according to the processing result in the follow-up process can accurately reflect the call completing rate of the current dialing period.

title_en: Apparatus and method for controlling transmission of electronic device
abstract_en: An electronic device according to various embodiments of the present invention may include a transmission module and a processor, wherein the transmission module includes a first transmission module and a second transmission module. The processor may receive a feedback of the transmission power of the first transmission module, calculate a difference between a target transmission power and the transmission power of the first transmission module, determine a state of the first transmission module based on the difference, and, according to the determination that the state of the first transmission module is abnormal, close the transmission operation of the first transmission module and activate the transmission operation of the second transmission module. Various other embodiments are possible.

title_en: X/Ku frequency band polarization twistable dual-polarization corrugated horn feed source
abstract_en: The invention provides an X/Ku frequency band polarization twistable dual-polarization corrugated horn feed source which comprises a dual-polarization excitation section, a mode conversion section and a radiation horn which are sequentially connected, wherein the dual-polarization excitation section comprises a horn front section, an end cover arranged on the horn front section, a ridge arranged in the horn front section and two sockets arranged on the horn front section and used for feeding. The polarization torsion of the feed source is realized, and in the torsion process, the performance change of the feed source can meet the use requirement.

title_en: Terminal
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a terminal, and belongs to the field of electronic equipment. The terminal includes: the flexible display screen extends from the front surface of the machine body to the back surface of the machine body; wherein, the organism includes: the device comprises a first machine body, a second machine body and a telescopic component, wherein the first machine body and the second machine body are arranged in parallel; the flexible display screen comprises a telescopic component, a first display component and a second display component, wherein the telescopic component is configured to drive the first body and the second body to move along the directions away from each other when in an outward extension state so as to drive a display area on the flexible display screen, which is positioned on the back surface of the body, to move from the back surface of the body to the front surface of the body; and the telescopic component is configured to drive the first machine body and the second machine body to move along the mutually approaching direction when the flexible display screen is in an inward contraction state so as to drive the display area on the front surface of the machine body on the flexible display screen to move from the front surface of the machine body to the back surface of the machine body.

title_en: Multi-station multi-target decentralized data sharing decision operation management and control architecture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-station multi-target decentralized data sharing decision operation management and control architecture, and aims to provide an overall architecture capable of realizing centerless multi-station multi-target task planning and scheduling. The invention is realized by the following technical scheme: the method comprises the steps that an upper-level center is used as a main node, a centerless mesh communication network for communicating any two points between the upper-level center and each navigation station is established by means of ground communication, satellite communication, beidou navigation communication and short wave communication, each navigation station adopts a centerless data sharing and decision mechanism and a sensing-evaluating-decision-executing closed loop to realize autonomous dynamic resource adjustment according to system management software and single station control software, each navigation station executes resource allocation and scheduling of the station according to a scheduling scheme generated by the station, the whole network decision of a system task planning scheme of each navigation station is completed by the same consensus strategy according to the centerless data sharing mechanism, and task reconstruction of a ground navigation system is executed according to a decision result.

title_en: Method for improving coupling performance of multi-antenna system by decoupling wave guide device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving coupling performance of a multi-antenna system by adopting a decoupling wave guide device. The decoupling wave guide device comprises a wave guide metal piece, and the wave guide metal piece is fixed on the antenna main board in a screw or direct insertion mode and is in contact with a stratum on the antenna main board. Or the wave-guiding metal piece is fixed above the antenna main board through the nonmetal supporting piece, and the wave-guiding metal piece is not contacted with the stratum. According to the invention, the wave guide device is inserted between the unit antennas of the multi-antenna system and connected to the ground of the main board, and part of electromagnetic waves which are generated in a coupling way are guided to enter the ground of the main board, so that the coupling with other antenna units is reduced, the purpose of reducing the coupling between the antennas is achieved, the structure is simple, the effect is good, and the wave guide device can be well applied to an MIMO communication system.

title_en: Channel state measuring method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a channel state measuring method and a channel state measuring device. In the embodiment of the invention, the terminal receives the CSI reporting mode indication information, and the CSI reporting mode indication information is used for indicating the terminal to perform CSI joint measurement and feedback based on N pieces of associated CSI measurement configuration information, so that the terminal can perform CSI measurement and feedback according to the CSI reporting mode indication information, and CSI measurement and feedback in a coordinated transmission scene by a plurality of coordinated transmission points are realized.

title_en: Interaction method for satellite Internet of things terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a satellite Internet of things terminal and a data interaction method thereof, and relates to the technical field of satellite Internet of things; the method comprises the following steps: s1, preparing for emission; s2, collecting data; s3, sending data; s4, receiving the entering of a waiting state; s5, receiving the entering of a preparation state; s6, processing the feedback information; the invention has the beneficial effects that: the satellite Internet of things terminal can establish stable data communication with a satellite channel in an extremely low power consumption working mode.

title_en: Time sensitive network redundant clock synchronization method and synchronization system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a time-sensitive network redundant clock synchronization method, which comprises the following steps: setting n master clocks, wherein each master clock provides a time synchronization signal of a clock domain for the time sensitive network, and n is more than or equal to 2; each node comprises n local clock management modules, and each local clock management module calculates a message and a clock synchronization signal message according to the link delay of each master clock and calculates to obtain the local clock domain time reference of each master clock; a multi-clock-domain clock synchronization management module is designed in each node and used for periodically calling time references of a plurality of local time domains, and the time references after fusion are used as the global time of the node through a fusion algorithm. The invention also discloses a time-sensitive network redundant clock synchronization system. The invention can improve the synchronization precision, redundancy, reliability and applicability of the clock synchronization of the whole time sensitive network.

title_en: Layout and array method of millimeter wave human body security inspection imager antenna based on MIMO
abstract_en: The invention provides a layout and array method, an array and an imaging detection method of an antenna of a millimeter wave human body security inspection imager based on MIMO, and belongs to the field of millimeter wave imaging. The layout method of the antenna array of the imager comprises the following steps: determining a horizontal aperture and a vertical aperture of an imager antenna array to be formed according to imaging requirements, wherein the imager antenna array comprises a receiving antenna array and a transmitting antenna array; and in the range of the aperture in the horizontal direction, the transmitting antenna array and the receiving antenna array are correspondingly arranged on the mobile scanning assembly, each transmitting antenna in the transmitting antenna array and one receiving antenna in the receiving antenna array form a transmitting-receiving antenna pair, the transmitting antennas are uniformly distributed in the transmitting antenna array, and the receiving antennas are uniformly distributed in the receiving antenna array. The invention is applied to an MIMO sparse array mode, and can effectively reduce the complexity of the system and the hardware cost.

title_en: Near field wireless device
abstract_en: One example discloses a near field wireless device configured to be coupled to a main conductive structure, the near field wireless device comprising: an electric near-field antenna having a first conductive antenna surface coupled to a first feed point and a second conductive antenna surface coupled to a second feed point; wherein the first conductive surface is separated from the second conductive surface by an air gap; wherein the first conductive surface and the second conductive surface are configured to be substantially equidistant from the primary conductive structure; and wherein the first conductive surface and the second conductive surface geometrically conform to the primary conductive structure.

title_en: Single-particle-state remote preparation method based on non-maximum entangled GHZ channel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a single-particle-state remote preparation method based on a non-maximum entangled GHZ channel. The quantum channel is established by applying the non-maximum entangled GHZ channel and the quantum remote state preparation method, so that the requirement of constructing a complex quantum communication network is met; by carrying out channel modulation at the remote auxiliary node, the problem that the source node has limited measurement capability and can not introduce auxiliary particles to carry out channel modulation is solved, and the method is simple to operate and easy to realize.

title_en: Double-fiber double-wave time transfer system and instantaneous clock error estimation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-fiber double-wave time transmission system and an instantaneous clock error estimation method, wherein a master time service station and a slave time service station are connected through an optical fiber link, the master time service station and the slave time service station are respectively provided with a laser emitter, a wavelength division multiplexing module, a time difference measuring module, a light detector, a transmitting channel and a receiving channel, the master time service station is also provided with a time signal holding module, and the slave time service station is also provided with a clock and a time delay compensation module. The method can accurately measure and calculate the clock error of the master station and the slave station, realize real-time automatic compensation and improve the time transmission precision of the optical fiber.

title_en: Operation terminal and facility device control system
abstract_en: An operation terminal (1a) is provided with: a connected device information transmitting unit (123) that transmits, to another operation terminal (1b), the 1 st connected device information, which is information on a facility device connected to the operation terminal (1 a); a connected device information acquisition unit (122) that acquires, from another operation terminal (1b), the 2 nd connected device information, which is information on a facility device connected to the other operation terminal (1 b); an operation receiving unit (15) that receives operations for the facility devices connected to the operation terminal (1a) and the facility devices connected to the other operation terminals (1 b); and an air-conditioning control command transmitting unit (142) that determines a destination to which a control command is transmitted based on the 1 st connection device information and the 2 nd connection device information, and transmits the control command to the destination, the control command indicating the content of the operation received by the operation receiving unit (15).

title_en: Apparatus and method for coordinating delivery of multiple data channels on a physical medium
abstract_en: The present invention provides an apparatus and method for unifying high-bandwidth, low-latency data services. In one embodiment, a network architecture for service delivery over at least a portion of an existing infrastructure (e.g., a hybrid fiber coax infrastructure) is disclosed that includes standard-compatible ultra-low latency and high data rate services (e.g., 5G NR services) via a common service provider. In one variation, the 3gpp 5g NR supported parallel MIMO data streams are frequency shifted before injection into a single coax feeder to achieve the aggregate maximum carrier bandwidth available to the 3gpp 5g NR chipset with frequency diversity (rather than spatial diversity). In one embodiment, an intermediate frequency IF is transmitted on the medium (i.e., instead of the higher frequency) and then block converted to an RF carrier frequency in an enhanced consumer premises device CPEe for 3GPP band compatible interoperability with the 3GPP 5g NR chipset in the CPEe.

title_en: Dual-polarized transmission surface for controlling electrical characteristics by terminating filter circuit and design method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dual-polarized transmission surface for controlling electrical characteristics by terminating a filter circuit and a design method thereof, wherein the transmission surface comprises: the dual-polarization receiving antenna comprises a dual-polarization receiving antenna array, a filter circuit and a transmitting antenna array, wherein the receiving antenna array is used for transmitting received electromagnetic wave signals to the filter circuit, the filter circuit is used for regulating and controlling the amplitude, phase and frequency characteristics of a transmission surface, and the transmitting antenna array is connected with a filter circuit terminal. The invention provides a new idea of controlling the electrical characteristics of incident electromagnetic waves by using a circuit, can realize a transmission surface with a single frequency band or multiple frequency bands and filter characteristics by reasonably designing the circuit, can obtain a frequency selection surface with a reflection frequency band and a transmission frequency band, and can be used as a dichroic mirror of a Cassegrain antenna subreflector.

title_en: Method and device for providing alarm about deleted contact
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method and apparatus for providing an alert regarding a contact being deleted. The method comprises the following steps: when it is monitored that a contact person in the contact person database is deleted, acquiring relevant information of contact person deletion; and determining whether to perform alarm display or not based on the relevant contact person deletion information. According to the method and the device, when the contact person is deleted, alarm information can be provided for the user, and the use experience of the user is improved.

title_en: RFID carrier tape with top and bottom conductors
abstract_en: Methods of incorporating a second conductor into an RFID carrier tape device and the resulting devices are disclosed in various embodiments. The second conductor adds functionality via coupling between the carrier conductor and the second conductor. The added function may be a secondary antenna operating at a different frequency than the first antenna driven by the carrier pad, sensing capability, a driver for a transmitting device such as an LED, or an interface to one or more semiconductor devices mounted on the second conductor.

title_en: Internet of things intelligent water meter system based on smart city system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an Internet of things intelligent water meter system based on a smart city system, and particularly relates to the field of intelligent water meter systems, wherein the Internet of things intelligent water meter system comprises a data acquisition layer, a data transmission layer, a data management layer and a comprehensive application layer; the data acquisition layer at least comprises an intelligent water meter which is connected with an intelligent acquisition device and used for collecting data information collected by the intelligent water meter; the data transmission layer is a wireless mobile network, the wireless mobile network at least comprises an Internet of things intelligent gateway, the Internet of things intelligent gateway is respectively connected with the data acquisition unit and the data management layer through a network, and data information received by the data acquisition unit is transmitted into the data management layer. According to the invention, multiple verification is required for requests and commands entering the database server from the outside, and the data acquisition of the intelligent water meter of the Internet of things must be judged by the system, so that the safety of the system in operation is ensured, and the possibility of data attack is reduced.

title_en: Multi-band easily-tuned terahertz wave absorber based on graphene
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-band terahertz wave absorber easy to tune based on graphene, which comprises a wave absorber unit, wherein the wave absorber unit is provided with 9 layers of structures, graphene layers and Topas medium layers are arranged at intervals of 8 layers from top to bottom in sequence, the bottom layer is a metal layer, the graphene layers are elliptic, and long axes of every two adjacent graphene layers are perpendicular to each other. The graphene layer is used as a wave absorbing material, and the graphene layer is of an elliptical structure and can induce local surface plasmon resonance of incident terahertz waves. Through doping different carrier concentrations to four different graphite alkene layers to change the chemical potential of graphite alkene, and then can independently adjust 8 frequencies of inhaling the ripples frequency channel, perhaps the length adjustment of major-minor axis also can independently adjust 8 frequencies of inhaling the ripples frequency channel. The terahertz wave absorber has the advantages of eight-frequency-band absorption, high absorption rate, easiness in tuning, simple structure, easiness in integration and the like.

title_en: Three-phase guide rail type multifunctional wireless electric energy metering terminal
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric energy data acquisition equipment, and particularly relates to a three-phase guide rail type multifunctional wireless electric energy metering terminal which comprises a terminal body, wherein a single chip microcomputer, a three-phase electric energy measuring module, a communication module, an LORA module, a miniature current transformer, a miniature voltage transformer and a power management module are arranged in the terminal body, and the miniature current transformer and the miniature voltage transformer are respectively connected with the three-phase electric energy measuring module. The invention can measure positive and reverse active electric energy, input and output reactive electric energy, can measure A, B, C three-phase voltage, three-phase current, each phase and total active power, reactive power, power factor and power grid frequency, and has the function of recording the maximum demand; the electric energy is respectively accumulated and stored according to the existence, the idle work, the positive direction, the reverse direction, the peak, the flat direction and the valley, the electric energy data freezing function is realized (the default freezing time is 24 hours at the end of each month), and the freezing data of 12 months can be stored in the table.

title_en: Data scanning optimization method, device and system and related components
abstract_en: The application discloses a data scanning optimization method, which is characterized in that a data scanning overall control instruction which is to be sent to a desktop cloud terminal by a virtual machine is intercepted; generating a simulation scanning control instruction according to the scanning control strategy of the high-speed scanner according to the data scanning overall control instruction; the USB controller is called to send the scanning instructions to the high-speed scanner one by one according to the sending rule of the simulation scanning control instructions, and the scanning instructions are changed into a whole, so that the instruction sending times between the virtual machine and the desktop cloud terminal are greatly reduced, the network transmission limitation is reduced, and the resource loss caused by the fact that the virtual machine sends the scanning control instructions of all parts to the desktop cloud terminal one by one through the network is effectively reduced. The application also provides a data scanning optimization device, equipment, a system and a readable storage medium, and has the beneficial effects.

title_en: Balanced type filtering phase shifter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a balanced type filtering phase shifter, which comprises a main line structure and a reference line structure, wherein the main line structure and the reference line structure have the same symmetrical structure and respectively comprise a top metal layer, a bottom metal layer, an intermediate metal ground, a first dielectric substrate and a second dielectric substrate. The top metal layer comprises two half-wavelength folded coupling lines, two half-wavelength first microstrip lines, two half-wavelength second microstrip lines, two half-wavelength third microstrip lines and two half-wavelength feeder lines. The bottom metal layer comprises a fourth microstrip line with half wavelength, two fifth microstrip lines and two feeder lines. Compared with most of the existing balanced phase shifters, the phase shifter has the common-mode rejection capability and the filtering capability; three ends of the two folded coupling lines are respectively connected with three half-wavelength microstrip lines, so that the phase shifter with a plurality of differential mode transmission zero points and a plurality of common mode transmission zero points is realized, and the phase shifter has the characteristics of high frequency selectivity and wide common mode rejection.

title_en: Bluetooth antenna structure and touch control pen with same
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a bluetooth antenna structure and a stylus pen having the same. The Bluetooth antenna structure comprises a substrate and an antenna module. The antenna module is arranged on the substrate. The first radiator has a first length along a first direction. The second radiator has a second length along the first direction, and the second radiators are arranged at intervals on the first radiator along the second direction. The second direction is perpendicular to the first direction. The plurality of third radiators are arranged at intervals along the second direction and correspond to the first radiators. The first connecting piece is arranged between the first radiating body and the second radiating body. The second connecting piece is arranged between the first radiator and a third radiator of the adjacent first radiator. The plurality of third connecting pieces are arranged between the third radiating bodies at intervals along the second direction. The first radiator, the third radiator, the second connector and the third connector form a resonant path. Thereby, the bluetooth band is generated through the resonance path.

title_en: Electronic device and control method thereof
abstract_en: An electronic device may include: a camera; a storage device; a display; and a processor configured to: obtaining three-dimensional (3D) coordinates corresponding to a face area of a user included in an image captured by a camera; obtaining position adjustment information for adjusting an image capturing position of the camera according to a difference between the 3D coordinates of the face region and the reference 3D coordinates stored in the storage means; and controlling the display to provide a guidance Graphical User Interface (GUI) for adjusting an image capturing position of the camera based on the position adjustment information.

title_en: Antenna array system for monitoring vital signs of a person
abstract_en: The present invention is directed to a patch antenna array system for monitoring vital signs of a person in an enclosed environment, comprising three patches whose far field pattern is shaped in the E-plane by series feeding and in the H-plane by parallel feeding to obtain a cardioid pattern, thereby compensating for free space losses due to large distances.

title_en: Method and device for optimizing weight parameters of antenna and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method and a device for optimizing weight parameters of an antenna and electronic equipment, which are used for solving the problems that the configuration of the weight parameters of the existing 3D-MIMO base station antenna usually needs consumed human resources and the manual configuration is difficult to achieve the optimum. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring user distribution conditions and weight parameters of antennas in the coverage range of a three-dimensional multi-input multi-output (3D-MIMO) base station to be optimized; iteratively optimizing the weight parameters of the antennas of the 3D-MIMO base station to be optimized according to the antenna gain maximization principle based on the user distribution condition in the coverage range of the 3D-MIMO base station to be optimized, the weight parameters of the antennas and a preset 3D-MIMO base station configuration database; and when the antenna gain of the 3D-MIMO base station to be optimized meets the convergence condition of the iterative optimization, configuring the weight parameter of the antenna of the 3D-MIMO base station to be optimized based on the weight parameter corresponding to the antenna gain meeting the convergence condition of the iterative optimization.

title_en: Codebook subset restriction signaling
abstract_en: The network node (10) signals to the wireless communication device (14) which precoders in the codebook are restricted from being used. The network node (10) generates codebook subset restriction signaling in this regard that, for each of one or more groups of precoders, jointly restricts the precoders in the group by restricting a certain component (e.g., a certain beam precoder) that the precoders in the group have in common. This signaling may be, for example, rank-agnostic signaling that jointly restricts the precoders in a group regardless of the precoder's transmission rank. In any case, the network node (10) transmits the generated signaling to the wireless communication device (14).

title_en: Low-voltage-driven high-speed photon quantum state preparation device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a low-voltage driven high-speed photon quantum state preparation device and a method thereof. The preparation device comprises a light source, a polarization beam splitting unit, a return unit, a phase modulation unit and an intensity modulation unit, wherein the polarization beam splitting unit is used for splitting signal light into a first component and a second component with polarization states perpendicular to each other and enabling the first component and the second component to enter the return unit. The return unit is used for returning the first and second components to the polarization beam splitting unit again at the same time. A phase modulation unit and an intensity modulation unit are arranged in the return unit for phase modulating and intensity modulating at least one of the first and second components, wherein the intensity modulation comprises making the intensity of said component zero.

title_en: Scanning piece collecting device and control method thereof
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the scanner and specifically relates to a scanning piece collection device and control method thereof, its scanning device and paper piece collecting box, paper piece collecting box includes first box and is fixed in the second box of first bottom of the case portion, scanning device set up in the last top surface of first box, the lateral wall of first box articulates there is first chamber door, the lateral wall of second box articulates there is the second chamber door, first chamber door is provided with the control first controlling means that first chamber door was opened and close, the second chamber door is provided with the control the second controlling means that the second chamber door was opened and close, the bottom surface is opened down in the first box have with the paper mouth that falls that the second box link up, paper mouth department is provided with and is used for the shutoff the dodge gate and the control of paper mouth the drive arrangement that the dodge gate opened and close. The paper piece collection and storage system has the effect of improving convenience of collecting and storing paper pieces which are scanned and finished in an office hall.

title_en: Electronic device control method, electronic device control device, storage medium and electronic device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an electronic device control method, an electronic device control device, a storage medium and an electronic device, which are applied to the electronic device. The electronic equipment control method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first data flow of a first excitation signal transmitted by a first master set communication module within a preset time; acquiring a second data flow of a second excitation signal transmitted by a second master set communication module within a preset time length; and determining the master set communication module with larger data traffic as a target master set communication module, and controlling the target master set communication module to be conducted with the first radiator or the second radiator so as to improve the radiation performance of the electronic equipment.

title_en: Wall-mounted high-speed shooting instrument based on OCR technology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of OCR, in particular to a wall-mounted high-speed scanner based on OCR technology, which comprises a wall-mounted box body and a high-speed camera lens, wherein damping telescopic rods are arranged on the inner walls of the left side and the right side of the wall-mounted box body and are hinged with a carrying plate, a plurality of second fixed teeth meshed with the first fixed teeth are arranged on the upper side of a sliding plate, the lower ends of two sealing blocks are fixedly connected with piston rods extending out of mounting seats, first air outlet pipes connected with a cavity are arranged at the upper ends of the two mounting seats, a first air blowing pipe with two ends both pointing to the interior of the wall-mounted box body is assembled at one side of the first air outlet pipe provided with a first one-way air outlet valve, second air blowing pipes with two ends both pointing to the carrying plate are assembled at the two second air blowing pipes provided with a second one-way air outlet valve, the surface of the carrying plate and the box body can be blown to remove ash respectively.

title_en: Circular polarized quadrifilar helix antenna
