abstract_en: Devices and systems are disclosed that include a body having a plurality of slots. Each slot of the plurality of slots includes a first portion, a second portion, and a third portion. The first portion is located on the first surface of the body. The second portion is located on the second surface of the body and forms a spiral shape. The third portion is located on a third surface of the body. The first surface and the second surface are not parallel. The third surface and the second surface are non-parallel. The apparatus includes a plurality of antenna elements disposed in respective ones of a plurality of slots. The plurality of antenna elements are configured to receive Radio Frequency (RF) signals. The apparatus includes a ground plane coupled to a first end of each of the plurality of antenna elements.

title_en: Multi-beam CSI feedback
abstract_en: In multi-beam communications, a UE may assist in scheduling beams utilized during multi-beam communications by improving the manner in which beam quality is reported to the network. The apparatus may measure signals received from the base station on at least one beam. The apparatus may detect a trigger event for providing CSI for the at least one beam. The apparatus may send an uplink transmission including a CSI report in response to detecting a triggering event. The apparatus may receive an uplink request from a UE for CSI providing at least one beam. The apparatus may transmit an indication to schedule a CSI report in response to the uplink request. The apparatus may receive an uplink transmission from the UE including a CSI report for the at least one beam.

title_en: Wireless communication module and method for data transmission based on GPRS network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless communication module and a method for data transmission based on a GPRS network. The wireless communication module comprises a power supply circuit, a GPRS chip, a logic level conversion circuit, a switching on/off control circuit, a switching on/off state feedback circuit, an Internet of things card, a radio frequency circuit, a GPRS antenna and an indicator light; the power circuit is connected with an external power supply and is connected with the GPRS chip; the GPRS chip is connected with the single chip microcomputer system through the logic level conversion circuit, the on-off control circuit and the on-off state feedback circuit respectively; the GPRS chip is connected with the Internet of things card, the radio frequency circuit and the indicator lamp respectively, and is connected with the server through the radio frequency circuit and the GPRS antenna. The invention can be combined with an instrument converter of a singlechip system, can be arranged in the converter, and realizes the wireless transmission of data between an instrument end and a server through a GPRS network.

title_en: Indoor little basic station and antenna unit of high circularity
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of communication, and provides a high-roundness indoor small base station and an antenna unit, wherein the antenna unit comprises a feed network, an integrated support and a radiator; the integrated bracket is arranged on the metal carrier, and the radiator is arranged on the integrated bracket and is positioned at the edge of the metal carrier; the radiator comprises a radiation piece, and a feed probe and a short-circuit probe which are connected with the radiation piece. In the practical application process, the parasitic radiator is loaded around the radiating sheet, current distribution which is opposite to the surface current of the metal carrier is generated on the parasitic radiator, and mutual offset with the surface current of the metal carrier is realized, so that the surface current of the antenna structure is distributed in relative central symmetry, that is, the optimization of out-of-roundness in the horizontal direction can be realized, and the problem that the current generated on the surfaces of the radiator and the metal carrier cannot be distributed in relative central symmetry, that is, the characteristic of high roundness in the horizontal direction of an antenna unit cannot be met under the trend of high integration and integration of the antenna is solved.

title_en: Method and device for sharing carrier channel by platform area intelligent terminal APP
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for sharing a carrier channel by an intelligent terminal APP in a transformer area, which are characterized in that a carrier communication agent APP is arranged to realize that the intelligent terminal of the transformer area acquires the APP to share the carrier channel under the occasion of power line carrier communication of a low-voltage distribution transformer area, and the transmission of messages is realized by utilizing an MQTT protocol bus, so that the method and the device can be used for equipment such as an intelligent distribution terminal, an intelligent fusion terminal of the transformer area, a concentrator and the like, the sharing and interaction of the carrier signal channels of the equipment are realized, and the resource utilization rate of a power line carrier communication interface of the terminal is improved.

title_en: Calling system and calling method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a calling system and a calling method, which relate to the technical field of communication, wherein the calling system comprises: the system comprises emergency help equipment, an intelligent terminal, a distributed server and a seat terminal; the emergency help-seeking device is used for responding to the triggered call instruction and sending an emergency call signal to the intelligent terminal; the intelligent terminal is used for responding to the emergency call signal and sending a first call request to the distributed server; and the distributed server is used for sending a second call request to the seat terminal of the call center associated with the intelligent terminal according to the first call request so as to establish voice call service connection between the intelligent terminal and the seat terminal of the call center associated with the intelligent terminal. The calling system and the calling method can improve the rescue efficiency by utilizing the distributed server.

title_en: Signal identification device and method of wireless tire pressure data multi-path antenna
abstract_en: The invention relates to a signal identification device of a wireless tire pressure data multi-path antenna and a method thereof, and the signal identification device comprises a bearing keel, a wiring terminal, an insulating lining plate, a signal receiving circuit, a frequency modulation circuit, a communication antenna, a plurality of auxiliary storage batteries and a driving circuit, wherein the wiring terminal is embedded in the front end surface of the bearing keel, the communication antennas are embedded in the rear end surface of the bearing keel, the insulating lining plates are embedded in the upper end surface and the lower end surface of the bearing keel, the auxiliary storage batteries and the driving circuit are embedded in the upper end surface of the bearing keel and are connected with the insulating lining plates, and the signal receiving circuit and the frequency modulation circuit are embedded. The using method comprises three steps of system assembly, system setting, signal identification and the like. On one hand, the invention can effectively improve the receiving efficiency of the wireless signals for detecting the tire pressure and improve the stability and the communication quality of the received signals; on the other hand, the precision of the specific wireless communication signal identification operation can be effectively realized.

title_en: WIFI board carries antenna
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of antenna structure design, in particular to a WIFI onboard antenna. The method comprises the following steps: a dielectric substrate; the antenna element comprises a first antenna element and a second antenna element; one end of the microstrip feeder line is connected with the first antenna oscillator, and the other end of the microstrip feeder line is connected with the transceiver; and one end of the microstrip balun is connected with the first antenna oscillator, and the other end of the microstrip balun is connected with the second antenna oscillator and used for balancing resonance between the first antenna oscillator and the second antenna oscillator. The technical scheme has the following advantages or beneficial effects: the first antenna oscillator and the second antenna oscillator printed on the mainboard are connected through the microstrip balun, so that the second antenna oscillator which is originally grounded in the existing design can generate resonant current and participate in radiation, the radiation performance of the antenna is improved, the resonant frequency band range of the antenna can be 2.4 GHz-2.5 GHz by adjusting the length of the antenna oscillator and the position of the microstrip balun, and a good impedance matching effect is achieved.

title_en: Filter
abstract_en: A compact filter having excellent characteristics is provided. A filter (10) is provided with: a resonator (11A) having a via electrode (20) formed in a dielectric substrate (14) and a 1 st strip line (18) facing a 1 st shield conductor (12B) among a plurality of shield conductors (12A, 12B, 12Ca, 12 Cb) formed so as to surround the via electrode and connected to one end of the via electrode; an input/output terminal (22A) coupled to the 2 nd shield conductor (12A) among the plurality of shield conductors; and a 1 st capacitor electrode pattern (26A) coupled to the input/output terminal, wherein the 1 st capacitor electrode pattern is capacitively coupled to a 2 nd capacitor electrode pattern (27A) or a 1 st strip line connected to the via electrode section.

title_en: Passenger flow analysis equipment
abstract_en: Passenger flow analysis apparatus comprising: the processor is used for responding to the received first wake-up signal for wake-up, is suitable for controlling the power supply module to supply power to the second detection equipment after receiving the first wake-up signal, and controls the power supply module to supply power to the communication module when data needs to be uploaded to the server, so that the data transmitted by the second detection equipment is received and transmitted to the communication module; the first detection device is suitable for detecting whether a human body target appears in real time, and when the human body target appears, a first wake-up signal is sent to the processor; the second detection equipment acquires data after being electrified and lasts for a first time period; and the communication module receives the data transmitted by the processor and sends the data to the server after being electrified. According to the passenger flow analysis equipment, under the condition that the PIR sensor does not detect that a human body target appears, most components in the passenger flow analysis equipment are in a low power consumption mode or a dormant or power-off state, so that the power consumption of the passenger flow analysis equipment is greatly reduced.

title_en: End-to-end detection method for echo removing effect between communication systems
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of audio test, in particular to an end-to-end detection method applied to echo removing effect among communication systems i According to the formula Calculating the average sound pressure difference of the audio signal returned to the sending module, and judging the intelligent communication system according to the average sound pressure differenceThe technical scheme effectively finishes echo suppression test and effectively obtains the echo suppression characteristic parameter of the audio signal, and effectively judges whether the echo suppression characteristic of the audio signal is good or not according to the echo suppression characteristic parameter.

title_en: Electronic float with function of voice broadcasting of fish conditions
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electronic float with a function of voice broadcasting of fish conditions, which is characterized by comprising a fish detecting emitter and a fish detecting receiver; the shell of the fish finding emitter is divided into an upper cover and a base, a threading column is respectively designed, a through hole is arranged in the middle of the threading column, the threading column is also simultaneously connected together after the upper cover and the base are buckled, a threading hole from top to bottom is formed in appearance, and a fish line can pass through the threading hole; the fish detecting emitter is internally provided with an ultrasonic probe, a battery and an emitter circuit board which are connected by a connecting wire and used for detecting the fish condition; the receiver shell is divided into an upper part and a lower part, a button and an installation part are arranged after buckling, and the receiver shell can be carried about or installed on a fishing rod; the fish finding transmitter transmits the detected fish information to the receiver in a wireless communication mode, and the receiver broadcasts the received fish information through voice.

title_en: Radio frequency spectrum dynamic allocation method and device based on reinforcement learning algorithm
abstract_en: The application discloses a radio frequency spectrum dynamic allocation method and device based on a reinforcement learning algorithm, which are used for solving the problem of insufficient utilization of a frequency spectrum due to idle frequency spectrum, so that the frequency spectrum resources are tense. The method comprises the steps of constructing a radio communication system model, and determining assignable radio frequency bands and bandwidths; determining key performance indexes and corresponding priorities corresponding to different communication scenes; and respectively allocating corresponding frequency bands and bandwidths to different communication scenes by utilizing a reinforcement learning and deep neural network according to the key performance indexes and priorities of the communication scenes. In the method, the DQN algorithm is applied to a frequency band allocation strategy in a multi-communication scene in a 5G Internet of things environment, flexible allocation of radio frequency bands is realized, and the utilization rate of a 5G frequency spectrum and the reliability of a communication system can be improved.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring induction heating equipment and implementation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent monitoring induction heating device and a realization method, wherein an induction coil G1 is wound on a welding seam of a pipe fitting to be heated, K-type thermocouples K1, K2, K3 and Kn are bound on the welding seam of the pipe fitting according to the standard and are used for feeding back the surface temperature of the heated pipe fitting in real time, the K-type thermocouples feed back the measured temperature to a PLC (programmable logic controller), and when the measured temperature is lower than the given temperature of a touch control screen, the PLC regulates the output power of a main power supply loop to increase by controlling a main control panel circuit, otherwise, the output power of the main power supply loop decreases; meanwhile, the PLC regulates the output power of the main power supply circuit to become zero by controlling the main control panel circuit, so as to protect the heated pipe from overheating; the operator observes the real-time heating state of job site through the cell-phone, realizes long-range scram operation through cell-phone APP, finally accomplishes the postweld heat treatment work to the pipe fitting welding seam, reaches the effect of eliminating internal stress.

title_en: Microwave synthesis device for improving power output
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microwave synthesis device for improving power output, and belongs to the technical field of microwaves. The microwave cavity comprises a main waveguide and a plurality of identical auxiliary waveguides, wherein the auxiliary waveguides are distributed along the axial direction of the main waveguide, the main waveguide and the auxiliary waveguides are made of metal, and the microwave mode of the main waveguide is identical to that of the auxiliary waveguides; one end of each auxiliary waveguide is provided with an input port, the output ports of the auxiliary waveguides are provided with short circuit surfaces for preventing energy output, and the short circuit surfaces of the auxiliary waveguides are positioned on the same side; a short circuit surface for preventing energy output is arranged on the same side of the input port of the main waveguide and the auxiliary waveguide; and a coupling slit for communicating the inner cavity of the main waveguide with the inner cavity of the auxiliary waveguide is formed on the common connecting surface of the auxiliary waveguide and the main waveguide, and the coupling slit is used for coupling microwave sources in the auxiliary waveguides into the main waveguide so as to increase the output power. The invention can efficiently couple a plurality of high-power microwave sources, thereby achieving the purpose of amplifying power.

title_en: High-frequency antenna multiplexing method for multi-RFID (radio frequency identification) tag identification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-frequency antenna multiplexing method for multi-RFID (radio frequency identification) tag identification, which is applied to the field of wireless communication and aims to solve the problems of energy transmission and communication in a narrow space.A antenna suitable for the space is manufactured in the limited narrow space, and all other devices needing communication in the space are mounted on the antenna, namely a plurality of devices use the same antenna to collect electromagnetic wave energy and use the same antenna to communicate with other devices; each device selects to monopolize an antenna (a full matching mode in which one device is connected to the antenna) or yield the antenna (the device is short-circuited and does not receive signals and energy of the antenna) according to a received command, only one device can be selected to monopolize the antenna each time the device function is started, and all other devices yield the antenna, so that the device monopolizing the antenna can obtain enough energy from the antenna.

title_en: Method and apparatus in a node used for wireless communication
abstract_en: A method and apparatus in a node used for wireless communication is disclosed. A first node receives a first signaling and a first reference signal; the first information block is transmitted. The first signaling corresponds to the first reference signal; the first information block indicates a first channel quality, measurements for the first reference signal are used to determine the first channel quality; the first signaling indicates a first destination identification used to identify a first group of nodes comprising a positive integer number of nodes other than the first node. The method increases the reference signals which can be used for measuring the path loss, and improves the measuring accuracy of the path loss.

title_en: Display method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a display method, an electronic device and the like. In the method, during the state switching process of the foldable display screen of the electronic device, the electronic device can display a target interface with a size changing in the foldable display screen. Therefore, the scheme can achieve smooth transition of interface switching in the state switching process of the foldable display screen, achieve the visual effect that the size change of the target interface is fitted with the state switching process of the actual foldable display screen, and improve the visual experience of a user.

title_en: Miniaturized multi-polarization reconfigurable antenna with electric modulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small-sized electric modulation multi-polarization reconstruction antenna, which comprises a circular first dielectric substrate, wherein a circular parasitic radiation sheet is printed on the upper surface of the first dielectric substrate; a square second dielectric substrate is arranged below the first dielectric substrate, and an air layer is arranged between the second dielectric substrate and the first dielectric substrate at intervals; a feed network and a circular main radiating sheet are printed on the upper surface of the second medium substrate, and the feed network is connected with the main radiating sheet; and the lower surface of the second dielectric substrate is printed with a grounding metal plate, and the grounding metal plate and the second dielectric substrate are identical in shape and size. The miniaturized electrically-controlled multi-polarization reconfigurable antenna adopts an electronic adjusting mode to realize the receiving and transmitting of electromagnetic waves with left-hand circular polarization, right-hand circular polarization, + 45-degree linear polarization and-45-degree linear polarization, simplifies the feed structure of the antenna, and enhances the functionality and the integration degree of the antenna.

title_en: MBUS host computer receiving circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a MBUS host receiving circuit, comprising: according to the MBUS host receiving circuit provided by the invention, the acquisition module acquires a current signal in an MBUS bus and converts the current signal into a level signal, the isolation module realizes electrical isolation between the acquisition module and the signal processing module, the signal processing module divides the level signal output by the isolation module into two paths, the two paths of level signals carry out voltage reduction processing on one path of level signal and filter a high level signal in the other path of level signal to obtain a reference voltage, the signal processing module filters a static electric signal of a low voltage signal after voltage reduction by using the reference voltage to obtain the level signal, and the signal conversion module converts the level signal into a TTL signal and then transmits the TTL signal to a single chip microcomputer, so that a pure and stable TTL signal can be obtained without manually setting the reference voltage, and the accuracy and the stability of the high level signal received by the MBUS host are improved.

title_en: Dual-band multi-mode combined feed source loudspeaker
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dual-band multi-mode combined feed source loudspeaker, and belongs to the technical field of microwaves. The device comprises a support, wherein the support is fixedly connected with an outer structure, a C-frequency band feed source and an S-frequency band feed source group are arranged on the support, the C-frequency band feed source is arranged in the center of the support, and the S-frequency band feed source group is arranged outside the C-frequency band feed source; the S-band feed source group comprises a plurality of S-band feed sources, the S-band feed sources are uniformly distributed along the central ring direction of the support at intervals, and the rear end of any one S-band feed source is connected with the waveguide converter. The C frequency band feed source adopts a ring loading corrugated horn; the ring-loading corrugated horn comprises a light wall area, a ring loading area, a corrugated area and an opening angle area, wherein the light wall area is in transitional connection with the corrugated area through the ring loading area, and the opening angle area is in butt joint with the corrugated area. This application is applicable to C frequency channel and S frequency channel, designs suitable C frequency channel feed structure and bore to compromise the performance of two frequency channels.

title_en: Communication terminal device
abstract_en: The application provides a communication terminal device, relates to the technical field of communication, and is used for realizing microwave and optical dual-mode data transmission and beam pointing fast deflection. The method mainly comprises the following steps: the dual-mode phase control antenna array unit is used for receiving a control signal sent by the dual-mode directional adaptive control unit, and transmitting an electric signal between the dual-mode data processing unit and the dual-mode phase control antenna array unit; the dual-mode phase control antenna array unit comprises N dual-mode phase control subunits, wherein each dual-mode phase control subunit comprises a dual-mode radiation subunit, a phase-shifting subunit and a transceiving subunit which are connected in sequence; the dual-mode radiation subunit comprises M optical antennas, a fixing piece, an optical waveguide, a rear-end optical component, P microwave antennas and a microwave feed waveguide; wherein the optical antenna is used for receiving and transmitting optical signals, and the microwave antenna is used for receiving and transmitting microwave signals.

title_en: Auxiliary control device for servo motor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of servo motor control, and discloses an auxiliary control device for a servo motor. The first anti-interference layer and the second anti-interference layer in the anti-interference plate can achieve the purpose of signal anti-interference, and the servo motor can be conveniently controlled through the control box; the infrared control module can be used for remotely controlling the controller through remote infrared rays, and the wireless receiving and transmitting module can also be used for controlling the wireless terminal.

title_en: Circuit and method for improving radio frequency isolation and mobile terminal
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a circuit, a method and a mobile terminal for improving radio frequency isolation, wherein the circuit comprises: the switch module comprises at least two isolation control modules; the isolation control module receives signals of a plurality of frequency bands and is used for outputting attenuated signals; the switch module is connected with the isolation control module and used for gating a radio frequency channel according to a received frequency band, the radio frequency channel corresponds to the isolation control module corresponding to the received frequency band and outputs the signal meeting the requirement of preset isolation. The scheme improves the radio frequency isolation, and the space which can be saved is realized by combining frequency bands according to requirements, and the more the combination is, the more the space is saved relatively.

title_en: Information transmission system and method for supervising entrance and exit of living places of floating population
abstract_en: The invention discloses an information transmission system and method for supervising entrance and exit of a living place of floating population. The system consists of an LoRa terminal set, an LoRa gateway, an NB-IoT terminal set, an NB-IoT base station and an information fusion processing platform. The information transmission system adopts a LoRa architecture blended into NB-IoT, meets the requirements of sporadic distribution and in-and-out supervision of a connected centralized living place, and reduces TCO of the system; an internal/external double antenna is designed according to the maintenance system LoRa complete system, so that the shielding effect of a metal door on LoRa signals is eliminated, and the reliability of the system is improved; an LC filter circuit of LoRa is improved by means of a surface acoustic wave filter, and a Bluetooth module ensures the legal power of opening/closing door authorization of a house property owner; according to the data of the entrance and the exit of the resident place of the lessee, the LoRa working mode is set according to the requirement of people, and the low power consumption and the real-time performance of the information transmission system are considered.

title_en: Voice transcription method, device, recording pen and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a voice transcription method, a voice transcription device, a recording pen and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring current audio data based on an audio acquisition module in the electronic equipment; determining the transcription text of the current audio data based on the current transcription mode of the electronic equipment; the transfer mode is determined based on at least one of audio transfer requirements, equipment energy consumption states, equipment network states and historical transfer states, and the transfer mode is online transfer or offline transfer. According to the voice transcription method and device, the recording pen and the storage medium provided by the embodiment of the invention, the current transcription mode is determined based on at least one of the audio transcription requirement, the equipment energy consumption state, the equipment network state and the historical transcription state, and the current transcription text of the audio data is determined based on the current transcription mode, so that different scene requirements can be met, and the flexibility and the application range of voice transcription are improved.

title_en: Optimization method of MU-MIMO beam overlapping, communication equipment and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an optimization method, communication equipment and a system for MU-MIMO beam overlapping, wherein when the correlation degree between original channel matrixes corresponding to second communication equipment is greater than a preset threshold value, the first communication equipment adjusts the original channel matrixes corresponding to the second communication equipment according to a preset deflection angle to obtain new channel matrixes, and the new channel matrixes are sent to the corresponding second communication equipment; the second communication equipment receives the new channel matrix sent by the first communication equipment, decodes according to the new channel matrix and generates spatial stream data; the problem of the beam overlapping under the multi-user environment that can not be fine solution among the prior art is solved. That is, the MU-MIMO beam overlap optimization method, the communication device, and the system provided by the present invention adjust the angle of each beam according to the deflection angle by combining the multipath environments of a plurality of users, and regenerate a new beam direction, thereby avoiding mutual interference between users whose beams overlap in the original space.

title_en: Combined spectrum sensing method and system based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of cognitive radio, in particular to a combined spectrum sensing method and system based on a neural network. The method comprises the steps of collecting spectrum data at a plurality of edge nodes by using an undersampling technology and training by using a time delay neural network model to finally obtain a judgment result of a spectrum, then converging the judgment result to a central node, fusing data, training a convolutional neural network, and finally obtaining a final global spectrum sensing result at the central node. The method can effectively improve the accuracy of spectrum sensing, and simultaneously, the spectrum sensing result has more global significance, thereby providing an accurate and reliable basis for the establishment of a communication link.

title_en: Electromagnetic absorption structure with optical transparency and adjustable wave-absorbing frequency
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electromagnetic absorption structure with both optical transparency and adjustable wave-absorbing frequency, which comprises a first dielectric substrate, a first graphene layer, a diaphragm layer, a second graphene layer, a second dielectric substrate, an indium tin oxide layer, a third dielectric substrate, a dielectric loss layer, a reflecting layer and a fourth dielectric substrate which are sequentially laminated from top to bottom, wherein each graphene frequency selective surface unit in the first graphene layer respectively comprises a square graphene block and four rectangular graphene blocks distributed around the square graphene block, the structure of the second graphene layer is completely the same as that of the first graphene layer, and each indium tin oxide frequency selective surface unit in the indium tin oxide layer respectively comprises a square indium tin oxide block and four rectangular indium tin oxide blocks distributed around the square indium tin oxide block; the method has the advantages that the wave-absorbing frequency can be regulated and controlled only by regulating the resistance value of the graphene surface, and the wave-absorbing frequency has optical transparency and a large range of adjustable wave-absorbing frequency.

title_en: Low-profile shared-aperture dual-circular-polarization orbital angular momentum state multiplexing antenna
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-profile shared-aperture dual-circular-polarization orbital angular momentum state multiplexing antenna, which belongs to the field of electromagnetism and specifically comprises the following components: regular octagon metal paster, two dielectric slabs, metal floor and feed network. The regular octagonal metal patch is etched with a gap and is connected with the feed network through four metalized through holes in the two dielectric plates; two metallized through holes are formed in the first dielectric plate to form a short-circuit column. The feed network comprises two 3dB directional couplers, two ports at one end of each coupler are respectively used as input ends of radio frequency signals, the two radio frequency signals with equal amplitude and 90-degree phase difference are distributed through the couplers and reach a specific region of a regular octagon through metallized through holes to form two currents with orthogonal oscillation directions and 90-degree phase difference, and then different circularly polarized electromagnetic waves are generated and radiated outwards. The invention greatly improves the communication capacity under the condition of not occupying additional frequency spectrum resources.

title_en: Echo cancellation method and device for voice communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses an echo cancellation method and device for voice communication. The method comprises the following steps: respectively acquiring a far-end voice signal and a near-end voice signal, and aligning the far-end voice signal and the near-end voice signal; processing the aligned far-end voice signal and near-end voice signal based on the optimization criterion of the minimum average short-time accumulated error criterion according to the short-time correlation characteristic of the nonlinear acoustic echo to obtain and update the filter coefficient of the optimal nonlinear filter; and generating an estimated echo according to the filter coefficient of the nonlinear filter and the far-end voice signal so as to eliminate the echo voice signal in the near-end voice signal. The method not only processes the nonlinear acoustic echo generated by the actual call terminal due to power amplifier components, acoustic structure design and the like, but also better meets the requirement of IP telephone on voice in actual application, thereby improving the quality of call. Moreover, the echo cancellation method also solves the problem that the NLMS self-adaptive method has poor effect in processing nonlinear echo.

title_en: Image steganalysis method and terminal based on Tucker decomposition
abstract_en: The invention discloses an image steganalysis method and a terminal based on Tucker decomposition, wherein the method comprises the following steps: training by using a data set to obtain an initial image steganalysis model; performing Tucker decomposition search on each convolution layer of the initial image steganalysis model by using a preset search algorithm to obtain the number of input channels and the number of output channels of the decomposed core tensor of each layer; and establishing a new image steganography analysis model according to the number of input channels and the number of output channels of the decomposed core tensor of each layer, training, selecting the image steganography analysis model with the best performance to perform image steganography analysis, and judging whether the input image is a carrier image or a steganography image carrying steganography information. According to the method, one convolution layer in the initial image steganalysis model is decomposed into a convolution group consisting of three lightweight convolution layers through Tucker decomposition, so that the purposes of reducing model parameter quantity and calculating quantity are achieved.

title_en: Partition wall and method for improving isolation of millimeter wave receiving and transmitting antenna
abstract_en: The invention discloses a partition wall and a method for improving isolation of a millimeter wave receiving and transmitting antenna, and belongs to the technical field of receiving and transmitting antennas. This improve division wall of millimeter wave receiving and dispatching antenna isolation mainly includes: the partition wall is an H-shaped medium partition wall. The antenna matching device is simple in structure, small in occupied space, small in antenna matching influence and small in antenna directional diagram influence.

title_en: Terahertz waveguide and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a terahertz waveguide and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: drawing the prefabricated pipe into a capillary by adopting a capillary wire drawing method; plating a metal film outside the capillary tube; plating a protective layer outside the metal film; and corroding the capillary by adopting a corrosion method. Unlike traditional method of plating dielectric film inside metal film, the present invention produces capillary as dielectric film through drawing, plating metal film and final etching capillary with corrosion method to reach optimal thickness requirement.

title_en: Method and device for dynamic lossless bandwidth adjustment of M-OTN system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for adjusting dynamic lossless bandwidth of an M-OTN system.A source node adds bandwidth adjustment information issued by a control platform into OSU frame overhead and transmits the bandwidth adjustment information to the downstream one by one; after the host node extracts the bandwidth adjustment information from the OSU frame overhead, calculating whether the residual bandwidth resources of the host node meet the adjustment requirement, and transmitting corresponding bandwidth adjustment confirmation information to the upstream one by one; the source node adds a bandwidth adjustment instruction issued by the control platform into OSU frame overhead and transmits the bandwidth adjustment instruction to the downstream one by one; after the host node extracts the bandwidth adjustment instruction from the OSU frame overhead, the host node feeds back bandwidth adjustment instruction confirmation information to the upstream node by node, and completes the adjustment of the pipeline bandwidth of each node in the link and the adjustment of the client signal bandwidth step by step. The scheme does not need to interrupt the link data transmission processing process, does not need a unified network control platform to control and operate, and meets the actual use requirement of the operator network.

title_en: System and method for reporting beam correspondence status
abstract_en: Certain aspects of the present disclosure provide techniques for reporting beam correspondence states. Certain aspects provide a method for wireless communications by a first wireless device. The method comprises the following steps: based on detecting the occurrence of the trigger event, one or more beam correspondence states are determined for one or more beams or portions of beams used by the first wireless device for communication. The method further comprises the following steps: transmitting, to a second wireless device, one or more indications of one or more beam correspondence states, wherein the one or more indications of one or more beam correspondence states indicate: whether the first wireless device has the capability of beam correspondence between one or more beams and corresponding one or more transmit beams or receive beams used by the first wireless device for communication.

title_en: Touch display screen and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a touch display screen and electronic equipment, and belongs to the technical field of electronic equipment. The touch display screen comprises a touch layer and a touch substrate, wherein the touch layer comprises a plurality of touch sensors which are arranged in an array, the touch sensors are arranged on the first surface of the touch substrate, antenna contact points are arranged on at least part of the touch sensors, and the antenna contact points are electrically connected with a radio frequency integrated circuit so that the touch sensors provided with the antenna contact points are formed into antenna electrodes. The scheme of the application realizes that part of the touch sensor has both a touch function and an antenna radiation function, so that the problem that the conventional antenna layer and the conventional touch layer are mutually interfered due to overlapping is solved, the addition of the antenna layer on the touch display screen is avoided, the thickness of the touch display screen is reduced, and the touch experience of a user and the radiation efficiency of the antenna are improved.

title_en: System and method for channel and interference measurement in wireless networks
abstract_en: An embodiment method used by a User Equipment (UE) includes: performing Channel Measurement (CM) for a first subset of a set of non-zero-power (NZP) CSI reference signal (CSI-RS) resources and Interference Measurement (IM) for at least a second subset of the set of NZP CSI-RS resources. The second subset includes one or more NZP CSI-RS ports. The IM is performed according to the following assumptions: each NZP CSI-RS port in the second subset corresponds to an interfering transmission layer, the IM being a set according to an energy per resource element ratio respectively associated with one NZP CSI-RS resource in the second subset; and other interference not associated with the interfering transmission layer is located in the first and second subsets. The method comprises the following steps: generating a Channel State Information (CSI) report based on the CM and the IM and sending the CSI report to a network.

title_en: Sparse array antenna layout method and sparse array antenna
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sparse array antenna layout method and a sparse array antenna. The method comprises the following steps: determining a first parameter of the regular unit subarray, wherein the first parameter comprises the number of the antenna units forming the unit subarray, the arrangement mode and the space between the antenna units; determining a second parameter of the regular antenna subarray according to the space of each antenna unit and the disturbance quantity of the space, wherein the second parameter comprises the number and the arrangement mode of the unit subarrays forming the antenna subarray and the space among the unit subarrays; the plurality of antenna sub-arrays are randomly distributed in a preset area of the array antenna, and the antenna sub-arrays in the preset area are symmetrically transformed for a plurality of times, so that the final array antenna is formed. The invention can inhibit grating lobe to the maximum extent, reduce the cost of the antenna; in addition, the small antenna subarrays which are regularly distributed are easy for batch production of T/R components, and the light and thin radio frequency front end is integrated, so that the weight of the antenna is greatly reduced.

title_en: Antenna, terminal middle frame and terminal
abstract_en: The utility model provides an antenna, terminal center and terminal relates to the communication hardware field. The antenna includes: the first antenna unit and the second antenna unit are adjacently arranged; the first antenna unit comprises a first antenna branch and a first parasitic branch, and the second antenna unit comprises a second antenna branch; the first parasitic branch is positioned between the first antenna branch and the second antenna branch; the first parasitic branch section is L-shaped and comprises a first branch section and a second branch section; the first end of the first branch segment is in contact with the ground area, the second end of the first branch segment is connected with the first end of the second branch segment, and the second end of the second branch segment points to the second antenna branch segment. The antenna unit is divided into the antenna branch sections and the parasitic branch sections, and the parasitic branch sections are arranged between the two adjacent antenna branch sections in an L-shaped mode, so that the two antenna branch sections excite reverse current to the parasitic branch sections, surface waves are offset, electromagnetic coupling between the antenna units is reduced, and isolation between the antenna units is reduced.

title_en: Method for testing starting capability of automatic driving vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for testing starting capability of an automatic driving vehicle, which comprises the following steps: arranging a directional antenna, a positioning antenna, wireless transmission equipment, wireless communication equipment and a combined navigation receiver on a test vehicle; the roadside wireless communication unit is connected with the wireless communication equipment, a starting instruction and a driving destination are issued to the test vehicle through the roadside wireless communication unit, the directional antenna and the positioning antenna transmit acquired information to the combined navigation receiver in real time after the test vehicle is started until the test vehicle reaches the driving destination, the combined navigation receiver calculates a course angle, a transverse acceleration and the like of the test vehicle and transmits the course angle, the transverse acceleration and the like back to the roadside wireless communication unit through the wireless transmission equipment, and the roadside wireless communication unit compares the received information with a built-in threshold value and judges whether the test is successful or not. The invention can test the starting capability of the automatic driving vehicle before the automatic driving vehicle is put into the actual road test, thereby ensuring the safety of the starting process of the automatic driving vehicle.

title_en: Superconducting device and method for controlling direct current and microwave signals
abstract_en: Fabrication of superconducting devices that combine or separate direct current and microwave signals is provided. A method may include forming a dc circuit to support dc, a microwave circuit to support microwave signals, and a common circuit to support dc and microwave signals. The method may further include operatively coupling a first terminal of the direct current circuit and a first terminal of the microwave circuit to a first terminal of a common circuit. The direct current circuit may comprise a band stop circuit and the microwave circuit may comprise a capacitor. Alternatively, the dc circuit may comprise a band stop circuit and the microwave circuit may comprise a band pass circuit. Alternatively, the microwave circuit may comprise a capacitor and the direct current circuit may comprise one or more quarter wavelength transmission lines.

title_en: 5G communication technology signal tower and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 5G communication technology signal tower and a use method thereof, the structure comprises a base, a support column, a protective frame, a communication transmission structure, a D2D communication terminal and a lightning rod, wherein the base is horizontally arranged at the lower end of the support column, the protective frame is arranged at the outer side of the support column in a surrounding manner, the communication transmission structure is mechanically connected to the outer side of the support column, the D2D communication terminal is fixedly arranged above the outer surface of the support column, the lightning rod is vertically arranged at the upper end of the support column, the communication transmission structure comprises an installation disc, a fixing structure, a buffer structure, a connecting frame and a communication transmission box, the fixing structure is arranged at the outer side of the installation disc in a surrounding manner and welded with the installation disc, the fixing structure is arranged at the outer side of the installation disc, the contact area with wind is further reduced, the structure is more stable when encountering the, the shaking of the equipment is reduced, the communication transmission is more stable, and the experience effect of a user is improved.

title_en: Lightning arrester aging evaluation system and method under multi-pulse influence of humid environment
abstract_en: The application shows a lightning arrester aging evaluation system and method under the influence of multiple pulses in a humid environment, wherein an upper computer is controlled to transmit information to a humidity control main terminal through a wireless signal transmission device, and the humidity control main terminal processes data transmitted by a humidity sensor of a test box to obtain actual test humidity; if the actual test humidity meets a first error range, performing a multi-pulse impact aging test to obtain multi-pulse simulation impact times; calculating the reference current performance and the humidity influence factor according to the actual test humidity and the multi-pulse simulation impact frequency, and further calculating the valve plate aging factor; and evaluating the aging condition of the valve plate of the lightning arrester according to the valve plate aging factor. The invention accurately evaluates the aging degree of the valve plate of the lightning arrester in different humidity under multiple lightning strokes, reduces the test error by accurately controlling the humidity, more truly simulates the actual environment, and provides guidance for the design, manufacture and maintenance of the valve plate of the lightning arrester in a humid environment.

title_en: Collinear interference estimation method for high-low orbit co-frequency coexisting satellite communication system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collinear interference estimation method of a high-low orbit co-frequency coexisting satellite communication system, which comprises the following steps of: according to ephemeris data of a high-low orbit satellite communication system and longitude and latitude of a ground station, constructing an interference analysis scene between the high-low orbit satellite communication system and the ground station; screening out collinear interference links among high and low orbit satellite communication systems according to ephemeris data; distinguishing the types of the interference links according to the screened collinear interference links; configuring a ground station, communication terminal parameters of each satellite, a satellite ephemeris and earth station position parameters; and respectively estimating the carrier power received by the receiving end, the noise power and the carrier power from the interference source. The method aims at the specific calculation method for respectively providing parameters such as signal source carrier power, noise power, interference source carrier power and the like under different interference link types, improves the accuracy and pertinence of collinear interference estimation, and can be applied to design of satellite communication systems in various frequency bands such as S, Ku and Ka and declaration and coordination of space frequency resources.

title_en: Broadband reflection array antenna based on single-layer clip-shaped unit structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a broadband reflection array antenna based on a single-layer clip-shaped unit structure, which comprises a pyramid horn antenna and a reflection array, wherein the reflection array comprises a plurality of reflection units, each reflection unit comprises a metal patch, a dielectric substrate and a metal grounding plate, the metal patch is printed on the upper surface of the dielectric substrate, and the metal grounding plate is arranged at the bottom of the dielectric substrate; the metal paster is the clip type structure that has embedded type of falling L metal arm, reserves certain width between type of falling L metal arm and the rectangle paster both sides inward flange. The external dimension of each reflecting unit rectangular patch is kept unchanged, the phase of each reflecting unit rectangular patch can realize linear change of more than 360 degrees, the planar reflecting array antenna formed by the reflecting units can realize remarkable improvement of gain bandwidth and aperture efficiency, and stable and good radiation characteristics are presented in a working frequency band.

title_en: Pilot frequency optimization design method based on equiangular compact frame theory
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pilot frequency optimization design method based on an equiangular compact frame theory, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: in FDD massive MIMO system downlink; step two: taking a random Gaussian matrix as an initial pilot matrix; matrix cross correlation minimization is taken as an optimization target; step three: designing a pilot matrix optimization algorithm according to an equiangular tight frame theory; step four: channel estimation is carried out by sending the optimized pilot frequency, and a CSM iterative algorithm is adopted in the optimization algorithm so as to further reduce the calculation complexity; the invention has the beneficial effects that: aiming at the channel estimation problem of FDD large-scale MIMO downlink, the invention improves the channel estimation performance by optimizing a pilot matrix method.

title_en: Wave beam alignment method of intelligent reflecting surface auxiliary millimeter wave communication system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of millimeter wave wireless communication, and particularly relates to a quick beam alignment method of an intelligent reflector assisted millimeter wave communication system. A fast beam alignment method based on sparse sensing and phase-free estimation is provided by writing a cascade channel related to an intelligent reflecting surface into sparse representation, and an optimal beam pair is recovered by designing a series of sparse sensing matrixes and utilizing a maximum likelihood estimator. Simulation experiments show that the method provided by the invention can achieve the performance similar to brute force search with extremely low pilot frequency training overhead, has huge performance advantages compared with the existing beam alignment algorithm, can still maintain better robustness under low signal-to-noise ratio, and embodies the practical feasibility of the invention.

title_en: Software platform for managing miniature communication terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a software platform for managing a miniature communication terminal, which relates to the technical field of electronic communication and software and comprises a server, a database, an interactive interface program, a communication management program, a registration configuration management program and a data analysis processing program. The software platform manages the micro communication terminals distributed in different places or the micro communication terminals installed in other equipment through the Internet, receives data collected or forwarded by the micro communication terminals, and then analyzes and processes the data, so that files such as daily operation condition reports, alarm notices, early warning prediction reports and the like can be formed. The invention can help users to better use the micro communication terminal or the equipment provided with the micro communication terminal, and simultaneously provides the improvement and upgrade basis of products for related manufacturers.

title_en: Intelligent photographing method for surveying operation in communication industry
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent photographing method for exploration operation in the communication industry, which comprises the following steps: step 1, uniformly planning the photographing attributes of a survey site or a survey object to form a preset photographing formula model; step 2, downloading a photographing formula model to a photographing device; step 3, the photographing device identifies the surveyed object; step 4, the photographing device automatically photographs the surveyed object; step 5, the photographing device automatically photographs the periphery of the surveyed object in multiple angles; step 6, automatically screening out the picture with the highest definition by the photographing device; if the unqualified photo exists, reminding the reconnaissance personnel to retake the photo; step 7, the photographing device automatically adds a watermark and a signature of a photographer; step 8, the photographing device automatically writes the survey information into the photo data; step 9, the photographing device automatically encrypts the photo; step 10, the photographing device automatically backs up the photos; and 11, transmitting the photo to a cloud server by the survey personnel.

title_en: Automobile performance test turntable
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of mechanical equipment, and discloses an automobile performance testing turntable, which adopts the technical scheme that the turntable comprises a bottom plate and a connecting plate, wherein the bottom plate is horizontally arranged, a vertical plate is arranged on the bottom plate, a power assembly is arranged on the vertical plate, the vertical plate can be provided with a fixing place through the arranged bottom plate, the connecting plate can slide up and down on the vertical plate, the power component can drive the connecting plate to slide up and down on the vertical plate so as to move the dual-polarized antenna to a proper height, the dual-polarized antenna can rotate on the connecting plate through the arranged rotating shaft and can receive signals through the arranged dual-polarized antenna, the dual-polarized antenna can be driven to rotate around the rotating shaft through the arranged rotating component, so that the dual-polarized antenna rotates to an angle with the optimal data transmission rate, the detection platform can provide a place for the automobile to improve the utilization rate of the indoor space.

title_en: Dust concentration detection display screen
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dust concentration detection display screen which comprises a box cover, a display screen main body and a control box, wherein a photovoltaic plate is arranged on one side of the display screen main body, a sliding groove is formed in one side of the box cover, a fixing head is arranged in the sliding groove, a sliding block is arranged on one side of the fixing head, a spring is arranged on one side of the sliding block, the control box comprises a radiating groove, radiating holes, a data interface and a power interface radiating groove, the radiating holes are formed in one side of the control box, a radiating fan is arranged in the radiating groove, a data storage device is arranged in the control box, a processor is arranged on one side of the data storage device, a storage battery is arranged on one side of the processor, a heat conduction strip is arranged at the bottom end of the processor, a data connector is arranged at the bottom end of the heat conduction strip, a wireless signal. The invention not only has the effects of convenient assembly and disassembly and touch control of remote data transceiving, but also has the characteristics of convenient energy saving and power storage and intelligent heat conduction and heat dissipation.

title_en: Flying rod, flying rod assembly, cavity filter and communication equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses fly pole, fly pole subassembly and cavity filter, communication equipment, this fly pole includes: the flying rod body is made of an insulating material; and the conductive layer is arranged on at least one side surface of the flying rod body, wherein when the flying rod is used in the cavity filter, the surface of the flying rod body provided with the conductive layer extends from one resonant cavity in the cavity filter to the other adjacent and communicated resonant cavity. The application provides a flying bar can reduction in production cost, alleviates flying bar quality, makes things convenient for the later stage to process according to actual need.

title_en: Visible light imaging communication control method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visible light imaging communication control method, a visible light imaging communication control device, visible light imaging equipment and a storage medium. The invention obtains the input data received by the modulation module and converts the input data into a digital modulation signal; controlling an LED driver to carry out AC-DC coupling with LED driving current, and loading the digital modulation signal to an LED light source to realize the electro-optic conversion of the digital modulation signal and form a modulation optical signal; controlling a camera to receive the modulated light signal through a visible light channel and converting the modulated light signal into a digital signal; demodulating the digital signal to generate a data stream; decoding the data stream into original input data and outputting the original input data to a back-end controller for information extraction; and forming a visual graphical interface according to the extracted information data. The visible light imaging communication control method can improve the illumination quality from a modulation mode, meet the illumination requirement and effectively save resources.

title_en: Live equipment of multi-functional portable platform
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of platform live broadcast equipment, in particular to multifunctional movable platform live broadcast equipment, and provides a scheme for solving the problem that the existing equipment cannot carry and store external equipment at the same time. The direct-broadcasting device is convenient to store and carry when carrying external equipment through linkage and matching of all parts, the added additional live-broadcasting equipment can be placed on the accessory mounting table and connected through the sockets, signal wires connecting all the equipment pass through the pipelines arranged on the device, and therefore the direct-broadcasting device is convenient to arrange and prevents the signal wires from being wound together in a mess manner when being carried.

title_en: Hierarchical video transmission method based on millimeter waves
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hierarchical video transmission method based on millimeter waves, which comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring millimeter wave channel information according to pilot frequency information transmitted by a user; step 2, performing SVC video coding on the video required by the user; step 3, pre-coding the original signal matrix, forming a beam of the pre-coded signal through a discrete lens antenna array, and selecting the beam as a beam for bearing the emission signal according to the contribution of the transmission rate; and 4, performing power distribution of transmitting videos and layer number distribution of the grading videos on the users within the coverage range of the base station. According to the hierarchical video transmission method based on the millimeter waves, the set of the wave beams which have the largest influence on the information transmission rate of the system is selected, so that radio frequency links needed in the system are reduced, and the power consumption and the cost of the system are reduced.

title_en: Traffic prediction device method and device, and bandwidth allocation method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a traffic prediction device method and a device thereof, and a bandwidth allocation method and a device thereof, wherein the traffic prediction device method comprises the following steps: determining second traffic prediction information from: first cache information, first traffic information, second cache information; the first buffer information is used for indicating a buffer occupancy state of a transmission container T-cont in a first dynamic bandwidth allocation DBA period, the first traffic information is used for indicating traffic sent by the T-cont in the first DBA period, the second buffer information is used for indicating a buffer occupancy state of the T-cont in a second DBA period, the second traffic prediction information is used for indicating a predicted value of the OLT for the second traffic information, and the second traffic information is the traffic sent by the T-cont in the second DBA period. According to the invention, the problem that the OLT cannot accurately predict the bandwidth required by the ONU in the related technology can be solved, so that the effect that the OLT can accurately predict the bandwidth required by the ONU can be achieved.

title_en: Method, device, system and medium for intelligent customer service switching
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method, a device, a system and a medium for intelligent customer service switching. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a consultation problem of a user; identifying user intention according to the consultation problem; replying the consultation problem based on the response knowledge points which are acquired from the response knowledge point library and are matched with the user intention; determining whether the current man-machine conversation content triggers a manual condition; if the current man-machine conversation content triggers a manual conversion condition, matching according to the mapping relation between the historical man-machine conversation content and the pre-established manual customer service group-dialogue information to obtain a response manual service group; and initiating a transfer request for designating the response manual customer service group to the manual customer service system. The method of the embodiment of the disclosure can be matched with the manual service group with proper skills according to the mapping relation during the transfer of the people.

title_en: Test method, device and equipment for automatically driving vehicle
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method, a device and equipment for testing an automatic driving vehicle, which are applied to the technical field of automatic driving and used for improving the safety and accuracy of a test result. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of firstly determining a target vehicle to be tested and a real closed test scene in a preset range, then receiving simulation data sent by a cloud server, wherein the simulation data are generated by the cloud server according to the preset simulation scene, and then carrying out AR test on the target vehicle by utilizing the simulation data in the real closed test scene in the preset range to obtain a test result. Therefore, the target vehicle is subjected to the AR test in the real closed test scene by using the cloud simulation data, so that the target vehicle cannot distinguish whether the environment where the target vehicle is located is real or the AR test scene, the accuracy of the test result can be improved through a test mode combining the real scene and the simulation data, and the safety of the test process is ensured.

title_en: Electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses an electronic device, which only comprises one antenna, wherein the antenna at least comprises a first subsection and a second subsection, the first subsection is used for supporting the coverage of a first frequency band and a second frequency band based on the generation of low-frequency and medium-frequency resonance, and a gap is arranged between one end of the second subsection and the first end of the first subsection and used for supporting the coverage of a third frequency band under the excitation of the first end; the frequency corresponding to the first frequency band is lower than the frequency corresponding to the second frequency band, and the frequency corresponding to the second frequency band is lower than the frequency corresponding to the third frequency band. Therefore, the coverage of different communication frequency bands is supported by one antenna, so that the number of the antennas is reduced under the condition of ensuring multi-frequency band coverage, the space occupation amount is correspondingly reduced, the antenna can be better adapted to the smaller antenna clearance environment of the current equipment, and the mutual influence among different antennas in a multi-antenna setting mode is avoided.

title_en: Printed antenna
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a printed antenna, and the coverage modes of selectable working frequencies and directional patterns of the antenna are expanded. The printed antenna is printed on the substrate, the substrate is also provided with a feed source module, and the printed antenna comprises an annular antenna body, a feed port and a switch device; the loop antenna body comprises a first end and a second end, a distance is reserved between the first end and the second end, a connecting line between the first end and the second end and the loop antenna body form a closed loop, the first end is connected with the feed source module through the feed port, and the second end is connected with the grounding point (GND); the feed source module is used for outputting a feed signal to the loop antenna body through the feed port; the loop antenna body comprises a plurality of loop antenna branches, a switch device is arranged between every two adjacent loop antenna branches, and the switch device is used for conducting or disconnecting the two adjacent loop antenna branches.

title_en: Flexible broadband dipole wearable graphene antenna
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flexible broadband dipole wearable graphene antenna, which comprises: the radiating unit is in a dipole antenna form and comprises a first conductor and a second conductor which are arranged in an up-down symmetrical mode, wherein the first conductor comprises a connected trapezoid part and a rectangular part, the upper bottom of the trapezoid part is close to the center of the flexible dielectric substrate, the lower bottom of the trapezoid part is connected with the first long edge of the rectangular part, the second long edge of the rectangular part is close to the edge of the flexible dielectric substrate, and the length of the long edge of the rectangular part is the same as that of the lower bottom of the trapezoid part; a plurality of rectangular grooves are arranged on one side, close to the edge of the flexible medium substrate, of the first conductor at intervals, the depth of each rectangular groove is gradually decreased from the center to two sides, and the distance between every two adjacent rectangular grooves is equal. According to the antenna, the radiating unit is in a broadband dipole antenna form, and a symmetrical and gradually-changed rectangular groove structure is loaded, so that a wider impedance bandwidth is realized.

title_en: Lens antenna packaging structure, preparation method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a lens antenna packaging structure, a preparation method and electronic equipment, wherein the lens antenna packaging structure comprises a rewiring layer, a feeder line, a plastic packaging layer, an antenna, a lens, a chip and a solder ball bump; the lens covers the antenna, so that one or a combination of a spherical beam and a cylindrical beam radiated naturally converges after being refracted by the lens, and a plane beam is finally formed to improve the directionality of the beam through the lens, so that the directional gain of electromagnetic waves can be enhanced through the lens, the attenuation and loss of the electromagnetic waves of the antenna are reduced, and the lens has a great energy-saving function on a 5G base station and a terminal.

title_en: Electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses an electronic device, comprising a housing assembly, wherein the housing assembly comprises a first housing and a second housing which can relatively move; the flexible screen is arranged on the shell assembly and can be unfolded or folded along with the relative movement of the first shell and the second shell; the loudspeaker is arranged on the first shell, the loudspeaker comprises a variable sound cavity, the variable sound cavity is connected with the second shell, and the volume of the variable sound cavity can be increased or decreased along with the relative movement of the first shell and the second shell. The electronic equipment sound quality and appearance thinning and thinning can be solved.

title_en: Adjustable wireless base station
abstract_en: An adjustable wireless base station comprises a base, a plurality of antenna modules and an antenna driving module, wherein the antenna modules are movably arranged on the base and used for receiving and transmitting wireless signals, and the antenna driving module is movably connected with the antenna modules and used for driving the antenna modules to move relative to the base, so that the purpose of adjusting the radiation pattern of the adjustable wireless base station is achieved.

title_en: Airborne satellite communication system and satellite link switching method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses an airborne satellite communication system and a satellite link switching method thereof, wherein a modem of the airborne satellite communication system comprises a plurality of core protocol board cards, a beam configuration information interaction module and a switching connection module for connecting the core protocol board card which is currently used to an antenna; the method comprises the following steps: starting up a target core protocol board card; based on the current core protocol board card in use, sending the access time and the current position information of the target core protocol board card to a network operation center of the current core protocol board card; based on feedback information of a network operation center of a current core protocol board card, obtaining beam configuration information of a target core protocol board card, and writing the beam configuration information into a beam configuration information interaction module; switching and connecting a target core protocol board card to an antenna; and the target core protocol board card establishes a communication channel and tracks the satellite according to the read beam configuration information. The method and the device shorten the interruption time of satellite communication in the satellite link switching process.

title_en: Spatial expandable mesh antenna with profile precision capable of being adjusted in orbit
abstract_en: The invention provides a space expandable mesh antenna with the shape surface precision capable of being adjusted in an orbit, which comprises: the foldable support device comprises a foldable annular support rod, an elastic inhaul cable, a central foldable support truss and a central liftable platform; the center liftable platform is installed at the top end of the center foldable support truss, the foldable annular support rods surround the center foldable support truss as the center, the elastic cables form an antenna reflecting surface through the foldable annular support rods, the bottom surface of the antenna reflecting surface is connected with the center foldable support truss through the elastic cables, and the top surface of the antenna reflecting surface is connected with the center liftable platform through the elastic cables. According to the invention, the antenna reflecting surface is formed by the composite material annular foldable rod and the elastic inhaul cables, the annular supporting rigidity is provided by the composite material annular foldable rod, and the parabolic antenna reflecting surface can be realized by adopting a layer of cable net, so that an antenna inhaul cable system is simple, the processing and preparation difficulty is low, and the high storage ratio can be realized.

title_en: System for transmitting a sampled signal through an imperfect electromagnetic path
abstract_en: The infrastructure electronic equipment includes infrastructure Local Site Transport (LST). LSTs carry payload sampled signals over imperfect Electromagnetic (EM) pathways whose physical properties are typically unknown at the time the equipment (e.g., cameras, displays, set-top boxes) is manufactured. Previous LSTs prevent EM pathway degradation in several ways: request a high quality cable (e.g., HDMI); limit transmission distance (e.g., HDMI); and/or reduce quality via compression to extend transmission distance to some extent (e.g., ethernet).
