The subject of the present disclosure is an infrastructure LST for sampling signals that causes the physical errors that inevitably arise due to propagation of sensory payload through imperfect EM pathways to manifest themselves in a perceptually good way, thereby taking advantage of the traditional infrastructure and reducing costs to achieve a favorable fidelity to transmission distance ratio.

title_en: Switch assistor for communication and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an exchanger aid for communication and a using method thereof, belonging to the field of exchangers, the scheme is that the exchanger is fixedly limited by adjusting the distance between a pair of C-shaped frames, dust entering the inside of the exchanger is reduced by an isolating and heat radiating device, when the exchanger is used, the dust enters the inside of the exchanger through a fine through hole or an interface, the working temperature is raised, a heat absorbing plate absorbs high temperature and is discharged through a radiating fin, the dust in the exchanger is absorbed to the outer side of an adhesive plate of the dust by negative charges generated by current after a graphite layer is electrified, a heat expansion ball is broken when the exchanger generates high temperature or open fire in short circuit, carbon dioxide in the heat expansion ball leaks to reduce open fire combustion conditions, when the temperature of the exchanger is overhigh, heat is transferred into a glass tube through heat conducting carbon fibers, and alcohol in the glass tube is broken by thermal expansion, the heat dissipation effect of the switch is improved, and further damage of the switch is reduced.

title_en: Wearable device and wearing detection method thereof
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of electronic equipment, and particularly provides wearable equipment and a wearing detection method thereof. A wearable device, comprising: an antenna unit including a radiator; and the wearing detection unit comprises a detection circuit, and the detection circuit is connected with the feed terminal of the radiator so that the radiator forms the sensing end of the wearing detection unit, thereby being beneficial to the miniaturization design of equipment.

title_en: Adaptive eye-worn device antenna
abstract_en: An eyewear apparatus comprising a lens; a support structure adapted to be worn on a user's head, the support structure comprising an edge configured to support the lens in a viewing area visible to the user when the support structure is worn; an antenna embedded in or forming part of the support structure, the antenna extending at least partially into the rim; a transceiver adapter for transmitting and receiving signals; and a tuner coupled between the transceiver and the antenna, the tuner adapted to match an impedance between the antenna and the transceiver to improve power transfer.

title_en: Dynamic spectrum access method based on confidence interval upper bound algorithm and DRL algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dynamic spectrum access method based on a confidence interval upper bound algorithm and a DRL algorithm, and belongs to the field of wireless communication. The method specifically comprises the following steps: s1: constructing a distributed dynamic spectrum access system model; s2: constructing a cumulative expected reward function for the SUE; s3: obtaining an optimal access strategy according to historical experience and state actions of an access channel so as to obtain the maximum accumulated expected reward; s4: and solving the access strategy by adopting a method of combining a DQN algorithm and a confidence interval upper bound algorithm in deep reinforcement learning, and obtaining the optimal access strategy through continuous iteration. The invention can obtain the optimal dynamic spectrum access strategy corresponding to the condition that the channel state transfer rule is known under the condition that the channel dynamic change rule is unknown.

title_en: Test method and test circuit based on 400G optical module
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test method based on a 400G optical module, wherein the test method comprises the following steps: including, host computer control standard photoelectric module works in pseudo-random code mode and error code detection mode, replace high-end error code appearance through standard photoelectric module, standard photoelectric module and the photoelectric module that awaits measuring all set up on same production testing board simultaneously, adopt 16 to connect high-speed electric differential signal group, need not 32 expensive radio frequency connecting wires, through above-mentioned connected mode, realize the production test to the 400G optical module, high-end error code appearance has both been saved, 32 expensive radio frequency connecting wires, the replacement cost who surveys the board has also greatly reduced.

title_en: Optical module-based electric dispersion compensation method
abstract_en: An electrical dispersion compensation method based on an optical module, comprising: waiting for the optical module to be in a ready state, initializing the optical module by the MCU, and finishing reset and initialization of the electric dispersion compensation chip; the method comprises the steps that after initialization of an electric dispersion compensation chip is completed, a reference mode is entered, an LOS (logic of output) judgment unit monitors a received electric signal according to a preset rule, and when the received electric signal triggers a DE _ LOS (Dee _ LoS) state of an optical module, the electric dispersion compensation chip starts to start an automatic calibration function; the electric dispersion compensation chip automatically runs a calibration algorithm, performs dispersion compensation on the electric signal converted by the receiving sub-module, and calibrates the optical module; and after the optical module finishes calibration, the optical module is switched from the reference mode to the master mode, so that the optical module works normally. The method is different from the conventional compensation design, the calibration coefficient is automatically updated according to the difference of the light source, the electric dispersion compensation coefficient is ensured to be always in the most appropriate range, and the application range is greatly improved.

title_en: Timestamp correction method based on system time as cryptographic algorithm initialization vector
abstract_en: The invention provides a timestamp correction method based on system time as a cryptographic algorithm initialization vector. The method is used in communication encryption systems with global time information, including but not limited to NTP time-synchronized communication encryption systems, TDMA communication encryption systems, and the like. No matter the cipher device adopts a CBC (code-based communication) mode, an OFB (offset-based distribution) mode and the like of a sequence algorithm or a grouping algorithm, an algorithm initialization vector is required. The method attaches defined initialization vector components containing correction timestamps to encrypted message transmission along with the path; after receiving the encrypted message, the receiving end equipment reads the correction timestamp and the local timestamp attached to the associated channel for correction, and then uses the corrected timestamp and other information to form a unique initialization vector and correctly decrypts the message. The method of the invention solves the problem that in a communication encryption system with global time information, the time information is used as an initialization vector of a cryptographic algorithm, thereby reducing the load occupation loss caused by encryption and decryption and simultaneously ensuring the consistency of cryptographic synchronization information.

title_en: Information processing apparatus, information processing method, recording medium, and computer program product
abstract_en: The invention provides an information processing apparatus, a recording medium, and an information processing method, which can properly extract a document region from an input image of a captured document, compared with a case where the document region is not extracted from the input image of the document according to an item of the document. The information processing apparatus is characterized by comprising a processor for receiving an input image including images of a plurality of originals, executing an output process for detecting one or more items predetermined as items included in the originals from the input image, and executing an image extraction process for extracting and outputting each original from the input image based on the detected one or more items.

title_en: Pipe network damage point positioning and monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pipe network damage point positioning and monitoring device, which comprises a bracket, wherein the top end of the bracket is provided with a mounting frame, the inner side of the mounting frame is provided with a monitor, the bottom end of the bracket is provided with a detecting head, the detecting head and the bracket are spliced together, the arc surface of the probe is provided with a lead wire which is connected with the detector, the top end of the mounting frame is provided with an antenna, the invention solves the problems that the prior pipeline monitoring equipment mostly monitors the state of the pipeline in real time and cannot monitor the leakage of the pipeline, so that the leakage of the underground pipeline cannot be timely monitored and fed back to the terminal under the condition of pipeline leakage, through improving and optimizing monitoring facilities's structure for monitoring facilities can carry out real-time monitoring to the point of pipeline damage, and monitoring facilities can feed back the condition of weeping to the terminal when the weeping appears in the pipeline of being convenient for.

title_en: Preparation method and system of micron-sized rectangular waveguide
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method and a system of a micron-sized rectangular waveguide, which are characterized in that a to-be-processed product is obliquely arranged in the horizontal direction, the oblique direction is perpendicular to the oblique direction of a first side edge of a cutting edge of a diamond blade, and the diamond blade is cut in the vertical direction to form a first scribing groove; and rotating the to-be-processed product to enable the to-be-processed product to be obliquely arranged with the horizontal direction, wherein the arranging direction is perpendicular to the oblique direction of the second side edge of the cutting edge of the diamond blade, so that the diamond blade is kept to cut in the vertical direction to form a second scribing groove, and a rectangular waveguide is formed at a reserved position between the two scribing grooves. The invention does not need to cut through the micron-sized lithium niobate thin film layer, thereby obtaining the rectangular waveguide with smooth side wall and easy processing.

title_en: HPLC carrier module debugging system for smart electric meter
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent electric meters, in particular to an HPLC carrier module debugging system for an intelligent electric meter, which comprises an electric energy meter, wherein the output end of the electric energy meter is electrically connected with an electric meter information acquisition module, the output end of the electric meter information acquisition module is electrically connected with a carrier concentrator, the output end of the carrier concentrator is electrically connected with a signal receiving unit, the output end of the signal receiving unit is electrically connected with an HPLC concentrator switcher, and the output end of the HPLC concentrator switcher is electrically connected with a central processing chip. This a central processing chip that is used for HPLC carrier module debugging system of smart electric meter to set up passes through PLC control module independent control relay one, relay two and relay three respectively to through relay one, relay two and relay three with carrier debugging module one, carrier debugging module two and three one-to-one control of carrier debugging module, and then debug.

title_en: High-elasticity composite high polymer material and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of high polymer materials, in particular to a high-elasticity composite high polymer material and a preparation process thereof, wherein the high-elasticity composite high polymer material comprises 24-32 parts of polyurethane polyol, 16-28 parts of isocyanate, 11-15 parts of foaming agent, 7-14 parts of chain extender, 4-6 parts of foam stabilizer and 2-3 parts of antioxidant; because the mechanical property of a product prepared from the high-elasticity material needs to be selected from the overall dimension, on one hand, the lightness and thinness of the structure of the product need to be maintained, and on the other hand, the protection effect of the mobile phone under a falling state also needs to be ensured; therefore, the water storage film grids vertically overlapped are formed in the rubber foam protective shell, the water storage film provides buffering deformation allowance for the protective shell through the flow of the water solution filled in the water storage film, the thickness of the protective shell prepared from the rubber foam is reduced, meanwhile, the glycol component mixed in the water solution in the water storage film is added, the structural stability of the water storage film is maintained, and the service life of the protective shell is prolonged.

title_en: Call processing method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure discloses a call processing method, a device, an electronic device, a storage medium and a program product, wherein the call processing method comprises the following steps: responding to a received substitute number inquiry request sent by a calling party, wherein the substitute number inquiry request carries a calling number and/or a first substitute number, and the calling number and the first substitute number are determined; inquiring the current state of the first alternative number, and determining an available second alternative number from a preset alternative number set when the current state of the first alternative number is unavailable. The technical scheme not only can well protect the privacy of the user, but also can avoid the situation that a certain substitute number becomes unavailable due to various reasons to cause the interruption of the user call flow, thereby improving the stability of the user call flow and improving the service quality of the user.

title_en: Sync signal monitoring using multiple configurations within a sync signal period
abstract_en: Various aspects of the present disclosure generally relate to wireless communications. In some aspects, a wireless node may determine a default period for repeating a reference signal period; and may monitor one or more reference signals in the reference signal period using a plurality of configurations of a plurality of intervals of the reference signal period. Each interval is shorter than the default period. Numerous other aspects are provided.

title_en: Clock identification method and device based on PTP
abstract_en: The invention provides a clock identification method and a clock identification device based on PTP, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving a PTP message sent by a master clock; determining a first frequency stability of the master clock according to the PTP message, wherein the first frequency stability is information which is carried in the PTP message and is used for representing the frequency stability of the master clock; determining a second frequency stability according to the PTP message, wherein the second frequency stability is determined based on the actual frequency of the master clock; judging whether the deviation between the first frequency stability and the second frequency stability meets a preset condition or not; and if so, taking the master clock as a synchronizable clock. According to the invention, the forged master clock can be identified in time.

title_en: Operation execution method, operation execution device, electronic device, and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses an operation execution method, an operation execution device, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, which belong to the technical field of artificial intelligence, wherein the operation execution method comprises the following steps: displaying a target image corresponding to the current behavior characteristics of the user; receiving a confirmation input for the target image; in response to the confirmation input, a target operation corresponding to the first scene feature in the target image is determined, and the target operation is performed.

title_en: Routing method and device for avoiding high risk area in low-orbit satellite network
abstract_en: The invention provides a routing method and a device for avoiding a high risk area in a low earth orbit satellite network, which comprises the following steps: determining an overhead low-orbit satellite node corresponding to a ground high-risk area as a dangerous node; determining a nearest available orbital plane for forwarding of data packets between nodes based on a minimum distance between the dangerous nodes and a high risk area in a low earth orbit satellite; and determining a route for forwarding the data packet between the nodes based on the nearest available orbit plane, and updating the route at each hop for executing the route for forwarding the data packet. The method and the device provided by the invention realize that the transmission path of the data packet in the low-orbit satellite network avoids the overhead of a high-risk area.

title_en: Data isolation exchange method and device based on visible light communication
abstract_en: The invention provides a data isolation exchange method and a device based on visible light communication.A visible light sender and a visible light receiver are respectively provided with a built-in communication rule in advance, so that a sending device and a receiving device can be ensured to know the relevant information of a service data message in advance for carrying out subsequent data synchronization and ensuring the correctness of data transmission; before sending a service data frame, a visible light sender sends an initial message to a visible light receiver through a visible light unidirectional transmission channel to judge and prepare for receiving data; after the visible light transmitter carries out data splitting and recombination processing on the service data frame to be transmitted according to the message control information, the service data frame is sequentially transmitted to the visible light receiver through the visible light unidirectional transmission channel; and when the accumulated data length of the sent service data frame reaches the data length in the message control information, sending the ending message in the synchronous communication rule to a visible light receiver through a visible light one-way transmission channel.

title_en: Virtual frame pre-processing for optical scanning
abstract_en: The invention relates to virtual frame pre-processing for optical scanning. An optical scanner captures a plurality of images from a plurality of image capture devices. In response to the activation signal, an evaluation phase is performed, and in response to the evaluation phase, an acquisition phase is performed. In an evaluation phase, a first set of images is captured and processed to generate a virtual frame comprising a plurality of regions, wherein each region contains a reduced data image frame based on a corresponding one of the plurality of images. Further in the evaluation phase, the attributes of each of the plurality of regions of the virtual frame are evaluated according to a first predefined criterion, and the operating parameters for the acquisition phase are set based on the result of the evaluation. In the acquisition phase, a second set of at least one image is captured via at least one of the plurality of image capture devices according to the set of operating parameters.

title_en: Method and system for testing antenna array
abstract_en: The invention provides a test method and a test system of an antenna array, comprising the following steps: step S1: the antenna array rotates a set value from the initial angle; step S2: the signal generator outputs a first electric signal with a set power value to the antenna array, and the antenna array converts the first electric signal into an electromagnetic signal to be transmitted; step S3: the receiving antenna receives the electromagnetic signal and converts the electromagnetic signal into a second electric signal to the spectrum analyzer, and the spectrum analyzer acquires the power value of the second electric signal; step S4: and judging whether the power value of the second electric signal is within the power threshold range of the spectrum analyzer, if so, saving the power value of the second electric signal and returning to the step S1, otherwise, adjusting the set power value and returning to the step S2. The invention realizes the multi-angle high dynamic range test of the antenna array.

title_en: Electronic equipment assembly and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electronic equipment assembly and terminal equipment, wherein the electronic equipment assembly comprises the terminal equipment and an earphone; the terminal equipment comprises a processor, a frequency modulation module, a first communication interface and a first switch; the processor is connected with the output end of the frequency modulation module and is also connected with the control end of the first switch; the input end of the frequency modulation module is connected with the grounding end of the first communication interface through the first switch; the first switch is switchable in a plurality of states; the earphone comprises a second communication interface, the second communication interface is matched with the first communication interface, and the second communication interface is detachably connected with the first communication interface.

title_en: Intelligent bathroom heater control system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent bathroom heater control system and method, which comprises an intelligent control module arranged on the intelligent bathroom heater, wherein the intelligent control module realizes intelligent control of other electrical appliances in a bathroom by adopting a remote control code matching mode, so that the intelligent bathroom heater becomes a control center, and voice control of other electrical appliances in the bathroom can be realized even in an off-line state. And the music can be loaded and unloaded in an off-line state by leading in the song list of the external music player or leading out the self-built song library in a state of wireless network connection, so that the music can be played in the off-line state, the experience of a user is improved, and the application range is wider.

title_en: Adaptive beam width modulation algorithm for inhibiting beam drift effect in millimeter wave communication system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive beam width modulation algorithm for inhibiting a beam drift effect in a millimeter wave communication system. The algorithm models the adaptive beam width modulation problem as a context-based online optimization selection problem, wherein each option corresponds to a different beam width, and the width of the data transmission beam is adjusted and updated according to the perceived environmental change rate. At the beginning of each time unit, a communication environment context is constructed, required nonlinear characteristics are obtained through a neural network, and then the optimal width of a data transmission beam is determined through a Bayes linear decision model. The adaptive beam width modulation algorithm designed by the invention can effectively sense the rate of environmental change, adaptively adjust the width of the data transmission beam, ensure that higher communication link quality can be obtained in the whole communication process, and effectively improve the throughput of a millimeter wave communication system.

title_en: Foldable electronic device
abstract_en: The application discloses collapsible electronic equipment includes: the display screen is provided with a light-transmitting area; the camera module comprises a light taking lens; the screw rod is respectively connected with the camera module and the motor; when the motor rotates, the camera module is driven to move by the screw rod; when the display screen is in an unfolded state, the camera module is located at a first position relative to the bolt lead screw; when the display screen is in a folded state, the camera module is located at a second position relative to the bolt lead screw; when the camera module is located at the first position and the second position, the light taking lens is opposite to the light transmission area.

title_en: Call processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for call processing, relates to the fields of artificial intelligence, communication technology and the like, and can be applied to voice interaction equipment. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: analyzing the call instruction to obtain at least one call object; for each calling object, inquiring by utilizing a pre-constructed address book to obtain an inquiry result; the query result comprises one of single matching, multiple matching and no matching; and utilizing the query result to perform call processing. Different matching results of the address book and the calling object can be processed in a targeted manner, so that the aim of improving the identification result of the calling object is fulfilled. The effect of enriching the applicable scenes of the voice interaction equipment is achieved.

title_en: Mobile phone rear cover with transparent antenna and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile phone rear cover capable of placing a transparent antenna and a preparation method thereof, wherein the mobile phone rear cover comprises a glass layer and an antenna layer which are connected through a bonding adhesive layer, the antenna layer comprises a hardening layer, a UV adhesive layer and a transparent antenna which are sequentially stacked, the transparent antenna is formed on the side surface of the UV adhesive layer connected with the glass layer, through holes are formed in the feeding positions of the glass layer and the bonding adhesive layer, which correspond to the transparent antenna, and conductive adhesive is filled in the through holes to connect the transparent antenna and a radio frequency transmission line arranged on the outer surface of the glass layer. The invention realizes the transparentization of the antenna positioned on the rear cover of the mobile phone glass, and can greatly improve the design space of the antenna; through printing out netted net slot earlier, laminating has bond glue film, the glass layer of through-hole again, realizes taking lid preparation behind the cell-phone of transparent antenna, and transparent antenna's placing in the lid behind the realization cell-phone that can be better provides the guarantee for the signal of cell-phone.

title_en: Hole-free receiver device and mobile terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nonporous receiver device and a mobile terminal, comprising: the earphone body is arranged on the shell of the mobile terminal; the sound guide channel is arranged on the earphone body and extends away from the shell direction; the piezoelectric crystal and the earphone body are respectively positioned at two ends of the sound guide channel, and the piezoelectric crystal covers the sound guide channel; the piezoelectric crystal is electrically connected with the earphone body and is driven by the electrode of the earphone body to deform to open or close the sound guide channel. The problem of listen a section of thick bamboo and can't satisfy no hole outward appearance and high-quality audio simultaneously among the prior art is solved.

title_en: Miniature bus gateway suitable for intelligent meter reading system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mini bus gateway suitable for an intelligent meter reading system, which comprises a CPU main controller, a remote communication module, more than one communication control switch capable of selecting communication ports, more than one power switch and a power manager, wherein the power switch is connected with the power manager; the communication control switch is an electronic switch address selector with one input and four outputs; the power end of the CPU master controller is connected with the power supply manager, the power control end of the CPU master controller is respectively and electrically connected with a power switch, a general programmable input/output (GPIO) of the CPU master controller is connected with the input end of the communication control switch, each output end of the communication control switch is connected with an intelligent water meter, the output of the communication control switch is connected with more than one intelligent water meter to form a group of meter reading units, each group of meter reading units is connected with the power supply manager through one power switch, and the intelligent water meters on the same group of meter reading units are connected with the same power switch. This structure practices thrift equipment cost.

title_en: Electronic equipment and wearable equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to an electronic device and a wearable device. The middle frame is provided with a mounting cavity, the middle frame is provided with a matching surface, the middle frame comprises an antenna exposed on the matching surface, and the cover plate is overlapped on the matching surface and covers the antenna and the mounting cavity. The circuit board is arranged in the mounting cavity and electrically connected with the antenna. Above-mentioned electronic equipment, the fitting surface of antenna exposure center, apron superpose in the fitting surface and cover antenna and installation cavity, compare in the antenna of flexible circuit board form, but above-mentioned antenna set up the whole thickness of attenuate electronic equipment, and can improve the anti-interference and the anti-shielding performance of antenna to promote electronic equipment's communication performance.

title_en: Method for synchronizing networks
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for synchronizing networks, wherein a first, in particular real-time-capable, wired communication system having a first time base is set up in a first network, wherein a second, in particular real-time-capable, wired communication system having a second time base is set up in a second network, wherein the first network is connected to a wireless communication system, in particular real-time-capable, via a first switching unit, and wherein the second network is connected to the wireless communication system via a second switching unit, wherein the first switching unit and the second switching unit are synchronized with one another according to a third time base of the wireless communication system, which is independent of the first time base and the second time base, wherein a third synchronization message is transmitted from the first switching unit to the second switching unit, and the transmission time of the third synchronization message from the first switching unit to the second switching unit is determined in the third time base, and taking into account said transmission time when synchronizing the second time base with the first time base.

title_en: Double-frequency double-fed high-gain filtering antenna and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-frequency double-fed high-gain filter antenna and electronic equipment, which comprise a PCB (printed Circuit Board), two low-frequency units, three high-frequency units, a first coaxial line, a second coaxial line, a third coaxial line and a CPW (compact peripheral component interconnect) transmission line, wherein the PCB is provided with a first low-frequency unit and a second high-frequency unit; the PCB board comprises a first surface and a second surface which are opposite, and the CPW transmission line comprises a CPW signal line and a CPW ground line; the two low-frequency units are arranged on the first surface of the PCB, and the three high-frequency units are arranged on the second surface of the PCB; the second coaxial line is connected with the first low-frequency unit, and the first low-frequency unit is connected with the second low-frequency unit through a third coaxial line; the first coaxial line is connected with the first high-frequency unit, and the first high-frequency unit, the second high-frequency unit and the third high-frequency unit are sequentially connected through a CPW transmission line; the CPW ground line is provided with a first break at one side of the second high frequency unit. The invention can improve the gain of the antenna.

title_en: Four-channel multifunctional chip
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of microwave monolithic integrated circuits, and provides a four-channel multifunctional chip, which comprises: the circuit comprises an input end of a multifunctional chip, four output ends of the multifunctional chip, a power supply end of the multifunctional chip, a grounding end of the multifunctional chip, an amplifier, a grid end power supply end, a drain end power supply end, a one-to-four power divider, four phase shifters, three serial-parallel drivers, a data latch end, a data input end, a clock end and a chip selection end, wherein the input end of the multifunctional chip is connected with the four output ends of the multifunctional chip; at least one of the first phase shifter, the second phase shifter, the third phase shifter and the fourth phase shifter includes a phase shift functional module including at least an attenuation circuit. The phase shifter is provided with the attenuation circuit to attenuate the output signal, so that the voltage standing wave ratio of the output port connected with the phase shifter is effectively improved, and the performance of the four-channel multifunctional chip is improved.

title_en: Management and control system and method for managing mobile terminal based on family and school together
abstract_en: The invention discloses a management and control system and a management and control method for managing mobile terminals together based on families and schools, and the management and control system comprises a campus management terminal, a first mobile terminal and a second mobile terminal, wherein the campus management terminal is linked with the first mobile terminal, the first mobile terminal and the second mobile terminal are linked with each other through an MDM configuration program and are used for monitoring and storing user identification information acquired when a student user enters a management and control area and activating terminal identification information of the first mobile terminal corresponding to the student user, the second mobile terminal carries out comparison and identification on the user identification information and original identity data of the user, acquires position information of the first mobile terminal according to a comparison and identification result and a judgment result, generates a management and control instruction for managing and controlling the first mobile terminal according to the position information, and issues a corresponding management and control mode. The invention can ensure that the child uses the mobile terminal under the control of parents or teachers, thereby achieving the purpose of managing the child to use the mobile terminal together.

title_en: Communication method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a communication method and device, which are used for realizing radio frequency link sharing, improving the utilization rate of a radio frequency link and increasing the uplink transmission rate. The method comprises the following steps: the terminal receives first configuration information and second configuration information from a first network device, wherein the first configuration information is used for indicating a first reference signal resource of a first antenna port, and the second configuration information is used for indicating a second reference signal resource of a second antenna port; or, the first configuration information is used to indicate a third reference signal resource of a first number of antenna ports, and the second configuration information is used to indicate a fourth reference signal resource of a second number of antenna ports; and the terminal sends a first reference signal according to the first configuration information and sends a second reference signal according to the second configuration information.

title_en: Method and system for realizing quick opening of cloud mobile phone application
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for realizing quick opening of cloud mobile phone application, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that a user local mobile phone and a cloud mobile phone establish a quick starting mode of cloud application in the user local mobile phone; and starting the cloud application in a quick starting mode on a local mobile phone of the user. According to the method, the method for rapidly starting the application in the cloud mobile phone can be realized, the complexity that the user can only open the cloud mobile phone application after multiple operations is avoided, the opening effect similar to local application can be realized, the convenience for the user to use the cloud application is improved, a larger amount of cloud mobile phone service is attracted to people, and the development and prosperity of the cloud mobile phone service market are promoted.

title_en: Antenna system and method of operating an antenna system
abstract_en: An antenna system for a mobile communications base station and a method of operating a communications network including a base station are described. The antenna system includes an antenna array for beamforming and is configured as a radar sensor, a communications antenna, or a combined radar sensor. The radar image may be used to determine a map of objects in the vicinity of the antenna system and to adjust beam steering or beamforming of the antenna system.

title_en: Electronic device
abstract_en: The application discloses electronic equipment includes: the substrate layer is provided with a first region and is a light-transmitting material piece; the liquid lens is arranged in the first area; the liquid crystal layer is arranged on one side of the base material layer; the backlight module is arranged on the other side of the substrate layer; the light emitted by the backlight module can be transmitted to a screen of the electronic equipment through the liquid crystal layer; the light transmitted to the liquid crystal layer through the screen of the electronic device can enter the liquid lens for imaging. In electronic equipment, liquid camera lens are established in first region, through liquid camera lens deformation for liquid camera lens can focus fast, can reduce the thickness of long burnt macro function module by a wide margin, need not be to the screen trompil, can realize real comprehensive screen and make a video recording, improve the shooting effect.

title_en: Radar module with microwave chip
abstract_en: A radar module configured for factory monitoring includes a microwave chip having a radar signal source, a coupling element, and a resonant chamber, wherein the coupling element protrudes into the resonant chamber.

title_en: Wearable device
abstract_en: The application discloses wearing equipment includes: a loop active antenna and a loop passive antenna, wherein: the annular active antenna and the annular passive antenna are arranged in the thickness direction of the wearable device at intervals, a connecting line of the circle center of the annular active antenna and the circle center of the annular passive antenna is perpendicular to the plane where the annular active antenna is located and the plane where the annular passive antenna is located, a first distance is arranged between the annular active antenna and the annular passive antenna, and the radius of the annular passive antenna is larger than that of the annular active antenna.

title_en: Electronic shelf label
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electronic shelf label, which comprises an electronic paper display and a control circuit board, wherein the electronic paper display is electrically connected with the control circuit board, a transparent antenna layer is arranged in the electronic paper display, and a feed-in point of the transparent antenna layer is electrically connected to the control circuit board, so that the position of the transparent antenna layer is closer to the outside, the signal receiving capability of the transparent antenna layer is facilitated, and the occupation of the layout space of the control circuit board is also avoided.

title_en: Monitoring communication method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring communication method based on a monitoring communication system, which comprises a background control terminal, a field monitoring terminal, a static communication terminal and a dynamic communication terminal; the monitoring communication method comprises the following steps: the background control terminal is communicated with the field monitoring terminal through optical cable connection, and the background control terminal judges the field state according to the field monitoring data sent by the field monitoring terminal; when the background control terminal judges an abnormal state, the background control terminal performs primary communication to the site through a static communication terminal; when primary communication is carried out, the background control terminal judges a communication receiving state through a field monitoring terminal; when the background control terminal judges that the state is not received, the background control terminal performs secondary communication to the site through the dynamic communication terminal. The invention adopts a dynamic communication mode to notify the content to be communicated, and solves the problem of poor long-distance communication in the prior art.

title_en: Heat dissipation formula communication base station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat dissipation type communication base station which comprises a base, wherein a case is arranged on the upper portion of the base, a supporting plate and a partition plate are arranged inside the case, the partition plate is located below the supporting plate, a top plate is arranged on the top of the case, a lifting ring is arranged above the partition plate, a lifting motor is arranged on the upper portion of the partition plate, a center block is connected to the top of a motor shaft of the lifting motor, a connecting beam is connected to the periphery of the center block, the other end of the connecting beam is connected with the inner side of the lifting ring, a circle of guide groove is formed in the lifting ring, two mounting arms are connected to the lower portion of the supporting plate, a first mounting block and a second mounting block are arranged between the two mounting arms, the first mounting block is located above the second mounting block, a first rotating sleeve and a second rotating sleeve are respectively rotatably arranged on the upper portions of the first mounting block and the second mounting block, and a first rotating arm is connected to the left side of the first rotating sleeve.

title_en: Electronic device including actuator configured to output sound and method of operating the same
abstract_en: An electronic device is provided. The electronic device includes: a display; an actuator configured to output at least one of sound and vibration by using the display; and a processor configured to: identifying whether the display is enabled; identifying a temperature of the electronic device if the display is enabled; and controlling the actuator to generate at least one of sound and vibration at a specified frequency if the temperature is below a specified temperature.

title_en: Face image acquisition method, face image recognition method, flexible screen terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a face image acquisition method, a face image recognition method, a flexible screen terminal and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of image processing. The method comprises the step of controlling the shooting device of the flexible screen terminal to move relative to the face of a user according to deformation of the flexible screen so as to acquire face images of the user. Therefore, the technical scheme realizes that the accuracy and the safety of face image acquisition are improved by combining the deformation characteristics of the flexible screen.

title_en: Luminous cell-phone backplate production line equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a noctilucent mobile phone backboard production line device which comprises a clamp assembling machine, a clamp conveyer, a clamp pick-and-place machine, a Logo printer, a plane transfer machine, a vacuum coating machine, an ink printer, a vacuum high-pressure machine, a clamp dismounting machine, a clamp recycling machine and a cover plate strengthening device, wherein a clamp is arranged in the clamp assembling machine, a board is loaded into the clamp by the clamp assembling machine, the clamp conveyer conveying clamp sequentially passes through the Logo printer, the plane transfer machine, the vacuum coating machine and the ink printer to form a backboard semi-finished product, the backboard semi-finished product is separated from the clamp by the clamp dismounting machine, and the clamp is transported back into the clamp assembling machine by the clamp recycling machine. The noctilucent mobile phone backboard production line equipment can realize full-automatic production of mobile phone backboards, can improve production efficiency, can emit noctilucence when dark or dark through the mobile phone backboard produced by the noctilucent mobile phone backboard production line equipment, and enables the mobile phone backboard to have a gradient color layer through a process of realizing gradient color through dip-dyeing.

title_en: Folding assembly and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses folding assembly and electronic equipment, wherein, folding assembly includes: the first folding body and the second folding body are rotatably connected; the first magnet is fixedly arranged on the first folding main body; the second magnet is rotatably arranged on the second folding main body; the driving structure is arranged on the second folding main body and is in transmission connection with the second magnet, and the driving structure is used for adjusting the posture of the second magnet in the second folding main body so as to adjust the magnetic force between the second magnet and the first magnet; when the second magnet is switched from the first posture to the second posture, the first folding body and the second folding body can be unfolded relatively. Among the technical scheme of this application, through setting up first magnet and second magnet to the adjustable magnetic force between the two of the gesture of adjustment second magnet improves the fastening degree when folding the laminating of two center on the one hand, also is convenient for simultaneously when will launching, reduces the dynamics demand of opening, and then reduces the operation degree of difficulty of opening.

title_en: Communication module of MR glasses under complicated electromagnetic environment
abstract_en: The application relates to a communication module of MR glasses under a complex electromagnetic environment, and the system comprises a signal conversion circuit, a wireless transmission circuit and a power supply driving circuit which are connected in sequence. The signal conversion circuit carries out charging and discharging and monitoring on the circuit through the processing of voltage stabilization and voltage division of signals, and converts video signals of VGA standard into CVBS standard; the wireless transmitting circuit converts the signal into the original electric signal by the analog information source, then carries out the reverse conversion in the channel, the baseband signal is converted into the signal suitable for being transmitted in the channel by the modulator at the transmitting end, and then carries out the reverse conversion by the demodulator at the receiving end. The scheme ensures the quick response capability and the steady-state performance of the MR glasses communication module circuit, meets the design requirements of intelligence, small size, high transmission rate, high performance and strong anti-interference capability, and has very important significance for improving the economic benefit and the working efficiency of production enterprises.

title_en: Optical distribution device, optical communication detection system and optical communication detection method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an optical distribution device, an optical communication detection system and an optical communication detection method. The embodiment of the application provides a light distribution device, which comprises: the optical device comprises an input port, M output ports and N first light reflectors, wherein M is larger than or equal to N, and M and N are positive integers, and the input port is respectively connected with the M output ports through M optical fibers; one of the N first light reflectors is connected to one of the M output ports in a pluggable manner, wherein each of the N first light reflectors is configured to reflect a test light signal entering the corresponding output port.

title_en: Signal generation method, device and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a signal generation method, a signal generation device and a signal generation system. The method comprises the following steps: performing cyclic electro-optical modulation on the first signal to generate a first optical frequency comb signal; the first signal is a signal output by a laser source; the first optical-frequency comb signal comprises a target spectral component having a frequency equal to the sum or difference of the frequency of the first signal and the frequency of the target signal; performing first filtering processing on the first optical frequency comb signal to generate the target frequency spectrum component; and generating the target signal according to the heterodyne beat frequency of the first signal and the target frequency spectrum component. According to the method, the first signal is subjected to cyclic electro-optic modulation, so that a first optical frequency comb signal comprising a target frequency spectrum component with higher power can be obtained, the target frequency spectrum component with higher power can be further filtered out, and a terahertz wave signal with higher frequency can be obtained after heterodyne beat frequency is carried out according to the target frequency spectrum component and the first signal.

title_en: 5G radio frequency extension unit and communication method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power equipment, in particular to a 5G radio frequency extension unit and a communication method, aiming at the problem that a radio frequency unit system in the prior art does not disclose an operation method of specific corollary equipment, the following scheme is proposed, and the scheme comprises the following steps: firstly, the radio frequency equipment is installed at a required position in a proper mode, or is sucked on the top or tied on a column or fixed on a wall, and then a 48V power supply is inserted into a PWR power supply interface of the equipment, so that pRU is powered through the interface; the connection between pRU and EU is realized by 10G eCPRI network cable, thus realizing the interaction of IQ data and communication information between EU and RPU; and the lighting conditions of the two indicator lights RUN and link on the observation equipment are adjusted in time. The invention can judge the equipment condition in time according to different flashes or extensions of the indicator lamp, and carry out equipment management, performance management, fault management (fault removal online repair), version management and power management through the relevant operating system of the base station.

title_en: Automatic tracking satellite communication equipment and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of satellite communication, and discloses automatic tracking satellite communication equipment and a working method thereof. The invention solves the problems that the prior art can only receive or transmit radio frequency signals of a certain frequency band, has long development period and high cost, is difficult to inherit programs, can not adapt to development requirements, and has poor signal receiving stability, low environmental adaptability and low practicability.

title_en: Networking water quality monitoring system and water quality monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: A networking water quality monitoring system and a water quality monitoring method thereof relate to the technical field of water quality monitoring. The water quality monitoring system comprises a water quality monitoring group, a wireless information end, an information sending end, a receiving control end, a signal sending end and an information transfer end, wherein the wireless information end is arranged on the water quality monitoring group and is connected with the receiving control end through the information sending end, the receiving control end is connected with the signal sending end, the signal sending end is connected with the wireless information end through the information transfer end, and the water quality monitoring group comprises a monitoring probe group, a connecting line belt, a data transmission line, a control end block, a luminous indicating column and a wireless transfer end. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the networking water quality monitoring operation can be carried out by utilizing the Internet of things, so that the multi-group water quality monitoring operation can be carried out simultaneously, and a plurality of water quality monitoring projects can be carried out simultaneously, so that the accuracy and the real-time performance of the water quality monitoring are ensured, and the water quality monitoring operation is convenient for scientific research personnel to carry out.

title_en: Quantum key distribution system, encoder, decoder and method based on DPSK
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantum key distribution system, an encoder, a decoder and a method based on DPSK. The system comprises: the single photon source is used for generating single photon signals by taking time T as a period; the first end phase modulator is used for carrying out second-order phase modulation on the single photon signal by taking time 2T as a modulation period; the beam splitter is used for splitting the single photon phase modulation signal into two paths of signals; the second end phase modulator is used for modulating one path of signals output by the beam splitter by adopting a second basis; the time delay device is used for delaying the other path of signal output by the beam splitter by T; the beam combiner is used for carrying out beam combination coherence on output signals of the second end phase modulator and the delayer; and the two single-photon detectors are used for obtaining detection results. The invention can complete the quantum key distribution without distributing specific base selection information by delaying one period T, thereby ensuring the security and the code rate of the quantum key distribution.

title_en: Active multi-beam tile-type phased array receiving assembly
abstract_en: The invention discloses an active multi-beam tile-type phased array receiving assembly, which comprises an array antenna, a radio frequency receiving chip and a multilayer circuit board, wherein the radio frequency receiving chip is packaged by adopting double-sided BGA solder balls, the upper surface of the radio frequency receiving chip is connected with the array antenna, the lower surface of the radio frequency receiving chip is connected with the multilayer circuit board, the radio frequency receiving chip receives incoming signals received by the array antenna, and carries out filtering, amplification and amplitude and phase adjustment on the incoming signals, and transmits the processed signals to the multilayer circuit board; the multilayer circuit board comprises a signal transmission layer, a beam forming network and a power supply layer, wherein the signal transmission layer is used for receiving processed signals, the beam forming network is used for carrying out power synthesis on the signals received by the signal transmission layer to output signals with equal amplitude and same phase, and the power supply layer is used for wiring of a power supply part of a power supply and welding of a power supply chip; the invention improves the system sensitivity of the receiving assembly and reduces the thickness of the circuit board, the types of blind buried holes and the lamination times.

title_en: High-isolation single-pole double-throw switch circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-isolation single-pole double-throw switch circuit, which comprises a signal input end, a first signal output end, a first signal transmission line, a second signal output end and a second signal transmission line, wherein the two ends of the first signal transmission line are respectively connected with a third switch tube and a fifth switch tube which are grounded in parallel, and the two ends of the second signal transmission line are respectively connected with a fourth switch tube and a sixth switch tube which are grounded in parallel; a seventh switching tube is connected in series between the first signal transmission line and the first signal output end, the seventh switching tube is connected in parallel with the first matching resistor, an eighth switching tube is connected in series between the second signal transmission line and the second signal output end, and the eighth switching tube is connected in parallel with the second matching resistor; the circuit also includes a phase shift compensation path coupled to the first transmission line and the second transmission line. The invention improves the isolation of the existing switch structure by 10dB under the same process, the insertion loss only worsens by 0.15dB, and the standing waves of three ports all meet the conventional use requirements.

title_en: Method, communication device and storage medium for determining pilot power
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to methods, communications devices, and computer storage media for determining pilot power, and relate to the field of communications. According to the method, a plurality of sampling level values of a received current frame signal are obtained; determining a current power of the current frame signal based on the plurality of sample level values; determining a current traffic signal fraction of the current frame signal based on the plurality of sampling level values; if the current service signal occupation ratio is determined to be less than or equal to the preset occupation ratio, taking the current power as the current pilot power of the current frame signal; and if the current service signal occupation ratio is determined to be larger than the preset occupation ratio, determining the current pilot frequency power of the current frame signal based on the current power, the current power floating upper limit and the current power floating lower limit. Therefore, the pilot power can be accurately determined under the condition of different traffic signal ratios.

title_en: Remote control system based on serial port communication protocol
abstract_en: A remote control system based on a serial port communication protocol is characterized by comprising a network cable transmission industrial control signal circuit board, a network cable transfer function circuit board and a serial port signal level amplifier, wherein an output port of the network cable transmission industrial control signal circuit board is electrically connected with an input port of the serial port signal level amplifier, an output port of the serial port signal level amplifier is electrically connected with an input port of the network cable transfer function circuit board, and an original signal is amplified by the serial port signal level amplifier by 10 times of gain.

title_en: Healthy smart phone
abstract_en: The application provides a healthy smart phone, comprising: the shell comprises a first opening and a second opening which are arranged at intervals; the control module comprises at least one main board and is arranged inside the shell; the body fluid detection module comprises a test paper slot, the test paper slot is arranged in the first opening, and the test paper slot is used for placing and detecting test paper bearing body fluid to be detected; a temperature detection module comprising a temperature sensing probe, at least a portion of the temperature sensing probe being exposed by the second opening; and the electrocardio detection module is used for detecting electrocardio.

title_en: Feedback method of channel state information and communication device
abstract_en: The application discloses a feedback method of channel state information and a communication device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that network equipment sends first indication information to a terminal, the terminal receives the first information and feeds back CSI to the network equipment according to the first indication information; the first indication information is used for indicating the corresponding relation between an antenna port and a channel state information reference signal CSI-RS port. The method and the device are applicable to a communication system comprising the hybrid antenna array, and the network equipment can indicate the corresponding relation between the antenna ports and the CSI-RS ports for the terminal, so that the method and the device can be compatible with the determination rule of the current antenna port sequence, namely, various hybrid antenna arrays. Meanwhile, the network equipment can indicate the same or different antenna port sequences aiming at different mixed antenna arrays, and better system performance is ensured.

title_en: Cooperative communication and switching method and system in low-orbit broadband satellite system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of low-orbit satellite communication, and particularly discloses a cooperative communication and switching method and a system in a low-orbit broadband satellite system. The invention solves the problem that the distance between the cooperative satellite and the user is different, ensures that the user signal is not submerged in noise, shortens the transmission delay and ensures the seamless switching of the user in the process of the rapid movement of the satellite.

title_en: Heat dissipation module, control method, electronic equipment and manufacturing method
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a heat dissipation module, a control method, an electronic device and a manufacturing method, comprising the following steps: a vibrating reed comprising: a magnetic material; one end of the fluctuation film is connected with the vibration piece in a connecting way; the driving module is provided with an electromagnet, the electromagnet is arranged opposite to the vibrating piece, and the control circuit is connected with the driving module and is used for transmitting control signals of powering on and powering off the electromagnet to the driving module; the electromagnet generates a magnetic field for driving the vibration piece to vibrate when the electromagnet is electrified and powered off; wherein the wave film vibrates with the vibration of the vibrating piece. The vibration plate is driven to vibrate by utilizing the magnetic field change generated by the electromagnet when the power is on and off as a power source, so that the vibration plate drives the fluctuation film to vibrate, and the vibration of the fluctuation film generates air convection to play a role in heat dissipation. The convection type heat dissipation mode can timely transfer heat and improve heat dissipation effect.

title_en: Device and method for detecting power of radiation unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for detecting power of a radiation unit, which relate to the technical field of electronics and comprise a plurality of directional couplers, a microwave switch, a wave detector, an amplitude measurement processor, a system computer and a terminal display device. The invention can improve the testing efficiency, increase the reliability of the detection result and enable the user to master the working state of the radiation channel through terminal display.

title_en: Coaxial double-slot antenna capable of realizing vertical polarization by horizontal erection and feeding method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a coaxial dual-slit antenna which is erected horizontally to realize vertical polarization and a feeding method thereof. The coaxial line outer conductor (2) is provided with a gap (1) formed in the coaxial line outer conductor, the length of the gap (1) formed in the coaxial line outer conductor is one half wavelength, and the coaxial line inner conductor (3) is connected with the terminal short-circuit sheet (5) and the coaxial line outer conductor (2) through the short-circuit line (4). The invention is used for solving the problems of high section of the traditional vertical oscillator type antenna system of the medium-long wave antenna and the short wave antenna and low radiation efficiency of the horizontally erected antenna. The antenna can realize the radiation and the reception of the vertical polarized electromagnetic wave with ultra-low profile and high radiation efficiency under the condition of horizontal erection. Meanwhile, the coaxial cable can also be used for solving the problem that radiation cannot be realized by opening a longitudinal gap on the outer skin of the coaxial cable according to the transmission line theory.

title_en: Expandable antenna for meteorological satellite DCP communication
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of antennas, in particular to an expandable antenna for communication of a meteorological satellite DCP, which comprises an expandable antenna body, wherein the expandable antenna body comprises a reflecting plate, the reflecting plate comprises a first metal plate, the first metal plate is square in shape, and four second metal plates are hinged to the peripheral end edges of the first metal plate; a vertical upper sleeve is welded at the center of the surface of the first metal plate, a horizontal through hole I penetrating through the sleeve body is formed in the upper part of the vertical upper sleeve, and a horizontal rod is inserted into the horizontal through hole I; the outer end of the horizontal rod is provided with a groove hole; the spiral matrix material is made of the metal memory material, three telescopic high-strength composite materials are used for controlling the telescopic operation of the spiral matrix, the spiral matrix material has the advantages of convenience in use, small space volume after compression, convenience in storage and transportation, great convenience in use and improvement in use efficiency.

title_en: Method and system for synchronizing signals of communication system
abstract_en: The invention provides a signal synchronization method and a system of a communication system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: multiplying a target receiving signal by a local oscillator signal, and inputting the multiplied signal into an intermediate frequency filter; inputting the signal after passing through the intermediate frequency filter into a parallel capture module to obtain a target matching signal; synchronizing the target matching signal according to the position of the correlation peak; wherein the target received signal is determined from a received signal after transmitting a hopped spread spectrum signal through the communication system. The system performs the method. The invention realizes synchronous receiving of the fast hopping spread spectrum signal based on the self characteristics of the fast hopping spread spectrum signal, thereby ensuring signal transmission with high confidentiality and strong anti-interference performance.

title_en: System and method for communication beam recovery
abstract_en: A method for operating an access node comprising: generating a configuration message comprising information specifying a first reference signal type and a second reference signal type for identifying a new beam, and information specifying random access channel resources allocated for transmitting preamble sequences, wherein each random access channel resource is associated with a reference signal of the first reference signal type, transmitting the configuration message to one or more User Equipments (UEs), receiving a preamble sequence on one of the random access channel resources from a UE, and determining an identity of the UE from the preamble sequence and the one of the random access channel resources.

title_en: Method for monitoring rainfall intensity and runoff accumulated water on underlying surface based on amplitude sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for monitoring rainfall intensity and runoff accumulated water of an underlying surface layer based on an amplitude sensor, wherein the system comprises: the data collection layer comprises a plurality of optical fiber pressure sensors, and a vibration sheet is arranged below each optical fiber pressure sensor; the plurality of optical fiber pressure sensors adopt checkerboard type distribution points; a data transport layer; the central control processing layer is used for demodulating the rainwater data to obtain a central wavelength signal of the optical fiber pressure sensor within a period of time under a certain rainfall intensity, expressing the central wavelength signal through a signal frequency chart, judging the current real-time rainfall intensity according to the central wavelength rainfall frequency in the signal frequency chart, and obtaining a rainfall intensity-frequency corresponding image; a composite display layer; and the early warning response layer is used for sending out an early warning instruction according to the demodulation and processing result of the central control processing layer. The method can accurately judge whether the soil layer and the permeable pavement hard layer in the underlying surface generate runoff and real-time rainfall intensity, and perform early warning.

title_en: Ultra-wideband phase-shifting circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-wideband phase-shifting circuit which comprises a first single-pole double-throw switch circuit, a second single-pole double-throw switch circuit, a full-pass filter circuit and a band-pass filter circuit. According to the invention, broadband phase shifting is realized by switching the single-pole double-throw switch between the all-pass filter circuit and the band-pass filter circuit, a phase shifting path realizes a required broadband lagging phase based on a magnetic coupling all-pass network structure, the order of a reference state high-pass element is reasonably selected by utilizing the phase advance characteristic of the high-pass element according to the phase shifting amount to be realized, and a wider phase-frequency characteristic bandwidth can be realized; series resonance and parallel resonance in the band-pass network improve the inherent phase nonlinear characteristics of the high-pass element at a low frequency end and a high frequency end, and further widen the phase bandwidth; the single-pole double-throw switch circuit and the phase-shifting network are designed in a matching mode, so that smaller insertion loss and area can be realized. The phase-shifting circuit has the characteristics of wide working bandwidth, small insertion loss, compact circuit structure and stable performance.

title_en: Information processing apparatus, storage medium, and information processing method
abstract_en: The invention provides an information processing apparatus, a storage medium, and an information processing method, which can execute a processing request after determining a relevant user related to the processing request when the processing request is received from a processing request transmitting apparatus. An information processing apparatus is provided with a processor that receives a device ID and a processing request that identify the processing request transmitting device from the processing request transmitting device, and executes processing related to the processing request after determining a relevant user related to the processing request based on the device ID.

title_en: Electromagnetic driving device and self-reset microwave switch
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of microwave switches, and discloses an electromagnetic driving device and a self-resetting microwave switch, wherein the electromagnetic driving device comprises a coil rack, a coil, a spring, an upper static iron core, a lower movable iron core, a sliding rod and a bracket; in addition, the corresponding microwave switch channel is still in a conducting state when the electromagnetic driving device is not connected to be excited through the elasticity of the spring, so that the energy consumption is reduced.

title_en: Millimeter wave circularly polarized omnidirectional antenna
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave circularly polarized omnidirectional antenna which comprises an antenna main body, an installation bottom plate and a connector, wherein a radiation cavity is arranged in the antenna main body, a plurality of radiation gaps communicated with the radiation cavity are arranged on the circumferential side surface of the antenna main body, the first end of the antenna main body is fixedly connected with the first side surface of the installation bottom plate, the connector is connected with the installation bottom plate, and the antenna end of the connector is arranged in the radiation cavity; according to the invention, the antenna main body is designed, the plurality of radiation gaps are arranged on the antenna main body, the antenna is fed through the connector, and the antenna radiates outwards in an omnidirectional manner through the radiation cavity, so that circularly polarized waves are realized, and the coverage of plus and minus 20-degree airspace in pitching is met.

title_en: Optical fiber transceiver, pulse signal transceiving system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an optical fiber transceiver, a pulse signal transceiving system and a pulse signal transceiving method, wherein the optical fiber transceiver comprises: an optical transmitter and an optical receiver; the optical transmitter is connected with the transmitting terminal equipment; the optical transmitter is connected with the optical receiver through an optical fiber circuit; the optical transmitter is used for carrying out dark pulse modulation on the pulse time-frequency electrical signal sent by the sending terminal equipment and carrying out electro-optical conversion on the modulated pulse time-frequency electrical signal to obtain a pulse time-frequency optical signal; the optical receiver is connected with the receiving terminal equipment; the optical receiver performs photoelectric conversion on the pulse time-frequency optical signal transmitted by the optical fiber line to obtain a transmitted pulse time-frequency electrical signal, and transmits the transmitted pulse time-frequency electrical signal to the receiving terminal equipment. The optical transmitter of the invention carries out 'dark pulse' modulation on the time-frequency electric signal sent by the sending terminal equipment, and has the advantages of optical fiber line attenuation change resistance, stable transmission time delay and low cost.

title_en: Big data security management system based on cross-border electronic commerce
abstract_en: The invention discloses a big data security management system based on cross-border electronic commerce, which comprises intrusion signal feature extraction, a design classification model, network transmission signal intrusion link situation perception, experimental results and analysis, wherein the intrusion signal feature extraction is used for carrying out framing processing on optical fiber signals on the basis of the mutual correlation characteristics, non-intrusion signals and intrusion signals existing in an optical fiber network are distinguished by selecting short-time zero-crossing-rate time domain features and short-time energy, the interference of the non-intrusion signals on identification results is eliminated, the features of the intrusion signals are extracted from three aspects of wavelet domain, frequency domain and time domain, and the feature set of the optical fiber network intrusion link signals is constructed.
