After the system defends the optical fiber network invading link by different methods, the network security is different, and the situation awareness security defense method of the invading link based on the data element characteristic network transmission signal is provided, thereby laying a foundation for the safe and stable development of the optical fiber network.

title_en: Methods and apparatus for wireless communication using pre-configured uplink resources
abstract_en: A method for wireless communication at a user equipment, UE, includes receiving an uplink control channel configuration including a repetition level indicator and a resource indicator for transmitting uplink control channel transmissions while in an idle mode, transitioning from a connected mode to an idle mode, determining a number of repetitions and a set of resources for transmitting uplink control channel transmissions in the idle mode based at least in part on the uplink control channel configuration, and transmitting uplink control channel transmissions according to the number of repetitions and the set of resources while in the idle mode.

title_en: Signal level indicator and antenna assembly including the same
abstract_en: Exemplary embodiments of a signal level indicator and an antenna assembly including the same are disclosed. In an exemplary embodiment, the antenna assembly includes an antenna configured to be operable for receiving a signal, a signal level indicator for indicating the strength of the signal received by the antenna, and an amplifier coupled for communication with the antenna, the signal level indicator, and the signal output. The amplifier is configured to be operable to amplify signals received by the antenna.

title_en: Multi-frequency system gain self-adaption method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a multi-frequency system gain adaptive method, apparatus, electronic device and storage medium, wherein the method applied to a remote unit comprises: receiving a combined communication signal sent by an extension unit, extracting a first synchronous signal from the combined communication signal, adjusting an attenuation value of a first public attenuation module based on the first synchronous signal, extracting a second synchronous signal from the combined communication signal, checking whether the attenuation value of the first public attenuation module meets a preset condition based on the second synchronous signal, and adjusting the attenuation value of the second public attenuation module based on the second synchronous signal under the condition that the attenuation value of the first public attenuation module meets the preset condition. Therefore, the existing synchronous signals are used for gain adjustment operation, the system response time is greatly shortened, the link gain adjustment is automatically and quickly completed, and the system link stability is improved.

title_en: Radio frequency system and customer premises equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to a radio frequency system and customer premises equipment, the radio frequency system includes: n antennas, the radiation faces of the N antennas facing at least three different directions; the radio frequency circuit is respectively connected with the N antennas and is configured to control a target antenna group to receive and transmit radio frequency signals, the target antenna group comprises M antennas in the N antennas, M is more than or equal to 2 and less than N, and N is more than or equal to 4; a processor coupled to the radio frequency circuit, the processor configured to: determining N antennas from N antennas to form a first alternative antenna group, wherein the radiation faces of the N antennas in the first alternative antenna group are different from each other, and N is more than or equal to 3 and less than N; determining one antenna in the first alternative antenna group as a first target antenna; and determining M-1 antennas adjacent to the first target antenna as a second target antenna, wherein the target antenna group comprises the first target antenna and the M-1 antennas.

title_en: Analog photonic link
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optical fiber communication, and provides an analog photon link, which comprises: a transmitting unit and a receiving unit; the transmitting unit comprises a continuous wave laser and a direct modulation laser; the direct modulation laser comprises an optical signal input end, an optical signal output end and an electrical signal input end; the optical signal input end is connected with the output end of the continuous wave laser; the optical signal output end is connected with the input end of the receiving unit; the electric signal input end is used for receiving a microwave modulation signal; the continuous wave laser is used for generating injection light; the direct modulation laser is used for modulating an optical carrier based on a microwave modulation signal in an injection locking state to generate an optical carrier analog signal; and the receiving unit is used for carrying out photoelectric conversion on the optical carrier analog signal to generate an electric signal. The analog photon link provided by the invention improves the modulation bandwidth of the direct modulation laser, inhibits the frequency chirp caused by the fluctuation of the load current under the intensity modulation, and reduces the cost of the analog photon link.

title_en: Aircraft target carrier recovery system suitable for complex environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aircraft target carrier recovery system suitable for a complex environment, which comprises a beacon device, a radio frequency antenna, a satellite and a ground receiving terminal, wherein the satellite comprises a GPS satellite and a BD satellite for navigation and a BD second-generation satellite for communication, the beacon device is bound with the target carrier and comprises a controller, a GPS/BD receiver and an RDSS short message communication module, the GPS/BD receiver receives radio frequency signals broadcast by the GPS satellite and the BD satellite and generates position signals according to the radio frequency signals in a resolving mode to be transmitted to the controller, the controller receives the resolved position information and controls the RDSS short message communication module to send the position information to the BD second-generation satellite in a short message mode according to preset time, and the BD second-generation satellite is used as an information forwarding base station to send the position information to the ground receiving terminal. The invention can provide accurate target position information, and the ground receiving terminal can obtain the information at any position, thereby breaking through the limitation of the relative distance between a target carrier and a searcher, improving the recovery efficiency and reducing the recovery difficulty.

title_en: Cluster communication method and device of low-earth-orbit constellation satellite communication system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cluster communication method of a low-orbit constellation satellite communication system, which comprises the following steps of setting a low-orbit cluster communication frame structure: aiming at the cluster communication service of the low-earth constellation satellite communication system, adding channel associated signaling on a service channel or an uplink shared channel, controlling a communication link and realizing the synchronization between a satellite terminal and a satellite; and (3) switching the low-rail cluster communication: the satellite terminal is switched in a base station under the same gateway station or among base stations under the same gateway station; in the switching process, the cluster controller selects the matched frequency resources from the global aspect to distribute, and the resource distribution and the switching negotiation between the cluster controller and the base station are realized. The invention adds a frame structure meeting the requirement of quick synchronization on a service channel, controls a link and realizes quick synchronization; and a communication flow between the cluster controller and the base station is also designed, and the functions of resource allocation, switching negotiation and the like between the cluster controller and the base station during cluster service are realized.

title_en: Method for timing acquisition terminal of low-voltage transformer area by using mobile 5G base station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for timing a low-voltage station area acquisition terminal by utilizing a mobile 5G base station, which comprises the following steps: step 1: taking a clock of the mobile 5G base station as a clock reference of the whole low-voltage distribution room acquisition system; step 2: setting a clock deviation threshold value by taking the acquisition terminal as a calibrated device, establishing contact with the mobile 5G base station through a communication module, and periodically acquiring a clock from the mobile 5G base station; and step 3: the acquisition terminal calculates and generates clock compensation according to the communication duration; and 4, step 4: after clock compensation is added, the acquisition terminal judges the difference value between the clock information of the acquisition terminal and the mobile 5G clock information and judges whether the difference value exceeds the clock deviation threshold range or not so as to calibrate the clock information of the acquisition terminal. The invention provides a method for calibrating the time of a low-voltage station area acquisition terminal by using a mobile 5G base station, aiming at the problems that the existing acquisition terminal has a complicated and fussy time calibration process and is not suitable for high-frequency periodic time calibration, and the time calibration method does not need to install new equipment and can be used for quickly and conveniently calibrating the time of the acquisition terminal by the mobile 5G base station, thereby making up the technical blank of the clock control of the acquisition terminal during the time calibration period of a master station.

title_en: Filter device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of radio frequency devices, and provides a filter which comprises a cavity with a resonant cavity, a cover plate for covering the cavity, at least one resonant rod, at least one nut and at least one fastening screw, wherein at least one first through hole is formed in the cover plate, each resonant rod is arranged in each resonant cavity and is provided with a resonant hole and a second through hole formed in the bottom of the resonant hole, the nut is positioned on one side, opposite to the first through hole, away from the cavity, of each resonant rod, the fastening screw is provided with a head part and a nail part which are sequentially connected, the head part of the fastening screw is stopped at the bottom of the resonant hole, and the nail part of the fastening screw sequentially penetrates through the second through hole and the first through hole and is in threaded connection with the nut. Compared with the existing filter, the filter provided by the invention has the advantages that the tuning rod can be obviously simplified, and the adjustment of the resonant frequency of the resonant cavity is not influenced, so that the structure and the assembly of the filter can be effectively simplified, the assembly time of the filter can be effectively shortened, and the use performance of the filter can be effectively ensured and improved.

title_en: Electronic card tray and electronic assembly
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electronic card tray and an electronic assembly, wherein the electronic card tray comprises a bracket and a movable door, the bracket is provided with a clamping groove, the movable door is provided with a clamping hook which is clamped with electronic equipment, the movable door is movably connected with the bracket, the movable door can move front and back and left and right relative to the bracket, when the movable door moves left and right for a preset distance, the clamping hook is separated from the electronic equipment, the electronic card tray also comprises a first shell fixed on the bracket, the first shell comprises an elastic sheet and a guide sheet, the elastic sheet is forwards abutted against the movable door, the movable door is provided with an L-shaped guide groove, the guide sheet is limited in the guide groove to move front and back and left and right, the electronic card tray does not need to be additionally provided with objects such as a fixed needle and the like, the electronic card tray can be directly withdrawn from the electronic equipment by hands, and the electronic card tray is simple and convenient to use.

title_en: Composite analog signal processing ICX chip and preparation process thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite analog signal processing ICX chip, which comprises an outer shell, wherein an ICX chip board is arranged in the outer shell, a wireless module is arranged at the top end of the ICX chip board, supporting plates are fixedly connected to two sides of the inner wall of the outer shell, a guide pipe penetrates through the inner part of each supporting plate and is fixedly connected with the inner part of each supporting plate, a pressure rod is connected to the inner part of each guide pipe in a threaded manner, an accommodating groove is connected to the top end of the outer shell in an embedded manner, a rotating rod is fixedly connected to the inner wall of each accommodating groove, and a signal receiving and transmitting antenna is fixedly connected to the surface of each rotating rod. According to the invention, the wireless module is connected with the signal receiving and transmitting antenna through the connecting wire, the signal receiving and transmitting antenna and the wireless module can enable the ICX chip board to wirelessly receive and transmit signal data, the single data line transmission mode in the past is changed, the arc-shaped aluminum foil plate is rotated, the signal can be refracted, the transmission capability of the signal to a specific position is improved, and the ICX chip board can be fixed on the surface of the supporting plate in an extruding manner by rotating the pressing rod, so that the installation and the disassembly of the ICX chip board are facilitated.

title_en: Antenna and communication apparatus
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an antenna and communication equipment, wherein the antenna comprises a balun structure; a radiating structure disposed on the balun structure; and the coupling structure is arranged on the radiation structure and used for reducing interference current so as to reduce the influence of the interference current on the antenna and reduce the radiation of the antenna on the interference current.

title_en: Azimuth angle anomaly detection method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an azimuth anomaly detection method, an azimuth anomaly detection device, azimuth anomaly detection equipment and a storage medium, wherein the azimuth anomaly detection method comprises the following steps: obtaining a measurement report corresponding to a target base station, wherein the measurement report comprises: the method comprises the steps that first signal strength of a first cell and second signal strength of a second cell corresponding to a target base station are obtained, and the second cell is a neighbor cell of the first cell; acquiring a first azimuth angle of a second cell relative to a first cell; determining a predicted azimuth angle of a first cell corresponding to the measurement report according to the first azimuth angle, the first signal strength and the second signal strength; determining a target azimuth angle of the first cell according to the predicted azimuth angle; and if the difference value of the target azimuth angle and the working parameter azimuth angle of the target base station aiming at the first cell is larger than a first threshold value, determining that the azimuth angle of the first cell is abnormal. According to the method and the device, the abnormity of the cell azimuth angle can be detected without manually measuring the azimuth angle of the base station antenna.

title_en: Interference device
abstract_en: The application discloses an interference apparatus. The interference device includes: the electronic equipment comprises a shell, a first accommodating groove and a second accommodating groove, wherein an accommodating space is formed in the shell, a first accommodating groove is formed in one side of the outer portion of the shell, the accommodating space is internally provided with the second accommodating groove and is located at two ends of the first accommodating groove, the second accommodating groove is communicated with the first accommodating groove, and the first accommodating groove is used for accommodating electronic equipment; the two interference signal generating modules are respectively arranged in the two second accommodating grooves, and the interference signal generating modules are used for sending a first sound wave signal to the first accommodating groove; each interference signal generation module comprises at least two interference signal generators, the at least two interference signal generators are used for converting electric signals into corresponding first sound wave signals, the first sound wave signals are emitted to the first accommodating groove by the interference signal generators, and at least one interference signal generator inclines towards the center line of the first accommodating groove in the length direction.

title_en: PXIe-based one-to-many optical fiber communication board card
abstract_en: The invention relates to a PXIe-based pair of multi-fiber communication board cards, and belongs to the field of testing. The board card comprises a connector interface (1), an RS422 communication part (2), a switching value part (3), an optical module part (4), a multi-channel conversion module part (5), a core controller (6) and a PXIe interface (7). The PXIe-based one-to-many optical fiber communication (SRIO) board card designed by the invention realizes the test of one-to-many optical fiber communication functions, reduces the cost of testing equipment in the batch production stage, shortens the time of debugging and testing stages, and improves the utilization rate of testers.

title_en: Phase shifter assembly
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a phase shifter assembly comprising: a first phase shifter having a first via; a second phase shifter disposed at one side of the first phase shifter and having a second via hole; a first gear provided on a side of the second phase shifter remote from the first phase shifter and having a third through hole, wherein the first through hole, the second through hole, and the third through hole are aligned with each other in an assembled state; a rack configured to drive the second phaser to move relative to the first phaser via the first gear to adjust the tilt angle of the phaser assembly; and a first reversing mechanism provided between the first gear and the rack and engaged with the first gear and the rack, respectively, so that a component of a linear velocity of an electric contact position of the first phase shifter and the second phase shifter in a moving direction of the rack is opposite to the moving direction of the rack.

title_en: Horizontal polarization electromagnetic pulse simulator and antenna assembly thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a horizontal polarization electromagnetic pulse simulator and an antenna assembly thereof. The antenna assembly comprises a plurality of first connecting parts and a second connecting line connected with the plurality of first connecting parts; the plurality of first connecting parts are used for being connected with a pulse source of an electromagnetic pulse simulator, and the first connecting lines are connected with the second connecting lines. The antenna assembly for the horizontal polarization electromagnetic pulse simulator is simple in installation process, simplifies installation procedures and can guarantee installation requirements.

title_en: Communication device, control method, base station, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides communication equipment, a control method, a base station and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the communication equipment comprises a transmitting link, a receiving link, an antenna module, a coupling module, a correction frequency conversion module and a logic module, wherein the antenna module is respectively connected with the transmitting link and the receiving link, the coupling module is respectively connected with the transmitting link, the receiving link and the antenna module, the correction frequency conversion module is arranged on the transmitting link and/or the receiving link, when the correction frequency conversion module is arranged on the transmitting link, the correction frequency conversion module is controlled to work, the transmitting link can transmit a first correction signal of a second frequency point, the receiving link can receive the first correction signal and transmit the first correction signal to the logic module for correction of a radio frequency signal, and when the correction frequency conversion module is arranged on the receiving link, the transmitting link can transmit the second correction signal of the first frequency point, and the correction frequency conversion module is controlled to work so that the receiving link can receive the second correction signal and transmit the second correction signal to the logic module for correction of the radio frequency signal.

title_en: Satellite communication signal fault diagnosis method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a satellite communication signal fault diagnosis method and device, wherein the satellite communication signal fault diagnosis method is applied to a satellite ground station and comprises the following steps: analyzing the received abnormal communication signals, and determining at least one parameter to be detected in the abnormal communication signals; inputting the at least one parameter to be detected into a preset fault mode library, and acquiring initial fault equipment attribute information output by the preset fault mode library; determining initial fault equipment according to the initial fault equipment attribute information, calculating equipment confidence coefficient of the initial fault equipment, and determining a fault processing mode of the initial fault equipment based on the equipment confidence coefficient; and processing the initial fault equipment according to the fault processing mode, and updating the preset fault mode library according to the attribute information of the initial fault equipment.

title_en: Power calibration optimization method and system of signal generation device
abstract_en: The invention provides a power calibration optimization method and a power calibration optimization system for a signal generating device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a fixed DAC value of an ALC loop; acquiring secondary power compensation data; and fixing the DAC value and the secondary power compensation data by using the ALC loop to obtain an actual DAC value. The obtaining of the ALC loop fixes the DAC value, including ALC loop power calibration of the signal generating device. The secondary power compensation of the invention only needs to read the actual power value under the fixed DAC value once, therefore, the calibration time can be greatly reduced by fixing the DAC value of the ALC loop and increasing the secondary power compensation, and the calibration time can be reduced to 25 percent of the original calibration time for a 50GHz signal generating device; meanwhile, although there is still a maximum calibration error of 2 δ in the fixed ALC loop DAC value, the offset value obtained by the secondary power compensation already includes the calibration error, and thus, the accuracy of the power calibration can be improved by the secondary power compensation method.

title_en: High-speed visible light communication system based on SCMA and self-adaptive coding and decoding method
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-speed visible light communication system based on SCMA and a self-adaptive coding and decoding method, which relate to the technical field of wireless communication, and the communication system comprises: the system comprises a signal sending end, a signal receiving end and a signal processing end, wherein the signal sending end is used for mapping bit signal streams of a plurality of users through a codebook and superposing the bit signal streams to synthesize a four-dimensional complex signal stream, and superposing and transmitting the complex signal stream; a visible light channel for transmitting the complex signal stream; and the signal receiving end is used for receiving the complex signal stream transmitted by the visible light channel and decoding the complex signal stream to obtain an original bit signal stream. The invention aims to reduce the complexity of the original MPA decoding algorithm to the maximum extent on the premise of ensuring the decoding accuracy.

title_en: Offline discontinuous reception procedure
abstract_en: Various aspects of the present disclosure generally relate to wireless communications. In some aspects, a User Equipment (UE) may receive a configuration identifying one or more narrowband channels in which the UE is to receive one or more Physical Downlink Shared Channel (PDSCH) repetitions of a paging message associated with a discontinuous reception process. The UE may receive one or more machine type communication physical downlink control channel (MPDCCH) repetitions of control information in an online mode of the UE. The UE may receive the one or more PDSCH repetitions in one or more narrowband channels identified by the configuration in an online mode of the UE. The UE may process the one or more MPDCCH repetitions and the one or more PDSCH repetitions in an offline mode of the UE. Numerous other aspects are provided.

title_en: Underwater target detection and identification subsurface buoy system based on acousto-optic-magnetic technology combination
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater target detection and identification submerged buoy system based on acousto-optic-magnetic technology combination, which comprises a submerged buoy subsystem, a heterogeneous communication subsystem, a shore-based subsystem and a distribution recovery subsystem, wherein the submerged buoy subsystem comprises a supporting base and a main cover arranged at the top of the supporting base, a power supply, an information acquisition module, a data preprocessing module and a data analysis processing module are arranged in the main cover, and a first data transmission station is arranged outside the main cover; the heterogeneous communication subsystem comprises a VHF beacon connected with the upper surface of the support base through an intelligent disconnection component; when underwater targets are detected and identified, the data preprocessing module preprocesses target information acquired by the information acquisition module and transmits the target information to the data analysis processing module, and the VHF beacon floats to the water surface and transmits an analysis result of the data analysis processing module to the shore-based subsystem through radio. The subsurface buoy system has the advantages of high identification accuracy, strong autonomous capability, high data transmission efficiency and high reliability.

title_en: High-safety unloading energy efficiency method utilizing physical layer safety technology in UAV-MEC environment
abstract_en: A high-safety unloading energy efficiency method utilizing physical layer safety technology in UAV-MEC environment constructs a novel unmanned aerial vehicle edge unloading scene, aims at maximizing the ratio of system safety communication transmission rate to legal unmanned aerial vehicle energy consumption, establishes a maximum secret energy efficiency model of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and jointly optimizes the track of the legal unmanned aerial vehicle, CPU calculation frequency allocation and unloading strategy of calculation tasks under the constraint of meeting given time delay, CPU calculation frequency and unloading rate, and simultaneously improves safety communication in the UAV-MEC scene from the aspect of physical layer safety. A global optimization algorithm based on a block coordinate descent method is constructed to solve the optimization problem, the optimization problem is decoupled into three sub-problems, the non-convex problem is approximated to be a local convex optimization problem by introducing a relaxation variable, and a CVX tool is used for carrying out repeated iteration on the convex problem to solve the system to approximate the optimal solution. The method fully considers the relation between the unmanned aerial vehicle safety communication and the unmanned aerial vehicle energy consumption, and improves the whole Qos of the system.

title_en: Optimizing queued calls
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention provide methods, systems, computer program products for managing calls queued at a call center in an attempt to receive service from a call center worker. According to the method, a first speech segment received in a call made by a device is first recorded. Next, it is determined whether a portion of the first speech segment relates to a first predefined speech segment. The volume of the device is adjusted in response to the portion of the first speech segment correlating with the first predefined speech segment. In response to the portion of the first speech segment not being correlated with the first predefined speech segment, alerting a user of the device.

title_en: Implantable biosensor delivery system and implantation activation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an implantable biological sensor delivery system and an implantable activation method, wherein the system comprises a sensing wireless signal transmitter and an applicator, the wireless signal sensing transmitter is provided with a mechanical switch, the applicator is provided with an application system and a mechanical trigger mechanism, and the application system is used for pushing out the wireless signal transmitter and releasing the wireless signal transmitter to a human body; the mechanical triggering mechanism is connected with the application system and is used for operating a mechanical switch in the process that the application system pushes out and releases the wireless signal transmitter to the human body so as to enable the implantable biological sensor delivery system to be switched from a storage mode to an operating mode. The processing circuit of the system in the storage mode is simple, and the standby power consumption is low; the mechanical triggering mode is adopted, and the mechanical mechanism in the storage mode is tightly surrounded and firmly fixed, so that false triggering is prevented, and compared with the photo-electromagnetic triggering mode, the anti-interference anti-false triggering mode has low standby power consumption and strong anti-interference anti-false triggering.

title_en: Horn antenna
abstract_en: The present invention provides a horn antenna, comprising: the antenna comprises an antenna feed source, a first waveguide, a waveguide converter, a second waveguide, a horn body and a super-surface lens; the antenna feed source is connected with a first waveguide, and the first waveguide is connected with a first end of the waveguide converter; one end of the second waveguide is connected with the second end of the waveguide converter, the other end of the second waveguide is connected with the horn body, and the super-surface lens is arranged at one end of the horn body, which is far away from the second waveguide; the super-surface lens comprises a first substrate, a second substrate and a metal patch, wherein a first metal grid is arranged on a first end face of the first substrate, a second metal grid is arranged on a first end face of the second substrate, the metal patch is formed on one of a second end face of the first substrate and a second end face of the second substrate, and the first metal grid and the second metal grid are arranged in an orthogonal mode. The horn antenna is low in manufacturing cost, and the super-surface lens is positioned right above the diameter surface of the horn mouth, so that the miniaturization, the light weight and the high gain of the horn antenna are realized.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle bee colony dense continuous emission control system based on high-speed optical fiber bus
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle swarm dense continuous launching control system based on a high-speed optical fiber bus, which comprises a swarm launching bin, N unmanned aerial vehicles, an optical fiber repeater, a rocket ignition control device, N rocket boosters and a ground control station, wherein the swarm launching bin is connected with the N unmanned aerial vehicles; the bee colony launching bin is provided with N launching bin grids, and each bin grid is loaded with one unmanned aerial vehicle; the optical fiber transponder is arranged in the swarm launching bin and is interconnected with all the unmanned aerial vehicles by utilizing a high-speed optical fiber bus; the rocket ignition control device is connected to the optical fiber transponder through a high-speed optical fiber bus to realize interconnection and networking with the unmanned aerial vehicle; the N rocket boosters are respectively arranged at the tail part of the unmanned aerial vehicle and are connected to a rocket ignition control device through ignition wires; the ground control station carries out information transfer with unmanned aerial vehicle through radio communication. The system can solve the influence of the problems of multi-source data, electromagnetic interference, information error codes, complex links and the like on rocket launching control, and ensures that the unmanned aerial vehicle swarm combat system reliably and stably carries out continuous and intensive unmanned aerial vehicle launching.

title_en: Photoelectric fusion frequency conversion system
abstract_en: An electro-optically fused frequency conversion system comprising: the input conditioning circuit is suitable for conditioning the first radio frequency receiving signal to obtain a first conditioning signal, conditioning the second radio frequency receiving signal to obtain a second conditioning signal, and conditioning the intermediate frequency transmitting signal to obtain a third conditioning signal or a fourth conditioning signal; the microwave up-conversion link is suitable for obtaining an up-conversion signal according to the up-conversion local oscillator signal and the first signal to be processed; the microwave photon frequency conversion link is suitable for obtaining a microwave signal of a specified frequency conversion frequency point according to the second signal to be processed, the high local oscillation signal and the optical local oscillation signal; the output conditioning circuit is suitable for filtering the microwave signals of the appointed variable frequency point to obtain final variable frequency signals; the intermediate frequency transmitting signal is a signal of a fixed frequency point, and the frequency of the first radio frequency receiving signal is within a first preset range; the frequency of the second radio frequency receiving signal is within a second preset range.

title_en: Data acquisition and processing system for power equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data acquisition and processing system of power equipment, which comprises: a data acquisition module: collecting data information of the power equipment; a data preprocessing module: preprocessing the acquired receipt information to remove defect data and interference; a data format unifying module: extracting the data information after the preprocessing according to a uniform format module and storing the data information into a format module; the data output module is used for sending the data information with unified format to a back-end monitoring system; the technical problem that serious burden is brought to monitoring personnel due to the fact that equipment information formats of the same power equipment are not uniform due to different manufacturers is solved.

title_en: Medium-loaded silver paste-free antenna for navigation positioning and design and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dielectric-loaded silver paste-free antenna for navigation and positioning and a design and preparation method thereof. The dielectric loading silver paste-free antenna comprises a microstrip slot antenna and a dielectric block. The microstrip slot antenna comprises a dielectric substrate, and metal patches and metal conduction bands which are respectively printed on the upper surface and the lower surface of the dielectric substrate. The metal patch is provided with an annular gap coupled with the metal conduction band and two pairs of rectangular gaps which are symmetrically arranged by taking the center of the annular gap as a symmetrical point. Two rectangular gaps in each pair of rectangular gaps are symmetrically arranged by taking the center of the annular gap as a symmetrical point, one end of each rectangular gap is communicated with the outer edge of the annular gap, and the other end of each rectangular gap radiates outwards. The antenna has the characteristics of simple and light structure, excellent performance, low profile, low cost, wide axial ratio, low return loss, wide absolute bandwidth, stable radiation pattern and the like, and is suitable for the positioning function of a satellite navigation system.

title_en: Encoding method, decoding method, related equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an encoding method, a decoding method, related equipment and a storage medium, which are used for reducing the transmission power of a signal, wherein the encoding method comprises the steps that a sending device determines the Most Significant Bit (MSB) according to transmission data, and the MSB comprises at least part of payload of the transmission data; the transmitting device encoding the MSB to obtain MSB overhead; the transmitting device obtaining a least significant bit, LSB, based on the MSB overhead, the LSB including at least the MSB overhead; the transmitting device transmits a transmission frame to a receiving device, and the MSB and the LSB are respectively located in different rows of the transmission frame.

title_en: Antenna, antenna module and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an antenna, antenna module and electronic equipment, antenna include the gradual change groove antenna, fold into oscillator and feed structure, and the gradual change groove antenna is including the first metal structure and the second metal structure that constitute the gradual change groove, and the both ends in gradual change groove are slot end and wide mouth end respectively. The extension direction of the folded dipole is intersected with the extension direction of the gradual-change groove, the folded dipole comprises a main dipole and a parasitic dipole which are oppositely arranged, the main dipole is positioned between the parasitic dipole and the narrow slit end, the main dipole comprises a first branch electrically connected to the first metal structure and a second branch electrically connected to the second metal structure, and the area between the main dipole and the parasitic dipole forms a resonant groove of the gradual-change groove antenna. The feed structure is electrically connected between the first branch and the second branch, and simultaneously feeds the folded dipole and the gradient slot antenna so as to excite the gradient slot antenna directional antenna and excite the folded dipole into an omnidirectional antenna. The antenna has the advantage of miniaturization of the double antenna.

title_en: ONU authentication method, ONU authentication device, optical line terminal and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an ONU authentication method, an ONU authentication device, an optical line terminal and a readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of communication. The method comprises the following steps: under the conditions that an authentication request of an ONU to be authenticated is received, the ONU to be authenticated is determined to be online and the ONU with a logic identification LOID is changed, a restarting signal is sent to the ONU to be authenticated, and historical ONU information of the ONU to be authenticated is deleted, wherein the historical ONU information comprises historical bottom layer information and historical upper layer information corresponding to the ONU to be authenticated, the historical bottom layer information comprises historical service configuration information, and the historical upper layer information comprises equipment identification of the ONU to be authenticated; and receiving an authentication request sent by the ONU to be authenticated after restarting, and authenticating the ONU to be authenticated according to the authentication request. Thus, the condition that the ONU is easy to be on-line and fails when the ONU to be authenticated is on-line and the ONU with the LOID is changed can be avoided.

title_en: Control method and device of Bluetooth equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a control method, a control device and a storage medium of Bluetooth equipment, and relates to the technical field of terminals; the method comprises the following steps: the Bluetooth headset establishes communication connection with the terminal equipment based on a Bluetooth communication protocol; the Bluetooth headset is a master device in communication connection, and the terminal device is a slave device; the Bluetooth headset is used for playing audio in the terminal equipment; under the condition that the terminal equipment determines that the audio played by the Bluetooth headset is jammed and the power of a Bluetooth module in the Bluetooth headset is smaller than a power threshold value, the terminal equipment indicates the Bluetooth headset to be switched into slave equipment; the terminal equipment is switched to be main equipment; terminal equipment sends the audio data package of the audio frequency that bluetooth headset broadcast to bluetooth headset, and like this, the card pause has certain probability to take place because of bluetooth headset causes as the master unit, switches owner, slave unit back, and terminal equipment initiatively sends the audio data package to bluetooth headset, helps solving the audio frequency card pause problem when the audio frequency among the bluetooth headset broadcast terminal equipment.

title_en: Anti-reflection unmanned aerial vehicle aircraft control equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses anti-reflection unmanned aerial vehicle aircraft control equipment which comprises a control assembly, wherein the control assembly comprises a control platform, remote rods and a display screen, the display screen is embedded into the control platform, and the remote rods are arranged on the control platform on two sides of the display screen; the shading assembly comprises a U-shaped frame, a piece of sunshade cloth and a fixing frame, the U-shaped frame is arranged around three circles of the display screen, the bottom of the sunshade cloth extends into the console from the top surface of the U-shaped frame, and the fixing frame is fixedly arranged along the extending direction of the top of the sunshade cloth; according to the invention, the fixing frame and the sunshade cloth can be taken out from the U-shaped frame, when the sunshade cloth is not used, the sunshade cloth and the fixing frame can be taken in the U-shaped frame, the sunshade cloth can be taken in by hand operation, and the operation is simple.

title_en: Radiating element, antenna assembly and base station antenna
abstract_en: The invention relates to a radiating element for an antenna array, the antenna array comprising a first vertically extending array and a second adjacent vertically extending array, the first array being spaced from the second array by a first equivalent spacing, two adjacent radiating elements in the first array and/or the second array being spaced by a second equivalent spacing, wherein the first equivalent spacing is not equal to the second equivalent spacing, wherein the radiating element has an asymmetric radiator, the asymmetric radiator has a first extension in a first direction and a second extension in a second direction perpendicular to the first direction, wherein the first extension size is not equal to the second extension size, wherein the first equivalent spacing has a first ratio with respect to the second equivalent spacing, and the first extension has a second ratio relative to the second extension, wherein the second ratio is set to match the first ratio. In addition, the invention also relates to an antenna component and a base station antenna.

title_en: Circuit arrangement and quantum communication device for calibrating unequal-arm interferometers
abstract_en: The invention provides a circuit device and a quantum communication device for calibrating an unequal-arm interferometer, wherein the circuit device comprises: a constant voltage power supply; the heating pipe is arranged on the short arm of the unequal arm interferometer; and the diode is reversely connected between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the output end of the constant voltage power supply and is connected with the heating tube in series, wherein the diode provides corresponding reverse saturation current for the heating tube according to the change of the ambient temperature so as to offset the excess amount of the optical path change of the long arm of the unequal arm interferometer under the influence of the change of the ambient temperature relative to the optical path change of the short arm of the unequal arm interferometer under the influence of the change of the ambient temperature. The invention is beneficial to improving the adaptability of the unequal arm interferometer to the surrounding environment so as to ensure the stability of the interference effect of the unequal arm interferometer, thus the code forming rate of a quantum communication system applying the unequal arm interferometer is more efficient, stable and reliable.

title_en: Method and device for adjusting temperature of mobile phone
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for adjusting the temperature of a mobile phone, in particular to the technical field of mobile phone accessories, a plurality of control devices are uniformly distributed in a back cover, when high temperature occurs at any position, the invention can not only realize that a control valve opens the opening of a spiral pipe at the corresponding position to realize the smooth circulation of liquid, but also control the movement of a touch structure, and further can automatically trigger a contact switch to control a water pump to operate, so that the water pump can circularly convey water to take away heat, thereby playing a role in cooling, and the device can automatically trigger the control device and the touch structure in a high-temperature area to realize the operation of controlling the water pump under the high-temperature condition, thereby playing the targeted heat dissipation operation, improving the significance of local heat dissipation, and assisting other positions to achieve the heat dissipation effect, thereby bringing better application prospect.

title_en: Wireless vehicle control system and method
abstract_en: A vehicle control system and method are provided. The vehicle control system includes a controller configured to be operably disposed on a first propulsion-generating vehicle of a multi-vehicle system and a wireless communication unit configured to be electrically coupled to the controller. The controller is configured to control the wireless communication unit to wirelessly transmit a first vehicle control signal to a second propulsion generating vehicle of the multi-vehicle system when the first propulsion generating vehicle and the second propulsion generating vehicle are in a non-cabled state, the second propulsion generating vehicle being in close proximity to and mechanically coupled to the first propulsion generating vehicle. The controller is further configured to control the wireless communication unit to wirelessly transmit a different second vehicle control signal to a third propulsion-generating vehicle of the multi-vehicle system, the third propulsion-generating vehicle being spaced apart from the first and second propulsion-generating vehicles by at least one non-propulsion-generating vehicle of the multi-vehicle system.

title_en: Antenna structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antenna structure, comprising: a feed-in radiation part, a first radiation part, a second radiation part, a non-conductor support element and a peripheral element. The feed-in radiation part is provided with a feed-in point. The first radiation part comprises a branch part and a broadening part, wherein the feed radiation part is coupled to a grounding potential through the first radiation part. The second radiation part is coupled to the feed radiation part and the first radiation part. The non-conductor supporting element can bear the feed-in radiation part, the first radiation part and the second radiation part. The peripheral member includes a non-conductive case and an inner metal member, wherein the branch portion and the widened portion of the first radiating portion are disposed on the non-conductive case of the peripheral member.

title_en: Card inserting and pulling assembly, card taking tool, mobile phone and card taking method
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of mobile phones and discloses a card plugging and unplugging assembly, a card taking tool, a mobile phone and a card taking method. The plug card assembly comprises a first card support, a second card support and a card seat, wherein the second card support is independent of the first card support; the card holder is provided with a first card position and a second card position, the first card position supports the first card holder, the second card position supports the second card holder, the first card position and the second card position are arranged side by side along the plugging direction of the first card holder or the second card holder, and the second card position is close to the outer side of the plugging direction relative to the first card position; the second card support is provided with a main body part and a stress part, and the stress part extends towards the first clamping direction and is superposed with the first card support. When the second card support is taken out, the first card support can not be taken out, normal use of certain function pairs is guaranteed, and continuity of partial functions of equipment such as a mobile phone is better.

title_en: Satellite beam using method, satellite communication equipment and terminal
abstract_en: The invention provides a satellite beam using method, satellite communication equipment and a terminal, wherein the method comprises the following steps: sending a downlink scanning beam signal to a terminal on a scanning wave position in a mode of periodically scanning the scanning wave position by using a first type of beam; receiving a feedback signal sent by the terminal according to the downlink scanning beam signal; obtaining a scanning wave position of the terminal according to the feedback signal; and according to the scanning wave position, using the first type of wave beam and/or the second type of wave beam to communicate with the terminal. The method can ensure that the satellite beam still can provide efficient communication service for users in the whole coverage range under the condition of narrow beam or even spot beam, and improves the transmission efficiency.

title_en: On-orbit distributed information resource application service system
abstract_en: The invention provides an on-orbit distributed information resource application service system, which comprises: the service platform layer is used for integrating, packaging and managing computing resources, storage resources, communication resources, data resources and plug-in resources of the distributed on-orbit satellite so as to provide task planning services, data processing services and information extraction services for the on-orbit satellite; the hardware environment layer is used for supporting the service platform layer to carry out operation of software programs required by task planning service, data processing service and information extraction service; and the application plug-in layer is used for developing, integrating and running plug-in resources required by the mission planning service, the data processing service and the information extraction service under the support of the service platform layer.

title_en: Flexible screen terminal and drop protection method and storage medium thereof
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a flexible screen terminal, a fall protection method thereof and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: monitoring whether the flexible screen terminal is in a falling state or not; when the flexible screen terminal is in a falling state, respectively acquiring state parameters of each part of the flexible screen reaching a target position; respectively calculating deformation models of all parts of the flexible screen based on state parameters of all parts of the flexible screen reaching a target position; and respectively controlling each part of the flexible screen to execute deformation according to the corresponding deformation model. The technical scheme provided by the disclosure can effectively reduce the collision damage of the flexible screen terminal.

title_en: System and method for testing wireless resource management consistency of millimeter wave terminal with multiple arrival angles
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for testing wireless resource management consistency of a millimeter wave terminal with multiple arrival angles, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the system comprises a feed source system, a metamaterial lens array, a carrying turntable, a test instrument and a change-over switch box; electromagnetic waves radiated by the feed source system are reflected or transmitted by the metamaterial lens array to form plane waves, and downlink signals are contained; the feed source system receives electromagnetic waves reflected by the tested equipment and reflected or transmitted by the metamaterial lens array, wherein the electromagnetic waves comprise uplink signals; the object carrying turntable is positioned in the range of the plane wave dead zone and is used for carrying tested equipment and adjusting the angle of the tested equipment; the test instrument is used for measuring and analyzing the uplink signal and the downlink signal; and the change-over switch box is used for switching the uplink signals and the downlink signals of the feed source system and the test instrument. The method and the device realize the test of the radio resource management under multiple arrival angles, improve the dynamic range of a test system, and solve the problem of the arrival angle in the consistency test of the radio resource management of the 5G millimeter wave terminal.

title_en: Sagnac loop-based reference system-independent measurement device-independent QKD system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for QKD independent of a reference system independent measuring device based on a sagnac loop, comprising a transmitting end Alice, a transmitting end Bob and a measuring end Charlie; the transmitting end Alice, the transmitting end Bob and the measuring end Charlie are connected through a free space channel; the transmitting end Alice comprises a Laser1 and a first sagnac loop modulator, wherein the first sagnac loop modulator comprises an intensity modulator IM1, a polarization controller PC1, an optical circulator Cir1, a first transmitting end sagnac loop, an optical attenuator ATT1 and a fiber collimator Col 1; the transmitting end Bob comprises a Laser2 and a second sagnac loop modulator, wherein the second sagnac loop modulator comprises an intensity modulator IM2, a polarization controller PC2, an optical circulator Cir2, a second transmitting end sagnac loop, an optical attenuator ATT2 and a fiber collimator Col 2; the invention solves the problem of complex preparation of the intermediate state in the prior art, has higher speed and better stability, achieves the purposes of eliminating the influence of the environment on the polarization state, does not need to align a reference system, simplifies the complexity of the system and improves the code rate.

title_en: Three-dimensional scanning method, system, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a three-dimensional scanning method, a system, an electronic device and a storage medium, wherein the three-dimensional scanning method comprises the steps of establishing a plug-and-play wireless network supporting a plug-and-play protocol based on a wireless communication module under the condition that a scanning device and a tracking device are connected to a local area network; when the area to be scanned is scanned, the synchronous signal between the tracking device and the scanning device is obtained through the plug-and-play wireless network, the scanning device and the tracking device are instructed to synchronously obtain respective scanning data based on the synchronous signal, and a three-dimensional scanning result of the area to be scanned is generated according to the scanning data. By the method and the device, the problem of low configuration flexibility of three-dimensional scanning is solved, and the three-dimensional scanning method supporting plug and play is realized.

title_en: Spread spectrum communication method, system, sending module and receiving module based on power line
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power line communication, and discloses a spread spectrum communication method, a system, a sending module and a receiving module based on a power line. When the transmitting module of the invention transmits signals, the signal to be transmitted is divided into a plurality of information blocks comprising index bits and modulation bits, the index bits are mapped into transmitting time slices, the modulation bits are mapped into spreading codes, finally, analog signals are generated according to the transmitting time slices and the spreading codes and transmitted to a power line channel, the receiving module detects the signals of the power line channel, and carries out corresponding demapping on the detected signals, and the index bits and the modulation bits are recovered according to the demapping result, so that output signals are obtained according to the index bits and the modulation bits. The invention can solve the technical problems of larger noise interference, lower signal-to-noise ratio and low communication rate of the existing power line communication method, and realize high-rate reliable power line communication.

title_en: Bilinear channel estimation method based on UAMP
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wireless communication, and discloses a bilinear channel estimation method based on UAMP, which comprises the following steps: step A, performing dimension reduction conversion and simplification on a MIMO communication system model assisted by RIS by utilizing the Kronecker product and Khatri-Rao product property; step B, performing factor decomposition on a joint posterior probability density function of the to-be-estimated quantity of the system model to obtain a corresponding factor graph model; step C, setting initialization parameter values aiming at the factor graph model in the step B, carrying out bilinear channel estimation by using a UAMP algorithm framework, and obtaining estimation values of different channels; step D, repeating the step C until the algorithm converges; compared with the existing algorithm, the algorithm has the advantages of larger estimation performance, obviously improves the single iteration complexity and the iteration convergence speed, and has stronger robustness.

title_en: Method and apparatus for dynamic antenna array reconfiguration and signaling in millimeter wave bands
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to dynamic antenna array reconfiguration and signaling in the millimeter wave band. A User Equipment (UE) may detect an antenna array change condition. The UE may send a request for beam training for antenna array configuration in response to the detection. The request for beam training may include a requested antenna array configuration for the UE, and an indication of beam weights used with the requested antenna array configuration. The base station may determine whether to grant or deny the requested antenna array configuration for the UE. The UE may receive an indication of an antenna array configuration for the UE from the base station. The base station may transmit a number of reference signals as a set of consecutive channel state information reference signals (CSI-RS). The UE may train the reconfigured active antenna array configuration based on the reference signal.

title_en: Foldable electronic device
abstract_en: The application discloses collapsible electronic equipment, including first device body, the second device body, first antenna, second antenna and first parasitic radiator, first antenna includes first antenna radiator, the second antenna includes the second antenna radiator, at least part of first antenna radiator and at least part of second antenna radiator extend along the direction that is on a parallel with the pivot, when collapsible electronic equipment is in fold condition, in collapsible electronic equipment's thickness direction, at least some overlaps between first antenna radiator and the first parasitic radiator that corresponds the setting, make first antenna radiator and first parasitic radiator coupling. The envelope correlation coefficient and efficiency of the first antenna and the second antenna in the folded state can be improved.

title_en: Automatic timing method based on intelligent terminal data communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic time correction method based on intelligent terminal data communication, which aims to solve the problem of initialization or abnormity of a clock after power failure of an electric energy meter in the prior art, diagnoses in the process of reading and acquiring tasks through a concentrator, improves the effective utilization of communication data bandwidth, and judges and executes the time correction processing of the electric energy meter clock according to a deviation threshold value. The method comprises the following steps: recording the reading time and the receiving response time in the clock of the concentrator and simultaneously reading the command receiving time and the data sending time in the clock of the electric energy meter by the concentrator in the process of executing the reading task once on the electric energy meter; calculating one-way transmission delay according to the reading time, the response receiving time, the command receiving time and the data sending time; and calculating errors of the concentrator clock and the electric energy meter clock by combining the one-way transmission delay, and correcting the electric energy meter clock according to the concentrator clock and the one-way transmission delay if the errors exceed a preset threshold.

title_en: Sterilization apparatus for food production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sterilization device for food production, which comprises: the high-temperature short-time sterilization device comprises a bearing bottom plate, two grafting baffles are fixedly mounted at the top of the bearing bottom plate, an instantaneous sterilization mechanism, a material carrying mechanism and a command issuing mechanism are respectively and fixedly mounted at the top of the bearing bottom plate, the high-temperature short-time sterilization device is accelerated by a strong current, the temperature of a sterilization area is rapidly raised to 135 ℃, the time required by the whole heating process is 2-8s, the heating mode basically reaches the principle of microbial thermal death, the sensitivity of microbes to high temperature is far greater than that of most food components to high temperature, the microbes can be effectively killed in a short time at ultrahigh temperature, the speed of food production can be adapted to the speed of the food production of a production line, the mode that the food production line is not considered in the existing device is effectively solved, the traditional sterilization mode cannot cooperate with the production rate, and the problem that the required sterilization time is long is solved, and the efficiency of the whole sterilization of the device is improved.

title_en: Microstrip array antenna and radar system
abstract_en: The invention provides a microstrip array antenna and a radar system, wherein the microstrip array antenna comprises a metal patch layer, a first medium substrate layer, a metal gap feed layer, a metal column separation cavity layer, a second medium substrate layer, a third medium substrate layer and a metal stratum, wherein the metal patch layer is attached to the upper surface of the first medium substrate layer, the second medium substrate layer is positioned below the first medium substrate layer, and the upper surface of the third medium substrate layer; the metal gap feed layer is attached to the upper surface of the second medium substrate layer; the metal posts of the metal post compartment layer penetrate through the second medium substrate layer and the third medium substrate layer; the metal ground layer is attached to the lower surface of the third medium substrate layer. The antenna provided by the invention has the characteristics of bandwidth, high efficiency and low side lobe, can improve the bandwidth of the antenna, improves the efficiency of the antenna, reduces the electromagnetic interference of a radar system, and improves the accuracy of radar detection.

title_en: Signal mixing circuit device and receiver
abstract_en: The application discloses signal mixing circuit device and receiver, signal mixing circuit device includes: the first mixer, the second mixer, the third mixer, the fourth mixer, the first signal amplifying circuit, the second signal amplifying circuit, the signal intensity detector, the controller and the attenuator. And detecting the signal intensity value output by the first signal amplifying circuit by using a signal intensity detector, starting a high-gain path under the condition that the signal intensity value is smaller than a first threshold value as a detection result, eliminating the noise of the input end of the local oscillation signal of the first frequency mixer by using a fourth frequency mixer, eliminating the noise of the input end of the local oscillation signal of the second frequency mixer by using a third frequency mixer, and ensuring higher signal-to-noise ratio. And when the detection result is that the signal intensity value is greater than the second threshold value, the low-gain path is started, and the low-gain path multiplexes part of circuits of the high-gain path, so that the whole circuit area is effectively reduced, and the chip cost and the power consumption are reduced.

title_en: System comprising a plurality of units
abstract_en: A system, comprising: a first unit and one or more second units. The first unit includes: a timing reference configured to provide a primary timing reference signal; a master time block configured to provide a master time signal for the first unit based on the master timing reference signal; and a first interface configured to: receiving time-stamped processed second RF signals from the one or more second units; and providing a first unit timing signal to the one or more second units based on the master time signal. The one or more second units each include: a slave time block configured to: determining a slave time signal for the second unit based on the master timing reference signal; determining one or more second timing values based on the slave time signal; determining an adjustment time based on the first unit timing signal and the second timing value received from the first unit; and adjusting the slave time signal based on the adjustment time.

title_en: Method for resisting single event effect of high-speed optical interface module in space environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for resisting a single event effect of a high-speed optical interface module in a space environment, which comprises the following steps: a. classifying the influence generated by the single event effect; b. and respectively carrying out corresponding processing according to the classification result. The method has the characteristics of high efficiency, complete functions and quick recovery.

title_en: Transmission and receiving point distribution method and related equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a transmitting and receiving point distribution method which can be applied to distributed Massive MIMO. The method in the embodiment of the application comprises the following steps: acquiring the signal strength of mutual signals among a plurality of RRUs; determining a neighbor relationship between the plurality of RRUs based on the signal strength; and allocating transmission and reception points TRP to which the plurality of RRUs belong based on the adjacent relation. Compared with the prior art that the TRP needs to be manually divided according to the RRU position, on one hand, the division error caused by manually distributing the TRP according to the coordinate information is avoided. On the other hand, the defect that TRP division can be carried out only by determining the position of the RRU is avoided.

title_en: Indoor positioning checking method based on photographing of front camera and rear camera of mobile phone
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indoor positioning checking method based on photographing of front and rear cameras of a mobile phone, which comprises the following steps: firstly, establishing an indoor space rectangular coordinate system; secondly, establishing an indoor panoramic image library; thirdly, collecting indoor double-scene images by using a smart phone; matching the front image and the rear image with an indoor panoramic image library; fifthly, acquiring the indoor position of the user; and sixthly, checking the position of the user in the room. The method has simple steps and reasonable design, and uses the images shot by the front camera and the rear camera of the smart phone at the same time for indoor positioning of image matching, thereby effectively utilizing the double-scene shooting function of the mobile terminal, increasing the matching range and improving the matching accuracy and positioning precision; and the double-scene shooting has the checking condition that the front optical axis and the rear optical axis are parallel, the matching calculation positions in two directions can be checked with each other, and the speed and the precision of indoor positioning can be greatly improved.

title_en: Channel information feedback method, communication device and communication system
abstract_en: The application discloses a channel information feedback method, a communication device and a communication system, which are used for solving the problem that feedback occupies too many transmission resources in the prior art. The method is applied to a first wireless device and comprises the following steps: receiving a first message from a second wireless device, wherein the first message is used for notifying measurement channel information, the first message carries first indication information related to the first wireless device, and the first indication information indicates a feedback condition; measuring channel information according to the first message; determining a first channel information variable quantity according to the currently measured channel information and the historically measured channel information; and feeding back a measurement report to the second wireless equipment when the first channel information variation meets the feedback condition.

title_en: Space-time-frequency non-stationary wireless communication channel modeling method for communication of Internet of vehicles
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space-time-frequency non-stationary wireless communication channel modeling method for Internet of vehicles communication, which divides clusters in an Internet of vehicles communication environment into static clusters and dynamic clusters, and models continuous arbitrary tracks of a transmitting and receiving end and the dynamic clusters of the Internet of vehicles communication, so that the characteristics of traffic flow density VTD and vehicle running track VMT in an Internet of vehicles communication scene are considered in the construction of a space-time-frequency non-stationary Internet of vehicles communication channel model, and the accuracy and the universality of the construction of the channel model are improved. The method is adopted to construct a large-scale MIMO millimeter wave vehicle networking V2V statistical channel model, the influence of VTD and VMT on array evolution and time evolution of static clusters and dynamic clusters is considered in the construction of the space-time-frequency non-stationary V2V channel model, and the defect that the existing V2V channel model can not organically integrate VTD, VMT and space-time-frequency non-stationary modeling can be overcome.

title_en: Information detection method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an information detection method, an information detection device, information detection equipment and a readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of communication, so as to reduce the complexity of detecting management information. The method comprises the following steps: receiving an uplink optical signal of an optical demultiplexer in an uplink direction, and demodulating low-speed management information from the uplink optical signal, wherein the uplink optical signal comprises the low-speed management information; and/or, in a downlink direction, receiving a downlink optical signal sent by the optical module, and demodulating low-speed management information from the downlink optical signal, where the downlink optical signal includes the low-speed management information. The embodiment of the invention can reduce the complexity of detecting the management information.

title_en: High-frequency circuit structure, subassembly, circuit card, and method for manufacturing high-frequency circuit structure
abstract_en: The high-frequency wiring structure (10) according to the present invention comprises: a high-frequency circuit board (111); a ground lead pin (122) fixed to a ground terminal provided in a bottom surface of the high-frequency wiring substrate; and a signal lead pin (132) fixed to a signal line end provided in a bottom surface of the high-frequency wiring substrate, wherein the signal lead pin (132) is provided between the ground lead pins (122), the signal lead pin (132) having the following structure: each of the signal lead pins (132) pops up from a horizontal plane to which a bottom surface of the ground lead pin (122) belongs in a direction toward a side where the high-frequency wiring substrate is arranged, and a popping-up height is substantially the same in a structure in which the respective signal lead pins (132) pop up. Accordingly, the high-frequency circuit structure (10) of the present invention can reduce crosstalk in a wide frequency band and can provide excellent high-frequency characteristics.

title_en: Apparatus and method for mappable I/O channels on an electrical transmitter
abstract_en: An electrical transmitter (100) is provided, the electrical transmitter (100) comprising an ethernet connection (118) and a power source. The electronic device (112) is configured to receive an ethernet connection (118) and a power source. The electronic device (112) includes logic operable to: detecting a power supply; and receiving power from an ethernet connection (118) or a dedicated power connection (116). A power connection terminal (114) that is remapped by the electronic device (112) is operable to accept power when a dedicated power connection (116) is detected, and is operable to accept a non-power connection when power from an ethernet connection (118) is detected.

title_en: Reserving resources for subsequent side link transmissions via initial side link control information communication
abstract_en: Aspects are disclosed for reserving resources for side link communications. In one example, an initial side link communication is transmitted that includes an indication of resources reserved for a subsequent side link communication. Based on transmission characteristics associated with transmitting the initial side link communication, transmission constraints are applied to subsequent side link communications. Subsequent side link communications are then communicated in accordance with the transmission constraints.

title_en: Quick NC-OFDM communication resource allocation method
