abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid NC-OFDM communication resource allocation method, which comprises the following steps: step 1, calculating the power required by each sub-channel for transmitting 1-bit data according to a channel condition result perceived by a frequency spectrum and the transmitted bit error rate requirement; step 2, according to the power required by each sub-channel for transmitting 1 bit of data obtained in the step 1, selecting the sub-channel for actually transmitting the data based on a threshold comparison criterion; step 3, bit power distribution of the sub-channels in the initialization step 2 is carried out based on the water injection idea, the bit number of the sub-channel initialization distribution is rounded down and the power of the sub-channel distribution is recalculated, and the bit power initial distribution result of the actual transmission sub-channels is obtained; and 4, calculating a sub-channel power difference value based on the power corresponding to the sub-channel bit number before and after the downward rounding in the step 3, selecting a sub-channel with the smallest power difference value, and distributing the residual power to the sub-channel at one time to finish the final distribution of the bit power. The method can realize rapid and effective bit power distribution and improve the efficiency of resource distribution.

title_en: Sports facility intelligent management system based on cloud computing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloud computing-based sports facility intelligent management system, which comprises a vibration detection module, a communication module, a cloud computing module and a management terminal module, wherein the vibration detection module is used for detecting the vibration of a user; the vibration detection module is used for acquiring vibration data of the sports facility and transmitting the vibration data to the communication module; the communication module is used for transmitting the vibration data to the cloud computing module; the cloud computing module is used for storing the vibration data, early warning the sports facilities with the accumulated service life exceeding a preset monitoring threshold value, and sending a prompt message to the management terminal module; the management terminal module is used for displaying the prompt message. The vibration data are acquired to judge whether the sports facilities are in the use state or not, and then the accumulated use duration of the sports facilities is calculated according to the vibration data, so that the sports facilities which need to be replaced earlier than the use duration due to overhigh use frequency can be found in time, the corresponding sports facilities are updated in time, and the safety of the sports facilities is improved.

title_en: First-order optimization method for large-scale cellular MIMO uplink total rate
abstract_en: The invention provides a first-order optimization method for a large-scale de-cellular MIMO uplink total rate, which comprises the following steps of: step 1, establishing an uplink pilot training model and deriving MMSE channel estimation, step 2, deriving a UE total rate closed expression and establishing a UE total rate optimization problem, and step 3, designing a UE total rate optimization method: a weighted MMSE based overall rate optimization algorithm or an APG based overall rate optimization algorithm is employed. On the premise of meeting the constraint of UE data transmission power, the total rate of the UE is greatly improved, so that the performance loss caused by malicious attack of an interference machine is compensated.

title_en: Short-distance communication system in metering box and wireless connection method thereof
abstract_en: A short-distance communication system in a metering box and a wireless connection method thereof comprise a front-meter controller, an electric energy meter and a rear-meter circuit breaker, wherein the front-meter controller and the rear-meter circuit breaker are respectively connected with the electric energy meter through the wireless communication modules by canceling an HPLC module in the front-meter controller and assembling the wireless communication modules, a concentrator acquires equipment information of the front-meter controller and the rear-meter circuit breaker through the electric energy meter, or the HPLC module in the electric energy meter is canceled, and the wireless communication modules for communication connection are arranged in the front-meter controller, the electric energy meter and the rear-meter circuit breaker, so that the concentrator can respectively access the electric energy meter and the rear-meter circuit breaker through the forwarding functions of the front-meter controller and the electric energy meter. The invention reduces the number of HPLC modules, reduces the cost and the power consumption, and reduces the line loss.

title_en: Frequency-voltage pre-configuration method and related device
abstract_en: The application provides a frequency voltage pre-configuration method and a related device, wherein the device comprises a baseband chip, a power management chip and a target hardware combination; the baseband chip is used for detecting a first data task adapting to the target hardware combination, switching the hardware state of the target hardware combination from an idle state to a busy state, and acquiring a reference frequency pressure gear; the power management chip is used for sending a frequency voltage pre-configuration instruction to the power management chip; the power management chip is used for receiving and responding to the frequency voltage pre-configuration instruction sent by the baseband chip, and adjusting the working frequency voltage gear of the target hardware combination from the idle state frequency voltage gear to the reference frequency voltage gear; the target hardware combination is used for processing the data task of the target service type. In this way, in the time of calculating the gear adapting to the load requirement of the task by the baseband chip, the influence of waiting frequency voltage calculation and voting on the service time sequence is effectively reduced by pre-configuring the gear for the target hardware combination.

title_en: Portable WIFI signal detection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic components, in particular to a portable WIFI signal detection device, which comprises a box body, wherein the box body is provided with: the box body base is arranged at the bottom of the box body; the bearing base disc is arranged in an inner cavity of the box body and loaded on the box body base, a loading frame is arranged on the box body base, an adjusting assembly is arranged between an installation surface of the bearing base disc and the loading frame, and the adjusting assembly is used for adjusting an adjusting inclination angle of the bearing base disc; the turnover frame is arranged on the side edge of the box body base and can be rotatably installed; the box covering frame is designed to be of a four-side frame type structure; the cover box closing frame, the box body base and the turnover frame are combined in an interference fit mode and can be installed on the top of the turnover frame in a turnover mode. The invention is convenient for operators to carry and transfer, and has comprehensive detection function so as to be convenient for matching with a production line production system.

title_en: Optical switching device based on non-trusted high-speed space optical communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical switching device based on non-trusted high-speed space optical communication, which comprises three parts, namely transmitting, switching and receiving. The transmitting part comprises a laser, a first beam splitter, a data signal, a first modulator, a second modulator, a control signal, a first beam combiner, a first optical amplifier and a first optical antenna, and the exchanging part comprises a second optical antenna, a second optical amplifier, a second beam splitter, a first optical delay device, a third optical amplifier, an optical coupler, a second optical delay device, a first photoelectric detector, a second beam combiner, a first processor, an optical exchanger and an optical antenna array. According to the invention, the control signal is analyzed, the data signal is delayed and forwarded in an all-optical manner, so that the signal exchange efficiency is improved, excessive processing complexity is not caused to the processor, the power consumption of the device for high-speed signal processing is greatly reduced, and the application requirement of satellites for low power consumption is met.

title_en: Microwave transmission mechanism with radio frequency coaxial load
abstract_en: The invention provides a microwave transmission mechanism with a radio frequency coaxial load, which comprises a radio frequency input end, a plurality of radio frequency output ends, a plurality of load connectors and a plurality of reed assemblies, wherein the lower end of a first push rod of each reed assembly is fixedly connected with a first microwave reed, the upper end of the first push rod extends to a cavity of a shell, a first spring is sleeved on the first push rod, the lower end of a second push rod is fixedly connected with a second microwave reed, the upper end of the second push rod extends to the cavity of the shell, the second spring is sleeved on the second push rod, a microstrip section of each load coaxial connector is fixedly welded with a load inner conductor, a load insulator is sleeved on the outer side of the load inner conductor, the load inner conductor is fixed in a load outer conductor through the load insulator, and a central inner conductor of the radio frequency input end, the central inner conductor of the radio frequency output end and the inner conductor of the load connector extend into a microwave cavity of a base. The coaxial switch solves the problems of signal leakage, mutual interference and radio frequency source damage of a hollow port in the using process of the coaxial switch with high frequency and multiple channels.

title_en: Multi-mode navigation antenna
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode navigation antenna, which relates to the field of antennas, and comprises: multilayer from bottom to top: the antenna comprises a feed network, a grounding patch, a third radiation patch, a second radiation patch and a first radiation patch, wherein a dielectric substrate is arranged between each two layers; the first radiation patch is fed based on two feed metalized through holes, the two feed metalized through holes penetrate through the feed network, the second radiation patch is fed based on four feed metalized through holes, the four feed metalized through holes penetrate through the feed network, the third radiation patch is annular, the third radiation patch and the second radiation patch share the four feed metalized through holes, and the feed mode is electromagnetic coupling feed. The multimode space-conducting wire has the advantages of small volume, light weight, low profile, easy conformation with a carrier, easy integrated manufacture with a radio frequency circuit, capability of obtaining a unidirectional wide-lobe directional diagram, and maximum radiation direction in the normal direction of a plane. Provides a better design direction for further multi-mode of the microstrip antenna.

title_en: Antenna device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an antenna device and electronic equipment, wherein the antenna device comprises: the antenna comprises a first radio frequency transceiver, a second radio frequency transceiver, a first radio frequency front end, a second radio frequency front end, a third radio frequency front end, a combiner, a first antenna and a second antenna; the first radio frequency transceiver is respectively connected with the first radio frequency front end and the second radio frequency front end, the first radio frequency front end and the second radio frequency front end are connected with the first antenna through the combiner, and the second radio frequency transceiver is connected with the second antenna through the third radio frequency front end; the first radio frequency transceiver is configured to independently operate in a first Wi-Fi frequency band or a second Wi-Fi frequency band, the second radio frequency transceiver is configured to independently operate in the second Wi-Fi frequency band or a third Wi-Fi frequency band, the first radio frequency front end operates in the first Wi-Fi frequency band, the second radio frequency front end operates in the second Wi-Fi frequency band, and the third radio frequency front end independently operates in the second Wi-Fi frequency band or the third Wi-Fi frequency band.

title_en: Ground and non-ground communication method and device
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates in part to non-terrestrial communication systems and, in some embodiments, to the integration of terrestrial and non-terrestrial communication systems. Non-terrestrial communication systems can provide more flexible communication systems with extended wireless coverage and enhanced quality of service compared to conventional communication systems.

title_en: Brillouin distributed sensing method and system based on filter bank multi-carrier technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to a Brillouin distributed sensing method and a system based on a filter bank multi-carrier technology, wherein the method comprises the following steps: generating a pseudo-random signal by a signal generator, and modulating the pseudo-random signal to obtain modulated data D; arranging the modulation data D according to a preset rule to obtain a frequency domain matrix; presetting filter bank multi-carrier technical parameters according to actual requirements; obtaining a filter bank multi-carrier time domain signal according to the filter bank multi-carrier technical parameter and the frequency domain matrix; modulating the time domain signal to an optical carrier of the Brillouin time domain analysis optical fiber sensing system according to the filter bank multi-carrier technical parameters to realize the measurement of external information; the invention can only process the modulation signal under the condition of not changing the system structure, thereby improving the simplicity and the accuracy of the system.

title_en: BOSA calibration parameter emergency recovery method
abstract_en: The BOSA calibration parameter emergency recovery method provided by the invention has the advantages that the BOSA calibration parameter is distributed and arranged in four different devices, when the BOSA parameter is lost or a chaotic fault occurs due to software faults, the BOSA calibration parameter stored before is read out according to a preset sequence for repair work, and finally, the faults related to the BOSA device in the ONU are repaired; according to the method, the probability of repairing the BOSA parameters when the BOSA parameters are lost or confused due to software faults is improved by selecting the parameter backup device and setting the calling sequence.

title_en: Intelligent campus classroom roll call system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic information and information, in particular to an intelligent campus classroom roll call system which comprises a campus educational administration platform database for storing basic information of students, a processor for processing data information, a voice broadcast module for roll call broadcast, a wireless communication module for communication between the campus educational administration platform database and the processor, a sound acquisition module for acquiring answers of the students and a control module for operation. The invention can help the teacher to know the student conveniently, effectively solves the problem that the teacher does not know the word and knows the student easily when the teacher roll the name personally, ensures the accuracy and the effectiveness of roll, effectively restricts the idea of the student escaping from the class, reduces the rate of escaping from the class, can summarize the long-term attendance rate of the student, and can be used as a reference for the evaluation of the student.

title_en: Broadband and high-power-capacity patch antenna based on capacitive coupling feed
abstract_en: The invention discloses a broadband and high-power capacity patch antenna based on capacitive coupling feed, which belongs to the technical field of high-power microwaves and antennas, wherein a circular capacitor patch is printed on the upper surface of a first dielectric substrate, a rectangular radiation patch is printed on the upper surface of a second dielectric substrate, a parasitic patch is printed on the upper surface of a third dielectric substrate, and the three dielectric substrates are stacked from top to bottom; the radio frequency coaxial connector comprises a probe, a medium and a metal shell which are coaxially arranged from inside to outside in sequence, the metal shell and the medium are embedded into the grounding plate, the probe penetrates through the first medium substrate, the second medium substrate and the third medium substrate, the probe is connected with the circular capacitor patch, and a circle of coaxial-like metal columns are uniformly arranged in the third medium substrate around the radio frequency coaxial connector probe; the technical problem that the existing patch is difficult to be applied to a high-power microwave system as a high-power microwave antenna radiation source due to narrow bandwidth and low power capacity is solved.

title_en: Household help seeking device and method
abstract_en: A family help-seeking device and method, its apparatus includes monitoring device and execution help-seeking device, the monitoring device includes sensor module, switch module, encoder module, launcher module; the help-seeking execution device comprises a receiver module, a timer unit circuit, a transmitter unit circuit and a help-seeking device; the output end of the sensor assembly is connected with the input end of the switch module, the output end of the switch module is connected with the input end of the encoder module, and the output end of the encoder module is connected with the input end of the emitter module. The invention aims to provide a help-seeking alarm mode which is simple, convenient, rapid, reliable and accurate to operate, and can send out a help-seeking signal in time when the empty nest old man is in a sudden distress.

title_en: Power distribution station intelligent auxiliary system platform built based on IEC61850 standard
abstract_en: A power distribution station intelligent auxiliary system platform built based on IEC61850 specification belongs to the monitoring field. The method comprises the steps of establishing a power distribution station room auxiliary monitoring platform, collecting parameters such as temperature, humidity and harmful gas of the power distribution station room for processing, realizing intelligent control of relevant equipment by controlling linkage of a plurality of independent subsystems, realizing linkage of an air conditioner and temperature and humidity monitoring equipment by adopting a big data analysis and learning algorithm, and controlling technical indexes such as temperature, humidity and harmful gas in the power distribution station room within a standard range; the method comprises the steps of uniformly establishing a model from non-IEC 61850 equipment information to IEC61850 equipment information for each subsystem equipment; and the centralized management and monitoring of the non-IEC 61850 equipment in the daily operation process are realized by using a uniform transmission protocol and an interface. The intelligent monitoring system is applied to the environment management scene of the power distribution station, and the quality and the efficiency of the environment monitoring work of the power distribution station are greatly optimized.

title_en: Wireless remote control device of beam column type steel guardrail opening structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wireless remote control device of beam column type steel guardrail opening structure, includes opening crossbeam, electrical system, rotation motor, control module, shaped steel stand, concatenation crossbeam, every beam column type steel guardrail opening structure all sets up two opening crossbeams, overlap joint each other through connecting the channel-section steel between the opening crossbeam, the opening crossbeam is connected with the concatenation crossbeam through rotating the motor, and the rotation motor includes stator and rotor, and the stator passes through connecting bolt anchor in the opening crossbeam, and the concatenation crossbeam, opening crossbeam are passed respectively to the rotor, electrical system receives the radio wave of wireless remote controller transmission to convert into instruction transmission and give control module, rotate by control module control rotation motor again, rotate the rotation of motor and drive the opening crossbeam and realize vertical or horizontal direction's motion around the rotor. Through reasonable design, beam column type steel guardrail opening structure satisfies bridge guardrail's safety protection demand, and vertical opening design does not influence the normal operation of vehicle, and maintainer can open and close remotely.

title_en: Random polarization converter based on time coding transmission type dual-polarization super-structure surface
abstract_en: The invention relates to an arbitrary polarization converter based on a time coding transmission type dual-polarization super-structure surface, which belongs to the field of artificial electromagnetic super-structure materials, n multiplied by n super-structure surface units are arrayed in a two-dimensional plane, each super-structure surface unit is integrated with four switch diodes, wherein two switch diodes in the same polarization direction are connected with each other by a metal patch, two switch diodes in the same polarization direction are controlled by the same external control circuit, the switch diodes in different polarizations are independently controlled by different external control circuits, and the equivalent transmission coefficient of the super-structure surface can be effectively regulated and controlled by independently and periodically switching bias voltages on the switch diodes, so that an arbitrary polarization incident wave is converted into an arbitrary polarization emergent wave at fundamental wave harmonic frequency point.

title_en: Optical coupler, communication method and communication system
abstract_en: The application discloses an optical coupler, a communication method and a communication system, and belongs to the field of communication. The communication system includes: the device comprises N transmitters, M receivers and an optical coupler, wherein N and M are positive integers larger than 1. Each of the N transmitters is configured to send a path of first optical signal to the optical coupler. The optical coupler is used for coupling N paths of first optical signals sent by the N transmitters into one path of second optical signal and broadcasting and sending the second optical signal to the M receivers. Each of the M receivers is configured to receive the second optical signal transmitted by the optical coupler. And demodulates the second optical signal. The communication time delay in the communication system can be reduced.

title_en: Radio frequency signal acquisition and playback system and method capable of being configured as unattended operation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a radio frequency signal acquisition playback system and method that can be configured to unmanned on duty, including gathering playback module, gather playback module and include mutual transceiver channel submodule S1 and digital signal processing submodule S2, digital signal processing submodule S2 is connected in host computer M2, digital signal processing submodule S2 includes PS processing system and PL programmable logic, PS processing system is used for receiving the host computer instruction and controlling transceiver channel submodule S1 and PL programmable logic, PL programmable logic is used for controlling to enable or disable unmanned on duty function, send the data 2 of transceiver channel submodule S1 to host computer M2 selectively or unselectably under unmanned on duty function enabling or disabling state. The system can be configured into an unattended collection working mode, so that the labor cost is reduced, useless data can be automatically filtered, and the use efficiency of the magnetic disk is improved.

title_en: Clamping arm rotary opening clamping device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wireless charging mobile phone supports, in particular to a clamping arm rotating and opening clamping device, which adopts the technical scheme that: the clamping device comprises an upper shell, a lower shell and a bracket device, wherein the upper shell is arranged at the top of the lower shell, a driving device is arranged on the inner wall of the lower shell, and the driving device is connected with the clamping device; the driving device comprises a motor, the motor is fixedly installed at the bottom of the inner wall of the lower shell, a motor gland is fixedly installed on the inner wall of the lower shell, the motor gland covers the top of the motor, a gear is fixedly installed on the motor gland in a manner that the output end of the motor extends out of the motor gland, and one end of the gear is connected with a gear set A, so that the driving device has the beneficial effects that: the clamping arm can be rotated to open and stretch, so that the mobile phone is clamped, the bracket can be stretched and folded, the mobile phones of different types and other devices can be compatible to use, and the user experience is greatly improved.

title_en: Frequency hopping within virtual bandwidth portions
abstract_en: Various aspects of the present disclosure generally relate to frequency hopping within virtual BWPs. In some aspects, a UE may determine a virtual bandwidth portion (BWP) in which to frequency hop a frequency offset from a first narrow BWP to a second narrow BWP. The virtual BWP may have the same subcarrier spacing as the first narrow BWP and a larger bandwidth than the first narrow BWP. The UE may perform communication based at least in part on frequency hopping within the virtual BWP. Numerous other aspects are provided.

title_en: Water heater starting control method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent household appliances, and particularly relates to a water heater starting control method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The invention aims to solve the problem of low accuracy of starting control of the existing water heater. According to the method, the access information is obtained, and the access information characterizes the operation event triggered when the target user accesses the NAS server; determining the water use time according to the access information; based on the water consumption time, the intelligent water heater is controlled to heat. Because the operation event triggered when the user accesses the NAS server is related to the daily work and rest of the user, the water consumption time of the user can be estimated and determined according to the access information representing the operation event triggered when the target user accesses the NAS server, and then the water heater is controlled to heat, so that the starting heating time of the water heater is matched with the daily work and rest of the user, the accuracy of the starting control of the water heater is improved, the energy consumption of the water heater is reduced, and the water consumption experience of the user is improved.

title_en: Intelligent panel and space electromagnetic wave regulation and control system
abstract_en: The application discloses intelligence panel and space electromagnetic wave regulation and control system. This intelligent panel includes: a class M electromagnetic unit, wherein M is greater than or equal to 2; the types of the M types of electromagnetic units are distinguished by at least one of the geometric shapes of the electromagnetic units, the regulation and control modes of the electromagnetic units and the types of electromagnetic parameters regulated and controlled by the electromagnetic units. The intelligent panel has the advantages that the regulation and control capability of incident electromagnetic waves is greatly improved, and further the regulation and control capability of the space electromagnetic environment is greatly improved.

title_en: Miniaturized gap filter antenna based on folded substrate integrated waveguide
abstract_en: The invention relates to a miniaturized slot filter antenna based on a folded substrate integrated waveguide, which is characterized in that a ground plate is arranged on the lower surface of a lower-layer dielectric slab, a strip line connected with a middle-layer metal layer and a microstrip line connected with the strip line are arranged on the upper surface of the lower-layer dielectric slab, an upper-layer dielectric slab is placed above the lower-layer dielectric slab and mutually attached, a top-layer metal layer covers the upper surface of the upper-layer dielectric slab, a groove is formed in the top-layer metal layer, metalized through holes with the same size and period are arranged on the lower-layer dielectric slab and the upper-layer dielectric slab, and the metalized through holes are connected with the top-layer metal layer, the upper-layer dielectric slab, the middle-layer metal layer and the lower-layer dielectric slab to form a metal electric wall; the long side of one side of the middle metal layer is pressed by the metallized through hole, and a gap is reserved between the long side of the other side of the middle metal layer and the metal electric wall. The filtering antenna of the invention provides a solution for the miniaturization and the improvement of the comprehensive performance of a future wireless communication system.

title_en: Low-power-consumption complete machine linkage control system and method for satellite mobile communication portable station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-power consumption complete machine linkage control system and a method of a satellite mobile communication portable station, wherein the system comprises a main control board, a baseband processing unit, a power amplifier and an antenna unit, and the method comprises the following steps: the master control board carries out data interaction with the baseband processing unit through the multiplexing port, the master control board is provided with a linkage control unit, and the linkage control unit establishes a sleep awakening strategy for sleep awakening control between the master control board and the baseband processing unit; the power amplifier and antenna unit comprises an antenna front end consisting of a power amplifier unit, a low-noise amplifier unit and an antenna, and a wire harness is adopted between the antenna front end and the main control board for transmitting radio frequency signals and control signals and supplying power to a power supply; the base band processing unit is additionally provided with a receiving and sending control enabling signal, the power amplifier is additionally provided with a switch enabling control signal, a single chip microcomputer is respectively arranged on the main control board side and the antenna side, and the antenna switch control work is carried out according to the duty ratio according to the working state of the base band processing unit.

title_en: Device and method for measuring chip-level optical transmission performance parameters
abstract_en: The application relates to a device and a method for measuring chip-level optical transmission performance parameters, wherein the device comprises: the power supply module is used for providing working voltage for the modulator and the heater on the chip to be tested; the signal generator is connected with the modulator and is used for applying a fluctuation signal with a preset frequency to the modulator; the adjusting module is used for adjusting the power of the heater and the driving current of the light source of the chip to be tested at a preset environment temperature; and the measuring module is used for receiving the optical signal output after modulation by the modulator and determining the extinction ratio of the chip to be tested under different heater powers and the optical modulation amplitude of the chip to be tested under different light source driving currents based on the optical signal. The high-speed performance of the device can be tested at the chip level, the measurement cost is low, the efficiency is high, and qualified chips can be screened in the early stage of production, so that the loss of the later-stage packaging process is reduced, and the yield of the optical module can be improved.

title_en: Wavelength monitoring method and system of wavelength division multiplexer
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of integrated optical chips, in particular to a wavelength monitoring method and a wavelength monitoring system of a wavelength division multiplexer, and specifically, the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an input light source split from an input light source of the wavelength division multiplexer through a first monitoring mach zehnder interferometer; the first monitoring Mach Zehnder interferometer and the wavelength division multiplexer have the maximum output optical power under the preset working wavelength; the working wavelength is determined based on the phase difference corresponding to the phase shift arm and the waveguide temperature of the waveguide; adjusting the temperature of a first waveguide corresponding to the first monitoring mach zehnder interferometer, and detecting the output optical power corresponding to an output light splitting source of the first monitoring mach zehnder interferometer; and determining a target wavelength difference corresponding to the maximum monitored output optical power. The method can comprehensively acquire the offset information of the input wavelength and the working wavelength, realize the complete alignment of the input wavelength and the working wavelength, and reduce the bandwidth requirement of the device on the wavelength division multiplexer.

title_en: Audio fault time positioning method, audio data storage method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an audio fault time positioning method, an audio data storage method and electronic equipment. The audio fault time positioning method comprises the following steps: the first electronic device stores the audio data in a PCM file during playing the audio data, the attribute values of the PCM file including a file creation time. The second electronic device parses the PCM file stored in the first electronic device, determines a relative time at which the first audio fault occurs in the PCM file, and determines an absolute time at which the first audio fault occurs according to the relative time and the file creation time. The first electronic device may be a cell phone and the second electronic device may be a personal computer. Like this, maintenance personal or research and development personnel can obtain the first electronic equipment log of corresponding time point according to the concrete time point that audio fault took place, and then can combine this log to carry out quick effective location to audio fault for audio fault's solution speed promotes user experience.

title_en: Transmitting terminal layout method based on wavelet analysis channel gain
abstract_en: A transmitting terminal layout method based on wavelet analysis channel gain is characterized in that PAM, PWM, PPM and OOK signals X are generated based on pulse amplitude modulation, pulse width modulation, pulse position modulation and traditional binary digital keying  i  (i ═ 1,2,3, 4); then based on LOS (line of sight) Lambert radiation model, a single LED light source is regarded as a Lambert light source, and indoor VLC (Visible) is obtained under the conditions of given room size, receiving plane height h and initial LED array distributionLight Communication) system, and determining a channel gain matrix H of an LOS channel by combining parameters such as an emitting angle theta of an LED array and an incident angle psi of receiving plane Light to represent the characteristics of an indoor visible Light Communication channel; the output signal is obtained by performing two-dimensional convolution on the input signal and the channel gain matrix H and superposing noise n under different AWGN channel signal-to-noise ratios The light intensity can meet the requirement of indoor illumination, and when the Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) is larger than 15dB, the modulation recognition accuracy of the receiving end can reach 90%.

title_en: Low-orbit mobile communication satellite tracking device and tracking method
abstract_en: The application discloses a low-orbit mobile communication satellite tracking device and a tracking method, wherein the tracking device comprises a tracking main path, a tracking branch path, a tracking signal processing unit, an antenna control unit and an antenna driving unit; the tracking main path forms a main feed source signal; the tracking branches form a plurality of branch radio frequency signals; the tracking signal processing unit is used for calculating and receiving the primary feed source signal and the plurality of branch radio frequency signals to obtain primary feed source amplitude signals and a plurality of branch radio frequency amplitude signals; the antenna control unit calculates the deviation between the received primary feed source amplitude signal and the radio frequency amplitude signals of the multiple branches, and determines driving parameters according to the deviation; and the antenna driving unit drives the antenna to move according to the driving parameters. According to the application, the deviation of the main feed source and the branch radio frequency amplitude signals is obtained by obtaining the branch radio frequency amplitude signals of a plurality of directions relative to the antenna main shaft, so that the antenna is driven to move, the effective tracking of the low-orbit mobile communication satellite is realized, and the problem of tracking the low-orbit mobile communication satellite by the small-caliber antenna is solved.

title_en: Image processing and fusion computing device based on ground unmanned platform
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical fields of image processing, edge computing and unmanned, and provides an image processing and fusion computing device based on a ground unmanned platform, which aims to realize the image processing and fusion processing processes of the ground unmanned platform with low delay, quick response and high agility and simultaneously consider the tasks of all-weather and localized processing of the platform, and comprises the following steps: the device comprises a video access conversion unit, an FPGA preprocessing calculation unit, a video output conversion unit and an ARM core calculation unit. The device fully exerts the hardware architecture characteristics of two computing units, namely the FPGA and the ARM, and utilizes parallel computing resources and assembly line computing resources matched with software functions, so that the video acquisition and processing delay time is greatly reduced under the cooperation of the input and the output of the video conversion unit, the use requirements of high-definition and low-power consumption scenes are met, and better image processing and fusion computing effects can be achieved.

title_en: Method and system for fingerprint verification and enrollment using secure storage of templates
abstract_en: A method (600) for fingerprint verification of a user is proposed. The method (600) comprises: receiving (602) a sample (108) of a fingerprint from the user; extracting (604) keypoints (204) from the sample (108); extracting (606) descriptors (202) from the sample (108), wherein the descriptors (202) are based on information collected from regions surrounding the keypoints (204); retrieving (608) the registered descriptors (302); matching the descriptors (202) with the registered descriptors (302), thereby forming a list of matching descriptor pairs (304); transferring (610) the list (304) of matching descriptor pairs and the keypoints (204) from the first module (104) to the second module (106); retrieving (614) registered keypoints (308); matching (616) the keypoints (204) and the registered keypoints (308) in combination with the list of matching descriptor pairs (304); and in case of a match (618), signaling (620) a positive verification result using the second data communication device (122), otherwise signaling (622) a negative verification result using the second data communication device (122).

title_en: UHF RFID label checking frequency hopping method suitable for closed metal box
abstract_en: The invention provides a UHF RFID label checking frequency hopping method suitable for a closed metal box body, which comprises the following steps: dividing the whole working frequency band into a plurality of sub-frequency bands according to the number of the antennas and the required maximum inventory time; setting the arrangement sequence of the central frequency points in the sub-frequency bands; setting the arrangement sequence of the sub-bands of each antenna during working, wherein when a reader-writer starts checking, a first round of polling is started for all the participating antennas according to a certain sequence, when the selected antennas select working frequency points, one sub-band should be selected firstly, and then the frequency points are selected according to the arrangement sequence of the frequency points in the sub-bands to work; in the first round of polling, the first polled antenna selects the median subband, the second antenna selects the next highest numbered subband, the third antenna selects the next lowest numbered subband, and the next polled antenna repeats the subband selection sequence in turn until all antennas are polled.

title_en: Systems and methods for presenting channel quality indication, CQI, data associated with multimode antennas
abstract_en: A method is provided for presenting data indicative of a channel quality indication, CQI, associated with a multimode antenna of a first device. The method includes acquiring data indicating a CQI when a multimode antenna is configured in each of a plurality of antenna modes. Each of the plurality of antenna patterns has a different radiation pattern. The method includes determining one of the plurality of antenna modes as a selected antenna mode of the multimode antenna based at least in part on the data indicative of the CQI. The method includes providing, to a second device separate from the first device, data indicative of CQI associated with one or more of the plurality of antenna modes.

title_en: Real-time positioning system for remote tunnel constructors
abstract_en: The scheme belongs to the field of intelligent tunnel construction, and particularly relates to a real-time positioning system for remote tunnel constructors. In order to achieve the above purpose, the present solution provides a real-time positioning system for remote tunnel constructors, including an led lamp set up inside a tunnel, further including: a microprocessor: the micro processor is used for generating LED lamp position id information, encoding the LED lamp position id information and sending out LED lamp position id signals by controlling the frequency of the LED lamp; the receiving terminal: for receiving led lamp position id signals; the micro chip is used for sending out micro chip id information after receiving the led lamp id signal by the receiving terminal, the micro chip codes the micro chip id information and transmits out the micro chip id signal through the switching frequency of the active light source; an optical receiving module: the light receiving module is used for identifying the microchip id signal through the switching frequency of the active light source and generating personnel position information. The quick positioning of constructors is realized.

title_en: Time drift correction method for self-contained underwater sound recorder by using AIS information of ship
abstract_en: A time drift correction method of a self-contained underwater sound recorder by utilizing AIS information of a ship relates to the technical field of marine acoustic observation. The method comprises the following steps: 1) Encrypting the ship information; 2) Constructing a frequency shift curve cluster; 3) High resolution time-frequency processing; 4) Extracting frequency shift amplitude; 5) Extracting time drift; 6) And correcting time drift. Based on ship information of a ship Automatic Identification System (AIS), a Doppler frequency shift curve is constructed according to Doppler frequency shift characteristics of a moving target, and time drift amount is obtained by performing time-frequency analysis and calculation on acoustic data of a self-contained acoustic recorder, so that the time drift of the self-contained acoustic recorder is corrected. The method can be used for synchronous processing of asynchronous (self-contained) underwater acoustic observation systems in local areas and even global sea areas, has good applicability and strong stability, and saves the cost required by beacons or communication equipment.

title_en: Optical transmission device, optical module, and network device
abstract_en: The application discloses an optical transmission device, an optical module and network equipment. The optical transmission device includes: an optical waveguide; the optical waveguide comprises a first core layer and a second core layer, the core diameter of the first core layer is fixed, the second core layer comprises a first end and a second end, the first end is connected with one end of the first core layer, the core diameter of the first end is the same as that of the first core layer, and the core diameter of the second core layer is gradually increased from the first end to the second end; the other end of the first core layer is close to a single-mode optical transmission module, the second end of the second core layer is close to a multimode optical fiber, and the optical waveguide is used for coupling an optical signal output by the single-mode optical transmission module to the multimode optical fiber. According to the optical transmission device, the optical transmission device is arranged between the single-mode optical transmission module and the multimode optical fiber, so that the transmission rate of optical signals in the multimode optical fiber can be improved.

title_en: Radio frequency test seat matching device, radio frequency signal transceiver and radio frequency equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a radio frequency test socket matching device, a radio frequency signal transceiver and radio frequency equipment. The radio frequency test socket matching device comprises: the first plate surface of the first dielectric substrate is used for arranging a radio frequency test seat and a transmission line; the first grounding metal layer is arranged on the second plate surface of the first dielectric substrate, and the second plate surface is opposite to the first plate surface; the first grounding metal layer is partially provided with a first hollowed area, and the orthographic projection of the first hollowed area on the first board surface covers the orthographic projection of the signal pad of the radio frequency test seat on the first board surface and covers the orthographic projection of the test seat connecting end part of the transmission line on the first board surface. This application can reduce the equivalent capacitance and the equivalent series capacitance of signal pad through hollowing out one deck ground metal layer, need not to punch to the dielectric substrate, also need not to handle multilayer signal layer and can realize the broadband and match and reduce the matching loss, possesses and realizes simple advantage.

title_en: Work switching method and system for binocular DVP camera module
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of module switching, and particularly relates to a work switching method and a work switching system of a binocular DVP camera module, wherein the work switching method of the binocular DVP camera module comprises the following steps: and the circuit processor controls the high and low level of the PWDN _ IN to carry out work switching on the first path of photosensitive chip and the second path of photosensitive chip. According to the method and the device, the circuit processor controls the high-low level of the PWDN _ IN to switch the work of the first path of photosensitive chip and the second path of photosensitive chip, the control circuit is simple, development and smt operation are easy, the cost is low, and multi-path control is stable and effective. Meanwhile, the work switching method of the binocular DVP camera module is small in heating value, high in switching efficiency and stable in work.

title_en: Integrated antenna and Internet of things equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an integrated antenna and Internet of things equipment, wherein the integrated antenna comprises a substrate, a floor, a first radiation unit, a second radiation unit and a third radiation unit, wherein the first radiation unit, the second radiation unit and the third radiation unit are integrated on the substrate and are independent from each other; first radiating element is the T type setting, including first minor matters, second minor matters and third minor matters, first minor matters with the second minor matters is linear arrangement, the third minor matters with first minor matters and second minor matters set up perpendicularly to form the space that is located third minor matters both sides, the symmetric space includes first space and second space, second radiating element and third radiating element set up respectively in first space and second space to be connected with the floor, first radiating element, second radiating element and third radiating element electric connection respectively to external equipment's mainboard.

title_en: Multi-beam anti-interference phased array antenna
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-beam anti-interference phased array antenna, which belongs to the technical field of communication antennas and comprises an antenna array surface, a radio frequency assembly unit, a thermal control unit and an anti-interference digital processing unit which are sequentially connected from top to bottom, wherein the anti-interference digital processing unit and a control unit are arranged on the same layer, and a frequency conversion unit and a power supply module are respectively arranged on two sides of the radio frequency assembly unit; the radio frequency component unit is connected with the anti-interference digital processing unit; the control unit is in communication connection with the radio frequency assembly unit; the control unit is communicated with the anti-interference digital processing unit, switching between an anti-interference mode and a non-anti-interference mode is achieved, and the working state of the anti-interference digital processing unit is monitored. The linear polarization signal is synthesized by the two circularly polarized signals, so that stable signal gain in scanning within the range of 360 degrees off-axis angle +/-60 degrees of azimuth can be guaranteed, gain loss can be greatly reduced, and high-precision and high-stability polarization tracking is realized.

title_en: Radio frequency front-end device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses radio frequency front-end device and electronic equipment, radio frequency front-end device have integrateed LBPA, MB PA, HB PA, wave filter, LNA and switch, have realized the support to low and medium high frequency channel (LMHband) simultaneously to support the double function of M + H, practiced thrift the area occupied to the PCB board better, reduced electronic equipment's cost.

title_en: Waveguide noise source with low-reflection absorption load mounting structure
abstract_en: The present invention provides a waveguide noise source with a low reflection absorption load mounting structure. The noise source comprises a rectangular waveguide, a waveguide flange, a fine tuning flange, a blind flange and an absorption load; the waveguide flange is fixedly connected to the input end of the rectangular waveguide; the fine tuning flange is connected with the waveguide flange through a fastener; the blind flange is connected with the fine adjustment flange through a fastener; the fine tuning flange is provided with a rectangular through hole; the position of the rectangular through hole corresponds to the position of the inner cavity of the rectangular waveguide; one end of the absorption load is fixed in the rectangular through hole; the remainder of the absorbing load is placed inside the rectangular waveguide. The fine tuning flange fixes one end of the absorption load, and the absorption load can be in close contact with the inner wall of the rectangular waveguide by adjusting the relative position of the fine tuning flange and the waveguide flange, so that the installation reliability of the absorption load is improved, and the stably-output low-reflection-coefficient thermal noise can be obtained.

title_en: Transmission array and antenna based on all-metal huygens super surface
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission array based on an all-metal huygens super surface, which comprises a plurality of all-metal transmission units which are periodically arranged, wherein each all-metal transmission unit is of a huygens super surface structure comprising an upper metal patch and a lower metal patch, and an air layer is arranged between the upper metal patch and the lower metal patch; the upper and lower metal patches are provided with first closed metal conductor strips, the metal conductor strips are provided with gaps for separating the metal conductor strips, and the gaps are positioned at different positions on the upper and lower metal patches, so that the upper and lower layers generate surface currents in opposite directions and simultaneously generate Wheatstone resonance when electric and magnetic dipoles are formed on the surfaces of the upper and lower Wheatstone supercaps. The invention also discloses a transmission array antenna based on the all-metal huygens super surface, which comprises a feed source loudspeaker and a transmission array. The invention is based on double-layer all-metal integral manufacture, and solves the problem that the transmission efficiency is influenced by the loss introduced by a double-layer transmission array in the prior art.

title_en: Task planning and spectrum resource joint optimization method and system for multiple unmanned aerial vehicles
abstract_en: The invention discloses a task planning and spectrum resource joint optimization method for multiple unmanned aerial vehicles, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle communication and mainly comprises the following steps: under the shared spectrum environment, determining a reconnaissance task planning and spectrum resource joint optimization problem of a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles corresponding to a disaster area in the rescue operation according to relevant parameters of the disaster area; and decomposing the optimization problem into an unmanned aerial vehicle task planning and track control subproblem, an unmanned aerial vehicle subchannel allocation subproblem and an unmanned aerial vehicle transmitting power optimization subproblem by using a block coordinate descent method, and solving the unmanned aerial vehicle task planning and track control subproblem, the unmanned aerial vehicle subchannel allocation subproblem and the unmanned aerial vehicle transmitting power optimization subproblem by using an iterative optimization algorithm to obtain an optimal unmanned aerial vehicle subchannel allocation matrix, an optimal unmanned aerial vehicle flight track coordinate matrix and an optimal unmanned aerial vehicle transmitting power allocation matrix. The invention can realize higher unmanned aerial vehicle transmission rate and better robustness.

title_en: Electronic device
abstract_en: The application provides an electronic device, which comprises a circuit board, a frame, a contact protrusion and a conductive elastic sheet, wherein the frame comprises an inner surface facing the circuit board, and a gap is formed between the frame and the circuit board; the contact protrusion is connected to the inner surface, the contact protrusion being located within the gap; the conductive elastic sheet is fixed to the circuit board and located in the gap, one end, far away from the circuit board, of the conductive elastic sheet is abutted to the contact protrusion, and the contact form of the conductive elastic sheet and the contact protrusion comprises point-surface contact. The technical scheme of this application can make and have good electricity connection performance between circuit board and the frame all the time in long-term working process, and the operational reliability of complete machine is good.

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle data unloading method based on fairness perception and related equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle data unloading method based on fairness perception and related equipment. The system is applied to a data unloading system, and the data unloading system comprises a plurality of base stations, a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles and a plurality of user terminals, and any base station is selected from the plurality of base stations to serve as an initial base station; the method is performed by an initiating base station and comprises: constructing a data unloading model corresponding to the data unloading system according to the plurality of base stations, the plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles and the plurality of user terminals; in response to determining that any unmanned aerial vehicle arrives, acquiring data information of the arriving unmanned aerial vehicle; and performing optimization processing according to the data unloading model and the data information to obtain an optimal scheduling strategy, executing a data unloading task by the arrived unmanned aerial vehicle according to the received optimal scheduling strategy to obtain unloading data, and sending the unloading data to a termination base station selected according to the optimal scheduling strategy for storage. The service fairness is maximized while guaranteeing the data offloading efficiency.

title_en: Method and apparatus for transmitting or receiving signal based on spatial parameter in wireless communication system
abstract_en: A method and apparatus for transmitting or receiving a signal based on spatial parameters in a wireless communication system are disclosed. A method for performing downlink reception or uplink transmission by a terminal in a wireless communication system according to an embodiment of the present disclosure may include: transmitting information related to a beam switching time of a terminal to a base station; receiving Downlink Control Information (DCI) including information on downlink reception or uplink transmission from a base station; and applying one of a plurality of sets of spatial parameters to perform downlink reception or uplink transmission based on the beam switching time and a predetermined threshold, wherein at least one of the beam switching time and the predetermined threshold may be based on at least one of a subcarrier spacing, a location of a frequency, a capability of a terminal, and a Cyclic Prefix (CP) related configuration.

title_en: Wearable device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an electronic equipment technical field specifically provides a wearable equipment, includes: an antenna system comprising an annular radiator, the radiator comprising at least a portion of a bezel of the wearable device, the radiator electrically connected to a circuit board of the wearable device; the annular insulating support is connected with the inner wall of the radiating body; the screen assembly is connected with the upper end face of the support in an assembling mode. In the embodiment of the disclosure, the width of the radiation gap between the middle frame and the screen assembly is increased through the insulator support, when the ultra-high screen accounts for the assembly of the screen assembly, the performance requirement of the antenna can be still met, and the ultra-narrow black edge wearable equipment is favorably realized.

title_en: Full-duplex radio over fiber communication method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-duplex radio over fiber communication method. The invention realizes the multiplexing of the light source in the base station by utilizing the polarization multiplexing technology, avoids additional use of the light source and simplifies the base station equipment; the orthogonal polarization state of light is utilized to simultaneously inhibit radio frequency self-interference and noise interference in an optical domain through a simple structure at a base station, so that the further influence of the radio frequency self-interference and the noise interference in an optical link is avoided, and the dynamic range of the system is improved; by designing a modulation mode and a bias point of a radio frequency signal, single-sideband modulation of an optical carrier uplink/downlink signal is realized, and the influence of dispersion in the optical fiber transmission process can be overcome; and finally, full duplex communication based on the ROF is realized so as to improve the utilization rate of frequency spectrum resources. The invention also discloses a full-duplex radio over fiber communication system. Compared with the prior art, the invention can effectively solve the problems of radio frequency self-interference and noise interference, and realize full duplex communication based on the ROF so as to improve the utilization rate of frequency spectrum resources.

title_en: Channel estimation method and system combining Grassmann manifold in large-scale MIMO system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a channel estimation method and a channel estimation system combining Grassmann manifold in a large-scale MIMO system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, a receiving end receives a signal sent by a base station and obtains preliminary estimation channel information according to the received signal and a preferred scheme; s2, constructing a combined Hankel matrix according to the preliminary estimation channel information and the conjugate data thereof; s3, obtaining an azimuth arrival angle estimated value by utilizing the property of Grassmann manifold; and S4, recovering the channel state information by using the azimuth arrival angle estimation value. Compared with the traditional method, the method for estimating the channel by using the Grassmann manifold property can reduce the influence of noise under the condition of knowing a small amount of channel information, thereby realizing higher channel utilization rate and further improving the performance of a communication system.

title_en: Image information security management method based on state coding table
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of information security management, in particular to an image information security management method based on a state coding table, which comprises the following steps: replacing the first sequence of the plaintext pixel points according to the replacement sequence to obtain an index value of the plaintext pixel points; obtaining a symbol sequence and a transition sequence of the plaintext pixel points according to the positions of the index values of the plaintext pixel points in the state coding table, and further obtaining a ciphertext of the plaintext pixel points; and setting the gray value of the plaintext pixel points as the ciphertext to obtain a ciphertext image formed by the ciphertext pixel points. The invention combines the basic state value and the state coding table to encrypt the plaintext pixel points to obtain the ciphertext image of which the gray histogram is completely different from that of the plaintext image, so that the ciphertext image has stronger avalanche effect, simultaneously, the capability of the ciphertext image for resisting the attack of statistical analysis is improved, the image security in the operation of a computer network system is better ensured, and the information leakage and other problems are avoided.

title_en: Programmable customized broadband anti-interference automatic test system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a programmable customized broadband anti-interference automatic test system, which comprises interference source generating and loading software, wherein the interference source generating and loading software runs on a signal source, generates frequency point, bandwidth, time, output signal power and interference pattern of an interference signal according to customization of a user, generates digital baseband data after corresponding interference signal normalization by combining the sampling frequency and the number of sampling points of the signal source, converts the digital baseband data into an interference signal source file and stores the interference signal source file in a specified folder; during testing, the corresponding file is read according to the control instruction and is input into the signal source through a standardized interface provided by the signal source, so that the signal source can output the corresponding interference signal. The invention can generate various interference signal source files with different styles according to the test requirements of different communication equipment in advance, load the interference signal source files into a signal source according to the requirements to generate different interference signals, and realize the switching of configurations such as different interference scenes, interference intensity, interference frequency points and the like by loading different interference signal source files, thereby greatly reducing the test time.

title_en: IPD-based miniaturized high-out-of-band rejection band-pass filter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a miniaturized high-out-of-band rejection band-pass filter based on IPD (IPD), which comprises a substrate layer, a metal layer and a circuit structure formed on the metal layer, wherein the circuit structure of the band-pass filter comprises m on-chip transformer filters between an input port and an output port, n1 LC resonators positioned between the input port and the on-chip transformer filters and n2 LC resonators positioned between the output port and the on-chip transformer filters, and the passive band-pass filter with small size, low loss, good out-of-band rejection and low cost is realized by adopting a specific compact structure and a thin film passive integration technology. The topological structure comprising the transformer and the capacitor inductor to form the resonator can solve the problem of high in-band loss, increases high-order mode zero point to enhance out-of-band rejection, greatly reduces the chip size and is easy to integrate.

title_en: Channel simulator based on watts model and simulation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a channel simulator based on a watts model and a simulation method, a plurality of external field environments can be simulated by arranging an FPGA (field programmable gate array) main control circuit and a DSP (digital signal processor) digital processing module, meanwhile, a comparison test can be carried out in a controllable and repeatable environment by arranging an STM32 main control circuit, the research period is greatly shortened, manpower and material resources are saved, in addition, a differential amplification circuit is arranged, a strong inhibition effect on a common-mode signal can be realized, and a differential-mode signal can be amplified.

title_en: Substrate and antenna module
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a substrate and an antenna module, wherein the substrate with a through hole from a 1 st surface to a 2 nd surface which is a surface opposite to the 1 st surface is provided with: two 1 st through holes which are provided in parallel with a predetermined interval and transmit a high-frequency signal; and at least 3 reference potential 2 nd through holes arranged in parallel with the two 1 st through holes at a distance narrower than the predetermined distance, wherein among the 32 nd through holes, one 2 nd through hole is arranged in a region between the two 1 st through holes, and the other two 2 nd through holes are arranged in a region other than the region between the 1 st through holes, in such a manner that: one of the other two 2 nd through holes is provided in parallel with one of the two 1 st through holes, and the other of the other two 2 nd through holes is provided in parallel with the other of the two 1 st through holes.

title_en: Identity authentication method and device based on user keystroke dynamics
abstract_en: The invention discloses an identity authentication method and device based on user keystroke dynamics, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting key data generated when a user inputs a PIN code; after key data are preprocessed, determining time domain characteristics of the preprocessed key data, and performing fast Fourier transform on the preprocessed key data to determine frequency domain characteristics of the preprocessed key data; inputting the time domain features and the frequency domain features into a pre-trained feature extraction model, wherein the feature extraction model is a convolutional neural network to obtain first features; and inputting the time domain characteristic, the frequency domain characteristic and the first characteristic into a pre-trained classifier to obtain an identity authentication result. According to the invention, through locally acquiring the key data and authenticating the user identity in the intelligent terminal device, the privacy of the user data is effectively ensured, and various attack modes aiming at PIN code input behaviors on the mobile device, such as spot attack, shoulder surfing attack, video attack and the like, can be effectively resisted.

title_en: Multichannel radio frequency receiving assembly
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multichannel radio frequency receiving assembly, which belongs to the field of light frequency conversion in optical carrier microwave communication (ROF) and telecommunication communication, and comprises an assembly shell, wherein the assembly shell comprises a base, a printed circuit board is embedded at the upper end of the base, and a golden finger is fixedly connected at the left end of the printed circuit board.

title_en: Low-altitude-oriented 5G cell side lobe covering method and device and computing equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of wireless, and discloses a low-altitude 5G cell side lobe covering method, a device and computing equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: an 8-beam round-sending mechanism is adopted, wherein a side lobe beam covers low altitude; calculating downward inclination angles corresponding to different terminal heights according to the station spacing and the station height; obtaining the signal intensity of the side lobe wave beam at different terminal heights according to the down dip angle calculation and the down dip angle; and evaluating the low-altitude coverage capability of the side lobe beam according to the signal strength. Through the mode, the embodiment of the invention can meet the requirement of low-altitude coverage on the premise of not influencing the ground foundation coverage of the existing network.

title_en: Rapid method for monitoring water quality
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid method for monitoring water quality, which adopts online monitoring combining a water quality monitoring system and a microorganism sensor, wherein the water quality monitoring system comprises a power supply, a main controller, a water quality sensor interface, water quality processing equipment and an NB module, the NB module is connected with the main controller through the interface, the main controller is connected with the water quality sensor and the interface of the microorganism sensor, the main controller controls the water quality processing equipment, the NB module is also connected with an antenna, and the antenna is communicated with a mobile terminal. The invention aims at each distributed water quality monitoring point, removes errors of the acquired sensor data, improves the precision, and is matched with the microbial sensor to carry out on-line water quality monitoring so as to realize the real-time monitoring of the distributed water environment.

title_en: Mobile phone shell based on NFC intelligent ink screen
abstract_en: The invention discloses an NFC-based intelligent ink screen mobile phone shell, which comprises a mobile phone shell body, wherein the mobile phone shell body comprises a back plate, an upper end plate, a lower end plate and side plates; according to the invention, the NFC technology is adopted to combine the electricity utilization and information transmission lines, the structure is optimized, the NFC chip adopts the wireless transmission technology, the structure is light and thin, the occupied space is small, the problems of excessive thickness and weight increase caused by using the ink screen to the mobile phone shell are avoided, and the convenience in use and the aesthetic degree of the mobile phone shell are improved; through setting up NFC conductive component, the ink screen body can carry out the transmission of picture characters through NFC chip. The mobile phone shell is enabled to keep fresh and has stronger functionality at all times without influencing the consumption of a mobile phone battery due to the fact that the mobile phone is powered on for a long time and causing bad experience of the mobile phone to be scalded.

title_en: Household user identification method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method, a device and equipment for identifying family users, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring data information of each user in a user group, and combining a plurality of users in the user group according to account numbers and/or certificate numbers in user registration information to generate a plurality of family user groups and a plurality of non-family user groups; generating training data of the plurality of family user groups and the plurality of non-family user groups according to the user registration information and the call information in a preset time period, and training the family user identification model through the training data to obtain a trained family user identification model; and identifying whether the target user group in the user group is the family user group according to the trained family user identification model, determining the users who definitely belong to the same family user group through the certificate number or the account number, and mining the data characteristics of the family user group through the identification model, thereby improving the identification accuracy of the family user.

title_en: Apparatus and method for up-conversion of millimeter wave signals and detection of up-converted signals
abstract_en: At the optical frequency V by means of an input beam combiner  OPT  Up-converting the optical signal at linear polarization and at frequency V  GHz  The propagating input signals at these are combined for co-propagation through a nonlinear optical medium and at a frequency and V  SUM  ＝V  OPT  +V  GHz  Or a frequency difference V  DIFF  ＝V  OPT  ‑V  GHz  A plurality of up-converted optical signals are generated at one or both of (a) and (b). The orthogonally polarized up-converted optical signal and the up-converted optical signal are separated by a polarizer, and the up-converted optical signal is preferentially transmitted to the detection system by a filter. The input signal is modulated to encode the transmitted information and the modulation is passed on to the upconverted optical signal. The detection system includes one or more photodetectors that receive the upconverted optical signal and generate therefrom an electrical signal that is modulated to encode the transmitted information.

title_en: Packaging structure of 5G RFIC containing antenna
abstract_en: A packaging structure of a 5G RFIC comprising an antenna comprises a dielectric layer, at least one antenna is arranged on the outer surface of the dielectric layer; a groove is arranged below the dielectric layer; a conductive contact is arranged below the dielectric layer; the dielectric layer is also provided with at least one dielectric layer contact; a second conductive path is arranged in the dielectric layer, one end of the second conductive path is connected with the dielectric layer joint, and the other end of the second conductive path is exposed on the outer surface of the dielectric layer to be connected with the antenna; an RFIC die disposed within the recess of the dielectric layer, the RFIC die having at least one die contact; the chip contact is connected to the dielectric contact; a packaging glue layer located in the groove of the dielectric layer to package the RFIC chip in the groove; and a substrate under the dielectric layer, wherein the opening of the recess under the dielectric layer faces the substrate, and the RFIC chip faces the substrate, and at least one conductive ball is disposed above the substrate and connected to the conductive contact under the dielectric layer.

title_en: Low-earth-orbit satellite non-measurement report autonomous prediction switching method and equipment
