abstract_en: The application discloses a method and equipment for switching measurement report-free autonomous prediction of a low earth orbit satellite, wherein the method comprises the following steps: sending a switching prediction report to a target end through a source end, and carrying out resource allocation by the target end according to the switching prediction report; the target end sends the resource configuration information to the source end, and the source end sends a switching report to User Equipment (UE) according to the resource configuration information; and the UE completes channel switching according to the switching report.

title_en: Vehicle control method, mobile terminal and server
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a vehicle control technology, and in particular, to a vehicle control method, a mobile terminal, and a server. The method is applied to the mobile terminal and comprises the following steps: detecting whether a first event occurs in the use process of the vehicle, wherein the first event is a front event of returning of a user; and in the case of the first event, sending an instruction for uploading the position of the vehicle to the vehicle, so that the vehicle sends first position information to a server in response to the instruction.

title_en: Antenna support device suitable for monitoring aircraft frequency spectrum
abstract_en: The invention discloses an antenna supporting device suitable for monitoring an aircraft frequency spectrum, which solves the problem that one antenna in the prior art cannot realize a horizontal polarization mode and a vertical polarization mode, and comprises a connecting frame arranged at the top of the antenna, a rotary supporting mechanism arranged on one side of an aircraft bracket and a rotary driving mechanism arranged on the other side of the aircraft bracket; the rotary supporting mechanism and the rotary driving mechanism are arranged coaxially; the rotary supporting mechanism and the rotary driving mechanism are in one-to-one correspondence with the end part of the connecting frame, drive the antenna to rotate along the coaxial line of the rotary supporting mechanism and the rotary driving mechanism, and drive the antenna to rotate and switch in the horizontal direction and the vertical direction. Through the scheme, the antenna has the advantages of simple structure, flexible and reliable action and the like, and has high practical value and popularization value in the technical field of antennas.

title_en: Electric installation tool for grounding hanging ring
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric installation tool for a grounding hanging ring, which comprises a hanging ring installation fitting, an electric control box, a remote control motor and a remote controller, wherein the electric control box is arranged on the electric control box; the grounding hanging ring mounting hardware fitting is arranged on one side of the electric control box and used for mounting the grounding hanging ring and providing fastening torque force for a locking bolt in the grounding hanging ring; the remote control motor is arranged on the other side of the electric control box and is used for providing power for the grounding hanging ring mounting hardware fitting; the electric control box is used for connecting the grounding hanging ring mounting hardware fitting and a remote control motor and is respectively and electrically connected with the remote control motor and the remote controller in a wireless communication manner; the remote controller is used for remotely controlling the start and stop of the remote control motor. The invention has the advantages that: 1) The use of the insulating arm vehicle is reduced, and the manpower and the use cost of the vehicle are saved; 2) The direct contact of operators with the electrified body is avoided, the safety of the operators is ensured, the operation time is shortened, and the working efficiency is improved; 3) Is not limited by the operation site, and has wider application range.

title_en: Quartz fiber/polyimide composite material radome and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a quartz fiber/polyimide composite material antenna housing and a preparation method thereof; the preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing a mould pressing die; preparing a quartz/polyimide prepreg; cutting quartz/polyimide prepreg, loading the cut quartz/polyimide prepreg into a mould pressing die, carrying out mould pressing and forming by adopting a mould pressing net size forming process, and demoulding to obtain a prefabricated antenna housing; coating moisture-proof paint on an arc cover plate, a square frame and a heat insulation cushion block of a prefabricated antenna housing, and after coating, coating a conductive coating on the square frame to obtain a quartz/polyimide composite material antenna housing; the technical problems that an existing combined material antenna is complex in process, unreliable in bonding and low in strength due to the fact that the heat insulation pad is bonded with the antenna housing main body through a post bonding method are solved.

title_en: Portable mobile low-frequency ground-penetrating emergency communication device and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of communication, and particularly relates to a portable mobile low-frequency through-the-earth emergency communication device and a use method thereof, aiming at solving the problems that the traditional mobile through-the-earth communication device has short communication distance and the intensity of a fixed communication device has to be increased. The invention includes: the antenna comprises a shell 1, a self-aligning antenna group 2, a high-precision magnetic sensor 3, a main controller 4 and a storage battery 5, wherein the self-aligning antenna group 2 is configured to be an antenna group which is arranged in a first space 101 and can change the direction, the self-aligning antenna group 2 can point to a selected fixed communication base station at any time through the high-precision magnetic sensor 3 and the main controller 4, further long-distance communication is realized, the interval of the fixed communication base station can be further increased, and the layout cost is reduced. The self-aligning antenna group is arranged to be aligned with the selected fixed communication base station all the time, and the longer-distance communication of the mobile equipment can be realized by utilizing the different effective transmission distances of the mechanical magnetic antenna in different directions.

title_en: Intelligent beam alignment method based on deep convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wireless communication and deep learning, and particularly relates to an intelligent beam alignment method based on a deep convolutional network. The invention can definitely represent the space correlation among different wave beams by finding a method, selects a fixed wave beam subset in the wave beam space by utilizing the space correlation, inputs the signal-to-noise ratio of the wave beam subset collected off line into the deep convolution neural network for wave beam training by utilizing the strong characteristic extraction and representation capability of the deep convolution neural network, and further the deep convolution network can deduce the optimal wave beam. By using the method provided by the invention, the access point can accurately deduce the optimal beam communicated with the user equipment at the current moment only by detecting a small amount of fixed beams without detecting the whole beam space, thereby completing strict beam alignment, and improving the throughput performance while reducing the overhead of the system.

title_en: Satellite network networking method based on label routing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a satellite network networking method based on label routing, and belongs to the field of heaven and earth integrated network communication. In the invention, the satellite terminals mutually learn the mapping relation between the user addressing identification and the satellite label, the satellite label is packaged for the user data according to the target user addressing identification, and the user data is routed and forwarded on the satellite and among the satellites by adopting the satellite label, thereby reducing the protocol processing burden and the forwarding complexity on the satellite. The method simplifies the route forwarding function of the satellite in the satellite network, is convenient for the satellite to realize large-capacity exchange, and supports the multi-protocol unified bearing of large-scale satellite user networking and user data.

title_en: Robot control method, robot, program, and recording medium
abstract_en: The robot control system acquires request information indicating a request for the robot to collect peripheral information of the user while maintaining a relative distance to the position of the user within a predetermined distance, acquires position information indicating the position of the robot and confirmation information indicating that the robot is located near the user, and when it is determined that the user of the robot is located outside the residence area of the user along with the robot based on the map information, the position information and the confirmation information, transmits, to the robot, a command for changing the setting of the robot from the 1 st specification capable of collecting the peripheral information of the user located inside the residence area to the 2 nd specification capable of collecting the peripheral information of the user located outside the residence area in response to the request.

title_en: Method for single call homography in single frequency digital transit wireless communication system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for transferring single call homography of a wireless communication system in single frequency digital. The method for single call homography of the single frequency digital transit wireless communication system comprises the following steps of S1, call request initiation, S2, analysis, S3, request frame generation, S5, surrounding link machine request processing, S6, call response packet sending, S7, source link machine confirmation, S8, call mobile station confirmation, S9, call end, wherein the mobile station hung under the transit station generates corresponding analysis packets for the call request, the transit station sends out full-broadcast request frames in public frequency for other transit stations to receive, S4, request frame receiving and forwarding, S5, surrounding link machine request processing, S6, call response packet sending, S7, source link machine confirmation, S8, call mobile station confirmation, S9, call end, voice communication under single call homography modes among a plurality of transit stations is achieved, and meanwhile, reliability of a voice communication link can be guaranteed.

title_en: Power emergency communication method based on lightweight point-to-multipoint microwave communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power emergency communication method based on lightweight point-to-multipoint microwave communication, which relates to the technical field of communication, and is characterized in that an electric power emergency communication device is used as a long-distance emergency communication return channel, and electric power system data of a terminal station is returned to a monitoring center in an emergency manner.

title_en: Method and device for scanning file, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device, a computer device and a storage medium for scanning files. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring paper files to be scanned and file format requirements to be stored; establishing a generated document type corresponding to the scanned document according to the file type, and setting a file naming mode corresponding to each generated document type; controlling a scanner to scan each type of files in the paper files in batches according to the file types, respectively synthesizing a plurality of types of generated files, and automatically naming and storing each type of generated files according to a corresponding file naming mode; or controlling a scanner to scan the paper files according to the sequence of the files to be stored, classifying and splitting the synthesized generated files according to a preset splitting rule, and then automatically naming and storing the files according to a corresponding file naming mode. By adopting the method, automatic scanning, naming, file format and size adjustment and automatic storage can be realized, the accuracy of data storage is improved, and the operation time is saved.

title_en: Antenna detection system and coupling box
abstract_en: The application relates to an antenna detection system and a coupling box, wherein the antenna detection system comprises a coupling box, an antenna to be detected and a detection module, wherein the antenna to be detected and the detection module are arranged on an interactive flat plate, the coupling box comprises a box body and a standard antenna arranged in the box body, a gap is reserved on one side surface of the box body, the antenna to be detected is clamped in the gap, and the detection module is respectively connected with the standard antenna and the interactive flat plate. Compared with the prior art, the application has the advantages that the gap is reserved on the surface of one side of the box body of the coupling box, so that the antenna to be detected arranged on the interactive flat plate can be arranged in the gap in a clamping way, and the standard antenna is arranged in the coupling box, so that the receiving and transmitting of radio frequency signals can be carried out between the standard antenna and the antenna to be detected under the condition of not being interfered by external signals, the receiving and transmitting condition of the signal of the antenna to be detected arranged on the interactive flat plate can be accurately detected, the accuracy and the operability of the antenna detection are improved, and the time cost and the labor cost of the detection are greatly saved.

title_en: Communication apparatus, communication method, and recording medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a communication apparatus, a communication method, and a recording medium. To provide a mechanism that enables flexible design of timing regarding communication. The communication device includes a communication control unit that controls transmission of a first channel and reception of a second channel, or vice versa, the first channel being transmitted in a first direction, the second channel being a channel corresponding to the first channel and transmitted in a second direction opposite to the first direction, and a setting unit that sets a control mode of the communication control unit to the first mode or the second mode. The communication control unit transmits and receives the first channel and the second channel in different subframes in a first mode, and transmits and receives the first channel and the second channel within the same subframe in a second mode.

title_en: Frequency hopping system low-complexity carrier tracking method based on halving search strategy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a frequency hopping system low-complexity carrier tracking method based on a halving search strategy, and belongs to the field of communication signal processing. According to the invention, the frequency offset estimation of the current hopping data is obtained through a plurality of times of halving searches to complete the frequency offset compensation, then the frequency offset search starting point of the next hopping is directly obtained according to the frequency hopping pattern rule, the next hopping data is subjected to the halving searches for a small number of times on the basis to complete the frequency offset estimation and compensation of the current hopping, and the subsequent data are subjected to the same iteration operation to realize carrier tracking. The invention realizes the frequency offset estimation by utilizing the multi-symbol cumulative gain, and can work in a low signal-to-noise ratio environment; the invention adopts the halving search method to search the frequency, only needs to carry out a small amount of complex multiplication and addition operation for each search, and has low algorithm complexity; according to the invention, in combination with the frequency hopping pattern rule in the tracking process, the frequency offset searching starting point of the follow-up hopping data is directly obtained by the frequency offset estimation value of the previous hop, and the frequency offset estimation value with higher accuracy can be obtained through fewer iterations.

title_en: Energy storage digital collector with self-adaptive frequency
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive frequency energy storage digital collector, which comprises: the serial port communication module is used for data transmission between the collector and the energy storage equipment; the data processing unit is used for acquiring and processing data; the wireless communication module is used for transmitting data entropy coding; and the power supply module is used for supplying power to the collector. The invention can adaptively adjust the acquisition frequency according to the value of the data, reduce the bandwidth pressure and the batch storage pressure of the server, realize the all-round monitoring of the battery cell and further improve the use safety.

title_en: Microstrip antenna assembly, radar receiving and transmitting assembly and radar system
abstract_en: The invention provides a microstrip antenna assembly, a radar transceiving assembly and a radar system, wherein the microstrip antenna assembly specifically comprises two microstrip patch antennas which are respectively used for providing a radar transmitting channel and a radar receiving channel, and a radio frequency oscillator which is arranged on a coupling path of the two microstrip patch antennas and is used for absorbing coupling electromagnetic wave energy between the microstrip patch antennas. Through the technical scheme that this disclosure provided, through introducing radio frequency oscillator in order to reduce the electromagnetic wave coupling between the receiving and dispatching antenna in the radar module, promote the isolation between transmission port and the receiving port, and then can realize the reduction of interval between the receiving and dispatching antenna when guaranteeing that radar module has high receiving sensitivity to the repayment signal for highly integrated, miniaturized radar module design demand is satisfied.

title_en: Industrial control safety cascade management system and method based on message queue
abstract_en: The invention discloses an industrial control security cascade management system and method based on a message queue, and relates to the field of industrial control network security management. Each management system is provided with a management area tree, and the management area tree comprises upper nodes and lower nodes; the industrial control equipment is associated according to the tree partitions, all lower nodes are hung under the root areas of the upper nodes as a tree structure, and one area tree node is added when one lower node is added; the method comprises the steps that a strategy management module, a cascade configuration module and an alarm module are arranged in a superior node and a subordinate node, the strategy management module is responsible for strategy configuration sending management, the cascade configuration module is responsible for superior and subordinate cascade configuration, and the alarm module is responsible for generating and reporting system alarms. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, any node can be ensured to have the highest authority, the emergency can be responded in time, the network attack is blocked at the first time, and the influence on an industrial control system is reduced.

title_en: Refined intelligent monitoring method for data center
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data security, in particular to a refined intelligent monitoring method for a data center, which comprises the steps of establishing a database, acquiring fault data and recording the fault data into the database; grouping the data centers, and acquiring temperature and humidity data and hardware telemetering data of each working group and temperature and humidity data and hardware telemetering data of each device; generating a fault event according to the fault data, and positioning a fault working group and fault equipment which generate the fault event according to fault event information; carrying out hardware fault troubleshooting on the fault working group and the fault equipment, and judging whether the fault equipment is a hardware fault according to temperature and humidity data and hardware telemetering data of the fault working group and the fault equipment; when the fault working group and the fault equipment are determined to be hardware faults, generating warranty information and automatically reporting the warranty information; when the hardware of the fault working group and the fault equipment normally runs, the fault system is checked, and meanwhile, automatic repair is carried out.

title_en: System and method for compensating turbulent channel of laser communication
abstract_en: The invention provides a turbulent flow channel compensation system for laser communication, which comprises: the device comprises a receiving optical system, a liquid crystal wave plate, a wave controller, a liquid crystal light modulator, a beam splitting prism, a camera, a communication receiver and a computer; the receiving optical system sends the received carrier optical signal to the liquid crystal wave plate; the wave controller controls the liquid crystal wave plate to change the polarization state of the carrier wave optical signal; the liquid crystal wave plate sends the carrier wave optical signal to the liquid crystal optical modulator; the liquid crystal optical modulator changes the wave front phase distribution of the carrier optical signal; the beam splitter prism sends signals to the camera and the communication receiver respectively; the camera and the communication receiver send carrier optical signals to the computer; the computer controls the wave controller and the liquid crystal light modulator to correct the data parameters of the carrier light signal. The system can dynamically and flexibly feed back the disturbance of the space domain and the time domain of the laser signal, and simultaneously compensate the facula distortion generated by the turbulent flow channel and reduce the jitter of the receiving power, thereby improving the stability of the transmission of the laser communication link in the turbulent flow channel and reducing the error rate of the communication system.

title_en: Method for transmitting information and low-power wide area communication system
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for transmitting information and a low-power wide area communication system. The method obtains an initial signal through a spread spectrum modulation device. In the case where the initial signal is acquired, the initial signal is modulated by a packetized multilevel frequency shift keying and chirp signal to generate a modulated signal, which includes a preamble sequence, a frame control header, and a data payload. And transmitting the modulation signal to a spread spectrum demodulation device through a channel, and demodulating the frame control head and the data load by combining the leader sequence under the condition that the spread spectrum demodulation device receives the modulation signal so as to acquire information. The method and the device generate the modulation signals based on the grouped multi-system frequency shift keying and chirp signals, and demodulate the received modulation signals through the spread spectrum demodulation device, so that information is obtained, the performance of the signals in a complex electromagnetic environment can be stabilized, and the communication rate is improved.

title_en: Compact dual-polarization filtering magnetoelectric dipole antenna and communication equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compact dual-polarization filtering magnetoelectric dipole antenna and communication equipment, wherein the antenna comprises a radiator dielectric substrate, a balun structure and a reflecting dielectric substrate which are sequentially arranged from top to bottom, and the balun structure is respectively connected with the radiator dielectric substrate and the reflecting dielectric substrate; the upper surface of the radiator dielectric substrate is provided with four planar oscillator arms and four filter structures, the four planar oscillator arms are arranged in central symmetry, each planar oscillator arm forms an electric dipole, the four filter structures are mutually and symmetrically arranged around the four planar oscillator arms, and each filter structure is positioned between two adjacent planar oscillator arms; the balun structure comprises four baluns which are arranged in a central symmetry mode, any two metal floors opposite to the baluns form a magnetic dipole, and the magnetic dipole and the electric dipole form a magnetic dipole together. Compared with the existing scheme, the invention is more compact, and has wider bandwidth, low-frequency band out-of-band rejection characteristic and stable radiation performance in band.

title_en: Analog echo cancellation method
abstract_en: The method for eliminating the analog echo comprises the following steps: generating a first signal according to the digital signal; filtering the first signal according to a first filter coefficient of the first filter device to generate a second signal; adding the first reference signal and the second signal to form a third signal; performing digital-to-analog conversion according to the first signal and the third signal and outputting to generate an echo signal; performing analog-to-digital conversion according to the echo signal to generate a fourth signal; generating a fifth signal according to the digital signal and the fourth signal; and updating the first filter coefficient according to the fifth signal. Generating the fifth signal comprises: generating a second filter coefficient of the second filter device; updating the second filter coefficient; obtaining first and second representative coefficients in the second filter coefficients; and generating a fifth signal according to the first and second representative coefficients.

title_en: BIM technology-based banknote printing factory digital park control method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a BIM technology-based bank note printing factory digital park control method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a banknote printing equipment model and embedding the banknote printing equipment model into a BIM building model; establishing a two-dimensional table of a basic information base of the money printing equipment model, wherein a row represents each model, and a column represents basic information of the model; a production network and a management network covering the whole park are established; analyzing real-time data, classifying and coding a variable point table of the money printing equipment according to variable parameter categories, and constructing a two-dimensional table with a unified data structure, wherein columns and rows in the table respectively represent the attribute and the attribute value of each variable; automatically filling and storing each piece of real-time data in a storage library according to the encoded variable point table and the two-dimensional table with the unified data structure; and displaying the internal structure of each equipment facility and the corresponding variable parameter attribute and value based on the banknote printing equipment model. The invention realizes the real-time monitoring of the running state of the equipment facilities and ensures the smooth production.

title_en: Wireless intelligent wearable device and image acquisition method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a wireless intelligent wearable device and an image acquisition method thereof. The apparatus includes a first portion and a second portion that are in wireless communication with each other. The first and second portions include first and second processors, first and second wireless communication modules, first and second cameras, first and second image acquisition modules, and first and second clocks, respectively. The first image acquisition module sends a first hardware trigger signal based on a first clock to the first camera, and the second image acquisition module sends a second hardware trigger signal based on a second clock to the second camera. At least one processor causes the first wireless communication module and the second wireless communication module to continuously perform wireless communication with each other and/or with a smart device and determine a clock difference to achieve synchronization of the first and second hardware trigger signals. Thus, a plurality of cameras arranged at a plurality of parts of the device realize dynamic accurate synchronization of image shooting and acquisition.

title_en: Airport unpowered plate trailer detection positioning system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a detection and positioning system and method for an airport unpowered plate trailer, and belongs to the field of airport equipment. This airport does not have power trigger to detect positioning system includes: the trailer positioning terminal and the trailer detecting terminal are arranged on the trailer; a trigger positioning beacon mounted on the trigger; the trigger positioning beacon comprises a detection end and a transmitting end; on each plate trailer, a detection end is arranged at the rear end of the plate trailer, and a transmitting end is arranged at the front end of the plate trailer; or the detection end is arranged at the front end of the plate trailer, and the transmitting end is arranged at the rear end of the plate trailer; the detection end and the plate trailer detection terminal can detect signals sent by the transmitting end. The invention avoids the requirement of the existing Bluetooth positioning technology on the layout of base stations, also avoids the influence of signal shielding on the positioning precision, realizes continuous high-precision positioning in the whole apron range, and fully meets the performance requirement and the cost requirement of an airport on the positioning of the plate trailer.

title_en: Audio processing method and equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an audio processing method and equipment, relates to the field of electronic equipment, and solves the problems that a mobile phone receiver leaks sound when playing sound in a quiet environment and the sound quality is poor when sounding through a screen. The specific scheme is as follows: detecting a first trigger condition; and controlling the receiver and the screen to respectively play the sound in the corresponding frequency band in the sound signal according to the strategy corresponding to the first triggering condition.

title_en: Automatic matching adjusting circuit for fast matching frequency
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic matching adjusting circuit for quickly matching frequency, which belongs to the technical field of automatic matching adjusting circuits and comprises a power supply conversion circuit, a self-oscillation circuit, a full-bridge driving circuit and a transmitting antenna, wherein the power supply conversion circuit is externally connected with a 12V power supply, the 12V power supply is also electrically connected with the full-bridge driving circuit, the power supply conversion circuit outputs a 5V power supply to the self-oscillation circuit, the self-oscillation circuit is coupled with the full-bridge driving circuit, the full-bridge driving circuit is electrically connected with the transmitting antenna through a capacitor, the self-oscillation circuit is grounded through a surge module, the device mainly generates adjustable driving frequency through the self-oscillation circuit, the driving frequency drives the transmitting antenna through the full-bridge driving circuit, and the optimal driving frequency can be found by measuring the waveform on the antenna.

title_en: Document correction method, system and medium based on infrared range finder
abstract_en: The invention relates to a document correction method, a system and a medium based on an infrared range finder, which belong to the technical field of image processing, and acquire an image after secondary processing by performing distortion correction processing on the image after primary processing, acquire camera parameter information of a camera, and acquire a correction image projected onto a light screen according to a distance value from the infrared range finder to a plane A  2 B 2 C 2 D 2 , the processed secondary image and the camera parameter information. According to the method, when the photographed document needs to be corrected, correction of the photographed document can be completed without using an edge detection algorithm or manually selecting four points of the document, and the situation that difficulty is brought to correction when the paper shape is irregular or part of edge information is missing is avoided. The camera shooting document is automatically corrected, and the oblique view shot by the camera is converted into a top view of the front view by utilizing the geometric relationship.

title_en: Multi-physical field stealth device for ultrasonic waves and electromagnetic waves and manufacturing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-physical-field stealth device for ultrasonic waves and electromagnetic waves and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein each refraction unit comprises a first A medium area, a second A medium area and a first B medium area; the a medium and the B medium are isotropic and transparent to both acoustic waves and electromagnetic waves, and satisfy equations (1) and (2): c. C  2  /c  1  ＝n  1  /n  2  (1)n  1  >n  2  (2) (ii) a When ultrasonic waves and electromagnetic waves are incident perpendicular to the outer interface of the first A medium area of the two refraction units on one transverse side, the ultrasonic waves and the electromagnetic waves pass through the second A medium area and the first B medium area and are emitted out along the same path after avoiding the stealth area; the multi-physical-field stealth device designed based on the refraction law and the manufacturing method greatly reduce the design complexity of the stealth device. Through repeated selective calculation, benzene and water are selected to carry out functional design of the device, and the technical problem that the functional design of a single physical field device cannot meet the requirements of multiple physical fields in variable environments is solved.

title_en: Multi-user selection method and system based on orthogonal reference frame
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-user selection method and a system based on an orthogonal reference frame, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, constructing an orthogonal reference frame according to the dimension of a base station antenna; s2, defining a corresponding index set for each user according to the channel information; and S3, selecting a user according to the obtained index set. According to the constructed orthogonal reference frame and the channel estimation information, the invention selects a group of user combinations with less multi-user interference, thereby reducing the calculation complexity and improving the system throughput, and further improving the performance of the communication system.

title_en: Wearable device and data processing method of wearable device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a wearable device and a data processing method of the wearable device, wherein the wearable device comprises a display screen, a first Bluetooth module and a processor, the first Bluetooth module is used for establishing communication connection between the wearable device and a vehicle; the processor is used for obtaining the distance between the wearable device and the vehicle, and controlling the display interface of the display screen to be switched from a first interface to a second interface when the distance is smaller than a set distance threshold value, wherein the second interface comprises one or more controls used for controlling the vehicle. The wearable device can automatically display a control for controlling the vehicle when the wearable device is close to the vehicle. In this way, the user can conveniently control the vehicle through the control without performing additional operation.

title_en: Method for realizing true and false target identification of MIMO radar based on communication signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing MIMO radar true and false target identification based on communication signals, which comprises the following steps of adopting a radar communication integrated scheme at a transmitting end of a multi-input multi-output radar system, embedding communication information and spread spectrum information in a radar waveform, constructing a decision problem selected from two possible hypotheses at a radar receiving end, namely zero hypothesis Or a backup hypothesis Carrying out correlation processing, bispectrum transformation and diagonal slicing on radar receiving signals under two decision assumptions, extracting six effective characteristic parameters, carrying out data normalization processing, carrying out decision by using a support vector machine, obtaining average classification recognition rates under different signal-to-noise ratios through ten-fold cross validation, and deciding that targets at the same position are false targets forged Or a truly existing target Thereby realizing the identification of the true and false targets.

title_en: Access method of microwave cavity filter
abstract_en: The application relates to an access method of a microwave cavity filter, and relates to the technical field of microwave circuit design. The microwave cavity filter is placed on one side of a microwave circuit box body, so that a connecting hole in the microwave cavity filter is aligned to a mounting hole in the microwave circuit box body, and a first interface is also aligned to a second interface; s2, positioning rods are arranged in the connecting hole and the mounting hole, one end of the connector is inserted into the first interface, the other end of the connector is inserted into the second interface, one end of the connecting component is inserted into the connecting hole, and the other end of the connecting component is inserted into the mounting hole; s3, rotating the connecting assembly to enable one end of the connecting assembly to be clamped in the connecting hole and the other end of the connecting assembly to be clamped in the mounting hole; and S4, rotating the rotating assembly to drive the two fixing assemblies to slide on the connecting assembly until the fixing assemblies are inserted into the positioning rods, so that the microwave cavity filter is fixedly installed on the side wall of the microwave circuit box body. The microwave circuit box has the effect that the connection of the filter and the microwave circuit box is stable.

title_en: Mutual coupling induction type contactless connector
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mutual coupling induction type contactless connector, which comprises a connector plug and a connector socket, wherein the connector plug comprises a plug shell and a first circuit structure; the invention has the advantages that: the mutual coupling induction mode of the first mutual coupling structure and the second mutual coupling structure is used for transmitting the energy signal and the data signal to the connector socket from the connector plug, the whole process is in a non-contact transmission state, the butt joint with the jack through the contact pin is not needed, the butt joint in a direct insertion or rotary insertion mode is not needed in the using process, the use is more convenient, the reliability is higher, the repeated use rate is higher, and the reliability problem of structural wear caused by mechanical contact does not exist.

title_en: Bluetooth system, method for processing Bluetooth signals, chip and electronic equipment
abstract_en: A Bluetooth system, a method of processing Bluetooth signals, a chip and an electronic device are provided. The Bluetooth system includes: the modulation module is used for modulating and generating a plurality of paths of Bluetooth signals to be transmitted; the phase compensation module is connected with the modulation module at one end and is used for carrying out phase compensation on the multipath Bluetooth signals so that the multipath Bluetooth signals are superposed in phase at the receiving end; and the transmitting module is used for transmitting the multipath Bluetooth signals, wherein the multipath Bluetooth signals are transmitted through a plurality of antennas. According to the embodiment of the application, the multipath Bluetooth signals to be transmitted can be subjected to phase compensation, so that the multipath Bluetooth signals can be overlapped in phase at the receiving end, and the Bluetooth transmission distance can be improved.

title_en: Optical cable disturbance monitoring system and method based on equivalent sampling and precise time delay
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of optical cable disturbance monitoring, and particularly relates to an optical cable disturbance monitoring system and method based on equivalent sampling and precise time delay. The method utilizes the laid optical cable to generate a narrow pulse signal based on an equivalent time sampling method, precision clock control, precision delay control and the like, and realizes the generation of back scattering light and the equivalent time sampling of the back scattering light by triggering a narrow pulse laser to emit laser and a fine delay module to generate fine delay at the same time; by triggering and emitting laser for multiple times and sampling equivalent time, optical fiber disturbance monitoring signals with different positions and high resolution are reconstructed, and optical fiber disturbance at different positions can be monitored.

title_en: Multi-panel power reporting technique
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communications are described. A User Equipment (UE) may communicate via a first panel of the UE and a second panel of the UE. The UE may determine at least one of a first power headroom value for the first panel or a second power headroom value for the second panel, the first power headroom value being specific to the first panel and the second power headroom value being specific to the second panel. The UE may transmit a report to a base station indicating at least one of the first power headroom value for the first panel or the second power headroom value for the second panel. In some examples, the base station may receive the report and transmit a signal indicating a power adjustment for at least one of the first panel or the second panel in response to receiving the report.

title_en: Information feedback method and related device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an information feedback method and a related device, comprising the following steps: the terminal equipment sends first information to the network device, wherein the first information comprises the sum of the number of non-zero coefficients of all spatial layers of the terminal equipment, and the non-zero coefficients are used for forming a superposition coefficient matrix in a codebook; the first information also comprises first indication information, and the first indication information indicates whether second information sent to the network device by the terminal equipment carries indication information of a nonzero coefficient position or not; the terminal device transmits the second information to the network apparatus. On the premise of ensuring correct data transmission, the coding rate of the indication information sent to the network device by the terminal equipment is reduced.

title_en: Information processing apparatus and information processing method
abstract_en: The invention provides an information processing apparatus and an information processing method, etc., which appropriately share address book information stored in a terminal apparatus. The information processing device includes a communication unit that communicates with the terminal device and a control unit that controls the communication unit, the control unit transmits an acquisition request for address book information to the terminal device via the communication unit, and the control unit controls to retransmit the acquisition request when the address book information cannot be acquired for the acquisition request and when a predetermined time has not elapsed since the transmission of the acquisition request.

title_en: Method for controlling microphone, terminal, electronic device and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of mobile phone vehicle-machine interconnection, in particular to a method, a terminal, electronic equipment and a medium for controlling a microphone. The method for controlling the microphone is applicable to the mobile terminal and comprises the following steps: acquiring attribute information of a microphone; the attribute information comprises at least one of matching information of the microphone and the seat, the opening state of the microphone, whether the microphone can be controlled by the mobile terminal or not or the control right of the microphone is opened; responding to the attribute information that the microphone can be controlled by the mobile terminal, and acquiring the control right of the microphone; and sending the microphone control instruction to the microphone connecting terminal. The method can control the microphone more reliably.

title_en: Decorative structure, shell assembly, electronic equipment and photoelectric assembly
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electronic equipment structures, aims to solve the problems of low connection reliability and poor sealing effect of a decorative structure of the existing electronic equipment at a shell plate, and provides a decorative structure, a shell assembly, electronic equipment and a photoelectric assembly. The decorative structure is used for being mounted to a shell plate of the electronic equipment, and the shell plate is provided with an outer plate surface and an inner plate surface which are opposite. The shell plate is provided with a mounting plate hole which penetrates through the outer plate surface and the inner plate surface. The ornamental structure includes a seat member and an outer fitting member. The seat member includes a seat plate and a rim connected to an outer periphery of the seat plate. The outer fitting includes a body portion including a middle portion and an outer ring portion positioned at an outer periphery of the middle portion. Wherein the middle portion and the seat plate are interconnected at the mounting plate aperture. The ring is spaced from the outer ring portion and defines an annular mating groove to permit the plate body of the shell plate adjacent the periphery of its mounting plate aperture to fit within the mating groove. The invention has the advantages of higher connection reliability and better sealing effect of the decorative structure.

title_en: Wireless communication device
abstract_en: A wireless communications apparatus, comprising: an antenna for receiving and transmitting signals; the radio frequency chip is electrically connected with the antenna, is used for identifying the type of the signal received by the antenna and is also used for processing the signal; a coupler electrically connected to the antenna for coupling the signal; the sharing unit is electrically connected between the radio frequency chip and the coupler and used for receiving the signals coupled by the coupler and selecting signal receiving paths with different attenuation amounts according to the types of the signals, so that the problem that the LTE NB-IoT and the EGPRS cannot be compatible is solved.

title_en: Control system of electric automobile charging opening cover
abstract_en: The application discloses a control system of a charging port cover of an electric vehicle, which relates to the technical field of charging and comprises a charging pile, a charging gun head and a charging port cover assembly of the electric vehicle, wherein the charging pile is connected with the charging gun through a charging gun line; a charging pile controller, a signal emitter and a display screen are arranged in the charging pile, wherein the charging pile controller is respectively and electrically connected with the emitter, the charging gun head and the display screen; the charging gun head is provided with a control button assembly, is connected with the charging pile controller through a charging gun wire and is used for controlling the emitter to perform polling communication with the charging port cover assembly, and the charging port cover is opened through the established communication connection; the charging port cover assembly is provided with a wireless receiver and a charging port cover controller, and the charging port cover assembly is used for establishing communication connection with the charging pile and opening the charging port cover according to the generated opening instruction.

title_en: U-shaped metamaterial and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of metamaterials, in particular to a U-shaped metamaterial and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: coating polyamic acid on a substrate sheet in a rotating mode to obtain a first prefabricated layer, and performing thermal imidization treatment to obtain a bottom dielectric layer made of polyimide; obtaining a U-shaped metal layer on the upper surface of the bottom dielectric layer; coating polyamic acid on the bottom dielectric layer in a rotating mode to obtain a second prefabricated layer, and performing thermal imidization treatment to obtain an intermediate dielectric layer made of polyimide; obtaining another U-shaped metal layer on the surface of the intermediate medium layer; spin-coating polyamic acid on the middle dielectric layer provided with the U-shaped metal layer to obtain a third prefabricated layer, and performing thermal imidization treatment to obtain a top dielectric layer made of polyimide material, so as to obtain a periodic unit; and periodically arranging the periodic units to form the U-shaped metamaterial. The embodiment of the invention provides a preparation method of a metamaterial capable of changing the polarization state of terahertz waveband electromagnetic waves.

title_en: Indication of modulation and coding scheme for wireless device in coverage enhancement mode
abstract_en: Some embodiments include a method performed by a network node for indicating a modulation and coding scheme for a wireless device operating in a coverage enhancement mode, wherein the wireless device operates with a first modulation and coding scheme using physical downlink shared channel repetition and operates with a second modulation and coding scheme not using physical downlink shared channel repetition, and wherein the second modulation and coding scheme is a higher order modulation and coding than the first modulation and coding scheme, the method comprising: configuring the downlink control information to indicate one or more parameters related to the second modulation and coding scheme when physical downlink shared channel repetition is not used, the indication comprising at least a modulation and coding scheme field of the first modulation and coding scheme and one or more downlink control information field bits regarding reuse when repetition of the physical downlink shared channel is used.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle deployment method and system based on dense boundary priority service
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of mobile edge computing, and particularly relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle deployment method and system based on dense boundary priority service. The method comprises the steps of S1, obtaining relevant information under a current scene, S2, establishing a system optimization model taking the position of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the gain of a communicable channel as constraints and taking the maximized average transmission rate as a target, S3, decomposing the optimization problem into a sub-problem of the maximum service radius and the vertical position and a sub-problem of the region division and the horizontal position, S4, solving the sub-problem of the maximum service radius and the vertical position, and S5, solving the sub-problem of the horizontal position of the unmanned aerial vehicle. The invention has the characteristics of aiming at complex urban environment, taking the unmanned aerial vehicle as a mobile edge server, assisting a user or the edge server in processing tasks when the data volume increases rapidly, and maximizing the average transmission rate of the system.

title_en: Anti-interference optimal transmission method for energy acquisition cognitive Internet of things network
abstract_en: The invention relates to an anti-interference optimal transmission method for an energy acquisition cognitive Internet of things network. The cognitive Internet of things is modeled as a complete system consisting of a main base station, a plurality of main users, a plurality of Internet of things nodes, an Internet of things cognitive base station and a plurality of malicious attack nodes by combining the cognitive radio technology, the energy acquisition technology and the anti-interference technology in the communication field. Under the condition that each node of the cognitive Internet of things is attacked maliciously by a deep reinforcement learning method, a cognitive base station does not need priori knowledge, does not have a model to learn a malicious node channel attack strategy, reasonably formulates an countermeasure strategy and adjusts channel access, mode selection and power distribution of each node so as to achieve the purpose of maximizing the throughput of the system. The invention is suitable for the field of wireless communication.

title_en: Many camera lenses slider cell-phone protective housing that possesses solar charging function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of digital products, in particular to a multi-lens sliding block mobile phone protective shell with a solar charging function, which comprises a shell frame, a lens sliding block module, a touch component and a solar power generation component, wherein the product takes a digital product shell as a carrier, and a plurality of groups of optical lenses are intensively distributed on the same carrier in a sliding block mode, so that the product is convenient to carry and use; the situation lamp piece is also the same, so that various atmosphere situations can be selected, such as a starry sky situation, a landscape situation and the like, the lens of the mobile phone and the tablet personal computer product is self-provided, the starlight effect cannot be generated during night shooting, the lens used by the product is the optical nano lens, the shooting effect is good, the lens suitable for night scene shooting can be selected to complete shooting of the starlight effect, when the night shooting is performed, the flash lamp of the mobile phone is adjusted to be normally on, the flash lamp can project the situation lamp piece to a target position, a person stands in the situation to shoot, and the atmosphere is thicker.

title_en: USB control device, receiving device and corresponding seat sending and receiving box
abstract_en: The invention provides a USB control device, a receiving device and a corresponding seat sending and receiving box. The USB control device is used in the seat receiving box, and comprises: the system comprises a USB selection module, a first format conversion module, a second format conversion module, a first FPGA module or a first system on a chip and a first switch chip; the input end of the USB selection module is used for receiving a USB signal received by the agent receiving box as a host end, the output end of the USB selection module is respectively connected with the input ends of the first format conversion module and the second format conversion module, the output ends of the first format conversion module and the second format conversion module are respectively connected with the input end of the first FPGA module or the input end of the first system on a chip, the output end of the first FPGA module or the output end of the first system on a chip is connected to the input end of the first switch chip, and the output end of the first switch chip is externally connected with the agent sending box. The invention can realize the double-current transmission of the USB data, and can improve the reliability of the system when being applied to a network seat system.

title_en: Triangle inward folding hinge for folding mobile phone with flexible screen and without crease
abstract_en: The invention discloses a triangle inward folding hinge for folding a flexible screen mobile phone without crease bending, which comprises a base and a main control movable frame, wherein a first rotating arm and a second rotating arm which are symmetrically distributed are arranged on two sides of the base, the first rotating arm and the second rotating arm are respectively linked with the base and the main control movable frame, the first rotating arm and the second rotating arm are mutually linked, a connecting movable frame is arranged at the outer end of the base, and the connecting movable frame is in linkage fit with the second rotating arm; the base is provided with a first curve groove and a first sliding shaft, the first rotating arm is provided with a second curve groove and a second sliding shaft, the first sliding shaft is in sliding fit with the second curve groove, the second sliding shaft is in sliding fit with the first curve groove to realize track control, and in the bending and rotating process, the front-section travel of the track is changed in a U-shaped mimicry mode, and the rear-section travel of the track is changed in a water drop mimicry mode, so that the rotating control is completed.

title_en: Alarm adjusting method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an alarm adjusting method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: when the alarm is in a ringing state, acquiring a holding state corresponding to the electronic equipment; acquiring holding characteristics corresponding to the holding state, wherein the holding characteristics are determined based on a sound wave signal sequence generated when the alarm rings; and determining an adjusting mode of the alarm according to the holding characteristics. By the method, the alarm clock adjusting mode can be determined directly through the holding characteristics associated with the holding state corresponding to the electronic equipment, operation is not needed under the condition of watching the screen of the electronic equipment, the alarm clock adjusting mode is simplified, and the intelligence of alarm clock adjustment is improved.

title_en: Modeling method, model and acquisition method of satellite north-south conservation strategy model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of aerospace, and provides a modeling method, a model, an obtaining method, equipment and a medium of a Dueling DQN-based north-south conservation strategy model, wherein the modeling method comprises the following steps: s1: initializing a model; s2: obtaining the inclination angle control behavior and the Q value; s3: obtaining the inclination angle of the satellite at the current moment, and obtaining the inclination angle control action executed by the satellite; s4: obtaining the satellite inclination angle and the accumulated reward at the next moment; s5: storing the satellite combination state data set into an experience pool; s6: calculating a target value; s7: calculating errors and updating parameters; s8: updating the Q value; s9: repeating the steps S3-S8, wherein the times of executing the steps S3-S8 are equal to the times of orbit control of the set of satellite state data; after the steps S3-S8 of the appointed iteration times are repeatedly executed, updating the weight parameter of the target convolution layer, the parameter of the target dominance function network and the parameter of the target state value function network; s10: steps S2-S9 are repeatedly performed. The scheme can obtain an optimal decision strategy and reduce the consumption of satellite fuel.

title_en: Star cluster imaging method and system guided by satellite-ground cooperation
abstract_en: The invention provides a star cluster imaging method and a system for satellite-ground cooperative guidance, which comprises the following steps: establishing a satellite-ground data transmission link and a satellite-ground measurement and control link; carrying out wide area search to obtain target search information; downloading target search information to a ground system; selecting a target with highest confidence from the target search information to obtain a target label; extracting contents according to the target number, packaging the contents into an inter-satellite guiding data packet, and sending the inter-satellite guiding data packet to a slave satellite through an inter-satellite link; acquiring and analyzing an inter-satellite guiding data packet from a satellite; planning an imaging task according to the target longitude and latitude of the inter-satellite guiding data packet from the satellite, recording a target label when the task is executed, and calculating the starting and ending time of the execution of the satellite imaging task; and judging whether the imaging task of the slave satellite is successfully planned or not through a planning result zone bit displayed by the remote measurement of the slave satellite in the ground system. The method gives consideration to the autonomy of inter-satellite cooperation and the controllability of ground intervention, and improves the success rate of cluster-guided imaging compared with inter-satellite guided imaging.

title_en: Unmanned driving device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned driving, and particularly relates to an unmanned driving device which is used for being installed at a driving position of a vehicle to replace manual control of the vehicle, and comprises a rack and a driving device, wherein the rack is installed on the rack: the device comprises a steering wheel driving mechanism, a gear handle driving mechanism, an accelerator pedal driving mechanism, a brake pedal driving mechanism, a light deflector rod driving mechanism and a controller, wherein the controller is used for controlling the steering wheel driving mechanism, the gear handle driving mechanism, the accelerator pedal driving mechanism, the brake pedal driving mechanism and the light deflector rod driving mechanism to act; and the wireless communication module is electrically connected with the controller and is in communication connection with the remote control terminal. The invention can modify the existing vehicle, and reduces the implementation cost of the remote unmanned technology.

title_en: Signal isolation equipment based on edge equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of edge equipment, in particular to signal isolation equipment based on edge equipment, which comprises an edge equipment body, wherein side strips are fixedly arranged on the side walls of two sides of the edge equipment body, first strip-shaped grooves are formed in the upper end parts of the two side strips, second strip-shaped grooves are formed in the inner walls of the two first strip-shaped grooves, first screw rods are arranged in the two first strip-shaped grooves, an isolation mechanism comprises a signal isolation equipment body, the signal isolation equipment body is positioned above the edge equipment body, inner grooves are symmetrically formed in the side walls of the signal isolation equipment body, springs are fixedly arranged in the inner walls of the two groups of inner grooves, wedge blocks are fixedly arranged on the side walls of the two groups of springs, the two groups of wedge blocks are respectively and slidably arranged in the two groups of inner grooves, and are respectively matched with the two groups of slots, so that the signal isolation equipment body is more convenient to install and disassemble and labor-saving when the equipment is used, and the signal isolation effect is enhanced in a full-coverage mode.

title_en: Stop band enhancement type low-pass coaxial filter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stop band enhanced low-pass coaxial filter. It is composed of coaxial input, filter structure and coaxial output. The filtering structure consists of a high-low impedance low-pass filter and an embedded coupling short column, and the effects of restraining higher harmonic waves and out-of-band spurious are achieved by introducing a coupling short column null effect (stop band enhancement) into the cavity of the high-resistance part. And the position of the null frequency can be controlled by adjusting the position of the short-circuit column and the height of the gap between the short-circuit column and the high-resistance part cavity. The designed stop band enhanced low-pass coaxial filter has a simple structure, can be directly integrated with an antenna radiator or a T/R component, has the characteristics of small insertion loss and high power capacity, and can be used as a connector with filtering characteristics for double-negative, double-positive or double-positive conversion.

title_en: Transaction execution method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The specification discloses a transaction execution method, a device, a storage medium and electronic equipment. The transaction execution method comprises the following steps: address information and transaction identification in an NFC tag of the intelligent device are acquired, the address information and the transaction identification are written into the NFC tag in advance, a designated application program installed in the terminal device is called according to the transaction identification, so that travel information from the current position to the geographic position corresponding to the address information is determined according to the address information through the designated application program, and the travel information is sent to a communication object for executing the transaction corresponding to the transaction identification, so that the communication object executes the transaction according to the travel information.

title_en: Resource scheduling method of cognitive backscatter communication system based on imperfect CSI
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of Internet of things, and particularly relates to a resource scheduling method of a cognitive backscatter communication system based on imperfect CSI, which comprises the following steps: establishing a signal transmission model of the cognitive backscatter communication network; considering the user service quality of cognitive backscattering, backscattering coefficient constraint, transmission time constraint and maximum interference power constraint of a main receiver, and constructing a resource allocation problem of maximizing the throughput of a secondary system; establishing a multivariable coupled nonlinear robust resource allocation model; and converting the original problem into a deterministic convex optimization problem by using a worst criterion, continuous convex approximation, S-Procedure, variable replacement and alternative iteration method and solving the problem. The method converts the system performance optimization problem into the deterministic convex optimization problem by using the worst criterion, the continuous convex approximation, the S-Procedure, the variable replacement and the alternate iteration method, and has better throughput and robustness compared with a non-robust algorithm.

title_en: System for identifying candidate vehicle systems
abstract_en: A system 200 for identifying a candidate vehicle system is provided that includes a controller 201 having one or more processors 202. The one or more processors may be configured to: obtaining first vehicle system data from a first vehicle system of a plurality of vehicle systems 100 based on a common characteristic shared by the plurality of vehicle systems; and obtaining second vehicle system data from a second vehicle system of the plurality of vehicle systems, the second vehicle system data based on the common characteristic shared by the two or more vehicle systems. The one or more processors may be further configured to: comparing 408 the first vehicle system data with the second vehicle system data; and identifying one of the first vehicle system or the second vehicle system as a candidate vehicle system to be serviced 410 based on a comparison of the first vehicle system data and the second vehicle system data.

title_en: Cloud platform-based nondestructive testing four-foot wall climbing robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloud platform-based nondestructive testing four-foot wall climbing robot, which comprises a mechanical transmission subsystem, a real-time detection and control subsystem and a cloud platform detection subsystem; the mechanical transmission subsystem comprises a leg component and a mounting plate, and is used for realizing the free movement of the wall climbing robot in four directions of the inner vertical surface of the boiler and the omnibearing free movement of the horizontal wall surface, and the barrier-crossing movement, so as to finish the nondestructive detection of the working surface of the boiler; the real-time detection and control subsystem is used for realizing the real-time detection of the thickness of the water-cooled tube on the inner vertical surface of the boiler, the crack on the wall surface and the weld on the wall surface, and controlling the movement of the robot; the cloud platform detection subsystem comprises a terminal acquisition and transmission module, a rear-end application service module and a front-end service display module; the invention can greatly shorten the detection time, and can quickly position the defect position and the defect type through cloud computing, thereby changing the current situation that workers enter the boiler for detection.

title_en: Hierarchical image display method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hierarchical image display method, which belongs to the technical field of image display, and comprises the following specific steps: classifying attribute information of the original image; embedding different image information correspondingly according to different attribute information, and generating a corresponding secret key from the different image information; the color image information is extracted from the original color image information in a high-frequency wavelet subband through a color-to-gray mapping algorithm, and a color recovery algorithm is used for reconstructing a color image according to a secret key; hiding the depth image information in a high-frequency wavelet subband by a mapping algorithm from depth to gray scale, and extracting the depth information to reconstruct a depth map by a depth recovery algorithm according to a secret key; and extracting the key according to the display requirement, and extracting the image corresponding to the attribute information from the reconstructed image according to the key to realize hierarchical image display. The method can better realize the embedding and image reconstruction of different attribute information of the image, and the acquired reconstructed image has better quality.

title_en: Portable electronic device and panel antenna module thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable electronic device and a flat antenna module thereof. The panel antenna module comprises an antenna bearing structure, an inner annular radiation structure, a first inner feed-in structure, an outer annular radiation structure and a first outer feed-in structure. The inner annular radiating structure is disposed on the antenna carrying structure. The first inner feed structure is disposed on the antenna carrying structure. The outer annular radiating structure is disposed on the antenna carrying structure. The first external feed structure is disposed on the antenna carrying structure. The inner annular radiating structure and the outer annular radiating structure are respectively arranged on different planes of the antenna bearing structure. Therefore, the inner annular radiating structure and the first inner feed-in structure are mutually matched to form a first antenna assembly for a first antenna operating frequency, the outer annular radiating structure and the first outer feed-in structure are mutually matched to form a second antenna assembly for a second antenna operating frequency, and the first antenna operating frequency of the first antenna assembly is greater than the second antenna operating frequency of the second antenna assembly.

title_en: Electronic device and antenna module
abstract_en: An electronic device and an antenna module. The electronic device comprises a metal shell, a carrier plate, a feed-in piece, a radiation piece and a first parasitic radiation piece; the metal shell is provided with a slotted hole with an open end, and the first upper edge part of the metal shell is positioned at the upper edge of the position where the slotted hole is formed in the metal shell; the carrier plate is arranged in the metal shell; the radiation piece is arranged in the carrier plate, the vertical projection of the radiation piece on the metal shell is at least partially overlapped with the slotted hole, and the radiation piece comprises a feed-in part connected with the feed-in piece; the first parasitic radiating element is arranged on the carrier plate and connected or coupled with the first upper edge part, and the side edge of the first parasitic radiating element is close to the edge of the opening end; the radiation piece is used for feeding in a signal through the feed-in piece to generate at least one resonance mode, and the radiation piece is coupled with the slot hole to excite another resonance mode. According to the electronic device and the antenna module provided by the invention, the upper edge area of the slotted hole antenna is increased by utilizing the first parasitic radiation piece, so that the radiation characteristic of the antenna module is improved, and better radiation efficiency is obtained.

title_en: Digital phased array optical fiber data transmission method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital phased array optical fiber data transmission method in the phased array digital processing field. The method has the advantages that the data framing and the data deframed in the optical fiber transmission are converted into the equal ratio array, the asynchronous FIFO is used for realizing the data framing and the data deframed, the required FIFO depth is far smaller than the data frame length, compared with the ping-pong operation, the method can effectively reduce the requirement of programs on resources, is beneficial to the low-power design of the digital receiving assembly, and can improve the digital processing capacity of the beam forming board card and the digital multi-beam forming capacity.

title_en: Light receiving system based on rotary biprism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a light receiving system based on a rotary biprism, which comprises light receiving, biprism structural design and deflection of received light beams. The system main body structure is formed by coaxially and oppositely arranging two wedge-shaped prisms and is used for deflecting incident light rays to form horizontally emergent light rays. A position detector is used to obtain coordinate information of the light rays exiting the prism. And converging the light rays emitted from the prism structure by using a lens to enable the parallel light rays to be converged on a focus. A photodetector is positioned at the focal point of the lens, and is used to receive the optical signal. The system workflow comprises three stages of light direction estimation, calculation of prism rotation angle and light convergence. In the beam direction estimation stage, the direction of the incident light is determined by using coordinate points on the position detector in combination with an iterative algorithm. The system has the advantages of simple algorithm, light weight, compact structure and high precision.

title_en: Architecture and method for hundred million-level low-altitude intelligent networking centerless identity authentication based on PUF (physical unclonable function)
