abstract_en: The invention discloses a hundred million-level low-altitude intelligent networking centerless identity authentication architecture and a method based on a PUF (physical unclonable function), which comprise an identity authentication architecture, intra-domain local authentication, unmanned aerial vehicle cross-domain authentication and satellite assisted authentication, and provide two secrets based on deterministic messages for realizing hierarchical and weight-dividing authentication of an unmanned aerial vehicle by using a token and a PUF trust root, and carrying out key distribution and the attribute distribution of the unmanned aerial vehicle in an authentication method so as to realize the identity authentication and unmanned aerial vehicle management under the hundred million-level low-altitude intelligent networking. The invention can ensure the safety and the high efficiency of the identity authentication between the low-altitude intelligent networking entities, adopts a centerless method to adapt to hundred million-level unmanned aerial vehicle equipment, and has high flexibility and autonomy.

title_en: Wireless remote upgrading method and device for automatic spray disinfection equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless remote upgrading method and a device for automatic spray disinfection equipment, comprising the following steps: establishing Bluetooth connection with a mobile phone applet; receiving a program upgrading file sent by a mobile phone applet; data interaction is carried out with the central controller; storing the interacted data into a program upgrading memory; restarting to open the bootstrap circuit; and synthesizing an operation mode and finishing upgrading. The invention avoids the complicated disassembly of the shell of the automatic spray disinfection equipment, replaces the wired upgrading mode by the wireless upgrading mode, and improves the productivity and the working efficiency.

title_en: Folding angle detection method and device for folding screen and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a folding angle detection method and device of a folding screen and a readable storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of terminals. The folding screen is an inner screen of the electronic device, the content display area of the folding screen is divided into a first display area and a second display area by a folding shaft, at least two Hall sensors are arranged in the first display area and/or the second display area, at least one magnetic field generating device is further installed in the electronic device and corresponds to the at least two Hall sensors, each magnetic field generating device in the at least one magnetic field generating device is not in the same display area with the corresponding Hall sensor, and accordingly in response to folding operation of the folding screen, the electronic device can determine folding angles between the first display area and the second display area through the magnetic field intensity sensed by each Hall sensor, and accuracy of folding angle detection is improved.

title_en: Single-layer single-feed double-frequency circularly polarized microstrip antenna
abstract_en: The invention provides a single-layer single-feed double-frequency circularly polarized microstrip antenna, which comprises a dielectric substrate, a microstrip patch and a coaxial feed probe, wherein the dielectric substrate is arranged on the microstrip patch; a grounding layer is arranged on one side surface of the dielectric substrate; the microstrip patch is positioned on the other side surface of the dielectric substrate; the surface of the microstrip patch is cut to form a plurality of U-shaped slot grooves which are rotationally distributed; the coaxial feed probe penetrates through the dielectric substrate and is connected with the microstrip patch, an inner coaxial dielectric is arranged between the bottom end of the coaxial feed probe and the grounding layer, and a feeder shielding layer connected with the grounding layer is sleeved outside the inner coaxial dielectric. The invention is different from the existing double-frequency circularly polarized microstrip antenna, the structure of the antenna is simpler, only a single-layer dielectric plate and single-point coaxial feed are used, the size of the antenna is compact, and the antenna is easy to process and produce.

title_en: Metal structure unit, unit and array structure
abstract_en: The application provides a metal structure unit, metal structure unit includes the first metal level that sets up along incident electromagnetic wave direction, and the printing has low frequency unit and a plurality of high frequency unit, the low frequency unit includes first paster, first paster is hollow structure, high frequency unit nest in the hollow structure of first paster. According to the technical scheme, the nesting combination of the high-frequency super-surface unit and the low-frequency super-surface unit is realized, the high-frequency super-surface unit and the low-frequency super-surface unit are provided with independent voltage bias lines, PIN tubes and/or varactors, the high-frequency unit and the low-frequency unit on the same aperture plane are used for modulating the reflection phase of incident waves simultaneously, independently and dynamically, the working requirements of dual-band electromagnetic modulation can be met, and the system integration and the cost reduction are facilitated.

title_en: Multi-antenna back scattering communication method, device and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-antenna back scattering communication method, a device and a system, which belong to the technical field of wireless communication, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the environmental excitation source emits an excitation signal; the multi-antenna back scattering tag reflects the excitation signal and simultaneously realizes multi-dimensional mapping of tag information by selecting an antenna and controlling an impedance network; the receiver decouples the coupling channels of the direct link and the cascade backscatter link according to the joint pilot frequency corresponding to the multi-antenna backscatter tag and the environment excitation source, and estimates the channels of the direct link and the cascade backscatter link respectively; the environmental stimulus signal is first detected based on the estimated decoupling channel, and then the multi-dimensionally mapped back-scattered signal is detected based on inter-link signal characteristics. The invention provides a unified application framework for the multi-antenna back scattering tag, which can flexibly utilize space, time and index dimension resources to carry out information mapping, and realize back scattering high-speed and high-reliability transmission.

title_en: Electronic device and method for setting path of transmission signal by electronic device
abstract_en: According to various embodiments, an electronic device includes: the wireless communication system includes a communication processor, at least one Radio Frequency Integrated Circuit (RFIC) connected to the communication processor, and a plurality of antennas, each of the plurality of antennas being connected to the at least one RFIC through at least one Radio Frequency Front End (RFFE) circuit to transmit a signal corresponding to at least one communication network, wherein the communication processor may identify information related to a strength of a received signal received through each of the plurality of antennas, identify a maximum transmittable power set corresponding to a transmission path of each of the plurality of antennas, and control a transmission signal to be transmitted through at least one antenna selected from among the plurality of antennas based on at least the identified information related to the received signal strength and the maximum transmittable power. Various other embodiments are possible.

title_en: Pneumatic control valve based on remote dynamic supervision
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of valves, in particular to a pneumatic control valve based on remote dynamic supervision, which comprises a pneumatic execution box and a fluid transfer pipeline, wherein a pneumatic execution mechanism is arranged in the pneumatic execution box, a valve body is positioned in the fluid transfer pipeline, a valve rod is arranged at the top of the valve body, the pneumatic execution mechanism acts on the valve rod, pipeline butt joint assemblies are arranged at two ends of the fluid transfer pipeline, and a valve control panel is fixedly arranged on the front surface of the pneumatic execution box; according to the invention, the valve is controlled through the valve control panel or controlled through the remote control terminal, the valve body is driven by the pneumatic actuating mechanism to realize the opening and closing of the valve, the fluid conveying pipeline and the fluid transfer pipeline are butted and positioned by the pipeline butting assembly, the opening and closing operation analysis module is used for analyzing the opening and closing operation of the valve, and the operation early warning module is used for carrying out maintenance timeliness analysis when receiving an operation reaction qualification signal, so that the subsequent normal operation of the corresponding valve is ensured, and the effective monitoring and the remote dynamic supervision of the corresponding valve are realized.

title_en: Inter-satellite laser communication ranging integrated error compensation method based on optical Doppler effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inter-satellite laser communication ranging integrated error compensation method based on an optical Doppler effect, which belongs to the technical field of communication, and is realized by mainly utilizing a clock frequency measurement and speed calculation module based on optical Doppler frequency shift and a distance calculation module based on dynamic two-way single-way ranging; the invention realizes real-time measurement of the relative speed between terminals by measuring the Doppler frequency shift of the receiving clock relative to the transmitting clock, can realize real-time high-precision speed measurement under the condition of not adding extra hardware, and uses the measured speed to compensate the ranging error under the dynamic condition, thereby greatly improving the ranging precision under the dynamic condition.

title_en: Decoupling structure of dual-polarized MIMO antenna
abstract_en: The invention discloses a decoupling structure of a dual-polarized MIMO antenna, which is applied to a four-unit MIMO antenna and comprises six dielectric plates S1, S2, S3, S4, S5 and S6, wherein the dielectric plates S1 are provided with metal structures P4, the dielectric plates S2 are provided with metal structures P3, the dielectric plates S4 are provided with metal structures P2, the dielectric plates S6 are provided with metal structures P1 and S7 which are cross dielectric plates, the decoupling structure is vertically arranged under an antenna unit, the back surface of the S7 is provided with a T-shaped feeder line P5, the front surface of the decoupling structure is provided with a rectangular metal sheet P6 and S8 which are cross dielectric plates, the decoupling structure is vertically arranged between adjacent isolation wall dielectric plates S9, the back surface of the decoupling structure is provided with U-shaped metal square rings P7 and S9 which are metal isolation walls and are enclosed around the cross dielectric plates S7, and M is a metal reflecting plate. The invention has the advantages that the decoupling structure is innovative, and under the condition that the space between the antenna units is smaller, the isolation degree is higher in a wider bandwidth.

title_en: Antenna assembly and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an antenna assembly and electronic equipment, wherein the antenna assembly comprises N turns of coils, a first isolator and a second isolator, wherein the first isolator is positioned on the front surface of the N turns of coils and covers at least part of areas of M turns of the N turns of coils from outside to inside, and M is a positive integer smaller than N; the second separator is positioned on the reverse side of the N-turn coil and covers at least part of the N-turn coil except part of the M-turn coil; wherein the first and second spacers are ferrite or nanocrystals.

title_en: Active user and transmission delay detection method for asynchronous large-scale system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of information and communication, and relates to an active user and transmission delay detection method for an asynchronous large-scale system. In view of the problems in current random access protocols that it is impractical to allocate different pilot sequences for such a large number of users, and that collisions inevitably occur due to the limited number of pilot sequences, the present invention proposes a joint detection scheme of active users and propagation delays that iteratively detects active users and estimates their propagation delays, and identifies conflicting users by means of different propagation delays. Due to sporadic user activity patterns, the active user detection problem can be expressed as a compressed sensing problem, which is solved by the improved Turbo-CS algorithm. In addition, a delay calibration method based on expectation maximization is provided for transmission delay estimation of active users. The simulation results verify the superior performance of the proposed algorithm in terms of miss probability and identifiable number of active users.

title_en: Radio frequency processing method and system based on combiner
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of wireless communication, in particular to a radio frequency processing method and a system based on a combiner, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the device comprises a radio frequency interface, a preprocessing circuit, a power divider circuit, a mixing circuit, a filter circuit, an amplifier circuit, a phase shifter circuit, a combiner circuit, an analog-to-digital conversion circuit, a baseband processing circuit and a parameter adjusting circuit. The application can keep that only one radio frequency receiving port is needed in the prior art, and only one AD conversion circuit is needed to realize the quadrature mixing of radio frequency signals, in addition, the parameter adjusting circuit of the application adjusts mixing and filtering parameters according to feedback signals, and can also improve the signal processing quality in the process of receiving and transmitting the radio frequency signals to a baseband, and improve the signal to noise ratio of the signals.

title_en: Solar intelligent well lid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a solar intelligent well cover, wherein one side of the well cover is hinged with a well seat, a solar window and a display screen window are arranged on the well cover, a mounting sleeve is arranged on the lower side of the well cover, a mounting seat is arranged in the mounting sleeve, a first positioning groove is arranged at the upper side of the mounting seat and corresponds to the position of the solar window, a second positioning groove is arranged at the position of the upper side of the mounting seat and corresponds to the position of the display screen window, a solar panel is arranged in the first positioning groove, a display screen is arranged in the second positioning groove, a mounting cavity is formed on the lower side of the mounting seat, a power supply module and a control module are arranged in the mounting cavity, a fixed pressing plate is arranged at the lower end of the mounting sleeve in a threaded manner, the mounting seat is pressed and positioned through the fixed pressing plate, and sealing rings are arranged between the fixed pressing plate and the mounting sleeve and between the fixed pressing plate and the mounting seat. The invention has simple structure and convenient disassembly and assembly, ensures the sealing in the installation cavity, and ensures that the electric elements in the installation cavity are not influenced by moisture in the electric inspection well and the like.

title_en: High-performance hybrid helical antenna
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of antennas, and relates to a high-performance hybrid helical antenna which comprises a plane helix, a cylindrical helix and a spherical helix, wherein the diameter of the cylindrical helix is equal to the central wavelength of a radiation wave, the diameters of the plane helix and the spherical helix are equal to the diameter of the cylindrical helix, the plane helix and the spherical helix are of self-compensating structures, the number of turns of the plane helix is more than six, the number of turns of the cylindrical helix is more than five, the number of turns of the spherical helix is more than three, the plane helix, the cylindrical helix and the spherical helix all comprise two helical arms which are mutually wound by 180 degrees, the two helical arms of the plane helix are respectively connected with the two helical arms of the spherical helix through the two helical arms of the cylindrical helix, and the two helical arms of the spherical helix are mutually connected. The application has the advantages of ultra-wideband, directivity and axial ratio and improves various performances of the spiral antenna.

title_en: Preparation method of terahertz absorber and terahertz absorber
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a terahertz absorber and the terahertz absorber, and the method comprises the following steps: preparing a metal layer; preparing a dielectric layer on the upper surface of the metal layer by taking the metal layer as a substrate; based on a target frequency band of the terahertz absorber acting on the terahertz waves, a gradient optimization algorithm is utilized to carry out iterative optimization to obtain a target arrangement mode of a plurality of phase change material patches; based on the target arrangement mode of the phase change material patches, the phase change material patches are attached to the upper surface of the dielectric layer, so that the terahertz absorber is prepared.

title_en: Patch radiating element
abstract_en: The invention discloses a patch radiating unit which comprises a reflecting plate and a radiating unit arranged on one side surface of the reflecting plate, wherein the radiating unit comprises a radiating patch, a feed balun and a matching network, the radiating patch is electrically connected with the matching network through the feed balun, the matching network is fixed on the reflecting plate, the radiating patch is of a curved surface structure arched in a direction away from the reflecting plate, and at least one slot line is arranged on the radiating patch. The invention adopts the structure of conformal curved surface and grooved surface, and can effectively widen the working bandwidth of the antenna on the premise of reducing the width of the radiating unit.

title_en: Information processing method, system, server and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of communication and discloses an information processing method, an information processing system, a server and a storage medium. The information processing method is applied to the master device, the master device is connected with the slave device, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the input/output IO port level of a first device on the main equipment through a preset transmission line resource; when the IO port level of the first device is the first level, after the IO port level of the first device is adjusted to the second level, preset transmission information is sent to the slave device through the transmission line resource, so that the slave device can process the transmission information. The main equipment acquires the IO port level of the first device through one transmission line resource and transmits information to the slave equipment, so that the functions of board card state identification and various information transmission can be realized on the same transmission line resource, and meanwhile, the utilization rate of hardware resources can be improved through multiplexing of the transmission line resource, and the competitive advantage of server products is improved.

title_en: Vibration prompt control method, vibration prompt control device and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a vibration prompt control method, a vibration prompt control device and a storage medium. The vibration prompt control method is applied to the terminal and comprises the following steps: responding to the vibration instruction detected by the terminal, determining scene parameters currently used by the terminal, and determining vibration parameters matched with the scene parameters currently used; and controlling the terminal to perform vibration prompt based on the vibration parameters. According to the embodiment of the disclosure, the terminal can be controlled to perform vibration prompt based on the used scene parameters, so that the situation that the terminal corresponds to the same vibration parameter in any scene is avoided, and the user experience is improved.

title_en: Baseband receiving system and baseband receiving method for foundation navigation signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a baseband receiving system and a baseband receiving method of a foundation navigation signal, which are used for capturing and tracking the foundation navigation time-hopping spread spectrum signal. Wherein the system comprises: a carrier digital controlled oscillator for generating a local carrier signal; a digital down converter for converting the input intermediate frequency sampling signal into a zero intermediate frequency baseband signal and realizing carrier stripping; a code generator driven by a code clock signal output by the code digital control oscillator, and generating three pseudo code sequences of early, immediate and late; the correlator group performs correlation despreading on the baseband signal and the three pseudo code sequences to obtain three I/Q integral values of early, instant and late; a time slot counting and interrupt request module for continuously counting time slots, comparing the counting with a stored signal transmission time hopping pattern, and outputting an interrupt processing request; and the calculation control module is used for writing in the initialization configuration parameters, reading the state and the data, and calculating the control quantity and writing in the module so as to capture and track the foundation navigation signals.

title_en: Inclinometer, inclinometer system and measurement data validity judging method
abstract_en: The invention provides an inclinometer, an inclinometer system and a method for judging the validity of measured data, wherein the inclinometer comprises a repeater, a measuring head and a cable, the repeater comprises an acquisition circuit and a rechargeable battery, the acquisition circuit comprises a singlechip, a power conversion circuit and a power supply bus master station circuit, the acquisition circuit controls the power conversion circuit and the power supply bus master station circuit to be turned on and off through the singlechip, the measuring head comprises a power supply bus slave station circuit, one end of the cable is connected with the power supply bus master station circuit, and the other end of the cable is connected with the power supply bus slave station circuit. Compared with the prior art, the technical scheme of the invention can solve the technical problems of large cable volume, large weight, high cost and poor portability of the inclinometer in the prior art.

title_en: Network scheduling method, device, terminal equipment, network equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a network scheduling method, a device, a terminal device, a network device and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of network communication. The dual-card terminal network scheduling method comprises the steps that a dual-card terminal is loaded with a first card and a second card, the first card can reside in an SA network or an LTE network, the second card resides in the LTE network, when the second card is detected to execute long-term evolution voice VoLET voice service, the first card is in an RRC_IDLE state or an RRC_INACTIVE state, wireless capacity corresponding to the voice service is reported to network equipment of the first card, and when the wireless capacity is used for indicating that the second card executes VoLET voice service, the first card resides in the SA network. Through the technical scheme of the disclosure, the problems of rebuilding, call drop and the like of the second card when the second card is in VoLET voice service caused by the LTE network resource of the second card can be prevented from falling back to the LTE network, so that the stability of the double-card double-pass terminal when VoLET voice service is executed is improved, and the use experience of a user is improved.

title_en: Multi-band testing method for base station antenna
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-frequency band testing method of a base station antenna, which comprises the steps of testing industrial parameter equipment in an indoor environment and an outdoor environment, wherein a signal source, a transmitting antenna, a plurality of industrial parameter equipment and a computer are configured in the indoor environment, the industrial parameter equipment is connected with a multi-serial hub device, the multi-serial hub device is connected with the computer, a radio frequency line is used for connecting the signal source and the transmitting antenna before detection, the signal source is electrified, and a signal source output frequency band, transmitting power and a signal output mode are set; a second dimensional array of high band radiating elements mounted on a front face of the back plane, wherein an uppermost one of the high band radiating elements is mounted on the front face of the back plane higher than an uppermost one of the low band radiating elements and an uppermost one of the mid band radiating elements when the base station antenna is mounted for use.

title_en: Method, system and medium for predicting large-scale multiple-input multiple-output system channel
abstract_en: The invention provides a channel prediction method, a system and a medium for a base extension extrapolation large-scale multiple-input multiple-output system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: modeling an uplink channel by using a base extension model, representing the uplink channel as a small number of unknown BEM coefficients, and reconstructing the uplink channel by estimating the small number of unknown BEM coefficients; representing the estimated uplink channel as a linear combination of the discrete ellipsoid BEM and the corresponding coefficients to reduce the complexity of the downlink channel prediction; and predicting the coefficients of the DPS-BEM of the downlink time variation, and using the DPS-BEM coefficients obtained by prediction for the recovery of the downlink channel. The invention relieves the problem of channel aging in a large-scale MIMO TDD system.

title_en: Time domain carrier communication method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a time domain carrier communication method, which is applied to a wireless charging system, wherein the system comprises a transmitting end and a receiving end which are respectively provided with a wireless communication module and a coil, and the method comprises the following steps: the transmitting terminal activates a transmitting terminal wireless communication module and generates a transmitting terminal wireless communication address; the transmitting end transmits the wireless communication address to the receiving end in a carrier mode; after the receiving end coil captures the carrier voltage, processing the received carrier signal and broadcasting the processed data; after the transmitting end wireless communication module scans the broadcast data, the broadcast data content is compared with the wireless communication address, and if the broadcast data is consistent with the transmitting end wireless communication address, the transmitting end initiates the connection action of the wireless communication module to the receiving end. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device can ensure the connection uniqueness of the wireless communication module, and solve the problems of wireless charging and the like caused by data transmission errors due to wrong connection.

title_en: Time dimension topology boundary state observation method for microwave section time photonic crystal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a time dimension topological boundary state observation method of a microwave section time photonic crystal, and belongs to the technical field of time photonic crystals. The method loads the varactors on two sides of the microstrip transmission line in a differential feed mode, and constructs a time photonic crystal structure capable of dynamically modulating the relative dielectric constant of the microstrip transmission line; the method of the invention adopts a differential modulation structure, can isolate the influence of a modulation signal on a main transmission signal, and directly observe a time photonic crystal k The exponential amplification characteristic and the time dimension topological boundary state in the band gap realize the observation of the time domain response characteristic of the time photonic crystal.

title_en: Space constellation design method and related device based on MIMO-VLC
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space constellation design method and a related device based on MIMO-VLC, and relates to the technical field of new-generation communication. The space constellation design method and the related device based on MIMO-VLC take the correlation between effective active groups into consideration M Each symbol space in the first-order unipolar PAM symbol set is divided into a plurality of subspaces of effective activation groups, the unipolar PAM symbols of each subspace are calculated to form a new unipolar PAM symbol set, therefore, all the effective activation groups can be allocated with different unipolar PAM symbols for bit mapping, the problem that the existing space constellation design method based on MIMO-VLC does not consider the characteristic that the MIMO-VLC channel has correlation is solved, and a plurality of activation components are arrangedThe same single-polarity PAM modulation symbol set is shared, so that the external mutual information output by the demapper is unreliable, and the performance of the GSM constellation system is affected.

title_en: Intelligent park security system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent security system of a park based on edge calculation, which relates to the technical field of intelligent security of the park, and aims to solve and obtain a new data transmission allocation strategy by setting a real-time data collection module to collect real-time data generation states and data processing states in the park in real time and setting a data real-time transmission module to abstract a problem of generating a transmission strategy for newly generated data into an integer convex optimization problem when the data of the edge calculation equipment is overloaded by setting a park information collection module to collect security monitoring equipment information, edge calculation equipment information and communication information of the park in advance and setting a processing program distribution module to abstract the problem of distributing a processing program for each edge calculation equipment into an integer planning problem so as to minimize the weighted sum of total communication time and the number of used edge calculation equipment; the irrecoverable loss caused by the failure to find security accidents in time is avoided.

title_en: Leaky-wave antenna, leaky-wave antenna array and antenna system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of orbital angular momentum wireless communication, in particular to a leaky-wave antenna, a leaky-wave antenna array and an antenna system. Comprising the following steps: the radiation structure, the transition structure and the excitation structure are respectively arranged on different metal plates, and the radiation structure comprises an annular cavity and an opening; the transition structure comprises a via hole arranged on the metal plate; the excitation structure comprises two gradual change wave guide grooves, and one end of each gradual change wave guide groove is used as an excitation port of the leaky-wave antenna; the upper and lower parts of the through hole of the transition structure are respectively connected with the opening of the radiation structure and the other end of each gradual change wave guiding groove of the excitation structure. When the leaky-wave antenna is excited, electromagnetic waves are transmitted into the annular cavity of the radiation structure from the other port, the via hole and the opening of the radiation structure along the gradual change wave guide groove, the annular cavity radiates OAM wave beams into the space, the electromagnetic waves are converted from the waveguide mode to the OAM mode, and the development of wireless communication of millimeter wave OAM is accelerated.

title_en: Fraud early warning method, device, electronic equipment and computer readable medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fraud early warning method, a fraud early warning device, electronic equipment and a computer readable medium, and relates to the technical field of communication. The method comprises the steps of determining a first association range object of a called party of a current call under the condition that the current call is determined to belong to a fraud call, determining a second association range object of the called party from the first association range object according to social interaction data between the called party and the first association range object, and sending an early warning reminding message to the called party and the second association range object of the called party. According to the method, under the condition that the current call is a fraud call, the second association range object of the called party is identified in real time, and then the early warning reminding message is sent to the called party and the second association range object of the called party, so that the second association range object of the called party can be timely called Fang Jinfang fraud, people with weak fraud awareness can be effectively protected, the fraud risk is reduced, the fraud call prevention effect is improved to the greatest extent, and meanwhile, the fraud call distinguishing capability of the called party and the second association range object of the called party can be improved.

title_en: Satellite-borne SAR antenna with modularized laminated layout structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a satellite-borne SAR antenna with a modularized laminated layout structure, which comprises the following components: each antenna module comprises a radiation coupling layer, a transfer joint layer, a radio frequency network layer and an active control layer, wherein each radiation coupling layer is arranged on a corresponding installation position on the array surface frame, a feed network interface, a calibration network connection port, a low-frequency cable connection port, an array surface thermal control implementation plane and a fixed interface are arranged on the lower surface of the radiation coupling layer, the transfer joint layer is arranged on the upper surface of the radiation coupling layer, the transfer joint layer is electrically connected with the radiation coupling layer, the radio frequency network layer is arranged on the transfer joint layer, the radio frequency network layer is electrically connected with the radiation coupling layer, the active control layer is arranged on the radio frequency network layer, and the active control layer is electrically connected with the radiation coupling layer; the feed network is connected with the radiation coupling layer through a feed network interface, the calibration network is connected with the radiation coupling layer through a calibration network connection port, and the array surface thermal control system is arranged on an array surface thermal control implementation plane and is used for conducting heat to the antenna module; the low-frequency cable is communicated with the radiation coupling layer through a low-frequency cable connection port and is used for providing control signals for the antenna module.

title_en: All-optical mode matching method, system and electronic equipment for QPSK signals
abstract_en: The application provides a full-optical mode matching method, a full-optical mode matching system and electronic equipment for QPSK signals, which can directly participate in a matching process by doubling the phase to replace a phase compression method in a related technology. The complexity of the matching method is reduced, the symbol processing process is simplified, the efficiency of the matching method is improved, and the pattern recognition can be rapidly and effectively completed. And the number of optical devices used by the matching system is greatly reduced, the system cost is reduced, and the on-chip integration of the matching system is facilitated.

title_en: Method for improving tuning performance of optical module, optical module and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of optical communication, and relates to a method for improving tuning performance of an optical module, the optical module and a readable storage medium, wherein a current signal value I is controlled by a monitoring target  set  And control current signal initial value I  init  Is the difference I between (1)  ▽  When it is greater than the current deviation reference value I  th  When using the target control current signal value I  set  Replacing the initial value I of the control current signal  init  Or monitoring whether the time T of the operation of the optical module is greater than the time deviation reference value T  th  The time T is greater than the time deviation reference value T  th  At the time, the target control current signal value I is saved  set  Continuously correcting and adjusting the initial value I of the control current signal  init  Reducing the value of the control current signal I and the target control current signal  set  The tuning performance of the optical module can be kept at a high level.

title_en: Unidirectional transmission system, unidirectional transmission method, unidirectional transmission device, unidirectional transmission equipment and unidirectional transmission medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a unidirectional transmission system, a unidirectional transmission method, unidirectional transmission device, unidirectional transmission equipment and unidirectional transmission media, which are used for solving the problems that in the prior art, a satellite cannot send downlink data to a UE (user equipment) due to various reasons, so that operations such as authentication, handshake and the like cannot be performed between the satellite and the UE, and the data of the UE cannot be effectively transmitted to the satellite. In the embodiment of the invention, after the UE sends the RRC connection request, the RRC request comprises a control plane Non-IP small data area, and the control plane Non-IP small data area comprises data to be sent, so that the data of the UE can be sent to the satellite, and therefore, when the satellite cannot send downlink data to the UE due to various reasons in the embodiment of the invention, the data of the UE can still be effectively transmitted to the satellite.

title_en: Nonlinear calibration device and method for amplifier
abstract_en: The application provides a nonlinear calibration device and method of an amplifier, which relate to the technical field of data processing and comprise the following steps: the device comprises a predistortion module, a signal processing module and an error analysis module, wherein the signal processing module is respectively in communication connection with the predistortion module and the error analysis module; the predistortion module is used for carrying out nonlinear processing on an input signal and outputting a first signal; the signal processing module is used for sequentially carrying out power amplification, power division, down-conversion, low-pass filtering and intermediate frequency signal sampling processing on the first signal, and dividing the first signal into a plurality of power amplifier output signals; the error analysis module is used for analyzing the errors of the input signals and the output signals of each power amplifier to obtain a first weight, and the first weight is used for performing the nonlinear processing.

title_en: Interference-free point selection method and device for optical channel
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for selecting interference-free points for optical channels, which are characterized in that the optical channels are mapped on a voltage distribution coordinate system, the positions of the optical channels and interference areas thereof are represented by the energy supply voltage of a chip, grid points are arranged on the coordinate system, any two optical channels are a connection group, the connection group is connected with all grid points, the grid point with the least connection line passing through the interference areas of all connection groups is obtained as a preferred grid point, the preferred grid point and the corresponding connection group are used as preferred optical paths, and a preferred optical path set with the least number of cut optical channels is obtained through iteration, wherein the preferred optical path set is a final optical path.

title_en: Remote diagnosis method for natural gas metering analysis equipment
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a remote diagnostic method of a natural gas gauge analysis device, comprising: the natural gas metering diagnostic system comprises: one or more monitoring stations interconnected by a network, the monitoring stations including an edge processor, and a detection unit and an alarm unit respectively connected to the edge processor. The method comprises the following steps: the edge processor receives the detection data sent by the detection unit; and the edge processor diagnoses the detection unit according to the detection data, and controls the alarm unit to alarm in response to determining that the detection unit diagnoses abnormality. According to the application, after the edge processor determines that the diagnosis is abnormal, the alarm unit is controlled to alarm, and the edge processor replaces the remote central data acquisition server. The problem that the remote central data acquisition server cannot perform diagnosis work because data cannot be obtained due to network faults is avoided, and the problem that the diagnosis work cannot be performed is avoided.

title_en: Diffusion model-based generated image steganography method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a generation type image steganography method based on a diffusion model, which relates to the technical field of information security and mainly comprises two parts of secret picture generation and secret information extraction, wherein the process of secret picture generation is as follows: 1. secret information encryption; 2. dividing secret information sub-blocks; 3. mapping each secret information sub-block to a hidden space to generate a hidden vector; 4. and inputting the hidden vector into a diffusion model to generate a secret-carrying picture. The secret information extraction process comprises the following steps: 1. reading the encrypted picture data and inputting the encrypted picture data into an extraction network to recover hidden vectors; 2. extracting secret information in the hidden vector; 3. mapping the secret information into a binary bit stream; 4. decrypting to obtain secret information. Therefore, the invention ensures the generation quality of the steganography picture and higher secret information extraction rate while ensuring the high steganography capacity.

title_en: Co-fired ceramic phased array antenna
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a co-fired ceramic phased array antenna, which comprises a low-temperature co-fired ceramic substrate, a radiation antenna array, a radio frequency feed network, a high-temperature co-fired ceramic substrate, a control and power supply network, a radio frequency interface and a device-level TR component, wherein the radio frequency interface is welded on the lower surface of the high-temperature co-fired ceramic substrate, the control and power supply network is positioned in the high-temperature co-fired ceramic substrate, the device-level TR component is welded on the lower surface of the high-temperature co-fired ceramic substrate, the upper surface of the high-temperature co-fired ceramic substrate and the lower surface of the low-temperature co-fired ceramic substrate are welded to form a mixed stacked ceramic substrate, the radio frequency feed network is positioned in the low-temperature co-fired ceramic substrate, and the radiation antenna array is positioned on the upper surface of the low-temperature co-fired ceramic substrate. In this way, the internal stress of the whole structure can be reduced, the heat dissipation capacity of the phased array antenna is improved, the radiation performance of the phased array antenna is enhanced, the miniaturization, integration and light weight of the phased array antenna are realized, and meanwhile, the phased array antenna is guaranteed to have good reliability.

title_en: DMD high frame frequency display system and method matched with photoelectric integration time
abstract_en: The application discloses a DMD high-frame-rate display system and a method for matching photoelectric integration time. The system comprises a detector, an upper computer, a main control board, a DMD, a light source driver, an illumination system and a projection screen, wherein the DMD calculates a frame period of a display image according to phase modulation information, a synchronous signal of the detector and photoelectric integration time data, calculates a maximum frame frequency of the display image based on a binary pulse width modulation method, acquires the changed photoelectric integration time after the photoelectric integration time of the detector changes, calculates a new time base, and modifies parameters of a register in a control time sequence according to the new time base to adjust the display frame frequency of the image. The application can utilize the synchronous signal of the detector to reversely push the display time base according to the photoelectric integration time of the detector, realizes the synchronization of the photoelectric integration time of the detector and the DMD display frame frequency, does not generate false signals, flickering and image confusion phenomena, and can realize the optimal imaging effect.

title_en: Method for indicating precoding matrix, user equipment and access equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method for indicating a precoding matrix, user equipment and access equipment, wherein the method for indicating the precoding matrix comprises the steps of generating indication information, wherein the indication information is used for indicating K  NZ  -v non-zero weighting coefficients, the K  NZ  -v non-zero weighting coefficients belong to K  NZ  non-zero weighting coefficients, v is the transmission layer number, the K  NZ  non-zero weighting coefficients are used for constructing the precoding matrix, the precoding matrix is at least constructed based on the K  NZ  non-zero weighting coefficients, m spatial vectors and n frequency domain vectors, the indication information is generated based on a first mode when a first preset condition is met, the indication information is generated based on a second mode when a second preset condition is met, and the indication information is sent. The embodiment of the invention also provides the user equipment and the access equipment, which can transmit the parameters related to the precoding matrix in different modes according to different conditions, thereby solving the problem that the current protocol is not perfect enough and enabling the reporting scheme to adapt to various configuration scenes.

title_en: Method for rapidly calculating adjacent channel interference
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for rapidly calculating adjacent channel interference, which comprises the following steps: step 1, determining adjacent frequency interference conditions according to the bandwidth overlapping conditions of an interference system and an interfered system; step 2, discretizing the effective range of adjacent channel interference to obtain a discretized value data table; step 3, calculating adjacent channel leakage power ratio ACLR and adjacent channel rejection ratio ACRR according to adjacent channel interference situation based on a discrete dimension reduction mode; and 4, calculating the effective power of the adjacent channel interference according to the ACLR and the ACRR. The method analyzes 7 situations of adjacent frequency interference among stations, adopts a discrete dimension reduction mode to design simple algorithms respectively, remarkably reduces the calculation complexity of the adjacent frequency interference, is particularly suitable for terminals with limited calculation resources such as small portable computers, tablet computers and the like, and can meet the requirements of complex electromagnetic environment or large-scale network interference coexistence analysis on the small calculation terminals.

title_en: Automatic stamping, scanning and binding integrated device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of stamping equipment, in particular to an automatic stamping, scanning and binding integrated device which comprises a base, and is characterized in that a file storage box, a Y moving module, an X moving module, a stamping device, a scanning device, a paper moving mechanism and a binding device are arranged on the base; the Y moving module is connected with the base in a sliding manner and can move along the Y-axis direction; the X moving module is connected with the Y moving module and can move along the X axis direction; the stamping device is connected with the X moving module and is arranged above the file storage box; the scanning device is connected with the base through a scanning bracket and is arranged above the base; the paper moving mechanism is connected with the base and is arranged at one side of the X moving module; the binding device is connected with the base and is arranged on one side of the paper moving mechanism. The invention can realize the integrated automatic stamping, scanning and binding process of the device, saves manpower and time and improves the efficiency of stamping, scanning and binding the files.

title_en: Flexible communication processing load, cooperative communication system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible communication processing load, a cooperative communication system and a method, which combine channelized service forwarding with beam hopping synchronization based on ground gateway station center control by optimizing the design of digital transparent processing load, and realize efficient management and inter-processor cooperative communication of a low-orbit spacecraft in a mode of combining wide area signaling beams with phased array service beams. The invention combines the channelized service forwarding with the jump beam synchronization based on the central control of the ground gateway station by optimizing the design of the digital transparent processing load, and realizes the efficient management and inter-device cooperative communication of the low-orbit spacecraft in a mode of combining the wide area signaling beam with the phased array service beam.

title_en: Underwater sound node self-adaptive retransmission method based on distance measurement and calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater sound node self-adaptive retransmission method based on distance measurement, which comprises the following steps of transmitting data to a target node by a sending node and starting a timer, receiving the data by the target node, transmitting the data to the sending node after processing, judging whether the sending node successfully receives the data transmitted by the target node, retransmitting according to a retransmission rule if the sending node does not receive the data transmitted by the target node or fails to completely and correctly receive the data transmitted by the target node within a retransmission timeout time, completing bidirectional communication by the sending node and the target node, and inputting various characteristics in a communication process and updating other node information tables stored in the sending node. The invention carries out distance measurement and calculation while the nodes communicate, improves the utilization efficiency of data, brings the node characteristic information into the selection standard of the retransmission rule, and continuously updates the node characteristic information, improves the data transmission throughput among the nodes, and improves the adaptability of the nodes under different underwater sound channel conditions.

title_en: Anti-interference circuit, PA-MID architecture and radio frequency transceiver system
abstract_en: The application relates to an anti-interference circuit, a PA-MID framework and a radio frequency receiving and transmitting system, wherein the anti-interference circuit is applied to the PA-MID framework with a power amplifier-multiplexer, the PA-MID framework comprises an intermediate frequency transmitting circuit and a high frequency transmitting circuit, and the anti-interference circuit comprises a switch circuit, a band-pass filter circuit and a band-stop filter circuit. The switching circuit comprises a plurality of paths, and is used for conducting the paths between the intermediate frequency transmitting circuit and the band-stop filter circuit through a first path and conducting the paths between the high frequency transmitting circuit and the band-pass filter circuit through a second path. The band-stop filter circuit is used for filtering target high-frequency signals in signals output by the intermediate-frequency transmitting circuit and the high-frequency transmitting circuit through the first path, and the band-pass filter circuit is used for enabling the target high-frequency signals in the signals output by the high-frequency transmitting circuit through the second path to pass. In the method, the interference between the intermediate frequency signal and the high frequency signal is reduced.

title_en: Method and system for generating wave bitmap spectrum under data wave beam
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for generating a wave bitmap spectrum under a data beam, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1: initializing map information by a wave control module; s2: the UE accesses the data beam and uploads the data beam to the wave control module for identification; s3: the wave control module judges whether the wave position exists in the spectrum, and if the wave position exists, the spectrum is completely included in the wave position; if the wave position exists, carrying out the subsequent steps; s4: the wave control module judges whether the wave position accessed by the UE is in the spectrum or not, and selects whether the spectrum needs to be modified or not according to the judging result; s5: and uploading the modified spectrum to a software module and a hardware module of the satellite, wherein the software module is scheduled according to the spectrum, and the hardware module is scanned according to the spectrum. When a wave position is newly added, the influence on most wave positions in the spectrum is small, and the time for informing the UE by an air interface is reduced.

title_en: Single-layer metamaterial wave absorber for efficiently absorbing electromagnetic waves at 2-4GHz
abstract_en: The invention discloses a single-layer metamaterial wave absorber for efficiently absorbing electromagnetic waves at 2-4GHz, which is a periodic structure formed by a plurality of wave absorbing units, wherein each wave absorbing unit comprises an FSS metal structure, a dielectric layer and a metal bottom plate. The FSS metal structure material is copper, and the conductivity sigma=5.8x10  7  S/m, and the FSS metal structure is a double-loop-shaped double-opening resonant ring structure. The double-loop type double-opening resonant ring is composed of a double-opening resonant structure and a double-opening metal ring outside the double-opening resonant structure. In the implementation process of the invention, the designed FSS metal structure has good filtering effect on electromagnetic waves in a specific low frequency band, reduces reflection of incident waves and allows more electromagnetic waves to enter the structure; the designed double-loop double-opening resonance metal ring can strengthen the intensity of resonance and the position of resonance frequency and increase the loss of incident electromagnetic waves through methods of structure, size, material, arrangement and the like.

title_en: System and method for processing an audio input signal
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and method for processing an audio input signal. A system and method for processing an audio input signal includes a microphone, a controller, and a communication link that may be coupled to a remote speaker. The microphone captures and transmits an audio input signal to the controller, and the controller is coupled to the communication link. The controller includes executable code to generate a first result based on the audio input signal via a linear noise reduction filtering algorithm and a second result based on the first result via a nonlinear post-filtering algorithm. An audio output signal is generated based on the second result using a feature recovery algorithm. The audio output signal is transmitted via a communication link to a speaker, which may be at a remote location.

title_en: Circularly polarized feed network and circularly polarized antenna
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a single-feed-point circularly polarized feed network and a circularly polarized antenna, and relates to the technical field of antennas. The circularly polarized feed network comprises a strip line (1), a first phase region (2), a second phase extension line (3) and an outer ring metal ground (10), wherein the first phase region (2) and the second phase extension line (3) are positioned on two sides of the strip line (1) and are connected with the strip line (1). The first phase region (2) and the second phase extension line (3) are used for generating two electric field components with equal amplitude and 90 DEG phase difference. The phase difference of 90 DEG components can be adjusted by adjusting the sizes of the first phase region and the second phase extension line, and the two components are synthesized to form circular polarization. The circular polarization feed network can be scaled in equal proportion to realize the use in different frequency bands.

title_en: Communication method and device for multi-robot collaborative operation and communication middleware
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of robot communication, and discloses a communication method for multi-robot collaborative operation. The communication method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first state parameter and a first time stamp of the robot acquired by each controller; the first state parameters are in one-to-one correspondence with the first time stamps; performing time stamp synchronization on the plurality of first state parameters and the first time stamp to obtain a plurality of second state parameters with the same time stamp; packaging the plurality of second state parameters into a state parameter frame, and sending the state parameter frame to upper-layer software; obtaining a control instruction frame corresponding to the state parameter frame through upper software; and feeding back a corresponding control instruction to each controller according to the control instruction frame, so that each controller can control the corresponding robot. By adopting the communication method, the cooperative work effect of robots of different types can be improved. The application also discloses a communication device and a communication middleware for the collaborative operation of the multiple robots.

title_en: Multimode crosstalk analysis method based on distributed deep neural network mode field identification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multimode crosstalk analysis method based on distributed deep neural network mode field identification, which comprises the steps of training a used distributed deep neural network, obtaining different crosstalk information by changing the propagation modes of optical signals in different optical transmission systems, generating images by the crosstalk information and inputting the images into the distributed deep neural network for training to obtain a required distributed deep neural network mode crosstalk identification model, and combining the obtained crosstalk identification model with different optical transmission systems to obtain corresponding quicker and more accurate mode crosstalk information. Compared with the traditional image recognition technology, the distributed deep neural network improves the accuracy, communication and delay requirements of image recognition, and simultaneously obtains higher fault tolerance and privacy.

title_en: Antenna device adopting foldable memory metal and deployment method
abstract_en: An Artificial Magnetic Conductor (AMC) antenna device comprising a ground plane and a flexible antenna element layer above the ground plane. The ground plane includes a conductive substrate surface, a plurality of memory metal wires, and a Frequency Selective Surface (FSS) layer over the substrate surface, wherein the FSS layer includes a plurality of conductive patches spaced apart from one another. Each of the memory metal wires electrically connects one of the conductive patches to the substrate surface. Each of the memory metal wires is rigid in a memory shape state such that the FSS layer is fixedly spaced apart from the substrate surface during operation of the AMC antenna device. The memory metal wires are flexible in the non-memory shape state such that the FSS layer is able to contract towards the substrate surface when the antenna device is stowed.

title_en: Ultra-wideband integrated circularly polarized tightly coupled array antenna based on sequential rotation technology
abstract_en: The application discloses an ultra-wideband integrated circularly polarized tightly coupled array antenna based on a sequential rotation technology, which comprises the following components: a multilayer dielectric substrate, a metal floor, a resistor disc and 4 array units; the array unit adopts a tightly coupled design structure and comprises a 90-degree phase shifter, an I-shaped metal sheet, a square-like metal sheet and seven metal through holes, adjacent units are connected through the metal sheet and rotated by 90 degrees, four adjacent feeds used by the array have 90-degree phase differences, and the units matched with the rotation form a sequential rotation structure. The application adopts a tight coupling structure, so that the antenna has ultra-wide working bandwidth under a lower section, and the whole array applies a sequential rotation technology, so that the antenna has good circular polarization performance under the ultra-wide working bandwidth; meanwhile, the integrated design is adopted, and the device has the advantages of compact structure, space saving, low cost and the like.

title_en: Relay satellite data transmission baseband pool monitoring software system based on micro-service architecture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a relay satellite data transmission baseband pool monitoring software system based on a micro-service architecture, and relates to the technical field of software communication. The system comprises a hardware environment layer, a platform support layer, a business service layer and a man-machine interaction layer, wherein the hardware environment layer provides a basic hardware environment for business function operation, an all-in-one machine and a gigabit network switch are adopted, the platform support layer develops a dependent basic plug-in and a software operation environment based on a SpringCloud micro-service platform to realize software function servitization, provides a software operation framework for monitoring software of a baseband pool to complete unified service management, the business service layer provides data access service, general service and business processing service and concentrates on different business requirements, and the man-machine interaction layer provides man-machine interaction interfaces for various operation users and displays functions of a resource pool in view. The invention has high utilization rate, low maintenance and upgrading cost, and high reconfigurability and expansibility.

title_en: 1bit graphene coding super surface with beam deflection capability and coding method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 1bit graphene coding super surface with beam deflection capability, which comprises a square first dielectric substrate and a square second dielectric substrate which are stacked up and down; four square graphene patches are printed on the upper surface of the first dielectric substrate, the four square graphene patches are symmetrical with respect to the center of the first dielectric substrate, and a metal bottom plate is printed on the lower surface of the second dielectric substrate; each graphene patch consists of 20 x 20 small graphene square sheets, the square resistance selected by each small graphene is Rs=10Ω/sq or Rs=1000Ω/sq, and each small graphene square sheet is coded according to different square resistances of each small graphene square sheet, compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that bias voltage does not need to be externally applied, the ultra-surface is coded by adopting graphene, and the beam deflection in the millimeter wave field is realized; the electromagnetic characteristics of the graphene are not changed, and the voltage interference is avoided; is convenient to manufacture.

title_en: Communication method of broadband carrier communication network
abstract_en: A communication method of broadband carrier communication network, set up the table case relay broadband carrier communication module that can three-phase communication in the line entrance of each table case, there are any two nodes with three-phase communication ability of the multi-phase communication channel, choose the best phase channel of link quality between two as the information transmission channel, the signal monitoring phase of the three-phase relay communication node in the beacon time slot district is this information transmission channel, and adjust according to the sending phase information of the residual signal; selecting a three-phase relay communication node with the best quality of a communication link as an agent node after the single-phase communication node is accessed to the network; after the single-phase communication node selects the full-weight proxy node, if a three-phase relay communication node with better communication link quality is provided, the full-weight proxy node is changed; when the master node checks meter, the node in the node set taking a certain three-phase relay communication node as the full-weight proxy node can check meter point by point or directly check the service data of the three-phase relay communication node.

title_en: Ground control device for high-speed pulse communication and regulation and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a ground control device for high-speed pulse communication and a regulation and control method thereof, wherein the ground control device comprises a flow regulation component and a quick code-transmitting component, one end of the quick code-transmitting component is connected with one end of the flow regulation component in series, the other end of the quick code-transmitting component is connected with a water injection pipeline, the other end of the flow regulation component is connected with an underground water distributor in series through a water injection pipeline, a main control board of the ground control device is electrically connected with the quick code-transmitting component and the flow regulation component, the main control board continuously opens and closes the quick code-transmitting component to enable high-low variable pressure waveforms in the water injection pipeline, the underground water distributor detects the variable pressure waveforms in the water injection pipeline, and pressure pulse communication between the underground water distributor and the ground control device is realized through pressure codes generated by the pressure waveforms. The invention has the advantages that the rapid code sending function is added, the main control board regulates and controls the rapid code sending component to realize fine flow regulation and rapid code sending, and the intelligent separated layer water injection system of the oil field is beneficial to high-efficiency management.

title_en: Inertial navigation error compensation method for mechanical phased array antenna
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for inertial navigation error compensation of a mechanical phased array antenna, and relates to the technical field of antennas. An inertial navigation error compensation system is formed by an antenna body, a mechanical platform, an antenna carrier and a positioning satellite, and the satellite is used as a reference target so as to correct errors generated by inertial navigation; by carrying out large dynamic change monitoring, inertial navigation error compensation under the unstable condition is avoided; when inertial navigation error compensation is carried out, determining the direction of the antenna pointing to the satellite by searching the maximum value of signal intensity; the problem of signal loss caused by pitching change of the mechanical platform is considered, the problem of signal attenuation caused by different signal frequencies is considered, and accurate and effective maximum signal intensity is found after the signal attenuation is respectively supplemented; the current inertial navigation attitude data can be subjected to error compensation by solving the positioning error data and reversely calculating the inertial navigation attitude error; the low-precision inertial navigation can meet the deployment requirement of the mechanical phased array antenna, and has practical and popularization values.

title_en: Novel low-insertion-loss duplexer based on IPD technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel low-insertion-loss duplexer based on an IPD technology. The invention is mainly composed of a circuit layer, a grounding ring surrounding the circuit layer and a dielectric layer. The circuit layer includes a first capacitor, a second capacitor, a third capacitor, a fourth capacitor, a fifth capacitor, a sixth capacitor, a seventh capacitor, an eighth capacitor, a first inductor, a second inductor, a third inductor, a fourth inductor, and a fifth inductor. Through novel topological structure, realize low insertion loss, high isolation duplexer, wherein through adding LC series resonator and LC parallel resonator and producing the selectivity of the duplexer in the mode of zero point outside the band, strengthen the performance of the duplexer.

title_en: Optical fiber dispersion measuring system and method
abstract_en: The application provides an optical fiber dispersion measurement system and method, wherein the system comprises a transmitting end device and a receiving end device connected with the transmitting end device through an optical fiber link to be measured, the transmitting end device comprises a signal combiner, an optical carrier generating unit and an electro-optical modulation unit, the signal combiner and the optical carrier generating unit are connected with the electro-optical modulation unit, the receiving end device comprises a wavelength division multiplexer, the input end of the wavelength division multiplexer is connected with the electro-optical modulation unit through the optical fiber link to be measured, the output end of the wavelength division multiplexer is respectively connected with a first optical signal shunt demodulation unit and a second optical signal shunt demodulation unit, and the first optical signal shunt demodulation unit and the second optical signal shunt demodulation unit are connected with a measuring and calculating unit. The application combines the time interval measurement result of the low-frequency pulse signal with the phase difference detection result of the high-frequency periodic signal, calculates the dispersion quantity through the wavelength difference and the dispersion delay difference of the optical carrier, and effectively improves the measurement accuracy of the dispersion quantity.

title_en: Self-compensating analog beam forming traveling wave phased array
abstract_en: An antenna array comprising two traveling wave sub-arrays is disclosed. The antenna array has two or more feed lines for providing transmit signals to the antenna array of each subarray. The transmission signals propagate in opposite directions to each other in the feeder line. The antenna array provides improved beam deflection compensation and continuous beam controllability while maintaining a simple cost-effective structure.

title_en: Intelligent identification and management method and system for identities of labor workers
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a system for intelligent identification and management of the identity of a labor worker, wherein the method comprises the steps that when face image acquisition equipment acquires the face image of the labor worker, the face image is sent to an image splitting model; the image splitting model determines a splitting area based on the face image and splits the face image into a plurality of partial images based on the splitting area; identifying image features of a plurality of partial images, screening out target partial images containing the target features of the sensitive parts of the human face, and anonymizing the target partial images; and storing the anonymized face image and a plurality of partial images corresponding to the face image. The method and the device have the effect of improving the safety of the face data of the labor staff.

title_en: Image forming apparatus having a plurality of image forming units
abstract_en: The invention provides an image forming apparatus for transmitting and receiving electronic mail by using a token. The image forming apparatus according to an embodiment includes an image forming unit, a token acquiring unit, a token storing unit, and an email transmitting/receiving unit. The image forming section forms an image on a sheet. The token acquisition section performs authentication and authorization with the authorization server to acquire a token. The token storage unit stores the token acquired by the token acquisition unit. The email transmitting/receiving unit requests the token from the token acquiring unit, and transmits/receives email to/from the email server using the token responded from the token acquiring unit.

title_en: Conference voice detection method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of voice detection, in particular to a conference voice detection method and system based on deep learning. The method can timely and efficiently search and collect contents of words or hot words which are focused in the conference, and is beneficial to improving conference efficiency. Detecting sensitive word information in the acoustic characteristic voice data by using the target ResNet residual network identification model by acquiring the acoustic characteristic voice data and establishing the target ResNet residual network identification model; if the acoustic feature voice data contains sensitive words, inputting the acoustic feature voice data into a database for storage, wherein the sensitive words at least comprise event sensitive words and character sensitive words; judging the audio class information in the acoustic characteristic voice data based on the target ResNet residual error network identification model; if the proportion of the dispute voice information in the audio class information is larger than that of the normal voice information, a conference mediation instruction is generated, and the conference mediation instruction is transmitted to a server or a manager.

title_en: Full-bandwidth tunable waveguide magic T with electromagnetic damage resistance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-bandwidth tunable waveguide magic T with electromagnetic damage resistance, and relates to the technical field of microwaves.
