The waveguide magic T comprises a waveguide magic T main body, the waveguide magic T main body comprises a left balance arm and a right balance arm which are symmetrical left and right and are mutually communicated, a vertical E arm is arranged above the center of the joint of the left balance arm and the right balance arm, an H arm is positioned on the side of the center of the joint of the left balance arm and the right balance arm, electromagnetic damage resistant structures are arranged in inner cavities of the left balance arm and the right balance arm, a first bandwidth matching boss is formed on the bottom wall of the inner cavity between the left balance arm and the right balance arm, a second bandwidth matching boss is formed on the upper surface of the first bandwidth matching boss, the lower end of a tuning probe is positioned on the outer side of the waveguide magic T main body, and the upper end of the tuning probe penetrates out from the upper surface of the second bandwidth matching boss. The waveguide magic T has good bandwidth matching and electromagnetic damage resistance, and is high in integration and small in size.

title_en: System and method for processing speech audio stream interrupt
abstract_en: An apparatus for communication includes one or more processors configured to receive a voice audio stream representing voice of a first user during an online meeting. The one or more processors are further configured to receive a text stream representing speech of the first user. The one or more processors are further configured to selectively generate an output based on the text stream in response to an interruption in the speech audio stream.

title_en: Multi-intensity quantum direct communication method and system based on single photon source protocol
abstract_en: The application provides a multi-intensity quantum direct communication method and a system based on a single photon source protocol, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the information receiving end prepares single photon sequences with various light intensities through a decoy state technology and transmits the single photon sequences to the information transmitting end; after the information sending end receives photon information, the information receiving end discloses photon information preparation, and the information sending end and the information receiving end confirm communication safety and parameter estimation; the information transmitting end codes the message through the random number by combining photons with various light intensities and a capacity expansion technology based on masking, calculates a message hash value according to a preset method, and transmits the hash value and a coding result to the information receiving end in a quantum direct communication mode; after the information receiving end receives photon information sent back by the information sending end, the information sending end discloses a random number and a hash value; the information receiving end decodes the received message, and the message sending end and the message receiving end perform parameter estimation again. The application solves the problems of low code rate and single light source of the existing quantum communication.

title_en: Microwave cable integrated assembly, dilution refrigerator and superconducting quantum computer
abstract_en: The application discloses a microwave cable integrated component, a dilution refrigerator and a superconducting quantum computer; the microwave cable integrated assembly is applied to a dilution refrigerator and comprises a plurality of heat sink modules and microwave cables, wherein the heat sink modules are used for being connected with all cold discs in the dilution refrigerator in a one-to-one correspondence manner, and the microwave cables are connected with all heat sink modules; wherein, a preset number of microwave cables are arranged in parallel between two adjacent heat sink modules; the preset number is the total number of microwave links between all cold plates in the dilution refrigerator; the number of the microwave cables arranged on the two sides of each heat sink module is the same, and the microwave cables on the two sides of each heat sink module are in one-to-one correspondence and are kept in electrical connection; the two ends of each microwave cable are connected with the heat sink module in a pluggable manner. The microwave cable assembly in the application integrates and assembles the microwave cables in all microwave links in the dilution refrigerator into a complete integral structure through pluggable connection with each heat sink module, thereby reducing the assembling difficulty of the microwave links.

title_en: Material property measuring system
abstract_en: The application relates to a research and analysis of material properties by designing a material property measuring system comprising a device for measuring properties of a transmitted test material, the device comprising an electronic board with at least one transmitter for measuring properties of the test medium, a transceiver and a power supply in a housing, and a remote device for measuring properties in the body of the test material connected thereto by means of an optimally 0.3-20 meter cable, the device comprising an electronic board with at least one transmitter for measuring properties of the test medium; the device for measuring the characteristics of the transmission test material is designed to acquire signals from a remote device, which has a sealed housing containing an electronic board with the transmitters, with a thickness of 0.5-20 mm, and to transmit the signals of all the transmitters to the digital device and/or to the cloud server by means of wireless communication. The application improves the accuracy of data measurement and transmission, the reliability of the characteristic measurement equipment under the working condition and the performance of the material property measurement system.

title_en: Monitoring method, device and storage medium based on video color ring
abstract_en: The application discloses a monitoring method based on video color ring, which is used for solving the problems of single alarm type, lower alarm success rate and lower alarm timeliness of the existing monitoring system. The method comprises the following steps: determining whether the monitored party is in an abnormal state or not according to the acquired monitored party state information; when determining that the monitored party is in an abnormal state currently, determining an abnormal state type corresponding to the current abnormal state, and determining a monitoring number corresponding to the abnormal state type; and initiating an alarm call to a guardian based on the guardian number, receiving an alarm video color ring issued by a video color ring server and generated according to the abnormal state type, and playing the alarm video color ring before the alarm call is connected.

title_en: Broadband low-scattering microstrip array antenna based on phase cancellation mechanism
abstract_en: A broadband low-scattering microstrip array antenna based on a phase cancellation mechanism is formed by performing checkerboard arrangement on extended cross-shaped microstrip antenna units and bent cross-shaped microstrip antenna units which have similar radiation characteristics and have a reflection phase difference of approximately 180 degrees in a broadband range, wherein the two microstrip antenna units are formed by metal radiation patches, an L-shaped coupling feed structure, a metal floor and a dielectric substrate. The L-shaped coupling feed structure consists of a rectangular feed patch and a metallized via hole, and can control two microstrip antennas to have similar radiation characteristics. The invention can keep the normal radiation performance of the microstrip array antenna and realize the broadband low-scattering characteristic on the premise of not introducing an extra low-scattering design structure, and can meet the design and application requirements of a broadband stealth antenna system.

title_en: Reconfigurable variable gain amplifier, wireless communication device, and frequency band switching method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reconfigurable variable gain amplifier, wireless communication equipment and a frequency band switching method, which comprise the following steps: the device comprises a broadband input matching circuit, a first amplifier, a digital cross-connection type gain control unit, a reconfigurable inter-stage matching circuit, a second amplifier, a phase compensation structure and a reconfigurable output matching circuit; the reconfigurable interstage matching circuit and the reconfigurable output matching circuit adopt a plurality of switching transistors to switch the capacitance value, the inductance value and the coupling coefficient of the balun, so that the purpose of switching the working frequency band of the variable gain amplifier is achieved; the gain control unit adopts a digitally controllable cross-connected transistor array to realize low-phase change of the variable gain amplifier in different gain states; the phase compensation structure adopts a transistor switch to change the on-resistance value, thereby realizing further reduction of phase change.

title_en: Information processing method, device and system and ground network node
abstract_en: The invention provides an information processing method, an information processing device, an information processing system and a ground network node. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring satellite service information, wherein the satellite service information comprises at least one of satellite network state information and satellite computing power information; acquiring a target mapping relation according to satellite service information, ground network state information and ground computing power information, wherein the target mapping relation is used for representing the corresponding relation between a satellite network and a ground network; determining a target satellite network and a target notification domain according to the target mapping relation, wherein the target satellite network is a satellite network corresponding to the current earth surface coverage domain in the current time slice, and the target notification domain is a ground notification domain where a ground network in the current time slice is located; and sending satellite service information corresponding to the target satellite network in the target notification domain. The invention can effectively reduce invalid information notification in the ground network and save network resources.

title_en: Communication signal transmission method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a communication signal transmission method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of communication. The method comprises the following steps: determining transmission parameters corresponding to each antenna path in at least two antenna paths according to the acquired channel quality of the at least two antenna paths; and transmitting communication signals to the terminal on at least two antenna paths according to the transmission parameters corresponding to each antenna path in the at least two antenna paths. Different adjustment modes are adopted for different antenna paths so as to adapt to the transmission requirements of different transmission paths; and transmitting communication signals to the terminal on at least two antenna paths according to the transmission parameters corresponding to the antenna paths, so that the communication efficiency between the communication devices is improved.

title_en: Signal interference detection method based on time-frequency domain distribution characteristics
abstract_en: The patent relates to the technical field of electromagnetic spectrum interference signal detection under high and low signal-to-noise ratios, in particular to a signal interference detection method based on time-frequency domain distribution characteristics. The software radio module is used for collecting frequency point energy data of the target frequency band signal when no interference signal exists and when the interference signal exists, and transmitting the frequency point energy data back to the control module; the control module is used for issuing energy data acquisition instructions, monitoring a target frequency band in real time and detecting interference signals. The presence detection of the interfering signal is generally divided into three stages. And selecting energy detection or time-frequency domain characteristics and pearson correlation coefficients according to different signal-to-noise ratios to perform presence detection on the interference signals. When the signal-to-noise ratio is high, the monitoring frequency band is scanned by adopting energy detection, and the part exceeding the threshold value is marked to judge whether an interference signal exists or not; and when the signal-to-noise ratio is low, detecting whether an interference signal exists or not through the time-frequency domain characteristics, and if the interference signal exists, carrying out final verification by using the pearson correlation coefficient.

title_en: Orbital angular momentum lens antenna
abstract_en: The invention discloses an orbital angular momentum lens antenna, which comprises two feed sources and a transmission array, wherein the feed sources are arranged below the transmission array in a bias feed mode; the dual-focus design realizes antenna aperture plane multiplexing, provides a design of super-surface caliber multiplexing, and realizes multiplexing of two paths of orthogonal electromagnetic OAM beams. The invention provides a design of ultra-surface caliber multiplexing, which realizes multiplexing of two paths of orthogonal electromagnetic OAM beams, combines OAM multiplexing with MIMO technology to realize high channel capacity gain, and adopts a Fabry-Perot Luo Sanshe-like resonance unit to be beneficial to improving polarization purity of an antenna.

title_en: Balanced linear phase band-pass filter with differential mode non-reflection characteristic
abstract_en: The invention discloses a balanced linear phase band-pass filter with a differential mode non-reflection characteristic, which comprises a balanced differential input port A, a balanced differential output port B, a four-section quarter-wavelength impedance transformation line, a four-section quarter-wavelength microstrip transmission line, a four-section quarter-wavelength resonance microstrip line, two-section quarter-wavelength inversion transformation lines, four groups of non-reflection absorption branches, two groups of low-frequency negative group delay branches and two groups of high-frequency negative group delay branches. The balanced band-pass filter can be realized on a single PCB, has a simple structure and is beneficial to processing integration. Besides, the filter not only can effectively inhibit common-mode noise and improve the electromagnetic compatibility of a communication system, but also can effectively absorb out-of-band signals through resistors and reduce the reflection wave energy of the out-of-band signals, so that the differential mode non-reflection characteristic is realized, and meanwhile, the group delay fluctuation of the filter is reduced by loading the negative group delay branches, the linear phase band-pass filter characteristic is realized, and the overall performance of the balanced band-pass filter is further improved.

title_en: Topology derivation and division method for ultra-large-scale low orbit satellite constellation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a topology derivation and division method for a very large scale low orbit satellite constellation. The method comprises a stable topology establishment method, a central node derivative method, a full constellation topology division and reprocessing technology. The method comprises the steps of establishing a stable topology, giving satellite screening constraint capable of keeping a long-period stable topology configuration, deriving a satellite with a full constellation as a topology center point by a center node derivation method, enabling each center node to establish the stable topology respectively by a full constellation topology division and reprocessing technology, and redistributing the repeated and missing satellites. By adopting the method, the topology derivation and division of the satellites in the ultra-large-scale constellation can be realized, and the unorganized constellation is divided into a plurality of topologies which can keep stable configuration for a long time. The invention adopts the same orbit derivative method to generate and reasonably divide the full constellation satellite topology for the first time, and provides preconditions for carrying out the high-efficiency transmission of information between planets and realizing the autonomous operation and management of the constellation.

title_en: Charging icon display method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a charging icon display method and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the electronic equipment is connected to a charger which is powered on; the electronic equipment charges a battery in the electronic equipment based on the initial power through a charger which is powered on; the electronic equipment confirms target charging power through a charging drive and a charger which is powered on, and stores target power charging information, wherein the target power charging information comprises a target charging icon; the electronic equipment charges a battery in the electronic equipment based on the target charging power through a charger which is powered on; the electronic device sends callback notification information to the battery driver through the charging driver; in response to the callback notification message, the electronic device sends target power charging information to the first application through the battery-driven and communication interface; and the electronic equipment acquires the target charging icon from the target power charging information through the first application and displays the target charging icon. The time for the electronic equipment to switch and display the high-power charging icon is shortened.

title_en: Intelligent equipment rapid network distribution method and device, medium and equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to a method and device for rapidly distributing network for intelligent equipment, a medium and equipment. The method comprises the following steps: the second intelligent device receives the router information and the family account information sent by the first intelligent device; the second intelligent device is connected with a home router according to router information, device registration is carried out on a cloud end through the connected home router, the message server platform is connected through the cloud end, so that the message server platform pushes the second intelligent device to a device list of a mobile terminal bound with home account information, the second intelligent device in the device list is used as a shadow device of the first intelligent device to be displayed, the mobile terminal determines whether the second intelligent device has binding authority, and if the second intelligent device has the binding authority, a binding relationship is established between the second intelligent device and the home account information. The embodiment of the invention can improve the distribution network rate.

title_en: Double FSS structure for realizing tight coupling array H-plane wide-angle scanning
abstract_en: The double FSS structure for realizing the wide angle scanning of the H surface of the tightly coupled array comprises a plurality of periodically arranged antenna units, wherein each antenna unit comprises a floor, a feed unit is arranged on the floor, a dipole radiation unit and a double-sided extension line are printed on the feed unit, an upper-layer frequency selection surface is horizontally arranged above the dipole radiation unit, a lower-layer frequency selection surface is arranged below the dipole radiation unit and above the floor, and the floor is parallel to the upper-layer frequency selection surface and the lower-layer frequency selection surface and is arranged at the lowest part of the antenna unit; according to the invention, the impedance conjugate matching method during large-angle scanning is utilized to analyze the Floque impedance change rule of the antenna port of the single-pole antenna array during large-angle scanning, and two FSS structures are respectively loaded on the top of the antenna array surface and between the dipole radiating unit and the floor, so that the H-plane scanning characteristic of the array can be remarkably improved, the Floque impedance change rule during large-angle scanning is opposite to that of the antenna, thereby realizing conjugate matching and improving the broadband wide-angle active standing wave characteristic.

title_en: Distributed load balancing satellite routing method based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The application relates to a distributed load balancing satellite routing method based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises the steps of obtaining the queue occupancy rate and the queue state identification of a neighbor satellite node by sensing the data buffer queue load condition of the neighbor satellite node; on one hand, the geographic distance factors of the neighbor nodes and the destination nodes are combined with the topological distance factors to measure the proximity degree of the neighbor nodes and the destination nodes, the obtained topological-geographic distance factors can better reflect the proximity degree between the satellite nodes in the same hemisphere or different hemispheres and can be used as a driving factor for good satellite network routing to accelerate the convergence of a routing algorithm, so that communication data flows can be transmitted according to the path with the shortest transmission distance under the condition of low load in the routing forwarding process, and the nodes with high load can be timely bypassed, thereby reducing the congestion condition of the nodes as much as possible, realizing the load balance of data flow transmission, reducing the network packet loss rate and improving the throughput.

title_en: User interface for multi-user communication session
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates generally to user interfaces for multi-user communication sessions. In some examples, a device initiates a real-time flow in a communication session. In some examples, the device transitions between streaming real-time audio and real-time video. In some examples, the device is capable of synchronizing media playback during real-time streaming.

title_en: Protection device, method, system, equipment and medium based on optical bypass equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a protection device, a method, a system, equipment and a medium based on optical bypass equipment, wherein the device comprises first optical switching equipment, second optical switching equipment, optical bypass equipment and service equipment; a light bypass device is connected in series between the first optical switching device and the second optical switching device; the service equipment is connected in series between the first optical switching equipment and the second optical switching equipment through the optical bypass equipment; the optical bypass equipment comprises a wide area network optical module, a local area network optical module, a light splitting module and an exchange chip; one end of the wide area network optical module is connected with the first optical switching equipment, the other end of the wide area network optical module is connected with the second optical switching equipment, the service equipment is connected with the local area network optical module, and the wide area network optical module is connected with the local area network optical module through a switching chip; the optical splitting module comprises a first optical splitting unit and a second optical splitting unit, wherein the first optical splitting unit is connected in series between the first optical switching device and the wide area network optical module, and the second optical splitting unit is connected in series between the wide area network optical module and the second optical switching device.

title_en: Optical detector
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an optical detector (100) with enhanced sensitivity for detecting optical signals originating from larger angles of incidence. The optical detector (100) may also be used to determine the direction of origin of the optical signal. The optical detector (100) comprises a photodetector (101) and a lens (103). The photodetector (101) has a central axis (102) lying in a central plane (001) perpendicular to the photodetector plane (002). The lens has a first lens section (131) and a second lens section (132) separated by a central plane (001). The first lens section (131) includes a first light receiving surface (133) and a first light exit surface (135), and the first light exit surface (135) faces the photodetector (101). The second lens section (132) comprises a second light receiving surface (134) and a second light exit surface (136), and the second light exit surface (134) faces the photodetector (101). The first light receiving surface (133) comprises a first convex surface having a non-constant curvature, the first convex surface having a first minimum radius of curvature (051) at a first surface point. The second light receiving surface (134) includes a second convex surface having a non-constant curvature, the second convex surface having a second minimum radius of curvature (052) at a second surface point. A first angle (053) enclosed by the central axis (102) and the first line (055) is greater than zero degrees, wherein the first line (055) is perpendicular to the first convex surface at a first surface point and extends up to the central axis (102). And a second angle (054) enclosed by the central axis (102) and a second line (056) is greater than zero degrees, wherein the second line (056) is perpendicular to the second convex surface at a second surface point and extends up to the central axis (102).

title_en: Voice call method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application is applicable to the field of audio data processing, and provides a voice call method and electronic equipment.

title_en: Communication establishment method, flash device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of photographic wireless control, in particular to a communication establishment method, a flash trigger, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method applied to a transmitting end of the flash trigger comprises the steps of responding to a trigger signal of an automatic connection function of the flash trigger, polling all channels and sending a first message requesting connection to a receiving end of the flash trigger; receiving and recording a second message from a receiving end of the flash trigger, wherein the second message comprises the receiving power of each channel; sequencing the recorded channels according to the received power of each channel; and selecting a channel with highest receiving power as a first channel, and establishing communication connection with a receiving end of the flash initiator through the first channel. The application has the effects of automatically searching the most suitable channel and establishing communication connection with the receiving end of the flash trigger, avoiding manually adjusting the channel between the transmitting end and the receiving end of the flash trigger to be the same, and improving the connection efficiency.

title_en: Ultra-wideband antenna structure and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The ultra-wideband antenna structure and the electronic equipment provided by the embodiment of the disclosure comprise: a dielectric substrate; the antenna structure is positioned on one side of the dielectric substrate; the antenna structure comprises a radiation patch and a feeder line; the grounding layer is positioned at one side of the dielectric substrate, which is away from the antenna structure; the radiation patch is provided with a first hollowed-out slit, and the length of the first hollowed-out slit is related to lambda/2; lambda represents the wavelength within the band of the desired notch.

title_en: Cloud-pipe-end-integration-based data acquisition method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a cloud-pipe-end-integration-based data acquisition method and a cloud-pipe-end-integration-based data acquisition system, wherein the data acquisition method comprises the following steps: the cloud platform responds to a data acquisition task, and a data list is selected based on the data acquisition task to generate a target data list, and the target data list is issued to the central computing platform; and the central computing platform indexes and configures a vehicle-end controller according to the content of the target data list, and the configured vehicle-end controller acquires a target vehicle-end signal and sends the target vehicle-end signal to the cloud platform. The application can improve the data acquisition quality, increase the data acquisition range and accelerate the data acquisition rate.

title_en: Traffic signal lamp capable of realizing remote control
abstract_en: The application discloses a traffic signal lamp capable of realizing remote control in the technical field of traffic signal lamps, which comprises a control unit, a wireless communication unit, a vertical fixed box and a horizontal installation box fixedly connected with the vertical fixed box; a plurality of signal lamp units are installed at the horizontal installation box, each signal lamp unit comprises two lamp cap groups, and each lamp cap group comprises 3 lamp caps which are distributed in a row. The utility model provides a traffic signal lamp, every signal lamp unit has two lamp holder groups, when one of them lamp holder group damages, remote control center control signal lamp unit rotates to use another lamp holder group, gather identification mark through first image acquisition unit, can judge whether the mounted position of signal lamp unit is correct, through the restriction of ratchet, thereby spacing the position of signal lamp unit, according to the image that second image acquisition unit gathered, can detect whether the signal lamp holder damages, thereby make things convenient for periodic inspection.

title_en: Phase matching quantum key distribution method based on advantage extraction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a phase matching quantum key distribution method based on advantage extraction, which comprises the following steps: the communication parties Alice and Bob respectively prepare coherent state pulses and send the coherent state pulses to the communication party Eve; the communication party Eve carries out interferometry on the coherent state pulse, records and publishes a measurement result; the communication parties Alice and Bob reserve success events meeting a first preset condition; repeating the steps for N times to obtain successful events meeting the first preset condition, and performing key screening to obtain an original key; respectively estimating the channel gain of the coherent pulse and the error rate under the Z base by the communication parties Alice and Bob; responding to the error rate being smaller than or equal to a corresponding preset threshold value, and for each successful event meeting a second preset condition, the communication parties Alice and Bob perform advantage extraction on the original secret key and update the original secret key; performing key error correction and secret amplification on the original key to obtain a finally shared security key; the invention can obviously improve the performance of PM-QKD under the conditions of larger background error rate and long-distance transmission.

title_en: Multipath laser communication device, system, method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: A multipath laser communication device, a system, a method and electronic equipment relate to the technical field of space laser communication, and the system comprises: the controller comprises a liquid crystal spatial light modulator and at least two optical communication transceiver modules, wherein the optical communication transceiver modules are arranged opposite to the liquid crystal spatial light modulator and are used for enabling light beams to propagate between the optical communication transceiver modules and the liquid crystal spatial light modulator to realize communication; the optical communication receiving module is divided into an emitting group and a receiving group, wherein the emitting group is used for emitting light beams to the liquid crystal spatial light modulator, and the receiving group is used for receiving the light beams on the surface of the liquid crystal spatial light modulator; the device, the system and the method can realize one or more paths of light beams to be controlled simultaneously by adopting the liquid crystal spatial light modulator, are used for realizing networking more easily during laser communication, and greatly reduce the volume and the power consumption of the system due to adopting a non-mechanical control mode.

title_en: Electronic device including grip sensor
abstract_en: According to various embodiments of the present disclosure, an electronic device includes: a first surface; a second surface facing in a direction opposite to the first surface; a housing including a side surface at least partially surrounding a space between the first surface and the second surface; a printed circuit board disposed between the first surface and the second surface; a first sensing element including a plurality of conductive through holes arranged in parallel with the side surface at least a portion of an edge of the printed circuit board; and a grip sensor electrically connected to the first sensing element, wherein the grip sensor may be configured to detect a capacitance change caused according to a proximity or contact state of an external object with respect to the housing at least a portion of a side surface of the housing using the first sensing element.

title_en: DC offset cancellation circuit and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a direct current offset cancellation circuit and a direct current offset cancellation system, which can rapidly control the on or off of corresponding branch current as long as a corresponding branch switch of each current mirror unit receives a corresponding control signal, so as to adjust the current flowing through a first output end and a second output end, thereby realizing direct current offset cancellation and improving the efficiency of direct current offset cancellation; in addition, the circuit is composed of a first reference current source, a second reference current source, a first current mirror unit group, a second current mirror unit group, a third current mirror unit group, a fourth current mirror unit group, a first switch, a second switch, a third switch and a fourth switch, and resistance and capacitance are not required to be introduced, so that the complexity of the circuit is reduced.

title_en: Positioning measurement method, terminal and network equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a positioning measurement method, a terminal and network equipment. The method comprises the steps of receiving first information sent by network equipment, wherein the first information is used for configuring positioning reference signals PRS of a terminal; receiving second information sent by the network equipment, wherein the second information is used for configuring a measurement interval of the terminal, and the second information is determined based on the first information; the terminal supports the receiving frequency hopping of PRS for reducing the capability of the RedCAP terminal, and improves the communication efficiency.

title_en: Vanadium dioxide-based dual-function switchable terahertz device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of terahertz wave band super-surface functional devices, in particular to a vanadium dioxide-based difunctional switchable terahertz device, which comprises a plurality of structural units, wherein each structural unit is formed by compounding a vanadium dioxide annular pattern layer, an upper silicon dioxide medium layer, an I-shaped gold pattern layer, a vanadium dioxide film layer, a lower silicon dioxide medium layer and a gold substrate layer. When vanadium dioxide is in a metal state, the super surface realizes a broadband absorption function; when the vanadium dioxide is in an insulating state, the super surface realizes a reflective linear polarization conversion function. The invention integrates the characteristics of the two functional devices, namely the broadband absorber and the reflective linear polarization converter, into a super-surface structure by utilizing the phase change characteristic of vanadium dioxide, realizes the switching of different functions of the same device, has the characteristics of insensitive polarization and wide-angle absorption during broadband absorption, and solves the defects of single function and non-tunable of the traditional terahertz device.

title_en: Broadband variable gain amplifier
abstract_en: The application provides a broadband variable gain amplifier, which comprises an input module, a first output module and a second output module, wherein the input module is used for receiving differential input voltage and processing the differential input voltage to generate processing voltage; the input end of the gain module is connected with the output end of the output module, the gain module at least comprises a primary gain unit, and the primary gain unit is used for receiving the processing voltage and the first control signal, amplifying the processing voltage with a first amplification factor and outputting a first amplified voltage; the first control signal comprises the first amplification factor; the input end of the output module is connected with the output end of the gain module and is used for generating differential output voltage; according to the above, the gain can be adjusted, and the high bandwidth can be adjusted at the same time.

title_en: Small antenna structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a small antenna structure, the radiation process of which comprises: the first cube structure and the second cube structure are mainly used as excitation units and are used together with the matching circuit to excite an emission mode of the metal area where the antenna is located, so that a radiation function is realized; in a specific high-frequency band, the first cube structure and the second cube structure are used as radiators, so that the radiation function of the high-frequency band is realized. By providing the first and second cube structures, the electrical length of the first and second cube structures is effectively increased when the first and second cube structures are used as excitation units; when the first cube structure and the second cube structure are used as radiators, the connection mode is similar to a grid structure, so that the bandwidth can be effectively widened; because the first cube structure and the second cube structure are mainly used as excitation units, a lower dielectric constant can be used in preparation, so that the radiation efficiency of the whole system is not greatly influenced by the height of the loss angle of the dielectric material; compared with the existing small antenna design, the anti-interference performance of the antenna system caused by the inconsistency of the dielectric materials and the process can be enhanced.

title_en: Remote monitoring system for solar aviation obstruction lights
abstract_en: The invention relates to a remote monitoring system for a solar aviation obstruction lamp, which belongs to the technical field of remote monitoring of aviation obstruction lamps, wherein the monitoring system can monitor the state and the performance of the lamp in real time by arranging a monitoring module and collecting working parameters of the aviation obstruction lamp, and a cloud service module receives and processes monitoring data, and can conveniently know the working state of the aviation obstruction lamp by comparing with a set threshold value, so that abnormal conditions can be found in time and the monitoring system can be processed and maintained in time. The monitoring modules are constructed into a netlike topological structure through the second communication units, the structure can realize mutual communication among the monitoring modules, the selection of communication lines between the monitoring modules and the cloud service module is increased, and the stability and the reliability of the system are improved. The electric signal of the solar power supply circuit and the electric signal of the aviation obstruction lamp working circuit are sampled and monitored to monitor whether the solar power supply module can normally supply power for the aviation obstruction lamp.

title_en: Low-profile antenna flexible interconnection structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible interconnection structure of a low-profile antenna, which comprises the following components: an antenna array surface; the antenna array surfaces are arranged and spliced to form a sheet structure; the antenna array surface comprises a unit integrated plate and a structural plate; a volume cavity is formed between the unit integrated plate and the structural plate, and a flexible interconnection layer and a chip type power chip are arranged in the volume cavity; the flexible interconnection layer is in press fit contact with the chip power chip and is integrally arranged on the inner side of the antenna array surface; the unit integrated board, the flexible interconnection layer, the chip power chip and the structural board are detachably connected; the structure is composed of a unit integrated board, a flexible interconnection layer, a chip type power chip and a structural board. The flexible interconnection layer is used for realizing the welding-free interconnection between the chip power chip and the unit integrated board, so that the aims of reliable interconnection method without welding stress and rapid maintenance of the chip power chip are fulfilled.

title_en: Indication method of precoding matrix, terminal and network side equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a precoding matrix indicating method, a terminal and network side equipment, belonging to the technical field of communication, wherein the precoding matrix indicating method comprises the following steps: the terminal receives DCI, wherein the DCI comprises a first indication domain, and the first indication domain is used for indicating at least one of the following: the method comprises the steps of generating a precoding matrix, selecting information of antenna ports, effective precoding matrix information, and transmitting layer information of the precoding matrix, and judging whether full power transmission is used or not; and the terminal determines a precoding matrix of uplink transmission according to the first indication domain.

title_en: Light reversing light reflector, light relay device and fiber laser
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an optical reverse reflector, an optical relay device and an optical fiber laser, and relates to the technical fields of optical fiber laser and optical communication. An optical transmitter, an optical lens, a filter, and an optical reflector arranged in this order; an optical transmitter for receiving and transmitting an incident laser light or a target laser light; the optical lens is used for carrying out beam expansion and collimation treatment on incident laser to obtain collimated laser and transmitting the collimated laser to the filter; a filter for reflecting the amplified spontaneous emission noise in the collimated laser and the target laser to different positions and emitting the target laser to the light reflector; and a light reflector for reflecting the target laser light to the light transmitter. The target laser in the collimated laser can be reflected back to the optical transmitter through the filter, and the amplified spontaneous emission noise in the collimated laser is reflected to other positions, so that the amplified spontaneous emission noise in the collimated laser can be accurately and completely filtered.

title_en: Bandwidth allocation method, device, storage medium and equipment of passive optical network
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a bandwidth allocation method, device, storage medium and equipment of a passive optical network, and relates to the technical field of optical fiber communication. The bandwidth allocation method of the passive optical network comprises the following steps: determining the characteristics of the service flow message according to the acquired service flow message of the optical link terminal in the passive optical network; determining whether the service corresponding to the service flow message meets the service operation requirement according to the service flow message characteristics; and under the condition that the service corresponding to the service flow message does not meet the service operation requirement, adjusting the bandwidth parameter of the optical network unit connected with the optical link terminal, and distributing the bandwidth according to the adjusted bandwidth parameter. The method and the device can meet the time delay requirement in more high-speed service network scenes.

title_en: Wireless performance test method and system based on compression range dead zone expansion
abstract_en: The invention provides a wireless performance test method and a system based on compact range dead zone expansion, which generally relate to the technical field of compact range test, wherein the implementation of the method is based on a wireless performance test device, and the method comprises a feed source, a reflecting piece and a rotating table, wherein the reflecting piece is provided with a reflecting surface; the method comprises the following steps: placing a feed source at a focus position of a reflecting surface to obtain an original phase of the feed source; rotating the rotary table to obtain a first scattering parameter of the equipment to be tested; moving the feed source along a first straight line, wherein the moving distance is a first distance; inputting the first distance into a phase compensation model to obtain a compensation phase so as to obtain an adjustment phase, and adjusting the original phase of the feed source to the adjustment phase; rotating the rotary table to obtain a second scattering parameter of the equipment to be tested; repeatedly moving the feed source along the first straight line to obtain a plurality of second scattering parameters; and the wireless communication performance of the device to be tested is characterized by the first scattering parameters and the second scattering parameters. The method provided by the invention can increase the size of the test dead zone under the condition that the size of the reflecting surface is certain.

title_en: Method and device for transmitting system information
abstract_en: A system and method for system information transmission. The system and method include broadcasting, by the wireless communication node, a system information block indicating a configuration of different resources to the wireless communication device.

title_en: Automated three-dimensional scanning method, apparatus, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure relates to an automatic three-dimensional scanning method, device, equipment and storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring a current scanning path, wherein the current scanning path comprises at least one scanning point pose; the method comprises the steps of scanning a scanned object based on a scanning point pose of a current scanning path to obtain a current three-dimensional model corresponding to the scanned object, determining a next scanning path based on the current three-dimensional model, updating the current scanning path based on the next scanning path, scanning the scanned object based on the updated scanning point pose of the current scanning path, and updating the current three-dimensional model corresponding to the scanned object. According to the embodiment of the disclosure, the three-dimensional scanning quality can be improved.

title_en: Image processing method and related equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an image processing method and related equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting a plurality of visible light images and a plurality of near infrared images; acquiring a first visible light image sequence and a first near infrared image sequence; generating a second visible light image sequence according to the image definition; generating a second near-infrared image sequence from the second visible image sequence; respectively calculating the motion amplitude of each near infrared image in the second near infrared image sequence relative to the visible light images in the second visible light image sequence; generating a third near-infrared image sequence according to the motion amplitude; and fusing the plurality of visible light images in the second visible light image sequence and the plurality of near infrared images in the third near infrared image sequence to obtain a target image. According to the method and the device for obtaining the target image, the multiple visible light images and the multiple near infrared images with small differences can be screened out, and the multiple visible light images and the multiple near infrared images are fused to obtain the target image, so that the quality of the image of the electronic device is improved.

title_en: Communication method and device
abstract_en: A communication method and a device relate to the technical field of communication, and can support a radio frequency identification RFID system to segment data based on a segmentation mechanism, simplify the segmentation mechanism and reduce segmentation expenditure. The method can be used for an RFID system, wherein a first protocol layer of a terminal device acquires first information for indicating the size of a transmission block, if the size of a first data packet is larger than the size of the transmission block, the first protocol layer segments the first data packet according to the size of the transmission block to obtain a plurality of first segmented data packets, and transmits the plurality of first segmented data packets; the first data packet is a data packet received by a first protocol layer from a previous protocol layer; the size of the first segmented data packet is less than or equal to the transport block size.

title_en: Electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides electronic equipment, which comprises a radio frequency signal source, a first side frame, a first antenna unit and a second antenna unit. The first side frame comprises a first corner part, a main body part and a second corner part which are sequentially arranged. The first antenna unit is provided with a first antenna radiator and a first parasitic branch, the first antenna radiator and the first parasitic branch are arranged on the main body part, the first parasitic branch is coupled with the first antenna radiator, and the first antenna unit generates a first resonance mode supporting a first medium-high frequency band and a second resonance mode supporting a second medium-high frequency band under the excitation of a radio frequency signal source. The second antenna unit is excited by the radio frequency signal source to generate a third resonance mode supporting a target WIFI frequency band and a fourth resonance mode supporting a target ultrahigh frequency band. The electronic equipment provided by the application can improve the game experience performance of the user.

title_en: Two mapping algorithm designs in differential spatial modulation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a differential space modulation system, which comprises two mapping schemes when the number of transmitting antennas is different: look-up table sequential mapping (LUTO) and Permutation Mapping (PM), for look-up table sequential mapping, the implementation steps are as follows: predefining an antenna combination mapping table; determining an antenna grouping mode; at the transmitting end, the corresponding group is selected according to the bit sequence, and the antenna combination is selected according to the sequence in the group. The invention determines the number of transmitting antennas and the modulation sequence according to the need, selects proper mapping algorithm in the mapping of the lookup table and the permutation and replacement mapping, designs the mapping table according to the number of transmitting antennas for the mapping algorithm of the lookup table, and directly maps the input bit stream into a signal matrix for the permutation and mapping algorithm, so that a user can select the most suitable mapping mode according to specific needs.

title_en: Electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses electronic equipment, which belongs to the technical field of communication; the electronic equipment comprises a loudspeaker shell, a frame body, an antenna board and a connecting piece; the loudspeaker shell and the antenna board are arranged in the frame body, and a first through hole is formed in one side, close to the frame body, of the loudspeaker shell; the antenna board is provided with a second through hole, the connecting piece sequentially penetrates through the first through hole and the second through hole and is connected with the frame body, and the loudspeaker shell, the antenna board and the frame body are fixedly connected through the connecting piece; the edge of the loudspeaker shell is provided with connecting buckles which are distributed at intervals with the first through holes, and the connecting buckles are matched with the frame body in a clamping manner.

title_en: Intelligent reflecting surface-assisted uplink NOMA unmanned aerial vehicle network energy efficiency optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent reflection surface assisted uplink NOMA unmanned aerial vehicle network energy efficiency optimization method, which aims at a multi-user uplink direct link blocking scene, and establishes an energy efficiency optimization model based on an uplink NOMA-UAV network taking RIS assistance into consideration based on a rice channel model; decomposing the energy efficiency optimization model, and respectively solving the decomposed optimization sub-models; based on a block coordinate descent method, alternately optimizing the energy efficiency optimization model according to the solution of the optimization function of the optimization sub-model until the energy efficiency optimization model converges; and further obtaining a scheme for enabling the energy efficiency optimization model to reach an optimal solution, and realizing the maximum energy efficiency of the intelligent reflection surface-assisted uplink NOMA unmanned aerial vehicle network.

title_en: Rotary opening and closing structure and foldable equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a rotary opening and closing structure and foldable equipment, wherein two rotary parts and a sliding part are arranged on a body. The sliding piece can enable the two first swinging pieces to swing synchronously through the matching of the two sliding heads and the two arc-shaped sliding grooves, so that the two rotating parts can further move synchronously. In this way, on the one hand, the first drive end is arranged so as to be slidable in the guide slot. Meanwhile, the elastic piece is abutted between the first driving end and the follow-up part, and the first axis is configured to be close to one side of the body, which faces away from the middle plate, relative to the second axis. Therefore, when the second swinging piece drives the follow-up part to swing, the first driving end can slide relative to the follow-up part, and the elastic piece generates friction force between the first driving end and the follow-up part. To provide damping for the rotation of the rotating part. On the other hand, after the friction is configured, the foldable device can be stably kept in the form after being unfolded by a preset angle, so that the foldable device is prevented from being easily rotated.

title_en: Delay serial cascade pulse position modulation system, method and deep space optical communication system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a delay serial cascade pulse position modulation system, a delay serial cascade pulse position modulation method and a deep space optical communication system. Relates to the technical field of coding and decoding applicable to deep space optical communication. The delay serial cascade pulse position modulation system comprises a transmitting end and a receiving end. The transmitting end comprises a coding module, a transmitting terminal symbol sequence segmentation module, a sub-symbol interleaving module, a delay module, a sub-symbol sequence merging module and a PPM modulation module which are sequentially connected. The receiving end comprises a PPM sub-symbol demodulation module, a receiving terminal symbol sequence segmentation module, a reverse delay module, a sub-symbol de-interleaving module, a decoding module and a feedback module which are connected with the decoding module and the PPM sub-symbol demodulation module in sequence. With lower computational complexity and better error performance.

title_en: Rotating shaft device, folding shell and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a rotating shaft device which comprises a rotating shaft assembly, a torsion assembly and an elastic assembly, wherein the rotating assembly comprises a first base and a rotating piece, the rotating piece is rotationally connected to the first base and comprises a first cam, the torsion assembly comprises a rotating shaft and a rotating shaft mounting piece, the axis of the rotating shaft is parallel to the rotating axis between the rotating piece and the first base, the rotating shaft mounting piece is sleeved on the rotating shaft in a sliding manner along the axial direction of the rotating shaft and comprises a first propping cam, the elastic assembly comprises a first elastic piece, opposite ends of the rotating shaft mounting piece respectively prop against the first elastic piece and the rotating piece, the first elastic piece props against the rotating shaft mounting piece to enable the first propping cam and the first cam to prop against each other in a rotatable manner, and when the rotating piece rotates relative to the rotating shaft mounting piece, the first cam props against the first propping cam in a rotatable manner, and friction torsion between the first cam and the first propping cam limits rotation of the rotating piece. The application also provides a folding shell with the rotating shaft device and electronic equipment.

title_en: Terahertz multifunctional super-surface device based on graphene
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a graphene-based terahertz multifunctional super-surface device, including: the multifunctional super-surface device consists of a plurality of super-surface units which are periodically arranged; each super-surface unit comprises a bottom metal reflecting layer, a middle dielectric layer and a top pattern layer which are arranged from bottom to top; the top pattern layer comprises a metal strip and a graphene film layer; when linearly polarized terahertz waves vertically enter the super-surface device, the Fermi level of graphene in the graphene film layer is changed, so that electric dipole resonance is generated between the graphene film layer and the metal strip, electric dipole resonance is generated between the metal strip and the bottom metal reflecting layer, strong coupling is generated between the metal strip and incident electromagnetic waves, and efficient absorption and efficient polarization conversion effects on the incident terahertz waves are achieved. According to the preparation method, the Fermi energy level of the graphene is controllable by means of the adjustable characteristic of the Fermi energy level of the graphene, and the Fermi energy level of the graphene is controllable by means of external voltage, so that good absorption effect and polarization conversion effect are achieved simultaneously.

title_en: Control method and storage medium of intelligent Internet of things equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of the Internet of things, and discloses a control method and a storage medium of intelligent Internet of things equipment. After the first instruction is sent to the Internet of things platform, the Internet of things platform receives the instruction and simultaneously sends a feedback signal to the wireless control terminal and prompts the voice, so that a user can know the use information of the Internet of things platform in real time; the wireless control terminal can be connected to the internet of things platform through a wireless network, can also be connected to the internet of things platform through bluetooth, and through the connection of multiple modes, the connection mode of the wireless control terminal is adjusted according to actual conditions to the user of being convenient for, avoids leading to wireless control terminal unable use because of the network fluctuation.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle transmission line itinerant detection task unloading method based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a task unloading method for unmanned aerial vehicle transmission line itinerary detection based on a neural network, which utilizes a fully-connected neural network to output integer programming problem results, utilizes convex optimization to solve the problem of solving continuous values, can decide a sensor data unloading scheme with lower complexity, has the time of less than 0.1 second, is one percent of the traditional algorithm, and is more suitable for a scene with more frequent channel change.

title_en: Structure, method for manufacturing structure, and millimeter wave radar module
abstract_en: The present invention provides a structure body, a method for manufacturing the structure body, and a millimeter wave radar module, wherein the structure body is formed by joining 2 resin members, and at least one of the resin members is a resin member with high electromagnetic wave absorptivity. A structure comprising a 1 st member formed of a thermoplastic resin composition A and a 2 nd member formed of a thermoplastic resin composition B, wherein the 1 st member and the 2 nd member are at least partially joined, a test piece obtained by molding the thermoplastic resin composition A to a thickness of 2mm has a transmittance of 70.0% or more at a frequency of 76.5GHz, a test piece obtained by molding the thermoplastic resin composition B to a thickness of 2mm has a transmittance of less than 50.0% at a frequency of 76.5GHz, and a test piece obtained by molding the thermoplastic resin composition B to a thickness of 2mm has an absorptivity of 40.0% or more at a frequency of 76.5 GHz.

title_en: Transmission line
abstract_en: The invention relates to a transmission line for communication between a first electronic device and a second electronic device, the transmission line comprising: a flexible planar transmission line for connection to a first electronic device, the flexible planar transmission line comprising a first conductive layer, a first dielectric layer, a second conductive layer, and a signal line disposed between the first dielectric layer and the second dielectric layer, wherein the signal line is provided with an exposed portion; an adapter comprising an electrical conductor provided with a first opening at a first side of the electrical conductor, the first opening being arranged to receive a flexible planar transmission line; and a first connector provided at a second side of the electrical conductor, the first connector being provided with a contact area at the second side arranged to receive a first connection for connecting to a second transmission line of a second electronic device, and a pin for receiving a second connection of the second transmission line; wherein the contact region is electrically connected to the second conductive layer and the adapter further comprises a support arranged to deform the flexible transmission line plane to connect the signal line to the pin and the first conductive layer to the contact region.

title_en: Portable lightweight universal type multi-degree-of-freedom loudspeaker adjusting device and method
abstract_en: The utility model provides a portable lightweight general multi freedom loudspeaker adjusting device and method, the device is including setting up subaerial bottom plate, the bottom plate upside is fixed with three transitional flange that is isosceles triangle and arrange, three transitional flange has three one-level screw rod through threaded connection respectively, three one-level screw rod upside is fixed with the roof through three lower nut one and three upper nut one, the roof inboard is fixed with three second grade screw rod through three lower butterfly nut and three upper butterfly nut, second grade screw rod upside is fixed with loudspeaker adjusting device through three lower nut two and three upper nut two, loudspeaker adjusting device upside is fixed with the loudspeaker support, loudspeaker support side is fixed with loudspeaker. According to the invention, the adjustment of the horn height direction is realized by arranging the primary screw and the secondary screw, and the adjustment of the horn azimuth and elevation angle is realized by arranging the horn adjusting device. The structure is simple, and the installation is convenient.

title_en: Extremely wide wave beam broadband low back lamella GNSS positioning antenna
abstract_en: The application provides a low back lamella GNSS locating antenna of extremely wide wave beam broadband, including radiation piece, feed probe, cavity, feed network, a plurality of radiation piece dielectric washer and radiation piece dielectric screw: the radiating patch comprises a direct feed radiating patch 1, a direct feed radiating patch 2, a parasitic patch 1 and a parasitic patch 2; the feed probe is fixed with the direct feed radiation piece 1 and the direct feed radiation piece 2; the radiation piece medium screw penetrates through the radiation piece and the radiation piece medium gasket and is fixed in the cavity through threads; the radiation piece dielectric gaskets are respectively positioned between the radiation piece and the cavity and are used for keeping the height of the radiation piece and enabling the radiation piece to be parallel to the upper surface of the cavity; the feed network is arranged below the inner part of the cavity, is electrically connected with the direct feed radiating patch 1 and the direct feed radiating patch 2 through the feed probes, and is used for directly feeding the direct feed radiating patch 1 and the direct feed radiating patch 2 and coupling and feeding the parasitic patch 1 and the parasitic patch 2 so as to enable the antenna to be compatible with more navigation frequency bands and wider wave beams.

title_en: Image processing method, electronic device, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: The present application relates to the field of image processing, and in particular, to an image processing method, an electronic device, and a computer readable storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first image to be processed; predicting a first light flow graph corresponding to the first image, wherein the light flow graph is used for representing the displacement of corresponding pixels between the front frame image and the rear frame image; generating an optical flow ring according to the first optical flow diagram, wherein the optical flow ring comprises a group of optical flow diagrams connected end to end; and generating a target video corresponding to the first image according to the optical flow ring. By the method, the static picture can be dynamically displayed, so that the appreciation experience of a user on the static picture is effectively improved.

title_en: Mining vehicle digital radio integrated in information management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mining vehicle digital radio integrated in an information management system, which is characterized by comprising the following components: comprising the following steps: the device comprises a liquid crystal display, a digital radio module, an antenna, a left loudspeaker, a right loudspeaker and a USB interface; the digital radio module is provided with a radio function module, and the signal output end are respectively connected with the liquid crystal display; the signal input end of the digital radio module is respectively connected with the signal output ends of the antenna and the USB interface, and the signal output end of the digital radio module is respectively connected with the signal input ends of the left loudspeaker and the right loudspeaker. According to the invention, the original traditional mechanical radio body is canceled, the radio function is digitalized and integrated in the mining vehicle information management system, so that the experience of a driver can be improved, and the driving fatigue of the driver can be effectively reduced.

title_en: Full duplex transmitting and receiving circuit, serial circuit chip, electronic equipment and vehicle
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of electronic and electric appliances, and provides a full duplex transmitting and receiving circuit, a serial circuit chip, electronic equipment and a vehicle. The full duplex transmitting and receiving circuit comprises a first output module, a second output module and a processing module, wherein the first output module and the second output module are of a current type logic architecture, the second output module and the processing module which can transmit the same forward differential signal with the first output module are added, and then the processing module can remove the forward differential signal transmitted by the first output module in the mixed signal according to the forward differential signal transmitted by the second output module, so that the reverse differential signal is obtained, full duplex communication on the same channel is realized, the additional channel is not needed, the cost is low, and the application range is wide.

title_en: Information processing method and device, communication equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides an information processing method and device, a communication device and a storage medium. The information processing method performed by the NTN apparatus may include: in a discontinuous coverage scene of NTN, auxiliary information and validity information are sent to User Equipment (UE), wherein the auxiliary information is used for the user equipment to determine the coverage condition of NTN; and the validity information indicates validity of the discontinuous coverage corresponding to the auxiliary information.

title_en: Four-port time domain antenna
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of ultra-wideband antenna technology and time domain electromagnetics, and particularly provides a four-port time domain antenna which is used for simultaneously giving consideration to a radiation field with higher amplitude, ultra-wideband, smaller physical size, higher energy utilization rate and lower fault risk. The invention is mainly composed of an electric dipole bent plate, a feed part, a parallel plate, an active magnetic dipole plate, a passive magnetic dipole plate and a grounding backboard, is based on an ultra-wideband electromagnetic combined antenna, is divided and mirrored in the horizontal and vertical directions to form a four-port structure, can increase the radiation field of the antenna by more than 20 percent on the premise of unchanged input power and physical size, does not need an additional combiner compared with the power combining technology, and has the advantages of high radiation intensity, large bandwidth, small physical size, high energy utilization rate, low fault risk and the like, and has wide application prospect in ground penetrating radar, ultra-wideband imaging, unmanned aerial vehicle reaction and remote warning.

title_en: Verbal menu for determining and visually displaying calls
abstract_en: The determination and visual display of the verbal menu of the call. Audio data output in a call between a calling device and a device associated with a target entity is received. The audio data includes speech indicating one or more selection options for the user of the calling device to navigate in the call via a call menu provided by the target entity. Text is determined by programmatically analyzing the audio data, the text representing speech. The selection option is determined based on programmatically analyzing at least one of the text or audio data. At least a portion of the text is displayed by the calling device as one or more visual options corresponding to the selected option during the call. The visual options are each selectable as an operable item via user input to cause a corresponding navigation through the call menu.

title_en: Health protection system and method based on electric stimulation awakening and active noise reduction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a health protection system and method based on electric stimulation awakening and active noise reduction. In the system, a noise detection module is used for detecting noise information of an external environment; the physiological information detection module is used for detecting physiological information of a user; the auxiliary detection module is used for obtaining behavior state information based on the gesture and the image information of the user; the control module is used for determining active noise reduction parameters based on the noise information, and determining electric stimulation parameters based on the physiological information, the behavior state information and the counted active noise reduction information; the active noise reduction module generates noise reduction sound waves based on the active noise reduction parameters, and the noise reduction sound waves are cancelled by interference of external environment noise; the fatigue wake-up module generates a current mode stimulation current based on the electrical stimulation parameters and acts on a target stimulation site of the user via the electrodes to wake up the user. The invention can realize better noise reduction effect and wake-up effect.

title_en: Centralized control method for excitation signals of cloud box of aircraft
abstract_en: The invention discloses a centralized control method for excitation signals of an aircraft cloud box, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of constructing an aircraft cloud box excitation signal centralized control system, wherein the control system comprises an excitation signal generation module, a network adapter, a network switch and a control terminal, and an operator responds to the control terminal through an input device according to system integration test requirements. The invention can simplify the decentralized control engineering, has higher reliability, stronger expansion capability, simple and convenient operation, enhances the overall control experience of operators, ensures that a plurality of signal devices are cooperatively processed, avoids that a plurality of devices cannot generate each excitation signal at the same time, and performs centralized processing and classification on signal control, improves the instantaneity and the accuracy of each test signal of the aircraft cloud box, simultaneously facilitates the system integration test of the aircraft cloud box and the monitoring, diagnosis and maintenance of related transmission devices, improves the production efficiency, and promotes the production management.

title_en: Voice Bluetooth wifi general type electronic equipment controller
abstract_en: The invention discloses a voice Bluetooth wifi general electronic equipment controller, which structurally comprises a shell, wherein a display screen, an operation button, a heat dissipation opening and a mounting plate are arranged on the shell, the display screen is fixedly and detachably arranged on one side of the upper surface of the shell, the operation button is positioned on one side of the display screen and detachably arranged on the upper surface of the shell, the mounting plate is welded on one end of the shell, the mounting plate is provided with a mounting hole, and the heat dissipation opening is positioned on one end of the shell. The invention realizes wireless transmission and remote control of the electronic equipment controller in the use process, and can also operate the electronic equipment controller in a voice mode, thereby avoiding that an operator can not operate other matters caused by personally operating the electronic equipment controller around the electronic equipment controller, reducing the labor intensity of the operator when operating the electronic equipment controller, and improving the convenience of the electronic equipment controller in the use process.

title_en: Active eight-channel filter and radio frequency receiver
