abstract_en: The application discloses an active eight-channel filter and a radio frequency receiver, wherein the active eight-channel filter is arranged between a down-conversion mixer circuit and an up-conversion mixer circuit of the radio frequency receiver, and the filter comprises: 8 second-order low-pass filters and 8 baseband negative resistance structures, wherein the input end of each second-order low-pass filter is connected with 8 output ends of the down-conversion mixer circuit; the output end of each second-order low-pass filter corresponds to the input end of each baseband negative resistance structure one by one; the baseband negative resistance structure is equivalent to a negative resistance and counteracts the output resistance and parasitic resistance value of the MOS tube of the second-order low-pass filter when the resonance frequency of the radio frequency receiver is achieved, so that signal distortion and waveform distortion are reduced, or interference between the internal resistance of the signal source and the input resistance of the second-order low-pass filter is reduced when the input resistance of the input signal source is smaller than the impedance of the baseband negative resistance structure. The application can be widely applied to the technical field of electronic circuits.

title_en: Rotating device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The present application relates to the field of terminals, and in particular, to a rotating device and an electronic device. The rotating device comprises: the door plate structure extends along a first direction, and comprises a first part, a second part and a third part which are sequentially connected along the first direction. Wherein the first portion comprises a first surface, the second portion comprises a second surface, and the third portion comprises a third surface. At least a portion of the first surface and/or at least a portion of the third surface is lower than the second surface in a second direction, the second direction being perpendicular to the first direction. The gap between the rotating device and the flexible screen is large enough, and when the electronic equipment falls, the door plate structure of the rotating device cannot impact and squeeze the flexible screen, so that the failure probability of the flexible screen is effectively reduced, and the service life of the electronic equipment is prolonged.

title_en: Communication method and communication device
abstract_en: The application provides a communication method and a communication device. In the application, when a terminal device determines to report M superposition coefficients for indicating CSI to a network device, dividing the M superposition coefficients into N groups of superposition coefficients corresponding to N different grouping indexes, and then reporting only one group of superposition coefficients in the N groups of superposition coefficients at i reporting moments, wherein N groups of superposition coefficients formed by the reported group of superposition coefficients and N-1 groups of superposition coefficients reported at least one reporting moment before the i reporting moment correspond to the N different grouping indexes; correspondingly, for the network equipment, when the ith reporting time is over, determining the CSI based on N groups of superposition coefficients formed by a group of superposition coefficients reported at the ith reporting time and N-1 groups of superposition coefficients reported at least one reporting time before the ith reporting time. The communication method provided by the application can ensure the accuracy of reporting the CSI and simultaneously can reduce the feedback expenditure of the CSI.

title_en: Glass frosting liquid and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a glass frosting liquid and a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of glass surface treatment. The glass frosting liquid comprises the following components: ammonium bifluoride, sodium chloride, hydrofluoric acid, nitric acid, hydrochloric acid and a dispersing agent; wherein the mass percentage of nitric acid in the glass frosting liquid is 10-20%. The glass frosting liquid is simple to use, stable in frosting, contains sodium chloride and nitric acid, can promote crystal nucleus growth and control crystal forms, stably and uniformly sand glass, does not leak sand, and solves the problems that the glass frosting liquid cannot stably sand glass, or the yield is too low and the quality is not stable and the glass frosting liquid is easy to produce in quantity due to uneven sand filling.

title_en: Monitoring device and method for monitoring deformation situation of roadway surrounding rock
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring device and a method for monitoring deformation situation of roadway surrounding rock, which relate to the field of intelligent monitoring of roadway surrounding rock, and comprise a bearing table, a laser sensor module, a camera, a light supplementing lamp, a control module and a power supply which are arranged on the bearing table, wherein the laser sensor module is connected with the control module, the camera is connected with the control module, a wireless communication module is arranged in the control module, the wireless communication module is connected with the computer, and monitoring devices simple structure, simple to operate, control module is according to the target image of receiving, and control laser sensor rotates, aligns each target in proper order and ranges distance, and the change amount of distance between each target that further obtains, and whole process automation monitoring, measurement accuracy is high, can learn the deformation situation of country rock in real time high efficiency.

title_en: High-flux digital beam synthesis system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-flux digital beam synthesis system and a high-flux digital beam synthesis method, and relates to the technical field of signal processing. Comprising the following steps: the system comprises a plurality of signal acquisition and channel distribution units, a high-speed switching network unit, a plurality of beam forming units and a storage unit. The invention is suitable for digital beam synthesis of a large-scale radio astronomical phased array receiver, can complete complex calculation tasks of mass data in real time, and has strong calculation performance; by adopting Alveo acceleration card to receive and process data, the CPU processing core can be bypassed, and the efficiency of data receiving and processing is effectively improved; the system can adjust the scale of the acceleration card according to the number of array elements and the bandwidth, and configure calculation parameters, and has the characteristics of high flexibility and strong expandability; alveo the acceleration card has lower power consumption than the GPU, and has the advantage of energy conservation.

title_en: Long Bo lens and Lunbo lens system
abstract_en: The invention provides a Luneberg lens and a Luneberg lens system. Long Bo the lens includes: an outer housing comprising a plurality of first dielectric outer rings arranged in a first direction and a plurality of second dielectric outer rings arranged in a second direction, each of the first dielectric outer rings and at least one of the second dielectric outer rings being mutually pivotably coupled; an inner housing arranged concentric with an outer housing, the inner housing comprising a plurality of first dielectric inner rings arranged along the first direction and a plurality of second dielectric inner rings arranged along the second direction, each of the first and at least one of the second dielectric inner rings being mutually pivotably coupled. The Long Bo lens is in an extended state when the first direction is orthogonal to the second direction, and the Long Bo lens is in a collapsed state when the first direction is oblique to the second direction.

title_en: IQ channel calibration method of radio frequency receiver, radio frequency receiver and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an IQ channel calibration method of a radio frequency receiver, the radio frequency receiver and electronic equipment, and relates to the field of communication. The application calibrates the IQ channel of the radio frequency receiver by using the oscillation signal with the phase difference of 90 degrees, does not need to use two oscillators, and can reduce the hardware cost of the radio frequency receiver. And comparing the amplitude difference and the phase difference of the IQ channels of the radio frequency receiver by utilizing the oscillation signals of the two different frequency points twice, and averaging the amplitude difference and the phase difference of the two times to obtain the calibration quantity of the current gain gear, thereby improving the accuracy of IQ channel calibration. In addition, the application can realize the calibration of the IQ channel by only changing the built-in hardware structure of the radio frequency receiver without using an external radio frequency signal source, thereby further reducing the hardware cost of IQ calibration.

title_en: Channel information feedback method and communication device
abstract_en: The application provides a channel information feedback method and a communication device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the terminal equipment receives configuration information sent by the network equipment, wherein the configuration information is used for configuring a feedback mode of channel information; when the feedback mode configured by the configuration information is a first mode, the terminal equipment feeds back the current channel information to the network equipment; and when the feedback mode configured by the configuration information is the second mode, the terminal equipment feeds back the predicted channel information to the network equipment. The method provided by the application can meet the channel information feedback requirements of different scenes, especially the channel information of feedback prediction can solve the problem of data transmission performance degradation caused by expiration of the channel information in a mobile scene, and is beneficial to improving the system performance.

title_en: Phased array receiver chip and phased array wireless receiving system
abstract_en: The application provides a phased array receiver chip and a phased array wireless receiving system, comprising: the band-gap reference current source generates corresponding reference current according to the current chip temperature, and provides the reference current for the N radio frequency channels; the radio frequency channel processes the radio frequency signal transmitted by the receiving antenna under the control of the reference current, and transmits the processed signal to the power synthesizer; the power synthesizer synthesizes the received signals and transmits the synthesized signals to the post-processing circuit. And carrying out self-adaptive adjustment according to the current chip temperature, generating corresponding reference current, providing the reference current for each radio frequency channel, and finishing temperature compensation so that the phased array receiver chip can keep stable performance under various temperature conditions.

title_en: PCIE bus-based remote transmission method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a PCIE bus-based remote transmission method and a PCIE bus-based remote transmission system, which are used for realizing the remote transmission of a PCIE bus. In the method, a master-end conversion device converts an electrical signal based on PCIE into an optical signal, the optical signal is transmitted to a slave-end conversion device through an optical fiber, the optical signal transmitted through the optical fiber is received by the slave-end conversion device, and the optical signal is converted into the PCIE electrical signal. The method can greatly improve the transmission distance of the PCIE bus, has low cost, high reliability and high compatibility, and can be downwards compatible with x16, x8, x4, x2 and x1.

title_en: Underwater sound channel prediction method based on cross frequency domain grouping and deep learning
abstract_en: A method for predicting underwater sound channels based on cross frequency domain grouping and deep learning belongs to the field of wireless communication. The method solves the problems that the existing single tap and single frequency point prediction method cannot utilize the complex time-frequency relation of the channel and the existing deep learning method has high calculation complexity. The frequency point grouping method based on the cross frequency correlation matrix can avoid the problems of too complex model and too many parameters to be trained, which are caused by too many input features of the deep learning predictor model, and high calculation complexity. And the CFDG-DL channel predictor combining the FC layer and the LSTM layer can utilize the complex time-frequency relation of the frequency domain channel, thereby improving the channel prediction performance. The method can be applied to underwater acoustic channel prediction.

title_en: Method and device for reminding user of drop-out, cabin domain controller and traffic vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for reminding a user of missing a drop, a cabin domain controller and a traffic vehicle, and belongs to the field of digital processing. According to the invention, the communication distance change value corresponding to the signal intensity change of the mobile terminal after the passenger gets off the vehicle completely is obtained, and when the comparison result between the communication distance change value and the preset distance threshold meets the drop-out condition, the mobile terminal is judged to be dropped in the vehicle, and drop-out warning is initiated in time. Therefore, passengers can be timely prompted to drop the mobile terminal in the traffic vehicle, so that passengers can timely find that the mobile terminal is dropped, the limitation of the mobile terminal connection function of the traffic vehicle is greatly improved, and convenience is improved. Meanwhile, the use experience of passengers can be improved.

title_en: Optimization method, device, system and storage medium for optical signal-to-noise ratio margin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, a system and a storage medium for optimizing an optical signal to noise ratio tolerance. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an initial algorithm model; the initial algorithm model is improved, and a first algorithm model is obtained; the gradient vector in the first algorithm model is a one-dimensional gradient vector, and the moving step length is calculated based on each one-dimensional gradient vector; and taking the signal quality influence parameters of the transmitting ends of the plurality of coherent light modules as independent variables of the first algorithm model, taking the optical signal to noise ratio margin of the coherent light modules as an objective function of the first algorithm model, and obtaining the signal quality influence parameters of the transmitting ends when the optical signal to noise ratio margin of the coherent light modules is optimal by utilizing the first algorithm model. The scheme provided by the invention can be used for integrally optimizing the optical signal-to-noise ratio tolerance parameter of the coherent optical module, improving the optical signal-to-noise ratio tolerance performance of the coherent optical module and reducing the optimization time of the optical signal-to-noise ratio tolerance of the coherent optical module.

title_en: Anti-robbery clapping mobile phone shell
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-robbery mobile phone shell, which comprises: a mobile phone case 1; the camera protection window 2 is arranged on the mobile phone shell 1 and corresponds to the position of the camera of the mobile phone matched with the anti-robbery mobile phone shell; wherein: the camera protection window 2 is provided with a transparent protective cover 201 which covers the camera of the mobile phone; the magnetic force group 3, set up on shell body 1 of the mobile phone; ferrofluid 4, which is arranged on the mobile phone shell 1 and is pulled by the magnetic force group 3 to cover the transparent protective cover 201 in the working state; the controller 5 is arranged on the mobile phone shell 1, and after receiving a control instruction, the controller 5 controls the magnetic force group 3 to release the magnetic field according to a first preset mode so as to pull the ferrofluid 4 to cover the transparent protective cover 201. Therefore, even if the mobile phone is illegally called to carry out the illegal photographing and illegal recording, the camera of the mobile phone can be blocked by the ferrofluid and cannot realize the illegal photographing and illegal recording.

title_en: Monitoring node, monitoring system, terminal equipment and service system
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a monitoring node, a monitoring system, a terminal device and a service system. The monitoring node includes a thermal imaging camera, a processor, and a wireless module. The thermal imaging camera is disposed within the monitored area at a first predetermined height from the ground surface with the optical axis substantially perpendicular to the ground surface to thermally image a corresponding imaging area on the ground surface. And the processor analyzes the thermal imaging graph to obtain an analysis result. The wireless module wirelessly broadcasts the analysis results, and/or the thermal imaging map. The present disclosure is mainly applied to building indoor spaces, and also to interior spaces of large-sized devices such as trains, ships, airplanes, and the like. According to the method and the device, accurate identification analysis and positioning of the on-site object target in the monitoring area can be achieved at the single node end, and the analysis result and/or the thermal imaging image can be broadcast to the receiving terminal with wireless receiving capability in the monitoring area, so that accurate active and passive positioning functions can be provided for the object target, and other related purposes can be supported.

title_en: Default rules in uplink transmission
abstract_en: A wireless device is capable of receiving first Downlink Control Information (DCI) including an activated Transmission Configuration Indicator (TCI) status code point indicating a TCI status and a second TCI status. The wireless device can receive a second DCI including a field indicating whether to transmit a transport block having one or more of the first TCI state and the second TCI state. The wireless device can transmit a repetition of the transport block based on the field.

title_en: Method for controlling multiple devices
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of equipment control, and provides a method for controlling multiple devices, which aims at simplifying operation steps and improving compatibility of new and old devices, and determines target devices through alignment detection without manual selection, so that the operation is simpler and more convenient; the control command map issued by the target equipment is based on the control command map, the self state of the remote controller is automatically adjusted, the compatibility of iterative change of the control command of the new equipment or the old equipment is stronger, the remote controller does not need to be internally provided with the control command of each equipment in advance, and the cost increase caused by the requirement on the storage space is avoided.

title_en: High-precision positioning and high-speed communication integrated method for underwater sound ultrashort baseline
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater sound ultrashort baseline high-precision positioning and high-speed communication integrated method, which comprises the following steps: the information bit stream is subjected to channel coding to obtain a coding bit vector; vector is obtained after interleaving coding; obtaining a differential PSK symbol vector; obtaining an in-transmission data block through serial-parallel conversion; performing IFFT to obtain a time domain signal x (t); obtaining a transmitting signal s (t); the communication receiving end receives the received signal v  m  (t); five-channel time delay estimation is carried out, and target skew distance R and target azimuth information are calculated Calculating to obtain the target position Doppler estimation and compensation are carried out on the signal v  m  (t) to obtain a signal Then carrying out matched filtering and differential coherent detection to obtain an estimated symbol; and sequentially performing parallel-serial conversion, DPSK demapping, deinterleaving and channel decoding to obtain an information bit stream. The underwater sound positioning and communication system can realize underwater sound high-precision positioning and underwater sound high-speed communication at the same time, avoids the need of installing independent underwater sound positioning and communication equipment for realizing underwater sound positioning and underwater sound communication at the same time, and reduces the use cost and maintenance complexity of the system.

title_en: HPLC Bluetooth communication system-based substation area user transformer identification method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power transmission communication, and discloses a station area user change identification method based on an HPLC Bluetooth communication system, wherein the system comprises an HPLC CCO module, a Bluetooth dual-mode module and a slave Bluetooth module; the Bluetooth dual-mode module comprises an HPLC STA module and a main Bluetooth module, wherein the HPLC CCO module is arranged on a station area user transformer terminal device to realize networking communication with the Bluetooth dual-mode HPLC STA module; the Bluetooth dual-mode module is arranged on an electric energy meter or an intelligent breaker, the master Bluetooth module is communicated with the slave Bluetooth module through Bluetooth networking, and the slave Bluetooth module is arranged on power equipment, such as an ammeter or a breaker.

title_en: Cooperative energy-saving processing method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a cooperative energy-saving processing method and a cooperative energy-saving processing device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining energy-saving state information of the AP, including entering the energy-saving state or exiting the energy-saving state; the energy-saving state information is announced to an SFU energy-saving state machine of the SFU or an MFU energy-saving state machine of the MFU, and the energy-saving state information is used for carrying out cooperative energy-saving processing with a PON system of a high-speed passive optical network, so that the problem that the energy-saving efficiency of the PON system and a WIFI system is not very high and the quick access of new terminal equipment is influenced by delay in waking up from a low-power consumption state in the related art can be solved, when the SFU energy-saving state is entered, an interaction mechanism of the energy-saving state information is announced to the PON system, the cooperative energy saving of the PON and the WIFI system is realized, and when the energy-saving state is exited, the interaction mechanism of the energy-saving state information is announced to the PON system, so that the PON system can be wakened in time, and the quick access of the new terminal equipment can be realized.

title_en: Satellite communication device for controlling offshore unmanned equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a satellite communication device for controlling offshore unmanned equipment. The board card comprises a power management board card, a satellite communication board card and a local network communication board card, wherein a plurality of satellite communication board cards are arranged, so that remote communication control of the offshore multi-unmanned equipment can be realized. In addition, by cascading a plurality of satellite communication devices in the invention, the control quantity of unmanned equipment is greatly increased. The invention can be compatible with satellite communication systems such as the first, second and third domestic heaven, and simultaneously provides a compatible interface for the subsequent low-orbit internet satellites. In addition, the invention also designs a case shell structure, and the insertion and the extraction of the board card are more convenient through the positioning and ejecting mechanism, and the reliable installation of the board card in the case shell is ensured through the locking mechanism, so that the board card is prevented from being ejected out due to misoperation or external force vibration.

title_en: Method and system for sharing beam bandwidth supporting multiple services
abstract_en: The invention provides a beam bandwidth sharing method and system supporting multiple services, comprising the following steps: acquiring the compatible system of a satellite load phased array antenna and the number of beams corresponding to each system; acquiring service bandwidth signals, wherein the service bandwidth signals are synthesized with a plurality of service signals; dividing the bandwidth of each beam to obtain a plurality of sub-bands; and allocating resources required by the service bandwidth signals by utilizing the sub-bands. The bandwidth of each beam is divided, and resources required by the sub lead a group of people service bandwidth signals obtained by division are utilized to allocate, so that any sub-band of all beams in different modes can support different services, thereby realizing the sharing of the total beam frequency band by multiple services, effectively improving the utilization rate of resources, flexibly adjusting the division scheme according to actual service requirements, and solving the problems of poor resource allocation flexibility and serious resource waste under the existing bandwidth allocation scheme.

title_en: Antenna structure and terminal
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to an antenna structure and terminal, antenna structure includes metal center (1), metal center (1) has first radiation arm (11), second radiation arm (12) and third radiation arm (13), first radiation arm (11) with second radiation arm (12) interval sets up, third radiation arm (13) include parasitic branch (131), parasitic branch (131) set up first radiation arm (11) with between second radiation arm (12) to respectively with first radiation arm (11) with second radiation arm (12) interval sets up. The antenna structure can expand the length of the antenna.

title_en: Design method and device for high-gain broadband microstrip antenna and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a high-gain broadband microstrip antenna design method, a device and computer equipment. The high-gain broadband microstrip antenna comprises an antenna radiation plate and an antenna reflection plate, wherein the antenna radiation plate and the antenna reflection plate are relatively arranged in parallel and are connected through a connecting piece, and the antenna radiation plate comprises dipoles and microstrip lines adopting a microstrip balun structure; the method comprises determining the structure and size of dipoles according to a target operating frequency band; according to the target standing wave ratio of the dipoles in the target working frequency band, the size of the microstrip line and the position of the dipoles in the antenna radiation plate are adjusted; and adjusting the distance between the antenna radiation plate and the antenna reflection plate to adjust the beam width to be the target beam width. The method can enable the microstrip antenna to have high-gain interference beams within the frequency band range of 600-2500 MHz, the frequency band bandwidth exceeds 4 times, the lowest gain within the frequency band is greater than 5dB, and the highest gain within the frequency band exceeds 8dB.

title_en: Large-scale radar antenna and transmission part integrated structure and precision control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a large-scale radar antenna and transmission part integrated structure, which comprises: antenna skeleton, fix the antenna back of the body frame at the antenna skeleton back, and rotation axis and gear, wherein: the rotating shaft is arranged on the antenna back frame, and a gear support piece is arranged on the antenna back frame; the central angle of the gear is smaller than or equal to 180 degrees, the gear is arranged on the gear support piece and is coaxial with the rotating shaft, a transverse adjusting gasket is arranged between the end part of the gear and the antenna back frame, and a longitudinal adjusting gasket is arranged between the inner side of the end part of the gear and the antenna back frame. According to the precision control method for the integrated structure of the large-scale radar antenna and the transmission part, when the gear is installed, the thickness of the longitudinal adjusting gasket is repaired according to the measured radial tooth jump value of the gear so as to eliminate the longitudinal gap of the installation surface of the gear; the thickness of the transverse adjusting gasket is repaired according to the coaxiality of the gear and the rotating shaft, so that the transverse gap of the gear mounting surface is eliminated.

title_en: MIMO channel access
abstract_en: Single-input single-output (SISO) data transmission may request multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) rank adaptation information. The number of transmission chains used for transmission may be determined, for example, by an Access Point (AP). A Physical Layer Convergence Procedure (PLCP) protocol data unit (PPDU) may be transmitted to, for example, a Station (STA). The PPDU may include data and Training (TRN) sequences. The number of TRN sequences may be equal to the number of transmission chains. The PPDU may include information associated with the determined number of transmission chains for transmission. Feedback may be received, for example, from the STA. The feedback may include information identifying a transmission chain associated with the transmitted TRN sequence and/or channel measurements associated with the identified transmission chain. The subsequent PPDUs may be transmitted based on channel measurements associated with the transmission chain identified from the received feedback.

title_en: Circuit for signal connection, device for inductive power transfer and signal transmission and method for producing the same
abstract_en: The invention relates to a circuit for connecting a unit for generating a near field communication signal by means of a signal to an antenna structure for near field communication signal transmission, said circuit (1) comprising at least one filter circuit (4) and said antenna structure (3), the filter circuit (4) being an even-order filter circuit, the number of steps being at least 4, wherein the amplitude response (FG) of said circuit (1) decreases monotonically over a defined frequency range; the invention also relates to a device for inductive power transfer and signaling, and to a method of manufacturing a circuit for signal connection.

title_en: Exhibition information pushing method, device, equipment and medium based on visible light communication
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optical information, solves the problems of unstable connection and data transmission delay existing in the prior art that a large-scale exhibition hall depends on radio frequency or a mobile network, and provides an exhibition information pushing method, device, equipment and medium based on visible light communication. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring first position information of each exhibitor in the exhibition venue according to a first light signal sent by a first light source; determining target exhibition positions of the exhibition staff according to the second position information and the first position information of each exhibition position; coding and modulating the display position information of the target display position according to a preset coding and modulating rule to obtain a second optical signal; and controlling a second light source of the target exhibition booth to send a second light signal to the corresponding exhibition staff according to the first position information. The invention can avoid the problems of frequency interference and signal aliasing and ensure the stability and reliability of communication.

title_en: Optical fiber signal testing system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of signal testing, in particular to an optical fiber signal testing system which comprises a processor, a testing front-end preparation analysis module, a testing equipment calibration analysis module, an optical fiber signal detection comparison module and a testing display early warning terminal, wherein the optical fiber signal detection comparison module is used for detecting optical fiber signals; according to the invention, the light source and the light receiver are subjected to pre-preparation analysis, the test equipment is subjected to calibration analysis one by one when the preliminary preparation qualified signal is generated, so that whether the timely calibration signal corresponding to the test equipment is generated or not is judged, the accuracy of a test result and the smooth performance of a test process are guaranteed, the optical fiber signal qualified signal, the test failure high-grade early warning signal or the test failure low-grade early warning signal corresponding to the optical fiber are generated through analysis when the optical fiber signal is tested, and the auxiliary analysis is performed when the optical fiber signal test qualified signal or the test failure low-grade early warning signal is generated, so that the comprehensive and effective analysis of the optical fiber signal test is realized, and the accuracy of the test result is further improved.

title_en: Novel sixteen-channel fiber bragg grating demodulation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel sixteen-channel fiber bragg grating demodulation system, which relates to the field of demodulation of fiber bragg grating sensors and comprises a light source driving module, a light source, a first coupler, a second coupler, an adjustable filter, an electric temperature sensor, an optical module, a circuit acquisition module, an industrial control host, an etalon, a photoelectric converter and a to-be-detected grating sensor, wherein the input end of the light source is electrically connected with the input end of the light source driving module, and the output end of the light source is electrically connected with the etalon, the photoelectric converter and the to-be-detected grating sensor through the first coupler and the second coupler. The novel sixteen-channel fiber grating demodulation system has the characteristics of high sensitivity, high resolution, strong anti-interference capability and the like, can realize real-time monitoring and control of the fiber sensor, can be applied to measurement of various physical quantities such as temperature, pressure, strain, vibration and the like, and can improve the reliability and stability of the fiber communication system.

title_en: Satellite-ground cooperative polarization compensation method and polarization measurement system for quantum satellite
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a satellite-ground cooperative polarization compensation method and a satellite-ground cooperative polarization measurement system for a quantum satellite, the method includes performing coded attenuation processing on pulsed quantum light to obtain a plurality of initial single photons; for any target polarization state, processing each initial single photon by utilizing a target wave plate group with a first angle parameter to obtain a plurality of first target single photons, and detecting the first target single photons by utilizing a plurality of ground detectors to obtain first count data; under the condition that the target wave plate set is adjusted to a second angle parameter, each initial single photon is processed by the target wave plate set to obtain a plurality of second target single photons, and the second target single photons are detected by a plurality of ground detectors to obtain second count data; and generating a polarization compensation angle of the target wave plate group according to the first count data, the second count data and the satellite-based vector data so as to realize polarization compensation of the quantum satellite by utilizing the polarization compensation angle.

title_en: Cavity filter
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a cavity filter, which is characterized in that a cover body is buckled on a body to form a resonant cavity. The driving part is rotationally connected with the limiting part, and a containing groove facing the outer side of the resonant cavity is formed in the driving part. Meanwhile, an internal thread for guiding the driving part to slide is arranged on the side wall of the accommodating groove. Therefore, when the driving part rotates along the internal thread, the driving part can drive the deformation area to deform through the limiting part so as to change the size of the resonant cavity. Therefore, an operator can accurately adjust the filtering performance of the cavity filter by controlling the rotation angle of the driving part. Meanwhile, the metal scraps or external sundries can be prevented from being brought into the resonant cavity due to the arrangement of the adjusting screw. On the other hand, in the process of rotating the driving part, the driving part is arranged in the accommodating groove, so that the occupation of the cavity filter on the space can be reduced.

title_en: Relay communication method based on full duplex satellite
abstract_en: The invention discloses a relay communication method based on a full duplex satellite, and belongs to the technical field of satellite communication. The invention designs the communication ground station and the satellite relay into the CCFD working mode, the satellite relay eliminates the self-interference of the self-transmitting antenna by using the self-interference elimination module, and the ground station eliminates the self-interference of the self-transmitting antenna and the self-interference of the satellite relay downlink by using the self-interference elimination module, thereby realizing the two-way communication of the two ground stations simultaneously through the same frequency of the satellite relay. The invention can improve the spectrum utilization efficiency of satellite relay and overcome the defects of the prior PCMA and CCFD technology.

title_en: Substrate integrated waveguide filter antenna
abstract_en: The invention relates to a substrate integrated waveguide filter antenna which comprises an upper layer dielectric substrate, an upper layer metal grounding plate, a middle layer dielectric substrate, a middle layer metal grounding plate, a lower layer dielectric substrate and a lower layer metal grounding plate which are sequentially stacked to form an antenna part and a filter part, wherein two rectangular radiation gaps are etched on the upper layer metal grounding plate, a radiation unit is coupled with the filter part through the two rectangular radiation gaps, two rectangular coupling grooves are etched at the positions, close to two ends, of the middle layer metal grounding plate, a square coupling groove with a coupling branch is etched at the central position, an upper resonant cavity and a lower resonant cavity of the filter part are coupled through the rectangular coupling grooves and the square coupling groove with the coupling branch, an excitation source is arranged on the lower layer metal grounding plate, and electromagnetic waves generated by the excitation source are firstly transmitted to the filter part through the rectangular coupling grooves on the middle layer metal grounding plate, and then transmitted to a metal patch through the rectangular radiation gaps on the upper layer metal grounding plate and radiated.

title_en: Multifunctional composite material radome
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional composite material radome, which relates to the technical field of radar radomes, wherein a radome body comprises a front panel, a back panel and two side panels; the front plate comprises a first aramid paper honeycomb core, two layers of quartz cyanate ester prepreg laminates are respectively arranged on the front side and the rear side of the first aramid paper honeycomb core, and an intermediate adhesive film is arranged between the first aramid paper honeycomb core and the quartz cyanate ester prepreg laminates; the side panel comprises a second aramid paper honeycomb core, two layers of alkali-free cloth prepreg laminates are respectively arranged on the left side and the right side of the second aramid paper honeycomb core, an epoxy adhesive film is arranged between the second aramid paper honeycomb core and the alkali-free cloth prepreg laminates, and a lightning rod is fixedly arranged on one side, outside the cover body, of the side panel; the back plate comprises an aluminum honeycomb core, two layers of conductive carbon fiber prepreg laminates are respectively arranged on the front side and the rear side of the aluminum honeycomb core, and an epoxy adhesive film is arranged between the aluminum honeycomb core and the conductive carbon fiber prepreg laminates. The multifunctional composite material radome provided by the invention has excellent wave-transmitting performance and heat dissipation performance.

title_en: Playing method, device, audio playing equipment, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a playing method, a device, an audio playing device, an electronic device and a storage medium, which are applied to the audio playing device, wherein the audio playing device comprises a playing storage area, and the method is characterized by comprising the following steps: acquiring a first time difference value between a first synchronous playing time corresponding to first data and a first receiving time when the audio playing equipment receives the first data; based on the magnitude relation between the first time difference value and a preset time threshold value, configuring the first synchronous playing time or a second synchronous playing time as a playing trigger time, wherein the second synchronous playing time comprises a synchronous playing time corresponding to second data received after the first data; and when the play trigger time is reached, reading data from the play storage area and playing. The method can ensure enough time to configure the playing trigger time, and improves the stability of the audio playing device in playing.

title_en: Liftable radar antenna pedestal device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ship equipment, and particularly relates to a liftable radar antenna pedestal device, which comprises a radar antenna pedestal, a hydraulic component and a connecting frame, wherein the radar antenna pedestal comprises a radar antenna pedestal and angle steel, and the angle steel is vertically arranged around the radar antenna pedestal; the hydraulic component comprises a hydraulic cylinder, a piston rod and a cylinder body, wherein a connecting plate is arranged on the end face of one side of the cylinder body, which is close to the radar antenna base, the hydraulic cylinder is fixedly arranged in the cylinder body, and one end of the hydraulic cylinder extends out of the connecting plate through the piston rod to be connected with the radar antenna base; the connecting frame is used for connecting the radar antenna pedestal when the height, and the angle steel is fixed on the connecting plate through bolts and nuts. The device not only can meet the use height requirement of the radar antenna, but also can reduce the height of the antenna pedestal when needed, ensure that the ship can smoothly pass through the area with limited height, thereby improving the sailing efficiency and the safety of the roll-on-roll-off ship.

title_en: RIS-based enterprise intranet universe coverage method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise intranet universe coverage method and system based on RIS, which relates to the technical field of wireless communication, and comprises the steps of setting a RIS unit of a multilayer metamaterial structure according to a self-adaptive phase adjustment algorithm, optimizing frequency response, realizing omnibearing signal receiving and transmitting, constructing a channel model, and realizing cooperative work of a base station and the RIS unit; identifying a mountain area communication blind area through an RIS phased array, changing the direction of a transmission path, covering the blind area communication blind area to a user base station, and realizing blind area link establishment communication; and combining the urban signal area and the mountain area communication blind area, dynamically adjusting the position and the angle of the RIS unit, and realizing the enterprise intranet global coverage. According to the invention, the RIS configuration is optimized through the federal learning framework, so that the base station and the RIS unit work cooperatively, and the communication efficiency of the coverage area is improved; identifying and covering a mountain area communication blind area through an RIS phased array to realize blind area link establishment communication; the position and the angle of the RIS unit are dynamically adjusted by combining the urban signal area and the mountain area communication blind area, so that the global coverage of the enterprise intranet is realized.

title_en: Signal forwarding device
abstract_en: A signal forwarding device belongs to the technical field of network transmission, and relates to an intelligent control technology for various industries in the information technology industry; the invention is matched with the prior achievements of the applicant, a transmission system and a central control system form a line and a scheme for transmitting enhanced signals, the transmission system tracks and receives and memorizes original control platform signals, a modulation signal channel is formed, the transmission system is controlled, the central control system receives signals of the transmission system and related units to form a central control channel, the result of the central control channel controls the transmission rule of the transmission system, double-channel double control is formed, a transmission basis is formed, and the circuit is further provided with a time-staggered starting unit, a transmission control part, a long-time transmission control part and a program control circuit.

title_en: Optical network risk node determining method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for determining an optical network risk node, belonging to the technical field of optical networks, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring all network devices of an optical network or optical fiber connections among the network devices, and determining optical network services corresponding to the network devices or the optical fiber connections; performing simulated rerouting on each optical network service and simulated allocation of occupied time slot resources to obtain a rerouting execution state of each optical network service; and determining all the risk nodes according to the rerouting execution states. The invention determines the network equipment or the optical fiber connection with failed rerouting in advance by carrying out simulated rerouting and simulated allocation of the time slot resources occupied by the optical network service corresponding to each network equipment or the optical fiber connection in advance, avoids the failed rerouting caused by a static threshold and excessive investment, and improves the self-healing rate of ASON service.

title_en: Modulation Coding Scheme (MCS) correction method, network equipment and device
abstract_en: The application provides a Modulation Coding Scheme (MCS) correction method, network equipment and a device, wherein the method is applied to the network equipment and comprises the following steps: determining a single transmission stream SINR between the network device and the first terminal; determining a multi-transport stream SINR between the network device and the first terminal; determining SINR loss values of transmission flows between the network equipment and the first terminal under space division interference between the first terminal and the second terminal according to the single transmission flow SINR and the multiple transmission flow SINR; determining an MCS level back-off value between the network device and the first terminal according to the SINR loss value; and correcting the MCS level between the network equipment and the first terminal according to the MCS level back-off value. The application can carry out MCS correction according to the space division interference intensity, and realizes the balance between MCS backspacing and space allocation pair probability.

title_en: Space terahertz communication beam tracking device and method based on beam waveguide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space terahertz communication beam tracking device and method based on a beam waveguide, wherein the device comprises the following components: the terahertz wave beam waveguide tracking antenna, the terahertz double-channel receiver, the angle tracking receiver, the tracking controller, the position and posture sensor and the two-dimensional servo rotating mechanism; the terahertz dual-channel is used for processing the terahertz sum signal and the terahertz difference signal to obtain an intermediate frequency sum signal and an intermediate frequency difference signal; the angle tracking receiver obtains an error angle signal according to the intermediate frequency sum signal and the intermediate frequency difference signal; the position posture sensor measures the position posture value in real time; the tracking controller obtains a compensation error angle according to the error angle signal and the position attitude value, and controls the two-dimensional servo rotating mechanism to rotate according to the compensation error angle. The invention solves the problems that the traditional radio frequency receiver needs to be hard-linked with the terahertz antenna through the waveguide and rotates together with the antenna, thereby increasing the moment of inertia of the servo rotating mechanism and needing to additionally use a microwave rotating joint.

title_en: Processing equipment and method for circulator
abstract_en: The invention discloses processing equipment and a processing method of a circulator, and relates to the technical field of processing and production of circulators; the automatic feeding device comprises a workbench, wherein a supporting frame assembly is arranged at the top end of the workbench, a top frame is arranged at the top end of the supporting frame assembly, four symmetrically distributed movable adjusting plates are arranged at the bottom of the top frame, a lifting assembly and a feeding assembly are arranged on the movable adjusting plates, a driving assembly is arranged at the top end of the top frame, and a spacing adjusting assembly is arranged in the top frame; according to the invention, the lifting assembly, the driving assembly and the feeding assembly are arranged, the four screws are respectively conveyed to the corresponding driving assemblies through the feeding assembly, the four screws are driven to descend through the lifting assembly and simultaneously driven to rotate through the driving assembly to be installed on the circulator, and the distance adjusting assembly and the supporting frame assembly are arranged, so that the distance adjusting assembly drives the movable adjusting plate to move under the guiding of the supporting frame assembly to adjust the installation distance of the screws.

title_en: Time synchronization method and device and computer equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of vehicle control, and provides a time synchronization method, a time synchronization device and computer equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving a first message and a second message sent by standard equipment, and determining a first relative moment of the standard equipment according to time information in the first message and the second message; maintaining a first relative time of the standard device based on the first relative time; and sending a third message and a fourth message to target equipment, so that the target equipment determines a second relative moment of the standard equipment according to the time information in the third message and the fourth message, wherein the second relative moment is used for the target equipment to maintain a second relative time of the standard equipment. According to the technical scheme provided by one or more embodiments of the present disclosure, the cost of time synchronization can be reduced, and the compatibility of time synchronization is improved.

title_en: XQUIC protocol-oriented satellite network congestion control method based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a satellite network congestion control method based on deep reinforcement learning and oriented to XQUIC protocols, relates to the field of network transmission congestion control, and solves the problems of heterogeneous training environment, difficult method convergence, low parallel training efficiency and the like caused by the high delay and high dynamic property of a satellite network in the existing method. The asynchronous distributed parallel training architecture is also provided, and the problems of low sampling efficiency, unbalanced sampling data distribution and limited single-node network simulation capability of a high-delay and high-dynamic satellite network environment are solved through parallel training.

title_en: Beam management method, device, terminal and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a beam management method, a device, a terminal and a readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of communication, wherein the beam management method is applied to a first terminal and comprises the following steps: transmitting a first reference signal to a second terminal; receiving a beam measurement result sent by the second terminal, wherein the beam measurement result is obtained by the second terminal through beam energy detection according to the first reference signal; and carrying out beam determination according to the beam measurement result. The scheme of the invention can realize millimeter wave communication of the direct link.

title_en: Robust watermarking system based on two-dimensional code detection and correction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robust watermarking system based on two-dimension code detection and correction, which relates to the technical field of image processing and watermarking, and comprises a DES encryption module, a watermarking block embedding module, a two-dimension code identification module, an image correction module and an information extraction module; the safe embedding and the reliable extraction of the information are realized; the watermark information is encrypted by using a DES encryption module to prevent information from being stolen or modified, and the encrypted watermark is embedded into the two-dimensional code by using a watermark block embedding module; the picture containing the two-dimensional code is extracted to obtain two-dimensional code information through a two-dimensional code identification module, the image correction module is used for correcting the distorted two-dimensional code image in a perspective mode, the image correction module is used for processing edges of the distorted two-dimensional code image to obtain a complete two-dimensional code image, the information extraction module is used for obtaining watermark information, the key information watermark is hidden in the two-dimensional code on the premise that normal two-dimensional code extraction is not affected, and the fact that the two-dimensional code can still be scanned and decoded normally even if the watermark embedding position changes is guaranteed.

title_en: Yagi antenna and support applied to yagi antenna
abstract_en: The invention discloses a yagi antenna and a bracket applied to the yagi antenna. The yagi antenna comprises a main board, a folded vibrator, a plurality of directors and a disc, wherein the folded vibrator is arranged on the main board and is used for amplifying electromagnetic waves of external equipment received by the yagi antenna, so that the yagi antenna receives stronger electromagnetic signals; the plurality of directors are arranged on the main board, the distances among the plurality of directors are the same, and the directors can strengthen electromagnetic waves transmitted or incoming from one side of the extending direction of the directors; the disc is a metal disc, the metal disc is arranged on the main board corresponding to the folded vibrator, and the metal disc can weaken electromagnetic waves transmitted from the outside. The scheme aims at solving the problems that the size of the existing yagi antenna is too large and portability of the yagi antenna is affected.

title_en: Channel estimation optimization method, device, equipment and medium of base station MIMO wireless communication system
abstract_en: The application relates to a channel estimation optimization method, a device, equipment and a medium of a base station MIMO wireless communication system, which relate to the field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining channel lead codes in various communication connection requests; the method comprises the steps of determining pulse release rates of a plurality of neurons corresponding to channel preambles in a preset channel estimation optimization model based on the channel preambles in a communication connection request, carrying out poisson sampling according to the pulse release rates by using poisson distribution in the neurons of the channel estimation optimization model, randomly generating a time interval for next pulse release, recording channel pulse codes of the channel preambles corresponding to the current time point when the accumulated time interval reaches or exceeds a preset time interval threshold, and inputting the channel pulse codes of the channel preambles to a variable self-encoder in the channel estimation optimization model to reconstruct the channel preambles. The application improves the accuracy and efficiency of channel estimation and simultaneously obviously reduces the energy consumption of the MIMO wireless communication system.

title_en: Optical time domain reflectometer test box for smart phone and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an optical time domain reflectometer test box for a smart phone and an operation method thereof, wherein the smart phone comprises a third interface module and a data processing module, the test box comprises an optical time domain reflectometer laser emission module, an optical time domain reflectometer signal receiving module, a power supply conversion management module, a first interface module, a second interface module and a micro-control unit module. The optical time domain reflectometer test box for the smart phone integrates the optical time domain reflectometer into the test box, and the test box is small in size and light in weight, and does not have a battery; and the optical time domain reflectometer testing software is installed on the smart phone, and the data communication, the data processing and the result display are completed by utilizing the powerful data processing capacity and the data storage capacity of the smart phone.

title_en: Optical fiber fault positioning method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault positioning method and device for optical fibers, and relates to the technical field of optical communication. The management device can determine the fault logic fiber with faults from the optical network according to the fiber breakage alarm information of the optical network, further, the management device determines the fault fiber related to the fault logic fiber according to the fiber mapping relation of the optical network, acquires the fault physical position of the fault point in the fault fiber, and outputs the fault physical position, so that the process of manually determining the fault fiber corresponding to the fault logic fiber according to the fault logic fiber checking drawing is avoided, the process of manually detecting the physical position of the fault point in the fault fiber in the field is avoided, the fault positioning efficiency of the optical fiber in the optical network is improved, and the fault recovery time of the optical network is reduced.

title_en: Wireless communication device, terminal equipment, signal processing method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a wireless communication device, terminal equipment, a signal processing method and a system, wherein the wireless communication device comprises a signal selection module, a radio frequency module and a baseband module, wherein the signal selection module is connected with the radio frequency module; the signal selection module is connected with the baseband module; the signal selection module is used for selecting the first signal and the second signal and outputting the first signal and the second signal to the baseband module; the first signal is input to the signal selection module through the radio frequency module, and the second signal is not input to the signal selection module through the radio frequency module.

title_en: Method and device for resisting adjacent star interference of small-caliber antenna and small-caliber antenna array
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for resisting adjacent satellite interference of a small-caliber antenna, and a small-caliber antenna array, and belongs to the technical field of satellite communication. The method comprises the steps of controlling the azimuth of each small-caliber antenna included in the small-caliber antenna array based on an ephemeris graph, geographic position information of the small-caliber antenna array and current time information, enabling each small-caliber antenna to be aligned to each target satellite in the current time, enabling the number of target satellites to be smaller than or equal to that of the small-caliber antennas included in the small-caliber antenna array, enabling common-frequency beams of the target satellites in the current time to cover the small-caliber antenna array, obtaining signals received by each small-caliber antenna in the current time, and obtaining adjacent satellite removing interference signals received by each small-caliber antenna in the current time based on the received signals and the directional diagrams of each small-caliber antenna. The method and the device for resisting adjacent star interference of the small-caliber antenna, the small-caliber antenna array and the adjacent star interference resisting effect are excellent.

title_en: Satellite network mobility management method and system based on PMIPv6
abstract_en: The invention discloses a satellite network mobility management method and system based on PMIPv6, and belongs to the field of satellite communication. The system includes a plurality of distributed deployed location mobility anchor LMAs, ground stations, a ground service network, and mobile access satellites MAS. The LMA is used as a key management node for interaction between the ground service network and the satellite network and is responsible for user mobility management, data forwarding and information synchronization between the LMAs. The MAS is used as a user satellite network access point, a fixed IP address of the same network segment is allocated for the user, the MAS serves as a router to issue network segment routes, and a proper LMA is selected for user registration. The mobility management method comprises the mechanisms of user registration, handover, data forwarding, LMA synchronization and the like. The invention improves the accessibility and reliability of the ground service network backhaul route in the low-orbit satellite network, realizes the efficient bidirectional data transmission between the user and the ground network, and is suitable for a future large-scale LEO satellite communication system.

title_en: Difunctional terahertz metamaterial absorber based on vanadium dioxide and photosensitive silicon
abstract_en: The invention provides a difunctional terahertz metamaterial absorber based on vanadium dioxide and photosensitive silicon, which is formed by periodically arranging a plurality of unit structures with square cross sections; each unit structure consists of a resonance layer, a dielectric layer and a vanadium dioxide film layer from top to bottom; the resonant layer consists of a horizontal metal cutting line, four identical vanadium dioxide circular rings and two vertical photosensitive silicon structures; the vanadium dioxide ring comprises a pair of complete vanadium dioxide rings and a pair of vanadium dioxide rings with openings at the upper end and the lower end; the complete vanadium dioxide ring is arranged on the main diagonal of the resonant layer, and the open vanadium dioxide ring is arranged on the auxiliary diagonal of the resonant layer; the horizontal metal cutting line is arranged at the horizontal symmetrical line position of the resonant layer; each photosensitive silicon structure is penetrated through the opening of each vanadium dioxide ring with one end connected with the horizontal metal cutting line and the other end leveled with the edge of the square unit structure.

title_en: Combined detection decoding method, device, equipment, medium and product of MIMO system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a joint detection decoding method, a device, equipment, a medium and a product of a MIMO system. The method comprises the following steps: detecting a receiving vector to obtain a current log-likelihood ratio of each bit of each transmitting symbol in the transmitting vector, decoding the current log-likelihood ratio to obtain a virtual codeword and a first real codeword, storing the virtual codeword and the first real codeword into a first codeword set, storing the first real codeword into a second codeword set, searching a first target codeword in the first codeword set, determining a next log-likelihood ratio based on a competing codeword of the first target codeword and serving as the current log-likelihood ratio, and carrying out iterative updating on the first codeword set and the second codeword set to output an updated second codeword set; determining a second target codeword in the target second codeword set and taking the second target codeword as a decoding result; according to the technical scheme, the generation quality of the code word list can be improved, so that the performance of data detection and the convergence rate of joint detection decoding are improved.

title_en: Optical transparent reflective array antenna based on liquid crystal
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical transparent reflective array antenna based on liquid crystal, which comprises: the radiating structure comprises a top layer transparent substrate, a radiating unit, a liquid crystal layer, a grounding plate and a bottom layer transparent substrate, and the feed source structure comprises a pyramid loudspeaker. The antenna of the invention forms a beam in a specified direction by carrying out phase compensation on an array unit, adopts a mode of combining a liquid crystal material with an ITO transparent material and replacing the existing metal patch and a grounding plate with a patch and a grounding plate made of ITO films, and compared with the existing reflection array antenna based on liquid crystal, the antenna realizes the design of a completely transparent reflection array antenna, is a feasible solution for various new applications, adopts a sub-wavelength rectangular patch, reduces the reflection loss of the unit near a resonance point due to the existence of a field in a space among a substrate, air and adjacent units, and effectively reduces the conductor loss in the design of the reflection array antenna.

title_en: Electromagnetic wave absorber based on fractal rectangular structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electromagnetic wave absorber based on a fractal rectangular structure, which is of a central symmetrical structure as a whole, and comprises a metal back plate layer and a wave absorbing structure, wherein the wave absorbing structure comprises a base layer and a plurality of wave absorbing layers, and the base layer material and the wave absorbing layers are the same or different in material; each wave-absorbing layer is of a fractal rectangular structure with the same shape and different sizes, each wave-absorbing layer comprises an initial rectangular structure and four small rectangular structures, the four small rectangular structures iterate outwards by taking four vertexes of the initial rectangular structure as the center, the substrate layers are distributed on the metal back plate layers, each wave-absorbing layer is arranged on the substrate layers, and the areas of the wave-absorbing layers from bottom to top are in gradient reduction trend. The electromagnetic absorber has the advantages of simple structure, easy regulation and control of structural parameters, wide absorption bandwidth, high absorptivity, insensitive polarization and the like, and provides a method for realizing wide-angle broadband absorption design of electromagnetic waves.

title_en: Remote controller
abstract_en: A remote controller (100) as a remote controller is provided with: a lithium ion battery (111); an infrared signal transmission unit (102) and a resistor (101) connected in parallel with the lithium ion battery (111), wherein the resistor (101) is connected in series with the infrared signal transmission unit (102) as a first resistor; a microcomputer (105) connected in parallel with the lithium ion battery (111) and serving as a microcomputer for controlling the transmission of the infrared signal from the infrared signal transmission unit (102); and a plurality of capacitors (106-110) connected in parallel with the microcomputer (105) and including two or more ceramic capacitors.

title_en: MOFs derived electromagnetic wave absorbing material, preparation method and application
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of electromagnetic wave absorbing materials, and particularly relates to a MOFs derivative electromagnetic wave absorbing material, a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps of S1, dissolving cobalt acetate and/or zinc acetate in deionized water, stirring at room temperature to form a solution A, dissolving dimethyl imidazole in the deionized water, stirring at room temperature to form a solution B, pouring the solution B into the solution A, stirring, and performing centrifugal drying to obtain accordion MOFs precursors, and S2, performing high-temperature carbonization treatment on the accordion MOFs precursors under the condition of mixed gas of H  2  and N  2  to obtain the accordion MOFs derivative electromagnetic wave absorbing material. The preparation process is simple, the cost is low, no material polluting the environment is used in the preparation process, and the prepared electromagnetic wave absorbing material can simultaneously realize the effective combination of electromagnetic cooperation and a porous structure.

title_en: Switching circuit, switching application system, communication equipment and switching application method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a switching circuit, a switching application system, communication equipment and a switching application method, relates to the technical field of communication, and is used for reducing the power consumption of the switching circuit. The switching circuit comprises a first sub-switching circuit and a second sub-switching circuit which are connected in parallel, wherein the first sub-switching circuit comprises at least one first depletion type transistor connected in series, and the second sub-switching circuit comprises at least one first enhancement type transistor connected in series; the switching circuit comprises a first end, the first sub-switching circuit comprises a second end and a third end, and the second sub-switching circuit comprises a fourth end and a fifth end; the first end is electrically connected with the second end, and the first end is electrically connected with the fourth end; under the condition that the switching circuit is powered off, the second end and the third end are connected, and the fourth end and the fifth end are disconnected.

title_en: Vehicle-ground communication multipath interference suppression method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle-ground communication multipath interference suppression method, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a simulation space according to a vehicle-ground communication scene, and determining a track position and a ground base station position; s2, presetting a train running direction, selecting a plurality of train terminal positions according to a train running method within a track position length range, respectively simulating train-ground communication modes into train-ground receiving and ground-transmitting train-receiving for each selected train terminal position, carrying out channel simulation based on a ray tracing method, and determining performance parameters of multipath signals, direct signals and composite signals of a receiving end under two train-ground communication modes; s3, determining the running length of the train based on the running direction of the train, the terminal position of the train and the track position of each selected terminal position of the train; taking the track length, the train running length corresponding to a single train terminal position and the synthesized signal performance parameter under a train-ground communication mode as an input data set, and taking the direct signal performance parameter under the same train-ground communication mode of the single train terminal position as a corresponding output data set; and S4, training a neural network based on input data sets and output data sets corresponding to all train terminal positions in the same train-ground communication mode, obtaining a multipath signal suppression model of a receiving end in the train-ground communication mode, performing multipath signal suppression on the receiving end through the multipath signal suppression model during actual train-ground communication, and estimating a direct signal.

title_en: User grouping and power distribution method for PD-NOMA system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PD-NOMA system user grouping and power distribution method, which comprises the steps of obtaining the total user number of the PD-NOMA system, the signal-to-noise ratio of receiving end symbols corresponding to all users and grouping threshold parameters, obtaining a first grouping according to the signal-to-noise ratio of the receiving end symbols corresponding to all users and the grouping threshold parameters through a set grouping scheme, eliminating users in the first grouping from the total user number, continuing grouping according to the rest users through the set grouping scheme until all users finish grouping, determining a power distribution coefficient based on the obtained user grouping, and obtaining channel capacity of all groups and power distribution of the users in all groups. The method comprises the steps of providing a grouping scheme of a multi-user scene under a PD-NOMA system, a constraint condition that user equipment can share the same spectrum resource in groups, a power allocation scheme of the user equipment sharing the same spectrum resource and a decoding sequence scheme of a receiving end.

title_en: Distributed monopole antenna for enhanced cross-body linking
abstract_en: The disclosed distributed monopole antenna may include a first conductive plate and a second conductive plate. The distributed monopole antenna may also include a plurality of different vias that electrically connect the first conductive plate to the second conductive plate. Still further, the distributed monopole antenna may include an antenna feed electrically connected to at least one of the plurality of vias. Various other systems, methods of manufacture, and wearable electronic devices implementing the distributed monopole antenna are also disclosed.

title_en: General sense integrated signal generation method and device, product and electronic equipment
