abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, a product and an electronic device for generating a sense-on integrated signal, which relate to the technical field of sense-on integrated, the method can limit the position of a sense sub-carrier in a frequency division multiplexing symbol corresponding to a sense resource through a sense resource pattern, generate a corresponding chirp sense reference signal sequence, apply the chirp sense reference signal sequence to the position of the sense sub-carrier, the pattern for generating the all-in-one frequency division multiplexing signal can be obtained, the all-in-one signal generation flow based on frequency division multiplexing is realized, and compared with all-in-one signal generation based on time division multiplexing, the all-in-one frequency division multiplexing signal comprises a communication part and a sensing part, and can realize all-time all-in-one. In addition, the monopolization of resources in the frequency domain or the time domain dimension can be avoided, the resource allocation is optimized, and the resource waste is avoided.

title_en: Method for improving network signal quality
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving network signal quality, which belongs to the technical field of device heat dissipation control and comprises the steps of adjusting the transmitting power of a transmitting device at intervals, acquiring the temperature of the transmitting device in real time, under any transmitting power, not starting the radiating device to generate a temperature change curve along with time, starting the radiating device and gradually improving the radiating power of the radiating device to obtain a standard temperature rise curve, obtaining an optimal temperature rise curve from the temperature rise curve according to an actual temperature rise curve, taking the optimal radiating power corresponding to the optimal temperature rise curve as initial radiating power, acquiring an actual temperature change curve in the radiating device after the radiating device is started and comparing the optimal temperature change curve with the standard temperature rise curve, and adjusting the radiating power of the radiating device according to a comparison result.

title_en: Communication device, communication method and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of short-distance communication, and particularly relates to communication equipment, a communication method and a readable storage medium, wherein the communication equipment comprises the steps of obtaining a card swiping speed, and when the card swiping speed exceeds a set threshold value, a processing unit drives a speed reducing unit to output acting force opposite to the advancing direction of a communication card in a card swiping channel; the invention can timely reduce the speed when the speed of swiping the card is too high, can overcome the problem of missing read-write contents caused by too high speed of swiping the card of the communication card, and the swiping habit of a cardholder is input by swiping the card for many times at the same time, so as to realize judging whether to swipe the card for the cardholder, improve the swiping safety, realize the combination of double-sided swiping and multi-communication mode swiping, improve the swiping safety, optimize the swiping operation and more quickly and conveniently carry out swiping.

title_en: Power self-adaption method, system, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a power self-adaption method, a system, a terminal and a storage medium, which relate to the field of intelligent water meters and comprise the steps of obtaining the flow velocity of water flow in the water meter; the method comprises the steps of calculating the difference between the water flow speed and a preset reference flow speed, defining the difference as the flow speed difference, matching the emission frequency from a preset emission frequency matching model according to the flow speed difference when the flow speed difference falls into a preset emission interval, controlling a preset emission device to emit water flow speed information according to the emission frequency, and defining the water flow speed as the reference flow speed. The intelligent water meter energy utilization rate control method has the effects of improving the energy utilization rate of the intelligent water meter and changing the frequency of information transmission according to the condition of the flow rate of water flow.

title_en: Transmission line structure and wireless communication system
abstract_en: A transmission line structure and a wireless communication system. The transmission line structure comprises a first transmission line, a plurality of second transmission lines and an impedance conversion transmission line, wherein the first transmission line is coupled with a first port and is provided with a first impedance and a first line width, the second transmission lines are respectively coupled with a plurality of second ports and are provided with a second impedance and a second line width which are respectively identical to the first impedance and the first line width, and the impedance conversion transmission line is coupled between the first transmission line and the second transmission lines and is provided with a third impedance smaller than the first impedance and a third line width larger than the first line width. The transmission line structure of the invention can be used as a feedback network of the radio frequency front end module for transmitting a plurality of feedback signals of a plurality of power amplifier modules to a transceiver of a wireless communication system so as to reduce the cost of the radio frequency front end module.

title_en: Nationwide data communication network shutdown based on Ruifeng micro RK3588
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a shutdown of a nationwide data communication network based on a Rayleigh core micro RK 3588. The full-country data communication network shutdown based on the Rayleigh core micro RK3588 comprises a main board module which is manufactured in a full country, an interface board module comprises an indication lamp board and a network port expansion board, all components of the main board module and the interface board module adopt home brands, a power supply module comprises a double-path redundant power supply which is used for providing power for the main board module and the interface board module, a case module comprises a case body and front and rear panels which are arranged on the case body, and a software module comprises firmware and an operating system. The whole-country data communication network based on the Rayleigh core micro RK3588 is powered off, home-made devices are selected for each component of the main board and the interface board, 100% home-made of board-level components is achieved, home-made products are adopted for the power supply and the chassis, home-made operation systems are adopted for the operation systems, 100% whole-country production of the whole machine is achieved, and further complete autonomous control of key equipment of the power system is achieved.

title_en: Water logging sensor and use method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of water logging sensors, in particular to a water logging sensor and a use method thereof, the water logging sensor comprises a mounting seat, a buzzer is inserted at the top end of the mounting seat, a Bluetooth module body is arranged in the buzzer, a mounting mechanism is arranged in the inner wall of the mounting seat, a locking mechanism is arranged on the outer wall of the mounting seat, and when the buzzer and the mounting seat are in butt joint, the two containing bins and two limiting plates in the mounting mechanism are arranged, the quick locking is convenient for the staff to install and dismantle to make things convenient for the staff and the user to carry out the change and the installation of subassembly, and through the setting of sealing member, can go to pump into gas when bee calling organ and mount pad are installed, make sealing strip inflation, sealing strip laminating seal groove, when increasing sealed effect, also can further consolidate bee calling organ and mount pad, and locking mechanical system's setting, synchronous unblock of being convenient for facilitates the use.

title_en: Time synchronization accuracy self-monitoring method, time sensing system and self-monitoring system for time sensitive network
abstract_en: The application provides a time synchronization accuracy self-monitoring method, a time sensing system and a self-monitoring system for a time sensitive network, wherein the method comprises the steps of sequentially receiving a synchronous message sent by a previous node in a time synchronization information transmission path where the time sensitive network is positioned and a following message uniquely corresponding to the synchronous message in the time sensitive network, wherein the previous node is a preset master clock node or other time sensing systems; based on the synchronous message, the following message and the propagation delay between the following message and the previous node, acquiring a local clock offset value, performing time synchronization accuracy self-monitoring on the local clock offset value, and if the local clock offset value is monitored to meet the time synchronization accuracy rule, calibrating the local clock based on the local clock offset value. The application can monitor the accuracy of the received time synchronization message on the time sensing system in real time and can ensure the accuracy of time synchronization in the time sensitive network.

title_en: Portable bracket for remote control of unmanned aerial vehicle inspection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable bracket for remote control of unmanned aerial vehicle inspection, which comprises a waist fixing bracket, two shoulder straps, a first bracket, a remote controller placing platform, a second bracket, a flat panel placing platform and a sun shield, wherein the two shoulder straps are connected to the waist fixing bracket through three buckles, one end of the first bracket is fixed on the waist fixing bracket, the remote controller placing platform is arranged above the first bracket, one end of the second bracket is rotationally connected with the first bracket through a rotating shaft, the other end of the second bracket is rotationally connected with the flat panel placing platform, the sun shield is rotationally connected above the flat panel placing platform, the portable bracket supports the remote controller placing platform through the first bracket, the second bracket supports the flat panel placing platform, the angle of the portable bracket can be adjusted according to personal use requirements, the portable bracket is convenient to watch and operate, the problem of neck and shoulder pain, dizziness, tinnitus and other symptoms caused by long-time forward low head of an inspection person is solved, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Antenna structure, control method and control device thereof, and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to an antenna structure, a control method, a control device and electronic equipment thereof, which comprise a radiator, wherein two ends of the radiator are respectively a first free end and a second free end, the radiator is provided with a plurality of spaced feed points and a plurality of spaced grounding points, and the feed points are spaced from the grounding points; the radiator can move relative to the feed source and the floor, so that the feed source is connected to a target feed point in a switchable conduction mode, the floor is connected to a target grounding point in a switchable conduction mode, the target feed point is one of a plurality of feed points, and the target grounding point is one of a plurality of grounding points. Through the movement of the radiator relative to the feed source and the floor, the feed source is connected to the target feed point in a switchable manner, and meanwhile, the floor is connected to the target ground point in a switchable manner, so that the electric length of the radiator is changed, and the switching of multi-frequency band communication can be performed under the condition that a tuner is not additionally arranged and the whole machine space is not occupied, so that the frequency of the antenna can be reconfigured, and the working requirements of the antenna in different frequency bands are met.

title_en: High-bandwidth power line communication method based on carrier aggregation technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication, in particular to a high-bandwidth power line communication method based on carrier aggregation technology, which comprises the steps of selecting a load for carrying out frequency band subcarrier adjustment based on the data quantity to be transmitted of the load of each unstable trend frequency band subcarrier, aggregating a plurality of unstable trend frequency band subcarriers into an optimized subcarrier, or determining characteristic loads corresponding to each unstable trend frequency band subcarrier, adjusting the starting moment of the characteristic load, and further realizing the optimization of the data transmission method according to the delay condition and the load demands of different subcarriers, and improving the overall performance and the resource utilization rate of a power line communication system.

title_en: Terminal-emission leaky-wave antenna with arbitrary dielectric constant based on subarray alternation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an end-fire leaky-wave antenna with any dielectric constant based on subarrays alternation, which comprises an upper metal layer, a dielectric substrate and a lower metal layer which are sequentially arranged from top to bottom, wherein the upper metal layer comprises a first metal wire and first subarrays which are alternately arranged at two sides of the first metal wire, the lower metal layer comprises a second metal wire and second subarrays which are alternately arranged at two sides of the second metal wire, the first subarrays and the second subarrays are symmetrical relative to the axes of the first metal wire and the second metal wire, and the subarrays of the first subarrays and the second subarrays comprise one or more radiation units with the same quantity. The antenna generates a stable end-shot directional diagram through space-1 harmonic radiation, can realize an end-shot leaky-wave antenna on a dielectric substrate with a lower dielectric constant, reduces processing difficulty, and simultaneously realizes a higher gain length ratio and a larger gain bandwidth.

title_en: Medium wave emission signal remote monitoring and regulating system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a medium wave emission signal remote monitoring and regulating system which comprises a hardware system and a software system, wherein the hardware system comprises a transmitter control module, a radio frequency signal detection module, a data acquisition module and a power supply control module, the transmitter control module is used for realizing the remote starting and stopping of a medium wave signal transmitter, and the radio frequency signal detection module is used for acquiring amplitude and phase information of the medium wave emission signal to realize the real-time monitoring and control of the medium wave emission signal. According to the invention, the real-time data of the medium wave emission signal can be clearly observed through the remote monitoring and regulation and control by the user interface, the user interface has good compatibility, the compiling and the adjustment can be carried out according to the requirements, the anti-interference module is added in the data transmission stage, the internal high-frequency interference source of the medium wave emitter can be effectively isolated, the signal interference is prevented, and the accuracy and the stability of the remote monitoring and regulation and control system are improved.

title_en: Evaluation system, method, device, equipment and medium for cloud control basic platform regulation instruction
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an evaluation system, a method, a device, equipment and a medium of a cloud control basic platform regulation instruction, wherein in the system, a road end subsystem comprises a road end time information acquisition module used for transmitting acquired road end time information to an instruction evaluation subsystem, a cloud end subsystem comprises a data acquisition module used for transmitting cloud end time information and external data to the instruction evaluation subsystem, a vehicle end subsystem comprises a vehicle end time information acquisition module used for transmitting acquired vehicle end time information to the instruction evaluation subsystem, the instruction evaluation subsystem is used for acquiring the road end time information, cloud end time information and vehicle end time information, aligning the road end time information, the cloud end time information and the vehicle end time information with the time information of the instruction evaluation subsystem, calculating the value of a regulation instruction evaluation index according to the time information of each subsystem after alignment, and the reliability of a regulation instruction evaluation result is improved by adopting the technical scheme.

title_en: Multi-site narrowband radio frequency transceiver chip test method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a testing method and a system of a multi-site narrowband radio frequency transceiver chip, wherein the method comprises the steps that a first signal processing module distributes radio frequency signals output by a vector signal generator to each path of narrowband radio frequency transceiver chip; the up-conversion mixer obtains and mixes the low intermediate frequency signals output by the narrow-band radio frequency transceiver chip with the local oscillation high frequency signals output by the local oscillation signal generator, and outputs high frequency signals, wherein each path of narrow-band radio frequency transceiver chip is provided with the corresponding up-conversion mixer and local oscillation signal generator, and the second signal processing module combines the high frequency signals output by each path and feeds the high frequency signals back to the upper computer through the vector spectrum analyzer. The invention can realize the simultaneous test of a plurality of narrowband radio frequency transceiver chips, reduce the number of test equipment and the corresponding cost and improve the test efficiency.

title_en: Phased array system suitable for to empty cover
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of communication and array antennas, and discloses a phased array system suitable for space coverage, which comprises a power division network and a plurality of TR (transmitter-receiver) components connected with one end of the power division network, wherein one end of each TR component, which is far away from the power division network, is sequentially connected with a pitching beam forming network BFN and a plurality of antenna arrays ANT, and the pitching beam forming network BFN is used for generating wide beams with gains which are sequentially reduced along the far field, midfield and near field directions in the pitching direction through the plurality of antenna arrays ANT in a fixed beam forming mode. The original multi-dimensional phased array can be simplified into one dimension, only horizontal scanning is required to be supported, and the number of components such as the TR component, the PS component and the like can be greatly reduced under the condition that the array scale is not changed, so that the design cost of a phased array system is effectively reduced. Meanwhile, a fixed beam forming mode is adopted to generate wide beams with gains sequentially reduced along the far field direction and the middle field to near field direction, the gains of far field areas are considered, the non-blind area coverage of the middle field area and the near field area is realized, and the complexity of network access searching and tracking in air communication is reduced.

title_en: Downhole direct current carrier communication system and communication method based on TTL serial port modulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground direct current carrier communication system and a communication method based on TTL serial port modulation, wherein the system comprises a ground part and an underground part, the ground part is connected with the underground part through a cable, the ground part comprises a TTL universal serial port I, a high-speed switching module, a direct current stabilized voltage power supply I and a direct current stabilized voltage power supply II, the underground part comprises a decoding circuit and a TTL universal serial port II, the high-speed switching module is used for switching the direct current stabilized voltage power supply I and the direct current stabilized voltage power supply II according to the level of a TTL serial port signal, a steady TTL carrier signal is modulated and transmitted to the decoding circuit through the cable, and the decoding circuit comprises a high-pass filter, an amplifier, a voltage follower and a hysteresis comparator. The system and the method disclosed by the invention improve the stability and the reliability of the communication system, simplify the system design, reduce the requirements of external modules and circuits and reduce the design complexity and the cost.

title_en: Multidimensional nano composite wave-absorbing material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of wave-absorbing materials, and in particular relates to a multidimensional nano composite wave-absorbing material, and a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of mixing nickel salt hydrate, cobalt salt hydrate and copper salt hydrate according to a design proportion and dissolving the mixture in water to form A solution; preparing alkaline solution B, adding MXene dispersion liquid into a container, dropwise adding solution A and solution B to maintain alkaline environment, adding carbon nanotube composite conductive agent and Fe  3 O 4  nano particles, reacting at normal temperature, heating, centrifuging and washing the product. The invention innovatively develops the MXene-NiCoCu-Fe-CNT type nano composite hydrotalcite wave-absorbing material with good wave-absorbing performance, which is prepared by a simple double-drop coprecipitation method and a hydrothermal method, and the raw material cost is greatly reduced on the premise of simplifying the preparation process.

title_en: Doppler frequency offset calculation method, initial access method, device, terminal and medium
abstract_en: The application provides a Doppler frequency offset calculation method, an initial access method, a device, a terminal and a medium. The Doppler frequency offset calculation method is applied to a terminal and comprises the steps of receiving downlink synchronous information, wherein the downlink synchronous information indicates first ephemeris information, the first ephemeris information comprises first time information, if second ephemeris information exists, calculating based on the second ephemeris information and the first ephemeris information to determine target Doppler frequency offset corresponding to target time, the second ephemeris information is information obtained before time corresponding to the first time information, and the target time indicates the time of sending an uplink signal to network equipment. The application can reduce the error of Doppler frequency offset calculation and improve the Doppler frequency offset compensation accuracy.

title_en: Method and terminal for determining timing advance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a terminal for determining a timing advance, which are used for providing a calculation mode of the timing advance, improving the self-adaptability to satellite-to-ground communication scenes of different parameters and avoiding the problems of excessive timing advance or inter-symbol interference due to improper setting of experience values. The method comprises the steps of determining the motion state of a satellite relative to a terminal, acquiring the last estimated Doppler frequency offset value when the satellite is in a close state relative to the terminal, and determining the timing advance of the current time slot according to the last estimated Doppler frequency offset value.

title_en: Pipeline companion optical cable relay test pile and pipeline companion optical cable system
abstract_en: The invention provides a pipeline accompanying optical cable relay test pile and a pipeline accompanying optical cable system. The pipeline tracing optical cable relay test pile comprises a pipeline tracing optical cable relay test pile body, an optical cable well and an optical cable junction box, wherein the optical cable well is positioned at the bottom of the pipeline tracing optical cable relay test pile body, the optical cable junction box is positioned in the optical cable well, and the top of the pipeline tracing optical cable relay test pile body is exposed outside the ground. Under emergency, through setting up the optical cable relay test stake that has quick test interface, direct connection OTDR or optical cable fault location tester are quick location fault position nearby, guarantee production data transmission steady operation, effectively solve OTDR can't directly find optical cable fault point, optical cable fault location tester test range surpass the problem of the effective test range of equipment accuracy own, when reducing the optical cable rush-repair by a wide margin, realize the high-efficient location of fault point, the quick recovery optical cable communication.

title_en: Method, apparatus, and computer-readable storage medium for synchronization
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method, apparatus, and computer-readable storage medium for synchronization. In some embodiments, a user equipment determines an offset variation between the user equipment and a network device based on a received first reference signal, the offset variation including a time offset variation and/or a frequency offset variation, determines a time domain position of a second reference signal based on a time domain delay of the second reference signal relative to the first reference signal, the time domain delay being lower than a transmission period of the first reference signal, and updates the offset variation based on the second reference signal detected at the time domain position. In this way, the user equipment can determine the offset variation based on the time domain delay amount and the first reference signal and the second reference signal in the transmission period range, so that the time for determining the offset variation in the transmission period is increased, the offset variation can be updated more quickly, and the communication efficiency is further ensured.

title_en: Design method of structural four-bit binary cross and co-polarized transmission and reflection energy distribution super-surface
abstract_en: The invention provides a design method of a structural four-bit binary cross and homopolarization transmission and reflection energy distribution super-surface, which comprises the following steps of establishing a structural super-surface unit, wherein the structural super-surface unit comprises a top layer and a bottom layer of H-shaped resonator, a middle metal layer and an upper layer and a lower layer of medium substrate, the middle metal layer comprises a cross-shaped opening, changing the rotation angle of an H-shaped metal patch and the corner and the size of the cross-shaped opening, distributing cross-polarization transmission, cross-polarization reflection, homopolarization transmission and homopolarization reflection energy, discretizing the energy distribution, converting the energy distribution into a four-bit binary form and realizing complete four-bit binary energy distribution. The invention realizes flexible regulation and design of energy distribution by carrying out four-bit binary coding on the transmission energy and the reflection energy which are crossed and polarized in the same way.

title_en: SDR-based laser and radio frequency dual-system data communication device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an SDR-based laser and radio frequency dual-system data communication device and method, and belongs to the technical field of software radio and laser communication. The device provided by the invention has the advantages that the light path device is fixed on the lower layer plate side by side through the fixing component, meanwhile, the upper layer plate is an SDR circuit board, the volume and the weight of the traditional laser communication optical head are effectively reduced, the redundancy of the device is reduced through optimizing the layout and the selection of the light path device and the radio frequency component, the light weight and the miniaturization are realized, the portability and the fixing stability of the device are improved, the quality of laser transmission is further ensured, the flexible switching of laser and wireless radio frequency data communication can be realized through the control of the upper computer and the main control circuit chip, the single limitation of the application scene of the traditional radio frequency laser dual-mode communication device is overcome, the device can adapt to various communication scenes and requirements, and the flexibility and the adaptability of the device are improved.

title_en: Novel interference frequency point detection method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a novel method, a device, a storage medium and electronic equipment for detecting interference frequency points, and relates to the technical field of interference frequency point detection, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining frequency hopping communication frame data of a communication system, splitting according to a set frequency set, and generating a data set in a layered sampling mode; the method comprises the steps of establishing an interference classification model based on a supervised learning algorithm, setting model parameters, training and verifying the interference classification model based on the data set to obtain a frequency point interference state identification model, detecting interference frequency points in a communication frame based on the frequency point interference state identification model, and outputting a set of interfered frequency points in the communication frame. The application greatly improves the precision and the robustness of the detection of the interference frequency points by utilizing the machine learning technology, and provides a new solution for the intellectualization of the detection of the interference frequency points.

title_en: Base station antenna angle adjusting device
abstract_en: The invention provides a base station antenna angle adjusting device which comprises a driving adjusting mechanism and a driven adjusting mechanism, wherein the driving adjusting mechanism comprises an azimuth angle adjusting component, an inclination angle adjusting component and an adjusting locking component, the inclination angle adjusting component comprises a first angle arm seat, a first adjusting arm and a first transmission component, the azimuth angle adjusting component comprises a first supporting plate and a second transmission component, the driven adjusting mechanism comprises a second angle arm seat, a first driven adjusting component and a second driven adjusting component, the adjusting locking component is used for driving the first transmission component to transmit, the first adjusting arm is driven to move along the radial direction of a holding pole, and meanwhile, the first driven adjusting component rotates along the axial direction perpendicular to the holding pole along with the movement of the first adjusting arm, so that the downward inclination angle of a base station antenna is adjusted. The second transmission assembly is driven by the adjusting locking assembly to drive the first supporting plate to rotate around the inclination angle adjusting assembly, and meanwhile, the second driven adjusting assembly synchronously rotates along with the first supporting plate, so that azimuth angle adjustment of the base station antenna is achieved.

title_en: Invoice scanning and inputting device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of invoice scanning, in particular to an invoice scanning and inputting device which comprises a scanner shell, wherein a feed inlet is formed in the top of the scanner shell, a discharge outlet is formed in one side end face of the scanner shell, a collecting frame is fixedly connected to one side of the discharge outlet, which is located on the end face of the scanner shell, a conveying plate and a baffle are fixedly connected to the inside of the scanner shell, which is close to the feed inlet, of a collecting frame, when a monitor invoice encounters a paper jam or a corner fold, a paper rubbing motor stops driving a paper rubbing wheel to rotate, the paper clamping opening is parallel to the top face of a stay plate through a reciprocating mechanism and an adjusting motor, so that the invoice can be accurately clamped, an adjusting rod is driven through an electric telescopic rod, so that the position of the traction rod is adjusted, the paper clamping plates are pushed to be close to each other through the traction rod, so that the invoice is clamped, manual operation is not needed in processing of the paper jam, the paper jam can be rearranged through a sorting mechanism after the paper jam is pulled out, and the time for manually processing the paper jam or the paper fold can be reduced.

title_en: Method and device for calculating network topology service path of access type OTN equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for calculating network topology service paths of access type OTN equipment, belonging to the technical field of service path calculation; the method comprises the steps of screening all paths according to whether resources meet the requirement of availability to obtain available paths, determining a main path from the available paths, judging whether a standby path is needed according to the parameter entering condition, and determining the standby path from the available paths if the judgment result is that the standby path is needed. The invention calculates all paths at one time, screens to obtain available paths, automatically selects main paths and standby paths according to priority or necessary conditions in the available paths, and jointly determines the automatically selected main paths and standby paths according to the conditions that the priority of the overall user self-selected data is highest, the main paths and the standby paths give consideration to the existing protection group relationship, the loop link state of the networking condition of the main paths and the standby paths, the priority of the main and standby port different boards in the chain networking, the shared link risk group and the like.

title_en: Information transmission method of self-adaptive access mechanism based on traffic flow density
abstract_en: The invention relates to an information transmission method of a self-adaptive access mechanism based on traffic flow density, which comprises the steps that in a cellular network coverage area, a base station broadcasts network configuration parameters to all vehicle users in the area, a selection window is defined in a time slot t  G , candidate channel resources are identified in the selection window, a sensing window is defined, the candidate channel resources in the selection window are screened by utilizing the sensing window, the part of channel resources with the lowest average reference signal strength indication in the sensing window are selected as residual candidate channel resources L2, whether the residual candidate channel resources L2 are available or not is checked, and a channel busy rate CBR is calculated. According to the invention, the MODE2 access mechanism is adaptively adjusted according to different traffic flow densities. The method can select a high-efficiency access mode to improve the transmission rate, and can switch to a more robust access mode to enhance the reliability and the anti-interference capability of transmission when the traffic flow is high.

title_en: Rotary shaft decoration of folding screen mobile phone and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of manufacturing of miniature parts of electronic equipment, in particular to a rotating shaft decoration of a folding screen mobile phone and a preparation method thereof. The rotating shaft decorating part comprises a metal connecting part, an injection molding part and a metal plate, wherein the metal connecting part comprises a first end extending vertically and a second end extending transversely from the bottom of the first end, the second end comprises a first side face and a second side face which are arranged vertically opposite, the injection molding part comprises a wrapping part wrapping the first end, an extension part attached to the first side face and a reinforcing connecting part extending vertically, the extension part is connected with the wrapping part, the reinforcing connecting part is connected with the extension part, and the metal plate is adhered to the second side face and the reinforcing connecting part and welded with the second end. According to the application, on one hand, the connection strength of the injection molding piece and the metal connecting piece is enhanced, the probability of the injection molding piece separating from the metal connecting piece is reduced, and on the other hand, the connection strength of the injection molding piece and the metal connecting piece is also enhanced, and the probability of the injection molding piece separating from is reduced.

title_en: Multi-mode vortex electromagnetic wave generator
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-mode vortex electromagnetic wave generator, which comprises a super-surface condition displacement operator with adjustable quantity and a super-surface coin throwing operator with adjustable quantity. The super-surface condition displacement calculator comprises a first medium substrate, a first metal layer and a second medium substrate, wherein a plurality of first metal sheets are arranged on the first medium substrate and are arranged in a first gradual change rotation angle mode, the first metal sheets are cross-shaped, a plurality of first holes are formed in the first metal layer, a plurality of second metal sheets are arranged in the first holes, the super-surface coin throwing calculator comprises a third medium substrate, a second metal layer and a fourth medium substrate, a plurality of third metal sheets are arranged on the third medium substrate and are arranged in a second gradual change rotation angle mode, the third metal sheets are cuboid, a plurality of second holes are formed in the second metal layer, and a plurality of fourth metal sheets are arranged in the second holes.

title_en: Automatic frequency shift method for interference detection of 5G repeater
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electronic information, and provides an automatic frequency shift method for interference detection of a 5G repeater, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining slave input power and master-slave loss, calculating a slave interference threshold value, obtaining slave power level information, judging slave interference frequency point information, obtaining target base station parameter information, calculating path loss, calculating host output power, calculating a host interference threshold value, obtaining host power level information, extracting host interference-free frequency point information, constructing a frequency point combination set, removing interference frequency points, calculating a weight data set and configuring frequency point combination. The invention can avoid the interference to the base station caused by the non-operation installation of the repeater system by automatically scanning the interference and automatically configuring the interference to the working frequency band with lower interference in the wireless cascade environment of the master-slave machine, and can detect the interference power level in a larger range by adjusting the receiving gain of the receiver so as to ensure better coverage and coverage stability.

title_en: EMC test method and system for intelligent network-connected automobile communication system
abstract_en: The invention provides an EMC test method and system for an intelligent network-connected automobile communication system, which comprise the steps of performing field test on the communication system of a vehicle, recording first position change information between a mobile vehicle and a stationary base station, performing path mapping according to the first position change information to obtain second position change information between the stationary vehicle and the mobile base station, keeping the test vehicle stationary in a test site according to the second position change information, moving the test base station, and testing the communication system of the test vehicle. The invention solves the problem that the prior art has a general network connection testing scheme and the original monitoring equipment of the half anechoic chamber can not meet the electromagnetic radiation immunity testing requirement of the intelligent network connection automobile network connection system.

title_en: Data encryption transmission method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a data encryption transmission method and device, which are characterized in that image data to be encrypted are divided into a plurality of image blocks, importance scores of the image blocks are determined, the image blocks to be encrypted are determined based on the importance scores of the image blocks, then, for any image block to be encrypted, pixel values of all pixel points in the image block to be encrypted are obtained, the pixel values of all pixel points are converted into binary sequences, the image block to be encrypted is converted into a plurality of bit plane data based on the binary sequences corresponding to the pixel values of all the pixel points, so that the bit plane to be encrypted of the image block to be encrypted is determined based on the information proportion of each bit plane data of any image block to be encrypted, encryption is further carried out on the bit plane to be encrypted of each image block to be encrypted, and the encrypted image data corresponding to be encrypted are constructed based on the encrypted image blocks corresponding to each image block to be encrypted and other image blocks to be encrypted, and encryption efficiency can be improved while data safety is ensured.

title_en: Ground month communication method and system based on ring month constellation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of aerospace detection, and particularly relates to a ground month communication method and system based on a surrounding month constellation. The method comprises the following steps of distributing a plurality of satellites on a low month orbit and a medium month orbit to form a ring month constellation uniformly covered in a north-south polar region and an equatorial region, obtaining position coordinate information of each satellite, establishing an adjacent relation in the constellation, distributing adjacent satellites to each satellite, constructing a multi-hop data relay link among the satellites, performing link redundancy design to enable each satellite of the ring month constellation to be connected with the adjacent satellites, realizing data transmission of an initial satellite and a target satellite through multi-hop data relay transmission, transmitting the data to the earth through earth-month communication by the target satellite, monitoring the state of each satellite in real time, performing state diagnosis, repairing if faults occur, and switching to standby equipment if the repairing fails. The invention has strong coverage, can realize full-area coverage and has high communication reliability.

title_en: Folding transmission array antenna
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of antennas, and discloses a folding transmission array antenna which comprises a linear polarization-to-circular polarization super surface, a transmission super surface and a feed source antenna array, wherein the linear polarization-to-circular polarization super surface is positioned right above the transmission super surface, the feed source antenna array is integrated on the upper surface of the transmission super surface, the linear polarization-to-circular polarization super surface comprises a plurality of mutually connected linear polarization-to-circular polarization units, each linear polarization-to-circular polarization unit converts an input linear polarization wave into a circular polarization wave, the transmission super surface comprises a plurality of mutually connected transmission units, each transmission unit regulates and controls the propagation direction of electromagnetic waves, the feed source antenna array comprises a plurality of mutually connected microstrip array antennas, and each microstrip array antenna provides excitation signals for the folding transmission array antenna. The invention effectively improves the efficiency of converting linear polarized wave into circular polarized wave by adjusting the geometric characteristics of each metal structure in the linear polarization-to-circular polarization super surface and the transmission super surface, and realizes high gain under the condition of low plane surface.

title_en: Data communication method and system based on dual-mode power communication system
abstract_en: The invention provides a data communication method and system based on a dual-mode power communication system, belongs to the technical field of power communication, and solves the problems of low success rate of data acquisition, low reliability and unstable communication in the existing power line communication. The invention can realize the functions of data acquisition, active reporting in power failure, accurate clock synchronization, automatic identification of a station area, phase topology identification, automatic file synchronization, communication performance monitoring, network optimization and the like based on an HPLC technology and a wireless communication dual-mode communication mode, thereby ensuring the reliability and the stability of dual-mode power data communication.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for calibrating real-time clock
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for calibrating a real-time clock, which relate to the technical field of charging time calibration of electric automobiles and comprise the steps of acquiring clock calibration parameters based on a preset time interval; and under the condition that the dormancy instruction is received and the vehicle is determined not to be in the dormancy state, calibrating the wake-up time stamp by using the compensation error to obtain the target wake-up time stamp. The method and the device are used for solving the problem that the vehicle cannot be used normally because the vehicle is parked for a long time or the electric quantity of the storage battery is exhausted in the dormant state in the prior art, determining the target wake-up time stamp when receiving the dormant instruction, so as to wake up the dormant whole vehicle controller when the target wake-up time stamp, enabling the vehicle controller to control the high-voltage system to charge the storage battery, and solving the problem that the vehicle cannot be used normally because the voltage of the storage battery is lower than the critical voltage.

title_en: Session generation method, device, equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a session generation method, a session generation device, session generation equipment and a computer readable storage medium, which are applied to the technical field of computers and comprise the steps of marking a session to be marked by utilizing a large model to obtain a marking result, counting the marking result, determining a session policy according to the counting result, and generating an outbound session according to the session policy. The method and the device realize automatic marking of the content in the conversation corresponding to the content through a large model technology to obtain marking results, give out conversation strategies through statistics of all marking results, and generate outbound conversation according to the conversation strategies. According to the method, automatic labeling is achieved through the large model, labor cost of manual labeling and analysis of statistical strategies is released, conversation in different scenes can be labeled by the method, the optimal conversation strategy is automatically generated according to the labeled statistical results, and the conversation robot can be quickly built and optimized, so that intelligent outbound is achieved.

title_en: Multi-operator shared base station iron tower and operator antenna adding method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-operator shared base station iron tower and an operator antenna adding method, wherein the base station iron tower comprises an iron tower main body and a machine room, a plurality of antenna holding rods are arranged on the iron tower main body in a surrounding manner, an upper end mounting platform and a lower end mounting platform are respectively arranged at the upper end and the lower end of the antenna holding rods, a plurality of movable mounting platforms are arranged between the upper end mounting platform and the lower end mounting platform, and the movable mounting platforms are arranged on the antenna holding rods in a sliding manner. The antenna assembly device has the advantages that the plurality of movable mounting platforms are arranged, the antenna holding rods are shared, new operator antennas can be added in the later period, and after operators are added, the movable mounting platforms are fixed at the positions corresponding to the heights of the antennas, so that the antennas can be maintained and replaced by the operators conveniently.

title_en: Full-automatic abnormal EUT equipment (electric energy meter) detection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-automatic abnormal EUT equipment (electric energy meter) detection system, which relates to the field of medical care equipment and comprises a detection device, a communication system, an automatic switching system, a main station system and an anti-misoperation protection system, wherein the detection device is used for simulating various on-site power-on environments, the communication system is used for realizing communication with the EUT equipment (electric energy meter) and the main station, the automatic switching system is used for controlling a multi-path relay through a system command to realize random sequencing output of current A/B/C phase lines and voltage A/B/C/N phase lines, and meanwhile, an anti-short circuit mechanism is arranged on software and hardware, the identification system is used for judging whether the EUT equipment (electric energy meter) is abnormal or not according to the content of a message returned by the EUT equipment (electric energy meter). According to the invention, through a highly-automatic detection flow, the test period of the three-phase electric energy meter is greatly shortened, and compared with the traditional manual test, the system can solidify a test scheme and a flow, and effectively reduce negligence and omission of human factors, thereby remarkably improving the accuracy and reliability of detection.

title_en: Antenna downward inclination angle adjusting device and base station antenna
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of antennas, and in particular relates to an antenna downtilt angle adjusting device and a base station antenna. The switching structure comprises a switching support, a driving component and at least one position selecting gear, wherein a plurality of switching grooves are formed in the switching support and are arranged along a first direction, the driving component comprises a driving piece, the driving piece can extend into and out of the switching grooves and drive the switching support to move for a preset distance when extending into the switching grooves, intermittent movement of the switching support is achieved, the position selecting gear is rotatably arranged on the switching support, the input structure drives the position selecting gear to rotate when the switching support is in an intermittent period of intermittent movement, the output structure comprises at least one group of racks which are in one-to-one correspondence with the position selecting gears, the racks extend along a second direction, and the second direction is perpendicular to the first direction. The switching support intermittently moves, the phase shifter is driven by the gear and the rack for selecting the position, the requirement on control precision is low, and the transmission efficiency is high.

title_en: Blind extraction method, device and equipment for privacy information of thumbnail-maintained encrypted image
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device and equipment for blind extraction of privacy information of a thumbnail-maintained encrypted image, which can provide an emergency solution for a user passing identity verification and legal authorization under the abnormal condition that a secret key and the like cannot be obtained, and improve the safety redundancy. The method comprises the steps of inputting ciphertext image samples generated by a thumbnail preservation encryption method and corresponding plaintext image samples serving as training samples into a privacy information extraction network constructed based on a generation countermeasure network, alternately training a discriminator and a generator in the training network, generating predicted privacy information by the generator according to the ciphertext image samples in the training process, updating parameters of the discriminator by utilizing the ciphertext image samples and the predicted privacy information, and updating the parameters of the generator by utilizing the parameters of the discriminator. The user inputs the ciphertext image to be processed into a generator in the trained privacy information extraction network, and decrypts the ciphertext image and extracts the privacy information in a key-free mode.

title_en: Index modulation linear frequency modulation signal generating device and method
abstract_en: An index modulation linear frequency modulation signal generating device is provided, and is characterized by comprising a dual-wavelength laser source (1), a wavelength division demultiplexer (2), a double parallel Mach-Zehnder modulator (3), a 90-degree electric coupler (4), an intermediate frequency signal source (5), an optical coupler (6) and a photoelectric detector (7). An index modulated chirp signal generation method is also provided. The invention combines multi-order slope modulation and cyclic shift modulation, and outputs index modulation LFM signals of high-frequency ultra-wideband through photon up-conversion technology. The generated signal has better robustness under the condition of strong Doppler frequency shift, and the communication rate can be further expanded.

title_en: Transmitter and receiver for medical applications
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a transmitter and a receiver for medical applications, wherein the transmitter comprises an analog front end for receiving analog signals of nerve electrodes, a digital baseband processing module for digitizing and channel coding the analog signals to obtain coded signals, a modulator for performing 16-QAM modulation on the coded signals to obtain modulated signals, adopting 16-QAM modulation to improve the expandable data rate, generating a plurality of target frequency signals through a phase-locked frequency divider and dividing the target frequency signals into a plurality of target sub-frequency signals, adjusting the phases of the modulated signals based on the plurality of target sub-frequency signals to obtain phase adjustment signals, realizing multi-band data transmission in the transmitter, and finally amplifying the phase adjustment signals by a power amplifier, transmitting the amplified phase adjustment signals to a transmitting unit, so that the transmitting unit transmits signals, and realizing high-rate low-power consumption signal transmission.

title_en: Terminal equipment control method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a terminal equipment control method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining position information of the terminal equipment, judging whether the terminal equipment is located in a conference room according to the position information, collecting audio signals of the conference room if the terminal equipment is located in the conference room, judging whether the conference room meets conference proceeding conditions according to the audio signals, setting an audio mode of the terminal equipment to be a mute mode if the conference room is determined to meet the conference proceeding conditions, and automatically setting the audio mode to be mute when the terminal equipment is determined to be located in the conference room and meeting conditions are determined to be met.

title_en: Scheduling method and device for power communication system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a scheduling method and device of an electric power communication system, wherein the scheduling method and device comprises the steps of obtaining system parameters from text information, image information and voice information, carrying out multi-mode fusion processing on the system parameters to obtain multi-mode fusion characteristics, constructing a reward function based on a preset objective function and determining an optimal power allocation strategy based on a reinforcement learning method according to the multi-mode fusion characteristics, taking the resource state of a base station as a state, taking the power allocated by the base station as equipment and the service quality weight of the equipment as actions, and constructing the objective function based on the service quality requirement of the equipment and the allocable resources of the base station. The application can effectively integrate the system parameters of multiple modes, improve the accuracy and efficiency of resource scheduling decisions, integrate the system resource and service quality requirements, optimize the resource scheduling of the power communication system and improve the system performance and service quality.

title_en: File access management method, system and file cabinet
abstract_en: The invention provides a file access management method, a file access management system and a file cabinet, and belongs to the technical field of file management. The method comprises the steps of S1, obtaining identity information of a worker, identifying the identity of the worker based on the identity information, S2, controlling an electronic chip to push out when the worker is identified as a legal user, enabling the worker to use a portable device to scan the electronic chip to establish connection, S3, controlling a cabinet door of a file cabinet to be opened after connection is completed, sending file information in the file cabinet to the portable device, enabling the worker to know the file information in the file cabinet and select a file to be taken, and S4, receiving file selection information returned by the portable device, controlling a drawer corresponding to the file selection information to be opened, and enabling the worker to conveniently take out the corresponding file. By verifying the identity of the staff, the electronic chip is controlled to be pushed out after the verification is passed, so that illegal users can be prevented from being connected with the electronic chip at will to acquire file information in the file cabinet, the safety and confidentiality of the file cabinet are improved, and effective management of files is facilitated.

title_en: CSI human body falling identification method in bathroom shower interference environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a CSI human body falling identification method in a bathroom shower interference environment, and belongs to the technical field of wireless communication. The method comprises the steps of S1, acquiring falling data in a bathroom area in a shower interference environment, calculating a space channel constant R through a CSI amplitude value and a CSI phase, calculating a shower signal energy ratio SSER through a power spectrum density PSD, and calculating a shower interference index by combining the space channel parameter R and the shower signal energy ratio SSER to perform interference judgment, S2, dividing the acquired same action CSI data on the basis of the step S1, dividing non-shower interference data into a source domain data set, dividing shower interference data into a target domain data set, constructing and training a neighborhood self-adaptive network model, and obtaining a falling activity recognition result. The invention can effectively improve the identification accuracy of the human body falling movement under the shower interference environment.

title_en: Beam forming parameter migration method, device, storage medium and system based on constellation self-management control
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to the field of satellite communications technology, and more particularly, to a method, apparatus, storage medium and system for migrating beamforming parameters based on constellation self-management control. The method comprises the steps that a first satellite obtains target parameters to be migrated, the target parameters comprise beam forming parameters and position information of a ground terminal, the first satellite migrates the target parameters to a second satellite through an inter-satellite link, the target parameters indicate the second satellite to adjust the characteristics of antenna beams according to the beam forming parameters so as to access the ground terminal, the first satellite and the second satellite run along the same direction on the same orbit, and the first satellite is located in front of the second satellite. According to the embodiment of the disclosure, the inter-satellite link is utilized to realize parameter migration between satellites on the same orbit, so that the pressure of satellite-to-ground data transmission is reduced, the instantaneity of the parameters is improved, the migration of the parameters in a constellation network can be realized at a low cost, and the number of ground stations is not limited.

title_en: Method for recording snore and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a snore recording method and electronic equipment. The method can be applied to electronic equipment, and comprises the steps that when the second electronic equipment detects that a user falls asleep, first information is sent to the first electronic equipment, a first indication is used for indicating the user to enter a sleep state, and the first electronic equipment records audio and stops recording the audio when preset conditions are met. According to the technical scheme, when the electronic equipment records the snore of the user, the wearable equipment detects the sleep state of the user, and when the user is in the sleep state, information is sent to the electronic equipment, so that the electronic equipment starts to record the snore of the user, and the power consumption of the electronic equipment can be reduced.

title_en: Space electromagnetic environment big data processing system based on AI
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electromagnetic spectrum management and discloses an aerospace environment big data processing system based on AI, which comprises an electromagnetic information collecting module, a first order information constructing module, a link quality judging module and a spectrum distribution module, wherein the electromagnetic information collecting module is used for collecting electromagnetic information, the first order information constructing module is used for constructing first order information of two structural dimensions based on the electromagnetic information, the link quality judging module is used for inputting the first order information into a quality model and outputting results of each link quality by the quality model, the spectrum distribution module is used for inputting the first order information into a distribution model and outputting results of spectrum distribution of each communication node by the distribution model.

title_en: Antenna module and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses an antenna module and electronic equipment, wherein the antenna module comprises a first radiator, a filter circuit and a feed circuit, wherein the first radiator is provided with a first end and a second end along the extending direction of the first radiator, the filter circuit is connected with the first position of the first radiator, the first position is positioned between the first end and the second end, the filter circuit comprises M parallel filter branches, M is more than or equal to 2, and the feed circuit is connected with the second position of the first radiator and is used for receiving and transmitting a target radiation signal at least through the first radiator. The different filtering branches and the first part of the first radiator form current paths with different electrical lengths, and the current paths are used for realizing the receiving and transmitting of radiation signals with different frequency bands.

title_en: Wide-angle scanning dielectric resonator array antenna based on parasitic ring structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a wide-angle scanning dielectric resonator array antenna based on a parasitic ring structure, which comprises N rectangular dielectric resonators, 2N fence-shaped parasitic ring structures, N feed slots, N feed microstrip lines, a floor, N input ports, a first dielectric plate, a second dielectric plate and a third dielectric plate. The rectangular dielectric resonator of the main radiator is of an axisymmetric structure, the parasitic ring structure and a feed network of the underfloor are also axisymmetric, the structure can ensure the symmetry of an antenna radiation pattern and the stability of the phase center of the antenna radiation pattern, the fence-shaped parasitic ring structure contributes to the radiation energy in the low elevation angle direction, the fence-shaped parasitic ring structure is complementary with the rectangular dielectric resonator antenna with zenith radiation characteristics, the unit beam width is expanded, the array antenna obtains wide-angle scanning characteristics, and the antenna has the advantages of compact and simple structure, wide-angle scanning, low cross polarization, high radiation efficiency, stable gain, stable pattern and the like.

title_en: Method and device for testing performance of receiver of frequency hopping communication equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of communication and particularly discloses a method and a device for testing the performance of a receiver of frequency hopping communication equipment, which comprise the steps of S1, determining proper measuring frequency according to the working frequency range of the tested equipment, measuring and calibrating the transmitting power of signals of a partner testing equipment by utilizing a sensitivity measuring device of the frequency hopping equipment according to the measuring frequency, S2, connecting a partner testing equipment end to a signal source and a tested equipment end to a spectrum analyzer, adjusting the attenuation value of an adjustable attenuator to be 0dB and measuring and recording the loss of a test link.

title_en: Communication method, device and system
abstract_en: The application provides a communication method, a device and a system, which relate to the field of communication, and the method comprises the steps of receiving first indication information from second network equipment, wherein the first indication information comprises first reference information, the first reference information is used for determining a first direction, the first direction is the direction of a reference beam in a first beam cluster, the beams in the first beam cluster meet a first beam relation, and the first beam relation is used for indicating the position relation among the beams in the first beam cluster; and pointing the reference beams in the first beam cluster to a first direction according to the first reference information. Based on the scheme, the first network device adjusts the directives of all beams in one beam cluster based on the beam relation corresponding to the beam cluster by indicating the directives of the reference beams in the beam cluster, so as to provide a condition for covering a specific area of a service area in the form of a narrow beam based on the beam cluster formed by a small number of beams.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle frequency spectrum detection performance test method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle testing, and particularly discloses a method and a system for testing the spectrum detection performance of an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the method comprises the steps of inserting a preset number of radio transmitters containing a wave band range into a test area, and determining theoretical signals of all points in the test area based on the radio transmitters; the method comprises the steps of determining at least one test path of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the theoretical signal, collecting information along the determined test path to obtain actual signals of all points, comparing the actual signals with the theoretical signal, and determining the test accuracy. According to the invention, the plurality of signal transmitters are arranged in the test scene, the combination of the signal transmitters can obtain a plurality of signals, the signals are distributed at different positions, and the test path of the unmanned aerial vehicle is determined according to the signal distribution, so that the type of the test signal of one-time test behavior is improved, the efficiency is higher, the moving unmanned aerial vehicle is tested, the actual situation is more compatible, and the test accuracy is higher.

title_en: Method and device for relaying communication
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for relay communication, wherein the method comprises the steps that a first relay node receives first information, the first information comprises forwarding information of the first relay node and forwarding information of at least one second relay node, and the second relay node is a subsequent forwarding relay node of the first relay node in a data forwarding path; the first relay node decodes the forwarding information of the at least one second relay node to obtain a first decoding result, and sends the first decoding result to the base station. And the base station retransmits the first information according to the decoding result. The relay node decodes the forwarding information of the subsequent relay node, and the base station pre-judges whether retransmission is performed in advance according to the decoding result, so that retransmission time delay is reduced.

title_en: Image display method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses an image display method and an image display device, and belongs to the technical field of electronic equipment. The method includes receiving a first input to a first location on a first image, the first image being a cover image of a first dynamic image, the first dynamic image including the first image and a first video, and displaying a second video in response to the first input, the second video being a video that is triggered to be captured based on the first location.

title_en: RAN slice resource allocation method based on user association under unmanned aerial vehicle assistance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a RAN slice resource allocation method based on user association under the assistance of an unmanned aerial vehicle, which belongs to the field of mobile communication and comprises the following steps of constructing a heterogeneous network model consisting of a macro base station, a pico base station, a femto base station and three service types of users in a heterogeneous network area assisted by the unmanned aerial vehicle, obtaining an optimal association scheme of the unmanned aerial vehicle and a ground base station by adopting bilateral matching game, modeling and decoupling the problems of user association and slice resource allocation into two sub-problems, solving the problem of user association by adopting a Lagrange multiplier method, and solving the problem of slice resource allocation by adopting a multi-agent depth deterministic gradient strategy algorithm. The invention combines the game theory, the Lagrange multiplier method and the multi-agent depth deterministic gradient strategy algorithm, solves the problems of user association and slice resource allocation in the heterogeneous network scene assisted by the unmanned aerial vehicle, and maximizes the utility of the whole system while meeting different requirements of different types of users.

title_en: Remote sensing satellite instruction automatic inverse editing and modifying framework based on remote control instruction parameters
abstract_en: The invention relates to a remote sensing satellite instruction automatic inverse coding and modifying framework based on remote control instruction parameters, and relates to the technical field of satellite remote control instructions. The architecture comprises an automatic inverse coding method, a method for automatically acquiring inverse coding values according to instruction parameters and an automatic instruction modification method. The remote sensing satellite instruction automatic inverse coding and modifying framework based on remote control instruction parameters aims at inverse coding and modifying of satellite remote control instruction codes, and is an instruction inverse coding and modifying system with high universality, good reliability and high automation degree. The remote sensing satellite instruction automatic inverse coding and modifying framework based on the remote control instruction parameters supports various instruction parameter types, has a highly-automatic remote control instruction inverse coding and modifying process, reduces manual development intervention in the whole process, and is high-efficiency.

title_en: Broadband antenna for wireless broadcast channels
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to broadband antennas for wireless broadcast channels. An apparatus may include a plurality of carriers, wherein each carrier includes a plurality of communication processors, each communication processor disposed above or in a respective carrier of the plurality of carriers and configured to provide a wireless broadcast communication channel, and a plurality of antennas, each antenna disposed on or in a respective carrier and coupled to a respective communication processor, wherein each antenna extends into a corner of a respective carrier, and wherein carriers in each pair of adjacent carriers are positioned less than about 1 wavelength from each other, the wavelengths corresponding to a lowest operating frequency.

title_en: High-frequency transceiver chip based on-chip antenna-pulse source same-chip integration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-frequency transceiver chip based on-chip antenna-pulse source co-chip integration, which relates to the technical field of antennas, wherein an on-chip integrated antenna structure is divided into a radiation structure, a transmission structure, an excitation structure and a sampling structure, the radiation structure provides efficient signal transmission and reception, the transmission structure ensures signal transmission quality and impedance matching, the excitation structure generates necessary excitation signals, and a collection unit collects and processes signals in transmission. The high-frequency transceiver chip based on-chip antenna-pulse source same-chip integration utilizes an on-chip integrated antenna structure constructed by a photoconductive material and a coplanar waveguide structure to realize the transmission and the reception of radio signals, overcomes the limitations of the traditional metal antenna structure, has the characteristics of small volume, low power consumption, high integration level, strong environmental adaptability and the like, and simultaneously has the advantages of lower transmission loss, high integration level and strong reliability.

title_en: Miniaturized 5G broadband automobile glass antenna
