abstract_en: The invention relates to a miniaturized 5G broadband automobile glass antenna which comprises a first component, a second component, a third component and a fourth component, wherein a groove I is formed in the first component, the groove I is arranged in the groove I, so that the first component forms a defective ground structure, the second component is used as a feed structure for supplying power to the antenna, the third component is connected with the second component, the second component is used for supplying power to the third component, the third component is of a monopole structure, one end of the fourth component is connected with the first component, and a bending part is arranged on the fourth component and used for reducing the area of a radiation structure and adjusting low-frequency impedance matching. The miniaturized 5G broadband automobile glass antenna adopts a single-sided design based on glass media, reduces the possibility of damaging a three-dimensional structure, maintains the mechanical property of glass, covers 4GLTE frequency bands and common 5G frequency bands, has a good +z radiation pattern in each frequency band, can remarkably reduce the requirement on a large metal floor by utilizing a defective ground structure, and simultaneously obtains a good low-frequency broadband.

title_en: Modulation circuit and wireless transceiver
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a modulation circuit and wireless receiving and transmitting equipment, which are used for reducing cost. The modulation circuit comprises a self-bias amplifying module and a source adjusting module, wherein a first power amplifying tube is arranged in the self-bias amplifying module and is used for amplifying specific signals, the source adjusting module is connected with a source electrode of the first power amplifying tube in the self-bias amplifying module, and the source adjusting module is used for adjusting the source electrode potential of the first power amplifying tube when the self-bias amplifying module is in a power-down mode so that the gate source voltage of the first power amplifying tube is lower than a threshold voltage and further the drain current of the first power amplifying tube is zero.

title_en: Control method suitable for one-to-many inter-satellite resource dynamic allocation
abstract_en: The invention provides a control method suitable for one-to-many inter-satellite resource dynamic allocation, which mainly solves the problems of low resource allocation speed and unreasonable dynamic resource allocation in the prior art; the invention controls the resource allocation by a system control table, and controls the resource allocation module to dynamically allocate the user resource rapidly, wherein the system control table comprises a user visibility table, a link state table and a priority table, and the resource allocation control comprises visibility inquiry control, state table inquiry control and user output control. The visibility inquiry control inquires whether the user is visible or not according to the user star ID number in the state table, the state inquiry control inquires whether the link state allocates resources or not according to the user visibility table, the user output control outputs the user star information in different states to the resource allocation module according to the state of the user star and the priority table, and the resource allocation module dynamically allocates the resources according to the state of each user.

title_en: Picture switching method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a picture switching method and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of terminals. The method can effectively solve the problems of slow picture loading and picture non-tracking in the picture switching process. The method comprises the steps of responding to triggering operation for the desktop card, determining a first preloading component in the components of the desktop card, then transmitting a first picture loaded in the first preloading component to a display component, and displaying the first picture through the display component. The triggering operation is used for triggering the electronic equipment to switch the pictures displayed on the desktop card, and the components of the desktop card comprise a display component and a plurality of preloading components. The display component is used for displaying the pictures displayed on the desktop card, the preloading component is used for loading the pictures to be displayed, and the preloading components comprise first preloading components.

title_en: Intelligent ammeter remote monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent ammeter remote monitoring device, which belongs to the technical field of intelligent ammeter, and comprises an ammeter end monitoring system and a remote monitoring end system. The ammeter end adopts an electric energy acquisition unit, a current sampling unit, a voltage sampling unit and a temperature sensing unit to acquire data, and the characteristic extraction is carried out through a lightweight characteristic extraction module, so that the self-adaptive sampling is realized based on abnormal characteristics. The remote monitoring end adopts a hybrid neural network to carry out depth analysis, which comprises four layers of feature coding, equation embedding, time sequence analysis and feature decoding, and realizes the flow processing of multi-ammeter data through a parallel processing module to finally generate an operation state evaluation result and early warning information. The technical problems that in the prior art, real-time efficient monitoring is difficult to be carried out on the running states of a plurality of intelligent electric energy meters, and potential abnormality is found are solved.

title_en: Throwing type sediment in-situ testing device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a throwing type sediment in-situ testing device and a method, which belong to the technical field of geotechnical testing equipment, wherein the throwing type sediment in-situ testing device comprises a probe, a probe rod, a control cabin and a hanging ring which are sequentially arranged from bottom to top; the speed reducing mechanism comprises a speed reducing umbrella and a driving assembly, the speed reducing umbrella comprises a framework and umbrella blades, the framework is rotationally connected with the control cabin, one end of each umbrella blade is connected with the control cabin, the other end of each umbrella blade is connected with the framework, and the driving assembly can drive the framework to stretch out to the periphery of the control cabin so as to drive the umbrella blades to be unfolded. The in-situ test method of the drop-off sediment adopts the in-situ test device of the drop-off sediment. The umbrella blades play a role in decelerating, so that the probe is prevented from being impacted greatly when penetrating into soil.

title_en: Ultra-wideband bidirectional absorption type common-mode filter based on traveling wave mechanism and hybrid transmission line conversion structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-wideband bidirectional absorption common mode filter based on a traveling wave mechanism and a hybrid transmission line conversion structure, which comprises a hybrid transmission line conversion structure, a first filter and a second filter, wherein the hybrid transmission line conversion structure is used for supporting the transmission of differential mode signals; and the traveling wave absorption unit is used for absorbing destructive common mode signals in the hybrid transmission line conversion structure. The hybrid transmission line conversion structure consists of a grounded coplanar waveguide, a microstrip line, a dielectric integrated coplanar waveguide and broadside isolation differential lines positioned on the top layer and the bottom layer. The traveling wave absorption unit is composed of a medium integrated slot line, a bonding pad and a lumped resistor. The novel broadside isolation differential line provided by the invention can effectively inhibit destructive differential mode parasitic resonance in the traditional design, so that the bandwidth of the complete transmission of useful differential mode signals is improved, and meanwhile, destructive common mode electromagnetic noise can be coupled and transmitted to a lumped resistor in a traveling wave mode for dissipation, so that the bidirectional common mode absorption bandwidth is larger.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for establishing feed link of satellite-borne base station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for establishing a feed link of a satellite-borne base station, which are characterized in that a security module is used for replacing a lightweight core network in a load part of the existing satellite-borne base station, information interaction is carried out between a distribution unit and a central unit of the satellite-borne base station and a feed terminal, when the feed terminal needs to establish the feed link with the satellite-borne base station, the security module can carry out security authentication on terminal identification information acquired by the distribution unit, and after the security authentication passes, the feed link between the satellite-borne base station and the feed terminal is established, and because the bearing data processing for establishing the feed link is only in the satellite-borne base station and does not involve the traditional core network, the feed terminal does not need to carry out information interaction with a plurality of network elements in the core network when the feed link is established, the data flow link is shorter, and the access time delay of a feed user is reduced.

title_en: Waveguide assembly for radar sensor
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a waveguide assembly, in particular for a radar sensor. The waveguide assembly has a transmitter or transceiver for microwaves, a circuit carrier and a hollow core waveguide. The circuit carrier has a cavity, in particular a recess, wherein the emitter is arranged for feeding microwaves into the cavity. The circuit carrier has an opening connected to the cavity, wherein the hollow waveguide is coupled to the opening and is thus able to receive microwaves. The hollow core waveguide of the waveguide assembly has a pin which is designed for introduction into an opening, in particular a recess, of the cavity by means of at least one longitudinal section of the pin. The circuit carrier has a metal layer covering the cavity walls in the region of the opening of the cavity. The metal layer has a contact surface, in particular an end face, wherein the pin has an end face and is configured to be opposite the contact surface with the end face after being introduced into the opening.

title_en: Method for adjusting time slot access probability of underwater acoustic sensing network based on interference relation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for adjusting time slot access probability of a water sound sensing network based on an interference relation. The method aims at an underwater data acquisition scene, wherein a plurality of underwater sensing nodes are accessed to a central receiving node in a sharing way according to time slots. Under the setting of any time slot length, the central receiving node can determine the interference relation of each time slot among the underwater sensing nodes according to the propagation delay between each sensing node and each sensing node, and accordingly, the access probability of each underwater sensing node is adjusted in a targeted manner, so that the maximization of the utility of the whole underwater acoustic sensing network is realized. The method can effectively reduce the problems of long idle waiting time and serious data backlog existing in the traditional time slot access MAC protocol, and can obviously improve the throughput of the whole network on the premise of ensuring that the underwater sensing nodes fairly share the access medium.

title_en: Foldable electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a foldable electronic device, which comprises an antenna. The operating frequency band of the antenna includes a satellite communications frequency band. The antenna includes a first radiator and a second radiator. The part of the conductive frame of the first shell is used as a first radiator, and the part of the conductive frame of the second shell is used as a second radiator. When the foldable electronic equipment is in an unfolding state, parasitic resonance generated by the second radiator is close to first resonance generated by the first radiator, and radiation characteristics of the antenna at the first resonance are improved through the parasitic resonance, so that a user has better communication quality when in satellite communication, and experience of the user when in satellite communication can be improved.

title_en: Method and device for optical network protection switching
abstract_en: A method and a device for optical network protection switching relate to the technical field of optical communication and are used for improving system performance. On the one hand, the transmitting end splits the optical signal to be transmitted to the first transmission path and the second transmission path, and the splitting ratio of the split light to the first transmission path and the second transmission path is different, so as to balance the transmission performance of the first transmission path and the second transmission path, prevent the performance of the whole system from being reduced caused by the larger performance reduction of a single path, and improve the overall performance of the system. On the other hand, the transmitting end splits the optical signal to be transmitted to the working path and the protection path, and the splitting ratio of the split light to the working path is higher than that of the protection path. In a scenario that a plurality of protection systems are cascaded, for a single point failure, a failed span is subjected to protection switching to a protection path, and although the performance of a transmission system of the span is reduced, other protection spans are still in a working path with higher light splitting proportion, and the total transmission performance can still be improved.

title_en: Voice telephone AI (advanced technology attachment) system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to intelligent information technology, and discloses a voice telephone AI guest-rubbing system and a method. The system comprises modules of data acquisition and preprocessing, voice interaction, intelligent decision, client management, system optimization and the like. The method comprises a voice emotion recognition algorithm adopting multi-modal fusion, an intelligent dialogue strategy optimization algorithm based on reinforcement learning, a knowledge-graph-driven client accurate portrait construction method, a real-time feedback self-adaptive speech technology generation mechanism and a blockchain-based client data security and privacy protection mechanism. The method relies on the system to complete the whole process of customer expansion. The invention can improve the guest-rubbing efficiency, the precision and the customer experience, ensure the safety of the customer data and provide powerful support for the expansion of enterprise customers.

title_en: Dual-polarized dipole antenna
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wireless communication, and particularly provides a dual-polarized dipole antenna which comprises a dielectric plate, a first radiation layer and a second radiation layer, wherein the first radiation layer and the second radiation layer are respectively arranged on the upper surface and the lower surface of the dielectric plate and are connected with a coaxial cable, a plurality of main body feeder lines and a plurality of dipole arms are arranged in the second radiation layer, the main body feeder lines are arranged in a rotationally symmetrical mode by taking the center of the dielectric plate as an axis, a spacing space is formed between every two adjacent main body feeder lines, the dipole arms are arranged in a rotationally symmetrical mode by taking the center of the dielectric plate as an axis, the dipole arms are arranged in a one-to-one correspondence mode with the spacing spaces, and the dipole arms are positioned in the corresponding spacing spaces. The electromagnetic transparent structure can be simplified while the electromagnetic transparent characteristic is realized, the coverage range of the frequency band meets the requirement, and the smooth and effective construction of the multi-frequency common-caliber base station antenna array is ensured.

title_en: Mobile station communication method, satellite communication method, and satellite communication system
abstract_en: The application discloses a mobile station communication method, a satellite communication method and a satellite communication system. The communication process comprises the steps that a mobile station sends an initial direct transmission message to a satellite network, wherein the initial direct transmission message carries a mobile station capability identification cell, the mobile station capability identification cell is at least used for indicating at least one encryption algorithm supported by the mobile station, the satellite network determines a first encryption algorithm from the encryption algorithms supported by the mobile station and sends a first encryption mode command message to the mobile station, the first encryption mode command message carries a starting encryption parameter and the first encryption algorithm, the mobile station sends a first encryption mode completion message encrypted by the first encryption algorithm to the satellite network, and the satellite network continues signaling or data transmission with the mobile station, wherein the transmitted signaling or data are encrypted by the first encryption algorithm. The method and the device solve the technical problem that the encryption algorithm is difficult to negotiate or switch efficiently based on the existing protocol in the satellite communication scene.

title_en: Radar photoelectric integrated detection tracking equipment and control method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a radar photoelectric integrated detecting and tracking device and a control method thereof, relating to the technical field of security monitoring, the device comprises a server, a vertical rod support, a tripod head camera, a radar detection module and an image detection module, wherein the tripod head camera is sequentially arranged on the vertical rod support from top to bottom, the radar detection module consists of a plurality of array millimeter wave radars, and the image detection module consists of a plurality of fish-eye cameras. Each array millimeter wave radar scans the detection angle and generates a radar track, each fisheye camera shoots fisheye images under the view angle, a server determines the overlapping detection angle between two adjacent array millimeter wave radars and performs fusion and deduplication on part of radar tracks positioned in the overlapping detection angle to obtain a real radar track, fisheye images shot by the fisheye cameras are spliced to obtain a panoramic image, and the cameras of the cradle head are controlled to conduct guiding tracking based on the real radar track and the panoramic image. The application can realize omnibearing detection and tracking and improve the stability and precision of tracking.

title_en: Display module and display device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a display module and a display device, wherein the display module comprises a display panel and a polaroid positioned on the light emitting side of the display panel, the display panel comprises a display area and a binding area positioned on one side of the display area, the polaroid comprises a first area and a second area positioned on the periphery of the first area, the orthographic projection of the first area on the display panel coincides with the display area, an NFC antenna is arranged on the second area, and contacts for binding connection with the binding area are arranged on the NFC antenna.

title_en: Antenna and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a wireless communication technology field specifically provides an antenna and electronic equipment, including first radiation branch knot, second radiation branch knot and the first electric capacity of coupling, utilize first radiation branch knot and second radiation branch knot and combine a plurality of feeds and first electric capacity, can realize the multiscale and fuse the antenna, realize, for example, double-frenquency GPS, double-frenquency wiFi and 5G N78 frequency channel fuse, utilize as few space as possible can realize the antenna design of multiscale, fully improve the antenna design degree of freedom under the compact space, reduce the antenna design degree of difficulty.

title_en: Intelligent communication box system based on multi-mode large model and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication box systems, in particular to an intelligent communication box system based on a multi-mode large model and a control method thereof, comprising the following steps of 1, visual characteristic acquisition, namely acquiring on-site multi-path camera images, and extracting a visual characteristic vector V, wherein the mathematical expression of the visual characteristic vector V is as follows: In the equation, The method comprises the steps of (1) collecting audio characteristics, namely collecting microphone array audio, extracting a voice characteristic vector A, wherein M is the number of camera paths for video frames collected by an ith camera, and the mathematical expression of the voice characteristic vector A is as follows:  according to the invention, based on the multi-mode large model, the audio-video fidelity and link robustness in the bandwidth limited environment are improved, the high-quality transmission of key areas and semantic information is ensured, the spanning improvement from manual experience parameter adjustment to end-to-end automation is realized, and the strict requirements of rescue communication on real-time performance, reliability and sustainable operation are met.

title_en: Optical forward error correction coding method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides an optical forward error correction coding method and device, comprising a laser, a signal generator, an electro-optical intensity modulator, a mode beam splitter, a mode demultiplexer and a photoelectric detector. The invention realizes the electro-optical conversion of the signal to be processed through the electro-optical intensity modulator, and changes the power of the optical signals of different modes by using the mode beam splitter so as to load the element values of the weight matrix. The output signals of different modes are separated by a mode demultiplexer and then transmitted to different photodetectors in parallel, and the photodetectors remap the signals to the electrical domain for post-processing to complete matrix-vector multiplication calculation. The invention has high integration level, good expandability and low energy consumption, can conveniently load weight, and has the potential of realizing high-speed calculation. The invention can be applied not only to forward error correction coding, but also to other scenes requiring matrix calculation.

title_en: HTCC-based embedded circuit type jet impact cooling structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an embedded circuit type jet impact cooling structure based on HTCC, which comprises an inlet and outlet layer, a water inlet cavity layer, a jet nozzle layer, a water outlet cavity layer, a jet outlet layer and a jet impact layer which are sequentially pressed and sintered from top to bottom, wherein a vertical water inlet is arranged in the inlet and outlet layer, a water inlet jet cavity is arranged in the water inlet cavity layer, a jet nozzle is arranged in the jet nozzle layer, a water outlet jet cavity is arranged in the water outlet cavity layer, a jet outlet is arranged in the jet outlet layer, an impact cavity is arranged in the jet impact layer, and the ground of the impact cavity is sequentially provided with a metal heat-conducting plate and AiP components. The water jet cavity is connected with a vertical water outlet, the impact cavity is connected with the jet outlet to discharge high-speed jet, the jet outlet is communicated with the water jet outlet cavity, and after the water flow sequentially passes through the water jet outlet cavity, the water flow is finally discharged from the vertical water outlet.

title_en: Signal transmission method and related equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a signal transmission method and related equipment, which can ensure that the optical power of two paths of local oscillation light used for carrying out coherent demodulation on signal light is in an equal or approximately equal state, and effectively reduce the complexity and time delay of an adjusting process. The method comprises the steps of receiving signal light by a signal unit through a signal optical fiber, dividing the local oscillation light into first local oscillation light and second local oscillation light by a polarization beam splitting rotator, splitting the first local oscillation light by the first beam splitter to obtain third local oscillation light and first detection light, splitting the second local oscillation light by the second beam splitter to obtain fourth local oscillation light and second detection light, and indicating a first power adjusting unit to output fifth local oscillation light according to the third local oscillation light and also indicating a second power adjusting unit to output sixth local oscillation light according to the fourth local oscillation light by a comparator according to the magnitude relation between the optical power of the first detection light and the optical power of the second detection light, wherein the fifth local oscillation light and the sixth local oscillation light are used for carrying out coherent demodulation on the signal light.

title_en: Light flexible wave-absorbing/heat-conducting dual-functional film material and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a light flexible wave-absorbing/heat-conducting dual-functional film material and a preparation method thereof, wherein GO and CoFe  2 O 4  are respectively and uniformly dispersed into DMF and PAN spinning solution, CNF-CoFe  2 O 4  and CNF-GO films are obtained through electrostatic spinning, and the flexible sandwich structure film wave-absorbing/heat-conducting material is obtained through hot pressing with the CNF-CoFe  2 O 4  film after the CNF-GO film is subjected to reduction treatment. The preparation method disclosed by the invention is simple in preparation process, low in raw materials and easy to obtain, and the prepared film material has the advantages of flexibility, effective absorption frequency bandwidth, good heat conduction performance, environment friendliness and the like.

title_en: Signal noise reduction method and system for improving power line communication quality
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent voice signal processing, in particular to a signal noise reduction method and a system for improving the quality of power line communication, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining signal data transmitted by the power line communication and obtaining each modal component of the power line communication signal; according to the characteristic difference between peaks in the extremum curves of the modal components, a first difference value of the modal components is constructed, the superposition interference difference coefficient of the modal components is obtained by combining the change condition of the peaks in the extremum curves corresponding to the modal components, the step length parameter of signal noise reduction under the frequency range corresponding to the modal components is adjusted, the adjustment coefficient of signal reconstruction weight of the modal components is calculated, the weight of signal reconstruction of the modal components is adjusted by combining the preset initial weight, and the power communication signal after noise reduction is obtained through signal reconstruction. The application can improve the accuracy of the noise reduction processing of the signals.

title_en: TDD wireless repeater and uplink and downlink switching method
abstract_en: The application discloses a TDD wireless repeater and an uplink and downlink switching method, which comprises a first radio frequency switch, a second radio frequency switch, a third radio frequency switch, a fourth radio frequency switch, a control unit and a control unit, wherein the fixed end is connected with a BS, two movable ends are respectively connected with a second radio frequency switch and a third radio frequency switch, the fixed end is connected with an input end of a radio frequency amplification link, two movable ends are respectively connected with a first radio frequency switch and a fourth radio frequency switch, the third radio frequency switch is connected with an output end of the radio frequency amplification link, two movable ends are respectively connected with the first radio frequency switch and the fourth radio frequency switch, the fixed end is connected with an MS, two movable ends are respectively connected with the second radio frequency switch and the third radio frequency switch, the control unit is used for controlling the connection of the fourth radio frequency switch and the second radio frequency switch, the third radio frequency switch and the first radio frequency switch, the first radio frequency switch and the third radio frequency switch and the fourth radio frequency switch, and the third radio frequency switch are connected through the radio frequency amplification link. Therefore, the problem of resource waste caused by the fact that the existing TDD wireless repeater adopts two radio frequency amplification links is solved.

title_en: Channel access method, COT sharing method, device, terminal and network equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a channel access method, a COT sharing method, a configuration method, a device, a terminal and network side equipment of a subband in SBFD, and belongs to the technical field of communication; the first interception result is related to a detection power or energy detection threshold in the first channel, the detection power or energy detection threshold is related to interference power in the first channel, the terminal determines whether to access the first channel according to the first interception result, and the uplink sub-band is an uplink sub-band in sub-band full duplex SBFD configuration.

title_en: Rotating shaft mechanism and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a rotating shaft mechanism and electronic equipment. The gear comprises a middle beam, a synchronous gear, a first swing arm and a second swing arm, wherein the synchronous gear comprises a first gear and a second gear which are meshed and mounted on the middle beam and are respectively connected with the first swing arm and the second swing arm, the first gear comprises a first tooth, the first tooth comprises a first end and a second end which are oppositely arranged in the tooth width direction of the first tooth, the second gear comprises a second tooth, the second tooth comprises a third end and a fourth end which are oppositely arranged in the tooth width direction of the second tooth, the third end and the first end are positioned on one side of the synchronous gear, the fourth end and the second end are positioned on the other side of the synchronous gear, the tooth top thickness of the first tooth gradually changes from the first end to the second end, the tooth top thickness of the second tooth gradually changes from the third end to the fourth end, and the change trend of the tooth top thickness of the second tooth is opposite to that of the first tooth. The synchronous structure of the technical scheme of the application has good synchronous effect and is easy to realize synchronous rotation of the structures at the two sides of the rotating shaft.

title_en: Antenna and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an antenna and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of antennas. The antenna includes a first radiator and a second radiator. One of the first radiator and the second radiator has a feeding point, and the other of the first radiator and the second radiator is a parasitic structure. The first radiator includes a first end and a second end, and the second radiator includes a third end and a fourth end. The first end, the second end and the third end are open ends, the second end and the third end are arranged oppositely, a gap is formed between the second end and the third end, and the first radiator and the second radiator are coupled through the gap. When the antenna works at a preset frequency, the current direction on the first radiator is the same as the current direction on the second radiator. The electrical length of the first radiator is greater than 0.25 lambda 1 and less than or equal to 0.5 lambda 1, wherein lambda 1 is the dielectric wavelength of the first radiator when the antenna operates at a preset frequency. In this way, the antenna can have a high radiation efficiency and a low specific absorption rate.

title_en: RS-422 bus communication fault investigation method based on oscilloscope assistance
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of RS-422 bus communication, and particularly relates to an RS-422 bus communication fault checking method based on oscilloscope assistance, wherein in the method, under the condition that the type of a data signal check bit sent by a sending end device is unknown, an oscilloscope is used for carrying out waveform analysis on the data signal on an RS-422 bus, and the voltage and ripple of the data signal and the waveform characteristics of a start bit, a data bit, a check bit and a stop bit of each byte are observed; if the check bit type of the sending end equipment is inconsistent with the check bit setting of the receiving end equipment, the check bit setting of the receiving end is adjusted to enable the check bit types of the sending end equipment and the receiving end equipment to be matched, and therefore communication faults are solved. The invention not only provides a high-efficiency and accurate RS-422 bus communication fault investigation method, but also provides theoretical basis and practical guidance for the investigation of similar communication faults through the application of the parity check principle, and has important practical application value.

title_en: MIMO-FSO power distribution method based on TD3N
abstract_en: The invention discloses a MIMO-FSO power distribution method based on TD3N, which adopts a deep reinforcement learning technology, is based on a MIMO-FSO system under a multiplexing mode, aims at a changed atmosphere environment, provides a power distribution algorithm based on deep reinforcement learning, reasonably distributes power resources according to channel state information at different moments by the algorithm, realizes capacity maximization under total power and peak power limitation, and improves the frequency spectrum efficiency of the system. In addition, the algorithm fully considers the influence of atmospheric turbulence, atmospheric attenuation, noise factors and the like on the MIMO-FSO system so as to ensure that the system can maintain excellent communication performance under real and variable environmental conditions.

title_en: Test data processing method and related device
abstract_en: The application discloses a processing method of test data and a related device, relating to the technical field of information encryption and hiding, the method generates a target test screenshot and simultaneously obtains a binary bit stream of context information of the target test screenshot in a data embedding stage, and embeds the context information into the target test screenshot by replacing the least significant bit of a two-level system pixel value of each target pixel in the target test screenshot by using the binary bit stream of the context information one by one, the method and the device achieve the purpose of hiding and storing the context information in the target test screenshot, further, in a data tracing stage, the lowest significant bits of the two-level system pixel values of all target pixels are extracted one by one from the steganographic image of the target test screenshot, the extraction of the context information is achieved, binding of the test screenshot and the context information is achieved, efficient storage and safety of the context information are guaranteed, and accordingly traceability and accuracy of the context information are achieved.

title_en: Method and apparatus for microwave assisted laser communication
abstract_en: The application discloses a microwave-assisted laser communication method, which comprises the steps of adopting time slot allocation in a task preparation stage, utilizing microwaves to transmit first message information and mutually identify nodes, wherein the transmission does not consider the priority of the first message information, adopting time slot allocation in a directional link establishment stage, and utilizing the microwaves to transmit second message information based on the priority of the second message information so as to establish and track the nodes.

title_en: Stepping frequency modulation radar transmitter based on super surface
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space-time coding super-surface based step frequency radar transmitter, and belongs to the technical field of artificial electromagnetic super-surfaces. The transmitter comprises 1) a space-time coding super surface formed by sub-wavelength units, each unit is integrated with a varactor diode and a patch capacitor, a bias voltage is applied through an FPGA (field programmable gate array) to realize the continuous regulation and control of a reflection phase 0-2 pi, 2) a stepping frequency modulation signal generation method is used for generating a stepping frequency modulation reflection echo by designing a super-surface reflection coefficient coding vector and an incident signal of time-varying frequency, 3) a waveform purity analysis model is used for quantifying the influence of amplitude errors and phase errors on the signal purity, and 4) a novel radar transmitter architecture is used. The invention can synchronously realize the functions of radar waveform generation and beam scanning, and integrates the functions of a waveform generator and a T/R component of a traditional transmitter in a single device. Compared with a conventional architecture, the method has the advantages that the hardware complexity and the integration cost are obviously reduced, the broadband waveform generation capability is supported, and the target distance and the speed information can be accurately acquired.

title_en: VDES ship earth station uplink transmission data processing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a VDES ship earth station uplink transmission data processing method, which comprises the following steps of paging message communication, ship earth station sending a paging response ACK message to a satellite, uplink addressing communication, ship earth station sending an uplink addressing resource request message and an uplink addressing communication data packet message to the satellite, downlink addressing communication, sending a downlink addressing communication response ACK message to the satellite, ship earth station sending an uplink short message to the satellite, and ship earth station sending a downlink short message response ACK message to the satellite. The invention has the advantages of solving the problem of the channel utilization rate of the VDE-SAT system, optimizing ship earth station transmitted satellite message processing method, preprocessing the message to be transmitted, improving ship earth station data transmission efficiency, fully utilizing limited time slot and channel resources and improving the utilization rate of the VDE-SAT channel.

title_en: Miniaturized device capable of locking frequency of semiconductor laser and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a miniaturized device capable of locking the frequency of a semiconductor laser and a control method thereof, relating to the technical fields of laser technology and optoelectronic devices, wherein the miniaturized device comprises an integrated shell; the optical module comprises an optical path component, an electro-optical modulator and a photoelectric detector, wherein the control module comprises a first singlechip, a second singlechip, a direct digital frequency synthesizer, a digital-analog converter and an analog-digital converter, the control method monitors the state of the system in real time, and once unlocking is detected, the frequency scanning and the unlocking flow are automatically started.

title_en: Intelligent router with display screen and interaction system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent router with a display screen and an interaction system thereof, and relates to the technical field of monitoring, wherein the intelligent router comprises a router shell, the top of the router shell is fixedly embedded with the display screen, the top of the router shell is provided with a silica gel film, the outer side of the silica gel film is fixedly provided with a first mounting frame, four supporting components are arranged between the first mounting frame and the router shell, the front side of the router shell is provided with an interaction cavity, the top of the inner cavity of the interaction cavity is fixedly provided with a plurality of infrared sensors, fingers move from left to right in the interaction cavity, the infrared sensors detecting the fingers feed back detection results to the display screen, virtual buttons at corresponding positions on the display screen are lightened, a user can position the virtual buttons needing to be operated without cleaning dust at the top of the silica gel film, the use method for positioning the virtual buttons after the user deashing the display screen is changed, and the normal operation of the intelligent router is prevented from being influenced by false touch of the virtual buttons.

title_en: Cavity filter
abstract_en: The application discloses a cavity filter, which comprises a cavity, a plurality of resonant rods and a coupling piece, wherein the cavity is provided with a bottom wall, the resonant rods comprise a first resonant rod, a second resonant rod and a third resonant rod which are sequentially adjacent and are arranged on the bottom wall at intervals, the first resonant rod is configured to be coupled with the third resonant rod, the coupling piece is a suppression ring arranged on the bottom wall, the suppression ring is positioned between the first resonant rod and the third resonant rod, the suppression ring is made of metal materials and comprises a ring part, and the suppression ring is provided with a groove with an opening facing to one side far away from the bottom wall. The cavity filter can stably work in high-temperature or low-temperature environments, and the out-of-band suppression is enhanced by adopting the suppression ring with a simple structure as a coupling piece to replace a conventional flying lever structure, so that the debugging difficulty and the sensitivity are reduced.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle detection and identification system based on radio frequency signal feature extraction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle detection and identification and air traffic management, and discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle detection and identification system based on radio frequency signal feature extraction, which comprises a radio frequency signal acquisition module, a feature database module and a signal processing analysis module, wherein the system firstly carries out bandwidth filtering on acquired signals, then builds a multidimensional time sequence feature sequence capable of representing communication behaviors, and finally carries out segment-by-segment alignment comparison with a template sequence through a sliding window mechanism to complete identification.

title_en: Communication method and related equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a communication method which is used for reducing the indication overhead of the second information and reducing the network resources occupied by the second information. The method is applied to network equipment and comprises the steps of sending first information aiming at a first channel to terminal equipment, wherein the first information indicates at least one group of first mapping relations configured by the network equipment for the first channel, and each group of first mapping relations indicates mapping relations of code points, TCI states and RI. And sending second information to the terminal equipment, wherein the second information is used for enabling a first TCI state, and the first TCI state is contained in at least one group of TCI states corresponding to the first mapping relation.

title_en: Stable in structure's light high strength antenna structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of antenna structures, in particular to a light high-strength antenna structure with a stable structure, which comprises a lightning rod tip, a center rod, a steel wire rope, a cross rod, an inclined rod, a first wire, a metal disc and an inductor, wherein the center rod and the cross rod are made of high-strength carbon fiber materials, the inclined rod is made of high-strength glass fiber materials, the rod members form an outline framework of the whole antenna, the weight of the antenna is obviously reduced by adopting a composite material, and meanwhile, the strength and the rigidity of the antenna structure also meet the use requirements. The wire rope that the slope set up is drawn forth from the lightning rod tip, and the bottom mounting is on the metal disk, and the wire rope that the level annular set up is established ties the diagonal rod, and the net that these wire ropes constructed not only can increase the fastness of structure, can also prevent thunder and lightning direct attack antenna with the lightning rod tip together, has the efficiency that improves antenna signal radiation efficiency simultaneously concurrently.

title_en: Cross-layer IP and optical network resource collaborative analysis method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a collaborative analysis method, a collaborative analysis system, collaborative analysis equipment and collaborative analysis media based on cross-layer IP and optical network resources. The method comprises the steps of collecting key information such as performance, topology, alarm and resources of I P networks and optical network equipment in real time, carrying out feature extraction and resource modeling on I P networks and optical network data respectively to generate respective single-layer models, carrying out association fusion on I P network single-layer models and optical network single-layer models to construct a cross-layer resource model, analyzing performance indexes according to performance indexes and preset thresholds in the cross-layer resource model to obtain cross-layer performance collaborative analysis results, wherein the cross-layer performance collaborative analysis results comprise I P layers of time delay, packet loss rate, optical layer optical power and the like, and are used for evaluating health states, resource utilization efficiency and service bearing capacity of joint operation of the I P networks and the optical networks. The method can solve the problems of difficult positioning of the cross-layer faults and insufficient linkage of resources and performance, realize visualization and collaborative management of the cross-layer network resources and improve the fault processing efficiency.

title_en: System and method for card simulation on a wearable device
abstract_en: Systems and methods for card simulation on a wearable device are provided. An exemplary system includes a contactless card and a wearable device. The communication field between the contactless card and the wearable device may be opened. The wearable device may receive data from the contactless card. The wearable device may emulate an applet of the contactless card, allowing the wearable device to use the applet information to complete a transaction that would otherwise require the contactless card.

title_en: Calibration method, device, electronic equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a calibration method, an apparatus, an electronic device, a storage medium, and a program product, where the method includes obtaining historical calibration data of each channel in a radio frequency board, where one radio frequency board corresponds to at least one channel, performing intra-board calibration on first service data of each channel in each radio frequency board based on the historical calibration data to obtain second service data, and performing inter-board calibration on the second service data based on relative difference degrees between different radio frequency boards for any two radio frequency boards to obtain third service data. In summary, compared with the existing measurement-by-measurement-and-manual calibration mode, the technical scheme provided by the disclosure can increase calibration efficiency, improve accuracy and meet actual needs by means of the historical calibration data of each channel in a centralized calibration mode in stages.

title_en: Model proving and verifying method and system for multi-unmanned plane cooperation-oriented double-order T-norm-Choquet-OWA resource aggregator
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle coordination, and discloses a model proving and verifying method of a double-order T-norm-Choquet-OWA resource aggregator for multi-unmanned aerial vehicle coordination. In joint simulation involving 360 unmanned aerial vehicles, the method controls the average Round Trip Time (RTT) to 55 milliseconds, which is reduced by 5%, 10%, 15% and 20% compared to a "minimum (Min)" scheduler, a deep reinforcement learning-near-end policy optimization (DRL-PPO) algorithm, a single-layer OWA method and a Weighted Sum (WSM) method, respectively. Jitter remains within 11 milliseconds, the packet loss rate is less than 0.03%, and the remaining power is increased by about 12% compared to the optimal heuristic baseline. These results demonstrate the low latency and high stability advantages of the predictive peak cut fill and two stage fuzzy polymerization approach in large scale unmanned aerial vehicle populations.

title_en: Method and device for resisting attack by black box signal based on frequency spectrum characteristics
abstract_en: A black box signal anti-attack method and device based on spectrum features includes S1, preprocessing an input IQ signal, converting a time domain signal into frequency domain features through Fourier transformation, calculating optimal frequency bands according to the length of the input signal, uniformly dividing the signal into a plurality of frequency bands, S2, carrying out nonlinear transformation on the frequency spectrum features by using an adaptive frequency spectrum disturbance generator, extracting key feature representations in the frequency spectrum, constructing frequency domain disturbance through extracted amplitude and phase parameters, S3, carrying out time domain reconstruction on the frequency domain disturbance by using inverse Fourier transformation and superposing an original signal to generate a target anti-attack sample, S4, designing a loss function according to attack effects, gradient guidance and disturbance constraint, optimizing the frequency spectrum disturbance generator, S5, selecting a sensitive frequency band based on a dynamic mask mechanism, and carrying out iterative optimization on the anti-attack disturbance based on the selected frequency band. When the query resources are consumed, a final challenge sample is returned. The invention only depends on the input and output of the model, uses the self-adaptive spectrum disturbance generator and the dynamic mask mechanism to dynamically update the frequency domain countermeasure disturbance, converts the frequency domain countermeasure disturbance into the time domain through the inverse Fourier transform, and finally generates the countermeasure sample with higher concealment.

title_en: Dispersion simulation transmission link and dispersion simulation method based on analog signal processing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of optical fiber communication, and discloses a dispersion simulation transmission link and a dispersion simulation method based on analog signal processing, wherein the dispersion simulation transmission link comprises: a coherent transmitter, an IQ modulator, lasers with different wavelengths, a coherent receiving chip (ICR), a bragg dispersion compensating grating (FBG-DCM) and a coherent receiver. The data is sent out from the coherent transmitter, and the data is first passed through ICR to convert the light field into electric field, and then modulated into new light field by IQ modulator. The ICR output end can select two paths, and the first path is to The second path is to convert the wavelength into FBG-DCM compensation window by using the IQ modulator to realize the superposition of negative dispersion after ICR receiving and the conversion of the IQ modulator to the original wavelength transmission The method is connected to an IQ modulator, utilizes the secondary emission of intrinsic light with different wavelengths to realize phase conjugation and simultaneously convert the phase conjugation into an FBG-DCM compensation window, and realizes superposition of positive dispersion through the steps after ICR receiving.

title_en: Quantum entanglement communication system and method based on multiple complex algebra structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a quantum entanglement communication system based on a multiple complex algebra structure, which establishes a mapping relation between photon multiple degrees of freedom and quaternion space. The technology breaks through the limitation of traditional quantum communication dimension, obviously improves the communication capacity and the transmission distance on the premise of ensuring absolute safety, and provides revolutionary solutions for scenes such as 5G/6G mobile communication, ocean observational networks and the like.

title_en: Test platform calibration method and device of RF system, storage medium and platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a test platform calibration method, a device, a storage medium and a platform of an RF system, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing wireless connection with a standard RF system and performing code matching; the method comprises the steps of receiving a calibration instruction of a test platform, reading a parameter initial value, a preset parameter deviation range and a preset signal power value of a target performance parameter, generating the target performance parameter calibration instruction and sending the target performance parameter calibration instruction to a standard RF system, wherein the standard RF system is used for processing a target radio frequency signal and generating a parameter actual value aiming at the target performance parameter according to the target performance parameter calibration instruction, obtaining the parameter deviation value of the target performance parameter, calibrating the parameter initial value according to the parameter deviation value and the preset parameter deviation range to obtain a parameter standard value of the target performance parameter, selecting the next performance parameter to determine the target performance parameter, and repeating the steps until the parameter standard value of each performance parameter is obtained. The invention can improve the calibration efficiency and consistency of the test platform.

title_en: Wi-Fi channel state information time delay estimation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Wi-Fi channel state information time delay estimation method and a Wi-Fi channel state information time delay estimation system, wherein the method comprises the steps of preprocessing acquired multi-antenna CSI data to obtain a multi-antenna CSI matrix; the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-antenna joint Bayesian model, extracting main paths of each antenna, carrying out consistency detection, calculating fusion delay values, delay uncertainty and channel anomaly identifications to form state characteristics, training the DQN through a multi-objective reward function by adopting a light DQN combined by depth separable convolution and full connection, outputting optimal pilot frequency configuration actions, executing the optimal pilot frequency configuration actions and mapping the optimal pilot frequency configuration actions into pilot frequency configuration parameters, generating and sending time domain orthogonal multi-antenna pilot signals, outputting a new CSI matrix, updating network parameters of the multi-antenna Bayesian model and the light DQN, and carrying out closed-loop optimization on dynamic channel adaptation. The method effectively overcomes the influence of hardware errors on time delay estimation by organically combining multi-antenna data combined preprocessing and Bayesian estimation.

title_en: Ship-end multimode routing method based on communication service priority
abstract_en: The invention provides a ship-end multimode routing method based on communication service priority, and belongs to the technical field of offshore communication. The method mainly comprises the steps of obtaining external transmission service flows of a ship end, constructing an access decision model based on an offshore wireless channel model and taking the transmission rate of maximized service flows in communication time as a target, determining the communication mode of each moment based on the access decision model, constructing a routing decision model based on a ship network model and taking the maximized utility function in communication time as the target according to the communication mode of each moment and QoS requirements of the external transmission service flows, and determining a transmission path based on the routing decision model. The invention utilizes the dual-stage intelligent routing model to evaluate the instantaneous performance and the service bearing capacity of each wireless interface in real time at the access layer, and combines the service priority and the network resource condition to carry out path scheduling at the in-ship routing layer, thereby dynamically matching the most suitable transmission scheme for different services and obviously improving the stability and the resource utilization rate of the ship network.

title_en: Impedance matching feed adapter for carrier-based short wave antenna
abstract_en: The invention discloses an impedance matching feed adapter for a carrier-based short wave antenna, and belongs to the technical field of short wave antennas. The impedance matching feed adapter comprises a supporting assembly and an impedance matching assembly, wherein the supporting assembly comprises a supporting base, an insulating shell, an insulating frame and an insulator, the supporting base is detachably connected with the insulating shell to form a cavity, the insulating frame is inserted into the cavity, the insulator is inserted onto the supporting base, the impedance matching assembly comprises a core column, an impedance matching coil and a feed connector, the core column is inserted into the insulator, the impedance matching coil is spirally wound on the periphery of the insulating frame, and the feed connector is inserted onto the top of the insulating shell. The impedance matching feed adapter for the carrier-based short wave antenna can integrate insulation support and impedance matching functions, can realize reliable insulation support between the short wave antenna and a ship deck, and can ensure that the short wave antenna has good impedance matching in a working frequency band.

title_en: Multi-unit very low frequency transmitting antenna system and tuning method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-unit very low frequency transmitting antenna system and a tuning method thereof, which belong to the technical field of very low frequency transmitting antennas and comprise a plurality of antenna units, a plurality of tuning pavilions, a plurality of low-voltage feeder lines, a transmitter and a plurality of ground grids, wherein the tuning pavilions are respectively positioned near the central position of each group of antenna units, each tuning pavilion consists of a plurality of tunable coils with the same structure, the tuning pavilions are connected with the root parts of the antenna units, the low-voltage feeder lines are respectively connected with the transmitter and the tuning pavilions, the transmitter is positioned at the geometric center of an antenna array formed by the antenna units, the transmitter is connected with the low-voltage feeder lines through a branching device and a high-voltage isolating switch, the ground grids are respectively paved by taking the antenna units as the centers, the ground grids are formed by a plurality of local ground grids paved radially, and the ground grids are connected or kept independent and disconnected through metal ground grid wires. The invention obviously reduces the complexity of antenna design and construction and reduces the dependence on the land topography of the antenna array.

title_en: Antenna of notebook computer and notebook computer
abstract_en: The antenna of the notebook computer and the notebook computer provided by the application can realize the connection of the radiating unit and the grounding unit through the connection unit realized in the form of the printed wire, so that an independent welding point is not required to be arranged, the occupation of the connection unit and a medium substrate where the connection unit is positioned to the internal space of the notebook computer is reduced, the waste of precious space in the notebook computer is reduced, the volume and the weight of the notebook computer are also reduced, and the use experience of the notebook computer is improved.

title_en: Back scattering communication total throughput maximization method based on stacked intelligent super surface energization
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wireless communication, in particular to a method for maximizing total throughput of back scattering communication based on stacked intelligent super surface (STACKED INTELLIGENT Metasurface, SIM) energization, which comprises the steps of constructing a back scattering communication system model based on SIM assistance; the method comprises the steps of establishing a non-convex, multivariable coupling and multi-constraint resource allocation problem aiming at maximizing the total throughput of the system, converting the original problem into a transmitting end power allocation optimization sub-problem, a time slot allocation optimization sub-problem and a SIM phase shift optimization sub-problem, converting the non-convex optimization sub-problem into a convex optimization sub-problem by using a successive convex approximation method, a punishment method and a first-order Taylor expansion, and alternately optimizing to obtain an overall resource allocation scheme. According to the invention, the SIM is introduced into the transmitting end, so that the signal beam forming operation can be realized in the electromagnetic wave domain, compared with the traditional scheme, the total throughput performance of the system is obviously improved, meanwhile, the dependence of the transmitting end on a complex radio frequency link can be effectively reduced, and the system has good economic benefit.

title_en: Secondary positioning ultra-light switching structure and design method
abstract_en: The invention provides a secondary positioning ultra-light switching structure which comprises a switching structure body formed by machining, wherein the switching structure body is provided with a lower mounting surface for connecting a spacecraft cabin plate and an upper mounting surface for connecting a rotating mechanism, a lower positioning element or a lower positioning surface for positioning the spacecraft cabin plate is arranged on the lower mounting surface, an upper positioning element or an upper positioning surface for positioning the rotating mechanism is arranged on the upper mounting surface, the switching structure body is made of an aluminum alloy material, and the structure is subjected to topological optimization to form a frame structure with a lightening hole or a light-weight cavity. Also provides a design method of the secondary positioning ultra-light switching structure. Therefore, the invention can meet the transfer task requirement of carrying out large-size offset and high-precision secondary positioning on the mechanism on the spacecraft.

title_en: MIMO mobile phone antenna self-adaptive tuning method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive tuning method of a MIMO mobile phone antenna based on reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps of collecting working parameters, carrying out fusion coding on a working parameter set to generate a feature vector containing historical state and time sequence information, calculating an action range boundary according to the working parameter set, generating a boundary crossing detection rule and a rollback triggering condition, inputting the feature vector and the action range boundary into an improved diffusion policy generation model, generating tuning action by using a hierarchical policy network, detecting according to the boundary crossing detection rule and triggering rollback when crossing to obtain a stable execution state, calculating a stability index, constructing a diversity-stable collaborative rewarding function, updating the hierarchical policy network, generating a scene label, forming a key value pair index, storing, constructing a lightweight policy and solidifying in a network distillation mode. The invention realizes the self-adaptive tuning of the MIMO mobile phone antenna.

title_en: Non-cooperative unmanned aerial vehicle radiation source directional attack method based on CVE-AdvGAN
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-cooperative unmanned aerial vehicle radiation source directional attack method based on CVE-AdvGAN, and relates to the technical field of communication. The technical scheme includes that non-cooperative unmanned aerial vehicle radiation source signals are perceived, physical layer and protocol layer characteristics are extracted, a target radiation source characteristic library is built, a CVE database is searched based on signal related information, available loopholes are screened, attack loads are built, a CVE-AdvGAN model containing a generator and a discriminator is built, an countermeasure sample meeting the concealment and effectiveness is generated, the target real-time position is combined through a transmitting module, the countermeasure sample is transmitted in a directional mode, the attack effect is verified, and if the attack effect is unsuccessful, the model and the transmitting parameters are optimized in a closed loop mode. The method solves the problems of poor robustness, weak practical applicability, poor directional attack effect and blank application in the unmanned aerial vehicle field of the existing radiation source attack method, can verify the robustness of the system, improves the attack accuracy and concealment, realizes the landing of the algorithm from theory to practical application, and ensures the safety of the spatial domain of the my.

title_en: Network fault management method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of computer networks and provides a network fault management method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a program product, wherein in the process of executing a service by adopting a RoCE network, the method respectively executes the following operations of determining a physical layer performance score, a link layer performance score, a transmission layer performance score and a load regulation factor of each task path of the service; and switching the task path to a target standby path determined from the link replacement candidate pool under the condition that the task path is determined to have a network hidden fault based on the link performance comprehensive score of the task path. The application can timely and accurately detect the hidden faults of the network and switch paths, thereby ensuring the communication efficiency of the service and the normal operation of the service.

title_en: Compact broadband microwave circular polarization-millimeter wave MIMO common-caliber antenna
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compact broadband microwave circular polarization-millimeter wave MIMO common-caliber antenna structure, and relates to the field of microwave communication design; the cross dipole radiator consists of rectangular patches with cross grooves and phase delay lines, the phase delay lines provide 90-degree phase difference so as to form circular polarized radiation, and the rectangular patches with a pair of rectangular millimeter wave slots and the rectangular patches with a pair of millimeter wave slots with cut angles are asymmetric, so that the coupling function is caused, and the impedance bandwidth and the axial ratio bandwidth of the microwave circular polarized antenna are widened. The invention integrates the antennas in the microwave frequency band and the millimeter wave frequency band on the single-layer substrate, has simple mechanism, low cost and excellent performance, realizes high isolation between the two frequency bands by sealing the substrate integrated waveguide, and can promote the performance of the microwave antenna.

title_en: Address book management method and related device
abstract_en: The application discloses an address book management method and a related device, wherein the method comprises the steps that firstly, a terminal device obtains a first address book, wherein the first address book corresponds to a first user account number registered in network side equipment, the first address book comprises at least one piece of contact person information, the terminal device establishes communication connection with user equipment of a user, and the terminal device allows the user to check and/or use the first address book on the terminal device under the condition that the user equipment is authorized equipment of the first user account number. Therefore, the data security of the address book of the user account on the terminal equipment is improved. In addition, compared with the mode that the terminal equipment and the user equipment are connected through Bluetooth to synchronize the address book, the method can improve the synchronous rate of the address book and can also improve the use experience of the user.

title_en: Intelligent cable trench cover protection system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent cable trench cover plate protection system and a control method thereof, which belong to the technical field of cable protection and comprise a cover plate assembly, a detection assembly and a central control unit, wherein the central control unit is arranged at the far end of a cable trench and is in communication connection with the cover plate assembly and the detection assembly. The central control unit is configured to dynamically construct and maintain a dynamic safety boundary centered on the operator based on the data collected in real time by the detection assembly, and automatically execute a protection strategy including activating forced ventilation, evacuation alarms, locking the cover plate body when an abnormal risk is identified. The invention can realize effective protection of the cable in the cable trench on the basis of ensuring the safety of operators.

title_en: Wide-bandwidth axial ratio circularly polarized antenna based on tight coupling principle
abstract_en: The invention provides a wide bandwidth axial ratio circularly polarized antenna based on a tight coupling principle, which relates to the technical field of microstrip antenna structure design, and comprises a first dielectric plate serving as a substrate, wherein a feed network capable of realizing one-to-four power division and 90-degree phase shift is printed on the lower bottom surface of the first dielectric plate; the second dielectric plate is arranged above the first dielectric plate in parallel, four circular arc-shaped metal patches are arranged on the lower bottom surface of the second dielectric plate to form a radiation unit, close coupling is realized between adjacent patches through interdigital capacitors, and a strip-shaped microstrip line is arranged on the upper top surface of the second dielectric plate. Four coaxial feeder lines are vertically connected with the output end of the feed network and each metal patch, so that efficient transmission of signals is realized. A circular metal cavity is arranged on the upper surface of the first dielectric plate and is connected with a metal ground for improving the axial ratio at a low elevation angle. The invention realizes wide impedance bandwidth and wide axial ratio bandwidth, and has wide axial ratio beam width and high radiation efficiency.

title_en: High-frequency-band and high-integration spaceborne transmitting surface antenna
abstract_en: The application discloses a high-frequency band and high-integration spaceborne transmitting surface antenna, which belongs to the field of antennas and comprises a supporting seat, wherein a pitching directional base is fixed on the side surface of the supporting seat, a horizontal directional base is arranged on one side of the pitching directional base, a first variable speed motor is arranged on the side surface of the pitching directional base, an output shaft of the first variable speed motor penetrates through the horizontal directional base, an output shaft of the first variable speed motor is fixedly connected with the horizontal directional base, a cabin plate is arranged on one side, close to the supporting seat, of the horizontal directional base, a reflecting surface component is arranged on the cabin plate, a second variable speed motor is arranged on the horizontal directional base, an output shaft of the second variable speed motor penetrates through the horizontal directional base and is fixedly connected with the cabin plate, and a locking and releasing mechanism for locking and releasing the reflecting surface component is arranged on the supporting seat. The application has the effect of improving the assembly efficiency.

title_en: Total station video nano-tube method of high-voltage direct-current converter station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a total station video nano-tube method of a high-voltage direct-current converter station, and relates to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance of power systems. The method realizes unified access, management and service provision of the multi-source heterogeneous video equipment by locally deploying the video nanotube server at the converter station. The system supports standard and private protocol adaptation, provides a standardized northbound interface, and realizes acquisition, transmission, storage, calling and safety control of video data. The invention solves the problems of discretization, non-uniform interfaces and high operation and maintenance cost of the video system of the converter station, improves the integration, safety and expandability of the video system, and is suitable for intelligent operation and maintenance management of the high-voltage direct-current converter station.

title_en: Communication method and device
abstract_en: A communication method and device belong to the technical field of communication. The method comprises the steps of generating m x n first beams, wherein the n first beams in the m first beams are located in an ith first coverage area in the m first coverage areas, n and m are positive integers, i is a positive integer smaller than or equal to m, the m first coverage areas are arranged along a first direction in a view field range of a non-ground communication device, the first direction is perpendicular to a flight direction of the non-ground communication device, the n first beams in the m x n first beams are arranged along a second direction in the ith first coverage area, and the second direction is the flight direction of the non-ground communication device. According to the scheme, a large amount of wave beam coverage can be carried out along the satellite flight direction according to the characteristics of the satellite coverage ground users, so that the wave beam coverage effect is effectively improved.

title_en: Voice call information recording method, device, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a voice call information recording method, a device, a storage medium and a program product, and relates to the technical field of electronic equipment.
