The method comprises the steps of responding to a first operation, displaying a call information recording window in a call interface, wherein the call information recording window comprises a first control, responding to a second operation on the first control, obtaining voice data in the call process, obtaining key information from the voice data, and displaying the key information in the call information recording window. The technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the application can improve the recording efficiency and accuracy of the call information.

title_en: Signal prediction model training method, signal prediction method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a signal prediction model training method, a signal prediction device and equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining actual signal quality data received by each signal receiving point in a sample signal propagation scene and environment obstacle information corresponding to the sample signal propagation scene, obtaining signal dispersion characteristics of quantized information corresponding to each signal receiving point and used for representing signal propagation influenced by the environment obstacle according to the environment obstacle information, inputting a signal prediction model to be trained according to the signal dispersion characteristics, propagation link parameters corresponding to each signal receiving point and wireless access equipment configuration information corresponding to the sample signal propagation scene, obtaining predicted signal quality data corresponding to each signal receiving point, and finally training the signal prediction model according to the difference between the predicted signal quality data and the actual signal quality data. By adopting the method, the prediction precision of the signal prediction model and the accuracy of signal prediction are improved.

title_en: Autonomous preferred system and method for external antenna of Internet of things product
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of Internet of things products, and provides an autonomous preferred system and method for an external antenna of an Internet of things product, wherein the technical scheme is that a decision module is connected with a relay set, the relay set is connected with an antenna interface, and the antenna interface is connected with the external antenna of the Internet of things product; the method comprises the steps of obtaining external antenna working parameters connected with all antenna interfaces, comparing the external antenna working parameters with preset working parameters one by one, controlling a relay set through a first control strategy if matching conditions are met, enabling the antenna interfaces meeting the conditions to be communicated with corresponding communication modules so as to conduct information interaction, determining the external antenna type actually connected with the current antenna interface if the matching conditions are not met, and controlling the relay set through a second control strategy according to the external antenna type actually connected, so that the communication modules corresponding to the current antenna interface and the external antenna type actually connected are communicated so as to conduct information interaction. And automatically matching the external antenna with the optimal route.

title_en: Voice coding and decoding method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a voice coding and decoding method which comprises a receiving end and a transmitting end, wherein the transmitting end collects voice data, the voice data is in a pulse code modulation PCM format, single channels and 16 bits are adopted, the sampling rate is 8kHz, 320 bytes of voice data are collected every 20ms, each 320 bytes of voice data are compressed into 5 bytes of compressed data, a plurality of groups of compressed data are assembled into data frames, each 18 groups of compressed data form a data frame, protocol fields are added to the heads of the data frames, encryption and scrambling processing are carried out on the data frames, the processed data frames are transmitted to a satellite communication channel through a Digital Signal Processor (DSP), the receiving end receives the data frames from the satellite communication channel, receives one frame every 60ms, splices the data frames into a complete voice data frame, descrambles and decrypts the voice data frame, decompresses each 5 bytes of decrypted data into 320 bytes of voice data, and plays the decompressed voice data.

title_en: Composite magnetic powder and wave absorbing material thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to composite magnetic powder and a wave-absorbing material thereof. The composite magnetic powder comprises a magnetic powder inner core, a heat-resistant layer wrapping the magnetic powder inner core and a hydrophobic layer wrapping the heat-resistant layer. The composite wave-absorbing material has good wave-absorbing performance in the frequency range of 2-18 GHz, and good high temperature resistance and corrosion resistance, and can meet the requirements of products on environmental adaptability and high attenuation of electromagnetic waves. According to the invention, the heat-resistant layer and the hydrophobic layer are coated on the magnetic powder inner core in a double-layer manner, so that the wave-absorbing performance, corrosion resistance and high temperature resistance of the wave-absorbing material can be enhanced.

title_en: Satellite telemetry monitoring and alarming method and system based on event-driven state machine
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ground measurement and control of spacecrafts, and particularly relates to a satellite telemetry monitoring and alarming method and system based on an event-driven state machine. The method comprises the steps of modeling the life cycle of a satellite planning arc section as an event-driven finite state machine, obtaining the planning time and corresponding latest telemetry data of a satellite to be monitored and a plan, generating a current event, routing the generated current event to a state processor corresponding to the current state of the satellite to be monitored, and simultaneously executing corresponding alarm operation by combining the current state of the satellite based on preset business logic responding to different events and completing state transition of the next state of the satellite. The invention builds an event-driven finite state machine model, abstracts the life cycle of a satellite planning arc into four states and three types of events, executes service logic through a state processor mode, and reconstructs the whole monitoring alarm logic through the states, the events and the actions.

title_en: Leaky-wave antenna and antenna system
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a leaky-wave antenna and an antenna system, and relates to the technical field of communication. The leaky-wave antenna comprises a first dielectric substrate, a first metal layer, a dielectric functional layer, a second metal layer and a second dielectric substrate, wherein the first metal layer comprises a first transmission line and a first radiation unit, a plurality of first gaps are distributed at intervals on the edge of one side, parallel to the length direction, of a first plasmon section of the first transmission line, and the plurality of first radiation units and the first gaps are located on the same side of the first transmission line. In the embodiment of the disclosure, based on the first plasmon segment included in the first transmission line, the binding capacity of electromagnetic signals can be improved, the radiation of the electromagnetic signals is reduced, so that the transmission efficiency of the electromagnetic signals is ensured, meanwhile, the small-size setting of the leaky-wave antenna is convenient to realize, in addition, the antenna signals are radiated outwards by the first radiation unit, and the high gain of the antenna signals can be ensured on the basis that the first transmission line has higher transmission efficiency.

title_en: Small-sized vertical large-aperture spotlight antenna applied to full frequency band and practical application method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a small vertical large-aperture angle spotlight antenna applied to a full frequency band and an actual application method, which are characterized in that the spotlight antenna comprises a spotlight-type outer cover, the outer cover is fixed through a bracket, an auxiliary supporting component is arranged on the back of the outer cover and used for reinforcing and fixing, angle indication numerals are engraved on the side face of the outer cover and used for accurately adjusting pitch angles, a reflecting plate is arranged in the outer cover, a low-frequency vibrator group, a medium-frequency vibrator group, a high-frequency vibrator group, a coupling piece, a separation strip and a power divider and a combiner are arranged on the back of the reflecting plate, the low-frequency vibrator group, the medium-frequency vibrator group and the high-frequency vibrator group are mutually matched to realize full coverage of 2G, 3G, 4G and 5G frequency bands, in order to realize the purpose of realizing the vertical large-aperture angle, the low-frequency vibrator group, the medium-frequency vibrator group and the high-frequency vibrator group are arrayed in a horizontal mode, so that horizontal half-power wave beam width is restrained, half-power wave beams in the vertical direction are not affected, in order to reduce the size of the outer cover, and the generation cost is reduced, and the low-frequency vibrator and the medium-frequency vibrator are arranged in a nested mode.

title_en: Prediction of overlap with measurement reports
abstract_en: Example embodiments of the present disclosure relate to methods, apparatus, devices, and computer-readable storage media for prediction overlapping measurement reports. In one method, a first device receives a configuration of at least one prediction time window from a second device for generating predicted results from a model. The first apparatus determines, based on the configuration, a period of time during which the at least one prediction time window overlaps with the at least one observation time window for the measurement associated with the prediction. The first device transmits to the second device at least one report of measurements obtained over the time period and at least one result of predictions generated from the model over the time period.

title_en: Temperature control method, temperature control device, electronic device, storage medium, and program product
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a temperature control method, apparatus, electronic device, storage medium, and program product. The method comprises the steps of detecting user behavior of a user on system resources of the terminal equipment under the condition that the actual temperature of the terminal equipment is larger than a first temperature threshold value, and reducing the value of the system resources at least under the condition that the user behavior is not detected, so that the actual temperature of the terminal equipment after the value of the system resources is reduced is smaller than the actual temperature before the value of the system resources is reduced. Therefore, under the condition that the user behavior and the actual temperature are considered, the value of the system resource is reduced, the terminal equipment can be cooled, the use experience of the user is improved, the adverse effect of high temperature on the terminal equipment is avoided, and low-temperature scalding is avoided.

title_en: Electronic apparatus and control method thereof
abstract_en: The disclosure provides electronic equipment and a control method thereof, wherein the electronic equipment comprises the steps of collecting temperature differences between the inside and the outside of a camera cavity and ambient humidity when the electronic equipment operates, determining a fogging critical temperature corresponding to the ambient humidity according to a pre-established mapping relation, reducing the operating power consumption of the electronic equipment under the condition that the temperature difference reaches the fogging critical temperature, judging whether the fogging problem occurs in the camera DECO through detecting the temperature inside and outside the camera DECO, and eliminating or relieving the fogging problem by executing software operation under the condition that the fogging problem occurs, so that the user experience is prevented from being influenced by the fogging phenomenon.

title_en: Multilayer RIS beam forming optimization method integrating different composition and liquid neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multilayer RIS beam forming optimization method integrating different patterns and a liquid neural network, belonging to the wireless communication channel optimization technology. The optimization method comprises the steps of establishing a kinematic model of a base station vehicle and a user side, establishing a base station vehicle-user far-field channel model and a user side multi-layer RIS near-field channel model, establishing a fusion model and a loss function thereof, extracting joint characteristics of a base station vehicle transmitting beam, RIS phase shifts of each layer and a user side combining matrix by using the fusion model, and performing collaborative optimization. According to the invention, a fusion model is constructed by combining the heterogeneous graph neural network and the liquid neural network, so that an end-to-end differentiable learning frame is obtained, the emitting beam of the parameterized base station, the phase shift of each layer of RIS and the user merging matrix are combined and optimized, and in the back propagation, the beam forming with low delay and high precision can be realized in a multi-user high-dynamic scene according to the maximization of the frequency spectrum efficiency and the automatic updating of the power, interference and hardware constraint.

title_en: Automatic communication test method and device for radar module and application terminal
abstract_en: The application provides a radar module automatic communication test method, a device and an application terminal; the automatic communication testing method for the radar modules comprises the steps of setting any radar module to be tested as a transmitting end through an application program after the radar module to be tested is powered on, setting other radar modules as receiving ends, responding to a testing instruction of the application program to conduct communication testing on the radar modules, displaying a testing state of the receiving ends based on a lighting state of the lamp, and simultaneously displaying and counting the testing state of the receiving ends in real time through the application program to obtain a testing result. The application greatly reduces manual intervention, improves test efficiency, intuitively displays the states of the transmitting end and the receiving end by utilizing the on-off state of the lamp, and enables a tester to directly observe the test result, so that the test result is clearer and the work difficulty of the tester is reduced.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for realizing virtual wireless controller system
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for realizing a virtual wireless controller system, which relate to the technical field of communication, and the method comprises the steps of acquiring a unique system identifier of a first virtual machine system; the method comprises the steps of generating a unique device identifier and a unique serial number of a first virtual wireless controller system based on a unique system identifier, generating a license request file based on the unique system identifier, the unique device identifier, the unique serial number and a globally unique request identifier, checking the encrypted license file in response to receiving the encrypted license file generated based on the license request file, and setting an authorization state of the virtual wireless controller system to be valid if the encrypted license file is successfully checked, so that the virtual wireless controller system can normally provide wireless network management services. The method effectively solves the security problems that the existing virtualization scheme is easy to illegally copy, and the admission control is difficult.

title_en: Communication method and related product
abstract_en: The application discloses a communication method and related products. The method comprises the steps that network equipment sends first information, the first information is associated with the number K of frequency domain sub-bands corresponding to a first time domain unit, the frequency domain sub-bands comprise at least one resource block RB, the K frequency domain sub-bands are discontinuous in the frequency domain, K is an integer larger than 1, and terminal equipment receives the first information and sends pilot signals in the K frequency domain sub-bands. By adopting the method provided by the embodiment of the application, when the channel measurement is carried out based on SRS (sounding reference signal) transmitted by frequency hopping on a plurality of frequency domain sub-bands, the interpolation channel estimation accuracy of the rest unmeasured sub-bands is improved, and the performance of the channel measurement is further improved.

title_en: Communication method and device
abstract_en: A communication method and device relate to the technical field of communication. In the method, under a CJT scene, a terminal acquires information of a first sub-band of phase deviation to be fed back, and then sends first information, wherein the first information is used for indicating the phase deviation of the first sub-band, the phase deviation of the first sub-band is obtained according to I CSI-RS ports corresponding to a first antenna port, and I is an integer larger than 1. Therefore, the phase deviation reporting of the sub-band level can be realized, and the accuracy of reciprocity correction is improved.

title_en: Replaceable device, replaceable chip and data transmission method
abstract_en: The application provides a replaceable device, a replaceable chip and a data transmission method thereof, and relates to the technical field of imaging. The data transmission method comprises the steps that firstly, a replaceable chip receives a target command of an imaging device, wherein the target command is used for encoding data by an RS encoder and a CRC code, the target command is used for detecting the data integrity by the CRC code, and if the detection determines that the data integrity is detected to be wrong, the RS encoding is used for correcting the error. And returning CRC code data detection to re-detect the data integrity after the RS coding error correction is finished, and resetting the command when the target command fails to verify or the same command fails to correct at least twice. And finally, returning a CRC (cyclic redundancy check) code integrity detection result as an error when the same command error correction failure of the target command is RS coding error correction. By the technical scheme, the communication time cost is saved, the integrity and the correctness of data transmission can be ensured to a certain extent, and the reliability of the data transmission is improved.

title_en: Communication equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses communication equipment which at least comprises a photovoltaic base station knapsack, wherein the photovoltaic base station knapsack comprises a communication base station module, a photovoltaic module, an energy storage module and a voltage conversion module, the voltage conversion module comprises a power input end and a power output end, the voltage conversion module is respectively and electrically connected with the energy storage module and the communication base station module, the voltage conversion module receives a photovoltaic electric signal from the photovoltaic module when the power input end is electrically connected with the photovoltaic module, and the voltage conversion module receives a network side electric signal from an adapter when the power input end is electrically connected with the adapter. The technical scheme of the invention can improve the use reliability and endurance stability of the communication equipment.

title_en: Time synchronization system, method and vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to a time synchronization system, a time synchronization method and a vehicle, and relates to the technical field of time synchronization. The first controller transmits a calibration timestamp to the second controller and the first display device as a first master clock within the time synchronization system. The calibration time stamp is used to calibrate the time of the second controller and the first display device. The second controller adjusts the frequency of its own clock source based on the calibration time stamp so that its own time is synchronized with the time of the first controller. The second controller transmits time synchronization information to the second display device as a second master clock within the time synchronization system to calibrate the time of the second display device. And constructing a double-layer time domain structure through the first master clock and the second master clock, providing a unified time reference for display equipment in a time synchronization system, and realizing time unification of the display equipment among networks.

title_en: Error correction and recovery in an optical communication system with a low power light source device
abstract_en: The first communication device receives a set of bits for transmission over a plurality of channels of an optical communication link. The optical communication link includes a greater number of lanes than is required to support transmission at a particular clock rate to provide the maximum speed supported by the optical communication link. The first communication device multiplexes the sets of data bits for transmission over the corresponding channels and transmits the multiplexed sets of bits over the channels to the second communication device. The first communication device uses a greater number of lanes to transmit error correction code bits and/or uses a greater number of lanes to provide one or more redundant lanes in the optical communication link in addition to transmitting the set of bits at a particular clock rate over the plurality of lanes at a maximum speed supported by the optical communication link.

title_en: Terahertz phased array secondary sub-array sub-banding dispersion compensation design method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a terahertz phased array secondary sub-array sub-banding dispersion compensation design method which comprises the following steps of 1, constructing primary sub-array units and sub-band bandwidths of a terahertz phased array system, 2, constructing secondary sub-arrays and sub-banding decision variable constraint conditions, 3, constructing secondary sub-arrays and digital sub-banding decision variable groups, 4, determining phased array beam quality optimization target parameters according to terahertz phased array application requirements, 5, jointly optimizing and solving secondary sub-arrays and sub-banding topological structures, and 6, calculating and compensating an optimized phase compensation parameter set. Compared with the existing uniform division or single compensation mode, the sub-array and sub-band of the invention have smaller scale, the space three-dimensional layout is easier to realize, the time dispersion and the space dispersion of the broadband large-scale terahertz phased array system are eliminated to a certain extent, and the precise high-quality pointing of the terahertz wave beam is realized.

title_en: BD-RIS-based assisted satellite RSMA system security performance improving method
abstract_en: The application relates to a BD-RIS-based assisted satellite RSMA system security performance improving method. According to the cascade channel coefficients from the satellite to the legal user and the illegal node, decomposing the information to be transmitted into public stream and private stream by using RSMA technology, calculating the received signal-to-noise ratio of the two parties, and further obtaining the public stream and private stream communication rate of the legal user and the eavesdropping rate of an eavesdropper. And constructing an objective function at the rates, and combining a preset loss function to construct a BD-RIS reflection coefficient and satellite transmission beam forming vector optimization model. Solving by adopting a double-cycle PDD algorithm, resolving the problem by adopting a BCD method, processing non-convexity by SCA, and carrying out relaxation and projection on symmetrical unitary constraint of a reflection coefficient matrix to obtain an optimized vector and matrix. The method of the application calculates the safe transmission rate of the system and realizes the enhancement of the safety performance.

title_en: Communication method and related device
abstract_en: The communication method and the related device comprise the steps of receiving first indication information, wherein the first indication information is used for indicating a first precoding matrix, any row vector comprising non-zero elements related to data signal streams at least further comprises one non-zero element related to a first signal stream in the first precoding matrix, sending at least two signal streams on a first antenna port according to the first indication information, the at least two signal streams comprise one data signal stream and one first signal stream, and the first signal stream is used for reducing PAPR of the at least two signal streams. Thus, after the mapping of the first precoding matrix, at least one first signal stream is superimposed on the antenna port carrying any data signal stream. Further, the peak amplitude of the signal transmitted from any antenna port of the first communication device including the first antenna port is reduced, and the PAPR of the signal transmission is reduced, so that the problems of signal distortion, power backoff and the like affecting the communication performance are effectively avoided.

title_en: Data entry comparison device
abstract_en: The invention provides a data input comparison device, which relates to the technical field of manufacturing cost comparison devices and comprises a fixing part, a surface fixing part and a leveling part, wherein the surface fixing part is arranged in the fixing part, the leveling part is arranged in the fixing part, the shielding part is arranged above the surface fixing part, and the fixing frame is fixed on a mounting frame, so that the fixing frame is kept stable and is convenient to restrain a connecting frame and further convenient to adjust, the leveling frame is convenient to move downwards, the cylindrical roller at the bottom is contacted with a manufacturing cost table, a surface placing plate is used for processing the manufacturing cost table through the cylindrical roller in the moving process, and meanwhile, the pressing table is matched with the pressing table frame to press the manufacturing cost table, so that the manufacturing cost table is convenient to use, and the problems that the conventional input comparison device is usually kept stable in a pressing mode, but the manufacturing cost table is made of paper, so that wrinkles are easy to occur after the conventional input comparison device is used for a long time, and the input cost table is influenced due to uneven surface.

title_en: RDSS bidirectional zero value automatic calibration method, device, receiver and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an RDSS bidirectional zero value automatic calibration method, an RDSS bidirectional zero value automatic calibration device, a receiver and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of determining zero value adjustment quantity according to the change of a test standard position point and continuous at least two positioning errors, so that a bidirectional zero value gradually converges to a calibration value meeting a preset convergence condition in the closed loop iterative adjustment and positioning verification process, and the calibration value is stored for subsequent positioning of a receiver, thereby solving the problems that manual parameter adjustment is needed, calibration efficiency is low, and positioning errors are difficult to stably converge under the conditions of radio frequency link parameter change, installation, inventory, address transfer and the like in the prior art.

title_en: Debugging equipment and method for cavity filter
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of filters, and discloses a debugging device and a debugging method of a cavity filter, wherein the debugging device comprises a frame, a feeding conveyer belt is movably arranged at the left position on the frame, a discharging conveyer belt is movably arranged at the front position on the frame, the feeding conveyer belt and the discharging conveyer belt are both used for conveying filter elements, the upper end of the filter element is provided with a plurality of groups of adjusting screws inserted into the inner cavity of the filter element, one side of the frame, which is far away from the discharging conveyor belt, is provided with a traction base, the end part of the traction arm is vertically provided with a telescopic cylinder, the inside of the telescopic cylinder is downwards movably provided with a telescopic rod, and the lower end of the telescopic rod is connected with a circular debugging table. The lifting seat enters the shielding cavity of the shielding interference box by leaving the lifting groove, and the bottom of the shielding cavity is blocked by the lifting seat, so that omnibearing electromagnetic shielding is realized, the shielding interference box is used for blocking external electromagnetic interference, and the accuracy of capacitive coupling is obviously improved during debugging.

title_en: Method, apparatus, medium, electronic device and program product for selecting antenna
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method, apparatus, medium, electronic device, and program product for selecting an antenna. The method comprises the steps of determining a target antenna with optimal receiving performance from a plurality of antennas of receiving end equipment when receiving antenna performance detection signals, wherein the time interval between the ending time of receiving the antenna performance detection signals and the starting time of receiving effective transmission signals is smaller than or equal to a preset value, the preset value is larger than or equal to 0, the effective transmission signals are effective communication data between transmitting end equipment for transmitting the antenna performance detection signals and the receiving end equipment, and the effective transmission signals are received through the target antenna. Therefore, the antenna with the optimal performance can be selected in real time, so that the antenna with the optimal performance can be utilized to receive signals in time, the efficiency of selecting the antenna is improved, and the communication quality is improved.

title_en: Curved surface polarization torsion reflecting surface and antenna using same
abstract_en: The invention provides a curved surface polarization torsion reflecting surface and an antenna using the same, and belongs to the technical field of antennas. The curved surface polarization torsion reflecting surface comprises a curved surface medium plate, a metal bottom plate and an electromagnetic super surface, wherein the metal bottom plate and the electromagnetic super surface are respectively arranged on the outer side and the inner side of the curved surface medium plate, and the electromagnetic super surface is formed by periodically arranging a plurality of single-layer electromagnetic super surface units. According to the invention, the single-layer super-surface unit with the polarization torsion function is conformal on the curved surface, so that the technical problems that the traditional multilayer plane polarization torsion structure is complex in processing, difficult to conformal on the curved surface and deteriorated in performance after conformal are solved. The reflecting surface is preferably a paraboloid, so that the incident wave polarization torsion is realized, and meanwhile, the spherical wave can be converted into a plane wave to improve the antenna gain. The super-surface unit keeps good cross polarization reflection performance in a wide incidence angle range of 0-40 degrees, is suitable for curved surface conformal design, can be integrally formed by 3D printing, and has simple and convenient processing and stable performance.

title_en: Cross-data center computing and optical network joint scheduling method and device for hybrid parallel training
abstract_en: The application provides a cross-data center computing and optical network joint scheduling method and equipment for hybrid parallel training, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining data parallel gradient synchronous traffic, computing time of each pipeline stage on a single micro batch, tensor parallel traffic and pipeline parallel traffic between adjacent stages by adopting a time model formula according to a model structure of a training task, hybrid parallel configuration and pipeline stage division; and (3) with the aim of minimizing the total time of single iteration, under the constraint of calculation and an optical network, determining the deployment position of the data center, the calculation resources and the optical network path and bandwidth of cross-data center communication of each pipeline stage by joint optimization so as to perform deployment and optical channel establishment. The method and the device can solve the problem of low training efficiency caused by mutual independence and lack of cooperation of calculation scheduling and optical network resource allocation in cross-data center training, realize cooperative optimization of calculation and optical network resources, effectively reduce training time delay and improve resource utilization efficiency.

title_en: Intelligent frequency agility method and system based on frequency spectrum cognition and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent frequency agility method and system based on frequency spectrum cognition and deep learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of generating a plurality of baseband linear frequency modulation signals with different center frequencies to obtain a broadband radio frequency linear frequency modulation signal set; the method comprises the steps of inputting signals into a digital phased array receiving channel simultaneously to obtain a plurality of paths of baseband data sets, carrying out integral multiple clock period delay on each signal data in the baseband data sets according to the real-time total delay of the receiving channel to obtain a delay linear frequency modulation signal set, determining the peak position of each data in a related peak data set according to the plurality of paths of baseband data sets and the delay linear frequency modulation signal set through a peak searching algorithm model to further calculate a phase difference set, and removing first-order linear components and direct-current components in the phase difference set by adopting a declivity algorithm to obtain a phase nonlinear set of the digital phased array receiving channel. The invention can realize nonlinear, efficient, accurate and low-cost measurement of the digital phased array receiving channel phase.

title_en: Method, equipment and medium for scheduling multilink traffic based on convergence and distribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, equipment and medium for multi-link flow scheduling based on convergence and distribution, which relate to the technical field of flow scheduling and comprise the steps of collecting access messages, merging flow clusters, counting total traffic and message quantity of the flow clusters, generating a service observation row and average message length, executing link light detection and interface counting, generating a link observation row, generating a normalized traffic sequence and a service discrimination threshold value, acquiring a service phase row, generating a bearing state quantity and a link discrimination threshold value, acquiring a link phase row, generating a phase conflict value sequence and a time limit bearing quantity sequence, forming a candidate link set, solving the synchronization completion moment, generating link traffic, generating the number of final continuous message blocks according to the candidate link set and the link traffic, combining the average message length and the message quantity, executing distribution transmission, enabling link selection and service distribution to be more targeted, and improving the consistency, the executable and the stability of multi-link flow scheduling.

title_en: Power supply network control system for optimizing power consumption of SS phased array
abstract_en: The application relates to a power supply network control system for optimizing power consumption of an SS phased array. The system comprises a management FPGA, a baseband processing unit, a control FPGA and a control FPGA, wherein the management FPGA receives an external power consumption management instruction, generates a mode switching signal and outputs the mode switching signal to the baseband processing unit to instruct the control FPGA to switch between a low power consumption silent mode and a normal working mode. The service FPGA acquires the radio frequency channel configuration requirement required by beam forming and respectively generates a first power supply enabling signal and a second power supply enabling signal aiming at a receiving channel and a transmitting channel, the radio frequency receiving power supply control unit independently controls the power supply on-off of each receiving channel according to the first enabling signal, and the radio frequency transmitting power supply control unit independently controls the power supply on-off of each transmitting channel according to the second enabling signal. When the baseband processing unit is switched back to the normal working mode from the low-power consumption silent mode, the stored configuration parameters and calibration data before switching are directly called to work continuously, and the service FPGA continuously maintains independent power supply control on each channel. The system can reduce power consumption and avoid phase ambiguity.

title_en: Source stirring reverberation room based on mechanical frequency conversion multi-polarization array antenna and stirring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a source stirring reverberation room based on a mechanical frequency conversion multi-polarization array antenna and a stirring method, and belongs to the technical field of electromagnetic compatibility testing. The source stirring reverberation room based on the mechanical variable frequency multi-polarization array antenna comprises a shielding shell, a receiving and transmitting system and a control system. Wherein, the shielding shell is provided with a closed test space. A transceiver system is disposed within the test space and includes a test antenna. The test antenna comprises at least two transmitting antennas and at least two receiving antennas, the same number of transmitting antennas are arranged on the three side walls, and each side wall is provided with a receiving antenna which is symmetrical with the transmitting antenna on the side wall about the geometric center of the receiving antenna. The control system is in signal connection with the receiving and transmitting system, calculates and controls the amplitude and the phase of the feed signal of the transmitting antenna according to a preset source mixing field regulation algorithm, can synthesize uniformly distributed random fields in a test space, and improves the electric field uniformity index of a test area in a low frequency band.

title_en: Communication method, electronic device, program product and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a communication method, electronic equipment, a program product and a storage medium, and the communication method, the electronic equipment, the program product and the storage medium are applied to the technical field of computers. The communication method of the embodiment of the application is applied to the first electronic equipment. The communication method comprises the steps of obtaining a message receiving state of a message sent by a second electronic device based on a power line carrier communication link, determining a packet loss rate of a next data transmission time slot of the power line carrier communication link according to the message receiving state, and determining a message sending mode of sending a new message in the next data transmission time slot according to the packet loss rate of the next data transmission time slot, wherein the message sending mode comprises the steps of sending a new message by using the power line carrier communication link, and sending the new message by using wireless link redundancy on the basis of sending the new message by using the power line carrier communication link. According to the method provided by the embodiment of the application, communication is realized on the basis of the power line carrier communication link, and on the basis of transmitting the new transmission message through the power line carrier communication link, the wireless link redundancy is used for transmitting the new transmission message, so that the success rate of transmitting the new transmission message can be improved on the premise of not additionally wiring, and the communication stability is ensured. And moreover, the occupation of wireless resources can be saved while the communication quality is ensured, the available bandwidth of users of the wireless resources is improved, and the user experience of wireless communication is improved.

title_en: Intelligent application identifier selection in near field communication systems
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to intelligent application identifier selection in near field communication systems. Example Near Field Communication (NFC) tag devices, NFC card emulation devices, and methods of initializing an NFC application protocol at an NFC communications listener are provided. An example NFC tag device includes one or more applications and an NFC transceiver. The one or more applications each include a unique application identifier. The NFC transceiver is configured to receive an application identifier polling command from the NFC reader, wherein the application identifier polling command includes a first application identifier, and to transmit a second application identifier corresponding to a supported application of the one or more applications.

title_en: Industry expansion and reporting processing system and method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a business expansion and reporting processing system and a business expansion and reporting processing method. The system comprises an electric energy meter component, a master station, an electric energy meter component and a master station, wherein the electric energy meter component is used for acquiring a user zone bit, uploading the user zone bit to the master station through a zone terminal component, the user zone bit has a binding relation with a user initiating an industry expansion and reporting request, the master station is used for acquiring an industry expansion and reporting work order corresponding to the user zone bit, issuing preset check information in the industry expansion and reporting work order to the electric energy meter component through the zone terminal component, and uploading the user zone bit and an electric energy meter identifier of the electric energy meter establishing the binding relation with the electric energy meter component to the master station through the zone terminal component under the condition that the preset check information passes the check, and the master station is used for completing information filling in the industry expansion and reporting work order based on the electric energy meter identifier. The scheme can realize automatic information input in the business expansion work order, and improves the accuracy and efficiency of information input.

title_en: MIMO detection device and receiving equipment
abstract_en: The present application relates to a MIMO detection apparatus and a reception device. The device comprises an LR module, an MMSE-SIC module and an LSD module, wherein the LR module is used for receiving a first channel matrix from a noise whitening device and decomposing the first channel matrix through an LLL algorithm to obtain a second channel matrix, the MMSE-SIC module is used for determining constellation point coordinate hard judgment points of transmitted data based on the second channel matrix and received data from the noise whitening device, the LSD module is used for determining first minimum Euclidean distance values under the condition that bits in the transmitted data are respectively in direct proportion and second minimum Euclidean distance values under the condition that bits in the transmitted data are respectively in inverse proportion through tree search calculation, and the LSD module is further used for determining log likelihood ratios of the transmitted data based on the first minimum Euclidean distance values and the second minimum Euclidean distance values. The receiving device comprises the apparatus.

title_en: High-frequency module and communication device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-frequency module and a communication device, which can improve shielding performance. A high-frequency module (100) is provided with a mounting substrate (9), an elastic wave filter (1), a metal block (3), a resin layer (5), and a shielding layer (6). The mounting board (9) has a first main surface (91) and a second main surface (92) that face each other, and has a ground layer (94). The elastic wave filter (1) is mounted on a first main surface (91) of a mounting board (9). The metal block (3) is disposed on a first main surface (91) of the mounting board (9) and is connected to a ground layer (94). The resin layer (5) is disposed on the first main surface (91) of the mounting substrate (9) and covers the outer peripheral surface (13) of the elastic wave filter (1) and the outer peripheral surface (33) of the metal block (3). The shielding layer (6) covers the resin layer (5), the metal block (3), and a main surface (12) on the side opposite to the mounting substrate (9) side in the elastic wave filter (1). The metal block (3) is in contact with the shielding layer (6).

title_en: Miniaturized positioning rescue machine with built-in antenna and production method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a miniaturized positioning rescue machine with an internal antenna and a production method thereof. Belongs to the technical field of emergency rescue. The method comprises the steps of carrying out integrated layout design on a circuit board of the positioning rescue machine to generate circuit board integrated layout data, designing a miniaturized printed antenna according to the circuit board integrated layout data, integrating the printed antenna on the surface of the circuit board to form a built-in antenna circuit board, and printing the antenna on the circuit board to form the built-in antenna, so that the integration degree of the positioning rescue machine is greatly improved, the size of equipment is greatly reduced, rescue workers or explorers can carry the equipment easily, and the mobility of actions is improved.

title_en: Communication system, physical layer key generation method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of communication, in particular to a communication system, a physical layer key generation method, a device, equipment and a medium, and aims to solve the problems of poor stability, low quality, high failure speed and low safety of generated keys. The physical layer key generation method comprises the steps of obtaining first channel state information of a communication channel of a first terminal and a second terminal at a current moment and second channel state information of a plurality of historical moments, extracting features based on the first channel state information and the second channel state information to obtain first features and second features, fusing the first features and the second features to obtain fused features, obtaining channel feature information of the communication channel based on the fused features, wherein the channel feature information comprises correlation, quantization bits and a quantization threshold, carrying out quantization processing on the channel feature information, generating a final key based on the channel feature information after the quantization processing, and effectively improving stability, quality and safety of the key.

title_en: Bionic composite metamaterial wave absorber
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wave absorbing materials, and provides a bionic composite metamaterial wave absorber, which comprises a plurality of periodically arranged structural units, wherein each structural unit comprises a metal backboard, a lower magnetic medium layer and an upper magnetic medium layer which are in a square thin plate shape and have the same side length and different thicknesses from bottom to top, a composite frequency selective surface layer is arranged between the lower magnetic medium layer and the upper magnetic medium layer, the lower magnetic medium layer and the upper magnetic medium layer are provided with the same hole arrays, each hole array comprises a central round hole and circular arc grooves positioned at four corners of the lower magnetic medium layer and the upper magnetic medium layer, each composite frequency selective surface layer comprises a PET substrate layer, a first resistance pattern layer and a second resistance pattern layer which are arranged on the PET substrate layer, the whole first resistance pattern layer is in a non-closed ring shape, and the second resistance pattern layer is arranged at the center of the first resistance pattern layer. The invention can realize ultra-wideband high-efficiency absorption of microwave frequency bands under ultra-thin thickness.

title_en: Positioning method of air-ground collaborative geological investigation system
abstract_en: A positioning method of an air-ground collaborative geological exploration system relates to the technical field of robot communication and navigation and comprises the following steps of monitoring satellite positioning signal quality and communication link state of a ground mobile carrier in real time, triggering the air carrier to fly above the ground mobile carrier and establishing a positioning enhancement link for relaying satellite positioning signals when the satellite positioning signal quality is lower than a preset threshold, adjusting the flight state of the air carrier if the ground mobile carrier recovers autonomous positioning capability through the positioning enhancement link, and enabling the ground mobile carrier to autonomously activate an independent beacon module and periodically send rescue detection signals to trigger air-ground collaborative search and rescue when the ground mobile carrier does not recover autonomous positioning capability through the positioning enhancement link and the communication link fails.

title_en: Detection device, communication equipment and communication system
abstract_en: The application provides a detection device, communication equipment and a communication system, relates to the technical field of communication, and aims to solve the problem of high detection difficulty of an antenna and an iron tower. The detection device comprises a detection component and a control circuit, wherein the detection component is used for detecting physical characteristic information of an iron tower and/or frequency spectrum information of an antenna arranged on the iron tower and generating detection signals, and the control circuit is used for transmitting the detection signals to an operation and maintenance network. According to the detection device provided by the application, the physical characteristic information of the iron tower can be effectively detected, and the frequency spectrum information of the antenna can be effectively detected, namely, the detection device provided by the application can automatically detect the frequency spectrum information and/or the physical characteristic information, so that the states of the antenna and/or the iron tower can be effectively detected, maintained and the like.

title_en: Method and device for data mapping
abstract_en: The application provides a data mapping method and equipment, which can realize the transmission of OTN frames in a PON system, thereby achieving the purposes of simplifying the mapping processing process, reducing the time delay and improving the system performance. The method includes mapping a first data frame to a first transmission frame, wherein the first transmission frame comprises an overhead area and a payload area, the first data frame is centrally arranged in the front part of the payload area, the rest part of the payload area is provided with a stuffing byte, the overhead area indicates the data amount of the first data frame carried in the payload area, and the first transmission frame is sent.

title_en: Built-in communication antenna device of wind-powered electricity generation bearing
abstract_en: The application relates to a built-in communication antenna device of a wind power bearing, which comprises a bearing arranged on a main shaft and a bearing seat arranged on the outer side of the bearing, wherein end covers are respectively arranged at the front end and the rear end of the bearing, an annular accommodating cavity is formed among the end covers, the bearing and the main shaft, a plurality of antennas are arranged in the annular accommodating cavity, a wireless communication device and a first induction coil are arranged in the antennas, the wireless communication device is in wireless communication connection with a remote monitoring system, the bearing comprises an inner ring, an outer ring and a plurality of intelligent rollers arranged between the outer ring and the inner ring, each intelligent roller comprises a second induction coil, a sensor module, a pose sensor and a battery, each sensor module comprises a temperature sensor, a load sensor and a first wireless communication module, each first wireless communication module is respectively connected with the temperature sensor, the load sensor and the pose sensor, and each first wireless communication module is in wireless communication connection with the wireless communication device. The application can wirelessly transmit the bearing data to a remote monitoring system.

title_en: Card holds in palm assembly and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to a card support assembly and electronic equipment, wherein the card support assembly comprises a card support body, a head assembly and a locking piece. The card support body is used for supporting a card, the head assembly is connected to the card support body, and the locking piece is used for locking the card support body or the head assembly on the shell in the thickness direction. The clamping support assembly and the electronic equipment provided by the embodiment of the application can lock the clamping support body or the head assembly and the shell in the thickness direction through the locking piece. Compared with the prior art, the card support assembly saves a larger space in the length direction or the width direction, and the locking piece can be arranged on the shell, can also be arranged on the head assembly or the card support body, and can be partially embedded or spliced in the thickness direction, so that the whole structure of the card support assembly is more compact, and the miniaturization of electronic equipment is facilitated.

title_en: Time synchronization method, apparatus, electronic device, storage medium, and computer program product
abstract_en: The application provides a time synchronization method, a device, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a computer program product, and relates to the technical field of network time synchronization, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving a synchronization message sent by a time server; the synchronous message comprises time data, wherein the time data is used for representing time delay in a communication path, and time synchronization is carried out based on the time data and a receiving time stamp aiming at the synchronous message. The scheme in the embodiment of the application can improve the network performance.

title_en: High-performance compact terahertz circular polarizer based on diagonal ridge integration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-performance compact terahertz circular polarizer based on diagonal ridge integration, relates to the technical field of terahertz passive devices, and solves the technical problems that the broadband performance of the existing terahertz circular polarizer is insufficient, an additional 45-degree transition structure is needed in the existing device, the system integration level is low, and discontinuity is easy to introduce. The square wave guide structure comprises a metal shell, square wave guides, first angular corrugated sections, second angular corrugated sections and the like, wherein a cavity is arranged in the metal shell, two ends of the cavity penetrate through the metal shell, square ridges are formed on two opposite edges along the length direction of the square wave guides by the square wave guides, the first angular corrugated sections are arranged on the square ridges, the second angular corrugated sections are arranged on the other two edges along the length direction of the square wave guides, and the first angular corrugated sections and the second angular corrugated sections are staggered in the length direction of the square wave guides.

title_en: Novel method for printing and tracing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel method for printing and tracing, and relates to the technical field of printing. According to the method, a standard color database is established, the high-precision image acquisition and analysis technology is combined, the color difference between a to-be-printed product and a standard color sample is compared in real time, and an ink adjustment scheme is generated based on an intelligent algorithm, so that quick and accurate printing and color following are realized. Compared with the traditional color-following mode relying on manual experience, the color-following method has the advantages that the color-following precision and efficiency are greatly improved, the labor cost is reduced, the waste of printing ink is reduced, the color-following method is suitable for various scenes such as package printing and book printing, and has higher practicability and popularization value.

title_en: Radio frequency switch and antenna substrate
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a radio frequency switch and an antenna substrate, and relates to the technical field of integrated circuits. The radio frequency switch comprises a substrate, a first metal layer, a second metal layer and a magnetic material layer, wherein the first metal layer is located on one side of the substrate, the second metal layer is located on one side, away from the substrate, of the first metal layer, at least part of the magnetic material layer is located on one side, away from the substrate, of the second metal layer, the first metal layer comprises a bottom electrode structure of an inductor, the second metal layer comprises a spiral structure of the inductor, and the magnetic material layer comprises a magnetic core structure of the inductor. The embodiment of the invention realizes the improvement of the inductance value and reduces the parasitic resistance and the occupied area.

title_en: Malicious audio-visual equipment detection method and system based on active signal excitation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting malicious audio-visual equipment based on active signal excitation, belonging to the technical field of information security and equipment detection; the method comprises the steps of collecting an environment electromagnetic signal, collecting an environment electromagnetic radiation signal in a target space to be detected, obtaining an original signal of an electronic device working state in the environment, processing the original signal to obtain a time domain signal and a frequency spectrum signal, extracting and tracking candidate signals, exciting an active physical signal, observing radiation signals in response to changes, judging whether malicious audio-visual equipment is present in the environment or not, and judging whether the malicious audio-visual equipment is present in the environment or not. By adopting the method, the working state of the malicious equipment is induced to change controllably by actively injecting the excitation signal into the environment to be detected, and whether the radiation response of the malicious equipment and the excitation signal show a strong correlation is monitored, so that the detection and confirmation of the malicious equipment are realized.

title_en: High performance codebook design
abstract_en: The technology disclosed herein relates to channel state information reporting in wireless networks. An example wireless communication method includes receiving, at a wireless device, a Reference Signal (RS) and Channel State Information (CSI) reporting configuration signaling for channel measurements from a network device, the wireless device determining CSI based on the RS and the CSI reporting configuration signaling, wherein the CSI includes a Precoding Matrix Indicator (PMI) indicating a v-layer precoding matrix for v transport layers, and transmitting the CSI from the wireless device to the network device.

title_en: Multi-band unmanned aerial vehicle cooperative interference time sequence control method based on AI self-adaption
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AI-based adaptive multi-band unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative interference time sequence control method in the field of an artificial intelligent computer system for reinforcement learning, which comprises the steps of obtaining multi-band frequency spectrum congestion environment state data and node action execution delay characteristics; the method comprises the steps of inputting data into an analysis module to extract a frequency band concurrent competitive pressure evaluation value, carrying out forward offset deduction and weighted summation of a time dimension on the evaluation value through a reinforcement learning scoring unit, outputting a future time slot collision probability calculation value with delay compensation, issuing a cooperative scheduling instruction and synchronously applying a countdown offset if the probability meets a safety threshold, and triggering degradation protection action for reducing state synchronous broadcasting frequency if the probability continuously exceeds an anti-collision upper limit. The invention overcomes the limitation of the traditional static heuristic rule on coping with state abrupt change hysteresis, solves the problem of radio frequency resource self-excitation collision caused by time slot instruction overlapping under a high dynamic airspace, and realizes space-time decoupling and cooperative gain of efficiency.

title_en: Communication control method and distributed antenna system
abstract_en: A communication control method is performed by a distributed antenna system that controls coherent transmission between a terminal that performs communication with a signal processing device or a higher-level signal processing device via a plurality of distributed antennas that cooperatively perform coherent transmission, and includes a step of estimating, for each of the plurality of distributed antennas, a propagation delay difference in the terminal between the signal processing device or the higher-level signal processing device and the terminal, or a propagation delay difference in the terminal between the signal processing device or the higher-level signal processing device and the terminal, based on the propagation delay between the signal processing device or the higher-level signal processing device and the propagation delay between the plurality of distributed antennas and the terminal, and a step of controlling a transmission time for each of the distributed antennas in such a manner that the propagation delay difference estimated for each of the distributed antennas is within an allowable delay difference.

title_en: Wireless device, first network node and method for failure processing performed by same

title_en: Communication method and device

The terminal transmits the second information. By adopting the method, the CSI feedback overhead can be reduced, and the CSI feedback efficiency is effectively improved.

title_en: Satellite communication transmission method and system based on secure network coding and inter-satellite cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a satellite communication transmission method and system based on secure network coding and inter-satellite cooperation, and belongs to the technical field of satellite communication. The method comprises the steps that a first satellite communication node obtains an original data stream to be sent, the original data stream is converted into a first sub-data stream and a second sub-data stream with relevance through a secure network coding algorithm, the first satellite communication node sends the first sub-data stream to a first ground receiving node through a first wireless link, the second sub-data stream is sent to a second satellite communication node through a secure link, the second satellite communication node sends the second sub-data stream to a second ground receiving node through a second wireless link after receiving the second sub-data stream, the received first sub-data stream and the received second sub-data stream are transmitted to a ground decoding center, and the ground decoding center recovers the original data stream according to inverse operation of the secure network coding algorithm.

title_en: OTFS multi-satellite channel estimation-oriented PCRB analysis and power optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PCRB analysis and power optimization method and system for OTFS multi-satellite channel estimation, which comprises the steps of constructing an OTFS signal-based pilot frequency and data superposition transmission model, constructing a pilot frequency observation covariance matrix based on multi-satellite LoS path correlation and data interference, constructing an observation Fisher information matrix based on PCRB, utilizing a spread spectrum pilot frequency derivative subspace to label an inverse matrix of the pilot frequency observation covariance matrix in the PCRB-based observation Fisher information matrix, constructing an equivalent observation Fisher information matrix for PCRB calculation and power optimization based on a standard quantification processing result, calculating PCRB according to the equivalent observation Fisher information matrix, constructing a throughput maximization-oriented power optimization problem based on the PCRB, and solving the throughput maximization-oriented power optimization problem to obtain an optimal power optimization scheme. The invention can obtain better balance between the channel estimation precision and the data transmission rate, and avoid the problems of channel estimation error increase and actual throughput reduction caused by simply increasing the data power.

title_en: Multi-device charging indicator lamp synchronous control method based on NTP time calibration

title_en: Optimal path planning method for satellite network

The invention ensures the optimal flow distribution of the business with different priorities through the quantitative evaluation of the link efficiency and the maximum flow calculation, and simultaneously supports the dynamic route update to adapt to the change of the link state.
