abstract_en: The utility model provides a fast locking SFP optical fiber module device, comprises a box bod, box body top and bottom all are provided with the screw hole, threaded hole is provided with the movable rod, the movable rod surface is provided with the screw thread, the inside fixed block that is provided with of box body, fixed block one side is connected with the iron sheet, iron sheet one side is provided with the sheet rubber, box body one side is provided with box body fiber-optical mouth, box body one side is provided with SFP optical fiber module socket, be provided with SFP optical fiber module in the SFP optical fiber module socket, SFP optical fiber module one side is provided with SFP optical fiber module fiber inlet, SFP optical fiber module one side is provided. The device for quickly locking the SFP optical fiber module not only greatly reduces the time required for locking the SFP optical fiber module, but also greatly reduces the cost.

title_en: Router with novel fixed leaded light post structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a router with novel fixed leaded light post structure, include: the router comprises a router body, a light guide column and a light guide column fixing piece; the lower part of the router body is provided with a PCB, and the PCB is provided with an LED lamp; the upper part of the router body is provided with an upper cover; the top of the upper cover is provided with a lamp hole; the upper cover is also provided with a buckle; the light guide column is fixed in the light guide column fixing piece; the light guide post fixing piece is provided with a bayonet; the light guide column fixing piece and the upper cover are detachably connected in a mode that the buckles are embedded into the bayonets, the top of the LED lamp is connected with the bottom of the light guide column fixed in the light guide column fixing piece, and the top of the light guide column fixed in the light guide column fixing piece is embedded into the lamp hole. This scheme has realized fixing the leaded light post in the router with the mode of joint between bayonet socket and the buckle, need not the energy such as electric power, has saved the energy, and simple to operate is swift, has improved the effect of installation, does benefit to and practices thrift the cost of labor, and the emission of no longer harmful gas is convenient for rework.

title_en: Testing device for simulating insertion loss capability of passive device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a testing arrangement for simulating passive device insertion loss ability, the device includes adjustable attenuator, first shunt, second shunt and a plurality of connectors and casing, wherein, adjustable attenuator, one end is connected with the main light end of first shunt, and the other end is connected with the main light end of second shunt; the adjustable attenuator, the first splitter and the second splitter are arranged in the shell, each light splitting end of the first splitter is respectively connected with the connectors on one side or outside one side of the shell, and each light splitting end of the second splitter is respectively connected with the connectors outside the other side of the shell. By the utility model, various products can be simulated, and a plurality of joints can be simulated; a plurality of different insertion loss values can be provided for testing, and the anti-series connection result can be achieved; the device not only can be used repeatedly, but also can restore the original parameters by adjusting the parameters when abrasion occurs.

title_en: Intelligent synchronous light curtain
abstract_en: This synchronous light curtain of intelligence relates to the light curtain field, can promote the ability of anti interference in the synchronous process of light curtain by a wide margin, and it includes two core part: one is a transmitter which comprises a power supply module, a state indicating module, a micro control processor, B light-emitting components and D external ports, wherein the value range of B is an integer set larger than 0, and the value range of D is an integer set larger than 0; the receiver comprises a power module, a state indicating module, a micro control processor, X receiving optical components and W external ports, wherein the value range of X is an integer set larger than 0, and the value range of W is an integer set larger than 0.

title_en: Mounting bracket for 5G communication antenna
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a 5G is installing support for communication antenna, including the support body fixing base, its characterized in that: connecting blocks are welded at the upper end and the lower end of one side of the frame body fixing seat, the two connecting blocks are hollow, sliding blocks are arranged at the two sides of each connecting block, the two sliding blocks are inserted from the two ends of each connecting block and are respectively embedded in the connecting blocks, through holes are formed in the upper side and the lower side of each of the two ends of each connecting block, the upper through hole and the lower through hole are positioned on the same vertical line, jacking bolts are arranged in the through holes, and corresponding arc-shaped connecting arms are welded on the two sliding blocks; the utility model discloses simple structure, the modern design not only can match the communication tower pylon of different thickness sizes, can also adjust the angle and the height of antenna, installation and regulation convenient and fast, be suitable for the occasion abundant.

title_en: Antenna structure and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides an antenna structure and electronic equipment, include: the method comprises the following steps: the IFA antenna is respectively connected with the feed point and the grounding point; the grounding point is connected with a reference ground; the reference ground length is greater than 0.8 antenna wavelengths. Antenna structure can improve the design of cell-phone antenna through the size of referring to ground, can make every frequency band performance best like this, also can let the cell-phone have good communication performance in the area of weak signal, improves user's experience.

title_en: Scenic spot bathroom intelligent control device
abstract_en: An intelligent control device for a scenic spot toilet comprises a toilet control terminal, wherein a signal output end of the toilet control terminal is in bidirectional signal connection with a signal input end of an LoRa base station, and a signal output end of the LoRa base station is in bidirectional signal connection with a signal input end of a background; the information is acquired in real time through the sensing module and is transmitted to the STM32 microcontroller, the information is processed through the STM32 microcontroller, the information is transmitted to a background system through the LoRa base station through the LoRa module and relevant data are stored, and background workers can remotely manage and control the toilet through monitoring data; meanwhile, tourists can also know information such as the position of the toilet, queuing conditions and the like through the mobile phone terminal, so that shunting used by the toilet in the scenic spot can be realized; the utility model has the advantages of simple structure, convenient operation, intelligence efficient.

title_en: Modular frequency synthesis multichannel receiving assembly
abstract_en: The utility model provides a modularized frequency synthesis multichannel receiving component, which comprises an internal component, a frequency synthesis module, a receiving module, a module and a power supply, wherein the frequency synthesis module and the receiving module are interconnected through a coaxial cable inlet wire; the external box body comprises a shell, a plurality of accommodating spaces are arranged in the shell, and a first accommodating box, a second accommodating box and a third accommodating box are arranged in the accommodating spaces; the units with different functions are designed into independent modules, so that the test and problem investigation are facilitated, the appearance of the module is simple, and the laser sealing welding is facilitated.

title_en: Mobile phone cover plate convenient to disassemble and assemble
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cell-phone apron convenient to dismouting, including cell-phone body, enclosing cover and inner cup, earlier fix an enclosing cover on the cell-phone body through two first fixed screws, pass through the mounting groove that the mounting panel inserted in the enclosing cover with the inner cup again, make one side of enclosing cover and one side of inner cup laminate mutually, be connected another enclosing cover and cell-phone body again, at last rethread second fixed screw is connected the enclosing cover with the inner cup, constitutes a whole. The utility model has the advantages that the outer cover, the inner cover, the first fixing screw and the second fixing screw are arranged, so that the mobile phone cover plate can be conveniently disassembled and assembled, and meanwhile, the integrated arrangement also ensures the effective protection of the mobile phone body; through the setting on rubber layer, strengthening layer and tempering layer, improved the intensity of being struck of cell-phone body, buffer spring and rubber pad's setting has improved the cell-phone and has better buffering effect when falling ground, reduces the impact force that the cell-phone received, strengthens the crashproof ability of cell-phone, prolongs its life.

title_en: Computer network safety controller
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a computer network safety controller, the utility model relates to a computer network technical field, including controller body and box, the controller body is located the inside of box, the controller body passes through the supporting shoe and fixes mutually with the box, the one end of box is fixed with the fan, the other end of box is fixed with the drying cabinet, the top of box is fixed with the water tank, the interior bottom of water tank is fixed with the gas case that looses, the gas pocket that looses has been seted up at the top of gas case that looses, the air current output of fan communicates mutually with the gas case that looses through the air duct, the air current input of fan is linked together with the tip of box. The utility model discloses simple structure has increased the peripheral air mobility of controller body, plays to the controller body and accelerates radiating effect, also prevents that the dust in the outside air from getting into the box, avoids the dust to cover on the controller body and influence the heat dissipation, also has good dustproof effect.

title_en: Antenna capable of being directly connected with terminal equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an antenna that can lug connection terminal equipment relates to antenna technical field, need be connected with the help of corresponding switching equipment when being connected with terminal equipment for solving the antenna, and the antenna can not directly be connected with terminal equipment, and the time greatly increased that consumes when carrying out the antenna installation, and the multi-functional regulation degree of difficulty of current antenna is great, can not carry out the problem of corresponding regulation according to the user demand. The inside of antenna pedestal is provided with rotates the groove, the top of antenna pedestal is provided with first antenna mast, two the top of first antenna mast all is provided with the second antenna mast, the upper end of second antenna mast is provided with the receiving head, the inside of antenna pedestal is provided with accomodates the groove, the inside of accomodating the groove is provided with the connector, the lower extreme of antenna pedestal is provided with the spout, the below of connector is provided with the threaded rod, the below of antenna pedestal is provided with second locking cap.

title_en: Equipment remote diagnosis system based on handheld terminal
abstract_en: A remote equipment diagnosis system based on a handheld terminal comprises cloud server resource equipment, handheld terminal equipment and fault equipment with an electronic tag; the handheld terminal equipment is connected with the cloud server resource equipment through a wireless communication circuit and a mobile network; the fault equipment is provided with an electronic tag, and the handheld terminal equipment uploads the collected fault information on the field equipment to the cloud server resource equipment; the cloud server resource equipment sends the fault information to the same handheld terminal in the remote expert through the network, and the remote expert analyzes and diagnoses the received information data and can also interact the data information with the field terminal through the cloud server resource equipment; the utility model discloses set up a technical bridge for long-range expert and on-the-spot fault equipment, be convenient for realize the long-range diagnosis of equipment.

title_en: Built-in cell-phone shell of hiding structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a built-in cell-phone shell of hiding structure, including cell-phone shell backplate, cell-phone shell top shell, silence regulation hole, sound control cover, louvre, cell-phone shell drain pan, antislip strip, switch cover, camera mounting hole, power charging hole, rope sling fixed orifices and lifting hole, cell-phone shell backplate one side bonds there is the cell-phone shell top shell, cell-phone shell top shell bottom bonds there is the cell-phone shell drain pan, and cell-phone shell drain pan one side is connected with the cell-phone shell backplate, cell-phone shell drain pan bottom both sides all bond there is the antislip strip, cell-phone shell drain pan bottom center department has seted up the power charging hole, cell-phone shell drain pan bottom is located center department both sides and has all seted up a plurality of lifting hole, and this cell-phone shell simple structure, cell-phone shell backplate, cell-phone shell top shell and cell-phone shell drain pan adopt three limit designs, if carelessly fall to be difficult to warp on the ground, and warp can, The angle and the shape of the top shell of the mobile phone shell and the bottom shell of the mobile phone shell are favorable for a user to use.

title_en: Multifunctional wall socket
abstract_en: A multifunctional wall socket relates to the technical field of charging sockets. It includes: the PCB board comprises a bottom shell, a panel assembled on the bottom shell, and a PCB board arranged in the bottom shell and the panel; a mains supply socket is formed in one side of the front face of the panel; the other side of the front side of the panel is provided with a mobile phone bracket with a support at the lower part; and a wireless charging device electrically connected with the PCB is arranged in the mobile phone support. By adopting the technical scheme, on the basis of keeping the commercial power supply socket, the mobile phone can be wirelessly charged, and the mobile phone can also serve as a mobile phone support.

title_en: End-fire antenna and intelligent terminal
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an end-fire antenna and intelligent terminal, through the first surface at the dielectric layer, first radiation layer has been laid along the first direction, the first side of the first feeder fragment on first radiation layer is provided with at least one first fan-shaped radiating element, and on the second surface of dielectric layer, second radiation layer has been laid along the second direction the same with the first direction, the second side of the second feeder fragment on second radiation layer is provided with at least one second fan-shaped radiating element, make the antenna radiate the energy away along the feeder fragment on radiation layer. Furthermore, by laying at least one director element at one end adjacent the first feeder segment and at one end adjacent the second feeder segment, respectively, the gain in the end-fire direction of the antenna, as well as the frequency operating range, is increased.

title_en: Portable digital 5G high-frequency signal detection and analysis system and analyzer thereof
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable digital 5G high frequency signal detection and analysis system, present the module including radio frequency module and control, radio frequency module include ultra wide band antenna, receiver, AD conversion module and FPGA module, control present the module including control mainboard and memory, this application still discloses the analysis appearance that corresponds, the analysis system and the analysis appearance that this application corresponds adopt digital transmission architecture, with signal receiver, AD converter, FPGA integrated circuit, control mainboard and memory integration inside the body, holistic small, light in weight, and digital architecture adopts the linux system kernel of open source, the secondary of being convenient for upgrades the development, and the suitability is strong, and suitable using widely, moreover, can realize 5G high frequency signal detection and analysis, the frequency sweep is fast, and detection range is wide.

title_en: Double-screen smart phone based on sliding closure type privacy protection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double screen smart mobile phone based on slide closure formula privacy protection, including smart mobile phone, main screen assembly and vice screen assembly, the slip protective sheath has been cup jointed to the surface of main screen assembly, there is the baffle one side of slip protective sheath through hinge swing joint, the bottom fixedly connected with dead lever of baffle, the fixed orifices has been seted up at the top of slip protective sheath, one side fixedly connected with mount pad of slip protective sheath, the inner wall swing joint of mount pad has clean pole. This two screen smart mobile phones based on sliding closure formula privacy protection, through the setting of slip protective sheath, can protect the main screen assembly of cell-phone, when sliding the main screen assembly, can drive the slip protective sheath and slide to play the guard action for the main screen assembly, through the setting of apron, can protect the main screen assembly not scraped the flower, also can prevent that information from being seen by others when not using simultaneously, protect the privacy.

title_en: Voice control module based on Bluetooth technology
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a voice control module based on bluetooth, including intelligent home gateway module and socket terminal, intelligent home gateway module includes networking module, controller and voice interaction module, and networking module electric connection has the server, and socket terminal passes through data connection module electric connection with intelligent home gateway module. This voice control module based on bluetooth, carry out data connection through setting up intelligent home gateway module and socket terminal through the bluetooth, and then control socket terminal through intelligent home gateway module, utilize the internally mounted protection module at socket terminal simultaneously, monitor the use of socket body through protection module, and give intelligent home gateway module with the timely transmission of overload alarm information, and then carry out voice alarm through the voice interaction module in the intelligent home gateway module, thereby have the characteristics of being convenient for use the socket safely through voice control module.

title_en: Be used for industrial automation 5G little basic station
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of base stations, in particular to a 5G small base station for industrial automation, which comprises a fixed bottom plate, wherein the upper side of the front side of the fixed bottom plate is bilaterally and symmetrically provided with a first fixing through hole, the lower side of the front side of the fixed bottom plate is bilaterally and symmetrically provided with a second fixing through hole, the front side of the fixed bottom plate is also bilaterally and symmetrically provided with a connecting seat at the lower side of the first fixing through hole, the connecting seat is internally provided with a connecting rod, the outer wall of the connecting rod is evenly provided with hanging hooks, the middle part of the front side of the fixed bottom plate is provided with a bearing seat, the left side of the front side of the bearing seat is provided with a first connecting bracket, the right side of the front side of the bearing seat is provided with a first connecting hook, the whole equipment has simple structure and convenient operation, and when, can save a large amount of time, in time maintain it, work efficiency is high.

title_en: Infrared RS485 and RS232 communication circuit that changes
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an infrared RS485 and RS232 communication circuit that changes, including infrared receiving module, infrared emission module, power supply circuit, RS485 communication chip and RS232 communication chip, power supply circuit is the communication circuit power supply, and infrared receiving module is connected to the direction pin of RS485 communication chip and the first input of RS232 communication chip respectively, and the receiving output of RS485 communication chip and the first output of RS232 communication chip are connected to through the AND gate infrared emission module's input realizes that communication circuit can insert RS232 interface and RS485 interface simultaneously. And through setting up digital switch at infrared receiving module, disconnection infrared receiving module work when infrared emission module operating condition realizes half duplex communication.

title_en: Router convenient to antenna installation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a router convenient for antenna installation, which relates to the technical field of wireless network equipment and comprises an outer shell, clamping plates and antenna interfaces, wherein the antenna interfaces are installed outside the outer shell, the antenna interfaces are provided with six groups, two groups of clamping plates are installed outside each group of antenna interfaces, the clamping plates run through the outer shell, rubber pads are fixed outside the clamping plates, every two groups of rubber pads are arranged oppositely, the outer side of the antenna interfaces is provided with a ring groove, the ring groove is provided with six groups, two groups of stop blocks are fixed inside each group of ring grooves, and a sliding rod is installed above the ring groove. The operation is simple and convenient, and the installation efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Self-excitation detection device for digital wireless repeater
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a self-excitation detection device for a digital wireless repeater, which comprises a core logic processor, wherein the core logic processor comprises a signal amplitude calculation module, an amplitude detection module and a self-excitation judgment module; the signal amplitude calculation module is connected with an amplitude detection module, and the amplitude detection module is connected with a self-excitation judgment module; the signal amplitude calculation module is used for calculating the absolute amplitude value of the digit by an amplitude approximate calculation method; the amplitude detection module is used for comparing the absolute amplitude value calculated by the signal amplitude calculation module with a detection threshold, deburring a comparison result and transmitting the processed comparison result to the self-excitation judgment module. The utility model discloses the auto-excitation condition that can real-time effectual detection digital wireless repeater carries out the automatic adjustment of gain to digital wireless repeater according to the auto-excitation condition.

title_en: Electromagnetic interference prevention device for 5G signal base station
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for a base station technical field provides a 5G signal base station electromagnetic interference resistance device, including signal subassembly and shielding subassembly, the signal subassembly includes bottom plate and base station main part, the base station main part is fixed in the bottom plate upper surface, the shielding subassembly includes first shield plate, second shield plate and carousel, the second shield plate is acceptd in first shield plate, the bottom fixed connection of first shield plate is in the bottom plate; through setting up first shield plate, second shield plate and carousel, at the in-process that uses, utilize first shield plate and second shield plate to set up around the basic station main part, utilize first shield plate to electromagnetic wave shielding, and, still can take out the inside of second shield plate from first shield plate when needs, increase the cage cover scope to the basic station main part, and further increase the shielding dynamics to the electromagnetism, avoid the in-process electromagnetic interference's that the basic station main part is using problem to appear, reduce the troublesome production of unnecessary.

title_en: Separation shock-resistant foam gasket assembly for mobile phone
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a foam cotton gasket component for a separation and shock resistance mobile phone, which comprises an upper gasket and a lower gasket, wherein the upper gasket is provided with a first containing groove with an opening at the bottom, a plurality of first foam cotton gaskets are distributed in the first containing groove in an array manner, and the bottom of the upper gasket is provided with a buffer component; the lower gasket is arranged under the upper gasket, a second containing groove with an opening at the top is formed in the lower gasket, a plurality of second foam pads corresponding to the first foam pads are arranged in the second containing groove, and the top surface of the lower gasket is matched with the buffer assembly, so that the buffer effect of the gasket assembly can be improved.

title_en: Dual-polarized filtering patch antenna with high selective radiation efficiency
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dual-polarized filtering patch antenna with high selective radiation efficiency, which comprises a metal reflection floor, a first feeder line unit, a second feeder line unit, a driving patch unit and a parasitic patch unit which are arranged from bottom to top in sequence; the metal reflection floor keeps a distance from the driving patch unit, the driving patch unit and the parasitic patch unit to form an air layer; the first feeder unit and the second feeder unit are respectively provided with an input port, the two input ports are connected with the metal reflection floor through metal columns, and the coupling between the input ports and the driving patch is adjusted by adjusting the height of the metal columns, so that the bandwidth of the antenna is changed; a slot line is arranged on a driving patch of the driving patch unit and used for introducing a resonance mode to expand bandwidth and radiation zero; the parasitic patch of the parasitic patch unit is provided with a cross-shaped slot line for adjusting the bandwidth and the position of a radiation zero point; the utility model discloses need not extra filter circuit and realize the filtering effect promptly, possess high selectivity radiation efficiency.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle data link transmission quality test equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle data link transmission quality test equipment, including portable computer and the asynchronous serial module, synchronous serial module, optical communication module, video acquisition coding module, ethernet communication module and the high accuracy timer of being connected with portable computer, optical communication module includes optical communication module 1 and optical communication module 2, ethernet communication module includes network communication module 1 and network communication module 2, network communication module 1 and optical communication module 1 connect, network communication module 2 and optical communication module 2 connect. The utility model integrates a plurality of common information interaction interfaces, and can simulate the receiving and the forwarding of a plurality of interface data; the utility model discloses can be simultaneously through multiple interface connection unmanned aerial vehicle, the real condition of simulation carries out the test of unmanned aerial vehicle link interface.

title_en: Flash lamp decoration
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flash light decoration, including the mounting panel, the mounting groove has been seted up in the left side of mounting panel, first mounting hole has been seted up at the top on mounting panel right side, first mounting hole runs through the mounting panel and extends to the left side of mounting panel, the second mounting hole has been seted up to the bottom on mounting panel right side, the second mounting hole runs through the mounting panel and extends to the left side of mounting panel, fixedly connected with astigmatic lens in the first mounting hole, fixedly connected with condensing lens in the second mounting hole, the inside rotation of mounting groove is connected with apart from adjustment mechanism, the utility model relates to a cell-phone accessory technical field. This flash light decoration adjusts the distance between two sliders, drives the installation piece motion through the connecting rod, adjusts the distance between installation piece and the fixed block, and then adjusts the distance between astigmatic lens and condensing lens and the light filling lamp, can effectively improve the light filling effect of light filling lamp, improves the final imaging quality of shooting.

title_en: Magnetic antenna
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a magnetic antenna, this magnetic antenna include casing and metal bar magnet, and the metal bar magnet is fixed in on the internal face of casing, the internal face is equipped with anti eddy current structure, and anti eddy current structure includes many arc archs, and many arc archs are the equidistant concentric circles of non-and distribute, and the scope of anti eddy current structure covers the metal bar magnet. The utility model discloses a magnetism antenna is through setting up above-mentioned anti vortex structure on the inner wall of casing, because the interval inequality between two adjacent arc archs is favorable to abolishing the disturbance of magnetic line of force law, consequently can play the effect that the dispersion was dredged to the magnetic line of force vortex to effectively eliminate the vortex of magnetic line of force, avoid the interference of magnetic line of force vortex to antenna signal, many arc archs can structurally increase the whole antitorque nature and the shock resistance of casing simultaneously.

title_en: Wearable wireless temperature measuring device for pigs
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wearable pig is with wireless temperature measuring device, including wearable main part in pig side belly, install temperature measurement module in the main part, temperature measurement module includes microprocessor and the temperature probe who is connected with microprocessor, power module and piezoelectric module, microprocessor adopts CC2538 radio frequency chip, crouches to realize giving the pig temperature measurement for piezoelectric module pressure opening device through the pig side. The utility model discloses a wearable main part on one's body at the pig realizes installing temperature measuring device on one's body the pig, can not cause the injury to the pig, forms pressure for the belly when rethreading the pig rest and starts the temperature measuring device temperature measurement, lets temperature probe can hug closely at pig skin, realizes the precision temperature measurement.

title_en: Novel panel antenna structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel panel antenna structure includes the panel antenna body, the bottom fixedly connected with stopper of panel antenna body, first spacing groove has been seted up to the bottom of stopper. The utility model discloses a establish the surface at the bracing piece with stopper and fixture block cover, then rotate the commentaries on classics piece, it is rotatory that the commentaries on classics piece drives the bull stick, the bull stick drives second cardboard rebound, the second cardboard passes through the supporting shoe and drives the surface contact of fixture block rebound and bracing piece, and make the bracing piece card go into the inside of first spacing groove and second spacing groove and press from both sides tightly fixedly, dismantle the reverse above-mentioned operation of panel antenna body at last as required can, thereby the advantage of the dismouting panel antenna of being convenient for has been possessed, the mounting structure who has solved current panel antenna mostly screws through nut and U type snap ring and fixes on the surface of bracing piece, this just leads to the user very inconvenient when the installation or dismantle, influence the problem of panel antenna dismouting efficiency.

title_en: Dual-band WiFi antenna
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dual-frenquency wiFi antenna, through setting up floor and wiFi antenna, because two radiation oscillator pairs are all printed on the floor, the user can set up RF circuit and wiFi antenna connection on the floor, makes it become wireless wiFi module, because wiFi antenna and floor are integrated into one piece structure, compare in board carried antenna or external antenna, its data throughput is better; in addition, as the ground is arranged between the two radiation oscillator pairs, and the number of the ground is two, the isolation of the dual-frequency WiFi antenna can be greatly improved, and the two radiation oscillator pairs are prevented from interfering with each other when receiving and transmitting signals; moreover, the feed-in radiation oscillator is in a sickle shape, so that the voltage standing wave ratio and the radiation power of the dual-frequency WiFi antenna can be greatly improved.

title_en: Mobile communication antenna device meeting MIMO (multiple input multiple output)
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a satisfy MIMO's mobile communication antenna device, be in including box body, setting PCBA, a plurality of 5G antenna in the box body, PCBA on have a plurality of 5G antenna installation regions that are used for setting up the 5G antenna, set up a 5G antenna in every 5G antenna installation region, adjacent two 5G antenna between the distance be greater than 70 mm. The utility model integrates a plurality of 5G antennas in one box body, has high integration and moderate volume, simplifies the arrangement difficulty and improves the arrangement flexibility; the vertical polarization gain effect of the 5G signal is good, the overall gain is improved, the antenna performance, particularly the isolation between the antennas, is ensured on the premise of saving space to the maximum extent, and double-antenna low-frequency MIMO (lower than 2.3 GHz) and four-antenna high-frequency MIMO (higher than 2.3 GHz) are achieved.

title_en: Shipborne VHF antenna multiplexing device and shipborne communication system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multiplexing device of on-board VHF antenna and on-board communication system belongs to navigation communication technology field. The utility model discloses a multiplexing device of on-board VHF antenna includes VHF radio incoming end, AIS receiving and dispatching incoming end and public antenna incoming end, VHF radio incoming end has connected gradually first coupler, first detector and first comparator, AIS receiving and dispatching incoming end has connected gradually the second coupler, second detector and second comparator, the input of first comparator and second comparator still is connected with digital analog converter, digital analog converter includes programmable memory, through writing into first level value and second level value in advance, after comparing in first comparator and second comparator, then through each radio frequency switch of logic device control. The utility model discloses a VHF antenna multiplexing device can solve the poor problem of input conduction threshold value uniformity that factors such as PCB board material, production technology, device error lead to, promotes the redundancy and the reliability on the quality of product design.

title_en: Tripod support structure of portable antenna
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the antenna boom, in particular to tripod supporting structure of portable antenna, including bed plate (2) and three supporting leg (1), the same interval distribution of three supporting leg (1) is connected on bed plate (2), can dismantle on supporting leg (1) and be provided with set-square (3), bed plate (2) and set-square (3) can be dismantled through preventing turning round post (4) and connect, prevent turning round post (4) including preventing turning round post main part (5) and fixation nut (6), prevent turning round post main part (5) and be cylindric, one end is the internal thread, the other end be with fixation nut (6) complex external screw thread. The utility model discloses a can dismantle in the focus position of bed plate and set-square and be provided with and prevent turning round the post, effectively improve portable antenna tripod supporting structure's antitorque performance, increase the stability of support.

title_en: Hidden folding support cell-phone shell
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hidden folding support cell-phone shell belongs to cell-phone accessory technical field, has solved current cell-phone shell and has had the problem that can not effectively strut the cell-phone, and its technical essential is: including soft shell and crust, the inboard cover of crust is equipped with the soft shell, cell-phone body outer wall is hugged closely to the soft shell inboard, crust outside middle part is equipped with the mounting groove, be equipped with the supporting component in the mounting groove, through soft shell and crust, the protection cell-phone body that can be more stable prevents falling, through supporting the component, can prop up the cell-phone, can hide the supporting component simultaneously, improves the practicality of device, satisfies user's user demand, has the protection and prevents falling, stable supporting and simple and convenient practical advantage.

title_en: Wireless router convenient for heat dissipation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a router technical field specifically is a conveniently carry out radiating wireless router, including unable adjustment base, unable adjustment base's top and the position that is close to four corners all are equipped with first support column, and the top of four first support columns supports jointly has the router main part, and the exhaust vent has been seted up to the bottom of router main part, and the top of router main part is equipped with the rectangle air-supply line, and the inner wall of rectangle air-supply line and the position that is located the bottom are equipped with the frame support frame, and the surface support of frame support frame has the mounting panel, and the middle part at mounting panel top is equipped with radiator fan. This conveniently carry out radiating wireless router inputs the router with outside air from the inlet opening in through radiator fan for the circulation of the inside air of router, through seting up the exhaust vent in the bottom of router main part, can make the heat of the inside production of router discharge along with the distinguished and admirable fast, thereby avoid appearing influencing the condition of online quality because the inside high temperature of router.
