abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of trackers, and discloses a wireless tracker which comprises a shell, an antenna, a control panel, a charging assembly and a magnetic attraction assembly, wherein the antenna is arranged in the shell and is configured to be in communication connection with an external terminal; the control panel is arranged in the shell by attaching to the antenna and is in signal connection with the antenna; the charging assembly is arranged in the shell and is electrically connected to the control panel; the subassembly is inhaled to magnetism holds carrier and magnetism and inhale the piece including setting up in the shell, holds carrier and sets up in the antenna towards one side of control panel, and magnetism is inhaled the piece and is set up on holding the surface that deviates from the antenna. According to the wireless tracker, the wireless tracker is adsorbed on an external magnetic attraction structure or a metal structure through the magnetic attraction assembly, the magnetic attraction piece is stably arranged in the shell due to the arrangement of the bearing piece, the magnetic attraction piece is prevented from shifting when the tracker moves, the firmness and stability of the wireless tracker in fixing on a tracked object are improved, the wireless tracker is prevented from falling or losing, and accurate magnetic attraction alignment of the wireless tracker during charging is facilitated.

title_en: Multifunctional desktop Bluetooth lyric sound box
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of sound box equipment, and particularly relates to a multifunctional desktop Bluetooth lyric sound box which comprises a sound box main body, wherein a front cover is arranged on the front side of the sound box main body, an outer frame is arranged between the sound box main body and the front cover, a groove is formed in the top of the sound box main body, a handle is arranged in the groove, a clamping groove is formed in the upper surface of the handle, a supporting block is arranged on one side, close to the sound box main body, of the front cover, and a lamp panel is arranged at the bottom of the supporting block. The multifunctional music box has the advantages that the supporting block, the lamp holder, the lamp beads and the outer frame are arranged, the multi-color illumination function of the sound box main body can be increased, illumination is started when a user listens to songs, the music atmosphere can be effectively rendered, the lamp beads surround the periphery of the sound box main body, the illumination is diffused, the multifunctional music box can be used for night illumination, and the interestingness of the use of the sound box main body is increased; through setting up handle and draw-in groove, can reach the portability that realizes the audio amplifier main part on the one hand, on the other hand realizes cell phone stand support function, makes the audio amplifier main part can be used to support cell-phone, flat board when the desktop is placed.

title_en: Resonance rod and filter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of communication, and provides a resonance rod and a filter. The pressure head part comprises a first rod body and a second rod body, and the connecting part is provided with an accommodating cavity; the second rod body is accommodated in the accommodating cavity and detachably connected to the connecting part. And, in the axial direction, the connecting portion is movable relative to the second rod. The resonance rod provided by the utility model is divided into two parts. The pressure head part comprises a first rod body and a second rod body, and the first rod body is fixedly connected to the filter, so that the pressure head part can be kept stable and is not easy to separate from the filter; the second body of rod then holding in the holding intracavity of connecting portion to, second body of rod detachably connects in connecting portion, and like this, when the resonance bar needs the dismouting, only need with connecting portion dismouting on the second body of rod can, need not to adjust the mounted position of pressure head and wave filter, improved the dismouting efficiency of resonance bar greatly, also made things convenient for operating personnel to be under construction.

title_en: Outer frame with communication signal antenna display equipment and display equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an outer frame of display equipment with a communication signal antenna and the display equipment, wherein the outer frame comprises a wooden or bamboo frame body, the inner wall of the frame body is provided with a plurality of steps which extend along the circumferential direction of the inner wall and are used for supporting the display equipment, and the top surface of the step at the outer side far away from the front display surface of the display equipment is provided with an antenna slot for accommodating the communication signal antenna. The outer frame and the display device are made of wood or bamboo, the antenna is arranged on the outer side of the outer frame, smooth transmission of signals is guaranteed around, and the cost of the die is saved.

title_en: Router with bunch structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a router with a wire harness structure, which comprises a router, wherein a plurality of network wires are inserted into the right end of the router, a wire harness clamp for binding the network wires is arranged on the right side of the router, a clamping block capable of clamping the network wires is arranged on the inner side of the wire harness clamp, the wire harness clamp is rotatably connected with the router through a connecting rod, the network wires are inserted into the wire harness clamp when being bound, and then the network wires are clamped through controlling the clamping block to prevent the network wires from shaking, so that the binding of the network wires is completed, and the condition that the network wires are disordered is effectively avoided.

title_en: Plug gauge capable of automatically transmitting data
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plug gauge for automatically transmitting data, which comprises: the plug gauge comprises a plug gauge body, one end of the plug gauge body is provided with a measuring part, the other end of the plug gauge body is provided with an indicating gauge, a positioning ring which is sleeved on the outer edge of the plug gauge body is arranged between the measuring part and the indicating gauge, the outer edge of the bottom of the positioning ring is fixedly connected with a plurality of positioning columns which are arranged at intervals and a trigger button, the indicating gauge is electrically connected with a transceiver, the other end of the transceiver is electrically connected with the trigger button, wherein the measuring part is higher than the trigger button, the trigger button is higher than the positioning columns, and the positioning columns are abutted to the surface of a workpiece to be measured while the trigger button is triggered. This plug gauge triggers the button in the measuring and can automatic triggering, need not artificial triggering to the realization will measure data automatic transmission record to the computer, data logging's efficiency when effectively having improved the aperture measurement, data measurement is more accurate, greatly reduced human cost and error rate, make data acquisition light convenient more.

title_en: Angle-adjustable terminal installation mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an angle-adjustable terminal installation mechanism which comprises a base, wherein the inner side of the base is of a cavity structure, a storage battery is fixedly installed on the inner side of the base, one side, close to a telescopic rod, of a supporting plate is fixedly connected with a heat dissipation frame, a plurality of through holes are formed in the supporting plate in an array mode, heat dissipation columns are transversely arranged on the inner sides of the through holes, one ends of the heat dissipation columns are fixedly connected with the inner wall of the heat dissipation frame, fans are arranged on the inner wall of the heat dissipation frame, a control switch is arranged on one side of the base, the fans are electrically connected with the control switch, and the control switch is electrically connected with the storage battery. In the utility model, in order to quickly radiate the mobile phone, the aluminum material with higher heat conductivity coefficient is adopted to manufacture the heat-conducting column, the heat generated by the mobile phone is quickly transferred to the heat-conducting column, the storage battery supplies power to the fan by controlling the switch to be turned on, and then the fan carries out wind power radiation on the heat-conducting column on the inner side of the heat-radiating frame, so that the circulation of air around the heat-conducting column can be accelerated, and the mobile phone can be quickly cooled.

title_en: Financial affairs check are tested and are signed scanner support device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of office equipment, in particular to a financial check label checking scanner bracket device which can adjust the angle and height of a scanner at any time according to requirements, and improves the convenience in the use process; the automatic feeding device comprises a base plate, a support, a rotating shaft, a handle, an extension board, first lead screw, a slide plate, a rotating shaft, a connecting plate, a gear, a rack, a sliding plate, a cylinder, a supporting platform, a driving device and a clamping device, support fixed mounting is on the base plate, the rotating shaft is rotated and installed on the support, handle fixed mounting is in the rotating shaft, extension board fixed mounting is in the pivot upper end, driving device installs on the extension board, first lead screw rotates and installs on the extension board, the lower extreme and the output of driving device of first lead screw are connected, slide up-and-down slidable mounting is on the extension board, slide and first lead screw spiral shell dress, the rotation axis rotates and installs on the slide plate, connecting plate fixed mounting is at the rotation axis front end, clamping device fixed mounting is at the connecting plate lower extreme.

title_en: Intelligent watch with waterproof horn structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides an intelligent watch with a waterproof horn structure, which relates to the technical field of intelligent watches and comprises: the electron inner core, the outward appearance wall activity cover of electron inner core is equipped with rubber housing, rubber housing's interior table wall is fixed to be inserted and is equipped with sealing ring A, the fixed waterproof isolated mechanism that is provided with in bottom of electron inner core, the sound conduction that spreads from loudspeaker to bearing the telescopic second section, finally spread in the play sound hole on the overcoat, utilize the equidistance range that goes out the sound hole, spread out outside the equipment uniformly, solved the transmission effect of existing equipment for increasing loudspeaker through above-mentioned condition, and the waterproof nature's of the meter body problem of neglecting, utilize the cotton rubber ring of ponding bubble to replace some liquid glue and high temperature glue to reach the water-proof effects, combine together again with loudspeaker and be applied to on the intelligent wrist-watch complete machine, it is poor effectively to have solved intelligent wrist-watch loudspeaker water-proof effects, increase the stability of equipment sound transmission, loudspeaker tone quality and volume are improved.

title_en: Convenient electric power information acquisition equipment who overhauls
abstract_en: The utility model relates to electric power information acquisition equipment convenient to overhaul, which comprises an installation box and electric power information acquisition equipment arranged in the installation box, wherein clamping assemblies used for clamping and fixing the electric power information acquisition equipment are arranged on two sides in the installation box, and limiting assemblies used for limiting the electric power information acquisition equipment are arranged on the other two sides in the installation box; the limiting assembly comprises a threaded rod, a limiting block and an adjusting handle, and the threaded rod is connected to the inside of the installation box. This convenient electric power information acquisition equipment who overhauls drives the threaded rod through rotating adjustment handle and removes to the installation box is inside, is convenient for adjust the stopper and removes to limiting groove inside, is convenient for carry on spacingly to electric power information acquisition equipment's both sides, when needs overhaul electric power information acquisition equipment, only need drive stopper reverse movement through the counter-rotation adjustment handle, make the stopper break away from the limiting groove can, reached the advantage of convenient maintenance.

title_en: Simple and convenient type radome of installation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of radar antenna housing, and discloses a radar antenna housing with simple and convenient installation, which comprises a housing body, the outer wall of the cover body is symmetrically provided with positioning lugs, the bottom of the cover body is provided with a base which is arranged in a circular ring shape, and the inner wall of the top of the base is oppositely provided with slots, and the two slots are both provided with arc-shaped slots along the clockwise direction, rubber pads are arranged on the top wall and the bottom wall in the arc-shaped groove, the positioning lug is matched with the slot, just the positioning lug matches with the arc wall, utilizes the positioning lug and the slot of cover body outer wall to realize the assembly, and clockwise rotation cover body again is the positioning lug at the arc wall internal rotation, is contradicted by the rubber pad, accomplishes stable assembly, and this scheme simple structure promotes the simple operation degree greatly, and the dismouting is simple and convenient, need not loaded down with trivial details connections such as screw, promotes the practicality greatly.

title_en: Frequency-selective planar antenna housing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of radars, in particular to a frequency selection planar radome, which comprises a planar radome body and a frequency selection surface, wherein the frequency selection surface is arranged on the inner bottom surface of the planar radome body, the frequency selection surface comprises a plurality of rectangular metal sheets, annular gaps are arranged on the rectangular metal sheets, the centers of the annular gaps are overlapped with the centers of the rectangular metal sheets, the rectangular metal sheets are arranged in a two-dimensional planar array mode by taking the side length of the rectangular metal sheets as a period, and the array size is determined according to actual project requirements. The frequency selection planar antenna housing can reduce the influence on a radiation directional diagram and has an inhibiting effect on signals outside a working frequency band.

title_en: USB3.0 optical communication equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a USB3.0 optical communication device, which comprises an uplink interface module, a transmission optical fiber and a downlink interface module; the uplink interface module is connected with the downlink interface module through a transmission optical fiber; the uplink interface module is also connected with an upper computer, and the downlink interface module is provided with a plurality of USB3.0 interfaces; the uplink interface module is used for converting the electrical signal output by the upper computer into a first wavelength laser signal or converting a second wavelength laser signal into an upper computer interface electrical signal; the downlink interface module is used for converting the first wavelength laser signal into a HUB electrical signal or converting the electrical signal transmitted to the HUB by the peripheral interface into a second wavelength laser signal; the transmission optical fiber is a single-mode optical fiber, the first wavelength laser signal is transmitted to the downlink interface module through the transmission optical fiber, and the second wavelength laser signal is transmitted to the uplink interface module through the transmission optical fiber. The utility model greatly improves the transmission distance of USB3.0 and the compatibility of optical communication equipment.

title_en: Family information data router
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a home information data router, which comprises a shell, wherein a circuit board is arranged in the shell, a plurality of studs are arranged on the circuit board, a placing plate is jointly arranged at the upper ends of the studs, a hard disk is arranged on the placing plate, and the placing plate is respectively connected with the corresponding studs through a plurality of bolts; the upper surface of the placing plate is provided with two second limiting plates, and the two second limiting plates are fixed with the hard disk through a plurality of second screws; the circuit board is provided with an interface, and the hard disk is connected with the interface through a connecting wire; the bottom is equipped with two first limiting plates in the casing. The utility model can integrate the circuit board and the hard disk as much as possible, reduce the volume of the whole device, improve the integration level of the internal devices of the router, and ensure that the heat of the circuit board and the hard disk can be better released during the working, thereby ensuring that the temperature of the hard disk and the circuit board can be reduced.

title_en: 4G wireless fixed telephone with wall-hanging structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of 4G fixed wireless phones, in particular to a 4G fixed wireless phone with a wall-mounted structure, which comprises two groups of support frames, a base and a 4G fixed wireless phone body, wherein the two groups of support frames are arranged, the upper ends of the two groups of support frames are connected through a connecting strip, wall-mounted assemblies are inserted at the intersection of four surfaces of the back of the two groups of support frames, the front surface of one group of support frames is connected with the base, a placing groove is formed in the front side of the base, and the 4G fixed wireless phone body is inserted in the placing groove. The wall-mounted device is provided with two groups of support frames which are hinged through the connecting strips, the wall-mounted device can be placed or hung on a wall as required, the two groups of support frames are kept to be in a triangular structure when the wall-mounted device is placed, the wall-mounted assembly is fixed on the wall when the wall is hung, the support frames are clamped on the clamping strips on the wall-mounted assembly, and the support frames only need to be extruded and taken down when the wall-mounted device is taken down at a later stage, so that the wall-mounted device is greatly convenient to use.

title_en: Pen container with mobile phone support
abstract_en: The pen container with the mobile phone support comprises a container body, wherein a containing groove is formed in the container body, a partition plate is arranged in the containing groove and divides the containing groove into a first containing groove and a second containing groove from front to back, a hollowed-out baffle is transversely arranged in the first containing groove and divides the first containing groove into a slot and a sound amplifying cavity from top to bottom, and a sound amplifying hole is formed in the lower end of the front end of the sound amplifying cavity. The front part of the pen container is provided with a slot for inserting a mobile phone, a sound expansion cavity is arranged below the slot, and the side wall of the front end of the container body is provided with a sound expansion hole. After the structure is adopted, the mobile phone can be inserted into the slot of the pen container, the sound emitted from the lower end of the mobile phone is diffused through the sound amplifying cavity and the sound amplifying hole, and compared with the prior art, the pen container has the advantages that the mobile phone can be inserted into the pen container, the sound outlet in the lower end of the mobile phone cannot be blocked, and the sound amplifying effect can be achieved on the sound emitted from the mobile phone.

title_en: Via structure, support structure, printed direct structuring antenna and device terminal
abstract_en: The application provides a via structure, a support structure, a printed direct structuring antenna and a device terminal, the via hole structure is arranged on a supporting structure with a first side surface and a second side surface which are opposite, the supporting structure is used for arranging a printed directly-formed antenna, the via hole structure comprises a tapered hole part and a cylindrical hole part which are communicated, the tapered hole part gradually shrinks from outside to inside and penetrates through the first side surface, the cylindrical hole part penetrates through the second side surface, the inclination angle of the hole wall of the tapered hole part relative to the axial direction of the tapered hole part gradually decreases from outside to inside, and the communication position between the tapered hole part and the cylindrical hole part adopts smooth connection, and the inner end peripheries of the tapered hole part and the cylindrical hole part are the same at the communication position, after the adhesive is dispensed, the via hole structure, the contact area between the hole wall and the dispensing silver paste is greatly increased, and the overall conduction performance of the conducting hole structure is improved.

title_en: Four-channel optical transceiver module device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a four-channel's light transceiver module device, including light transceiver module, light transceiver module's fixed surface is connected with U type baffle, light transceiver module top all is provided with the clamp plate with the right side of bottom, the left side of clamp plate extends to the left side of U type baffle, and light transceiver module top all is provided with the fixed block with the right side of bottom, and the left side fixed connection of fixed block is on the surface of U type baffle, and the fixed block is kept away from the equal fixedly connected with slide bar in four corners of light transceiver module one side, and the clamp plate cover is established on the surface of slide bar. The utility model discloses use by the cooperation of light transceiver module, U type baffle, clamp plate, fixed block, slide bar, spring, carriage release lever, U type connecting plate and slipmat to possess the advantage that stability is high, solved traditional light transceiver module device and lacked location structure, take place easily after the installation of light transceiver module device and rock the condition that drops, cause the stable problem of influence communication.

title_en: Multifunctional hybrid optical fiber transceiver
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional hybrid optical fiber transceiver, which comprises a shell, a WIFI antenna, a dustproof heat dissipation cover and a sliding rod, wherein the WIFI antenna is connected and arranged at one end of the top of the shell, an RJ45 interface area is connected and arranged at one end of the front surface of the shell, a rubber block is arranged at an external port of the RJ45 interface area, and the rubber block plays a role in protecting the RJ45 interface area and effectively prevents dust and impurities from entering the internal position of the RJ45 interface area. According to the utility model, through the RJ45 interface area, the rubber block, the connector interface area and the indicator light fittings, the rubber block can block the port to avoid dust accumulation for the RJ45 interface area, the induction detection piece is arranged at the inner end inside the connector interface area, when the induction detection piece is connected with a circuit, the induction detection piece induces and transmits the indicator light through the data converter, and after the indicator light is lightened, a worker can be prompted to successfully connect the connector, so that the practicability of the transceiver body is effectively improved.

title_en: Indoor air circulation control device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of air conditioner remote controllers, and discloses an indoor air circulation control device which comprises a remote control body, wherein a battery groove is integrally formed in the bottom of the remote control body, a concave table is arranged on the upper side, close to the battery groove, of the remote control body, a limiting groove and a clamping groove are respectively formed in the top and the bottom of the concave table of the remote control body, a battery cover is placed in the concave table, a buckle is integrally formed in the bottom of the battery cover, and a limiting block is fixedly mounted on the top of the rear wall of the battery cover. According to the utility model, the inner rod and the pressing plate are arranged, after the battery cover is limited, the pressing plate is abutted against one side of the battery cover, the battery is separated by the raised line, the spring is self-adaptively telescopic along with the deformation of the battery or the battery cover in the later period, the pressing plate can always effectively limit and extrude the battery, the poor contact condition caused by the loosening and inclination of the battery in the later period is avoided, the frequent disassembly of the battery cover by a worker for adjusting the position of the battery is not required, and the battery cover is suitable for wide popularization and application.

title_en: Sensor circuit and intelligent sensor
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the sensor, a sensor circuit is provided, intelligent sensor, through at sensor module generation sensing signal, host system receives the sensing signal, and according to the sensing signal generation sensor transmitting signal, the oscillation module carries out filtering processing to sensor transmitting signal, antenna module is with the sensor transmitting signal transmission to the environment after filtering processing, and receive the radio signal in the environment, convert radio signal into antenna received signal and send to host system, the transmission power of sensor transmitting signal is adjusted according to antenna received signal's signal strength by host system at last, thereby wireless sensor's power dissipation problem is greatly improved, signal transmission's stability has been promoted.

title_en: RFID portable data acquisition terminal
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an RFID portable data acquisition terminal, which comprises a data acquisition terminal body, wherein the data acquisition terminal body comprises a switch assembly, an antenna assembly, a mobile phone support assembly and a two-dimensional scanning head, the switch assembly and the antenna assembly are distributed at intervals, the antenna assembly comprises an antenna front cover, an antenna and an antenna rear cover, an installation cavity for installing the antenna is formed after the antenna front cover and the antenna rear cover are closed, the switch assembly comprises a handle front cover, a battery, a handle rear cover, a card reading button switch and a switch button, a cavity for installing the battery is formed after the handle front cover and the handle rear cover are closed, the card reading button switch and the switch button are both fixedly arranged between the handle front cover and the handle rear cover, the mobile phone support assembly comprises an aluminum bottom plate and a mobile phone support, the mobile phone support and the two-dimensional scanning head are both fixedly arranged on the end surface of the aluminum bottom plate, and the two-dimensional scanning head is in limit connection with the mobile phone support, and meanwhile, a mounting groove is formed in the end face of the aluminum bottom plate, and a main plate is arranged inside the mounting groove.

title_en: Bluetooth communication accessory of II type concentrator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a Bluetooth communication accessory of a type II concentrator, and relates to the field of power utilization information acquisition of a power grid. In order to realize Bluetooth communication on the basis of considering the cost, the Bluetooth communication device comprises a shell, a 485 module, a main control module and a Bluetooth module, wherein the 485 module, the main control module and the Bluetooth module are arranged in the shell; the shell is provided with a 485 loop line connecting port, and the 485 loop line connecting port is connected with the 485 module; the Bluetooth communication accessory is connected to the 485 loop wire in a pluggable manner through the 485 loop wire connecting port so as to be in communication connection with the II-type concentrator on the 485 loop wire; the master control module is connected with the 485 module and the Bluetooth module to convert the 485 signal and the Bluetooth wireless signal in two directions. The technical scheme realizes the bidirectional conversion of the Bluetooth wireless signal and the 485 signal and provides a physical channel for the communication of a new generation of intelligent Internet of things electric energy meter and a stock II type concentrator; bluetooth communication accessory extension formula ground concatenates on original platform district 485 loop lines, and can realize plug at any time as required, reduce cost, and promote the convenience that II type concentrator bluetooth mode communication was reformed transform.

title_en: Miniaturized circularly polarized antenna
abstract_en: The utility model provides a miniaturized circular polarization antenna, includes dielectric substrate, radiation piece and ground plate, on the radiation piece around the center on radiation piece surface and distance the equal department's of center on radiation piece surface sculpture forms four closed gaps, four closed gaps include the first closed gap that sets gradually along clockwise or anticlockwise, second closed gap, third closed gap and fourth closed gap, the girth of first closed gap, second closed gap, third closed gap and fourth closed gap increases along clockwise or anticlockwise one by one, when realizing the antenna circular polarization function, make the current path on radiation piece surface increase, thereby change the circuit distribution on the radiation piece, reach and reduce resonant frequency, make the size of radiation piece can reduce, thereby reduce circular polarization antenna's size.

title_en: Multilayer high-shielding waveguide window structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multilayer high-shielding waveguide window structure, which comprises a plurality of layers of waveguide windows and a waveguide window frame; the plurality of layers of waveguide windows are fixed in the waveguide window frame by welding; each layer of waveguide window is composed of a plurality of hexagonal waveguide cavities, and two adjacent layers of waveguide windows are arranged in a staggered mode; the hexagonal waveguide cavity consists of six metal side walls; and a metal short-circuit element is loaded in the hexagonal waveguide cavity. The utility model has compact structure, can be flexibly customized according to the requirement of shielding effectiveness, has ultrahigh electromagnetic shielding property while ensuring ventilation rate, miniaturization and heat dissipation, and can be applied to ventilation shielding windows of radar communication, military equipment and the like.

title_en: Superconducting band-pass filter
abstract_en: The utility model provides a superconducting bandpass filter configured to act on a control terminal of a superconducting qubit and a quantum coupler to achieve frequency division multiplexing control of the superconducting qubit and the quantum coupler, the superconducting bandpass filter comprising: the power module comprises a current source and a source end impedance which are connected; a superconducting resonator module including a plurality of superconducting resonators of the same frequency that are coupled together; a first LC module including a coupling capacitor and an inductor of the feeder line and the superconducting resonator module; and a second LC module including a load impedance and a coupling capacitance and inductance between the superconducting resonator module and the second LC module.

title_en: Antenna packaging device
abstract_en: The disclosure provides an antenna packaging device, which can change the position and angle of an antenna for receiving and transmitting electromagnetic waves through an external force by arranging a movable antenna structure capable of moving or inclining relative to a substrate under the action of a non-contact force, so as to solve the problem that the intensity of the electromagnetic waves of received signals is weakened if a receiving end antenna is not on a main radiation direction path of a transmitting end antenna.

title_en: Bluetooth glasses with listen collet chuck
abstract_en: The utility model provides Bluetooth glasses with a listening clamp, which relate to the technical field of Bluetooth glasses and comprise a frame, wherein a lens is fixedly arranged in the middle of the frame, the side surface of the frame is rotatably connected with a glasses leg, the side surface of the frame is provided with a hole, the side surface of the hole is fixedly provided with a spring, the side surface of the spring is fixedly connected with a rectangular block, the side surface of the rectangular block is fixedly provided with an anti-falling frame, the lower end of the glasses leg is provided with a loudspeaker, the side surface of the anti-falling frame is fixedly connected with an inserting plate, when the Bluetooth glasses are used and the Bluetooth glasses are accidentally dropped on the ground, the anti-falling frame is firstly impacted by force, in the impacting process, the spring is compressed by the impact, the spring drives the rectangular block and the anti-falling frame to move towards the hole, the inserting plate slides in an inserting groove along with the movement of the anti-falling frame, so as to effectively reduce the impact force generated by the dropping, therefore, the probability of lens damage is reduced, and the practical use is facilitated.

title_en: Single-interface redundant switch
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a redundant formula switch of single interface, including the switch body, the front side of switch body is equipped with a plurality of connectors, the front side of switch body is equipped with the thermovent, install a plurality of snubber blocks on the switch body, every the snubber block is located the corner of switch body, the upper end fixedly connected with installation piece of switch body, the upper end of installation piece is equipped with the mounting groove, the inner wall rotates around the mounting groove and is connected with the dwang, fixed cover is equipped with the handle on the dwang, the left side of handle is equipped with the sliding tray. The device is through setting up snubber block and rubber pad isotructure, and the effectual impulsive force that receives when having slowed down the device and dropping or receiving the striking has not influenced the device upper end and has placed article again when having carried by the inside part of protection device to a great extent, setting up of handle isotructure, and the filter screen subassembly can also be dismantled fast and get off, improves the maintenance efficiency in later stage.

title_en: Electrochromic rear cover of mobile phone with touch performance and mobile phone
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lid behind cell-phone electrochromic with touch-control performance, including first glass substrate, second glass substrate to and be located the electrochromic function rete between first glass substrate and the second glass substrate, electrochromic function rete is first transparent conducting layer, electrochromic layer, ion conductor layer, ion storage layer, the transparent conducting layer of second in proper order from first glass substrate to second glass substrate, is equipped with touch-control Sensor functional layer between first glass substrate lower surface and the first transparent conducting layer. The utility model discloses on the basis of lid behind current electrochromic, utilize the sputtering method to plate one deck ITO pattern (OGS technique promptly), realize the touch-control function as touch-control Sensor functional layer, do not influence electrochromic's effect, make the back lid have the touch-control performance simultaneously, the user can realize functions such as unblock, gesture through the back lid touch-control, has richened the actual use of back lid, has made things convenient for the consumer to use.

title_en: Radio frequency front end module
abstract_en: The utility model provides a radio frequency front end module relates to the radio frequency technology field. The radio frequency front end module comprises: the power amplifier, the low noise amplifier, the first multi-channel radio frequency switch, the second multi-channel radio frequency switch, the plurality of filters and the tunable filter, wherein the input end of the power amplifier is used for connecting the transmitting end of the radio frequency transceiver, the output end of the low noise amplifier is used for connecting the receiving end of the radio frequency transceiver, the output end of the power amplifier and the input end of the low noise amplifier are both connected with one end of the second multi-channel radio frequency switch, the plurality of filters are connected with the other end of the second multi-channel radio frequency switch in parallel, the plurality of filters are also connected with one end of the first multi-channel radio frequency switch in parallel, the other end of the first multi-channel radio frequency switch is connected with the first end of the tunable filter, the second end of the tunable filter is used for being connected with the radio frequency antenna, so that the cut-off frequency and the harmonic suppression are adjusted, the number of components is reduced, the size and the design difficulty of the radio frequency front-end module are reduced, and the cost is reduced.

title_en: Portable testing arrangement of HPLC communication unit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable testing device for HPLC communication units, which comprises a central control unit, a testing function selection port, an input/output module, a serial communication interface and a power module; the test function selection port, the input/output module and the serial port communication interface are respectively connected with the central control unit through an address bus and a data bus; the power supply module is used for providing power supply for the whole testing device; the serial port communication interface is connected with the central control unit through a bidirectional data channel and used for providing a data exchange interface for the HPLC communication unit to be tested. An object of the utility model is to provide a portable testing arrangement of HPLC communication unit realizes the test function to outside HPLC communication unit through the two-way data connection passageway of central control unit and serial ports communication interface.

title_en: Three-channel L-band VPX signal processing system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a three channels L wave band VPX signal processing system, including XC6SLX9 series programmable logic device U79, the first passageway circuit of being connected with programmable logic device U79, second passageway circuit and third passageway circuit, the radio frequency output circuit who is connected with programmable logic device U79, with first passageway circuit, second passageway circuit, the clock frequency division circuit that third passageway circuit and radio frequency output circuit are connected, and with programmable logic device U79, radio frequency output circuit, with first passageway circuit, the second passageway circuit, the third passageway circuit, the supply circuit that radio frequency output circuit and clock frequency division circuit are connected. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages that: make things convenient for dismouting to accomodate, nimble practicality, convenient accurate adjustment antenna angle, it is fixed stable.

title_en: Portable carry-on WiFi equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses portable WiFi equipment with a positioning function, which comprises an outer shell, a wiring frame, wiring terminals and a wire tray, wherein one end of the turnover frame is fixedly connected with the wiring frame, a rotating seat is movably arranged at the top of the wiring frame, the wiring terminals are fixedly arranged in the wire tray, and clamping rods are fixedly connected at the bottom end of the wiring frame; the wiring frame is movably connected with the storage groove through the overturning bracket, the wiring frame can carry out primary protection through the storage groove, meanwhile, the protection cover plate is further arranged on one side of the outer shell, the protection cover plate on one side of the protection cover plate can cover the outer part of the storage groove, so that secondary protection is formed, the wiring terminal on the outer side of the butt joint line frame is effectively protected, the top of the wiring frame is provided with the rotatable rotating seat, the side face of the wiring frame is provided with the side groove and the wiring terminal, and when the rotating seat is rotated, the wire guide disc can be driven to rotate through the rotating shaft rod, so that the position of the wiring terminal in the side groove is changed, and the angle of wiring is adjusted.

title_en: Logo assembly of battery cover, battery cover and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a logo component of a battery cover, the battery cover and electronic equipment, wherein the logo component of the battery cover comprises: a substrate, wherein the substrate is a solid substrate; the pattern layer is arranged on the surface of the base material, and a logo is formed on the pattern layer. Therefore, the base material is directly made into the solid color base material, the process of covering the ink and the electroplating process for many times can be omitted, the production period can be effectively shortened, and the production cost can be reduced.

title_en: Protective interphone
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a protective interphone, and relates to the technical field of interphones. The utility model comprises a machine body, wherein a main machine module is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the machine body, one side of the machine body is connected with a side pressing handle in a sliding manner, a group of compression springs a are arranged between the side pressing handle and the opposite surface of the machine body, the other side of the machine body is hinged with a grab handle through a hinge shaft, a compression spring b is arranged between the grab handle and the opposite surface of the machine body, an inner wire tube is fixedly arranged in the machine body, the peripheral side surface of the inner wire tube is connected with an antenna head in a sliding manner, a soft antenna which is electrically connected with the antenna head is fixedly arranged at the axial position of the inner wire tube, the antenna head is in linkage lifting with the grab handle through a linkage assembly, and a contact pressure head matched with the main machine module is fixedly arranged on the inner walls of the grab handle and the side pressing handle. In the utility model, when the intercom is needed to be used, a user holds the intercom body and presses the side pressing handle and the grab handle simultaneously, and then the two touch heads press the touch switch after the side pressing handle and the grab handle are pressed simultaneously.

title_en: Luminous emergent communication leakage coaxial cable
abstract_en: The utility model provides a luminous emergent communication leaky coaxial cable, comprising: the protective sleeve layer of the leakage coaxial cable for emergency is provided with boss parts which are arranged oppositely, and the boss parts are internally provided with luminous lines; therefore, not only can the luminous characteristics of the luminous emergency leakage cable and the signal transmission and radiation characteristics of the leakage cable be ensured, but also the luminous emergency communication leakage coaxial cable can be rapidly laid, and the recycling and reuse can be satisfied.

title_en: Outdoor gateway antenna convenient to adjust
abstract_en: The utility model provides an outdoor gateway antenna convenient to adjust, and relates to the technical field of gateway antennas. Including the antenna body, the antenna body outside rigid coupling has solid fixed ring, gu fixed ring upper surface opens there is the ring channel, the ring channel is connected with the circle axle, in the ring channel was inserted to circle axle one end, the other end symmetry rigid coupling had the dead lever, the one end rigid coupling that the circle axle was kept away from to the dead lever has signal enhancement board two, the bottom symmetry rigid coupling of antenna body has articulated seat one, articulated seat one rotates and is connected with articulated seat two, articulated seat two's bottom rotates and is connected with the connector. The utility model solves the problem that the existing outdoor gateway antenna is inconvenient to operate and adjust when the signal is enhanced.

title_en: Antenna structure and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an antenna structure and electronic equipment, wherein the antenna structure comprises a module chip and an antenna plate, the antenna plate is electrically connected with the module chip, the antenna plate is at least a part of a shell of the electronic equipment, the antenna plate comprises a body part and a feed-in connecting part, the body part is provided with an antenna gap, and the antenna gap is provided with a first end face and a second end face which are opposite; the feed-in connecting portion in first terminal surface with body portion connects and towards the second terminal surface extends the setting, the module chip includes first radio frequency connector, feed-in connecting portion with have the clearance between the second terminal surface, first radio frequency connector with feed-in connecting portion and the feed point electricity of module chip is connected, and antenna structure in this application embodiment can effectively reduce the thickness of the electronic equipment who uses this antenna structure.

title_en: Antenna sensing equipment and base station antenna
abstract_en: The utility model discloses antenna sensing equipment and a base station antenna, relates to the technical field of communication equipment, and aims to solve the problem that the installation angle of a solar panel in the antenna sensing equipment is inconvenient to adjust. The antenna sensing equipment comprises an attitude sensor, a solar photovoltaic panel and a connecting piece, wherein the attitude sensor is used for collecting and outputting antenna attitude parameters. The solar photovoltaic panel is obliquely arranged on one side of the gesture sensing device and is electrically connected with the gesture sensing device, and is used for supplying power to the gesture sensing device. The connecting piece is arranged between the solar photovoltaic panel and the attitude sensing device. The connecting piece has the both ends of rotating the connection, and the one end of connecting piece is connected with solar photovoltaic board, and the other end of connecting piece is connected with gesture sensing device to make solar photovoltaic board rotate the installation for gesture sensing device. The antenna sensing device provided by the utility model is convenient to install.

title_en: Dual polarized aperture coupling feed antenna and communication module
abstract_en: The application provides a dual-polarized aperture coupling feed antenna and a communication module. The dual-polarized aperture coupling feed antenna comprises a radiation layer, an aperture coupling layer and a feed layer; the upper surface of the radiation layer is provided with at least two pairs of circular radiation patches, and the polarization modes of the two pairs of circular radiation patches are mutually perpendicular; the radiation layer is fitted above the aperture coupling layer, and a first feed gap and a second feed gap are arranged on the upper surface of the aperture coupling layer; the feed layer is fitted below the aperture coupling layer, and a first microstrip line and a second microstrip line are arranged on the upper surface of the feed layer; the first feed slot and the first microstrip line at least partially overlap, and the second feed slot and the second microstrip line at least partially overlap, in a direction perpendicular to the aperture coupling layer. The antenna isolation and gain can be improved, so that the poor radiation efficiency of the antenna is improved, and the microstrip line impedance is reconstructed through the antenna tuning switch to reconstruct the optimal resonance of the antenna.

title_en: Adjustable antenna
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of antennas and discloses an adjustable antenna, which comprises a fixed frame, wherein a limiting rod is inserted in the fixed frame, an adjusting frame is fixedly connected to the top end of the limiting rod, an inner threaded pipe is fixedly connected to the lower surface of the adjusting frame, the inner threaded pipe is inserted in the adjusting frame, a screw rod is connected to the inner threaded pipe, and the limiting frame is fixedly connected to the lower surface of the fixed frame, so that the antenna can adjust the distance between an antenna head and the fixed frame according to actual use conditions, the practicability of the device is improved, an arc-shaped sliding rail is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the adjusting frame, a sliding block is movably connected to the inner part of the arc-shaped sliding rail, a supporting plate is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the sliding block, a connecting column is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the supporting plate, and an electric push rod is fixedly connected to the side surface of the adjusting frame, so that the antenna head can be driven to rotate, and the device can adjust the horizontal direction of the antenna head according to actual use conditions.

title_en: Multi-band phased array antenna array phase-shifting network system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-band phased array antenna array phase-shifting network system, which comprises a power division network, a phase control network, a control interface and antenna subarrays, wherein the power division network is connected with the phase control network; the power division network receives the radio frequency signals sent by the baseband processing unit and distributes the radio frequency signals to different switch networks; the phase control network comprises a first switch network, a second switch network and a plurality of microstrip phase delayers connected with the two switch networks, wherein the first switch network is connected with the power division network, and the second switch network is connected with the antenna subarrays; the first switch network receives the radio frequency signals and selects corresponding microstrip phase delayers according to control signals of the control interface, the microstrip phase delayers change excitation phases of the radio frequency signals, and the second switch network excites the radio frequency signals with phase changes to the antenna subarrays. The utility model can rapidly and effectively realize different phase excitation requirements of the phased array antenna array; the system is simple, the framework is reasonable, the implementation is easy, and the system can be widely applied to the feed network of the phased array antenna.

title_en: Portable interphone
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a portable interphone, which comprises an interphone body and a radio component, wherein the interphone body is provided with a containing cavity, an opening is formed on the interphone body and is communicated with the containing cavity, the radio component comprises a connecting wire, a wire receiving roller and a radio receiving head, the wire receiving roller is rotationally connected in the containing cavity, one end of the connecting wire is electrically connected with the interphone, the other end of the connecting wire is connected with the radio receiving head, the connecting wire is wound on the wire receiving roller, and the radio receiving head is positioned outside the containing cavity.

title_en: Mobile phone protection shell convenient to disassemble and assemble
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mobile phone accessories, in particular to a mobile phone protection shell convenient to assemble and disassemble. A mobile phone protective housing convenient for disassembly and assembly, comprising: the mobile phone shell comprises a mobile phone shell outer enclosure, a shell backboard and a connecting assembly, wherein the mobile phone shell outer enclosure is connected with the shell backboard in an assembling way through the connecting assembly. The mobile phone shell is designed to surround the mobile phone shell and be split with the shell back plate, the shell back plate can be integrally taken down, the mobile phone can be taken out from the back after the back plate is taken down, and the mobile phone shell and the mobile phone are simple and quick and cannot be damaged.

title_en: Mobile phone liquid crystal display detection device convenient to adjust
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of product detection, in particular to a mobile phone liquid crystal display screen detection device convenient to adjust. The utility model provides a mobile phone liquid crystal display screen detection device convenient to adjust, which comprises a base, a placement frame, fixing blocks, a first handle and the like, wherein the placement frame is arranged on the base, the fixing blocks are arranged on two sides of the placement frame, and the first handle is rotationally connected to the fixing blocks. According to the utility model, the limiting mechanism is arranged above the gear, the limiting rod, the second elastic piece and the limiting block of the limiting mechanism are matched, the limiting rod cannot back up in the process of adjusting the angle upwards, the safety in the adjusting process is ensured, the limiting block can be pulled away from the gear when the limiting rod needs to be restored, the fixing mechanisms are arranged on two sides of the placing frame, the mobile phone is fixed through the fixing mechanisms, and then the fixing device can be clamped by pushing down the buckle, so that the fixing device cannot fail in the adjusting process.

title_en: Split router
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of routers, in particular to a split router, which comprises a router and a connecting mechanism, wherein the left side of the router is connected with an antenna through the connecting mechanism, storage boxes are arranged on the front side and the back side of the router, the top of each storage box is connected with a sealing cover in a sliding manner, the top of each sealing cover is provided with a pull ring, and the inner wall of each storage box is provided with a protection pad; the utility model provides a router antenna, including the fixed box of fixed connection in the router left side, fixed box's internally mounted has the connecting sleeve, connecting sleeve's outer wall fixedly connected with external screw thread pipe, connecting sleeve's inside sliding connection has the connecting rod, the outer wall of connecting rod just installs insulating cover in keeping away from connecting sleeve position department, has solved present router antenna and generally all is fixed mounting on the router, and when the transportation, the antenna is difficult folding, leads to the transportation volume great, inconvenient problem of transportation.

title_en: Tunable filter
abstract_en: The application provides an adjustable filter, which relates to the technical field of wireless communication; the tunable filter includes: the tuning device comprises a cavity and a tuning assembly, wherein a plurality of resonant cavities are arranged in the cavity; the tuning assembly is provided with two groups, each group of tuning assembly comprises a driving piece and a tuning medium piece, the driving end of the driving piece is connected with the corresponding tuning medium piece, the resonant cavities are divided into two groups, and each group of resonant cavities corresponds to one tuning medium piece. Compared with the related art, the two tuning dielectric sheets are independently controlled, and the depths of the two tuning dielectric sheets entering the resonant cavity can be respectively adjusted, so that the performance influence of the two tuning dielectric sheets on the adjustable filter can be coordinated by adjusting the different depths of the two tuning dielectric sheets entering the resonant cavity, and errors brought in the processing and assembling processes are reduced.

title_en: Dial and watch
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model relates to the technical field of electronic wearable equipment, and discloses a dial plate and a watch, wherein the dial plate comprises: a metal housing on which an antenna is integrated; the main board is arranged in the metal shell, a wireless communication circuit is arranged on the main board, and a limit hole is formed in the edge of the main board; the first electric connecting piece is provided with a fixed end and an abutting end which are opposite, wherein the fixed end is fixed in the limiting hole and is electrically connected with the wireless communication circuit, and the abutting end abuts against the inner wall of the metal shell so as to form electric connection between the wireless communication circuit and the antenna. Through the mode, the embodiment of the utility model ensures the texture and the attractive appearance of the watch, and simultaneously realizes the receiving and transmitting of wireless signals.

title_en: Gateway with fixed knot constructs
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gateway with a fixed structure, which comprises a mounting plate, a gateway main body and a radiating opening, wherein the mounting structure is arranged on two sides of the top end of the mounting plate, the radiating opening is arranged on two sides of the gateway main body, and the top end of the radiating opening is provided with a dustproof structure. According to the gateway main body installing and fixing device, the fixing plate is driven to be sleeved on the fixing screw rod through the connecting block to be in contact with the surface of the installing plate for supporting, the fixing screw rod penetrates through the supporting plate to position the supporting plate, meanwhile, the sliding block is inserted into the sliding seat and slides along the inner wall of the sliding seat to guide until the bottom of the sliding seat is attached, then the locking screw cap is taken to rotate on the fixing screw rod to screw down to tightly press and fix the supporting plate, and therefore the effect of installing and fixing the gateway main body on the installing plate is achieved, the installing and fixing function of the device is achieved, convenience of the device is improved, stability of the gateway main body is guaranteed, and falling damage of the gateway main body is prevented.

title_en: Anti-disassembly monitoring vehicle-mounted video recorder
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an anti-disassembly monitoring vehicle-mounted video recorder which comprises a video recorder body and a mounting plate, wherein a first fixing plate is fixedly connected to the top of the video recorder body, two first clamping blocks are fixedly connected to the bottom of the mounting plate, a fixing groove is formed in the top of the first fixing plate, two second clamping blocks are connected to the inside of the fixing groove in a sliding mode, the first clamping blocks and the second clamping blocks are L-shaped, and a first threaded rod and a second threaded rod are connected to the inside of the fixing groove in a rotating mode. According to the utility model, the first threaded rod and the second threaded rod are rotated to enable the second clamping block to translate, and the first clamping block and the second clamping block are hooked with each other, so that the first fixing plate is fixed with the mounting plate, when the device is disassembled, the first threaded rod and the second threaded rod are rotated to enable the second clamping block to move, the elasticity of the compression spring and the spring is increased, so that the pressing switch is connected, the buzzer generates a sounding alarm, and the device can generate the sounding alarm before being disassembled, thereby effectively preventing theft.

title_en: Domain controller of double Ethernet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a domain controller of double Ethernet, comprising: the control module is used for receiving and generating control signals to other modules; a plurality of port modules for communicating with a gateway connection; the reset module is used for resetting the control module; the control module is electrically connected with the plurality of port modules and the reset module respectively. The dual-Ethernet domain controller has simple structure and convenient use, realizes a dual-channel Ethernet interface by matching the control module with a plurality of port modules, and satisfies the rapid conversion and the safe communication among the multiple gateway data in the vehicle.

title_en: Chargeable anti-falling mobile phone shell
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a chargeable anti-drop mobile phone shell, which comprises a mobile phone shell, wherein a back box is fixedly arranged on the back surface of the mobile phone shell, an inner rubber cushion is fixedly connected to the inside of the mobile phone shell, a mounting frame is connected to the bottom of the inner wall of the back box, a charging device is fixedly arranged at the top of the mounting frame, buffer rubber cushions are connected to two sides of the inner wall of the back box, one sides of the buffer rubber cushions are contacted with the surface of the charging device, a shell protection mechanism for protecting the side of the mobile phone shell is connected to the surface of the inner wall of the mobile phone shell, the shell protection mechanism comprises a rubber frame, miniature springs and an arc sponge cushion, a plurality of miniature springs are connected to the outer surface of the rubber frame, the two sides of the inner wall of the rubber frame are connected with the arc sponge cushion, a charging port is arranged at the bottom of the mobile phone shell, and charging wires are arranged at the corners of the back box.

title_en: Aging rack for mobile phone
abstract_en: A handset burn-in rack comprising: the mobile phone comprises a case, a support, a plurality of heat dissipation back clamps for fixing the mobile phone, a temperature detection mechanism and a power supply, wherein the support, the plurality of heat dissipation back clamps, the temperature detection mechanism and the power supply are all located in the case, the plurality of heat dissipation back clamps, the temperature detection mechanism and the power supply are all arranged in the support, the plurality of heat dissipation back clamps and the temperature detection mechanism are all electrically connected with the power supply, the plurality of heat dissipation back clamps are arranged in a rectangular array mode along the up-down direction and the left-right direction, and the temperature detection mechanism faces the heat dissipation back clamps to detect the temperature of the mobile phone. The mobile phone aging rack can detect the temperature of the mobile phone in real time in the process of performing mobile phone aging test, can cool a single mobile phone, avoids influencing the aging process of other mobile phones due to overhigh temperature, and ensures the accuracy of test results.

title_en: Ultra-wideband high-gain antenna assembly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electronic communication antennas and discloses an ultra-wideband high-gain antenna assembly, which comprises an outer cylinder, wherein a docking rod is fixedly assembled on the side surface of the outer cylinder, an antenna cylinder is rotationally connected to the inner wall of the outer cylinder, an antenna rod body is slidingly connected to the inner wall of the antenna cylinder, a circular plate is rotationally connected to the inner wall of the outer cylinder, the inner wall of the circular plate is rotationally connected with the outer edge of the antenna cylinder, a clamping block group is fixedly assembled on the inner wall of the circular plate, and a positioning block is slidingly connected to the inner wall of the clamping block group. Through the cooperation of locating piece and adjusting ring, when needs adjust antenna section of thick bamboo angle, to the direction removal adjusting ring that keeps away from the antenna section of thick bamboo, and then utilize the adjusting ring to drive the side of locating piece and keep away from the inner wall of fixture block group, afterwards rotate the antenna section of thick bamboo until the antenna section of thick bamboo reaches suitable angle, loosen the adjusting ring this moment to utilize the spring to drive the slide bar through the limiting plate and remove, and utilize the inner wall joint spacing of the side and fixture block group of slide bar drive the locating piece.

title_en: External mobile phone heat radiation structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an external mobile phone radiating structure, which belongs to the technical field of mobile phone radiating, and comprises a bottom plate, wherein the bottom plate is sequentially provided with semiconductor refrigeration borneol, a hot end radiating aluminum piece and a radiating fan from bottom to top at the position of the semiconductor refrigeration borneol, one end of the bottom plate is in sliding connection with a hollow-structure air duct, and a roller fan is arranged in the air duct.

title_en: Air quality monitoring device based on multiple gas sensors and visual sensor
abstract_en: The utility model aims to solve the problem that the existing air quality monitoring device lacks an image acquisition function; providing an air quality monitoring device based on a plurality of gas sensors and visual sensors; the device comprises a shell, a plurality of detection sensors, a communication module and a main controller operation module; the detection sensors are respectively connected with the main controller operation module in a communication way; the main controller operation module is also in communication connection with the communication module; the detection sensors are arranged in the shell and are used for detecting gas; the system also comprises a vision sensor module for acquiring image data; the vision sensor module comprises an optical lens which is connected with the main controller operation module; image data is timely acquired through the vision sensor module, and the environmental conditions around the monitoring device are comprehensively mastered.

title_en: Ultrathin heat-conducting gasket for mobile phone
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of heat-conducting gaskets, and particularly relates to an ultrathin heat-conducting gasket for a mobile phone, which comprises an outer frame, wherein a base is fixedly arranged on one side of the lower part of the outer frame, an adhesive sheet is fixedly arranged below the base, a radiating fin is fixedly arranged below the inner part of the outer frame, a first heat-conducting fin is arranged above the radiating fin, heat-conducting silica gel is fixedly arranged above the first heat-conducting fin, a mounting patch is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the outer frame, a heat-conducting groove is fixedly arranged inside one side of the radiating fin, a heat-conducting plate is fixedly arranged inside the heat-conducting groove, a first heat-conducting block is movably connected inside the heat-conducting plate, a spring is fixedly connected below the heat-conducting plate, a limiting block is fixedly connected below the spring, a ceramic seat is fixedly connected above the ceramic seat, and a second heat-conducting block is arranged above the ceramic seat. According to the utility model, the heat conduction structure inside the heat conduction gasket has good toughness through the arrangement of the heat conduction silica gel and the spring, so that the service life of the heat conduction gasket is prolonged.

title_en: Fixing structure of high-power L-band microwave antenna
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fixing structure of a high-power L-band microwave antenna, which mainly comprises a supporting column body and an antenna fixing component, wherein the antenna fixing component is fixed on the supporting column body and used for fixing the microwave antenna, the antenna fixing component comprises a first clamping mechanism, a second clamping mechanism and a connecting piece positioned between the first clamping mechanism and the second clamping mechanism, the first clamping mechanism and the second clamping mechanism are arranged up and down symmetrically and are fixedly connected with the supporting column body, the upper end and the lower end of the connecting piece are respectively connected with the first clamping mechanism and the second clamping mechanism, and one side of the connecting piece, which is far away from the supporting column body, is fixedly connected with the microwave antenna. The fixing structure provided by the utility model is convenient for disassembling the microwave antenna for maintenance or replacement in the later period.

title_en: Resident user room temperature collection system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a resident user room temperature acquisition device, comprising: the information acquisition module is used for acquiring the room temperature data of the resident user, a test element of the information acquisition module is arranged in the user entity, and the output end of the information acquisition module is connected with an acquisition port of the main control module; the wireless transmission module is used for uploading the acquired room temperature data of the residential users to a remote end in a wireless transmission mode, and a control port of the wireless transmission module is connected with an output port of the main control module; the main control module is used for controlling the information acquisition module to acquire the room temperature data of the resident user on one hand and controlling the wireless transmission module to upload the room temperature data of the resident user to a remote end on the other hand; and the power supply module is used for supplying power to the information acquisition module, the wireless transmission module and the main control module. The utility model can automatically upload the acquired temperature data to the far end, and the distributed real-time acquisition of the temperature data is convenient for heating enterprises to design a targeted heating scheme.

title_en: Anti-falling mobile phone protection shell
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-falling mobile phone protective shell, which comprises a main body, a first backboard, a second backboard and a magnet, wherein the first backboard is arranged on the main body; the main body is provided with a protection block, a first groove is formed in the main body along the inner wall and one side of the protection block in a surrounding mode, the first backboard and the second backboard are arranged in the first groove, and the magnet is arranged between the first backboard and the second backboard; the mobile phone is arranged between the first lug and the second lug; a second groove, a third groove and a fourth groove are formed in the main body between the first bump and the second bump, and the positions of the second groove and the third groove are symmetrical; the first lug, the second groove, the third groove and the fourth groove are provided with step surfaces, the edges of the periphery of the mobile phone are arranged on the step surfaces, when the mobile phone shell is collided, the second groove, the third groove and the fourth groove form an air bag effect to generate buffer, and the mobile phone is protected secondarily.

title_en: Three-dimensional adjustable device of microwave moisture meter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of microwave moisture meters. The technical proposal is as follows: the utility model provides a device that microwave moisture appearance can three-dimensionally regulate which characterized in that: comprises a lower bracket, a first antenna mounting seat fixed on the lower bracket, an upper bracket capable of being vertically and movably positioned on the lower bracket, and a second antenna mounting seat capable of being horizontally and movably positioned on the upper bracket; the upper bracket and the lower bracket are connected through a vertical adjusting component; the second antenna mounting seat is connected with the upper bracket through a horizontal adjusting component; the first antenna mounting seat and the second antenna mounting seat are correspondingly arranged. The device can adjust the relative positions of the microwave transmitting antenna and the microwave receiving antenna of the microwave moisture meter in the three-dimensional direction so as to improve the use flexibility of the microwave moisture meter, and has the characteristics of simple structure and convenient operation.

title_en: Interference equipment convenient to adjust
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electronic information and discloses interference equipment convenient to adjust, which comprises an interference device body, wherein a fixed seat is arranged on the interference device body, a mounting hole is formed in the fixed seat, a rotating block is rotationally connected in the middle of the fixed seat through a damping rotating shaft, a limiting plug block is fixedly connected on the rotating block, and a connecting rod is rotationally connected to the back side of the interference device body through the damping rotating shaft; this kind of novel interference equipment that is applied to and is convenient for adjust through setting up adjusting part, can set up the interference ware body on the wall through the fixing base, and then through adjusting part and commentaries on classics piece to and rotate the connecting rod of connecting at the interference ware body dorsal part can ensure all the time that the operating end of interference ware body openly all the time and staff contacts, not only can adjust the position of interference ware body on the fixing base like this, can rotate the angle of interference ware body to the visual angle of operating with the staff after rotating in addition and match.

title_en: Anti-falling transmission equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses anti-falling transmission equipment, which relates to the technical field of information transmission and comprises a shell, wherein sliding grooves are formed in two sides of the shell, a sliding block is connected to the inner wall of each sliding groove in a sliding manner, a sliding shaft is connected to the inner wall of each sliding block in a sliding manner, fixing blocks are fixedly connected to two sides of the shell, one sides of each fixing block are fixedly connected with two ends of each sliding shaft.

title_en: Cavity 3DB bridge
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a cavity 3DB bridge in the field of bridges, wherein the interior of the bridge body is provided with a cavity, bridge coupling sheets are arranged in the cavity, each bridge coupling sheet is provided with two bridge coupling sheets, the two bridge coupling sheets are overlapped in a mirror image way, the bridge body is provided with an input connector and an output connector, the input connector and the output connector are symmetrical to each other, the input connector and the output connector are respectively provided with a pair, the input connector is symmetrically arranged on one side of the bridge body, the output connector is symmetrically arranged on the other side of the bridge body, the connecting end of the input connector and the connecting end of the output connector extend into the cavity, the two ends of one bridge coupling sheet are connected with the input connector, and the two ends of the output connector are connected with the two ends of the other bridge coupling sheet. The cavity 3DB bridge adopts a cavity type design to replace a micro-strip circuit board bridge, realizes full-frequency-band network coverage, can be used indoors and outdoors, and has high product power, small loss and low intermodulation.

title_en: Humidity sensor based on Lora wireless data transmission
