abstract_en: The utility model discloses a humidity sensor based on Lora wireless data transmission, which comprises a humidity sensing unit, an embedded MCU unit, a Lora transmission unit and a power supply unit. The humidity sensing unit converts humidity data into digital signals by adopting a capacitive humidity conversion chip; the embedded MCU unit adopts an STM32F103 chip, is connected with the humidity sensing unit through an IIC interface, reads humidity data, and transmits the humidity data to the upper computer through the Lora transmission unit after filtering data processing. The power supply unit converts 5V direct current power supply into 3.3V direct current and supplies power for the humidity sensing unit, the embedded MCU unit and the Lora transmission unit after voltage stabilization. Compared with the traditional humidity sensor, the humidity sensor has the advantages of long communication distance, low power consumption, high reliability, no need of wiring and the like.

title_en: Antenna card holds in palm and has circuit board of this card support
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an antenna card support and a circuit board with the same, comprising a card support plate, wherein a U-shaped buckle is arranged on one side wall of the card support plate, an L-shaped card support leg extends out of one side, far away from the U-shaped buckle, of the bottom surface of the card support plate, the card support leg faces towards one side, far away from the U-shaped buckle, of the card support plate, a vertical plate forming a clamping groove extends out of the bottom surface of the card support plate, a clamping groove through hole is formed in the bottom surface of the clamping groove, a supporting leg extends out of the bottom surface of the card support plate, far away from the side edge of the card support leg or the side edge adjacent to the card support leg, and the height of the supporting leg is higher than that of the vertical plate and smaller than that of the card support leg.

title_en: Antenna of microwave communication device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of microwave communication and discloses an antenna of a microwave communication device, which comprises a box body, wherein an elevating mechanism is fixedly connected to the inside of the box body, a rotating mechanism is fixedly connected to the top of the elevating mechanism, the elevating mechanism comprises a fixed cross beam, first motors are fixedly connected to the two sides of the inside of the fixed cross beam, screw rods are fixedly connected to the output ends of the first motors, second limiting blocks are fixedly connected to the tops of the screw rods, movable plates are connected to the outer threads of the screw rods, opening and closing assemblies are fixedly connected to the two sides of the movable plates, the opening and closing assemblies comprise second rotating pins, and the bottoms of the second rotating pins are fixedly connected to the upper sides of the movable plates. According to the utility model, the antenna is protected by the arrangement of the box body and the box cover, the service life of the antenna device is prolonged, the normal and stable transmission of microwave signals is ensured, and the signal transmission range is increased by the arrangement of the second motor.

title_en: Wireless communication and LED driver based on industrial Ethernet
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of wireless communication and LED drivers, and discloses an industrial Ethernet-based wireless communication and LED driver, which comprises an LED driver main body, wherein a standby IO port is arranged at the left upper corner of the front end surface of the LED driver main body, a 24V power input end is arranged at the right upper corner of the front end surface of the LED driver main body, a nixie tube is arranged at the right lower part of the standby IO port and positioned at the front end surface of the LED driver main body, an adding key is arranged below the nixie tube, a subtracting key is arranged at the right side of the adding key, a determining key is arranged at the right side of the subtracting key, an NRF communication module is arranged right below the 24V power input end, a network port module is arranged below the NRF communication module, and a lamp strip interface is arranged at the left lower corner of the LED driver main body. The utility model can carry out remote communication and also can carry out switching of equipment through the wireless communication device, and has convenient use and strong practicability.

title_en: Positioning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a positioning device, which comprises: the device comprises a shell, a bottom cover and a circuit board, wherein the circuit board is arranged in the shell; the bottom cover is provided with a boss and an antenna structure, the antenna structure is clung to the bottom cover through a film, the boss is provided with an electrode plate, the antenna structure extends to the boss and is connected with the electrode plate, the circuit board is provided with a metal plate, when the shell and the bottom cover are covered, a preset distance is formed between the antenna structure and the circuit board, and the metal plate is connected with the electrode plate and keeps a connection state. When the positioning device starts to operate, the circuit board and the antenna structure keep a certain distance, and the antenna structure is attached to the bottom cover by the film, so that the risk of mutual interference of the circuit board and the antenna structure is reduced to a great extent, and the positioning accuracy of the positioning device is improved.

title_en: Novel dustproof intercom
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an interphone, and provides a novel dustproof interphone, which comprises an interphone shell and a dustproof plate, wherein an opening for plugging an earphone hole, a microphone hole and a charging interface is formed in the upper part of the side wall of the interphone shell, a slot for accommodating the dustproof plate is formed in the side wall of the interphone shell, the slot penetrates through the opening in the side wall, and the dustproof plate can be arranged in the slot in a manner of sliding up and down to open the opening or sealing the opening. The utility model solves the problems of inconvenient use and short service life of the dustproof cover on the existing interphone shell.

title_en: BITS clock interface and 2M service interface multiplexing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of communication, in particular to a BITS clock interface and 2M service interface multiplexing device; the circuit comprises a panel, a comparator, a line interface unit, a processor and a clock recovery unit; through setting up input interface and output interface on the panel, input and output 2M service signal and BITS clock signal to generate the selection signal through comparator and treater, select corresponding signal output to the panel, under the condition that does not increase panel interface and LIU chip, multiplexing BITS external clock interface and 2M service interface, realized having reduced the bulk cost of equipment under the condition that does not reduce the equipment function.

title_en: Interface cabinet simulation driver remotely controlled in short distance
abstract_en: The utility model provides a short-distance remote control interface cabinet simulation driver, which comprises a singlechip ESP-32 with a Bluetooth connection function, wherein the singlechip ESP-32 is fixed on a bread board, a power supply module supplies power to the singlechip ESP-32 through a USB data line, a mobile phone is interconnected and communicated with the singlechip ESP-32 through Bluetooth connection, the singlechip ESP-32 is connected with a relay module through a DuPont line for controlling and supplying power, a common end of the relay is connected in parallel through a power line and leads out a power connector, and a normally open contact of the relay module is connected with a point position of an aviation plug through the power line. The utility model has simple structure, reasonable design and convenient use, and can control the driving of the relay through the mobile phone when the signal engineering monomer is tested, thereby improving the test efficiency.

title_en: Distribution frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a distribution frame, which comprises: the frame body is hollow, at least one row of mounting holes are formed in the front surface of the frame body at equal intervals, limiting holes are formed in the upper end face or the lower end face of each mounting hole, and when two rows of mounting holes are formed in the mounting holes, the limiting holes in the two rows of mounting holes are oppositely arranged; the connecting sleeve is detachably inserted into the mounting hole, and a propping piece is arranged on the connecting sleeve and propped against the inner wall of the mounting hole; the optical fiber adapter is detachably inserted into the connecting sleeve; by the design of the utility model, the installation number and the installation position of the optical fiber adapter and the network module can be adaptively adjusted according to actual demands, the overall flexibility and the universality are improved, the structure is simple, the production is convenient, and the defect of the conventional distribution frame in use is overcome.

title_en: Power amplifier module for L-band satellite active antenna
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a power amplifier module for an L-band satellite active antenna, which relates to the technical field of communication and comprises a shell, wherein a motor bin is arranged on the surface of the shell, a transmission mechanism is arranged in the motor bin, and a first heat dissipation plate is arranged in an inner cavity of the shell. According to the utility model, when the temperature sensor sends out a signal, the heat radiation fan is started, the servo motor is started to drive the driven rod to rotate through the transmission rod and the first transmission belt, the driven rod drives the driven column to rotate through the second transmission belt, the driven column drives the stop block to move through the gear and the rack to ventilate the heat radiation holes, meanwhile, the lifting sleeve is driven by threads to descend with the misplaced heat radiation plate, so that the holes formed in the surface of the misplaced heat radiation plate are relatively far away from the second heat radiation plate to ventilate and radiate heat, the internal temperature can be rapidly reduced, and when the device is in a standby mode, the device is closed through the temperature sensor transmission mechanism when the temperature is low, so that dust prevention is carried out.

title_en: Elevator call mechanism with wide universality
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an elevator call mechanism with wide universality, which comprises a panel, a mounting box and an elevator call circuit board, wherein a high-fidelity loudspeaker, an emergency call button, a sound pick-up and a storage bin are arranged on the panel, a bin door with a magnetic stripe is further arranged on the storage bin, the bin door is connected with the panel through a hinge, a storage partition plate, a first hanging plate and a second hanging plate are fixedly arranged in the storage bin, the first hanging plate and the second hanging plate can be matched and clamped, the first hanging plate is fixedly designed on the storage partition plate, the second hanging plate is fixedly designed on the sound pick-up, a telephone curve is further arranged on the sound pick-up, the telephone curve is stored in the storage bin, and the telephone curve is respectively in telecommunication connection with the sound pick-up and the elevator call circuit board. The pick-up through the design can be taken down, only need open the bin gate then take out the pick-up when crowd of different heights uses, and telephone curve can be prolonged, just so can adapt to the people of different heights and use, uses convenience more, and the universality is wide.

title_en: Digital modulation circuit of mobile phone signal shielding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a digital modulation circuit of a mobile phone signal shielding device, which comprises a CPLD circuit, a synthesis circuit, an integration circuit, a VCO circuit and an amplifier circuit; the CPLD circuit is respectively connected with one end of the integrating circuit and one end of the synthesizing circuit; the other ends of the integrating circuit and the synthesizing circuit are connected with one end of the VCO circuit, the other end of the VCO circuit is connected with the amplifier circuit, and the amplifier circuit is connected with the external circuit and is used for outputting digital modulation signals; the CPLD circuit is used for generating a random digital waveform signal. The circuit of the utility model can generate the digital modulation interference signal of the mobile phone frequency band in a targeted way. The modulation signal is simulated according to the detected mobile phone signal, so that mobile phone communication can be effectively blocked; and corresponding interference signals are generated for different use environments, so that the interference efficiency of the equipment is improved. Compared with the prior art, the shielding circuit has better interference effect through a shielding mode of a simple sawtooth wave VCO.

title_en: Lens support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lens support, which relates to the technical field of lens supports, and comprises a support, wherein one side of the support is provided with a rotating rod, the inside of the rotating rod is provided with a rotating shaft hole, the bottom of the rotating rod is provided with a fixing piece, the rotating rod and the fixing piece are integrally formed, and the fixing piece is arranged below the support; the fixing piece is provided with a plurality of groups of through holes, a positioning ring is further arranged below the support, a plurality of groups of rivets are arranged at the bottom or the top of the positioning ring, and the through holes are matched with the rivets. The utility model is designed aiming at the existing needs, the rotating shaft can rotate in the rotating rod through the rotating support, so that the lens support is formed, and the rotating rod and the rotating shaft which are made of metal materials are not easy to age when being used, and are more durable, more stable and strong in practicability.

title_en: Edge computing gateway radiating assembly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of radiators, and discloses an edge computing gateway radiating component which comprises a radiating shell, wherein the radiating shell is U-shaped, and radiating fins are arranged on two outer side surfaces and one outer bottom surface of the radiating shell; a heat conducting partition plate is arranged between the two inner side surfaces of the heat radiating shell, and the heat conducting partition plate divides the space in the heat radiating shell into an upper cavity and a lower cavity for installing the circuit board; the inner bottom surface of the heat dissipation shell and the upper side surface of the heat conduction partition plate are respectively provided with a plurality of connecting columns for installing the circuit board. The utility model has the beneficial effect of good heat dissipation effect.

title_en: Optical device, optical transceiver module and related equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an optical device, an optical transceiver component and related equipment which can be applied to FTTR scenes. The optical device is used for converting an electrical signal into an optical signal for transmission or converting an optical signal into an electrical signal. The optical device has a base including a substrate and electrical pins. The base member includes first surface, second surface and side, and first surface sets up with the second surface is relative, and the side is connected in first surface and second surface, and the side includes the mounting plane, and the mounting plane is used for covering the heat conduction pad in order to be connected with optical communication equipment's casing part to heat conduction to casing part that the light device produced through the heat conduction pad. The electrical pins are arranged on the second surface and are used for being electrically connected with a circuit board of the optical communication equipment. Because the heat conducting pad covers the installation plane, the contact area and the heat radiating area of the side face and the heat conducting pad are increased, the heat radiating efficiency of the optical device is improved, the optical device can work normally at the working temperature, and the optical performance of the optical device is improved.

title_en: Portable network switch based on cloud computing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cloud computing-based portable network switch, which comprises a switch main body, wherein a joint groove is formed in the front surface of the switch main body, network cable interfaces which are arranged at equal intervals are arranged in the joint groove, a sliding groove communicated with the joint groove is formed in the bottom of the switch main body, and a moving block is connected in the sliding groove in a sliding mode. According to the utility model, the sealing plate is opened through the buckling piece, ninety degrees of rotation is carried out to enable the sealing plate and the moving block to be horizontal, then the sealing plate is pushed into the inside of the chute to be contained, the network cable interface inside the attaching groove is exposed, then the network cable is connected in a butt joint mode, the cloud computing network is accessed for data exchange transmission, when the equipment is carried and moved, the network cable is pulled out, the sealing plate is pulled out along the chute, and ninety degrees of breaking the sealing plate is carried out, so that the sealing plate is clamped into the inside of the attaching groove to realize sealing protection of the network cable interface, and therefore the device has the advantage of protecting the butt joint when carrying the mobile equipment.

title_en: Portable knapsack platform suitable for ad hoc network
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable knapsack table suitable for an ad hoc network, which relates to the field of knapsack tables and comprises a mounting seat, wherein two sides of the mounting seat are fixedly connected with support plates, threaded holes are formed in the support plates, and guide holes are formed in the support plates at positions close to the threaded holes; the utility model has the advantages that: the position of the fixing plate can be adjusted by matching the bolt, the clamping ring and the clamping ring with the supporting plate and the threaded holes in the supporting plate, so that the main body of the backpack table can be limited and fixed, and meanwhile, the flexibility of taking the main body of the backpack table can be improved to a certain extent by the adjustable fixing plate; the shock-absorbing assembly formed by the fixing rod, the rotating plate, the connecting block, the connecting rod, the damping rod and the spring can form multiple shock-absorbing buffers, so that the frequency of vibration of the backpack body during transportation on a vehicle is reduced, and meanwhile, the safety and stability of the backpack body can be improved.

title_en: Multi-point temperature and humidity billboard monitoring system based on MQTT protocol
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of environmental monitoring, in particular to a multi-point temperature and humidity billboard monitoring system based on an MQTT protocol, the multipoint temperature and humidity billboard monitoring system comprises a plurality of temperature and humidity sensors which are distributed in a place to be monitored and used for collecting temperature and humidity signals, a server which is in communication connection with each temperature and humidity sensor through an MQTT protocol, and at least one temperature and humidity billboard which is in communication connection with the server through the MQTT protocol and used for indicating temperature and humidity conditions. The system is provided with a plurality of temperature sensors in a distributed manner, and the temperature and humidity signals acquired at multiple points are closer to the real temperature and humidity conditions of the places, so that the reliability is higher; the MQTT protocol is used for transmitting signals instead of adopting a wired connection mode, a large number of burial lines are not required to be laid manually, the influence of the scale of factories and workshops and the position of monitoring points is small, and the input cost of temperature and humidity monitoring and the installation difficulty of the system are reduced.

title_en: Remote control device of automatic bird repeller for airport
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an airport automatic bird repellent remote control device which comprises a remote control body, wherein a signal transmitter is fixed at the top of the remote control body, a touch screen is fixed at the left side of the remote control body, control buttons are fixed at the left side of the remote control body, auxiliary buttons are fixed on the front surface and the back surface of the remote control body, clamping grooves are fixed at the bottom of the front surface of the remote control body, a clamping mechanism is fixed at the right side of the remote control body, a carrying assembly is fixed at the bottom of the right side of the remote control body, and the clamping mechanism comprises a working bin fixed with the right side of the remote control body. This automatic bird ware remote control device of driving in airport aims at the support with the fixture in remote control body left side, rotates fixture for fixture can fix with the support, makes the remote control body can fix a position and put, thereby realizes fixing in the location of the automatic bird ware remote control device of driving in airport, prevents to hand-carry the purpose that leads to bird ware remote control device to lose.

title_en: Eight-array antenna unfolding and folding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an eight-array antenna unfolding and folding device, which comprises a regular eight-prism-shaped unfolding and folding main body and unfolding and folding plates arranged on the outer side of the unfolding and folding main body, wherein the unfolding and folding main body comprises an upper cover plate, a lower cover plate and eight wall plates arranged between the upper cover plate and the lower cover plate, and the unfolding and folding plates comprise eight unfolding plates for installing antennas, wherein the eight unfolding plates are sequentially arranged from left to right and comprise a first unfolding plate, a second unfolding plate, a third unfolding plate, a fourth unfolding plate, a fifth folding plate, a sixth folding plate, a seventh folding plate and an eight folding mechanism for driving the eight unfolding plates to be in two states of unfolding and folding, and the adjacent unfolding plates are connected through hinge joints. The utility model can simultaneously install eight strip-shaped block antennas, and has small occupied space in the folded state, and is convenient and quick to unfold.

title_en: Bluetooth tracking device with stable endurance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a Bluetooth tracking device with stable endurance, which comprises a shell, wherein the shell comprises a middle frame, and a circuit board and a battery electrically connected with the circuit board are accommodated in the middle frame; the solar panel is characterized in that a first mounting groove and a second mounting groove are respectively formed in two sides of the middle frame, a first cover plate is embedded in the first mounting groove, a second cover plate is embedded in the second mounting groove, at least one of the first cover plate and the second cover plate is a solar panel, and the solar panel is electrically connected with the circuit board. According to the utility model, the solar panel is used for charging, and the device can be used for charging at any place with illumination, so that the convenience of use is improved. Meanwhile, as the solar panel can provide power for the equipment at any time, the cruising ability of the equipment is also obviously improved.

title_en: Intelligent security equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses intelligent security equipment, which comprises: the intelligent security gate comprises a first security gate, a second security gate, an infrared sensing sensor assembly and a face recognition mechanism, wherein the infrared sensing sensor assembly is arranged on the first security gate and the second security gate respectively, the upper surface of the second security gate is inwards sunken with a mounting groove, and the face recognition mechanism is arranged in the mounting groove. The utility model overcomes the defects that in the prior art, the device adjusts the height of the face recognition screen through the toothed plate, then carries out face recognition, and reduces the recognition efficiency, thereby greatly reducing the passing efficiency and causing traffic jam when the traffic is large. Therefore, the intelligent security equipment can automatically and quickly capture the face of the user to improve the passing efficiency.

title_en: Mobile phone card bag with support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mobile phone card bag with a bracket, which comprises a bottom plate, a shell and a bracket component; the bottom plate is inserted into the shell, a gap is formed between the bottom plate and the shell, and the bracket component is movably connected with the shell; the bracket component comprises a supporting part, a supporting seat and a movable connecting piece for connecting the supporting part and the supporting seat; the shell is provided with a first through hole, and the supporting seat is embedded in the first through hole; the supporting part is provided with a limiting part, and a plurality of sequentially ordered limiting strips are arranged in the limiting part; one part of the movable connecting piece is arranged in the limiting piece and is limited between the limiting strips; the card is placed in the shell, the elastic sheet limits the card in the shell, and the second baffle limits the distance of the card inserted into the shell; the supporting seat can rotate 360 degrees on the third baffle plate and support the mobile phone card bag at different angles; when the supporting seat rotates to a proper angle, the water drop grooves and the salient points are limited; can support the mobile phone, can accomodate the card again, convenient and practical.

title_en: Floating base station
abstract_en: The application discloses a floating base station, which comprises a floating main body and a base station main body, wherein the base station main body is assembled on the floating main body; the base station main body comprises at least two wireless communication modules, and at least one wireless communication module is in wireless communication connection with the underwater equipment. The purpose of simultaneously communicating with a plurality of different devices can be achieved by arranging a plurality of wireless communication modules, in addition, the base station can also communicate with the underwater device by arranging at least one wireless communication module which is specially used for communicating with the underwater device, and a designer can set the number of the wireless communication modules for communicating with the underwater device according to the requirement. Compared with the prior art, the floating base station disclosed by the application can achieve the purpose of improving the communication quality and speed when communicating equipment under the water surface.

title_en: Mobile terminal
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mobile terminal which can be applied to the field of communication. A mobile terminal includes: a terminal body; and when one end of the extension line is connected with the main board ground of the terminal body, the extension line is used as an extension ground of the main board ground.

title_en: Coupling adjusting structure and filter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of communication, and provides a coupling adjusting structure and a filter. The coupling adjusting structure comprises a connecting sheet, two coupling sheets, a first mounting sheet and a second mounting sheet, wherein the coupling sheets are perpendicular to each other in pairs, the height direction, the thickness direction and the width direction, the projection area of the coupling sheets in the thickness direction is larger than the projection area of the coupling sheets in the width direction, the coupling sheets are provided with a first end part and a second end part in the height direction, the first end parts of the two coupling sheets are respectively connected with two ends of the connecting sheet, the first mounting sheet and the second mounting sheet are connected to the second end part, the first mounting sheet and the second mounting sheet are distributed at intervals along the height direction to form clamping intervals, and the first mounting sheet is positioned above the second mounting sheet. The coupling adjusting structure is of a sheet structure, the weight is greatly reduced, and the coupling adjusting structure and the light weight design of the filter are facilitated.

title_en: Device for reducing transmission microwave loss of MPCVD equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a device for reducing microwave loss of transmission of MPCVD equipment, which comprises a microwave waveguide conversion piece, wherein a microwave consumption reducing component for the transmission of the MPCVD equipment is arranged at the top of the microwave waveguide conversion piece, the microwave consumption reducing component comprises a round corner structure which is arranged inside the microwave waveguide conversion piece, four chamfer structures are arranged inside the microwave waveguide conversion piece, a silver plating layer is electroplated on the surface of a waveguide is electroplated inside the microwave waveguide conversion piece, and a metal microwave cutoff baffle is arranged at the inner height of the microwave waveguide conversion piece. According to the device for reducing the microwave transmission loss of the MPCVD equipment, the surface and the inside of the microwave waveguide conversion piece are plated with silver, so that the microwave transmission loss is reduced, the structure of the microwave piece is optimized, and the fillet structure and the chamfer structure formed in the microwave waveguide conversion piece reduce the tip discharge and the gap discharge, and the microwave transmission loss is reduced, so that the effect of reducing the microwave loss is achieved.

title_en: Interface sealing mechanism of POE switch
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an interface sealing mechanism of a POE (Power over Ethernet) switch, which relates to the technical field of POE switches and comprises a switch body, wherein a group of interfaces which are arranged in an equidistant manner are arranged on the switch body, a second rectangular plate is arranged on the front surface of the switch body, a group of sealing assemblies are arranged on the second rectangular plate, and the sealing assemblies are in one-to-one correspondence with the interfaces. It is through the cooperation between seal assembly and the second right angle plate, when some interfaces are in use, and another part of interfaces are not when using, can seal the protection to the interface that is not using, thereby can avoid the dust to enter into in the interface that is not using, the poor contact appears when leading to it to use next time, through setting up the rectangle frame, can hide the spring, thereby can improve the whole aesthetic property of device, through setting up the heat dissipation window, under the radiating prerequisite of not influencing the switch body, can avoid dust and impurity etc. to enter into the inside of switch body.

title_en: Waterproof ball-type security monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waterproof ball-type security monitoring device which comprises a mounting frame, wherein a positioning pipe is fixedly arranged on one side of the mounting frame, a telescopic pipe is connected inside the positioning pipe in a sliding mode, a fixing block is connected to the telescopic pipe in a rotating mode, a camera body is fixedly connected to the bottom of the fixing block, and a protection cover is arranged at the bottom of the camera body. According to the utility model, the waterproof mechanism is arranged to protect the camera body and the upper part of the protective cover in rainy days, so that the camera body can be prevented from being corroded by rainwater, then when dust and the like on the surface of the protective cover are accumulated more, the pushing mechanism is started to drive the telescopic pipe, the camera body and the protective cover to move along the positioning pipe, so that the protective cover can be attached to the cleaning mechanism, and then the rotating mechanism drives the fixing block, the camera body and the protective cover to rotate reciprocally, so that the dust on the surface of the protective cover can be scraped by the fixed cleaning mechanism.

title_en: Sphygmomanometer with identification information and wireless communication module
abstract_en: The utility model provides a blood pressure instrument with identification information and a wireless communication module, which comprises: the blood pressure monitor comprises a blood pressure monitor body and a cuff, wherein a connecting pipe is arranged on the cuff, a plug is arranged at one end of the connecting pipe, a jack is arranged on the blood pressure monitor body, a first fixing piece is arranged on the outer portion of the blood pressure monitor body, the first fixing piece is located on the outer portion of the jack, a fixing block is arranged at one end of the plug, and a second fixing piece is movably arranged around the connecting pipe. When the plug connector is used, a user can be clamped with the clamping block outside the first fixing piece through the clamping piece arranged outside the second fixing piece, so that the fixing block is clamped and fixed, the plug on the connecting pipe can be more stable after the connection is completed, the loose phenomenon in the use process is avoided, the installed plug can be protected, and the possibility that the plug is broken into the jack due to external collision and other factors in the use process is prevented.

title_en: Watch type medical call receiver
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical auxiliary tools, and discloses a watch type medical call receiver which comprises a main body mechanism and an auxiliary mechanism, wherein the auxiliary mechanism is positioned on the right side of the main body mechanism, the main body mechanism comprises a receiver body, a touch screen and a protective cover, the touch screen is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the receiver body, the protective cover is movably arranged at the upper end of the receiver body, and the main body mechanism further comprises an observation window and a connecting seat. This wrist-watch formula medical call receiver has realized that this receiver body can wear the use when using through installing main part mechanism, and this receiver body can provide good protective effect for the touch-sensitive screen, when guaranteeing that medical personnel can observe the display information, can avoid medical personnel to touch the condition of touch-sensitive screen by mistake to appear, can reduce the wearing and tearing that bring the touch-sensitive screen in the receiver body use simultaneously, has improved the security and the protectiveness that this receiver body used.

title_en: Bluetooth transmitter capable of supporting USB-A and USB-C interfaces simultaneously
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of Bluetooth equipment, in particular to A Bluetooth transmitter capable of supporting USB-A and USB-C interfaces simultaneously, which comprises A shell and A PCBA board arranged in the shell, wherein both sides of the PCBA board are respectively provided with A USB-A male interface and A USB-C male interface, and the USB-A male interface and the USB-C male interface extend to the outer surface of the shell. The utility model is compatible with various devices and is convenient for users to use and carry.

title_en: Magnetic attraction type electronic equipment support and shell
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electronic equipment accessories, in particular to a magnetic electronic equipment bracket and a shell. The magnetic electronic equipment support comprises a support seat, supporting legs and a mounting seat which are made of nonmetal materials. The mounting seat sleeved with the damping ring is penetrated into the mounting hole on the support seat, and meanwhile, the support seat can rotate around the first positioning seat of the mounting seat. The damping ring between the support seat and the mounting seat plays a role in preventing loosening, and the service life of the support is prolonged. During assembly, the damping ring is sleeved on the first positioning seat, and then the first positioning seat penetrates through the mounting hole in the support seat, so that the damping ring is extruded by the first positioning seat in the mounting hole in the support seat. The assembly does not damage the bracket fittings and is more convenient. The support seat, the support legs and the mounting seat are made of nonmetallic materials, so that the wireless charging requirement can be met. The magnet is arranged inside the supporting leg, so that the electronic equipment can be firmly fixed on the charging plate for charging.

title_en: Lifting type communication antenna supporting rod
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lifting type communication antenna supporting rod which comprises a supporting column, wherein an adjusting groove is formed in the top end of the supporting column, a supporting rod main body penetrates through the adjusting groove, a supporting plate is installed at the top end of the supporting rod main body, guide holes are formed in two sides of the supporting column, guide blocks are installed in the guide holes, and one side of each guide block is connected with the bottom end of the outer side of the supporting column. According to the utility model, through the lifting action of the lifting ring, the steel wire rope can be adjusted according to the change of the supporting height, so that the supporting effect of the steel wire rope on the supporting column is better, the winding of the steel wire rope on the fixing plate is utilized, the unfolding length of the steel wire rope can be adjusted according to actual needs, and the functions of the limiting plate, the fixing thorn, the fixing cone and the like are matched, so that the free loosening and the scattering of the steel wire rope are avoided, and the limiting stability of the steel wire rope is improved.

title_en: Split type pivot structure of cell-phone
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rotating shaft structures, in particular to a split type rotating shaft structure of a mobile phone, which comprises a base, a first assembly seat, a second assembly seat, a first transmission assembly, a second transmission assembly, a first support, a first rotating shaft, a second support and a second rotating shaft, wherein the first assembly seat and the second assembly seat are arranged on the base at intervals up and down, the first transmission assembly is arranged between the first assembly seat and the base in a rotating mode, the second transmission assembly is arranged between the second assembly seat and the base in a rotating mode, the first support is connected with the first transmission assembly in a transmission mode, the second support is connected with the second transmission assembly in a transmission mode, the first support is connected with the first transmission assembly in a transmission mode, the first support is connected with the second transmission assembly in a transmission mode, the second support is connected with the second support in a rotation mode, and the first support and the second support is driven by the first transmission assembly and the second transmission assembly to be close to or far away from each other. Compact structure and occupation space are little, easily assembly and processing, and it is high to rotate smoothness, improves structural strength and use experience and feel.

title_en: Wireless network serial port server
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wireless network serial port server, which relates to the technical field of wireless network serial port servers and comprises a machine body, wherein a power hole is formed in one side of the machine body, an antenna is arranged in one side of the machine body, a connecting port is formed in one side of the machine body, a clamping device is arranged in one side of the machine body, the clamping device comprises a rectangular frame, a connecting device is arranged between the rectangular frame and the machine body, a circular hole is formed in one side of the rectangular frame, a bidirectional screw rod is arranged in the circular hole, and the bidirectional screw rod is arranged in the rectangular frame.

title_en: Tracking receiving system based on phase shift switching
abstract_en: The utility model provides a tracking receiving system based on phase shift switching, which comprises a tracking receiver A, a tracking receiver B, a phase shift switching module and a phase shift synthesis module, wherein the tracking receiver A and the tracking receiver B are both in communication connection with a controlled end of the phase shift switching module by TTL, the phase shift switching module is in communication connection with the controlled end of the phase shift synthesis module by DIF, a signal output end of the phase shift synthesis module is connected with a signal input end of the phase shift switching module, and the signal output end of the phase shift switching module is in switching connection between the input end of the tracking receiver A and the input end of the tracking receiver B.

title_en: Radio frequency signal processing device and communication equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a radio frequency signal processing device and communication equipment, wherein the device comprises a receiving circuit, a transmitting circuit, a first baseband module, a second baseband module, a receiving multiplexing circuit and a transmitting multiplexing circuit, wherein the receiving multiplexing circuit is respectively in signal connection with the receiving circuit, the first baseband module and the second baseband module, the transmitting multiplexing circuit is respectively in signal connection with the transmitting circuit, the first baseband module and the second baseband module, and the first baseband module and the second baseband module respectively process the receiving and transmitting data of different communication standards. By using the scheme of the utility model, the area and the cost of the module or the communication equipment can be reduced, and the complexity of terminal implementation can be reduced.

title_en: Waterproof LDS antenna structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waterproof LDS antenna structure which comprises a fitting, wherein a sealing cover is arranged at the top end of the fitting, a first sealing groove is formed in the bottom end of the sealing cover, a first sealing pad is adhered to the top surface of the first sealing groove, a sealing table is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the fitting, the bottom end of the first sealing pad is contacted with the top end of the sealing table, and a sealing sheet is fixedly connected to the inner surface of the sealing cover and close to the edge. According to the LDS antenna, the connector is inserted into the connecting groove, so that the accessory is connected with the sealing cover, in the connecting process, the sealing table and the first sealing groove extrude the first sealing gasket and the sealing sheet and the second sealing groove extrude the second sealing gasket, the LDS antenna body is comprehensively sealed, the LDS antenna body is effectively prevented from contacting moisture, the mounting is convenient, the fixing is firm, the sealing performance is strong, and the service life of the LDS antenna body is prolonged.

title_en: Micro base station antenna sealing structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a micro base station antenna sealing structure, which comprises a bottom plate and an antenna housing covered with the bottom plate, wherein an annular first abutting structure is arranged on the top side of the bottom plate, a second abutting structure with the shape and the position matched with those of the first abutting structure and a sealing ring integrally connected to the bottom side of the second abutting structure in an injection molding mode are arranged on the bottom side of the antenna housing, when the antenna housing is covered with the bottom plate, the sealing ring abuts against the first abutting structure to realize sealing, and the antenna housing, the bottom plate, the first abutting structure, the second abutting structure and the sealing ring are jointly enclosed to form a containing cavity for installing an antenna assembly. According to the scheme, the number of materials can be reduced, the material cost is reduced, glue spraying is not needed in the assembly process, or a sealing ring is additionally installed, the installation time can be reduced, the production efficiency is improved, the product reliability is improved, the repair rate is reduced, and the sealing performance is ensured.

title_en: Waveguide assembly with adjustable phase
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of power transmission, in particular to a phase-adjustable waveguide assembly which comprises a front connector whole, a rear connector whole and a shell, wherein the front connector whole is pressed into the shell to form a front half part of the connector, the rear connector whole is pressed into the shell to form a rear half part of the connector, the rear half part of the connector is rotated into a front nut with the rear connector whole, a nut is sleeved outside the rear connector whole between the shell and the front nut, and a rear nut is further arranged on the rear side of the front nut. In the structure of the present utility model, the phase is adjusted by rotating the housing to increase the overall length, compared to the conventional one.

title_en: 5G communication antenna
abstract_en: The utility model provides a 5G communication antenna which comprises a mounting cylinder, wherein a mounting chassis is arranged in the mounting cylinder, a connecting block is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the mounting chassis, a mounting screw is connected onto the connecting block in a threaded manner, a communication module is fixedly arranged at the top end of the mounting screw, the communication module is connected with an antenna, and a matched mounting assembly is arranged between the mounting cylinder and the mounting chassis. The utility model is convenient for installing the antenna by matching the structures, has simple operation and is beneficial to popularization.

title_en: Reflection type polarization rotator
abstract_en: The application provides a reflective polarization rotator which comprises a reflective bottom plate, a dielectric layer and a metal patch, wherein the reflective bottom plate is used for reflecting electromagnetic waves, the dielectric layer is arranged on the upper surface of the reflective bottom plate, the metal patch is arranged on the upper surface of the dielectric layer, the horizontal section of the metal patch is of a Chinese character 'Wang' shape structure, and the central line of the Chinese character 'Wang' shape structure is inclined to the horizontal polarization direction and the vertical polarization direction. The reflection type polarization rotator provided by the application has wider working bandwidth and higher polarization conversion efficiency, and is simple in structure and more convenient to process and apply.

title_en: High-efficiency terminal antenna and mobile terminal
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-efficiency terminal antenna and a mobile terminal, wherein the high-efficiency terminal antenna comprises a feed point, a grounding point, a first radiation branch electrically connected with the feed point, a second radiation branch electrically connected with the grounding point, a third radiation branch and a fourth radiation branch, the third radiation branch is connected with the first radiation branch, the fourth radiation branch is connected with the third radiation branch, a first gap is formed between the first radiation branch and the second radiation branch, and a second gap is formed between the fourth radiation branch and the first radiation branch. The high-efficiency terminal antenna can effectively improve the radiation bandwidth of the antenna, thereby improving the overall radiation efficiency of the antenna and widening the radiation frequency band of the antenna.

title_en: Artificial intelligent remote control device for power equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an artificial intelligent remote control device for power equipment, which relates to the technical field of power equipment and comprises two threaded rods and a movable plate in threaded sleeve joint with the rod walls of the two threaded rods, wherein two mounting plates are symmetrically and fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the movable plate, two rotating rods are symmetrically arranged between the two mounting plates, the rod walls at two ends of each rotating rod are rotationally connected with the side walls of the corresponding mounting plates, a winding roller is fixedly sleeved on the rod wall of each rotating rod, steel ropes are wound on the surface of each winding roller, a guide mechanism is arranged between the two mounting plates, and each steel rope is matched with the guide mechanism. According to the utility model, through the arranged motor, the corresponding rotating rod can be driven to rotate in the working process of the motor, so that the other rotating rod can be driven to rotate through the two arranged gears, synchronous rotation of the two winding rollers can be realized, and the manufacturing cost and the later maintenance cost of the whole device are effectively reduced.

title_en: Cash collecting device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a cash register device which comprises a stand column, a base, an NFC module and a display screen. The base is fixed with the upright post so as to be supported on the table top. NFC module is located the top of stand. The display screen is located on the outer side of the radial direction of the upright post. The NFC module is used for being close to the electronic equipment to complete electronic payment or identity verification, a payment code or verification code does not need to be manually opened, payment efficiency is improved, the base is arranged, the stability of the collection equipment is improved, and the display screen can display the amount to be paid or the payment mode guide or payment result and the like so as to save the time of consultation and further improve the payment efficiency.

title_en: Film sticking device with rolling wheel integrated on upper cover
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of film sticking devices, in particular to a film sticking device with rolling wheels integrated on an upper cover, which is used for assisting in sticking a protective film on a screen to be stuck, and comprises a base and an upper cover which is positioned and covered on the base, wherein a positioning groove for positioning the screen to be stuck is formed in the base, the upper cover is connected with a rolling assembly which is used for rolling and sticking the protective film on the screen to be stuck in a sliding manner, the rolling assembly comprises a sliding main body and the rolling wheels which are rotationally connected at the lower end of the sliding main body, two ends of the sliding main body are respectively provided with an elastic hoop structure, sliding can be normally arranged on a guide rail along the upper cover in the assembling process, the assembling mode is simple, and a plurality of positions can be abutted and tightly generated between the sliding main body and the upper cover after the sliding main body and the upper cover are butted by utilizing the matching of the two elastic hoop structures, so that shaking can not be generated between the assembled sliding main body and the upper cover, the firm stability of the assembling is ensured, and the effect of the protective film and the using experience of a user are improved.

title_en: Auxiliary control rod piece for trusted WLAN access equipment installation
abstract_en: The utility model provides an auxiliary control rod piece for mounting trusted WLAN access equipment, which comprises a metal pipe, image pickup equipment fixed at the top of the metal pipe and wireless access equipment in the middle of the metal pipe, wherein an image pickup equipment threading pipe is arranged on the pipe wall at the top of the metal pipe, the pipe wall at the middle of the metal pipe is connected with the wireless access equipment threading pipe, a first grounding terminal is arranged below the wireless access equipment and is connected with the metal pipe or electrically, a grounding wire of the wireless access equipment is connected with the first grounding terminal, the lower part of the metal pipe is electrically connected with a second grounding terminal, the second grounding terminal is directly or indirectly connected with a grounding network, and the bottom of the metal pipe is used for being fixed through a concrete foundation.

title_en: Fixed knot constructs for 5G antenna PCB equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fixing structure for assembling a 5G antenna PCB, which comprises a workbench, wherein a base is arranged at the bottom end of the workbench, an adjusting mechanism is arranged at the top end of the workbench, a limiting component is arranged at one side of the top end of the workbench, the adjusting mechanism comprises a fixing box arranged in the top end of the workbench, sliding grooves are formed in the top end of the workbench, a screw is rotationally connected between the sliding grooves and the fixing box, a fluted disc is rotationally connected in the bottom end of the fixing box, a first rotating tooth is arranged at one end of the screw located in the fixing box, and a rotating rod is rotationally connected between the fixing box and the interior of the workbench, so that the effect of rapid fixing and limiting can be achieved according to the specification of a PCB.

title_en: DSP sound effect processing integrated circuit
abstract_en: The utility model provides a DSP sound effect processing integrated circuit, which relates to the field of DSP sound effect processing and comprises a power supply, a voltage stabilizing circuit, a display screen, a processor, a reset circuit, an encoder, an external interface circuit and a display screen driving circuit, wherein the power supply is electrically connected with the processor through the voltage stabilizing power supply, the encoder is electrically connected with the processor through the encoder circuit, the display screen is electrically connected with the processor through the display driving circuit, and the reset circuit, the docking interface circuit and the indicator lamp circuit are electrically connected with the processor.

title_en: Wireless control's intelligent home gateway
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wireless control intelligent home gateway which comprises a machine body, a shell and an operation end, wherein the shell is arranged above the machine body, sleeved on the left surface, the right surface and the upper surface of the machine body, movably connected with the machine body, and the operation end is arranged at the front end of the machine body. The utility model solves the problems that the prior gateway is inconvenient to open when the interior of the prior gateway is maintained and checked by the shell and the machine body which are usually connected and fixed by the screws through the matching use of the machine body, the shell, the operation end, the connecting groove, the fixing device, the box body, the clamping assembly, the moving rod, the clamping head, the spring, the linkage assembly, the control assembly, the clamping groove and the button, and the condition that the sliding wire is damaged to the gateway when the screws are twisted for a period of time, thereby the disassembly and the installation during the maintenance and the check are difficult to be carried out and the condition that the sliding wire of the screws is damaged to the gateway is caused.

title_en: High-precision GNSS antenna
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of navigation antennas, and discloses a high-precision GNSS antenna which comprises an upper cover, a base, a dielectric antenna, a PCB (printed Circuit Board), a shielding cover and a reflecting sheet, wherein the upper cover and the base are covered and form a containing cavity, the dielectric antenna, the PCB, the shielding cover and the reflecting sheet are all contained in the containing cavity, the dielectric antenna is arranged above the PCB and is electrically connected with the PCB, the shielding cover is arranged below the PCB, and the reflecting sheet is positioned below the shielding cover. The utility model has the advantages of small volume, stable structure, adjustable installation mode according to different scenes, diversified installation scenes, insusceptibility to external installation environment, ensured AR, PCO, PCV under the action of the reflecting sheet, improved antenna gain and bandwidth, diversified navigation systems, and adjustable receiving of signals of different frequency bands of different navigation systems according to requirements.

title_en: Candy box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of candy boxes, in particular to a candy box which comprises a candy box structure, wherein the candy box structure comprises a fixing plate and a top cover, a bottom shell is arranged below the fixing plate, a driving shaft is connected between the fixing plate and the bottom shell in a penetrating way, the top of the driving shaft is fixed with the bottom of the top cover, a driving toothed ring is fixedly sleeved outside the driving shaft, a plurality of arc teeth are uniformly meshed and connected around the driving toothed ring, the center of the arc teeth is rotatably arranged on the bottom shell, one end of the arc teeth is fixedly connected with a box body, and the driving toothed ring drives the arc teeth to rotate through rotation of the driving shaft, so that the plurality of box bodies are folded or unfolded. The candy box adopts a double-layer or multi-layer design mode, can be synchronously folded or opened, is convenient for storing and taking candy, has staggered design positions of each layer, is folded or unfolded and looks similar to a flower on the whole, and increases novelty and interestingness from the aspect of appearance.

title_en: Antenna and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an antenna and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of communication, comprising an antenna body, a first antenna and a second antenna, wherein the antenna body comprises a first radiator and a second radiator, the first radiator surrounds a first space, the first space is opened towards the second radiator, and part of the second radiator extends into the first space through the open end of the first space; the connecting wire is electrically connected with the first radiator and the second radiator, and is suitable for being electrically connected with the main board. Therefore, the first space which is opened towards the second radiator is surrounded by the first radiator, and part of the second radiator extends into the first space through the opening end of the first space, so that the antenna can be reasonably designed, the antenna can have excellent performance only by small size and clearance, the size of the antenna can be reduced on the premise of meeting the performance requirement of the antenna, and the application range of the antenna can be improved.

title_en: Radiator and electronic device
abstract_en: The application provides a radiator and electronic equipment, wherein the radiator comprises a plurality of first radiation branches, a plurality of first switch assemblies, at least one second radiation branch and at least one second radiation branch, wherein the positions of the first radiation branches are different from those of the first radiation branches, the first radiation branches can be electrically connected with a signal transmission interface and are used for receiving or radiating electromagnetic wave signals, one end of each first switch assembly is electrically connected with the signal transmission interface, the other end of each first switch assembly is electrically connected with one first radiation branch, the first switch assemblies can be selectively connected with the signal transmission interface and at least one first radiation branch based on channel feedback information, the at least one second radiation branch is different from the first radiation branches in position, and the at least one second radiation branch is electrically connected with the signal transmission interface, and the first radiation branch and the second radiation branch connected with the signal transmission interface can form a current path to send and receive electromagnetic wave signals.

title_en: Low-power consumption data acquisition device based on energy storage system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a low-power-consumption data acquisition device based on an energy storage system, which comprises a main control module, a real-time clock module, the energy storage system, a charging and voltage conversion module, a sensor module, a camera and a Type-C interface, wherein the sensor module comprises an infrared sensor, an ambient light sensor, an infrared filter and a plurality of infrared LED lamps, and the main control module is connected with the real-time clock module, the charging and voltage conversion module, the sensor module, the camera and the Type-C interface. The utility model can effectively reduce the power consumption, has the lowest tested power consumption reaching microampere level, can perform quick and safe wireless transmission, and has safer and more reliable data.

title_en: Dual-channel Ka-band millimeter wave receiver
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of wireless communication and discloses a double-channel Ka-band millimeter wave receiver which comprises an adjusting component and a limiting component, wherein the adjusting component comprises a rotating column, a rotating disc, a rotating strip and a limiting block, the rotating disc is fixed on one side of the rotating column, the rotating strip is fixed on one side of the rotating disc, the limiting block is arranged at one end of the rotating strip, the moving component is arranged on the limiting block and comprises a moving component, the moving component comprises a limiting frame, a first spring, a supporting frame and a moving plate, and the limiting frame is sleeved on the outer side of the limiting block. The utility model has the beneficial effects that the limiting device can effectively prevent the antenna from accidentally moving when being influenced by external factors, ensure the stability of the antenna in the use process, ensure the continuity and reliability of signal receiving, and ensure that an operator can feel certain resistance when adjusting the angle of the antenna by the damping adjusting mode, thereby being easier to control the adjusting force and speed.

title_en: Back splint quick detach intercom
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of interphones, in particular to a back clamp quick-release interphone which comprises an interphone main body, wherein a connecting plate is arranged at the back of the interphone main body, a connecting groove is arranged in the middle of the connecting plate, a plurality of grooves are formed in the inner wall of the connecting groove, springs are arranged in the grooves, one end of each spring is connected with a sliding block, the end parts of the sliding blocks are semicircular, the end parts of the sliding blocks protrude out of the grooves, a clamping plate is connected with the connecting groove, clamping grooves matched with the end faces of the sliding blocks are formed in the two ends of the clamping plate, and a clamping frame is arranged at the back of the clamping plate. According to the utility model, the clamping plate slides into the connecting groove, the sliding blocks retract into the grooves in the sliding process, and the sliding blocks are clamped in the clamping grooves after the clamping grooves on two sides of the clamping plate are opposite to the sliding blocks, so that a certain resistance is required for pulling out the clamping plate when the clamping plate is used, and the clamping plate cannot slide out easily, so that the clamping plate is separated.

title_en: Circuit assembly for transmitting W-band signals
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a circuit component for transmitting W-band signals, which belongs to the technical field of electronics and comprises RSIW structural waveguides formed by upper-layer printed boards and lower-layer printed boards which are arranged in a stacked manner, wherein an outlet amplifying circuit arranged on a top metal layer of the upper-layer printed boards is connected with an upper waveguide feed port positioned on the same layer, an inlet amplifying circuit arranged on a top metal layer of the lower-layer printed boards is connected with an inlet filter, wherein the inlet filter is also connected with a lower waveguide feed port positioned on the same layer, not only can the W-band signals be transmitted in the waveguides be supported, but also the high integration level is realized, and the component can be used as a primitive to be integrated and applied to various microstrip circuits and antennas which are required by transmitting the W-band signals with the high integration level.

title_en: Electricity safety on-line monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an on-line monitoring device for electricity safety, which comprises a shell, wherein an inner notch is arranged on the front surface of the shell, an operation panel is arranged in the inner notch, the top of the inner notch is rotationally connected with a protective cover, the protective cover is connected with the inner notch in a matched manner, a display screen is arranged at the top of the operation panel, and control keys are equidistantly arranged below the display screen by the operation panel. The utility model relates to the technical field of electricity safety monitoring, and solves the problems that in the prior art, the electricity safety online monitoring equipment lacks effective protection, which may threaten the stable operation of the equipment, is easily affected by multiple factors such as bad weather, dust accumulation, animal invasion and the like when the equipment is used under outdoor complex and changeable environmental conditions, so that the monitoring data is inaccurate, even equipment faults frequently occur, and the reliability and timeliness of the electricity safety monitoring are seriously affected.

title_en: Remote control device for power distribution branch distribution and power down
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a power distribution branch distribution remote control device, which comprises a connecting bottom plate, rubber mats, a box body, waveguide windows, an operation panel, an input cable, an output cable, an antenna and heat radiation fins, wherein the rubber mats which are fixedly adhered are arranged at the bottom end of the connecting bottom plate, the box body specified by screws is arranged in the middle of the top end of the connecting bottom plate, the waveguide windows with embedded structures are arranged in the middle of the left end and the right end of the box body, the operation panel with the embedded structures is arranged on the left side of the front end of the box body, the input cable is arranged on the right side of the operation panel, the output cable with the embedded structures is arranged on the left side of the rear end of the box body, the antenna is arranged on the left side of the top end of the box body, and the antenna is connected with the operation panel, and the heat radiation fins with the embedded structures are arranged on the right end of the box body. The time-sharing power-down remote control device improves the heat dissipation and anti-interference effects of equipment through reasonable design, and meanwhile adopts a mechanical structure to realize power down and power up of a circuit, so that the structure stability is high.

title_en: High-gain antenna and network communication equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-gain antenna and network communication equipment, wherein the high-gain antenna comprises a substrate, a first radiating array and a second radiating array, wherein the first radiating array and the second radiating array are positioned on two side surfaces of the substrate, the first radiating array comprises a plurality of first radiating bodies and a ground feeding assembly electrically connected with the first radiating bodies, the second radiating array comprises a plurality of second radiating bodies, the first radiating bodies are arranged on the front surface of the substrate at intervals, the second radiating bodies are arranged on the back surface of the substrate at intervals, the first radiating bodies and the second radiating bodies are connected in a staggered mode, and the first radiating bodies and the second radiating bodies which are adjacent to the opposite surface of the substrate are connected with each other. The high-gain antenna of the utility model not only can simplify the complexity of the wiring design of the traditional antenna and make the matching easier, thereby being convenient for mass production, but also can effectively improve the overall radiation gain and radiation efficiency of the antenna.

title_en: Airborne auxiliary antenna structure
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the field of airborne antennas, and provides an airborne auxiliary antenna structure which comprises a bottom plate and an outer shell body arranged at the top of the bottom plate, wherein a cavity is formed in the outer shell body, an installation table is arranged at the top of the bottom plate, a fixing seat is arranged at the top of the installation table, a plurality of connecting tables are annularly arranged at the same height on the inner side surface of an inner channel of the fixing seat, one ends of the connecting tables, which are far away from the inner side surface of the channel, are fixedly connected with connecting columns, screw holes are formed in the tops of the connecting columns, a circuit board is connected to the tops of the connecting columns through bolts, a top cover is arranged at the tops of the fixing seat, and the tops of the top cover are abutted to the inner top surface of the outer shell body. Therefore, the device can simplify the assembly process and improve the maintenance convenience through modularized design, ensure the installation precision, and effectively improve the shock resistance, the environmental tightness and the reliability of an antenna system of the whole structure.

title_en: Power transmission icing on-line monitoring device integrated with tension sensor
abstract_en: The utility model provides an on-line monitoring device for power transmission icing integrating a tension sensor, which comprises a main control module, a tension sensor module, a microclimate sensor module, an image monitoring module and a power module, wherein the microclimate sensor module is connected with the main control module through a wired interface to provide real-time external environment meteorological information for the main control module, the tension sensor is communicated with the main control module through a wireless transmission interface to provide accurate wire tension information for the main control module and accurately convert the information into icing thickness information, the image monitoring module comprises a daytime camera module and a night vision camera group and provides effective and accurate image information for the main control module, the main control module is provided with heating glass and a windshield wiper device, the main control module controls the heating glass to heat when icing is generated, and the windshield wiper device is used for washing the generated water, so that the accuracy of the icing value can be improved by applying the technical scheme.

title_en: Mobile phone middle frame structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mobile phone middle frame structure, which relates to the technical field of mobile phone middle frames and comprises a metal frame and a metal corner frame, wherein a connecting structure is arranged between the metal frame and the metal corner frame, embedded mounting grooves are formed in two ends of the metal frame, a connecting groove is formed in one side of each embedded mounting groove, and the connecting structure comprises a connecting main body. According to the utility model, the embedded mounting groove is formed between the metal frame and the metal corner frame, the embedded mounting blocks are arranged on two sides of the connecting structure, after the embedded mounting blocks are mounted in the embedded mounting groove, the connecting structure can be tightly connected with the metal frame and the metal corner frame under the action of the limiting block, so that the tightness between the connecting structure and the metal frame and between the connecting structure and the metal corner frame is better, the device is further provided with the bevel edge and the slope, and the sealing rubber pad is further arranged between the bevel edge and the slope, so that the tightness of the device is further improved, and the practicability of the device is effectively enhanced.

title_en: Signal transmission chip circuit board with interaction of low-frequency signals and high-frequency signals
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a signal transmission chip circuit board for interaction of low-frequency signals and high-frequency signals, which belongs to the technical field of circuit boards and comprises a circuit board body, wherein a plurality of power supply units, radio frequency transceiver units, antenna matching units and information processing units are arranged on the circuit board body, the power supply units, the radio frequency transceiver units and the antenna matching units are electrically connected with the information processing units, and the information processing units are connected with a CAN low-frequency communication unit and a CAN high-frequency communication unit.

title_en: Metal frame flat plate double WIIF antenna
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flat plate double WIIF antenna with a metal frame, which is connected to one side of the metal frame and comprises a PCB (printed circuit board), wherein a coupling groove is formed in one side of the metal frame, the PCB is arranged on the outer side of the coupling groove, a feed point and a feed point are respectively arranged on the left side and the right side of the PCB, a left coupling body and a right coupling body are respectively arranged on the outer side of the left side and the right side of the PCB, the feed point and the feed point are both connected with elastic sheets, the feed point is coupled with the left coupling body through the elastic sheets to form a left radiation branch, the feed point is coupled with the right coupling body through the elastic sheets to form a right radiation branch, the performance of the antenna can be ensured to the greatest extent under the condition that the space environment of the antenna is not ideal in an all-metal machine, the antenna radiation direction can be improved by using the antenna arranged on the metal frame, and the user experience is improved, and therefore the problem that the space environment of the antenna with a narrow frame and wide screen design is insufficient is solved.

title_en: Cover plate assembly and filter
