The optical receiver includes a photodetector and a trans-impedance amplifier that includes a first differential branch circuit, a second differential branch circuit, and a differential amplifier. The first differential branch circuit includes a first capacitor and a first trans-impedance amplifying unit, where an input end of the first capacitor receives an input signal from a power supply end of the photodetector, and an output end of the first capacitor is coupled to an input end of the first trans-impedance amplifying unit. The first differential branch circuit is configured to: amplify the input signal and output a reference signal. The second differential branch circuit is configured to amplify an electrical signal from the photodetector. Signal physical parameter values of the reference signal and an interference signal included in an amplified electrical signal are the same or similar.

title_en: Smart contact lens
abstract_en: Disclosed is a smart contact lens (100, 100a) including a visible area (110), an outer ring area (120), a signal source (130), an antenna assembly (140), an induction coil (150), a high pass filter (160), an induction module (170), and a low pass filter (180). The outer ring area (120) encircles the visible area (110). The signal source (130) is disposed in the outer ring area (120). The antenna assembly (140) is disposed in the outer ring area (120) and connected to the signal source (130). The induction coil (150) is disposed in the outer ring area (120) and encircles the antenna assembly (140). The induction coil (150) and the antenna assembly (140) jointly resonate at an ultra-high frequency band, and the ultra-high frequency band is between 902 MHz and 928 MHz.

title_en: Systems and methods for energy and fronthaul bandwidth efficient uplink performance improvements for o-ran-based radio access networks
abstract_en: A method for optimizing uplink performance of Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) system implementing O-RAN split option 7-2x-based uplink (UL) multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) operation includes: selectively utilizing non-port reduced DMRS symbols and non-port reduced DMRS measurements to mitigate performance degradation of the UL MIMO in conditions involving high mobility for a user equipment (UE) and/or high interference. The non-port reduced DMRS symbols are DMRS symbols from multiple antenna streams before digital beamforming operation, and non-port reduced DMRS measurements are measurements derived from the non-port reduced DMRS symbols. A radio unit (RU) of the O-RAN system i) extracts the non-port reduced DMRS symbols, and ii) transmits the non-port reduced DMRS measurements to a distributed unit (DU) of the O-RAN system. The DU transmits combining and/or digital beamforming matrix elements to the RU for combining and/or digital beamforming matrix application.

title_en: Polycarbonate resin composition and member for antenna
abstract_en: Provided are a polycarbonate resin composition having a low relative permittivity and a low dielectric dissipation factor and excellent in terms of heat resistance, impact resistance, toughness and stiffness, and a member for an antenna. The polycarbonate resin composition comprising 30 to 120 parts by mass of a polystyrenic resin (B), and 3 to 50 parts by mass of an elastomer (C), relative to 100 parts by mass of a polycarbonate resin (A), wherein a melt viscosity ratio (ηA/ηB) of the polycarbonate resin (A) to the polystyrenic resin (B) at 260°C and 1216 sec -1  is within a range of 4.5 to 12.5.

title_en: Assemblies for mounting antenna cables
abstract_en: A cable mounting kit includes: first and second clamps, the first clamp including a first securing feature configured to engage a second securing feature on the second clamp to enable the first and second clamps to enclose and mount on a mounting structure, each of the first and second clamps including a clamping surface configured to engage the mounting structure and an opposed outer surface with a pair of first mounting holes; at least one hanger panel, the hanger panel having a plurality of second mounting holes on an outer surface thereof and a first pair of latches, the hanger panel being mounted to the first clamp; and at least one adapter extension, the adapter extension comprising a base having a second pair of latches, a shaft extending from the base, and a head with a pair of third mounting holes.

title_en: Antenna and electronic device
abstract_en: This application provides an antenna and an electronic device that includes the antenna. The antenna includes an antenna body and a feed point and a grounding point that are located on the antenna body. The antenna body includes a first section and a second section that intersect with each other. An electrical length between the feed point and a first end of the antenna body is greater than an electrical length between the feed point and a second end opposite to the first end. The antenna body generates resonance of a second wavelength in a quarter wavelength mode between the feed point and the first end, and the antenna body generates resonance of the second wavelength in a half wavelength mode between the first end and the second end. In this application, mode excitation generated based on the resonance of the second wavelength in the quarter wavelength mode can be enhanced by using the resonance of the second wavelength in the half wavelength mode, so that horizontal mode excitation and vertical mode excitation of the antenna are relatively balanced. Therefore, the antenna can have relatively good radiation performance regardless of whether the electronic device is in free space (FS) or in a handheld state.

title_en: Wearable device
abstract_en: This application provides a wearable device, including an antenna, and a pattern of the antenna may be switched, so that an anti-interference capability of the wearable device can be improved. The wearable device includes a casing, the antenna, and a ground plane. The antenna includes a feed unit, a switch, a first electronic element, a first radiator, and a second radiator that are disposed in the casing. An end of the first radiator and an end of the second radiator are opposite to each other and are not in contact with each other. A first end of the first radiator includes a feed point. The feed unit is electrically connected to the first radiator at the feed point. A first end of the second radiator includes a ground point. The switch is electrically connected between the second radiator and the ground plane at the ground point. The first electronic element is electrically connected between the switch and the ground plane.

title_en: Transmission device, transmission method, reception device, and reception method
abstract_en:
The present technology relates to a transmission device and a transmission method, and a reception device and a reception method that enable more efficient multiplexing of signals. 
     A communication device performs control to multiplex and transmit a plurality of chirp signals generated by performing chirp modulation on transmission data and shifting a transmission frequency between the center frequencies of adjacent transmission channels. The present technology can be applied to wireless communication systems.

title_en: Coupled chassis antenna system
abstract_en: A computing device includes a first metal computing device chassis component including an aperture, a second metal computing device chassis component including a display, and a hinge connector mechanically and movably connecting the second metal computing device chassis component to the first metal computing device chassis component. The computing device includes a primary antenna positioned within the first metal computing device chassis component, the primary antenna being configured to radiate radiofrequency signals at a first radiofrequency bandwidth through the aperture in the first metal computing device chassis component and to capacitively couple to the second metal computing device chassis component to radiate radiofrequency signals at a second radiofrequency bandwidth.

title_en: Active heat dissipation apparatus
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an active heat dissipation apparatus including a thermal conduction panel body having a refrigerant flow space in which a refrigerant is stored and flows, the refrigerant flow space being formed in the thermal conduction panel body by bending or joining at least one metal panel member, in which the refrigerant flow space includes a first refrigerant flow path positioned adjacent to a press-fitting portion provided in a rear surface portion of a heat dissipation housing main body that is a heat dissipation target, the first refrigerant flow path having a vaporization zone in which the refrigerant changes from a liquid phase to a gaseous phase, and a plurality of strength reinforcement portions formed in a condensation zone excluding the vaporization zone of the first refrigerant flow path and configured to reinforce rigidity of the thermal conduction panel body configured to define one side surface and the other side surface of the refrigerant flow space, thereby significantly improving heat dissipation performance.

title_en: Electronic device
abstract_en: An electronic device is provided. The electronic device may include any one of a handheld device, an in-vehicle device, a wearable device, a terminal device, connected to a wireless modem, a cellular phone, a smart phone, a personal digital assistant, a computer, a tablet computer, a handheld computer, and the like. In embodiments of this application, a software matting algorithm does not need to be used when a main board processes an electrical signal transmitted by an ambient light sensor so that a computing method is simple. In addition, a corresponding location of a transparent cover plate does not need to be painted with black ink, thereby simplifying a processing process of the electronic device and reducing use costs.

title_en: Group channel state information (csi) reporting enhancement for multi-rx chain capable ue
abstract_en: Aspects are described for a user equipment (UE) comprising two or more transceivers configured to enable wireless communication with a first base station, and a processor communicatively coupled to the two or more transceivers. The processor is configured to measure a first reference signal and a second reference signal during a measuring period to determine a first measuring result of the first reference signal and a second measuring result of the second reference signal. The processor is further configured to generate one or more reports that include the first measuring result and the second measuring result, wherein the one or more reports indicate that the first measuring result is associated with the second measuring result in time. The processor is further configured to transmit the one or more reports to the first base station.

title_en: Capturing and processing of images using monolithic camera array with heterogeneous imagers
abstract_en: A method for estimating distance to an object in a scene using an imaging system (400) comprising a camera array (410) with multiple imagers (540), an image processing pipeline module (420) and a controller (440). The image processing pipeline module (420) comprises an upstream pipeline processing module (510), an image pixel correlation module (514), and a parallax confirmation and measurement module (518). The method comprises: providing images (412), including a current image, captured by the multiple imagers (540) to the upstream pipeline processing module (510) for processing; aligning, by the image pixel correlation module (514), portions of images, including the current image, captured by different imagers of the multiple imagers to compensate for parallax; processing, by the parallax confirmation and measurement module (518), the current image to detect and measure the parallax by keeping track of various pair-wise measurements and calculating a parallax difference that is a best fit to a sample data; and determining distance to an object in the scene using the measured parallax.

title_en: Allocation of network resources based on delay information
abstract_en: A device (e.g., at least one network entity) may receive a message. The message may include round-trip (RT) latency requirements. The RT latency requirements may include uplink delay information and/or downlink delay information. The device may generate first policy charging and control (PCC) rules, for example based on the uplink delay information and/or the downlink delay information. The device may send first information indicating the first PCC rules, for example to a session management function (SMF). The device may receive a notification that one or more of an uplink delay and/or a downlink delay is associated with a flow. The device may determine second PCC rules, for example based on the uplink delay information and the downlink delay information. The device may send second information indicating the second PCC rules, for example to the SMF.

title_en: Ultrasonic wave-based device connecting method and related apparatus
abstract_en: An ultrasonic wave-based device connection method is applied to device connection in a conference scenario or a screen projection scenario. In the method, a first electronic device sends a plurality of ultrasonic signals that respectively carry detection information and that are in different bands, and obtains decoded information that is obtained by decoding each ultrasonic signal and that is fed back by a second electronic device. Detection information corresponding to each of the plurality of ultrasonic signals is compared with the decoded information, to determine a target band in which the second electronic device can correctly decode an ultrasonic wave, and then connection information is sent by using an ultrasonic wave in the target band, so that the second electronic device establishes a connection to the first electronic device based on the connection information. This effectively ensures that all devices having different frequency responses can establish a connection between devices based on an ultrasonic signal.

title_en: Determining cpu usage for a csi report with time domain channel properties
abstract_en: Systems and methods for determining a total number of Channel State Information (CSI) Processing Units (CPUs) for a report are provided. In some embodiments, a number of resource sets and of resources per set are determined. A number of autocorrelation delays up to which to report and/or a number of CPUs for the report is determined. In some embodiments, the whether the User Equipment (UE) has enough CPUs to process a Time Domain Channel Property (TDCP) report is determined. For a given maximum number of CPUs, both the gNB and the UE determine whether the UE has enough CPUs to process a TDCP report. This makes it possible to design a less complex UE. This puts a limit on the required CPU capabilities of the UE and thus makes it possible to dimension the UE processing power accordingly rather than to over-dimension the UE for the worst-case CPU load.

title_en: Method for controlling optical module by single board in olt and related apparatus
abstract_en: Embodiments of this application disclose a method for controlling an optical module by a board in an OLT and a related apparatus. During upstream slot allocation, the board in the OLT obtains information such as an identifier of a target ONU and a target operating rate of the target ONU, and the board sends the information to an optical module through a target interface. Then, the optical module determines an operating parameter based on the information carried in a target message, for example, determines operating parameters of an equalizer, an amplifier, a filter, and a laser. In other words, this application provides a new interface solution between a board and an optical module. The board can transfer more information to the optical module according to the new interface solution, to satisfy higher complexity and efficiency requirements of the board for controlling the optical module.

title_en: Array antenna device
abstract_en: An array antenna device (100) is provided with: a first layer (10) in which a plurality of antenna elements (11) are arranged in a grid shape; and a second layer (20) that overlaps the first layer (10). The second layer (20) has: an IF signal main line (21) and an LO signal main line (22) that extend in the orthogonal direction to each other; an IF signal branch line (23) and an LO signal branch line (24) that extend in the orthogonal direction of the IF signal main line (21) and the LO signal main line (22); and a plurality of mixers (29) that are arranged in the same grid shape as the plurality of antenna elements (11) at the intersections of the branch lines (23, 24), and electrically connected to the branch lines (23, 24) and the antenna elements (11). Phase shifters (25, 26, 27, 28) are provided between the connection points of the branch lines (23, 24) in the main lines (21, 22) and/or between the connection points of the mixers (29) in the branch lines (23, 24). The first layer (10) and the second layer (20) vertically overlap such that the arrangement region (110) of the plurality of antenna elements (11) in the first layer (10) and the arrangement region (290) of the plurality of mixers (29) in the second layer (20) overlap in a plan view.

title_en: User equipment processing time
abstract_en: A wireless device receives, from a base station, a wireless device capability enquiry message. The wireless device transmits, and after receiving the wireless device capability enquiry message, a wireless device capability information message that includes: a first parameter indicating a first number of symbols for a first processing time of a first type of CSI report; and a second parameter indicating a delta value for a second processing time of a second type of CSI report. The first type of CSI report comprises one or more reference signal measurement results. The second type of CSI report comprises one or more prediction results. The second processing time is based on a sum of the first number of symbols and the delta value.

title_en: Feeding network, antenna and mobile communication base station
abstract_en: A feeding network (20) for an antenna (14) has at least one lower level node (22), a plurality of upper level nodes (24), and a plurality of loads (26). The at least one lower level node (22) is electrically connected in parallel to a plurality of the upper level nodes (24) by lower level signal lines (28). The upper level nodes (24) are electrically connected in parallel to a plurality of the loads (26) by upper level signal lines (30). The upper level nodes (24), the respective connected loads (26) and the corresponding upper level signal lines (30) form subnetworks (32). The lengths of the upper level signal lines (30) of one of the subnetworks (32) differ from the lengths of the upper level signal lines (30) of at least one other of the subnetworks (32). Further, an antenna (14) and a mobile communication base station (10) are shown.

title_en: Digital radio transmitter and data transmission method
abstract_en: A chirp-based spread spectrum digital radio transmitter configured to suppress or attenuate discontinuities in the chirp frequency profile with an interpolation or smoothing procedure. The interpolation reduces significantly out-of-band emissions and does not affect the demodulation and decoding. In the case of a LoRa communication, the inventive transmitter has low constellation error and can communicate with legacy unmodified receivers. The process does not introduce unwanted phase shifts and can be used to control the signal's phase, also on continuous segments of the chirp to insert an arbitrary phase shift.

title_en: Exploiting inter-cell multiplexing gain in wireless cellular systems
abstract_en: Systems and methods are described for exploiting inter-cell interference to achieve multiplexing gain in a multiple antenna system (MAS) with multi-user (MU) transmissions ("MU-MAS"). For example, a MU-MAS of one embodiment comprises a wireless cellular network with multiple distributed antennas operating cooperatively to eliminate inter-cell interference and increase network capacity exploiting inter-cell multiplexing gain.

title_en: Efficient fiber utilization with widely parallel optical interfaces
abstract_en: Devices, systems, and methods that utilize an optical medium efficiently, for example by performing bidirectional (BiDi) dense wavelength division multiplexing (DWDM) according to a wavelength plan. Some wavelength plans prioritize or consider radix, energy efficiency, and/or fiber utilization. Some devices can be network devices, such as switches, routers, and/or the like. Some devices can be computers, servers, and/or the like.

title_en: Antenna switching circuit including register and electronic device for controlling antenna switching circuit
abstract_en: In an antenna switching circuit and an electronic device according to an embodiment, the antenna switching circuit may comprise at least one first port electrically connected to a matching circuit. The antenna switching circuit may comprise a second port electrically connected to one port of the at least one first port and an antenna. The antenna switching circuit may comprise a signal identification circuit for identifying a characteristic of a signal input through the second port. The antenna switching circuit may comprise a register for storing data corresponding to the characteristic of the signal input through the second port. The antenna switching circuit may comprise a controller for controlling a connection between the at least one first port and the second port. The controller may transmit the data stored in the register to a processor.

title_en: Dielectric resonator antenna system
abstract_en: An electromagnetic device includes: an electrically conductive ground structure; at least one dielectric resonator antenna (DRA) disposed on the ground structure; at least one electromagnetic (EM) beam shaper disposed proximate a corresponding one of the DRA; and, at least one signal feed disposed electromagnetically coupled to a corresponding one of the DRA. The at least one EM beam shaper having: an electrically conductive horn; a body of dielectric material having a dielectric constant that varies across the body of dielectric material in a specific direction; or, both the electrically conductive horn and the body of dielectric material.

title_en: Method and device for communication using barcode image, and wearable component with embedded sensing core engine
abstract_en: The invention proposes barcodes, probably two dimensional (2D) barcodes, that contain data relating to service provided by networked servers. Typically, 2D barcodes may represent URLs which can be used by browsers to access web pages/services (No from S530). In embodiments the barcodes use a different preset coding rule/syntax/format for the data which is understood by the backend servers 41-43 which generate/publish the 2D barcodes (S500, S505) and provide the networked services (S540, S545). The camera which photographs the 2D barcode may be in a mobile device (e.g. smartphone) or wearable device (e.g. glasses). In embodiments the raw data from the 2D barcode may be sent to a backend server for decoding, mobile devices may modify and republish 2D barcodes (e.g. to get paid if modified barcode is used in a purchase), the 2D barcode may include links to download locations of software used to understand preset coding rule data. Embodiments include multiple backend servers which cooperate to provide services.

title_en: Multi-standard radio switchable multiplexer
abstract_en: A wireless device comprising a diversity antenna 140 and a triplexer 142, wherein the triplexer is configured to receive signals from the diversity antenna and to provide signals in a first frequency range along a first path and to provide signals in a second frequency range along a second path. The wireless device also comprises a first reconfigurable multiplexer 911a coupled to the first path at a first signal port 916a and a second reconfigurable multiplexer 911b coupled to the second path at a second signal port 916b. The first and second reconfigurable multiplexers have respective first and second switching networks, respective first and second filter assemblies and respective first and second amplifier assemblies. The filter assemblies are implemented between the switching networks and a respective first and second plurality of bi-directional ports associated with a respective first and second plurality of radio access networks. A controller is configured to control the first and second switching networks to provide a signal path between the first or second signal port and a respective one or more of the first or second plurality of bi-directional ports.

title_en: PIM Cancellation
abstract_en: Radio frequency signals are transmitted and received using a radio system 100 coupled to an external antenna 14 via an additional combiner or diplexer 16 and one or more received reference signals are used for measurement of passive intermodulation (PIM) 32, 34 from one or more nodes 33 provided in a signal path external to the radio system 100, one of the nodes 33 being associated with a signal path between the additional combiner or diplexer 16 and the external antenna 14. Passive intermodulation (PIM) cancellation 28 is then performed based on the received one or more reference signals, including a first reference signal from the node 33. The combiner or diplexer 16 may be coupled to one or more further radio systems and the node 33 may be a dual direction coupler (132 fig.3) having forward and reverse ports.

title_en: Methods for controlling NCR forwarding
abstract_en: A repeater node configured to perform a forwarding function in a network. While the repeater node is communicably connected to a first network entity in the network, a change in a link with the first entity is detected (e.g. radio link failures are detected). Based on the detected change in the link, the forwarding function is modified. The repeater node may be a Network Control Repeater (NCR) which controls a forwarding function (NCR-fwd). The link change may be detected by determining a number of out of sync indications to be equal to or greater than a first predetermined number, and wherein each of the out of sync indications is identified based on measurement of transmissions on the link with the first network entity. The determination may also involve starting a timer (e.g. T310) wherein the forwarding function is modified when the timer is started. The timer is stopped when the number of in sync indications is determined to be equal to or greater than a second predetermined number, stopping the timer and further modifying the forwarding function. The change in forwarding function may be from a ON state to OFF state or vice versa.

title_en: Printer, control method for printer, information processing device, and control method and program for information processing device
abstract_en: To appropriately inform a terminal device representing an information processing device for performing printing using a versatile printer driver, of a configuration for a printer including vendor's unique option devices, so that capability of the printer can be utilized in full.SOLUTION: When a printer configuration information generation section 426 receives an inquiry for an IPP attribute from a terminal device 104 (if yes at S602), the same accesses to an area in which IPP non-regulated printer configuration information (Option XML) of a printer 105 is stored, and sends information (url) for obtaining the Option XML as an attribute value of the IPP attribute to the terminal device 104 (S608).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Information processing apparatus, control method, and program
abstract_en: To provide a management method with high convenience for management of job logs.SOLUTION: An information processing apparatus capable of communicating with an image input apparatus and a print apparatus acquires a scan history data of a scan processing carried out by the image input apparatus, acquires print history data of print processing carried out by the print apparatus, and manages the scan history data and the print history data. Further, the information processing apparatus, if the scan history data includes any information relating to copying, associates the scan history data having copy information and print history data for copying corresponding to the scan history data for copying with each other to manage them as copy history data.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Information processing apparatus, information processing program, information processing system, and information processing method
abstract_en: To notify an utterer of partners to whom the utterer should attach importance.SOLUTION: An information processing apparatus has an entire processing unit that receives the details of setting showing the expression of an object to be detected, and a network processing unit that notifies the other information processing apparatuses of the details of setting. Upon receiving notification indicating that the expression of the object to be detected is detected from image data acquired by the other information processing apparatuses, the entire processing unit outputs the notification to a display unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Network system
abstract_en: To provide a network system that can achieve both of an optical signal-to-noise ratio and band narrowing in an optical signal.SOLUTION: A network system includes a plurality of transmission devices each provided with a wavelength selection switch having a wavelength filter through which an optical signal is transmitted for each channel, and a management device, and the wavelength selection switch can set a band to extend the transmission band of the optical signal of a predetermined channel to the wavelength filter of an adjacent channel, and the management device includes an OSNR calculation unit that calculates an OSNR of the optical signal on the basis of the power loss due to the wavelength filter on the path of the optical signal, a bandwidth calculation unit that calculates the bandwidth of the optical signal according to the narrowing by the wavelength filter on the path, a determination unit that determines whether the OSNR and bandwidth satisfy conditions for the optical signal transmission quality, respectively, and a determination processing unit that determines whether to set the band to the wavelength selection switch on the basis of the determination result.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4A

title_en: Wireless tag reader
abstract_en: To provide a wireless tag reader capable of reducing leaking radio waves.SOLUTION: The wireless tag reader has a tunnel, an antenna, and an opening. The antenna emits radio waves for reading a wireless tag inside the tunnel. The opening is formed in the tunnel so as to penetrate to the inside of the tunnel, and which is smaller than the wavelength of the radio wave emitted by the antenna.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Image reading device, and image forming system using the image reading device
abstract_en: To reduce a machine size in a sheet conveyance direction.SOLUTION: An image reading device 30 comprises: a conveying unit 40 that conveys a sheet; and a first reading unit (scanner unit 51) that reads an image formed on the sheet. The conveying unit has a first conveying unit 41 that conveys a sheet from an entrance 30a to an exit 30b of the device along a sheet conveyance path 43, and a second conveying unit 42 that conveys a sheet along a bypass path 44 that bypasses part of the sheet conveyance path. The first reading unit is arranged on the sheet conveyance path. A second reading unit (colorimeter 52) different from the first reading unit is arranged on the bypass path.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Print control system and print control method
abstract_en: To effectively detect information to be protected.SOLUTION: A print system 1 comprises a host computer 2 and a server 3. The host computer 2 comprises: an item extraction unit 34 which extracts a paint-out item for each format which is an item of information, which is associated with a document format of document data, and in which paint-out processing is to be performed in the document data, and a paint-out item for each application which is an item of information, which is associated with the application of the document data, and in which the paint-out processing is to be performed in the document data; and a search unit 36 which searches for the information of the item associated with at least any one of the paint-out item for each format or the paint-out item for each application extracted by the item extraction unit 34, from a patient database DB which the server 3 has, and generates a paint-out list LST4. The server 3 comprises a data storage unit 46 holding the patient database DB.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Electronic device, electronic device control method, and electronic device control program
abstract_en: To provide an electronic device, an electronic device control method, and an electronic device control program for improving accuracy of measuring an object.SOLUTION: An electronic device 1 transmits radio waves whose frequencies change with the passage of time from a plurality of transmitting antennas 25A and 25B as transmission waves. The electronic device 1 includes phase control units 23A and 23B that control at least one phase of the transmission waves transmitted from the plurality of transmitting antennas 25A and 25B. The phase control units 23A and 23B adjust at least one phase of the transmission waves so that phases of reflection waves received from the receiving antennas 31A, 31B, and 31N are aligned, respectively, based on results of receiving the reflection waves of the transmission waves, which have been transmitted from the plurality of transmitting antennas 25A and 25B, from the receiving antennas 31A, 31B, and 31N, respectively.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Image forming device, information processing method and program
abstract_en: To prevent a printing sheet, determined as a defect sheet but may have no defect in fact, from being ejected to a sheet ejection destination to which a defect sheet is ejected, and enable a user to easily distinguish printing sheets.SOLUTION: When reading out a print result, the print result is ejected into a first tray when a detected result by detecting means that detects image defect shows absence of the image defect; the print result is ejected into a second tray when the result shows presence of image defect and the defect includes defect other than stripes; and the print result is ejected into a third tray when the result shows presence of the image defect and the defect does not include defect other than stripes.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Broadcast receiving system
abstract_en: To provide a digital broadcast receiver capable of executing a higher value-added function.SOLUTION: A broadcast receiving system includes a broadcast receiving device which can receive both broadcast data of an MPEG2 transmission system and broadcast data of an MMT transmission system, and a remote controller. The broadcast receiving device comprises an operation input unit which receives control information from the remote controller, and a control unit. The control unit provides two control states of first control and second control. The first control switches display and nondisplay of a data broadcast service display screen of the MPEG2 transmission system. The second control switches display and nondisplay of a multimedia service display screen of the MMT transmission system. On the remote controller, a button for outputting control information for the first control and a button for outputting control information for the second control are configured as the same button.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 29

title_en: Illumination system
abstract_en: To provide an illumination device having improved convenience.SOLUTION: An illumination system consists of a plurality of illumination devices 2 and an instruction device 1 capable of transmitting a command to the plurality of illumination devices 2. Self-identification information on wireless communication is set in advance by the instruction device 1 with respect to the plurality of illumination devices 2. The instruction device 1 transmits a command including an instruction of arrangement confirmation lighting with respect to the illumination devices 2. The illumination device 2 comprises a light source unit 20, a light source control unit 21 for controlling the light source unit 20, a wireless communication unit 22, and a slot 23 to which a storage device 24 is detachably attached. The wireless communication unit 22 can receive the command including the instruction of arrangement confirmation lighting and control object information. The light source control unit 21 controls the light source unit 20 according to the instruction only when the control object information corresponds to the self-identification information. The storage device 24 stores the self-identification information and provides the self-identification information to the light source control unit 21 when the command is received in a state in which the storage device 24 is attached to the slot 23.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Image processing system and device utilization program installer
abstract_en: To provide a technology for constructing a system with good operability in an image processing system equipped with an image processing device.SOLUTION: In a scan system 100 with multiple scanners 2 to 5 and a server 1 connected to the scanners 2 to 5, a CPU 11 of a server 1 execute installation processing, and in the installation processing, scanner drivers 42 to 45 to instruct the scanners 2 to 5 to execute scanning are installed in the server 1, each scanner name of the scanners 2 to 5 is acquired, and each acquired scanner name is written into scanner information files 52 to 55 corresponding to the scanners 2 to 5. After that, when middleware 50 outputs a search instruction for searching a scanner to the an OS 41, the OS 41 outputs the scanner name stored in the scanner information files 52 to 55 to the middleware 50 in response to the search instruction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Image formation apparatus and control method of image formation apparatus
abstract_en: To enable setting on whether or not a printed job is deleted for each of two user groups in a case where one apparatus is shared by a first user group from which a fee for printing is collected and by a second user group from which the fee is not collected.SOLUTION: An image formation apparatus for forming an image on a printing medium based on a print job comprises: storage means which stores the print job; execution means which executes log-in to the image formation apparatus; and control means which performs control so as to prevent re-execution of the executed print job on the basis of a first mode in which payment processing of a fee is performed in one log-in to the image formation apparatus and performs control so as to re-execute the executed print job on the basis of a second mode in which the payment processing of the fee is not performed in one log-in to the image formation apparatus.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Receiving device
abstract_en: To provide a receiving device that can suppress increase of a device scale and power consumption to match time between a first information signal and a second information signal which are acquired from two pieces of broadcasting being simultaneously broadcasted.SOLUTION: A receiving device comprises: a first demodulation circuit and a second demodulation circuit that demodulate a first information signal and a second information signal representing an image or voice respectively from two broadcasting waves which are broadcasted simultaneously, to output; a delay circuit that delays the first information signal to output; a mixing circuit that generates a reception information signal on the basis of the first information signal output from the delay circuit and the second information signal; and a delay control unit 20 that generates a delay control signal on the basis of the first information signal and the second information signal. The delay control unit comprises: a first frequency band intensity calculation unit 222; a second frequency band intensity calculation unit 232; and a delay signal generation unit 250.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Test equipment for radar system
abstract_en: To provide a test device and test equipment for radar systems that can simulate moving targets with a simple configuration.SOLUTION: Test equipment has a shield structure. A shield structure 3 has a main body portion 31 and a bent portion 32. The main body portion 31 is installed between a first radio wave transmission/reception device 2a and a second radio wave transmission/reception device 2b and shields radio waves directly radiated from the second radio wave transmission/reception device 2b to the first radio wave transmission/reception device 2a. The bent portion 32 is formed at an end portion of the main body portion 31 and shields radio waves diffracted at the end portion of the main body portion 31.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Receiving device
abstract_en: To improve the immediacy and flexibility of alerts.SOLUTION: In a related table in which processing-related information related to output processing that outputs an alarm on the receiving side is registered in association with an index, and that is provided so as to be included in data of the upper layer above a physical layer, a transmitting device generates and transmits transmission data including an index associated with the predetermined processing-related information in physical layer data. In the related table, the index is associated with the processing-related information and an area code representing the area for which the output processing is to be performed according to the processing-related information. The present technology can be applied, for example, to a case in which an emergency alarm is provided in television broadcasting.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Image formation system, control method therefor, and program
abstract_en: To provide an image formation system capable of reducing time and effort in setting a display language by a user.SOLUTION: An image formation system 100 is configured so that a morpheme string composed of a plurality of morphemes is acquired on the basis of phrases acquired by a smart speaker 102, a language is specified using the morpheme string, and a display language of a control panel 209 is updated on the basis of the specified language.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 20

title_en: System and method for transferring optical data
abstract_en: To provide a modulation approach that is suitable especially for an optical data communication by using an LED.SOLUTION: In a system and a method for transferring optical data, positive data modulation alone is used, in which an offset is applied to a positive modulation value before a modulation drive current signal for a light emission element is generated. The offset is such that a minimum drive current is within a range where the electron-to-photon efficiency of the light emission element is substantially the same. The drive current is thus included in a more linear part of the current-to-intensity characteristics. This reduces deformations and therefore may increase a data rate.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Print system, information processing apparatus, control program, and control method
abstract_en: To provide a print system, an information processing apparatus, a control program, and a control method with which when a printer driver is installed, time and effort associated with solving a trouble can be omitted.SOLUTION: A print system 10 includes an image forming apparatus and an information processing apparatus. The image forming apparatus is made to store custom data indicating setting values of a print condition that can be achieved in the apparatus. The information processing apparatus includes a CPU, and the information processing apparatus acquires the custom data stored in the image forming apparatus with the CPU. A standard print condition in a printer driver is set in accordance with the custom data.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 11

title_en: Information processing apparatus, information processing system, and program
abstract_en: To provide an information processing apparatus that, in a trial period for replacing an old model with a new model, allows the combinational use of functions of both models before and after the replacement in the set trial period without issuing new permission information different from permission information registered in the old model, and when the trial period ends, prevents the functions of both models from being allowed to be used.SOLUTION: In an image forming apparatus, in replacement of an old model image forming apparatus with a new model image forming apparatus, a license management control unit receives, via an operation input unit, an IP address for specifying the image forming apparatus before the replacement and a setting in a trial period of the apparatus, acquires a license key from the old model image forming apparatus before the replacement based on the received IP address to make functions of the apparatus effective, when the trial period ends, if the apparatus is selected to be continuously used, makes functions of the other image forming apparatus ineffective, and if the apparatus is selected not to be used, makes the functions of the apparatus ineffective.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Device, program and method for signal detection
abstract_en: To improve the detection accuracy of a reception signal.SOLUTION: A signal detection device 100 determines the presence or absence of reception signal power in a spectrogram to detect a presence region A of a reception signal. Then, based on the presence or absence of power in a frequency axis direction of the spectrogram and the presence or absence of power in the time axis direction, the signal detection device 100 divides the presence region A to separate into each region on the basis of each reception signal. Since packets are arranged in OFDMA with almost no gap in the time direction, reception signals are displayed on the spectrogram as a series of packets. Here, by dividing with f1-f5 for each region in which power exists in the frequency axis direction, and by dividing with t1-t4 for each region in which power exists in the time axis direction, the reception signals can be separated for each packet R11-R31, so that they can be displayed in an identifiable manner.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Receiver, method, and program
abstract_en: To collect receiver data while ensuring confidentiality.SOLUTION: A receiver for digital television broadcasting includes: broadcasting signal reception means that receives a broadcasting signal; encryption key acquisition means that obtains an encryption key from a server having the encryption key on the basis of an encryption key acquisition instruction included in the broadcasting signal; encryption means that generates data with encryption by encrypting receiver data in the receiver using the encryption key on the basis of a write instruction included in the broadcasting signal; and information writing means that writes the data with encryption to information storage means.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8

title_en: Antenna control device and antenna control system
abstract_en: To provide an antenna control device which can be mounted on a mobile station which radio communicates with a base station.SOLUTION: The antenna control device includes: a mobile station position information acquisition unit which acquires mobile station position information; a base station position information acquisition unit which acquires base station position information associated with connection success information indicating successful radio communication between the mobile station and the base station; a beam direction information generation unit which, when the mobile station and the base station come to have preset positional relationship, generates beam direction information for radio communication between the mobile station and the base station, from the mobile station position information and the base station position information; a beam control unit which controls antenna directivity based on beam direction information; and a transmission/reception unit which transmits a radio signal to be transmitted to the base station through a directional antenna in which directivity is controlled by beam control information used by the beam control unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Image processing apparatus, image processing method, and program
abstract_en: To improve compression efficiency at the time of performing color reduction processing and compressing image data for each color.SOLUTION: An image processing apparatus according to the present invention includes: reading means configured to read an image on an original document and generate image data; color reduction means configured to perform color reduction processing for quantizing a color in the generated image data; change means configured to change, in a case where brightness of an edge pixel indicating an edge portion in an image based on the image data with the color quantized is equal to or higher than a threshold value, a pixel value of the edge pixel to a pixel value of a color of a pixel having highest brightness among pixels surrounding the edge pixel, and change, in a case where the brightness of the edge pixel is lower than the threshold value, the pixel value of the edge pixel to a pixel value of a color of a pixel having lowest brightness among the pixels surrounding the edge pixel; and compression means configured to compress the image data in which the pixel value of the edge pixel is changed by the change means while dividing the data color by color.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Facsimile machine, control program and control method
abstract_en: To provide a facsimile machine, a control program and a control method, capable of easily reprinting a facsimile image after fax image printing is stopped.SOLUTION: A facsimile machine (10) includes a CPU (20). In response to the stop of facsimile image printing, the CPU (20) sets, as a display range, from a second display screen to the last display screen from among a plurality of display screens that are switched to a display (32) to be displayed by the time when a facsimile image is printed on a sheet, and displays, on the display (32), a display screen at least for executing processing to print the facsimile image.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Image forming system, portable terminal, and program
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a technology that, in cooperation of an image forming apparatus and a portable terminal with each other, makes it possible to check that the image forming apparatus cooperating with the portable terminal is an image forming apparatus desired by a user. 
     SOLUTION: A portable terminal 50 acquires information (information for specifying apparatus) for a user to determine whether an image forming apparatus that is to cooperate with the portable terminal 50 is a desired image forming apparatus through BLE communication (short-range radio communication) with the image forming apparatus. The portable terminal 50 displays a confirmation message 700 confirming execution of cooperation with the image forming apparatus. The confirmation message 700 includes the information for specifying apparatus (for example, apparatus name "sixth floor, east side 1"). The portable terminal 50 executes the cooperation with the image forming apparatus (for example, authentication operation) according to the user's operation to confirm the confirmation message 700.

title_en: Mobile terminal test device and mobile terminal test method
abstract_en: To provide a mobile terminal test device and a mobile terminal test method that can set an output level of a test signal to a testable level in a short time and efficiently perform reception sensitivity tests of mobile terminals.SOLUTION: In a measurement device 1, a reception sensitivity test control unit 18 that performs multiple times of reception sensitivity tests includes a deterioration state determination unit 18d that determines whether measured throughput is in a state in which throughput has dropped to a preset rate in a steep drop area where the throughput drops sharply. An output level variable setting unit 18e performs a set process of setting the output level of the test signal to be different from a previous time according to a comparison result of whether a measurement result of throughput exceeds a predetermined threshold value and a determination result of whether the throughput is in the dropped state by the deterioration state determination unit 18d, and including a process of leveling down or leveling up the output level of the test signal with respects to the previous time in units of error tolerance EL when it is determined to be the dropped state.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Image processing apparatus and image processing program
abstract_en: To avoid unnecessary communication and a user's unexpected wrong operation by allowing connection to a server only when it is necessary.SOLUTION: A multi-functional machine 200 comprises: a communication interface 270 that can communicate with an information management server 100; an operation unit 250; and a processor 210. When a contract for providing a service using the information management server 100 is not established, the processor 210 executes disabling processing of disabling a specific operation for causing the operation unit 250 to allow the multi-functional machine 200 and the information management server 100 to communicate with each other, and when the contract is established, executes enabling processing of enabling the specific operation with the operation unit 250.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Additively manufactured mesh horn antenna
abstract_en: To provide an efficient mesh horn antenna manufactured through a time- and cost-saving process, and a manufacturing method thereof.SOLUTION: An antenna device 210 includes an additively manufactured tubular body (a rectangular waveguide portion 216 and a pyramidal horn portion 218) having a wall 228 and a wall 230 provided with a plurality of holes. The tubular body transmits electromagnetic radiation in a selected operating frequency range, and has a mass below a maximum mass threshold. The holes reduce the mass of the tubular body to less than the maximum mass threshold without significantly adversely affecting electromagnetic radiation transmission capability of the tubular body in the selected operating frequency range.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Information processing device, information processing method, and program
abstract_en: To improve convenience in performing color adjustment of output objects outputted by a printer.SOLUTION: An information processing device comprises: display means which displays a user interface which can adjust a set value of a parameter related to image quality to be used for printing according to indication from a user; acquisition means which acquires the set value of the parameter from information on the user interface; conversion means which converts an image based on the information acquired by the acquisition means; and generation means which generates print data including the converted image and the acquired information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Communication system, robot, and storage medium
abstract_en: To provide a technology concerning a robot to be used for a plurality of purposes of use.SOLUTION: A communication system includes one or a plurality of robots and a server device. The robot includes: a positioning unit for acquiring position information of the robot; a driving unit capable of moving the robot according to a remote operation via a terminal device; a periphery data acquisition unit for acquiring periphery data of the robot; a first processing unit for generating first data based on the periphery data and second data based on the periphery data and the position information; and a communication unit for transmitting the first data to the terminal device and transmitting the second data to the server device. The server device includes a second processing unit for generating map data based on the second data received from the robot, and a storage unit for storing the map data.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Transmitter collation device, learning device, transmitter collation method, learning method, and program
abstract_en: To reduce situations in which in the case of estimating, from a signal wirelessly transmitted from a transmitter of a collation object, a plurality of types of information indicating the transmitter, mismatch between estimated results is caused.SOLUTION: A transmitter collation device 1 comprises a receiving unit 1a, radio wave feature amount generation unit 1b, a storage unit 1c, a similarity calculation unit 1d, an addition similarity calculation unit 1e, and an inference unit 1f. The storage unit 1c stores K (integer equal to or greater than 2) sets of template feature amount groups for inferring K types of information showing a transmitter. The similarity calculation unit 1d generates an i(integer of 1 to K)-th sample feature amount from a radio wave feature amount and calculates an i-th similarity group on the basis of the i-th sample feature amount and i-th set of template feature amount group. The addition similarity calculation unit 1e adds K similarities corresponding to i being 1 to K using an i-th weighting coefficient to calculate an addition similarity. The inference unit 1f infers K pieces of information previously associated with respective calculation sources of K similarities maximizing the addition similarity to be information indicating the transmitter.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Display, display device, and electronic apparatus having antenna integrated therein
abstract_en: To provide a display, a display device, and an electronic apparatus having an antenna integrated therein.SOLUTION: In an electronic apparatus 1, an antenna 2 is integrated with a display 100, and includes a millimeter-wave antenna 21. The millimeter-wave antenna includes a plurality of millimeter-wave antenna units 211. At least two millimeter-wave antenna are connected to each other to form a connection structure. The connection structures are multiplexed to constitute at least a first portion 221 of a non-millimeter-wave antenna.EFFECT: The display, a display device, and an electronic apparatus having an antenna integrated therein can effectively reduce an antenna size to reduce the influence of the antenna to the visual and optical effect and the touch effect of the display, which enhances the functionality and value of the display and can also ensure a user's visual and tactile experience.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Antenna and non-contact type data transceiver
abstract_en: To provide an antenna and a non-contact type data transceiver of which radiation elements are hardly broken even when an external force is applied.SOLUTION: An antenna 12 includes a radiation elements 17, 18. The radiation elements 17, 18 are each formed from a linear body formed in a meander shape by a plurality of main extension parts 31 and a plurality of turning parts 32. The plurality of main extension parts 31 are spaced side by side in a main direction (X direction). The main extensions parts 31 extend and intersect the main direction (X direction). The plurality of turning parts 32 alternatively connect one ends and other ends of adjacent main extension parts 31 among the plurality of main extension parts 31. At least one of the plurality of turning parts 32 has a spiral winding part 33 formed from the linear body wound one or more times.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: oscillator
abstract_en: To provide an oscillator capable of reducing crosstalk.SOLUTION: An oscillator includes a SQUID 102, a transmission line 103a connected to the SQUID 102, a ground plane 106, and a first connection circuit 107a provided near a node of an electric field of a standing wave generated when the oscillator oscillates and connecting the ground planes 106 existing on both sides of the transmission line 103a.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 10A

title_en: Program and information processing device
abstract_en: To provide a program for accepting a setting of a sheet feeding method, which is a technique for improving convenience when automatic selection is set as a sheet feeding method.SOLUTION: A program is executable by a computer of an information processing device and accepts a print setting to be used for printing on a printer via a user interface of the information processing device. The print setting includes sheet sizes and sheet feeding methods. Possible options of the sheet feeding methods include automatic selection in which a sheet feeding tray is selected by the printer. The user interface is informed of a feedable tray out of a plurality of printer sheet feeding trays for a sheet size set in the print setting when accepting a change in the sheet size via the user interface in a state where the automatic selection is set as the sheet feeding method in the print setting.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Communication program, base station, and communication system
abstract_en: To perform wireless communication between multiple terminals and a base station with low delay and high efficiency.SOLUTION: A communication program is performed by causing a calculation device of a base station to execute processing of the base station that performs wireless communication with a plurality of devices. The processing includes, by at least one active terminal from among a plurality of devices that are synchronized: receiving a resource block signal including a plurality of OFDM symbols independent of each other and transmitted to the base station by a plurality of antenna elements; detecting the active terminal on the basis of the resource block signal; estimating the impulse response of a propagation path propagated by the resource block signal from the active terminal to the base station; complementing the frequency response of the propagation path on the basis of the impulse response; and estimating data included in a resource block on the basis of the frequency response.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Image forming apparatus
abstract_en: To provide an image forming apparatus that prevents deterioration in usability when executing a print job that performs a large amount of printing.SOLUTION: An image forming apparatus includes: an image forming unit that forms an image on a recording material; a controller that controls ejection of the recording material on which the image is formed; an ejection tray 410, which is removable from a main body and from which the recording material is ejected; and an ejection tray 411, which is disposed vertically below the ejection tray 410 and from which the recording material is ejected. The number of recording materials that can be stacked on the ejection tray 411 in a status that the ejection tray 410 is removed therefrom is greater than the number of recording materials that can be stacked in the ejection tray 411 in a status the ejection tray 410 is mounted thereon. When the number of printed recording materials in a print job that ejects the recording material to the ejection tray 410 or the ejection tray 411 exceeds a predetermined number (YES in S501), the controller reports to remove the ejection tray 410 therefrom (S502).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Terminal device, device, and program
abstract_en: To enhance usability for setting a device.SOLUTION: A program causes a computer of an information processing device which is communicative with an external device to function as each of the following means: receiving means for receiving first information, transmitted from the external device, regarding setting items of the external device; acquisition means for acquiring second information regarding the setting of the information processing device; and transmission means for causing the external device to transmit third information being based on first information and second information and regarding setting items of the external device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: reader
abstract_en: To provide a reader capable of reading a document while maintaining reading image quality, even if an image sensor is determined to be abnormal.SOLUTION: Before a document is read, black level confirmation (S11) to confirm a normality of a black level of a sensor IC chip and linearity confirmation (S13, S19) to confirm a normality of photoelectric conversion linearity of each light receiving element of the sensor IC chip are performed. If the black level of all sensor IC chips is normal but the linearity of at least one sensor IC chip is abnormal (S14: NO), linearity connection is performed on a pixel value obtained by reading a document (S16). If the black level of at least one sensor IC chip is abnormal and the linearity of all sensor IC chips is normal (S20: YES), the document is read after the black level correction has been performed (S21).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Image forming apparatus
abstract_en: To provide an image forming apparatus that can easily connect to a desired server among a plurality of partner servers.SOLUTION: An image forming apparatus 10 comprises a reading unit 1, a communication unit 50, and a control unit 60. The reading unit 1 reads an input image of a business card or a staff identity card of a user. The communication unit 50 executes communication via a network 20. The control unit 60 controls the reading unit 1 and the communication unit 50. The control unit 60 specifies a desired partner server related to the user's post from among a plurality of partner servers 11-13 via the network 20 by using at least one of character information and image information based on the input image, and sets information for connection to the desired partner server to the communication unit 50.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: cross dipole antenna
abstract_en: To provide a cross dipole antenna which can perform a communication at a plurality of frequencies, and includes a simple structure which can be miniaturized.SOLUTION: A cross dipole antenna 100 comprises: a core formed of a dielectric body material; a reflection board; a first element group extending in a first length L1, and is constituted of four first elements orthogonally arranged; a second element group that is formed on an outer surface of the core, extends in a second length L2, is constituted of four second elements orthogonally crossing each other, and is resonated at a second resonance frequency f2; and a power supply wire that transmits power to each element. The first and second elements extend so as to be bent from a top surface to a side surface along an outer surface of each core. The first length L1 of the first element is smaller than 1/4 of a first wavelength λ1 corresponded to a first resonance frequency f1, and the second length L2 of the second element is smaller than 1/4 of a second wavelength λ2 of the second frequency f2.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Image processing device, image processing method and program
abstract_en: To perform a color conversion process efficiently using hardware resources.SOLUTION: Axis setting for deriving a point where a conversion target point ti and one of color components match is performed using a reference table. The output values of points Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4 between grid points where the conversion target point ti and the value in R axis direction are the same, are acquired from the reference table. Linear interpolation in a G axis direction is carried out using the acquired output values of Q1-Q4, and the output values of interpolation points R1, R2 between the points Q1-Q4 where the conversion target point ti and the value in G axis direction are the same are calculated. Linear interpolation in a B axis direction is carried out using the acquired output values of interpolation points R1, R2, and the output value of an interpolation point S between the interpolation points R1, R2 where the conversion target point ti and the value in B axis direction are the same, i.e., the conversion target point ti, is calculated.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Multi-feeding detection device, conveyance apparatus, and image reading apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a multi-feeding detection device, a conveyance apparatus, and an image reading apparatus which can increase a driving speed of a push-pull circuit outputting a driving signal to a transmission element.SOLUTION: A drive circuit outputs a driving signal to a transmission element. The drive circuit has a push-pull circuit. The push-pull circuit outputs the driving signal in which the current is amplified. The push-pull circuit includes a first N-type MOSFET and a second N-type MOSFET and is the circuit in which a source terminal of the first N-type MOSFET is connected to a drain terminal of the second N-type MOSFET. The drive circuit is the circuit in which a conversion signal in which the voltage level is inverted in comparison to a reference signal is input to a gate terminal of the first N-type MOSFET and the reference signal is input to a gate terminal of the second N-type MOSFET. The second adjustment circuit makes timing of the fall of the conversion signal input to the gate terminal of the first N-type MOSFET earlier.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Receiving device
abstract_en: To provide a semiconductor receiving device having excellent power consumption characteristic and noise resistance.SOLUTION: A receiving device 400A includes an input part 401, a first high-pass filter 410, a gate-grounded amplifier 450, a second high-pass filter 430, and a demodulator 440. The input part 401 removes low-frequency noise in received digital modulation signal and reduces influence of parasitic element in an isolation element 300. The high-pass filter 410 removes noise in a signal outputted from the input part 401 and operates so as to determine DC operation point of the gate-grounded amplifier 450. The gate-grounded amplifier 450 also serves as a band-pass filter. The second high-pass filter 430 removes low-frequency noise outputted from the gate-grounded amplifier 450. The demodulator 440 demodulates the digital modulation signal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Image formation apparatus
abstract_en: To provide an image formation apparatus which can suppress unauthorized use.SOLUTION: An image formation apparatus 1 comprises: an imaging unit 21; a storage unit 22; a collation unit 23; a determination unit 24; and a control unit 25. The imaging unit 21 acquires image data by imaging the peripheral scenery of the image formation apparatus 1. The storage unit 22 stores first registered image data registered by imaging the peripheral scenery of an installation schedule place of the image formation apparatus 1. The collation unit 23 collates the image data with the first registered image data to output first collation data. The determination unit 24 determines whether or not the image formation apparatus 1 is installed at the installation schedule place on the basis of the first collation data to output determination information. The control unit 25 drives a drive system of the image formation apparatus 1 on the basis of the determination information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Reflection board
abstract_en: To provide a reflection board which can reduce a manufacturing cost.SOLUTION: A reflection board 1 that reflects an electromagnetic wave of a specified frequency band to a direction different from a specular direction, includes an uneven structure in which a plurality of unit structures 10 including a thickness distribution where a thickness is increased to a predetermined direction is arranged. The unit structure 10 includes a plurality of cell regions 11a to 11f each having a different thickness, at least includes a first unit structure having two or more cell regions each having a different thickness as a unit structure, and includes a conductive layer 3 on a surface on each uneven structure side. Both of the adjacent cell regions are conducted.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Image forming apparatus and printing control method and program
abstract_en: To make printed user information remain in a log even when executing printing of content displayed on a signage after a log-out.SOLUTION: An image forming apparatus is configured to: receive a printing instruction; in response to the printing instruction, determine whether a user is present or absent during a log-in; and, in the case of determining that the user is absent during the log-in, receive a log-in operation of the user, or otherwise, in the case of determining that the user is present during the log-in, or in the case that the user logs in, execute printing in response to the printing instruction, record, as a log, information on the user in a log-in state, and data of a printing object in association with each other when the printing is executed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Relay device, terminal device, control method, and program for improving position estimation accuracy
abstract_en: To improve positioning accuracy in a wireless communication system in which a relay device is used.SOLUTION: The relay device that relays a wireless signal received from a base station device to a terminal device, when receiving a predetermined signal generated using a first series from the base station device, relays to the terminal device a predetermined signal corresponding to a signal generated using a second series corresponding to the first series that is not used when the base station device generates the predetermined signal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Communication device, radio communication system, and synchronization signal transmission method
abstract_en: To reduce delay in starting communication.SOLUTION: A communication device includes: a communication interface that communicates with a plurality of radio units; and a processor that is connected to the communication interface. Therein, the processor executes a process of: determining a maximum number of beams that indicates an upper limit of the number of beams formed by each of the plurality of radio units such that a sum total of the number of beams formed by the plurality of radio units is equal to or less than the number of synchronization signals that are able to be transmitted within a predetermined time unit; and notifying the plurality of radio units of the determined maximum number of beams.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Induction brillouin scattering suppression highly nonlinear optical fiber
abstract_en: To provide a method and system for induction Brillouin scattering suppression highly nonlinear optical fiber, and a non-transitory computer-readable medium.SOLUTION: According to an aspect of an embodiment, operations may include obtaining a respective target temperature for each respective segment of multiple segments of a Highly Non-Linear optical Fiber (HNLF). Each respective target temperature may be based on a respective Zero-Dispersion Wavelength (ZDW) distribution of its corresponding segment and may be based on a target ZDW of the HNLF. The operations may also include adjusting a respective temperature of each respective segment that may be based on the respective target temperature of each respective segment such that each respective segment has a respective ZDW that is within a threshold of the target ZDW.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1A

title_en: Information processing device
abstract_en: To provide an information processing device that can quickly remove an obstacle that impedes the movement of an autonomous vehicle.SOLUTION: A server 100 (information processing device) includes a communication unit 103 that receives a rescue request signal transmitted from a vehicle 10 when the vehicle 10, capable of automatically driving, becomes unable to travel due to an obstacle 900. The server 100 includes a processor 101 (control unit) that transmits a removal request signal requesting removal of the obstacle 900 to the outside through the communication unit 103 on the basis of a rescue request signal received by the communication unit 103. The processor 101 acquires position information of the obstacle 900 through the communication unit 103, and determines the destination of the removal request signal on the basis of the position information of the obstacle 900.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Sheet processing apparatus, and processing condition setting method
abstract_en: To provide a sheet processing apparatus that can reduce the time and effort of a user occurring in changing a sheet size used for setting a sheet processing condition, and a processing condition setting method.SOLUTION: In an image forming apparatus 100, when sheet information designated by a user includes specific information, a setting screen Y100 is displayed which includes a sheet size detected by a sensor and a sheet attribute different from a sheet size included in the sheet information, according to an operation to an operation key Y25, some of sheet sizes used for setting a sheet processing condition are displayed and a designation operation to designate any one of the displayed sheet sizes is received, and according to the designation operation, the sheet size included in the setting screen Y100 is changed to the sheet size designated by the designation operation.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Image processing device
abstract_en: To provide an image processing device that can accurately detect a relative position between an operation panel of the image processing device and a terminal device owned by a user.SOLUTION: An image processing device 200 is communicably connected to a terminal device 100. An operation panel 260 receives operation from a user. A communication part 250 has a plurality of antennas and is used for making communication with the terminal device 100. A control part 240 performs control in accordance with direction information showing a direction of the terminal device 100 with respect to the image processing device 200, obtained based on radio waves that are transmitted between the terminal device 100 and the communication part 250. The communication part 250 is arranged in a range corresponding to the operation panel 260, in a lateral direction when viewed from a front face 200a on which the operation panel 260 can be operated of a side surface of the image processing device 200.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: antenna device
