abstract_en: To provide an antenna device that reduces an effect of multiple reflections and improves detection performance.SOLUTION: An antenna device includes: a substrate; an integrated circuit chip having a transmitting antenna and a receiving antenna and mounted on the substrate; a waveguide having a first aperture that is provided on the substrate side and surrounds the transmitting antenna and the receiving antenna in an aperture surface view, a second aperture that is provided further back than the first aperture in a radiation direction of the transmitting antenna, and a first inner wall surface connecting the first and second apertures; a radio wave lens fixed to the second aperture; and a cylindrical radio wave absorber provided inside the first inner wall surface. The radio wave absorber has a third aperture that is provided on the first aperture side, is smaller than the first aperture and the substrate in the aperture surface view of the first aperture, and surrounds the transmitting and receiving antennas, a fourth aperture that is provided further back than the third aperture in the radiation direction and larger than the third aperture, and a second inner wall surface connecting the third and fourth apertures.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1B

title_en: Color calibration system, color calibration method, image display device for color calibration, image display method for color calibration, observation environment image confirmation apparatus, and observation environment image confirmation method
abstract_en: To provide a color calibration system capable of recording a calibrated environment.SOLUTION: A color calibration system includes: an image conversion unit which generates a color-calibration image that reproduces a printed matter; an image display unit which displays the color-calibration image and an image including a chart image comprising regions filled with predetermined multiple colors, respectively; an observation environment confirmation unit which confirms an environment in which the color-calibration image is subjected to color calibration, on the basis of an observation environment image obtained by imaging the image displayed by the image display unit; and an observation environment image recording unit which stores the observation environment image.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Optical transmission system, wavelength converter, and optical transmission device
abstract_en: To improve transmission performance of an optical transmission system which uses wavelength conversion.SOLUTION: An optical transmission system comprises: a WDM transmission device which outputs a WDM signal light including light having a plurality of wavelengths; a wavelength converter which converts the WDM signal light into converted light in a different wavelength band; and a processor which controls the signal level of the WDM signal light entering the wavelength converter. The processor controls the signal level of the WDM signal light so that the signal level of the WDM signal light decreases in a direction away from the wavelength of pump light used by the wavelength converter.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Wire harness fault detector
abstract_en: To detect abnormality when a wire harness is disconnected or shorted or when it is affected by noise or vibration to chatter, without adding a special apparatus such as an A/D conversion circuit, etc.SOLUTION: A control unit on the originating side transmits a first transmit signal whose signal region is of a first pattern and a second transmit signal whose signal region is of a second pattern differing from the first pattern, which are high-and-low binary signals, more than half of one cycle of which is a non-signal region where there is a contiguous sequence of either a high or a low signal and the rest is a signal region consisting of a combination of high and low signals. A control unit on the receiving side detects abnormality of a wire harness when either a high or a low signal is received continuously for a period longer than the non-signal region, or when a pattern composed of received high and low signals is different from the pattern of both of the first and second pattern transmit signals.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Inspection device, inspection system, method for controlling inspection device, and program
abstract_en: To solve the problem in which: a product passes inspection, even if the product is different in a hue and an image position from a printed material as is expected by a user, that is, from a printed material on which RIP processing is performed by a printer other than a printer performing print image inspection or a RIP device.SOLUTION: The present invention is an inspection device that can communicate with at least an image forming apparatus, and comprises: first receiving means that receives, from the image forming apparatus, a first image created by the image forming apparatus performing image creation processing on print data; first inspection means that performs first inspection on the basis of the first image and a scan image acquired by reading a printed material printed by the image forming apparatus; second inspection means that performs second inspection on the basis of the first image and a second image created by an image processing apparatus performing the image creation processing on the print data; and transmission means that transmits, to the image forming apparatus, information based on results of the inspection performed by the first inspection means and second inspection means.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: System and color sample book
abstract_en: To provide a technique that allows users to easily understand where color samples in a color sample book are located on a color chart.SOLUTION: A system (100) includes: a color sample book (1) that has multiple cards (12) displaying color samples (11) and displays a symbol (13) in which a URL is encrypted; and a server (3) that transmits, to a terminal (2) that images the symbol (13), data for displaying a website including a color chart that displays a list of all listed colors, in which each position of colors the number of which is greater than the number of all the listed colors in the color sample book (1) is determined, and does not display colors other than all the listed colors or displaying them with masked.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Control device for optical communication device, control method for optical communication device, and control program for optical communication device
abstract_en: To provide a control device for an optical communication device that can easily and automatically determine a line design parameter group suitable for communication using a laser beam.SOLUTION: A control device (10) for an optical communication device comprises: a generation unit (11) that generates a plurality of candidate parameter groups; a determination unit (12) that performs a determination as to whether the plurality of parameters are suitable for communication using a laser beam; and a decision unit (13) that decides a line design parameter group from the candidate parameter groups. The generation unit (11) generates new candidate parameter groups based on a result of determination.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Optimization method and communication device thereof
abstract_en: To provide an optimization method and a communication device for improving throughput.SOLUTION: An optimization method for maximizing throughput includes the steps of determining at least one precoding matrix and at least one combining matrix jointly by Bayesian optimization, causal Bayesian optimization, or dynamic causal Bayesian optimization, and outputting at least one precoding matrix and at least one combining matrix, and the at least one precoding matrix is configured for at least one digital precoder 220pB and analog precoder 220pF of a transmitter 220. The at least one combining matrix is configured for at least one analog combiner 260cF and digital combiner 260cB of the at least one receiver 260.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Image forming system
abstract_en: To provide an image forming system that allows a photoelectric conversion panel to receive a suitable prescribed quantity of light.SOLUTION: An image forming system 100 comprises a photoelectric conversion panel 4, an actinometer 43, a motor 42, a motor driving unit 5, a light quantity detection unit 60, and a setting unit 67. The photoelectric conversion panel 4 performs photoelectric conversion. The actinometer 43 detects the quantity of light received by the photoelectric conversion panel 4. The motor 42 rotates the actinometer 43. The motor driving unit 5 drives the motor 42. The light quantity detection unit 60 detects a predetermined light quantity point indicating a predetermined quantity of light at which the actinometer 43 exceeds a threshold Th. The setting unit 67 sets, to the motor driving unit 5, a first angle from a reference point at which the actinometer 43 starts to the predetermined light quantity point. The motor driving unit 5 drives the motor 42 to rotate the photoelectric conversion panel 4 to the first angle.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: High frequency circuit and communication apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a high frequency circuit capable of improving a NF.SOLUTION: A high frequency circuit 1 comprises: a filter 310 that includes a passing band containing a reception band of a first band which can be used in a first area and a second area; a filter 321 that includes a passing band containing the reception band of a second band that can be used in the first area; a filter 330 that includes a passing band containing the reception band of the first band; a filter 341 that includes a passing band containing the reception band of a third band that can be used in the second area; and a switch 510 that contains a terminal 511 connected to an antenna connection terminal 101, a terminal 512 connected to the antenna connection terminal 102, a terminal 513 connected to the plurality of filters containing filters 310 and 321, and a terminal 514 that is connected to the plurality of filters containing filters 330 and 341.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Hook member fitting structure in fire alarm facility-purpose appliance
abstract_en: To provide a hook member fitting structure in a fire alarm facility-purpose appliance, which enables a hook member to be fitted to a housing with a simple structure at a position not protruding beyond a housing front face.SOLUTION: An appliance for fire alarm facility 1 is installed with a back wall 21 of a box-shaped housing 4 fixed to a wall W. A hook member 10 for engaging a telephone handset 40 is a plate-like member having: a flat plate portion 11 extending in a vertical direction; an upper hook portion 12 extending forward from a top edge of the flat plate portion 11; and a lower hook portion 13 provided at a lower end of the flat plate portion 11 and engaging with the handset 40. A locking portion 30 that receives and locks the upper hook portion 12 of the hook member 10 from the outside below the housing 4 is formed at the lower end of the rear wall 21 of the housing 4; and the hook member 10 is fitted to the housing 4 with the upper hook portion 12 engaged with the engaging portion 30 and the flat plate portion 11 abutting against the wall surface W.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing device, program, and information processing system
abstract_en: To solve a problem in which printing receipt images requires a lot of work, making it difficult to efficiently print expense reports in conventional technology.SOLUTION: An information processing device acquires a data list from an external service, determines whether an image is associated with data selected from the acquired data list, acquires an image to be associated with the selected data when it is determined that an image is not associated with the selected data, and associates the selected data with the acquired image for storage. Furthermore, the information processing device generates and stores a two-dimensional code that encodes the destination to save the image. The two-dimensional code is read and printed by a printing device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Information processing device
abstract_en: To enable a driver to operate a security gate such as a shutter by a voice command, for example by opening and closing the gates.SOLUTION: An information processing device 1 is mounted on a vehicle and includes a control unit and a memory unit, and the control unit performs operations including accepting voice input, acquiring infrared information from the memory unit on the basis of detection of the voice input, and transmitting an infrared signal to a security gate opening and closing device 2 on the basis of the acquired infrared information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Relay device and system
abstract_en: To provide a relay device and a system that can also accommodate optical modules that cannot perform digital coherent optical communication.SOLUTION: In a system 10, a relay device 300 includes a first connection unit 310, a second connection unit 320, and a relay unit 330 that relays communication of an electrical signal between a first optical module 100 that is connected to the first connection unit and does not support coherent optical communication, and a second optical module 200 that is connected to the second connection unit and supports coherent optical communication. The relay unit converts an optical signal 410 received by the first optical module from an optical fiber 190 into an electrical signal 510 and relays the same to the second optical module, and converts an optical signal 430 received by the second optical module from an optical fiber 290 into an electrical signal 520 and relays the same to the first optical module.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Image processing device and control method thereof, and program
abstract_en: To reduce user's time and effort during setting a folder path by using a character string in a document.SOLUTION: According to the present invention, an image processing device includes character recognition means for performing character recognition processing for recognizing characters included in image data to acquire character information, display means for displaying the characters shown by the character information acquired by the character recognition means, and transmission means for transmitting the image data to a folder with a character selected by a user among the characters displayed by the display means as a name.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 14

title_en: Image forming apparatus
abstract_en: To make erroneous detection by the detection unit less likely to occur when the job is not received, as compared with a case where the range of the detection area by the detection unit is set to be equal between when the job is received and when the job is not received.SOLUTION: An image inspection device comprises: an operating unit that receives power and performs operations related to image formation; a detection unit that detects an entry of an object into a detection area, which is a predetermined range from the operating unit; and a processor. Upon receiving a job for the operating unit to perform the operations, the processor expands a range of the detection area by the detection unit compared to when not receiving the job, and changes a state of the operating unit according to a detection result by the detection unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Communication control device and communication control method
abstract_en: To enable information to be appropriately shared among a plurality of users.SOLUTION: A communication control device includes a position information acquisition unit for acquiring position information from a plurality of terminal devices included in a communication system, a communication range setting unit for setting a communication range for each of the plurality of terminal devices, a communication control unit by which when a first terminal device out of the plurality of terminal devices makes a call, a second terminal device located within a first communication range set by the communication range setting unit for the first terminal device is identified based on the position information, and a communication content is transmitted from the first terminal device to the identified second terminal device, and an extended communication range setting unit by which when the second terminal device makes a call after a communication content from the first terminal device is transmitted, an extended communication range is set by integrating the first communication range with a second communication range which is a communication range of the second terminal device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Radar device, and vehicle lamp
abstract_en: To prevent an increase in transmission loss when using a radar device with a shielding member.SOLUTION: A shielding member provided herein is used in a radar device and comprises: a flat first portion made of a foamed resin; a second portion made of a non-foamed resin and arranged to surround the first portion so as to abut the side face of the first portion; and a third portion made of a non-foamed resin and arranged to abut one face and the other face of the first portion.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Remote operation system
abstract_en: To provide a remote control system that can make it easier to manage a control board used in a target device remotely operated by a remote controller.SOLUTION: A remote operation system of the present disclosure includes a target device equipped with a control board having a first storage unit, and a remote controller that communicates with the control board to remotely operate the target device. The control board receives designated product number information transmitted from the remote controller in response to a predetermined operation on the remote controller, and stores the designated product number information in the first storage unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Display control device, display control method, image processing system, and program
abstract_en: To provide a technology that enables color matching of both image areas in an image having an image area corresponding to an area where an external display device displays an image and an image area corresponding to a subject.SOLUTION: A display device 100 acquires image data having image areas corresponding to an external display device on which an image is displayed and a subject different from the external display device. A detection unit 104 detects a first area corresponding to an image display area of the external display device from the image data. A parameter generation unit 103 generates color adjustment parameters for performing color matching between the detected first area and a second area corresponding to the subject. A color conversion unit 105 applies color conversion based on the generated color adjustment parameters to the first area to perform color adjustment.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Video Display System
abstract_en: To provide a digital broadcast receiver capable of performing a function with higher added-value.SOLUTION: A broadcast receiver, capable of receiving broadcast data transmitted by a plurality of transport systems different from each other, includes a first reception section which receives broadcast data of a first transmission system; a second reception section which receives broadcast data of a second transmission system; a video output section which outputs a video developed on the basis of each decoded data; and an operation input section and a control section which receive control information from a remote controller. The remote controller includes a button for switching between display and non-display of services interlocking with a broadcast program. When the remote controller is operated by a user, the control section executes different display control dependent on when a program displayed on an output video from a video output section is a program transmitted and received by the first transmission system and when it is a program transmitted and received by the second transmission system.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 29

title_en: Application program, storage medium, method, and information processing apparatus
abstract_en: To solve the problem in which: when a portable terminal searches for a printer, a desired printer may not participate in a wireless LAN network in which the portable terminal participates, and in this case, the portable terminal cannot find the desired printer through the search.SOLUTION: A portable terminal displays a guide screen for causing a printer to participate in a wireless LAN network in which the portable terminal participates. An SSID of an access point to which the portable terminal is connected is displayed on the guide screen.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Composite sensor, and vehicle
abstract_en: To provide a composite sensor capable of solving a problem that, since a camera and a radar are integrated, the housing is large, restricting the installation location.SOLUTION: The composite sensor includes: a main body that has a radar control unit, a camera control unit, a transmitting/receiving unit that is connected to the radar control unit, an image sensor that is connected to the camera control unit; and an antenna unit that is separated from the main body that is connected to the transmitting/receiving unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method for determining layout for imaging relief precursor while taking total imaging time into account
abstract_en: To provide a method for determining at least one layout for imaging at least one relief precursor, and a computer program.SOLUTION: A method for determining at least one layout for imaging at least one relief precursor (6) includes the steps of: receiving image job data of at least one image job including at least two raster image files (10 and 20) having at least two different resolutions (R1 and R2) and/or at least two different quality settings which require different image modes; and using processing means to determine at least one layout including image job data for imaging at least one mask layer of at least one relief precursor (6) while taking a total imaging time required for imaging at least one mask layer into account.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Security system, portable terminal, program, and security method
abstract_en: To provide a security system that improves user convenience when the mode switching operation is performed.SOLUTION: A security system includes a security device that monitors intrusion into a monitored area by a plurality of security modes, and a portable terminal that can switch the security modes remotely by communication with the security device. The security system includes storage means, determination means, control means, and communication means. The storage means stores mode identification information indicating the security mode set in the monitored area. The determination means determines whether or not the portable terminal has moved from inside the monitored area to outside the monitored area, or whether or not the portable terminal has intruded into a first area within a predetermined distance range near the monitored area outside the monitored area from a second area outside the predetermined distance range. The control means causes the portable terminal to display a switching screen on which the switching operation of the security modes can be input according to a determination result of the determination means and the set security mode. The communication means transmits a switching request for the security mode when the switching operation is input on the switching screen.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Duplexed rf tag
abstract_en: To increase the possibility, when receiving a radio wave, of transmitting information in response to the radio wave.SOLUTION: A duplexed RF tag 10 includes a passive type RF tag 11 and a passive type RF tag 15. The duplexed RF tag 10 is formed by, for example, by sandwiching the RF tag 11 and the RF tag 15 with thin and hard paper (for example, a cardboard or the like) from the front and rear sides. The principal surface of the RF tag 11 and the principal surface of the RF tag 15 are on a same plane. The RF tag 11 and the RF tag 15 are not overlapped with each other, and their length directions intersect at right angle with each other.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: System for communication and wireless power transfer, antenna circuit, and terminal
abstract_en: To provide an antenna circuit capable of protecting circuit components such as an amplifier in a terminal when the terminal receives a wireless power transmission (WPT) signal.SOLUTION: The antenna circuit includes a reception circuit unit having a reception amplifier, a transmission circuit unit having a transmission amplifier and a circulator, a power reception circuit unit having a rectifier, and a signal path switching unit. The signal path switching unit switches the signal path so as to connect the shared antenna and the reception circuit unit at the time of downlink reception and connect the shared antenna and the transmission circuit unit at the time of uplink transmission and at the time of reception of the WPT signal. The circulator includes a first port, a second port, and a third port connected to the transmission amplifier, the signal path switcher, and the rectifier, respectively, unidirectionally transmits the transmission signal input from the transmission amplifier to the first port to the second port, and unidirectionally transmits the WPT signal input from the signal path switcher to the second port toward the third port.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Optical scanning device
abstract_en: To provide an optical scanning device capable of making a black stripe or a white stripe at a joint of scanning areas of a plurality of optical scanning devices inconspicuous.SOLUTION: The present invention provides an image forming apparatus including a plurality of optical scanning apparatuses each including a photosensitive member, a light source, a light source lighting unit configured to turn on the light source, a deflector configured to cause light from the light source turned on by the light source lighting unit to be scanned in a main scanning direction on the photosensitive member, a light detection sensor disposed near a scanning start position of the light in the main scanning direction, and a writing control unit configured to determine a writing timing at which scanning of light in the main scanning direction is started and control the light source lighting unit in accordance with the writing timing. In the image forming apparatus, a plurality of the optical scanning devices are configured such that a scanning region on the photosensitive member is divided in the main scanning direction and different regions obtained by dividing the scanning region are scanned in directions away from each other, and the writing control unit generates the writing timing based on a synchronization detection signal generated by receiving light by the light detection sensor and randomly varies the writing timing.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Program for supporting general-purpose scan software, information processing method, and information processing apparatus
abstract_en: A user who uses the scan standard driver is limited to a function that can be realized only by the standard driver, and cannot designate a function unique to the scan vendor.SOLUTION: A program for supporting a function of general-purpose scan software that can be commonly used in image processing apparatuses provided by a plurality of manufacturers, the program causing a computer to display a display screen for receiving a setting of contrast adjustment of an image to be read by the image processing apparatus, and output a reading instruction for causing the image processing apparatus to execute scanning in accordance with the setting received on the display screen.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Image forming apparatus and computer readable medium
abstract_en: To change a reading condition when an image forming apparatus reads a diagnostic image and a processing condition of a read image obtained by reading the diagnostic image according to a situation at the time of diagnosis of the image forming apparatus.SOLUTION: The reading condition when reading the chart paper CP is made different between a case where the mode of the image forming apparatus 100 is in the daily diagnosis mode and a case where the mode of the image forming apparatus 100 is in the failure diagnosis mode. In the daily diagnosis mode, the chart paper CP is read at a low resolution. On the other hand, in the failure diagnosis mode, the chart paper CP is read at a higher resolution than in the daily diagnosis mode.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Frequency bandwidth dividing and combining apparatus for catv signal and catv signal processing method using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a CATV signal frequency band separation and combination apparatus and a CATV signal processing method using the same. The CATV signal frequency band separation and combination apparatus includes: an input part receiving an analog signal transmitted from a headend through a cable network; a control part detecting a pilot signal by dividing the received analog signal, and then, switching the received analog signal to each different filter unit depending on whether the pilot signal is detected; and a plurality of filter units having different pass bands. Each of the filter units includes a filter part amplifying a CATV broadcast signal of the received analog signal by transmitting the same to an amplifier and bypassing a multimedia service signal, and outputting the amplified CATV broadcast signal and the bypassed multimedia service signal by combining the signals; an output part receiving a signal from the filter part to transmit the same to an external device; and a power supply part receiving power from an external power source to supply a driving voltage necessary for each of the components. Therefore, the present invention is capable of providing various multimedia services to a user.

title_en: Devices and Techniques of Time Slot Type Change in TSCH Protocol
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for changing a time slot type in a time slotted channel hopping (TSCH) protocol, in which the time of each time slot is changed so that data is transmitted by changing a TX device to an RX device and changing the RX device to the TX device, and thus a dedicated time slot that is not used can be used, and a method thereof. According to the present invention, the apparatus comprises: a time slot state management module checking whether a time slot type is a dedicated time slot of a corresponding apparatus when a new time slot starts and checking whether it is a TX operation or an RX operation; a data packet management module checking whether there is a data packet to be transmitted currently and deleting packets that have been transmitted to perform updating; a radio state management module receiving information about an operation required in the current time slot from the time slot state management module and performing TX/RX state change and a TX/RX operation; and a pre-signal execution module and a channel clear assignment (CCA) execution module for performing a pre-signal operation and a CCA operation, respectively, and notifying the radio state management module to determine whether to change the TX/RX state.

title_en: Broadband Bowtie Dipole Antenna Structure
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a broadband bowtie dipole antenna structure, which has a cross shape with an integrated balloon PCB. The broadband bowtie dipole antenna structure of the present invention includes: a first PCB having a through-hole formed from a central position to an upper side and having a bowtie-type radiation part extending from the central position toward upper and lower portions; a second PCB having a through-hole formed from the central position to a lower side and having a bowtie-type radiation part extending from the central position toward upper and lower portions; and a balloon PCB configured to cross-couple the both PCBs at 90° using the through-holes of the first and second PCBs, electrically connect the radiation parts of the both PCBs by soldering around the through-holes where the first and second PCBs are coupled, and physically connected to some areas other than the radiation part of the second PCB, wherein the balloon PCB has a balloon transformer mounted at a center, and has a terminal part in which one end of the balloon transformer is connected to an end launch connector and the other side of the balloon transformer is electrically connected to the bowtie-type radiation part. The present invention can achieve miniaturization of a broadband dipole antenna.

title_en: Cargo vehicle site monitoring system and method using artificial intelligence
abstract_en: Disclosed are a system and method for monitoring a cargo vehicle on-site using an artificial intelligence. The system for monitoring the cargo vehicle on-site using the artificial intelligence according to one aspect of the present invention comprises: one or more image photographing devices for photographing a cargo vehicle entering or exiting; a storage device for storing the registered cargo vehicle information; and a control device that analysis a photographing image by the image photographing device based on the cargo vehicle information, identifies the cargo vehicle entering or exiting, and generates the cargo vehicle entering/exiting monitoring information by checking a type and weight of a load by an artificial intelligence analysis using the information and photographing image for the identified cargo vehicle. Therefore, the present invention is capable of increasing production efficiency.

title_en: Fire alarm automation system in apartment complex
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire alarm automation system in an apartment complex and, more specifically, to a fire alarm automation system in an apartment complex improved for enhancing an effect of preventing an accident of residents by detecting fire occurring outside a household of the apartment complex and securing a communication channel in case of emergency such as natural disaster, war, fire, and the like through monitoring via a fire detector that can be easily attached and detached and a subminiature CCTV that can perform wireless communication even in a place where the fire detector cannot be installed.

title_en: Chimney rack system that can open close the door unattended
abstract_en: A chimney rack system enabling unmanned opening and closing of a door according to the present invention comprises: a communication server; a chimney rack installed at the rear of the communication server and collecting and discharging heat generated from the communication server; a control box monitoring the chimney rack and controlling a door formed at the rear surface of the chimney rack to be automatically opened when temperature inside the chimney rack exceeds a threshold value, and controlling the door to be automatically closed when the temperature falls below the threshold; and a duct device discharging heat emitted from the chimney rack to the outside. In a case of a sudden temperature rise in the chimney rack due to a fire or a fan failure, the present invention can remotely and automatically open the door to quickly exhaust hot air inside the chimney rack.

title_en: Optical module for improved thermal dissipation and optical communication system including the same
abstract_en: One embodiment discloses an optical module and an optical communication system including the same, wherein the optical module comprises: a substrate; an optical device that is arranged on the substrate and converts electrical signals to optical signals or converts optical signals to electrical signals; an electronic device that drives the optical device; an optical fiber support part that fixes an optical fiber spaced apart from the optical device; an optical wire that optically connects the optical device and an end portion of the optical fiber; a container that houses the optical device, the electronic device, and the optical fiber, and is isolated from the outside; and a coolant filled in the container, wherein the electronic device, the optical device, and the optical wire are in contact with the coolant.

title_en: Automatic inspection system of elevator emergency call device
abstract_en: Provided is an automatic inspection system for an elevator emergency call device, which comprises: a child device in which a microphone is installed; an auxiliary child device for transmitting an inspection dual tone multi frequency (DTMF); a mother device on an upper part of a vehicle which is connected to the child device; a machine room mother device connected to the mother device on an upper part of a vehicle; a pit mother device installed in a pit of an elevator; a main device connected to the child device, the mother device on an upper part of a vehicle, the machine room mother device, and the pit mother device; a control server connected to the main device to manage and store data related to an emergency call; a broadcasting server connected to the control server to generate and transmit an inspection DTMF in a vehicle; and a broadcasting speaker connected to the broadcasting server to broadcast the inspection DTMF in the vehicle. The present invention can automatically check whether an emergency call device is abnormal and utilizes a DTMF during the inspection to have no need to install an additional inspection device.

title_en: Satellite antenna with adjacent satellite interference exclusion function and its operating method
abstract_en: Disclosed is a satellite antenna having an adjacent satellite interference exclusion function. According to an aspect of the present invention, a satellite antenna having an adjacent satellite interference exclusion function comprises: a signal receiving unit for receiving a signal from a satellite; an SNR calculating unit for calculating a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) for a satellite signal received by the signal receiving unit; and a signal selecting unit for selecting any one satellite signal by comparing each signal-to-noise ratio calculated by the SNR calculating unit with respect to satellite signals from a plurality of satellites.

title_en: RF filter tuning apparatus using a single motor and method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and a method for tuning an RF filter using a single motor, which include a tuning screw driver for tightening a tuning screw of an RF filter and a nut driver for tightening a nut to control the screw and the nut with one motor, and also control the tuning screw driver and the nut driver of the RF filter with a time difference to reduce production costs. According to the present invention, the RF filter tuning apparatus using a single motor comprises: a single motor; a main gear fixated to an end of the single motor; a screw gear provided to be engaged with the main gear; a screw driver provided in a lower end of the center of the screw gear to be rotated; a nut gear provided to be engaged with the main gear; and a nut driver provided in a lower end of the center of the nut gear to be rotated.

title_en: Method for reducing inter cell intereference and apparatus thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed is an operation method of a first base station corresponding to at least one of a plurality of adjacent cells in a cooperative cell including adjacent portions between a plurality of adjacent cells. The operation method of a first base station according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises the steps of: identifying a sub-region planned to transmit a beam among sub-regions dividing the coverage of the cooperative cell; excluding a sub-region corresponding to a sub-region planned to transmit the beam among the sub-regions related to the first base station in the cooperative cell; and planning to transmit the beam to at least a part of the sub-regions other than the excluded sub-regions among the sub-regions related to the first base station in the cooperative cell.

title_en: Warming Clothes which contain wireless technique and high capability thin-film batteries
abstract_en: The present invention relates to heating clothes, and more specifically, to heating clothes capable of improving functionality compared to a conventional product with a temperature controlling function for each part by applying wireless technology and high-capacity thin-film battery technology. The heating clothes according to the present invention comprises: a heating body which is operated by electrical signals and current; a transmitting unit which transmits the electrical signals and the current; a power unit which emits the electrical signals and the current through the transmitting unit; and a displaying device which is recognized as a smartphone by charging the power unit and mounting a sensor, is composed of a charging unit and an operating unit having a button which is manually operated, and displays a temperature depending on a color of light. The power unit uses a power unit of a thin-film battery type which does not require an electrolyte instead of a lithium-ion battery (a conventional secondary battery using lithium ion and including the electrolyte). The charging unit is made in a form of being wirelessly charged by mounting a wireless charging tool interlocked with the smartphone.

title_en: Display apparatus and electric apparatus having the same
abstract_en: A display device comprises: a flexible display panel including a display area on which an image is displayed, wherein the display area includes a first folding area; a cover window disposed on the flexible display panel; and an antenna layer including a first antenna element disposed in the first folding area between the display panel and the cover window. Therefore, the display device can increase antenna performance of an electronic device.

title_en: Air conditioning system and control method of the same
abstract_en: An air conditioning system and a method for controlling the air conditioning system are provided. According to an embodiment of the present invention, an air conditioning system comprises: two or more outdoor antennas installed on an outdoor unit; a first indoor antenna installed in a first indoor unit; a second indoor antenna installed in a second indoor unit; and a controller. The controller allows any one of a plurality of outdoor antennas and the first indoor antenna or the second indoor antenna to wirelessly communicate with each other. According to an embodiment of the present invention, it is possible to provide an air conditioning system in which an omnidirectional antenna characteristic can be obtained by an outdoor antenna and communication between an outdoor unit and an indoor unit is performed with high efficiency.

title_en: Network management system and method for synchronization of communication network
abstract_en: A method for synchronizing a communication network according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a step of monitoring a connection status of the second communication nodes to be synchronized using a synchronization signal provided through a first communication node to which a synchronization source is connected; a step of determining whether or not the number of the second communication nodes connected according to a monitoring result exceeds a reference value; and a step of switching a synchronization mode of at least one second communication node when the number of the second communication nodes exceeds the reference value. Therefore, the present invention is capable of having an effect of preventing a communication service failure due to an excessive traffic in advance.

title_en: Apparatus and method for echo cancelling
abstract_en: In accordance with an embodiment of the present invention, a method for controlling the echo of an electronic device, comprises the operations of: acquiring a first voice signal received from an external device through a communication circuit; generating a first reference signal obtained by enhancing the first voice signal, using the first voice signal; generating a second reference signal obtained by amplifying the first reference signal; outputting the second reference signal through a speaker of the electronic device; acquiring an utterance of a user including the second reference signal output through the speaker, through a microphone of the electronic device; comparing a first time at which the second reference signal output through the speaker is acquired by an echo path delay (EPD) compensator through the microphone with a second time at which the second reference signal is acquired by the EPD compensator through an inner path between the speaker and the EPD compensator; performing echo cancellation on the utterance of the user acquired through the microphone using the first or second reference signal as a result of comparison; and transmitting the utterance to which the echo cancellation is applied to the external device through the communication circuit. In addition, various embodiments identified through the specifications are possible. Therefore, echoes can be effectively canceled through echo reference compensation.

title_en: High Frequency Antenna and Plasma Processing Device
abstract_en: Provided are a high-frequency antenna that can efficiently flow large currents even at high frequencies for plasma generation and a plasma processing device using the high-frequency antenna. The high-frequency antenna (10) with regard to the present invention is made of a metal fiber sheet. The plasma processing device regarding to the present invention is equipped with: a vacuum container (21) having an opening part (213) in a wall (211); a high-frequency antenna (10) made of a metal fiber sheet, disposed in the opening part (213); and a protection plate (12) of a dielectric provided to hermetically close the opening part (213), on an inner side of the vacuum container (21) rather than that of the high-frequency antenna (10). Since the high-frequency antenna (10) made of the metal fiber sheet has a larger surface area than that of a high-frequency antenna made of a metal plate of the same shape, an impedance for the high-frequency current is low. Therefore, the high-frequency current generally used for plasma generation (for example, of a frequency of 13.56 MHz) can be flowed more efficiently with the large current.

title_en: Offline play supporting platform system
abstract_en: Disclosed is a service providing method performed in a mobile terminal of a master for instructing play offline for a group consisting of protected persons of guardians. The method includes: a play activation step of activating a play mode when there is a play start instruction for a master's play instruction for group members at an offline location agreed in advance; and a master quality management steps of in which it is determined whether there is a downgrade factor for master's instruction quality to reflect it to the master's instruction quality, from a time when the play mode is activated to a time when activation ends. Therefore, it is possible to eliminate or minimize distrust, concern or anxiety of the guardians.

title_en: Clamping apparatus for antenna
abstract_en: Provided is a clamping device for an antenna, wherein the configuration of rotating an antenna in a vertical direction and in a horizontal direction is integrated to simplify the structure thereof and to reduce the size thereof. For the purpose, the clamping device for an antenna according to the present invention comprises: a tilting bracket connected to an antenna to support the antenna; a base bracket installed on a prop and arranged to protrude toward the antenna; an integrating housing having the tilting bracket combined therewith to be able to rotate in a vertical direction and combined with the base bracket to be able to rotate in a horizontal direction; a tilting driving unit for rotating the tilting bracket in a vertical direction; and a rotation driving unit for rotating the integrating housing in a horizontal direction, wherein the tilting driving unit and the rotating driving unit are arranged in the integrating housing.

title_en: Electronic device including magnetic sensor and operating method thereof
abstract_en: An electronic device includes: a magnetic sensor configured to identify a strength of a magnetic field; a wireless communications circuit; a processor; and a memory electrically connected to the magnetic sensor, the wireless communications circuit and the processor and storing instructions. The instructions, when executed by the processor, causes the electronic device to identify the plurality of strengths of the magnetic field during a first period using the magnetic sensor, identify whether a reference strength is updated based on the plurality of strengths, identify a first state of the electronic device based on a comparison result between the latest intensity among a plurality of intensities and an updated reference strength when a reference intensity is updated, and is configurable to perform a function according to the identified first state. In addition to this, various embodiments identified through the specification are possible.

title_en: The system for automatic call transfer
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic call routing service system, which comprises: an originating mobile switching center (MSC) which translates the number of a call requested from an originating terminal and requests routing to a terminating MSC; a terminating MSC which connects the call to a terminating terminal for call transfer service during a call at the terminating terminal with respect to the transmitted originating call; and a call routing device which is provided on one side of an exchanger for terminating call routing and is connected to the exchanger to translate the designated terminating number, or which is provided on one side of a specific space of a terminating subscriber to allow the terminating terminal to freely set and change the representative number, so that based on the set terminating number order with respect to the originating call introduced through the terminating MSC according to a terminating call connection request from the originating terminal, terminating calls during talking on the phone are sequentially switched. Therefore, the automatic call routing service system allows the originating call requested through the subscriber of the originating terminal to flow into a call transfer device through the exchanger and the call transfer device to selectively designate the order of designating calls and to transfer the calls to the designated terminating terminal, or to sequentially connect the originating calls according to the designated order when the terminating terminal is on a call, thereby providing calls regardless of time and location.

title_en: Foldable display and electronic device including thereof
abstract_en: An electronic device according to various embodiments of the present disclosure comprises: a hinge structure; a first housing connected to the hinge structure; a second housing connected to the first housing through the hinge structure so as to be rotatable with respect to the first housing; and a flexible display that is disposed on one area of the first housing and one area of the second housing and can be folded according to rotation, wherein the flexible display includes a glass layer, the glass layer includes a plurality of slits and a flexible part disposed to be bendable, and at least a portion of side surfaces of the plurality of slits may include a rough surface. Various other embodiments identified through the specification are also possible. The flexible display can prevent a display from peeling off.

title_en: Player Condition Check Self-Management Note For Best Performance
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an athlete condition check self-management note for optimal performance, which can realize more accurate condition check management, comprising: an upper end recording unit; an emotion check unit for selecting, displaying, and recording a main emotion; a score check unit disposed on a lower right side of the upper end recording unit of a left side; a description writing unit; a daily goal inspection unit; and a tag indicating unit of a structure having a specific color.

title_en: Cage for companion animals with UV sterilization function
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pet cage having a UV sterilization function for providing a comfortable environment for a pet. The pet cage having a UV sterilization function according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a cage body in which a pet lives; a UV sterilization unit installed in the cage body, and irradiating an interior of the cage body with ultraviolet light; an occupancy sensor unit installed in the cage body, and detecting the presence of the pet in the cage body; a wireless communication unit installed in the cage body, and performing wireless communication with a user terminal; a notification unit installed in the cage body, and notifying the completion of sterilization inside the cage body by the UV sterilization unit; a power supply unit installed in the cage body, and supplying power to the UV sterilization unit, the occupancy sensor unit, and the wireless communication unit; and a control unit installed in the cage body, and controlling the operation of the UV sterilization unit, the occupancy sensor unit, the wireless communication unit, and the power supply unit.

title_en: Transmitting apparatus and operating method thereof
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a transmitting apparatus comprises: an antenna module; a first communication module for transmitting and receiving signals via the antenna module with a first terminal served by the transmitting apparatus; and a processor electrically coupled to the first communication module. The processor obtains a channel matrix between terminals performing receive beamforming and the transmitting apparatus, obtains, from the obtained channel matrix, a first interference channel matrix corresponding to channel matrix between terminals other than the first terminal among the terminals and the transmitting apparatus, obtains, from the obtained first interference channel matrix, a second interference channel matrix satisfying an interference intensity condition, and determines a precoding matrix for a transmit stream of the first terminal based on a given precoding matrix and the obtained second interference channel matrix. Therefore, the present invention can minimize interference strength of transmit stream of a served terminal and determine an optimal precoding matrix for the transmit stream.

title_en: Food monitor system
abstract_en: A food monitoring system according to an embodiment comprises: a food monitoring device comprising a tableware area where tableware is placed, one or more load cells that detect the weight of the tableware when placed in the tableware area and the weight of the tableware after food is eaten and output a weight signal, a temperature sensor that measures the temperature of the food and outputs a temperature signal, and a signal processing unit that receives the weight signal and the temperature signal, calculates the weight difference before and after the food is eaten and the temperature of the food, and transmits the weight difference as a wireless signal; and a terminal that receives the wireless signal and executes an application that monitors the weight difference and the temperature of the food. Accordingly, food intake/temperature monitoring can be performed for the number of people (10 to 20 people) in each nursing ward.

title_en: Ue performing measurement operation for handover, communication system including the same, and operation method thereof
abstract_en: In order to achieve the above objective, according to one aspect of a technical idea of the present disclosure, provided is an operation method of a terminal, which includes the steps of: transmitting a user capability including receive performance information of a terminal to a serving cell; receiving a Doppler parameter generated based on the user capability and radio resource control (RRC) configuration information, from the serving cell; measuring reference signal received power (RSRP) of a reference signal and a Doppler shift with reference to the RRC configuration information, and the Doppler parameter; and reporting the RSRP_Doppler generated based on a measurement result to the serving cell.

title_en: Remote management of fruit trees and eradication of rodents
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a remote management of orchards and a rodent repellent, which enables wireless communication by means of a switch and a sensor and prevents rodents from climbing by means of an electric stimulator, solving the problem that it is difficult to use because of the need to attach and detach the device according to the harvest season. Accordingly, the present invention solves the problem that it is difficult to use because of the need to attach and detach the device according to the harvest season. The present invention comprises: a solar panel formed on a tree as a small panel so that the necessary power for an orchard rodent prevention device can be supplied through natural energy; a switch and sensor formed as a small square box so that wireless communication is possible; an electric stimulator formed in a cylindrical shape that can be wrapped around a tree so that rodents can be prevented from climbing; and a moisture and nutrient sensor formed in a rod shape so that the amount of nutrients and moisture can be detected by being inserted into the soil.

title_en: Structure and method for wireless charging of electronic device
abstract_en: According to embodiments of the present invention, an electronic device may comprise: a first housing; a second housing which is slidably coupled in a first direction designated from the first housing and in a second direction which is opposite to the first direction; a flexible display which is arranged to be supported by at least one portion of the first housing and the second housing, and of which the shape changes according to the movement of the second housing; a first antenna which is arranged at the second housing; a second antenna which is arranged at the first housing; and at least one battery which is set to be charged by using power received by means of the first antenna and/or the second antenna depending on the shape of the flexible display.

title_en: Guided weapon avoidance system and guided weapon avoidance method
abstract_en: A guided weapon avoidance system and a guided weapon avoidance method may be disclosed. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a guided weapon avoidance system comprises: a laser alarm device measuring a first laser signal irradiated to an object to generate warning information notifying a laser irradiation state; a laser light source device connected to the laser alarm device and generating a second laser signal for generating a similar target based on the warning information; and a similar target generation device connected to the laser light source device and generating a plurality of similar targets based on the second laser signal.

title_en: HMI device monitoring system using infrared and near field communications
abstract_en: The present invention provides an HMI device monitoring system using infrared communication and Wi-Fi. A portable monitoring terminal carried by a worker and an HMI device are equipped with dual infrared communication modules and short-range communication modules that operate on different communication protocols. During access, tasks such as equipment recognition, registration, and access approval (hereinafter referred to as pairing/authentication work) are performed using infrared communication. Once the pairing/authentication work is completed, the short-range communication module is activated to perform data exchange using short-range wireless communication. Accordingly, connections between devices are established accurately and quickly, significantly improving work efficiency, monitoring accuracy, and reliability. Furthermore, false access to the HMI device caused by a manager's carelessness can be prevented, effectively reducing process-related accidents. Additionally, unnecessary time consumed during the pairing/authentication work can be minimized.

title_en: System and method to remotely and automatically register the password per household of apartment complex for parking breaker entrance
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a remote automatic registration system for registering a password for each complex/generation for entering a parking circuit breaker. A remote automatic registration system for registering a password for each apartment complex/household for access to a parking circuit breaker comprises: an ARS server which calls a specific phone number, receives an apartment code number and a call number, confirms previously registered resident information, and sets a resident parking lot access password for each apartment complex/household; an apartment management server in which the resident information and information of cars are and manage stored, the resident password is stored, the visiting car number image/photograph, the entrance time, license plate numbers is stored in the apartment management server and which this is transmitted to the smartphone of the corresponding generation resident; a kiosk terminal which controls the opening and closing of the parking barrier for outside visitors based on the resident's authorization/denial message; and a parking circuit breaker connected to the kiosk terminal.

title_en: A mobile phone with fan
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mobile phone case, and more specifically, to a mobile phone case with a fan, in which a fan is installed on a mobile phone case to provide the convenience of holding both a mobile phone and a hand-held fan with one hand during the summer and to cool the heat generated by the mobile phone. The mobile phone case with a fan, according to the present invention, comprises: a main body in which the front surface is open to accommodate a mobile phone, a predetermined accommodating space is formed therein, and a ventilation hole is formed to penetrate the back surface with a predetermined diameter; a ring-shaped circular side wall that protrudes a certain length from an edge of the ventilation hole in a direction away from the accommodating space; a fan that is provided on the circular side wall and receives a predetermined power to generate airflow; an inlet that penetrates a lower part of the circular side wall to allow external air to flow into the circular side wall when the fan is operated; a rechargeable battery provided in the main body to supply power to the fan; and a Bluetooth module provided in the main body to control the operation of the fan using the mobile phone.

title_en: Antennadevice and electronic device including the same
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, provided is an electronic device that may comprise a housing or an antenna device arranged in the housing. The antenna device may comprise a first antenna array, a second antenna array, a communication processor, a radio frequency integrated circuit (RFIC), or an intermediate frequency integrated circuit (IFIC). The second antenna array may be arranged adjacent to the first antenna array. The second antenna array may be configured to transmit and/or receive signals in a frequency band different from that of the first antenna array. The RFIC may be electrically connected to the communication processor and the second antenna array. The IFIC may be electrically connected to the communication processor. The IFIC may be configured to be selectively connected to the first antenna array.

title_en: Transparent cover of vehicle radar equipped with hot wire
abstract_en: A transparent hot wire cover for a vehicle radar is disclosed. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a transparent hot wire cover for a vehicle radar comprises: a transparent substrate having insulating properties; a first conductive mesh pattern for an antenna formed on a front surface of the transparent substrate; and a second conductive mesh pattern for heat generation formed on a rear surface of the transparent substrate. The first conductive mesh pattern and the second conductive mesh pattern can be electrically connected to a radar module. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a transparent hot wire cover for a vehicle radar can provide a transparent cover that is free from radio wave transmission, can evenly and quickly remove moisture such as snow or frost from the entire transparent cover, and can provide an attractive transparent cover in which no metal pattern is visible.

title_en: Electronic device and method for controlling vibration thereof
abstract_en: An electronic device and a method for controlling vibration of an electronic device are provided. The electronic device comprises: a housing including a first housing part and a second housing part configured to be movable from the first housing part; a display capable of changing the size of an area visible from the front of the housing as the second housing part moves; a vibration motor accommodated within the housing and configured to vibrate at least a portion of the housing; at least one sensor; and a processor operatively connected to the display, the vibration motor, and the at least one sensor.

title_en: Electronic device
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an electronic device. According to one embodiment of the present disclosure, an electronic device includes: a housing including a first portion having a thickness in a first direction; and a display disposed in the housing. The first portion of the housing includes: a first conductive member forming a portion of an edge of the housing; a second conductive member forming a portion of an edge of the housing and spaced apart from the first conductive member in an extending direction of the edge; and a non-conductive member disposed between the first conductive member and the second conductive member. The first conductive member may include a plurality of protrusions protruding toward the second conductive member, contacting the non-conductive member, and spaced apart from each other in the first direction.

title_en: Battery management system and communication status inspecting method thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method for checking a communication state of a battery management system communicating with an external battery management system and a battery management system performing the same. The method comprises the steps of: receiving an optical signal having communication information transmitted from the external battery management system through a light receiving unit including a plurality of optical sensors arranged in a symmetrical structure around a reference point; checking one or more optical sensors receiving the optical signal among the plurality of optical sensors; and checking a communication state with the external battery management system based on the checked result.

title_en: Method and apparatus for receiving a signal in coded multi-user massive multi input multi output system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a signal receiving method for receiving signals transmitted through a channel from multiple users, performed by a signal receiving apparatus of a coded multi-user massive multi-input multi-output (MIMO) system. The method comprises: a detection step of detecting signals transmitted from each of the multiple users by obtaining a soft decision value for a symbol estimated using channel state information from the received signal; and a decoding step of decoding the detected signal based on the soft decision value. The detection step and the decoding step are performed sequentially and repeatedly according to at least one global iteration number. Each global iteration is characterized by being performed according to a Joint Detecting and Decoding (JDD) process, which consists of at least one local iteration of the detection step and at least one local iteration of the decoding step according to a predetermined ratio.

title_en: sunright-electronic phone charger
abstract_en: A solar cell of a mobile phone charging case comprises: an external protection (1) made of transparent plastic, silicon, and rubber; a solar panel (2) attached to the inside of the external protection to convert solar energy into electric energy; an inner material (3) made of a protective microfiber or a soft material for effectively protecting a mobile phone; an electric wire (4) transferring the electric energy; and a charging terminal (5) charging the mobile phone. According to the present invention, solar heat can be converted into electric energy by the solar panel, thereby solving a problem that an existing mobile phone case cannot be charged with magnetic force.

title_en: Method and apparatus for transmission and reception of a downlink control channel for power control in network cooperative communication systems
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a 5G or 6G communication system for supporting a higher data rate. The present disclosure relates to operations of a terminal and a base station in a wireless communication system, and more particularly, to a method for transmitting and receiving a downlink control channel for power control in network cooperative communication and an apparatus capable of performing the same. The present disclosure provides an apparatus and method capable of effectively providing a service in a mobile communication system.

title_en: Handling of beam pair links.
abstract_en: There is provided mechanisms for causing a switch to an alternative beam pair link. A terminal device is configured with a trigger condition for beam link failure. A method is performed by the terminal device. The method comprises estimating, during communication with a network node over a current beam pair link, that performance of the communication would behandling of beam pair links better if using the alternative beam pair link instead of the current beam pair link for the communication. The method comprises reporting beam link failure of the current beam pair link to the network node, without the trigger condition for beam link failure of the current beam pair link being met, thereby causing the switch to the alternative beam pair link.

title_en: Apparatus management system.
abstract_en: An apparatus management system comprising a control terminal (20) and a management device (30). The control terminal (20) collects information pertaining to an air conditioner (10). The management device (30) performs communication with the control terminal (20) via a communication network. The management device (30) has a communication unit and an abnormality determination unit. The communication unit accepts the abnormality content of the air conditioner (10) that is inputted thereto. The abnormality determination unit designates detailed operation information in accordance with an estimated abnormality content. The detailed operation information is used for specifying the cause of abnormality when abnormality of the air conditioner (10) is estimated. The control terminal (20) has a transmission processing unit. The transmission processing unit transmits the detailed operation information on the basis of designation of the abnormality determination unit.

title_en: Aerial vehicle management for an aeronautical communications network
abstract_en: The invention provides a system and method of providing service coverage for the provision of data services to a target aircraft comprising the step of configuring one or more other aircraft in an area at a specific time such that the data services can be provided via a radio or communication link to the target aircraft via the one or more other aircraft; and predicting a data services requirement in an area and configuring a pattern of communication links with the one or more other aircraft and the target aircraft to maintain the predicted data services.

title_en: Antenna device for a radar sensor
abstract_en: Antenna device (100) for a radar sensor (200) having: - at least one first antenna group (20) arranged on a surface of a substrate (1) and having a defined number of serially connected planar antenna elements (10); - at least one second antenna group (30) arranged on the surface of the substrate (1) and having a defined number of serially connected planar antenna elements (10); a feed line (12) which is connected to the centre of each of the the two antenna groups (20, 30); - wherein a feed signal can be fed into the antenna group (20, 30) by means of the feed line (12) in such way that a feed signal which is phase-shifted by 180 degrees with respect to the second antenna group (30) can be fed to the first antenna group (20).

title_en: System and method for generating and transmitting a non-real time communication
abstract_en: A system and method for generating and transmitting a non-real time communication are disclosed. The system includes a communication center having a communication server and a scheduling server which reduce a cost of transmitting non-real time communications. The communication server controls at least one or more of a transmission speed, a transmission quality, or a transmission packet size. The scheduling server is configured to schedule the transmission of non-real time communications based on when network traffic is low or near idle.

title_en: Electronic device including multiband antenna
abstract_en: An electronic device is provided. The electronic device (101,201, 301, 401, 402, 403, 601a, 601b, 601c, 701, 801, 901, 1001, 1101) includes an outer housing (210, 320, 410, 710, 810, 910, 1010) having a first conductive structure, a display adapted to expose at least a portion of the display through the first surface of the outer housing (210,320,410,710,810,910, 1010), and a printed circuit board (PCB) (360, 440, 740, 840, 940, 1040, 1140) electrically connected to the display (160, 220, 330, 420, 720, 820, 1120), where the first conductive structure includes a first point connected to a feeder of the PCB (360,440, 740,840,940, 1040, 1140) and a second point connected to a ground part of the PCB (360, 440, 740, 840, 940, 1040, 1140), and where the display (160, 220, 330, 420, 720, 820, 1120) includes a second conductive structure electrically connected to the PCB (360, 440, 740, 840, 940, 1040, 1140).

title_en: Communications network and related devices
abstract_en: This application discloses a communications network and a related device. The communications network includes a first optical line terminal, a second optical line terminal, and customer-premises equipment. The second optical line terminal may be connected to a first optical line terminal at an upper layer through a PON interface, and may be further connected to customer-premises equipment at a lower layer through a PON interface. The communications network in this application enables a user in a remote area to access a broadband service. In addition, the PON interface features point-to-multipoint transmission, and therefore transmission media can be saved and networking costs can be reduced. (Figure 6)

title_en: Method and system for controlling iq signal phase error
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the technical field of coherent optical modules. Disclosed are a method and a system for controlling IQ signal phase error, the method comprising the following steps: controlling the IQ signal phase error by adjusting the intensity coefficients of channels corresponding to I signal and Q signal, respectively. The present invention can reduce or even eliminate the quadrature angle phase error of IQ signals to improve the performance of the coherent optical communication system without providing a phase shifter or changing the original coherent optical communication system architecture.  (Fig. 1)

title_en: Control channel resource grouping and spatial relation configuration
abstract_en: Certain aspects of the present disclosure provide techniques for control channel resource grouping and spatial relation configuration. Aspects of the present disclosure provide a method of wireless communication by a user equipment (UE). The method generally includes receiving an indication of one or more groupings of one or more control channel resources within a configured bandwidth. Each grouping is associated with a spatial relation. The UE applies a spatial relation for a control channel transmission using one or more control channel resources in a grouping of the one or more groupings. The grouping is associated with the spatial relation.

title_en: Wagon monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for monitoring wagon activity in order to determine certain parameters, such as position and speed, as well as to display said parameters on a map, by means of a dedicated management program. The claimed wagon monitoring method consists in forming wagon networks, using some devices to be mounted on the wagons to transmit information on certain parameters, such as: position, speed, vibrations etc., to a management program, via a data concentrator and a global communication network. According to the invention, the monitoring system comprises a plurality of electronic devices (wag_POS_1, wag_POS_2,...,wag_POS_n) for monitoring the wagon parameters, mounted on the bogie of each wagon (w1, wn-1, wn) and communicating in a mash-type network, the electronic circuits of the devices (wag_POS) being supplied with electric power by means of a power unit (BE) which has the role of converting a part of the energy resulting from rotation of the wagon wheels and from vibrations into electric power.

title_en: RFID tag arrangement with omnidirectional antenna characteristics
abstract_en: An RFID tag arrangement (1) comprises a first (20; 20’; 20”; 20”’) and second (30; 30’; 30”; 30’”) antenna, each comprising an intermediate feeding part (23; 23’; 23”a, 23”b; 23”’a, 23”’b and 33; 33’; 33”a, 33”b; 33”’a, 33”’b) and two radiating dipole elements (21, 22; 21’, 22’; 21”, 22”; 21’”, 22’” and 31, 32; 31’, 32’; 31”, 32”; 31’”, 32’”) connected to the intermediate feeding part and extending in different directions. An RFID chip (24) is electrically coupled to each of the intermediate feeding parts. The radiating dipole elements of the two antennas are arranged at a distance from each other, and the intermediate parts are arranged to cross each other at least one crossing point.
