abstract_en: A computer implemented method of processing calls in a telephone network, the method comprising: identifying a plurality of calls that have been made by a particular telephone number to destination telephone numbers in the telephone network; dividing the plurality of calls into N subsets of calls, determining whether a sequence of one of the subsets of calls corresponds to a correct calling order, wherein the correct calling order is determined based on a predetermined rule for ordering destination telephone numbers in the telephone network, that rule having previously been generated based on a secret shared with a party that is authorised to use the particular telephone number; and determining that one or more of the calls were made by spoofing the particular telephone number when that sequence does not correspond to the correct calling order.

title_en: Reference signal selection in multiple transmission reception point operations
abstract_en: Various aspects of the present disclosure generally relate to wireless communication. In some aspects, a user equipment (UE) may receive configuration information associated with a multiple transmission reception point (mTRP) operation, the configuration information indicating a plurality of CORESETs and including an indicated transmission configuration indicator (TCI), of a plurality of TCIs. The UE may receive an RS based on a selection rule for at least one beam failure determination (BFD) reference signal (RS) set, the selection rule indicating that the at least one BFD RS set comprises at least one of: a source RS of the indicated TCI, based on at least one CORESET being associated with the indicated TCI, or a source RS of a non-indicated TCI of the plurality of TCIs, based on each of the plurality of CORESETs being associated with a respective TCI other than the indicated TCI. Numerous other aspects are described.

title_en: Ai/ml 5g temporal domain beam prediction
abstract_en: An apparatus and system are described for using an artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML) model in beam scheduling. The AI/ML model is implemented in one or both of a base station (BS) or user equipment (UE). Beam prediction is triggered by the BS or by a request from the UE. Durations of the observation phase and prediction phase are described, as are the input and output for the AIML model. When multiple AI/ML models are stored a selection mechanism is used to indicate which specific AI/ML model is implemented.

title_en: Packet sending method and electronic device
abstract_en: The present application provides a packet sending method and an electronic device. The method is applied to a first electronic device, and comprises: in response to a received first operation, disabling at least one service module in a running state in a first electronic device, wherein the first operation is used for instructing to send a satellite packet; and sending a first packet. The solution provided by the present application can realize the satellite communication function, and increase the success rate of satellite communication.

title_en: Method for managing reachability of a user equipment in a non-terrestrial network
abstract_en: A user equipment (UE) communicating with a non-terrestrial network (NTN) node can implement a method for managing paging for the UE from a core network (CN). The method includes: (i) receiving, from the CN and at the UE, a downlink message including NTN time information associated with reachability; (ii) starting, at the UE, a timer with a time duration based on the NTN time information; and (iii) suspending, at the UE, monitoring paging for the UE while the timer is running.

title_en: Estimation of transmitted samples of mimo streams
abstract_en: There is provided techniques for estimating transmitted samples of MIMO streams. A method is performed by a MIMO transceiver. The method comprises receiving a sequence of samples from each receive antenna containing combinations of the MIMO streams. The method comprises repeatedly, and for each block of samples of each MIMO stream, identifying, using a set of test angles, which of the test angles that minimize a distance between each of the samples as rotated by the test angles and constellation points as selected from a set of constellation points, and estimating the transmitted samples for the block of symbols of the MIMO stream as a sequence of the constellation points as given by the identified test angles for the block of samples of the MIMO stream.

title_en: Wireless communication method and apparatus, communication device, and storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to the technical field of wireless communications. Disclosed are a wireless communication method and apparatus, a communication device, and a storage medium. The wireless communication method comprises: acquiring a long-term signal-to-noise ratio measurement value for performing signal-to-noise ratio measurement on a wireless communication signal; adaptively selecting a filter coefficient according to the long-term signal-to-noise ratio measurement value, and performing infinite impulse response low-pass filtering according to the selected filter coefficient to obtain a stable long-term estimation value; and performing signal compensation according to the long-term estimation value, and updating the long-term estimation value according to an actual compensation value.

title_en: Electronic device comprising antenna
abstract_en: According to an exemplary embodiment of the present invention, an electronic device is provided, the electronic device comprising: a side which provides at least a portion of a side surface of the electronic device and includes a first conductive portion, a second conductive portion, and a third conductive portion that are physically separated from each other; a wireless communication circuit configured to transmit and/or receive a signal in at least one selected or designated frequency band through the first conductive portion and the third conductive portion; a first electrical path electrically connecting the first conductive portion and the wireless communication circuit; and a second electrical path electrically connecting the third conductive portion and the first electrical path, wherein the second conductive portion is positioned between the first conductive portion and the third conductive portion and electrically and/or physically connected to a ground region included in the electronic device.

title_en: Cross frequency range information for beam prediction
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communications are described. A user equipment (UE) may transmit a set of sounding reference signals (SRSs) using a set of beams of the UE via a first serving cell that may support communications for the UE using a first frequency range. The UE may then receive directional information for the UE based on channel propagation characteristics between the UE and a network entity, where the channel propagation characteristics may be based on the SRSs transmitted via the first serving cell. Based on the directional information, the UE may perform a beam prediction procedure to predict an uplink beam of the UE for communicating via a second serving cell that may be different from the first serving cell. The UE may then transmit one or more uplink messages, using the uplink beam of the UE, via the second serving cell using a second frequency range.

title_en: Method for managing an optical-link satellite telecommunications system aided by meteorological models for continuity of service
abstract_en: The invention describes a method for optical-link communication between at least one satellite (10) and a plurality of transmitting and/or receiving ground stations (20), comprising: - obtaining cloud coverage data from the ground stations, and data relating to an orbit of the satellite, - determining, for each ground station (20), forecasts on the possibility of establishing an uninterrupted optical link between the satellite and the ground station, for at least two given short-term and long-term time horizons, and - selecting at least one of the ground stations (20) to establish an uplink or downlink optical-link communication with the satellite, based on the longest predicted duration for which it is possible to establish an uninterrupted optical link between the station and the satellite.

title_en: Method and device for beamforming in wireless communication system
abstract_en: An operation method of a first node in a wireless communication system according to an embodiment of the present disclosure may comprise the steps of: transmitting, to a second node, terminal capability information including information about a sensor included in the first node; transmitting, to the second node, first location information of the first node when the first node enters a specific area; receiving, from the second node, a correction table for the sensor; obtaining an offset value for the sensor on the basis of correction information and a preconfigured calibration offset table; obtaining a first measurement value through the sensor; obtaining a final prediction value for the sensor on the basis of the offset value for the sensor and the first measurement value; and performing at least one of beam prediction and beam tracking on the basis of the final prediction value.

title_en: Multilayer substrate module and electronic device
abstract_en: The objective of the present invention is to reduce weight. This multilayer substrate module (100) includes: a rigid part (101) in which a first multilayer substrate (1), a dielectric component (3), and a second multilayer substrate (2) are stacked; and a flexible part (102) in which the first multilayer substrate (1) and the second multilayer substrate (2) are stacked without the intermediary of the dielectric component (3). The rigid part (101) has a radiation electrode (4) and a ground electrode (5). At least one of a plurality of first conductive layers (12a, 12b, 12c) and a second conductive layer (22) has a conductor part that is included in the flexible part (102) and the rigid part (101). The thickness (T2) of the flexible part (102) is thinner than the thickness (T1) of the rigid part (101).

title_en: Lighting device comprising radar-transparent section and heating element
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lighting device (2), in particular for a motor vehicle, comprising: at least one light source (100, 100a, 100b) for emitting light; a light guiding section (200), which, relative to an optical axis (4) of the lighting device (2), is arranged outside a radar incoupling surface (402) for incoupling radar beams (6) of a radar-transparent section (400) and at least partially extends along an imaginary peripheral path (204), wherein the light guiding section (200) comprises a light incoupling surface (202) for incoupling the light from the light sources (100), and wherein the light guiding section (200) guides the incoupled light (102) proceeding from the light incoupling surface (202) toward a light transition region (300) between the light guiding section (200) and the radar-transparent section (400); and the radar-transparent inner section (400) having the radar incoupling surface (402) for incoupling the radar radiation (6) and having an outcoupling surface (404) for outcoupling the incoupled radar radiation (6) and for emitting a light distribution (106) depending on light (104) introduced into the inner radar-transparent section (400) by means of the light guiding section (200), wherein the radar-transparent section (400) comprises at least one heating element, in particular a plurality of heating elements (10).

title_en: Antenna feed and antenna comprising the same
abstract_en: Embodiments of present disclosure provide an antenna feed and an antenna comprising the antenna feed. In an aspect, the antenna feed comprises a body formed of a dielectric material and around a center axis. The body comprises a first surface portion with a first elliptical curve in radial cross-section. Slopes of tangents to the first elliptical curve are decreased gradually in a radially outward direction. The body also comprises a second surface portion axially opposite to the first surface portion and with a second elliptical curve or a plurality of linear segments in the radial cross-section. Slopes of tangents to the second elliptical curve or slopes of the plurality of linear segments are increased gradually in the radially outward direction. The embodiments of the present disclosure implement a high-performance antenna feed and antenna suitable for terahertz frequencies, especially the D-band.

title_en: Configuration method and authentication method for optical communication device, and apparatus, optical communication device, and system
abstract_en: Disclosed are a configuration method and authentication method for an optical communication device, and an apparatus, an optical communication device, and a system, which belong to the technical field of optical communications. The configuration method comprises: a first optical communication device determining a random delay parameter, wherein the random delay parameter is less than 48 μs; and sending a broadcast message to a plurality of second optical communication devices, wherein the broadcast message carries configuration information, the configuration information being used for configuring random delay parameters. The first optical communication device can flexibly configure the random delay parameters of the second optical communication devices by means of the broadcast message.

title_en: Phase-reconfigurable circuits with dynamic phase modulation for wideband dual-input power amplifiers
abstract_en: A phase-reconfigurable circuit (100) for a dual-input power amplifier is provided. The circuit (100) includes an envelope detector (120) configured to process an envelope of an RF input signal into an envelope signal. A first vector-sum phase-shifter (140) and a second vector-sum phase-shifter (145) processes an in-phase and a quadrature-phase version of the RF input signal with the envelope signal to produce a first differential output signal having a dynamically-modulated phase difference with a second differential output signal.

title_en: Base feedback method and apparatus
abstract_en: A base feedback method and apparatus, relating to the technical field of communications, and used to implement an effective solution for feeding back a weighting coefficient matrix under a non-DFT base. In the present application, when reporting a space domain feature base and a frequency domain feature base (or a space-frequency feature base), by means of decomposing the space domain feature base and the frequency domain feature base into a space domain base and a frequency domain base (or decomposing the space-frequency feature base into a space-frequency base), and by means of reporting a weighting matrix obtained by decomposition, separately indicating the space domain feature base and the frequency domain feature base (or the space-frequency feature base); associating a priority level of a reported weighting coefficient with a sequence number of the space domain base, a sequence number of the frequency domain base, and a sequence number of the space domain feature base and the frequency domain feature base. In addition, the present application ensures, as much as possible, that a coefficient having a relatively high amplitude has a higher priority level, i.e., is preferentially fed back, and a coefficient having a relatively low amplitude is preferentially discarded, so as to ensure reporting precision is ensured and improve system performance.

title_en: Electronic device, method, and non-transitory computer-readable storage medium for broadcasting in wireless environment
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electronic device for broadcasting in a wireless environment, wherein the electronic device is configured to, while providing a first audio service by broadcasting packets N times within one (a) BIS event, detect an event for a second audio service provided by transmitting packets to an external electronic device, and to, while providing the second audio service by using a communication circuit on the basis of the detection, broadcast packets for the first audio service M times (M is a natural number greater than or equal to 1 and less than N) within the BIS event.

title_en: Optimizing model performance of user equipments (ues) based on collective intelligence at base station
abstract_en: Embodiments of present disclosure disclose optimizing model performance of UEs based on collective intelligence at base-station. The base-station transmits first segment CSI-RS to plurality of UEs in an area via DL channel corresponding to each of the plurality of UEs. The base-station receives compressed CSI feedback comprising second segment of predicted CSI-RS and one or more CSI parameters from each of the plurality of UEs. The base-station reconstructs CSI-RS associated with each of the plurality of UEs based on CSI feedback received from corresponding UE and first segment. The base-station identifies one or more UEs from plurality of UEs providing an optimized CSI based on predefined threshold-value, using reconstructed CSI-RS. Thereafter, base-station transmits, assistance-information and model-parameters associated with one or more UEs to each of the plurality of UEs, for training corresponding model. Thus, present disclosure improves KPIs of UEs, based on model-parameters and assistance-information of best performing UE(s).

title_en: Optical module, and temperature collection method for optical module
abstract_en: An optical module, and a temperature collection method for an optical module. The optical module comprises: a circuit board (300), wherein a first temperature sensor (302) and a micro-control unit (303) are provided on the circuit board (300), and a second temperature sensor (3031) is built in the micro-control unit (303). The micro-control unit (303) is configured to: determine a collected-data source for the current working temperature of the optical module and acquire third collected data corresponding to the current working temperature of the optical module; when the collected-data source for the current working temperature is the first temperature sensor (302), determine the magnitude relationship between the third collected data and a first preset threshold; when the third collected data is greater than or equal to the first preset threshold, determine the current working temperature of the optical module by means of first collected data of the first temperature sensor (302); when the third collected data is less than the first preset threshold, acquire a compensation value, and second collected data of the second temperature sensor (3031); and perform compensation calibration on the second collected data on the basis of the compensation value, and determine the current working temperature of the optical module.

title_en: Composite resonator and radio wave control plate
abstract_en: This composite resonator comprises: a first electrode that constitutes a first resonator and is disposed on a first surface; and a second electrode that constitutes a second resonator and is disposed on a second surface which is separated from the first surface in a first direction. In a plan view along a direction orthogonal to the first surface and the second surface, the second electrode has a rotationally-symmetrical opening located in a portion that faces a portion of the first electrode where the magnetic field is relatively small. In a plan view along the direction orthogonal to the first surface and the second surface, the first electrode and the second electrode overlap with each other in a rotationally symmetrical manner.

title_en: Method and device for transmitting/receiving channel state information in wireless communication system
abstract_en: A method and a device for transmitting/receiving channel state information in a wireless communication system are disclosed. The method according to one embodiment of the present disclosure may comprise steps in which a UE: receives configuration information related to a CSI report from a base station; receives a downlink RS on one or more resources from the base station; transmits, to the base station, a first uplink transmission related to whether an event related to the CSI report has occurred; and transmits, to the base station, a second uplink transmission including a report value derived on the basis of the downlink RS.

title_en: Terminal, wireless communication method, and base station
abstract_en: A terminal according to an aspect disclosed herein comprises: a reception unit that receives precoding information for uplink (UL) transmission using three antenna ports (3TX); and a control unit that controls the 3TX UL transmission on the basis of second precoding information associated with the number of layers of first precoding information among the precoding information.

title_en: Method and apparatus for user equipment-initiated beam management
abstract_en: This method, of a user equipment, for user equipment-initiated beam management may include the steps of: determining whether a condition for transmitting a signal for triggering user equipment-initiated beam management is satisfied; when it is determined that the condition is satisfied, transmitting, to a base station, the signal for triggering user equipment-initiated beam management; receiving, from the base station, a channel state information (CSI)-related reference signal; and as a result of measuring the CSI-related reference signal, when a beam reporting event has occurred, transmitting, to the base station, a measurement report related to the beam reporting event.

title_en: Rotating shaft mechanism and electronic device
abstract_en: The present application provides a rotating shaft mechanism and an electronic device. According to the rotating shaft mechanism, a support member is arranged in at least one of a main shaft and connecting plate assemblies; the support member comprises a support body and a protective portion; the protective portion is arranged on the surface of the side of the support body facing a flexible circuit board; the protective portion at least covers a contact portion of the support member, and the surface of the side of the protective portion facing the flexible circuit board is an insulating wear-resistant surface.

title_en: Robotic antenna system for multiple satellites tracking
abstract_en: Multiple low noise block down converter feeds (LNBFs) independently move close to the surface of the lower half of a spherical lens to create N beams for simultaneous tracking of N satellites, preferably containing a visible hemisphere. A spiderlike robot with non-metal arms positions the LNBFs. Each LNBF can have several feeds for different satellite frequency bands. LNBFs can be carried by one or two circular rails, movable arc rails orthogonal to a circular rail, or magnetic coupling to the lens. RC platforms can be autonomous, with connections using Bluetooth™ or other radio links. be Single feeds can be arranged in a chess board arrangement, where each piece of the chess board is responsible for a small three-dimensional angle of the sky. In any of these embodiments, LNBFs can be positioned closer or farther from the lens to create a relative phase shift.

title_en: Communication device, communication system, and communication method
abstract_en: A first communication device (11) and a second communication device (12) (see Fig. 1) are provided with: a first communication unit (21) that communicates data including voice to an external communication device; an extraction unit (22) that extracts communication information; a counting unit (23) that counts the elapsed time from the end of communication; a second communication unit (24) for transmitting and receiving a VOX switching request signal and a response signal between the first and second communication devices; an input unit (25) to which voice is input; a calculation unit (26) that calculates priority information; a control unit (28) that determines whether the VOX function is enabled or disabled in accordance with the priority information; and a VOX unit (27) that transmits data to the external communication device via the first communication unit (21) when the VOX function is enabled and the voice input to the input unit (25) is at or above a prescribed volume level. This makes it possible to use the VOX function of a plurality of VOX communication devices.

title_en: Information sending method and apparatus
abstract_en: Disclosed in embodiments of the present disclosure are an information sending method and an apparatus. The method comprises: determining a first parameter, the first parameter being the number of slots occupied by transport block processing over multiple slots (TBoMS); determining a second parameter, the second parameter being the length of an orthogonal cover code (OCC) sequence; and on the basis of the first parameter and the second parameter, sending to a network device a physical uplink shared channel (PUSCH) of the TBoMS based on OCC extension, such that a terminal can realize transmission of the TBoMS based on OCC extension. Thus, the link performance of data channels can be improved while realizing multi-user multiplexing and improving the overall capacity of a system, more users can be supported to perform uplink transmission, improving the system communication efficiency, and the resource utilization rate and the spectral efficiency can be effectively improved.

title_en: Device, system and method for neural stimulation, and storage medium
abstract_en: A device, system and method for neural stimulation, and a storage medium. The device comprises: a stimulation control module, which is disposed outside of a biological body, and is used for generating a stimulation instruction; a remote control module, which is disposed outside of the biological body, is in communication connection with the stimulation control module, and is used for generating a module activation instruction for activating the stimulation control module; and an electrode module, which is used for being implanted into the biological body, and is in communication connection with the stimulation control module, so as to execute the stimulation instruction sent by the stimulation control module. By means of the solution, intervention can be performed in a timely manner when a patient foresees risks, so as to reduce potential risks; and the volume of an implanted part can also be reduced, thereby reducing surgical trauma and also breaking through power consumption limits, and thus neural stimulation therapy with a better effect is implemented by using an algorithm with a higher precision.

title_en: A dual-band offset dish antenna for beam steering
abstract_en: This disclosure relates to antennas suitable for beam steering to enable intelligent beam tracking (IBT). The disclosure presents a dual-band antenna, which may be an offset dish antenna. The antenna comprises a feeder for radiating radio frequency (RF) waves along a first axis, a first lens arranged on the first axis, a second lens arranged on the first axis downstream the first lens, and a sub-reflector arranged on the first axis downstream the second lens. The antenna further comprises a dish reflector. The first lens, the second lens, and the sub-reflector are together configured to focus the RF waves to a focal point of the dish reflector, and the dish reflector is configured to reflect the RF waves as an antenna beam along a second axis. To steer the antenna beam, at least one of the first lens and the second lens is displaceable orthogonal to the first axis.

title_en: Method for building a target sequence of binary samples of a code sequence comprising binary chips
abstract_en: The present disclosure proposes a method for getting a binary sequence representing the sampling of an underlying binary code sequence. The proposed approach builds the target sequence by concatenating sets of samples taken from another reference sequence representing the sampling of the same underlying code but at different sampling rate and/or initial phase than the target sequence. The main idea is that both the target and the reference sequences share sets of samples that are common, sample by sample, in both sequences, so that such sets of samples can be reused to build the target sequence, and, at each transition between sets, one or several reference samples must be either duplicated or discarded. The present disclosure explains how to compute the indexes of those common sets and shows how the samples at the transitions need to be managed. The main advantage of this approach is to allow computational savings.

title_en: Communication method and related apparatus
abstract_en: Provided in the present application are a communication method and a related apparatus, which can effectively improve the accuracy of channel information. The method comprises: a terminal device acquiring N first CSI reports; and when CSI reporting resources are insufficient to feed back the N first CSI reports, the terminal device updating M first CSI reports among the N first CSI reports on the basis of a preset codebook, so as to obtain M second CSI reports, wherein M is less than or equal to N, and both M and N are positive integers.

title_en: Electronic device for managing communication link with wearable electronic device and operating method thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an electronic device for managing a communication link with a wearable electronic device and an operating method thereof. According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, the electronic device comprises a communication circuit for supporting short-range communication, at least one processor, and a memory for storing instructions. The instructions, when executed by the at least one processor, may cause the electronic device to: establish a first communication link with a first external electronic device; receive information regarding a wearing status of the first external electronic device from the first external electronic device through the first communication link; obtain information regarding a wearing status of a second external electronic device; and request the first external electronic device to establish a third communication link with the second external electronic device if both the first external electronic device and the second external electronic device are worn.

title_en: Foldable terminal device
abstract_en: Provided in the present application is a foldable terminal device, comprising a first main body, a second main body, a connection structure and a feed source. The first main body and the second main body are folded or unfolded relative to each other by means of the connection structure. The first main body comprises a main branch; the main branch is arranged on the first frame of the first main body opposite to the connection structure; and the main branch is provided with a feeding point and a first grounding point, is connected to the feed source by means of the feeding point and is grounded by means of the first grounding point. The second main body comprises a first parasitic branch, the first parasitic branch being arranged on the second frame of the second main body opposite to the connection structure. When the foldable terminal device is in a folded state, and under the excitation of a feed signal output by the feed source, the main branch resonates at a first frequency and generates a current in a first direction, and the first parasitic branch resonates at a second frequency, the first frequency being lower than the second frequency, such that under the coupled excitation of the main branch, the first parasitic branch generates a current distributed in the first direction, thus reducing the radiation energy loss of the main branch by means of currents superimposed in the same direction.

title_en: Cash register device and cash register assembly
abstract_en: A cash register device and a cash register assembly. The cash register device (100) comprises a lower shell (1), an upper shell (2), an NFC module (3), and a code scanning module (4). The upper shell (2) and the lower shell (1) are fixed to each other and define an accommodating cavity (11). The NFC module (3) is located in the accommodating cavity (11) for performing electronic payment by proximity to an electronic device. The electronic device can perform electronic payment simply by being brought in proximity to the NFC module (3), thereby improving shopping experience for consumers, increasing the number of transactions for merchants, and increasing the revenue for the merchants. The code scanning module (4) is located in the accommodating cavity (11) for identifying a payment code. The code scanning module (4) and the NFC module (3) are successively arranged along the length direction of the cash register device and face the same side of the cash register device. The code scanning module (4) provides more payment modes, achieves greater customer friendliness, and improves use experience for the consumers.

title_en: Flexible design of type 1 precoding codebook for channel state information (csi) framework
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to a method (700) for channel state information (CSI) reference signal processing and feedback reporting at a user equipment (UE) (500) The method (700) includes receiving (702), from a base station (gNB) (600), a plurality of non-precoded non- zero power (NZP) CSI reference signal (CSI-RS) resources. Based on the CSI-RS resources, UE (500) determines beam indicators corresponding to a set of discrete Fourier transform (DFT) spatial domain (SD) vectors of reduced dimension, derived using array splitting in horizontal and vertical combinations. Co-phasing phase shift indicators are applied to the DFT SD vectors to construct candidate narrow SD beams. A polarization co-phasing phase shift is applied to a subset of these beams to generate a beam for each transmission layer. UE (500) then generates a CSI report comprising information on the selected beam indicators, co-phasing shift indicators, and polarization co-phasing for transmission to the gNB (600).

title_en: Optical sending device, optical receiving device, terminal device, ota upgrade method and system
abstract_en: An optical sending device, an optical receiving device, a terminal device, and an OTA upgrade method and system. The optical sending device comprises a light source, the light source being used for sending to at least one optical receiving device an optical signal carrying target data, and the target data being used for an OTA upgrade of a terminal device.

title_en: Use of reduced dimensional adaptive beam weights for uplink transmission
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communications are described. A first wireless communication device (e.g., a user equipment (UE)) may transmit sounding reference signals (SRSs) via a set of beams via application of adaptive beam weights using a subset of the total quantity of antenna elements of the first wireless communication device. Accordingly, the first wireless communication device may perform adaptive beam training, but may reduce the total quantity of possible adaptive beam weights. The first wireless communication device may request SRS resources from the second wireless communication device (e.g., a network entity) and the second wireless communication device may grant SRS resources for the first wireless communication device to perform the adaptive beam training. The second wireless communication device may measure the SRSs and may estimate the set of adaptive beam weights for the first wireless communication device to use for a subsequent uplink communication.

title_en: Indicating a change in at least a subset of channel state information
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method comprising generating a report comprising information that indicates a change in at least a subset of channel state information compared to previously reported channel state information; and transmitting the report within an uplink transmission to a network device, wherein the report is transmitted on one or more unused radio resources from one or more radio resources allocated for the uplink transmission.

title_en: Method for enhancing codebook-based pusch transmission
abstract_en: Various aspects of the present disclosure relate to a UE, a network entity, a processor for wireless communication, and methods for enhancing codebook-based physical uplink shared channel (PUSCH) transmission. In an example method, the UE reports information indicating a number of transmit (Tx) antenna ports and a number of antenna groups, wherein the number of transmit antenna ports is 6, 12, or 16. The UE further receives an indication of one or more fully coherent precoding matrices selected from codebooks for 2Tx, 4Tx, or 8Tx transmission, wherein the one or more precoding matrices are used to determine a precoding matrix for uplink (UL) transmission with 6Tx, 12Tx or 16Tx antenna ports.

title_en: Method and system for data exchange between fpv drone and operator
abstract_en: The inventions relate to communications technology. A method for data exchange between an FPV drone and an operator consists in converting a video signal from an on-board video surveillance camera of an FPV drone into optical form, and transmitting same over a fibre optic cable to a transceiver device of a detachable module, which converts the signal into electrical form for transmission over a radio link to a transceiver device of an operator console. The FPV drone is controlled in a similar fashion by the transmission of control signals from the operator control console over the radio link to the transceiver device of the detachable module, where the signals are converted into optical form for transmission over the fibre optic cable to the FPV drone. A system for data exchange between an FPV drone and an operator comprises two cascaded communication links, specifically a radio link and a fibre optic link, and a module which can be detached from the FPV drone and landed, said module comprising a landable optoelectronic transceiver device of the fibre optic link and, coupled thereto, a transceiver device of the radio link, as well as a parachute suspension, and an autonomous power supply with an on-off unit. This increases the operating range of the communication links and improves jamming resistance.

title_en: Stamped aircraft fairing
abstract_en: An aircraft antenna assembly for an electronically steered antenna, the aircraft antenna assembly including a formed aluminum fairing integrated with the electronically steered antenna, wherein the fairing comprises an integrated skirt and top surface framing the electronically steered antenna and an adapter plate connecting the fairing to the aircraft.

title_en: Scintillation mitigation in geographically distributed satellite access nodes
abstract_en: Systems and methods are described for scintillation mitigation in satellite communications systems with geographically distributed access nodes. Some embodiments operate in context of a bent-pipe satellite that illuminates user and gateway coverage areas with fixed spot beams. Beamforming can be used, along with coordinated, phase-synchronized communication by the distributed access nodes, to generate signals that coherently combine via the satellite. Scintillation and/or other atmospheric irregularities can degrade phase synchronization at the access nodes. Accordingly, embodiments can monitor phase tracking performance of the access nodes to detect when a phase tracking error occurs in at least one of the access nodes. In response to detecting the phase tracking error, embodiments can inhibit transmitting of forward uplink data signals by at least that access node.

title_en: Hybrid adaptive networks
abstract_en: Described herein are hybrid adaptive networks (HAN) that enable the use of multiple, independent communications networks as a unified communications system. The disclosed HAN includes multiple communications networks that user terminals can simultaneously access. The disclosed HAN enables a user terminal to seamlessly roam across multiple communications networks. The disclosed HAN can increase the capabilities and resilience of user terminals by providing simultaneous access to multiple communications networks. For example, these communications networks may span multiple orbital regions, operate over multiple frequency bands, provide independent terrestrial infrastructure, and/or feature different network management and cyber defense implementations thereby providing inherent diversity and removing single points of failure and/or targets for attack.

title_en: Incomplete Decentralization Method Based on Blockchain Technology
abstract_en:
The invention discloses an incomplete decentralization method based on blockchain 
technology, which comprises the following steps of: (1) Algorithm formula: Innovatively 
proposing a general algorithm formula for incomplete decentralization on a chain. (2) 
Algorithm model: A general algorithm model is given based on the algorithm formula, which 
is applied to the strong supervision model of chain. The vote with private key signature is 
inputted as model and the ring structure continues, and finally outputted as the overall decision 
of the ring structure to ensure the anonymity of individual's decision. (3) Smart contract 
function body model and compilation deployment: The invention innovatively proposes to 
apply the smart contract technology compilation algorithm to realize the super node on the 
traditional blockchain, which not only protects the consensus mechanism of decentralization at 
the bottom of the blockchain, but also meets the application requirements of strong supervision 
on the chain. At the same time, the authority on the chain can be adjusted through regulating 
the algorithm model. This method meets the needs of strong government centralization, 
increases the flexibility of chain decision-making, and realizes a better combination of 
blockchain and strong government centralization.

title_en: Adjusting weights of weighted consensus algorithms for blockchains
abstract_en: Systems and methods are described for adjusting decision reliability scores (e.g.,weights) in weighted consensus algorithms for blockchains include accessing broadcast events in a blockchain, where the broadcast events correspond to a historic period of time. A broadcast decision provided by a participant in the blockchain for each of the broadcast events may be identified. A consensus decision for each of the broadcast events may be identified where the consensus decision indicates whether there is a consensus among participants in the blockchain that a corresponding broadcast event should be added as a new node to the blockchain. A success rate may be calculated for the participant based the identified broadcast decision provided by the participant for each of the broadcast events and the identified consensus decision for each of the broadcast events. Based on the success rate, the decision reliability score for the participant may be increased, decreased, or maintained.

title_en: Frequency converting cable network signal transmission devices
abstract_en: A network communication device includes an input port configured to receive a downstream signal from a network, a first output port in communication with the input port and configured to receive a first reduced-power version of the signal received at the input port, one or more second output ports, and a converting circuit configured to receive a second reduced-power version of the signal received at the input port, down-convert a high-frequency portion thereof, and produce a down-converted signal. The one or more second output ports receive at least a portion of the down-converted signal.

title_en: Request and response methods for detecting MLD, station, and access point
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present application provide a request and response technology of detection between a station and multiple AP MLDs. If the station wants to obtain a communication parameter of a non-transmitted BSSID AP, a detection request frame can be sent to an AP of a non-transmitted BSSID in an MBSSID set, and a transmitted BSSID AP in the MBSSID set may, as a substitute, reply to a detection response frame, or, if the station wants to detect multiple AP MLDs in one step, the station may send the detection request frame to one transmitted BSSID AP in the MBSSID set, so as to request the AP to reply to the communication parameter of the non-transmitted BSSID AP, wherein the non-transmitted BSSID AP and the transmitted BSSID AP may belong to different AP MLDs. By implementing the present application, the station may obtain communication parameters of multiple APs in one or more AP MLDs by sending one detection request frame, and may obtain communication parameters of the AP MLDs on multiple links, thereby efficiently implementing association of the station and the AP MLDs or establishing multi-link transmission between the station and the AP MLDs.

title_en: Protection device and dongle and method for using the same
abstract_en:
A system for physically protecting an object comprising: 
a protection device having a controllable actuator for engaging and releasing physical 
protection of an object and 
a dongle associated with the protection device, 
wherein the protection device comprises an internal memory and a first data connection 
interface, wherein the internal memory of the protection device stores at least a first private 
key, 
wherein the dongle comprises an internal memory, a second data connection interface 
compatible with the first data connection interface of the protection device and a third data 
connection interface, wherein the internal memory of the dongle stores at least a second private 
key, a third public key, and a signed combined identifier, 
wherein the signed combined identifier incorporates at least a first public key, which is 
cryptographically associated with the first private key, and a second public key, which is 
cryptographically associated with the second private key, and 
wherein the signed combined identifier comprises a signature from a third private key, 
which third private key is cryptographically associated with the third public key.

title_en: A method and electronic device for messaging
abstract_en: A method, electronic device and computer program product for messaging is disclosed, comprising: at a computer system, wherein the computer system is capable of communicating with a display: receiving a request to display a group of message participants, the message participants being at least two participants; in response to receiving the request to display a group of message participants, displaying a participant representation for each participant or subgroups of participants in a participant interface area; enabling each participant representation to have one of a plurality of selectable states including one or more active states and one or more inactive states; displaying, in a message interface area, messages associated with each participant or groups of participants that are in a selected active state.

title_en: Systems and methods for managing user subscriptions to content sources
abstract_en:
The present invention relates to a method for managing user 
subscriptions to content sources. The method comprises storing a 
plurality of content source bundles. A first content source 
bundle includes a first subset of a plurality of content sources 
and a second content source bundle includes a second subset of 
the plurality of content sources. The method comprises 
determining, based on a user profile, that a user has a 
subscription to the first content source bundle. The 
subscription enables the user to access the first subset of 
content sources in the first content source bundle. The method 
comprises monitoring viewing habits of the user relative to the 
first subset of content sources in the first content source 
bundle. Based on the monitoring, the method comprises 
determining, for each respective content source of the content 
sources within the first subset of the plurality of content 
sources, whether the respective content source is frequently 
viewed by the user. The method comprises comparing a number of 
the content sources within the first subset determined to be 
frequently viewed by the user to a total number of content 
sources within the first subset. Based on the comparison, the 
method comprises determining an aggregate percentage of the 
content sources within the first subset of the plurality of 
content sources that are frequently viewed by the user. The 
method comprises determining whether the aggregate percentage is 
less than a threshold. In response to determining that the 
aggregate percentage is less than the threshold, the method 
comprises enabling the user to modify the first content source 
bundle to add a first content source from the second subset of 
the content sources in the second content source bundle based on 
the viewing habits of the user.

abstract_en:

ABSTRACT 
A system and a method are disclosed for enabling accurate estimation of a location of a water 
vessel. In an embodiment, a rescue system transmits a Short Message Service (SMS) message 
to a user device on the water vessel, the SMS message comprising a selectable option that, 
when selected, causes a location of the user device to be shared. Based on a selection by a 
user of the user device of the selectable option, the system receives a plurality of location 
coordinates from the user device at a plurality of respective times, each respective location 
coordinate describing a respective location of the user device at its respective time. The 
system computes an estimated location of the water vessel based on the plurality of location 
coordinates and an elapsed time between a current time and a time at which a last-received 
location coordinate was received. The system transmits the estimated location to a responder 
device.

title_en: System and method for latency critical quality of service using continuous bandwidth control
abstract_en:
A system and method are provided for a bandwidth manager for packetized 
data designed to arbitrate access between multiple, high bandwidth, ingress channels 
(sources) to one, lower bandwidth, egress channel (sink). The system calculates 
which source to grant access to the sink on a word-to-word basis and intentionally 
corrupts/cuts packets if a source ever loses priority while sending. Each source is 
associated with a ranking that is recalculated every data word. When a source buffer 
sends enough words to have its absolute rank value increase above that of another 
source buffer waiting to send, the system "cuts" the current packet by forcing the 
sending buffer to stop mid-packet and selects a new, lower ranked, source buffer to 
send. When there are multiple requesting source buffers with the same rank, the 
system employs a weighted priority randomized scheduler for buffer selection.

title_en: Apparatus and method for acquisition of periodically broadcasted system information in wireless communications
abstract_en: Described herein is a user equipment that communicates over a radio interface with a base station apparatus of a radio access network (RAN), the user equipment comprising: receiver circuitry configured to receive a first type system information block (SIB) from the base station apparatus, the first type SIB comprising: scheduling information associated with a system information (SI) message, the SI message comprising at least one second type SIB, wherein the scheduling information comprises a periodicity of the SI message; and a parameter indicating an SI window length; and processor circuitry configured to: determine whether a stored version of the at least one second type SIB is not valid; in response to determining that the stored version of the at least one second type SIB is not valid: initiate, based on the periodicity and the SI window length, an SI message acquisition process to monitor the SI message in a plurality of SI-window occasions; determine that the SI message acquisition process has failed when the SI message is not successfully received within a maximum number of SI-window occasions; and initiate a re-acquisition process to re-acquire the first type SIB from the base station apparatus upon the determination of the failure of the SI message acquisition process.

title_en: Data transmission method and communication apparatus
abstract_en: Embodiments of this application provide a data transmission method and a communication apparatus. Embodiments of this application are applied to a wireless local area network system that supports various IEEE 802.11 protocols, such as 802.11be (EHT) or 802.11bf series protocols. 5 The method includes: An access point sends first indication information to a first station, where the first indication information indicates that the first station is accepted to obtain sensing information of a second station. The access point sends the sensing information to the first station, where the access point is a proxy of the first station, the proxy is configured to obtain the sensing information for the first station, the first station is a sensing by proxy requesting station, and the 10 second station is a sensing by proxy responding station. According to the technical solutions, in embodiments of this application, when the access point becomes the proxy of the sensing by proxy requesting station, security of the sensing information of the sensing by proxy responding station can be ensured.

title_en: Efficient data compression and analysis as a service
abstract_en: Data may be efficiently analyzed and compressed as part of a data compression service. A data compression request may be received from a client indicating data to be compressed. An analysis of the data or metadata associated with the data may be performed. In at least some embodiments, this analysis may be a rules-based analysis. Some embodiments may employ one or more machine learning techniques to historical compression data to update the rules-based analysis. One or more compression techniques may be selected out of a plurality of compression techniques to be applied to the data. Data compression candidates may then be generated according to the selected compression techniques. In some embodiments, a compression service restriction may be enforced. One of the data compression candidates may be selected and sent in a response.

title_en: Phase compensation device, phase compensation method and communication apparatus
abstract_en: A symbol phase difference compensation unit (6) calculates a first phase difference that is a phase difference between a known pattern extracted from a received signal and a true value thereof, and makes phase compensation for the received signal on the basis of the first phase difference. A provisional determination unit (12) provisionally determines an output signal of the symbol phase difference compensation unit (6) to find an estimated value of a phase. A phase difference acquisition unit (13) acquires a second phase difference that is a phase difference between the phase of the output signal and the estimated value of the phase found by the provisional determination unit (12). A phase difference compensation unit (14) makes phase compensation for the output signal on the basis of the second phase difference.

title_en: Machine learning platform for dynamic device and sensor quality evaluation
abstract_en: Aspects of the disclosure relate to computing platforms that utilize improved machine learning techniques for dynamic device quality evaluation. A computing platform may receive driving data from a mobile device. Using the driving data, the computing platform may compute a plurality of driving metrics, which may include: a geopoint expectation rate score, a trips per day rank score, a consecutive geopoint time difference score, a global positioning system (GPS) accuracy rating score, and a distance between consecutive trips score. By applying a machine learning model to the plurality of driving metrics, the computing platform may compute a device evaluation score, indicating a quality of the driving data received from the mobile device. Based on the device evaluation score, the computing platform may set flags, which may be accessible by a driver score generation platform, causing the driver score generation platform to perform an action with regard to the mobile device.

title_en: Verifiable access credential
abstract_en: The invention allows using a commodity hardware (e.g. a smartphone, a tablet, a computer.. . ) to automatically establish a high level of assurance authentication and identification of any government- issued identity document of a user (e.g. identity card, driving license, passport.. . ) and link that to digital identity counterpart. Moreover, the invention allows personalizing a material-based security feature provided of said government-issued identity document to create a link between the identity document and its data content that can be read by such a commodity hardware and serves as reliable credential for accessing a service once the material-based security feature has been authenticated via the commodity' hardware and a signature of the identity data of the user has been authenticated by a server of an authority.

title_en: Electronic material sleeve for medical devices
abstract_en: An electronic material sleeve has a length and wall thickness and is adapted to fit over a hand-held emergency medication dispensing device via material elasticity, the sleeve including at least a microprocessor and associated circuitry encapsulated within a wall of the electronic sleeve, the microprocessor adapted to support at least one computer aided task and at least one wireless communications technology, the sleeve having at least one encapsulated batter, a partly encapsulated charge port for charging the at least one battery, at least one LED partially encapsulated within a wall of the electronic sleeve, at least one audio speaker partially encapsulated within a wall of the electronic sleeve, and at least one eccentric rotating motor (ERM) adapted to vibrate encapsulated within a wall of the electronic sleeve, the sleeve capable of performing one or more tasks in response to a command signal.

title_en: Neuron system and neuron device based on Internet of things and communication network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a neuron system and a neuron device based on the Internet of things and a communication network, which integrate resources of the Internet of things and the communication network, improve the utilization degree of data acquired by a sensor, reduce the manufacturing cost of a mobile terminal and improve the utilization efficiency of the resources. The technical proposal is as follows: the system comprises a sensing actuator, an Internet of things, a communication network, a cloud server and a neuron device, wherein the sensing actuator collects information of an induction object; the neuron device is used for directly carrying out data communication with the sensing executor and is used as a dynamic mobile node in a communication network, and information interaction is carried out through the communication network and a cloud server; and the cloud server is used for carrying out information transmission with each neuron device in the communication network, and uniformly storing and processing the information uploaded by the neuron devices.

title_en: Standard POE and force non-standard POE integration to receive power supply circuit
abstract_en: The utility model provides a standard POE receives electric power source circuit with force non-standard POE integration, sets up between POE network socket and powered device, includes: the standard power supply module has line impedance meeting a standard protocol, is conducted when the input voltage is greater than a set value, and transmits the voltage input by the POE network socket to the DC-DC voltage reduction and stabilization module; the non-standard jumper module can switch a non-standard power supply line, and a power supply is directly transmitted to a network socket through a network cable without detection and then directly transmitted to the DC-DC voltage reduction and stabilization module; the DC-DC voltage reduction and stabilization module is used for reducing and stabilizing the input direct-current voltage and supplying power to the power receiving equipment; the input end of the standard power supply module is connected with the POE network socket, the output end of the standard power supply module is connected with the input end of the DC-DC voltage reduction and stabilization module, the output end of the DC-DC voltage reduction and stabilization module is connected with the powered device, and the non-standard jumper modules are connected at two ends of the standard power supply module in parallel. The invention integrates the standard POE and non-standard POE power supply modes into a whole, avoids the repeated production of equipment with different power supply types, and is compatible with the power taking environment of a user to the maximum extent.

title_en: Login authentication method, authentication server, authentication client and login client
abstract_en: The invention provides a login authentication method, an authentication server, an authentication client and a login client. The login authentication method is applied to an authentication server and comprises the following steps: acquiring an authentication request message generated by a login client in a terminal according to user identity identification information of a login user; triggering an authentication client to acquire the biological characteristic information of the user according to the authentication request message; receiving the biological characteristic information collected by the authentication client; and comparing the biological characteristic information with the pre-stored user biological characteristic registration information corresponding to the user identity identification information to generate an authentication result. According to the scheme, the authentication server is used for triggering the collection of the biological characteristic information, and when the terminal where the login client is located does not have the biological characteristic collection capacity, the user can also use the biological characteristic information for login operation, so that the flexibility of the user operation is improved.

title_en: Information interaction method, information interaction device and terminal based on neighborhood network
abstract_en: The invention provides a neighborhood network-based information interaction method, a neighborhood network-based information interaction device and a terminal, wherein the neighborhood network-based information interaction method comprises the following steps: sending a first network communication service request according to a neighborhood network communication protocol; receiving feedback information of a first network communication service request sent by any second terminal in a first neighborhood network cluster to which a first terminal belongs according to the first network communication service request; and/or receiving feedback information sent by any third terminal in a second neighborhood network cluster to which the second terminal belongs. According to the technical scheme, on one hand, real-time network communication can be achieved without access equipment such as a router and the like, dependence on third-party equipment and network access cost are reduced, on the other hand, information interaction is carried out within a specified range, the purpose of network data transmission is stronger, and therefore the use experience of a user is improved.

title_en: Decoy state quantum key distribution system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a system and a method for distributing a decoy state quantum key. The system comprises the following components: a transmitting device and a receiving device; the sending device selects any one group of measuring bases from the three groups of measuring bases as signal measuring bases, and the other two groups of measuring bases are decoy measuring bases; selecting a group of measuring bases from the three groups of measuring bases; when the decoy measuring base is selected, randomly sending a first eigenstate or a decoy state of the decoy measuring base; when the signal measuring base is selected, randomly sending any eigenstate or decoy state of the signal measuring base; sending the information of the measurement base and the information of the decoy state to a receiving device; performing parameter estimation according to the measurement base information and the information of the decoy state to obtain an error rate; and correcting errors and amplifying privacy to obtain a secret key. The invention can greatly reduce the number of used quantum states and save system resources required for preparing, sending or receiving the quantum states while improving the code rate of the quantum key distribution system.

title_en: Multimedia information interaction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for multimedia information interaction, wherein the method comprises the following steps: registering a network terminal; the network terminal acquires information, push information and a user-defined grouping rule; the network terminals carry out grouping; the network terminal receives information sharing and information interaction; and the network terminal displays the information and dynamically updates the information. The system comprises a server group and an information alliance management platform, wherein the server group comprises: the system comprises a data server, a strategy server, an application server and an information management server. The information sharing and information interaction between the network terminals and among the network terminals are realized, all information is updated in real time according to the user characteristics, and the information utilization rate is improved.

title_en: Flexible buffer allocation in network switches
abstract_en: The invention discloses flexible buffer allocation in a network switch. The communication device includes a plurality of interfaces configured to connect to a packet data network for receiving and forwarding multiple types of data packets. A memory is coupled to the interface and configured as a buffer to accommodate packets received over the ingress interface while waiting to be transmitted to the network via the egress interface. The packet processing logic is configured to maintain a plurality of transmission queues associated with respective ones of the egress interfaces and to place both first and second queue entries corresponding to first and second data packets of the first and second types, respectively, in a common transmission queue for transmission over a given egress interface while allocating respective space in the buffer to store the first and second data packets against separate first and second buffer allocations assigned to the data packets of the first and second types, respectively.

title_en: Lock control adaptation system based on internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of asset management, in particular to a lock control adaptation system based on the technology of the Internet of things, which comprises an equipment supervision platform of the Internet of things, a first asset management object and a mobile terminal, wherein the first asset management object comprises a first asset, a first controller module, a first mechanical lock, a first magnetic lock and a first magnetic key, the first controller module comprises a controller, a communication module, a first button module, a first induction module and a dormancy awakening device, the first mechanical lock comprises a main lock body, a first mechanical connecting rod, a first transmission device and a first door magnet, the first transmission device is in wireless connection with the first door magnet, the first magnetic lock is in wireless connection with the controller, the controller is externally connected with an alarm device, the alarm device is in wireless connection with the mobile terminal, and the controller is in Bluetooth connection with the mobile terminal, the controller is connected with the battery module.

title_en: Intelligent set top box and control system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent set-top box and a control system and a control method thereof, wherein the set-top box comprises: the interest target data acquisition unit is used for acquiring interest target data of a user; the individual data acquisition unit is used for acquiring individual data of a user; the collecting and analyzing unit is used for searching and analyzing the electronic program guide information of the front-end television program source according to the individual data of the user and classifying according to the interest target data; the invention can provide scientific and reasonable program strategies according to target data and individual data of the user, and dynamically change the program strategies by continuously tracking and monitoring the operation of the user to adapt to the requirements of different users.

title_en: Forwarding table entry access method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a forwarding table entry access method and a forwarding table entry access device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving a table entry reading command sent by a forwarding module, wherein the table entry reading command carries a storage address of a first forwarding table entry to be read; searching a first Hash barrel which is in an effective state and contains the same storage address as the first forwarding table entry according to the storage address of the first forwarding table entry; if the first Hash barrel is found, sending a first forwarding table item cached in a cache space corresponding to the first Hash barrel to a forwarding module; and if the first Hash barrel is not found, reading a first forwarding table item from the storage module, and sending the read first forwarding table item to the forwarding module.

title_en: Controller apparatus, method and computer readable medium
abstract_en: A controller device is disclosed comprising a transceiver capable of communicating via a wireless communication network, a controller arranged to control a physical entity in which the controller device is located, and an interface between the transceiver and the controller. The transceiver is arranged to provide information via the interface relating to a current or impending disruption in communication via the wireless network. The controller is arranged to operate in at least a first state and a second state, the first state being when the information indicates that no interruption is present or imminent, wherein the first state comprises closed-loop control from a remote entity via the wireless communication network, and the second state being when the information indicates that an interruption is present or imminent, wherein the second state comprises autonomous control operation of the controller. Methods and computer programs are also disclosed.

title_en: Emoticon recommendation method based on time sequence analysis of user session emotion trend
abstract_en: An emoticon recommendation method based on time sequence analysis of user conversation emotion trend analyzes emotion values of conversation by discovering user chat records so as to construct a mapping relation of emoticons in an emotion matrix; analyzing the conversation history record by using an emotion dictionary to calculate emotion keywords; calculating a 21-dimensional emotion vector of the conversation through the emotion keywords and the calculation rule; and performing single-step prediction on the development of the current conversation emotion vector of the user through a time sequence (ARMA/ARIMA) model, and selecting an expression group closest to the emotion trend of the user from the mapping relation through a nearest neighbor algorithm (KNN) according to a prediction result and generating a recommendation list. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, when the user uses the chat tool, the emoticons conforming to the emotion and conversation context of the current user can be timely and accurately recommended to the user, so that the complex operation of selecting the emoticons by the user is greatly facilitated, the recommendation coverage rate is improved, and the user experience is also enhanced.

title_en: System, method and apparatus for implementing DSL line fault determination and location
abstract_en: According to embodiments disclosed herein, there are provided apparatus, systems, and methods for DSL line fault determination and localization via SELT diagnostics, DELT diagnostics, and MELT diagnostics. For example, such a system or computer-implemented method may include modules for: receiving a metallic loop/line test (MELT) test output by applying a MELT test to the DSL line; receiving a Double Ended Line Test (DELT) test output by applying a DELT test to the DSL line; receiving a single-ended loop test (SELT) test output resulting from applying a SELT test to the DSL line; determining that one or more faults exist on the DSL line by comparing the MELT test output, the DELT test output, and the SELT test output; and locating one or more determined faults by comparing the MELT test output, the DELT test output, and the SELT test output. Other related embodiments are disclosed.

title_en: Telephony collaboration system and method for trusted environments
abstract_en: A telephony collaboration system and method are provided. The method comprises the following steps: activating a wireless function on the management device; determining whether a new group is to be created; determining whether to subscribe the guest device to an existing group; determining whether to join the guest device to a previously subscribed group; when the management device is to create a new group, creating the new group and assigning a name to the new group; when a guest device is to subscribe to an existing group, scanning the existing group and sending a subscription request requesting that the guest device be subscribed to the existing group; and when the management apparatus is to join the previously subscribed group, scanning the previously subscribed group and transmitting a join request requesting registration of the management apparatus to the previously subscribed group.

title_en: Method and apparatus for managing IT infrastructure based on application characteristics
abstract_en: The exemplary embodiments described herein relate to systems and methods for using and updating performance thresholds based on application characteristics. The exemplary embodiment compares the monitored performance indicators to threshold values having similar application characteristics as monitored. The exemplary embodiments also manage remediation plans to address performance issues based on application characteristics. In an exemplary embodiment, in response to an alarm being raised, the management software retrieves an existing plan created for a similar situation.

title_en: Cooperative protection method and device for data network and optical transmission network
abstract_en: A data network and optical transmission network cooperate the protective method and apparatus; the method comprises the steps of presetting the priority of the service, acquiring the topological information of the equipment, determining the risk quantitative value of a single link, selecting a transmission path of the service for service transmission, determining a bandwidth reservation quantitative value and reserving the bandwidth according to the bandwidth reservation quantitative value; the device comprises a setting unit, an obtaining unit, a determining unit, a selecting unit and a reserving unit. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, the reliability of data network protection is improved in a mode of cooperatively protecting the data network and the optical transmission network, the simultaneous failure of the main link and the standby link of the path due to the failure of the underlying link is avoided, the bandwidth reservation is protected according to the service requirement, and the resource utilization rate of the optical transmission network is effectively improved.

title_en: Message sending method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a message sending method and equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining group sending information and at least one receiver corresponding to the group sending information, responding to a command of adding an title to the group sending information by a user, obtaining the title of each receiver, obtaining target group sending information corresponding to each receiver according to the title of each receiver and the group sending information, wherein the target group sending information comprises the group sending information and the title of the receiver, and sending the corresponding target group sending information to each receiver. The message sending method and the message sending device provided by the invention can enable the user to send the targeted message to a plurality of recipients simply, conveniently and quickly.

title_en: Mobile terminal restart positioning method, mobile terminal and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile terminal restart positioning method, a mobile terminal and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when the situation that a preset refreshing period of a position corresponding to a preset key information point in a Kernel layer Kernel scheduling module of the mobile terminal is in an abnormal state is monitored, reading an abnormal identifier corresponding to the preset refreshing period; matching the abnormal identifier with a pre-stored log identifier; if the abnormal identifier is successfully matched with the log identifier, searching log information associated with the log identifier according to the log identifier, and acquiring process information of a process corresponding to a preset refreshing period; and generating a restart log according to the process information and the log information so as to locate the restart reason of the mobile terminal according to the restart log. The invention improves the efficiency of positioning the restart reason of the mobile terminal and reduces the labor cost.
