title_en: Large-scale complicated pencil auxiliary wiring projection system of shielding more
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-scale complex wire harness auxiliary wiring multi-screen projection system, which comprises a server system, a client system, a projection display system, a shared storage device and a bar code scanning device, wherein the server system is connected with the client system through a network; the server-side system undertakes data processing and system control of the whole system, loads a configuration file, reads a specified wiring harness template drawing and sends the wiring harness template drawing to the client-side system for processing, and then performs projection display through the projection display system; the server system is in network communication connection with the client system, receives and executes the control instruction sent by the server system, calibrates the wiring harness template diagram, and is also responsible for fusion splicing and calibration of the projection display image of the projection display system; the projection display system consists of a plurality of industrial projectors, is arranged above the workbench and is used for projecting and displaying the wiring information of the wiring harness; the bar code scanning device is used for acquiring the wire number of the wire harness.

title_en: System and method for hybrid automatic repeat request time for device-to-device communication overlaid on cellular network
abstract_en: An embodiment of a system for operating a communication controller in a wireless communication system for a group of user devices participating in a DMC link is provided. The communication controller is configured to allocate a set of subframes in a periodic set of subframes to the group of UEs for the DMC link, signal the allocated set of subframes to the group of UEs, and transmit parameters related to a group of HARQ processes of the DMC link. In an embodiment, the communication controller independently determines HARQ processes of the group of HARQ processes of the HARQ process and the DMC link using HARQ processes of cellular UE transmissions, and the parameter is for enabling the group of UEs to manage the group of HARQ processes of the DMC link.

title_en: Downlink data transmission method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a downlink data transmission method and device, and relates to the field of wireless communication. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a downlink control signaling of a base station, and acquiring a reference modulation mode aiming at a user; detecting an actual modulation mode of a base station for a transmission signal of a user; judging whether the user is scheduled to be an NOMA transmission mode or an OMA transmission mode according to the reference modulation mode and the actual modulation mode; and processing the signal received by the user according to the judgment result. The method and the device provided by the invention realize the dynamic self-adaptive switching of NOMA and OMA, do not need to add new downlink control signaling, and reduce the control signaling overhead.

title_en: Self-adaptive back-off method under large number of multi-hop wireless nodes
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-adaptive back-off method under a large number of multi-hop wireless nodes, which is a method for realizing the quick communication between the multi-hop nodes and a host under the condition that a large number of wireless sensing nodes exist, and relates to the technical field of wireless communication. Aiming at the defects of the existing backoff algorithm, the invention adopts a node grouping mode, firstly sets different sending probabilities for the groups with different priorities, and then sets different backoff windows, so that the sending probabilities and the backoff windows can be adaptively adjusted, the cardinality of the sending nodes is effectively reduced, and the transmission efficiency of the nodes with high priorities is ensured. Meanwhile, when the number of the nodes occupying corresponding priority in the node group is larger than the number of the nodes occupying corresponding priority, and the retransmission times are more, the probability is higher to obtain smaller back-off time and obtain relatively shorter sleep time, and the overall transmission efficiency of the network is improved.

title_en: Reader
abstract_en: The invention relates to a reader, which is connected with an intelligent capsule, and a spiral antenna is arranged in the intelligent capsule. The reader includes: the communication antenna module comprises a flat antenna and a duplexer; the signal acquisition and processing module is used for signal digital processing and generating a target digital signal; a radio frequency transceiver module comprising: the frequency synthesis unit is connected with the communication antenna module on one side, the orthogonal demodulation unit on the other side is connected with the signal acquisition and processing module; one side of the direct digital synthesis unit is connected with the signal acquisition and processing module, and the other side of the direct digital synthesis unit is connected with the communication antenna module; the logarithmic limiting amplifying unit is connected between the communication antenna module and the quadrature demodulating unit. The invention optimizes the performance of the receiving loop of the reader, rapidly receives or transmits the frequency signal, and simultaneously increases the distance between the receiving and transmitting signals of the reader by increasing the gain of the antenna of the reader and the built-in duplexer, thereby realizing the receiving and transmitting switching of the signals of the reader.

title_en: Method and base station for avoiding inter-cell interference
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method and a base station for avoiding inter-cell interference, wherein the method includes: determining a target time period in which inter-cell interference may occur; adjusting the time-frequency resource range allocated to the target user equipment by each base station in the target time period based on the target bandwidth segment BWP, and determining a reconfiguration time-frequency resource range, wherein each base station comprises: the first base station and a second base station adjacent to the first base station are involved in the inter-cell interference; determining target scheduling configuration information for avoiding the inter-cell interference according to the reconfiguration time-frequency resource range; scheduling a first target user equipment on the target BWP according to the target scheduling configuration information. By adopting the method for avoiding the inter-cell interference, the inter-cell interference can be effectively reduced or eliminated, and the user experience of the 5G network equipment is improved.

title_en: Method for operating a data transmission system and data transmission system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for operating a data transmission system (2, 36, 50, 68, 72), wherein a first data transmission device (4, 6, 52) is connected to a first data line (14, 16, 64) which is connected to a first data interface (10, 12, 62), and a second data transmission device (4, 6, 52) is connected to a second data line (14, 16, 64) which is connected to a second data interface (10, 12, 62) and transmits data via the first data interface (10, 12, 62). In order to achieve reliable operation of a data transmission system (2, 36, 50, 68, 72), it is proposed that: -inhibiting the transmission of data via the second data interface (10, 12, 62).

title_en: Advanced persistent threat detection
abstract_en: For detecting persistent attacks in an information system infrastructure, the information system infrastructure comprising resources associated with sensors capable of sending notifications to a management device, the notifications comprising reports on accessing the associated resources, the method comprising the following steps (MD) in the management device: evaluating (S1) a threat level for an ongoing attack detected for a given set of resources from received notifications having a low weight in the evaluation of the threat level, activating (S2) a sensor associated with a resource of the information system infrastructure that is a potential subsequent target of the ongoing attack if the threat level is less than a catch threshold, setting a weight of the notifications sent from the activated sensor to an average weight in the evaluation of the threat level, and further evaluating the threat level of the ongoing attack from received notifications sent from the activated sensor, deploying (S3) a trap in the information system infrastructure that is a potential subsequent target of the ongoing attack and that is capable of sending a notification to a management device if the threat level is greater than the catch threshold; setting a weight of the notification sent from the deployed trap to a high weight in the evaluation of the threat level, and further evaluating the threat level of the ongoing attack in accordance with the received notification sent from the deployed trap.

title_en: Radio network node, wireless device and methods therein
abstract_en: A Radio Network Node (RNN) (106) and methods therein provide improved robustness of a radio link between the RNN and a wireless device (108). The RNN and the wireless device operate in a communication network (100). The RNN sends a transmission to the wireless device using a first transmission mode associated with a first level of coverage extension. When the first time period has elapsed, the RNN sends a transmission to the wireless device using a second transmission mode associated with a second level of coverage extension. The coverage extension of the second level is higher than the coverage extension of the first level.

title_en: In-flight cellular communication system coverage for mobile communication devices located in an aircraft
abstract_en: A network node of a terrestrial cellular system provides telecommunication services to User Equipment (UE) in an airborne aircraft. Navigation information transmitted from the aircraft is periodically acquired, including the aircraft identity, location, altitude, and time at which the aircraft location was determined. By transmitting a beam-deflected, doppler shift compensated downlink signal, and by performing beam-deflected reception of an uplink signal, a link is maintained between the network node and the UE. Based on the navigation information, the beam deflection is directed towards the aircraft. The doppler shift compensation is adapted to compensate the doppler shift such that the UE experiences the nominal carrier frequency when receiving the transmission from the antenna node. The handover from the first to the second coverage area comprises using the same cell identifier and the same frequency allocation in the second coverage area as used in the first coverage area.

title_en: Method and device for pushing information
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method and a device for pushing information. One embodiment of the method comprises: acquiring a human body image; extracting human body contour key points of the human body in the human body image; determining the obesity index of a target part of the human body in the human body image based on the extracted key points of the human body contour, wherein the obesity index is used for representing the obesity degree of the target part; and pushing motion information based on the determined obesity index of the target part. The embodiment pushes the motion information based on the human body image, so that the pushed motion information is rich in pertinence.

title_en: Method for realizing information transmission safety based on digital envelope technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing information transmission safety based on a digital envelope technology, which comprises the following steps: the user A information plaintext outputs an information ciphertext, a symmetric algorithm key ciphertext, a hash value ciphertext of the information plaintext and a user A public key through data encryption, processes the information ciphertext through a digital envelope technology and then transmits the information ciphertext, the symmetric algorithm key ciphertext and the hash value ciphertext to the user B through a network; the user B receives the input of the digital envelope technology package, namely, an information ciphertext, a symmetric algorithm key ciphertext, a hash value ciphertext of an information plaintext and a user A public key, and carries out decryption processing to output the information plaintext and a value Wen Haxi of the information plaintext sent by the user A; and carrying out hash calculation on the received information plaintext to obtain a hash value, and comparing the two hash values to determine whether the information transmission is successful. The invention adopts digital envelope technology to solve the key exchange, synchronization and management problems, adopts symmetric algorithm encryption to a large amount of information in real-time transaction, and only uses asymmetric algorithm encryption and decryption to a small amount of symmetric encryption algorithm keys for exchanging keys and checking the authenticity of the information, thus improving the information transmission speed and reducing the resource consumption.

title_en: Authentication method, user equipment, authentication device, authentication server and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to an authentication method, user equipment, an authentication device, an authentication server and a storage medium. The authentication method comprises the following steps: the authentication device receives a service establishment request from user equipment, wherein the service establishment request carries an identity of the user equipment; the authentication device determines an equipment group where the user equipment is located and a group authentication state of the equipment group based on the identity of the user equipment, wherein the equipment group comprises a plurality of user equipments in the same security domain as the user equipment, and the group authentication state is authenticated when any user equipment in the equipment group passes the user authentication; and the authentication device determines the user authentication state of the user equipment as passing authentication under the condition that the group authentication state is passing authentication.

title_en: Wireless networking device and wireless networking method of existing equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless networking device and a wireless networking method of the existing equipment, which belong to the technical field of wireless networking of the existing equipment, the technical problem to be solved by the invention is how to realize the transformation of the existing equipment in a coal mine well by utilizing a wireless communication technology, and simultaneously, the transformation cost is ensured to be low and the transformation workload is small, and the adopted technical scheme is as follows: the structure of the system comprises a main controller, a wired access unit, a wireless networking unit and an EEPROM storage module, wherein the main controller is respectively connected with the wired access unit, the wireless networking unit and the EEPROM storage module; the wireless networking unit comprises a networking unit and a routing inspection unit, the networking unit comprises a LoRa wireless module and a WiFi wireless module, and the main controller is connected with the LoRa wireless module and the WiFi wireless module through serial ports respectively to realize real-time wireless monitoring of the safety monitoring system server; the inspection unit comprises a Bluetooth wireless module and a 2.4G RFID module. The invention also discloses a wireless networking method of the prior equipment based on the wireless networking device.

title_en: Method, device and system for adjusting working state of local area network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device and a system for adjusting the working state of a local area network; the method is applied to edge computing equipment which is respectively in communication connection with a cloud server and a local area network, and comprises the following steps: receiving real-time data sent by a local area network; judging whether the working state of the local area network is normal or not according to the real-time data and the dynamic baseline model sent by the cloud server; if not, determining a decision instruction according to a pre-stored decision logic model, and sending the instruction to the local area network so as to adjust the working state of the local area network; the decision logic model is established according to the working parameters and the control parameters of the local area network. The invention improves the real-time and accuracy of decision and improves the efficiency of adjusting the working state of the local area network.

title_en: System and method for detecting wifi module of refrigerator
abstract_en: The invention provides a system and a method for detecting a wifi module of a refrigerator, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the induction device is used for inducing whether the refrigerator to be detected exists in real time, and if so, sending an identification signal to the identification device; the identification device is used for identifying the refrigerator to be detected when the identification signal is received, identifying the wifi signal network name of the refrigerator to be detected and sending the wifi signal network name to the control device; the control device is used for allocating an idle wifi production testing module for the refrigerator to be detected when the wifi signal network name of the refrigerator to be detected sent by the identification device is received, and sending the wifi signal network name to the wifi production testing module allocated to the refrigerator to be detected; and the wifi production and detection module is used for detecting the wifi module of the refrigerator to be detected based on the network corresponding to the wifi signal network name when the wifi signal network name sent by the control device is received. The invention can improve the detection efficiency.

title_en: Face feature encryption system and method based on face recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a face feature encryption system and method based on face recognition. The invention discloses a face characteristic encryption system based on face recognition, which comprises the following steps: the acquisition module is used for acquiring a face feature vector obtained based on face recognition; and the encryption module is used for setting a 6-bit digital password to encrypt the face feature vector. The invention also discloses a face feature encryption method based on face recognition, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring a face feature vector obtained based on face recognition; s2, setting a 6-bit digital password to encrypt the face feature vector. The scheme for encrypting the face feature vector enables the user to set the 6-bit password, and solves the problem of leakage of face feature information.

title_en: Video processing method and related product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a video processing method and a related product, wherein the method comprises the following steps: if a memory video sharing request aiming at the third-party application is received, jumping to a memory video management page; if an editing instruction for a first recall video displayed in the recall video management page is received, editing the first recall video according to the editing instruction to obtain a second recall video; and uploading the second recall video. By the adoption of the method and the device, the editable recall video can be shared in the third-party application, and user experience is improved.

title_en: Privacy protection multi-party diagnosis model fusion method and system and cloud server
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of information security, and discloses a privacy-protecting multi-party diagnosis model fusion method and system and a cloud server; the medical center system comprises a trusted authority, a cloud server and a medical center terminal. The trusted authority completes system initialization and provides system parameters and key distribution for the medical center terminal and the cloud computing server; the cloud computing server stores encrypted data resources, and fuses the local diagnosis models to generate a global diagnosis model; the medical center terminal generates a local diagnosis model, encrypts and sends the local diagnosis model to the cloud computing server, and simultaneously undertakes a fusion computing task issued by the cloud computing server; the medical center terminal and the cloud computing server perform bidirectional authentication in service. The invention realizes privacy protection of local diagnosis models and case data resources of the medical center, improves system efficiency, and can be used for providing convenient and private online medical service for users in actual life.

title_en: System and method for enabling multicast packets to traverse non-multicast networks
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system and a method for enabling a multicast packet to pass through a non-multicast network, which can achieve the address conversion between the multicast packet and a unicast packet by modifying the IP address and the UDP port number of the multicast packet through an OpenFlow protocol, thereby enabling the multicast packet to pass through the non-multicast network.

title_en: Average consistency-based quiescent point convergence processing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quiescent point convergence processing method based on average consistency, which comprises the following steps: (1): firstly, calculating the movement speed of a positioning target according to historical positioning position data and adjacent time intervals; (2): establishing a motion state estimation model, and performing statistical analysis on the motion speed and the attributes of the positioning target to obtain the current motion state of the positioning target; (3): judging whether a quiescent point convergence algorithm is started or not according to the result obtained in the step (2), and if the motion state of the positioning target obtained in the step (2) is motion, directly outputting the position result of the positioning target; if the motion state of the positioning target obtained in the step (2) is static, continuing the processing in the step (4); (4): and calling a quiescent point convergence algorithm to carry out jitter convergence processing on the static positioning result. The invention can be widely applied to the field of wireless positioning.

title_en: Method, forwarding device, controller and system for transmitting message
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method, forwarding equipment, a controller and a system for transmitting a message, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the forwarding equipment receives protocol messages from other forwarding equipment or user equipment from the port; the forwarding equipment performs virtual extensible local area network (VXLAN) encapsulation on the protocol message to generate a first VXLAN message, wherein the first VXLAN message comprises the protocol message and the port information; and the forwarding equipment sends the first VXLAN message to the controller. By adopting the embodiment of the application, the speed of transmitting and processing the protocol message can be improved, and the overall performance of the system is improved.

title_en: Method, device and storage medium for identifying inactivated Trojan horse program
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method, a device and a storage medium for identifying an inactivated Trojan program, thereby identifying the Trojan program which is inactivated or temporarily inactivated in a network and locating a host infected by the Trojan program. The method comprises the following steps: extracting data of a time interval for trying to connect with a service end and/or data of a SYN request-response ratio for connecting with the service end from a data packet of unknown type flow; determining the probability that the flow of the unknown type comes from the inactivated Trojan horse program and the probability that the flow of the unknown type comes from the normal program according to the training data and the extracted data; determining that the traffic of the unknown type is from the inactivated Trojan horse program when the probability that the traffic of the unknown type is from the inactivated Trojan horse program is greater than the probability that the traffic of the unknown type is from the normal application program.

title_en: Acquisition terminal communication safety evaluation method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for evaluating the communication security of an acquisition terminal, which relate to the technical field of evaluation of the acquisition terminal. The attack method provided by the invention comprises invalid frame attack, valid frame retransmission, boundary big data message data attack, data disguise and data tampering, and the security performance of the communication port of the acquisition terminal is evaluated by the attack methods, so that the security performance of the communication port of the acquisition terminal can be effectively evaluated.

title_en: Registration method of remote automatic registration system of vehicle-mounted monitoring terminal
abstract_en: A remote automatic registration system and method for a vehicle-mounted monitoring terminal comprise the vehicle-mounted monitoring terminal and a monitoring terminal background in wireless communication connection with the vehicle-mounted monitoring terminal, wherein the vehicle-mounted monitoring terminal comprises a processor, a key module, a GPS module, a GSM module, an SIM card module and an indicator lamp module are connected to the processor, the monitoring terminal background comprises a wireless communication module in wireless communication connection with the GSM module and a controller connected with the wireless communication module, and the controller is connected with the monitoring terminal background. The invention can identify whether the vehicle is registered or not through the VIN information reported by the vehicle-mounted terminal. And for unregistered vehicles, automatically supplementing the registration information of the vehicles by inquiring the product information management system of the company to finish registration.

title_en: Polarization code wireless data secure transmission method based on random scrambling code assistance
abstract_en: The invention relates to a polarization code wireless data secure transmission method based on random scrambling code assistance, and belongs to the technical field of channel coding and wireless secret communication. The method comprises the following steps: 1) initializing system parameters; 2) carrying out random scrambling on information to be transmitted; 3) performing CRC (cyclic redundancy check) on the sequence subjected to the random scrambling; 4) performing Polar coding on the sequence subjected to CRC; 5) modulating the sequence coded by Polar; 6) carrying out signal noise integrated design on the modulated signal and sending the signal into a channel; 7) the Bob end and the Eve end receive signals and respectively output soft information after demodulation; 8) carrying out Polar decoding on the Bob end and the Eve end respectively; 9) the Bob end and the Eve end descramble respectively; 10) and the Bob terminal and the Eve terminal respectively carry out error analysis. The method can effectively improve the safety performance of data transmission of the wireless communication system and simultaneously improve the burst interference resistance of wireless data transmission on the premise of slightly increasing the complexity of coding and decoding.

title_en: Information pushing method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides an information pushing method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: after a browsing request sent by a client is detected, extracting a key character combination in the browsing content of the browsing request; selecting the user intention matched with the key character combination from the intention library according to the weight value of the user intention corresponding to the key character combination; the method comprises the steps that a key character combination and a weight value of a user intention corresponding to the key character combination are stored in an intention library in advance; the method comprises the steps of sending push information corresponding to user intention to a client side so that the client side can display the push information in browsing content browsed by a user currently, and compared with the prior art that an information push method is high in hysteresis and poor in timeliness, the push information is not wanted by the user frequently, the service efficiency is low, and the user experience is poor, the method carries out information push to the client side based on the intention of the user which can reflect the user requirements best, the push information meets the requirements of the user, the timeliness is good, the service efficiency is improved, and the user experience is good.

title_en: Help seeking method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a help-seeking method and a help-seeking device, which comprise the following steps: sending positioning request information to a target terminal; receiving positioning response information returned by the target terminal based on the positioning request information; according to the positioning response information, sending distress information to other preset terminals under the condition that the target terminal is determined to be in an abnormal state; wherein, the information of asking for help includes: before the target terminal is determined to be in the abnormal state, the positioning response information is received finally, the method and the system determine whether the target terminal is in the abnormal state by using an automatic interaction scheme based on a positioning function, and automatically send distress information to other target terminals when the target terminal is determined to be in the abnormal state so as to ensure the transmission of the distress information under the distress condition, and realize the purpose that a user asks for help in distress in the environment without signals or with poor signals.

title_en: Flow control method and related device for virtual private cloud
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of cloud computing, and provides a flow control method and a related device for a virtual private cloud. In a method for controlling a flow of a virtual private cloud, a controller of the virtual private cloud sets a total token bucket, and a distributed gateway sets a sub-token bucket, including: when sending a data packet, acquiring the size of the data packet sent by the distributed gateway; sending a flow request to a controller, wherein when the flow request carries a token issuing instruction, the flow request is used for indicating the controller to issue the tokens in the total token bucket to the sub-token buckets according to the average sending rate set by the virtual private cloud; acquiring a first token quantity in a sub-token bucket; when the size of the data packet is smaller than the first token number, the data packet is sent through the tokens in the sub-token bucket; deleting a number of tokens corresponding to the size of the data packet from the sub-token bucket; when the size of the packet is larger than the first token number, the packet is discarded. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention ensures that the flow control of the virtual private cloud is more accurate.

title_en: Data transmission method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a data transmission method and a data transmission device. The method comprises the following steps: when the target length of the domain resource required by the target transport block is greater than the first length of the available domain resource of the target time slot, determining the size of a first sub transport block transmitted on the available domain resource of the target time slot; segmenting the target transport block into a first sub-transport block and a second sub-transport block according to the size of the first sub-transport block; wherein, the second length of the time domain resource required by the second sub-transmission block is equal to the difference value between the target length and the first length; determining a first time domain resource for transmitting the second sub-transport block on a next time slot of the target time slot according to a second length of the time domain resource required by the second sub-transport block; and sending a first resource allocation message to the terminal. The technical scheme can reduce waiting time delay, reduce transmission time delay, ensure high reliability and low time delay of service and improve service quality.

title_en: Method for transmitting video content from server to client device
abstract_en: A method of transmitting video content from a server to a client device. Examples of the present invention provide a method of delivering media, such as video sequences, from a server to a client device that takes into account the relative importance of different parts of the video sequence. The sequence is divided into time slices, where each slice is encoded at multiple bit rates (and hence quality). The viewer importance parameter is assigned to each segment to represent the relative importance of that segment, and this information is stored in a manifest file or the like. The client receives the segments and viewer importance data in a manifest file. Upon learning of a future segment marked as having a higher viewer importance than the next segment for download, the client initiates the download of the other segment by issuing a request (e.g., an HTTP request) while simultaneously issuing a concurrent request for delivery of the next segment.

title_en: Method and device for determining time domain resources for unlicensed transmission
abstract_en: The present application provides a method for determiningA method of assigning time domain resources for unlicensed transmission, comprising: the method comprises the steps that terminal equipment obtains a first time domain period and a second time domain period of an authorization-free transmission resource, wherein the first time domain period is P 1 A time unit, the second time domain period is P 2 A time unit of which P 1 Greater than or equal to P 2 (ii) a The terminal equipment acquires the number k of the authorization-free transmission resources in the first time domain period; and the terminal equipment determines the index of the time unit of the unlicensed transmission resource for unlicensed transmission according to the first time domain period, the second time domain period and the number k of the unlicensed transmission resources in the first time domain period. The configuration of the authorization-free transmission resources for the terminal equipment in two adjacent periods without overlapping can be supported.

title_en: Communication control method, communication control device and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a communication control method, a communication control device, a communication server and a communication terminal, wherein at least one field contained in a current session message input by a user is extracted and sent to a communication database for matching, so that at least one candidate session message related to the current session message, such as a historical session message and/or application operation data of a built-in application, is obtained based on a matching result, and the at least one candidate session message is sent to a communication client for displaying, so that the user directly selects the candidate session message meeting the self-intention, the user does not need to manually input the message content, and the communication efficiency of the user before is greatly improved.

title_en: Radar-assisted tracking of mobile devices to improve communication links in high frequency communications
abstract_en: In high-frequency mobile communication networks, pulsed signal transmissions such as radar pulses are used as a means of determining or assisting in determining that User Equipment (UE) is likely to be present in a predetermined area and/or tracking the UE. Such information may be used to expedite a handover or establish a reconnection within the communication network as a result of determining that a UE is likely to be present and/or tracking the UE. In this regard, more targeted beam sweeps or more frequent sweeps may be performed in directions in which it has been determined that a UE is likely to be present in order to facilitate establishing a communication link between target transmission points, such as a Base Station (BS), or reconnection with an existing transmission point.

title_en: Reference signal transmission method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a reference signal transmission method and device. In the application, a base station sends a first reference signal trigger or activation signaling to a terminal, wherein the first reference signal trigger or activation signaling is used for indicating the terminal to send a first reference signal according to resource configuration information of the first reference signal; the base station receives a first reference signal sent by the terminal according to the first reference signal trigger or activation signaling; the initial sending time unit of the first reference signal is determined according to an initial sending time unit of a second reference signal associated with the first reference signal, and the second reference signal is a downlink reference signal.

title_en: Request processing method, processing device, request verification method and verification device
abstract_en: The invention provides a request processing method, which comprises the following steps: generating an initial Uniform Resource Locator (URL) link for a specified service; obtaining at least a session key and encrypted cookie data; the session key corresponds to the client version, and the encrypted cookie data is encrypted by adopting the key corresponding to the client version; processing at least the session key and the encrypted cookie data by using a designated signature function to obtain a signature; and adding at least encrypted cookie data and a signature to the initial URL link to obtain the URL link to be requested, and transmitting the URL link. Because the signature is obtained by processing at least the session key and the encrypted cookie data by using the specified signature function, the cookie data is used for recording the access behaviors of the client, and the access behaviors of different types of users are greatly different, the URL link can distinguish whether the requester is a stealing link user or a normal user by adding the encrypted cookie data and the signature, and the safety of service response is improved.

title_en: System and method for calculating service contribution degree of scattered network nodes
abstract_en: The method for calculating the service contribution of the dispersed network nodes comprises the following steps: a step in which the server receives service contribution degree details from a plurality of nodes; a step in which the server verifies the received service contribution details; the server publishes the verified service contribution degree detail; and calculating a service contribution degree of the node by using a block chain including a block having the published service contribution degree specification issued by one of the plurality of nodes. According to the invention, the service contribution of the decentralized network nodes can be calculated. Meanwhile, the contribution degree of the scattered network nodes to a specific server can be calculated in a differentiated manner. And moreover, the transparency of the service contribution degree calculation details of the scattered network nodes can be ensured.

title_en: Method and device for configuring parameters of bandwidth part, storage medium, base station and user equipment
abstract_en: A method and device for configuring parameters of a bandwidth part, a storage medium, a base station and user equipment are provided, wherein the method for configuring the parameters of the bandwidth part comprises the following steps: determining a parameter to be updated of user equipment according to a bandwidth part to be configured and a configured bandwidth part aiming at a service cell of the user equipment; and sending the parameter value of the parameter to be updated to user equipment so that the user equipment can carry out parameter configuration according to the parameter value of the parameter to be updated. The technical scheme of the invention can reduce the signaling overhead when configuring the parameters of the bandwidth part for the user equipment.

title_en: Digital certificate processing method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of information security, in particular to a digital certificate processing method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium, comprising the following steps: acquiring a domain name of a server, and traversing a server domain name list, wherein the server domain name list comprises a domain name of a core server and a domain name of a non-core server; determining the type of the server according to the server domain name list; receiving a digital certificate updating instruction, and downloading an updated digital certificate from a network according to the digital certificate updating instruction; if the server is a non-core server, taking the updated digital certificate as a new digital certificate; and if the server is a core server, decrypting the updated digital certificate by using the cached digital certificate key. The method and the device effectively improve the efficiency of the local terminal in carrying out the digital certificate and simultaneously improve the safety of updating the digital certificate.

title_en: Password management method and device and password manager
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for password management, a storage medium and a password manager, belonging to the technical field of information security. The method comprises the following steps: receiving an operation request sent by a client; the operation request comprises a first password to be verified and password operation information; sending a verification request to a block chain platform according to a first password to be verified; the verification request is used for triggering the block chain platform to verify the first password to be verified by using the stored password; if a first message to be verified, returned by the block chain platform, of passing the verification of the password is received, judging that the operation request passes the verification; and operating the corresponding stored password in the block chain platform according to the password operation information in the operation request. By the technical scheme, the problem that the safety of each managed password cannot be guaranteed by the conventional password management method is solved. The validity check is fully carried out before the operation is carried out on the password stored in the block chain platform, so that the safety of the managed password can be effectively ensured.

title_en: SDN cluster fault-time service rapid and continuous switching system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a system and a method for rapidly and continuously switching services when an SDN cluster fails, and solves the problems that service interruption and time consumption for recovering a normal state are caused by abnormal SDN controllers in the existing heterogeneous SDN cluster. The switching system adds a decision module, a global backup module, a pre-connection module and an instruction agent module in the original SDN cluster architecture, and realizes the functions of quickly switching to an available controller and quickly recovering services when an SDN controller fails by using methods of trusted decision, trusted backup, asynchronous starting, pre-connection and instruction agent and executing global backup, abnormal judgment, abnormal confirmation, backup recovery, preparation switching, formal switching, interrupt processing and cluster updating. The invention has the advantages that the redundancy controller does not need to be started in advance, the backup is ensured to be correct, the switching time is short and the service is continuous. The method can be used in the field of SDN cluster construction and maintenance.

title_en: Conference audio control method, system, device and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a conference audio control method, a system, equipment and a computer readable storage medium based on a voice detection technology, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving conference audio, performing voice detection on the conference audio, and judging whether the conference audio contains user voice; if the conference audio comprises user voice, extracting the user voice in the conference audio, and converting the user voice into text data; and comparing and matching the text data with preset conference keywords, and judging whether the conference audio is output or not according to the matching result of the text data and the conference keywords. The invention can automatically mute the users who do not speak, reduce manual operation and improve efficiency.

title_en: Method for determining whether video pushes related legal knowledge or not
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining whether a video pushes related legal knowledge, which comprises the following steps: constructing a legal item library, a legal case library and a legal knowledge word library; acquiring a subtitle matching legal feature word set, a bullet screen matching legal feature word set, the number of bullet screen matching confusion words, the number of bullet screen matching negative emotion words, a similarity value, a heat analysis value and a video playing progress percentage according to subtitles and bullet screen information corresponding to the video playing content; and inputting the features into a machine learning classifier for classification, and finally determining whether the current node pushes a corresponding legal provision or case. The invention can combine the information of video barrage, caption, legal provision retrieval popularity and the like to decide whether to push the corresponding legal provision or case at present, so that the pushing is more targeted and the technical problem of excessive knowledge pushing is solved.

title_en: Method and apparatus for switching bandwidth parts
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method and equipment for switching bandwidth parts, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining whether a deactivation timer expires before a start time of a measurement interval; if the deactivation timer is overtime before the starting time of the measurement interval, determining the switching time of the bandwidth part BWP according to the ending time of the measurement interval; or, if the deactivation timer will time out before the start time of the measurement interval, determining the switching time of the BWP according to the actual time-out time when the deactivation timer operates according to the target operation mode, where the actual time-out time is later than or equal to the end time of the measurement interval. The method of the embodiment of the invention can provide a solution for how the terminal equipment switches the bandwidth part under the condition that the deactivation timer of the terminal equipment does not time out before the starting moment of the measurement interval, thereby avoiding the measurement interruption of the terminal equipment during the measurement interval and improving the communication effectiveness.

title_en: Method and system capable of reducing power consumption of Internet of things product battery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system capable of reducing the power consumption of a battery of an Internet of things product, which comprises Internet of things equipment, wherein the Internet of things equipment comprises a detection unit: the system comprises a power-on detection signal used for triggering the Internet of things equipment; a timing unit: receiving a starting-up detection signal, and outputting a confirmation signal after time delay processing; MCU: and outputting a signal for the Internet of things equipment to enter a working mode after receiving the starting detection signal and the confirmation signal. The detection device comprises: the wireless broadcast packet is sent by the Internet of things equipment for detecting that the Internet of things equipment abnormally enters a normal working mode, the equipment which abnormally enters the working mode is automatically connected, and a request for awakening the equipment abnormally to enter a sleep mode is sent; and (3) abnormal awakening equipment: and after receiving a sleep mode request sent by the detection equipment, entering a sleep mode. The method has very high application value in realizing the management of the power consumption of the battery in an abnormal use state on the Internet of things products with high requirements on miniaturization, water resistance, dust resistance and impact resistance.

title_en: Carrier switching method, device and medium based on asymmetric uplink carrier aggregation
abstract_en: The invention provides a carrier switching method and a carrier switching device based on asymmetric uplink carrier aggregation. The method comprises the following steps: after determining that the accessed user equipment UE has asymmetric uplink carrier aggregation capability, the base station judges whether the uplink main carrier control channel load of a target cell is high or not when the user equipment UE is in a switching scene; and if so, switching the UE from the current uplink carrier of the current cell to the uplink auxiliary carrier of the target cell. Under a switching scene, when the load of the uplink main carrier control channel of the target cell is high, the user equipment is directly switched to the uplink auxiliary carrier of the target cell, and the application range of the asymmetric uplink carrier aggregation technology is expanded.

title_en: Information processing method, equipment, client, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an information processing method, equipment, a client, a system and a storage medium, relates to the field of video processing, and aims to solve the problem of poor live broadcast effect in the prior art. The method comprises the following steps: identifying target video content in a first live stream; determining information of at least two voting objects in the target video content; encoding the information of the at least two voting objects into a second live broadcast stream, and sending the encoded second live broadcast stream to a client, wherein the second live broadcast stream and the first live broadcast stream contain the same video content; counting the voting data of the at least two voting objects according to the voting information of the at least two voting objects sent by the client; and sending the voting data to a live broadcast control platform so that the live broadcast control platform determines a live broadcast picture according to the voting data. The embodiment of the invention can improve the live broadcast effect.

title_en: Method and system for updating APN (access point name) of terminal equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for updating an APN (access point name) of terminal equipment. The method comprises the following steps: downloading an APN configuration file from a server terminal when the server terminal is checked to have the APN configuration file updated; detecting whether the terminal equipment supports the APN to be updated and whether the version message of the APN to be updated is higher than the version message of the current APN of the terminal equipment, if the terminal equipment supports the APN to be updated and the version message of the APN to be updated is higher than the version message of the current APN of the terminal equipment, saving an APN configuration file and informing the terminal equipment of updating the APN; and importing the APN configuration file into a system database of the terminal equipment, and updating the APN according to the APN configuration file. The invention can acquire the configuration file of the APN from the server terminal without upgrading the ROM or updating on line, and load the configuration file into a system of the terminal equipment to realize the updating of the APN.

title_en: Networking method and system of network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a networking method and a networking system of a network, wherein the networking method comprises the following steps: determining factors influencing the network efficacy and the weight of each factor; determining the proportion of the aggregation nodes required by the network according to the factors and the weight of each factor; and determining a threshold value according to the ratio so that each transmission node in the network adopts a preset sink node distribution algorithm to determine whether the transmission node is a sink node or not according to the threshold value. Compared with the prior art that a single transmission node is selected as the sink node, the technical scheme provided by the invention reduces the service life difference of each transmission node, balances the probability that each transmission node is selected as the sink node, and improves the network efficiency.

title_en: Method and device for realizing load balance in voice recognition system and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a load balancing realization method in a voice recognition system, which comprises the following steps: receiving a first voice recognition task sent by a user; inquiring CPU utilization rate of each voice recognition server in a preset task execution list; the first voice recognition task is sent to a first voice recognition server with the minimum utilization rate of a first CPU; and receiving the instant second CPU utilization rate fed back by the first voice recognition server and updating the instant second CPU utilization rate into the task execution list. The invention also provides a load balancing realization device, a server and a computer readable storage medium in the voice recognition system. According to the method, the device, the computer equipment and the computer readable storage medium for realizing the load balance in the voice recognition system, the task execution list which is dynamically updated can be inquired, and then the voice recognition server with the minimum CPU utilization rate is selected for executing the received voice recognition task, so that the load balance is realized quickly, in real time and efficiently.

title_en: Anti-quantum computing public key pool updating method and system based on alliance chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for updating a quantum computation resistant public key pool based on a alliance chain. In the invention, in the process of transmitting the public key and the signature information to other members by a user, the public key in the public key pool is used as the offset to encrypt the public key and the signature information, so that the quantum computer cannot crack the private key through the public key and the signature information.

title_en: Simulation method of quantum secret communication network
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulation method of a quantum secure communication network, which aims to accurately analyze specific influence factors of performance by finely depicting actual QSCN, and belongs to the field of simulation analysis of the quantum secure communication network. The invention comprises the following steps: based on graph theory, simulating a quantum secure communication network by using a graph G = (V, E, F), wherein V, E and F respectively represent the collection of nodes, edges and network flows in the quantum secure communication network based on the graph theory; wherein pairs of connected nodes(s) in a quantum secure communication network are utilized  i  ,t  j  ) The connection requirements of (2) represent attributes of the node; representing edges (u) using channel capacity and key capacity in quantum secure communication networks  σ  ,v  φ  ) The attribute of (2); using non-negative functions f(s)  i  ,t  j  ,u  σ  ,v  φ  ) Representing a pair of connected nodes(s)  i  ,t  j  ) At the side (u)  σ  ,v  φ  ) Network flow of (d), f(s)  i  ,t  j  ,u  σ  ,v  φ  ) Is an integer multiple of the packet size P, the network flow satisfies the capacity and flow restrictions of the quantum secure communication network.

title_en: Method for realizing global wall-hitting sound effect in smart television
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing a global wall-hitting sound effect in an intelligent television, which comprises the following steps: A. b, before the system dispatches a direction key keydown key message to an application, recording the current focus V1 of the application and other auxiliary information Info 1; C. after the system sends a direction key keyup key message to an application, recording the current focus V2 of the application and other auxiliary information Info 2; D. and comparing the recorded focuses V1 and V2, and judging whether the current focus state belongs to the focus wall collision or not by combining auxiliary information Info1 and Info2, if so, playing wall collision audio, and otherwise, not playing the wall collision audio. The method can implement the global wall-hitting sound effect at the system level, can take effect to all the applications, and does not need to perform any special processing of the wall-hitting sound.

title_en: Hybrid strategy heterogeneous social network information diffusion analysis based on evolutionary game theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mixed strategy heterogeneous social network information diffusion analysis method based on an evolutionary game theory, and belongs to the field of signal processing. Under the condition of knowing the basic characteristics of the network, namely knowing the number of rational users, the number of irrational users, the connection relation among the users and other parameters in the network, the method can estimate the dynamic change of information diffusion of the network at each moment and the final evolution stable state of the network by judging whether the rational users know the types mutually and substituting each parameter into the formula in the corresponding condition, thereby analyzing the influence of the irrational users on the information diffusion of the whole network. The invention can accurately predict the information diffusion condition in the network, and the actual dynamic change and the final stable state are highly consistent with the actual condition; meanwhile, by comparing with the case without the irrational user, the quantitative influence of the irrational user on the network can be obtained. Therefore, the method and the device can effectively estimate the influence of the irrational user on the social network information diffusion.

title_en: CGW (Central gateway-based) and data processing method based on CGW
abstract_en: The invention provides a data processing method based on a Central Gateway (CGW) and the CGW, wherein the CGW comprises a first communication module, a second communication module and a processing unit, and the method comprises the following steps: when the vehicle is in a dormant state, the first communication module sends a first heartbeat packet to the cloud server; acquiring network signal strength of a first communication module and a second communication module; when the network signal intensity of the first communication module is smaller than that of the second communication module, the processing unit sends a first prompt message for network switching to the second communication module; and the second communication module sends a second heartbeat packet to the cloud server according to the first prompt message for network switching. Therefore, the communication module can be selected, signal transmission is carried out through the communication module with high network signal intensity, and only the CGW interacts with the cloud server when the vehicle is in a dormant state, so that power consumption is saved.

title_en: Passenger flow accurate test method based on wireless positioning technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a passenger flow accurate testing method based on a wireless positioning technology, which comprises the following steps: s1: collecting original data in a wireless network in one day of a shop in real time, and storing the original data in the wireless network in a server; s2: converting the time sequence of the original data stored in the server, calculating the time difference, and eliminating abnormal area data in the original data; s3: merging the abnormal region data and performing time-adjacent sequencing; s4: carrying out secondary cleaning on the data, putting the data after the secondary cleaning into a 24-hour time period, and calculating the frequency of the signals appearing in 24 hours; s5: and storing the calculated data into a server. According to the technical scheme, the accuracy of the passenger flow test of the wireless positioning technology is improved to 80% under the condition that the cost is kept unchanged, the decision of a brand dealer is helped, and meanwhile, the operation cost is greatly reduced.

title_en: Discontinuous reception processing method, user terminal and network side equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a discontinuous reception processing method, a user terminal and network side equipment, and belongs to the technical field of wireless communication. The discontinuous reception processing method applied to the user terminal comprises the following steps: and receiving a Physical Downlink Control Channel (PDCCH) indication, and starting one of a plurality of pre-acquired active period extension timers with different lengths. By the technical scheme of the invention, the power consumption of the UE can be reduced as much as possible while the specific service of the UE can be scheduled more quickly.

title_en: Adaptive offset OFDM modulation method based on IM-DD in wireless optical communication system
abstract_en: The adaptive bias OFDM modulation method based on IM-DD in the wireless optical communication system provided by the invention fully considers the inherent characteristics of an optical detector and the difference of the amplitudes of different signal samples in the OFDM modulation method based on IM/DD in the wireless optical communication, and designs the adaptive bias according to the specific amplitude of the signal sample on the basis of ensuring that the signal meets the nonnegative constraint; ensuring that no interference is caused to the transmitted symbols; and the minimum bias which is added into the signal and meets the non-negativity is set to be opposite polarity of the minimum value of the signal sample, and the effect of reducing the power consumption of the system is achieved by subtracting the minimum value in the signal sample, so that the non-negativity of the transmission signal is ensured, and the power consumption of the system is reduced. The method can not influence the transmitted signals, can not cause the power to become low, and reduces the complexity of the system while maintaining the spectrum efficiency of the system.

title_en: Equipment management method, system and storage medium of local area network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a local area network equipment management method, which is applied to each storage equipment in the same local area network and comprises the following steps: receiving a device discovery request which is sent by a management module based on an LLDP protocol and in a local area network multicast mode; collecting device information of itself after receiving the device discovery request; and setting the destination MAC address of the frame header in the LLDP protocol as the address of the management module so as to feed back the collected own equipment information to the management module in a point-to-point mode, so that the management module completes equipment discovery. By applying the scheme of the application, the safety of information is guaranteed, and meanwhile, the bandwidth occupation is reduced. The application also provides a device management system and a storage medium of the local area network, and the device management system and the storage medium have corresponding technical effects.

title_en: Driving information transmission method, device, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a driving information transmission method, a device, a system, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring target driving reference information sent by the information server, wherein the target driving reference information is obtained according to the geographical position sent by the driving reference end; determining a driving information subscription end corresponding to the target driving reference information; and sending the target driving reference information to the driving information subscription end, and sending the target driving reference information to the corresponding driving reference end through the driving information subscription end. The method can improve the transmission efficiency.

title_en: Method and device for reporting private data and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a device and a storage medium for reporting private data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that terminal equipment obtains reported data, divides the reported data into front string data and rear string data according to a preset step length, then scrambles the front string data and the rear string data respectively to generate privacy data, and sends the privacy data to a server. The method comprises the steps that a server receives privacy data sent by a plurality of terminal devices, determines N first series of data, then obtains M data to be reported according to the privacy data, and finally determines the data to be reported with the reporting proportion larger than a first preset value as target reporting data. In other words, according to the method of this embodiment, the terminal device divides the reported data into two parts, and scrambles the two parts to generate the private data, and the private data sent by the server terminal device matches the reported data from the head and the tail directions, so that the matching accuracy is high, and the matching speed is high.

title_en: Energy acquisition D2D communication resource allocation method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy acquisition D2D communication resource allocation method based on reinforcement learning. In the method, a D2D sending end adopts a mode A to directly communicate with a D2D receiving end, or adopts a mode B as a relay to assist cellular communication and simultaneously applies NOMA technology to communicate with a D2D receiving end. Firstly, deducing an interruption probability expression when a user adopts different modes for communication; and then, assuming that energy collection and channel state information at all the time instants are known, channels are allocated to the D2D users and relays are selected for the cellular users by using a KM algorithm, and meanwhile, the transmission power of the D2D users is optimized by using a reinforcement learning method by considering energy causality constraint and maximum transmission power limit. In the invention, the D2D sending end can be used as a relay to assist the edge cellular user communication, the resource allocation of the D2D user and the cellular user is optimized under the condition of meeting the user service quality and energy constraint, the total capacity of the D2D user and the mode B cellular user can be improved, and more edge cellular users are allowed to access the network.

title_en: Equipment adding method of Mesh network, gateway equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a device adding method of a Mesh network, gateway equipment and a storage medium. The device adding method of the Mesh network comprises the following steps: transmitting scanning request information to a first device; receiving scanning response information returned by the first equipment according to the scanning request information; transmitting connection authentication information to the first device according to the scanning response information; and receiving and verifying a connection authentication request sent by the first equipment, and establishing connection with the first equipment if the verification is passed. The embodiment of the invention realizes the convenient and quick addition of the equipment in the wireless Mesh networking.

title_en: Vehicle offline detection system and method for detecting Bluetooth key function
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle offline detection system and a detection method for detecting a Bluetooth key function, wherein the detection system comprises a production data system, an electric detection device, an encryption machine, a handheld detection device and a Bluetooth key controller assembled on a vehicle; the electric detection equipment is deployed on a vehicle production line and used for acquiring vehicle information data of a detected vehicle and synchronizing the vehicle information data to a production data system through a local area network; the handheld detection device is respectively connected with the production data system and the encryption machine through a local area network, acquires corresponding vehicle information data through the production data system, sends the corresponding vehicle information data to the encryption machine, generates a session key according to the vehicle information data through the encryption machine, and feeds the session key back to the handheld detection device; handheld detection device installs and to supply the user to carry out the APP that the bluetooth was controlled to the vehicle, and handheld detection device and bluetooth key controller pass through the bluetooth connection and detect the vehicle of being examined through the APP, and the testing result feeds back to production data system and stores.

title_en: Multi-radio device and method of operating the same
abstract_en: A wireless device, comprising: a first analog radio module and a second analog radio module; a first medium access control module and a second medium access control module configured to control access to the digital network via the first analog radio module and the second analog radio module, respectively; a first baseband module and a second baseband module configured to convert between analog signals at the first analog radio module and the second analog radio module and digital signals at the first medium access control module and the second medium access control module, respectively; and circuitry configured to selectively coordinate the first and second medium access control modules to create a single channel configuration for use by the wireless device in transmitting and receiving radio signals over the wireless interface by setting the first and second analog radio modules to operate on a common frequency and by commonly controlling the first and second baseband modules to convert common packets between analog and digital signals transmitted to or received from the respective medium access control modules.

title_en: Personal communication device, payment terminal, financial transaction system and method, and storage medium
abstract_en: A personal communication device for processing financial information via a payment terminal, the payment terminal configured to output a wireless signal configured to: receiving the wireless signal of a payment terminal; it is determined whether the strength of the received wireless signal is above a first signal threshold. And if the received signal strength is above the first signal strength threshold, transmitting a wireless request signal for the payment terminal to establish a communication channel with the personal communication device, wherein the request signal causes the payment terminal to establish only one communication channel, wherein the communication channel is only between the personal communication device and the payment terminal. When the financial transaction at the personal communication device ends, a wireless release signal for closing the communication channel is transmitted so that the payment terminal can establish another communication channel with another personal communication device.

title_en: Method and apparatus for configuring time domain resource allocation for different service types in mobile communication
abstract_en: Various solutions are described for configuring time domain resource allocation (TD-RA) for different service types with respect to user equipment and network devices in mobile communications. The apparatus may receive a configuration of a plurality of TD-RA tables from a network node. The apparatus may activate at least one of the plurality of TD-RA tables. The apparatus may determine the allocated resources based on at least one of the plurality of activated TD-RA tables. The apparatus may perform the transmission on the allocated resources.

title_en: Application program calling method, device and equipment based on virtual robot
abstract_en: The invention provides an application program calling method, device, equipment, vehicle and storage medium based on a virtual robot, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first control instruction; identifying a target application program to be called according to the first control instruction; acquiring a target Application Programming Interface (API) corresponding to a target application; and controlling the target application program to execute the first control instruction by calling the target API. According to the method, the virtual robot interacts with the application program, so that the complex steps of a user in controlling different application programs are reduced, and the convenience and the intelligence of calling the application program are improved.

title_en: Block chain link point monitoring method and device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a block chain link point monitoring method and device, relates to the technical field of communication, and is used for determining an operation index of a block chain system according to transmission parameters of a cochain data block, so that the operation state of the block chain system can be visually and conveniently embodied. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring transmission parameters of an uplink data block, wherein the transmission parameters comprise an identifier of the uplink data block, a sending time of the uplink data block, an identifier of at least one block chain node, an identifier of a first block chain node and a receiving time of the first block chain node for receiving the uplink data block. Determining an operation index of the block chain system according to the transmission parameters of the uplink data block, wherein the operation index comprises at least one of uplink success rate and average transmission duration. And if the operation index meets a second preset condition, determining that the block chain system is abnormal.

title_en: Automatic measuring device and method for mass flow of produced liquid of oilfield production well
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic measuring device and method for the mass flow of produced liquid of an oilfield production well, wherein the device comprises the following components: a controller and a measuring device body; the measuring device body includes: the device comprises a first electromagnetic valve, a second electromagnetic valve, a metering tank, a pipeline pump, an integrated weighing module and a third electromagnetic valve; wherein: the controller is respectively connected with the first electromagnetic valve, the second electromagnetic valve, the pipeline pump and the third electromagnetic valve in a control way; the controller is in communication connection with the integrated weighing module. The invention adopts an external metering tank, and the occupied area is small. No movable parts are arranged in the tank, the possibility of scaling is reduced, and the accuracy of calculating the liquid output mass flow is easy to ensure; the metering tank and the integrated weighing module are easy to prevent corrosion and explosion, reliable in structure and easy to maintain. On the other hand, the automatic online measurement of the mass data of the flow is realized, and the accuracy and the efficiency of measurement are improved.

title_en: Cloud game video processing method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the field, in particular to a cloud game video processing method, electronic equipment and a storage medium.
