The cloud game video processing method comprises the following steps: identifying a target game event in a cloud game; acquiring a target clipping object in the target game event; determining a starting time and an ending time according to the target clipping object; acquiring a video clip between the starting time and the ending time in the cloud game; the starting time is the time before the target game event starts, and the ending time is the time after the target game event ends. By adopting the embodiment of the invention, the wonderful game video clips can be automatically clipped and generated in the cloud game process, so that players can share the automatically clipped game video clips conveniently.

title_en: Data transmission method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a data transmission method, a data transmission device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the first video network data forwarding device receives configuration parameters sent by the management and control platform through an SNMP protocol, configures a local video network data forwarding device according to the configuration parameters, receives video network data sent by the first video network terminal, converts the video network data into internet data, and forwards the internet data to the opposite video network data forwarding device according to the configuration parameters, so that the opposite video network data are converted into the video network data by the opposite video network data forwarding device and sent to the second video network terminal. Adopt first video networking data forwarding equipment and opposite terminal video networking data forwarding equipment, can realize that data changes the transmission between video networking and internet to the messenger does not have the place of installing the video networking net twine, also can carry out the video networking business through the video networking terminal, thereby enlarges the application range of video networking business, and reduce cost.

title_en: Internet of things node code updating method based on cross-protocol communication
abstract_en: The invention provides a cross-protocol communication-based Internet of things node code updating method, which comprises the steps of compiling an updating script on an upper computer; the upper computer acquires a phase sequence of a signal sent by a node to be updated and realizes time synchronization; the upper computer updating program encodes and transmits the updating data packet according to a cross-protocol communication protocol; a receiving module of the node to be updated receives the updating script and decodes the updating script according to the protocol; the updating module of the node to be updated is responsible for checking and updating the received updating data packet; the ZigBee node sends updating completion information to the upper computer according to the cross-protocol communication protocol; and the upper computer scans the data packet which receives the updating completion of the node, and the updating is completed. The code updating method provided by the invention is realized based on a cross-protocol communication method, and the single-hop realization mode greatly reduces the energy consumption load of the updating node in the traditional code updating process and reduces the complexity in the updating process.

title_en: Running time information transmission method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for transmitting running time information, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of networks. According to the method and the device, the first request carrying the line identification is sent to the control device, the first response sent by the control device is received, the first response at least carries the running time information of at least one vehicle with the line identification, and the running time information of the at least one vehicle is sent to at least one terminal in a broadcasting or multicasting mode, so that outside-station passengers can be informed of when the next vehicle arrives at the station in time, the transmission range of the running time information is expanded, the limitation of the running time information transmission process is eliminated, and the user experience of outside-station passengers is optimized.

title_en: Terminal and base station in wireless communication system and method for performing the same
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a communication method and system for merging a fifth generation (5G) communication system for supporting higher data rates than a fourth generation (4G) system with technologies for internet of things (IoT). The present disclosure may be applied to smart services based on 5G communication technologies and IoT-related technologies, such as smart homes, smart buildings, smart cities, smart cars, networked cars, healthcare, digital education, smart retail, security, and security services. A method and apparatus for transmitting and receiving control and data channels in a wireless communication system are disclosed.

title_en: Method for operating a communication network in a ring topology and such a communication network
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method of operating a communication network in a ring topology and such a communication network. The invention relates to a method for operating a communication network 1 having ring network devices 2a-f, which are connected to one another in a ring topology by means of ring network lines 4a-e to form a network, wherein the ring network devices 2a-f use a ring redundancy method, wherein a management ring network device 2a periodically sends test packets through the communication network 1, which are received in turn by the other ring network devices 2b-f and are sent back in turn by them until the management ring network device 2a, in order to determine a fault of the communication network 1, wherein a delay in the transmission of the test packets along the ring topology due to at least one fault packet in the ring topology is prevented by: the time of all ring network devices 2a-f is synchronized and at least part of the data traffic planning and processing is implemented according to the standard IEEE 802.1Qbv in the ring redundancy method used by applying at least part of the time aware shaping method, wherein the transmission of test packets is planned and controlled such that the test packets are forwarded to the ring network devices 2a-f at least substantially without waiting time. The invention also relates to a corresponding communication network 1.

title_en: Method, terminal and server for judging working path record and key stay
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for judging working path record and key stay, which comprises the following steps: the server receives a positioning point sent by the terminal according to set time, wherein the positioning point is position information of the current position of the terminal; extracting key dwell points in the positioning points and recording the key dwell points in a key dwell point table, wherein the key dwell points meet the condition that the front positioning point and the rear positioning point are positioned within a certain distance of the key dwell points within fixed time; and the server displays a path formed by the positioning point and the key stop point on the electronic map through the user identifier, wherein the user identifier is the user identifier of the current login of the terminal.

title_en: Intelligent detection device and method for power failure of HPLC communication unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent detection device and method for the power failure of an HPLC communication unit, and relates to the technical field of communication detection; the device comprises a server, a first detection device, a second detection device, a protocol analyzer, a signal analyzer, a first capacitance tester, a second capacitance tester and a program module for detecting the power failure report of a concentrator local HPLC communication unit or an electric energy meter HPLC communication unit; the method is based on the equipment to execute the following operations, wherein the server, the protocol analyzer, the signal analyzer and the capacitance tester respectively receive power failure reported information and complete power failure reporting detection; the power failure report of the local HPLC communication unit or the electric energy meter HPLC communication unit of the detection concentrator is realized through the server, the first detection device, the second detection device, the protocol analyzer, the signal analyzer, the first capacitance tester, the second capacitance tester, the power failure report detection module and the like.

title_en: Quasi co-located antenna for LBT
abstract_en: Quasi co-location (QCL) for Listen Before Talk (LBT) procedures is disclosed. A base station with multiple antennas may identify one or more QCL antenna groups. The various aspects provide different rules for defining QCL relationships, such as based on interference experienced by antennas, physical or logical connection of antennas and LBT coupling, or synchronization. QCL may be further determined across multiple shared channels, such as based on the frequency spacing or frequency bands of the channels. Once clustered into QCLs, the base station performs an LBT procedure to reserve access to one or more shared communication channels. If the LBT is successful, the base station may then transmit a channel reservation preamble on the shared communication channel in response.

title_en: Efficient and accurate database service discovery method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an efficient and accurate database service discovery method, which is technically characterized by comprising the following steps: specifying a database service IP range; appointing the mapping relation between the port range of different database type services and the database type; detecting surviving hosts within the network; detecting the port state of the surviving host, and establishing connection with the surviving port; and determining the service type of the database by analyzing the message characteristics and the abnormal message characteristics. The invention has reasonable design, can efficiently and accurately discover the database service surviving in the network by the modes of living host screening, active port detection, database service type determination and the like, and can be widely applied to the fields of database management, database operation and maintenance, database carding, database detection, database vulnerability scanning and the like.

title_en: Video playing control method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a video playing control method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of video playing. In the present application, first, target display time information is obtained based on display time information of a first frame video frame displayed in a target video stream and play duration information of the target video stream. Secondly, determining a target sub-video frame of each target sub-video stream based on the target display time information, wherein the target video stream comprises a plurality of target sub-video streams. Then, a splicing display operation is performed based on the target sub video frames of the plurality of target sub video streams. By the method, the problem of poor playing control effect in video playing based on the webpage client in the prior art can be solved.

title_en: Video clip positioning method, server, client and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a video clip positioning method, a server, a client and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving a video segment positioning request sent by a client, wherein the video segment positioning request carries a first comment; the first comment is a comment which is input in a comment area of the first video by a user and is used for positioning a video clip; determining a first video clip matched with the first comment according to the video clip positioning request; and sending the first video segment to the client so that the client can display the first video segment as a reply comment of the first comment. According to the embodiment of the invention, the interested video segments are positioned in a mode of inputting the user comments in the comment area of the video, so that the user operation is facilitated, and the user experience is improved. In addition, according to the embodiment of the invention, the interested segments are positioned according to the comments input by the users, so that the video segments described by all the user comments can be basically positioned, and the requirements of each user are met.

title_en: Electronic device and control method thereof
abstract_en: An electronic device according to an embodiment includes: an input receiver configured to receive user input; a voice receiver configured to receive a voice command; a processor configured to control to execute a specific function of the electronic device based on receiving a user input corresponding to execution of the specific function other than a utterance of a first voice command corresponding to the execution of the specific function, and to execute a guide operation for the utterance of the first voice command.

title_en: Network routing method and device based on segmented routing
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a network routing method and a device based on segmented routing, wherein an SDN deployment architecture constructed based on different large-flow service scene data flows comprehensively considers grid information constructed based on test data among access routers and port state information acquired from the routers as a metric value calculation optimal path method, and aiming at the SDN deployment architecture, the method adapts to different large-flow service routing adjustment by using existing network equipment as much as possible; based on grid information constructed by test data among access routers and port state information collected from the routers, metric values of differentiation adjustment are carried out according to the requirements of service flow, and PCE (path computation optimization) is carried out based on the metric values.

title_en: Configuration management method and system
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of computer configuration, and provides a configuration management method and a configuration management system, wherein the management method comprises the following steps: calculating a first hash value of a current configuration file, wherein the current configuration file is a file formed by collecting configuration commands which are currently running; acquiring a second hash value of a pre-stored historical configuration file, wherein the historical configuration file is a unified configuration file issued by a management node; and if the first hash value and the second hash value are different, updating the current configuration file according to the historical configuration file. In the above manner, whether the current configuration file is changed or not is judged through the second hash value of the historical configuration file, so that the current configuration file is updated, and the configuration commands in the computer cluster are ensured to be consistent.

title_en: Method and device for detecting network intrusion data
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a device for detecting network intrusion data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: and acquiring data in each network segment, and inputting the data in each network segment into a pre-trained network intrusion detection model to obtain a detection result corresponding to each data. The embodiment of the invention uses a pre-trained network intrusion detection model to detect the data of each network segment, the value of the weight in the pre-trained network intrusion detection model which is lower than a preset weight threshold value is zero, and the pre-trained network intrusion detection model is the network intrusion detection model with the minimum cost value in the network intrusion detection model of which the weight is lower than the preset weight threshold value and is zero, and the network intrusion detection model only keeps the connection of channels of which the weight is not lower than the weight threshold value, thereby reducing the complexity and the redundancy of the network intrusion detection model, reducing the risk of overfitting the network intrusion detection model and improving the accuracy of the network intrusion detection model for identifying the network intrusion data.

title_en: Machine learning model, method, device and storage medium for mobile terminal position tracking
abstract_en: A machine learning model, method, apparatus, and storage medium for mobile terminal location tracking. The invention relates to a communication method, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving a communication signal of a current time slot of a user side; processing parameters of the communication signal of the current time slot according to a machine learning model obtained by pre-training so as to predict the movement of the user terminal at the next time slot; wherein the training process of the machine learning model comprises: acquiring communication observation data; determining a plurality of data lines from the communication observation data, wherein each data line comprises departure point information, target point information and a motion direction label between the departure point and the target point; and training the plurality of data lines as a training set. The invention can improve the precision of predicting the movement of the user and reduce the interruption condition in communication.

title_en: Method and apparatus for discovery and access of restricted local services for unauthenticated UEs
abstract_en: The (ME) may determine whether the mobile device has valid credentials for accessing an available public land mobile network. The availability of limited carrier service access support may be detected (920). If limited operator service access support is available and the mobile device does not have valid credentials for accessing an available public land mobile network, a cell of the public land mobile network that supports the limited operator service access may be selected (930) as the serving cell. An attach procedure may be performed (940) for the restricted operator service using the public land mobile network of the selected cell as the selected public land mobile network.

title_en: Access request flow limiting method, server and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a data processing technology and provides an access request current limiting method, a server and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a corresponding current limiting strategy according to a URL address in a request after a gateway receives an access request of a client, generating a time stamp and a key value pair of a service type corresponding to the request according to a mark in the request, processing the number of tokens after the last request and the time for obtaining the tokens last time according to the key value pair of the service type, calculating to obtain the number of remaining tokens after the request is processed based on the time stamp, the time for obtaining the tokens last time and the current limiting strategy, writing the time stamp and the number of remaining tokens into a database, sending the number of remaining tokens to the gateway, and finally judging whether to execute the current limiting operation on the request according to the number of remaining tokens and a preset value. The invention can control the access request number of the client, does not need to independently maintain the token bucket and the token number, and greatly reduces the consumption of the memory and the threads.

title_en: Session configuration method and device
abstract_en: In the application, terminal equipment sends a session establishment request for requesting to establish a first session to a session management network element; after receiving a session establishment request, a session management network element sends redundant transmission safety information to access network equipment; the access network equipment receives the redundant transmission safety information and sends the redundant transmission safety information to the terminal equipment, wherein the redundant transmission safety information is used for indicating a safety key and a safety strategy of a first session and a second session which need to be established by the terminal equipment, and the second session is the redundant session of the first session. The access network equipment can send the redundant transmission safety information to the terminal equipment, can ensure that the access network equipment and the terminal equipment keep consistent aiming at the safety key and the safety strategy of two sessions (a first session and a second session) used for redundant transmission, and further can ensure that the safety configuration of the two sessions used for redundant transmission is completed.

title_en: Computing resource allocation method, device, server and storage medium
abstract_en: In the embodiment of the application, according to the corresponding evaluation indexes obtained from metadata, the evaluation indexes are expressed as data for reflecting account quality, at least one account is classified, the metadata is expressed as operation behavior data of the corresponding account, and the computing resources of each account are divided according to the classification results of the accounts and the evaluation indexes corresponding to the accounts, so that the computing resources are dynamically allocated, the resource utilization rate is improved, meanwhile, the computing resources can be inclined to high-quality users, the computing resources can play a larger value space, and resource waste caused by unreasonable use of the computing resources by the users is prevented.

title_en: Split augmented reality device, data transmission system and data transmission method thereof
abstract_en: A split type augmented reality device, a data transmission system and a data transmission method thereof are provided, wherein the data transmission method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of first signals in a downlink channel; splitting and encoding the plurality of first signals to obtain a first compressed signal; transmitting the first compressed signal; decoding the first compressed signal to obtain the plurality of first signals; generating a plurality of second signals in the uplink channel; splitting and encoding the plurality of second signals to obtain a second compressed signal; transmitting the second compressed signal; decoding the second compressed signal to obtain the plurality of second signals. Therefore, the data transmission quantity and the transmission rate of the split type augmented reality device can be effectively improved.

title_en: Data transmission method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a data transmission method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving data sent by a terminal in an inactive state, wherein the data comprises data to be sent by the terminal and identification information of the terminal, determining an anchor base station of the terminal according to the identification information, sending the data to the anchor base station, sending the data to core network equipment through the anchor base station, forwarding uplink data of the terminal to the anchor base station through interaction between the anchor base station and a service base station currently providing air interface resources for the terminal, uploading the uplink data to the core network through the service base station, and not needing to carry out context transfer or switching between the core network and the base station, signaling and interface overhead, and improving data transmission efficiency.

title_en: Data processing method and device and terminal
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a data processing method, a data processing device and a data processing terminal, wherein a first terminal device receives first data and second data from at least one second terminal device, the feedback priority of the first data is higher than the feedback priority of the second data, the first terminal device sends first HARQ feedback information corresponding to the first data and second HARQ feedback information corresponding to the second data to the at least one second terminal device, and the feedback time of the first HARQ feedback information is earlier than that of the second HARQ feedback information; therefore, the method and the device for determining the HARQ feedback resource by the receiving end realize the mode of autonomously determining the HARQ feedback resource by the receiving end, further ensure that the data with high feedback priority is fed back before the data with low feedback priority, and can ensure the effective transmission of important data, thereby ensuring the driving safety of vehicles.

title_en: Data transmission method and related equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a data transmission method and related equipment, which are applied to terminal equipment in a communication system, wherein the communication system further comprises a cloud server, and the method comprises the following steps: sending first information to the cloud server, wherein the first information comprises information of a service cell where the terminal equipment is located and data transmission quality of the terminal equipment; receiving transmission time configuration information sent by the cloud server, wherein the transmission time configuration information is determined by the cloud server based on the first information and a peak-shifting uploading strategy; determining transmission resources for transmitting the target data packet based on the transmission time configuration information and a first data volume of the target data packet to be transmitted; and transmitting the target data packet on the transmission resource. By adopting the method and the device, the success rate of data transmission of the terminal equipment can be improved.

title_en: Improvements in broadcast channel reception in NB-IOT devices
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving the reliability of Narrowband Physical Broadcast Channel (NPBCH) reception in narrowband Internet of things (NB-IoT) User Equipment (UE) in a cell acquisition stage. It is an object of the present invention to improve the existing NPBCH reception procedure to achieve lower code rates and thus to solve for more reliable transmissions between eNodeB and UE. The UE receives, descrambles and de-rate matches at least a first set of 64 NPBCH subframes and a second set of 64 NPBCH subframes, applies a modifier sequence { m } to the first set of 64 NPBCH subframes using the four most significant bits of the system frame number as a counter and the modifier sequence { m }, then combines the two sets, decodes and extracts the master information block from the combined NPBCH subframes, and if a match is found, the UE attaches to the cell.

title_en: HbbTV application starting method and display equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a HbbTV application starting method and display equipment, which enable a user to actively select to start an HbbTV application. The display device includes: a display; a controller coupled to the display for performing: responding to a target HbbTV application selection instruction, and outputting a channel corresponding to the selected target HbbTV application; responding to a first channel selection instruction, wherein a first channel carried by the first channel selection instruction is selected from channels corresponding to the target HbbTV application, switching the display device to the first channel, starting the target HbbTV application in the first channel, updating the state, recorded by a state machine, corresponding to the HbbTV self-starting application to a first state, and the first state is used for indicating to stop starting the HbbTV self-starting application in the first channel.

title_en: Method for operating an infrastructure device, infrastructure device and communication device
abstract_en: A method of operating an infrastructure equipment forming part of a wireless communications network and configured to communicate with one or more communications devices, the method comprising forming a downlink signal for transmission via a wireless access interface. The wireless access interface includes resource elements for carrying subcarriers of Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) symbols in a frequency dimension, the resource elements being formed into a plurality of resource element blocks in the frequency dimension, and the wireless access interface is divided into time units in a time dimension, each time unit for carrying a plurality of OFDM symbols. The time unit may be, for example, a subframe of the radio access interface. The forming of the downlink signal includes selecting a plurality of component signals from a set of component signals, each component signal of the set of component signals being formed from a sequence of signal samples for transmission over a plurality of OFDM symbols in one resource element block and in one time unit, each component signal being detectable by a narrow bandwidth receiver, and selecting one or more resource element blocks of the plurality of resource element blocks and one or more time units for each signal component of the plurality of component signals to transmit the component signal. The sequence of signal samples may be, for example, a narrowband internet of things wake-up signal (NB-IoT WUS) formed, for example, from a Zadoff-Chu sequence and carried by a plurality of OFDM symbols in one resource element block of the wireless access interface. In one example, the multiple component signals may be used to form a wider bandwidth wake-up signal, e.g., a wake-up signal that may be used for eMTC devices.

title_en: Flow classification method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a flow classification method and a device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining valid bits corresponding to a first rule set according to distribution characteristics of concerned bits of a plurality of rules in the first rule set, wherein the valid bits comprise bits for distinguishing numerical values of different rules in the plurality of rules; determining a hash key value of each rule according to a numerical value of a valid bit of each rule in a first rule set, and storing each rule in the first rule set in at least one storage unit of S storage units according to the hash key value, wherein the first rule set is any one of N rule sets, the N rule sets are stored in the S storage units, N and S are integers greater than or equal to 1, and the valid bits of the rules stored in each storage unit of the S storage units are the same; and when the stream classification is carried out, searching a corresponding rule in each storage unit in the S storage units according to the hash key value of the search key word.

title_en: Equipment state monitoring method and intelligent traffic cloud management platform
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an equipment state monitoring method and an intelligent traffic cloud management platform. The equipment state monitoring method comprises the following steps: monitoring the state of the target equipment through the monitoring module; when the monitoring module detects that the target equipment is changed from an online state to an offline state, first information is sent to the warning module through the monitoring module; and under the condition that the alarm module receives the first information, outputting offline alarm information through the alarm module. According to the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the monitoring module is arranged in the intelligent transportation cloud management platform so as to monitor the online state and the offline state of the equipment; and an alarm module is arranged in the intelligent traffic cloud management platform, so that offline alarm information for prompting the disconnection of the equipment is output under the condition that the monitoring module detects the disconnection of the equipment, the staff can intervene the disconnection of the equipment in time, and the adverse effect caused by the disconnection of the equipment is reduced.

title_en: Method for efficiently using resources between cooperative vehicles
abstract_en: Disclosed are methods, systems, and apparatus for side link communications. The WTRU may receive the first SCI element from a second WTRU within the group. The WTRU may receive a first RCI element within a first set of resources scheduled by a first SCI. The first RCI may include information about which WTRUs in the group are scheduled to use the second set of resources. The WTRU may determine that one or more sub-resources within the second set of resources are available based on the first RCI. The WTRU may transmit data in one or more sub-resources. The first SCI and the first RCI may be received in a first reserved period and one or more sub-resources may be in a second reserved period.

title_en: Video transmission method suitable for satellite data communication network
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent video transmission protocol suitable for a satellite data communication network, which comprises the following steps: step a-the relevant devices (encoder, decoder server, video receiver) remain online. And B, transmitting real-time video data and control data. The invention aims to utilize an artificial intelligence data transmission control technology and an autonomous innovative protocol to solve the problem of low performance of video monitoring on demand caused by high delay, low bandwidth, high error rate and other data communication network environments, reduce the resource requirement of video monitoring on demand service on the data communication network bandwidth, improve the user experience, improve the efficiency of video monitoring in the satellite data communication field and enable the wide-area, low-cost and high-efficiency intelligent video monitoring based on the satellite data communication network to be popularized and applied in the industry. The invention is compatible with video transmission of mainstream camera coding modes in the current market, (including various video coding and decoding and transmission protocols such as H.26x series, MPEG series, WebM series and the like).

title_en: Digital truck construction method based on trusted Internet of vehicles intelligent equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital truck construction method based on trusted Internet of vehicles intelligent equipment, which comprises the following steps of: constructing an intelligent device of the Internet of vehicles based on the technology of the Internet of things and a block chain, wherein the intelligent device of the Internet of vehicles is provided with a digital identity module and generates a safe and credible digital identity signature for the device; constructing a digital truck management cloud system, and providing support services such as digital truck identity registration, digital truck identity authentication, digital truck data security storage, digital truck operation monitoring and the like; constructing a trusted block chain management system of the digital truck: establishing a credible digital truck link system based on a block chain technology, and providing services such as distributed accounts, data block registration, data consensus authentication, credit cross validation and the like for each digital truck construction party; and constructing a third-party service organization node, an equipment manufacturer node and a government industry management organization node, thereby further improving the reliability of the data of the digital truck in the system.

title_en: Index modulation-based single-carrier high-speed spread spectrum underwater acoustic communication method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a single-carrier high-speed spread spectrum underwater acoustic communication method based on index modulation, and belongs to the field of underwater acoustic communication. Carrying out serial-parallel conversion, joint symbol serial number mapping, CP insertion and parallel-serial conversion on signals at a transmitting end in sequence, and then inputting the signals into an underwater acoustic channel; and removing CP, FFT, frequency domain equalization, IFFT and symbol serial number joint decoding are sequentially carried out on the signals at a receiving end to obtain output signals. The method combines index modulation, spread spectrum and cyclic shift technology under the framework of SC-FDE. The joint spreading code index and the cyclic shift index are used as an information bearing unit to improve the data rate, thereby enhancing the frequency spectrum, the energy efficiency and the transmission safety.

title_en: Audio and video matching zero watermark generation method and audio and video tamper-proof detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an audio and video matching zero watermark generation method and an audio and video tamper-proofing detection method. When generating the zero watermark, the method of the invention carries out segmentation matching on the audio and video by taking time as a unit, and the generated zero watermark not only carries the video characteristics but also carries the sound characteristics of the corresponding audio; the video characteristics are a characteristic matrix constructed after processing each video segment key frame image; when the sound characteristics are generated, the influence of a silent section is fully considered, and different sound watermarks are generated in a sound section and the silent section; and performing exclusive or operation on the video characteristics and the voice watermark to obtain an audio and video matching zero watermark, and sending the audio and video matching zero watermark to a third-party copyright certification authority for registration and storage. The zero watermark generated by the method can be used for audio and video tamper detection and self copyright verification, and the matching certification of the video and the corresponding audio is realized. When any one of the audio and video to be verified is tampered, the zero watermark generated by the method can effectively prove that the audio and video to be verified is tampered.

title_en: Hijacking flow identification method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification discloses a hijacking flow identification method, a hijacking flow identification device and electronic equipment, wherein the method can be used for acquiring access data of a plurality of first access subjects related to flow to be identified in a first historical time period after receiving the flow to be identified, counting the access data, determining a time sequence formed by arranging values of at least one statistical index under the plurality of first access subjects in a preset period according to a time sequence, and obtaining a plurality of time sequences; constructing a feature matrix of the traffic to be identified based on the plurality of time sequences and inputting the feature matrix into a preset convolutional neural network to obtain an evaluation parameter of whether the traffic to be identified belongs to hijack traffic, wherein the preset convolutional neural network is obtained based on the feature matrix training of the sample traffic, and the construction mode of the feature matrix of the sample traffic is consistent with that of the feature matrix of the traffic to be identified; and finally, based on the evaluation parameters, whether the traffic to be identified belongs to hijacking traffic can be identified.

title_en: Distribution method, server and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a distribution method, a server and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when the historical performance consumption data set of at least one application server is acquired from the storage server, acquiring a corresponding relation set of time and performance consumption values of the at least one application server according to the historical performance consumption data set; when a data request sent by a client is received, determining a real-time performance consumption value set corresponding to at least one application server according to the current time and a corresponding relation set of the time and the performance consumption value; selecting an application server corresponding to the minimum real-time performance consumption value in the real-time performance consumption value set from at least one application server to obtain an optimal application server; and forwarding the data request to the optimal application server to complete the distribution of the data request. The distribution method provided by the embodiment of the invention improves the effect of load balancing.

title_en: Front-end camera real-time video-on-demand method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a front-end camera real-time video on demand method and device, electronic equipment, based on the method, a data server receives an http on demand request sent by a traffic police terminal, converts the http on demand request into an sip on demand request which can be identified by a front-end camera, synchronously processes an http state identifier corresponding to the http on demand request and an sip state identifier corresponding to the sip on demand request, sends the sip on demand request to a target camera, synchronously updates the identifier contents of the sip state identifier and the http state identifier according to the content of the sip on demand response returned by the front-end camera, generates a corresponding http on demand response to be returned to the traffic police terminal when the identifier contents meet preset conditions, the traffic police terminal can complete the whole on demand process only on a web browser or a platform without calling special SDK software, thereby ensuring the safety, and the http protocol is a general protocol, the convenience of video acquisition is improved.

title_en: Wireless communication method and user equipment
abstract_en: Aspects of the present application provide apparatus and methods for wireless communication. The apparatus includes processing circuitry that may select a first non-default and unevaluated urs rule as the evaluating urs rule, wherein the urs rule includes a traffic descriptor that matches an application triggered by the apparatus. The processing circuit may select a first unavaluated RSD that evaluates the urs rules as the evaluating RSD and determine whether the evaluating RSD includes at least one of an unsupported PDU session type, an unsupported SSC pattern, and an unsupported S-nsai. When it is determined that the evaluation RSD includes at least one of an unsupported PDU session type, an unsupported SSC pattern, and an unsupported S-nsai, the processing circuit determines whether the evaluation urs rule includes a second unavaluated RSD. When it is determined that the evaluation urs rule includes a second unavaluated RSD, the processing circuitry selects the second unavaluated RSD as the evaluation RSD. By using the present application, wireless communication can be performed more efficiently and accurately.

title_en: Intelligent key cabinet system based on Bluetooth communication and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent key cabinet system based on Bluetooth communication.A box body is provided with a control bin and at least one storage bin for storing keys, a hook is arranged in each storage bin, the keys are hung on the hooks through key rings, the hooks are connected with electric cylinders on the back surface in the storage bins through connecting rods, the electric cylinders push the hooks to extend out of or retract into the storage bins, a controller and a Bluetooth unit are fixed in the control bin, the controller is connected with each electric cylinder through a signal wire, and the controller is connected with a Bluetooth unit through a signal wire and is communicated with a mobile phone of a user through the Bluetooth unit. The invention has the functions of sensing and judging the key inside, has the function of receiving the receipt when the key is taken away and put back temporarily, is convenient for starting and closing the system through Bluetooth connection, controls the whole process, and can ensure the sequence and the process of operation work.

title_en: Uplink control data transmission
abstract_en: Disclosed is a UE and a method of interference randomization in the UE, comprising: encoding a set of control information bits including ACK/NACK bits to generate encoded control information bits; scrambling the encoded control information bits to generate scrambled control information bits; modulating the scrambled control information bits to generate modulation symbols; determining a Physical Uplink Control Channel (PUCCH) ACK/NACK resource index; determining a first orthogonal sequence index, a second orthogonal sequence index, and a cyclic shift for a demodulation reference signal (DMRS), wherein each of the first orthogonal sequence index, the second orthogonal sequence index, and the cyclic shift is determined based on the PUCCH ACK/NACK resource index; spreading the modulation symbols in a block manner using a first orthogonal sequence indicated by the first orthogonal sequence index and a second orthogonal sequence indicated by the second orthogonal sequence index; applying the cyclic shift to the DMRS; and transmitting the DMRS and the block-wise spread modulation symbols on a PUCCH.

title_en: Method and system for processing panoramic sensing data of transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for processing panoramic sensing data of a transformer substation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring monitoring data transmitted by each monitoring subsystem in the transformer substation according to a set communication protocol, and converting the monitoring data into a set uniform format; creating nodes according to the hierarchical structure of the transformer substation, forming an equipment tree, and binding monitoring data in the transformer substation on each node; and after the equipment in the transformer substation gives an alarm, automatically finding out the node of the equipment and all data bound by the node from the equipment tree. According to the invention, a panoramic fusion component model of the transformer substation is constructed, the trans-regional and trans-system data fusion of the transformer substation is realized, and the panoramic fusion component model comprises an auxiliary monitoring system, a comprehensive automation system, an online monitoring system, an inspection robot system, a video monitoring system, an integrated power supply system, a fire fighting system and the like, so that the problems of a plurality of transformer substation monitoring systems and ramparts in data are solved, and the working efficiency of inspection and overhaul personnel is improved.

title_en: Service access method, device and equipment in micro-service architecture
abstract_en: The application discloses a service access method in a micro-service architecture, which is applied to a gateway and comprises the following steps: when an object access request is received, determining a request service instance list corresponding to the object access request; acquiring all service instances from a registration center, and grouping the service instances according to the strategy configuration parameters of the service instances in all the service instances to obtain a grouped service instance list; determining a target service access linked list according to the strategy configuration parameters of each grouped service instance list and the request service instance list; and distributing the object access request to each target service instance in the target service access linked list. Therefore, the matching degree of the target service access linked list obtained according to the method and the object access request is higher, and therefore the accuracy and the efficiency of service access can be relatively improved. The application also discloses a service access device, equipment and a computer readable storage medium in the micro service architecture, which all have the beneficial effects.

title_en: Calculation migration method for cooperation between fog nodes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a computation migration method for cooperation among fog nodes. The method comprises the steps that a fog node receives a batch of computing tasks from a user application program, and a task allocation process of the fog node is triggered. The method comprises the steps that an edge controller receives task migration requests from one or more fog nodes and triggers a cooperative migration task allocation process of the edge controller. And after the fog node obtains the distribution result of each task, executing a task scheduling process. The migration method provided by the invention can shorten the response delay of the computing task, improve the resource utility of the edge computing system and enable the edge computing to meet the service quality requirement of the computing task.

title_en: Dynamic security protection method and system for industrial internet
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a dynamic security protection method and system for an industrial internet, and belongs to the technical field of the internet. The method comprises the steps of dynamically monitoring an intrusion request in real time, wherein the intrusion event comprises all access requests which cannot be identified by a server; determining whether a solution for protecting the intrusion request is stored, wherein a plurality of solutions for handling a plurality of types of intrusion requests are stored in the server in advance, and the solution is one of the plurality of solutions; if not, generating interference information, wherein the interference information comprises a null IP address; and sending the interference information to the intrusion information and sending alarm information. The method and the device can effectively reduce the probability of being invaded and save human resources.

title_en: Intelligent interactive multifunctional oiling machine and gas station system
abstract_en: The application discloses interactive multi-functional tanker aircraft of intelligence and filling station system, including two at least two rifle tax-control mainboards, through CAN bus protocol communication between each two rifle tax-control mainboards to gather the oil gun data to the input of keysets, the output of keysets passes through the RS232 agreement and transmits the treater of planting the Android system in to, the treater is used for showing the oil gun data to the user through graphical interface after receiving the oil gun data, the advantage of the invention is: simple structure has greatly promoted service function efficiency.

title_en: Barrage display method and device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bullet screen display method and device and a storage medium. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that a first barrage sent by a first account is obtained in the process that a playing client logged in by the first account plays a media file; acquiring a credit indication parameter of a first account and a value indication parameter of a first barrage, wherein the credit indication parameter is used for indicating the credit level of the first account, and the value indication parameter is used for indicating the association degree of the first barrage and a media file; and under the condition that the credit indication parameter is larger than the first target value and the value indication parameter is larger than the second target value, displaying the first barrage in the playing client. The invention solves the technical problem of low bullet screen display efficiency in the related technology.

title_en: Abnormality processing method and device based on online class, storage medium and terminal
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an abnormality processing method and device based on an online classroom, a storage medium and a terminal, and belongs to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the steps that a server monitors abnormal events occurring in a user terminal in an online classroom, determines the abnormal reasons of the abnormal events, determines corresponding abnormal processing guide information based on the abnormal reasons, and sends the abnormal processing guide information to the user terminal, or processes the abnormal events based on the abnormal reasons, so that the processing efficiency of the abnormal events occurring in the online classroom can be improved, and a user is helped to recover normal online teaching in time.

title_en: Network access relation display method and related equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a display method and related equipment of a network access relation, which belong to the technical field of networks, wherein the display method of the network access relation specifically comprises the steps of acquiring network characteristic data through a probe, wherein the network characteristic data comprises an IP access relation and a network index, and the IP access relation comprises a corresponding relation between an active access IP address and an accessed IP address; determining a target subnet containing an IP address in the IP access relation from a predefined subnet; according to the IP access relation, associating the target subnet to obtain a subnet access relation; and visually displaying the access relation of the sub-network in a display interface based on the network indexes. By the processing scheme, the complicated IP access relation in the network is converted into the corresponding subnet access relation, so that the access relation is greatly simplified, the subnet access relation is visually, conveniently and simply displayed, and the display effect is improved.

title_en: Signal processing method and related equipment
abstract_en: A signal processing method and related equipment are provided, wherein in the signal processing method, user equipment can obtain configuration information of a Received Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI) value for detecting signals on an unauthorized frequency; the configuration information comprises sampling parameter information corresponding to signals on the unauthorized frequency and at least one statistical window, wherein the sampling parameter information comprises a sampling interval; the user equipment samples the signal on the unauthorized frequency at the sampling interval and obtains the RSSI value of the signal on the unauthorized frequency at each sampling moment; the user equipment counts the RSSI value of each sampling moment of the signal on the unauthorized frequency, which is included by at least one counting window, and obtains the RSSI value counting result of the signal on the unauthorized frequency; and the user equipment reports the RSSI value statistical result of the signal on the unauthorized frequency to the base station. The method and the device can improve the accuracy of the RSSI value according to which the base station serving the user equipment selects the idle unauthorized frequency.

title_en: Intelligent advertising system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent advertisement system based on big data, which relates to the technical field of intelligent advertisements and solves the technical problems of low advertisement pushing precision and range in the prior art; the invention is provided with the information acquisition module, the preference weight coefficient is obtained by analyzing the search record and the browsing record on the user terminal, and the search keywords are classified according to the preference weight coefficient, so that the acquired data source is more accurate, and a foundation is laid for improving the efficiency and the precision of advertisement pushing; the advertisement publishing module is arranged, and the arranged and analyzed advertisements are orderly pushed to the user according to the preference label set by the information acquisition module, so that the advertisement pushing precision is ensured; the invention is provided with a data interaction module, and the data interaction module is arranged by analyzing the user and the contact person Exchange data between them, to contact people And the advertisement push is carried out, so that the advertisement propaganda range and the utilization efficiency of the advertisement are improved.

title_en: Visitor monitoring management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visitor monitoring management method and a visitor monitoring management system, wherein the visitor monitoring management method comprises the following steps: a mobile terminal of a visitor establishes close range communication connection with a verification device at a community door; the mobile terminal sends a network access request to the verification equipment; the verification equipment verifies the mobile terminal according to the mobile terminal information, and sends the address information of the server to the mobile terminal after the verification is passed; the mobile terminal establishes wireless connection with the server according to the address information of the server; the mobile terminal packs the mobile terminal information, the initial position information and the building information corresponding to the destination into a data packet and sends the data packet to the server; the server generates route information according to the initial position information in the data packet and the building information corresponding to the destination, and sends the route information to the mobile terminal; the mobile terminal displays the route information, performs navigation according to the route information, and sends the position information to the server in real time. The visitor can conveniently and quickly find the destination, and in addition, the whole-process tracking and monitoring of the visitor are realized.

title_en: Communication method, terminal equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a communication method, terminal equipment and a computer readable storage medium, which are applied to the technical field of communication, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that the terminal equipment determines that the connection between the terminal equipment and a first cell fails, wherein the first cell is a cell under first network equipment; the terminal equipment determines the signal quality of a second cell under second network equipment, and the first network equipment and the second network equipment both provide communication service for the terminal equipment; and if the signal quality of the second cell is greater than or equal to a first preset threshold value, the terminal equipment executes the connection recovery process of the terminal equipment and the first cell through the second cell. By implementing the embodiment of the application, the data interruption time of the terminal equipment can be reduced aiming at the situation of connection failure of the main base station of the terminal equipment.

title_en: Voice processing method, device, storage medium and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a voice processing method, apparatus, storage medium and terminal device, the method comprising: acquiring audio data in real time, and storing target audio data acquired within a preset time period; performing voice activity detection on first audio data acquired in a target time period, and determining a first environmental state of a terminal device in the target time period, wherein the target time period is a time period within the preset time period, and the environmental state comprises a quiet state and a non-quiet state; performing acoustic processing on the audio data collected in real time if it is determined that the first environmental state is the non-quiet state. That is to say, the audio data collected in real time can be acoustically processed only when the terminal device is determined to be in a non-quiet state in the target time period, so that the processing load of an acoustic processing module of the terminal device in the quiet state can be reduced, the CPU occupation can be reduced, and the power consumption of the terminal device can be reduced.

title_en: DPDK frame-based DDS data transmission diagnosis method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a DDS data transmission diagnosis method and a DDS data transmission diagnosis system based on a DPDK frame, which comprises the steps of constructing a DDS diagnosis tool based on the DPDK frame and accessing a DDS data transmission network; in a DDS diagnosis tool, constructing three threads of receiving, sending and diagnosing DDS data, and pre-distributing a message sharing queue; the DDS diagnosis tool circularly reads DDS data messages from the network access port, copies DDS characteristic messages and puts the DDS characteristic messages into a pre-distributed message sharing queue for diagnosis processing. The invention adopts the user mode data forwarding framework of DPDK, and realizes the diagnosis and monitoring of DDS data transmission on the premise of not influencing the normal communication of the vehicle-mounted Ethernet DDS.

title_en: Method and system for controlling access request related to screen projection equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for controlling an access request related to screen projection equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a home region of a user equipment and an identifier of a screen projection device associated with the user equipment; when the authentication states of the user equipment and the screen projection equipment are determined to be successful, acquiring dynamic information of the user equipment, and acquiring attribute information and current setting of the screen projection equipment; when the home region of the user equipment is matched with the equipment position, determining whether the screen projection equipment allows access according to the current setting; when access is allowed, when the distance between the current position and the equipment position is smaller than or equal to a distance threshold value, the data message is forwarded to screen projection equipment, so that the screen projection equipment is prompted to generate a response message according to the data message; and sending the response message to the user equipment to prompt the user equipment to establish data connection with the screen projection equipment according to the response message, so that the screen projection equipment is accessed.

title_en: Password management method based on secure hardware
abstract_en: The invention discloses a password management method based on secure hardware, which comprises the secure hardware and a password management APP, wherein the secure hardware comprises an encryption chip and a TurboNFC communication chip; the encryption chip is a trusted platform module and is used as an independent device for generating a secret key and encrypting and decrypting the secret key, and the encryption chip is internally provided with an independent processor and a safe storage unit for storing the secret key and the characteristic data and providing encryption and safe authentication service functions for the password management APP; the password management APP transmits data through asymmetric encryption communication and an encryption chip, and the TurboNFC communication chip is responsible for data transmission and conversion of communication modes; the password management APP provides the needed account number and password management for the user; the invention can effectively improve the safety of the password management APP.

title_en: Data transmission method, device, base station, network node and communication equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a data transmission method, a device, a base station, a network node and communication equipment, wherein the data transmission method comprises the following steps: determining whether to start relay reverse mapping between the target node and the adjacent node according to the capability information between the target node and the adjacent node; if yes, sending relay reverse mapping enabling information to the target node; wherein the capability information includes uplink and downlink reachability information and/or load information between the target node and a neighboring node. The scheme can support and realize signaling interaction between the relay nodes, so that uplink and downlink transmission adopts the same load to return the relay link for mapping, thereby fully utilizing the reciprocity of wireless channels; and replace the control plane signalling through the user plane channel associated signalling, reduce the signalling overhead between relay node or terminal and the donor base station and reduce and map the time delay of changing; the problem of signaling resource waste caused by incapability of signaling interaction among relay nodes in the prior art is well solved.

title_en: User plane migration method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a user plane migration method, a device and a storage medium, wherein the user plane migration method comprises the following steps: and the service gateway control plane function reselects the service gateway user plane function and sends the indication information of the selected target service gateway user plane function to the mobile management entity or the service general packet radio service support node. The scheme provided by the embodiment can avoid the TA List plan modification, saves the address resource of the S11 port, greatly reduces the logic complexity of the SGW-C implementation, has no need of splitting the resource, can be completely shared, and effectively avoids the problem of operation collaborative planning.

title_en: Carrier phase recovery method and system based on Q power polarity judgment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carrier phase recovery method and a system based on Q power polarity judgment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing Q power operation and phase rotation on the received signal after phase compensation, and then performing power detection; selecting a signal with larger power after rotation to carry out polarity judgment, and calculating a phase offset signal; and calculating a phase compensation signal of the received signal at the next moment according to the phase deviation signal, and performing phase compensation on the received signal at the next moment by using the phase compensation signal. Compared with a polar ring based on Q power, the method improves the frequency offset capture range and noise immunity; compared with a PD algorithm, the method can be suitable for QPSK, 8PSK, 16APSK and other constant amplitude modulation modes; compared with the DD algorithm, the frequency offset acquisition range is improved.

title_en: Identification method based on instantaneous feature aerial analog signal
abstract_en: The invention discloses an identification method based on instantaneous characteristic aerial analog signals, which comprises the following steps: step S1, erecting a receiving antenna and selecting a receiving frequency band; setting a central frequency, selecting an acquisition bandwidth, initializing monitoring equipment, acquiring required monitoring data and storing the acquired monitoring data in a memory of the current monitoring equipment; step S2, acquiring the time domain sampling sequence of the current monitoring equipment in the step S1; step S3, performing preprocessing such as filtering on the data acquired in step S2; step S4, calculating the instantaneous characteristic sequence of the signal; step S5, the signal modulation pattern is identified, the peak value and the peak-to-average ratio of the spectrum are obtained, and the patterns of the CW, AM, and FM signals are distinguished according to the obtained values. The invention provides an identification method based on instantaneous characteristic aerial analog signals, which has the advantages of strong anti-interference performance, simple algorithm implementation, small calculated amount and high identification accuracy rate which can reach more than 85 percent, and can be widely applied to the fields of communication, radio monitoring and management and the like.

title_en: Micropower wireless access method and device for power transmission and transformation equipment internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a micropower wireless access method and a micropower wireless access device for the Internet of things of power transmission and transformation equipment, and the method relates to the processes of time synchronization, service channel access, control channel configuration information access and burst information access; in time synchronization, the sink node determines parameters such as delay according to the time slot of the service information randomly sent by the sensing terminal, and the sensing terminal adjusts the sending time of the corresponding frame according to the parameters; the service channel access process adopts a mode mainly of unidirectional reporting, so that the working time of the sensor is minimized; limited two-way communication is realized on the control channel, parameter configuration such as sensor period, threshold value and the like is supported, a retransmission mechanism is supported on the control channel aiming at important alarm information, and the reliability of alarm service is improved. The invention can provide standardized access for the equipment state perception sensor with high frequency, small data volume and low power consumption of the power transmission and transformation equipment Internet of things, and can meet the requirements of long service life and maintenance-free operation of the micro-power consumption sensor.

title_en: Transmission method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a transmission method and a transmission device, and belongs to the technical field of wireless communication. The transmission method is used for a first node or a third node and comprises the following steps: acquiring information of a fifth time-frequency resource, and executing at least one of the following operations on the fifth time-frequency resource: indicating or configuring whether a second node transmits in the fifth time-frequency resource, wherein the second node is a next-level node of the first node; indicating that the fifth time-frequency resource is used for transmission by the first node or transmission by the second node; not expecting the second node to transmit on the fifth time-frequency resource; not scheduling the second node to transmit on the fifth time-frequency resource; not configuring the second node to transmit on the fifth time-frequency resource. By the technical scheme of the invention, the problem of resource overlapping or transceiving conflict can not occur when the IAB transmits.

title_en: Cross-cluster routing forwarding method and system for message
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-cluster routing forwarding method and a system of messages, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the server side obtains a written routing rule configuration record in the distributed coordination system; the server side converts the routing rule configuration record into a corresponding routing rule executor by using a routing rule resolver in the Topic; the server side performs routing rule matching on the message needing routing in the Topic by using the routing rule executor to obtain a routing cluster list corresponding to the message; and the server forwards the message to the corresponding cluster by using the route duplicator in the Topic according to the route cluster list. The cross-cluster routing forwarding system of the message provided by the invention adopts the cross-cluster routing forwarding method of the message, and realizes cross-cluster routing replication forwarding of the message by relying on a distributed coordination system to perform routing rule configuration at the server, thereby avoiding the consumption of extra computing resources and reducing the maintenance cost.

title_en: Physical uplink control channel repetition configuration
abstract_en: Various aspects of the present disclosure generally relate to wireless communications. In some aspects, a user equipment may determine a physical uplink control channel repetition parameter based at least in part on a downlink control information message associated with an indication of a physical uplink control channel resource configuration. The user equipment may transmit a transmission set of physical uplink control channels based at least in part on the physical uplink control channel repetition parameter. Numerous other aspects are provided.

title_en: Automatic configuration method of bus node identifier and bus network system
abstract_en: The application discloses an automatic configuration method of a bus node identifier and a bus network system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: under the condition of receiving a voltage or current source signal output by a previous node, processing the voltage or the current source signal to obtain a node voltage of any slave node; and determining the identifier of any slave node according to the obtained node voltage, the stored identifier and the corresponding relation table of the node voltage. The identifier of the slave node is determined through the obtained node voltage, the stored identifier and the corresponding relation table of the node voltage; the configuration of the node identifier is completely self-adaptive, additional processing is not needed, the flexibility in application is strong, and the maintenance work of products at the later stage is facilitated; the configuration of the slave nodes is the same, the batch application is convenient, and the maintenance cost is reduced.

title_en: Program information publishing method, system, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a program publishing method, a system, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving a program issuing instruction; identifying a plurality of corresponding terminals and the number of the terminals according to the program issuing instruction; dividing the terminals into a first class terminal and a second class terminal according to the number of the terminals; acquiring a first instruction corresponding to a first type terminal in the program issuing instruction, acquiring a corresponding first type program data packet according to a program identifier carried by the first instruction, and sending the first type program data packet to the first type terminal; acquiring a second instruction corresponding to the second type terminal and caching the second instruction into a queue; reading a second instruction in the queue at regular time, and acquiring a corresponding second type program data packet according to a program identifier carried by the second instruction; and sending the second type program data packet to a second type terminal. According to the invention, the corresponding terminal is shunted after the instruction is received, and the instruction corresponding to the shunted terminal is processed in batches, so that the efficiency of issuing the program information is improved, and the server is prevented from being crashed due to excessive instruction data.

title_en: Video processing method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a video processing method and a video processing device, which are used for quickly and repeatedly marking a target object in a video. The method comprises the following steps: determining a first frame image where a target object is located in a video to be processed, and determining a first area where the target object is located on the first frame image; labeling the target object in the first area, and displaying a first labeling result; judging whether the target object in the first area on a second frame of image in the video to be processed changes or not; the second frame image is a next frame image of the first frame image; if so, labeling the target object in the second frame image, and displaying a second labeling result.

title_en: Radio frequency index measuring method and device
