abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a radio frequency index measuring method and a radio frequency index measuring device, which are applied to a server, wherein the server is connected with acquisition equipment through a network, and the method comprises the following steps: sending a signal acquisition command to the acquisition equipment to control the acquisition equipment to acquire a radio frequency signal to an antenna to be detected; the radio frequency signals comprise at least two different network standard signals, and the at least two different network standard signals comprise 5G network standard signals; receiving the radio frequency signal uploaded by the acquisition equipment; separating the received radio frequency signals to obtain each network standard signal in the radio frequency signals; and calculating the radio frequency index of each network system signal transmitted by the antenna to be tested according to each network system signal obtained by separation. The embodiment of the invention can improve the testing efficiency and reduce the testing cost.

title_en: Serial communication system and link switching method applied to same
abstract_en: The system comprises a Master node and n Slave nodes which are sequentially connected in series through a physical link, and also comprises n-1 Switch modules and n-1 bypass links, wherein the n-1 Switch modules are respectively connected with the first n-1 Slave nodes one by one; the mth Slave node is connected with an input link and an output link of the mth Slave node to form a first connection corresponding to the mth Slave node, the mth Switch module is connected with the mth bypass link, the mth bypass link is connected with the input link and the output link of the mth Slave node to form a second connection corresponding to the mth bypass link, m is greater than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to n-1, and m and n are positive integers; the mth Switch module is configured to: and when the m-th Slave node is detected to work abnormally, switching the first connection to the second connection. The invention can bypass the middle node with fault in the serial communication system, and the back end node of the middle node with fault can still keep communication with the Master node.

title_en: Techniques for communicating synchronization signal timing information
abstract_en: Techniques for communicating synchronization signal timing information are provided, where the described techniques may be implemented as a wireless communication method in which timing information in a wireless communication network is mapped to a signal. The timing information includes information related to a synchronization signal block index, and the signal includes at least one of a reference signal and a synchronization signal on a broadcast channel. The signal is transmitted by including at least a portion of information related to a synchronization signal block index.

title_en: Transmission control device, transmission control method, reception control device, and reception control method
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a transmission control apparatus, a transmission control method, a reception control apparatus, and a reception control method. Provided is a technique capable of processing desired data in a receiving-side communication device even when a sequence number space is shared between a plurality of data transmitted from the transmitting-side communication device. [ solution ] to provide a transmission control device provided with: a communication control unit that controls transmission of a plurality of data each including a serial number; and a data generating unit that generates, as information indicating one or more data to be processed in a receiving apparatus among the plurality of data, number information indicating a sequence number included in each of the one or more data to be processed, wherein the communication control unit controls transmission of the number information to the receiving apparatus.

title_en: Multi-network access method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-network access method and a multi-network access device. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: when one or more appointed special networks in a plurality of different project special networks are accessed, determining an IP address in an access request, wherein the IP address is used for network access; converting the IP address into a private IP address of a specified special network through a virtual router; and accessing the specified special network through the virtual network card and the private IP address. The invention solves the technical problems that multiple network cards and IPs are needed for multi-network access and the configuration is complex.

title_en: Method and apparatus for internet contents push service in wireless mobile communication system
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide methods, apparatus and computer programs for content push services in a wireless mobile communication system. In one embodiment, the method comprises: receiving an active push service request from an internet content provider; determining an active push policy based on predetermined assistance information for network optimization processing for the active push service request; and sending a command for an active push service to at least one network element in the wireless mobile communication system, such that at least a portion of the internet content specified by the active push service request is actively pushed to the one or more users based on the determined active push policy.

title_en: Antenna weight optimization method and device, computing equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of wireless communication, and discloses an antenna weight optimization method, an antenna weight optimization device, computing equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring minimization drive test data reported by a terminal in a three-dimensional multi-input multi-output cell; calculating antenna weight scores under different antenna weights of the three-dimensional multi-input multi-output cell according to the minimization drive test data; and sorting the antenna weight scores under different antenna weights, and taking the antenna weight with the highest antenna weight score as the optimal antenna weight. Through the mode, the embodiment of the invention realizes the antenna weight optimization by applying the MDT data, has short data collection period, saves the network optimization cost and improves the 3D-MIMO cell optimization efficiency.

title_en: User authentication method, user authentication equipment and user authentication system
abstract_en: The application provides a user authentication method, user authentication equipment and a user authentication system, which comprise the following steps: the method comprises the steps of receiving user biological characteristic information of a user to be authenticated and an identity verification account input by the user to be authenticated, which are acquired by a target application platform, detecting whether the user biological characteristic information is consistent with verification biological information associated with the identity verification account, if the user biological characteristic information is consistent with the verification biological information associated with the identity verification account, determining that the user to be authenticated passes verification, and returning verification passing information to the target application platform so that the target application platform allows the user to be authenticated to log in the target application platform. Therefore, the identity authentication account is a character string which is distributed by the user authentication equipment and does not contain the real information of the user, so that the target application platform cannot acquire the real information of the user in the authentication process, the condition that the real information of the user is leaked is avoided, and the safety of the real information of the user is improved.

title_en: Communication method, device and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a communication method, a device and a system, belonging to the field of communication. The method comprises the steps that a first forwarding node receives a first service message, the first forwarding node is other nodes except for an end node, the other nodes pass through a transmission tunnel, the transmission tunnel is a tunnel used for transmitting the first service message, the first forwarding node obtains the retention time of the first service message in the first forwarding node, and the first forwarding node sends a second service message which comprises the retention time. By adopting the scheme of the application, the accuracy of calculating the transmission time of the service message can be improved, so that the change value of the transmission time of the service message received by the power equipment each time on the transmission tunnel is ensured not to exceed the preset threshold value.

title_en: Multi-beam satellite-borne AIS signal receiving system and method based on time modulation super surface
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-beam satellite-borne AIS signal receiving system and method based on a time modulation super surface, which comprises the following steps: a time-modulated super-surface and 1-bit coded cells on the surface; the AIS signal receiving device comprises a feed source, a low noise amplifier, a frequency mixer and a local oscillator which are connected in sequence, wherein the AIS signal receiving device is used for carrying out low noise amplification and down conversion on the received AIS signal and then converting the AIS signal into a digital domain; the low-pass filter and the analog-to-digital converter are sequentially connected, the phase of the one-bit coding unit on the time modulation super surface is controlled and periodically modulated, and the received AIS signal is filtered and demodulated, so that simultaneous multi-beam reconnaissance of the AIS signal is realized. The invention reduces the realization difficulty of the satellite-borne large-aperture antenna, and the AIS cells covered by each independent wave beam are isolated through space/frequency, thereby reducing the time slot conflict probability of the satellite-borne AIS signal interception and realizing high interception probability.

title_en: Method and apparatus for random access channel preamble design in non-terrestrial network communications
abstract_en: Methods and apparatus relating to Random Access Channel (RACH) preamble design in non-terrestrial network (NTN) communications of user equipment and network devices are described. The device may initiate a RACH procedure. The apparatus may determine a fractional frequency offset pattern or coverage code across a set of preamble sequences. The apparatus may generate the RACH preamble signal according to at least one of a fractional frequency offset pattern and a cover code. The apparatus may transmit a RACH preamble signal to a network node. According to the method and the device for designing the random access channel preamble in the non-terrestrial network communication, provided by the invention, the conflict/correlation of adjacent sequences can be reduced, and the resource inefficiency can be avoided.

title_en: Driving behavior reminding method and device, cloud server and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a driving behavior reminding method and device, a cloud server and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of intelligent auxiliary reminding and driving behavior reminding. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: receiving a road section driving strategy acquisition request sent by a vehicle, wherein the road section driving strategy acquisition request comprises a voice instruction and a code of the vehicle; when the voice command is matched with the preset voice command, positioning the vehicle according to the code to obtain the current position information of the vehicle; acquiring a road section driving strategy corresponding to the current position information, and generating prompt information corresponding to the road section driving strategy; and sending the prompt message to the vehicle to enable the vehicle to provide the prompt message to the user. The method can intelligently provide the best driving suggestion of the user, and improves the driving experience of the user, so that the driving is safer and more reasonable, and the loss of the vehicle is reduced.

title_en: Handover request with network information
abstract_en: Apparatuses, methods, and systems for sending and/or receiving a handover request with network information are disclosed. A method (1000) includes sending (1002) a handover request to a target device. The handover request includes: first information indicating that a source communication network corresponding to a source device cannot support a predetermined quality of service; and second information corresponding to a capacity of the source communication network. The method (1000) includes receiving (1004) a response to the handover request.

title_en: Identity verification system, method and platform
abstract_en: The application provides an identity authentication system, method and platform, wherein the identity authentication system comprises: the terminal is used for sending an access request to the service system; the service system is used for sending the service identifier to the identity verification platform; and the identity verification platform is used for determining a corresponding verification type according to the service identifier sent by the service system, calling a corresponding verification rule according to the verification type, verifying the verification information input by the user according to the corresponding verification rule and sending a verification result to the terminal. According to the identity authentication system, the coupling degree between the service system and the authentication rules is reduced through the identity authentication platform, the service system is connected into the identity authentication platform, any one or more authentication types in the identity authentication platform can be used according to service requirements, the service system can conveniently set the authentication types of the services, and the services are authenticated through the unified identity authentication system, so that unified user experience is provided.

title_en: Ethernet data transmission circuit, system and Ethernet data transmission method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an Ethernet data transmission circuit, an Ethernet data transmission system and an Ethernet data transmission method, which relate to the technical field of communication, and on one hand, the security of the Ethernet in the transmission process can be improved; on the other hand, without increasing the workload of the encoder, the polarity processing circuit of the ethernet data transmission circuit may be used to process the ethernet data into the preset polarity for encoding by the encoder. An ethernet data transmission circuit comprising: the polarity processing circuit is configured to process the polarity carried by the Ethernet data into a preset polarity; the encoder is configured to receive the Ethernet data and the preset polarity carried by the Ethernet data and encode the Ethernet data.

title_en: Method, device and storage medium for monitoring running state of peer
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method, a device and a storage medium for monitoring the running state of a peer, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that a routing device obtains address family information of a first peer and address information of the first peer; the routing device sends a notification message to a server, wherein the notification message carries address family information of the first peer and address information of the first peer, so that the server stores the running state of the first peer according to the address family information of the first peer, the address information of the first peer and the type of the notification message. By placing address family information of the corresponding peer in the message, the peer information monitored by the scheme can be more definite and more reliable; and the peer state change processing mode of a single address family is more convenient and faster to normalize.

title_en: Intelligent recorder safety protection method, system and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety protection method, a system and a computer readable storage medium of an intelligent oscillograph, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining first remote access information; obtaining first account information according to the first remote access information; obtaining first user information according to the first account information; obtaining first position information of a first user at a first time; obtaining second position information of the first user at a second time; obtaining a third time according to the first time and the second time, wherein the third time is the interval time between the first time and the second time; inputting the first position information, the second position information and the third time into a convolutional neural network model to obtain first output information of the convolutional neural network model; and judging whether to permit the first remote access information to be accessed or not according to the first output information. The invention solves the technical problem that the information verification of the remote access oscillograph is not safe and accurate enough in the prior art.

title_en: Abnormality prevention control system, monitoring device, and abnormality prevention control method
abstract_en: In an abnormality prevention control system for a time-triggered communication system in-vehicle network, a 1 st error monitoring device includes: a 1 st frame transmitting/receiving unit that receives a frame flowing through an in-vehicle network; and a 1 st error detection unit configured to transmit an error notification frame for notifying that an error has occurred in the frame, when detecting that an error has occurred in the frame received by the 1 st frame transmission/reception unit, wherein each of the 2 nd error monitoring devices includes: a 2 nd frame transmitting/receiving unit that receives the error notification frame; and a 2 nd error detection unit which, when an error in its own branch is not detected with respect to the frame in which an error has occurred included in the received error notification frame, sets the frame as an invalidation target frame, and shifts one or more 2 nd error monitoring devices to an invalidation mode for invalidating reception of the frame that follows.

title_en: Design and implementation of micro front end in construction of Beiyin financial scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of financial scenes, in particular to design and implementation of a micro front end in the construction of a Bei Yin Jin scene, which comprises a dynamic route, a route configuration information design, a sub-engineering interface design module, a multiplexing scheme design, a flow scheme design and a deployment scheme; dynamic routing: use of reach-Router; designing routing configuration information: after the dynamic loading scheme is determined, the base engineering needs to know the resource path of the sub-engineering, then loads the corresponding JS and CSS resources, and makes a set of mapping information, that is, the unique identifier of the service line is Key, and the corresponding static resource address is Value.

title_en: Sensitive data determination method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for determining sensitive data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a network data packet sent by a data providing party to a data acquiring party or mirror image flow of the network data packet; analyzing the network data packet or the mirror flow of the network data packet to obtain data provided by a data provider; determining whether the data comprises sensitive data according to a sensitive data feature library; and if the data is the sensitive data, determining the storage position of the sensitive data at the data provider, so that the problem that the storage position of the sensitive data cannot be accurately defined in the related technology can be solved, confirming whether the data returned by the data provider to the data acquirer contains the sensitive data, and confirming the storage position of the sensitive data.

title_en: Block chain multi-chain layered collaborative technology system
abstract_en: The invention protects a block chain multi-chain layered collaborative technology system, and relates to the technical field of block chains, wherein a master-slave multi-chain model of a block chain is established, different consensus mechanisms are adopted for constructing a master chain and a slave chain, and a base layer, a topology layer, a consensus layer and an application layer of the block chain are processed in a layered mode, so that a more bottom-layer PBFT plus 1^ 1 facing a distributed file system is improved, the system is more suitable for a transaction-facing block chain system, and a high-throughput, low-delay, high-efficiency and energy-saving consensus algorithm is designed.

title_en: Access looping rate algorithm processing method for 5GSPN bearing CRAN
abstract_en: The number of 5G base stations is respectively counted through two dimensions, namely SPN large convergent point dimension and SPN access ring dimension, so that PTN/SPN overall planning is facilitated to be promoted, and the access ring forming rate of the SPN bearing CRAN reaches 100% to support the rapid development of 5G services.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted unit management method and system based on preinstalled and step-by-step information writing
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle-mounted unit management method and system based on preassembly and step-by-step information writing, which support the vehicle-mounted unit to be installed during vehicle production, and users only need to write information in the vehicle-mounted unit in a distributed manner after purchasing a vehicle, so that the vehicle-mounted unit can be handled conveniently. Meanwhile, the safety scheme is utilized to ensure the safety of all application scenes of the pre-installed OBU.

title_en: Method for reducing energy consumption, mobile terminal and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for reducing energy consumption, a mobile terminal and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method for reducing energy consumption comprises the following steps: when an application program running in the background requests networking, detecting whether the networking times of the application program in a first preset duration are greater than preset times or not; if the networking times of the application program in the first preset time period are greater than the preset times, detecting whether the geographic position of the terminal is changed or not; and if the geographic position of the terminal is not changed, stopping running the application program. According to the invention, when the background running application program requests networking, whether the networking is allowed or not is determined based on two factors of the networking frequency and whether the position of the mobile terminal is changed, so that the application processor is prevented from being frequently awakened, and the power consumption of the mobile terminal is saved.

title_en: Receiver and method of operating a receiver to process a preamble of a data packet
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a receiver and a method of operating a receiver to process a preamble of a data packet. An improved receiver is used in packet communications where the process of configuring the gain of the receiver and identifying the preamble in the packet becomes more robust. The improved receiver does not need to rely on the received power level exceeding the trigger threshold to initiate gain control. Instead, the gain control operates while the receiver is waiting for a data packet. The frequency correction process may run simultaneously with the gain control process.

title_en: OTA upgrade package acquisition method, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the field of Internet of vehicles and discloses an OTA upgrade package acquisition method, electronic equipment and a storage medium. In the invention, the method for acquiring the OTA upgrade package comprises the following steps: acquiring an encryption package, a first encryption key and a second key from an over-the-air OTA platform; the first encryption key is the encrypted first key, the first key is the hash value of the OTA upgrade package, and the encryption package is the encrypted OTA upgrade package; decrypting the first encryption key by using the second secret key to obtain a first secret key; and decrypting the encrypted packet by using the first secret key to obtain the OTA upgrade packet. The invention can avoid the problem of verification failure caused by unstable network during networking verification and reduce the requirement of a decryption process on the terminal equipment.

title_en: Four-dimensional chaotic circuit device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a four-dimensional chaotic circuit, which comprises a first operational amplifier, a first analog multiplier, a third analog multiplier, a first resistor, a seventeen resistor, a first capacitor, a fourth capacitor and a direct current power supply, wherein the first operational amplifier, the second analog multiplier, the third analog multiplier, the fourth resistor and the direct current power supply form an X signal channel, a Y signal channel, a Z signal channel, a W signal channel and a W signal channel; in the first to third analog multipliers, a first input end of the first analog multiplier is connected with a-Y signal output end, a second input end of the first analog multiplier is connected with a Z signal output end, both the first input end and the second input end of the second analog multiplier are connected with the Y signal output end, a first input end of the third analog multiplier is connected with a-X signal output end, and a second input end of the third analog multiplier is connected with the Z signal output end. The invention realizes a four-dimensional chaotic circuit through the primary term, the secondary cross term and the constant term, and has important significance for the chaotic system in the information engineering fields of communication encryption, radar encryption, electronic countermeasure and the like.

title_en: Network function chain deployment method, device, terminal device and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a network function chain deployment method, which comprises the steps of receiving a deployment request of a network function chain, obtaining topology information of a plurality of nodes for deploying the virtual network function, establishing an objective function with the shortest end-to-end time delay, wherein the objective function meets the reliability constraint of the nodes, the resource capacity constraint of the nodes and the reliability constraint of links when the virtual network function is deployed, and when the network function chain is deployed, the nodes meeting the objective function are searched for deployment according to the deployment information carried by the virtual network function and the topology information of the plurality of nodes, so that the reliability of transmission can be effectively guaranteed while the low-time delay network service request is met. The embodiment of the invention also correspondingly provides a network function chain deployment device, terminal equipment and a storage medium.

title_en: Chaotic mapping-based low-complexity selective mapping method improvement method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chaos mapping-based low-complexity selective mapping method improvement method, which uses two times of chaos mapping to generate a random grouping sequence and a random phase sequence, and the random grouping sequence and the random phase sequence are respectively used for randomly grouping OFDM subcarriers and replacing the original conventional random phase sequence in an SLM. Due to the characteristics of the chaos mapping such as sensitivity to initial values, randomness of results and the like, the method is very suitable for improving the SLM, and meanwhile, the safety of the OFDM system can be improved. The invention increases randomness, reduces the complexity of the system, solves the problem of insufficient phase sequence, reduces the information amount of sideband information redundancy, reduces PAPR and improves transmission efficiency.

title_en: Multi-source heterogeneous IoT (Internet of things) equipment data unified access and storage system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a uniform data access and storage system for multi-source heterogeneous IoT equipment, which comprises an edge server without a public network IP, a cloud proxy server with the public network IP, an intelligent home gateway and various intelligent home terminals with different communication protocols, wherein the edge server, the cloud proxy server, the intelligent home gateway and the intelligent home terminals are communicated in sequence; the edge server and the cloud proxy server are both provided with databases; the invention also discloses a method for uniformly accessing and storing the multi-source heterogeneous IoT equipment data by using the system, and an intelligent home terminal detects the home environment and personnel state data of the user; the intelligent home gateway receives detection data of multiple access protocols from the intelligent home terminal, converts the detection data into detection data matched with the access protocols of the cloud proxy server and sends the detection data to the cloud proxy server; and the cloud proxy server distributes the detection data to the edge server matched with the house address of the user. The invention can support data transmission and storage of 'multi-user-multi-source equipment-multi-edge server'.

title_en: Audio system control method, device, terminal and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: An audio system control method includes: when the target application program is detected to stop playing, acquiring a first reference condition of an audio stream contained in an audio system; obtaining a control instruction corresponding to the audio system based on a first reference condition of the audio stream; and controlling the audio system to respond to the control instruction.

title_en: Capability interaction method and device, and interaction triggering method and device
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a capability interaction method, which is applicable to a base station, and the method comprises the following steps: and the capability information is interacted with the core network to solve the problem of multi-card communication conflict in the terminal. According to the method and the device, the core network can determine the capability of the base station for solving the multi-card communication conflict problem in the terminal and the capability of the base station for solving the multi-card communication conflict problem in the terminal, so that the core network and the base station can cooperate to solve the communication conflict problem for the terminal more comprehensively.

title_en: Service transmission method and device, computer readable storage medium and electronic device
abstract_en: The invention provides a service transmission method and device, a computer readable storage medium and an electronic device, wherein the service transmission method comprises the following steps: respectively introducing multiple groups of service data contained in service flow into a first processing path corresponding to each group of service data according to first identification information for processing so as to respectively obtain packet data obtained after processing each group of service data; and sending the plurality of packet data to a receiving side so that the receiving side can acquire the service flow according to the packet data. The invention can solve the problem that networking equipment is too complex due to the influence of a service transmission mode in the networking process in the related technology, thereby achieving the effect of reducing the networking complexity.

title_en: Modularized electric energy meter communication method and modularized electric energy meter applying same
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a communication method of a modularized electric energy meter, which comprises the following steps: configuring a communication address and a logic address for a module in the modularized electric energy meter; storing a module information list of each module logic address in the management module; transmitting a communication frame to a plurality of modularized electric energy meters at an external device; when the communication address of the management module in a certain electric energy meter is matched with the communication address in the communication frame, determining that the external equipment requests the modularized electric energy meter for communication; searching a module corresponding to a logical address in a communication frame sent by external equipment in a module information list; finally, judging whether the module to be communicated is a management module, if so, sending response data to the external equipment by the management module; if not, the management module forwards the communication frame to the module to be communicated, the module to be communicated transmits the response data to the management module, and the management module forwards the response data to the external equipment. In the method, the communication between each module and the external equipment is realized without adding a communication interface.

title_en: Method for music collection by using Bluetooth headset
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for collecting music by using a Bluetooth headset, which comprises the Bluetooth headset and Bluetooth master equipment, wherein a Bluetooth module arranged in the Bluetooth headset sends out a communication signal, the Bluetooth master equipment is used for searching the communication signal, Bluetooth connection is established between the communication signal and the Bluetooth headset, music is played by a music application program on the Bluetooth master equipment, the played music is output to the Bluetooth headset from a headset end, and a music collection key is arranged on the Bluetooth headset. According to the invention, the music collection key is arranged on the Bluetooth headset worn by the user, in the process of listening to songs, the collection command is sent to the Bluetooth master device by pressing the collection key of the Bluetooth headset, the Bluetooth master device sends the collection command to the Bluetooth headset after receiving the command and completing the music collection event, and the user does not need to open a music application program on the Bluetooth master device to collect favorite music, so that the music collection device is very convenient to use.

title_en: Application identifier set configuration method, device, apparatus and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application identifier set configuration method, equipment, a device and a medium, comprising the following steps: determining an interested management information base application identification set and an authorized destination address service set; configuring the set of management information base application identifications and the authorized destination address service set into: the management information base application identification set is equal to the application identification set corresponding to the authorized destination address service set, or the management information base application identification set is a subset of the application identification set corresponding to the authorized destination address service set. By adopting the invention, the management information base can not maintain an invalid application identification entity, and the network layer and the application layer can not carry out useless entity maintenance. Further, the protocol behavior, interface configuration goals and implementation schemes are also specified for this problem.

title_en: Effective route origin synchronization method and system based on fact ownership
abstract_en: The invention discloses an effective route origin synchronization method and system based on fact ownership, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the route source information of the BGP route of the AS initiates synchronous update to the VC server; the VC server extracts and records the updated data of the incremental routing source meeting the preset observation period conditions and sends the updated data to the data aggregation management server; the data aggregation management server processes the updated data of the incremental routing source sent by each VC server and sends the processed information to the relying party server for summarizing; and the relying party server updates the global routing source information table and forwards the global routing source information table to the VC server connected with the relying party server through each data aggregation management server, so that global consistency of data is realized. The method of the invention can accurately judge whether the information of a certain routing source is effective or not by improving the processes of collecting, judging, synchronizing and the like of the effective routing source information on the premise of not influencing the conventional RPKI mechanism.

title_en: Data processing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure discloses a data processing method, relates to the field of data processing, and particularly relates to the field of live data processing. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring interactive data of at least one aspect generated in the playing process of a video in a live broadcast room; calculating the interaction amount of each aspect of the live broadcast room based on the interaction data of each aspect of the at least one aspect; and carrying out statistical analysis on the interaction amount of each aspect of the live broadcast room in a preset time period. The present disclosure also discloses a data processing apparatus, an electronic device, and a storage medium.

title_en: Method and system for transferring SIM card information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for managing historical SIM card activity information in a first server. When a first request message is received from a first device, it is determined whether historical SIM card activity information for the SIM card is found in a database. If historical SIM card activity information for the SIM card is found, it is determined whether the database has been updated within a predefined time period. If no historical SIM card activity information for the SIM card is found or the database has not been updated within a predefined time period. Sending a second request message to a service provider of the SIM card. Receiving historical SIM card activity information for the SIM card from the service provider. Storing historical SIM card activity information for the SIM card received from the service provider in the database. Sending historical SIM card activity information for the SIM card to the first device. Wherein the database is stored in an auxiliary storage of the first server.

title_en: Half duplex processing in carrier aggregation
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communications are described. A User Equipment (UE) may receive a first slot format configuration for a first serving cell for a first set of Transmission Time Intervals (TTIs) including a first TTI, and receive a second slot format configuration for the first serving cell for the first TTI, the second slot format configuration being different from the first slot format configuration. The UE may determine a first communication direction for the first TTI for the first serving cell based on the priority of the slot format configuration. The UE may identify, for the second serving cell, a second communication direction indicated by one or more slot format configurations for the second serving cell for the first TTI. The UE may determine whether to communicate on the second serving cell for the first TT according to one or more slot format configurations for the second serving cell.

title_en: Authentication method for realizing security of small program login and without network isolation based on oauth2.0
abstract_en: The invention discloses an authentication method for realizing applet login safety and authentication without network isolation based on oauth2.0, which comprises the following steps: opening a WeChat applet and judging whether the WeChat applet is in a user login state; if not, starting a pre-login mode; receiving user operation, and judging whether the operation needs real-name authentication; if so, taking the mobile phone number as a unique key value for judging whether to call the user information of the WeChat; if so, when the operating state of the applet user is the user information interface-free mode when the applet accesses the service background according to the login token returned by the service background and calls the service interface containing the user information by adopting the scheme provided by the embodiment, the applet also needs to carry the pre-login token to access in a pre-login mode to protect the access authority of the background interface; in addition, by utilizing the oauth2.0 protocol, a login state with a mobile phone number as a unique value is generated by self-definition for login, so that the safety of the system can be ensured.

title_en: Information processing method and device and computing equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an information processing method, an information processing device and computing equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: detecting a system access request initiated by a target user aiming at a target processing system; determining decision results respectively generated by a plurality of online decision models at the target processing system in response to the system access request; determining target recommendation information based on decision results respectively corresponding to the plurality of online decision models; and outputting the target recommendation information for the target user. The embodiment of the application improves the recommendation accuracy and effectiveness.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted vision auxiliary driving system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle-mounted vision auxiliary driving system and a control method thereof, wherein the method is realized by the vehicle-mounted vision auxiliary driving system, and the vehicle-mounted vision auxiliary driving system comprises a Bluetooth electronic tag (10) arranged on a front vehicle; the Bluetooth signal receiving station comprises a Bluetooth signal receiving station (11) arranged on a rear vehicle, a camera (12) arranged on a vehicle body of the rear vehicle and a controller (13), wherein the Bluetooth signal receiving station (11) comprises a first Bluetooth antenna (111) arranged on a vehicle head, a second Bluetooth antenna (112) and a processor (110).

title_en: High-speed random sampling encryption method for geological and geographical big data
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-speed random sampling encryption method for geological and geographical big data, which is used for obtaining geological and geographical data files; dividing the file into data blocks with random sizes by a file random division module; randomly sampling the data blocks by a reservoir sampling method to obtain the sampled data blocks; encrypting the extracted data block by adopting an AES encryption method; encrypting the data blocks which are not extracted by adopting a ZUC stream cipher method; and storing the encrypted data block and the Hash value corresponding to the data block. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the method can realize the quick and efficient encryption of the big data file while ensuring the safety, and fills the gap that the traditional data encryption technology in the current market hardly meets the requirements of the big data on the aspects of encryption speed, processing performance, safety and the like.

title_en: Network security device with monitoring function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network safety device with a monitoring function, which structurally comprises an assembly plate, a network safety device and a heat dissipation net, wherein the heat dissipation net is embedded at the top end, the left end and the right end of the network safety device, the invention has the following beneficial effects that a hot plug protection device is arranged in the device, when a camera is electrified and operated, a first electromagnet is powered through a power supply port of an Ethernet, so that the electromagnet drives the protection clamping plate arranged on the electromagnet to carry out limiting protection buckling on a network cable connector, the hot plug phenomenon is better prevented, the safety of a camera device is ensured, through arranging a storage battery and a power failure prompting device in the device, when a main power supply line of the device is powered off, the camera of the device can be switched to the storage battery for supplying power and carrying out certain local camera storage, meanwhile, a second electromagnet can follow the main power failure, so that the force of a compression spring of the electrified plate is connected with an electric connection plate, the alarm is powered on to trigger the power-off prompt, so that the equipment fault can be timely processed.

title_en: Transmission network operation and maintenance workbench integrated with super controller SC
abstract_en: A super controller SC is embedded into a transmission network operation and maintenance workbench to form the transmission network operation and maintenance workbench integrated with the super controller SC, a downward channel of the transmission network operation and maintenance workbench can be opened, a service automatic opening function is supplemented, and the problem that the conventional transmission network operation and maintenance workbench cannot automatically open services is solved, so that the functional system of the transmission network operation and maintenance workbench is improved, and a powerful operation and maintenance tool is provided for one-line operation and maintenance work.

title_en: IPv6 cross-domain roaming-based terminal management method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a terminal management method and device based on IPv6 cross-domain roaming. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: when the mobile terminal changes the link care-of address in the local area network where the mobile terminal is located currently in the global network, the mobile terminal sends a binding update message to the roaming anchor node in the local area network where the mobile terminal is located currently, wherein the binding update message is used for changing the link care-of address in the local area network where the mobile terminal is located currently, the global network comprises a plurality of local area networks, and each local area network is internally provided with the roaming anchor node used for representing a regional agent. The method and the device solve the technical problem that the safety of the workflow of the IPv6 protocol in the related technology is low.

title_en: Iot's cash registering equipment as an organic whole is printed and reported in collection
abstract_en: The invention discloses iot cash register equipment integrating printing and broadcasting, which comprises a cloud printing sound box, an Internet of things iot cloud platform and a network connection module, wherein the network connection module comprises a 4G module or a WiFi module, the cloud printing sound box is connected with the Internet of things iot cloud platform through the 4G module or the WiFi module to form the Internet of things connection equipment, a payment code is bound with the cash register platform, the Internet of things iot cloud platform is in butt joint with the cash register platform, and a user is connected with a receiving silver platform through a mobile phone or a pos machine code scanning payment code. The product realizes diversified voice broadcasting, and the merchant has better, faster and more convenient experience service in the aspect of money collection prompt. The problem of distance limitation caused by the Bluetooth module is effectively solved; the method can better provide that the takeout merchant broadcasts the amount of money to be collected and prints the small cashier ticket at the same time; the equipment has small volume, is convenient to move at any place and does not occupy space; cloud broadcasting and cloud printing are more stable and faster.

title_en: Method for using wireless blue tooth device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for a wireless Bluetooth device, which comprises the following steps: receiving a specific data packet transmitted from an audio gateway through a first piconet; when the specific data packet is received and the confirmation character corresponding to the specific data packet is received through a second piconet, sending the specific confirmation character to the audio gateway through the first piconet; wherein the specific data packet is received from the audio gateway through the first piconet in a first time slot, the acknowledgement character corresponding to the specific data packet is received through the second piconet in a second time slot, the second time slot is different from the first time slot, the first time slot is later than the second time slot, and the specific acknowledgement character is transmitted to the audio gateway in a specific time slot next to the first time slot. The method can reduce the retransmission number of the wireless communication audio data packets and improve the performance of the system.

title_en: XSS attack risk analysis method and device based on Bayesian network model
abstract_en: The application relates to an XSS attack risk analysis method and device based on a Bayesian network model. According to the method, a network structure part of an XSS attack risk analysis model is directly constructed by using a Bayesian network, prior probabilities of nodes in the Bayesian network model are obtained by depending on expert experience, and a conditional probability table of each node is obtained by learning, so that a complete XSS attack risk analysis model is obtained. And (3) quantitatively analyzing the risk of the network system suffering from XSS attack by Bayesian network reasoning in an XSS attack risk analysis model to obtain a corresponding risk analysis result. According to the method and the device, an XSS attack risk analysis model is established on the basis of the STRIDE threat model based on the transmission relation of the network components and the network data stream, the risk of the network under XSS attack can be quantitatively analyzed, weak links in network security protection can be found, and good data support can be provided for the formulation of a network defense strategy.

title_en: Method and device for setting MMIO base address of server system
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for setting MMIO base address of a server system, which comprises the following steps: detecting the total capacity of all memories in the server system in the process of power-on self-test of the server system, and determining the minimum MMIO base address of the server system according to MMIO specification and the total capacity; and if the target MMIOH base address range corresponding to the target PCIE equipment configured in the server system can be calculated according to the white list, and meanwhile, the minimum MMIOH base address is within the target MMIOH base address range, the base address is judged as the MMIOH base address of the server system, and the base address is stored in the BIOS of the server system. The method can avoid the complicated process of manually setting the MMIOH base address of the server system, so the efficiency and the accuracy of setting the MMIOH base address of the server system can be improved by the method.

title_en: Vulnerable line identification method and structure based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fragile line identification technology of an electric power system, in particular to a fragile line identification method and structure based on edge calculation. The method is characterized in that edge calculation is introduced in a physical network in a mode of expanding equipment carriers, so that compatibility and high-efficiency transmission of collected data of different types of equipment are realized, the edge calculation is introduced in an information network in a mode of decomposing information processing, so that decision processing load of a network control center is reduced, real-time control of the physical network by the information network is ensured through decomposition of decision links, the purposes of improving transmission rate, improving processing speed, reducing work load and the like are achieved.

title_en: Video processing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a video processing method, a video processing device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the field of artificial intelligence, in particular to technologies such as deep learning and computer vision. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: extracting audio data and first image data in first video data; determining a first key image sequence by using a preset model and first image data; during the playing of the audio data, the at least one image is displayed according to the time stamp of the at least one image in the first key image sequence. By utilizing the embodiment of the disclosure, the video playing configuration requirement can be reduced.

title_en: Track error correction method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a track error correction method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: calculating a difference value between a first target distance and a second target distance for each target Bluetooth device arranged in a target area, wherein the first target distance is: calculating the distance between the target position and the target Bluetooth equipment according to the position coordinate of the target position and the position coordinate of the target Bluetooth equipment; the second target distance is: calculating the distance between the target position and the target Bluetooth device according to the RSSI of the target Bluetooth device received by the user terminal at the target position; judging whether the ratio of the target difference values larger than the preset threshold value in the difference values is larger than the preset ratio or not; if the ratio is larger than the preset ratio, the target position is removed from the moving track; by the method, inaccurate target positions on the moving track can be removed, and the accuracy of the moving track is improved.

title_en: DNS (Domain name Server) hosting analysis detection system and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a DNS trusteeship analysis detection system and a detection method thereof, wherein, the DNS trusteeship customizes different line analysis aliases to directly provide A record analysis; the system comprises a source discrimination module, an analysis and pursuit module, a content caching module and a result detection module; a source screening module: the system is used for providing corresponding data according to the source IP of the client; an analysis and pursuit module: the domain name resolution result of the client is used for continuously searching; a content caching module: the cache module is used for caching the pursuit result and providing data to the detection module; a result detection module: the system is used for detecting the availability of the analysis result; the resolution speed of the client is improved, and the alias is not required to be inquired for multiple times to obtain the final IP address; the availability of the IP address is improved, and the multi-protocol detection system ensures the availability of the IP address.

title_en: Consistency filtering method based on information weighting
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of single-target tracking of a sparse sensor network, and particularly relates to a consistency filtering method based on information weighting; the invention utilizes the error cross covariance of prior information among nodes as measurement to determine the weight of fused information of each node, and through a consistency algorithm, each node and the neighbor nodes are iterated repeatedly, thereby improving the dynamic state estimation precision of each sensor node to the target in the monitoring area, ensuring the state estimation to be converged to the optimal centralized estimation, accelerating the convergence speed of the distributed tracking algorithm, and simultaneously reducing the calculated amount and the communication cost of the whole network.

title_en: Pose information determining method and device and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for determining pose information and terminal equipment, and relates to the technical field of positioning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring current time information and outline position information of terminal equipment; determining a target positioning algorithm from a plurality of candidate positioning algorithms according to the current time information and/or the outline position information; the candidate positioning algorithm at least comprises a first positioning algorithm and a second positioning algorithm, wherein the first positioning algorithm is used for determining pose information based on received positioning satellite data, and the second positioning algorithm is used for determining pose information based on rough position information; and determining pose information of the terminal equipment by utilizing a target positioning algorithm. The invention can effectively improve the accuracy and precision of the pose information.

title_en: Method and device for processing read request of distributed file system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for processing a read request of a distributed file system. In the invention, if the data to be read has copy data in the host initiating the read request, the data is directly read from the host, and compared with the prior art, the data needs to be read across the network under the condition that the copy data exists in the host initiating the read request, thereby optimizing the read performance of the distributed file system.

title_en: Network element management method, device, computer equipment and medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a network element management method, a network management system, an independent computing node, a computer device, and a computer readable medium, wherein the network element management method includes: acquiring first network element data of each network element; determining a network element of a model to be received; training a model according to the first network element data; and sending the model obtained by training to the network element of the model to be received. The network management system can realize intelligent management of the network elements, enhance the computing power of the base station and realize intelligent operation and maintenance of the base station.

title_en: Load balance judging method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a load balance judging method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method obtains current network perception data of all users in a cell to be judged, wherein the current network perception data comprises current voice service data and current data service data; inputting current network perception data into a preset network perception discrimination model, and obtaining perception weights of all users in a preset network area according to the output of the preset network perception discrimination model; determining the number of the perception difference users in the cell to be judged according to a preset network perception threshold and perception weight; according to the number of the users with poor perception and the total number of the users of the cell to be judged, whether the cell to be judged needs to be subjected to load balancing or not is determined, the load condition of the cell can be judged and balanced more accurately, the condition of unbalanced load is effectively solved, network resource distribution is more reasonable, and network perception of users is improved.

title_en: Communication method, device, storage medium and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a communication method, a device, a storage medium and a system, which relate to the technical field of communication and are used for solving the problem that UE (user equipment) cannot be accessed nearby in special service telephone service, and the method comprises the following steps: receiving a target call request; the target calling request comprises a target position mark and a called number, and the target position mark is used for reflecting the position of User Equipment (UE) corresponding to the calling number in equipment of different operator networks; and determining target short number platform equipment in the called operator network based on the target position identifier and the called number, and sending a target calling request to the target short number platform equipment, wherein the distance between the target short number platform equipment and the UE is less than or equal to a preset threshold value. The embodiment of the invention is applied to a communication system of a fixed voice network.

title_en: Intelligent parking information management method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent parking information management method based on big data, which comprises the following steps: the intelligent parking information is collected by the first vehicle-mounted mobile terminal, and the intelligent parking information is collected by the second vehicle-mounted mobile terminal; establishing communication connection between a first vehicle-mounted mobile terminal and a base station; establishing communication connection between the second vehicle-mounted mobile terminal and the base station; receiving, by a first vehicle-mounted mobile terminal, a first beam failure configuration message sent by a base station, wherein the first beam failure configuration message allocates a PUSCH resource for sending a beam failure request to the first vehicle-mounted mobile terminal; receiving, by the second on-board mobile terminal, a second beam failure configuration message transmitted by the base station; receiving, by a first vehicle-mounted mobile terminal, a coordinated resource configuration sent by a base station; receiving, by the second vehicle-mounted mobile terminal, the coordinated resource configuration sent by the base station, wherein the coordinated resource configuration indicates, to the second vehicle-mounted mobile terminal, a sidelink resource for sending the coordination information.

title_en: Causal relationship identification method, terminal device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a causal relationship identification method, a terminal device and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring broadband transmission data, wherein the broadband transmission data comprises an uploading rate time sequence and a downloading rate time sequence; determining an auto-prediction error corresponding to the uploading rate time sequence based on an auto-regression model, and determining a joint prediction error corresponding to the uploading rate time sequence based on a joint regression model and the downloading rate time sequence; or determining the self-prediction error corresponding to the downloading rate time sequence based on the autoregressive model, and determining the joint prediction error corresponding to the downloading rate time sequence based on the joint regression model and the uploading rate time sequence; and determining a causal value between an uploading rate and a downloading rate according to the self-prediction error and the joint prediction error. The invention aims to achieve the effect of improving the comprehensiveness of broadband velocity measurement result analysis.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle Ai intelligence shooting manufacturing system
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle Ai intelligent shooting manufacturing system, and relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle shooting management. This unmanned aerial vehicle Ai intelligence shooting manufacturing system, including service terminal, shooting unmanned aerial vehicle, APP applet, shoot unmanned aerial vehicle and service terminal and pass through signal connection, with the video picture passback of shooting to service terminal and handle, APP applet and service terminal cooperate and use, the user carries out the interdynamic with service terminal through APP applet, it has the camera that is used for the picture to shoot fixed mounting on the unmanned aerial vehicle, unmanned aerial vehicle's inside still is provided with the treater that is used for handling the signal, carries out the communication module B of communication with service terminal. Through setting up AI intelligence shooting, utilize to shoot unmanned aerial vehicle and shoot the picture, through service terminal and APP applet convenience of customers to video processing and other operations simultaneously, not only be favorable to reducing the intensity of labour who shoots the staff in the scenic spot to the picture of shooing is more comprehensive lively.

title_en: Application and update method and system for V2X vehicle-mounted terminal digital certificate
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for applying and updating a V2X vehicle-mounted terminal digital certificate, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when a starting instruction is received, an application instruction is sent to a digital certificate issuing system through a digital certificate application terminal, wherein the application instruction comprises a preset communication certificate; generating a corresponding digital certificate according to the application instruction through a digital certificate issuing system and feeding the digital certificate back to a digital certificate application terminal, wherein the digital certificate comprises a request instruction capable of establishing secure communication; and acquiring the digital certificate received by the digital certificate application terminal, and establishing communication connection with the digital certificate issuing system through the digital certificate so as to automatically apply and update to the digital certificate issuing system. The risk that the V2X vehicle-mounted terminal directly applies for the digital certificate to the digital certificate issuing system in the process is avoided, the interference of external signals is effectively avoided, potential safety hazards are eliminated, and the use experience of a user is improved.

title_en: Method and device for deploying application instance and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device and a readable storage medium for deploying an application instance, wherein a data analysis network element receives a first message from a first network element, and the first message comprises indication information for indicating a first area; the first message is used for requesting to acquire first indication information; the first indication information is used for indicating the prediction information of the terminal equipment accessing the application instance of the target application in the first area; the data analysis network element determines first indication information; and the data analysis network element sends the first indication information to the first network element.

title_en: Attack detection method and system for internet of vehicles TSP platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an attack detection method and system for a TSP (Total suspended particulate) platform of a vehicle networking, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting communication flow data of a target TSP platform; and performing data extraction on the communication traffic data to obtain a characteristic value to be detected, comparing the characteristic value to be detected with preset attack identification characteristic data, judging whether an attack action exists in the characteristic value to be detected according to a comparison result, and outputting a detection result. The invention can effectively detect whether the target TSP platform is attacked or not, and further ensure the safety of the Internet of vehicles.

title_en: Game optimization method based on information visible MEC system task scheduling strategy
abstract_en: The invention provides a game optimization method based on an information visible MEC system task scheduling strategy, which is characterized in that a decision making module DMM is introduced into a mobile device to build a system architecture of a mobile edge computing MEC, and according to the expected stay time and the expected net benefit of a newly arrived task, the DMM makes a decision of discarding the task, distributing the task to a local execution system LES or unloading the task to an MEC server through a transmission system TS. And obtaining an individual optimal task scheduling strategy and a social optimal task scheduling strategy according to the performance index of the MEC system under the steady state and by combining a numerical experiment. And a pricing scheme of waiting of the tasks in the MEC system is formulated, the arrival behaviors of the tasks are restricted and adjusted, and the unification of an individual optimal task scheduling strategy and a social optimal task scheduling strategy is realized. The method provided by the invention solves the problems of insufficient capacity and poor performance of the mobile equipment, ensures the lowest time delay of each task, and maximizes the benefits of operators and the whole tasks.

title_en: Dampproofing anticorrosive waterproof industrial switch
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dampproof, corrosion-proof and waterproof industrial switch, which comprises a switch main body, wherein the switch main body comprises a plurality of data sockets, a switch and a shell, the data sockets and the switch are all arranged on the same side of the shell, a separation strip is arranged between the data sockets, the separation strip is provided with a buckle and a dust cover, the buckle is used for realizing the clamping connection between the separation strip and the dust cover, the dust cover is provided with an elastic sheet, the elastic sheet is provided with a semicircular groove, the switch is provided with a pressing plate and a rubber pad, the pressing plate is arranged on the top surface of the rubber pad, the shell comprises a left side cover, a right side plate, a heat dissipation opening and heat dissipation fins, the left side cover is in threaded connection with the right side plate, the heat dissipation opening is arranged on the top surface of the left side cover, the heat dissipation fins are arranged on one side of the left side cover away from the right side plate, and are perpendicular to a horizontal plane, and the switch main body can realize separation protection on the data sockets in the use process through the arrangement of the dust cover, and moisture, dust and the like can be prevented from entering the data sockets.

title_en: DDPG network-based mixed radiation source signal separation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mixed radiation source signal separation method based on a DDPG network, which comprises the steps of firstly adopting K signal test antennas to collect radiation source signal samples of K sample radiation sources, processing the radiation source signal samples to obtain mixed signal samples, regarding a separation matrix as an intelligent body, regarding addition and subtraction of matrix elements as actions, regarding the separation degree of signals as an environment, designing the DDPG network, then adopting the mixed signal samples to train the DDPG network, obtaining mixed signals of the K radiation sources by each signal test antenna during actual application, inputting the mixed signals into the trained DDPG network for retraining, and obtaining a signal separation result. The invention effectively improves the accuracy of the mixed signal separation by introducing the DDPG network.

title_en: Service processing method, device and system based on cloud environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a service processing method, a device and a system based on a cloud environment, relating to the field of cloud computing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving a service request from a client, the request comprising: a request name set according to a predetermined rule; determining the position information of the server in the server cluster according to the request name of the service request; determining a server according to the position information based on preset routing information, wherein the routing information indicates the corresponding relation between the static identifier of the server and the position information; and executing the service corresponding to the service request based on the determined server to which the client belongs, and returning a service processing result to the client. The invention can provide an efficient service addressing mechanism, can quickly respond to the service request of the client and improve the experience of the user.

title_en: Access method of application server and terminal
abstract_en: An access method and a terminal of an application server relate to the technical field of communication, and under the condition that the application server does not support IPv6 well, the situation that the terminal repeatedly preferentially uses an IPv6 address to connect the application server to cause repeated failure is avoided, and the internet surfing experience of a user is improved, wherein the method specifically comprises the following steps: and identifying a problem scene that the terminal fails to connect with the application server by using the IPv6 address, setting the domain name accessed in the problem scene as a limited domain name, and directly connecting the application server by using the IPv4 address when the first domain name is accessed again subsequently.

title_en: User equipment for executing switching and method thereof
abstract_en: A method performed by a user equipment, UE, for performing a handover from a source access node to a target access node is provided. The UE, source access node and 5 target access nodes are operating in a wireless communication network. The UE receives (601) a handover command message from a source access node. The UE establishes (602) a target radio connection with a target access node and determines (603) whether a source cell release criterion is met. When it is determined that the source cell release criterion is met, the UE releases (604) the source radio 10 connection with the source access node.

title_en: State estimation method of nonlinear complex network system based on random communication protocol
abstract_en: The invention discloses a state estimation method of a nonlinear complex network system based on a random communication protocol. In order to save network resources and reduce the burden of network communication, a scheduling method based on a random communication protocol is adopted, each node only has one measurement component to transmit through the network when transmitting signals, and meanwhile, the situation of resisting attacks in data transmission is considered. Then, the mean square stability and H meeting the estimation error augmentation system are obtained by utilizing the Lyapunov stability theory ∞ And (4) sufficient conditions of performance indexes. And finally, solving the gain of the state estimator by a linear matrix inequality method, and providing a safety state estimation method based on a random communication protocol for a nonlinear complex network system.

title_en: Fingerprint positioning method, device and equipment based on main adjacent region signal and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a fingerprint positioning method, a fingerprint positioning device, fingerprint positioning equipment and a fingerprint positioning storage medium based on a main adjacent area signal.
