The method comprises the following steps: determining a current main adjacent region according to measurement data to be positioned; determining a candidate grid corresponding to the measurement data to be positioned according to the current main neighbor matching fingerprint library; matching the grid main adjacent index of the candidate grid with the measurement main adjacent index of the measurement data to be positioned to determine a grid error, and selecting the candidate grid with the minimum grid error as an optimal grid; and determining the current position of the measurement data to be positioned based on the optimal main adjacent index of the optimal grid and the measurement main adjacent index. According to the embodiment of the invention, the matching of the adjacent regions is added, the candidate grids are effectively screened from the grids which are annularly distributed in the main region matching result, the range of the positioning grids is reduced, the optimal grids are screened according to the matching error value obtained by calculating the main adjacent index information, and the matching precision is improved.

title_en: Method and apparatus for indicating a two-step random access procedure in a wireless communication system
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a communication technology and system thereof for fusing a fifth generation (5G) or quasi-5G communication system with an IoT technology that supports higher data transmission rates than fourth generation (4G) communication systems, such as Long Term Evolution (LTE). The present disclosure may be applied to smart services (e.g., smart home, smart building, smart city, smart car or interconnected car, healthcare, digital education, retail business, security and security related services, etc.) based on 5G communication technology and IoT related technology. A method and apparatus for applying two-step random access when using third generation partnership project (3 GPP) 5G New Radio (NR) technology in an unlicensed band is provided.

title_en: Network transmission method and system with high safety and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a network transmission method, a system and a readable storage medium with high safety, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a wireless sensor network framework, dividing a plurality of wireless sensors into different groups, wherein each group comprises a wireless sensor group head and a plurality of wireless sensor nodes; respectively establishing a group key by the wireless sensor group head and each wireless sensor node; each wireless sensor node collects data, encrypts the data and transmits the encrypted data to the first wireless sensor group; the wireless sensor group firstly collects data ciphertexts transmitted by each wireless sensor node of the group, decrypts the data ciphertexts by adopting the group key, restores the data to obtain the data collected by each wireless sensor node of the group, and performs fusion processing; the wireless sensor group firstly transmits the generated fusion data to the base station through a secure link and the fusion data is reported to a data management center by the base station. The invention can improve the transmission safety of the wireless sensor network.

title_en: Test method and device for mimicry industrial control gateway, mimicry industrial control gateway and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a testing method and a testing device for a mimicry industrial control gateway, the mimicry industrial control gateway and a medium, wherein the testing method comprises the following steps: generating an analog replay message according to a message format according to the strategy information of the mimicry industrial control gateway and the analog attack target, wherein the strategy information comprises: accessing a control strategy and an industrial control strategy, wherein the simulated attack target is a simulated attacked executive body in the mimicry industrial control gateway; sending the simulation replay message to the mimicry industrial control gateway so that the simulation attack target in the mimicry industrial control gateway receives the simulation replay message; generating an illegal message, wherein the illegal message is used for triggering mimicry arbitration; and checking a mimicry decision log, wherein the mimicry decision log comprises illegal messages subjected to mimicry decision, illegal messages intercepted by industrial control and scheduling behaviors of the simulated attack targets. The method can improve the diversity of the simulation replay message and improve the flexibility of the test.

title_en: Application service monitoring method and device, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses an application service monitoring method and device, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium. The method comprises the steps of installing a communication device which is independent of a host machine in interaction with the cloud host machine of the cloud platform in advance, deploying a data acquisition agent in the host machine, and integrating a data acquisition program matched with the data acquisition agent and data acquisition templates of various application services into an application service installation package. When the generation of the target application service is detected, generating a data acquisition configuration file according to the attribute information of the target application service and a target data acquisition template matched with the type of the target application service; when the target application service is successfully deployed on the cloud host, the monitoring performance data acquired by the cloud host based on the data acquisition configuration file is acquired, so that various types of application services of the cloud platform can be safely and efficiently monitored.

title_en: Webpage tamper-proofing method and device based on two-stage protection system
abstract_en: The invention provides a webpage tamper-proofing method and device based on a two-stage protection system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: storing the webpage file in a central server in a local area network which cannot be directly accessed by a user, wherein the webpage file in the central server is called a central webpage source file; synchronizing the central webpage source file to an edge server providing service for a user, wherein the webpage file synchronized to the edge server by the central server is the edge webpage source file; synchronizing the edge webpage source file to a webpage file on an application server for being accessed and used by an actual user; detecting edge webpage source files and webpage files accessed by actual users; in the process of changing the files, the behavior of file change is not interfered, after the file change is finished, if the webpage files accessed by the actual users are changed, the edge webpage source files are immediately synchronized, and if the edge webpage source files are changed, the central webpage source files are immediately synchronized.

title_en: Error rate measuring device and error counting method
abstract_en: According to the communication standard of the measured object, the errors of the area set by the user are counted. The error rate measurement device (1) is provided with: an operation unit (4) which sets a length of 1 code and a length of 1 FEC Symbol of FEC according to the communication standard of the object W to be measured; a storage unit (5) for storing symbol string data that receives and converts a signal from a subject (W); a data segmentation mechanism (3 da) for segmenting the stored symbol string data into MSB data and LSB data; a data comparing unit (3 d) that compares the segmented MSB data and LSB data with Error data, respectively, detects MSB errors and LSB errors for each 1 code length, respectively, and detects FEC Symbol errors for each of the MSB data and LSB data at 1 FEC Symbol interval; and an Error counting means (7 a) for counting the detected MSB Error, LSB Error, and FEC Symbol Error.

title_en: Data acquisition and management integrated method, system, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a data acquisition and management integrated method, a system, a device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a network protocol library, wherein the network protocol library comprises at least two different network protocols; matching a network protocol corresponding to the input data from the network protocol library through a protocol adapter; collecting the input data by adopting the matched network protocol; and adopting concurrent management for the network protocol library and a plurality of protocols and protocols in the network protocol library, wherein the concurrent management comprises: based on the generic architecture, at least one identical manager or sub-management system is assigned to at least two different network protocols.

title_en: Network slice resource sharing method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a sharing method, device, equipment and medium of network slice resources, comprising the following steps: acquiring a resource application sent by a first service; searching a network slice resource corresponding to the resource application to obtain a target network slice resource; comparing the priority of the second service corresponding to the target network slice resource with the priority of the first service; if the first service has a higher priority than the second service, inquiring the running state of the target network slice resource; and if the running state is idle, transmitting data to be transmitted of the first service by utilizing the target network slice resource and the original network slice resource of the first service. The slice network resources acquired by the low-priority service can be shared to the high-priority service without initiating application to the network, so that time delay and resource waste are avoided, and the resource utilization rate is improved.

title_en: Secondary feature extraction and malicious attack identification method based on kernel principal component analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a secondary feature extraction and malicious attack identification method based on kernel principal component analysis. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, hierarchically sampling the acquired malicious traffic to acquire a more balanced training sample set and a more balanced testing sample set; step 2, preprocessing an original network traffic data set to obtain a more standard data set; step 3, extracting the characteristics of the preprocessed network flow by using a secondary characteristic extraction method based on kernel principal component analysis, and effectively eliminating redundant information in original network flow data; step 4, the extracted features are used for training a classification model, and classification and identification are carried out on different malicious attack behaviors; and 5, obtaining a network flow malicious attack detection report according to the identification result obtained in the step 4. The invention simultaneously considers the characteristics of the data in two aspects of mean value and variance, and further more comprehensively analyzes the data characteristics.

title_en: Network operation and maintenance method, device, electronic equipment, medium and program product
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a network operation and maintenance method and device, which can be applied to the technical field of computer networks and the financial field. The method comprises the following steps: converting the change requirement attachment into a network configuration change file; comparing the network configuration change file with the current network configuration information to obtain result network configuration information; changing the current network configuration information according to the result network configuration information; the network configuration change file is a database file and comprises network private line information, source end information and destination end information which are in one-to-one correspondence. The present disclosure also provides an apparatus, a device, a storage medium and a program product. The network operation and maintenance method and device can realize automatic change of network configuration and automatic generation of the monitoring script, greatly reduce the workload of operation and maintenance personnel and improve the network operation and maintenance efficiency.

title_en: File data processing method and device, electronic equipment and computer readable medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a file data processing method, a file data processing device, electronic equipment and a computer readable medium, and relates to the technical field of big data.A specific implementation mode comprises the steps of receiving an uploading rule request sent by a client, calling a rule engine to generate website rule configuration information based on client information in the uploading rule request and attribute information of a file to be uploaded, and returning the website rule configuration information; and receiving a file uploading request sent by the client according to the website rule configuration information, inquiring metadata in the file uploading request to upload the newly added file, and returning uploading progress and address information of the newly added file. Therefore, the method and the device can solve the problems of low file management efficiency and poor safety in the prior art.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle control interaction method based on SIP protocol
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle control interaction method based on an SIP (session initiation protocol), which comprises the steps of analyzing unmanned aerial vehicle equipment information, then deeply packaging unmanned aerial vehicle equipment control interaction information, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle equipment control interaction information comprises unmanned aerial vehicle state information inquiry, unmanned aerial vehicle control information and the like, packaging the unmanned aerial vehicle control interaction information into an SIP information body, and carrying out unmanned aerial vehicle control interaction communication between network gates through the SIP. The method of the invention not only can reduce the number of ports used, but also takes the unmanned aerial vehicle video stream as national standard equipment to be connected into the national standard gateway, and is used as the national standard equipment to carry out unified aggregation and management, a plurality of national standard platforms can be cascaded rapidly, the video stream expansion is easy, and the interactive information deep packaging is convenient for encryption and decryption security control.

title_en: NFC dynamic splicing method and device based on camera system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of Internet of things equipment, in particular to a camera system NFC-based dynamic splicing method and device, wherein the camera system NFC-based dynamic splicing method comprises the following steps: acquiring a camera and display equipment of an access network, and matching the camera with the display equipment according to a resolution condition; determining display equipment participating in splicing according to the image acquired by the camera and the operating frequency of the display equipment; acquiring a data packet which is used for playing or displaying by display equipment participating in splicing, and processing the data packet according to the physical resolution of the corresponding display equipment; establishing a multi-display device NFC matching connection, and determining a screen occupation ratio according to the physical resolution of the display device; and simultaneously issuing the at least two processed data packets to at least two display devices for splicing display according to the determined screen occupation ratio. The method provided by the invention realizes the pairing between the devices by using the NFC, and is easy to realize.

title_en: Live video data generation method and device and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a live video data generation method, a live video data generation device and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of live broadcasting. In the embodiment of the application, the multi-frame action images of the target animal extracted from the animal media resources are obtained in advance, so that in the process of singing by a broadcaster, the corresponding action images are obtained along with the audio data of the singing by the broadcaster, and further, live video data containing different action forms of the target animal are generated. That is, in this application embodiment, when the anchor sings, the live broadcast video is not only the anchor singing following the accompaniment, but also can include the animal image of the different action forms that correspond the anchor singing, and like this, the content of live broadcast video is richer, has strengthened the interest, attraction spectator that can be better to increase the watching volume.

title_en: Holographic electronic sand table simulation method for rail transit intelligent vehicle yard
abstract_en: The invention relates to a holographic electronic sand table simulation method facing a rail transit intelligent train yard, which comprises an intelligent train yard, a signal system and a holographic electronic sand table, wherein the intelligent train yard and the signal system mainly comprise a signal area controller ZCSim, a line controller LCSim and a signal simulation interlocking CISim. The holographic electronic sand table mainly comprises a background server for holographic projection, a protocol conversion module, a sand table turnout, a signal machine and a sand table vehicle. The intelligent parking lot, the signal system and the holographic electronic sand table form a closed-loop system, any external real equipment does not need to be connected, and meanwhile, any running main line equipment cannot be influenced. The combination of the holographic electronic sand table simulation verification device and the intelligent vehicle yard improves the testing efficiency and coverage rate, ensures the field opening rate of the intelligent vehicle yard system, reduces the field defect escape rate of the subway vehicle yard, and has shorter construction time, smaller required space, lower cost and stronger expansibility.

title_en: Display device and control method thereof
abstract_en: A display device is disclosed. The display device includes: at least one display module; a first interface configured to receive a first signal from a first display apparatus; a second interface configured to receive a second signal from a second display apparatus; and a processor configured to: repeatedly performing a first operation for identifying a first signal received through the first interface and a second operation for identifying a second signal received through the second interface; displaying an image on the at least one display module according to the first signal received through the first interface without performing the second operation, based on the first signal being recognized while the first operation is performed; and displaying an image on the at least one display module according to the second signal received through the second interface without performing the first operation, based on the second signal being recognized while performing the second operation.

title_en: Method and system for safe dynamic resource allocation of power wireless private network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for safe and dynamic resource allocation of a power wireless private network, which comprises the following steps: for each connection relation in a pre-constructed dynamic high-energy-efficiency resource allocation model of the power wireless private network, obtaining the minimum transmission energy corresponding to each connection relation by adopting a convex optimization method; storing the connection relations, the data stream information in the connection relations and the minimum transmission energy into a set memory pool; selecting sample data from the memory pool, and training to obtain an optimal connection relation, an optimal power distribution value and an optimal energy efficiency value; the dynamic high-energy-efficiency resource allocation model of the power wireless private network is constructed based on the service relationship between each base station and each user equipment in the power wireless private network. A dynamic energy-efficient resource allocation model of the power wireless private network is established, and an optimal resource allocation framework is found.

title_en: Computer network data secure transmission method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a computer network data secure transmission method and device. The method comprises the following steps: judging whether transmission data is sent to the second terminal equipment for the first time; and when the first terminal equipment does not send the transmission data to the second terminal equipment for the first time, based on the agreed encryption and decryption rule, encrypting the transmission data and the current target information by adopting the previous target information sent to the second terminal for the previous time to obtain second encrypted transmission data. By the method, the encryption keys of the first terminal equipment during each transmission are different, and even if the encryption key transmitted at this time is cracked, the encryption mode still does not need to be changed. In addition, compared with the traditional single encryption mode, the encryption mode of the dynamic key has higher security.

title_en: Clothes washing system and method based on Internet of things and commercial application
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of clothes washing through the Internet of things, in particular to a clothes washing system and method based on the Internet of things and commercial application. The laundry system based on the Internet of things comprises a user side, a management side and a data service center, wherein the user side is used for realizing user operation, the management side is used for realizing manager operation, and the data service center is used for realizing data storage and data processing. The laundry method of the present invention is implemented based on the laundry system, and the commercial application of the present invention is an application of the laundry system and the laundry method. By the invention, the whole-course tracking of the clothes can be better realized, and a complete washing closed loop is realized, so that an online washing process can be better realized.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted unit, expressway electronic toll collection system and toll collection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle-mounted unit, an expressway electronic toll collection system and a toll collection method, wherein the vehicle-mounted unit is provided with a V2X radio frequency module, and the expressway electronic toll collection system is provided with a V2X antenna, so that communication connection can be realized at a farther distance based on a vehicle-road cooperation system in an ETC transaction process. According to the charging method, communication is carried out by using the V2X vehicle-road cooperative system, the vehicle-mounted unit is pre-read at a long distance to generate transaction information, and then transaction reading and writing are directly carried out at a short distance by the ETC antenna, so that the reading efficiency of the vehicle-mounted unit can be guaranteed, and the ETC transaction speed and the transaction success rate are greatly improved.

title_en: Method and apparatus for non-linear estimation using reference signals
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for non-linear estimation by using a reference signal. The transmitter may be configured to generate a reference signal having a non-constant envelope for non-linear estimation by the receiver. The transmitting side may transmit a reference signal. The receiving party may be configured to receive a reference signal having a non-constant envelope from the transmitting party. The receiving side may estimate at least one non-linear characteristic based on a reference signal having a non-constant envelope. The receiver may transmit feedback based on the at least one non-linear characteristic and/or perform at least one digital post-distortion (DPoD) operation based on the at least one non-linear characteristic.

title_en: Network traffic data processing method and server
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of network security, and provides a method for processing network flow data and a server, which are used for improving the reading performance of a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: reading network flow data in a set period from a physical network card through a platform which runs in a user space and has an input/output (I/O) technology; and analyzing each network flow data to determine the change state of the network flow data belonging to the same flow identifier. By operating a platform with an I/O technology in a user space, the function that the user space directly reads data from a physical network card is realized, zero copy is performed in the data acquisition process, and the reading performance of the system is improved.

title_en: Self-selection method and device of Internet of things center node, Internet of things equipment and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a self-selection method of an Internet of things center node, which comprises the steps of broadcasting a first message to other second Internet of things equipment accessed to the Internet of things on any first Internet of things equipment side accessed to the Internet of things to determine whether the first Internet of things equipment is eliminated or not, receiving second messages respectively broadcast by the second Internet of things equipment, respectively comparing the priorities of the first Internet of things equipment and the second Internet of things equipment according to information carried by the second messages, eliminating the second Internet of things equipment if the priority of the first Internet of things equipment is higher than that of the second Internet of things equipment, and becoming the Internet of things center node under the condition that the first Internet of things equipment is not eliminated within a set time threshold; the first message and the second message at least carry information for distinguishing the priority of the Internet of things equipment. The method and the device do not need to occupy a large amount of software and hardware resources, and are favorable for the rapid networking of the Internet of things local area network.

title_en: Task scheduling method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a task scheduling method, a task scheduling device, computer equipment and a storage medium. According to the method, a scheduling system receives a target data request of a target client, the scheduling system distributes target home nodes for responding to the target data request for the target client according to access data, target content is stored in the target home nodes, the access data are data fed back to the scheduling system for the home nodes, each access data is used for indicating a service state of one home node when responding to the data request, the scheduling system sends a link address of the target home node to the target client, the target client downloads the target content from the target home node through the link address, and compared with the traditional downloading of the data through CDN nodes, the use cost can be reduced through the downloading of the home nodes, so that a data downloading mode with lower cost is provided for a provider of data resources.

title_en: Call method and related equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a communication method, equipment and a system. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that the first mobile terminal stops collecting audio data and/or video data and receives the audio data and/or the video data collected by first external equipment, wherein the audio collecting capacity of the first external equipment is superior to that of the first mobile terminal, and/or the video collecting capacity of the first external equipment is superior to that of the first mobile terminal; the audio acquisition capabilities are affected by audio acquisition parameters, including: one or more of sensitivity, frequency response, and directivity; the video capture capability is affected by video capture parameters, including: one or more of resolution, color space, frame rate, color rendition, texture rendition, denoising, dynamic speed, photosensitive component and lens; and the first mobile terminal sends the audio data and/or the video data collected by the first external equipment to the second mobile terminal through the session.

title_en: Power distribution method and device based on neural network
abstract_en: A power distribution method and device based on a neural network. According to the method, the characteristics of the communication system can be extracted through the neural network model based on the channel vector characteristics of the MIMO communication system, the characteristics are further fitted through multiple iterations based on the neural network model, the transmission power allocated to each user is determined according to the fitting result, and the allocation result of the transmission power can be optimized due to the fact that the characteristics of the communication system are considered in power allocation.

title_en: Drinking water safety monitoring and informatization system
abstract_en: The invention provides a drinking water safety monitoring and informatization system, which implements remote monitoring and informatization management on drinking water safety engineering by using a wired or wireless mode and comprises a monitoring center, a communication network, monitoring equipment and measurement and control equipment.

title_en: Broadband phased array multifunctional reconfigurable radio frequency assembly and signal generation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-functional reconfigurable radio frequency assembly of broadband phased array and signal generation method, include wide narrowband compound signal source, reconfigurable frequency conversion assembly and T/R assembly in the radio frequency link framework, wherein wide narrowband compound signal source outputs the excitation signal of the intermediate frequency of broadband, narrowband low intermediate frequency excitation signal; the reconfigurable frequency conversion assembly comprises a three-stage local oscillator shared by receiving and transmitting. The reconfigurable signal generation and processing capability covering C, X, ku three octaves is realized by the three-stage frequency conversion scheme of the frequency-adjustable primary local oscillator, the double-frequency point secondary local oscillator and the single-frequency point tertiary local oscillator in combination with the broadband and narrowband composite excitation input, so that the working frequency range of the phased array surface system is greatly increased, and the flexibility of signal processing types is improved; by adopting a shared design at the main link body parts of the three-stage frequency conversion assembly, the switch filter bank, the T/R module and the like, the size, weight and production cost of the system are saved, and the utilization rate of resources is improved.

title_en: Method for supporting switching and corresponding base station and network node
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a method for supporting handover, a corresponding base station and a corresponding network node. The method comprises the following steps: forwarding the data to a destination base station of a second RAT; receiving a first end-marker packet from a first user plane functional entity; and sending a second end-marker packet to the first user plane functional entity in case no data is forwardable for a quality of service, QoS, flow mapped to a data bearer. According to the method of the public embodiment, the data packet sending delay can be reduced, and the user experience is improved.

title_en: Throughput optimization method for backscattering auxiliary wireless energy supply communication system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for optimizing throughput of a backscattering auxiliary wireless energy supply communication system, which takes the long-term average throughput of the wireless energy supply communication system with optimized backscattering auxiliary as a Markov decision process, wherein the Markov decision process comprises three elements of a system state s, an action a and a reward function R, an optimal online strategy corresponding to the Markov decision process is obtained by adopting a deep Q learning algorithm, and then a transmitter executes according to the optimal online strategy when an environmental radio frequency source is started. The invention can adapt to the dynamic changes of channel state, energy capture condition and data buffer, and can effectively improve the long-term average effective throughput of the system.

title_en: Providing digital certificates in a cryptographically secure manner
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for providing a digital Certificate (CERT) for a device (50) in a cryptographically protected manner, said method comprising the following steps: -generating (S1) a one-time security identifier (OTP) in the configuration means (40) from the provided secret (S) and at least one device unique description (SN), -transmitting (S2) the one-time security identifier (OTP) to the device (50), and-generating (S3) security information (PW) in the device (50) from the one-time security identifier (OTP), -requesting (S4) the Certificate (CERT) at the issuing authority (40) by means of a request message (Req) containing the device unique description (SN) and being cryptographically protected by means of the security information (PW), and-verifying (S5) the security information (PW) in the issuing authority (40) by means of the device unique identifier (SN) and the secret (S) provided to the issuing authority, and-transmitting (S6) the Certificate (CERT) to the device (50) in case of a positive verification result.

title_en: Blockchain transaction processing and authority management method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blockchain transaction processing and authority management method thereof, wherein the blockchain comprises a transaction data end and a transaction data terminal, the transaction data end comprises a plurality of transaction data ends, the transaction data ends are connected with one transaction data terminal, and a blockchain dividing module is arranged between the transaction data ends and the transaction data terminal; the blockchain dividing module is used for dividing transaction data between the transaction data end and the transaction data terminal into separate stages, wherein the input end and the output end of each stage are respectively represented by A, B, the blockchain dividing module is arranged to divide the transaction data in stages, the data are subjected to stage data detection, and meanwhile the transaction data reforming module is used for reforming the data, so that the disorder of the data in the transaction process of the blockchain is avoided.

title_en: Vacuum tube high-speed aircraft ground wireless communication physical resource multiplexing method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a vacuum tube high-speed aircraft train-ground wireless communication physical resource multiplexing method, which comprises the steps of dividing different low-delay high-reliability communication services into a plurality of grades according to error rate and delay indexes, mapping the grades to resource blocks with different sizes, determining the multiplexing range of the services based on different allowable delays of the services of each grade, constructing an optimization problem with minimum uRLLC service total power as a target on the basis of ensuring the uRLLC service bit error rate and delay requirements, and providing a greedy strategy to rapidly solve the optimization problem. The invention can overcome the deep fading of the channel to a certain extent, make up the defect of power saving under the condition that the existing communication physical resource multiplexing theory does not consider the coexistence of various uRLLC services, and improve the reliability of the communication system.

title_en: Service processing method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a service processing method and equipment, wherein the method comprises the step of acquiring a network initialization message sent by a modem corresponding to a mobile terminal, wherein the network initialization message comprises a current network mode parameter corresponding to a current network mode of the modem. And when the current network mode parameter is determined to be the target network mode parameter corresponding to the local target network mode of the mobile terminal, sending a service processing message to the modem so that the modem performs corresponding service processing operation according to the service processing message. And acquiring a service response message returned by the modem after corresponding service processing operation is carried out according to the service processing message, so that the network mode of the modem is accurately judged, the waste of resources is reduced, and the service processing message can be timely processed.

title_en: AES & SM4 reconfigurable mask S box hardware circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AES&The SM4 reconfigurable mask S box hardware circuit comprises a mask preprocessing unit, a front affine and mask correction unit, a multiplication inverse unit with a mask and a rear affine and mask correction unit; the scheme realizes that the S box of AES and SM4 is based on the composite domain GF ((((2)) under the standard base  2  )  2  )  2  ) Is a reconfigurable design of (2); the S box adopts a masking technology, adopts masking preprocessing and segmentation correction masking technology, and ensures that the S box has side channel defense capability under the condition that the output does not change the masking value. The reconfigurable S box of the scheme has the advantages of small area, low delay and attack resistance.

title_en: Number portability method based on block chain network and operator system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a number portability method based on a block chain network and an operator system. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring number portability pre-application information of a user terminal, wherein the number portability pre-application information comprises a terminal number of the user terminal; acquiring information to be confirmed according to a terminal number of a user terminal, wherein the information to be confirmed comprises a compensation scheme of an operator to be transferred and service package information of the operator, and sending the information to be confirmed to the user terminal so that the user terminal can generate number portability formal application information based on the information to be confirmed; acquiring the number portability formal application information signed by a terminal private key and sent by a user terminal, carrying out system signature on the number portability formal application information signed by the terminal private key, and broadcasting the number portability formal application information signed by the system to a number portability announcement block chain network. The invention can simplify the number portability process and reduce the energy consumption of the service system.

title_en: Method for monitoring video color ring usage based on virtual cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for monitoring the usage amount of video color ring based on a virtual cloud platform, which comprises S1, firstly, a third-party controller performs connection monitoring on downloading and cache records in a user interface; s2, obtaining grouping information of virtual machines in the cloud platform user machine, wherein the cloud platform user machine at least comprises one virtual machine; and S3, monitoring the download use data flow generated by the source virtual machine through the virtual switching equipment, and dragging the download use data flow into the virtual machine according to the use amount of the cloud platform. The invention compares with the common statistics according to the download quantity, neglects the usage quantity of the cached color ring, causes inaccurate counting, and causes certain error to the usage quantity of the monitored color ring, the third party controller monitors the connection of the download and the cache record in the user interface, monitors from the original outlet, effectively monitors the caching quantity and the usage quantity of the color ring, thereby improving the monitoring efficiency of the color ring.

title_en: Low-code industrial control method based on AOE network and event driving
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-code industrial control method based on an AOE network and event driving, which comprises the following steps: 1) Designing a control strategy based on event driving; 2) Constructing an AOE network; 3) Defining basic information, variables, events and actions of the AOE network by utilizing the AOE network configuration file, so as to describe the AOE network constructed in the step 2) and the control strategy designed in the step 1); 4) Writing a measuring point configuration file and a channel configuration file; 5) And analyzing and executing the AOE network. The method adopts a low-code mode to express the control strategy, and simplifies the development flow: event driving reduces unnecessary waste of computing resources and communication resources, and digital control and multi-thread control are easier to realize; the complete AOE and event-driven control strategy execution framework is designed to be able to accommodate environments with high uncertainty.

title_en: Control channel monitoring capability for low latency communications
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides systems, methods, and apparatus in which a User Equipment (UE) may indicate different Physical Downlink Control Channel (PDCCH) monitoring capabilities per monitoring span or slot, such as UE capabilities in terms of number of Control Channel Elements (CCEs), Blind Decoding (BDs), number of Downlink Control Information (DCI) formats, etc. For example, a UE may support different numbers of CCEs per slot or different numbers of DCI per monitored span for different service types (such as different numbers of CCEs for enhanced mobile broadband (eMBB) and for ultra-reliable low latency communication (URLLC)). The UE may indicate different sets of PDCCH monitoring capabilities (such as sets of PDCCH monitoring capabilities for different service types, monitoring spans, time slots, etc.). The base station may receive an indication of the UE pdcch monitoring capability information and may configure the UE with one or more monitoring occasions accordingly.

title_en: Communication coarse synchronization detection method suitable for medium-voltage power line carrier
abstract_en: The invention provides a communication coarse synchronization detection method suitable for a medium-voltage power line carrier, which is characterized in that acquired data are continuously cached by a carrier machine, delay cross-correlation is carried out after 8192 data are cached, whether coarse synchronization is successful or not is judged by calculating a correlation coefficient of the delay cross-correlation, and judgment is carried out by adopting two conditions of minimum value and maximum value, so that the judgment robustness is enhanced. The invention does not only depend on the power line single carrier communication technology, avoids the influence of selective attenuation of the power line frequency, adopts a specific multi-carrier mode, enhances the performance of a communication system, and has positive significance for the national power grid company to integrally control the operation information acquisition of the power line.

title_en: Method for transmitting AP error code in BLE advertisement
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to a method for transmitting an AP error code in BLE advertisement. Methods and apparatus for automatically obtaining state from an isolated AP that cannot connect to a cloud. The obtained state information is then used to automatically alleviate the problem and speed up connecting the isolated APs back to the cloud. The method is well suited for use in systems with various access points, such as wireless and/or wired access points, which may be used to gain access to the internet or another network such as the "cloud". Network management systems have been configured to monitor networks and use preconfigured data to determine remedial actions to be automatically taken when an AP loses connection with the cloud.

title_en: Terminal registration processing method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a terminal registration processing method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: detecting that one or more identification cards are inserted into the card slot; reading the identification marks of the one or more identification cards; acquiring a network identifier corresponding to the identity identifier from a database, wherein the database stores the corresponding relation between the identity identifier of the registered card and the network identifier; according to the obtained result, the one or more identity identification cards are registered, the problem that network load is aggravated due to the fact that a network is required to distribute all identifiers by adopting a new card registration process for a pseudo card changing scene of a double-card or multi-card terminal in the related technology can be solved, and for the pseudo card changing scene, the network identifiers of the registered identity identification cards are stored, so that unnecessary signaling interaction of the network is reduced, and meanwhile, the efficiency and the speed of the terminal to register to the network are improved.

title_en: Mobile phone split screen method, system, equipment and medium based on mobile phone Internet of vehicles application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile phone split screen method, a system, a computer device and a storage medium based on mobile phone car networking application, wherein the method is applied to a main driving mobile phone end and comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of performing screen projection connection with a vehicle-mounted terminal, and starting screen projection application on the vehicle-mounted terminal; acquiring a connection request from a passenger mobile phone end, and establishing a connection channel with the passenger mobile phone end; the screen-throwing interface mirror image is sent to the mobile phone end of the passenger through the connecting channel; and receiving an event processing request from the mobile phone terminal of the passenger, and sending an operation instruction to the vehicle-mounted terminal according to the event processing request, wherein the operation instruction is used for controlling the screen-throwing application. According to the technical scheme, the main driving mobile phone end directly connected with the vehicle-mounted terminal is used as a screen throwing main body, and other mobile phones perform routine operations on the vehicle-mounted terminal in a mode of sending event processing requests to the main driving mobile phone end.

title_en: Live interaction method and device, storage medium and computer equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a live interaction method, a live interaction device, a storage medium and computer equipment. The embodiment of the application receives long-press touch operation of a preset gift control; responding to long-press touch operation aiming at a preset gift control, and continuously triggering a gift instruction of a target virtual gift associated with the preset gift control, wherein the triggering frequency of the gift instruction is increased along with the increase of the duration time of the long-press touch operation; and playing the target continuous shooting animation corresponding to the target virtual gift, wherein the continuous shooting effect of the target continuous shooting animation changes along with the increase of the triggering times of the giving instructions. Therefore, continuous presentation of the target virtual gift is realized through long-press touch operation, playing of corresponding target continuous-impact animation is realized, the continuous-impact effect of the played target continuous-impact animation changes along with the pressing time of long-press touch operation, the live interaction mode and the interestingness are increased, and the diversity of live interaction is greatly improved.

title_en: Method and apparatus for transmitting and receiving packet in communication system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method of transmitting a packet by a transmitting device in a communication system, the method comprising: obtaining a source packet, the source packet in the source packet comprising a packet header including a packet identifier for distinguishing an asset associated with the source packet from another asset, the asset being a multimedia data entity associated with a unique identifier; discarding at least one source packet among source packets, wherein each source packet comprising said discarded at least one source packet comprises data related to at least one asset; generating one or more repair symbols by Forward Error Correction (FEC) encoding remaining source packets, among the source packets, except the discarded at least one source packet; generating repair data for protecting the discard information by FEC encoding; and transmitting the remaining source packets and repair packets including the one or more repair symbols and repair data for protecting discard information to a receiving device.

title_en: Method, device and storage medium for acquiring network address of MUD file
abstract_en: A method, device and storage medium for obtaining network address of MUD file are disclosed, belonging to communication technical field. In the method, a network device acquires hardware information of a terminal initiating authentication, and then acquires a network address of a MUD file of the terminal according to the hardware information of the terminal. The hardware information is one or more of the following information: identification of the access device of the terminal; an access port number of the terminal; or the type of terminal. Thus, when the terminal initiates authentication, the network device can automatically obtain the network address of the MUD file of the terminal, without the terminal transmitting the network address of the MUD file. Therefore, the deployed terminal can be smoothly integrated into the MUD management framework of the IETF RFC8520 standard, the upgrading and reconstruction work of the terminal is avoided, and the operation cost is reduced.

title_en: Encryption and multi-stage calibration method for stream media of unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an encryption and multi-stage calibration method of stream media of an unmanned aerial vehicle, which is characterized in that based on video stream data collected by the unmanned aerial vehicle, the video stream data is disassembled and packed, one of sub-video transmission data packets is randomly extracted, and part of video data A1, audio data A2 and picture data A3 are extracted; and the server correspondingly generates a random sequence matrix W containing the information of the sub-video transmission data packet n And responding to generate random numbers of four levels and four sub-servers corresponding to the four levels, wherein the four sub-servers are arranged and encrypted according to the levels, the current sub-server needs to be unlocked by adopting a key during decryption, the next sub-server starts an unlocking state, and the decryption can be continued by using the key, namely, the operations of multi-level encryption and decryption are adopted, and the sub-video transmission data packets are in a random sequence, so that the encryption level is further enhanced.

title_en: Paging method, apparatus, storage medium and communication system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a paging method, a device, a storage medium and a communication system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: and the NWDAF network element receives a data arrival notice sent by the AMF network element, wherein the data arrival notice comprises the identification of the user terminal of the arrival of the downlink data and the current time. The NWDAF network element acquires a plurality of historical position information of the user terminal in a connected state according to the identification of the user terminal, predicts a plurality of cells in which the user terminal is possibly positioned at the current time according to the plurality of historical position information, and informs the AMF network element of the plurality of cells so that the AMF network element pages the user terminal based on the plurality of cells. Therefore, the AMF network element pages the user terminal only based on the predicted cell where the user terminal is probably located currently, thereby effectively saving network signaling overhead and reducing network processing load.

title_en: Protocol system of integrated intelligent device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a protocol system of integrated intelligent equipment, which comprises a service layer, a protocol layer and intelligent equipment, wherein the intelligent equipment comprises a memory; and the service layer is associated with a memory in the intelligent equipment through the protocol layer so as to realize linkage of the service layer and the intelligent equipment. The invention enables the business system to be linked with the intelligent equipment through the protocol layer, and has simpler and easier operation and convenient maintenance.

title_en: Background music host
abstract_en: The invention discloses a background music host computer, comprising: a wiring port module for providing an interface for electrical connection with an external device; the main control module is used for receiving an input instruction and sending the input instruction to the sound source switching module or the intercom broadcasting module; the sound source switching module is used for switching the current sound source according to the input instruction; the intercom broadcasting module is used for communicating with an external system or equipment according to the input instruction to realize intercom and paging functions. The background music host provided by the invention can be interconnected with a plurality of other background music hosts when in application, so that synchronous music playing is realized, and local song information is convenient to synchronously manage; meanwhile, the background music host can also receive paging of the pager and talkback with the SIP terminal and other background music hosts, so that functions of the background music host are enriched, the intelligent degree of the background music host is improved, and the method has the advantages of simplicity in operation, convenience in management and strong applicability.

title_en: AI-driven real-time point cloud video transmission method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AI-driven real-time point cloud video transmission method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring video data information by using AI (Artificial intelligence) generating equipment, and processing the video data information to obtain point cloud video data; extracting hierarchical features of the point cloud video data, determining key point cloud features in the point cloud video frame, and transmitting the key point cloud features; and receiving the key point cloud characteristics, expanding and reconstructing the received key point cloud characteristics to obtain point cloud information similar to the original input point cloud, and forming an original point cloud video on the visual effect. According to the invention, the original point cloud video stream to be transmitted is subjected to feature extraction, only part of key point cloud features are transmitted, and finally recovery reconstruction is carried out at the receiving end, so that the effect that the original point cloud video is transmitted visually is achieved, the transmission quantity and energy consumption of the point cloud video stream can be reduced remarkably, complex multiple processing in the traditional transmission scheme is avoided, and the data transmission quantity is greatly reduced.

title_en: Method and apparatus for broadband transmission in wireless communication
abstract_en: An apparatus (e.g., an Access Point (AP) or a non-AP Station (STA)) detects an idle state of a non-primary sub-band of an operating bandwidth that includes a primary sub-band and the non-primary sub-band. The apparatus controls transmission power when performing transmission on at least the non-primary subband.

title_en: Encoder and decoder, encoding method and decoding method with profile and level dependent encoding options
abstract_en: A video encoder (101) according to an embodiment is provided. A video encoder (101) is configured for encoding a plurality of pictures of a video by generating an encoded video signal, wherein each picture of the plurality of pictures comprises original picture data. The video encoder (101) comprises a data encoder (110), the data encoder (110) being configured for generating an encoded video signal comprising encoded picture data, wherein the data encoder is configured to encode a plurality of pictures of the video as encoded picture data. Furthermore, the video encoder (101) comprises an output interface (120), the output interface (120) being configured for outputting encoded picture data for each of the plurality of pictures. In addition, a video decoder, a system, methods for encoding and decoding, computer programs and an encoded video signal according to embodiments are provided.

title_en: File decryption method, computer device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a file decryption method, a computer device and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an encrypted file and a shadow file corresponding to the encrypted file, decrypting the encrypted file and the shadow file to obtain a decrypted file and a decrypted shadow file, and determining the decryption state of the encrypted file according to the decrypted shadow file. In the method, the shadow file is adopted to replace the original encrypted file to be decrypted to determine the decryption state of the encrypted file, the shadow file is a very small file and is irrelevant to the size of the encrypted file to be decrypted, so that the speed of judging the decryption state of the shadow file is irrelevant to the size of the encrypted file to be decrypted, the decryption speed is greatly improved, and the accuracy of judging the decryption state of the encrypted file by the method is improved by judging whether the shadow file is decrypted successfully or not with extremely low error rate due to the small shadow file.

title_en: Method and device for predicting relationship between slice alarms based on relationship graph convolution network
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of communication, and discloses a slice alarm inter-relation prediction method and device based on a relation graph convolution network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring network slice alarm topology data from NSMF, wherein the network slice alarm topology data comprises physical connection relations of all nodes in the slice network topology and feature vectors containing alarm text sequences of all nodes; predicting candidate edge scores among nodes by applying a pre-trained relationship graph convolution network-based slice alarm relationship prediction model according to the physical connection relationship and the feature vector; and obtaining the logic association relation among the node alarms in the slicing network topology according to the candidate edge scores among the nodes. By means of the method, the correlation between slice alarms can be deeply mined, and the accuracy of correlation of network slice alarms is improved.

title_en: Image data transmission method, apparatus, device, storage medium, and program product
abstract_en: The disclosure provides an image data transmission method, an image data transmission device, electronic equipment, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product, and relates to the technical field of media clouds. The method comprises the following steps: receiving an acquisition request of a target image transmitted by a client, and determining the network quality of the client; when the network quality is smaller than the preset quality, performing discontinuous cutting on pixel points forming a target image according to at least one of interlacing and spacing to obtain sub-image data; and sequentially issuing the sub-image data of each part to the client according to the display sequence corresponding to the actual cutting mode. According to the method, the amount of single transmission data is reduced, meanwhile, the sub-image data with intervals can enable a user to view the effective image content of the target image approximately, so that the overall time consumption of the effective image content transmitted to the client is shortened, and the image viewing experience of the user is improved through shorter waiting time of the user.

title_en: Information transmission delay upper bound calculation method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to an information time delay upper bound computing method, a system, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: equivalent is carried out on the electric power information system, a corresponding information flow fluid model is obtained, and the information flow fluid model comprises a plurality of transmission paths and a plurality of communication ports supporting information flow transmission; based on the obtained information flow fluid model, calculating an equivalent backlog matrix of the communication port during information flow transmission; based on rated output bandwidths of all communication ports, an equivalent backlog matrix and a total time delay matrix of a transmission path in the power information system are calculated, and timeliness and effectiveness of information flow transmission in the power information system are evaluated based on the obtained equivalent backlog matrix and the total time delay matrix. The invention can be widely applied to the field of power information systems.

title_en: Method and device for solving inconsistent user plane states of core network and base station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for solving the problem that the states of user planes of a core network and a base station are inconsistent, and relates to the technical field of mobile communication; after receiving the trigger message, the core network instructs the base station of the user plane to reconstruct the PDU resource in a manner of releasing and then establishing, so that the state of the user plane of the core network and the base station is synchronized. In the embodiment of the invention, under the condition that the states of the user planes of the communication system are inconsistent, the core network reestablishes PDU resources in a first-release and then-establishment mode, so that the PDU resources are prevented from being established again by the base station of the user plane under the condition that the PDU resources exist, and the problem of inconsistent states of the user planes in the communication system is solved.

title_en: Random access method and equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to a random access method and equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the terminal equipment sends a first message to the network equipment, wherein the first message comprises a random access preamble and an uplink message, and the uplink message comprises a first identifier; the terminal equipment determines a first target radio network temporary identifier RNTI for blind detection of a first physical downlink control channel PDCCH according to the first identifier; the terminal equipment blindly detects the first PDCCH according to the first target RNTI; and the terminal equipment determines whether the contention conflict in the random access process is solved or not according to the result of blind detection of the first PDCCH or the first physical downlink shared channel PDSCH scheduled by the first PDCCH. The random access method and the device can solve the competition conflict in the two-step random access process.

title_en: Single board power-on method, main control board and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of communication, in particular to a single board power-on method, a main control board and a readable storage medium. The single board power-on method comprises the following steps: receiving a power-on request sent by a single board; wherein, the power-on request carries single board information of the single board; determining whether the single board is compatible with a main control board according to the single board information; if the single board is compatible with the main control board, the single board is electrified, so that the normal operation of the frame is not affected under the condition that the single boards with different forwarding capacities are used in the same frame.

title_en: Data service implementation method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a data service implementation method and device, and belongs to the field of communication. The method may comprise: under the condition that the first terminal and the second terminal establish call connection, connecting to a preset server, and sending first identification information to the preset server; receiving call matching information sent by the preset server, wherein the call matching information is sent by the preset server under the condition that the second terminal is connected to the preset server, and the first terminal and the second terminal confirm successful call matching based on the first identification information and the second identification information, and the second identification information is sent to the preset server by the second terminal; and performing data interaction with the second terminal through the preset server. According to the method and the device, the first terminal and the second terminal can perform data interaction through the preset server in the process of communicating with the second terminal, and the method and the device are very convenient and fast.

title_en: Method for output layer aggregation of multi-layer video code stream
abstract_en: Systems and methods for encoding and decoding are provided. A method includes receiving an encoded video bitstream, the encoded video bitstream including a set of parameters and video data divided into a plurality of layers; deriving at least one first syntax element from the plurality of layers specifying at least one first layer to be output in an output layer set, and at least one second syntax element indicating profile level information for the output layer set, based on the parameter set; decoding a portion of the video data of the encoded video bitstream corresponding to the output layer set based on information derived from the parameter set.

title_en: Authority transfer method and system for digital key offline condition of trusted execution environment
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for transferring authority of a digital key offline condition of a trusted execution environment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step S1: a cloud root key and a vehicle identification code are imported in a vehicle end production line stage, the vehicle identification code and an SE ID are bound, a root certificate is filled into the SE, and a vehicle end root key is generated; step S2: generating a vehicle-end digital key based on the vehicle-end root key and deriving the vehicle-end digital key; step S3: generating a mobile phone terminal digital key, and authenticating the generated mobile phone terminal digital key and the mobile phone terminal digital key; step S4: and through the technical characteristics of the trusted execution environment and the trusted clock, the authority transfer of the digital key under the offline condition is realized based on the generated vehicle-end root key and the vehicle-end digital key.

title_en: Method, host, communication system and storage medium for providing challenge to device
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides methods, hosts, communication systems, and storage media that provide challenges to devices. The described example relates to a method for providing a challenge to a device, comprising compiling a first challenge based on a first random value and a parameter; compiling a second challenge based on the second random value, the parameter, and based on the first challenge or any intermediate result thereof; and providing the first challenge and the second challenge to the device. Furthermore, a corresponding device, a system comprising such a device and a computer program product are proposed.

title_en: Intranet data access management method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for managing intranet data access, comprising a server receiving an access request of an extranet user; the access request comprises the position information of the user and the IP information of the user; and the server verifies the position information of the user and the IP information of the user contained in the access request, and directly regards the user as an intranet user when the position information is in a first position range and the IP information is in the first IP range. The invention can solve the problem that the user has trouble accessing the intranet when the user is in the intranet physical range but not in the intranet network.

title_en: End-to-end path discovery and use method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method and a device for discovering and using an end-to-end path, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the source end equipment sends M path discovery request messages carrying different labels to the sink end equipment; the label is used as a factor for selecting the path by the path discovery request message and the data message; after receiving the M path discovery request messages, the sink end equipment sends path discovery response messages to the source end equipment; the path discovery response message comprises path quality information corresponding to at least one label in the M labels; after receiving the path discovery response message, the source end device sends a data message to the sink end device; the data message comprises a label of a path discovery request message, the path quality information of which meets the quality requirement of the data message; and the sink terminal equipment receives the data message. The source device in the above technical solution can forward the data traffic to different paths according to the received path quality information, so as to improve the network throughput.

title_en: Data access method, gateway device, server and data access system
abstract_en: The invention provides a data access method, gateway equipment, a server and a data access system, wherein the data access method comprises the following steps: the gateway equipment receives a first access request sent by a client; the first access request is sent to a second server, so that service data generated by the second server according to the first access request is obtained; when the gateway equipment monitors that the second server fails to respond to the first access request, the first access request is sent to the first server, and the first server synchronizes service data generated by the second server after the second server is online and responds to the received access request; and feeding back the received service data generated by the first server according to the first access request to the client. The data access method, the gateway equipment, the server and the data access system provided by the invention can solve the problem of client access failure caused by the existence of various potential faults at the beginning of server upgrading.

title_en: Self-adaptive double-standard component extremum comparison decision feedback equalization circuit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-adaptive double-standard component extremum contrast decision feedback equalization circuit, which comprises a two-tap filter, a threshold self-adaptive unit, a comparison circuit, a time delay unit, a double-standard amplitude equalization decision circuit, a coefficient updating unit and a buffer; the input end of the two-tap filter is used for receiving an input signal VIN, the output ends of the two-tap filter are respectively connected with the input end of the threshold self-adaptive unit and the input end of the comparison circuit, the output end of the comparison circuit is respectively connected with the input end of the time delay unit, the input end of the double-standard amplitude value equalization decision circuit and the input end of the buffer, and the buffer is used for outputting the signal VOUT; the output end of the time delay unit and the output end of the threshold self-adaptive unit are both connected with the input end of the double-standard amplitude value equalization judging circuit, the output end of the double-standard amplitude value equalization judging circuit is connected with the input end of the coefficient updating unit, and the output end of the coefficient updating unit is in feedback connection with the input end of the two-tap filter. The signal transmission error rate is reduced, and the design structure of the decision feedback equalization circuit is optimized.

title_en: Abnormity analysis method and device based on association graph
abstract_en: According to the anomaly analysis method and device based on the association diagram, the aggregation anomalies of different devices of different manufacturers are obtained; generating an association table according to the historical aggregation exception; constructing a current association diagram containing the current aggregation abnormity according to the association table and the device network topological diagram corresponding to each historical aggregation abnormity on the network; in the current association diagram, selecting a preset number of threat paths according to the ranking of the threat degrees from large to small; and combining a preset number of threat paths to generate a threat graph and sending the threat graph to a server. Security personnel can be assisted in discerning attack scenarios. According to the method and the device, the association table is generated according to the association among the aggregation anomalies, and the current association graph is constructed by combining the network topological graph, so that the problem of inaccurate analysis caused by complex association is solved, meanwhile, the threat paths are selected according to the threat degree to form the threat graph for analysis, and the accuracy of analyzing the complex association anomalies is improved.

title_en: Network server request identification
abstract_en: A proxy server is disclosed for receiving a request from a client to a web server and a response from the web server to the client corresponding to the request. The request is encapsulated and the encapsulated request is received at the proxy server. The encapsulated request is read at the proxy server. Metadata is added to the response corresponding to the encapsulated request at the proxy server. The metadata may be based on the read encapsulated request or corresponding response.

title_en: ETC application key updating method, device and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an ETC application key updating method, device and system.
