The method comprises the following steps: determining a transmission key factor according to the random number and the elliptic parameter; generating a transmission secret key according to the elliptic hash value, the transmission secret key length and elliptic element coordinates corresponding to the transmission secret key factors; receiving a key update request from a mobile phone client, encrypting ETC key instruction plaintext in the key update request according to a transmission key to generate ETC key instruction ciphertext, and encrypting a transmission key factor according to a secure public key to generate a key envelope; sending the ETC key instruction ciphertext and the key envelope to the ETC charging equipment through the mobile phone client, so that the ETC charging equipment updates the ETC application key according to the key update request; the key update request is obtained by ETC charging equipment through ETC key instruction ciphertext and key envelope, so that the full life cycle management and monitoring of the ETC key can be realized, and the safety and convenience of highway management are improved.

title_en: Host survival detection method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a host survival detection method, a host survival detection device, computer equipment and a storage medium. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: acquiring various detection packets and a detection sequence of a current time period, and sending the detection packets to a target host to be detected according to the detection sequence of the current time period; when the periodic adjustment operation is triggered, calculating the detection efficiency of various detection packets in the current time period, and determining the detection sequence of the next time period according to the calculation result; and returning to execute the operation of sending the detection packet to the target host to be detected according to the detection sequence of the current time period until all the target hosts are detected. According to the technical scheme, the detection sequence is dynamically adjusted in real time by adopting various detection packets according to the detection results of the detection packets, so that more surviving hosts can be detected by fewer data packets, and the accuracy and efficiency of host survival detection can be improved.

title_en: Wireless communication device and wireless communication method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention avoids the occurrence of unnecessary data transmission and waiting time in joint transmission using an access point. A wireless communication apparatus according to the present invention includes a communication control unit and a signal generation unit. The communication control unit generates control information for requesting communication result information as to whether or not reception is successful in the transmission destination device when the first joint communication is carried out in association with another wireless communication device. The signal generation unit generates a signal including the control information generated by the communication control unit as a signal for facilitating a second combined communication that is combined with another wireless communication device.

title_en: Network security protocol vulnerability analysis method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a network security protocol vulnerability analysis method, and belongs to the technical field of network security automation analysis. Firstly, deducing a state machine of a target protocol; then extracting an effective execution path (state transition path) of the target state machine; performing formal modeling on the state transition path based on application Pi calculation to show the behavior and interaction of protocol participants, and performing the formal modeling on the state transition of each step of the state machine to complete the automatic modeling of the state machine transition path realized by the security protocol program; and automatically converting the target protocol into a symbolic model which can be used for formal analysis, and realizing the automatic conversion from the protocol state machine to the formal analysis script. Finally, a formalized analysis tool is used for carrying out vulnerability automatic analysis and excavation on the protocol. The invention avoids the problem of dependence on manual analysis, can automatically analyze the vulnerability of the sample by utilizing formal analysis, and greatly improves the analysis efficiency.

title_en: Rebound shell detection method in linux system, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rebound shell detection method, terminal equipment and storage medium in a linux system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1: constructing a trust library according to the network connection information of the network connection trusted object and the process information of the process trusted object; s2: capturing newly established outbound network connections in the system; s3: performing first trust library checking, if the checking is qualified, judging that the checking is legal, and ending; otherwise, entering S4; s4: associating the captured outbound network connection to a process; s5: performing rebound shell examination on the characteristic information of the associated process, and if the examination conditions are all met, judging that the process is a rebound shell process, and ending; otherwise, entering S6; s6: performing a second trust library check, if the check is qualified, judging that the trust library is legal, and ending; otherwise, the shell process is judged to be rebounded, and the process is ended. The invention takes the external connection behavior of the rebound shell as the basis and the trust library as the assistance, and can improve the hit rate and the accuracy of rebound shell inspection by combining the basic characteristic information of the rebound shell process.

title_en: Mobile relay control method, relay and communication system
abstract_en: The application provides a mobile relay control method, which is applied to a relay in a communication system, wherein the communication system comprises a plurality of terminals and at least one relay, each relay is movable, and the method comprises the following steps: the method and the device for the mobile relay technology have the advantages that the position information of each terminal and each relay is obtained, the target terminal is detected according to the position information, under the condition that the target terminal is detected to be located outside the effective coverage range and located in the maximum relay range of at least one relay, the first movement strategy is determined according to the position information, and the position of the terminal is controlled according to the first movement strategy.

title_en: Mobility management method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a mobility management method, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that first network equipment receives a first message, wherein the first message comprises information for indicating a target cell; the first network device determines whether to allow the terminal device to access the target cell according to at least one of the following information: and the context information of the terminal equipment and the resource state information of the target cell. By utilizing the resource state information comprising a plurality of cells and/or the context information of the terminal equipment to determine whether the terminal equipment is allowed to access the cells, the judgment can be made before the terminal equipment accesses the target cell, thereby improving the success rate of access, avoiding resource waste and realizing centralized control of the plurality of cells.

title_en: Method, medium and equipment for reselecting relay UE
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to a method for reselecting relay UE, which comprises the following steps: discovering a first relay UE and selecting to establish a first direct link with the first relay UE, the first direct link being used for direct communication between a remote UE and the first relay UE; and measuring a signal from the first relay UE received through the first direct link and obtaining a measurement result of the signal; and when the measurement result is smaller than the first threshold value, performing the relay UE reselection. Embodiments of the present application also relate to a machine-readable storage medium and a user equipment.

title_en: Code block group acknowledgement feedback technique in wireless communications
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communications are described that support group-based acknowledgment feedback techniques. Two or more different downlink transmission groups may each have associated Transport Block (TB) level or Code Block Group (CBG) level group-based acknowledgement feedback, and the base station may send downlink control information to the UE indicating one or more parameters for determining which downlink transmissions to report in the TB level, CBG level, or a combination thereof in the group-based feedback. Based on the parameters in the downlink control information, the UE may determine feedback to report and timing to send the feedback to the base station.

title_en: Electric power transmission and transformation safety prompting system and method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of power systems, and provides a power transmission and transformation safety prompting system and method based on the Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring various basic data of the electric power transmission and transformation equipment; inputting each item of basic data into a data abnormity judgment library, and judging each item of basic data by the data abnormity judgment library; marking the basic data for judging the abnormality as abnormal data, and inputting the abnormal data into an equipment maintenance library; and inputting the abnormal data into a historical abnormal database, wherein the historical abnormal database comprises the abnormal information of each time and a corresponding solution. The equipment maintenance library can output maintenance information corresponding to the power transmission and transformation equipment generating abnormal data, so that maintenance personnel can be quickly informed to maintain; in addition, the historical abnormal database can output the optimal reference solution information, so that even if the maintenance personnel do not arrive in time, the working personnel can process according to the reference solution information.

title_en: Coexistence processing method and system for multiple communication systems of Internet of things chip
abstract_en: The invention provides a coexistence processing method and a coexistence processing system for various communication systems of an Internet of things chip, which coordinate coexistence between different communication protocols by using a simple coexistence processing system running on a hardware driving layer. The coexistence processing system is respectively connected with the hardware driving layer of the high-priority communication protocol and the hardware driving layer of the low-priority communication protocol, can receive messages sent by the hardware driving layer of the high-priority communication protocol, and controls the opening and the termination of the hardware driving layer of the low-priority communication protocol. Based on the scheme of the invention, the physical layer and the upper layer of each communication protocol do not need to process coexistence among multiple communication protocols, the terminal application software can call two or more than two communication systems simultaneously, the use states of various communication systems do not need to be inquired, the development of software application is facilitated, and the software development period is obviously shortened. The invention reduces the interference among various communication protocols and effectively improves the energy utilization rate and the communication rate of the chip of the Internet of things.

title_en: Intelligent automation device, method and storage medium for user interaction
abstract_en: A system and method for controlling television user interaction using a virtual assistant is disclosed. The virtual assistant may interact with the television set-top box to control content displayed on the television. A voice input for a virtual assistant may be received from a device having a microphone. The user intent may be determined from the voice input, and the virtual assistant may perform tasks according to the user intent, including causing playback of media on the television. The virtual assistant interactions may be displayed on a television in an interface that expands or contracts to occupy a minimum amount of space while conveying desired information. The user intent may be determined from the voice input using a plurality of devices associated with a plurality of displays and information communicated to the user. In some examples, virtual assistant query suggestions may be provided to a user based on media content displayed on a display.

title_en: Digital intelligent teaching platform
abstract_en: The digital intelligent teaching platform comprises a platform main body, an automatic lifting device, a wireless transmission device, an attendance system, a teacher identification module and an intelligent drawer device, wherein the platform main body comprises the automatic lifting device, the wireless transmission device, the attendance system, the teacher identification module and the intelligent drawer device; the automatic lifting device comprises a regulation and control lifting module, a courseware playing instruction module and a manual control module; the attendance system comprises a face capturing camera, a human body infrared sensor and a camera capturing module; intelligent drawer device, including intelligent flexible module, drawer main part. The platform main body has an automatic lifting function and a wireless receiving and transmitting function of courseware of a teacher, so that the platform main body is prevented from blocking the sight of students in the front row and the back row for watching the courseware, and the platform main body is provided with an attendance system for carrying out student attendance statistics through the matching correction of the face capture camera and the human body infrared sensor; monitoring the listening and speaking states of students through a camera capture module; the intelligent drawer extension and retraction device has the functions of teacher identity identification and intelligent drawer extension and retraction; the blackboard-writing desk has the function of fixing the platform panel in an inclined manner, and is convenient for a teacher to write on a blackboard.

title_en: Workflow task unloading method and system in mobile edge computing environment
abstract_en: A workflow task unloading method and a system in a mobile edge computing environment, wherein the workflow task unloading method in the mobile edge computing environment comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring information of wireless equipment, calculating a channel gain value, and constructing a channel model; s2: generating an unloading calculation mode and a local calculation mode, and obtaining data calculation rates in the two calculation modes; s3: constructing a workflow task unloading model and setting constraint conditions; s4: constructing a Markov decision model and determining an unloading strategy function; s5: and solving an unloading strategy function by adopting the SAC model to unload the workflow task. The computing efficiency of the workflow task, the time distribution of the workflow task transmission and the time distribution among the wireless devices are optimized by solving an optimal workflow task unloading strategy, so that the computing efficiency of the workflow task and the processing capacity of the wireless devices are greatly improved, and the experience of users of the wireless devices is improved.

title_en: Method, device and server for monitoring cash security of bank outlets
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device and a server for supervising cash security of a bank outlet. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of acquiring account data input by terminal equipment, ticket data sent by currency detection equipment and cash data of tail box equipment in the current period of cash transaction in real time; determining whether the cash safety is abnormal or not according to the account data, the ticket data and the cash data; and sending reminding information to the management equipment under the condition that the cash safety is determined to be abnormal. The method and the device can find out cash transaction in time, reduce workload and work difficulty of investigation, and improve safety of cash of bank outlets.

title_en: Terminal management method, device and centralized management system
abstract_en: A terminal management method, a device and a centralized management system relate to the technical field of communication, and the terminal management method comprises the following steps: when a target terminal accesses a centralized management and control system, acquiring an access certificate of a target access point; then, after the access authentication is successfully carried out according to the access certificate, a return path from the first console to the target access point and a target path from the target terminal to the target access point are determined according to a preset path label mapping relation; then, splicing the target path and the return path to obtain the full path information from the target terminal to the first console; and finally, a communication session is established between the first control console and the full-path information, so that the first control console manages the target terminal through the communication session, the terminal management control can be realized, gateway equipment is not needed, the exposure of the actual positions and IP of the terminal and the management terminal is avoided, and the communication safety is ensured.

title_en: BBRv2 bandwidth detection method and system based on time delay
abstract_en: A time delay-based BBRv2 bandwidth detection method comprises the following steps: adding a state variable reflecting network delay variation in a BBRv2 path model; modifying the original ProbeBW state of the BBRv2 to form a new ProbeBW state, comprising: the BBRv2 enters a ProbeTry state once every 8 RTTs; BBRv2 sets paging _ gain to X in the first RTT of the ProbeTry state; BBrv2 sets paging _ gain to 1 at the second RTT of the ProbeTry state, and BBrv2 determines MinRTT at the end of the second RTT curr_rtt ≥γ×MinRTT prev_rtt If the result is true, entering a ProbeDown state and setting the paging _ gain as Y, otherwise entering the next step; BBRv2 compares the current MinRTT curr_rtt Save to MinRTT before_probe Then entering into Probe state, when the Probe state is finished, BBrv2 judges MinRTT curr_rtt ＞γ×MinRTT before_probe And if the result is true, entering a ProbeDown state and setting the paging _ gain to 0.75, otherwise, repeating the step.

title_en: Apparatus and method for deriving telemetry data
abstract_en: A network device and method for deriving network telemetry data is disclosed. The network device is configured to receive at least one data message suitable for telemetry export, classify the at least one data message based on predefined rules to obtain a classification for each data message, generate a telemetry report for each data message in the at least one data message, and export the at least one telemetry report at an export rate based on the classification for each of the at least one data message. In this way, a dynamic adaptive telemetry data derivation strategy is provided that ensures network performance while minimizing the overhead due to the implementation of the measurement mechanism.

title_en: SGX-based server cluster log acquisition method and device
abstract_en: The application relates to a server cluster log acquisition method and device based on SGX. And the remote log acquisition and processing code is placed in a trusted execution environment, the log acquisition device is connected with all BMCs in the cluster by a program, DH key exchange protocols are respectively carried out with the BMCs in the cluster, and communication keys are respectively established. The BMC proves that the program of the log obtaining device runs in the trusted enclave through the remote proving function of the SGX, then the log obtaining device logs in all BMCs in the cluster, and after the identity authentication is successful, the log of the BMCs in the cluster is obtained through the communication key. The log data of the distributed server cluster is uniformly collected, and the correlation analysis function is realized; the security requirements of encrypting the log transmission process, encrypting the log processing process, encrypting the log storage process and the like are realized; the method realizes classification and grading of the logs, realizes classification and storage of the logs and improves the utilization rate of the logs.

title_en: Frequency domain generalized linear equalization method, device and system and nonvolatile storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of communication and discloses a frequency domain generalized linear equalization method, a device and a system and a nonvolatile storage medium. In the method, when a signal to be processed is received, a complex value of the signal to be processed is obtained, a conjugate item of the signal to be processed is obtained according to the complex value, the obtained conjugate item and the obtained complex value are used as input signals and input into a frequency domain generalized linear equalizer, a frequency domain error vector of the input signals is calculated by the frequency domain generalized linear equalizer, an initial frequency domain compensation coefficient is updated according to the frequency domain error vector, a target frequency domain compensation coefficient suitable for performing equalization processing on the current signal to be processed is obtained, equalization processing in a time domain is converted into equalization processing in the frequency domain, therefore, the implementation complexity is greatly reduced, the signal to be processed is finally compensated and/or restored based on the equalized target frequency domain compensation coefficient, and therefore the problems of imbalance between IQs and IQskew are solved.

title_en: Method and device for displaying on-stream interactive animation and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of network live broadcast, and provides a method and a device for displaying an open-cast interactive animation and computer equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: responding to a first interactive playing instruction, and acquiring an interactive playing identifier and an open play background image corresponding to the interactive playing identifier; wherein, a plurality of target pixel blocks are displayed in the open-cast background image, and an open-cast interactive graph in the open-cast background image is formed based on the target pixel blocks; displaying the open-cast background image in the client; generating a start interactive animation path according to the position information of the target pixel block; and responding to a hover trigger instruction on the open-cast interactive graph, acquiring display data of the open-cast interactive animation path, and displaying the open-cast interactive animation on the open-cast background image according to the open-cast interactive animation path and the display data of the open-cast interactive animation path. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device can effectively improve the interface interaction experience of the user and avoid the loss of the user.

title_en: Communication module switching method, system and medium for RK3399 mainboard
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and a medium for switching communication modules for a RK3399 mainboard, wherein the method comprises the following steps: configuring a module switching module and a communication driver package on an RK3399 mainboard; configuring a communication module and a communication rate matching set; setting a resource occupation threshold; detecting system process information and acquiring process requirements; setting a module switching mode based on the communication rate matching set, the resource occupation threshold, the system process information and the process requirement; performing a communication module switching operation based on the module switching module, the communication driver package, the communication module, and the module switching mode; the invention can enable the terminal equipment carrying the RK3399 mainboard to intelligently recognize the communication requirement of the current terminal equipment according to different system process conditions, and further call the RK3399 mainboard to automatically switch between the 4G module and the 5G module according to the communication requirement.

title_en: Method and apparatus for adding notifications related to user equipment multicast group and leave
abstract_en: Methods, apparatuses, and computer program products are described that facilitate sending and receiving notifications related to multicast groups or multicast streams that user devices are added to or leaving a network. A method may include: receiving, from a session controller, a request to report when a Protocol Data Unit (PDU) session is added to/removed from a downlink replication tree associated with an Internet protocol multicast stream; determining whether the PDU session has been added to or removed from a downlink replication tree associated with an Internet protocol multicast flow; and in response to the determination, sending a message to a session management function indicating that the PDU session has been added to or removed from the downlink replication tree. The message may include an internet protocol address associated with a source of the added or removed multicast stream and/or the multicast destination of the internet protocol multicast stream.

title_en: Data transmission method, device, communication equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosed embodiments relate to a data transmission method, a data transmission device, a communication device and a storage medium. Selecting one transmission connection from a plurality of transmission connections for transmitting a beacon frame carrying downlink connection indication information, wherein the downlink connection indication information is used for indicating the transmission connection with cached downlink data in the plurality of transmission connections; transmitting the beacon frame over the selected transport connection.

title_en: Website safety protection method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to a website safety protection method and a website safety protection device, which are characterized in that at least one target IP address for sending an access request, URL information and error state information corresponding to the access request sent by the target IP address are determined according to access request data of a website; according to URL information and error state information corresponding to the access request sent by the target IP address, performing risk level assessment on the target IP address to obtain risk level information corresponding to the target IP address; and carrying out safety protection response processing on the target IP address according to the dangerous grade information corresponding to the target IP address. Therefore, complex algorithm or model with large calculation amount can be avoided, third party service dependence and human intervention are reduced as much as possible, and meanwhile, the system detection speed is improved and the resource load is reduced.

title_en: Authentication method, authentication device, authentication equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an authentication method, an authentication device, authentication equipment and a storage medium, wherein the authentication method comprises the following steps: when a user corresponding to a user identifier meets the authentication condition list, the target identity authentication end encrypts authentication data and absolute authentication data corresponding to the authentication data by using a key to obtain encrypted authentication, and an application end does not store a decryption key corresponding to the key, wherein the authentication data comprises data used for authentication by the user end; the target identity authentication end signs the authentication request and the encrypted identity to obtain a second signature, assembles the authentication request, the encrypted identity and the second signature into a target identity, and sends the target identity to a user end; and the user sends the target identification to the application end. User privacy disclosure is prevented to some extent.

title_en: Control method and system for picture display of multi-channel video
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a system for controlling the picture display of a plurality of paths of videos, wherein the method for controlling the picture display of the plurality of paths of videos comprises the following steps: for each display area, determining the position coordinates of the display area on the display interface, and associating the position coordinates with one path of video source to generate a first association item; calling an open graphic library, traversing all the first association items by the open graphic library, and adding picture textures for each first association item to obtain a second association item; the open graphic library transmits the second associated item to the Surface corresponding to the display interface so as to display the picture texture in the corresponding display area of the display interface, thereby reducing the creation quantity of the Surface.

title_en: Call switching method and device, computer readable storage medium and processor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a call switching method, a call switching device, a computer readable storage medium and a processor. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: when a broadband service channel for the communication of the broadband module is abnormal, the narrowband module scans a base station in a narrowband system to obtain narrowband base station information, and synchronizes the narrowband base station information to the broadband module; the broadband module reports the call information and the narrowband base station information to the broadband system so that the broadband system synchronizes the call information and the narrowband base station information to the narrowband system; the broadband module receives an allocation result acquired by the broadband system, wherein the allocation result is a narrowband service channel allocated by the narrowband system based on the call information and the narrowband base station information; the wideband module synchronizes the allocation result to the narrowband module and switches the call to a narrowband service channel. The invention solves the technical problem that voice data is easy to lose when the broadband network is switched to the narrowband network with poor quality in the related technology.

title_en: Railway freight vehicle shunting and grouping method and system based on UWB positioning technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to a railway freight car shunting and grouping method and system based on UWB positioning technology, wherein the method comprises the following steps of obtaining the time of pulse signals transmitted by positioning tags reaching each positioning base station; the method comprises the steps of obtaining coordinates of each positioning base station, obtaining the coordinates of the positioning labels according to the time of pulse signals transmitted by the positioning labels reaching each positioning base station and the coordinates of each positioning base station, and carrying out shunting grouping according to the coordinates of the positioning labels. The invention can acquire the real-time positions of the locomotive and the vehicles in real time, and feed back the real-time positions to the locomotive cab when the locomotive and the vehicles to be grouped are approaching, so that the vehicle hanging speed is ensured to be lower than the set range, and the shunting safety is ensured.

title_en: Video cloud transcoding and distribution combined decision method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a video cloud transcoding and distribution joint decision method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical data of a cloud platform; calculating transcoding cost based on the cost of the transcoding template, and calculating flow cost based on the video code rate to obtain a cost function; calculating a code rate parameter based on the video code rate, calculating a delay parameter based on the transcoding delay and the distribution delay of the audience, and calculating a QoE function based on the code rate parameter and the delay parameter; the cloud platform is preset with a plurality of constraint conditions, and a penalty function is calculated according to the constraint conditions; calculating an incentive value according to the cost function, the QoE function and the penalty function; if the utility value scheme is adopted, all state action pairs with the same state as the current state and the maximum utility value among the state action pairs are obtained; updating the utility value of the current state action pair; and executing the action in the state action pair, calculating the state action pair and the reward value after the first time length, and updating the utility value corresponding to the state action pair of the cloud platform after the first time length.

title_en: Signature verification method and device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a signature verification method, a signature verification device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the signer generates a first private key component and sends a certificateless public key application to the key manager; the key management party generates a second public key component and a second private key component based on the signature party identifier and the first public key component and returns the second public key component and the second private key component to the signature party; under the condition that the signer passes the verification of the second public key component and the second private key component, the signer identifies the signer and synthesizes a signature public key and a signature private key; the signer generates a signature result based on the target message, the signature public key and the signature private key and sends the target message, the signature public key and the signature result to the signer; the signature verifier verifies the signature result based on the pre-stored public key of the key management party and the signature public key to obtain the signature verification result, so that the process of signature verification without certificates is realized, and the security is high.

title_en: Fault-tolerant prefabricating method for deterministic network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault-tolerant prefabricating method for a deterministic network, which comprises the following steps of 1: the fault-tolerant prefabrication module carries out DetNet flow identification detection on a control plane of a deterministic network and carries out historical data statistics; step 2: according to the statistical historical data, a prediction model based on an artificial intelligence algorithm is combined to predict whether future data need to be subjected to the DetNet flow copying operation, if so, the DetNet flow copying operation is configured and issued, and a path and measures for data packet loss are guided; and step 3: and the path planning module guides the global network flow path by utilizing centralized path setting by means of a control plane of the deterministic network. The invention realizes reliability, ensures time delay, saves network bandwidth resources, provides more link resources for non-DetNet flow, and provides a more reliable and rapid network guarantee.

title_en: Dance video generation method, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a dance video generation method, dance video generation equipment and a dance video storage medium. Specifically, the models can comprehensively predict the dance picture including the dance gesture in the next frame based on information such as audio, picture action, rhythm and the like, and the predicted dance gesture can realize stepping and sticking, so that the reality and the accuracy of the video picture are improved. Meanwhile, the scheme realizes the personalized customization of the dance video aiming at the songs selected by the user, and can provide the dance video which is more suitable for the preference of the user. Accordingly, the dance video generation device and the storage medium provided by the application have the technical effects.

title_en: Method and system for inspecting equipment of Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to an equipment inspection method and system of the Internet of things, which are used for carrying out multi-dimensional inspection on equipment conditions in an area, judging the running health degree of equipment per se, further judging the health degree of the type of equipment, and evaluating the running health degree of the equipment in the whole area; the equipment inspection management system is used for comprehensively managing the equipment and the inspection thereof, the equipment of the Internet of things is used for realizing different functions, the self-inspection data are fed back to the equipment inspection management system, and the equipment inspection terminal is used for carrying out manual inspection on the equipment and feeding back the inspection data to the equipment inspection management system; the equipment inspection management system, the Internet of things equipment and the equipment inspection terminal are connected to the same local area network. According to the method, in the dimension of the project, the running health degree of the equipment of the whole project can be accurately estimated, on one hand, various equipment suppliers can be compared and estimated, and on the other hand, whether the intelligent system and the equipment of the project are actually used in a landing mode or not can be estimated, so that the intelligent performance and the value of the Internet of things can be guaranteed.

title_en: Service processing method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a service processing method and a device, wherein the service processing method comprises the steps of being applied to terminal equipment, wherein the terminal equipment is provided with equipment application, a service container and a receiving and sending client side, the service container is used for carrying out equipment login processing and service scene subscription processing of the terminal equipment, the method comprises the steps that the receiving and sending client side receives service information of subscribing a service scene sent by the service side through a data link, the receiving and sending client side responds to initialization calling of the equipment application to establish the data link, the service information is transmitted into the equipment application to display the service information through the equipment application, and if the service information is triggered, the service container is called to obtain service detail data corresponding to the service information.

title_en: Base station, terminal, transmission method and reception method
abstract_en: The base station includes: a control circuit configured to determine a downlink control channel signal allocation method in at least one of a first period before an opportunity of carrier sensing and a second period after the opportunity of carrier sensing, based on information on at least one of the number of blind decodings for the downlink control channel signal and the number of resources for channel estimation; and a transmission circuit configured to transmit the downlink control channel signal based on the determined allocation method.

title_en: Movement detection method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of monitoring, and provides a mobile detection method, a mobile detection device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an image frame monitored by a camera, wherein a wireless communication module is arranged in the camera; judging whether a moving target body exists in the detection area or not according to the image frame, wherein the moving target body comprises a human body and/or an object; if the mobile target body exists in the detection area, acquiring channel state information of the wireless communication module; judging whether the moving target body exists in the detection area or not according to the channel state information; and if the mobile target body exists in the detection area according to the channel state information, triggering corresponding operation. By the method, the accuracy of operation triggering can be improved.

title_en: Alliance chain transaction privacy protection method based on label encryption and zero knowledge proof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a alliance chain transaction privacy protection method based on label encryption and zero knowledge proof, and belongs to the technical field of blockchain privacy protection. The method adopts the modes of label encryption and zero knowledge proof, solves the problem of user identity information leakage in the alliance chain and the problem of malicious transaction in the alliance chain. The method provides a special transaction mechanism, and can effectively protect user identity privacy data under the condition of supporting audit. The method not only allows the user to carry out anonymous transactions in the alliance chain, but also realizes distributed efficient tracking of suspicious transactions, and meanwhile, effective supervision and identity privacy protection are achieved, and balance of the two aspects is realized.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and computer storage medium for determining target cell
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method, a device, equipment and a computer storage medium for determining a target cell, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring cell information of each SIM card of a terminal from a network side to obtain a cell list, periodically measuring signal intensity values of cells in the cell list through at least one antenna used by each SIM card respectively, fully utilizing network searching and measuring capability of the terminal, finding a plurality of networks at a certain place at a certain moment as far as possible, arranging according to the size of the signal intensity values to obtain an alternative network information table, and determining a cell measured by an antenna corresponding to the largest signal intensity value in the alternative network information table as the target cell when communication of the SIM card is abnormal.

title_en: Cloud programming system, method, equipment and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of communication of the Internet of things and discloses a cloud programming system, which comprises a terminal and a cloud editor, wherein communication connection is established between the terminal and the cloud editor, a terminal main service communication unit is arranged in the terminal, and a cloud editor basic unit and a cloud script editor are arranged in the cloud editor; the terminal main service communication unit is used for sending the running script in the terminal to the cloud editor basic unit; the cloud editor base unit is used for synchronizing the received running script to the Yun Jiaoben editor; and the Yun Jiaoben editor is used for editing and running the running script in real time and storing the edited and running script to the terminal. The invention also discloses a cloud programming method, cloud programming equipment and a computer storage medium. According to the cloud programming system, the development and operation cost of communication of the Internet of things is reduced.

title_en: Equipment management method and device
abstract_en: A device management method and apparatus, wherein the method comprises: the first device transmits a scan signal, and the answering device transmits an answer signal to the first device based on the received scan signal. The first device determines that the area of the response device recorded in the system device information acquired by the first device from the second device is incorrect according to the received response signal, and sends an update instruction to the second device, wherein the update instruction is used for instructing the second device to update the area of the response device recorded in the system device information stored by the second device. The technical scheme is beneficial to improving the accuracy of the area of each Internet of things device recorded in the system device information stored in the second device, and when the terminal device receives the control instruction from the user, the terminal device can effectively control the Internet of things device corresponding to the control instruction based on the more accurate system device information recorded in the second device.

title_en: Communication control method, device, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a communication control method, a device, a system and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of mobile communication. The communication control method comprises the following steps: in response to the fact that the new air interface NR terminal in the connection state moves to the boundary of the coverage range of the dynamic spectrum sharing DSS base station and the long term evolution LTE base station, determining resource occupation information of the NR terminal; and sending an intelligent scheduling request to the LTE base station, wherein the intelligent scheduling request comprises resource occupation information of the NR terminal, so that the LTE base station adjusts the resource configuration of the LTE base station according to the intelligent scheduling request, and the adjusted resource configuration avoids resources occupied by the NR terminal. According to the embodiment of the invention, under the condition that DSS and LTE base station PRB resources are not wasted, the networking flexibility and the resource utilization rate are greatly improved, and uplink and downlink interference is reduced.

title_en: Industrial Internet of things equipment fault detection method based on fog computing architecture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault detection method for industrial Internet of things equipment based on a fog computing architecture, which comprises the industrial Internet of things equipment, an edge gateway and a fog server; the fog server is provided with a data preprocessing submodule, a feature extraction submodule and a fault classification submodule; after the fog server receives the operation data of the industrial Internet of things equipment through the edge gateway, the data preprocessing submodule preprocesses the relevant data and converts the one-dimensional time sequence signal into a two-dimensional image; the characteristic extraction submodule learns the characteristics of the time sequence signal from the two-dimensional image through a convolutional neural network and sends the characteristics to the fault classification submodule; the fault classification submodule comprises a plurality of fault classification models and trains the fault classification models by adopting the characteristics of the time sequence signals; the trained fault classification model runs on the fog server, and the running state of the industrial Internet of things equipment is monitored in real time.

title_en: Data conversion method of multi-party secure computing protocol
abstract_en: The invention provides a data conversion method of a multi-party secure computing protocol, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of building an SPDZ system and an ABY3 system, generating a relation random number through each computing node of the ABY3 system, secretly sharing the generated relation random number through each computing node of the ABY3 system to obtain a secret sharing factor of the relation random number, sending the secret sharing factor to the SPDZ system, respectively calculating temporary conversion factors by each participant of the SPDZ system according to the secret sharing factor computing node, sending the temporary conversion factors to each computing node of the ABY3 system, summing the temporary conversion factors through each computing node of the ABY3 system to obtain a component of the secret sharing factor, and setting the secret sharing factor of each computing node according to the component. The data conversion method of the multi-party secure computing protocol provided by the invention can realize interconnection and intercommunication of different privacy computing systems based on SPDZ and ABY 3.

title_en: Radio frequency distance determination
abstract_en: A method of determining a distance between a radio frequency device (2) and a target (18) is disclosed, wherein the radio frequency device (2) receives a radio frequency signal (16) from the target (18). The method comprises the following steps: determining a time domain channel response from a received radio frequency signal (16); determining the amplitude of the maximum peak value in the time domain channel response; determining the amplitude of a second earlier peak in the time domain channel response; comparing the second peak amplitude to a threshold based on the maximum peak amplitude; identifying the largest peak as the shortest path peak if the second peak amplitude is less than the threshold; identifying the second peak as a shortest path peak if the second peak amplitude is less than the threshold; and calculating a distance between the radio frequency device (2) and the target (18) based on the time corresponding to the shortest path peak.

title_en: Coding and decoding system based on space coupling low density generation matrix code
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coding and decoding system based on space coupling low density generation matrix code, wherein, one frame of input information at the input end of the whole system is 5120bits, and only 1024bits of v  2  Enters an SC-LDGM encoder, and the other 4096bits are equally divided into two paths of sequences v  0  And v  1  And the encoded 2048bits information c  2  2048 constellation points are formed to participate in modulation and transmission, generated soft information enters an SC-LDGM decoder to carry out iterative decoding, recoding is carried out according to a 1024bits decoding result after completion, and then a 4096bits judging result which does not participate in coding is obtained through hard judgment. The system adopts the scheme of judging uncoded bits by the bits participating in SC-LDGM coding and decoding, can simultaneously reduce the consumption of hardware resources and realize high-flux transmission in an acceptable error rate range, and can be widely applied to the field of channel coding and decoding.

title_en: Closed cell visitor card issuing processing system and method
abstract_en: A closed cell visitor card issuing processing system and method are disclosed, wherein visitor information and access authority filled by a owner are acquired, and a visitor invitation link is generated according to the visitor information and the access authority, wherein the visitor invitation link comprises a visitor two-dimensional code; sending a visitor invitation link containing a visitor two-dimensional code generated by a visitor invitation background to a visitor object; reading a visitor two-dimensional code in a visitor invitation link to acquire the passing permission data of a visitor object; and manufacturing a passing induction card according to the passing permission data of the visitor object, and configuring the manufactured passing induction card to the visitor object. The card making unit is used for making a passing induction card according to the passing permission data of the visitor object, the physical Bluetooth induction card is used, and the visitor two-dimensional code fails after the passing induction card is made. The invention can effectively solve the problem that visitors with other intentions can hold the two-dimensional code smoothly without obstruction, effectively improve the security management level of high-grade cells, create honorable community security experience for owners and ensure the security of the cells.

title_en: Calculation force network system, calculation force calling method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a computing power network system, a computing power calling method and a computing power calling device, wherein the computing power network system comprises: the system comprises a calculation force service module, a calculation force control module and at least two calculation force nodes, wherein the at least two calculation force nodes comprise a calculation force routing layer; the computing power routing layer is configured to generate a computing power routing table based on the obtained computing power information and upload the computing power routing table to the computing power control module, wherein the computing power routing table records computing power capability parameters and network capability parameters of a local computing power node and a neighbor computing power node; the computational force control module is configured to determine a target computational force policy based on the computational force routing table, wherein the target computational force policy comprises a target computational force destination address and target routing path information.

title_en: Distributed biological feature safety recognition system, face recognition method, medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed biological feature safety recognition system, a face recognition method, a medium and equipment, wherein the system comprises: at least one first terminal device for acquiring first/second biometric features of a first user; encrypting the first biological characteristic to obtain a data packet to be decrypted; the at least one second terminal device is used for receiving the decryption data packet sent by the first terminal device and the device public key of the first terminal device; after the first/second biological characteristics of the second user are acquired, decrypting the data packet to be decrypted by utilizing the characteristic private key of the second biological characteristics of the second user and the equipment public key of the first terminal equipment to obtain decrypted first biological characteristics; and comparing the decrypted first biometric characteristic with the first biometric characteristic of the second user to identify whether the second user is the first user. The invention is constructed by adopting the concept of decentralization, a server without a central node is adopted, and information is exchanged between the trusted terminals which are subjected to trusted authentication, so that the safety of the system is improved.

title_en: Witness voting mechanism processing method and witness voting mechanism processing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a witness voting mechanism processing method and a witness voting mechanism processing system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: respectively acquiring data of a first element and a second element of a first node of a witness node set to obtain a first data set and a second data set, wherein the first element is a deposit amount, and the second element is historical consensus information; performing historical consensus classification on the second data set to obtain a first consensus classification result; processing the second data set according to the first consensus classification result to obtain a third data set; obtaining a first element statistic and a second element statistic by performing weight distribution calculation on the first data set and the third data set; and obtaining a ticket number statistical result according to the first element statistical value and the second element statistical value. The node voting method and the node voting system solve the technical problems that the node voting scheme based on the original consensus algorithm is low in voting result credibility and voting efficiency.

title_en: Zero-trust single-packet authentication system and method based on universal browser
abstract_en: The invention discloses a zero-trust single-packet authentication system based on a universal browser, which comprises the universal browser, a single-packet authentication proxy server and a safety access gateway; the single packet authentication proxy server comprises a TCP proxy service module and a UDP proxy service module, wherein the TCP proxy service module is used for supporting the initiation of the direct connection with the general browser, and the UDP proxy service module is used for realizing the protocol conversion from TCP to UDP. By the technical scheme of the invention, all service ports of the safe access gateway can not receive the TCP connection request before any user passes single-packet authentication, thereby avoiding various handshake attacks and TLS vulnerability attacks of a TCP protocol, various port sniffing and DOS attacks and realizing high safety protection of connection after authentication.

title_en: AR virtual live broadcast method and system
abstract_en: The application provides an AR virtual live broadcast method and system, which relate to the technical field of computer simulation, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a current image frame of a person in front of a green curtain background, which is shot by a camera in real time; carrying out green curtain matting on the current image frame to obtain a figure image; synthesizing the character image and a pre-generated virtual scene to obtain a synthetic image; and rendering the synthetic image in real time, and live-broadcasting and pushing the rendered synthetic image in a stream pushing mode. This application can realize lifelike AR effect in the live.

title_en: Picture quality detection result display method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for displaying image quality detection results, and relates to the technical field of Internet. And displaying a picture quality detection result graph according to the picture quality detection result corresponding to each frame of picture of each video, wherein the picture quality detection result corresponding to each frame of picture of each video is commonly displayed in the picture quality detection result graph, and the picture quality of each frame of picture of each video can be reflected by the picture quality detection result graph, so that the picture quality of each frame of picture of one or more videos is analyzed and compared by taking one frame of picture as granularity, and the accurate analysis of the difference condition of picture quality of a plurality of video files by a user is intuitively realized from finer granularity, thereby improving the use experience of the user.

title_en: Block chain-based document data security verification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a block chain-based document data security verification method, which belongs to the technical field of document processing and is characterized by comprising the following steps of: a. a user generates a word document containing a user ID by using a cryptographic algorithm through a word plug-in, wherein the cryptographic algorithm comprises an SM2 algorithm and an SM3 algorithm; b. signing the word document, creating user information at a block chain cloud end, and generating a CA certificate through a cloud end server; c. generating a block through a block chain, binding a CA certificate and a user ID generated by a cloud server and storing the CA certificate and the user ID into the block; d. and acquiring the certificate of the corresponding user from the block of the block chain according to the user ID of the word document, and finishing the certificate verification signature. The invention has the distributed characteristic, each user can independently sign and verify the electronic document, the precision of the verification result is ensured, the electronic document can be written locally, and the operation is more convenient and humanized.

title_en: Active immune security defense method suitable for sensing node of Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention provides an active immune security defense method suitable for a sensing node of the Internet of things, which comprises an adaptive active immune security policy for the sensing node, wherein the security policy is used for dealing with security threats faced by the sensing node, a security threat description vector is provided aiming at the types of the security threats faced by the sensing node in a sensing computing network, and the existing security policy in the node is represented by a security policy quadruple, wherein the description of the security policy comprises faced security threat indexes, countermeasures taken, a control policy and an expected output result, and the security policy of the node is described by the four aspects. Meanwhile, a credible self-checking strategy of the node is provided, self-checking frequency is set according to the security threat index, and the node carries out periodic self-checking to guarantee the security and credibility of the node.

title_en: Method and device for generating video abstract and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a device for generating a video abstract and a readable storage medium. The method is applied to video acquisition equipment, the video acquisition equipment comprises a hardware unit for acquiring motion information in real time, and the motion information comprises speed information and direction information of the video acquisition equipment, and the method comprises the following steps: starting to collect video signals in response to a collection starting instruction, and recording motion information corresponding to each frame in the process of collecting the video signals; determining key frame extraction frequency according to the motion information corresponding to each frame; determining a key frame in the collected video signal according to the key frame extraction frequency; and responding to an acquisition ending instruction, and generating a video summary according to the key frames. The embodiment of the invention can generate the video abstract on line, and can improve the efficiency and the quality of the generated video abstract.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for positioning, screening and matching personnel in exhibition
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps of acquiring the position information and/or the moving track of each target node in the environment where a positioning base station is based on the pre-installed positioning base station, wherein the target nodes comprise nodes which are registered in advance through Bluetooth and have a wireless communication function; acquiring spatial distance information of each target node based on the position information of the target node, and acquiring user information corresponding to each target node smaller than a preset distance threshold from a background user information server when the distance information of the target node is smaller than the preset distance threshold; and matching the user portrait according to the user information, and outputting prompt information when the user portrait of each target node smaller than a preset distance threshold value is matched. The method can display the behaviors in a classified mode according to the user level, and mine the user data to improve the transaction rate.

title_en: Consensus method and block link point
abstract_en: A consensus method and blockchain nodes, the method being performed by a first node in a blockchain, the blockchain including a plurality of consensus nodes, the first node being one of the plurality of consensus nodes, the method comprising: acquiring entrusting information of the consensus nodes from a block chain, wherein the entrusting information is used for indicating the number of entrusting nodes associated with the consensus nodes, and the entrusting nodes are nodes entrusting any consensus node in the block chain to perform consensus; performing consensus operations on consensus offers based on the delegation information.

title_en: Application data synchronization method, device, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to an application data synchronization method, equipment, a terminal and a storage medium, belonging to the field of electronic technology, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when the user is identified to log in or awaken the first application through the synchronous plug-in, identifying a first account currently used by the first application; identifying a correlation account of a first account based on a pre-stored correlation relationship between accounts of different applications, wherein the correlation account corresponds to a correlation application one to one, and the correlation application and the first application have at least one same function; acquiring synchronous data from cloud servers corresponding to the associated accounts respectively; based on the synchronization data, the data in the first application is updated. The invention has the effects of realizing the synchronization of data between application programs with similar functions and improving the user experience.

title_en: Dynamic management method, system and service node of network card in container platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic management method, a system and a service node of a network card in a container platform, wherein the method comprises the following steps: monitoring the CRD resources, and comparing the CRD resources before and after change when the CRD resources have a change event so as to determine the type of the network card operation to be executed currently; the CRD resource comprises network card information and routing information; identifying a target container corresponding to the changed CRD resource, calling a network card newly-added interface and an address setting interface if the operation type of the network card represents a newly-added network card, and respectively creating a newly-added network card for the target container and configuring an IP address for the newly-added network card according to network card information in the changed CRD resource; and calling a route adding interface, and configuring a route for the newly added network card according to the route information in the changed CRD resource. According to the technical scheme, the network card can be dynamically managed in the POD operation process.

title_en: Method and apparatus for personalizing audio content
abstract_en: The present document describes a method (400) for personalizing audio content. The method (400) comprises receiving (401) a manifest file (140) for the audio content. The manifest file (140) comprises at least one adaptation set (281, 282) referencing an audio bitstream (121), wherein the audio bitstream (121) comprises a plurality of audio objects (181) and a plurality of different pre-selected elements (291,292,293) for the adaptation set (281, 282), wherein the different pre-selected elements (291,292,293) specify different combinations of the plurality of audio objects (181). The method (400) further comprises selecting (402) a preselected element (291) from the plurality of different preselected elements (291,292,293), and causing (403) presentation of an audio signal that depends on the selected preselected element (291).

title_en: Method and apparatus for random access
abstract_en: Various embodiments of the present disclosure provide a method for random access. A method, which may be performed by a terminal device, comprises determining (S211) an association between a random access resource and a shared channel resource of a request message for a random access procedure based at least on whether or not frequency hopping is enabled for the shared channel resource, or when frequency hopping is enabled for the shared channel resource, and transmitting (S212) the request message to a network node according to the association. According to the embodiment of the disclosure, the association between the random access resource and the shared channel resource of the signaling transmission in the random access process can be flexibly and efficiently configured.

title_en: Data transmission method of oil and gas field station
abstract_en: The invention provides a data transmission method of an oil and gas field station, which comprises the steps that a sensor arranged at an equipment end in a field detects equipment in the field; a step of wirelessly transmitting the data collected by the sensor to a protocol converter by a wireless communication module; further comprising: a step of receiving a signal transmitted by a wireless communication module by the protocol converter; a step in which the protocol converter transmits the received signal to a control device; the control device transmits the received and processed signal to the edge computer; and the edge computer transmits the received signals to the in-field monitoring equipment according to a preset communication protocol through a communication module with a preset communication protocol. The invention has the beneficial effect of improving the quality and speed of signal transmission in the oil and gas field station.

title_en: Application delay for power mode adaptation
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communication are described. A User Equipment (UE) may communicate with a base station on multiple Component Carriers (CCs) in a Carrier Aggregation (CA) configuration. The base station may transmit an indication to the UE identifying a new power mode (e.g., power mode adjustment) to be implemented by the UE. The power mode may identify communication parameters to be adjusted by the UE. The UE may determine a delay for applying the new power mode on the CC. The delay may provide the UE with time to activate or deactivate components or elements based on the new power mode. In some examples, the UE may determine a delay based on one or more selected CCs and then apply the delay across CCs. The UE may implement the power mode on one or more (or all) CCs after the delay.

title_en: Method, device and terminal for reporting channel state information
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device and a terminal for reporting channel state information, and belongs to the technical field of wireless communication. The method for reporting the channel state information comprises the following steps: the terminal measures CSI of N first sub-bands in a first time window, wherein the first time window comprises M time domain units, N is an integer larger than 1, and M is an integer larger than or equal to 1; selecting P second sub-bands from the N first sub-bands according to first CSI (channel state information) of the N first sub-bands measured in the first time window, wherein P is an integer which is greater than 0 and less than or equal to N; and reporting a CSI report, wherein the CSI report comprises second CSI corresponding to the P second sub-bands.

title_en: Resource access method and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a resource access method and terminal equipment, and relates to the technical field of communication, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the terminal equipment responds to a first operation acting on a target application program, generates a first URL request for accessing a first webpage, and sends a first domain name resolution request to a first DNS server according to the first URL request; if the domain name resolution is determined to fail, restarting the first URL request, and sending a second domain name resolution request to a second DNS server according to the first URL request, wherein the second DNS server is different from the first DNS server; then obtaining a request result of the second domain name resolution request; acquiring a webpage resource of a first webpage according to a request result; and finally, displaying the first webpage according to the acquired webpage resources. The technical scheme provided by the application can improve the success rate of webpage resource access, thereby improving the browsing experience of users.

title_en: Wireless resource allocation optimization method and device based on graphic neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless resource allocation optimization method and a device based on a graph neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: modeling large-scale wireless network deployment in a terahertz frequency band, and considering the power and subchannel allocation problem of a plurality of receiver and transmitter pairs in the large-scale wireless network in the terahertz frequency band; correcting interference in the signal transmission process, and establishing a physical channel model of a large-scale wireless network downlink system under the terahertz frequency band; describing a problem of optimizing wireless network resource allocation; modeling a wireless network into a wireless channel diagram, and expressing a wireless network resource allocation optimization problem as a diagram optimization problem; and finding a strategy capable of mapping the wireless channel diagram to the optimal power allocation vector and the optimal sub-channel allocation vector, and realizing the joint allocation optimization of power and sub-channels. The method can solve the problem of resource allocation optimization of the large-scale wireless network in the terahertz frequency band.

title_en: Remote data reproduction and fault analysis and prediction system and method for excavator
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of excavator control, in particular to an excavator remote data reproduction and fault analysis and prediction system and a method, wherein the system mainly acquires operation scene and operation process data through an operation scene and action sensing module arranged on an excavator equipment end, and distributes the operation scene and the operation process data to a server end through a wide area network for node management and data storage; the operator can compare the operation process data with the template data through the playing equipment end and then play back the operation until the operator is skilled in operation, and the operation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Method and device for transmitting measurement reference signals
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for transmitting a measurement reference signal, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining measurement reference signal information according to at least one of received signaling information and a convention rule, and transmitting the measurement reference signal according to the measurement reference signal information. By adopting the technical scheme, the information of the measurement reference signal is determined according to the signaling information, so that the measurement reference signal resource can adopt the time domain OCC, the capacity of the measurement reference signal is increased, and the coverage of the measurement reference signal is not influenced. The method solves the problem that the prior art has no effective technical proposal, and the capacity or coverage of a measurement reference signal is enhanced in new wireless.

title_en: kubernetes cluster service guaranteeing method, module and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kubernetes cluster service guaranteeing method, a kubernetes cluster service guaranteeing component and a kubernetes cluster service guaranteeing system, wherein the guaranteeing method comprises a service repairing method and a service scheduling method; the service repair method is used for selecting the service to be repaired based on the resource usage amount and the importance degree of each service in the node when the total resource usage amount of the node reaches a preset usage amount threshold, and ensuring that the service is stable in running while ensuring the stability of the node state. The service scheduling method is used for scheduling the newly added service or the service to be repaired serving as the service to be scheduled, and comprises the following steps: when the service to be scheduled is an important service, taking candidate nodes without the important service as preselected nodes; and calculating the matching degree of the service to be scheduled and each preselected node, extracting a preferred node from the preselected nodes based on the matching degree, and scheduling the service to be scheduled to the corresponding preferred node. The invention can ensure that important services independently and stably run.
