title_en: Cloud security computing method and device based on cloud fault-tolerant technology and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloud security computing method and device based on a cloud fault-tolerant technology and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, a management node adopts a master-slave multi-slave fault-tolerant architecture and realizes management node survival self-checking and user request load balancing by using KeepAlived and Haproxy; s2, the service node maintains the life cycle of the application micro-service by adopting a dynamic redundant fault-tolerant safety design, and the service node feeds back survival information to the management node in real time through heartbeat; the application micro-services report the life cycle to the management node based on a probe mechanism, and input and output information is exchanged among the application micro-services through redundancy voting. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, the availability and reliability of the traditional cloud computing platform or the cloud computing service can be effectively improved, and the reliability and stability of each cloud computing-based industrial control system can be further improved.

title_en: Communication protocol adaptation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a communication protocol adaptation method, a device, equipment and a computer readable storage medium; the communication protocol adaptation method in the application comprises the following steps: acquiring a wireless communication protocol, and configuring a communication port according to the wireless communication protocol; verifying the communication module according to the configured communication port to obtain a communication verification result; and performing self-adaptive configuration on the communication port according to the communication check result, and performing communication pairing on the communication port and the communication module based on the self-adaptive configuration. According to the technical scheme, self-adaptive communication pairing is carried out on the intelligent terminals with multiple wireless communication protocols, so that the communication protocol matching efficiency is improved, and the terminal development efficiency is improved.

title_en: Interference waveform matching system and positioning method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an interference waveform matching system and a positioning method thereof, wherein the interference waveform matching system comprises a data acquisition module, an IDS automatic module, an interference gene library module, a waveform matching core module, an application analysis module and a work order circulation module. According to the invention, the interference data is automatically acquired and automatically analyzed by the integrated IDS module, so that the working efficiency is improved, the counting error is avoided, the typical waveform of an interference source is set by constructing two core modules of an interference gene library and a waveform matching algorithm, the interference cell is quickly and accurately matched, and the problem of slow interference positioning timeliness is solved.

title_en: Service data monitoring method, equipment, storage medium and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a business data monitoring method, equipment, a storage medium and a device, wherein the business data monitoring method is characterized in that user operation information is obtained based on an IP address verification algorithm, business data to be rewritten is determined, mirror image processing is carried out on the business data to be rewritten, and whether user rewriting operation meets preset rewriting conditions or not is judged according to data attributes corresponding to the mirror image data; and when the user rewriting operation does not meet the preset rewriting condition, stopping responding to the user rewriting operation, and determining the risk probability of the risk path so as to remind. Because the attribute judgment is carried out on the mirror image data operated by the user and the risk path is determined according to the judgment result, compared with the prior art that the permission of an operator is set so as to ensure that other personnel cannot rewrite the corresponding service data, the method and the device for judging the risk before rewriting the data improve the data safety and can effectively ensure the data safety compared with the limitation problem caused by the prior art.

title_en: Business data sharing method and system based on privacy computing technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a business data sharing method and a business data sharing system based on a privacy computing technology, which are applied to the technical field of data sharing; acquiring sensitive data of service data; judging whether the sensitive data has a preset encryption format or not; if not, setting a sensitive sub-threshold value for the service data; acquiring a data type corresponding to the sensitive data; setting different scores for different sensitive data according to the data types; judging whether all scores corresponding to sensitive data in the business data are larger than the sensitive score threshold value or not; if not, sharing the service data; the method comprises the steps of setting a sensitive score threshold value for sensitive data in the service data, and judging whether the service data needs to be shared according to whether a score corresponding to the sensitive data in the service data is larger than the sensitive score threshold value; important sensitive data in the service data are effectively prevented from flowing out.

title_en: Method, system and storage medium for separating CPU and GPU processing video stream
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a system and a storage medium for separating a CPU and a GPU to process video streams. The method for separating the CPU and the GPU to process the video stream comprises the following steps: classifying, namely classifying the video stream files of the easily-processed groups into a CPU cluster for processing; classifying video stream files of the difficult-to-process group into a GPU cluster for processing; servers with computing space allocated within each cluster using K8S; a step of communication between the CPU cluster and the GPU cluster, wherein Kafka is used as a communication mechanism between the CPU cluster and the GPU cluster; and a step of circular processing, wherein the current task to be processed is finished when the number of the items is 0, otherwise, the step of video stream classification is returned. According to the method and the system, the CPU cluster is used for processing simple tasks, the GPU cluster is used for processing complex tasks, the background processing capacity is greatly increased, and the server cost is reduced.

title_en: Method and system for safely transmitting industrial Internet of things data
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for safely transmitting industrial Internet of things data, which construct a mode of safely transmitting industrial Internet of things data by combining software and hardware, realize the data acquisition and the safe transmission of industrial Internet of things sensors by combining a security gateway with hardware security attribute and a software encryption and decryption algorithm, and solve the technical problems that in the current industrial production, the data acquired by various sensors are transmitted in a network to be easily stolen and tampered by an attacker, and especially when a user searches data remotely, for example, the data of the sensors are transmitted to a client after being acquired from a data center, the data transmission of plaintext is unsafe, and the production data is easy to leak.

title_en: Radio network node, user Equipment (UE) and methods performed therein
abstract_en: Embodiments herein relate, for example, to a method performed by a radio network node for handling communication of a User Equipment (UE) in a wireless communication network. The radio network node sends a handover command for handover of the UE from the source cell to the target cell, wherein security parameters for encrypting data communicated between the radio network node and the UE are reserved during the handover. Furthermore, the radio network node maintains a sequence number state for receiving and/or transmitting signaling radio bearers of the UE during handover from the source cell to the target cell and/or at a fallback from the target cell to the source cell when the UE triggers the fallback to the source cell.

title_en: POE port test system and method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a POE port test system and a POE port test method, wherein the system comprises a controller, a load adjusting module and a communication module; the controller is connected with the load adjusting module and used for controlling the load adjusting module to adjust a load gear based on a test instruction; the communication module is connected with the load adjusting module and used for establishing communication connection with POE power supply equipment; the load adjusting module is provided with a plurality of load gears. By the POE port testing system and method provided by the embodiment of the application, the full-coverage full-power test of the POE port can be realized, and the load range can be fully automatically adjusted in the testing process.

title_en: Precoding matrix indicator feedback for multiple transmission hypotheses
abstract_en: Aspects relate to reporting Channel State Information (CSI) for multiple Transmission Reception Points (TRPs) in a communication system. A Downlink (DL) channel received from a plurality of TRPs is measured and a plurality of transmission hypotheses are determined based on the measured DL channel from the plurality of TRPs. Transmitting CSI to a network in a communication system and the CSI comprising a Precoding Matrix Indicator (PMI) having at least a spatial basis matrix common to all transmission hypotheses and at least one coefficient matrix based on the spatial basis matrix.

title_en: System and method for reference signaling design and configuration in a wireless communication network
abstract_en: Systems and methods for reference signaling design and configuration in a wireless communication network are discussed herein. In one embodiment, the system and method are configured to determine, by a wireless communication device, an activated beam state applicable to a downlink signal received from a wireless communication node. The system and method may also be configured to determine, by the wireless communication device, first information of an uplink signal transmitted to the wireless communication node, the first uplink signal being associated with an uplink resource, based at least on the activated beam state.

title_en: Method and device for studying and judging fraud-related mobile phone application, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for researching and judging a fraud-related mobile phone application, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of mobile phone application, and the method comprises the following steps: forming a static analysis portrait of the mobile phone application to be researched based on the application basic information of the mobile phone application to be researched; performing simulation operation processing on the mobile phone application to be judged, recording operation screenshots corresponding to each operation, and respectively determining an operation execution sequence and an operation sequence flow corresponding to each application function according to the operation sequence of each application function; forming a target application representation based on the static analysis representation, each operation screenshot, each operation sequence flow and each operation execution sequence; and matching the target application portrait with each application study model in the application study model library, and if the matching is successful, determining that the mobile phone application to be studied and judged is a fraud-related mobile phone application. The scheme provided by the embodiment of the application can improve the research and judgment efficiency of the application of the mobile phone involved in fraud.

title_en: Large file fragment uploading method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for uploading large file fragments, which relate to the technical field of file uploading and comprise the following steps: acquiring a file to be uploaded, acquiring a command written by a user side through a preset interface, starting a file fragmentation function and determining the size of fragments; and sequentially traversing and intercepting the files to be uploaded according to the fragment indexes based on a preset file intercepting formula so as to obtain file fragments corresponding to each index, and uploading the file fragments to a server after each file fragment is intercepted until the fragment uploading operation of the files to be uploaded is completed. According to the method and the device, corresponding function expansion is carried out on the Element-UI, the upload component is packaged for the second time, the component is simplified due to the simple function of the upload component, a user can select large file fragmentation operation conveniently and simply, the fragmented file cannot be lost due to fragment uploading interruption caused by page refreshing during file fragmentation uploading, and user experience is improved.

title_en: Fast adaptive task unloading system and method based on mobile edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fast adaptive task unloading system and method based on mobile edge calculation, wherein the system comprises: an application layer, a vehicle layer and an MEC layer; the subtasks of the application layer are unloaded to the MEC server or a local vehicle to run, and each vehicle of the vehicle layer processes the subtasks locally. And the MEC layer carries out unloading sequencing on all the subtasks according to a defined task unloading method and carries out unloading scheduling on each subtask in sequence according to the unloading sequence. The method comprises the following steps: and sampling a plurality of task unloading scenes. And training a task unloading strategy corresponding to the specific scene. For each scenario, local target policies and network parameters are initialized. And selecting and executing actions according to a local sampling strategy, obtaining rewards and collecting experience tracks. And updating the target policy network parameters. And updating the network parameters of the global strategy. The invention has the advantages that: more stable, a small amount of training can realize the good exploration to the environment, has better uninstallation effect.

title_en: Network speed prediction method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a network speed prediction method, a device, equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring actual download network speed information and the size of the downloaded video clips corresponding to the first preset number of downloaded video clips; determining the sizes of the video clips to be downloaded corresponding to the second preset number of video clips to be downloaded; and carrying out network speed prediction based on a preset time sequence prediction model, actual downloading network speed information, the size of the downloaded video fragments and the size of the video fragments to be downloaded, and determining the current predicted downloading network speed information corresponding to each video fragment to be downloaded. By the technical scheme of the embodiment of the disclosure, the downloading network speed of the video clips to be downloaded can be accurately predicted, and further the user watching experience is improved.

title_en: Ethernet frame transmitting method, receiving method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, a terminal and a medium for transmitting/receiving an Ethernet frame, and relates to the field of wireless communication. The method comprises the following steps: the compression end sends a first Ethernet frame to the decompression end, and a packet head of the first Ethernet frame carries first information which is used for indicating whether a context is established to the decompression end and/or whether feedback needs to be sent. So that for some Ethernet frames which do not need header compression, the decompression end does not need to establish a context and/or send feedback, and storage resources and network resources of the decompression end are saved.

title_en: Mobile digital certificate service method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mobile digital certificate service method, which has the technical scheme key points that: the method comprises the following steps: the mobile terminal sends digital certificate request information to the server terminal; the server generates a corresponding mobile digital certificate according to the digital certificate request information, stores the mobile digital certificate in an authentication system and sends the mobile digital certificate to the mobile terminal; the mobile terminal sends the signature information to the server terminal, and the server terminal forwards the signature information to the authentication system; the authentication system generates authentication response information according to the signature information and sends the authentication response information to the server side, and the server side sends the authentication response information to the mobile side; the mobile terminal sends the authentication response information to the certificate dependent terminal, and the certificate dependent terminal generates an authentication result according to the authentication response information; the method and the device have the advantage of providing the authentication service mechanism of the mobile terminal.

title_en: Security consistency control method for solving influence of FDI attack on multi-agent system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of multi-agent system control, and discloses a security consistency control method for solving the influence of FDI attack on a multi-agent system, which comprises the following steps: under a Kalman filtering framework, an estimator capable of estimating the state of a neighbor agent is designed; a safety protection mechanism is designed based on the proposed state estimator, so that each intelligent agent adopts a safety value to update the state, the influence of virtual data injection attack on the system is eliminated, and the system is ensured to asymptotically realize the mean square and binary consistency; establishing event triggering conditions by using the estimated value and the value received from the network so as to reduce the transmission of state information and relieve network congestion; the method considers that a communication channel between intelligent agents and a communication channel from a sensor to a controller are simultaneously attacked by a malicious attacker, and the influence of process noise and measurement noise exists in the system, so that the method is suitable for a complex network environment and has better robustness and anti-interference performance.

title_en: Method and device for uploading files and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a program product for uploading files, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical uploading parameters of a target file; determining the number of uploading channels of the target file according to the historical uploading parameters; and establishing an uploading queue for the target file based on the number of the uploading channels, and uploading the target file through the uploading queue. Therefore, the method and the device can determine the number of the uploading channels of the uploaded files based on the historical uploading parameters of the target files and upload the files based on the determined number of the uploading channels, so that the number of the uploading channels can be adjusted more flexibly according to the uploading parameters, efficient data uploading suitable for network conditions is realized, and failure and errors of data uploading are reduced.

title_en: Method and device for determining access resources, storage medium and terminal
abstract_en: A method and device for determining access resources, a storage medium and a terminal are provided, wherein the determining method comprises the following steps: the frequency domain location of narrowband CORESET0 and/or narrowband initial activation downstream BWP is determined, and/or narrowband SIB1 is determined. The invention provides a feasible technical scheme for acquiring narrowband CORESET0 and narrowband initial activation downlink BWP for narrowband UE.

title_en: Method and device for configuring reference signal resources
abstract_en: A method and an apparatus for configuring reference signal resources are disclosed. By limiting the reference signal resource configuration behavior of the base station, different reference signal resources are time division multiplexed; or, the configuration behavior of the base station is not limited, and when the base station configures the concurrence of a plurality of reference signal resources, the terminal discards the collided reference signal resources according to a certain rule; or the terminal can report the processing capacity of the terminal on the reference signal resource, and the base station reasonably configures the reference signal resource for the terminal according to the reporting capacity of the terminal, so that the reference signal resource with multiple purposes is reasonably configured, the collision of the reference signal resource is avoided, the communication reliability is improved, and the processing complexity of a terminal chip is reduced.

title_en: Video playing method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a video playing method, a video playing device, video playing equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: displaying a target music page corresponding to the target music, wherein the target music page comprises a video recommendation control; and responding to a triggering operation acted on the video recommendation control, and playing a first video in the video recommendation page, wherein the first background music in the first video is similar music matched with the target music in a preset music dimension. Through the technical scheme of the embodiment of the disclosure, videos with similar background music can be played quickly without manual searching, so that interactivity with a user is enhanced, and user experience is improved.

title_en: UE assistance information for dual connectivity
abstract_en: Certain aspects of the present disclosure provide techniques for signaling User Equipment (UE) assistance information (UAI) specific to a particular Cell Group (CG) (e.g., secondary CG (SCG)). For example, the techniques may be performed to generate a CG-specific UAI that may indicate configuration parameters for the UE when operating in a multi-radio dual connectivity (MR-DC) mode. The UE may signal the UAI to the network entity along with an indication of the CG to which the UAI is to be applied.

title_en: Method for realizing indoor passive and passive positioning by utilizing LoRa signal fingerprints
abstract_en: A method for realizing indoor passive positioning by utilizing LoRa signal fingerprints is characterized in that firstly, in an off-line stage: an indoor positioning environment is built by using the LoRa node equipment and the LoRa gateway equipment, so that communication between the LoRa gateway and the node equipment is realized; using a proxy server as a data transfer station, receiving data with the LoRa node equipment ID and RSSI transmitted from the LoRa gateway; compiling a monitoring program by using Java language, and storing the received data to the local from the proxy server; eliminating abnormal data of the acquired data by a difference-amplitude limiting filtering algorithm, and keeping the overall characteristics of the data; training the model by using a Gaussian-naive Bayes algorithm to obtain a fingerprint library based on the LoRa signal receiving intensity; and (3) in an online positioning stage: and acquiring RSSI data of the LoRa node equipment for the equipment or personnel to be positioned, and estimating the position according to the trained model. The method can monitor personnel invasion of a certain indoor area under the condition that an object or personnel to be positioned does not carry any positioning equipment, and further deduces the specific indoor position information of the object or the personnel.

title_en: Two-stage feedback protocol
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communications are described. Techniques for providing additional feedback regarding a channel as part of a feedback procedure are described. The feedback information associated with the feedback procedure may include two phases of feedback information. The feedback information for each stage may include different types of information. The first phase may include an acknowledgement or negative acknowledgement of each feedback procedure supported. The second phase may include additional feedback information regarding any downlink transmissions that were not successfully received and thus included negative acknowledgements in the first phase. Additionally or alternatively, the second phase may include additional feedback information regarding any downlink transmissions that were successfully received and thus include acknowledgements in the first phase. Techniques for handling variable sizes of feedback information included in the two phases are also described.

title_en: Information processing method, device, equipment and medium based on resource allocation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an information processing method, device, equipment and medium based on resource allocation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of distributing system resources of a management server according to configuration information to determine a delivery thread corresponding to each processing thread, obtaining delivery docking parameters fed back by a client through the delivery threads, inputting received transaction data into the processing threads respectively for processing so as to update initial data in the processing threads, obtaining snapshot information corresponding to the delivery docking parameters from the updated initial data according to the delivery docking parameters of the delivery threads, and delivering the snapshot information to the client docked with the delivery threads through the delivery threads. The invention belongs to the technical field of big data processing, and the method stores the received transaction data through a processing thread, and acquires snapshot information corresponding to a submission docking parameter through a submission thread, so that the corresponding snapshot information is acquired according to the requirements of a client for feedback, and the transaction data information is viewed more comprehensively.

title_en: Communication environment safety early warning method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a communication environment safety early warning method, a communication environment safety early warning device, electronic equipment and a storage medium; the communication environment safety assessment method and device can acquire the current first safety method application information of the communication terminal and the second safety method application information of the cloud server corresponding to the communication terminal, calculate the communication terminal safety factor of the communication terminal according to the first safety method application information, and/or calculate the cloud server safety factor of the cloud server according to the second safety method application information, determine the communication environment safety assessment result of the current communication environment based on at least one of the communication terminal safety factor and the cloud server safety factor, and display a communication environment safety prompt message if the communication environment safety assessment result indicates that the current communication environment is unsafe; by the embodiment of the invention, the security evaluation can be carried out on the communication environment in the current communication process, and the user is reminded according to the evaluation result, so that the user can conveniently control the privacy degree of the communication content in the communication process.

title_en: Block synchronization method, block chain system, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a block synchronization method, a block chain system, a device and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of block chains. The blockchain system includes a plurality of VPs and m NVP clusters, each NVP cluster including a first NVP and at least one second NVP, the first NVP being an NVP that communicates with a corresponding VP, the method including: each VP of m VPs in the multiple VPs sends a first message carrying a block to a first NVP in a corresponding NVP cluster; and if each NVP receives the first message, storing the block carried by the first message into a block chain, and sending the first message to the adjacent NVP. In the application, each VP in m VPs only needs to send a first message carrying a block to a first NVP in a corresponding NVP cluster, so that synchronization of each NVP in the corresponding NVP cluster to the block can be realized, the pressure of the VP is reduced, and further the block consensus efficiency can be improved.

title_en: Soft load system configuration method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a soft load system configuration method, a soft load system configuration device, computer equipment and a storage medium in the field of intelligent operation and maintenance. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a configuration request initiated aiming at target associated information; generating first adjustment configuration information according to the container identifier and the configuration mode corresponding to the container; generating second adjustment configuration information according to the soft load cluster number, the service node name, the container identifier corresponding to the container and the configuration mode in the target association information; and configuring the associated information configuration file in the soft load cluster according to the second adjustment configuration information to obtain the configured soft load cluster. By adopting the method, the problem of service abnormity caused by inconsistent configuration of the registration center and the soft load cluster can be solved, the stable operation of the service is ensured, and the working efficiency of the soft load cluster system is improved.

title_en: System and method for locating wireless accessories
abstract_en: The present application relates to a system and method for locating wireless accessories. Embodiments described herein provide systems and methods for crowdsourcing locations of wireless devices and accessories lacking wide area network connectivity. One embodiment provides a data processing system configured to perform operations comprising: loading a user interface on an electronic device, the user interface to enable determination of a location of a wireless accessory associated with the electronic device; generating a set of public keys included within a signal broadcast by the wireless accessory, the signal broadcast during a first time period; sending the group of public keys to a server and requesting to return data corresponding to one public key in the group of public keys; decrypting the location data using a private key associated with the public key; and processing the location data to determine a likely location of the wireless accessory.

title_en: Authentication method and device
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to authentication methods and devices. The present disclosure relates to authenticating a first device to a second device, comprising at least two consecutive verification operations comprising the following consecutive steps. The second device generates first data and transmits the first data to the first device. The first device generates third data and fourth data used by a subsequent authentication operation and transmits the third data to the second device. The second device checks third data indicating whether the check was successful.

title_en: Method and apparatus in a node used for wireless communication
abstract_en: A method and apparatus in a node used for wireless communication is disclosed. Firstly, a node receives first signaling, wherein the first signaling is used for activating or releasing a first type of signal; subsequently transmitting the target information block in the first set of resources; a first field in the first signaling is used to indicate a first time offset value, a target time unit occupied by the first set of resources is related to both the first time offset value and a first reference time unit; the target information block is used for feeding back the first type of signal or the first signaling; the first signaling and the first type of signals are directed to different services; the first reference time cell is associated to a first set of search spaces; and the time domain resource occupied by the first signaling belongs to a second search space set. The application provides a new determination mode of PUCCH resources during SPS activation or deactivation under multicast so as to improve the flexibility of the system and optimize the performance of the system.

title_en: Task planning and spectrum resource joint optimization method and system for multiple unmanned aerial vehicles
abstract_en: The invention discloses a task planning and spectrum resource joint optimization method for multiple unmanned aerial vehicles, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle communication and mainly comprises the following steps: under the shared spectrum environment, determining a reconnaissance task planning and spectrum resource joint optimization problem of a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles corresponding to a disaster area in the rescue operation according to relevant parameters of the disaster area; and decomposing the optimization problem into an unmanned aerial vehicle task planning and track control subproblem, an unmanned aerial vehicle subchannel allocation subproblem and an unmanned aerial vehicle transmitting power optimization subproblem by using a block coordinate descent method, and solving the unmanned aerial vehicle task planning and track control subproblem, the unmanned aerial vehicle subchannel allocation subproblem and the unmanned aerial vehicle transmitting power optimization subproblem by using an iterative optimization algorithm to obtain an optimal unmanned aerial vehicle subchannel allocation matrix, an optimal unmanned aerial vehicle flight track coordinate matrix and an optimal unmanned aerial vehicle transmitting power allocation matrix. The invention can realize higher unmanned aerial vehicle transmission rate and better robustness.

title_en: Sidelink feedback reporting
abstract_en: Various aspects of the present disclosure generally relate to wireless communications. In some aspects, a first User Equipment (UE) applies a timing adjustment to a sidelink connection with a second UE, wherein the timing adjustment aligns a slot structure on the sidelink connection with a slot structure on an uplink connection with a base station; and transmitting, based at least in part on the timing adjustment, side uplink feedback received via the side uplink connection over the uplink connection, wherein the side uplink feedback is mapped to a time slot of two or more time slots on the uplink connection that overlap the side uplink feedback based at least in part on the rule. Numerous other aspects are provided.

title_en: Vehicle-end game processing method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vehicle-end game processing method and a device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when a starting instruction of a target game is received, acquiring a user identifier of a current user; sending a local check code of the user data corresponding to the user identification to the cloud end so that the cloud end can compare the local check code with the cloud end check code; determining the latest action mapping table data and the latest game progress data based on the feedback information of the cloud; determining game content according to the latest game progress data, and triggering a projection module to project the game content to a projection surface; and when the current interaction data of the user is received, analyzing the current interaction data based on the latest action mapping table data, and executing a game interaction process. The scheme provides diversified entertainment experience for the user, and realizes that the game progress is not influenced when the user plays the cross-vehicle game through local user data synchronization and cloud user data synchronization, and can play with familiar actions to avoid the sense of incongruity.

title_en: Polarization code simplified SCL decoding method based on key set
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a polarization code simplified SCL decoding method based on a key set. The invention belongs to the technical field of channel coding, which firstly comprehensively considers the Minimum Hamming Weight (MHW) of information bits and the channel reliability according to the channel characteristics of a polarization code to construct a key set, then in actual decoding, the information bits in the key set still execute SCL decoding to carry out path splitting, and the information bits outside the key set directly carry out hard decision. Simulation results show that the complexity of the CS-SCL decoding method is reduced by at least 70% compared with that of the traditional SCL decoding method, the computational complexity of the CS-SCL decoding method is reduced compared with that of the PS-SS-SCL decoding method, the error correction performance loss of the CS-SCL decoding method is extremely small, and a good compromise choice is provided for the error correction performance and the complexity of the polarization code decoding method.

title_en: Network attack prediction method and device based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network attack prediction method and a device based on a knowledge graph, belonging to the field of network security and comprising the following steps: s101, acquiring data; s102, preprocessing the acquired data; s103, constructing a network security body facing to network attack; s104, extracting data according to the defined knowledge expression model; s105, fusing and correcting the extracted various data to construct a network security knowledge graph; and S106, predicting the attack event by using the constructed network security knowledge graph. The invention improves the prediction accuracy of the attack behavior.

title_en: IA robot monitoring method and device based on RPA and AI
abstract_en: The disclosure provides an IA robot monitoring method based on RPA and AI. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: and identifying the data information currently acquired from each VNC server and/or the connection state of the RPA robot associated with each VNC server and the console so as to determine the current running state of each RPA robot, and updating the monitoring card corresponding to each RPA robot in the RPA monitoring interface according to the current running state of each RPA robot. Therefore, the current running state of the RPA robot is identified and determined, and the RPA monitoring interface is automatically updated according to the current running state of the RPA robot, so that the robot is monitored by the IA, and the operation and maintenance efficiency of the RPA robot is improved.

title_en: Multimedia data transmission method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a multimedia data transmission method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: responding to the data transmission request, and acquiring original multimedia data to be transmitted; if the preset special effect processing condition is met, determining a target special effect processing mode of the original multimedia data according to a preset special effect processing mode, wherein the preset special effect processing mode at least comprises a central processing unit mode and a graphic processor processing mode; and carrying out special effect processing on the original multimedia data based on the target special effect processing mode to obtain target transmission multimedia data. According to the technical scheme of the embodiment of the disclosure, the original multimedia data can be subjected to special effect processing through an applicable special effect processing mode, so that the technical effects of improving the data transmission efficiency, reducing the performance consumption of a processor and increasing the diversity of special effect processing are achieved.

title_en: Information processing apparatus and monitoring system
abstract_en: The application discloses an information processing device and a monitoring system. Wherein the information processing apparatus includes: the circuit board is provided with a first chip, a heart rate monitoring chip and a motion induction sensor, the first chip is used for determining position information of a target object, the heart rate monitoring chip is used for monitoring heart rate information of the target object, the motion induction sensor is used for acquiring motion information of the target object, and the target object is an object carrying an information processing device; and the processor is connected with the circuit board and used for determining the state information of the target object according to the position information, the heart rate information and the motion information. The technical problem that efficiency is low when state information of animals is determined in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Method and device for reporting channel state information
abstract_en: In one aspect of the invention, a method, computer-readable medium, and apparatus are provided. The apparatus may be a UE. The UE measures a first set of reference signals at a first point in time to determine a first set of values corresponding to a set of channel state information parameters. The UE determines a difference between the first set of values and a set of reference values corresponding to the set of CSI parameters. The UE transmits a first CSI report including a change indicator indicating the difference. The invention realizes the beneficial effect of saving resources.

title_en: DMRS port information determining method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method, a device and a storage medium for determining DMRS port information, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining first configuration information; the first configuration information is used for indicating a type of a DMRS port information indicating table or a DMRS code division multiplexing CDM group; and determining DMRS port information based on the first configuration information. According to the method, the device and the storage medium for determining the DMRS port information, the DMRS port information is determined based on the configuration information for indicating the type of the DMRS port information indication table or the DMRS CDM group, so that the cost of DCI indication is reduced.

title_en: Data processing method and system
abstract_en: One or more embodiments of the present disclosure provide a data processing method and system, where the method is applied to a client, the client maintains a first memory area corresponding to a first RDMA network card installed on a network device where the client is located and a second memory area, and includes storing call request data corresponding to a remote call to the first memory area in response to a remote call initiated by the client to the server, wherein the server maintains a third memory area corresponding to a second RDMA network card installed on the network device where the client is located and a fourth memory area, writing the call request data from the first memory area to the third memory area through an RDMA write operation, so that the server obtains call request data from the third memory area, performs call processing based on the call request data to obtain call result data corresponding to the call request data, and stores the call result data to the fourth memory area, and remotely reads the call result data from the fourth memory area to the second memory area through an RDMA read operation.

title_en: Check valve
abstract_en: The application discloses a check valve, which comprises a valve body, a valve cover, a first sealing washer, a connecting plate, a pin shaft, a rocker arm, a valve clack, a middle head washer, a bending detection assembly and a water outlet section, wherein the valve body is detachably connected with the valve cover, and the first sealing washer is arranged between the valve body and the valve cover; the connecting plate is arranged inside the valve body and is rotationally connected with the rocker arm through a pin shaft; one side of the valve clack is connected with the rocker arm, and the other side of the valve clack is connected with the middle head gasket; the bending detection assembly is mounted on the rocker arm; the water outlet section and the valve body are integrally formed, and the water outlet section is of a Tesla structure. From this, can detect the deformation degree of rocking arm in real time, need not that relevant personnel regularly demolish the detection to the rocking arm, not only reduce relevant personnel's intensity of labour, can also know the deformation degree of rocking arm in time simultaneously, guarantee check valve's result of use.

title_en: Method and device for searching terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a searching method and device of terminal equipment and a storage medium. The first terminal equipment and the second terminal equipment are matched; the method comprises the following steps: responding to a device searching instruction, triggered by a first terminal device, for searching for the second terminal device, and acquiring state information of the second terminal device, where the state information includes: first information used for representing the connection state of the second terminal equipment and the first terminal equipment, and/or second information used for representing the use state of the second terminal equipment; judging whether equipment searching conditions are met or not according to the state information; and if the equipment searching condition is met, sending a prompt triggering instruction to the second terminal equipment, wherein the prompt triggering instruction is used for controlling the second terminal equipment to prompt the position of the second terminal equipment. Therefore, the first terminal equipment triggers the second terminal equipment to prompt the position of the second terminal equipment, and therefore the second terminal equipment can be found quickly and accurately.

title_en: Address conflict processing method and device in Internet of vehicles and user equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses an address conflict processing method, an address conflict processing device and user equipment in the Internet of vehicles, and relates to the technical field of Internet of vehicles, wherein the method is applied to first user equipment and comprises the following steps: after the first unicast service announcement message is sent, receiving a first unicast service announcement response message sent by second user equipment; judging whether address conflict exists between at least two second user equipment according to the first unicast service announcement response message; in the event of an address conflict, a first message is sent to trigger an address reselection mechanism. The proposal of the application solves the problem of message transmission confusion caused by address conflict in the existing unicast service.

title_en: Micro control unit upgrading method and device, intelligent equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method and a device for upgrading a micro control unit, intelligent equipment and a storage medium, wherein the intelligent equipment can send attribute information of a plurality of micro control units on the intelligent equipment to a server; receiving a target upgrading notification of a target micro-control unit returned by the server based on the attribute information of the plurality of micro-control units; sending a target upgrading notification to a target micro-control unit through a mother micro-control unit; when the candidate attribute information in the target upgrading notification is matched with the attribute information of the target micro-control unit, sending qualified information of the target upgrading notification to the master micro-control unit; and acquiring a target upgrading packet from the server through the mother micro control unit based on the received qualified information, and sending the target upgrading packet to the target micro control unit so as to upgrade the target micro control unit. The problem of little the control unit upgrading efficiency low is solved, control unit upgrading efficiency has been improved.

title_en: Web application security protection method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a Web application security protection method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium; relates to the technical field of network security. The method comprises the following steps: in response to receiving an access request of a user on a Web page, determining whether the access request includes an independent visitor Cookie; extracting one or more groups of message characteristics in the access request; if the access request comprises the independent visitor Cookie, counting the independent visitor Cookie information corresponding to the message characteristics in the preset time window; and determining the access request related to the message characteristics as an attack behavior according to the independent visitor Cookie information corresponding to the message characteristics, and adopting a configured security processing strategy to process the attack behavior. The method and the device can solve the problems of slow response processing speed and low protection accuracy of the traditional network security equipment in the security protection process of Web application.

title_en: Method, system and computer equipment for compressing channel state information based on sample set
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and computer equipment for compressing channel state information based on a sample set, and belongs to the technical field of wireless communication. The invention comprises the following steps: representing the obtained channel state information by using a tensor T, wherein the tensor T = R + I I, the tensor R represents a real part of the tensor T, and the tensor I represents an imaginary part of the tensor T; flattening the last two shafts of the tensor R and the tensor I, and splicing the last two shafts of the flattened tensor R and the last shaft of the tensor I to obtain a matrix C, wherein the shape of the matrix C is [ t,2 × R × s ]](ii) a Repeating the steps S1-S2V times to obtain V matrixes C; arranging the V matrixes C in sequence to form a matrix C list, wherein the ith matrix in the matrix C list uses a symbol C  i  And showing that the matrix C list is a channel state information sample set. The invention can solve the problem that the reduction degree is lower under the condition of the same compression ratio or the compression ratio is higher under the condition of the same reduction effect.

title_en: Intranet resource access method, system, equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses an intranet resource access method, an intranet resource access system, intranet resource access equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method is applied to a server, and when the server receives a resource request for accessing an intranet, which is sent by a requester, the server sends the resource request to an agent program under a target internal network; acquiring a target resource corresponding to the resource request in the internal network through the agent program; and sending the target resource to the requester sending the resource request. That is, in the present application, a user can access resources in the intranet through interaction between the server and the agent located in the intranet. Compare in the current internal network of direct access through setting up VPN or the proxy server who uses, under the scene that light-weight intranet penetrated the access, this application only need can realize with the help of the agent program of operation at the intranet to the significantly reduced intranet pierces through the resource cost who realizes, and deploys more nimble convenience.

title_en: Terminal and communication method
abstract_en: The terminal has: a receiving unit that receives system information from a cell; a control unit configured to acquire the cell common setting and the uplink common setting included in the system information; and a transmission unit configured to transmit an uplink in the cell by applying the setting common to the cell and the setting common to the uplink, wherein the control unit assumes a field necessary for the setting common to the cell and the setting common to the uplink when the cell supports the independent operation.

title_en: Communication facility site selection method, medium and terminal based on size constraint clustering
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of communication, and relates to a communication facility site selection method, a medium and a terminal based on size constraint clustering, which comprises the following steps: s10, preprocessing before clustering; s20, clustering of size constraints; s30, AP address selection of the class: selecting a node as the position of the AP; s40, preprocessing of classes: connecting nodes which can be connected with the AP and all nodes which can be interconnected together, taking the connected nodes as a large node, and connecting the obtained large node set through a relay; s50, limiting the relay search range of the class; s60, relay address selection of the class: the maximum number of the connectable nodes and the minimum average value of the link budget attenuation are met; s70, isolated point processing: connecting the isolated points with a planned certain class by using a relay, and classifying the isolated points into the class; s80, topology adjustment of the class; and S90, obtaining a multi-dimensional clustering result. The address selection method has high operation efficiency, and the clustering algorithm can obtain an optimal solution under the condition of fixing the clustering number and size by adopting a minimum cost flow model.

title_en: Method and device for merging flight operation data, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for combining flight operation data, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The invention relates to the technical field of aviation operation. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a flight plan and dynamic information storage table; receiving and analyzing the SITA format message, acquiring flight operation time data in the SITA format message, and updating the flight plan and dynamic information storage table according to the flight operation time data in the SITA format message; and receiving and analyzing an AFTN format message, acquiring flight operation time data in the AFTN format message, and updating the flight plan and dynamic information storage table according to the flight operation time data in the AFTN format message. The problem that the airport is singly dependent on SITA format messages or AFTN format messages and the completeness and the accuracy of flight operation data are difficult to guarantee is solved, the defect that flight operation data only depend on one format message is overcome by combining the flight operation data, and the completeness and the accuracy of the flight operation data are guaranteed.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for cross-machine room transmission link optimization
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for cross-machine room transmission link optimization, which can be applied to the field of big data or the field of finance, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring transmission task information (including an identifier of a source machine room, an identifier of a target machine room and transmission data volume of a file to be transmitted); for each available transmission link from a source machine room to a target machine room, processing historical transmission records and transmission data quantity of the available transmission link by using a deep learning model, and obtaining transmission efficiency scores related to transmission network overhead and predicted transmission time consumption of the available transmission link; and finally, transmitting the file to be transmitted by using the first optimal link with the highest transmission efficiency score. According to the scheme, before the file is transmitted, the first optimal link with optimal transmission network overhead and estimated transmission time consumption is selected according to the transmission task information, and the transmission is carried out by the first optimal link, so that the time consumption and occupied resources of file transmission across a machine room are effectively reduced, and the transmission efficiency is improved.

title_en: Dynamic adjustment method for token bucket capacity, storage medium and electronic device
abstract_en: The application discloses a dynamic adjustment method of token bucket capacity, a storage medium and an electronic device, which relate to the technical field of smart home/smart home, and the dynamic adjustment method of the token bucket capacity comprises the following steps: acquiring flow information of a plurality of systems corresponding to the API gateway, and generating a capacity expansion baseline based on the flow information; generating a dynamic capacity expansion threshold value based on the flow information and the capacity expansion baseline; and under the condition that the flow increment of the API gateway in the target time period is larger than a preset target threshold, adjusting the capacity of the token bucket based on the preset capacity threshold and the dynamic capacity expansion threshold of the token bucket. The flow information is changed in real time, so that the dynamic capacity expansion threshold value is also changed dynamically, the capacity of the token bucket can be adjusted according to the flow information of the system, the accuracy of the capacity adjustment of the token bucket is ensured, the intelligent response to the sudden increase of the flow is realized through the dynamic adjustment, and the system is not crushed.

title_en: Anti-hang-up detection method and system and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of intelligent learning, in particular to an anti-hang detection method, an anti-hang detection system and terminal equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring video playing information of a learner when the learner learns on the intelligent equipment; judging whether to learn the current playing video for the first time or not based on the video playing information; if the current playing video is the first learning, closing the video fast forward function; acquiring an anti-hang detection strategy; detecting whether the to-be-learners hang up or not based on the anti-hang up detection strategy; and if the learner hangs up, pausing playing the video and recording on-hook information. The method can prevent the video from being played in an on-hook mode to finish the study when the user swipes a class without carefully studying as much as possible.

title_en: Live broadcast interaction method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The application discloses a live broadcast interaction method, a live broadcast interaction device, live broadcast interaction equipment, storage media and program products, and relates to the technical field of computers and the Internet. The method comprises the following steps: displaying a live display interface (210) for answering and spelling by at least two answerers; displaying an interactive interface after a target answerer pointed by the audience uses the interactive prop on a live broadcast display interface based on the interactive prop selected by the audience; wherein the interactive prop influences the answer spelling result (220) of the answerer. The method enriches the interaction mode of the audience when watching the continuous microphone interaction, enhances the interaction between the audience and the answering person (such as the main broadcasting), and improves the participation and the interest of the audience.

title_en: Automatic storage method for vehicle refueling information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for automatically storing vehicle refueling information, which has the main design concept that whether refueling operation is performed in a gap between power-off and power-on is judged by the quantity of fuel in a current vehicle transmitted by an instrument during the adjacent previous power-off and power-on, and the detailed information of the current refueling is acquired and recorded once the refueling operation is confirmed, and the refueling information is bound with user account information in a vehicle machine and then uploaded to a server for storage, so that the detailed information records of the previous refueling can be stored, and a user can conveniently acquire all the previous refueling record detailed information of a related vehicle at any time and any place by accessing the server. The invention can automatically record the detailed information of each refueling, so as to avoid the situation that a user can search the refueling record everywhere when needing to inquire the refueling record, and can also avoid the problem that the refueling data record is lost due to the replacement of a mobile phone or the damage of a vehicle machine storage medium and the like, thereby greatly improving the vehicle using experience of the user.

title_en: Loop monitoring method, system, computer device and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a loop monitoring method, a loop monitoring system, a computer device and a readable storage medium. The method is applied to an edge gateway equipment end, a target communication connection application is sent to establish communication connection with a message agent end, a communication connection success signal generated by the message agent end in response to the communication connection application is received, electric quantity data of a loop to be monitored is obtained according to the communication connection success signal, information to be forwarded is generated according to the electric quantity data, the information to be forwarded is issued to the message agent end, the information to be forwarded carries subject data and the electric quantity data, and the subject data corresponds to a sensor for collecting the electric quantity data. By adopting the method, the loop of the power distribution system can be remotely monitored in real time, and the loop operation data can be intelligently processed and analyzed.

title_en: Distributed computing power cluster intelligent scheduling method and device and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a distributed computing power cluster intelligent scheduling method and device and computer equipment, and relates to the technical field of computing power networks. After the computing power demand information of N computing processing sub-services is obtained, a BP neural network comprising an input layer, a first hidden layer, a second hidden layer and an output layer is created according to the N computing processing sub-services and M computing power resource supply devices which are normally served in a distributed computing power resource system at present, then the required number of N computing power resources which are in one-to-one correspondence with the N computing processing sub-services is taken as an output target vector to be led into the BP neural network, a new BP neural network which sequentially meets load balancing, user computing power demand and scheduling resource saving demand and completes training is obtained, finally a final computing power resource scheduling scheme is obtained according to the node values of all hidden nodes in the new BP neural network, and the purposes of load balancing of the distributed computing power resource system and combining the advantages of a distributed computing power resource system and a cluster are achieved.

title_en: Factory microservice system, method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a factory micro-service system, a method, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the system comprises a layered service cluster, and the layered service cluster comprises a webpage layer cluster, a gateway layer cluster and a service layer cluster; the webpage layer cluster is used for acquiring a target request initiated by a target user and verifying login information; the gateway layer cluster is used for analyzing the target service information to obtain a target interface and access authority information and verifying the access authority information; and the service layer cluster is used for matching and providing the target service according to the target interface. According to the method and the system, the login information is verified through the webpage layer cluster, the access authority information is verified through the gateway layer cluster, the service layer cluster is matched with the service layer cluster, and the target service is provided, so that a target user can access the target service to execute the service function in the factory generation and manufacturing process, the consistency of distributed transactions is ensured, and the reliability of the system is improved.

title_en: Policy control method, device, base station and medium for single user level
abstract_en: The application provides a policy control method, a device, a base station and a medium of a single user level, and relates to the technical field of communication, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a user level policy, wherein the user level policy comprises policy control information and terminal information, and the terminal information carries an International Mobile Subscriber Identity (IMSI) and/or a mobile subscriber number (MSISDN) of a user terminal; and when the user terminal corresponding to the terminal information carries out a protocol data unit PDU session, controlling the PDU session based on the strategy control information. By the method, the complexity and time delay of realizing the single-user strategy can be reduced, the load of the 5G core network is reduced, and the strategy control efficiency is improved.

title_en: Edge computing soft gateway for numerical control equipment and implementation method thereof
abstract_en: The edge computing soft gateway for the numerical control equipment comprises a data transmission module, a data storage module and a data application module, wherein the data application module comprises a data visualization component, a fault alarm component, a cutter life prediction component, a self-adaptive control component and a cloud edge cooperative component. The data transmission module establishes two-way communication with the numerical control equipment based on protocol analysis, acquires equipment operation real-time data and issues a control instruction; the data storage module is used for storing real-time data, historical data and edge calculation result data; the data application module is responsible for data visualization, fault alarm, tool life prediction, self-adaptive control and cloud edge cooperative data application. The application solves the problems of how difficult the numerical control equipment acquisition protocol is to integrate, weak edge calculation and storage capacity, untimely cloud calculation response and the like.

title_en: Cell-specific reference signal muting for even further enhanced machine type communication
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to cell-specific reference signal muting for even further enhanced machine type communication. The present disclosure relates to a network device, such as an evolved NodeB (eNB) or next generation NodeB (gNB), that may configure a set of User Equipments (UEs) for Cell Reference Signal (CRS) muting to provide better channel quality and power efficiency in communications. In the case where the eNB mutes CRS transmissions that are not needed by any UEs, an increase in downlink throughput may be generated and the connection drop rate reduced. CRS muting capability may be determined based on User Equipment (UE) capability information. In accordance with CRS muting capabilities of UEs, CRS muting may be generated outside of a Narrowband (NB) or Wideband (WB) plus/minus X Physical Resource Blocks (PRBs) based on the CRS muting capabilities, where X is a non-negative integer.

title_en: Router based on dielectric lens antenna
abstract_en: The invention relates to a router based on a dielectric lens antenna, which comprises a shell, the dielectric lens antenna and a control circuit board, wherein the shell is provided with a first opening and a second opening; the dielectric lens antenna is arranged in the shell and comprises a dielectric lens, a reflecting plate and a feed source for radiating electromagnetic waves, wherein the feed source is arranged on the reflecting plate, and the output end of the feed source is opposite to the dielectric lens; the control circuit board is arranged in the shell and is in communication connection with the feed source. Above-mentioned router based on dielectric lens antenna through set up dielectric lens antenna in the shell, is connected feed and control circuit board communication, and sets up the output and the dielectric lens of feed relatively, and control circuit board can be with wireless WIFI signal transmission to feed, then wireless WIFI signal radiation to dielectric lens's inside, and the WIFI signal wave beam through dielectric lens can gather more to WIFI wireless signal's directionality and antenna gain have been improved.

title_en: NB-IoT meter test communication method, system and test equipment based on Web
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Web-based NB-IoT meter test communication method, a Web-based NB-IoT meter test communication system and a piece of test equipment, and belongs to the technical field of instruments and meters and communication. According to the invention, the NB-IoT meter is connected with the test equipment through the API interface of the browser, so that the test data and the feedback data between the NB-IoT meter and the test equipment are transmitted through the serial interface, thus the communication is realized through the browser, the installation of system software based on a desktop end is avoided, the test applicability is improved, the equipment limitation caused by the installation problem is avoided, and the test efficiency is improved.

title_en: Content distribution method in multi-unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary edge computing system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a content distribution method in a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary edge computing system, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary edge computing system model, defining a joint optimization problem of unmanned aerial vehicle deployment and content caching, and solving the joint optimization problem by taking the minimum average response time delay of each user request content in the system as a target and combining a genetic algorithm and a greedy strategy to obtain an optimal unmanned aerial vehicle deployment position and a content caching scheme. The method is beneficial to optimizing unmanned aerial vehicle deployment and content caching, and reduces average response time delay of each user requesting content in the system.

title_en: System and method for key fob communication disconnection
abstract_en: The systems, methods, and other embodiments described herein relate to controlling a key fob. In one embodiment, a key fob associated with a vehicle includes an antenna, a control circuit including one or more processors and memory communicatively connected to the one or more processors, and a disable switch connected to the antenna and to the control circuit. The disable switch connects the antenna to the control circuit in a first state and disconnects the antenna from the control circuit in a second state.

title_en: Equipment control method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a device control method, a device and a storage medium, relates to the technical field of communication, and can solve the problems of complex process and poor experience when a user interacts with Internet of things equipment at the present stage. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a man-machine interaction message from a terminal; determining an instruction work order according to the man-machine interaction message; the instruction worksheet is used for controlling the Internet of things equipment; and sending the instruction worksheet to the Internet of things equipment. The method and the device are used for controlling the Internet of things equipment.

title_en: Automatic diagnosis method and related device
abstract_en: The application provides an automatic diagnosis method and a related device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: sending a Common Gateway Interface (CGI) request message to a Universal Serial Bus (USB) Dongle; receiving a CGI response message returned by the USB Dongle, wherein the CGI response message comprises an ICCID; sending a status request message to a vendor server based on the ICCID; receiving a status response message returned by the manufacturer server, wherein the status response message comprises the status information of the SIM card; determining whether the SIM card is in an abnormal state or not based on the state information of the SIM card; and outputting the abnormal state when the SIM card is in the abnormal state. The electronic equipment can automatically diagnose the abnormal state of the SIM card and output the abnormal state, so that the detection efficiency of the abnormal state of the built-in SIM card of the USB Dongle is improved.

title_en: Message annotation configuration method, packet packing method and parsing method
abstract_en: The application relates to a message annotation configuration method, a packet packing method and an analysis method. Marking the message annotation on the attribute of a target entity type Javabean corresponding to the message type to be annotated to realize the configuration of the message annotation; the message annotation comprises message prefix length annotation, message header annotation and application data annotation. By adopting the scheme, the analysis/coding rule does not need to be configured by independently using the xml file, and other files do not need to be configured independently; the configuration of the analysis/coding rules can be realized without separating from the programming source code, so that the development efficiency can be improved to a certain extent.

title_en: Real-time cooperative deterministic resource scheduling method for heterogeneous equipment of rolling production line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time collaborative deterministic resource scheduling method for rolling production line heterogeneous equipment, which belongs to the technical field of industrial Internet of things time-sensitive networks and comprises the following steps: constructing a network topology model based on a directed graph; constructing a mixed flow model of the comprehensive node parameters; calculating a delay boundary of the mixed flow based on a leaky bucket algorithm with variable data packet length; constructing a mixed traffic routing constraint based on broadcast form transmission; the construction of comprehensive scheduling constraint for preventing the mutual interference of mixed flows, the limitation of network resources allocated to the flows and meeting the requirement of the cut-off time of the flows; and (3) integrating objective function construction of the route and flow delay boundary and solving the mixed traffic priority distribution problem under the multipath.
