The invention ensures that the sum of the delays of the whole network flows is minimum on the premise of ensuring the delays of the mixed flows, improves the overall performance of the network, and solves the problem of multi-path dynamic priority distribution of the mixed flows under the complex network formed by the asynchronous flow shaper.

title_en: Projection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of projection equipment, in particular to a projection device which comprises two control modes and can be switched under multiple modes, and the projection device comprises a projector host and a remote controller in wireless communication connection with the projector host; the projector host comprises a control unit, an audio playing unit, an image video display unit, a voice analysis unit and a communication unit, wherein the audio playing unit, the image video display unit and the voice analysis unit are connected with the control unit, the communication unit is in communication connection with a remote controller, the control unit enters a conventional playing mode or a motion monitoring mode according to a remote controller signal received by the communication unit, and when the control unit indicates that the projection device enters the motion monitoring mode, the control unit displays received motion data through the image video display unit and controls the audio playing unit to synchronously output matched music. Above-mentioned projection arrangement when realizing conventional projecting apparatus instant music, the accessible remote controller gathers user's motion data in order to get into the motion mode, has increased projection arrangement's function, has improved the market competition of product.

title_en: High-definition wireless video transmission equipment based on 5G data transmission system
abstract_en: The invention provides high-definition wireless video transmission equipment based on a 5G data transmission system, which relates to the technical field of 5G data video transmission equipment and comprises a centralized data processing center, a 5G video data unit, a 4G video data unit and a video shooting device, wherein the centralized data processing center is connected with the 5G video data unit, the 5G video data unit is connected with the 4G video data unit, the 5G video data unit is provided with the video shooting device, and the 4G video data unit is provided with the video shooting device.

title_en: TIS rapid test method for OTA test system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a TIS rapid test method for an OTA test system. The method comprises the following steps: the terminal reports the RSRP value through an antenna probe; the RSRP value of the first antenna probe is used as an initial value of the EIS and is issued to the terminal through the first antenna probe; testing to obtain a terminal feedback error rate; then according to the size of the error rate, the level is reduced or increased; until the terminal feeds back a level value meeting the error rate, the EIS value of the first antenna is obtained; repeating the steps, and testing to obtain EIS values of all the antenna probes; and according to the EIS of each antenna probe, performing spherical integration and averaging to obtain the final TIS. According to the invention, the EIS value of the first antenna probe is tested firstly, and all the antenna probes are pre-estimated according to the difference value between the pre-estimated EIS value and the real EIS value of the first antenna probe, so that the times of testing the error rate are reduced, the testing efficiency is improved, and the testing speed of TIS in the OTA test is improved.

title_en: Heterogeneous network-based millimeter wave communication perception integrated system and communication method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a heterogeneous network-based millimeter wave communication perception integrated system and a communication method. The mobile communication macro base station sends signals to all the user terminals, the mobile communication micro base station establishes a link with the user terminals of the adjacent micro base stations, and establishes a high-speed millimeter wave duplex communication link; the method comprises the steps that a user side firstly extracts information such as an arrival angle from a broadcast signal of a macro mobile communication base station, performs coarse positioning on the user side, and after receiving a pre-link signal, a micro mobile communication base station sends a micro base station feedback signal comprising self identity information and position information to the user side; when the user side leaves the coverage area of the mobile communication micro base station, cutting off a link with the current mobile communication micro base station and linking with the mobile communication macro base station; and repeating the steps after a new mobile communication micro base station exists around the user side, and establishing a new millimeter wave duplex communication link.

title_en: Privacy data processing method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a method and a device for processing private data. The method can be applied to a privacy computing platform and comprises the steps of receiving an authorization application of privacy data of a target user submitted by a first organization, sending the authorization application to user equipment of the target user, responding to an authorization statement sent by the user equipment, acquiring ciphertext privacy data from a data storage end used by the target user based on the authorization statement, enabling the authorization statement to comprise information of the first organization, generating ciphertext result data based on the ciphertext privacy data, and returning the ciphertext result data to the first organization.

title_en: Side channel black box attack method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a side channel black box attack method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, which are used for acquiring side channel information according to a preset first acquisition scheme, determining characteristic points with side channel leakage by using a preset characteristic selection model, and generating characteristic vectors according to the determined characteristic points; the method comprises the steps of collecting training data according to a preset second collection scheme, cutting the training data according to the feature vector to obtain a training data set, labeling a label for the training data set, training a deep learning model according to the training data set labeled to generate an attack model, collecting data according to a preset third collection scheme, cutting the feature vector to generate an attack data set, inputting the attack data set into the attack model, generating a probability vector of a secret key, and completing side channel black box attack by taking the secret key with the highest score as the attack secret key. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device realize the universality of the side channel attack and improve the efficiency of the side channel attack.

title_en: System level verification platform for PCIe bus network interface card
abstract_en: The invention provides a system-level verification platform of a PCIe bus network interface card, which comprises a PCIe UVC component, a GMAC UVC component, a scoreboard module, a checker component, a JTAG UVC component and a design DUT to be tested, wherein the PCIe UVC component is connected with the design DUT to be tested, the PCIe UVC component is connected with the scoreboard module, the design DUT to be tested is connected with the GMAC UVC component, the GMAC UVC component is connected with the scoreboard module, the GMAC UVC component is connected with the checker component, the checker component is connected with the scoreboard module, an external transmission test sequence transmits a data frame to the PCIe UVC component, and an external reception test sequence transmits the data frame to the GMAC UVC component. The invention carries multi-stage checksum detection, and can realize real-time check on data frames.

title_en: Barrage information display method, barrage information sending device, computer equipment and barrage information medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a barrage information display method, a barrage information sending method, barrage information sending device, computer equipment and a barrage information medium, and belongs to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the steps of obtaining first barrage information corresponding to a played target video, wherein the first barrage information comprises barrage texts, selecting a first target image containing target objects based on the target objects described by the barrage texts, and displaying second barrage information, wherein the second barrage information comprises the barrage texts and the first target image. The bullet screen information display method provided by the application can display bullet screen texts and corresponding target images, enrich the display modes of bullet screen information and improve the display effect of bullet screen information.

title_en: Method and device for processing broadcast information
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a communication device for processing broadcast information, wherein the method for processing broadcast information comprises the steps that a first device receives a basic broadcast frame sent by a second device, the first device analyzes the basic broadcast frame in a physical layer to obtain indication information, the indication information comprises at least one item of first indication information, the first indication information is used for indicating whether the content of an extended broadcast frame is changed, the second indication information is used for indicating the type of broadcast, the third indication information is used for indicating whether the content of a scanning response frame is changed, and the first device determines whether the extended broadcast frame is received or not according to the indication information. The method for processing the broadcast information can enable the first equipment to flexibly determine whether to receive the extended broadcast frame according to the indication information, and when the extended broadcast frame is not received, the power consumption of the first equipment is saved.

title_en: Method and device used in user equipment and base station for wireless communication
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device in a user equipment, a base station and the like used for wireless communication. The user equipment receives the first signaling and then transmits a first wireless signal in a first time-frequency resource. Wherein the first signaling is used for determining a first set of resource elements, and part or all of the resource elements in the first set of resource elements belong to the first time-frequency resource; the resource particles occupied by the first wireless signal are in the first time-frequency resource and outside the first set of resource particles; the first wireless signal comprises a first wireless sub-signal and a second wireless sub-signal; the target reference pattern is a pattern formed by resource particles occupied by the first wireless sub-signal; the first set of resource elements relates to at least one of { time domain resources occupied by the first wireless sub-signal, type of the target reference pattern }. The method reduces the signaling overhead of the base station for indicating the first resource particle set.

title_en: Selecting a transmission configuration
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communication are described. A non-coherent modulation configuration may be selected for a transmission of a data set based on a radio frequency spectrum band used for the transmission. After selecting the non-coherent modulation configuration, the data set may be modulated using a differential phase shift keying modulation technique. After selecting the non-coherent modulation configuration, a discrete fourier transform may be used to generate a set of frequency-domain symbols from the set of modulated symbols. The set of frequency-domain symbols may be mapped to a set of subcarriers, and a time-domain waveform may be generated from the mapped set of frequency-domain symbols, producing a time-domain waveform. The time domain waveform may be transmitted over a radio frequency spectrum band.

title_en: Node selection method, terminal and network side equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a node selection method, a terminal and network side equipment, which belong to the technical field of communication, and the node selection method of the embodiment of the application comprises the following steps: the first node selects a second node; wherein the second node is configured to perform positioning with the first node.

title_en: Security testing method, device and medium for narrowband Internet of things equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a security test method, a device and equipment for a narrowband internet of things device, a medium and a computer program product, which comprise the steps of generating a control instruction for controlling the operation of the narrowband internet of things device and sending the control instruction to the narrowband internet of things device, generating baseband test data for baseband security test and Ethernet test data for Ethernet security test and sending the baseband test data and the Ethernet test data to the narrowband internet of things device, monitoring the operation state of the narrowband internet of things device for the baseband test data and the Ethernet test data and determining the test result of the narrowband internet of things device, and determining the baseband security and the Ethernet security of the narrowband internet of things device based on the test result.

title_en: Combined navigation positioning system based on 5G, GNSS and multi-sensor fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of positioning systems, and discloses a combined navigation positioning system based on 5G, GNSS and multi-sensor fusion. According to the combined navigation positioning system based on 5G, GNSS and multi-sensor fusion, a mixed positioning server is established to receive positioning messages of a GNSS, a logistics IGV unmanned vehicle, a sensor and a monitoring camera and reply a real-time positioning result, the mixed positioning server comprises a thread pool access port to receive the positioning messages and reply the real-time positioning result, the mixed positioning server comprises but is not limited to a unified positioning result representation packaging module, a deep coupling satellite positioning engine, a characteristic data planning module and a position characteristic extraction module, and the purpose of high precision of the combined navigation positioning system is achieved.

title_en: Aircraft ad hoc network clustering construction method based on simultaneous same-frequency full duplex transmission
abstract_en: The invention provides an aircraft ad hoc network clustering construction method based on simultaneous same-frequency full duplex transmission, which comprises the following steps of pre-clustering network nodes before flying, binding pre-clustering information, designating a cluster head node by each communication cluster, and the rest being cluster member nodes, respectively providing a set of full duplex signal transceivers and a set of half duplex signal transceivers which are provided with dual-polarized antennas and can simultaneously demodulate multiple paths of full duplex signals by each node, constructing full duplex communication links in the clusters by each communication cluster sequentially through full duplex communication after taking off until all cluster member nodes establish full duplex communication links with the cluster head nodes, and broadcasting the cluster head node of each communication cluster into cluster state information by half duplex communication after the communication construction in the clusters is completed, and establishing inter-cluster half duplex communication links. According to the invention, the intra-cluster communication link is built by simultaneously and simultaneously carrying out full duplex on the same frequency, and the inter-cluster communication link is built by half duplex, so that the efficiency of large-scale communication node clustering construction is effectively improved.

title_en: Login verification method and device, electronic equipment and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a login verification method, a login verification device, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of network communication. Receiving an access request of a user, and generating a login password picture; the login password picture comprises each pre-stored password character and an authentication element corresponding to the password character; randomly generating a mapping relation between each password character and each verification element, wherein each verification element is different; receiving a login authentication request of a user; the login authentication request comprises a target authentication element input by the user based on the login password picture; and determining whether the user login authentication is successful or not according to the target authentication element, the mapping relation and a pre-stored user authentication password. The method does not need the user to input for many times, simplifies the login process of the user and improves the use experience of the user.

title_en: Preamble sequence processing method and related device for radar communication integrated equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a preamble sequence processing method and a related device for radar communication integrated equipment, which are used for carrying out double difference operation on an original preamble information sequence by acquiring the original preamble information sequence; acquiring an information sequence and performing phase modulation to generate a target information sequence; performing inverse discrete Fourier transform on the target information sequence to generate a positive phase sequence; performing inverse discrete Fourier transform on the target information sequence after performing phase inversion to generate an inverse phase sequence; splicing the positive phase sequence and the negative phase sequence in the time direction to generate a preamble sequence; the preamble sequence contains positive phase symbols and negative phase symbols which are correspondingly arranged in a Baker code positive and negative bit mode, so that a receiving end completes two pulse compression on each phase symbol (positive or negative) and the whole symbol arranged in the Baker code, a radar communication integrated signal structure of block sliding window processing is realized, the complexity of system processing is effectively reduced, and the radar target detection precision is improved.

title_en: Device for evaluating network risk of 5G private network
abstract_en: A method and a device for evaluating network risk of a 5G private network relate to the technical field of information. The private network dynamic risk identification system comprises a private network dynamic risk identification module, a private network environment risk identification module and a private network comprehensive risk assessment module, wherein the private network dynamic risk identification module comprises a private network data acquisition and analysis sub-module, a private network data association sub-module and a private network risk identification sub-module, and the private network environment risk identification module comprises a private network vulnerability identification sub-module and a private network environment risk identification sub-module. The invention provides risk early warning by identifying network security risks existing in the 5G private network through risk events in traffic of a signaling plane and a user plane, terminal and server loopholes, private network data management and control conditions, service influence caused by terminal offline, terminal environment risks and the like.

title_en: Secure secret recovery
abstract_en: The secret is sliced into a plurality of encrypted slices. The encryption slices may be distributed among the members of the group. Encryption slices allow the secret to be recovered, but require a group rights key to decrypt. Therefore, multiple slices are required to recover the secret, but are still insufficient.

title_en: Battery replacement state judgment method and device, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a battery replacement state judgment method, a battery replacement state judgment device, a terminal and a storage medium, which belong to the technical field of electric vehicles and comprise the following steps: respectively acquiring a physical connection state and an external signal connection state of the battery replacement battery and the outside; determining the characteristic state of the battery replacement battery and judging whether self-checking can be started or not according to the connection state of the battery replacement battery with the outside and the connection state of the battery replacement battery with the outside physical connection state and the outside signal connection state respectively; if yes, self-checking is started, and a self-checking result is fed back to the VCU vehicle control unit. The method has the advantages that the accurate judgment of the connection state of the battery and the outside is realized, the self-checking failure and false alarm of the battery replacement system can be effectively reduced, and the battery failure is prevented from being mistakenly reported after the battery replacement of the vehicle, so that the customer experience is avoided; meanwhile, according to the method provided by the invention, the battery state can be accurately judged, and if the connection problem between the battery replacement battery and the outside exists, the fault point can be accurately positioned, the problem troubleshooting time is reduced, and the maintenance efficiency is improved.

title_en: Internet of things data aggregation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an Internet of things data aggregation system and method, comprising a data aggregation gateway main cluster, a load equalizer and a plurality of data acquisition gateways; the data acquisition gateways are respectively connected with the load balancer in a communication way, and the load balancer is connected with the data aggregation gateway main cluster in a communication way; the data acquisition gateway is used for acquiring equipment data of the sensing layer equipment and sending the equipment data to the load balancer; the load equalizer is used for receiving the equipment data sent by the data acquisition gateway and forwarding the equipment data to the service cluster; the data aggregation gateway main cluster is used for receiving the device data forwarded by the load equalizer as a service cluster, and aggregating, analyzing, processing and uploading the device data to the cloud big data platform. The invention can rapidly and reliably process a large amount of data and effectively improve the running stability of the system.

title_en: Controller
abstract_en: The present invention provides a controller, the controller comprising: casing, display screen, mainboard and NFC module, the casing includes the holding chamber, the holding chamber includes the printing opacity region, the display screen with the mainboard all is located the holding intracavity, the display screen with the mainboard electricity is connected, the display screen orientation the printing opacity region sets up, the NFC module with the mainboard electricity is connected, the NFC module with the inner wall fixed connection in holding chamber, the display screen is in vertical projection on the mainboard is located the NFC module is in the vertical projection on the mainboard. Like this, owing to can be with the inner wall fixed connection in NFC module and holding chamber to need not to reserve the space that sets up of NFC module on the mainboard, reduced the volume of mainboard, and then reduced the volume of whole controller.

title_en: Authentication service distribution method, node cluster and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention provide an authentication service allocation method, a node cluster, and a computer-readable storage medium, by deploying authentication services at working nodes in the node cluster, and maintaining a mapping relationship between each authentication service and a corresponding access address using an address mapping list. When receiving the authentication request, the master node determines the target authentication service and the access address thereof according to the address mapping list, and then sends the authentication request to the target authentication service according to the access address of the target authentication service. The authentication service is deployed on the working node, and the proxy POD is utilized to manage the authentication service, so that the POD is prevented from being bulked due to the redundant operation of adding the domain to the POD, and meanwhile, a high-availability access authentication function is provided. Meanwhile, the POD processing process is avoided when the authentication request is processed in the node cluster, cluster resources are saved, and the processing process is simplified.

title_en: Improved method for realizing batiman-adv routing protocol
abstract_en: The invention provides an improved implementation method of a batiman-adv routing protocol. The method comprises the following steps: step one, constructing a virtual backbone network in the MANET by utilizing an improved UCDS algorithm; step two: an improved batman-adv routing protocol is deployed and run on backbone nodes. Selecting a domination set member by utilizing a DS rule; selecting connected set members by using non-CS rules and CS rules; the domination set and the connected set jointly form a connected domination set; and connecting the members of the branch set to form a virtual backbone network. Step two, adding neighbor node information in the OGM packet; generating and forwarding an OGM packet on a DS member node; only OGM packets are forwarded on CS member nodes. The method leads the MANET to have obvious improvement on the successful delivery rate of the data packet, the average end-to-end time delay, the routing overhead and other aspects.

title_en: Method and apparatus for wireless communication
abstract_en: A User Equipment (UE) selects or reselects a target cell of a non-terrestrial network or resumes connection with the target cell after a satellite handoff for a permanently fixed Low Earth Orbit (LEO) cell. The target cell is a serving cell or a non-serving cell. The UE determines the cell type of the target cell. The cell type may be a LEO cell type, a geostationary orbit (GEO) cell type, a mobile cell type, a fixed cell type, a temporarily fixed LEO cell type, or a permanently fixed LEO cell type. The UE completes the selection or reselection of the target cell or completes the connection with the target cell based on the cell type.

title_en: Time slice-based ranging scheduling method and system for ultra-wideband
abstract_en: The invention provides a time slice-based ranging scheduling method and a time slice-based ranging scheduling system for ultra-wideband, wherein the method comprises the following steps: initiating a ranging request; scheduling according to the generated scheduling information, wherein the scheduling information comprises timing tasks; judging whether the time slice is expired, encrypting data and sending the data if the time slice is expired and the first condition is met, judging whether a second condition is met if the time slice is expired and the first condition is not met, receiving the data and decrypting the data if the second condition is met, judging whether a third condition is met if the second condition is not met, reporting a ranging result if the third condition is met, judging whether a fourth condition is met if the third condition is not met or reporting the ranging result, stopping ranging if the fourth condition is met, and judging whether the time slice is expired again if the fourth condition is not met. According to the time slice-based ranging scheduling method and system for ultra-wideband, the idle time utilization rate of the time slice is increased, and the ranging success rate is improved.

title_en: Control method, control device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a control method, a control device, an electronic device and a storage medium, wherein if an image switching instruction is obtained, image acquisition is carried out on a display device at a higher second shooting frame rate to obtain a second resolution image sequence, if the change condition of the target attribute of a second resolution image in the second resolution image sequence meets a condition, the image switching displayed by the display device is completed, and at the moment, image acquisition is carried out on the display device at a lower first shooting frame rate to obtain a first resolution image for carrying out quality detection on the display device.

title_en: Big data identification and network adaptation method and system based on user
abstract_en: The invention provides a big data identification and network adaptation method and a system based on users, wherein the method comprises the following steps: taking a second user group which has the same multidimensional characteristic as each first user in the first user group as a target user group; determining resident cells of all target users based on ticket data of all target users in the target user group; and determining the network adaptation degree of the target user group according to the thermodynamic diagram of the resident cell and the site planning data. According to the invention, the target user group is identified by extracting the multidimensional information of the second user group (such as the 2/4G user group with the same multidimensional characteristic as the 5G user group), the resident cell of the target user group is identified, the aggregated thermodynamic diagram of the target user group is formed, the evaluation of the suitability of the target user and the network is realized by adapting the thermodynamic diagram and site planning data, the priority order of network resource release and network construction is better guided, and the fastest conversion of network benefits is realized.

title_en: Test method, device, electronic equipment and medium for simulating network multi-card access
abstract_en: The utility model provides a test method, a test device, an electronic device and a computer readable storage medium for simulating network multi-card access, which are used for solving the technical problem that the time of a multi-card terminal in the process of searching and accessing a cell is too long, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring simulated cell information to be tested; respectively configuring an accessible intelligent card in the terminal for each simulation cell; when the terminal initiates a cell signal search and a smart card in the terminal tries to access the model cell, if the smart card is not an accessible smart card configured in the simulated cell, an access refusing message is sent to the smart card, so that the smart card gives up network residence to the simulated cell. The method and the device for processing the access requests of the smart cards enable the simulation cell to process the access requests of the corresponding smart cards and reject the access of other smart cards quickly. The directional fast network searching of the multi-card terminal in the test process is realized, the waiting time is reduced, and the test efficiency is improved.

title_en: Method, device and storage medium for determining consensus node
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method, a device and a storage medium for determining consensus nodes, which comprise the steps of obtaining multiple rounds of election information from a consensus node contract center, wherein the multiple rounds of election information comprises the number of consensus nodes to be elected, electing the consensus nodes of a current election round according to the multiple rounds of election information, updating the multiple rounds of election information according to the consensus nodes elected by the current election round, electing the consensus nodes of the next election round of the current election round according to the multiple rounds of election information updated in the current election round, and determining all the consensus nodes elected by all the election rounds as final consensus nodes under the condition that the number of all the consensus nodes elected by all the election rounds is equal to the number of the consensus nodes to be elected. By adopting the technical means, the problem that the existing consensus algorithm needs to rely on regional chain tokens to determine consensus nodes in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Communication method and device for network energy conservation
abstract_en: The application provides a communication method and a communication device for network energy saving, which can be executed by a first device or a second device, wherein the second device can be a request device for energy saving analysis, and the first device can be an execution device for energy saving analysis. According to the method, the first device may receive first information including a power saving target of the network from the second device, and send a power saving analysis result corresponding to the power saving target, which may include at least one of a reduction in energy consumption and an improvement in energy efficiency, to the second device. The method enables the energy-saving analysis result to correspond to the energy-saving target of the network, and can improve the reliability of the energy-saving analysis process and the effectiveness of the analysis result.

title_en: Multilink flow distribution method and device, storage medium and electronic device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a multilink flow distribution method, a multilink flow distribution device, a storage medium and an electronic device. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring the total expected throughput of downlink data cached on the access point multi-link equipment and/or the total expected throughput of uplink data cached on the site multi-link equipment; acquiring the actual available throughput of each link connected between the access point multilink equipment and the site multilink equipment; and allocating link bandwidth for each link according to the total expected throughput of the downlink data and/or the total expected throughput of the uplink data and the actual available throughput of each link. In the embodiment of the invention, the bandwidth allocation of each link is balanced by comprehensively considering the factors of the bandwidth of each link of the multilink, the uplink data transmission, the downlink data transmission and the like, so that the problem that the bandwidth allocation mode of the multilink in the related technology is difficult to realize a good balancing effect is solved.

title_en: Domain name alarm information sending method and device, electronic equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure discloses an alarm information sending method, an alarm information sending device, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium. The alarm information sending method comprises the following steps: acquiring domain name alarm data; aggregating the domain name alarm data to obtain aggregated domain name alarm data; if the aggregated domain name alarm data meets the alarm condition, sending domain name alarm information; if the aggregated domain name alarm data does not meet the alarm condition, checking online data according to the domain name alarm data; if the online data is abnormal, domain name alarm information is sent; if the online data is not abnormal, checking offline data according to the domain name alarm data; and if the offline data is abnormal, sending domain name alarm information. According to the method, the domain name alarm data are aggregated and verified through the online data and the offline data, so that the technical problems of low investigation alarm efficiency and large alarm error are solved.

title_en: Smart city traffic signal lamp time setting method and Internet of things system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a time setting method of a smart city traffic signal lamp and an internet of things system, the method is realized by the time setting internet of things system of the smart city traffic signal lamp, the internet of things system comprises a user platform, a service platform, a management platform, a sensing network platform and an object platform, and the method is executed by the management platform and comprises the following steps: acquiring pedestrian information and intersection information of a target intersection based on an object platform through a sensing network platform, wherein the target intersection is an intersection provided with a traffic signal lamp; determining a time setting scheme of a traffic signal lamp of a target intersection based on the pedestrian information and the intersection information; and sending the control instruction corresponding to the time setting scheme to the object platform through the sensing network platform, and responding to the received control instruction by the object platform so as to control the lighting time of the traffic signal lamp.

title_en: Control method and device of intelligent device and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a control method and device of intelligent equipment and a computer readable storage medium. The method is applied to an intelligent device platform and comprises the steps of publishing preset intelligent device capability information to a blockchain node when the intelligent device platform is started for the first time, obtaining identity information of the intelligent device when the intelligent device is detected to be online for the first time, publishing the identity information to the blockchain node, subscribing an access event of the application device platform to the intelligent device from a message bus, and establishing device intercommunication with the application device platform. Under the condition of equipment intercommunication, information interaction between the intelligent equipment and an application equipment platform is realized based on intelligent equipment capability information and identity information through a message bus, and control of the intelligent equipment is realized. The intelligent equipment platform is improved, the intelligent equipment is not required to be changed, and the interconnection and intercommunication efficiency between equipment providers corresponding to the intelligent equipment platform and service providers corresponding to the application equipment platform is improved.

title_en: Data index monitoring and alarming method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a data index monitoring and alarming method, device, equipment and storage medium, aiming at comprehensively mastering the influence range of abnormal fluctuation of data indexes. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a plurality of data indexes to be monitored, and monitoring the plurality of data indexes in real time; when abnormal data indexes are monitored to appear in the multiple data indexes, determining data indexes which are about to generate relevant fluctuation except the abnormal data indexes from the multiple data indexes to obtain relevant fluctuation data indexes; and generating corresponding alarm information according to the related fluctuation data indexes.

title_en: E2E data encryption-based communication system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of data encryption communication, and provides a communication system and a communication method based on E2E data encryption. Wherein, the system comprises a domain controller, an executive component and a perception component; the sensing element is used for sensing vehicle state information and transmitting the sensed vehicle state information to the domain controller through an E2E communication protection protocol; the domain controller is used for issuing a corresponding control instruction to a corresponding execution element through an E2E communication protection protocol according to the received vehicle state information; the E2E communication protection protocol is additionally provided with a changed cyclic code for encrypting the communication information.

title_en: Method, apparatus, storage medium and computer program product for forwarding messages
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method, a device, a storage medium and a computer program product for forwarding a message, and belongs to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a first message; determining the weight of each output port in at least one output port corresponding to the destination address of the first message, wherein the weight of the output port is inversely related to the shortest path length of the output port reaching the destination address; determining a link load value of each output port; selecting a first outlet port to be used based on the weight of each outlet port and the link load value; and forwarding the first message through the first output port. By adopting the method and the device, the data transmission efficiency of the whole computer cluster network system can be improved.

title_en: Police condition positioning method and device and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a warning condition positioning method, a warning condition positioning device and computer equipment, and relates to the technical field of rescue positioning, wherein the warning condition positioning method comprises the following steps: acquiring the telephone number and sound information of the current police condition; judging the safety state of the alarm person according to the sound information; if the alarm person is in a safe state, sending a positioning link to the alarm person through a short message according to the telephone number, wherein the positioning link is a webpage link with a positioning map; acquiring position information of an alarm point; if the alarm person is not in a safe state, generating the position information of the alarm point according to the sound information and the historical sound information of the historical alarm condition. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the accuracy of acquiring the position information of the alarm point is improved by utilizing the positioning link, the position of the alarm point is predicted by utilizing the sound information, the alarm condition positioning under special conditions is realized, and the rescue efficiency and the rescue success rate are effectively improved.

title_en: IPv6 terminal identity authentication method utilizing 5G NR physical layer information
abstract_en: The invention discloses an IPv6 terminal identity authentication method utilizing 5GNR physical layer information, belonging to the field of wireless communication security. The method comprises the steps of firstly constructing a mobile safety communication system model with an eavesdropper, then enabling legal communication parties to mutually send detection signals, further carrying out channel estimation on a communication channel, then carrying out decorrelation processing on a channel estimation matrix, enabling the legal communication parties to respectively carry out joint quantization on the phase and amplitude of the channel estimation matrix subjected to the decorrelation processing, enabling the legal communication parties to respectively generate consistent secret keys in a privacy coordination mode based on a BCH error correction code, enabling the legal communication parties to respectively carry out hash sequence transformation on the obtained consistent secret keys to obtain final secret keys, enabling a legal sender to generate identity authentication labels according to the generated secret keys and information to be transmitted together through hash transformation, and sending the identity authentication labels and the information together, enabling a legal receiver to compare the identity authentication labels generated after hash transformation according to the received information and the generated secret keys with the received identity authentication labels, and completing authentication process. The invention effectively resists active attack, does not have the problem of incompatibility with the underlying network, solves the security leakage risk brought by key distribution management, and enhances the security of the system.

title_en: Greedy iteration-based optimal deployment method for photoelectric-radar sensor network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a greedy iteration-based optimal deployment method for a photoelectric-radar sensor network, and relates to the technical fields of photoelectric-radar sensor networks, sensor deployment and the like. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining a minimum rectangle capable of covering an area to be monitored, discretizing an input area, then calculating the number of nodes required for covering the monitored area, obtaining position coordinates of each node by using uniform distribution according to the number of the nodes, randomly initializing an initial sensing direction of each node, updating the sensing direction and the coverage area of the nodes in an iterative mode to obtain a sensing direction sequence of a sensor node, and finally adjusting the sensing direction according to the sensing direction sequence of the sensor to cover the area to be monitored. The method realizes the maximization of the sensing coverage monitoring area with lower network deployment cost by fixing the node position and adjusting the sensing direction.

title_en: Method and device for generating fault root cause positioning model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for generating a fault root cause positioning model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical alarm data as sample data, and constructing a training set, wherein the historical alarm data corresponds to an alarm object, and the alarm object comprises any one or more network devices in a service platform; generating an alarm association rule according to the training set, wherein the alarm association rule is used for representing association relations among alarms generated by a plurality of alarm objects; and training to obtain a target fault root cause positioning model according to the alarm association rule, wherein the target fault root cause positioning model is used for positioning the fault root cause of the fault of the alarm object based on the fault propagation relation among the alarm objects.

title_en: Domain name resolution method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a domain name resolution method and a device, wherein the domain name resolution method comprises the following steps: constructing initial subdomain name information according to target domain name information and subdomain name length information carried in a domain name resolution instruction by responding to the domain name resolution instruction; generating target subdomain name information according to the initial subdomain name information, and storing the target subdomain name information into a domain name buffer queue; under the condition that the target sub-domain name information to be processed exists in the domain name buffer queue, resolving the target sub-domain name information to be processed in the domain name buffer queue according to a preset domain name resolving method to generate a domain name resolving result; the method realizes the generation and the resolution of the sub domain name, further realizes the comprehensiveness of domain name generation, and improves the comprehensiveness and the accuracy of domain name expansion and domain name resolution.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for data synchronization
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for data synchronization, wherein the method comprises the steps that a receiving client initiates an office data synchronization service request comprising an office data file name; acquiring service management information matched with prefix information of a local data file name in response to a local data synchronous service request; sending the office data file name and service management information to the IPFS system by calling the office data warehouse-in service interface to obtain an IPFS hash value; receiving an IPFS hash value sent by an IPFS system; by calling an API corresponding to the service management chain code, and sending the IPFS hash value and corresponding office data file information to the super ledger system; receiving feedback information of the super ledger system; responding to the feedback information, and sending an office data file to a target database according to the service management information by calling an office data warehouse-in service interface; and synchronously loading the office data file of the target database to the target service system by calling the service management chain code so as to complete data synchronization.

title_en: Positioning method, device, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a positioning method, a positioning device, a positioning system, an electronic device and a storage medium, wherein the positioning method comprises the following steps: responding to Bluetooth connection operation between the user terminal and the master Bluetooth device, and transmitting data transmission information corresponding to the Bluetooth connection operation to a plurality of slave Bluetooth devices; each slave Bluetooth device monitors Bluetooth communication between the user terminal and the master Bluetooth device under the instruction of data transmission information; receiving a plurality of monitoring data respectively returned from the Bluetooth equipment; and determining the position information of the user terminal relative to the vehicle based on the plurality of monitoring data respectively returned from the Bluetooth equipment. The utility model discloses a set up on the joint vehicle main bluetooth equipment and a plurality of follow bluetooth equipment fix a position, because a plurality of follow bluetooth equipment set up the different positions on the automobile body respectively, and the data that can monitor from bluetooth equipment of different positions department also is different to can carry out diversified location, the precision of location is higher.

title_en: Method for managing terminal device, electronic device and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The present application relates to the technical field of intelligent terminals, and in particular, to a method for managing terminal devices, an electronic device, and a computer readable storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: the electronic equipment enters a standby state at a first time point, and a first processor in the electronic equipment enters a dormant state; receiving a first type of communication message sent by a routing device through Wi-Fi connection, wherein the first type of communication message is a communication message which is sent in a broadcasting mode and has no target receiving address; the electronic equipment wakes up the first processor based on the received first type communication message; and in a preset time period after the first time point, carrying out power-down processing on the Wi-Fi chip based on the fact that the number of awakening times of the first processor is a first number, wherein the number of awakening times refers to the number of times that the first processor wakes up based on the first type of communication messages, and the first number is larger than or equal to the preset number. The scheme of the application can reduce the awakening times of the AP processor in the standby state and reduce the standby power consumption.

title_en: Method and apparatus in a node for wireless communication
abstract_en: A method and apparatus in a node for wireless communication is disclosed. The first node receives a first signaling group and sends M signals respectively in the M RE sets. The first signaling group is used to determine M RE sets, a first transmission block comprises N bit block subsets, the first bit block subset is one of the N bit block subsets and mapped to each RE subset of the M RE subsets after rate matching and modulation, the first RE subset is one of the M RE subsets and belongs to a first RE set of the M RE sets, the positions of at least one RE subset in the RE sets which are different from the positions of the first RE subset in the first RE set exist among the M RE subsets and outside the first RE subset, and the positions of at least two RE subsets in the RE sets which are different from each other in the RE sets which are present in the M RE subsets.

title_en: Remote debugging method, system, equipment and medium for set top box
abstract_en: The invention provides a remote debugging method, a system, equipment and a medium for a set top box, which belong to the technical field of set top box debugging, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step S10, the upper computer acquires debugging information of the set top box; step S20, the upper computer sends a debugging instruction to the set top box based on the debugging information, and the set top box executes the received debugging instruction and displays debugging data; step S30, the upper computer shoots a debugging interface of the set top box through the UVC video acquisition equipment to acquire a debugging video; and S40, remotely accessing the upper computer by the local client to acquire the debugging video, and remotely debugging the set top box through the upper computer based on the debugging video. The invention has the advantages that: the convenience of debugging of the set top box is greatly improved.

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle group channel access control method under layered architecture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle group channel access control method under a layered architecture, which is applied to the technical field of wireless communication and aims at solving the problems that the traditional access control method is not suitable for large-scale, multi-unmanned aerial vehicle and multi-task required communication scenes and is not beneficial to access control and management under dynamic scenes; the invention divides the large-scale network into a plurality of independent clusters, each cluster independently determines the channel allocation in the cluster, and can obtain higher access efficiency under the large-scale scene with multi-unmanned aerial vehicle clustering. Meanwhile, a channel access correction method based on grouping requirements is provided, and when the total channel resources obtained from each cluster by a single grouping do not meet the grouping requirements, secondary correction is carried out on channels among the clusters or channels in the clusters so as to meet the communication requirements of all the clusters.

title_en: Model generation method and system based on multiparty federal learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and particularly provides a model generation method and system based on multiparty federal learning. The method of the invention comprises the following steps: the participant server uploads the sample data with the preset quantity to the cloud server; the cloud server generates an initial model and sends the initial model to the participant server; the participant server trains the initial model by using respective sample data to obtain respective model parameters and uploads the respective model parameters to the cloud server; the cloud server fuses the model parameters to obtain fused model parameters and sends the fused model parameters to the participant server; the participant server updates the local model according to the fusion model parameters and uploads the local model to the cloud server; repeating the steps of obtaining fusion model parameters, sending the fusion model parameters to a participant server and updating the local model according to the fusion model parameters until a preset condition is met; the cloud server fuses the model parameters obtained after the preset conditions are met and sends the model parameters to the participant server, and the participant server loads the model parameters to obtain a target model.

title_en: Shared parking charging and networking alarm system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of shared parking, and particularly discloses a shared parking charging and networking alarm system and method, wherein the shared parking charging and networking alarm system and method comprise a cloud platform background system, a property side background system, an police side background system, an identification indication system, a shared parking space charging and alarm device, a parking space sharing terminal and a reserved parking space terminal; the shared parking space charging and alarming device comprises a processor, a mains supply interface, a charging connector, a smoke alarm, a current monitoring module, a signal transmitting and receiving device, a second indicator lamp, monitoring equipment, a loudspeaker, a microphone, a solar panel, a storage battery and an illuminating lamp, wherein the mains supply interface, the charging connector, the smoke alarm, the current monitoring module, the signal transmitting and receiving device, the second indicator lamp, the monitoring equipment, the loudspeaker, the microphone, the solar panel, the storage battery and the illuminating lamp are connected with the processor. Through setting up supervisory equipment, smoke alarm and current monitoring module, monitor condition, charging current and the smog in the parking stall to can in time know vehicle condition and charging condition, in time remind reservation user and property personnel, avoid charging in-process to take place unexpected, can early warning can avoid bigger loss.

title_en: Dynamic beam scheduling method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a dynamic beam scheduling method and device. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: issuing a first beam scheduling instruction to a satellite communication system, and acquiring a first beam projection state and a first network communication state in a beam coverage area after the satellite communication system executes the first beam scheduling instruction; inputting the first beam projection state and the first network communication state into a beam scheduling strategy model based on reinforcement learning, and obtaining a second beam scheduling instruction output by the beam scheduling strategy model, wherein the beam scheduling strategy model predicts that the second network communication state in a beam coverage area after the satellite communication system executes the second beam scheduling instruction is better than the first network communication state; and issuing a second beam scheduling instruction to the satellite communication system. The method and the device solve the technical problems of low beam scheduling efficiency and poor flexibility in the satellite-ground fusion network in the related technology.

title_en: Resource allocation method, resource allocation device, and storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a resource allocation method, a resource allocation device, and a storage medium. In the resource allocation method, a detection trigger message frame is generated, wherein the detection trigger message frame comprises a plurality of resource unit index pairs, the index pairs comprise a start index and an end index, and more than one resource unit in the plurality of resource units is allocated to a station under a specified bandwidth; and sending the detection trigger message frame. The second device receives a sounding trigger message frame, wherein the sounding trigger message frame comprises a plurality of resource unit index pairs, the index pairs comprise a start index and an end index, and more than one resource unit in the plurality of resource units is allocated to a station under a specified bandwidth; and transmitting a measurement message frame which does not contain a data part based on the detection trigger message frame. The resource allocation for sending the detection trigger message frame under the multi-connection is realized through the method and the device.

title_en: Coding and decoding schemes using symbol soft values
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an encoding and decoding scheme using symbol soft values. The first communication device (100) transmits a set of modulation symbols. The set of modulation symbols has been obtained from a set of coded bits obtained by linear transformation of a set of uncoded bits according to a coding matrix G, which is the kronecker product of two binary matrices G1 and G2. G1 is a matrix And G2 is a K x K full rank binary matrix, where K is the modulation order of the modulation symbol constellation and K >1, and where M  0  is a multiple of K. The second communication device (300) receives the set of modulation symbols and obtains a set of decoded bits from the set of received modulation symbols and a set of symbol soft values.

title_en: GOOSE message redundant transmission system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of information transmission, and discloses a GOOSE message redundancy transmission system and a method, wherein the GOOSE message redundancy transmission system comprises the following components: a plurality of sites; each station is provided with a station IED, a GOOSE switch and a redundant transmission device which are electrically connected in sequence; the GOOSE switches among the stations are connected through a wired communication channel, and the redundant transmission devices among the stations are connected through a wireless communication channel; the redundant transmission device comprises a GOOSE message database, a wired communication module, a GOOSE message transceiver module and a wireless communication module which are electrically connected in sequence, wherein the wired communication module is electrically connected with the GOOSE switch, and the GOOSE message transceiver module is electrically connected with the GOOSE message database. The invention can realize the redundant transmission of the GOOSE messages between the sites, realize the backup line of the GOOSE data transmission and ensure that the GOOSE messages between the two sites are not interrupted.

title_en: Modularized vertical farm and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modularized vertical farm and a using method thereof. The modularized vertical farm comprises an operation service module and a plurality of standard box modules; the operation service module comprises an operation communication sub-module and a box operation upper computer; the standard box module comprises a box body, a box body communication sub-module, an inter-box interface, a cultivation sub-module and an environment monitoring control lower computer; the box body communication sub-module, the interface between the box bodies, the cultivation sub-module and the environment monitoring control lower computer are all arranged in the box body; the box body operation upper computer is electrically connected with the operation communication sub-module; the operation communication sub-module is in wired communication and/or wireless communication with the box body communication sub-module; the box body communication sub-module is electrically connected with the environment monitoring control lower computer; the environment monitoring control lower computer is respectively connected with the cultivation submodule and the box body interface. Compared with the prior art, the invention can flexibly match with the operation requirement change, and can quickly replace the standard box module to plant multiple types of target crops.

title_en: Data log collection and analysis method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The present application relates to the field of network streaming media, and in particular, to a method and apparatus for collecting and analyzing a data log, an electronic device, and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of analyzing first data log information corresponding to the called current data, determining first playing information corresponding to the current additional data contained in the current data based on an analysis result, screening historical data corresponding to the current data in a preset historical time period, determining second data log information corresponding to the historical data, analyzing the second data log information, determining second playing information corresponding to the historical additional data contained in the historical data and artificial interruption playing rate based on the analysis result, and if the artificial interruption playing rate is smaller than the preset interruption playing rate, adjusting the first playing information based on the second playing information, and playing the current data based on the adjusted first playing information. The application has the effect of improving the user experience.

title_en: Stateful/stateless mixed multicast data forwarding method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of network communication and data processing, and particularly relates to a state/stateless mixed multicast data forwarding method, which comprises the following steps: forwarding of multicast data messages adopts a stateful forwarding mechanism, a stateless forwarding mechanism or a forwarding mechanism with mixed states and stateless; the router preferentially uses a stateful forwarding mechanism to forward the multicast data message; the router selects a corresponding forwarding mechanism to forward the multicast data message according to the multicast forwarding table item number of the next hop router; the state/stateless mixed multicast data forwarding method can effectively balance forwarding cost, forwarding state and control cost of the router, thereby improving the expansibility of multicast.

title_en: Permission verification method and device for decentralised autonomous organization and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a right verification method, device and electronic equipment for a decentralization autonomous organization, which comprise the steps of sending a document cooperation transaction to be cooperated to a server so as to enable the server to feed back a cooperation mark corresponding to the document cooperation transaction, sending a data query request to the server so as to enable the server to feed back user data corresponding to the cooperation application terminal if a cooperation signature application sent by the cooperation application terminal based on the cooperation mark is received, feeding back a cooperation right signature to the cooperation application terminal if the user data passes verification, enabling the cooperation application terminal to initiate a cooperation right application to the server based on the cooperation right signature, and conducting cooperation on the document cooperation transaction when the cooperation right application passes signature verification. The invention can obviously improve the security and transparency of the decentralised autonomous organization collaboration.

title_en: Beam switching method and device based on channel prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a beam switching method and a device based on channel prediction, wherein the method combines an integrated sense of presence (ISAC) technology, and simultaneously introduces a Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface (RIS) to predict channel conditions on the basis of communication and sensing resource sharing so as to make a decision of beam switching. Acquiring state information in a scene of the Internet of vehicles in each time slot; inputting the state information into a reinforcement learning Q value network so as to obtain Q values corresponding to all actions, and outputting the corresponding actions in the current Q value by adopting an epsilon-greedy method; performing an action to obtain a corresponding prize value and status information for a next time slot; storing state information, actions, rewards value of the current time slot and state information of the next time slot in an experience pool; and performing data sampling from the experience pool, and training the reinforcement learning Q value network so as to perform beam switching according to the trained Q value network, thereby improving the stability of the communication link.

title_en: Method and system for generating round-based collaborative playlist and non-transitory computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: Systems and methods herein describe generating a shared list of media elements. The system detects selection of an application icon within the chat interface and generates an application interface. The application interface includes a media library. The system initiates a first user time limit and detects a selection of a media element from a media library. The system adds the media element to a shared list of media elements. When the first user time limit expires, the system initiates a second user time limit and detects selection of a second media element from the media library. The system adds the second media element to the shared list of media elements. Upon expiration of the second user time limit, the system stores a shared list of media elements.

title_en: Flow control feedback for full duplex communication
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communications are described. The described techniques provide for improving Negative Acknowledgement (NACK) feedback from a User Equipment (UE) to limit self-interference during full-duplex communication with a base station. Upon failing to receive a downlink transmission from a base station, a UE may generate feedback associated with self-interference at the UE for transmission to the base station. The UE may then transmit a report to the base station indicating that the UE failed to decode the downlink transmission, and the UE may include the feedback associated with the self-interference at the UE in the report. The base station may receive the report and adapt a configuration used for full duplex communication with the UE based on the feedback, thereby limiting self-interference of the UE during full-handed communication.

title_en: WAF error interception active identification and automatic generation release rule method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for automatically identifying and generating a release rule by WAF (wireless local area network) interception. A method for actively identifying WAF interception and automatically generating release rules includes such steps as associating analysis of WAF alarm and interception logs with user information to determine the relation between WAF alarm and interception logs and user information, generating enriched WAF alarm and interception logs containing user information, grouping the enriched WAF alarm and interception logs based on user, judging if their user is a threat user based on threat judging strategy, screening out the enriched WAF interception logs from the enriched WAF alarm and interception logs, grouping the enriched WAF interception logs based on interception rules, judging if the rule corresponding to the interception logs is erroneously intercepted based on the error judging strategy, and self-adapting release. The invention effectively ensures the safe operation of the service and simultaneously ensures the stability and continuity of the service.

title_en: Message processing method, message processing device and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a message processing method, a message processing device and a storage medium, belonging to the technical field of network communication. The message processing method is directed to a hardware processing structure comprising a processor and a TCAM, and is applied to the TCAM, and comprises the following steps: searching a target table entry rule matched with a keyword from a TCAM (ternary content addressable memory) in response to the keyword generated based on the Ethernet message from a processor, wherein the TCAM is preconfigured with at least one table entry rule based on the processing requirement of the Ethernet message, and each table entry rule comprises a priority level for representing the table entry rule and an indication character for processing action of the Ethernet message corresponding to the table entry rule; and sending the indication character corresponding to the target table item rule to the processor, so that the processor determines and executes the processing action of the Ethernet message according to the indication character. The message processing method provided by the embodiment of the invention can simplify the table look-up step, improve the message processing efficiency and save the SRAM resources.

title_en: Data packet determining method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a data packet determining method, a data packet determining device and a data packet storing medium, relates to the technical field of communication, and can ensure the transmission success rate of key frames so as to improve the quality of service. The method comprises the following steps: determining a plurality of data packet queues; each of the plurality of data packet queues includes at least one data packet; the data packets in the different data packet queues bear different types of frames; a data packet queue corresponds to a priority; determining at least one data packet to be discarded from a target data packet queue; the target data packet queue is a data packet queue with priority less than or equal to a first preset threshold value in the plurality of data packet queues. The embodiment of the application is used in the process of determining the data packet.

title_en: Server, display device and diagnosis receiving method
abstract_en: The application provides a server, a display device and a consultation method, wherein the server is configured to: receiving a consultation request of a user terminal, wherein the consultation request comprises a user identity and a user type of a user; if the user type is the first type, a first diagnosis receiving command containing the user identity is sent to a first terminal, so that the first terminal and the user terminal establish a first video diagnosis receiving process; if the user type is the second type, sending a triage command containing the user identity to a second service unit so that the second service unit feeds back target department information after establishing a triage process with the user terminal; and sending a second diagnosis receiving command to a second terminal according to the received target department information and the user identity, so that the second terminal and the user terminal establish a second video diagnosis receiving process, and the second type characterizes that the user is not bound with any doctor. The method and the device improve the inquiry experience of the user inquiry.

title_en: JWT-based software authorization method
abstract_en: The invention provides a JWT-based software authorization method, which comprises the following steps: step one: and (3) generating an authorization file: organizing and signing various constraint information to form a JWT authorization file; step two: and (3) installing an authorization file: and carrying out signature verification and constraint information consistency verification on the authorization file. The invention adopts the JWT public standard as the main format of the authorization file, adopts the RSA asymmetric encryption algorithm to sign the JWT load part, separates public and private keys, and solves the problems of key leakage risk and compatibility in the traditional mode. The invention adopts a multi-feature acquisition mode of the equipment to form the equipment fingerprint, thereby preventing the risk of single-feature counterfeiting. The invention adopts a system time abnormity adjustment judging mechanism (the comparison is carried out between the verification and the history verification record, and the abnormity adjustment is judged if the difference exceeds a threshold value), thereby solving the risk of modifying the system time to bypass the verification mechanism.

title_en: Method for applying virtual load to wireless charging receiving end
