abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for applying a virtual load to a wireless charging receiving end, wherein the method comprises the following steps: (1) The wireless charging transmitting terminal TX and the wireless charging receiving terminal RX are in communication connection; (2) When the wireless charging receiving terminal RX is in an idle state, adding a virtual load to the wireless charging receiving terminal RX to adjust communication waveforms and coil waveforms; (3) Judging whether the wireless charging transmitting terminal TX and the wireless charging receiving terminal RX are in a negotiation period or not, and reasonably using the virtual load according to a judging result. The method for applying the virtual load to the wireless charging receiving end starts from the aspects of improving the coil waveform and the communication waveform, and the virtual load applied to the wireless charging receiving end RX can enable the amplitude of alternating current signals on the coil to be stable, so that the wireless charging receiving end RX and the wireless charging transmitting end TX can be facilitated to carry out communication demodulation and decoding, and the method has a remarkable application effect.

title_en: Method and device for defending model attack, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: In the method for defending against model attack provided in the present specification, according to a determined target service, in each preset candidate model capable of executing the target service, determining that a target model executes the target service, after obtaining a first output result, transforming the first output result according to a transformation function preset by the target model to obtain a second output result, determining a final output result of the target model according to the second output result, and executing the target service according to the final output result. According to the method, the execution business of the target model is randomly determined from the multiple models to be selected, the difficulty of cracking the model structure through multiple attacks is increased, meanwhile, the output results of different models to be selected are unified through the transformation of the first output result output by the target model, the attack difficulty is further improved, and the safety of the model is improved.

title_en: Multi-picture navigation method, device and storage medium for live broadcast content real-time classification
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-picture navigation method, a device and a storage medium for live broadcast content real-time classification, which comprise the steps of receiving initial input parameter data corresponding to a live broadcast stream sent by a controller, and obtaining current watching data of a user; packaging the obtained video stream and the initial input parameter data, and performing picture classification processing according to the interest degree of a user on a certain live broadcast content; establishing a real-time picture feature database, extracting key frames and classifying characters; calling all real-time picture features in the real-time picture feature database to generate a picture segmentation scheme; dividing the simplified video data according to a picture division scheme to obtain independent picture video data, and generating live video division navigation information; according to the content request of the user, the corresponding live program stream is pushed to the user terminal, and the method and the device solve the problem that the existing live broadcast platform cannot sort the selection of broadcasting small windows and the navigation switching of the main picture and the split pictures.

title_en: Graded anti-interference method based on ZigBee priority
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grading anti-interference method based on ZigBee priority. According to the method, a WiFi module and a ZigBee module are mounted on an Internet of things gateway, wiFi wireless access points are deployed into a three-channel cellular network communication model, wiFi communication indexes are monitored in real time, and interference degrees are calculated. And carrying out channel state evaluation by combining the packet acceptance rate PRR and the packet error rate PER of the heartbeat packet, and judging whether the ZigBee transmission is interfered or not. The hierarchical anti-interference channel hopping algorithm is used for reducing or eliminating interference, a ZigBee channel is selected from WiFi channel gaps when the interference just occurs, the outer WiFi channel is utilized for expanding the selection range when the interference is still unresolved, and the WiFi channel is adjusted to be used for selecting the best transmission channel of ZigBee when the interference is the worst. The invention solves the problem of mutual interference between 2.4GHz frequency band ZigBee and WiFi.

title_en: Cross-border electronic commerce information transaction processing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-border electronic commerce information transaction processing system, which comprises a consumer terminal, a merchant service terminal and a transaction platform monitoring terminal, wherein the transaction platform monitoring terminal comprises a user management module, a merchant management module and a transaction management module, the user management module comprises a first information recording module for storing personal information of a user, an order collecting module for collecting historical order information of the user and a search recording module for collecting historical commodity search information of the user, and the merchant management module comprises a second information recording module for storing merchant information, a commodity recording module for collecting commodity information of the merchant and an online service module; the transaction management module comprises a commodity pushing module for generating commodity pushing information to be sent to the consumer terminal according to the search information of the search recording module, the order information of the order collecting module and the commodity information of the commodity recording module. According to the invention, commodity information conforming to the consumption habit is pushed by a unidirectional consumer according to the history of the consumer, and the order rate is improved.

title_en: NFV arrangement method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses an NFV arrangement method, an NFV arrangement device, NFV arrangement equipment and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of communication and are used for solving the problem that fusion type VNF cannot be arranged in the prior art. The application on NFVO includes: receiving a fusion VNF packet uploaded by a user; analyzing the fusion VNF package to obtain VNF deployment information and CNF deployment information; according to the VNF deployment information, deploying the VNF and acquiring a VNF deployment result; deploying the CNF according to the CNF deployment information to obtain a CNF deployment result; and sending the deployment result of the VNF and the deployment result of the CNF to a user as the joint deployment result of the fusion-type VNF corresponding to the fusion-type VNF package. The technical scheme disclosed by the application can be applied to the process of NFV arrangement of the fusion type VNF.

title_en: Audio transmission device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an audio transmission device and method. The device comprises: the device comprises a Bluetooth module, a first conversion module and a second conversion module; the Bluetooth module is respectively connected with the first conversion module and the second conversion module, and the first conversion module is connected with the second conversion module; the first conversion module is used for converting the first audio signal into an SPDIF format and transmitting the SPDIF format to the second conversion module when the first audio signal is accessed to the external first audio signal through the HDMI interface; the second conversion module is used for outputting the first audio signal in the SPDIF format to the first audio playing device through the wired interface, converting the first audio signal in the SPDIF format into a target format, and sending the first audio signal in the target format to the Bluetooth module; and the Bluetooth module is used for broadcasting the first audio file in the target format to the second audio playing device in an outward manner through Bluetooth communication. The invention can play the audio through the wired and wireless audio playing equipment at the same time.

title_en: Communication method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a communication method and a communication device, wherein under the condition that a time-frequency resource of a DMRS for bearing a PDSCH overlaps with a time-frequency resource of CORESET, a terminal determines a backward movement distance of the DMRS, determines a first time parameter d3 according to at least one of the backward movement distance of the DMRS and the duration of the PDSCH, and determines a processing time T according to the first time parameter d 3. And transmitting HARQ feedback information to the network equipment under the condition that the first symbol of the PUCCH is not earlier than the earliest feedback symbol, wherein the earliest feedback symbol is a symbol determined according to the last symbol of the PDSCH and the processing time T. By introducing the new first time parameter d3, the method and the device increase the processing time T to a certain extent, provide sufficient PDSCH processing time for the terminal before transmitting the HARQ feedback information, and enable the HARQ feedback information to be normally transmitted.

title_en: Internet of things management method and system for building material industry
abstract_en: The invention discloses a management method and a management system of an Internet of things in a building material industry, which belong to the technical field of the Internet of the building material industry, and are characterized in that the management method of the Internet of things in the building material industry comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a unified equipment category template and a unified system template; s2, building a unified data coding standard in the building material industry; s3, establishing a standard structure of an enterprise, a factory and a production line; s4, establishing a production line and accessing factory equipment data; s5, data monitoring, and displaying data fluctuation in a visual mode through a chart; s6, analyzing the equipment data by utilizing a proper mechanism model; s7, equipment control: and controlling the equipment through the Internet of things. The invention is used for effectively managing the production data of the building material industry and the operation data of related equipment. The internet of things data is managed based on a digital management platform instead of a specific product, and functions of remote monitoring, real-time early warning, factory production index comparison and the like can be realized, so that the purposes of improving the management and control level and efficiency of factories and equipment are achieved.

title_en: Cloud storage flow cost control method and device
abstract_en: The application relates to a cloud storage flow cost control method and device, and relates to the technical field of cloud storage, wherein the method comprises the following steps: configuring a cloud storage server into a private read-private write mode; the user-defined server corresponding to the user is allocated, and the user-defined server and the cloud storage server are communicated based on an intranet; configuring a fixed bandwidth payment mode with preset duration to a custom server; and accessing the cloud storage server by using the custom server. According to the cloud storage method and the cloud storage system, the cloud storage server is configured, and the cloud storage server is accessed by using the custom server with the specific charging mode as an intermediate medium, so that the cost of cloud storage flow is effectively reduced.

title_en: Information processing method and device, communication equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides an information processing method and device, a communication device and a storage medium. An embodiment of the present disclosure provides an information processing method, where the method is performed by a user equipment UE, and the method includes: transmitting a first request message to a first network device, wherein the first request message comprises: identification information of the UE; receiving a first response message of the first network device, wherein the first response message comprises: a security key for protecting a location broadcast message.

title_en: Method, system, storage medium and computer equipment for controlling access security of vehicle-mounted intelligent host
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for controlling the access safety of a vehicle-mounted intelligent host, which comprises the steps of establishing a white list legally controlled by a vehicle-mounted intelligent host; monitoring the operation behavior of the vehicle-mounted intelligent host, and judging whether the operation behavior belongs to a specified legal behavior according to the white list; and if the legal behavior is determined, the function management and control restriction on the vehicle-mounted intelligent host is released. The invention also provides a system, a storage medium and computer equipment for dividing terminal management based on the terminal labels. Therefore, the invention can avoid the safety risk brought by taking over the external equipment and network access by the non-vehicle owner and effectively improve the safety of vehicle authentication.

title_en: Combustion control method and system based on intelligent secret key electronic cigarette
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of intelligent control technology improvement application, and provides a combustion control method based on an intelligent secret key electronic cigarette, which comprises an electronic cigarette with a short-distance communication function and an intelligent key, wherein the combustion control method based on the intelligent key electronic cigarette comprises an unlocking step and a locking step: an unlocking step, namely starting the intelligent key in the effective range of the electronic cigarette, and establishing a communication channel between the electronic cigarette and the intelligent key to unlock the electronic cigarette, wherein an internal combustion appliance of the electronic cigarette works normally; and in the locking step, when the intelligent key switch is closed or leaves the effective range of the electronic cigarette, the electronic cigarette cannot receive a matching protocol, the electronic cigarette is automatically locked, and an internal combustion appliance cannot work. The intelligent identification and automatic induction can be realized, and the operation is simpler and more convenient. The electronic cigarette can be prevented from being eaten by teenagers or being mishandled to bring safety risks.

title_en: Relay position optimization method for double-hop multi-user multi-relay underwater wireless optical communication system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a relay position optimization method of a double-hop multi-user multi-relay underwater wireless optical communication system, which comprises the following steps: based on a certain system performance expression as an objective function, a Hungary algorithm is used for distributing relay nodes for source nodes; based on the obtained pairing combination of the source node and the relay node, optimizing and updating the position of the selected relay node by using a particle swarm algorithm; and based on the updated relay node position, allocating a relay node for the source node again by using the Hungary algorithm, and if the new allocation is different from the original allocation, continuing to optimize the position of the selected relay by using the particle swarm algorithm until the current allocation is the same as the last allocation. According to the method, the situation that better distribution exists possibly after the relay position is optimized for a single time is considered, the overall performance of the system can be effectively improved, and a certain guiding significance can be provided for actual relay deployment of UWOC.

title_en: Wireless sensor network authentication and key agreement method, device and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless sensor network authentication and key agreement method, a device and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving first registration information sent by a second node, and sending second registration information to the second node, wherein the first registration information comprises an identity of the second node and a first function code hash value of the second node; the second registration information comprises an identity of the first node and a first function code hash value of the first node; generating a random number, reading the identity mark, the function code and the current time stamp of the first node, and generating an authentication instruction; the authentication instruction is sent to the second node, so that the second node performs authentication verification based on the received authentication instruction; and responding to the signal that the second node successfully completes authentication verification, acquiring a temporary session key negotiated with the second node, and completing authentication and key negotiation of the wireless sensor network. The invention can meet the functionality and safety required by the wireless sensor network.

title_en: Joint HARQ timing and SLIV design for multiple PDSCH grants
abstract_en: Aspects of the present disclosure generally relate to wireless communications. In some aspects, a User Equipment (UE) may receive a grant scheduling a plurality of downlink communications, wherein the grant includes a plurality of Start and Length Indicator Values (SLIVs) indicating respective Time Domain Resource Allocations (TDRAs) for the plurality of downlink communications and a feedback timing indicator indicating timing of uplink feedback communications for the plurality of downlink communications. The UE may determine that there is a collision between a timing of a first uplink feedback communication for a first downlink communication of the plurality of downlink communications and a TDRA for a second downlink communication of the plurality of downlink communications. The UE may adjust at least one of a timing of the first uplink feedback communication or a TDRA for the second downlink communication. Numerous other aspects are provided.

title_en: Terminal equipment and data encryption method
abstract_en: Some embodiments of the present application provide a terminal device and a data encryption method, where after initial data is acquired by the terminal device, the terminal device may perform integer encoding on the initial data to obtain an initial integer, then acquire a secure random number with any length, splice the initial integer and the secure random number to obtain a spliced random integer, and then perform mask processing on the spliced random integer to obtain a new random integer, so as to transmit the new random integer as target transmission data to a data receiver. According to the technical scheme, the initial data transmitted by the sender can be encrypted into random integers for transmission, and the random processing is carried out on the initial data, so that the encrypted results are different each time, interception or leakage of the initial data can be prevented, and the safety of the initial data is ensured. Meanwhile, in the encryption process, related parameters can be adjusted, so that the randomness of the result is ensured, and the problem of low data security in the data transmission process is solved.

title_en: Industrial control protocol fuzzy test optimization method based on coverage guidance
abstract_en: The invention discloses an industrial control protocol fuzzy test optimization method based on coverage guidance, which combines a mutation test on the basis of a traditional coverage guidance fuzzy test, screens high-quality test cases by comparing output results of a program to be tested and a mutation PUT, introduces a concept of coverage guidance tracking, and codes the current coverage boundary in a binary file of the program to be tested so as to self report when new coverage is generated in the test cases, thereby eliminating unnecessary tracking of a coverage guidance fuzzer, improving the fuzzy test efficiency and greatly improving the leak detection capability and the test efficiency of the coverage guidance fuzzy test.

title_en: Method and apparatus for performing multi-beam based random access procedure in wireless communication
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides methods and apparatus for performing a multi-beam based random access procedure in wireless communication. A method for a base station to perform a multi-beam contention-free random access procedure in wireless communication includes transmitting information on one or more random access channel, RACH, resources to a user equipment through radio resource control, RRC, signaling, the one or more RACH resources including information for beam direction acquisition, different RACH resources being mapped to each beam, and one or more multi-RACH preambles being mapped onto the one or more RACH resources based on frequency division multiplexing, FDM, receiving one or more allocated multi-RACH preambles from the user equipment through the plurality of beams, and transmitting a random access response to the user equipment.

title_en: Electronic device for performing emergency services and method of operating the same
abstract_en: According to various embodiments, an electronic device includes at least one processor, wherein the at least one processor may be configured to confirm an event associated with an emergency service upon registration with a first communication system, send a service request corresponding to the event to a network based on the confirmation of the event, start a timer having an end time shorter than an end time of a T3517 timer based on the sending of the service request, search for and select a cell corresponding to a PLMN of a second communication system that does not include the first communication system based on failing to receive a response corresponding to the service request until the timer ends, perform at least one operation for registering with the second communication system based on the selected cell, and perform the emergency service corresponding to the event in the second communication system based on registering with the second communication system. Various other embodiments are possible.

title_en: Photovoltaic power station gateway automatic restarting equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to automatic restarting equipment and a method for a photovoltaic power station gateway, wherein the equipment comprises a power supply module; the processing module is electrically connected with the power supply module; the information acquisition module is in signal connection with the processing module and is used for detecting the running state of the photovoltaic power station; the sensor module is used for detecting the running state of the intelligent gateway body; the restarting module is used for receiving the gateway running state sent by the sensor module, and sending a restarting instruction to the processing module if the gateway crashes; and the storage module is electrically connected with the processing module. According to the invention, by arranging the restarting module, when the gateway fails, the gateway can finish automatic restarting, so that the running stability of the photovoltaic power station system is ensured, and the reliability of the photovoltaic power station for integrally coping with the gateway risk is improved.

title_en: Method and apparatus for unlicensed data transmission in a wireless communication system
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a communication technology and system that converges 5 th generation (5G) communication systems and internet of things (IoT) technology, the 5 th generation (5G) communication systems supporting higher data rates after the 4 th generation (4G) systems. The present disclosure may be applied to smart services (e.g., smart home, smart building, smart city, smart car or networking car, healthcare, digital education, retail, security and security related services, etc.) based on 5G communication technology and IoT related technology. A method and apparatus for performing an unlicensed communication-based and hybrid automatic repeat request acknowledgement (HARQ-ACK) information transmission thereof are provided.

title_en: Clock synchronization method, system, component and equipment
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a clock synchronization method, system, component, and apparatus. The clock synchronization method applied to the slave module comprises the steps of responding to the received first message sent by the master module, sending a second message to the master module and starting timing; stopping timing in response to receiving a third message sent by the main module; the third message is sent by the main module at intervals of a first preset time period after the second message is received; dividing the difference between the current timing time length and the first preset time length by 2 to obtain transmission delay between the master module and the slave module; and according to the transmission delay, clock synchronization is carried out on the master module and the slave module. And obtaining the transmission delay between the master module and the slave module in a timing mode, so that clock correction between the master module and the slave module can be performed.

title_en: Multiparty privacy exchange system and method
abstract_en: The specification provides a multiparty privacy intersection system and method, wherein the multiparty privacy intersection system comprises m participators, the m participators comprise a central party and m-1 other parties; the other party calculates a first exchange message set based on a predefined round of key exchange protocol and sends the first exchange message set to the central party, then calculates a second key exchange message based on the first key exchange message and blind factors of the other parties and sends the second key exchange message to the central party, wherein the first key exchange message is calculated by the central party based on a round of key exchange protocol and broadcast to each other party, and the blind factors are random parameters determined by the other parties through random sampling; the central party calculates a first negotiation key according to the first exchange message set, obtains an encryption blinding factor according to the second key exchange message, determines a zero-sharing set of other parties according to the encryption blinding factor and the first negotiation key, and determines intersection elements of m participants based on the zero-sharing set of m-1 other parties.

title_en: Recommendation avatar placement in an environmental representation of a multi-user communication session
abstract_en: Recommended avatar placement in a multi-user communication session may include: obtaining geometric information associated with a physical environment of a user of a communication device participating in a multi-user communication session; determining an activity type of the multi-user communication session; determining a recommended avatar placement for the user based on the geometric information and the activity type; and displaying an indication of the placement of the recommendation header in the environmental representation of the multi-user communication session.

title_en: Multi-mode voice synthesis method and system based on stack memory network
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-mode voice synthesis method and a system based on a stack memory network, which relate to the technical field of video and voice processing and comprise the following steps: the video information is used to assist in synthesizing audio-visual synchronous speech from text. The speaker characteristics are extracted from the face, i.e., the timbre of the synthesized speech is controlled using the face. During training and reasoning, the corresponding voice is searched by using the video through the introduced video-voice stack memory network, style characteristics are extracted from the voice obtained by searching, the problem of unmatched training-reasoning styles of the multi-mode TTS module is solved, the expressive performance of synthesized audio is enhanced, and personalized voice is customized. The invention introduces the video-voice stack memory network to explicitly connect the two modes of video and voice, rather than using the distance loss to minimize the distance between the features extracted by the information of different modes.

title_en: Method and system for synchronizing switch chip logic stacking two-layer table items and switch
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for synchronizing a logical stacking two-layer table entry of a switch chip and the switch, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a target message, wherein the target message comprises a target field; forwarding the target message to a corresponding stacking port based on the target message, deleting the target field after the stacking chip of the last-stage switch receives the target message, wherein the switch at least comprises two stages of switch stacking chips; and acquiring two-layer table item data based on the target field, and completing the table item data synchronous update of the switch stacked chip based on the two-layer table item data in the target message forwarding process. The invention can rapidly realize the synchronization of the two-layer forwarding table items of the multi-chip stacking switch by customizing the communication mechanism of the MAC Notification message among special switch chips, realize the purpose of stacking a plurality of switch chips to form a large-scale switch with lower cost, and improve the competitiveness of related Ethernet products.

title_en: Method and equipment for forwarding ring network data message by proxy
abstract_en: The application provides a method and equipment for forwarding looped network data messages by proxy, wherein the method comprises the following steps: setting two RPR ports for connecting each adjacent node of RPR ring net and proxy RPR port for connecting one proxy node through direct RPR link; when the collected topology of the RPR ring network does not contain the proxy node, notifying other nodes in the current topology of the RPR ring network of the proxy node; advertising nodes in the current topology of the RPR ring network to the proxy node through the direct connection RPR link; recording an output interface of the proxy node in the RPR ring selection table as a proxy RPR port; updating an output interface of the RPR broadcasting table into an RPR port in a normal state and an agent RPR port; and based on the updated RPR broadcasting table, transmitting the first RPR broadcasting message which is forwarded by each node except the proxy node in the upper ring to the proxy node through the RPR proxy port.

title_en: Token bucket packet loss optimization method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a token bucket packet loss optimization method and system, and relates to the communication technology. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring the current residual token number of a reverse token bucket of the TCP message which is allowed to pass and a window value of the TCP message; and if the window value of the TCP message is larger than the window maximum value of the reverse token bucket, and/or the current residual token number of the reverse token bucket is smaller than half of the volume of the reverse token bucket, the window value of the TCP message is reduced. According to the token bucket packet loss optimization method, through associating one IP two-way QoS token bucket, when one side QoS passes through a TCP message, a reverse QoS token bucket is obtained, whether the window value of the TCP message needs to be modified is judged by judging the residual token number of the reverse token bucket, the subsequent sending flow of the message receiving end is influenced, the overall flow sending rate of the sending end is influenced, and the sending rate of the message and the generating rate of the token are kept balanced to the greatest extent.

title_en: Mining drift node repositioning method based on mechanical antenna
abstract_en: The application discloses a mine drift node repositioning method based on a mechanical antenna, which comprises the steps of obtaining node position information of original positioning nodes in a mine, and additionally installing low-frequency transmitting nodes and vibration sensors on the original positioning nodes; after collapse of the mine occurs, a measurement network is built above the mine based on an unmanned aerial vehicle carrying a measurement base station, a low-frequency emission node is started and emits a positioning signal, and the measurement base station receives the low-frequency signal of the low-frequency emission node to obtain position information of the repositioning node after the accident; modeling and comparing node position information of the original positioning node with node position change of repositioning node position information after accident, and sensing mine situation change in real time. The application provides a faster and more accurate drifting node repositioning scheme, which can realize faster rescue.

title_en: Identity writing and reading method of quantum terminal equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an identity writing and reading method of a quantum terminal device, which relates to the field of quantum communication, wherein the quantum terminal device comprises a processing module, a decryption unit, an encryption and decryption module and a storage module, and the identity writing method comprises the following steps: the identity writing unit generates and encrypts the identity information of the quantum terminal equipment to obtain first ciphertext information, the first ciphertext information is sent to the decryption unit through the processing module, the decryption unit decrypts the first ciphertext information and sends the first ciphertext information to the encryption and decryption module through the processing module, the second ciphertext information is obtained through encryption, and the second ciphertext information is sent to the storage module through the processing module for storage. The identity reading method comprises the following steps: the identity reading unit sends a request for reading the identity information, the processing module receives the request and sends the second ciphertext information read from the storage module to the encryption and decryption module, and the encryption and decryption module decrypts the second ciphertext information and sends the second ciphertext information to the identity reading unit through the processing module. The invention realizes uniqueness, irreproducibility and unrepeatability of the identity of the quantum terminal equipment.

title_en: Encryption chip for information security and data protection of Internet of vehicles
abstract_en: The invention provides an encryption chip for information security and data protection of the Internet of vehicles, which comprises the following components: the bidirectional authentication module is used for obtaining a networking bidirectional authentication result between the vehicle-mounted terminal and the vehicle networking platform; the structure determining module is used for determining the information structure of the received target internet of vehicles information needing to be transferred and sent; the demand judging module is used for obtaining an escape demand judging result of the target Internet of vehicles information based on the attribute information of each component in the information structure; the step determining module is used for determining a data protection step based on the sending and receiving end information of the target internet of vehicles information and the escape requirement judging result; the processing transparent transmission module is used for carrying out data protection processing on the target vehicle networking information based on the data protection step and the networking bidirectional authentication result and completing transparent transmission of the information protection; the data encryption protection method is used for realizing data encryption protection of the internet of vehicles information in the transmission process between the internet of vehicles platform and the vehicle-mounted terminal of the vehicle, and the safety of the internet of vehicles information is improved.

title_en: Method and system for arranging real-time video analysis tasks based on service grids
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for arranging real-time video analysis tasks based on a service grid. The grid management service divides grids of the cloud servers in the machine room, starts video streaming sub-nodes at each grid for video streaming subscription forwarding, distributes video analysis tasks, is managed by the task distribution service, selects the grid with the lowest load for calculation, and realizes load balancing.

title_en: Graph attention-based vehicle networking multi-agent edge computing content caching decision method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a graph attention-based vehicle networking multi-agent edge calculation content caching decision method, which comprises the steps of inputting an edge vehicle networking environment, modeling a network topology into a graph structure, initializing Q network parameters maintained by vehicle users as agents, making a task request by the vehicle users, deciding whether task content is cached after calculation is completed, making caching decisions by the vehicle users according to self-observation of the environment, coding observation values of the vehicle users, generating node characteristics, integrating node characteristics in a local area of the node by a convolution layer according to an adjacent matrix of the node, generating hidden characteristic vectors, and updating the Q network parameters of the agents with the aim of optimizing system calculation time delay. According to the invention, the observation information in the local area of each vehicle user is integrated by using the graph convolution taking the multi-head attention as the convolution kernel, and the content cache of the calculation task completed by the multi-agent through cooperative learning is further considered, so that the minimum system unloading calculation time delay is realized.

title_en: Cloud diagnosis service system and vehicle detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloud diagnosis service system and a vehicle detection method. The cloud diagnosis service system comprises a server and a vehicle detection unit. The vehicle detection unit receives a first detection program from the server. The vehicle detection unit provides a vehicle detection signal to the electric bicycle. The vehicle controller of the electric bicycle provides a plurality of state values of the vehicle controller, the torque sensor, the motor unit, the battery unit and the connecting wire set of the electric bicycle to the vehicle detection unit according to the vehicle detection signal. The server or the vehicle detection unit provides a vehicle detection report according to the plurality of vehicle state signals.

title_en: Parameter measurement method, ranging method and communication equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a parameter measurement method, a ranging method and communication equipment, which relate to the field of communication, can accurately determine the power-on time length of a transmitting path and the power-on time length of a receiving path of the communication equipment on the premise of not increasing hardware cost, and reduce errors in the ranging process according to the power-on time length of the transmitting path and the power-on time length of the receiving path so as to enable a ranging result to be more accurate. The parameter measurement method comprises the following steps: and obtaining m groups of sampling data. The noise duration in each set of sampled data is determined. And determining a first power-on duration and a second power-on duration of each communication device according to the noise duration in each group of sampling data and the distance among n pre-stored communication devices.

title_en: Method, system, medium and equipment for implementing multi-service message notification mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, a medium and equipment for realizing a multi-service message notification mechanism, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition unit, a data processing unit, a service grouping unit and an information forwarding unit, wherein the service is in communication connection with the data acquisition unit, the data acquisition unit is in communication connection with the data processing unit, the data processing unit is in communication connection with the service grouping unit, the service grouping unit is in communication connection with the information forwarding unit, and the information forwarding unit is in communication connection with the service. The invention improves the communication efficiency between services and ensures the reliability and accuracy of message transmission.

title_en: Conference type determining method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a conference type determining method, a conference type determining device and a storage medium, relates to the technical field of communication, and solves the technical problem that information security is difficult to guarantee in an online conference process in the related technology. The method comprises the following steps: determining the number of terminals currently joining the conference and the organization identification of the user corresponding to the terminals currently joining the conference; determining the conference type of the conference based on the number of terminals currently joining the conference and the organization identification of the user corresponding to the terminals currently joining the conference, wherein the conference type comprises a first conference type or a second conference type; the first conference type is different from the conference admission rules of the second conference type. The present disclosure is used in the context of online conferences.

title_en: Method and device for generating carbon footprint information
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for generating carbon footprint information, and belongs to the technical field of computers. According to the application, the carbon emission of the equipment in the running process is acquired based on the real-time power consumption and the running time of the equipment in the running process, so that the carbon footprint information of the equipment is provided, the carbon emission information can be changed along with the change of the real-time power consumption and the change of the running time, and therefore the dynamically changed carbon emission information can be provided, the carbon footprint information is matched with the running condition of the equipment on the network, and the accuracy of the carbon footprint information is obviously improved.

title_en: Intelligent building site management cloud platform based on BIM+GIS
abstract_en: The invention discloses a BIM+GIS-based intelligent building site management cloud platform, which particularly relates to the technical field of building site management, and comprises a personnel information management module, a mechanical management module, a material management module, a visualization module, an environment monitoring module and a safety management module, wherein the personnel information management module is used for collecting information of workers, a real-name system input system is used for issuing a cartoon and an intelligent safety helmet with an identity mark according to the real-name system information, and the mechanical management module is used for providing safety early warning for real-time operation information and working states of a lifter, a tower crane and the lifting platform by utilizing the Internet of things technology. The intelligent construction site disclosed by the invention can promote multiparty linkage and overall planning and design by means of various digital and intelligent means, and can finish unified technical application and calculation construction by means of the unique characteristics of BIM technology. And constructing an intelligent information service platform of the construction site, and further improving the site design construction level.

title_en: Method and device for testing vehicle-mounted Ethernet
abstract_en: The invention discloses a testing method and a testing device of a vehicle-mounted Ethernet, which are applied to an upper computer, wherein the method comprises the following steps: configuring Ethernet parameters corresponding to a controller to be tested, wherein the Ethernet parameters comprise an Ethernet node protocol and a node physical address; calling an objective function based on the test item, simulating the test environment of the Ethernet and testing the controller to be tested; and generating a test report of the controller to be tested according to the test data and the preset standard test data generated by the controller to be tested for the test item. The problem of the test efficiency of on-vehicle ethernet low, the test result rate of accuracy is lower is solved, the beneficial effect that improves on-vehicle ethernet's test efficiency and rate of accuracy has been got.

title_en: Knowledge center construction method and system based on AIGC large model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of knowledge center construction, and particularly relates to a knowledge center construction method and system based on an AIGC large model. According to the invention, through the combination of the sampling module and the evaluation module, the retrieval amount of each knowledge data in a plurality of sampling time periods can be counted, the retrieval kurtosis is calculated according to the retrieval amount of the knowledge data, and then the corresponding time period can be obtained by executing the offset operation based on the time node corresponding to the retrieval kurtosis, so that the data sharing interface of the knowledge data can be reasonably distributed, the data transmission fluency of the knowledge center can be ensured, and the experience degree of a user can be correspondingly improved.

title_en: Data transmission method, system, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a data transmission method, a system, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of monitoring a first data transmission signal of a first communication channel to obtain a first data transmission detection result; and switching to the first communication channel and transmitting data through the first communication channel if the first data transmission detection result indicates that the first communication channel has data code element transmission, monitoring a second data transmission signal of the first communication channel to obtain a second data transmission detection result, and switching back to the second communication channel if the second data transmission detection result meets the preset transmission condition. However, the first communication channel is usually an auxiliary channel, and the communication quantity is small, so that the first communication channel is switched to only when the first communication channel has data code element transmission, and is switched back to the second communication channel which is a main channel when the data transmission of the first communication channel meets the preset transmission condition, so that the communication of the second channel which is the main channel is basically not affected.

title_en: Electric power tunnel monitoring system
abstract_en: According to the power tunnel monitoring system provided by the application, the data information of a plurality of target positions of the power tunnel can be monitored through the monitoring terminal, and the alarm information is generated according to the data information. Then can transmit the monitoring information wirelessly through the communication device, thus prevent the transmission data line from being destroyed in the prior art and causing unable transmission data, then send the monitoring information to the monitoring platform through GSM/GPRS channel of the communication branch center, wherein, GSM/GPRS channel can change the existing electric manhole cover security system from wired data transmission mode to wireless data transmission mode. And finally, the operator can look up the specific position corresponding to the monitoring information in real time and can acquire the monitoring information in time through the monitoring platform, so that the operator can maintain in time.

title_en: Relation database-based bracket mimicry and arbitration method
abstract_en: The invention provides a mimicry architecture of a relational database, which comprises a transaction marking module located on each heterogeneous execution body and used for adding a unique mimicry transaction marking for a transaction, a grouping marking module located on each heterogeneous execution body and used for adding a unique mimicry grouping marking for each SQL statement in the transaction, a resolver located on a database pre-agency and used for normalizing and resolving the mimicry transaction marking carried by the transaction to obtain a target mimicry transaction marking, determining target Socket connection according to the target mimicry transaction marking, normalizing and resolving SQL statements in different transactions carrying the target mimicry transaction marking one by one based on the mimicry grouping marking to obtain target transactions, and sending the target Socket connection and the target transactions to the database pre-agency so that the database pre-agency can operate by sending the target transactions to the database based on the target Socket connection.

title_en: Efficient management system and management method for industrial equipment inspection offline data
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-efficient management system and management method of off-line data are patrolled and examined to industrial equipment, wherein the system includes request control system, data analytic system, database processing system, high in the clouds server, data show district, its characterized in that: one side of the request control system is connected with the cloud server and the data display system through the transmission chip, the other side of the request control system is connected with the data analysis system, and the data analysis system is connected with the database system for processing. The invention can integrate the inspection information in different environments by matching the request controller, the data analyzer and the database processor, realize the complete display of the work order information and the operation work order in the off-line environment, and well solve the problems that the inspection work order information of the industrial equipment cannot be obtained, the inspection information cannot be processed and the inspection efficiency is low in the off-line environment.

title_en: Method, device and equipment for detecting invisible attack of power system
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to the field of electric power security protection technologies, and in particular, to a method, an apparatus, and a device for detecting a stealth attack of an electric power system. Clustering all power system sensor state measured values according to dynamic response characteristics of power demands of a physical load when a power system normally operates to obtain cluster boundaries, acquiring new state measured values through the power system sensors, classifying the newly acquired state measured values into corresponding clusters according to cluster boundary conditions, sequentially carrying out stealth attack detection on all the clusters, and judging whether the power system suffers from external stealth attack. Through the embodiment of the specification, the problem that normal load disturbance and external attack of the power system cannot be effectively distinguished in the prior art is solved, meanwhile, dynamic detection efficiency of invisible attack of the power system is improved, and malicious attack of an external attacker on the power system is effectively avoided.

title_en: 5G-based hydraulic equipment remote control method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a 5G-based hydraulic equipment remote control method and device. In the method, by configuring the cyclic shift code in the symbol and the useful symbol length to relatively change under the condition that the symbol length is unchanged, namely the subcarrier interval is unchanged, a more flexible symbol structure is realized, so that the symbols with the same length can be applied to different transmission distances, and thus, for two hydraulic devices, such as a second hydraulic device and a third hydraulic device, at different positions in a large-scale device cluster, matched symbols, such as a first symbol and a first symbol, can be adopted to respectively send information to the two hydraulic devices, thereby meeting the communication requirement of the large-scale device cluster and avoiding wasting communication overhead caused by low communication efficiency.

title_en: Data request method, device, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data request method, a device, terminal equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the field of computer networks, wherein the method comprises the following steps: responding to an access request initiated by a client to a designated application, and sending a request for acquiring configuration rules corresponding to the client to a server through a gateway, wherein the request for acquiring the configuration rules corresponding to the client carries a client identifier and a designated application identifier; receiving a configuration rule corresponding to the client returned by the server through the gateway; sending a request for acquiring static resources corresponding to the configuration rules to the server through the gateway; and receiving static resources corresponding to the configuration rules returned by the server through the gateway. The invention can make the personalized demands of customers be prominently displayed.

title_en: Providing configuration information for accessing a free-standing non-public network
abstract_en: The techniques described herein enable provisioning of configuration information between one or more network entities of a home Service Provider (SP) and one or more network entities of a network, such as a standalone non-public network (SNPN), to support User Equipment (UE) associated with a home SP that is visiting the SNPN. For example, the configuration information may enable the UE to access or use services provided by the home SP. In some aspects, the configuration information may include proxy call session control function addresses, tunneling information, and the like. In this way, although the home SP providing the function does not have a Session Management Function (SMF) for signaling configuration information of the support function, the UE accessing the SNPN still supports the function. Thus, the interconnection of the SNPN and the home SP network is improved.

title_en: Intelligent reflecting surface, signal sending method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an intelligent reflecting surface, a signal sending method, a signal sending device and a storage medium, belonging to the field of wireless communication. According to the embodiment of the application, the intelligent reflecting surface receives the adjustment information sent by the first wireless device and adjusts the switch state of the first wireless device according to the adjustment information, and because the adjustment information is sent by the first wireless device based on the response condition of the second wireless device to the first signal sent by the first wireless device, the adjustment information can adjust a plurality of array elements included in the intelligent reflecting surface to a more proper switch state, so that the plurality of array elements can adjust the received second signal sent by the first wireless device to a more proper phase, the probability of deep attenuation of the second signal due to reflection of a plurality of reflectors is reduced, and the communication effect between the first wireless device and the second wireless device is improved.

title_en: Method performed by user equipment and user equipment
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method performed by a user equipment UE and the user equipment, the method comprising: judging whether the secondary cell group SCG is deactivated or activated; in case the SCG is deactivated, the configured multi-global subscriber identity card MUSIM interval is disabled; in case the SCG is activated, the configured MUSIM interval takes effect.

title_en: Cell switching method, device, equipment and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of wireless networks and discloses a cell switching method, which comprises the following steps: determining an uplink large-traffic terminal according to the buffer status report; monitoring uplink power headroom and collecting measurement reports for the uplink large-traffic terminal; when the uplink power margin is limited, determining the strongest neighbor cell according to the measurement report; and carrying out cell switching on the uplink large-traffic terminal according to the strongest neighbor cell. By the mode, the embodiment of the application improves the accuracy of cell switching.

title_en: Communication method, device and system
abstract_en: The application provides a communication method, a communication device and a communication system. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that a policy control network element receives first information, wherein the first information is service information or service chain requirements, and the service chain requirements comprise at least one service function; the policy control network element obtains first service chain policy information from a first network element according to the first information, wherein the first service chain policy information comprises at least one service chain policy information, and the service chain policy information is used for indicating the network element corresponding to the at least one service function and the sequence of the service data passing through the network element corresponding to the at least one service function. Based on the scheme, the policy control network element can dynamically acquire corresponding service chain policy information from the first network element according to the first information, so that the service chain policy is dynamically configured.

title_en: Intention processing method and communication equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an intention processing method and communication equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring first intention input information of a first user; generating a first initialization intention based on the first intention input information; under the condition that the first initialization intention is not achievable, a first resource game result is obtained, wherein the first resource game result is a game result meeting Nash equilibrium by processing a first operator resource benefit function and N first user resource benefit functions through a game algorithm, and the first resource game result comprises a game value of a resource demand parameter of each game user in N game users; correcting the intention of the first initialization intention by using the game value of the resource demand parameter of the first user to obtain a first corrected intention; creating a first intention object under the condition that the first corrected intention is determined to be achievable, sending the first intention object to an intention processor, triggering the intention processor to conduct intention implementation based on the first intention object, and improving the effect of intention implementation.

title_en: Control method and equipment for initial trigger frame in EMLSR
abstract_en: Control method and equipment for initial trigger frame in EMLSR. Techniques related to dynamic initial trigger frame control for enhanced multi-link single radio (EMLSR) in wireless communications are described. A first multi-link device (MLD) performs frame exchange with a second MLD on a first link of a plurality of communication links without transmitting an initial control frame. The first MLD then enables transmission of the initial control frame on the first link in a subsequent frame exchange with the second MLD.

title_en: Method and system for providing communication services in user equipment using a data network
abstract_en: A method of providing network services to a User Equipment (UE) may be provided. The method may include identifying an event associated with a first Subscriber Identity Module (SIM) of a plurality of SIMs, wherein the event includes at least one of: the network service on the first SIM is not available, the condition that at least one application associated with at least one of the plurality of SIMs in the UE is engaged in a critical data session, and the condition that the power saving criteria is met. Furthermore, an enhanced packet data gateway (ePDG) interface for the first SIM using the physical interface is created as a mobile network for a second SIM of the plurality of SIMs, and the ePDG interface is used to provide network services associated with the first SIM.

title_en: Data acquisition method and device and method and device for identifying subsidence person
abstract_en: The application discloses a data acquisition method and device and a method and device for identifying a flaccid person, which relate to the technical field of network security and mainly aim at acquiring data for identifying the flaccid person in a targeted manner so as to improve the efficiency and accuracy of identifying the flaccid person; the main technical scheme comprises the following steps: analyzing a malicious program to obtain configuration information; the configuration information is information required by the malicious program for connecting with a corresponding attacker server; connecting the attacker server based on the configuration information; target data for identifying a flawed person is collected from the aggressor server.

title_en: Novel low-power consumption unmanned intelligent gateway and method for electric power material warehouse
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel low-power consumption unattended intelligent gateway and a method for an electric power material warehouse, wherein the method comprises the following steps: at least one closed goods shelf of the electric power goods warehouse, which is used for storing electric power goods; the terminal gateways are arranged at the closed type goods shelves of the at least one electric power material warehouse and are used for sensing the access control action of the closed type goods shelves of the at least one electric power material warehouse, waking up and monitoring material category identification and material taking and placing positions, categories and quantity, generating corresponding taking and placing event messages, and encrypting and transmitting the taking and placing event messages; the central gateway remotely receives the picking and placing event messages encrypted and transmitted by the plurality of terminal gateways, decrypts the event messages and sends the decrypted event messages to the server for backup.

title_en: Game live interaction method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a game live interaction method, a game live interaction device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of computers. The game live interaction method comprises the following steps: responding to the live broadcast operation of the main broadcasting end, determining a live broadcast game account number, and determining the type of the live broadcast game according to the live broadcast game account number; determining the game event predictable content according to the live game type, and transmitting the game event predictable content to a main broadcasting end; acquiring configuration information of a main broadcasting end for configuring the predictable content of the game event, determining the game event to be monitored according to the configuration information, and sending a monitoring request corresponding to the game event to be monitored to a game server corresponding to the live game account; the game event data obtained by monitoring the game event to be monitored by the game server corresponding to the live game account is obtained, and the game event prediction result is determined based on the configuration information and the game event data, so that the configuration efficiency in the game event prediction process can be improved, and the configuration error rate can be reduced.

title_en: Data noise reduction method and device, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a data noise reduction method, a device, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring target data, wherein the target data comprises high-frequency data, and the high-frequency data is signal data with signal frequency larger than a set frequency threshold value; performing target processing on the high-frequency data based on a preset threshold value to obtain noise reduction high-frequency data, wherein the threshold value is determined according to target parameters, and the target parameters comprise at least part of: channel bandwidth, data volume of the high-frequency data, migration rate, length of wavelet coefficient corresponding to the target data, and number of decomposition layers corresponding to the high-frequency data. The application can improve the data accuracy after noise reduction.

title_en: Network flow storage parallel processing service architecture and implementation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a network flow storage parallel processing service architecture and an implementation method thereof, wherein the implementation method comprises the following steps: acquiring the number of nodes, acquiring network card information, and acquiring a raid card of a local PCIe (peripheral component interconnect express) on NUMA (non-uniform memory access) where the network card is positioned and a storage path mapped by a storage medium on the raid card; and performing thread configuration on each node, and copying a plurality of nodes on a single server based on the thread configuration to realize linear expansion. Compared with the prior art, the application has the remarkable advantages that: the NUMA framework is utilized to enable a plurality of servers to operate like a single system, and meanwhile, the advantages of a small system which is convenient to program and manage are maintained, and the performance of the network flow storage system can be increased approximately linearly by simply copying a single node. Through balanced distribution of various threads and relation setting, coordination operation of software/hardware is adapted to different scenes, so that resource allocation and utilization are more reasonable, process codes of a service system are not required to be modified, and overall operation performance of the system is improved.

title_en: Message display method and related device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a message display method and a related device, which can realize that a first message can be rapidly displayed to a target member for viewing without a complex operation flow, thereby accurately reminding the target member to view the first message and improving the reminding effect of session content. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first selection instruction for a first message in a target group; acquiring a second selection instruction for the target member based on the first message and the member identification corresponding to the target member in the group member list, wherein the group member list is a member list corresponding to the target group; and displaying a second message in the display interface according to the first selection instruction and the second selection instruction, wherein the second message comprises a first message, a first identifier and a member identifier corresponding to the target member, and the first identifier is used for reminding the target member to view the first message.

title_en: Propagation source positioning method based on encoder and decoder framework
abstract_en: The invention discloses a propagation source positioning method based on an encoder and decoder framework, which belongs to the technical field of network space safety information tracing, and comprises the following steps of inputting a group of time-varying propagation subgraphs, evaluating an influence transfer matrix between any two users, evaluating coarse granularity probability characteristics of each node, constructing dynamic infection characteristics of each node, constructing topological characteristics of each node, aggregating characteristics of all nodes under a time stamp sj, predicting propagation sources of time sequence data under all time stamps by using bidirectional GRU, correcting propagation source prediction probability of any node v under different time stamps by using a multi-headed time sequence attention mechanism, and outputting a group of nodes with highest probability as predicted propagation sources. The method solves the problem of poor positioning accuracy caused by ignoring the influence of heterogeneous behavior interaction of the user on the propagation, and realizes accurate positioning of complex behavior interaction scenes facing the user in the social network.

title_en: Data security transmission method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of data transmission, in particular to a data security transmission method and a system, wherein the data security transmission method is disclosed and comprises the following steps: the network data packets are arranged in a corresponding mode with array subscripts according to a sequence, the locally generated arrays of the transmission unit and the receiving unit are randomly scrambled according to the same mode to obtain the same random array, the network data packets are rearranged according to the scrambled random array, and the receiving unit locally rearranges the scrambled network data packets according to the random array to obtain transmission data. The invention simply encrypts the data through the random array generated locally, so that the data related to the original array does not exist in the data transmission process, the data is separated according to the random reorganized array, and a stealer cannot correctly analyze the data, and cannot acquire the transmitted correct data.

title_en: Wireless test method of complete machine
abstract_en: The application discloses a wireless test method of a complete machine, which is characterized in that a production test tool is in wireless connection with the assembled complete machine to complete the test task of a corresponding test item, and a production test system is matched with a scanning and communication function of a related instruction and an auxiliary module, so that the high-efficiency test of the complete machine product is realized, and the quality and the functional stability of the factory product are improved; the method is provided with the WiFi connection mode, the appointed Bluetooth connection mode and the complete machine connection test method matched with the Bluetooth connection mode, so that the test requirements of different types of complete machines are met, the application range of a production and test system is expanded, and the automation level of the production and test of the complete machines is greatly improved.

title_en: Underwater image information transmission device based on sonar
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of sonar information wireless transmission equipment, and particularly relates to an underwater image information transmission device based on a sonar. The underwater image information transmission device has the anti-interference function when transmitting underwater sonar signals, also has the functions of preventing water surface floating sundries from being impacted and reducing noise, and the intensity of wireless signals transmitted by the device can be automatically adjusted according to the depth of the water level, so that the stability and the reliability of wireless signal transmission are improved, and the effect of underwater detection of the sonar is further ensured.

title_en: Intelligent education video editing method based on hybrid intelligent text analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent education video editing method based on mixed intelligent text analysis, which comprises the steps of extracting video voice to return text information, obtaining a word segmentation mark sequence by using a word segmentation method, selecting nouns in the word segmentation mark sequence, and constructing a candidate word set. The feature word set T1 is obtained using a feature word extraction method based on information gain. And screening the characteristic words in the characteristic word set T1 through accuracy measurement according to the characteristic word set T1 to obtain a characteristic word set T2. And searching all sentences containing the feature words in the feature word set T2 in the text information to obtain a topic sentence set L1. And calculating the characteristic value of the topic sentence, and screening the topic sentence to obtain a topic sentence set L2. And obtaining a classified topic sentence set L3 by using a classification tool according to the topic sentence set L2. Sentence numbers in each class of topic sentences are extracted from the classified topic sentence set L3, labels of the slice text and time stamps of the voice text are aligned, time stamp fragments are obtained, and video fragments are clipped according to the time stamp fragments.

title_en: Energy-saving communication base station utilizing solar energy and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy-saving communication base station utilizing solar energy and a use method thereof. This energy-saving communication base station utilizing solar energy installs the L shape linking piece at flexible arm tail end under the control of flexible arm, realizes flexible arm and outwards promotes L shape linking piece, and articulated between the movable piece and the first piece of connection on its L shape linking piece outer wall will promote the expansion adjustment of first piece of connection and movable piece under receiving flexible arm operation, and connect and expand tiling between articulated photovoltaic board one and photovoltaic board two in L shape linking piece top, and the lithium cell of installation is used for collecting the electric energy of photovoltaic collection in the motor to through contact and external butt joint that lithium cell top is connected, with the electric energy transmission.

title_en: Vehicle positioning optimization management method based on vehicle-mounted central security gateway
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle positioning optimization management method based on a vehicle-mounted central security gateway, which relates to the technical field of vehicle-mounted equipment security.

title_en: Network traffic detection method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a network traffic detection method, a network traffic detection device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method relates to the technical field of communication. The method comprises the following steps: determining whether an incoming interface is a target detection interface or not based on the incoming interface for receiving the current message; if the incoming interface is a target detection interface, determining whether to perform flow detection on the current message based on a network quality analysis table, wherein a virtual private network VPN identifier and a positioning identifier Locator address are stored in the network quality analysis table. The present disclosure may no longer be limited by the five-tuple constraint, but may determine which traffic should be detected through the matching of interfaces and the network quality analysis table. Specifically, the present disclosure may define a message to be detected through VPN and Locator addresses in a network quality analysis table, so as to precisely match traffic to be detected by looking up the network quality analysis table.
