title_en: Encryption transmission method, decryption transmission method, encryption device and decryption device
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an encryption transmission method, a decryption transmission method, an encryption device, and a decryption device, where the encryption transmission method is applied to an electronic device, the electronic device at least includes a network filtering driving module and an OpenPGP module, and the encryption transmission method includes: detecting a mail currently being sent, and capturing a data packet corresponding to the mail through a network filtering driving module; analyzing the data packet to obtain a mail transmission protocol in the data packet; extracting a corresponding mail text in the data packet according to the mail transmission protocol, and encrypting the mail text through an OpenPGP module, wherein the OpenPGP module comprises a PGP certificate for encrypting the mail text; and sending the encrypted mail text to a receiver.

title_en: Monitoring equipment supervision system and method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring equipment supervision system and a monitoring equipment supervision method based on the Internet of things, and particularly relates to the technical field of the Internet of things, wherein the monitoring equipment supervision system comprises a data acquisition module, a data preprocessing module, a data transmission module, an edge equipment processing module, a cloud platform processing center, an equipment supervision module and a remote control module; training a machine learning model through a cloud platform processing center, and compressing and optimizing the trained model to reduce the size and complexity of the model; performing model inference locally through an edge device processing module, so as to avoid transmitting a large amount of original data to a cloud platform processing center for processing; the monitoring equipment is controlled, configured and managed remotely through the remote control module, the management efficiency of the monitoring equipment is improved, all remote control, configuration and management operation logs are reserved, subsequent audit, fault investigation and maintenance work are facilitated, and the integrity and traceability of operation are ensured.

title_en: Method for improving file verification speed in file transmission system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving file verification speed in a file transmission system. According to the invention, different inspection methods are selected according to the size of the file, so that the inspection speed of the file can be greatly improved, and the file inspection method has very high reliability. And by negotiating the verification capability between the transmission end and the receiving end, providing an optimal verification method for each transmitted file in different file sizes.

title_en: Time-sharing communication system based on power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power supply communication, in particular to a time-sharing communication system based on a power grid, which comprises the following components: the receiving module receives a plurality of text messages to be transferred uploaded by a user; the uploading module uploads the text information to be transmitted according to the time sequence of the transit time to obtain uploaded text information; the transmission module judges the integrity and the accuracy of the uploaded text information, receives a coding activation instruction when the result is complete and accurate, adds an initial check symbol to the uploaded text information, codes the initial check symbol, acquires the coded information to be transmitted and transmits the coded information through any transmission channel; the acquisition module receives the termination code word information and records the receiving time; the channel judging module judges the integrity of the transmission channel according to the receiving time and the transit time; and the information judging module is used for decoding the termination code text information through the decoder to obtain termination text information and judging whether the termination text information is tampered, and if the termination code text information is not tampered, the termination code text information is the text information to be transferred. The invention solves the problem of inaccurate transmission results.

title_en: Signal access method, signal access device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a signal access method, a signal access device, computer equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of wireless communication. The method comprises the following steps: determining whether the currently accessed wireless signal source is a target wireless signal source in at least two wireless signal sources under the condition that the UE is determined to be positioned in the signal coverage areas of the at least two wireless signal sources and positioned in the signal coverage boundary of any wireless signal source; if the wireless signal source is the target wireless signal source, the wireless signal source which is accessed currently is maintained unchanged. When the method supports the UE to move back and forth on the boundary line of the coverage areas of the plurality of wireless signal sources, the target wireless signal source is actively determined from the plurality of wireless signal sources, so that the shake caused by the frequently switched connection of the wireless signal sources is avoided, the UE can reasonably access the plurality of wireless signal sources in the moving process, and the stability of the signal access of the UE is ensured.

title_en: Multimode ticket processing system based on ARM technology system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multimode ticket processing system based on an ARM technical system, which relates to the technical field of ARM, and comprises: the ticket mode acquisition unit is used for acquiring the traffic mode of the target ticket; the ARM random code generation unit is used for generating an initial random code of the ticket by using the ARM processor according to the type code corresponding to the type of the vehicle and the purchase code corresponding to the purchase mode; a high-dimensional data generating unit for generating a high-dimensional chaotic sequence by applying high-dimensional chaotic mapping a plurality of times from an initial state vector using an ARM processor, and generating high-dimensional data using the high-dimensional chaotic sequence; the Grad error correction code processing unit is used for generating the Grad error correction code by using the ARM processor and the generated high-dimensional data to obtain an encoded codeword; and the anti-counterfeiting code generating unit is used for obtaining a final anti-counterfeiting code after high-dimensional chaotic encryption by using the ARM processor. The invention improves the security, anti-counterfeiting performance, reliability and attack resistance of the ticket.

title_en: Log safe storage and efficient query method based on blockchain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safe log storage and efficient query method based on a blockchain, and belongs to the technical field of information security. Firstly, a chain uplink and downlink collaborative tamper-proof log storage framework based on a blockchain is designed, wherein a log server receives a log uploaded by a log generator through a secure channel and stores the log in an encrypted mode, meanwhile, keywords in the log are extracted to construct an inverted sequence index table, and the index table is stored in the blockchain in a transaction mode. The framework ensures the tamper resistance and integrity of the log through the non-tamper resistance of the data on the chain and the effective mapping of the data on the chain and the data under the chain. On the basis of the framework, a safe and efficient log query method is designed: the identity of the log inquirer is authenticated by the access control strategy based on the role, the request of the legal log inquirer is efficiently processed by using the intelligent contract, and the index item is saved by adopting the self-adaptive prefix tree as the data structure, so that the efficient retrieval of the log is realized.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted mobile phone interconnection diagnosis system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle-mounted mobile phone interconnection diagnosis system and a method thereof in the technical field of vehicle-mounted mobile phone interconnection diagnosis, wherein the vehicle-mounted mobile phone interconnection diagnosis system comprises a mobile phone end and a vehicle machine end, the mobile phone end and the vehicle machine end carry out protocol stack software layer communication through a virtual software channel, the mobile phone end and the vehicle machine end carry out information connection between the mobile phone end and the vehicle machine end through an interconnection unit, and the mobile phone end and the vehicle machine end carry out function diagnosis through a diagnosis software module architecture. The mobile phone interconnection system can solve the problem positioning in the mobile phone interconnection development process, and realize the problem positioning and detailed process recording of abnormal mobile phone interconnection faults in the production process of the vehicle and the machine, particularly in the after-sale process. The after-sale pressure of Tier1 and a vehicle factory is greatly reduced, the after-sale efficiency is greatly improved, and the quality improvement of mobile phone manufacturers and vehicle manufacturers is facilitated.

title_en: Computing power resource sharing method, device and storage medium based on computing priority network
abstract_en: The application provides a computing power resource sharing method, device and storage medium based on a computing priority network, and relates to the technical field of computing power scheduling. The method comprises the following steps: based on the first edge node receiving the computational power service request, determining a computational power resource using node which sends out the computational power service request; determining a target computing power service node for processing the computing power service request based on the control module, and determining a corresponding target address and computing power resource access strategy of the target computing power service node; and sending the computing power service request to a target computing power service node corresponding to the target address based on the first convergent node, so that the target computing power service node processes the computing power service request based on the computing power resource access strategy, and sending a processing result of the computing power service request to the computing power resource use node. The method of the application achieves the technical effects of improving the utilization rate of the computing power resources and the processing efficiency of the production task.

title_en: Third party information acquisition method, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a third party information acquisition method, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a service call request; the service call request is generated when the access terminal server requests to use the third party service; the proxy server belongs to a proxy server cluster registered in a registration center; the registry is used for registering the access terminal service deployed on the access terminal server; the access terminal service calls the proxy server in a service discovery mode; obtaining a third party service calling result according to the service calling request; generating third party information responding to the service call request according to the third party service call result; and sending the third party information to the access terminal server, so that the access terminal server can forward the third party information to the terminal. The method and the device can improve the efficiency and the safety of acquiring the third party information through the proxy server.

title_en: Passive device reference signal
abstract_en: Aspects of the present disclosure generally relate to wireless communications. In some aspects, a User Equipment (UE) may receive a first set of reference signals and a second set of reference signals from a base station, wherein the second set of reference signals is reflected from a first passive device operating as a Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface (RIS). The UE may communicate with the base station in consideration of the first passive device. Many other aspects are described.

title_en: User plane connection establishment method and device, communication equipment, communication system and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method and a device for establishing user plane connection, a communication device, a communication system and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the first network element can acquire first information, wherein the first information is used for the terminal to sign up online in a common Application Programming Interface (API) architecture (CAPF) core function; and establishing a user plane path according to the first information, wherein the user plane path is used for establishing user plane connection between the terminal and the CAPFA core function. The method can realize the establishment of the user plane path connected with the CAPPIF core function.

title_en: Router testing method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of computers, and discloses a router testing method, a router testing device, router testing equipment and a storage medium. The invention obtains a test data packet by selecting a seed data packet from a preset seed set and carrying out data transformation on the seed data packet; transmitting the test data packet to the router to be tested so that the router to be tested runs the test according to the test data packet; if the router to be tested is down, the crash log information generated when the router to be tested is down is stored, and the state of the router to be tested is recovered. Because the router to be tested is tested by adopting the test data packet subjected to data transformation during testing, the coverage rate of the testing can be improved, so that more comprehensive loopholes in the router are ensured to be excavated, and the router can be quickly subjected to state recovery when the router is down, so that the next testing can be ensured to be quickly performed, and the testing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Novel router supporting multi-network access
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the router field, and provides a novel router supporting multi-network access, which comprises a body, wherein the body is provided with a plurality of interfaces, and the novel router further comprises: a frame slidingly coupled with a wire assembly; a winding mechanism is arranged on one side of the wire assembly; the bottom fixedly connected with a plurality of sucking disc of body, the bottom of body is provided with the sleeve, all communicates between every sucking disc and the sleeve and has the air duct, be provided with adjustment mechanism in the sleeve. A novel router supporting multi-network access is characterized in that after the air pressure in a sleeve reaches a certain value, a second fluted disc is locked and does not move, at the moment, the second fluted disc is relative to the first fluted disc to continue to rotate, after a winding mechanism completes winding, the first fluted disc and the second fluted disc are locked, so that the air pressure in the sleeve is ensured to be stable, the adsorption force between a sucker and a wall surface is ensured, and the problem that the existing novel router supporting multi-network access is easy to fall off when the sucker is adsorbed by the wall surface is solved.

title_en: BIM and Internet of things-based fabricated building carbon emission control method
abstract_en: The disclosure provides an assembled building carbon emission control method based on BIM and Internet of things, which relates to building carbon emission technology, and comprises the following steps: building a BIM model of the assembled building, and embedding a carbon emission coefficient accounting formula and a greenhouse gas emission amount calculating formula into the BIM model; based on the Internet of things technology and the BIM model, building activity data acquisition is carried out on a plurality of production stages of the fabricated building, and a plurality of building activity data sets are obtained; calculating a predicted total carbon emission based on the plurality of building activity data sets; and when the predicted total carbon emission is greater than the preset total carbon emission threshold, optimizing and adjusting the production plan of the fabricated building. The method can solve the technical problem that the accuracy of carbon emission calculation is low due to the fact that the existing assembly type building carbon emission calculation mode is not refined, and can improve the accuracy of the carbon emission calculation result, so that the carbon emission control level of the assembly type building is improved.

title_en: Satellite communication self-adaptive coding modulation method
abstract_en: An improved adaptive code modulation method comprising: after receiving the signal-to-noise ratio reported by the satellite terminal, the satellite gateway station carries out weighting processing on the historical signal-to-noise ratio in a certain time window and the signal-to-noise ratio at the current moment and predicts the signal-to-noise ratio at the next moment; the satellite terminal periodically feeds back the error rate at the current moment; and according to the error rate at the current moment, adjusting the initial MCS of the predicted signal-to-noise ratio mapping to obtain the MCS value at the next moment. The signal-to-noise ratio of the next moment is predicted through the signal-to-noise ratio smoothing processing, so that jitter caused by single errors is avoided; the satellite terminal directly feeds back the error rate instead of feeding back the ACK/NACK, so that the return air interface resource is saved; according to the error rate adjustment, the error of the predicted signal to noise ratio can be avoided, and the rapid change of the tracking channel can be completed in an auxiliary way.

title_en: Quantum distributed data storage and recovery method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantum distributed data storage and recovery method, which relates to the technical field of data encryption, and a storage node is used for storing received data; the storage management server is used for decrypting the received encrypted information to obtain shared secret information and shared password information; the user end establishes a channel with the storage management server through a quantum channel and a classical channel, and the quantum channel distributes a secret key by adopting QKD; and the quantum random number generator is connected with the storage management server and used for generating quantum random numbers. According to the quantum distributed data storage and recovery method, password authentication and quantum communication are combined, the shared secret fragments of recovered data can be obtained only by having a correct authentication password, the quantum communication can realize the distribution of a quantum key with the safety ensured by quantum physical characteristics, and the quantum key is used for encrypting transmission signaling and data, so that the safety of communication is improved.

title_en: Method for acquiring APT multi-relation prediction model, relation prediction method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method for acquiring an APT multi-relation prediction model, a relation prediction method and a device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting APT attack reports or related logs to form an original report information set; converting the original report information set into a graph structure; repeating the following processes until the training process of the graph neural network is finished, and obtaining an APT multi-relation prediction model: performing polygonal relation prediction based on the graph structure and the graph neural network to obtain a plurality of paths taking each entity as a starting point and relation types of each path; and calculating loss values corresponding to the paths and the relation types, and adjusting parameters of the graph neural network according to the loss values. By adopting the embodiment of the application, the multi-relation among the entities (namely, the connection relation among a plurality of entities) can be deduced, and the novel APT entity multi-relation prediction scheme can predict all potential associated entities according to the characteristics of the APT entities, so that the defects can be effectively solved.

title_en: Factory production safety management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a factory production safety management system, which comprises a production workshop acquisition module, a production environment acquisition module, a production image acquisition module, VR playing equipment, a wearer information acquisition module, a data processing module and an information sending module; the production workshop acquisition module is used for acquiring production workshop information, the production environment acquisition module is used for acquiring production environment information, and the production image acquisition module is used for acquiring production image information; the data processing module is used for processing the production image information and converting the production image information into factory VR live broadcast content in real time, and the factory VR live broadcast content is sent to VR playing equipment for playing; the wearing person acquisition module is used for acquiring wearing person information of wearing VR playing equipment in real time. The invention can more comprehensively carry out the safety management of factory production.

title_en: Control box for railway tunnel video monitoring
abstract_en: The invention provides a control box for railway tunnel video monitoring, which comprises: a case; the intelligent circuit breaker is arranged in the box body and used for controlling the running state of the power supply; the communication device is arranged in the box body and is used for being in communication connection with the control terminal through a network; and the controller is arranged in the box body and is respectively in communication connection with the intelligent circuit breaker and the communication device, and the controller is used for controlling the working state of the intelligent circuit breaker according to the control signal of the control terminal. According to the control box, the communication device, the intelligent circuit breaker and the controller are arranged, and the reclosing instruction can be remotely sent to the controller through the control terminal, so that the intelligent circuit breaker is remotely controlled to finish reclosing.

title_en: Method and apparatus in a node for wireless communication
abstract_en: A method and apparatus in a node for wireless communication is disclosed. A first receiver that receives a first signaling; a first transmitter for transmitting a first signal in a first time-frequency resource pool, wherein the first signal carries a first bit block and a second bit block; wherein the first signaling is used to determine the first time-frequency resource pool; the second bit block comprises a transport block, and the first bit block comprises at least one of a first type HARQ-ACK or a second type HARQ-ACK; the number of HARQ-ACK bits included in the first bit block and the type of HARQ-ACK included in the first bit block are used together to determine the number of time-frequency resource elements included in a first reserved resource pool; the target coded bit sequence output via the first procedure is related to the number of time-frequency resource elements comprised by the first reserved resource pool, and the first bit block and the second bit block are each used for determining the target coded bit sequence.

title_en: Cloud computing-based power data quality monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power data quality monitoring method based on cloud computing, which relates to the technical field of power transmission, and is characterized in that environmental condition data in a monitoring area is acquired, a weather coefficient T (x) is generated, the communication state of the weather coefficient T (x) is monitored, a communication state set is established, a communication coefficient T (S) is acquired, power data sent by a monitoring node is received, a data quality coefficient S (p) is generated and output by the power data set, and the quality of electronic data is evaluated; performing multiple linear regression analysis, namely adding the corresponding regression coefficients to obtain coefficients and Xs, and predicting the change trend of the data quality coefficient S (p) when the coefficients and Xs exceed a coefficient threshold value to obtain a predicted value S (p) Y of the data quality coefficient S (p); judging whether the corresponding monitoring node has or is about to have an operation fault, avoiding continuous output of low-quality power data, and guaranteeing high quality of the power data.

title_en: Remote monitoring system for solar aviation obstruction lights
abstract_en: The invention relates to a remote monitoring system for a solar aviation obstruction lamp, which belongs to the technical field of remote monitoring of aviation obstruction lamps, wherein the monitoring system can monitor the state and the performance of the lamp in real time by arranging a monitoring module and collecting working parameters of the aviation obstruction lamp, and a cloud service module receives and processes monitoring data, and can conveniently know the working state of the aviation obstruction lamp by comparing with a set threshold value, so that abnormal conditions can be found in time and the monitoring system can be processed and maintained in time. The monitoring modules are constructed into a netlike topological structure through the second communication units, the structure can realize mutual communication among the monitoring modules, the selection of communication lines between the monitoring modules and the cloud service module is increased, and the stability and the reliability of the system are improved. The electric signal of the solar power supply circuit and the electric signal of the aviation obstruction lamp working circuit are sampled and monitored to monitor whether the solar power supply module can normally supply power for the aviation obstruction lamp.

title_en: Optical cable routing optical cable common mode risk early warning system and method based on optical cable routing optical cable common mode risk early warning system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optical cable risk early warning, in particular to an optical cable routing optical cable common mode risk early warning system and method based on optical cable routing, wherein the system comprises the following components: the system comprises a data detection unit, a risk analysis unit and a risk early warning unit; the method comprises the following steps of detecting an optical cable to obtain data information of the optical cable, determining an optical cable route of the optical cable, and obtaining a plurality of initial waveform diagrams of the optical cable route; calculating a hash value of the optical cable route through a public hash function, judging whether the optical cable has a common mode risk or not, generating an early warning signal, sending the early warning signal to a risk early warning unit, and acquiring and displaying state information of the optical cable route according to a plurality of initial oscillograms; and sending out optical cable common mode risk early warning according to the received early warning signal, and informing personnel to clear and check the early warning.

title_en: Audio signal processing method, device, intelligent television, medium and program product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an audio signal processing method, an audio signal processing device, an intelligent television, a medium and a program product, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent televisions. The method is applied to the intelligent television, and comprises the following steps: receiving a mixing system starting instruction triggered by a user when the first audio signal is played; the first audio signal is not an audio signal provided by the karaoke application server; responding to a starting instruction of the audio mixing system, and displaying a first user interface of the audio mixing system; responding to a mixing start instruction triggered by a user through a first user interface, and collecting a second audio signal of the user; mixing the first audio signal and the second audio signal to obtain a mixed audio signal; playing the mixed audio signal. Therefore, the embodiment of the application can improve the flexibility of K songs through the intelligent television.

title_en: Spectrum resource sharing method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a spectrum resource sharing method, device, equipment and medium, and relates to the technical field of wireless communication. The method comprises the following steps: the base station acquires channel state information of P first terminals and channel state information of Q second terminals, wherein the first terminals are cellular user terminals, and the second terminals are D2D user terminals; calculating the target power of the first terminal and the target power of the second terminal in each of the M terminal groups according to the channel state information of the P first terminals and the channel state information of the Q second terminals; after the first terminal and the second terminal are paired, the rate of the first terminal is increased compared with the rate of the original first terminal; determining a target terminal group in M terminal groups according to the increasing rate of the first terminal in each terminal group; and based on the information of the target terminal group, issuing an allocation instruction to a second terminal in the target terminal group so that the second terminal in the target terminal group accesses the spectrum resource used by the first terminal in the target terminal group.

title_en: TBOX software parameter upgrading method and device, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a TBOX software parameter upgrading method, a TBOX software parameter upgrading device, electronic equipment and a TBOX software parameter upgrading medium, wherein the TBOX software parameter upgrading method comprises the following steps: acquiring a parameter upgrading instruction and a new parameter, wherein the new parameter is a parameter of a software parameter for upgrading TBOX software; and comparing the new parameter with the current software parameter of the TBOX software according to the parameter upgrading instruction, judging whether the current software parameter is changed relative to the new parameter, and if so, modifying the current software parameter according to the new parameter to realize the upgrading of the current software parameter. By the method, the new parameters and the current software parameters are compared, and the independent updating of the software parameters of the TBOX software is completed, so that the updating and the expandability of the TBOX software are greatly enhanced.

title_en: QKD system and method for improving QKD code rate
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of quantum key distribution, and discloses a QKD system and a method for improving QKD (quantum key distribution) code rate, wherein a transmitting end of the system is used for measuring synchronous light after splitting to obtain a first optical power measured value, transmitting the first optical power measured value to a receiving end through a classical channel and synchronizing a quantum optical serial number with the receiving end through a quantum channel; the receiving end obtains a second optical power measured value through measurement after the received synchronous light is split through a classical channel, calculates the difference value of the second optical power measured value and the second optical power measured value, obtains the single photon level which enters the single photon detector currently based on the difference value and the nominal single photon level, obtains the dead time parameter according to the corresponding relation between the single photon level and the dead time parameter, and closes a gate signal within the range of which the time length is the dead time parameter after each response photon detection. The invention can automatically and accurately adjust the dead time parameter of the single photon detector at the QKD receiving end in real time, so that the QKD system can adapt to the change of the channel attenuation and always maintain high code rate performance.

title_en: Device binding method and device, electronic device and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a device binding method, a device, electronic equipment and a computer storage medium; in the embodiment of the application, according to a binding request of the to-be-bound internet of things device, generating a candidate device identifier of the to-be-bound internet of things device; storing the candidate device identifiers into a device binding list corresponding to the user identifiers; if the repeated equipment identifier exists in the equipment binding list, screening out a first sub-binding list and a second sub-binding list from the equipment binding list; taking out the device identifier from the first sub-binding list to obtain a target device identifier; and adjusting the target device identifier according to the second sub-binding list to obtain an adjusted device identifier, storing the adjusted device identifier into the second sub-binding list, and storing the second sub-binding list as a device binding list. The embodiment of the application can enable the same equipment identifier to not exist under the same user, and improve the accuracy of equipment control.

title_en: Video clipping processing method and device, computing equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a video clipping processing method and a device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an experimental video to be cut, setting an initialization continuous frame reading frame number and a frame skipping frame number, and reading a top view frame in the experimental process according to the continuous frame reading frame number and the frame skipping frame number; detecting all experimental equipment identification frames and experimental operation area frames in the read overlook frame image through a target detection model; judging whether the read overlook frame image has experimental operation or not based on the position relation between the experimental operation area frame and the experimental equipment identification frame; increasing the frame skip number or reducing the frame skip number after frame returning according to whether the read overlooking frame image has experimental operation or not until a target cutting point is detected; archiving the target clipping points, clipping the experimental video based on the target clipping points. The scheme can improve the frame reading efficiency and the video clipping accuracy.

title_en: Data storage method, device and medium based on out-of-order rearrangement
abstract_en: The invention provides a data storage method, a device and a medium based on disordered rearrangement, wherein a cache pool arranged in an FPGA is divided into a plurality of block structures, and then each IP fragment is stored in a corresponding block structure through the offset of each disordered IP fragment to be rearranged and the occupation condition of each block structure; therefore, the invention finishes the data storage work of disordered rearrangement by a hardware realization mode, simultaneously releases the occupancy rate of the CPU and the kernel protocol stack, improves the processing capacity of complex messages and is beneficial to the increase of throughput.

title_en: Communication method and device between virtual digital control systems
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a communication method and a device between virtual digital control systems, which are applied to a point table configuration communication program. The method includes the steps of generating a first interface point table according to a first forward attribute of a first virtual digital control system, generating a second interface point table according to a second forward attribute of a second virtual digital control system, constructing a corresponding relation point table based on the first interface point table and the second interface point table, and realizing communication among the virtual digital control systems through the corresponding relation point table. Therefore, by utilizing the scheme provided by the embodiment of the application, the input/output interfaces between the virtual digital control systems can be decoupled through the corresponding relation point table generated in the point table configuration communication program, the independence is improved, the configuration efficiency and the friendliness of the input/output interfaces are further improved, the conversion of analog input and output of different virtual digital control systems is realized through the point table configuration communication program, and the development workload of the virtual digital control systems can be reduced.

title_en: Optical cable resource operation and maintenance management method, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an optical cable resource operation and maintenance management method, equipment and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of optical cable management, wherein the optical cable resource operation and maintenance management method comprises the following steps: acquiring physical parameters and environmental parameters of an optical cable; wherein, the physical parameters comprise optical cable pressure, optical cable vibration and tensile stress, and the environmental parameters comprise environmental temperature and environmental humidity; predicting according to the parameters to obtain corresponding changes in a preset future time period; thereby determining a risk level for the fiber optic cable; when the risk level is low, repeating the process; when the risk level is high, obtaining the fault position and the fault type of the optical cable according to the pressure change, the vibration frequency change and the stretch bending stress change of the optical cable corresponding to the risk level; thereby judging the damage degree of the optical cable; sequencing each optical cable according to the corresponding damage degree, and managing according to a sequencing result and a preset maintenance rule; thereby improving the detection efficiency of the optical cable faults.

title_en: Planning and scheduling method, system, equipment and medium of unmanned aerial vehicle MEC network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of edge calculation and discloses a planning and scheduling method, a system, equipment and a medium of an unmanned aerial vehicle MEC network, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a network transmission model of an edge calculation network according to the total flight time delay and the total energy consumption of an unmanned aerial vehicle; and constructing a planning function by taking the maximization of the model task utility as a target, and adopting a deep reinforcement learning algorithm to make a decision on the planning function to obtain an optimal user unloading strategy and an optimal unmanned plane motion path. According to the invention, the access path of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the task unloading strategy of the user are jointly optimized, so that the maximization of network performance can be realized under the constraint of meeting the capacity and the flight duration of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the problems of complex task allocation and path planning are effectively solved, and the problem solving efficiency is improved, so that the network operation efficiency and the network resource utilization rate are further improved.

title_en: Switching method for switching terminal from macro base station to micro base station
abstract_en: The invention provides a switching method for switching a terminal from a macro base station to a micro base station, and relates to the technical field of wireless communication. The method comprises the following steps: transmitting a radio signal of a handover resource reserved for the virtual cell; and under the condition that a wireless connection request sent by the terminal is received, establishing the wireless connection between the switching resource and the terminal. The scheme of the invention solves the problem that the terminal is not smoothly switched into the micro base station from the macro base station.

title_en: Block chain transaction uplink method, related device and medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a blockchain transaction chaining method, related apparatus and medium. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a collection node uplink request; the method comprises the steps of incorporating first initial resources in a first resource pool associated with a first node and second initial resources in a second resource pool associated with a second node into an aggregation dedicated storage space; executing a plurality of transactions by using a first initial resource and a second initial resource in the aggregated dedicated memory space, the first initial resource becoming a first result resource after executing the plurality of transactions, the second initial resource becoming a second result resource after executing the plurality of transactions; and generating an aggregated transaction based on the first initial resource, the second initial resource, the first result resource and the second result resource, and recording the aggregated transaction to the blockchain. The method and the device can reduce the transaction uplink cost when a large number of transactions to be uplink are frequently generated between two nodes. The present disclosure is applicable to various scenarios of blockchain, artificial intelligence, cloud technology, and the like.

title_en: Identity verification method and system based on eToken and 2FA verification
abstract_en: The invention discloses an identity verification method and system based on eToken and 2FA verification, and belongs to the technical field of identity verification. The method of the invention comprises the following steps: installing an eToken plug-in on a client of a target system; acquiring hardware information of eToken hardware through the eToken plugin at a server side of a target system, and binding a user account for a user to log in the target system, a webpage of the target system and a program of the target system with the hardware information of eToken hardware acquired by the eToken plugin; and verifying the user account number and the password input by the user to the target system, the webpage and the program once, if the user account number and the password pass the once verification, 2FA verification is performed on the user account number based on the eToken hardware, and after the 2FA verification passes, the user is allowed to log in the target system. The invention can carry out secondary identity verification on the user account of the login target system, the webpage and the program based on 2FA verification, thereby ensuring the security of the system and the like.

title_en: Method for testing network bandwidth of physical server
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for testing network bandwidth of a physical server, and belongs to the field of computer networks. When testing the network bandwidth of the physical server, the data tested by using the single-process iperf3 is often limited by cpu, and there is no way to fill the whole bandwidth. When using multiprocessing iperf3, the bandwidth of the test is often low, and the udp loses a lot of packets for various reasons. The method introduces a method for testing bandwidth by using the iperf3, and transfers the packet to the cpu where the numa is located through the RSS and Flow directors of the network card, and simultaneously avoids the processing of the packet/pierf 3 by the cpu which is processed by a cpu hyper-thread, effectively reduces the packet loss rate, improves the processing capacity of the pierf 3, obtains more accurate TCP bandwidth and UDP bandwidth, and reflects more real network performance.

title_en: Backscatter internet of things system, communication method, communication device, network equipment and medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a backscatter internet of things system, a communication method, a device, network equipment and a medium, and relates to the technical field of internet of things. Wherein, backscatter internet of things system includes: the main transmitter is used for transmitting downlink signals; a plurality of backscatter devices for quadrature modulating the received downstream signal to generate a plurality of backscatter signals, and transmitting the plurality of backscatter signals in parallel; a receiver for receiving a baseband signal based on a primary link channel and a plurality of backscatter received signals based on a plurality of secondary link channels, the receiver further configured to: eliminating interference of a main link channel based on channel estimation operation; and recovering the baseband signal and the plurality of backscatter received signals based on the coordinated parallel detection operation of the baseband signal and the plurality of backscatter received signals. Through the technical scheme, the deployment of a plurality of back scattering devices in the Internet of things system is facilitated.

title_en: Configuration authorization CG determining method, device, UE, network equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a configuration authorization CG determining method, a device, UE, network side equipment and a medium, which belong to the technical field of communication, and the uplink transmission permission determining method of the embodiment of the application comprises the following steps: the User Equipment (UE) acquires the data quantity to be transmitted of the CG cluster; and the UE determines at least one of the CG which is needed to be used and the CG which is not used based on the data quantity to be transmitted and the uplink transmission capacity provided by each CG in the CG cluster.

title_en: Terminal intelligent control system for competition of Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication, in particular to a terminal intelligent control system for competition of the Internet of things. Comprising the following steps: the terminal control module is used for adjusting the refreshing frequency of the terminal picture according to the state recovery time of the terminal or sending out a data integrity monitoring signal; the data integrity monitoring unit is used for outputting a first corresponding compression rate when responding to the data integrity monitoring signal; the terminal picture monitoring unit is used for reconfiguring the first corresponding compression rate according to the contrast of the terminal picture so as to output a second corresponding compression rate or send out a terminal cruising degree monitoring signal; and the critical electric quantity control module is used for calculating a terminal cruising degree evaluation parameter according to the terminal cruising degree monitoring signal, and re-determining the critical electric quantity of the power saving mode according to the terminal cruising degree evaluation parameter. The invention realizes the improvement of the control efficiency and the control accuracy of the control system.

title_en: Modulation degree determining method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a modulation degree determining method and device, wherein the modulation degree determining method comprises the following steps: acquiring an input signal, performing a preset number of modulation operations based on the input signal and a preset modulation degree, and determining a preset number of modulation operation results; performing preset operation on the preset number of modulation operation results to obtain the preset number of target operation results; determining an initial set value based on target operation results of a preset number, and determining a target set value from initial set values corresponding to at least two preset modulation degrees; the target modulation degree is determined from the at least two modulation degrees based on the target setting value determination. In the modulation degree searching process, the local waveform corresponding to each modulation degree is calculated for each modulation degree, then the operation value corresponding to each modulation degree is obtained, and then the maximum value in the operation values is searched, wherein the modulation degree corresponding to the maximum value is the estimation result of the modulation degree, so that the estimation precision of the modulation degree is improved.

title_en: Method for performing data transmission
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for performing data transmission between a control device (100) and an electronic unit, wherein a control unit (103) and a FlexRay transceiver are provided in the control device (100) and the control unit (103) and the FlexRay transceiver are likewise provided in the electronic unit, and wherein for the data transmission a FlexRay connection is used as a physical link and a UART protocol is used for the data transmission.

title_en: Network-initiated zero-energy paging method and device
abstract_en: A wireless transmit/receive unit (WTRU) may include one or more antennas and a first transceiver operatively coupled to the antennas. The one or more antennas and the first transceiver may be configured to receive a first signal from a network using zero energy from the WTRU. The one or more antennas and the first transceiver may be further configured to extract energy from the first signal. The first transceiver may be further configured to examine an interval between energy threshold events to decode an energy characteristic of the first signal. The first transceiver may be further configured to activate a second transceiver operably coupled to the one or more antennas if the decoded energy characteristic matches the stored energy characteristic, wherein the second transceiver is powered by the WTRU. The one or more antennas and the second transceiver may be configured to receive a second signal from the network.

title_en: Communication device, base station, and communication method
abstract_en: The UE (100) communicates wirelessly with a base station (200), and the base station (200) manages a cell (250) that includes N (N.gtoreq.2) TRPs (201#0, 201#1). The UE (100) comprises: a communication unit (110) that receives a Radio Resource Control (RRC) message from the base station (200), wherein the Radio Resource Control (RRC) message includes information for configuring N beam failure detection resource sets (521#0, 521#1); and a control unit (120) that detects beam failure individually for each of the N beam failure detection resource sets (521#0, 521#1). When beam failure is detected with respect to all of the N beam failure detection resource sets (521#0, 521#1), the control unit (120) determines whether or not to start a random access procedure to the cell (250) based on a state recovered from the beam failure.

title_en: Outdoor inspection method and equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an outdoor inspection method and equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a current position through an intelligent inspection terminal, and determining the position of a next inspection point to be detected currently based on the determined shortest inspection route; guiding a user to go to the next inspection point based on the current position and the position of the next inspection point and a navigation route with shortest time or shortest path generated by the terrain environment; correlating the ground inspection data acquired by the intelligent inspection terminal with the identification of the current inspection point to generate inspection data; uploading inspection data to a cloud server through an intelligent inspection terminal; if the intelligent patrol terminal detects that the self electric quantity is lower than a preset threshold value and/or the current weather environment accords with a preset abnormal condition, preset early warning information is sent to the cloud server; and if the gesture data detected by the intelligent patrol terminal accords with the preset dangerous condition of the user, executing a preset recourse flow. The application realizes intelligent inspection.

title_en: Resource allocation method and device, base station, communication system and storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a resource allocation method and apparatus, a base station, a communication system, and a storage medium. The resource allocation method comprises the steps of carrying out resource allocation on each of a plurality of CSI-RS resources to obtain a resource allocation result, wherein at least one of the total number of ports of each CSI-RS resource and the total number of power control offset values is larger than 1, carrying out CSI reporting allocation on the plurality of CSI-RS resources according to the resource allocation result to obtain a CSI reporting allocation result, and sending the CSI reporting allocation result to a user terminal.

title_en: Can realize many people many thing networking access control system that open
abstract_en: The invention discloses an access control system capable of realizing multi-person multi-opening Internet of things, which comprises an access control execution unit, wherein an identification module is arranged on the access control execution unit and is connected with a host control module through an information transmission module, the identification module transmits collected user data to the host control module, the host control module is connected with a data storage module, the data storage module is connected with a data collection module, the host control module is connected with a user side module, and the user side module is provided with a management sub-module. The system realizes the intellectualization of the unit door lock access control, monitors the coordination of the door lock access control, and can rapidly carry out releasing when the door lock has a problem; the method can be used for inputting information materials of the main user, managing and uploading data of related personnel through the main user, and can reduce the autonomous acquisition quantity of information required by the system, simultaneously realize the function of opening the access control by multiple persons at the same time, realize the management of the subsequent users by the user, and facilitate tracing when problems occur in the later period.

title_en: Control method of application program, application server and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method of an application program, an application server and a storage medium. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: outputting operation prompt information of the intelligent electric appliance through an application program so as to prompt a target user to execute target operation on the intelligent electric appliance; acquiring current state information of the intelligent electrical appliance; when the state information is target state information, issuing rewards to an account of the target user; the target state information characterizes a target state when the intelligent electrical appliance reaches the target operation completion. The invention aims to improve the popularity of intelligent electrical appliances.

title_en: Method and system for collecting multi-channel video data by MVPS (mechanical vapor compression system) series video processing system
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for acquiring multi-channel video data by an MVPS (mechanical vapor compression system) series video processing system, and belongs to the technical field of video processing. The method comprises the following steps: initializing VI equipment; detecting whether the register receives at least one path of video data after the register is configured with the driving parameters of the data acquisition drive, and if so, acquiring resolution system information of the received at least one path of video data; initializing a VI channel of the VI device according to the resolution system information of the at least one path of video data, collecting multi-frame images in the at least one path of video data based on the VI channel, performing data processing on the multi-frame images to generate target video data, and collecting the target video data. The video data acquisition method and the video data acquisition device can acquire multiple paths of video data at the same time, occupy fewer CPU resources when the video data are acquired, and solve the problem that higher CPU resources are occupied when the video data are acquired in multiple paths.

title_en: Communication method and device
abstract_en: A communication method and apparatus. The method comprises the following steps: the terminal equipment determines the time taken to measure each of the Q PRS frequency layers with pattern 2; and the terminal equipment determines a second measurement time according to the maximum value of the time used by each PRS frequency layer in the Q PRS frequency layers, wherein Q is a positive integer. By the method, the terminal equipment can determine the second measurement time according to the maximum value of the time used by each PRS frequency layer in the Q PRS frequency layers, so that the total measurement time of the terminal equipment for measuring the Q PRS frequency layers by adopting the mode 2 can be reduced.

title_en: Relay service method, relay node, network device, and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a relay service method, a relay node, a network side, network equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of communication. The relay service method disclosed by the disclosure comprises the following steps: the relay node distributes a first communication address for the accessed remote node according to a remote node address pool issued by the network side equipment; and sending remote node report information to the network side equipment, wherein the remote node report information comprises the identification of the remote node and the first communication address. By the method, the burden of the remote node is reduced, and the efficiency of relay communication is improved; the problem of collision between the relay node port and the remote node port is avoided, and the reliability of communication is improved.

title_en: Processing method, device, equipment and medium based on collection payment service
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a processing method, a device, equipment and a medium based on a collection payment service, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a collection payment service queue; the collection service queue comprises a plurality of collection numbers to be collected, and each collection number to be collected is provided with collection data to be collected and historical collection data to be collected; according to the payment data to be supported and the historical payment data to be supported, determining the support condition of each payment number to be supported, and determining that the support condition is a supported payment number or a target payment number which is supported and processed from a plurality of payment numbers to be supported; and transferring the target payment number to be supported from the payment service queue to an early warning auditing list so as to perform early warning auditing treatment on the target payment number to be supported. By the embodiment of the invention, the dynamic identification and early warning auditing treatment on the situation of repeated collection possibly occurring are realized, the occurrence of the repeated collection situation is reduced, and the use experience of a communication user is improved.

title_en: Distributed system based on virtual network and communication method
abstract_en: The utility model provides a distributed system and communication method based on virtual network, the distributed system based on virtual network includes a plurality of nodes and the virtual network that is connected with each node, and each node includes virtual equipment and network card, and each node in the distributed system communicates through virtual network, keeps the IP allocation of virtual network after the equipment of distributed system moves or removes, only need the connection passageway of reestablishing virtual network can to the fortune dimension efficiency of distributed system has been improved.

title_en: Intelligent detection method for streaming of end-side monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent detection, in particular to an intelligent detection method for streaming of end-side monitoring equipment, which comprises the following steps: s1: the video convergence platform carries out grouping management according to different position areas of the video convergence platform by the end side monitoring equipment; s2: the video convergence platform performs picture processing according to the real-time monitoring picture obtained by frame extraction of the end side monitoring equipment to obtain a processed picture, and judges whether the processed picture is streamed or not; s3: and after the video convergence platform detects that the end-side monitoring equipment is offline, deleting the characteristic value stored by the end-side monitoring equipment and ending the detection. The automatic detection of the streaming can realize automatic, real-time and intelligent streaming detection and processing, avoid the tedious and uncertain manual discovery and intervention, effectively protect the privacy and information safety of users and avoid unnecessary trouble and loss caused by streaming. The use experience of the user is improved, and the definition and stability of the video picture are ensured.

title_en: Transmission parameter determining method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a transmission parameter determining method and device, relates to the technical field of communication, and is used for selecting proper transmission parameters so as to improve the effectiveness and reliability of a communication system. The method comprises the following steps: receiving control information; according to the received control information, determining the association relation between M transmission control information states TCIState and N code division multiplexing CDM groups, wherein M is greater than or equal to N, and M and N are positive integers; further, transmission parameters are determined based on the association relationship between the M TCI states and the N CDM groups.

title_en: Single-node service failure service continuous providing method in distributed environment
abstract_en: The invention provides a single-node service failure service continuous providing method in a distributed environment, and belongs to the technical field of instant messaging. The instant communication client and the server end send heartbeat messages in a unicast mode, the heartbeat messages are used for judging whether the server node fails or not by the instant communication client, the instant communication client detects available servers in a multicast mode after the failure, and the available servers are selected in a time-limited arbitration mode to log in a new server and restore the previous service. The method for realizing unicast heartbeat interaction, multicast available server detection and service automatic recovery has the characteristics of automation, high efficiency and the like. The invention is easy to operate at the instant communication client side, discovers the server rapidly, is convenient for roaming registration and service recovery, and is particularly suitable for the instant communication client of server distributed deployment.

title_en: Method for realizing connection equipment of Internet of things platform based on FRP (fiber reinforced Plastic) and Internet of things system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing platform connection equipment of an internet of things based on FRP (fiber reinforce Plastic), which comprises the following steps: configuring a port pool on an Internet of things platform; sending a connection request to an Internet of things platform through a browser; when the internet of things platform receives the connection request, acquiring a port number from the port pool, and setting the port number to be in an unavailable state; the internet of things platform sends a pre-connection request to the equipment; the device modifies the configuration of the FRPC according to the pre-connection request and starts the FRPC, and the FRPC automatically allocates a device port for connection according to the FRPS; the equipment is connected with the equipment port through the port number in an SSH (secure digital interface); the internet of things platform obtains the FRPC starting result, realizes remote connection with equipment through an SSH protocol, and feeds back the connection result to the browser in real time. The invention also discloses an Internet of things system. The method has the advantages of simple configuration, high efficiency and good user experience.

title_en: One-to-many wireless communication method, device and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of communication, in particular to a one-to-many wireless communication method, a device and a system, wherein the method screens out a communication channel with high communication quality from each communication channel through the latest communication data as a working channel, determines a public channel with a frequency band interval with the working channel according to the frequency band of the working channel, enables a central end and each edge end to establish communication in the public channel, and switches to the working channel together for data transmission; the working channel screened by the method is a communication channel with high communication quality, so that the center end and the edge end have good communication effect when communicating through the working channel, stability and accuracy of data transmission are guaranteed, and furthermore, the center end cannot be interfered by data of the common channel when communicating with the edge end in the working channel due to the fact that the determined common channel and the working channel have a certain frequency band interval, and communication quality is further guaranteed.

title_en: KeeLoq algorithm-based automobile remote control key system
abstract_en: Automobile remote control key system based on KeeLoq algorithm belongs to automobile remote control technical field. The invention aims to solve the problems of poor remote control stability and safety of the existing automobile remote control key in a complex environment. The invention comprises a remote control unit and a receiving unit; the remote control unit is used for encrypting key information of a remote controller keyboard by adopting a KeeLoq algorithm and then sending the key information in a wireless mode; the receiving unit is used for receiving the wireless signals sent by the connected remote control unit, decrypting the received wireless signals by adopting a KeeLoq algorithm and obtaining control information; the remote control unit is connected with the receiving unit in a wireless mode. The remote control key is mainly used for automobile remote control keys.

title_en: Precoding configuration and indication for simultaneous PUSCH to multiple TRPs
abstract_en: Precoding configuration and indication for simultaneous PUSCH to multiple TRPs. The UE receives a configuration of a first set of SRS resources and a second set of SRS resources for non-codebook based transmission. The UE receives DCI including a first SRI field and a second SRI field. The first SRI field indicates SRS resources of the first indicated SRS resource set. The second SRI field indicates SRS resources of the second indicated SRS resource set. The size of the first SRI field is based on the first maximum number of layers, the second maximum number of layers, the third maximum number of layers, the first number of SRS resources in the first indicated SRS resource set, and the second number of SRS resources in the second indicated SRS resource set. The size of the second SRI field is based on the third maximum number of layers and a second number of SRS resources in the second indicated set of SRS resources.

title_en: Voice service processing method and device and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a voice service processing method, a device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first special bearer establishment request initiated by a user terminal aiming at voice service; detecting whether the strategy control functional entity has full fault or not according to the first special bearing establishment request; if the policy control functional entity has a full fault, a first special bearing establishment request is sent to the disaster recovery policy and charging rule functional entity, so that the disaster recovery policy and charging rule functional entity requests the session management functional entity to establish a special bearing of the voice service according to the first special bearing establishment request and session information corresponding to a default bearing associated with the user terminal, and the voice service is realized through the special bearing. According to the technical scheme, when the policy control functional entity has full faults, the special bearing of the voice service can be established through the disaster recovery policy and charging rule functional entity, and the voice service is realized.

title_en: Video file management method and device, LED screen playing system and medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a video file management method, a video file management device, an LED screen playing system and a medium. The video file management method comprises the following steps: starting and mounting a preset file system by a main control chip; setting a serial communication interface of a main control chip as a storage interface of a storage chip; responding to a communication request of the upper computer, and establishing communication connection between the main control chip and the upper computer; and the main control chip receives the video file sent by the upper computer and stores the video file into a preset video file catalog in the storage chip. The video file management method achieves the effect of simpler program update and play setting.

title_en: Communication method, communication device and communication system
abstract_en: The application provides a communication method, a communication device and a communication system. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving first indication information from the network device, the first indication information being used to indicate whether the packet data convergence protocol (packet data convergence protocol, PDCP) discards the data unit; if the first indication indicates PDCP discard data unit, discarding PDCP data unit and re-establishing radio link control (radio link control, RLC). By the technical scheme provided by the application, the performance of the terminal equipment in cell switching can be improved.

title_en: FTTR equipment fault repairing method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a fault repairing method and device for FTTR equipment. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining sensing data of the fiber to the home (FTTR) equipment, wherein the level of the sensing data at least comprises one of the following steps: the network management cloud level, the equipment level and the service module level; and performing fault repair according to the level to which the perception data belong by using a fault diagnosis repair strategy corresponding to the level. By the embodiment of the invention, the problems of long time consumption and low efficiency of the fault restoration of the access network in the related technology can be solved, and the effects of improving the fault restoration efficiency and the user experience are achieved.

title_en: Measurement processing method, device, terminal and network side equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a measurement processing method, a device, a terminal and network side equipment, which belong to the technical field of communication, and the measurement processing method of the embodiment of the application comprises the following steps: the remote terminal judges whether the measurement event is satisfied according to the measurement result of the side link SL or the configuration information of SL measurement; wherein the measurement event is a measurement event related to path switching.

title_en: Data transmission scheme in wireless communication
abstract_en: There is provided a method of wireless communication, the method comprising: data transmission with a second node in an Integrated Access and Backhaul (IAB) network is performed by a first node of the IAB.

title_en: Automatic switch patch installation method based on micro-service
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for automatically installing a switch patch based on micro-service, which comprises the following steps: s1: developing and verifying a new patch, building a file storage server and a network data storage database, and developing micro-service software; s2: releasing the new patch, and storing the new patch in a file storage server when releasing the new patch; s3: registering the released new patch information into a network data storage database; s4: deploying micro-service software into a network server; s5: the switch passively waits for notification by the microservice software to act. The invention can realize unmanned intelligent automatic installation of the switch patch, release manpower, reduce error rate, greatly promote the maintenance efficiency of the switch, accelerate the recovery speed of network faults, manually patch hundreds of switches at most a day, and realize the patch installation of tens of thousands of switches in a day after realizing automatic installation.

title_en: Connection method, device, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a connection method, a connection device, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: in the case that the first electronic device monitors at least one connectable second electronic device, determining first operation information of the first electronic device, and determining at least one connection policy based on historical connection information between the first electronic device and the at least one second electronic device, each connection policy including one second electronic device to which the first electronic device suggests a connection under one operation information, the operation information including at least one of: time period, location and running service; from the at least one connection policy, a first connection policy corresponding to the first operational information is determined.

title_en: Voice quality analysis technology and analysis method based on communication equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a voice quality analysis technology and an analysis method based on communication equipment, which relate to the technical field of digital communication data analysis and comprise communication equipment, a voice feature extraction module, a network adaptability module and an evaluation fusion module, wherein the voice feature extraction module, the network adaptability module and the evaluation fusion module are integrated in the communication equipment, and the voice feature extraction module utilizes a deep learning technology to build a model to learn and capture voice features from original voice signals; the sound feature extraction module includes: a spectral feature extraction unit and a timing information capturing unit. The invention realizes the function of extracting the time sequence spectrum characteristic information of the audio signal by designing the sound characteristic extraction module, solves the problem that the spectrum and time sequence characteristics of the voice signal cannot be understood and abstracted, enhances the abstract expression of the voice signal, and enables the system to be more suitable for voice input of different types and quality, thereby improving the capability of overall voice quality analysis.
