title_en: Information transmission method and device
abstract_en: The application provides an information transmission method and device, relates to the technical field of communication, and is used for solving the problem that electric quantity is wasted caused by the fact that communication equipment blindly monitors downlink control information at all monitoring occasions. The method comprises the following steps: the communication device determines information of the target beam; determining a target monitoring opportunity according to information of the target beam and a mapping relation between the beam and the monitoring opportunity, wherein the target monitoring opportunity is positioned in a system information window, and the system information window is used for OSI; and monitoring downlink control information at the target monitoring opportunity. The method and the device are suitable for the process of information transmission between the network equipment and the communication equipment.

title_en: Message data extraction method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, a computer device and a storage medium for extracting message data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving original data; determining GTC frame data based on the original data; counting the GTC frame data, and determining target PLOAM message data and GEM frame data based on the count value; and processing the GEM frame data to obtain target OMCI message data. According to the method and the device, the count value obtained through counting is compared with the address, and the target PLOAM message data and the target OMCI message data can be obtained rapidly, so that the required buffer memory space and the processing data quantity are reduced, the hardware circuit resources and the CPU processing process space are saved, and the message data extraction efficiency is improved.

title_en: Grain purchase and sale supervision data reporting method, system, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grain purchase and sale supervision data reporting method, a system, a storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: preprocessing grain purchase and sale supervision data to be reported in a database based on a preset interface standard; checking the pre-processed grain purchase and sale supervision data according to a preset checking rule; performing supplementary recording on grain purchase and sale supervision data which do not pass the verification according to a preset supplementary recording modification rule until the verification is passed; executing the next operation on the grain purchase and sale supervision data passing the verification; encrypting the grain purchase and sale supervision data passing the verification according to a preset encryption rule; and compressing the encrypted grain purchase and sale supervision data according to a preset compression rule, and uploading the compressed grain purchase and sale supervision data to an upper supervision platform through a pre-built safety channel.

title_en: Multi-network hybrid acceleration method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of network acceleration, in particular to a multi-network hybrid acceleration method and system. The application of the random linear network coding ensures that the data packet has stronger adaptability in various network environments, effectively reduces errors and delays in the data transmission process, optimizes the utilization of a data transmission path and wavelength resources by combining the K shortest path algorithms of Yen and the dynamic wavelength and bandwidth allocation algorithm, improves the transmission efficiency of the whole network, and can automatically adjust network flow and routing strategies while monitoring the network state in real time by applying a network flow analysis model and a reinforcement learning algorithm, thereby enhancing the self-adaptive capacity and management efficiency of the network.

title_en: Display apparatus and control method of display apparatus
abstract_en: The application provides a display device and a control method of the display device, mainly relating to the technical field of display processing.A shell of the display device is provided with an incremental coding rotator and a processor, and a software system architecture of the processor comprises a kernel layer and an application layer; wherein the incremental encoding rotator is configured to: receiving an input signal input by a user; an application layer configured to: determining a scene identifier corresponding to a current display picture of the display equipment, and sending the scene identifier to a kernel layer; a kernel layer configured to: determining a control signal based on the scene identification and the input signal; reporting a control signal to an application layer; an application layer configured to: the display device is controlled based on the control signal. The incremental rotary encoder is used as an interactive input device to control the display device in different scenes such as volume adjustment, menu interaction, artistic drawing and the like.

title_en: Conditional switching method, communication node and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a condition switching method, a communication node and a storage medium. Under the condition that the condition switching of the second communication node is determined, acquiring configuration information of a candidate cell; sending a first message to the second communication node, wherein the first message comprises configuration information of the candidate cells and execution conditions of conditional switching, and the first message is used for indicating the second communication node to select the candidate cells meeting the execution conditions in the candidate cells as target cells and switch to the target cells according to the configuration information; wherein, in the case that the target cell is a non-terrestrial network cell, the execution condition includes a reference signal condition and an execution state condition.

title_en: Software installation method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a software installation method, a device, equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: in the production stage of the diagnosis equipment, installing download software in the diagnosis equipment, and establishing communication connection between the download software and a server; the server stores diagnosis software and product configuration; under the condition that the diagnosis equipment is legal equipment, acquiring a configuration identifier of the diagnosis equipment by using downloaded software; sending a configuration identifier to a server to obtain configuration information fed back by the server after inquiring the product configuration based on the configuration identifier; downloading a plurality of diagnostic software corresponding to the configuration information from a server; after installing a plurality of diagnosis software, unloading the downloaded software in the diagnosis equipment. The application can complete the software one-key installation work by means of the Internet, has flexible mode, higher efficiency, is not easy to make mistakes, does not need to be connected with a USB port of a product by wire, saves the manual operation of maintenance and management and presetting vehicle type diagnosis software, and can save time and external cooperation cost.

title_en: Method for guiding battery replacement equipment and server
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method of booting a battery replacement apparatus and a server. The method for guiding the battery station (20) (battery replacement equipment) comprises the following steps: information (condition information) concerning a condition to be valued by a user of the electric vehicle (10) among a plurality of conditions concerning a plurality of battery stations (20) for replacing a battery (11) (secondary battery) mounted on the electric vehicle (10) is acquired. The method for guiding the battery station (20) comprises the following steps: by evaluating each of the plurality of battery stations (20) using the information, at least 1 battery station (20) of the plurality of battery stations (20) recommended to the user is determined. The method for guiding the battery station (20) comprises the following steps: the user is notified of the information of the at least 1 battery station (20).

title_en: Data transmission system and method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The application discloses a data transmission system and a data transmission method based on the Internet of things, which belong to the technical field of data transmission of equipment of the Internet of things and comprise the following steps: the receiving end of the server receives first collected data distributed in the temporary storage space; establishing a plurality of groups of transmission channels, and determining a communication mode between the transmission channels and the temporary storage space in the first acquired data transmission process; feeding back the communication mode determined in the first acquired data transmission process to a transmission end in a binary signal mode; and judging the switching frequency in the data transmission process according to the stored binary signal, and selecting the verification mode of the receiving end according to the switching frequency. In the implementation process of the technical scheme of the application, the effect of adjusting the transmission channels according to the data is realized by establishing a plurality of groups of transmission channels and determining the communication mode of the transmission channels and the temporary storage space, the transmission efficiency of the data is improved, the communication mode in the transmission process is stored in the form of binary signals, and the verification mode of the receiving end is adjusted.

title_en: Subtitle processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of communication, and particularly discloses a subtitle processing method, device, equipment and storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: receiving target subtitle data of a live stream sent by a signaling server; the target subtitle data comprises target subtitle text, subtitle translation delay and target time stamps; the target timestamp is a timestamp for inserting target supplemental enhancement field information into the live stream; the target supplemental enhancement field information includes at least a target timestamp; determining an alignment time stamp of the target subtitle data aligned to the live stream based on the target time stamp and the subtitle translation delay; determining the current playing time of the live stream based on the historical timestamp in the historical supplementary enhancement field information in the live stream; and if the current playing time reaches the alignment time stamp, displaying the target subtitle text. Therefore, the synchronization accuracy and the high efficiency between the live caption display and the live stream play are improved, and the caption effect and the live broadcast effect of the live stream are further improved.

title_en: Method, terminal equipment, storage cabinet, service end and system for taking parts
abstract_en: The invention relates to a piece taking method, terminal equipment, a storage cabinet, a server and a system, wherein the method applied to the terminal equipment comprises the steps of obtaining positioning information of the terminal equipment, obtaining target mark frequency matched with the positioning information, generating a piece taking ultrasonic carrier signal according to a storage cabinet identification corresponding to a piece to be taken, piece taking code information and the target mark frequency, sending the piece taking ultrasonic carrier signal to the storage cabinet based on an audio module of the terminal equipment, and controlling the target storage cabinet corresponding to the storage cabinet identification to execute piece taking and door opening operation by the piece taking ultrasonic carrier signal. Under the scene that the same locker is subjected to multi-person pickup, the different lockers in the same area are subjected to multi-person synchronous pickup, the different lockers in different areas are subjected to multi-person synchronous pickup and the like, the non-contact pickup is realized, meanwhile, the mutual interference brought by short-distance synchronous pickup can be reduced, and the server side can be helped to distinguish the pickup processes of the different areas and the different lockers.

title_en: Method for transmitting channel state information report, communication device, and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a transmission method, a communication device and a storage medium for a channel state information report, which relate to the technical field of wireless communication and can improve the compression performance of channel information. The method comprises the following steps: determining a first state parameter according to a contracted mode; or determining a first state parameter according to the mode of signaling transmission; determining second channel state information and second state parameters according to the first state parameters and the first channel state information; generating a channel state information report according to the second channel state information; and sending a channel state information report.

title_en: Method for realizing tracking limitation of multi-agent system considering limited bit rate
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for realizing tracking limitation of a linear discrete multi-agent system with limited bit rate, belonging to the field of networked multi-agent cooperative control. The technical key points of the invention are as follows: establishing a mathematical model of a linear discrete multi-agent system, describing bandwidth limitation in a communication network by using bit rate, providing an improved coding and decoding strategy, and designing a distributed control protocol based on decoding information; obtaining an expression of an error system according to a control protocol; obtaining a feedback gain matrix based on the linear inequality; substituting the gain matrix into the designed distributed control protocol enables the tracking of linear multi-agent systems with limited bit rates to be bounded. The invention overcomes the influence of the limited bit rate on the system, introduces a coding and decoding strategy to control the agents in the network, reduces the hardware cost, adopts an error system to lead the error between the follower and the leader in the system to reach the expected state, thereby leading the multi-agent system to achieve the characteristics of bounded tracking, easy realization and easy solution.

title_en: Active IPv6 address detection method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of network security, in particular to a method, a device, equipment and a medium for detecting an active IPv6 address, wherein the method comprises the following steps: identifying an IPv6 address list in open source data; generating a tree structure according to the IPv6 address list, wherein leaf nodes of the tree structure are address clusters in the IPv6 address list, each node except the leaf nodes in the tree structure is provided with a plurality of sub-nodes, and the sub-nodes are values of characters in the IPv6 address; traversing the root node to the leaf node of the tree structure in turn based on the generation direction of the conditional probability to detect a new active IPv6 address in the IPv6 address list. Therefore, the problems of fewer active IPv6 addresses obtained by detection in the related technology, larger memory consumption in the generation process, lower efficiency and the like are solved.

title_en: Communication method, device, related equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a communication method, a communication device, related equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that a first network function obtains computing power resource information of communication equipment, wherein the communication equipment at least comprises core network equipment; and analyzing the computing power resource information, and determining a target routing strategy for at least one terminal with computing power requirements, wherein the target routing strategy at least comprises path information related to core network equipment.

title_en: Data scheduling method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a data scheduling method, a data scheduling device and a storage medium, relates to the technical field of communication, and is used for scheduling transmission of a plurality of data streams of a plurality of users. The data scheduling method comprises the following steps: generating scheduling information, wherein the scheduling information is used for scheduling transmission of a plurality of data streams, and the plurality of data streams comprise data streams of a plurality of users; and sending the scheduling information.

title_en: Method and device used for positioning
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device used for positioning. The first node receives a first information block, the first information block being used to determine a first resource pool; transmitting first signaling, wherein the first signaling is used for determining a first time domain resource block from the first resource pool; transmitting a first positioning reference signal on a first reference signal resource; the first reference signal resource belongs to the first time domain resource block in the time domain; the configuration of the first reference signal resource is related to a positional relationship between the first time domain resource block and a time domain resource occupied by the first signaling in a time domain, and the configuration of the first reference signal resource includes at least one of a number of symbols of the first reference signal resource and a time domain position of the first reference signal resource in the first time domain resource block. The application enhances the resource utilization efficiency of the sidelink positioning reference signal resource pool.

title_en: Virtual local area network security risk prediction method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual local area network security risk prediction method based on artificial intelligence. The invention belongs to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a virtual local area network security risk prediction method based on artificial intelligence, which is characterized in that a weight matrix is defined based on a robust loss function, the influence of an abnormal value on a model is reduced, an output weight estimated value of the model is obtained based on matrix operation, the complexity of the model is controlled by introducing regularized parameters, the error adjustment weight is introduced, and the fitting capacity of the model to different samples is improved, so that the performance of the model is improved; based on the chaotic sequence initialization parameter position, based on definition of movement step length and movement weight, updating of search position is performed, premature convergence is prevented, based on design of movement strategy, the search is more robust, and the search performance is improved.

title_en: Intelligent management and control system for oil immersed transformer installation and management and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of transformer installation, and relates to an intelligent management and control system for oil immersed transformer installation and a management and control method thereof. In the management and control system, the upper computer is connected with intelligent on-line monitoring equipment to realize data interaction, the intelligent on-line monitoring equipment carries out wireless data interaction with the tank farm intelligent management and control system, the transformer information intelligent management and control system and the field device intelligent management and control system, the intelligent on-line monitoring equipment gathers the data information of the sensor to operate, the upper computer reads the data information to display on a screen, and meanwhile, data is written into the intelligent on-line monitoring equipment on the screen of the upper computer. In the control method, automatic oil unloading control, automatic oil filtering control, equipment internal inspection control, equipment vacuumizing tube control, automatic oil injection control and hot oil circulating tube control are realized. The invention collects the installation process, the internal data of the product and the surrounding environment data in real time to form a complete installation record of oil discharge, oil filtration, internal detection, vacuumizing, oiling and hot oil circulation.

title_en: Channel state information error compensation
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to apparatuses, methods, devices, and computer-readable storage media for CSI error compensation. The method comprises the following steps: transmitting, at a first device and based on a pilot pattern, a first signal on a composite channel, the first signal comprising a set of pilot symbols set of first and second values set to be interleaved over a set of subcarriers in a frequency domain; determining amplitude and phase mismatch parameters based on the second signal and the pilot pattern when the second signal for sensing is received on the composite channel, the second signal being generated by reflecting the first signal by at least one object on the composite channel; and performing amplitude and phase compensation on the second signal based on the amplitude and phase mismatch parameters. The I/Q imbalance compensation scheme may enable accurate sensing of CSI by using a pilot pattern with less overhead and non-linear compensation. In this way, the performance, stability and signaling pattern of the communication system may be improved.

title_en: Paging early indication monitoring in user equipment specific discontinuous reception
abstract_en: Systems, methods, apparatuses, and computer program products are provided for paging early indication monitoring in user equipment-specific discontinuous reception and cell-specific discontinuous reception. For example, the method may include determining at least one of: the overlap between the first paging frame of the user equipment-specific discontinuous reception period and the second paging frame of the cell-specific discontinuous reception period, the relative length of the user equipment-specific discontinuous reception period and the cell-specific discontinuous reception period, or whether there is an indication of the transmission of the user equipment-specific paging early indication. The method may further include deciding to monitor for a paging early indication of the paging frame based on a result of the determining.

title_en: Power equipment network safety protection system for data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power equipment network safety protection system for data analysis, which comprises a safety evaluation module, a network hardware acquisition module, a network state acquisition module, other acquisition modules, a data processing module and an information sending module, wherein the network hardware acquisition module is used for acquiring data; the safety evaluation module is used for performing safety evaluation to acquire safety evaluation information, the network hardware acquisition module is used for acquiring network hardware equipment information applied to the power equipment, the network state acquisition module is used for acquiring network state information, and the other acquisition modules are used for acquiring other information; the data processing module is used for processing the security evaluation information, the network state information, the network hardware equipment information and other information to generate first security control information, second security control information, third network control information and fourth security control information. The invention can comprehensively carry out network safety protection of the power equipment.

title_en: Computer information authentication system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a computer information authentication system, which comprises the following steps: target node identity verification, acquisition of target node environment information, transmission of a first consensus request, verification of the first consensus request, judgment of the credibility of the target node and target node authentication result. According to the invention, the plurality of nodes participate in the verification process together, so that the robustness and the anti-attack capability of the system are improved, the system is prevented from being manipulated by malicious nodes, the information authentication process between the first verification node and the third verification node is simplified, the third verification node depends on the authentication result of the second verification node on the first verification node, and repeated verification of the information of the first verification node is avoided, so that the information authentication efficiency is improved; the plurality of consensus nodes jointly determine whether the target node is trusted or not, so that the situation that an untrusted node is added into a trust network can be avoided, and the trust degree of the trust network can be improved.

title_en: Service push method, apparatus, computer device, readable storage medium, and program product
abstract_en: The application relates to a service pushing method, a device, computer equipment, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product, which are applied to the technical field of big data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring object information of a target service object and service information of X service providing objects, wherein X is a positive integer, the object information is used for representing service requirements of the target service object, and the service information is used for representing service levels of the service providing objects; according to the object information and the service information of the X service providing objects, sequencing the priorities of the X service providing objects to obtain the target priority information of the X service providing objects; and selecting a target service providing object corresponding to the target service object from the X service providing objects according to the target priority information of the X service providing objects. By adopting the method, the target service providing object obtained by selecting the target priority information can be more accurate, and the pushing accuracy of the service object is improved.

title_en: Trusted time stamping system realized by using blockchain and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a trusted time stamp system realized by using a block chain and a method thereof, relating to the technical field of time stamp systems, wherein the technical scheme is as follows: comprising the following steps: a blockchain server for ensuring computation and operation of the system; a data detection receiving module for detecting and receiving the instant data; the beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the information integrity recognition module can verify that the time stamp mark information on the recognition data packet is complete and not tampered when in safety processing, the information source recognition module can recognize that the acquired time stamp mark information is from a trusted and non-repudiated information source, the information recognition resisting module can recognize and resist recording and playback of the time stamp mark information by an active attacker, so that the credibility of high-precision time stamp mark can be ensured after the data packet is time stamped, whether the time stamp mark information is complete or not tampered can be recognized, the source of the acquired time stamp mark information can be recognized, the safety is high, and the credibility is sufficient.

title_en: Information processing method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an information processing method, an information processing device and information processing equipment, wherein the information processing method comprises the following steps: in the process that a terminal establishes a protocol data unit PDU session, determining at least one multicast group to be added by the terminal according to group information of the multicast group to which the terminal belongs; and according to the at least one multicast group, transmitting the matching forwarding rule related to the data transmission of the corresponding multicast group. The scheme can realize that the UE is added into the multicast group in the process of establishing the PDU session, and does not need to be independently added into the multicast group, thereby simplifying the scheme flow, improving the efficiency, reducing the interaction redundancy and saving the signaling, and well solving the problems of complicated flow and interaction redundancy of the information processing scheme for the UE to be added into the multicast group in the prior art.

title_en: Data transmission method and related device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a data transmission method and a related device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that a first end obtains data to be transmitted, which is currently required to be transmitted to a second end, target data in a target file is modified based on the data to be transmitted, and a current model of the first end is updated by the first end based on the target data in the current target file to obtain a first target model; transmitting an instruction to a second end, and updating the current model of the second end by the second end based on the instruction and target data in the current target file to obtain a second target model; the first end performs data transmission with the second end based on the first target model and the second target model. According to the invention, manual modification is not needed, only the target data in the target file is acquired to automatically modify the front-end model and the back-end model, and the data transmission efficiency is improved when the first end and the second end interact.

title_en: Information processing method and device and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an information processing method, an information processing device and a storage medium, which comprise the following steps: acquiring a plurality of initial alarm data when a core network fault occurs; establishing a fault topological graph according to a plurality of initial alarm data; and inputting the fault topological graph into a fault determination model to obtain fault node information and fault event types of the core network.

title_en: Video image dithering processing method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a dithering processing method, a dithering processing device, dithering processing equipment and a dithering processing medium of video images, wherein the dithering processing method comprises the following steps: determining an image frame to be processed of a video; adjusting a time domain dithering mode according to the image state of the image frame to be processed; determining a target calculation frame number corresponding to the image frame to be processed based on the time domain dithering mode; and according to the target calculated frame number, combining the pixel point position information of the image frame to be processed to perform time domain dithering to obtain a time domain dithering result corresponding to the video, thereby reducing the image dithering of a static area and improving the viewing quality of the video image.

title_en: Method and apparatus for performing data transmission based on congestion indicator in wireless communication system
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method of performing an operation for a User Equipment (UE) in a wireless communication system. Specifically, the method comprises the following steps: receiving a first data unit from an upper layer; receiving a congestion indicator from a network; and transmitting the first data unit to the network based on the first data unit being a critical data unit, wherein the first data unit is discarded based on the first data unit not being a critical data unit.

title_en: Method and device for small data transmission SDT
abstract_en: A wireless device receives a Radio Resource Control (RRC) release message from a base station, the radio resource control release message including a measurement configuration for one or more measurements by the wireless device when the wireless device is in an RRC inactive state, and a Small Data Transfer (SDT) configuration for an SDT procedure for transmission by the wireless device when the wireless device is in the RRC inactive state. When the wireless device is in the RRC inactive state based on the RRC release message, the wireless device initiates the SDT procedure based on the SDT configuration and does not perform measurements associated with the measurement configuration during the SDT procedure.

title_en: Federal learning system based on FISCO group mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a federal learning system based on a FISCO group mechanism, which comprises a supervision node group and a plurality of layers of client groups, wherein local training update is carried out on any client according to an initialized global model or a global model obtained by the last learning iteration to obtain an updated local model, the updated local model is obtained on any client group based on a practical Bayesian fault-tolerant consensus mechanism and a malicious node screening mechanism based on cosine similarity, the updated global model is obtained by aggregation based on a block chain or supervision nodes until a preset federal learning convergence condition is met, and otherwise, next round federal learning is carried out. The invention ensures the privacy of the blockchain system while maintaining the security and decentralization by dividing the client groups of different levels, and secondly, the introduction of the supervision nodes can play a role in the penetration supervision of the cross-mechanism, and can greatly improve the efficiency of model aggregation.

title_en: Delay spread and average delay quasi co-located source for positioning reference signals
abstract_en: Disclosed are techniques for receiving reference Radio Frequency (RF) signals for position estimation. In one aspect, a receiver device receives a reference RF signal from a transmission point over a wireless channel, receives an indication from a positioning entity that the reference RF signal is acting as a source of a quasi-co-located (QCL) type of positioning reference RF signal received by the receiver device from the transmission point over the wireless channel, measures an average delay, a delay spread, or both the average delay and the delay spread of the reference RF signal based on the QCL type, receives a positioning reference RF signal from the transmission point over the wireless channel, and identifies a time of arrival (ToA) of the positioning reference RF signal based on the measured average delay, the delay spread, or both the average delay and the delay spread of the reference RF signal.

title_en: Information transmission method, device, terminal, network equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an information transmission method, a device, a terminal, network side equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps when being executed by the terminal: receiving a channel state information reference signal and target indication information sent by network side equipment; carrying out downlink channel measurement on the channel state information reference signal to obtain a downlink channel matrix; compressing and quantizing the downlink channel matrix based on the target indication information to obtain compressed and quantized downlink channel bit stream information; and transmitting the compressed and quantized downlink channel bit stream information to network side equipment. The invention can effectively reduce the feedback overhead of the downlink channel information of the terminal by utilizing the indication of the network side equipment.

title_en: Signal transmission method and system for avoiding saturation of demodulation reference data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of signal processing, in particular to a signal transmission method and a system for avoiding saturation of demodulation reference data, comprising the following steps: s1: acquiring a sequence to be transmitted of a preset type; the preset type is a Low-PAPR 2 sequence based on pi/2-BPSK modulation; s2: generating a demodulation reference signal and an amplitude compensation value for a sequence to be transmitted, and then judging whether the amplitude compensation value can cause fixed-point saturation; s3: reducing the amplitude compensation value to obtain a secondary amplitude compensation value, and then adopting the secondary amplitude compensation value to compensate the sequence to be transmitted to form a first compensation signal; s4: and the first compensation signal is transmitted after baseband power adjustment, and then exits. The beneficial effects are that: when the amplitude compensation value can lead to fixed point saturation, the amplitude compensation value is reduced, and then gain compensation is carried out on the whole signal in a baseband power adjustment mode, so that the problem of fixed point data saturation is avoided under the condition that the signal meets the power requirement during transmission.

title_en: Satellite edge computing task unloading and resource allocation method based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a satellite edge computing task unloading and resource allocation method based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps: by analyzing task information in a satellite edge computing network, a satellite network node communication model and a dynamic queue backlog updating model are established by adopting a partial computing unloading strategy under a terminal-satellite-cloud three-layer computing architecture; defining the total energy consumption of the system as an objective function, describing a calculation unloading joint resource allocation problem as a mixed integer nonlinear programming problem, modeling the problem as a Markov decision process, solving a calculation unloading and resource allocation strategy which meets the task deterministic time delay requirement and has the lowest energy consumption under the resource constraint through deep reinforcement learning, and solving the network dynamic change problem by adopting an algorithm based on a depth deterministic strategy gradient. The invention effectively reduces the total energy consumption of the system on the premise of meeting the task certainty requirement, and realizes the joint optimization of the task unloading position, the unloading proportion and the resource allocation strategy.

title_en: Android system recovery method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application provides an android system recovery method, an android system recovery device, android system recovery equipment and an android system recovery medium. In the method, when the android terminal determines that both the android system and the recovery mode are damaged, the recovery resource packet sent by the terminal equipment can be received, and then the recovery resource packet is checked. And after verification is passed, installing a recovery resource package, replacing the original recovery partition file in the android terminal with a target recovery partition mirror image file, and recovering the android system. According to the android system recovery method and the android system recovery device, the android system recovery is carried out through receiving the recovery resource packet sent by the terminal equipment, and the recovery resource packet is checked, so that the safety of the android terminal is effectively improved.

title_en: Interactive information system based on industrial digitization
abstract_en: The invention discloses an interactive information system based on industrial digitization, relates to the field of industrial Internet of things, and solves the defects of lag in interactive capability, signal interference, poor safety and poor compatibility existing in the existing interactive information system based on industrial digitization; the interaction capability and response speed of the system are improved through the intelligent signal processing module and the real-time data processing algorithm based on deep learning; reducing the influence of signal interference on communication quality through a real-time data processing algorithm based on deep learning; the safety of the system is improved through a block chain model based on quantum cryptography; optimizing data transmission rate and reliability through an adaptive communication module and an adaptive modulation algorithm based on machine learning; intelligent compatibility with different devices and systems is achieved by using a cross-platform application module and a compatibility adaptation system; the invention greatly improves the data processing and information interaction capability of the industrial digital interaction information system.

title_en: Video processing method and server
abstract_en: The application discloses a video processing method and a server, and relates to the technical field of videos. In the scheme, the server can receive a first operation for the first video sent by the electronic device in the process of playing the first video by the electronic device, then the server can acquire a second video corresponding to the first operation, embed the second video in an unremitted segment of the first video to obtain an embedded third video, and finally send the embedded third video to the electronic device so that the electronic device plays the second video when the playing progress of the first video reaches the embedding position of the second video.

title_en: Power control for repeated uplink transmissions
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communications are described. A User Equipment (UE) may be scheduled to transmit uplink data to a base station using a particular transmission length provided by the base station. The UE may send multiple repetitions of uplink data to the base station using a transmission with a variable length. The UE may determine a transmit power based on the length provided by the base station and use the transmit power for transmitting the repetition, regardless of the actual length of the repetition.

title_en: Method, system and computer readable storage medium for accessing data
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device and a computer readable storage medium for accessing data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: and the data request end generates a use pass card according to the access token and the asymmetric key of the data request end, and sends the use pass card to the data source for verification. And the data source verifies the use certificate to obtain a first verification result. And if the first verification result is passed, sending the challenge ciphertext encrypted according to the asymmetric public key and the authorization strategy to the data request terminal. The data request end decrypts the challenge ciphertext according to the attribute key to obtain a challenge token, and sends the challenge token to the data source for verification to obtain a second verification result. If the second verification result is that the verification is passed, the data source establishes data connection with the data request terminal. Therefore, the attribute key of the data request end can decrypt the challenge ciphertext only by meeting the attribute authorization policy and having the corresponding asymmetric public key attribute, and the data security is improved.

title_en: Cross-blockchain transaction methods, related devices, storage media, and products
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method, related apparatus, storage medium, and article of manufacture for cross-block chain transactions. The cross-region block chain transaction processing method comprises the following steps: acquiring, by a distribution node, a cross-chain transaction request from a source blockchain network and distributing the cross-chain transaction request to a first number of repeaters; first verifying and signing, by a first number of repeaters, the cross-chain transaction request to generate a sub-signature; and after receiving the second number of sub-signatures, generating a first signature of the relay system by the signature aggregation node, and sending the cross-chain transaction request and the first signature to the target blockchain network so that the target blockchain network performs second verification on the first signature and processes the cross-chain transaction request, wherein the second number is smaller than the first number. Embodiments of the present disclosure may be applied to various scenarios of blockchains, virtual digital assets, security technologies, and the like. The embodiment of the disclosure can reduce resource consumption while realizing cross-chain security.

title_en: Trusted unloading method based on intermediary excitation in information asymmetric Internet of vehicles scene
abstract_en: The invention provides a trusted unloading method based on intermediary incentive in an information asymmetric Internet of vehicles scene. The method comprises the following steps: the RV in the information asymmetric Internet of vehicles scene generates a plurality of tasks, the RV establishes communication connection with the IV in the area, sends attribute information of the tasks to the IV, stores the attribute information in a task buffer area, and decides whether to leave the tasks in the buffer area for waiting to be scheduled or continue uploading the tasks to the RSU according to the task attribute, the queue condition in the buffer area and the condition of the RSU, and the RSU processes the tasks. And IV, dividing a single task in the buffer area into a plurality of subtasks, distributing the subtasks to a plurality of service vehicles SV for parallel processing, sending the processing result back to the IV after each SV completes the task, merging the processing results by the IV, and returning to the RV. The method can furthest balance expected benefits and entropy, can prevent the strategy from being converged to a poor local optimal value prematurely, and can realize a more efficient and reliable vehicle networking task unloading strategy.

title_en: Media data security protection method and system based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image data processing, in particular to a media data security protection method and system based on a blockchain, comprising the following steps: acquiring a plurality of video frames; presetting a scale to obtain the content similarity degree of any two video frames; clustering the video frames according to the content similarity degree to obtain a plurality of class clusters and a plurality of representative video frames, and dividing the representative video frames into a plurality of windows; obtaining watermark perceived indexes of each window in each representative video frame; obtaining a sampling image of each representative video frame after each downsampling by an image pyramid algorithm and an interpolation algorithm, and further obtaining the visual blurring degree of each window in each representative video frame; thus, the watermark insertion position of the video frame is obtained, and the safety protection of the media video is completed. The invention aims to solve the problems that when the watermark is inserted into the video by a simple watermarking method, the inserted watermark is easy to tamper and the watermark can influence the viewing experience of audiences.

title_en: Network traffic prediction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a network flow prediction method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which belong to the technical field of machine learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of inputting time sequence network flow data into a first depth forest model to obtain a first prediction result output by the first depth forest model; the method comprises the steps of inputting time sequence network flow data into a time sequence feature extraction network of a time sequence prediction model to obtain a feature map output by the time sequence feature extraction network, inputting the feature map into a second depth forest model to obtain a second prediction result output by the second depth forest model, inputting the feature map into a prediction network of the time sequence prediction model to obtain a third prediction result output by the prediction network, and inputting the first prediction result, the second prediction result and the third prediction result into a weighted average module to obtain a network flow prediction result output by the weighted average module. The invention can extract valuable characteristics from a large amount of user data and accurately predict communication flow in a changeable network environment.

title_en: Digital certificate query method and system based on industrial Internet identification
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital certificates and discloses a digital certificate inquiring method and system based on industrial Internet identification. When the method issues the digital certificate for the user entity, the identification code of the user entity is added in the information of the digital certificate, so that the unique identification code can be utilized to replace the traditional mode of carrying out the retrieval of the certificate through the digital certificate DN or the digital certificate serial number. The problem that the digital certificate number of each certificate authority is not unique can be solved, and the digital certificate data is differentiated across enterprise applications; when the digital certificate is retrieved, the identification analysis system can be utilized to quickly and efficiently inquire and analyze the data of the digital certificate, so that the data sharing of the digital certificate among enterprises, industries and areas is realized.

title_en: Distributed connectivity detection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distributed connectivity detection method, which is realized by a connectivity detection task issuing module and a plurality of connectivity detection execution task modules. The invention is realized by a dynamic subnet splitting technology, a ring scheduling technology, a ring dynamic double-buffer queue, a hierarchical detection mode of connectivity detection and a data format of structured data storage: triggering connectivity detection through a program, an interface and configuration; supporting the connectivity detection and the distributed connectivity detection of equipment in batches; the hierarchical detection mode is adopted, so that the detection efficiency can be effectively improved. The invention realizes a set of distributed connectivity detection method which is distributed, schedulable, dynamically balanced in resources, configurable in strategy, capable of storing structured data and providing a program interface through the technical means of pure software, and solves the problem of low connectivity detection efficiency and the problem of connectivity detection of a plurality of sub-networks which are limited to interview by safety equipment.

title_en: Personnel positioning correction method for elevator maintenance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of elevator maintenance, in particular to a personnel positioning correction method for elevator maintenance. According to the invention, personnel positioning is performed for a plurality of times, and personnel positioning abnormal constants are counted by judging whether the distance between the front positioning and the rear positioning exceeds a set threshold value, and authority detection and reminding are performed when the personnel positioning abnormal constants reach the set threshold value; the beneficial effects are that: the method realizes effective correction of the positioning of the maintenance personnel, avoids the situation that the normal operation of the maintenance work is influenced due to the positioning deviation or abnormality caused by the influence of factors such as a base station, GPS signals and the like, and improves the maintenance efficiency of the elevator.

title_en: Model conversion method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a model conversion method, a model conversion device and a model conversion storage medium, relates to the technical field of computers, and is used for improving the problems of lower flexibility and lower efficiency when network equipment is configured and managed through MTOSI interface models. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of original files in a first data model; the plurality of original files comprise XSD files and WSDL files; respectively carrying out grammar verification on a plurality of original files to determine respective type information of the plurality of original files; the type information of the XSD file is used for indicating the data type of the data included in the XSD file; the type information of the WSDL file is used for indicating the function type of the function corresponding to the WSDL file; converting each original file based on a conversion rule corresponding to the type information of each original file in the conversion rule set to obtain a plurality of YIN files; and constructing YANG files corresponding to the plurality of YIN files respectively to obtain a second data model.

title_en: Video processing method, live video processing method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a video processing method, a live video processing method and electronic equipment. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: intercepting at least one image frame from a current display video, wherein the current display video comprises at least one object; identifying an image frame, and determining a target object contained in the image frame and first position information of the target object in the image frame; and scaling and adjusting the current display video based on the first position information and the second position information of the current display video to obtain the target display video. The application solves the technical problem of poor effect of displaying the target object contained in the video in the related technology.

title_en: Electronic contract signing method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The present application relates to the field of computer technologies, and in particular, to a method, a system, an apparatus, and a storage medium for signing an electronic contract. The electronic contract signing method comprises the following steps: receiving a first request sent by a first signing end, wherein the first request carries first identity information; verifying the first identity information, and if the first identity information passes the verification, establishing a signed record multimedia call with the first signing end; receiving a second request sent by a second signing end, wherein the second request carries second identity information; verifying the second identity information, and if the second identity information passes the verification, adding the second signing end into the signed record multimedia call; recording subscription record multimedia calls to form subscription records, and receiving subscription information of the first signing end and the second signing end; and generating a subscription backtracking file based on subscription record multimedia call and subscription information, which is beneficial to realizing evidence preservation after electronic contract subscription.

title_en: Wireless network voice and conference scheduling method based on channel associated signaling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of network communication, in particular to a wireless network voice and conference scheduling method based on channel associated signaling, which is obtained based on channel associated signaling and ultrashort wave system (CAS for VHF, CAS4 VHF), and comprises a voice and scheduling platform of a fixed base station main station and a mobile station through a framework, so that the function of scheduling conference among multiple parties can be realized in addition to the function of point-to-point calling, and particularly the functions of full duplex voice, point-to-point dialing calling, multiparty conference scheduling among all stations of the main station, interconnection and intercommunication with a public telephone program-controlled switching network (Public SwitchedTelephone Network, PSTN) and the like are realized in a VHF wireless network. The CAS4VHF interaction flow is simple, does not occupy a data channel after the call is established, is very suitable for the narrow bandwidth channel characteristic of the VHF wireless network, and solves the defects of the existing VHF wireless network communication.

title_en: LED real-time printing time code method based on serial port communication, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a serial communication-based LED real-time code printing method, which relates to the technical field of virtual serial communication, and comprises the following steps of 1, acquiring time code data of a video source accurately marked video frame in real time; step 2, searching the port of the LED screen equipment; step 3, instruction parameters for serial port communication are drawn; and 4, the data format of serial communication is formulated. The receiving end of the invention responds to different display data according to specific analysis designation, and the time code of each frame is completely printed to the LED in real time, so that the time code information can be displayed in real time, accurately and quickly, the synchronous state of equipment and the input source time code can be more intuitively checked, the serial port communication is transmitted by asynchronous wires, the anti-interference performance of the data communication is higher, the compatibility is stronger, the baud rate of 9600bps is 9600 bits, namely, the time of each 1bit is about 0.1ms in 1/9600 second, the transmission stability is higher, and the real-time and quick requirement is met.

title_en: Content interaction method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a content interaction method, a content interaction device, content interaction equipment, a storage medium and a program product; the method comprises the following steps: displaying a content page; the content page comprises target media content published by a target object, and is provided with a comment component; responding to the triggering operation of the comment component, and displaying a comment page corresponding to the target media content; displaying live broadcast description information of the target live broadcast of the target object in the comment page and a live broadcast entrance; the live broadcast portal is used for triggering a live broadcast room entering the target object to browse the target live broadcast; the information acquisition efficiency of the object can be improved, and further the user experience is improved.

title_en: Audio cloud storage method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an audio cloud storage method and device. The method comprises the following steps: when receiving the audio to be stored, determining an audio type corresponding to the audio to be stored; analyzing and processing the audio to be stored based on the audio type and at least one preset audio content complexity calculation method, and determining the complexity of at least one audio fragment corresponding to the audio to be stored; and determining a target bit rate corresponding to the at least one audio fragment according to the complexity of the at least one audio fragment and a predetermined allocation strategy corresponding to different complexity, and compressing and storing the corresponding audio fragment according to the target bit rate. By the technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention, the effective compression of the audio is realized, the quality of the compressed audio is ensured, and meanwhile, the effective storage of the compressed audio is realized.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for realizing sensor data time synchronization
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method, apparatus, device, and medium for implementing sensor data time synchronization. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: obtaining a first sequence of a plurality of device time stamps including a first sensor and a second sequence of a plurality of receive time stamps including intermediate devices receiving first sensor data; determining a first time difference caused by time system switching based on a first sub-sequence in the first sequence and a second sub-sequence in the second sequence in response to the target device timestamp in the first sequence meeting a preset time system switching condition; using the first time difference to unify the time system of the third sequence; the first sensor data and the second sensor data are time-synchronized based on one of the first sequence and the second sequence, and the third sequence unified by the time system.

title_en: HYPERLEDGER FABRIC key protection method and system based on SGX
abstract_en: The invention discloses a HYPERLEDGER FABRIC key protection method and a system based on SGX, which are implemented by the operations related to a user private key, such as generating a public private key of a user in HYPERLEDGER FABRIC, generating a certificate request by using the private key, sealing/decrypting the sealed private key, proposing/transacting/submitting a signature by using the private key to HYPERLEDGER FABRIC, and the like, in an enclasped of the SGX, and when the private key is not used, the private key is stored in an untrusted local file system in a sealed mode. The invention can improve the security of the user key in HYPERLEDGER FABRIC in the process of generating, storing and using under the condition of not affecting the normal function of Fabric by utilizing the security function and the characteristic of SGX.

title_en: Mode switching method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a mode switching method, a device, an electronic device and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of mobile communication, comprising: under the condition that the terminal is in a double-card double-pass DSDA mode and the first user identification card and the second user identification card perform service concurrence, acquiring a first service type corresponding to the first user identification card and a second service type corresponding to the second user identification card; determining a target user identification card from the first user identification card and the second user identification card under the condition that the first service type and/or the second service type is voice service; acquiring network information corresponding to a target network registered by a target user identification card; and switching the terminal from the double-card double-pass DSDA mode to the double-card double-standby DSDS mode according to the network information so as to stop the service of the appointed user identification card, wherein the appointed user identification card is the user identification card except the target user identification card in the first user identification card and the second user identification card.

title_en: Dynamic encryption communication method and secret conference room thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of encryption communication, and particularly relates to a dynamic encryption communication method and a secret conference room thereof, wherein the dynamic encryption communication method comprises the following steps: the communication participants are authenticated by adopting an improved zero knowledge proof technology, and when all the communication participants complete authentication, real-time communication is started; encrypting original data sent by a sender by using a homomorphic encryption algorithm, and decrypting the received encrypted data by using a private key by a receiver to obtain decrypted data; each communication participant distributes a pair of public keys and private keys, the public keys are registered on a blockchain, and the blockchain records the mapping relation between the public keys and the identity information of the communication participant; the invention improves the safety of identity verification and real-time communication, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Satellite communication transfer system equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of ad hoc network audio and video direct call, and discloses satellite communication transfer system equipment, which comprises: the transfer station equipment and the handheld terminal equipment; the transfer station equipment comprises a transfer station host, an antenna and a matched cable; the handheld terminal equipment comprises a handheld terminal host, an antenna, a battery, a charger and a matched cable; the broadband wireless transmission is adopted between the transfer station equipment and the handheld terminal equipment, the network topology mode is an ad hoc network mode, multiple communication modes such as multipoint concurrent transmission, chained relay transmission and the like can be supported, the network topology is self-adaptive, and the characteristics of self-organization, self-recovery and high destruction resistance are achieved. The invention aims at constructing satellite communication transfer system equipment, realizes the integration of satellite communication and a pre-established extension network, and expands the access range of satellite communication. The system supports the transmission and exchange of various services such as voice, video, data and the like, and can be communicated with the data interfaces of the TBW206 and TFW207 satellite stations. The satellite communication system can fully exert the advantages of satellite communication, and practically solve the problems of communication and contact, decision consultation, professional command, information collection and collection, service support and the like.

title_en: Private data multistage link encryption transmission system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of communication network security, and provides a private data multistage link encryption transmission system, which comprises: n VPN clients receive user communication data and send the user communication data to a first-stage node of the backtracking multistage link; the backtracking multi-level link comprises multi-level nodes, wherein the multi-level nodes encrypt user communication data according to time factors in the first level node and decrypt the user communication data in sequence from the second level node to the final level node; wherein the last-stage node address is fixed; and the VPN server is deployed in the last-stage node of the backtracking multi-stage link, and after the VPN client is successfully authenticated, the VPN client communicates according to the intranet IP address distributed by the virtual network card. The transmission system provided by the invention only needs to be accessed to the network by both communication parties, does not need to have the requirement on the public network IP of the VPN client, can reduce the possibility of being traced and traced by the outside and ensures the safety and reliability of network data transmission on the premise of ensuring convenience.

title_en: Method and apparatus in a node for wireless communication
abstract_en: A method and apparatus in a node for wireless communication is disclosed. A first receiver receiving at least one signaling; a first transmitter to transmit a first UCI on a target PUSCH, the target PUSCH being one of a plurality of PUSCHs; the target PUSCH depends on reference information corresponding to the plurality of PUSCHs, wherein the reference information comprises at least one of a control resource set pool index, an MCS index and frequency domain resource allocation; wherein each PUSCH of the plurality of PUSCHs is scheduled by one signaling of the at least one signaling.

title_en: Method and apparatus for probing in a MAP network
abstract_en: Methods and apparatus for probing in a MAP network are disclosed. A method of operation of a first device in a Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN) system, comprising: the method includes receiving a Multiple Access Point (MAP) network frame from a second device, identifying a joint Null Data Packet (NDP) transmission for MAP sounding and a first interleaved subcarrier based on the joint NDP transmission from the MAP network frame, and transmitting the first NDP to a third device by using the first interleaved subcarrier based on the joint NDP transmission.

title_en: Node configuration method and related device for secure real-time bus SRB
abstract_en: The application discloses a node configuration method and a related device for a secure real-time bus SRB, which respond to connection operation to obtain a connection state of a master node of a node network, wherein the node network comprises a plurality of nodes, the plurality of nodes comprise the master node, and communication connection exists between each node in the plurality of nodes and at least one other node. And if the connection state indicates that the communication between the master node and the configuration system is normal, sending configuration information to the master node so that the master node can carry out information configuration on the node networking according to the configuration information. The nodes are connected by communication, so that data transmission can be performed, and the node networking is established by the communication connection between the master node and the configuration system. Based on the configuration information, the configuration information is only required to be sent to the master node in the information configuration process. Configuration information for other nodes is also sent through the master node. Based on the information configuration method, the information configuration can be realized without the need of establishing communication connection between each node and the configuration system, and the configuration efficiency is improved.

title_en: Multi-target cloud edge collaborative computing unloading method and related equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a multi-target cloud edge collaborative computing unloading method and related equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining time delay and power consumption of the user layer application on different computing platforms; determining an overhead model applied to different computing platforms according to the time delay and the power consumption, and determining an unloading strategy according to the overhead model; problem planning is conducted on the unloading strategy, and the minimum user spending in the unloading strategy is determined; and acquiring application requests of a user layer, and configuring different application requests to a computing platform with minimum expenditure by utilizing a genetic algorithm according to an unloading strategy. The method not only satisfies that enough computing resources are available for processing data of the application, but also satisfies low-delay and low-cost processing of the application.

title_en: Electronic equipment and antenna power control method
abstract_en: The present application provides an electronic device including: a radio frequency unit, a controller and at least one antenna. The radio frequency unit is selectively connected with at least one antenna to transmit and receive electromagnetic wave signals of a preset frequency band through a target antenna in the radio frequency unit. The controller obtains a first signal quality parameter of the target antenna, and when the current signal quality is lower than a first preset signal quality, the controller controls to execute a first power adjustment operation, including: the first adjustment process: increasing the transmitting power of the radio frequency unit by a first preset power adjusting value every first preset time until a first preset condition is met; the second adjusting process: reducing the transmitting power of the radio frequency unit by a second preset power adjustment value every second preset time, and returning to execute the first adjustment process until the current signal quality is lower than the first preset signal quality. The application also provides an antenna power control method, which can effectively ensure the communication performance and avoid SAR exceeding standard.

title_en: Communication protocol detection method, circuit, chip and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The present application relates to the field of communication protocol detection technologies, and in particular, to a communication protocol detection method, a circuit, a chip, and an electronic device. The communication protocol detection method, the circuit, the chip and the electronic equipment provided by the embodiment of the application convert the received communication protocol signal into an input detection signal; acquiring at least one detection signal characteristic of the input detection signal; determining a communication protocol type of the communication protocol signal based on the at least one detected signal characteristic; by the mode, the communication protocol signals are converted into the input detection signals, the corresponding communication protocol types are determined according to at least one detection signal characteristic of the input detection signals, and the communication protocol signals are adapted to the communication protocol signals of various communication protocol types, so that the universality and the efficiency of detection are improved, and the detection accuracy is improved by judging through the at least one detection signal characteristic.

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary movement edge calculation method based on C-NOMA
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary mobile edge computing method based on C-NOMA, which comprises the following steps: constructing a mobile edge computing system assisted by multiple unmanned aerial vehicles, constructing a communication model and a computing model, and solving the optimization problem of minimizing the total delay of the system under the constraint of minimum safety capacity and maximum computing resources, wherein the optimization problem is decomposed into three problems of optimizing unloading proportion variables, optimizing computing resources of the unmanned aerial vehicles and optimizing user transmitting power; optimizing the user transmitting power by using a relaxation variable method and a continuous convex approximation method to obtain a convex problem; and solving three sub-problems by using a block coordinate descent method and a continuous convex approximation method to obtain the minimum total system delay. The invention can improve the privacy and safety problems of information transmission in the network; with the aim of minimizing the total delay of communication and calculation in the system, an optimization scheme for unloading the proportional variable, calculating the resource and distributing the user transmitting power is provided, and the calculation rate is improved when the large-scale access users provide unloading service.

title_en: Information transmitting and receiving method and device, communication device and storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an information transmitting and receiving method and device, a communication device, and a storage medium, wherein the information transmitting method includes: and sending first indication information to a network element of a core network, wherein the first indication information is used for indicating the communication device to determine information of an artificial intelligent model used by the position related information of the terminal. According to the method and the device, the communication device can send the first indication information to the network element of the core network, the communication device is indicated to determine the information of the artificial intelligent model used by the position related information of the terminal through the first indication information, so that the network element of the core network can timely learn the artificial intelligent model used by the communication device, and proper management is further carried out on the artificial intelligent model.

title_en: Micro-service load balancing method, device, equipment and medium
