Therefore, accurate metering and charging for the use of base resources of different manufacturers are realized, and efficient resource management and differentiated charging processing are realized.

title_en: Network intrusion detection method based on clustering oversampling and Transformer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network intrusion detection method based on clustering oversampling and a transducer, and relates to the technical field of network security and deep learning. The method comprises the steps of carrying out data cleaning on network flow data, balancing a data set through a clustering oversampling technology, extracting characteristic values through a method combining information gain and rapid correlation filtering, normalizing the characteristic values through a Max-Min normalization method, converting the characteristic values into images according to time stamps and characteristic sizes, marking attack types, amplifying the generated images through a bilinear interpolation method, dividing a training set and a testing set, fine-tuning a classification head through migration learning, extracting deep features of the network flow data, and realizing accurate classification on normal flow and various attack flows. The network intrusion detection method based on clustering oversampling and Transformer provided by the invention not only can effectively identify different types of network attacks, but also can obviously improve the accuracy and reliability of intrusion detection.

title_en: Processing device and method for serial port baud rate, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing device and method of serial port baud rate, electronic equipment and storage medium, wherein the device comprises a data transmission module and a data processing module; the data processing module is used for converting the second serial port data into fourth serial port data identifiable by the switch according to the first serial port baud rate, the data transmission module is used for transmitting the third serial port data to the target serial port, and the data transmission module is used for transmitting the fourth serial port data to the switch. Compared with the related art, when the serial port baud rates of the target serial ports of the switch and the serial port server are inconsistent, the serial port baud rate of the opposite party is automatically utilized to convert the serial port data of the opposite party, so that the opposite party can identify the serial port data of the opposite party, the serial port baud rate of the target serial port is not required to be manually reconfigured, and the processing efficiency of the serial port baud rate is improved.

title_en: Denier detection system and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a fineness detection system and a fineness detection method, which relate to the field of fineness detection and comprise the following steps: the length measuring device is used for transmitting the fiber length and the fiber outlet rate corresponding to the target fiber bundle outlet to the controller, the controller records breakpoint information based on the fiber outlet rate and the fiber length, the fiber length and the breakpoint information are transmitted to the computer, the computer transmits a weight measuring instruction to the electronic scale when the fiber length reaches a preset length, so that the electronic scale measures the weight of the fiber bundle, and the computer also calculates the fineness of the fiber output by the target fiber bundle outlet according to the fiber length, the breakpoint information and the weight of the fiber bundle transmitted by the electronic scale. According to the application, the configuration computer calculates the fineness of the fiber output by the target fiber bundle outlet according to the weight of the fiber roll sent by the electronic scale, the fiber length and the breakpoint information sent by the controller, so that automatic data recording, weight measurement and detection are realized, and the fineness detection precision and efficiency are improved.

title_en: Intelligent health management system and method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent health management system and method based on the Internet of things, in particular to the technical field of privacy protection, which applies homomorphic encryption technology to encrypt physiological data, health data and identity information of the elderly, after encryption is completed, the physiological data and the health data of the old are integrated and then are stored in the intelligent equipment terminal separately from the identity information, and the data transmission and storage processes always keep an encryption state, so that the risk of data leakage is effectively reduced; according to the method, the system and the device, the data training is carried out on the health comprehensive early warning model at the nodes, then the training results of the health comprehensive early warning model of each node are aggregated to obtain the global health comprehensive early warning model, data privacy can be guaranteed, machine learning modeling can be carried out by using scattered data, and when the privacy risk of the system is detected, the privacy risk alarm is sent to the system management center, and then the privacy protection scheme is adjusted, so that the duration of the privacy risk can be reduced.

title_en: Method, apparatus, device, storage medium and program product for processing access request
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a program product for processing an access request, and relates to the technical field of network security. The method comprises the steps of determining a target IP corresponding to an access request according to the received access request, determining a first user name corresponding to the target IP, pre-establishing corresponding relations between different user names and different IPs, wherein one user name corresponds to at least one IP, and forwarding the access request to a corresponding preset destination address based on an access request processing rule corresponding to the first user name. The method and the device for processing the user account, the terminal equipment and the like for initiating the access request based on the user name can avoid loopholes caused by IP address change and the like of the user terminal equipment, have better flexibility, and can effectively improve the security of the running environments such as the network accessed by the user.

title_en: Detection network, detection method, antenna system and base station for antenna signals
abstract_en: The application provides a detection network, a detection method, an antenna system and a base station of antenna signals, wherein the detection network comprises two correction channels and a switch network, the first correction channel comprises a plurality of first output ports, the phases of the plurality of first output ports are the same, the second correction channel comprises a plurality of second output ports, the number of the second output ports is the same as that of the first output ports, the phases of the plurality of second output ports are different, the plurality of first output ports and the plurality of second output ports are connected with an antenna array, the switch network is respectively connected with the two correction channels and is used for realizing the connection of the two correction channels with a calibration port in different time domains, the calibration port is connected with an RRU, and the calibration port is used for inputting transmission signals between the antenna array and the RRU. The detection network, the detection method, the antenna system and the base station for the antenna signals can rapidly and conveniently detect whether the connection line between the antenna array and the RRU is correct or not.

title_en: Attribute-based encryption method, system, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to an attribute-based encryption method, an attribute-based encryption system, attribute-based encryption equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of receiving a data access request of a data user, wherein the data access request comprises a user identification of the data user and a requested ciphertext, the ciphertext comprises access control layer information and encrypted data layer information, obtaining a user list, determining a conversion key corresponding to the data user from the user list according to the user identification, decrypting the ciphertext once according to the conversion key to obtain a primary conversion ciphertext, sending the user identification and the primary conversion ciphertext to a trusted execution environment so that the trusted execution environment can decrypt the primary conversion ciphertext twice to obtain a secondary conversion ciphertext, and sending decryption instructions carrying the secondary conversion ciphertext to the data user, wherein the decryption instructions are used for instructing the data user to decrypt the secondary conversion ciphertext for three times so as to obtain target data. The method can realize controllable data user authority more safely and conveniently.

title_en: Call data encryption method and related equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a call data encryption method and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of communication. The method comprises the steps of responding to a call request initiated by first equipment, encrypting a first private key generated by the first equipment through a pre-stored target public key to obtain a first encrypted private key, storing the first encrypted private key and the first public key corresponding to the first private key into a blockchain to obtain a stored transaction message returned by the blockchain, sending the stored transaction message to second equipment corresponding to the call request, wherein the stored transaction message is used for indicating the second equipment to store a second encrypted private key and a second public key in the blockchain based on the stored transaction message, the second encrypted private key is obtained by encrypting the second private key through the target public key for the second equipment, and encrypting call data of the first equipment through the second public key in the blockchain to obtain first encrypted data. By the method, the risk of leakage and misuse of call data can be reduced, and the safety of the call data is improved.

title_en: Vehicle service abnormality detection method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a vehicle service abnormality detection method and electronic equipment, the method comprises the steps of determining target embedded point data corresponding to each service in a plurality of services executing target vehicle control instructions, determining instruction execution rules corresponding to the target vehicle control instructions, carrying out association arrangement processing on the services according to the instruction execution rules to obtain service links, determining abnormal services in the service links according to the target embedded point data corresponding to each service, carrying out marking processing on the abnormal services in the service links, and displaying the marked service links and the target embedded point data corresponding to each service as vehicle service abnormality detection results. The embedded point data is automatically collected aiming at the execution process of the vehicle control instruction, the abnormal service is checked, the whole service link, the abnormal service in the service link and the embedded point data of each service are displayed, the automatic problem positioning is realized, and the problem analysis is convenient for users.

title_en: Message processing method, device, network equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a message processing method, a device, network equipment and a storage medium, wherein the message processing method comprises the steps of responding to a service message received through a target interface and obtaining an interface index of the target interface; the method comprises the steps of determining a first ARC index associated with an interface index, calling a service node in a service processing path to execute processing operation on a service message according to the service processing path associated with the first ARC index, wherein the service node comprises a first service node started based on the interface and a second service node started globally. The embodiment of the application can enable the interface of the network equipment to simultaneously support the first service node based on the interface and the second service node which is globally started, greatly enhances the flexibility and adaptability of the network equipment in a complex network environment, and meets the diversified and refined network management requirements.

title_en: PRS ID configuration method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a PRS ID configuration method, a device and equipment, which relate to the technical field of communication, and the method is applied to configuration management equipment; and configuring RSU PRS IDs and RSU PRS ID sets for RSUs in the first geographical position multiplexing range according to the first quantity, the first geographical position multiplexing range and RSU deployment information of road side equipment. According to the scheme, the RSU PRS IDs configured for the RSUs in the first geographical position multiplexing range can be guaranteed to be unique and orthogonal, and the probability of resource collision of a transmitting end and the complexity of receiving of a receiving end are reduced.

title_en: PowerLink protocol message processing method, powerLink protocol message processing device, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of industrial network security, in particular to a processing method, a device, a storage medium and a program product of a PowerLink protocol message. The method comprises the steps of receiving a PowerLink protocol message, deleting bytes of an Ethernet header and bytes of an Ethernet tail, obtaining byte values of service type bytes, of which the offset with the message header is a first preset number of bytes, in the pruned PowerLink protocol message, determining a function code type of the service type, decoding the function code type to obtain decoding information, obtaining byte values of address nodes, of which the offset with the message header is a second preset number of bytes, in the message, processing the PowerLink protocol message according to load length, decoding information and the byte values of the address nodes, improving processing efficiency of the PowerLink protocol message, obtaining better processing effect, and carrying out deep analysis on the message to improve the accuracy of message detection.

title_en: Remote monitoring control system and method for dental scaler based on mobile phone Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of tooth cleaners, and discloses a remote monitoring control system and method for a tooth cleaner based on a mobile phone Internet of things; the method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time working state data of the dental scaler, constructing a dental scaler working state data diagram, carrying out optimization analysis on the dental scaler working state data diagram on a cloud server to obtain preliminary optimal working parameters of the dental scaler, identifying and marking an overlapped cleaning area on the dental scaler working state data diagram, calculating an optimal working path based on the working state data diagram marked with the overlapped cleaning area, combining the optimal working path with the preliminary optimal working parameters to obtain a final optimal working strategy, transmitting the final optimal working strategy on the cloud server to a mobile phone end in a wireless communication mode, receiving the final optimal working strategy by the mobile phone end, and sending the final optimal working strategy to the dental scaler in a wireless communication mode to adjust the working state of the dental scaler, so that remote intelligent control and optimization of the working state are realized.

title_en: Ad hoc network underground cable external damage prevention alarm method, device and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-external-damage alarm method, device and system for an underground cable of an ad hoc network, wherein the device comprises a control module, a vibration sensor, a sound pick-up, a Lora wireless communication module and an alarm module, wherein the vibration sensor, the sound pick-up, the Lora wireless communication module and the alarm module are connected with the control module, the vibration sensor is used for detecting vibration signals generated when heavy machinery around the underground cable is constructed, the sound pick-up is used for detecting sound signals generated when the heavy machinery around the underground cable is constructed, the Lora wireless communication module is used for networking and mutually sending information between adjacent anti-external-damage alarm devices of the underground cable, the control module is used for comprehensively analyzing the vibration signals and the sound signals to judge whether an alarm is needed, and the alarm module is used for receiving instructions of the control module to carry out buzzing alarm. The invention can jointly judge the external breaking event, thereby improving the judgment accuracy.

title_en: Power grid upgrading mirror image data transmission method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid upgrading mirror image data transmission method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps that a sending end generates a first key sequence and a second key sequence based on a preset iterative algorithm and two different initial iterative information; the method comprises the steps of generating a first-layer encryption data sequence by a sending end based on a first key sequence and a first encryption algorithm, encrypting the power grid upgrading mirror image data by the sending end based on a second key sequence and a second encryption algorithm, generating a second-layer encryption data sequence by the sending end based on the first-layer encryption data sequence, and obtaining the power grid upgrading mirror image data by performing layered decryption on the second-layer encryption data sequence by a receiving end based on the first key sequence, the second key sequence, the first encryption algorithm and the second encryption algorithm. By the technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention, the safe transmission of the power grid upgrading mirror image data is realized, the possibility that an encryption algorithm is violently broken can be reduced, the safety of the power grid upgrading mirror image data transmission is improved, and the running safety of the power grid is ensured.

title_en: Signal processing method, apparatus, computer device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a signal processing method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out frequency domain-to-time domain processing on a frequency domain input signal based on a preset first localization operation rule to obtain a time domain signal sequence, wherein the first localization operation rule is an upward setting localization operation rule or a downward setting localization operation rule, compensating the time domain signal sequence based on a predetermined compensation sequence to obtain a time domain signal compensation sequence, the compensation sequence is obtained by carrying out fitting processing on each difference sequence sample in a difference sequence sample group, the difference sequence sample is obtained by carrying out frequency domain-to-time domain processing on the frequency domain signal sample based on the first localization operation rule, and the second localization operation rule. Based on the scheme of the application, the speed and accuracy of converting the frequency domain into the time domain of the signal can be improved.

title_en: Network rate control method, apparatus, chip, network interface card, computer device, readable storage medium, and program product
abstract_en: The present application relates to a network rate control method, apparatus, chip, network interface card, computer device, computer readable storage medium and computer program product. The method comprises the steps of determining a current network rate, determining a target network rate based on the current network rate, wherein the relation between the target network rate and a rate increase round is a concave function, and adjusting the current network rate to be the target network rate. The method can improve the utilization rate of the broadband.

title_en: Monitoring abnormality investigation method and monitoring system thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of computers, and provides a monitoring abnormality investigation method and a monitoring system thereof. The method comprises the steps of setting a basic communication mode between disconnected reconnection equipment and a target server after the disconnected reconnection equipment completes one-time identity authentication, obtaining first operation data of the disconnected reconnection equipment in a disconnected reconnection period, obtaining second operation data of a plurality of associated computer equipment with preset association relation with the disconnected reconnection equipment in the disconnected reconnection period, carrying out risk evaluation on the first operation data and the second operation data by using a risk analysis model to obtain a comprehensive risk value, carrying out secondary identity authentication on the disconnected reconnection equipment if the comprehensive risk value is higher than a risk threshold, and otherwise, switching the basic communication mode into a normal communication mode. According to the method and the system, risk investigation is carried out on the disconnection reconnection equipment, so that the risk of safety threat to the target server caused by the abnormal disconnection reconnection equipment can be reduced.

title_en: NR system-based mobile terminal characteristic value acquisition and positioning method and device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of mobile communication and discloses a method and a device for acquiring and positioning a characteristic value of a mobile terminal based on an NR system, comprising the following steps of S1, starting a base station and configuring coverage range and parameters of an NR network; S2, receiving an RRC connection request of the mobile terminal, establishing a communication link, S3, sending an identity request signaling, receiving a response signaling containing SUCI, S4, decoding SUCI to be the IMSI, judging whether the IMSI is a target user, S5, periodically pre-dispatching the target user, maintaining link stability, and S6, positioning the target terminal through signal strength and direction information. Through the periodic pre-scheduling in the specific time domain and the frequency domain, the signaling communication without data interaction is realized, so that the dependence on the flow in the communication process is reduced, the problem of data flow consumption is further avoided, and the defect of high communication cost in the traditional method is solved.

title_en: Network control safety loop system of motor train unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network control safety loop system of a motor train unit, which comprises a network controller, wherein the network controller comprises a power supply, an IO input/output interface, an Ethernet interface, a TRDP network card and a processor, the power supply is used for supplying power to the network controller, the Ethernet interface is used for receiving network signals after the power supply is electrified, the TRDP network card is used for analyzing Ethernet data in the network signals according to a TRDP protocol to obtain on-off state signals of different loops corresponding to data messages with loop identifications, the IO input/output interface is used for acquiring the on-off state signals of the safety loops corresponding to the data messages with the safety loop identifications, and the processor is used for controlling the Ethernet interface to transmit control signals to the network according to the on-off state signals of the safety loops corresponding to the data messages with the safety loop identifications acquired by the IO input/output interface.

title_en: Container health monitoring method based on embedded real-time environment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of computer system software, and particularly relates to a container health monitoring method based on an embedded real-time environment, which is used for analyzing and processing collected container running state data after collecting the running state data of a container in real time to determine the health state of the container; when the health state of the container is determined to be abnormal, generating alarm information and taking corresponding treatment measures. The invention can monitor the health of the container more efficiently and accurately.

title_en: Method for negotiating block acknowledgement feedback mechanism, communication equipment and communication system
abstract_en: A Block Acknowledgement (BA) feedback mechanism negotiation method, a communication device and a communication system. The method is applied to an initiating terminal for establishing a BA feedback mechanism and comprises the steps of determining a first wireless frame, wherein the first wireless frame comprises first identification information which identifies timeout information of a block acknowledgement BA frame, the timeout information identifies timeout information of the BA feedback mechanism applied to a plurality of physical access point devices (AP) or multi-link access point devices (AP) MLD, and sending the first wireless frame can enable the BA feedback mechanism to be applied among the plurality of physical APs or AP MLDs, so that the frequency spectrum utilization rate and the data transmission efficiency are improved, and the BA feedback mechanism can adapt to UHR requirements.

title_en: Commercial district passenger flow prediction method, system and device based on graphic neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a business district passenger flow prediction method, a system and a device based on a graph neural network, which relate to the technical field of business district passenger flow prediction, and the method mainly comprises the steps of constructing a feature space of business district passenger flow prediction based on a traffic district set and a business district set; the traffic community feature is embedded into a graph neural network to obtain a traffic community embedded vector, the business circle feature is embedded into a first multi-layer perceptron to obtain a business circle embedded vector, the embedded vector is connected with a corresponding OD flow feature to serve as an OD flow comprehensive representation vector, a second multi-layer perceptron is trained and verified, the OD flow comprehensive representation vector which is best in performance on a verification set is taken as input and is transmitted into a fully-connected neural network, and the business circle passenger flow is predicted. According to the scheme, geographical semantic information of the land parcels is brought into the model for feature embedding, a multi-graph structure combining two spatial dependency relations is constructed, the commercial ring OD flow is predicted through a graph neural network and a graph embedding technology, and the prediction accuracy is higher.

title_en: Underground low-voltage power supply and carrier communication system and communication method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground low-voltage power supply and carrier communication system and a communication method, which relate to the technical field of carrier communication and aim to solve the problem that the ground is required to supply power to an underground measurement and control device and is required to be in bidirectional communication with the underground measurement and control device in the underground oil extraction and water injection process, and the traditional cable power supply and communication system and the communication method cannot meet the actual needs. The system comprises a power supply circuit unit and a power receiving circuit unit, wherein the power supply circuit unit comprises a main controller, a power supply source, a relay module, a signal receiving module and the like, the power receiving circuit unit comprises a circuit unit 1, a circuit unit 2 and a circuit unit 3, and the circuit units 1-3 are respectively composed of a slave controller module, a storage battery module, a carrier signal transmitting module, a carrier signal receiving module, a measurement and control module and the like. The system adopts a direct current power supply and communication mode of 'one master and multiple slaves', simplifies underground power supply and communication equipment of an oil field, improves the operation efficiency and reduces the operation and maintenance cost.

title_en: Data processing method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a data processing method, a data processing device, computer equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of communication. In the data processing process, for each data transmission, the first computer encrypts the data by using a compression algorithm and a private key in a first key pair to obtain a signature of the data, regenerates a data key, encrypts the data by using the data key, encrypts the data by using a public key in a second key pair, comprehensively uses a plurality of encryption algorithms to improve the complexity of data encryption, and because the compression algorithm is irreversible, the data keys used for each data transmission are different and the private key in the first key pair is only held by the first computer device and the second computer device, the method can judge whether the data is the data sent by the first computer device or not based on the compression algorithm, the data key and the first key pair, thereby improving the safety of the data.

title_en: Anti-phishing propaganda method, system, medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: A propaganda method, a system, a storage medium and electronic equipment for countering phishing relate to the technical field of information. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a to-be-called list, determining a current calling user in the to-be-called list, determining a first fraud strategy based on user basic information of the current calling user, wherein the first fraud strategy comprises a fraud type, a first fraud level, a first fraud operation and a first fraud language, obtaining a first feedback result of the current calling user on a first fraud scheme, calculating an anti-fraud score value of the current calling user based on the first feedback result, adjusting the first fraud strategy when the anti-fraud score value is larger than a score threshold value to obtain a second fraud strategy, obtaining a second feedback result of the current calling user on the second fraud scheme, generating an anti-fraud report based on the first feedback result and the second feedback result, and sending the anti-fraud report to the current calling user. By implementing the technical scheme provided by the application, the effectiveness of anti-fraud propaganda can be improved.

title_en: Multi-image encryption method based on improved z curve and chaotic signal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-image encryption method based on an improved z curve and chaotic signals, which comprises the steps of randomly selecting R, G, B color channels of input images, fusing four input images with different sizes into a fused image, processing the fused image by using an SHA256 algorithm to obtain a secret key, carrying out grouping calculation to obtain an initial value of a grid multi-scroll chaotic system, sequentially carrying out zero padding operation and blocking operation on the fused image, substituting the initial value into the grid multi-scroll chaotic system to obtain three chaotic sequences, carrying out division on the chaotic sequences, carrying out scrambling operation on each sub block by combining the chaotic sequences through two algorithms successively, storing the sub blocks into an array, carrying out dynamic DNA encoding and decoding operation on elements in the array by combining the chaotic sequences to obtain a sequence DNAjiema, and carrying out grouping diffusion on the sequence DNAjiema by an improved central diffusion algorithm to finally obtain an encrypted image.

title_en: Information transmission method and communication device
abstract_en: A method and a communication device for information transmission indicate uplink sub-band precoding information through two-stage DCI, wherein a first-stage DCI on a PDCCH (physical downlink control channel) only needs to indicate one rate matching parameter, and the rate matching parameter can be used for determining whether a second-stage DCI on a PDSCH exists or not and the ratio of resources occupied by the second DCI to resources occupied by the PDSCH. The second level DCI is used to indicate subband precoding information. When there is downlink data transmission, the information of the subband precoding part can be selected to be directly transmitted along with the PDSCH, and no special PDSCH channel is required to be additionally scheduled to transmit the second DCI. The indication cost of whether the second-level DCI on the PDSCH indicated by the first-level DCI exists or not and the specific resource mapping position is reduced, and the length of the first-level DCI is reduced, so that fewer communication resources are needed for transmitting the first-level DCI, and the consumption of the communication resources is reduced.

title_en: Non-contact serial bus detection method
abstract_en: A non-contact serial bus detection method belongs to the technical field of bus communication and comprises the following steps of S1, switching on a power supply and an illuminating lamp of a non-contact serial bus tester, S2, receiving and sending signals by a cylindrical antenna at the front end of a shell of the non-contact serial bus tester, S3, selecting a refresh rate and displaying refresh rate information, S4, selecting a bus type and displaying bus type information, and S5, selecting a baud rate and displaying baud rate information. Compared with the traditional checking method, the method can be used for checking the bus communication faults, avoids introducing new faults and ensures the efficiency of checking the faults.

title_en: Network optimization method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a network optimization method, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of network optimization, wherein the method is applied to communication equipment, according to the total weight of communication quality between current communication equipment and other equipment directly communicated with the current communication equipment, a first stability weight corresponding to a current equipment identifier is obtained, the minimum value in all the first stability weights corresponding to the current equipment identifier is used as a second stability weight corresponding to the current equipment identifier, the number of the current equipment identifiers corresponding to the second stability weight is smaller than a preset stability weight is used as the number of stable equipment, when the number of the current equipment is not smaller than the preset equipment number and the number of the stable equipment is not smaller than the preset stable equipment ratio, the low-power Bluetooth network is optimized, an optimization strategy can be dynamically adjusted, unnecessary optimization is avoided, resource consumption is reduced, and meanwhile, the efficient operation and the stability of the low-power Bluetooth network can be ensured.

title_en: High concurrent transaction data processing system and method combining edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high concurrency transaction data processing system and method based on edge calculation, which are used for improving the efficiency and safety of transaction data processing. The method receives transaction data from a plurality of user terminals simultaneously through a multithreading concurrent receiving queue of the edge equipment, and performs strict integrity and validity check on the data. The verified data are processed in a slicing way, and intelligently distributed to a plurality of processing modules for parallel processing. The edge equipment intelligently integrates the processing results of all the modules by adopting a real-time parallel reduction algorithm to generate transaction response data. And then, compressing the response data by using an adaptive compression algorithm, synchronizing to a central server through a multi-encrypted secure transmission channel, and feeding back the synchronization state to the user terminal in real time. After the data is successfully synchronized, the edge equipment safely deletes the local cache, and high efficiency, safety and reliability of data processing are ensured.

title_en: Rapid start network congestion control method suitable for power system
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of power systems, and particularly relates to a rapid start network congestion control method suitable for a power system, which ensures the accuracy and reliability of data by collecting and preprocessing power equipment and network flow data. And then, training a flow prediction model by using the preprocessed data, wherein the model can accurately predict the network flow in a future period of time and provides a basis for real-time decision. In the starting process of the power system, network congestion detection is carried out by combining real-time network state and equipment state data, and potential congestion risks are found in time. And finally, dynamically adjusting the flow scheduling and control strategy based on the network congestion detection result and the prediction result of the flow prediction model, so as to optimize the resource allocation and avoid unsuitable decisions. The series of steps ensures that network congestion can be timely and accurately handled under the condition of rapid change of network state, and the efficiency and stability of rapid starting of the power system are improved.

title_en: OTDR system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an OTDR system, which relates to the technical field of optical communication and comprises an optical switch and an OTDR optical module inserted into network equipment, wherein the OTDR optical module is connected with the optical switch through optical fibers, at least one optical fiber line connected with the optical switch is combined with at least one optical fiber line connected with at least one communication optical module inserted into the network equipment, the OTDR optical module is used for sending an OTDR optical signal to the optical switch and receiving a feedback optical signal of the OTDR optical signal, and a detection result of the optical fiber line is generated according to the OTDR optical signal and the feedback optical signal. The scheme can improve the convenience of management and maintenance work of the optical fiber line and the flexibility of OTDR upgrading.

title_en: Method for access network node, method for core network node, method for user equipment, access network node, core network node and user equipment
abstract_en: A method for an access network node is provided. The method includes transmitting a first message to the UE, the first message including a query for the UE's capability to receive a multicast/broadcast service, or MBS, in case the UE is in an rrc_inactive state, the RRC being a radio resource control, and receiving a second message from the UE, the second message including a list of one or more MBS sessions that the UE can support in case the UE is in an rrc_inactive state, in case the UE has information for identifying at least one MBS available to the UE.

title_en: Method, system and medium for rapidly uploading and downloading massive small files in batches
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and a medium for rapidly uploading and downloading a large number of small files in batches, and belongs to the technical field of computer storage. The method comprises an initialization stage, an uploading preprocessing stage, an intelligent packaging stage, an uploading execution stage, a downloading initialization stage, a downloading execution stage and a loading execution stage, wherein the preprocessing is carried out on files to be uploaded and whether batch uploading conditions are met or not, the intelligent packaging stage is carried out to obtain a package body, the uploading execution stage is used for dividing the package body into a plurality of file blocks and uploading the file blocks to an S3 object storage system after matching hash values, when a client receives a file downloading request of a user, file information to be downloaded designated by the user is obtained, file matching is carried out, the downloading execution stage is used for executing a single file downloading flow for a single file downloading request, and the batch file downloading flow is executed for a batch file downloading request. The method improves the overall efficiency of data transmission, shortens the time required by uploading, and is particularly suitable for large-scale data uploading scenes.

title_en: Beam fault recovery via relay nodes
abstract_en: Aspects of the present disclosure relate generally to wireless communications. In some aspects, a User Equipment (UE) may send a Beam Fault Recovery (BFR) message for a failed link, wherein the failed link is one of an indirect link with a network node or a direct link with the network node via a relay node, wherein the BFR message is sent on one of the indirect link or the direct link that is not the failed link. The UE may receive the updated beam configuration for the failed link on the selected beam indicated by the BFR message. Many other aspects are described.

title_en: Video signal input delay determining method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a video signal input delay determining method, a video signal input delay determining device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of inserting a target pixel point into a designated position of a video frame to obtain the target video frame, recording a sending time stamp of the target video frame, sending the sending time stamp and the target video frame to a receiving end, recording a receiving time stamp by the receiving end when the target pixel point in the target video frame is detected, and determining video signal input time delay according to the sending time stamp and the receiving time stamp. The application can improve the measurement precision of the video signal input delay on the basis of not increasing the complexity and the measurement cost of the system.

title_en: Mixed flow transmission method driven by receiving end and computing network
abstract_en: The application relates to a mixed flow transmission method driven by a receiving end and a computing network. The method comprises the steps of constructing a network topology structure of a computing center, classifying sub-flows in mixed flows by a receiving end according to types of the sub-flows, generating credit packets based on rates for each type of flow, adopting a credit scheduling mode driven by the receiving end to carry out data transmission, adopting a selective packet loss and packet loss recovery mechanism to carry out data packet transmission when unscheduled data packets arrive at a switch, allowing new flows to send unscheduled data packets at a link rate, actively limiting the sending rate of the credit packets on the switch, ensuring full utilization of the link capacity to avoid excessive buffer occupation, and adopting a congestion control mechanism based on delay to realize fair coexistence of heterogeneous flows in the flow transmission process. The method is excellent in performance under heterogeneous flow coexistence scenes, and can effectively guarantee high performance characteristics such as low buffer occupancy rate, rapid convergence and the like.

title_en: Method, system, device and storage medium for calibrating activation point of positioning device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, which can be applied to the fields of finance, medical treatment, vehicle leasing and the like, and discloses a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for calibrating an activation point of positioning equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring the activation point positioning reported by target positioning equipment at the first reporting time and judging whether the activation point positioning is in an equipment factory area or not; and when the positioning information is determined to meet the calibration condition in the process of sequentially acquiring the positioning information, calibrating the positioning of the activation point by using the positioning information. The method has the advantages that the target positioning equipment with the activation points positioned in the equipment factory area is calibrated by utilizing the subsequent positioning information, so that the data accuracy of the activation points of the positioning equipment is improved, and the method has important significance in subsequent risk control, asset monitoring, fraud early warning and the like on leases based on the data of the positioning equipment.

title_en: Service group session processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a business group session processing method, a business group session processing device, business group session processing equipment and a storage medium. The business group session processing method comprises the steps of responding to marking operation of any business group session in the message interface, changing attribute marks of the business group session, wherein the attribute marks comprise business state attributes and business priority attributes, and displaying the changed attribute marks on the message interface. According to the technical scheme, the marking function of the business group session is added, the attribute mark of the business group session is displayed on the message interface, so that a user can know the business state and the business priority corresponding to the business group session in time, and can manage various business group sessions according to the business state and the business priority, the business management and treatment efficiency is improved, and the user experience is enhanced. The method solves the problems that when the service group session is too many, the user is difficult to manage the service group session and the corresponding service efficiency is affected.

title_en: Object storage backup system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an object storage backup system. The method comprises the steps of storing load information representing the operation condition of service nodes into a distributed key value storage module, sending survival signals to the distributed key value storage module based on the survival signal sending module, sending node abnormal information to each health node based on all the received survival signals, responding to the received node abnormal information by the health node for each health node and the node identification of the health node, and continuously executing a first object storage backup task which is not completed by the abnormal node under the condition that the target identification of the target health node with the smallest load in all the health nodes is determined to be the node identification based on all the read load information. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention can improve the high availability of disaster backup service of object storage.

title_en: Information encryption method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an information encryption method, which is applied to a target key in an information encryption system, wherein the information encryption system comprises a plurality of keys, a plurality of lock cylinders and a management platform, the target key is any one of the plurality of keys, each key has a matching relation with at least one lock cylinder, the method comprises the steps of encrypting unlocking request information input by a user to obtain a first encryption file, sending the first encryption file to the management platform and receiving a second encryption file returned by the management platform, decrypting and verifying the second encryption file to generate unlocking indication information corresponding to the target lock cylinder, encrypting the unlocking indication information to obtain a third encryption file, and sending the third encryption file to the target lock cylinder, so that the target lock cylinder performs unlocking operation according to the third encryption file, the confidentiality, the integrity and the source authenticability of information transmission in the unlocking process are ensured, and the safety and the accuracy of an unlocking process are improved.

title_en: Indoor distribution system and signal coverage method
abstract_en: The application discloses an indoor distribution system and a signal coverage method. The system comprises an active radio frequency distribution node used for carrying out cascade amplification on signals, wherein the active radio frequency distribution node is connected in cascade through a leakage cable, and the leakage cable is used for transmitting the signals and radiating the signals outwards through an opening arranged on the leakage cable in the signal transmission process. The application solves the technical problem that the indoor distribution system in the related art adopts an antenna coverage mode, so that the signal coverage is uneven for the area with dense intervals due to the penetration loss of the intervals.

title_en: Dynamic battery power consumption optimization method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic battery power consumption optimizing method based on machine learning, which relates to the technical field of energy consumption optimizing, solves the technical problem that the power consumption managing strategy is difficult to be formulated in a targeted way, so that the power consumption characteristics of different functional applications cannot be effectively distinguished in the process of electric quantity management, when the electric quantity is low, the unusual low-power consumption application and the unusual high-power consumption application are reasonably limited or closed, the operation of the unusual application is preferentially ensured, the user use requirement and the battery endurance are effectively balanced, the effective use duration, the use times and the duration duty ratio of the application are calculated, the priority value is comprehensively obtained and compared with the preset priority value, the application usability is intelligently judged, different priorities are given when the electric quantity is managed, the resource allocation efficiency is improved, and the user experience is improved.

title_en: Data encryption and privacy protection method for trusted data exchange platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a data encryption and privacy protection method of a trusted data exchange platform, which belongs to the technical field of data transmission and comprises the following steps of 1, receiving data exchange requests of a plurality of requesters by the data exchange platform, determining data to be exchanged of the data exchange platform, 2, determining historical request exchange evaluation values and historical receiving exchange evaluation values of each sub data to be exchanged, 3, determining encryption tags of each data exchange request, determining classified data of the data exchange platform, 4, encrypting the classified data, transmitting the classified data after data encryption, and 5, generating a data exchange report to realize trusted data exchange. The data exchange system can realize fine granularity grading and encryption of data exchange requests, realize multi-level data protection and privacy protection, ensure the safety, high efficiency and flexibility of the data exchange process, reduce the risk of data leakage and improve the transparency, credibility and safety of a data exchange platform.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for detecting peripheral cameras by intelligent television
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for detecting a peripheral camera of an intelligent television, which relate to the technical field of intelligent detection and comprise the steps of receiving a detection instruction and calling a signal scanning assembly in the intelligent television according to the detection instruction; and analyzing and evaluating the data to be detected to determine the detection result of the camera of the surrounding environment. According to the application, the signal scanning assembly is integrated in the intelligent television, so that data acquisition, analysis and evaluation are carried out on the surrounding environment where the intelligent television is located, so that the detection result of the camera in the surrounding environment is obtained, and the effect of accurately detecting the hidden camera through the intelligent television configured in the room is realized.

title_en: Underwater sound sensing network control system and control method based on crowd-sourced cooperation
abstract_en: The application provides a control system of a water sound sensing network based on crowd-sourcing cooperation, which comprises a main control board, a communication module and a processor, wherein the main control board is connected with the communication module, the communication module is connected with the processor, the main control board is also connected with the processor, the main control board is used for supplying power to nodes of the water sound sensing network, acquiring environment sensing information of the water sound sensing network and residual electric quantity information of the nodes, the communication module is used for receiving node data in the water sound sensing network, the processor is used for packaging data to be transmitted into data packets, and the data packets are transmitted according to transmission parameter decision. Under the condition that part of node energy in the network is exhausted or damaged, the intelligent cooperation based on the rest nodes can maintain the network performance, and the robust and reliable underwater acoustic communication service can be continuously provided for various underwater applications.

title_en: Threat hunting method and device for full log and information based on bidirectional clustering
abstract_en: A threat hunting method and device based on bidirectional clustering for full logs and intelligence comprises the steps of obtaining full log data and extracting log feature data, carrying out clustering processing by adopting a pre-established threat region classification model based on the log feature data to obtain a first clustering result, generating a corresponding clustering threat detection model for each region cluster in the first clustering result according to the log feature data contained in the region cluster, carrying out clustering processing on the log feature data in the region cluster according to the corresponding clustering threat detection model of the region cluster to obtain a second clustering result, and determining a threat hunting result according to the second clustering result of all the region clusters. In an exemplary embodiment, the method further includes verifying threat hunting results and fusing the verification results into threat intelligence data. The proposal provided by the embodiment can improve the automation degree of threat hunting and discover novel threats and unknown threats.

title_en: DCI receiving method, DCI sending device, terminal and network side equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a DCI receiving method, a DCI sending device, a terminal and network side equipment, belonging to the technical field of wireless communication, wherein the DCI receiving method in the embodiment of the application comprises the following steps: the terminal detects DCI, wherein the DCI comprises at least one of first-level DCI and second-level DCI, the first-level DCI comprises auxiliary information, the auxiliary information is used for auxiliary detection of the second-level DCI, and the second-level DCI comprises scheduling information for terminal data.

title_en: Quality of service flow model for low latency services
abstract_en: An entity in a Core Network (CN) of a wireless communication system receives quality of service (QoS) parameters related to processing of a set of Protocol Data Units (PDUs) for a traffic (1602), performs QoS binding of the service data flow to a QoS flow for a media type using the QoS parameters (1604), generates a QoS profile associated with a QoS Flow Identifier (QFI) of the QoS flow, and transmits the QoS profile to a Radio Access Network (RAN) via which the UE accesses the CN (1606).

title_en: Self-adaptive optimization method for network security equipment based on rule analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of network safety equipment, and discloses a network safety equipment self-adaptive optimization method based on rule analysis, which comprises the steps of obtaining a historical feedback behavior mode of the network safety equipment, dividing the historical feedback behavior mode into a historical safety feedback behavior mode and a historical abnormal feedback behavior mode, determining a safety feedback rule data set and an abnormal feedback rule data set, calculating an initial historical safety processing factor and an initial historical abnormal processing factor, carrying out normalization processing, constructing an initial processing factor set, dividing the initial processing factor set into a first initial processing factor set and a second initial processing factor set, calculating a historical safety event processing factor, extracting the historical safety event processing factor of each network safety equipment, carrying out self-adaptive optimization on a plurality of network safety equipment, removing network safety equipment with poor protection effect, realizing effective management and coordination, fully playing the protection function of each network safety equipment, improving the efficiency and effect of network safety protection, and guaranteeing the safe and stable operation of a network system.

title_en: Sampling frequency offset phase compensation method and device under QPSK modulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sampling frequency offset phase compensation method and a device under QPSK modulation, which relate to the technical field of phase compensation methods, collect each load frame and carry out QPSK modulation on the load frame, configure corresponding phase rotation factors for each OFDM symbol based on QPSK modulation of each load frame, determine corresponding phase compensation values based on rotation compensation of each subcarrier in the calculation process of the phase rotation factors until all subcarriers in each load frame have the corresponding phase compensation values, trigger corresponding diversity combination according to each OFDM symbol, at the moment, do not need to directly estimate the sampling frequency offset estimation value, acquire approximate sampling frequency offset phase deflection information by utilizing a plurality of subcarrier information to combine and reduce noise, correct accordingly, obtain a better correction effect under low signal to noise ratio, realize the phase compensation of corresponding data before demodulation and decoding and improve the receiving performance.

title_en: Channel State Information (CSI) reporting method, equipment and device
abstract_en: Receiving CSI reporting configuration information sent by network equipment, wherein the CSI reporting configuration information is associated with a plurality of reference signal resources; and based on the CSI reporting configuration information and the measurement results of the plurality of reference signal resources, sending CSI to the network equipment, wherein the CSI comprises a first number of reference signal resource indications and at least two first numbers of reference signal resource indications. The scheme of the application can improve the flexibility of CSI feedback.

title_en: Federal learning edge equipment training time delay optimizing system based on privacy protection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a federal learning edge equipment training time delay optimization system based on privacy protection, which belongs to the field of federal learning and privacy protection and comprises an edge equipment layer, a central server layer and a coordination layer, wherein the edge equipment layer, the central server layer and the coordination layer are connected through electric signals, the edge equipment layer collects, pre-processes data and encrypts and transmits the data to develop local training and privacy protection, the coordination layer is provided with task complexity, time delay and privacy overhead weight, the strategy is adjusted and the time delay is optimized according to a comprehensive objective function, the two layers are connected, and the central server layer decrypts, trains and aggregates the data to update a global model and feeds back the global model. The system initializes parameters first, then uses comprehensive balance dynamic sampling federal training algorithm, and carries out iterative training through equipment selection, local updating, strategy judgment, global parameter calculation and the like until reaching a preset round to obtain an optimal model. The invention solves the problems of privacy protection and time delay and improves the training efficiency and the data security.

title_en: Intelligent parking recommendation system for energy conservation
abstract_en: An intelligent parking recommendation system for vehicle energy conservation includes an intelligent parking recommendation application (SPRA) that determines that an enabling condition has been met and obtains information about the vehicle and vehicle environment from sensors and actuators of the vehicle. SPRA monitor information from the sensors and actuators, information obtained from remote computing resources, and current vehicle usage by the vehicle operator, determine a typical parking duration for the current parking location, and categorize the current parking location. SPRA utilize Artificial Intelligence (AI) or Machine Learning (ML) models to suggest parking spaces within a parking location that meet user and energy consumption passenger cabin thermal quality preferences. SPRA selectively park or direct the vehicle in a parking space that meets constraints and preferences and minimizes energy consumption to maintain the thermal quality of the passenger compartment and battery.

title_en: Vehicle system and vehicle based on optical communication
abstract_en: The application discloses a vehicle system based on optical communication and a vehicle, wherein the system comprises a center module and an edge module, the edge module comprises a photoelectric communication module and a vehicle terminal device electrically connected with the photoelectric communication module, the center module is electrically connected with the photoelectric communication module, and the photoelectric communication module is configured to perform photoelectric conversion processing and signal transmission on received electric signals so as to realize communication between the center module and the vehicle terminal. Therefore, the application can make interaction between the central module in the vehicle system and the vehicle terminal equipment in each edge module through optical signals, and avoid the problems of high time delay, low transmission rate and the like in the process of transmitting electric signal data to a certain extent, thereby guaranteeing the data transmission time delay and data transmission efficiency between the central module and the vehicle terminal equipment, better supporting the application scenarios with high real-time requirements such as vehicle information acquisition and analysis, vehicle and cloud platform data interaction and the like, and guaranteeing the use experience of users on the vehicles.

title_en: Communication method and related device
abstract_en: The application provides a communication method and a related device, which are applied to the technical field of communication. The method comprises receiving a first message, wherein the first message is used for indicating a first preamble sequence and/or a second preamble sequence, and transmitting the first preamble sequence or the second preamble sequence on a first random access resource, wherein the first random access resource is associated with a first preconfigured uplink resource PUR. The embodiment of the application can effectively ensure the probability of communication between the terminal and the network equipment.

title_en: Fusion encryption method, system, equipment and medium based on multiple encryption
abstract_en: The application discloses a fusion encryption method, system, equipment and medium based on multiple encryption, which comprises the steps of obtaining first encryption data, extracting the front end of data corresponding to the first encryption data to obtain a file type and a plurality of feature codes, determining the actual encryption times corresponding to the first encryption data based on the feature codes, if the actual encryption times are larger than a preset time threshold, matching the file type with a preset encryption coding table to determine a first encryption sequence, judging whether the first encryption data meets preset encryption sequence conditions according to the first encryption sequence, and if the first encryption sequence conditions are met, secondarily encrypting the data content in the first encryption data and updating the front end of the data to obtain second encryption data. The application can improve the safety of the power grid data.

title_en: Java Agent-based service vulnerability detection technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to a Java Agent-based service vulnerability detection technology, which relates to the technical field of service vulnerability detection, wherein a basic environment of Java Agent is set, an Agent class is created and used as a starting point of the Java Agent to allow modification of class byte codes, when the class is loaded, the Java Agent modifies the byte codes through a byte code operation library, security check logic is inserted at an inlet and an outlet of a target method to detect potential security vulnerabilities, when the security vulnerabilities are detected, related information including vulnerability types, vulnerability descriptions, triggering conditions, influence ranges and time stamps is automatically collected and recorded, the vulnerability types comprise injection vulnerabilities and authority vulnerabilities, and vulnerability detection reports are generated in an arrangement mode and provided for operation and maintenance teams so as to repair the vulnerabilities and optimize system security in time.

title_en: Intelligent analysis system and method for communication data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent analysis system and method for communication data, which relate to the technical field of data transmission, wherein the system comprises the steps of acquiring an intelligent household equipment list; the method comprises the steps of obtaining target household scene information interactively, carrying out equipment application analysis on the target household scene information to obtain a target application household equipment set, constructing a communication analysis cloud, carrying out matching mapping and resource analysis on a household equipment control model group to obtain a target equipment control model set, and carrying out communication control on the target application household equipment set based on a household equipment control parameter set. Solves the technical problems that the prior household equipment communication data analysis has insufficient data island and equipment compatibility, so that the user needs are difficult to be matched accurately, and the analysis processing of the communication data is not accurate, comprehensive and intelligent, the intelligent household device has the advantages that the comprehensive capture, intelligent analysis and accurate control of communication data among intelligent household devices are realized, and the technical effects of improving the analysis accuracy and the intellectualization of the communication data are achieved.

title_en: Cluster operation and maintenance instruction execution method, device, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a cluster operation and maintenance instruction execution method, a device, an electronic device and a storage medium, wherein the cluster operation and maintenance instruction execution method comprises the steps of receiving batch instruction information, carrying out parameter extraction on the batch instruction information to obtain basic parameters, a target device group and a routing strategy, carrying out instruction disassembly on the batch instruction information to obtain an atomic instruction based on the basic parameters and the target device group, creating an instruction queue, wherein each cluster device corresponds to a first index value of the instruction queue, calculating a second index value based on the routing strategy and the target device identifier, searching the instruction queue matched with the second index value based on the first index value in the instruction queue, distributing the atomic instruction to the instruction queue, generating a target configuration item based on the atomic instruction, issuing the target configuration item to the target device, and executing the atomic instruction by the target device. The application solves the problems of large cluster resource consumption and low instruction execution efficiency.

title_en: Data routing system and related method
abstract_en: The application discloses a data routing system for realizing data routing between computing nodes. The system includes a first topology network and a second topology network, the first topology network being nested within the second topology network. The network structure of the first topological network is an enhanced surrounding network topology structure formed by a first node group, and network nodes in the enhanced surrounding network topology structure have connection relations with upstream nodes, downstream nodes and non-adjacent nodes in each dimension respectively. The network structure of the second topology network is a fully interconnected network topology composed of the second group of nodes. The second node group includes a second number of first node groups, and a connection relationship exists between the second number of first node groups. The system builds a large-scale or super-large-scale network through nesting the hierarchical network structure of the enhanced surrounding network topology and the full-interconnection topology, thereby effectively reducing the network cost and the power consumption and improving the network expandability.

title_en: Method for scheduling honeycomb-free large-scale MIMO wireless resources
abstract_en: The invention discloses a honeycomb-free large-scale MIMO wireless resource scheduling method. The method comprises the steps of constructing a downlink non-cellular network, wherein N APs share M sub-bands, serving U single-antenna UE, the APs are connected to a CPU through a forward link, establishing an optimization model containing channel quality factor weighted spectrum efficiency according to user scheduling, sub-band allocation and power control of the APs in a time slot to maximize energy efficiency of the non-cellular network, predicting scheduling weight factors of the APs to different users by adopting a CNN-LSTM-Attention network model, and solving the optimization model based on the weight factors to obtain an optimal resource scheduling scheme. Compared with the prior art, the invention adopts the CNN-LSTM-Attention model to process the honeycomb-free large-scale MIMO network model data so as to obtain the pairing mode of the optimal access point and the user, and the pairing mode is fused into the calculation of the model through the weight factors, so that the model can be more accurately analyzed according to the importance or the demand degree of the user in the processing process.

title_en: Electronic device and method for wireless communication, computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to an electronic device and method for wireless communication, a computer readable storage medium. Wherein the electronic device for wireless communication comprises processing circuitry configured to receive at least one perception signal from a primary user via at least one equivalent channel established between the electronic device and the primary user corresponding to a direct channel between the primary user and the electronic device by means of at least one reconfigurable intelligent surface for determining whether the primary user occupies a predetermined frequency band used by the direct channel and the at least one equivalent channel.

title_en: Content pushing method, related device and medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a content pushing method, related device and medium. The method comprises the steps of determining a target object group to which a target object belongs, obtaining a first curve of the target object group relative to a target class, wherein the first curve indicates the change of the adhesiveness of an average single session object along with a first duty ratio, the first duty ratio is the duty ratio of the target class in a single session, determining a first integral curve of the first curve, determining a target point on the first integral curve, enabling the absolute value of a first difference of average curve values at two sides of the target point on the first integral curve to be maximum, and determining the content duty ratio of pushing the target class for the target object group based on the target point. The content pushing and optimizing method and device can improve content pushing accuracy after optimizing and simultaneously reduce content pushing and optimizing cost. The embodiment of the disclosure is applied to big data, data processing and the like.

title_en: Capability information reporting method, device, communication equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a capability information reporting method, a device, communication equipment and a medium, which belong to the technical field of communication; the terminal receives target WUS configuration information from the access network equipment, wherein the target WUS configuration information is related to WUS configuration information indicated by the capability information.

title_en: Method for determining the position of a transmitter
abstract_en: To determine the position of an emitter in an environment comprising at least one receiver, the present disclosure provides obtaining geometric information related to the environment representing a 3D model, receiving a signal at the receiver and measuring at least one angle of arrival "AoA" of the signal, and based on the measurements, calculating statistical properties of AoA, and using the 3D model and the statistical properties of AoA to obtain a path with respective associated weights, and using the path with associated weights to estimate the position of the emitter.

title_en: Image data transmission method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of electric digital data processing, in particular to a transmission method and a transmission system of image data, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring a preprocessing target image data set; the method includes preprocessing a target image data set, performing format conversion based on the target image data set, determining a conversion data set, performing timing synchronization based on the conversion data set, and performing transmission based on the synchronized image data. The application realizes real-time transmission of the intraoperative image data by carrying out time sequence processing and synchronous processing on the target data, greatly increases the accuracy of the intraoperative operation steps, realizes compatibility of different data formats, and improves the data universality in image transmission.

title_en: Method, device, terminal and equipment for determining information of synchronous signal block SSB
