abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, a terminal and equipment for determining information of a synchronous signal block SSB, which belong to the technical field of communication, and the method for determining the information of the synchronous signal block SSB comprises the following steps: the terminal determines at least one of information related to a transport block TB of a first SSB, which is an SSB extended based on a second SSB, and power information of the first SSB.

title_en: Dynamic route optimizing distribution method for satellite laser communication optical network
abstract_en: In satellite optical network systems, network routing is particularly important for improving network performance, because it can effectively utilize the inter-satellite laser link resources of the satellite optical network. Typically, the link cost of a particular inter-satellite link is represented by a time delay of the information. Because each node in the satellite optical network moves at a moment, the link cost of each inter-satellite link is changed at a moment, and a plurality of ring networks are formed by the multi-link mutually backup network topology structure, the factors of link distance, transmission delay, doppler effect and geographic position of a link satellite need to be comprehensively considered, and an optimal route (optimal optical path) is searched for a connection request of a source-target satellite node. By using the method and the device for constructing the satellite laser communication optical network multi-loop network virtual topological structure, the network topological structure can be made into a loop-free tree network topological structure, and broadcast storm, multi-frame copying and unstable address table caused by the multi-loop redundant link network topological structure can be avoided. Based on the method and the device, the optimal dedicated link can be rapidly assigned between the source-target user nodes in the satellite optical network system based on the link cost judgment mode, and the data transmission path can be automatically switched according to the state of the physical layer laser link, so that the problem of dynamic route allocation of the satellite laser communication optical network can be effectively solved.

title_en: Dynamic Sybil attack defense method and system in electric power carbon transaction blockchain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic defense method and a system for a witch attack in an electric power carbon transaction blockchain, which comprise system initialization, initializing blockchain network and model parameters, detecting the witch attack, preprocessing data, utilizing GAT and multi-scale parallel convolution technology to identify different node types by combining with AFF, evaluating node states, comprehensively scoring and grading the nodes according to various indexes such as detection results, dynamically responding, and executing main node election, malicious node isolation, victim node scoring compensation and conservative communication mode triggering according to evaluation results. According to the invention, attack detection and dynamic defense based on node state evaluation are combined, so that the accuracy of electric power carbon transaction blockchain Sybil attack detection is improved, the defensive capability of the electric power carbon transaction blockchain to Sybil attack is enhanced with higher malicious node rejection rate, and the electric power carbon transaction safety is ensured.

title_en: Electric power business data interaction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a power service data interaction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring target report information sent by each target communication terminal in a plurality of communication terminals according to a time slot window corresponding to each target communication terminal in a current target service period; the method comprises the steps of determining the terminal state of each communication terminal in a current target service period according to target report information sent by each target communication terminal, generating terminal state record information corresponding to the communication terminals in the current target service period based on the terminal state of each communication terminal, replying corresponding response information to each communication terminal based on the terminal state of each communication terminal in a response time slot window in the current target service period, and responding to a specified service request to a power master station according to the specified terminal state under the condition that the power master station receives the specified service request of the specified communication terminal issued in the current target service period.

title_en: Communication method, terminal device, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of terminals and provides a communication method, terminal equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method is applied to first equipment, and is used for receiving a first operation, wherein the first operation is used for starting distributed services; the method comprises the steps of responding to a first operation, displaying an icon of a second device, wherein the second device is found based on a short-distance communication mode and supports distributed service, short-distance connection and long-distance connection, responding to a second operation, determining current communication conditions, the second operation comprises an operation for selecting the icon of the second device, the second operation indicates the first device to share data with the second device, and when the current communication conditions do not meet the short-distance connection requirement, establishing first long-distance connection with the second device. The method can solve the problem that the number of concurrent connections of the equipment is limited.

title_en: Attack detection method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses an attack detection method, an attack detection device, attack detection equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of automobiles. The method comprises the steps of obtaining first message data received by a CAN in a first time period, wherein an end time node of the first time period is a current time, a start time node is a historical time which is spaced from the current time by a preset time length, determining message identification shannon entropy, data field relative entropy and time interval approximate entropy according to the first message data, carrying out weighted summation on the message identification shannon entropy, the data field relative entropy and the time interval approximate entropy through an attention mechanism to obtain a composite entropy characteristic, and determining whether the CAN is subjected to malicious attack in the first time period or not through a pre-trained anomaly detection model and the composite entropy characteristic. By the technical means, the stability of the message data is evaluated from three dimensions of message identification, byte distribution and message time sequence, so that whether malicious attacks are injected into the message data is effectively identified, and the accurate detection of the malicious attacks is realized.

title_en: Self-adaptive multi-client voice call method, system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a self-adaptive multi-client voice call method, a self-adaptive multi-client voice call system and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of starting a simple discovery protocol service, establishing a multicast communication SSDP service end, enabling a client to broadcast equipment information of the client according to an open system interconnection mode, judging whether the client has the same group in a manager by the SSDP service end through group identification, if so, establishing a TCP socket with the client according to a TCP service address and a port and other clients in the same group, storing the equipment information of the client in the manager, acquiring an input voice call by the client through an audio acquisition module, determining a plurality of other clients in the same group from the manager, simultaneously transmitting the voice call to the plurality of other clients in the same group, and playing audio by a call playing module to complete the voice call of the plurality of clients. The embodiment of the invention can increase the interactive clients at any time and has high stability. The application deployment cost is reduced, and the quality of call audio is improved.

title_en: Flood disaster state distributed sensing equipment and system for power equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of power equipment monitoring, and discloses flood disaster state distributed sensing equipment and a system. The equipment integrates a flood early warning and monitoring terminal, a liquid level/inclination angle/rainfall sensor and a camera device, is equal to a pole tower, acquires liquid level, inclination angle, rainfall and image data through multiple sensors, and uploads the liquid level, inclination angle, rainfall and image data to a central data center through a communication network after preprocessing. The main control board contains multiple communication module and realizes protocol conversion and edge calculation, and the protective housing staple bolt is installed and integrated inclination sensor, and level sensor is with PVC side's pipe protection of punching. The system adopts solar power supply and 4G communication to support distributed point distribution and risk partition encryption. The technical scheme solves the problems of poor real-time performance and single parameter in traditional monitoring, realizes multidimensional real-time monitoring, intelligent early warning and efficient operation and maintenance, and has the advantages of high precision, high reliability and easy deployment.

title_en: Automatic image generation in interactive systems
abstract_en: Examples disclosed herein describe techniques related to automatic image generation in an interactive system. An image generation request is received from a first user device associated with a first user of an interactive system. The image generation request includes a text prompt. In response to receiving the image generation request, an image is automatically generated by an automatic text-to-image generator based on the text prompt. Causing an image to be presented on the first user device. An indication of a user input for selecting an image is received from a user device. Responsive to receiving an indication of user input for selecting an image, the image is associated with a first user within the interactive system and a second user of the interactive system is enabled to be presented with the image.

title_en: Service processing method, device, electronic equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a business processing method, a business processing device, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a program product, and relates to the technical field of computer processing, in particular to the technical field of resource expansion and contraction. The method comprises the steps of obtaining configuration information of a service chain for processing target service under the condition that the first request quantity of the target service is in an abnormal state, wherein the service chain comprises a plurality of services, the configuration information comprises resource configuration information of the services, the resource configuration information represents the association relation between the configuration parameters of resources for running the services and the request parameters of the target service, expanding the resources of the services in the service chain based on the first request quantity and the configuration information to obtain a first updated service chain, and processing the target service by utilizing the first updated service chain.

title_en: Power consumption information acquisition network flow anomaly detection and system self-healing method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for detecting and self-healing a network flow abnormality during power consumption information acquisition, wherein the method comprises the steps of 1, data acquisition and preprocessing, 2, constructing an abnormality detection model, wherein the model comprises five modules, namely input data, an encoder, latent variable representation, a decoder and reconstruction output, 3, model training, 4, acquiring network flow abnormality detection, 5, abnormality confirmation, 6, self-healing strategy selection and execution, and 7, self-healing effect verification. The invention can improve the accuracy of the abnormal detection result, meet the real-time requirement of the collected network flow abnormal detection, dynamically adjust the self-healing strategy according to the latest environmental information, and realize the online updating and continuous optimization of the strategy.

title_en: Message forwarding method, communication node, communication system and related products
abstract_en: The application discloses a message forwarding method, a communication node, a communication system and related products, and belongs to the technical field of networks. The method is applied to first network equipment in a communication network, and comprises the steps of determining a plurality of first paths according to indication information carried by a data message to be forwarded, wherein the indication information indicates second network equipment for forwarding the data message last in the communication network, the first paths refer to message transmission paths from the first network equipment to the second network equipment, selecting a target path from the first paths according to global path congestion states respectively corresponding to the first paths, and the global path congestion states indicate global congestion conditions of the corresponding first paths, wherein the target path is used for forwarding the data message to the second network equipment. Therefore, when the first network equipment forwards the data message, the congestion condition of the whole message transmission path is comprehensively considered, and the accuracy of selecting the target path is improved.

title_en: Nuclear power plant DCS communication connection management method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a nuclear power plant DCS communication connection management method and a system, wherein the method can generate unified service codes according to service requests after acquiring the service requests sent by clients, inquire the network connection quantity of a target site based on the unified service codes, execute service behaviors according to the network connection quantity, and set the network connection state of the target site according to the service behaviors. The method can realize complete and effective lower computer communication network connection management, automatically complete management processes such as network connection counting, network connection registration, network connection cancellation and the like, reduce the management complexity of network connection, and reduce the application operation failure rate caused by abnormal network connection release so as to solve the problem that the DCS of the nuclear power plant is difficult to effectively manage various attribute members such as sites, clients, businesses and the like.

title_en: Mixed data transmission method, system, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a transmission method, a system, a storage medium and electronic equipment of mixed data, which relate to the technical field of data processing, and the mixed data receiving and transmitting processes of the batch data and the real-time data are completed by integrating batch and real-time data transmission interfaces and using the unified interfaces, so that the ambiguity problem generated by respectively receiving and transmitting the batch data and using different interfaces is avoided, and the consistency, the accuracy and the timeliness of the mixed data, such as the real-time data and the batch data in the transmission process are improved. In addition, the data acquisition configuration table is adjusted to realize the transmission and data retransmission of the historical batch data, and the data acquisition configuration table records the related information of data acquisition and transmission, so that the parameters and conditions in the data acquisition configuration table are modified, namely the transmission strategy of the mixed data is flexibly controlled, the processing of the historical data is included, and the flexibility of the real-time data and the batch data in the transmission process is improved.

title_en: Super-resolution video caching method for multi-user mobile edge computing network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a super-resolution video caching method for a multi-user mobile edge computing network, which comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic multi-granularity super-resolution model and a video caching model, wherein the dynamic multi-granularity super-resolution model is used for selecting the super-resolution model according to video block characteristics, the video caching model is used for determining the proportion of super-resolution pairs to the super-resolution tasks executed by users when video caching is carried out according to the current system state, the two models are trained and deployed to an edge server, when the users need to download videos, the edge server sends video requests to the edge server, the edge server determines video blocks and then invokes the dynamic multi-granularity super-resolution model to determine the adopted super-resolution model, invokes a video caching decision model to obtain actions of each user, and video caching and super-resolution computation are completed according to the actions. The invention realizes reasonable allocation of the cache resources of the edge server under the multi-user competition environment, and reduces video jamming and delay fluctuation of users.

title_en: Information processing method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses an information processing method, device and equipment, belonging to the technical field of communication, wherein the information processing method disclosed by the embodiment of the application comprises the following steps: the first communication device obtains first information from the second communication device; and the first communication equipment executes a first operation according to the first information, wherein the first operation is used for managing the local network, and the first communication equipment and the second communication equipment are network entities deployed in the local network.

title_en: Optical fiber network intelligent fixed inspection and fault closed loop processing system, method and equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent fixed inspection and fault closed-loop processing system, method and equipment for an optical fiber network, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance of optical fiber communication networks. The method comprises the steps of collecting and fusing multi-source heterogeneous data such as resource management, fault network management, distributed sensing and geographic information, analyzing the fused data by utilizing a multi-mode model based on a convolutional neural network and a graph neural network, realizing the meter-level accurate positioning of faults, adopting a long-period memory network model to dynamically optimize a fixed-check plan, automatically creating, circulating and associating fault lists, mode lists and maintenance lists based on analysis decision results, and realizing the whole-flow closed loop from diagnosis list dispatching to repair verification. By the aid of the scheme, the problems of data dispersion, single analysis dimension and lack of closed loops in the process in the prior art are solved, and the accuracy, efficiency and automation level of operation and maintenance of the optical fiber network are remarkably improved.

title_en: Communication method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a communication method, a device, equipment and a medium, which are used for paging a terminal. In the embodiment of the application, the first satellite base station can send the first request to the core network equipment, the first request can include first information, wherein the first information can include at least one access network identifier, and the access network identifier can be an access network identifier corresponding to an access network type supported by the first satellite base station, so that the core network equipment can determine a target satellite base station used by a paging terminal based on the first information and can send a paging request for the terminal to the target satellite base station, and the target satellite base station can page the terminal after receiving the paging request.

title_en: UEFI firmware updating method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a UEFI firmware updating method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the UEFI firmware updating method comprises the steps of responding to power-on operation, completing a starting sequence according to original UEFI firmware, and loading a network driver to establish network connection; the method comprises the steps of constructing a firmware update request data packet, broadcasting and sending the firmware update request data packet in a local area network, obtaining a unicast response packet returned by a firmware management server in the local area network, correspondingly generating the unicast response packet by the firmware management server according to the received load data in the firmware update request data packet, sending the unicast response packet to the computing device according to the address information, and completing firmware update according to the unicast response packet. The application can automatically complete the firmware update through the network.

title_en: Communication test method of vehicle-mounted Ethernet
abstract_en: The invention provides a communication test method of a vehicle-mounted Ethernet, which belongs to the technical field of vehicles and comprises the steps of configuring network parameters of a tested piece and an accompanying piece to enable the tested piece and the accompanying piece to conduct data interaction, recording a first message sent by the tested piece and a second message received by the accompanying piece, comparing the first message with the second message, and judging the communication state of the Ethernet. The invention judges whether the Ethernet communication state is normal or not and whether packet loss occurs or not based on the actual information by comparing the messages sent by the tested piece and received by the accompanying test piece.

title_en: Ammeter data copying method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to an ammeter data complement reading method which is applied to a concentrator terminal and comprises the steps of sending data reading instructions to all ammeter according to a preset physical address sequence when each preset meter reading period starts. If the effective collected data fed back by the ammeter is not received within the preset timeout threshold, a missing collecting queue is established according to ammeter information, data information and time information, and in the current meter reading period, after the current round of data collection is completed, the residual idle time of the current meter reading period and the estimated single meter reading time are calculated, and the data meter reading is carried out according to the residual idle time of the current meter reading period and the estimated single meter reading time. According to the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the data which are not successfully collected are subjected to the repeated reading by utilizing the current meter reading period and the residual time of the subsequent meter reading period, a repeated reading mechanism of the layered priority is provided, the timeliness and fairness of the repeated reading of the data are considered, and the loss risk of the data which are missed for a long time can be avoided.

title_en: Communication method, device, equipment, medium and product of voice interaction equipment
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of intelligent household appliances, and particularly relates to a communication method, a device, equipment, a medium and a product of voice interaction equipment. The method comprises the steps of receiving signal intensity information and sound intensity information sent by a wheat seat by a base, determining the distance between the base and the wheat seat according to the signal intensity information and the sound intensity information, scanning a channel of a preset communication frequency band between the base and the wheat seat under the condition that the distance between the base and the wheat seat is smaller than a distance threshold value, determining a channel with the smallest interference in the preset communication frequency band, and controlling the base to communicate with the wheat seat through the channel with the smallest interference. The method realizes the dynamic selection of the communication channel, ensures the stable communication between the base and the wheat seat, improves the stability and reliability of the communication between the base and the wheat seat, avoids the interference of other channels in the same frequency band, and improves the use experience of users.

title_en: Handling cell handover failure in wireless communications
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to handling cell handover failure in wireless communications. According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, a method performed by a communication apparatus adapted to operate in a wireless communication system comprises the steps of receiving a first configuration for a cell handover to a first cell and a second configuration for conditional mobility to a second cell, wherein the first configuration is included in a source cell configuration and the second configuration is related to an execution condition for the conditional mobility, applying the second configuration for the conditional mobility to the source cell configuration based on the execution condition being met, receiving a cell handover command for the first cell after the second configuration for the conditional mobility is applied, restoring to the source cell configuration prior to the application of the second configuration for the conditional mobility based on the received cell handover command, and applying the first configuration for the cell handover included in the restored source cell configuration.

title_en: Multi-dimensional evaluation and intelligent dynamic reconstruction method for segmented block chain nodes
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of block chain slicing, in particular to a multi-dimensional evaluation and intelligent dynamic reconstruction method of a sliced block chain node, which comprises the steps of constructing a double-layer sliced block chain architecture; the method comprises the steps of designing multidimensional evaluation to calculate node performance and reputation, adaptively executing slicing decisions based on system states, executing a node allocation optimization algorithm based on the performance and reputation scores of the nodes, adjusting the distribution of the nodes in the system, and balancing the performance and safety. The invention realizes the reconfiguration of the sliced block chain in the large-scale heterogeneous network by the design of the double-layer sliced architecture, the dynamic parameter optimization model and the multidimensional node evaluation mechanism. The designed multidimensional evaluation algorithm calculates the performance and reputation of the nodes, the fragmentation parameters are determined through a deep reinforcement learning algorithm, reasonable allocation of the nodes in the system is realized through optimizing the node distribution strategy, and finally, the long-term dynamic balance of throughput and safety in the reconfiguration process is achieved, so that the stability and the high efficiency of the fragmentation block chain system in a large-scale application scene are remarkably enhanced.

title_en: Method, terminal, network device, system and medium for activating low-power-consumption receiver
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method, terminal, network device, system and medium for activating a low power receiver. The method comprises the steps of receiving and measuring a reference signal sent by network equipment through a main receiver MR, obtaining a measurement result, and determining whether a low-power-consumption receiver LR is activated or not according to the measurement result and an offset, wherein the offset comprises a first offset generated due to the fact that the frequency domain positions of the reference signal and the low-power-consumption signal are different. In the method disclosed by the invention, the terminal can determine the time for activating the LR by utilizing the measurement result of the MR and the first offset, so that the accuracy of activating the LR in the different frequency scene is improved, and the MR energy-saving effect is improved while the LR receiving performance is ensured.

title_en: Arbitration-based computer-implemented transfer of resources
abstract_en: The described techniques and systems are capable of identifying a request to transfer one or more computer-implemented resources associated with a first computer-implemented account to a second computer-implemented account, the one or more computer-implemented resources being managed at least in part by a service selected to be accessible to at least one entity considering the request, the service being implemented separately from another service to manage access to the one or more computer-implemented resources. Further, the techniques and systems can confirm that the at least one entity approves the request to transfer the one or more computer-implemented resources associated with the first computer-implemented account and transfer the one or more computer-implemented resources to the second computer-implemented account.

title_en: Request processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a request processing method, a request processing device, request processing equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of extracting tenant identifications of received request information, determining service levels of tenants corresponding to the extracted tenant identifications, determining routing strategies of tenants corresponding to the tenant identifications through a monitoring configuration center, adding the tenant identifications as request heads to the request information, and sending the request information to corresponding servers. According to the technical scheme, the micro-service gateway extracts the tenant identification in the request information, determines the service level and the routing strategy of the tenant corresponding to the tenant identification, and routes the request information to the corresponding server according to the routing strategy, so that accurate routing of the request information according to the routing strategy of the tenant is realized, and the request processing efficiency is improved. And the number of the corresponding instances of the server is determined according to the service grade and the request number of the corresponding tenants of the server, so that the dynamic allocation of the resources is realized.

title_en: Grid data transmitting apparatus, grid data transmitting method, grid data receiving apparatus, and grid data receiving method
abstract_en: A method of transmitting mesh data according to an embodiment may include the steps of encoding mesh data and transmitting a bitstream including the mesh data. A method of receiving mesh data according to an embodiment may include the steps of receiving a bitstream including mesh data and decoding the mesh data.

title_en: Main control parasitic and movable liquid cooling CDU cluster control system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a liquid cooling CDU cluster control system with parasitic master control and mobility, which comprises a hardware layer, a functional layer and an interaction layer, wherein the hardware layer comprises CDU nodes and a distributed communication network, the CDU nodes form a CDU cluster, the functional layer comprises a master control module and a conflict detection module, the master control module is arranged on each CDU node, and the interaction layer comprises a human-computer interface. The invention also discloses a master control parasitic and movable liquid cooling CDU cluster control method. In the invention, the CDU cluster provides recooling and circulating power for the secondary side cooling medium, and the main control module of the host machine performs centralized control on the whole secondary side system through the executor based on the detection data of the detection sensor, the identification result of the conflict detection module and the control instruction input by the interaction layer. Because the main control module is arranged in each CDU node, special main control hardware is not required to be additionally arranged, the cost can be effectively reduced, and the occupation of the frame space is avoided.

title_en: Method for monitoring platform to send WeChat message
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for sending a WeChat message by a monitoring platform, which relates to the technical fields of computer science and software engineering and comprises the steps of constructing a multi-account credential pool, distributing a request through a weight polling algorithm, monitoring the call quantity of each account interface in real time, switching to a standby account and triggering a token cooling mechanism when the call frequency of a single account reaches a preset threshold, automatically generating WeChat interface permission configuration by adopting a declaration template based on an intelligent configuration engine, verifying legality through a configuration self-checking module, automatically triggering a domain name service provider API to finish recording update if the condition that a domain name is not recorded and a certificate is expired is detected, executing a key information extraction algorithm on an ultra-long text, identifying a monitoring index based on a BERT model, compressing the monitoring index to be within a WeChat limit length, generating a skip link, calling a GPU (graphic processing unit) to accelerate compression pipeline for picture data, and dynamically scaling the resolution to a preset size. The proposal solves the problems of frequency limitation, fussy authority configuration and message format constraint of the WeChat interface.

title_en: Radio frequency interference optimization method based on compliance constraint
abstract_en: The invention provides a radio frequency interference optimization method based on compliance constraint, which comprises the steps of obtaining broadband radio frequency signals, carrying out time-frequency analysis, identifying and extracting abnormal frequency points through calculating normalized abnormal scores of each frequency point in a time window to form an abnormal frequency point set, calculating track connection cost, constructing a frequency hopping track set according to the track connection cost, carrying out overall risk assessment and local high risk frequency band clipping on the frequency hopping track set based on frequency risk weight to obtain a compliance track set, evaluating the processing cost of each compliance track of the compliance track set according to available resources of a current system, screening out tracks executable in a current scheduling period to be used as an executable track set, and generating interference parameters according to the executable track set and the corresponding frequency index and abnormal scores. The invention solves the systematic defects of the prior art in terms of real-time performance, generalization performance, compliance performability and energy economy.

title_en: Bus transmission integrity checking circuit and method, bus system and communication system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bus transmission integrity checking circuit and method, a bus system and a communication system, and belongs to the technical field of communication. The circuit comprises an encoding module, a main decoding module, a slave decoding module and a comparison module, wherein the encoding module is arranged at a data sending end and used for encoding an upstream signal according to a check algorithm corresponding to the upstream signal transmitted on a bus to obtain a check code, the main decoding module is arranged at a data receiving end and used for decoding according to the upstream signal and the check code to obtain first check result information and generating a first fault signal according to the first check result information, the slave decoding module is arranged at the data receiving end and used for decoding in the same decoding mode as the main decoding module to obtain second check result information, and the comparison module is arranged at the data receiving end and used for generating a second fault signal according to the first check result information and the second check result information. The embodiment of the invention can realize the quick response of bus transmission integrity check and the saving of circuit area.

title_en: Network security automatic on-duty robot system based on AI drive
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AI-driven network security automatic on-duty robot system which comprises a behavior acquisition module, a mutation sensing module, a memory modeling module, a channel discrimination module, a strategy generation module and a feedback injection module, wherein the behavior acquisition module is used for acquiring multisource behavior data in a network operation environment to generate a gray region behavior set, the mutation sensing module is used for introducing an abnormal mutation sensing structure into an improved RWKV model to generate a mutation response vector, the memory modeling module is used for introducing a time sequence memory structure to generate a risk state representation, the channel discrimination module is used for constructing a behavior risk classification result and outputting a channel selection result, the strategy generation module is used for generating a treatment strategy instruction sequence to construct a treatment record and a behavior response vector, and the feedback injection module is used for introducing a strategy feedback injection structure to update the risk state representation to finish a network security on-duty response flow. The invention can realize continuous, intelligent and safe automatic guard oriented to complex network environment.

title_en: Display method and device for network switching, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a network switching display method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving initial flow data sent by router equipment in a first network, wherein the router is connected with a switch used for carrying out network switching on the first network and a second network, judging whether the switch triggers a switching event for switching the second network to the first network or not according to the initial flow data, and displaying the switching event on a display screen connected with a numerical control device when judging that the switch triggers the switching event for switching the second network to the first network. According to the embodiment of the invention, whether the switching event of the first network and the second network occurs or not is judged by analyzing the initial flow data sent by the router equipment, and further the switching event can be directly displayed on the display screen, so that a user can clearly perceive the switching event.

title_en: Supporting analysis for access gateway functions via network data analysis functions
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to supporting analysis for access gateway functions via network data analysis functions. The network device may establish a first interface with a service architecture (SBA) based network data analysis function (NWDAF) and may establish a second interface with a third generation partnership project (3 GPP) access device and a non-3 GPP access device. The network device may provide the definition of the analytics data generated by NWDAF to NWDAF and via the first interface, and may provide the raw data of the operating state of the SBA to NWDAF and via the first interface, such that NWDAF calculates analytics data based on the definition and the raw data of the operating state. The network device may receive analysis data from NWDAF via the first interface and may perform one or more actions based on the analysis data.

title_en: Multi-mechanism medical data collaborative modeling and intelligent generation method based on privacy protection
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-mechanism medical data collaborative modeling and intelligent generation method based on privacy protection, which relates to the technical field of privacy protection, and comprises solving the problem of characteristic isomerism through a cross-mechanism characteristic semantic mapping map, and constructing a hybrid coding data structure to perform hierarchical privacy protection, safely fusing the multiparty local feature representations by using a homomorphic encryption mechanism to generate a global representation, and distributing differential privacy budget based on feature sensitivity. The invention realizes the cooperative modeling of the multi-mechanism data security, and improves the model performance while guaranteeing the data privacy security.

title_en: Method, apparatus and computer program
abstract_en: There is provided an apparatus comprising means for providing an indication of resource allocation for a side chain at a first base station to at least one second base station via a core network entity, and means for receiving information related to resource allocation from the at least one second base station via the core network entity. The apparatus also includes means for determining another resource allocation for the sidelink based on the received information, and means for causing transmission of the another resource allocation such that the at least one second base station is notified of the another resource allocation.

title_en: BFD message sending method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a BFD message sending method and device, which relate to the technical field of communication, and are applied to network equipment; the method comprises the steps of traversing IP addresses in a first range in an IP address field configured by network equipment according to a set period, generating BFD messages by taking the IP addresses traversed each time as source IP addresses, selecting a target link from a plurality of equivalent links based on a five-tuple of the BFD messages generated each time if the network equipment and the next hop equipment have a plurality of equivalent links, sending the BFD messages generated each time to the next hop equipment through the target link, and sending the BFD messages generated each time to the next hop equipment through the links between the network equipment and the next hop equipment if the network equipment and the next hop equipment do not have a plurality of equivalent links. By the scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the occurrence of abnormal logic links based on BFD detection by network equipment can be avoided, and the service stability is improved.

title_en: Method and device for providing computing power service, computer program product and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method and an apparatus for providing a power service, a computer program product, and an electronic device, and relates to the technical field of wireless communication, where the method includes sending a power service request to a power distribution management system, and receiving a power service request response sent by the power distribution management system, where the power service request response includes a target distributed unit; and sending the data to the target distributed unit, and receiving a calculation result which is sent by the target distributed unit and corresponds to the data. The method reduces the process that the calculation data in the existing scheme must be transmitted to a centralized unit or a core network to carry out protocol processing and then execute calculation, and reduces the relevant time delay of the communication flow.

title_en: Personalized video creation method and system based on multi-mode AI
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image communication, in particular to a personalized video creation method and a system based on a multi-mode AI, comprising the following steps of receiving user intention input by a user; the method comprises the steps of carrying out deep analysis on user intention input by a user to obtain a structured video creation requirement, generating a video file by utilizing a large language model and a file generation algorithm based on the video creation requirement, carrying out intelligent matching and generation of multi-mode materials according to the video file to obtain a first video, automatically identifying voice of the first video, converting the voice of the first video into text, matching with a time stamp to generate a subtitle file synchronous with video content to obtain a second video, and carrying out evaluation and optimization on the second video to obtain a final video. According to the method, through the depth fusion multi-mode AI technology, one-key intelligent generation from user intention to personalized video content is realized, the video creation efficiency is greatly improved, the threshold is reduced, and the expression form of the video content is enriched.

title_en: Multi-specialty collaborative geotechnical engineering BIM intelligent management and control platform
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of BIM intelligent management and control platforms, and particularly relates to a multi-professional collaborative geotechnical engineering BIM intelligent management and control platform which comprises an acquisition and transmission structure and a main body structure, wherein the acquisition and transmission structure is electrically connected with the main body structure and is used for acquiring information on site and transmitting the information to the main body structure, the main body structure comprises an intelligent host, the acquisition and transmission structure comprises an upper shell and a lower shell, a plurality of plugging rods are fixed at the bottom of the inner side of the upper shell, a plurality of plugging pipes are fixed at the bottom of the inner side of the lower shell, the plugging rods are plugged into the plugging pipes, the upper shell and the lower shell are combined to form a mounting bin, and a central processor and a camera are assembled in the mounting bin. The invention can collect various information in real time and accurately on the geotechnical engineering site, and quickly transmit the information to the intelligent host in the main structure, the intelligent host integrates and processes the data, and the intelligent host combines with the BIM model to provide visual and accurate geotechnical engineering information for various professionals such as investigation, design, construction, monitoring and the like.

title_en: Method for efficiently transmitting FC-AE-1553 data based on coaxial cable
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for efficiently transmitting FC-AE-1553 data based on a coaxial cable, belongs to the technical field of FC-AE-1553 data transmission, and solves the problem of low communication efficiency of an FC-AE-1553 network system in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of encoding FC-AE-1553 information vectors based on an LDPC encoding method at a network transmitting end node to obtain FC-AE-1553 codeword information, transmitting the FC-AE-1553 codeword information to a network receiving end node through a coaxial cable, dynamically adjusting transmission rate and transmission power according to network load and error rate monitored in real time in the transmission process, and decoding the FC-AE-1553 codeword information based on an LDPC decoding method at the network receiving end node to obtain FC-AE-1553 information vectors. And the communication efficiency of the FC-AE-1553 network system is improved.

title_en: Service scheduling method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a service scheduling method, electronic equipment and a storage medium, belonging to the technical field of communication, wherein the method comprises the steps of deconstructing a target service into a plurality of micro services; determining an algorithm network infrastructure corresponding to each micro service and a forwarding path between the algorithm network infrastructures according to preset conditions, wherein the preset conditions comprise, but are not limited to, a target service scheduling strategy, scheduling constraints of a plurality of micro services, information of the algorithm network infrastructures and network infrastructure capability, generating an application service link routing table according to the algorithm network infrastructures corresponding to each micro service and the forwarding path of the algorithm network infrastructures, wherein the service application service link routing table comprises a mapping relation between a micro service link and each micro service, the micro service link comprises a plurality of micro services, the micro service link is used for providing the target service, and issuing the application service link routing table to the algorithm network infrastructures so that the algorithm network infrastructures schedule traffic of the plurality of micro services according to the application service link routing table.

title_en: Universal integrated fusion system, index determination method, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application provides a sense-of-general integrated fusion system, an index determining method, electronic equipment and a medium, and relates to the technical field of communication, wherein the sense-of-general integrated fusion system comprises a fusion base station, a preset terminal and a fusion server, the fusion base station is provided with a passive internet of things module, and the preset terminal is provided with an RFID tag; the fusion base station is used for sending a first signal and receiving a second signal through the passive-connected-with-things module, the first signal comprises a first sensing signal and an RFID (radio frequency identification) excitation signal, the RFID excitation signal multiplexes the waveform and time slot resources of the first sensing signal, the second signal comprises a second sensing signal after the first sensing signal is reflected by a preset terminal and an RFID uplink signal after the RFID excitation signal is backscattered by an RFID tag, and the fusion server is used for carrying out fusion calculation according to the received second sensing signal and the received RFID uplink signal so as to determine the sensing performance index. The system perception performance can be evaluated more comprehensively and accurately, and the accuracy of the perception performance index is improved.

title_en: Method and apparatus for rate adaptation for packet traffic employing variable codecs
abstract_en: Embodiments relate to a method and apparatus for code rate adaptation of packet traffic employing a variable codec for a User Equipment (UE) in communication with a network. In particular, embodiments relate to transmitting a Recommended Bit Rate (RBR) to a network to pre-schedule transmission of primary packets, transmitting a UE Assistance Information (UAI) delay budget report to configure a connected mode discontinuous reception (CDRX) period, and transmitting a Buffer Status Report (BSR) to the network to schedule transmission of remaining packets for dynamic scheduling after the RBR is insufficient.

title_en: TELEMETRY protocol based real time Log analysis method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time log analysis method and device based on TELEMETRY protocol, which comprises the steps of receiving analysis service at a remote network management server deployment TELEMETRY, receiving and analyzing device positioning logs, enabling the device to not store log files, enabling data encapsulation between router devices and servers to use GPB format codes and transmit the data through the protocol, configuring TELEMETRY clients at the router devices, enabling a large number of scenes to be assigned with sensor-path and keys for collecting logs, enabling distributed devices to span scenes of multiple single boards, enabling the distributed devices to be assigned with multiple keys, configuring TELEMETRY clients to upload periods at the router devices, and enabling log data to be reported to the remote server in a large number. The invention can upload log information to a remote server, monitor specific data by designating a sensor-path, grasp data change in a very short time by configuring a very small uploading period, and deploy a data visualization and analysis tool at the remote server to assist in analyzing the log information.

title_en: Lightweight wisdom distribution substation gateway marginal equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a lightweight intelligent substation gateway edge device, relates to the technical field of intelligent gateways, and in order to solve the problems mentioned in the technical proposal, the embodiment of the application provides a lightweight intelligent substation gateway edge device which comprises an intelligent gateway, the intelligent gateway upper surface is provided with a heat dissipation auditing board, one side of the intelligent gateway is provided with a wireless transmission module, the other side of the intelligent gateway is provided with a connection module, and the lightweight intelligent substation gateway edge equipment also comprises a low-frequency quick-release prevention adjusting mechanism and a stretch-breaking prevention mechanism; according to the scheme, the novel design of the low-frequency quick-release prevention adjusting mechanism and the stretch-breaking prevention mechanism is adopted for the gateway edge equipment of the lightweight intelligent power distribution station, so that various pain points of the traditional gateway equipment in the power distribution station application are effectively solved, the requirements of intelligent upgrading of the power distribution station on efficient, stable and reliable gateway equipment are met, and the intelligent power distribution station gateway has wide popularization and application values.

title_en: Automatic switching device for train dispatching main and standby train platform antennas and implementation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic switching device for a train dispatching main and standby train platform antenna and an implementation method thereof. The device comprises a radio frequency interface, a radio frequency switch, a directional coupler, a detector, a microcontroller and an LED indicator lamp, wherein the radio frequency interface I is connected with an antenna, the radio frequency interfaces II and III are respectively connected with a main station platform and a standby station platform, and the radio frequency switch realizes automatic switching between the antenna and the main station platform and the standby station platform under the control of the microcontroller. The directional coupler and the detector are used for collecting forward power and reverse power of the transmitted signal, and the microcontroller calculates standing wave ratio according to the detection voltage and carries out threshold judgment. The method comprises the steps that a default antenna is communicated with a main station after the device is electrified, the main station is automatically switched to when a signal transmitted by a standby station is detected to meet a threshold, and if the signal of the standby station is insufficient, the main station is kept working, and indication and alarm are carried out through an LED. The device realizes the rapid automatic switching between the main station and the standby station, reduces the communication interruption time, and effectively improves the reliability and the operation and maintenance automation level of the communication system.

title_en: Network traffic multi-level safety protection model, system, method, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a network traffic multi-level safety protection model, a system, a method, equipment and a medium. According to the method, a plurality of modularized atomization protection points are constructed through a predefined eBPF program library, and network management and control capabilities such as matching, speed limiting and state observation are achieved. In the system initialization stage, a data plane architecture containing a plurality of kernel execution layer distributor programs is constructed, and the persistence of the programs and resource maps is realized through pin operation. The SDK module receives the declarative network security policy, the policy control module analyzes the declarative network security policy to generate configuration parameters, and the user mode module loads eBPF programs according to the configuration parameters and mounts the configuration parameters to the kernel execution layer. The network flow triggers the protection point according to the path, outputs the observed data, and the state aggregation submodule aggregates the data according to the strategy and feeds back information to the upper layer application. Therefore, the flexible deployment of the protection points and the dynamic driving of the strategies can be realized, and the system has good expandability and response capability.

title_en: Multi-mode large model-based multimedia file generation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode large model-based multimedia file generation method, which relates to the technical field of education content generation and sequentially completes task alignment and evidence readiness, problem analysis and problem solving track diagram construction, compiling into unified instructions of a mirror-dividing whiteboard and bystanders, controlled generation and generation co-optimization, posterior judgment, traceable release and learning write-back, wherein the problem solving track diagram is used as a unique true source in the scheme, semantic structures which can be used as questions are mapped into shots, books and mouth-casts, the targets of the proper ages and cognitive load are synchronously restrained, the fact and safety scores are calculated according to the shots in the generation stage, local regeneration is triggered, the whole-section rework is reduced, source credential is written before release, and the viewing and evaluation write-back learning conditions are combined to form a correct, proper age, self-evolutionable closed loop. The unified number is communicated with the input, the processing and the output, the fixed-point rollback and the spot check are supported, the uncertainty and the cost are reduced, and the distribution and the home check are convenient.

title_en: Random access reporting method and user equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a random access reporting method and user equipment. The random access reporting method comprises the steps that User Equipment (UE) executes a Random Access (RA) process, judges that the random access process is completed, and stores Small Data Transmission (SDT) information in an RA report, wherein the random access process is judged to be used for SDT, the random access process is initiated in a four-step mode by setting a random access type, the UE sets first RA information as a downlink signal quality value acquired when the random access process is initiated, or sets third RA information as the data size in an uplink cache when the random access process is initiated.

title_en: MIPI C-PHY eye diagram simulation method, computer equipment, program product and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an MIPI C-PHY eye diagram simulation method, computer equipment, a program product and a storage medium, which comprise the steps of generating three-phase mapping codes of three ports of a transmitting end A, B, C according to NRZ code type signals generated by the transmitting end, generating transmitting end output waveforms according to the three-phase mapping codes to obtain single-edge response signals of a single-end receiving end A, B, C, obtaining first waveforms of the single-end receiving end A, B, C by overlapping the single-edge response signals bit by bit, obtaining second waveforms of differential receiving ends AB, BC and CA according to the first waveforms, and generating a traditional eye diagram and a trigger eye diagram based on the second waveforms of the differential receiving ends AB, BC and CA. The scheme can be suitable for the eye diagram simulation of the MIPI C-PHY, so that the eye diagram of the MIPI C-PHY can be estimated efficiently and accurately.

title_en: Screen throwing control method and device and sound box with screen
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of screen projection, and particularly discloses a screen projection control method and device and a screen-carried sound box, which are used for solving the problems that a fixed mirror image display mode is adopted in the prior art, namely, the display screen of the sound box and the display capacity of external display equipment are completely synchronous, but when the external display equipment is plugged in and plugged out in the video playing process, the current playing state of the sound box cannot be automatically identified, the video is required to be restarted manually, and the user experience is poor. The method comprises the steps of determining whether the sound box with the screen is in a video playing state when the fact that the external display device is connected with the sound box with the screen through the multimedia interface is determined, creating a presentation interface associated with a player corresponding to the display device if the sound box with the screen is in the video playing state, displaying video pictures corresponding to the video playing state in the presentation interface, and controlling the player to display the video pictures, wherein display contents corresponding to the display device and the sound box with the screen are the same or different.

title_en: Resource information correction method and system for passive optical network equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for correcting resource information of a passive optical network device, which belong to the technical field of communication network resource management, and comprise the steps of acquiring a unique identifier associated with an optical network unit after responding to failure of activation of the optical network unit, wherein the optical network unit is accessed to a network through the passive optical network device; the method comprises the steps of acquiring alarm information generated by unregistered states of optical network units from a network management system based on a unique identifier, extracting actual connection information of the optical network units from the alarm information, and updating resource information corresponding to passive optical network equipment in a resource management system based on the actual connection information. When the activation of the optical network unit fails, the invention reversely acquires the real uplink connection information from the alarm information of the network management system by utilizing the unique identifier thereof, and automatically writes back and updates the error data in the resource management system, thereby realizing the automatic correction of the dummy resource information such as the passive optical network equipment and further improving the maintenance efficiency.

title_en: Positioning integrated method for underwater acoustic signal communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater acoustic signal communication positioning integrated method. The existing method does not jointly consider the problem of channel resource occupation caused by communication and positioning integration. The method uses mutually orthogonal Chirp subcarriers as communication signals and long Chirp signals as pilot frequencies, and the pilot frequencies and the communication signals are transmitted together in a superimposed manner at a sender, so that extra channel expenditure caused by externally adding the pilot frequencies is saved, and the signal transmission time interval is shortened. The receiver uses multiple pilot signals to perform joint Doppler estimation and compensation and arrival time estimation, and the result of the arrival time estimation is used for a positioning system on one hand and a communication system on the other hand. The demodulation mode is to use different Chirp subcarriers to perform correlation calculation and perform symbol demodulation according to the correlation value. The communication positioning integrated waveform design method adopted by the invention can shorten the signal transmission time interval, can reduce the complexity of the system and has good communication performance.

title_en: Message processing method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a message processing method, a device and a storage medium, which comprise that a network processor receives a data message, if a message outer VLAN field is 1, the data message is considered to be a first type message received from a first type interface board, a first port attribute table is checked to perform relevant service processing, if the message outer VLAN field is 2, a second type message received from a second type interface board is considered to be a second type message, cha Di two port attribute tables are used to perform relevant service processing, and if the message outer VLAN field is 3, a third type message received from a third type interface board is considered to be a third port attribute table is checked to perform relevant service processing. The invention has the advantages that the network processor directly decides which type of port attribute table to check according to the outer VLAN field in the message, the table entry of the interface board type is obtained at one time by less checking, the message forwarding performance is improved, and the code instruction space of the network processor is saved.

title_en: VPN device communication method and device, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of computer network communication, and particularly discloses a VPN device communication method, a device, an electronic device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of adding a plurality of pre-established VPN device clusters into a pre-established logic communication domain; the method comprises the steps of configuring a network structure of the logic communication domain, generating a communication strategy based on the network structure, and establishing bidirectional communication among the plurality of pre-established VPN device clusters based on the communication strategy. The method can greatly reduce configuration complexity and workload, improve configuration efficiency, improve network reliability and reduce security risk.

title_en: Implementation method of LTE-TETRA interconnection gateway for subway
abstract_en: A LTE-TETRA interconnection gateway and an implementation method for a subway belong to the field of rail transit communication equipment, and comprise a power supply module, a main control circuit, a TETRA channel machine I, TETRA channel machine II, an antenna I and an antenna II, wherein the power supply module supplies power to the main control circuit, the TETRA channel machine I and the TETRA channel machine II, the main control circuit is respectively connected with the TETRA channel machine I and the TETRA channel machine II, the TETRA channel machine I is connected with the antenna I, the TETRA channel machine II is connected with the antenna II, the main control circuit is used for AT command interaction, SIP signaling analysis and audio processing with the TETRA channel machine I and the TETRA channel machine II, the TETRA channel machine I and the TETRA channel machine II are used for narrowband communication, interconnection of an LTE broadband and a TETRA narrowband can be realized, and communication stability and equipment operability under a complex environment are ensured.

title_en: Abnormal root cause analysis method for distributed batch test results
abstract_en: The application discloses a distributed batch test result abnormal root cause analysis method which comprises the steps of 1, generating an abnormal characteristic fingerprint library of distributed test nodes based on online real flow playback data recorded by a AREX platform, 2, constructing an abnormal propagation dependence spectrum among the test nodes according to the abnormal characteristic fingerprint library, 3, carrying out multidimensional association analysis on the abnormal propagation dependence spectrum through a time sequence sliding window to generate a root cause tracing path, 4, carrying out reverse parameter deduction based on the root cause tracing path, positioning a core parameter combination triggered by the abnormality, 5, generating a verification case according to the core parameter combination, and carrying out closed loop verification in a playback environment to confirm the root cause. The scheme relieves the defects of the traditional technology in the aspects of exception propagation association, source positioning, parameter locking and result verification, and meets the requirements of the scene on the analysis efficiency and reliability of the exception root cause.

title_en: Trusted data space low-delay interaction platform integrating edge calculation
abstract_en: The application discloses a trusted data space low-delay interaction platform integrating edge computing, which relates to the technical field of edge computing and comprises the steps of constructing a hierarchical trusted execution environment in a target edge computing network based on a preset trusted execution environment layering rule, constructing a device collaborative relationship map of the target edge computing network, dividing the device collaborative relationship map into a plurality of real-time grades, configuring a differentiated key pre-allocation strategy for each real-time grade, screening network nodes by double nodes based on behavior characteristic pre-screening and real-time connection performance evaluation, determining federal learning participation nodes and acquiring an elastic federal learning scheme, and executing low-delay interaction management by cooperatively integrating the hierarchical trusted execution environment, the differentiated key pre-allocation strategy and the elastic federal learning scheme. The method solves the problems that the prior art cannot effectively meet the low delay requirement and the safety of data interaction in the edge computing network.

title_en: Remote area Internet of vehicles task unloading method and device based on high-altitude platform assistance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of Internet of vehicles communication and calculation, in particular to a remote area Internet of vehicles task unloading method and device based on the assistance of a high-altitude platform, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a vehicle connection judgment model based on the high-altitude platform and an edge server, acquiring the position of a vehicle, judging whether the vehicle is connected to the edge server or the high-altitude platform or not; the method comprises the steps of constructing a communication model, a time delay model and an energy consumption model, calculating the unloading transmission rate, the total time delay of a task and the total energy consumption of the task according to the communication model, the time delay model and the energy consumption model and the connection judgment result, constructing an optimization objective function according to the time delay model and the energy consumption model, modeling a task unloading problem as a Markov decision process, training by adopting a MAPPO algorithm, outputting a task unloading strategy, and providing a solution for the problem of limited task unloading and high time delay of the Internet of vehicles in a remote area.

title_en: Pathological image feature extraction model construction method, feature extraction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a pathological image feature extraction model construction method, a feature extraction method and a system, wherein the construction method comprises the steps that a server sends current global parameters of a global student model to clients, the clients conduct distillation training on the local student model based on local unlabeled sample images to obtain current local parameters of the local student model, key layers are determined from the parameter layers based on parameter updating amounts of parameter layers between the global parameters and the local parameters, the parameter updating amounts of the key layers are compressed and uploaded to the server, the server aggregates the parameter updating amounts uploaded by the clients, the current global parameters of the global student model are iteratively updated based on aggregation results, global distillation is conducted to obtain updated global teacher models, and the final global teacher models are used as pathological image feature extraction models until the global student models complete training. The method and the system provided by the invention greatly reduce the communication data volume between the client and the server.

title_en: Multi-agent system differential privacy consistency control method for replay attack
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of distributed control of multi-intelligent system, and discloses a replay attack-oriented multi-intelligent system differential privacy consistency control method which effectively overcomes the defects of the existing method in the aspect of privacy protection and can provide stronger privacy protection capability. The key idea is that the real data are not transmitted among the agents, but disturbance data added with privacy protection noise are transmitted, so that a malicious attacker cannot acquire the real data, and the privacy protection effect is achieved. In addition, in order to resist replay attack, the method of the invention also couples the disturbance data to be transmitted with the secret key before the disturbance data is transmitted so as to realize the purpose of replay attack detection. In addition, the method also realizes privacy protection effect and mean square asymptotic consistency under the condition of ensuring that the noise variance is allowed to be increased through time-varying step length design based on a random approximation method.

title_en: Low-altitude aircraft-based base station investigation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a base station investigation method, device and equipment based on a low-altitude aircraft and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the steps of generating an optimal survey route of a low-altitude aircraft according to geographic position information of a base station, controlling the low-altitude aircraft to fly based on the optimal survey route, collecting visual images, infrared thermal imaging data, point cloud data and radio frequency signals of the base station in the flying process, identifying each device of the base station according to the visual images and the infrared thermal imaging data of the base station, analyzing whether each device of the base station has heating abnormality according to the infrared thermal imaging data corresponding to each device, positioning and analyzing interference sources of the base station according to the visual images, the point cloud data and the radio frequency signals of the base station, and obtaining survey results of the base station based on the interference source positioning analysis results and the heating abnormality analysis results. The application can improve the reliability of the investigation result of the base station and the investigation efficiency.

title_en: Block chain intelligent contract method and system based on secret state
