abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of blockchain technology, information safety and privacy calculation, and provides a blockchain intelligent contract method and system based on a secret state, aiming at the problem that the existing blockchain transaction scheme cannot give consideration to privacy, auditability and execution efficiency, wherein the system comprises an on-chain component and an off-chain high-performance decryption node; the on-chain component is an intelligent contract deployed on the blockchain network, the intelligent contract is used for issuing proposal and Paillier public keys and homomorphically aggregating a plurality of encrypted transaction data to obtain an encrypted transaction result, and the off-chain high-performance decryption node is used for acquiring the encrypted transaction result from the intelligent contract, decrypting the encrypted transaction result and returning the decrypted plaintext to the intelligent contract. The invention can ensure the decentralization trust through the mixed architecture of the coordination on the chain and the computation under the chain, and simultaneously solves the performance and availability bottleneck of the homomorphic encryption scheme in the practical application.

title_en: Traffic association method, apparatus, network device, storage medium, and program product
abstract_en: The application relates to a flow association method, a device, network equipment, a storage medium and a program product, which relate to the technical field of network technology and security and can effectively avoid invalid ticket generation caused by ticket data deletion. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of associated information according to signaling surface traffic corresponding to a user session, wherein the associated information comprises first channel information representing a traffic transmission channel, the traffic transmission channel is used for the user surface traffic, responding to updating of associated records in a memory, resetting the duration time of the associated records according to the updating period of the associated records, wherein the associated records are used for bearing the associated information, the duration time is effective reserved time length of the associated records in the memory since the associated records are written into the memory, and determining target associated information in the reserved associated information of the memory according to comparison of second channel information carried by the user surface traffic and the first channel information, and associating the target associated information and the user surface traffic to obtain an application detail record ticket.

title_en: Multi-person offline conference record generation method and device based on voice recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for generating a multi-person offline conference record based on voice recognition, wherein the method comprises the steps that a terminal creates conference room associated radio equipment; the conference participants and the microphone are bound one by one to realize directional radio, the model is called to identify and synchronize to the terminal, and a report of the exportable results is generated after the conference is finished. The method constructs a unique mapping of conference room-radio equipment-conference participants through a hardware multi-level binding mechanism, solves the problems of difficult multi-path voice distinguishing and inaccurate speaker identity association in the prior art from a physical layer, particularly can accurately distinguish various paths of voices by means of a hardware exclusive identification and directional radio when a plurality of people speak simultaneously, avoids confusion, ensures high interference resistance, stable transmission and multi-channel parallel conflict-free performance by adopting UHF protocol transmission by radio equipment, ensures complete and accurate data, realizes time synchronization by means of a jitter buffer, ensures continuity of recording logic, and greatly improves conference recording value and execution efficiency by full-process automation.

title_en: Live stream management method, device, equipment, medium and program product
abstract_en: The application provides a live stream management method, a live stream management device, live stream management equipment, live stream management media and a live stream management program product. The method for managing the live broadcast stream in the application comprises the steps of receiving a live broadcast service attribute configuration request sent by a user, wherein the live broadcast service attribute configuration request comprises a live broadcast site identifier and a live broadcast service attribute label, determining a live broadcast service function dimension to which the live broadcast service attribute label belongs, dynamically configuring the live broadcast service attribute label for the live broadcast stream in the live broadcast site corresponding to the live broadcast site identifier based on the live broadcast service function dimension, determining a node capacity label corresponding to the live broadcast service attribute label, and sending the live broadcast stream configured with the live broadcast service attribute label to a node configured with the node capacity label. The implementation mode solves the problems of confusion and functional conflict of live service attribute management in the traditional architecture, and ensures the stability and the resource utilization efficiency of a live link through accurate node matching and dynamic scheduling.

title_en: Resource allocation method, apparatus, device, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resource allocation method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a program product, wherein when a resource request which is sent by a cloud platform and carries identification information of tenants and the required number of computing power processing units is received, a resource allocation record of each tenant is inquired according to the identification information, when no allocation record is inquired, a first virtual local area network and a corresponding first parameter surface network segment are allocated for each tenant, a protocol address of each first parameter surface network segment is allocated, tenant rules are arranged based on the allocated resource information of each tenant, wherein the tenant rules comprise isolation rules among different tenants and resource intercommunication rules of the same tenant, and the tenant rules are sent to a switch to instruct the switch to execute the tenant rules. By adopting the embodiment of the invention, the tenant isolation can be realized when resources are allocated to the tenant, and the data leakage is prevented.

title_en: Method, system and storage medium for managing and using extremely simple two-dimension code driven certificates by mobile application to replace UKEY
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of information security and discloses a method for managing and using a very simple two-dimension code driving certificate by replacing UKEY with mobile application, which comprises the following steps of S1, generating a very simple two-dimension code, S2, managing session records, wherein the server generates a two-dimension code only comprising a temporary authorized access address, and the server establishes and stores and uses the very simple two-dimension code in a state The method comprises the steps of uniquely corresponding token record, S3, request and response, wherein the mobile application end scans and analyzes the two-dimensional code, the server end returns an operation instruction and a minimum parameter set to the mobile application end, and S4, certificate installation and service operation, wherein the mobile application end executes certificate installation or service operation according to the operation instruction. The invention can complete the whole process from certificate installation to business operation by the code scanning of the mobile phone App by a user, has extremely short operation path, eliminates the complicated login and session management of the traditional App by the stateless design of the mobile application, and realizes the light-weight experience of the mobile application.

title_en: Method and system for detecting port forbidden state of network equipment and automatically joint debugging
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of network equipment management, and particularly discloses a method and a system for detecting a port forbidden state of network equipment and automatically joint debugging. The port physical blocking state is sensed in real time through the special detection cable and the microcontroller, meanwhile, the logic configuration state is collected through the network management protocol, and real-time comparison is carried out according to the pre-established port mapping relation and the consistency judging model. When the abnormal ports with inconsistent states are identified, the system can automatically trigger a differential joint debugging strategy, wherein if the physical is not blocked and the logic is opened, the port is automatically closed by a command, and if the physical is blocked and the logic is closed, a report is generated to prompt manual checking. And particularly, high-priority real-time warning is carried out on the event of which the physical seal is abnormally relieved, so that the full-flow automatic operation and maintenance from state sensing, intelligent research and judgment to automatic treatment is realized, and the management and control efficiency and reliability of a network safety boundary are obviously improved.

title_en: Wireless network scanning method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a wireless network scanning method, a device, equipment and a medium, and relates to the technical field of wireless communication. The wireless network scanning method comprises the steps of executing background scanning tasks to scan wireless network signals every first preset time, responding to a first scanning instruction received between a first time and a second time, and sending background scanning results obtained by executing the background scanning tasks at the first time to a user terminal for display after the second preset time, wherein the first time and the second time are starting time of two adjacent background scanning tasks, and the second preset time is smaller than the first preset time. The application reduces the waiting time of the user and improves the operation experience of the user.

title_en: Electromagnetic transient real-time simulation data transmission method, system and device
abstract_en: The application relates to a data transmission method, a system and a device for electromagnetic transient real-time simulation, which are characterized in that affine time base parameters and sub-time slot gating are introduced, the transmission time is precisely controlled from the source, a sliding window delay locking ring is adopted to carry out closed loop shaping on the time error of received data, the data release time is strictly locked at a preset time, the influence of transmission jitter on the data is thoroughly eliminated, the stability and the self-adaption of the data transmission are improved, the data blank can be intelligently filled, the accuracy of the data transmission is improved, the quality of the data transmission is ensured, the online self-calibration function is realized through the jitter fingerprint, the data transmission cannot be attenuated along with the environmental change, the long-term optimal deterministic state is maintained, and the technical problems of uncertain data transmission, poor quality and poor self-adaption of the real-time simulation data packet transmission technology of the existing power system are solved.

title_en: Method for calculating performance parameters of fluid network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for calculating performance parameters of a fluid network, and belongs to the technical field of computational fluid mechanics. The method comprises the steps of sequentially numbering nodes and units in a network, sequentially placing numbers of low-number nodes at two ends of each network unit in an affiliated node array, placing numbers of high-number nodes in an adjacent node array to construct a topological structure of a fluid network, setting boundary conditions based on performance parameters of known network nodes and network units, describing a relation between the performance parameters of the network units and the performance parameters of the network nodes connected with the network units through an empirical formula to obtain an equation set, and solving the equation set or carrying out iterative solution to obtain the performance parameters of all the network nodes and all the network units. The method is based on a unit connection matrix and a node connection matrix, determines a belonged node and an adjacent node for each network unit, and further constructs a belonged node array and an adjacent node array of the fluid network for describing a network topology structure.

title_en: Vehicle OTA upgrading progress calculation method and system and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle OTA upgrading progress calculation method, a system and a vehicle, wherein the vehicle OTA upgrading progress calculation method is executed by a vehicle end of the vehicle, upgrading task metadata of an upgrading task from a cloud end is received, a plurality of upgrading groups and execution sequences thereof are determined based on the upgrading task metadata, group duration of each upgrading group is calculated, the proportion of each group duration in total estimated duration is calculated, the plurality of upgrading groups are sequentially executed according to the execution sequences, in the upgrading process, the intra-group real-time progress of each upgrading group is calculated according to the real-time installation progress of each electronic control unit in the currently executed upgrading group, the vehicle OTA upgrading progress is calculated according to the corresponding proportion of the currently executed upgrading group and the intra-group real-time progress, the upgrading process is divided into a plurality of stages and groups, and total progress weights are distributed according to the actual time consumption proportion of each group, so that progress bar propelling is highly matched with real time consumption, and smoother and more predictable progress feedback is facilitated.

title_en: Image pickup apparatus, system, adapter, control method, storage medium, and computer program product
abstract_en: Provided are an image pickup apparatus, a system, an adapter, a control method, a storage medium, and a computer program product. The image pickup apparatus has a first contact unit and a second contact unit. The first communication unit performs first communication via the first contact unit. The second communication unit performs second communication via the first contact unit. The detection unit detects a voltage of the second contact unit after a corresponding one of the plurality of accessories has been connected. In the case where the detected voltage of the second contact unit satisfies the first condition, control is performed to start the second communication. The predetermined adapter is configured to supply a voltage satisfying a first condition to the second contact unit in a case of being connected to the image pickup apparatus.

title_en: Method and apparatus for selecting operation modes with different repetition modes for low power consumption wake-up signals in a wireless communication system
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to methods and arrangements for power saving at a user equipment, UE, (20) side of a wireless communication system.

title_en: Data detection method, device, storage medium and product
abstract_en: The application provides a data detection method, equipment, a storage medium and a product, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining data to be detected, obtaining a reconstruction error corresponding to the data to be detected by using a pre-trained neural network model based on the data to be detected, wherein the pre-trained neural network model is obtained by training a basic model established by a gating circulation unit and a sparse self-encoder based on a training data set, and intrusion detection is carried out on the data to be detected based on whether the reconstruction error corresponding to the data to be detected is larger than a pre-determined abnormal threshold value, wherein the pre-determined abnormal threshold value is determined based on a reference reconstruction error set obtained by using the pre-trained neural network model by using a verification data set.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring method for running state of power distribution network based on wireless communication network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of operation monitoring of power distribution networks, in particular to an intelligent monitoring method for the operation state of a power distribution network based on a wireless communication network. The cloud platform is used for generating a treatment plan package aiming at the identified high-risk target in advance and issuing the treatment plan package to the edge gateway, and when a fault occurs, the edge gateway can rapidly match and activate the treatment plans from a plurality of locally stored treatment plans without waiting for a cloud instruction, so that the improvement of fault response speed and the shortening of fault isolation and recovery time are realized, and the problem of slow response caused by communication delay in the prior art is effectively solved.

title_en: Multi-cabinet cascading vibration noise data acquisition clock synchronization method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of industrial measurement and control, and discloses a multi-machine-box cascading vibration noise data acquisition clock synchronization method; the local clock signals and the environmental parameters of each chassis are obtained in real time, a clock drift prediction model based on deep learning is constructed, and accurate prediction of clock behaviors is achieved. The multimode communication strategy combining optical fibers and wireless radio frequencies is innovatively adopted, a reliable transmission mechanism which is redundant is formed, and the anti-interference capability is obviously enhanced. The dynamic compensation mechanism based on the fuzzy logic controller can intelligently adjust compensation parameters according to clock states and environmental changes, and accurate correction is realized. A multi-stage verification mechanism comprising local self-checking, inter-chassis mutual checking and global optimization is established, and a graph neural network technology is introduced to perform system-level optimization, so that the self-learning and self-optimization capabilities are provided. The invention obviously improves the time consistency of the vibration noise data.

title_en: Power grid electricity consumption information acquisition standby power management system and control method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system automation and energy management, and particularly discloses a power grid electricity consumption information acquisition standby electricity management system and a control method. The system comprises a main power supply monitoring module, an energy reserve management module, a communication environment sensing module, an energy efficiency policy decision core and a task priority scheduling module. And dynamically adjusting the communication step length and the transmitting power by capturing the states of the power grid, the battery and the channel in real time, and executing data scheduling according to the priority. By adopting the technical scheme, the invention realizes the fine distribution of the electric energy, reduces the invalid standby power consumption, prolongs the life cycle of the acquisition terminal in the power failure state, ensures the reliable reporting of key information under extreme working conditions, and provides data support for the research and judgment of power grid faults.

title_en: Network threat detection and response system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of network threat detection and discloses a network threat detection and response system based on deep learning. The system comprises an acquisition module, a statistics module and an instruction generation module, wherein the acquisition module is used for acquiring a standardized data set from a plurality of preset safety areas, the statistics module is used for counting attack equivalent cumulative values, defending force indexes and asset attack exposure degrees based on the standardized data set, and the instruction generation module is used for calculating threat comprehensive scores according to the attack equivalent cumulative values, the asset attack exposure degrees and the defending force indexes and generating blocking instructions, isolating instructions and current limiting instructions according to the threat comprehensive scores. The invention can automatically generate the access control strategy according to the analysis result of the attack chain and issue and execute the access control strategy to form a complete closed loop from threat detection to strategy optimization, thereby improving the cooperativity, the accuracy and the instantaneity of network security operation.

title_en: Distributed collaborative processing and management platform for multi-source mapping data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed collaborative processing and management platform of multi-source mapping data, and particularly relates to the technical field of distributed data processing, wherein a unified data sequence is generated by collecting node space coordinates, time and signal intensity parameters; the method comprises the steps of calculating data correlation by combining space and time offset difference, executing synchronous scheduling according to bandwidth and time delay parameters, tracking error propagation trend by residual analysis, and carrying out delay compensation on overrun nodes to realize efficient cooperation and dynamic synchronous management of multi-source data. The method realizes accurate alignment and efficient integration of heterogeneous data through unified modeling of space, time and signal multidimensional information, remarkably improves synchronization precision and bandwidth utilization rate through offset residual calculation and self-adaptive time sequence scheduling, effectively suppresses error diffusion and drift accumulation through an error tracking and delay compensation mechanism, and improves stability, instantaneity and data consistency of a distributed mapping system in a multi-node environment.

title_en: Apparatus and method for communication
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a solution for communication. In one solution, a terminal device sends first information to a network device, the first information indicating at least one of an antenna switching capability of the terminal device, or a first maximum duration for which the terminal device is capable of maintaining power consistency and phase continuity in a first state of a non-terrestrial network (NTN) device, wherein the first state of the NTN device includes two or more of a first elevation of the NTN device, or a payload type of the NTN device, and determines a TDW for demodulation reference signal (DMRS) bonding based on at least one of the first information, or second information from the network device indicating one or more TDWs.

title_en: Anti-theft method and device for television equipment, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a television equipment anti-theft method, a device, a computer equipment and a storage medium, which can realize dynamic anti-theft monitoring from production and circulation to a terminal use stage in the whole life cycle of an intelligent television, establish an equipment unique anti-theft identifier through a blockchain algorithm and hash calculation, realize high-precision identity verification at networking moment, realize real-time analysis of identifier change, geographic position deviation and network access abnormality of the equipment in use by utilizing difference comparison, accurately identify counterfeit or illegal activation behaviors, automatically trigger a remote locking instruction according to risk level and effectively block the circulation of the stolen equipment. The application greatly improves the anti-counterfeiting, anti-theft and remote control capacity of equipment through the synergistic effect of the blockchain security certificate, the trusted hash verification and the intelligent locking control, provides reliable overseas sales security guarantee for enterprises, and builds an extensible intelligent terminal security management system.

title_en: Client signature verification method, device, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The application provides a client signature verification method, device, equipment, medium and product, and relates to the field of financial science and technology or other related fields. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a signature certificate file in a current android application package, calculating a plurality of hash values of the signature certificate file according to the signature certificate file, comparing the hash values with the hash values of the signature certificate file in a target android application package in a one-to-one correspondence mode, and checking if the hash values are equal to the hash values of the signature certificate file in the target android application package in a one-to-one correspondence mode. The scheme of the application improves the operation safety of the client.

title_en: Method and apparatus in a node for wireless communication
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device in a node for wireless communication. The node receives a first information block, the node sends a first signal, the first information block configures the first signal, the first signal comprises a first sub-signal and a second sub-signal, the first sub-signal comprises control information bits, the second sub-signal comprises data information bits, the first sub-signal and the second sub-signal are orthogonal in the time domain, the time domain interval length between the first sub-signal and the second sub-signal is equal to a first interval length, and the first interval length depends on the number of OOK time units included in one multi-carrier symbol occupied by the first signal in the time domain. The application improves the reliability of transmission.

title_en: Parameter determining method, data transmission method, device, communication system and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a parameter determining method, a data transmission method, a device, a communication system and a medium. The method comprises the steps of configuring a plurality of candidate parameter values corresponding to parameters of a receiving module in a serial-parallel converter according to initial sequence signals sent by signal sending equipment, generating a first sequence signal when the parameters are configured to be the candidate parameter values according to each parameter, acquiring a second sequence signal when the parameters generated by the signal sending equipment are configured to be the candidate parameter values, determining signal transmission error rates when the parameters are configured to be the candidate parameter values according to the first sequence signal and the second sequence signal, and determining the candidate parameter value with the minimum signal transmission error rate as the optimal parameter value of the parameter. By adopting the method, the optimal parameter value can be configured for each parameter in the RX module of the SerDes system.

title_en: Data transmission method, earphone, audio system and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a data transmission method, an earphone, an audio system and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of receiving a call voice packet through a current downlink Bluetooth frame sent by sound source equipment, sequentially carrying out access code detection and header verification on the current downlink Bluetooth frame, and when the fact that the first earphone fails to detect the access code of the current downlink Bluetooth frame or fails to verify the header is determined, and the first earphone receives the call voice packet forwarded by the second earphone in the remaining time of the current downlink Bluetooth frame under the condition that the first earphone does not successfully receive the call voice packet in the downlink Bluetooth frame before the current downlink Bluetooth frame, and forwarding the call voice packet to the first earphone in a time slot corresponding to the current downlink Bluetooth frame under the condition that the second earphone successfully receives the call voice packet. The method is beneficial to improving the anti-interference capability of the earphone and reducing call noise caused by blocking, packet loss and the like.

title_en: Split architecture communication network
abstract_en: A base station may have multiple entities such as control plane devices and distributed devices. The distributed means provides radio coverage to the user equipment via at least one cell and processes a physical layer of a radio protocol stack of the base station, and the control plane means processes a radio resource control layer of the radio protocol stack of the base station. The base station is configured such that the distributed device sends information about its characteristics or capabilities to the control plane device in an actively initiated message. This allows the control plane means to assign the physical layer configuration required for communication between the user equipment and the distributed means to the distributed means and the user equipment using the capability information and the information in the service request in response to the user equipment service request.

title_en: Automatic detecting and alarming system for combustible gas
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic combustible gas detection and alarm system which comprises a detection module, a main control module, an alarm module and an execution module, wherein the detection module, the alarm module and the execution module are all connected with the main control module, the detection module is used for detecting combustible gas to form a concentration corresponding signal of the combustible gas, the main control module acquires the concentration corresponding signal of the combustible gas and performs concentration classification according to the concentration corresponding signal to form a corresponding concentration grade, the alarm module sends out a corresponding alarm signal according to the concentration grade, and the execution module triggers a corresponding execution instruction according to the concentration grade. The invention realizes the intelligent control and grading alarm mechanism of the singlechip, solves the problems of fuzzy alarm condition distinction, low automation degree and the like of the traditional combustible gas alarm system, has the advantages of low cost, accurate response, strong expansibility and the like, can be widely applied to scenes such as families, industries, special environments and the like, and provides a high-efficiency and economic solution for the safety monitoring of the combustible gas.

title_en: Self-adaptive interpolation reduction device and method for automatic driving continuous time-space data transmission
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive interpolation restoration device and a self-adaptive interpolation restoration method for automatic driving continuous space-time data transmission, belongs to the technical field of automatic driving data transmission and processing, and solves the problems of high bandwidth occupation, insufficient restoration precision, poor scene suitability and the like of the existing transmission scheme. The device comprises six modules of data acquisition, vehicle end edge calculation, self-adaptive interpolation reduction, error check and the like, wherein the method is used for acquiring multi-type space-time data for the vehicle end, adding an identifier, extracting dynamic characteristic parameters to divide low, medium and high dynamic driving scenes, adaptively configuring start and stop point intervals, customizing encapsulation data, restoring the data by a cloud according to a scene matching interpolation algorithm, performing error check on the original space-time data cached by the vehicle end, and triggering transmission supplement and shortening the start and stop point intervals if the threshold is exceeded. The invention greatly reduces the data transmission quantity and bandwidth occupation, improves the restoration precision and data reliability, reduces the vehicle end energy consumption and adapts to the real-time data interaction requirement of the full working condition of automatic driving.

title_en: Vehicle control method, device, medium and product
abstract_en: The application provides a vehicle control method, a device, a medium and a product, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining running information and load information of a target vehicle in a current scene, determining service information of the target vehicle in a next scene based on the running information, wherein the service information comprises a plurality of scene services corresponding to the next scene, and controlling resource scheduling of the scene services based on the load information.

title_en: Signature verification method for Dilithium signature
abstract_en: A method for signature verification of Dilithium signatures comprises the steps of-considering a message with a Dilithium signature, the Dilithium signature having a scalar signature component and two vector signature components, -considering a public Dilithium key corresponding to the Dilithium signature, the public Dilithium key having a matrix public key component and a vector public key component-wherein an evaluation of the difference of the product of one of the matrix public key component and the vector signature component and the product of scalar quantity according to the scalar signature component and the vector public key component is replaced by an evaluation of the difference of the product of the one of the matrix public key component and the vector signature component and a further summand in the form of a random vector and the sum of the product of the scalar quantity and the vector public key component and the further summand. The device is configured to perform the above mentioned method.

title_en: Steady-state abrupt change self-adaptive deep Q learning underwater routing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a steady-state mutation self-adaptive deep Q learning underwater routing method, which comprises the steps of constructing a layered diffusion mechanism taking sink nodes as sources, enabling submerged buoy nodes to share the global state of sink nodes, constructing a joint feature pool indexed according to neighbors and a local information table independently maintained by the submerged buoy nodes, constructing a short-term mutation value network and a long-term steady-state value network, carrying out weighted fusion on the outputs of the short-term mutation value network and the long-term steady-state value network based on dynamic mutation factors to execute routing decisions, setting a counter facts reward based on a short-term experience pool, designing a causal reward based on a long-term experience pool by the short-term mutation value network, correcting the counter facts reward deviation of the short-term mutation value network, fusing two network parameters by the target Q network and providing training references, and dynamically adjusting the training modes of the network in the initial training period, the mutation period and the stationary period and the routing decision weight by the dynamic mutation factors. And the quick response and self-adaptive robust transmission of the cold start and environment abrupt change stage are realized.

title_en: Power consumption determining method, device, terminal, chip and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a power consumption determining method, a device, a terminal, a chip and a storage medium, and relates to the field of terminals and artificial intelligence, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of first observation parameters of a communication chip in the terminal in an RRC connection state in a first period; the first observation parameters comprise at least one of radio link quality parameters, data transmission performance parameters, resource scheduling parameters and power saving configuration parameters, and the estimated power consumption of the communication chip in the RRC connection state in the second period is determined according to the similarity among the plurality of first observation parameters. Therefore, the real-time and scene-adaptive power consumption estimation of the terminal side can be realized, the energy consumption characteristic of the communication chip in the terminal in the actual running environment is reflected more accurately, the accuracy and timeliness of the power consumption estimation are obviously improved, the dynamic change under different wireless environments and service loads is effectively adapted, and a reliable basis is provided for the refined sensing and management of the terminal energy consumption.

title_en: Method and device for controlling equipment to access network
abstract_en: A method of operating a distribution network auxiliary device in a wireless communication system according to an embodiment of the present disclosure may include receiving a request message from a distribution network device requesting the distribution network auxiliary device to activate a device networking function for a device to be networked on behalf of the distribution network device, transmitting a response message including a result code indicating that the distribution network auxiliary device activates the device networking function to the distribution network device in response to the request message, and performing the device networking function for the device to be networked.

title_en: Blockchain evaluation system for cross-border supply chain
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data information transmission, in particular to a blockchain evaluation system for a cross-border supply chain, which comprises a multi-source data acquisition module, a blockchain generation module, a credibility labeling module, a blockchain node information verification module and a blockchain node information verification module, wherein the multi-source data acquisition module is used for acquiring multi-source data, the blockchain generation module is used for constructing a digital ID and generating a blockchain based on the digital ID, the credibility labeling module is used for calculating ID credit of the digital ID and labeling the digital ID, stabilizing and calibrating the calculation process of the ID credit, and the blockchain node information verification module is used for verifying node information of the blockchain according to violation conditions and revising the calculation process of the ID credit according to the violation conditions. The system achieves the aim of quickly generating the traceable blockchain with high credibility through credit-violation-region combination.

title_en: Network attack self-adaptive response system for multisource threat information fusion and AI decision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network attack self-adaptive response system and method based on multisource threat information fusion and AI decision, and belongs to the technical field of network security. The method comprises the steps of collecting heterogeneous data through a multi-source perception layer, constructing a real-time updated network space digital twin body, carrying out deep threat correlation analysis on a threat cognition layer based on an ATT & CK framework to generate an attacker tactical intention map, constructing a multi-agent countering simulation environment in a dynamic game decision engine, carrying out attack and defense game deduction by adopting a Monte Carlo tree search algorithm, solving a dynamic optimal defense strategy, converting the strategy into an executable defense action plan through a strategy execution layer and automatically issuing and executing, and finally carrying out effect evaluation and feedback learning on an evolution verification layer to drive a system to continuously evolve. The invention realizes complete closed loop from threat perception, intelligent decision-making to autonomous evolution, and remarkably improves the instantaneity, the self-adaptability and the intelligent countermeasure level of network defense.

title_en: Mail differentiation processing method and system for multiple recipient groups based on global detection result
abstract_en: The invention provides a mail differentiation processing method and system of multiple recipient groups based on global detection results, which is characterized in that a built-in memory of a computer is used for storing programs and data, a conventional security detection module and a local filtering strategy module which are used as detection bases are included in the memory, a strategy group module which is used as a core innovation unit is constructed on the conventional security detection module and the local filtering strategy module, the strategy group module is configured to execute differentiation strategies aiming at specific recipient groups based on output results of the conventional security detection module and the local filtering strategy module, dynamically select corresponding strategies to process mails, radically convert mail processing strategies from mail-oriented level to recipient group-oriented level, perfectly meet the requirements of modern enterprises for implementing differentiation security management and business process integration according to departments and roles, and solve the industry pain point of each policy.

title_en: Information transmission method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an information transmission method and device. The method includes, for a terminal device having one or more AI/ML characteristics, the terminal device receiving from a network device first configuration information or second configuration information related to an AI/ML unit performance evaluation or selection.

title_en: Multi-system wireless test method and system based on FPGA reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of communication tests, and particularly relates to a multi-system wireless test method and system based on FPGA reconstruction, which are applied to a test system consisting of backboard interconnection, eight-channel signal processing, radio frequency channels, clocks, a main control and a power supply module, and are used for realizing seamless switching of multi-system tests by powering on self-checking, power supply, clock distribution and bus establishment, matching and uploading FPGA reconstruction firmware of a system to be tested, completing FPGA reconstruction based on FPP×32 mode dynamic loading firmware, analyzing upper computer test instructions, distributing parameters by buses and completing radio frequency link establishment and time sequence calibration, distributing transmission/reception modes to complete multi-system radio frequency signal transceiving and baseband processing to generate test data, integrating the working states of each module, and repeating S2-S5 without power off to complete seamless switching of the multi-system tests. The flexible adaptation of multi-system test is realized through FPGA dynamic reconstruction, the test efficiency is greatly improved, and the test cost is reduced.

title_en: Vector processing unit for wireless communication
abstract_en: The present application relates to the field of wireless communication signal processing technologies, and in particular, to a vector processing unit for wireless communication. The vector processing device comprises a vector processing controller, a vector arithmetic unit, a vector bit operation unit and a vector operation unit, wherein the vector processing controller is used for receiving and decoding an external instruction and generating a mode configuration signal corresponding to the external instruction according to a decoding result, the vector arithmetic unit is connected to the vector processing controller and used for executing 16-bit, 32-bit or 64-bit precision arithmetic operation according to the mode configuration signal, the vector bit operation unit is connected to the vector processing controller and used for executing bit-level operation according to the mode configuration signal, and the vector operation unit is connected to the vector processing controller and used for processing movement, filling and storage of vector register data according to the mode configuration signal. The vector processing unit provided by the application can flexibly adapt to various baseband processing algorithms in wireless communication, and overcomes the defects of fixed functions and poor scene adaptability of the traditional special accelerator.

title_en: Authentication system information block
abstract_en: The present disclosure describes techniques and systems for authenticating a System Information Block (SIB). These techniques enable a base station (120) to schedule a signed SIB for transmission and generate a signed SIB (805). The base station packages (810) the signed SIB for transmission, transmits (815) SIB1, and transmits the signed SIB (820). Further aspects describe techniques for a User Equipment (UE) (110) to verify (830) signed SIBs, authenticate the contents of the signed SIBs, and then verify other received SIBs (835) using some of the contents of the signed SIBs and use the verified SIBs for network attachment.

title_en: Intelligent contract signing method, device and medium based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent contract signing method, equipment and medium based on edge calculation. The method is applied to privacy calculation and blockchains and comprises the steps of obtaining a signing request of a target user, extracting signing information of the target user based on the signing request, transmitting the signing information to an edge computing environment, calling target user protocol data of the blockchain based on the signing information in the edge computing environment, carrying out intelligent contract signing according to the target user protocol data to generate a contract signing result, determining a right user set corresponding to the contract signing result, and encrypting the contract signing result by using a broadcast encryption algorithm based on the right user set to generate an encrypted contract signing result. By processing in the edge computing environment, the data transmission distance can be shortened, delay is reduced, and processing efficiency is improved. And the self-service signing process is realized without manual intervention. The authority of the signing result is bound with the user set through the broadcast encryption algorithm, and only the authorized user can decrypt the result, so that the privacy of the user is ensured.

title_en: Voice assistant interactive interface display method, medium and electronic device
abstract_en: The application discloses a voice assistant interactive interface display method, a medium and an electronic device, which relate to the technical field of intelligent home/intelligent families, and are used for firstly receiving a voice control instruction of a user on intelligent equipment, then identifying the identity of the user based on the voice control instruction under the condition that the voice control instruction cannot control the intelligent equipment, and finally presenting the following preset voice control instruction operation guidance on an identity-matched voice assistant interactive interface. According to the method, when the fact that the user cannot control the intelligent equipment is determined, the user can conveniently use the equipment function through the operation interface according to the user identity matching adaptive voice assistant interaction interface, paper specifications are not required to be read, and the use experience of the intelligent equipment is effectively improved.

title_en: Detection method for implicit toxicity multi-mode data and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection method and terminal equipment for implicit toxicity multi-mode data, belongs to the technical field of toxicity data detection, and can solve the problems that an existing model cannot effectively detect implicit toxicity content and cannot provide clear explanation and quantify the concealment degree of the implicit toxicity content. The method comprises the steps of S1, obtaining a plurality of visual nodes from an input image of an input image-text pair, constructing a visual association tree of the input image, S2, obtaining a plurality of text nodes from an input text of the input image-text pair, constructing a text association tree of the input text, S3, constructing a cross-modal bipartite graph of the input image-text pair according to the visual association tree and the text association tree, S4, matching each node pair in the cross-modal bipartite graph with all concept pairs in a toxic concept pair set respectively, and determining a toxicity label of the input image-text pair according to a matching result. The method is used for detecting the implicit toxicity multi-modal data.

title_en: Animation detection method, device, electronic equipment, computer readable storage medium and computer program product
abstract_en: The application provides an animation detection method, an animation detection device, electronic equipment, a computer program product and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of responding to a detection request for an animation file, analyzing the animation file to obtain skeleton key points of a virtual object at each moment in a target time period, estimating the gesture of the virtual object based on the skeleton key points of the virtual object at each moment in the target time period to obtain a skeleton gesture sequence of the virtual object in the target time period, determining a moving track of the target key points in the target time period based on the skeleton gesture sequence, and detecting abnormality of the animation file based on the moving track. According to the application, the character animation can be automatically detected, and the detection efficiency is improved.

title_en: Terminal equipment activation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: A method, apparatus, device and storage medium for activating terminal device are disclosed. The method comprises the steps of adding a local Profile agent in an eSIM card of terminal equipment, wherein the local Profile agent is used for writing a card in a mode of a card application in the eSIM card, the card application is preset in the eSIM card, and in response to a card writing request, terminal equipment activation is realized in the eSIM card through the card application by the local Profile agent. The application puts the local Profile agent LPA in the eSIM card, realizes the writing of the eSIM card by the card application mode, and the eSIM card data is decoupled with the terminal operating system without passing through the terminal operating system. The application can safely activate the terminal equipment on one hand and improve the safety of the card writing process on the other hand.

title_en: Position verification method and device of user equipment, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a method and a device for verifying the position of user equipment, a storage medium and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of Internet of things communication. The method and the device solve the problem that in the related art, when the rough position information of the user equipment cannot meet corresponding requirements, the position of the user equipment cannot be accurately verified.

title_en: Communication method, terminal, network device and storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a communication method, a terminal, a network device, and a storage medium. The communication method comprises the steps that a terminal receives first downlink reference signal resources configured by network equipment, wherein the first downlink reference signal resources are related to transmission layer numbers RANK corresponding to N port groups, and N is a positive integer. The communication method improves the system performance.

title_en: Nonlinear channel equalization method assisted by field recovery iteration
abstract_en: The invention provides a field recovery iteration-assisted nonlinear channel equalization method which is applied to an intensity modulation direct detection (IM)/DD (digital video) optical fiber transmission system. The method comprises the steps of cascading a Gerchberg-Saxton (GS) iterative algorithm with a Volterra Decision Feedback Equalizer (VDFE) in a digital receiver to form the GS-VDFE equalizer. The GS iteration module is used for initially compensating fiber dispersion and improving fading frequency point power by reversely pushing phase and iteratively updating an optical field from a light intensity signal, and the VDFE module is used for carrying out nonlinear equalization on GS output signals by adopting a simplified structure of second-order feedforward Volterra and first-order feedback DFE so as to eliminate residual distortion. The GS preprocessing ensures that the VDFE does not need high-order nonlinear compensation, reduces the complexity and noise sensitivity of the equalizer, and reduces the GS iteration times to below 20 times by adopting the VDFE to bear residual compensation, thereby reducing the processing time delay. The invention can effectively recover the high-speed digital signal in the large dispersion channel without changing the structure of the existing system, and lighten the spectrum fading and the self-timer interference.

title_en: Back source detection method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to a back source detection method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring the detection duration of each IP address returned response data in the process of carrying out back source detection on the IP addresses in an IP address set for the first time; dividing the IP addresses in the IP address set into a fast set and a slow set according to the detection duration, carrying out source-returning detection on the fast set according to a first detection period corresponding to the fast set to obtain first response data, carrying out source-returning detection on the slow set according to a second detection period corresponding to the slow set to obtain second response data, and outputting a detection result according to the first response data and the second response data. Therefore, the IP addresses can be divided into a fast set and a slow set according to the detection duration of each IP address, and the source-returning detection is carried out for different sets, so that the problem that the response data returned by the IP addresses affect the overall detection efficiency slowly is avoided, the overall source-returning detection period is quickened, and the detection speed is improved.

title_en: Intelligent body-oriented cellular telephone remote trust control method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote trust control method and device for a cellular phone facing an intelligent machine body, and relates to the technical field of safety control of intelligent equipment. The method can be implemented in a mode of combining pure software, pure hardware, firmware and soft and hard, and comprises the steps of carrying out trust admittance verification on a calling party after receiving a cellular call, directly carrying out non-perception interception on a non-trust main call, automatically answering the trust main call and starting initial identity verification, entering an instruction interaction stage after verification is passed, synchronously executing real-time continuous identity verification on each effective instruction, strongly binding a verification result with instruction execution authority, executing the instruction when the verification is passed, and hanging up the call when the verification is failed. The device comprises an incoming call processing module, an identity verification module and an instruction gating execution module which are sequentially connected in a communication mode. The invention realizes the safety control of the intelligent organism remote control full link, reduces the risks of illegal invasion and instruction impossibility, has wide adaptability and can cover various implementation scenes.

title_en: Signaling interaction method and device for unmanned aerial vehicle adaptive code modulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a signaling interaction method and device for unmanned aerial vehicle adaptive code modulation. The method comprises the steps of carrying out channel estimation by a receiving end to obtain an instantaneous signal-to-noise ratio and a sight distance state, calculating a signal-to-noise ratio change trend according to a historical signal-to-noise ratio, calculating a recent block error rate according to a historical confirmation/unacknowledged identification result, comparing the recent block error rate with a target to generate an out-of-standard mark, combining the signal-to-noise ratio grade, the trend mark, the sight distance state mark and the block error rate out-of-standard mark into multi-dimensional state information, sending the multi-dimensional state information through an uplink feedback signaling, receiving and analyzing the multi-dimensional state information by a transmitting end, inquiring a Q table by using the multi-dimensional state information as an index to obtain a modulation coding mode index, notifying the receiving end through a downlink control signaling, and carrying out data receiving by the receiving end according to the modulation coding mode index. The method and the device enable the transmitting terminal to acquire the rich information supporting intelligent decision by defining the multidimensional state information feedback format, have good backward compatibility and low feedback expenditure, and are suitable for low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle communication.

title_en: Method, device and equipment for jointly estimating and compensating time offset and frequency offset of uplink data
abstract_en: The invention provides a time offset and frequency offset joint estimation and compensation method, device and equipment of uplink data, and relates to the technical field of communication, wherein the method comprises the steps of directly calculating frequency offset through multiplexing peak value phase difference information in a TA estimation process, realizing joint estimation of TA and frequency offset, and avoiding precision loss and multiple FFT calculation overhead caused by traditional separate processing; meanwhile, the TA estimation value is utilized to correct the memory read address to realize time offset compensation, the traditional data shift operation is replaced, and the current sub-frame frequency offset estimation value is combined to carry out real-time frequency offset compensation without multiple times of averaging or iteration, so that the uplink data receiving performance with low calculation amount and high instantaneity is maintained under the conditions of high-speed movement and large time delay.

title_en: Frame-parallel multi-mode state level communication method, device, equipment and storage medium for long video understanding
abstract_en: The application provides a frame parallel multi-mode state level communication method, device and equipment for long video understanding and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and computer vision. The method comprises the steps of dividing an input video into a plurality of frame sub-sequences, parallelly encoding the plurality of frame sub-sequences based on a plurality of provider large language models when sharing the same text context or task instruction to generate multi-mode intermediate state representation, extracting visual key value states from the multi-mode intermediate state representation, performing distinguishing, screening and standardization processing to form a multi-mode state key value pair set, injecting the visual key value states into a text condition key value buffer of a carrier large language model, and performing reasoning calculation by the carrier large language model based on the key value buffer after the state injection to generate a video understanding related output result. The application can more fully reserve and fuse the key vision and time sequence information in the video while ensuring the communication efficiency, and promote the overall reasoning performance in the long video understanding task.

title_en: Random access method and related device
abstract_en: The present application relates to the field of wireless communications technologies, and in particular, to a random access method and a related device. The method includes sending a first request message. The first request message includes a first random access preamble, and the first transmission resource used is located in a first uplink carrier of the N1 second uplink carriers. The N1 second uplink carriers are all used for random access. A first response message is received. The first response message includes a first preamble identification of the first random access preamble and a first RAR. The first RNT I for the first response message scrambling is determined based on the first transmission resource and the first carrier identity. The first carrier identification is an identification of a first uplink carrier among a plurality of second uplink carriers, the plurality of second uplink carriers including N1 second uplink carriers. Or the first response message further comprises a first carrier identification. Or the second transmission resource of the first response message is associated with the first uplink carrier. The method can improve the random access efficiency of the terminal equipment.

title_en: V2X communication-fused multi-vehicle cooperative intelligent parking scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic control, in particular to a multi-vehicle collaborative intelligent parking scheduling method integrating V2X communication, which comprises the steps of obtaining a real-time parking space occupation grid diagram through a road side unit, receiving parking intention information sent by a plurality of vehicles to be parked through V2X, predicting the running path of each vehicle and the time of reaching a path intersection area, compiling a dynamic scheduling alliance when the difference of the expected arrival moments of at least three vehicles is smaller than a preset threshold value, generating a virtual queue for the dynamic scheduling alliance, slicing space-time resources of the path intersection area, distributing exclusive passing time windows and speed curves for each vehicle, adjusting the vehicle speed based on dynamic priority through a V2V real-time sharing state in the running process, realizing the non-parking collaborative passing of the intersection area, and completing parking of each vehicle through a post-intersection area dismissing alliance. According to the invention, through cooperative scheduling of multiple vehicles, the conflict of the paths and the intersections is effectively eliminated, and the traffic efficiency of the parking lot is improved.

title_en: Communication method and related equipment
abstract_en: A communication method comprises the steps of receiving a first request of a first network element, wherein the first request is used for indicating data registration, the first request carries information of data which can be provided by the first network element, the first network element is a producer of the data, receiving a second request of a second network element, the second request comprises data requirements, and sending first information to the second network element, the first information is used for acquiring the data, and the data corresponding to the information of the data meets the data requirements. Based on the technical scheme, the data registration process as the data producer is defined, the data registration process is simplified, the data registration and data collection efficiency is improved, and the data registration process as the data producer does not need to be triggered when the data consumer requests to subscribe to data or analyze, so that the integrity and the reliability of the data can be ensured.

title_en: Forest fire extinguishing intelligent decision-making and commanding system and method based on unmanned aerial vehicle clusters and digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent decision and command system and method for forest fire suppression based on unmanned aerial vehicle clusters and digital twinning, in particular to the field of fire alarm and emergency command and dispatch, which comprises the steps of reading detection type codes, detection value abstracts, position grid codes and local time stamps through a fire alarm terminal, calculating event identification by byte splicing by utilizing the detection type code, the position grid code and the local timestamp, and outputting an uplink message which contains the event identification and the detection value abstract and is used for association of unmanned aerial vehicle cluster tasks; based on the event identification, the fire alarm terminal reads the local confirmation sequence number and adds one to obtain a message sequence number, and the message sequence number is written into the uplink message and then sent through the NB-IoT. The state of the same fire point is pushed to the boundary through the closed loop write-back solidification of the event identification and the message sequence number, and the repeated rejection and the disorder convergence of the platform side are combined, so that the alarm uploading and the command issuing relatively inhibit the dispatching oscillation caused by repeated and conflict command under the disorder retransmission of the weak network.

title_en: Data pre-disaster active protection method based on hardware abnormality and system fault prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AI pre-disaster pre-judging and data rescuing method. The terminal acquires the characteristics of formatting risk, abnormal storage, abnormal key process and the like in real time, the AI module outputs risk scores and repairable scores, and when judging that a non-repairable disaster is about to happen, the terminal automatically triggers the Agent to rescue key data and packages the key data. And after calculating the abstract of the data packet, carrying out asymmetric encryption by using a public key of a receiving party, uploading the data packet to the cloud, and sending a downloading notification mail to a user after the cloud completes verification. The user downloads the ciphertext package through the mail portal and decrypts and recovers using the private key. The method realizes the data protection closed loop with controllable active rescue and key master right before disaster.

title_en: Multi-user quantum fair exchange method and system based on Bell state entangled particles
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-user quantum fair exchange method and system based on Bell state entangled particles. By utilizing the quantum entanglement characteristic of Bell states and the unitary matrix super-secret coding technology and combining a semi-trusted third party mechanism, the fair and safe exchange of multiparty secret information is realized, and the problems of unfair time, high third party dependence and weak quantum attack resistance in the traditional protocol are solved.

title_en: Network security monitoring system of industrial control system and monitoring method and equipment thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network safety monitoring system of an industrial control system and a monitoring method and equipment thereof, in particular relates to the technical field of network safety monitoring, and aims to solve the problem that abnormal control behaviors generated in short time cannot be found timely and accurately due to mismatching of monitoring time sequences and control time sequences; the method comprises the steps of acquiring scanning period data of an industrial control system controller and sampling time sequence data of monitoring nodes, constructing a time sequence mapping relation data set, identifying coverage gaps to form a non-matching window, determining a time sequence interval in which short-time control operation and control actions occur, respectively carrying out time sequence merging and abnormal feature extraction on real-time control state data and network message data, carrying out fusion analysis based on time sequence positions of the abnormal features, and finally backtracking to determine start and stop time intervals and communication link information and generate safety monitoring alarm data, thereby realizing accurate positioning and abnormal traceability of the short-time control operation and control actions and improving accuracy and reliability of network safety monitoring of the industrial control system.

title_en: 5G network slice flow prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 5G network slice flow prediction method and a 5G network slice flow prediction system, and relates to the technical field of network flow prediction. The method comprises the steps of mapping network slices into hypergraph nodes, mapping slice clusters sharing the same physical feature into hyperedges, constructing a hypergraph incidence matrix, constructing original features of all slices into space-time feature tensors, inputting a hypergraph convolution network to extract space features to obtain network slice updating features, splicing the updating features with a previous hidden state, adaptively generating fractional orders according to the splicing features, carrying out weighted summation on hidden states at a plurality of historical moments by using the fractional orders to obtain updated hidden states, and finally outputting flow prediction results based on the updated hidden states. According to the invention, the high-order space coupling relation between the slices is captured through hypergraph convolution, the problem of forgetting of a long sequence of the traditional cyclic neural network is overcome through a self-adaptive fractional order memory mechanism, and the accuracy and the robustness of network slice flow prediction are remarkably improved.

title_en: Method and device for reporting artificial intelligence capability
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an AI capability reporting method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: and the terminal equipment sends reporting information to the first network equipment, wherein the reporting information comprises AI capability information of the first cell. Or the core network device sends a fourth message to the first network device, where the fourth message includes AI capability information about the second network device.

title_en: Method and apparatus for reporting in a node for wireless communication
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for reporting in a node for wireless communication. The method comprises the steps of receiving a first information block by a first node, configuring a report by the first information block, receiving an RS in a first RS resource set, when the report is periodical, the first RS resource set is used for at least one of channel measurement or interference measurement of the report by the first information block, when the report by the first information block is event-triggered, the report by the first information block is triggered only when a triggering event is met, the triggering event depends on measurement of the first RS resource set, the first information block comprises a first index, and whether the report by the first information block comprises the first index depends on whether the report by the first information block is event-triggered.

title_en: Large-range high-precision variable time delay control method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-range high-precision variable delay control method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining baseband sampling data and writing the baseband sampling data into a DDR (double data Rate) buffer module; the method comprises the steps of calculating target variable delay parameters according to a channel simulation scene and a sampling rate, wherein the target variable delay parameters comprise integer time delay and decimal time delay of the sampling rate, generating a read address according to the integer time delay and a real-time write address of a DDR buffer module, performing fixed-point accumulation operation on the decimal time delay, obtaining integer times of decimal time delay adjustment quantity according to a fixed-point accumulation operation result, performing integer time delay adjustment on baseband sampling data read out of the DDR buffer module according to the integer times of time delay adjustment quantity to obtain first sampling data, performing decimal time delay adjustment on the first sampling data according to the decimal time delay adjustment quantity to obtain second sampling data, and outputting the second sampling data as baseband sampling data after the target variable delay. The invention can realize the time delay control with large range, high precision and continuous and adjustable.

title_en: Wireless communication method and communication device
abstract_en: A method of wireless communication and a communication device are provided. The method comprises the steps that a first device sends a first frame to a second device, wherein a first link and a second link are established between the first device and the second device, the first frame is used for preempting TXOP of the first link, the first frame is transmitted through the second link, the first frame is transmitted through the first link when the first time is earlier than the second time, the first time is the time when the first device obtains transmission resources for transmitting the first frame in the first link, and the second time is the time when the first device obtains the transmission resources for transmitting the first frame in the second link. The application can use multiple links to initiate the preemption of TXOP of other links on one link. Therefore, even if the link is occupied, the link can be preempted through the first frame, so that the traffic to be transmitted can be sent as soon as possible, i.e. low-delay transmission is realized.

title_en: Heterogeneous log and standard rule knowledge base construction method, system and storage medium for Internet of vehicles security
abstract_en: The invention provides a heterogeneous log and standard rule knowledge base construction method, a heterogeneous log and standard rule knowledge base construction system and a storage medium for safety of the Internet of vehicles, wherein the method comprises the following steps of 1, identifying an accessed data source format, wherein the accessed data comprises semi-structured operation data of the Internet of vehicles and unstructured compound rule data of the Internet of vehicles; and 2, adopting a dual-channel knowledge base construction assembly line to respectively process the semi-structured data of the Internet of vehicles and the unstructured data of the Internet of vehicles, standardizing to express discrete log features and constraining to extract standard map paths, and constructing a data base with a bottom vector fact base and an upper map rule base which are separated in a bimodal manner and are logically aligned. The method has the beneficial effects that by constructing a double-way fusion architecture of the log semantic enhancement assembly line and the standard rule knowledge base, the logic alignment of heterogeneous knowledge is realized on the retrieval level, the problems of log semantic sparseness and standard logic faults in the prior art are solved, and the safety audit can more accurately compare the on-site illegal behaviors with the static compliance standard.

title_en: Access control method, device and equipment for power data
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device and equipment for controlling access to electric power data, and relates to the technical field of electric power data.
