The method comprises the steps of obtaining a data request instruction sent by a user when the power data access operation is executed, carrying out risk rating on the power data access operation based on the data request instruction to obtain an initial risk level, collecting real-time context information corresponding to the power data access operation, determining a dynamic risk score corresponding to the power data access operation based on the initial risk level and the real-time context information, determining risk relieving measures based on the dynamic risk score, processing original data requested in the data request instruction according to the risk relieving measures, and sending the processed data to the user. The invention can effectively solve the problem of disconnection between the safety measures and the instantaneous risks in the traditional static model, and avoid the low efficiency of low-risk access due to excessive protection or the leakage of high-risk access due to insufficient protection.

title_en: Large-model-driven intelligent tracing method for network attack behavior
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of network security, and relates to a large-model-driven intelligent tracing method for network attack behavior, which comprises the steps of preprocessing original data of a multi-element network data source, converting the preprocessed original data into a standardized structured data set, respectively representing different modal data by characteristics, fusing the different modal data, and performing dimension reduction optimization to generate a characteristic vector with identification degree and compactness; the method comprises the steps of carrying out field fine tuning on a pre-trained large model, carrying out multi-task parallel analysis, breaking through the dilemma of weak recognition of hidden attacks by a traditional method by depending on strong semantic understanding and associated reasoning capability of the large model, then constructing an attack graph, combining a graph reasoning algorithm with a Bayesian network, calculating the probability of attack source suspicion, completing the anonymization-caused path fracture by means of the large model, reversely adjusting parameters by matching with a closed loop optimization mechanism, greatly improving tracing accuracy, reducing misjudgment rate, and solving the core problems of the conventional tracing path fracture and low efficiency.

title_en: Synchronous communication system for testing vehicle and target object under complex scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synchronous communication system for testing a vehicle and a target object in a complex scene, which comprises a vehicle to be tested, a real target object and a virtual target object, a distributed high-precision space-time reference network, a real parameter acquisition module, a virtual-real fusion test verification interface, a dynamic behavior coordination system and a multimode communication adaptive switching module, wherein the distributed high-precision space-time reference network is used for providing unified space-time reference for the vehicle to be tested and the real target object, the real parameter acquisition module is used for acquiring acceleration, speed and path of the vehicle to be tested and the real target object, the virtual-real fusion test verification interface is used for realizing cooperative test of the real target object and the virtual target object in the same communication network, the dynamic behavior coordination system is used for reproducing parameters of the vehicle to be tested and the real target object on a complex scene platform, generating a motion track of the vehicle to be tested and the virtual target object, and adjusting the motion state of the virtual target object in real time through a closed loop feedback mechanism, and the multimode communication adaptive switching module is used for supporting C-V2X, DSRC G-Uu three-mode parallel communication. The invention ensures that the time and space height of the test scene restore the real traffic environment.

title_en: Method for switching satellite in non-ground network, terminal equipment and network equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a method, terminal equipment and network equipment for non-terrestrial network satellite switching, which are beneficial to improving the success rate of access of non-RACH switching in an NTN cell. The method is applied to satellite switching from a first satellite network coverage area to a second satellite network coverage area, and comprises the steps of receiving a first switching command, wherein the first switching command comprises power related information in the second satellite network coverage area, and/or relative position information of a second satellite corresponding to the second satellite network and terminal equipment, and determining first power for uplink transmission to the second satellite network according to the first switching command.

title_en: Issuing interaction method, device, equipment, storage medium and product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a release interaction method, device, equipment, storage medium and product, wherein the method comprises the steps of displaying a release configuration page, wherein object configuration items respectively corresponding to at least one release object associated with release video are displayed in an object configuration area in the release configuration page, responding to the selected operation of the object configuration items, taking the release object corresponding to the object configuration items as a target object, and displaying a recommendation label in the object configuration items, wherein the recommendation label is configured to be displayed in an object display item corresponding to the target object in the object collection page when a video release platform displays the object collection page corresponding to the release video, so that the problem that the display form of object information is single and fixed is solved, the screening cost of the object information is reduced, and the waste of video resources is reduced.

title_en: Train positioning method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a train positioning method which comprises the steps of obtaining UWB ranging data and IMU motion data collected by a tag of a train, inputting the UWB ranging data into a first DQN intelligent agent to obtain an optimal base station combination, determining KF gain according to the IMU motion data and the optimal base station combination, adjusting the KF gain through a second DQN intelligent agent, and determining the positioning of the train according to the adjusted KF gain. According to the scheme provided by the application, the two DQN intelligent bodies are utilized to realize the selection of the optimal base station combination scheme and the adaptive adjustment of the parameters of the fused KF model, so that the influence of NLoS transmission on UWB positioning caused by fixed obstacles is avoided, and the fused positioning fixed error of the same line is overcome.

title_en: Agricultural product whole industry chain traceability and quality safety intelligent supervision platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an agricultural product whole industrial chain traceability and quality safety intelligent supervision platform which comprises a safety production management system, a logistics management system, a whole link trusted data acquisition system, a blockchain trusted certification and traceability system, a big data intelligent analysis system, an intelligent supervision early warning system and a multi-terminal collaborative application service system, wherein the safety production management system is used for upgrading an industrial chain, building intelligent agriculture, the logistics management system is used for acquiring internet of things equipment deployed at key nodes of the industrial chain, guaranteeing real and real data sources, the blockchain trusted certification and traceability system is used for accessing and fusing blockchain certification data, enterprise reporting data and government supervision data, the big data analysis and machine learning model is used for building a quality safety risk assessment and early warning model, and the intelligent supervision early warning system is used for multi-terminal collaborative application service system. The invention uses the non-tamperable and traceable characteristics of the blockchain to fundamentally solve the problems of easy counterfeiting and insufficient public trust of agricultural product traceable data and establish the data foundation of mutual trust of all parties of the industrial chain through the full-link trusted data acquisition system and the blockchain trusted storage verification and traceability system.

title_en: Sensing method, sensing transmitter and sensing receiver
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a sensing method, a sensing transmitter and a sensing receiver. The sensing method comprises the steps that a sensing transmitter carries out time domain selective precoding on a first sensing reference signal according to a first Doppler frequency component, a second sensing reference signal is determined, the first Doppler frequency component is a Doppler frequency component corresponding to a channel link from the sensing transmitter to a sensing target, and the sensing transmitter sends the second sensing reference signal. According to the embodiment of the disclosure, the sensing functional units such as the sensing receiver or the fusion center can determine the speed information of the sensing target according to the measured Doppler frequency by performing time domain selective pre-coding on the sensing reference signal.

title_en: Distributed optical fiber sensing device and method for compressed sensing heuristic AI
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optical fiber sensing, in particular to a distributed optical fiber sensing device and method for compressed sensing heuristic AI. The cloud edge collaborative model comprises an edge compression model and a cloud identification model which are connected in series, the weight of a convolution layer of the edge compression model is initialized to be an orthogonal random matrix before training is started, the edge compression model meets limited equidistant properties, the edge compression model and the cloud identification model are subjected to end-to-end combined training, the edge compression model has the capacity of extracting semantic features with the most discrimination of an identification task on the premise of guaranteeing the maximum compression rate, high-dimensional sensing data are obtained, the high-dimensional sensing data are compressed by the edge compression model, a compressed feature map is obtained, and the compressed feature map is identified by the cloud identification model, so that an identification result is obtained. The invention can realize maximum compression of data volume while guaranteeing the identification accuracy.

title_en: Internet of vehicles intrusion detection method and system based on mask stripe convolution self-encoder
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vehicle networking intrusion detection method and system based on a mask stripe convolution self-encoder, and the method comprises the steps of converting payload bytes of continuous CAN data frames into CAN payload gray level images, generating block-level, frame-level or continuous frame mask areas by utilizing a multimode mask generator guided by information quantity and filling the mask areas, inputting mask input images into the mask stripe convolution self-encoder to carry out self-supervision reconstruction training, extracting local byte disturbance, continuous change in time direction and coupling characteristics among cross-field frames by the encoder through a stripe convolution module facing a CAN frame structure, calculating reconstruction loss and updating parameters by taking the masked areas as main objects, removing a decoder after training is finished, reserving the encoder and connecting a lightweight classification head, and outputting intrusion detection results by the encoder and the classification head in a deployment stage.

title_en: Underwater wireless optical communication oriented safe and reliable transmission collaborative optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safe and reliable transmission cooperative optimization method for underwater wireless optical communication, and relates to the technical field of underwater wireless optical communication physical layer safety. Aiming at the problem that the safety and reliability of an Underwater Wireless Optical Communication (UWOC) system are difficult to consider in a complex water environment, the invention provides a safe and reliable transmission collaborative optimization method, and specifically, the method is characterized in that channel state information reciprocity is enhanced firstly based on a PCA preprocessing technology, then a DISM algorithm is innovatively provided to generate a high-consistency physical layer key, finally, self-adaptive safe polarization coding is realized based on an MC-SPC scheme, and key generation and channel coding collaborative optimization is completed. Simulation results show that the key inconsistency rate generated by DISM algorithm is as low as 0.0016, the average key generation rate is about 1.99bps, and NIST randomness test is passed, meanwhile, the MC-SPC scheme has lower error rate than the traditional polarization code scheme, the error rate of the eavesdropping terminal is stabilized near 0.5, and the method has the advantages of safety and reliability under various scenes.

title_en: Information input method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to an information input method, apparatus, device, and storage medium. The method presented herein includes presenting an information input component in a display device, responsive to a first input location of a plurality of input locations being in an input state, determining a first set of elements matching the first input location from a plurality of elements associated with an input panel based at least on the first element having been input at a second input location of the plurality of input locations, presenting the first set of elements in a first manner in the input panel to indicate that the first set of elements is in a selectable state, moving an indicator between the first set of elements displayed by the input panel based on movement instructions received via a controller associated with the display device, responsive to receiving the input instructions via the controller, inputting a second element corresponding to the indicator to the first input location. In this way, embodiments of the present disclosure can improve information input efficiency of a user to a display device.

title_en: Automatic intelligent inspection method based on large language model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic intelligent inspection method based on a large language model, which comprises the following steps of S1, receiving inspection requirements of natural language description of operation and maintenance personnel by the large language model, carrying out semantic analysis and element extraction to obtain user intention, S2, generating a script to be executed by the large language model by taking the user intention as a search word, S3, determining an inspection range and the script to be executed by a system, issuing and executing the script to be executed, S4, carrying out full-quantity recovery and standardized cleaning on a returned result after receiving a script execution completion signal by the system, and S5, generating an inspection report by the large language model. The intelligent inspection system and the intelligent inspection method based on the large language realize improvement of multi-link inspection efficiency through intelligent inspection in large language, clearly confirm and avoid inspection risks, and can intelligently get insight into problems and provide decision assistance.

title_en: Remote SQL configuration and safe calling method and system based on template engine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote SQL configuration and safe calling method and system based on a template engine, and belongs to the technical field of database safe access. The system comprises a calling terminal module, an access gateway module, a template management module, a remote configuration module, a security management and control module, a template engine module, an SQL execution module, an abnormality monitoring module and a data storage module. The template management module and the remote configuration module realize unified creation, auditing, release and three-level synchronization of the SQL template among the group headquarter server, the regional subsidiary server and the mining area server. The abnormality monitoring module is used for monitoring abnormal behaviors in real time, triggering an alarm and recording abnormal details when the monitoring index exceeds a threshold value. The invention solves the problems of lack of unified management, single security protection level and difficult collaboration of multiple databases in the SQL template in the prior art.

title_en: Self-adaptive packet scheduling method and system for measuring forward path delay based on reverse transmission ACK in data center network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-adaptive message scheduling method and a self-adaptive message scheduling system for measuring forward path delay based on reverse transmission ACK in a data center network, and belongs to the technical field of data center network transmission. The method comprises the steps that a sending end sends data packets to a receiving end along a selected path through source routing, the receiving end generates high-priority acknowledgement messages ACK to return along a reverse path, each switch accumulates the length of an outbound queue of an inbound port of the acknowledgement packet ACK to the head of the acknowledgement packet after normalized scaling and specific offset when the acknowledgement packet ACK passes, the sending end accurately reconstructs unidirectional transmission path time delay of a forward data message according to the acknowledgement packet, calculates spraying weight of each path through self-adaptive pruning and time delay-weight mapping functions based on the real-time delay of each path and selects the paths to send the data packets, comprehensively considers the time delay states of all paths to accurately control congestion, multiplicatively reduces the rate if available and not-fully loaded paths exist, namely additively increases the rate if and only if all paths are congested, independently maintains the in-transit message state for each path to distinguish non-tail packet loss from disordered sequence, and distinguishes three scenes of tail packet loss, link failure and congestion through a ghost message mechanism. The invention can obviously reduce the feedback delay and measurement error of time delay measurement, improve the bandwidth utilization rate of multipath transmission and reduce the flow completion time.

title_en: Intelligent diagnosis-based frequency converter communication anomaly detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a frequency converter communication abnormality detection method based on intelligent diagnosis, which relates to the technical field of frequency converter communication abnormality detection and comprises the steps of obtaining communication message data between a frequency converter and a main control unit, analyzing node addresses, function codes, register addresses, message serial numbers, sending time stamps and response time stamps, constructing a communication time slot fingerprint and a protocol state shadow model, generating an expected response message and an expected response time window according to a current request message and matching with an actual response message, calculating a protocol state deviation value and a time slot deviation value according to a matching result, generating a communication abnormality syndrome vector, and determining a communication abnormality type according to the communication abnormality syndrome vector. The invention can improve the recognition accuracy of response mismatch, old frame playback, time slot drift and node communication interruption precursor abnormality.

title_en: Apparatus and method for CSI inference reporting
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to an apparatus and method for CSI inference reporting. In one aspect, a terminal device receives an inference report configuration for Channel State Information (CSI) from a network device. Based on determining that the inference report configuration for CSI is inapplicable, the terminal device determines a first priority for a first CSI report associated with the inference report configuration for CSI, wherein the first priority is lower than a second priority for a second CSI report associated with the inference report configuration for CSI during the suitability reporting of the inference report configuration for CSI.

title_en: Text relay-based low-code rate channel high-definition voice AI reconstruction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a text relay-based low-code rate channel high-definition voice AI reconstruction method, and relates to the technical field of voice communication and artificial intelligence intersection. The method adopts a bidirectional symmetrical communication architecture, each node is provided with a sending link and a receiving link, the sending link establishes a unified audio buffer pool, stream voice recognition and voiceprint recognition are synchronously executed, only texts and speaker identifications are transmitted, the receiving link eliminates the problem of voice stuttering and tearing caused by text fragmentation through a three-level elastic buffer mechanism, and finally high-fidelity voice is rebuilt through stream TTS. The invention designs a satellite link binary byte packet protocol, which is realized by an AI service scheduling terminal and supports CRC check, dynamic FEC error correction and communication reliability guarantee. The invention supports bidirectional collaborative deployment of the edge equipment and the cloud server, thoroughly avoids tone quality damage of a low-code-rate vocoder, realizes bidirectional clear communication in a high-noise environment, and is suitable for low-code-rate channel scenes such as emergency communication, ocean navigation and the like.

title_en: Cross-attention fusion-based mixed modulation signal component identification method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of communication signal processing, and particularly relates to a cross-attention fusion-based mixed modulation signal component identification method. The method comprises constructing a mixed signal set composed of multiple digital modulation modes, randomly selecting 1-1 for each sample The method comprises the steps of carrying out linear superposition on modulation sources, superposing additive Gaussian white noise, obtaining an observation mixed signal, splitting a complex baseband signal into a time domain input formed by a real part and an imaginary part, carrying out short-time Fourier transform on the signal to form a two-dimensional time-frequency diagram as a frequency domain input, extracting features by a transform encoder of a time domain branch and a convolution neural network of a frequency domain branch respectively, realizing double-branch fusion by a cross-modal attention mechanism, and finally outputting a multi-label recognition result of the mixed modulation type and a coupling number recognition result of the number of source signals respectively. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device can effectively improve the identification accuracy of the mixed modulation signal under the condition of no multipath effect and the robustness under the scene of low signal to noise ratio.

title_en: Video resource allocation method, device, equipment and medium based on intention perception
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent decision making and discloses a video resource distribution method, a device, electronic equipment and a medium based on intention perception, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring video monitoring events in an unmanned aerial vehicle video monitoring system and multiple paths of video data transmitted by an unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring camera, and analyzing video priority queues of the multiple paths of video data according to the video monitoring events; analyzing video request parameters of a video priority queue according to the priority sequence, performing hierarchical visual rendering on the video priority queue according to the video request parameters to obtain initial rendered video, detecting pixel motions of multiple paths of video data to obtain a video motion result, and rendering and updating the initial rendered video according to the video motion result to obtain target rendered video. By detecting the pixel movement of the multipath video data, the dynamic hot spot change of the monitoring scene is accurately adapted, the initial rendering video is rendered and updated, and the resource allocation and hot spot pictures are linked in real time, so that the accuracy of the resource allocation is improved.

title_en: Digital television program safe receiving system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital television receiving, in particular to a digital television program safe receiving system and method, comprising an external safe receiving module and intelligent terminal equipment; the external module comprises a tuning demodulation unit, a safety chip and a USB interface controller, wherein the safety chip is integrated with a positioning receiver and a hardware safety module, the hardware safety module and the positioning receiver are integrated in the same system-in-package, and the intelligent terminal equipment comprises a USB host interface and an internal main control chip. The intelligent terminal equipment receives the transmission stream through the USB interface, and calls the built-in main control chip to complete the demultiplexing and decoding and then plays. The invention uses the existing chip of the intelligent television to carry out demultiplexing and decoding, reduces the cost of users, and simultaneously seals the decryption key and the positioning signature in a hardware safety environment, thereby meeting the controllable compliance requirement.

title_en: Method and apparatus for reporting signal measurements to a contact tracking network
abstract_en: Techniques for contact tracking using Wi-Fi based positioning are provided. An example method for reporting signal measurements to a contact tracking network includes activating a contact tracking application on a user equipment based on proximity to the contact tracking network, receiving one or more measurement signals from stations in the contact tracking network, and reporting the signal measurements and station identification to a network entity.

title_en: Quantum attack resistant SSL VPN communication method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application provides an SSL VPN communication method, device, equipment and medium for resisting quantum attack, which are used in the technical field of quantum secret communication and comprise the steps of responding to a query request sent by a user side, encrypting and packaging a first random array and a corresponding user identifier based on a quantum cipher card to obtain target encryption information and sending the target encryption information to the user side, receiving feedback information sent by the user side and decrypting the feedback information to obtain a corresponding target quantum random array and a corresponding time tag, carrying out hash computation on the target quantum random array and a second random array based on the time tag to obtain a corresponding key, determining a corresponding key confirmation code, sending the key and the key confirmation code to the user side, acquiring a service request sent by the user side based on a quantum SSL VPN channel, verifying the service request based on a quantum cipher card to obtain corresponding service feedback information and sending the corresponding service feedback information to the user side, and improving the safety of quantum communication.

title_en: Network digital space zero trust security construction method based on comprehensive audit monitoring
abstract_en: The application relates to a network digital space zero trust security construction method based on comprehensive audit monitoring. The method comprises the steps of collecting network digital space full-flow operation behaviors and normalizing, dynamically generating and embedding a global unique traceability marker for each access session, carrying out vectorization embedding and dependency relation calculation on event flow carrying markers through a time sequence-semantic joint model to obtain an aggregate representation vector reflecting a behavior mode, calculating a dynamic trust score in real time by combining a multidimensional dynamic audit baseline, generating a differentiated access control instruction by comparing the differential access control instruction with a multilevel trust threshold, and when the instruction is refused or forced authentication, reconstructing a behavior time line based on the pre-embedded traceability marker, and rapidly locking a responsibility main body and an operation path, thereby realizing closed loop of 'full audit-dynamic evaluation-precise management-high-efficient traceability', and achieving the technical effects of continuous verification, dynamic defense and precise traceability.

title_en: Method for electronic security assessment of a building automation system and building automation system
abstract_en: A method and building automation system for electronic security assessment of a building automation system is provided. The building automation system includes a controller and a network of electronic devices connected in electronic communication. The method includes requesting, by the controller via a secure channel, an electronic security scan of the controller with a data set of the controller for a cloud-based service. The method also includes initiating an electronic security scan of the controller based on the data set of the controller. The method also includes electronically evaluating a security breach of the building automation system. The method also includes electronically evaluating, by the controller, a security breach of an electronic device network that is electronically communicatively coupled to the controller. The method also includes determining a recommendation list for resolving security vulnerabilities of the building automation system based on the electronically assessed security vulnerabilities.

title_en: Method, system and storage medium for command interaction between client and equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method, a system and a storage medium for command interaction between a client and equipment, and relates to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the steps of receiving a service request sent by a client application, wherein the service request comprises a standard operation intention for describing service operation types and parameters, the service request is used for requesting to access target equipment, analyzing the standard operation intention into an intermediate semantic tree for expressing service operation logic, compiling the intermediate semantic tree into an instruction stream of a private protocol which can be executed by the target equipment according to a protocol mapping rule corresponding to the target equipment, and sending the instruction stream of the private protocol to the target equipment. The method of the embodiment of the application realizes the decoupling of the client service logic and the hardware private protocol, reduces the hardware adaptation cost and improves the system expansibility.

title_en: Equipment problem solving method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for solving equipment problems, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining problem feedback data submitted by an equipment end, inputting the problem feedback data into a problem judgment model, and obtaining a problem judgment result; under the condition that the target problem represented by the problem judging result actually exists, the problem feedback data are input into a problem classification model to obtain a problem classification result, a target repair path matched with the problem classification result is determined from a plurality of preset repair paths, the target problem is repaired according to the target repair path to obtain a repair result, resource synchronization data are pushed to the equipment terminal based on the repair result, and repair state information corresponding to the repair result is displayed through the equipment terminal.

title_en: Optical fiber room dividing system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of communication, and particularly discloses an optical fiber indoor division system and method, wherein the optical fiber indoor division system comprises a digital integrated circuit and a first photoelectric module which are connected through signals, a second photoelectric module, a microcontroller and an antenna module which are connected through signals, wherein the first photoelectric module and the second photoelectric module are connected through optical fibers, and the digital integrated circuit is configured to modulate LTE signals to have wavelengths Modulating NR signal to wavelength of carrier one of (2) Modulating the WIFI signal to a wavelength of carrier two The microcontroller is configured to receive carrier one to restore carrier one to an LTE signal, to receive carrier two to restore carrier two to an NR signal, and to receive carrier three to restore carrier three to a WIFI signal. Because the frequency difference of different carriers is larger, the frequency difference of different optical carriers is also larger, and the adjacent frequency interference condition is avoided.

title_en: High-mobility unmanned aerial vehicle network routing method based on bird swarm behavior and unmanned aerial vehicle bee swarm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle network routing, and discloses a high-mobility unmanned aerial vehicle network routing method based on bird swarm behavior and an unmanned aerial vehicle swarm, wherein the method comprises the steps that each unmanned aerial vehicle node records the meeting time and node ID of each meeting single-hop neighbor node, and starts meeting age timing; the method comprises the steps of obtaining the relative directions between each unmanned plane node and each single-hop neighbor node, respectively maintaining and generating independent routing tables for each unmanned plane node, using a source node as a starting point, inquiring the routing tables maintained by adjacent single-hop neighbor nodes layer by layer, obtaining the meeting ages of the single-hop neighbor nodes and a destination node, determining corresponding anchor nodes according to the meeting ages of each layer of single-hop neighbor nodes and the destination node, triggering the next network search layer by layer until the destination node is found and a routing path is established. The invention can realize the efficient unmanned aerial vehicle network routing technology based on the bird group behavior.

title_en: New QCL type for predictive beam management
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communications are described. A User Equipment (UE) may predict a beam for one set of resources based on measurements made via the beam and another set of resources. As described herein, a network entity may indicate a quasi co-located (QCL) relationship that indicates both temporal and spatial parameters. Such QCL relationships may increase the consistency between the predicted beam reported by the UE and the actual transmit beam used by the network entity for subsequent downlink transmissions. Such QCL relationships may combine temporal and spatial parameters indicated by other QCL relationships. QCL relationships may also be applicable to measurement beams and predicted beams, or machine learning models may be used to infer and predict training applications across beams.

title_en: Presbyopic glasses for preventing senile dementia patient from getting lost
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a prevention senile dementia patient wandering away presbyopic glasses, including the presbyopic glasses main part, the picture frame is installed to the one end of presbyopic glasses main part, and the lens is installed to the surperficial both sides of picture frame, and the mirror leg is installed at the both ends of picture frame, and the inside of mirror leg is the fretwork form setting, and solar charging module is installed to the inboard one end of mirror leg, and solar charging module's one side is installed and is removed the online module, removes the one side of online module and installs the GPS module, and Mini phone card plug-in card module is installed to one side. The utility model discloses a to the senile dementia patient of no normal behavior ability, the design need not charge the glasses of preventing wandering away that can continue a journey for a long time, inserts mini telephone card back by the guardian, regularly passes through GPRS radio frequency signal formation information sharing with the gps information of product position through removing the online module with the form of being interrupted, presents the positional information of user for the guardian.

title_en: Low-power-consumption digital acquisition equipment based on narrowband Internet of things
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a low-power consumption digital acquisition equipment based on narrowband thing networking, including casing, integrated circuit board, battery and a plurality of external sensor interface. The external sensor interface is arranged on the shell and used for connecting an external sensor; the integrated circuit board is packaged with a microprocessor, an NB-Iot module and a voltage conversion assembly; the NB-Iot module is used for carrying out wireless signal transmission with the server; the voltage conversion assembly is used for converting the voltage of the battery into a plurality of required voltages and supplying power to the microprocessor, the NB-Iot module and the external sensor; the microprocessor is used for controlling the output voltage of the voltage conversion assembly, the signal transmission of the NB-Iot module and the data processing of the external sensor. The digital acquisition equipment has the advantages of low power consumption, light weight, small volume, convenient carrying and the like.

title_en: Cloud recorded broadcast storage system equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cloud recording and broadcasting storage system device, which comprises a base, heat dissipation holes are arranged at the left side and the right side of the base, a fixed frame is welded inside the base, a fan is arranged inside the fixed frame, a baffle is fixedly arranged inside the base, a cooling pipe is arranged inside the base, which plays the role of heat dissipation and cooling, an installation cylinder is welded at the left side and the right side of the upper end of the base, slide rails are respectively arranged at the top and the bottom of the inner wall of the installation cylinder, a slide block is connected in the slide rails in a sliding manner, a movable rod is welded at the side of the slide block, a slide plate is fixedly connected at the other side of the movable rod, a mounting plate is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the installation cylinder, a movable groove is arranged at the top of the mounting plate, a limiting plate is movably connected, the disassembly is convenient, and the device is suitable for memories of different models.

title_en: Television receiver
abstract_en: The utility model provides a television, include: the television comprises a strip-shaped main body support, wherein a first strip-shaped groove transversely penetrating through the main body support is formed in the main body support, a groove opening faces the back of the television, and the bottom of one end of the first strip-shaped groove is provided with a remote control display opening; the back of the screen component is fixedly connected with the main body bracket and is provided with an electric control component; the pair of corner blocks are respectively embedded into two ends of the first strip-shaped groove along the penetrating direction, a remote control assembly mounting port is formed in one side, far away from the remote control display port, of the corner block close to the remote control display port, a through chamber is formed between the remote control assembly mounting port and the remote control display port, a remote control assembly is mounted in the through chamber, and the remote control assembly is electrically connected with the electric control assembly; the rear cover plate is connected with the corner block close to the remote control display opening so as to cover the remote control assembly mounting opening; and the rear shell is fixedly connected with the back surface of the screen assembly and seals one side of the television on the back surface of the screen assembly. The utility model discloses remote control subassembly among the TV set assembles easily and targets in place, and the packaging efficiency is high, and is with low costs.

title_en: Handheld comprehensive test terminal supporting WIFI6 router speed measurement
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of communication technology, a handheld comprehensive test terminal that WIFI6 router that test data accuracy and efficient support tests speed is disclosed possesses: at least one RF detector circuit configured in the test terminal, the RF detector circuit being configured to acquire a data signal of the network line; at least one push-pull circuit, the input end of which is coupled to the output end of the RF detection circuit, the push-pull circuit is used for amplifying the data signal input by the RF detection circuit; and the input end of the microprocessor is connected with the output end of the push-pull circuit, and the microprocessor is used for processing the data signal amplified by the push-pull circuit.

title_en: Firewall equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of firewall equipment, in particular to firewall equipment, which comprises an equipment main body and a main control board, wherein the top end of the equipment main body is connected with an access board, the top end of the access board is connected with a bolt, one side of the equipment main body is provided with a heat dissipation hole, one end of the heat dissipation hole is provided with a switch, the base surface of the equipment main body is respectively provided with a display screen, a network output end, a network input end and a power interface, the back end of the equipment main body is connected with a heat dissipation fan, the heat dissipation fan is connected with a dust screen near one side of the equipment main body, the outer end of the heat dissipation fan is connected with a fixed frame, one end of the main control board is respectively connected with a data memory, a power supply and a temperature sensor, one end of the data memory, the electric energy loss of the equipment main body is reduced, so that the equipment is more efficient in use.

title_en: Monitoring device and system for hidden area of transformer substation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses embodiment provides a monitoring devices and system of transformer substation hidden area belongs to the fortune dimension technical field of transformer substation. The monitoring device includes: a monitoring unit comprising: a main body; the lens is used for acquiring the image of the hidden area; the infrared temperature measuring port is used for collecting the temperature of the equipment in the hidden area; the flash lamp is arranged near the lens and used for illuminating the hidden area; the temperature and humidity sensor is arranged on the side surface of the main body and used for acquiring the ambient temperature and humidity of the hidden area; the data analysis and processing unit is connected with the monitoring unit and is used for processing the monitoring information of the monitoring unit through a preset algorithm; the first Bluetooth unit is connected with the data analysis and processing unit and is used for being connected with the inspection robot in a matching way so as to send monitoring information of the monitoring unit; and the first mobile network unit is connected with the data analysis and processing unit and is used for being connected with a background server to upload the monitoring information.

title_en: Intelligent gateway system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent gateway system, which comprises an equipment access module, a protocol conversion module, a power module and a communication module, wherein the power module is used for providing stable power for other modules; the equipment access module is used for accessing a physical communication interface for terminal equipment; the protocol conversion module is used for establishing the conversion of protocols among different street lamp controllers, the conversion of protocols among different sensors and the conversion of data structures, analyzing the content of a data structure body sent by the monitoring center through the communication module, analyzing the service data according to the protocol according to the content, sending the service data to the equipment access layer, receiving the data of the equipment access layer, analyzing the data according to the protocol and sending the content of the data structure to the communication layer; the communication module is used for being responsible for communication between the intelligent gateway and the intelligent platform.

title_en: Wireless cable dynamometer based on 4G cloud computing
abstract_en: A clueless dynamometer based on 4G cloud computing is characterized in that equipment comprises: the device comprises a power supply module, a sensing module, a storage module, a communication module and a main control chip; the binding belt also comprises a shell and a binding belt; wherein: each module is integrated on a circuit board, is arranged in the shell through the circuit board, fixes the whole functional equipment on the bridgewire of the tested object through the shell and the binding tape, and ensures that the sensitive end of the sensing module is contacted with the bridgewire of the tested object; the power supply module provides energy for the whole equipment; the sensing module is used for acquiring acceleration data; the storage module is used for storing the acquired acceleration data and sending the acceleration data to the cloud end through the communication module; the communication module adopts a 4G module or a 5G module to transmit the acquired data to the cloud end; the main control chip is simultaneously connected with the power supply module, the sensing module, the storage module and the communication module and used for managing data acquisition, storage and transmission.

title_en: High-efficient cooling network switch rack
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rack technical field just discloses a high-efficient cooling network switch rack, include: the cabinet body, hinge fixedly connected with cabinet door is passed through on the surface of the cabinet body, the positive fixedly connected with handle of cabinet door, the inner wall fixedly connected with support bar of the cabinet body, and the surperficial sliding connection of support bar has and places the box, the front of placing the box is provided with fixing device, the top fixedly connected with reason line device of placing the box, the top of placing the box is provided with locking device. This high-efficient cooling network switch rack opens the cabinet door through holding the handle, and the pulling fixed strip makes square pipe remove to the one end of keeping away from the spring, and the spring is in tensile state under the drive of square pipe simultaneously, places the switch in placing the box, loosens the fixed strip and makes the spring drive square pipe under the effect of tension, can make the fixed strip fix the switch, has reached the effect of protecting the switch.

title_en: Overhead wireless router
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a top-mounted wireless router, including router body, installation casing, the upper end surface of router body is provided with the erection column, the surface of erection column is provided with the rubber layer, the surface of installation casing is provided with the draw-in groove, the bottom of draw-in groove is provided with the mounting hole, the upper end surface of installation casing is provided with the viscose circle, the inside of installation casing is provided with heat radiation structure. A top-mounted wireless router, through mutually supporting of installation casing, erection column, rubber layer, mounting hole, viscose circle, it is comparatively convenient when installing the router, avoided traditional bolt, bolt fastening, can not cause destruction to the ceiling, and comparatively simple when dismantling, be favorable to overhauing the router, through heat radiation structure's effect, can improve the radiating effect of router in the router use, avoid the router to generate heat and cause the influence to its use.

title_en: Two-channel LORA gateway equipment based on CAT-1
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a CAT-1-based dual-channel LORA gateway device, relates to the technical field of Internet of things, solves the problems of poor universality and high use cost of the existing gateway device, improves the expansibility and the usability of the gateway device, and reduces the use cost, and the specific scheme is as follows: a CAT-1-based dual-channel LORA gateway device, comprising: the system comprises an LORA module, an Ethernet controller module and a CAT-1 module; the LORA module comprises a first LORA module and a second LORA module, the first LORA module and the second LORA module are respectively communicated with different LORA node devices, and the first LORA module and the second LORA module are respectively connected with a CAT-1 module; the CAT-1 module is connected with the Ethernet controller module and is communicated with an external server through a CAT-1 network; and the Ethernet controller module is communicated with an external server through a network port.

title_en: Parking space navigation system based on UWB positioning and parking lot management system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a parking space navigation system based on UWB positioning, comprising: the vehicle-mounted ETC system comprises an OBU module, a UWB receiving module, a parking space identification camera, a parking management cloud platform, a mobile device and a vehicle-mounted computer. The UWB receiving module is integrated into an OBU module of the vehicle-mounted ETC; the parking space recognition camera sends a parking space state recognition result to the parking management cloud platform; UWB basic station transmitting signal in the parking stall discernment camera, UWB receives the mould and receives the signal after, forms the location, the OBU module and the mobile device or the on-vehicle computer of on-vehicle ETC carry out the communication, mobile device and on-vehicle computer are after obtaining available parking stall information with parking management cloud platform communication, and the user can find the parking stall through the parking stall navigation module and the interior electronic map of parking area accuracy. Compared with the prior art, the parking space navigation method and the parking space navigation system can realize automatic identification of the available parking spaces and carry out parking space navigation.

title_en: Digital media conference system processing platform for multi-channel data transmission
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a digital media conference system processing platform for multi-channel data transmission, which comprises a conference terminal and a multimedia terminal, wherein a data module is arranged between the conference terminal and the multimedia terminal, the data module comprises a main control unit responsible for core logic, a data receiving unit responsible for information interaction with the conference terminal and a data transmitting unit responsible for information interaction with the multimedia terminal, and a data conversion module responsible for data compiling and converting is arranged on a signal circuit between the data receiving unit or the data transmitting unit and the main control unit; the conference terminal comprises a fixed conference terminal and a mobile conference terminal, the fixed conference terminal is connected with the data module through a wired signal, and the mobile conference terminal is connected with the data module through a wireless signal.

title_en: Wireless broadcast television transmitting system and transmitting base station
abstract_en: The embodiment relates to a wireless broadcast television transmitting system and a transmitting base station. The system comprises: the iron tower is used for mounting an antenna; a receiving unit for receiving a radio signal source; the transmitting unit is electrically connected with the iron tower and used for transmitting a radio signal; the power distribution unit comprises a power supply module and a power distribution cabinet electrically connected with the power supply module, and is respectively electrically connected with the iron tower, the receiving unit and the transmitting unit and used for supplying power to the iron tower, the receiving unit and the transmitting unit; the control unit is respectively electrically connected with the receiving unit, the transmitting unit and the power distribution unit and is used for controlling the receiving unit to receive a radio signal source, controlling the transmitting unit to transmit a radio signal and controlling the power distribution unit to supply power; and the grounding unit is respectively electrically connected with the iron tower, the receiving unit, the transmitting unit, the power distribution unit and the control unit and is used for grounding the iron tower, the receiving unit, the transmitting unit, the power distribution unit and the control unit.

title_en: One-key starting control system for passenger car
abstract_en: The utility model provides a one-key start control system for a passenger car, which comprises: the controller is connected with a whole vehicle circuit of the passenger vehicle and controls the whole vehicle circuit by outputting a control signal; the starting switch is arranged on the passenger car instrument desk and generates a control signal by changing the state of the starting switch; the low-frequency antenna is arranged at one side of a driver, senses the position of the driver and transmits a position signal to the controller; and the high-frequency antenna is arranged on one side of the controller, is connected with the controller and is used for receiving the high-frequency signal sent by the induction key. The operation flow of a driver can be simplified, the complex and tedious starting or flameout operation can be automatically realized only by pressing the operation switch after the brake is stepped, and the labor intensity of the driver can be reduced.

title_en: VC liquid cooling router
abstract_en: The utility model aims to provide a VC liquid cooling router, which comprises a shell, a first liquid cooling channel and a second liquid cooling channel, wherein the shell consists of a first shell and a second shell and is arranged at the lower part of the router; the control device is positioned in the shell and fixed below the second shell; the transmitting device is movably connected above the shell; and the heat dissipation device is positioned below the control device and is fixed on the first shell. The VC liquid cooling router comprises a control device for realizing signal conversion, a transmitting device which comprises a connecting piece and an antenna and is connected with the control device to enable the converted signals to be transmitted out in a wireless mode, and a heat dissipation device which comprises a VC plate, a fan and a heat dissipation fin and is used for continuously dissipating heat of the control device in the VC liquid cooling mode to enable the router to work stably.

title_en: Image acquisition device and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of data transmission, in particular to an image acquisition device and system based on the Internet of things, wherein the image acquisition device based on the Internet of things comprises a control unit and an image acquisition unit connected with the control unit, the control unit is formed by a first chip, and the image acquisition unit is formed by a second chip; the RGB2 pin of the first chip is connected with the DOUT2 pin of the second chip; the RGB3 pin of the first chip is connected with the DOUT3 pin of the second chip; the RGB4 pin of the first chip is connected with the DOUT4 pin of the second chip; the RGB5 pin of the first chip is connected with the DOUT5 pin of the second chip; the RGB6 pin of the first chip is connected with the DOUT6 pin of the second chip; the RGB7 pin of the first chip is connected with the DOUT7 pin of the second chip.

title_en: MiniPCIE changes two giga net gape cards
abstract_en: The utility model provides a miniPPIC to double kilomega network interface card, comprising: a board card body; two sides of the board card body are provided with a golden finger connector, a first board alignment connector and a second board alignment connector; the board card body is provided with a network controller chip, an EEPROM chip, a first network transformer, a second network transformer and a programming burning debugging interface; the golden finger connector is connected with the network controller chip through a PCB on the board card body; the network controller chip is connected with the first board wire alignment connector through a first network transformer; the network controller chip converts miniCIE signals into standard double-gigabit network port signals, the network transformer outputs the standard double-gigabit network port signals to the board-to-board connector, the function of expanding network interfaces is achieved, the multi-network connection is convenient to use, and interconnection and data transmission of multiple devices can be completed.

title_en: Novel mechanical system equipment multinode sensor electrical connection network deployment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel mechanical system equipment multi-node sensor electrical connection networking, wherein a gear box side composite function sensor and a motor side composite function sensor are both connected with a temperature multi-core cable and a vibration multi-core cable, the left side of a concentrator is connected with two input adapters, the right side of the concentrator is connected with two output adapters, a distributing plate and a wire protecting sleeve are arranged in the concentrator, the temperature multi-core cable and the vibration multi-core cable are inserted into the input adapters, the other ends of the temperature multi-core cable and the vibration multi-core cable penetrate through the wire protecting sleeve and are in an X-shaped cross recombination structure, the two temperature multi-core cables penetrate through the output adapters at the upper part of the right side of the concentrator to be connected with a collected temperature detection end, and the two vibration multi-core cables penetrate through the output adapters at the lower part of the right side of the concentrator to be connected with the collected vibration detection end. This practicality can carry out categorised reorganization as required with different grade type signal cable, and the overall planning of the signal of being convenient for is handled and analysis and engineering planning and maintenance, has improved fastening nature and leakproofness simultaneously.

title_en: Gateway for intelligent home network
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gateway for an intelligent home network, which has the technical scheme key points that: the air-exchange type air-conditioner shell comprises a shell and a core body arranged in an inner cavity of the shell, wherein a hollow mounting plate is fixedly connected in the inner cavity of the shell, the core body is fixedly arranged at the top of the hollow mounting plate, a plurality of air vents are formed in the bottom of the shell, and a plurality of air-exchange assemblies are arranged between the hollow mounting plate and the bottom of the inner cavity of the shell; four corners of the bottom of the shell are respectively provided with a buffer assembly for buffering, the shell is provided with a plurality of network cable jacks, a power supply jack and a USB jack, the side end faces of the four sides of the shell are respectively provided with an anti-collision assembly, and the top of the shell is fixedly connected with a rubber buffer pad; the problem of among the prior art gateway barrier propterty poor, can't carry out all-round protection to the gateway, the accident falls or receives easy damage when striking is effectively solved.

title_en: Remote PM2.5 concentration detection device
abstract_en: A remote PM2.5 concentration detection device comprises a shell, a voltage-stabilized power supply, a PM2.5 detector body, a short message module, a vibration motor and an axial fan; the device is also provided with a control circuit and a signal acquisition circuit; the device comprises a shell, a vibration motor, an axial flow fan, a PM2.5 detector body and a water tank, wherein the shell is provided with a movable door, the inner lower end of the shell is provided with the water tank, water is filled in the water tank, two ends of the shell are respectively provided with an air inlet and an air outlet, the vibration motor is arranged at one end of the shell, the axial flow fan is arranged at the rear part of the air inlet, and the PM2.5 detector body is arranged at the rear part of the axial flow fan; the stabilized voltage power supply, the short message module, the control circuit and the signal acquisition circuit are arranged in the shell and electrically connected. This novel air sample of gathering is more, and the detector body can reach better detection effect to relevant region, can prevent that the dust granule is too much to the influence that PM2.5 detector body work brought, distinguishes according to three magnitude of a force to the PM2.5 data of witnessed inspections to for the different SMS contents of the cell-phone propelling movement of the relevant personnel of distal end, played powerful technical support for formulating the pertinence measure.

title_en: Dual-mode radio frequency system supporting 5G and WIFI
abstract_en: The utility model provides a support 5G and WIFI's bimodulus radio frequency system, include: the CPU mainboard is connected with the WIFI module through a PCIe interface and is connected with the FPGA chip through an SGMII interface and an SPI interface; the FPGA chip is connected with the 5G radio frequency module through a 204B interface; the 5G radio frequency module is used for releasing a 5G signal; and the WIFI module is used for releasing the WIFI signal. The dual-mode radio frequency system integrates the WIFI module and the 5G radio frequency module, the coverage of WIFI signals and 5G signals can be achieved by using one set of system, and the construction efficiency of a wireless network is improved.

title_en: 5G single-channel frequency shift remote terminal
abstract_en: The utility model provides a 5G single channel frequency shift remote terminal, include: the 5G single-path frequency shift remote terminal comprises a single chip microcomputer, an FPGA synchronous module, a clock chip, a frequency mixer and a multi-function device; the single chip microcomputer, the FPGA synchronous module, the clock chip and the frequency mixer are connected with one another in pairs, and the multi-function device is connected with the input end of the frequency mixer. The input end of the multifunctional device is connected with the 5G single-path frequency shift near-end machine through a feeder line, the multifunctional device comprises three output ends, 1.1G, 1.3G and the second path of 3.5G radio frequency output signals are respectively output, and the 1.1G radio frequency output signals and the 1.3G radio frequency output signals are correspondingly connected with the two input ends of the frequency mixer one by one. And the output end of the frequency mixer outputs a first path of 3.5G radio frequency output signal. The utility model has the advantages that: modular design, can install and remove. Low cost and short development period.

title_en: Intelligent temperature control equipment for router
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a temperature regulating equipment especially relates to an intelligent temperature regulating equipment for router. The intelligent temperature control equipment with the protection function for the router is provided. The utility model provides an intelligent temperature control equipment for router, is including base, mount, protecting frame, filter screen, support frame, motor, flabellum and fender rod etc. and the base top is connected with the mount, and the mount intermediate junction has the protecting frame, and the inside upside of protecting frame is connected with the filter screen, and the protecting frame inboard is connected with the support frame, and the motor is installed to the support frame inboard, and the output shaft of motor has the flabellum, and the vertical position of the inside downside of protecting frame is connected with five fender rods uniformly. The utility model discloses a be equipped with control module and temperature-sensing ware, respond to the temperature of router through temperature-sensing ware, control module just can control motor start or close, avoids the high temperature of router and influences work.

title_en: Household detachable cloud equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a domestic reassembling type cloud equipment, the connecting plate comprises a connecting plate, the fixed mounting panel that is equipped with in top at the connecting plate back, a plurality of screws have been seted up to mounting panel one side, the both sides side at the connecting plate back is all fixed and is equipped with the connecting block, one side of two connecting blocks all is equipped with the slide bar jointly, the both sides of slide bar are all overlapped and are equipped with the spring, through being provided with the carriage release lever, first kelly, first fixed block, a spring, the STB, the mounting panel, install mounting panel at waiting to install wall or workstation, remove two carriage release levers to both ends, the carriage release lever removes and extrudees the spring, with STB and second kelly block back, loosen the carriage release lever, make first kelly and first fixed block under spring elastic deformation, make family cloud equipment can install according to actual conditions through this kind of mode, and convenient the dismantlement after the installation, reduce family cloud equipment fixing position limitation, increase the convenience that family cloud equipment used.

title_en: Maintenance detection equipment for communication base station
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a maintenance detection device for a communication base station, which comprises a three-wheel drive walking unit, wherein the top end of the three-wheel drive walking unit is provided with a lifting mechanism, the top end of the lifting mechanism is provided with a support plate, and an elastic protective cover is arranged between the three-wheel drive walking unit and the support plate; the top middle part of backup pad is provided with the casing, and the inside of casing is provided with adjustment mechanism, and adjustment mechanism's top sets up to the camera, and the top of casing and the outside that is located adjustment mechanism are provided with the dirt proof boot. The utility model has the advantages of reasonable and reliable structure, easy operation is convenient, can detect the observation to communication base station computer lab internal plant through the camera, detects communication base station's signal through basic station signal detector to can provide help for the staff to communication base station's maintenance, and then can guarantee communication base station's good operation.

title_en: Intelligent switch
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of switches, in particular to an intelligent switch, which integrates the functions of a PoE switch, a charger and a docking station, provides power and data transmission for an output port through a PoE power supply circuit and a switch circuit, and provides a charging function and a data transmission function for a port connection module through a fast charging circuit and a switch circuit, so that all ports of the intelligent switch can provide power and output transmission capacity outwards, and the docking station can provide power and data transmission functions for back-end equipment at the same time, namely, a user side does not need to use two devices to charge and transmit data, and the intelligent switch is more convenient to use.

title_en: Elevator one-key dialing intercom system and elevator comprising same
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an elevator one-key dialing intercom system and an elevator comprising the same. The one-key dialing intercom system of the elevator comprises a calling button and a calling button, wherein the calling button is arranged on an operation box panel of an elevator car and receives intercom requests of users; the intercom, it sets up in the inside of the control box of elevator car, the memory module of intercom is configured to have stored at least one telephone number in advance, the main control module of intercom is configured to obtain at least one telephone number of storing in advance in the memory module, when receiving user's intercom request through the call button, send the at least one telephone number that obtains to communication module in order, communication module of intercom is configured to carry out corresponding call communication in order based on received telephone number, until call communication is successful or the calling of all received telephone numbers has been accomplished. The utility model can improve the possibility of successful call communication of the trapped elevator user.

title_en: Out-of-band network management equipment
abstract_en: The application provides out-of-band network management equipment, relates to the technical field of communication, and can solve the problems of high operation and maintenance cost and low data security of operation and maintenance work. The apparatus includes: the device comprises a battery module, a display module, a network connection interface and a data processing module; the battery module is connected with the display module, and the display module is respectively connected with the network connection module and the data processing module; wherein: the battery module is used for supplying power to the out-of-band network management equipment; the display module is used for inputting parameters of each interface in the out-of-band network management equipment; the network connection module is used for accessing at least one network for the out-of-band network management equipment; the data processing module is used for establishing a remote control channel for the out-of-band network management equipment. The embodiment of the application is used in the network operation and maintenance working process.

title_en: Router convenient to adjust
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of routers, and particularly discloses a router convenient to adjust, which comprises a router base, wherein a rubber pad is arranged on the inner wall of the router base, a shell is movably arranged on the inner side of the router base, limiting pieces are arranged on two sides of the shell, a tension spring is arranged on the inner side of the router base, a hook plate is movably arranged above the router base through a limiting mechanism, a toggle arc block is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the hook plate, and a jack is formed in the outer surface of the toggle arc block. This router convenient to adjust need not directly to clean the router body when cleaning router shell surface accumulation's dust, and the restriction to the hanging axle can be removed to the direct stop gear that lets couple board through adjusting, can take off the router shell and carry out thoroughly and convenient cleanness, avoids the inside components and parts damage that causes of router of water stain erosion in the cleaning process.

title_en: Standard signal system device electrical performance inspection platform
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electrical performance inspection platform for a standard signal system device, which consists of a liquid crystal screen, a garage signal board, an upper wellhead signal board, a horizontal signal board, a telephone board module and a DC24V intrinsic safety power supply. The liquid crystal screen is connected with an RS485 interface of the automobile room signal board through the RS485 interface; the garage signal board is respectively connected with the upper wellhead signal board, the horizontal signal board and the telephone board module through the CAN interface; the inspection platform can simultaneously detect the electrical properties of a liquid crystal screen, a car room signal board, an upper wellhead signal board, a horizontal signal board and a telephone board module in a signal system, has the characteristics of safe and reliable detection, simplicity and easiness in operation, convenience in replacement and accurate monitoring of equipment faults, and can be transmitted to a PC end for storage through Ethernet communication, so that workers can conveniently collect and analyze equipment information.

title_en: Distributed mobile gateway
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a distributed mobile gateway, which comprises a gateway equipment body, wherein an interface is arranged on the front surface of the gateway equipment body, two antennas are fixedly arranged on the rear side of the gateway equipment body, and a protection structure is arranged on the front surface of the gateway equipment body. This decentralized mobile gateway through setting up protective structure, when this gateway equipment is idle not used, pulls positive handle of dust cover left, makes it drive the dust cover and removes left, and the slider of upper and lower both sides is driven in the inside of spout when the dust cover removes slides left, and first magnet on the slider moves left along with the slider, until first magnet and second magnet contact realize that the opposite phase between the magnet attracts, and then fix the position of dust cover for the dust cover covers a plurality of interface is whole in it, avoids impurity such as dust to get into in the interface on the gateway equipment body, causes the problem of interface inner contact failure.

title_en: Lifting rail robot with image recognition function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hanger rail robot with an image recognition function, which comprises a robot main body, wherein one end of the robot main body is provided with a shockproof moving mechanism, a steering mechanism is arranged in the robot main body, one end of the steering mechanism is provided with an image recognition mechanism, one end of the robot main body is symmetrically provided with fixing sheets, one side of each fixing sheet is symmetrically provided with a shockproof assembly, one end of each shockproof assembly is fixedly connected with a hub motor, an extension sheet is arranged between the fixing sheets, one end of each extension sheet is provided with a positioning wheel, and the hanger rail robot has the beneficial effects that: the vibration-proof moving mechanism counteracts vibration generated by the device in moving by using the vibration-proof assembly, so that the stability of the device is further improved, the situation that the service life of internal mechanical elements of the device is reduced due to vibration and the like is prevented, a steering mechanism is arranged in the device, and the steering mechanism enables a steering shaft to rotate through a first bevel gear and a second bevel gear, so that the image recognition mechanism has a larger detection range.

title_en: Intelligent charging device based on Internet of things
