The 3D reconfigurable memory I/O interface using a quad-band interconnect (QBI) suggested in the present invention comprises: a plurality of RF band transceivers including a plurality of RF band transmitters which generate RF carrier signals by using different bands and convert an input data stream for the generated RF carrier signals into ASK modulated signals, and a plurality of RF band receivers which receive ASK modulated signals from the plurality of RF band transmitters through quad-band transformers, convert the ASK modulated signals into BaseBand (BB) data, and amplify and filter the converted BB data signals; a single BB transceiver including a BB transmitter which transmits the input data stream to the quad-band transformers, and a BB receiver which receives a data stream from the quad-band transformers; the quad-band transformers for reconfigurable multi-band data communication between the plurality of RF band transceivers and the single BB transceiver; and a shared short 3D interconnect between the quad-band transformers. According to the present invention, a 3D integrated circuit technique can reduce signal latency and improve signal integrity.

title_en: Customized platform provision system for infants
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a customized platform provision system for infants, which may be realized to fabricate and provide infant-customized video contents provided in an untact manner to improve learning, improve creativity, develop emotions and improve physical health of infants. To this end, the present invention comprises: a content filming booth which is provided to film a video for making infant-customized contents; a learner terminal which is connected to an exclusive webpage or an exclusive application provided to provide infant-customized platform provision service to receive infant-customized contents made by using the video filmed in the content filming booth before providing the same to a learner; and a platform constructing server which makes the infant-customized contents, made by using the video filmed in the content filming booth, into a database to store the same, and provides in real time the infant-customized contents, made by using the video which is being filmed in the content filming booth in response to a content provision request received from the learner terminal, or provides after searching the requested infant-customized contents from the infant-customized contents stored in the database.

title_en: The Method that Provide A Visually Assistive Interface for Color Blind People
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for providing a visual assistance interface for a color weak person, which displays a grid window formed in a grid shape on a screen in an overlay type, derives a color of a display pixel of the screen corresponding to each position of a plurality of grid pixels located inside the grid window as text color information composed of text, and displays the same at a position of the corresponding grid pixel.

title_en: Apparatus and method for providing customized service
abstract_en: A device for providing a customized service according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a moving part controlled to move to a place wherein a user can be recognized; a collecting part that collects photographing information related to the user through a visual sensor; a derivation part that inputs the information collected through the collecting part into at least one or more analysis models and derives element information for each analysis model; a situation recognition part that integrates the element information of each derived analysis model to generate integrated information, and recognizes a current situation of the user based on the integrated information to generate situation information; and a service providing part that provides a customized service to the user based on the situation information.

title_en: In-memory based data processing system and method for real-time mass data collecting, processing and storing of edge
abstract_en: Disclosed are an in-memory-based data processing system and method for real-time collection, processing, and storage of large-capacity edge data. To this end, the in-memory-based data processing system according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: an SNET module configured to enable edge and two-way online transaction processing (OLTP) to collect and analyze data from the edge, generating an action command according to a preset action condition, and transmitting the action command to the edge; an SDB module for storing information collected from an external RDBMS and environmental information for each user and service; and a CAST module for constructing partially filtered data required for an application service in the SDB module as an in-memory DB and processing a transaction of the application service based on a data analysis result in the SNET module and the in-memory DB.

title_en: System and method for performing transmission cancellation indication monitoring
abstract_en: Provided is a method for providing a transmission grant to a UE device by means of a network. The method includes a step of initiating a process to provide a transmission grant for a transmission within a particular time. The method includes a step of verifying that there is no cancellation indication that overlaps the particular time. The method includes a step of providing, based on a verification that there is no cancellation indication that overlaps, the transmission grant to the UE device. The method includes a step of determining that there is no transmission overlapping a cancellation window associated with a monitoring opportunity and omitting the monitoring opportunity based on the determination. Also disclosed is a system for providing a transmission grant to a UE device.

title_en: System for preventing false offerings of used car
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for preventing false offerings of a used car, which can prevent damage from false offerings by providing the location of a used car for sale in real time when the used car registered on a sales site is for sale. To this end, the present invention provides the system for preventing false offerings of a used car, which comprises: a location providing terminal connected to a vehicle for sale, receiving power from the vehicle for sale, providing location information on the vehicle for sale, and including a terminal unique identification code; a sales management server which receives vehicle information about the vehicle for sale and the terminal unique identification code to check transaction validity, and when the validity is authenticated, generates sale information and a sale unique key value based on the vehicle information and the terminal unique identification code; and a buyer terminal which inquires for the sale information on the vehicle for sale and transmits a specific terminal unique identification code and vehicle identification number of a specific vehicle for sale.

title_en: A vehicle information service providing method and a apparatus using vehicle information sharing service networks based on block chains
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a method relates to an operation method of a vehicle information service providing device includes: collecting at least one of vehicle sharing service information, vehicle maintenance information, and vehicle insurance information shared from a block chain-based vehicle sharing service network; processing the vehicle service information based on the collected information; and providing the processed vehicle service information to one or more user terminals or service devices. Therefore, it is possible to participate in various operators and to reflect feedback of service users.

title_en: Apparatus and method for encryption, apparatus and method for converting ciphertext
abstract_en: According to an embodiment, an encryption method comprises the following steps of: generating a cipher text for a secret key, which is an integer vector, by using a first homomorphic encryption algorithm based on integers; generating a key stream which is an integer vector from a nonce and the secret key by using a key stream generator; encoding the key stream by using a message encoding function of the first homomorphic encryption algorithm; encoding a message, which is a real vector, by using a message encoding function of a second homomorphic encryption algorithm based on real numbers; generating a cipher text for the message by using an encoding result of the key stream and an encoding result of the message; and transmitting the nonce, the cipher text for the secret key, and the cipher text for the message to a cipher text conversion device.

title_en: System for uav assisted relay ad-hoc network system and method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an ad-hoc network relay system to control traffics concentrated on an UAV. According to the present invention, the system comprises: a plurality of ground nodes searching for a route to a destination node when entering a network, identifies routing policy areas defined so that packets are transmitted in different routing methods on the basis of routing parameters received from a UAV when a path is discovered, and transmitting a packet to the ground node or the UAV according to any one of routing policy areas depending on a load state of the UAV and importance of the packet to be transmitted; and at least one UAV receiving the pack to the received packet to the destination node through a public path when the packet is transmitted from the ground node, calculating the load state of the ground node and the load state of the public network collected from messages broadcast by the plurality of ground nodes, determining the routing parameters for determining a boundary between the routing policy areas on the basis of the calculated load conditions, and broadcasting the determined routing parameters to the ground nodes.

title_en: Electronic apparatus, control method thereof and server
abstract_en: An electronic device is disclosed. The electronic device comprises: a memory storing a composite function in which two or more polynomials are combined; and a processor for reflecting and operating a plurality of homomorphic ciphertexts to the composite function and obtaining a comparison result of the plurality of homomorphic ciphertexts based on an operation result when a comparison operation command for the plurality of homomorphic ciphertexts is received. Each of the two or more polynomials outputs a value within a preset range for a value within a preset domain and a domain of one of the two or more polynomials may be determined based on a range of a previous polynomial.

title_en: System and method for transferring data between nodes in wireless sensor network
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and method for internode data transmission on a wireless sensor network. The method for internode data transmission on a wireless sensor network comprises the following steps of: classifying a plurality of nodes into at least one group based on a distance between the plurality of nodes and each sink node; classifying at least one node belonging to a first group of the at least one group, into at least one sub group; selecting a first head node from among at least one node belonging to the at least one sub group; and enabling the first head node to transmit at least one of data of the first head node and data of the at least one node belonging to the at least one sub group, to the sink node. Therefore, the present invention is capable of optimally and quickly transmitting data while preventing and minimizing a waste of resources.

title_en: Apparatus and method for providing credit insurance information in a financial system that provides peer to peer loan service using blockchain
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a financial system that provides peer-to-peer lending services between a borrower and at least one investor using a blockchain. According to the present disclosure, a method of operating an insurance money payment system in a financial system includes the steps of: creating, by a blockchain network device, an insurance pool indicating a virtual wallet for compensating for the principal loss of the at least one investor by clustering the nodes constituting the blockchain network; paying, by at least one investor, the investment to the borrower through the deposit management server; paying, by the borrower, the principal and interest corresponding to the investment to the deposit management server; converting, by the deposit management server, at least a part of the principal and interest into cryptocurrency through an exchange and paying an insurance premium to a virtual account of the blockchain network; and storing, by the blockchain network device, the insurance premium in the insurance pool.

title_en: Remote control solution server that identifies the location of communication equipment using shooting information
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a remote control solution server. The present invention comprises: a communication part that receives the photographing information comprising the image information for a communication equipment from a first person in charge terminal; and a communication equipment location guide part that extracts the first coordinate information for which is a photographing point of the communication equipment from the photographing information, and sets the first coordinate information as the location information of the communication equipment. Therefore, the present invention is capable of solving a problem of a GPS transmission/reception failure.

title_en: Method for proximity communication between terminals and apparatus thereof
abstract_en: A proximity communication method between terminals and a terminal like that are provided. A communication method between terminals, according to an embodiment of the present invention, comprises the steps of: establishing a connection between a first terminal and a second terminal via a first communication channel using a first protocol; transmitting, by the first terminal, a first message comprising a public key of the first terminal to the second terminal through the first communication channel; storing, by the second terminal, the public key of the first terminal; transmitting, by the second terminal, a second message comprising the public key of the second terminal to the first terminal through the first communication channel; and storing, by the first terminal, the public key of the second terminal.

title_en: Method and apparatus for processing data based on wireless multiple link
abstract_en: According to a preferred embodiment of the present invention, a wireless multi-link based data processing method and a device thereof comprise: a multi-data processing logic for a case when a message is inputted through two or more links among wireless multi-links; and a processing logic for a case when a message is inputted through only one link among the wireless multi-links, thereby receiving data through the only one link in the wireless multi-links or processing duplicate data without link performance degradation, regardless of whether the message is received through the two or more links.

title_en: Virtual platooning method based on beamforming in V2X environment
abstract_en: Provided is a virtual platooning method based on beamforming in a V2X environment. The virtual platooning method according to an embodiment of the present invention generates a virtual platooning group with the surrounding vehicles, and shares the driving-related information with the surrounding vehicles included in the virtual platooning group. Accordingly, a channel usage time for vehicles not included in other virtual platooning groups increases by performing communication only between the vehicles in the same virtual platooning group, does not wait for the channel to be empty in a situation wherein an emergency signal (for example, emergency stop situation) needs to be transmitted, and the channel can be used directly to transmit the emergency signal to other vehicles.

title_en: Apparatus for voluntary helper based emergency support service
abstract_en: A voluntary helper-based emergency rescue service device, which is capable of determining helpers whose number of rescue participations exceeds a certain standard as super helpers and providing a user terminal with locations of the super helpers, comprises: a helper population construction unit which constructs a helper population corresponding to at least some of a plurality of users through voluntary application using helper terminals; a helper management unit which manages locations of helpers in the helper population through tracking the helper terminals; a user location detection unit which receives a tracker signal through a user terminal and detects a user location code in the tracker signal; a helper processing unit which determines at least one helper within a certain distance from the helper population based on the user location code and provides a rescue signal to the corresponding helper terminal; and a rescue processing unit which, when a response to the rescue signal is received from the corresponding helper terminal, drives a navigation of the corresponding helper terminal and guides a movement path generated based on the user location code.

title_en: Method and apparatus for monitoring control signal in wireless communication system
abstract_en: According to the present specification, a method for monitoring a signal in a wireless communication system and a device thereof comprise a PDCCH monitoring operation based on a combination of X and Y. Specifically, a section of a search space is limited to a multiple of L to allow a PDCCH to be monitored in Y slots.

title_en: ELECTRONIC DEVICE AND OPERATING METHOD TO COMPENSATE In-phase/Quadrature Imbalance
abstract_en: Disclosed is an electronic device, comprising: a feedback oscillator for outputting a first oscillation signal and a second oscillation signal having a preset phase difference from the first oscillation signal; an upconversion mixer for outputting a first loopback signal mixing the first oscillation signal with a reference tone signal and outputting a second loopback signal mixing the second oscillation signal with the reference tone signal; and a receiver for generating a first reference IQ signal from the first loopback signal, generating a second reference IQ signal from the second loopback signal, and comparing an actual phase difference between the first reference IQ signal and the second reference IQ signal with the preset phase difference. The feedback oscillator comprises a phase shifter for receiving the first oscillation signal and outputting the second oscillation signal.

title_en: Non-volatile composite memory and method for operation of non-volatile composite memory
abstract_en: The present invention, as a non-volatile composite memory, comprises: a packet buffer comprising a first non-volatile memory for storing a packet, and a second memory different from the first memory; and a packet buffer control part that determines a memory to store the packet to any one memory among the first memory or the second memory, and maps a cell address to be stored in a determined memory for a plurality of cells divided into packets. Here, the first memory is a magnetoresistive random access memory (MRAM), and the second memory is a phase change memory (PCM). Therefore, the present invention is capable of providing an operation method for mapping the packet or mapping the cell address.

title_en: METHOD OF PROVIDING MUSIC NFT issue SERVICE PERFORMED ON A SERVER PROVIDING PLATFORM FOR TRADING MUSIC USING BLOCKCHAIN-BASED NFT
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method of providing a music NFT issue service performed on a server of a platform for trading music using a blockchain-based NFT and, more specifically, to a method of providing a service for issuing a partial NFT, which registers and issues a music NFT to improve stability and reliability on a music registering and trading platform using a blockchain-based NFT, and enables individual transactions for partial music.

title_en: Management method of PSK for group topology communication devices
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method for managing a key for encryption communication of a wireless communication group in a wire/wireless combined communication system. The method comprises: a group designation step of designating, as a wireless communication group, a communication gateway that performs wireless communication at the end of a wired communication device, and nodes connected to the communication gateway in a system that performs wired/wireless combined communication; a master key generation step of enabling a key authentication center to assign an identifier to each wireless communication group designated in the group designation step and generate a master key; a master key distribution step of encrypting the master key generated by the key authentication center and distributing the same to each wireless communication group; and a master key registration step of decrypting the encrypted master key distributed from each wireless communication group and registering the master key. Therefore, the method can reduce the possibility of leakage of the master key.

title_en: An wireless communication apparatus for adaptive beamforming and method of operation thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method for operating a first device communicating with a second device in a WLAN system including the first device and the second device. The method for operating a first device according to an aspect of the present disclosure comprises the steps of: receiving an NDP frame from a second device; obtaining channel characteristic data with the second apparatus based on NDP frame; determining the class of channel by applying the machine learning algorithm in channel characteristic data; creating beam forming feedback information based on the discernment result; creating the feedback frame according to the beam forming feedback information; and transmitting the feedback frame to the second device.

title_en: Method for Managing the State of Concentration of Untact Learning Video
abstract_en: A purpose of the present invention is to provide a non-face-to-face learning video concentration management method for managing the concentration state of the learner's learning video. The present invention comprises: a first step of receiving N (N>=1) concentration state verification count information for checking the learning concentration state of a learner who learns by playing the learning video provided through the learning site and storing the same in an operation DB; a second step of determining N concentration state verification times; a third step of checking whether the playing time of the learning video reaches the nth (1<=n<=N) concentration state verification time among the N concentration state verification times applied to the learning video when the learning video is provided to the learner terminal through the learning site and played through the video playback area; a fourth step of checking whether a mouse click or touch input occurs for the concentration state verification mark; and a fifth step of storing concentration state authentication information for generating the learner's learning concentration information for the learning video in an operation DB. The present invention has the advantage of being able to quantify a learner's concentration on learning, thereby enabling an operator or manager to evaluate or judge a learner's concentration on learning.

title_en: Method and apparatus for poviding digital twin federation service
abstract_en: Provided is a method for providing a digital twin association service in a digital twin association service providing apparatus of any one digital twin. The digital twin association service providing apparatus collects domain-specific data of the digital twin and association data according to association with at least one other digital twin in a domain different from the digital twin, collects external data from an external server, analyzes the domain-specific data, the association data, and the external data to recognize a multilateral situation, and provides an intelligent service based on the multilateral situation.

title_en: Rs-ofdm based communication method and rs-ofdm based communication device
abstract_en: The present invention proposes an rs-ofdm-based communication method and an apparatus for performing rs-ofdm-based communication, wherein the rs-ofdm-based communication method realizes a new rs-ofdm-based communication method that can improve a data transmission rate/speed compared to the prior art through the use of a color code and a deep learning network and enables communication without deterioration in performance and/or system performance in a mobility scenario that is feared by the use of the color code.

title_en: Virtual experience concert system and method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a virtual experience concert system and method implemented to provide a virtual concert experience, such as singing or performing by oneself while receiving audience responses as in an actual concert hall or stage. The system comprises: a concert-linked microphone which receives sound input from a user; a virtual concert execution device which plays back a virtual concert performance by mixing a concert background video desired by the user, a concert background audio, and the sound input from the concert-linked microphone; a wearable virtual concert display device equipped with a VR device, which provides the user with the virtual concert performance executed by the virtual concert execution device using the VR device under control of the execution device; and a virtual concert audio output device which outputs the concert background audio played back by the virtual concert execution device under its control.

title_en: Server, method and computer program for relaying video call services
abstract_en: A metahuman control server relaying a video call service may comprise: an information receiving unit that receives metahuman video information from a metahuman participant terminal; an optimal resolution derivation unit that calculates a metahuman requested resolution based on metahuman video service area information included in the metahuman video information and compares a preset supported resolution with the metahuman requested resolution to derive an optimal resolution; a resolution conversion unit that converts the resolution of a metahuman video corresponding to the metahuman video information to the optimal resolution; and an image transmission unit that transmits the metahuman video with the converted resolution to a video call service server that provides the video call service.

title_en: System for providing voting service and method thereof
abstract_en: A system for providing a voting service and a method thereof are disclosed. According to an embodiment, the method of providing a voting service through a user terminal comprises the steps of: receiving a request related to a page from a user; processing, when the request is a request related to a first type page (a page provided in an activated state of a voting service category), the request related to the first type page by communicating with a content delivery network (CDN); and processing, when the request is a request related to a second type page (a page excluding the first type page), the request related to the second type page by communicating with a database server.

title_en: The smoke escape mask storage box
abstract_en: A smoke mask storage box is provided, which includes: a lower box (102) having a storage space (12) for storing and providing masks; an upper box (104) equipped with a sensor unit that has a number of sensors that detect heat, temperature, and location in the event of a fire and provide voice guidance, and transmits and receives information signals detected by the sensors to the fire management center; and a sensor unit (117) having a plurality of sensors installed in the upper box (104). The smoke mask storage box of the present invention has the effect of being able to track and find the initial ignition point of a fire by installing a separate temperature sensor and smoke sensor in the storage box, and has the effect of making it easy to respond to and manage fires by using the smoke mask storage box placed indoors.

title_en: Jamming signal detection method and electronic apparatus therefor
abstract_en: According to the present disclosure, a method for detecting a jamming signal performed by an electronic device comprises the steps of: receiving a signal; checking a kurtosis value of the signal; comparing the kurtosis value of the signal with a threshold value; and checking whether a jamming signal is included in the signal based on a comparison result of the kurtosis value of the signal and the threshold value.

title_en: Method for advertisement using moving pictureuser-created contents
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an advertisement method through video user production content. According to the present invention, a video user production content (ucc) produced by a user himself/herself is produced, a content classification list of the corresponding ucc is written in accordance with a predetermined rule when registering in a web server, and prepared advertisement content corresponding to the classification list is searched to complete a video ucc file including one advertisement information. When this content is distributed and consumed, the content or scene of the content has robustness with the advertisement content, so that a high advertising effect may be achieved by the associative technique. There is an advantage in that a predetermined advertisement profit may be distributed to the user who produced the content based on various events according to the playback request of the content consumer users.

title_en: Method and apparatus for transmitting and receiving data and feedback in wirelss communication system
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method and apparatus for transmitting and receiving data and feedback in a wireless communication system. According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, a terminal may store HARQ ACK information for a HARQ process set in a buffer of a hardware end of the terminal, update the stored HARQ ACK information according to a data decoding result received from a base station, and transmit the updated HARQ ACK information to the base station through an uplink control channel as a HARQ-ACK transmission indicator for the HARQ ACK process set from the base station is received.

title_en: Apparatus and method for preventing theft of item in vehicle
abstract_en: Disclosed are an apparatus and a method for preventing stolen goods in a vehicle. According to an aspect of the present invention, an apparatus for preventing theft of goods in a vehicle comprises: a storage device including a door; a locking module locking or unlocking the door; an input module receiving a user input; and a processor connected to the locking module and the input module. The processor generates a first control signal for locking the door and outputs the first control signal to the locking module when a first input signal is received through the input module.

title_en: Method for Storing, Transferring, and Sharing Non-Fungible Token Objects
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a method for storing, transferring, and sharing an encrypted object comprises the steps of: generating an object main key; encrypting an object with the generated object main key; generating n object auxiliary keys to be allocated to n users (n is a natural number of 1 or more), respectively, and generating n e-object main keys to be allocated to each user by encrypting the object main key with the generated object auxiliary key; storing the generated n e-object main keys in a database; transmitting the object auxiliary key to the users; and deleting the object main key and the object auxiliary key from a server.

title_en: Device and operating method for providing digital twin platform services
abstract_en: Disclosed is a digital twin platform service device comprising: an interface module which receives data from a real object, displays a result calculated based on the received data on a digital twin, and transmits a control signal related to the result displayed on the digital twin to the real object; and a block combination module which combines a plurality of blocks each providing a designated function to generate a service module for managing the real object, wherein the service module calculates the result displayed on the digital twin based on the received data. In addition, various embodiments identified through the specification are possible.

title_en: Method and System for providing proposed messages according to message delivery requests
abstract_en: A method comprising: receiving, by a communication company server, an originating call request for transmitting a plurality of voice messages to a receiving terminal from an originating terminal; determining, by the communication company server, whether a receiver account corresponding to the receiving terminal is subscribed to an overseas notification service in response to receiving the originating call request; determining, by a service server, an importance level for the plurality of voice messages when the receiver account is subscribed to the overseas notification service; and providing, by the service server, a proposal message for proposing a roaming application for the receiver account when the importance level is equal to or higher than a threshold level. A system for performing the method is disclosed.

title_en: Method and apparatus for network intrusion detection for docker containers
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and an apparatus for detecting network intrusion in a network based on a docker container. A method of a first device may include providing, by the first device operating in a kernel area and a user area, information for determining whether a packet of a third device operating in the user space is a malicious packet to a second device operating in the kernel space.

title_en: Scheduling apparatus and method.
abstract_en: A method of a scheduling apparatus for multi-user scheduling, wherein the multi-user scheduling may - for example - be in an unlicensed communication environment. The method comprises transmitting a first signal to a first set of users wherein the first signal is indicative of a request for user-specific information, receiving - responsive to transmitting the first signal - a respective second signal from each of a second set of users wherein the second signal is indicative of the requested user-specific information, and scheduling - responsive to receiving the respective second signals - a third set of users based on the received second signals. The second set is a subset of the first set of users, and the third set of users is a subset of, or coincides with, the second set of users. Corresponding scheduling apparatus, wireless communication apparatus and computer program product are also disclosed.

title_en: User terminal and wireless communication method.
abstract_en: A user terminal according to an embodiment of the present disclosure comprises: a transmission unit that transmits a demodulation reference signal (DMRS) based on Ï/2-BPSK modulation in the uplink transmission of at least one of an uplink shared channel and an uplink control channel before the establishment of a wireless resource control (RRC) connection; and a control unit that establishes the RRC connection on the basis of the uplink transmission. The embodiment of the present disclosure makes it possible to appropriately perform uplink transmission using on Ï/2-BPSK modulation.

title_en: A handheld wand device and method for scanning the physical signature data of a physical unclonable function along an arbitrary path.
abstract_en: Unique physical unclonable function objects are created by molding pre-magnetized or post-magnetized particles into a resin. The particles form a unique physical "fingerprint" based on the random particle size, position, polar rotation, magnetization level, particle density, etc. This invention addresses devices for accurately measuring the physical fingerprint of a PUT, specifically including the X, Y, & Z components of the magnetic field at enough discrete points on the PUT to allow a confident recognition of the identification. A handheld wand is described for measuring the magnetic field along an arbitrary path.

title_en: Automatic qos optimization in network equipment.
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and software for automatically optimizing QoS configuration in networking equipment. A network device measures current line metric values associated with a network connection of the device and compares the current line metric values to previously measured values to determine whether there has been a material change in a line metric value. If a material change in a line metric value has occurred, new QoS settings are computed for the network device based on the current line metric values measured, and the new QoS settings are applied to the QoS functions of the network device. The measuring, comparing, computing, and applying steps are repeated on a periodic basis in order to keep the QoS settings optimized to changing network conditions.

title_en: Method for controlling transmission and related apparatus.
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present application provide a method for controlling transmission and a related apparatus. The method is applied to a terminal in a non-radio resource control (RRC) connected state, and comprises: when a first preset condition is met, performing an RRC connection recovery process for a radio access network-based notification area to update (RNAU). The first preset condition comprises that a second timer expires and a first timer is not running; or the first preset condition comprises that the terminal receives a system information block SIB1 of a serving cell, the serving cell does not belong to a configured radio access network-based notification area, and the first timer is not running; the first timer is started when the terminal initiates the RRC connection recovery process used for small packet data transmission SDT, and the second timer is started when the terminal receives an RRC release message comprising the duration of the second timer. The present application may avoid triggering the RNAU during the SDT process, thereby preventing the small packet data transmission from being influenced, and preventing unnecessary power consumption and signaling overhead.

title_en: Intermodal asset identification and association system
abstract_en: Systems, methodologies and components enable the ability to assign, manage and use intermodal, bi-modal and tractor/trailer asset associations between shipping assets, for example, container/truck associations, chassis/container associations, chassis/truck associations, trailer/truck associations, associations for gensets, and refrigerated containers, etc.

title_en: Individual buffer management in transport of scalable video
abstract_en: A method is provided to determine buffer parameter settings for a plurality of layers in a transport stream. Each layer includes a respective transport stream buffer parameter setting. Then, the method provides respective transport stream buffer parameter settings to individual transport stream buffers for respective layers in the plurality of layers. Then, the method buffers the respective layers in the individual transport stream buffers according to the respective transport stream buffer parameter settings. After buffering, the method combines the respective layers to form a combined bit stream.

title_en: Operating system for quantum network nodes and execution of quantum network applications using such operating system
abstract_en: A method for executing quantum network applications comprising classical code blocks and quantum code blocks on a quantum network node is described. Each quantum network node may include one or more communication qubits and one or more storage qubits. Further, the method comprises the steps of: receiving a quantum code block associated with a first quantum network application by an operating system of a first quantum network node, the quantum code block comprising quantum operations, the quantum operations including local quantum operations not related to entanglement generation and at least an entanglement generation operation for entanglement generation between the first quantum network node and a second quantum network node; executing at least part of the quantum operations on the quantum computing system via a first subsystem of the operating system, wherein if a quantum operation is relates to an entanglement generation operation, sending the entanglement generation operation to a second subsystem of the operating system, the second subsystem preparing execution of the entanglement generation operation as a background process of the operating system, while the first subsystem continues executing local quantum operations; blocking the execution of the local quantum operations associated with a first quantum network application by the first subsystem, if a first local quantum operation requires access to an entanglement associated with the entanglement generation operation; executing the entanglement generation operation by the second subsystem based on a timeslot in a network schedule provided to the first and second quantum network node; unblocking execution of the quantum operations by the first subsystem if entanglement between the first and second quantum network node is established; and, providing the local quantum operation access to a communication qubit of the quantum computing system of the first quantum network node that is entanglement with a communication qubit of the quantum computing system of the second quantum network node.

title_en: Method and device for transmission and reception of information about resource unit size in system of wireless local network
abstract_en:
FIELD: wireless communication. 
     SUBSTANCE: access point (AP) receives from a station (hereinafter – STA) a control message to adapt a communication line, containing the first field for a recommended resource unit (hereinafter – RU) in the station (STA), the second field for a recommended modulation-coding scheme (MCS) in STA, and the third field that relates to a RU size for an uplink multi-user (hereinafter – UL MU) communication in STA, and transmits an initiating frame to initiate UL MU communication in STA, wherein the RU size of the uplink distributed by the initiating frame is determined based on the third field and set as equal or less than a size of the recommended RU for UL MU communication. 
     EFFECT: increase in the reliability of the uplink transmission. 
     15 cl, 30 dwg

title_en: Dynamic environmental compensation of two-way time transfer
abstract_en: There is provided a method for enabling time comparison and dynamic delay compensation of timing between a first node (A) and a second node (B) in a two-way time transfer network (N), which provides a delay compensation with improved ability to compensate for dynamic delays during for real-world network conditions. The method comprises monitoring time information sent between the nodes and observations associated with delays caused by environmental effects associated with the transmission medium in the network that affects the timing, to derive at least two delay compensation factors for reducing time errors in the two way time transfer to compensate for static and dynamic environmental delays in the timing.

title_en: Master base station and resourece allocation indicating method
abstract_en: A master base station and a resource allocation indicating method are provided. The master base station and a distributed base station is based on layer 1-layer 2 split technology. In the method, a bandwidth part (BWP) configuration is enabled. Different BWP configurations have different configuration in frequency domain, and the BWP configuration corresponds to continuous and part of common resource units. Make the BWP configuration be corresponding to a common configuration to generate a corresponding relation. The corresponding relation is related to a corresponding situation between identifications of multiple local resource units and the common resource units. The identifications of the local resource units are used in the BWP configuration uses to identify the local resource units, and the identifications of the common resource units are used in the common configuration to identify the common resource units. The corresponding relation is transmitted. Accordingly, BWP can be implemented with a transmission interface of layer 1-layer 2 split technology.

title_en: Method and system for setting carrier aggregation scheme
abstract_en: A system and method for setting blind detection and control channel element monitoring limits in a carrier aggregation scheme. In some embodiments, the method includes: receiving, by a network from a first user equipment (UE), a declaration of capabilities of the first UE; sending, by the network, to the first UE, a first search space (SS) configuration for a first component carrier in a carrier aggregation (CA) scheme; and sending, by the network, to the first UE, a second search space configuration for a second component carrier in the carrier aggregation scheme. The first search space configuration may define a first set of monitoring occasions, the second search space configuration may define a second set of monitoring occasions (MOs), and an aligned span pattern, corresponding to the first set of monitoring occasions and the second set of monitoring occasions, may comply with the declaration of capabilities of the first UE.

title_en: User equipment and base station for mobile communication system
abstract_en: A user equipment (UE) and a base station (BS) for a mobile communication system are provided. The UE obtains a first timing advance (TA) value of a source BS, and receives a radio resource control (RRC) connection reconfiguration message for a handover from the source BS to a target BS. The UE calculates a receiving time difference between a receiving time of two synchronization signals respectively transmitted by the source BS and the target BS, and calculates a reference time difference according to first reference time information of the source BS and second reference time information of the target BS. The UE calculates a second TA value of the target BS based on the first TA value, the receiving time difference and the reference time difference.

title_en: A method of mixing public blockchains with private blockchains and computer readable medium
abstract_en:
The present invention is a method for mixing public blockchains with private blockchains. The method includes: providing a private blockchain managed by a hybrid chain service system, and deploying a smart contract on a public blockchain; hashing a new block to generate a block hash when the block is generated by the private blockchain; generating a first time stamp 
signature form the hash block through a time stamp service organization; generating a second time stamp signature form the first time stamp signature through the hybrid chain service system; and publishing the second time stamp signature. Accordingly, the private blockchain transactions that are not anchored to the public blockchain also has credible in the present invention. The present invention further provides a computer-readable medium for performing the method for mixing public blockchains with private blockchains.

title_en: Remote computing device recovery
abstract_en: Various aspects of the present disclosure generally relate to wireless communication. In some aspects, a user equipment (UE) may establish a connection with a server through a wireless network. The UE may receive, from the server and via the connection through the wireless network, at least one of a firmware image file or a software image file. The UE may transmit at least one of the firmware image file or the software image file to a computing device. Numerous other aspects are described.

title_en: Migration of nodes in an iab communication system
abstract_en: Methods and apparatus for use in a migration process in which a Distributed Unit, DU, of an Integrated Access Backhaul, IAB, node is migrated from one IAB topology managed by a source IAB donor Central Unit, CU, to another IAB topology managed by a target IAB donor CU are disclosed. A method at the source IAB donor CU comprises determining the DU of the IAB node is to be migrated from the one IAB topology of the source IAB donor CU to the another IAB topology of the target IAB donor CU; sending, to the IAB node, a request for establishing a F1 connection between the IAB node and the target IAB donor CU. A method at the IAB node comprises receiving, from the source IAB donor CU, a request for establishing a F1 connection between a target IAB donor CU and the IAB node; sending, to the target IAB donor CU, a F1 setup request for requesting set up of the F1 connection.

title_en: Wireless communication system and wireless communication method
abstract_en: This wireless communication system (10) comprises a communication unit (21) and a communication device (32). In communication using a communication channel composed of a plurality of communication slots, the communication unit (21) and the communication device (32) change the communication channel in each hopping cycle and perform time-sharing wireless communication using one of the plurality of communication slots. The communication unit (21) determines a first communication slot in which a trigger signal can be transmitted to the communication device (32), from among the plurality of communication slots, before a conveyance carriage (20) transfers an article to or from a load port (31), and transmits a trigger signal to the communication device (32) using the first communication slot. Upon having received the trigger signal from the communication unit (21), the communication device (32) performs, with the communication unit (21), interlock communication for allowing the transfer of the article by the conveyance carriage (20).

title_en: Network system for long reach ethernet and associated control method
abstract_en: A network system for long reach Ethernet and associated control method are provided. A long reach transceiving specification is additionally designed in the physical layer circuit (PHY) of a network module. In the network system, when both network modules support the long reach transceiving specification, the long reach transceiving specification can be selectively used for data transaction after the auto-negotiation process. In one embodiment, a unique hardware structure is designed in the physical layer circuit (PHY) of the network module. When both network modules of the network system include the unique hardware architecture, the long reach transceiving specification can be selectively used for data transaction after the auto-negotiation process.

title_en: Methods and apparatus for adaptive streaming of point clouds
abstract_en: Methods, apparatus, and systems directed to adaptive streaming of V-PCC (Video-based Point Cloud Compression) data using an adaptive HTTP streaming protocol, such as MPEG DASH. A method includes signaling the point cloud data of the point cloud in a DASH MPD including: a main AdaptationSet for the point cloud, including at least (1) a @codecs attribute that is set to a unique value signifying that the corresponding AdaptationSet corresponds to V-PCC data and (2) an initialization segment containing at least one V-PCC sequence parameter set for a representation of the point cloud; and a plurality of component AdaptationSets, each corresponding to one of the V-PCC components and including at least (1) a VPCCComponent descriptor identifying a type of the corresponding V-PCC component and (2) at least one property of the V-PCC component; and transmitting the DASH bitstream over the network.

title_en: Method and device of communicating with a lte network and a nr network
abstract_en: A communication device for communicating with a long-term evolution (LTE) network and a new radio (NR) network is configured to execute instructions of: the communication device registering to the LTE network and the NR network; and performing an IP multimedia subsystem (IMS) registration via the LTE network but not via the NR network, when registering to the LTE network and the NR network.

title_en: Consensus system downtime recovery
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for consensus system downtime recovery. One of the methods includes: multicasting a pre-prepare message to at least some of the backup nodes; obtaining (Q-1) or more prepare messages respectively from (Q-1) or more of the backup nodes, wherein the prepare messages each indicate an acceptance of the pre-prepare message by the corresponding backup node; storing the pre-prepare message and the (Q-1) or more prepare messages; multicasting a commit message to at least some of the backup nodes, the commit message indicating that the primary node agrees to the (Q-1) or more prepare messages; and obtaining, respectively from Q or more nodes among the primary node and the backup nodes, Q or more commit messages each indicating that the corresponding node agrees to (Q-1) or more prepare messages received by the corresponding node.

title_en: Control mechanism of sevice scope and sevice intensity of electronic equipment
abstract_en: A control mechanism of service scope and service intensity of electronic equipment is introduced. The electronic equipment includes at least one antenna, a wireless communication module and a processing unit. The electronic equipment is configured to provide a service. The control mechanism of service scope and service intensity of electronic equipment includes: the wireless communication module being electrically connected to the at least one antenna and the processing unit; the wireless communication module receiving a wireless signal of a terminal mobile device in an antenna sensing range of the at least one antenna through the at least one antenna sensing; the processing unit generating a control signal according to the wireless signal; and adjusting a service scope and a service intensity of the electronic equipment according to the control signal.

title_en: Bandwidth part switch management
abstract_en:
Various aspects of the present disclosure generally relate to wireless communication. In some aspects, a base station (BS) may transmit and a user equipment (UE) may receive cloned bandwidth part configuration information. In some aspects, the UE may determine a linkage between a primary bandwidth part and the cloned bandwidth part. In some aspects, the BS may transmit and the UE may receive a downlink control information message identifying the primary bandwidth part to signal a bandwidth part switch for the primary bandwidth part and a first bandwidth part or identifying the cloned bandwidth part to signal the bandwidth part switch for the primary bandwidth 
part and a second bandwidth part. In some aspects, the UE may perform the bandwidth part switch based at least in part on the downlink control information message. Numerous other aspects are provided.

title_en: Method for initiating instant voice communication by messaging service
abstract_en: A method for initiating instant voice communication by messaging service is applied to a communication server. The method comprises: a transmitting end providing a sending information and a first number of a first receiving end to the communication server, wherein the sending information includes a serving party name and a text message; the communication server generating a first link information and a first instant messaging page corresponding to the first link information, and transmitting a first message which includes the first link information and the text message to the first receiving end by the MMS specification or the SMS specification according to a message length of the first link information and the text message; the first receiving end connecting to the first instant messaging page via the first link information. The first instant messaging page displays the serving party name and provides instant messaging service between the transmitting end and the first receiving end to provide a more convenient communication to consumers.

title_en: Autonomous resource selection for vehicle-to-vehicle sidelink communications
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and storage media for reporting geo-information in wireless communications networks are described. In embodiments, a roadside unit (RSU) may instruct or configure a user equipment (UE) to report its geo-information to other UEs and/or receive other geo-information from the other UEs over vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) sidelinks. In embodiments, the RSU or a core network element may allocate radio resources for V2V communications to geographic areas and/or based on reported geo-information. In embodiments, the UE may use its geo-information and/or the obtained geo-information to select resources from the allocation for transmission or receipt of V2V messages. Other embodiments may be described and/or claimed.

title_en: Interference layer categorization and non zero power interference measurement resource for non linear precoding
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communications are described. In one aspect, the described techniques provide for identifying interference signals on multiple layers or resources and determining whether the interference signals transmitted on a particular layer or resource were precoded using linear precoding (LP) or NLP. In this aspect, a receiving device may equalize signals received from a transmitting device (e.g., filter out interference signals) based on determining whether the interference signals were precoded using a first type of precoding (e.g., linear precoding (LP)) or a second type of precoding (e.g., NLP). In another aspect, the described techniques provide for performing interference measurements on signals precoded using NLP based on categorizing interference resources as being precoded using LP or NLP. In this aspect, a receiving device may perform and report measurements differently for interference signals precoded using LP and interference signals precoded using NLP.

title_en: Head-mounted display, content loading method and non-transitory computer readable storage medium thereof
abstract_en: A head-mounted display, content loading method, and non-transitory computer readable storage medium thereof are provided. The head-mounted display selects a first multimedia content from a plurality of multimedia contents in response to receiving a switching signal, and the switching signal is generated based on determining that a user chooses to execute a new application program, and a playing content of the first multimedia content corresponds to the new application program. The head-mounted display transmits the first multimedia content to a display to play the first multimedia content on a plurality of pixels of a display screen of the display.

title_en: Systems and methods for positioning reference signal staggering configuration
abstract_en: Disclosed are methods and apparatuses for resolving aliasing ambiguities produced when using channel state information reference signal, a sounding reference signal (SRS) or other transmission as a positioning reference signal (PRS) occupying a subset of tones of a PRS bandwidth. The aliasing ambiguity results in a plurality of different possible positioning measurements, such as time of arrival (TOA), reference signal timing difference (RSTD), or reception to transmission difference (Rx-Tx). The aliasing ambiguity may be resolved using a previous position estimate that may be used to produce an approximation of the expected positioning measurement. A position estimate may be generated using a multiple stage PRS configuration, in which one or more stages provide a coarse position estimate that has no ambiguity, which can be used to resolve the ambiguity of a more accurate position estimate resulting from the PRS signal.

title_en: Method for processing beam failure, and terminal
abstract_en: Provided in the present disclosure are a method for processing beam failure, and a terminal; the method comprises: determining a beam failure recovery event, a beam failure event comprising: an abnormality occurring during beam failure recovery or at least two cells both undergoing beam failure recovery; according to the beam failure recovery event, executing a specific operation.

title_en: Dynamically managed virtual server system
abstract_en: A virtual server system includes multiple pools of server components connected via a high-speed communication fabric and a dynamic virtual server manager configured to determine attributes of a workload in multiple workload dimensions and configure a virtual server using server components of the server component pools. The selected server components implement a virtual server configured based on the determine workload attributes in the multiple workload dimensions. Also, the dynamic virtual server manager dynamically adjusts which server components are used to implement the virtual server based on changes in workload attributes.

title_en: Codex search patterns
abstract_en: A Codex human knowledge encyclopedia including a webpage database residing in the Codex and stored in non-volatile digital memory, a master index and a partial master index for each element of the Codex, an optimizer receiving from a computing device interactive input, and executing software instructions to transform input based on rules of grammar and semantics into a search pattern and personalizing the search pattern by adding Global Positioning System (GPS) coordinates from the computing device. Mapping the search pattern to an element stored in the Codex and upon identifying the search pattern, obtaining the optimal dataset from the Codex bypassing all calculations since optimal dataset is readily available, picking and arranging, in an order from highest to lowest, from the optimal dataset, the top responses as output based on personalized usage pattern of behavior, and displaying the output to the user.

title_en: Electronic device and method in wireless communication system, and wireless communication system
abstract_en: An electronic device at a base station end includes a processing circuit, the processing circuit being configured to: configure, in response to request signalling from a user equipment, an aperiodic beam-forming reference signal relevant to a first beam group for the user equipment, wherein the first beam group is determined by a base station according to channel state information periodically fed back by the user equipment; generate downlink control information, so as to indicate that the user equipment feeds back beam selection information according to the aperiodic beam-forming reference signal; determine, according to the beam selection information, one or a plurality of candidate beams and one or a plurality of corresponding second pre-coding codebooks; and determine an effective pre-coding codebook based on the one or multiple second pre-coding codebooks.

title_en: CDM8 based CSI-RS designs for MIMO
abstract_en: A network node, wireless device, base station, user equipment and corresponding methods are provided. The network node includes processing circuitry configured to: select a first set and second set of reference signal resources in a subframe and aggregate the first set and second set of reference signal resources in the subframe to form a code division multiplexing, CDM, aggregation configuration. The first set and second set of reference signal resources in the subframe satisfy a temporal criterion such that any two resource elements in the first set and second set of reference signal resources have up to a maximum time separation of six OFDM symbols. The first set and second set of reference signal resources in the subframe satisfy a frequency criterion such that any two resource elements in the first set and second set of reference signal resources have up to a maximum frequency separation of six subcarriers.

title_en: Preventing foreign initiated fraudulent or unauthorized use of calling service
abstract_en: Novel tools and techniques are provided for implementing prevention of foreign initiated fraudulent or unauthorized use of calling service. In various embodiments, a computing system might receive, from a first user device associated with an originating party, a request to access a first account of a calling system and an access code. Based on a determination that the received access code is valid, the computing system might determine whether the first user device associated with the originating party is located in a foreign country. If so, the computing system might determine whether a database contains a configurable flag indicating that international access is not allowed for the first account. If so, the computing system might initiate one or more first actions. If not, the computing system might provide the first user device with access to the first account of the calling system.

title_en: Car sharing system
abstract_en: A car sharing system includes a car share device and a usage right lending unit that allows multiple users including a first user and a second user to use the vehicle. If the second user requests for usage of the vehicle when the vehicle is being rented to the first user, the usage right lending unit allows the second user to use the vehicle as long as the second user satisfies a lending condition.

title_en: Methods for constructing secure hash functions from bit-mixers
abstract_en: Provided is a method and system for producing message authentication tags and a method and system for producing hash values using bit-mixers. The methods include producing a message authentication or hash value by obtaining a message; segmenting, padding by an electronic processor, the message into a number of equal sized message blocks comprising a first message block, one or more subsequent message blocks, and a final message block; performing, by the electronic processor, a first bit-mixing operation on the first message block with an initialization value; performing, by the electronic processor, subsequent bit-mixing operations on the one or more subsequent message blocks and the final message block with a previous message block; and producing, by the electronic processor, the message authentication tag based on the first bit-mixing operation and the subsequent bit-mixing operations, employing a secret key material.

title_en: Method for transmitting carrier combination for carrier aggregation and electronic device therefor
abstract_en: An electronic device including a communication circuitry, a processor, and a memory is provided. The processor of the electronic device receives a user equipment (UE) capability enquiry that includes information indicating the number of carrier aggregation (CA) combinations associated with a network from the network using the communication circuitry and determines UE capability information based on at least one of the number of default CA combinations of the electronic device, the number of CA combinations of a region associated with the network, the number of CA combinations of a country associated with the network, the number of CA combinations corresponding to a supported frequency band of a mobile network operator (MNO) associated with the network, and the number of CA combinations associated with the network.

title_en: Electronic device for transmitting data and method for controlling the same
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, an electronic device for transmitting data comprises a memory storing the data, a processor, and a coil. The processor may perform controls to detect a data receiving device configured to detect a magnetic field corresponding to the data and apply a voltage or a current corresponding to the data to the coil in response to the detection of the data receiving device.

title_en: Method and device in first node and base station used for wireless communication
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method and a device in a first node and a base station for wireless communication. A first node transmits K1 first-type reference signal(s), and operates a first radio signal and a second radio signal; the K1 first-type reference signal(s) is(are) transmitted by K1 first-type antenna port set(s) respectively, a target antenna port set is a first-type antenna port set in the K1 first-type antenna port set(s); a first antenna port set and a second antenna port set are respectively used for transmitting the first radio signal and the second radio signal. The disclosure makes it practical for the first node to simultaneously operate radio signals transmitted from different transmitters in beamforming scenarios by connecting a first antenna port set and a second antenna port set with a target antenna port set, thereby improving the reception and transmission efficiency and the entire performance of the system.

title_en: Video inspection systems with personal communication device user interfaces
abstract_en: Video inspection systems using personal communications devices for information display, control and storage are disclosed. In one embodiment a video inspection system includes a cable storage drum, a push-cable, a rotatable support for carrying the drum, a camera head coupled to the push-cable, and a personal communications device operatively connected to the camera head through a wired or wireless communications link.

title_en: Transmitter and method for generating additional parity thereof
abstract_en: A transmitter is provided. The transmitter includes: a Low Density Parity Check (LDPC) encoder configured to encode input bits to generate an LDPC codeword including the input bits and parity bits to be transmitted in a current frame; a parity permutator configured to perform by group-wise interleaving a plurality of bit groups configuring the parity bits based on a group-wise interleaving pattern comprising a first pattern and a second pattern; a puncturer configured to puncture some of the parity-permutated parity bits; and an additional parity generator configured to select at least some of the punctured parity bits to generate additional parity bits to be transmitted in a previous frame of the current frame, based on the first pattern and the second pattern.

title_en: Vehicle, fleet management and traffic light interaction architecture design via V2X
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a method of controlling traffic lights in a V2X environment includes the operations of receiving, at a cloud server, status information of a number of vehicles; and filtering out one or more vehicles that are not to encounter a traffic light on their routes in a predetermined distance ahead of the vehicles. The method further includes obtaining a punctuality status of each remaining vehicle according to a schedule table; and optimizing each traffic light in the V2X environment based on the punctuality status of the vehicle to obtain a traffic light optimization result. The cloud server can send the traffic light optimization result to a vehicle closest to each traffic light. The vehicle that receives the traffic light optimization result can relay the result to the traffic light that is closest to the vehicle.

title_en: Method for performing sidelink transmission in wireless communication system and apparatus therefor
abstract_en:
A method for performing a sidelink transmission in a wireless communication system and a device are disclosed in the present specification. 
     In detail, in the present specification, a method for performing a sidelink transmission in a wireless communication system, the method performed by a user equipment (UE) includes receiving, from a base station, a sidelink grant to be used for scheduling of the sidelink transmission, wherein the sidelink grant includes control information indicating an offset of a specific subframe associated with the sidelink grant; determining the specific subframe in consideration of a value indicated by the control information; and performing the sidelink transmission in the specific subframe.

title_en: Method for distributed application segmentation through authorization
abstract_en: Methods and supporting systems for managing secure communications and establishing authenticated communications between processes of a computer application operating across network domains are provided. Authentication agents operate on servers hosting application processes, wherein each authentication agent has access to policies related to each of the application processes. An authentication agent operating on an originating server intercepts transmissions from an originating application processes and appends a trust profile associated with the originating application process. The transmission is released to a receiving server, where it is intercepted and validated at the receiving server by a second authentication agent on the receiving server. If the validation succeeds the transmission is forwarded to the receiving application process where it is executed, processed or otherwise acted upon acted upon, and the receiving server provides an acknowledgement transmission to the originating server confirming the transmission was received and processed by the receiving application process.

title_en: Automated network change system
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and apparatus, for automatically changing a network system. A method includes receiving a set of first intents that describe a state of a first switch fabric; receiving a set of second intents that describe a state of a second switch fabric; computing a set of network operations to perform on the first switch fabric to achieve the second switch fabric, the set of operations also defining an order in which the operations are to be executed, and the set of operations determined based on the set of first intents, the set of second intents, and migration logic that defines a ruleset for selecting the operations based on the set of first intents and the second intents; and executing the set of network operations according to the order, to apply changes to elements within the first switch fabric to achieve the state of the second switch fabric.

title_en: Handling storage unit failure in a dispersed storage network
abstract_en: A method for execution by dispersed storage failure detection unit of a dispersed storage network includes generating a storage unit weights and storage set weights based on the storage unit weights. One storage unit that meets a weight-adjustment trigger condition is identified, and a new storage unit weight for the identified storage unit is generated. A first data migration within the storage set that includes the identified storage unit is facilitated based on the storage unit weights. A failing set of storage units in a second storage set is identified. A new storage set weight for the second storage set is generated when the number of storage units in the failing set compares favorably to a failure threshold number. A second data migration that includes transferring data slices stored in the second storage unit to other storage sets is facilitated based on the storage set weights.

title_en: Method for transmitting uplink sounding reference signal, terminal, network side device, and storage medium
abstract_en: A method for transmitting uplink Sounding Reference Signal, SRS, a terminal, a network side device and a storage medium are provided. The method includes determining a transmission manner for one or more uplink SRSs in a wideband system by a terminal according to a configuration from a network side device, wherein the wideband system is configured with a plurality of basic parameters; transmitting the one or more uplink SRSs to the network side device in the wideband system by the terminal according to the transmission manner.

title_en: Vehicle having fail-safe internal data transfer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vehicle having fail-safe internal data transfer. The vehicle comprises a vehicle body and a wired data transfer network provided on the vehicle body. Furthermore, network subscribers are provided on the vehicle body, which network subscribers are connected to each other via respective network nodes of the data transfer network. The data transfer network has a data-transferring ring wiring.

title_en: Transmitter with self-triggered transition equalizer
abstract_en: A transmitting device includes an output node, at least one driver circuit and transition equalization circuitry. The driver circuit drives an output data signal including a data transition onto the output node. The output of the transition equalization circuitry is coupled to the output node. The transition equalization circuitry begins to drive the output node at the data transition and ends driving of the output node a pre-determined delay after beginning to drive the output node. The transition equalization circuitry drives the output node by injecting current onto the output node if the data transition is a positive transition, and sinking current from the output node if the data transition is a negative transition.

title_en: Systems and methods for active signature detection
abstract_en: Disclosed embodiments describe a system for completing a transaction using an electronic transaction card by receiving, from a user device executing a software application, a selection of a first account function associated with a financial transaction; determining that the account function requires user verification; detecting, via a motion detection component, a motion pattern performed on the electronic transaction card by the user; authenticating an identity of the user, by the electronic transaction card, based on the detected motion pattern; and completing, by the user device, the financial transaction.

title_en: Method, apparatus, and system for providing mobile transportation platform data capture for data analytics
abstract_en: An approach is provided for mobile transportation platform data capture. The approach, for instance, involves collecting through electronic means, a comprehensive aggregation of technical computing data, communications data, control systems data, systems configuration data, and network data on mobile transportation platforms (e.g., aircraft, automobiles, trains, ships, etc.) and the ecosystems they operate in.
