The method comprises: receiving first measurement information from a first access network device, wherein the first measurement information is used for indicating at least one parameter value, the at least one parameter value is determined on the basis of at least two sensing signals received by the first access network device, and the parameter value is a phase difference value or a distance value; and on the basis of the at least one parameter value, determining at least one of at least one humidity variation value, first rainfall, and at least one waterlogging depth variation value. By means of the method, a humidity value, a waterlogging depth value, or rainfall can be determined by means of a phase difference value or a distance value of sensing signals, and multiple kinds of meteorological information that can not be sensed by means of traditional meteorological monitoring methods can be realized, thereby improving the monitoring accuracy of the meteorological information, and effectively realizing the sensing of the meteorological information.

title_en: Data protection agreement management method and apparatus
abstract_en: The present application discloses a data protection agreement management method and apparatus. The method comprises: in response to an operation of a first user clicking on a first service, a terminal device sending first information; receiving and displaying a data protection agreement for the first service; in response to an operation of the first user signing or not signing the data protection agreement, acquiring a signing result of the data protection agreement; and sending the signing result of the data protection agreement. The first information is used for requesting to acquire the data protection agreement for the first service, the first information comprises a first management identifier, the first management identifier is used for identifying the data protection agreement, and the first information further comprises a user identifier of the first user. The terminal device can accurately acquire the data protection agreement for the first service in a timely manner on the basis of the first management identifier. Compared with existing solutions in which data protection agreements are published in APP versions, the present invention reduces the need for APP version updates caused by data protection agreement updates, thereby achieving the effective use of data protection agreements for different services.

title_en: Method and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: This method according to the present disclosure comprises: acquiring image information including a text description information (TDI) supplemental enhancement information (SEI) message; and deriving text description information for at least one picture on the basis of the TDI SEI message, wherein the TDI SEI message includes a text description designated in a character string format, and the text description designated in the character string format is not a null character string.

title_en: Device chain establishment method, device, and storage medium
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present application discloses a device chain establishment method, a device, and a storage medium. The method is applied to a first terminal device, and comprises: receiving a chain establishment start instruction sent by a second terminal device, wherein the chain establishment start instruction carries network information of terminal devices participating in chain establishment; in response to the chain establishment start instruction, sending test data to other terminal devices respectively on the basis of the network information, and determining a transmission parameter for each piece of test data, wherein the transmission parameter comprises a transmission speed; determining a grouping list on the basis of the transmission speed, wherein the grouping list comprises a first grouping comprising terminal devices belonging to a same network device as the first terminal device, and a second grouping comprising terminal devices not belonging to a same network device as the first terminal device; and sending the grouping list to the second terminal device, for the second terminal device to perform comprehensive scoring processing on the basis of grouping records in the received grouping list, determine a target grouping list, and establish a device chain on the basis of the target grouping list, thereby solving the problem of low efficiency in device chain establishment and improving the efficiency of device chain establishment.

title_en: User-controlled data sovereignty system with cryptographic enforcement
abstract_en: A user-controlled data sovereignty system operated by a single entity, comprising a distributed ledger with validation nodes executing a modified Byzantine Fault Tolerant consensus protocol achieving 37.9% latency reduction through two-phase validation, a hardware security module (FIPS 140-2 Level 3) storing cryptographic keys in tamper-resistant hardware, and a cryptographic enforcement module validating data access requests using elliptic curve digital signatures and time-locked permission constraints. The system implements jurisdiction-aware data routing through geographic validation node placement and dual-key authorization for cross-border transfers, encoding UK Data (Use and Access) Act 2024 compliance requirements as cryptographic policy predicates. Permission state finality is achieved within two consensus rounds, eliminating temporal vulnerabilities in revocation propagation while providing O(log n) verification complexity through Merkle tree structures.

title_en: Network service access control method and system
abstract_en: The present application discloses a network service access control method and system. The method is applied to a network service provider; a secondary server, a target server, and a firewall are deployed on the network service provider; and a target service runs on the target server. The method comprises: the secondary server receives a request of a user, wherein the request is adapted to a predetermined packet format of the secondary server, the content comprises combined information and a check code, and the combined information comprises an access identifier and a firewall setting command; the secondary server searches for an associated target server on the basis of the access identifier, and forwards the combined information and the check code to the target server; the target server verifies the combined information and the check code; and if the verification is successful, on the basis of the setting command, the target server notifies the firewall to adjust firewall settings regarding access of the user to the target service.

title_en: Wake-up signal monitoring in a wireless device
abstract_en: There is provided techniques for monitoring of a WUS from a network node. A method is performed by first wireless device. The method comprises sending a request to a second wireless device, served by a network node, to perform the WUS monitoring on behalf of the first wireless device. The method comprises repeatedly receiving a proximity verification signal from the second wireless device. The method comprises receiving an indication of a WUS detection for the first wireless device from the second wireless device. The method comprises performing a communication procedure with the network node responsive to having received the indication of the WUS detection.

title_en: Multi-cloud service dependency analysis method and apparatus, and computer device
abstract_en: A multi-cloud service dependency analysis method, comprising: acquiring service discovery information and service invocation data of a plurality of cloud environments (S200); on the basis of the service discovery information and the service invocation data, constructing a service dependency graph (S400); on the basis of the service dependency graph, determining the importance of each service, and on the basis of the importance, performing screening to obtain Top N target services (S600); and identifying dependent services and strongly connected components of the Top N target services (S800).

title_en: Communication method, terminal device, communication device, communication system, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a communication method, a terminal device, a communication device, a communication system, a storage medium, and a program product. The method comprises: when a radio link failure (RLF) occurs, handing over to a first cell on the basis of configuration information of the first cell; or on the basis of an RLF prediction result, determining whether to hand over to the first cell on the basis of the configuration information, wherein the configuration information is stored when a terminal device satisfies a handover condition of the first cell. In the embodiments of the present disclosure, since the configuration information of the first cell is pre-stored when the terminal device satisfies the handover condition of the first cell, the process of the terminal device handing over to the first cell on the basis of the configuration information does not require cell selection, which can effectively reduce communication link interruption.

title_en: System to prevent disclosing personally identifiable information (pii) and method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system (100) and method (200) to prevent disclosing personally identifiable information (PII) over a network (111). The system (100) includes a client device (101) configured to generate a communication request, a receiver device (102) configured to receive the communication, and a centralized server (103) connected to both the 5 client device (101) and receiver device (102). The centralized server (103) includes a processor (104) that is configured to fetch the generated communication request from the client device (101), create a session token (105) for the received request, and map the session token (105) to one or more session identifiers (106) pre-stored at the centralized server (103). The session token (105) is then transmitted from the centralized server (103) to the receiver device (102) to 0 facilitate communication with the client device (101) over the network (111), ensuring the PII remains protected and undisclosed.

title_en: Calculation, propagation and/or display of scoring functions for decoded telemetry words
abstract_en: A system (10) for evaluating communications with a component in a downhole environment includes a telemetry system including a receiver (46) configured to detect a modulated telemetry signal during a downhole operation via a telemetry channel, demodulate the detected telemetry signal and decode the demodulated signal according to a telemetry algorithm associated with a telemetry protocol, the telemetry algorithm specifying a plurality of potential words related to the downhole operation, the telemetry system configured to assign a score to each potential word based on the decoded signal and the telemetry protocol. The system also includes a processor (36) configured to, based on the assigned score for each potential word and domain information related to the downhole operation, evaluate a correctness of at least one potential word, the evaluating including determining a likelihood that the at least one potential word corresponds to the decoded signal based on the domain information.

title_en: Beam measurement method and apparatus, device, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a beam measurement method and apparatus, a device, a storage medium and a program product. An AI model is configured in a terminal device, and prediction is performed on beams on the basis of AI, so as to obtain a prediction result corresponding to a measurement task, thus improving the efficiency of acquiring results of measurement tasks; moreover, performing prediction by means of an AI model can also ensure the accuracy of prediction results and ensure the communication performance of communication links; in addition, on the basis of an AI model, a plurality of different measurement tasks can be executed simultaneously, such that the technical problem that a plurality of measurement tasks cannot be executed simultaneously can be solved, thereby further improving the efficiency of measurement task execution.

title_en: Data collection method, indication method for data collection, and apparatus
abstract_en: A data collection method, an indication method for data collection, and an apparatus. The data collection method comprises: a terminal device receiving first information sent by a first network device or a second network device; and the terminal device collecting first data by using a first configuration matching the first information, wherein the first data is used for at least one of training a first model and supervising the first model, and the first model is an AI/ML model applied to the terminal device side.

title_en: Energy savings and system information for cells having defined geographic sections
abstract_en: A method in a user equipment (UE) includes: receiving, from a network, information indicating a plurality of geographic sections within a cell; determining a geographic section of the plurality of geographic sections within the cell in which the UE is located; transmitting, to the network, a message including a request for system information for the geographic section, wherein the message is transmitted in a period of time of a plurality of periods of time, wherein each period of time of the plurality of periods of time is associated with a particular geographic section of the plurality of geographic sections within the cell, wherein the period of time corresponds to the geographic section within the cell in which the UE is located; and receiving, from the network, system information for at least the geographic section within the cell in which the UE is located.

title_en: Method and apparatus for uplink transmission through non-terrestrial network
abstract_en: A method performed by a terminal, according to an embodiment of the present disclosure, may comprise the steps of: generating transport block processing over multiple slots (TBoMS) and a transport block (TB) determined to perform repetitive transmission; applying an orthogonal cover code (OCC) to at least one physical uplink shared channel (PUSCH) mapped to the TB; and transmitting, to a base station, the at least one PUSCH to which the OCC has been applied.

title_en: Resource processing methods and apparatuses, and storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to the technical field of communications, and provides resource processing methods and apparatuses, and a storage medium. A method comprises: identifying a resource requirement of a user equipment (UE), the resource requirement comprising a computing power requirement and/or a network requirement; and, on the basis of the resource requirement, determining a first computing power node, the first computing power node being used for computing a service data flow of the UE. By means of enhancing network functions, user requirements can be sensed and responses can be quickly made to optimize services, so as to meet complex and changeable network environments and user requirements.

title_en: Door opener with ability to erase or deactivate individual remote actuators from a control list
abstract_en: A system for operating a movable barrier may include an opener and an administration device. The opener may be operably coupled to the movable barrier to transition the movable barrier between open and closed positions. The opener may include a receiver configured to receive a transmitted signal from a remote transmitter, and a controller including first processing circuitry configured to determine whether the transmitted signal is from an authorized remote operator by comparing a code in the transmitted signal to a list of codes in an authorized remote actuator list and activate the motor in response to the transmitted signal being determined to be from the authorized remote actuator list. The administration device may include second processing circuitry configured to enable communication with the controller. The controller is further configured to delete an individual code from the authorized remote actuator list responsive to an instruction from the administration device.

title_en: Data processing method for generating soqpsk-stc signals, and for processing such signals
abstract_en: The invention relates to a data processing method, the method comprising: encoding (S104, S202) a pilot bit sequence according to space-time block coding, so as to produce a first encoded pilot bit sequence and a second encoded pilot bit sequence; encoding (S104, S203) a data stream according to space-time block coding, so as to produce a first encoded stream and a second encoded stream; modulating (S106, S206) a first pilot-inserted encoded stream according to an SOQPSK modulation scheme so as to produce the first signal, the first pilot-inserted encoded stream resulting from periodic insertion of the first encoded pilot bit sequence into the first encoded stream; and modulating (S107, S207) a second pilot-inserted encoded stream according to the SOQPSK modulation scheme so as to produce the second signal, the second pilot-inserted encoded stream resulting from periodic insertion of the second encoded pilot bit sequence into the second encoded stream.

title_en: Large fan-in RQL gates
abstract_en: Large fan-in logical gate circuits (100) for use in reciprocal quantum logic, RQL, systems and related methods permit for improved efficiency and density of RQL logic. A majority 3-of-5 gate circuit, as described, can be extended to include more than five inputs, and can also be modified to create AND gates, OR gates, and OA gates. The gate circuits can accommodate inputs and provide outputs each in the form of single flux quantum, SFQ, pulses, either positive or negative, to indicate asserted and de-asserted logic states, respectively.

title_en: Accelerated parallel processing of 5G NR signal information
abstract_en: Apparatuses, systems, and techniques to perform signal processing operations in a fifth generation (5G) new radio (NR) network using one or more parallel processing units (PPUs). In at least one embodiment, one or more PPUs implement signal processing in a baseband unit (BBU) performing 5G NR physical layer operations in a communication network.

title_en: Apparatus and method for automatic volume control with ambient noise compensation
abstract_en: An electronic device and method that automatically adjusts an audio output volume level based on a live environmental acoustic scenario input via a microphone using a machine learning algorithm trained with Human Activity Recognition (HAR). Equipped with such an intelligence the electronic device classifies ambient sounds occurring in the environment of the listening area in which the device is situated into different acoustic scenario mappings such a voice or conversation, for an ambient human conversation detected event, and noise, such as for example a vacuum cleaner or dish washer noise detected event, and automatically adjust the audio output volume accordingly.

title_en: Method and arrangement in a cellular communications system
abstract_en:
The present invention relates to the area of wireless communication, and 
especially to a method and an arrangement for transmission output power 
control in a cellular telecommunications network. An improved transmission 
output power control is achieved by adapting a pre-defined power mask to a 
signal transmission characteristic of the signal transmission and applying the 
adapted power mask to a sub-frame or an OFDM symbol. The present invention 
could be implemented in a network node such as an eNodeB or in a user 
equipment.

title_en: System and method for high dynamic range waveform digitization
abstract_en: Diverse applications from particle physics experiments to lidar are driving cost and current reduction in giga-hertz sampling rate high-resolution data conversion. Multiple imagers captures a single pixel of data and require processing at very high speed. High-bandwidth high-rate signal sampling, analog-to-digital conversion, and transfer of large amounts of data to a digital data acquisition block are required in such systems. Dynamic range, power consumption, and transfer of high-speed, high-bit width data are key implementation challenges. Data acquisition architectures optimized for specific requirements of such systems may facilitate system implementation and reduce overall system cost.

title_en: Frequency band extending device and method, encoding device and method, decoding device and method, and program
abstract_en:
FREQUENCY BAND EXTENDING DEVICE AND METHOD, ENCODING DEVICE AND 
METHOD, DECODING DEVICE AND METHOD, AND PROGRAM 
ABSTRACT 
The present invention relates to a decoding device and 
method, and a program, whereby music signals can be played 
with higher sound quality due to the extension of frequency 
bands.  
A bandpass filter 13 divides an input signal into multiple 
sub-band signals, a feature amount calculating circuit 14 
calculates feature amount using at least one of the multiple 
divided sub-band signals and the input signal, a high frequency 
sub-band power estimating circuit 15 calculates an estimated 
value of a high frequency sub-band power based on the 
calculated feature amount, a high frequency signal generating 
circuit 16 generates a high frequency signal component based on 
the multiple sub-band signals divided by the bandpass filter 
13, and the estimated value of the high frequency sub-band 
power calculated by the high frequency sub-band power 
estimating circuit 15. A frequency band extending device 10 
extends the frequency band of the input signal using a high 
frequency signal component. The present invention may be 
applied to a frequency band extending device, for example.

title_en: Technology configured to enable treatment of samples, including biological samples, using a combination of variable electric field generation and magnetic field suppression
abstract_en: The present invention relates, in various embodiments, to devices and methods configured to emit electric fields for the treatment of samples via variable electric fields, and to technology configured to enable treatment of a sample via a variable electric field in presence of magnetic field suppression. For example, in some embodiments the technology enables treatment of biological samples such as plant material and/or seeds. One example embodiment provides an emitter device including: a body; an elongate cavity defining formation within the body, the cavity defining formation including a sidewall which defines an elongate cavity, the cavity having at least one opening through the body defining a cavity output; an electric field generating component, wherein the electric field generating component is configured to selectively generate a variable electric field within the cavity such that the variable electric field is emitted through the cavity output; and a magnetic field suppression arrangement, wherein the magnetic field suppression arrangement is configured to suppress magnetic field in a region through which the electric field propagates.

title_en: Data processing device and data processing method
abstract_en: This technology pertains to a data processing device and data processing method which are capable of providing an LDPC code having a favorable error rate. This LDPC encoder encodes at a code length of 64,800 bits and at a 12/30, 13/30, 14/30, 15/30, 16/30 or 17/30 LDPC code rate. The LDPC code contains information bits and parity bits, and a check matrix (H) is configured from an information matrix section corresponding to the information bits of the LDPC code, and a parity matrix section corresponding to the parity bits. The information matrix section of the check matrix (H) is represented by a check matrix initial value table expressing the position of one element of the information matrix section for each of 360 rows. This technology can be applied in cases when conducting LDPC encoding and LDPC decoding.

title_en: A filter combiner for a doherty amplifier, and a doherty amplifier
abstract_en: A filter combiner (301) for a Doherty amplifier (302), characterized in that the filter combiner (301) comprises a first port (303) with an impedance of Zo configured to be connected to an output of a carrier amplifier (304); a second port (305) with an impedance of Zo.r/(1+r) configured to be connected to a load (306); a third port (307) with an impedance of Zo=r/(1+r) configured to be connected to a peak amplifier (308), wherein r is a power ratio for the carrier amplifier to the peaking amplifier; a fourth port (309) with an impedance of Zo configured to be connected to an output port (310) of the Doherty amplifier (302); wherein the first port is connected to the second port via a first network (311), wherein the first network is a lowpass filter; wherein the first port is connected to the third port via a second network (312), wherein the second network is a lowpass filter which is configured to operate as a band stop filter upon loading the input or the output of the second network with a high impedance when the peak amplifier is off; wherein the third port is connected to the fourth port via a third network (313), wherein the third network is a lowpass filter configured to operate as a band stop filter upon loading the input or the output of the second network with a high impedance when the peak amplifier is off; wherein the fourth port is connected to the second port via a fourth network (314), wherein the fourth network is a lowpass filter.

title_en: Configurable power wheelchair systems and methods
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a control system for a power wheelchair is provided allowing a user to change the type of input control device throughout a day, week, month, and/or year as their physical and/or mental condition changes. This includes changing input controls from proportional to switch-type devices. A user may start the day when they are not tired with a proportional input control device like a proportional joystick. Then, as the day progresses and the user begins to experience fatigue or exhaustion, the user can change to a switch-type control device requiring less control and dexterity (e.g., less strength and energy) to effectively control the power wheelchair. The user can also start the day with a 4, 3, or 2 switch direction input control and later change to a single switch input control device with scanning. Other combinations are also possible.

title_en: Passive mixer and operation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a passive mixer and an operation method thereof, wherein the passive mixer comprises a transconductance amplifier stage circuit, a switching mixer stage circuit and a transimpedance amplifier stage circuit; the transconductance amplification stage circuit increases the transconductance value, is connected with a radio frequency voltage signal, and converts the radio frequency voltage signal into a radio frequency current signal through current multiplexing; the switch mixing stage circuit is connected with the local oscillation signal, modulates and mixes the radio frequency current signal and the local oscillation signal, filters the mixed signal and outputs an intermediate frequency current signal; the transimpedance amplifier stage circuit reduces input impedance and increases equivalent transconductance value and gain through the auxiliary operational amplifier unit BN and the auxiliary operational amplifier unit BP, and converts an intermediate frequency current signal into an intermediate frequency voltage signal and outputs the intermediate frequency voltage signal. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of wide frequency band, high conversion gain, good port isolation and low power consumption.

title_en: Duty ratio corrector
abstract_en: A duty ratio corrector. The duty cycle corrector comprises a first pulse swallower, a second pulse swallower and a decision and hold circuit. The first pulse swallower provides a first clock signal having a second duty cycle in accordance with a first input clock having a first duty cycle. The second pulse swallower provides a second clock signal having the second duty cycle in accordance with a second input clock having the first duty cycle. The decision and hold circuit provides an output clock having a duty ratio of 50% according to the first clock signal and the second clock signal. The phase difference between the first input clock and the second input clock is 180 degrees, and the second duty ratio is smaller than the first duty ratio.

title_en: Monoclinic analog-to-digital converter with digital double sampling function, chip and terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monoclinic analog-to-digital converter with a digital double sampling function, a chip and a terminal. In the monoclinic analog-to-digital converter, a first sampling switch is connected between an analog signal input end and a first polar plate of a first sampling capacitor, and a second sampling switch is connected between a high reference voltage and the first polar plate of the first sampling capacitor; the slope signal output end of the slope generator is connected with the first polar plate of the second sampling capacitor; the second plates of the first sampling capacitor and the second sampling capacitor are respectively connected with the negative input end and the positive input end of the differential comparator; the negative and positive input ends of the differential comparator are connected with the positive and negative output ends of the differential comparator through a comparator reset switch respectively; meanwhile, the positive output end and the negative output end of the differential comparator are respectively connected with the positive input end and the negative input end of the latch; the output signal of the latch is connected with the enabling end of the counter, and the digital signal output by the counter is the analog-digital conversion result of the monoclinic analog-digital converter.

title_en: Quick gain control system for frequency hopping receiving channel
abstract_en: A fast automatic gain control system for a frequency hopping channel, applied to a receiver, comprising: the system comprises a radio frequency AGC loop control unit, a first mixer, a first frequency synthesizer module, an LNA3, a channel FPGA control module, a first intermediate frequency filter, an LNA4, a second mixer, a second frequency synthesizer module, a second intermediate frequency filter, an intermediate frequency AGC loop control unit, an anti-aliasing filter and a digital signal processing module; the radio frequency AGC loop control unit comprises a first frequency hopping filter, a first radio frequency gain control circuit, a second frequency hopping filter, a second radio frequency gain control circuit and a radio frequency signal intensity detection circuit, and the intermediate frequency AGC loop control unit comprises an intermediate frequency signal intensity detection circuit and a controllable gain amplifier VGA; the first radio frequency gain control circuit comprises a first electronic switch, an LNA1 and a second electronic switch, and the second radio frequency gain control circuit comprises a third electronic switch, an LNA2 and a fourth electronic switch.

title_en: Grid protection plate for gate protection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gate protection plate for gate protection, which comprises a port D-Gon and a port D-E, wherein the port D-Gon is connected with a driving plate to output driving pulse signals, the port IGBT-G is connected with an IGBT gate, and the port IGBT-E is connected with an IGBT emitter; and a gate driving resistor connected between the port D-Gon and the port IGBT-G, and a source driving resistor connected between the port D-E and the port IGBT-E; and the IGBT on pressure relief circuit and the IGBT off pressure relief circuit are connected between the port IGBT-G and the port IGBT-E. According to the invention, by adding a part of circuits, the energy during switching on and switching off is absorbed and discharged, so that the resistance of the driving resistor is reduced in design, and the IGBT loss is reduced; when the IGBT works normally, the gate voltage can be stabilized at about 16V, and the long-term running performance and the service life of the IGBT are ensured.

title_en: Method and device for realizing software phase-locked loop
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method and a device for realizing a software phase-locked loop, wherein the method comprises the following steps: converting the three-phase voltage component of the power grid voltage into a two-phase voltage component according to Clark conversion; inputting the two-phase voltage component into a first biquadratic generalized integrator to obtain a fundamental positive sequence component corresponding to the two-phase voltage component; converting the fundamental positive sequence component into d and q axis voltage components based on park transformation; performing PI regulation integration on the q-axis voltage component to obtain a phase angle of the grid voltage; and acquiring a phase angle adjusting value corresponding to the phase angle according to a second double-second order generalized integrator and feeding the phase angle adjusting value back to the park transformation for closed-loop adjustment to form a software phase-locked loop. The software phase-locked loop realized by the method can still realize the rapid and accurate phase-locked effect when the voltage of a power grid is unbalanced, the harmonic content is large and the frequency fluctuates.

title_en: Intrinsically safe dynamic driving circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intrinsically safe dynamic driving circuit, which comprises a first dynamic-static conversion circuit, a second dynamic-static conversion circuit, a signal oscillation circuit and an energy conversion and feedback circuit, wherein the first dynamic-static conversion circuit consists of a photoelectric coupler 1U1, a triode 1Q2 and a voltage stabilizing circuit 1U 2; the second dynamic-static conversion circuit is composed of a photoelectric coupler 2U1, a triode 2Q2 and a voltage stabilizing circuit 2U 2. The dynamic driving circuit completes energy transmission under the control of 2 paths of dynamic pulses, all adopted elements are passive elements, and the failure of any element or the failure of any path of pulse can not cause driving output, so the circuit has higher safety level and is an intrinsic safety circuit.

title_en: Circuit structure for driving bias voltage of LCD
abstract_en: The invention discloses a circuit structure for driving bias voltage by an LCD (liquid crystal display), which comprises a resistor R1, a resistor R2, a resistor R3, a first NMOS (N-channel metal oxide semiconductor) tube, a second NMOS tube, a PMOS (P-channel metal oxide semiconductor) tube and a transmission gate TG, wherein the output end of the resistor R1 is respectively connected with one end of the transmission gate TG, the input end of the resistor R2 and the input end of the first NMOS tube, the output end of the resistor R2 is respectively connected with the other end of the transmission gate TG, the input end of the resistor R3 and the input end of the PMOS tube, and the output end of the resistor R3 is connected with the input end of the second NMOS tube. By adopting the NMOS tube and the PMOS tube, the invention has the advantages of stable bias voltage, good effect, simple structure, high circuit integration level, small occupied chip area and low cost.

title_en: Successive approximation type analog-to-digital converter and self-detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a successive approximation type analog-to-digital converter and a self-detection method thereof. A successive approximation analog-to-digital converter comprising: a reference signal generator for generating a reference voltage; a digital-to-analog converter for receiving the reference voltage generated by the reference signal generator and outputting a first level voltage and a second level voltage based on the input first analog signal, second analog signal and the reference voltage; a comparator for comparing the first level voltage with the second level voltage and outputting a comparison signal; and digital logic for outputting digital data based on the comparison signal, the digital logic comprising: and a data generator for generating data to replace the input of the first analog signal and the second analog signal when the successive approximation analog-to-digital converter performs self-detection.

title_en: Enhanced amplifier efficiency by cascode current steering
abstract_en: According to some implementations, a Power Amplifier (PA) includes: a common emitter configured to receive a Radio Frequency (RF) signal. The PA further includes: a carrier amplifier coupled to the common emitter to form a carrier cascode configuration, a collector of the carrier amplifier being supplied with a first supply voltage. The PA further includes: a peaking amplifier coupled to the common emitter to form a peaking cascode configuration, a collector of the peaking amplifier being supplied with a second supply voltage greater than the first supply voltage.

title_en: Load switch capable of conducting current limiting bidirectionally
abstract_en: The invention provides a load switch capable of conducting in a bidirectional mode and limiting current. The technical scheme of the invention realizes bidirectional current limiting while bidirectional conduction, and has the function of preventing reverse connection of a power supply and ground.

title_en: Combined/sequential pulse width modulation
abstract_en: Several standard PWM generators generate PWM signals that can be used to drive power stages for full-bridge, feed-forward, push-pull, phase-shift, zero-voltage-transition ZVT, and other switch-mode power supply SMPS switching topologies. These PWM signals may be fed to the logic functions of the combinational logic block. The appropriate PWM signals are selected as operands and the desired logic function to operate on these input operands. The resulting combined PWM signal may then be used directly or may be fed through dead time processing circuitry before being output to application circuitry. In addition to the combinational logic function, sequential logic functions may also be used to provide sequential PWM signals, such as synchronous sequential, asynchronous sequential, and/or sequential combinational PWM signals.

title_en: Temperature-compensated oscillating circuit, oscillator, method of manufacturing the same, electronic apparatus, and moving object
abstract_en: The invention provides a temperature compensation type oscillating circuit, an oscillator, a manufacturing method thereof, an electronic device and a mobile body, wherein the temperature compensation type oscillating circuit can be used for realizing the oscillator with small frequency deviation caused by temperature while reducing manufacturing cost. The temperature compensation type oscillating circuit comprises: an oscillation circuit that oscillates a vibrator; a fractional N-PLL circuit that multiplies the frequency of an oscillation signal output from the oscillation circuit according to an input frequency division ratio; a temperature measuring unit that measures a temperature; and a storage unit that stores a temperature correction table for correcting a frequency-temperature characteristic of the oscillation signal, wherein the frequency division ratio of the fractional-N-PLL circuit is set based on the measured value of the temperature measuring unit and the temperature correction table.

title_en: Capacitive proximity sensor and door handle device provided with same
abstract_en: Provided is an electrostatic capacitance type proximity sensor capable of reliably recognizing a human body and water. The resonant frequency of the LCR resonant circuit (20) when the object is not close to the sensor electrode (22) is set to be f  1  The judgment voltage signal is set to V  1  The resonance frequency of the LCR resonance circuit (20) when the human body approaches the sensor electrode (22) is set as f  2  The judgment voltage signal is set to V  2  The resonance frequency of the LCR resonance circuit (20) when water approaches the sensor electrode (22) is f  3  The judgment voltage signal is set to V  3  At this time, having f  1  ＞f  2  ＞f  3  In the case of the relation of (2), the control part (42) satisfies V  2  ＞V  1  ＞V  3  Is controlled by the relation of the high frequency signal (S  0  ) And identifies the proximity of the human body to the water direction sensor electrode (22).

title_en: Doherty amplifier
abstract_en: A doherty amplifier comprising: a main power amplifier having a main amplifier output; a peak power amplifier having a peak amplifier output; combining the nodes; a main output impedance inverter connected between the main amplifier output and the combining node; and a transformer connected between the peak amplifier output and the combining node.

title_en: Differential switch circuit
abstract_en: The present invention provides a differential switch circuit, which comprises: a first transistor having a first terminal coupled to the first input terminal, a second terminal coupled to the first output terminal, and a control terminal coupled to the switching signal receiving terminal; a second transistor having a first terminal coupled to the second input terminal, a second terminal coupled to the second output terminal, and a control terminal coupled to the switch signal receiving terminal; a central switching element located on a signal path between control terminals of the first transistor and the second transistor; and a switching element control circuit for controlling the central switching element in accordance with the switching signal. The switching element control circuit turns off the central switching element when the switching signal turns on the first transistor and the second transistor, and turns on the central switching element when the switching signal turns off the first transistor and the second transistor.

title_en: Amplifier of TV tuner chip and method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses an amplifier of a television tuner chip and a method thereof. An amplifier includes a negative gain amplifier, a load element, and a transconductance device. The negative gain amplifier has an input and an output. The load element has a first terminal coupled to the supply voltage terminal and a second terminal. The transconductance device has: a first current electrode coupled to a second terminal of the load element; a control electrode coupled to an output of the negative gain amplifier and a second current electrode coupled to an input of the negative gain amplifier.

title_en: high-dB-gain broadband variable-transconductance six-bit active phase shifter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-dB-gain broadband variable transconductance six-bit active phase shifter, which mainly solves the problem of larger mirror image current error in the conventional phase shifter. The system comprises a single-turn double balun, a quadrature signal generator, an analog adder, a buffer and a control circuit. After the radio frequency signal enters the active balun circuit, the single-end radio frequency signal is converted into a differential signal with opposite phase and same amplitude, and the overall gain of the circuit is improved. After the differential signals pass through a triple-pole orthogonal signal generator, four orthogonal signals with the same amplitude are generated to serve as the input of the analog adder, under the action of a controller, a cluster of signals with equal phase shift are synthesized in an orthogonal vector synthesis mode, and the output signals of the phase shifter are obtained through the action of a buffer. The invention not only improves the phase precision, but also reduces the gain attenuation of the passive module, avoids applying bias current by using a digital-to-analog conversion circuit, reduces the power consumption of the circuit and can be used in a radio frequency integrated circuit.

title_en: All-quartz crystal resonator with improved electrode connection structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full quartz crystal resonator with an improved electrode connection structure, which relates to the field of quartz crystal resonators, wherein two corners on a diagonal line of a quartz wafer are provided with metal layers, and each metal layer comprises an upper metal layer arranged on the upper surface of the quartz wafer and a lower metal layer arranged on the lower surface of the quartz wafer; the upper metal layer and the quartz wafer are provided with a through hole I which penetrates through, two corners on a diagonal line of the packaging base are respectively provided with a through hole II and a through hole III, and when the quartz wafer is arranged on the packaging base, the through hole I and the through hole II penetrate through, and the through hole III is contacted with the lower metal layer; the inner walls of the first through hole, the second through hole and the third through hole are plated with metal layers, and the inside is filled with sealing medium. The invention solves the problems that the plated metal material of the semicircular ring structure arranged at two end points of a diagonal line of the quartz wafer of the traditional all-quartz crystal resonator is easy to fall off, and the stability of the fallen metal layer is poor when conducting electricity.

title_en: High speed AC coupled inverter-based buffer with replica biasing
abstract_en: Certain aspects of the present disclosure provide a high speed AC-coupled inverter-based buffer that may be used, for example, as a buffer for a Voltage Controlled Oscillator (VCO). One example buffer for a VCO generally includes: a first inverter stage having an input node configured to receive a first complementary signal of a differential pair; a second inverter stage having an input node configured to receive a second complementary signal of the differential pair; replicating a biasing stage of the first inverter stage or the second inverter stage, wherein an output node of the biasing stage is connected with an input node of the biasing stage; a first impedance coupled between an input node of the first inverter stage and an input node of the biasing stage; and a second impedance coupled between the input node of the second inverter stage and the input node of the biasing stage.

title_en: Jitter injection for continuous MASH ADCS
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to dither implantation of continuous MASH ADCS. For continuous-time multi-stage noise-shaping analog-to-digital converters (CT MASH ADC), quantization noise cancellation typically requires an estimation of a transfer function, such as the noise transfer function of the front-end modulator. To estimate the noise transfer function, a dither signal may be injected in the front-end modulator. However, it is not important how the dither signal can be injected, as the dither signal can potentially leak into the back-end modulator and cause overall noise degradation. To address some of these problems, the dither signal is injected after the flash analog-to-digital converter (ADC) of the front-end modulator. In addition, a virtual comparator structure may be used to synchronize the dither with the quantization noise of the target flash ADC.

title_en: Spread spectrum clock generator
abstract_en: A phase or frequency locked loop circuit includes an oscillator configured to generate an output clock signal whose frequency is set by an oscillator control signal. The modulator circuit receives a first signal and a second signal and is configured to generate a control signal whose value is modulated in response to the first and second signals. A filter circuit generates the oscillator control signal by filtering the control signal. The delta-sigma modulator circuit is operative to modulate the second signal responsive to a modulation mode. Thus, the output clock signal is a spread spectrum clock signal.

title_en: Output circuit for pulse code pattern generator
abstract_en: The invention discloses an output circuit for a pulse code pattern generator, which comprises a pulse edge adjusting circuit, a pulse amplitude control circuit, an attenuator and a linear amplifier; the pulse edge regulating circuit is used for carrying out edge regulation on an input pulse width differential signal, setting the time of a rising edge and a falling edge of a pulse, and controlling the amplitude of the pulse signal output by the pulse edge regulating circuit; the pulse edge regulating circuit is connected with the linear amplifier through the attenuator, and the linear amplifier is used for linearly amplifying the pulse signal output by the pulse edge regulating circuit so as to achieve the set output amplitude. Therefore, when the pulse output control circuit is applied to the pulse code pattern generator, the performance of the pulse code pattern generator can be improved.

title_en: Apparatus for built-in self-test Nyquist rate analog-to-digital converter circuit
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an apparatus for a built-in self-measuring nyquist rate analog-to-digital converter circuit. For example, a built-in self test (BIST) circuit is provided for testing an analog-to-digital converter (ADC). A multiple-order delta-sigma (Σ Δ) modulator has an input receiving an input signal, a first output generating an analog test signal derived from the input signal and applied to the input of the ADC, and a second output generating a binary data stream. The digital recombination and filtering circuit has a first input receiving the binary data stream and a second input receiving the digital test signal output from the ADC in response to the analog test signal. The digital recombination and filtering circuit combines and filters the binary data stream and the digital test signal to generate a digital result signal that includes signal components derived from errors introduced by operation of the ADC. Correlation circuitry is used to isolate the error signal component.

title_en: Three-continuous-stroke recognition circuit and three-continuous-stroke recognition method based on same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-continuous-stroke recognition circuit and a three-continuous-stroke recognition method based on the circuit, wherein the three-continuous-stroke recognition circuit comprises a key switch, a Bluetooth chip and a recognition circuit for connecting the key switch and the Bluetooth chip, the Bluetooth chip is a ROM (read only memory) Bluetooth chip, the Bluetooth chip is provided with an MFB (Multi-frequency bus) interface, a first PIO (particle image input) interface and a second PIO interface, and the recognition circuit comprises a first triode, a second triode, a first resistor, a second resistor, a third resistor and a fourth resistor; the identification method comprises the following steps: 1) judging whether the MFB interface and the first PIO interface have signal input at the same time in the period time; 2) judging whether the MFB interface and the second PIO interface have signal input at the same time in the period time; 3) and judging whether the MFB interface and the second PIO interface simultaneously input signals again in the cycle time. The invention can lead the ROM version Bluetooth chip to identify the three-connection impact of the key switch, thereby effectively reducing the manufacturing cost.

title_en: Method and system for efficient detection of corrupted data
abstract_en: The file system may allocate data of the storage system as data units, where a set of data units may be grouped into storage regions within a volume. The process of verifying the validity of data within a storage region may include obtaining a first set of error-detecting codes from a subset of data stored in the storage system, such as from data units of a file system object. Each of the first set of error-detecting codes may be associated with a respective data unit within the storage region. A second set of error-detecting codes can be generated based at least in part on the first set of error-detecting codes, and the second set of error-detecting codes can be associated with the storage region such that the second set of error-detecting codes can be used to verify the validity of data within the storage region.

title_en: Low-voltage high-speed programmable equalization circuit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a low-voltage high-speed programmable equalization circuit, which comprises a gain boosting amplifying stage, a CML differential amplifying stage and an emitter follower, wherein the input end of the gain boosting amplifying stage is an input end of the equalization circuit, and the output end of the gain boosting amplifying stage is connected with the input end of the CML differential amplifying stage; the output end of the CML differential amplification stage is connected with the input end of the emitter follower; and the output end of the emitter follower is the output end of the equalizing circuit. According to the invention, one path of an input signal passes through a pure resistance network full-path and the other path passes through a resistance-capacitance network high-path through a gain boosting amplifying stage, so that high-pass filtering is realized, and the effective high-speed signal loss is reduced to the minimum; and the two variable current sources in the gain boosting amplifying stage realize that the equalizing compensation size is programmable, and the proportion of the two variable current sources is adjusted according to different cable lengths of different application scenes, so that proper equalizing compensation is realized, and various application requirements are met.

title_en: High-precision comparator circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-precision comparator circuit which comprises a core circuit, a reference voltage input end, an input voltage input end, an output end, a second switch and a third switch, wherein the core circuit comprises a core circuit positive input end, a core circuit negative input end and a core circuit output end, the input voltage input end is connected to the core circuit negative input end through the second switch, the reference voltage input end is connected to the core circuit positive input end, the core circuit positive input end is connected to the core circuit negative input end through the third switch, the core circuit output end is connected with the output end of the comparator circuit, and the core circuit comprises an amplifier circuit and a phase inverter circuit. The high-precision comparator circuit provided by the invention avoids parasitic capacitance introduced by adding capacitance and switches to the input nodes of the comparator circuit, eliminates precision loss introduced by the parasitic capacitance, reduces the difficulty of circuit design, and can save power consumption and area.

title_en: Amplifier arrangement with envelope signal shaping for gate bias modulation
abstract_en: Embodiments described herein include an amplifier configured for use in Radio Frequency (RF) applications. According to these embodiments, the amplifier is implemented to generate a shaped envelope signal and the shaped envelope signal is applied to a transistor gate of the amplifier to provide gate bias modulation. So configured, the shaped envelope signal may facilitate higher linearity of the amplifier.

title_en: Seal ring, package for housing electronic component, electronic device, and methods for manufacturing seal ring and package for housing electronic component
abstract_en: The invention provides a seal ring, which is provided with a metal solder layer on one surface of a kovar alloy-containing substrate and a metal plating layer on the other surface, and can prevent stains from being generated on the surface of the metal plating layer, thereby realizing excellent air tightness of a package for receiving electronic elements. The present invention solves the above problems by providing an annular seal ring having a nickel layer with a thickness of 0.1 to 20 μm on a first surface of a substrate containing kovar alloy (iron-nickel-cobalt alloy) and a metallic solder layer on a second surface opposite to the first surface.

title_en: High-side switch for current supply of at least one sensor
abstract_en: A high-side switch (100) for the current supply of at least one sensor is provided, comprising two terminals (1, 2) and a current path (10), by means of which the terminals (1, 2) are connected to one another and in which a measuring transistor (4) and at least two resistors (5) are connected to one another in series. Furthermore, the high-side switch (100) comprises a power transistor (6) which is connected in parallel with the current path (10), and a comparator (30) which has two inputs (31, 32), one of which is fixedly connected to the current path (10) and one of which can be variably connected to the current path (10) in such a way that the number of resistors (5) located between the inputs (31, 32) and the connection point of the current path (10) can be varied. The comparator (30) also comprises an output (33) which is connected to the control inputs of the measurement transistor (4) and of the power transistor (6). A first current source (40) which can be calibrated is connected to the control input of the measuring transistor (4).

title_en: Hybrid scheduling and latch-based pipeline for low density parity check decoding
abstract_en: A pipelined decoding system for performing pipelined decoding of codewords characterized by one or more parity syndromes may include: a first pipeline stage circuit configured to process a first parity set consisting of one or more first parity equations for a codeword and to process a second parity set consisting of one or more second parity equations for the codeword; a second pipeline stage circuit configured to generate one or more codeword update messages for a second parity set based on the first estimate of the codeword; and third pipeline stage circuitry configured to update the first estimate of the codeword with one or more codeword update messages of the first parity set to obtain a second estimate of the codeword.

title_en: Convolutional neural network
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are systems and methods that implement more efficient and less resource intensive CNNs. Specifically, the use of sampling simulation technique (SAT) methods in CNNs in the simulation field is disclosed. Using CNN designs in SAT can reduce power consumption and operating speed compared to CNN designs with digital logic and memory. The low power consumption of CNN designs with SATs enables sensor devices to detect functions at very low power to achieve isolated operation.

title_en: Frequency-fast adjustable frequency converter and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a frequency-fast adjustable frequency converter and a control method, wherein the frequency-fast adjustable frequency converter comprises a silicon controlled rectifier bridge, a three-phase inverter bridge, a current detection circuit and a voltage detection circuit which are respectively used for collecting load current signals and voltage signals, a control board which is connected with the output of the current detection circuit and the detection circuit, a rectifier phase control board which is connected with the control board in a communication way, and a PWM driving module which is used for driving the three-phase inverter bridge and is connected with the control board in a communication way. The invention utilizes the current detection circuit and the voltage detection circuit to detect the load, realizes real-time feedback of the state, controls the silicon controlled rectifier bridge through the rectifier phase control plate, realizes controllable and adjustable input voltage, is convenient for synchronous adjustment of the voltage in the subsequent frequency conversion, and improves the controllability.

title_en: Discrete quantity and analog quantity normalized acquisition circuit and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of airborne discrete quantity and analog quantity acquisition, and particularly relates to a discrete quantity and analog quantity normalized acquisition circuit and method. A discrete-quantity, analog-quantity normalized acquisition circuit, the circuit comprising: the device comprises a signal configuration unit, a switch matrix 1, a switch matrix 2, a four-to-one switch, a range configuration unit, an A/D converter and a logic control unit. The signal configuration unit is respectively connected with the switch matrix 1 and the switch matrix 2; the four-out-of-one switch is respectively connected with the switch matrix 1, the switch matrix 2 and the range configuration unit, and the A/D converter is respectively connected with the range configuration unit and the logic control unit. In the invention, the system discrete quantity input and analog quantity input multiplex a set of conversion channels, the discrete quantity input acquisition is realized by a voltage acquisition method, and the system has the characteristics of small volume, low power consumption and light weight; meanwhile, the system has complete interface protection function and BIT mechanism, and has accurate fault location, high isolation rate and high reliability.

title_en: High-precision converter
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-precision converter, which relates to an integrated circuit and comprises a main cell array consisting of N conversion cells, and is characterized in that in a high-X conversion cell of the main cell array, each conversion cell is connected with a trimming array in a matching way, N-X is less than or equal to 10, and N and X are natural numbers. The main unit array has the advantages that all modules in the main unit array adopt the same module, the finished product circuit can reach the maximum matching precision provided by a process manufacturer, meanwhile, the trimming array is added at the high X position, and the precision of the finished product circuit can reach the precision requirement of 12 bits and above.

title_en: Planar inductor for RF heating system
abstract_en: The solid state heating apparatus may be incorporated into a stand-alone appliance or other system. The heating device may include an impedance matching network coupled between the electrode and a Radio Frequency (RF) source. The impedance matching network may be a variable impedance matching network that is adjustable during heating operations. The impedance matching network may comprise a planar inductor formed from patterned conductive layers disposed on either side of a substrate.

title_en: Application of molybdenum disulfide in manufacturing odd harmonic microwave frequency multiplier
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of molybdenum disulfide in preparation of an odd harmonic microwave frequency multiplier, wherein the odd harmonic microwave frequency multiplier comprises a cavity, an input coaxial connector and an output coaxial connector which are respectively positioned at two ends of the cavity, and a cover plate matched with the cavity, a molybdenum disulfide frequency multiplier high-frequency substrate is arranged in the cavity, the molybdenum disulfide frequency multiplier high-frequency substrate comprises a high-frequency substrate and microstrip lines which are arranged on the high-frequency substrate and respectively connected with the microstrip line input coaxial connector and the microstrip line output coaxial connector, gaps are arranged among the microstrip lines, and molybdenum disulfide is arranged among the gaps. The invention utilizes the good nonlinear microwave characteristic of molybdenum disulfide, is suitable for nonlinear devices such as frequency multipliers, and the like, adopts the frequency multipliers made of molybdenum disulfide, has good nonlinear performance, can not generate echo signals, has very simple circuit design and good frequency doubling effect, and has the third frequency doubling loss equivalent to fundamental wave.

title_en: Apparatus and method for impedance measurement and adaptive antenna tuning
abstract_en: The impedance of the antenna can be matched without directly measuring the phase. This is advantageous because it reduces the cost and complexity of the wireless transceiver. In particular, the phase component of the antenna reflection coefficient may be estimated from the return loss measurement. For example, the transceiver may measure an initial return loss of the antenna, adjust the impedance of the at least one adjustable element, and then measure one or more adjusted return losses of the antenna. The phase of the reflection coefficient can be estimated from the difference between the initial return loss and the one or more adjusted return losses.

title_en: High efficiency power voltage level shifter circuit
abstract_en: The disclosed systems and methods relate to a high efficiency power voltage level converter. In a normal mode, in which a first supply voltage (vdd1) of a first voltage domain is different from a second supply voltage (vdd2) of a second voltage domain, the voltage level converter (250) converts an input signal (a, a _ n) in the first voltage domain to an output signal in the second voltage domain. In a bypass mode in which the first supply voltage is substantially the same as the second supply voltage, a bypass circuit (252) is configured to bypass the voltage level converter (250) and provide the input signal as the output signal in the first voltage domain, thereby avoiding delays introduced by the voltage level converter in the bypass mode. Further, a power down circuit (275) is configured to power down the voltage level converter in the bypass mode, but not in the normal mode.

title_en: Level shifter with bypass
abstract_en: Various implementations described herein relate to integrated circuits having level shifting circuitry and bypass switching circuitry. The level shifting circuit is arranged for converting an input signal from a first voltage domain to an output signal of a second voltage domain. The bypass switch circuit is arranged to activate and deactivate the level shift circuit based on the bypass control signal.

title_en: Delay unit parameter selection method and device and oscillator circuit
abstract_en: The application provides a delay unit parameter selection method, a delay unit parameter selection device and an oscillator circuit, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing temperature simulation on the oscillating circuit to obtain a temperature coefficient of the oscillating circuit; when the temperature coefficient is not the target temperature coefficient, adjusting the gate length of a switching tube in the delay unit according to the comparison result of the temperature coefficient and the target temperature coefficient, and continuously performing temperature simulation on the adjusted oscillating circuit until the temperature coefficient reaches the target temperature coefficient; and outputting design parameters of the oscillating circuit when the temperature coefficient reaches the target temperature coefficient. The output frequency of the oscillator is not changed along with the temperature change, so that the problem that the frequency of the oscillator is changed along with the temperature change in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Memory classification circuit, memory detection tool and memory detection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a memory classification circuit, a memory detection tool and a memory detection system, wherein the memory classification circuit comprises a main controller, a current threshold setting circuit and an overcurrent protection circuit, a signal transmission end of the main controller is connected with an upper computer, and a control end of the main controller is connected with a plurality of controlled ends of the current threshold setting circuit; a plurality of output ends of the current threshold value setting circuit are connected with a current threshold value input end of the overcurrent protection circuit; the detection end of the overcurrent protection circuit is connected with the memory to be detected, and the output end of the overcurrent protection circuit is connected with the main controller. The invention realizes classification according to the driving current of the memory, thereby solving the problem that the memory can not be screened out due to larger driving current in the memory caused by screening the shorted memory by the self-recovery fuse.

title_en: Circuit system for directly demodulating frequency modulation signal based on phase-locked loop and control method
abstract_en: The invention provides a circuit system and a control method for directly demodulating a frequency modulation signal based on a phase-locked loop, wherein the system comprises: an amplifying module for amplifying the input radio frequency signal; the phase/frequency discrimination module is used for acquiring the frequency difference and the phase difference of the local oscillator and the amplified radio frequency signal; the frequency band limiting module is connected with the phase discrimination/frequency discrimination module to limit the bandwidth according to the frequency difference and the phase difference and amplify the bandwidth; the controllable gain amplifying module is used for adjusting the amplitude of the output signal of the frequency band limiting module in a controllable mode; the frequency synthesizer module with controllable frequency is connected with the controllable gain amplifying module and the frequency/phase discrimination module, and generates corresponding frequency change according to the frequency difference and the phase difference signal after gain adjustment so as to carry out frequency adjustment and tracking. The system has the advantages of capability of carrying out carrier frequency tracking and carrier error elimination on the basis of realizing conventional frequency shift keying demodulation, simple structure, low power consumption and strong performance.

title_en: Data processing method and system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a data processing method, a system, an electronic device and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: after receiving a data compression command, determining the target length and the complementary maximum length of a fixed-length compression storage unit; extracting target compressed data from the data to be compressed corresponding to the data compression command; the length of the target compressed data is the product of the target length and a preset compression rate; compressing the target compressed data into a target fixed-length compressed storage unit, and judging whether the residual length of the target fixed-length compressed storage unit is greater than the complementation maximum length; if not, performing complementary operation; if so, taking the residual length as the target length; and repeating the steps until the data to be compressed corresponding to the data compression command is completely compressed. The data processing method provided by the application improves the decompression speed of the compressed data.

title_en: Encoding method, decoding method, encoding device and decoding device
abstract_en: The application provides an encoding method, a decoding method, an encoding device and a decoding device, wherein the encoding method comprises the following steps: dividing a transmission block to be transmitted into N bit sections, wherein N is an integer greater than 1; coding the ith bit segment in the N bit segments to obtain an ith coding block, wherein the check bit of the ith coding block is obtained by calculating the reference bit of the ith bit segment and the reference bit of the ith bit segment; i is a positive integer which is greater than 1 and less than or equal to N, and the reference bits of the ith bit segment comprise part or all of the bits in the ith-1 bit segment except the reference bits of the ith-1 bit segment. The coding method of the embodiment of the application does not need to change the existing hybrid automatic repeat request protocol based on the transmission block, keeps the advantages of low uplink channel resource occupancy rate and simple management of feedback retransmission of the existing feedback retransmission protocol, and improves the coding gain.

title_en: Code length free polarization code coding method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polarization code encoding method with free code length, belonging to the field of channel encoding and decoding in the field of wireless communication. Aiming at the problems that the existing method for increasing the code length freedom degree of the polarization code can simultaneously cause the increase of decoding complexity and the decoding effect of the polarization code except for special code length is not good, the polarization code is firstly decomposed into subcodes with specific code length through binary conversion, an optimal scheme for performing joint coding on the subcodes is obtained by utilizing a polarization effect optimization algorithm, and finally, the subcodes are coded in a joint coding mode. Compared with the punctured polar codes and the multi-core polar codes, the decoding complexity of the coded codes is effectively reduced, and the decoding complexity of partial code lengths is reduced by nearly 50%. The decoding effect is also better than the existing punctured polarization codes, and compared with the multi-core polarization codes, the invention has better code length freedom.

title_en: Low-power-consumption reference voltage circuit system based on dynamic compensation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of reference voltage design, in particular to a low-power-consumption reference voltage circuit system based on dynamic compensation, which comprises: the reference voltage compensation circuit and the load circuit are selectively connected to the same reference voltage end of the reference voltage circuit, and when the load circuit obtains a forward current from the reference voltage end, the reference voltage compensation circuit provides a compensation current for the reference voltage end so as to compensate the voltage drop of the reference voltage end. The invention has the advantages that: 1) The reference voltage buffer circuit design based on dynamic compensation utilizes the charge sharing principle, can greatly reduce the power consumption and the area of an analog-digital conversion system, and indirectly improves the conversion speed of an analog-digital converter; 2) Logic signal generation circuits with corresponding dynamically adjusted charge compensation are used to achieve fast detection and response.

title_en: Optical switch device with blocking body and blocking action space
abstract_en: The optical switch device with the blocking body and the blocking action space comprises an optical transmitter, an optical receiver, an electronic circuit chip and an optical switch, and is characterized in that: the optical switch is provided with an elastic blocking body (2-1), a blocking action space (9-1), a light emitting window and a light receiving window, wherein the blocking action space (9-1) is arranged below the blocking body (2-1), and the light emitting window and the light receiving window are both positioned in the blocking action space (9-1); when the optical switch device is used: the blocking body (2-1) is pressed down, and the blocking body (2-1) blocks the light paths of the light emitting window and the light receiving window; the blocking body (2-1) is reset, and the light path is conducted; the scheme has the advantages of simple process, low production cost, long service life and ultra-thin structure, and can be applied to PC keyboards and notebook keyboards; the film keyboard can be applied to medical equipment, industrial control equipment, household appliances and the like.

title_en: Storage device, data management method, and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a storage device, a data management method and a storage medium of a data management program, which can compress data and appropriately manage the data. The storage device (104) comprises: more than one FMPK (113) having FM chip capable of storing data; and a storage controller (109) that controls storage of write data for which a predetermined write request is made to the FMPK (113), wherein the storage device (104) is configured in such a manner that: the FMPK (113) has a compression/decompression circuit for compressing data by a second compression algorithm different from the first compression algorithm, and the memory controller (109) compresses data in accordance with the first compression algorithm, determines which of the memory controller (109) and the compression/decompression circuit compresses write data based on a predetermined condition, compresses the write data by the determined memory controller (109) or compression/decompression circuit, and stores the compressed write data in the FMPK (113).

title_en: Simple high-gain amplifying circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simple high-gain amplifying circuit, which comprises an amplifying unit and a holding unit, wherein the amplifying unit comprises a signal input end capable of receiving a signal to be amplified and a signal output end capable of outputting an amplified signal, the holding unit is connected with the signal input end of the amplifying unit and further outputs a holding signal capable of enabling the voltage of the signal input end of the amplifying unit to be close to the voltage of the signal output end of the amplifying unit, and further the amplifying unit is located in a reverse central point working area during operation.

title_en: Comparator and analog-to-digital converter
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention provide a comparator. The comparator includes: the circuit comprises a first current source circuit, a pre-amplifying circuit, an amplifying circuit, a comparing circuit and an output circuit. The first current source circuit is configured to supply a first constant current to the pre-amplification circuit.
