The pre-amplification circuit is configured to amplify a first input signal into a first pre-amplified signal and amplify a second input signal into a second pre-amplified signal according to a first constant current. The amplifying circuit includes a current mirror and a load circuit, and is configured to generate a first image signal of the first pre-amplified signal and a second image signal of the second pre-amplified signal through the current mirror, and generate the first and second amplified signals through the load circuit based on the first and second image signals, respectively. The load circuit includes differential diode-connected transistors. The comparison circuit is configured to compare the first amplified signal and the second amplified signal. The output circuit is configured to output the first voltage or the second voltage based on a result of the comparison.

title_en: SiC MOSFET class II short-circuit current suppression circuit and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a circuit and a method for suppressing second-class short-circuit current of a SiC MOSFET, comprising the following steps: logic circuit, push-pull amplifier, gate voltage switching circuit and gate voltage detection circuit. When the second type of short circuit occurs, the grid voltage will be suddenly changed to form a higher voltage peak.

title_en: Negative resistance type voltage-controlled oscillating circuit and voltage-controlled oscillator
abstract_en: A negative resistance voltage-controlled oscillation circuit and a voltage-controlled oscillator comprise a frequency selection module, a negative resistance differential pair module and an impedance module. The frequency selecting module is used for receiving the direct current signal, generating first impedance and determining the oscillation frequency of the loop; the negative resistance differential pair module is used for generating negative resistance; the impedance module is used for generating a second impedance so that after the second impedance is overlapped with the first impedance, the gain of the loop is increased to ensure that the circuit can start vibrating. According to the negative resistance type voltage-controlled oscillating circuit and the voltage-controlled oscillator, the impedance module is additionally arranged to provide the second impedance for the circuit, the second impedance is overlapped with the first impedance provided by the frequency selection module, and then the second impedance is subjected to gain operation with the negative resistance provided by the negative resistance differential pair module, so that the gain of a loop is increased, the circuit is ensured to start vibrating, and the problem that the whole circuit cannot start vibrating and output alternating current with a target oscillating frequency due to the fact that the loop gain cannot reach the starting condition of the circuit in the traditional negative resistance type oscillating circuit is solved.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted touch key and one-key starting device
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle-mounted touch button, which comprises a touch area and a frame area; the touch area comprises a first touch area and a second touch area; the touch layer is a single-layer touch Sensor, and the touch Sensor only comprises two Sensor patterns: a first Sensor pattern of the first touch area and a second Sensor pattern of the second touch area; the first Sensor pattern is a driving electrode, and the second Sensor pattern is a sensing electrode. The invention further provides a one-key starting device comprising the vehicle-mounted touch control key. The design of the touch key adopts a single-layer touch Sensor, only two Sensor patterns are arranged in the touch area and are respectively used as a driving electrode and a sensing electrode, so that single-layer single-point touch is realized. Compared with the double-layer touch Sensor and other multi-point touch single-layer touch Sensor design schemes, the structure and the process are simpler, and the cost is reduced. The method provides a simple design idea and a simple method for the low-cost vehicle-mounted touch key.

title_en: Apparatus and method for sensing distributed load current
abstract_en: An apparatus for sensing a distributed load current provided by a power gating circuit. The apparatus includes a power gating circuit including a set of bulk transistors coupled in series with a set of circuits between a first voltage rail and a second voltage rail. The apparatus includes a current sensor having a first ring oscillator, a first frequency-to-code (FTC) converter, a second ring oscillator, a second FTC converter, and a subtractor. The first ring oscillator includes a first set of one or more inverters configured to receive a first voltage at a node between the power gating circuit and the first circuit, and a second set of one or more inverters configured to receive a second voltage at a second node between the power gating circuit and the second circuit. The first ring oscillator is configured to generate a signal including a frequency related to a voltage drop across the first and second sets of transistors.

title_en: High-frequency broadband amplifier
abstract_en: The invention discloses a broadband amplifier circuit, which comprises an NMOS high gain amplifier with a common source electrode, and an improved active inductance high-frequency broadband load circuit formed by a cascode NMOS transistor, a switch resistor and a capacitor. The broadband amplifier has the characteristics of high gain, large bandwidth, adjustable bandwidth and low noise, and is particularly suitable for an integrated circuit, and the implementation area is small.

title_en: Reflection type sensor
abstract_en: In a reflective sensor that irradiates light from a light emitting element to an object and receives light reflected by the object, it is possible to prevent influence of disturbance light and prevent light from entering the light receiving element other than at the time of detection of the object. A light shielding plate (12) is provided so as to cover the light transmitting portion (11 b) with a gap through which an object passes being left between the light shielding plate and the surface (11 a) of the case main body (11) in which the light transmitting portion (11 b) is formed, the light emitting element and the light receiving element being provided. The rib (12 b) has: the 1 st inclined surface is provided on the surface (12 a) of the light shielding plate (12), and the angle formed by the surface (12 a) is an acute angle when viewed from the length direction. In the light-emitting element, a1 st slope is intersected by a surface passing through the approximate center of the light-emitting element, namely, a surface which is approximately orthogonal to the surface (11 a) and is along the length direction of the rib (12 b).

title_en: Regularization parameter multi-task adaptive filter network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regularization parameter-variable multitask adaptive filter network, which comprises the following steps: the node neighborhood subset selecting module is used for selecting a node neighborhood subset required by updating a parameter vector of each node in the adaptive filter network; the impulse noise interference resisting module based on the maximum skip rule is used for updating the weight vector of the network node of the adaptive filter; and the regularization parameter calculation module is used for accelerating the convergence speed of the multitask adaptive filter network when estimating the unknown parameter vector. The filter network utilizes the regularization parameter item and the maximization lingo line rule to accelerate the convergence speed of the estimation unknown system and improve the anti-pulse interference performance of the network. The filter network disclosed by the invention can be applied to the fields of electronics, communication, control and the like with impulse noise interference.

title_en: Polar code interleaving and bit selection
abstract_en: The present invention provides an apparatus and method for polarization sub-block interleaving and bit selection. In one novel aspect, mid-portion interlacing sub-block interlacing is provided for polar code interlacing. In one embodiment, the middle portions of the polarization codes are interleaved and interleaved polarization codes are generated. In another embodiment, the lower portion and the upper portion are also interleaved through sub-blocks using a mid-portion interleaving method. In another novel aspect, a rate dependent unified bit selection is provided. Bit selection can be divided into three operation categories, repetition, puncturing and shortening. Each class follows a unified bit selection rule, the different classes differing only in access scheme. In one embodiment, a circular buffer is used for bit selection.

title_en: Low-power consumption comparison circuit, successive approximation type analog-digital converter and chip
abstract_en: The application relates to a low-power consumption comparison circuit, a successive approximation type analog-digital converter and a chip. The low-power consumption comparison circuit comprises a logic processing module, a comparison module and a trigger module, wherein the logic processing module acquires a comparison control signal according to a clock frequency signal, a sampling frequency signal and an output signal of the trigger module; the comparison module determines the working mode of the current comparison module according to the comparison control signal, wherein the working mode comprises a comparison mode and a turn-off mode, and when the comparison module is in the comparison mode, the comparison module compares an external first comparison input signal and an external second comparison input signal and outputs a comparison completion signal; the trigger module generates an output signal according to the comparison completion signal, and controls the comparison module to be switched off through the output signal. According to the low-power-consumption comparison circuit, after comparison of the comparison module is completed, the comparison module is reset, and dynamic power consumption in the comparison process is reduced.

title_en: Driving power supply based on GaN technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of semiconductors, in particular to a driving power supply based on GaN technology, which is characterized in that a diffusion region is arranged between two source electrode etching regions and is respectively contacted with the two source electrode etching regions to form an isolation region, and a dopant region is arranged at the periphery of the isolation region, so that the breakdown voltage of a collector electrode and a base electrode can be improved, and the on-resistance of a drain electrode and a source electrode can not be influenced; through the improvement to the GaN transistor structure in the driving power supply, the junction capacitance of the output of the GaN transistor is reduced, and the reduction of the junction capacitance reduces the on-off loss of the driving power supply and the gate capacitance of the GaN transistor, so that the charging time of the capacitor is shortened, and the switching speed of the GaN transistor is improved.

title_en: System on chip
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of communication and discloses a system on a chip. In the present invention, a system on a chip includes: a first clock for generating a stable and non-lost first clock signal; a second clock for generating a second clock signal having a frequency higher than the first clock signal; the detector is respectively connected with the first clock and the second clock and is used for detecting whether a second clock signal of the second clock is lost or not; and the controller is respectively connected with the first clock, the second clock and the detector, and is used for switching the system clock from the second clock to the first clock when the detector detects that the second clock signal generated by the second clock is lost. The system on chip provided by the invention can prevent the deadlock of the system.

title_en: Method and apparatus for encoding and decoding digital image or video stream
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for encoding a digital image or video stream, comprising: -a receiving phase, wherein a portion of the image (f) is received; -a Graphics Weight Prediction (GWP) phase, wherein elements in a weight matrix (W) associated with a graph relating to blocks (predicted blocks) of an image (f) are predicted based on reconstructed, dequantized and inverse transformed pixel values of at least one previously encoded block (predicted block) of the image (f), the weight matrix (W) being a matrix comprising elements (W  i,j  ) -a graphics transformation calculation phase, in which a graphics fourier transformation of a block of the image (f) is performed, obtaining for said block a set of coefficients determined on the basis of the predicted weights; -a coefficient quantization stage, wherein the coefficients are quantized; -an output phase in which a bitstream comprising the transformed and quantized coefficients is transmitted and/or stored.

title_en: Automatic frequency modulation method, device and equipment for electronic cigarette and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electronic cigarettes, and discloses an electronic cigarette automatic frequency modulation method, device, equipment and storage medium. The invention obtains the power value set by the user by receiving the power setting instruction input by the user; determining the current output duty ratio of Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) according to the power value; obtaining the maximum counting value of PWM corresponding to the current output duty ratio; determining the target frequency and the target output duty ratio of PWM according to the current output duty ratio and the maximum counting value; and taking the target frequency and the target output duty ratio as the frequency and the output duty ratio corresponding to the power value, thereby solving the problems of overlarge oil burst sound when a user smokes in low power and the potential safety hazard when the user smokes in high power.

title_en: Interstage gain mismatch correction method of pipeline ADC (analog to digital converter)
abstract_en: An interstage gain mismatch correction method of a pipeline ADC (analog to digital converter) belongs to the technical field of analog integrated circuits. Based on the theoretical basis that the ideal ADC input-output characteristic curve is a linear relation, the invention utilizes the injected correction signals with opposite signs to lead the residual error transfer characteristic curves of the two channels to be inconsistent, thereby completing the gain correction of the nonlinear channel by the linear channel. When the pipeline ADC is a split or time-interleaved pipeline ADC, two channels in the split or time-interleaved pipeline ADC can be respectively used as a reference channel and a correction channel; it is also possible to implement two virtual channels by quantizing the same input signal twice, with one quantized channel as a reference channel and the other quantized channel as a correction channel. The invention solves the problem of gain mismatch in the pipeline ADC; the method for calculating the slope based on at least three points is provided, and compared with the traditional two-point slope method, the accuracy is improved; the invention can work in a digital background and has high real-time performance.

title_en: Methods and systems for reconstructing genomic reference sequences from compressed genomic sequence reads
abstract_en: The methods and apparatus described in this disclosure include representing a reference genome in terms of syntax elements describing differences between the reference genome and genomic sequences previously aligned with the reference genome. Each aligned genomic sequence is described by means of a subset of the syntax elements. Syntax elements describing all genomic sequences are partitioned in blocks according to their statistical properties. Each syntax element block is entropy coded. The entropy encoded blocks are then concatenated to form a compressed bitstream. By virtue of the syntax element representing the difference between the reference genome and the aligned sequence, the syntax element is partitioned in blocks according to its statistical properties, each syntax element block being entropy coded. These entropy encoded syntax elements are embedded in the bitstream of the encoded blocks of syntax elements describing the aligned reads. The disclosed method enables reconstruction of a reference genome for alignment when decoding compressed genomic sequences while preserving different options of random access to compressed data and enabling efficient compression.

title_en: Differential amplifier circuit with variable transconductance
abstract_en: A differential amplifier circuit includes a differential input stage circuit, a load stage circuit coupled to the differential input stage circuit, and an output stage circuit coupled to the load stage circuit. The output stage circuit generates an output signal. The differential input stage circuit comprises a first differential pair (first differential pair) having a first transconductance (first transconductance) and a second differential pair (second differential pair) having a second transconductance (second transconductance). The first differential pair is biased by a first current source and receives a first input signal and an output signal. The second differential pair is biased by a second current source and receives a second input signal and an output signal. At least one of the first transconductance and the second transconductance is adjusted (adjusted) in accordance with the image data.

title_en: Inter-group communication method for ships
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inter-group communication method for ships, which comprises a data sending end and a data receiving end, and the method comprises the following specific steps: firstly, a data sending end and a data receiving end complete handshake; the data sending end automatically detects the communication condition with the data receiving end, and when the data sending end and the data receiving end are in primary communication, the next step is carried out; otherwise, jumping to the step six; when data transmission is carried out for the first time, a data receiving end is informed through a data informing table, and the data sending end is about to send data contents and a data sending sequence; the data receiving end can conveniently establish a form in time, and the data is filled according to the sequence to finish the transmission of a basic data; if not, self-checking whether the data transmitted this time is the same as the data transmitted last time in sequence and format, if so, continuing to transmit, otherwise, reestablishing a data notification table to notify the data receiving end of the specific content of the data transmitted this time.

title_en: Reconfigurable harmonic suppression complex filter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reconfigurable harmonic suppression complex filter which comprises 2N voltage amplifiers and N multiphase complex filters with the same structure, wherein N is a positive integer greater than or equal to 2. The 2N voltage amplifiers are used to realize isolation between adjacent two-stage multi-phase complex filters to prevent the adjacent filters from being mutually loaded, thereby deteriorating the filtering performance of the filters. The N complex filters are used for selecting and filtering the input intermediate frequency signals. The fundamental frequency of one stage of complex filter determines the center frequency of the integral filter, and the rest N-1 stages of complex filters are used for increasing harmonic suppression and in-band flatness performance of the integral filter. The reconfigurable harmonic suppression complex filter of the embodiment is based on the principle of a differential N-channel filter, and has remarkable power consumption and area performance compared with the existing analog baseband filter.

title_en: Multi-sensor state estimation method and device and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of data processing, and provides a multi-sensor state estimation method, a multi-sensor state estimation device and terminal equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: in each cycle, taking out the sensor messages to be arranged into a queue; deleting the system state estimation value of which the time stamp is later than the initial time stamp; taking out the sensor messages in the queue; when the prediction data are taken out, predicting a system state estimation value corresponding to the first time stamp according to a prediction algorithm of Kalman filtering; when the update data is taken out, acquiring a system state estimation value corresponding to the first timestamp and updating according to an update algorithm of Kalman filtering; when all the sensor messages in the queue are used, performing next circulation; and detecting and outputting the system state estimation value with the latest timestamp in the state estimation queue. The method and the device can solve the problems that when the multi-sensor fusion is carried out by using Kalman filtering, time synchronization is required, part of measured data can be lost, the time synchronization difficulty is high, and the output frequency of the Kalman filter is low.

title_en: Temperature compensation circuit based on radio frequency power amplifier
abstract_en: The application discloses a temperature compensation circuit based on a radio frequency power amplifier, which comprises a first temperature compensation unit and a second temperature compensation unit, wherein the first temperature compensation unit comprises an operational amplifier and a fourth resistor T1 with a positive temperature coefficient, the fourth resistor T1 is connected with the output end of the operational amplifier in parallel, the second temperature compensation unit comprises a voltage dividing resistor and a diode which are connected with the output end of the operational amplifier in series, and the radio frequency power amplifier is connected with the diode, and the voltage drop Vd of the diode has a negative temperature coefficient. According to the application, the second temperature compensation unit performs linear temperature compensation on the radio frequency power amplifier, the first temperature compensation unit performs nonlinear temperature compensation through a resistor building circuit with a positive temperature coefficient, and the bias voltage of the radio frequency power amplifier is subjected to temperature compensation in a mode of combining two kinds of temperature compensation, so that the linearity of the gain of the radio frequency power amplifier at different temperatures is improved.

title_en: Multi-source noise suppression circuit for natural gas leakage laser detection system
abstract_en: A multi-source noise suppression circuit for a natural gas leakage laser detection system relates to the technical field of detection equipment and comprises a power supply circuit, a bias circuit, an operational amplifier circuit and a filter circuit, wherein the power supply circuit and the bias circuit are respectively connected with the operational amplifier circuit, and the operational amplifier circuit is connected with the filter circuit. The power supply circuit adopted by the multi-source noise suppression circuit for the natural gas leakage laser detection system adopts an RC active filtering mode, so that clutters in a direct current power supply can be directly filtered, and stable output voltage is provided for an operational amplifier in the circuit; the operational amplifier single circuit adopts a construction scheme of parallel capacitors of operational amplifier feedback resistors, so that I/V conversion is realized and conversion loss can be reduced; the filtering circuit adopts a narrow-band filtering method, so that the overall signal-to-noise ratio of the circuit is improved, and the accuracy of subsequent data is guaranteed.

title_en: Broadband injection locking frequency multiplier
abstract_en: The invention discloses a broadband injection locking frequency multiplier which adopts a double injection type structure and comprises two harmonic generators and an injection locking oscillator. The two harmonic generators are coupled with the injection locking oscillator through transformers composed of inductors in the harmonic generators; the two harmonic generators convert the input fundamental wave signals into two paths of harmonic signals, and then the two paths of harmonic signals are respectively coupled to the injection locking oscillator through a transformer to realize frequency multiplication. Compared with the traditional structure, the broadband injection locking frequency multiplier has a wider locking range when the input power is smaller, and has the advantages of ultra-wide bandwidth, low input sensitivity, low power consumption, high integration and the like.

title_en: Driving device for power semiconductor device
abstract_en: A driving apparatus for a power semiconductor device, comprising: the power amplifying circuit is used for outputting a driving signal subjected to power amplification to the power semiconductor device so as to control the running state of the power semiconductor device; the short circuit detection circuit is used for detecting the short circuit state of the power amplification circuit and generating a corresponding short circuit state signal according to the short circuit state; the control circuit is used for generating a corresponding control signal according to the short-circuit state signal and the received driving signal; wherein when the short-circuit state signal is a signal representing that the power amplifying circuit is short-circuited, the control circuit is configured to control the power amplifying circuit to change the level of the signal output by itself to zero. The device can rapidly and accurately identify whether the power amplification circuit is short-circuited, and can perform corresponding protection action under the condition that the power amplification circuit is short-circuited.

title_en: Device for automatically adjusting LD current turn-off delay of projector and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for automatically adjusting the LD current turn-off delay of a projector, which comprises the projector, a projection screen, a brightness test module and a controller, wherein the controller is connected with the brightness test module and is communicated with the brightness test module through a communication protocol; the projector outputs a black field signal and projects the black field signal to a projection screen, the brightness test module measures the screen brightness and transmits brightness data to the controller, and the controller outputs LD current turn-off delay data to the projector after calculation. According to the device for automatically adjusting the LD current waveform of the projector, after a corresponding software method is added, the problem that the LD current waveform of a part of projectors and the reset pulse of a part of DMDs cannot be completely matched in batch production of the projectors can be effectively solved.

title_en: Differential signal to single-ended signal circuit, phase-locked loop and SERDES circuit
abstract_en: The application relates to a differential signal-to-single-ended signal circuit, a phase-locked loop and a SERDES circuit, when the voltage of a first differential signal is larger than that of a second differential signal and is larger than the threshold voltage of a differential signal input circuit, namely when the logic of the differential signal is 1, a first switch tube is in a cut-off state, and a half circuit on the same side of a corresponding current mirror circuit and a first differential signal input end will not have current flowing. Under the clamping action of the input power supply voltage, the current flowing through the half circuit on the same side of the second differential signal input end in the current mirror circuit is larger than the current corresponding to the second differential signal input end in the differential signal input circuit, and finally the voltage output to the external circuit is pulled up. Through the circuit, the function of converting the differential signal into the single-ended signal can be realized, and the lower static power consumption can be ensured under the stable logic state of the input differential signal.

title_en: Linear power amplifier driving method with variable power supply voltage
abstract_en: A power supply voltage variable linear power amplifier driving method belongs to the technical field of power amplifier driving control. The invention aims at the problem that the operation reliability of a power device is influenced because huge loss is still generated in the power device due to high voltage drop when the power device of the conventional linear power amplifier is in no load or light load. The method comprises the steps of collecting a current signal of an output end of a linear power amplifier, a load working condition demand signal and a power supply voltage signal of a power supply, and calculating by adopting a control unit to obtain a current instruction signal of an input end of the linear power amplifier; simultaneously obtaining positive and negative power supply PWM command signals of the variable power supply voltage unit; and the variable power supply voltage unit is used for converting a power supply according to the positive and negative power supply PWM command signal to obtain a current expected power supply voltage signal, and the current expected power supply voltage signal is used as an actual power supply signal of the linear power amplifier to enable the actual power supply signal to be adjusted along with the load working condition requirement. The invention enables the change of the bus voltage to be dynamically adjusted along with the actual requirement of the linear power amplifier.

title_en: Data rate self-adaptive digital shaping filtering system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data rate self-adaptive digital forming filtering system and a method, wherein the method comprises the following steps: (1) Carrying out data rate identification according to an input associated clock; (2) Performing phase integration on input baseband data to obtain a timing error; (3) Judging the polarity of the timing error according to the data polarity; (4) Performing loop filtering on the timing error after the polarity correction; (5) Generating a local clock synchronized with the input baseband data; (6) According to the synchronous clock, dynamically generating a forming coefficient required by the current baseband data symbol; (7) Storing the input baseband data in the process of processing to prevent data loss; (8) And reading out data in the memory, and performing shaping filtering by adopting the dynamically generated shaping coefficient.

title_en: CMOS ring oscillator with adjustable pulse width frequency
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of clock oscillators, and particularly discloses a CMOS ring oscillator with adjustable pulse width frequency, which comprises an inverted output type Schmitt trigger and an output stage circuit connected with the inverted output type Schmitt trigger. The invention has simple structure and easy realization, adopts the N-type MOS tube as the delay capacitor, and has smaller area and higher integration level. The frequency and pulse width can be adjusted by adjusting the delay generated by the resistor and the capacitor, the adjustable range is wide, the flexibility of circuit design is improved, and the circuit has strong practicability.

title_en: Thin film bulk acoustic resonator and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a film bulk acoustic resonator and a manufacturing method thereof. The manufacturing method comprises the following steps: fabricating a lower electrode on a first surface of the SOI substrate; forming a piezoelectric layer on a first surface of the SOI substrate and a lower electrode; forming a top electrode on the piezoelectric layer; an air cavity is formed on a second surface of the SOI substrate, the second surface and the first surface being disposed opposite each other. The manufacturing method provided by the invention simplifies the preparation process of the FBAR, and the AlN thin film grown by the method has high quality, thereby being beneficial to improving the performance of devices, and simultaneously, the frequency of the resonator is adjusted by controlling the thickness of top silicon at the position of silicon oxygen injection isolation; and the SOI material has the characteristics of low power consumption, high integration density, radiation resistance and the like, reduces the complexity of the device preparation process, and is suitable for the radio frequency front end of a 5G communication system in the future.

title_en: Digital initialization circuit
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital initialization circuit, which comprises a first register; the counting unit is provided with a current storage value and is used for receiving a clock signal, adding one to the current storage value of the counting unit to obtain a result value when the clock signal passes by one period, and updating the current storage value by utilizing the result value; a comparing unit for comparing the current stored value of the counting unit with a predetermined value; when the comparing unit determines that the current stored value of the counting unit is equal to the preset value, the counting unit clears the current stored value to count again, and meanwhile the first register starts to output an initialization signal until the first register stops outputting the initialization signal when the comparing unit determines that the current stored value of the counting unit is equal to the preset value again. The digital initialization circuit provided by the invention can control the initialization time and has higher anti-interference performance.

title_en: Radio frequency signal processing circuit and radio frequency front end unit
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses radio frequency signal processing circuit and radio frequency front end unit, radio frequency signal processing circuit includes: the radio frequency power amplifier comprises a voltage conversion circuit, a switching circuit and a radio frequency power amplification circuit; the voltage conversion circuit is used for converting the voltage of an input enable signal into a first positive voltage or a first negative voltage; the switch circuit is controlled to be conducted according to the first positive voltage, or the switch circuit is controlled to be not conducted according to the first negative voltage; wherein the first positive voltage and the first negative voltage are in opposite phase; the switch circuit is used for controlling the radio frequency power amplifying circuit not to be in a working state when the switch circuit is conducted, and controlling the radio frequency power amplifying circuit to be in the working state when the switch circuit is not conducted; the radio frequency power amplifying circuit is used for amplifying the radio frequency signal input to the radio frequency power amplifying circuit and then outputting the amplified radio frequency signal.

title_en: Bulk acoustic wave resonator, bulk acoustic wave resonator group, filter, and electronic device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bulk acoustic wave resonator, comprising: a substrate; an acoustic mirror; the bottom electrode is connected with the bottom electrode pin; the top electrode is connected with the top electrode pin; a piezoelectric layer disposed between the bottom electrode and the top electrode, wherein: overlapping regions of the top electrode, the piezoelectric layer, the bottom electrode, and the acoustic mirror in the thickness direction of the resonator constitute an effective region of the resonator; and a plurality of acoustic holes periodically arranged around the effective area, wherein the acoustic holes at least partially enter the piezoelectric layer from the upper surface of the piezoelectric layer. The invention also discloses a bulk acoustic wave resonator group, a filter with the resonator or the resonator group and electronic equipment with the filter or the resonator group.

title_en: Charge sharing resistant D latch for use in medium and low frequency circuitry
abstract_en: A charge sharing resistant D latch applied to a medium and low frequency circuit system belongs to the field of radiation hardening in the reliability of an integrated circuit. The problems of high hardware overhead, large device area, high power consumption and long transmission time of the traditional anti-charge sharing D latch are solved. According to the invention, the gate of the transistor TP1, the gate of the transistor TN3 and the node S5 are connected, the gate of the transistor TP2, the gate of the transistor TN4 and the node S6 are connected, the gate of the transistor TP9, the gate of the transistor TN9 and the node S1 are connected, and the gate of the transistor TP10 and the gate of the transistor TN10 and the node S2 are connected, so that the area can be minimized by adopting a connection mode nearby to reduce the area of a layout; meanwhile, the connection mode can also improve the anti-overturning capacity of the nodes S3, S4, S7 and S8. The invention is mainly applied to medium and low frequency circuit systems.

title_en: Multi-spectrum closed-loop locking method and system for CPT magnetometer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-spectrum closed-loop locking method and a multi-spectrum closed-loop locking system for a CPT magnetometer. The invention can obtain effective CPT transmission signals when the laser direction of the CPT magnetometer and the direction of the magnetic field to be measured are in any relative included angle, thereby avoiding the influence of the directional characteristic of the CPT effect on signal measurement. Compared with the CPT magnetometer tracked by a single transmission peak, the method can obtain larger error signal amplitude, thereby improving the sensitivity of magnetic field measurement and having extremely high engineering application value.

title_en: Analog-to-digital converter self-test using time base and current source
abstract_en: The constant current source, the stable time base, and the capacitor are used to self-test the operation of an analog-to-digital converter (ADC) by charging the capacitor for a predetermined amount of time to produce a voltage thereon. This voltage will be proportional to the amount of time the capacitor is charged. Only the amount of time that the capacitor is charged needs to be changed to verify multiple points on the transfer function of the analog-to-digital converter during the self-test. The relative accuracy between the test points can be readily obtained. Absolute accuracy can be obtained by using the exact clock reference of the time base, known current sources and capacitance values.

title_en: Lossless image compression method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for lossless compression of images, which belong to the technical field of image processing and comprise the following steps: acquiring an original image; calculating the residual error of the original image by adopting an arithmetic coding method, counting the occurrence frequency of each symbol in the residual error, and storing the number into an array counts [ ]; according to the array counts [ ], a Huffman tree is circularly established, and each leaf node of the Huffman tree is coded by using a length limiting method to obtain a Huffman coding table; and compressing the residual error of the original image by utilizing a Huffman coding table to obtain coded data for decoding processing. The invention provides a lossless compression method combining arithmetic coding and a general text compression method, which has the decoding speed of the general text method while ensuring the compression ratio.

title_en: Switching element control circuit and power module
abstract_en: The switching element control circuit 100 of the present invention includes: a third electrode voltage control unit 10 for controlling the third electrode voltage; a first electrode current detection unit 20 for detecting a first electrode current flowing through the switching element 200; a memory unit 30 for storing information of an initial threshold voltage and an initial first electrode current, and drain electrode characteristics of the threshold voltage; and a threshold voltage calculation unit 40 configured to: the threshold voltage at the time of operation of the switching element 200 is calculated by including the first electrode current, the initial threshold voltage, and information of the initial first electrode current, and information on the first electrode current characteristic of the threshold voltage, wherein the third electrode voltage control unit controls the third electrode voltage based on the threshold voltage at the time of operation calculated by the threshold voltage calculation unit 40. According to the switching element control circuit 100 of the present invention, even when the threshold voltage at the time of operation fluctuates from the initial threshold voltage, the switching loss can be reduced.

title_en: Code modulation method, system, medium and electronic device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a code modulation method, a system, a medium and electronic equipment, wherein the method can sort code word bits based on the weight of the code word bits in the code words, then determine the sub-channel capacity corresponding to the code words according to the code rate of the current code words, select the corresponding interleaving pattern to carry out row-column interleaving on the sorted code words, and write the code word bits with higher weight into the row or column corresponding to the sub-channel with better weight, so that the code word bits interleaved by an interleaver form a specific sorting mode, and the sorting mode can map the code word bits with higher weight in the code words to the sub-channel with better weight during modulation processing, thereby realizing global optimum.

title_en: Method for simulating Boom Box encoder by using music player
abstract_en: The Boom Box system is used in a seismic recording team to synchronize and control explosive operations, and a typical system contains at least two Boom boxes, one configured as an encoder and the other configured as a decoder. For many years, encoders have been used to detect decoders without the encoder and without the decoder being able to be serviced. The maintenance price of the delivery is high and the period is long, and the production is influenced. To solve this technical problem, a scheme of emulating a Boom Box encoder using a music player is proposed. The music player is connected with the decoder, and the detection of the decoder can be completed by playing the pre-recorded and edited encoder ignition instruction waveform file consistent with the decoder queue number and the starting code.

title_en: Voltage-variable SiC MOSFET active driving circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a voltage-variable SiC MOSFET active driving circuit, which comprises: the driving circuit, the voltage sampling circuit, the pulse generating circuit and the source voltage circuit; the voltage sampling circuit is used for collecting voltage signals at two ends of a grid source electrode in the switching process of the SiC MOSFET and transmitting the voltage signals to the pulse generating circuit; the pulse generating circuit is used for generating a pulse signal according to the received voltage signal and transmitting the pulse signal to the source voltage circuit; and the source voltage circuit is used for outputting a driving voltage control signal to the SiC MOSFET according to the pulse signal. The advantages are that: the invention can inhibit the current change rate in the switching process of the SiCMOS MOSFET by changing the drive voltage of the SiC MOSFET and inhibit the phenomena of current, voltage overshoot and oscillation in the switching process of the device under the condition of sacrificing small switching loss.

title_en: Decoding soft decision delay reduction method for original bit error rate perception
abstract_en: The invention discloses a decoding soft decision delay reduction method for original bit error rate perception. In order to ensure the reliability of data storage, the LDPC adopts a soft decision decoding algorithm based on log-likelihood ratio information and has stronger decoding and error correcting capabilities. However, in the decoding decision process, the bit information is frequently decided, causing a high decision delay. The method firstly obtains the change information of the original bit error rate according to the current LDPC decoding result. And then, according to the change information of the bit error rate, in the next decoding judgment process, directly updating the log-likelihood ratio information of the bit to a target value in an iterative manner and then executing judgment operation so as to reduce the redundant judgment times and further reduce the soft-decision decoding judgment delay.

title_en: High-power AC/DC integrated electronic load system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-power alternating current-direct current integrated electronic load system and a control method thereof, wherein the high-power alternating current-direct current integrated electronic load system comprises a plurality of PWM (pulse width modulation) control bridges, a subtraction module, a modulation wave control module, a triangular carrier wave generation module and a comparison module, wherein each PWM control bridge is mutually independent, the subtraction module is electrically connected with the modulation wave control module, the triangular carrier wave generation module and the modulation wave control module are electrically connected with the comparison module, and phase shift PWM waveforms are generated by utilizing a waveform generation mode in a PWM control technology and a waveform iteration structure in a multiplexing superposition technology, so that high equivalent switching frequency is obtained on the premise of not improving a single group of switching frequency and keeping a main circuit topological structure, and the harmonic content in the output waveforms of the system is reduced. The electronic load realized by the power field effect transistor is well prevented from generating self-oscillation when the load characteristic requirement is changeable and the power is larger, the operation is not facilitated, and the problems of large power current ripple, serious heating of the power transistor and the like are solved.

title_en: Nuclear magnetic resonance data acquisition method and system based on multiple ADC
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nuclear magnetic resonance data acquisition method and system based on multiple ADC, comprising the following steps: the digital receiver receives the nuclear magnetic resonance free induction attenuation signal s, the digital receiver divides the received nuclear magnetic resonance free induction attenuation signal s into m sub-signals, amplifies the m sub-signals according to different receiving gains to obtain amplified multipath sub-signals, the digital receiver carries out analog-to-digital conversion on the amplified multipath sub-signals by utilizing an analog-to-digital converter, the obtained multipath digital signals are sent to a sampling computer, the sampling computer averagely divides each path of digital signals in the multipath digital signals into n sections of sub-digital signals, so as to obtain a matrix D, sequentially obtains data which has the largest value in all columns of the matrix D and does not overflow, divides the data by the corresponding amplification factors of all columns, and all the data form a data set. Compared with the prior art, the method not only improves the signal-to-noise ratio, but also improves the dynamic range of nuclear magnetic resonance signal acquisition.

title_en: Optical switch and method for reducing crosstalk
abstract_en: An optical switch having a plurality of actuators, the optical switch comprising a controller configured to control the operation of a plurality of channels, wherein each channel has at least one electrical driver and at least one actuator, by crossing periods of one or more drivers having a voltage switched output with periods of no voltage switched output while the output voltage is switched from one level to another. Alternatively, an optical switch having a plurality of actuators includes a controller configured to control operation of a plurality of channels, wherein each channel has at least one electrical driver and at least one actuator, by switching the output voltage of at least one driver of a first channel from one level to another level while at least one other driver of at least one other channel is in a relatively high impedance mode.

title_en: Structure and method for improving inhibition degree or isolation degree of electronic device in high-frequency band
abstract_en: The invention provides a packaging carrier plate for a filter, which comprises a plurality of conductive layers, a dielectric layer arranged between the conductive layers and a winding inductor, wherein one end of the winding inductor is suitable for being electrically connected with a corresponding filter, the other end of the winding inductor is electrically connected with a bottom conductive layer in the plurality of conductive layers, the packaging carrier plate is provided with a through hole in a closed area or a semi-closed area defined by the winding inductor, a conductor column is arranged in the through hole, one end of the conductor column is electrically connected with the bottom conductive layer, and the conductor column is spaced from the winding inductor to form a capacitor. The invention also relates to a method for improving the suppression degree of a multiplexer in a high frequency band, the multiplexer comprises a plurality of filters arranged on a packaging carrier plate, the filters are provided with parallel branches, parallel resonators and grounding inductors are connected in series on the parallel branches, and the method comprises the step of connecting a capacitor in parallel with the grounding inductor of at least one filter.

title_en: Fine digital predistortion optimal linearization method of nonlinear power amplifier
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fine digital predistortion optimal linearization method of a nonlinear power amplifier. By microscopic analysis of the useful output signal and nonlinear distortion of the power amplifier, a practical analytical expression method of the interrelation among the useful output signal of the power amplifier, the nonlinear distortion output by the power amplifier and the parameters of the power amplifier is established; the method comprises the steps of providing a mapping construction method of all possible output frequency spectrums of a predistortion-power amplifier complex (DPD-PA complex) in theory; a solution of the fine digital predistortion optimal linearization method is provided under the condition of conforming to the constraint condition. Compared with the digital predistortion scheme provided by the existing macroscopic integral analysis method, the digital predistortion linearization performance of the multi-carrier system is verified to have the optimal theoretical upper limit through analytical calculation or numerical calculation. At the same time, this optimal linearization theoretical upper limit is achieved in embodiments of the method.

title_en: Mixing matrix generation method of modulating broadband converter based on step-type random sequence
abstract_en: The invention provides a mixing matrix generation method of a modulation broadband converter based on a ladder-type random sequence. The method comprises the steps of 1, determining the range length d which can be selected by the non-0 position of the sequence which can be generated by each channel for a modulation broadband converter system with the channel number of M and the mixing sequence length of M, 2, distributing the range, generating a random sequence of +/-1 in the corresponding range, and 3, setting other elements of the sequence to be 0. The method shortens the length of the mixing sequence, and has better denoising effect for the situation that a reconstruction support set preset by an SOMP algorithm possibly appearing in a dynamic spectrum is larger than an actual support set. In the method, only a small segment of elements of the mixing sequence of each channel are random sequences, and the values of the rest elements are 0. The method is suitable for the design and application field of the modulation broadband converter.

title_en: Sensitive preamplifier of input leakage current compensation type electric charge
abstract_en: The invention relates to an input end leakage current compensation type charge sensitive preamplifier, which belongs to the technical field of nuclear electronics and solves the problem of influence of circuit bias current; the circuit comprises a charge sensitive loop circuit and a compensation bleeder circuit; the charge sensitive loop circuit is connected with the detector and is used for integrating and accumulating the charge quantity of the detection current of the detector, converting the charge quantity into a voltage signal in direct proportion to the charge quantity and outputting the voltage signal to the post-stage circuit; the compensation bleeder circuit is connected between the output end and the input end of the charge sensitive loop circuit; monitoring the output voltage value of the charge sensitive loop circuit, when the voltage value exceeds the linear amplification area, releasing the accumulated charge amount, reducing the output voltage value, and returning the output voltage value to the linear amplification area; and providing a compensation current to compensate the leakage current of the input end of the charge sensitive loop circuit. The invention makes the charge sensitive preamplifier work in the linear amplification area; and the leakage current at the input end is compensated, so that the effect of improving the energy resolution is achieved.

title_en: Jitter insertion system for waveform generation
abstract_en: A test and measurement instrument for generating an analog waveform includes an interpolator configured to receive a digital signal and output interpolated samples of the digital signal at a sampling rate, a filter modulation controller configured to output first filter coefficients at a first time and second filter coefficients at a second time, a convolver configured to generate a convolved signal by convolving the interpolated samples of the digital signal and the first filter coefficients and convolving the interpolated samples of the digital signal and the second filter coefficients, and a digital-to-analog converter configured to convert the convolved signal to an analog signal based on a fixed constant clock signal.

title_en: Power amplifying circuit
abstract_en: The invention provides a power amplification circuit capable of suppressing variation of a reference potential of a substrate. The power amplification circuit (10) is provided with a substrate (301) and a semiconductor chip (201) provided on the substrate, and the semiconductor chip is provided with: a power amplification unit (211) that amplifies the RF signal; a ground terminal (231 a) connected to the ground of the power amplification unit (211); and a circuit element (411) one end of which is electrically connected to the ground terminal without going through the outside of the semiconductor chip. The substrate has: and a circuit element (412) having one end electrically connected to the output of the power amplification unit and the other end electrically connected to the other end of the circuit element (411). The circuit element (411) and the circuit element (412) constitute a harmonic termination circuit (410) that reflects a harmonic component (RF 3) of an RF signal (RF 2) that is an amplified signal from the power amplification unit, toward the power amplification unit.

title_en: Building construction remote monitoring system based on thing networking
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building construction remote monitoring system based on the Internet of things, which comprises a signal sampling module and a comparison detection module, the signal sampling module samples the output signal of the signal acquisition equipment in the building construction remote monitoring system by using a signal sampler J1 with the model number of DAM-3056AH, in order to further ensure the accuracy of the signal peak value, one path of the comparison detection module uses a diode D4 to detect the potential difference before and after the frequency modulation circuit, feeds an abnormal signal back to the output end of the operational amplifier AR4, and directly adjusts the peak value of the output signal, and the other path uses a diode D5 to detect the potential difference between the output signal of the rectification circuit and the reference rated signal, the signal is normal, at the moment, the diode D5 is not conducted, the operational amplifier AR5 amplifies the output signal of the operational amplifier AR4, a signal transmitter E1 sends a signal to a building construction remote monitoring system terminal, and the building construction remote monitoring system terminal timely analyzes and responds to.

title_en: Bulk acoustic wave resonator, method of manufacturing the same, filter, and electronic apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a bulk acoustic wave resonator and a method for manufacturing the same, the resonator comprising: a substrate; an acoustic mirror; a bottom electrode; a top electrode; and a piezoelectric layer disposed between the bottom electrode and the top electrode, wherein: the bottom electrode is provided with a first bottom electrode and a second bottom electrode which are connected with each other in the thickness direction of the resonator, the first bottom electrode is attached to the piezoelectric layer, and the second bottom electrode is positioned between the first bottom electrode and the substrate in the thickness direction; and the piezoelectric layer is a planar structure. The invention also relates to a filter with the resonator and an electronic device with the filter or the resonator.

title_en: Gesture control for wall-mounted devices
abstract_en: A method for controlling operation of a power switch includes obtaining, by one or more processors of the power switch, data indicative of one or more contactless gestures. The method includes determining, by the one or more processors, a control action based at least in part on the data indicative of the one or more contactless gestures. The method includes implementing, by the one or more processors, the control actions.

title_en: Signal receiver circuit, semiconductor device and semiconductor system including the same
abstract_en: A signal receiver circuit, a semiconductor device and a semiconductor system including the same are provided. The signal receiver circuit includes a first amplifying circuit and an offset compensating circuit. The first amplifying circuit generates a first amplified signal and a second amplified signal by amplifying an input signal and a reference voltage. The offset compensation circuit adjusts the voltage level of the first amplified signal and the voltage level of the second amplified signal based on the DC level of the input signal and the voltage level of the reference voltage.

title_en: Construction method of low-rank cyclic matrix and associated multi-element LDPC code
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of wireless communication technology and image processing, and discloses a construction method of a low-rank cyclic matrix and a related multi-element LDPC code thereof, wherein the search space of the cyclic matrix is reduced by utilizing isomorphic theory; and searching by using a rank calculation algorithm to obtain cyclic matrixes with different ranks. The application obtains the low-rank cyclic matrix which is easy to realize by hardware, and provides a construction method of the low-rank cyclic matrix. A non-zero field element assignment method is adopted, and a multi-element LDPC code construction method under different orders is provided. Compared with binary LDPC codes constructed based on PEG algorithm, the constructed multi-element LDPC codes have the error code rate of 10 under the BPSK modulation mode  ‑5  A coding gain of 0.9dB in the vicinity; when combined with higher order modulation, there is a greater performance improvement. In the additive white gaussian noise channel, the constructed multi-element LDPC code has good iterative decoding performance, and the performance curves under the iteration of 5 times and 50 times almost overlap.

title_en: High-linearity low-voltage input buffer circuit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high linearity low voltage input buffer circuit, comprising: NMOS transistor M  N1  、M  N3  And M  N2  、M  N6  A main buffer respectively forming positive and negative input ends; PMOS transistor M  P1  、M  P3  And M  P2  、M  P4  Respectively forming auxiliary buffers; NMOS transistor M  N3  、M  N4  And M  N5  、M  N6  Respectively form a replica current amplifier and a replica capacitor C  c  The invention adopts the auxiliary buffer to simulate the load effect of the main buffer to generate the copy current of the load current, then the copy current is mirrored to the load transistor of the main buffer through the current amplifier, and the load capacitor is charged and discharged through the load transistor, thereby keeping the current of the input transistor constant and eliminating the nonlinearity caused by the load current.

title_en: Manchester code decoding method based on FPGA and IEC60044-8 standard
abstract_en: The invention provides a Manchester code decoding method based on FPGA and IEC60044-8 standards, which comprises the following steps of S1, filtering Manchester code signals; step S2, generating a receiving clock and detecting a level signal in a Manchester code, wherein the frequency of the receiving clock is 2 times of the frequency of the encoding clock; step S3, aligning the falling edge of the receiving clock with the level falling edge of the Manchester code; s4, detecting a frame header by adopting a receiving clock; and S5, generating a decoding clock with the same frequency as the encoding clock, and decoding in S6, wherein the decoding clock is adopted to sample the Manchester code detected by the receiving clock, so as to obtain the bit information of the Manchester code. The invention well solves the problems of too high clock requirement and complex decoding logic of Manchester code decoding in the prior art.

title_en: P-channel MOS tube driving circuit capable of self-adapting to input voltage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a P-channel MOS tube driving circuit capable of self-adapting to input voltage, which comprises a first MOS tube, a triode, a first resistor, a diode, a first constant current switch module, a second constant current switch module and a trigger source, wherein the grid electrode of the first MOS tube is respectively connected with the emitter electrode of the triode and the first constant current switch module, the drain electrode of the first MOS tube is connected with a circuit output end, the source electrode of the first MOS tube is respectively connected with the input end of the circuit and the collector electrode of the triode, the diode is arranged between the emitter electrode and the base electrode of the triode, the base electrode of the triode is respectively connected with the cathode electrode of the diode and the second constant current switch module, one end of the first resistor is connected with the input end of the circuit, the other end of the first resistor is connected with the base electrode of the triode, and the first constant current switch module and the second constant current switch module are both connected with the trigger source. The invention can adapt to different input voltages, and widens the range of the input voltages.

title_en: Embedded high-power microwave functional module
abstract_en: The invention discloses an embedded high-power microwave functional module which comprises an output matching circuit, an input matching circuit, a functional circuit interface, a microwave interface, a test interface, a direct current power supply interface, a mechanical installation interface, a heat sink, a microwave power tube, a locating pin, a liquid cooling input port and a liquid cooling output port. The microwave power tube, the matching and functional circuit and the bottom heat sink are independent from the power amplifier and are provided with interfaces for supporting conduction heat dissipation and liquid cooling heat dissipation. The plug-and-play high-power component is an independent and replaceable high-power component with complete functions of temperature compensation, temperature compensation protection, time sequence control and the like and a flexible heat dissipation mode, can be conveniently produced and debugged while maintaining good high-power performance, and can be replaced in time in an external use environment.

title_en: Analog-digital conversion device and capacitance adjusting method thereof
abstract_en: An analog-to-digital conversion device and a capacitance adjusting method thereof are provided, which comprises a comparator, at least one digital-to-analog converter and a reference buffer. The comparator is used for comparing the first input signal with the second input signal and outputting a comparison signal. The at least one digital-to-analog converter comprises at least one capacitor. The reference buffer is used for providing a reference signal, and the at least one digital-to-analog converter receives the reference signal so as to cause the voltage of the reference signal to shake to generate a shake signal. The capacitance of the at least one capacitor of the at least one digital-to-analog converter is adjusted according to the dithering signal.

title_en: Positive and negative pressure self-adaptive sampling circuit
abstract_en: The invention provides a positive and negative pressure self-adaptive sampling circuit, which comprises: the power supply voltage detection circuit is characterized by comprising a power supply voltage detection circuit, a power supply voltage detection circuit and a power supply voltage detection circuit, wherein the first end of the power supply voltage detection circuit is electrically connected with the positive electrode end of a power supply, the second end of the power supply voltage detection circuit is electrically connected with the negative electrode end of the power supply, and the power supply voltage detection circuit comprises a positive low voltage-to-high voltage power transfer circuit; and the sampling switch control circuit comprises a positive low-voltage-to-negative high-voltage level transfer circuit, a positive low-voltage-to-positive high-voltage level transfer circuit and a controlled selection circuit. The invention can automatically operate, automatically detect the power supply state of the high-voltage power supply, intelligently switch the positive low-voltage to negative high-voltage level transfer circuit and the positive low-voltage to positive high-voltage level transfer circuit in the sampling switch control circuit, and automatically adapt to different analog voltage input ranges according to the power supply voltage.

title_en: Ring oscillator physical unclonable function circuit based on printing electronic technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ring oscillator physical unclonable function circuit based on a printing electronic technology, which is characterized by comprising a PET (polyethylene terephthalate) substrate, two groups of conductive dot units, a first ring oscillator circuit, a second ring oscillator circuit, an input selector and a first logic control unit, wherein the two groups of conductive dot units are printed on the PET substrate by adopting nano copper particles and are arranged in a dot matrix manner, and the output ends of counters in the first ring oscillator circuit and the second ring oscillator circuit are respectively connected with the input end of the first logic control unit. The invention utilizes the uncertain output of the electric conduction of the printed electronic lattice to select the inverter connected with the circuit for the ring oscillator, the randomness of the whole PUF circuit comprises the difference of the electric conduction randomness of the printed electronic lattice and the time delay of the inverter, and compared with the traditional RO PUF, the safety and the robustness of the circuit are improved.

title_en: Bulk Acoustic Wave Resonator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bulk acoustic wave resonator. The bulk acoustic wave resonator comprises a substrate, and a reflecting structure, a bottom electrode, a piezoelectric layer and a top electrode which are sequentially arranged on the substrate, wherein the bulk acoustic wave resonator comprises a resonance area, the resonance area comprises an edge area, at least one cavity is arranged in the edge area, and the top and/or the bottom of each cavity is positioned in the piezoelectric layer. The invention can avoid parasitic mode formed by lateral wave during resonance, and reduce energy leakage of lateral wave.

title_en: Millivolt power harvesting FET controller
abstract_en: The application provides a millivolt power collection FET controller. In the described example of a circuit and method for controlling a transistor (230) having first (250), second (240) and third (245) terminals, a voltage level at the first terminal (250) partially controls a current flowing from the second terminal (240) to the third terminal (245). The controller (260) receives voltages present across the second (240) and third (245) terminals of the transistor (230) and uses the voltages to power components of the controller (260). The controller (260) provides a voltage to the first terminal (250) of the transistor (230). The controller (260) adjusts the voltage across the second (240) and third (245) terminals of the transistor (230) by adjusting the voltage provided to the first terminal (250).

title_en: Method for deciding when to end bit flipping algorithm during hard decision soft decoding
abstract_en: A method of determining when to end a bit flipping algorithm during hard decision soft decoding performed by a low density parity check decoder is disclosed. The method comprises the following steps: selecting a specific number of iterations as a first threshold; when the first threshold is reached, determining a highest variable node codeword for each iteration performed so far to generate a plurality of highest variable node codewords; comparing the highest variable node codeword with a second threshold, the second threshold being the maximum error of the highest variable node for the current iteration divided by 2; and ending the bit flipping algorithm when the value of the highest variable node codeword is less than or equal to the second threshold. The present invention saves power consumption for bit flipping by performing only a specific number of iterations on the algorithm. By using the column weight as a performance parameter, the correct point in time to terminate the bit flipping can be quickly known, and other decoding algorithms can be selected after the current bit flipping algorithm is terminated.

title_en: Photoelectric high-power microwave amplification method based on wide-bandgap semiconductor device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photoelectric high-power microwave amplification method based on a wide-bandgap semiconductor device, and aims to solve the problems of low output power and low amplification efficiency of the conventional amplification circuit. The technical scheme is that a B type push-pull amplifying circuit based on a wide band gap semiconductor device is constructed by two power supplies, two pulse forming devices, two wide band gap semiconductor devices, two current limiting resistors, a load resistor and a grounding terminal; the two laser pulses and the voltage generated by the two direct current power supplies simultaneously act on 2 wide band gap semiconductor devices in the amplifying circuit; the 2 wide band gap semiconductor devices are excited by photoelectric signals to work as light-operated variable resistors, and the on-resistance of the wide band gap semiconductor devices is linearly changed along with the light intensity of the high-energy pulse cluster laser, so that the output current and the light intensity are changed in a direct proportion, and the photoelectric microwave is amplified. The amplifier circuit has the advantages of simple structure, high working voltage and high microwave output power, not only eliminates unipolar limitation, but also effectively solves the problem of low output power.

title_en: Reflection-free amplifier
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a reflectionless amplifier, which is characterized in that the reflectionless amplifier is a single-ended or differential reflectionless amplifier, and comprises a high-frequency signal absorption network, a low-frequency signal absorption network and a passband signal amplifier; the passband signal is a signal amplified by the amplifier according to the design; the high-frequency signal absorption network is used for absorbing high-frequency signals in input signals, and the high-frequency signals are input signals with signal frequencies higher than those of the passband signals; the low-frequency signal absorption network is used for absorbing low-frequency signals in input signals, and the low-frequency input signals are input signals with signal frequencies lower than those of the passband signals. The scheme provided by the embodiment of the application can realize the broadband reflection-free design of the amplifier and the miniaturized design of the reflection-free amplifier.

title_en: Transmission method and reception method
abstract_en: A transmission method and a reception method are provided. The sending method comprises the following steps: in the case that the number of input bits is less than the number of information bits, filling bit spaces of the information bits with input bits and one or more zero-padded bits; encoding information bits based on a low density parity check, LDPC, code to generate parity bits, interleaving the parity bits; dividing a codeword including information bits and interleaved parity bits into a plurality of bit groups; interleaving the plurality of groups of bits based on the permuted order of the pattern to provide an interleaved codeword; calculating the number of parity bits to be punctured based on the number of information bits; puncturing one or more parity bits of the interleaved codeword based on the calculated number; mapping the input bits and the parity bits remaining after the punctured codeword onto the constellation points, and transmitting a signal generated based on the constellation points.

title_en: D trigger, nonlinear phase detector and data recovery circuit
abstract_en: The application discloses a D trigger, a nonlinear phase detector and a data recovery circuit, wherein the D trigger comprises a current mode latch, a sensitive amplifier and an RS latch which are connected in sequence; the low level of the current mode latch is effective; the positive phase input end and the negative phase input end of the current mode latch are respectively used as the positive phase input end and the negative phase input end of the D trigger; a positive phase output end and a negative phase output end of the RS latch are respectively used as a positive phase output end and a negative phase output end of the D trigger; and the clock input end of the current mode latch is connected with the clock input end of the sensitive amplifier and used as the clock input end of the D trigger. The D flip-flop is constructed by combining the current mode latch and the SAFF, so that the circuit has the advantages of high input sensitivity, high rejection ratio and the like of the current mode logic circuit, and also has the characteristics of low power consumption and full swing of output signals of the SAFF, the sensitivity and the accuracy are effectively improved, and further the economic benefit of products is improved.

title_en: Low-power-consumption successive approximation type analog-to-digital conversion circuit module
