abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-power-consumption successive approximation type analog-to-digital conversion circuit module which comprises a comparator, a logic comparison control and output module, a sampling switch and a successive approximation capacitance module, wherein the comparator is used for comparing the logic comparison control and output module; the inverting input end of the comparator receives the converted voltage through the sampling switch, the non-inverting input end of the comparator is connected with the logic comparison control and output module through the successive approximation capacitance module, and the output end of the comparator is connected with the logic comparison control and output module; after the sampling switch is closed, sampling the analog voltage to be converted, storing the analog voltage at the inverting input end of the comparator, then transferring the comparison result to the logic comparison control and output module by the comparator, controlling the successive approximation capacitance module circuit to transfer different voltages to the non-inverting input end of the comparator by the logic comparison control and output module according to the comparison result of the comparator, and finally continuously adjusting the control of the capacitor to finally realize the output of voltage coding; the analog-to-digital conversion circuit module can reduce energy consumption and the number of capacitors in the module, thereby reducing the chip area.

title_en: Power-on reset circuit and isolated half-bridge driver
abstract_en: The application discloses power-on reset circuit and isolated half-bridge driver, this power-on reset circuit includes: delay circuit, inverter circuit and switching circuit. Wherein one end of the delay circuit is coupled to the power supply and the other end of the delay circuit is coupled to ground. The time delay circuit is used for outputting a voltage signal in the process that the power supply voltage rises from zero voltage to steady-state voltage. The inverting circuit is used for performing inverting processing on the voltage signal to obtain a control signal. The switch circuit is used for conducting under the control of the control signal so as to output the power supply or the ground as a reset signal. According to the scheme provided by the embodiment of the application, in the power supply electrifying process, the switch circuit is conducted by means of the power supply voltage, so that the power supply or the ground is output as the reset signal, the reset signal can be stably output in the whole power supply electrifying process, and the reliability of the POR circuit is improved.

title_en: Integrated circuit drive control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a drive control system, in particular to an integrated circuit drive control system, which comprises a controller, an upper computer and a semiconductor refrigerating sheet arranged on an integrated circuit board, wherein the controller is connected with a signal receiving module used for receiving a control signal sent by the upper computer, the controller is connected with an encoder used for encoding the control signal, the controller is connected with a pulse generator used for converting the encoded signal into a slot pulse signal, the controller is connected with a decoding module used for decoding the slot pulse signal to generate a control instruction, the controller is connected with a signal conversion module used for converting a serial control instruction into a parallel control instruction, and the controller is used for carrying out drive control on a drive load through the drive module according to the parallel control instruction; the technical scheme provided by the invention can effectively overcome the defects that in the prior art, a plurality of controllers are required to drive the output ports, the wiring is complex, and the reliability is reduced due to larger working heat.

title_en: Key structure and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a key structure and electronic equipment, and belongs to the technical field of electronics. The key structure comprises: a planar support plate, a circuit board, and a piezoelectric element including at least one emitter electrode and at least one receiver electrode; at least two first mounting holes are formed in a first area of the circuit board, each first mounting hole is embedded with one emitting electrode or one receiving electrode, and the emitting electrode and the receiving electrode are respectively and electrically connected with the circuit board; the first area is fixedly connected with one surface of the plane supporting plate. The planar support plate in the key structure provided by the embodiment of the application has the advantages of simple structure, easiness in processing, low cost and simple mounting process between the circuit board and the planar support plate, so that the processing efficiency of the key structure can be improved, and the production cost is reduced.

title_en: Method for adjusting sampling phase and serial flash memory controller
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for adjusting sampling phase and a serial flash memory controller, wherein the serial flash memory controller comprises a processing path, the processing path comprises a delay circuit, and a register in the delay circuit receives a phase difference adjusting signal; an adjusting delay circuit in the delay circuit is connected with the register and delays the associated clock signal or the first data signal according to the phase difference adjusting signal so as to enable the phase difference between the associated clock signal and the first data signal to be within a first preset range; the adjusting delay circuit comprises a plurality of sub-delay circuits connected in series, the delay time of each sub-delay circuit is a first time, the initial phase difference between the associated clock signal and the first data signal is a second time, and the preset number is associated with the first time and the second time. By means of the method, the phase difference between the associated clock signal and the first data signal can be adjusted, accurate sampling of the first data signal is achieved, and stable transmission of the data signal is achieved.

title_en: Variable cycle engine resolution redundancy estimation method based on improved state tracking filter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a variable cycle engine resolution redundancy estimation method based on an improved state tracking filter. Firstly, establishing a nonlinear component level model of a variable cycle engine in a state above slow running, solving a state space model when MSV is 75 at a design point, and increasing a health parameter into a state quantity to obtain an increased state space model; then, a constant Kalman gain array is obtained and is combined with a nonlinear model to form an improved state tracking filter, the correction quantity of the health parameter is calculated according to the residual error of the sensor, and then the nonlinear model is corrected, so that the model output self-adaption in the full envelope is realized; and then, after the sensor fault is detected, the filtering is closed, the residual error is set to zero, and the output parameter corresponding to the self-adaptive model is used as the resolution redundancy of the fault sensor. The method solves the problems that the existing piecewise linear model has too many solved state space equations, the filtering estimation precision is reduced along with the change of working points, and the analytic redundancy cannot be accurately provided, and is successfully applied to the variable cycle engine.

title_en: Multi-lead signal coupler
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-lead signal coupler, relates to information communication accessories, and aims to solve the problem that people need an external power supply when using the coupler and are inconvenient to use, and the technical scheme is characterized in that: the device comprises a signal input module, a signal output module and a signal processing module, wherein the signal input module is used for connecting a signal source to receive an input signal which is a pulse signal; the coupling unit is connected with the signal input module and responds to an input signal to output a transmission signal; the signal amplification circuit is connected with the coupling unit and used for receiving the transmission signal to amplify the transmission signal; and the power supply unit is coupled with the signal input module and the signal amplification circuit and used for receiving the input signal to drive the signal amplification circuit. The coupler can be normally used without an external power supply or a built-in battery and other power supplies by converting the input signal into the power supply driven internally, is convenient for people to install and use, and forms a plurality of mutually independent signal channels through the arrangement of a plurality of photoelectric coupling circuits, so that the integration level is higher.

title_en: High-reliability PMOS power switch tube driving circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-reliability PMOS power switch tube driving circuit which comprises a Schmidt trigger, a level shifter 1, a level shifter 2, a driving stage 1, a driving stage 2, a driving stage 3, LDO1, LDO2, enabling control, dead zone control, a discharging passage, a PMOS power switch tube and a power amplifier. The PMOS power switch tube driving circuit adopts a sectional control means to generate any control voltage required by the PMOS power switch tube, thereby meeting the requirements of different types of power switch control. Compared with the traditional PMOS power switch tube driving circuit, the invention is added with the enabling control module for detecting the amplitude of the power supply voltage, and when the power supply voltage meets the working requirement, the invention generates the enabling signal, thereby obviously reducing the unstable state of driving output in the power supply powering-on and powering-off process.

title_en: MEMS device
abstract_en: The invention provides a MEMS device capable of inhibiting diffusion of a part of metal of eutectic alloy forming a connecting part along a connecting wiring. A resonance device (1) is provided with: a MEMS substrate (50) comprising a resonator (10) and a connection wiring (75) electrically connected to the resonator (10); and a connection part (70) electrically connected to the connection wiring (75), wherein the connection part is composed of a eutectic alloy of the first metal layer (71) and the second metal layer (72) provided on the MEMS substrate (50) side, and the line Width (WL) of the connection wiring (75) is smaller than the Width (WC) of the connection part when the main surface of the MEMS substrate (50) is seen in plan view.

title_en: 3D stacked space power synthesis amplifier
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 3D stacked space power synthesis amplifier, and aims to provide a 3D power synthesis amplifier with shorter connection distance and higher integration level. The invention is realized by the following technical scheme: the first synthetic array surface 1 and the second synthetic array surface 2 are laminated, the synthetic array surface N and the synthetic array surface N-1 are laminated, the synthetic array surfaces 1-N are vertically interconnected through input/output nodes of the synthetic array surfaces 1-N in sequence from bottom to top and from top to bottom, and are overlapped together in the Z direction to form an N array, input and output radio frequency channels penetrating through the layers in the X direction are formed in the layer stacking of the synthetic array surfaces 1-N based on a 3D micro-mechanical technology, and three-dimensional packaging of three-dimensional integration and signal communication is formed in the Z-axis direction; thus forming a hybrid 3D array with multiple amplifier fronts and power splitting/combining network fronts alternately stacked and vertically interconnected. The invention can realize more amplifier synthesis in the same volume. The use of miniaturization and high power is satisfied.

title_en: Film acoustic resonator and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a film acoustic resonator and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the film acoustic resonator comprises a first substrate containing an acoustic reflection structure, an acoustic resonator unit at least partially positioned on the acoustic reflection structure, a substrate bonded with the first substrate through an annular cofferdam, and a cavity formed between the substrate and the acoustic resonator unit, wherein the acoustic resonator unit at least partially comprises a first electrode, a piezoelectric layer and a second electrode which are overlapped from bottom to top, and at least one of the substrate and the annular cofferdam has the effect of shielding electromagnetic waves. The invention effectively blocks or attenuates the propagation of electromagnetic waves generated by the resonator unit to the outside, thereby inhibiting the electromagnetic radiation outside the resonator unit.

title_en: Rapid track compression method based on effective distance
abstract_en: In order to effectively solve the problem of multi-scale self-adaptation in track compression, the invention provides a rapid track compression method based on effective distance, and provides a new characteristic weighting method, wherein the characteristic effective distance is used as a characteristic value of track compression, so that the straightness of a track section in a specific time can be effectively measured; the invention supports the parallel computation of the track compression and can improve the efficiency of the track compression; and online compression is supported, and the track drawing efficiency can be improved.

title_en: MIMO receiving judgment method based on diffusion channel in molecular communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a MIMO receiving judgment method based on a diffusion channel in molecular communication, which is applied to the field of molecular communication and aims at the problem of high error rate of an MIMO model in the prior art.

title_en: Power supply circuit and amplifying circuit
abstract_en: This power supply circuit is configured to supply power to the amplifier and includes: a power supply line extending by branching from a signal line through which a signal input to the amplifier is transferred or a signal output from the amplifier is transferred; and a capacitive element having one end connected to a distal end of the power supply line and the other end grounded, the capacitive element guiding the signal to the ground, wherein a base end of the power supply line is a branch portion at which the power supply line branches from the signal line, and a line length of the power supply line extending from the branch portion to the distal end is shorter than λ/4, where λ is a wavelength of the signal.

title_en: Intelligent electronic switch
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to intelligent electronic switches. An integrated circuit that may be used as an intelligent switch is described herein. According to one embodiment, an integrated circuit includes a power transistor coupled between a power supply pin and an output pin, and further includes a control circuit configured to trigger turning on and off of the power transistor according to an input signal. The control circuit is configured to trigger turn-off of the power transistor when a load current through the power transistor is at or above a predetermined current and a supply voltage received at the supply pin is at or below a predetermined threshold voltage.

title_en: Method for amplifier load current cancellation in a current integrator and current integrator with amplifier load current cancellation
abstract_en: Amplifier load current cancellation in a current integrator includes: will input current (I) in ) Is applied to an operational transconductance amplifier provided with an integrating capacitor (C) for current integration int ) Steering the output current of an operational transconductance amplifier(I out ) Through a sense resistor (R) sense ) Thereby generating a voltage drop across the sense resistor, and generating a cancellation current (I) based on the voltage drop across the sense resistor out，cancel ) And injecting a cancellation current into the output current before or after the output current passes through the sense resistor, thereby canceling the dependence of the output current on the input current.

title_en: RF filter device
abstract_en: An RF filter device is provided which provides a small spatial dimension and good electrical performance. The filter arrangement comprises a resonator structure and a further circuit. The acoustic mirror is arranged between the active structure and another circuit.

title_en: Configurable delay circuit and delay configuration method
abstract_en: A configurable delay circuit and a delay configuration method belong to the technical field of integrated circuit signal delay. The invention aims at the problem that the delay time provided by a standard inverter unit is difficult to meet the SET pulse width detection requirement when the existing inverter unit is adopted to detect or filter the SET pulse. The configurable delay circuit comprises a main circuit, a pull-up network unit and a pull-down network unit, wherein the main circuit comprises an inverter I1, an inverter I2, four NMOS transistors N1, N2, N3, N4 and four PMOS transistors P1, P2, P3 and P4; the main circuit can provide output delay of hundreds of picoseconds magnitude, and the output delay can be further adjusted through the control ends configured by the pull-up network unit and the pull-down network unit on the basis, so that on one hand, the design requirement can be better met, and on the other hand, the delay change caused by process deviation, temperature and power supply voltage fluctuation can be responded through adjusting the delay of the circuit in real time. The delay time of the invention can meet the SET pulse width detection requirement.

title_en: DC power supply switch device for power monitoring
abstract_en: The invention provides a direct-current power supply switching device for power monitoring, which comprises an NMOS (N-channel metal oxide semiconductor) tube M1, a resistor R1, a resistor R2, a thyristor Q1, a resistor R3, a resistor R7, a thyristor trigger circuit and a turn-off control circuit, wherein the NMOS tube M1 is connected with the resistor R1; the drain electrode of the NMOS tube M1 is connected with one end of a resistor R1, the other end of the resistor R1 is used as the input end of the power supply switching device, and the source electrode of the NMOS tube M1 is the output end of the power supply switching device; the drain electrode of the NMOS tube M1 is connected with the anode of a thyristor Q1 through a resistor R2, and the cathode of the thyristor K1 is connected with the gate of the NMOS tube M1 after being connected in series through a resistor R3 and a resistor R7; can effectively avoid causing the impact to electrical apparatus spare at opening the in-process to form the protection, can turn off fast at the outage in-process, thereby effectively carry out accurate control to electrical apparatus spare, whole circuit structure is simple moreover, and the reliability is high.

title_en: Level conversion circuit and electronic device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a level conversion circuit and electronic equipment, which are used for solving the problem that the level conversion circuit is hung dead due to a fault device. The level shift circuit of the embodiment of the application includes: a level input unit, a charge and discharge unit, a switch unit and a level output unit; the first end of the switch unit is connected with the level input unit, the second end of the switch unit is connected with the first end of the charge and discharge unit, the third end of the switch unit is connected with the second end of the charge and discharge unit and the level output unit, and the third end of the charge and discharge unit is grounded; when the level input unit inputs a high level and a load connected with the third end of the switch unit pulls the voltage of the third end of the switch unit to a low level, the charge and discharge unit discharges before the switch unit is cut off, and when the voltage of the charge and discharge unit is lower than a preset voltage, the switch unit is cut off.

title_en: Voltage controlled oscillator, phase-locked loop circuit and clock chip
abstract_en: The invention discloses a voltage-controlled oscillator, a phase-locked loop circuit and a clock chip, wherein the voltage-controlled oscillator comprises a plurality of delay units which are connected end to end, the differential input end of each delay unit is connected with the differential output end of the previous delay unit, and the differential output end of one delay unit outputs a differential output signal; the delay unit comprises a differential inversion unit and a positive feedback unit, the differential inversion unit changes the current of the first current source by adjusting the voltage-controlled control signal input by the adjusting field effect transistor, and the differential inversion unit outputs a differential output signal. The voltage-controlled control signal of field effect transistor is adjusted in the adjustment to the on-resistance of field effect transistor is adjusted in the change, and then influences the size of first current source and adjusts the frequency, has reduced voltage controlled oscillator's output frequency and has received the influence of power, and anti power noise interference's ability is strong, when being used for phase-locked loop circuit, has faster locking time.

title_en: Linearization with level tracking
abstract_en: Systems, apparatuses, modules, methods, and other implementations are disclosed, including a method for digital predistortion that includes receiving, by a digital predistorter, a first signal that depends on a change in amplitude based on an input signal u, where the change in the first signal corresponds to a temporal change in a nonlinear characteristic of a transmit chain including a power amplifier. The method further comprises receiving, by the digital predistorter, an input signal u; generating, by the digital predistorter, a digital predistortion signal v based at least in part on a signal comprising the input signal u and the first signal to mitigate nonlinear behavior of the transmit chain; and providing the pre-distorted signal v to the transmit chain.

title_en: Entropy encoder, entropy decoder, and corresponding entropy encoding method and entropy decoding method
abstract_en: The invention provides an entropy encoder, an entropy decoder and a corresponding method. The entropy encoder includes: an entropy encoding circuit arranged to receive a plurality of symbols of a pixel group and entropy encode data derived from the plurality of symbols of the pixel group to generate a bit stream segment consisting of a first bit stream part and a second bit stream part, wherein the first bit stream part contains encoded magnitude data for the plurality of symbols of the pixel group and the second bit stream part contains encoded sign data for at least a part of the plurality of symbols of the pixel group; and a size determination circuit arranged to determine a size of a bitstream portion, wherein the bitstream portion comprises at least one of the first bitstream portion and the second bitstream portion. The entropy encoder, the entropy decoder and the corresponding methods of the present invention can obtain the bit stream position of the bit stream segment of the extracted bit stream segment.

title_en: Excitation circuit for ultrasonic icing detection and ultrasonic icing detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses an excitation circuit for ultrasonic icing detection and an ultrasonic icing detector. The power supply comprises an N-channel MOS field effect transistor Q1, a grid G is a signal input end, a source electrode S is grounded, a drain electrode D is respectively connected with one end of a current-limiting resistor R1 and one end of an energy-storage capacitor C1, the other end of the current-limiting resistor R1 is connected with VCC voltage, the other end of the energy-storage capacitor C1 is connected with one end of an output resistor R2, the other end of the output resistor R2 is grounded, and the voltage loaded on the output resistor R2 is output voltage. The invention has the characteristics of small volume and weight, low cost, large detection range and high detection precision, and ensures the aerodynamic appearance of the airplane.

title_en: Sound effect customizing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sound effect customizing method, which comprises the following steps: playing a reference audio frequency with a preset frequency; setting a gain parameter of a reference audio by a user to obtain a customized gain parameter, wherein the customized gain parameter is associated with a preset frequency; replacing original gain parameters of corresponding frequencies in preset original customized sound effects by adopting customized gain parameters to obtain user customized sound effects; the user listens to the audio frequency with the preset frequency, and sets the gain of the audio frequency with the preset frequency, so that the user can intuitively sense the hearing change caused by the adjustment of the gain under the preset frequency, and the user can adjust the sound effect more specifically to obtain the customized sound effect capable of meeting the personalized hearing requirement of the user.

title_en: Frequency detection and tracking acceleration circuit used in PLL
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a frequency detection and tracking acceleration circuit used in a PLL, which comprises: the device comprises a signal input module, a clock generation module, a first sampling module, a second sampling module, a comparison module, a power supply output module and a locking module. The frequency detection and tracking acceleration circuit used in the PLL can detect the tracking state of the phase-locked loop, and the phase-locked loop sends out a signal when the frequency of the phase-locked loop approaches a target; and the lock detection function can be utilized, and certain parameters of the phase-locked loop are controlled by signals, so that the tracking time is shortened, and the problem that the tracking time requirement of the phase-locked loop conflicts with the bandwidth is avoided.

title_en: Narrow pulse width negative pulse type downlink signal decoding method and system based on pattern recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for decoding narrow-pulse-width negative pulse type downlink signals based on pattern recognition, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a voltage signal converted from the drilling fluid flow information; extracting a reference signal segment from the voltage signal; extracting similar segments similar to the waveform characteristics of the reference signal segments from the voltage signal based on a pattern recognition principle; decoding the voltage signal according to the extracted similar segments based on a code element interpretation algorithm to obtain a code element signal sequence; and identifying the code element signal sequence to obtain a control instruction. All similar segments are extracted from the voltage signal, and the voltage signal is decoded according to the similar segments, so that the decoding accuracy is improved.

title_en: Surface acoustic wave filter chip packaging manufacturing method and structure thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a surface acoustic wave filter chip packaging manufacturing method and a surface acoustic wave filter chip packaging structure, wherein a through hole is arranged in a surface acoustic wave filter chip, and a circuit layer and a conductive bump are arranged away from a chip functional area through the through hole, so that structures such as a hole groove for electrical connection and the like do not need to be formed on a sealing cover layer, the requirements on the properties such as the thickness, the structural strength and the like of the sealing cover layer are reduced, a high molecular polymer can be selected as the sealing cover layer of the surface acoustic wave filter chip, and compared with a metal, glass or wafer cover plate, the high molecular polymer is thinner, the packaging structure is favorably miniaturized, the cost is lower, and the industrial requirements.

title_en: Control device for sapphire frequency source
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control device for a sapphire frequency source. The control device is based on a sapphire microwave cavity working in a whispering gallery mode, two high-Q-value E-mode and H-mode oscillation signals are separated through an electrical means, the H-mode oscillation signals serve as main oscillation signals, phase and amplitude change information is extracted from the E-mode oscillation signals and serves as feedback control signals, the main oscillation signals are stabilized, extra modulation signals are not needed, and therefore microwave signals with extremely low stray, high frequency stability and low phase noise are obtained. Compared with circuit devices used in low-temperature sapphire frequency sources at home and abroad, the low-stray-power-factor-free low-noise frequency source circuit has the advantages of high frequency stability, low phase noise and low stray.

title_en: Encoding circuit, decoding circuit, encoding method, decoding method, and transmission device
abstract_en: An encoding circuit, a decoding circuit, an encoding method, a decoding method, and a transmitting apparatus. An encoding circuit comprising: an allocator configured to allocate a symbol corresponding to a value of a plurality of bit strings among a plurality of symbols within a constellation of multi-level modulation; a converter configured to convert values of respective bit strings excluding the first bit string such that the closer a region within the constellation is to a center of the constellation, the greater the number of symbols allocated into the region; a switch configured to switch between a first period in which a first error correction code is inserted and a second period in which the first error correction code is not inserted; and an inserter configured to generate the first error correction code from a second bit string in the second period in accordance with the switching, and insert the first error correction code into two or more bit strings in the first period.

title_en: High-power GaN power amplifier modulation circuit
abstract_en: The invention provides a modulation circuit of a high-power GaN power amplifier, which comprises a high-voltage driver integrated circuit and a PMOS (P-channel metal oxide semiconductor) tube; the high-voltage driver integrated circuit comprises a reference power supply generation module, an enabling control module and a high-side dead zone control module; the grid electrode of the PMOS tube is connected with the high-side dead zone control module, the source electrode of the PMOS tube is connected with power supply voltage, and the drain electrode of the PMOS tube is connected with the GaN power device. The modulator can provide peak current of 40 amperes, and can be applied to a high-power GaN power amplifier; meanwhile, the modulation circuit adopts a special overshoot voltage prevention circuit, the influence of overshoot voltage can be effectively inhibited, and the long-term reliability is obviously superior to that of the traditional modulator; the circuit adopts various means for inhibiting power supply ripples and preventing voltage impact, thereby ensuring the reliability in working.

title_en: Imaging element
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide an imaging element capable of reducing crosstalk in an AD conversion section. The imaging element is provided with: capacitors in even column regions; and capacitors in odd column regions configured to face the capacitors with different areas.

title_en: Knee-touch type medical dirt dustbin control circuit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of medical treatment, in particular to a knee-touch type medical waste dustbin control circuit. The technical problems of the invention are as follows: provides a knee touch type medical dirt dustbin control circuit which can not pollute hands of people. A knee touch type medical dirt dustbin control circuit comprises a power supply circuit, a switch group, a touch control circuit, a control IC and the like; the switch group is connected with the input end of the touch control circuit, and the output end of the touch control circuit is connected with the control IC. According to the invention, the cover of the dustbin can be opened and closed by the direct current motor, so that manual operation is not required, and hands of people are not polluted; the current limiting circuit is used for protecting the direct current motor driving circuit, so that the direct current motor driving circuit is prevented from being damaged due to overlarge current.

title_en: Optical coupling isolation circuit based on GH063L
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical coupling isolation circuit based on GH 063L. The high-voltage-resistant optical coupler comprises a GH063L optical coupler, two output pins VO1 and VO2 of the GH063L optical coupler are respectively connected with one ends of a pull-up resistor R1 and a pull-up resistor R2, the other ends of the pull-up resistors R1 and R2 are both connected with a VCC pin of the GH063L optical coupler, and the VCC pin is externally connected with 3.3V voltage; pins IN1 and IN2 of the GH063L optical coupler are signal input ends, and pins VO1 and VO2 are signal output ends. The invention has the characteristics of simple circuit structure, high-frequency signal distortion prevention, and strong high-frequency signal isolation capability and anti-interference capability.

title_en: Door lock system and reset circuit thereof
abstract_en: A door lock system and a reset circuit thereof, the scheme comprises: the first end of the first capacitor is connected with the first power interface; the first end of the first resistor is connected with the second end of the first capacitor, and the second end of the first resistor is grounded; the control end of the first switch tube is connected with the first end of the first resistor, the input end of the first switch tube is connected with the second power interface, and the output end of the first switch tube is grounded; the control end of the second switching tube is connected with the input end of the first switching tube, and the input end of the second switching tube is connected with the second power supply interface; the first end of the second resistor is connected with the output end of the second switching tube, and the second end of the second resistor is grounded; the control end of the third switching tube is connected with the output end of the second switching tube, the input end of the third switching tube is connected with the second power interface, and the output end of the third switching tube is used as the reset signal output end of the reset circuit of the lock system, so that the power reset operation of the door lock system is realized, and the door lock system is reset once.

title_en: Hardware friendly data compression
abstract_en: Systems, apparatuses, and methods for compressing data are provided. One exemplary method may include interleaving one or more literal length fields with one or more literal fields to an output. The literal amount field may contain a first data segment that is copied verbatim to the output, and each of the one or more literal amount length fields may contain a value that represents the length of the subsequent literal amount field. The method may further include determining a second data segment and a matching location that match a previously verbatim copied data sequence and writing one or more matching length fields of the output and a matching location field containing the matching location to the output. The literal length field may contain the total length of the first data segment and the match length field may contain the total length of the second data segment.

title_en: FBAR filter
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of filters, and provides an FBAR filter, which comprises: the input end of the counteracting circuit is connected with the input end of the FBAR filter circuit, the output end of the counteracting circuit is connected with the output end of the FBAR filter circuit, the counteracting circuit is used for forming a second path, when the working frequency is in the stop band of the FBAR filter, the signal passes through the counteracting circuit, and when the working frequency is in the pass band of the FBAR filter, the signal passes through the FBAR filter circuit. This application can realize high suppression at the stop band low frequency end through increasing offset circuit, and components and parts among the offset circuit can not cause FBAR filter's chip volume to increase by a wide margin, can not introduce more losses and worsen the in-band insertion loss.

title_en: Method and device for realizing LDPC (Low Density parity check) coding of 5G NR (noise-and-noise) standard
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a device for realizing LDPC coding of a 5G NR standard. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a check matrix H of the LDPC code; decomposing the check matrix H according to a specified size to obtain a decomposed check matrix; decomposing the check formula according to the decomposed check matrix; and solving the check bit w according to the decomposed check formula, and carrying out LDPC coding according to the check bit w. The embodiment of the invention can reduce the processing amount required by matrix processing, so that the realization of the LDPC coding of the 5G NR standard can have lower resource consumption and lower processing time delay.

title_en: Clock comparator and method thereof
abstract_en: A clock comparator and a method thereof. The clock comparator comprises a first clock transconductance amplifier, a clock regeneration type load, an SR latch and a second clock transconductance amplifier. The first clock transconductance amplifier is used for receiving a first voltage signal and outputting a first current signal to an internal node according to a clock. The clock regeneration type load is used for enabling the second voltage signal to be self-regenerated at the internal node according to the clock. The SR latch is used for receiving the second voltage signal at the internal node and outputting a third voltage signal. The second clock transconductance amplifier is used for receiving a third voltage signal and outputting a second current signal to the internal node.

title_en: Transmission gate circuit, matrix switch and electronic equipment
abstract_en: A transmission gate circuit, a matrix switch and an electronic device, wherein the transmission gate circuit comprises a first transmission gate and a second transmission gate, the input end of the first transmission gate is used for transmitting the input signal or the output signal of a load circuit connected with the first transmission gate, the control end of the first transmission gate is used for inputting a first control signal, and the output end of the first transmission gate is also connected with the output end of the second transmission gate; the input end of the second transmission gate is used for inputting a leakage adjusting signal, and the control end of the second transmission gate is used for inputting a second control signal. When the first transmission gate is in a conducting state under the control of the first control signal, the second transmission gate is in a closing state under the control of the second control signal, and when the first transmission gate is in a closing state under the control of the first control signal, the second transmission gate is in a conducting state under the control of the second control signal; the leakage adjusting signal is used for reducing the leakage current of the first transmission gate when the first transmission gate is turned off and the second transmission gate is turned on.

title_en: Driving method and driving device of silicon controlled rectifier and heating appliance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a driving method, a driving device and a heating appliance of a silicon controlled rectifier, wherein the driving method comprises the following steps: acquiring a mains voltage; judging whether a zero-crossing detection signal appears according to the mains supply voltage; when the zero-crossing detection signal appears, a driving signal is sent to the controllable silicon; the driving signal is stopped after lasting for a first preset time; after stopping the second preset time, sending a driving signal to the controlled silicon again; and judging whether a zero-crossing detection signal appears according to the mains voltage, and stopping the driving signal after the driving signal lasts for the first preset time when the zero-crossing detection signal appears. So set up, the silicon controlled rectifier can switch on in succession, avoids the high frequency voltage impact that the silicon controlled rectifier bore when postponing to switch on. And further, the loss of the circuit components can be reduced.

title_en: Digital-to-analog converter (DAC) circuits employing resistor rotator circuits configured to be included in analog-to-digital converter (ADC) circuits
abstract_en: Digital-to-analog converter (DAC) circuits are disclosed that employ a resistor rotator circuit configured to be included in an analog-to-digital converter (ADC) circuit. In one aspect, a DAC circuit includes a plurality of DAC stages, where each DAC stage may be configured to generate one or more DAC analog signals corresponding to a selected resistance within the DAC stage. Each DAC stage is configured to receive a corresponding top voltage and bottom voltage. Each DAC stage is configured to generate a number of DAC analog signals based on the corresponding top and bottom voltages and a selected resistance of the DAC stage. Each DAC stage includes a regulation circuit including a resistance configured to regulate the resistance of the corresponding DAC stage such that a parallel combination of the resistance of the regulation circuit and the resistance of the next DAC stage is maintained at a desired resistance level.

title_en: Power device based on integrated internal matching circuit and processing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power device based on an integrated internal matching circuit, which comprises an input internal matching network, a power tube and an output internal matching network, wherein the input internal matching network, the power tube and the output internal matching network are sequentially connected in series to form an electric path for transmitting a microwave signal to a load, and the input internal matching network and the output internal matching network are respectively connected with a microwave signal source and the load and are respectively used for matching input impedance so that the power tube obtains maximum excitation power from the microwave signal source. The first microwave frequency band input path and the second microwave frequency band input path are arranged in the input internal matching network, so that a double-frequency function can be effectively realized, the working bandwidth and the working frequency of the whole device are improved, the parasitic influence is reduced, and the input internal matching network, the power tube and the output internal matching network are printed and integrated, so that the size of the whole device is effectively reduced, the loss of transmission lines is reduced, and the output power is improved.

title_en: Method and device for loading modulation parameters, processor and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for loading modulation parameters, a processor and electronic equipment. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining all modulation parameters to be updated of all modulation signals output by a controller and preset loading time, wherein the modulation parameters to be updated are all modulation parameters to be updated of all modulation signals, and the preset loading time is preset loading time for executing loading of the modulation parameters to be updated; dividing all the modulation signals into a first type of modulation signals and a second type of modulation signals according to preset loading moments, wherein the first type of modulation signals are modulation signals with the same preset loading moments, and the second type of modulation signals are modulation signals with different preset loading moments; and controlling the first type modulation signal and the second type modulation signal to respectively execute loading operation. The invention solves the technical problem that the output result deviates from the expected value due to the deviation of the updated modulation parameter time sequence in the execution process of the switching period in the prior art.

title_en: Circuit for improving short-circuit fault response speed of SiC MOSFET device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a circuit for improving the short-circuit fault response speed of a SiC MOSFET device, which comprises a desaturation comparison circuit, a drive circuit, a first current channel, a second current channel and a clamping circuit. The invention increases the charging speed of the desaturation detection capacitor by adding the desaturation charging loop; when short circuit occurs, the voltage of the clamping circuit rises at the moment, and due to the fact that the second current channel is added on the basis of the first current channel, the voltage rising speed of the desaturation capacitor is higher, the fault switch tube is turned off quickly, short circuit current of the switch tube is restrained quickly, and damage of short circuit fault to devices is reduced.

title_en: Short wave digital signal interpretation and reduction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short wave digital signal interpretation and reduction method, which is implemented according to the following steps: step 1, inputting a short wave digital signal input signal into a judgment subsystem, converting the signal format, and cutting a signal containing multiple communications into a single complete communications file; step 2, judging whether the single complete communication file is a negotiation signal, if the single complete communication file is the negotiation signal, transferring the single complete communication file to a negotiation signal processing subsystem, and otherwise, transferring the single complete communication file to a non-negotiation signal processing subsystem; step 3, after being processed by the negotiation signal processing subsystem or the non-negotiation signal processing subsystem, the restored data is displayed through the data message output and presentation subsystem; the method of the invention interprets the non-negotiation signal through the Like-Huffman algorithm, and effectively improves the compression effect of the file in the interpretation process.

title_en: Oscillator
abstract_en: The present invention provides an oscillator, comprising: a capacitance C1; a first current source I1; a second current source I2; a comparison circuit for comparing the voltage drop across the capacitor C1 with a low voltage threshold V1 and a high voltage threshold V2; a threshold voltage generation circuit, when the output end of the comparison circuit outputs a charging control signal, the output end of the threshold voltage generation circuit outputs a high voltage threshold value V2; when the output end of the comparison circuit outputs a discharge control signal, the output end of the threshold voltage generation circuit outputs a low voltage threshold V1; and the charge and discharge control circuit is used for controlling charge and discharge of the capacitor C1, and the control end of the charge and discharge control circuit is connected with the output end of the comparison circuit. Therefore, the stability and the precision of the oscillator are higher, and the frequency and the duty ratio of the oscillation waveform can be adjusted.

title_en: RF filter system for processing chamber
abstract_en: A Radio Frequency (RF) filter system for a substrate processing chamber includes a first RF filter coupled to a first element of the processing chamber and a second RF filter coupled to the first element of the processing chamber. Each of the RF filters includes a first filter stage configured to reject a first frequency; a second filter stage coupled to the first filter stage and configured to reject the second frequency; and a third filter stage coupled to the second filter stage and configured to reject the first frequency. Furthermore, the first filter stage comprises a first inductor and a first capacitor, the second filter stage comprises a second inductor and a second capacitor, and the third filter stage comprises a third inductor and a third capacitor.

title_en: Power amplifier with high back-off efficiency
abstract_en: The application discloses power amplifier with high back-off efficiency includes: the power amplifier comprises a plurality of power amplifier subunits, wherein each power amplifier subunit comprises a first capacitor, a first end of each first capacitor is electrically connected with an output end, a second end of each first capacitor is connected with a stacked inverter circuit, and the stacked inverter circuit controls the second end of each first capacitor to float when the power amplifier subunits are closed. When the stacked inverter circuit comprises a PMOS tube and an NMOS tube, and the power amplifier subunit works, the stacked inverter circuit is conducted, and the second end of the first capacitor is controlled to be switched between VDD and GND. When the power amplifier subunit is closed, the stacked inverter circuit is cut off and presents a high-resistance state, so that the second end of the first capacitor is floated, and the rollback efficiency is further improved.

title_en: Millimeter wave power amplifier based on CMOS (complementary Metal oxide semiconductor) process and power control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave power amplifier based on a CMOS (complementary metal oxide semiconductor) process and a power control method, belonging to the technical field of radio frequency integrated circuits. The output power is adjusted by controlling the work or the non-work of a specific MOS tube of the single-stage amplification unit, specifically, for a certain MOS tube, only the work state and the non-work state are realized, and the multi-gear adjustment is realized by increasing the number of a plurality of on-off controllable transistors; when the highest output power is in a gear, all the working transistors of the power amplifier work, the working current is the largest, the output power is reduced, the number of the working transistors of the power amplifier is reduced, and the power consumption is reduced; compared with a power control mode based on an attenuator, the power consumption is lower and the efficiency is higher when the power control mode works at low output power.

title_en: Power amplifier
abstract_en: Provided is a Doherty amplifier which can be made highly efficient and compact and can reduce the influence of parasitic components. A power amplifier is provided with: a 3dB coupler that splits the signal (RF1) into a signal (RF2) and a signal (RF3) that lags behind it by about 90 degrees; a carrier amplifier that amplifies a signal (RF2) in a region where a power level of the signal (RF1) is at least a 1 st level and outputs a signal (RF 4); a peak amplifier that amplifies the signal (RF3) and outputs a signal (RF5) in a region where the power level of the signal (RF1) is at least the 2 nd level; a hybrid coupler has transmission lines (1051, 1052), signals (RF4, RF5) are input to one terminals of the transmission lines (1051, 1052), the other terminal of the transmission line (1052) is opened, and an amplified signal of a signal (RF1) is output from the other terminal of the transmission line (1051).

title_en: Filter and forming method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a filter and a forming method thereof. The filter comprises a lower electrode layer, a middle interlayer and an upper electrode layer which are sequentially formed on a substrate, wherein the middle interlayer comprises a piezoelectric layer at least formed in a resonance area and a dielectric layer at least formed in a peripheral area, so that mechanical vibration appearing outside the resonance area can be relieved based on the dielectric layer, the mechanical loss of the edge of a resonance structure is improved, the parasitic electrical loss of the peripheral area can be effectively reduced, and the Q value of the filter is favorably improved.

title_en: High-speed 8/9 prescaler circuit, control method thereof and phase-locked loop comprising same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-speed 8/9 dual-mode prescaler, which comprises 10 TSPC latches L1-L10, 1 NAND gate (G2), 1 NOR gate (G3), a first NOT gate (G1) and a second NOT gate (G4); the method is characterized in that: TSPC latches L1, L3, L5, L7, and L9 are latches of a first type, and TSPC latches L2, L4, L6, L8, and L10 are latches of a second type. The high-speed 8/9 dual-mode prescaler provided by the invention has high working frequency and wide coverage frequency band.

title_en: A/D converter and electronic device
abstract_en: The A/D converter (10) according to the present invention is provided with a comparator circuit (21) which performs comparison with a threshold voltage (V  th ) to determine whether an excessive input of a pixel signal (S  VSL ) has been input, and a first transistor (TR 17) whose control terminal receives the comparison result and forms a clamp circuit, wherein the clamp circuit (TR 17) is turned on (or off) to equalize currents flowing through a first predetermined position (CP 1) and a second predetermined position (CP 2) which are connected to each other through the first transistor (TR 17) at the time of clamping, or to equalize voltages at the first predetermined position (CP 1) and the second predetermined position (CP 2), thereby enabling suppression of streaks when an excessive input is applied to the pixel signal line (TR 13, TR14, R1) side.

title_en: Power amplification module
abstract_en: The invention provides a power amplification module capable of inhibiting the length of a region occupied by a transistor array from increasing, and inhibiting parasitic resistance from a transistor to an impedance conversion circuit from increasing and parasitic inductance from varying. The semiconductor chip includes a plurality of transistor columns. First bumps connected to the collectors of the transistors are arranged corresponding to the plurality of transistor columns, and second bumps connected to the emitters are arranged. The transistor columns are arranged along the sides of the convex polygon. The first bonding pad and the second bonding pad arranged on the circuit board are respectively connected with the first bump and the second bump. The first impedance conversion circuit connects the first pad and the signal output terminal. The plurality of transistors of the transistor column are grouped into a plurality of groups, and the first impedance conversion circuit includes a reactance element configured for each group.

title_en: Data compression method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a data compression method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of segmenting original data through a breakpoint detection algorithm, fitting each segment of data according to a fitting algorithm, effectively realizing high-efficiency compression of the data, obtaining restored data through a decompression algorithm, solving the problems of huge scale and overlarge storage and transmission cost under the condition of data of a current mass data acquisition scene, and playing a role in promoting the further development of various data platforms digitally converted in a big data era. The original data is segmented through a breakpoint detection algorithm, the data of each segment is fitted according to a fitting algorithm, efficient compression of the data can be effectively achieved, and restored data is obtained through a decompression algorithm, so that the problems that the scale is too huge, and the storage and transmission costs are too large under the condition that mass data acquisition scene data are currently achieved are jointly solved, and a promotion effect is played for further development of various data platforms of digital transformation in a big data era.

title_en: 10MHZ crystal oscillator working at ultra-low phase noise
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 10MHZ crystal oscillator working at ultra-low phase noise, which comprises a differential amplifier, a parasitic resonance suppression filter, a voltage tuning phase shifter and a crystal resonator; the output port of the differential amplifier is connected with the input port of the parasitic resonance suppression filter, the output port of the parasitic resonance suppression filter is connected with the input port of the voltage tuning phase shifter, the output port of the voltage tuning phase shifter is connected with one end of the crystal resonator, and the other end of the crystal resonator is connected with the input port of the differential amplifier. The invention can ensure good symmetry, low noise and optimal noise matching; harmonic signals except for 10MHz are filtered through a parasitic resonance suppression filter, so that loss is reduced to the maximum extent; the voltage tuning phase shifter is utilized to accurately calculate the change of the phase noise, and the oscillation starting of the crystal oscillator with the ultra-low phase noise is realized.

title_en: Voltage controlled oscillator
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a voltage-controlled oscillator, which comprises at least two pairs of coils, wherein each pair of coils form an oscillator unit, each oscillator unit comprises at least two working modes, each working mode generates independent oscillation frequency in a preset frequency range, and the preset frequency ranges of the corresponding oscillation frequencies in different working modes are different. The voltage-controlled oscillator provided by the embodiment of the invention can generate an ultra-wideband signal source and reduce the occupied area.

title_en: Radio frequency amplifier with BYPASS path
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radio frequency amplifier with a BYPASS passage, which comprises a radio frequency amplifying passage and BYPASS passages connected in parallel at two ends of the radio frequency amplifying passage, wherein when the radio frequency amplifying passage works, the BYPASS passage is closed; when the radio frequency amplification channel is closed, the BYPASS channel is conducted; the radio frequency amplification path and the BYPASS path share the same input matching network. By implementing the scheme, the BYPASS function of the radio frequency amplifier can be realized without influencing the main technical index of the amplifier; meanwhile, the influence of the input and output matching networks of the amplifier on a BYPASS path is also reduced to the minimum, and the insertion loss of-3 to-8 dB and the return loss of about-10 dB can be realized according to the requirements in the BYPASS path, so that the application requirements of a radio frequency system are well met.

title_en: Power amplifier overheat protection circuit integrated by thermoelectric system
abstract_en: The patent discloses a power amplifier overheat protection circuit integrated by a thermoelectric system, and belongs to the field of microelectronics. The invention comprises a power tube temperature detection circuit, a local high-temperature trigger circuit, a self-recovery circuit, an RS trigger circuit and a PA bias control circuit which are integrated by taking a thermoelectric device as a basic unit. When the temperature of the PA is too high due to long-time high-power work, the power tube is switched off, and the PA stops working; when the temperature of the power tube in the PA area is reduced to normal temperature, the PA bias circuit supplies power normally, and the PA restores to a normal working state. The invention also utilizes the unique Seebeck effect and the Peltier effect of the thermoelectric system to respectively play roles of overheat protection and heat dissipation in addition to the overvoltage and overcurrent protection of the power tube, thereby reducing the risk of thermal breakdown of the power tube due to continuous working at a high temperature state, improving the reliability and safety of the PA, and the thermoelectric device can be integrated into a chip or made into a flexible film to be attached to the surface of the PA, realizing complete packaging and realizing chip-level high-temperature protection.

title_en: Data driving circuit
abstract_en: A data driving circuit may include a trigger circuit and a pre-driver. The trigger circuit may be configured to block remaining signal paths other than the signal path corresponding to the currently selected driving strength among the plurality of signal paths for transmitting data. The pre-driver may be configured to drive data transmitted through a signal path corresponding to a currently selected drive strength using impedances determined according to a plurality of impedance control codes.

title_en: Amplification device, radar device, and amplification method
abstract_en: An object is to provide an amplifying device, a radar device, and an amplifying method that suppress adverse effects on other circuit elements due to a failed amplifier. The solution is that the amplifying device is provided with a plurality of amplifying parts, a power supply main line (91), a plurality of power supply branch lines (92), and a protection part. The plurality of amplification units amplify the high-frequency signals, respectively. The power supply main line (91) is a power supply line common to the plurality of amplifying sections. A plurality of power supply branch lines (92) branch from a power supply main line (91) and are connected to the amplification unit, respectively. The protection unit is disposed for a power supply branch line (92) connected to the amplifier unit, and cuts off the power supply branch line (92) on the basis of a drive current flowing from the power supply branch line (92) to the amplifier unit.

title_en: Digital same or and exclusive OR gate implementation method based on ternary memristor cross array
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital same or different or gate implementation method based on a ternary memristor cross array. The invention adopts a ternary memristor cross array with a 4 multiplied by 3 structure, wherein two of the ternary memristor cross array are used as input memristors, and one is used as an output memristor. The three-value digital logic same or different or gate circuit based on the three-value memristor cross array is clear and simple in structure and easy to achieve. The cross array implementation of the exclusive-OR gate and the exclusive-OR gate has important significance on application research in multiple fields of multi-valued digital logic operation, storage integration and the like.

title_en: Voltage Controlled Oscillator and Phase Locked Loop Frequency Synthesizer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a voltage-controlled oscillator and a phase-locked loop frequency synthesizer. The first end of the ring oscillation module is connected with the power end, the second end of the ring oscillation module is respectively connected with the first end of the frequency adjustment module and the first end of the gain adjustment module, the second end of the frequency adjustment module and the second end of the gain adjustment module are commonly connected with the grounding end, the third end of the frequency adjustment module is connected with the control voltage, and the third end of the gain adjustment module is connected with the adjusting controller of the phase-locked loop frequency synthesizer. The frequency adjusting module adjusts the output frequency of the oscillating signal in a mode of not more than the first adjusting precision according to the control voltage, the gain adjusting module adjusts the output frequency of the oscillating signal and the gain of the voltage-controlled oscillator in a mode of not less than the second adjusting precision according to the reference clock control signal, gain deviation can be reduced, and phase noise generated by the bias circuit is eliminated.

title_en: Power amplifier circuit and electronic device
abstract_en: The invention provides a power amplifier circuit and electronic equipment, which comprise a power tube, a main bias unit and an auxiliary bias unit; the main bias unit is respectively connected to a power supply voltage end and a reference voltage end, and is also connected between the control end of the power tube and the first end of the power tube and used for providing a first bias voltage for the control end of the power tube and the first end of the power tube; the first end of the power tube is directly or indirectly connected with the power supply voltage end, and the second end of the power tube is grounded; the auxiliary bias unit is respectively connected with the power supply voltage end and the reference voltage end, and is also connected between the control end of the power tube and the first end of the power tube and used for providing a second bias voltage for the power tube when the current temperature of the auxiliary bias unit is less than the threshold temperature.

title_en: Radio transmitter with transmitted signal strength indicator and method therefor
abstract_en: A radio transmitter and a radio transmission method. The radio transmitter includes: a power amplifier configured to receive an input voltage signal and output an output voltage signal; a transformer configured to receive the output voltage signal and output a load voltage signal to a load; a sensing inductor configured to output a sensing current signal according to magnetic coupling with the transformer; a digitally controlled phase shifter configured to receive the output voltage signal and output a phase shifted voltage signal according to a phase control code; a mixer configured to output a mixed current signal according to a mixture of the sense current signal and the phase-shifted voltage signal; and a transimpedance amplifier having a low pass response configured to convert the mixed current signal to an average voltage signal.

title_en: Method, device and equipment for compensating power supply voltage of electric steering engine
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device and equipment for compensating power electricity supply voltage of an electric steering engine e Of the first modulation signal u ce (ii) a Collecting the voltage U of the power electricity; calculating to obtain a dynamic electricity voltage compensation coefficient K according to the collected voltage U of the power U (ii) a According to the first modulation signal U e And the dynamic voltage compensation coefficient K U Calculating to obtain a second modulation signal u of the dynamic electricity cp (ii) a The second modulation signal u cp Sending the signal to a driver to trigger the driver to modulate the second modulation signal u cp And carrying out logic conversion to obtain a power amplification signal, wherein the power amplification signal is used for driving an actuating mechanism to track a rudder control instruction. This application is through gathering electric steering wheel power electricity voltage, adjusts modulation signal in real time according to power electricity voltage's change, realizes differentAnd the performance reduction of the steering engine under the power voltage is compensated.

title_en: Improved novel proximity switch protection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an improved novel proximity switch protection device, which comprises: the damping assembly can absorb vibration when the proximity switch is vibrated to ensure the position stability of the proximity switch; proximity switch one end is run through and is installed on the box body, and a plurality of damping subassemblies support proximity switch free end, when proximity switch absorbs the vibration, the vibration is transmitted and is absorbed on a plurality of damping subassemblies, has guaranteed proximity switch's stable in position, has avoided proximity switch unsettled to appear, has solved the sensitivity of proximity switch response under the environment of vibration and has received the problem of influence.

title_en: Terahertz mixer and electronic component
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a terahertz frequency mixer and an electronic component, the terahertz frequency mixer including: the device comprises a metal cavity, a local oscillator input waveguide and a radio frequency input waveguide, wherein the metal cavity is formed with the radio frequency input waveguide and the local oscillator input waveguide; the microstrip line is accommodated in the metal cavity and extends into the metal cavity where the radio frequency input waveguide and the local oscillator input waveguide are located respectively to form an antenna for receiving the radio frequency signal and the local oscillator signal respectively, a metal grounding layer is arranged at the first end, far away from the radio frequency input waveguide, of the microstrip line, and a blocking structure for blocking the transmission of the radio frequency signal to the first end is arranged on at least the part, far away from the first end, of the metal grounding layer. According to the terahertz frequency mixer, the blocking structure is arranged on the metal grounding layer in the metal cavity to block the radio-frequency signal from being continuously transmitted to the first end (namely the grounding end), so that the influence of uncertain factors caused by conductive adhesive smearing or other welding materials on the characteristics of the terahertz frequency mixer is effectively reduced, and the reliability and consistency of the terahertz frequency mixer are improved.

title_en: Radio frequency switch circuit, radio frequency switch chip and wireless communication equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radio frequency switch circuit, a radio frequency switch chip and wireless communication equipment, wherein the radio frequency switch circuit comprises N switch sub-circuits, and each switch sub-circuit comprises a series switch unit and a parallel switch unit; the switch sub-circuit further comprises a first feedback unit and/or a second feedback unit. According to the invention, the series switch unit outputs the radio frequency signal, and the parallel switch unit blocks the inactive radio frequency signal to the ground, so that the isolation degree of the switch is increased; the harmonic part in the signal is filtered by the feedback unit, so that the second harmonic and the third harmonic generated by the switch are reduced, the linearity of the switch is effectively increased, and the aim of increasing the maximum output power of the switch is fulfilled. In addition, the sizes of the series switch unit and the parallel switch unit are greatly reduced, so that the production cost is reduced, and the method has wide practical application prospect.

title_en: Amplifier for cutting off leakage current and electronic device including the same
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an electronic device including an amplifier, the amplifier including: a first transistor configured to receive an input signal through a gate terminal thereof, and having a source terminal electrically connected to ground; a second transistor configured to transmit an output signal through a drain terminal thereof, and having a gate terminal electrically connected to ground; and a switch electrically connected to the gate terminal of the second transistor and configured to switch a voltage supplied to the gate terminal of the second transistor according to on or off of the amplifier.

title_en: Phase lock detection device, phase lock detection method, and phase lock loop
abstract_en: The invention provides a phase-locking detection device, a phase-locking detection method and a phase-locked loop, which comprise a reference pulse generation circuit, a feedback pulse generation circuit, a reset signal generation circuit, a pulse acquisition circuit and a phase-locking judgment circuit, wherein the reference clock is input into the reference pulse generation circuit to generate reference pulses, the reference pulses are input into the pulse acquisition circuit and the reset signal generation circuit, the feedback clock is input into the feedback pulse generation circuit, the feedback pulse generation circuit outputs feedback pulses, the feedback pulses are input into the pulse acquisition circuit, the pulse acquisition circuit takes the feedback pulses as clock end input, the reference pulses are taken as counting end input, and a phase-locking enabling signal is output to the phase-locking judgment circuit, and the phase-locking judgment circuit outputs a locking signal after the counting reaches a preset value. The scheme provides a detection device with simple precision and structure.

title_en: Beam atomic clock frequency locking device based on laser-induced fluorescence signal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a beam atomic clock frequency locking device based on laser-induced fluorescence signals. The device comprises: the power module is used for converting an external input power supply into a power supply voltage required by the internal module and separating digital ground from analog ground so as to distinguish the digital power supply from the analog power supply; the fluorescent signal conversion module is connected with the power supply module and used for converting fluorescent signals generated in the atomic beam tube into voltage signals comprising one path of direct-current voltage signals and at least one path of alternating-current voltage signals; the digital operation module is connected with the power supply module and the fluorescent signal conversion module and is used for generating a deviation correcting signal by the voltage signal; and the deviation correcting signal output module is connected with the power supply module and the digital operation module and is used for outputting a deviation correcting signal so as to control the output frequency of the voltage-controlled crystal oscillator. The invention can improve the signal-to-noise ratio of the locking device, and realize that the output frequency of the voltage-controlled crystal oscillator is locked at the atomic transition frequency with high signal-to-noise ratio, thereby improving the stability and accuracy of the output frequency of the crystal oscillator.

title_en: LDPC decoder, operating method of LDPC decoder and semiconductor memory system
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method of operating a Low Density Parity Check (LDPC) decoder, the method including designating each symbol of a codeword as a variable node value of each of a plurality of variable nodes, performing syndrome check on each of the check nodes based on a parity check matrix, calculating a roll-over function value of the variable nodes based on the syndrome values of the check nodes and a roll-over function, dividing the roll-over function values into a plurality of groups, determining a roll-over function threshold based on a group maximum value of the groups among the plurality of groups, and selectively roll-over the variable node values based on a comparison result of the roll-over function value of the corresponding variable node with the determined roll-over function threshold.

title_en: Electronic device comprising a level shifter
abstract_en: An electronic device is disclosed. The electronic device includes: an input node; an output node; a power node that transmits a voltage of a third level to the output node when the voltage of the input node is the first level; and a capacitor that transmits a change in the voltage of the input node to the output node through the coupling when the voltage of the input node changes from the first level to the second level such that the voltage of the output node is adjusted to a fourth level.

title_en: Detecting a fill state of a consumable dispenser
abstract_en: A sensor device arranged to detect a filling state of a consumable in the dispenser, the consumable being a web, the filling state being related to a spatial extension of the consumable in the dispenser, the sensor device comprising a capacitive sensor comprising an elongated planar sensor area; and a first measuring section configured to measure a filling state of the dispenser; wherein the capacitive sensor comprises a first channel and a second channel; wherein the first measuring section is configured to measure the filling state of the dispenser based on the capacitance changes detected by the first channel and the second channel.

title_en: Operational amplifier
abstract_en: An operational amplifier comprises a first output transistor and a second output transistor connected in series between two power supply nodes, the second output transistor having a semiconductor type opposite to that of the first output transistor, the first output transistor and the second output transistor being electrically coupled to an output node, and a gate of the first output transistor and a gate of the second output transistor being connected to a first driving node and a second driving node, respectively; and the decoupling capacitor circuit is electrically connected between the first driving node and the second driving node.
