title_en: Pulse signal transmitting circuit
abstract_en: The invention provides a pulse signal transmitting circuit capable of transmitting pulse signals without changing pulse width and duty ratio without causing a large increase in circuit scale and chip size. The pulse signal transmission circuit includes an output transistor (M0) having a drain terminal connected to an output terminal, and an inverter circuit (12) provided in a preceding stage of the output transistor and generating a signal to be input to a gate terminal of the output transistor, wherein the pulse signal transmission circuit outputs a pulse signal from the output terminal, and a delay circuit (13) for delaying one of a fall and a rise of the input pulse signal is provided with the pulse signal as an input, and the pulse signal delayed by the delay circuit is input to the inverter circuit.

title_en: Pipelined analog-to-digital conversion circuit
abstract_en: The application provides a pipeline analog-to-digital conversion circuit, and relates to the field of pipeline circuits. Comprising the following steps: an N-stage analog-to-digital converter, N-1 allowance amplifiers and N-1 digital filters, wherein N is an integer greater than or equal to 2; the output end of the residual quantity amplifier is electrically connected with the analog input end of the (i+1) -th stage analog-to-digital converter, and i is any positive integer smaller than N; the first-stage analog-to-digital converter is an analog-to-digital converter with a noise shaping function, and the digital output end of each stage of analog-to-digital converter behind the first-stage analog-to-digital converter is electrically connected with a digital filter respectively. Compared with the prior art, the feedforward technology is adopted, all nonideal shaping of all amplifiers can be realized, and the problems of overlarge circuit hardware and time expenditure in the prior art are avoided.

title_en: Load driving device and engine system
abstract_en: The invention provides a load driving device, which can diagnose the fault of an output terminal before the charging voltage is stable in a structure that the output terminal of the load driving device for driving inductive load is connected with a capacitor. In the load driving device of the present invention, a capacitor is connected between a load terminal and a ground terminal, and the presence or absence of a failure at the load terminal is diagnosed based on a current flowing between an internal power supply of a diagnostic circuit and the load terminal.

title_en: Neural network activation compression with exception block floating point
abstract_en: Apparatus and methods are disclosed for training a neural network accelerator using a quantized precision data format having outliers, and in particular, for storing activation values from a neural network in a compressed format for use during forward and backward propagation training of the neural network. In some examples of the disclosed technology, a computing system is configured to perform forward propagation for a layer of a neural network to generate a first activation value in a first block floating point format. In some examples, the activation value generated by the forward propagation is converted by the compressor to a second block floating point format having a narrower numerical precision than the first block floating point format. The outlier comprising additional bits of mantissa and/or exponent is stored in the auxiliary storage for the subset of activation values. The compressed activation value is stored in memory, where it can be retrieved for use during back propagation.

title_en: Pulse width modulation amplifier, related chip and signal width modulation method
abstract_en: The application discloses a pulse width modulation amplifier, a related chip and a signal width modulation method. The pulse width modulation amplifier converts a digital input signal into an analog input signal, subtracts a feedback signal from the analog input signal to generate an analog error signal, converts the analog error signal into a digital error signal, filters the digital error signal, and performs a down-sampling operation on the digital error signal to generate an error reference signal. The pulse width modulation amplifier adds the digital input signal and the error reference signal to generate an input correction signal, compares the input correction signal and the inverted input correction signal with the triangular wave signal to generate a first modulation signal and a second modulation signal, increases the driving capability of the first modulation signal and the second modulation signal to generate a first modulation output signal and a second modulation output signal, and uses the difference value of the first modulation output signal and the second modulation signal as the pulse width modulation signal.

title_en: High-speed LVDS interface circuit and chip
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-speed LVDS interface circuit and a chip, and belongs to the technical field of analog integrated circuits. The interface circuit in the chip comprises a first charge pump circuit, a second charge pump circuit, a four-phase switch circuit and a common mode feedback circuit, and in addition, the chip also adopts a compensation structure. The circuit adopts a common mode feedback circuit to stably output common mode voltage, a charge pump circuit charges and discharges at the jump edge of a clock signal to reduce the rising/falling time of a mountain, and the performance of a high-speed interface circuit is improved through a high-frequency compensation circuit.

title_en: Construction of local repair code based on hypercube and fault code element repair method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of computers, and discloses a hypercube-based local repair code construction and fault code element repair method. The method utilizes the path distance function on the hypercube to meet specific association construction Is a matrix of (a) in the matrix. The row vector of the correlation matrix is marked by the point with the path distance function of 1, the column vector is marked by the point with the path distance function of 2, finally, the row vector and the column vector are correlated to obtain the correlation matrix, and then the correlation matrix is combined with the identity matrix to obtain the required check matrix. Using this method, (n, k, r, t=2) LRCs are constructed, two repair options can be provided in the event of a single symbol failure, and the constructed code is optimal in terms of both minimum distance and code rate.

title_en: Digital predistortion for multiple antenna systems
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to digital predistortion for multiple antenna systems. Certain aspects of the present disclosure relate to methods and apparatus for power amplifier control. A power amplifier network includes a first path including a first power amplifier. The power amplifier network further includes a second path including a second power amplifier. The power amplifier network further comprises a common input path to both the first path and the second path. The power amplifier network further includes a first power control network for controlling a first signal applied to the first power amplifier. The power amplifier network further comprises a second power control network for controlling a second signal applied to a second power amplifier, wherein the first power control network is different from the second power control network.

title_en: Ring configuration circuit, method of operating a circuit and phase locked loop
abstract_en: The invention discloses a circuit with annular configuration, a method for operating the circuit and a phase-locked loop. According to an embodiment, a ring oscillator includes a plurality of stages coupled in a ring configuration, wherein each stage of the plurality of stages has an input node coupled to an output node of a previous stage of the plurality of stages. Each of the plurality of stages includes a ring oscillator transistor having a control node coupled to an input node and a load path coupled to an output node, and a direct injection circuit having a load path coupled between the control node of the ring oscillator transistor and the output node and a control node coupled to a first oscillator input node, and a tail injection circuit having a load path coupled between the output node and a first power supply node and a control node coupled to a second oscillator input node.

title_en: Percentile-based statistical data compression method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a statistical data compression method and a system based on percentile, comprising the following steps: step 1: judging the upper limit value of the number of the statistical units to obtain a total statistical unit; step 2: screening out statistical units meeting preset conditions from the total statistical units according to a preset sampling rate; and step 3: calculating the index percentile threshold value of the screened statistical units meeting the preset conditions; and 4, step 4: and filtering the statistical units according to the index percentage threshold, filtering, removing all statistical units with index values less than or equal to the index percentage threshold, and aggregating the filtered statistical units to a dimension lower than the statistical units. The invention improves the processing efficiency and prolongs the effective long-term storage time of the data.

title_en: Capacitive coupling output buffer circuit of voltage-controlled oscillator and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a capacitive coupling output buffer circuit of a voltage-controlled oscillator and a control method thereof.A voltage-controlled oscillator, a first capacitor, a first phase inverter and a second phase inverter are sequentially arranged between an input end and an output end; the first inverter includes: the first P-channel MOS transistor and the first N-channel MOS transistor are connected between a power supply end and a ground end in series, an MOS transistor group is connected between the first P-channel MOS transistor and the first N-channel MOS transistor in a crossing mode, and the grid electrode of the MOS transistor group is connected with an EN signal end and an ENN signal end; the third N-channel MOS transistor is characterized by further comprising a third N-channel MOS transistor, wherein the grid electrode of the third N-channel MOS transistor is connected with the ENN signal end, the source electrode of the third N-channel MOS transistor is grounded, and the drain electrode of the third N-channel MOS transistor is connected with the grid electrode of the first N-channel MOS transistor. The output buffer circuit in the enable-close mode can realize zero power consumption.

title_en: Programmable gain amplifier and programmable gain amplifying circuit
abstract_en: The application relates to a programmable gain amplifier and a programmable gain amplifying circuit, which comprise a transconductance amplifier, an operational amplifier, a resistor R1 and a resistor R2; the first input end and the second input end of the transconductance amplifier are used for receiving input voltage, the first output end of the transconductance amplifier is connected with the third input end of the operational amplifier, and the second output end of the transconductance amplifier is connected with the fourth input end of the operational amplifier; the third output end and the fourth output end of the operational amplifier are used for outputting voltage; one end of the resistor R1 is connected with the third input end of the operational amplifier, and the other end of the resistor R1 is connected with the third output end of the operational amplifier; one end of the resistor R2 is connected with the fourth input end of the operational amplifier, and the other end of the resistor R2 is connected with the fourth output end of the operational amplifier; the resistance value of the resistor R1 is equal to that of the resistor R2; the transconductance amplifier is used for adjusting the gain of the amplifier, and the operational amplifier is used for improving the linearity of the amplifier.

title_en: Level shifter device and method for converting signal voltage
abstract_en: A level shifter apparatus and a method for converting a signal voltage are disclosed. The level shifter apparatus includes a first stage level shifter configured to convert an input signal into a first output signal having a voltage between a VPS control voltage and ground, or between a VDD supply voltage and a VNS control voltage. The level shifter apparatus includes a second stage level shifter arranged after the first stage level shifter and configured to convert the first output signal into a second output signal having a voltage between ground and a VDD supply voltage.

title_en: SET detection circuit, method and chip
abstract_en: The invention discloses a SET detection circuit, a SET detection method and a SET detection chip.A locking detection module input end is respectively connected with clk0 and clk360, and a locking detection module output end is connected with lock_l0; the input ends of the inverter and the transmission gate of the differential clock judgment circuit are respectively connected with two differential signals, the two differential signals are a pair of complementary differential signals, the output ends of the inverter and the transmission gate are connected with the input end of the exclusive-OR gate, and the output end of the exclusive-OR gate is connected with the d port of the trigger; the ck port of the trigger is connected with clk0; the rstb port of the trigger is connected with the output end of the locking detection module; the q port of the trigger is connected with the first input end of the NAND gate, the second input end of the NAND gate is connected with tie_high, and the output end of the NAND gate is connected with lock_l1. The lock detection function in the normal circuit is reserved, and two special SET responses in the voltage-controlled delay line can be detected.

title_en: Configuration of programmable logic areas via a programmable network
abstract_en: Examples described herein provide an Integrated Circuit (IC) having a programmable logic region that is configurable via a programmable network. In one example, the integrated circuit includes a programmable logic region, a controller, and a programmable network. The programmable network is connected between the controller and the programmable logic region. The controller is programmed to configure the programmable logic region via the programmable network. In some examples, the programmable logic region may be configured faster, among other benefits.

title_en: Output driving circuit and memory
abstract_en: The invention provides an output driving circuit and a memory. The output drive circuit includes: a signal input end for inputting a complementary positive input signal and a negative input signal; the pull-up output unit is connected with the signal input end, and a positive input signal is used as an input signal of the pull-up output unit; the pull-down output unit is connected with the signal input end, and the negative input signal is used as an input signal of the pull-down output unit; at least one compensation unit connected in parallel with the pull-up output unit or the pull-down output unit; at least one pulse signal generating circuit, the input end of which is connected with the signal input end and generates a pulse signal according to the positive input signal or the negative input signal, wherein the pulse signal is used as a control signal of the compensating unit; and the signal output end is respectively connected with the output end of the pull-up output unit, the output end of the pull-down output unit and the output end of the compensation unit and outputs an output signal. The output driving circuit can improve the output signal conversion rate of the output end, thereby improving the performance of the memory.

title_en: Composite body type coding method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite body type coding method, belonging to the technical field of composite body type coding; the composite body type coding is simple and easy to remember, and the body type characteristics can be judged more directly from the coding literal; the garment manufacturer can determine the body type feature code (XYm) which is more suitable for the garment by professional analysis according to the outline design of the garment, so that the body type feature code (XYm) can be recommended to consumers very conveniently, the number of times of trying on by the consumers can be greatly reduced, the sale efficiency is improved, and the sale cost is reduced; if relevant body shape feature code (XYm) matching information is provided when the E-commerce sells clothes, a customer can conveniently select and purchase on the internet, and the order rate and the customer experience are improved.

title_en: Spinning nanooscillator
abstract_en: The invention provides a spinning nano oscillator, which sequentially comprises: the magnetic resonance detector comprises a strong spin orbit coupling layer, a first free layer, a first barrier layer of the detector and a reference layer of the detector, wherein spin orbit torque current is input through the strong spin orbit coupling layer, under the assistance of interface interaction between the strong spin orbit coupling layer and the first free layer, the magnetic moment of the first free layer is induced to precess, the periodic oscillation of a magnetic domain wall is triggered, the detector detects the change of the magnetic moment and outputs periodic signals through the detector, the read-write path is separated, and breakdown is prevented.

title_en: Phase correction device and method, distance measuring device, and phase fluctuation detecting device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a phase correction device, a distance measuring device, a phase fluctuation detection device and a phase correction method. The phase correction device includes: a local oscillator having an all-digital phase synchronization circuit for generating a local oscillation signal based on a reference clock, and a device for applying the local oscillation signal to a phase of an input signal to be detected; a1 st phase detector included in the all-digital phase synchronization circuit, for detecting and outputting a phase of the local oscillation signal; a reference phase generator configured to generate and output a quasi-reference phase corresponding to a reference phase of the local oscillation signal at the initial setting of the local oscillation signal based on the reference clock; a2 nd phase detector configured to detect a variation in the phase of the local oscillation signal based on the phase detected by the 1 st phase detector and the quasi-reference phase; and a correction circuit for correcting the phase of the input signal using the detection result of the 2 nd phase detector.

title_en: Circuit microwave signal stable gain device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of signal processing, in particular to a circuit microwave signal stable gain device, which comprises an upstream device and a downstream device for signal processing, wherein the upstream device and the downstream device are connected in series; the microwave signal guiding device is characterized in that a signal input module used for receiving an external signal is arranged in the upstream device, a power adjusting module used for adjusting signal power is embedded in the input module, a double-path conduction module used for signal shunting is arranged in the downstream device, high-power paths and low-power paths which are arranged at intervals are arranged in the double-path conduction module, the high-power paths and the low-power paths jointly act on microwave signal guiding, and the double-path conduction module is arranged, so that the classification guiding processing of the signals can be efficiently guaranteed.

title_en: Frequency output circuit and beauty instrument with power management chip
abstract_en: The invention discloses a frequency output circuit and a beauty instrument with a power management chip, wherein the power end of the power management chip is connected with the power input end, the power management chip is integrated with a charging module and a power management module connected with the charging module, and the frequency output circuit comprises a radio frequency module, an ultrasonic module and a PWM output module; the input ends of the radio frequency module, the ultrasonic module and the PWM output module are all connected to the power management module; the radio frequency module is used for processing the power supply output by the power supply management module so as to output a radio frequency signal; the ultrasonic module is used for processing the power supply output by the power supply management module so as to output an ultrasonic signal; and the PWM output module is used for processing the power supply output by the power supply management module so as to output an adjustable PWM signal. According to the technical scheme, the size of the PCB is reduced through the integrated design, and the development difficulty of the power supply is reduced.

title_en: Power amplifier, power amplifying circuit, and power amplifying apparatus
abstract_en: Provided are a power amplifier, a power amplifying circuit, and a power amplifying device, which suppress the fluctuation of reactive current. A power amplifier (100) is provided with a transistor (101), a transistor (102), a transistor (103), and a bump formed on a semiconductor substrate (303), wherein the bump is electrically connected to an emitter of the transistor (101) and is provided so as to overlap an arrangement region (A1) in which the transistor (101) is arranged, an arrangement region (A2) in which the transistor (102) is arranged, and an arrangement region (A3) in which the transistor (103) is arranged, in a plan view of the semiconductor substrate (303).

title_en: Small signal processing method for power amplifier control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small signal processing method for power amplifier control, which is characterized in that by carrying out Hample filtering and autocorrelation operation on an analog sine wave small signal with smaller amplitude and lower signal-to-noise ratio and carrying out Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) frequency measurement on the result of the autocorrelation operation, the signal-to-noise ratio of the sine wave is effectively improved by comparing an ideal digital sine wave with a triangular wave generated by a built-in ROM, signal burrs are eliminated, and the problem of PWM wave output jump caused by abnormal fluctuation of the amplitude of the signal due to environmental noise and ADC quantization error when the analog sine wave small signal is input is solved, thereby ensuring stable output of PWM signals, leading the control signal of a power amplifier to be more stable and better in performance.

title_en: High speed DC offset pre-driver with low ISI
abstract_en: A DC offset pre-driver has an input port configured for coupling to a serial data stream, an inverting output amplifier having a feedback node and an output port, and a capacitor AC coupled between the input port and the feedback node, wherein the output port is configured for coupling to a transistor at an input of a high speed DAC or TX driver. A weak feedback inverter having a structure similar to the inverting output amplifier but with a lower driving strength than the inverting output amplifier is coupled between the output port and the feedback node to act as a positive feedback latch. For data rates from 10GS/s to 28GS/s or higher, the pre-driver provides a DC offset of up to 3V with high reliability and minimal inter-symbol interference. The pre-driver may provide a plurality of input ports implemented as a pre-driver array in an M-bit system, and the output amplifier may be composed of N stages.

title_en: Semiconductor device, character recognition device, and character recognition method
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a semiconductor device, a character recognition device, and a character recognition method. The semiconductor device includes: a sensor that detects a capacitance of a touch key group including a plurality of touch keys arranged in a matrix; and a control device configured to perform character recognition based on a change in capacitance of the plurality of touch keys detected by the sensor and a sampling pattern, the sampling pattern being time-series data of the trajectory.

title_en: Variable gain amplifier and phased array system
abstract_en: A variable gain amplifier and a phased array receiver, wherein the gain amplifier (30,40) comprises: a Cascode circuit (31,41) for outputting an adjustable current to an output matching network (33,43), wherein the Cascode circuit (31,41) is a Cascode circuit, or a common emitter common base circuit; and a variable capacitance circuit (32,42) coupled to the first node with a Cascode circuit (31,41) and the output matching network (33,43), respectively, for adjusting a parasitic capacitance of the Cascode circuit (31,41) relative to the output matching network (33,43). When VGA (30,40) is switched in gain, the capacitance value of the variable capacitance circuit is adjusted to compensate the parasitic capacitance change caused by the Cascode circuit (31,41) relative to the first node during gain switching, so that the parasitic capacitance seen from the first node is approximately kept constant before and after gain switching, and correspondingly, the matching of the final output of VGA (30,40) is also kept consistent. In this way, when the VGA (30,40) switches the gain, the uniformity of the gain step and the phase can be maintained in a wide frequency band.

title_en: Self-adaptive high-reliability HBT linear power amplifier
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-adaptive high-reliability HBT linear power amplifier, wherein a power detection and control unit and an analog power switch unit are added on a basic HBT linear power amplifier unit. The power detection and control unit monitors the signal power intensity of the input HBT linear power amplifier, and when abnormal high-power signals are input into the HBT linear power amplifier, the analog power supply is turned off through the analog power supply switch unit to ensure that the HBT linear power amplifier is always in a safe state. By detecting the signal power input into the power amplifier in real time, the self-adaption of the HBT linear power amplifier under different working states is realized, and the defects of efficiency reduction, linearity degradation, difficult matching and the like caused by the protection of the HBT linear power amplifier by the analog power supply series current limiting resistor are overcome. The high robustness of the HBT linear power amplifier is realized on the basis of not obviously sacrificing the linearity and the efficiency of the HBT linear power amplifier.

title_en: Energy consumption data predictive coding compression acquisition method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for predicting, encoding, compressing and acquiring energy consumption data, wherein the system is used for implementing the method and comprises the following steps: acquiring energy consumption data of electric equipment; storing the acquired energy consumption data into a fixed-length memory queue; and starting a thread reading queue according to the forwarding frequency regularly, and performing prediction compression transmission on the energy consumption data in a self-adaptive manner according to a preset frame structure. The distributed energy consumption data acquisition based on predictive coding, adaptive chunk and adaptive precision control is realized, the real-time energy consumption data acquisition of a data center machine room is effectively realized, and data support is provided for monitoring and evaluating the energy consumption of the data center and realizing the high-efficiency energy consumption management.

title_en: Electronic component and method for manufacturing the same
abstract_en: In the electronic component, an insulating surrounding part is brought into close contact with the periphery of the electronic component, and the first surface of the electronic component is exposed from the second surface of the surrounding part. The wiring substrate is opposed to a third surface constituted by the first surface and the second surface. An insulating bonding member is interposed between the third surface and the wiring substrate to bond the two. The conductive bump is located between the third surface and the wiring substrate, and electrically connects the electronic element and the wiring substrate. The first through hole of the bonding member overlaps the vibration region in the first surface in a perspective plan view. The second through hole of the engagement member receives the projection. At least one part of at least one of the first through hole and the second through hole is overlapped with the second surface when viewed in a perspective mode in a top view.

title_en: Filtering algorithm applied to carbon dioxide sensor
abstract_en: The invention provides a filtering algorithm applied to a carbon dioxide sensor, which comprises the following steps of filtering in a single sampling period, wherein the filtering process in the single sampling period comprises reference sampling and peak value sampling; the filtering is carried out in a plurality of continuous sampling periods, the filtering process in the plurality of continuous sampling periods comprises rapid approach filtering or successive approximation filtering, the problem that when a B-type carbon dioxide sensor adopts a B-type electric thermopile, a built-in amplifier is not arranged, the noise generated by the amplifier is large, and the sensitivity, namely the precision, of the B-type carbon dioxide sensor is low is solved, and the sensitivity and the precision of the B-type carbon dioxide sensor are effectively improved.

title_en: Bridge suspension cable stress monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stress monitoring system for a bridge stay cable, which effectively solves the problem that the accuracy of a damaged signal is influenced by a filtering mode set by an ultrasonic detection method in the prior art, so that the judgment of a worker on the stress of the stay cable is influenced.

title_en: Pulse signal level calculating method and circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a calculation method and a calculation circuit of pulse signal level. According to the invention, the state of a clock signal is detected when the level of the pulse signal changes, then, the clock signal is controlled to delay for triggering at different times according to the detected state of the clock signal in the next period of the pulse signal, and from the triggering time of the clock signal, the clock signal of the pulse signal in the first level and the current period is respectively counted to obtain a first count value and a second count value, and the duty ratio of the pulse signal is obtained according to the first count value and the second count value. The first count value, the second count value and the duty ratio obtained in the way are the same in each period of the pulse signal, so that counting errors can be effectively eliminated, the duty ratio precision is improved, and screen flicker is eliminated.

title_en: Elastic wave device
abstract_en: An elastic wave device capable of effectively suppressing higher-order modes. An elastic wave device (1) is provided with a support substrate (4) as a silicon substrate, a silicon nitride film (5) provided on the support substrate (4), a silicon oxide film (6) provided on the silicon nitride film (5), a piezoelectric layer (7) provided on the silicon oxide film (6) and using Y-cut X-propagated lithium tantalate, and an IDT electrode (3) provided on the piezoelectric layer (7) and having a plurality of electrode fingers. When λ is a wavelength defined by the electrode finger pitch of the IDT electrode (3), the film thickness of the piezoelectric layer (7) is 1 λ or less, the Euler angle of the piezoelectric layer (7) is (in the range of 0 + -5 °, θ, in the range of 0 + -5 °), or (in the range of 0 + -5 °, θ, in the range of 180 + -5 °), θ in the Euler angle of the piezoelectric layer (7) is 95.5 ° < θ < 117.5 ° or-84.5 ° < θ < 62.5 ° which are equivalent to each other, and the relationship between θ in the Euler angle of the piezoelectric layer (7) and the film thickness of the silicon nitride film (5) is a combination shown in Table 1 or Table 2.

title_en: Delta-sigma modulator device and delta-sigma modulation method
abstract_en: The delta-sigma modulator device includes a sampling circuit, a digital-to-analog converter circuit, an integrator circuit, and an analog-to-digital converter circuit. The sampling circuit is used for sampling an input signal to generate a first signal. The digital-to-analog converter circuit is used for converting a first digital signal into a combination of a first reference voltage and a common mode voltage to generate a second signal, wherein the first reference voltage is one of a positive reference voltage and a negative reference voltage. The integrator circuit is used for performing an integration operation according to the first signal and the second signal to generate a third signal. The analog-to-digital converter circuit is used for quantizing the third signal into an output signal and generating a first digital signal according to the output signal.

title_en: Controlled switch switching circuit and switching device
abstract_en: The invention provides a controlled switch switching circuit and a switching device; the circuit comprises: the first enabling signal receiving end is used for receiving a first enabling signal of the negative pressure module; the control output end is used for being connected with a controlled end of a controlled switch in the negative pressure module; the second control assembly is configured to: outputting a first voltage when the first enable signal is enabled and outputting a second voltage when the first enable signal is disabled, the first voltage being a ground voltage, the second voltage being to be gradually increased from a negative voltage value to the ground voltage; the difference value between the negative pressure value and the output voltage of the negative pressure module is smaller than a preset threshold value; the first control assembly is configured to: when the first enable signal is enabled, a first control signal is output to control the controlled switch to be switched off, and when the first enable signal is disabled, a second control signal is output to control the controlled switch to be switched on.

title_en: Time-interleaved analog-to-digital converter
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to time-interleaved analog-to-digital converters. The invention discloses a time-staggered analog-digital converter which is used for converting an input signal into a digital output signal and comprises N analog-digital converters, a clock generation circuit and a control circuit. The N analog-digital converters receive the input signals and sample the input signals according to N sampling clocks to respectively generate digital output codes, wherein N is an integer greater than or equal to 2. The clock generation circuit is coupled to the N analog-to-digital converters, and is used for receiving the working clock and a set of control values and generating the N sampling clocks according to the set of control values and the working clock. The control circuit is coupled to the N analog-to-digital converters and the clock generation circuit, and is used for periodically generating the set of control values based on the pseudo random number and alternately outputting the digital output codes as the digital output signals.

title_en: Data weighted average algorithm and digital-to-analog conversion circuit
abstract_en: The invention provides a data weighted average algorithm and a digital-to-analog conversion circuit, wherein the algorithm comprises the following steps: defining an initial index PA of an odd period and an initial index PB of an even period; if the current period is an odd number period, starting from the position of the initial index PA, according to the input signal number S of the digital-to-analog converter  in  Selecting the number of corresponding elements, and calculating the index moving step number S  step  ＝M‑S  in  The new index of the next odd period is obtained as PA' =pa-S  step  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the If the period is even, the index moving step number S is calculated from the position of the initial index PB  step  ＝M‑S  in  A new index PB' =pb-S for the next even period is obtained  step  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the M is the number of elements in the digital-to-analog converter, and the initial index PA of the odd cycle and the initial index PB of the even cycle are shifted in opposite directions. The invention can eliminate the mismatch error of the passive device, reduce the switching rate of the element, and reduce the intersymbol interference effect while improving the linearity.

title_en: Intelligent switch circuit, system, circuit and chip applying intelligent switch system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent switching circuit, an intelligent switching system, a circuit applying the intelligent switching system and a chip, and belongs to the field of radio frequency identification devices. The intelligent switching circuit includes: the RFID tag comprises an RFID tag module, a self-holding relay device and an on-off element; the RFID tag module is connected with the self-holding relay device, and the self-holding relay device is connected with the on-off element; the RFID tag module is activated when communicating with a reader-writer, and outputs electric energy to the self-holding relay device; and the self-holding relay device controls the on-off element to switch the on-off state under the action of electric energy. The intelligent switch circuit is activated when communicating with the reader-writer, and outputs electric energy to drive the self-holding relay device to control the on-off element to switch the on-off state, so that the switch function is realized, and the defects that the existing intelligent switch needs the communication function to be in the on state and the power consumption is high are overcome.

title_en: Passive high-power TR switch and TR assembly
abstract_en: The invention discloses a passive high-power TR switch and a TR component, wherein the TR switch comprises a transmitting signal port, the transmitting signal port is connected with a first high-frequency plate, the first high-frequency plate is connected with a second high-frequency plate through at least one pair of diodes which are reversely connected in parallel, the second high-frequency plate is connected with a third high-frequency plate through a first inductor, and the third high-frequency plate is connected with a public port; the second high-frequency plate is connected with a fourth high-frequency plate through a capacitor, and the fourth high-frequency plate is connected with a fifth high-frequency plate through at least one pair of diodes which are connected in reverse parallel; the third high-frequency plate is connected with a sixth high-frequency plate through a capacitor, and the sixth high-frequency plate is connected with a seventh high-frequency plate through at least one pair of diodes which are connected in parallel in an opposite direction; the turn-off, turn-on and rectification characteristics of the switch diode are utilized to realize turn-on under a large signal and turn-off under a small signal, and the transmitting and receiving signals are isolated by adopting the characteristics of the filter, so that the passive high-power TR switch characteristic is realized.

title_en: Universal dynamic delay jitter elimination method, device, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a universal dynamic delay jitter elimination method, a universal dynamic delay jitter elimination device, a universal dynamic delay jitter elimination terminal and a universal dynamic delay jitter elimination storage medium, wherein whether the operation is false operation is detected; when the false operation is detected, recording the number of false operations; and adjusting the jitter elimination delay time of the next operation according to the recorded false operation times, and performing jitter elimination processing based on the adjusted jitter elimination delay time during the next operation. The method can adjust the jitter elimination delay time according to the number of false operations, so that the jitter elimination delay time is more reasonable, the judgment for multiple times is avoided, and the judgment accuracy is ensured; meanwhile, one shake elimination module can be used to adapt to different application scenes, and the workload of developers is reduced.

title_en: Touch sensing device and electronic device with improved touch sensing discrimination
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a touch sensing apparatus and an electronic device with improved touch sensing discrimination, the touch sensing apparatus including: a first touch sensing unit including a first sensing electrode and a first sensing inductor electrically connected to each other, wherein a capacitance of the first touch sensing unit varies according to a parasitic capacitance formed between the first sensing electrode and an external object based on a contact of the external object; a first force sensing unit including a first sensing coil spaced apart from an inner side surface of a frame, wherein an inductance of the first force sensing unit varies according to a variation in a distance between the first sensing coil and the frame based on a pressing touch; and a circuit unit configured to detect whether a touch of the external object is input based on a change in the capacitance of the first touch sensing unit and a change in the inductance of the first force sensing unit.

title_en: Surface acoustic wave device with composite film layer
abstract_en: The application discloses a surface acoustic wave device with a composite film layer, which relates to the field of surface acoustic wave devices. By adopting an etching process to carry out patterning treatment at any interface in the composite film layer to form a groove structure, high-order clutter response can be effectively scattered, and high-order clutter of different frequency bands can be reduced or even eliminated by adjusting the depth and radial size of the pattern, so that the stop band suppression capability is improved.

title_en: Voltage-controlled oscillator based on unipolar transistor and analog-digital converter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a voltage-controlled oscillator and an analog-to-digital converter based on a unipolar transistor, wherein the voltage-controlled oscillator comprises: a ring oscillator; the delay unit comprises a first transistor, a second transistor and a first capacitor; the drain electrode of the first transistor is connected with a power supply voltage VDD, the source electrode of the first transistor is connected with the drain electrode of the second transistor, the source electrode of the second transistor is grounded, and the drain electrode of the second transistor is grounded through a first capacitor; the drain electrode of the second transistor is connected to the input end of the ring oscillator, the output end of the ring oscillator is connected to the grid electrode of the first transistor, and the grid electrode of the second transistor is connected with the control voltage Vctrl; the first transistor works in a saturation region, and the second transistor works in a deep triode region; the delay of the delay unit is much larger than that of the ring oscillator. The invention provides a scheme for designing a voltage-controlled oscillator by only using an n-tube or a p-tube, meets the requirements on special processes, and can be widely applied to the field of semiconductor integrated circuits.

title_en: Non-contact control method and device for keys
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a device for controlling a key in a non-contact manner. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of emitting a plurality of laser beams, wherein the laser beams form a first laser plane and a second laser plane which are parallel to each other, monitoring the first laser plane, obtaining a first light spot coordinate of a first reflection light spot when the first reflection light spot appears on the first laser plane, monitoring the second laser plane, obtaining a second light spot coordinate of a second reflection light spot when the second reflection light spot appears on the second laser plane, calculating a click coordinate by adopting the first light spot coordinate and the second light spot coordinate, determining key information by adopting the click coordinate, and controlling a key corresponding to the key information.

title_en: Impedance correction circuit
abstract_en: The invention provides an impedance correction circuit, which comprises a first correction circuit, a second correction circuit, a switch circuit and a control circuit. The first correction circuit is suitable for being coupled with an external resistor through a connecting pad and generating a first voltage. The second correction circuit generates a second voltage and a third voltage. The switch circuit is coupled to the first and second calibration circuits, and selectively provides the first, second and third voltages to the first and second nodes. The control circuit is coupled to the first and second nodes, and generates first, second and third control signals according to voltages of the first and second nodes. The switch circuit provides a first voltage to the first and second nodes during a first time interval. In a second time interval, the switch circuit provides a second voltage to the first and second nodes, or provides a second and third voltages to the first and second nodes, respectively.

title_en: Acoustic resonator device
abstract_en: The method of manufacturing a bulk acoustic wave resonator structure for a fluidic device may include a first step of disposing a first conductive material on a portion of a first surface of a substrate to form at least a portion of a first electrode, then a piezoelectric material may be disposed over the first electrode, then a second conductive material may be disposed over the piezoelectric material to form at least a portion of a second electrode, then an acoustic energy management structure is disposed over a first side of the bulk acoustic wave resonator, then a third conductive material is disposed over a portion of the second conductive material that extends beyond the bulk acoustic wave resonator, and finally a portion of the second surface of the substrate is removed to expose a chemical mechanical connection at the first electrode at a second side of the bulk acoustic wave resonator.

title_en: Method for improving out-of-band rejection of bulk acoustic wave filter and filter structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for improving out-of-band rejection of a bulk acoustic wave filter and a filter structure, wherein the method for improving out-of-band rejection comprises the following steps: step 1, arranging a sound velocity buffer layer on a substrate, and arranging a piezoelectric layer on the sound velocity buffer layer; step 2, arranging M interdigital transducers on the piezoelectric layer, wherein M is an odd number larger than 3; in the M interdigital transducers, the width of each interdigital transducer is the same as the width of a gap between the interdigital transducers, the number of the interdigital array of each interdigital transducer is singular, and the number of the interdigital array of each interdigital transducer is M-2; and 3, adjusting the front and back positions of the M interdigital transducers to enable the M interdigital transducers to be in nonlinear up-down staggered arrangement, and reducing echo reflection between two adjacent interdigital transducers by adjusting the angles and the positions of the M interdigital transducers.

title_en: Multi-level output driving circuit and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-level output driving circuit and a method. The circuit comprises a signal selection module, a weight generation module, a coefficient transfer module and a weight adjustment and data output module, wherein the signal selection module is used for selecting and outputting signals to be transmitted of corresponding channels according to signals input from the outside, the weight generation module is used for generating weight data according to the weight of an output eye diagram, the weight of the output eye diagram and the weight data are multi-bit binary data, the coefficient transfer module is used for carrying out weight control on the signals to be transmitted according to the weight data to generate data containing weight information, and the weight adjustment and data output module is used for carrying out weight adjustment and pulse amplitude modulation calculation according to the weight adjustment control data, the signals to be transmitted and the data containing weight information to generate four-level pulse amplitude modulation data PAM4. Compared with the prior art, the embodiment of the application enriches the eye pattern adjustment modes, and can be suitable for eye pattern imbalance caused by different transmission environments.

title_en: Power amplifier power consumption self-adaption device and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a power amplifier power consumption self-adaptive device and a method thereof, wherein the power amplifier power consumption self-adaptive device comprises the following steps: the self-adaptive power amplifier comprises a traditional power amplifier and a self-adaptive module, wherein the self-adaptive module is positioned in a circuit for supplying power to a power amplification unit by a direct-current power supply, the self-adaptive module comprises a signal sorting unit and a controllable switching power supply, the signal sorting unit is used for sorting the signal phase and the signal intensity of a working signal from the traditional power amplifier, generating a control signal suitable for controlling the controllable switching power supply, and sending the control signal to the controllable switching power supply; the controllable switch power supply outputs controlled variable voltage to the power amplification unit for power supply under the action of the control signal, wherein the output voltage intensity of the controllable switch power supply is related to the working signal, and the power supply voltage output to the power amplification unit is automatically adjusted along with the working signal intensity.

title_en: Method for preparing micromechanical resonator
abstract_en: The invention provides a preparation method of a micromechanical resonator, which comprises the following steps: obtaining a substrate structure, wherein a resonance part and two electrode parts which are positioned at two sides of the resonance part and are arranged at intervals are formed on the substrate structure; growing a sacrificial layer on the substrate structure and patterning the sacrificial layer to partially expose the resonance part and the two electrode parts; depositing and patterning first polycrystalline silicon, and forming a resonance structure, an input electrode and an output electrode corresponding to the resonance part and the two electrode parts, wherein capacitance gaps are formed between the input electrode and the resonance structure and between the output electrode and the resonance structure; releasing the sacrificial layer under the resonance structure to obtain a resonator wafer; and preparing a packaging cover plate, and bonding the packaging cover plate and the resonator wafer in a vacuum mode to form the MEMS resonator. The vacuum airtightness is ensured, the whole process flow is simple and reliable, and high-precision, high-quality, large-batch and low-cost preparation can be realized.

title_en: Packaging structure and packaging method of resonance device
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a packaging structure of a resonance device and a packaging method thereof, the packaging structure including: at least one resonating device including a first side and a second side opposite the first side; a sealing portion on the second side on the at least one resonator device; a package substrate on the sealing part; the sealing part is annular, at least one resonance device and the packaging substrate are bonded, a cavity is arranged between the at least one resonance device and the packaging substrate, and the cavity is positioned on the inner side of the sealing part; and the covering layer is positioned on the second side, positioned on the at least one resonance device, and used for covering the packaging substrate and the sealing part and improving the sealing property or the interference resistance. The packaging wafer is bonded to the main wafer through the polymer for wafer-level packaging, the yield of products can be improved compared with metal bonding, and the packaging wafer can be a low-resistance silicon wafer, so that the packaging cost is reduced. In addition, the covering layer is arranged on the outer side of the packaging wafer and used for improving the sealing performance of the packaging, and the anti-interference performance can be improved by adopting the metal covering layer.

title_en: Wallace tree compressor based on Xilinx FPGA primitive
abstract_en: The invention provides a Wallace tree compressor based on Xilinx FPGA primitive, which consists of a tree type compression structure and a final summation unit; the tree-type compression structure compresses a plurality of binary numbers to two or three outputs, and the summation module adds the compression results to output a final result. The tree-type compression structure takes a 4:2 compressor as a basic compression unit and is matched with a 3:2 compressor when necessary. The bit level structure of the 4:2 compressor comprises an LUT6-2 module, a first muxcy module and a first xorcy module which are called by Xilinx FPGA primitives; the LUT6-2 module is configured as two common-input and independent-output LUTs 5, which can implement two independent binary functions; the first muxcy block and the first xorcy block are dedicated carry logic resources in the CLB, and are configured as a 3:2 compressor. A 3:1 compressor is designed according to the same idea as the final summation unit of the Wallace tree. The invention is used for realizing the multi-operand addition and subtraction operation, not only greatly improves the utilization rate of hardware resources, but also reduces the overall delay and power consumption of the Wallace tree.

title_en: Power supply voltage control method and controller of audio power amplifier and audio equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply voltage control method of an audio power amplifier, a controller and audio equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving and buffering a current digital audio signal; determining a power supply voltage value corresponding to the digital audio signal in each interval amplified by the audio power amplifier according to the peak envelope voltage of the digital audio signal; when the power supply voltage corresponding to the current interval is different from the power supply voltage corresponding to the next interval, determining a transition function adopted by the power supply voltage corresponding to the current interval to be changed to the power supply voltage corresponding to the next interval before the current interval is ended; generating a transition voltage sequence according to the transition function and the transition time; and outputting the transition voltage sequence. The method enables the power supply voltage between adjacent intervals to be in stable transition, thereby reducing EMI interference caused by different power supply voltages between adjacent intervals.

title_en: Self-acceleration locking phase-locked loop
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-accelerating locking phase-locked loop which comprises a phase frequency detector, a charge pump, a low-pass filter, a voltage-controlled oscillator, a frequency divider, a rectifier, a filter and a bandwidth control circuit. The phase frequency detector, the charge pump, the low-pass filter and the voltage-controlled oscillator are sequentially connected, the output of the voltage-controlled oscillator is fed back to one input end of the phase frequency detector through the frequency divider, and the other input end of the phase frequency detector is connected with a reference frequency source. The output end of the phase frequency detector is also connected with the input end of the rectifier, the filter and the bandwidth control circuit are sequentially connected, the bandwidth control circuit is used for generating a control word signal in a proportional relation with an output signal of the phase frequency detector and inputting the control word signal into the low-pass filter, and the access number of capacitors in a parallel capacitor array of the low-pass filter is controlled to control the bandwidth, so that the accelerated locking of the reference frequency of the phase-locked loop is realized.

title_en: Electronic circuit and bistable circuit
abstract_en: An electronic circuit has a cell array having a plurality of memory cells, each memory cell having a bistable circuit having a first inverter circuit and a second inverter circuit capable of switching a first mode having substantially no hysteresis in transfer characteristic and a second mode having hysteresis in transfer characteristic, an output node and an input node of the first inverter circuit being connected to an input node and an output node of the second inverter circuit, respectively, and a control circuit which, after one or more first memory cells of the plurality of memory cells which store data that may not be held are powered off, sets a bistable circuit in the remaining one or more second memory cells of the plurality of memory cells to the second mode, supplies a second power supply voltage to the bistable circuit in the one or more second memory cells in a state where the second mode is maintained, the second power supply voltage being lower than the first power supply voltage supplied to the circuit at the time of reading and/or writing data, and the bistable circuit capable of holding data in the second power supply voltage.

title_en: Hydrogen atomic clock frequency control system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydrogen atomic clock frequency control system, which comprises a main clock system, a common view comparison receiver and a central server; the main clock system comprises a hydrogen atomic clock and a phase trimmer, and the hydrogen atomic clock inputs a time reference signal into the phase trimmer for processing; the phase trimmer forms a 1PPS signal after processing, and inputs the 1PPS signal into the common view comparison receiver; the common-view comparison receiver receives satellite signals through an antenna, and compares the 1PPS signals with the satellite signals to form a common-view comparison data file; and the main clock system sends the common-view comparison data file to a central server through a phase trimmer through a network, and the central server processes the common-view comparison data file and returns feedback adjustment quantity to the phase trimmer to finish the frequency control of the hydrogen atomic clock.

title_en: Bulk acoustic wave resonator and bulk acoustic wave filter
abstract_en: The application provides a bulk acoustic wave syntonizer and bulk acoustic wave filter relates to wave filter technical field, includes: the piezoelectric ceramic device comprises a substrate, and a lower electrode, a piezoelectric layer and an upper electrode which are sequentially stacked on the substrate, wherein the outline of the upper electrode in the orthographic projection of the substrate is formed by connecting four curves end to end, the joint of two adjacent curves is provided with an arc transition, and the two curves arranged at intervals are not parallel. Therefore, the reliability of the device can be effectively improved, meanwhile, the parasitic harmonic amplitude value can be effectively inhibited, the Q value is improved, and the performance of the device is improved.

title_en: Voltage latching type level conversion circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a voltage latching type level switching circuit, which belongs to the field of integrated circuits and comprises a phase inverter taking a power supply 1 as a voltage source, a level switching unit taking a power supply 2 as a voltage source and an output buffer taking the power supply 2 as a voltage source; the inverter provides a group of reverse signals for the level conversion unit; the level conversion unit receives an input reverse signal and realizes conversion of different voltage domains in a voltage latching mode, and the output buffer realizes shaping for an output signal and improves the driving capability of a lower stage. The invention is suitable for 1.8V-5V bidirectional level conversion under 1Gbps, and can control the voltage latch function of the level conversion circuit through the enable signal, and the transmission delay is less than 200 ps; compared with the conventional level conversion and latch which are connected in series, the invention has the advantages of smaller transmission delay, smaller dynamic power consumption, wider voltage domain range, higher transmission rate and less total amount of MOS (metal oxide semiconductor) transistors.

title_en: Method and structure for improving preparation yield of bulk acoustic wave filter
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a structure for improving the preparation yield of a bulk acoustic wave filter. The structure comprises a substrate, a Bragg reflection layer, a rectangular supporting column, a stepped supporting column, a bottom electrode, a seed layer and a pentagonal top electrode; the rectangular support columns and the stepped support columns are arranged on two sides of the upper surface of the base body, and three pairs of Bragg reflecting layers with structures are arranged in grooves formed by the rectangular support columns, the stepped support columns and the upper surface of the base body; a bottom electrode is disposed on an upper surface of the bragg reflection layer, and an up-lead portion of the bottom electrode extends to the upper surface of the stepped support pillar along a stepped surface of the stepped support pillar; the seed layer extends to the upper surface of the rectangular support column; a piezoelectric layer is arranged above the seed layer; and a pentagonal top electrode with a three-region structure is arranged above the piezoelectric layer.

title_en: Dual-path parallel decoding storage device and method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a double-path parallel decoding storage device and a method, which relate to the field of communication technology.

title_en: Filter and multiplexer comprising the same
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a filter and a multiplexer including the same. The filter according to the present disclosure includes at least one series resonator unit connected in series between an input node and an output node, including a series resonator or including a series resonator and an inductor and/or a capacitor connected in parallel or in series therewith, and at least one parallel resonator unit connected in parallel between a connection node and a ground node, including a parallel resonator or including a parallel resonator and an inductor and/or a capacitor connected in parallel or in series therewith, the connection node being a node at an input and/or an output of the at least one series resonator unit, wherein at least one of the at least one series resonator unit and/or the at least one parallel resonator unit is a composite resonator including a resonator. According to the filter and the multiplexer comprising the filter, more out-of-band transmission zero points can be formed in the frequency response curve of the filter, so that out-of-band attenuation is enhanced.

title_en: Power amplifier bias circuit based on GaAs HBT process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power amplifier bias circuit based on a GaAs HBT process, which comprises a temperature compensation unit, a standard current mirror bias unit and a multi-order temperature coefficient voltage unit, wherein the standard current mirror bias unit comprises a replication circuit unit and an output circuit unit, a first HBT tube HBT1 and a third HBT tube HBT3 are respectively arranged in the replication circuit unit and the output circuit unit, and the multi-order temperature coefficient voltage unit is arranged in the replication circuit unit. The bias circuit provided by the invention has the advantages that the multi-order temperature coefficient voltage unit is arranged in the replica circuit unit of the standard current mirror bias unit, the circuit is simplified, the on-chip integration is facilitated, meanwhile, the current mirror structure is changed, the leakage current of the first HBT tube HBT1 is reduced by utilizing the current amplification function of the transistor, the transmission precision between the output bias current and the input reference current is improved, and the stable bias current is output.

title_en: Protection method and circuit of power amplifier and terminal
abstract_en: The application provides a protection method, a circuit and a terminal of a power amplifier, relates to the technical field of communication, and can protect the power amplifier. The protection circuit of the power amplifier comprises: the power supply voltage detection circuit comprises a power supply voltage input end, a current detection module, a voltage detection module, a control module, a switch module and a power supply voltage output end; the power supply voltage input end receives power supply voltage and transmits the power supply voltage to the power supply voltage output end; the power supply voltage output end transmits the power supply voltage to the power amplifier to supply power to the power amplifier; the current detection module is used for detecting a current signal between the power supply voltage input end and the first end of the switch module and sending the current signal to the control module; the voltage detection module is used for detecting a voltage signal at the voltage output end of the power supply and sending the voltage signal to the control module; the control module is used for controlling the switch module to be switched off when the current signal is greater than the preset current signal and/or the voltage signal is greater than the preset voltage signal.

title_en: Driving circuit of semiconductor circuit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a driving circuit of a semiconductor circuit, which comprises a low-voltage working circuit, a high-voltage working circuit, a bootstrap circuit and a precharge control circuit, wherein the input end of the low-voltage working circuit is the input end of the driving circuit, the output end of the low-voltage working circuit is connected with the input end of the high-voltage working circuit, the output end of the high-voltage working circuit is the output end of the driving circuit, the bootstrap circuit supplies power for the high-voltage working circuit, the control output end of the precharge control circuit is connected with the control input end of the bootstrap electric control circuit, the voltage detection end of the precharge control circuit is connected with the low-voltage power supply of the driving circuit, and when the precharge control circuit detects the electrifying state, the bootstrap circuit is controlled to work so as to complete the charging process. By arranging the precharge control circuit, the MCU can effectively control the upper bridge arm switching tube to be normally conducted in the power-on state, so that the normal operation of the semiconductor circuit is ensured.

title_en: Transimpedance amplifier circuit, optical receiver, and optical communication system
abstract_en: The invention provides a transimpedance amplifier circuit comprising: the signal detection module is used for detecting the voltage magnitude or the signal intensity of the output voltage signal and generating a control bias voltage according to the detection result; the automatic gain control module is connected with the output end of the signal detection module and used for generating a gain switching control voltage according to the control bias voltage on the basis of the initial voltage, wherein the gain switching control voltage is adaptively adjusted along with the process deviation and the ambient temperature; and the trans-impedance amplifier module is connected with the output end of the automatic gain control module and is used for converting the input current signal into an output voltage signal and switching the low gain mode and the high gain mode according to the gain switching control voltage. The transimpedance amplifier circuit provided by the invention solves the problem that the quality of an output signal in a dynamic range is influenced due to the fact that the starting point and the starting degree of AGC are changed because the existing transimpedance amplifier is influenced by the process deviation of a chip and the high and low temperature of the application environment.

title_en: Semiconductor structure with redundant structure, manufacturing method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a semiconductor structure, a manufacturing method thereof and an electronic device. The assembly includes a substrate, a plurality of bulk acoustic wave resonators, and at least one redundant structure. At least two resonators are stacked on one side of the substrate to form a resonator stacking unit. An acoustic decoupling layer is arranged between the top electrode of the lower resonator and the bottom electrode of the upper resonator, and the acoustic decoupling layer forms an acoustic mirror of the upper resonator. The at least one redundancy structure overlaps at least one resonator of the plurality of resonators on the one side of the substrate to form a redundancy overlapping unit, the redundancy overlapping unit is juxtaposed with the resonator overlapping unit on the one side of the substrate in a horizontal direction, the redundancy structure comprises a redundancy piezoelectric layer which is in the same layer as a corresponding piezoelectric layer in the resonator overlapping unit, and a top electrode, a piezoelectric layer and a bottom electrode of the resonator in the redundancy overlapping unit are respectively in the same layer as a top electrode, a piezoelectric layer and a bottom electrode of the same layer resonator in the resonator overlapping unit.

title_en: Specific subharmonic suppression pulse width modulation method and device based on Levenberg-Marquardt method
abstract_en: One or more embodiments of the present disclosure provide a specific subharmonic suppression pulse width modulation method and apparatus based on the Levenberg-Marquardt method, which convert the converter specific subharmonic suppression pulse width modulation problem into a solution of an transcendental equation set composed of subharmonics expressed by switching angles, so that a carrier does not need to be generated and compared with a modulated wave, and a control flow is simplified. Meanwhile, the Levenberg-Marquardt method can overcome the possible non-solution condition of the existing algorithm, and the pulse width modulation problem can be ensured to obtain the switch angle adjustment direction stably.

title_en: Method and system for calibrating interstage gain error of pipeline successive approximation ADC (analog-to-digital converter)
abstract_en: The invention discloses an interstage increment of a pipeline successive approximation type ADC (analog to digital converter)The beneficial error calibration method comprises the following steps: after the input signal is sampled and quantized, the last bit of unit capacitance in the DAC of the first stage Up-injecting a first dither to calculate an inter-stage gain; corresponding bit capacitance of DAC in the second stage Injecting a second jitter opposite to the first level to offset the margin swing increased by the first jitter injection; multiplying the output of the second-stage DAC by the first jitter, counting a plurality of data, accumulating to obtain an average value, and calculating to obtain the gain-containing Bit weight and second stage capacitance of The algebraic sum of the bit weight values of (a) is used to finally calculate the actual gain. The invention randomly breaks up the order of the capacitors by adopting a cycle switching calibration technology which does not influence the normal work of the ADC, thereby randomizing the fixed error, reducing the harmonic wave in the ADC frequency spectrum and leading the ADC frequency spectrum to have a harmonic wave in the frequency spectrum of the ADC The actual weight of (a) can be approximately regarded as the ideal weight.

title_en: Reconstruction method for acquiring ultrahigh frequency signal by equivalent time sampling
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of signal reconstruction, and particularly relates to a reconstruction method for acquiring an ultrahigh frequency signal by equivalent time sampling, which comprises the following steps: s1, carrying out equivalent time sampling on the ultrahigh frequency sine wave signal by using a sampling oscilloscope to obtain an observation vector y; s2, constructing a measurement matrix A by utilizing a Fourier transform and equivalent time sampling method; and S3, constructing a compression sampling equation y as Ax, and reconstructing the original ultrahigh frequency signal x through the observation vector y and the measurement matrix A. The invention can accurately reconstruct the high-frequency signal by sampling at a time far lower than the Nyquist sampling rate. Equivalent time sampling enables the frequency spectrum not to be moved regularly, but a small part and a small part are moved in a messy way, frequency leakage is uniformly distributed in the whole frequency domain, and therefore leakage values are small, and recovery is achieved.

title_en: Multi-stage sigma-delta analog-to-digital converter with dithering
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a multi-stage sigma-delta analog-to-digital converter with dithering. Techniques are provided for implementing subtractive dithering in a multi-stage ADC. Subtracting jitter involves adding a first jitter signal at a first node and a second jitter signal at a second node (which may be the same as the first node), where the first and second jitter signals combine and the sum is approximately zero. By using subtractive dithering in a multi-stage ADC, the margin requirements of the loop filter in the ADC main loop and the range requirements of the feedback DAC in the main loop can be relaxed.

title_en: ICP sensor circuit with high efficiency, wide frequency response and high dynamic range
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ICP sensor circuit with high efficiency, wide frequency response and high dynamic range, which comprises a piezoelectric signal input end, a piezoelectric signal output end and a signal amplification circuit, wherein the piezoelectric signal input end is connected with the input end of the signal amplification circuit after sequentially passing through a low-frequency compensation circuit and a high-frequency compensation circuit, the output end of the signal amplification circuit is connected with the piezoelectric signal output end and is simultaneously connected with the piezoelectric signal input end through a high dynamic loop, and the ICP sensor circuit also comprises a power distribution circuit for supplying power to each circuit. The invention can achieve the effects of wider acceleration measuring range, wider frequency response, higher acceleration measuring precision, low production cost and obvious economic efficiency, and is suitable for different materials or different structures of piezoelectricity to generate different frequency responses.

title_en: W-waveband high-gain low-noise amplifier circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a W-band high-gain low-noise amplifier circuit, which comprises cascaded three-stage amplification circuits, wherein the cascaded three-stage amplification circuits all adopt a cascode structure and comprise an input matching network, an input tuning inductor, a common emitter transistor, an interconnection inductor, a common base transistor, a bias decoupling capacitor and an output matching network; the input end of the input matching network is connected with an input signal, and an input tuning inductor is connected between the output end of the input matching network and the base electrode of the common emitter transistor in series; an interconnected inductor is connected in series between the collector of the common emitter transistor and the emitter of the common base transistor; the base electrode of the common base electrode transistor is connected with one end of a bias decoupling capacitor and VDD, and the other end of the bias decoupling capacitor is grounded; the collector of the common base transistor is connected with an output matching network, and the output matching network is simultaneously connected with VDD; the emitters of the common emitter transistors of the second stage and the third stage of the amplifying circuit are directly grounded, and the first stage is grounded through an emitter feedback inductor. The invention can realize high gain and low noise coefficient of W wave band.

title_en: Pulse jacking compensation circuit of Marx generator based on resonant circuit
