abstract_en: The invention discloses a pulse top-falling compensation circuit of a Marx generator based on a resonant circuit, which comprises: the pulse top drop compensation circuit is used for compensating the pulse top drop under different loads and different pulse widths. In applications such as particle accelerators, the voltage, current top-drop of the high voltage pulse is required to be as low as possible; in a Marx generator, a compensation unit is obtained when the resonant inductor and the compensation switch are connected in series and connected in parallel with the main capacitor in the normal unit. During discharge, a nearly linear portion of the sinusoidal voltage is applied to the load as pulse compensation, achieving a rectangular pulse with almost no top-dip. Different compensation unit numbers can compensate the voltage top drop to different degrees, and the compensation effect is also adjustable. Furthermore, these compensation units can also be used as normal units in a Marx generator, as long as the resonant control switch is switched off. According to the invention, the compensation degree can be adjusted, the capacitance and the system cost can be greatly reduced, and the method has good feasibility and application prospect.

title_en: Data stream compression method based on Flink and RVR, edge computing system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial big data and artificial intelligence, and discloses a data stream compression method, an edge computing system and a storage medium based on Flink and RVR, wherein the method comprises the following steps: reading data streams from at least one data source in parallel to form an input data stream; distributing data streams of different data sources in different Flink partition windows, and forming independent data blocks which are continuously updated along with window advancing on the basis of a Flink rolling window operator; when each window is finished, triggering a self-defined window function to execute data rearrangement and RVR (relevance vector regression) sparse compression operation on data in the window and outputting a sparse data stream; and writing the data streams thinned by the data sources into an external system in parallel based on a Flink data sink operator. According to the invention, the relevance vector regression RVR algorithm is embedded in the Flink distributed stream type calculation framework, so that real-time parallel compression of data of multiple data sources can be realized, and the automation and intelligence level of data processing is improved.

title_en: Signal processing circuit and signal processing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a signal processing circuit and a signal processing device, comprising: the signal reading module comprises a detection transistor, a reference transistor, a voltage following unit and a signal acquisition unit; the voltage following unit is respectively and electrically connected with the first current source, the drain electrode of the detection transistor, the drain electrode of the reference transistor, the source electrode of the detection transistor, the source electrode of the reference transistor and the signal acquisition unit; the source electrode of the detection transistor and the source electrode of the reference transistor are also electrically connected with a second current source; the differential amplification module is electrically connected with the signal acquisition unit; the differential amplification module takes the acquired source voltage of the detection transistor as a detection voltage signal and the source voltage of the reference transistor as a reference voltage signal, and performs signal amplification to output a detection result after the amplified detection voltage signal and the amplified reference voltage signal are differentiated, so that the influence of environment and temperature on the detection transistor is eliminated, and the problem that the ion concentration is difficult to accurately detect is solved.

title_en: Wafer-level packaging process for filter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wafer-level packaging process for a filter, and belongs to the technical field of filter packaging. The wafer level packaging process of the filter comprises the following steps: and S1, arranging a first insulating layer on the working surface of the wafer, and opening a hole on the first insulating layer to expose the first region, the second region and the third region of the wafer. And S2, forming a second insulating layer on the first insulating layer, and forming a hole in the second insulating layer to expose the first region and the third region of the wafer. The third area is not sealed by the second insulating layer, and due to the separation design among the chips, the shrinkage difference generated in the subsequent process is effectively weakened, so that the packaged filter is prevented from warping. And S3, filling metal on the electrodes in the first area to form a metal layer, and generating a preset pattern on the metal layer. And S4, manufacturing welding points on the preset pattern. And S5, cutting the wafer along the third area to form a plurality of chips. The process improves the packaging efficiency and the packaging effect.

title_en: System and method for testing filters in redundant signal paths
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to systems and methods for testing filters in redundant signal paths. Systems and methods for detecting faults in redundant signal paths during operation of the redundant signal paths are disclosed. The test signal is injected sequentially into each signal path while the input signal is conducted by other signal paths that are not receiving the test signal. The test signal is selected at a frequency to verify the operation of the filters connected in series along each path. The processor generates a test signal, injects the test signal at an input of the filter and receives an output of the filter. The processor then generates a frequency response for the filter in each signal path based on the output from the filter and the original test signal. The frequency responses obtained along each of the redundant signal paths are compared with one another to detect a failure of one of the filters present along the respective signal path.

title_en: PAM-NRZ signal conversion circuit, conversion method, device and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a PAM-NRZ signal conversion circuit, which comprises a signal comparison unit, a first OR gate, a delay unit and a second OR gate, wherein the input end of the signal comparison unit is used for receiving a PAM signal, the output end of the signal comparison unit is electrically connected with the input end of the first OR gate, the output end of the first OR gate is electrically connected with the input end of the second OR gate and the input end of the delay unit, the output end of the delay unit is electrically connected with the input end of the second OR gate, and the output end of the second OR gate is used for outputting only an NRZ signal obtained by short-edge conversion of the PAM signal. The PAM-NRZ signal conversion circuit provided by the invention can be used for inhibiting the conversion of the long edge of the PAM signal into the output signal and only outputting the NRZ signal obtained by the conversion of the short edge of the PAM signal, so that the accuracy of the data cycle of the NRZ signal converted by the PAM signal is ensured, and the problem of different duty ratios of the NRZ signal caused by different conversion times of the long edge of the PAM signal and the short edge of the PAM signal is solved.

title_en: Control circuit, controller and air conditioner
abstract_en: The application provides a control circuit, which comprises a first resistor, a second resistor, a third resistor, a switch module and a fourth resistor, wherein the first end of the first resistor is connected with a VCC power supply, the second end of the first resistor is connected with the first end of the switch module, the second end of the second resistor is grounded, the first end of the third resistor is connected with the first end of the switch module, the second end of the third resistor is connected with the second end of the switch module, the third end of the third resistor is connected with a first bus, the fourth end of the third resistor is connected with a second bus, and the switch module is used for switching on connection between the second end of the first resistor and the first bus and connection between the first end of the second resistor and the second bus. Therefore, the control circuit provided by the application can reduce signal distortion as much as possible, improve anti-interference performance and enhance the reliability of the control circuit. Meanwhile, the control circuit adopts fewer elements such as dial switches or relays, and the like, so that the effects of low cost, easiness in maintenance and the like can be realized.

title_en: Phase-locked loop parameter correction method, phase-locked loop, data processing device and storage medium
abstract_en: A parameter correction method of a phase-locked loop circuit, a data processing apparatus, an electronic device, and a non-transitory readable storage medium. The parameter correction method of the phase-locked loop circuit comprises the steps of setting a plurality of target parameters of the phase-locked loop circuit, acquiring a plurality of filter coefficients of a digital loop filter based on the plurality of target parameters, and providing the plurality of filter coefficients to the digital loop filter so that a plurality of working parameters of the phase-locked loop circuit are correspondingly consistent with the plurality of target parameters. According to the method, through the set target parameters, the filter coefficients of the digital loop filter are automatically adjusted, so that the working parameters of the phase-locked loop circuit are correspondingly consistent with the target parameters, the overall working characteristics (such as frequency characteristics) of the phase-locked loop circuit are kept unchanged, and the stability of the phase-locked loop circuit is improved.

title_en: Offset voltage correction circuit and offset voltage correction method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an offset voltage correction circuit and an offset voltage correction method, wherein the offset voltage correction circuit comprises a data acquisition module, an adjustment enabling module, a correction enabling module and an offset correction module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for receiving a data signal and a reference signal, acquiring a data indication signal according to a comparison result of the reference signal and the offset data signal, wherein the offset data signal is a data signal after the offset signal is overlapped, the adjustment enabling module is used for receiving the data signal, the reference signal, the data indication signal and an enabling signal, if the enabling signal is at a high level, acquiring a theoretical indication signal according to a comparison result of the data signal and the reference signal, and generating an enabling identification signal based on a comparison result of the theoretical indication signal and the data indication signal, and the offset correction module is used for counteracting the offset signal based on the enabling identification signal, and counteracting input offset voltage at an input stage of an operational amplifier so as to ensure accuracy of signal transmission.

title_en: Method of forming doped crystalline piezoelectric film via MOCVD and related doped crystalline piezoelectric film
abstract_en: A method of forming a piezoelectric film may include: providing a wafer in a CVD reactor and forming an aluminum nitride material on the wafer, the aluminum nitride material doped with a first element E1 selected from group IIA or group IIB and doped with a second element E2 selected from group IVB to provide the aluminum nitride material, the aluminum nitride material comprising a crystallinity at Full Width Half Maximum (FWHM) of less than about 1.5 degrees to at FWHM of less than about 10 arc seconds as measured using X-ray diffraction (XRD).

title_en: Atomizing device, double-Hall mistake-proofing atomizing structure and linear Hall self-adaptive algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to an atomization device, a double-Hall mistake-proofing atomization structure and a linear Hall self-adaptive algorithm, wherein the double-Hall mistake-proofing atomization structure comprises an atomization main body and a switch assembly; the atomization main body comprises a first Hall module and a second Hall module; the switch component is provided with a first magnetic piece and a second magnetic piece which correspond to the positions of the first Hall module and the second Hall module respectively; when the switch assembly moves to the first position, the first magnetic piece and the second magnetic piece are staggered with the first Hall module and the second Hall module respectively; when the switch assembly moves to the second position, the first magnetic piece and the second magnetic piece are respectively opposite to the first Hall module and the second Hall module, and when the switch assembly is switched between the first position and the second position, the first Hall module and the second Hall module control atomization of the atomization main body. The atomizing device can prevent the magnet of the switch assembly from triggering the atomizer to work by mistake through double-Hall detection, and can protect the atomizer from working by mistake.

title_en: Bulk acoustic wave resonator having acoustic resistance layer, assembly and manufacturing method thereof, filter, and electronic device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bulk acoustic wave resonator comprising: a substrate; an acoustic mirror; a bottom electrode; a piezoelectric layer; and a top electrode, wherein: the overlapping area of the top electrode, the piezoelectric layer and the bottom electrode in the thickness direction of the resonator forms an effective area of the resonator; the piezoelectric layer comprises a first layer and a second layer, an acoustic resistance layer is arranged between the first layer and the second layer, the second layer is arranged above the first layer, the inner edge of the acoustic resistance layer is positioned at the inner side of the boundary of the acoustic mirror in the horizontal direction, and the acoustic resistance of the acoustic resistance layer is different from that of the piezoelectric layer; the resonator further comprises a channel or opening communicating the acoustic resistive layer with the outside. The invention also relates to a bulk acoustic wave resonator assembly, a method of manufacturing a bulk acoustic wave resonator, a filter and an electronic device.

title_en: Circuit for entering hundred-percent duty ratio and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of analog integrated circuits, and particularly relates to a circuit for entering a hundred-percent duty ratio and a control method thereof. The invention mainly utilizes an internal detection adaptive on timer to generate a signal to be compared with an internal FB detection circuit, if the timer is inverted at the moment, but the output signal of an FB detection circuit is still at a high level, the signal is determined to enter a 100% duty cycle at the moment, a high duty signal HD is generated, the signal is utilized to adjust the threshold value of an ea comparator, the high level maintaining length of an FB _ low signal is smoothly lengthened, the system can smoothly enter a 100% state by utilizing the method, and meanwhile, the circuit is positioned in an integral loop and cannot damage the stability of the system.

title_en: Processing method and device for synchronous optimization pulse width modulation and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a processing method, a device and electronic equipment for synchronous optimization pulse width modulation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: dividing the space voltage vector into 6 sectors, dividing each sector into k angle intervals, and setting voltage sampling points for each angle interval; determining a three-phase SOPWM waveform according to the modulation degree and the quantity of the switching angles; acquiring a voltage vector sequence and a voltage vector action angle of a three-phase SOPWM waveform corresponding to each voltage sampling point; determining a target sampling point under a corresponding target sector according to a set target voltage vector; determining a target voltage vector sequence and a target voltage vector action angle of a target sampling point from a voltage vector sequence and a voltage vector action angle corresponding to each voltage sampling point; and determining the output level according to the target voltage vector sequence, the target voltage vector action angle and the carrier value. Therefore, the digital implementation process is greatly simplified, the resource occupancy rate is reduced, and the time consumption of operation is reduced.

title_en: Power amplifier chip and radio frequency front end module
abstract_en: The power amplifier chip of the invention comprises an amplifier array, the amplifier array comprises at least one amplifier unit, each amplifier unit comprises a transistor array and a first through hole and a first bonding pad which are arranged in a first area, the transistor array is arranged at one side of the first area, the first through hole is used for being connected to a grounding terminal, at least some of the transistors in the array of transistors have collectors connected to the first pad, the first pad is also for connection to a first node on a substrate, the first node being one node on the power amplifier chip output path, thereby reducing the area of the power amplifier chip, being beneficial to the integration and miniaturization design of the power amplifier chip, and excessive loss caused by overlong transmission lines is avoided, and the overall loss of the power amplifier chip is reduced.

title_en: MIPI circuit applied to high-speed mode
abstract_en: The invention provides an MIPI circuit applied to a high-speed mode, which comprises an output unit, a driving unit and a matching unit, wherein the matching unit is used for generating a driving voltage which enables the on-resistance of an MOS tube to be the same as the target resistance, and supplying power to the driving unit by adopting the driving voltage, the driving unit is used for receiving an initial high-speed differential signal, generating a high-speed differential signal under the driving voltage domain, and driving the output unit to output the target high-speed differential signal, so that the voltage domain of the target high-speed differential signal is the high-speed differential signal under the driving voltage domain, the target high-speed differential signal is further related to the target resistance, and the influence of MOS tube technology, voltage and temperature on the MIPI circuit of the high-speed mode is reduced.

title_en: Tuning device and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tuning device and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of semiconductors. The tuning device comprises a film bulk acoustic wave resonance structure and a packaging structure, wherein the film bulk acoustic wave resonance structure comprises a first substrate layer, a bottom electrode layer, a piezoelectric layer, a top electrode layer and a first metal layer which are arranged in a stacked mode, the packaging structure comprises a second substrate layer and a second metal layer arranged on the second substrate layer, the second metal layer comprises a first sub-metal layer and a second sub-metal layer, a dielectric layer is arranged between the first sub-metal layer and the second sub-metal layer, so that the first sub-metal layer, the dielectric layer and the second sub-metal layer form a capacitor, and the first sub-metal layer and/or the second sub-metal layer are connected with the first metal layer to enable the capacitor to be connected with the film bulk acoustic wave resonance structure in series or in parallel. The tuning device provided by the invention has a simple structure, has a large bandwidth and is easy to adjust the resonant frequency.

title_en: Broadband millimeter wave agile frequency source
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave agile frequency source, which comprises a phase-locked source module, a five-frequency division module, a primary frequency conversion filtering module, a quadruple frequency module, a secondary frequency conversion filtering module, a clock module and a control module. The phase-locked source module outputs three paths of signals, the first path of output is connected with the primary frequency conversion module, the second path of output is connected with the five-frequency division module, the third path of output is connected with the four-frequency division module, the output of the five-frequency division module is connected with the primary frequency conversion module, the output of the clock module is connected with the four-frequency multiplication module, and the four-frequency division module and the output of the primary frequency conversion module are connected with the secondary frequency conversion module to output millimeter wave signals through secondary frequency conversion. The invention overcomes the defects of complex design, large debugging difficulty and large volume of the traditional millimeter wave agile frequency source typesetting and is not suitable for the miniaturization and integration requirements of missile-borne electronic interference equipment.

title_en: Piezoelectric element
abstract_en: In the piezoelectric element (100), the second electrode layer (130) is located on the second surface (112) side of the single crystal piezoelectric layer (110). A hole (131) facing the through hole (113) is formed in the second electrode layer (130). The second electrode layer (130) is composed of Pt, ti, al, cu, au, ag, mg or an alloy containing at least one of these metals as a main component. The third electrode layer (140) is disposed on the opposite side of the second electrode layer (130) from the single crystal piezoelectric layer (110). The third electrode layer (140) is provided with at least a portion that is located outside the edge (132) of the hole (131) with a gap from the edge (132) of the hole (131) when viewed from the direction perpendicular to the second surface (112). The third electrode layer (140) is composed of Ni or an alloy containing Ni as a main component.

title_en: Amplifier based on intermodulation cancellation technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an amplifier based on intermodulation cancellation technology, which comprises an input matching network, a main path AB type active self-bias amplification network, a secondary path C type active self-bias cancellation network and an output matching network. The invention adopts the active self-bias improved Darlington amplifying structure, which can obviously improve the high-frequency gain characteristic of the amplifier and the isolation index, and simultaneously combines the intermodulation cancellation technology, utilizes the positive three-order intermodulation component of the secondary circuit C-class active self-bias cancellation network to counteract the negative three-order intermodulation component of the main circuit AB-class active self-bias amplifying network, thereby improving the IP3 index and the P1dB index of the amplifier, and having lower power consumption and relatively simpler circuit structure.

title_en: Quartz crystal resonator for improving application capability of vehicle-mounted product
abstract_en: The invention relates to a quartz crystal resonator for improving the application capability of a vehicle-mounted product, which comprises the following components: the quartz chip is positioned in the sealing structure, an upper electrode film is arranged on the upper surface of the quartz chip, a lower electrode film is arranged on the lower surface of the quartz chip, the upper electrode film comprises a plurality of upper electrode films which are connected in series, and the lower electrode film comprises a plurality of lower electrode films which are connected in series; the upper electrode film and the lower electrode film are connected with terminals on the base. The invention can meet the requirement of high vibration generating margin of the quartz crystal resonator and the oscillating circuit of the electronic equipment for vehicles.

title_en: Radio frequency switch circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radio frequency switch circuit, which comprises a signal input end, a signal output end and a transistor stack circuit, wherein the signal input end is connected with the signal output end; the transistor stack circuit comprises N transistors, wherein the second end of the (i-1) th transistor is connected with the first end of the ith transistor, and the second end of the ith transistor is connected with the signal output end; the total width of each transistor is calculated as: w is the total width of the transistor, FW is the width of the gate fingers, F is the number of the gate fingers, and M is the number of the parallel comb fingers; the W value in the first transistor is maximum, and the W value in the Nth transistor is minimum; the FW value of each transistor is configured such that a breakdown voltage of the transistor is greater than a peak voltage experienced across the transistor, the breakdown voltage being inversely related to the FW value. The technical scheme can ensure that the breakdown voltage of each transistor is greater than the peak voltage born by the two ends of each transistor, thereby achieving the effect of preventing the radio frequency switch circuit from being damaged.

title_en: Signal processing circuit and electronic device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a signal processing circuit and an electronic device. Wherein, signal processing circuit includes: the charge amplifying circuit is used for receiving the differential charge signal output by the sensor; amplifying and converting the differential charge signal to output a first voltage signal; the in-phase amplifying circuit is connected with the charge amplifying circuit and used for receiving the first voltage signal; amplifying the first voltage signal and outputting a second voltage signal; the voltage-controlled filter circuit is connected with the in-phase amplifying circuit and is used for receiving the second voltage signal, amplifying and filtering the second voltage signal and outputting a third voltage signal; and the hysteresis comparison circuit is connected with the voltage-controlled filter circuit and is used for receiving the third voltage signal and comparing the third voltage signal to obtain a stable square wave signal. By adopting the scheme provided by the embodiment of the application, the common-mode noise signal can be well inhibited, the response speed is high, the influence of resistance of a circuit is small, and the square wave signal output effect is good.

title_en: Decision feedback equalizer and PAM-4 receiver
abstract_en: The invention provides a decision feedback equalizer and a PAM-4 receiver, which on one hand reduces parasitic capacitance by reducing the number of interfaces of equalizing taps and reduces the establishment time of a summing device, on the other hand reduces delay caused by a sampling decision device by increasing the bandwidth of a sampling stage and increasing the input amplitude of a latch, and further comprehensively reduces the loop delay of a DFE from two aspects and solves the problem of tension of a timing margin.

title_en: Device for ultrasonic regulation and control of artificial nerve synapse, preparation method and regulation and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for ultrasonic regulation and control of an artificial nerve synapse, a preparation method and a regulation and control method, and belongs to the field of ultrasonic application. Comprising the following steps: the artificial nerve synapse bionic device comprises an artificial nerve synapse bionic device array, a first pair of interdigital electrodes, a second pair of interdigital electrodes and a piezoelectric substrate; the piezoelectric substrate is positioned at the bottom layer, and the piezoelectric monocrystalline material is cut along a specific direction, wherein the specific direction refers to the direction of the acoustic surface wave which can generate horizontal shearing under the action of an electric field after the piezoelectric monocrystalline material is cut along the specific direction; the artificial nerve synapse bionic device array is positioned in the middle area of the upper surface of the piezoelectric substrate, and the length of the array is not longer than that of the interdigital electrode in the Y direction; the first pair of interdigital electrodes and the second pair of interdigital electrodes are respectively positioned on the upper surface of the piezoelectric substrate and symmetrically distributed on the left side and the right side of the array, and the first pair of interdigital electrodes and the second pair of interdigital electrodes are identical in material and size. The invention realizes the regulation and control of the artificial nerve synapse weight by utilizing the ultrasound, and provides a new thought and approach for the intelligent control of an artificial neural network.

title_en: Analog-digital conversion circuit and method based on adaptive delta predictive modulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to an analog-digital conversion circuit based on self-adaptive increment predictive modulation and a design method thereof, wherein the circuit comprises: the summing circuit is used for comparing the input analog signal with the feedback signal and calculating the difference to obtain an error signal; a loop filter coupled to the summing circuit for receiving the error signal; a comparator connected to the loop filter, the sum of the output signals of the loop filter being decided by the comparator; the adaptive incremental predictive coder-decoder receives the judgment result of the comparator, and carries out adaptive incremental predictive coding-decoding according to the judgment result to obtain a digital signal corresponding to the input analog signal; and a digital-to-analog converter that converts the digital signal to an analog feedback signal that is input to the summing circuit. The invention reduces the dithering noise caused by the repeated adjustment of the self-adaptive loop, thereby reducing the quantization noise power, effectively improving the signal-to-noise ratio of the modulator and improving the overall performance.

title_en: Driving circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a driving circuit, which comprises an edge modulation circuit, an isolation transformer, an energy storage circuit, a demodulation circuit and a switch control circuit, wherein the edge modulation circuit is connected with the isolation transformer; wherein, demodulation circuit includes: the voltage stabilizing circuit comprises a diode D2, a diode D3, a voltage stabilizing tube Z3, a voltage stabilizing tube Z4, a switch tube S1, a switch tube S2, a resistor R1 and a voltage stabilizing unit; the invention can respond to the modulated positive and negative voltages transmitted from the primary winding of the isolation transformer to the secondary winding, demodulate the positive voltage with a certain amplitude on the secondary winding of the isolation transformer into an on signal to drive the power semiconductor device to be on, demodulate the negative voltage with a certain amplitude on the secondary winding of the isolation transformer into an off signal to drive the power semiconductor device to be off, and flexibly improve the anti-interference capability of the circuit and prevent the false on and false off by increasing the on and off threshold values of the signal demodulation circuit.

title_en: Frequency and phase discrimination control system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a frequency and phase discrimination control system and a method, wherein a control unit receives control information sent by a master station, analyzes the control information to obtain a frame header and frequency information of the control information, and determines the initial position of the frequency information according to a communication protocol or a standard; the control unit starts to detect frequency information from the determined initial position, judges whether a rising edge or a falling edge arrives, and opens the analog switch A if the rising edge or the falling edge arrives; carry out on-off control to analog switch A and analog switch B through the control unit, export under the phase frequency detector steady state, simultaneously, under the combined action of wave filter, voltage follower, realized accurate, fast adjustment control to local clock, shorten the time that local clock locks reference frequency greatly, work efficiency obtains improving, effectively solved have main website and slave station among the technique and be difficult to realize that slave station and main website carry out the frequency and the technical problem of phase synchronization problem under half-duplex communication condition.

title_en: Polarization code SCLF decoding method based on flip set
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a polarization code SCLF decoding method based on a flip set. The invention belongs to the technical field of channel coding, which comprises the steps of firstly estimating LLR expectations of each polarized sub-channel and bit error probability of an SC decoder by utilizing a Gaussian approximation principle, then obtaining the bit error probability of CA-SCL decoding by path measurement of the SCL decoder in actual decoding, identifying error bits containing an SC state by the bit error probability, and sequencing the error bits according to ascending order of reliability to obtain a turning set. And finally, when the CA-SCL decoding fails for the first time, adopting a bit turning scheme for only exchanging decision results on the SC state path to sequentially turn bits in the turning set, and reducing error propagation and decision errors of the CA-SCL decoding. Simulation results show that the SCLF decoding method based on the flip set provided by the invention has obvious decoding performance improvement and calculation complexity reduction.

title_en: Method, apparatus and storage medium for encoding raw data into quantum line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for encoding original data to a quantum circuit and a storage medium. The method for encoding the raw data to the quantum line comprises the following steps: acquiring original data and preprocessing the original data to obtain target data; constructing an angle tree corresponding to the target data according to the target data; respectively encoding nodes on the angle tree corresponding to the target data into the quantum wires; combining the quantum states in the quantum circuit by using a first quantum logic gate, and outputting the encoded last quantum state of the quantum circuit; wherein, the amplitude of the last quantum state of the quantum circuit after encoding corresponds to the target data one by one. The invention can effectively reduce the depth of the sub-line and improve the coding efficiency.

title_en: Variable capacitance device, implementation method and pressure switch device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a variable capacitance device, an implementation method and a pressure switch device, which comprise a movable electrode and at least one fixed electrode which form a variable capacitance; the movable electrode is grounded or connected with a power supply, and the fixed electrode is connected with a signal detection interface of the capacitance detection unit; voltage differences exist between the signal detection interface and the power supply and between the signal detection interface and the ground wire; the capacitance detection unit is used for converting the capacitance value into a pressure value and outputting the pressure value. The variable capacitance device is used for outputting a pressure value, the pressure switch is used for outputting an instruction of an opening action, a closing action and a closing action with preset frequency of the analog switch to target equipment, when a high-frequency instruction action needs to be input, continuous key knocking is not needed, so that the operation frequency during input is reduced, the hand fatigue caused by long-time or too frequent key knocking of fingers is relieved, the knocking frequency is reduced, and the service life of the whole equipment can be prolonged.

title_en: Bulk acoustic wave filter, manufacturing method thereof and communication device
abstract_en: A bulk acoustic wave filter, a method of manufacturing the same, and a communication device. The bulk acoustic wave filter includes a first filter substrate and a second filter substrate; the first filter substrate comprises a first substrate, and a first resonator, a first electrode pad and a first auxiliary pad which are positioned on the first substrate; the second filter substrate comprises a second substrate, and a second resonator, a second electrode pad and a second auxiliary pad which are positioned on the second substrate; the first filter substrate is disposed opposite to the second filter substrate to form a cavity between the first filter substrate and the second filter substrate, the first electrode pad is disposed in contact with the second auxiliary pad, and the second electrode pad is disposed in contact with the first auxiliary pad. The bulk acoustic wave filter can greatly reduce the manufacturing cost.

title_en: List enhancement decoding method and device based on polarization ALOHA
abstract_en: The method executes packet-level interference cancellation list (pSCL) decoding based on polar codes on a received data packet transmitted through a time slot deletion channel, generates L decoding paths (results) after decoding, and selects a path with the minimum time slot weight from the L paths as an optimal decoding path of the polar codes according to the time slot weight when the L decoding results are subjected to Serial Interference Cancellation (SIC) iterative decoding of the time slot ALOHA for outputting; after the optimal path decoding output recovers a plurality of data packets, the consistency check of the respective data packets is carried out on the data packets, if the consistency check is met, the data packets are correctly received, and the confirmation frame of the data packets is broadcasted. The process organically combines the independent inner code decoding process and the independent outer code decoding process into one, forms a list enhanced decoding method for resisting time slot deletion, and effectively improves the throughput rate of a time slot ALOHA system under a time slot deletion channel.

title_en: Surface acoustic wave device
abstract_en: The invention provides a surface acoustic wave device, which comprises a substrate, a first piezoelectric film, a second piezoelectric film, a first interdigital electrode, a second interdigital electrode, a plurality of first reflectors and a plurality of second reflectors, wherein the substrate is provided with an upper surface and a lower surface, the first piezoelectric film is arranged on the upper surface, the second piezoelectric film is arranged on the lower surface, the first interdigital electrode is arranged on the first piezoelectric film, the second interdigital electrode is arranged on the second piezoelectric template, the plurality of first reflectors are respectively arranged on two sides of the first interdigital electrode along the propagation direction of the surface acoustic wave, and the plurality of second reflectors are respectively arranged on two sides of the second interdigital electrode along the propagation direction of the surface acoustic wave. The surface acoustic wave device provided by the invention has the advantages that the two surface acoustic wave structures are obtained, the size of the device is reduced, the required space is saved, and the production cost is reduced.

title_en: Semiconductor device, logic system thereof and operation method thereof
abstract_en: Embodiments of the invention provide a semiconductor device, a logic system thereof and a method of operating the semiconductor device. The semiconductor device includes a first latch circuit and a second latch circuit connected to the first latch circuit. The second latch circuit includes a first feedback circuit configured to receive a first clock signal of a first phase and a second clock signal of a second phase, and a first transmission circuit configured to receive the second clock signal and a third clock signal of a third phase. The first feedback circuit is configured to be turned off by the first clock signal and the second clock signal before the first transmission circuit is turned on by the second clock signal and the third clock signal.

title_en: Parameter self-calibration system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a parameter self-calibration system which comprises a microcontroller, a controllable switch, an adjustable reference source output voltage value adjusting circuit, an ADC (analog to digital converter) sampling point, an operational amplifier circuit, a zero drift suppression circuit and a temperature drift suppression circuit, wherein the microcontroller is connected with the adjustable reference source through the adjustable reference source output voltage value adjusting circuit, the adjustable reference source and the ADC sampling point are connected with the controllable switch, the controllable switch is used for switching an adjustable reference source calibration loop and an ADC sampling point working loop, the controllable switch is connected with the operational amplifier circuit, and the operational amplifier circuit is connected with the zero drift suppression circuit, the temperature drift suppression circuit and an AD sampling port of the microcontroller. The invention relates to a control method of a parameter self-calibration system. The invention omits the process of averaging the measured data of a plurality of prototype machines to obtain the reference parameter in the development stage, can ignore the problems caused by factors such as the precision, the null shift, the temperature shift and the like of components and parts, and greatly improves the data display precision of the product.

title_en: Novel single event upset resistant trigger circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel single event upset resistant trigger circuit which comprises a logic input circuit, a first main stage gating circuit, a second main stage gating circuit, a third main stage gating circuit, a fourth main stage gating circuit, a first auxiliary stage gating circuit, a second auxiliary stage gating circuit, a third auxiliary stage gating circuit, a fourth auxiliary stage gating circuit, a main stage latch, an auxiliary stage latch and at least one inverter which are in circuit connection relation. The invention can solve the technical problems that the level is overturned and cannot be recovered when particles enter the circuit in the radiation environment in the prior art.

title_en: Self-feedback output system and method based on analog-to-digital conversion sampling module
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic communication, in particular to a self-feedback output system based on an analog-digital conversion sampling module, which is characterized by comprising a core processor; the digital-to-analog conversion output module is connected with the core processor through a peripheral equipment interface and outputs analog data through an output interface under the operation instruction of the core processor; and the analog-to-digital conversion sampling module is connected with the core processor and the output interface, and samples the analog data output by the output interface to obtain a sampling signal and feeds the sampling signal back to the core processor. The invention designs an independent analog-digital conversion sampling module, when the digital-analog conversion output module is started, the analog-digital conversion sampling module synchronously starts sampling, compares the sampling with set output data after being calculated by a core processor, judges whether the output deviation of the digital-analog conversion output module is normal or not, and adjusts the output of the digital-analog conversion output module in time.

title_en: Switch tube control system, switch tube control method, switch tube control device and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses switch tube control system, this system includes: a sampling unit, a control unit; the sampling unit is connected with the switch tube to obtain the first end voltage and the second end voltage of the switch tube, and the switch tube is convenient to turn off according to the detection voltage. The control unit is connected with the sampling unit and the control end of the switch tube, and is used for acquiring a difference value of the voltage of the first end and the voltage of the second end as a detection voltage and controlling impedance connected with the control end of the switch tube according to the detection voltage. The working state of the switch tube is judged through the first end voltage and the second end voltage of the switch tube, so that the impedance connected with the control end of the switch tube is controlled, and the switch tube is prevented from being damaged due to overhigh voltage. Therefore, by adopting the switching tube control system provided by the application, the impedance connected with the control end of the switching tube can be accurately controlled, and the switching-off peak abnormality caused by overhigh voltage can be prevented. In addition, the application also provides a switching tube control method, a device and a medium, and the effects are the same as above.

title_en: Signal receiver and signal transceiver
abstract_en: The invention provides a signal receiver and a signal transceiver capable of preventing leakage current. The signal receiver includes a pair of terminal switches, a first resistor, a second resistor, and a pull-down circuit. The terminal switch receives the operation power. The pair of terminal switches have a common control terminal. The first resistor is coupled between the first signal input terminal and the common control terminal. The second resistor is coupled between the second signal input terminal and the common control terminal. The pull-down circuit is coupled between the common control terminal and the reference voltage terminal. The pull-down circuit determines whether to pull down the first control voltage on the common control terminal to the reference voltage according to the enable state or the power-off state of the signal receiver.

title_en: Switched capacitor circuit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a switched capacitor circuit comprising a mosfet-based switch, said switch comprising: a first metal oxide semiconductor field effect transistor (1) having a gate, a source and a drain, wherein the source is connected to a first node (T1) and the drain is connected to a second node (T2), or the drain is connected to a first node (T1) and the source is connected to a second node (T2); a second metal oxide semiconductor field effect transistor (2) having a gate, a source and a drain, wherein the source is connected to the drain and the source and drain are connected together to a second node (T2); a first capacitor (C1) connected between the first node (T1) and the third node (T3); and a second capacitor (C2) connected between the second node (T2) and the third node (T3).

title_en: Battery impedance tester and measuring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a battery impedance tester and an internal resistance measuring method thereof, wherein the battery impedance tester comprises: the device comprises an excitation signal generating module, a V-I conversion module, a signal conditioning module, an orthogonal decomposition module and a signal acquisition module; the excitation signal generation module is connected with the V-I conversion module and the orthogonal decomposition module, the V-I conversion module is further connected with the signal conditioning module and the battery to be tested, the signal conditioning module is further connected with the battery to be tested, the signal conditioning module, the orthogonal decomposition module and the signal acquisition module are further connected in sequence, and the excitation signal generation module and the signal acquisition module are further connected with an external main control board. The battery impedance tester only integrates an excitation signal generation module, a V-I conversion module, a signal conditioning module, an orthogonal decomposition module and a signal acquisition module in an embedded mode, and does not comprise other control devices. The battery impedance test of the invention has low cost, low power consumption and small size.

title_en: Photonic chip, field programmable photonic array, and photonic integrated circuit
abstract_en: The present invention relates to photonic chips implemented by the combination and interconnection of identically oriented programmable photonic processing blocks, all their longitudinal axes being parallel, implemented on photonic chips capable of implementing one or more simultaneous photonic circuits with optical feedback paths and/or linear multiport conversions by appropriate programming of their resources and selection of their input and output ports. The invention also relates to a parallel field programmable photon array (P-FPPA) comprising at least one programmable circuit block based on the same directional/parallel tunable beam splitter with independent coupling and phase shift configuration and a peripheral high performance building.

title_en: SAR ADC offset error correction method and circuit based on differential structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a SAR ADC offset error correction method and circuit based on a differential structure, wherein the correction method comprises the following steps: under the drive of the correction logic module, N-bit correction result information is obtained by performing N-time logic switching and judgment on auxiliary correction capacitors in the P auxiliary correction capacitor array and the N auxiliary correction capacitor array; coding the correction result information by using a correction logic module to obtain compensation direction information and a correction compensation value; the compensation direction information represents the type of compensation; the correction compensation value represents the magnitude of the compensated voltage value; and in a normal working stage, correcting the offset error of the ADC according to the correction compensation value and the correction compensation direction information output by the correction logic module.

title_en: Multi-standard low density parity check decoder
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a multi-standard low density parity check decoder. A wireless receiving apparatus includes a Low Density Parity Check (LDPC) decoding circuit, the LDPC decoding circuit comprising: a cyclic shifter constructed and arranged to simultaneously process a plurality of codewords of a parity check matrix configured for different wireless communication standards, including performing cyclic shift operations of the plurality of codewords to align with one or more required check nodes of a decoder; and logic circuitry at an output of the cyclic shifter, the logic circuitry constructed and arranged for a matrix larger than the parity check matrix and including components with spare hardware due to the construction and arrangement for the larger matrix to decode the plurality of codewords of the smaller parity check matrix for output to the one or more required check nodes.

title_en: High-speed low-power consumption high-voltage driving circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-speed low-power-consumption high-voltage driving circuit which comprises an N-type DMOS tube N1, a P-type DMOS tube P1, a voltage-stabilizing tube D1, an inverter driving circuit (X1, X2 and X3), a low-voltage NMOS tube (N2, N3, N5, N7 and N8), a high-voltage NMOS tube (N4 and N6), a low-voltage PMOS tube (P2, P3, P4 and P5), a resistor (R1, R2 and R3) and a capacitor (C1 and C2), wherein the source end of the low-voltage PMOS tube P4 is connected with the source end of the high-voltage NMOS tube N4, the drain end of the low-voltage PMOS tube P4 is connected with the drain end of the low-voltage NMOS tube N7, the source end of the low-voltage PMOS tube P5 is connected with the drain end of the high-voltage NMOS tube N6, and the drain end of the low-voltage PMOS tube P5 is connected with the drain end of the low-voltage NMOS tube N8.

title_en: Physical layer circuit for multi-wire interface
abstract_en: The invention discloses a physical layer circuit, which specifically comprises N signal connection pads, four or six signal physical medium additional sublayers and M shielding connection pads. The M shielding connection pads comprise a first shielding connection pad coupled to the four signal entity medium additional sub-layers or first to third shielding connection pads coupled to the six signal entity medium additional sub-layers. The first shielding connection pad is positioned between a second signal connection pad and a third signal connection pad in the signal connection pads, the second shielding connection pad is positioned between the third signal connection pad and a fourth signal connection pad in the signal connection pads, the third shielding connection pad is positioned between the fourth signal connection pad and a fifth signal connection pad in the signal connection pads, and M and N are positive integers.

title_en: Oil gun signal nondestructive acquisition device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a non-destructive oil gun signal acquisition device, which reserves an original oil gun signal for a mainboard of an oiling machine in a non-destructive and non-interference manner through double isolation protection conversion of a power supply and the signal, ensures that the original oil gun signal is reliably and stably acquired, ensures that the original oil gun signal is reliably and stably converted and output in a unified manner, solves the problem that the original oil gun signal cannot be stably acquired due to different diversity and strength of the original oil gun signal, avoids interference on an oiling machine line of the original oil gun signal due to the access of the power supply of the device, and achieves the technical effects of being compatible with different types of oiling machines, stably acquiring the oil gun signal and avoiding signal interference.

title_en: Thin film surface acoustic wave device using Rayleigh mode
abstract_en: A surface acoustic wave device (5) is provided which uses a layered substrate system having a special material and a specially cut piezoelectric film (4). The proper choice of materials and cutting of the piezoelectric film results in a low velocity of the excited wave mode, which allows the use of smaller devices without compromising other performance parameters according to specifications.

title_en: Crystal oscillator drive circuit, controller, air conditioner control system and variable frequency air conditioner
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of air conditioners, and provides a crystal oscillator driving circuit, a controller, an air conditioner control system and a variable frequency air conditioner, wherein the crystal oscillator driving circuit comprises a power supply, a peripheral application circuit and a gm self-feedback regulating circuit; the gm self-feedback adjusting circuit generates an additional path of compensating current which changes along with the oscillation amplitude of the crystal, and the amplifier is driven after the reference current is compensated. The method can automatically adjust the amplifier gm until the crystal oscillator starts oscillation stably under various conditions, thereby realizing excellent reliability and very wide application conditions.

title_en: Broadband attenuator
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic communication, in particular to a broadband attenuator which comprises a digital broadband attenuator and an analog digital attenuator, wherein the digital broadband attenuator comprises a switch resistor, a plurality of resistors are connected in parallel between a signal input end and an output end of an electronic communication system, each resistor is connected with a switch in series to form a switch resistor array attenuator, the analog digital attenuator comprises an operational amplifier, a first resistor, a second resistor, a third resistor and a variable voltage-controlled resistor, one end of the first resistor is connected with the output end of the digital broadband attenuator, the other end of the first resistor is connected with the positive input end of the operational amplifier, the negative input end of the operational amplifier is connected with the second resistor in series and then grounded, the third resistor is connected between the positive input end and the output end of the operational amplifier in series, the third resistor is connected with the variable voltage-controlled resistor in parallel, and the control end of the variable voltage-controlled resistor is connected with an external control signal, the invention has the characteristics of continuous adjustability, wide band, constant time delay and fixed gain/insertion loss.

title_en: Data compression system and method based on multistage series decimation filter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data compression system and a method based on a multistage series extraction filter, wherein the data compression system comprises a channel selector switch, a multistage extraction filter, a multistage storage switch, an extraction filter coefficient memory or a filter coefficient generator and a data memory; wherein the channel switch is connected with the first stage of the multistage series decimation filter; all stages in the multi-stage decimation filter are connected in series in sequence. When the data compression system and the data compression method based on the multistage series decimation filter are applied to online analysis of data, the system can compress prepared data according to analysis requirements, so that the efficiency of online data processing can be greatly improved when long data with high and low frequency analysis requirements are considered simultaneously is processed; on the other hand, when the application data is collected in real time, the extraction filter can output compressed data at different stages, namely the system can realize the function of classifying data at different extraction rates of channels, and the actual data storage amount can be greatly reduced through reasonable configuration selection.

title_en: High performance phase locked loop for millimeter wave applications
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to advanced phase-locked loops for millimeter wave applications. The PLL includes an input comparison circuit that compares a reference signal with a frequency divided feedback signal to control a charge pump that generates a charge pump output signal. The filter receives the charge pump output signal when the switch is closed and generates an oscillator control signal such that the oscillator generates an output signal. The frequency divider circuit arrangement divides the output signal by a divisor to generate a frequency-divided feedback signal. The divisor generation circuit arrangement changes the divisor over time so that the output signal ramps from the start frequency to the end frequency. When the frequency of the output signal is the start ramp frequency, the modification circuit stores the first oscillator control signal equal to the value of the oscillator control signal. When the frequency of the output signal reaches the end ramp frequency, the switch is opened and the stored first oscillator control signal is applied to the loop filter.

title_en: Ultrasonic surgical device control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultrasonic surgical equipment control system, which comprises: piezoelectric transducer P, first inductance L  S  Parallel matching branch M  P  Parallel filter branch F  t  The voltage transformer PT, the current transformer CT, and the signal sampling unit, the phase-locked loop circuit and the inversion unit which are electrically connected in sequence. By parallel matching branches M  P  Matching with the piezoelectric transducer P; from the first inductor L  S  And a parallel filter branch F  t  The formed filter circuit performs frequency selection and equivalent impedance adjustment; the hardware phase-locked loop circuit generates a frequency signal and performs fast frequency tracking. The voltage transformer PT and the current transformer CT feed back voltage and current on the piezoelectric transducer P to the phase-locked loop circuit, the phase-locked loop circuit automatically adjusts output frequency to the same phase of voltage and current signals, and the piezoelectric transducer P is in an optimal resonance working state. The invention can adapt to the larger variation range of the equivalent load impedance of the piezoelectric transducer P, and has the advantages of high frequency tracking speed and good output power stability.

title_en: Bit stream decompression method for FPGA security analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bit stream decompression method facing FPGA security analysis, which decompresses a compressed bit stream file through a preprocessing module, a frame address processing module and a data processing module which are sequentially constructed, wherein the preprocessing module constructs a configuration information base, identifies a chip model and judges whether an input file is the compressed file, the frame address processing module searches frame addresses, judges frame address types, sequences the frame addresses and marks special frame addresses, and the data processing module carries out data processing according to the frame address types. The invention decompresses the compressed bit stream file generated in the FPGA development environment to generate an uncompressed file, breaks through the limitation that the bit stream reverse engineering can not be carried out based on the compressed file, improves the practicability of the bit stream reverse engineering, realizes the effect of successfully decompressing the compressed bit stream file, and can completely restore the uncompressed bit stream file corresponding to the compressed bit stream file.

title_en: Multi-channel amplification attenuation phase-shift serial port control multifunctional chip
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-channel amplification attenuation phase-shift serial port control multifunctional chip, which belongs to the technical field of integrated circuit design and comprises a three-level amplification switch network, a one-to-three power distribution network, a first numerical control attenuation phase-shift network, a second numerical control attenuation phase-shift network, a third numerical control attenuation phase-shift network, a serial drive network and a direct-pass network; the invention has the advantages of multi-channel signal switching work, high channel isolation, low noise, high gain, low power consumption, high attenuation phase-shifting precision, high integration degree and the like.

title_en: Semiconductor device with a plurality of transistors
abstract_en: The present application relates to semiconductor devices. It is intended to provide a technique for detecting a low voltage of a power-on reset circuit. The semiconductor device has a power-on reset circuit including: a first bipolar transistor; a second bipolar transistor formed by connecting a plurality of bipolar transistors in parallel; detecting a voltage regulating resistance element; a temperature characteristic adjustment resistance element; a current regulating resistance element; and a comparator.

title_en: Gesture switch circuit, range hood and control method of range hood
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of household appliances, in particular to a gesture switch circuit, a range hood and a control method thereof, wherein the gesture switch circuit comprises: the device comprises a single chip microcomputer, an infrared receiving module and an infrared transmitting module, wherein the infrared receiving module and the infrared transmitting module are respectively connected with the single chip microcomputer; the infrared receiving module comprises two paths of infrared receiving circuits, each path of infrared receiving circuit comprises an infrared receiving tube, and the infrared transmitting module comprises two infrared transmitting tubes; an infrared receiving tube in each infrared receiving circuit and an infrared transmitting tube form a group of infrared detection geminate transistors respectively; infrared transmitting tubes in the two groups of infrared detection geminate transistors respectively transmit infrared signals, infrared receiving tubes in the two groups of infrared detection geminate transistors generate waveforms after detecting corresponding infrared signals, and if the infrared receiving tubes of the two infrared receiving modules collect effective signals, the gesture action is determined to exist; triggering a power on-off switching instruction; the range hood comprises a gesture switch circuit; the invention can carry out switch control with low cost and no touch.

title_en: Handshaking method for establishing MCU simulation debugging single-line communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a handshake method for establishing MCU simulation debugging single-line communication, which can realize one-line communication handshake of a singlechip and a simulator and can prevent the communication error handshake problem from occurring at the same time, the method is realized based on simulator simulation debugging, the simulation debugging adopts Manchester coded one-line communication, and the handshake method comprises the following steps: resetting the MCU; enabling the MCU to enter a RECOVER mode, and simultaneously setting a first communication frequency; the simulator sends out an instruction for establishing one-line communication with the MCU; the MCU sends a first return code to the simulator after receiving the ASC II code; the simulator judges whether the first return code is a third code; the simulator sends a fourth code, a second communication frequency is set, and the MCU sends a second return code to the simulator; the simulator judges whether the second return code is equal to the fourth code; the simulator calculates the clock signals and sends the same clock signals to the MCU; the MCU sends an ECHO to the simulator; the simulator judges whether the ECHO is the same as the preset signal or not, and if the ECHO is the same as the preset signal, the handshake is finished.

title_en: Quasi-cyclic low-density parity-check code decoding method, system, device and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for decoding a quasi-cyclic low-density parity check code, which are used for acquiring a predetermined parity check matrix; adjusting the parity check matrix into a target operation matrix consisting of an identity matrix and a displacement matrix, wherein the dimensions of the identity matrix and the displacement matrix are both p multiplied by p; acquiring a target code word to be decoded corresponding to the current decoding recurrence number; splitting the target code word into target sub-code words with the lengths of p; determining a target operation sub-matrix corresponding to each target sub-code word in the target operation matrix; parallelly operating the target sub-code word and the target operator matrix to obtain a symptom value of the target code word; a current coding result of the current coding pass count is determined based on the syndrome value to determine a target coding result based on the current coding result. In the application, the corresponding target operator matrixes and the target sub-code words are operated in parallel, so that the operation efficiency of the symptom values can be improved, and the operation efficiency of the whole decoding method is further improved.

title_en: Automatic impedance matching method for low-frequency, broadband and high-power underwater acoustic transducer
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic impedance matching method of a low-frequency, broadband and high-power underwater acoustic transducer, which comprises a control system controlling and transmitting a signal source; the water depth transmitter receives signals and performs impedance matching, and specifically includes: amplifying power; impedance matching is carried out by adopting a single-phase Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) rectification technology; the underwater acoustic transducer is matched and works; the sonar system transmits a sound source according to the signals after impedance matching; the control system receives a feedback signal from the sound source. The automatic impedance matching method of the low-frequency, broadband and high-power underwater acoustic transducer adopts a single-phase Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) rectification technology, namely, a wide-range controllable reactor is used for replacing a traditional matching network, the limitations of the existing impedance and the traditional matching network are eliminated, and therefore the impedance and the reactor with wide impedance and inductance adjustment range, wide working frequency range, wide working voltage range, wide working current range and wide power range are obtained, self-adaptive impedance matching is achieved, the method is simple, and engineering implementation is easy.

title_en: Finite element and COM model-based DMS filter design method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a finite element and COM model-based DMS filter design method, and belongs to the field of electronic element design. Including a method of extracting COM parameters from COMSOL, then creating a COM model of the DMS filter using SimplyFortran and calculating the structural parameters. The calculation method for extracting the COM coupling model parameters comprises modal analysis and frequency domain analysis, wherein the modal analysis obtains a reflection coefficient, a center frequency, a surface acoustic wave speed and an electromechanical coupling coefficient, and the frequency domain analysis obtains a transduction coefficient and an electrostatic capacity. And calculating parameters such as electrode thickness of the filter, input-output interdigital logarithm (INTERDIGITAL TRANSDUCER, IDT), number of reflection grids and the like in simple Fortran by using the extracted COM parameters. The invention aims to extract COM model parameters in a COMSOL simulation mode, and parameter extraction is not performed in an experimental mode, so that the design time is shortened, and the design efficiency is improved. Finally, the DMS filter is conveniently designed in SimplyFortran by using the COM parameters, and the scattering parameters are obtained (S  21 ).

title_en: Slew rate control circuit, I2C bus system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of electronics, and discloses a slew rate control circuit, an I2C bus system and a control method thereof. The circuit comprises a current generator, a pulse generator, a pre-charging unit, a control unit and a fast-pulling unit, wherein the current generator comprises a first current source and a second current source; the pulse generator generates a pulse signal according to an input open-drain driving signal to start the pre-charging unit, and the first current source pulls up and clamps the grid voltage of the output transistor at a threshold voltage through the pre-charging unit; the second current source is coupled to the control unit, and the control unit charges the grid electrode of the output transistor with controlled fixed current and enables the drain electrode voltage of the output transistor to gradually drop with a controlled slew rate; the pull-back unit detects the drain voltage of the output transistor, and when the drain voltage is smaller than a preset voltage, the gate voltage of the output transistor is rapidly charged, so that the drain voltage of the output transistor is reduced to a low level.

title_en: Wide-range frequency divider chain based on CML structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wide-range frequency divider chain based on a CML structure, which belongs to the field of integrated circuit design and comprises a main frequency divider chain and a multiplexer, wherein the main frequency divider chain divides frequency of an input signal and performs primary screening, and the multiplexer performs final screening on output of the main frequency divider chain. The main frequency divider chain comprises four 2/3 dual-mode frequency dividers which are sequentially connected in series, each 2/3 dual-mode frequency divider receives corresponding input to carry out frequency division by two and frequency division by three respectively, and transmits frequency division output to the next 2/3 dual-mode frequency divider to carry out frequency division, and each 2/3 dual-mode frequency divider selects output of a frequency division circuit or a frequency division circuit by three according to corresponding control signals to serve as input of the multiplexer. The invention has more various frequency division ratios, larger coverage range of output frequency and smaller occupied chip area, is more beneficial to being integrated in the whole digital phase-locked loop, and greatly reduces the area of the phase-locked loop chip.

title_en: Voltage and current sensing circuit for measuring a load connected to a power amplifier
abstract_en: A voltage sensing circuit for measuring a load connected to a power amplifier, the load for receiving first and second voltages in opposite phases, the voltage sensing circuit comprising a first input coupled to the first voltage, a second input coupled to the second voltage, a first voltage divider circuit comprising an input coupled to the first input and an output coupled to the first output, a second voltage divider circuit comprising an input coupled to the second input and an output coupled to the second output, and a driving circuit comprising a first input for receiving a reference voltage, a second input for receiving a common mode signal of the first and second voltage divider circuits, and an output for driving the output common mode voltage of the first and second voltage divider circuits with the reference voltage.

title_en: Cascode amplifier based on SiGe-BiCMOS (complementary Metal-oxide-semiconductor transistor) process
abstract_en: The invention provides a SiGe-BiCMOS (complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor transistor) process-based cascode amplifier, which comprises an input matching unit, a first-stage differential cascode unit, a second-stage differential cascode unit, a third-stage differential cascode unit, a fourth-stage differential cascode unit and an output impedance matching unit, wherein the input matching unit is connected with the first-stage differential cascode unit; compared with a low-noise amplifier with a four-stage single-ended structure, the low-noise amplifier has better noise resistance and can obtain higher gain at lower frequency; compared with a low noise amplifier with a five-stage differential structure, the low noise amplifier has stronger stability. According to the invention, the MOS transistor is adopted at the input stage, and compared with an HBT transistor, a lower noise coefficient is obtained at a higher frequency; the input stage adopts a composite transistor structure, so that the power gain of the circuit is improved; the cascode structure adopted by the invention reduces the Miller effect of the device and effectively expands the working frequency band.

title_en: Apparatus and method for automatic volume control with ambient noise compensation
abstract_en: An electronic device and method that automatically adjusts an audio output volume level based on a live ambient acoustic scene input via a microphone using a machine learning algorithm trained with Human Activity Recognition (HAR). Having been equipped with such intelligence, the electronic device classifies environmental sounds occurring in the environment of the listening area in which the device is located into different acoustic scene maps, such as speech or dialog (detection of events for environmental human conversation) and noise (detection of events for vacuum cleaner or dish washer noise, for example), and automatically adjusts the audio output volume accordingly.

title_en: Automatic/manual dual-purpose ladder locking switch and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic/manual dual-purpose ladder locking switch and a control method thereof, wherein: the locking ladder switch comprises signal output ends of one or more human body sensors of each floor in and outside the lift car, the signal output ends are respectively connected with respective diode anodes, the diode cathodes are respectively connected with a public conductor, and then the automatic locking ladder switch is connected with a signal input end in the shared electronic switch to form the automatic locking ladder switch, and the automatic locking ladder switch and the manual locking ladder switch mode switching change-over switch are switched.
