The human body sensors inside and outside the lift car start the lift to enter and keep an automatic unlocking state in a multi-point, parallel, relay and mutual control mode, and data for saving electric energy are acquired through data acquisition of the automatic locking lift. After the switching mode of the manual elevator locking is switched, manual unlocking or elevator locking can be performed. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the dynamic power and energy saving, the electric energy consumption and the loss of electronic components are reduced.

title_en: Cell gel microsphere generation device based on high-voltage pulse electric field
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cell gel microsphere generation device based on a high-voltage pulse electric field, and belongs to the technical field of biology. The invention provides a cell gel microsphere generation device based on a high-voltage pulse power supply, which comprises a driving device, an injector, a receiving container, the high-voltage pulse power supply and an annular electrode, wherein the driving device is used for driving a piston core rod of the injector, the receiving container is arranged below a needle head of the injector, so that when the driving device drives the piston core rod, liquid in a needle cylinder of the injector can flow into the receiving container through the needle head under the extrusion of the piston core rod, the high-voltage pulse power supply takes the needle head of the injector as an output end and takes the annular electrode as a grounding end, and when the high-voltage pulse power supply outputs voltage, a high-voltage pulse electric field can be formed between the needle head and the annular electrode, and the annular electrode is arranged between the needle head of the injector and the receiving container; the cell gel microsphere generating device can be used for preparing monodisperse cell gel microspheres, and has a great application prospect in three-dimensional cell culture.

title_en: Photoelectric trigger signal generating device for image scanning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a signal generating device, in particular to a photoelectric trigger signal generating device for image scanning, which comprises a signal processing module, a signal comparison module and a signal processing module, wherein the signal processing module is used for receiving a current signal sent by a photoelectric sensor and converting the current signal into a voltage signal to be output to the signal comparison module; the input/output interface module receives voltage threshold data sent by the upper computer, transmits the voltage threshold data to the microprocessor, and uploads sampling data to the upper computer; the threshold value adjusting module outputs a corresponding voltage threshold value signal to the signal comparison module under the control of the microprocessor; the signal comparison module is used for comparing the voltage signal sent by the signal processing module with the voltage threshold signal sent by the threshold value adjusting module and generating a square wave trigger signal based on the comparison result; the technical scheme provided by the invention can effectively overcome the defect that the error output can be generated when the photoelectric signal is directly adopted for triggering in the prior art.

title_en: Rectifier and continuous logarithmic detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rectifier and a continuous logarithmic detector, and relates to the field of electronics, wherein the rectifier comprises: the double-balance differential circuit is used for rectifying an input signal to obtain a rectified signal; a linearization processing circuit for linearizing the rectified signal to obtain a first current in linearization relation with an input voltage in the input signal, for filtering the first current to obtain a second current, and for inputting the second current as an operating current to the current mirror circuit; a current mirror circuit for mirroring the first current to an output of the rectifier; the rectifier has higher linearity.

title_en: Data mutual exclusion filter circuit and data mutual exclusion filter method
abstract_en: The invention provides a data mutual exclusion filter circuit and a data mutual exclusion filter method. The embodiment of the disclosure provides a data mutual exclusion filter circuit, which comprises a preprocessing sub-circuit and N-level filter sub-circuits, wherein N is more than or equal to 2, each level of filter sub-circuit can compare whether input data currently received by a main input end is the same as historical data stored by the main input end and feed back comparison results to the preprocessing sub-circuit, the preprocessing sub-circuit outputs corresponding data to a 1 st level of filter sub-circuit according to comparison results fed back by each level of filter sub-circuit, if the comparison results fed back by any level of filter sub-circuit are the same, preset placeholders are output, and if the comparison results fed back by each level of filter sub-circuits are different, input data are output.

title_en: Analog-digital conversion circuit, control method, chip and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an analog-to-digital conversion circuit, a control method, a chip and electronic equipment, and belongs to the technical field of electronics. The analog-digital conversion circuit comprises a main digital-analog conversion module and an auxiliary digital-analog conversion module, and the auxiliary digital-analog conversion module and the main digital-analog conversion module are the same in circuit type; the main digital-to-analog conversion module is used for receiving an input signal and converting the input signal based on a reference voltage signal to obtain a first conversion voltage; the auxiliary digital-to-analog conversion module is used for receiving a reference digital signal and processing the reference digital signal based on the reference voltage signal to obtain a second conversion voltage; the comparison module and the logic module are used for determining a target digital signal code value based on the first conversion voltage and the second conversion voltage, and the target digital signal code value is a conversion result of the input signal. By the aid of the method and the device, conversion accuracy of the analog-to-digital conversion circuit can be improved.

title_en: Parallel bus relay method, system, device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a parallel bus relay method, a system, a device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of mobile networks. The method comprises the following steps: a plurality of source information bit sequences output by a bus of a sending end are arranged into a plurality of first subsegments to be coded with the same length; carrying out first subsection conversion processing on the first subsection to be coded to obtain a second subsection to be coded; respectively carrying out parallel coding on a plurality of second subsegments to be coded by a plurality of subsegment coders to respectively generate a plurality of coding subsegments; and modulating the plurality of coding subsections to generate a modulated signal, and transmitting the modulated signal to a receiving end bus through a network. The embodiment of the disclosure utilizes the ultra-short time delay characteristic of the parallel channel coding and decoding method and combines a high-order modulation and demodulation method to realize ultra-short time delay and high-speed transmission of whole-course parallel processing.

title_en: Novel indirect frequency compensation circuit is put to tertiary fortune
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel three-stage operational amplifier indirect frequency compensation circuit, which belongs to the field of electronic circuits and comprises a first resistor R  A , a second resistor R  B , a first capacitor C  C1 , a second capacitor C  C2 , NMOS transistors MN 1-MN 8 and PMOS transistors MP 1-MP 6, wherein the NMOS transistors MN 1-MN 5 and the PMOS transistors MP 1-MP 2 are operational amplifier first gain stages, the NMOS transistors MN 6-MN 7 and the PMOS transistors MP 3-MP 5 are operational amplifier second gain stages, the NMOS transistors MN8 and the PMOS transistors MP6 are third gain stages, and the second resistor R  B , the first capacitor C  C1 , the first resistor R  A  and the second capacitor C  C2  are indirect frequency compensation networks. The invention can offset the secondary pole point in the operational amplifier loop by generating the zero point positioned on the left half plane, and can greatly improve the phase margin of the loop and the transient stability of the circuit under the condition of adopting smaller compensation capacitance.

title_en: Acoustic wave resonator filter
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides an acoustic wave resonator filter. The acoustic wave resonator filter includes: a series section comprising at least one series acoustic wave resonator electrically connected in series between a first port and a second port, the acoustic wave resonator filter configured to transmit a Radio Frequency (RF) signal from the first port to the second port; a shunt section including a plurality of shunt acoustic wave resonators that are electrically connected in anti-series with each other between one node of the series section and ground; and a DC voltage terminal configured to generate a DC voltage across the at least one of the plurality of acoustic shunt resonators by electrically connecting the DC voltage terminal to the first electrode of the at least one of the plurality of acoustic shunt resonators and the second electrode of the at least one of the plurality of acoustic shunt resonators.

title_en: Trigger and reset circuit and method for reading out priority of composite signal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a triggering and resetting circuit and method for reading priority of a composite signal, and belongs to the technical field of sensor chips. The composite signal priority reading circuit is provided with an amplifying module, a comparing module, a detecting module and a priority reading module in a triggering and resetting circuit for composite signal priority reading, wherein the amplifying module is used for receiving an input current signal and amplifying the current signal to obtain an amplified current signal; the comparison module is used for receiving the amplified current signal, comparing the amplified current signal and outputting a pulse signal; the detection module is used for carrying out time measurement and energy measurement according to the pulse signal and generating a trigger signal according to the pulse signal; the priority reading module is used for receiving the trigger signal, reading the address information according to the trigger signal, reading the time information and the energy information according to the trigger signal, simultaneously reading the address information, the time information and the energy information and rapidly reading various information.

title_en: Q matrix-based QC-LDPC coding transmission method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a QC-LDPC coding transmission scheme based on a Q matrix, which leads error vectors to be linked with a matrix Q by introducing a correlation matrix of a reversible quasi-cyclic Q matrix during coding on the basis of a Bit-Flipping (BF) decoding algorithm of hard decision decoding. When decoding, the relation is used to make the values of the inverted reference vector have correlation, and the decoding method is called as Q decoding algorithm. In addition, under the transmission scheme provided by the invention, in addition to a hard decision Q decoding algorithm, part of channel soft information can be introduced during decoding, an RQ decoding algorithm is defined, and the decoding performance is further improved. Simulation results show that when the scheme adopts a Q decoding algorithm, the error rate lower than that of BF decoding can be obtained; when the RQ decoding algorithm is adopted, the error rate lower than Weighted Bit-Flipping (WBF) decoding can be obtained. And the decoding iteration times under the scheme of the invention are reduced, and the decoding performance is obviously improved.

title_en: Piezoelectric device
abstract_en: In the piezoelectric device (100), a connection portion (130) connects a pair of beam portions (120) adjacent to each other among a plurality of beam portions (120) to each other. The connection portion (130) is connected to one of the pair of beam portions (120) at the 1 st end portion. The connection portion (130) is connected to the other of the pair of beam portions (120) at the 2 nd end portion. The 2 nd end is opposite to the 1 st end in the direction in which the pair of beam portions (120) are aligned. The 2 nd connecting portion is located at a position along the 1 st connecting portion. The connection portion (130) has only one 1 st end. The connecting portion (130) has only one 2 nd end. The 1 st end and the 2 nd end are located closer to the distal end (122) of each of the pair of beam sections (120) than to the fixed end (121).

title_en: Reliability optimization method based on high-density flash memory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reliability optimization method based on high-density flash memory, which is characterized in that a gray code arbitration method sensed by flash memory life stages is adopted to realize the reliability optimization of the high-density flash memory, the method is characterized in that a data re-reading counter and a re-writing counter are arranged in a flash memory controller to judge the flash memory life stages, and a corresponding gray code arbitration mechanism is designed for each flash memory life stage to schedule page resources in the flash memory and optimize the reliability of the flash memory, compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of realizing the improvement of the reading performance and the service life of the high-density flash memory by the gray code arbitration sensed by the flash memory life stages, optimizing the extra gray code conversion cost of the high-density flash memory after starting various gray codes, effectively reducing the re-reading and re-writing operation of a background, greatly improving the reading performance and the service life of the multi-coding flash memory based on the high-density flash memory, and being simple and convenient, has good use effect and certain application prospect.

title_en: LDPC decoding method based on packet self-adaptive normalization factor control
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of mobile communication, and provides an LDPC decoding method based on grouping self-adaptive normalization factor control, aiming at QC-LDPC codes in a 5G data sharing channel, in order to further reduce the difference between the decoding performance of an MS algorithm and the decoding performance of a BP algorithm and improve the decoding performance of an NMS algorithm. Based on the overestimation problem of the MS algorithm, the normalization factor of the node LLR message is solved by utilizing the ratio characteristics of the check node LLR message of the BP algorithm and the MS algorithm. In order to reduce the complexity of decoding, according to the change characteristics of the optimal normalization factor, weighted average processing is adopted; in order to reduce the average iteration times and accelerate the convergence speed of decoding, the method utilizes the residual error characteristics of check node information to carry out layering processing, preferentially updates the layer with the largest residual error, and dynamically rearranges the layers among different iterations. Simulation results show that the proposed method can achieve better convergence rate and excellent decoding performance.

title_en: Capacitor array weight value calibration method for high-precision SAR ADC
abstract_en: A capacitor array weight calibration method for a high-precision SAR ADC belongs to the technical field of analog integrated circuits. The invention is characterized in that: firstly, a foreground method is adopted for calibration, a recombination algorithm is utilized for recombining unit capacitors of a high-order capacitor array, and then a background calibration method is adopted for calibrating the weight values of the whole capacitor array. The method is convenient to operate and low in cost, and the restructuring algorithm calibration provides a good initial value for background calibration, so that the convergence rate is higher, and the method is easy to realize on a chip.

title_en: Improved switch with hysteresis
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an improved switch with hysteresis, in particular to a switch circuit comprising an input terminal connected via a first resistor to the base of a first transistor, the first transistor being an NPN bipolar gate transistor, the switch circuit further comprising a second resistor connected between the base of the first transistor and ground, and comprising an output line or terminal connected to the collector of the first transistor, and wherein the emitter of the first transistor is grounded, the circuit further comprising a second transistor, the second transistor being a PNP bipolar gate transistor, wherein the collector of the second transistor is connected via a third resistor to the base of the first transistor, and the emitter of the second transistor is connected to the input terminal, and wherein the emitter of the second transistor is also connected via a fourth resistor to the base of the second transistor, and the base of the second transistor is also connected to the output terminal via a fifth resistor and a diode.

title_en: Switching value input signal acquisition circuit and method with self-detection and low power consumption
abstract_en: The invention relates to a switching value input signal acquisition circuit with self-detection and low power consumption and a method thereof, wherein the circuit is connected with an MCU, and is characterized in that, the acquisition circuit comprises a path of opening self-checking loop and at least one path of opening acquisition loop which are respectively connected with the MCU, and the path of opening self-checking loop is respectively connected with each path of opening acquisition loop. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of universal AC/DC, improved system reliability and the like.

title_en: Clock recovery circuit and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a clock recovery circuit and a method. The clock recovery circuit may include: a data slicer configured to generate an output data value based on an input signal; a first error block; a phase adjustment loop comprising: a first error limiter configured to generate a first error signal based on a comparison of a threshold voltage and an input voltage, wherein the first error block is configured to selectively output the first error signal in response to a first pattern in the output data value; a second error block configured to selectively output the first error signal in response to a second pattern in the output data values; and a voltage threshold modification circuit configured to adjust a threshold voltage based on an output of the second error block; a voltage controlled oscillator, wherein the data slicer and the first error slicer are clocked based on an output of the voltage controlled oscillator; and a loop filter configured to control a frequency of the voltage controlled oscillator based on an output of the first error block.

title_en: System for scanning data before data transmission and marking same data
abstract_en: A system for scanning data before data transmission and marking same data comprises a D trigger, an exclusive OR gate, an AND gate, a CPU, a storage and a data bus, wherein the D trigger is connected in series to form a first group of shift registers and a second group of shift registers, the exclusive OR gate, the AND gate, the first group of shift registers and the second group of shift registers form a scanning device, the CPU, the storage and the scanning device are connected through the data bus, relative static data flow and flowing data flow are respectively sent to the first group of shift registers and the second group of shift registers, the same data is scanned, the same data is marked and stored in the storage as a basis of compressed data.

title_en: LED module, method and driver for controlling same
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an LED module and a method and driver for controlling the same. One example is a method of operating an LED module, the method comprising: controlling, by the on-off controller, the high-side FET and the low-side FET to create a plurality of charging modes and discharging modes of an inductor coupled to the LEDs of the LED module, each charging mode ending at a peak current indicated by a signal applied to a peak current input of the on-off controller; driving the peak current signal to a peak current input through an open-loop regulator that calculates the peak current signal for each charging mode without using a feedback signal indicative of current through the LED; and driving the peak current signal to the peak current input through a closed-loop regulator that calculates the peak current signal for each charging mode based on a feedback signal indicative of the current through the LED.

title_en: Half-cycle delay stepping clock synchronization circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a half-cycle delay stepping clock synchronization circuit, and relates to the field of large-scale digital clock synchronization. The circuit comprises a 1-1024 frequency division circuit and a half-cycle delay stepping output circuit; clock signals enter from a signal input port of the 1-1024 frequency division circuit, and are input from an output port of the 1-1024 frequency division circuit to a frequency division input port of the half-period delay stepping output circuit after being subjected to frequency division by the 1-1024 frequency division circuit; a reset signal output port of the half-cycle delay stepping output circuit unit outputs a reset signal to an input reset port of the 1-1024 frequency division circuit; and a clock output port of the half-cycle delay stepping output circuit unit outputs the delayed frequency division signal. The invention is suitable for CMOS process, has the output characteristics of clock source synchronization, frequency division and delay stepping of 0.5 period, can realize a circuit which takes 0.5 period as delay stepping, can divide frequency by integer and is synchronous with the rising edge of an input signal clock.

title_en: Clock synchronization circuit with half-period time delay stepping
abstract_en: The invention discloses a half-period time-delay stepping clock synchronization circuit, and relates to the field of large-scale digital clock synchronization. The circuit comprises a 1-1024 frequency dividing circuit and a half-period time delay stepping output circuit, wherein a clock signal enters from a signal input port of the 1-1024 frequency dividing circuit, is input to a frequency dividing input port of the half-period time delay stepping output circuit from an output port of the 1-1024 frequency dividing circuit after frequency division of the 1-1024 frequency dividing circuit, a reset signal output port of a half-period time delay stepping output circuit unit outputs a reset signal to an input reset port of the 1-1024 frequency dividing circuit, and a clock output port of the half-period time delay stepping output circuit unit outputs a delayed frequency dividing signal. The invention is suitable for CMOS process, has the output characteristics of clock source synchronization, frequency division and 0.5 period as delay step, and can realize the circuit which takes 0.5 period as delay step, can divide frequency by an integer and is synchronous with the rising edge of the clock of the input signal.

title_en: Multiplexing circuit and cashier payment system
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of cashing payment systems, and provides a multiplexing circuit and a cashing payment system, wherein the multiplexing circuit comprises a first communication interface, a second communication interface, a third communication interface, a first USB switching circuit, a second USB switching circuit, a third USB switching circuit, a charging control circuit, a fifth USB switching circuit, a hub and a communication control circuit: by setting the connection relation among the first communication interface, the second communication interface, the third communication interface, the first USB switching circuit, the second USB switching circuit, the third USB switching circuit and the fifth USB switching circuit and switching the channels, the communication among the devices connected by the communication interfaces is realized. Therefore, the technical problem that communication cannot be realized between single cashing equipment in the same application scene of the multiplexing circuit in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Crystal oscillation piece and frequency device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of information devices, in particular to a crystal oscillation piece and a frequency device, wherein the crystal oscillation piece comprises: the front side comprises a first vibration area and a first pin area, the back side comprises a second vibration area and a second pin area, the first vibration area is opposite to the second vibration area, and the first pin area is opposite to the second pin area; the first thickness of the oscillating sheet where the first oscillating region and the second oscillating region are located is different from the second thickness of the oscillating sheet where the first pin region and the second pin region are located, and the thicknesses of the oscillating region and the pin region are set to be different, so that the condition that the vibration energy generated by the oscillating sheet can be weakened by conductive adhesive in the transmission process is reduced, the vibration energy of a thickness shearing mode is further ensured, the impedance of a device formed by the oscillating sheet is reduced, and the performance of the device is improved.

title_en: Integrated solid-state switch module with low parasitic inductance and packaging design method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated solid-state switch module with low parasitic inductance and a packaging design method thereof, wherein the switch module comprises: a series-parallel array of solid-state electronic switch chips, a ceramic copper-clad plate, a PCB and the like. The invention utilizes the process of integrating the solid-state switch by the ceramic copper-clad plate multilayer plate, the lower plate is used for welding one pole of the solid-state switch array, and the middle layer and the top layer are welded with the other pole of the solid-state switch array. The bottom layer, the middle layer and the top layer plate can circulate current when the solid-state fast-switching module is switched on, and the solid-state fast-switching array is specially sequenced, so that the directions of the currents flowing through the bottom layer, the middle layer and the top layer circuit are opposite to each other, and therefore parasitic inductances generated when the currents flow through the circuits are mutually offset to obtain a smaller parasitic inductance value. The invention reduces the parasitic inductance of the integrated module by specially sequencing the solid-state switch chips on the ceramic copper-clad plate, thereby improving the switching speed of the electronic switch and reducing the switching loss.

title_en: Power supply control device
abstract_en: In a power supply control device (10), a first FET (20 a) and a second FET (20 b) of an N-channel type are arranged in a current path of a current flowing from a positive terminal (Tp) to a negative terminal (Tn). The first FET (20 a) has a drain disposed downstream of a source. The second FET (20 b) has a drain disposed upstream of the source. The cathode of the first diode (26) is connected to the negative terminal Tn. The first drive circuit (21 a) and the second drive circuit (21 b) switch the first FET (20 a) and the second FET (20 b) on or off by adjusting the gates of the first FET (20 a) and the second FET (20 b) whose reference potential is the potential of the cathode of the first diode (26).

title_en: Fractional frequency division system and method
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to systems and methods of fractional frequency division. Systems and methods provide a fractional signal from a delta sigma modulator to a summer, a combination of an integer value and the fractional signal to a divider, and a divided clock signal from the divider in response to the combination and an input clock signal. The system and method also delays the divided clock signal in response to a truncated phase error and a gain calibration factor from a calibration unit to provide output clock signals having equal periods.

title_en: Non-uniform phase-shift optical quantization analog-to-digital converter
abstract_en: The invention relates to a non-uniform phase-shifting light quantization analog-to-digital converter, which comprises an electro-optical modulator, a non-uniform phase shifter and a non-uniform threshold decision module. Analog electric signals and optical pulse signals to be quantized are input into an electro-optic modulator to be modulated, the obtained modulated optical signals are input into a non-uniform phase shifter to be subjected to non-uniform phase shifting operation, and finally, the phase shifting signals are compared and judged through a non-threshold judgment module to output non-uniform quantization codes. The non-uniform phase-shifting light quantization analog-to-digital converter reduces quantization error, improves quantization performance, reduces clock jitter by using an optoelectronic technology, has better pulse amplitude jitter resistance compared with the uniform phase-shifting light quantization analog-to-digital converter, and can better meet the requirements of high-speed and high-precision analog-to-digital conversion application scenes.

title_en: State estimation method of networked control system
abstract_en: The application discloses a state estimation method of a networked control system, which belongs to the technical field of network security, and comprises the following steps: establishing a state estimation model of a discrete time nonlinear networked control system under FDI attack; setting initial values of all parameters of the state estimation model at initial moments; inputting k moment state filtering value at k+1 moment And filtering the error covariance matrix P (k|k) to generate a Sigma point set having 2m+1 points; calculating a one-step predicted value and a one-step prediction filtering covariance matrix of the moment state according to the Sigma point set; calculating a Kalman filtering value at the moment k+1 and a filtering covariance matrix; calculating a new card party check value at the moment k, and evaluating the accuracy of the state estimation model according to the new card party check value; calculating a Kalman filtering value and a filtering covariance matrix at the moment according to the innovation chi-square test value; and judging the value of k, if k is less than N, setting k=k+1, returning, wherein N is the last moment, and if not, exiting, and ending the flow.

title_en: Method for automatically detecting filter pass band
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for automatically detecting a filter passband, wherein, in the first step, an insertion loss curve of a filter is obtained through actual measurement or simulation, and then the highest value and the position of the insertion loss curve are searched through a comparison method; dividing the insertion loss curve into a left section and a right section based on the insertion loss maximum value position, and respectively searching the minimum value of each section of the insertion loss curve on the two sides; and thirdly, setting a pass band insertion loss threshold tol according to the specific application scene of the method, comparing point by point from the lowest value position to the highest value position in two segmented curves, finding a first point larger than the threshold and a previous point, and then performing linear interpolation of insertion loss, wherein the intersection point of the linear interpolation curve in the two curves and the threshold is the upper edge and the lower edge of the pass band. The working accuracy of this application is high, and stability is good, and is better to the universality of operating mode environment.

title_en: Voltage adaptation circuit, method and equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a voltage adaptation circuit, a method and equipment in the technical field of computers. The voltage adaptation circuit provided by the application can adjust the working voltage of the second interface connected with the first interface in the PHY chip based on the working voltage adaptability of the first interface of the MAC controller, so that the PHY chip can automatically adapt to the working voltage of the MAC controller. No matter how the working voltage of the first interface of the MAC controller changes, the circuit provided by the scheme can enable the working voltage of the second interface connected with the first interface in the PHY chip to be the same as the working voltage of the first interface, so that the voltage adaptation circuit provided by the application has better universality and can reduce the production cost and the maintenance cost. Correspondingly, the voltage adaptation method and the voltage adaptation equipment provided by the application also have the technical effects.

title_en: Switch control circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a switch control circuit, which comprises a switch circuit, a current surge suppression circuit and a control circuit, wherein the input of the switch circuit is connected with a direct current input, the output of the switch circuit is connected with a direct current output, the input of the current surge suppression circuit is connected with the direct current input, the output of the current surge suppression circuit is connected with the control end of the switch circuit, the output of the control circuit is connected with the control end of the switch circuit and the output of the current surge suppression circuit, and the input of the control circuit is connected with a control signal. The invention is used for electronic equipment, and when the rear-end equipment is electrified and works, the unstable phenomena of overcurrent restart and the like of the front-end power supply equipment can be avoided, and the rear-end equipment can be protected from damaging the electric equipment due to surge current impact; the current surge suppression circuit has the advantages of fewer required devices, very simple circuit structure, low economic cost and high cost performance.

title_en: Multi-band adjustable gain low-noise amplifier
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a multi-band gain-adjustable low-noise amplifier, which comprises a signal input end, an input matching network, a plurality of common-source-stage amplification units, a negative gain attenuation network, a source-stage negative feedback unit, a common-gate drive amplification unit, a choke inductance unit, an impedance-adjustable output matching network, an output resistance attenuation network and a signal output end, wherein one or more common-source-stage amplification units can be selectively controlled to amplify signals through a first control signal, so that the adjustment of gain can be realized, and the requirement of a large dynamic range is met; and the first choke inductance is controlled to be connected with the circuit or not by controlling the connection or disconnection of the first P-type transistor and the second P-type transistor in the choke inductance unit, so that the adjustment of the working frequency band can be realized, and in addition, the adjustment of a wider frequency band can be realized by further matching the choke inductance unit and the output matching network with adjustable impedance, thereby being beneficial to reducing the occupied area.

title_en: Ultra-wideband low-noise amplifier based on gate-source low-coupling structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-wideband low-noise amplifier based on a gate-source low-coupling structure, which is applied to the field of low-noise amplifier chips and aims to solve the problems that the conventional cascode amplifier is narrow in bandwidth and high in noise caused by high gate-source coupling of a second-stage cascode transistor. The cascode amplifier is improved, and on one hand, a grid-source low-coupling connection structure is adopted, so that parasitic capacitance is reduced, noise coefficient is reduced, and bandwidth is increased; on the other hand, the bandwidth is further expanded by combining a negative feedback structure.

title_en: LC resonator and LC filter
abstract_en: The characteristics of the LC filter are improved, and the LC filter is prevented from being enlarged. An LC resonator (1A) according to one embodiment of the present invention is provided with a first planar electrode (102), a second planar electrode (103), a first line electrode (101), a first conductive conductor (111), a second conductive conductor (112), and a third planar electrode (104). The second planar electrode (103) faces at least a part of the first planar electrode (102) in the specific direction (Z). A first conductive conductor (111) and a second conductive conductor (112) extend from the first line electrode (101) in a specific direction (Z) and are connected to the first planar electrode (102) and the second planar electrode (103), respectively. The third planar electrode (104) is opposed to at least a part of the second planar electrode (103) in a specific direction. The second planar electrode (103) is disposed between the first planar electrode (102) and the third planar electrode (104) in the specific direction (Z).

title_en: Processing circuit and chip
abstract_en: The invention provides a processing circuit and a chip, wherein the processing circuit comprises: a plurality of logic cells; and a thermal sensor located in the middle of and surrounded by the plurality of logic units; wherein the plurality of logic units and the thermal sensor are both implemented by a core device. The embodiment of the invention can be implemented to more accurately measure the temperature without greatly influencing the system performance.

title_en: 5Gbps low-voltage differential signal driving circuit for high-speed serial interface
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of integrated circuits and discloses a 5Gbps low-voltage differential signal driving circuit for a high-speed serial interface. The circuit is suitable for a power supply voltage of 1.8V, and the output voltage swings to 350mV on a reference voltage of 0.9V. The whole circuit is simulated after the CadenceSpectre platform is finished by adopting a 40nm process. A high-speed level shifter for voltage domain conversion is designed, and high-speed transmission of LVDS is guaranteed.

title_en: Multi-LDPC code minimum sum decoding method and device based on global minimum set
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication, in particular to a multi-LDPC code minimum sum decoding method and device based on a global minimum set, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a global minimum set a  p  for each pair of output information vectors according to d  c  input information vectors, the input information vectors including a first LLR information vector U  pi  and a first symbol information vector β  pi , each pair of output information vectors including a second LLR information vector V  ip  and a second symbol information vector β  ip ,1≤p≤d c ,|A p |＝n ms ; generating 2n  m  pairs of candidate paths according to n  ms  elements in the global minimum set of the output information vectors, wherein 2n  m  pairs of candidate paths have different offsets; initializing the intermediate information vector based on the candidate path of 2n  m ; updating the initialized intermediate information vector based on a maximum value sorting method; the updated intermediate information vector is taken as an output information vector. By adopting the invention, the decoding delay performance can be improved and the complexity can be reduced.

title_en: Digital-to-analog conversion device with signal correction mechanism and method
abstract_en: A digital-to-analog conversion apparatus having a signal correction mechanism. The digital-to-analog conversion circuit converts an input digital signal having an input codeword to generate an output analog signal. The echo transmission circuit processes the output analog signal to generate an echo signal. The correction circuit generates a deviation signal from a codeword deviation table mapping based on the input codeword. The echo cancellation circuit processes the deviation signal according to the echo cancellation coefficient to generate an echo cancellation signal. An error calculation circuit subtracts the echo signal from the echo cancellation signal to generate an error signal. The inversion error calculation circuit inverts the echo cancellation coefficient and calculates an inversion error value with the error signal. The deviation updating circuit updates the corresponding relation of the code word deviation table according to the path delays of the echo cancellation circuit and the reversal error calculation circuit.

title_en: Anti-aliasing filtering vibration signal detection circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection circuit of a vibration signal of anti-aliasing filtering, which at least solves the technical problem of low filtering efficiency in the prior art. The RC high-pass filter is used for filtering direct-current components in the vibration signals on the airplane; the programmable gain amplifier is used for converting the differential signal into a single-ended signal, and meanwhile, the signal gain can be configured, so that the acquisition requirements of various airborne signals and small signals are met; the hardware filter comprises an anti-aliasing filter circuit consisting of a multi-order Butterworth low-pass filter and an ADC chip; the system comprises an SOC controller, an ARM processor and an FPGA programmable gate array, wherein the ARM processor is used for data packing and distribution processing, the FPGA internally contains an IP core and an LUT table structure, the FIR digital filter can be transplanted to the FPGA, parameters of the filter can be modified on line according to actual requirements, the design period of products is shortened, and the integration level of a vibration signal acquisition system is enhanced.

title_en: Ultra-low power consumption ultra-wideband low-noise amplifier
abstract_en: An ultra-low power consumption ultra-wideband low-noise amplifier comprises an input stage amplifier and an output stage amplifier which are connected in sequence; the input stage amplifier consists of an input matching network, an MOS feedback common source structure and a cascade matching network; the output stage amplifier consists of a resonant inductor, an MOS feedback common source structure and an output matching network. Through the mode, the power consumption of the amplifier can be greatly reduced under the condition of ensuring the performances of gain, noise and the like through the power consumption optimization technology, and on the other hand, the noise reduction technology is optimized, the noise coefficient is reduced, and the broadband flat gain is obtained by using the staggered tuning technology.

title_en: Attenuation adjustable circuit and chip based on RLGC circuit model
abstract_en: The utility model provides an attenuation adjustable circuit and chip based on RLGC circuit model, relates to electron technical field, and this attenuation adjustable circuit includes: the circuit comprises a switched capacitor array circuit, a first impedance circuit and a second impedance circuit; the input end of the first impedance circuit is coupled to the input end of the attenuation adjustable circuit, the output end of the first impedance circuit is connected with the input end of the second impedance circuit, the output end of the second impedance circuit is coupled to the output end of the attenuation adjustable circuit, the output end of the first impedance circuit and the input end of the second impedance circuit are respectively connected with the first end of the switch capacitor array circuit, and the second end of the switch capacitor array circuit is grounded; the first impedance circuit and the second impedance circuit include an inductive element and a resistive element, and the switched capacitor array circuit includes a capacitive element and a switching element. The switched capacitor array circuit is used for adjusting the attenuation value of the attenuation adjustable circuit in a first attenuation range, the attenuation adjustable circuit can meet different attenuation requirements, and the switched capacitor array circuit has good applicability.

title_en: Power supply modulator and power supply modulation type amplifier
abstract_en: The power supply modulator (1) is provided with a1 st switching element (11) having a1 st terminal and a2 nd terminal, the 1 st terminal being applied with a1 st voltage, the 2 nd terminal being connected to an output terminal, and a2 nd switching element (13) having a 3 rd terminal and a 4 rd terminal, the 3 rd terminal being connected to the output terminal and the 2 nd terminal, respectively, and the 4 nd terminal being applied with a2 nd voltage lower than the 1 st voltage. The power source modulator (1) is provided with a1 st drive circuit (15) having a5 th terminal and a 6 th terminal, the 5 th terminal being applied with a1 st voltage, the 6 th terminal being grounded, the resistance value between the 5 th terminal and the 6 th terminal being changed in accordance with the signal level of a pulse width modulation signal, thereby controlling the opening and closing of the 1 st switching element (11), and a2 nd drive circuit (17) having a 7 th terminal and an 8 th terminal, the 7 th terminal being grounded, the 8 th terminal being applied with a2 nd voltage, the resistance value between the 7 th terminal and the 8 th terminal being changed in accordance with the signal level of an inversion signal of the pulse width modulation signal, thereby controlling the opening and closing of the 2 nd switching element (13).

title_en: Signal transmission device and signal transmission circuit
abstract_en: A signal transmission device includes a signal side electrode, a1 st signal line connected to one side of the signal side electrode, a 2 nd signal line connected to the other side of the signal side electrode, a power supply side electrode paired with the signal side electrode and connected to the signal side electrode via an electronic component including at least an inductance component, and a capacitive coupling portion capacitively coupling the power supply side electrode and a ground wiring or a power supply wiring, the 1 st signal line, the signal side electrode, and the 2 nd signal line forming a transmission path for transmitting an electric signal, the 1 st signal line, and the 2 nd signal line transmitting electric power via the signal side electrode, the electronic component, and the power supply side electrode.

title_en: CONVEX structure quartz wafer, processing device and manufacturing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CONVEX structure quartz wafer, a processing device and a manufacturing method. Furthermore, the middle part of the square plate-shaped wafer is provided with an equal-thickness ring, and the thickness from the equal-thickness ring to the edge is reduced in sequence. The small-size quartz crystal wafer structure in the technology can solve the problem of overlarge impedance in terminal application, and the purpose of reducing the impedance of the quartz crystal resonator is achieved by designing the appearance structure of the quartz crystal wafer.

title_en: Signal transmission method, circuit and memory
abstract_en: The application provides a signal transmission method, a circuit and a memory, which can output a second signal which does not comprise a narrow pulse after processing a first signal to the interior of the memory for processing when receiving an external first signal, and directly output the first signal to the interior of the memory for processing when the external signal does not comprise the narrow pulse, so that the narrow pulse of the external signal received by the memory is eliminated, the normal processing of the external signal in the memory is not influenced by the narrow pulse of the external signal, and the accuracy of the memory in processing the signal is improved.

title_en: High-isolation T-type analog switch and control circuit thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-isolation T-type analog switch and a control circuit thereof, wherein the control circuit comprises a plurality of stages of delay modules, a plurality of groups of inverter circuits and an OR circuit, the input end of a first stage of delay module is coupled with a control signal of a system, the output end of the first stage of delay module is coupled with the input end of a second stage of delay module and the first input end of the OR circuit, the output end of the OR circuit outputs a first control signal, and the first control signal passes through the first group of inverter circuits and then outputs a second control signal; the output end of the second-stage delay module is respectively coupled with the input end of the third-stage delay module and the input end of the fourth-stage delay module; the output end of the third-stage delay module is coupled to the input end of the second group of inverting circuits, and the output end of the second group of inverting circuits outputs a third control signal and is coupled to the second input end of the OR circuit; and the output end of the fourth-stage delay module outputs a fourth control signal. The control circuit can avoid the occurrence of electric leakage in the switching process of the T-type analog switch circuit.

title_en: Elastic wave device
abstract_en: The present invention provides an elastic wave device which suppresses a response caused by Rayleigh waves. An elastic wave device (1) is provided with an IDT electrode (5) provided on a piezoelectric substrate, and reflector electrodes (6, 7) disposed on both sides of the IDT electrode (5) in the direction of propagation of an elastic wave, and having a plurality of electrode fingers (6 a or 7 a) disposed at intervals, and further provided with dielectric films (10, 11) disposed between the reflector electrodes (6, 7) and the piezoelectric substrate in the regions where the plurality of electrode fingers (6 a, 7 a) of the reflector electrodes (6, 7) are disposed and the intervals.

title_en: Method and device for measuring temperature and temperature measuring system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for measuring temperature and a temperature measuring system. The method for measuring the temperature comprises the following steps: acquiring a first voltage value obtained by measuring the current temperature by an analog-digital converter; determining a second voltage value according to the first voltage value and the mapping relation between the band-gap reference voltage and the temperature, wherein the second voltage value is a measured value of the analog-to-digital converter under the ideal band-gap reference voltage on the current temperature; and determining the temperature value corresponding to the second voltage value as the temperature value of the current temperature according to the second voltage value and the mapping relation between the measured voltage value and the temperature value. According to the embodiment of the application, the factor that the band gap reference voltage fluctuates along with the temperature is considered, and based on the factor, the voltage value output by the analog-to-digital converter is adjusted before the mapping relation between the voltage value and the temperature value is inquired, so that the influence of the band gap reference voltage on sampling data along with the temperature fluctuation is reduced, and the measurement accuracy of the temperature is improved.

title_en: Online extracting device for magnetic field signals of transformer winding deformation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a magnetic field signal on-line extraction device for transformer winding deformation, which is characterized in that a sampling module is used for inducing a magnetic field signal into a current signal, a filtering module is used for filtering the current signal transmitted by the sampling module as the sampling signal and keeping an over-power frequency signal, a superposition voltage module is used for generating half of the voltage of a single power supply voltage and superposing the generated voltage on the filtering module, and a current amplification module is used for converting and amplifying the current signal transmitted by the filtering module into a voltage signal so as to realize high-fidelity sampling of the running transformer winding signal.

title_en: Delay circuit of vehicle-mounted auxiliary equipment power supply signal and vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a delay circuit and vehicle of on-vehicle auxiliary assembly power supply signal, delay circuit of on-vehicle auxiliary assembly power supply signal includes: the current limiting control module comprises a current limiting control module, a current limiting module, an energy storage module and a load switch module, wherein a signal input end of the current limiting control module is connected with a power supply signal of the vehicle-mounted auxiliary equipment, a first control output end of the current limiting control module is electrically connected with a first control input end of the current limiting module, a current limiting energy storage output end of the current limiting module is electrically connected with a current limiting energy storage input end of the energy storage module, a second control output end of the energy storage module is electrically connected with a second control input end of the load switch module, and a load power supply end of the load switch module is electrically connected with the vehicle-mounted auxiliary equipment. Through the technical scheme disclosed, the interference of external short-time high-level signals can be effectively prevented, and the reliability of the vehicle is improved.

title_en: Water-to-air cross-medium communication method based on QC-LDPC code
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater acoustics, in particular to a water-air cross-medium communication method based on QC-LDPC coding by adopting an airborne air coupling capacitor micro-mechanical ultrasonic transducer, which can effectively improve the water-air cross-medium communication quality.

title_en: Cache data compression method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data storage, and provides a cache data compression method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring data to be compressed, carrying out binary and DNA code conversion, and then carrying out base layering treatment; acquiring the size of a self-adaptive sliding window in the base sequence and the size of a forward cache region according to the arrangement entropy of the base sequence; taking the arrangement entropy of the adaptive sliding window dictionary and the base segments in the forward cache region in the base sequence as the acquisition necessary degree of the complementary base segments of the forward cache region, and obtaining the base sequence after the replacement or the unchanged treatment of the complementary base segments according to the comparison result between the acquisition necessary degree and a preset threshold value; coding and compressing the processed base sequence by using a self-adaptive sliding window and a forward buffer area, and marking the coding result of the complementary base segment by using a negative sign in the coding and compressing process; the compressed base sequences are stored in a buffer area according to the compression sequence. The size of the self-adaptive sliding window and the size of the forward buffer area are realized to improve the compression rate for storage.

title_en: Automatic gain control method and device based on configurable event trigger
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic gain control method and device based on configurable event triggering, relates to the technical field of signal processing, and solves the technical problem that control and adjustment of circuit gain are not accurate enough in a complex channel environment. The automatic gain control device can identify impulse noise and adjust the gain according to the signal energy of the non-impulse noise part; the single-tone noise and the out-of-band interference can be detected and filtered, and the target adjustment energy is improved according to the corresponding scene; the progress of gain control can be adjusted according to the number of times of adjustment and the communication state.

title_en: Mine intrinsically safe pressure sensor with anti-counterfeiting function
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mine intrinsically safe pressure sensor with an anti-counterfeiting function, which comprises: the physical quantity and electric signal conversion module is used for converting the sensing pressure physical quantity into a voltage signal; the voltage frequency conversion module is used for receiving a voltage signal; the timing module is used for outputting a low level which enables the voltage signal received by the voltage frequency conversion module to be short-circuited to the ground in a timing mode; the voltage frequency conversion module is also used for converting the voltage signal into a frequency signal corresponding to the voltage signal and outputting the frequency signal under the condition that the timing module does not output low level; the timing module is also used for converting the voltage signal short-circuited to the ground into a frequency signal with zero frequency or a fixed value and outputting the frequency signal under the condition that the timing module outputs a low level; the invention judges whether the mining intrinsically safe pressure sensor is matched with the associated equipment or not through the corresponding relation between the voltage signal and the frequency signal or the time interval of the frequency signal with zero or a fixed value output by the voltage frequency conversion module.

title_en: Low-temperature voltage-controlled oscillator circuit with low flicker noise, chip and quantum measurement and control system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a low-temperature voltage-controlled oscillator circuit with low flicker noise, a chip and a quantum measurement and control system, wherein in the low-temperature voltage-controlled oscillator circuit with low flicker noise, a double-layer inductive coupling structure and a transformer structure are adopted, so that a double-second harmonic resonance point and a triple harmonic resonance point can be constructed simultaneously, and a harmonic tuning technology is maintained to be effective at low temperature, so that harmonic waves can be aligned accurately, and further low-temperature flicker noise is restrained successfully; meanwhile, the first differential-mode capacitance regulating circuit and the second differential-mode capacitance regulating circuit are used for respectively realizing fine adjustment and coarse adjustment of the frequency of the oscillator, and the suppression of broadband low-temperature flicker noise is realized.

title_en: High solid content butylbenzene latex automated production data management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-solid-content styrene-butadiene latex automatic production data management system which comprises a system acquisition controller and a data remote transmission module, wherein the system acquisition controller is used for acquiring operation parameter data of styrene-butadiene latex production equipment, processing data signals and then sending the processed data signals into the data remote transmission module; the system comprises a data remote transmission module, a system acquisition controller, a background monitoring server and a data processing server, wherein the data remote transmission module comprises an operational amplifier noise reduction stabilizing circuit, an isolation power amplifier circuit and a wireless signal transmitter, the operational parameter data of each styrene-butadiene latex production device is acquired by the system acquisition controller, a mature data processing technology is used for carrying a carrier wave on a data signal, and then the data signal is sent into the data remote transmission module, and the operational parameter data of the styrene-butadiene latex production device is analyzed and compared by the background monitoring server by the mature computer data processing technology, so that the remote data monitoring is realized, and a safe and stable data base is provided for the automatic production of the high-solid-content styrene-butadiene latex continuous polymerization system.

title_en: Device for adjusting duty ratio of clock signal
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device for adjusting the duty ratio of a clock signal, which comprises: the first signal output module is used for generating output voltage; the first adjusting module is used for adjusting the rising edge of the clock signal of the output voltage so as to keep the transmission delay of the rising edge of the clock signal of the output voltage consistent with the transmission delay of the falling edge of the clock signal of the output voltage; the second adjusting module is used for adjusting the falling edge of the clock signal of the output voltage so as to keep the transmission delay of the falling edge of the clock signal of the output voltage consistent with the transmission delay of the rising edge of the clock signal of the output voltage; and the second signal output module is used for outputting the output voltage after the clock signal is adjusted. The technical scheme provided by the invention realizes that the transmission delay of the rising edge and the falling edge of the clock signal of the output voltage is kept consistent, and avoids the distortion of the duty ratio of the output waveform, thereby generating the stable clock signal with constant duty ratio.

title_en: Six-bit half analog-to-digital converter
abstract_en: A six-bit half-analog-to-digital converter belongs to the technical field of metering and testing instruments. The calibration reference circuit of the invention utilizes a given voltage signal and adopts a voltage division circuit and an isolation circuit to obtain 3 stable direct current voltage signals; the calibration conversion circuit is used for receiving the measured voltage signal and 3 stable direct-current voltage signals and respectively sending the measured voltage signal or 3 accurate and stable direct-current voltage signals to the measured voltage integrator I and the measured voltage integrator II; when the analog-to-digital converter is calibrated, the measured voltage integrator I and the measured voltage integrator II sequentially integrate 3 stable direct current voltage signals at the same time to obtain three time reference signals, the obtained time reference signals are transmitted to the FPGA control system, and the FPGA control system carries out calibration and analog-to-digital conversion of the analog-to-digital converter. The invention is suitable for analog-to-digital conversion of signals.

title_en: Linear regulation of SPAD turn-off voltage
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to linear regulation of the SPAD turn-off voltage. An electronic device is described herein that includes a pixel and a turn-off circuit. The pixel includes: a Single Photon Avalanche Diode (SPAD) having a cathode coupled to a high voltage node and an anode selectively coupled to ground by an enable circuit; and a clamping diode having an anode coupled to the anode of the SPAD and a cathode coupled to the off-voltage node. The shutdown circuit includes: a sensing circuit coupled between the off voltage node and ground and configured to generate a feedback voltage; and a regulation circuit configured to sink current from the off voltage node to ground based on the feedback voltage such that a voltage at the off voltage node remains substantially constant.

title_en: High-voltage-resistant interface circuit, interface equipment and CMOS chip
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a high-voltage-resistant interface circuit, interface equipment and a CMOS chip, wherein the high-voltage-resistant interface circuit comprises: the circuit comprises an input/output interface, a signal input interface, a signal output interface, an enable signal interface, a first inverter, a second inverter, a NAND gate, a NOR gate, a switch unit, a first control unit, a second control unit, a first isolation transistor, a second isolation transistor, a pull-up driving transistor and a pull-down driving transistor; based on the high-voltage-resistant interface circuit, the chip can directly carry out signal communication with external equipment, and when the signal voltage output by the external equipment is greater than the power supply voltage signal voltage of the chip, the switch unit, the first control unit, the second control unit and the isolation transistors can effectively prevent the signal of the external equipment from flowing backwards to the chip through the pull-up driving transistor or the pull-down driving transistor while ensuring the normal communication of the chip.

title_en: Crystal oscillator calibration method and device and computer equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a crystal oscillator calibration method, a crystal oscillator calibration device and computer equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a period count value of a target crystal oscillator in a preset time interval, wherein the period count value is the vibration frequency of a reference crystal oscillator in the time interval; and if the period count value is not in a preset count value reference interval, calibrating the target crystal oscillator until a calibration stop condition is reached. The method provided by the invention can calibrate the frequency of the target crystal oscillator based on the reference crystal oscillator, improve the reliability of the target crystal oscillator, and increase the application range of the internal low-speed crystal oscillator, thereby reducing the area of a circuit board and the cost of components.

title_en: Method and apparatus for providing a reference clock
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and apparatus for providing a reference clock. A method for providing a reference clock signal, the method comprising: generating, by an oscillator, a first clock signal having a first frequency, the first clock signal coupled to a frequency synthesizer; generating, by the frequency synthesizer, a second clock signal based on the first clock signal, the second clock signal having a second frequency different from the first frequency; outputting a reference clock signal to one or more components of an electronic device, the reference clock signal being one of the first clock signal or the second clock signal; identifying one or more spurious frequency components; and monitoring the reference clock signal for the presence of the one or more spurious frequency components, the monitoring comprising: in response to determining that at least one of the one or more spurious frequency components is present, selecting the other of the first clock signal or the second clock signal as the reference clock signal.

title_en: Logic control device and method for analog-to-digital converter and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a logic control device, a logic control method and electronic equipment for an analog-to-digital converter, wherein the logic control device comprises a phase generator, a slope detector, a shift register and a digital delay switch unit; the phase generator is used for generating a clock signal and outputting the clock signal to the slope detector to serve as a local clock; a slope detector for detecting a slope of the received input voltage and outputting a corresponding switch enable signal; the shift register is used for receiving the comparison result output by the analog-to-digital converter and outputting a corresponding shift control signal; the digital delay switch is used for receiving the shift control signal output by the shift register and controlling the switch state of the digital delay switch unit according to the shift control signal so as to control the working state of the signal folding circuit in the analog-to-digital converter. The logic control device structure can be simplified, and the power consumption of the device can be reduced.

title_en: MEMS resonator
abstract_en: The application provides a MEMS resonator for generating timing signals, comprising a driving electrode and a sensing electrode which are opposite at intervals, and a vibrating arm arranged between the driving electrode and the sensing electrode. The vibrating arm is provided with a toothed surface formed by arranging a plurality of first teeth at intervals, the driving electrode is provided with a toothed surface formed by arranging a plurality of second teeth at intervals, the sensing electrode is provided with a toothed surface formed by arranging a plurality of third teeth at intervals, adjacent teeth are arranged at intervals with the teeth to form tooth sockets, and exposed surfaces between the tooth roots form a sensing surface. Part of the first teeth are staggered with the plurality of second teeth, and the other part of the first teeth are staggered with the plurality of third teeth. The teeth are arranged in the tooth grooves, a new capacitor is formed between the tooth tops and the sensing surface, and the area of the sensing capacitor is increased, so that the sensitivity to the applied voltage and the distance between the vibrating arm and the driving electrode is reduced, the MEMS resonator can bear more changes of the gap width, and the MEMS resonator is suitable for the driving voltage amplitude in a wide range.

title_en: Balun transformer
abstract_en: The present invention provides a balun capable of well matching impedance between a circuit of a preceding stage and a circuit of a subsequent stage in a wide frequency band. The balun includes a1 st wiring having a1 st end connected to a1 st balanced line transmitting one of balanced signals and a 2 nd end connected to a 2 nd balanced line transmitting the other of the balanced signals, a 2 nd wiring having a1 st end grounded and a 2 nd end, a 3 rd wiring having a1 st end connected to a 2 nd end of the 2 nd wiring and a 2 nd end connected to an unbalanced line transmitting unbalanced signals and electromagnetically coupled to the 2 nd wiring, a1 st capacitor having a1 st end connected to a1 st end of the 3 rd wiring and a 2 nd end grounded, and a 2 nd capacitor having a1 st end connected to a 2 nd end of the 3 rd wiring and a 2 nd end grounded, the 1 st wiring being electromagnetically coupled to at least one of the 2 nd wiring and the 3 rd wiring.

title_en: Power supply driving circuit and system thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a power supply driving circuit and a system thereof, wherein the circuit comprises: the signal input circuit is electrically connected to the second switch circuit and the inverter circuit respectively and is used for inputting MCU signals; a second switching circuit electrically connected to the first switching circuit and configured to be placed in an on state or an off state in response to the MCU signal; an inverter circuit electrically connected to the third switching circuit and configured to output a first signal to the third switching circuit in response to the MCU signal; a third switch circuit electrically connected to the first switch circuit and configured to be placed in an on state or an off state in response to the first signal; and a first switch circuit configured to be placed in a conductive state and output a first voltage to a first connection point formed by electrically connecting the first switch circuit and the third switch circuit when the second switch circuit is turned on. Through the mode, the embodiment of the invention can reduce the dependence on the driving chip, and simultaneously reduce the cost without reducing the reliability.

title_en: Overcurrent protection system and method of silicon carbide driver, driver and driving system
abstract_en: The application provides an overcurrent protection system and method of a silicon carbide driver, the driver and a driving system. The overcurrent protection system comprises an overcurrent protection module with an overcurrent protection comparator, a voltage change rate detection module and a logic control module. The over-current protection module provides a plurality of different over-current protection levels over time during a conduction period of the main MOSFET, including a first over-current protection level during a first time period of a conduction front. The overcurrent protection comparator receives a current detection signal flowing through the drain of the main MOSFET and an overcurrent protection level at a corresponding time. The logic control module generates a control signal to the gate of the main MOSFET based on the output of the over-current protection comparator. The overcurrent protection module dynamically adjusts the first overcurrent protection level based on the change rate of the drain-source voltage detected by the voltage change rate detection module to provide an adaptive first overcurrent protection level according to the change rate of the drain-source voltage.

title_en: Crystal oscillator
abstract_en: The subject of the invention is to miniaturize a crystal oscillator and obtain a stable oscillation output. The present invention is a crystal oscillator including a package storing therein a crystal oscillator, comprising: a substrate having the crystal oscillator on one surface side and a circuit component including an oscillation circuit for oscillating the crystal oscillator and a heating element for adjusting a temperature in the package on the other surface side; a step portion formed on an inner wall of the package so as to support only an end portion of the substrate from one surface side, the step portion being formed so that the crystal oscillator, the circuit component, and the heating element are spaced from a wall portion of the package; and a metal wire connecting a terminal provided in the heating element and a terminal provided in the package without passing through the substrate.

title_en: Transistor, power amplifier and electronic device
abstract_en: The application provides a transistor, a power amplifier and an electronic device. The transistor comprises an AlN barrier layer, an AlGaN layer and an SiN layer, wherein the AlGaN layer and the SiN layer are stacked on the AlGaN layer, and an AlGaN/AlN composite barrier is formed between the AlGaN layer and the AlN barrier layer and an SiN/AlN composite barrier is formed between the SiN layer and the AlN barrier layer, so that the transistor is an enhancement transistor, and the problem of safety caused by electric leakage when the transistor does not work can be avoided. In addition, the SiN layer is made of an insulating material, and the AlN barrier layer is covered by the SiN layer partially, so that the surface passivation effect can be realized, and the transistor can have higher safety performance.

title_en: Low-power-consumption amplifier with continuous attenuation function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-power consumption amplifier with a continuous attenuation function, which comprises a current multiplexing negative feedback network, an active attenuation network, a cascode network and a negative pressure and positive and negative pressure control network. The circuit is a circuit with a temperature compensation effect and capable of simultaneously controlling an enhancement transistor and a depletion transistor under negative pressure, can realize continuous adjustable attenuation in a large range on the premise of ensuring that the influence of ground state noise and power performance is small, and has the characteristics of wide band, high gain, low power consumption and low noise.

title_en: Signal tracking filter with angular frequency self-feedback function
abstract_en: The application discloses a signal tracking filter with angular frequency self-feedback, which comprises: the device comprises a common-frequency signal extraction module, a phase tracking compensation module and a PI feedback control module. The same-frequency signal extraction module is used for extracting a fundamental frequency component from an input signal, and the fundamental frequency signal is an output signal; the phase tracking compensation module obtains a pulse control signal based on the output signal and the input signal, and obtains a direct current control signal through the pulse control signal; the PI feedback control module obtains the tracking frequency of the same-frequency extractor based on the direct-current control signal and feeds the tracking frequency back to the input end. The application can process the collected signals without angular frequency input, filter out higher harmonics in the signals, extract the fundamental frequency signals and perform phase compensation, realize accurate tracking of the fundamental frequency signals, and can be widely applied to complex signal processing processes.

title_en: Wide voltage range input and output circuit
