abstract_en: A driving circuit drives an output terminal with an input/output voltage using an NMOS transistor and a PMOS transistor. The pre-driver for the NMOS transistor is supplied with a driving voltage and receives a data signal referring to the driving voltage. The pre-driver for the PMOS transistor has a positive power supply input connected to the positive power supply rail, a negative power supply input receiving a second drive voltage equal to the supply voltage minus the drive voltage. The level shifter circuit shifts the data signal with reference between the supply voltage and the second driving voltage. The charge pump circuit is used for providing a second driving voltage, and the charge pump circuit is driven at a variable switching frequency which is proportional to the current of the PMOS transistor.

title_en: Wide voltage range level shifter circuit
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a wide voltage range level shifter circuit. The level shifter circuit shifts the digital signal between a first voltage level and a second voltage level. For a low-to-high transition, the output PMOS transistor is turned on using the first NMOS transistor activated by the digital signal at the first voltage level, and simultaneously the second NMOS transistor is turned off to decouple the output PMOS transistor from ground potential, and the third NMOS transistor is turned off to decouple the current mirror circuit from ground potential. For a high-to-low transition, the output PMOS transistor is turned off using the output of the current mirror circuit, and the fourth NMOS transistor is turned on. When the drain of the output PMOS transistor is close to the voltage level of the ground potential, the second NMOS transistor is turned on using the inverted version of the digital signal, and the current in the current mirror circuit is turned off using the fifth NMOS transistor.

title_en: Low-noise amplifier circuit and radio frequency front-end circuit
abstract_en: The present application relates to a low noise amplifier circuit and a radio frequency front end circuit, the low noise amplifier circuit includes a first transistor and a second transistor, wherein: the grid electrode of the first transistor is connected with the input end of the low-noise amplifier circuit, and the source electrode of the first transistor is grounded; the grid electrode and the drain electrode of the second transistor are connected with the power supply end of the low-noise amplifier circuit, and the drain electrode of the second transistor is also connected with the output end of the low-noise amplifier circuit; the drain of the first transistor and the source of the second transistor are merged together; the first transistor is a floating body transistor, and the second transistor is a body contact transistor. The amplifier has the effects of improving the performance of the amplifier and reducing the occupied area of the circuit.

title_en: Method for acquiring long key value based on state machine principle
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for acquiring a long key value based on a state machine principle, which comprises the following steps: the device MCU detects whether an interrupt trigger signal of key interrupt EXT _ IT is generated or not, and if yes, a key interrupt processing flow is executed; then, starting a Timer0 and starting timing; when the Timer0 generates the count overflow interrupt, the Timer interrupt processing function is called and executed. The invention can obtain twice key values compared with a single key, and can reduce the number of keys and the cost under the same function. Meanwhile, the method has the advantages of high stability, simplicity in operation, high sensitivity, no influence from external environment, simplicity in implementation process and the like.

title_en: Bulk acoustic wave resonator and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bulk acoustic wave resonator and a preparation method thereof, which relate to the technical field of semiconductor device manufacturing and comprise a substrate, wherein the surface of the substrate is provided with a concave cavity; one surface of the first electrode layer covers the cavity; the piezoelectric layer is attached to the substrate and covers the rest surface of the first electrode layer; the second electrode layer is attached to and connected with one surface, far away from the substrate, of the piezoelectric layer; and the sensitive layer is attached and connected with one surface, far away from the piezoelectric layer, of the second electrode layer. The embodiment of the invention provides a bulk acoustic wave resonator, which optimizes the structure of the bulk acoustic wave resonator, so that the frequency of the bulk acoustic wave resonator can be adjusted within a certain range.

title_en: Switch strategy of differential capacitance type analog-to-digital conversion array and control logic thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a switching strategy and logic control implementation of a differential capacitance type analog-to-digital conversion array, wherein a high-3-bit binary weight capacitor is split into 7 equal-weight capacitors on the premise of ensuring the total weight, and the switching strategy enables the capacitance type analog-to-digital conversion array to realize thermometer code control of the high-3-bit weight capacitor under a common-mode voltage-based framework, so that the influence of mismatch of the single capacitors in the binary weight capacitor array can be reduced while lower-pole plate sampling and minimization of the area and dynamic energy consumption of the capacitor array are compatible.

title_en: Calibration circuit for resistance-capacitance time constant of continuous time sigma-delta analog-to-digital converter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a calibration circuit for a resistance-capacitance time constant of a continuous time sigma-delta analog-to-digital converter, which comprises an operational amplifier OPA, a resistor R, a capacitor C and a comparator, wherein the resistor R comprises a resistor Ra and a resistor Rb, the resistor Ra, the capacitor C and the operational amplifier OPA form a continuous time integrator, the resistor Ra and the resistor Rb and the operational amplifier OPA form a differential amplifier, two input ends of the comparator are connected with output ends vop and von of the operational amplifier OPA, and the output end of the comparator is connected with a counter. According to the invention, by adding two feedback resistors, the integrator is changed into an amplifier to realize accurate charging of the capacitor; an integrator realized by using a fully differential circuit discharges the capacitance of the fully differential integrator to eliminate the influence of parasitic capacitance; the RC time constant can be increased by increasing the discharge resistance, and the counting accuracy is improved.

title_en: Signal processing system and method for FPGA high-sampling-rate signals
abstract_en: The application discloses signal processing system of FPGA high sampling rate signal includes: the multi-phase local oscillator generating module is configured to generate a plurality of local oscillator signals with high sampling rates; the plurality of complex frequency mixing modules are arranged corresponding to the plurality of local oscillator signals with high sampling rates; the complex frequency mixing module is configured to receive the corresponding local oscillator signal with the high sampling rate and the high sampling rate signal, and perform complex frequency mixing on the corresponding local oscillator signal with the high sampling rate and the high sampling rate signal to obtain a plurality of intermediate frequency signals; and the filtering and extracting module is configured to receive the plurality of intermediate frequency signals, filter and extract the intermediate frequency signals and obtain low sampling rate signals. The signal processing of the high sampling rate signal is completed, the low sampling rate signal which can be directly processed by the FPGA is finally obtained, the logic resource of the FPGA is greatly saved by multiplexing the multi-phase local oscillator generating module, the mode of phase control is more flexible, and the applicability is stronger.

title_en: Multi-channel PWM wave push-pull output device and method capable of switching level
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-channel PWM wave push-pull output device and method capable of switching level, wherein the device comprises: the circuit comprises n push-pull output circuits, a first voltage switching circuit and a second voltage switching circuit, wherein the anode of a first reverse-filling prevention diode of the first voltage switching circuit is used as a first voltage input end, the cathode of the first reverse-filling prevention diode of the first voltage switching circuit is electrically connected with the voltage input end of the corresponding push-pull output circuit, and the n first voltage input ends are electrically connected; the positive pole of a second reverse-filling prevention diode of the second voltage switching circuit is used as a second voltage input end, the negative pole of the second reverse-filling prevention diode is electrically connected with the voltage input ends of the corresponding push-pull output circuits through the first resistance branch, and the m second voltage input ends corresponding to any one push-pull output circuit are electrically connected with the m second voltage input ends corresponding to other push-pull output circuits in a one-to-one correspondence mode. By arranging the two voltage switching circuits, the high level switching of the output PWM waves is realized, and the mutual noninterference between the outputs of a plurality of PWM waves driven by the same high level is effectively ensured.

title_en: Pin expanding equipment and process for tuning fork type quartz crystal resonator
abstract_en: The application discloses a tuning fork type quartz crystal resonator pin expanding device which comprises a bottom plate assembly for carrying a tuning fork type quartz crystal resonator at equal intervals, a conveying line for automatically conveying the bottom plate assembly, an automatic arrangement device for automatically arranging the disordered tuning fork type quartz crystal resonator on the bottom plate assembly at equal intervals, and an automatic pin expanding device for automatically expanding pins of the tuning fork type quartz crystal resonator arranged on the bottom plate assembly at equal intervals, wherein the automatic pin expanding device can realize automatic pin expanding of the tuning fork type quartz crystal resonator, and has good product consistency and high automation degree.

title_en: Quasi-complementary class B output stage circuit structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of integrated circuit design, in particular to a quasi-complementary class B output stage circuit structure, wherein a triode QP is added between a collector C of a triode Q1 and a base B of a triode Q2 in an output power pull-up tube, and the triode QP and a triode Q1 cascode structure can form a cascode circuit, so that the high-frequency characteristic of the cascode circuit is better, and the influence of the frequency characteristic difference of a pnp tube in a bipolar process on the working frequency of an operational amplifier can be compensated. The base B input of transistor QP is free to bias. The structure can be compatible with a bipolar process containing a JFET process, the triode Q3 can be replaced by a JFET tube, meanwhile, the diode Q5 or the diode Q6 is replaced by the JFET tube in a diode connection mode, the temperature influence is reduced, a bypass current irrelevant to the temperature is obtained, and the switching speed under high frequency can be improved by adding a feedback resistor between the emitter and the base of the triode Q4.

title_en: Bulk acoustic wave resonator
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a bulk acoustic wave resonator, comprising: the array substrate comprises a substrate, and a reflecting structure, a lower electrode layer, a piezoelectric layer and an upper electrode layer which are arranged on the substrate in sequence; the projections of the lower electrode layer and the upper electrode layer on the substrate comprise an overlapping region and a non-overlapping region; the region with the largest area in the non-overlapping region of the lower electrode layer constitutes a lead connection region of the lower electrode layer, and the region with the largest area in the non-overlapping region of the upper electrode layer constitutes a lead connection region of the upper electrode layer. The bulk acoustic wave resonator provided by the disclosure effectively avoids the generation of transverse standing waves and resonance outside a resonance region, reduces parasitic resonance, and has a higher Q value.

title_en: Phase-locked loop pre-emphasis system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a phase-locked loop pre-emphasis system, which comprises a phase-locked loop circuit and a pre-emphasis modulation circuit, wherein the phase-locked loop circuit comprises a phase frequency detector, a charge pump, a filter, a voltage-controlled oscillator and a frequency divider which are sequentially connected in series; the pre-emphasis modulation circuit comprises a digital filter, a pre-emphasis module and a modulation module. The phase-locked loop pre-emphasis system of the invention provides a novel modulation mode: namely an in-band pre-emphasis modulation mode; the invention only adjusts the in-band and out-of-band, thus needing no matching of the in-band and out-of-band; when the invention transmits the data packet, the phase-locked loop is always in the closed loop state, thus the length of the data frame is not limited; the invention does not need a digital-to-analog converter, thereby saving area and cost.

title_en: Push-pull output drive stage protection circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a push-pull output drive stage protection circuit, which relates to the technical field of circuits and comprises PMOS (P-channel metal oxide semiconductor) transistors PM1 to PM4, NMOS (N-channel metal oxide semiconductor) transistors NM1 and resistors R1 to R3, wherein the PMOS transistors PM1 to PM4 are all unipolar PMOS transistors, and the NMOS transistor NM1 is a unipolar NMOS transistor; when VOUT voltage is higher than VCC, according to the characteristic of PMOS pipe, PMOS pipe PM3 and PMOS pipe PM4 open, and PMOS pipe PM2 pipe is turn-off, and VSUB equals with VOUT's voltage, just so can judge that PMOS pipe PM1 is that grid and substrate end potential are equal with VOUT's voltage, just can judge according to the characteristic of PMOS pipe, VOUT's electric current can not flow backward to VCC.

title_en: 12-bit CMOS digital RGB color sensor integrated circuit
abstract_en: The application discloses 12 digit RGB colour sensor integrated circuit of bit CMOS relates to sensor technical field, including the electrical unit, high speed processor IC1, the analog to digital conversion unit, the data sets for the unit, external input unit, the magnification control unit, the power protection unit, the display lamp unit, show the control unit, the electrical unit, the analog to digital conversion unit, the data sets for the unit, the external input unit, the magnification control unit, the power protection unit, the display lamp unit, show the control unit and link to each other with high speed processor IC1 respectively. This application can realize obtaining the higher testing result of degree of accuracy and reliability when detecting the object based on the signal amplification factor of detection part among the adjustment integrated circuit of the surperficial reflection of light intensity adaptability of detected object at the testing process to improve integrated circuit and examine time measuring interference killing feature and stability, and then make integrated circuit's stability and output accuracy improve.

title_en: Operational amplifier, driving circuit, interface chip and electronic equipment
abstract_en: An operational amplifier, a driving circuit, interface chips (1201, 1301, 1401, 1501) and electronic equipment (1600) relate to the technical field of power electronics. The operational amplifier includes a first load (R1), a second load (R2), a first switch tube group (301-1), a second switch tube group (301-2), and a tail current source (203). A first end of the first switch tube group (301-1) is connected with a first output end (outp) of the operational amplifier, and is connected with a power supply (VDD) of the operational amplifier through a first load (R1), and a second end of the first switch tube group is grounded through a tail current source (203). A first end of the second switch tube group (301-2) is connected with a second output end (outn) of the operational amplifier, and is connected with a power supply (VDD) through a second load (R2), and the second end is grounded through a tail current source (203). The first switch tube group (301-1) and the second switch tube group (301-2) comprise at least two input adjusting units (401) with the same number, and the input end of each input adjusting unit (401) is connected with one input signal (IP, IN). The input signals (IP, IN) to which each input adjustment unit (401) is connected are adjustable. The operational amplifier can linearly adjust the gain, and the stability and the adjusting effect of the operational amplifier are improved.

title_en: Method for realizing zero return of duty ratio adjustable half bridge or full bridge output for overcoming parasitic capacitance influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a realization method for outputting return-to-zero by a duty ratio adjustable half bridge or full bridge for overcoming the influence of parasitic capacitance, which comprises designing an input signal logic control circuit and an alternating current output short circuit control circuit, and realizing the parasitic parameter influence control of outputting return-to-zero by combining push-pull signals, wherein the input signal logic control circuit is of a half bridge circuit topology, the alternating current output short circuit control circuit comprises an OR logic circuit, an isolation circuit, a pull-up resistor R6 and a bidirectional electronic switch circuit, the isolation circuit consists of an isolation resistor (R7) and a photoelectric coupler U2, and the bidirectional electronic switch circuit comprises a third field effect transistor Q3, a fourth field effect transistor Q4, a first voltage dividing resistor R1 and a second voltage dividing resistor R2. The invention can overcome the influence of junction capacitance and load and realize the controllable output of the duty ratio.

title_en: Terahertz voltage-controlled oscillator, communication equipment and communication system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a terahertz voltage-controlled oscillator, communication equipment and a communication system, and relates to the technical field of voltage-controlled oscillators, wherein the terahertz voltage-controlled oscillator comprises: a fundamental frequency oscillation circuit and a nonlinear buffer circuit, the fundamental frequency oscillation circuit generating a pair of differential fundamental frequency signals: the terahertz frequency band signal processing circuit comprises a first fundamental frequency signal and a second fundamental frequency signal, the nonlinear buffer circuit is connected with the fundamental frequency oscillation circuit, and the nonlinear buffer circuit performs nonlinear enhancement processing on the first fundamental frequency signal and the second fundamental frequency signal to generate a third harmonic signal of a terahertz frequency band. The terahertz frequency band harmonic generation device can generate a third harmonic signal of a terahertz frequency band, and the generated third harmonic signal has the characteristics of a certain tuning range, low phase noise, high output power and the like.

title_en: Three-stage composite amplifying circuit of electron tube and transistor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-stage composite amplifying circuit using an electron tube and two transistors as amplifying elements, which is characterized in that: the electronic tube (V), the transistor (Q1) and the transistor (Q2) are sequentially connected, and under the cooperation of the transistor (R1) and the transistor (R2), the driving of the next-stage circuit by the output current of the previous-stage circuit is realized, so that a three-stage composite amplifying circuit is formed. Wherein, the resistor (R1) is connected between the base (b 1) and the emitter (e 1) of the transistor (Q1) or between the grid (g 1) and the source (s 1); the resistor (R2) is connected between the base (b 2) and the emitter (e 2) of the transistor (Q2), or between the gate (g 2) and the source (s 2). Based on common PNP BJT, NPN BJT, enhancement type P MOS and enhancement type N MOS transistors, 16 effective three-stage composite amplifying circuits can be constructed by permutation and combination.

title_en: Control switch circuit structure and personal care product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control switch circuit structure applied to personal care products, which is different from the important parts of other products, and adopts two sensors for judging photoelectric signals, reduces the interference of other object reflections on the circuit through certain logic setting, and prevents mistaken touch opening; if the switch function is realized by a single sensor, the photoelectric signal is easily interfered by other objects to be triggered by mistake; the intelligent charging device comprises a main control board, wherein the main control board is respectively connected with a motor driving circuit and a charging circuit, an induction switch is arranged on the main control board, the induction switch comprises a soft substrate arranged on the main control board, a photoelectric induction board is welded on the soft substrate, and two photoelectric sensors are arranged on the photoelectric induction board. The machine body is provided with a control switch circuit structure as above, the control switch circuit structure is arranged inside the machine body, and the control switch circuit structure is connected with a driving part in the machine body. The invention has reasonable design, is beneficial to preventing misoperation, saves electric energy, prolongs normal working time and service life, and can better meet the continuously developed use requirements of users.

title_en: Waterproof system for processing capacitive touch through pressure sensing technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a waterproof system for processing capacitive touch through a pressure sensing technology, which comprises: the system comprises a pressure sensor, a signal conditioning module, an equivalent model simulation unit, a peripheral processing circuit and an SOC processing unit; the pressure sensor has two output ends: vp1 and Vn1, both coupled to the signal conditioning module; the pressure sensor accurately converts the deformation signal into an electric signal, and the electric signal is sent into a signal conditioning module to be processed; the signal conditioning module comprises a programmable gain amplification module 1, a programmable gain amplification module 2, a successive approximation converter SARADC and an IDAC compensation circuit which are connected in a cascade manner; the invention realizes the waterproof grade of IPX5 and meets the requirement of vehicle specification waterproof.

title_en: Dither signal generation method, circuit and SIGMA DELTA modulator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Dither signal generation method, a Dither signal generation circuit and a SIGMA DELTA modulator. The Dither signal generating circuit is applied to a SIGMA DELTA modulator and comprises a random number generating unit, a first delay unit, a first adder unit, a first gain unit, a second delay unit and a second adder unit, so that 7 Dither levels can be generated only by 1bit of random numbers, the design requirement of the random numbers is reduced, the hardware cost is saved, the transfer function of a control code is skillfully designed, the Dither signal has the effect of first-order shaping, and the precision loss of the modulator caused by Dither D/A conversion errors is greatly reduced.

title_en: Trimming and testing circuit, integrated circuit and chip
abstract_en: The invention provides a trimming and testing circuit, an integrated circuit and a chip, and belongs to the technical field of circuits. Wherein, this circuit includes: the device comprises an enabling module, a trimming and testing module, a sensitive amplifier module and a decoder module; the first output end of the enabling module is used for inputting a first enabling signal to the trimming and testing module; the second output end of the enabling module is used for inputting a second enabling signal to the trimming and testing module; the third input end of the trimming and testing module is used for receiving the clock signal under the condition that the second output end of the enabling module outputs a second enabling signal; the fourth input end of the trimming and testing module is used for receiving the digital code under the condition that the second output end of the enabling module outputs the second enabling signal; the adjusting and testing module is connected with the sensitive amplifier module; and the decoder module is used for conducting the test pin with the second circuit to be tested according to the digital code. The trimming and testing circuit, the integrated circuit and the chip provided by the invention can reduce the area of the chip.

title_en: Harmonic suppression-based frequency doubling circuit structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a harmonic suppression-based frequency doubling circuit structure, which comprises a first partial circuit consisting of a broadband transformer network, a second partial circuit consisting of an improved frequency doubler with a common-gate amplifier, a third partial circuit consisting of a fully differential amplifier with tail current, and a fourth partial circuit consisting of a broadband transformer with a trap effect, which are sequentially connected in series; through the three-coil transformer and the addition of capacitive coupling, a trap effect can be achieved, so that harmonic waves are better suppressed while broadband design is ensured. By the mode, the broadband frequency doubling method and the broadband frequency doubling device can complete broadband frequency doubling and simultaneously suppress each subharmonic to a great extent.

title_en: Polar code encoding and decoding method, device, base station and user equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a Polar code encoding method, which is applied to a base station and comprises the following steps: calculating the bit length needing zero padding according to the length of the upper layer parameter and the length of the transmission information bit; adding zero bits with corresponding length at the tail of the transmission information bits; and sending a signal for finishing all Polar code encoding operations to the user equipment. The invention provides a Polar code decoding method, which is applied to user equipment and comprises the following steps: receiving a signal which is sent by a base station side and coded by Polar codes, and recovering coded bits from the signal; determining the position of an information bit needing to be decoded according to the indication of the frozen bit in the coded bits; determining a zero padding identifier by calculating a zero padding position; and decoding the bit with the zero padding identification in the information bit position into 0. The invention can enhance the decoding accuracy and improve the decoding performance.

title_en: High-speed high-precision analog-to-digital converter and performance improvement method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-speed high-precision analog-to-digital converter and a performance improving method of the analog-to-digital converter, wherein the analog-to-digital converter comprises an input configuration module, an analog-to-digital conversion module, a self-adaptive parameter extraction module and a full period data recovery module, correction parameters are obtained through matching among the input configuration module, the analog-to-digital conversion module, the self-adaptive parameter extraction module and the full period data recovery module in a parameter extraction working mode, digital calibration correction of digital signals is realized through the analog-to-digital conversion module and the correction parameters in a normal working mode, the correction parameters comprise jitter correction parameters, gain correction parameters and mismatch error correction parameters, the signal-to-noise ratio and linearity of the analog-to-digital converter are improved, the performance influence of the analog-to-digital converter caused by smaller and smaller intrinsic gain and larger mismatch error with the reduction of the process size is avoided, the random jitter of injection is completely eliminated, and the influence of the signal-to-noise ratio of the analog-to-digital converter caused by the random jitter injection is avoided.

title_en: Pulse wave direct current power supply generator and automatic arc extinction parameter adjusting method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a pulse wave direct current power supply generator which is used for sputtering a substrate of a cavity body and comprises a first voltage source, a second voltage source, a switch unit, a control unit and a detection unit. The control unit provides a first control signal to control the switching of the switching unit so as to integrate the first voltage of the first voltage source and the second voltage of the second voltage source into pulse wave voltage. The control unit adjusts parameters of a first preset period for arc extinction according to the fact that the number of times that the fluctuation range of the voltage value is higher than the range is higher than the occurrence number in the working period of the first voltage when the pulse voltage is in the first voltage.

title_en: Bulk acoustic wave ear-shaped channel resonator
abstract_en: The invention provides a bulk acoustic wave ear-shaped channel resonator, which belongs to the technical field of semiconductors and microelectronics, wherein peak platforms are arranged on four layers of a seed layer, an upper electrode, a piezoelectric layer and a lower electrode and are close to the inner side of the periphery of an actual effective area, the projection positions of the peak platforms of the four layers are overlapped, valley platforms are arranged on four layers of the seed layer, the upper electrode, the piezoelectric layer and the lower electrode and are close to the inner side of the peak platforms, and the projection positions of the four valley platforms are overlapped; the four layers of the seed layer, the upper electrode, the piezoelectric layer and the lower electrode are arranged on the inner side of the periphery of the actual effective area, the four layers of the valley are overlapped in projection positions, the peak is arranged on the four layers of the seed layer, the upper electrode, the piezoelectric layer and the lower electrode on the inner side of the valley, the projection positions of the four layers of the peak are overlapped, and compared with the existing structure, the Q value can be improved by about 30%.

title_en: Triangular wave generating circuit for eliminating direct current offset of positive and negative ends of differential signal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a triangular wave generating circuit for eliminating direct current offset of positive and negative ends of differential signals, which relates to the technical field of triangular wave generating circuits, wherein one end of a current source I1 is connected with VDD, the other end of the current source I1 is connected with a grid and a drain of NM1 and a grid of NM6, and a source of NM1 is grounded; one end of R1 is connected with VDD, the other end of R1 is connected with one ends of R2, R5 and R6, the other end of R2 is connected with R3, the other end of R3 is connected with R4, the other end of R4 is grounded, the other end of R5 is connected with one end of output Vout-and CAP3, and the other end of CAP3 is connected with one end of PM1, one end of NM2, one end of R9, one end of R7 and one end of CAP 5. The patent provides a triangular wave generating circuit for eliminating direct current offset of positive and negative ends of differential signals, and ensures that the direct current offset of the positive and negative ends of an output signal of a triangular wave is smaller.

title_en: High frequency module
abstract_en: The semiconductor IC (130) is provided with a first high-frequency element (for example, an inductor (218) of a low-noise amplifier (21)), a second high-frequency element (for example, an inductor (215) of a low-noise amplifier (22)), and a first via conductor (for example, a via conductor (131)) which is arranged between the first high-frequency element and the second high-frequency element and is connected to a ground potential.

title_en: Active load inductive clamp circuit applied to E-type radio frequency power amplifier
abstract_en: The invention provides an active load inductive clamping circuit applied to an E-type radio frequency power amplifier, which comprises the following components: the device comprises a radio frequency choke coil, a MOSFET S1, a driving module, a parallel capacitor, a resonant inductor L0, a resonant capacitor C0, a clamping circuit and a load. The grid electrode of the MOSFET S1 is connected with the output end of the driving module and receives a driving signal, and the drain electrode of the MOSFET S1 is connected with the first end of the radio frequency choke coil, the first end of the parallel capacitor and the first end of the resonant inductor L0; the second end of the radio frequency choke coil is connected with a power supply VDD; the second end of the resonant inductor L0 is connected with the first end of the clamping circuit and the first end of the resonant capacitor C0, and the second end of the resonant capacitor C0 is connected with the first end of the load.

title_en: Differential amplifier
abstract_en: Provided is a differential amplifier device which can be miniaturized. The differential amplification device (1) comprises: an input matching circuit (MN 1) which is an input balun to which a signal input at an input terminal is input; an output matching circuit (MN 2) which is an output balun for outputting a signal to an output terminal; the 1 st amplifier (11) and the 2 nd amplifier (12) are arranged in parallel between the input balance-unbalance converter and the output balance-unbalance converter, and output differential signals; a 1 st diode (D1) provided between the reference potential and a path between the input balun and the 1 st amplifier; a 2 nd diode (D2) provided between the reference potential and a path between the input balun and the 2 nd amplifier; and a bias circuit (21) for applying bias to the 1 st diode and the 2 nd diode, wherein the cathodes of the 1 st diode and the 2 nd diode are connected with the reference potential side.

title_en: High-speed full-parallel analog-to-digital converter based on virtual metal resistor
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-speed full-parallel analog-to-digital converter based on a virtual metal resistor, which comprises a voltage dividing resistor module, an interpolation type comparison module, a coding module and a latch output module, wherein in the interpolation type comparison module, amplification comparison is firstly carried out, then inversion latching is carried out, only 2  (n‑1)  standby reference voltages are needed for obtaining 2  n  thermometer codes, compared with a traditional structure, only half of reference resistors and pre-amplification comparators are needed, the circuit scale and the power consumption are reduced, in the coding module, the thermometer codes are firstly converted into gray codes, then the gray codes are converted into binary codes, intermediate conversion is carried out by adopting the gray codes, the condition that the thermometer codes are suddenly changed to generate peaks due to errors of the comparators is reduced, the existence of the spark codes is restrained, the stable inversion of output signals is ensured, the input analog signals are directly quantized and coded, the sampling processing process is removed, and the data output delay is reduced, and the low-delay design is realized.

title_en: High-precision current sampling circuit with rail-to-rail common mode input range
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of analog circuits, and particularly relates to a high-precision current sampling circuit with a rail-to-rail common mode input range. The invention aims to solve the problems that the precision of a traditional current sampling circuit is not high enough, the common-mode input voltage range is not enough to cover the change of user demands and the current detection imbalance caused by various non-ideal factors is not easy to correct. The invention uses a symmetrical resistor sampling structure based on an operational amplifier, which comprises two operational amplifiers controlled by logic level: the high-voltage operational amplifier and the low-voltage operational amplifier not only can achieve the common-mode input range from rail to rail, but also have the advantages of high precision and easy adjustment.

title_en: Radio frequency switch matrix supporting single-shot multi-receive detection mode of reader
abstract_en: The application provides a radio frequency switch matrix supporting a single-shot multi-receive detection mode of a reader, which comprises a first type interface, a second type interface and a third type interface, wherein the first type interface is used for being connected with a singlechip to receive digital control instructions, the second type interface is provided with a transmitting end and a receiving end which are respectively used for being connected with ports matched with the RFID reader, and the third type interface is used for being respectively connected with independent antenna interfaces matched with an antenna of the end reader. The UHF RFID detection system has the advantages that the single-channel transmitting and multi-channel receiving working modes of the UHF RFID detection system are realized by utilizing the multi-channel radio frequency switch matrix, and the system can achieve high detection efficiency and reduce the overall power consumption under the condition of low transmitting power in the mode. The UHF RFID antenna has the advantages of realizing 50 ohm impedance matching in the UHF RFID frequency range of 840MHz-928MHz, reducing the layout area of a module PCB and the width of a radio frequency signal wire while realizing 50 ohm impedance matching, and reducing the radio frequency signal loss to the greatest extent by adopting gradual change wire layout between the radio frequency signal wire and a chip bonding pad.

title_en: Decoding method and device based on LDPC code and solid state disk
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of flash memory error correction, in particular to a decoding method and device based on an LDPC code and a solid state disk. According to the method, the initial LLR quantization corresponding to the initial input code word failing in initial iterative decoding is obtained, the characteristics of all variable nodes in the LDPC decoding process are monitored, the positions of error variable nodes are obtained in a grading mode, and the code word failing in original decoding is re-decoded by combining with an LLR ladder type rule to obtain a decoding result with correct decoding, wherein the LLR ladder type rule is used for identifying variable nodes with different numbers step by setting different difference condition combinations and correspondingly turning LLR value symbols, so that the number of error bits in each stage of iterative decoding process is reduced, the error correction capability of LDPC decoding is improved accordingly, delay is reduced, and the use experience of a user is optimized.

title_en: Digital comprehensive dynamic voltage comparator based on offset voltage calibration technology
abstract_en: A digital comprehensive dynamic voltage comparator based on an offset voltage calibration technology comprises a comparison unit and an offset voltage calibration unit, wherein the comparison unit is composed of two three-input NAND gates, the three-input NAND gates are used for realizing rapid comparison of positive input voltage and negative input voltage through cross coupling, the offset voltage calibration unit is used for detecting output voltage when input ends Vin  +  and Vin  ‑  are short-circuited and generating calibration voltage, and the calibration voltage and the input voltage are used as input of the comparison unit after OR operation, so that negative feedback is formed to reduce the offset voltage. The dynamic voltage comparator circuit based on the two three-input NAND gate cross coupling and fused offset voltage calibration technology is realized by completely using a digital standard unit, and has the advantages of small area, low power consumption, automatic layout integration, small offset voltage and the like.

title_en: Resonator, manufacturing method thereof, filter and electronic equipment
abstract_en: A resonator (100), a manufacturing method thereof, a filter and electronic equipment relate to the field of resonators and can inhibit stray on an admittance curve of the resonator. The resonator (100) includes: a substrate (S), a transducer (T) disposed on the substrate (S); the transducer (T) comprises a first electrode (a 1), a piezoelectric layer (a 3) and a second electrode (a 2) which are arranged in a laminated manner; the second electrode (a 2) is close to the substrate (S) relative to the first electrode (a 1); the first electrode (a 1) comprises a first edge (e 1) and the piezoelectric layer (a 3) comprises a second edge (e 2); the first edge (e 1) is arranged flush with the second edge (e 2).

title_en: VO-based2Temperature-control frequency-adjustable MEMS band-stop filter of phase-change material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a temperature control frequency adjustable MEMS band stop filter based on a VO  2  phase change material, which sequentially comprises a SiO  2  substrate, a bottom electrode comprising four independent electrode modules, a Si  3 N 4  double-end solid support plate comprising four plates, a top electrode comprising four independent electrode modules, a Si  3 N 4  insulating layer, a heating resistor and a VO  2  layer from bottom to top, wherein the top electrode corresponds to the bottom electrode, the heating resistor is positioned above the Si  3 N 4  insulating layer and the resistance maximum region is positioned at the two end regions of the Si  3 N 4  double-end solid support plate, the heating resistor is made of Pt to increase the high temperature resistance characteristic of the heating resistor, and meanwhile, the heating resistor is formed by Pt metal strips with different widths to ensure the maximum resistance value of the upper plate region and the lower plate region of the Si  3 N 4  double-end solid support plate.

title_en: System and method based on envelope tracking and adaptive digital predistortion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system based on envelope tracking and self-adaptive digital predistortion, which comprises a predistorter, a digital-to-analog converter, a hybrid envelope amplifier and a power amplifier, wherein a baseband signal is sequentially processed by the predistorter and the digital-to-analog converter and then is input into the hybrid envelope amplifier, and the baseband signal is amplified and supplied to a drain electrode/collector electrode of the power amplifier for power supply through dynamic modulation of the hybrid envelope amplifier. The method comprises the steps of 1, inputting a baseband signal into a mixed envelope amplifier after being processed by a predistorter and a digital-to-analog converter in sequence, and 2, inputting the signal into the mixed envelope amplifier, and using the dynamic modulation output of a linear voltage stabilizer and a switching stage as the input voltage of a power amplifier. 3. The feedback path samples the input voltage of the power amplifier, and the predistorter can adaptively track the change of the characteristics of the amplifier in real time after the input voltage is processed by an adaptive algorithm. The invention improves the efficiency of the power amplifier and the accuracy of the digital predistortion technology based on the lookup table, and achieves better baseband linearization amplification effect.

title_en: Implementation method and device of parallel IIR universal filter
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of filters, and particularly relates to a method and a device for realizing a parallel IIR universal filter; the method includes dividing an output sequence into a first sequence and a second sequence; establishing an internal buffer space with the size of 2Q, parallelly reading data to be processed in a first sequence in a ping-pong buffer mode, circularly shifting and reading out Q data each time, and performing multiply-accumulate operation on the Q data by using Q multipliers; multiplexing the internal buffer space of 2Q, reading the cyclic shift access number of the data to be processed in the second sequence by adopting a ping-pong buffer mode, reading Q data by cyclic shift each time, and calculating Q-order data by adopting Q multipliers. The invention divides the output sequence of the filter into two parts for processing, and each part simultaneously processes a plurality of data in parallel, thereby improving the processing speed and efficiency; meanwhile, the invention has the characteristics of small occupation of hardware resources, high processing speed, universality and the like.

title_en: Automatic testing method and system for ADC (analog to digital converter) of SOC (system on chip)
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic testing method and system for an ADC (analog to digital converter) of an SOC (system on chip), wherein the method comprises the following steps of: after receiving the test instruction, the MCU executes the set ADC test case and sends a corresponding test command to the DAC test board through the SPI communication interface; the DAC test board outputs VREF signals and signals to be tested to a reference source and a sampling channel of an ADC of the MCU respectively, and the ADC samples according to the received reference source and signals to be tested; after each sampling of the ADC is completed, the MCU obtains ADC sampling data, and the ADC sampling data is transmitted to the upper computer through the serial port; after receiving the ADC sampling data, the upper computer performs histogram analysis of amplitude distribution on the ADC sampling data to obtain differential characteristics and integral characteristics of the ADC; according to the invention, the DAC is automatically controlled to output a high-precision analog signal as an ADC input through the SPI interface of the MCU, the PC end automatically processes the ADC code value data from the MCU, one DAC test board can be matched with SOCs of various types for use, and the integrated circuit has the advantages of simple structure, strong flexibility, small signal source noise and good stability.

title_en: Oscillator circuit with voltage and temperature compensation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oscillating circuit with voltage and temperature compensation, which comprises a trigger circuit U1, wherein the trigger circuit U1 comprises a PMOS tube and an NMOS tube, the PMOS tube comprises a first PMOS tube MP1, a second PMOS tube MP2, a third PMOS tube MP3, a fourth PMOS tube MP4 and a fifth PMOS tube MP5, the NMOS tube comprises a first NMOS tube MN1, a second NMOS tube MN2, a third NMOS tube MN3, a fourth NMOS tube MN4 and a fifth NMOS tube MN5, the trigger circuit U1 comprises a circuit structure with temperature and voltage compensation function, and the circuit structure can greatly reduce the frequency deviation of the oscillating circuit output under different working temperatures and working voltages.

title_en: Bulk acoustic wave ear-shaped channel resonator device and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a bulk acoustic wave ear-shaped channel resonator device and a manufacturing method thereof, belonging to the technical field of semiconductors and microelectronics. The invention solves the problems of large loss and low Q value of the bulk acoustic wave resonator in the non-longitudinal mode in the prior art.

title_en: Semiconductor device and control system
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a semiconductor device and a control system. The semiconductor device includes: an electrical isolator; a transmitting circuit that transmits a transmission signal via the electrical isolator; a receiving circuit that receives a reception signal corresponding to the transmission signal via the electrical isolator; an encoding circuit that encodes two input signals and generates a transmission signal; and a decoding circuit that decodes the two input signals from the received signal.

title_en: Broadband on-chip nested loop Alternating Current (AC) coupling system and method
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention provide an AC coupling method and system that utilizes nested loop circuits to generate a differential mode output that facilitates offset compensation and a common mode output that facilitates DC biasing of active circuits. In an embodiment, the nested loop circuit includes a differential amplifier, a differential mode loop that generates a differential mode output, and a common mode loop that generates a common mode output using a common mode voltage and a reference voltage.

title_en: Circuit and method for detecting phase difference by dynamic offset
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of phase difference signals, in particular to a circuit and a method for detecting a phase difference by dynamic offset, which aim to solve the problem that the phase difference is seriously distorted by time delay in the clock calculation process in the prior art and cannot be accurately calculated. Each group of phase difference calculation units of the phase difference calculation circuit outputs synchronous phase difference pulses to form a pulse diagram; each group of phase difference dynamic shifting units of the phase difference dynamic shifting circuit outputs synchronous shifting phase difference signals to form a phase difference shifting diagram. The phase difference is calculated by multiplying the number of synchronous phase difference pulses in the pulse diagram by the time of one synchronous phase difference pulse by the offset time of the first synchronous offset phase difference signal to the Nth synchronous offset phase difference signal in the phase difference offset diagram. The offset time of the phase difference signal is added into the synchronous phase difference pulse, so that the time delay error in the clock calculation process can be compensated, and the phase difference calculation result is more accurate.

title_en: Channel data processing method, EIT data processing method and related equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a channel data processing method, an EIT data processing method and related equipment, comprising the following steps: after the channel is opened, analog signals output by the channel are subjected to analog-to-digital conversion continuously, and conversion results are distributed to a plurality of data calculation modules through ping-pong operation; after any data calculation module obtains a group of data, the data are processed by utilizing FFT and CFAR to obtain a first target amplitude and a second target amplitude; judging whether all the frequency conditions, the signal-to-noise ratio conditions and the consistency conditions are met based on the target amplitude; if yes, determining the first target amplitude as the amplitude of the channel in the current frame; if not, controlling another data calculation module to acquire a new group of data, and returning to execute corresponding calculation. According to the method and the device, the data stream after the channel is opened is processed in a ping-pong operation mode, the data meeting the frequency condition, the signal-to-noise ratio condition and the consistency condition is adaptively positioned, the idle period of the data is not required to be preset according to experience, and the EIT frame rate is improved.

title_en: Amplifying circuit and capacitance distribution method
abstract_en: The application provides an amplifying circuit and a capacitance distribution method, wherein the amplifying circuit comprises: the device comprises a sampling module, an amplifying module and a feedback module; the sampling module is connected with the amplifying module, and the feedback module is connected with the amplifying module; the sampling module comprises a capacitance to be distributed and a capacitance distribution unit, and the capacitance distribution unit is used for distributing partial capacitance of the capacitance to be distributed to the amplifying module and the feedback module. And in the initial state of the amplifying circuit, the capacitor is sampled, and the amplifying capacitor and the feedback capacitor have a proportional relationship. The sampling capacitance, the amplifying capacitance and the feedback capacitance are taken into account through the proportionality coefficient, so that the input voltage can be full, and the convenience is improved. The capacitance distribution method comprises the following steps: the sampling capacitor is expanded by a preset multiple, and meanwhile, the capacitor is distributed to the amplifying capacitor and the feedback capacitor to enable the amplified sampling capacitor, the distributed amplifying capacitor and the distributed feedback capacitor meet the proportional relation, and the utilization rate of the capacitor in the circuit is increased through the amplification.

title_en: Key function identification circuit and method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the field of sensor application and discloses a key function identification circuit and a method. In the invention, by connecting a plurality of keys respectively to each channel interface of the multi-channel key controller, after setting different functions of different key trigger combinations and key trigger sequences, the functions corresponding to the triggered key combinations and/or the triggered key sequences can be identified by the multi-channel key controller; the mode of combining keys avoids single-key false touch, and as each channel of the multi-channel key controller corresponds to one key group respectively, namely each key in the same key group is connected with the same channel without increasing the number of channels, the expansion of key functions is realized on the basis of the original single key function of the low-channel key controller, the application potential of the low-channel key controller is developed, and more key functions are realized with lower cost.

title_en: Open-loop and closed-loop combined QAM signal carrier phase tracking method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for tracking the carrier phase of a QAM signal by combining an open loop and a closed loop, which comprises the following steps: during the loop updating period, carrying out carrier phase stripping on the input baseband complex signal to obtain a baseband complex signal; according to the theoretical constellation diagram, performing symbol judgment on the baseband complex signal to obtain a judged symbol; inputting the baseband complex signal and the judged symbol to a phase discriminator to obtain a carrier phase error; modeling the carrier phase error as a second order polynomial function and estimating values of coefficients in the second order polynomial function by carrier phase error open loop during a loop update interval; and obtaining the carrier phase error of the loop through the values of the coefficients in the second-order polynomial function, and generating a carrier frequency predicted value to strip the carrier phase in the next loop updating period, thereby solving the problem that the DD-PLL loop with low updating frequency cannot correct short-term carrier phase fluctuation caused by phase noise.

title_en: Nested delta-sigma analog-to-digital conversion system and method
abstract_en: A nested delta-sigma analog-to-digital conversion system and method, comprising: the digital-to-analog converter comprises an analog filter, an analog comparator, a first feedback digital-to-analog converter, a second feedback digital-to-analog converter, a digital filter and an MSB quantizer, wherein the second feedback digital-to-analog converter is arranged in front of the first feedback digital-to-analog converter, the digital filter and the MSB quantizer are sequentially connected, the input end of the first feedback digital-to-analog converter is connected with the output end of the analog comparator, the analog filter, the analog comparator and the first feedback digital-to-analog converter form an internal analog delta-sigma loop, the input end of the second feedback digital-to-analog converter is connected with the output end of the MSB quantizer, the output end of the second feedback digital-to-analog converter is connected with the input end of the analog filter, and the second feedback digital-to-analog converter, the internal analog delta-sigma loop, the digital filter and the MSB quantizer form an external mixed delta-sigma loop. According to the invention, the signal swing of the internal analog delta-sigma loop is dynamically adjusted through the nested external digital-analog external mixed delta-sigma loop, so that the design difficulty of the internal analog delta-sigma loop can be reduced, and the energy efficiency and the accuracy are obviously improved.

title_en: Quadruple frequency device and frequency source
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quad-frequency and a frequency source. The quad-frequency comprises: an input matching network for converting a single-ended input signal to a first differential signal; the first-stage frequency doubling module is used for carrying out frequency doubling output on the first differential signal; the interstage matching network is used for converting the frequency doubling signal into a second differential signal; the second-stage frequency doubling module is used for carrying out frequency doubling output on the second differential signal to generate a quadruple frequency signal; the output matching network is used for amplifying and filtering the quadruple frequency signal; the first-stage frequency doubling module is of a phase control stack double-push frequency doubling structure; and/or the second-stage frequency doubling module is a multi-port driving matching stack double-push frequency doubling structure. The embodiment of the invention improves the coordination capability of broadband and harmonic suppression of the quadrupler.

title_en: Circuit arrangement, communication device and method for biasing a transistor stack
abstract_en: The invention relates to a circuit arrangement, a communication device and a method for biasing a transistor stack. The circuit arrangement comprises a transistor stack and a bias circuit of a replica circuit comprising the transistor stack, the circuit arrangement being operated in at least an active mode and a standby mode, during operation in the active mode the bias circuit generating an input gate bias voltage based on a reference current conducted through the replica circuit, the bias circuit generating a bias voltage to a cascode transistor of the replica circuit, the bias voltage being substantially equal to a bias voltage to a corresponding cascode transistor of the transistor stack during operation in the active mode and during operation in the standby mode, and the bias circuit generating a bias voltage to the cascode transistor of the replica circuit during operation in the standby mode, the bias voltage being substantially equal to a bias voltage to the cascode transistor of the replica circuit during operation in the active mode.

title_en: Dual-mode power amplifier, power amplifying method and related equipment thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a dual-mode power amplifier, a power amplifying method and a related device thereof, wherein the dual-mode power amplifier comprises three switches, a gain mode circuit and a differential mode circuit, the first switch controls the on-off of the gain mode circuit, the second switch and the third switch control the on-off of the differential mode circuit, the gain mode circuit is formed by connecting three stages of power amplifying circuits in series, the differential mode circuit is formed by connecting a first voltage transformation circuit with a second voltage transformation circuit in series through a differential parallel circuit, and the differential parallel circuit is formed by connecting a first differential serial circuit with a second differential serial circuit in parallel. Therefore, the dual-mode power amplifier comprises two mode circuits, a multi-stage differential circuit structure is adopted in the differential mode circuit, high broadband performance and high linearity are realized, the dual-mode power amplifier can be freely switched when the requirement for improving gain or the requirement for high linearity and broadband exists, the limitation that the traditional dual-mode power amplifier is only applied to the power amplification efficiency is broken through, and the application mode of the power amplifier is widened.

title_en: Signal acquisition circuit and wearable equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a signal acquisition circuit and wearable equipment. The signal acquisition circuit comprises a differential amplifier, a first electrode, a second electrode, a first negative capacitance circuit and a second negative capacitance circuit. The first electrode is connected with the first input end of the differential amplifier through a first lead wire, and the second electrode is connected with the second input end of the differential amplifier through a second lead wire. The first negative capacitance circuit is electrically connected with the first lead and the ground wire, the second negative capacitance circuit is electrically connected with the second lead and the ground wire, and both the first negative capacitance circuit and the second negative capacitance circuit have negative capacitance effects.

title_en: Switch protection structure and switch protection device
abstract_en: The invention provides a switch protection structure and a switch protection device, comprising: the control signal input end, the switching circuit and the two current discharge-extraction modules; the switch circuit is connected with the control signal input end; the two current discharging-extracting modules are respectively arranged at two ends of the switch circuit; the first end of the switch circuit is connected with the input end of the switch protection structure; the second end of the switch circuit is connected with the output end of the switch protection structure. In the mode, by arranging the current discharging-extracting modules at the two ends of the switching circuit respectively, when the switching circuit is disconnected and the input voltage of the first end of the switching circuit exceeds the power supply voltage or is lower than the ground level, the current discharging-extracting modules can discharge the input voltage to the ground end or generate the extracted current, so that the voltage of the second end of the switching circuit is not influenced by the first end, and the safe operation of the circuit is further ensured.

title_en: Multi-order Kalman carrier tracking method, tracking loop and signal receiver for QAM signals
abstract_en: The application provides a multi-order Kalman carrier tracking method for QAM signals, which comprises the following steps: predicting the signal residual error vector of the starting moment of the next tracking period according to the signal residual error vector of the preset QAM signal of the starting moment of the previous tracking period; calculating and updating a priori covariance matrix of a signal residual error vector of the QAM signal at the starting moment of the next tracking period; estimating a residual carrier phase error estimation value of the QAM signal at the beginning moment of the next tracking period; and correcting the signal frequency and phase error of the QAM signal at the starting moment of the next tracking period to obtain a corrected QAM signal. The application also provides a multi-order Kalman carrier tracking loop and a signal receiver. The application can realize high-precision and steady tracking of the QAM signal with high dynamic and low signal-to-noise ratio, and can meet the requirements of high dynamic scene and wide phase-locked loop bandwidth during carrier phase tracking of the QAM signal.

title_en: Electronic component
abstract_en: The invention aims to prevent interface peeling caused by stress of an insulating layer in an electronic component having 3 or more conductor layers in which a capacitor and an inductor are integrated. The electronic component (1) of the present invention is provided with: a conductor layer (M1) including a conductor pattern (25) constituting an inductor; a conductor pattern (31) that overlaps a part of the conductor pattern (25) with the dielectric film (4) interposed therebetween; an insulating layer (11) that covers the conductor layer (M1) and the conductor pattern (31); a conductor layer (M2) which is provided on the insulating layer (11) and which includes a conductor pattern (55) that constitutes an inductor; and an insulating layer (12) that covers the conductor layer (M2). The conductor layer (M2) further includes: and a dummy pattern (56) which is provided separately from or branched from the conductor pattern (55) and overlaps the conductor pattern (31). Thus, since the stress of the insulating layer (12) is not directly applied to the conductor pattern (31), peeling at the interface between the conductor layer (M1) and the dielectric film (4) is prevented.

title_en: Dual-power priority selection circuit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dual-power priority selection circuit which comprises a dual-power-on reset synthesis circuit, a two-phase non-overlapping RS trigger circuit and a level converter, wherein the dual-power-on reset synthesis circuit is used for monitoring the condition of dual power supplies and generating a power-on reset signal and a synthesized output signal according to the condition of the dual power supplies, the dual-power-on reset synthesis circuit comprises two input ends and two output ends, the two input ends are respectively connected with the two power supply ends of the dual power supplies and are used for outputting the generated power-on reset signal, the two-phase non-overlapping RS trigger circuit is used for taking the synthesized output signal as a power supply and generating a corresponding level signal according to the power-on reset signal, and the level converter is used for converting the level signal into a power supply control signal. The invention enables the system to automatically select among different input power supplies so as to avoid power supply conflict.

title_en: Amplifying device
abstract_en: The amplifying device comprises an amplifying circuit and a protection circuit. The amplifying circuit is provided with an input end for receiving the radio frequency signal and an output end for outputting the amplified radio frequency signal. The amplifying circuit includes a transistor. The transistor has a first terminal, a second terminal and a control terminal. The first end of the transistor outputs the amplified radio frequency signal, and the control end of the transistor is coupled to the input end of the amplifying circuit. The first end of the protection circuit is coupled to the input end or the output end of the amplifying circuit. The protection circuit comprises a switch unit and a clamping unit. The switch unit is controlled by a first control signal to be turned on or turned off. The clamping unit is coupled to the switching unit. When the switch unit is turned on, the clamp unit clamps the voltage of the first end of the protection circuit within a predetermined range.

title_en: Electronic device and tactile button assembly for electronic device
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to electronic devices and haptic button assemblies for electronic devices. An electronic device includes: a housing including a sidewall defining an opening; a tactile button assembly, the tactile button assembly comprising: an input member positioned within the opening and defining an input surface; a magnetic component positioned in the housing and coupled to the input member, the magnetic component configured to generate a magnetic flux; and a conductive loop having a conductive section configured to conduct current through the magnetic flux in a direction transverse to a local flux direction of the magnetic flux; and a processing unit positioned in the housing and configured to cause the current to be conducted through the conductive loop, thereby causing lateral translation of the input member in a translation direction substantially parallel to the input surface, thereby producing a haptic output.

title_en: Signal generating device capable of suppressing noise
abstract_en: The present application relates to a signal generating apparatus capable of suppressing noise. A signal generating apparatus includes: a glitch suppression circuit including n m-stage inverters coupled in series and configured to receive an input signal and perform an inverting operation on the input signal based on a plurality of voltage signals to generate an output signal, and when a glitch occurs in the input signal, adjust switching threshold voltages of the m-stage inverters based on the plurality of voltage signals to generate a glitch removed output signal; a level detection circuit configured to detect a logic level of the output signal supplied from the glitch suppression circuit to generate a level detection signal and a complementary level detection signal; and a voltage signal generation circuit configured to receive the input signal, the complementary input signal, the level detection signal, and the complementary level detection signal, to generate a plurality of voltage signals, and to provide the plurality of voltage signals to the glitch suppression circuit.

title_en: Error amplifier and power supply
abstract_en: The invention provides an error amplifier and a power supply. In the error amplifier, when feedback voltage fluctuates, the feedback voltage can be amplified through the pre-amplifier, so that a pull-up circuit, a pull-down circuit or a steady-state circuit can be accurately gated, the precision requirement on each transconductance amplifier can be reduced, and the design requirement of the error amplifier is reduced. And when the load step jumps, the voltage at the output end of the error amplifier is pulled up or pulled down at a faster speed by gating the pull-up circuit or the pull-down circuit, so that the load transient response performance of the loop is effectively improved, and the stability of the loop is not influenced.

title_en: 1/2 sine window function signal generating device and filtering signal generating system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a generation device of a 1/2 sine window function signal and a generation system of a filtering signal, wherein the device comprises: adder, subtracter, first integrator, second integrator and delayer; the subtracter, the first integrator and the second integrator are sequentially connected, the second integrator is connected with the subtracter to form closed loop feedback, the first integrator is respectively connected with the adder and the delayer, and the delayer is connected with the adder. The invention can sequentially transmit the input signals to the subtracter, the integrator, the delayer and the adder, generates a 1/2 sine window function through the subtracter, the integrator, the delayer and the adder, is different from the existing window function, constructs a fastest tracking filter through the 1/2 sine window function signals, realizes the fastest filtering tracking, breaks through an exponential tracking mechanism, and can improve the filtering processing effect and filtering performance.

title_en: Reference signal switching circuit, test circuit and test instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reference signal switching circuit, a test circuit and a test instrument, wherein the switching circuit comprises an input end, a channel for receiving an input signal, and a control circuit, wherein the input signal comprises an internal reference signal and an external reference signal, and the internal reference signal or the external reference signal is input into the channel in a selective mode each time; the phase-locked loop is arranged at the output port of the channel and comprises a loop filter; the output end outputs an internal reference signal from the output end after the internal reference signal or the external reference signal passes through the phase-locked loop; the output end of the loop filter is provided with a first constant-temperature crystal oscillator; when the channel is input with an internal reference signal or an external reference signal, the first constant temperature crystal oscillator generates an internal reference signal after passing through the loop filter. The invention not only ensures the synchronization problem of using the variable external reference signal, but also solves the problem of phase noise deterioration of using the external reference signal.

title_en: Implementation method of numerical control oscillator based on improved CORDIC algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing a numerical control oscillator based on an improved CORDIC algorithm, which has the defects of large occupied resources and relatively low resolving speed. The system performs code writing and simulation at Quartus, modelSim. Simulation results show that the structure provided by the invention can improve the running speed of the system from 217.77MHz to 291.04MHz, and improves the output efficiency of the system. Has a value which can be realized in particular.

title_en: Self-adaptive double-threshold generator based on nonlinear energy operator for action potential detection
abstract_en: The self-adaptive double-threshold generator based on the nonlinear energy operator is used for detecting action potential, wherein the NEO circuit generates a proper positive threshold and a proper negative threshold through signal processing to be detected, the positive threshold and the negative threshold are transmitted to a peak voltage comparator and a valley voltage comparator through a peak value holding circuit and a valley voltage holding circuit, a signal to be detected is compared with the positive threshold and the negative threshold through the peak voltage comparator and the negative voltage comparator respectively, the negative threshold is detected, the positive peak is captured only in a window period and exceeds the positive threshold through a window delay circuit, authentication detection of an action point is achieved, then the positive peak and the negative peak are overlapped through an adder, a synthesized detection result is output, and finally counting of the number of action potentials contained in the signal to be detected is completed through a counter, so that the self-adaptive double-threshold action potential detection based on the nonlinear energy operator is achieved.

title_en: Synchronous-asynchronous hybrid counter and semiconductor device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a synchronous-asynchronous mixed counter, which comprises the following components: an asynchronous counter and a synchronous counter; the asynchronous counter comprises a first trigger, a second trigger, a third trigger, a fourth trigger and a fifth trigger, wherein the first trigger, the second trigger, the third trigger and the fourth trigger are configured to asynchronously count based on a first clock signal; the output signal of the n-th trigger is used as a second clock signal; the synchronous counter comprises an n+1th to n+mth flip-flops, and the n+1th to n+mth flip-flops are configured to synchronously count based on a second clock signal; the first output ends of the first flip-flop to the n+m flip-flop output signals as the output of the synchronous-asynchronous hybrid counter; and determining the number of the triggers of the asynchronous counter and the synchronous counter according to preset conditions. The invention overcomes the defects of the traditional single synchronous counter or asynchronous counter, and the counter with higher working efficiency, simple wiring and small area is obtained by synchronous-asynchronous mixing. In addition, a semiconductor device is also provided.

title_en: Clock jitter removing system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of integrated circuits, and particularly relates to a clock jitter removing system.
