A clock jitter-removing system comprises a reference clock end, a phase-locked loop, an input clock end and an output clock end, wherein the reference clock end is connected with the phase-locked loop; further comprises: the input end of the first time-to-digital converter is respectively connected with the reference clock end and the input clock end; the input end of the second time-to-digital converter is respectively connected with the input clock end and the output clock end; the input end of the first divider is respectively connected with the output end of the phase-locked loop, the output end of the first time-to-digital converter and the output end of the second time-to-digital converter, and the output end of the first divider is connected with the output clock end. The invention fully utilizes the advantages of the digital circuit and the technology of the time-digital converter to simplify the system and increase the flexibility of the jitter-removing system, and achieves better jitter-removing function for the clock which needs to be jittered and is provided by the input clock end through the system.

title_en: Circuit for driving and method for driving gate of transistor
abstract_en: A circuit for driving and a method for driving a gate of a transistor are disclosed. The circuit includes a gate driver having a supply voltage terminal and configured to generate an output at an output terminal based on an input. The voltage multiplexer is configured to connect the first voltage terminal to the power supply voltage terminal in response to a voltage selection signal having a first value and to connect the second voltage terminal to the power supply voltage terminal in response to a voltage selection signal having a second value. The first logic unit is configured to generate a fault signal in response to detecting one of a first fault condition associated with operation of the gate driver and a second fault condition associated with operation of the gate driver, and to generate a voltage selection signal having a second value based on the fault signal. The second logic unit is configured to generate a voltage selection signal having a second value after a predetermined delay period based on the input value.

title_en: Method, device and system for adjusting multichannel gain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a system for adjusting multichannel gain, which are applied to a gain adjusting device, gain adjusting information is obtained by receiving and analyzing a gain adjusting trigger signal, corresponding gain control information is generated according to the gain adjusting information, the gain control information is sent to the gain controlling device, the gain controlling device determines a channel to be adjusted according to the channel information, and gain values of a plurality of channels are respectively adjusted according to adjustment gain values. The invention determines the channel needing gain adjustment and the corresponding adjustment gain value through the gain control information, combines a plurality of channels needing gain adjustment through the channel information in the gain control information, and adjusts the channel gain value of the combined set through the adjustment gain value, thereby realizing simultaneous adjustment of the multi-channel gain, namely the combined set adjustment of the multi-channel gain.

title_en: Orthogonal signal generating circuit and working method thereof
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a quadrature signal generation circuit and a method of operating the same; is applied to the technical field of electronic circuit design. The circuit comprises a pre-amplifying circuit, a frequency doubling circuit, a frequency division circuit, a driving circuit and a calibration circuit which are sequentially arranged; the working method comprises the steps that an input signal is amplified by the pre-amplifying circuit, the frequency of the amplified signal is increased to 2 times of the original frequency by the frequency doubling circuit, an IQ orthogonal signal is generated by the frequency doubling circuit, the IQ orthogonal signal is sent to the driving circuit, and finally the IQ orthogonal signal with the self-calibration of the orthogonal error is sent to the transceiver by the calibrating circuit. In this way, IQ signals with extremely small quadrature errors can be generated, and the same frequency of input and output reduces the requirement on the frequency of off-chip signals, thereby improving the bandwidth and reducing the cost; in addition, the input signals can be connected in a single-ended mode or a differential mode, and the application of users is facilitated.

title_en: Element and terahertz camera system using the same
abstract_en: In an antenna array including a first antenna, a second antenna, a third antenna, a fourth antenna, and a fifth antenna, the second antenna, the first antenna, and the third antenna are arranged in this order in a first direction, and the fourth antenna, the first antenna, and the fifth antenna are arranged in this order in a second direction. The conductor layer of the second antenna is connected to the conductor layer of the first antenna via a first coupling line extending in the first direction, the conductor layer of the first antenna is connected to the conductor layer of the third antenna via a second coupling line extending in the first direction, the conductor layer of the fourth antenna is connected to the conductor layer of the first antenna via a third coupling line extending in the second direction, and the conductor layer of the first antenna is connected to the conductor layer of the fifth antenna via a fourth coupling line extending in the second direction.

title_en: Hybrid bandwidth filter
abstract_en: The invention provides a hybrid bandwidth filter, which comprises a plurality of acoustic wave resonators and a plurality of LC resonators, wherein the acoustic wave resonators are electrically connected with the LC resonators, and the LC resonators comprise an inductor and a capacitor. The filter has the advantages that the bandwidth limitation of the traditional acoustic wave filter is broken through by designing the LC resonator while the high Q value performance of the acoustic wave resonator is obtained by mixing the acoustic wave resonator and the LC resonator.

title_en: Frequency synthesizer of low-phase-noise low-stray frequency modulation continuous wave
abstract_en: The invention relates to a frequency synthesizer of low-phase noise low-stray frequency modulation continuous wave, which comprises an input reference crystal oscillator, a PLL and a DDS; the device also comprises a first frequency multiplier, an injection locking oscillator, a second frequency multiplier, a first filter and a mixer; the output of the input reference crystal oscillator is multiplied by the first frequency multiplier and then is input into the injection locking oscillator, and the output of the injection locking oscillator is multiplied by the second frequency multiplier and then is filtered by a first filter and then enters into one input end of the mixer; the output of the input reference crystal oscillator enters the other input end of the mixer through the frequency signal output by the first phase-locked loop, and is mixed with the signal output by the first filter to form an output. The invention ensures that the final FMCW after frequency multiplication still has better spurious suppression.

title_en: Elastic wave filter and composite filter device
abstract_en: Provided is an elastic wave filter which can improve power resistance. An elastic wave filter (2) has an input end and an output end, n (n=3) elastic wave resonators connected in series in the order of first, second, and third elastic wave resonators (S4 a, S4b, S4 c) are provided in a series arm connecting the input end and the output end, the first, second, and third elastic wave resonators (S4 a, S4b, S4 c) have a plurality of electrode fingers, the first to third elastic wave resonators (S4 a to S4 c) include an mth elastic wave resonator (m is a natural number of 1<m < n, m=2), and the electrode finger pitch of the second elastic wave resonator (S4 b) is the smallest among the electrode finger pitches of the first, second, and third elastic wave resonators (S4 a, S4b, S4 c).

title_en: ROM compression method for DDS and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ROM compression method for DDS and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of frequency synthesis; compressing and storing the sine wave signal by adopting a double ROM table; the first ROM table takes the phase quantized value as an addressing address and the amplitude quantized value as storage data to realize phase-amplitude conversion; the second ROM table takes the amplitude quantized value as an addressing address and the phase quantized value as storage data to realize amplitude-phase conversion; the zero value stored in the traditional phase-cut-free ROM table is reduced by introducing the bit zone to realize the compression storage of the double ROM table, and the occupied ROM resource can be reduced. In addition, the invention adopts a plurality of phase steps to carry out non-uniform division on the phase intervals of the sine wave signals (0, pi/2) to obtain a plurality of sub-phase intervals, so that each sub-phase interval only comprises a critical phase point, the depth of the first ROM table can be further compressed, the ROM table is subjected to lossless compression on the premise of not increasing the complexity of a circuit, and the capacity of the required ROM is further reduced.

title_en: Gain control circuit for antenna system and antenna system
abstract_en: The application provides a gain control circuit for an antenna system and the antenna system. The gain control circuit includes: the device comprises a numerical control attenuator, a power amplifier, a coupler, a detector and a singlechip; the numerical control attenuator is connected with the input end of the power amplifier; the output end of the power amplifier is connected with the coupler; the detector is connected between the coupler and the singlechip and is configured to feed detection results back to the singlechip; the singlechip is connected with the numerical control attenuator and is configured to adjust the output power of the numerical control attenuator based on the detection result. In the embodiment of the application, the output power is coupled to the detector through the coupler, the radio frequency signal is converted into an analog voltage value, the reference value is set in the singlechip, the reference value is compared with the detected voltage value, the attenuator amount of the numerical control attenuator is determined, the gain control accuracy is improved, the stability of the output power under the conditions of high-low temperature environment and overdriving of the front-stage input signal is provided, and the antenna is ensured to adapt to the thermal environment with changeable temperature.

title_en: Frequency band searching method based on phase-locked loop
abstract_en: The invention discloses a frequency band searching method based on a phase-locked loop, which comprises the following steps: selecting a frequency band, setting a phase-locked loop for tracking, setting M output voltage reading points in tracking waiting time, recording the current frequency band and the last output voltage value when the continuous N output voltages read at the M output voltage reading points meet the condition, and ending the frequency band search; when the read output voltages do not have continuous N output voltages meeting the condition, the last output voltage confirmation is carried out after the tracking waiting time timing is finished, if the voltages meet the condition, the current frequency band and the last output voltage value are recorded, and if the voltages do not meet the condition, the frequency band searching is finished to the next frequency band searching. According to the invention, the plurality of output voltage reading points are arranged in the original longer waiting time, when a plurality of continuous output voltages meet the condition, namely the frequency band searching is stopped, the subsequent redundant waiting is avoided, the system resources are saved, and the overall efficiency is improved.

title_en: Laser frequency modulation positioning processing method for crystal etching
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of piezoelectric crystals, in particular to a laser frequency modulation positioning processing method for crystal etching, which comprises the following steps: s1, obtaining an initial crystal etching area by utilizing real-time frequency data of a crystal to be etched; s2, performing segment adjustment processing by using the initial crystal etching area to obtain a real-time etching area; and S3, completing laser frequency modulation positioning processing according to the real-time etching area, analyzing to obtain the area to be etched by the current frequency adjustment laser, and controlling the laser to etch the vibration surface of the product so as to adjust the vibration frequency of the crystal. In this way, the vibration frequency of the product can be accurately adjusted. When motion control is performed, positioning deviation can occur if the X axis and the Y axis in the space are not vertically arranged, and the algorithm is utilized to compensate during positioning according to the vertical angle deviation of the X axis and the Y axis in the coordinates, so that the positioning deviation is corrected, and the positioning accuracy is improved.

title_en: Level shifter with high common mode rejection and low quiescent current
abstract_en: The application relates to a level shifter with high common mode rejection and low quiescent current, comprising: an input inverter and pull-down differential pair circuit and a differential to single-ended output circuit, the input inverter and pull-down differential pair circuit being connected to the pulse generating circuit for generating a narrow pulse, thereby generating a multiplied pull-down current; the addition of the cross-coupling circuit in the differential to single ended output circuit suppresses parasitic charging current. The beneficial effects of the application are as follows: when the signal is converted in high and low, the application can instantaneously generate pulse signals to enhance tail current capacity and signal conversion rate, thereby reducing transmission delay. When the pulse signal ends, the tail current returns to a lower level, thereby reducing the static power consumption of the system. Meanwhile, the application adopts a cross coupling mode to restrain the common mode signal, but the input differential mode signal cannot be attenuated, thereby realizing effective level conversion of the input signal.

title_en: Judgment and prediction method for optimizing foundation valuation based on Kalman algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of Kalman filtering, in particular to a judgment and prediction method for optimizing foundation valuation based on a Kalman algorithm, which comprises the following specific steps: the method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining a net value of a certain product on any day when the product is received, taking the net value as an initial value (called S1), setting an error between the initial value and a real value as est, then obtaining the net value of the product on the day after the S1, taking the net value as a predicted value, setting the error between the predicted value and the real value as emu, obtaining Kalman gain after applying a formula, then calculating the Kalman gain through the new predicted value, adding a detection algorithm at the same time, reducing the influence caused by market emotion, repeating the steps from S1 to S6, and iterating through the four values to obtain the real value of the product. The judgment and prediction method for optimizing the fund valuation based on the Kalman algorithm optimizes the judgment of the fund valuation and predicts the future trend of the fund.

title_en: Sigma-delta analog-to-digital converter and method for eliminating idle tone thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an sigma-delta analog-to-digital converter and a method for eliminating idle tones thereof. The sigma-delta analog-to-digital converter comprises a loop filter, a quantizer, an adder and a digital-to-analog converter. The loop filter filters a difference between an analog input signal and an analog feedback signal to produce a filtered signal. The quantizer is coupled to the loop filter and generates a digital output signal according to the filtered signal. The adder is coupled to the quantizer and adds a digital dither signal to the digital output signal to generate a digital feedback signal. The digital-to-analog converter is coupled to the loop filter and generates the analog feedback signal according to the digital feedback signal.

title_en: CDAC circuit with high precision and low power consumption
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of analog-to-digital converters, and particularly relates to a CDAC circuit with high precision and low power consumption. The invention mainly comprises a sectional capacitor module, a sampling switch module and a common-mode voltage generator module. The invention relates to a charge redistribution-based capacitive DAC, which utilizes the characteristic of charge storage of a capacitor, and hangs an upper electrode plate of the capacitor in the air when sampling is finished, so that the sampling and holding of an input signal can be completed without an additional sampling and holding circuit; the invention adopts a three-section capacitor array, greatly reduces the area of the capacitor while keeping the linearity of the capacitor, thereby realizing high precision, adopts a split capacitor technology, adopts a switch switching mode which is a monotone type capacitor switching mode without setting, saves most of power consumption compared with the traditional setting type switch switching mode, and realizes low power consumption, and adopts a common-mode-free structure, thereby saving the power consumption of external common-mode voltage and related common-mode driving and reducing the power consumption.

title_en: Crystal filter and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a crystal filter and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the filter comprises: a first base, a first monolithic crystal filter, and a second monolithic crystal filter; the first monolithic crystal filter and the second monolithic crystal filter each include: the second base comprises a first pin, a second pin and a third pin, and the first pin, the second pin and the third pin are respectively connected with the quartz oscillator; the first pin of the first monolithic crystal filter and the first pin of the second monolithic crystal filter are respectively used as an input end and an output end of the crystal filter, and the second pin of the first monolithic crystal filter and the second pin of the second monolithic crystal filter are respectively connected with the input end of the coupling capacitor. The application greatly reduces the number of components used for forming the filter, thereby greatly reducing the volume of the filter, improving the vibration resistance and the reliability of the filter and completing the high-precision filtering function.

title_en: Asymptotic performance analysis method of coding system at any moment of joint information source channel
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of progressive performance analysis, and particularly relates to an asymptotic performance analysis method of a coding system at any moment of a joint information source channel. The invention aims to provide an asymptotic performance numerical analysis method for analyzing an encoding and decoding system of a joint source channel at any moment based on an SC-RA code, which comprises transmission characteristics, a decoding threshold and decoding complexity at any moment. The method of the invention firstly initializes the parameters of the system, sets the maximum iteration times and mutual information, then obtains the decoding threshold after the channel decoding is converged by updating the channel nodes and counting the updating times of the mutual information, and finally obtains the related index parameters of the system performance after the maximum iteration times are reached.

title_en: Road surface data storage method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a road surface data storage method, and belongs to the technical field of data storage; the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an elevation data matrix of a road surface by utilizing a linear scanning mode along the running direction of the vehicle; obtaining the damage degree of each damaged data block; acquiring the replacement probability of each data replacement center data in the data set; replacing the second window center data with data corresponding to the maximum replacement probability; replacing the central data in each first window with data corresponding to the maximum frequency in the first window; namely, acquiring a replaced elevation data matrix; and encoding, compressing and storing the data in the replaced elevation data matrix by using Huffman encoding. The invention replaces the data with smaller frequency of occurrence in the elevation data matrix with the data with larger frequency of occurrence, reduces the coding length of the data set after Huffman coding, and improves the compression efficiency of coding.

title_en: Method and device for passively suppressing magnetic field noise of super-cooled atoms
abstract_en: A method and a device for passively suppressing magnetic field noise of super-cooled atoms, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step-down processing is carried out on the commercial electric signal by using a transformer to obtain a low-voltage sine wave signal; performing waveform conversion on the low-voltage sine wave signal by using a voltage comparator to obtain a low-voltage square wave signal; the low-voltage square wave signal is output in the forward direction or the reverse direction by utilizing a double-pole double-throw switch and a logic NOT gate, so that a clock signal is obtained; and triggering the gating signal through the D trigger chip based on the clock signal to obtain an output control signal. The device comprises a transformer, a switching power supply, a double-pole double-throw switch, a voltage comparator, a D trigger chip and a logic NOT gate. By using the method, the experiment is controlled by the square wave synchronous with the mains supply, the influence of noise generated by the mains supply is reduced, and the coherent time of the intra-atomic state control is increased by orders of magnitude. The application can be widely applied to the technical field of active noise reduction.

title_en: High-precision programmable gain amplifier with offset DAC
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pre-amplification link of a signal in an analog integrated circuit, in particular to a high-precision programmable gain amplifier with an offset DAC, which comprises CMOS switches K1-K21, variable capacitors C1 and C2, constant value capacitors C3 and C4, an operational amplifier OPA and offset DACs D1 and D2, wherein the variable ranges of the variable capacitors C1 and C2 are 1, 2, 4 and 8 times, the constant value capacitors C3 and C4 are equal to the corresponding capacitance values when the variable capacitors C1 and C2 are doubled, and the CMOS switches K1-K17, the variable capacitors C1 and C2, the constant value capacitors C3 and C4 and the operational amplifier OPA form a main body of the high-precision programmable gain amplifier. The invention has large amplification factor and high precision, and the output voltage is symmetric on both sides of the reference voltage Vcm during operation, and the + -1/2 full range value can be adjusted on the basis of output through the offset DAC.

title_en: Incremental SDM integrator
abstract_en: The application discloses an incremental SDM integrator, which comprises a plurality of first integrators and a plurality of second integrators which are arranged in a cascading way, wherein the first integrators and the second integrators respectively comprise an operational amplifier, a chopper, a sampling capacitor, a feedback capacitor, a plurality of time sequence switches and a plurality of reset switches. According to the application, the offset voltage integrated in each CHOP period of the rear-stage integrator is regulated by regulating the CHOP time sequence and the reset mode of the integrator, so that the integral value of the offset voltage transmitted by the rear-stage integrator in one complete CHOP period is 0, the offset voltage of the front-stage integrator is ensured not to be amplified by the rear-stage integrator, and the output offset of the incremental SDM integrator is reduced or eliminated.

title_en: Switch and resistor-based switch routing circuit and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of microwaves and discloses a switch routing circuit based on a switch and resistors and a use method thereof. The invention solves the problems of insufficient flexibility of the functions of the routing network, limited use in a plurality of application occasions and the like in the prior art.

title_en: Phase frequency detector based on metal oxide thin film transistor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a phase frequency detector based on a metal oxide thin film transistor, and relates to the technical field of integrated circuit design. The phase frequency detector includes: the device comprises a first D trigger, a second D trigger, an inverter, a delay module and a NAND gate; the first D trigger comprises four NOR gates which are connected in sequence and have the same structure; the second D trigger has the same circuit structure as the first D trigger; the NOR gate comprises four MO-TFT tubes and a first capacitor; the NAND gate comprises four MO-TFT tubes and a second capacitor; the inverter comprises four MO-TFT tubes, and because all N-type MO-TFT tubes are adopted in the NAND gate, the NOR gate and the inverter circuit, the problem that a traditional CMOS circuit system is difficult to reconstruct due to the lack of a P-type MO-TFT tube in the traditional CMOS is solved based on the characteristics of the MO-TFT tubes, and the inverter is simple in preparation process, low in preparation environment requirement, capable of realizing transparency and capable of being manufactured on a flexible substrate.

title_en: Adaptive square root unscented Kalman filter spatial deviation registration method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of target tracking and positioning, and provides a self-adaptive square root unscented Kalman filtering space deviation registration method and a system, which initialize a target sensor to be detected and construct a sensor measurement equation and a target state equation; the method comprises the steps of adaptively solving square root of covariance matrix, calculating sampling points and weights, utilizing an adaptive unscented Kalman filtering algorithm, estimating state, measurement and other filtering intermediate parameters at k moment based on state mean value and covariance matrix at k-1 moment, adaptively calibrating adjustable parameters in a state equation according to whether abnormal measurement data are caused by noise and other interference at the current moment of a system, utilizing the adaptive unscented Kalman filtering algorithm and an adaptive clustering algorithm, constructing a deviation pseudo-measurement equation according to deviation estimated value at k-1 moment, error covariance matrix and predicted measurement data, estimating and compensating the deviation value, repeating the steps to form closed loop circulation operation, and carrying out iterative operation until registration of all sensors is completed.

title_en: Implementation method of CIC filter, signal processing device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a CIC filter realization method, a signal processing device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the first CIC filter is a single-stage CIC filter with the differential delay of 1 for R times of downscaling or upsampling, when R is the Q power of an integer p, the first CIC filter is realized by Q cascaded identical second CIC filters, and the second CIC filter is a single-stage CIC filter with the differential delay of 1 for p times of downscaling or upsampling, wherein the sampling directions of the first CIC filter and the second CIC filter are the same. According to the technical scheme, the CIC filter with the higher sampling rate is realized through the CIC filter with the lower sampling rate, the problems of overlarge word length of an integrator and a differentiator in the CIC filter and the higher sampling rate of the integrator are avoided, and the realization difficulty of the CIC filter is reduced.

title_en: High-speed multi-output latch circuit
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of analog-to-digital conversion, in particular to a high-speed multi-output latch circuit which is suitable for a successive approximation type analog-to-digital converter circuit. Compared with the traditional high-speed SAR logic latch architecture, the invention only controls the reset and the latch by one clock signal by respectively arranging the PMOS transistor and the NMOS transistor to fully utilize the mutual connection between the signals and simultaneously reset and latch, and greatly reduces the scale and the complexity of an additionally required logic circuit under the condition of slightly increasing the delay. The invention does not need a comparator to provide additional reset or latch control signals, greatly simplifies the scale and complexity of the circuit, can output four control signals and reduces the area of a chip; the logic circuit of the existing high-speed SAR logic latch circuit structure is large, a plurality of clock control signals are needed, and only two control signals can be output.

title_en: Intelligent medical data analysis method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to an intelligent medical data analysis method based on artificial intelligence, which comprises the following steps: acquiring historical intelligent medical data, character types of newly-added intelligent medical data and newly-added intelligent medical data; acquiring an initial frequency contribution weight of each character position of the historical intelligent medical data according to the data length of the historical intelligent medical data; obtaining final weighting frequency of the character type of the historical intelligent medical data according to the adjustment factor of the character type of the newly added intelligent medical data and the weighting frequency of the character type; performing self-adaptive adjustment on the weighted frequencies of other types of characters of the historical intelligent medical data according to the final weighted frequencies of the newly added intelligent medical data type characters of the historical intelligent medical data; and compressing the newly added intelligent medical data according to the adjusted weighting frequency of each type of character. The invention makes the average code length of characters with higher local frequency shorter, and increases the arithmetic coding compression rate.

title_en: Integrated filter packaging structure, packaging method, module and electronic product
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated filter packaging structure, a packaging method, a module and an electronic product. The integrated filter packaging structure comprises a piezoelectric substrate, a plurality of electric connection pads, interdigital electrodes, side walls, a top cover, a loaded layer and protruding points; the piezoelectric substrate is provided with a front surface and a back surface which are opposite, the electric connection pad, the interdigital electrode and the side wall are all formed on the front surface, the electric connection pad is arranged around the interdigital electrode, the top cover, the piezoelectric substrate and the side wall are jointly enclosed to form a closed resonant cavity, the interdigital electrode is positioned in the resonant cavity, the top cover at least comprises a dielectric layer and a loaded layer, and the loaded layer and the electric connection pad are electrically connected by utilizing a rewiring layer or a metal column; the bump and the loaded layer are electrically connected by a rewiring layer or a metal column. The invention integrates the loaded layer in the top cover structure of the filter, can reduce the size and strengthen the top cover structure, and improves the yield and the integration level.

title_en: Intelligent electronic switch, integrated circuit chip, chip product and automobile
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an intelligent electronic switch for preventing temperature detection failure, which comprises: the power supply end, the power ground end, the load output end and the drive control unit; a power switch; the temperature detection branch circuit comprises a temperature detection unit and a first element, wherein one end of the temperature detection unit is connected with a power supply end of a power supply, the other end of the temperature detection unit is connected with a power ground end of the power supply, the temperature detection unit is connected with the first element in series, the point where the temperature detection unit is connected with the first element is a temperature detection point, and the temperature detection unit is arranged adjacent to or embedded into the power switch and is used for detecting the temperature of the power switch; and one input end of the failure judging unit is connected with the temperature detecting point, the other input end of the failure judging unit is connected with the failure threshold voltage, and the failure detecting unit compares the voltage of the temperature detecting point with the failure threshold voltage to output a signal whether the temperature detecting unit fails or not. The embodiment of the application also provides an integrated circuit chip, a chip product and an automobile.

title_en: Internet of vehicles system based on common LED car light optical communication and implementation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle networking system based on common LED car light optical communication and an implementation method. The system mainly comprises a transmitting terminal and a receiving terminal. The transmitting terminal comprises an information coding module, an information packaging module, a signal modulation module and a signal transmitting module. The information coding module adopts mixed coding of no-rate codes and Hamming codes to code input data and divides the data into data packets, the information packaging module secondarily codes each data packet, the signal modulation module adopts 4-ASK modulation to convert an original signal into a modulation signal, and the signal transmission module drives the LED car lamp to transmit the modulation signal. The receiving terminal is used for receiving the information sent by the transmitting terminal and mainly comprises an information receiving module, a signal processing module and an information processing unit. The information receiving module receives information by adopting a photosensitive diode, the signal processing module converts the signal into a digital signal which can be identified and processed by the information processing unit, and the information processing unit demodulates and decodes the digital signal to restore the information.

title_en: Piezoelectric vibration device manufacturing apparatus and piezoelectric vibration device manufacturing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a piezoelectric vibration device manufacturing apparatus and a piezoelectric vibration device manufacturing method, wherein a plurality of piezoelectric elements can be respectively arranged on a plurality of holding members at a predetermined position and in a predetermined direction. Comprises a suction head moving device (12) for simultaneously reciprocating a plurality of suction heads (20). The plurality of suction heads (20) respectively suck the piezoelectric elements (P) through suction nozzles (28). At least one of the suction head horizontal movement mechanism (21), the suction head vertical movement mechanism (24), and the suction head rotational movement mechanism (26) is configured to be able to independently and individually adjust the positions of the suction nozzles (28) based on information on the positions of the plurality of piezoelectric elements (P) sucked by the plurality of suction nozzles (28) and information on the positions of the plurality of holding members (H) supplied to the holding member supply position (Sh), so that the piezoelectric elements (P) sucked by the plurality of suction nozzles (28) can be arranged on the corresponding holding members (H).

title_en: RF power transmission architecture with switchable matching and frequency adjustment
abstract_en: A power supply circuit includes: switchable matching; a high voltage bus and a low voltage bus connectable to the load such that the load is connected in series between the buses; at least two capacitors having a fixed capacitance, the at least two capacitors having a fixed capacitance being connectable between a high voltage bus and a low voltage bus; and a plurality of solid state switches equal in number to the number of capacitors with fixed capacitance connectable between the high voltage bus and the low voltage bus, each switch configured and arranged to connect or disconnect one of the capacitors between the high voltage bus and the low voltage bus into or from electrical communication between the high voltage bus and the low voltage bus; and a variable frequency power supply comprising a high voltage output connection, the high voltage connection being connected to the high voltage bus.

title_en: Filtering self-mixer
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a filtered self-mixer comprising: the micro-electromechanical resonator comprises an input signal end, an energy detection circuit unit, a bias voltage unit, a coupling branch unit and a micro-electromechanical resonator branch. The input signal end is used for receiving the wake-up signal and the interference signal as input signals; the energy detection circuit unit comprises at least one CMOS tube and is used for mixing an input signal through a secondary effect and outputting a baseband signal; the bias voltage unit is used for providing the grid voltage of the CMOS tube so as to adjust the channel impedance of the CMOS tube; the coupling branch unit is arranged between the input signal end and the energy detection circuit unit and is used for coupling the input signal to the drain electrode or the source electrode of the CMOS tube in the energy detection circuit unit; the micro-electromechanical resonator branch is arranged between the input signal end and the bias voltage unit, and can output different grid signals under different frequencies to adjust the secondary effect, so that the filtering of interference signals in the input signals is realized.

title_en: Palm template protection and identification method and device based on multi-mode shared secret key
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological feature recognition, in particular to a palm template protection and recognition method and device based on a multi-mode shared secret key. The invention generates a random key irrelevant to the original biological characteristics, encrypts the random key to form a biological characteristic template, realizes and strengthens the irreversibility of the characteristics, constructs and trains a shared key generation network, converts palmprint and palmveins into the same characteristic space, improves the correlation between modes and the safety of the template while realizing the end-to-end encryption of the biological characteristic template, introduces LDPC encoding and decoding, realizes the correction of the key, reduces noise interference and improves the authentication of the key. The method can simultaneously improve the authentication, correlation and safety of the multi-mode features, improves the recognition rate, and solves the problems that the prior method does not integrate template protection and the recognition rate is not ideal in part of cases.

title_en: Fuse trimming method and fuse trimming circuit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fuse trimming method and a fuse trimming circuit, wherein the physical quantity is trimmed by the resistor trimming circuit, the resistor trimming circuit comprises n+1 connected resistor networks and n fuses, each fuse is connected with one resistor network, and the fuse trimming method repeatedly executes the following steps for i times: obtaining an actually measured resistance value in a resistance trimming circuit; taking the difference between the target reference resistance value and the actual measured resistance value as a compensation resistance value; calculating an n-bit binary number according to the compensation resistance value to represent the fuse wire to be blown at the time; and selecting whether to blow fuses of corresponding bits in the resistance trimming circuit according to the value of at least one binary number selected from the currently output n-bit binary numbers. According to the fuse trimming method, at least one fuse is trimmed each time, then the compensation resistance value is calculated for multiple times to trim gradually, trimming precision is improved, and the problem that trimming precision is not high due to the fact that the resistance of an access circuit is too large or too small through one trimming is avoided.

title_en: High-frequency accuracy reference clock source
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-frequency accuracy reference clock source which is mainly used for improving performance of electronic systems such as radars, communication and the like in the aspect of frequency accuracy correlation. The reference clock source comprises an FPGA control module, an external frequency standard signal acquisition circuit connected with the FPGA control module, a frequency output adjustment circuit connected with the FPGA control module, and an output frequency acquisition circuit connected with the frequency output adjustment circuit and used for sending acquired signals to the FPGA control module for comparison. The invention does not need to adjust the frequency accuracy in a mode of artificially modifying a circuit by resistance voltage division or mechanical adjustment and the like a traditional clock source, has the characteristic of automatic frequency accuracy adjustment, has a simple implementation method, and has higher frequency accuracy than a traditional high-frequency-accuracy rubidium clock, and smaller volume and power consumption than a single rubidium clock.

title_en: Multistage common-differential mode hybrid filtering electric fast transient pulse group decoupling network
abstract_en: The application provides a multistage common-differential mode mixed filtering electric fast transient pulse group decoupling network, which comprises a primary decoupling circuit and a secondary decoupling circuit which are sequentially arranged between a power supply output end and a power supply input end, wherein the primary decoupling circuit is a differential mode inductor for weak differential mode interference and common mode interference, and the secondary decoupling circuit is a common mode inductor for weakening common mode interference; and a three-stage decoupling circuit is connected in series between the two-stage decoupling circuit and the power input end, and the three-stage decoupling circuit is used for adjusting the rising edge time or the falling edge time of the interference pulse. The application can efficiently attenuate the interference signal of the power input end and can ensure that the waveform index of the power supply output end meets the industry standard.

title_en: Reference level generating circuit applied to analog-to-digital converter and method for generating reference level
abstract_en: The present application relates to a reference level generating circuit applied to an analog-to-digital converter and a method of generating a reference level, the reference level generating circuit comprising: a charge pump, a control voltage generating unit, and a transmitting unit, wherein: the charge pump is connected with the control voltage generating unit and is used for providing starting voltage for the control voltage generating unit; the control voltage generation unit and the transmission unit are used for providing control voltage for the transmission unit; the transmission unit is connected with the comparator of the analog-to-digital converter and is used for providing a reference level for the comparator. According to the scheme of the application, the reference level generating circuit respectively provides common mode levels for the positive and negative ends of the comparator in the sampling stage and controls whether the switch of the reference level is provided for the positive and negative ends of the comparator, and the internal resistance is relatively constant, so that the linearity of the analog-to-digital converter can be improved, and the performance of the analog-to-digital converter is improved; furthermore, charge injection is also addressed and clock feedthrough effects are reduced.

title_en: Open drain output circuit and chip
abstract_en: The invention discloses an open-drain output circuit and a chip, wherein the circuit comprises: the first pull-down unit comprises a first inversion unit, a first MOS tube and a first resistor, wherein the control end of the first MOS tube is connected with the first inversion unit, the first MOS tube is connected with the pull-up resistor and the output end of the output circuit, and the first resistor is connected with the first MOS tube; the second pull-down unit pulls down the voltage of the output terminal when the first power voltage is lower, and the third pull-down unit pulls down the voltage of the output terminal when the first power voltage is reduced. According to the open drain output circuit and the chip, the output end is pulled down to be low level by the first pull-down unit under the low first power voltage; the second pull-down unit prevents the output overshoot from being generated at the output end in the process of rapidly powering down the first power supply voltage, and solves the abnormal situation that the chip driven by the output is re-enabled in the process of powering down.

title_en: Sparse matrix compression format interconversion method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for interconversion of sparse matrix compression formats, which are used for analyzing format conversion instructions when receiving the format conversion instructions, and determining a current compression storage format and a target compression storage format; acquiring first sparse matrix data meeting the current compressed storage format; performing format conversion on the first sparse matrix data to obtain second sparse matrix data meeting an intermediate compressed storage format; performing in-situ rearrangement operation without generating intermediate data on the second sparse matrix data by using a preset iterator to obtain third sparse matrix data; and compressing and storing the third sparse matrix data according to the target compressed storage format to obtain fourth sparse matrix data meeting the target compressed format. According to the application, the iterator is preset to point to the same position in the sparse matrix data at the same time, and the in-situ replacement operation is adopted to realize the reordering, so that the effect of considering the memory efficiency and the operation efficiency can be achieved without generating intermediate data additionally.

title_en: Multiplexing structure of frequency divider in phase-locked loop
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multiplexing structure of a frequency divider in a phase-locked LOOP, which is characterized in that on the basis of the original phase-locked LOOP structure, an internal node of a LOOP frequency divider LOOP DIV is led out and input into a POST frequency divider POST DIV outside the LOOP, and the multiplexing structure is used for replacing part of functions of the POST frequency divider POST DIV outside the LOOP; if the internal node of the LOOP frequency divider LOOP DIV has a 2/4/8/16/32 divided clock; when the POST DIV outside the LOOP needs to divide by 2, the 2-frequency division clock of the internal node of the LOOP DIV is led out to the POST DIV outside the LOOP, so that the power consumption of the system is reduced. By utilizing the structure, when the POST frequency divider POST DIV outside the LOOP is more, the system power consumption can be greatly reduced by leading out the internal node of the LOOP frequency divider LOOP DIV.

title_en: Audio power amplifier and audio system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of audio frequency, and discloses an audio frequency power amplifier and an audio frequency system, wherein the audio frequency power amplifier comprises: a differential module provided with a first output terminal and a second output terminal; the first end of the non-overlapping module is connected with the first output end and the second output end at the same time, and the two signal output ends of the non-overlapping module respectively output a first control signal and a second control signal outwards after passing through a buffer; the first end of the power switch module receives the first control signal and the second control signal at the same time, the power switch module outputs a high-voltage signal after receiving the first control signal, and the power switch module outputs a low-voltage signal after receiving the second control signal; the second end of the power switch module is adapted to apply a high voltage signal and a low voltage signal to the input end of the horn. Thus, the power output can be improved, and the requirement of output power is met.

title_en: Bimodal wave generating circuit and electrotherapy instrument
abstract_en: The application discloses a bimodal wave generating circuit and an electrotherapy instrument, which comprise an input unit, an output unit and a waveform control unit, wherein the input unit is used for receiving a dipulse square wave signal output by a main control unit; the output unit is connected with the input unit and is used for outputting bidirectional bimodal waves; one end of the waveform control unit is used for receiving the analog signal output by the main control unit, the other end of the waveform control unit is connected with the output unit, and the waveform control unit is used for controlling the shape of the bidirectional double-peak wave according to the analog signal and the double-pulse square wave signal. The bimodal wave generating circuit disclosed by the application can output a bidirectional bimodal wave, and the bidirectional bimodal wave has low irritation, so that strong irritation is avoided, and the skin of a human body is not damaged.

title_en: Clock signal bandwidth regulating circuit and clock signal bandwidth regulating method
abstract_en: The invention provides a clock signal bandwidth regulating circuit and a clock signal bandwidth regulating method, comprising the following steps: the device comprises a first clock signal generation module, a second clock signal generation module, a feedback module and an output module; the first clock generation module is used for inverting and delaying the clock signal to obtain a first clock signal, and regulating and controlling the bandwidth of the first clock signal based on the level control signal output by the feedback module; the second clock generation module inverts the first clock signal to obtain a second clock signal; the feedback module obtains a level control signal based on the bandwidth control signal, the first clock signal and the second clock signal; setting a clock signal bandwidth regulating circuit to be in a narrow bandwidth mode or a wide bandwidth mode under the action of a bandwidth control signal; the output module is connected with the second clock signal and outputs the second clock signal. The invention further realizes the switching of the narrow bandwidth modulation and the wide bandwidth modulation of the clock signal by setting the bandwidth control signal, and solves the problem that the conventional bandwidth regulating circuit is single in regulation.

title_en: Power amplifier protection device, using method thereof and radio frequency transceiver
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a power amplifier protection device, relates to the technical field of power amplifier circuits, and particularly relates to a power amplifier protection device, a using method thereof and a radio frequency transceiver device. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: the power amplifier protection device includes: a power amplifier, a load state detection circuit, and an impedance transformation circuit; the output end of the power amplifier is connected with the first end of the impedance transformation circuit; the second end of the impedance transformation circuit is connected with an external load; the first end of the load state detection circuit is connected with the control end of the power amplifier; the second end of the load state detection circuit is connected between the second end of the impedance transformation circuit and an external load; the load state detection circuit is used for detecting the load state of the output end of the power amplifier; the impedance transformation circuit is configured to transform the open-load state to a short-load state in response to detecting the open-load state as the open-load state.

title_en: Waveform generator, multi-signal channel delay correction method and medium
abstract_en: A waveform generator, comprising: at least two waveform generation channels; at least two output channels; a switching unit; an analog-to-digital conversion unit; the processing unit is used for: generating two paths of same digital correction waveform signals; the frequencies of the two paths of signals are adjusted for multiple times, and after each adjustment: performing cross-correlation operation on the two paths of correction waveform sampling signals; transforming the correlation operation result from the time domain to the frequency domain to obtain a phase difference; based on each phase difference and the corresponding adjusted frequency, obtaining a phase function between the phase difference and the frequency, and obtaining a target time delay; and performing delay correction based on the target time delay, so that the time delays of the two paths of simulated correction waveform signals are synchronous. The delay correction can be realized based on the waveform generator, so that the cost of synchronous calibration is low. The application also provides a multi-signal channel delay correction method and a medium.

title_en: Wavelet threshold denoising method and device based on parameter optimization
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of signal processing and discloses a wavelet threshold denoising method and device based on parameter optimization. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting original signals of direct current voltage and current, processing the original signals by a wavelet threshold denoising method according to preset denoising parameter combinations to obtain reconstructed signals, calculating a plurality of single indexes between the original signals and the reconstructed signals, calculating composite indexes according to the single indexes to obtain wavelet threshold denoising performance composite evaluation results, finding out optimal denoising parameter combinations by taking the minimum wavelet threshold denoising performance composite evaluation results as targets, denoising the original signals according to the combinations, and calculating direct current electric energy values by using denoised signals. The invention realizes denoising of the direct current voltage and current signals under the condition of comprehensively considering the wavelet basis function, the decomposition layer number, the threshold function and the threshold criterion, so as to achieve better denoising effect, thereby improving the accuracy of calculating the direct current electric energy value.

title_en: switching circuit
abstract_en: The switching circuit of the present invention includes: a p-channel transfer transistor having a source connected to a power source and a drain connected to a load; and a gate driving circuit connected to the gate of the transfer transistor; the gate driving circuit includes: a1 st transistor through which a1 st current flows by turning on of an on/off signal; and an amplifier in which a reference voltage corresponding to the 1 st current is input to a negative input terminal, a gate voltage of the gate is input to a positive input terminal, a gate current from the gate is controlled by an output from an output terminal so that the gate voltage matches the reference voltage, and a maximum current of the output can be set. The soft on time from the on of the on/off signal to the on of the transfer transistor is set by setting the maximum current according to the gate capacitance of the transfer transistor.

title_en: Transverse coupling acoustic filter
abstract_en: The invention provides a transverse coupling acoustic filter, which is characterized in that an electrode layer is arranged on the surface of a piezoelectric layer, the electrode layer is composed of two interdigital electrodes and a grounding electrode which are physically separated, electrode fingers of the two interdigital electrodes extend reversely and are arranged in a crossing way, the adjacent two electrode fingers are separated by the grounding electrode, so that sound waves which propagate transversely are excited in the piezoelectric layer by the application of radio frequency input voltage between one interdigital electrode and the grounding electrode and are detected by the other interdigital electrode, in addition, the relation between the thickness d of the piezoelectric layer and the center distance p between the adjacent two electrode fingers is adjusted, so that the sound waves have a plurality of transverse coupling resonance modes and a plurality of zero points and poles which are connected with the piezoelectric layer, and the distance between the two poles is far, so that a filter with high bandwidth is formed by the zero points and the poles which are far away, a larger filter bandwidth is easy to form, and in addition, a high-frequency main resonance mode can be selected according to actual needs, and the high-frequency characteristic of the filter is realized.

title_en: Optical isolation type rotary-changing processing circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical isolation type rotary transformer processing circuit which comprises an MCU, an optical isolation module, a rotary transformer resolving module, a following amplifying module, a push-pull filtering module, a rotary transformer and a power module, wherein the MCU controls the signal output of the rotary transformer resolving module through the optical isolation module, the output of the rotary transformer resolving module is electrically connected with the following amplifying module, the following amplifying module is electrically connected with the push-pull filtering module, the push-pull filtering module is electrically connected with the rotary transformer, the feedback signal of the rotary transformer is electrically connected with the rotary transformer resolving module, resolving data are transmitted to the MCU through the optical isolation module, and the MCU, the optical isolation module, the rotary transformer resolving module, the following amplifying module and the push-pull filtering module are all electrically connected with the power module.

title_en: Intelligent power grid monitoring data storage method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a smart power grid monitoring data storage method and system, comprising the following steps: acquiring intelligent power grid monitoring character data, acquiring an initial dictionary according to the intelligent power grid monitoring character data, acquiring coding data, data to be compressed and a character string frequency sequence according to the initial dictionary, acquiring an extended dictionary according to the character string frequency sequence, acquiring an importance degree sequence of the character string in the initial dictionary according to a frequency index of the character string in the character string frequency sequence and a latest frequency factor of the character string in the initial dictionary, acquiring an updated dictionary, and coding and storing the intelligent power grid monitoring character data according to the extended dictionary and the updated dictionary. According to the invention, the character string matching search strategy of the LZ78 algorithm is improved, character strings with higher importance degree are reserved as search data, the search range of the character strings is reduced, and the effect of improving the compression speed is achieved.

title_en: Educational robot data intelligent acquisition and storage method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data compression and storage, in particular to an intelligent data acquisition and storage method and system for an educational robot, comprising the following steps: collecting interaction data; dividing an initial target interval into sub-intervals according to the frequency of each type of data; acquiring a target interval of the first data according to the size of the subinterval corresponding to the first data so as to acquire a target interval of the last data, and acquiring compressed data; acquiring a binary marker coding sequence according to a target interval of each data; acquiring a fixed hash value according to the interactive data; acquiring first possible data and a first possible target interval according to the compressed data and the binary marker coding sequence, and further acquiring various decompressed data; and obtaining final decompressed data according to the fixed hash value. According to the invention, the initial target interval is divided continuously and iteratively to make the range of the final target interval as large as possible, and the shorter the code length of any number selected in the final target interval is after coding, the compression efficiency is improved.

title_en: Circuit for driving IPM, method thereof and IPM
abstract_en: The application provides a circuit for driving an IPM, a method thereof and the IPM, wherein a first output end and a second output end of a control chip of the circuit are respectively connected with two input ends of an exclusive-OR gate, the first output end of the control chip and the output end of the exclusive-OR gate are respectively connected with two input ends of the first AND gate, and the second output end of the control chip and the output end of the exclusive-OR gate are respectively connected with two input ends of the second AND gate; the output end of the first AND gate circuit is connected with the input end of the first NOT gate circuit, the output end of the second AND gate circuit is connected with the input end of the second NOT gate circuit, the output end of the first AND gate circuit and the output end of the first NOT gate circuit are respectively connected with the two output ends of the third AND gate circuit, and the output end of the second AND gate circuit and the output end of the second NOT gate circuit are respectively connected with the two output ends of the fourth AND gate circuit; the output end of the third AND gate circuit and the output end of the fourth AND gate circuit are respectively connected with the input end of the target phase in the IPM.

title_en: Weak signal detection circuit based on photomultiplier output end
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of detection circuits, and discloses a weak signal detection circuit based on an output end of a photomultiplier, which comprises a signal connector, a pre-amplifying circuit, an inverting amplifying circuit, a full-differential grounding low-pass filter circuit, an analog-to-digital conversion driving acquisition module, a controller and a reference power supply, wherein the signal connector is connected with the pre-amplifying circuit; the input end of the signal connector is connected with the output end of the photomultiplier, the output end of the signal connector is connected with the input end of the pre-amplifying circuit, the output end of the pre-amplifying circuit is connected with the input end of the inverting amplifying circuit, the output end of the full-difference grounding low-pass filter circuit is connected with the input end of the analog-digital conversion driving acquisition module, and the output end of the analog-digital conversion driving acquisition module is connected with the controller. The invention can accurately extract weak signals from noise background through proper signal processing and amplification, and is suitable for the fields of fluorescence spectroscopy, biomedical research, environmental monitoring and the like.

title_en: Gain self-adaptive temperature regulation and control circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gain self-adaptive temperature regulation circuit, which comprises a temperature detection unit, a voltage-controlled current source, a current-to-voltage unit and a variable gain amplifier which are connected in sequence; the temperature detection unit detects the temperature of the variable gain amplifier and generates a corresponding temperature voltage signal; the voltage-controlled current source comprises a current mirror and at least one voltage-to-current unit, and generates a corresponding regulation current signal according to the temperature-voltage signal, wherein the regulation current signal changes approximately linearly with the temperature-voltage signal; the current-to-voltage unit generates a corresponding regulation voltage signal according to the regulation current signal; the variable gain amplifier correspondingly regulates the link gain of the variable gain amplifier according to the regulating voltage signal, so that the total gain of the variable gain amplifier is kept dynamically stable along with the temperature change. The invention can realize continuous fine regulation and control of the link gain of the variable gain amplifier on the premise of not sacrificing the linearity of the circuit.

title_en: Discrete time filter, receiver, transmitter and communication device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a discrete time filter, a receiver, a transmitter and communication equipment, and relates to the technical field of communication; the discrete time filter is used for solving the problems that the existing discrete time filter can increase extra power consumption and is inconvenient to adjust when adjusting the feedback coefficient. The discrete time filter comprises a transconductance circuit, a switched capacitor filter circuit, a first sampling capacitor, a second sampling capacitor and a switch; the output end of the transconductance circuit is connected to the first node through the switched capacitor filter circuit; the first end of the first sampling capacitor and the first electrode of the switch are connected with a first node; the second terminal of the switch and the second terminal of the first sampling capacitor are grounded. The second sampling capacitor is connected with the switch, and sampling and negative feedback are realized through the connecting end of the change-over switch, so that the feedback coefficient is adjusted.

title_en: Watchdog circuit capable of restarting system in power-off mode and system power-off restarting method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a watchdog circuit capable of restarting a system in a power-off state and a system power-off restarting method, wherein the watchdog circuit comprises the following components: the device comprises a dog feeding signal input module, a switch on enhancing module, a switch off enhancing module and a watchdog circuit enabling module which are connected in sequence; the feeding dog signal input module comprises: the first end of the double diode D1 is also connected with an IO voltage end of the CPU through a resistor R4, the first end of the double diode D1 is also connected with the ground through a capacitor C2, and the second end of the double diode D1 is connected with a watchdog input voltage end through a resistor R2; when the whole system is powered off, the voltage of the IO voltage end of the CPU of the system continuously drops until 0V, and the charging voltage of the discrete element watchdog circuit also follows the voltage drop of the IO voltage end of the CPU; in the invention, the charging voltage dropping speed of the watchdog circuit is smaller than the IO voltage dropping speed of the CPU due to the capacitor C2 and the resistor R4, and the delay time is prolonged to the second level by reasonably adjusting the values of the capacitor C2 and the resistor R4.

title_en: Delay self-adaptive calibration method and device and calibration circuit
abstract_en: Delay self-adaptive calibration method, delay self-adaptive calibration device and calibration circuit relate to the technical field of integrated circuits. In order to solve the technical problems of complex calibration algorithm and high resource expense of the existing delay calibration technology in the prior art, which are only applicable to the delay calibration of a single asynchronous ADC, the invention provides the technical scheme that: the delay self-adaptive calibration method comprises the following steps: dividing the frequency of the acquired sampling clock signal to generate a frequency-divided signal; and generating a multiphase clock; performing AND operation on each multiphase clock and the corresponding original sampling clock signal to obtain an output signal serving as coarse calibration enabling and fine calibration enabling; when the coarse calibration enabling or the fine calibration enabling is detected, gradually reducing the delay of the signal through switch control; when the voltage of the signal to be detected reaches a preset high level threshold, latching the current switch control signal; step six, completing calibration of other clock signals. The method is applied to delay self-adaptive calibration work of the column-level asynchronous ADC.

title_en: Circuit for reducing bias temperature instability effect
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a circuit for reducing bias temperature instability effects, applied to a chip, comprising at least one logic gate circuit and at least one switching tube, wherein the logic gate circuit comprises a first branch and a second branch which are connected in parallel. The first branch is connected with the target voltage, and the second branch is connected with the target voltage through a switching tube. The switching tube is configured to be turned off when the chip is in a standby state and turned on when the chip is in an operating state. The type of the target voltage is matched with the types of the first branch circuit and the second branch circuit, and the output states of the first branch circuit and the second branch circuit when the chip is in the working state are related to the target voltage. In this way, the switching tube can be used to switch on the first branch and switch off the second branch when the chip enters the standby state. In this way, the impact of the PBTI effect and/or NBTI effect on circuit performance may be reduced while ensuring logic output.

title_en: Current-mode PWM rectifier control system and method suitable for input unbalance
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of PWM rectification control, and provides a current type PWM rectifier control system and method suitable for unbalanced input, which mainly comprise the following steps: firstly, acquiring the change of each equivalent input resistance when the input voltage is unbalanced; and secondly, according to the change of the equivalent input resistance of each phase when the input voltage is unbalanced, the equivalent on-time Ta, tb and Tc of each phase in one input voltage period is adjusted, and the balance of three-phase input currents ia, ib and ic under the input voltage unbalance is realized. The invention can realize the input current balance of the current type PWM rectifier under the unbalanced input voltage condition without additional hardware equipment, and simultaneously reduce the output current ripple.

title_en: Successive approximation type analog-digital converter and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a successive approximation type analog-digital converter and equipment, which relate to the field of integrated circuits and comprise a sampling and holding module, a comparison module, a successive approximation logic module and a capacitor array, wherein the sampling and holding module comprises a first transistor, a second transistor and a third transistor. The first transistor to the third transistor form a dynamic switch structure, the voltage at the first end of the capacitor array can be isolated from an input signal in a conversion stage of successively comparing the reference voltage with the sampling voltage, and even if the second transistor in the sampling hold module can not work in a subthreshold state during overvoltage input, so that the stability of the voltage at the first end of the capacitor array is ensured, and the precision of the successive approximation type analog-digital converter is further ensured.

title_en: Class AB bridge type audio power amplifier circuit, open circuit detection method and audio equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses an AB type bridge type audio power amplifier circuit, an open circuit detection method of the AB type bridge type audio power amplifier circuit and audio equipment. The AB type bridge type audio power amplifier circuit comprises an audio power amplifier module, a current detection module, a current comparison module, a voltage comparison module and a composite logic gate module. The audio power amplifier module drives the positive and negative output end power tubes to generate positive and negative output signals according to the input signals so as to drive the load. The current detection module detects the current of the power tube at the positive and negative output ends. The current comparison module compares the current relation between the current of the power tube at the positive and negative output ends and the current threshold value. The voltage comparison module compares a voltage relationship between an input voltage and a voltage threshold. And the composite logic gate module judges the open circuit condition of the load according to the current relation and the voltage relation. Therefore, the open circuit condition of the load can be detected in the working process of the amplifier, and the normal working of the amplifier is not affected.

title_en: Edge computing gateway data acquisition-oriented adaptive filtering method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an edge computing gateway data acquisition self-adaptive filtering method, which comprises the following steps: step 1, a host communicates with an IO board card to acquire an IO board card equipment address; step 2, the host reads the information of the registration table of the IO board card and obtains the model of the IO board card; step 3, judging that the type of the IO board card corresponds to a channel containing analog data so as to acquire analog data to be filtered; and 4, calling an adaptive filter to filter the analog data. The invention avoids complex equipment inquiry and matching processes, simplifies the data acquisition process, and improves the quality and reliability of data; the adaptive Kalman filter is adopted to carry out adaptive filtering on the nonlinear system effectively, so that the adaptive Kalman filter is more flexible to use, has lower computational complexity, is more suitable for environments with limited resources, and realizes the full-automatic process of collecting and filtering data of the edge computing gateway.

title_en: Radio frequency device, electronic equipment and manufacturing method
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a radio frequency device, an electronic apparatus, and a manufacturing method, the radio frequency device including: a first substrate including a first region therein; a first type resonator and a second type resonator are formed in the first region; the first type of resonator includes a first interdigital electrode, a second piezoelectric layer, and a first acoustic wave reflecting region; the second type of resonator includes a second interdigital electrode, a second piezoelectric layer, an insulating layer, a first piezoelectric layer, and a second acoustic reflection region; wherein the materials of the first piezoelectric layer and the second piezoelectric layer are different. The method can provide the optimal integration scheme of the resonator, improve the integration level of the device, reduce the size of the device, simplify the structure of the device, reduce the process difficulty and the manufacturing cost, and facilitate industrial mass production.

title_en: High-precision timer hardware implementation method
