abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chips, and provides a high-precision timer hardware implementation method, which comprises the following steps: performing low-order invalidation processing on a timer counting counter according to the frequency division value of the timer; the low-resolution PWM wave after output control is delayed by DLL; according to the control signals in the setting and resetting control registers, using the low invalid bit value of the corresponding comparison register to select the high-precision PWM wave after DLL delay; the high-precision timer hardware implementation method provided by the invention can be realized by changing the hardware of the high-precision timer on the basis of a common timer; the high resolution can be realized without increasing the main frequency rate of the kernel; by setting the frequency division value of the working clock, the resolution can be flexibly adjusted.

title_en: Bidirectional active mixer, radio frequency transceiver circuit and communication equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses two-way active mixer, radio frequency transceiver circuit and communications facilities, the mixer includes: the device comprises a control circuit, an intermediate frequency circuit, a mixing switch circuit, an adjustable current source circuit and a matching network; the first end and the second end of the intermediate frequency circuit are respectively connected with the radio frequency transmitting end and the radio frequency receiving end; the first end and the second end of the frequency mixing switch circuit are respectively connected with the radio frequency receiving end and the first end of the matching network; the second end of the matching network is connected with the first end of the adjustable current source circuit; the third end of the matching network is connected with the radio frequency input/output port; the control circuit is used for receiving the radio frequency signal and controlling the intermediate frequency circuit to serve as an intermediate frequency load; controlling an adjustable current source circuit to serve as a tail current source of the mixing switch circuit; the control circuit is used for transmitting radio frequency signals and controlling the intermediate frequency circuit to serve as a passage for the radio frequency signals to reach the mixing switch circuit; the adjustable current source circuit is controlled to inject current into the mixing switch circuit. The mixer is shared in two states of signal receiving and signal transmitting, so that the circuit area is saved, and the power consumption is not increased.

title_en: Multi-sample rate data converter
abstract_en: A test and measurement instrument comprising: a first data channel comprising a first data converter operating at a first rate; and a second data channel comprising a second data converter operating at a second rate different from the first rate. Rate control may include: a clock generation circuit. The clock generation circuit includes: an intermediate frequency generator structured to generate an intermediate frequency clock from the first clock reference signal; a first frequency clock generator structured to generate a first frequency clock directly from the intermediate frequency clock; and a second frequency clock generator structured to generate a second frequency clock directly from the intermediate frequency clock. The first frequency clock may be used to control the rate of the first data channel and the second frequency clock may be used to control the rate of the second data channel. Methods are also disclosed.

title_en: Stream table compression method, computer equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of computers and provides a flow table compression method, computer equipment and a medium. The method comprises the following steps: determining a first flow table to be compressed, which comprises a plurality of flow table items to be compressed; for each flow table item to be compressed, determining a first key value segment and a second key value segment of a key value part of the flow table item to be compressed based on a first segmentation strategy; aiming at each flow table item to be compressed, based on a first compression algorithm, compressing the first key value segment to obtain a third key value segment, and then replacing the first key value segment with the third key value segment to obtain a corresponding compressed flow table item, thereby obtaining a plurality of compressed flow table items; based on the plurality of compressed stream table entries, a first register table is generated, and the first register table is used for replacing the first stream table to perform stream table matching and stream table actions. Thus, the resources and the cost occupied by the flow table are reduced, and the processing delay and the power consumption of the data frames are also reduced.

title_en: Filter, forming method, communication device and terminal
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a filter, a forming method, communication equipment and a terminal, wherein the filter comprises the following components: at least two resonators; a bonding structure located on a portion of the resonator; a substrate connected with the bonding structure, and a first cavity is arranged between the substrate and the resonator; the protection layer comprises a substrate connecting part and an intermediate protection part which are connected, wherein the substrate connecting part is connected with the substrate and surrounds the first cavity, and the intermediate protection part covers the bottom of the resonator, so that the substrate connecting part and the intermediate protection part of the protection layer and the substrate form a sealed protection space surrounding the resonator. According to the filter provided by the embodiment of the invention, the protective layer is formed at the bottom of the resonator, so that the protective layer and the substrate form the sealed protective space surrounding the resonator, the corrosion of plastic packaging glue to the lower part of the filter and the corrosion of water vapor to the filter can be prevented, and the structural reliability of the filter is improved.

title_en: Pulse discharging circuit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pulse discharging circuit which comprises a PCB board, a high-frequency transformer T1, an energy storage capacitor C7, a secondary turn-off diode D4, a discharging plug connector JP3, a discharging plug connector JP4, a control thyristor Q7 and peripheral elements, wherein the high-frequency transformer T1 is electrically connected with a negative electrode charging wire electrically connected with the energy storage capacitor C7, the high-frequency transformer T1 is electrically connected with a positive electrode charging wire electrically connected with the secondary turn-off diode D4, the energy storage capacitor C7 is electrically connected with a positive electrode discharging wire electrically connected with the secondary turn-off diode D4 and the discharging plug connector JP3, the energy storage capacitor C7 is electrically connected with a negative electrode discharging wire A electrically connected with the control thyristor Q7, and the control thyristor Q7 is electrically connected with a negative electrode discharging wire B electrically connected with the discharging plug connector JP 4; the invention has the advantages that components with smaller volume can be selected under the condition of meeting reliable indexes, the ignition preparation time can be reduced, and the residual energy after ignition can be reduced.

title_en: Input clock buffer and clock signal buffering method
abstract_en: An input clock buffer and a clock signal buffering method. The input clock buffer includes: a first capacitor: a second capacitor: a first amplifier for generating a first output signal, comprising an input terminal coupled to the first capacitor and the second capacitor, wherein the first capacitor and the second capacitor receive a differential input signal; a second amplifier for generating a second output signal according to the differential input signal; a frequency detection circuit for generating a frequency detection signal according to a frequency of the differential input signal; and a switch, which is positioned between an output of the first amplifier and an output of the second amplifier, and is used for being turned on or turned off according to the frequency detection signal.

title_en: Defibrillation biphasic wave generating system and method, electronic device, and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a defibrillation biphasic wave generation system and method, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of external defibrillation. The defibrillation biphasic wave generating system comprises a power supply, a main switch and an H-bridge circuit, wherein a first end of the main switch is electrically connected with one end of the power supply, a second end of the main switch is electrically connected with one end of the H-bridge circuit, and the other end of the H-bridge circuit is electrically connected with the other end of the power supply; the H-bridge circuit comprises four bridge arms, each bridge arm comprises at least two switching tubes which are connected in series, and each bridge arm is connected with a voltage equalizing circuit in parallel; the main switch and the controlled end of each switch tube are connected with corresponding driving circuits, and each driving circuit is connected with corresponding control signals. According to the defibrillation biphasic wave generating system provided by the embodiment of the invention, the problem that the switching tube is broken down due to non-uniform voltage, so that equipment is damaged and the treatment of a patient is delayed can be avoided; moreover, the electric gap requirement can be met, and the cost is reduced.

title_en: Ramp generator, readout circuit and image sensor
abstract_en: The invention provides a slope generator, a reading circuit and an image sensor, wherein the slope generator comprises a current source, a resistor, a first operational amplifier, a second operational amplifier, a first capacitor, a second capacitor, a first switch, a second switch, a third switch and a fourth switch; the first input end of the first operational amplifier receives the reference voltage, the second input end is connected with the first end of the first capacitor and is connected with the power supply voltage through a current source, and the output end is connected with the first end of the second capacitor and is grounded through a resistor; the first end of the first capacitor is connected with the reference voltage through the first switch, and the second end of the first capacitor is connected with the reference voltage through the second switch; the second end of the second capacitor is connected with the input end of the second operational amplifier and grounded through the third switch; the output end of the second operational amplifier is connected with the first end of the fourth switch, and the second end of the fourth switch is connected with the second end of the first capacitor and outputs a slope voltage. The invention solves the problem of larger thermal noise of the existing slope generator.

title_en: Radio frequency switch circuit and chip for optimizing voltage distribution balance of stacked switch tube
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radio frequency switch circuit and a chip for optimizing voltage distribution balance of a stacked switch tube. The radio frequency switching circuit is formed by stacking N switching transistor source-drain links, wherein N is a positive integer and is more than or equal to 3; the source end and the drain end of each switch transistor are connected through a source-drain bias resistor; the body end of each switching transistor is connected with a body end bias resistor, and after N body end bias resistors are sequentially connected in series, the head end is connected with a body end bias voltage source; meanwhile, the serial diode branch circuit connected with the body end of the even-level switching transistor is connected to the source-drain end of the switching transistor of the even-level switching transistor, and the serial diode branch circuit connected with the body end of the odd-level switching transistor is connected to the source-drain end of the adjacent switching transistor. When the radio frequency switching circuit is turned off, the body end leakage current generated by each stage of switching transistor flows into the radio frequency main path through the serial diode branch and counteracts each other, so that the balance of the voltage distribution of the stacked switching transistors is optimized.

title_en: DAC device supporting DMA request and processing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a DAC device supporting DMA request, comprising: the device comprises a FIFO buffer module, a DAC digital module and a DAC analog module. The input end of the FIFO buffer module is connected with the DMA module and is used for buffering the DMA data transmitted by the DMA module. The output end of the FIFO buffer module is connected with the input end of the DAC digital module and is used for transmitting the buffered DMA data to the DAC digital module. The output end of the DAC digital module is connected with the DAC analog module. The invention also discloses a processing method of the DAC device supporting the DMA request. The invention can realize the buffer of DMA data, thereby realizing continuous DMA request and improving DAC processing rate.

title_en: Wafer-level packaging method of BAW filter
abstract_en: The application discloses a BAW filter wafer level packaging method, which comprises the following steps: bonding the first surface of the first BAW wafer and the first surface of the second BAW wafer, performing wafer-level bonding, etching the first surface of the BAW wafer after wafer-level bonding to form a silicon through hole, exposing a metal bonding pad after wafer-level bonding, depositing a metal seed layer in a non-silicon through hole area of the first surface of the BAW wafer, electroplating copper in the silicon through hole, and electroplating bumps on the formed copper surface to form the BAW filter of wafer-level packaging; and (5) performing reflow soldering in the bump electroplating process. The first BAW wafer serving as the sending end and the second BAW wafer serving as the receiving end are bonded together to realize three-dimensional stacking, so that occupied area is directly reduced by half, chip integration and use are facilitated, and chip miniaturization and light weight are realized.

title_en: Bandwidth-adjustable on-chip second-order band-pass filter
abstract_en: The invention discloses an on-chip second-order band-pass filter with adjustable bandwidth, relates to an on-chip integrated semiconductor technology, and provides a scheme for solving the problems that the bandwidth cannot be adjusted in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a second-order filter module of N channels after setting a first-order N-channel filter structure image, wherein each channel of the second-order filter module is controlled by a bias switch signal in one-to-one correspondence, and the bias switch signals are obtained by respectively superposing N-phase non-overlapping switch signals with adjustable bias voltages. The method has the advantages of realizing on-chip integration, bandwidth adjustment and out-of-band high suppression.

title_en: Broadband EMI filter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a broadband EMI filter, which belongs to the field of passive devices, and comprises a cavity (2), wherein the upper end and the lower end of the cavity (2) are respectively provided with an internal conductor (1), the middle of the internal conductor (1) is provided with a central conductor (6), one to three suppression units are arranged in the cavity (2), the structure of each suppression unit is rotationally symmetrical along the central conductor (6), the first suppression unit is in an inductance and capacitance structure, the second suppression unit is in an inductance structure, and the third suppression unit is a radio frequency coil and an absorption inductance; the broadband EMI filter structure is beneficial to miniaturization of components and meets the EMI resistant requirements of systems with high density of electronic instruments and equipment such as large ships and large aircrafts.

title_en: Ladder matrix code and high-parallelism low-delay sequence statistic decoding method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ladder matrix code and a high-parallelism low-delay sequence statistic decoding (Ordered statistics decoding, OSD) method thereof, wherein the ladder matrix code can be divided into a ladder generating matrix code and a ladder checking matrix code, and the corresponding generating matrix or checking matrix has a ladder structure or has a ladder structure after column-row exchange. Based on the special ladder structure, the decoding of the ladder matrix code can adopt special high-parallelism low-delay OSD. Specifically, at least one reliable bit is selected from the bits corresponding to each step to form an extended reliable base, and the corresponding generation matrix or check matrix has an upper triangle or lower triangle structure. Under a special triangle structure, gaussian elimination can realize parallel processing of all lines, and then recoding and the like are performed to finish decoding. The ladder structure provided by the invention combines with a special OSD design, overcomes the defect that Gaussian elimination in the traditional OSD can only be executed in series, and can further combine with local constraint OSD and the like to reduce recoding times, thereby realizing low-delay low-complexity high-reliability decoding.

title_en: PCB-based serial type B-J type continuous Doherty power amplifier
abstract_en: The invention discloses a serial type B-J type continuous Doherty power amplifier based on a PCB (printed circuit board), which comprises a power divider, a first input matching network, a second input matching network, a first bias and harmonic suppression network, a second bias and harmonic suppression network, a transistor Q1, a transistor Q2, a first 1/4 wavelength microstrip line, a second 1/4 wavelength microstrip line, a balance changer and an output resistor R1, wherein the input end of the power divider is connected with two output ends of the power divider correspondingly, the first bias and harmonic suppression network, the second bias and harmonic suppression network and the second input matching network are respectively connected with the first input matching network and the second input matching network correspondingly, and one end of the output resistor R1 is connected with the output end of the balance changer and the other end of the output resistor R1 is grounded. Through the design, the amplifier can solve the problem of influence of transmission line dispersion and peak power amplifier output impedance frequency response on carrier power amplifier back-off efficiency, further realize good matching of fundamental waves and suppression of harmonic waves in a broadband, and meet the requirement of a back-matching network bandwidth on low-resistance transformation ratio.

title_en: Remote monitoring and transmitting method for temperature data of intelligent sleeping bag
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data compression, in particular to an intelligent sleeping bag temperature data remote monitoring and transmitting method. The method comprises the steps of obtaining original noise degree of target temperature data in a temperature sequence; obtaining the similarity between a local preset window and a neighborhood similarity window of target temperature data; the original noise is adjusted by using the similarity and the environmental temperature data to obtain the corrected noise degree; according to the difference between the target temperature data and the temperature data in the searching preset window and the correction noise degree, the data to be smoothed is screened from the target temperature data, and smoothing is carried out to obtain a smooth temperature sequence; and compressing and storing temperature data in the smooth temperature sequence by using run-length coding. According to the intelligent sleeping bag temperature data compression method, noise data are smoothed before the intelligent sleeping bag temperature data are transmitted, compression transmission is carried out, the runlength of the runlength process of the temperature data is increased, and the compression transmission efficiency of the temperature data of the intelligent sleeping bag is improved.

title_en: High-bandwidth precision transimpedance amplifier with high integration level and low direct current offset
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of radio frequency receiving and transmitting electronics, in particular relates to a high-bandwidth precision transimpedance amplifier with high integration level and low direct current offset, and aims to solve the problem that in the prior art, a direct current offset compensation circuit, a gain control circuit and a bandwidth calibration tuning circuit work independently and the integration level is insufficient. The invention comprises the following steps: a trans-impedance amplifier kernel for realizing the filtering of analog-to-digital conversion and the bandwidth calibration and accurate tuning of a sampling link; the quantizer quantizes the single-ended output voltage and the differential output voltage of the transimpedance amplifier core differential output when the switch is closed; the feedback network controls the current generation module to generate injection current and extraction current and controls the transimpedance amplifier core; the current generation module generates injection current and extraction current; and a switch for controlling the working mode of the transimpedance amplifier. The invention provides a transimpedance amplifier structure which utilizes a single-loop feedback network to simultaneously compensate direct current offset, control gain and calibrate bandwidth.

title_en: Resonant cavity structure of high-Q miniaturized loading distributed capacitor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic components, in particular to a resonant cavity structure of a high-Q miniaturized loading distributed capacitor. The resonant cavity inner conductor and the resonant cavity outer conductor are separated and form a part of capacitance, and the resonant cavity inner conductor is of a hollow structure, so that a part of capacitance is formed inside the resonant cavity inner conductor; one end of the tuning screw rod extends into the outer conductor of the resonant cavity from the other end opposite to one end of the outer conductor of the resonant cavity, and is arranged at intervals with the inner conductor of the resonant cavity to form a part of variable capacitor. Through the scheme, dielectric loss is almost not existed, the facing area between layers can be increased, the current density is reduced, the metallic heating loss is further reduced, the capacitance of the plate capacitor generated between the layers is further increased, and the quality factor Q of the LC parallel resonant cavity is increased.

title_en: Clock phase locking method and system for pilot signal auxiliary phase feedback
abstract_en: The invention discloses a clock phase locking method and system for pilot signal auxiliary phase feedback, and belongs to the field of signal processing. The method tracks the real-time phase of the beat frequency signal through the pilot frequency signal, and the system comprises an analog signal synthesizer, an ADC, an ultra-stable local oscillator for generating the pilot frequency signal and a sampling clock, a pilot frequency phase error extractor, a digital phase accumulator, a tracking frequency synthesizer, a phase feedback compensator, a digital pilot frequency synthesizer, a digital frequency synthesizer, a plurality of mixers and a plurality of filters. The invention has the advantages of extracting the phase error of the reference sampling clock introduced by the analog-to-digital converter (ADC) from the pilot signal in real time and compensating the feedback quantity used by phase locking, suppressing the interference of the ADC sampling process on the clock phase locking precision, and providing a high-precision clock comparison standard for space gravitational wave detection.

title_en: Adaptive filtering method based on improved normalized variable step length LMS algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to an adaptive filtering method based on an improved normalized variable step length LMS algorithm, and belongs to the field of digital signal processing. The method solves the problems that the steady state performance of a filter is low, the initial convergence speed is low and the steady state performance of a SVSS-NLMS step-size switching algorithm is reduced when the calculated fixed constant value is unstable facing a large amount of unknown environmental parameters in the channel identification process of the existing self-adaptive filtering method. The improved algorithm adopts a three-section switching type step length changing scheme, wherein the step length of the middle section adopts a real-time reduction iteration scheme, so that the initial large step length can be smoothly transferred to the optimal small step length, the convergence speed is higher, and meanwhile, the robustness is better. The algorithm is defined as ISSVS-NLMS, and has fewer parameters to be adjusted, higher stability and lower risk when the hardware processes data, and is beneficial to the hardware implementation of an echo suppression system.

title_en: Amplifier and oscilloscope
abstract_en: The invention discloses an amplifier and an oscilloscope. The input control end of the transconductance amplification module is connected with the input signal pair, and the transconductance amplification module is used for converting the input signal pair into an output current pair and outputting the output current pair; the feedforward transconductance module comprises a first feedforward control end pair, wherein the first feedforward control end pair is connected with the input signal pair and outputs a feedforward current pair; the gain control module comprises a first differential pair and a second differential pair, wherein a first output end of the first differential pair is used for compensating positive phase output current in the output current pair, and a second output end of the first differential pair is used for compensating reverse phase output current in the output current pair; the first output end of the second differential pair is used for compensating the positive phase output current in the output current pair, and the second output end of the second differential pair is used for compensating the negative phase output current in the output current pair. The technical scheme provided by the invention can eliminate the process deviation.

title_en: MEMS resonator and optimization method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a MEMS resonator and an optimization method thereof, comprising the following steps: the vibrating arms and the external electrodes are arranged at intervals; the opposite sides of the vibrating arms and the external electrodes are in a tooth shape, an external electrode gap in a tooth shape is formed between the vibrating arms and the external electrodes, and the external electrode gap comprises a plurality of first gaps and second gaps which are staggered and communicated; and an included angle theta is formed between the first gap and the length direction of the vibrating arm, and the magnitude of the included angle theta is inversely related to the absolute value of the frequency deviation delta f_p of the MEMS resonator. The MEMS resonator disclosed by the invention can solve the problem of resonance frequency deviation caused by stress in the packaging process.

title_en: Cascade end region steady-state pressure field reconstruction method based on compressed sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascade end region steady-state pressure field reconstruction method based on compressed sensing, which develops a vector compressed sensing method suitable for multi-working-condition steady-state measurement based on a traditional compressed sensing method, and is combined with a data driving modal analysis method, so that the cascade end region pressure distribution is reconstructed with higher precision by adopting a less number of sparse measurement point layouts for the first time. The method comprises two parts of data training and data reconstruction, firstly, an optimal sparse measuring point arrangement scheme meeting the measurement requirements of multiple working conditions can be obtained before experimental development through the data training, experimental measurement can be carried out through the arrangement scheme, and high spatial resolution pressure field reconstruction of the blade grid end region can be achieved through solving an optimization problem.

title_en: Amplifier circuit
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides an amplifier circuit applied to a power amplifier, wherein the amplifier circuit comprises: the voltage regulating circuit is connected with the input end of the power amplifier, samples an input signal and generates a limiting voltage based on the sampled signal; the voltage regulating circuit is also connected with a bias circuit in the power amplifier, and the limiting voltage is used for limiting the bias current of the power amplifier.

title_en: High-side driving circuit, control method thereof and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-side driving circuit, a control method thereof and a vehicle. The high-side driving circuit includes: at least one pre-driving unit and at least one switching unit; the output end of the pre-driving unit is electrically connected with the control end of the corresponding switch unit, the first end of the switch unit is electrically connected with the voltage signal end, the second end of the switch unit is electrically connected with the first end of the load, and the second end of the load is electrically connected with the grounding end; when a load working instruction is received, the pre-driving unit controls the first end of the switching unit to be conducted with the second end of the switching unit, and controls the pulse modulation PWM frequency of the switching unit. The high-side chip is replaced by the pre-driving unit and the switching unit, so that high-side driving is realized, cost can be effectively reduced, the advantages are realized, and the purposes of controlling the load and the speed regulating circuit can be realized by means of the pre-driving unit and the switching unit.

title_en: Electronic device and temperature sensing device thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an electronic device and a temperature sensing device thereof. The temperature sensing device comprises a differential stage circuit and an output stage circuit. The differential stage circuit has a first differential end and a second differential end and includes a cross-coupled transistor assembly, a first resistor, and a second resistor. The cross-coupled transistor assembly receives a first voltage. The first resistor is coupled between the first differential end and the second voltage, wherein the first resistor is a polysilicon resistor. The second resistor is coupled between the second differential end and a second voltage, wherein the second resistor is a silicon carbide diffusion resistor. The output stage circuit generates a driving voltage according to a first control voltage on the first differential end and a second control voltage on the second differential end.

title_en: Impedance matching method and system based on series-parallel equivalent capacitance matrix
abstract_en: The invention discloses an impedance matching method and system based on a series-parallel equivalent capacitance matrix, comprising the steps of presetting a first series-parallel equivalent matching circuit aiming at a branch line, obtaining a first reflection coefficient of an injected cable signal after being processed by the series-parallel equivalent matching circuit, wherein the first series-parallel equivalent matching circuit comprises a branch inductance and a bypass capacitance of the branch line, and integrally connecting the capacitor matrix in parallel; judging the first reflection coefficient and the first threshold value, and performing capacitance configuration according to a capacitance matrix in the first series-parallel equivalent matching circuit to obtain a second series-parallel equivalent matching circuit; and acquiring a second reflection coefficient of the injected cable signal after being processed by a second series-parallel equivalent matching circuit, and if the second reflection coefficient meets a threshold value, successfully matching the impedance based on the series-parallel equivalent capacitance matrix. The problem caused by impedance mismatch between the signal line and the power cable can be effectively solved, and the injection efficiency of signals is improved.

title_en: High-precision current sampling circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-precision current sampling circuit, which comprises two current mirror groups, wherein the two current mirror groups are used for copying bias current sources, the output end of a first current mirror group is connected with a negative feedback loop, and the output end of a second current mirror group is connected with an AD module; one end of the negative feedback loop is connected with the peripheral implementation circuit, and the other end of the negative feedback loop is connected with the second current mirror group. The invention simplifies the structure of the current sampling circuit, so that the area and the power consumption are lower, and the amplification error caused by process deviation is eliminated.

title_en: Chip compatibility verification method, device and system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a chip compatibility verification method, device and system and electronic equipment, and belongs to the technical field of integrated circuit testing. The verification method comprises the following steps: analyzing the test case data to at least obtain excitation data of the compatibility index of the verification target; driving an RTL DUT of a chip to be tested based on the excitation data and obtaining first test signal data; transmitting the excitation data to an evaluation card for exciting a label matching chip on the evaluation card; when the evaluation card receives the excitation data and excites the benchmarking chip, a measurable signal is generated at a data acquisition point on the evaluation card; acquiring test data acquired by a data acquisition card and converting the test data into second test signal data; and comparing the first test signal data with the second test signal data to verify whether the chip to be tested and the target chip meet the target compatibility index. The embodiment of the application improves the verification efficiency and the reliability.

title_en: Power synthesis module and power amplifier
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of radio frequency, and particularly provides a power synthesis module and a power amplifier, which aim to solve the problem of matching output impedance and load impedance of the power amplifier. The power synthesis module comprises a first signal amplification circuit, a second signal amplification circuit and a coupling inductance circuit; in the coupling inductance circuit, the first inductance and the second inductance are connected in series, the third inductance and the fourth inductance are connected in series, the other end of the third inductance is the output end of the power synthesis module, and the other end of the fourth inductance is grounded; the first inductor and the second inductor are respectively connected with the first ends of the first signal amplifying circuit and the second signal amplifying circuit, and the second ends of the first signal amplifying circuit and the second signal amplifying circuit are input ends of the power synthesis module; the first inductor and the third inductor form a coupling inductor, and the second inductor and the fourth inductor form a coupling inductor. By the coupling inductance, the output impedance of the power combining module can be adjusted to be consistent with the load impedance, so that the load can obtain the maximum power.

title_en: Composite substrate and method for manufacturing composite substrate
abstract_en: The invention provides a composite substrate with suppressed warpage. The composite substrate according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: the piezoelectric film is composed of a polycrystal having a c-axis orientation degree of 80% or less, which is determined by the Lotgering method.

title_en: Apparatus and method for data transmission offset value in burst transmission
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and method for data transmission offset values in burst transmission. An example apparatus may include offset logic configured to provide an offset value associated with a receiver circuit of a memory device coupled to a signal line. The offset value is based on an individual transition threshold bias of a sample circuit of the receiver circuit. The example apparatus may further include an input/output I/O circuit including a driver circuit. The driver circuit is configured to receive a logic signal and the offset value and to provide an output signal to the signal line based on the logic signal and to adjust a voltage of the output signal based on the offset value.

title_en: Intelligent electronic switch, integrated circuit chip, chip product and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent electronic switch, include: the switch control unit is used for being connected with the load in series, and the control end of the switch control unit is connected with the switch control unit; the overcurrent detection judging module is used for obtaining sampling current information, the sampling current information is used for representing current flowing through the power switch, the sampling current information is also used for receiving second reference voltage, and when the sampling current information is larger than or equal to the second reference voltage and lasts for a first preset duration, the overcurrent detection judging module outputs an overcurrent signal to the switch control unit, and the switch control unit controls the power switch to be disconnected and cut off; the overcurrent detection judging module is further used for obtaining a first battery signal representing battery voltage, the second reference voltage is adjusted according to the first battery signal, and the larger the first battery signal is, the smaller the second reference voltage is. The embodiment of the application also provides an integrated circuit chip, a chip product and electronic equipment.

title_en: Method for reducing crosstalk between chip interfaces
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for reducing the crosstalk between chip interfaces, which relates to the technical field of high-speed signal crosstalk processing and comprises the following steps: step S1, dividing chip interfaces according to a preset dividing principle and then combining to form a plurality of interface islands; and S2, inserting a power line between adjacent interface islands in the plurality of interface islands for isolation. The beneficial effects are that: the interfaces are designed in an island mode, and the power lines are inserted between the islands to isolate, so that the distance between high-speed signals between the interfaces is increased due to the arrangement of the power lines, the capacitive coupling and inductive coupling of electromagnetic fields between the interfaces are obviously reduced, and the mutual crosstalk between the interfaces is reduced from the source.

title_en: Discrete low-power integrator based on operational amplifier switching delta-sigma modulator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a discrete low-power-consumption integrator for a delta-sigma modulator, which belongs to the field of integrated circuits and comprises a first feedback module, a second feedback module, an integrating amplifier module and a signal input module, wherein the integrator module comprises a first operational amplifier and a second operational amplifier, and input ends of the integrator module are respectively connected with the signal input module and the first feedback module and the second feedback module. The outputs of the first and second op-amps are also connected to the integrator output, respectively. The result generated by the post-stage quantizer controls the first feedback module and the second feedback module, and the clock inputs CLK1, CLK2, CLK1S and CLK2S control the signal input module and the integrator module. The delta-sigma ADC first-stage integrator is most important, wherein the operational amplifier has the highest requirement and the highest power consumption. The integrator of the invention can greatly reduce the power consumption of the whole modulator.

title_en: Topology structure and bandwidth reconfigurable low-pass filter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a topological structure, which comprises a first varactor, a second varactor, a first open circuit branch, a second open circuit branch, a third open circuit branch, a fourth open circuit branch, a fifth open circuit branch, a sixth open circuit branch, a seventh open circuit branch, an eighth open circuit branch, a first microstrip line, a second microstrip line, a third microstrip line, a fourth microstrip line, a fifth microstrip line, a sixth microstrip line, a seventh microstrip line, an eighth microstrip line, a ninth microstrip line, a tenth microstrip line, an eleventh microstrip line, a twelfth microstrip line, a thirteenth microstrip line, a fourteenth microstrip line, a fifteenth microstrip line, a sixteenth microstrip line, a seventeenth microstrip line, an eighteenth microstrip line, a nineteenth microstrip line, a twentieth microstrip line, an input end and an output end. The invention also discloses a bandwidth-reconfigurable low-pass filter based on the topological structure, which has the advantages of wide bandwidth-reconfigurable range, compact structure, good selectivity, wide stop band, high isolation and the like.

title_en: Direct drive circuit structure based on depletion type power field effect transistor device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a direct drive circuit structure based on a depletion type power field effect transistor device, which comprises the following components: the positive voltage driver DRV, the charge pump CP, the normally-on transistor Q2, the diode D1, the voltage control circuit, the voltage stabilizing tube D2, the normally-off transistor Q1 and the control signal output circuit; the positive voltage driver DRV is connected to the charge pump CP, the charge pump CP is connected to the gate of the normally-on transistor Q2, the gate of the normally-on transistor Q2 is also connected to the anode of the diode D1, the cathode of the diode D1 is connected to the source of the normally-off transistor Q1, the source of the normally-on transistor Q2 is also connected to the cathode of the voltage regulator D2, the anode of the voltage regulator D2 is connected to the source of the normally-off transistor Q1, the gate of the normally-off transistor Q1 is connected to the voltage control circuit, and the control signal output circuit is connected to the positive voltage driver DRV and the voltage control circuit. The invention can reduce the switching loss and fully release the performance of the depletion type power field effect transistor device.

title_en: RFFE control interface identification circuit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of radio frequency control interfaces, and discloses an RFFE control interface identification circuit which comprises a first current mirror, a second current mirror, a resistor R1 and a resistor R2; when the signal input end of the invention inputs high and low level signals or is in a suspended state in actual use, the two control state output ends can generate signal states of three states, so that when the invention is three, nine signal states can be generated in total, and the signal states can be used for enabling control, thereby reducing the circuit area required for realizing the same function and being beneficial to actual application.

title_en: Piezoelectric vibrator
abstract_en: The present invention provides a piezoelectric vibrator, comprising: a piezoelectric vibration element including a piezoelectric sheet, a first excitation electrode provided on a first surface of the piezoelectric sheet, and a second excitation electrode provided on a second surface of the piezoelectric sheet; a first crystal substrate having an external terminal and bonded to a first surface of the piezoelectric sheet; and a second crystal substrate bonded to the second surface of the piezoelectric sheet, wherein the first crystal substrate has a main surface defined by a first base axis and a second base axis intersecting the first base axis, and when an axis obtained by tilting the third axis about the first axis by a first predetermined angle is a first tilt axis, among the first axis, the second axis, and the third axis which are crystal axes of the crystal, the first crystal substrate is configured to have the first axis corresponding to the first base axis and the first tilt axis corresponding to the second base axis, and the first predetermined angle is any angle included in an angle range of-90 degrees to-60 degrees and 80 degrees to 90 degrees.

title_en: Data deserializing device, processing method and core particle integrated system
abstract_en: The invention provides a data deserializing device, a data deserializing method and a core particle integrated system, and the data deserializing device comprises: a local synchronous clock generation loop, which forms a local synchronous clock and a local synchronous parallel clock according to the local serial clock and the system parallel clock; the first-in first-out stack is used for inputting serial data or local intermediate frequency data, and the local synchronous clock is used as a data output clock to finish the cross-clock domain processing of the input data so as to form the local synchronous data; the first deserializer converts the local synchronous data into local synchronous parallel data according to the local synchronous clock; and a synchronization circuit that converts the locally synchronized parallel data into parallel data under the locally synchronized parallel clock. The data deserializing device, the data deserializing method and the core particle integrated system provided by the invention can save hardware resources, improve the performance of the system and meet the low-delay requirement of data transmission among core particles.

title_en: Decompression method and device for compressed data, chip and storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a decompression method and apparatus, a chip and a storage medium for compressed data, wherein the decompression method includes: dividing the accessed compressed data code stream, and analyzing to obtain the data block head and the weight data; obtaining a data block head each time to obtain a code table data value set and a comparator value of a set bit number; acquiring preparation data in the weight data one by one according to a decoding clock period; taking the preparation data of the number of the decoding channels each time and sequentially putting the preparation data into the decoding channels until the preparation data is put into the decoding channels; the decoder connected with each decoding channel is utilized to fetch the preparation data with the first bit width for decoding so as to obtain the pre-decoding data with the second bit width, and the pre-decoding data output by the decoder in the decoding channel are spliced into the decoding data with the original bit width in parallel in each decoding clock period. Therefore, parallel decoding operation can be realized, and decoding efficiency is improved.

title_en: Tracking module
abstract_en: A tracking module (100) is provided with: an integrated circuit (80), a capacitor (C11), and a capacitor (C30) disposed on a module substrate (90), the integrated circuit (80) comprising: at least one switch comprised by a switched capacitor circuit (20) configured to generate a plurality of discrete voltages based on an input voltage; and at least one switch included in an output switch circuit (30) configured to selectively output at least one of a plurality of discrete voltages based on the envelope signal, the capacitor (C11) being a flying capacitor included in the switched capacitor circuit (20), the capacitor (C30) being a smoothing capacitor included in the switched capacitor circuit (20), the capacitor (C11) being disposed closer to the integrated circuit (80) than the capacitor (C30) in a plan view of the module substrate (90).

title_en: Capacitive proximity switch
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of capacitive proximity switches, and particularly discloses a capacitive proximity switch which comprises a first proximity switch shell and a second proximity switch shell, wherein an integrated circuit part is arranged in the first proximity switch shell, one side of the integrated circuit part stretches into the second proximity switch shell, one sides of the interiors of the first proximity switch shell and the second proximity switch shell are fixedly connected with a first stabilizing component, the other sides of the interiors of the first proximity switch shell and the second proximity switch shell are fixedly connected with a second stabilizing component, an adjusting ring at the bottom of a positioning rod is rotated to adjust the movement of the positioning rod in a ring belt manner, and a clamping block is separated from a clamping hole under the action of a return spring, so that the positioning rod is separated from a positioning seat, the capacitive proximity switch shell can be detached, the detachment is convenient and rapid, and a worker can maintain or clean internal parts of the switch conveniently, and the capacitive proximity switch is very useful in application occasions requiring frequent maintenance.

title_en: Radio frequency amplifier and radio frequency front end module
abstract_en: The application provides a radio frequency amplifier and a radio frequency front end module, wherein the radio frequency amplifier comprises: balun, first radio frequency amplifying circuit, second radio frequency amplifying circuit, first resonant circuit and second resonant circuit; the balun comprises a first coil, a second coil and a third coil; the first radio frequency amplifying circuit is connected with the second coil, and the second radio frequency amplifying circuit is connected with the third coil; the first end of the first coil is grounded through a first resonant circuit, and the second end of the first coil is grounded through a second resonant circuit; when the first radio frequency amplifying circuit outputs radio frequency signals of a first frequency band, a first end of the first coil outputs first output signals, and a second end of the first coil is short-circuited to ground through the second resonant circuit; when the second radio frequency amplifying circuit outputs radio frequency signals of a second frequency band, the second end of the first coil outputs second output signals, and the first end of the first coil is short-circuited to the ground through the first resonant circuit. The area occupied by the radio frequency amplifier can be reduced, and the miniaturization of the radio frequency front end module is facilitated.

title_en: Novel touch knob and gas stove
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel touch knob, wherein a knob shell is of a hollow structure, a shaft sleeve is led out from the lower part of the knob shell through a transversely extending connecting cantilever, the knob shell is connected with a valve shaft of a regulating valve of a gas stove when in use, a timing digital display assembly is arranged in a hollow cavity above the connecting cantilever, a control panel is arranged in a light-emitting ring, and a touch display cover is arranged above the control panel and the light-emitting ring. Because knob shell and timing digital display subassembly are split structure, can accomplish each other not connect, when installing on gas-cooker, the cavity of timing digital display subassembly accessible knob shell is connected with the mounting of the governing valve body of below, and the knob shell passes through the valve shaft of shaft sleeve connection governing valve, like this when rotatory knob shell, can guarantee that the position of timing digital display subassembly is unchangeable. Meanwhile, the touch display cover is arranged above the knob shell, so that timing setting can be conveniently carried out, and the luminous ring is started after timing setting, so that a reminding effect can be achieved.

title_en: High-frequency acoustic wave resonator and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of resonators, in particular to a high-frequency acoustic wave resonator and a preparation method thereof. The high-frequency acoustic wave resonator of the present application includes a first support substrate, a reflective layer, a piezoelectric film, and an electrode, which are stacked in this order. The reflecting layer is formed by carrying out ion implantation modification on the base material body and at least comprises a low sound velocity reflecting layer and a high sound velocity reflecting layer which are stacked along the thickness direction of the first supporting substrate. The reflecting layer can reflect the energy of high sound velocity sound wave layer by layer, the sound wave energy of high sound velocity is restrained inside the piezoelectric layer and the reflecting layer, and the loss caused by the leakage of the energy of the high sound velocity sound wave to the first supporting substrate is prevented. The high-frequency and large-bandwidth acoustic resonator is prepared by effectively exciting the acoustic modes with high sound velocity and large electromechanical coupling coefficients.

title_en: Signal conditioning circuit, conditioning method, integrated circuit chip and digital microphone
abstract_en: The invention discloses a signal conditioning circuit, a conditioning method, an integrated circuit chip and a digital microphone, wherein the signal conditioning circuit comprises: the follower module is configured to receive a first analog quantity input at one side of the sensor, operate the first analog quantity according to a feedback coefficient and output an obtained second analog quantity; the proportional amplifying module is connected with the follower module and is configured to operate the second analog quantity according to a proportional coefficient and output an obtained third analog quantity; the analog-to-digital converter is connected with the proportional amplifying module and is configured to convert the third analog quantity and output the obtained first digital quantity; and the digital control unit is connected with the analog-to-digital converter and is configured to determine an analog compensation amount according to the first digital amount and adjust the feedback coefficient and/or the proportionality coefficient according to the analog compensation amount. The signal conditioning circuit provided by the invention can accelerate the stabilizing speed, avoid instant jitter and improve the precision of the conditioned signal.

title_en: Program controlled attenuator
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication calibration measurement and automatic test, and discloses a program-controlled attenuator, wherein the power input end of the program-controlled attenuator is connected with a working power supply, the voltage of the working power supply is converted into an attenuation working voltage within a preset range by a voltage conversion circuit, a switch driving circuit is connected with a driving signal, and a first attenuation passage or a second attenuation passage is conducted by an attenuation gating circuit according to the driving signal when the attenuation gating circuit is connected with the attenuation working voltage.

title_en: High-speed signal transmission circuit and control method based on same
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a high-speed signal transmission circuit and a control method based on the high-speed signal transmission circuit, and relates to the field of printed circuits, wherein the high-speed signal transmission circuit comprises a sensing value compensation module, a capacitive adjustment module and a layer-changing through hole module; when the high-speed signal output by the layer-changing through hole module is received, the capacitive adjustment module is used for carrying out negative bias treatment on the working frequency of the high-speed signal, so that the high-speed signal is respectively subjected to frequency raising and frequency lowering through the inductance value compensation module and the capacitive adjustment module, and the electromagnetic interference shielding effect of frequency division of the high-speed signal is achieved through secondary fine adjustment of the working frequency of the high-speed signal; the extra design cost of the whole machine for the EMI is reduced, and the reliability of the product is improved.

title_en: Proximity switch circuit
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of sensors, and discloses a proximity switch circuit, which comprises a power supply conversion module, a detection module and a relay output module, wherein the power supply conversion module is used for reducing the power supply voltage so as to supply power for the detection module and the relay output module; the detection module is used for detecting a target object and outputting a control signal according to a detection result; and the relay output module is used for controlling the power on or off of the relay coil according to the control signal so as to control a load connected with the relay. According to the proximity switch circuit, the load is controlled by connecting the relay output circuit with the load, the current can reach several amperes to more than ten amperes, and the problem that the output circuit of the proximity switch sensor cannot pass through large current is solved. And the coil part and the output metal contact of the relay are isolated from each other, so that the circuit is not burnt out by surge current. In addition, the relay output has no limitation on the current direction, so the proximity switch circuit of the application has no requirement on the connection position of the load.

title_en: Multi-diaphragm thickness wafer using layer transfer, acoustic resonator and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: There is provided an acoustic resonator comprising: a substrate; a first piezoelectric layer having a first surface and a second surface opposite each other, wherein the second surface is coupled to the substrate directly or via one or more intermediate layers; a second piezoelectric layer having opposing first and second surfaces, wherein the first surface is coupled to the first surface of the first piezoelectric layer and opposite the substrate; an etch stop layer disposed between the first surfaces of the first piezoelectric layer and the second piezoelectric layer, respectively; and a first interdigital transducer (IDT) and a second IDT on at least one of the first piezoelectric layer and the second piezoelectric layer, respectively. In addition, a portion of one of the first piezoelectric layer and the second piezoelectric layer is removed between the second surface of the respective piezoelectric layer and the etch stop layer.

title_en: Filter device and multiplexer
abstract_en: The invention provides a filter device capable of suppressing attenuation deterioration near a resonance frequency in a structure in which the resonance frequency of a part of series arm resonators is located outside a pass band. A filter device (1) is provided with a plurality of series-arm resonators and at least one parallel-arm resonator, the plurality of series-arm resonators are provided with at least one 1 st series-arm resonator (S1) and at least one 2 nd series-arm resonator (S2) other than the at least one 1 st series-arm resonator (S1), the resonance frequency of the 1 st series-arm resonator (S1) is positioned on the high-frequency side than the passband of the filter device (1), the 2 nd series-arm resonator (S2) is provided with a series connection structure in which at least two series-arm resonators (S2-1 to S2-3) are connected in series, the anti-resonance frequencies of the at least two series-arm resonators (S2-1 to S2-3) are different, and the resonance frequency of the 1 st series-arm resonator (S1) is positioned between the anti-resonance frequency of the series-arm resonator on the lowest frequency side and the anti-resonance frequency of the series-arm resonator on the highest frequency side among the 2 nd series-arm resonators (S2).

title_en: Parameter design method for high-power high-voltage pulse power supply circuit topology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a parameter design method of a high-power high-voltage pulse power supply circuit topology, and provides a parameter design method of a high-power high-voltage pulse power supply circuit topology meeting the requirements of average output power and maximum repetition frequency. Wherein, high-power high-voltage pulse power supply circuit topology includes: rectifying network, resonant cavity, pulse forming network. Aiming at the application occasion of lighting the xenon lamp of the solid laser, the invention adopts a constant-current charging mode on the basis of adjustable charging voltage, and the energy storage capacitor of the pulse power supply can be charged rapidly so as to meet the requirement of high repetition frequency.

title_en: Overload and short-circuit protection circuit for MOS tube load circuit
abstract_en: The MOS tube load circuit overload and short-circuit protection circuit comprises an MOS tube Q3, an MOS tube driving circuit, a current-limiting protection circuit and a short-circuit protection circuit, wherein when the load current exceeds a rated current limit I  e , the current-limiting protection circuit stabilizes the current flowing through the MOS tube Q3 at I  e  by controlling the switching frequency of the MOS tube Q3; when the load circuit is short-circuited, the MOS tube Q3 is utilized to be closed, so that overheat phenomenon caused by frequent opening and closing of the MOS tube Q3 is avoided. The overload and short-circuit protection circuit for the MOS tube load circuit realizes the protection of the MOS tube Q3 when the load circuit is short-circuited or over-current, when the load circuit is short-circuited, the short-circuit protection circuit controls the MOS tube Q3 to be closed through the MOS tube driving circuit, and when the short-circuit phenomenon disappears, the MOS tube Q3 is automatically opened, so that the overheat phenomenon of the MOS tube Q3 caused by frequent opening and closing of the load short-circuit is avoided.

title_en: Tuning switch circuit and radio frequency chip
abstract_en: The invention provides a tuning switch circuit and a radio frequency chip, wherein the tuning switch circuit comprises a switch bias unit, a tuning switch unit and a tuning device unit which are connected in sequence; the switch bias unit comprises a negative pressure generating module, a first positive pressure generating module, a second positive pressure generating module, a voltage driving module and a logic control module; the tuning switch unit comprises a multi-stage stacked field effect transistor circuit formed by sequentially connecting the multi-stage stacked field effect transistor circuit in series, wherein each stage of stacked field effect transistor circuit comprises a field effect transistor and a first resistor. The tuning switch circuit can reduce the on-resistance of the tuning switch circuit without increasing the area of the field effect transistor.

title_en: Signal detection circuit, detection method, signal processing circuit and electronic device
abstract_en: The application discloses a signal detection circuit, a detection method, a signal processing circuit and electronic equipment, wherein the signal detection circuit comprises: the proportional amplifying circuit is coupled with the circuit to be detected so as to receive the signal to be detected sent by the circuit to be detected; the hysteresis circuit is coupled with the proportional amplifying circuit; the hysteresis circuit is used for receiving the signal to be detected sent by the proportional amplifying circuit, comparing the signal to be detected with a preset reference voltage, determining the amplifying proportion of the signal to be detected, and sending a control signal corresponding to the amplifying proportion to the proportional amplifying circuit; the proportional amplifying circuit is used for receiving the control signal and carrying out proportional amplification on the signal to be detected based on the amplification proportion; wherein the number of the amplification ratios is at least two. By the mode, the signal detection circuit can effectively ensure the detection precision of weak signals while not reducing the signal detection range.

title_en: Double-grid cascode drive
abstract_en: A cascode circuit is formed using a high voltage transistor in series with a low voltage transistor. The clamp switching device is used to discharge the gate of the high voltage transistor when the cascode is turned off. A rate limiting device may be used to control the on and off characteristics of the cascode. The rate limiting device may include resistors and/or transistors. The high voltage transistor may be, for example, a normally on silicon carbide JFET, and the low voltage transistor may be a silicon MOSFET.

title_en: Broadband operational amplifier using double gate amplification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a broadband operational amplifier utilizing dual gate amplification. The invention comprises a first stage of common source amplification and a second stage of double gate amplification, and specifically comprises seven NMOS (N-channel metal oxide semiconductor) tubes, seven PMOS (P-channel metal oxide semiconductor) tubes, four resistors and four capacitors. According to the invention, the NMOS and PMOS amplifying tubes of the second stage are driven simultaneously by the normal phase signal and the reverse phase signal output by the first stage, so that the transconductance of the second stage of the operational amplifier is improved, and the gain of the operational amplifier is improved. In addition, the current of the active load of the second stage also follows the change of the output signal of the first stage, thereby accelerating the change of the current of the second stage and improving the conversion rate of the output signal. In addition, the NMOS tube and the PMOS tube of the double-gate amplification are connected in series, and one path of current is multiplexed, so that the consumption of the current is reduced.

title_en: Dual RCC pivot piezoelectric resonator, in particular for a timepiece rotating electric machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a piezoelectric resonator (1), in particular for a rotating piezoelectric motor, the resonator (1) comprising a fixed base (3) and an oscillating mass (2) extending along a longitudinal axis, provided with at least one inertial mass (4), preferably two inertial masses (4) arranged in opposite positions, comprising a flexible guide connecting the oscillating mass (2) to the base (3) so as to enable the oscillating mass (2) to oscillate in a balance wheel motion about a rotation center, the flexible guide comprising a first RCC-type pivot provided with an intermediate movable element and a first pair of flexible strips connecting the base to the intermediate movable element, and a second RCC-type pivot formed by a second pair of flexible strips connecting the intermediate movable element to the oscillating mass, the piezoelectric resonator (1) comprising a first flexible strip (6) at least partially containing piezoelectric material connecting the intermediate movable element to the base (3), the material being able to be deformed by the first flexible strip and to cause the oscillating mass (2) to oscillate by the first flexible actuation.

title_en: Small-area low-power-consumption multifunctional discriminating and counting circuit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a small-area low-power-consumption multifunctional screening and counting circuit, and belongs to the technical field of circuits. The pulse shaping amplifier outputs a first signal after modulation processing, the voltage peak value of the first signal is kept by the peak value keeping circuit, and then the voltage peak value is compared with a threshold voltage value provided by the DAC through the comparator. The square wave signal output by the comparator becomes a control signal of the control logic module and controls the input code word of the DAC to change, so that the voltage signal output by the DAC is changed. And determining an energy interval in which the peak value of the output signal of the pulse shaping amplifier is positioned by a successive approximation method, and counting the counters connected after the interval, wherein the rest counters are kept unchanged. The circuit structure provided by the invention effectively reduces the area and the power consumption of the circuit.

title_en: Multistage amplitude-phase circuit amplitude modulation-phase modulation optimization method, device, medium and equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a multistage amplitude-phase circuit amplitude modulation-phase modulation optimization method, which comprises the following steps: sequentially performing a first calibration process from the nth stage attenuator to the 1 st stage attenuator and a second calibration process from the mth stage phase shifter to the 1 st stage phase shifter; the first calibration procedure includes: determining a first actual state value of each stage of attenuator, and calibrating the first actual state value through an attenuation state association coefficient corresponding to an nth stage of attenuator to obtain a first calibration state value; the second calibration procedure includes: and determining a second actual state value of each stage of phase shifter, and calibrating the second actual state value through a phase shift state association coefficient corresponding to the mth stage of phase shifter to obtain a second calibration state value. The application realizes the precise optimization and closed-loop control of state values among different levels, and simultaneously realizes the linkage of attenuation and phase through the association coefficient, optimizes the amplitude-phase screening mode, and solves the series of problems of lower precision, lack of correlation consideration and the like in the traditional method.

title_en: Multi-order filter based on through silicon via structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of three-dimensional structure filters, in particular to a multi-order filter based on a through silicon via structure and a preparation method thereof, wherein the filter combines a TSV technology to construct a three-dimensional capacitor and a three-dimensional inductor, and the filter effectively reduces the occupied area on a plane by utilizing the space in the vertical direction; meanwhile, the three-dimensional capacitor and the three-dimensional inductor structure can be adjusted in structure and quantity according to design requirements, so that a filter structure meeting the design requirements is formed.

title_en: Structure for inhibiting stray response of SAW device
abstract_en: The application provides a structure for inhibiting stray response of a SAW device, which comprises a first piezoelectric substrate layer, a second piezoelectric substrate layer and an IDT layer, wherein the second piezoelectric substrate layer is arranged on the first piezoelectric substrate layer, the IDT layer is arranged on the second piezoelectric substrate layer, and the IDT layer consists of a first electrode and a second electrode. The structure provided by the application can be used for adjusting Euler angles of the second piezoelectric substrate layers, comparing admittance frequency responses under different thicknesses of the second piezoelectric substrate layers, selecting proper thickness of the second piezoelectric substrate layers, and keeping the electromechanical coupling coefficient of the SAW device unchanged while realizing good inhibition of the spurious response of the SAW device.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and storage medium for testing reliability of analog-to-digital conversion chip
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a system, an electronic device and a computer readable storage medium for testing the reliability of an analog-to-digital conversion chip. The method comprises the following steps: the environmental parameters of the test space are regulated through the reliability test device, and N different test environments are provided for the analog-digital conversion chip; in each test environment, analog quantity is sent to an analog-to-digital conversion chip through a signal generator; reading a digital signal stream output by an analog-to-digital conversion chip aiming at analog quantity; analyzing key parameters of the analog-to-digital conversion chip according to the digital signal stream; and analyzing according to the key parameters of the analog-to-digital conversion chip under the N test environments to obtain a reliability test result of the analog-to-digital conversion chip. By adopting the method, various running environments of the analog-to-digital conversion chip can be simulated, the reliability of the analog-to-digital conversion chip in various testing environments can be tested, and the testing efficiency of the analog-to-digital conversion chip is improved. The potential risk of the analog-to-digital conversion chip can be identified, and data support is provided for improving the reliability of the analog-to-digital conversion chip.

title_en: Single crystal AlN film bulk acoustic wave duplexer and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a single crystal AlN film bulk acoustic wave duplexer and a preparation method thereof, wherein the bulk acoustic wave duplexer comprises a receiving filter and a transmitting filter, and the receiving filter comprises a first substrate, a first resonator unit, a dielectric layer and a first bonding structure; the emission filter comprises a second substrate, a second resonator unit and a second bonding structure, wherein the first bonding structure and the second bonding structure are bonded with each other, and a second top electrode layer of the second resonator unit is bonded with a first top electrode layer or a dielectric layer of the first resonator unit. The application connects the receiving filter and the transmitting filter together in a flip-chip bonding mode, has compact structure and does not need to partition different filters, and simultaneously, the flip-chip bonding mode also enables the first piezoelectric layer and the second piezoelectric layer to adopt monocrystalline AlN films as piezoelectric materials, thereby improving the performances of isolation, insertion loss and the like of the film bulk acoustic wave duplexer. The present application relates to the field of semiconductor manufacturing.

title_en: Virtual capacitor series tuning device suitable for low-frequency electromagnetic emission system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of low-frequency electromagnetic emission, and discloses a virtual capacitor series tuning device suitable for a low-frequency electromagnetic emission system, which aims to solve the problems that a high-voltage capacitor in the series tuning device is huge in consumption and inflexible in adapting to a working frequency point. The device comprises a plurality of serially connected virtual capacitor serial tuning modules, wherein each virtual capacitor serial tuning module comprises a short-circuit switch, an access switch, a single-phase coupling transformer, a single-phase full bridge and a supporting capacitor; the support capacitor is connected with the direct current side of the single-phase full bridge, the alternating current side of the single-phase full bridge is connected with the secondary side of the single-phase coupling transformer, the primary side of the single-phase coupling transformer is connected in series with the low-frequency electromagnetic emission system through the access switch, the serial tuning module is connected with the position of the low-frequency electromagnetic emission system in parallel with the short-circuit switch, and the access switch and the short-circuit switch are used for controlling the virtual capacitor serial tuning module to be connected with and cut out of the low-frequency electromagnetic emission system in a matched mode. The device can flexibly adapt to the working frequency point and the resonance state of the low-frequency electromagnetic emission system.

title_en: Pre-amplifying device capable of being automatically started and stopped
