abstract_en: The invention relates to a pre-amplifying device capable of being started and stopped automatically, which comprises a shell structure, a connecting wire harness and a connector, wherein the shell structure comprises a plurality of pre-amplifying single boards and 1 motherboard, and each pre-amplifying single board comprises an input protection circuit, an amplifying circuit and an output protection circuit; the motherboard comprises a motherboard circuit, a power supply circuit and a signal relay; a plurality of preamplified single plates are arranged on a motherboard, and the motherboard is fixed in the shell structure; the shell structure is connected with the connector through a connecting wire harness, and the connector is used for being connected with a product interface; the power supply circuit is used for controlling the on-off of the power supply, and the signal relay automatically judges according to whether the power supply is input or not. The invention can realize the automatic start and stop of the pre-amplifying device, and each product only needs one hoisting process for finishing the in-water test, thereby saving one product hoisting process, greatly saving time, improving the testing efficiency, saving labor and reducing labor intensity.

title_en: Triangle wave generator irrelevant to VDD
abstract_en: The application discloses a triangle wave generator irrelevant to VDD, which comprises a voltage-current conversion circuit, a charge pump circuit and a digital feedback circuit, wherein the voltage-current conversion circuit comprises a PNP triode Q1 and an NPN triode Q2, the base electrode of the PNP triode Q1 is connected with 1/4 power supply voltage VDD, the collector electrode is grounded, the emitter electrode is connected with one end of a resistor R5, and the common end of an emitter stage and the resistor R5 is connected with the base electrode of the NPN triode Q2; the emitter of the NPN triode Q2 is grounded through a resistor R4, the collector is connected with one side of the first current mirror, the other side of the first current mirror is connected with the first side of the second current mirror circuit, the second side of the second current mirror circuit is connected with the first side of the third current mirror circuit, the second side of the third current mirror circuit is connected with the third side of the second current mirror circuit, and the triangular wave generator designed by the circuit is high in precision and is not influenced by power supply voltage.

title_en: Analog-to-digital conversion device, method, equipment and medium based on Dummy comparator
abstract_en: The application relates to an analog-to-digital conversion device, method, equipment and medium based on a Dummy comparator, wherein the device comprises the following components: an auxiliary converter for providing a target input voltage; the Dummy comparator is used for comparing and analyzing the target input voltage to obtain a target level probability value corresponding to the target input voltage; and the controller is used for carrying out analog-to-digital conversion on the initial analog signal to obtain an initial conversion result and a conversion residual error corresponding to the initial analog signal, and correcting the initial conversion result according to a pre-constructed voltage-probability lookup table and the conversion residual error to generate a final conversion result. Therefore, the problems that in the prior art, the noise distribution of the comparator changes along with the environment, the accurate noise distribution of the comparator is difficult to obtain, the deviation of residual estimation is large, the improvement of the ADC signal to noise ratio is greatly limited and the like are solved.

title_en: Three-level inverter modulation method, electronic device, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-level inverter modulation method, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the three-level inverter comprises a positive bus capacitor and a negative bus capacitor, and the method comprises the following steps: collecting first voltages at two ends of a positive bus capacitor and second voltages at two ends of a negative bus capacitor, and calculating a voltage difference value between the first voltages and the second voltages; determining a zero sequence modulation algorithm to be executed according to the magnitude relation between the voltage difference value and a preset differential pressure threshold value; and modulating the three-phase initial modulation wave according to a zero sequence modulation algorithm to obtain a three-phase intermediate modulation wave. Compared with the related art, the invention can better adapt to the requirements of the application scene of neutral point potential balance when carrying out the voltage balance of the positive bus and the negative bus, improves the voltage utilization rate, reduces the inverter loss and further improves the safe operation coefficient of the inverter.

title_en: Push-pull power amplifier
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a push-pull power amplifier, which comprises: the circuit comprises a first matching circuit, an amplifying circuit, a biasing circuit, a feedback circuit and a second matching circuit; the input signal of the push-pull power amplifier is input by the first matching circuit, and the output signal is output by the second matching circuit; the first matching circuit is used for carrying out input impedance matching processing on the input signal and outputting a first signal; the amplifying circuit is used for amplifying the first signal and outputting a second signal to the feedback circuit and the second matching circuit; the feedback circuit is used for generating a first bias voltage according to the second signal and outputting the first bias voltage to the first matching circuit in a feedback way; the bias circuit is used for generating a second bias voltage and outputting the second bias voltage to the first matching circuit; the second matching circuit is used for performing output impedance matching processing on the second signal and generating an output signal. The invention improves the reliability of the push-pull power amplifier and realizes the control of the power consumption and the output power of the push-pull power amplifier.

title_en: Multi-source remote sensing data global digital tree model simulation data compression storage method
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-source remote sensing data global digital tree model simulation data compression storage method, which belongs to the technical field of remote sensing data processing and comprises the following steps of S1: global scope slicing, which slices global scope using a particular grade; s2: the tree simulation multi-source remote sensing data generation method; s3: the multi-source remote sensing data preprocessing method unifies the format, the coordinate system, the range and the resolution of the multi-source remote sensing data; s4: the high-performance tree programming generation method is used for extracting the position information and attribute information of the global tree and storing the position information and attribute information as vector point data; the invention uses a processing scheme of blocking and multithreading to extremely fast improve the processing speed of data; generating a global tree simulation model for restoring the real geographic distribution, the height and the category; the improved vector tile technique achieves efficient map data storage, transmission and rendering while also providing a richer, more flexible map browsing experience for the user.

title_en: Level transfer circuit suitable for switching power supply
abstract_en: A level transfer circuit suitable for a switching power supply relates to the technical field of integrated circuits, and has the main structure that: the gate of the eleventh NMOS tube is connected with the input pin of the low voltage domain, the input end of the fourth inverter, the source is connected with the low level of the low voltage domain, the drain is connected with the drain end of the twelfth NMOS tube and the source end of the fourteenth NMOS tube; the twelfth NMOS tube and the thirteenth NMOS tube form a current mirror, the gate of the fourteenth NMOS tube is connected with the output end of the fourth inverter, the drain is connected with the drain and the gate of the fifteenth PMOS tube, and the thirteenth NMOS tube is also connected with a high-voltage domain power supply through a second resistor and a first resistor; the source end of the fifteenth PMOS tube is connected with the low level of the high-voltage domain; a first node is formed between the second resistor and the first resistor, and the first node is connected with an output pin through a fifth inverter and a sixth inverter. The invention can solve the problem that the traditional level shifting circuit consumes layout area, and avoid leakage current caused by incapability of completely closing the down tube of the inverter.

title_en: A/D converter
abstract_en: The A/D converter (1) is provided with a first integrator (2) and a quantizer (3), and further is provided with a signal input chopper switch (10), a first integrating capacitor chopper input switch (6), output side chopper switches (8) and (15) arranged on the output side of the first operational amplifier (4), and a feedback chopper switch arranged in a feedback path from the output of the quantizer (3) to the input of the first integrator (2). Chopper switches (6, 8, 10, 15) and feedback chopper switches perform chopping operations at the same frequency Fchsys. The output side chopper switches (8) and (15) are arranged so that the polarity of the input value of the quantizer (3) matches before and after the chopping operation.

title_en: Photovoltaic power fluctuation smoothing method based on self-adaptive revolving door algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a photovoltaic power fluctuation smoothing method based on a self-adaptive revolving door algorithm, which belongs to the technical field of power systems and comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining actual photovoltaic power, compressing the actual photovoltaic power by using an initialization gate width through a revolving gate algorithm, calculating a compression error and a compression rate, and adjusting the gate width of the revolving gate algorithm based on the compression error and the compression rate to obtain an optimal gate width; compressing actual photovoltaic power by using an optimal gate width through a revolving gate algorithm, extracting and processing photovoltaic power characteristic data points, and obtaining a photovoltaic characteristic curve; the method comprises the steps of obtaining photovoltaic grid-connected instruction power, distributing power deviation between a photovoltaic characteristic curve and photovoltaic actual power to a super capacitor to make up, and distributing power deviation between the photovoltaic grid-connected instruction power and the photovoltaic characteristic curve to a battery energy storage system to make up. The invention effectively reduces the fluctuation of the photovoltaic grid-connected power, reduces the action times of the BESS and prolongs the service life of the BESS.

title_en: Passive equalizer
abstract_en: One example discloses a passive equalizer circuit, the passive equalizer circuit comprising: an input configured to receive an input signal having an input frequency band; a transfer function circuit configured to transform the input frequency band into an output frequency band; and an output configured to be coupled to an active equalizer circuit and to carry an output signal having the output frequency band; wherein the transfer function circuit comprises a variable impedance configured to adjust a mid-band frequency gain of the output signal.

title_en: Driving circuit, isolation device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a driving circuit, an isolating device and electronic equipment, which have simple structures. The voltage regulation module comprises N groups of boosting groups, an integration unit and a driving signal output end, wherein each group of boosting groups comprises a storage unit and a unidirectional transmission unit; the first end of the unidirectional transmission unit of the even number boost group, the second end of the unidirectional transmission unit of the previous boost group and the first end of the storage unit are coupled to the first node; the first end of the unidirectional transmission unit of the odd boost group, the second end of the unidirectional transmission unit of the previous boost group and the first end of the storage unit are coupled to the second node; the first ends of the unidirectional transmission units of the first group of boosting groups receive power signals, and the second ends of the storage units of the odd and even boosting groups respectively receive first and second pulse width modulation signals with the same frequency and opposite phases; the second end of the unidirectional transmission unit of the N group of boosting groups and the first end of the storage unit are coupled to the third node; an integrating unit is arranged between the third node and the driving signal output end.

title_en: Delay pulse signal generating circuit
abstract_en: The delay pulse signal generating circuit provided by the embodiment of the disclosure comprises: the first logic module outputs a high level from the second node when the input node is changed from a low level to a high level, outputs a low level from the third node when the input node is changed from the high level to the low level, and outputs a low level from the second node and outputs a high level from the third node; the delay module is used for charging the capacitor when the second node and the third node are both in a low level, changing the first node from a high level to a low level when the voltage of the capacitor is larger than the lower turnover threshold voltage, discharging the capacitor when one node in the second node or the third node is in the high level, and changing the first node from the low level to the high level when the voltage of the first end of the capacitor is smaller than or equal to the upper turnover threshold voltage; and the second logic module is used for changing the output node from the low level to the high level if the second node is in the high level when the first node is in the low level and changing the output node from the high level to the low level if the second node is in the low level.

title_en: Comparator circuit
abstract_en: The present application provides a comparator circuit comprising: a first pre-amplification stage that amplifies the input signal in the comparison state to generate a first output signal; a second pre-amplification stage that performs switching between a reset state and a comparison state according to the first output signal, amplifies the first output signal in the comparison state to generate a second output signal, and provides positive feedback to the second output signal through the first positive feedback structure; and the latch stage resets the output end of the latch stage to a second preset level according to the clock signal in the reset state, and controls the second positive feedback structure and the third positive feedback structure to be opened through the second output signal and the clock signal in the comparison state so as to provide positive feedback for the output end. The application reduces the number of transistors connected with the clock signal, further suppresses the jitter of the clock signal and can effectively improve the precision of the comparator.

title_en: Voltage generating circuit, generating method and analog-to-digital converter using same
abstract_en: The invention provides a voltage generating circuit, a generating method and an analog-to-digital converter using the same, wherein a capacitor array connected to two ends of a comparator or an amplifier is respectively split into two capacitor arrays with equal capacitance values, first ends of the two capacitor arrays are connected through a switch, and the first ends of the two capacitor arrays are also respectively connected with a positive end of an input signal and a negative end of the input signal through the switch; in the sampling phase, the voltage on the first end of the first to fourth capacitor arrays can be the common mode voltage of the input signal by controlling the switching state of the corresponding switch; the input common-mode voltage of the comparator or the amplifier is irrelevant to the input signal, so that the design difficulty of the comparator or the amplifier can be reduced, and the abnormal function of the comparator or the amplifier can be avoided; compared with the prior art, the method can avoid occupation of a larger area and increase of power consumption, and is suitable for application with longer sampling time.

title_en: Optimization method and device for DTS data
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the field of distributed fiber optic geophysical data processing, and provides a method and a device for optimizing DTS data. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring original DTS data acquired by a plurality of sampling points of a distributed optical fiber; performing spatial domain denoising and time domain denoising on the original DTS data to obtain denoised DTS data; calculating a temperature correction amount according to the denoised DTS data and the standard temperature of the standard sampling point; the raw DTS data is optimized based on the temperature correction amount. The embodiment of the disclosure can greatly improve the accuracy of DTS data.

title_en: Method for eliminating direct current offset between electrodes of electroencephalogram acquisition equipment by digital-analog mixed DSL technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for eliminating direct current offset between electrodes of an electroencephalogram acquisition device by using a digital-analog mixed DSL technology, which relates to electroencephalogram signal processing and comprises the steps of transmitting an electroencephalogram acquisition input signal to a signal amplification module for amplification processing to obtain a first amplified electroencephalogram signal, processing the first amplified electroencephalogram signal through an analog direct current servo loop module to obtain a second analog direct current component, transmitting the electroencephalogram acquisition input signal to a digital direct current servo loop module to obtain a first digital direct current component, converting the first digital direct current component and the second analog direct current component into alternating current through a capacitor and a chopper modulation module to be offset with alternating current at an input end, transmitting the first amplified electroencephalogram signal to a programmable gain amplification module for secondary amplification processing to obtain a second amplified electroencephalogram signal, inputting the second amplified electroencephalogram signal to an anti-aliasing filter, converting the analog signal to a digital processing module for processing. The invention shortens the time for counteracting EDO at the input end, and the sampling rate of the analog-to-digital converter in the digital servo loop is very low, so that the power consumption of the digital servo loop is very small, and the problems that the high EDO inhibition range and the low input reference noise are difficult to realize, and the time constant of an integrator in the traditional analog direct current servo loop is too large and the EDO counteracting time is too long are effectively solved.

title_en: Optimal filtering curve generation method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for generating an optimal filtering curve, which are characterized in that firstly, linear interpolation is carried out on an x value of an original data curve to obtain an equidistant x value and a corresponding y value, the y value is subjected to equidistant interpolation by utilizing cubicspline _interp_on_y function to obtain interpolated curve data, the interpolated curve data are input into a Gaussian filter provided with sigma parameters to obtain a generating curve, the sigma parameters are gradually increased under the condition that the number of wave peaks of the generating curve is larger than a preset threshold value, and the optimal filtering curve is obtained until the number of wave peaks of the generating curve is not larger than the preset threshold value. One or more accurate x values corresponding to each equidistant y value can be found through cubicspline _interpolation_on_y function optimization interpolation process, the quality and reliability of interpolation data are improved on the basis of keeping linear characteristics of the curve, sigma parameters are adjusted until an optimal filtering curve is found, noise is effectively reduced, and key characteristics of the data are maintained.

title_en: Feed channel, feed channel group and GNSS active power divider
abstract_en: The invention discloses a feed channel, a feed channel group and a GNSS active power divider, and relates to the technical antenna field. The invention comprises using a feed channel group to feed the GNSS receiver to the amplifier of the low noise amplifier circuit, and the antenna signal is transmitted to the low noise amplifier circuit through the blocking capacitor, and the signal is amplified and distributed to the receiver; the antenna signal is fed to an antenna current detection circuit through a bias inductor or a magnetic bead, and when the antenna current detection circuit detects that the current is lower than a certain threshold value, the constant current source and the low noise amplifying circuit are powered off; the wide-range input voltage conversion circuit converts 3V-28V voltage into fixed 2.9V voltage and is used for supplying power to the low-noise amplifier circuit through the power electronic switch; the power electronic switch receives a control signal from the antenna detection circuit, and cuts off the power supply of the low-noise amplifier when the antenna is powered down. The situation that all equipment is paralyzed and cannot work due to the failure of certain equipment is avoided, and the robustness of the system can be effectively improved by the elastic error correction capability of avoiding service interruption.

title_en: Infrared signal gain adjustment method and infrared signal gain adjustment circuit
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an infrared signal gain adjusting method and an infrared signal gain adjusting circuit, wherein a gain adjusting signal output module is controlled to output gain adjusting signals respectively corresponding to each infrared receiver in a first part of infrared receivers in a first time period, and the gain adjusting signals are kept and output through a first signal keeping module; the gain adjustment signal output module is controlled to directly output gain adjustment signals corresponding to each infrared receiver in the second part of infrared receivers in the second time period, so that the received signals of each infrared receiver are subjected to gain adjustment by adopting the gain adjustment signals corresponding to each infrared receiver, the signal intensity value of the received signals of each infrared receiver after the gain adjustment is in the target signal intensity range, the signal intensity difference between each received signal after the gain adjustment is reduced, and the touch recognition precision is improved.

title_en: Broadband amplifier based on slot line coupling balun
abstract_en: The invention discloses a broadband amplifier based on a slot line coupling balun, relates to radar and communication technologies, and aims at solving the problems of insufficient bandwidth and the like in the prior art. The system comprises an input side coupling balun, an amplifying module, an output side coupling balun and an LC matching network which are sequentially connected through signals; the input side coupling balun inputs differential radio frequency signals and differential source control signals to the amplifying module through the slot line coupling structure; the amplifying module amplifies the differential radio frequency signal based on the differential source control signal and outputs the differential radio frequency signal in two paths; the output side coupling balun outputs two paths of differential radio frequency signals amplified by the amplifying module through the slot line coupling structure through an LC matching network; the LC matching network is used to match the output impedance of the output side coupled balun. The three-coupling transformer has the advantages of providing broadband input matching and solving the problems of extra loss and the like caused by larger phase amplitude error when the input signal is subjected to single-ended slip in the prior three-coupling transformer.

title_en: Low-noise polarization independent semiconductor optical amplifier and signal transmission system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication, and provides a low-noise polarization-independent semiconductor optical amplifier and a signal transmission system. The amplifier comprises a polarization beam splitting component, a polarization adjusting component, an amplifying component and a light path adjusting component; the first polarization port, the optical path adjusting component and the second polarization port of the polarization beam splitting component are sequentially coupled to form a closed loop optical path; the amplifying assembly is arranged on the closed loop optical path, and the polarization adjusting assembly is arranged between the first polarization port and the amplifying assembly; the polarization beam splitting component outputs first polarized light and second polarized light with different polarization directions; the polarization adjusting component adjusts the first polarized light to have the same polarization direction as the second polarized light; the amplifying component amplifies the light with the same polarization direction to obtain a gain signal. According to the invention, the polarization beam splitting component and the polarization adjusting component are arranged, so that the polarization of each light passing through the amplifying component is the same, and therefore, low polarization correlation gain can be obtained, the saturated output power of a signal is increased, and the gain and noise index are not degraded.

title_en: High-side switch circuit
abstract_en: A high-side switching circuit, comprising: a target current generation unit adapted to generate and output a target current; the first comparison unit outputs a first comparison result of the output voltage of the high-side switch circuit and the first voltage; a control unit outputting a first control signal based on a first comparison result; when the temperature protection trigger signal is received, the power tube is controlled to be disconnected, and when the temperature protection trigger signal is not received, the power tube is controlled to be connected; controlling the current of the power tube when being conducted to be equal to the target current; the protection threshold generating unit is suitable for outputting a first temperature protection threshold or a second temperature protection threshold as a target temperature protection threshold based on the first control signal; and the temperature protection unit is suitable for responding to the fact that the real-time temperature of the power tube is larger than the target temperature protection threshold value and outputting a temperature protection trigger signal. By the scheme, the reliability of the high-side switch circuit in a capacitor charging scene can be improved, and meanwhile the steady-state load capacity of the high-side switch circuit is not affected.

title_en: Linear capacitance isolator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a linear capacitance isolator, which comprises a signal transmitting unit, a signal receiving unit and an isolation capacitor electrically connected between the signal transmitting unit and the signal receiving unit, wherein the signal transmitting unit comprises a first conversion circuit for converting an input signal into a frequency signal; the signal receiving unit includes a frequency demodulating circuit for demodulating the frequency signal, and a second converting circuit for converting the frequency signal into an output signal. The linear capacitance isolator can realize linear transmission of input signals and output signals, simplifies a circuit architecture and reduces circuit cost.

title_en: Pulse circuit, control method and vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to a pulse circuit, a control method and a vehicle, and relates to the technical field of battery charging and discharging. The pulse circuit comprises a pre-charging module, a first switch circuit, an energy connecting end and a capacitive energy storage device. The energy storage device comprises a pre-charging module, an energy connecting end and a capacitive energy storage device, wherein the pre-charging module, the energy connecting end and the capacitive energy storage device are connected with each other, a first end of a first switch circuit is positioned between the energy connecting end and the capacitive energy storage device, a second end of the first switch circuit is connected with the pre-charging module, and pulse current is generated through on-off of the first switch circuit and the pre-charging module. The capacitive energy storage device is precharged by controlling on-off between the precharge module and the capacitive energy storage device. The self-heating pulse current for the battery pack is generated by controlling the on-off of the pre-charging module and the first switching circuit. Therefore, the integration of the pre-charging function and the self-heating function of the battery pack is realized, and hardware facilities such as additional components and parts are not required to be arranged, so that the integration level of the pulse circuit is improved.

title_en: Photoelectric proximity switch
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides an optoelectronic proximity switch, relates to switch technical field, and optoelectronic proximity switch includes: a first photodiode for receiving an optical signal and converting the optical signal into a first electrical signal; a second photodiode for receiving the optical signal and converting it into a second electrical signal; the add-subtract arithmetic unit is connected with the first photodiode and the second photodiode and is used for carrying out arithmetic on the first electric signal and the second electric signal to obtain an arithmetic result; the comparator is connected with the addition and subtraction operator and is used for comparing the operation result with a preset threshold value to obtain a comparison result; and the processor is connected with the comparator and used for obtaining a switch trigger signal according to a comparison result, wherein the switch trigger signal is used for controlling the photoelectric proximity switch to be switched on or switched off.

title_en: Real-time original data compression transmission method of detector based on Internet of things technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time original data compression transmission method of a detector based on the internet of things technology, which comprises the steps of extracting compression grade classification model characteristics by analyzing historical detector data, analyzing the data by combining the real-time internet of things detector data and data compressed by the compression grade classification model, judging compression types, and reducing data transmission quantity; particularly, for different data characteristics of a night quiet period, a construction period and a non-construction period, a high compression model, a general compression model and a common compression model are respectively adopted, and a compression strategy is dynamically adjusted, so that a higher data compression rate is realized, and network traffic consumption and equipment power consumption are reduced; through the data analysis application of the Internet of things technology, the high efficiency and the integrity of data transmission are ensured, and the stability of a long-time and long-distance earthquake monitoring system is improved.

title_en: Self-adaptive nonlinear Kalman filtering method and system based on model feature constraint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive nonlinear Kalman filtering method and a system based on model feature constraint, which relate to the technical field of noise estimation and comprise the following steps: receiving a model parameter ratio and covariance, wherein the model parameter ratio is a Gaussian noise statistical feature constraint; inputting the model parameter ratio and covariance into a pre-established nonlinear system model, and solving and outputting by using a dayf algorithm according to a parameter estimation criterion to obtain an optimal solution of the nonlinear system model, wherein the pre-established nonlinear system model is based on UKF filtering.

title_en: Nonlinear filtering method based on self-attention and grid track piecewise linear approximation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nonlinear filtering method based on self-attention and grid track slicing linear approximation. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a nonlinear system and an initial state estimation value thereof, and carrying out state estimation through a Kalman filtering algorithm embedded into a self-attention mechanism network, wherein the training of the network comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of constructing a state track according to a nonlinear system and an initial state estimation value, approximating an original nonlinear model by utilizing a grid track slicing linear approximation method to obtain a grid slicing approximation model of the system, constructing a training data set according to the nonlinear system model and randomly generated noise, constructing a pre-training data set according to the grid slicing approximation model of the system and a batch estimation algorithm, carrying out batch pre-training on a simplified self-attention mechanism network according to the pre-training data set, then storing network weights, and embedding the network weights into a Kalman filtering frame to carry out end-to-end formal training by utilizing the training data set. The Kalman filtering embedded with the self-attention mechanism can obtain better filtering effect.

title_en: Gain self-adaptive adjustment analog-to-digital conversion chip and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an analog-to-digital conversion chip with gain self-adaptive adjustment and a control method thereof, which are used for solving the technical problems that the traditional method for realizing the input signal with a large dynamic range has overlarge scale of a data acquisition system, low feedback speed, incapability of effectively detecting direct current components in the signal and higher data acquisition cost. According to the gain self-adaptive adjusting analog-to-digital conversion chip, the threshold comparison module is integrated in the analog-to-digital conversion chip, the comparison result of the digital code signal input by the buffer and the preset threshold digital code signal is fed back to the adjustable gain amplifier through the comparator in the threshold comparison module, and the gain coefficient of the adjustable gain amplifier is adjusted according to the comparison result, so that the analog-to-digital conversion chip can work in two gain modes of a low gain section and a high gain section by adopting a single channel, the number of channels is saved, the signal acquisition range is increased, and the signal acquisition in a large dynamic range is realized.

title_en: PUF-multi-bit parallel exclusive OR operation integrated circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PUF-multi-bit parallel exclusive-OR operation integrated circuit, which comprises a preset module, an interweaving module, a cascading module and a control module, wherein the control module controls the working mode of the PUF-multi-bit parallel exclusive-OR operation integrated circuit so that the PUF-multi-bit parallel exclusive-OR operation integrated circuit can work in a PUF mode, a logic operation mode and a power control mode respectively, when the PUF-multi-bit parallel exclusive-OR operation integrated circuit works in the PUF mode, the PUF circuit function is realized, the PUF-multi-bit parallel exclusive-OR operation integrated circuit works in the logic operation mode, the exclusive-OR operation logic function is realized, and when the PUF-multi-bit parallel exclusive-OR operation integrated circuit works in the power control mode, the low-power consumption standby function is realized; the edge AI chip has the advantages that the edge AI chip can replace a separated PUF circuit and an exclusive OR operation circuit, the area of the edge AI chip is reduced, the hardware resource consumption of the edge AI chip is reduced, and the calculation efficiency of the edge AI chip is improved.

title_en: Power amplifier mismatch protection circuit and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a power amplifier mismatch protection circuit and electronic equipment, which comprises a power amplifier, a standing wave detection protection module, a power module and a current detection control module, wherein the radio frequency output end of the power amplifier is electrically connected with an antenna feeder line connection port through a radio frequency link, the input end of the standing wave detection protection module is electrically connected with the radio frequency link in a coupling way, the output end of the standing wave detection protection module is electrically connected with the gate end of the power amplifier, the power module is electrically connected with the input end of the current detection control module, the detection end of the current detection control module is electrically connected with the drain end of the power amplifier, and the output end of the current detection control module is electrically connected with the gate end of the power amplifier. The application solves the problem that the load pulls large current when the mismatch of the power amplifier cannot be effectively restrained.

title_en: Voltage comparator circuit for energy harvester
abstract_en: A voltage comparator circuit for a power supply having an energy harvester and an energy storage device. The circuit comprises: a first voltage input node and a second voltage input node for receiving a first voltage level of a first output of the energy harvester and a second voltage level of a second output of the energy storage device, respectively; an output node for switching in response to a comparison of the first and second voltage levels; and a plurality of semiconductor junction devices for providing a floating local ground for varying in response to a variation of the first and/or second voltage levels, wherein the floating local ground has a voltage level higher than an absolute ground, the absolute ground being connected to the voltage comparator circuit; wherein the floating local ground is for preventing breakdown of circuit components due to a voltage difference at a terminal connected to each of the circuit components exceeding a breakdown voltage of the respective circuit component.

title_en: Digital circuit and method for parallel phase accumulation of digitally controlled oscillators
abstract_en: The application relates to a digital control oscillator and discloses a digital circuit and a digital circuit method for parallel phase accumulation of the digital control oscillator. The method comprises the following steps: the first unit is used for generating M+1 continuous phases corresponding to the current clock period, wherein M is an integer greater than 1; the second unit is used for updating or resetting the basic phase corresponding to the next clock period and providing the basic phase corresponding to the current period for the first unit, the application can reduce the requirement on hardware resources, the hardware complexity is reduced, the capability of flexibly configuring the phase difference can be obviously improved, the scene adaptability is stronger, and the system power consumption and the system cost are obviously reduced.

title_en: Clock controller circuit on test design chip
abstract_en: The invention relates to a clock controller circuit on a test design chip. Comprising the following steps: a multiplexer having a first input for receiving a free clock signal; the first output end of the multiplexer is connected with the first input end of the multiplexer; a second input of the multiplexer is used for receiving the design for testability clock signal; the second output end of the multiplexer is connected with the second input end of the multiplexer; the input end of the phase-locked loop is connected with the first output end of the multiplexer; the first input end of the on-chip clock controller is connected with the output end of the phase-locked loop; the second input end of the on-chip clock controller is connected with the first output end of the multiplexer; the third input of the on-chip clock controller is connected to the second output of the multiplexer. The invention can avoid the problem of test pattern simulation failure caused by C39 violation or no pulse in the capturing stage.

title_en: Configurable multiplexer based on gain-boosting common-gate amplifier
abstract_en: The invention discloses a configurable multiplexer based on a gain-boosting common-gate amplifier, which is formed by sequentially connecting an input end, a first series inductor and sources of first series transistors in series; the drain electrode of the first serial transistor is connected with the first output end; the connection point of the source electrode of the first series transistor and the first series inductor is a first node; the source electrode of the second serial transistor is connected with the first node, and the drain electrode of the second serial transistor is connected with the second output end; the first series inductor and the first parallel inductor are mutually coupled to form a transformer; the connection point of the grid electrode of the first serial transistor and the first serial capacitor is a third node, one end of the first parallel resistor is connected with the third node, and the other end of the first parallel resistor is connected with a first control voltage; the connection node of the grid electrode of the second series capacitor and the second series transistor is a fourth node, one end of the second parallel resistor is connected with the fourth node, and the other end of the second parallel resistor is connected with the second control voltage. The feedback network based on the transformer improves the gain, and achieves more compact area and better performance.

title_en: Frequency synthesizer based on control word and implementation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a frequency synthesizer based on control words and an implementation method, wherein the module comprises an MCU circuit unit, a phase discriminator circuit unit, a signal processing circuit unit and a signal output circuit unit, wherein the MCU circuit unit stores a control word setting program, outputs control words through a serial port, receives control word information and a reference frequency signal fr from a low-phase noise PLL synthesis chip in the phase discriminator circuit unit, synthesizes the control word information and the reference frequency signal fr through an operational amplifier, and generates a frequency signal with a design frequency as a nominal value after locking; the MCU is used for controlling through software, the control word is directly output through the serial port, frequency signals with different frequency values can be output according to actual application scene requirements, the universality is strong, the production process is optimized, the production cost is reduced, the production quality is improved, and finally, the frequency displayed in the form of components is improved, and the device has the characteristics of small volume and light weight and can be welded on a PCB.

title_en: Surface acoustic wave wafer-level structure, manufacturing method thereof and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a surface acoustic wave wafer level structure, a manufacturing method thereof and electronic equipment, relating to the technical field of semiconductors, the surface acoustic wave wafer level structure is introduced with the packaging cover plate as a bonding part of the WLP, and a plurality of protruding columns are formed by processing the packaging cover plate, so that the purpose of bonding with the substrate is achieved. Based on the characteristics of the packaging cover plate and the dry film, compared with a supporting dam formed by the dry film, the strength of the protruding column of the packaging cover plate is stronger than that of the supporting dam, and in the process of layout, the protruding column only needs to exist around a chip and in a place with a bonding pad connection requirement. That is to say, the technical scheme has great improvement in the aspects of reliability, supportability and the like compared with the double-layer dry film packaging technology.

title_en: Signal generator
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a signal generator. The signal generator comprises a shell, a signal generation circuit and an attenuation circuit which are arranged in the shell, wherein a first signal output interface used for being connected with an external oscilloscope, a second signal output interface used for being connected with an external device to be tested, and a frequency adjusting knob and an amplitude adjusting knob which are connected with the signal generation circuit are arranged on the shell. The signal output end of the signal generating circuit is connected with the signal input end of the attenuation circuit, the signal output end of the attenuation circuit is connected with the second signal output interface, and the signal output end of the signal generating circuit is also connected with the first signal output interface. The attenuation circuit is used for attenuating the signal generated by the signal generating circuit into a signal of microvolts. The signal generator of the invention uses a precise attenuation circuit, and can realize low-noise and high-precision attenuation, thereby generating a uV-level signal.

title_en: High-frequency rectifying type electric stimulation circuit and stimulator based on integrated comparator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-frequency rectifying type electric stimulation circuit and a stimulation instrument based on an integrated comparator, wherein the stimulation circuit adopts a four-way integrated comparator as an operational amplifier, and is matched with a peripheral compensation capacitor and a pull-up resistor to realize constant current control and pulse control and output constant current bidirectional square waves, so that the use of additional operational amplifiers is avoided, the performance requirements are met, the production cost and the typesetting space of a circuit board are reduced, the primary side of an isolation transformer is stimulated by utilizing the high-frequency square waves, the excitation inductance of the primary side of the isolation transformer is reduced, and the volume of the isolation transformer is reduced.

title_en: Data acquisition and storage method based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a data acquisition and storage method based on data analysis, which comprises the following steps: acquiring oxygen content data at each moment; according to the variation amplitude of each oxygen content data and the corresponding reference point, combining the difference of each oxygen content data and the extreme point to obtain an abnormal fluctuation interval; uniformly selecting initial points, and acquiring all normal points according to the distances between a plurality of abnormal fluctuation intervals around each initial point and the initial points and the regularity of the fluctuation of the abnormal fluctuation intervals around each initial point; adjusting oxygen content data around the normal points to obtain an optimized sequence; and compressing the optimized sequence to realize the optimized collection and storage of the oxygen content data of the plant greenhouse. According to the method, the obtained optimized sequence increases the repeatability of the data on the basis of keeping the accuracy of the abnormal data, so that the compression quality of the compression result is higher.

title_en: Power amplifier circuit and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a power amplifier circuit and electronic equipment, relates to the field of radio frequency, and is used for reducing the insertion loss of a carrier branch when the carrier branch and a peak branch are coupled through a coupler. The power amplifier circuit includes: the power amplifier comprises a first power amplifier, a second power amplifier, a matching network, a second phase shifting network, a coupler and a matching load, wherein the input end of the first power amplifier is used for inputting radio frequency signals, the output end of the first power amplifier is electrically connected with the input end of the coupler, the direct end of the coupler and the first end of the matching network are electrically connected to a combining point, the second end of the matching network is used for outputting radio frequency signals subjected to power amplification, and the isolation end of the coupler is grounded through the matching load; the coupling end of the coupler is electrically connected with the combining point through a second phase shifting network and a second power amplifier; the second power amplifier is open while the first power amplifier is performing power backoff.

title_en: Multiplexer
abstract_en: A multiplexer capable of reducing the total number of reflectors and IDTs included in an additional circuit is provided. The multiplexer includes a first filter circuit, a second filter circuit, a third filter circuit, and additional circuits at least a part of which are connected in parallel with the first and third filter circuits, respectively. The additional circuit has more than three IDTs and two reflectors. A first IDT of the three or more IDTs is connected to a path connecting the first terminal and the first filter circuit or a path passing through the inside of the first filter circuit. A third IDT of the three or more IDTs is connected to a path connecting the third terminal and the third filter circuit or a path passing through the inside of the third filter circuit. A second IDT of the three or more IDTs is connected to a path connecting the first filter circuit and the common terminal, a path connecting the third filter circuit and the common terminal, or a path connecting the second filter circuit and the common terminal.

title_en: Digital temperature sensor and chip
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital temperature sensor, which comprises a front-end analog circuit and a quantization circuit, wherein the front-end analog circuit is used for sensing temperature and outputting a first electric signal and a second electric signal which contain temperature information, the quantization circuit is used for inputting the first electric signal and the second electric signal which are output by the front-end analog circuit, obtaining a positive temperature signal positively correlated with the temperature and a negative temperature signal negatively correlated with the temperature based on the first electric signal and the second electric signal, and gradually approaching one of the positive temperature signal and the negative temperature signal with the product of temperature information N by multiplying the one of the positive temperature signal and the negative temperature signal with the product of temperature information N or gradually approaching the other of the positive temperature signal and the negative temperature signal with the product of the temperature coefficient with the larger temperature coefficient divided by the quotient of the temperature information N, so that quantized temperature information N is obtained, and temperature detection and quantized output are realized without adopting a high-precision ADC. The application also provides a chip comprising the digital temperature sensor.

title_en: Single-ended analog signal sampling circuit, chip and single-ended analog signal sampling device
abstract_en: The present application relates to the field of electronic technologies, and in particular, to a single-ended analog signal sampling circuit, a chip, and a single-ended analog signal sampling device. Wherein, sampling circuit includes: the circuit comprises a voltage dividing circuit, a double-channel operational amplifier and an analog-to-digital converter; a voltage dividing circuit for outputting a first voltage signal; the dual-channel operational amplifier is used for performing follow-up conversion on the first voltage signal so as to output a first sampling reference voltage signal and a second sampling reference voltage signal; the first sampling reference voltage signal and the second sampling reference voltage signal have the same temperature drift tendency; and the analog-to-digital converter is used for carrying out signal sampling on the single-ended analog signal based on the first sampling reference voltage signal and the second sampling reference voltage signal so as to output a digital signal corresponding to the single-ended analog signal. Compared with the sampling circuit in the related art, the single-ended analog signal sampling circuit provided by the application has the advantages of wider range of analog signals which can be sampled, higher sampling precision and lower hardware cost.

title_en: Successive approximation type analog-to-digital converter with dynamically configurable window and control method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a successive approximation type analog-to-digital converter with a dynamically configurable window and a control method thereof, wherein the analog-to-digital converter comprises: each stage of capacitor is connected to different voltages by controlling the switches of the first capacitor array and the second capacitor array, and the output end voltage of the comparator is subjected to logic conversion and coding by the logic control module; providing a boundary window with the same preset multi-level high-order number by the digital control module, and updating the numerical value of the preset multi-level high-order number based on the multi-level high-order number output by the logic control module; and judging whether the differential signal is positioned in the boundary window, and executing corresponding progressive approximation analog-to-digital conversion according to the judging result to obtain a digital sampling signal. The application updates the preset multilevel high-order digital code through a plurality of input differential signals so as to enable the boundary window to be in a dynamic adjustment state, so that the coverage range of the boundary window is unchanged, and when the sampled differential signals are in the boundary window, the preset multilevel high-order digital code is skipped, and the power consumption of the analog-to-digital converter is reduced.

title_en: Surface acoustic wave device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a surface acoustic wave device and an electronic apparatus, the surface acoustic wave device includes: the piezoelectric device comprises a substrate, a reflecting layer arranged on the substrate, a first piezoelectric layer and a second piezoelectric layer arranged on one side of the reflecting layer away from the substrate, and an electrode layer arranged on one side of the first piezoelectric layer away from the substrate. The first piezoelectric layer is positioned on one side of the second piezoelectric layer, which is away from the substrate, the Euler angle of the first piezoelectric layer is [ alpha, theta, beta ], the Euler angle of the second piezoelectric layer is [ alpha, theta-180 DEG, beta+180 DEG ], wherein alpha is less than or equal to 30 DEG and less than or equal to 30 DEG, beta is less than or equal to 30 DEG and less than or equal to 30 DEG. In the embodiment of the application, the double-layer piezoelectric layer is arranged, the Euler angles of the piezoelectric layers are reasonably arranged, so that the sound wave vibration directions of the main modes in the first piezoelectric layer and the second piezoelectric layer are the same, and the sound wave vibration directions of the hybrid modes are opposite, thus the sound wave of the hybrid modes can achieve the effect of reverse cancellation under the condition of maintaining the normal excitation of the main modes, thereby weakening or eliminating the hybrid modes of the surface acoustic wave device, and improving the stop band inhibition performance of the surface acoustic wave device.

title_en: Data processing method and device, processing equipment, computer storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The application discloses a data processing method and device, processing equipment, a computer storage medium and a program product, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a data stream, wherein the data stream comprises L characters; intercepting the first N characters in L characters as target objects, and determining a target interval corresponding to the target objects in an initial interval according to initial character probability distribution; after traversing the target object in the L characters: determining local character probability distribution according to N characters before the character, determining target character probability distribution according to the current process and the local character probability distribution determined by the process before the current process, and determining a zone corresponding to the character in a first zone according to the target character probability distribution, wherein the first zone is a target zone or a zone determined by the process before the current process; after determining the interval corresponding to the last character in the L characters, selecting a numerical value from the interval corresponding to the last character as the coding information of the L characters.

title_en: Method and device for determining amplifying circuit, computer storage medium and terminal
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method, a device, a computer storage medium and a terminal for determining an amplifying circuit, which only need two welding spots at an input end and an output end respectively on the premise of setting the miniaturization design that the diameter of a mutual inductance coil is smaller than a preset diameter threshold value and/or the length of the mutual inductance coil is smaller than a preset length threshold value, thereby avoiding contact resistance as far as possible, realizing impedance matching and voltage amplification of the amplifying circuit of a radio frequency signal and improving the application prospect of an electro-optic modulator.

title_en: Negative voltage level conversion control circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a negative-pressure level conversion control circuit which comprises an inverter, a first MOS tube, a second MOS tube, a third MOS tube, a fourth MOS tube, a conversion unit, a first voltage division unit and a second voltage division unit, wherein the two MOS tubes are P-type MOS tubes, the third MOS tube and the fourth MOS tube are N-type MOS tubes, the conversion unit is provided with two input ends and two output ends, an external signal is input into one input end of the conversion unit, the other input end of the conversion unit is connected with the output end of the inverter, one output end of the conversion unit is connected with the grid electrode of the third MOS tube, and the other output end of the conversion unit is connected with the grid electrode of the fourth MOS tube; the first voltage dividing unit is connected between the two P-type MOS tubes and the two output ends so as to divide the voltage on the two P-type MOS tubes; the second voltage dividing unit is connected between the two N-type MOS tubes and the two output ends so as to divide the voltage on the two N-type MOS tubes. The scheme of the invention ensures that each MOS tube works in a safe voltage range, and improves the working stability of the negative voltage level conversion circuit.

title_en: Internet of things multi-user joint decoding method suitable for downlink channel
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wireless communication, and particularly discloses an Internet of things multi-user joint decoding method suitable for a downlink channel, which comprises the following steps: based on a Polar-NOMA system model, constructing a polarization code in a multi-user scene to obtain a polarization code sequence; designing a polarized code iterative decoder according to the polarized code sequence; designing an iterative receiver according to the polar code iterative decoder; based on the Polar-NOMA system model and the iterative receiver, the Polar-NOMA system receiver is designed to realize multi-user joint decoding. The invention adopts the soft information iterative decoding method, solves the problem that the prior iterative decoding scheme can not reserve and utilize the information from the channel as much as possible, and has lower error rate.

title_en: Driving circuit of battery management system
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of driving circuits, and discloses a driving circuit of a battery management system. The driving circuit comprises a MOSFET module circuit connected between a constant current source and a storage battery anode, wherein the input end of a latch circuit is connected with the output end of a main control chip and the output end of an overcurrent detection circuit, the output end of the latch circuit is connected with a first driving chip and a second driving chip, the input end of a first HSD power supply circuit is connected with the output end of the main control chip and the storage battery anode end, the output end of the first HSD power supply circuit is connected with the input end of the first driving chip, the input end of the second HSD power supply circuit is connected with the output end of the main control chip, the output end of the second HSD power supply circuit is connected with the input end of the second driving chip, the output end of the first driving chip and the output end of the second driving chip are connected with the input end of the MOSFET module circuit, one end of the freewheel circuit is connected with the storage battery anode, and one end of the freewheel circuit is connected with the storage battery cathode. The power consumption of the driving circuit can be reduced, and the safety and reliability are improved.

title_en: Overvoltage locking output circuit system based on redundant low-power-consumption control
abstract_en: The invention relates to an overvoltage locking output circuit system based on redundant low-power-consumption control, which comprises an overvoltage output locking protection circuit and a redundant low-power-consumption control circuit, wherein the redundant low-power-consumption control circuit is connected with the overvoltage locking protection circuit, the overvoltage locking protection circuit comprises a basic output switch circuit and an overvoltage locking circuit, and the overvoltage locking circuit is connected with the basic output switch circuit; the redundant low-power consumption control circuit comprises an MCU control circuit and a redundant control circuit, wherein the redundant control circuit is connected with the MCU control circuit, and the MCU control circuit is connected with the overpressure locking circuit. The overvoltage locking output circuit system based on the redundant low-power-consumption control effectively overcomes the defects of the background technology, enhances the safety and reliability of system output, reduces the risk of output failure when the MCU works abnormally or fails, and simultaneously has the overvoltage locking and low-power-consumption control functions of the prior art.

title_en: Digital isolator for improving common mode transient immunity
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital isolator for improving common mode transient immunity, which relates to the technical field of integrated circuit isolation and comprises a pair of transceiver chips, wherein each transceiver chip has the same structure and comprises a transmitting module and a receiving module; and the digital control module is used for controlling one of the pair of transceiver chips to be in a transmitting mode and the other to be in a receiving mode. Connecting two identical transceiver modules together can realize multi-channel signal transmission in any direction. In addition, an envelope detection module, a CMTIenhancing module and a noise elimination module are also disclosed, which are used for improving the common mode transient immunity of the digital isolator and solving the problem that the attenuation of the transmission signal is greatly affected by noise.

title_en: ZYNQ-based capacitance tomography system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a ZYNQ-based capacitance tomography system and a ZYNQ-based capacitance tomography method. The system comprises a ZYNQ unit, a power supply unit, an electrode sensor, a capacitance measuring unit, a DDR4 storage unit and an upper computer, wherein the electrode sensor is connected with the capacitance measuring unit, the capacitance measuring unit comprises a switch switching circuit, a C/V conversion circuit, an excitation circuit and an analog-to-digital conversion circuit, the ZYNQ unit comprises a programmable logic end and a processor system end which are mutually connected, the programmable logic end comprises a switch switching module, a signal generating module, a digital quadrature demodulation module and an image reconstruction module, and the processor system end is respectively connected with the DDR4 storage unit and the upper computer. By using each unit hardware to perform parallel calculation and arranging the image reconstruction module in the ZYNQ unit, the image reconstruction algorithm is accelerated, compared with the traditional PC upper computer for processing data, the power consumption is effectively reduced, the device volume is reduced, the imaging speed and accuracy are improved, and the measurement error is reduced.

title_en: Impedance matching network suitable for high-quality factor and wide-impedance variation range load
abstract_en: The invention discloses an impedance matching network suitable for a load with a high quality factor and a wide impedance variation range, which comprises the following components: an impedance matching sub-network, a multi-stage reactance reduction network, a high quality factor and a load with a wide impedance variation range; then determining the parameter value in the impedance matching network, and further obtaining an impedance matching network model; in the model, a single-path multistage impedance matching method is used, reactance is firstly reduced to a proper range through a multistage reactance reduction network, and then impedance is matched to target impedance through an impedance matching network.

title_en: Low-power-consumption analog-to-digital converter used in-memory calculation
abstract_en: The application discloses a low-power-consumption analog-to-digital converter used in memory calculation, and belongs to the technical field of integrated circuits. The analog-to-digital converter realizes the function of ReLU by using the capacitor array and the comparator which are arranged in the analog-to-digital converter, and performs the ReLU operation of input data in the analog domain without adding an additional analog circuit, thereby reducing the complexity of the analog circuit and reducing the power consumption expense caused by ADC conversion without introducing an additional error; meanwhile, the ReLU threshold value is configurable in the scheme of the application, is suitable for a memory integrated chip read-out circuit system, combines the ReLU with the ADC, reduces the power consumption caused by the conversion of redundant data by the ADC and the power consumption expenditure caused by the processing of the ReLU by a subsequent digital module, and can reduce the area and the power consumption of the whole memory chip.

title_en: Physiological signal compression system based on depth self-encoder
abstract_en: The invention provides a physiological signal compression system based on a depth self-encoder, which comprises an encoder, a decoder, a fast Fourier transform module, a discriminator and an optimizer, wherein the encoder is used for converting an input physiological signal into a latent variable Z, the decoder is used for reconstructing an original physiological signal based on the latent variable Z, the fast Fourier transform module is used for calculating frequency components of input and output signals to acquire a frequency spectrum, the discriminator is used for judging the difference degree between characteristics of the input signal and characteristics of the output signal, and the optimizer is used for updating the weight of a neural network so as to obtain a better compression reconstruction effect. The physiological signal compression system based on the depth self-encoder can improve the compression rate to 360 times under the condition that the RMS (mean square error) and the PRDN (normalized RMS difference percentage) are acceptable, and the signal reconstruction quality is improved by adding the depth discriminator for training together in the training stage.

title_en: Data migration optimization transmission method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital information transmission, in particular to a data migration optimization transmission method, which comprises the steps of obtaining all water level data, precipitation amount and water flow of a target monitoring point and water level data of an upstream monitoring point, calculating stability and rainfall rate of each water level data of the target monitoring point according to all water level data and precipitation amount of the target monitoring point, obtaining the advisability of each water level data, calculating single importance degree and comparison importance degree of each water level data of the target monitoring point by combining the water level data of the upstream monitoring point, taking each water level data of the target monitoring point as each data of an initial dictionary, combining the comparison importance degrees of all water level data, finally obtaining the coding position front rate of each data, and carrying out data transmission by combining an LZW algorithm. According to the invention, the dictionary table of the LZW algorithm is dynamically updated based on the importance degree of the data, so that the important data is more advanced than the encoding table, and the safety in the transportation process is ensured.

title_en: Schottky diode assembly, design method, frequency multiplier and adjusting method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Schottky diode assembly, a design method, a frequency multiplier and an adjustment method, relates to the technical field of semiconductor devices, and solves the problem that the power consistency among diodes cannot be maintained when the number of the diodes is increased in the prior art; the invention comprises m rows and n columns of diodes, wherein split rings are arranged among the diodes in different rows, the split rings surround one row of diodes, n is more than or equal to 1, m is more than or equal to 2, and the diodes are Schottky diodes.

title_en: Amplifier circuit
abstract_en: The invention provides an amplifier circuit which comprises a first transistor, a second transistor, a high-end transistor, a low-end transistor, a first amplifier and a second amplifier. The NMOS is adopted as a high-end transistor, the power loss is low, and the source voltage clamp of the first transistor and the high-end transistor is equal through negative feedback by the first amplifier, so that the current flowing through the first transistor and the high-end transistor is equal, and the magnitude of the static current can be determined by the ratio of the width to the length of the first transistor and the high-end transistor. Therefore, the stability of the class AB amplifier or the class D amplifier with the amplifier circuit can be improved, and the design requirement of quiescent current can be easily met.

title_en: Method and system for taming rubidium atomic clock based on long-wave timing signal
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of time frequency, but not limited to, and discloses a method and a system for taming a rubidium atomic clock based on a long-wave timing signal, which are used for establishing a mathematical model of the long-wave timing signal, uniformly analyzing and modeling the long-wave timing signal influenced by various factors by analyzing the time-frequency characteristic of the long-wave timing signal, and correcting the long-wave time-varying signal with obvious fluctuation and periodic effect into a stable timing signal; the method comprises the steps of constructing a time difference model aiming at a secondary polynomial superposition periodic fluctuation term of the tamed rubidium atomic clock, correcting original time difference data of the rubidium atomic clock and long waves, and achieving taming of the rubidium atomic clock by utilizing the corrected time difference data of the rubidium clock and the long waves and combining a least square method. The method solves the problems of large short-term jitter and obvious periodic effect in long term of the long-wave timing signal, reduces the time difference data fluctuation of the long-wave and rubidium atomic clock, and expands the application of the long-wave timing in the aspect of atomic clock discipline.

title_en: Discrete time increment type analog-to-digital converter and control method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a discrete time increment type analog-to-digital converter and a control method thereof, wherein the analog-to-digital converter comprises a modulator and a digital filter, the modulator includes an integrator module, a single bit quantizer, a FIR feedback digital-to-analog converter, a first compensation path, and a second compensation path. The control method comprises the steps of carrying out noise shaping processing on an input signal and an output signal of a single-bit quantizer to obtain a preliminary output signal, and carrying out filtering processing on the preliminary output signal by a digital filter to obtain an output signal of an analog-to-digital converter. The embodiment of the application can reduce hardware consumption and digital power consumption, improve the conversion precision of the analog-to-digital converter and reduce the signal distortion degree of the analog-to-digital converter. The application can be widely applied to the technical field of mixed signal circuits.

title_en: Encoding and decoding device and related method
abstract_en: The application discloses a coding and decoding device and a related method. For example, in the encoding device, the generating module generates a first sparse signal according to the bit information, the first sparse signal is a sparse signal corresponding to a w non-zero element in a c column of spatial coupling, the matrix multiplying module performs addition and subtraction processing on the first sparse signal interleaved by the first interleaver by using the first transformation square matrix to obtain a first transformation result, the second interleaver interleaves the first transformation result to obtain a second transformation result, and the output module processes the second transformation result corresponding to each non-zero element in each column of the spatial coupling matrix to obtain an encoding result. Accordingly, in the decoding device, the iterative decoding module performs iterative decoding on the channel observation value acquired by the receiving module according to the spatial coupling matrix, the first transformation matrix and the conjugate transpose matrix of the first transformation matrix. Therefore, the hardware deployment difficulty of encoding and decoding of the sparse superimposed code and the resource overhead of hardware can be reduced.

title_en: Applet debugging method, apparatus, electronic device, readable medium and program product
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure disclose an applet debugging method, apparatus, electronic device, readable medium and program product. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an applet compression package file corresponding to a target applet according to jump information of the corresponding target applet. And analyzing the applet compression package file through a target application corresponding to the target applet to obtain applet page information. And generating the applet debugging page information according to the applet page information. And displaying the applet debugging page corresponding to the applet debugging page information for debugging. This embodiment is related to a computer, and can provide a full-link real running environment, thereby improving the applet debugging efficiency.

title_en: Intelligent networking automobile behavior prediction method based on fusion recognition algorithm
