abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent network-connected automobile behavior prediction method based on a fusion recognition algorithm, which relates to the technical field of automatic driving and comprises the steps of carrying out association matching on a sensor object and a tracker object, carrying out data fusion on the tracker object and the sensor object, updating the tracker object according to a fusion result, converting coordinate information of the tracker object to a world coordinate system to obtain a fusion recognition result, carrying out feature extraction on the fusion recognition result, constructing a training set, a verification set and a test set, constructing an initial prediction model by utilizing the training set, evaluating the initial prediction model by utilizing the verification set, optimizing the adjusted prediction model by utilizing the test set, preprocessing the fusion recognition result obtained in real time, and inputting the preprocessed fusion recognition result into a final prediction model to obtain the prediction result. The method solves the real-time problem of the current behavior prediction system, improves the accuracy of the prediction result, is beneficial to improving the traffic safety level and improves the stability and comfort level of planning control.

title_en: Temperature compensation type bulk acoustic wave resonator and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a temperature-compensated bulk acoustic wave resonator and a manufacturing method thereof, belonging to the technical field of semiconductors, the temperature-compensated bulk acoustic wave resonator comprises a first substrate, a supporting layer, a bottom electrode, a piezoelectric layer, a temperature-compensated layer and a top electrode which are sequentially laminated from bottom to top, the middle part of one surface of the first substrate connected with the supporting layer is provided with a cavity, and the temperature compensation layer is made of a material with a positive frequency temperature coefficient. The invention aims at the fact that the common piezoelectric material has a negative frequency temperature coefficient, the temperature compensation layer is added on the piezoelectric layer, the inserted temperature compensation layer adopts the material with a positive frequency temperature coefficient, so that the temperature compensation can be realized, the temperature compensation bulk acoustic wave resonator has lower temperature drift characteristics, the performance change of the bulk acoustic wave resonator and a filter constructed by the bulk acoustic wave resonator when the temperature of the bulk acoustic wave resonator changes along with the temperature of a working environment can be reduced, the working stability of a device can be enhanced, and the manufacturing method can be compatible with a CMOS technology.

title_en: Current source circuit, ramp generator, analog-to-digital converter and chip
abstract_en: The invention provides a current source circuit, a slope generator, an analog-to-digital converter and a chip, wherein the current source circuit is provided with a reference current generating circuit, a current mirror circuit and a clamping circuit, the current of the reference current source is mirrored through n paths of mirror branches, the current generated by the current mirror is clamped and split through the clamping circuit, the mirror branches connected with a first input end or a second input end of the clamping circuit determine the output current of the current source circuit, the circuit is simple and easy to realize, the precision of the output current can be accurately controlled through gating the mirror branches, the problem that transistors which are needed to be overlapped are increased in an exponential mode when the required regulation bit number of the output current is high in the prior art can be solved, and the balance between the current regulation precision and the layout area of the chip can be achieved.

title_en: Distributed feedback in amplified signal paths
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to distributed feedback in an amplified signal path. A device includes a signal path including a plurality of inverters connected in series, the plurality of inverters including a first inverter having a first input and having a first output, a second inverter having a second input coupled to the first output of the first inverter and having a second output, and a third inverter having a third input coupled to the second output of the second inverter and having a third output. The device also includes a first feedback path coupling the second output of the second inverter to the first input of the first inverter, the first feedback path including a fourth inverter, and a second feedback path coupling the third output of the third inverter to the second input of the second inverter, the second feedback path including a fifth inverter.

title_en: Positive square wave power supply circuit, testing device of device to be tested and power supply method
abstract_en: The application provides a positive square wave power supply circuit, a testing device of a device to be tested and a power supply method, wherein the positive square wave power supply circuit comprises a square wave generating unit which comprises a plurality of cascaded half-bridge structures, each half-bridge structure comprises a high-voltage direct-current power supply, an energy storage module, a first switch module positioned on the first bridge wall and a second switch module positioned on the second bridge wall, wherein the high-voltage direct-current power supply and the energy storage module are connected in parallel. The power supply circuit has the advantages of simple structure, good expandability, mutual independence between each stage and flexible adjustment of output square wave waveform parameters, is suitable for being used as a positive-polarity square wave power supply circuit for high-voltage SiC packaging insulation assessment, and solves the problem that partial discharge inside a high-voltage silicon carbide device exposed under the positive-polarity square wave voltage cannot be fully evaluated due to the lack of a high-voltage positive-polarity square wave power supply for the high-voltage SiC packaging insulation assessment in the prior art.

title_en: Alternating current electromagnetic field signal gain self-adaptive adjusting system based on operational amplifier
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alternating current magnetic field signal gain self-adaptive regulating system based on an operational amplifier, which comprises four parts, namely an operational amplifier, a programmable digital potentiometer, an interface circuit and a singlechip minimum system, wherein the control object is the proportional conversion gain of the operational amplifier, the four parts are positioned on the same circuit board, external signals are transmitted into the system through the interface circuit, and are transmitted to the singlechip minimum system after being processed by a bias amplifying circuit consisting of the operational amplifier, the programmable digital potentiometer and an auxiliary resistor capacitor, and the resistance distribution of the programmable digital potentiometer is controlled through judging the value of an output signal, so that the gain of the bias amplifying circuit is changed, and the automatic regulation of the gain is realized.

title_en: Gain control method, gain control unit and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a gain control method, a gain control unit and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of communication. The gain control method comprises the steps of determining an RSSI value based on an I/Q signal output by an analog-to-digital converter, determining first gain data and a control mark according to the I/Q signal, wherein the first gain data is used for indicating gain quantity for performing gain control under the saturated state of the analog-to-digital converter, the control mark is used for starting the gain control when a lead code of a data frame is identified, gain adjustment amplitude corresponding to the control mark is smaller than that corresponding to the first gain data, and a target gain adjustment quantity is determined according to the first gain data and second gain data determined based on the control mark and the RSSI value, wherein the target gain adjustment quantity is used for adjusting analog gain of an analog front-end circuit. The gain adjustment response speed is faster and the gain adjustment precision is higher.

title_en: Enhanced design and use of longer low density parity check Wi-Fi codewords
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and devices related to Low Density Parity Check (LDPC) Wi-Fi encoding and decoding are described. An apparatus may identify a first base matrix to generate 1944 bits of an LDPC codeword, identify a mask matrix to generate a second base matrix for generating 3888 bits of the LDPC codeword based on the first base matrix, entries of the mask matrix having values 0,1, and-1, generate the second base matrix by multiplying the first base matrix by the mask matrix, entries of the second base matrix indicating corresponding cyclic shifts to be applied to an identity matrix, generate a parity check matrix by multiplying the second base matrix by the identity matrix, generate 3888 bits of the LDPC codeword based on the parity check matrix, and transmit a frame including the LDPC codeword.

title_en: Frequency conversion circuit, antenna system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a frequency conversion circuit, an antenna system and electronic equipment, and belongs to the technical field of communication. The frequency conversion circuit comprises an input end, a first output end and a second output end, wherein the frequency conversion circuit comprises a frequency selection sub-circuit, a combining sub-circuit and a frequency mixing sub-circuit, the frequency selection sub-circuit is configured to divide a radio frequency signal input by the input end into a first frequency band signal, a second frequency band signal, a third frequency band signal and a local oscillation signal according to frequency, the frequency of the third frequency band signal is between the frequencies of the first frequency band signal and the second frequency band signal, the combining sub-circuit is configured to combine the first frequency band signal and the second frequency band signal and output a first radio frequency signal through the first output end, the first radio frequency signal at least comprises a radio frequency signal of a specific frequency band, and the frequency mixing sub-circuit is configured to mix the third frequency band signal and the local oscillation signal and output a second radio frequency signal through the second output end, and the second radio frequency signal is a radio frequency signal of the specific frequency band.

title_en: Frequency synthesizer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a frequency synthesizer, and relates to the technical field of communication hardware. The frequency synthesizer comprises a six-layer substrate and various elements, the six-layer substrate is reasonably laid out and wired, the elements are placed in a limited space, then a coplanar waveguide transmission line model is adopted for a loop filter part, shielding holes are added at the positions which are far away from metal edges to reduce return loss and insertion loss, the return loss is less than minus 30dB, the insertion loss is lower than 0.05dB, a bonding pad and a through hole are adopted for connection of an output high-frequency signal wire, and a metal column type coaxial-like structure is added to optimize the return loss and the insertion loss with the shielding holes, so that the miniaturized and high-performance frequency synthesizer is realized, and the frequency synthesizer is suitable for application scenes of high integration and miniaturization.

title_en: Power control module of power amplifier and radio frequency front end module
abstract_en: The application discloses a power control module and a radio frequency front end module of a power amplifier, wherein the power control module is at least partially integrated in a second chip and comprises a temperature detection circuit, a threshold comparison circuit and a control circuit, wherein the temperature detection circuit is used for detecting the working temperature of the power amplifier in the first chip and generating detection voltage related to the working temperature, the threshold comparison circuit is used for comparing the detection voltage with at least one preset threshold voltage and outputting a comparison result, the comparison result is used for indicating the magnitude relation between the detection voltage and the preset threshold voltage, and the control circuit is used for controlling the power mode of the power amplifier according to the comparison result. According to the application, by the temperature detection circuit, the threshold comparison circuit and the control circuit, before the working temperature of the power amplifier reaches the critical point, the heating of the power amplifier is delayed, so that the working temperature of the power amplifier is not easy to reach the critical point, the frequency of the power amplifier which is turned off is reduced, the efficiency of the power amplifier is improved, and the service life of the power amplifier is prolonged.

title_en: Single-port multi-control mode interface circuit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of integrated circuits, in particular to a single-port multi-control mode interface circuit. The port module comprises a port and a switch unit, wherein the port is connected with the switch unit, the switch unit is respectively connected with the pull-up resistor and the pull-down resistor, and the switch unit has three working states. The device comprises at least one group of comparison units, wherein each group of comparison modules comprises two comparison modules, each comparison module comprises a transistor element, a first MOS (metal oxide semiconductor) tube, a resistive element and an inverter, and in one comparison module, the transistor element is connected with an input power supply, and the resistive element is grounded; in the other comparison module, the transistor element is grounded, the resistive element is connected with an input power supply, and the signal control module selects an output mode according to the output signals of the comparison modules. Thus, the problem that the multi-mode control is complex through a single port in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Low-complexity decoding method of LDPC-Hadamard code based on prototype graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-complexity decoding method of LDPC-Hadamard codes based on a prototype graph, belonging to the field of digital signal processing. The implementation method of the invention comprises the steps of performing LDPC coding on information bits, then coding constraint relation of check nodes of the LDPC codes into Hadamard codes to obtain a prototype graph of the LDPC-Hadamard codes, transmitting and receiving coded code words through channels, initializing PVN nodes and HCN nodes by using received information, performing Hadamard decoding by using a symbol-by-symbol maximum posterior probability decoding algorithm, using DFHT approximation operation to reduce decoding complexity, transmitting information obtained after decoding to the PVN nodes, summing updated HCN node information and information of the last iteration, judging and decoding by using a summation result, and performing decoding judgment on PVN information. The invention combines LDPC coding, hadamard coding and Max-Log approximate calculation methods, reduces decoding complexity and enhances the stability and reliability of a communication system.

title_en: Decoding device, control circuit, storage medium, and check matrix generation method
abstract_en: The decoding device (320) is provided with a storage unit (331) which stores a1 st check matrix which can be divided into blocks of P x P small matrices and which is the maximum coding rate assumed as the check matrix of the low-density parity check code used in communication, and a generation unit (332) which generates a2 nd check matrix having a coding rate lower than that of the 1 st check matrix by using rows including units of the small matrices in the column direction, which are included in the 1 st check matrix, and which generates 1 st rows in which a part of the blocks is replaced with 0 matrix, and which generates 2 nd rows in which the predetermined blocks are replaced with 0 matrix and the positions of 1 s included in the small matrices of other blocks are replaced with predetermined fixed values, by setting P as positive integers.

title_en: Numerical control electric tuning trap and numerical control selection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a numerical control electric tuning trap and a numerical control selection control method, which belong to the technical field of trap modulation, and comprise a numerical control circuit, at least one trap circuit, a vector network analyzer, a PC, an upper computer and a numerical control circuit, wherein the numerical control circuit is used for generating a driving signal, the at least one trap circuit is used for receiving the driving signal generated by the numerical control circuit, carrying out trap processing on an input radio frequency signal, the vector network analyzer is electrically connected with an output end of the at least one trap circuit and is used for carrying out sweep processing on the output radio frequency signal subjected to trap processing of the at least one trap circuit and outputting trap frequency information, the PC is in communication connection with the vector network analyzer and is used for setting a sweep range of the vector network analyzer and obtaining the relation between the driving signal and the trap frequency information, and the upper computer is in communication connection with the PC and is used for obtaining a driving signal adapting to the trap frequency according to the relation between the driving signal obtained by the PC and the trap frequency and feeding back the driving signal into the numerical control circuit.

title_en: Signal processing circuit
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a signal processing circuit comprising a channel sampling unit (20) comprising a first terminal (In1+) and a second terminal (IN 1-) connected to a sensor (10) and a sampling circuit (22), the sampling circuit (22) being configured to allow positive and negative currents from the sensor (10) to flow between the first terminal (In1+) and the second terminal (IN 1-) and comprising a sampling end (P  1 ) arranged on a current path between the first terminal (In1+) and the second terminal (IN 1-) wherein a current direction of the positive current is opposite to a current direction of the negative current, a signal modulation unit (30) configured to obtain a sampling voltage at the sampling end (P  1 ) and to process the sampling voltage to generate a first processed signal, and a processor (40) configured to receive the first processed signal and to generate an output signal based on the first processed signal.

title_en: T-shaped three-level three-phase inverter IGBT radiation electromagnetic field distribution prediction method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electromagnetic interference prediction, and discloses a T-type three-level inverter IGBT radiation electromagnetic field distribution prediction method which comprises the following steps of S1, building a simulation circuit model of a T-type three-level inverter in simplorer based on an inverter SPWM control principle, S2, building an IGBT parameter model in simplorer, S3, inputting IGBT model parameters obtained in the step S2 into the simulation circuit model built in the step S1, S4, building an IGBT 3D model in ANSYS MAXWELL, setting custom material parameters, and performing grid subdivision calculation. According to the method, the radiation field of the internal space of the IGBT is finally obtained through setting of the model and calculation of related parameters, and the influence of the radiation field in the single IGBT is predicted according to the corresponding radiation field.

title_en: Digital controller
abstract_en: A digital controller for a switching converter configured to receive an input voltage at an input voltage node and to generate an output voltage at an output voltage node, the switching converter comprising one or more power switches and an energy storage element, the digital controller comprising a pulse width modulation control circuit configured to receive the output voltage and to generate a PWM control signal to control switching operation of the one or more power switches, and a switching circuit configured to couple the pulse width modulation control circuit to the input voltage node during a first phase and to couple the pulse width modulation control circuit to a supply voltage node during a second phase, the supply voltage node being at a supply voltage.

title_en: Power switch with small occupied area
abstract_en: A power switch includes a pair of substantially parallel half-bridges, a Printed Circuit Board (PCB) controller operable to turn the half-bridges on and off, power terminals for coupling a high energy power source to the half-bridges, power phase output terminals for connecting a load to the half-bridges, wherein the half-bridges, the PCB, the power terminals and the power phase output terminals are packaged in the same package having a relatively large planar first face surface on which contact surfaces of the terminals are exposed.

title_en: Sensor interface circuit for three-physical parameter fusion for battery monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sensor interface circuit for three-physical parameter fusion for battery monitoring, which comprises a differential amplifying circuit, a fixed resistor, a limiting resistor, a fixed capacitor, a resistance-type pressure sensor and a threshold memristor. The input of the differential amplifying circuit is the voltage of two ends of a battery, the output end of the differential amplifying circuit is connected with one end of a fixed resistor, the other end of the fixed resistor is connected with one end of a fixed capacitor and one end of a threshold memristor and is used as an output end, the other end of the threshold memristor is connected with one end of a resistance-type pressure sensor and one end of a limiting resistor, and the other ends of the fixed capacitor C, the resistance-type pressure sensor R  F  and the limiting resistor are grounded. The sensor interface circuit fuses the values of three physical parameters of voltage, temperature and stress of the battery into pulse characteristic quantities such as frequency of output pulse signals, maximum value of pulse signal amplitude, minimum value of pulse signal amplitude and the like, and meets the requirements of battery running state monitoring and BMS.

title_en: Low-power-consumption power-on reset circuit, module and chip for covering power-on delay
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of analog circuits, and particularly relates to a low-power-consumption power-on reset circuit, a module and a chip for covering fast and slow power-on delay. The detection circuit is used for detecting the power-on of the VDD and generating a corresponding power-on signal. The delay circuit is used for generating a delay signal with specified delay by utilizing the outputs of the band-gap reference current source and the band-gap reference voltage source existing in the power management circuit. The output circuit comprises 1 AND gate, and two input ends of the AND gate are respectively connected with the output ends of the detection circuit and the delay circuit, so that a reset signal meeting the delay requirement is generated according to the output of the detection circuit and the delay circuit. The power-on reset circuit can cover different power-on modes, can generate reset signals for making delay demands, and can inhibit the influence of jump easily occurring when the delay circuit is powered on quickly on the circuit reliability by detecting the output of the circuit.

title_en: Wideband active mixer reversible design method and system for improving reversible neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for reversibly designing a broadband active mixer for improving a reversible neural network, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a response of the broadband active mixer, and the response comprises a conversion gain G and a noise figure NF; and outputting design parameters of the broadband active mixer by responding to the input R-INN model, and designing the active mixer according to the design parameters, wherein the design parameters comprise resistance and capacitance, the R-INN model is constructed by combining real-value non-volume retention transformation and a reversible neural network, the R-INN model is obtained by training a training set, and the training set comprises the design parameters and corresponding responses in a preset range. The invention optimizes the accuracy of forward prediction and effectively and reversely pushes posterior distribution of design parameters by introducing an improved reversible neural network model combined with a real-value non-volume conservation transformation technology, thereby improving the efficiency and accuracy of the optimized design of the broadband active mixer.

title_en: Multi-sampling SS-ADC circuit and module based on slope noise self-adaption
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image sensor design, in particular to a slope noise self-adaption-based multi-sampling SS-ADC circuit and a module. The SS-ADC circuit comprises 1 common slope generating part DAC_H, 1 low noise slope generating part DAC_L, 1 comparator part COMP, 1 judgment LOGIC part LOGIC, 2 counting parts COUNTER 1-COUNTER 2 and 1 selection output part SELECT. The invention adds the low-noise RAMP generating part DAC_L to provide the quantized RAMP signal RAMP_L used under the condition of weak light, and selects different quantized RAMP signals to execute CCMS technology by judging the illumination condition, thereby effectively reducing the horizontal noise generated in the quantization process by the RAMP noise under the condition of weak light. The invention solves the problem that the horizontal noise can not be reduced when the existing CCMS technology is applied to the ADC.

title_en: Low-power-consumption broadband continuous time linear equalizer
abstract_en: The application discloses a continuous time linear equalizer which comprises a transconductance circuit, a transimpedance amplifier circuit and a common mode voltage feedback circuit, wherein the transconductance circuit comprises a pair of PMOS (P-channel metal oxide semiconductor) tubes, a pair of NMOS (N-channel metal oxide semiconductor) tubes, six current sources and two RC (resistor-capacitor) networks, and two branches are arranged between a power supply and ground. The drain electrode of the PMOS tube I is connected with the drain electrode of the NMOS tube I, the drain electrode of the PMOS tube II is connected with the drain electrode of the NMOS tube II, and a pair of differential intermediate signals are respectively output. The circuit has a simple structure and only has a primary circuit, adopts a complementary structure of the PMOS input pair transistor and the NMOS input pair transistor, maximally utilizes bias current, has low power consumption, improves the current utilization rate compared with the traditional circuit, can realize the balance of a wider frequency band under the condition of low power consumption, and has high gain.

title_en: Crystal oscillation circuit and crystal oscillator
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of integrated circuit design and discloses a crystal oscillation circuit and a crystal oscillator, wherein the crystal oscillation circuit comprises a core oscillation circuit configured to output oscillation voltage, a voltage amplitude detection circuit connected with the core oscillation circuit and configured to detect the amplitude of the oscillation voltage and output direct-current voltage according to the amplitude of the oscillation voltage, a first bias circuit connected with the voltage amplitude detection circuit and the core oscillation circuit and configured to output first bias current according to the direct-current voltage, and a second bias circuit connected with the core oscillation circuit and configured to output second bias current according to temperature change, wherein the first bias current and the second bias current act on the core oscillation circuit and provide bias current for the core oscillation circuit. The crystal oscillating circuit can reduce circuit power consumption after the crystal oscillation is completed under the condition of realizing the rapid oscillation starting of the crystal.

title_en: Series resonance voltage-controlled oscillator with mode switching function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a series resonance voltage-controlled oscillator with a mode switching function, which comprises a series resonance mode switching switch and two series resonance oscillator units connected in a coupling mode, wherein each series resonance oscillator unit comprises an active negative resistance network and an LC resonance network, each LC resonance network comprises a first inductor, a first capacitor and a second inductor which are sequentially connected in series, and the first inductor and the second inductor are correspondingly connected with two output ends of the active negative resistance network one by one. A first node is arranged on a circuit between the first inductor and the active negative resistance network, a second node is arranged on a circuit between the second inductor and the active negative resistance network, and the series resonance mode switching switch is used for controlling the switching of an even mode and an odd mode. The invention can ensure the reliability of mode switching when in application, meanwhile, the parasitic capacitance of the mode switching switch can not be introduced into the series resonant cavity, thereby not compressing the tuning range and widening the frequency tuning range of the series resonant oscillator.

title_en: Intelligent filtering method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent filtering method and system based on deep learning, and relates to the technical field of data filtering. The method solves the technical problem that when the intelligent optimization algorithm is used for optimizing the parameters of the filter, the optimizing performance and the computing efficiency conflict with each other. The method comprises the steps of obtaining interference control instruction data, extracting individuals passing through each data in the optimizing later stage, combining the optimizing later individuals corresponding to the same type of data after classifying the data to obtain various sub-search spaces, and calling the sub-search spaces to perform filter parameter optimization after classifying the filtering control instruction data. The sub-search space which belongs to various data is obtained by extracting the individual in the later period of optimizing and focusing on the partial filtering parameter with the filtering effect close to the optimal to the interference control instruction data, and the sub-search space is searched only in the corresponding sub-search space when the control instruction data to be filtered is processed, so that the search range is reduced and the search performance is improved.

title_en: Low-impedance miniaturized tuning fork wafer and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-impedance miniaturized tuning fork wafer and a manufacturing method thereof, the low-impedance miniaturized tuning fork wafer comprises vibrating arms, a base part, supporting arms, connecting electrode grooves and grooves, wherein the base part is symmetrically provided with two vibrating arms relative to a central shaft of the base part, the base parts on two sides of the vibrating arms are symmetrically provided with two supporting arms, the upper side and the lower side of each vibrating arm are respectively provided with a groove along the length direction of the vibrating arm, the depths of the grooves on the upper side and the lower side are the same and do not penetrate through the vibrating arms, the vibrating arms on the periphery of each groove are provided with the connecting electrode grooves, the side walls of the grooves on the two sides along the length direction are arc-shaped curved surfaces protruding towards each other.

title_en: Control method of waterproof touch type LED driving controller
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of LED driving controllers, in particular to a control method of a waterproof touch type LED driving controller, which is characterized in that environmental conditions and user preferences are automatically identified through an AI algorithm, sensor parameters are dynamically adjusted, self-adaptive configuration is realized, real touch and false triggering are intelligently distinguished by utilizing charge detection, capacitance induction and weak magnetic field change, user operation intentions such as tapping, long pressing, sliding and the like are deeply analyzed by combining machine learning, a control strategy is dynamically generated according to the user intentions and the environmental parameters, the brightness and the color temperature of an LED are automatically adjusted, a command is executed, a control strategy is optimized through a reinforcement learning algorithm, a health monitoring function is integrated, a user operation mode and environmental data are analyzed, the health state of equipment is intelligently judged, potential faults are early warned in advance, and stable operation and user experience of the equipment are ensured.

title_en: Gate driving circuit, motor driving device using the same, and electronic apparatus
abstract_en: The invention provides a gate drive circuit which suppresses through current and transient caused by reverse recovery current of a freewheeling diode. The 1 st current source (CS 1) is configured to generate a 1 st current (Ix) switchable between a 1 st current amount (Ia) and a 2 nd current amount (Ib) smaller than the 1 st current amount (Ia). The 1 st current mirror circuit (CM 1) has an input node connected to a 1 st current source (CS 1), and is configured to supply a 1 st current (Ix) to a gate of a power transistor (MH) in a foldback manner. The on-state fixed switch (SW 2) is connected between the gate of the power transistor (MH) and a high-level line (412) that generates a high voltage (V  H ) corresponding to the high level of the gate voltage of the power transistor (MH). The control circuit (210) is configured to control the on-state of the fixed switch (SW 2) and the 1 st current source (CS 1).

title_en: Operational amplifier
abstract_en: The application discloses an operational amplifier which comprises a first input stage circuit, a second input stage circuit and a switching circuit, wherein the first input stage circuit comprises a first differential pair of PMOS transistors, the first differential pair is used for generating a first differential current signal corresponding to a voltage difference between a positive input signal and a negative input signal, the second input stage circuit comprises a second differential pair of NMOS transistors, the second differential pair is used for generating a second differential current signal corresponding to a voltage difference between the positive input signal and the negative input signal, and the switching circuit is connected between the second input stage circuit and an input end of the operational amplifier. The switching circuit is used for conducting a connection path between the input end of the operational amplifier and the second differential pair only when the input common-mode voltage is larger than the reference voltage, so that the second input stage circuit does not contribute additional noise and offset voltage when the operational amplifier works normally, and the common-mode rejection ratio of the circuit is not affected.

title_en: Fractional frequency division phase-locked loop circuit based on digital time converter and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a decimal frequency division phase-locked loop circuit based on a digital time converter and a working method thereof, belonging to the technical field of decimal phase-locked loop circuits, comprising the following steps that step 1) the output of a main frequency divider is firstly subjected to frequency division by a first frequency divider controlled by a second frequency divider to obtain quantization noise; the method comprises the steps of step 2) carrying out filtering operation of phase domain adjustment on a filter, carrying out operation on FCW signals and output of a second frequency divider to obtain another quantization noise, processing the other quantization noise by a digital predistortion processor, step 3) controlling a switch capacitor bank of the filter to eliminate two quantization noise, step 4) outputting signals after eliminating the quantization noise by a voltage frequency divider, comparing the signals with signals of REF by a frequency discriminator and a loop filter, and controlling signal output of a main frequency divider by a relay and the loop filter.

title_en: Battery heating equipment, battery management system, battery pack and power utilization device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a battery heating device, a battery management system, a battery pack and an electric device, wherein the battery heating device comprises a heating module, a battery pack module and a battery pack module; the heating device comprises a first switch module, a micro control unit, a first control circuit, a first reference signal, a first switch module, a second switch module, a first control circuit, a second control circuit and a second control circuit, wherein the heating module and the first switch module are connected in series between a first power terminal and a second power terminal, the micro control unit is used for alternately outputting a first signal and a second signal, the first control circuit is electrically connected between the micro control unit and the first switch module, the first control circuit is used for sending the first reference signal to the first switch module when receiving the first signal so as to enable the first switch module to be conducted, and the first switch module is used for maintaining conduction when the micro control unit outputs the second signal. According to the embodiment of the application, the first switch module can be stably controlled to be conducted through the signal output by the micro control unit, and the first switch module can not malfunction under other interference signals, so that the stability and reliability of battery heating are improved.

title_en: Adjustable type Low noise amplifier
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of amplifiers and discloses an adjustable low-noise amplifier which comprises an amplifier component and an installation component, wherein an upper cover is arranged at the top of the amplifier component, a circuit board is arranged in the shell, an adjusting signal amplifier and a power supply module are arranged at the top of the circuit board, a positioning shaft is fixed on the inner bottom wall of the shell, a buffer block is fixed on the outer side of the positioning shaft, the circuit board is sleeved on the outer side of the positioning shaft and is positioned at the top of the buffer block, connecting ports are arranged at two ends of the shell, the installation component is arranged on the amplifier component and comprises a locking piece, the locking piece comprises an extrusion rod, and the extrusion rod is positioned at the bottom of the upper cover. The invention has the beneficial effects that the upper cover and the circuit board are fixed by the arrangement of the mounting assembly, and the upper cover and the circuit board can be simultaneously unlocked during the disassembly, so that the circuit board can be quickly disassembled, and the maintenance time can be reduced.

title_en: Planar SSR optocoupler
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optocouplers, in particular to a planar SSR optocoupler, which is characterized in that a light emitting diode arranged on an input loop and a bidirectional photosensitive silicon controlled rectifier and a bidirectional thyristor arranged on an output loop are utilized to drive the bidirectional photosensitive silicon controlled rectifier to open the gate electrode of the bidirectional thyristor through light emitting of the light emitting diode, and meanwhile, a thyristor T1 and a thyristor T2 are driven to control a LOAD LOAD, so that the function of a relay can be completed by the circuit.

title_en: Low density parity check code generation method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The present application relates to the field of communications technologies, and in particular, to a method, an apparatus, a computer device, and a storage medium for generating a low density parity check code. The low-density parity check code generation method includes dividing a check matrix to be processed of a low-density parity check code into an information bit matrix and a check bit matrix, carrying out row transformation rearrangement on the information bit matrix and the check bit matrix based on a preset row index, carrying out column transformation on a first check bit matrix based on a preset column index to form a rearranged second check bit matrix, constructing a matrix equation aiming at the check matrix based on the first information bit matrix and the second check bit matrix, solving the matrix equation to obtain each target check bit value in the second check bit matrix, and generating a target codeword of the low-density parity check code based on each information bit in the first information bit matrix and the target check bit value. The low-density parity check code generation method is higher in efficiency, wider in application range and lower in cost.

title_en: Oral cavity cleaning device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of washing and protecting devices, and discloses an oral cavity cleaning device which comprises a device body, a switch assembly and a driving assembly. The driving component is arranged in the device body and can drive the device body to vibrate. The switch assembly comprises a movable assembly, a pressing assembly and a magnetic field induction module. The movable component is magnetic and can be rotatably arranged on the outer side of the device body. The pressing component is positioned on the inner side of the device body, and the movable component can be pressed against the pressing component through a part of the device body so as to control the start and stop of the driving component. The magnetic field induction module is arranged in the device body and is in non-contact with the movable assembly, so that the magnetic field information of the movable assembly can be received, the movable assembly can rotate relative to the magnetic field induction module, the magnetic field information received by the magnetic field induction module is changed, and the driving assembly can adjust the rotating speed according to the magnetic field information. The oral cavity cleaning device improves the waterproof performance on the basis of ensuring the control performance, and prevents the device body from being internally watered due to the fact that the position of the switch assembly is not tightly sealed.

title_en: Pulse generator and method for generating pulses
abstract_en: The application discloses a pulse generator and a method for generating pulses, and relates to the technical field of pulses, wherein the pulse generator comprises a parameter configuration module, a phase accumulator, a pulse generation module and a digital-to-analog converter; the parameter configuration module is used for acquiring pulse parameters when the pulse output mode is in, calculating the Frequency Tuning Word (FTW) value of each pulse according to the pulse parameters, writing the pulse parameters and the FTW value into the memory, the phase accumulator is used for performing accumulation operation according to the FTW value to obtain a phase value, generating a trigger instruction and sending the trigger instruction to the pulse generation module when the phase value reaches the maximum capacity, the pulse generation module is used for generating a digital signal according to the pulse parameters and the FTW value and sending the digital signal to the digital-to-analog converter, and the digital-to-analog converter is used for receiving the digital signal and converting the digital signal into an analog signal. The pulse generator can output a pulse sequence with controllable parameters, and generate pulse signals with different characteristics, so that the flexibility and operability of the test are improved.

title_en: Piezoelectric ceramic driving circuit and vibration reduction system
abstract_en: The application relates to a piezoelectric ceramic driving circuit and a vibration reduction system, which comprises a comparison circuit and a driving enhancement circuit, wherein the comparison circuit is configured to receive an input signal and a carrier signal, generate a pulse width modulation signal corresponding to the input signal by comparing the input signal with the carrier signal and transmit the pulse width modulation signal to the driving enhancement circuit, and the driving enhancement circuit is configured to receive a power supply signal and charge and discharge piezoelectric ceramic through the power supply signal and the pulse width modulation signal so as to realize that the driving enhancement circuit outputs a driving signal corresponding to the pulse width modulation signal to the piezoelectric ceramic.

title_en: System and method for signal segmentation
abstract_en: The present disclosure is directed to systems and methods for signal segmentation. Providing broadband output isolation. An apparatus includes a first output for a first radio frequency, RF, signal. The apparatus includes a second output for a second RF signal. The device includes a first transistor having a first source/drain. The device includes a second transistor having a first source/drain, wherein the first source/drain of the first transistor is coupled to the first source/drain of the second transistor, and wherein the first transistor and the second transistor are disposed between the first output and the second output.

title_en: Low-power-consumption high-reliability anti-radiation D trigger
abstract_en: The application relates to a radiation-resistant D trigger with low power consumption and high reliability. The anti-irradiation D trigger comprises a clock control input module, a data input module, a master-stage latch module, a slave-stage latch module and a data output module, wherein the clock control input module is used for providing clock signals, the data input module is used for converting input signals into differential inputs by adopting two mutually independent transmission paths with different delays, the master-stage latch module is used for processing the differential inputs by adopting a cross-coupled interlocking structure, the master-stage latch module is used for converting a master-stage output signal into a first differential signal, the slave-stage latch module is used for processing the first differential signal by adopting the cross-coupled interlocking structure, and the data output module is used for converting slave-stage output signals by adopting two mutually independent output transmission paths with different delays and outputting the latch signals by clock control. Differential signals are adopted as input in the master-stage latch module and the slave-stage latch module, so that the performance of the anti-SETs and the SEU is improved, meanwhile, a cross-coupling interlocking structure is adopted, the working speed and the working frequency are improved, and the power consumption is greatly reduced.

title_en: Semi-controlled device resonant DC load switch, control method and control device
abstract_en: The invention provides a half-control device resonant direct current load switch, a control method and a control device. The main branch is connected with a main oscillation branch and an energy absorption branch in parallel, and the auxiliary switch is connected with an auxiliary oscillation branch in parallel. The auxiliary oscillating branch is an LC oscillating circuit, and the control module is connected with the main switch, the auxiliary switch and the thyristors in the auxiliary oscillating branch. The invention establishes the turn-off condition through the main switch and the auxiliary switch matched with the semi-control device and then through the auxiliary oscillating circuit, has simple structure, low cost and higher reliability in the longer turn-on process, is suitable for breaking smaller current, does not need extra control measures, and thus balances low cost and high performance.

title_en: High-pass filter and radar receiver
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a high-pass filter and a radar receiver, which comprise a substrate and a metal heat dissipation layer, wherein the heat conductivity coefficient of the substrate is larger than a first preset value, the metal heat dissipation layer is arranged on one side surface of the substrate, and a grooved groove with a set shape is formed in the metal heat dissipation layer. According to the application, the substrate made of high heat conduction material is selected, the metal heat dissipation layer is added on one side of the substrate, and meanwhile, the heat dissipation is increased by utilizing the grooves on the metal heat dissipation layer, so that the technical problem that the filter in the radar receiver influences the accuracy of the signal received by the radar receiver due to poor heat dissipation in the prior art is solved, the heat dissipation capacity of the filter is increased, and the technical effect of the filtering performance of the filter is ensured.

title_en: Digital-to-analog converter, circuit arrangement, discriminator and photon counting system
abstract_en: A digital-to-analog converter (100, 100  1 ,……100 n ) DAC includes a coarse resistor string digital-to-analog conversion unit (121), a fine resistor string digital-to-analog conversion unit (122), and a combining unit (109), the coarse resistor string digital-to-analog conversion unit (121) for selectively outputting a 2  N  level analog voltage in response to high N-bit digital data, where N is a natural number greater than or equal to 2, the fine resistor string digital-to-analog conversion unit (122) for selectively outputting a 2  N  level analog voltage in response to low N-bit digital data, and the combining unit (109) for combining an output of the coarse resistor string digital-to-analog conversion unit (121) and an output of the fine resistor string digital-to-analog conversion unit (122). The combination unit (109) includes a capacitor (111). The output of the coarse resistor string digital-to-analog conversion unit (121) and the output of the fine resistor string digital-to-analog conversion unit (122) can be connected to a first terminal (137) of the capacitor (111).

title_en: Power efficient successive approximation analog-to-digital converter
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are systems and methods for a power efficient successive approximation analog-to-digital converter, SAR, ADC. In one aspect, the SAR ADC includes a sampling and digital-to-analog conversion DAC circuit to sample an input voltage. In one aspect, the SAR ADC includes a first comparator coupled to the DAC circuit, and a first set of storage circuits coupled between the first comparator and the DAC circuit. In one aspect, the SAR ADC includes a second comparator coupled to the DAC circuit, and a second set of storage circuits coupled between the second comparator and the DAC circuit. In one aspect, the SAR ADC includes control circuitry configured to select, for each of a plurality of bits corresponding to the input voltage, a corresponding comparator to determine a state of the each of the plurality of bits during a corresponding time period.

title_en: Compact high-power high-efficiency GaN power amplifier chip
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compact high-power high-efficiency GaN power amplifier chip, and belongs to the technical field of radio frequency and microwave integrated circuits. The two-stage cascade amplifying structure is adopted, and comprises an input end, an input matching network, a first-stage amplifying network, an interstage matching network, a second-stage amplifying network, an output matching network, an output end and a bias and stabilizing circuit. The interstage matching network sets the functions of successful division, grid bias feeding, stability design and interstage impedance matching, the output matching network integrates the functions of power synthesis, drain bias feeding and output impedance matching, and the second-stage amplifying network adopts a plurality of GaN dies to be connected in parallel. The chip size is obviously reduced by reducing the space of independent elements and wiring through function integration, the signal amplification link and the energy transmission path are optimized, the output power and the efficiency in a wide frequency band are improved, the stability and the reliability of the chip in a wide working frequency band are enhanced by combining a stabilizing circuit and a symmetrical layout design, and the requirements of a communication system on a high-integration-level high-performance power amplifier are met.

title_en: Power amplifier distortion compensation system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of audio amplification, and particularly discloses a power amplification distortion compensation system based on deep learning, which comprises an input signal acquisition module, a deep learning distortion identification module, an electronic tube simulation module, a distortion compensation module, a PWM generation and optimization module, a power amplification module and a feedback learning module; the system combines a deep learning algorithm and a multi-band dynamic characteristic extraction method to realize high-precision identification of complex nonlinear distortion types such as harmonic distortion, dynamic distortion and the like, compared with traditional frequency spectrum analysis or static filtering compensation, the system can dynamically adjust a compensation strategy, the influence of distortion on tone quality is obviously reduced, the natural tone and auditory texture of an audio signal are highly restored through a nonlinear even harmonic enhancement algorithm, intelligent restoration of signal distortion is realized through a GAN framework, a generator dynamically generates high-fidelity compensation signals, meanwhile, the characteristics of different distortion types are learned through a discriminator, and the restored signals are ensured to be close to a distortion-free target.

title_en: Resonator and narrow-band acoustic surface filter
abstract_en: The invention provides a resonator and a narrow-band acoustic surface filter, which relate to the technical field of filters, the resonator provided by the invention comprises a piezoelectric substrate, a transducer and reflecting grids, wherein the transducer and the reflecting grids are arranged on the piezoelectric substrate, the reflecting grids are positioned on two sides of the transducer, the transducer is provided with a plurality of groups of interdigital electrodes, each group of interdigital electrodes comprises a grounding electrode group and a terminal electrode group, the grounding electrode group comprises a plurality of first interdigital electrodes which are sequentially arranged at intervals and are used for grounding, and the terminal electrode group comprises a plurality of second interdigital electrodes which are sequentially arranged at intervals and are used for accessing electric signals. The resonator provided by the invention can effectively reduce the passband width of the filter without sacrificing the insertion loss, out-of-band rejection and rectangularity.

title_en: Balance type broadband phase reconfigurable phase shifter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a balanced broadband phase reconfigurable phase shifter, wherein two sides of ports of two U-shaped coupling microstrip lines are respectively and correspondingly connected with one end of one second microstrip line, the other end of each second microstrip line is respectively and correspondingly connected with one end of one first microstrip line, the upper end and the lower end of two third microstrip lines are respectively and correspondingly connected with the side edges of one first microstrip line, a pair of varactors are respectively and reversely connected between the ports of each U-shaped coupling microstrip line and the ground in series, an anode grounded varactor is reversely connected at the bottom of each U-shaped coupling microstrip line in series, a reconfigurable differential mode phase shift reference value relative to initial bias can be obtained by changing bias voltages of the six varactors, the electrical lengths of the two U-shaped coupling microstrip lines, the four second microstrip lines and the two third microstrip lines are used for adjusting differential mode phase slopes so as to realize broadband adjustable differential modes, and simultaneously, the four second microstrip lines and the two third microstrip lines are also used for adjusting differential mode impedance matching bandwidths.

title_en: Analog-to-digital conversion circuit based on VTC and TDC and oriented to RRAM memory integrated chip
abstract_en: The application relates to an analog-to-digital conversion circuit based on a VTC and a TDC for an RRAM integrated chip, which comprises a first comparator, a charge pump, a voltage-time converter and a time-to-digital converter, wherein the first comparator is used for comparing an input first voltage signal with a first reference signal to output a first digital signal, the charge pump is used for receiving the first digital signal as an enabling voltage, reducing the input first voltage signal under the enabling voltage and outputting a second voltage signal, the voltage-time converter is used for mapping the second voltage signal into a time domain signal, and the time-to-digital converter is used for mapping the time domain signal into a second digital signal and outputting the first digital signal and the second digital signal as a combination. The two-stage structure of the application enables the whole input voltage range to be folded once, optimizes the linear input interval and performance of the VTC under large input voltage by the charge pump and the self-bias low-voltage cascode current mirror, and realizes the time domain analog-to-digital conversion circuit with wide input range and high precision.

title_en: Semiconductor device with a semiconductor device having a plurality of semiconductor chips
abstract_en: A semiconductor device includes a first set of transistors and a second set of transistors. The first group of transistors includes a first terminal, a second terminal, a control terminal, and a base terminal, wherein the base terminal of the first group of transistors is floating. The second set of transistors includes a first terminal, a second terminal, a control terminal, and a base terminal, and the first terminal, the second terminal, and the control terminal of the second set of transistors are coupled to the first terminal, the second terminal, and the control terminal of the first set of transistors, respectively. The base terminals of the second set of transistors are selectively electrically connected or disconnected from the bias voltage terminals. The base terminals of the second set of transistors are electrically disconnected from the bias voltage terminal when the semiconductor device is in a steady state, and the base terminals of the second set of transistors are electrically connected to the bias voltage terminal when the semiconductor device is in a transient state.

title_en: Power module for lateral logging and use method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of petroleum well logging, and discloses a power module for lateral well logging and a use method thereof, wherein a rectifying and filtering circuit, an FPGA chip, a DA converter and a power amplifying circuit are integrated in a power processing board, and the board width is greatly reduced due to the use of a large-scale integrated circuit, thus realizing a high-integration power module, the FPGA chip realizes sine waveforms through digital waveforms and a D/A converter, simplifying the filtering circuit, A large-scale FPGA chip is used as a core to realize a series of logic functions such as digital waveform storage, serial port receiving, D/A control, gain control, state monitoring and the like, the waveform size is also controlled by the FPGA, and the latter controls the output of the D/A converter according to a gain command, so that the final output current meets the measurement requirement of the downhole instrument, and the power module has the characteristics of high precision, quick response, stable output, small volume, flexible arrangement and strong independence.

title_en: Filtering forming circuit applied to front-end reading system of radiation detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a filter forming circuit applied to a front-end reading system of a radiation detector, which solves the problem of low quality of an output waveform of the existing filter forming circuit, and specifically comprises a resistor R3, a capacitor C4 and the like, wherein one end of the resistor R3 is an input port Vin of the filter forming circuit, the other end of the resistor R3 is connected with one end of the capacitor C3, the other end of the capacitor C3 is connected with an inverting input end of a differential operational amplifier A2, the capacitor C4 is connected across the inverting input end and the output end of the differential operational amplifier A2, the output end of the differential operational amplifier A2 is an output port Vout of the filter forming circuit, the non-inverting input end of the output port is grounded or an external power supply VREF, the input port IN of an active high-resistance sub-circuit R4 is connected with the output end of the differential operational amplifier A2, the output port OUT of the active high-resistance sub-circuit is connected with one end of a zero-cancellation capacitor Cpz, the voltage bias port VB of the active power supply is grounded or connected with the external power supply, and the other end of the zero cancellation capacitor Cpz is connected with the inverting input end of the differential operational amplifier A2.

title_en: Dynamic device matching device and method suitable for high-precision digital-to-analog converter
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to the field of integrated circuit design technology, including dynamic device matching apparatus and methods suitable for high-precision digital-to-analog converters. The method comprises the steps of setting a pointer updating unit, receiving an input signal, determining the end position of the pointer according to the input signal and the start position of the pointer, connecting n DAC control units with the pointer updating unit respectively, storing the current sequence numbers of the DAC control units by the sequence storing unit, comparing the current sequence numbers with target sequence numbers indicated by the start position and the end position respectively by the comparing unit, determining the output signal of the DAC control unit based on the comparison result, updating the current sequence numbers based on the comparison result, and selecting after the DAC control unit is selected when the DAC control unit receives the input signal next time under the condition that the DAC control unit is selected this time, so that shaping capability can be improved, and hardware implementation complexity is reduced.

title_en: Filtering verification circuit and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a filtering checking circuit and electronic equipment, which are applied to the field of bus communication. The digital filter circuit comprises a digital filter circuit and a cyclic redundancy check circuit, wherein a first input end of the digital filter circuit is connected with a host through an integrated circuit bus, a second input end of the digital filter circuit is connected with an output end of the digital filter circuit, an input end of the cyclic redundancy check circuit is connected with an output end of the digital filter circuit, and an output end of the cyclic redundancy check circuit serves as an output end of the filter check circuit. The digital filter circuit can filter burrs of the transmission signals on the bus according to the input initial signals and the output filter signals. The cyclic redundancy check circuit can perform check analysis on the transmitted signals so as to judge whether the data signals have faults in the transmission process or not according to the check signals, and whether the data transmission is correct and complete or not.

title_en: Load modulation variable gain power amplifier based on coupling line
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wireless communication, relates to a variable gain power amplifier, and particularly provides a load modulation variable gain power amplifier based on a coupling line, which is used for improving the average efficiency of the power amplifier in a deep backspacing interval and realizing gain control. The load modulation variable gain power amplifier has the advantages of realizing the effect of impedance modulation by using the 90-degree coupling line, having wider bandwidth compared with the traditional lambda/4 transmission line structure, having smaller loss of the 90-degree coupling line and smaller influence on efficiency compared with the transformer structure, and having obvious advantages in a broadband high-efficiency system. Meanwhile, by utilizing the distributed characteristic of the coupled line, the model not only considers magnetic coupling, but also considers electric coupling, and the ideal model is closer to reality in the design process, so that multiple iterations are not needed, and the design is simplified.

title_en: Hybrid switch power amplifying circuit of high-power high-precision alternating current constant current source
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hybrid switch power amplifying circuit of a high-power high-precision alternating current constant current source, which belongs to the technical field of electronics, and comprises a load, a plurality of single-channel inner ring units, an outer ring unit and a control unit, and solves the technical problem that any one or a plurality of transformers are easy to saturate when the transformers are in parallel output transient heavy load, the invention can effectively solve the problem of saturation of a single transformer in time, can meet the needs of certain inductive and resistive loads of connecting wires in actual use, reliably and stably works, does not generate the phenomenon of oscillation of output current, optimizes transient output waveforms, can meet the needs (50 Hz-3.3 kHz) of certain bandwidth, and meets the needs of harmonic components in heavy current testing.

title_en: Phase shifter circuit capable of automatically adjusting phase shift direction and signal phase adjusting method
abstract_en: The application discloses a phase shifter circuit capable of automatically adjusting a phase shift direction and a signal phase adjusting method, wherein the phase shifter circuit comprises a power management module, a phase shift module and a phase shift direction control module; the phase shifting direction control module is used for receiving an external control signal, and switching the equivalent structure of the phase shifting module through a single-pole double-throw analog switch to realize dynamic switching of the advanced phase shifting or the delayed phase shifting state, and the equivalent structure of the single-pole double-throw analog switch is used for dynamically switching the phase shifting circuit to combine the cascade voltage reduction design of the power management circuit and the resistance-capacitance parameter adjustment of the phase shifting circuit, thereby realizing continuous controllable adjustment of the input signal within the full phase range of-180 DEG to 180 DEG, breaking through the defects of fixed direction and limited adjustment range of the traditional phase shifter, and remarkably improving the flexibility, the degree of automation and the precision of phase control.

title_en: Signal processing method, signal processing device, electronic apparatus, computer storage medium, and computer program product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a signal processing method, a signal processing device, electronic equipment, a computer storage medium and a computer program product. The signal processing method comprises the steps of obtaining an input signal value of at least one discrete time of a current discrete time and a period of time before the current discrete time and an output signal value of at least one discrete time of a period of time before the current discrete time, executing fitting processing on a plurality of signal values to be fitted in the input signal value of the at least one discrete time of the current discrete time and the period of time before the current discrete time and the output signal value of the at least one discrete time of the period of time before the current discrete time to obtain a predicted output signal value of the next discrete time, and executing up-sampling processing on the input signal value of the at least one discrete time of the current discrete time and the period of time before the current discrete time, the output signal value of the at least one discrete time of the period of time before the current discrete time and the output signal value of the predicted next discrete time to obtain a plurality of signal values to be sampled.

title_en: Constant on time generation circuit
abstract_en: The invention provides a constant on time generation circuit which comprises a first RS trigger I1, a comparison signal control circuit, a first comparison signal generation circuit, a second comparison signal generation circuit, a reset signal control circuit, a test auxiliary circuit and a selector I2, wherein a second end of the test auxiliary circuit is connected to a set end of the first RS trigger I1 through the selector I2, an output signal of the first RS trigger I1 is calibrated through the test auxiliary circuit and the reset signal control circuit, an output signal of a previous stage circuit is connected to the set end of the first RS trigger I1 through the selector I2, and input delay of the reset end of the first RS trigger I1 is eliminated through dynamic adjustment of the reset signal control circuit. According to the invention, the resistance and capacitance errors are calibrated by utilizing a foreground calibration mode, and the output delay of the calibration comparator is dynamically adjusted after the normal working mode is entered, so that the accurate control of the constant on time is realized, and the working frequency of the switching power supply is accurately controlled.

title_en: Receiving circuit and memory
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a receiving circuit and a memory, wherein the receiving circuit comprises a first buffer configured to receive a clock signal and a complementary clock signal and compare the clock signal with the complementary clock signal to output a first intermediate signal and a second intermediate signal, and a second buffer configured to receive the first intermediate signal and the second intermediate signal and amplify the voltage difference between the first intermediate signal and the second intermediate signal to output a first output signal and a second output signal, and the DC gain of the first buffer is smaller than the DC gain of the second buffer. Embodiments of the present disclosure are at least advantageous for improving duty cycle distortion of a clock signal.

title_en: Load driving circuit and electrical equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a load driving circuit and an electrical device, the load driving circuit comprises a comparison module, a first delay module, a second delay module and a switch module. The comparison module outputs a first comparison signal to the first delay module when the first voltage is larger than the reference voltage. The first delay module delays a first time length from the moment of receiving the first comparison signal and outputs the first delay signal at the moment of ending the first time length. The second delay module delays a second time length from the power-on time and outputs a second delay signal at the time when the second time length is ended, wherein the second time length is longer than the first time length. The switch module is used for keeping off if the second delay signal is not received, and conducting when the first delay signal is received if the second delay signal is received, so that the load is electrified. By the mode, the safety of driving load operation can be improved.

title_en: Method and device for manufacturing ER193 type double-differential comparator circuit
abstract_en: The invention provides a manufacturing method and a device of an ER193 type double-differential comparator circuit, which belong to the technical field of semiconductor manufacturing, and the manufacturing method of the ER193 type double-differential comparator circuit in the embodiment of the invention is realized by adjusting the isolation photoetching position of a wafer, the drift of the epitaxial layer is corrected in the upper isolation photoetching process, and even if the epitaxial layer drifts, the photoetching pattern can still be accurately formed on the wafer, so that the electrical performance of poor circuit function or inconsistent circuit function caused by alignment errors is avoided.

title_en: Obstacle sensing method and system based on laser radar data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an obstacle sensing method and system based on laser radar data analysis, which relates to the technical field of radar data analysis obstacles, and comprises the steps of using a multi-mode sensor to scan the surrounding environment to obtain sensor data, synchronously collecting the data of the multi-mode sensor for preprocessing, the method comprises the steps of obtaining an obstacle target from a camera image, integrating sensor data by using a data fusion algorithm, and extracting obstacle features by combining a local feature descriptor and a global feature description of the obstacle by using a segmentation threshold function based on density clustering to form a complete obstacle feature description. The laser radar can provide high-resolution distance data, so that the system can accurately identify and position obstacles in the surrounding environment, and the method can complete the scanning and analysis of the environment in a short time by combining algorithm processing, realize quick response to the obstacles in the dynamic environment, and greatly improve the accuracy and reliability of obstacle detection.

title_en: Bulk acoustic wave resonator, filter and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a bulk acoustic wave resonator, a filter and electronic equipment, wherein the bulk acoustic wave resonator comprises a substrate layer, a Bragg reflection layer arranged on the substrate layer and a piezoelectric transduction structure layer arranged on the Bragg reflection layer, the Bragg reflection layer comprises a plurality of stacked film layers, refractive indexes of two adjacent film layers are different, the piezoelectric transduction structure layer comprises a piezoelectric layer and an electrode layer which are stacked, at least one film layer, close to the piezoelectric transduction structure layer, in the Bragg reflection layer is a preset film layer, the preset film layer comprises a cavity part and a supporting part, the cavity part and the supporting part are alternately arranged in a first direction, and the first direction is parallel to the substrate layer. According to the application, the cavity part is used for concentrating the acoustic energy on the piezoelectric layer, so that the electromechanical coupling coefficient of the bulk acoustic wave resonator is increased, the slowness curve of the main vibration mode of the bulk acoustic wave resonator is flattened under the alternate arrangement of the cavity part and the supporting part, and the transverse mode and the spurious response are suppressed, so that the quality factor of the bulk acoustic wave resonator is improved.

title_en: Self-adaptive power amplifier nonlinear correction system based on independent framework
