abstract_en: The application provides a self-adaptive power amplifier nonlinear correction system based on an independent framework, which consists of a digital processing unit, an analog-to-digital converter and a first digital-to-analog converter, wherein a gating dynamic neural network is configured in the digital processing unit, the gating dynamic neural network consists of a gating network and a backbone network, a baseband signal in communication equipment forms an initial analog signal after passing through a second digital-to-analog converter of the communication equipment, the initial analog signal is converted into a digital signal through the analog-to-digital converter and is transmitted to the digital processing unit, the data processing is carried out through the gating network and the backbone network in the digital processing unit to form a corrected signal, and then the corrected signal is converted into a target analog signal through the first digital-to-analog converter and is transmitted to a power amplifier of the communication equipment. The application combines the gate control dynamic neural network, can realize high-efficiency, flexible and adaptive dynamic configuration, and can meet the requirement of an intelligent communication system on the power amplification performance.

title_en: Attenuation compensation method and system for signal transfer function in analog-to-digital converter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for attenuation compensation of a signal transfer function in an analog-to-digital converter, which relate to the technical field of analog-to-digital converter circuit design and signal processing, and comprise the steps of setting attenuation gain of an integrator, and carrying out pre-attenuation treatment on an analog signal in an analog domain of the integrator; and performing gain compensation on the digital code stream in a digital domain to construct a digital domain recovery path corresponding to the attenuation parameters of the analog domain. The invention avoids overload distortion, unstable modulator or uncontrolled modulation caused by exceeding the dynamic range of the quantizer by the signal peak value at the analog front end of the sigma delta analog-to-digital converter, improves the system stability, realizes high-precision analog-to-digital conversion of the controlled amplitude signal, sets the corresponding gain compensation factor according to the attenuation parameter of the analog domain, realizes the linear recovery processing of the low-amplitude digital signal and compensates the attenuation introduced by the analog domain.

title_en: Driving circuit, controller and vehicle
abstract_en: The application discloses a driving circuit, a controller and a vehicle, and relates to the technical field of electronic circuits. The driving circuit comprises a current sampling module, a latch module and a first control module, wherein a first output end of the current sampling module is connected with a first input end of the latch module, an output end of the latch module is connected with a first input end of the first control module, an output end of the first control module is connected with an enabling end of the driving module, the current sampling module is used for collecting a current value of an input current of a driving object of the driving module, when an input current flowing is determined, a first current passing notification signal is output through the first output end of the current sampling module, the latch module is used for outputting a second current passing notification signal to the first control module when the first current passing notification signal is received, the second current passing notification signal is a latch signal aiming at the first current passing notification signal, and the first control module is used for controlling the driving module to stop enabling when the second current passing notification signal is received.

title_en: High-voltage grid protection circuit and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic circuits and discloses a high-voltage grid protection circuit and a device, wherein the high-voltage grid protection circuit comprises a high-voltage driving circuit, the high-voltage driving circuit comprises a high-voltage PMOS tube and a high-voltage NMOS tube, and further comprises a switch and a grid protection circuit which are arranged at the input end of the high-voltage driving circuit, the grid protection circuit comprises a resistor and a plurality of MOS tubes, the resistor and the MOS tubes are connected in series to form a self-bias structure, the grid protection circuit is respectively connected with the grid and the output end of the high-voltage driving circuit, and when the voltage is suddenly changed, the grid voltage of the high-voltage PMOS tube is pulled up. Through the equivalent replacement zener diode that high voltage MOS pipe and resistance combine, protect the drive circuit output stage of P pipe through the mode of self-bias on the structure, can clamp the grid voltage to suitable voltage rapidly when overvoltage takes place, optimize the grid protection function to, saved the chip area simultaneously, reduced the MASK quantity of chip, reduced the cost.

title_en: Isolation device with inductive and capacitive isolation circuits
abstract_en: The invention discloses an isolation device with inductive and capacitive isolation circuits. An isolation circuit device may include an isolation barrier and may be configured to receive one or more input signals on a low voltage side and deliver one or more output signals on a high voltage side. The isolation barrier may include a first capacitor disposed along the first input line, a second capacitor disposed along the second input line and electrically in parallel with the first capacitor, and a first inductor having a first end coupled to a first electrode of the first capacitor and having a second end coupled to a first electrode of the second capacitor. The isolation barrier may further comprise a center tap connected to the first inductor and a second inductor inductively coupled to the first inductor, and arranged with the first output and the second output on the high voltage side of the isolation circuit arrangement.

title_en: Silicon carbide MOSFET gate driving circuit, circuit module and equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a silicon carbide MOSFET gate driving circuit, a circuit module and equipment in the technical field of electronic circuits, which comprises a single-channel driving circuit, a quick turn-on circuit, an on oscillation regulating circuit, a quick turn-off circuit, a DUT device and a traditional SiC MOSFET device, wherein the quick turn-on circuit is electrically connected with the output end of the single-channel driving circuit, the on oscillation regulating circuit is electrically connected with the output end of the single-channel driving circuit and is also connected with the output end of the single-channel driving circuit in parallel, the on oscillation regulating circuit is also electrically connected with the quick turn-off circuit, and the DUT device is electrically connected with the quick turn-on circuit, the on oscillation regulating circuit, the quick turn-off circuit and the turn-off oscillation regulating circuit, so that the problems that the traditional SiC MOSFET device cannot be balanced between the switching speed and the switching oscillation and the control is complex are solved.

title_en: Multi-frequency high-precision piezoelectric MEMS oscillator and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-frequency high-precision piezoelectric MEMS oscillator and a preparation method thereof, wherein the multi-frequency high-precision piezoelectric MEMS oscillator comprises a substrate layer, a device layer, an oxidation layer, a piezoelectric layer and an electrode layer which are sequentially stacked, the substrate layer is provided with a partial cavity, the device layer comprises a patterned cantilever beam arm structure, an oxidation layer is arranged in a preset support area of the cantilever beam arm structure, the piezoelectric layer is arranged on a part of cantilever beams of the cantilever beam arm structure and a part of the oxidation layer, the electrode layer is arranged on a part of the oxidation layer and a part of the piezoelectric layer, and the electrode layer comprises an electrically isolated modulation electrode and a signal reading electrode. The embodiment of the invention can improve the precision and realize the multi-frequency output, and can be widely applied to the technical field of electronic devices.

title_en: Voltage-controlled oscillator, chip and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a voltage-controlled oscillator, an oscillator circuit, a chip and electronic equipment, relates to the technical field of communication or radar detection, and can improve the linearity of the voltage-controlled oscillator. The voltage controlled oscillator comprises a voltage controlled oscillator resonant cavity, an even harmonic generator circuit and a self-mixing tripler circuit. The voltage-controlled oscillator resonant cavity comprises a voltage-transformation diode array and a primary mode switching capacitor. The even harmonic generator circuit comprises a set of cross-coupled tubes, one end of which is electrically connected to the differential two ends of the voltage controlled oscillator, and simultaneously serves as an even harmonic generator and is electrically connected to the self-mixing tripler circuit. The self-mixing tripler circuit comprises a differential unit and a resonant cavity, and one end of the self-mixing tripler circuit is electrically connected with the even harmonic generator circuit. The low-frequency voltage-controlled oscillator and the self-mixing frequency tripler circuit realize current multiplexing, and the even harmonic generator circuit is used as an even harmonic generator of the self-mixing frequency tripler besides the negative resistance of the oscillator, so that the linearity of the millimeter wave frequency source is improved.

title_en: Sectional piezoelectric ceramic bias voltage control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sectional piezoelectric ceramic bias voltage control method, which belongs to the technical field of electromagnetic compatibility of power electronic equipment, and comprises the steps of calculating initial resonance frequency of a single piezoelectric ceramic under the condition of no voltage bias according to acquired piezoelectric ceramic data, calculating theoretical resonance frequency after bias voltage is applied according to the initial resonance frequency and bias voltage which is applied in the vibration direction of a plurality of groups of piezoelectric ceramics in advance, correcting inverse piezoelectric effect caused by the bias voltage and strain coupling between adjacent piezoelectric ceramics by FEM simulation and experiments by the plurality of groups of piezoelectric ceramics, comparing and verifying the theoretical resonance frequency with actual measurement resonance frequency after the bias voltage is added, and outputting a control completion signal.

title_en: Front-end chip of highly integrated V-band broadband multichannel multimode detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a front-end chip of a highly integrated V-band broadband multi-channel multi-mode detector, which belongs to the field of millimeter wave integrated circuits and comprises a phase-locked loop module PLL, a radio frequency local oscillator chain module LO, a dual-transmitting channel module TX, a dual-receiving channel module RX, a pulse time sequence control module and an SPI configuration interface module. The invention solves the problems of difficult generation of broadband signals, serious multi-channel phase mismatch, complex and low-efficiency multi-mode system and difficult compromise of the speed and the power consumption of a transmitting link existing in the conventional V-band detector chip.

title_en: Meter reading board and meter reading board control method based on RF MESH communication technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication, in particular to a meter reading board and a meter reading board control method based on an RF MESH communication technology, which stably provides a first direct current voltage and a second direct current voltage required by a level conversion unit through a special power conversion unit, so that the level-shifting unit can perform accurate and reliable level matching of the digital signal transmitted between the ammeter connector and the RF MESH unit based on the two specific voltages. The problem that logic level is incompatible possibly exists between the ammeter interface circuit and the RF Mesh communication module is effectively solved, signal distortion, transmission errors or device damage caused by level mismatch are avoided, and therefore the overall working efficiency and the data transmission quality of the meter reading board are improved. Meanwhile, meter reading can be automatically realized through the meter reading board provided by the invention, and the labor cost is reduced.

title_en: Signal gain regulating circuit and microwave signal receiving device
abstract_en: The invention provides a signal gain regulating circuit and a microwave signal receiving device, which are provided with a signal sampling unit for receiving an external carrier signal, a signal demodulation unit for demodulating the external carrier signal, extracting a baseband signal, and a gain control unit for conditioning the external carrier signal so that the level fluctuation range of the external carrier signal meets the demodulation requirement. When the level fluctuation of the external carrier signal exceeds the threshold range, the signal demodulation unit outputs a gain regulation signal to the gain regulation unit, the gain regulation unit carries out attenuation processing on the external carrier signal acquired by the signal sampling unit, the signal sampling unit transmits the processed stable external carrier signal to the signal demodulation unit, and the signal demodulation unit outputs a stable baseband signal after demodulation processing. According to the invention, the external carrier signal can be demodulated into the baseband signal with stable level fluctuation, and the signal gain regulating circuit has the advantages of simplified structure and high stability.

title_en: Piezoelectric device, preparation method thereof and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a piezoelectric device, a preparation method thereof and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of piezoelectric devices. The piezoelectric device includes a substrate, a transducer, and plated interconnect lines. The substrate comprises a base layer and a film layer, the base layer comprises a first area and a second area, the film layer covers the first area, orthographic projection on a reference plane is positioned outside orthographic projection of the second area on the reference plane, and the reference plane is a plane where the length direction and the width direction of the substrate are positioned. The plated interconnection line includes a first plated interconnection line portion covering the second region and a second plated interconnection line portion covering a surface of the thin film layer. Thus, the reliability of the piezoelectric device can be improved, and the piezoelectric device does not fail.

title_en: Key module and detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a key module and a detection method, wherein the key module comprises a base support, a feedback module arranged in the base support, a key assembly erected on the base support and a sensor module fixed on the key assembly, the sensor module comprises a spring plate, a pressing block arranged on the spring plate and at least two sensors, the pressing block is positioned above the feedback module, the sensors are used for detecting pressing parameters of the key assembly so that an external control system triggers corresponding key functions according to the pressing parameters, and the feedback module is used for providing vibration feedback for the key assembly according to preset parameters or the pressing parameters. By utilizing the invention, vibration feedback in the key process can be realized, the assembly is convenient and fast, the vibration sense is uniform, and the failure is not easy.

title_en: Detection decoding method, system, equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a detection decoding method, a system, equipment and a computer readable storage medium, which are applied to the technical field of random computation and comprise the steps of inputting external data into a detector, obtaining an output logarithmic domain random sequence through operation results of symbol nodes and observation nodes in the detector, converting the logarithmic domain random sequence output by the detector into a first probability domain random sequence, decoding based on the first probability domain random sequence as input of a decoder, updating symbol node information of the detector by utilizing a second probability domain random sequence returned by the decoder based on the first probability domain random sequence when decoding fails, and carrying out iterative operation again on the detector with updated symbol node information. The application can directly input the random sequence of the logarithmic domain output by the detector into the random sequence of the probability domain, and the decoder directly returns the random sequence of the probability domain, thereby reducing the computational complexity of the detector and the decoder and simultaneously reducing the delay of detection and decoding.

title_en: Automatic gain control device, echo removing device, automatic gain control method, and automatic gain control program
abstract_en: The processing load of the arithmetic device can be reduced and appropriate gain control can be performed. The device is provided with a frequency domain conversion unit which converts a1 st input signal into a2 nd input signal in the frequency domain, wherein the 1 st input signal is a time domain reference signal which is input from a receiving side signal path for transmitting a receiving signal to a speaker of a terminal in a1 st time period, a gain determination unit which calculates a1 st gain based on the 2 nd input signal, and a gain multiplication unit which is provided in the receiving side signal path and multiplies the 1 st gain by the receiving signal. The reference signal is a signal obtained by multiplying the reception signal by the 1 st gain by the gain multiplying unit.

title_en: Signal processing method based on band-pass filter
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of signal processing, in particular to a signal processing method based on a band-pass filter. The invention iteratively updates the upper and lower cut-off frequencies of the band-pass filter, and uses the updated band-pass filter to process sporadic short packet signals. After receiving the sporadic short packet signal, the minimum value of the average peak power ratio of the signal is used as a target, and the upper and lower cut-off frequencies of the band-pass filter are continuously updated until the optimal band-pass filter is obtained. The original sporadic short packet signal is then processed with an optimal bandpass filter to obtain a final estimate of the symbol rate contained in the sporadic short packet signal. Because the upper and lower cut-off frequencies of the band-pass filter are related to noise which can be filtered by the band-pass filter, when the average peak power ratio obtains the minimum value, the corresponding optimal band-pass filter can optimally filter noise around the symbol, so that the optimal band-pass filter can eliminate interference of the noise to accurately identify the symbol of the sporadic short packet signal, and further the estimation accuracy of the symbol rate is improved.

title_en: Gate driver and power device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power semiconductors, and discloses a grid driver and a power device, wherein the grid driver is connected to a power tube and comprises a comparator, a pull-down switching tube, a first path and a second path, the source electrode of the pull-down switching tube is grounded, the drain electrode of the pull-down switching tube is connected to the grid electrode of the power tube, the first path is provided with an inverter and an MOS tube and is suitable for responding to a high-level signal, the first path provides charging current for the grid electrode of the pull-down switching tube through the inverter and the MOS tube, the second path is provided with the MOS tube and a diode, and part of charges stored on the grid electrode of the power tube are directly transferred to the grid electrode of the pull-down switching tube through the second path. Therefore, the grid driver controls the grid of the pull-down switching tube and realizes charge transfer based on the first path and the second path, so that the rapid pull-down of the grid voltage is realized on the premise of not increasing static power consumption.

title_en: VCD file compression method based on functional relation, value prediction and bit plane recombination
abstract_en: The invention discloses a VCD file compression method based on functional relation, value prediction and bit plane recombination, and belongs to the field of file compression. The invention improves the compression efficiency by respectively designing the compression strategies for different parts of the head information area, the node information area, the numerical value change area and the like of the VCD file. Meanwhile, the compression rate is remarkably improved by analyzing the functional relation among signals in a numerical value change area and combining the technologies of variable length coding, signal value prediction, bit plane recombination and the like.

title_en: IDRSN-based denoising auxiliary decoding method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a IDRSN-based denoising auxiliary decoding method. The invention relates to the technical field of communication and deep networks, and solves the problem of noise reduction of a receiving end by using a deep neural network in a complex communication environment. The method comprises the steps of superposition of an original signal and noise, log likelihood ratio calculation, SC decoding, residual calculation, improvement of depth residual shrinkage network processing and noise removal of the signal, wherein the invention IDRSN integrates a depth residual network, a Inception module, an attention mechanism and a new threshold function, through the algorithm, the network can effectively estimate the received signal noise in a channel noise environment, accurately distinguish the signal from the noise and extract useful characteristics, thereby enabling a predicted result to be closer to a real channel gain, reducing interference of the noise on information data, and then combining a traditional algorithm to decode, so that the decoding performance can be effectively improved, and a more efficient decoding process is realized.

title_en: TIADC sampling time mismatch error estimation and calibration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a TIADC sampling time mismatch error estimation and calibration method, and belongs to the technical field of high-speed data acquisition and real-time transmission. The method realizes high-precision time error estimation by improving a mode of combining first order statistics and LMS self-adaptive filtering, adopts a parallel Farrow fractional delay filter based on Lagrange interpolation to carry out dynamic correction, utilizes the difference value and derivative information of sub-ADC sampling signals and ideal signals in an error estimation stage, calculates a time mismatch initial estimated value by improving the first order statistics, adopts an LMS algorithm to iteratively optimize the estimated value, realizes dynamic error tracking, inputs the optimized error parameters into the improved parallel Farrow filter, and generates K sub-filter groups through a multiphase decomposition structure. The invention obviously improves the spurious-free dynamic range and the effective bit number of the TIADC system, and is suitable for high-frequency signal acquisition scenes such as 5G communication, radar and the like.

title_en: Impedance matching method, system, terminal and medium of MPCVD equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of microwave impedance matching, and discloses an impedance matching method, a system, a terminal and a medium of MPCVD equipment, wherein the impedance matching method of the MPCVD equipment comprises the steps of obtaining initial reflected power when the MPCVD equipment works; if the initial reflected power is larger than a preset threshold value, the positions of the three pins are adjusted for multiple times to obtain current reflected power data of the MPCVD equipment, target reflected power is determined according to the current reflected power data, wherein the target reflected power is smaller than the preset threshold value, and the three pins are adjusted to target positions according to the target reflected power to complete impedance matching of the MPCVD equipment. The application can realize the aim of high-precision impedance matching.

title_en: Full differential peak detection AGC circuit
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of feedback type automatic gain control circuits, and discloses a full-differential peak detection AGC circuit, which comprises: a multistage variable gain amplifier, a buffer amplifier group, a first comparator EA1, a full differential peak detection unit, and an external port; the external port comprises a power supply end VDD, a ground end GND, a negative signal input end INN, a positive signal input end INP, a positive signal output end VON, a negative signal output end VOP, a plurality of bias ports and a reference voltage end VREF; the application adopts a fully differential structure design, can effectively inhibit common mode noise and external interference, and the fully differential peak detection unit realizes continuous discharge adjustment of the capacitor C11 through alternate discharge of the first NMOS tube NM1 and the second NMOS tube NM2 on the capacitor C11, so that the problem of capacitor discharge interruption in traditional peak detection is avoided, the loop response speed and the gain adjustment precision are improved, and even if one path of signal in differential signals is temporarily lost, the other path of signal can still drive the peak detection unit and the feedback loop to work, and the reliability is improved.

title_en: Ultra-wideband frequency doubling circuit with dual-port output
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ultra-wideband frequency doubling circuit with dual-port output, which belongs to the technical field of millimeter waves and terahertz waves, and adopts an unbalanced circuit topology structure, and comprises a signal input waveguide and an input transition structure, a fundamental wave low-pass filter, a frequency multiplier kernel, a third harmonic output transition structure and an output waveguide, a third harmonic suppression filter, a second harmonic output transition structure and an output waveguide, a direct current bias filter and a direct current feed structure which are sequentially connected. The invention can output the second harmonic and the third harmonic simultaneously under the condition of one input signal, improves the signal utilization rate, does not need to design a plurality of frequency doubling circuits, has the advantages of simple structure and low cost, can control the frequency continuity of the second harmonic and the third harmonic by adjusting the bandwidth of the fundamental wave signal input to the signal input waveguide and the input transition structure, further realizes the output of the ultra-wideband terahertz signal, and provides a new idea for obtaining the ultra-wideband terahertz source.

title_en: Resonator, filter and radio frequency front-end module
abstract_en: The application is suitable for the technical field of radio frequency filtering, and discloses a resonator, a filter and a radio frequency front end module, wherein the resonator comprises a piezoelectric substrate and an interdigital transducer arranged on the piezoelectric substrate, the interdigital transducer comprises at least two bus bars, the at least two bus bars are arranged on the piezoelectric substrate along a first direction, the bus bars are respectively and electrically connected with a plurality of electrode fingers, the electrode fingers between every two adjacent bus bars are alternately and alternately arranged in sequence along a second direction to form an intersection area and a gap area, the electrode fingers comprise a main body part and a connecting part positioned between the main body part and the bus bars, the main body part is positioned in the intersection area, the connecting part is positioned in the gap area and connected with one bus bar, the main body part comprises a plurality of main body parts, in the same electrode finger, the main body parts are sequentially connected along the first direction, and an included angle between every two adjacent main body parts is an obtuse angle. The embodiment can effectively control the value of the electromechanical coupling coefficient of the resonator so as to better adapt to the design requirement of the surface acoustic wave filter.

title_en: Trade data management method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a trade data management method and system, belonging to the field of data management, the method comprises binary converting the preprocessed trade data in the acquired segmented data set to obtain binary converted data, and generating a binary group by using any four binary numbers in sequence, generating a replacement template by using the binary group with the largest number as a standard, and then replacing the original preprocessed trade data to generate replacement data. According to the trade data management method and system provided by the application, binary data are grouped according to four bits, the statistics high-frequency group is used as a replacement template, data compression is realized through repeated counting or binary inversion and decimal conversion, the compression efficiency is improved, the occupation of storage space can be reduced, the transmission bandwidth requirement is reduced for trade data containing a large number of repeated binary modes, meanwhile, adaptive data are screened based on the capacity average value of storage nodes, and the resource waste of large-node small-data is avoided.

title_en: Clock frequency deviation detector with closed loop calibration
abstract_en: An apparatus (100) includes a switched capacitor (110) configured to generate a switched capacitor voltage (Vcap) based on an input clock signal (fin) and a current (Idac), a current digital-to-analog converter (105) configured to generate a current based on a first digital signal (Din), a first reference voltage generator (115) configured to generate a first reference voltage (Vref), and a first voltage comparison device (120) configured to generate a first frequency deviation detection signal (Dcm) based on a comparison of the switched capacitor voltage and the first reference voltage.

title_en: Electronic circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electronic circuit, which comprises an output circuit and a first switch transistor. The output circuit comprises at least one first output transistor. The at least one first output transistor comprises a control end, a first end and a second end. The first switch transistor comprises a control end, a first end and a second end. The at least one first output transistor and the first switch transistor are complementary transistors. The first end of the first switch transistor is coupled with the control end of the at least one first output transistor. In a specific time, the first switch transistor is in a closed state, and the control end of the at least one first output transistor is in a floating state.

title_en: High-low pressure mixed interface module, flexible plasma patch and wound surface treatment device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical devices, and provides a high-low voltage mixed interface module, a flexible plasma patch and a wound surface treatment device, wherein the high-low voltage mixed interface module comprises at least four layers of flexible circuit boards, each layer of flexible circuit board sequentially comprises a weak current signal transmission layer, a weak current signal transmission circuit and a power supply controller, wherein the weak current signal transmission circuit is suitable for being connected with an electrode assembly; the first reference stratum covers the surface of the weak current signal transmission layer and is used for providing weak current signal ground potential reference, the second reference stratum is arranged at intervals with the first reference stratum, pulse power wires are distributed on the high-voltage signal transmission layer and connected to discharge points of the electrode assembly from the power supply controller and used for transmitting high-voltage pulses. The invention solves the problem that weak signal detection and instantaneous high-voltage treatment circuit integration in the wound surface treatment device are difficult, and avoids interference of high-voltage microsecond pulse output on weak current signals in a transmission line from a power supply controller to an electrode assembly in the wound surface treatment device.

title_en: Comparator circuit module layout structure
abstract_en: A comparator circuit module layout structure relates to the technical field of integrated circuits and comprises two matching resistor arrays arranged at the upper left corner and the lower left corner in the whole layout structure, a matching capacitor array arranged between the two matching resistor arrays, a PDRIVER area formed by PMOS (P-channel metal oxide semiconductor) and a NDRIVER area formed by NMOS (N-channel metal oxide semiconductor) and a BIAS BIAS circuit area which are arranged on the right side of the matching resistor arrays and the right side of the matching capacitor array in sequence from left to right, wherein the two matching resistor arrays are connected with the matching capacitor array, and the matching capacitor array, the PDRIVER area, the NDRIVER area and the BIAS BIAS circuit area are sequentially connected. The resistor and capacitor parts of the layout structure are separated from the MOS tube more conveniently and more conveniently, devices and parasitic influences on the MOS tube are less, the flow direction of the whole signal is smoother, and the comparator achieves better performance and signal anti-interference performance.

title_en: Injection locking frequency multiplier circuit with oscillator
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of integrated circuits and discloses an injection locking frequency multiplier circuit with an oscillator, which comprises a differential mode resonant cavity, a first harmonic generation circuit and a second harmonic generation circuit, wherein the differential mode resonant cavity is used for generating a fundamental wave signal and a third harmonic signal; the device comprises a first oscillator unit, an injection unit, a second oscillator unit and a fourth-order resonant cavity, wherein the first oscillator unit is connected with a differential mode resonant cavity and used for providing negative resistance, the injection unit is connected with the differential mode resonant cavity and used for converting fundamental wave signals and third harmonic signals into third harmonic components, the second oscillator unit is used for providing negative resistance, and the fourth-order resonant cavity is connected with the second oscillator unit and the injection unit and used for coupling and outputting the third harmonic components. According to the invention, the fundamental wave signal generated by the differential mode resonant cavity is subjected to frequency multiplication output through the injection unit, the third harmonic wave signal is directly enhanced and output, and the third harmonic wave component output through the injection unit is coupled and output through the fourth-order resonant cavity, so that the phase noise of the frequency multiplier is reduced, the energy efficiency of the frequency multiplier is improved, and the requirement of millimeter wave high-speed wireless communication on the local oscillation performance can be met.

title_en: System and method for heat fade compensation for power amplifiers
abstract_en: Systems and methods for heat fade compensation for power amplifiers are disclosed. In one aspect, a current mirror is added that mirrors the current in the transistors used in the power amplifier. The mirror elements are embedded within the space occupied by the transistors used in the power amplifier. Based on the positioning, temperature variations occurring in the transistors used in the power amplifier are almost instantaneously experienced by the mirror elements. Thus, temperature-based performance variations are also experienced in these mirror elements. The mirror elements then provide an output signal that can be used to adjust the input signal or bias signal provided to the transistors in the power amplifier. This adjustment effectively enhances the signal amplified by the transistors in the power amplifier to counteract heat-induced degradation that would otherwise reduce the amplification provided by the power amplifier.

title_en: Pulse generating circuit for Serdes transmitter
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of integrated circuits and discloses a pulse generating circuit for a Serdes transmitter, which comprises a single pulse generating module, a current mode driving module and a pseudo-static selector, wherein the single pulse generating module comprises a first transistor, a second transistor, a third transistor, a fourth transistor, a fifth transistor, a seventh transistor, a sixth transistor, a seventh transistor, a third transistor, a fourth transistor, a fifth transistor, a seventh transistor, a grid electrode, a bias voltage, a source electrode and a full-swing single pulse signal, the grid electrode of the fifth transistor is connected with a lifting voltage, the grid electrode of the seventh transistor is connected with an output end of the single pulse generating module, the drain electrode of the fifth transistor is connected with the drain electrode of the seventh transistor and the full-swing single pulse signal is output, the current mode driving module comprises an eighth transistor, the grid electrodes of the eighth transistor and the ninth transistor are respectively connected with an output end of the pseudo-static selector, and the grid electrode of the eighth transistor is connected with a bias voltage, and the source electrode of the driving current is output. The application can improve the pulse establishment speed and reduce the complexity and cost of the driving module circuit.

title_en: Space evaluation method and system based on multidimensional sensing information
abstract_en: The application relates to a space evaluation method and a space evaluation system based on multidimensional sensing information, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multidimensional sensing data, wherein the multidimensional sensing data comprises building space data, behavior data, positioning data, physical environment indexes and investigation data, carrying out space-time unification on the multidimensional sensing data, carrying out data denoising and missing value processing to obtain a first data set, calculating a core evaluation index according to a preset index base through the first data set, wherein the core evaluation index comprises a line sensing index, a behavior sensing index, a subjective psychological index and the physical environment index, constructing a neural network evaluation model, and predicting satisfaction of a space to be tested after training through the core evaluation index. By adopting the technical scheme, the time efficiency and reliability of evaluation can be improved by intelligently acquiring multidimensional data, determining indexes based on behaviors and using a neural network model, and a precise basis is provided for space optimization.

title_en: Nonvolatile radio frequency switch chip for 5G radio frequency front end
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-volatile radio frequency switch chip oriented to a 5G radio frequency front end, which is characterized in that an input port, an input transmission line, a ReRAM core region MIM unit group, an output transmission line and an output port are sequentially and electrically connected, and the periphery of the input transmission line, the ReRAM core region MIM unit group and the output transmission line is annularly surrounded. The RAM core MIM unit is of a sandwich structure of three layers, namely a bottom electrode layer, a dielectric layer and a top electrode layer from bottom to top, wherein the bottom electrode and the top electrode are not electrically connected and are completely isolated by the middle dielectric layer. According to the invention, n ReRAM core MIM units are arranged in the same direction and equidistantly to form a ReRAM core MIM unit group, so that the on-resistance of a switch is reduced, the insertion loss is obviously reduced, and a graded ground wire coplanar waveguide transmission line is introduced to reduce the gap capacitance effect, thereby improving the isolation degree and improving the high-frequency impedance matching.

title_en: Radio frequency switching device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a radio frequency switch device, which relates to the technical field of semiconductors and aims at the technical problems of reduced package size and reduced performance of the radio frequency switch device, wherein the radio frequency switch device comprises an active area and a grid structure which are arranged along a first direction, the grid structure comprises a plurality of first grid structures which are arranged along a second direction and a plurality of second grid structures which are arranged along a third direction, a first end of each second grid structure is aligned with a first grid structure, a first grid structure of which the second end is positioned at the tail is far away from the outer side of the first grid structure, and the first direction, the second direction and the third direction are intersected in pairs. Thus, the rf switching device meets the product of reduced package size without a reduction in on-resistance.

title_en: Calibration system and calibration method for high-speed digital-to-analog converter
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of integrated circuits and discloses a calibration system and a calibration method of a high-speed digital-to-analog converter. The system comprises a transmitting end circuit, a digital-to-analog converter, an analog-to-digital converter and a calibration circuit, wherein the analog-to-digital converter is connected with a reference clock generation circuit, the digital-to-analog converter comprises a plurality of sub digital-to-analog converter units, and the sampling relation between the output of the digital-to-analog converter and the analog-to-digital converter and the data signal is determined according to the period of the data signal output by the transmitting end circuit, the number of the sub digital-to-analog converter units and the period of the reference clock. The calibration circuit determines the serial number of the data signal corresponding to the output data of the analog-to-digital converter and the serial number of the corresponding sub digital-to-analog converter unit according to the determined sub digital-to-analog converter unit of the first output data and the sampling relation, and calculates and outputs an error control word of each sub digital-to-analog converter unit. The application can obtain the data sequence points and the points of 0.5UI between the sequences by complete sampling, has high calibration precision, and realizes the compensation of the phase delay and the pulse width error of the digital-to-analog converter.

title_en: Successive approximation type analog-to-digital conversion device based on composite dielectric gate and working method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a successive approximation type analog-digital conversion device based on a composite dielectric gate and a working method thereof, belonging to the technical field of semiconductor devices, analog-digital conversion and memory calculation. The device is divided into coupling units with different areas according to binary values, the control of each weight coupling unit is realized through binary weights, large MIM capacitors and complex metal switch trees are not needed, the area consumption is reduced, the physical on-off characteristics of semiconductors are utilized, whether a read-out transistor is conducted or not is used as a comparison result, the gradual comparison between a partition area and an input quantity is realized, the comparison circuit logic of a circuit level is avoided, the remarkable reduction of the power consumption of a quantization unit is realized, in addition, the device provided by the invention is simple in structure, can be expanded in parallel according to the row or column direction according to the actual situation, mismatch is eliminated through code table compensation, the device can be used as the front end of an on-chip ADC, and can be embedded into a pixel/memory unit to serve as a local quantizer, and has stronger universality.

title_en: Decoder correction based on object-based context
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and machine-readable media for utilizing context information to create decoding feedback information to improve decoder accuracy and/or performance are disclosed in some examples. In some examples, the context information is from a layer of the network stack above a layer at which the decoder is located. The context information may be or be based on information about previously received and decoded data and/or information about the sender to provide decoding feedback information to the decoder for both correcting previous decoding errors and informing the decoder about which of a plurality of decoding choices is more likely to be correct. This may improve decoding performance by reducing errors and, in some examples, reduce complexity of selection and thus improve decoder efficiency by excluding certain decoding possibilities.

title_en: Capacitive touch detection circuit and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sensors, and discloses a capacitive touch detection circuit and a capacitive touch detection method, wherein the capacitive touch detection circuit comprises a charge compensation module, a voltage-current conversion module, an integration capacitor, a quantization circuit module and a counter; the touch control circuit comprises a voltage-current conversion module, an integration capacitor, a quantization circuit module and a counter, wherein the voltage-current conversion module is used for converting residual charges on the touch control capacitor after the compensation of the charge compensation module into currents and outputting the currents, the integration capacitor is used for integrating the currents to obtain integrated voltages, the quantization circuit module is used for quantizing the integrated voltages and controlling the integrated voltages to be stabilized in a preset voltage range of the reference voltage, and the counter is used for counting the output of the quantization circuit module to obtain digital codes representing the touch control capacitance. The invention can realize the touch detection performance with high linearity, low power consumption, small area and high noise immunity.

title_en: Sparse GRU-based power self-adaptive digital predistortion method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: A power self-adaptive digital predistortion method, system, equipment and medium based on sparse GRU comprises the steps of collecting input and output signals under different powers, constructing a composite feature vector through amplitude normalization and phase alignment, generating a predistortion training target through indirect learning, constructing a sparse GRU neural network, introducing L1 regularization constraint, obtaining a sparse predistortion model through combined optimization of mean square error and the sparse constraint, realizing partial weight updating based on power grading, weighting and fusion output during power interval switching to complete power self-adaptive optimization, and deploying the sparse GRU model after pruning and compressing in a predistortion module to compensate nonlinearity of a power amplifier.

title_en: Short wave power amplifying device with dynamically adjusted power supply
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short wave power amplifying device with a power supply dynamically adjusted, which comprises a power supply adjusting module, a radio frequency power amplifying module and a monitoring module, and is characterized in that a direct current power supply is directly supplied to the radio frequency power amplifying module in a mode 1, the device is suitable for amplifying constant envelope signals in the radar and communication countermeasure fields, the radio frequency power amplifying module is enabled to work in a state close to saturation to obtain higher efficiency, a mode 2 is used for tracking a control signal waveform to generate dynamically-changed power supply voltage, the device is suitable for amplifying amplitude modulation communication signals with a certain peak-to-average power ratio, the radio frequency power amplifying module is enabled to have higher efficiency under any instantaneous output amplitude through matching with the power supply voltage with the envelope change, and a mode 3 is used for obtaining whether the power amplifying module works in the full amplitude by adopting a sensor for detecting the load state of a power tube and adjusting the power supply voltage to cope with efficiency deterioration caused by underload of the power tube under the severe load condition. Through the mode, the efficiency of the radio frequency power amplifier under different application signal waveforms and severe load conditions is improved.

title_en: Semiconductor structure for improving power capacity of acoustic surface filter
abstract_en: The application discloses a semiconductor structure for improving the power capacity of an acoustic surface filter, which comprises a first resonator and a first wire PAD, a second resonator and a second wire PAD, wherein the first resonator and the first wire PAD are arranged in a first area, the first resonator and the first wire PAD are electrically connected, the second resonator and the second wire PAD are arranged in a second area, the second resonator and the second wire PAD are electrically connected, a third resonator and a third wire PAD are arranged in a third area, the third resonator and the third wire PAD are electrically connected, a heat conducting channel covers an electric isolation area, at least part of the first wire PAD is covered by the heat conducting channel, at least part of the second wire PAD is covered by the heat conducting channel, at least part of the third wire PAD is covered by the heat conducting channel, and an insulating medium material is adopted by the heat conducting channel. The heat of the high Wen Xiezhen device can be timely transferred to the low Wen Xiezhen device or the PAD region through the heat conduction channel, the high Wen Xiezhen device is prevented from being burnt, and the power capacity is improved.

title_en: Dynamic frequency scanning method based on radio frequency power supply pulse mode and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic frequency scanning method and related equipment based on a radio frequency power supply pulse mode, and relates to the technical field of radio frequency power supplies. The method comprises the steps of obtaining initial control parameters, monitoring an operation mode of the radio frequency power supply in real time, iteratively adjusting the output frequency of the radio frequency power supply based on a dynamically adjusted frequency step when the radio frequency power supply is in a pulse mode so as to determine the optimal frequency for enabling the radio frequency power supply to achieve impedance matching and enabling the reflection coefficient to be minimum, and controlling the radio frequency power supply to operate at the optimal frequency. The method aims to solve the problems that in the prior art, in a pulse mode of a radio frequency power supply, the traditional impedance matching method is difficult to adapt quickly due to dynamic change of load impedance, so that the power transmission efficiency is affected, the reflected power and the energy consumption are increased, the scanning can be completed quickly and stably, the impedance matching and the low reflected power are realized, and the accuracy of radio frequency plasma excitation is improved.

title_en: Preliminary syndrome calculation
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to preliminary syndrome computation. One or more syndromes can be initially calculated using at least a portion of the codeword and a portion of the parity check matrix. The preliminary computed syndrome can be used to determine where to route the codeword among a plurality of decoders tailored to various and/or different objectives, such as efficiency characteristics, reliability characteristics, etc. of the decoding scheme.

title_en: High-order digital decimation filter with variable decimation multiple and filtering method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-order digital decimation filter with variable decimation multiple, which comprises a cascade comb filter, wherein the cascade comb filter is used for downsampling and anti-aliasing filtering, filtering high-frequency components to obtain low-frequency density signals, the output end of the cascade comb filter is connected with a compensation filter for compensating passband attenuation and performing double decimation on the signals, and the output end of the compensation filter is connected with a half-band filter for realizing third-level signal decimation. The invention also discloses a filtering method of the high-order digital decimation filter with variable decimation multiples. Aiming at the defects of high hardware requirement, complex design, high filter order, difficult realization and the like of the traditional single-stage FIR filter, the invention aims at the defect of the CIC filter in the pass band flatness, compensates by using the CFIR compensation filter, and finally realizes the realization by using the half-band filter for frequency reduction.

title_en: Multi-scene self-adaptive intelligent audio amplifier based on AI (advanced technology attachment) and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to an AI-based multi-scene self-adaptive intelligent audio amplifier, which comprises a first audio amplifying module, a power limiting module, a gain control module, a second audio amplifying module, a feedback circuit and an AI processing unit, wherein the first audio amplifying module, the gain control module, the second audio amplifying module and the AI processing unit are sequentially connected, the first audio amplifying module is also connected with the power limiting module, the feedback circuit and the AI processing unit, the power limiting module is also connected with the second audio amplifying module, the feedback circuit and the AI processing unit, the gain control module is also connected with the feedback circuit and the AI processing unit, and the second audio amplifying module is also connected with the power limiting module and the feedback circuit. The invention further provides electronic equipment. The invention can meet the requirements of users on high tone quality and multi-scene adaptability.

title_en: Differential input dynamic latching comparator applied to PIPELINE ADC
abstract_en: The invention claims a dynamic latching comparator applied to a differential input of PIPELINE ADC, which comprises a pre-amplifier circuit, a latch circuit, a signal transmission switch, a reset switch and a clock generation circuit. The pre-amplifier circuit is used for comparing an input voltage with a reference voltage and amplifying the obtained result. The latch circuit is used for latching the output result of the pre-amplifier. The signal transmission switch is used for controlling the transmission of signals inside the latch comparator. The reset switch is used for resetting the latch and the output port. The clock generation circuit is used for generating a clock signal for controlling the comparator.

title_en: Heating element temperature measuring circuit and method of atomization equipment and atomization equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heating element temperature measuring circuit and method of atomization equipment and the atomization equipment, wherein the heating element temperature measuring circuit comprises a first switch module, a constant current source generating module, a second switch module, a third switch module and a control module, the control module controls the first switch module and the third switch module to be conducted, when the second switch module is controlled to be turned off, the voltage at one end of the heating module is collected, constant current is obtained, and the resistance value of the heating module is calculated according to the voltage at one end of the heating module and the constant current.

title_en: Ultra-wideband high-linearity power amplifier with negative feedback structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-wideband high-linearity power amplifier with a negative feedback structure, which comprises an input matching network, a driving stage amplifying circuit, an interstage matching network, a power stage amplifying circuit, an output matching network, a negative feedback RLC network and a self-adaptive bias circuit, wherein an input radio frequency signal is subjected to primary amplification by the input matching network to the driving stage amplifying circuit, is subjected to secondary amplification by the interstage matching network to the power stage amplifying circuit, is output by the output matching network, the driving stage amplifying circuit comprises a first transistor and a second transistor, the power stage amplifying circuit comprises a third transistor and a fourth transistor, the self-adaptive bias circuit is used for providing self-adaptive bias voltages for the first transistor and the third transistor, and the negative feedback RLC network is used for controlling the gain and bandwidth of the amplifier and comprises the driving stage negative feedback network and the power stage negative feedback network. The invention can widen the working bandwidth of the power amplifier and improve the gain, output power and linearity of the amplifier.

title_en: Double-node flip self-recovery nonvolatile latch and chip based on MTJ
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of integrated circuits, in particular to a double-node flip self-recovery nonvolatile latch based on an MTJ (magnetic tunnel junction) and a corresponding radiation-resistant memory chip thereof. The nonvolatile latch comprises an anti-irradiation latch circuit, a read-write circuit and a backup recovery circuit, wherein the anti-irradiation latch circuit comprises a plurality of groups of storage nodes which are mutually redundant and are reinforced, at least one group of main storage nodes which are reinforced by non-polarity, and the rest are redundant storage nodes. The read-write circuit is used for executing data read-write task for the irradiation resisting latch circuit. The backup-restore circuit includes a base portion and a duplicate portion. The basic part is used for completing data backup through two magnetic tunnel junctions and is used for restoring the main storage node. The duplication part comprises a plurality of NMOS tubes and is used for restoring the redundant storage nodes. The invention improves the SNU or DNU resistance of the circuit, optimizes the power consumption and the speed of the circuit, and solves the problem of unbalanced performance of the traditional circuit.

title_en: Resonator filter structure based on supporting structure, filter and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of circuits, in particular to a resonator filter structure based on a supporting structure, a filter and electronic equipment. The resonator filter structure based on the supporting structure comprises a substrate and a circuit structure integrated on one side of the substrate, wherein the substrate comprises a resonator area and a capacitor area, the resonator area is provided with the resonator circuit structure, the capacitor area is provided with the capacitor structure, an acoustic mirror in the resonator circuit structure and a capacitor medium layer of the capacitor structure are air, one electrode layer of the capacitor structure is connected with one electrode layer of the resonator circuit structure and is formed after being deposited through the same deposition process and subjected to patterning treatment, the resonator circuit structure comprises at least one resonance unit, and the resonator filter structure based on the supporting structure further comprises a supporting structure for supporting an upper electrode layer of the capacitor unit in the capacitor structure.

title_en: Space-time data encoding and decoding method for three-dimensional space
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space-time data encoding and decoding method of a three-dimensional space, which comprises the steps of S1, preprocessing multi-source data, S2, aligning space-time data, S3, modeling space-time tensors, S4, performing self-adaptive encoding and decoding on the space-time tensor data, wherein the multi-source sensor is used for collecting the data of the three-dimensional space and comprises space data, three-dimensional traffic network data and attribute data, S2, aligning the space-time data, S3, performing self-adaptive encoding and modular hierarchical encoding on the space-time tensor data, S4, performing self-adaptive encoding and decoding on the space-time tensor data, S5, performing self-adaptive quantization on the space-time tensor data, and performing independent operation structures of a plurality of layers and modules based on the space-time data, S6, and performing structural processing on the self-adaptive encoding and modular hierarchical encoding on the space-time tensor data to obtain the structural result of space-time data encoding of the three-dimensional space.

title_en: System and method for implementing dual-core voltage controlled oscillator
abstract_en: The present disclosure describes systems and methods for implementing a dual core voltage controlled oscillator VCO. The dual core VCO may include a transformer structure having a planar circular geometry. The transformer structure may be divided into a first half and a second half. Each half of the transformer structure may include a first end and a second end. The dual core VCO may include a first core and a second core. The first core may be coupled with the first end of the first half and the first end of the second half. The second core may be coupled with the second end of the first half and the second end of the second half. The transformer structure may be configured to reduce an effective inductance of the dual-core VCO by a first threshold while maintaining an impedance within a second threshold.

title_en: Method for forming surface acoustic wave resonator
abstract_en: A method for forming a surface acoustic wave resonator comprises the steps of providing a piezoelectric layer, forming an electrode material layer on the piezoelectric layer, forming an amorphous silicon layer on the electrode material layer, wherein the thickness of the amorphous silicon layer is smaller than 300 angstroms, forming a photoresist layer on the amorphous silicon layer, exposing and developing the photoresist layer to form a patterned layer, exposing part of the surface of the amorphous silicon layer, and etching the amorphous silicon layer and the electrode material layer by taking the patterned layer as a mask until the surface of the piezoelectric layer is exposed, wherein an interdigital transducer is formed on the piezoelectric layer, and the interdigital transducer comprises a plurality of interdigital electrodes arranged along a first direction. The interdigital electrode formed by the method has good size uniformity and appearance.

title_en: Control device with visual indicator
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a control device having a visual indicator. A control device configured to control the amount of power delivered to an electrical load may provide feedback regarding the amount of power delivered to the electrical load. The control device may include a visual indicator illuminated by a plurality of light sources. The control device may include control circuitry configured to determine the amount of power delivered to the electrical load and control the light source to illuminate a portion of the visual indicator to indicate the amount of power being delivered. Different sections of the illuminated portion of the visual indicator may be illuminated to different intensity levels and the intensity levels may be adjusted between different operating states.

title_en: Data receiver circuit including loop-unwrapped phase decision feedback equalizer with duty cycle control
abstract_en: A data signal receiver circuit includes a comparator configured to generate a first data signal based on a comparison of an input data signal and a reference voltage, wherein the first data signal includes a first logic low pulse and a first logic high pulse, and a duty cycle control circuit configured to generate a second data signal based on the first data signal, wherein the second data signal includes a second logic low pulse responsive to the first logic low pulse, wherein the second logic low pulse has a width greater than a Unit Interval (UI), and generate a third data signal based on the first data signal, wherein the third data signal includes a second logic high pulse responsive to the first logic high pulse, wherein the second logic high pulse has a width greater than the UI.

title_en: BUCK converter and slope generating circuit therein
abstract_en: The invention discloses a BUCK converter and a slope generating circuit thereof, comprising a basic slope generating unit, a first current extraction branch circuit, a second current extraction branch circuit and a third switch tube, wherein the first current extraction branch circuit comprises a second current source and is used for extracting the current of the first current source when a system has a large duty ratio, the second current extraction branch circuit comprises a first current comparator, an RC buffer unit, a buffer and the third switch tube, the first current comparator is used for comparing the current of the first current source and the second current source, the output end of the first current comparator is connected with the input end of the RC buffer unit, the output end of the RC buffer unit is connected with the input end of the buffer, the output end of the buffer is connected with the grid electrode of the third switch tube, and the drain electrode of the third switch tube is connected with the basic slope generating unit and is used for extracting the current of the first current source. The invention can avoid the output signal of the BUCK system from generating larger ripple waves and improve the stability.

title_en: Intelligent management method and system for power amplifier
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of power electronics, and provides an intelligent management method and system of a power amplifier, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining output voltage and current of the power amplifier and determining real-time load impedance; the junction temperature of the power amplifier is predicted according to a coupled thermal model that relates effective thermal resistance to load mismatch, and stability compensation parameters for maintaining operational stability and predistortion parameters for compensating nonlinear distortion are cooperatively determined and adjusted based on the predicted junction temperature and real-time load impedance. Through collaborative intelligent management, the safety and reliability can be improved, the performance maximization is realized, and the full-working-condition high-fidelity is ensured.

title_en: Two-way voltage comparison circuit
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of circuit design, in particular to a two-way voltage comparison circuit which comprises a voltage acquisition module and a photoelectric coupler, wherein the voltage acquisition module comprises a first diode and a second diode, the isolation comparison circuit comprises a light-emitting diode and an isolation triode, the anode of the first diode is connected with the output end of a first power supply, the cathode of the first diode is connected with the cathode of the light-emitting diode, the anode of the second diode is connected with the output end of a second power supply, the cathode of the second diode is connected with the anode of the light-emitting diode, the isolation triode is used for receiving an optical signal emitted by the light-emitting diode after being electrified, and the isolation triode is conducted when receiving the optical signal. The application is suitable for circuits with high comparison voltage values, and can ensure the detection precision and simplify and integrate the two voltage comparison circuits.

title_en: Symmetrical solid support micro-beam electric power sensing device based on MEMS resonator
abstract_en: The invention provides a symmetrical solid support micro-beam electric power sensing device based on an MEMS resonator, and belongs to the technical field of micro-electromechanical system sensing. The sensing device includes a sensing assembly. The sensing assembly includes a vibrating beam, an excitation electrode, a tuning electrode, and an auxiliary electrode. The vibration beam is connected with auxiliary electrodes along the two ends of the axial direction of the vibration beam, the excitation electrodes and the tuning electrodes are arranged at intervals along the length direction of the vibration beam, and the excitation electrodes and the tuning electrodes are arranged on the same side of the vibration beam. The excitation electrode is applied with an excitation voltage so that the excitation electrode can excite the vibration beam to generate resonance. The tuning electrode is applied with tuning voltage, so that the tuning electrode can adjust the rigidity of the vibration beam according to the ambient temperature to invert the thermal power corresponding to the heat source. The two sensing assemblies are arranged in a central symmetry mode, so that interference of electrostatic fields generated by the excitation electrodes and the tuning electrodes corresponding to different vibration beams can be weakened mutually. The invention can realize high-precision power inversion in a wide temperature range.

title_en: Radio frequency amplifier with multiple power control loops
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a radio frequency amplifier having multiple power control loops. A wireless circuit may include a radio frequency amplifier configured to operate in a plurality of different modes, configurations, or bias settings, a power detector coupled to an output of the radio frequency amplifier, a plurality of power integrators, and a switching circuit having an input configured to receive a measured power level from the power detector and having an output coupled to the plurality of power integrators. The switching circuit may have a switching state that is adjusted based on a current mode, configuration, or bias setting for the radio frequency amplifier. The power integrator may be part of a plurality of power control loops. The power control loop may be coupled to additional switching circuitry that is activated based at least in part on the current mode, configuration, or bias setting and a subsequent mode, configuration, or bias setting for the radio frequency amplifier.

title_en: Operational amplifier
abstract_en: The invention discloses an operational amplifier which comprises an input and conversion unit and a gain and driving unit, wherein the input and conversion unit is used for receiving a differential input signal and converting the differential input signal into a single-ended signal with dynamic compensation current, and the gain and driving unit is used for decomposing the single-ended signal into complementary signals and independently amplifying the complementary signals to obtain an amplified signal with push-pull driving capability. The invention breaks through the speed limit and improves the response speed of the operational amplifier while maintaining the core advantages of high impedance and low noise.

title_en: Low-power consumption high-speed comparator
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of analog integrated circuit design, in particular to a low-power-consumption high-speed comparator which is composed of a cascade preamplifier and a latch, wherein the preamplifier comprises a positive output end fp and a negative output end fn, the latch comprises a positive output end out+ and a negative output end Out-, one ends of the fn and fp are discharged to the ground, the other ends of the fn and fp are charged to VDD, the working state of the low-power-consumption high-speed comparator comprises a reset stage and a comparison stage, the reset stage fn and fp are charged to VDD, the out+ and the Out-are discharged to the ground, the drain electrode of Mt2, the source electrode of M15 and the drain electrode of Mt3, and the source electrode of M16 are reset to the ground, the comparison stage fn and fp are discharged from VDD, and the out+ and the Out-respectively output digital signals to complete comparison, and the comparator designed by the application has the characteristics of high resolution, no need of high-precision time sequence input and high comparison speed.

title_en: Method for re-local decoding of code modulation system by adopting constant weight shaper
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for re-local decoding of a code modulation system by adopting a constant weight shaper, belonging to the technical field of information theory and coding. The method comprises the steps of in a low density parity check LDPC code modulation system adopting a constant weight shaper CCDM, after original minimum and MS algorithm decoding fails, performing double expansion on CNs connected with unsatisfied check nodes UCNs and variable nodes VNs corresponding to unreliable bits in CCDM code words based on the connection relation of Tanner graphs of the LDPC codes, selecting VNs connected with the CNs through double expansion, utilizing candidates VNs to locally correct values of corresponding positions in original confidence vectors, generating a candidate input information vector list, and performing re-decoding on vectors in the list one by one to obtain a decoding output result. The method can reduce the error platform of the LDPC code in the code modulation system, reduce error diffusion in the inverse forming process of the system and improve the transmission reliability of the LDPC code modulation system while not remarkably increasing the computational complexity.

title_en: Magnetic stimulation two-way treatment head control circuit and control method
abstract_en: The magnetic stimulation double-way treatment head control circuit comprises an MCU, wherein one end of an energy storage capacitor C1 is connected with two paths of treatment head control circuits, each treatment head control circuit comprises a forward thyristor and a reverse thyristor which are connected in parallel, the forward thyristor is connected with a forward thyristor driving and feedback circuit, the reverse thyristor is connected with a reverse thyristor driving circuit, and the control method of the magnetic stimulation double-way treatment head is controlled by adopting the control circuit. The invention only needs one high-voltage power supply and one group of energy storage capacitors to realize the treatment of two treatment heads, thereby saving cost and space.

title_en: Chromatographic column box unit and optimization method
abstract_en: The application discloses a chromatographic column box unit and an optimization method, and belongs to the technical field of chromatographic detection. The application provides a chromatographic column box unit which comprises a data acquisition board, a signal isolation unit, a power isolation unit, a precision amplifying circuit and a high-precision ADC acquisition module, wherein the signal isolation unit is used for blocking interference of a digital circuit, the power isolation unit is used for providing independent pure power supply, the precision amplifying circuit is composed of an instrument amplifier and a high-stability reference voltage source, and the high-precision ADC acquisition module is used for adopting a sigma-delta technology. The data processing system further comprises a microprocessor in the data acquisition board executing an optimized Kalman filtering algorithm, and performing real-time low-delay denoising processing on the data output by the ADC acquisition module.
