The application systematically suppresses digital, power supply and random noise through the collaborative design of hardware physical isolation and software algorithm optimization, and remarkably reduces baseline noise, thereby realizing high-sensitivity and high-precision detection of low-concentration (less than or equal to 1 mu L/L) gas and improving the anti-interference capability and stability of the system.

title_en: Method for locating instant power consumption through current analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of current analysis and discloses a method for positioning instant power consumption through current analysis, which comprises the steps of collecting a voltage value of a DUT terminal through a data collector, converting the voltage value into current data through AD conversion built in the data collector, and transmitting the current data to a PC terminal through a USB data line; the method comprises the steps of processing collected current data based on a real-time current measurement method to obtain instant current fluctuation of WIFI in different time periods, judging target current with larger instant current mutation of the WIFI in the system operation through the instant current fluctuation, quickly finding out a problem device with the instant maximum power consumption of the system according to the target current with larger instant current mutation, marking the problem device and carrying out problem processing. The invention avoids the problems of missed sampling or redundancy of the traditional fixed parameters, reduces the distortion of statistical values, ensures the usability of data and improves the quality of data.

title_en: Method for realizing information frequency conversion and distribution based on superconducting frequency comb coherent injection locking phenomenon
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing information frequency conversion and distribution based on a superconducting frequency comb coherent injection locking phenomenon. The superconducting microwave frequency comb coherent injection locking phenomenon is utilized to simultaneously generate a plurality of amplitude modulation, frequency modulation or phase modulation signals with different carrier frequencies and identical modulation signals from one amplitude modulation, frequency modulation or phase modulation signal. The method can receive information in a wide microwave frequency band, synchronously convert the information to a plurality of frequencies in real time, and realize frequency conversion and distribution of the information with extremely low power consumption at low temperature. Compared with the frequency mixing scheme, the frequency mixing method does not need to add external local oscillation signals, and is favorable for high integration at low temperature. The invention is suitable for information frequency conversion of a plurality of narrow frequency bands with larger frequency span, has certain frequency selectivity, and the applicable frequency band can be precisely controlled by using superconductive microwave frequency combs with different fundamental frequencies. The information can be simultaneously distributed to a plurality of different frequency bands and used for real-time synchronous transmission of information among a plurality of different working frequency band systems.

title_en: Circuit for realizing multi-mode output of ADC (analog to digital converter)
abstract_en: The invention provides a circuit for realizing multi-mode output of an ADC (analog to digital converter), which comprises a sampling sub-circuit, a time-division multiplexing circulating sub-circuit, a digital processing sub-circuit and a digital processing sub-circuit, wherein the sampling sub-circuit is used for collecting electric data signals of a plurality of ports, the time-division multiplexing circulating sub-circuit is used for sequentially and circularly obtaining input signals from the electric data, the ADC is used for converting the input signals into digital signals, the digital processing sub-circuit is used for processing the digital signals according to a set output mode to obtain a calculated value, and comparing the calculated value with a target configuration value and then outputting PWM waves corresponding to the output mode.

title_en: Current source type high-frequency driving circuit and driving method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power electronic circuits, and discloses a current source type high-frequency driving circuit and a driving method, wherein the driving method corresponds to the current source type high-frequency driving circuit. The application realizes the rapid switching of the power switch tube to reduce the switching loss, and can recover the gate energy dissipated in the traditional driver to reduce the driving loss, the boosting function reduces the on-resistance of the power switch tube and the conduction loss, the bipolar gate voltage reduces the switching tube false-on phenomenon caused by crosstalk, the driving negative pressure eliminates the current transfer phenomenon existing in the traditional current type driving to a certain extent under the high-frequency low-power working condition, the bidirectional switch thoroughly eliminates the current transfer under the high-frequency high-power working condition, the driving capability is further improved, the high-current rapid driving is realized, the calculation of the duty ratio inhibits the overshoot of the driving voltage in the dead time, and the stable driving operation is ensured.

title_en: Zero drift operational amplifier applied to TEC controller
abstract_en: The invention discloses a zero drift operational amplifier applied to a TEC controller, which comprises a detuning circuit and a main body amplifier circuit, wherein a first output end of the detuning circuit is connected with a first input end of the main body amplifier, and a second output end of the detuning circuit is connected with a second input end of the main body amplifier. The invention adopts a method combining a self-zeroing technology and a chopping technology to enable the offset voltage of the operational amplifier to be as low as 1uV and the temperature drift to be as low as 10 nV/degree C, in addition, the invention not only eliminates 1/f flicker noise of a low frequency band, but also enables the noise substrate of a high frequency band to be very low and flat, and makes up for the short plate of the traditional offset eliminating means.

title_en: DAC output voltage control method, system, equipment and medium based on step delay
abstract_en: The invention discloses a DAC output voltage control method, a DAC output voltage control system, DAC output voltage control equipment and a DAC output voltage control medium based on step delay. The method comprises the following steps of obtaining the current output voltage of the DAC as an initial voltage value, receiving target voltage values and set values of target slope parameters, wherein the target slope parameters comprise target step length and target delay, and controlling the initial voltage value to be changed into the target voltage value step by step according to the target slope parameters. The invention is realized without depending on a hardware circuit, and the DAC can change the output voltage according to the set slope parameter by a software implementation process, so that the requirements of the DAC on the slope of the output voltage under different scenes can be used. According to the invention, the target slope parameter and the target voltage value can be changed at any time in the DAC output voltage regulation process, the DAC output voltage is controlled to be changed into a new target voltage value according to the new slope parameter, and no error exists in the software operation process. The invention is easy to modify and migrate and has higher universality.

title_en: Data compression method, device, equipment, medium and product for power grid cloud platform
abstract_en: The application relates to a data compression method, device, equipment, medium and product for a power grid cloud platform. The method comprises the steps of performing data conversion processing on acquired operation data of a power grid cloud platform to obtain long integer data, performing logarithmic iterative compression processing on the long integer data, acquiring iterative data when an iterative process is terminated, performing parameter combination processing on the basis of the iterative data, a preset scale factor and a preset operation precision parameter to obtain metadata, wherein the metadata is used for lossless restoration of the operation data, and performing secondary encoding processing on the metadata to obtain compressed code streams. The compression rate can be improved by adopting the method.

title_en: Hadamard-LDPC iterative decoding method based on interference suppression
abstract_en: The invention provides a Hadamard-LDPC iterative decoding method based on interference suppression, and belongs to the technical field of wireless communication. The method comprises the steps of initializing Hadamard check nodes and decoder variable nodes according to log likelihood ratio LLR values, iterating by utilizing variable node decoders and Hadamard check node decoders, estimating impulse interference power information, calculating impulse interference power variance, carrying out weighted updating on channel receiving information LLR values by utilizing the impulse interference power variance, obtaining updated decoder variable node posterior LLR values, decoding judgment, judging whether the maximum iteration times are met, continuing iterating if the maximum iteration times are not met, judging according to symbols of the updated decoder variable node posterior LLR values if the maximum iteration times are met, and finally outputting judgment results. The invention suppresses the confidence of the interfered bit in the iterative decoding process by the real-time cognition of the interference power of each bit and the updating of the channel information, reduces the influence of the interference on the decoding performance, and improves the anti-interference capability and the decoding performance of the system.

title_en: On-chip ultra-wideband balun circuit based on coupling line
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of circuits, and particularly relates to an on-chip ultra-wideband balun circuit based on a coupling line, which comprises a monolithic integrated circuit realized by adopting a GaAs process, wherein the bottom of the monolithic integrated circuit is grounded and is provided with a GaAs substrate with the thickness of 100 mu M, and two metal layers, namely a first metal layer M1 and a second metal layer M2, are arranged above the GaAs substrate. The invention provides a stable on-chip integration foundation for a circuit by means of a GaAs monolithic integrated circuit process, a 100 mu M substrate and an M1/M2 metal layer, and combines processing feasibility and cost control, and the parallel coupling line and the 75 omega transmission line both adopt a winding structure, thereby greatly reducing the occupied area of the circuit and adapting the demand of on-chip integration for compactness.

title_en: Event-driven analog signal pulse coding device and analog signal processing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an analog signal pulse coding device and an analog signal processing method based on event driving, wherein the device comprises a signal conditioning module, a threshold comparison module, an event triggering module and a pulse coding module, wherein the signal conditioning module comprises at least one conditioning unit, the conditioning unit is used for receiving analog signals and performing signal front-end analog conditioning, and then outputting analog conditioning signals, the threshold comparison module is connected with the signal conditioning module and is used for performing threshold detection on the analog conditioning signals according to a set threshold and then outputting threshold comparison signals, the event triggering module is connected with the threshold comparison module and is used for triggering pulse event signals corresponding to the analog conditioning signals according to the threshold comparison signals, and the pulse coding module is connected with the event triggering module and is used for converting the pulse event signals into pulse coding signals in a pulse coding mode. According to the invention, by introducing the threshold comparison module and the event triggering module at the front end of the device, invalid sampling can be effectively avoided, a large amount of redundant data can be reduced, and power consumption, communication, storage pressure and burden can be reduced.

title_en: Multi-parameter configurable saturated power amplifier modulation circuit, system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-parameter configurable saturated power amplifier modulation circuit, a system and a method, which relate to the technical field of radar communication and comprise a D/A conversion module, a subtraction/multiplication operational amplification circuit, an operational amplification circuit, a switch protection circuit, a pulse modulation circuit and a pulse modulation circuit, wherein the D/A conversion module is used for outputting voltage, the input end of the subtraction/multiplication operational amplification circuit is connected with the output end of the D/A conversion module, the inverting input end of the subtraction/multiplication operational amplification circuit is connected with the output end of the operational amplification circuit, the output end of the subtraction/multiplication operational amplification circuit is connected with a public port of the switch protection circuit, and the output end of the switch protection circuit is connected with the input end of the pulse modulation circuit. The invention can modulate according to pulse width, voltage, waveform form, rising rate and falling rate, accurately generate required specific pulse signals, realize output waveform diversification, simultaneously remarkably reduce device cost and has outstanding technical and economic values.

title_en: Bidirectional switching device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a bidirectional switching device. The bidirectional switching device comprises a control node, a first load node, a second load node, a main substrate, a main transistor and a substrate potential modulation circuit, wherein the main transistor is a bidirectional conduction transistor and comprises a first grid electrode terminal, a first main electrode terminal, a second main electrode terminal and a first main substrate terminal, the first grid electrode terminal is connected to the control node, the first main electrode terminal is connected to the first load node, the second main electrode terminal is connected to the second load node, the first main substrate terminal is connected to the main substrate, and the substrate potential modulation circuit regulates the substrate potential of the bidirectional switching device to be consistent with the lower voltage of the voltages of the first main electrode terminal and the second main electrode terminal according to signals in the first main electrode terminal and the second main electrode terminal. Therefore, potential floating of the main substrate can be effectively restrained, and stability and performance consistency of the device are improved.

title_en: Single-channel multi-frequency signal digital synthesis method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a single-channel multi-frequency signal digital synthesis method and a system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining parameter sets of a plurality of target signals in real time, carrying out frequency sweep on each target signal, respectively obtaining a plurality of tuning control words of a carrier signal and a modulation signal corresponding to the target signals according to the parameter sets of the target signals in the frequency sweep process, obtaining pulse count values according to the frequency of a reference clock and the triggering time, synthesizing all the target signals according to all the plurality of tuning control words to obtain single-channel multi-frequency modulated signals, converting the single-channel multi-frequency modulated signals into single-channel multi-frequency analog signals through a digital-to-analog converter, and carrying out post-processing on the single-channel multi-frequency analog signals to obtain post-processed single-channel multi-frequency analog signals, wherein the post-processed single-channel multi-frequency analog signals are finally output signals. The invention realizes the method of completing the multi-frequency signal synthesis in a single channel without an external combiner, so as to simplify the system structure, reduce the power consumption and improve the signal quality.

title_en: Active elimination type filtering method and related device for cross interference of charging modules
abstract_en: The application discloses an active elimination type filtering method and a related device for cross interference of a charging module, which are used for improving the electromagnetic compatibility and stability of a charging system and reducing the influence of the cross interference. The method comprises the steps of monitoring an output frequency spectrum of a charging module, decoupling the frequency spectrum to obtain interference frequency and interference intensity, constructing a digital twin model based on the interference frequency and the interference intensity, extracting working state characteristics of a target module, analyzing the working state characteristics and an expected coupling path to obtain a coupling intensity coefficient, generating an expected coupling interference signal generated by the target module according to the digital twin model, generating an anti-vector signal according to the expected coupling interference signal, injecting the anti-vector signal into a pulse width modulation carrier wave of the target module to generate an actual driving signal, monitoring a residual interference frequency spectrum output by the target module, calculating a deviation value between the residual interference frequency spectrum and a preset threshold value, and updating parasitic parameters and the anti-vector signal of the digital twin model according to the deviation value.

title_en: Analog-to-digital converter, chip and electronic device
abstract_en: The invention provides an analog-to-digital converter, a chip and electronic equipment, wherein the analog-to-digital converter is further added with a double-sided sampling circuit on the basis of an original sigma-delta ADC architecture, the double-sided sampling circuit samples a first edge of a signal to be sampled in a first half period of the signal to be sampled and samples a second edge of the signal to be sampled in a second half period of the signal to be sampled, and a sigma-delta ADC modulator can subtract two sampling results in one period of the double-sided sampling circuit to obtain a multiplied sampling signal and quantize the increment of the multiplied sampling signal, so that the double-sided sampling conversion in one period of an analog input signal is realized, the signal amplitude is increased relative to the original sigma-delta ADC architecture, and meanwhile, the double-sided sampling circuit has a certain suppression capability on low-frequency noise. The chip and the electronic equipment of the invention have the advantage that the performance is improved due to the adoption of the analog-digital converter of the invention.

title_en: Encoding method, decoding method and communication device
abstract_en: The application provides an encoding method, a decoding method and a communication device, which are used for guaranteeing the performance stability of LDPC codes and relate to the technical field of wireless communication. In the method, a first communication device obtains a sequence of information bits. The first communication device encodes the information bit sequence based on the LDPC matrix to obtain a first check bit sequence. The first communication device obtains a first sequence, which is obtained by interleaving the information bit sequence and the first check bit sequence. Based on the scheme, the first communication equipment can interweave the information bits and the check bits in the LDPC code, structurally change the distribution rule of the information columns and the check columns, optimize the circle property and ensure the stable performance of the LDPC code.

title_en: Control method, circuit and network-structured energy storage converter for hardware drive interlocking delay
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method, a circuit and a network-structured energy storage converter for hardware driving interlocking delay, which relate to the technical field of power electronics and comprise four interlocking delay control units which respectively act on a first outer tube IGBT, a first inner tube IGBT, a second inner tube IGBT and a second outer tube IGBT, wherein the first interlocking delay control unit, the third interlocking delay control unit, the first interlocking delay control unit, the fourth interlocking delay control unit and the second interlocking delay control unit control the interlocking between the corresponding inner tube IGBT and the outer tube IGBT through locking signals respectively generated, the first interlocking delay control unit, the second interlocking delay control unit, the third interlocking delay control unit and the fourth interlocking delay control unit control the turn-off delay of the corresponding inner tube and the turn-on delay of the outer tube through turn-off control signals and turn-on control signals respectively generated. The interlocking of complementary signals and the control of the delay on-off of the inner tube and the outer tube are realized by means of a hardware logic circuit.

title_en: VR interactive data management method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of VR interactive data management, in particular to an artificial intelligence-based VR interactive data management method. The method comprises the steps of respectively obtaining coordinate point sequences of all joint points and normal fluctuation threshold values of various coordinates, obtaining action change coordinate points, dividing the coordinate point sequences to obtain different data segments to be compressed, forming two data segments to be compressed, which are corresponding to the two joint points and have time containing or equal relation, into a data segment combination to be analyzed, obtaining relative position vectors of various coordinates of the data segment combination, judging whether the data segment combination is a linkage combination, obtaining action mode codes of the linkage combination and fitting slope values of each coordinate of basic data segments, and storing the action mode codes of the data segment combination and the initial coordinate points and the fitting slope values of each coordinate in the basic data segments. The application can improve the compression rate of VR interactive data.

title_en: Temperature coefficient-nonlinearity joint compensation method for I/F conversion circuit
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a temperature coefficient nonlinearity joint compensation method for an I/F conversion circuit, which solves the problem that the temperature coefficient compensation and nonlinearity compensation of traditional I/F conversion circuits are independently completed, and cannot balance the nonlinearity within the full temperature range and the temperature coefficient index under the full range, resulting in low compensation accuracy of the I/F conversion circuit. The present invention effectively combines temperature coefficient compensation and nonlinearity compensation, which can reduce the nonlinearity of the circuit at various temperature points within the full temperature range, and reduce the temperature coefficient of the circuit operating at any current point within the full range, meeting the accuracy requirements of the I/F conversion circuit for the full range and full temperature range in different working environments.

title_en: Current control circuit of power chip and vehicle-mounted terminal
abstract_en: The application provides a current control circuit of a power chip and a vehicle-mounted terminal, the current control circuit comprises a control circuit, a backflow prevention circuit, a current limiting circuit, a time delay circuit and a time delay circuit, wherein the control circuit is connected with the power chip, the current limiting circuit is connected with the power chip, the time delay circuit is connected with the current limiting circuit and the power chip, when the output current of the power chip is larger than an overcurrent threshold value, the current limiting circuit is conducted, the backflow prevention circuit is disconnected to control the time delay circuit to be conducted, after the time delay circuit delays for a preset time, a feedback signal is output to the power chip, the power chip outputs a control signal according to the feedback signal, and the control circuit controls the backflow prevention circuit to stop outputting the current according to the control signal. The application solves the technical problem of repeated opening and closing of the device in the current limiting process and prolongs the service life.

title_en: Temperature compensation method, circuit and device for inhibiting local oscillator leakage
abstract_en: The invention provides a temperature compensation method, a circuit and a device for inhibiting local oscillation leakage, and relates to the technical field of temperature compensation, wherein the method comprises the steps of converting real-time temperature of a modulator into real-time voltage through a thermosensitive unit; and carrying out temperature compensation on the modulator based on the real-time voltage and the reference voltage corresponding to the modulator so as to inhibit local oscillation leakage. According to the invention, under the condition that external processing is not needed, the environment temperature of the modulator can be regulated in real time by means of the regulation of the thermosensitive unit, so that the modulator works stably, and automatic real-time temperature compensation is realized in a temperature detection closed loop mode, so that local oscillator leakage is kept stable at different environment temperatures, and only calibration data at one temperature is needed.

title_en: Dual-redundancy signal interlocking logic conversion circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dual-redundancy signal interlocking logic conversion circuit which comprises an interface input conversion circuit, a logic voting circuit, a driving circuit and a relay circuit, wherein the interface input conversion circuit comprises a plurality of groups of input/output interface chips, each group of input/output interface chips respectively outputs two paths of outputs, each path of output end is respectively connected with one path of input end of the logic voting circuit, each path of input end of the logic voting circuit respectively corresponds to one path of output end and is respectively connected with one path of input end of the driving circuit, and each path of input end of the driving circuit respectively corresponds to one path of output end and is respectively connected with one path of input end of the relay circuit. According to the invention, through the output inverse logic design, the existing logic is converted into the normal open logic and the closed logic after the action, and the logic voting circuit is used for performing logic conversion locking, outputting the logic conversion and the locked signals, avoiding the false triggering of the later-stage device caused by the lack of the position of the earlier-stage device in the interlocking control, and guaranteeing the safety of the interlocking control flow.

title_en: Clock stabilization circuit, memory system and operation method of memory system
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a clock stabilization circuit, a memory system, and a method of operating a memory system. The clock stabilization circuit includes a shift register configured to output one or more shift signals by shifting data and an inversion flag based on a clock signal, a comparison circuit configured to output one or more comparison signals by comparing the one or more shift signals with one or more keys, respectively, a stabilization flag register configured to enable a stabilization flag based on a first delayed clock signal generated by delaying the clock signal and the one or more comparison signals, and a masking circuit configured to output an internal clock signal by masking a second delayed clock signal generated by delaying the first delayed clock signal based on the stabilization flag.

title_en: Operational amplifier, chip and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an operational amplifier, a chip and electronic equipment, which comprise a differential input stage, a bias generating circuit, a push-pull output stage, a first overload recovery circuit and a second overload recovery circuit, wherein the differential input stage receives a differential input signal, the bias generating circuit generates a bias signal based on the differential input signal, the push-pull output stage generates an output signal based on the bias signal, the first overload recovery circuit pulls up the control end voltage of an upper pipe of the push-pull output stage when the output signal of the push-pull output stage is larger than a preset upper limit, and the second overload recovery circuit pulls down the control end voltage of a lower pipe of the push-pull output stage when the output signal of the push-pull output stage is smaller than a preset lower limit. The operational amplifier, the chip and the electronic equipment accelerate overload recovery through the overload recovery circuit, the overload recovery time can be limited within 100ns, the operational amplifier, the chip and the electronic equipment are suitable for high-speed application scenes, and the stability of an operational amplifier loop can be maintained under the conditions of low power supply voltage and high power supply voltage.

title_en: Fast BF decoder with column region convergence detection function
abstract_en: A method for operating a BF decoder and an associated memory system utilizing the BF decoder is provided. The method comprises a) providing a parity check matrix comprising column regions having different column weights, b) bit-flipping BF decoding a read codeword from a memory, the read codeword having errors and the BF decoding yielding a decoded codeword having a measured error rate determined using the parity check matrix, and c) skipping column regions in the parity check matrix where the regions shown to converge when performing BF iterations to reduce the measured error rate, the decoded codeword containing the correct bit values.

title_en: LED current overshoot reduction apparatus and method
abstract_en: An apparatus includes a reference current generation circuit coupled between a first voltage bus and a second voltage bus, wherein the reference current generation circuit is configured to generate a predetermined reference current, a first reference current path comprising a first switch, wherein the predetermined reference current is configured to be mirrored to generate a first reference current in the first reference current path, a load current path comprising a power switch, and a Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) anti-spike circuit configured to control the first switch so as to reduce an overshoot occurring at a leading edge of a load current flowing through the power switch.

title_en: Non-stationary data quantization processing method based on dynamic fluctuation perception
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing compression and machine learning, and discloses a non-stationary data quantization processing method based on dynamic fluctuation perception, which adopts Welford algorithm to continuously track real-time fluctuation statistical measurement of photovoltaic data flow, and calculates first-order differential sequences of the data flow in parallel to capture time dynamic characteristics; constructing a non-uniform quantizer with a learnable parameter, setting a non-uniform input threshold value by using a quantile initializing strategy, and mapping a non-uniform interval into a fixed uniform integer output by combining a non-uniform to uniform quantization mechanism; in order to guide the study of quantization parameters, the invention constructs a dynamic composite loss function based on the consistency of the fluctuation self-adaptive Beta divergence and the time gradient, wherein the function comprises a Beta divergence distribution loss item dynamically controlled by the real-time fluctuation.

title_en: Pulse circuit
abstract_en: The application discloses a pulse circuit, which relates to the technical field of electronics and comprises a boost circuit, a signal amplifying circuit, a pull-up switch and a pull-down switch, wherein the boost circuit comprises a boost control circuit, a first diode and a first capacitor, the first end of the boost control circuit is connected with one end of the first capacitor, the other end of the first capacitor is connected with the negative electrode of the first diode, the positive electrode of the first diode is connected with a first power supply, the first end of the signal amplifying circuit is connected with the negative electrode of the first diode and the other end of the first capacitor, the second end of the signal amplifying circuit is connected with a pull-up switch to control the on-off of the pull-up switch, the first end of the pull-up switch is connected with a second power supply, the first end of the pull-down switch is grounded, the second end of the pull-up switch is connected with the second end of the pull-down switch to output pulse signals in a matched mode, and a main control chip is connected with the boost control circuit, the signal amplifying circuit and the pull-down switch respectively. The application adopts the diode and the capacitor to boost voltage, and has low production and manufacturing cost.

title_en: AC coupling broadband high-performance turnover input buffer circuit applied to high-speed high-precision analog-to-digital converter
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of analog integrated circuits, and particularly relates to an alternating-current coupled broadband high-performance flip input buffer which mainly comprises an alternating-current coupled flip source follower core module, a nonlinear parasitic capacitance compensation module, a bias network and a current mirror, wherein the alternating-current coupled flip source follower core module mainly comprises a main source follower realizing source follower basic function, a CASCODE tube lifting circuit integrally linear, a current mirror tube providing main current and constructing a negative feedback loop with a coupling capacitor and a resistor, the input buffer output impedance under the concerned frequency can be effectively reduced, wider bandwidth and better linearity can be realized, the input signal range can be greatly widened at the same time, the nonlinear parasitic capacitance compensation module compensates the nonlinear parasitic capacitance of the main source follower tube through an accumulation type MOS varactor, the integral linearity is further improved, and the bias network and the current mirror provide bias which is not influenced by process temperature change for the core module, and wider drain-source voltage is provided, so that better linearity is realized.

title_en: Metastability detection and correction in analog-to-digital signal converters
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to metastability detection and correction in analog-to-digital signal converters. Embodiments disclosed herein relate to detecting metastability to reduce noise and improve the performance of analog-to-digital converter ADC (120). In an example, an ADC (120) is provided that includes comparator circuitry (comparator 215), synchronization circuitry (synchronizers 225 and 230), digital output circuitry (SAR circuit 235), and stability check circuitry (digital stability checker circuit 240). The comparator circuitry performs a comparison of the analog input signal and the analog feedback signal and outputs a result of the comparison. The synchronization circuitry samples the result of the comparison at different times to produce a first sample value and a second sample value. The digital output circuitry generates a digital output signal based on the first sample value and outputs the digital output signal. The stability check circuitry determines whether a metastable condition occurs with respect to the analog-to-digital converter based on the first sample value and the second sample value and outputs an indication of whether the metastable condition occurs.

title_en: ADC time domain error background calibration method and system based on digital output statistics
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ADC time domain error background calibration method and system based on digital output statistics, which comprises a digital signal monitoring module, a gain error calibration module and a hierarchical level offset error calibration module, wherein digital signals output by a front end and a rear end of an ADC are obtained through connecting the front end and the rear end of the ADC and carrying out real-time monitoring on the digital signals, the offset error direction of a voltage-time converter VTC is extracted and regulated by utilizing the different same relation between the saturation state of the rear end ADC and the MSB of the front end and the rear end, a hierarchical level offset calibration loop is constructed and decoupling calibration is carried out on each path offset of VTC and TDC, and the simultaneous, real-time and high-robustness calibration on gain errors and multisource offset errors is realized on the premise of no interruption and low cost, and the method belongs to the technical field of mixed signal integrated circuits.

title_en: Multi-chip multichannel ADC chip synchronization method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for synchronizing multiple multi-channel ADC chips, and belongs to the technical field of wireless communication and signal processing. The method comprises the steps of providing homologous and same-phase reference clock signals for multiple ADC chips and an FPGA through multiple output clock PLL chips, establishing independent data processing channels for each ADC in the FPGA, sequentially performing LVDS serial-parallel conversion and data sample point splicing processing, uniformly converting asynchronous data of each ADC chip into the same system clock domain by adopting asynchronous FIFO, and simultaneously reading all the asynchronous FIFO through synchronous control logic to realize synchronous data output. The device adopts a star topology hardware architecture and comprises a reference clock source, a multi-channel clock PLL chip, a plurality of ADC chips and an FPGA main control chip integrating each processing module. The invention solves the problems of clock phase deviation and data sampling asynchronism among multiple ADCs, realizes high-precision synchronization of the phase difference among channels smaller than 0.3ns, and has the advantages of low realization cost, strong system expansibility and good instantaneity.

title_en: Electroacoustic transducer and TF-SAW device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electroacoustic transducer and a TF-SAW device, and belongs to the technical field of radio frequency filtering. The electroacoustic transducer comprises interdigital electrodes formed by a plurality of groups of electrode fingers which are arranged in a staggered mode, and a multistage bus bar structure which is arranged at two ends of the interdigital electrodes and is formed by a secondary bus bar, a primary bus bar and bus bar connecting fingers for connecting the secondary bus bar and the primary bus bar, wherein an electrode finger mass increasing part is arranged in a low sound speed area of the interdigital electrodes. The invention optimizes the size ratio of the multi-stage bus bar structure and the bus bar connecting fingers when the dummy fingers are not configured by optimizing the secondary bus bar length D, the dummy finger average length gamma and the number ratio of the dummy finger length larger than the average value. The invention also discloses a TF-SAW device containing the electroacoustic transducer, and the optimal matching relation between the electroacoustic transducers with different structures and the corresponding piezoelectric substrates is defined. According to the invention, through structural parameter optimization, the transverse mode can be effectively inhibited, and the frequency response stability and the filtering performance of the device are improved.

title_en: Novel coupling mode acoustic wave resonator and filter
abstract_en: The application discloses a novel coupling mode acoustic wave resonator and a filter, which comprise a substrate; the electrode comprises a substrate, a piezoelectric layer arranged on one side surface of the substrate, and an interdigital electrode arranged on one side of the piezoelectric layer away from the substrate. The piezoelectric coefficient of the piezoelectric layer comprises an e  11  component, an e  13  component, an e  31  component and an e  33  component in a piezoelectric coefficient matrix by selecting the material of the piezoelectric layer and setting the value range of an in-plane Euler angle alpha, and longitudinal waves with two mutually perpendicular polarization directions are coupled together by designing the ratio of the thickness of the piezoelectric layer to the periodic wavelength of the interdigital electrode and the ratio of the thickness of the interdigital electrode to the periodic wavelength of the interdigital electrode to form a novel coupling mode sound wave with a polarization direction forming a certain included angle with the plane of the piezoelectric layer. The included angle is more than 0 degrees and less than 90 degrees. The application provides a solution for the high-frequency large-bandwidth acoustic wave filter, has simple device structure and reduces the complexity and cost of device preparation.

title_en: Distributed filtering method, system and storage medium based on depth expansion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed filtering method, a distributed filtering system and a distributed filtering storage medium based on depth expansion, relates to the technical field of sensor networks, and aims to solve the problems of poor multi-noise adaptation, insufficient node estimation consistency and high calculation complexity of a traditional method. The method comprises the steps of establishing a network topology and a system model, designing an information fusion filter structure, mapping a system iteration equation into a deep expansion neural network, constructing a composite loss function containing estimation errors and node divergence, and solving the optimal gain by utilizing deep neural network training. The method is suitable for a multi-noise scene, realizes double advantages of precision and consistency, has low calculation complexity and strong robustness, and is suitable for the fields of environment monitoring, dynamic target tracking and the like.

title_en: Random signal generating device based on saturable absorber semiconductor laser
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of random number generation. In particular to a random signal generating device based on a saturable absorber semiconductor laser. The device comprises a random self-pulsation entropy source, a photoelectric detector and a pulse amplitude quantization module. The random self-pulsation entropy source adopts a saturable absorber semiconductor laser (preferably a DFB-SA structure), a driving current is injected into a gain area, reverse bias voltage is applied to an absorption area to generate light pulses with random amplitude and stable repetition period, a photoelectric detector adopts a PIN photodiode or an avalanche photodiode to convert the light pulses into corresponding electric pulses, a pulse amplitude quantization module comprises a differential comparator and a peak detection circuit, and the electric pulse peak value is quantized in each pulse period through a fixed threshold value or an adaptive threshold value to generate a random bit sequence. The invention does not need external electric clock, ADC and digital post-processing, realizes random signal generation with high speed and high stability, and has simple structure, low power consumption and high integration level.

title_en: Operational amplifier
abstract_en: An operational amplifier device comprises an operational amplifier and a calibration circuit, wherein a first input end and a second input end of the operational amplifier are in short circuit, the calibration circuit comprises a detection circuit, a control circuit, a compensation circuit and a compensation circuit, the detection circuit outputs a detection result based on output voltage of the operational amplifier, the control circuit is coupled with the output end of the detection circuit, a first calibration signal is output when the detection result is positive offset voltage, and/or a second calibration signal is output when the detection result is negative offset voltage, the compensation circuit is used for compensating the operational amplifier to reduce the positive offset voltage in response to receiving the first calibration signal, and/or the operational amplifier is compensated to increase the negative offset voltage in response to receiving the second calibration signal. By the scheme, the input offset voltage is eliminated, and meanwhile, the signal to noise ratio and bandwidth of the operational amplifier are not affected.

title_en: High-frequency low-loss resonator electrode layer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-frequency low-loss resonator electrode layer which comprises a top electrode, a piezoelectric layer and a bottom electrode which are sequentially arranged from top to bottom, wherein the top electrode is a composite electrode, the composite electrode comprises a high-acoustic-impedance layer connected with the piezoelectric layer and a conductive low-acoustic-impedance layer connected above the high-acoustic-impedance layer, the high-acoustic-impedance layer is made of W or Mo, the conductive low-acoustic-impedance layer is made of Al, the piezoelectric layer is made of AlN, scAlN or other piezoelectric film materials, and the high-frequency low-loss resonator electrode layer is prepared by adopting multi-chamber PVD. The series resonance resistance is reduced on the premise of keeping the target working frequency of the resonator unchanged through the composite electrode structure, ohmic loss and heating are reduced, and the efficiency and stability of the device are improved.

title_en: Ship track grading visualization method and related equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a ship track grading visualization method and related equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of executing multi-scale adaptive track thinning by constructing a grading slope threshold model, and constructing a unified track point retention judgment model by matching with navigation speed change constraint, heading change constraint and shoreline or obstacle constraint, so as to realize fine regulation and control of track thinning and realize grading thinning and high-quality visualization of ship tracks. The method and the device have the advantages that the compression rate and the processing efficiency of track data are improved through a grading slope threshold model and a unified judging mechanism, the accuracy of track morphology reservation is realized through combining navigational speed change constraint information and heading change constraint information, the phenomenon of land penetration of the thinned track can be effectively avoided through shoreline or obstacle constraint, the space logic and accuracy of the track are guaranteed, the strict requirements of maritime supervision and other scenes are met, and the method and the device can be widely applied to the technical field of maritime traffic monitoring.

title_en: Low-parasitic high-frequency parallel switch tube core structure circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-parasitic high-frequency parallel switch tube core structure circuit which comprises at least two micro-strips and at least one parallel switch tube core. The parallel switch tube core at least comprises a basic unit which takes a drain electrode module as a center, and a grid electrode module and a source electrode module are sequentially arranged on two sides of the basic unit, the source electrode module is grounded through a ground hole, and the grid electrode module is led out through a grid electrode terminal. The parallel switch tube core is connected in parallel between two adjacent micro-strips to form a micro-strip-parallel switch tube core-micro-strip signal path or connected to a common node between the adjacent micro-strips through a drain terminal thereof. The structure effectively reduces parasitic parameters and impedance to ground, greatly improves high-frequency isolation while not increasing insertion loss, switching time and circuit area, and is suitable for various semiconductor processes and high-frequency switching systems.

title_en: Filter and new energy passenger car motor controller
abstract_en: The invention provides a filter and a new energy passenger car motor controller, belonging to the technical field of filters, wherein the filter comprises a first magnetic ring, a second magnetic ring and a plurality of capacitance-adjustable capacitors, the capacitors form a multi-level common differential mode filter assembly, and the multi-level common differential mode filter assembly is respectively connected with the first magnetic ring and the second magnetic ring to form a filter loop; the filtering loop comprises a line side and a load side, wherein the line side is used for receiving a first signal to be filtered, the load side is used for outputting a second signal after the first signal is filtered and receiving a third signal to be filtered, and the line side is also used for outputting a fourth signal after the third signal is filtered. The single filter has the beneficial effects that the single filter not only can inhibit and reduce the interference conducted to the circuit side when the load side rear-stage motor controller and the motor work, but also can inhibit and reduce the interference conducted to the circuit side when the load side boost work, and the electromagnetic compatibility of the whole vehicle is improved.

title_en: Digital interpolation compensation method applied to SFO in multi-carrier optical communication system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital interpolation compensation method applied to sampling frequency deviation SFO in a multi-carrier optical communication system, which comprises the steps of firstly designing a low-pass finite impulse response filter with a narrower transition zone as a reference filter of the interpolation filter according to the characteristic of signal bandwidth of multi-carrier, and then approximately calculating the coefficient of the interpolation filter according to a basis function method and a minimum mean square error method. Finally, the digital interpolation filter of the improved Farrow structure is designed by using the interpolation filter coefficients for the interpolation compensation of the multi-carrier signals. The invention suppresses the image interference at the high frequency subcarrier in the multicarrier system by designing the low-pass interpolation filter with a narrow transition band, so as to improve the signal-to-noise ratio of the data subcarrier and improve the transmission performance of the system.

title_en: Method for predicting resonant frequency of spiral resonator, size analysis method and device
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a method for predicting the resonant frequency of a spiral resonator, a size analysis method and a size analysis device, and belongs to the fields of radio frequency electronic engineering and quantum precision measurement. The method for predicting the resonant frequency of the spiral resonator comprises the steps of dividing a main coil of the spiral resonator into a plurality of subsections to establish a mutual inductance matrix based on the subsections, obtaining total equivalent inductance of the spiral resonator based on the mutual inductance matrix, constructing a multi-body coupling capacitance network model according to a plurality of capacitance components of the spiral resonator, obtaining total equivalent capacitance of the spiral resonator based on the multi-body coupling capacitance network model, and determining a predicted value of the resonant frequency of the spiral resonator according to the total equivalent inductance and the total equivalent capacitance. The method and the device can obtain more accurate resonant frequency predicted values and provide more accurate parameters for the design, manufacture and processing of the spiral resonator.

title_en: Reconfigurable injection locking local vibration source system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a reconfigurable injection locking vibration source system which comprises a voltage-controlled oscillator, an injection locking frequency multiplier and an injection locking amplifier, wherein a first output end of the voltage-controlled oscillator is connected with a first input end of the injection locking frequency multiplier, a second output end of the voltage-controlled oscillator is connected with a second input end of the injection locking frequency multiplier, a first output end of the injection locking frequency multiplier is connected with a first input end of the injection locking amplifier, a second output end of the injection locking frequency multiplier is connected with a second input end of the injection locking amplifier, the voltage-controlled oscillator is used for generating a low-frequency fundamental wave, the injection locking frequency multiplier is used for performing frequency multiplication processing on the low-frequency fundamental wave to generate a frequency doubling wave or a frequency tripling wave, and the injection locking amplifier is used for performing power amplification on the frequency doubling wave or the frequency tripling wave, so that accuracy of millimeter wave output is improved.

title_en: Polar amplifier with dynamic duty cycle
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a polar amplifier with a dynamic duty cycle. The electronic device may include a wireless circuit with a polar power amplifier. A gate terminal of a transistor in the PMOS portion of the amplifier may receive a first Local Oscillator (LO) signal. The gate terminal of the transistor in the NMOS portion of the amplifier may receive the second LO signal. The tunable clock generator may generate the first LO signal and the second LO signal based on a binary control signal received from a physical layer (PHY) controller. The PHY controller may supply a binary control signal to weighting/enabling transistors in an inverter group of the tunable clock generator to dynamically adjust a duty cycle ratio between the first LO signal and the second LO signal over time. The PHY controller may perform this adjustment over time based on the characteristics of the radio frequency signal in a manner that optimizes the linearity and power consumption of the amplifier, even as the characteristics change.

title_en: Flash control circuit and method based on double energy storage units
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flash control circuit and a flash control method based on double energy storage units, which relate to the field of flash control, and the flash control circuit comprises a first charging branch circuit formed by a first isolation diode and a first energy storage unit and a second charging branch circuit formed by a second isolation diode and a second energy storage unit, wherein the first charging branch circuit and the second charging branch circuit are connected in parallel with the output end of the same boosting unit, and a double energy storage framework supporting dynamic charging scheduling is constructed on the premise of not adding an independent charging loop; in the period that both the two energy storage units are not discharged, the two energy storage units are communicated with the boosting unit, so that the parallel charging capability is realized, and the bottleneck that a complete power return period must be waited after discharging in a single-capacitor scheme is effectively eliminated.

title_en: Power amplifier equipment, remote radio unit and communication equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides power amplification equipment, a remote radio unit and communication equipment, which comprise a power dividing circuit, a main circuit power amplification circuit and an auxiliary circuit power amplification circuit, wherein the input end of the power dividing circuit is used for receiving a transmitting signal, the first output end of the power dividing circuit is connected with the input end of the main circuit power amplification circuit, the second output end of the power dividing circuit is connected with the input end of the auxiliary circuit power amplification circuit, the output ends of the main circuit power amplification circuit and the auxiliary circuit power amplification circuit are both connected with the output end of the power amplification equipment, the first working voltage of the main circuit power amplification circuit is adjustable, the first working voltage is used for adjusting the output rollback power of the power amplification equipment, the second working voltage of the auxiliary circuit power amplification circuit is fixed, and the auxiliary circuit power amplification circuit comprises a plurality of three-terminal active devices which are connected in series to form a stacked structure. And the first working voltage can be adjusted according to the actual application scene, so that the output power rollback of the power amplifier equipment is adjustable.

title_en: Crop growth model and data assimilation method based on AIEnKF algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crop growth model and data assimilation method based on AIEnKF algorithm, and belongs to the technical field of agricultural production simulation and data assimilation. The method comprises the steps of collecting meteorological data, soil data and agricultural management data of a target area, constructing a crop growth model based on WOFOST models, constructing four data assimilation algorithms of an aggregate Kalman filter EnKF, an adaptive aggregate Kalman filter AEnKF, an iterative aggregate Kalman filter IEnKF and an adaptive iterative aggregate Kalman filter AIEnKF, setting three assimilation strategies of a single variable assimilation leaf area index, a single variable assimilation soil moisture, a double variable assimilation leaf area index and soil moisture, executing data assimilation at a crop growth key time node, updating a state variable, and quantitatively evaluating assimilation effects by adopting a multi-dimensional index. The invention effectively solves the defects of the existing algorithm in nonlinear system processing and process noise adaptation, and improves the simulation precision and stability of key variables for crop growth.

title_en: Self-adaptive driving circuit for inhibiting overshoot voltage and turn-off oscillation of SiC MOSFET
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive driving circuit for inhibiting overshoot voltage and turn-off oscillation of a SiC MOSFET, which comprises a driving circuit, a control circuit and the SiC MOSFET switch, wherein the output end of the driving circuit is connected with the grid electrode of the SiC MOSFET switch and is used for generating a target grid electrode control current so as to carry out charge and discharge control on the grid electrode of the SiC MOSFET switch and further control the on-off of the SiC MOSFET switch, the input end of the control circuit is connected with the drain electrode and the source electrode of the SiC MOSFET switch, and the output end of the control circuit is connected with the driving circuit and is used for generating a driving circuit control signal according to the detection voltage between the drain electrode and the source electrode of the SiC MOSFET switch so as to control the amplitude and the output time sequence of the target grid electrode control current and thus self-adaptively adjust the on-off of the SiC MOSFET switch. The invention can effectively inhibit the dynamic overshoot voltage and the turn-off oscillation phenomenon, and improve the stability of the switching process.

title_en: Piezoelectric superlattice resonator and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of bulk acoustic wave resonators, and particularly provides a piezoelectric superlattice resonator and a preparation method thereof, wherein the piezoelectric superlattice resonator comprises a substrate, a bottom electrode, a superlattice piezoelectric layer and a top electrode which are sequentially connected from bottom to top, the superlattice piezoelectric layer comprises a plurality of vertically stacked piezoelectric structures, each piezoelectric structure comprises a concentration gradient layer and a concentration step layer, the concentration step layer is connected with the concentration gradient layer and is positioned above the concentration gradient layer, the concentration gradient layer and the concentration step layer both contain doping elements, the doping element concentration of the concentration gradient layer is distributed in a gradient manner along the thickness direction of the concentration gradient layer, the absolute value of the difference between the doping element concentration of the concentration step layer and the doping element concentration at the top of the concentration gradient layer is greater than or equal to 15%, and the piezoelectric superlattice resonator can realize uniform polarization of the piezoelectric layer and the advantages of different doping concentrations under the condition that external high-voltage polarization is not needed.

title_en: Multichannel signal processing system based on parallel accumulation and hierarchical accumulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multichannel signal processing system based on parallel accumulation and hierarchical accumulation, and belongs to the technical field of high-precision data acquisition. The system comprises a signal modulation module, a clock adjustment module, a pulse distribution module, an accumulation module, a grading accumulation module and a control module. The signal modulation module converts the multipath analog signals into 1-bit digital signals, the pulse distribution module distributes the digital signals of each channel into the accumulation module for accumulation according to a preset distribution strategy, the classification accumulation module classifies and performs accumulation operation when the accumulation module reaches the upper limit so as to improve the effective precision, and the clock adjustment module adjusts the clock frequency of each path of signals through the frequency divider so as to realize synchronous or asynchronous classification of the accumulation module under non-uniform distribution. The invention obviously improves the flexibility, the resource utilization efficiency and the effective precision of the multichannel signal processing through flexible hardware resource allocation and grading cumulative multiplication processing flow.

title_en: Signal amplification adapter for upgrading and reforming power grid
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of signal amplifiers, and particularly relates to a signal amplification adapter for upgrading and reforming a power grid, which comprises a power supply module, a filtering module, an input adjusting module, a three-phase and zero-sequence operational amplifier module, a phase detection and correction module and an output protection module, wherein the input adjusting module comprises a filtering unit which is respectively connected with an A-phase output, a B-phase output, a C-phase output and a zero-sequence signal and is used for filtering higher harmonic interference, the phase detection and correction module comprises a phase detection unit and a phase correction unit, the input of the phase detection unit is connected with the output of the three-phase and zero-sequence operational amplifier module and is used for detecting phase difference, and the input of the phase correction unit is connected with the output of the phase detection unit and is used for correcting the phase difference. By using the invention, the matching work of the electronic voltage sensor and the electromagnetic ammeter under the southeast Asia voltage characteristic can be realized.

title_en: Power amplifier module and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of radio frequency, and particularly relates to a power amplifier module and a preparation method thereof. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a substrate, arranging a first cavity and a second cavity on the substrate, fixing a power amplification chip and a power management chip in the first cavity and the second cavity respectively, filling the first cavity and the second cavity through insulating materials to enable the power amplification chip and the power management chip to be packaged in the first cavity and the second cavity respectively, grinding the insulating materials and the substrate to enable the power amplification chip and the power management chip to be flush with the surface of the substrate, and compared with the prior art, the method has the advantage that the power efficiency and the thermal stability of a power amplifier module are effectively improved.

title_en: Dual-frequency high-efficiency radio frequency power amplifier based on cascaded dual transmission lines
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dual-frequency high-efficiency radio frequency power amplifier based on a cascade dual transmission line, and belongs to the technical field of radio frequency power amplifiers. The power amplifier comprises a radio frequency input matching, a power transistor, a direct current bias, a cascade harmonic control matching network and a radio frequency output end. The cascade harmonic control matching network comprises harmonic control units which are sequentially cascaded along the direction from the drain electrode of the transistor to the load, wherein the two double-transmission-line harmonic control units are respectively used for low-frequency band and high-frequency band even harmonic impedance adjustment, and the other two open-circuit stubs are respectively used for third harmonic impedance adjustment of corresponding working frequency bands. The output matching structure controls the fundamental wave and the higher harmonic wave impedance in a high-efficiency working area of the inverse F type, reduces the overlapping loss of drain voltage and current waveform, and improves the drain efficiency. The invention is suitable for high-efficiency radio frequency power amplification in systems such as double-frequency communication, radar detection, multi-system wireless transmission and the like.

title_en: Differential line receiver and communication receiving apparatus
abstract_en: The application provides a differential line receiver and communication receiving equipment, and relates to the technical field of circuit design. The differential line receiver comprises a first resistor network, a second resistor network, a bias circuit, an enabling input circuit and a differential line receiving circuit, wherein the output end of the bias circuit is connected with the bias end of the differential line receiving circuit, the two input ends of the enabling input circuit are two enabling ends of the differential line receiver, the two output ends of the enabling input circuit are respectively connected with the two enabling input ends of the differential line receiving circuit, the input ends of the first resistor network and the input ends of the second resistor network are respectively the first input end and the second input end of the differential line receiver, the output ends of the first resistor network and the output ends of the second resistor network are respectively connected with the two input ends of the differential line receiving circuit, and the output ends of the differential line receiving circuit output single-ended signals. The application can provide stable input voltage with or without differential signal input, and solves the problem that the input end of the CMOS process product cannot float.

title_en: Thyristor driving circuit
abstract_en: The circuit (10) for driving a pair of thyristors (TH  1 、TH 2 ) comprises a first primary winding (PRW  1 ), a second primary winding (PRW  2 ),   A first secondary winding (SEW  1 ) and a second secondary winding (SEW  2 ), wherein the first primary winding (PRW  1 ) and the second primary winding (PRW  2 ) are connected in series, the first primary winding (PRW  1 ) is magnetically coupled to the first secondary winding (SEW  1 ) and adapted to control the first thyristor (TH  1 ), and the second primary winding (PRW  2 ) is magnetically coupled to the second secondary winding (SEW  2 ) and adapted to control the second thyristor (TH  2 ).   The circuit (10) further comprises a Voltage Source (VS) connected to the junction between the first end of the first primary winding (PRW  1 ) and the first end of the second primary winding (PRW  2 ), a first switch (SW  1 ) connected to the second end of the first primary winding (PRW  1 ), and a second switch (SW  2 ) connected to the second end of the second primary winding (PRW  2 ).

title_en: Carry propagation circuit of carry output circuit and asynchronous adder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carry output circuit, a carry propagation circuit and an asynchronous adder. The carry output circuit includes a carry signal main link formed by a series of controlled transmission gates, and a level output unit coupled to a carry output node (Cout). The output path of the level output unit is connected with a control unit, the control end of the control unit is connected with a carry propagation signal (Pi) or an inverted signal (Pibar) of the level output unit, and the output path is shut down when Pi=1. The level output unit can be embodied as a Ki/Gi circuit plus control switch, a single transmission gate, or a two-group three-pipe output structure. The bypass propagation circuit is also provided, wherein an enable signal of the bypass propagation circuit is simultaneously connected to the control unit, and the bypass is used for forcibly turning off the output path when the bypass is enabled. In the multi-level bypass architecture, the lower bypass output is cut off when the high-level bypass is enabled, and the main link remains on. The invention cuts off the output path under specific conditions by the control signal, and eliminates the conflict of the multipath level to the same node from the control logic level.

title_en: 108.48MHz/150kW solid state power source system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an 108.48MHz/150kW solid-state power source system, the system includes seven parts of input protection unit, leading power amplifier unit, 1:4 power distributor, 4 40kW power amplifier cabinets, 2 level 2:1 power synthesizer, output coupler, power supply system; the input protection unit, the preposed power amplifier unit, the 1:4 power distributor, the 4 power amplifier cabinets of 40kW, the 2-stage 2:1 power synthesizer and the output coupler are connected in series to form a transmitting link, and a power supply system supplies power to all the modules; when an external radio frequency signal is fed in, an input protection unit detects, judges and attenuates the input signal, a preposed power amplification unit preliminarily amplifies the signal, a 1:4 power distributor distributes the amplified signal to 4 40kW power amplification cabinets to amplify the amplified signal to required power, and a 2-stage 2:1 power synthesizer outputs the amplified signal through an output coupler. The utility model has the advantages of efficient, high duty cycle, wide pulse width and performance reliability.

title_en: Intelligent electrical equipment, single chip microcomputer adaptive to microwave detector and microwave detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent electric device, a single chip microcomputer adapted to a microwave detector, a microwave detector and a microwave transmitting method thereof, wherein the microwave detector is adapted to a single chip microcomputer, wherein the single chip microcomputer comprises a frequency source, a single chip microcomputer main body communicably connected to the frequency source and a frequency output port, wherein the microwave detector comprises a frequency synthesizer and a transmitting circuit, wherein the frequency synthesizer can synthesize and control a transmitting frequency signal according to a basic frequency provided by the frequency source of the single chip microcomputer after communicably connected to the frequency output port, wherein the transmitting circuit is communicably connected to the frequency synthesizer, wherein the transmitting circuit transmits a detecting microwave according to the transmitting frequency signal synthesized and controlled by the frequency synthesizer, the microwave detector does not use a crystal oscillator, and is beneficial to miniaturization and integration of the microwave detector.

title_en: Oblique infrared induction structure of AI skin care instrument
abstract_en: The utility model provides an obliquely arranged infrared induction structure of an AI skin care instrument, which comprises a shell, a bracket, a TX transmitting infrared tube, an RX receiving infrared tube and a control panel; the bracket is arranged in the shell and is provided with a TX transmitting infrared tube and an RX receiving infrared tube which are arranged side by side; the TX transmitting infrared tube and the RX receiving infrared tube are obliquely arranged, and the included angle of the extension lines of the TX transmitting infrared tube and the RX receiving infrared tube is 75 degrees; the TX transmitting infrared tube and the RX receiving infrared tube are connected with the control panel through leads; the control panel comprises a transmitting end circuit, a receiving end circuit and a single chip microcomputer; the transmitting end circuit is configured to drive the TX transmitting infrared tube to transmit an infrared signal; the receiving end circuit is configured to receive the reflected infrared signals received by the RX receiving infrared tube and send horizontal signals to the single chip microcomputer. The structure is simple, and the problems that liquid splashes to pollute the infrared tube due to the vertical separation arrangement and the appearance is not attractive are avoided.

title_en: Signal conditioning and monitoring circuit for different vibration signals
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a signal conditioning and monitoring circuit for different vibration signals and a use method, which comprises a BVT sensor signal amplification coupling unit, a signal switching unit and a signal processing unit, wherein the BVT sensor signal amplification coupling unit is used for amplifying and coupling the vibration signals output by a voltage type speed sensor and transmitting the vibration signals to the signal switching unit; the acceleration sensor signal amplification coupling unit is used for amplifying and coupling the vibration signal of the charge type acceleration sensor and transmitting the vibration signal to the signal switching unit; the signal switching unit is used for respectively receiving vibration signals amplified and coupled by the BVT sensor signal amplification coupling unit and the acceleration sensor signal amplification coupling unit, and respectively transmitting two paths of the switched vibration signals, wherein one path of the switched vibration signals is transmitted to the power amplifier high-pass output monitoring unit; the other path is transmitted to a subsequent signal processing unit; the power amplifier is provided with a high-pass output monitoring unit and is used for outputting the vibration signal passing through the signal switching unit to a sound power amplifier for loudspeaker monitoring. The utility model discloses circuit design is ingenious, and the design is novel.

title_en: Multiplexing signal selection circuit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multiplexing signal selection circuit relates to elevator technical field. The utility model discloses a multiplex signal input end, multiplex signal output end and multiplex signal select terminal, a plurality of signal circuit are connected respectively to multiplex signal input end and multiplex signal output end, multiplex signal select terminal includes level selection circuit and a plurality of switch chip, the level selection circuit to switch chip output control level, the switch chip of receiving the control level switches on, and the circuit that makes multiplex signal input end select switches on with the circuit that multiplex signal output end was selected. The utility model discloses a multiplexing signal circuit of switch chip selection need not artifical the grafting.

title_en: Resonator with thermistor
