abstract_en: The utility model relates to a take thermistor's syntonizer, including first pad, second pad, thermistor structure, first base plate, third base plate, base, oscillator and upper cover, first pad is fixed in the one side of first base plate, and the thermistor structure is fixed in the another side of first base plate, and third base plate a side lid fits the thermistor structurally, and the second pad is fixed to the another side of third base plate, and on the upper cover lid fitted the base, the oscillator is fixed in between base and the upper cover. The substrate and the thermistor are processed together, so that the whole processing procedure of the thermistor resonator is reduced, the processing time of the thermistor resonator is shortened, equipment and materials required by assembling the thermistor are omitted, and the dropping loss cost of the thermistor in the subsequent process can be reduced.

title_en: Temperature-resistant drift frequency-stabilized pulse generation electronic chip and voltage regulation chip
abstract_en: A temperature-resistant drift frequency-stabilized pulse generation electronic chip and a voltage regulation chip belong to the technical field of electronic and automobile control, and the temperature-resistant drift frequency-stabilized pulse generation electronic chip comprises a first capacitor, a second capacitor, a first bias resistor and a second bias resistor; the first transistor and the second transistor are used as a first arm of a geminate transistor, the third transistor and the fourth transistor are used as a second arm of the geminate transistor, collectors of the first transistor and the second transistor are connected to form a first arm output end, collectors of the third transistor and the fourth transistor are connected to form a second arm output end, a first bias current resistor is connected between bases of the first transistor and the second transistor in series, and a second bias current resistor is connected between bases of the third transistor and the fourth transistor in series; the emitters of the first and the third transistors are connected with the anode of the power supply, and the emitters of the second and the fourth transistors are connected with the cathode of the power supply; the first capacitor is connected with the output end of the second arm and the base electrode of the first transistor, and the second capacitor is connected with the output end of the first arm and the base electrode of the fourth transistor; the temperature drift of the consistent parameters offsets to enable the first arm to output a first polarity narrow pulse with frequency stability and temperature resistance, and the second arm outputs a second polarity narrow pulse with frequency stability, temperature drift resistance and reverse polarity.

title_en: Fish tape detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fish tape detection device, which comprises a first detection part, a second detection part and a third detection part, wherein the first detection part is provided with a first bracket, the first bracket is provided with an installation end and a fixed end, the installation end is provided with a through hole so that a first proximity switch penetrates through the installation end, the junction of the first proximity switch and the first bracket is provided with a first fixing part and a second fixing part for fixing the first proximity switch, and the fixed end is welded on a wall body; at first detection portion, first support is welded respectively to second detection portion and third detection portion, at three proximity switch of first shelf location, wherein the position that first proximity switch and third proximity switch accessed is unchangeable, the second proximity switch signal gets into well side control system simultaneously, also get into foreign side control system, only first proximity switch, second proximity switch and third proximity switch, the signal is lost respectively simultaneously to the second proximity switch, just can send the fragmentation signal, the system stability has been improved, the equipment trouble because of the error signal causes has been reduced.

title_en: Columnar tuning fork crystal convenient to install
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a column tuning fork crystal convenient to installation, concretely relates to tuning fork crystal technical field, including shell, base, tuning fork wafer and two metal pins, spacing spout has been seted up at the base top, inside the tuning fork wafer was established at the base top and was extended into spacing spout, the second recess has been seted up to the base bottom, the inside connecting plate that is equipped with of second recess, metal pin and connecting plate fixed connection, the base both sides all are equipped with two telescopic machanism, a plurality of fourth recesses have been seted up on the shell inside wall, telescopic machanism extends into inside the fourth recess. The utility model discloses an in inserting the spacing spout with the tuning fork wafer, metal pin is fixed and run through the base through the connecting plate and reinsert the fifth recess with the tuning fork wafer fixed, and telescopic machanism and fourth recess cooperation make base and shell fixed, do not need welding or bonding during the installation, and the part has spacingly, and simple to operate and error rate are little.

title_en: Low-power-consumption crystal oscillator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a crystal oscillator of low-power consumption, including end block, crystal oscillator body, admission pipe, stitch and sleeve, fixed mounting has the crystal oscillator body in the middle of the top surface of end block, and the outside side of crystal oscillator body is equipped with the admission pipe, and admission pipe fixed mounting is on the top surface of end block, the basal surface both ends of end block are equipped with the sleeve, and telescopic inside has inserted the stitch. The utility model discloses just can demolish the stitch that needs used for the rotation before dispatching from the factory and then insert and place in the admission pipe, avoid its stitch just expose outside before the use, avoid damaging, and later stage crystal oscillator body also can pull down the stitch rotation after demolising and insert the admission pipe again in, be convenient for deposit.

title_en: Modular touch feedback integrated button
abstract_en: The utility model provides a modularized touch feedback integrated button, which relates to the technical field of automobile parts and comprises a shell, a touch sensor, a circuit board, a base and a vibrating motor, wherein the touch sensor and the circuit board are respectively arranged in a cavity formed after the shell is buckled with the base; the acquisition end of the touch sensor is tightly attached to the inner side of the top of the shell and used for acquiring touch pressing capacitance signals, and the acquisition end of the touch sensor is connected to the circuit board through a flexible cable; a first contact pin is arranged on the base, one end of the first contact pin is electrically connected with the circuit board, and the other end of the first contact pin is used for being connected with an external control circuit; the vibrating motor is installed outside the base, and the vibrating motor is last to be equipped with the second contact pin, and the second contact pin passes the base and is connected with the circuit board electricity. The technical problems that the traditional touch key vibration feedback is poor in consistency, high in cost, high in redevelopment difficulty and the like are solved, the user operation experience is improved, the redevelopment time is shortened, and the production cost is reduced.

title_en: Acquisition circuit for pressure transmitter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an acquisition circuit for pressure transmitter, including multichannel analog-to-digital converter U1, the data transmission module, power module and waveform filtering part, specifically, it includes that the model is AD7414-8 multichannel analog-to-digital converter U1, resistance R6, resistance R7, resistance R8, resistance R10, resistance R9, resistance R11, resistance R12, resistance R13, resistance R14, resistance R15, resistance R16, resistance R17, resistance R18, inductance L1, electric capacity C14, electric capacity C13, electric capacity C15, resistance R19, electric capacity C16, electric capacity C17, electric capacity C2, electric capacity C3, electric capacity R3 and resistance R3. By the proposal, the utility model has the advantages of simple structure, effective filtering and the like.

title_en: Circuit for realizing synchronous switch of equipment following host
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a circuit of host computer synchro switch is followed to realization equipment, including equipment power input module, host computer switch detection circuitry and equipment power switch circuit, equipment power switch circuit and equipment power input module electricity are connected, host computer switch detection circuitry is connected with host computer switching signal end and equipment power switch circuit electricity simultaneously, equipment power switch circuit is connected with a plurality of external device one-to-one electricity through a plurality of output control ends, and the output signal of equipment power switch circuit's output control end is the same start signal or the same shutdown signal with the host computer switching signal of host computer switching signal end. When the host computer is started, the external devices are also started, and when the host computer is shut down, the corresponding external devices are also shut down, namely, the external devices follow the host computer to be synchronously switched instead of independently starting or shutting down each external device, so that the operation process is simplified, and the use convenience of a hardware system is improved.

title_en: Novel MCU reset circuit device
abstract_en: A novel MCU reset circuit device comprises resistors R1-R10, capacitors C1-C2, a diode D1, triodes Q1 and Q3, an MOS tube Q2, a comparator U1 and an external switch button J1; the input end of the Reset circuit device is 3.3V voltage and outputs a Reset signal; the input end is connected with a triode Q1 and a MOS tube Q2, the triode Q1 is grounded through an external switch button J1, the triode Q1 and the MOS tube Q2 are connected with a comparator U1 through a resistor and a capacitor, the comparator U1 is connected with a diode D1 and a triode Q3, and the triode Q3 outputs a level signal serving as a Reset signal. The reset circuit device can realize two functions of reset and restoration only by one button. The operation is simple, the operation can be completely assisted by a client, and after-sales personnel are not required to go to the door to perform local program burning and updating. The duration of the recovery signal is detected during the recovery operation, so that the reset operation and the recovery operation are obviously distinguished, and the method is friendly to clients.

title_en: Reset control circuit, integrated chip and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model discloses reset control circuit, integrated chip and electronic equipment, reset control circuit includes bleeder circuit, switch circuit and charge-discharge circuit, wherein, switch circuit includes the switch tube, charge-discharge circuit includes first electric capacity, bleeder circuit is connected with switch circuit and working power supply respectively, bleeder circuit is used for dividing voltage to working power supply to the switching on and shutting off of control switch tube, charge-discharge circuit is connected with switch circuit, switch circuit is connected with working power supply, first electric capacity is used for receiving charging voltage based on switching on of switch tube, in order to output reset control signal; or the first capacitor is used for outputting the discharge voltage based on the turn-off of the switching tube. By the mode, the switch can be suitable for occasions of rapid on-off switches.

title_en: Single-ended ECL output DIP-14 crystal oscillator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a single-ended ECL output DIP-14 crystal oscillator relates to mobile communication electron technical field. The device comprises a shell, an oscillator base and an oscillator core group; the oscillator core group comprises a patch crystal oscillator, a decoupling capacitor and a substrate; the shell and the periphery of the oscillator base are welded by resistance welding. The utility model discloses a single-ended ECL output mode satisfies the diversified demand of matching peripheral circuit load.

title_en: Micro-thin-sheet tuning fork crystal piece and tuning fork crystal resonator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a little thin slice formula tuning fork crystal piece and tuning fork crystal syntonizer, tuning fork crystal piece include fixed part and vibration portion, and two vibrating arms of vibration portion include vibrating arm connection district section and laser frequency modulation district section, and the surface of fixed part is formed with two installation electrodes, and vibrating arm connection district section surface is formed with the electrode figure of being connected with the installation electrode correspondence. The electrodes at the end of the inner wall surface of any vibration arm connecting section close to the fixing part extend towards the upper and lower surfaces of the vibration arm connecting section to form groove corner electrodes respectively. The upper surface and the lower surface of the vibration arm connecting section are provided with resonant arm groove units, the top ends of a first groove and a second groove are arranged in parallel, the first groove is arranged at one end close to the surface of the inner wall, the bottom end of the first groove extends to the upper part of the cross section of the groove corner, and groove electrodes are formed in the first groove and the second groove. The micro-thin tuning fork crystal wafer improves the quality of the wafer.

title_en: Power supply circuit and switching device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model provides a relate to electronic circuit technical field, disclose a supply circuit and switching device. The power supply circuit is applied to a change-over switch comprising a coil, and comprises a first power supply, a first switch circuit, a second power supply, a second switch circuit, a backflow prevention circuit and a control circuit, wherein the first power supply is connected with the coil of the change-over switch through the first switch circuit, the second power supply is connected with the coil of the change-over switch through the backflow prevention circuit, the control circuit controls the switching states of the first switch circuit and the second switch circuit according to an input control signal, when the control signal is a first level signal, the first switch circuit is controlled to be closed, when the control signal is a second level signal, the second switch circuit is controlled to be closed, so that the first power supply supplies power for the coil of the change-over switch, and after the preset time is delayed, the first switch circuit is controlled to be opened, so that the second power supply supplies power for the coil of the change-over switch. Therefore, the power consumption of the system can be effectively reduced on the basis of ensuring the reliable closing of the change-over switch.

title_en: Self-reference RC oscillator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a self-reference RC oscillator, which comprises an annular oscillator and two equal-voltage output circuits outputting two paths of same voltage; one output of the equal voltage output circuit is connected with the ring oscillator, and the other output of the equal voltage output circuit is connected to the ring oscillator after being connected with a resistor in series. The utility model discloses simple structure, oscillation frequency precision are high, do not need complicated reference current and basic voltage and comparator module, and the design is simple, low cost.

title_en: Filter convenient to regulate and control
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a convenient wave filter of regulation and control relates to wave filter technical field, for solving current wave filter and lack effectual safety protection measure at the in-process that carries out the regulation and control, in case the wave filter takes place the electric leakage can cause the problem of harm to the control personnel safety. The utility model discloses a filter, including wave filter main part, bearing frame, closed cover box, movable clamp plate, insulating stock, sealed cover box, filter.

title_en: Network filter of plug-in structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a network filter of grafting structure, including the wave filter main part, two grafting mechanisms of the equal fixedly connected with in middle part of wave filter main part both sides, the buffer gear of the bottom fixedly connected with a plurality of evenly distributed of wave filter main part, a plurality of buffer gear is by the fixing base, two buffering dampers and buffer component are constituteed, the installation cavity has been seted up at the top of fixing base, the bottom of installation cavity is respectively through the bottom fixed connection of two buffering dampers and buffer and connecting block, and the bolster sets up between two buffering dampers, the utility model relates to a network filter of grafting structure, through two buffering dampers and buffer, can offset the relevant connecting device during operation of this wave filter basically, the vibration that produces is very strong to the injury of wave filter, and the design practicality is very strong, is showing the life who prolongs the wave filter.

title_en: Resonator convenient to installation
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the syntonizer, concretely relates to syntonizer convenient to installation, which comprises a mounting bas, the upper end contact of mount pad is connected with the syntonizer, the lower extreme of syntonizer is provided with the chimb, the lower extreme of chimb is provided with the sleeve, there is the threaded rod through threaded connection in the chimb, telescopic lateral wall sliding connection has the bayonet lock, the upper end contact connection of bayonet lock has the mount pad, the terminal welding of bayonet lock has the kicking block, the lower extreme contact connection of threaded rod has the kicking block, the spring has been cup jointed in the outside slip of bayonet lock, the lower extreme of syntonizer is provided with the pin. The utility model discloses a set up the sloping block in the outside of pin, the inclined plane of sloping block and the cooperation below the slider for the device is drawing the time, and sloping block and slider produce relative displacement, make the slider compressed tightly the inner wall in holding the hole, make the syntonizer fixed more firm, can not receive external force and lead to the syntonizer to remove.

title_en: Series excited motor-based EMC filter for electric tools
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electric tools, in particular to an EMC filter of an electric tool based on a series excited machine, which comprises a first stator, a second stator, an annular common mode inductor, a capacitor and a rotor, wherein the annular common mode inductor comprises a first annular common mode inductor H1 and a second annular common mode inductor H2; the capacitor and the annular common mode inductor are connected to two ends of power inlet wires L and N of the electric tool in parallel, the first annular common mode inductor and the second annular common mode inductor are wound on the ferrite magnetic core, a series circuit is formed among the first annular common mode inductor, the first stator and the rotor, and a series circuit is formed among the second annular common mode inductor, the second stator and the rotor. The utility model provides a one kind electric tool EMC wave filter based on series machine can restrain the electromagnetic interference that the electric tool produced in the operation.

title_en: Analog filter cover plate and filter thereof
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an analog filter apron and wave filter thereof, including the wave filter main part with cover the mechanism, the loose axle is all installed at both ends about the wave filter main part, and loose axle one end installs the connecting seat, the inside mounting hole of having seted up of connecting seat, and the mounting hole is controlled both ends and all is installed the wire harness mechanism, cover the one end that the mechanism installed in the wave filter main part, the threaded hole is seted up to the one end of wave filter main part, and screw hole one end installs the fixing base, the bracing piece is installed to the fixing base upper end. In this analog filter apron and wave filter thereof, the pencil mechanism of installing in the device can carry out the circuit of connecting through the line concentration pipe in the pencil mechanism and carry out the injecing and the constraint of position, can effectively guarantee the security of interconnecting link to the cooperation covers the mechanism and can use the closure lid to protect, can not produce and disturb and cause danger.

title_en: High-voltage frequency converter of dust removal fan of steelmaking converter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a steelmaking converter, the utility model discloses steelmaking converter dust exhausting fan's high-voltage inverter includes switch board, main control board, reset switch and triode, the main control board includes reset control chip, the voltage output interface of reserving, the main control board links to each other with dust exhausting fan, reset switch's one end links to each other with the voltage output interface that the main control board was reserved, and reset switch's the other end links to each other with the base of triode, and the collecting electrode of triode links to each other with the main control board power, and the triode projecting pole links to each other with reset control chip, presses reset switch and can realize reset function, has solved maintainer and has reset complex problem of operating procedure to high-voltage inverter, the utility model is suitable for a steelmaking converter dust exhausting fan's high-voltage inverter.

title_en: Time delay module
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a delayer module, including voltage conversion circuit, first power amplifier circuit, the first level circuit of delay unit, delay unit second grade circuit, equalizer circuit, adjustable attenuator circuit, delay unit third grade circuit, delay unit fourth grade circuit, second power amplifier circuit and control circuit, voltage conversion circuit comprises chip U3, and behind electric capacity C5, connect 5V input voltage after 3 feet of chip U3 are connected, behind electric capacity C6, output 3.3V voltage after 2 feet of chip U3, first power amplifier circuit comprises chip U13. The delayer module can flexibly design delay quantities at different levels according to delay requirements, and can meet the requirements of different delay quantities through combination.

title_en: Filter with noise reduction mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wave filter with mechanism of making an uproar falls, including last lid and bottom plate, it passes through bolt and bottom plate fixed connection to go up the lid, bottom plate top fixedly connected with fixed plate, the outer table wall of fixed plate has the baffle through spout sliding connection, baffle top fixedly connected with heat-conducting plate. The utility model discloses in, the filter body outside is equipped with the lid, be equipped with the louvre on going up the lid, the louvre below is equipped with changes the board simultaneously, when not using, can close the board that changes, prevent that the dust from falling inside the lid, avoid influencing the use of wave filter, wave filter body below is equipped with buffer gear, when the wave filter receives the impact force, the wave filter body pushes down, the baffle receives pressure and moves down and drive the fixed block and move down, the fixed block is beaten the connecting rod and is expanded, the connecting rod removes and drives the slider and slide, alleviate pressure impact force, and then the result of use of the current wave filter that has the mechanism of making an uproar of falling has been improved.

title_en: Waveform generator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a waveform generator, which comprises an industrial PC, a waveform acquisition card, a processor, an operational amplifier modulation circuit and a digital-analog converter; the industrial personal computer is internally loaded with software for generating a waveform data file, the output end of the industrial personal computer is connected with the input end of the processor, the processor is connected with and controls the operational amplifier modulation circuit and the digital-to-analog converter, the output end of the digital-to-analog converter is also connected with the input end of the operational amplifier modulation circuit, the output end of the operational amplifier modulation circuit outputs a final waveform, the output end of the operational amplifier modulation circuit is also connected with the input end of the waveform acquisition card, and the output end of the waveform acquisition card is connected with the input end of the industrial personal computer. The utility model discloses an arbitrary waveform data file can be generated to industry control PC, can export required arbitrary waveform in a flexible way, simultaneously the utility model discloses the mode that the waveform takes place has been simplified to realize high-speed conversion by digital analog converter, the cost is reduced, waveform output efficiency has been improved.

title_en: Double-switch synchronous conduction circuit applied to pulse heavy current generator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-switch synchronous conduction circuit applied to a pulse heavy current generator, which comprises a first energy storage capacitor, one end of the first energy storage capacitor is connected with a coil, one end of the coil is connected with a TVS, one end of the TVS is connected with the other end of the first energy storage capacitor, one end of the TVS is connected with a logic gate circuit, a trigger device is arranged between the TVS and the logic gate circuit, the utility model relates to the technical field of pulse heavy current generators, two vacuum trigger Tubes (TVS) with better relative performance are adopted as discharge switches, by designing the FPGA gate circuit, the self-made trigger source which can control the driving to send two paths of synchronous pulse signals with extremely short rising edge (less than or equal to 160ns), extremely high amplitude (maximally up to 20kV) and adjustable pulse (2-10 mu s) is controlled, and the pulse acts on the discharge switch, so that the multiple discharge loops are synchronously switched on.

title_en: Electronic pressure switch
abstract_en: An electronic pressure switch, the upper end of the body has open cavities, the lower end surface is equipped with the base assembly in the open cavity, the opening of the upper end of open cavity embeds and closes the plug assembly, there is a circuit board assembly between upper end of the base assembly and the lower end of the plug assembly, there is a push rod assembly to pass the lower end of the body in the middle of the base assembly, there are reset springs between shell and the push rod assembly, there are hall switches on the circuit board assembly; the upper end of the push rod component is provided with a magnet. The advantages are that: no mechanical contact, no electric spark, stable switching signal, no instant shake, high reliability and high anti-interference performance.

title_en: Asynchronous communication circuit
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model relates to the technical field of communication, and discloses an asynchronous communication circuit, which comprises at least two asynchronous communication devices, a main controller, at least two level compatible circuits and a level compatible control circuit, wherein the at least two level compatible circuits are respectively connected with the at least two asynchronous communication devices, the level compatible control circuit is respectively connected with the at least two level compatible circuits and the main controller, the level compatible control circuit can select the asynchronous communication devices which need to communicate according to a control signal output by the main controller, and with asynchronous communication signal send to main control unit, the embodiment of the utility model provides an asynchronous communication circuit can realize multichannel asynchronous communication through level compatible control circuit, realizes that the level is compatible through level compatible circuit adjustment communication signal's level simultaneously.

title_en: Electrostatic protection circuit
abstract_en: The utility model provides an electrostatic protection circuit, wherein, this electrostatic protection circuit includes: the detection circuit is connected between the power line and the ground line and used for detecting an electrostatic discharge (ESD) event; and the protection circuit is connected between the detection circuit and the discharge tube and is used for closing the discharge tube and providing a positive feedback level for the discharge tube when no ESD event occurs. Through the utility model discloses, solved the technical problem that electrostatic protection circuit's electric leakage risk is big among the correlation technique, improved integrated circuit's security and stability.

title_en: Buddha praying counter with counting uploading function and Buddha praying counting system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a can read Buddha counter and can read Buddha counting system of uploading function on area count, the can read Buddha counter of uploading function includes trigger and wireless communication circuit on the area count, and wireless communication circuit is connected with the output electricity of trigger, and wireless communication circuit is connected with the external terminal communication. The utility model provides the convenience of chanting the use of Buddha counter is improved.

title_en: Conversion circuit for converting level signal into monopulse signal
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a level signal changes single pulse signal's converting circuit relates to level signal changes single pulse signal's method and circuit field. The method for converting the level signal into the single pulse signal and the conversion circuit have the advantages of being exquisite in structure, good in stability and high in reliability, being capable of stably converting the level signal into the single pulse circuit and effectively avoiding accidental shutdown of a system due to mistaken touch in the using process. The circuit comprises a level signal generating circuit, a delay conducting circuit, a level overturning circuit, a self-locking circuit and a delay switching-off circuit. Firstly, a level signal is generated, then the level signal is output as a single-pulse signal through a conversion circuit, and finally the single-pulse signal is used as a starting signal required by a computer system. The hidden danger of the traditional starting circuit in the industrial robot control system can be eliminated, and the reliability of the industrial robot control system is improved.

title_en: Device for improving intelligence of children through direct current stimulation
abstract_en: The utility model provides a device for improving children intelligence through direct current stimulation belongs to medical equipment's technical field. A device for improving children intelligence by DC stimulation comprises a rotator, a bracket, a connecting belt, a controller, a cathode sheet and an anode sheet; the utility model discloses a two contact tube overcoat in the pivot of circulator are equipped with a plurality of curved supports, make support accessible circulator expand or close, convenient storage, portability is higher, and be provided with elastic contact between curved support and the contact tube that corresponds, realize controller and negative pole piece through elastic contact and contact tube, the electricity of positive pole piece is connected, in addition, the caulking groove of alternative installation positive pole piece or negative pole piece has all been seted up on each support, the expansion of stimulation point quantity has been realized, and the state that accessible control support turned angle and connecting band both ends on the circulator are connected realizes the control to the space size that the support expanded back enclosed, thereby adapt to different users, adaptability is improved.

title_en: X-waveband ultra-low phase noise oscillator
abstract_en: The application provides an X wave band ultra-low phase oscillator that makes an uproar, X wave band ultra-low phase oscillator includes: the system comprises a radio frequency comb spectrum circuit, a high-frequency doubling circuit, a locking monitoring module and a power supply module; the input end of the radio frequency comb spectrum circuit is connected with the dot frequency reference signal, the output end of the radio frequency comb spectrum circuit is connected with the input end of the high-frequency doubling circuit, the output of the high-frequency doubling circuit is an X-waveband radio frequency signal, the input end of the power module is connected with an external power signal, and the output end of the power module is respectively connected with the radio frequency comb spectrum circuit, the high-frequency doubling circuit and the locking monitoring module, so that the reliability is improved.

title_en: One-way hysteresis comparator circuit and electronic device
abstract_en: The application discloses a one-way hysteresis comparator circuit and an electronic device. The one-way hysteresis comparator circuit includes a differential input pair of transistors and a current mirror as a load for the differential input pair of transistors. The differential input pair of transistors includes a first input transistor for receiving a first voltage and a second input transistor for receiving a second voltage. By flexibly changing the load of the first input tube and/or the second input tube, the hysteresis voltage of the one-way hysteresis comparator circuit can be changed.

title_en: 24 way merit divides ware
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a 24-path power divider, which comprises: the device comprises a plurality of signal driver units, a power supply unit, an indicator lamp driving unit and a signal input end; the signal input end is connected with the input end of the indicator light driving unit and is also connected with 4 input ends of each signal driver unit through resistors on the equal-length line; a plurality of output ends of the plurality of signal driver units are used as 24 output ends of the 24-path power divider; the output end of the power supply unit is respectively connected with the power supply ends of the signal driver units and the power supply end of the indicator lamp driving unit; the utility model solves the problem of limited driving capability of the pulse-per-second signal power divider of the time service equipment.

title_en: Low-noise amplifying circuit
abstract_en: The utility model provides a low-noise amplification circuit which comprises a low-noise amplifier, wherein a radio-frequency input end of the low-noise amplifier is electrically connected with an input filter circuit and then is connected with a radio-frequency signal, and a radio-frequency output end of the low-noise amplifier is electrically connected with a coupling capacitor C117 and a direct-current power supply and outputs the amplified radio-frequency signal. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: the gain amplification of the radio frequency signal (S frequency band) is realized, the circuit structure is simple, the miniaturization degree is high, the power consumption is low, and the problem that the satellite communication radio frequency front end in the prior art can not be well considered in low noise amplification and adaptation to a wider working frequency band is solved.

title_en: Frequency divider, clock signal generation circuit, and electronic device
abstract_en: The application provides a frequency divider, a clock signal generation circuit and an electronic device. The frequency divider includes: the first signal generating unit generates a first signal sequence including at least one first signal, each set of clock signals of the clock signal sequence including 2n +1 clock signals; transition edges of the first signal corresponding to transition edges of an n +2 th clock signal of the set of clock signals; an inverting unit; the second signal generating unit generates a second signal sequence comprising at least one second signal, wherein transition edges of the second signal correspond to transition edges of a 1 st inverted clock signal in the group of inverted clock signals, and the inverted transition edges correspond to transition edges of an n +1 th inverted clock signal; the combinational logic unit carries out combinational logic operation on the first signal sequence and the second signal sequence; the frequency division unit is used for generating a 2n +1 frequency division signal sequence with equal duty ratio. The probability of competition adventure can be reduced, and the probability of signal burr generation is reduced.

title_en: High-voltage multiplexer of multi-channel battery monitoring switch
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-voltage multiplexer of a multi-path battery monitoring switch, which comprises a driving circuit, a bias module and a switch module, wherein the high-voltage multiplexer of the battery monitoring switch also comprises the bias module and the switch module; a biasing module: providing bias voltage or bias current for the switch module and the driving circuit; a switch module: and the input voltage signals of the multiple batteries are collected through the control of the driving circuit. The utility model has the following advantages: the high-voltage multiplexer of the multi-path battery monitoring switch has the advantages of simple structure and high reliability; can guarantee that voltage transmission module closes strictly, other switches can not open by mistake simultaneously, and the opening of normal passageway is not influenced to the passageway that other strictly close.

title_en: Touch device with vibration feedback
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a touch device with vibration feedback, which comprises a panel bracket and a PCB main controller arranged in the panel bracket, wherein the PCB main controller is electrically connected with a touch panel and a vibration actuator, the panel bracket comprises a fixed part and a moving part, a spring structure is arranged between the fixed part and the moving part, a stress sensor is arranged on the spring structure, the stress sensor is electrically connected with the PCB main controller, and the touch panel and the vibration actuator are arranged on the moving part. According to the utility model, the resistance-type stress sensor is arranged on the spring structure, so that the elastic deformation of the spring structure caused by the pressure applied to the touch panel by the finger is converted into the change of the resistance value, the finger pressure can be back-calculated and the value is sent to the PCB main controller in real time, the PCB main controller outputs a vibration request signal to the vibration actuator according to the received pressure value, the vibration amplitude of the vibration actuator can be controlled, and the strength control of vibration feedback is realized.

title_en: Low-delay Bluetooth conference system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a low-delay Bluetooth conference system which comprises a machine body, an electromagnetic shielding layer and a filter, wherein the electromagnetic shielding layer is arranged on the wall of the periphery in the machine body, an installation plate is fixed in the middle of the machine body, a Bluetooth module is arranged in the middle above the installation plate, and one side of the Bluetooth module is connected with the filter. The beneficial effects are that: according to the Bluetooth wireless power supply device, the electromagnetic shielding layer and the filter are arranged, electromagnetic interference can be shielded through the electromagnetic shielding layer, then signal interference is filtered through the filter, delay of Bluetooth in transmission is reduced, stability of the Bluetooth wireless power supply device is guaranteed, the charging interface, the voltage stabilizer and the storage battery are arranged, the storage battery can be charged through the charging interface, stability of voltage during charging is guaranteed through the voltage stabilizer, power can be supplied to the Bluetooth wireless power supply device through the storage battery, an external circuit is not needed to be used through pulling, the Bluetooth wireless power supply device is convenient to use, and practicability of the Bluetooth wireless power supply device is improved.

title_en: Double-redundancy position switch
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dual-redundancy position switch, which is arranged on a cabin door, wherein a shell of the position switch is in direct contact with the cabin door, a target is arranged on a cabin door frame, a sensing surface of the position switch corresponds to the target, when the cabin door is opened, the target is far away from the sensing surface of the position switch, a Hall integrated circuit in the position switch outputs a high-level signal, when the cabin door is closed, the target is close to the sensing surface of the position switch, the Hall integrated circuit in the position switch outputs a low-level signal, and the position information of the cabin door can be obtained through the voltage value of the signal; the position switch comprises two independent position information detection processing circuits. The position switch adopts a dual-redundancy design, and has the advantages of reliable work, simple structure, convenient manufacture, small volume and strong electromagnetic environment effect protection capability.

title_en: AC bus switch control circuit
abstract_en: An alternating current bus switch control circuit comprises a direct current power supply circuit, a one-way conduction element D1, a resistor R1, a bootstrap capacitor C1, a first switch Q1 and a second switch Q2. The first end of the one-way conduction element D1 is connected to the output end of the dc power supply circuit, and the second end is connected to the first end of the resistor R1 and the bootstrap capacitor C1, respectively. The second terminals of the resistor R1 and the bootstrap capacitor C1 are connected to the first conductive terminals of the first switch Q1 and the second switch Q2, respectively. The second conducting terminals of the first switch Q1 and the second switch Q2 are both grounded. The control terminal of the first switch Q1 and the control terminal of the second switch Q2 are respectively used for receiving an externally input control signal. The common junction of the resistor R1 and the first switch Q1 is connected to the control end of the alternating current bus switch, and the common junction of the bootstrap capacitor C1 and the second switch Q2 is connected to the second conduction end of the alternating current bus switch. The utility model is composed of a small number of discrete devices, has low cost and is easy to realize.

title_en: Ultrasonic signal conditioning circuit and flowmeter
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an ultrasonic signal conditioning circuit and a flow meter, the circuit comprising: the power supply circuit, the at least one stage of amplifying circuit and the filter circuit; the power circuit is respectively connected with the amplifying circuit and the filtering circuit. According to the technical scheme, by adding the bipolar power supply, more ideal working conditions are provided for the operational amplifier, and the performance of the operational amplifier is improved; according to the technical scheme, a blocking capacitor and bias voltage are omitted, the complexity and noise input of a power supply are reduced, the alternating current response performance of a circuit is improved, and the problem of reduction of isolation caused by the bias voltage among multiple stages is solved. According to the technical scheme, the signal conditioning part adopts multi-stage amplification, so that the requirement on the performance of the device is reduced.

title_en: Filter capable of reducing thickness of module
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the wave filter technique and specifically relates to a reduce wave filter of module thickness, including module and wave filter, set up flutedly on the module diapire, the wave filter lower extreme is the boss, the boss can peg graft into in the recess, the equal fixedly connected with circuit board in both ends of wave filter, two equal fixedly connected with insulator on the circuit board, the insulator with the wave filter is connected, be provided with fixed establishment on the wave filter, be provided with the module apron in the module. The utility model discloses the thickness that has reduced the installation back module has to the volume has been reduced.

title_en: Radio frequency amplifier circuit and radio frequency chip
abstract_en: The utility model provides a radio frequency amplifier circuit and radio frequency chip, radio frequency amplifier circuit includes input matching circuit, first electric capacity, biasing circuit, radio frequency amplification transistor, first inductance, output matching circuit, low pass filter, resonant network module, second resistance and third electric capacity, low pass filter includes second inductance and second electric capacity; the resonant network module includes a first resistor and a fourth capacitor. Compared with the prior art, adopt the utility model discloses a good just gain height of radio frequency amplifier circuit and radio frequency chip's circuit stability.

title_en: Multi-mode multi-frequency power amplifier, radio frequency system and communication equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses multimode multifrequency power amplifier, radio frequency system and communications facilities, multimode multifrequency power amplifier includes: a control and low frequency amplification module for amplifying a low frequency band input signal to provide a low frequency band output signal and outputting a control signal based on an input signal type of the multi-mode multi-band power amplifier; the non-low frequency amplification module is used for amplifying the middle-frequency band input signal to provide a middle-frequency band output signal and amplifying the high-frequency band input signal to provide a high-frequency band output signal; and the switch module is used for selectively outputting the output signals of the corresponding types according to the control signals, and the control and low-frequency amplification module is prepared by adopting a CMOS (complementary metal oxide semiconductor) process. The multimode multi-frequency power amplifier provided by the application integrates the low-frequency amplifying circuit and the control circuit on the same die by adopting a CMOS (complementary metal oxide semiconductor) process, so that the production cost is reduced, the integration level of the multimode multi-frequency power amplifier is improved, and the electrical performance of the multimode multi-frequency power amplifier is further ensured.

title_en: Novel high-stability quartz crystal oscillator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel high stability quartzy crystal oscillator, including the crystal oscillator main part set up the quartz plate in the main part, the main part includes first shell and second shell, establishes second shell cover the inside of first shell set up spacing subassembly in the main part, spacing subassembly sets up the ejector pin including setting up the spacing hole on the first shell in second shell bottom, the ejector pin through first elastic component with second shell is connected, and lateral sliding is in gag lever post in the second shell, the gag lever post is connected with the second elastic component in the second shell set up first inclined plane on the ejector pin set up the second inclined plane on the gag lever post, work as when the ejector pin removes to the second shell, the gag lever post removes to keeping away from the second shell. When realizing that the quartz piece is not broken, spacing all the time between first shell and the second shell, after the quartz piece was broken, first shell and second shell can be demolishd easily, and easy operation is convenient.

title_en: Frequency regulating circuit of constant temperature crystal oscillator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a frequency adjusting circuit of a constant temperature crystal oscillator, which comprises a constant temperature crystal oscillator, a frequency divider, a frequency-voltage conversion unit and a negative feedback amplification control unit; the input end of the frequency divider is electrically connected with the output end of the constant-temperature crystal oscillator, and the frequency divider is used for dividing the frequency of an output signal of the constant-temperature crystal oscillator; the input end of the frequency-voltage conversion unit is electrically connected with the output end of the frequency divider, and the frequency-voltage conversion unit is used for converting the frequency signal output by the frequency divider into a voltage signal; the negative feedback amplification control unit is respectively electrically connected with the frequency-voltage conversion unit and the constant temperature crystal oscillator, and is used for amplifying the voltage signal output by the frequency-voltage conversion unit and sending the voltage signal to the voltage tuning end of the constant temperature crystal oscillator. According to the utility model discloses a constant temperature crystal oscillator's frequency control circuit can effectively improve constant temperature crystal oscillator's long-term frequency stability, and entire system is comparatively simple, realizes with low costs.

title_en: Touch device and household appliance
abstract_en: The application discloses touch device and domestic appliance, touch device includes main control board, touch pad and one or more infrared transceiver module. The touch pad and the main control board are arranged at intervals, and the touch pad is provided with a light-transmitting touch area. Infrared transceiver module includes infrared transmitter, infrared receiver and separates the optical element, infrared transmitter and infrared receiver all locate between touch panel and the main control board, infrared transmitter and infrared receiver all with main control board electric connection, at least one relative touch panel slope sets up in infrared transmitter and the infrared receiver, separate the optical element and set up in the main control board, separate the optical element and be located between infrared transmitter and the infrared receiver to the infrared light of avoiding infrared transmitter to send is by infrared receiver direct receiving. The touch device can enable infrared signals emitted by the infrared emitter to be directly and rapidly received by the infrared receiver, so that the sensitivity of the touch device is improved.

title_en: SAW resonator of aluminum nitride-based heterogeneous acoustic layer
abstract_en: The application discloses a SAW resonator of an aluminum nitride-based heterogeneous acoustic layer, which is used for improving the performance of the resonator. The resonator of the application comprises: the device comprises a heterogeneous acoustic layer HAL structure, an input interdigital transducer IDT, an output IDT, a first phononic crystal and a plurality of second phononic crystals; the HAL structure comprises a piezoelectric layer and a composite substrate, wherein the piezoelectric material of the piezoelectric layer is a scandium-doped aluminum nitride material; the input IDT and the output IDT are respectively arranged on the piezoelectric layer; a first phononic crystal embedded in the piezoelectric layer and located between the input IDT and the output IDT for constructing a defect zone by the first phononic crystal such that an acoustic wave of the input IDT propagates through the defect zone to the output IDT; the input IDT includes an input bus bar and the output IDT includes an output bus bar; the plurality of second photonic crystals are respectively embedded into the piezoelectric layer, are respectively positioned at two ends of the input bus bar and two ends of the output bus bar, and are used for reflecting sound waves through the second photonic crystals.

title_en: Power amplifier convenient to remove dust
abstract_en: The application relates to a power amplifier convenient to remove dust relates to power amplification technical field. The amplifier comprises an amplifier shell, wherein a dust removal part, a cooling fan and an amplification module are fixedly connected in the amplifier shell, an air inlet hole is formed in the side wall of the amplifier shell and used for separating dust in air, the dust removal part is communicated with the air inlet hole, and air outlet holes are formed in different sides of the air inlet hole. The radiator fan operates, and the air gets into dust removal piece earlier through the inlet port, through dust removal piece with the mixed dust separation in the air, later the air is discharged from dust removal piece and is discharged from the venthole through amplifying module, has alleviated the problem of the ash that advances when power amplifier dispels the heat.

title_en: Low-pass filtering device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model discloses a low-pass filtering device, including first signal adjustment module, first LRC primary filter module, first LRC secondary filter module, first output mode change over switch module, first decay module, second signal adjustment module, second LRC primary filter module, second LRC secondary filter module, second output mode change over switch module and second decay module; the audio is filtered in advance, so that the audio analyzer and the audio acquisition card are connected, the performance test of the product is not interfered, and the signal is not attenuated.

title_en: High-voltage bus filtering device, vehicle-mounted high-voltage device and vehicle
abstract_en: The application discloses a high-voltage bus filtering device, a vehicle-mounted high-voltage device and a vehicle, wherein a substrate is provided with a first through hole for penetrating a high-voltage conductor; the conductive component at least covers the inner surface of the first through hole; the copper cladding surrounds the periphery of the conductive assembly and covers the surface of the substrate, the conductive assembly is connected with an external conductive structure, and the copper cladding is divided into an inner ring and an outer ring by a middle fracture zone; the filter assembly is arranged on the fracture zone in a circle mode; the conductive assembly, the copper clad and the filter assembly together form a conductive path connecting the high voltage conductor and the external conductive structure. According to the technical scheme that this application embodiment provided, through the conductive component who sets up, cover copper and filter component go out ground connection with common mode current conduction, realize the purpose of filtering, in order to guarantee this filter equipment's filter effect, cover corresponding filter and conductive device setting on the surface of base plate, realized the face-to-face connection between filter and the high-voltage bus to this filter equipment's filter effect has been guaranteed.

title_en: High voltage switching circuit
abstract_en: The application discloses a high-voltage switch circuit, which comprises a first current source, a first signal end, a second signal end, a first switch, a second switch, a current-voltage converter, a first control switch and a common joint, wherein the first current source outputs a first current signal, the first switch and the second switch are respectively coupled with the first signal end and the second signal end correspondingly, the second switch is coupled with the first switch to form a first voltage control signal end, the current-voltage converter is provided with a first end and a second end, the first end is coupled with the first switch and the second switch to form a second voltage control signal end, the second voltage control signal end generates a voltage control signal according to the first current signal, the first control switch is coupled with the second end to form a voltage signal end, and the common joint is coupled with the first control switch; the voltage control signal end is isolated, and the stability of circuit control is improved.

title_en: Power amplifier protection circuit and radio frequency equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a power amplifier protection circuit and radio frequency equipment, and relates to the technical field of radio frequency. The micro-strip coupler is arranged between the push amplifier and the final amplifier which are included in the power amplifier cascade circuit, the push amplifier is mutually cascaded with the final amplifier through the micro-strip coupler, the push amplifier is connected with the negative feedback circuit through the controllable switch, the first power detection circuit electrically connected with the micro-strip coupler detects whether the first output power of the push amplifier exceeds a saturation power threshold value, the controllable switch is controlled to be conducted when the first output power of the push amplifier exceeds the saturation power threshold value, the negative feedback circuit shares the power of the push amplifier, and therefore the saturated output power of the push amplifier is limited, the overall gain of the power amplifier cascade circuit is reduced, the final amplifier is effectively protected, the maintenance cost of the power amplifier cascade circuit is effectively reduced, and the product stability and the product reliability of the power amplifier cascade circuit are improved.

title_en: Low-pass filter with good weather resistance
abstract_en: The application provides a low pass filter that weatherability is good, comprises a box bod, the bottom of box body is provided with mounting plate, and is provided with installation mechanism between mounting plate and the box body. This application is through first sealing mechanism and second sealing mechanism's use, the connected mode of first sealing strip and first recess is the block with the connected mode of second sealing strip and second recess and is connected, when mounting plate card advances first mounting groove and box body fixed connection, can extrude the inside first sealed pad of first recess through first sealing strip, promote its leakproofness, simultaneously extrude the inside second sealed pad of second recess through the second sealing strip on surface as the heat-conducting plate, conveniently promote low pass filter's leakproofness, possess waterproof performance, promote weather resistance, inside avoiding rivers to flow into the wave filter, influence the normal work of wave filter or damage the wave filter, influence the life of whole equipment.

title_en: Silicon carbide MOSFET driving circuit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of silicon carbide MOSFET drive, and discloses a silicon carbide MOSFET drive circuit, which comprises a light-emitting circuit and a light source, wherein the light-emitting circuit is arranged to provide a light source; the photosensitive circuit comprises an output end and an input end, generates charging current when receiving the light emitted by the light-emitting circuit, and the output end is configured to be electrically connected with the grid electrode of the silicon carbide MOSFET; load current return circuit, including first link and second link, first link is connected with carborundum MOSFET's source electrode electricity, and the second link is connected with the input electricity, when in-service use, the circuit structure of the utility model is simple, through setting up lighting circuit and photosensitive circuit, when lighting circuit sent out light, photosensitive circuit produced charging current based on the light that lighting circuit produced, and this charging current inputs carborundum MOSFET's grid and charges, makes carborundum MOSFET grid voltage rise, and when carborundum MOSFET's grid and the voltage difference of source electrode were greater than its threshold voltage, carborundum MOSFET switched on to realize carborundum MOSFET's switching on and turn-off the drive.

title_en: Sound wave test system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sound wave test system, sound wave test system includes: the power amplifier comprises a transformer and a capacitor array, wherein one end of the transformer is connected with the output end of the power amplifier, the other end of the transformer is connected with the first end of the capacitor array, and the second end of the capacitor array is connected with an inductance coil; the transformer is a transformer with an adjustable turn ratio. The utility model discloses can greatly reduced research and development cost and research and development time.

title_en: Time delay device for observation cabinet door of combined sampling machine
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a time delay device for an observation cabinet door of a combined sampling machine, which is used for improving the safety of the working environment of sampling workers. The method in the embodiment of the application comprises the following steps: the device comprises a control module, a time delay device and an observation cabinet door; the control module is used for controlling the working state of the combined sampling machine and is electrically connected with the observation cabinet door through the time delay device; the delay device at least comprises an intermediate relay and a time relay; the observation cabinet door comprises a limiting module and an electronic lock, the electronic lock is electrically connected with the time delay device, and the electronic lock is controlled by the time relay and the time relay.

title_en: Low noise amplifier with protection function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a low noise amplifier with protect function, including protection casing, protection cap, inside bearing structure, amplifier main part, limit structure, buffer structure and heat radiation structure, the both sides of protection casing and front department all are open type design, the both sides department of protection casing all is provided with curb plate A, two semi-circular groove has all been seted up to curb plate A department, the protection cap is through a plurality of fastener fixed mounting in the front opening part of protection casing, the both sides department of protection cap all is provided with curb plate B, two semi-circular groove has all been seted up equally to curb plate B department, inside bearing structure installs in the inside of protection casing, amplifier main part movable mounting is in inside bearing structure department. The utility model discloses it is better to the ventilation cooling circulation cooling effect of amplifier main part, and efficiency is higher to effectually avoided the amplifier main part to damage because of inside high temperature trouble, then effectual its life that has prolonged.

title_en: Annular plate-carried sine wave filter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an annular plate-carried sine wave filter, which comprises a bottom plate, a PCB arranged on the bottom plate and a top cover; the PCB is provided with a plurality of annular inductors and a plurality of capacitors, on-board terminal blocks are symmetrically arranged at two ends of the PCB, the annular inductors adopt sendust magnetic rings, and the PCB is fixedly connected with the bottom plate; the two sides of the bottom plate are vertically bent upwards to form side plates, the side plates are in an isosceles trapezoid shape, the lower ends of the side plates are lower bottoms of the isosceles trapezoid shape, the top cover is fixedly connected to the upper ends of the side plates, the length of the top cover is the same as that of the upper ends of the side plates, when the filter is viewed from the top, the annular inductor and the capacitor are completely shielded by the top cover, and the on-board terminal block is positioned outside the top cover; the two sides of the bottom plate are symmetrically provided with connecting grooves. The utility model discloses a sendust magnetic ring carries out the preparation of inductance, assembles electric capacity and loop type inductance on the PCB board, can satisfy the normal work under the high frequency characteristic, and is small, and the manufacturing is simple, and the inductance balance degree is good, and the inductance is stable, and the noise is little, with low costs, and the appearance is pleasing to the eye, simple to operate.

title_en: Novel touch device and touch equipment and water dispenser thereof
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel touch device and touch equipment, water dispenser thereof relates to and separates empty touch-control technical field, has solved sensitivity low, the poor technical problem of interference killing feature. The novel touch device comprises a control panel, a touch chip, at least one induction device and at least one indicating device; the touch areas are located on a face shell of the touch equipment and used for touch operation, and each touch area is arranged in one-to-one correspondence with each sensing device in spatial position. The utility model discloses an induction element can be conductive structure, capacitanc LED lamp, electric capacity response dish etc. and is close to or touches when the live body during the touch region, forms induction capacitance between live body and the induction element, and the touch-control chip carries out the analysis to induction capacitance and generates the response result and send to the control panel to trigger and carry out corresponding operation, greatly reduced production installation technology and cost, improved touch-control operation's sensitivity and interference killing feature greatly, promoted touch-control product property ability and user use experience.

title_en: Micro-electromechanical system resonator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a micro-electromechanical system syntonizer relates to micro-electromechanical system technical field. The micro electro mechanical system resonator comprises a harmonic oscillator and a coupling beam; one end of the coupling beam is fixedly connected with the harmonic oscillator, and the other end of the coupling beam is used for being connected with the anchoring body; the harmonic oscillator is used for twisting around the extension direction of the coupling beam in a first driving mode and driving the coupling beam to twist; the harmonic oscillator is also used for at least partially radially extending and contracting in the second driving mode and driving the coupling beam to extend and contract. The MEMS resonator can output two frequencies, namely one frequency as an operating frequency and one frequency as a function of temperature. A structure achieves two functions, can be used as a working frequency output resonator, can also be used as a temperature sensitive sensor, thereby consuming less power and/or reducing the space occupancy rate, and can provide a more accurate temperature measurement result to be used as a reference for generating a temperature compensated frequency signal when being used as the temperature sensitive sensor.

title_en: Clock synchronization pulse output circuit and vehicle automatic driving system thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a clock synchronization pulse output circuit and vehicle autopilot system relates to clock synchronization technical field, and this clock synchronization pulse output circuit includes: the circuit comprises a circuit input end, a preceding stage driving module, an output module and a circuit output end; the input end of the preceding stage driving module is connected with the input end of the circuit, and the output end of the preceding stage driving module is connected with the input end of the output module; the output module is connected with the output end of the circuit; the output module comprises a level output gating module and a constant current source circuit; the level output gating module comprises at least two level output switches connected with the constant current source circuit, and one of the level output switches is selected to be conducted; the input end of the constant current source circuit is connected with the output end of the preceding stage driving module, and the output end of the constant current source circuit is connected with the output end of the circuit. The application also provides a vehicle autopilot system. The technical problem that a clock synchronization circuit can only output one level in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Intelligent switch of moisture-proof protection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent switch of moisture-proof protection, including switch main part, protection machanism and complementary unit, the top of switch main part is provided with protection machanism, and the rear of switch main part is provided with complementary unit, protection machanism includes rubber buffer, rubber strip and charging socket, and the right-hand member of rubber buffer is connected with the rubber strip, the right-hand charging socket that is provided with of rubber strip. This intelligent switch of moisture protection, because scene subregion button gomphosis is inboard in the front end of shell, therefore the scene subregion button is not protruding, better aesthetic property has, different fluorescence sign corresponds different scene subregion buttons, be convenient for distinguish, the setting up of fluorescence sign does benefit to the supplementary viewing at night simultaneously, when charging socket does not use, the user plugs the rubber buffer to charging socket inside, thereby effectually shelter from charging socket, reduce the entering of moisture and dust, protect charging socket, when needs charge, pull out the rubber buffer can.

title_en: Bias circuit applied to radio frequency power amplifier
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a be applied to radio frequency power amplifier's bias circuit, it includes linear compensation module and steady voltage and temperature compensation module, steady voltage and temperature compensation module include the second transistor, the third transistor, the fourth transistor, the third resistance, fourth resistance and fifth resistance, the collecting electrode of second transistor is connected with the one end of third resistance and is connected with linear compensation module, the other end and the reference voltage of third resistance are connected, the projecting pole of second transistor and the base of third transistor, the collecting electrode is connected jointly, the projecting pole ground connection of third transistor, the base of second transistor and the one end of fourth resistance, the collecting electrode of fourth transistor, the base of fourth transistor is connected jointly, the other end and the reference voltage of fourth resistance are connected, the projecting pole of fourth transistor is connected with the one end of fifth resistance, the other end ground connection of fifth resistance. The utility model discloses a bias circuit can provide voltage compensation and temperature compensation for radio frequency power amplifier, makes radio frequency power amplifier can be stable, linear work in the application environment of complicacy.

title_en: High-voltage IGBT drive circuit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a power electronic technology field, in particular to a high-voltage IGBT drive circuit, wherein the drive circuit integrates MOSFET at the front stage and integrates an amplifying circuit at the rear stage, wherein the amplifying circuit is triode push-pull output or MOSFET output; the integrated short-circuit protection circuit that has of drive circuit, short-circuit protection circuit has reduced to saturation value UCEsat or load Ic when increasing 4 times to the rated value at collecting electrode and interelectrode voltage, control IGBT drive circuit withdraws from the saturation, the utility model discloses a discrete components and parts and little integrated fiber transceiver of encapsulation build the drive circuit of the high-power IGBT device of high busbar voltage, satisfy product electrical clearance and creepage distance performance demand, the design is nimble changeable practices thrift the space, and ductility is good, has powerful protection circuit to operate the safe and reliable steady operation protection navigation for the product, uses in electric wire netting power transmission and distribution circuit key device in batches at present, and the behavior is good.

title_en: Multilayer structure filter and vehicle mounted power supply DCDC conversion equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multilayer structure filter and a vehicle-mounted power supply DCDC conversion device, wherein the multilayer structure filter comprises N layers of PCBs which are arranged at intervals in sequence from top to bottom, and N is more than or equal to 3; n-1-stage output inductors are sequentially arranged at intervals from top to bottom, and each stage of output inductor is correspondingly connected to the adjacent upper and lower layers of PCBs through the input end and the output end of each stage of output inductor; n-1-stage output capacitors are sequentially arranged at intervals from top to bottom, and each stage of output capacitor is correspondingly connected to the second layer to the Nth layer of PCB respectively; and the filter output terminal is connected to the output end of the N-1 stage output inductor. This multilayer structure wave filter and use its vehicle mounted power DCDC conversion device, to the output filter among the vehicle mounted power conversion product DCDC converter, provide a multilayer structure wave filter, realize that the wave filter is miniaturized and save installation space to realize better heat dissipation, filtering and the shielding function in DCDC converter output heavy current route.

title_en: Microwave power amplifier
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a power amplifier technical field to a microwave power amplifier is disclosed, which comprises an outer shell, two installing ports have been seted up on the shell the dust screen is all installed, two to the inner face of installing port all seted up on the dust screen and avoided the mouth, the inside of shell is provided with mutually supported radiator unit and water conservancy diversion subassembly, still be provided with the deashing subassembly on the shell. The utility model provides a microwave power amplifier has replaced traditional microwave power amplifier's heat radiation structure, can enlarge radiator fan's heat dissipation area, guarantees microwave power amplifier's heat dispersion, can also avoid the dust to cause the phenomenon appearance of jam to two dust screens for the air current can be smoothly through two dust screens, and then guarantees microwave power amplifier's heat dispersion.

title_en: Multi-frequency-multiplication ultra-wideband coupler
abstract_en: The utility model provides a frequency multiplication ultra-wideband coupler, which comprises a double-core wire constant coupling module; the two-core fixed coupling module comprises a two-core cable WT1 and a two-core cable WT2; one cable input end of the double-core cable WT1 is used for inputting signals, one cable output end of the double-core cable WT1 is connected with one cable input end of the double-core cable WT2, and one cable output end of the double-core cable WT2 is used for outputting signals; the second cable output end of the double-core cable WT1 and the second cable input end of the double-core cable WT2 are respectively connected with a leveling correction module. The coupler can level and correct the signal waveform obtained by coupling, so that the coupled waveform is oblique and smooth, the power fluctuation is reduced under the condition of ensuring the poor standing wave of the ultra-short wave antenna, the working stability of the power amplifier is improved, and the running stability and reliability of a high-frequency communication system are improved.

title_en: Communication filter with protection heat dissipation function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a communication filter with protection heat dissipation function, the inside of riser is equipped with stop gear one, the top fixedly connected with dust screen of annular slab is first, the outside side of communication filter protective housing is equipped with a plurality of stop gear two, two sides all are inserted and are equipped with dustproof otter board two about the communication filter protective housing, the inside of communication filter protective housing is equipped with the communication filter body.
