The utility model can cool the communication filter body by cold air after cooling through the arrangement of the fan, the conical big opening, the conical small opening and other structures, thereby preventing the communication filter body from generating excessive heat during operation and being prevented from being discharged, and further preventing the communication filter body from being damaged; through setting up stop gear one and stop gear two, can be convenient for respectively dismantle and install dust screen one and dust screen board two, avoid dust screen one and dust screen board two live time overlength, dust to pile up too much and reduce the heat dissipation function.

title_en: Phase-locked loop, system, digital chip and radar sensor for quick locking
abstract_en: The application provides a phase-locked loop, a system, a digital chip and a radar sensor for quick locking. The phase-locked loop includes: a charge pump outputting a current in response to the frequency-phase-discrimination detection signal; the low-pass filter is connected with the charge pump and used for carrying out low-pass filtering on the current output by the charge pump so as to output a control signal; the voltage-controlled oscillator is connected with the low-pass filter and outputs a clock signal under the control of the control signal; wherein, in a first operation mode, the charge pump and/or the low-pass filter adjusts the control signal to enable the voltage-controlled oscillator to output a clock signal within a first bandwidth range; in a second operation mode, the charge pump and/or the low-pass filter adjusts the control signal to enable the voltage-controlled oscillator to output a clock signal within a second bandwidth range; the second bandwidth is smaller than the first bandwidth so as to achieve the purpose of locking the phase-locked loop.

title_en: High radiating antidetonation formula constant temperature crystal oscillator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-heat-dissipation anti-seismic constant-temperature crystal oscillator, which relates to the field of constant-temperature crystal oscillators, and the technical scheme comprises a base, an installation strip and a metal shell, wherein the metal shell is arranged outside the base; the externally mounted of base has the base, and the externally mounted of base has the oscillating circuit board, and a plurality of screw grooves have been seted up to the outside of oscillating circuit board, and the inside threaded connection of screw groove has stop gear, and the outside of oscillating circuit board is provided with the briquetting, uses through the cooperation of absorber plate, conduction block, heat-conducting plate, torsion block and threaded rod and not only realizes the location to the inside components and parts of metal casing, can also conduct the surface and then the quick heat dissipation of metal casing with the heat that the inside produced of metal casing, and then realizes the high heat dissipation to the device, guarantees the normal work of device simultaneously.

title_en: Schmitt trigger circuit and oscillating circuit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a Schmitt trigger circuit and an oscillating circuit, which comprise a trigger circuit U1 and comprise PMOS tubes and NMOS tubes, wherein the PMOS tubes comprise a first PMOS tube MP1, a second PMOS tube MP2, a third PMOS tube MP3, a fourth PMOS tube MP4 and a fifth PMOS tube MP5, the NMOS tubes comprise a first NMOS tube MN1, a second NMOS tube MN2, a third NMOS tube MN3, a fourth NMOS tube MN4 and a fifth NMOS tube MN5, the Schmitt trigger circuit comprises a circuit structure with temperature and voltage compensation function, and the circuit structure can greatly reduce the frequency deviation of the oscillating circuit output under different working temperatures and working voltages.

title_en: Analog voltage comparator
abstract_en: The application discloses an analog voltage comparator, including: the switching circuit comprises a first switching tube, a second switching tube, a selection path and a voltage sampling circuit; the grid electrode of the first switching tube is used for inputting a first voltage; the first end of the first switching tube is used for being connected with a power supply, and the second end of the first switching tube is connected with the first end of the selection passage; the grid electrode of the second switching tube is used for inputting a second voltage; the first end of the second switching tube is used for being connected with a power supply, and the second end of the second switching tube is connected with the second end of the selection passage; the voltage sampling circuit is connected between the second end and the third end of the selection path; the third end of the selection path is grounded; the voltage sampling circuit is used for outputting a first analog voltage when the first voltage is larger than the second voltage; outputting a second analog voltage when the first voltage is less than or equal to the second voltage; wherein the first analog voltage is greater than the second analog voltage. Under the condition that a logic gate circuit is not adopted, voltage comparison is realized, and the area of a circuit board is saved.

title_en: Stable active filter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a stable active filter, it includes active filter body and control module, active filter body bottom is provided with damper, damper includes base, bottom plate and buffer spring, the empty slot has been seted up in the base, buffer spring sets up in the empty slot along vertical direction, the bottom plate is located the empty slot top, active filter body installs on the bottom plate, buffer spring both ends respectively with base and bottom plate fixed connection, the base bottom is provided with the mobile assembly who conveniently removes active filter body. Install active filter body on the base through the bottom plate, in removal process and daily use, when taking place vibrations, cushion active filter body through buffer spring, slow down the vibrations impact force that active filter received, protect the component in the active filter, improve active filter holistic stability.

title_en: Limiting current control circuit and operational amplifier
abstract_en: The utility model provides a quiescent current control circuit of an operational amplifier and the operational amplifier, wherein the control circuit comprises: the first limit control module and the second limit control module; the method comprises the steps that a first limit control module collects current source output voltage output by a current source driving module, when the current source output voltage is smaller than a first reference voltage, current source driving current of the current source driving module is split, and the current source driving module reduces and outputs a first limit current limit according to the reduced current source driving current; and the current sinking output voltage output by the current driving module is collected through the second limit control module, when the current sinking output voltage is larger than the second reference voltage, the current sinking driving current is split, and the current sinking driving module reduces and outputs the second limit current according to the reduced current sinking driving current, so that the control of the first limit current and the second limit current is realized respectively.

title_en: Digestion object analysis device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of medical equipment, and particularly relates to a digest analysis device which comprises a machine body and a touch screen, wherein a baffle is symmetrically arranged on the outer side of the touch screen, a top plate is arranged above the baffle and fixedly connected with the machine body, a transmission mechanism is arranged above the top plate and comprises a synchronous right-angle speed reducer arranged on the upper surface of the top plate, a transmission shaft arranged at the power input end of the synchronous right-angle speed reducer through a coupler, a driven gear arranged at the outer wall of the transmission shaft, a servo motor arranged on one side of the transmission shaft, a driving gear arranged at the power output end of the servo motor and meshed with the driven gear, and an infrared human body proximity switch is arranged below the baffle.

title_en: Circuit with bandwidth frequency expansion function of operational amplifier
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a circuit with an operational amplifier bandwidth frequency expansion function, which comprises a bias voltage circuit, a bias voltage circuit and a power supply circuit, wherein the bias voltage circuit consists of a positive power supply +V, a resistor R5, a diode D1 and a resistor R7 connected with a negative power supply; the field effect tube frequency response circuit consists of a field effect tube Q1 and an RC filter circuit; the high-frequency signal input by the operational amplifier U1 is connected with the negative input end of the operational amplifier U1 through a buffer resistor R1, is connected to the grid electrode of the field effect transistor Q1 through a buffer resistor R2, and the drain electrode D of the field effect transistor Q1 is connected with a resistor R4 and is connected with the emitter electrode of the PNP triode Q2; the output end of the operational amplifier U1 is connected to the input end of the power amplifier U2 through a resistor R8. The utility model achieves the purpose of improving the frequency response of the operational amplifier by applying the characteristics of the field effect transistor, thereby achieving the measurement of wider frequency input and high response output, and greatly reducing the cost and complexity of the whole system by the circuit design.

title_en: Limit rotary inclined pressure switch
abstract_en: The utility model provides a spacing rotation type inclined plane pressure switch belongs to inclined plane switch technical field, including sensor base, middle casing and electrical component inclined plane support casing, install pressure sensor in the sensor base inner chamber, middle casing lower extreme and sensor base upper end coaxial coupling, electrical component inclined plane support casing is fixed in middle casing upper portion, middle casing lower extreme closes with the external screw thread of sensor base upper end through the internal screw thread, the middle casing can carry out 360 degrees rotations and angle regulation on the sensor base through the helicitic texture, fixed cover has the spacing ring that is used for carrying out spacing to the axial displacement distance that the middle casing rotation arouses on the port excircle face on the sensor base. According to the utility model, the middle shell and the sensor base are directly connected through the screw thread screwing structure, so that the connection of the two parts is realized, the relative rotation function between the two parts is ensured, the 360-degree rotation structure of the inclined plane switch meter head is simplified, and the manufacturing and processing are more convenient.

title_en: Ultrasonic knife host computer and ultrasonic knife system
abstract_en: The utility model provides an ultrasonic knife host computer and ultrasonic knife system, it is mainly that the appearance value deviation of the static electric capacity of solving current ultrasonic transducer is great, and ultrasonic transducer is in the use, and the temperature rise also can lead to the appearance value of static electric capacity to produce the drift, and ultrasonic transducer is along with the increase of use number of times, and the appearance value of static electric capacity also can produce undulant, leads to the resonant cavity that original matching circuit produced to deviate from the resonance point, and the matching effect is variation or ineffectiveness, influences technical problems such as ultrasonic knife system's working property. According to the ultrasonic knife system, the bypass capacitor with the capacitance value being more than 10 times of that of the static capacitor is connected in parallel in the transducer matching circuit, the capacitance value error of the static capacitor is eliminated, the static capacitor is stably matched, and therefore the current of the mechanical arm is accurately controlled, the ultrasonic knife head is enabled to output in a stable amplitude mode, and the performance requirement of the ultrasonic knife on tissue cutting hemostasis is met.

title_en: Integrated underwater vehicle actuating mechanism gas circuit electromagnetic valve control module
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an integrated control module of an air circuit electromagnetic valve of an execution mechanism of an underwater vehicle, which comprises the following components: a housing (1), a controller (2) mounted in the housing (1); the controller (2) includes: a PCB substrate (21), a power supply interface (22), a control signal input interface (23), a first control signal output interface (24) and a second control signal output interface (25) disposed on the PCB substrate (21), and a first control circuit (26) and a second control circuit (27) disposed on the PCB substrate (21); the first control circuit (26) is respectively connected with the power supply interface (22), the control signal input interface (23) and the first control signal output interface (24); the second control circuit (27) is connected with the power supply interface (22), the control signal input interface (23) and the second control signal output interface (25) respectively.

title_en: Practical TSI rotational speed input shaping circuit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a practical TSI rotational speed input shaping circuit, which comprises a direct current blocking circuit, an inverting circuit, a voltage comparison circuit and a monostable circuit; the external TSI signal passes through the blocking circuit to obtain a negative pulse signal V1 with direct current removed; the negative pulse signal V1 passes through the phase inverting circuit to obtain a positive pulse signal V2; the positive pulse signal V2 passes through the voltage comparison circuit to obtain a signal V3 only related to the rising edge and the falling edge; the signal V3 passes through the monostable circuit to obtain a TTL signal with steep rising edge, and the TTL signal is accessed into a data collector. The utility model can directly introduce the eddy current rotating speed signal from the TSI system of the turbogenerator, and reshape the eddy current rotating speed signal into the TTL signal which can be received by the rotating speed input interface of the data collector on the basis of eliminating the vibration signal which possibly causes interference to the rotating speed, thereby saving the trouble of installing the rotating speed sensor on site and improving the working efficiency.

title_en: Redundant heat backup PWM power amplification circuit and device for suspended ceiling power supply
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a redundant hot standby PWM power amplifying circuit and device of a ceiling power supply, wherein the circuit comprises a plurality of main power supplies and a standby power supply; the output ends of the main power supplies are respectively connected with a plurality of parallel power supply switching circuits; the output ends of the power supply switching circuits are connected with the PWM signal power amplifying circuit; each power supply switching circuit comprises a relay, a PMOS tube, a first resistor and a second resistor; the output end of the main power supply is connected with the normally-closed end of the relay and the input end of the first resistor; the output end of the first resistor is connected with the grid electrode of the PMOS tube and the second resistor; the source electrode of the PMOS tube is connected with the output end of the standby power supply; the output end of the standby power supply is connected with the normal start end of the relay; the output end of the relay is connected with the PWM signal power amplifying circuit. The utility model utilizes multiple standby power supplies to carry out redundant hot backup of the power supplies, improves the reliability of the system and ensures the safe and stable operation of the ceiling lighting system.

title_en: High-altitude operation safety rope adjusting and protecting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an overhead working safety rope adjusting and protecting device which comprises a protecting module, wherein the protecting module comprises a first operational amplifier, a first capacitor, a first switch, a second switch, a first input end, a first output end, a first resistor, a second potentiometer, a third resistor, a fourth resistor, a first triode, a second triode, a third PMOS switch, a fourth light emitting diode and a fifth triode, and one end of the first switch and one end of the second switch are connected with a power supply.

title_en: Touch key switch circuit and mechanical keyboard
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a light touch key switch circuit and a mechanical keyboard, which comprise a Hall sensor, a Hall sensor power switch and a Hall sensor output voltage detection interface, wherein the Hall sensor power switch is connected with the Hall sensor for opening or closing the Hall sensor, the Hall sensor is connected with the light touch key for detecting the voltage change of the light touch key, and the Hall sensor output voltage detection interface is connected with the Hall sensor for outputting the voltage value detected by the Hall sensor. Through the hall sensor that sets up, utilize hall sensor's linear output's characteristic, when MCU gathered hall sensor output's voltage variation, divide into a plurality of response gear with the stroke of pressing of dabbing the button to can eliminate the long, the slow problem of response of stroke that dabbing the button stroke problem and arouse.

title_en: Optocoupler relay
abstract_en: The utility model provides an optocoupler relay, comprising: the chip substrate, a plurality of opto-coupler relay modules and the MEMS shell of arranging of array, the MEMS shell is located on the chip substrate and covers all opto-coupler relay modules, opto-coupler relay modules includes: the device comprises a light emitting unit, a photosensitive unit, a driving unit and a switching unit. In the utility model, all the optocoupler relay modules are integrated on the same plane of the chip substrate and manufactured by using the SOI-based BCD process, and in each optocoupler relay module, the light-emitting unit is directly integrated on the side of the light-sensing unit, so that a high-light-transmittance colloid is not required to be used as a device support. Furthermore, the utility model solves the problem of light isolation between the optocoupler relay modules by arranging the high-reflection MEMS shell above all the optocoupler relay modules to enhance the obtained light intensity of the photosensitive units in a reflection mode.

title_en: Oscillator with calibration function
abstract_en: The utility model provides an oscillator with a calibration function, which comprises a switch capacitor module, an adjustable resistor, a comparator, a current calibration module and a linear voltage stabilizing module, wherein the switch capacitor module is connected with the adjustable resistor; the positive input end of the comparator is connected with the first end of the switch capacitor module, the output end of the comparator is connected with the second end of the switch capacitor module, and the input end of the comparator is connected with one end of the adjustable resistor; the other end of the adjustable resistor is grounded; the linear voltage stabilizing module comprises an operational amplifier and a first PMOS tube, wherein the positive input end of the operational amplifier is connected with a reference voltage, the negative input end of the operational amplifier is respectively connected with the drain electrode of the first PMOS tube and the negative input end of the comparator, and the output end of the operational amplifier is connected with the grid electrode of the first PMOS tube; the current calibration module comprises a second PMOS tube, a binary code current mirror or a thermometer code current mirror and is used for adjusting the current input into the switch capacitance module. The utility model provides a high-frequency dual-calibration oscillator circuit, which realizes accurate high-frequency signal output through rough resistor adjustment and fine current adjustment.

title_en: Filter structure with temperature compensation characteristic
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a filter structure with temperature compensation characteristics, which relates to the technical field of filters and is used for solving the problems that the heat dissipation effect formed by arranging a heat dissipation structure on a filter mounting base has little influence on the heat inside a filter, and the temperature of a low-temperature filter cannot be raised and cannot play a role in temperature compensation.

title_en: Modular combined IGCT gate driving unit structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a modular combination formula IGCT gate drive unit structure, is not high in order to solve current drive unit space utilization, and maintenance is inconvenient and with big costs, is unfavorable for the promotion and the improvement of gate drive's problem, through modular drive circuit design, and modular system includes: the control module is connected with the signal receiving and feedback module, the gate current triggering and charge extracting module and the driving state detecting module for sending and receiving control signals; the power supply module is connected with the control module and the capacitor bank module; according to the utility model, each part of the IGCT gate drive circuit is subjected to modularized design, so that the installation and debugging steps can be effectively simplified, the convenience of maintenance and replacement is improved, and meanwhile, convenience is provided for the transformation and upgrading of driving each module without mutual influence.

title_en: Centrosymmetric angular displacement limit signal generator
abstract_en: The central symmetrical angular displacement limit signal generator comprises an A position signal generating circuit, a B position signal generating circuit, a limit position circuit deviating from a central point, a reference power circuit and a working power supply, wherein the A position signal generating circuit comprises an A position sampling circuit and an A comparison circuit for comparing a signal acquired by the A position sampling circuit with a limit position signal Vi and outputting an A position limit signal; the output end of the A position sampling circuit is connected with the inverting end of the A comparison circuit through a buffer circuit; the B position signal generating circuit comprises a B position sampling circuit and a B comparison circuit, wherein the B comparison circuit is used for comparing the signals acquired by the B position sampling circuit with the limiting position signals Vi and then outputting B position limiting signals; the output end of the B position sampling circuit is connected with the inverting end of the B comparison circuit through a buffer circuit; the circuit output end at the limiting position of the offset center point is connected to the non-inverting input ends of the A comparison circuit and the B comparison circuit. The anti-interference capability is strong, and the precision is high.

title_en: Rotary position sampling system adopting soft decoding technology
abstract_en: A rotary position sampling system adopting soft decoding technology comprises an AD sampling module integrated in MCU; the AD sampling module comprises an excitation signal generating module and a rotation feedback signal sampling processing module; the excitation signal generation module outputs sine waves of differential signals, generates excitation signals after amplification processing and transmits the excitation signals to the rotary feedback signal sampling processing module; after receiving the excitation signal, the rotary feedback signal sampling processing module generates sine and cosine signals with variable amplitude, and the sine and cosine signals are input to a sampling pin of an AD sampling module of the MCU for conversion after being processed by a circuit to obtain sampling values of the two signals; the AD sampling module performs data sampling processing on sampling values of the two signals fed back, and obtains a real-time position angle of the motor through calculation; according to the scheme, the system cost is reduced by adopting the high-speed and high-precision AD sampling module integrated in the MCU, and the real-time performance and accuracy of position sampling are improved.

title_en: Impedance regulator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an impedance adjuster, comprising a first input port, an input filter, a current adjuster and a low-frequency filter; the first input port is connected in parallel with a radio frequency input port of the radio frequency power supply load and is used for accessing radio frequency input current; the input filter is electrically connected with the first input port and is used for filtering the accessed radio frequency input current; the current regulator is electrically connected with the first input port and is used for regulating the accessed radio frequency input current; the low-frequency filter is electrically connected with the current regulator and is used for low-frequency filtering. The impedance regulator solves the problem of adjustment of the input load current of the radio frequency power supply, and achieves impedance matching.

title_en: Control circuit for improving amplitude of sine wave output by crystal oscillator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a control circuit for improving the amplitude of a crystal oscillator output sine wave, wherein the input end of an oscillator is connected with a power supply, the output end of the oscillator is connected with the input end of a NOR gate, and the oscillator is used for outputting a first peak clipping sine wave; the power distribution unit includes: a driving unit; the input end of the driving unit is connected with the output end of the NOR gate, and the NOR gate is used for outputting a second peak clipping sine wave to the driving unit; the driving unit is provided with a first power distribution output end and a second power distribution output end; the first power distribution output end is used for being connected with external equipment, and the second power distribution output end is connected with an input reference clock of the equipment. According to the technical scheme, the oscillator, the NOR gate and the power distribution unit are arranged to realize the functions of amplifying signals and distributing signals; and further obtains the pulse width of the programmable output signal waveform.

title_en: Level conversion circuit
abstract_en: The present application provides a level shift circuit including: a first input stage, a second input stage, and an output stage; the first input end of the first input stage is configured to be connected with a first voltage domain signal, the second input end of the first input stage is connected with the first output end of the output stage, the third input end of the first input stage is configured to be connected with a first voltage source, and the output end of the first input stage is connected with the first input end of the output stage; the first input end of the second input stage is configured to be connected with an inverse signal of the first voltage domain signal, the second input end of the second input stage is connected with the second output end of the output stage, the third input end of the second input stage is configured to be connected with the first voltage source, and the output end of the second input stage is connected with the second input end of the output stage; the third input end of the output stage is configured to be connected with the second voltage source, the fourth input end of the output stage is configured to be connected with the first voltage source, and the level conversion circuit is used for reducing the layout occupation area and improving the working speed.

title_en: Pressure touch multifunctional panel and automobile
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pressure touch multifunctional panel and an automobile, wherein the pressure touch multifunctional panel comprises a panel, a vibration module, a touch module, at least one pressure sensor, a shell, a light isolation structure, a main board and a base; the utility model aims to improve the performance of the current multifunctional panel, reduce the probability of misoperation and bring better operation feedback to a user.

title_en: Radio frequency front-end circuit of dual-frequency receiver
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model discloses a radio frequency front-end circuit of a double-frequency receiver, which comprises a first radio frequency receiving channel, a second radio frequency receiving channel and a frequency synthesizer, wherein the first radio frequency receiving channel and the second radio frequency receiving channel are respectively formed by a low-noise amplifier, a mixer unit, a complex band-pass filter, an adjustable gain amplifier and an analog-to-digital converter which are sequentially connected, and the mixer units comprise a first mixer, a second mixer, a third mixer and a fourth mixer. The utility model only uses one frequency synthesizer to realize the double-frequency signal receiving; the area and the power consumption of the LNA can be small under the current technical condition, so that the circuit cost of the two LNAs is not increased; the utility model does not use an off-chip intermediate frequency filter to realize image rejection inside the chip; the utility model does not use a complex signal synthesis filter, and reduces the design cost and the circuit complexity; the automatic gain control of each channel of the present utility model is capable of independent operation.

title_en: Coupler and radio frequency chip
abstract_en: The utility model provides a coupler and a radio frequency chip, wherein the coupler comprises a first microstrip line and a second microstrip line coupled with the first microstrip line; two ends of the first microstrip line are respectively used as a radio frequency input port and an antenna output port, and two ends of the second microstrip line are respectively used as a coupling output port and an isolation port; the coupler also comprises a resistor, a first resonant circuit and a second resonant circuit; the first end of the first resonant circuit is connected to the isolation port, the first end of the second resonant circuit is connected to the second end of the first resonant circuit, the first end of the resistor is connected to the second end of the second resonant circuit, and the second end of the resistor is grounded. The coupler can increase the reverse isolation degree so as to improve the unidirectional directivity.

title_en: Touch point position replaceable touch sensor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of touch sensors, in particular to a touch point position replaceable touch sensor. The utility model provides a touch point position replaceable touch sensor capable of changing the touch point position of a touch sensor for installation and use and improving the use suitability. The utility model provides a touch point position interchangeable formula touch sensor, is including touch sensor, press lever, first spring and rotary mechanism, touch sensor right part slidingtype is connected with presses the lever, is connected with first spring between pressing lever and the touch sensor, is equipped with the rotary mechanism who is used for carrying out the spin change point after the installation on the touch sensor. According to the utility model, the connecting base is connected with the touch sensor mounting position, and the touch sensor rotates on the connecting base through the rotating column, so that the effect of changing the touch point positions of the touch sensor for mounting and using and improving the use suitability can be achieved.

title_en: Shielding terminating structure of filter cable
abstract_en: The application provides a filter cable shielding termination structure, which belongs to the technical field of cable shielding layer termination. The filter cable shielding termination structure comprises a filter body and a termination structure, wherein the filter body comprises a filter body and a cable body, the cable body is connected with the filter body, the termination structure comprises a cable shielding layer, a crimping ring, a locking washer and a pressurizing cap, the cable body is arranged in the cable shielding layer, the cable shielding layer is arranged in the pressurizing cap, the crimping ring is arranged in the pressurizing cap, the locking washer is arranged in the pressurizing cap, and the pressurizing cap is in threaded connection with the filter body. In this application, the shielding termination structure of the filter cable conveniently realizes the loop connection of the cable shielding layer, ensures the shielding effectiveness, and can be conveniently installed.

title_en: Novel float switch
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel floating ball switch, which comprises an integral frame, wherein a junction box is arranged above the integral frame, limit fixed slots are formed in the side parts of the integral frame, and high-position and low-position proximity switches and stop screws are arranged above and below the limit fixed slots; the stainless steel pipe is arranged in the middle of the integral frame, the floating ball connecting rod is arranged in the stainless steel pipe, the indicating stop block extending out of the stainless steel pipe is arranged on the floating ball connecting rod, and the bottom of the floating ball connecting rod is connected with the stainless steel floating ball. The utility model has the characteristics of easy spot detection and stable signal.

title_en: Circuit for controlling load by double MOS (metal oxide semiconductor) tubes
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model discloses a circuit for controlling a load by double MOS tubes, which comprises the following components: the device comprises a main control unit, a double MOS tube assembly, a voltage acquisition unit and a switch control unit, wherein the MOS tube assembly is connected with a load; the voltage acquisition unit is used for acquiring the voltage of the double MOS tube assembly; the main control unit is used for forming a control signal according to the voltage; the switch control unit is used for driving the double MOS tube assembly according to the control signal; the double MOS tube assembly is used for controlling the on-off of a loop of the load and the power supply. The circuit of the embodiment of the utility model can improve the safety and reliability of the control load circuit.

title_en: Photoelectric knob switch
abstract_en: The utility model provides a photoelectric knob switch, which comprises: the switch comprises a switch base, a control panel arranged at the top of the switch base, a knob adjusting ring surrounding the switch base and the control panel, and a bearing arranged between the knob adjusting ring and the switch base; the bottom of the control panel is provided with a photoelectric sensor at a position corresponding to the bearing, an inner ring of the bearing is fixed on the switch base, an outer ring of the bearing is fixed on the inner side of the knob adjusting ring, and the photoelectric sensor is used for scanning the bearing to judge the rotation direction of the knob adjusting ring. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: the defects that the structure of the knob switch with the gear is complex, the production cost is high, and the gear is easy to damage are overcome, and the rotation adjustment is more labor-saving compared with the gear structure adjustment by means of the bearing, so that the operation hand feeling of people for adjusting the knob switch is further improved.

title_en: Miniaturized power filter for nuclear magnetic resonance
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of filters, and discloses a miniaturized power filter for nuclear magnetic resonance, including the aluminium shell, the aluminium shell inboard is provided with PCB board and apron, the PCB board passes through screw and aluminium shell fixed connection, the apron is pegged graft in the aluminium shell is inboard, PCB board top welding has the electric capacity inductance, the apron compresses tightly in electric capacity inductance and PCB board top, lead wire and avionics plug are installed to aluminium shell both sides, the lead wire passes through PCB board and electric capacity inductance and avionics plug electric connection, lead wire and avionics plug are located the apron top. The miniaturized power filter for nuclear magnetic resonance generally has insertion loss requirements only for 10M to 100M, does not need a multi-stage circuit, can meet the requirements with fewer stages of capacitance and inductance, and has relatively smaller volume, thereby reducing the cost of the filter.

title_en: Swing rod type in-place detection mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of lithium batteries, and particularly relates to a swinging rod type on-site detection mechanism which is characterized by comprising a connecting plate, a switch bracket, a swinging rod and a return spring, wherein one side of the connecting plate is connected with a bottom plate of a battery storage bin, the other side of the connecting plate is respectively connected with the switch bracket and the swinging rod bracket, a proximity switch is arranged on the switch bracket, the swinging rod is connected with the swinging rod bracket through a mandrel, a triggering end of the swinging rod abuts against a triggering pull piece of the proximity switch, and a triggering end of the swinging rod is also connected with the switch bracket through the return spring; when no battery exists in the battery storage bin, the free end of the swing rod extends out of the bottom plate of the battery storage bin, and when a battery exists in the battery storage bin, the free end of the swing rod is turned over to be parallel to the bottom plate of the battery storage bin. The utility model has the advantages that: the swing rod type trigger structure is adopted, so that the proximity switch is separated from the trigger mechanism under the condition that a battery exists in the battery storage bin, and the problems of high proximity switch loss, high failure rate and the like are solved.

title_en: Program-controlled switching filter device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a program-controlled switching filter device which comprises a shell, an SMA radio frequency input port, an SMA radio frequency output port, a program-controlled serial port, a manual power switch, a filter bank, a power interface, a program-controlled relay, a radio frequency coaxial switch and a power module, wherein the SMA radio frequency input port, the SMA radio frequency output port, the program-controlled serial port, the manual power switch, the filter bank and the power interface are arranged on the shell; the control pin of the radio frequency coaxial switch is connected with the program-controlled relay and is used for controlling the on-off of each radio frequency channel of the radio frequency coaxial switch; the radio frequency port of the radio frequency coaxial switch is connected with the filter bank; the power supply module is connected with the program-controlled relay; the program control relay is connected with the program control serial port on the shell, and the program control serial port is used for being connected with a control end computer; the SMA radio frequency input port is used for connecting a radio frequency output end of the tested terminal; the SMA radio frequency output port is used for being connected with the input end of the spectrometer. The utility model improves the testing efficiency, stability and accuracy.

title_en: Novel wear-resistant signal output structure of electric tool switch
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel wear-resistant signal output structure of an electric tool switch, which comprises the following components: the B+ pad and the B-pad, the GND/VCC pad and the OUT pad which are arranged in parallel on the PCB substrate are used for two sliding pawls to slide so as to respectively switch on and off signals and speed regulation signals; the width of the middle end rails of the four pad rails is smaller than that of the pad rails, and the two middle end rails are symmetrically arranged in two positions; the sliding claw contacted with the B+pad realizes on-off signal switching in sliding, and the sliding claw contacted with the GND/VCC pad realizes speed regulation signal switching in sliding. The utility model can prolong the service life of the speed regulating switch of the electric tool and solve the problem of unstable signal output caused by abrasion.

title_en: Corrosion-resistant inductive proximity switch
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a corrosion-resistant inductive proximity switch, which comprises an L-shaped vertical seat and an installation sleeve in threaded connection with the vertical surface of the L-shaped vertical seat, wherein the inner end of the installation sleeve is provided with a proximity switch body, the front end and the rear end of the L-shaped vertical seat are respectively provided with a transverse plate, the side surface of the transverse plate is fixedly connected with an annular hollow ring, the inner end of the annular hollow ring is in sliding connection with a rubber anti-collision strip, one end of the rubber anti-collision strip, which is far away from a transverse rod, is fixedly connected with an elastic force-absorbing ball, the left end of the proximity switch body is provided with an object to be detected, in the corrosion-resistant inductive proximity switch, when the object to be detected is close to a probe, the L-shaped vertical seat is provided with a pair of rubber anti-collision strips with anti-contact functions, so that the use efficiency of the proximity switch body is guaranteed, and meanwhile, the safety distance between the rubber anti-collision strips and the object to be detected is adjusted through an arc-shaped micro groove and a raised micro ring, so that the flexibility of the protection process of the rubber anti-collision strips is improved.

title_en: Self-defined frequency point high-speed broadband frequency hopping signal generator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a self-defined frequency point high-speed broadband frequency hopping signal generator, which comprises: the device comprises a control module, a frequency source module, a storage module and an anti-interference module; the frequency source module comprises a phase-locked loop unit and a frequency synthesis unit, wherein a first input end of the phase-locked loop unit is used for accessing a reference clock signal, a second input end of the phase-locked loop unit is connected with an output end of the control module, a first input end of the frequency synthesis unit is connected with an output end of the phase-locked loop unit, a second input end of the frequency synthesis unit is connected with an output end of the control module, a third input end of the frequency synthesis unit is used for accessing a trigger signal, an output end of the frequency synthesis unit is connected with an input end of the anti-interference module, and an output end of the anti-interference module is used for being connected with an output end of the frequency hopping signal. The obtained frequency control word has higher frequency precision, and filters high-frequency mirror image components and low-frequency noise signals in the frequency signals, so that the frequency control word has good frequency spectrum purity, and the frequency hopping signal quality is effectively improved.

title_en: Power supply apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a power supply device. The power supply equipment comprises a storage battery interface, an MOS tube and a high-power absorbing device. The storage battery interface is used for connecting an energy storage component, and the energy storage component supplies power for an electric device of the vehicle through the storage battery interface. The MOS tube is used for connecting the energy storage component and the battery interface. The high-power absorption device is connected with the MOS tube in parallel and is used for enabling the voltage of the MOS tube to be smaller than a preset voltage. In the power supply equipment, the high-power absorbing device is arranged in parallel with the MOS tube, and the high-power absorbing device can clamp the voltage of the MOS tube, so that the voltage of the MOS tube is smaller than the preset voltage, and reverse spike voltage generated by closing the MOS tube is effectively prevented from breaking down the MOS tube.

title_en: Active filter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of active filters, and discloses an active filter, which comprises: the PCB is divided into a first part and a second part by taking the central axis of the PCB as a boundary; the filter circuit includes: a feedback capacitor C1, a feedback capacitor C2, a first magnetic device, and a second magnetic device; the feedback capacitor C1 is arranged on the surface of the first part; the feedback capacitor C2 is arranged on the surface of the second part; the first magnetic device is connected with the feedback capacitor C1 and is arranged on the surface of the first part; the second magnetic device is connected with the feedback capacitor C2, and the second magnetic device is arranged on the surface of the second part. The active filter of the utility model adopts symmetrical distribution, has uniform heat dissipation, simple and beautiful structure, small volume, high automation degree and good product performance consistency.

title_en: Signal output circuit and safety laser radar
abstract_en: The utility model provides a signal output circuit and a safe laser radar, wherein the signal output circuit comprises a level switching circuit, a first transistor detection circuit, a second transistor detection circuit and a controller, the level switching circuit comprises a first switch circuit and a second switch circuit, when the first switch circuit is conducted, a high-level control signal is output, when the second switch circuit is conducted, a low-level control signal is output, the first transistor detection circuit and the second transistor detection circuit respectively detect output currents when the first switch circuit and the second switch circuit are conducted, when the first level signal is output to the controller, the controller correspondingly switches the switch states of the first switch circuit or the second switch circuit, overcurrent detection and protection are realized, the working state of an external system is changed, meanwhile, the two transistor detection circuits are adopted, the structure is simple, the cost is low, the response time is short, and the overcurrent protection efficiency is improved.

title_en: Acquisition circuit with selectable switching value judgment threshold
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an acquisition circuit with an optional switching value judgment threshold, which comprises: the circuit comprises a first interface, a second interface, a first resistor, a second interface, a second resistor, a third resistor, a fourth resistor, an operational amplifier, a voltage dividing circuit and an optocoupler; the first interface is used for accessing an external sensor; the non-inverting input end of the operational amplifier is connected with the first interface, and the inverting input end of the operational amplifier is connected with an external switching value input interface; one end of the first resistor is connected between the non-inverting input end of the operational amplifier and the first interface, and the other end of the second resistor is connected with the second interface and then grounded; the second interface is connected with external 24V voltage through a second resistor, a third resistor and a fourth resistor respectively; the voltage dividing circuit is connected with the output end of the operational amplifier and the optical coupler; the optocoupler is connected to an external central chip. The utility model can easily adjust and adapt to the threshold value of switch detection, thereby better meeting different functional and performance requirements.

title_en: Ultra-wideband bias circuit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ultra-wideband biaser circuit, comprising: a DC port, an rf_dc port, an RF port, a first inductance, a second inductance, a third inductance, a first capacitance, a second capacitance, a third capacitance, a first resistance, and a second resistance; the first capacitor is connected with the RF_DC port and the RF port respectively, the DC port is connected with a third capacitor through a second resistor, and the third capacitor is connected to the ground; the RF_DC port is connected with the first capacitor and the DC port is connected with the second resistor through the first inductor, the second inductor and the third inductor in sequence; a second capacitor is connected between the second inductor and the third inductor, and the other end of the second capacitor is connected to the ground through a first resistor; the utility model can solve the problems that in the traditional ultra-wideband bias circuit, the conical inductor has high welding installation requirement, is fragile and has larger volume, and the ultra-wideband bias chip has high price and is not suitable for large-scale production.

title_en: Self-adaptive multi-node UART (universal asynchronous receiver/transmitter) optocoupler isolation communication circuit and air conditioner
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a self-adaptive multi-node UART (universal asynchronous receiver/transmitter) optocoupler isolation communication circuit and an air conditioner, comprising a host circuit, wherein the host circuit is connected with at least one slave circuit, and each slave circuit comprises a first transmitting module and is used for receiving a control signal sent by a slave MCU; the host circuit includes: the automatic regulating module comprises a digital potentiometer and a sampling resistor; the first transmitting module is used for connecting with the first transmitting module; the host MCU is provided with a preset voltage; the automatic regulating module is used for being connected with the automatic regulating module, subtracting the sampling voltage of the sampling resistor from the preset voltage, and controlling the digital potentiometer to regulate the self resistance value, so as to regulate the sampling voltage. If the sampling voltage received by the host MCU is not in the identifiable range or is incorrectly identified, the host MCU can pull up the resistor through the digital potentiometer, so that the sampling voltage is reduced to be in the identifiable range of the host MCU or is correctly identified, and the communication between the host MCU and the slave MCU is normal.

title_en: Filter for isolating audio impedance matching
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of filter dampproof, and discloses an isolated audio impedance matched filter, which comprises a shell cover and a shell support, wherein the top side of the shell support is fixedly connected with a mounting plate, and the top side of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with four riveting blocks; through setting up annular sealing strip, after the shell cover card goes into annular seal groove, the bottom side of shell cover can contact with annular sealing strip and extrude annular sealing strip, thereby annular sealing strip receives the extrusion to take place deformation and can laminate completely with annular seal groove's three side inner wall to the moisture in the day further ensures outside air can not get into in the shell cover.

title_en: Circuit for controlling LED with specific wavelength and receiving shaping and amplifying
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a circuit for controlling a specific wavelength LED and receiving shaping amplification, which comprises an LED driving circuit, a main control circuit and a signal processing circuit, wherein one input end of the LED driving circuit is electrically connected with a controller, the other input end of the LED driving circuit is electrically connected with an external power supply, a compensation end of the signal processing circuit is electrically connected with a compensation signal output end of the main control circuit, the input end of the signal processing circuit is electrically connected with an output end of a photodiode, the LED driving circuit is used for controlling and outputting stable optical signals, after the optical signals are irradiated on a detection card, fluorescence is excited, the fluorescent signals are irradiated on the photodiode after passing through an optical filter to stimulate the photodiode to output corresponding electric signals, and the electric signals are processed by the signal processing circuit and then output to the main control circuit for operation. The circuit for controlling the LED with the specific wavelength and receiving and shaping and amplifying has the effect of improving the detection accuracy.

title_en: Low-temperature drift interference type sensor signal processing circuit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a low-temperature drift interference type sensor signal processing circuit which comprises a first signal amplifying module, a second amplifying module, a third amplifying module and a fourth amplifying module, wherein the input end of the first amplifying module is connected to the output end of an external sensor, the output end of the first amplifying module is connected to the input end of the second amplifying module, the output end of the second amplifying module is connected to the input end of the third amplifying module, the output end of the third amplifying module is connected to the input end of the fourth amplifying module, and the second amplifying module comprises an amplifier U2, an encoder SW2, a capacitor C6, a capacitor C7, a capacitor C8, a resistor R4, a resistor R9, a resistor R10, a resistor R11, a sliding resistor R24 and a resistor module. The signal processing circuit of the low-temperature drift interference type sensor solves the problem that in the prior art, temperature drift affects unreliable output signals due to the fact that the size of partial pressure is required to be adjusted through an adjusting rheostat.

title_en: Phase-locked structure, signal generating circuit and equipment thereof
abstract_en: A phase locking structure, a signal generating circuit and equipment thereof relate to the technical field of communication. The phase-locked structure comprises a phase discriminator, a loop filter, a voltage-controlled oscillator, an FPGA and a D trigger. The phase detector is used for acquiring a reference clock signal and a first output signal to determine a phase difference between the reference clock signal and the first output signal and convert the phase difference into a voltage difference, the loop filter is connected to the phase detector to filter the voltage difference, the voltage-controlled oscillator is connected to the loop filter to generate an output signal of a phase-locked structure according to the filtered voltage difference, the FPGA is connected to the voltage-controlled oscillator to divide the output signal of the phase-locked structure, the clock end of the D trigger acquires the output signal of the phase-locked structure, and the input end of the D trigger acquires the divided output signal to generate a signal of the first output signal. The application provides a phase locking structure, a signal generating circuit and equipment thereof, which can achieve higher frequency precision and higher phase noise level.

title_en: Bracket for installing proximity switch
abstract_en: The utility model provides a support for installing a proximity switch, which relates to the technical field of proximity switch supports and comprises a support column, a fixed rail and a movable rail, wherein a base is installed at the lower end of the support column through bolts, an end cover is buckled at the upper end of the support column through bolts, an adjusting rod is rotatably installed in the end cover, the base at the lower end of the support column can be installed at a proper position through the arrangement of the support column and the fixed rail through bolts according to the installation position, the support is not required to be welded on a wall or a machine side, so that subsequent maintenance and replacement are more convenient, the vertical position of the proximity switch can be changed directly through rotating the adjusting rod through the arrangement of the adjusting rod and the movable rail, and the transverse position of the proximity switch can be finely adjusted through a sliding movable rail mode, so that the limitation that the position adjustment cannot be performed after the proximity switch is installed by the traditional support is avoided, and the installation of the proximity switch is more convenient and reliable.

title_en: Switch driving circuit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a switch driving circuit which can replace a switch driving chip to provide driving voltage for the switch circuit. In addition, the switch driving circuit can also output a reverse voltage having a higher voltage value. The power supply circuit comprises a first PNP type triode switch circuit, a diode switch circuit and a second PNP type triode switch circuit, wherein when a low-level control signal is input to a signal input end of a driving circuit, the first PNP type triode and the diode are conducted, the second PNP type triode is cut off, a signal output end of the driving circuit outputs forward voltage from a positive power supply of the driving circuit, when a high-level control signal is input to a signal input end of the driving circuit, the first PNP type triode and the diode are cut off, the second PNP type triode is conducted, and a signal output end of the driving circuit outputs reverse voltage from a negative power supply of the driving circuit.

title_en: Reset circuit for intelligent ammeter and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of intelligent electric meters, and discloses a reset circuit and electronic equipment for the intelligent electric meter, wherein the reset circuit comprises a direct current power supply module, a power supply conversion module, a communication module and a control module; the power supply module is connected with the communication module, the communication module is connected with the control module, the communication module resets the reset circuit according to the received working voltage of the reset circuit, the control module is connected with the power supply conversion module, and the control module is used for controlling the power supply conversion module to be turned on and off and controlling the communication module to reset the reset circuit. The reset circuit can realize effective reset of the communication module.

title_en: 4 X 4 radio frequency switching control circuit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a 4 multiplied by 4 radio frequency switching control circuit which comprises a logic unit and a radio frequency switching unit, wherein the logic unit is connected with the radio frequency switching unit, the logic unit comprises four groups of logic units, the radio frequency switching unit comprises four groups of radio frequency switching units, and the logic unit and a radio frequency switching power supply form the radio frequency switching control circuit. The related indexes of the utility model are controlled in a reasonable range, so that signal crosstalk and coupling between different radio frequency channels are reduced, and the radio frequency switching of N multiplied by N paths can be realized by upgrading the circuit in the later stage.

title_en: Anti-pass circuit and topology circuit
abstract_en: The application discloses a straight-through prevention circuit and a topology circuit, wherein in the straight-through prevention circuit, a first input end of a first NAND gate module is used for receiving a first input signal, a second input end of the first NAND gate module is used for receiving a second input signal, a first input end of the second NAND gate module is used for receiving a first input signal, a second input end of the second NAND gate module is used for receiving a third input signal, the first input end of the first AND gate module is connected with an output end of the first NAND gate module, the second input end of the first AND gate module is used for receiving the first input signal, the first input end of the second AND gate module is connected with an output end of the second NAND gate module, the second input end of the second AND gate module is used for receiving a third input signal, and the first input end of the third AND gate module is connected with an output end of the second NAND gate module. Based on the mode, the reliability of bridge arm switch control can be improved.

title_en: ESD protection circuit for enhancing source driver
abstract_en: The invention provides an ESD protection circuit for enhancing a source driver, which is coupled to an output buffer and comprises an ESD path, a fuse circuit and a low-voltage working circuit, wherein the ESD path is used for receiving ESD voltage, the fuse circuit is arranged between the ESD path and the protection circuit and comprises a fuse switch and an overvoltage detection circuit and is used for protecting the output buffer, and the low-voltage working circuit is connected in series between the fuse circuit and the output buffer and is used for absorbing the ESD voltage when the ESD voltage is smaller than a threshold value.

title_en: High isolation absorption type single-pole eight-throw switch module
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of radio frequency switches, in particular to a high-isolation absorption type single-pole eight-throw switch module which comprises a shell, a feed control board, a printed board, a power port, an input port and an output port, wherein the printed board and the feed control board are arranged in the shell, the input port and the power port are arranged on a front panel, the output port is distributed on the back of the shell at equal intervals, a single-pole double-throw switch and two single-pole four-throw switches are arranged on the printed board, and the two single-pole four-throw switches are connected to the fixed end of the single-pole double-throw switch. The utility model can provide high isolation and keep low insertion loss, and is suitable for high-performance radio frequency and microwave systems.

title_en: Slope feedback control circuit and micro-processing chip
abstract_en: The application provides a slope feedback control circuit and a micro-processing chip. The slope feedback control circuit comprises a driving circuit, a detection circuit, a constant current circuit and an LIN bus, wherein the driving circuit comprises a driving tube and a first capacitor, a first input end of the detection circuit is electrically connected to a control end of the driving tube, a second input end of the detection circuit is electrically connected to a transmitting signal end, an output end of the detection circuit is electrically connected to a first input end of the constant current circuit, a second input end of the constant current circuit is electrically connected to the transmitting signal end, an output end of the constant current circuit is electrically connected to the control end of the driving tube, a first end of the first capacitor is electrically connected to the control end of the driving tube, a second end of the first capacitor is electrically connected to a first voltage end, an input end of the LIN bus is electrically connected to the second end of the first capacitor and the first end of the driving tube, and the LIN bus is electrically connected to the second end of the first capacitor and the first end of the driving tube. The application improves the reliability of signal detection.

title_en: Broadband low-phase noise small-stepping frequency source
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a broadband low-phase-noise small stepping frequency source which comprises a large stepping ring and a small stepping ring, wherein the large stepping ring comprises a first power divider, a frequency multiplier, a first mixer, a second power divider, a first voltage-controlled oscillator and a first phase discriminator, and the small stepping ring comprises a direct digital frequency synthesizer, a second phase discriminator, a second mixer, a third power divider, a loop filter, a second voltage-controlled oscillator and a program-controlled frequency divider. The utility model divides the reference signal into 3 paths of reference signals after 3 power division by the first power divider, and respectively sends the reference signals into the frequency multiplier, the first phase discriminator and the direct digital frequency synthesizer, thereby ensuring the homology of the whole circuit, generating broadband low-phase-noise small-step signals through multi-stage frequency multiplication, phase locking of a large stepping ring and a small stepping ring and a digital frequency synthesizer, and avoiding fractional spurious, thereby avoiding the problems of insufficient frequency coverage, fractional spurious and larger phase noise.

title_en: Bias circuit and radio frequency power amplifier
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bias circuit and a radio frequency power amplifier, which belong to the technical field of high-power lasers, wherein the bias circuit comprises a programmable digital-to-analog conversion module, an enabling signal end of the module is respectively connected with one end of a filter capacitor C  1 、C 2  and one end of a voltage stabilizing inductor L  1 , the other end of the filter capacitor C  1 、C 2  is grounded, an external enabling signal is connected with the external enabling signal through the other end of the voltage stabilizing inductor L  1 , and the external enabling signal is input to the programmable digital-to-analog conversion module after voltage stabilization and capacitance filtering, so that the output voltage of the module can be stabilized, the precision requirement of digital-to-analog conversion is ensured, the precision control of the required bias voltage is realized, and the stability and the precision of the bias voltage are further ensured. Meanwhile, when the power amplification chip changes, parameters of the programmable digital-to-analog conversion module can be flexibly adjusted. Based on the method, the complexity of the bias circuit can be reduced and the flexibility of the bias circuit can be improved on the premise of ensuring stability and accuracy.

title_en: Device for converting analog quantity into pulse signal
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for converting analog quantity into pulse signals, which comprises an analog signal input module, a signal processing module, a voltage pulse conversion module and an optical coupler relay, wherein the analog signal input module is used for receiving analog quantity signals and converting the analog quantity signals into digital signals which can be processed, the signal processing module is connected with the analog signal input module and used for sampling and quantizing the signals and outputting voltage signals, the voltage pulse conversion module is connected with the signal processing module and used for converting the voltage signals into pulse signals and outputting the pulse signals, and the optical coupler relay is connected with the voltage pulse conversion module and used for isolating the signals and transmitting the signals to an online detection end. The utility model improves the conversion precision and speed and the stability by optimizing the design of the signal processing module, and in addition, ensures the stability and the transmission quality of the signals by introducing the optocoupler relay.

title_en: APF active filter heat radiation structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of source filters, in particular to an APF active filter radiating structure, which comprises an APF active filter body and a radiating component, wherein the radiating component comprises a cooling shell, a plurality of cooling units, a radiating pipeline, two pump bodies, an upper shell, a lower shell and an air flow unit, condensed water is stored in the cooling shell, is pumped into the radiating pipeline through the pump bodies to flow, so that the APF active filter body is radiated and cooled, the condensed water flows in the radiating pipeline for a circle and then returns to the cooling shell, the cooling is completed through the cooling units, the APF active filter body is continuously radiated, meanwhile, the upper shell and the lower shell are used for protecting the APF active filter body and internal parts, the air inlet and the air outlet are formed through the ventilation openings, and meanwhile, the air flow unit is used for further radiating the cooling shell and the condensed water, so that the heat dissipation of the APF active filter body is effectively improved, and the APF active filter body can be cooled in a short time.

title_en: PWM signal anti-interference circuit and corresponding circuit board
abstract_en: The utility model provides a PWM signal anti-interference circuit and a corresponding circuit board, wherein an optical coupling isolation module can receive PWM signals output by an FPGA chip and perform isolation operation on the PWM signals. The signal amplification module is connected with the optocoupler isolation module and can perform voltage amplification operation on the PWM signal, so that the driving capability of the PWM signal is improved. The current limiting module is connected with the signal amplifying module and can transmit PWM signals to the interface module. When the current value of the PWM signal is larger than the set value, the current limiting module is in an off state, so that a circuit and equipment of a later stage are protected. The interface module is connected with the current limiting module, and the interface module can transmit PWM signals to the equipment at the later stage. The surge suppression module and the bleeder module are connected with the interface module in parallel, the surge suppression module can perform surge suppression operation on the PWM signal, and the bleeder module can perform bleeder operation on electromagnetic interference of the PWM signal.

title_en: Intelligent photoelectric temperature sensing switch assembly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of electric devices, and discloses an intelligent photoelectric temperature-sensing switch assembly, which comprises a protection box, a photoelectric temperature-sensing circuit board and a top cover arranged at the top of the protection box, wherein a bottom plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the protection box, a chip is fixedly arranged at the top of the photoelectric temperature-sensing circuit board, a wiring terminal is fixedly arranged at the top of the photoelectric temperature-sensing circuit board, one side of the wiring terminal is connected with a wire, the other end of the wire is provided with a connecting wire, the other end of the connecting wire is fixedly provided with a USB end, a receiving end is arranged at the top of the photoelectric temperature-sensing circuit board, and a transmitting end is arranged at the top of the photoelectric temperature-sensing circuit board. This intelligence photoelectricity temperature-sensing switch subassembly through the cooperation of protective sheath one and protective sheath two, can play the effect of protection to connecting wire and protection box one end, also can play the effect of protection to the one end that connecting wire and USB end are connected simultaneously, avoids the connecting wire to take place the rupture easily.

title_en: Dual-power three-stage Darlington current amplifying circuit
abstract_en: A dual-power three-stage Darlington current amplifying circuit belongs to the technical field of special power supplies for power semiconductor testing, and solves the problem of how to improve the current source efficiency of the power semiconductor device conduction voltage drop test; the utility model adopts a mode of adding a three-stage Darlington tube into a double power supply, wherein a first power supply VCC supplies power to a triode Q1 and a triode Q2, a second power supply BT1 supplies power to a triode Q3, the triode Q1, the triode Q2 and the triode Q3 form a three-stage amplifying circuit, the amplification factor can reach 10 ten thousand times, the power supply efficiency can reach 90.9 percent, and the three-stage amplifying circuit is an efficient, low-cost and large-voltage-range pulse current source, and the three-stage amplifying circuit can be extended in parallel, and a plurality of three-stage amplifying units are connected in parallel, so that the test requirement of higher power can be met.

title_en: Solid-state relay
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a solid-state relay which comprises a base, a bottom plate and a silicon controlled rectifier, wherein the bottom plate is arranged at the bottom of the base, the silicon controlled rectifier is arranged on the bottom plate, a plurality of rivets are arranged below the base, riveting holes are formed in the bottom plate corresponding to the rivets, and the rivets of the base penetrate through the riveting holes to realize riveting with the bottom plate.

title_en: Isolation control circuit and multifunctional universal line switching module
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an isolation control circuit and a multifunctional universal line switching module, which comprise an output signal isolation control circuit and an input signal isolation control circuit, wherein the output signal isolation control circuit is used for isolating and outputting an output signal to a signal input/output interface, and the input signal isolation control circuit is used for isolating and outputting an input signal of the input/output interface. Therefore, all the input and output interfaces are isolated by using the optocoupler, so that the influence of external interference signals on the input and output signals is filtered to the greatest extent, and the error rate caused by the external interference signals in the signal transmission process can be greatly reduced. In addition, the multifunctional universal line switching module formed by the input/output interface circuit, one or more isolation control circuits, the main control circuit and the network communication circuit can monitor long-distance remote state or multi-device connection state through devices such as a router or a switch, and the universality is better.

title_en: Frequency hopping filter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of filters, in particular to a frequency hopping filter. The frequency hopping filter comprises a filter body, wherein a plurality of wiring terminals are arranged at two ends of the filter body, a fixing assembly is arranged outside the wiring terminals, the fixing assembly comprises inserting rods, two inserting rods are symmetrically distributed on two sides outside the corresponding wiring terminals, and the inserting rods and the extrusion pieces which are in sliding connection with each other are sleeved outside the corresponding wiring terminals. According to the frequency hopping filter provided by the utility model, through the arrangement of the fixing component, when the device is connected with the connecting wire, the spring can drive the extrusion sheet to reset through the acting force of the spring, and when the extrusion sheet extrudes the lug at the end part of the connecting wire, the connection of the connecting wire can be rapidly completed.

title_en: Linear Hall chip with backflow prevention function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a linear Hall chip with a backflow prevention function, which comprises a secondary operational amplifier arranged in the linear Hall chip, wherein a backflow prevention circuit is arranged in a Hall output end of the linear Hall chip, the backflow prevention circuit comprises a backflow prevention processor, the backflow prevention processor comprises a first input end, a second input end, a load tube, a first output end and a second output end, the first input end is connected with the Hall output end VOUT, the second input end is connected with a power supply end VDD, the two paths of inputs are respectively connected with the load tube for adjusting trigger pressure difference after passing through a current limiting resistor, the first output end is connected with the second output end through a switch tube, the second output end is connected with the secondary operational amplifier through the switch tube, and the secondary operational amplifier is also connected with the first input end of the backflow prevention processor through the switch tube.

title_en: Proximity switch takes copper needle coil skeleton
