abstract_en: The utility model discloses a coil framework with copper needles for a proximity switch, which comprises an annular outer baffle, a winding cylinder, an annular inner baffle and copper needles, wherein the winding cylinder is a hollow cylinder body, the winding cylinder is used for winding a coil, one end face of the winding cylinder is provided with the annular outer baffle, the end face of the annular outer baffle is provided with an opening groove for extending out of a coil port, the other end face of the winding cylinder is provided with the annular inner baffle, the outer end face of the annular inner baffle is provided with a plurality of copper needles extending outwards, the copper needles are welded with a circuit board and are electrically conductive, and the end face of the annular inner baffle is provided with an opening groove for extending out of a coil port.

title_en: Alternating double-end laser frequency modulation machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an alternating double-head laser frequency modulation machine which comprises a frame, a feeding device, a first laser frequency modulation device, a second laser frequency modulation device, a distributing device, a receiving device and a discharging device, wherein the feeding device, the first laser frequency modulation device, the second laser frequency modulation device, the distributing device, the receiving device and the discharging device are arranged on the frame, the feeding device is used for providing carrier bars for the two groups of laser frequency modulation devices one by one, the first laser frequency modulation device and the second laser frequency modulation device are arranged on two sides in a separated mode, the distributing device is in butt joint between the feeding device and the first laser frequency modulation device and the second laser frequency modulation device and is used for receiving the carrier bars and alternately distributing the carrier bars to the first laser frequency modulation device and the second laser frequency modulation device, the receiving device is in butt joint with the discharging ends of the first laser frequency modulation device and the second laser frequency modulation device, and the discharging device is in butt joint with the discharging ends of the receiving device.

title_en: Capacitive sensing type key and equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model relates to a key structure and discloses a capacitive sensing type key and equipment. The capacitive sensing type key comprises an upper cover, a base, a shaft core, an elastic piece and a capacitive module, wherein the shaft core penetrates through the top surface of the upper cover and moves in a reciprocating mode perpendicular to the top surface, the center of the shaft core extends to the base direction to form a guide rail column, the base comprises a guide rail channel which is formed by extending along the guide rail column to the upper cover direction, the shaft core moves in a reciprocating mode to drive the guide rail column to move in the guide rail channel in a reciprocating mode, the capacitive module comprises a first polar plate and a second polar plate which are arranged on the inner wall of the guide rail channel at intervals, projection of the first polar plate in the direction towards the second polar plate is overlapped with the second polar plate, the first polar plate and the second polar plate form a capacitor, capacitance signals generated by the capacitor change along with the reciprocation of the guide rail column between the first polar plate and the second polar plate, and the distance of the shaft core can be determined according to the capacitance signals.

title_en: Topological structure and high-selectivity miniaturized broadband band-pass filter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a topological structure, which comprises parallel three lines, a microstrip line, an open circuit branch knot, an input port and an output port, wherein one end of each parallel three line is respectively connected with the input port and the output port, and the other end of each parallel three line is sequentially connected with the microstrip line and the open circuit branch knot. The utility model also discloses a miniaturized broadband band-pass filter with high selectivity based on the topological structure, and the miniaturized broadband band-pass filter has the advantages of high selectivity and small size.

title_en: Built-in IEPE circuit for piezoelectric shock wave pressure sensor
abstract_en: The utility model provides a built-in IEPE circuit for a piezoelectric shock wave pressure sensor, which comprises a high-gain amplifier, a feedback capacitor and a constant current source, wherein the high-gain amplifier consists of an N-channel enhanced field effect tube, a P-channel enhanced field effect tube, a resistor R1, a resistor R2, a feedback resistor R3 and a resistor R4, the two ends of the high-gain amplifier are connected with the constant current source, the positive electrode of the constant current source is an output end, the constant current source is connected with the P-channel enhanced field effect tube, the built-in IEPE circuit also comprises a piezoelectric sensor sensitive element, the piezoelectric sensor sensitive element is connected with an input end and receives charge signals generated by the piezoelectric sensor sensitive element through the input end, and the feedback capacitor is arranged between the input end and the output end to form a negative feedback to form a charge amplifying circuit.

title_en: Charging reset circuit of lithium battery power supply electronic scale and electronic scale
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a charging reset circuit of a lithium battery powered electronic scale and the electronic scale, comprising an enabling power supply unit and a charging reset unit, wherein the enabling power supply unit is positioned between an external power supply and a power receiving device and is used for adjusting the voltage of the external power supply to supply power to the power receiving device, the charging reset unit is positioned between the external power supply and the enabling power supply unit, the charging reset unit is connected with an enabling control end of the enabling power supply unit, and the charging reset unit is connected with the external power supply. According to the electronic scale, the charging and resetting functions are integrated by arranging the enabling power supply unit and the charging and resetting unit, and a resetting key hole is not required to be arranged on the shell, so that the integrity of the electronic scale shell is improved, the performances of water resistance, dust resistance and the like of a product are improved, and the product is more attractive. In addition, the circuit also simplifies the internal structure of the electronic scale, simplifies the assembly steps and the number of parts in the production process, improves the production efficiency and reduces the production cost.

title_en: Touch switch
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a touch switch, which comprises a shell, a touch pad, a base, a circuit board, a vibrating motor and other parts, wherein the top of the shell is sunken towards the middle part, the touch pad is arranged in the sunken part, after the shell is movably connected with the base, a limiting block is arranged in a cavity of the shell to place the circuit board, the top of the base is connected with a sensing drive and is provided with a groove for accommodating the vibrating motor, a plurality of elastic bulges are uniformly distributed on the periphery of the groove, and a sensing rod of a sensing piece is contacted with the vibrating motor through the circuit board. The touch panel is arranged in the concave part of the shell and has anti-skid textures, accurate touch control is guaranteed, the shell is firmly connected with the base, the circuit board is reasonably arranged, the overall stability and safety are effectively improved, the accommodating groove of the sensing drive is provided with the elastic protrusions, the influence of the vibration motor on the internal structure is eliminated, the damage to circuit elements is reduced, the user experience is improved, and the running stability of equipment is improved.

title_en: Filtering device and communication equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a filtering device and communication equipment. The filter device comprises an input end, an output end, a filter circuit and an isolation circuit, wherein the input end is electrically connected with an antenna, the input end is used for receiving a received signal from the antenna, the input end is used for inputting the received signal of the antenna into the filter circuit and the isolation circuit, the filter circuit is electrically connected with the output end, the filter circuit is used for filtering the received signal of the antenna to obtain a first signal, the isolation circuit is electrically connected with a load, the isolation circuit is used for filtering the received signal of the antenna to obtain a second signal, wherein the first signal is a frequency signal which is required to be output by the filter device, and the second signal is a frequency signal which is different from the first signal in the received signal of the antenna. The application can filter the second signal and absorb the second signal through the load by arranging the isolation circuit, thereby reducing the signal reflection of the second signal to the front-end circuit and reducing the interference of the second signal to the first signal.

title_en: Sigma-Delta modulator capable of guaranteeing stability
abstract_en: The utility model provides a Sigma-Delta modulator which comprises a quantizer, at least three cascaded delay integration modules, an unstable detector and a control loop, wherein the input end of the first delay integration module receives an input signal, the output end of the last delay integration module is connected with the input end of the quantizer, in the two adjacent delay integration modules, the output end of the front delay integration module is connected with the input end of the rear delay integration module, the unstable detector is connected with the input end of the quantizer, the control loop of the Sigma-Delta modulator is determined to be stable according to the input signal of the quantizer, and if the control loop is unstable, the number of stages of the effectively cascaded delay integration modules is reduced. In this way, the Sigma-Delta modulator is automatically reduced after the whole system is unstable due to external factors, thereby avoiding complete loss of function of the Sigma-Delta modulator.

title_en: Novel analog Doppler frequency shift signal generation circuit
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of radars. The utility model provides a novel analog Doppler frequency shift signal generating circuit which comprises a high-frequency signal input module, a first mixer, a second mixer, a first filtering module, a second filtering module, a first local oscillation signal input module, a second local oscillation signal input module and a radio frequency signal output module, wherein the high-frequency signal input module is connected with the first mixer, the first mixer is respectively connected with the first filtering module and the first local oscillation signal input module, the first filtering module is connected with the second mixer, the second mixer is respectively connected with the second filtering module and the second local oscillation signal input module, and the second filtering module is connected with the radio frequency signal output module. According to the utility model, the frequency difference between the mixed spurious signals and useful signals is increased by reasonably increasing the frequency of the intermediate frequency signals, so that the aim of filtering the mixed spurious signals through a band-pass filter is fulfilled, and finally, high-quality Doppler frequency shift signals are generated.

title_en: Mobile phone shell touch conduction key and mobile phone shell
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mobile phone shell touch conduction key, which comprises a key main body and a plurality of conduction blocks equidistantly arranged on one side of the key main body, and also discloses a mobile phone shell, wherein the mobile phone shell comprises a shell, and the mobile phone shell touch conduction key is arranged on the side wall of the shell, and has the beneficial effects that: the utility model provides a mobile phone shell touch conduction key and a mobile phone shell, when the mobile phone shell is sleeved on a mobile phone, a conduction block can be in contact with a touch key on the mobile phone, and when a key main body is touched, the key main body transmits a touch signal to the touch key on the mobile phone through the conduction block, so that the touch operation is convenient, and the touch effect of touching the touch key on the mobile phone can be achieved.

title_en: Voltage-controlled adjustable center frequency band-pass filter and excitation signal modulation device
abstract_en: The application relates to a voltage-controlled adjustable center frequency point band-pass filter and an excitation signal modulation device, wherein an inverse low-pass filter circuit amplifies or attenuates received control voltage and outputs negative voltage matched with pinch-off voltage parameters of a field effect tube in a frequency selection filter, a nonlinear compensation circuit compensates the negative voltage and then transmits the negative voltage to the frequency selection filter, the frequency selection filter adjusts center frequency by utilizing an internal field effect tube according to the received negative voltage, and a received PWM signal is modulated into a same-frequency sine wave signal according to the adjusted center frequency. The control voltage can be regulated according to actual needs, so that the frequency-selective filter modulates the received PWM signal into the same-frequency sine wave signal according to the regulated central frequency, the central frequency point is supported to be continuously regulated on line, and the use reliability in the complex electromagnetic environment is improved.

title_en: Laboratory self-adaptive variable air volume ventilation control system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a laboratory self-adaptation variable air volume ventilation control system relates to laboratory ventilation equipment control technical field, contain temperature and humidity sensor, differential pressure detector, harmful gas monitoring sensor, infrared camera, data buffer memory module, multiplexing switch, data preprocessing module, controller module, man-machine interaction module, clock module, memory module, data transmission module, level conversion and pulse width adjustment circuit, variable air volume governing valve and power module, through setting up many monitoring sensor, humiture in the real-time supervision room, indoor pollution gas concentration, indoor personnel's condition, indoor pressure condition etc. through controller module, the air supply driving unit, the air supply governing valve, the air supply can effectually keep indoor pressure's stability, nimble pressure to indoor is adjusted, control, and speed of regulation is fast, effectual, the effectual health of indoor staff of laboratory environment of constant pressure.

title_en: Improved capacitance type proximity switch
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an improved capacitive proximity switch, which relates to the technical field of proximity switches and comprises a shell component, an inner component and a guide sealing mechanism, wherein the shell component is used for protecting the inner component, the guide sealing mechanism comprises a plurality of guide grooves, a bottom plate, a rubber sleeve, guide rods, sealing rings and threaded sleeves, the guide grooves are uniformly formed in the bottom of the outer side of a main shell, the bottom plate and the rubber sleeve are sequentially and fixedly sleeved on the outer side of a cable from top to bottom, the guide rods are uniformly and fixedly arranged at the edge of the top of the bottom plate, and the guide rods are uniformly arranged at the edge of the top of the bottom plate. The utility model has simple structure, effectively reduces the production and assembly difficulty, further reduces the production cost, and simultaneously, the sealing ring can effectively seal the bottom opening of the main shell, thereby ensuring the sealing effect between the main shell and the bottom plate.

title_en: Gain-adjustable differential amplifier
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a differential amplifier with adjustable gain, which belongs to the technical field of differential amplifiers and comprises a first operational amplifier, a second operational amplifier and a reference voltage source, wherein inverting and non-inverting input ends of the first operational amplifier are respectively connected with an external signal input end through a first resistor and a second resistor, inverting input ends of the first operational amplifier are connected with an output end of the differential amplifier through a fifth resistor, output ends of the reference voltage source are respectively connected with the non-inverting input end of the first operational amplifier through a third resistor, a fourth resistor is connected with the inverting input end of the first operational amplifier, the non-inverting input end of the second operational amplifier is connected with the output of the first operational amplifier, the inverting input end of the second operational amplifier is connected with the output end of the differential amplifier through an eighth resistor and then grounded.

title_en: Water pump control circuit and water pump
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water pump control, in particular to a water pump control circuit and a water pump, wherein the water pump control circuit comprises a controller; the digital signal transmission module is connected with the controller and used for connecting an external digital signal device and bidirectionally transmitting digital communication signals between the external digital signal device and the controller.

title_en: Power amplifier upper cover with strong protection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a power amplifier upper cover with strong protection performance, which relates to the technical field of power amplifier upper covers and comprises a shell, wherein an upper cover body is arranged at the top of the shell, two fixing grooves are formed in one side of the upper cover body, a dust screen is arranged in a clamping groove formed in the top of the upper cover body, and two supports are arranged in the upper cover body. According to the utility model, the flip type upper cover body is arranged at the upper part of the shell, when the power amplifier module in the shell is overhauled, the handle can be pulled to drive the two fixing blocks to separate from the fixing grooves which are respectively clamped, at the moment, the limit between the upper cover body and the shell is released, the upper cover can be opened to overhaul the power amplifier module in the upper cover body, the dismounting tool is prevented from being used for dismounting in the frequent dismounting process, the working efficiency is improved, the misoperation operation risk is reduced, the effective heat dissipation effect can be provided for equipment through the two heat dissipation fans arranged in the upper cover body, and the influence of accumulated heat in the shell on the power amplifier module is avoided.

title_en: Combined ultra-wideband mixer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a combined ultra-wideband mixer, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a clamping mechanism for clamping and mounting the ultra-wideband mixer to a specified working platform or a bracket is arranged below the bottom plate, a storage mechanism for positioning all component parts of the ultra-wideband mixer is arranged at the top of the bottom plate, a positioning component for positioning all component parts of the ultra-wideband mixer is arranged above the bottom plate, and a mounting component for mounting all kinds of joints is arranged on the surface of the storage mechanism.

title_en: Quartz crystal
abstract_en: The utility model provides a quartz crystal, which relates to the technical field of quartz crystals and comprises a base, wherein a base cavity is arranged in the base, the top of the base cavity is opened and is covered with an upper cover, a wafer is adhered to the bottom of the base cavity, and gradient electrodes are deposited on the upper surface and the lower surface of the wafer in a gradient manner. The gradient electrode has the advantages that the gradient electrode can buffer thermal expansion difference, reduce interface stress concentration and frequency drift, can enhance bonding strength between the electrode and a wafer, reduce interface peeling risk, reduce microcrack and peeling risk of an interface between the electrode and the wafer, and reduce surface pollution penetration probability.

title_en: Filter with high rectangle degree and small flatness in low frequency band
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of communication, in particular to a filter with high rectangular degree and small flatness in a low frequency band. Comprising a band-pass filter and an amplitude equalizer connected to the band-pass filter. The band-pass filter comprises an input inductor, a multi-order quasi-elliptic circuit and an output inductor which are sequentially connected. The multi-order quasi-elliptic circuit comprises a plurality of groups of parallel connection ground resonance units which are sequentially connected, wherein each group of parallel connection ground resonance units is an inductance and capacitance parallel connection ground circuit, parallel connection resonance units are connected between every two groups of parallel connection ground resonance units, each parallel connection resonance unit is an inductance and capacitance parallel connection circuit, and inter-stage grounding capacitors connected between the parallel connection resonance units are used for adjusting in-band flatness. The amplitude equalizer comprises two groups of frequency band high-end equalizers and one group of frequency band low-end equalizers which are sequentially connected. The utility model solves the problem that the elliptic function structure filter in the prior art can not simultaneously meet the requirements of high rectangle degree and low in-band flatness.

title_en: U-shaped correlation type infrared photoelectric switch
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a U-shaped correlation type infrared photoelectric switch which comprises a plastic shell, an emitting tube, a receiving tube, a first pin terminal and a second pin terminal, wherein a first embedded groove and a second embedded groove are respectively formed in two outer side walls of the plastic shell, a first circuit board of the emitting tube is adhered in the first embedded groove, a first channel is formed between the first embedded groove and a first optical window, the receiving tube comprises a second circuit board and a receiving chip, and a second channel is formed between the second embedded groove and the second optical window. The first embedding groove and the second embedding groove are formed in two sides of the plastic shell, so that the embedding and positioning of the transmitting tube and the receiving tube can be realized, the transmitting tube and the receiving tube are fixed in the first embedding groove or the second embedding groove in an adhesive mode, the transmitting tube and the receiving tube can be conveniently applied with force by matching with the inclined plane structure, the adhesive firmness is improved, and the arrangement of the first channel and the second channel can enable the infrared light to realize stable transmitting and receiving and avoid the optical axis deviation caused by assembly deviation.

title_en: Communication circuit, interface and test system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a communication circuit, an interface and a test system, wherein the communication circuit comprises a switching module, a first coupling module, a second coupling module and a communication interface module. The first coupling module and the second coupling module are respectively communicated with the first external equipment in a current loop, the switching module is used for switching connection among the first coupling module, the second coupling module and the first external equipment, and the communication interface module is used for communication signal conversion between the second external equipment and the first coupling module or the second coupling module. According to the communication circuit, the interface and the test system, the first coupling module and the second coupling module are integrated, and the connection among the first coupling module, the second coupling module and the first external equipment is switched through the switching module, so that flexible switching among different communication modes is facilitated. Through adding the control module, can also adapt to more communication protocols, satisfy more test scenes.

title_en: Signal generating device, quantum computing measurement and control system and quantum computer
abstract_en: The application discloses a signal generating device, a quantum computing measurement and control system and a quantum computer, which comprise a frequency multiplication circuit, a phase-locked loop circuit and a first voltage-controlled oscillator, wherein the frequency multiplication circuit is used for processing a received first clock signal to generate a second clock signal with higher frequency, the phase-locked loop circuit comprises a frequency mixer, a first filter and the voltage-controlled oscillator, two input ends of the frequency mixer are respectively and electrically connected with the output end of the frequency multiplication circuit and the output end of the voltage-controlled oscillator to generate a difference frequency signal based on a frequency difference value of the received second clock signal and the frequency signal, the input end of the first filter is electrically connected with the output end of the frequency mixer to perform low-pass filtering processing on the difference frequency signal and generate a first voltage-controlled signal, and the input end of the voltage-controlled oscillator is electrically connected with the output end of the first filter to output the frequency signal and adjust the frequency of the frequency signal according to the first voltage-controlled signal until the frequency signal is locked to a target frequency. The signal generating device of the application improves the near-end and far-end phase noise performance of the final output signal.

title_en: 10-Bit digital phase shifter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of wireless communication, and particularly discloses a 10-bit digital phase shifter which comprises a phase shifting unit group, a digital phase shifting circuit, an amplifier and a power supply control circuit, wherein the phase shifting unit group, the digital phase shifting circuit and the amplifier are sequentially connected in series, and the power supply control circuit is respectively connected with the phase shifting unit group, the digital phase shifting circuit and the amplifier. The 10-bit digital phase shifter is realized through cascading of four phase shifting units and a 6-bit digital phase shifting circuit, the four phase shifting units adopt a distributed cascading structure, each phase shifting unit can be independently controlled, signal transmission is carried out through a microstrip line or a strip line, the signal transmission distance is shortened, the phase shifting precision is improved, different logic levels can be converted through a power supply control circuit aiming at different phase shifting units or 6-bit digital phase shifting circuits, so that the phase shifting units or 6-bit digital phase shifting circuits can be mutually compatible, correct cascading control is realized, and the problems of poor signal processing quality and low accuracy caused by low phase control precision of the existing digital phase shifter are solved.

title_en: Long-time continuous sampling hold circuit for staggered and overlapped sampling
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of sample-hold circuits and discloses a long-time continuous sample-hold circuit with staggered overlapped sampling, which comprises a sample signal generating module, a first sample switch and a second sample switch, wherein the sample signal generating module receives an original sample signal and a high-frequency clock signal and outputs the first sample signal and the second sample signal, the first sample signal is input into the first sample switch, the second sample signal is input into the second sample switch, the first sample switch and the second sample switch alternately overlap-sample an input VIN signal and output a sample result VOUT.

title_en: Acoustic watch filter and communication equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sound surface filter capable of effectively suppressing a transverse mode and communication equipment. The acoustic surface filter comprises an IDT metal electrode arranged on a piezoelectric substrate, wherein the surface of the IDT metal electrode is covered with a temperature compensation layer, the IDT metal electrode comprises a finger electrode, a load layer is arranged in the end head area of the finger electrode along the acoustic wave propagation direction, the load layer adopts one of a first structure, a single continuous belt shape, a second structure, a plurality of continuous belt shapes, a third structure and a plurality of intermittent belt shapes, and the end head areas at two ends of the finger electrode do not adopt the first structure at the same time. The utility model uses the multi-strip load layer to block or reflect the transverse mode, to effectively restrain transverse wave mode, to improve the property of TC-SAW filter, with high Q value.

title_en: Anti-false touch capacitive touch switch
abstract_en: The utility model provides an anti-false touch capacitive touch switch which comprises a panel, a shell and an inner cavity, wherein the inner cavity is sequentially provided with a touch diaphragm, a bracket, at least one anti-false touch pad and a PCBA plate from top to bottom, the bracket is provided with a supporting part, a connecting part and an anti-false touch part, the touch diaphragm is arranged between the lower surface of the panel and the supporting part, the tail end of the touch diaphragm is connected with the PCBA plate, the connecting part is used for being connected with the panel and/or the shell, the anti-false touch part is pressed against the upper end of the anti-false touch pad, the lower end of the anti-false touch pad is connected with the PCBA plate, the anti-false touch pad is provided with a movable block, the lower end of the movable block is provided with a carbon electrode, the region of the PCBA plate corresponding to the movable block is provided with a golden finger, the anti-false touch pad is driven by the bracket to deform when the panel is pressed, the movable block is caused to move downwards, and an electric signal is generated when the carbon electrode of the movable block contacts with the golden finger, so that the anti-false touch capacitive touch switch has low cost and reliable performance.

title_en: Bulk acoustic wave resonator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bulk acoustic wave resonator. The bulk acoustic wave resonator comprises a first electrode, a piezoelectric layer and a second electrode which are arranged in a stacked mode, the electrode of the bulk acoustic wave resonator further comprises at least one group of irregular edges, each group of irregular edges comprises a first edge and a second edge which are adjacent, an included angle is formed between the extending direction of the first edge and the extending direction of the second edge, non-linear electrode boundaries are formed on the first edge and the second edge, wherein the irregular edges of different groups are edges of different electrodes, and the irregular edges of the same group are edges of the same electrode. The manufacturing process of the bulk acoustic wave resonator is simplified, the stability and the reliability of the bulk acoustic wave resonator are improved, and meanwhile, the resonance of a transverse mode can be restrained, so that the distribution and the layout of the resonator are facilitated, the design of the resonator is simplified, and the cost of the resonator is reduced.

title_en: Pulse sputtering power supply and semiconductor process equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a pulse sputtering power supply and semiconductor process equipment. The pulse sputtering power supply comprises a power supply voltage module, a boosting module, a back pressure module and a switching module, wherein the input end of the power supply voltage module is connected with an alternating current power supply and used for acquiring first voltage and providing the first voltage for the switching module, the boosting module is used for boosting the first voltage and providing second voltage for the switching module, the back pressure module is used for back pressure of the first voltage and providing third voltage for the switching module, the control end of the switching module is connected with a control signal and used for switching the switching state of the switching module based on the control signal, the output end of the switching module is used for providing the first voltage, the second voltage or the third voltage to the outside based on the switching state, and the power supply voltage module, the boosting module and the back pressure module are all provided with energy storage capacitors. The pulse sputtering power supply can solve the problem of limited back pressure time.

title_en: Multi-purpose high-voltage amplifier formed by serially connecting multiple stages NmosFET
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of power electronics and discloses a multi-purpose high-voltage amplifier formed by serially connecting multiple stages NmosFET, which comprises supporting legs, wherein a metal shell is arranged at the top of each supporting leg, a control switch and an adjusting button are arranged on the outer wall of each metal shell, an interface is arranged on one side of each adjusting button, which is far away from each control switch, a U-shaped anti-slip clamp is fixedly connected to one side of each interface, which is far away from each metal shell, a conveying pipe II is arranged on one side of each U-shaped anti-slip clamp, a protective cover is fixedly connected to the side wall of each ventilation hole, a metal shielding cover is fixedly connected to the inside of each protective cover, and a cleaning assembly is arranged inside each protective cover. According to the utility model, under the cooperation of the structures such as the metal shielding cover, the protective cover and the U-shaped anti-slip clamp, the structural stability and the operation safety of the equipment in the high-voltage signal amplification process are realized, and the influence of external interference and component displacement on the amplification precision is effectively avoided.

title_en: Milling machine display power supply
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of power supplies, in particular to a milling machine display power supply, which comprises a box body, wherein a power supply board is fixedly connected to the middle of the inner wall of the box body, a secondary RC filter is fixedly connected to the surface of the power supply board, a circular opening is formed in the center of the bottom surface of the outer wall of the box body, a circular ring is fixedly connected to the inside of the circular opening, a fan is arranged on the inner wall of the circular ring, and a conical frame is fixedly connected to the bottom surface of the inner wall of the box body close to the circular opening. The utility model has the advantages that when the fan blows air to the bottom surface of the power panel, the air flows to the annular frame and flows to the top surface of the power panel through the first hole, so that the effect of ventilating the top surface of the power panel can be achieved, the drying effect of the power panel is further improved, when the fan blows air to the bottom surface of the power panel, the air flows to the annular frame and flows to the top surface of the power panel through the first hole, the effect of ventilating the top surface of the power panel can be achieved, and the drying effect of the power panel is further improved.

title_en: Pin multiplexing circuit and electrical equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pin multiplexing circuit and electrical equipment, wherein the pin multiplexing circuit comprises a singlechip, a digital signal module and a first analog signal module, wherein the singlechip comprises a first signal acquisition port, the first analog signal module comprises a first pull-up resistor, a first low-pass filter and an isolation unit, the high-resistance unit is used for enabling the digital signal module to be in a high-resistance state when the digital signal module outputs a low-level signal, and the isolation unit is used for isolating the influence of the first low-pass filter on the high-level signal when the digital signal module outputs the high-level signal. Furthermore, through the arrangement of the high-resistance unit and the isolation unit, the influence of the analog signal module on the digital signal is reduced, the distortion in the digital signal transmission process is avoided, and the accuracy of the signal acquisition of the singlechip is improved. The name of the utility model. The first one. The first advantage of the independent claim.

title_en: Method for determining element values of filter structure
abstract_en: This invention relates to a method for determining element values of a filter structure having a linear sequence of coupled resonators, wherein a coupling between adjacent resonators is determined by one or more coupling factors, the method comprising deriving an input-to- output transfer function on the basis of an Impedance or Admittance matrix, wherein the matrix is determined as a function of input resistance, output resistance, resonator detuning and as a function of coupling factors, representing one of Kirchhoff's laws for loops or nodes of the filter structure and including the coupling factors; determining one or more conditions for the coupling factors such that the input-to-output transfer function; determining the coupling factors using the one or more determined conditions; and deriving element values of the filter structure in dependence on the determined coupling factors.

title_en: Nanofibers formed from a blend of photoactive thermoplastic polymer and trifluoropropyl polyhedral silsesquioxane and methods for using them
abstract_en: A polymer nanofiber includes: from 80 wt% to 99 wt% of a photoactive polycarbonate copolymer (XPC); and from 1 wt% to 20 wt% trifluoropropyl polyhedral oligomeric silsesquioxane (F-POSS). A method of making polymer nanofibers includes combining from 80 wt% to 99 wt% of a photoactive polycarbonate copolymer (XPC) with from 1 wt% to 20 wt% trifluoropropyl polyhedral oligomeric silsesquioxane (F-POSS) in a solvent; dissolving the XPC and F-POSS in the solvent to form a solution; and electrospinning the solution to form the polymer nanofibers.

title_en: Doherty amplifier with complex combining load matching circuit
abstract_en: A Doherty power amplifier includes input circuitry that provides input signals to carrier and peaking amplifiers with an input phase offset between 20 degrees and 160 degrees. Carrier and peaking amplifier output signals are combined at a combining node. A complex combining load matching circuit, which is connected to the combining node, consists of two, series-connected transmission line segments. The matching circuit provides a complex impedance,  ZL , with a non-zero reactive portion,  xn.  The output circuit between the peaking amplifier and the combining node has an electrical length of 0 or  n ∗ 180  degrees ( n  = an integer value). The output circuit between the carrier amplifier and the combining node has an electrical length,  θx,  equal to an absolute value of the input phase offset when the electrical length of the peaking output circuit is 0 degrees.

title_en: Analog-to-digital converter system, transceiver, base station and mobile device
abstract_en: An Analog-to-Digital Converter, ADC, system is provided. The ADC system comprises a plurality of ADC circuits and a first input for receiving a transmit signal of a transceiver. One ADC circuit of the plurality of ADC circuits is coupled to the first input and configured to provide first digital data based on the transmit signal. The ADC system further comprises a second input for receiving a receive signal of the transceiver. The other ADC circuits of the plurality of ADC circuits are coupled to the second input, wherein the other ADC circuits of the plurality of ADC circuits are time-interleaved and configured to provide second digital data based on the receive signal. Additionally, the ADC system comprises a first output configured to output digital feedback data based on the first digital data, and a second output configured to output digital receive data based on the second digital data.

title_en: Amplifier having switch and switch control processor controlling switch
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a pre-5th-Generation (5G) or 5G communication system to be provided for supporting higher data rates Beyond 4th-Generation (4G) communication system such as Long Term Evolution (LTE). An amplifier is provided. The amplifier includes a first resistor electrically connected to the input terminal, a second resistor electrically connected to the output terminal, a switch including a metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistor (MOSFET) and electrically connected to one end of the second resistor, and a switch control processor configured to electrically connect the gate terminal of the MOSFET constituting the switch and the bulk terminal of the MOSFET constituting the switch to an impedance having an impedance value higher than a preset first threshold.

title_en: Data-enable mask compression on a communication bus
abstract_en: An apparatus includes an encoding circuit, and a communication bus having conductive traces configured to transfer a data payload, including a control signal and up to a maximum number of data words. The encoding circuit is configured to receive an uncompressed data payload and a mask value, and to create, using the mask value, the control signal, the control signal indicative of whether the uncompressed data payload includes one or more non-enabled data words. In response to a determination that the control signal indicates that the uncompressed data payload includes one or more non-enabled data words, the encoding circuit is configured to create a compressed data payload from the uncompressed data payload, and to send, to a decoding circuit, the compressed data payload and the control signal via the plurality of conductive traces of the communication bus. The compressed data payload includes the mask value.

title_en: Remote communication with multiple dialysis machines
abstract_en: A remote control device may be used to wirelessly control functions of one or more dialysis machines, e.g. in a clinic environment and without requiring direct contact with the dialysis machines. Components of the remote control device may include control interfaces, e.g. buttons, for controlling and adjusting functions of a medical device, such as a dialysis machine, including, for example, volume control, blood pump control blood flow rate control and/or adjusting the level in the venous drip chamber, among other control features. Display of the remote control device may include one or more screens that may display information of one or more dialysis machines, patients undergoing dialysis treatment, and/or alarms or alerts of one or more of the dialysis machines. In an implementation, ultrasonic communication is used to wirelessly exchange information and commands between the remote control device and the one or more dialysis machines.

title_en: Variable gain amplifier system, particularly for optical receiver systems
abstract_en:
The invention relates to a variable gain system (1), particularly for optical receiver systems, comprising: 
an input (2) for an electronic signal, 
at least two variable gain amplifiers (3, 4), and 
an output (5) for an amplified electrical signal, 
wherein the at least two variable gain amplifiers (3, 4) are connected in parallel to the input (2) and the output (5) aggregates the signals of the at least two variable gain amplifiers (3, 4).

title_en: Noise suppressing interface circuit for device with control circuits in different noise environments
abstract_en: A thermal and environmental noise suppressing interface circuit which is configured to operate cold and is configured to perform biasing with suppression of noise currents from room temperature noise voltages and dc coupled rf readout of a superconducting device under test with a single coaxial cable or equivalent conductor pair. The circuit is configured to suppress the propagation of thermal and environmental noises to/from sensors operating at a different temperature from its operating and control equipment while maintaining a single input-output channel, and provides for the placement of a local grounding impedance on an intercept board.

title_en: Cavity filter tuning using imitation and reinforcement learning
abstract_en: A method for solving a sequential decision-making problem is provided. The method includes gathering state-action pair data from an expert policy; applying imitation learning to yield a cloned policy based on the gathered state-action pair data from the expert policy; and applying a reinforcement learning technique, wherein the reinforcement learning technique is initialized based on the cloned policy and has an output with one or more action to be performed for solving the sequential decision-making problem.

title_en: Partial-parallel cyclic redundancy check, crc, computation using a generator matrix stored in a look up table, lut
abstract_en: A cyclic redundancy check, CRC, computation circuit (300) is described. The CRC computation circuit includes an input for receiving an input stream (303) that has an input bit sequence comprising two or more bits of the input stream (303) at a time that are aligned to the rows of a CRC generator matrix stored in a Look Up Table, LUT (302); and two or more parallel processors (301) configured to perform a CRC computation of the input bit sequence. The Look Up Table, LUT (302), is operably coupled to the two or more parallel processors (301) and comprising a plurality of addresses wherein at least one of the plurality of addresses is configured to store two or more rows (402) of the CRC generator matrix. At least one of the two or more parallel processors (301) is configured to: first combine LUT data with the input stream (303) by using two or more bits of the aligned input stream (303) to mask the two or more rows (402) of the CRC generator matrix stored in the LUT (302) and thereby generate two or more intermediate parity bit sequences (406); and second combine the two or more intermediate parity bit sequences (406) into a single parity bit sequence (102).

title_en: Wideband buffer
abstract_en: Embodiments of a wideband buffer circuit and a wideband communication circuit that uses the wideband buffer circuit are disclosed. In an embodiment, the wideband buffer circuit includes first and second transistors deployed as a voltage buffer and connected to first and second input terminals, first and second parallel resistor-capacitor pairs connected to the first and second transistors, first and second cross-coupled transistors connected to the first and second parallel resistor-capacitor pairs and connected to first and second output terminals, and first and second current sources connected to the first and second cross-coupled transistors and a fixed voltage. The first transistor, the first parallel resistor-capacitor pair, the first cross-coupled transistor and the first current source are connected in series. Similarly, the second transistor, the second parallel resistor-capacitor pair, the second cross-coupled transistor and the second current source are connected in series.

title_en: Power semiconductor switch clamping circuit
abstract_en: A power semiconductor circuit is provided for clamping the voltage across the circuit when a power semiconductor switch is opened (i.e., turned off). The circuit may include a first surge arrester and a first semiconductor switch coupled in parallel with the power semiconductor switch. The first semiconductor switch is coupled in series with the first surge arrester. A second surge arrester may be coupled to the gate of the first semiconductor switch to control current flow through the first semiconductor switch and the first surge arrester.

title_en: Power-on reset circuit
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a power-on reset circuit, including: a band-gap reference circuit, a current comparator, and a voltage comparison circuit, the band-gap reference circuit, the current comparator, and the voltage comparison circuit being powered by a voltage source; where a first output terminal of the band-gap reference circuit is connected to a control terminal of the current comparator; a first current input terminal of the current comparator receives a first current signal, a second current input terminal of the current comparator receives a second current signal, and an output terminal of the current comparator is connected to a control terminal of the voltage comparison circuit; and a first input terminal of the voltage comparison circuit is connected to the first output terminal of the band-gap reference circuit, a second input terminal of the voltage comparison circuit receives a signal indicating a voltage value of the voltage source, and an output terminal of the voltage comparison circuit is used to output a reset signal, thereby avoiding occurrence of an error caused by output of the reset signal when the reference generating circuit is unstable, reducing false trigger during the power-on process, and increasing the power-on reliability.

title_en: System and method for identifying non-switching semiconductor switches
abstract_en: A system and a method for identifying a non-switching semiconductor switch are proposed. The system has a first acquisition component, a second acquisition component and a determination unit. The first acquisition component is designed to acquire a profile of an electrical variable of a first semiconductor switch driven by way of a first drive signal. The second acquisition component is designed to acquire a profile of an electrical variable of a second semiconductor switch driven by way of a second drive signal and connected in parallel with the first semiconductor switch. The determination unit is designed to use the profile of the electrical variable of the first semiconductor switch and the profile of the electrical variable of the second semiconductor switch as a basis for determining an output signal that allows identification of a non-switching semiconductor switch for the first semiconductor switch and/or the second semiconductor switch.

title_en: Sensor-less overcurrent fault detection using high electron mobility transistors
abstract_en: An overcurrent fault detector using a High Electron Mobility Transistor (HEMT) operated by a gate driver is disclosed. The overcurrent fault detector includes a band-pass filter and a control circuit. The band-pass filter is configured to receive gate-to-source voltage (VGS) signals of the HEMT and filter the VGS signals to generate a band-limited version of the VGS signals. The control circuit is configured to measure a value of the band-limited version of the VGS signals, determine if the value is greater than a threshold value, and generate a fault signal that disables the gate driver and terminates an overcurrent fault condition in response to determining that the value is greater than the threshold value.

title_en: Method of reducing transmission of data in a communications network by using machine learning
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a computer implemented method, performed by a wireless device, for reducing data transmission in a communications network by compression of measurements of network characteristics of the communications network, comprising the method steps of: (S210) obtaining a trained encoder, of a trained autoencoder, (S220) performing a measurements of network characteristics of the communications network, (S230) applying the trained encoder to compress the result of the measurements of network characteristics, and (S240) transmitting the compressed representation of measurements of network characteristics towards a network entity, whereby the network entity may perform a method comprising the method steps of: (S810) obtaining a trained decoder, of the trained autoencoder, (S820) receiving a compressed representation of a measurements of network characteristics, and (S830) applying the trained decoder to reconstruct the compressed representation of the measurements of network characteristics.

title_en: Resource-efficient indoor localization based on channel measurements
abstract_en: Described is an apparatus (800, 900) and method (700) for estimating a refined location in dependence on a plurality of measurements of one or more communication channels. The apparatus comprises one or more processors (801, 901) configured to: compress (701) each channel measurement; process (702) the compressed channel measurements using a neural network to form a plurality of intermediate location estimates; and process (703) the intermediate location estimates to form the refined location.

title_en: Self-calibration of reference voltage drop in digital to analog converter
abstract_en: A method for self-calibration of reference voltage drop in a Digital to Analog Converter (DAC) includes measuring each one of a plurality of thermometric weightages associated with a respective one of a plurality of thermometric bits, wherein the DAC includes a plurality of sub-binary bits and the plurality of thermometric bits. For each sequentially increasing combination of thermometric bit settings including at least two thermometric bits coupled to a high reference voltage and each sub-binary bit coupled to a low reference voltage, performing the steps of: determining a respective combined weightage correction; adding the combined weightage correction to the highest order bit of the combination of thermometric bit settings; and incrementing a number of bits of the combination of thermometric bit settings in response to the number of bits of the sequential combination being less than a total number of the plurality of thermometric bits.

title_en: Codeword bit interleaving scheme for multilayer transmissions in wireless communication system
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a codeword bit interleaving scheme for multilayer transmissions in a wireless communication system. The codeword bit interleaving scheme involves dividing columns of an interleaving matrix into at least two disjoint column groups based on transmission qualities (e.g., SNRs) of data transmission layers (e.g., MIMO layers). The column groups are then filled with codeword bits, starting with writing information bits into the column group(s) corresponding to the high-quality data transmission layers. After that, the column groups are all merged to restore the initial column arrangement of the interleaving matrix, and the codeword bits are read from the interleaving matrix row-wise and mapped to modulation symbols. The modulation symbols are in turn mapped to the data transmission layers themselves. By so doing, it is possible to allocate information bits of a codeword to high- quality data transmission layers, thereby increasing decoding performance.

title_en: Solid-state impedance matching systems including a hybrid tuning network with a switchable coarse tuning network and a varactor fine tuning network
abstract_en: An impedance matching network (104, 304, 1004) is disclosed for providing an impedance match between a RF generator (102, 202, 302, 1002) and a load (106) such as a plasma chamber (306), the impedance matching network comprising: a first electronic variable capacitance comprising: an input terminal (505) for receiving a first radio frequency (RF) input signal (RF IN ) from the RF generator (102, 202); a coarse tuning network (50, 502) comprising a switchable circuit configured to (i) receive the first radio RF input signal (RF IN ), (ii) output a first RF output signal (RF OUT ) to a reference terminal (506) or to the load (106), and (iii) receive a first direct current (DC) bias voltage (V BIAS  - Fig. 3), wherein the switchable circuit is configured to be switched between a first state and a second state, and wherein a capacitance of the switchable circuit is based on the first DC bias voltage (V BIAS  - Fig. 3) while in the first state and is not based on the first DC bias voltage (V BIAS  - Fig. 3) while in the second state; and a fine tuning network (400, 504) connected in parallel with the coarse tuning network (50, 502), the fine tuning network (400, 504) comprising a back-to-back diode varactor (400), wherein the back-to-back diode varactor (400) is configured to receive a second DC bias voltage (V BIAS  - Fig. 8a, 8b) and includes: a first diode (D2) configured to receive the first RF input signal (RF IN ), and a second diode connected (D1) in a back-to-back configuration with the first diode (D2) and configured to output a second RF output signal to the reference terminal (506) or to the load (106), wherein a capacitance of the back-to-back diode varactor (400) is based on the second DC bias voltage (V BIAS  - Fig. 8a, 8b); and a transformer (602, 622) connected to the input terminal (505) and between the first electronic variable capacitance and the plasma chamber, wherein the transformer (602, 622) converts a RF input signal received from the RF generator (102, 202) to the first RF input signal (RF IN ).

title_en: Aerosol generation device power system
abstract_en: There is provided an aerosol generation device (100) comprising a power system (600) and a controller (102). The power system comprises a first supercapacitor module (604) and a second supercapacitor module (606). The controller is configured to control a power flow of the first supercapacitor module to power a heater associated with the aerosol generation device, and control a power flow of the second supercapacitor module to charge the first supercapacitor module.

title_en: Apparatus and methods for low power clock generation in multi-channel high speed devices
abstract_en: Described are apparatus and methods for low power clock generation in multi-channel high speed devices. In implementations, a multi-channel data processing device includes a low frequency clock generation and distribution circuit configured to generate and distribute a 1/N sampling frequency (FS)(FS/N) clock, wherein N is larger or equal to 8, and multiple data processing channels connected to the low frequency generation and distribution circuit. Each data processing channel including input ports associated with different operating frequency clocks, and a channel local clock generation circuit comprising multipliers associated with some of the input ports, each multiplier configured to multiply the FS/N frequency clock to locally generate an operating frequency clock associated with an input port of the input ports. The device also includes a differential frequency doubler which generates a single-ended multiplied frequency clock from the differential FS/N frequency clock and converts it to a differential multiplied frequency clock.

title_en: System and method for multimodulation in a passive optical network
abstract_en: An optical line terminal (OLT) in flexible passive optical network (PON) transmits a downstream signal with two or more modulation formats, wherein at least one of the modulation formats is a modified PAMx modulation format and wherein x is greater than 2. The modified PAMx modulation encodes data bits such that the probability of at least one predetermined transition between amplitude levels is modified. Furthermore, an optical network unit (ONU) in the flexible PON is assigned to one of the plurality of modulation formats based on one or more parameters, such as configuration of the ONU and line conditions.

title_en: Electrical converter and method for operating an electrical converter
abstract_en: A DC-DC converter topology based on electromagnetically coupled class-D LC oscillator is proposed. An electrical converter comprises at least two oscillators (1,2), each of the at least two oscillators being designed to have an oscillating current and an oscillating voltage. Coupling elements (16, 17, 18, 19) arranged to couple the oscillating currents of the at least two oscillators and/or the oscillating voltages of the at least two oscillators. The at least two oscillators are connected in a series connection, adding their oscillating voltages, and/or in a parallel connection, adding their oscillating currents. The topology can be fully integrated, that is, it can be realized as an integrated circuit without external components, in particular without external passive components, such as capacitors and/or inductors.

title_en: Topologies for interconnecting capacitive and inductive elements in a capacitively-coupled rib
abstract_en: Topologies (110) for interconnecting capacitive and inductive elements in a capacitively-coupled rib are described. An example relates to a resonant clock network, RCN, that resonates in response to both a first clock signal (CLK+) having a first phase and a second clock signal (CLK-) having a second phase. The RCN includes at least one rib coupled to at least one spine. The rib includes a first capacitive line (120) configured to receive the first clock signal and provide, via a first capacitor, a first bias current to a first superconducting circuit. The rib further includes a second capacitive line (130) configured to receive the second clock signal and provide, via a second capacitor, a second bias current to a second superconducting circuit. The rib further includes at least one inductive line (140) configured to connect the first capacitive line (120) with the second capacitive line (130) forming a direct connection between the two capacitive lines.

title_en: Microelectromechanical button device and corresponding waterproof user interface element
abstract_en: A microelectromechanical button device (5) is provided with a detection structure (14) having: a substrate (22) of semiconductor material with a front surface (22a) and a rear surface (22b); a buried electrode (28) arranged on the substrate; a mobile electrode (32), arranged in a structural layer (30) overlying the substrate and elastically suspended above the buried electrode at a separation distance so as to form a detection capacitor (Cd); and a cap (46) coupled over the structural layer and having a first main surface (46a) facing the structural layer and a second main surface (46b) that is designed to be mechanically coupled to a deformable portion (3) of a case (2) of an electronic apparatus (1) of a portable or wearable type. The cap has, on its first main surface, an actuation portion (48) arranged over the mobile electrode and configured to cause, in the presence of a pressure applied on the second main surface, a deflection of the mobile electrode and its approach to the buried electrode, with a consequent capacitive variation of the detection capacitor, which is indicative of an actuation of the microelectromechanical button device.

title_en: Power supply circuit, related actuator and method of supplying a load
abstract_en: A power supply circuit for supplying a load, which may be a SMA component or a piezoelectric component, may use short high-voltage pulses to achieve fast heating of the load and, in order to comply with functional requirements, the SMA or piezoelectric component should not be supplied by connecting it directly to an electric line at a relatively high voltage. It is also disclosed an actuator comprising a power supply circuit of this disclosure and at least one load, comprising at least one smart materials chosen between a piezoelectric device and a a shape memory alloy (SMA) component, and a method of supplying a load comprising the steps of: connecting the AC to DC voltage converter of the power supply circuit to the AC mains by closing the input switch for charging a tank capacitor of the converter and, at the same time, opening the output switch for disconnecting the load from the tank capacitor; disconnecting the AC to DC voltage converter of the power supply circuit from the AC mains by opening the input switch and, at the same time, closing the output switch to supply the load by discharging the tank capacitor.

title_en: Epitaxial growth of aluminum on aluminum-nitride compounds
abstract_en: Apparatus and associated methods relate to forming an epitaxial layer of aluminum (14') on an aluminum-nitride compound (12'). The aluminum is epitaxially grown on the crystalline aluminum- nitride compound by maintaining temperature of a crystalline aluminum-nitride compound below a cluster-favoring temperature threshold within a vacuum chamber. Then, the crystalline aluminum- nitride compound is exposed to atoms of elemental aluminum for a predetermined time duration. The aluminum is epitaxially grown in this fashion for a predetermined time duration so as to produce a layer of epitaxial aluminum of a predetermined thickness. Such epitaxially-grown mono-crystalline aluminum has a lower resistivity than poly-crystalline aluminum. The resulting structure is used for a BAW resonator (10') wherein the epitaxial aluminum layer (14') serves as top electrode and the crystalline aluminum-nitride compound (12 ') as piezoelectric layer. The bottom aluminum electrode (16') may be polycrystalline.

title_en: Radio-frequency circuitry with shapable differential coupled lines for low-loss impedance matching
abstract_en: An electronic device may include wireless circuitry having one or more radio-frequency amplifiers (60) coupled to differential coupled lines (70). The differential coupled lines (70) may provide routing and impedance matching for the radio-frequency amplifiers (60) with minimal power loss. The differential coupled lines (70) may include a first pair of coupled lines (72-1a, 72-1b) and a second pair of coupled lines (72-2a, 72-2b). The first pair of coupled lines (72-1a, 72-1b) may include a first conductive routing path coupled to a first voltage line and a second conductive routing path routed along the first conductive routing path and coupled to a second voltage line. The second pair of coupled lines (72-2a, 72-2b) may include a third conductive routing path coupled to the first voltage line and a fourth conductive routing path routed along the third conductive routing path and coupled to the second voltage line.

title_en: Ion movement control system with low pass filter in analog switch
abstract_en: An ion trap system with low pass filter switch, including a digital to analog converter (DAC) connected to a first port and enabled to provide a DAC voltage, an electrode element connected to a second port, the electrode element configured to provide an electrical field for controlling a position of an ion, and a filter switch between the first port and the second port and having a filter leg and a bypass leg in parallel, the filter leg having a filter leg switch and a filter portion between the first port and the second port and selectively coupling the first port through the filter leg to the second port to slow a voltage transient of the DAC voltage to the electrode element, and where the bypass leg has a bypass leg switch that selectively couples the first port directly to the second port.

title_en: Method and device to control audio playback devices
abstract_en: Systems, methods, apparatus, and articles of manufacture to control audio playback devices are disclosed. An example method includes receiving (1302) first audio information from a first audio information source; generating (1304) audio signals based on the received first audio information from the first audio information source; receiving (1306) a source command from a user input device to change to a second audio information source; and in response to the source command: changing (1308) a signal source to the second audio information source and sending (1310) a volume message to the first audio information source to change a volume setting of the first audio information source.

title_en: Prescaler for a frequency divider
abstract_en: A hybrid true single-phase clock (H-TSPC) circuit includes a first logic circuit comprising non-ratio (NR) logic, a first mode switching device coupled to an output of the first logic circuit, a second logic circuit comprising ratio (R) logic, the second logic circuit configured to receive an output of the first logic circuit, a second mode switching device coupled to an output of the second logic circuit, a third logic circuit comprising non-ratio (NR) logic, the third logic circuit configured to receive an output of the second logic circuit, and a third mode switching device coupled to an output of the third logic circuit, wherein the first logic circuit, second logic circuit, and third logic circuit are configured in a ring.

title_en: A circuit and device including a transistor and diode
abstract_en: A circuit comprising: a transistor, a base of the transistor being switchably connectable to a signal source; a first diode connected between the base of the transistor, and a reference voltage; wherein the circuit arranged such that when the signal source is not connected to the base of the transistor, a voltage applied at an emitter of the transistor causes a current flow through the base of the transistor and through the first diode such that the transistor is in an ON state; the impedance of the signal source is lower than the impedance of the transistor through the emitter and base; the first diode is selected to provide a current limiting function such that when the signal source is connected to the base of the transistor, current flow through the base reduces such that the transistor switches to an OFF state; and in which the circuit comprises a second diode, the second diode comprised from a semiconductor region that provides the base of the transistor and a further semiconductor region in direct contact with the semiconductor region that provides the base of the transistor; and in which the signal source is connectable to the base of the transistor through the second diode.

title_en: Methods and apparatus for encoding and decoding of data using concatenated polarization adjusted convolutional codes
abstract_en: An encoder 102 receives a concatenated encoder input block    d   , splits    d    into an outer code input array    a ,  and encodes    a    using outer codes to generate an outer code output array    b .  The encoder generates, from    b ,  a concatenated code output array    x    using a layered polarization adjusted convolutional (LPAC) code. A decoder 106 counts layers and carries out an inner decoding operation for a layered polarization adjusted convolutional (LPAC) code to generate an inner decoder decision    b̃       i    from a concatenated decoder input array    y    and a cumulative decision feedback (   b̂     1 ,   b̂     2 , ··· ,    b̂       i -1 ). The decoder carries out an outer decoding operation to generate from    b̃       i    an outer decoder decision    â       i   , and carries out a reencoding operation to generate a decision feedback    b̂       i    from    â       i   , where the number of layers is an integer greater than one, with a concatenated decoder output block    d̂    being generated from outer decoder decisions.

title_en: Thermal droop compensation in power amplifiers
abstract_en: Systems and methods for thermal droop compensation in power amplifiers are disclosed. In one aspect, a droop compensation circuit is added to a temperature-sensitive active bias circuit in a power amplifier chain. The droop compensation circuit relies on current mirroring to draw a trigger current that may be used by a correction circuit to create an additional bias signal that offsets temperature-induced droop in the power amplifier. Variations contemplate where the bias signal is injected within the power amplifier chain and what form the correction circuit may take (e.g., an attenuator, a variable gain amplifier (VGA), or the like). By compensating for temperature droop in this fashion, rapid pulsing signals that generate rapid pulses of heat may be transmitted across an effectively linear power amplifier chain without having to deal with droop effects.

title_en: Wide voltage gate driver using low gate oxide transistors
abstract_en: A gate driver circuit includes first through third transistors (M1, M3, M4), a first voltage clamp (206), and control logic (210). The first transistor (M1) has a first control input and first and second current terminals. The first current terminal couples to a first voltage terminal. The first voltage clamp (206) couples between the first voltage terminal and the first control input. The second transistor (M3) couples between the first control input and the second voltage terminal. The third transistor (M4) couples between the first control input and the second voltage terminal. The third transistor (M4) is smaller than the second transistor (M3). The control logic (210) is configured to turn on both the second and third transistors (M3 and M4) to thereby turn on the first transistor (M1), and the first control logic (210) is configured to turn off the second transistor (M3) after the first transistor (M1) turns on while maintaining in an on-state the third transistor (M4) to maintain the first transistor (Ml) in the on-state.

title_en: Systems and methods for real-time energy and dose monitoring of an x-ray linear accelerator
abstract_en: A linear accelerator in data communication with a computing device and a programmable logic controller and including a magnetron, an electron gun that is configured to direct an accelerated beam of electrons at a target thereby generating a beam of X-rays, a primary collimator positioned beyond the target in a direction of the beam of X-rays, a secondary collimator coupled to an end of the primary collimator at which the beam of X-rays exit the primary collimator, an attenuating element and a calorimeter positioned within the primary collimator, and a reference detector positioned within the secondary collimator and configured to measure an X-ray radiation dose output of the linear accelerator on a pulse-by-pulse basis.

title_en: High-performance audio amplifier
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-performance audio amplifier (102) intended to control at least one loudspeaker (R44), the amplifier comprising a pre-amplification stage (301) that receives an input signal (S1), a power amplification stage (302) connected to the pre-amplification stage (301) and a negative feedback loop that delivers, to the pre-amplification stage (301), an image of the output signal (3), the power amplification stage (302) comprising two supply circuits (155a, 155b) comprising a MOSFET (M1, M2). The invention is characterized in that it comprises: a sub-circuit for assisting with charging, a sub-circuit for assisting with discharging said MOSFET (M1, M2), and a voltage-shifting sub-circuit.

title_en: Film structure and electronic device
abstract_en: A film structure (10) includes a Si layer (12a), a ZrO 2  layer (12b) which is a buffer film containing ZrO 2  and formed on the Si layer (12a), and a piezoelectric film (11) formed on the ZrO 2  layer (12b). The Si layer (12a) is an SOI layer in a Si substrate or an SOI substrate including a base made from a Si substrate, an insulating layer on the base, and an SOI layer made from a Si film on the insulating layer. A polarization direction of the piezoelectric film (11) is preferentially oriented perpendicularly to the substrate.

title_en: Audio amplification method and device
abstract_en: A method, comprising: receiving a digital input audio signal (D); applying signal processing (21, 22, 24, 26) to the digital input audio signal (D) received; providing an analog audio output signal (V OUT ) based on the digital input audio signal (D) via a switching converter circuit (17) driven by a pulse-width-modulated, PWM, signal (DRV), and sensing (19, R FB ) the analog audio output signal (V OUT ) and providing an analog feedback signal (I FB ) indicative of the sensed analog audio output signal (V OUT ). Applying signal processing (21, 22, 24, 26) to the digital input audio signal (D) comprises: producing (21) a digital error signal (D ERR ) indicative of a difference between the digital input audio signal (D) and a digital word signal (W); applying digital-to-analog conversion, DAC (22) to the digital error signal (D ERR ), producing an analog replica of the digital error signal (I ERR ) as a result; producing (24) an analog difference signal (I DIFF ) indicative of a difference between the analog replica of the digital error signal (I ERR ) and the analog feedback signal (I FB ); applying analog-to-digital conversion (26) to the analog difference signal (I DIFF ), producing said digital word signal (W) as a result; applying digital filtering (162; 562) to the digital word signal (W), producing a filtered digital word signal (D C ) as a result; and driving said switching converter circuit (17) with the PWM signal (DRV) produced based on the filtered digital word signal (Dc) .

title_en: Electronic device for shifting a voltage level
