abstract_en: Electronic device for shifting a voltage level; the device comprising: a feedforward component configured for one-shot shifting a first voltage level of a first domain to a third voltage level of a third domain, wherein the third voltage level is different from the first voltage level, via at least one second voltage level of at least one second domain, wherein the at least one second voltage level is different from the first voltage level and from the third voltage level; and a feedback component configured for feeding back the third voltage level from the third domain to the at least one second domain.

title_en: Method for predistorting an input signal with a view to compensating for the effect of a non-linear transfer function of a power amplifier, corresponding computer program products and corresponding devices
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predistorting an input signal with a view to compensating for the effect, on a radiofrequency signal generated from the input signal, of a non-linear transfer function of a power amplifier configured to amplify the radiofrequency signal. Such a method comprises: - carrying out a Walsh transform (E300) on a series of M terms dependent on temporal samples of the input signal, delivering M sequential components of a corresponding transformed series; - computing (E310) a sum of a plurality of operands resulting from the product of a datum dependent on at least one element of a transformed series and a corresponding predistortion coefficient, delivering a corresponding sequential component of a predistorted transformed input signal, the sum having a structure of a Volterra series transposed into the Walsh domain; and - carrying out an inverse Walsh transform (E320) on the sequential components of the predistorted transformed input signal, delivering an output signal for the generation of the radiofrequency signal.

title_en: Apparatus and method for controlling a resonator
abstract_en: A method and apparatus for modifying or controlling a resonator connected to a signal loop having an input (18828), an output (18822), and a closed loop frequency response. The signal loop has a primary resonator (18810) having a primary frequency response. There is at least one adjustable resonator (18812) having an adjustable frequency (f) and a secondary Q-factor. An adjustable scaling block (18824) applies a gain factor (g). A controller is connected to the at least one adjustable resonator (18812) and the adjustable scaling block (18824). The controller has instructions to adjust the closed loop frequency response toward a desired closed loop frequency response by controlling the adjustable frequency (f) of the at least one adjustable resonator (18812) and the gain factor (g) of the adjustable scaling block (18824).

title_en: Electronic apparatus and data storage method capable of reducing the number of storage portions connectable to logic circuit
abstract_en: An electronic apparatus (100) includes a logic circuit (63), a plurality of first storage portions (64A), a switching portion (65), and a storage processing portion (51B). The internal configuration of the logic circuit (63) is reconfigurable based on configuration data corresponding to one or more functions. The plurality of first storage portions (64A) separately store the configuration data. The switching portion (65) switches the first storage portion (64A) connected to the logic circuit (63). The storage processing portion (51B) stores, in a first storage portion (64A) not connected to the logic circuit (63) among the first storage portions (64A), the configuration data acquired from a second storage portion (54), instead of the configuration data stored in the first storage portion (64A).

title_en: System and method for integrated filtering and amplification
abstract_en: An integrated circuit coupled resonator filter including a low-noise amplifier (2208), first parallel resonator including a first capacitance (C1) connected in parallel with a first inductance (L1), a second parallel resonator including a second capacitance (C2) connected in parallel with a second inductance (L2) and a third parallel resonator including a third capacitance (C3) connected in parallel with a third inductance (L3). Magnetic coupling between the first inductance (L1) and the second inductance (L2), between the second inductance (L2) and the third inductance (L3), and between the first inductance (L1) the third inductance (L3) occurs in accordance with first (k12), second (k23) and third (k13) coupling factors, respectively. A frequency response of the coupled resonator filter includes a notch when values of the first coupling factor, the second coupling factor and the third coupling factor satisfy predetermined conditions, such that signals across the direct path, via k12,k23 and across the cross-coupled path, via k13, cancel.

title_en: Energy refeeding module, switching circuit and embodiment, plasma processing system, and a method of producing rectangular voltage output pulses for a plasma processing load
abstract_en: Energy refeeding module (15) for a switching circuit (101) with a switching unit (24) configured to be connectable to a DC voltage source (V1) and to deliver at its output (OUT) one or a combination of the following features: iv) high value of voltage, v) high value of voltage rise with a reduced oscillation and/or overshoot, vi) high current value to a capacitive load, in particular to a plasma processing load (12), the energy refeeding module (15) comprising: c. a rectifying circuit (14) configured to be connected with its positive end of its DC-side to the positive connection of the DC voltage source (V1), with its negative end of its DC-side to the negative connection of the DC voltage source, and d. a transformer (TF1) comprising: i. a primary winding (18) configured to be connected in series between the switching unit (24) and the output (OUT), and configured to have both, a stray inductance and parasitic resistance low enough to lead the one or a combination of the following features: - high value of voltage, - high value of voltage rise, - high current value and ii. a secondary winding (19) connected to the AC-side of the rectifying circuit (14).

title_en: Systems and methods for adaptive driver for inverter for electric vehicle
abstract_en: A system includes: an inverter configured to convert DC power from a battery to AC power to drive a motor, wherein the inverter includes: a power switch including a drain terminal, a source terminal, and a gate terminal; and one or more controllers configured to: receive one or more signals related to an operation of the power switch, update one or more state definitions based on the received one or more signals, and control a gate control signal to the gate terminal based on the updated one or more state definitions.

title_en: Gate drive charge pump circuit for dynamic bias control
abstract_en: In an example, a system (400) includes a charge pump (142A). The system (400) includes a transistor (108A) coupled to a power terminal (134), the transistor (108A) gate coupled to a charge pump (142A) output. The system (400) includes current sense circuitry having a power input, a load input and a sense output (410), where the power input is coupled to the power terminal (134), the current sense circuitry is configured to provide a sense signal at the sense output (410), and the sense signal represents a polarity and a magnitude of a current at the load input. The system (400) includes a controller (148) having a sense input (412) coupled to the sense output (410) and a control output (414) coupled to the control input, where the controller (148) is configured to provide a control signal at the control output (414) responsive to the sense signal, and the charge pump (142A) is configured to adjust a voltage at the charge pump (142 A) output responsive to the control signal.

title_en: Die-to-die and chip-to-chip connectivity monitoring
abstract_en: An input/output (I/O) sensor is provided for a multi-IC (Integrated Circuit) module. The I/O sensor includes: a signal input, configured to receive a data signal from an interconnected part of an IC of the multi-IC module; and a time duration measurement circuit, configured to measure a time duration between a first time, at which the data signal is at a first level, and a second time, at which the data signal is at a second level, different from the first level. The sensor may be incorporated into an I/O block, an IC, and/or a multi-IC module. An I/O sensor which includes a controller configured to measure duty cycle distortion of a multi-phase clock is also disclosed.

title_en: Data compression method and apparatus
abstract_en: This application discloses a data compression method and apparatus, and relates to the field of data processing technologies. The method includes: obtaining a first trace log generated in a running process of a first process, where each log record in the first trace log includes a function call record of calling a communication function by the first process; and constructing a first dictionary and a first grammar set based on the function call record in the first trace log, to compress the function call record in the first trace log, where for a first function call record included in any log record in the first trace log, a first symbol string in the first dictionary indicates the first function call record, and a first grammar tree in the first grammar set indicates a function call relationship in the first function call record. According to the method, a compression rate of compressing the trace log can be improved, and compression duration can be shortened.

title_en: Quantum-based device including gas cell
abstract_en: In one example, an apparatus includes a substrate, an antenna (1220,1222) on the substrate, a sealed container (610A, 61 OB) enclosing a dipolar gas, a waveguide (650A, 650B), and a stub (750A, 750B). The waveguide (650A, 650B) is communicatively coupled between the antenna (1220,1222) and the sealed container (610A, 610B). The waveguide (650A, 650B) is separated from the substrate by a gap. The stub (750A, 750B) is adjacent to the waveguide (650A, 650B) and extends away from the gap.

title_en: Sound volume control device
abstract_en: The volume control device is included in a sound generation system (8), which controls a sound generator (80) to generate a sound based on sound data (Dsd). The volume control device controls a volume (Vp) of the sound data. The volume control device includes a target volume storage unit (181) that sequentially stores and accumulates target volumes (d) that are repeatedly set at a predetermined period (T1). The volume control device also includes a volume determination unit (183) that sequentially determines, as the volume of the sound data, a moving average of the target volumes accumulated in the target volume storage unit during a predetermined average target period (Tav).

title_en: Projected dielectric sensor for matter detection, proximity detection, and gesture control
abstract_en: Systems and methods for a projected dielectric sensor comprising a first conductive path with a first conductive mesh, a second conductive path with a second conductive mesh, and a dielectric gap between them. The dielectric gap functions as an open circuit in a resting state, offering a broader detection range compared to traditional sensors. The sensor includes a power drive connected to the first conductive path and a collector connected to the second conductive path. The first and second conductive meshes include sheets that are positioned longitudinally side-by- side, enhancing sensitivity and simplifying manufacturing. In an example, the sheets are separated by at least 10 cm of dielectric material. The sensor can detect off-axis objects such as conductors, vehicles, humans, and baby seats, making it suitable for various applications including vehicle safety, biometric systems, gesture and mid-air control, and machine learning integration.

title_en: Reconfigurable, high stability gate-tunneling physical unclonable function with differential pulse-width modulation analog front-end interface
abstract_en: There is provided a circuit for a physical unclonable function comprising: first and second outputs; a cell comprising a plurality of CMOS devices; and a plurality of switching devices, the plurality of switching devices operable to connect a gate terminal of each of the plurality of CMOS devices to one of the first and second outputs, wherein a quantity of the plurality CMOS devices is a multiple of two, and wherein the circuit is configured such that each of the first and second output is connected to an equal quantity of the plurality of CMOS devices.

title_en: Dynamic element matching for multi-bit digital-to-analog converter in continuous-time delta sigma modulators
abstract_en: A continuous-time delta-sigma modulator (CTDSM) system includes a quantizer, an update block, a switching block, a summation block, and a feedback path. The quantizer is configured to quantize an analog input signal into one or more thermometer-coded digital signals. The update block is configured to generate control signals based on the thermometer-coded digital signals. The switching block is configured to route the thermometer-coded digital signals to a plurality of digital-to-analog converter (DAC) elements based on the control signals. The plurality of DAC elements is configured to convert the thermometer-coded digital signals into analog outputs. The summation block is configured to combine the analog outputs from the plurality of DAC elements to produce a final analog output. The feedback path is configured to use the final analog output as a feedback signal for the CTDSM system.

title_en: Hybrid successive approximation register analog-to-digital converter
abstract_en: In an example, an analog-to-digital converter (ADC) includes a comparator having a first input, a second input, and an output, the comparator configured to compare the first input and the second input to generate the output; a first digital-to-analog converter (DAC) coupled to the first input of the comparator, the first DAC including a first plurality of unsplit capacitors and at least one first split capacitor; a second DAC coupled to the second input of the comparator, the second DAC including a second plurality of unsplit capacitors and at least one second split capacitor; first switches coupled to the first DAC; second switches coupled to the second DAC; and a first circuit configured to, in response to the output of the comparator, generate control signals for the first and second switches.

title_en: Super-lattice castellated field effect transistor (slcfet) switch system
abstract_en: One example includes a super-lattice castellated field effect transistor (SLCFET) system. The system includes a plurality of SLCFETs arranged in a series stack between a first port and a second port to provide a propagation path of a radio frequency (RF) signal between the first port and the second port in response to activation of the SLCFETs. The system also includes a plurality of gate resistors interconnecting gate terminals associated with each of the respective SLCFETs and an activation port to which an activation signal is provided to concurrently activate the SLCFETs. The system further includes a plurality of balancing resistors coupled to the gate terminals associated with each of the respective SLCFETs, the balancing resistors being configured to approximately equalize a drain-gate voltage and a gate-source voltage associated with each of the SLCFETs when activated.

title_en: Power switch with normally on transistor
abstract_en: A power switch comprising: a cascode having a normally ON transistor connected in series with a normally OFF transistor at a cascode node; a safety switch between a gate of the normally ON transistor and a first ground common to the cascode and the switch; and a controller comprising: a controller power supply having a power supply output connected to the cascode node at which output the controller power supply provides a voltage relative to a second ground that is floating relative to the first ground; a first controller output connected to the gate of the normally ON transistor at which the controller generates a first voltage relative to the second ground; wherein the controller power supply is connected to the safety switch and voltage provided by the controller power supply is coupled to and operates to maintain the safety switch OFF and nonconducting and in the absence of the voltage the safety switch is turned ON and conducting.

title_en: Reference clock generation using machine learning compensation
abstract_en: Embodiments herein relate to a system which predicts the frequency or phase offset of a primary clock signal relative to a stable reference such as an atomic clock based on the frequency or phase offsets, respectively, of secondary clock signals relative to the frequency or phase, respectively, of the primary clock signal. The system can include a neural network which is trained to learn a correspondence between the offset of the primary clock signal relative to the stable reference and the offsets of the secondary clock signals relative to the primary clock signal. The training can include varying environmental conditions such as temperature, vibration, pressure, humidity or magnetic field. Once trained, the neural network can be used to provide a stable output clock signal based on the primary clock signal and its predicted offset.

title_en: Devices and methods related to radio-frequency filters on silicon-on-insulator substrate
abstract_en: A radio-frequency (RF) module comprises a wafer level chip scale package (WLCSP) mounted on a packaging substrate 172. The WLCSP has a silicon die 104 that includes a RF circuit 160 implemented at or near a first side of the die, mounting features 168 on the second side of the die, and a plurality of vias 108 connecting the first and second sides of the die. The WLCSP also has at least one RF flip chip 102 including a filter circuit mounted on the first side of the silicon die, in communication with the RF circuit. The lateral area of the WLCSP is less than 20% of the lateral area of a package where a similar silicon die and a similar number of RF flip chips are mounted next to each other on a packaging substrate. The RF module can be included in a wireless device to route a radio signal received by an antenna to a receiver.

title_en: Amplifier having input power protection
abstract_en: Amplifier having input power protection. In some embodiments, an amplifier circuit can include an input node and an output node, and an amplifier implemented between the input node and the output node. The amplifier circuit can further include a bias circuit configured to provide a bias signal to the amplifier. The amplifier circuit can further include a protection circuit configured to generate a detected voltage representative of a peak of a radio-frequency signal present at the input node. The protection circuit can be further configured to enable a protection mode when the detected voltage is greater than a first threshold value and to disable the protection mode when the detected voltage is less than a second threshold value that is less than the first threshold value.

title_en: Controlling slew rate
abstract_en: An audio signal processing circuit that predicts 104, based on the input signal, a required slew-rate SR for a first component 102 in a forward signal path and, via a controller 103, varies a slew-rate limit of the first component. The predictor may determine an amplitude of the input signal (201, Fig.2), possibly through an envelope detector that operates with an attack time constant which is faster than a release time constant thereby providing hysteresis. The predictor may predict a derivative of the amplitude (203, Fig.2) and predict the required slew-rate based on the amplitude and its derivative. The predictor may determine a spectral tilt of the input signal (401, Fig.4) and predict the slew-rate based thereon. The predictor may comprise a learned model (501, Fig.5). The predictor may predict the required slew-rate at a future point to account for delay in implementing the slew rate. The controller may vary slew-rate limit of the first component by: altering a bias current (Ib,Fig.7) supplied a transconductance amplifier (701, Fig.7) of the first component; controlling the number of enabled transconductance amplifiers (701, Fig.8) of the first component; and/or controlling connection of the a capacitor (703b, Fig.9) across an amplifier output stage (702, Fig.9). The first component may be a digital-to-analogue converter or amplifier. The controller may vary the slew rate limit of said second component 101 in the forward signal path.

title_en: Parallel hybrid acoustic passive filter
abstract_en: A multiplexer 170 with a hybrid acoustic passive filter comprises a plurality of filters 132, 134 configured to filter respective radio frequency signals HB2, HB1. Each of the plurality of filters has a different passband, and at least a first filter of the plurality of filters includes acoustic resonators and a non-acoustic passive component. The multiplexer also includes a shared filter 162 coupled between each of the plurality of filters and a common node, and a radio frequency filter 156 coupled to the common node. The first filter may include first and second shunt acoustic resonators and the non-acoustic passive component of the first filter may include a series-path LC tank coupled between the first and second resonators (Fig.12). A wireless communication device (Fig.29) including an antenna and the multiplexer is also provided. The shared filter may be a high-pass or harmonic notch filter; it may include an LC component and may further include acoustic resonators. The multiplexer may be used in communications devices which require strong intermodulation distortion rejection.

title_en: Operational amplifier
abstract_en: To provide an operational amplifier in which the effect of high-frequency exogeneous noise entering into from an output terminal or a power supply terminal is effectively reduced.SOLUTION: An operational amplifier comprises: a first low-pass filter which is comprised of a resistor R9 and a capacitor C6, the resistor R9 being connected to between a current source I2 and a collector of a transistor Q3, the capacitor C6 being connected to between the collector of the transistor Q3 and the ground; and a second lowpass filter which is comprised of a resistor R10 and a capacitor C7, the resistor R10 being connected to between a current source I3 and a collector of a transistor Q4, the capacitor C7 being connected to between the collector of the transistor Q4 and the ground.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Integrated circuit, test method therefor, and electronic apparatus
abstract_en: To provide an integrated circuit, a test method, and an electronic apparatus, enabling a circuit operation test even when the integrated circuit comprises a memory that is writable only once.SOLUTION: An integrated circuit comprises a logical circuit 120, and a switch circuit 130 enabling switching of wiring to be connected to the logical circuit. The logical circuit comprises: a first memory 122; a lookup table circuit 124 that on outputs data stored in the first memory the basis of an input signal; a first selection circuit 126 that comprises a first input terminal and a second input terminal and, selects either of the first input terminal and the second input terminal on the basis of a scan enable signal, and connects the selected terminal to a second output terminal; a flip-flop 127 comprising a third input terminal and a third output terminal; and a second selection circuit 128 that comprises a fourth input terminal and a fifth input terminal, and is connected to a fourth output terminal on the basis of an enable signal. The switch circuit performs switching of wiring connection according to signals from the third output terminal and the fourth output terminal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Memory system
abstract_en: To realize a memory system which can improve reliability of data.SOLUTION: A memory system according to the present invention controls a shift register type memory to write encoded data including a plurality of error correction code frames in a block of the shift register type memory. The memory system stores first data included in a first error correction code frame at a position corresponding to a first layer in a first data holding shift sequence, stores second data included in a second error correction code frame at a position corresponding to a second layer in the first data holding shift sequence, and stores a third data included in the first error correction code frame at a position corresponding to the second layer in a second data holding shift sequence.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 10

title_en: Multiplexer, wireless communication device, filter assembly, and signal processing method
abstract_en: To provide a multiplexer that reduces load loss.SOLUTION: A multiplexer 20" such as a duplexer, a quadplexer, and a hexaplexer includes a plurality of elastic wave filters coupled to one common node COM. One first elastic wave filter includes first types of a plurality of elastic wave resonances, and a single second type of series elastic wave resonator coupled between the first type of the plurality of elastic wave resonators and the common node. The first type (type A resonator) of the plurality of elastic wave resonances are a plurality of elastic surface wave resonators, and the single second type (type B resonator) of the series elastic wave resonator is one bulk elastic wave resonator.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2C

title_en: Data compression device and data compression method
abstract_en: To provide a data compression device that can efficiently compress time-series data without causing missing data.SOLUTION: The data compression device is configured with a time data compression unit 1, a statistical data compression unit 2, and a data storage unit 3. The time data compression unit 1 compresses time data using a first compression method and outputs it as first compressed data. The statistical data compression unit 2 compresses statistical data, which is data acquired in association with time data, using a second compression method different from the first compression method, and outputs it as second compressed data. The data storage unit 3 associates the first compressed data with the second compressed data and outputs it to a database.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Active balun circuit, power amplifier circuit, and power amplifier module
abstract_en: To suppress the increase in area of a semiconductor chip.SOLUTION: An active balun circuit 10 includes transistors Q1 and Q2 whose emitters are electrically connected to each other and which output differential signals, and a circuit element 30 connected between a reference potential and a connection point between the emitter of the transistor Q1 and the emitter of the transistor Q2. In the circuit element 30, the impedance at a particular frequency of an input signal seems sufficiently higher than the impedance at another frequency. To a base of the transistor Q1, the input signal of an input terminal Pin is applied. To a base of the transistor Q2, the reference potential is applied. To a collector of the transistor Q1 and a collector of the transistor Q2, power source voltage Vcc is applied. The signal of the collector of the transistor Q1 and the signal of the collector of the transistor Q2 are output as the differential signals.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Crystal oscillator
abstract_en: To provide a crystal oscillator capable of simplifying the manufacturing process to reduce the manufacturing cost, and reducing the manufacturing variation of products.SOLUTION: A ultra-low noise crystal oscillator uses two crystal oscillators of an oscillator 4 in an oscillation circuit section and a crystal filter 5 in a filter section on a subsequent stage, uses, as the oscillation circuit section, a butler circuit for connecting in-series-connected capacitors (C1, c2) 11 and 12 and an inductor (L) 21 in parallel, simplifying the manufacturing process to improve the manufacturing quality, and making floor noise characteristics excellent.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Semiconductor device
abstract_en: To provide a semiconductor device that does not require an additional external inductor, and enables multiband impedance matching without an increase of the are of a reception circuit module.SOLUTION: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a semiconductor device has a selector 16 that selects one of a plurality of input terminals 16a to connect the same to a connection terminal 18a to which one end of an inductor 14 is connected, a low-noise amplifier 17 whose input is connected to a connection terminal 18b to which the other end of the inductor 14 is connected, and a matching circuit 18. The matching circuit 18 is a circuit connected in parallel between the connection terminal 18a and the connection terminal 18b, and includes a switch SW1, a switch SW2, and a capacitor C. One end of the capacitor C is connected to the connection terminal 18a via the switch SW1, the other end of the capacitor C is connected to the connection terminal 18b via the switch SW2, and thereby the capacitor C can construct a parallel resonant circuit with the inductor 14.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Waveform-based data integrity check and error correction
abstract_en: To obtain efficient data integrity check, EC, or ED for ZT, UW, and CP-based waveforms that increase reliability, provide flexibility, maintain high coding rates, and are adaptable to different device types.SOLUTION: A radio transmit/receive unit (WTRU) may receive a unique word-error check (UW-EC) coded signal. The pre-decoder data check entity can check for errors on the basis of the EC bits and systematic and parity bits from the UW-EC coded signal. When no errors are detected by the pre-decoder data check entity, error-free data can be signaled to a source decoder without channel decoding.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Instantaneous interruption reset pulse generating circuit suitable for level shift circuit of instantaneous interruption compensation
abstract_en: To provide an instantaneous interruption reset pulse generating circuit suitable for high-side driver circuit without delay even when a power supply voltage VCC has instantaneous interruption.SOLUTION: An instantaneous interruption reset pulse generating circuit, which is a pulse generating circuit connected with a level shift circuit, includes a reset pulse generating circuit for outputting a reset pulse and a set pulse generating circuit for outputting a set pulse, and further includes a first power supply (VCC) and a second power supply (PreREG) for supplying a lower voltage than the first power supply voltage to the pulse generating circuit as a power supply voltage through the first power supply (VCC), a difference detector (VCC-PreREG DET) for detecting that a voltage difference between the first power supply voltage and the second power supply (PreREG) voltage is equal to or lower than a predetermined threshold value to output a voltage drop signal and an instantaneous interruption reset pulse generating circuit which receives the voltage drop signal, generates an instantaneous interruption reset pulse and transmits it to a level shift circuit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Circuit arrangement and real-time clock device
abstract_en: To provide a circuit arrangement that prevents a reduction in reliability of temperature compensation, while quickly switching power supply voltage.SOLUTION: A circuit arrangement 100 includes an oscillation circuit 150, a temperature sensor 162, an A/D conversion circuit 164, a processing circuit 120, and a power supply circuit 110. The oscillation circuit 150 has a variable capacitance circuit 156, and with the setting of the capacity of the variable capacitance circuit 156 with a capacity setting value CP, an oscillatory frequency is adjusted. When a first power supply voltage switching operation is performed which is to switch a power supply voltage from a first power supply voltage VDD to a second power supply voltage VBAT in an A/D conversion period of the A/D conversion circuit 164, the processing circuit 120 stops the update of the capacity setting value CP to be output to the variable capacitance circuit 156.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8

title_en: Noise suppression member
abstract_en: To provide a noise suppression member capable of suppressing common-mode noises with a simple configuration.SOLUTION: In a motor drive device 10, a noise suppression member 20 suppresses noises of an inverter circuit 40. The inverter circuit 40 is connected to a power supply 80 outside of a conductive housing 100. The noise suppression member 20 includes: a noise source side inductor 24 that is constituted of a conductive member wound and is connected to a grounded terminal 62 that is connected to the negative electrode (-) of the power supply 80 of the inverter circuit 40; and a terminal T1 that connects a terminal at the negative electrode (-) of the noise source side inductor 24 and the housing 100.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Voice data generation device
abstract_en: To embed identification information for preventing illegal distribution into voice data constituting a content as a watermark without preventing recognition of the content.SOLUTION: A voice data generation device 10 includes: an encoding part 13 for generating an encoded bit sequence obtained by encoding a prescribed information bit sequence as a cyclic code, in which the encoded bit sequence can uniquely identify an identification target and a bit sequence which is cyclically shifted from the encoded bit sequence identifies the same identification target; a diffusion part 14 for diffusing a repetitive bit sequence in which the encoded bit sequence is repeatedly arranged n times (n is an integer of 1 or more) by a prescribed diffusion code and generating the diffused encoded bit sequence; a modulation part 15 for generating a modulation signal by phase-modulating a prescribed carrier by the diffused encoded bit sequence; and a superposition part 16 for superposing the modulation signal with intensity adjusted in accordance with intensity of a signal of voice data on voice data.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Clock oscillator and manufacturing method of clock oscillator
abstract_en: To provide a clock oscillator that generates a plurality of output frequencies, a manufacturing method of the clock oscillators, and a usage method of the clock oscillator.SOLUTION: A clock oscillator includes a first resonator, a second resonator, and a frequency synthesis module. The output frequency of the first resonator is higher than the output frequency of the second resonator. The frequency synthesis module generates a synthesis frequency on the basis of the output frequency of the first resonator and the output frequency of the second resonator. The synthesis frequency is used as a clock frequency output by the clock oscillator. The clock oscillator uses both resonators with different output frequencies as clock signal sources and produces a synthesized clock signal by using the frequency synthesis module.EFFECT: One clock oscillator is used to meet the conditions of a plurality of ICT clock application scenarios, thereby reducing device complexity and manufacturing costs.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Bit error correction device, method, and program
abstract_en: To provide a bit error correction device, a method and a program with which it is possible to correct bit errors without adding an error correction code to data signals.SOLUTION: A bit error correction device 11 comprises: a first error detection unit 111a for detecting an error of a data signal inputted via a first path to the bit error correction device 11; a second error detection unit 111b for detecting an error of a same data signal inputted via a second path to the bit error correction device 11, that has the same bit arrangement as the bit arrangement of the data signal; and a bit interchange unit 114 which, when an error is detected in the data signal and an error is detected in the same data signal, interchanges bits at mutually different positions on the basis of a difference signal between the data signal and the same data signal and generating a plurality of corrected data signals.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: terahertz oscillator
abstract_en: To provide a terahertz oscillator capable of mode-locked multimode oscillation, that is, a terahertz oscillator capable of oscillating pulsed light.SOLUTION: In a terahertz oscillator with a resonant tunneling diode, a bias voltage applied to the resonant tunneling diode is chosen to be a voltage at which an oscillation frequency of the terahertz oscillator causes a frequency jump, and multimode oscillation is obtained by returning the oscillation light of the terahertz oscillator to the resonant tunneling diode. The bias voltage may be modulated at a predetermined frequency, for example, fmod=c/2L.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Switch overcurrent detection device
abstract_en: To provide a switch overcurrent detection device capable of miniaturizing the device.SOLUTION: A switch overcurrent detection device includes a plurality of semiconductor switches SW1 and SW2 connected in parallel with each other and having body diodes, a capacitor 51 having a first electrode connected to the anode side of a body diode constituting a sub-switch and a second electrode connected to the low-potential side terminal side of a main switch when some semiconductor switches among the plurality of semiconductor switches are used as the sub switch SW2 and the remaining semiconductor switches are used as the main switch SW1, a voltage detection unit 54 that detects the voltage between the terminals of the capacitor, and an overcurrent determination unit 54 that determines that an overcurrent is flowing through the main switch when the voltage between the terminals detected when the main switch is in the ON state is greater than an overcurrent threshold.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Semiconductor device
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To reduce the standby power or suppress the malfunction in a logic circuit performing clock gating. 
     SOLUTION: A logic circuit includes a transistor that is turned off in a state that a potential difference exists between a source terminal and a drain terminal in a period for which a clock signal is not supplied. A channel formation region of the transistor is formed of an oxide semiconductor with reduced hydrogen concentration. Specifically, the hydrogen concentration of the oxide semiconductor is 5×10 19 (atoms/cm 3 ) or less. Thus, the leakage current of the transistor can be reduced. As a result, the standby power can be reduced and the malfunction can be suppressed in the logic circuit.

title_en: Crystal oscillator
abstract_en: To provide a crystal oscillator capable of reducing the influence of the stress imposed by conductive adhesive on an oscillating part.SOLUTION: A crystal oscillator 10 has a configuration in which an oscillating part 11a, a fixing part 11b, a connecting part 11c for connecting thereof together, and an AT-cut crystal piece 11 with notches 11d on both sides of the connecting part are connected and fixed by a conducting adhesive 15 to a container 13 at a partial area of the fixing part. The connecting part spans the center of the short side of the oscillating part and the center of the long side of the fixing part. The conductive adhesive fixes the fixing part to the container on each side of the fixing part other than a portion in contact with the connecting part. When the width of the connecting part is expressed as W, W is 0.40 to 0.46 mm.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Receiving device
abstract_en: To enable reduction of variations of phase differences between clock signals.SOLUTION: A receiving device includes: a PLL circuit that generates a first clock signal; an accumulator that generates second phase information on the basis of first phase information and phase compensation information; a first phase interpolation part that generates a second clock signal on the basis of the first phase information and the first clock signal; a second phase interpolation part that generates a third clock signal on the basis of the second phase information and the first clock signal; a first compensation circuit that, on the basis of the second clock signal, generates a fourth clock signal, and a sixth clock signal with a phase being reversed to the fourth clock signal; a second compensation circuit that, on the basis of the third clock signal, generates a fifth clock signal, and a seventh clock signal with a phase being reversed to the fifth clock signal; and a third compensation circuit that generates phase compensation information on the basis of the fourth, fifth, sixth, and seventh clock signals.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Noise reduction circuit, load system, power conversion device, and refrigerating apparatus
abstract_en: To provide a noise reduction circuit.SOLUTION: A noise reduction circuit 30a comprises: noise cancelers 34a to 36a that reduce a common mode noise current flowing via a power line and an earth from a power converter 20 connected to an AC power supply 100 with a compensation current; and a DC power supply unit 33a for the noise cancelers. A voltage Vcc of a DC power supply V of the DC power supply part is less than 2/3 of a DC link voltage of the power converter. The voltage Vcc is set to a maximum value of V or √2 times or more of an actual value of V, when a connection point of a path (a coupling capacitor part 32a) connecting the power line with the ground and the power line is a first connection point, a connection point of the path and the ground is a second connection point, the common node noise current of the power line on the AC power supply side of the first connection point is Ig, the compensation current is Io, a path impedance is Z1, and the impedance on the AC power supply side of the first and second connection points is Z2 and V=2*(Z1*Io-Z2*Ig).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Signal processing device
abstract_en: To provide a signal processing device capable of restricting its manufacturing cost.SOLUTION: A signal processing device 1 is configured including: a signal processing part 2 at least having a first operational amplifier 41 and a second operational amplifier 42; a first switch 51 for changing the connection between a signal source and a first non-inverting input terminal 410, and between a reference voltage VCOM and the first non-inverting input terminal 410; a second switch 52 for changing the connection between the signal source and a second non-inverting input terminal 420 and between the reference voltage VCOM and the second non-inverting input terminal 420; and a control part 7 for defining an offset amount 72 of a first processing signal S5a based on a second processing signal S5b outputted from the signal processing part 2 by the connection of the reference voltage VCOM, the first non-inverting input terminal 410, and the second non-inverting input terminal 420, due to the changes of the first switch 51 and the second switch 52.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Transmission device, transmission method, reception device, and reception method
abstract_en: To secure favorable communication quality in data transmission using an LDPC code.SOLUTION: In group-wise interleaving, the LDPC code with a code length N of 17280 bits is interleaved in units of 360-bit bit groups 0 to 47. In group-wise deinterleaving, a sequence of the LDPC code after group-wise interleaving is returned to an original sequence. The present technology can be applied, for example, to a case of performing data transmission using an LDPC code, and the like.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 122

title_en: Reset circuit and semiconductor device
abstract_en: To improve reliability and safety of a reset circuit.SOLUTION: A reset circuit 10 includes: a first detection unit 11 configured to generate a first detection signal UVLO1 by comparing a monitoring target voltage VREG (e.g., internal electrical power source voltage) with a first threshold voltage VH; a second detection unit 12 configured to generate a second detection signal UVLO2 by comparing the monitoring target voltage VREG with a second threshold voltage VL equal to or less than the first threshold voltage VH; a logical gate 13 configured to generate a reset signal RST on the basis of the first detection signal UVLO1 and the second detection signal UVLO2; and a third detection unit 14 configured to detect whether a logic level of the first detection signal UVLO1 is switched after a logic level of the second detection signal UVLO2 is switched, to generate a failure detection signal LAT.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Signal generation apparatus, level correction value calculation system, and level correction value calculation method
abstract_en: To provide a signal generation apparatus configured to accurately determine a correction value of a variable attenuator while suppressing influence of non-linearity of a semiconductor component on a path from a signal generation unit to a measurement unit.SOLUTION: A signal generation apparatus includes: a signal generation unit 2 which generates a predetermined digital signal; a DA converter 3 which converts the digital signal generated in the signal generation unit 2 into an analog signal of a predetermined radio frequency; variable attenuators 40, 42, 44, and 46 that attenuate the analog signal converted by the DA converter 3; a measurement unit 6 that detects a level of the signal attenuated by the variable attenuators 40, 42, 44, and 46 and passing through one or more semiconductor components; and a control unit 7 that obtains a value of a step error, which is a correction value of an attenuation amount of the variable attenuators 40, 42, 44, and 46 in each of a plurality of steps obtained by dividing a maximum value of the attenuation amount of the variable attenuators 40, 42, 44, and 46 by a variation amount, which is a predetermined attenuation amount.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Filter circuit and multilayered filter device
abstract_en: To achieve a balanced filter circuit that can be downsized, and a balanced multilayered filter device that can be downsized.SOLUTION: A filter circuit 1 includes: a pair of balanced input ports 11 and 12; a pair of balanced output ports 21 and 22; resonators 20 and 30 provided in parallel between the pair of balanced input ports 11 and 12 and the pair of balanced output ports 21 and 22 in a circuit configuration; a capacitor C20 connected in parallel to the resonator 20; and a capacitor C30 connected in parallel to the resonator 30. The resonators 20 and 30 are magnetically coupled to each other and electrically connected to each other. The capacitors C20 and C30 are not electrically connected to a ground.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Piezoelectric vibrating piece, piezoelectric vibrator, oscillator, and piezoelectric vibrating piece manufacturing method
abstract_en: To provide a piezoelectric vibrating piece that can be made thinner and less prone to a short circuit due to adhesion of foreign matter, a piezoelectric vibrator, an oscillator, and a piezoelectric vibrating piece manufacturing method.SOLUTION: A piezoelectric vibrating piece 3 includes a piezoelectric plate 30 having a pair of vibrating arms, and an electrode film 40 formed on the outer surface of the piezoelectric plate 30. An electrode recess 50 whose depth D1 from the main surface is equal to or greater than a thickness T1 of the electrode film 40 is formed on at least one main surface of the piezoelectric plate 30. At least a part of the electrode film 40 is formed in the electrode recess 50.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8

title_en: Multi-mode channel coding
abstract_en: To provide a channel coding which is efficiently strength to an error.SOLUTION: A channel encoder 2 that codes a frame, comprises: a multi-mode redundancy encoder 4 that performs a redundancy and codes the frame in accordance with a specific coding mode from a set of coding modes different each other in regard to a redundancy amount added to the frame; and a coloring device that adopts a coloring sequence to at least one coding word. The multi-mode redundancy encoder outputs the frame to be coded containing at least one coding word, and the coloring sequence of the coloring device is that at least one bit of the coding word is changed by the adoption of at least one coloring sequence. The specific coloring sequence is selected in accordance with a specific coding mode.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: common mode noise filter
abstract_en: To provide a common mode noise filter capable of reducing the stress variation.SOLUTION: A common mode noise filter 1 includes an elementary body 2, multiple conductor layers 3, and a via-hole. An even number of the conductor layers 3 among multiple conductor layers 3 are spiral layers. The spiral layer 4 has a spiral conductor 41 and at least one via pad 42, 43. The outer edge of via-pad 42 includes an outer facing part RO4. When viewed from the top and bottom, the outer facing portion RO4 follows the shape of the inner facing portions RI4 and RI7 of the corresponding spiral layers 4 and 7 of the even number of spiral layers.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Semiconductor device
abstract_en: To provide a semiconductor device including a unipolar logic circuit.SOLUTION: In a semiconductor device 100 in which an output voltage of a logic circuit is prevented from dropping by increasing a gate voltage with a capacitor element 117, a drain and a gate of a first transistor 111 are electrically connected to a first wire 121 and a source thereof is electrically connected to a first node 131, a drain of a second transistor 112 is electrically connected to the first node, a source thereof is electrically connected to a second wire 122, and a gate thereof is electrically connected to a second node 132, a drain of a third transistor is electrically connected to a third wire 123, a source thereof is electrically connected to a third node 133, and a gate thereof is electrically connected to the first node, and a drain of a fourth transistor is electrically connected to the third node 133, a source thereof is electrically connected to a fourth wire 124, and a gate thereof is electrically connected to the second node. One electrode of the capacitor element is electrically connected to the first node and the other electrode thereof is electrically connected to the third node.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Converter structure for generation source suppression in saw filter device
abstract_en: To provide a front surface elastic wave filter device accumulated on a composite substrate having an improved parameter.SOLUTION: A converter structure for a front surface elastic wave device, comprises a pair of comb type electrodes (302 and 304) to be inter digitalized. The converter structure contains electrode means (306 and 308) that are adjacent with a pitch p satisfying a black condition regulated as a terminal intermediate electrode means distance between the two electrode means (306 and 308) which are adjacent while belonging to the a different pair of comb type electrodes (302 and 304) in the pair of comb type electrodes (302 and 304). The pair of comb type electrodes (302 and 304) includes at least one region (316) having an end part interval distance with respect to each other corresponding to the pitch p as well as belonging to the same comb type electrodes (302 and 304) by the two or more adjacent means (306 and 308). The present invention is also related to a front surface elastic wave filter device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Manufacturing method for crystal resonator wafer and crystal resonator wafer
abstract_en: To provide a manufacturing method for a crystal resonator wafer which has no notch or excessive projection and improves device performance when folding the crystal resonator wafer along a shallow groove, and a crystal resonator wafer.SOLUTION: A method forms N first recessed grooves by etching a front surface of a crystal wafer and forms N second recessed grooves by etching a reverse surface. The respective first recessed grooves and the second recessed grooves have structures which are wide above and narrow below, widths of second bottom ends of the respective second recessed grooves are equal to widths of the first bottom ends of the opposite first recessed grooves, and lengths of the second bottom ends are equal to length of the first bottom ends or longer. The method further includes: forming a first veer hole whose length is equal to the widths of the first bottom ends by directly facing one of the first bottom ends to one of the second bottom ends for etching; forming a second veer hole shorter in length than widths of the second bottom ends by directly facing the other end of the second bottom ends from the first bottom ends for etching; and forming a shallow groove by etching a target edge of the second veer hole.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: power amplifier circuit
abstract_en: To provide a power amplifier circuit capable of preventing breakage of an amplification element in a case where an input power becomes large, by a simple circuit configuration.SOLUTION: A power amplifier circuit 10 comprises: a transistor 101 whose base is supplied with a bias current IB1 and that amplifies an input signal RFin and outputs a current I1; a transistor 102 whose emitter is connected with the base of the transistor 101 and that supplies a bias current IB1 from the emitter to the base of the transistor 101; a transistor 1031 connected with the base of the transistor 102; a comparison voltage generation circuit 103 that generates a comparison voltage Vcomp on the basis of a current I2 flowing in the transistor 1031; and a comparison circuit 104 connected with the base of the transistor 102 and supplied with a comparison voltage and a reference voltage and that reduces a current I3a to be supplied to the base of the transistor 102 with increase in the current I2 on the basis of the comparison voltage and the reference voltage.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Bulk ultrasound (BAW) resonator
abstract_en: To increase an electromechanical coupling coefficient of an acoustic resonator, thereby improving its performance.SOLUTION: An acoustic resonator 22 includes a first piezoelectric layer 24, a second piezoelectric layer 26, a coupler layer 36, a first electrode 28, and a second electrode 30. The first piezoelectric layer 24 has a first polarity. The second piezoelectric layer 26 has a second polarity opposite the first polarity. The coupler layer 36 is between the first piezoelectric layer 24 and the second piezoelectric layer 26. The first electrode 28 is on the first piezoelectric layer 24 opposite the coupler layer 36. The second electrode 30 is on the second piezoelectric layer 26 opposite the coupler layer 36.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Amplifier circuit and communication device
abstract_en: To provide an amplifier circuit in which the distortion of output characteristics of high-frequency signals is suppressed.SOLUTION: An amplifier circuit 1 includes an amplifying transistor 11 connected to a signal input terminal 110, a power supply circuit 22 configured to supply a bias voltage vg1a to the amplifying transistor 11, a resistor 32 arranged in series in a bias path connecting the power supply circuit 22 and the amplifying transistor 11, a transistor 21, which is connected to the bias path and power supply circuit 22 and used to simulate the amplifying transistor 11, and a detection diode 31 connected to a bias path between the resistor 32 and the gate of the amplifying transistor 11 and the signal input terminal 110.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Compression device and compression method
abstract_en: To provide a compression device capable of compressing data in a short time.SOLUTION: A compression device according to an embodiment includes: a substring generator configured to generate a plurality of substrings from data strings for a plurality of cycles, each of the substrings having a plurality of bytes, leading byte positions the substrings being different from each other; a memory configured to store a plurality of input data strings input in a past cycle, a searcher configured to search the memory in order to obtain a plurality of first input data strings that at least partially match the plurality of substrings from among the plurality of input data strings, and to output a plurality of search results indicating a storage location of the memory where the plurality of first input data sequences are stored and a matching length between the plurality of substrings and the plurality of first input data strings; and a selector configured to determine whether to select a second search result in the plurality of search results on the basis of bitmaps of the plurality of search results and a bit string indicating whether a first search result in the plurality of search results is selected.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 10

title_en: Semiconductor relay
abstract_en: To provide a semiconductor relay capable of achieving high output and suppressing fluctuations in output current due to fluctuations in a drive signal.SOLUTION: A semiconductor relay 1 includes first and second input terminals 14, 15, first and second output terminals 16, 17, a drive circuit 2, a first FET 12, and a Zener diode 11. The first FET 12 is made of a compound semiconductor. The first FET 12 is connected to the first and second output terminals 16 and 17, and is turned on and off by a drive signal from the drive circuit 2. A first output terminal 3 of the drive circuit 2 is connected to a gate electrode 12a of the first FET 12, and a second output terminal 4 of the drive circuit 2 is connected to a source electrode 12b of the first FET 12. An anode electrode 11a of the Zener diode 11 is connected to the source electrode 12b of the first FET 12, and the cathode electrode 11b is connected to the gate electrode 12a.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Peak hold device, impedance measurement device, metal precipitation detector, and battery inside temperature estimation device
abstract_en: To provide a peak hold device which can acquire an arbitrary peak value of an attenuation vibration waveform.SOLUTION: A peak hold device 100 starts holding the value of an attenuation vibration waveform at a time before a target peak which is one of the largest peak and the smallest peak of a target of which peak value is to be acquired and repeats processing of stopping holding the value of the attenuation vibration waveform at a time after the target peak for a plurality of attenuation vibration waveforms.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Acoustic wave device, filter, and multiplexer
abstract_en: To provide an acoustic wave device capable of improving the frequency-temperature characteristics of both the resonant frequency and the anti-resonant frequency.SOLUTION: An acoustic wave device 100 includes a substrate 10, a piezoelectric layer 20 provided on the substrate 10 and having a lithium niobate layer 21 and a lithium tantalate layer 22 provided between the substrate 10 and the lithium niobate layer 21, and a pair of comb electrodes 32 provided on the lithium niobate layer 21, each of which has a plurality of electrode fingers 33 that excite acoustic waves, and in which the average pitch P of the plurality of electrode fingers 33 of one comb electrode 32 is greater than or equal to the distance T3 from the upper surface of the lithium niobate layer 21 to the lower surface of the lithium tantalate layer 22.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Semiconductor Device
abstract_en: To provide a semiconductor device capable of improving the slew rate of output voltage.SOLUTION: A semiconductor device comprises: a low-side driver M0 whose gate-to-source withstand voltage is lower than the externally input power supply voltage VDD; a power supply circuit 11 that outputs a first voltage V1 lower than the power supply voltage VDD; a first circuit that drives the gate of the low-side driver M0 using the first voltage V1 as a power supply; and a second circuit that supplies current Ia to the gate of the low-side driver M0 from the power supply voltage node to which the power supply voltage VDD is supplied.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: ESD Protection Circuit
abstract_en: To provide an ESD protection circuit which is not operated when a normal power supply is started and even when a power supply voltage is modulated at a normal operation.SOLUTION: An RC circuit 110 is connected serially between a VDD and a GND. An RC circuit 120 is connected serially between the VDD and the GND, and a time constant that is different from the time constant of the RC circuit 110 is set. In an inverter circuit 210, a potential between a resistance element 111 and a capacitance element 112 is set to an input. In an inverter circuit 220, a potential between a resistance element 121 and a capacitance element 122 is set to an input. In an NMOS transistor 310, an output of the inverter circuit 210 is input into a gate terminal, and a drain terminal is connected to the VDD. In an NMOS transistor 320, an output of the inverter circuit 220 is input into the gate terminal; the drain terminal is connected to a source terminal of the NMOS transistor 310; and the source terminal is connected to the GND.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: High frequency module and communication device
abstract_en: To reduce the deterioration of attenuation characteristics of a filter.SOLUTION: A high frequency module 1 includes a first receiving filter, a second receiving filter, a first low-noise amplifier, a first inductor, a second inductor, and a mounting substrate 4. The first receiving filter, the second receiving filter, the first inductor, and the second inductor are disposed on a first main surface 41 of the mounting substrate 4. In a plan view from a thickness direction D1 of the mounting substrate 4, an outer size S1 of the first inductor is larger than an outer size S2 of the second inductor. The first inductor has a first portion 563 in which part of a winding 562 is densely wound, and a second portion 564 in which the rest of the winding 562 is sparsely wound. In a direction perpendicular to the thickness direction D1, the first portion 563 of the first inductor and the first receiving filter do not overlap.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Electronic Circuit
abstract_en: To provide a technique that can adjust the difference in current rise speed when multiple transistors are turned on.SOLUTION: An electronic circuit may include a plurality of transistors connected in parallel, and a gate resistor connected in series to the gate of each transistor, the gate resistor having a resistance value that changes depending on temperature.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Piezoelectric Sensor
abstract_en: To prevent the occurrence of connection failure between a wiring layer and an electrode film.SOLUTION: A plurality of contact holes 81a are formed to overlap an electrode film 62 when viewed from a normal direction relating to the surface direction of a piezoelectric film 50. The plurality of contact holes 81a have different lengths in one direction of surface directions of the piezoelectric film 50, and as the length of the contact hole in the one direction increases, the depth of the contact hole increases. The electrode film 62 is exposed from a bottom of one contact hole 81a of the plurality of contact holes 81a. A wiring layer 81b is provided in each of the plurality of contact holes 81a so as to be electrically connected to portions of the electrode film 62 exposed from the contact holes 81a.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Elastic wave device, splitter, and communication device
abstract_en: To solve the problem in which: there is a demand for an elastic wave device using plate waves or bulk waves and having stable frequency characteristics in high temperature or in low temperature.SOLUTION: An elastic device comprises: an LT layer including a rotation Y-cut X-propagation LT single crystal; and an IDT electrode adjacent to the LT layer, having a plurality of electrode fingers, and configured to excite elastic waves. The cut angle θ of the rotation Y-cut X-propagation LT single crystal satisfies 10°≤θ≤90°. The elastic wave is a plate wave or a bulk wave.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Amplification circuit and illumination device
abstract_en: To provide an amplification circuit with excellent radiation resistance, being capable of handling large current with a simple structure.SOLUTION: An amplification circuit 10 includes an operational amplifier 1 including a MOSFET with a lateral structure composed of a semiconductor with a wider band gap than a Si semiconductor, a bipolar transistor 2 electrically connected to an output side of the operational amplifier 1 and composed of the Si semiconductor, and a resistor element 4 that detects one of a collector current and an emitter current of the bipolar transistor 2. A voltage of the resistor element 4 is applied to an inversion input terminal 1b of the operational amplifier 1, and a predetermined DC voltage is applied to a non-inversion input terminal 1a of the operational amplifier 1. The bipolar transistor 2 is electrically connected to an output unit 20 so that the other of the collector current and the emitter current flows to the output unit 20. The voltage between the collector and the emitter of the bipolar transistor 2 is lower than the sum of the voltage of the output unit 20 and the voltage of the resistor element 4.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Piezoelectric material for surface acoustic wave filter, piezoelectric substrate for surface acoustic wave filter, surface acoustic wave filter
abstract_en: To provide a novel piezoelectric material for surface acoustic wave filters.SOLUTION: A piezoelectric material for surface acoustic wave filters contains a lantern-tungsten nitride.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Power Amplifier Circuit
abstract_en: To provide a power amplifier circuit that improves distortion characteristics and efficiency by forming a bypass path for high-frequency components.SOLUTION: A power amplifier circuit 101 comprises: a distribution circuit 41 that distributes an input signal RFin with a phase difference applied; a carrier amplifier 51 that outputs a first amplified signal RF4; a peak amplifier 52 that outputs a second amplified signal RF5; a combiner circuit 42 that combines the first amplified signal and the second amplified signal to generate a third amplified signal RFout; a first bias circuit 151 having a first bias supply terminal 151a that supplies a first bias to a second terminal of a first capacitor 61 through a resistor element 160; a second bias circuit 152 having a second bias supply terminal 152a that supplies a second bias to a second terminal of a second capacitor 62 through a resistor element 162; and a third capacitor 64 having the first terminal connected to the second capacitor 62 and the second terminal connected to the first bias supply terminal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Performing radio frequency alignment control using a model-based digital twin
abstract_en: Radio frequency matching control is implemented using a model-based digital twin.SOLUTION: The method includes causing manufacturing equipment to generate an RF signal to energize a processing chamber associated with the manufacturing equipment. The method further includes receiving, from one or more sensors associated with the manufacturing equipment, current trace data associated with the RF signals. The method further includes updating impedance values of the digital replica associated with the manufacturing equipment based on the current trace data. The method further includes obtaining, from the digital replica, one or more outputs indicative of the prediction data. The method further includes causing performance of one or more corrective actions associated with the manufacturing equipment based on the predictive data.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Piezoelectric vibrator with built-in temperature sensor and reference signal generation device
abstract_en: To provide a piezoelectric vibrator with a built-in temperature sensor having a new structure effective for improving frequency temperature characteristics.SOLUTION: The piezoelectric vibrator 10 is provided with an AT-cut crystal vibrating piece 10a, a thermosensor 10b, and a resister 10c connected in series to the thermosensor, and is used by being connected to an external electronic device having a temperature compensation circuit for compensating an oscillation frequency of the crystal vibrating piece according to a predetermined correction formula. The resistor is a resistor having a first resistance value capable of setting the inter-terminal voltage of the temperature sensor to a voltage scheduled by a predetermined correction formula, or a second resistance value smaller than the first resistance value or a third resistance value larger than the first resistance value capable of setting the inter-terminal voltage to a correction voltage corresponding to the individual difference of the piezoelectric vibrator.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Digitally-controlled push-pull amplification device and method
abstract_en: A digitally-controlled push-pull amplification device comprises: a signal input module that receives a digital input signal; a bias voltage generation module that generates a digital bias voltage; a DAC module that adds and converts the digital input signal input from the signal input module and the digital bias voltage generated by the bias voltage generation module to an analog input signal; a push-pull amplification module that amplifies the analog input signal converted by the DAC module to generate an amplified analog signal; and a signal output module that outputs the amplified analog signal generated by the push-pull amplification module. In accordance with the digitally-controlled push-pull amplification device and method of the present invention, the digitally-controlled push-pull amplifier is configured to receive an input signal and an amplification factor in digital formats and apply a bias voltage corresponding thereto to perform amplification, thereby exhibiting increased convenience in control compared to existing analog-type push-pull amplifiers. In particular, since the bias voltage is calculated in real time in consideration of a real-time change in temperature of a transistor of the push-pull amplifier based on the unique temperature characteristics of the transistor of the push-pull amplifier, an amplification factor error due to the temperature characteristics can be reduced even when the amplifier is operated for a long time. On the other hand, when the input signal is 0, the bias voltage input to the push-pull amplifier is configured to be maintained at 0 V, so power consumption resulting from unnecessary operation of the amplifier can be reduced.

title_en: Method of determining input for elevator button, button input decision device and button input decision system performing method
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, a method for determining a non-contact input for an elevator button performed by a non-contact input determination device comprises: a step of receiving, from a sensing unit, a first detection signal for detecting a first object in a first angle range and a second detection signal for detecting a second object in a second angle range; a step of determining whether the first object is a human finger by using the first detection signal and the second detection signal; a step of generating distance information about the first object by using the first detection signal; and a step of determining the non-contact input to the elevator button by the first object based on the result of the determination and the distance information.

title_en: A short detection circuit for SiC MOSFETs
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a circuit for detecting a short circuit of a power semiconductor and, more specifically, to a circuit for detecting a short circuit of a power semiconductor, which converts a slope or a size of a drain source current of a power semiconductor into a digital value, accumulates and adds the converted digital value, and determines whether a short circuit occurs according to a result of the addition, thereby enabling rapid detection when a short circuit occurs.

title_en: Method for determining mutual inductance for efficient wireless power transfer and appratus thereof
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a device for determining mutual inductance for efficient wireless power transmission. The device comprises: a resonance circuit unit including at least one transmission resonant circuit unit and at least one reception resonant circuit unit to transmit power supplied to the transmission resonant circuit unit to the reception resonant circuit unit; and a control unit for supplying power to only one transmission resonant circuit unit and cutting off the power supply to the other transmission resonant circuit unit to determine a mutual inductance value associated with the transmission resonant circuit unit to which the power is supplied and supplying power to a reference transmission resonant circuit unit and only one transmission resonant circuit unit except for the reference transmission resonant circuit unit to determine a sign of mutual inductance associated with the transmission resonant circuit unit to which the power is supplied.

title_en: Proximity sensor with nonlinear filter and method
abstract_en: A sensor for a portable connected device including a filter (30) is arranged to reduce a noise component on a sampled input signal, wherein the filter is arranged to consider only input measurements which change systematically in a same direction, updating an output value when all the input samples in a predetermined time window are above or below a current output value and, repeating the current output value when the input samples in the time window are below and above the current output value.

title_en: High-frequency power supply system
abstract_en: Provided is a technology for suppressing an increase in a reflected wave power (the same as a reflection coefficient) by an IMD. According to the present invention, a high-frequency power supply system providing a high-frequency power for a load accessed comprises: a bias power supply which outputs a bias power at a first frequency; a source power supply which outputs a source power at a second frequency which is higher than the first frequency; and a matching unit which includes an impedance matching circuit which acquires the bias power and the source power and acquires the matching of impedance on the source power supply side and the load side. The source power supply determines a delay set value showing a starting timing for processing fluctuations in the frequency for the source power, processes fluctuations in the frequency by using the relevant delay set value and the value of the first frequency, and outputs the source power with the fluctuated frequency to the matching unit.

title_en: Ternary inverter providing adjustable intermediate voltage
abstract_en: The present application relates to a ternary inverter. In particular, the present application provides the ternary inverter for providing an adjustable intermediate voltage. The ternary inverter according to one embodiment of the present application includes: a first transistor including a first channel formed of a heterojunction in which first and second materials are combined; and a second transistor including a second channel formed of the first material, wherein the first material is formed over at least a portion of the area of the first channel and the entire area of the second channel. The ternary inverter according to the embodiment of the present application can provide an adjustable intermediate voltage. Accordingly, the intermediate voltage can be easily discriminated from a low voltage and a high voltage.

title_en: Synthetic aperture radar and decimation method for synthetic aperture radar data
abstract_en: An image radar includes: a memory storing filter coefficients corresponding to the decimation ratio; a controller for selecting the filter coefficients from the memory in response to the decimation rate received from a ground station; an analog-to-digital converter which converts a received signal into a digital signal; and a decimation unit for generating an image radar signal by reducing the digital signal to the first decimation ratio of a non-integer multiple and the second decimation ratio of an integer multiple according to the selected filter coefficient.

title_en: Display apparatus
abstract_en: Provided is a display apparatus capable of improving color reproduction with respect to an input image signal. The display device comprises: a display panel including a pixel array in which a pixel composed of a plurality of inorganic light emitting elements is arranged in a plurality of row lines and a sub-pixel circuit provided for each of the inorganic light emitting elements and providing a driving current to the inorganic light emitting elements; and a driving unit for setting an image data voltage to the sub-pixel circuits of the display panel in order of the row line during a data setting period and driving the sub-pixel circuits to provide the driving current to the inorganic light emitting elements in order of the row line based on a sweep signal and the image data voltage during the light emitting period. The sub-pixel circuits comprise: a capacitor having one end to which the sweep signal is applied; and a first driving transistor connected to the other end of the capacitor, receiving the sweep signal through the capacitor in a light emitting section, and controlling a time during which the driving current is provided to the inorganic light emitting elements on the basis of the sweep signal. The drive unit applies a first voltage to the one end of the capacitor separately from the sweep signal in the data setting period.

title_en: Direct digital frequency synthesizer capable of compensating frequency offset and minimizing spectral leakage
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention is a direct digital frequency synthesizer capable of compensating frequency offset and minimizing spectral leakage.
