According to the present invention, provided is a direct digital frequency synthesizer which comprises: a phase accumulator which generates phase information by accumulating frequency control words; a digital decoder which converts the phase information output from the phase accumulator into an amplitude of a sine wave; and a non-linear digital-to-analog converter which converts the amplitude converted by the digital decoder into an analog signal and outputs the analog signal. In order to compensate for frequency offset caused by dithering, the phase accumulator includes a frequency offset compensation circuit that subtracts 1 from a one-level-lower-bit having a ratio of 1/2 of a bit to which a pseudorandom binary sequence is added.

title_en: Battery switch driving circuit
abstract_en: The present invention provides a battery switch driving circuit for driving a battery switch using a switch, a capacitor, and a diode. The battery switch driving circuit according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises: a first battery input terminal and a second battery input terminal; a converter positioned between the first battery input terminal and the second battery input terminal; a switch positioned between the second battery input terminal and the converter to interrupt power input to the second battery input terminal when turned off; and a switch driving unit configured to turn on the first switch. The switch driving unit includes a first capacitor that is charged and discharged depending on the on/off operation of a second switch that operates with a PWM signal, and a second capacitor that is charged according to the on/off operation of the second switch by a voltage charged in the first capacitor.

title_en: Bicm reception device and method corresponding to 256-symbol mapping and low density parity check codeword with 16200 length, 3/15 rate
abstract_en: A bit interleaver, a BICM device, and a bit interleaving method are disclosed. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the bit interleaver comprises: a first memory for storing an LDPC codeword having a length of 16200 and a code rate of 3/15; a processor for interleaving the LDPC codeword in a bit group unit having a size corresponding to a parallel factor of the LDPC codeword to generate an interleaved codeword; and a second memory providing the interleaved codeword to a modulator for 256-symbol mapping.

title_en: Semiconductor temperature compensation circuit with built-in photodiode
abstract_en: Disclosed is a temperature compensation circuit for a semiconductor with a built-in photodiode. The temperature compensation circuit for a semiconductor with a built-in photodiode comprises: a compensation photodiode which has the same structure as a sensing photodiode, and has a 1/n size of the sensing photodiode, wherein N is a natural number of 2 or more; and a current amplifier which outputs a compensation current in which a current output from the compensation photodiode is amplified by N times, to generate a compensation current of the same size as a leakage current of the sensing photodiode.

title_en: Phase correction circuit, clock buffer and semiconductor appratus including the phase correction circuit
abstract_en: The present technology may comprise: a test clock generating part comprising a plurality of signal paths, and configured to generate a plurality of test clock signals in response to a plurality of selection signals and a plurality of phase control signals; a detection part configured to generate a plurality of detection voltages in response to the plurality of selection signals and the plurality of test clock signals; and a control part configured to generate the plurality of selection signals, detect a phase skew of the plurality of signal paths according to the plurality of detection voltages, and generate the plurality of phase control signals for correcting the same. Therefore, the present invention is capable of improving an operation performance of a semiconductor device.

title_en: Transmitter for transmitting duo binary signal
abstract_en: A transmitter according to the present invention is a transmitter generating a duobinary signal corresponding to level 0, level 1, or level 2 according to first data and second data. The transmitter comprises: a pull-up driving circuit including a plurality of pull-up resistors selectively connected between the first power supply and the transmission node according to the first data or the second data; and a pull-down driving circuit including a plurality of pull-down resistors selectively connected between the transmission node and the second power supply according to the first data or the second data. When at least one of the first data and the second data is activated, at least one of the plurality of pull-up resistors is connected between the first power supply and the transmission node. Alternatively, when at least one of the first data and the second data is activated, at least one of the plurality of pull-down resistors is connected between the second power supply and the transmission node. Accordingly, the present invention provides a transmitter which reduces the occurrence of errors by making intervals between adjacent levels constant when transmitting duobinary signals.

title_en: Apparatus of parity interleaving for encoding variable-length signaling information and method using the same
abstract_en: A parity interleaving method for variable-length signaling information and a device thereof are disclosed. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the parity interleaving device comprises: a processor configured to divide parity bits of an LDPC codeword having a length of 16200 and a code rate of 3/15 into a plurality of groups and group-wise interleave the groups by using a group-wise interleaving order to generate a parity bit string for parity puncturing; and a memory configured to provide the parity bit string for the parity puncturing to a parity puncturing unit.

title_en: Low-loss quasi-circulator
abstract_en: A low-loss quasi-circulator is provided. The quasi-circulator according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a first coupler whose input end is connected to a transmitting end; a first amplifier whose input terminal is connected to the output terminal of the first coupler; a second amplifier whose input terminal is connected to the output terminal of the first coupler; a second coupler whose one end is connected to the output terminal of the first amplifier and the output terminal of the second amplifier and the other end is connected to an antenna; and a third coupler whose one end is connected to the output terminal of the first amplifier and the output terminal of the second amplifier and the other end is connected to a receiving end. As a result, by minimizing the loss occurring in the quasi-circulator, it is possible to ultimately increase the efficiency of the RF FEM used in an ultra-high frequency radar system, etc.

title_en: A Device for signal processing of pulse amplitude modulation of optical transceiver
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a device for processing an N-level pulse amplitude modulation (PAM-N) signal comprises: an input unit that receives an input signal; a main amplifier connected to the input unit and amplifying the input signal by a first gain; and an output unit that outputs an output signal of the main amplifier. The device further comprises an auxiliary amplifier which is connected in parallel with the main amplifier between the input unit and the output unit and variably amplifies at least a portion of the input signal according to a linearity increase control signal corresponding to the output signal to apply it to the output unit.

title_en: Electronic device comprising matching circuit for reducing harmonics
abstract_en: According to various embodiments, a wireless power transmitter includes: a power amplifier configured to output an amplified signal based on an input signal and driving voltage; a first LC resonance circuit connected in parallel with the power amplifier; a matching circuit; and a transmission coil connected to the matching circuit. The matching circuit includes: a second LC resonance circuit including a first inductor and a first capacitor connected in series with the first inductor having one end connected to the output terminal of the power amplifier and one end of the first LC resonance circuit; and a second capacitor and a third capacitor connected to the other end of the second LC resonance circuit. The first inductor may be configured to have an inductance value such that the impedance of the second LC resonance circuit is greater than or equal to the first predetermined size at least one second or higher harmonic frequency of the operating frequency of the input signal. Accordingly, the distortion of the output waveform of the power amplifier can be alleviated.

title_en: Method and Apparatus for Controlling Pulse Timing of Transmission Signal Generator
abstract_en: Disclosed are a pulse timing control method of a transmission signal generating device and a device for thereof. The pulse timing control device according to an embodiment of the present invention may comprise: a parameter setting part that sets a system parameter for each amplification module to generate a transmission signal; a timing calculation part that calculates at least one timing for applying an operating voltage to each amplification module based on each of the system parameter; a timing control signal generating part that generates a timing control signal for each of the at least one amplification module based on the at least one timing; and a timing control part per module that controls an output signal so as to be outputted in each of the amplification module using the timing control signal. Therefore, the present invention is capable of having an effect of modifying a shape of each pulse waveform.

title_en: Multichannel amplifier to be capable of output power control having multiple step up transformers in Public Address system
abstract_en: A multi-channel amplifier having a variable output multi-stage transformer in a public address (PA) system is disclosed. The multi-channel amplifier having a variable output multi-stage transformer in a PA system comprises: a plurality of multi-channel amplifiers having at least one low-power amplifier of 30 W or less; and k number of matching transformers in a parallel configuration. The present invention is to provide a single high-power PA amplifier (1 AMP 30 W, 2 AMP 60 W, 4 AMP 120 W, 8 AMP 240 W, 16 AMP 480 W, or 32 AMP 960 W) having a variable output.

title_en: Multi-bit flip-flop circuit having reduced area and reduced wire complexity
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a multi-bit flip-flop circuit. The multi-bit flip-flop circuit of the present disclosure includes a first bit flip-flop and a second bit flip-flop. The first bit flip-flop includes an input multiplexer that receives a first data bit as a data input and a second data bit as a scan input and outputs one of the first data bit and the second data bit as a third data bit, a first transfer circuit, a first latch, a second transfer circuit, and a second latch that outputs a first output data bit. The second bit flip-flop includes an input multiplexer that receives a fourth data bit as a data input and a second output data bit as a scan input and outputs one of the fourth data bit and the second output data bit as a fifth data bit, a first transfer circuit, a first latch, a second transfer circuit, and a second latch that outputs the second output data bit.

title_en: Acoustic wave device with enhanced quality factor and fabrication method thereof
abstract_en: An acoustic wave device comprises a piezoelectric substrate and a transducer. The piezoelectric substrate has a surface. The transducer is disposed on the surface. The transducer comprises a first electrode, a second electrode, and at least one protruding part. The first electrode extends along a first direction and has a first end part. The second electrode extends along the first direction and has a second end part. The first electrode and the second electrode are separate and spaced apart from each other along the second direction. At least one protruding part is disposed at the first end part of the first electrode. At least one protruding part extends along the first direction and partially blocks the first end part.

title_en: Comparator circuit including feadback circuit
abstract_en: The present invention provides a comparator circuit capable of reducing power consumption, a semiconductor device including the same, and a system including the same. The comparator circuit includes an input circuit, a first reversal amplification circuit, a second reversal amplification circuit, a first coupling circuit, a second coupling circuit, and a feedback circuit. The input circuit generates an amplified input signal by alternately selecting each a positive input voltage and a negative input voltage during a sampling section and a lighting section. The first reversal amplification circuit generates a middle amplification signal by performing reversal amplification based on the amplified input signal during the sampling section. The second reversal amplification circuit generates a comparison result signal by performing reversal amplification based on the middle amplification signal during the sampling section. The first coupling circuit is connected between the input circuit and an input node of the first reversal amplification circuit. The second coupling circuit is connected between an output node of the first reversal amplification circuit and the input node of the second reversal amplification circuit. The feedback circuit amplifies the input node of the first reversal amplification circuit to a rail-to-rail voltage corresponding to a power voltage or a ground voltage based on the comparison result signal during the sampling section.

title_en: Semiconductor Device and Semiconductor System Capable of Operating Stably at Low Power
abstract_en: Disclosed are a semiconductor device and a semiconductor system, capable of operating stably at low power. According to one embodiment of the present invention, a semiconductor device includes at least one flip-flop. The flip-flop comprises: a first latch which includes a first data path receiving input data in response to a transmission signal and outputting middle data, and a first feedback path feeding back the middle data; and a second latch which includes a second data path receiving the middle data in response to the transmission signal and outputting output data, and a second feedback path feeding back the output data, wherein at least one of the first feedback path and the second feedback path is disabled prior to the first data path or the second data path.

title_en: Noise prevention method for by-pass circuit
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a noise prevention method of a bypass circuit formed in a plurality of signal processing circuits, wherein proposed is the noise prevention method of the bypass circuit that is characterized in adding a voltage follower circuit, and enabling the voltage follower circuit to be operated when only all of the plurality of signal processing circuits are bypassed and when a specific signal processing circuit operates, thereby enabling noise of the bypass circuit formed in the plurality of signal processing circuits to be prevented.

title_en: Electronic device for overvoltage protection
abstract_en: According to the present invention, an electronic device comprises: a transceiver including a transmitter and a receiver operating based on a power supply voltage and a pad voltage applied from a pad; and an overvoltage protection circuit applying a first protection voltage and a second protection voltage to each of the transmitter and the receiver. The overvoltage protection circuit includes: a reference voltage generator generating a reference voltage when the power supply voltage is on; and a voltage sensor generating and applying the first protection voltage and the second protection voltage based on the reference voltage when the power supply voltage is on, and generating and applying the first protection voltage and the second protection voltage based on the pad voltage when the power supply voltage is off.

title_en: Dc variable capacitor element
abstract_en: A dc variable capacitor device is disclosed. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a dc variable capacitor device comprises: a dc variable capacitor unit; a fine control unit controlling a q-factor of the dc variable capacitor unit; and an rf characteristic detection sensor unit monitoring an rf characteristic change caused by a dc bias in the dc variable capacitor unit.

title_en: Switchgear including deterioration detection device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a switchboard having an electric fire monitoring function, and more specifically, to a switchboard having an electric fire monitoring function, which is installed in the switchboard to comprehensively detect overcurrent, leakage current, arc, flame, and temperature, determines the occurrence of an electric fire in the switchboard based on the detected data, and drives a fire extinguishing device according to the determination result to quickly acupressure the electric fire.

title_en: Conditional transcoding for encoded data
abstract_en: A transcoder is disclosed. The transcoder may include a buffer for storing input encoding data. An index mapper may map an input dictionary to an output dictionary. A current encoding buffer may store the input encoding data, the input dictionary, and modified current encoding data that may be responsive to a map from the input dictionary to the output dictionary. A previous encoding buffer may store the input encoding data, the input dictionary, and modified previous encoding data that may be responsive to a map from the input dictionary to the output dictionary. A rule evaluator may generate an output stream in response to the modified current encoding data in the current encoding buffer, the modified previous encoding data in the previous encoding buffer, and a transcoding rule.

title_en: Method and Apparatus for Generating Multi-level High Voltage Non-sinusoidal Signal in Semiconductor Production Device Using Plasma
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, provided is a non-sinusoidal signal generating device which comprises: a first square wave circuit formed to apply positive voltages of two different magnitudes to an output terminal; a second square wave circuit formed to apply negative voltages of two different magnitudes to the output terminal; and a sawtooth wave circuit formed to apply sawtooth wave voltages of two different magnitudes to the output terminal. the sawtooth wave circuit includes an inductor formed to draw a current from a capacitive load connected to the output terminal.

title_en: Vehicle control apparatus with mosfet device protection circuit and method for protecting mosfet device thereof
abstract_en: According to a preferred embodiment of the present invention, a vehicle control device having a mosfet element protection circuit comprises: a control unit controlling a mosfet element for driving a vehicle load; and a protection circuit turning off the mosfet element when a battery short circuit failure occurs between the vehicle load and the mosfet element.

title_en: Electromagnetic filter and plasma processing apparatus having the same
abstract_en: The present invention provides an electromagnetic wave filter capable of preventing RF power, which is generated in a plasma chamber during a semiconductor process, from flowing into a heater control unit through a heater in the chamber, and a plasma substrate processing apparatus including the same. An electromagnetic wave filter provided in the plasma substrate processing apparatus according to the present invention comprises: a housing made of an electrically conductive metal material; an input port and an output port provided on both opposite sides of the housing; a base plate made of an electrically insulating material and installed on the bottom surface of the housing; an inductor installed on the upper surface of the base plate and connected to the output port; a plurality of conductive plates fixed to the upper surface of the base plate, electrically connecting the input port to the inductor, and the inductor to the output port; and a variable plate electrically connected to the conductive plates, and installed to be horizontally movable with respect to the conductive plates.

title_en: Method generating Pulse width modulation
abstract_en: A pulse width modulation (PWM) generation device according to one technical aspect of the present invention includes the steps of: calculating the Duration Time of an actual PLANT motor; calculating a counter N; calculating W1 using Mv(k) and the counter N; calculating a dutyCycle Counter N and a Duration Counter N; and performing a Data Type Conversion.

title_en: Amplifier
abstract_en: The present invention is to provide an amplifier with improved noise performance by removing generated harmonics. In particular, it is invented from the need for a noise index improvement technique capable of simultaneously performing matching required in the amplifier while minimizing the addition of devices and structural changes by using a degeneration inductor essential for the amplifier. An embodiment of the present invention includes: an amplification unit including a transistor; and a degeneration inductor having one end connected to a source terminal of the transistor and the other end connected to a ground terminal. A harmonic trap including a parasitic capacitor and a degeneration inductor due to parasitic capacitance existing in the transistor is formed. The harmonic trap is provided in the form of an amplifier for removing harmonics by allowing the harmonics generated in the amplifier to escape to the ground terminal connected to the degeneration inductor.

title_en: Programmable logic device and semiconductor device
abstract_en: According to the present invention, provided is a programmable logic device capable of realizing low power consumption while suppressing a reduction in operation speed. The programmable logic device of the present invention includes: a first circuit; a second circuit; a first transistor configured to control electrical connection between the first circuit and the second circuit in accordance with a potential of a gate; a first switch configured to control supply of a signal to a first node; a second switch configured to control supply of the signal to a second node; a second transistor having one of a source and a drain and a gate electrically connected to the first node, and the other of the source and the drain electrically connected to the second node; and a capacitor configured to hold the potential of the signal supplied to the first node.

title_en: Underwater Acoustic Radio Communication Device
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide an underwater acoustic wireless communication device for clarifying mutual communication by extracting only a voice signal. The underwater acoustic wireless communication device comprises: a control center transceiver (100) including a control microphone (110), a transmission/reception signal control unit (130), a sound transmission unit (140), a sound reception unit (150), an active filter unit (160), a control speaker (102), a power source (170), and an input display operation unit (180); and a diver transceiver (200) including a diver microphone (210), a diver transmission/reception signal control unit (230), a diver sound transmission unit (240), a diver sound reception unit (250), a diver active filter unit (260), a diver speaker (220), a diver power source (270), and a diver input display operation unit (280). According to the present invention, provided are a method and a device, capable of increasing the efficiency of information transmission by minimizing signal interference according to multiple paths that may occur underwater.

title_en: Bulk acoustic resonator
abstract_en: According to an embodiment, a bulk acoustic resonator may comprise: a resonance unit which comprises a first electrode positioned on a substrate, a piezoelectric layer positioned on the first electrode, and a second electrode positioned on the piezoelectric layer, and includes an active area in which the first electrode, the piezoelectric layer, and the second electrode overlap each other, and an outer area surrounding an edge of the active area; a first insertion layer overlapping the outer area along at least a portion of the edge of the second electrode; and a second insertion layer overlapping the outer area along at least a portion of the edge of the first electrode. The first insertion layer and the second insertion layer may include materials different from each other.

title_en: Full-angle single-mode reflectors of elastic waves
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present invention is to provide an omnidirectional single mode reflector of an elastic wave capable of reflecting only an elastic wave of the same mode as an incident wave mode regardless of an incident condition of the elastic wave by controlling reflectivity using a reflective scattering matrix. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the omnidirectional single-mode reflector of an elastic wave is provided at a solid boundary where an elastic wave including a longitudinal wave and a transverse wave is incident, and includes an anisotropic medium having a preset reflectance and formed as a reflector so that the incident elastic wave is reflected under an omnidirectional single-mode reflection condition; and physical properties of the anisotropic medium are calculated by applying a preset reflective scattering matrix, and the reflectance of the anisotropic medium is set to an omnidirectional single-mode reflection condition with the calculated physical properties of the anisotropic medium, thereby reflecting only the elastic wave in the same mode as the incident wave mode regardless of the incident condition of the elastic wave.

title_en: Successive Approximation Register for performing High Speed Operation and Analog Digital Converter of using the same
abstract_en: Disclosed are an SAR converter which converts an analog signal into a time-sequential digital signal, and an analog-to-digital converter for converting an N-bit data signal generated at each stage into an m×N-bit digital signal. The SAR converter stores the analog signal during an initial reset operation and converts the same into a digital signal through a comparison operation. While the SAR converter generates the digital signal, a residual voltage amplifier can amplify the analog signal from the SAR converter of the previous stage, thereby increasing the operating speed and reducing power consumption.

title_en: Receiver circuit, a semiconductor apparatus and a semiconductor system using the same
abstract_en: The receiving circuit may include a first amplification stage and a second amplification stage. The first amplification stage may generate a first output signal by differentially amplifying a pair of input signals. The second amplification stage may generate a second output signal by amplifying the first output signal. The reception circuit may deactivate the first amplification stage after deactivating the second amplification stage.

title_en: Chopper amplifier with efficiently reduced inherent offset voltage and offset detection circuit included therein
abstract_en: Disclosed are a chopper amplifier in which an internal offset voltage is efficiently reduced, and an offset sensing circuit included in the same. In the chopper amplifier of the present invention, the offset sensing circuit senses an amplified offset voltage through a positive demodulation signal and a negative demodulation signal to generate an offset recognition signal and a polarity signal. In this case, the offset recognition signal is activated as the amplified offset voltage is out of a margin level range, and the logic state of the polarity signal depends on the polarity of the amplified offset voltage. The signal amplification circuit which amplifies the modulation voltage difference and generates the amplified voltage difference is driven to reduce the amplified offset voltage according to the activation of the offset recognition signal by reflecting the logic state of the polarity signal. As a result, according to the chopper amplifier of the present invention, the internal offset voltage embedded in the signal amplification circuit is efficiently reduced.

title_en: Apparatus and Method for Controlling Power Amplifier in Low Earth Orbit Satellite Network
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, a method for controlling a power amplifier in a low-orbit satellite network comprises the steps of: allowing a terminal to communicate with a satellite; setting an initial applied voltage and a frequency; receiving orbit information from the satellite; and updating the initial applied voltage according to a network environment.

title_en: Initial control voltage generating circuit for voltage-controlled oscillator and phase-locked loop circuit
abstract_en: An object of the present application is to provide an initial control voltage generation circuit for a voltage controlled oscillator capable of shortening a time required for a control voltage to reach a final value during an initialization period even when a transistor corner is not typical. The initial control voltage generation circuit generates an initial control voltage and provides the initial control voltage to a voltage controlled oscillator. The initial control voltage generation circuit comprises: a resistor arranged between a supply voltage terminal and an output node to which the initial control voltage is outputted; and a transmission gate resistor arranged between the output node and a ground voltage terminal. According to various embodiments, the advantage is provided that it is possible to shorten the time required for the control voltage to reach the final value during the initialization period even when the transistor corner is not typical.

title_en: Modulator and modulation method using non-uniform 16-symbol signal constellation for low-density parity check codeword having 2/15 code rate
abstract_en: A modulator and a modulation method using a non-uniform 16-symbol signal constellation are disclosed. The modulator includes a memory and a processor. The memory receives a codeword corresponding to a low-density parity check (LDPC) code having a code rate of 2/15. The processor maps the codeword to 16 symbols of the non-uniform 16-symbol signal constellation on a 4-bit basis.

title_en: Asymmetrical trigger
abstract_en:
FIELD: pulse engineering. 
     SUBSTANCE: asymmetric flip-flop contains first and second transistors of one type of conductivity, an additional third transistor of another type of conductivity, which is a dynamic load for the second transistor, power bus and common bus, input and output of the device and six resistors. Economical nature of the asymmetric trigger is provided by the fact that in static modes one of the output transistors is closed and the through-current flowing through them from the power bus to the common bus is close to zero. Speed is provided by the fact that load capacity is recharged through low resistance of open transistor at formation of both front and rear fronts of output pulse. This circumstance provides high steepness of fronts of output pulse, and low resistance of channels of open output transistors provide approximation of levels of output signals to potentials of power bus and common bus. 
     EFFECT: invention allows increasing operating speed and efficiency of an asymmetric trigger and improving the shape of its output signals. 
     1 cl, 2 dwg

title_en: Amplifying system based on vacuum tubes, configured to reduce the residual noise, and method for grounding thereof
abstract_en:
FIELD: electrical engineering. 
     SUBSTANCE: invention relates to amplifiers. To realise the technical result, an amplifying system is proposed, based on vacuum tubes, containing: a first power supply circuit; a first load amplification circuit based on vacuum tubes; a second power supply circuit and a second load amplification circuit based on vacuum tubes. The first grounding end does not have a direct electrical connection with the second grounding end, and each of the first grounding end and the second grounding end is electrically connected with the corresponding alternating current voltage grounding of the mains power supply via a resistor with a wire jumper and a zero resistance. 
     EFFECT: reduction in the residual noise. 
     15 cl, 15 dwg

title_en: Chaotic oscillator
abstract_en:
FIELD: physics. 
     SUBSTANCE: invention relates to radio engineering and can be used as a source of chaotic electromagnetic oscillations. Chaotic oscillation generator comprises resistor 1, bipolar element with capacitance 2, double-pole element with negative inductive resistance 3, double-pole element with inductance resistance 4, non-linear impedance converter 5 and linear current converter 6, wherein the nonlinear impedance converter comprises a first voltage amplifier, first, second and third resistors, first and second active four-terminal circuits and a first current generator, a bipolar element with a negative inductive reactance comprises a two-terminal element with an inductive reactance, third active four-terminal circuit, second and third current generators, linear current converter comprises transistor, second voltage amplifier, first and second current mirrors, fourth, fifth and sixth current generators. 
     EFFECT: technical result consists in expanding the capabilities of tuning the characteristics of the generated chaotic signal without changing the parameters of the energy-storing elements due to the fact that the chaotic attractor is modified without changing the nominal values of the reactive elements by changing the parameters of the transfer characteristic of the nonlinear impedance converter. 
     1 cl, 14 dwg

title_en: Differential amplifier on arsenide-gallium field-effect transistors
abstract_en:
FIELD: radio engineering. 
     SUBSTANCE: in a differential amplifier on arsenide-gallium field-effect transistors, current-stabilizing two-pole (7) contains first (11) and second (12) auxiliary field-effect transistors, gates of which are connected to first (6) bus of a power supply source, a source of first (11) auxiliary field-effect transistor is connected to first (6) bus of the power supply source through first (13) auxiliary resistor, a source of second (12) auxiliary field-effect transistor is connected to first (6) bus of the power supply source through second (14) auxiliary resistor, drains of first (11) and second (12) auxiliary field-effect transistors are connected to combined sources of first (4) and second (5) input field-effect transistors, wherein the second outputs of first (8) and second (9) load resistors are connected to a source of additional field-effect transistor (15), a gate of which is connected to a drain of second (5) input field-effect transistor, and a drain is connected to second (10) bus of the power supply source. 
     EFFECT: increase in the voltage gain. 
     4 cl, 8 dwg

title_en: HALF BRIDGE GaN CIRCUIT AND SLEW DETECT CIRCUIT
abstract_en: A half bridge circuit is disclosed. The circuit includes low side and high side power switches selectively conductive according to one or more control signals. The circuit also includes a low side power switch driver, configured to control the conductivity state of the low side power switch, and a high side power switch driver, configured to control the conductivity state of the high side power switch. The circuit also includes a controller configured to generate the one or more control signals, a high side slew detect circuit configured to prevent the high side power switch driver from causing the high side power switch to be conductive while the voltage at the switch node is increasing, and a low side slew detect circuit configured to prevent the low side power switch driver from causing the low side power switch to be conductive while the voltage at the switch node is decreasing.

title_en: Signal attached single firewire power control system and method
abstract_en: The present invention provides a signal attached single firewire power control system and method, comprising a linear regulator, a switch cutoff module, and a controller. The linear regulator is disposed between the input terminal and the output terminal to stabilize a minimum voltage difference between the input terminal and the output terminal. The switch intercepting module includes a MOSFET switch disposed between the input terminal and the output terminal, a driver connected to the MOSFET switch gate, and a voltage feedback control circuit connected to the driver. The controller outputs a pulse modulation signal to the driver according to the control command to output a control signal via the MOSFET switch, while the voltage feedback control circuit is powered by the single fire line circuit.

title_en: Systems and methods for analog computing using a linear photonic processor
abstract_en: Systems and methods for performing matrix operations using a linear photonic processor are provided. The linear photonic processor is formed as an array of first amplitude modulators and second amplitude modulators, the first amplitude modulators configured to encode elements of a vector into first optical signals and the second amplitude modulators configured to encode a product between the vector elements and matrix elements into second optical signals. The linear photonic processor may be configured to perform matrix-vector and/or matrix-matrix operations.

title_en: Signal receiving circuit, memory storage device and signal receiving method
abstract_en: A signal receiving circuit, a memory storage device and a signal receiving method are provided. The signal receiving circuit includes an equalizer module, a clock and data recovery (CDR) circuit and a controller. The equalizer module is configured to receive a first signal and compensate the first signal to generate a second signal. The CDR circuit is configured to perform a phase locking on the second signal. The controller is configured to open or close a pattern filter of the CDR circuit according to the second signal, wherein the pattern filter is configured to filter a signal having a specific pattern in the second signal.

title_en: Housing case for crystal oscillator
abstract_en: A housing case for a crystal oscillator monitors a film thickness of a thin film to be formed on a surface of the crystal oscillator, the monitoring being performed by measuring a resonance frequency during film formation in a vacuum atmosphere. The housing case has: a case main body having disposed on an upper surface thereof a plurality of first recessed parts each being capable of housing therein a crystal oscillator in a horizontal posture with a main surface thereof facing in an up-and-down direction; a first cap body detachably mounted on the case main body from an upper side thereof; and an engaging means for engaging the first cap body relative to the case main body. The engaging means is so constructed and arranged that, in a state in which the first cap body is engaged with the case main body, the crystal oscillators housed in the first recessed parts are restrained from jumping out of position.

title_en: Device and method to reduce distortion in amplifier and system having amplifier circuit
abstract_en: A device to reduce distortion in an amplifier includes an input transistor configured to generate a voltage based on an input signal. The device further includes a diode connected transistor that is configured to sink the current. The diode connected transistor includes an output terminal, and a control terminal, where the output terminal is coupled to a control terminal. The device further includes a current source circuit that coupled to the control terminal. The device additionally includes an impedance element that coupled to the output terminal at a first node and to the control terminal and the current source circuit at a second node.

title_en: Ranging systems and methods for decreasing transitive effects in multi-range materials measurements
abstract_en: A measurement system includes a gain chain configured to amplify an analog input signal; a range selector configured to select a gain between the analog input signal and a plurality of analog-to-digital converter (ADC) outputs from a plurality of ADCs, wherein each ADC output has a path, and a gain of each output path is made up of a plurality of gain stages in the gain chain; and a mixer configured to combine the plurality of ADC outputs into a single mixed output.

title_en: Composite logic gate circuit including a simple logic gate circuit, a first PMOS transistor and a first NMOS transistor
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a composite logic gate circuit, which includes: a simple logic gate circuit including a first logic gate circuit and an inverter circuit, a first PMOS transistor and a first NMOS transistor. The first logic gate circuit is configured to receive a first input signal and a second input signal, and to output the first output signal. The inverter circuit includes a second PMOS transistor and a second NMOS transistor. The second PMOS transistor has a source coupled to a power input terminal, a drain coupled to a drain of the second NMOS transistor, and a gate configured to receive the first output signal. The second NMOS transistor has a source coupled to a ground terminal, and a gate configured to receive the first output signal. The first PMOS transistor has a source coupled to the drain of the second PMOS transistor, a drain coupled to a drain of the first NMOS transistor, and a gate configured to receive a third input signal. The first NMOS transistor has a source configured to receive the first output signal, and a gate configured to receive the third input signal. The simple logic gate circuit is an AND gate circuit or an OR gate circuit. The first logic gate circuit is an NAND gate circuit or an NOR gate circuit.

title_en: Computer -implemented system, device and method for improved estimation of codewords
abstract_en: A device is disclosed. The device may include an input buffer to receive a first low bit width message. A reconstruction circuit may implement a reconstruction function on the first low bit width message, producing a first high bit width message. A computation circuit may implementing a computation function on the first high bit width message, producing a second high bit width message. A quantization circuit may implementing a quantization function on the second high bit width message, producing a second low bit width message. A decision buffer may then store the second low bit width message. The reconstruction function and the quantization function may vary depending on an iteration and a layer of the device.

title_en: Amplifier
abstract_en: An amplifier includes an amplifier circuit and a gain adjustment circuit. The amplifier circuit has a design gain and a real gain and is configured to output an output signal according to an input signal and the real gain. The gain adjustment circuit is coupled to the amplifier circuit and is configured to compare a voltage of the input signal with a first reference voltage, wherein when the voltage of the input signal is exceeded the first reference voltage, the gain adjustment circuit rises the real gain of the amplifier circuit, so that the real gain approaches the design gain.

title_en: Filter integrated circuit
abstract_en: The present invention provides a filter integrated circuit including an acoustic wave filter chip and a matching circuit. The acoustic wave filter chip is covered upon a substrate. The matching circuit is arranged on the substrate to provide matching impedance to the acoustic wave filter chip. A first pad and a second pad of the matching circuit are connected to a first signal terminal and a second signal terminal of the acoustic wave filter chip, respectively. The first terminals of a first coil inductor and a second coil inductor of the matching circuit are connected to the first pad and the second pad of the substrate, respectively. The first coil inductor is adjacent to the second coil inductor so that mutual inductance and a parasitic capacitance are formed, so that the matching circuit and the acoustic wave filter chip jointly generate a transmission zero point in the triple frequency range of a baseband.

title_en: Mems resonator sensor substrate for plasma, temperature, stress, or ‎deposition sensing
abstract_en: Embodiments disclosed herein include diagnostic substrates and methods of using the diagnostic substrates to extract plasma parameters. In an embodiment, a diagnostic substrate comprises a substrate and an array of resonators across the substrate. In an embodiment, the array of resonators comprises at least a first resonator with a first structure and a second resonator with a second structure. In an embodiment, the first structure is different than the second structure.

title_en: Reconfigurable baseband filter
abstract_en: Wireless signal processing may be improved by using a configurable baseband filter (BBF) in the receive path of a transceiver. A configurable BBF may accommodate processing of different wireless signals in a single integrated circuit (IC) chip. For example, a single IC may support processing of 5G mm Wave RF signals and 5G sub-7 GHz RF signals by reconfiguring the BBF with settings appropriate for the different wireless signals. The reconfiguring of the BBF may include adjusting a bandwidth of the BBF and/or adjusting a filter order of the BBF. The reconfiguring of the BBF may be performed in response to detection of jammer signals to improve rejection of the jammer signals.

title_en: State detection circuit for detecting tri-state and state detection method thereof
abstract_en: A state detection circuit for detecting whether a state of an input node is floating, grounded, or electrically connected to an external voltage includes: a unidirectional device circuit and a discriminator circuit. The unidirectional device circuit is configured to operably electrically conduct a test node to a detection node unidirectionally. The detection node is coupled to the input node. The test node, the unidirectional device circuit, the detection node and the input node form a current path. The discriminator circuit is configured to operably discriminate a state of the input node according to a voltage level of the detection node. Within a detection step, the state detection circuit provide a test voltage at the test node. A voltage of the detection node is determined by the characteristics of the state of the input node, the test voltage, and the unidirectional device circuit.

title_en: Output stage of ethernet transmitter
abstract_en: An output stage of an Ethernet transmitter is provided. The output stage is coupled to a resistor and includes a first output terminal, a second output terminal, a first transistor, and a first transistor group. The resistor is coupled between the first output terminal and the second output terminal. The first transistor has a first source, a first drain, and a first gate, the first source being coupled to a first reference voltage and the first drain being coupled to the second output terminal. The first transistor group is coupled to the first reference voltage and the first output terminal. The first transistor group includes multiple transistors which are connected in parallel, and the magnitude of the current flowing to the first output terminal is related to the number of transistors that are turned on.

title_en: Pulse width modulation controller and control method thereof
abstract_en: A PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) controller includes a current detector, a current emulator, a voltage-to-current converter, and a current adder. The current detector detects a first current, and generate a second current according to the first current. The current detector receives an input voltage and outputs an output voltage. The current emulator obtains relative information of a lower-gate current. The voltage-to-current converter draws a third current from the current emulator according to the input voltage and the output voltage. The current emulator generates a fourth current according to the relative information and the third current. The current adder adds the fourth current to the second current, so as to generate a sum current.

title_en: Package comprising an acoustic device and a cap substrate comprising an inductor
abstract_en: A package that includes an acoustic device, a frame coupled to the acoustic device and a cap substrate coupled to the acoustic device through the frame. The acoustic device includes a substrate and an acoustic element coupled to the substrate. The cap substrate includes an inductor. The cap substrate is configured as a cap for the acoustic device. The package includes a cavity located between the acoustic device and the cap substrate. The frame may include a polymer frame.

title_en: Real number sine/cosine wave basis function transforming circuit
abstract_en: A real number sine/cosine wave basis function transforming circuit includes a window cutting unit, first and second transforming elements, and a root-sum-squares element. The window cutting unit used to cut an in-phase output signal and a quadrature signal in to an in-phase window signal and a quadrature window signal. The first and second transforming elements respectively transform the in-phase window signal and the quadrature window signal with the real number sine/cosine wave basis function to obtain the first and second transforming signal. The root-sum-squares element calculates a root-sum-squares value of the first and second transforming signal to output a real sine/cosine wave basis function transforming signal.

title_en: Random number generating circuit
abstract_en: A random number generating circuit is provided, which includes a noise-voltage generator, configured to convert an external voltage into a noise voltage; a voltage-controlled oscillator, configured to receive the noise voltage, and generates a first clock signal according to the noise voltage; a ring oscillator, configured to generate a sample clock signal; and a D flip-flop, configured to receive the first clock signal, and sample the first clock signal using the sample clock signal to obtain an output digital signal, wherein the output digital signal represents a random number.

title_en: Interfacing device and signal transceiving method thereof
abstract_en: An interface device and a signal transceiving method thereof are provided. The interface device includes a master circuit and a slave circuit. The slave circuit includes a second receiver, a clock generator, a sampler, and a comparator. The first receiver and second receiver respectively receive input data and a clock signal from the master circuit. The clock generator delays the clock signal according to a delay value to generate a delayed clock signal, and generates a plurality of sampling signals according to the delayed clock signal. The sampler samples the input data according to the sampling signals to generate a plurality of sampling results. The comparator compares the sampling results to generate a comparison result. The clock generator adjusts the delay value according to the comparison result.

title_en: Filter and filter manufacturing method
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a filter and a filter manufacturing method, wherein the filter comprises a resonator, a bottom plate and a frame, and the resonator is welded and connected to the bottom plate; the frame forms a through cavity, the bottom plate is welded and connected to one end of the cavity, and the resonator is located in the cavity; the frame comprises a first material, the resonator comprises a second material, the bottom plate comprises a third material, and the first material is different from the third material.

title_en: Glitch-free low-pass filter circuit and system circuit using the same
abstract_en: A glitch-free low-pass filter circuit has an integrating circuit, a Schmitt trigger, a first feedback logic circuit and a second feedback logic circuit. The integrating circuit is used to integrate an input signal to generate an integral signal. The Schmitt trigger is used to receive the integrated signal and generate a hysteresis signal according to the integral signal. The first feedback logic circuit is used for pulling the integral signal down to a reset voltage or up to the set voltage according to an inverted input signal and an inverted hysteresis signal, wherein the inverted input signal is generated by performing an inversion processing on the input signal, and the inverted hysteresis signal is generated by performing the inversion processing on the hysteresis signal. The second feedback logic circuit is used for pulling the integral signal down to the reset voltage or up to the set voltage according to the inverted hysteresis signal and an output signal of the low-pass filter circuit, wherein the output signal is the hysteresis signal is generated by performing twice inversion processing on the hysteresis signal.

title_en: Decoder circuits for the transmission of video media using spread spectrum direct sequence modulation
abstract_en: The present invention relates generally to video or other media transmission, and more particularly, to encoding and decoding of video media that has been transmitted between a video source and a video sink using spread spectrum direct sequence (SSDS) modulation.

title_en: Regulator and operation method thereof
abstract_en: A regulator includes a pre-regulator circuit, a pump circuit, an output stage circuit, and a tracking circuit. The pre-regulator circuit generates a pre-regulated voltage according to an input voltage. The pump circuit generates a pumped voltage according to the pre-regulated voltage and a tracking voltage. The output stage circuit generates an output voltage according to the pumped voltage and the power voltage. The tracking circuit tracks the output stage circuit to generate the tracking voltage and transmit the tracking voltage to the pump circuit.

title_en: Packaged electronic device
abstract_en: A latching relay includes a supply terminal, a load terminal, first and second coupling circuits, a latch circuit, first and second transistors, and a local supply node coupled to a capacitor. In one example, the supply terminal is coupled to a supply node and the load terminal is coupled to the load. The first and second transistors control the conductivity of a drive transistor coupled to the load. A microcontroller controls the latching relay to switch the load on and off. To enable the load, the microcontroller sinks current from the supply terminal and through the first coupling circuit. While the load is enabled, the capacitor is discharged. The latching relay is operable in a refresh mode in which current is pulsed through the first coupling circuit causing capacitor to be re-charged from the supply terminal. To disable the load, the microcontroller sinks current through the second coupling circuit.

title_en: Amplifier and method for controlling the same
abstract_en: The present application discloses an amplifier and a method for controlling the same. The amplifier includes a first P-type transistor, a second P-type transistor, a first N-type transistor and a second N-type transistor cascode-connected. At a first amplification stage, an AC component of a first input signal is amplified into a first amplified signal at a drain of the first P-type transistor. The second P-type transistor then amplifies the first amplified signal and an AC component of a second input signal and outputs at an output terminal.

title_en: Clock correction method and clock correction circuit
abstract_en: A clock correction method is provided in present disclosure. The clock correction method is suitable for a communication device comprising a clock correction circuit, which is configured to receive a fast clock and a slow clock. The clock correction method comprises: in response to the communication device being enabled and entering an active mode, calculating, by the clock correction circuit, a clock-period ratio according to the slow clock and the fast clock; in response to the communication device operating in a power-saving mode for a power-saving period, calculating the number of at least one rising edge of the slow clock received by the clock correction circuit during the power-saving period, as a cumulative number of slow clock periods; in response to the communication device switching from the power-saving mode to the active mode, calculating the difference between the internal time of the communication device and the reference time of another communication device as a time offset; and adjusting, by the clock correction circuit, the clock-period ratio according to a compensation value in the active mode, wherein the compensation value is related to the clock-period ratio, the cumulative number of slow clock periods and the time offset.

title_en: Clock control circuit and method
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a clock control circuit and method for a circuitry. The circuitry includes a scan flip-flop circuit, an at-speed domain and a timing exception domain. The scan flip-flop circuit is configured to output data towards the at-speed domain and the timing exception domain. The clock control circuit includes a first gate control circuit, a first gate circuit, a second gate control circuit and a second gate circuit. The first gate circuit is configured to block or output a clock signal to the scan flip-flop circuit by the control of a first control signal outputted by the first gate control circuit, a scan enable signal and a scan mode signal. The second gate circuit is configured to block or output an output signal of the scan flip-flop circuit to the timing exception domain by the control of a second control signal outputted by the second gate control circuit.

title_en: Transmitting device, digital predistorter and predistortion method thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed is a transmitting device, comprising, a multi-mode digital predistorter circuit configured to pre-compensate an input baseband signal in one of a plurality of digital predistortion modes according to a selection signal, a power amplifier configured to amplify the pre-compensated baseband signal and output the amplified baseband signal as an output signal of an allocated band, and a digital predistortion mode selector circuit configured to determine the one of the plurality of digital predistortion modes corresponding to the allocated band using a feedback signal obtained from the output signal, and set the multi-mode digital predistorter circuit to the one of the determined modes.

title_en: Control circuit and control method therefor
abstract_en: The control circuit comprises a first circuit, a second circuit and a control unit. The first circuit for receiving a first power source includes a first switch and a first output terminal, and the first switch includes a first control terminal. The second circuit for receiving a second power source includes a second switch, a second output terminal and a pour-back preventing element, and the pour-back preventing element is coupled between the second output terminal and the second switch. The second switch includes a second control terminal, and the first output terminal and the second output terminal are coupled to an input terminal of a device. The control unit has an output terminal coupled to the first control terminal and the second control terminal to output a control signal to the first control terminal and the second control terminal. When the control signal is switching status such that the first switch is turned on while the second switch is not completely turned off, the pour-back preventing element prevents the first power source pouring back to the second circuit via the input terminal of the device and the second output terminal.

title_en: Method for fast turn off and recovery of regulated outputs
abstract_en: Disclosed is bias circuitry for an amplifier. The bias circuitry (10) includes a bias generator (12) having a bias generator output terminal (14), and a switch having a bias input terminal (28), an amplifier bias output terminal (24), a bias shunt terminal, and a switch control terminal. The switch is configured to switch a bias generated by the bias generator to the amplifier bias output terminal in response to a connect bias signal received at the switch control terminal and to switch from the amplifier bias output terminal to the bias shunt terminal in response to a disconnect bias signal. An overvoltage detector (38) is configured to monitor a supply voltage to the amplifier and in response to generate the disconnect bias signal when the supply voltage exceeds a reference voltage and to generate the connect bias signal when the supply voltage level is less that the reference voltage.

title_en: Amplification circuit
abstract_en: Provided is an amplification circuit capable of maintaining high efficiency even when a second harmonic load deviates from an optimum value in a J-class operation. The present technology provides an amplification circuit comprising: an amplifier that amplifies to output a signal; a superimposing unit that is connected to at least one of an input terminal or an output terminal of the amplifier and superimposes a fundamental wave signal of the signal and a second harmonic signal that is a signal having a frequency twice that of the fundamental wave signal; and a matching circuit that is connected to the output terminal and generates a waveform signal of a J-class operation by applying loads corresponding to the respective signals to the fundamental wave signal and the second harmonic signal.

title_en: Power amplifier compression compensation circuit
abstract_en: A power amplifier compression compensation circuit is disclosed. In one aspect, a power amplifier chain may have a compression detection circuit at an output of the power amplifier chain. Responsive to detecting compression at the output, a variable gain control circuit may adjust the gain of an earlier amplifier in the power amplifier chain. The gain adjustment allows changes to be made more efficiently than adjusting a bias for amplifier stages. Both amplitude and phase compression may be addressed by aspects of the present disclosure.

title_en: Receiving module of transmission interface
abstract_en: A receiving module of a transmission interface is provided. The receiving module of the transmission interface includes an analog front-end (AFE) circuit and a track-and-hold circuit. The AFE circuit is used to receive an input signal to generate a first intermediate signal. The track-and-hold circuit is used to sample the first intermediate signal according to a first clock to generate a second intermediate signal, and comprises at least a first switch, at least a second switch, at least a first capacitor, and at least a second capacitor. The first switch and the second switch are turned on or off according to the first clock. The first capacitor has a first terminal and a second terminal, wherein the first terminal is coupled to the AFE circuit, and the second terminal receives a second clock. The second capacitor has a third terminal and a fourth terminal, wherein the third terminal is coupled to the AFE circuit, and the fourth terminal receives the second clock. The first clock and the second clock are inverse signals of each other.

title_en: Coupling biasing device and power adjustment method for communication circuit
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a coupling biasing device, which is a biasing device structure for a communication circuit. The coupling biasing device includes a body having a first surface, a second surface, and a through hole, a first wire arranged on the first surface in a fixed shape, and a second wire arranged in the through hole, where the second wire is electrically connected to the communication circuit, and is electrically connected to an external power supply through the first wire, so that the coupling biasing device and the communication circuit are coupled, thereby achieving a purpose of adjusting a communication bandwidth of the communication circuit.

title_en: Signal processing system and method thereof
abstract_en:
A signal processing system includes an adjustable filter, a signal difference calculating unit, a determining unit and a selecting unit. The adjustable filter is configured to receive a digital signal outputted from an analog-to-digital converter, and filter the digital signal to generate a filtered signal. The signal difference calculating unit is configured to calculate and output a signal difference value between the digital signal and the filtered signal. The determining unit is configured to compare the signal difference value with a predetermined threshold value, to generate a comparison result, and generate a selection signal and a bandwidth adjustment signal according to the comparison result. The selecting unit is configured to receive the digital signal and the filtered signal, and output one of the digital signal and the filtered signal according to 
the selection signal. The bandwidth of the adjustable filter can be adjusted according to the bandwidth adjustment signal.

title_en: Clocked comparator and method thereof
abstract_en: A clocked comparator and method thereof are provided. The clocked comparator includes an upper-side sampling latch, a lower-side sampling latch, and a decision-arbitrating latch. The upper-side sampling is latch configured to output a first decision in accordance with a detection of a sign of an input voltage signal plus an offset voltage at an edge of a clock signal. The lower-side sampling latch is configured to output a second decision in accordance with a detection of a sign of the input voltage signal minus the offset voltage at the edge of the clock signal. The decision-arbitrating latch is configured to receive the first decision and the second decision and output a final decision in accordance with whichever one of the first decision and the second decision that is resolved earlier.

title_en: Esd protection circuit and esd protection method
abstract_en:
An electrostatic discharge (ESD) protection circuit (for a protected device in a semiconductor system, the protected device being coupled between a first node and a first reference voltage) includes: an ESD device coupled between the first node and the first reference voltage; a logic block including a first input and an output, the first input being coupled to a second reference voltage, and the output being coupled to an input of the ESD device and a feedback control circuit 
coupled between the first node and a second input of the logic block.

title_en: Gate drive apparatus and control method
abstract_en: An apparatus includes a capacitive device configured to provide bias power for a high-side switch, a gate drive path having variable resistance connected between the capacitive device and a gate of the high-side switch, wherein the gate drive path having variable resistance is of a first resistance value in response to a turn-on of the high-side switch, and the gate drive path having variable resistance is of a second resistance value in response to a turn-off of the high-side switch, and wherein the second resistance value is greater than the first resistance value, and a control switch connected between the gate of the high-side switch and ground.

title_en: Transceiver circuit
abstract_en: A transceiver circuit is provided. The transceiver circuit includes a transceiver antenna, a transmitter circuit, a receiver circuit, a frequency synthesizer and a baseband circuit. The transmitter circuit is used to transmit a radio frequency signal corresponding to a radio frequency through the transceiver antenna. The frequency synthesizer is used to provide a first local oscillation signal and a second local oscillation signal having a first local oscillation frequency and a second local oscillation frequency, respectively. The baseband circuit operates in a transmitter mode and a receiver mode. In the transmitter mode, the frequency synthesizer provides the first local oscillation signal, and in the receiver mode, the frequency synthesizer provides the second local oscillation signal, the first local oscillation frequency is a non-integer multiple of the radio frequency, and the second local oscillation frequency is an integer multiple of the radio frequency.

title_en: Distributed crc polar codes
abstract_en: A method comprising: determining a cyclic redundancy check (CRC) generator sequence defining a one to one mapping between a sequence of control information values and cyclic redundancy check (CRC) sequence values; and determining a combined sequence, the combined sequence formed by distributing the cyclic redundancy check (CRC) value sequence within the sequence of control information values, wherein the distributing the cyclic redundancy check (CRC) value sequence within the sequence of control information values is based on a selected part of the cyclic redundancy check (CRC) generator sequence.

title_en: Method and apparatus for offset correction in sar adc with reduced capacitor array dac
abstract_en: Offset correction in a differential successive approximation register (SAR) analog-to-digital converter (ADC) is accomplished with a capacitor-reduced digital-to-analog converter (DAC) topology to enable offset correction without the need for a dedicated compensation DAC. This eliminates addition analog circuitry and die area. To perform the offset correction, the differential SAR ADC couples together inputs thereof to create an offset voltage, converts the offset voltage into a digital representation thereof, stores the digital representation of the offset voltage in an offset register, and corrects for the offset voltage by generating an offset compensation voltage with the capacitor-reduced array DAC controlled by the digital representation stored in the offset register. The digital representation controls scaling of reference voltages to the reduced capacitor array DAC associated with a least-significant-bit (LSB) of the differential SAR ADC.

title_en: Slew rate control device and slew rate control method
abstract_en: A slew rate control device and a slew rate control method are provided. The slew rate control device includes a signal generation circuit, a comparison circuit, and a control circuit. The signal generation circuit is used to generate a first voltage signal and a second voltage signal both having a slew rate, and the first voltage signal and the second voltage signal are a pair of differential signals. The comparison circuit is used to output an enabling signal according to the relative position relationship between the eye crossing point of the pair of differential signals and the signal edge of the reference clock. The control circuit is used to generate at least one control signal according to the enabling signal to control the signal generating circuit, so that the signal generating circuit can change the slew rate of the first voltage signal and the second voltage signal according to the at least one control signal.

title_en: Bulk-acoustic wave resonator
abstract_en: A bulk-acoustic wave (BAW) resonator is provided. The BAW includes a substrate, a first electrode disposed on the substrate, a piezoelectric layer disposed to cover at least a portion of the first electrode, and a second electrode disposed to cover at least a portion of the piezoelectric layer, wherein the piezoelectric layer includes an intermediate layer, a first layer disposed above the intermediate layer and a second layer disposed below the intermediate layer, the first layer and the second layer are symmetrical in relation to a plane through which a central line of the intermediate layer passes in a thickness direction, and a thickness of the intermediate layer is greater than a thickness of each of the first and second layers.

title_en: An error amplifier and a pulse width modulation circuit
abstract_en: An error amplifier for a pulse width modulation circuit is described. The amplifier includes an operational amplifier configured as an integrator and a feedback loop coupled between a signal output of the operational amplifier and an inverting input of the operational amplifier. The feedback loop comprises a feedback capacitor coupled to the signal output, a feedback resistor coupled to the feedback capacitor, and an integrator resistor coupled to the feedback resistor and the inverting input of the operational amplifier. A junction between the feedback resistor and the integrator resistor is configured to receive an input signal and a junction between the feedback capacitor and the feedback resistor is configured to receive a feedback signal from the pulse width modulation circuit.

title_en: High frequency multilayer filter
abstract_en: A high frequency multilayer filter may include a plurality of dielectric layers and a signal path having an input and an output. The multilayer filter may include an inductor including a conductive layer formed over a first dielectric layer. The inductor may be electrically connected at a first location with the signal path and electrically connected at a second location with at least one of the signal path or a ground. The multilayer filter may include a capacitor including a first electrode and a second electrode that is separated from the first electrode by a second dielectric layer. The multilayer filter has a characteristic frequency that is greater than about 8 GHz.

title_en: Digital to analog converter circuit
abstract_en: A digital to analog (DAC) circuit that performs least significant bit (LSB) dithering comprises: a first DAC; an auxiliary code generator configured to produce an auxiliary code; an auxiliary DAC configured to receive the auxiliary code and convert the auxiliary code into an analog version of the auxiliary code; and summing circuitry to dither LSBs of the first DAC with the auxiliary code. The auxiliary code generator is configured to update the auxiliary code at a rate less than a sampling rate of the DAC circuit, the auxiliary code has a smaller range than that of a range of binary-weighted LSBs of the first DAC and/or the auxiliary code generator is configured to produce the auxiliary code as a predetermined repeating sequence.

title_en: True complement dynamic circuit and method for combining binary data
abstract_en:
A true complement dynamic circuit (100) for combining, in particular comparing, binary data on dynamic first and second input signals (80, 82) to third and fourth input signals (84, 86), comprising at least a 1-bit compare circuit (130), wherein the dynamic first and second input signals (80, 82) are complementary signals during an evaluation phase, wherein a logical behavior is determined by the third and fourth input signals (84, 86).
        A method for operating a true complement dynamic circuit (100) for combining, in particular comparing, binary data on dynamic first and second input signals (80, 82) to third and fourth input signals (84, 86), comprising operating at least a 1-bit compare circuit (130), wherein the dynamic first and second input signals (80, 82) are complementary signals during an evaluation phase, determining a logical behavior by the third and fourth input signals (84, 86).

title_en: Piezoelectric vibration device and manufacturing method of piezoelectric vibration device
abstract_en:
The present invention provides a piezoelectric vibration device and a manufacturing method of piezoelectric vibration device that allow gas in a holding member to be exhausted without increasing takt time. The manufacturing  
method of piezoelectric vibration device includes: a member-with-sealing-material preparation step S110 for prepare a cover member 10 or a holding member 2 with a sealing material 11, the sealing material 11 being formed with a rectangular frame shape in a planar view and being provided, in any one of the cover member 10 and the holding member 2, on at least a part of a portion to contact the other one, and at least one corner portion 11c of the sealing material 11 having a thickened portion thicker than the portions other than the corner portion 11c; a cover member mounting step S120 for mounting the cover member 10 on the holding member 2 in which the piezoelectric element 7 has been bonded by bringing the thickened portion into contact with the other one; a temporary fixing step S130 for heating the cover member 10 which has been mounted on the holding member 2, to melt a part of the thickened portion to temporarily fix the cover member 10 and the holding member 2 together; and a sealing step S140 for melting the sealing material 11 containing the thickened portion to seal the cover member 10 and the holding member 2.

title_en: Solid-state image pickup element, image pickup apparatus, and method of controlling solid-state image pickup
abstract_en:
Image quality is to be improved in a solid-state image pickup element that performs time delay integration.
A correlated double sampling circuit generates a frame in which a predetermined number of lines each including a plurality of digital signals are arranged. A TDI frame memory retains a (K - 1)-th frame generated before a K-th frame. A time delay integration circuit performs time delay integration processing of adding the line having a predetermined address in the K-th frame and the line having an address at a certain distance from the predetermined address in the (K - 1)-th frame.

title_en: Semiconductor die
abstract_en: A semiconductor die includes a processing circuit, a first bond pad, and a second bond pad. The first bond pad is electrically connected to a first node of the processing circuit and a first bond wire. The second bond pad is electrically connected to a second node of the processing circuit and a second bond wire. The first bond wire and the second bond wire are magnetically coupled to form a first bond wire T-coil circuit with equivalent negative inductance.

title_en: Impedance adjusting circuit and impedance adjusting method for zero quotient calibration
abstract_en: An impedance adjusting circuit and an impedance adjusting method for zero quotient (ZQ) calibration. The impedance adjusting circuit includes a reference resistor, a pull-up impedance generator, a controller and a detection circuit. The reference resistor is coupled between a sensing node and a low reference voltage. The pull-up impedance generator is coupled to an external voltage.
