abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a data processing chip, a system and a data storage forwarding processing method, wherein the data processing chip comprises a data processing unit and at least one interconnection storage controller, the at least one interconnection storage controller comprises a first interconnection storage controller and a second interconnection storage controller, the data processing unit is respectively connected with each interconnection storage controller in the at least one interconnection storage controller, each interconnection storage controller is respectively correspondingly connected to a memory, and the data processing chip reads and writes data to the memory through the interconnection storage controller and realizes data exchange with other data processing chips. The embodiment of the invention reduces the cost of the data processing chip, the realization difficulty and cost of the data processing system and the complexity and time of data processing.

title_en: Low power operation for flash memory systems
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a circuit and method for low power operation in a flash memory system. In the disclosed embodiments of selecting a decoding circuit path, pull-up and pull-down circuits are used to save values at certain output nodes during a power-save or shutdown mode, allowing the main power supply to be shut down while still maintaining the values.

title_en: Data processing method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a data processing method and a device, which receive a plurality of pieces of data from a data source, wherein each piece of data carries a time stamp, judge whether each piece of data received in a first preset period is delayed according to the time stamp of each piece of data and a preset rule, separately count undelayed data and delayed data, count undelayed data received in the first preset period in real time, store delayed data, count delayed data at regular time, and combine the real-time data counting result and the delayed data counting result of the same window. Each combination is the repair of the real-time statistical result, the statistical result tends to be accurate in each combination, and the real-time performance and the accuracy of the statistical result are met.

title_en: Intelligent interaction processing method, device, equipment and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a processing method, a processing device, processing equipment and a computer storage medium for intelligent interaction. The method comprises the following steps: performing intention recognition on a preorder feedback item returned to a user; continuing to return a subsequent feedback item to the user based on the intent of the preceding feedback item. The invention can guess the subsequent intention of the user based on the preorder feedback items, can continuously return the needed postorder feedback items to the user without the operation of the user, is more intelligent and abundant, and simplifies the operation of the user.

title_en: Electromagnetic interference signal detection
abstract_en: In one embodiment, an apparatus includes an electrode coupled to a body of a user and configured to receive a signal from the body. The received signal is based on an electromagnetic interference signal generated by an object external to the apparatus. The apparatus also includes one or more processors coupled to the electrodes. The processor is configured to detect, based on the signals received by the electrodes, one or more of: an interaction between a user and an object, an identity of an object, or a scene surrounding the device.

title_en: Safe virtualized service flow tracking method
abstract_en: The invention provides a safe virtualized service process tracking method, which comprises the following steps: creating a virtualized sandbox program aiming at the business process, simulating the interactive processing process among network elements in each business processing process, generating a visual program operation diagram, recording interactive data and generating a data packet; according to the tracking task, a virtualized sandbox program sends and stores data packets generated by instruction exchange among network elements in a system log; the tracking system includes: the system comprises a virtualization sandbox program, a data receiving module and a data storage module. The program flow chart generated by the sandbox program in real time is sent to the storage system in real time and covers the previous flow chart; the data storage module runs completely independently of the virtual sandbox program.

title_en: Three-dimensional flow field multivariable data visualization method based on polyhedral pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flow field multivariable data visualization method based on a pipeline, and belongs to the field of flow field data visualization in scientific calculation visualization. The method of the invention visualizes the three-dimensional flow field multivariable data by constructing a colorful polyhedral pipeline. The method comprises the following basic steps: calculating a flow line, constructing a polyhedral pipeline along the flow line, visualizing the flow field vector direction through the shape of the pipeline, and then visualizing a plurality of scalar attribute data on the side surface of the pipeline through color mapping, thereby realizing the combined visualization of the scalar attribute data and the flow field vector data. The flexibility of multivariate correlation analysis on the three-dimensional flow field is increased, and the efficiency of visual analysis on multivariate data is improved.

title_en: Apparatus and method for transferring data between address ranges in memory
abstract_en: Apparatus and methods are provided for transferring data between address ranges in memory. The apparatus includes a data transfer controller that performs a transfer operation to transfer data from at least one source address range in memory to at least one destination address range in memory in response to a data transfer request received by the apparatus from the processing element. The redirection controller is then arranged to: while the transfer operation is being performed, an access request specifying a target address within the target address range is intercepted and a memory redirection operation is performed such that the access request is processed without waiting for the transfer operation to complete. By such a method, the device can effectively hide the fact that a transfer operation is being performed from the source of the access request, and thus the transfer operation can be arranged to occur in the background and in a manner transparent to the software executing on the source that has issued the access request.

title_en: Method and device for acquiring three-dimensional simulation map entity hot zone attribute information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for acquiring attribute information of a hot zone of a three-dimensional simulation map entity, wherein the method comprises the following steps: generating a overlooking color block, a hot area and a hot area color block of the building model in advance, keeping the overlooking color block consistent with the visual angle of a field collected image and carrying out spatial registration with the overlooking color block; acquiring pixel values of overlooking color blocks, and performing attribute association on the overlooking color blocks and geographic coordinate points corresponding to the building model; acquiring pixel values of the hot area color blocks, and performing attribute association on the hot area and the hot area color blocks; and performing attribute association on the hotspot and the corresponding geographic coordinate point of the building model, so that the hotspot acquires the attribute value of the geographic coordinate point. According to the method, assignment and association can be directly carried out in a space coordinate matching mode, the attribute information of the hot area is automatically added, and the problem that the attributes cannot be matched due to the fact that the geographic positions of the geographic coordinate points of the hot area and the building model are not matched is effectively solved, so that the workload of manually adding the hot area information is reduced, and the working efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Magnetic memory signal characteristic research method
abstract_en: A magnetic memory signal characteristic research method belongs to the technical field of magnetic memory signal detection of ferromagnetic materials, and particularly relates to a magnetic memory signal characteristic research method based on an FLAPW algorithm. The invention comprises the following steps: step 1): establishing a magnetomechanical model; step 2): using a FLAPW full-potential linear infixing and plane wave method; also included are calculated charge density and atomic magnetic moment portions that verify model accuracy.

title_en: Story context generation method based on event association in social network
abstract_en: The invention provides a story context generation method based on event association in a social network. Fig. 1 shows a flow chart of the process of the present invention, which mainly includes three stages. Firstly, event detection is carried out, and strongly related events are detected from microblog streams; then assembling a story through the associated events; and finally, generating and displaying the story venation of each story.

title_en: Policy analysis method and device, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a policy analysis method, a policy analysis device, a terminal device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring policy information of each policy from a policy database; constructing a policy relation network; setting a unique sub-network number for each policy relationship network; writing the sub-network number into the personal information of the insurance salesman related to the policy relation network according to the identity identification information; acquiring personal information of each insurance salesperson from a salesperson database; constructing a salesman relationship network; and analyzing the fraud risk of insurance salespeople according to the relationship network of the salespeople. According to the technical scheme, the established relation network of the service staff and the connection between the sub-network number and the insurance policy relation network are established, so that the identification rate of group cheating insurance risks participated by insurance sales staff is improved, and cheating insurance behaviors colluded by the insurance sales staff and clients can be accurately and effectively identified, so that the cheating insurance risk identification rate of the insurance sales staff is improved.

title_en: Mars entering terminal state efficient evaluation method based on intelligent learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a Mars terminal entering state efficient evaluation method based on intelligent learning, and belongs to the technical field of deep space exploration. The method utilizes a Mars entering trajectory optimization algorithm to optimize the maximum terminal height which can be reached by the spacecraft under different parameter combinations so as to provide sample data of a prediction model based on Gaussian process regression. The genetic algorithm is used for an optimization solver of the entering track in different scenes to avoid a local minimum value, and further ensure the data quality of a training sample in the Gaussian process. And the mean function, the kernel function and the hyper-parameter are used as main parameters of the Gaussian process and are selected as optimization parameters to describe the correlation among the samples, so that a Mars entering optimal terminal height prediction model based on the Gaussian process is established. The invention can complete the evaluation of the maximum terminal height under different entering scenes of more than 3000 groups within dozens of seconds, and the average relative error is within 4 percent.

title_en: Android permission management method and device, terminal and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a management method of android permission, which comprises the following steps: receiving an operation instruction, and comparing the operation instruction with a permission related instruction set of a preset system to judge whether the operation instruction is a target permission related instruction in the permission related instruction set; if so, acquiring an application identifier of the target authority related instruction for applying the authority, and calling a preset authority frame; inputting the application identifier into a preset authority frame, determining target authority information corresponding to the application identifier, and judging whether a user triggering the operation instruction has authority corresponding to an authority request according to the target authority information; and if the user triggering the operation instruction has the corresponding authority of the authority request, executing the operation instruction. The invention also discloses a management device, a terminal and a computer storage medium for the android permission. According to the invention, the permission related code in the application is written into the preset permission frame, so that the android permission management is more convenient.

title_en: User portrait construction method and device, terminal and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method, a device, a terminal and a computer readable storage medium for constructing a user portrait, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring original data from a preset service system and a medium; mining and modeling the original data to acquire label data corresponding to the original data; performing data image processing on the tag data according to a preset marketing theory and a big data classification method to obtain user portrait information with multiple dimensions, wherein the user portrait information with multiple dimensions comprises at least one of the following information: a base image, a behavior image, a product image, and a channel image. The invention can realize the services of improving the stock user value and realizing the user insights, product design, accurate marketing and the like of the scenes in the stock through the constructed user portrait with high quality and high efficiency, supplements the blank of improving the stock operation value, and ensures the data resource circulation sharing mode between a telecom operator and a third-party partner and the like through the established user portrait to be mutually beneficial and win-win.

title_en: Public opinion data visualization method and equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a public sentiment data visualization method and equipment, the scheme is after gathering the public sentiment data, confirm the emotion classification and the time information of every public sentiment data earlier, then according to the emotion classification and the time information of public sentiment data, confirm the quantity of the public sentiment data that belong to the target emotion classification in every preset time quantum, and obtain the keyword of the public sentiment data that belong to the target emotion classification in every preset time quantum, and then according to the quantity of the public sentiment data that belong to the target emotion classification in every preset time quantum, generate the visual figure about every preset time quantum, and add corresponding keyword in the visual figure. Since the emotional tendency, the quantity and the related keywords of the public opinion data in the preset time period are intuitively represented in the visual graph, the user can comprehensively and efficiently know the public opinion condition in the preset time period by looking up the visual graph.

title_en: Image processing method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to an image processing method, an image processing device, a computer device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining an image to be processed, inputting the image to be processed into a trained image de-occlusion model, generating at least one intermediate image with different scales from the image to be processed by the trained image de-occlusion model, extracting features of the image to be processed and the plurality of intermediate images by the trained image de-occlusion model to obtain a plurality of feature images, fusing the feature images to obtain a fused feature image, generating a current residual image by the trained image de-occlusion model according to trained model parameters and the fused feature image, generating the trained model parameters by adopting residual learning training on the image de-occlusion model, outputting the de-occlusion image by the trained image de-occlusion model according to the current residual image and the image to be processed, and improving the de-occlusion effect of the occlusion image to obtain a more accurate de-occlusion image.

title_en: Method, device and equipment for coloring multi-target area in picture and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for coloring multi-target areas in a picture, wherein the method comprises the following steps: carrying out graying processing on a picture to be colored to obtain a grayscale image; selecting a plurality of color standard diagrams for carrying out different color designs on the picture to be colored; coloring the gray level images respectively through the selected multiple color standard images; identifying and segmenting a plurality of colored target areas; and fusing the divided target areas to the corresponding positions of the picture to be colored. According to the method and the device, a plurality of target areas in the picture to be colored are colored by utilizing a plurality of existing color standard pictures with coordinated colors, the color information of the plurality of target areas in the picture to be colored is changed, a large amount of time is saved, the colors of the pictures are not too monotonous, the coloring diversity and flexibility are realized, and different design requirements are met.

title_en: Communication device, linking method and communication system
abstract_en: In order to establish a link quickly and reliably, an idle signal generation circuit generates an idle signal when a communication apparatus detects power-on or link-off. Then, the I/F circuit transmits the idle signal to the communication apparatus as a communication partner through the selection circuit. Further, the I/F circuit transmits and receives the learning signal to and from the communication apparatus as a communication partner. The step 1 learning circuit, the step 2 learning circuit and the step 3 learning circuit establish a link by using the learning signal. When a signal indicating that the link has been established is not received from the link detection circuit, the reset mask circuit sends the reset signal generated by the reset signal generation circuit to the step 1 learning circuit, the step 2 learning circuit, and the step 3 learning circuit to make them learn again.

title_en: Method and device for storing crash information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for storing crash information, wherein the method comprises the following steps: under the condition that the system is determined to be abnormally restarted, the first watchdog is controlled to reset the CPU; after the CPU is reset, setting a first watchdog and a second watchdog as a hardware feeding mode, and storing dead information into a flash memory; the second watchdog is configured as a dongle, and all devices of the whole board are reset if the second watchdog is overtime. The invention effectively solves the technical problem that the crash information cannot be effectively saved under the condition of abnormal crash restarting of the system in the prior art, so that the follow-up failure cannot be effectively analyzed, and achieves the technical effect that the crash information can be effectively saved under the condition of serious crash of the system.

title_en: Single-pixel imaging method based on adaptive area projection
abstract_en: A single-pixel imaging method based on adaptive area projection is used for improving the speed of single-pixel imaging. The method comprises the steps of firstly, projecting transverse and longitudinal sine stripes to an object by utilizing a stripe projector to obtain a two-dimensional Fourier coefficient of a required scene image; then, obtaining the projection of the scene image on the horizontal and vertical axes in the image domain by the Fourier slice principle; then, determining the size and the position of the object region in the scene by using an edge extraction algorithm; and finally, performing single-pixel imaging on the region where the object is located, and reconstructing an object image. The method can automatically adjust the position and the size of the imaging area according to the size of the object area, further reduce the imaging time and greatly improve the imaging speed under the condition of unchanged imaging quality.

title_en: Four-season-type person automatic distinguishing method based on person face image feature analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for automatically judging people in four seasons based on character facial image feature analysis, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of firstly, selecting four key facial regions including skin, eyes, lips and eyebrows based on a digital image of a face region; secondly, selecting four seasonal samples for the four face key areas respectively according to the established person image database labeled with the seasonal types; thirdly, comparing the color of each key area of the image to be detected with the color similarity of corresponding area samples of four season types in sequence by using an area color similarity algorithm based on a color histogram and a gray average value, and respectively obtaining the season type of each key area of the character; and fourthly, comprehensively analyzing the season types of the four key areas to obtain the final season type of the figure whole. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of automatic discrimination, objective analysis, accuracy, high efficiency and the like.

title_en: Burning method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a burning method provided by the embodiment of the invention, which comprises the following steps: responding to the triggering operation of a user, and sending a burning instruction to the lower computer so as to enable the lower computer to burn the product to be burned; acquiring the burning state information of the product to be burned from the lower computer, and determining whether the product to be burned is burned successfully; and when the product to be burned is burned successfully, controlling the identification device to identify the product which is burned successfully. The method can be better classified after the burning of the product is successful, and the products with successful burning and failed burning can be more easily distinguished, so that the confusion of the products with successful burning, unsuccessful burning and failed burning is avoided. In the embodiment of the invention, the automatic burning and marking process is realized, the burning efficiency is improved, and the burning efficiency is greatly improved by adopting the burning method.

title_en: IOT equipment control interface display method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a display method, a system, equipment and a storage medium of a control interface of IOT equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps that a user side obtains a first image related to the IOT equipment and sends the first image to a control center, and the control center identifies an equipment identification number through a set machine learning algorithm model; if the control center successfully identifies, the control center returns the equipment identification number, and the user side displays a corresponding control interface; if the control center fails to recognize, the control center returns an equipment identification number list, the user side selects an equipment identification number according to a user instruction and sends a first image storage signal to the control center, the control center stores a first image recognized by the user into an image training set, and the image training set comprises images marked with the equipment identification number and is used for training a machine learning algorithm model. The invention automatically displays the control interface of the IOT equipment through image recognition, and solves the problem that the manual searching of the equipment control interface is difficult and complicated caused by the increase of the IOT equipment.

title_en: Business software development method and device and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention is suitable for the technical field of software development and discloses a method, a device, terminal equipment and a storage medium for developing service software, wherein the method comprises the following steps: generating one or more process nodes based on one or more process node templates selected by a user according to a service function required to be realized and process node template parameters configured for the process node templates by the user; the process node template is obtained by analyzing various service requirements and performing abstract induction; and connecting each flow node by adjusting the processing logic sequence of the flow node to generate a business flow chart and a business flow configuration file corresponding to the business flow chart. The embodiment of the invention can reduce the development and maintenance difficulty of the service software, effectively improve the development efficiency, reduce the technical threshold of the development and maintenance of the service software and save the development cost.

title_en: MRI brain tumor image segmentation method based on multi-feature discrimination
abstract_en: A multi-feature-discrimination-based MRI brain tumor image segmentation method relates to an MRI brain tumor image segmentation technology, and aims to meet the development requirement of the multi-feature-discrimination-based MRI brain tumor image segmentation technology. Firstly, obtaining a multi-modal brain tumor vision difference image, and performing super-pixel segmentation on the vision difference image; then extracting multiple features from the super-pixel segmentation result and constructing a discrimination capability formula to obtain a weighted feature matrix; and finally, obtaining a final segmentation result by using a sparse representation segmentation algorithm. The invention can reduce the correlation between the tumor and the normal brain tissue in the segmentation algorithm according to the weighting characteristic matrix constructed by the multiple characteristics, and can obtain a better image segmentation result.

title_en: System and method for developing architectural design of electronic devices and manufacturing electronic devices
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention provide systems and methods for developing electronic architecture designs for electronic devices and manufacturing electronic devices. Exemplary systems and methods described by embodiments of the present invention selectively choose from one or more standard cells and/or one or more standard cell variations to form an electronic architecture design for analog circuits and/or digital circuits of an electronic device. In an example embodiment, a semiconductor foundry and/or a semiconductor technology node may impose one or more electronic design constraints on placing one or more standard cells onto an electronic device design real estate. In some cases, some of the one or more standard cells may not satisfy one or more electronic design constraints when arranged onto an electronic device real estate. In these cases, one or more standard cell modifications corresponding to these standard cells are arranged on the electronic device substrate face.

title_en: Descriptor-based PCIE bus DMA controller and data transmission control method
abstract_en: The invention provides a descriptor-based PCIE bus DMA controller and a data transmission control method, which comprise the following steps: the system comprises a TLP sending engine, a TLP receiving engine, an interface access control module, a DMA transmission control module, a descriptor access control module, a multi-DMA channel control module, a control state register and a DMA channel buffer. The DMA transmission process of the DMA controller designed by the invention is completely controlled and realized by the descriptor, thereby improving the data bandwidth and the transmission efficiency; the DMA data transmission can be configured with a plurality of DMA channels, and the priority, the transmission trigger threshold value and the overtime time of each DMA channel can be programmed, so that the data transmission real-time performance of a specific channel can be ensured while the data transmission is transmitted according to the high and low priorities; the uploading/issuing data cache of all DMA channels can realize dynamic management, realize multichannel DMA concurrent transmission and ensure the use efficiency of DMA transmission bandwidth.

title_en: HDFS file access authority control method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for controlling the access authority of an HDFS file, which comprises the following steps: receiving an access request aiming at an HDFS file sent by a user side; judging whether the HDFS file has a corresponding Hive table or not; if yes, judging whether the user has corresponding access authority to the Hive table or not based on the access request; if the user has the access right of the Hive table corresponding to the access request, accepting the access request; and if the user does not have the access right of the Hive table corresponding to the access request, rejecting the access request. The invention also discloses HDFS file access authority control equipment and a storage medium. The method and the device can avoid user permission expansion caused when the user does not have Hive permission but belongs to the user group of the HDFS file, thereby improving the safety of the HDFS file.

title_en: Forest fire automatic detection method and device based on deep neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire automatic detection method based on a deep neural network, which comprises the following steps: fitting the training sample image, obtaining a fitted image set after fitting, and seeking a combined image; acquiring an optimal digital combination in the combined image; fitting an image to be detected to obtain an initial processing image; selecting a candidate region of an initial processing image by adopting a self-adaptive threshold segmentation method, and segmenting the candidate region to obtain a suspected fire image; and constructing a convolutional neural network model based on spatial scale HOG pooling, inputting the suspected fire image into the convolutional neural network model, and if two or more fires exist, determining that the to-be-detected image has a fire point. The invention also provides a forest fire automatic detection device based on the deep neural network. The invention trains and creates the tree-shaped CNN model through the multi-channel fused fusion image set, thereby obtaining the probability of fire, and having high precision.

title_en: System and method for identifying products
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for at least partially automatically identifying, in particular for depreciating, checking for uniqueness and/or checking for authenticity, a product (10), wherein in at least one detection step (12) at least one representation of the product (10) is recorded, which in at least one checking step (14) is compared with at least one reference representation of the product (10) in an original state, wherein the presence of at least one feature (16) added to the product (10) relative to the original state is checked.

title_en: Memory system and control method
abstract_en: The application provides a memory system and a control method capable of selectively utilizing a plurality of areas corresponding to different kinds of interfaces. When a read request received from a host includes a first identifier representing a first region, a memory system of an embodiment obtains logical addresses from the received read request, and obtains physical addresses corresponding to the obtained logical addresses from a logical-physical address conversion table managing mapping between respective logical addresses and respective physical addresses of the one first region, and reads data from the one first region based on the obtained physical addresses. When the received read request contains a second identifier representing a second area, the memory system obtains physical address information from the received read request and reads data from the second area based on the obtained physical address information.

title_en: Evaluation method for electronic work spreading degree, computer storage medium and terminal
abstract_en: The invention provides an evaluation method of electronic work spreading degree, a computer storage medium and a terminal, which realize the evaluation of the electronic work spreading degree by analyzing the ductility and the effectiveness of manuscripts. The invention not only detects whether the manuscript is deleted, but also detects whether the manuscript is reprinted and the validity on the network, thereby more comprehensively and more accurately evaluating the network transmission degree of the manuscript. On the other hand, compared with the prior art that the network propagation degree of the manuscript is judged by detecting the reply number and the reading number of the manuscript, the evaluation method provided by the invention is not easy to control manually or tamper intentionally, so that the evaluation result is more real and credible, thereby helping a client judge the effectiveness of the manuscript propagation on a website and better reasonably allocating budget.

title_en: Processing text neural networks
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to processing text neural networks. Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on a computer storage medium, for generating a data set associating each text segment in a vocabulary of text segments with a respective digital embedding. In one aspect, a method includes: providing a search query including the text segment to an image search engine; obtaining image search results that have been categorized as being responsive to the search query by the image search engine, wherein each image search result identifies a respective image; for each image search result, processing the image identified by the image search result using a convolutional neural network, wherein the convolutional neural network has been trained to process the image to generate an image digital embedding for the image; and generating a digital embedding for the text segment from the image digital embedding for the image identified by the image search result.

title_en: Digital reading guiding equipment for children
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital reading guide device for children, which comprises: the device comprises an extraction unit, a data acquisition unit, a primary screening unit, a secondary screening unit and an arrangement display unit. According to the invention, books can be automatically screened according to interests and hobbies of the children, and books can be read according to the guidance of the same-age people and other children older than one year, so that the books read by the children are beneficial and proper, and the books can be guided, so that the children form a correct reading view; in addition, after the age of the children increases and a correct reading view is formed, the device can reduce the influence of non-subjective factors in the process of screening books according to the age, and the recommended books are ensured to meet the requirements of users.

title_en: Device under test verification device and related product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application can accurately and quickly verify all instructions in the instruction sequence of the device to be verified, determine the position of the instruction causing the error, and improve the efficiency of machine state verification.

title_en: Intelligent equipment fault monitoring method based on event map technology
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent equipment fault monitoring method based on an event atlas technology, which can learn historical data and current data and provide maintenance suggestions and fault early warning for equipment maintenance, and the method comprises the following steps: s10: constructing an event map through historical data analysis, wherein the event map comprises event elements, and the event elements form a network-shaped event map through event relations; the event element comprises a core node and an event attribute; s20: comparing the current equipment state with the event attributes in the event map, and matching the current equipment state with the event attributes to corresponding core nodes and event elements; s30: updating an event map in real time, and learning new faults and new states of the equipment and corresponding maintenance schemes; s40: judging the current equipment fault condition according to the event element, analyzing the equipment fault generation reason and providing a maintenance scheme; s50: and predicting the possible faults of the current equipment according to the relation between the event elements in the event map and the event elements, and giving fault early warning.

title_en: Image registration method and system, storage medium and terminal
abstract_en: The invention provides an image registration method and system, a storage medium and a terminal, comprising the following steps: acquiring calibration parameters and optimized calibration parameters of a left image sensor and a right image sensor; calibrating the left and right images acquired by the left and right image sensors according to the calibration parameters and the optimized calibration parameters; detecting feature points of the calibrated left and right images; acquiring description information of the feature points; and matching the characteristic points according to the description information so as to realize image registration. The image registration method and system, the storage medium and the terminal can quickly register the left image and the right image by utilizing the left image sensor and the right image sensor, and meet the requirement of quickly acquiring the scene of the three-dimensional information of the images.

title_en: Microphone selection and multiple speaker segmentation with ambient Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR)
abstract_en: The disclosed method and system relate to determining an optimal microphone pair and dividing a sound signal. The methods and systems may include receiving a set of sound signals including speech and/or background noise from one or more audio sources (e.g., conference participants). The method and system may include calculating TDOA and determining an optimal microphone pair based on TDOA and via robust statistics. The method and system may also include segmenting sound signals from multiple sources.

title_en: Method for sensing end of speech and electronic device implementing the method
abstract_en: An apparatus and method are provided, various embodiments of which include: a microphone; a memory; and a processor functionally connected to the microphone or the memory, wherein the processor is configured to: counting an End Point Detection (EPD) time based on the voice input; when the EPD time expires, determining whether a last word of the speech input corresponds to a previously configured word stored in the memory; and if the last word corresponds to the previously configured word, extending the EPD time and waiting for receipt of voice input. In addition, other embodiments are possible.

title_en: Analysis method for swing high-speed jet characteristic of underwater engine spray pipe
abstract_en: The invention discloses an analysis method for the swing high-speed jet characteristic of an underwater engine spray pipe, which comprises the steps of establishing a geometric model of the underwater solid rocket engine spray pipe, establishing a fluid calculation domain, carrying out geometric optimization on an interface of the two fluid calculation domains, arranging interface between the calculation domains for data transmission, realizing simulation of the swing working condition of the spray pipe, carrying out grid division on the flow domains in blocks, and carrying out grid independence verification to obtain the optimal grid number; importing the obtained final grid file into a FLUENT solver, setting and solving boundary conditions, adopted calculation models and calculation methods; by carrying out numerical simulation analysis and post-processing on numerical calculation results, the flow characteristics of the swinging high-speed jet of the rocket engine nozzle are accurately simulated and analyzed, the flow law and mechanism of the swinging high-speed jet of the nozzle are disclosed, a theoretical basis is provided for the structural design of the engine nozzle launched by the underwater powered missile, and the practical engineering application problem of launching of the underwater powered missile is solved.

title_en: Method, device and equipment for detecting wearing of safety helmet in construction site and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for detecting the wearing of a safety helmet on a construction site, wherein a safety helmet wearing detection model is trained according to a construction site image sample and marking information comprising human head position marking and safety helmet type marking, an image to be detected is input into the safety helmet wearing detection model, and the human head position information in the image to be detected and safety helmet type information corresponding to the human head position information are obtained and output.

title_en: Light spot edge fitting method
abstract_en: The invention provides a facula edge fitting method, which extracts laser facula edge images; passing the edge pixel points to fit the circle center of the circle to form concentric circles; finding out two tangent lines of which the outer points are led out to concentric circles and making a secant; solving the residual square sum from the out-of-circle point to the secant and converting the form into a polar coordinate form; and obtaining the value of the corresponding parameter when the sum of squares of the residual errors is minimum, namely the circle center value. The method is a facula edge fitting method based on an improved least square method, algebra and a geometric method are combined, and a residual square term in the least square circle fitting method is constructed by utilizing a geometric principle, so that the fitting precision of the central position of a facula is improved, and the problems that the conventional least square circle fitting method converts fitting parameter solving into linear algebra, the facula edge fitting process is not considered from the geometric angle, incomplete consideration is caused, the facula fitting effect is poor, and the accuracy and the certainty are difficult to evaluate are solved.

title_en: Eye ground image recognition model training method, eye ground image recognition method and eye ground image recognition device
abstract_en: The invention provides a fundus image recognition model training method, a fundus image recognition method and equipment, wherein the fundus image recognition model training method comprises the following steps: acquiring training data, wherein the training data comprises a first fundus image sample, a second fundus image sample and a third fundus image sample, and the second fundus image sample and the first fundus image sample are fundus images of the same eye; the third fundus image sample and the first fundus image sample are different eye fundus images; identifying the first fundus image sample, the second fundus image sample and the third fundus image sample by using a fundus image identification model to obtain a loss value; and adjusting parameters of the fundus image recognition model according to the loss value.

title_en: Pipeline safety coefficient generation method and device based on radial basis function neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a pipeline safety coefficient generation method and a pipeline safety coefficient generation device based on a radial basis function neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring defect parameters and risk parameters of a pipeline; and generating the safety coefficient of the pipeline by using the defect parameters, the risk parameters and a pre-established safety coefficient generation model based on the radial basis function neural network. The invention can provide a method for more accurately calculating the pipeline safety coefficient by utilizing the abundant data resources of the pipeline big data and combining the advantage of deep learning of a radial basis network method.

title_en: Semantic retrieval method for industrial fault information rapid matching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semantic retrieval method for quickly matching industrial fault information, which comprises the following steps of: step one, performing word segmentation indexing and word frequency statistics on an original document; training by using a word bag model, a local difference of words and a training algorithm; step three, classifying and filing the industrial parts; inputting documents, and calculating the document with the closest distance through a matrix distance algorithm; and step five, screening and sorting the selected result documents again by combining the industrial fault information, and returning solution documents according to the index. The invention aims at improving the matching accuracy and the matching speed by the method for realizing the industrial fault matching.

title_en: Selective track state estimation fusion method for local track dimensionality division
abstract_en: The invention discloses a selective track state estimation fusion method for local track dimensionality. The method reads and preprocesses the local flight path, and performs time alignment and space alignment; splitting the local track according to the latitude, calculating the track quality under the single latitude by utilizing a track quality measurement algorithm based on the gray approximate association degree, and sequencing the track quality according to the dimensionality; setting cycle times, selecting the number of single-latitude tracks according to track quality, carrying out track state estimation fusion on the two high-quality single-latitude tracks to obtain a fused track, and determining a system track; when the track quality of the fused track is greater than that of a high-quality single-latitude track, the method realizes selective fusion of local tracks, realizes track selection through an algorithm structure after dimension splitting, and improves the precision of a system track generated by fusion after a simple convex combination fusion method of multiple sensors of the local tracks and the local tracks is adopted.

title_en: Speech phoneme recognition method and device, storage medium and electronic device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for recognizing speech phonemes, a storage medium and an electronic device. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: extracting a plurality of first voice features which are in one-to-one correspondence with a plurality of voice frames from the plurality of voice frames which are sequenced according to the time sequence; determining a plurality of key voice features from the plurality of first voice features, wherein the probability that each key voice feature corresponds to one phoneme in the phoneme set is greater than or equal to a target probability threshold; determining a voice feature set corresponding to each key voice feature, wherein each voice feature set comprises the corresponding key voice feature and one or more voice features adjacent to the corresponding key voice feature in the plurality of first voice features; respectively carrying out feature fusion on the voice features in each voice feature set to obtain a plurality of fused voice features, wherein each voice feature set corresponds to one fused voice feature; the phonemes corresponding to each fused speech feature are separately identified in the phoneme set.

title_en: Magnetic memory, magnetic memory recording method, and magnetic memory reading method
abstract_en: Provided is a magnetic memory which can record multi-value information in a memory cell (10) while suppressing an increase in manufacturing cost, the memory comprising: first and second tunnel junction elements (100 a, 100 b), respectively, the first and second tunnel junction elements (100 a, 100 b) having a stacked structure including a reference layer (202) having a fixed magnetization direction, a recording layer (206) having a reversible magnetization direction, and an insulating layer (204) sandwiched between the reference layer and the recording layer; a first select transistor (300), the first select transistor (300) being electrically connected to first ends of the first and second tunnel junction elements; a first wire (400 a), the first wire (400 a) being electrically connected to the second end of the first tunnel junction element; and a second wiring (400 b), the second wiring (400 b) being electrically connected to a second end of the second tunnel junction element.

title_en: Motor signal compensation method, electronic device, and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a motor signal compensation method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring an original signal and a nonlinear parameter of a motor; calculating a compensation signal of the original signal according to the acquired nonlinear parameter of the motor and a compensation formula; the calculated compensation signal is transmitted to the motor to excite the motor to vibrate. The invention also discloses an electronic device and a storage medium. According to the motor signal compensation method, the original signal is compensated by combining the nonlinear parameter, so that the actual vibration effect of the motor after the compensation signal is obtained is closer to the expected effect, and the touch experience more consistent with the expectation is further obtained.

title_en: Large signal modeling method of double-active full-bridge converter under double phase-shift modulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large signal modeling method of a double-active full-bridge converter under double phase-shift modulation, which aims at a DAB converter under double phase-shift modulation, establishes an accurate discrete iteration model of the converter, then obtains a state matrix and an input matrix of a large signal equivalent circuit based on a state transfer function in a discrete domain and by utilizing a Baker-Campbell-Hausdorff theorem, and constructs a large signal equivalent circuit model of the converter. The invention overcomes the defects of the traditional discrete iterative model, unifies the mathematical model and the circuit model, intuitively reflects the coupling relation and the control-output transfer function of each variable of the system, and provides a new idea for the related research work of the double-active full-bridge (DAB) converter in control, stability analysis and the like.

title_en: Molten iron slagging-off detection method based on lightweight convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a molten iron slagging-off detection method based on a lightweight convolutional neural network, which comprises the following steps: collecting a molten iron slagging video with preset duration from an industrial site for molten iron slagging; extracting a preset number of pictures from the collected molten iron slag removing video to construct a training data set; labeling each picture in the constructed training data set to obtain corresponding label data; and training the training data set by using the lightweight network model, detecting the real-time collected molten iron slag removing pictures at intervals by using the trained lightweight network model, and monitoring the molten iron slag removing condition in real time. The method has better anti-interference capability, improves the detection precision of the molten iron and the desulfurized slag in the molten iron slagging-off process, can effectively detect the molten iron and the desulfurized slag, and can effectively identify the inner package wall of the molten iron and the slagging-off device; the real-time performance can meet the actual monitoring requirement while the molten iron slagging-off process can be stably detected, and the method has great application value in the production process.

title_en: Data processing method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a data processing method, a data processing device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring target data; acquiring subdata of target data on at least two dimensions; obtaining marking information of target subdata on one or more dimensions in subdata on at least two dimensions; and setting the marking information of the target subdata as the marking information of the subdata on other dimensions corresponding to the target subdata. According to the method and the device, a plurality of training data with labels can be obtained through one-time labeling, so that the labeling efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: EC reset circuit and electronic equipment based on USB C type interface
abstract_en: The invention discloses an EC reset circuit based on a USB C-type interface, which relates to the technical field of electronic circuits and comprises a detection circuit and a control circuit, wherein the input end of the detection circuit is in communication connection with external equipment through a USB data line and is used for receiving a forced reset signal output by the external equipment, the output end of the detection circuit is connected with a starting signal end and an enabling signal end of a power chip for supplying power to the EC through the control circuit, so that after the detection circuit receives the forced reset signal, the starting signal of the starting signal end and the enabling signal of the enabling signal end are pulled down through the control circuit, and the power connection of the EC is disconnected. The embodiment of the invention also discloses electronic equipment comprising the EC reset circuit based on the USB C-type interface. The embodiment of the invention can complete forced reset only by means of a USB C-type interface.

title_en: Method and terminal for creating shortcut
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a terminal for creating a shortcut, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving a first input aiming at a target application; in response to the first input, displaying a shortcut included by the target application in a target position of a first interface where the target application is located; receiving a second input for selecting a target shortcut and selecting a creation location of the target shortcut, the target shortcut being at least one of the shortcuts; and responding to the second input, and creating and displaying the target shortcut at the creating position. According to the scheme of the invention, the shortcut is quickly created, so that a user can conveniently and quickly create the shortcut of any target application, the desktop is more ordered, and the user experience is improved.

title_en: Existing building outer wall optimization application method based on reflective coating and vertical greening
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimized application method based on a reflective coating and vertical greening on an existing building outer wall. The method comprises the following steps: the first step is to construct a numerical heat transfer model for each facing wall using different techniques and calculate its temperature and thermal flow fields. And the second step is to optimize the multi-target particle swarm by taking the minimum wall load and the minimum cost as two objective functions to obtain the pareto front. The third step is to choose the optimal solution for all non-dominant solutions, i.e. feasibility schemes, entropy weight-gray correlation-TOPSIS decisions. And finally, calculating the overall ecological benefit of the scheme. The invention can apply the building outer facade cooling technology mainly comprising high reflection coating and vertical greening to the reconstruction of the existing building enclosure structure, and the whole method has the advantages of simplicity, rapidness and effectiveness, and the obtained final optimization scheme gives consideration to the advantages of wall energy conservation, investment economy and ecological benefit.

title_en: Memristor-based noninductive four-dimensional chaotic system circuit design and implementation
abstract_en: The invention provides a memristor-based noninductive four-dimensional chaotic system circuit design and an implementation method, and belongs to the field of nonlinear electronic circuits. The method is characterized in that a first-order four-dimensional chaotic system is designed based on a three-time memristor model according to a classical Chua chaotic circuit structure; and then, the circuit is optimally designed, the required grounding inductance is equivalently replaced under the condition of protecting the circuit structure, and the realization of the memristor-based noninductive four-dimensional chaotic system circuit is finally constructed. The chaotic system has the characteristics of simple structure, stable and reliable circuit realization and rich nonlinear chaotic dynamics of related variables. Due to the non-linear property of memristors with memory and the noninductive property of system circuits, the memristor can meet the functional requirements in the aspects of data information encryption, secret communication and the like in various environments.

title_en: Bill detection method, device, equipment and storage medium based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence, and discloses a bill detection method, device, equipment and storage medium based on deep learning, the invention inputs the characters extracted after identifying the bill into the STN network, and carefully corrects the characters, thereby improving the accuracy of character identification and the efficiency of bill detection. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a bill picture to be detected; normalizing the bill picture to obtain a normalized picture; according to the convolutional neural network model, angle correction is carried out on the normalized picture, and an adjusted picture is obtained; according to a preset network model, extracting required text information from the adjusted picture to obtain a text picture with the text information; and correcting the text information in the text picture according to the STN model of the spatial transformation network, obtaining an output picture, wherein the output picture is provided with corrected characters.

title_en: Voice interaction method and device and robot
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of intelligent robots, and provides a voice interaction method, a voice interaction device and a robot, wherein the method comprises the following steps: enhancing a corresponding microphone in a microphone array according to the position of a user, receiving a voice instruction sent by the microphone to the user, determining a voice signal noise value of the voice instruction, determining a distribution mode of the voice instruction according to the voice signal noise value, and sending the voice instruction to a corresponding application program for processing according to the distribution mode. According to the embodiment of the invention, voice interaction can be directly carried out with the robot without a wake-up word, so that the voice interaction mode is simple and convenient, and the user experience is good.

title_en: Modeling method for NX involute deflection helical gear
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modeling method of an NX involute deflection helical gear, which is a self-defined feature (hereinafter referred to as UDF) based on NX; the UDF is a hobbing action, can support self-defined paired gear pair parameters, can support a deflection gear, can support arbitrary switching of a spiral direction of a helical gear, can support switching of active and passive gear parameters, can be compatible with deflection or non-deflection straight-tooth gears, can output gear pair backlash and gear manufacturing inspection parameters with different parameters and different manufacturing precision, can efficiently and stably model a cylindrical gear, and can generate a tooth part model with the average time of 2 to 4 seconds.

title_en: Information protection master station system and fault information archiving method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a security master station system and a fault information archiving method thereof, belonging to the field of comprehensive analysis of fault information of a relay security information master station. The method comprises the steps of receiving fault information sent by each substation, sending the fault information to a message receiving micro-service module through an ICE interface, and sending the received fault information to a kafka message bus by the message receiving micro-service module; the preprocessing micro-service module acquires fault information in the kafka message bus, acquires all associated fault information of the fault information according to the configuration information in the configuration library, and sends the associated fault information to the kafka message bus; the archiving micro-service module acquires each associated fault information in the kafka message bus by adopting the kafka stream processing technology, and archives the associated fault information with the same unique identification to form archive information. Each micro-service module can increase the processing speed of data by sharing the data in the kafka message bus, the information archiving speed is high, the data is not easy to lose, and the information archiving is more accurate.

title_en: Image processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an image processing method, an image processing device, image processing equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving a first image and first template identification information sent by a first terminal, fusing the first image and the first template identification information to obtain a first fused image, generating first fused image identification information of the first fused image and feeding the first fused image identification information back to the first terminal, so that the first terminal shares first co-shooting request information carrying the first fused image identification information to a second terminal; enabling the second terminal to acquire the first map based on the first map-fusing identification information; receiving a second image and second template identification information sent by a second terminal; fusing the two images to obtain a second fused image; sending a second fused image to a second terminal so that the second terminal synthesizes the first fused image and the second fused image to obtain a target synthetic image; and sharing the image synthesis information to the first terminal so that the first terminal obtains and displays the target synthesis image based on the image synthesis information. The invention realizes the co-shooting effect of the multiple users on the same frame of the fused graph and improves the social interaction and the interestingness of the fused graph.

title_en: Method for cutting coal wall and counting lump coal rate by 2D simulation fully-mechanized face roller
abstract_en: A method for cutting a coal wall and counting the lump coal rate by a 2D simulation fully-mechanized face roller is suitable for mining research. Setting data of ball elements and wall elements in software of a linear bonding model, generating the ball elements in the wall elements and establishing an initial simulation model; establishing an initial model of a previous uniaxial compression and Brazilian split test, determining a proportional relation between microscopic parameters of the model and macroscopic physical mechanical parameters of a coal body, and establishing an initial coal body model; generating a roller model, and endowing the roller with proper rotating speed and horizontal right-hand speed to cut the coal body model until cutting is completed; and (4) counting the coal lump rate of the model after cutting is finished, comparing the coal lump rate with the actual coal lump rate of the reference working face, and adjusting the rotating speed and the horizontal speed of the model drum until the coal lump rate of the model is the same as the coal lump rate of the actual working face. The simulation software can be directly used for counting the cutting lump coal rate of the working face, the operation is simple, and the problem of coal mining efficiency reduction caused by counting the lump coal rate in the working face is avoided.

title_en: Alloy liquid information monitoring system and collecting method
abstract_en: The invention provides a monitoring system and a collecting method of alloy liquid information, belonging to the technical field of automobile part manufacturing, wherein the alloy liquid is contained in a water drum, and the monitoring system comprises a processor, a switch, a control module, a position switch, a detection module, a prompting device and a radio frequency identification module, wherein the processor is electrically connected with the switch and is used for data acquisition, data interaction control and data storage and coding the information of the alloy liquid in each water drum; the control module and the radio frequency identification module are respectively electrically connected with the switch and are used for communicating with the processor; the detection module, the prompting device and the position switch are respectively and electrically connected with the control module and used for detecting the alloy liquid, providing position signals for the monitoring system and sending out prompting signals. The invention is used for solving the technical problems that manual recording is time-consuming and labor-consuming and the accuracy of recorded data cannot be ensured, and can meet the requirements of data size and instantaneity of big data analysis.

title_en: Prompt message pushing method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a prompt message pushing method, device and storage medium; the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target object and a current pushing period; performing prediction classification processing on the target object and the current pushing period, and determining the function use probability of the target object corresponding to at least one function in different use time periods; determining at least one commonly used function and one or more use times of the at least one commonly used function pair based on the at least one function and the function use probability; wherein the use time is the time when the common function is started; when the prompt information corresponding to the at least one common function is obtained, pushing the prompt information of the common function corresponding to each use time in the at least one common function to the terminal corresponding to the target object in each use time of the one or more use times. By the method and the device, the accuracy of pushing the prompt information can be improved.

title_en: Face region acquisition method and device, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a face region acquisition method, a face region acquisition device, terminal equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: face detection is carried out on the current image to determine each face frame area; human body segmentation detection is carried out on the current image to determine each human body area; according to the face frame areas and the human body areas, the face standard areas are marked in the face frame areas so as to correct the current image according to the face standard areas, the technical problem that the obtained face areas are not accurate enough in the prior art, and therefore the image processing effect is affected is solved, and the face standard areas are marked in the face frame areas according to the face frame areas and the human body areas so as to correct the current image according to the face standard areas, so that the accuracy of the face areas is improved, and the image processing effect is guaranteed.

title_en: Method and system for multi-state machine event driven intelligent cabinet circulation information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for multi-state machine event driven intelligent cabinet circulation information, and belongs to the field of information management. Aiming at the problems of high cost and high difficulty in the transformation of the business process in the document circulation process in the prior art, the invention provides a method and a system for event-driven intelligent cabinet circulation information of multiple state machines, wherein the multiple state machines activate and send deaf respective state machine processing results by event-driven buses to publish and subscribe events. The invention can reduce the coupling performance of the system and the subsequent iteration transformation cost in the design and system level, can adapt to follow-up depending on external equipment, improves the expandability of the system, reduces the integration difficulty and improves the efficiency, can adapt to hardware to mark the whole process, and ensures the integrity and the safety of document circulation data.

title_en: Computer heat radiator installed on computer case
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of computer equipment, and particularly discloses a computer heat dissipation device installed on a computer case, which comprises a case with a computer mainboard, wherein one side in the case is provided with a blowing part for uniformly blowing air to the surface of the computer mainboard; when the portion of blowing, when the arris piece is whenever crossing a fixed dog, the cooling blower accomplishes a swing to realize that cooling blower carries out continuous swing at quick-witted incasement up-and-down motion's in-process, the surface to the computer motherboard can be evenly blown to the cold wind that gets into quick-witted incasement through the heat dissipation inlet port, improved the radiating effect to the computer motherboard.

title_en: Modeling method and device for virtual game object, processor and electronic device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modeling method and device for a virtual game object, a processor and an electronic device. The method comprises the following steps: determining a model intersection composed of a plurality of model components to be used, wherein each of the plurality of model components to be used is a separate solid material member; acquiring the normal direction of the surface of each model component to be used in the model intersection; and splicing the plurality of model components to be used according to the normal direction to obtain the virtual game object. The invention solves the technical problems that the skeletal skin animation provided in the related technology needs to be configured independently for each three-dimensional virtual game role appearing in a game scene, thereby causing larger workload, higher operation complexity and longer development period.

title_en: Access path-based data query method, device, storage medium and processor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data query method and device based on an access path. The method comprises the following steps: and receiving a data query request, and querying data matched with the access paths to be queried from a pre-established access behavior database according to the target nodes and the access sequences corresponding to each target node, wherein the access behavior database comprises nodes contained in each access path and the access sequences corresponding to each node, the data query request comprises the target nodes contained in the access paths to be queried and the access sequences corresponding to each target node, so that the limitation that node information of a plurality of nodes in one path caused by pre-computation is required to be recorded in a single item is not existed any more, the limitation of pre-computation on the dimension of the supported node information is overcome, the limitation of pre-computation on the path hierarchy is overcome, the cost of increasing the node information of a plurality of dimensions is reduced, the nodes for path query are not limited in hierarchy any more, and the consumed storage space is reduced.

title_en: Fault tolerance method of parallel linear processing system based on linear coding
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault tolerance method of a parallel linear processing system based on linear coding, which comprises the following steps of firstly, setting K paths of parallel linear processing branches; step two, performing linear coding on the processing coefficients of the K paths of parallel linear processing branches to generate the processing coefficients of the 2 paths of redundant linear processing branches; step three, input sample data are respectively subjected to parallel operation through a K-path basic linear processing branch and 2-path redundant linear processing branches, and K basic data and 2 redundant data are generated; step four, single fault detection is carried out on K basic data and 2 redundant data, error data are corrected, K fault-tolerant data are output, wherein an error branch is one of K+2 branches, and E is used for the data  1  And E is  2  Fault detection is performed on the value of (2) to determine the kth  i  The branch is the wrong branch. Compared with the prior art, the invention (1) has wide applicability; (2) The linear characteristic of the system can be fully utilized to provide fault tolerance protection; (3) the fault tolerance rate reaches more than 99%; (4) the fault tolerance overhead is small.

title_en: Information processing method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an information processing method, an information processing device and information processing equipment; the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a data warehouse construction requirement; extracting data to be extracted from a data source according to the construction requirement of a data warehouse; according to a preset transposition responsibility chain, carrying out transposition treatment on the data to be extracted; the preset transposition responsibility chain refers to a stream processing mode for carrying out transposition processing on the data to be extracted; storing the transposed data to be extracted into a preset table to obtain a data warehouse; presetting a table structure for storing data in a table data warehouse; when the data analysis request is obtained, responding to the data analysis request, and carrying out data analysis according to the data warehouse to obtain a data analysis result. By the embodiment of the invention, the complexity of constructing the data warehouse can be reduced.

title_en: Commodity short header generation method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a commodity short title generation method and device, relates to the technical field of text abstracts, and can improve the generation efficiency and precision of commodity short titles. The method comprises the following steps: crawling commodity title data and/or collecting search word data to construct a corpus data set; classifying a plurality of corpora in the corpus data set according to commodity categories based on a commodity classification table, and then extracting key phrases to build a word stock; marking each keyword in the word stock as a modifier word or a class word according to the part of speech; obtaining original commodity title data and segmenting the same to obtain a plurality of title words, respectively matching each title word with keywords in a word stock, and outputting successfully matched keywords; at least two effective keywords are selected from the keywords, and the commodity short titles are formed by splicing according to parts of speech. The device is applied with the method proposed by the scheme.

title_en: Cross-database micro-expression recognition method and device based on domain selection migration regression
