abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-database micro-expression recognition method and device based on domain selection migration regression, comprising the following steps: (1) Acquiring two micro-expression databases which are respectively used as a training database and a testing database, wherein each micro-expression database comprises a plurality of micro-expression videos and corresponding micro-expression category labels; (2) Converting the micro-expression videos in the training database and the testing database into micro-expression image sequences, extracting gray-scale face images from the micro-expression image sequences, and extracting local area characteristics of the faces after segmentation; (3) Establishing a domain selection migration regression model, and learning the domain selection migration regression model by adopting the local area characteristics of the human face to obtain a sparse projection matrix for connecting the local area characteristics of the human face with the micro expression class labels; (4) And (3) for the micro-expression to be identified, obtaining the local area characteristics of the face according to the step (2), and obtaining the corresponding micro-expression category label by adopting the learned sparse projection matrix. The invention has higher accuracy.

title_en: Method and device for realizing atomicity of multi-level intelligent contract stack
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps of sequentially calling and executing at least one second intelligent contract associated with a first intelligent contract in a later layer according to a calling sequence in the execution process of the first intelligent contract in the previous layer of the multi-layer intelligent contract stack; in each calling execution process, a corresponding second transaction container is established for a second intelligent contract, and the address of a cache data area in a first transaction container corresponding to a first intelligent contract is saved as the address of a commit data area in the second transaction container; according to the mode, intelligent contracts in each layer of a multi-layer intelligent contract stack are called and executed layer by layer until all the intelligent contracts are successfully called and executed, so that the atomicity of the multi-layer intelligent contract stack is realized, and the time and the resource expenditure are greatly saved; and if the calling and the execution of one of the intelligent contracts fail, all the transaction containers corresponding to the intelligent contracts which are successfully executed are discarded.

title_en: Blind spot warning method and device based on cooperation of inter-vehicle communication
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method of warning a Blind Spot (Blind Spot) of a vehicle based on inter-vehicle communication (Vehicle To Vehicle Communication), the method comprising: if a rear image of a first vehicle is acquired from a rear camera, the first blind spot warning device transmits the rear image to a blind spot monitor, determines whether a plurality of surrounding vehicles are positioned in the rear image by using a convolutional neural network, and outputs first blind spot monitoring information for confirming whether the plurality of surrounding vehicles are positioned in the rear image; and (b) if second blind spot monitoring information for confirming whether the second vehicle is located at a blind spot is acquired from a second blind spot warning device of the second vehicle by inter-vehicle communication, the first blind spot warning device warns that at least one of the plurality of surrounding vehicles and the second vehicle is located at the blind spot by referring to the first blind spot monitoring information and the second blind spot monitoring information.

title_en: System and method for partial digital retraining
abstract_en: Provided herein is an integrated circuit that in some embodiments includes a hybrid neural network that includes a plurality of analog layers, a digital layer, and a plurality of data outputs. The plurality of simulation layers are configured to include programming weights of the neural network for decision making by the neural network. The digital layer disposed between the plurality of analog layers and the plurality of data outputs is configured for programming to compensate for weight drift in programming weights of the neural network to maintain integrity of decisions made by the neural network. Also provided herein is a method, which in some embodiments comprises: programming weights of the plurality of simulation layers; determining the integrity of decisions made by the neural network; and programming the digital layer of the neural network to compensate for weight drift in the programmed weights of the neural network.

title_en: Project file generation method, system, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The scheme relates to a project file generation method. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that a server receives a project file generation request sent by a terminal; generating a request searching resource list according to the engineering file, and sending the resource list to the terminal; the terminal acquires and displays the resource list from the server, acquires a file label determined according to the resource list and sends the file label to the server; the server generates a file analysis result according to the file label and sends the file analysis result to the terminal; and the terminal acquires the engineering development category and generates an engineering file according to the engineering development category and the file analysis result. A user only needs to configure hardware resources, select different project types, required codes and function interfaces, finally generate a full project or an application layer project, and finally compile the full project or the application layer project into firmware codes to burn the firmware codes into a single chip microcomputer, so that the efficiency of embedded software development can be improved.

title_en: Write-friendly flash memory solid-state disk cache management method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a write-friendly flash memory solid-state disk cache management method, which takes a page as a basic unit to manage a clean data page in a cache, carries out page cluster operation on a dirty data page in the cache according to different flash memory physical blocks to which the dirty data page belongs, and organizes a plurality of data pages of the same flash memory physical block into one page cluster; setting system access time visit _ time to record the times of accessing a data page; recording the time mark of the cache access data page; setting a recent access time window; the latest access time window covers a plurality of data pages which are accessed recently in the cache, the value tw of the latest access time window is set to be 10% of the size of the cache space, when the target data of the I/O request is not hit in the cache, the target data of the I/O request is read from the flash memory and returned to the upper application, and then the target data pages are inserted into corresponding management linked lists in the cache according to the read-write type of the I/O request. The cache replacement times and the flash memory garbage recycling overhead are reduced, and the overall performance of the flash memory is improved.

title_en: Information display method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an information display method, information display equipment and a storage medium. In the information display method, when a first image area in the object distribution diagram is displayed, the first image area displayed in the interface can be updated to a second image area containing the selected object according to the position distribution data of the selected object in the position distribution diagram in response to the viewing operation of the selected object in at least one object contained in the object distribution diagram. Based on this, the content displayed by the interface can be quickly switched from the first image area to the second image area, which is beneficial to improving the efficiency of reviewing the selected object.

title_en: Face verification method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a face verification method, a device, equipment and a readable storage medium; the embodiment of the application is related to identity verification, and can extract the facial part in the facial image to obtain the part image corresponding to the facial part and the extracted facial image of the facial image; performing feature coding on the part image to obtain multi-layer feature information corresponding to the part image, wherein the multi-layer feature information comprises output layer feature information and intermediate layer feature information except for an output layer; performing feature decoding on the output layer feature information based on the intermediate layer feature information to generate a part modification image corresponding to the part image; fusing the part decorated image and the extracted face image to obtain a fused decorated face image; matching the fused decorated face image with the face verification image; and determining a face verification result according to the matching result of the fused decorated face image and the face verification image.

title_en: Animation data compression method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for compressing animation data, and belongs to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring animation data; performing curve fitting processing on the track data of the target animation track according to the track data of the target animation track; selecting part of animation frame data from the animation frame data of the target animation track according to the curve fitting result to obtain screened track data of the target animation track; respectively carrying out digit compression processing on the screened track data of the target animation track according to n animation channels to obtain compressed data corresponding to the n animation channels; and merging the compressed data corresponding to the n animation channels respectively to generate the compressed track data of the target animation track. According to the technical scheme, the animation frames are deleted through curve fitting, then digit compression processing is carried out on the animation track data, the animation compression rate is greatly improved, and the compression mode combination degree is improved.

title_en: Random number generator
abstract_en: A random number generator includes an address generator, a static random number source, a count value generator and a processing circuit. The count value generator generates a first random number. The address generator generates an address signal. The static random number source is connected to the address generator to receive the address signal and generate a second random number. The processing circuit is connected to the static random number source and the count value generator and is used for receiving the first random number and the second random number. The processing circuit performs logic operation on the first random number and the second random number to generate an output random number.

title_en: Video target detection method, system and device based on category external memory
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field, particularly relates to a video target detection method, a system and a device based on category external memory, and aims to solve the problem that the target detection performance is obviously reduced when the number of auxiliary frames is small in the prior art. The invention comprises the following steps: firstly, training a video target detection model through a self-attention mechanism according to training video information, then obtaining enhanced example characteristics of a video to be detected through the trained video target detection model and the self-attention mechanism, and finally inputting the enhanced example characteristics into a classification branch and a boundary box regression branch of a general target detection network to obtain a target detection result. The invention reduces the sensitivity of the video target detection method based on feature integration to the number of auxiliary frames in the prior art, and can accurately detect the target under the condition of less auxiliary frames or no auxiliary frames.

title_en: Popup display method and device and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a popup window display method, a popup window display device and a readable storage medium. The popup display method comprises the steps of requesting the rendering data of a first popup from a server, creating a first object by calling the popup method, executing an asynchronous function through the first object, requesting the rendering data of the first popup from the server through the asynchronous function, storing the rendering data at the tail of a data queue under the condition that the rendering data of the first popup sent by the server is received, starting at the head of the data queue, taking out one rendering data, and displaying the popup corresponding to the taken rendering data. Therefore, the method can ensure that only the popup window with the highest priority among popups corresponding to each rendering data in one data queue is displayed at a time, and solves the problem that each popup window cannot be displayed according to the order of priority when an asynchronous scheme is adopted to realize popup window display in the prior art.

title_en: Display control method for android system Internet of things equipment
abstract_en: A display control method for an android system Internet of things device comprises the following steps: s1, deleting an original GUI module in a complete android system to form a first android system module; s2, loading an ADF display driving module on the first android system module to form a second android system module; and S3, loading an improved GUI module on the second android system module to form an improved android system. According to the display control method for the android system Internet of things equipment, the android system is applied to the Internet of things equipment, meanwhile, the lower RAM and ROM which can be adopted by the Internet of things equipment can be achieved, and manufacturing and purchasing costs of the Internet of things equipment are effectively reduced.

title_en: Intention identification method based on syntactic analysis model and related device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and provides an intention identification method based on a syntactic analysis model, which comprises the following steps: acquiring an input sentence to be subjected to intention identification; determining at least one preset intention type aiming at the field type according to the field type to which the input statement belongs, and acquiring a keyword and a key syntactic relation corresponding to each intention type, wherein the key syntactic relation is used for representing the syntactic relation among the keywords; matching the input statement with each intention type according to the keyword and the key syntactic relation corresponding to each intention type to obtain the matching degree between the input statement and each intention type; and determining the intention type with the highest matching degree as the target intention corresponding to the input statement. In addition, the application also relates to a block chain technology, and sample sentences corresponding to different intention types under various field types can be stored in block chain nodes.

title_en: Independently add stationary 4K touch-control display
abstract_en: The invention discloses an autonomous reinforced 4K touch display, which relates to the technical field of computers and comprises a liquid crystal display module, a key and display interface module, a power supply module and a functional module. The hardware functional module comprises a 4K _ VGA driving board, a health management board, a backlight board, a key board and a touch panel. The video main chip of the 4K _ VGA drive board adopts NT68394, 4K video signals of the display control computer are input into the video chip through an HDMI interface, and the video signals are communicated through the chip NT68394 processing module to realize information reporting and user strategy issuing. The health management board realizes UART to hundred million network conversion through an Ethernet protocol stack chip CH395, uploads the health information of the display to the WEB management end in real time through the sensing module, responds to corresponding strategies and protection mechanisms according to the information, and meanwhile, the WEB management end can realize the brightness adjustment of remote backlight and the control of the working state of the liquid crystal screen module. The invention can realize remote management and real-time report of health information, and has the characteristics of safety, low power consumption and autonomous controllability.

title_en: Data display method, device, equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a data display method, a device, equipment and a computer readable storage medium, which relate to the technical field of data display, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring rolling position information and rolling type corresponding to a data rolling event when the data rolling event is detected; and searching target rendering data according to the scrolling position information and the scrolling type, determining a target data table area and a target blank space occupation block according to the scrolling type, and performing data rendering on the target data table area and the target blank space occupation block according to the target rendering data. The invention can realize the normal rendering of the data with large data volume in the transverse and longitudinal rolling processes, and does not cause the phenomenon of jamming or collapse.

title_en: Screen projection method, device, equipment and storage medium based on 5G network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of data screen projection, and discloses a screen projection method, a device, equipment and a storage medium based on a 5G network. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a first communication connection with a preset terminal device, and receiving a screen projection request sent by the terminal device based on a 5G network; establishing a second communication connection with a preset routing device according to the screen projection request; judging whether the first communication connection and the second communication connection belong to the same network type; and if the network channels belong to the same network system, setting the network channels corresponding to the first communication connection and the second communication connection to different frequency domains, and outputting screen projection data to a preset display based on the first communication connection and the second communication connection. Compared with the prior art, the embodiment of the invention reduces the network packet loss rate, reduces the network signal interference condition and also reduces the network delay, and obtains higher screen projection smoothness in different use scenes.

title_en: Method and device for calculating price of article
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for calculating the price of an article, and relates to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the steps of crawling webpage data, obtaining text information and image information in the webpage data, determining a target set according to the text information and the image information, wherein the target set comprises a plurality of objects, screening at least one target object from the target set, and calculating the price of the at least one target object. The implementation mode can solve the technical problems of large pricing error and insufficient intelligence.

title_en: Liquid cooling heat dissipation device capable of dissipating heat from multiple heat sources
abstract_en: The invention relates to a liquid cooling heat dissipating device capable of dissipating heat by multiple heat sources, which comprises a first water tank, a second water tank, a water cooling row assembly, a heat absorbing assembly and a water pump, wherein the first water tank is provided with a plurality of first water storage tanks which are adjacent to each other but are not communicated with each other; the second water tank is arranged at intervals with the first water tank and is provided with a plurality of second water storage tanks, and the second water storage tanks are mutually adjacent but not communicated; each water cooling row component is arranged between the first water tank and the second water tank in parallel, and the water cooling row components are communicated with the first water storage tank and the second water storage tank; the heat absorbing component is communicated with the second water storage tank; the water pump is installed in each water storage tank. Therefore, the device can be simultaneously provided for different heat sources, and has compact structure and small occupied space.

title_en: Task allocation method and related device
abstract_en: The application discloses a task allocation method and a related device. The task allocation method comprises the following steps: determining pre-allocation tasks of all executors; taking an executor as a transfer-out executor, and taking at least one pre-allocation task of the transfer-out executor as a task to be transferred; acquiring a first processing time length required by a transfer executor to process a pre-allocation task and a task to be transferred, wherein the transfer executor is an executor except the executor to be transferred; taking a transfer executor corresponding to the first processing time length meeting the preset transfer condition as a target transfer executor; and allocating the task to be transferred to the target transferor. By the scheme, tasks can be reasonably distributed.

title_en: Online budget quota compilation management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an online budget quota compilation management system, which comprises a client, a data processing server and a database server, wherein the client is connected with the data processing server through a network; the client is used for being responsible for page display processing required by the budget quota compilation management system and providing a human-computer interaction interface; the data processing server is used for responding to the request of the client, returning data required by the request and providing independent service for calculation in the online budget quota planning management system; and the database server is used for storing and inquiring data in the online budget quota establishment management system. By the online budget quota compilation management system, the data is stored on the database server in a centralized manner, real-time online compilation is realized, the problems of inconsistency, repetition, omission, loss and the like of the data are avoided, and the management efficiency is improved.

title_en: Method and device for transmitting information
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for sending information, and relates to the field of cloud computing. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: receiving first cloud mobile phone application starting information sent by a cloud mobile phone client, wherein the first cloud mobile phone application starting information comprises a user identifier, a first cloud mobile phone equipment identifier and a first cloud mobile phone application identifier; receiving second cloud mobile phone application starting information sent by a cloud mobile phone server, wherein the second cloud mobile phone application starting information comprises a second cloud mobile phone equipment identifier and a second cloud mobile phone application identifier; responding to the fact that the first cloud mobile phone application starting information is matched with the second cloud mobile phone application starting information, and acquiring prestored login information which corresponds to a user identifier and is used for logging in a cloud mobile phone application corresponding to the second cloud mobile phone application identifier; and sending the login information to the cloud mobile phone server so that the cloud mobile phone server can execute login operation according to the login information. According to the embodiment, the login efficiency of the cloud mobile phone application is improved.

title_en: Multimedia content similarity determination method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a multimedia content similarity determining method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which are used for firstly acquiring a plurality of target multimedia contents; then constructing a topological graph aiming at a plurality of target contents which are acted by the user historically, wherein edges in the topological graph are used for connecting the target contents which are acted by the user commonly; inputting parameters of target contents in the topological graph into a word vector model for calculation to obtain vector values of each target content; and calculating the similarity between the target contents according to the vector value. According to the technical scheme, when the similarity between the multimedia contents is determined, the vector value is calculated according to the content characteristics of the multimedia contents and the behavior characteristics of the user by utilizing the word vector model, and the data according to the calculation is more comprehensive, so that the finally obtained similarity is more accurate compared with the prior art, and the truly similar multimedia contents can be found out on the basis.

title_en: Energy spectrum CT image domain material identification method based on 3D full convolution neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying energy spectrum CT image domain materials based on a 3D full convolution neural network, which comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining energy spectrum CT images of materials to be identified of different energy segments; s2, converting the energy spectrum CT images of the different energy sections, including the materials to be identified, into three-dimensional image data; s3, inputting the three-dimensional image data into a 3D full convolution neural network material identification model to obtain a material identification result of the energy spectrum CT image of each energy segment; s4, carrying out image fusion on the material identification results of the energy spectrum CT images of the energy segments to obtain a comprehensive material identification image. The invention uses the 3D full convolution neural network to learn CT image information among different energy segments and the characteristics among different layers in the convolution process. The output image is subjected to a feature fusion method to obtain an energy spectrum CT image integrating clear features of each energy segment, so that an accurate and objective material identification result can be obtained.

title_en: Supervision detection method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to a supervision detection method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following steps: receiving a detection request, wherein the detection request carries a detection signal for detecting the steel bars; when the detection signal is detected, a starting request is sent to the unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the starting request carries a starting signal for starting the unmanned aerial vehicle to go to an initial detection point for detection; receiving initial detection information fed back by the unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the initial detection information is obtained by shooting reinforcing steel bars at initial detection points by cameras assembled by the unmanned aerial vehicle; when the initial detection information is detected, sending a supplementary recording request to the unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the supplementary recording request carries a supplementary recording signal for starting the unmanned aerial vehicle to go to a supplementary recording detection point for detection; receiving supplementary record detection information fed back by the unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the supplementary record detection information is obtained by shooting reinforcing steel bars at supplementary record detection points by a camera assembled by the unmanned aerial vehicle; and summarizing the initial detection information and the complement detection information into detection result information. The application has the effect of realizing convenient and safe detection.

title_en: Method and system for prioritizing trial-and-error attempt corrections of at least one bit
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method and system for prioritizing trial-and-error attempt corrections of at least one bit using at least one threshold to set a threshold voltage value to determine a logic bit level, the method comprising ranking a plurality of bits such that a first bit of the plurality of bits is ranked before a second bit, the second bit being less likely to be erroneous than the first bit.

title_en: Text clustering method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a text clustering method, a text clustering device, computer equipment and a computer storage medium, relates to the technical field of text clustering, and can quickly realize accurate clustering of massive text data and improve a text clustering effect. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring text corpus under each category randomly extracted from a network platform; extracting text segmentation words with text characteristics from the text corpus under various views by utilizing a multi-mode matching algorithm; inputting the text word segmentation with the text characteristics into a pre-trained language model to obtain vector representation of the text word segmentation; and clustering the vector representations of the text segmentation words by using a density-based clustering algorithm.

title_en: User characteristic generation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a user characteristic generation method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the fields of big data processing and the like. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring N pieces of historical behavior data of a target user within a first preset duration; wherein N is an integer greater than or equal to 1; determining topics corresponding to the N pieces of historical behavior data respectively based on the subject words of the M candidate clusters, and aggregating the topics corresponding to the N pieces of historical behavior data respectively to obtain K historical behavior data sets and topics thereof; wherein M and K are integers greater than or equal to 1; determining target behavior data corresponding to the K historical behavior data sets respectively based on center vectors of candidate clusters corresponding to the K historical behavior data sets respectively; and taking the topics and the target behavior data respectively corresponding to the K historical behavior data sets as characteristics of the target user.

title_en: Behavior determination method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for determining behaviors, a storage medium and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical transaction behavior information of a target object, determining transaction behavior characteristics of the historical transaction behavior of the target object according to the historical transaction behavior information, analyzing the transaction behavior characteristics by using a first model, and determining whether illegal transaction behaviors exist in the historical transaction behaviors corresponding to the transaction behavior characteristics, so that the technical problems of low recognition efficiency and low accuracy of the illegal behaviors in the related art are solved, and the technical effect of improving the behavior recognition efficiency of the target object is achieved.

title_en: Data synchronization method and service node
abstract_en: The application provides a data synchronization method and a service node, which are applicable to a distributed system comprising a plurality of service nodes, wherein the plurality of service nodes share a database; after receiving the data synchronization instruction, the first service node determines whether a synchronization lock is loaded in the distributed system; when no synchronous lock is determined, loading the generated synchronous lock to a distributed system; and pulling the data to be synchronized from the data center and updating the database. When the distributed system determines that one service node is already executing the data synchronization, the synchronization lock is set for the distributed system, so that when other service nodes receive the data synchronization instruction and the distributed system determines that the synchronization lock is already present, the service nodes skip the data synchronization execution, directly enter the working state of non-data synchronization, and the phenomenon of resource waste caused by the fact that at least two service nodes are simultaneously used for data synchronization in the same distributed system can be avoided.

title_en: Coronal mass projection detection method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coronal mass projection detection method based on deep learning, and belongs to the technical field of automatic coronal mass projection detection. The method comprises the following steps: step1, preprocessing CME images and preparing a data set; step2, extracting features; step3, generating candidate region suggestions; step4, pooling the target area; step5, performing CME fine classification; step6, frame regression; step7, removing the repeated redundant box. The method for introducing deep learning is used for CME target detection, and solves the problems that artificial design features cannot well characterize CME semantics when threshold segmentation or a traditional machine learning classifier is used for CME detection recognition, and the threshold and the traditional machine learning classifier are poor in classification effect, so that weak CME detection effect is poor; compared with other methods, the method has better robustness.

title_en: Method and device for drawing power grid tide section
abstract_en: A method for drawing a power flow section of a power grid includes the steps of obtaining a moving track of a cursor, conducting point-taking processing on the moving track to obtain a plurality of key points, calculating a curve equation and drawing a curve by a cubic spline interpolation method based on the plurality of key points, calculating a function value of the curve equation according to preset step precision to obtain a plurality of data points on the curve, and conducting three-dimensional drawing according to positions and connection relations of the plurality of data points to obtain a three-dimensional section. The method and the device provided by the embodiment of the invention solve the problems that the traditional power grid section drawing is not easy to operate and adjust, the display is not intuitive and the application limitation is large, can realize that the power grid tide section drawing is simpler and more convenient and easy to operate, can be suitable for complex regional conditions such as the bending boundary of a region, have universal applicability and simultaneously have more intuitionistic three-dimensional sections.

title_en: Background music controller
abstract_en: The invention provides a background music controller, which comprises a display module, a play module, a Bluetooth connection module, a power-off memory module and a communication module, wherein the Bluetooth connection module comprises a control circuit for displaying Bluetooth names, bluetooth connection states and Bluetooth connection password prompts of equipment to be connected; the display module, the play module, the Bluetooth connection module, the power-off memory module and the communication module are all connected to a circuit control board. The Bluetooth connection module is based on the Bluetooth control chip to display Bluetooth names, bluetooth connection states and Bluetooth connection password prompts of equipment to be connected on the display module. The background music controller provided by the invention is accurate in point-to-point butt joint, and the workload increase caused by misconnection is prevented.

title_en: Application program home page configuration method and device, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the internet technology, and discloses an application program home page configuration method, which comprises the following steps: performing semantic declaration on the initial base class template to obtain a standard base class template; marking and inheriting the standard base class template according to the home page content set to be displayed to obtain a component set; and dynamically extracting and combining the component set according to a preset user home page interface to obtain a user application program home page. The invention also relates to a blockchain technique, the set of components can be stored in a blockchain. The invention also provides an application program home page configuration device, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium. The invention can improve the flexibility of the application program home page configuration and the resource utilization rate.

title_en: Construction method for high-pressure rotary spraying based on image recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method for high-pressure jet grouting based on image recognition, which belongs to the technical field of construction engineering construction and comprises a high-speed camera, a fixed support, an image processing system, a jet grouting drilling machine, a geological drilling machine, a drainage groove, a slurry collecting tank and a jet grouting drilling machine console; the high-speed camera is in radio transmission with the image processing system, the image processing system is connected with the rotary jet drilling machine console through a cable, and the specific construction method comprises the following steps: conducting hole construction; installing a high-speed camera; pre-testing before rotary spraying construction; beginning rotary spraying construction; processing an image; adjusting construction parameters; and finishing the construction of the jet grouting pile. The invention adopts the image gray level analysis method, improves the subjective judgment to the objective analysis, judges the quality of the rotary spraying through slurry return, further adjusts the construction parameters, realizes the mechanization and intellectualization of construction, liberates labor force and reduces the construction cost.

title_en: CPLD updating method, server and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a CPLD updating method, a server and a computer readable storage medium, belonging to the technical field of computers, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving a firmware updating signal of a CPLD; the CPLD sets the clock signal of the I2C bus to 0; receiving a firmware update finishing signal of the CPLD; the CPLD releases the clock signal of the I2C bus, and the clock signal is recovered to be normal. The invention is used for realizing updating the CPLD system without power failure, and the clock signal of the I2C bus is set to be 0, so that the CPLD system can not be accessed by the system during updating, and the error reporting of the system can not occur. Therefore, the technical problems that the CPLD cannot be managed and controlled by the BMC chip during power-off updating and the system error reporting during power-off updating are solved.

title_en: Automated data slicing based on artificial neural network
abstract_en: A method, apparatus and computer program product for automated data slicing based on Artificial Neural Networks (ANN). The method comprises the following steps: obtaining an ANN, wherein the ANN is configured to provide predictions of data instances, wherein the ANN comprises a set of nodes having interconnections between the nodes; determining an attribute vector based on a subset of nodes of the ANN; determining a plurality of data slices based on the attribute vector; obtaining a test data set comprising test data instances; for each data slice, computing a performance measure of the ANN on that data slice, wherein the computing is based on an application of the ANN on each test data instance mapped to the data slice; and performing an action based on at least a portion of the performance measure of the data slice.

title_en: Face recognition method based on wavelet dimensionality reduction under homomorphic encryption
abstract_en: The invention provides a face recognition method based on wavelet dimension reduction under homomorphic encryption, which is designed in the technical field of face recognition and solves the problems of large occupied space, long face recognition time and poor real-time property in the face recognition process of the conventional face recognition method based on homomorphic encryption.

title_en: Method and device applied to graph database
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device applied to a graph database, and relates to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a service request from a user; retrieving data in a graph database based on a service request of a user; and sending the retrieved data to the user, wherein the data is distributively stored in the graph database. When multiple copies of the same data are configured, a cross-cluster model is configured to support dual clusters in the same city and clusters in different places. Before a user request is sent to nodes in the cluster, whether the service of each node in the cluster is normal or not is automatically detected, and if the service of one or more nodes is detected to be failed, tasks related to the user request are not sent to the failed nodes. The method has the same-city and different-place disaster recovery functions, can automatically isolate the failed nodes in the cluster, improves the efficiency of maintaining the graph database cluster, and reduces the management cost of the graph database cluster.

title_en: Content matching method and device and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a content matching method and device and a readable storage medium. A method of content matching, comprising: acquiring content to be matched; the content to be matched is UI content or UA content; splitting the content to be matched into character strings to be matched according to a preset sentence-breaking rule; acquiring attribute information of the string to be matched according to the content to be matched corresponding to the string to be matched; and matching the attribute information of the string to be matched with the attribute information of the reference string in a preset translation memory library, and determining the matching type of the string to be matched and the reference string. The method is used for perfecting the matching mode of the UI and the UA and improving the utilization rate of the UI and the UA.

title_en: Character image generation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a character image generation method, a device, equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: through traversing operation, storing a preset number of characters to be drawn in a complete character image to be drawn in a cache area to serve as candidate characters; the preset number is smaller than the total number of characters to be drawn in the complete character image; judging whether the candidate character is to be drawn in the target drawing area image according to the position of the candidate character in the complete character image and the position of the target drawing area; and drawing the candidate characters according to the judging result, and clearing the buffer area until the traversal is completed. According to the embodiment of the invention, only the character to be drawn which is traversed currently is stored in the cache area to serve as the candidate character, so that compared with the method that all characters in the complete character image are stored in the cache area, the required cache space is reduced, and the resource consumption is reduced.

title_en: Rainfall prediction method and system based on wavelet decomposition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rainfall prediction method and system based on wavelet decomposition, comprising the following steps: acquiring a plurality of historical rainfall time sequences and a current rainfall time sequence; screening out a plurality of historical rainfall time sequences of which the correlation degree with the current ongoing rainfall time sequence is greater than a set threshold value from the plurality of historical rainfall time sequences; decomposing a plurality of historical rainfall time sequences with the correlation degrees larger than a set threshold value and a current rainfall time sequence to respectively obtain a low-frequency component and a high-frequency component; constructing a VAR model for the low-frequency component to predict to obtain low-frequency component prediction quantity; constructing an NAR neural network for predicting the high-frequency components to obtain high-frequency component prediction quantity; and reconstructing the low-frequency component prediction quantity and the high-frequency component prediction quantity to obtain the rainfall prediction quantity.

title_en: Vegetable and fruit plant side branch point identification method based on different edge type intersection points
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vegetable and fruit plant side branch point identification method based on different edge types. Firstly, threshold segmentation is carried out on the collected color image of the vegetable and fruit plant, extraction of transverse edges and extraction of longitudinal edges are respectively carried out in the binary image of the color image, denoising processing is carried out on the extracted edges, and then threshold segmentation is carried out on the extracted transverse edges and longitudinal edges to remove the short edges of the leaves of the vegetable and fruit plant. The branch points of the vegetable and fruit plants are obtained by seeking intersection points of the processed transverse and longitudinal edges. And finally, screening out side branch points of the mutually corresponding vegetable and fruit plants through the distance limit between the two points and the edge type of the two points. The invention can realize the identification of the side branch points of the vegetable and fruit plants with similar branch and leaf colors and provide the information of the side branch positions for the operation of the branch and leaf trimming robot.

title_en: Method, apparatus, device and computer readable storage medium for extracting image data in multiple convolution windows in parallel
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method, apparatus, device, and computer-readable storage medium for extracting image data in a plurality of convolution windows in parallel. The method includes dividing the image into a plurality of sets of convolution windows, wherein the plurality of sets of convolution windows includes a first set of convolution windows and a second set of convolution windows, each set of convolution windows including a plurality of convolution windows. The method also includes extracting, using the plurality of data processing units, image data in the plurality of convolution windows in the first set of convolution windows in parallel, and after completing extracting the image data in the first set of convolution windows, extracting, using the plurality of data processing units, image data in the plurality of convolution windows in the second set of convolution windows in parallel. According to the embodiment of the disclosure, in the process of extracting the convolution data, the plurality of data processing units are used for extracting the image data in the plurality of convolution windows in parallel, so that the data extraction speed is increased, and the processing efficiency of image convolution is improved.

title_en: American license plate recognition method based on single-stage target detection and deptext recognition network
abstract_en: The invention relates to an American license plate recognition method based on a single-stage target detection and deptext recognition network, which comprises the following steps of S1: acquiring an American license plate data set, and generating a training set after preprocessing; step S2: modifying a target detection network CornerNet-Squeeze according to the license plate detection characteristics; step S3: training the improved CornerNet-Squeeze by using a detection end training set, and training a deep recognition network by using a data set MJSynth and a SynthText; step S4: sending the detection training set into a trained detection network, outputting three parts of images of a license plate number, annual inspection information and a state name, sending the three parts of images into an identification network, and manually modifying error information by text information output by the identification network to obtain an identification label; step S5: and further training the identification network by using the obtained identification label to obtain the high-precision identification network. Step S6: and (5) detecting the American license plate image to be detected by using the high-precision identification network trained in the step S5, and outputting a result. The invention can effectively identify American license plates.

title_en: Ecological system attribute component composition structure quantization method facing frequency distribution situation
abstract_en: A method for quantizing an ecosystem attribute component composition structure facing frequency distribution conditions relates to a method for quantizing an ecosystem attribute component composition structure. The method aims to solve the technical problem that the composition structure of the attribute components of the existing ecological system cannot be quantized. The quantization method of the invention: acquiring remote sensing satellite ecological image data of vegetation indexes or ecological parameters in a research area; determining a vegetation index grouping scheme of the type of the ecological system for the obtained raster data, converting the vegetation index or ecological parameter raster data into frequency distribution data of ecological system attribute components according to the grouping scheme, listing an ecological system attribute component frequency distribution data table, and constructing an attribute component frequency distribution map; according to EAC ═ x max ‑x min Calculate the attribute variation distance EAC, in Calculating an attribute variation DAC; push button The frequency uniformity DFE is calculated. The quantitative description is carried out on the distribution condition of the attribute component frequency through quantification, and the method is used for the field of analysis of the space-time change of the attribute structure of the ecological system.

title_en: Method for managing inventory and apparatus therefor
abstract_en: The invention provides a method of managing inventory, the method comprising: receiving location information indicating at least one spatial location in a plurality of spatial units and spatial information corresponding to the location information; calculating a state change amount regarding the at least one spatial position based on at least one of the position information, the spatial information, and information regarding a previous spatial state of each of the plurality of spatial units; or updating the information on the previous spatial state of each of the plurality of spatial units with information on a current spatial state based on the state change amount. The invention provides an inventory management device for performing the method. The present invention provides a non-transitory computer-readable recording medium for performing the method.

title_en: Intelligent water conservancy data center construction method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of water conservancy information, and particularly discloses an intelligent water conservancy data middling station construction method, which realizes omnibearing acquisition of water conservancy data, omnibearing data acquisition, can support application of water conservancy data service, realizes data sharing, carries out primary management on the data according to different types of data acquired by a water conservancy data source acquisition layer, classifies and stores the data into an information directory library according to data of different directories to realize storage of the data so as to be used as historical data for reference, establishes a corresponding data model to meet the requirement of normal operation of water conservancy, provides data reference for management or other personnel to judge the overall development condition of the water conservancy, establishes a multi-dimensional analysis layer to analyze the data from multiple aspects of requirements, finds and prepares different models, and can intuitively know the development directions of different requirements through the models, and favorable support is provided for the decision in the aspect of water conservancy management.

title_en: Segment beam prefabrication construction monitoring method based on three-dimensional laser scanning and BIM technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a segment beam prefabrication construction monitoring method based on three-dimensional laser scanning and BIM technology, which comprises the following specific steps: and establishing a point cloud data model through three-dimensional laser scanning, establishing a Building Information (BIM) model, comparing the point cloud data model with the BIM model, verifying construction precision, and adjusting the manufacturing size of the next adjacent section beam according to the construction precision. The invention applies the three-dimensional laser scanning and BIM drawing technology to the construction monitoring of the segmental beam by a short line method, and performs fine detection and monitoring on the segmental beam construction. The monitoring method can realize the detection of the precision of the construction dimensions of all details of the external structure, the internal structure, the steering block, the anchoring block, the shear key tooth block and the diaphragm plate of the segmental beam, and adjust the manufacturing dimension of the next adjacent segmental beam according to the detection result, so that the accumulation of construction errors is avoided, and the precision of the prefabrication processing of the segmental beam is ensured.

title_en: Multi-mode emotion recognition method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of voice recognition and image processing, and provides a multi-mode emotion recognition method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing de-duplication on video data of an object to be identified to obtain face time sequence image data of the object to be identified; acquiring text data of the object to be identified in real time when acquiring video data of the object to be identified; and inputting the aligned face time sequence image data and the text data into a multi-modal emotion recognition model so as to perform multi-modal emotion recognition of the object to be recognized. According to the invention, the emotion classification and detection accuracy and robustness are improved by acquiring the expression of the user and the text content of the conversation in the conversation process of the virtual person with the user in real time and acquiring the multidimensional rich features in a mode of joint input of the image and the text signal. Particularly in the forward and reverse words, irony and other scenes have higher accuracy.

title_en: Method and device for automatically issuing value-added tax invoice
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for automatically issuing value-added tax invoices, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the total information of the invoicing application form which is approved and approved, and generating an invoicing ledger; filling and printing a special value-added tax invoice based on information in the billing ledger, and recording a newly generated invoice number and an invoice code in the billing ledger; confirming the invoicing of the value-added tax special invoice which is finished with the invoicing, and filling a newly generated invoice number for storage; and performing invoice posting processing on the issued value-added tax special invoice. The invention can effectively improve the efficiency of issuing the value-added tax invoice and reduce the error rate.

title_en: Software automation testing method, device and system based on artificial intelligence model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a software automatic testing method, device and system based on an artificial intelligence model, which are used for solving the problem that the position of a device to be tested for executing testing operation is inaccurate. This scheme includes: acquiring a test task to be executed; inputting interface image characteristic information of target software into a first artificial intelligent model to obtain at least one candidate target object in an interface image; determining a target object which is matched with the specified object of the test area in at least one candidate target object; and executing test operation on the area where the target object is located in the interface of the target software. According to the scheme, the target object matched with the specified object in the test area can be accurately identified through the artificial intelligence model, so that the test operation can be accurately acted on the area where the target object is located, the problem that the test operation cannot be accurately executed due to the difference between the interface of the device to be tested and the test area is solved, the test efficiency is improved, and the labor consumption is reduced.

title_en: Wake flow calculation method considering local environment factors of wind power plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wake flow calculation method considering local environment factors of a wind power plant, and belongs to the technical field of wake flow calculation of wind turbine generators. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining local environment parameters of a wind power plant according to the local environment of the wind power plant, then calculating an atmospheric stability function of the environment where the wind power plant is located, then taking the obtained atmospheric stability function as input, calculating the earth surface friction speed by utilizing a Monin-Obukhov similar theory, then sequentially calculating to obtain the flow direction velocity pulsation of a near stratum, the flow direction turbulence intensity of the near stratum and the spanwise turbulence intensity of the near stratum, establishing a direct ratio relation of the spanwise turbulence intensity of a hub height to the spanwise turbulence intensity of the near stratum, obtaining the spanwise turbulence intensity of the hub height, then sequentially calculating to obtain a wake expansion coefficient, an initial wake radius and a wake radius, calculating the velocity loss thickness of a wake region, and finally obtaining the velocity distribution of the wake region. The method greatly expands the application range of the wake flow calculation method and improves the accuracy of the calculation result.

title_en: Method and device for predicting financial dilemma of marketing enterprises
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a device for predicting financial dilemma of a marketing enterprise. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring text data, and purchasing recombination event information and financial indexes of discussion and analysis of an enterprise annual report management layer of a target enterprise; text emotion analysis is carried out on the text data discussed and analyzed by the annual report management layer of the target enterprise to obtain annual report mining indexes of the target enterprise, and feature extraction is carried out on the information of the concurrent purchase recombination event of the target enterprise to obtain the concurrent purchase recombination indexes of the target enterprise; and inputting the annual report mining index, the parallel purchase recombination index and the financial index of the target enterprise into a dilemma prediction model, and outputting a financial dilemma prediction result of the target enterprise. According to the method and the device for predicting financial dilemma of the enterprises on the market, provided by the embodiment of the invention, multi-party data such as MD & A, M & A and financial indexes are integrated by considering multi-dimensional data, so that the lack of unilateral data sources is avoided, and a more accurate prediction result can be obtained.

title_en: Cold region judgment method, memory control circuit unit and memory storage device
abstract_en: The invention provides a cold area judgment method, a memory control circuit unit and a memory storage device. The method comprises the following steps: recording a plurality of logic updating times respectively corresponding to the plurality of logic units; calculating a plurality of reference updating times respectively corresponding to a plurality of entity erasing units according to the plurality of logic updating times; calculating a reference value according to a plurality of first logic updating times corresponding to the first logic units respectively; and judging at least one first entity erasing unit belonging to the cold area in the entity erasing units according to the reference value and the reference updating times.

title_en: Multi-agent conversation agent framework
abstract_en: The application relates to a multi-agent dialog proxy framework. One embodiment provides a method comprising: receiving, within a conversation agent creation framework for creating a conversation agent that performs negotiations on behalf of a user, (i) a selection of one of a plurality of conversation agent roles, (ii) a negotiation constraint for the selected role, and (iii) an object of negotiation; creating a conversation agent (i) having the selected role and (ii) programmed with the negotiation constraints; identifying at least one other conversation agent that (i) has a relative role with respect to the object and (ii) is programmed with relative role negotiation constraints; and conducting a dialog session between the dialog agent and the at least one other dialog agent, wherein the dialog session includes the negotiation for the object, and wherein the dialog agent and the at least one other dialog agent perform the negotiation according to the negotiation constraints and the relative role negotiation constraints.

title_en: Implicit recommendation method and system based on network self-cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an implicit recommendation method and system based on network self-cooperation. The method comprises the following steps: corresponding to a sequence recommendation model, constructing a peer-to-peer sequence recommendation model with the same network architecture; performing collaborative training on the sequence recommendation model and the peer sequence recommendation model thereof, and reactivating invalid parameters of the sequence recommendation model by transplanting parameters from the peer sequence recommendation model thereof according to the importance of each layer of parameters in the sequence recommendation model in the collaborative training process; and taking the historical browsing sequence of the user as input, and carrying out sequence recommendation service for the user by utilizing the sequence recommendation model which is cooperatively trained. According to the invention, the collaboration and optimization of a plurality of models are automatically promoted, so that a sequence recommendation model with better expressive force can be obtained, and accurate recommendation service is provided for users.

title_en: Neuronal network element
abstract_en: The invention provides a neural network unit, comprising: an inhibitory read control transistor and an excitatory read control transistor arranged in parallel; a write control transistor disposed opposite the two transistors in a vertical stack; the sources of the writing control transistor and the reading control transistor are arranged in a back way; the drain electrode of the write control transistor is electrically connected with the first end of a magnetic tunnel junction; the drain electrode of the inhibitory read control transistor is electrically connected with the second end of the magnetic tunnel junction through a weight signal line; the drain electrode of the excitatory read control transistor is electrically connected with the second end of the magnetic tunnel junction through a weight signal line. According to the invention, the transistors of the neuron network units are stacked up and down, so that the total area of a chip is reduced, and the two transistors share one magnetic tunnel junction, so that the level of an excitation signal and the level of an inhibition signal are completely consistent and offset under the condition of opposite signals, and the accuracy of a deep learning algorithm is improved.

title_en: Mine car parameter optimization method and system based on real-time data
abstract_en: The application provides a mine car parameter optimization method and a system thereof based on real-time data, tire parameters are adjusted in real time according to tire related data in the running process of a mine car, steering parameters are adjusted in real time according to steering related data in the running process of the mine car, and braking parameters are adjusted in real time according to braking related data in the running process of the mine car; the tire parameters, the steering parameters and the braking parameters are adjusted in real time by utilizing real-time data in the running process of the mine car, so that the accuracy of relevant data of the adjustment basis can be improved, and the adjustment precision and the adjustment adaptability are improved.

title_en: Method and device for recommending related information of case of prosecution and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification discloses a method, a device and a storage medium for recommending related information of a case of prosecution, wherein the method comprises the following steps: inputting a case-starting book of a case-starting; dividing the content of the prosecution book, and structurally resolving and analyzing case routing information and crime fact information of the prosecution case; screening case information which is the same as the case information from a case knowledge base; calculating a first similarity between the criminal fact information and the case information; and taking the case information with the first similarity higher than a first preset threshold value as first recommendation information of the case of the complaint. According to the scheme, the query workload of the relevant information of the case to be taken out can be reduced, the case handling efficiency of the inspector is improved, and the accuracy of information recommendation can be improved.

title_en: Pneumatic design method suitable for rotor blade
abstract_en: The invention provides a pneumatic design method suitable for a rotor, which comprises the following steps: determining a number of blades of the rotor; determining a diameter of the rotor blade; selecting wing profiles at different radial positions from the rotor shaft; establishing an airfoil pneumatic performance database; estimating aerodynamic performance parameters of the rotor; an optimization algorithm is used to optimize the overall aerodynamic efficiency of the rotor blade. The pneumatic design method can improve the overall pneumatic efficiency of the rotor under the condition of meeting aerodynamic requirements of the tiltrotor in forward flight, hovering and transitional states.

title_en: Language searching method and device for multi-language translation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a language searching method and a language searching device for a multilingual translation system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: displaying an automatic detection interface after the translation system is started; the automated inspection interface includes: a language bar and a content box; the language bar comprises a language selection control; after a triggering instruction of a user for the language selection control is received, displaying various languages in the content box, and classifying and arranging different languages according to a preset rule; and after receiving a selection instruction of the language displayed in the content box from the user, displaying the language selected by the user in the language bar. By using the method and the device, the user can conveniently search and use the source and target languages to be translated, the searching efficiency is improved, and the user experience is improved.

title_en: Auxiliary rehabilitation robot system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an auxiliary rehabilitation robot system which comprises a robot, wherein the robot is provided with a trunk, a head and a walking mechanism, supporting devices are fixedly arranged on two sides of the trunk, each supporting device comprises a screw-nut mechanism, a screw rod and a feed bar of the screw-nut mechanism are vertically arranged on the side surface of the trunk, nuts of the screw-nut mechanism are arranged on the screw rod and the feed bar, a supporting ring is arranged on the outer side of each nut, and each supporting ring comprises a front half ring and a rear half ring; the rear half ring is fixedly arranged on the nut, the front half ring is rotatably arranged on the nut through a hinge shaft, the screw rod is connected with a lifting motor, the lifting motor drives the nut to lift, the hinge shaft is connected with an opening and closing motor, and the opening and closing motor drives the front half ring to rotate; the lifting motor and the opening and closing motor are connected with a first control circuit. The robot is arranged in the rotary rehabilitation device. The invention provides a rehabilitation assisting robot system which can assist the arm of a patient to walk and is beneficial to rehabilitation exercise of the patient.

title_en: Pantograph active control method capable of memorizing network prediction of contact force duration
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pantograph active control method for contact force duration memory network prediction, which belongs to the field of pantograph active control and comprises the following steps: s1: constructing a binary bow net system vibration coupling model; s2: carrying out stress analysis on the bow net coupling model, establishing a state space equation, and carrying out modeling simulation to obtain contact force simulation data; s3: establishing a prediction model based on an LSTM network, predicting the contact force F' at the next moment, calculating the control force u (t) required at the next moment by utilizing the prediction result and the expected value of the contact force, and establishing a controller by taking the control force u (t) as a core; s4: selecting and installing an actuator; s5: the damping force is applied to the pantograph system by the actuator, and a closed-loop contact force active control system is established. The invention reduces the fluctuation degree of the bow net contact force and improves the current collection quality of the train.

title_en: Multi-stage scheduling device, method, network chip and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a multi-stage scheduling device, a multi-stage scheduling method, a network chip and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the multi-stage scheduling device comprises: a data memory capable of storing data based on the linked list address; the linked list control module can update the state of the queue and control the dequeuing/enqueuing of the data from the corresponding queue; the secondary scheduler is connected with the linked list control module, acquires a queue state and selects a queue participating in scheduling; the final scheduler is connected with the secondary scheduler, receives data in response to the enqueue request of the secondary scheduler and can buffer the linked list address of the data; the read information module is connected with the final scheduler and can access the data memory based on the linked list address acquired by the final scheduler to acquire data corresponding to the linked list address; the linked list control module comprises a linked list memory, wherein the linked list memory is provided with a plurality of sub-memories which store linked list information and a read port for a secondary dispatcher to read the linked list.

title_en: Method for judging pipeline self-oscillation caused by leakage of hydropower station water inlet ball valve in advance
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for judging pipeline self-oscillation caused by leakage of a hydropower station water inlet ball valve in advance, which comprises the steps of firstly carrying out numerical simulation on the hydropower station water inlet ball valve, and simulating the pressure pulsation change of a sealed upstream side in 20s when the hydropower station water inlet ball valve has micro water leakage; meanwhile, the pressure pulsation value of the upstream side of the sealing of the actual ball valve is constantly monitored through a pressure pulsation sensor, the actually measured value is compared with the pressure pulsation value of the sealing upstream side when the ball valve leaks, which is obtained through simulation, and if the actually measured pressure value and the simulated value in 20s keep the same oscillation trend and amplitude variation trend, and a waveform of rapid oscillation and expansion of pressure pulsation occurs, the fact that the water inlet ball valve of the hydropower station leaks and causes self-oscillation of a pipeline is indicated, and corresponding measures should be taken as soon as possible so as to avoid self-oscillation and expansion and generation of destructive results. The method is simple, is intelligent to operate, and has wide application prospect in monitoring leakage of the water inlet ball valve of the hydropower station and self-excited oscillation of the pipeline.

title_en: Two-dimensional code identification method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a two-dimension code identification method, a two-dimension code identification device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: dividing a two-dimensional code array image to be identified to obtain a plurality of two-dimensional codes; identifying the current two-dimensional code based on an adjacent enhancement mode to obtain an identification result of the current two-dimensional code; and the adjacent enhancement mode is an image enhancement mode used for successfully identifying the adjacent two-dimensional codes of the current two-dimensional code in the two-dimensional code array image. The method, the device, the electronic equipment and the storage medium provided by the invention realize batch identification of all the two-dimensional codes in the two-dimensional code array diagram, reduce the identification time in the process of batch identification of the two-dimensional codes, reduce the complexity of an identification algorithm and improve the efficiency of batch identification of the two-dimensional codes.

title_en: Risk assessment change detection method, apparatus, device and storage medium
