abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence, and discloses a risk assessment transaction detection method, device, equipment and storage medium, which are used for detecting the transaction of risk assessment data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring behavior data and business data of a user; calculating an investment experience evaluation value, an intention evaluation value and a first accuracy and a second accuracy which correspond to the investment experience evaluation value and the intention evaluation value respectively according to the behavior data; calculating a risk bearing capacity evaluation value and a corresponding third accuracy according to the service data; when a user fills in questionnaire evaluation, comparing the evaluation value with evaluation data of the questionnaire evaluation to obtain a preliminary estimated transaction coefficient; and calculating the preliminary abnormal reliability according to the first accuracy, the second accuracy and the third accuracy, judging whether the preliminary estimated abnormal coefficient and the preliminary abnormal reliability are both larger than a preset threshold value, if so, sending user information of the user to a staff terminal. In addition, the invention also relates to a blockchain technology, and behavior data and business data of a user can be stored in the blockchain.

title_en: Rugged road detection method, apparatus, storage medium, electronic device, and vehicle
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a rough road detection method, apparatus, storage medium, electronic device and vehicle, which belongs to the field of vehicles, and which greatly reduces the amount of computation and has high detection precision. A rough road detection method comprising: acquiring a first type of image and a second type of image related to the same road surface, wherein the first type of image is a color and/or brightness image, and the second type of image is a depth image; extracting first road information according to the first type of image; according to the interweaving mapping relation between the first type of image and the second type of image, carrying out equal proportion adjustment on the first road information to obtain second road information corresponding to the first road information in the second type of image; and determining rough road information according to the first road information in the first type of image and the second road information in the second type of image.

title_en: On-line link pressure testing method and device, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a method and a device for testing pressure of an on-line link, electronic equipment and a medium. The method comprises the following steps: for each currently executed target test task, sending a service request to a target link corresponding to the target test task according to the sending frequency set for the target test task; acquiring alarm information collected from each server cluster, wherein each server cluster comprises a server cluster in each target link; determining a target test task in an abnormal state by matching the alarm information with a pre-constructed abnormal item set, wherein the abnormal item set comprises at least one abnormal item, and any abnormal item is used for determining whether the target test task corresponding to the abnormal item is in the abnormal state; and reducing the sending frequency corresponding to the target test task in the abnormal state, and sending the service request to the target link corresponding to the target test task in the abnormal state based on the reduced sending frequency, so that the link breakdown can be prevented.

title_en: Parameter verification method, system and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a parameter checking method, a system and a computer storage medium, wherein the parameter checking method comprises the following steps: acquiring an original product classification and an original parameter list corresponding to the original product classification; searching a standard product classification corresponding to the original product classification according to a mapping relation table, wherein the mapping relation table comprises a mapping relation between the original product classification and the standard product classification; acquiring a standard parameter list corresponding to standard product classification; and matching the original parameter list with the standard parameter list, and outputting a verification result. By the aid of the method, parameter verification efficiency can be improved, and user experience is improved.

title_en: Network risk assessment method based on map
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network risk assessment method based on a map, which comprises the following steps: s1, collecting data, preprocessing the data, and importing the data into a database to construct a knowledge graph; s2, generating an attack graph according to the network topology structure of the constructed knowledge graph and the connection relation between the nodes; s3, calculating the security quantization scores of the single nodes in the network of the knowledge graph, and calculating the security quantization scores of the whole network by using the calculated security quantization scores of the single nodes; the invention organizes and manages the network nodes by using the knowledge graph, can visually see the network organization condition and state, improves the accuracy and comparability of the result of the traditional network risk assessment method, and provides system risk alarm prompt and suggestion for safety personnel.

title_en: Audio data processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to an artificial intelligence technology, and discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for processing audio data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring audio data of each preset character in a preset audio format, converting the audio data into binary data, and acquiring a corresponding frame number; if the number of frames of the character binary data is more than or equal to 3 frames, cutting the binary data into a head part, a middle part and a tail part by adopting a preset cutting mode; taking the binary data corresponding to the middle part as a sounding frame of the corresponding character, associating the sounding frame with the corresponding character and storing the sounding frame locally; after the business data are obtained, determining the number level of the business data, and obtaining the data to be processed corresponding to the business data based on the number level; the method comprises the steps of obtaining each character in data to be processed, obtaining pronunciation frames respectively associated with each character in the data to be processed from the local, and splicing the corresponding pronunciation frames in sequence to obtain first audio data. The invention can timely and smoothly broadcast the audio data corresponding to the data part.

title_en: Deleted application list extraction method, terminal device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a deleted application list extraction method, a terminal device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1: collecting characteristic data of the application and constructing a characteristic database; s2: connecting the equipment to be analyzed, and acquiring characteristic data of the historical installation application in the equipment to be analyzed; s3: matching the acquired feature data corresponding to the equipment to be analyzed with the feature data in the feature database, and extracting the feature data capable of being matched; s4: acquiring a corresponding application list according to the extracted feature data capable of being matched; s5: and eliminating the application currently installed on the device to be analyzed in the obtained application list to obtain a deleted application list. The method and the device recover the deleted application list through intelligent matching of the characteristic database, have higher universality, can make up the defects of the existing scheme, and improve the technology in the aspect of data recovery.

title_en: Three-dimensional data encoding method, three-dimensional data decoding method, three-dimensional data encoding device, and three-dimensional data decoding device
abstract_en: A three-dimensional data encoding method for generating a plurality of encoded data by encoding a plurality of subspaces into which a target space including a plurality of three-dimensional points is divided (S5061); a bitstream including a plurality of encoded data and 1 st information indicating shapes of a plurality of subspaces is generated (S5062). For example, the shape may be a two-dimensional shape or a three-dimensional shape of the plurality of subspaces. For example, the shape may be a rectangle or a circle. For example, the bitstream may include 2 nd information indicating whether or not a plurality of subintervals are repeated.

title_en: Single page development method, frame and medium for large website
abstract_en: The invention discloses a single page development method, a single page development frame and a single page development medium for a large website, wherein the method comprises the following steps of: designing a shell page according to basic functions, and taking the shell page as a page resource loaded by a website for the first time; designing a plurality of single pages according to the function division, setting a page manager, and storing the page code of each single page according to different single pages; configuring a page manager to respond to a tag page loading request of a user and load a corresponding page code into a page container according to the request; and setting a page container, loading one or more single pages in the page container, using the loaded single pages as label pages, displaying the first label page according to the user interaction information, and hiding the rest label pages. The invention can provide a single-page development mode with extremely high speed, high efficiency and high performance for a large website platform.

title_en: Production information management system based on two-dimensional code recognition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of camera production, and particularly discloses a production information management system based on two-dimensional code identification, which comprises an AOI detection end and a server, wherein the AOI detection end comprises an AOI detection module and is used for acquiring a front image of a circuit board, comparing the front image with a pre-stored standard image and generating a detection result after comparison; the AOI detection end further comprises a two-dimensional code recognition module, the two-dimensional code recognition module is used for collecting a back image of the circuit board while the AOI detection module collects a front image of the circuit board, determining an area where the two-dimensional code is located from the back image, recognizing the two-dimensional code and extracting a product serial number in the two-dimensional code; the server comprises a processing module, and the processing module is used for acquiring the detection result from the AOI detection module, acquiring the product serial number from the two-dimensional code identification module, and associating the product serial number with the detection result. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, the AOI detection efficiency can be improved.

title_en: Training method of dialect recognition model, readable storage medium and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of computers, and particularly relates to a training method of a dialect recognition model, a computer-readable storage medium and terminal equipment. The method comprises the steps of determining an output dialect category corresponding to a voice sample according to a preset centroid by a preset dialect recognition model, wherein each centroid is used for representing the characteristic of one dialect category, adjusting model parameters according to the output dialect category and a target dialect category corresponding to the voice sample, and continuously executing the step of determining the output dialect category corresponding to the voice sample according to the preset centroid until preset training conditions are met, so that a trained dialect recognition model is obtained. Because the centroids of the preset dialect categories are used in the training process, the centroids of each dialect category can characterize the characteristics of the dialect category, and therefore reliable basis is provided for recognition of the dialect.

title_en: Network content security detection method, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a network content security detection method, an electronic device and a storage medium, wherein the network content security detection method comprises the following steps: acquiring first network content acquired according to a preset data acquisition mode, wherein the preset data acquisition mode at least comprises one of the following modes: analyzing network content and crawling a web crawler based on network traffic; detecting first data of first network content through a deep learning model, and determining the similarity of the first data and preset network data, wherein the preset network data comprise preset illegal network data and are used for determining whether the first data are illegal contents; and determining the network content safety detection result according to the similarity. By the method and the device, the problem of limited detection range of the network content is solved, the network content is detected by analyzing network flow and a crawler, and the detection range of the network content is expanded.

title_en: Machine vision calibration method for kinematic parameters of Stewart platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a machine vision calibration method for kinematic parameters of a Stewart platform, which comprises the steps of placing a camera on an upper platform of the Stewart platform, moving the upper platform to a specific pose for a plurality of times, shooting an image of a calibration template after each movement, detecting pixel coordinates of a cross intersection Point on a checkerboard calibration template in the image by a corner Point detection method, solving a Perspective-n-Point problem to obtain the pose of the camera relative to the calibration template, finally constructing an equality constrained kinematic parameter error model, and converting the model into an unconstrained model to perform optimized solution. The method for calibrating the kinematic parameters can obtain the kinematic parameters only through the change of the relative pose under the condition that the transformation relation between the camera coordinate system and the upper platform coordinate system is unknown, and can effectively determine the error of the initial length of the supporting rod.

title_en: Anti-collision structure for computer display screen
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-collision structure for a computer display screen, which comprises a lifting structure and a supporting structure, wherein the lifting structure comprises a lifting sliding frame, a lifting table and a stretching structure, the lifting sliding frame is in a U shape, two sides of the lifting sliding frame are both provided with sliding grooves in a penetrating manner, the middle part of the bottom surface of the lifting sliding frame is vertically provided with a screw barrel in a penetrating manner, two sides of the lifting sliding frame are horizontally provided with fixing nails in a penetrating manner, the lifting table is horizontally and movably arranged in the lifting sliding frame, the front end surface of the lifting table is horizontally provided with the stretching structure, and the front end surface of the stretching structure is vertically provided with the supporting. The invention can improve the limit support of the computer display screen, further ensure the stability of the support and the flexibility of later use, simultaneously facilitate the protection of the display screen, reduce the damage of external force collision to the display screen, improve the flexibility of use and ensure the integral service life of the display.

title_en: Kurtosis estimation method for non-Gaussian random vibration signal
abstract_en: The invention relates to a kurtosis estimation method of a non-Gaussian random vibration signal, which comprises the following steps of: constructing a new virtual control signal z (i) with the data length NN according to the obtained actual measurement control signal x1 (i) with the data length N1 and the constructed virtual control signal x2 (i) with the data length N2, and entering the next step when the data length NN of the new virtual control signal meets the accuracy requirement of statistical analysis; a step of estimating the sectional kurtosis: segmenting a new virtual control signal z (i) meeting the statistical analysis requirement, and respectively calculating kurtosis ku  i ; the kurtosis estimated value smoothing processing step: and calculating the arithmetic average value of the segmented kurtosis ku  i  to obtain a final estimated value ku. According to the invention, the kurtosis value of the non-Gaussian random vibration discrete signal with the finite length can be effectively estimated according to the actually measured non-Gaussian random vibration discrete signal; the method can be applied to the field of non-Gaussian random vibration test control of double-parameter equalization with Power Spectral Density (PSD) and kurtosis (ku) as targets, and random vibration simulated in a laboratory is closer to a real environment.

title_en: BIM-based assembled shelter hospital design method, system, intelligent terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a BIM-based assembled shelter hospital design method, which comprises the steps of obtaining a design drawing of an assembled shelter hospital, and establishing a three-dimensional integral model according to the obtained design drawing; performing preliminary performance test on the three-dimensional overall model to obtain overall simulation data, and judging whether the three-dimensional overall model can pass the preliminary performance test according to the overall simulation data; performing assembled segmentation on the three-dimensional integral model passing the test to obtain an assembled component model; splicing the assembled component models, and obtaining an assembled three-dimensional model; and performing secondary performance test on the assembled three-dimensional model to obtain assembly simulation data, and judging whether the assembled three-dimensional model can pass the secondary performance test according to the assembly simulation data. The invention has the effect of improving the tightness of the assembled shelter hospital.

title_en: Scarf pattern defect detection method based on improved YOLOv3
abstract_en: A scarf pattern defect detection method based on improved YOLOv3, the method comprising the steps of: step 1, obtaining scarf image data in a scarf production process; step 2, recovering the blurring moving image of the scarf; step 3, detecting the pattern edge of the scarf by using an improved YOLOv3 algorithm; step 4, setting pattern reference lines and dividing pattern small squares; and 5, detecting the flaw of the scarf by using Harris corner points. According to the invention, after the point spread function and wiener filtering are calculated, the problem of image blurring caused by movement in the scarf production process is solved, and meanwhile, the improved YOLOv3 algorithm is utilized to detect the pattern edge of the scarf, and the improved YOLOv3 detection algorithm has the advantages of easiness in convergence, reduction of regression difficulty of a detection frame and the like. Finally, the defect detection of the scarf is realized by using a Harris corner detection algorithm.

title_en: Method and system for determining fracturing section gas production contribution rate of segmented fractured shale gas well
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for determining a fracture section gas production contribution rate of a segmented fractured shale gas well. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a gas production contribution rate calculation model of each fracturing section of the shale gas well; the gas production contribution rate calculation model of each fracturing section of the shale gas well is a calculation model of the gas production contribution rate of each fracturing section of the shale gas well based on the burial depth, the pressure gradient of each burial depth point, the fracturing flow-back fluid property, the oil pipe diameter and the liquid production amount per unit time under a specific oil nozzle size working system; acquiring the burial depth of each fracturing section of a target staged fracturing shale gas well, the properties of fracturing flowback fluid, the diameter of an oil pipe, the liquid yield per unit time during the underground pressure gradient test of a specific oil nozzle size working system and pressure gradient parameter data of each depth point; and determining the gas production contribution rate of the target fracturing section under the working system of the specific choke nozzle size of the target staged fractured shale gas well by utilizing the gas production contribution rate calculation model of each fracturing section of the shale gas well based on the parameter data of the target staged fractured shale gas well.

title_en: Machining defect classification method of tooth restoration product based on machine vision
abstract_en: One or more embodiments of the present disclosure provide a method for classifying machining defects of a dental restoration product based on machine vision, which includes collecting an image of the dental restoration product on a production line, performing a fine-selection pre-processing on the image, wherein the pre-processing can highlight a target surface feature and reduce noise in the image, thereby achieving the purpose of improving the precision and speed of a target surface defect detection and classification algorithm, then eliminating the problem of illumination change to a certain extent by using an LBP defect feature extraction method, and calculating at a high speed, and finally designing an SVM classifier to quickly and accurately classify and identify defects on the surface of the dental restoration product.

title_en: Method, terminal and storage medium for converting land use type into plant function type
abstract_en: The application provides a method for converting land use types into plant function types, which comprises the steps of S1, establishing a conversion matrix for converting land use types into plant function types, S2, determining a standard of land use types, sequencing plant function types corresponding to the standard, S3, limiting land use types, a grid of plant function types and conversion coefficients, S4, determining punishment coefficients and objective functions, and S5, solving an optimal solution through linear programming. The best solution of X (X) can calculate the result using the R language package "lpsolve", so that the land use type can be better mapped into the plant function type through X in the initial state, the corresponding F value can be written as F (F e [ m, mn ]), p=m indicates that all land use types are perfectly converted into the plant function type, f=mn indicates that the expected result is achieved, and the quick and accurate completion of land use type conversion of the plant function type is realized.

title_en: Trajectory prediction method and related equipment
abstract_en: A track prediction method is applied to automatic driving in the field of artificial intelligence and comprises the steps of obtaining attitude information and historical motion track information (201) of a target object; acquiring target information (202) representing the behavior intention of the target object based on the posture information; and obtaining a predicted track (203) of the target object through a track prediction model by taking the target information and the historical track information as input. The method takes the behavior intention of the pedestrian as the input characteristic of the pedestrian track prediction, can reduce the prediction error of the pedestrian track and improve the prediction performance of the pedestrian track.

title_en: Transparent cover plate and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses transparent cover plate and manufacturing method thereof, the manufacturing method comprises the following steps: providing a transparent substrate, wherein the transparent substrate is provided with a first surface and a second surface which are opposite; carrying out roughening treatment on the first surface, and forming a micro-convex structure and a micro-concave structure on the first surface; and after the roughening treatment is finished, smoothing the preset light-through window area of the first surface so as to reduce the roughness of the light-through window area and improve the light transmittance of the light-through window area. This application technical scheme when making transparent cover, at first carries out the roughening treatment of whole face to transparent substrate's first surface, need not protection through-hole region, improves the efficiency of surface roughening treatment, accomplishes roughening treatment back, right the first surface predetermine and lead to light window region and carry out smooth processing, in order to reduce lead to the roughness in light window region, improve lead to the luminousness in light window region.

title_en: Forest road rapid identification method and system based on regional boundary pixel exchange
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a forest road real-time identification method and system based on regional boundary pixel exchange. Firstly, video images are collected, extracted and subjected to preliminary segmentation based on space constraint. And secondly, carrying out similarity judgment on the boundary pixels of the region by constructing an energy function, and determining the exchange of the boundary pixels and the brother connected domain according to the energy maximization condition. And (3) performing attribution judgment and exchange of all sub-region boundary pixels through iteration, realizing rapid region updating and rapid image segmentation, and generating a new region boundary. Then, introducing a sub-region feature operator through a support vector machine model, and quickly identifying and classifying each region. And finally, extracting the boundary coordinates of the road area, generating a smooth road boundary through spline curve fitting, and completing the real-time identification of the unstructured road area in the forest region. The method solves the problem of misidentification of the existing algorithm in the forest environment, and highlights the accuracy and instantaneity of identifying the unstructured roads in the forest.

title_en: Public service data processing method and device based on block chain
abstract_en: The specification provides a block chain-based public service data processing method and device, which are applied to a public service platform, wherein the public service platform is in butt joint with the block chain; the public service platform stores service qualification information of a plurality of volunteers authenticated by the block chain; the method comprises the following steps: receiving public service help seeking information sent by a client of a target help seeker; matching the target volunteer for the target beneficiary based on the public interest help information and the service qualification information of the plurality of volunteers stored on the public interest platform; and acquiring a target rescue contract negotiated by the target help seeker and the target volunteer, and sending the target rescue contract to the block chain.

title_en: Target detection method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a target detection method and a target detection device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a target detection model based on YOLO-v4, and adding a prediction neuron in each grid cell of the target detection model to enable each grid cell to have a plurality of prediction neurons; dividing an image for target detection into a plurality of grids by using a target detection model, and determining a grid unit corresponding to each grid; detecting a boundary box corresponding to the target based on each grid unit, and determining a plurality of initial confidence degrees of the boundary box by a plurality of prediction neurons in the grid unit of which the boundary box is detected; obtaining a final confidence coefficient of the corresponding boundary box according to the plurality of initial confidence coefficients of each boundary box; and determining a target detection result according to the final confidence of each bounding box. According to the technical scheme, the network structure of the target detection model based on YOLO-v4 is changed, so that each grid unit in the target detection model has a plurality of prediction neurons with predictable confidence degrees, and the accuracy improvement of target detection is finally realized.

title_en: Animal and plant breeding value prediction method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for predicting breeding values of animals and plants, which belong to the field of breeding value prediction. According to the prediction method provided by the scheme, after the first breeding value is obtained through calculation, the markers of each chromosome are weighted according to the first breeding value, the fact that all the markers have effects is not required to be assumed, high-density marker information is effectively utilized, the accuracy of the final breeding value is improved, the calculation process is simple, and the prediction time and the calculation cost are reduced.

title_en: Software deployment method, device and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of software, in particular to a software deployment method, a device and a computer readable storage medium, which aim to solve the technical problem of how to efficiently and reliably deploy software. For this purpose, according to the embodiment of the invention, the software components to be deployed and the configuration information thereof can be obtained by analyzing the software deployment instruction, then the configuration file of the software is generated according to the configuration information, and finally the deployment installation package of the software is generated according to the software package of each software component and the configuration file. When the software is deployed, the deployment and installation of the software on the server can be completed by only running the deployment and installation package on the server needing to be deployed with the software. In addition, when the deployment installation package is operated, each software component in the installation package can be correspondingly configured and operated according to the corresponding configuration information, and delivery personnel are not required to configure and debug one by one, so that the efficiency and reliability of software deployment are obviously improved.

title_en: CAE simulation analysis strength durability performance data management method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a CAE simulation analysis strength durability data management method and a device thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step S100: acquiring simulation data generated by CAE simulation analysis strength durability, and storing the simulation data in a classified manner; step S200: acquiring analysis models corresponding to analysis results in a simulation historical database one by one, and judging whether the analysis models used by the historical data are of the same type; step S210: if so, comparing the different simulation result data of the same type of analysis model with the production comparison report; step S220: if not, return to step S200. The preprocessing data, the calculation result data and the generated report are respectively stored, and are respectively stored according to the project stage, the project name, the basic analysis, the optimization analysis and the processing time, so that effective summarization of a large amount of data is realized, an engineer can conveniently call data with different characteristics as required, and effective summarization and processing of the data are realized.

title_en: Deep learning-based food material feature extraction and compression method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of image search and the field of intelligent home furnishing, and particularly relates to a food material feature extraction and compression method based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of configuring a refrigerator camera, and enabling the camera to clearly shoot a process of a user for storing and taking food materials; step two, training a deep learning algorithm model; step three, feature extraction; step four, compressing the characteristic values; and step five, warehousing the characteristic values. The method solves the problem that the features of all dimensions of the image cannot be well extracted by the traditional feature extraction algorithm, the features extracted by the deep learning algorithm can well reflect the features of all dimensions of the image, the feature value extraction of the intelligent refrigerator food material is completed by utilizing the deep learning technology, the problem that the feature extraction of the traditional feature value extraction method is insufficient is solved, the features of all dimensions of the image can be extracted by the deep learning algorithm, and the accuracy of image search feature value comparison and refrigerator food material identification is improved.

title_en: Korean pronunciation correction system based on big data mining technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to a Korean pronunciation correction system based on big data mining technology, which utilizes a sensor to detect the formant frequency and the position changes of the tongue and the chin in the pronunciation process to determine the chin pronunciation parameters related to the pitch, and also utilizes magnetic resonance imaging and palate electrogram data to capture the three-dimensional sound channel geometrical characteristics of near consonants in the pronunciation process, and guides the dynamic adjustment of the movements of the lower jaw, the tongue and the throat of a learner according to the actual phoneme string and standard pronunciation.

title_en: Remote instruction response system and method for delivery robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote instruction response system and method for a delivery robot, and relates to the technical field of Internet of things. The method comprises the following steps: the user side sends the control instruction to the user cloud server, the user cloud server records the control cloud server, and the control cloud server issues the control instruction to the robot; the robot records and observes the control command to perform response or interruption processing, uploads self state information to the data cloud server, the data cloud server stores the state information, sends the state information to the user cloud server at regular time, and renders the state information on the user terminal. The remote instruction response method provided by the invention adopts a duplex communication mechanism for communication, the control and feedback are mutually independent, the remote instruction response method has better response capability and network fault tolerance capability, and programs at all ends adopt an observation mode and a light memory mode, so that the remote instruction response method has better response capability to environmental data change, and the robot can timely respond to remote instructions in the distribution process.

title_en: Block chain transaction consensus method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a block chain transaction consensus method and device, and relates to the technical field of computers. One embodiment of the method comprises: initiating a block consensus request, wherein the block consensus request comprises a block to be consensus; the block to be identified comprises at least one number, and each number corresponds to one transaction; determining whether a first transaction acquisition request is received, the first transaction acquisition request including at least one target number; the first transaction acquisition request is sent when a consensus node of a block to be consensus is received and at least one transaction corresponding to the number is determined to be missing, and the target number is the number of the missing transaction; and if so, sending the transaction corresponding to the target number to the consensus node sending the first transaction acquisition request. In the embodiment, when the block is identified, the identified data only has the number, and the block can pack more transactions, thereby improving the system throughput.

title_en: Service state circulation maintenance method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a service state flow maintenance method, a service state flow maintenance device and electronic equipment, which are used for at least solving the problem that the throughput of the whole service system is influenced by the existing service state flow maintenance mode. The method comprises the following steps: responding to target service operation of a specified service, and acquiring the current service state and service data of the specified service; searching a conversion strategy corresponding to the target business operation from a state machine instance pre-established for the specified business, wherein the state machine instance comprises business states related in a business process of the specified business and a conversion strategy between the business states, and the conversion strategy is used for indicating a conversion relation between the business states, a conversion condition and a corresponding relation between the business operations triggering the business state conversion; and performing state transfer maintenance on the service state of the specified service based on the searched conversion strategy and the current service state and service data of the specified service.

title_en: Account verification method and device in online shopping scene
abstract_en: The application discloses an account verification method and device in an online shopping scene. Determining the commodity browsed by the user this time as a reference commodity according to the operation executed by the user; if the ordering operation of the user is detected, determining the commodity targeted by the ordering operation as a target commodity; determining the comprehensive similarity between the target commodity and each commodity in the shopping cart of the user under the condition that the quantity of the reference commodities is not more than the quantity threshold value; determining a risk value of the ordering operation according to the comprehensive similarity between the target commodity and each commodity in the shopping cart of the user; and if the risk value is greater than the risk threshold value, generating and displaying verification indication information, so that the user executes verification operation according to the verification indication information. Therefore, by adopting the method in the specification, when the order placing stage is detected to enter, risk identification is carried out according to the target commodity targeted by the order placing, high-risk behaviors such as order swiping can be effectively identified, and corresponding account number verification measures are taken to avoid the risk caused by the order swiping from spreading to the payment stage.

title_en: Open fire detection method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an open fire detection method, which determines a highlight object by a method of searching a white image block through gray level binarization processing of an acquired image, further finds out an object outline to extract characteristics, and can simply and conveniently locate a high-temperature highlight part; in addition, in the method, feature items for distinguishing and identifying contour features of open fire and non-open fire are defined, namely Hu moment features and direction vector list features, the feature items well describe the contour shape of a white pattern block, and accurate distinguishing can be realized through the contour shape features; in addition, the classifier is applied to realize feature classification aiming at the extracted target features, so that accurate classification aiming at the features can be ensured, and accurate identification is realized. The invention also discloses an open fire detection device, equipment and a readable storage medium, and has corresponding technical effects.

title_en: Method, device and system for processing abnormal information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a system for processing abnormal information, and relates to the technical field of mobile interconnection and automatic program design. One embodiment of the method comprises: the method comprises the steps of generating an abstract syntax tree based on an applied source code, searching a node to be processed from the abstract syntax tree, generating a new abstract syntax tree after adding exception handling information to the node, generating an applied target code based on the new abstract syntax tree, and acquiring the exception information of the application through a newly added exception handling module.

title_en: Text recognition data synthesis method based on image fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a text recognition data synthesis method based on image fusion, which comprises the following steps: firstly, collecting text line pictures containing characters, and establishing a text picture library; then constructing a dynamic character instance segmentation network, and predicting each picture in a text picture library to obtain a mask of each character and a background picture after the character is removed; and finally, synthesizing a new text line picture according to the character mask and the background picture. The method can quickly synthesize massive vivid text images and solve the problem of lack of training data in the field of text recognition, thereby improving the accuracy and robustness of a text recognition model.

title_en: Method for using lock protocol under parallel task grouping scheduling
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for using lock protocol under parallel task grouping scheduling, which is characterized in that subtasks are fixedly distributed to each specific core through P-FP scheduling, so that the subtasks can be approximately regarded as serial tasks, and then shared resource l is used  q  The method is divided into local resources and global resources, the priorities of the subtasks, the priorities of the processors and the like are set, and through the setting, the allocation among the subtasks, the shared resources and the processors and the use of the lock protocol are combined, so that the technical requirement of the lock protocol of the serial task in the technical field of parallel task scheduling in the prior art is met, the lock protocol of the serial task can be adaptively migrated to the scheduling of the parallel task, the problems of deadlock, blocking chains and the like of the parallel task are reduced, the scheduling loss caused by priority overturning is reduced, and the scheduling efficiency of the parallel task is improved.

title_en: Nameplate and label bar code binding device for intelligent electric meter and using method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent electric meters, and particularly relates to a nameplate and label bar code binding device for an intelligent electric meter and a use method of the nameplate and label bar code binding device.

title_en: Picture sharing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure discloses a picture sharing method, relates to the field of artificial intelligence, and particularly relates to an information sharing technology. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: receiving a sharing instruction which is sent by a sharing user and aims at a target picture and target characters corresponding to the target picture; responding to the sharing instruction to identify the target characters, and obtaining an identification result corresponding to the target characters; identifying the target picture based on the identification result corresponding to the target text to obtain the identification result corresponding to the target picture; and sharing the target picture to at least one preselected user to be shared according to the identification result corresponding to the target picture. According to the embodiment of the application, the pictures can be automatically optimized in the picture sharing process, so that the target friends can be ensured to clearly see the content which the sharing user wants to share, the purpose of effectively sharing the pictures is achieved, and the browsing and interactive experience of the user is further improved.

title_en: Knowledge graph-based reasoning method and device and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a knowledge graph-based reasoning method, a device and a computer-readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: searching a second connected subgraph corresponding to the first connected subgraph in the knowledge graph, wherein in both any second connected subgraph and the corresponding first connected subgraph, one node does not belong to the intersection of the two nodes, and the second connected subgraph has one potential side less than the corresponding first connected subgraph, and if the potential side is increased by the second connected subgraph, the potential side is isomorphic with the corresponding first connected subgraph; and taking the potential edge as a predicted edge, or screening the predicted edge from the potential edges according to the statistical information of the potential edge. The method has the advantages of strong universality, strong interpretability, simple algorithm and low code development cost.

title_en: Method for managing cooperative work of multiple homogeneous intelligent algorithms to improve accuracy
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for managing cooperative work of multiple homogeneous intelligent algorithms to improve accuracy, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a training image set; dividing a training image set into two sets according to a proportion; a model training process; and (3) actual test process: and selecting the optimal intelligent algorithm corresponding to each image characteristic type according to the optimal prediction scoring matrix, and then carrying out intelligent identification by adopting the selected intelligent algorithm. Has the advantages that: the invention provides a method for managing cooperative work of multiple homogeneous intelligent algorithms to improve accuracy, which effectively fuses various intelligent algorithms, selects the intelligent algorithm with the best recognition effect on each image characteristic dimension of an analyzed image, thereby obtaining the best recognition result of the analyzed image in each image characteristic dimension and finally improving the accuracy of intelligent recognition of the analyzed image.

title_en: Kafka mechanism-based electricity consumption information acquisition method, blockchain network and user terminal
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an electricity consumption information acquisition method based on a Kafka mechanism, which comprises the following steps: the user node submits a transaction proposal to the endorsement node; the endorsement node receives the transaction proposal, endorses the transaction proposal, generates endorsement information, and sends the endorsement information to the user node; after receiving the endorsement information, the user node sends the endorsement information and the transaction proposal one to the ordering node; the ordering node orders and packages the transaction information into blocks according to the communication success rate and sends the blocks to the accounting node; the billing node bills the generated new block. The updated communication success rate is used for sorting on the sorting nodes of the Kafka mechanism, so that transactions submitted by the nodes with high communication success rate and high collection speed are preferentially successful, resources are preferentially vacated for next round of data collection, collection efficiency is integrally improved, new block generation speed is accelerated, and orderly and healthy work of the electricity consumption information collection block chain is promoted.

title_en: Method and device for deleting index items in memory
abstract_en: A method of deleting index entries in a memory includes selecting a target storage unit to be eliminated from the plurality of storage units (410), reading all index entries in the target storage unit (420), wherein all index entries in the target storage unit are continuously stored in the target storage unit, deleting all read index entries from the memory index table (430), and marking the target storage unit as free (440). According to the method, the index items corresponding to the plurality of data cached on the memory can be read through one IO, so that the same index items can be deleted in the index table of the memory.

title_en: BVH construction method and device for GPU and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a BVH construction method and device for a GPU and a storage medium. And deploying a BVH construction device on the GPU, wherein in the process of constructing the BVH, the node bounding box of the node and the primitive bounding box of the primitive surrounded by the node bounding box both use a spherical bounding box. The spherical bounding box can save the occupation of the storage bandwidth of the device in the process of constructing the BVH, and simultaneously reduce the time for constructing the BVH and improve the rate of outputting the BVH.

title_en: Fault detection method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification does not detect each hardware or software on the unmanned equipment independently, but obtains the current comprehensive sensing result of a plurality of unmanned equipment, determines a first difference between the current comprehensive sensing result of each unmanned equipment and the current comprehensive sensing result of other unmanned equipment, and detects whether the unmanned equipment has a fault according to the first difference. Because the comprehensive sensing result is not a result output by a certain hardware or software independently, but a final sensing result of all hardware and software is synthesized, the method can detect whether the unmanned equipment has faults which can influence the automatic driving function or not on the whole based on the final sensing result of the unmanned equipment, can reduce the maintenance cost of the unmanned equipment, and can improve the use efficiency of the unmanned equipment.

title_en: Commodity anti-counterfeiting two-dimensional code generation method based on scrambling encryption
abstract_en: The invention discloses a commodity anti-counterfeiting two-dimensional code generation method based on scrambling encryption, which comprises the following steps: carrying out numerical data and 8-bit binary conversion on a commodity identification code representing unique identity information of a certain commodity to obtain a combined binary matrix B; adjusting extraction positions in real time, performing chaotic iteration and extracting to generate chaotic sequences Y1 and Y2; scrambling the matrix B by rows by using a sequence Y1 descending sorting front and rear position change rule, and scrambling the binary matrix after row scrambling by rows by using a sequence Y2 descending sorting front and rear position change rule to obtain a binary matrix after row and column scrambling Will matrix The numerical data converted from each row of elements is filled into a matrix representing a gray image to generate a gray image, and the gray image is combined to generate the anti-counterfeiting commodityAnd (5) two-dimensional codes. The commodity anti-counterfeiting two-dimensional code generation method based on scrambling encryption is simple and feasible, has strong safety and is not easy to crack, and the generated commodity anti-counterfeiting two-dimensional code has uniqueness and non-forgeability.

title_en: Quantum state measurement method, device, equipment, storage medium and system
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a quantum state measurement method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a system, and relates to the field of quantum computation. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: the receiving end receives quantum states to be processed from at least two quantum channels, the quantum channels at least comprise a first quantum channel and a second quantum channel, the received quantum states to be processed at least comprise a first quantum state to be processed and a second quantum state to be processed, and the first quantum state to be processed is a quantum state after a target unknown quantum state at the sending end is transmitted through the first quantum channel; the second pending quantum state is a quantum state after the target unknown quantum state is transmitted via the second quantum channel; and at least carrying out data processing on the first quantum state to be processed and the second quantum state to be processed, so that noise information contained in the first quantum state to be processed and the second quantum state to be processed is cancelled out, and a target measurement result aiming at the target unknown quantum state is obtained. Thus, over-distance measurement is realized.

title_en: Road condition information determining method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a road condition information determining method, a road condition information determining device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, relates to the technical field of data processing, and further relates to technologies such as artificial intelligence, deep learning and intelligent traffic, and the technologies comprise the following steps: determining track prediction road condition information of the road section to be predicted according to navigation track data of the road section to be predicted; under the condition that the road section to be predicted meets the image prediction scheduling condition, determining image prediction road condition information of the road section to be predicted according to road section image data of the road section to be predicted; and determining target predicted road condition information of the road section to be predicted according to the track predicted road condition information and/or the image predicted road condition information. According to the embodiment of the application, the accuracy and the timeliness of the road condition information can be improved, and therefore the user experience is improved.

title_en: Tight coupling initialization method for underwater vision inertial navigation pressure positioning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of robot positioning, and particularly relates to a close coupling initialization method for underwater vision inertial navigation pressure positioning. The method utilizes the high-frequency IMU information to couple the image information and the pressure information under different time steps, strengthens the coupling degree among all initialization parameters, and improves the solving precision of the initialization algorithm.

title_en: Model training method, forest land change detection system, forest land change detection device and forest land change detection medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a model training method, a forest land change detection system, a forest land change detection device and a forest land change detection medium, and relates to the field of remote sensing image processing; extracting a vegetation coverage area from the remote sensing image, dividing the vegetation coverage area into a forest land area and a non-forest land area, and carrying out classification marking on the forest land area and the non-forest land area to obtain a classification label map; constructing a classification model, wherein the input of the classification model is a remote sensing image of a preset area, and the output of the classification model is a forest area and a non-forest area in the remote sensing image of the preset area; collecting a plurality of characteristic data of the forest land area and the non-forest land area from the classification label graph, training the classification model based on the characteristic data, and rapidly and accurately obtaining the forest land area and the non-forest land area in the remote sensing image through the classification model trained by the invention.

title_en: Image sensing circuit and image depth sensing system
abstract_en: The invention provides an image sensing circuit, which comprises a photosensitive pixel array, a first clock signal receiving circuit, a second clock signal receiving circuit and a second clock signal receiving circuit, wherein the photosensitive pixel array comprises a plurality of photosensitive pixel strings, the first end of the first photosensitive pixel string in the plurality of photosensitive pixel strings receives the first clock signal, the first end of the second photosensitive pixel string in the plurality of photosensitive pixel strings receives the second clock signal, and the photosensitive pixel array outputs a plurality of pixel values; a delay latch circuit for outputting the first clock signal to the first end of the first string of photosensitive pixels and outputting the second clock signal to the first end of the second string of photosensitive pixels, the first clock signal and the second clock signal having the same delay; and an image depth determining unit, coupled to the photosensitive pixel array and the reference pixel array, for determining an image depth according to the plurality of pixel values and the plurality of phase differences.

title_en: Design method and system of direct current loop impedance
abstract_en: The application discloses a design method and a system of direct current loop impedance, which directly calculate the optimal direct current loop impedance through a mathematical model, save the lengthy modeling simulation time in electromagnetic transient software and improve the calculation efficiency; the design method carries out global solution in the feasible domain of the system parameters, the obtained optimal system parameters and the DC loop impedance are the results which best meet the optimization target on the premise of system stability, and the situations of incomplete consideration or incomplete optimization and the like possibly existing in manual iterative design are avoided, so that the DC loop impedance design has higher precision; furthermore, the direct current loop impedance design method has the advantages that through the analytic optimization design that parameterization can be carried out on the direct current loop impedance according to different optimization design targets, repeated targeted adjustment and iteration are carried out on system parameters by professional designers, manpower and time are saved, and the technical problems that the existing direct current loop impedance design method is low in efficiency and poor in precision are solved.

title_en: Display panel
abstract_en: The application discloses a display panel, which comprises a touch layer, wherein the touch layer at least comprises a transparent metal layer, and a light contraction structure is formed on the light emergent side of the display panel by the transparent metal layer; the transparent metal layer through current display panel forms light constriction structure, need not newly-increased rete, under the prerequisite that does not change current rete thickness, gathers together light through light constriction structure, has reduced display panel's large visual angle light leak.

title_en: Image description method based on visual embedding and condition normalization
abstract_en: The invention discloses an image description method based on visual embedding and condition normalization. The invention provides a network based on a transformer model, which is called V-CLTM. At the input end of the transform model, extracting a target category in the image as a keyword by using a Keyword Embedding Module (KEM), and combining a text sequence as an input sequence; using a Visual Embedding Module (VEM) for extracting image features and encoding the features into a normalization layer of a transform can accept dimensions as conditional input; meanwhile, the conditional normalized LN layer provided by the invention is an effective mechanism for adjusting the model to perform feature selection through visual embedding, and the conditional normalized LN is applied to a transformer. The result shows that the method has better robustness and adaptive capacity.

title_en: Image comparison method, apparatus, electronic device, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an image comparison method, apparatus, electronic device, computer-readable storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a first pixel matrix of a reference image and a second pixel matrix of an image to be tested, determining a first characteristic value corresponding to the first pixel matrix and a second characteristic value corresponding to the second pixel matrix, comparing the first characteristic value and the second characteristic value to obtain similarity, and determining a comparison result of the image to be tested and the reference image according to the similarity. According to the scheme, the pixel matrix is directly processed, so that the data processing amount is reduced, whether the images are matched or not is judged by comparing the characteristic values of the images, and the image comparison efficiency is greatly improved because the images do not need to be reconstructed.

title_en: Manual-CACC automatic driving vehicle mixed flow simulation method based on cellular automata
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hybrid flow simulation method of a manual-CACC automatic driving vehicle based on a cellular automaton, which comprises the following steps: step 1, determining the safe distance between a manually-driven vehicle and a CACC automatically-driven vehicle; step 2, establishing a cellular automaton model of a manually driven vehicle; step 3, establishing a cellular automaton model of the CACC automatic driving vehicle; and 4, inputting the numerical value of the traffic flow to be simulated into the models in the step 2 and the step 3, and simulating the traffic flow mixed with the vehicles. The invention provides a method for modeling a mixed traffic flow of a manual-CACC automatic driving vehicle by combining a CACC automatic driving following model and a cellular automaton model, and reasonably simulates a vehicle mixed flow by considering the influence of the occurrence of CACC automatic driving vehicles on manual drivers on the characteristics of the mixed traffic flow.

title_en: Face detection and tracking method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for face detection and tracking, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a video frame; judging whether the current video frame meets the condition of the first frame or the condition of continuously tracking four frames of the video; if the condition of the first frame or the four frames of continuous tracking of the video is met, detecting the coordinates of a first face frame and the position coordinates of five key points of the first face; and if the condition of the first frame or the four frames of continuous tracking of the video is not met, tracking the position coordinates of the five key points of the second face according to the position coordinates of the five key points of the first face, and updating the coordinates of the second face frame. According to the embodiment of the application, the five key points of the face are used as tracking targets, the tracking is not easy to follow, the position coordinates of the five key points of the first face are obtained every five times of detection, then the tracking is performed, the position coordinates of the five key points of the second face are tracked according to the position coordinates of the five key points of the first face, and the coordinates of the second face frame are updated, so that the tracked coordinates of the second face frame are more stable and do not shake.

title_en: Mountain torrent forecasting and early warning method and system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent forecasting and early warning method and system based on digital twins, wherein the forecasting and early warning method comprises the following steps of constructing a digital twins database; constructing a digital twin watershed; on the basis of collecting multi-source precipitation forecast products, generating future ensemble average precipitation forecast results by adopting a geometric average method, forming precipitation ensemble forecast together with a single precipitation forecast product, and updating future precipitation data in a digital twin database in real time; coupling the rainfall ensemble forecast with a digital twin basin to realize the rolling forecast of the torrential flood; and based on the torrential flood forecast result, intelligently identifying the torrential flood risk level, generating an early warning decision and sending out early warning information according to the early warning classification standard. The advantages are that: the method solves the problem that the existing torrent forecasting and early warning method cannot accurately depict and reflect the current and future conditions of the drainage basin at the same time, and can accurately provide torrent disaster early warning information, dynamically evaluate risk levels and automatically issue early warning decisions so as to smoothly carry out torrent disaster defense work.

title_en: Blast furnace fault monitoring and self-healing control system based on dynamic Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blast furnace fault monitoring and self-healing control system based on a dynamic Bayesian network, which comprises a distributed industrial field data acquisition module, a centralized storage module, a centralized fault monitoring, diagnosing and self-healing control module and a distributed terminal control module. The centralized fault monitoring, diagnosing and self-healing control module is constructed based on a dynamic Bayesian network and comprises three layers, namely a symptom layer, a fault layer and a control layer, wherein the control layer comprises a plurality of stages related to time. The invention can monitor whether the production process of the blast furnace is abnormal in real time, can carry out fault diagnosis when the monitoring index is abnormal, and can output the adjustment value of the control quantity by inference according to the type and the severity of the fault, the control strategy is divided into different action stages according to the fault duration time after the self-healing control action, and the dynamic requirement of the control process can be met, thereby automatically eliminating the fault in the production process of the blast furnace and ensuring the safe and stable production of the blast furnace.

title_en: Longitudinal federal k-Means privacy protection method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data mining, and relates to a method, a device and electronic equipment for protecting the privacy of a longitudinal federal k-Means; the method comprises the steps that a participant encrypts sample data and uploads the sample data to a cloud server; the cloud server randomly selects a clustering center, calculates the sub-distance difference of the participants by using a secure multiplication protocol and sends the sub-distance difference to the participants; the participants divide the received sub-distance difference into shares and distribute, calculate the sum of the shares held by the participants and the received shares and send the sum to the cloud server; the cloud server divides the samples into clusters with the nearest cluster centers; calculating the sum of each characteristic of all samples in each cluster according to the clustering result, and updating the clustering center; the cloud server returns the clustering result to the participant until the clustering center is not changed or is changed slightly; the invention fully protects the data privacy of the participants, does not reveal a new clustering center to the participants, and can resist collusion attack so as to have higher security.

title_en: Vision detection system and method based on deep learning and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vision detection system, a method and a storage medium based on deep learning, wherein the vision detection system comprises an identification display module, an image acquisition module, a posture evaluation module and a result evaluation module; the image acquisition module is used for acquiring images of limb actions made by the arms of the user and inputting the images into the posture evaluation module; the gesture evaluation module is used for detecting and acquiring gesture key points of limb actions made by the arms; and the result evaluation module judges the arm state of the user according to the arm posture key point of the user, further judges whether the action of the user is consistent with the vision detection identification, and outputs a detection result. The result evaluation module judges whether the hand posture direction of the user is consistent or not according to the hand posture direction of the user, the hand posture is larger than the finger direction, the target is easier to identify, and the detection precision is higher.

title_en: Knee joint MRI image classification method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a knee joint MRI image classification method and a knee joint MRI image classification device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a coronal MRI image and a sagittal MRI image of a knee joint, and preprocessing the coronal MRI image and the sagittal MRI image to obtain a preprocessed coronal MRI image and a preprocessed sagittal MRI image; inputting the preprocessed coronal MRI images and the preprocessed sagittal MRI images into a Siamese ACL network in parallel for primary classification so as to determine whether the coronal MRI images and the sagittal MRI images of the knee joint belong to normal samples or fracture samples; when determining that the coronal MRI image and the sagittal MRI image of the knee joint belong to the fractured samples, classifying the fractured samples again through a ResNextACL network to determine the specific fracture type to which the fractured samples belong. Through the technical scheme, the specific fracture types of the MRI images of the knee joint can be classified.

title_en: Examination management system based on big data and intelligent education
abstract_en: The invention relates to an examination management system based on big data and intelligent education, which comprises: the intelligent education cloud platform is in communication connection with the examination management terminal and the intelligent invigilating equipment respectively; the intelligent education cloud platform comprises an image processing module, an examinee dividing module, an examinee mapping module, a behavior recognition module and a database, wherein the modules are in communication connection. And the image processing module generates an invigilation image sequence according to the monitoring video. And the examinee dividing module processes the invigilated image sequence according to the examination seat distribution information to obtain an invigilated image packet. And the examinee mapping module performs examinee mapping processing on all invigilator sub-image sets in the invigilator sub-image packet according to the examinee seat mapping information to obtain an examinee invigilator sequence packet. The behavior recognition module analyzes the examinee invigilation sequence to determine whether the corresponding examinee cheats, and sends cheating warning information to the examination management terminal when the corresponding examinee cheats.

title_en: Network entity joint sale system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of online shopping, in particular to a network entity joint sale system, which comprises a client, an entity merchant and a server, wherein the client is used for uploading commodity purchase demands of users after the users register and log in; the server receives the commodity purchasing demand, the distribution of the commodity purchasing demand is realized based on the geographic position of the user and the characteristic data of the commodity purchasing demand, and the entity merchant terminal uploads the related commodity introduction videos according to the received commodity purchasing demand and feeds the videos and the corresponding entity store information back to the client terminal. The invention realizes the combination of online shopping and entity shopping, and ensures the authenticity of goods on the premise of simplifying the shopping process of people; a new mode is provided for the operation of the entity merchant, thereby being beneficial to the survival of the entity merchant.

title_en: Pairing method and pairing system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a pairing method and a pairing system, wherein the pairing system comprises: the touch control pen comprises a first coil, the wireless keyboard comprises a second coil, and the method comprises the following steps: responding to the wireless keyboard to charge the touch pen through the second coil and the first coil, and sending a pairing request to the wireless keyboard through the first coil and the second coil by the touch pen; the wireless keyboard sends a pairing request to the electronic equipment; the electronic equipment displays a matching bullet frame based on the matching request, and the matching bullet frame is used for prompting a user to trigger the electronic equipment and the touch pen to be matched. In the embodiment of the application, the touch pen uses the wireless keyboard as an intermediate device for pairing the electronic equipment and the touch pen, and the wireless keyboard can directionally transmit the pairing request of the touch pen to the electronic equipment, so that the purpose of popping frames of the electronic equipment is achieved, the purpose of popping frames of other electronic equipment around the touch pen is avoided, and the user experience is improved.

title_en: Method and system for accelerating AI training by using advanced interconnection technology
abstract_en: In accordance with various embodiments, methods and systems are provided for accelerating Artificial Intelligence (AI) model training utilizing advanced interconnection communication techniques and systematic null compression on a distributed training system. During each iteration of performing a Scatter-reduction process on clusters of processors (117, 119, 121) arranged in a logical ring to train the neural network model (701), the processors receive compressed data blocks from a previous processor (107) in the logical ring, perform operations on the received compressed data blocks and compressed data blocks generated on the processors (117, 119, 121) to obtain calculated data blocks, and send the calculated data blocks to subsequent processors (117, 119, 121) in the logical ring (702). Compressed data blocks calculated from respective data blocks from a plurality of processors (117, 119, 121) may be identified on each processor (117, 119, 121) and distributed to and decompressed in each of the other processors (117, 119, 121) for use in AI model training (703).

title_en: Method for monitoring dynamic deflection of standard beam of 32 meters of high-speed railway based on strain mode
