abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for monitoring dynamic deflection of a standard beam of 32 meters of a high-speed railway based on a strain mode, which comprises the following steps: based on the characteristics of the load unbalance distribution of the train, a 'strain-dynamic deflection' model considering the correction of the distance from a measuring point to an equivalent neutral layer is established by adopting a modal strain theory based on a vibration mode superposition method, the distance from the strain measuring point to the equivalent neutral layer of the section of the box girder and the selection of the modal matrix vibration mode order have obvious influence on the reconstruction precision of the established strain-dynamic deflection conversion model, the distance from the strain measuring point to the equivalent neutral layer of the section of the box girder under the action of the load unbalance of the train is corrected by using Ansys numerical simulation, the selection of the modal order of the modal matrix is optimized by using a particle swarm algorithm, and the effectiveness and the accuracy of the invention are shown by UM multi-body dynamics simulation data set and actual dynamic load test results. The invention improves the automation, the intellectualization, the accuracy and the robustness of the intelligent identification of the bridge health monitoring real-time early warning subsystem.

title_en: Fire spread prediction method suitable for transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire spread prediction method suitable for a transformer substation, which comprises the following steps: (a) Constructing a three-dimensional model of a transformer substation, and acquiring transformer substation buildings, transformer substation equipment, transformer substation fire monitoring points and transformer substation fire monitoring state data; (b) Carrying out finite element division based on the structure of the transformer substation building and the density of the transformer substation equipment to form a finite element calculation area, and dividing the finite element calculation area into a plurality of finite element grids according to the finite element calculation area; (c) Abstracting each finite element grid into a flammable point, and calculating the temperature of the adjacent finite element grids from the flammable point; (d) And (d) based on the step (c), carrying out grid deduction on the fire spreading condition of the whole substation area layer by layer from the fire point. The method adopts a finite element method to construct a three-dimensional fire scene model with higher fineness, calculate a temperature field and predict a fire path to obtain the fire spreading prediction method with higher fineness and higher calculation speed.

title_en: Online operation monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to an online operation monitoring method, a system, a computer device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an online operation log of VPN equipment, analyzing the online operation log, and generating three layers of associated data of a login IP, a user name and operation; identifying abnormal operation according to the three-layer associated data and a preset dynamic baseline model; pushing alarm information corresponding to the abnormal operation; the preset dynamic baseline model is obtained by training an operation log corresponding to the normal operation of the VPN equipment in a historical record. In the whole process, the preset dynamic baseline model is an operation log corresponding to the normal operation of the VPN equipment, so that abnormal operation can be accurately identified according to the login IP, the user name, three layers of associated data of the operation and the preset dynamic baseline model.

title_en: Transmission line initiative bird repellent device based on video is studied and judged
abstract_en: The invention relates to a video study and judgment-based active bird repelling device for a power transmission line, which comprises a plurality of cameras, bird repelling devices, a background center and a user terminal, wherein the cameras, the bird repelling devices, the background center and the user terminal are fixedly arranged on a power transmission iron tower; the intelligent control module comprises a flying bird invasion detection module, an invading flying bird target tracking module and an action response module; the flying bird intrusion detection module is used for separating a flying bird target; the intrusive flying bird target tracking module is used for obtaining a flying bird motion track; the action response module is used for pre-judging the danger degree of the flying bird target according to the movement track of the flying bird and controlling the bird repelling device to repel; according to the invention, through analyzing the video content acquired by the camera, the birds invasion active early warning and the corresponding driving away which are possibly generated are carried out, so that the workload of outside line inspection personnel can be effectively reduced, meanwhile, the phenomenon of missing inspection can be prevented, the problems of low efficiency and difficult guarantee of accuracy of maintenance personnel are solved, and great convenience is brought to the maintenance work of the power transmission line.

title_en: Multi-role interface switching method of intelligent terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-role interface switching method of an intelligent terminal, which comprises the steps of configuring an application lock for each application program configured on the intelligent terminal, wherein the unlocking passwords A of the application lock of each application program can be configured into a plurality of application programs, configuring a user lock for the intelligent terminal, wherein the unlocking passwords B of the user lock can be configured into a plurality of application programs, unlocking the intelligent terminal by using the unlocking passwords B after the intelligent terminal receives one unlocking password B, and simultaneously unlocking the application program which can be unlocked by using the unlocking password B, wherein the unlocking password A of the application program is identical to the unlocking password B. After the intelligent terminal is opened and unlocked, each role can unlock the application program with authority for use, so that the intelligent terminal is convenient and quick to use, and when the intelligent terminal is applied to a mobile phone, the range of the child using the mobile phone application program can be controlled.

title_en: Method for controlling virtual pet and intelligent projection equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of intelligent equipment, and discloses a method for controlling a virtual pet and intelligent projection equipment, wherein the method for controlling the pet is applied to the intelligent projection equipment; in addition, the instruction information of the user can be received, and the virtual pet is controlled to perform corresponding interaction behavior according to the instruction information, so that the interaction is more flexible and convenient, the user can obtain better experience and more fun, and the pet partner feeling is close.

title_en: Authentication method for commodity delivery
abstract_en: A method for authenticating a delivery of goods to a recipient (400) is proposed, the method having the steps of: creating (S1), by the orderer, public and private keys corresponding to the asymmetric encryption; providing (S2) the public key to the courier (120, 200) by the orderer; creating (S3), by the courier (120, 200), information encrypted using the public key; passing (S4) the encrypted message to the recipient (400) for authentication; creating (S5) a plaintext of the encrypted information by decrypting the encrypted information by the recipient (400) with a private key; passing (S6) the plaintext to a courier (120, 200); if the transmitted plain text is consistent with the information, the addressee (400) is authenticated (S7) by the courier (120, 200).

title_en: Distributed computing method, system and storage medium based on nonvolatile memory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed computing method, a distributed computing system and a storage medium based on a nonvolatile memory, wherein the computing method comprises the following steps of S1: acquiring initial data, and preprocessing the initial data; step S2: distributing the preprocessed data to a plurality of parallel mapping nodes for processing, and storing an intermediate result obtained by processing in a nonvolatile memory; step S3: and taking the intermediate result from the nonvolatile memory, and inputting the intermediate result into a reduction node for reduction operation so as to output a final result. The method can keep the calculation intermediate result stored in the nonvolatile memory from being lost in the MapReduce calculation process under the condition of downtime of the computer, thereby improving the efficiency and the reliability of the system.

title_en: Selection margin test to determine whether to signal train a memory system
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and devices are provided for performing margin testing of a first memory store based on a subset of first signals associated with the first memory store. Such techniques determine, based on a margin test, first margin data that indicates whether the first memory stores complies with one or more electrical constraints. Such techniques determine whether to perform a signal training process based on the first margin data.

title_en: Information recommendation method and device, electronic equipment and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses an information recommendation method and device, electronic equipment and a computer storage medium. The specific implementation scheme comprises the following steps: acquiring query information of a target user; obtaining N candidate contents based on the query information of the target user; n is an integer greater than or equal to 1; determining the relevance between the N candidate contents and the target user respectively based on the relevant data of the target user; and according to the relevance between the N candidate contents and the target user respectively, sequencing the N candidate contents to obtain N sequenced candidate contents, and taking the N sequenced candidate contents as a recommendation query result corresponding to the query information. Therefore, the problem that the efficiency and the accuracy of information recommendation in the traditional mode are low is solved.

title_en: Information recommendation method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses an information recommendation method, an information recommendation device and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of information processing. The method comprises the following steps: the server receives a store recommendation request, wherein the store recommendation request carries position information; obtaining platform data of each target store in a preset range of the position information, wherein the platform data comprises: store data, historical order data and corresponding order user data for the target store; determining store grades corresponding to the target stores respectively based on a plurality of grading dimensions according to the platform data; and returning the recommended information of the target store with the store grade meeting the preset grade condition to the client. The method can achieve accuracy and comprehensiveness of store information recommendation.

title_en: Method for reducing size of layout file and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a method for reducing the size of a layout file, which is based on screening and similarity matching of polygons in a large-scale layout file and provides a method for replacing a plurality of similar polygons in a layout by using reference of a reference unit with a similarity ratio so as to reduce the number of vertex coordinates required to be stored in the layout file and further reduce the size of a layout file designed by a very large-scale integrated circuit. The method provided by the application can reduce the storage resources occupied by the layout file and the computer memory occupied by the layout design tool when the layout file is read in, improve the operating speed of the computer and the use efficiency of the layout design tool, improve the data transmission efficiency of integrated circuit design and manufacture, and is particularly suitable for being used in the design of the ultra-large scale integrated circuit.

title_en: Government affair service integrated management workflow design modeling method
abstract_en: The invention provides a government affair service integrated management workflow design modeling method, which comprises the following steps: s1, customizing a workflow model; the model is exported after being constructed, and can be used for quickly establishing a workflow model in other environments; s2, setting basic attributes of the workflow link, setting process node attributes and determining a working link; s3, setting a work link distribution strategy, formulating non-topological multi-factor government affair service processing workflow circulation conditions, and completing informatization modeling required by each link of government affair service processing; and S4, completing the establishment of the workflow model, creating a flow example in the business, and completing the actual government business processing according to the workflow model path and the rules. The invention can integrate the non-topological multi-factor government affair service processing workflow into the system construction model, ensure the safety of the derived model and improve the user experience.

title_en: Device and method for automatically converting voice channel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for automatically converting a voice channel, belonging to the technical field related to intelligent conversion of the voice channel and comprising the following steps: initialization: initializing and setting a system; and (3) instruction processing: analyzing the collected signal instruction, and converting the signal instruction into level information; determining a voice channel: determining whether the voice channel is triggered according to the level information, carrying out priority detection on the triggered voice channel, and controlling the connection of the voice channel according to the priority level; data transmission: transmitting data through the connected voice channel; the level information of each channel received through the processing module judges whether the voice channel waits for connection, and the voice channel waiting for is judged according to the priority level, so that the switching-on sequence of the voice channel is controlled, the intelligent conversion of the voice channel is realized, the simultaneous connection of a plurality of voice channels is avoided, and the occurrence of the condition that the user experience caused by the overlapping of various sounds is poor is avoided.

title_en: Assembly type building and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an assembly type building which comprises an assembly type wall body, wherein the wall body comprises a transparent plate, a preheating pipe, a heat insulation layer, an outer bearing wall, a heat insulation layer, an inner bearing wall and a ventilation part; the transparent plate, the preheating pipe and the heat insulation layer are arranged on the outer surface of the outer bearing wall, the transparent plate is arranged outside the preheating pipe, the heat insulation layer is arranged on the inner side of the preheating pipe, and the heat insulation layer is arranged between the outer bearing wall and the inner bearing wall; the ventilation component is arranged on the inner surface of the inner bearing wall; an inlet at the upper part of the ventilation component is connected with a heater, a preheating pipe extends from the upper part to the lower part of the wall body, the preheating pipe is provided with a branch, an inlet of the branch extends into a room at the inner side of the wall body, and a fan is arranged at the inlet of the branch. The invention firstly integrates water collection, air energy recovery and air source power generation into a system, thereby achieving the integral building integrated technical system.

title_en: Model training method, pavement damage segmentation device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a model training method, a pavement damage segmentation device and electronic equipment, relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and particularly relates to a computer vision and deep learning technology. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: processing the first road surface image by using the classification model to obtain road surface damage classification results of all pixel points in the first road surface image; marking road surface damage information in the first road surface image based on road surface damage classification results of all pixel points in the first road surface image; and training to obtain a pavement damage segmentation model based on the first pavement image and pavement damage information in the first pavement image. According to the embodiment of the disclosure, the labeling cost can be saved, and the accuracy of the segmentation model is improved.

title_en: Display module interference removing method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of Internet of things equipment, in particular to a display module interference removing method, a display module interference removing device, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the display module interference removing method comprises the following steps: determining access modes of wired equipment, wherein the access modes comprise a rising edge access mode, a falling edge access mode and a multi-pin access mode; determining a transmission mode of the wired device according to an access mode of the wired device, wherein the transmission mode comprises a display frame rate mode and a control command mode; reducing the transmission data volume according to the transmission mode of the wired equipment, acquiring the idle proportion of a transmission protocol after the transmission data volume is reduced, and allocating bandwidth for the wired equipment according to the idle proportion; and detecting whether an output picture has errors, if so, removing level interference according to the access mode. According to the invention, the bandwidth is dynamically allocated according to different transmitted data, so that the energy consumption of equipment is reduced; on the basis, a level interference removal method is provided, so that the display is more stable.

title_en: Bridge model updating method, system, storage medium and equipment based on vehicle-bridge coupling acting force correction
abstract_en: A bridge model updating method, a system, a storage medium and equipment based on vehicle-bridge coupling acting force correction belong to the technical field of engineering. The method aims to solve the problem that the simulation accuracy is low due to the fact that a fine updating method aiming at a bridge model is not available at present. The dynamic response of the bridge structure under the action of the load of the heavy-duty vehicle is obtained through the sensors distributed on the bridge structure; according to the vertical vibration acceleration a of the bridge at the gravity center o of the heavy-load vehicle o And vertical deflection y o And a heavy-duty vehicle speed u Vehicle with wheels Reconstructing the table-board response of the vibration table and obtaining the interaction force of the vehicle-bridge coupling model; and establishing a bridge structure nonlinear finite element model, taking the vehicle-bridge interaction force as an external force, taking the bridge structure dynamic response as a structural response, and finishing the correction of the bridge structure finite element model by a nonlinear parameter identification method. The method is mainly used for updating the bridge model.

title_en: Intrusion behavior detection method and device and multi-channel video monitoring system
abstract_en: The application relates to an intrusion behavior detection method, an intrusion behavior detection device, a multi-channel video monitoring system, an electronic device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an image sequence to be detected, wherein the frame rate of the image sequence is a first frame rate; detecting a moving target of the image sequence according to a second frame rate, and judging whether a target moving in a preset area exists in a current frame image in the image sequence; under the condition that a current frame image has a target moving in a preset area, carrying out intrusion behavior detection on images of preset frame numbers before and/or after the current frame image according to a first frame rate, wherein the first frame rate is greater than a second frame rate; and sending alarm information under the condition that at least one frame of image before and/or after the current frame of image has intrusion behaviors. By the method and the device, the problem of low accuracy rate of the monitoring system for detecting the intrusion behavior in the related technology is solved, and the technical effect of improving the accuracy rate of the monitoring system for detecting the intrusion behavior is achieved.

title_en: Transparency calculation method and system for water bodies of near-shore and inland waters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for calculating the transparency of a water body of an inshore water area and an inshore water area, and relates to the technical field of water color remote sensing. The method comprises the following steps: collecting spectral data of water bodies of near-shore and inland waters; performing cluster analysis on the spectral data, and dividing the water into different types of water according to an analysis result; selecting a corresponding preset transparency inversion model according to different water body types; and calculating the spectrum data by adopting the preset transparency inversion model to obtain the transparency of the water body. The water transparency calculation method is applicable to water bodies in coastal and inland water areas with complex optical properties, and has the advantages of large-range water areas, real-time synchronous data, continuous observation and the like.

title_en: Digital three-dimensional model construction method and system of production equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and a storage medium for constructing a digital three-dimensional model of production equipment. The problem of at present because workshop space is put and is arranged and make some positions of production facility crisscross from top to bottom, can't directly carry out edge detection alone through to this type of interconnected production facility on the workshop two-dimensional map, can only carry out three-dimensional monomer modeling through the manual work again and delay the project progress is solved.

title_en: Information hiding method based on estimated robustness
abstract_en: The invention disclosesThe information hiding method based on the estimated robustness comprises the following steps: taking each k×k image block as a unit, the coefficient set c= { C  f  ，f＝1，2，…，3k  2  4} as candidate vector; and calculating the estimated robustness of each candidate carrier according to the robustness estimated function r (m, f, t), and selecting the carrier with the optimal robustness to carry secret information. Wherein the robustness estimating function r (m, f, t) comprises the extracted robustness r caused by embedding modification  m  Extraction robustness r by the spatial frequency of the embedded carrier  f  And extraction robustness r due to texture characteristics  t  . Compared with the prior art, the method has the beneficial effects that the information is embedded in the DCT (Discrete Cosine Transform ) domain of the segmented image, the influence of texture attribute, frequency characteristic and embedding modification of the carrier on the extraction robustness of the embedded information is analyzed, the strong robust region is selected for embedding, and the robustness of information hiding is improved.

title_en: Parametric construction method of complex three-dimensional linear structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of civil water conservancy and traffic engineering, and discloses a parameterized construction method of a complex three-dimensional linear structure. The invention realizes the automatic design and arrangement of the profile graph of the cross section, and finally generates the three-dimensional linear structure entity through the automatic lofting of the corresponding profile. The invention can well improve the design precision of the three-dimensional linear structure, and meanwhile, the attribute management information is mounted in the three-dimensional engineering curve model, thereby effectively improving the engineering information management efficiency and controlling the construction quality.

title_en: Service request tracking method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a service request tracking method and device and electronic equipment. The tracking method of the service request comprises the following steps: the current layer node receives the service request, generates a cost layer space mark and determines a parent layer space mark; and when a service request is sent to the next layer node of the logical link, the local layer space mark of the current layer node is sent to the next layer node to be used as the parent layer space mark of the next layer node. The technical scheme provided by the application can quickly identify the superior and inferior calling relations of the service request, and the problem reason can be more easily checked.

title_en: Annular wireless sensor network clustering routing algorithm based on particle swarm and lion swarm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a ring wireless sensor network clustering routing algorithm, in particular to a ring wireless sensor network clustering routing algorithm (CRPL) based on particle swarm and lion swarm. The algorithm comprises three parts of a system model, cluster head election and routing path selection. The proposed CRPL clustering routing algorithm aims at reducing network energy consumption and prolonging network life cycle, firstly, based on a fitness function selected by cluster head nodes established by a lion group algorithm, the optimal cluster head node of each ring is selected, and meanwhile, a multi-target fitness function is established by adopting a particle swarm algorithm in the data transmission process to search a next hop relay node so as to obtain the optimal routing path.

title_en: Occlusion face recognition method, intelligent terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a face identification shielding method, an intelligent terminal and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a shielding face image; performing image blocking processing on the blocked face image to obtain a plurality of block images, and extracting local images in the block images; respectively carrying out image recognition on each local image to obtain a plurality of alternative recognition images of the shielding face image; determining an occlusion type according to the local image; determining a final recognition image of the occlusion face image from the plurality of alternative recognition images by the occlusion type. The occlusion face recognition technology based on the local image recognition has low data processing requirement, does not need to increase occlusion data deliberately, can extract the local image rapidly, recognizes the whole face in the occlusion face image accurately, and recognizes the face accurately and efficiently.

title_en: Pile-supported embankment multi-layer reinforcement body reinforcing technology based on numerical simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pile-supported embankment multi-layer reinforcement body reinforcing technology based on numerical simulation, which specifically comprises the following steps: establishing a numerical model of the pile-supported embankment with the multilayer reinforced ribs by using finite element software, and calculating and analyzing the working mechanism of the multilayer reinforced rib body; based on the stress-strain analysis result of each layer of reinforcement body in the reinforcement cushion layer, the strength grade of each layer of reinforcement body in the reinforcement cushion layer is optimized, and the fine design of the pile-supported reinforced embankment is guided. The invention deeply researches the cooperative bearing mechanism of the reinforcement bodies of each layer in the reinforcement cushion layer, can ensure that the strength of the reinforcement bodies of each layer is fully exerted, and effectively controls the vertical and horizontal displacement of the embankment, on one hand, the long-term stability of the pile-supported reinforced embankment can be maintained, and on the other hand, the material waste caused by the unreasonable design of the reinforcement bodies of multiple layers can be avoided.

title_en: Training method and device for oral cavity abnormality detection model based on panoramic X-ray film
abstract_en: The application provides a training method based on an oral panoramic X-ray film detection model, which is applied to the detection of oral abnormalities through the oral panoramic X-ray film; comprising the following steps: acquiring a sample image and an initial oral cavity abnormality detection model, wherein the sample image is provided with a characteristic mark; extracting image features of the sample image through a feature extraction model; carrying out recognition processing on the image features through the feature recognition model to obtain a recognition result of the sample image and a confidence parameter corresponding to the recognition result, wherein the confidence parameter is used for indicating the confidence of the recognition result; determining a loss function based on the recognition result, the confidence parameter and the feature label; and training a feature extraction model and a feature recognition model according to the loss function to obtain a target oral cavity abnormality detection model. The comprehensive diagnosis of the oral panoramic X-ray film is assisted by utilizing artificial intelligence technology such as deep learning and the like, so that the comprehensive diagnosis method has important application value and social benefit for improving the examination efficiency and convenience.

title_en: Switching method and switching system for disaster recovery database
abstract_en: The invention discloses a switching method and a switching system of disaster recovery databases, belonging to the technical field of database management, wherein the switching method comprises the following steps: intercepting a connection request when the disaster recovery database is switched; judging whether the connection request has the risk of data loss or not; if yes, returning interception information to a sender of the connection request; if not, the connection request is forwarded to the enabled database. By intercepting and analyzing the connection request, when the risk of data loss exists, interception information is returned to the sender of the connection request, so that wrong connection and wrong data are avoided, and the use experience is improved; and for normal connection requests without data loss risk, normal processing is performed, so that continuity of database services is ensured.

title_en: Natural gas hydrate generation condition prediction method based on polynomial neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a natural gas hydrate generation condition prediction method based on a polynomial neural network. The method combines a polynomial established by a grouping method based on data processing and a neural network to form a polynomial neural network algorithm, and obtains an accurate prediction formula of the natural gas hydrate generation condition by optimizing parameters through experimental data. The method comprises the following steps: collecting the generation condition data of natural gas hydrates with different components; constructing a basis function of the polynomial neural network by combining two independent parameters; real data is brought into a polynomial neural network for training; and (5) obtaining an optimal polynomial neural network formula through regression. The formula is suitable for accurate prediction of dry gas containing light hydrocarbon, carbon dioxide, hydrogen sulfide and nitrogen or acid gas dry gas or acid gas, and has the advantages of avoiding the defects of poor interpretability and poor transportability of a black box model of a traditional neural network algorithm.

title_en: Two-dimensional code correction method and device and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-dimensional code correction method, a device and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the two-dimensional code correction method comprises the following steps: and determining a target reference line corresponding to the position detection graph according to the reference point position and the preset distance in the position detection graph of the two-dimensional code to be corrected, scanning the two-dimensional code to be corrected according to the target reference line corresponding to each position detection graph to obtain fitting point groups corresponding to each position detection graph, fitting a plurality of fitting points in each fitting point group to obtain boundary lines corresponding to each position detection graph, wherein the boundary line corresponding to the lower left corner position detection graph is the bottom boundary line of the two-dimensional code to be corrected, the boundary line corresponding to the upper right corner position detection graph is the right boundary line of the two-dimensional code to be corrected, and correcting the shape of the two-dimensional code to be corrected according to the intersection point of the bottom boundary line and the right boundary line. The method and the device can improve the accuracy of correcting the shape of the two-dimensional code.

title_en: Webpage text recognition method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a webpage text identification method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a webpage text to be analyzed, wherein the webpage text to be analyzed comprises character rows and blank rows, a single blank row and a plurality of continuously arranged blank rows are regarded as intervals, and the number of the blank rows corresponding to the intervals represents the length of the intervals; calculating to obtain a reference interval length according to all intervals of the webpage text to be analyzed; filtering all intervals of the webpage text to be analyzed by using the reference interval length so as to reserve intervals with the length larger than the reference interval length; and searching the corresponding character number between any two lines and all the filtered intervals in an exhaustive way, and determining the text of the webpage according to the corresponding character number of each search area and all the filtered intervals. The method has higher recognition accuracy and can be suitable for various web pages.

title_en: Intelligent analysis and application method based on big data of smart community Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent analysis and application method based on big data of an intelligent community Internet of things. The smart community includes an integrated system and a plurality of subsystems, the method comprising: acquiring access modes between the subsystems and the integrated system; completing the development of the integrated system according to the access mode; the integrated system uses the configuration of the subsystem to carry out integrated debugging; and after the integrated debugging is started, the integrated system controls and monitors the subsystem. The method provided by the invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent communities, is used for solving the problems that the traditional community can not truly reflect the real condition of the community, the service is slow, the management mode is not visual and incomplete, and has the characteristics of providing maintenance service for owners and effectively improving the response speed of community service.

title_en: Memory circuit and operation method thereof
abstract_en: A memory circuit is provided that includes a first driver circuit, a first column of memory cells coupled to the first driver circuit, a first current source, a tracking circuit configured to track leakage current of the first column of memory cells, and a footer circuit coupled to the first column of memory cells, the first current source, and the tracking circuit. Embodiments of the present invention also provide a method of operating a memory circuit.

title_en: Construction method of microscopic reaction model in high-efficiency polysilicon deposition process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of a microscopic reaction model in a high-efficiency polysilicon deposition process, which comprises the following steps of a, constructing a microscopic distribution state of gas and a microscopic distribution state of atoms on the surface of a silicon rod, b, constructing a simulation box, introducing the gas into the simulation box to obtain a preliminary chemical reaction model, c, optimizing the chemical reaction model, and d, fixing all atoms in a unit cell layer at the bottom end of a Si substrate in the chemical reaction model to finish construction of the chemical reaction model. The invention effectively solves the problem that the Si substrate is easy to agglomerate because the stable configuration cannot be maintained at high temperature by fixing the Si unit cell layer, and realizes the simulation of the surface of a continuous and uninterrupted Si rod by constructing the Si substrate (Si supercell) in a mode of periodically repeating the Si unit cells. The chemical reaction model construction method is suitable for the chemical vapor deposition process of polysilicon, and is also suitable for the modeling process of gas-solid two phases in other chemical vapor deposition processes.

title_en: Internet of things equipment management method and system adopting memory data model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for managing equipment of the Internet of things by adopting a memory data model, and belongs to the technical field of equipment management of the Internet of things. Each data of the internet of things equipment needing to receive system management is placed in a memory and stored in the form of a memory object, virtual equipment in the memory is abstract mapping of real internet of things equipment, the core is a memory data model (namely an equipment shadow) mapped by the internet of things equipment, and a user can directly access the equipment data through the memory object instantiated in the memory by the equipment shadow instead of inquiring a database every time to obtain the data like a traditional method.

title_en: Interest tag-based processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure discloses a processing method, a processing device, processing equipment and a storage medium based on interest tags. The method comprises the following steps: in the process of displaying information flow in a preset application program, detecting that an interest tag display event is triggered; displaying a first page, and dynamically switching and displaying different subsets in a preset interest tag set in the first page, wherein the number of interest tags in the subsets is multiple and less than the total number of interest tags in the preset interest tag set. By adopting the technical scheme, the interest labels can be displayed in the process of displaying the information flow by the preset application program, so that a user can have the opportunity to dynamically adjust the interest labels in the process of using the preset application program, more interest labels are displayed for the user by dynamically switching the mode of displaying different interest label subsets, the utilization rate of the page display space is improved, the display effect of the interest labels can be optimized, and interactivity and interestingness are enhanced.

title_en: Method for predicting service life of gas turbine containing measurement error two-dimensional vibration parameters
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting the service life of a gas turbine containing measurement error two-dimensional vibration parameters, which comprises the steps of firstly, adding a single-channel test parameter during reliability modeling Describing the measurement error, thereby effectively solving the influence of the measurement error of the sensor on the vibration test data processing; moreover, according to the condition of two paths of vibration test data of the gas turbine, the correlation of the two paths of vibration test data is considered, the probability density function of using the Copula function to correlate the residual life of the two paths is provided, effective support can be provided for the prediction of the residual life of the whole gas turbine through the analysis of the vibration measurement parameters of the two paths of the gas turbine, the prediction precision of the residual life of the gas turbine is greatly improved, and the method is particularly suitable for the condition that the test data contain measurement errors in complex environments such as ship platform vibration transmission interference.

title_en: Air conditioner water system control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air conditioner water system control system, which is characterized by comprising the following components: a terminal load predictor connected with an outdoor data detection instrument outside a room where the terminal of each air conditioner is located; the terminal equipment instantaneous required flow calculation module is used for acquiring the maximum supply and return water temperature difference of the safe and stable operation of each air conditioner terminal equipment; a control pressure difference generator with one end connected to the instantaneous flow calculating module and the other end connected to the water pump controller; and the water pump controller is connected with a secondary pump in the power unit of the air-conditioning water system and can perform PID control on the number and the frequency of the water pumps of the secondary pump according to the actual water supply and return pressure difference acquired in real time and the deviation of a set value of the control pressure difference. The invention can more accurately meet the end requirement and has the advantages of simple, accurate, safe and stable control.

title_en: Prediction method for potential landslide and river blockage
abstract_en: The invention provides a prediction method for potential landslide and river blockage, and relates to the field of comprehensive application of remote sensing mapping and geological disaster chain disaster prevention and reduction. The method comprises the steps of firstly establishing a historical landslide and river plugging cataloguing of a target area, selecting a proper river plugging factor, then establishing a landslide and river plugging risk prediction model suitable for the area by using a machine learning method, carrying out potential landslide early-stage identification on the target area by using an SBAS-InSAR method, and then obtaining river plugging factor data of a potential landslide of the target area through the potential landslide and river plugging factor prediction model, so that the river plugging risk prediction of the potential landslide is carried out, and finally the spatial position prediction of the potential landslide and river plugging is realized. The method provided by the invention improves the problem of low accuracy of landform indexes and the traditional statistical model, and makes up for the deficiency of early judgment of landslide and river blockage in the prior art to a certain extent.

title_en: High-availability method and device for NFS (network file system) of storage array
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for high availability of a storage array NFS, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a heartbeat link between a first controller and a second controller; dividing shared storage resources in the double-control storage array, and setting the read-write priority of the first controller to be higher than that of the second controller; creating virtual IP resources of a first controller; creating NFS sharing by using the shared storage resources and the virtual IP resources, starting NFS sharing service, writing information of the NFS sharing service into a database of the dual-control storage array for persistence, and mapping the NFS sharing to the client; in response to receiving a data request sent by a client, a first controller receives the data request and stores data in a shared storage resource; in response to detecting a failure of the first controller via the heartbeat link, the second controller reestablishes and initiates NFS shared services in the second controller in accordance with the shared storage resources. By using the scheme of the invention, the single point failure problem of NFS can be eliminated, the availability is high, and the reliability of the system is improved.

title_en: Method and device for improving performance of intelligent network card
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method and a device for improving performance of an intelligent network card, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an address of an item pointed by a read request instruction of a current processing module, determining a hash value corresponding to the address according to the address of the item, determining a locking state of a cell corresponding to the read request instruction according to the hash value and a bit bitmap lock table which is built in advance and comprises a plurality of cells, and determining whether a dispatcher executes read operation according to the locking state of the cell. According to the method and the device, the bit map lock list structure is introduced, one lock in the prior art is disassembled into a plurality of locks, the conflict probability of each lock is reduced, and the list item read-write performance is improved.

title_en: Attack IP identification method, device, equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides an attack IP identification method, an attack IP identification device, attack IP identification equipment and a computer readable storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring one or more characteristics of a target IP to generate a characteristic set of the target IP; calling a pre-trained target recognition model; and inputting the feature set of the target IP into the target identification model so as to identify whether the target IP is an attack IP. In this way, whether the target IP is the attack IP can be automatically identified, so that the attack IP can be effectively and timely found, timely defense is facilitated, and network attack brought by the attack IP is avoided as much as possible.

title_en: Credit data output method, device and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a credit data output method, a device and a medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a credit investigation service field of a credit investigation information main body; determining credit investigation business requirements related to auditing the credit investigation information subject; processing data in a data source corresponding to the credit investigation service requirement through a pre-constructed credit investigation standard data output model of the credit investigation service field; the data is related to the credit investigation information body; and fusing the processing data to output credit data corresponding to the credit investigation service requirement. The embodiment of the application relates to a credit investigation standard data model which is distinguished in various fields and fused with different data sources, the data use is more sufficient and simpler, and on the basis, the credit investigation service requirements can be determined, the service requirements can be more flexibly met, and the credit investigation standard data model is very convenient and simple to use, whether data display is adopted, or index processing and modeling of related work of the credit investigation service are adopted.

title_en: Entity linking method based on knowledge graph sub-graph information and entity information
abstract_en: The invention relates to an entity linking method based on sub-graph information and entity information of an integrated knowledge graph, which comprises the following steps: obtaining a question text, feeding the question text into a trained mentioning recognition model, and recognizing a predicted mentioning word; and recalling the predicted mentioning words to obtain the target mentioning words with higher accuracy. Obtaining all candidate entities corresponding to the mentioning words from a knowledge base according to the target mentioning words; for each candidate entity, retrieving knowledge graph sub-graph information thereof; integrating the knowledge map sub-graph information into a candidate entity to obtain a candidate entity text, introducing an entity boundary label into the question text and the candidate entity text, and constructing an entity disambiguation data set; and feeding the trained entity disambiguation model, pooling to obtain a knowledge base entity corresponding to the reference word, and completing entity linkage. The method can effectively improve the recall rate of the recognition of the mentions, improve the sequencing accuracy of the candidate entities and reduce error transmission, and effectively solve the problems of reasoning and the condition of missing entities in the training set.

title_en: Case series connection method and device based on cross-chapter event extraction and related components
abstract_en: The invention discloses a case series connection method, a case series connection device and a related component based on cross-chapter event extraction. The method comprises the following steps: collecting a text collection from a database, the text collection comprising a plurality of documents; carrying out document analysis on the text set and outputting structured case metadata; extracting event elements in the case metadata to obtain the meta-event of the case; judging whether the meta-events of the cases are the same event according to a plurality of series strategies, performing weight voting on the judgment result of each series strategy according to the weight of each series strategy, and determining whether the meta-events of the cases are the same event; and connecting the documents corresponding to the same event in series based on the time sequence to form an event set of the case and output the event set. The method can find the routes of judicial events from massive documents, assist legal personnel in case combing and understanding the context of cases, and greatly improve the case combing efficiency and combing effect of the legal personnel.

title_en: Fish weight automatic estimation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for automatically estimating fish weight, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting underwater binocular videos of fishes to be detected; determining fish curvature of each frame of image in an underwater binocular video of the fish to be measured, and extracting an image with the fish curvature smaller than a preset curvature threshold value as a measurement frame; performing foreground segmentation on the measurement frame to obtain the profile characteristics of the fish to be measured, and acquiring a disparity map corresponding to the measurement frame; matching the contour features with the disparity map, and calculating the perimeter of the fish to be detected; and inputting the perimeter into a perimeter-weight estimation model to obtain a weight estimation result of the fish to be detected. According to the automatic fish weight estimation method, the automatic fish weight estimation device, the electronic equipment and the storage medium, the influence of the fish body curvature on the perimeter-weight estimation model precision can be reduced by acquiring the measurement frame suitable for fish size parameter estimation in the video, so that the fish weight can be estimated more accurately and efficiently.

title_en: Dynamic calibration method and device for internal and external parameters of monocular camera in surgical navigation
abstract_en: The monocular camera internal and external parameter dynamic calibration method and device in the surgical navigation can greatly improve the efficiency and the real-time performance of the camera in the fields of tracking of specific targets and augmented reality, can correct errors of the augmented reality in real time, can correct tracking errors of the targets in real time, and have wide application prospect. The method comprises the following steps: (1) decomposing a video stream shot by a monocular camera into single-frame images; (2) identifying the mark rectangular frame range of each frame of image in the pixel space, and sorting the mark rectangular frames in the pixel space by utilizing the target characteristic region division; (3) carrying out threshold segmentation on pixel points in each rectangular frame to obtain coordinate values of the central point of the rectangular frame in a pixel space; (4) calculating the physical coordinates of the mark points at the center of the characteristic frame of the target under an optical tracking system, and enabling the pixel coordinates of the mark points to correspond to the physical coordinates one by one; (5) and calibrating the camera for each frame of image, and solving an internal and external parameter matrix and distortion parameters of the camera.

title_en: Control method and system of voice scheduling system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a control method and system of a voice scheduling system and electronic equipment. In the control method, firstly, text word segmentation is carried out on the obtained voice text data to obtain a first word set, stop words are removed from the obtained first word set, and then keywords are identified by using a TF-IDF text feature extraction technology. And then, calculating the weight of the key words, and inquiring corresponding events in the event library according to the key words and the weight of the key words. And finally, performing auxiliary scheduling processing according to the identified events, so that the scheduling center can perform scheduling processing on multiple paths of calls at the same time. The technical scheme provided by the application avoids the situation that when monitoring multiple paths of monitored objects and calling simultaneously in a traditional mode, only one path of telephone traffic can be monitored and other paths of telephone traffic are muted, so that missed listening and missed receiving are caused.

title_en: Method for calculating inner width of rotating wheel of water turbine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating the internal width of a runner of a water turbine bucket, which relates to the technical field of water conservancy and hydropower engineering and aims to conveniently calculate relatively accurate internal width data of the runner according to basic parameters of the water turbine and provide a basis for multi-scheme comparison and selection in the early stage of a hydropower station. The technical scheme adopted by the invention is as follows: firstly, acquiring data of at least two groups of existing water turbine buckets to obtain the value of fitting parameters; then, determining parameters of the water turbine to be calculated, including the nominal diameter of a runner of the water turbine to be calculated and the specific rotation speed of a single nozzle; and finally, calculating the inner width of the runner of the water turbine bucket according to a formula. The method for calculating the internal width of the rotating wheel of the water turbine is used for calculating the internal width of the rotating wheel according to the easily acquired data, has small error of calculation results, can completely meet the requirement of multi-scheme comparison selection in the early stage of a power station, and can provide powerful technical support for subsequent domestic and foreign hydropower engineering construction.

title_en: Commodity title generation method and device, intelligent equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a commodity information processing technology, and provides a commodity title generation method, a device, intelligent equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving commodity information of a commodity input by a user, wherein the commodity information comprises a commodity name; identifying the commodity name, and acquiring a long-tail keyword associated with the commodity according to the commodity name; judging whether a selection instruction for selecting the long-tail keyword by a user is received; if so, selecting a first target keyword from the long-tail keywords according to the selection instruction, and combining the first target keyword and the commodity name into a commodity title; if not, a second target keyword is screened from the long-tail keywords, and the second target keyword and the commodity name are combined into a commodity title, so that the commodity title is automatically combined, each user is free from the trouble of thinking about the combined product title, and the working efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Material checking method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a material checking method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the field of storage logistics. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: in response to receiving an inventory task for materials in a warehouse, determining a goods grid where a material container corresponding to the inventory task is located; sending the cargo grid where the material container is located to a target automatic guided vehicle, so that the target automatic guided vehicle can obtain the identification of the material in the material container after planning the path; counting the identification in response to receiving the identification of the material in the material container sent by the target automatic guided transporting vehicle; and comparing the statistical result with a storage result of the materials in the material container, and determining a material checking result according to the comparison result. This implementation mode can improve the efficiency that warehouse goods and materials checked.

title_en: Hard disk management method and device, hard disk equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a hard disk management method and device, hard disk equipment and storage medium, which relate to the field of data storage and can prolong the service life of a hard disk, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring attribute information of a storage block in a hard disk under a first block type, wherein the attribute information is used for describing the storage block; if the working state of the storage block under the first block type does not meet the preset storage block working state under the first block type according to the attribute information of the storage block under the first block type, adjusting the block type of the storage block from the first block type to a second block type so as to perform data operation based on the storage block under the second block type; the working state of the storage block corresponding to the attribute information under the first block type meets the preset working state of the storage block under the second block type.

title_en: Interface function testing method and device, storage medium and equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses an interface function testing method, an interface function testing device, a storage medium and equipment, which are used for analyzing an interface document of a system to be tested to obtain a mapping relation between a message data item and an interface data item. And capturing interface elements from the interface of the system to be tested, and acquiring the analysis result of the message. And associating the content of the message data item with the content of the interface data item according to the mapping relation to obtain each information item pair. And comparing the content of the message data item with the content of the interface data item to obtain a comparison result for each information item pair. And counting the number of information item pairs with different message data item contents and interface data item contents indicated by the comparison result to obtain a first numerical value. And sending prompt information to the user when the first numerical value is larger than the preset threshold value. According to the scheme, the comparison process of the content of the message data item and the content of the interface data item does not need to be manually participated, the efficiency of interface function testing can be improved, and the operation risk caused by human factors can be reduced.

title_en: Information recommendation method and device
abstract_en: The application provides an information recommendation method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: responding to a request for uploading a house type graph, and acquiring the house type graph; outputting the service type for selection; responding to a service type received and input by selection, and acquiring service information corresponding to the house type graph, wherein the service information is service information which corresponds to the service type and is matched with the house type graph; and outputting the service information. The method can output the service information corresponding to the user type graph based on the service type, and improves the user experience.

title_en: Electronic generation method, device, system and medium for software cost
abstract_en: The application discloses an electronic generation method, equipment, a system and a medium of software cost, and belongs to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the following steps: loading a requirement document of the software project by using a document editor, wherein the document editor runs a cost plug-in; adding functional point data in the requirement document into the construction cost plug-in, wherein the functional point data is data related to functional points in the software engineering; generating a cost report of the software project through the cost plug-in, wherein the cost report is obtained by the cost plug-in based on the functional point data; and displaying the requirement document and the cost report in parallel in the document editor. The method and the device can improve the cost efficiency of software engineering.

title_en: Method and system for positioning spatial positions of multiple persons in real time based on camera shooting information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for locating the spatial positions of multiple persons in real time based on camera shooting information, wherein the method specifically comprises the following steps: 1) Calibrating each path of video cameras to obtain internal parameters, external parameters and distortion coefficients of the cameras; 2) Acquiring a video image, detecting the head of a person in the video image, and calculating the center position of the head; 3) The method comprises the steps of obtaining rays in each path of video image through video camera calibration and the center position of the head of a person in the video image; each ray starts from the optical center of the video image and passes through the center position of the head of the person detected in the video image; 4) Calculating the minimum distance between rays in different paths of video images, wherein the midpoint of a connecting line of the minimum distance between the rays is used as an effective leading-out point; 5) And clustering the effective derived points, kicking off false foci, and obtaining the rest foci as the spatial positions of the personnel. The invention has the advantages of good real-time performance, high positioning precision and the like.

title_en: Method and system for changing containerized workload isolation
abstract_en: Methods, apparatuses, and computer program products are provided for dynamically changing containerized workload isolation in response to detection of a trigger. In some embodiments, workloads are containerized using a default container runtime (e.g., runC) that uses the resource limiting capabilities of the compute node's host kernel, including cgroups and namespaces, to generate one or more cgroup-based containers on the compute node. In some embodiments, at least some containerized workloads are migrated from running in one or more cgroup-based containers to one or more Virtual Machines (VMs) started by a standby container runtime (e.g., runV) in response to a trigger, such as a host kernel vulnerability. In some embodiments, cgroup and namespaces of one or more cgroup-based containers are migrated to one or more VM runtimes on one or more VMs in real time without service interruption using checkpointing/recovery in CRIU-user space.

title_en: Health information sharing method, device, equipment and storage medium based on block chain
abstract_en: A health information sharing method, device, equipment and storage medium based on block chains. The invention relates to the field of digital medical treatment, and provides a health information sharing method, a device, equipment and a storage medium based on a block chain, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of receiving a family relationship establishment request uploaded by resident nodes, constructing sub-block chains of the relevant resident nodes and the resident nodes based on the information of the relevant resident nodes, initiating an adding request to each doctor node, adding the corresponding doctor nodes into the sub-block chains to form the family sub-block chains, and endowing each node in the family sub-block chains with authority for acquiring health information of each resident node in the family sub-block chains. Therefore, the relation is established for the health information of family members, the sharing of the health information is realized, the management taking families as units is realized, in addition, the decentralized family block chain construction can be realized through a block chain mechanism, the information is only shared in the family sub-block chain, and the safety of the information is ensured.

title_en: Electroencephalogram signal denoising method based on residual error generation countermeasure network
abstract_en: An electroencephalogram signal denoising method based on a residual error generation countermeasure network comprises the steps of selecting an electroencephalogram sample, constructing a noise-containing electroencephalogram signal sample, dividing a network training set and a test set, constructing a residual error generation countermeasure neural network, training a residual error generation countermeasure neural network, and reconstructing a denoised electroencephalogram signal. Because the invention constructs a residual error generation confrontation neural network, the learning capacity of the neural network is enhanced by introducing the residual error generator and the discriminator, the real-time denoising is realized, the discriminator is introduced, the efficiency and the quality of the EEG signal denoising are improved, and the effective characteristics are screened out; the signal denoising process is divided into a model training process and a denoising process, so that the signal-to-noise ratio and the mean square error of signal denoising are improved. The invention has the advantages of simple neural network structure, high EEG signal denoising efficiency, good denoising quality and the like, and can be applied to the technical field of pretreatment process and signal denoising processing of EEG signal processing.

title_en: Medical image processing method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical image processing method, a medical image processing device, computer equipment and a storage medium, relates to the technical field of information, and mainly aims to improve the prediction accuracy of the benign and malignant nodules. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a medical image to be predicted; inputting the medical image into a preset image feature extraction model, and extracting nodule feature vectors respectively output by a plurality of end-to-end residual attention networks in the preset image feature extraction model; splicing the plurality of nodule feature vectors to obtain risk level feature vectors corresponding to the nodules in the medical image; constraining a nodule feature vector output by a last residual attention network in the preset image feature extraction model by using the risk level feature vector to obtain a good and malignant feature vector corresponding to the nodule; and predicting a good-malignancy result corresponding to the nodule based on the good-malignancy feature vector. The invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence and digital medical treatment.

title_en: Measurement method and inspection apparatus
abstract_en: The invention can simplify the calibration man-hour of a plurality of current detection parts included in the inspection device and obtain accurate impedance value. The method for measuring the inter-electrode impedance between a plurality of first electrodes (51) and a plurality of second electrodes (52) which are isolated from each other comprises the following steps: calibrating one of the plurality of current detection units (4); measuring a first reference impedance (Z) of a reference sample (S) using a first current detection section (4a) which is a calibrated current detection section X1 ) (ii) a Using a plurality of current detection units (4) to measure objects at a plurality of positions of an object (50) to be inspected in parallelImpedance (Z) XM ) (ii) a And based on a first reference impedance (Z) X1 ) To correct the impedance (Z) of the object XM ) To calculate the corrected impedance (Z) DUT )。

title_en: Reinforcing bar corrosion rate intellectual detection system equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent detection device for corrosion rate of steel bars, which comprises: the system comprises a camera and a corrosion detection host, wherein the corrosion detection host stores a steel bar cross section corrosion pixel judgment network model obtained by training a classified convolutional neural network; the rust cross section of the steel bar to be measured, which needs to be measured, is arranged in the shooting range of the camera; the corrosion detection host can communicate with the camera and determine the steel bar to be detected according to the steps S1 to S4. The invention can measure the corrosion rate of the measured steel bar at the corrosion cross section, realizes the rapid measurement of the non-uniform corrosion rate of the steel bar, does not need to carry out complicated operations such as acid washing, heating, water injection and the like, can provide the corrosion rate measurement result on site, and has the advantages of high measurement speed, high measurement precision, simple and convenient operation, high reliability and high intelligent degree.

title_en: Storage and computation integrated architecture pulse array design method suitable for multi-precision neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a storage and computation integrated architecture pulse array design method suitable for a multi-precision neural network, which comprises the following steps: acquiring an original digital signal, and splitting the original digital signal into a plurality of 1-bit digital signals with the number of bits equal to that of the original digital signal; generating a plurality of input analog signals according to the plurality of 1-bit digital signals, wherein the plurality of input analog signals respectively correspond to different 1-bit digital signals; respectively carrying out analog-to-digital conversion on the input analog signals to obtain a plurality of target digital signals; and generating a convolution calculation result corresponding to the original digital signal according to the plurality of target digital signals. According to the invention, the original digital signal is split into a plurality of 1-bit digital signals, and a storage and calculation integrated framework can be constructed by adopting a low-bit AD/DA module, so that the problems of high power consumption and large area overhead of the storage and calculation integrated framework caused by the adoption of a high-bit AD/DA module in the storage and calculation integrated framework in the prior art are effectively solved.

title_en: Unmanned horseshoe harvester based on visual navigation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned water chestnut harvester based on visual navigation, which relates to the technical field of water chestnut harvesting and comprises a navigation mechanism, a remote measurement component and a microcontroller, wherein the navigation mechanism comprises a base and a tractor, the top of the base is fixedly provided with a shell and an adjusting component, one side of the shell is provided with the remote measurement component and the microcontroller, and the base is arranged at the top end of the tractor; the driving mechanism comprises a first driving shaft connected with the output end of the tractor and a transmission assembly driven by the first driving shaft; the screening mechanism is arranged at the tail of the tractor and comprises a support frame with a frame type structure and a tire for supporting the support frame to move, the support frame is used for supporting the transmission assembly and the screening assembly, and the screening assembly is connected with the transmission assembly. According to the invention, the microcontroller is arranged, the position coordinate and the speed information of the tractor are obtained through the automatic navigator arranged by the microcontroller, the tractor walks according to the set path and observes images of cultivated crops in real time through the remote measuring camera and the monitoring camera, and the navigation precision is improved.

title_en: Image generation method and device based on country and geography relation
abstract_en: The invention relates to an image generation method and a device based on country geodesic relation, belonging to the technical field of visual analysis of the geodesic relation, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly, well distributing each country node in an image for the geographic positions of different countries and the geodesic relation numerical values between a target country and other countries; then, classifying the country nodes, dividing the image into regions, regarding the country nodes as charged particles, calculating potential energy of each divided region, determining all equipotential lines in the same category by utilizing potential energy continuity, and determining contour lines containing all equipotential lines in the category; and finally, traversing the connection path between every two country nodes under each category, adding a proper virtual node, updating the connection path, and avoiding the path of direct connection between two country nodes from passing through the country nodes which do not belong to the current category. The images generated by the method effectively and reasonably display the georelationship among the countries, are highly visualized and are beneficial to analysis of the georelationship among the countries.

title_en: Hard disk fault prediction model establishment method based on multidimensional characteristics and application thereof
