abstract_en: The invention discloses a hard disk fault prediction model establishment method based on multidimensional characteristics and application thereof, belonging to the field of computer storage, comprising the following steps: obtaining a characteristic data set, wherein each sample comprises a hard disk state, corresponding characteristic data and time; after the samples in the characteristic data set are sequenced according to the ascending order of time, sample equalization and standardization are carried out, and then the samples are divided into a training set and a testing set according to the ascending order of time; taking the hard disk state as label information, training and testing the deep learning model by utilizing a training set and a testing set to obtain a hard disk fault prediction model; the characteristic data comprises SMART information, firmware version information, event log information and the like, each type of information corresponds to one or more data items, and the data items of the digital type take the value as an accumulated value. The invention uses SMART information, firmware version information, system information and the like as characteristic data at the same time, fully considers the time sequence of the data, can improve the training effect of the model, and finally improves the precision of hard disk fault prediction.

title_en: WAF equipment running state monitoring method and device and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a device for monitoring the running state of WAF equipment and a computer storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving state data sent by each component of the WAF in real time; aggregating the state data based on the utilization rate of the state data within a first preset time interval to summarize the state data into first operation data; determining the utilization rate of the first operation data in a second preset time interval according to the first operation data, and aggregating the first operation data according to the utilization rate in the second preset time interval to summarize the first operation data into second operation data; and determining the utilization rate of the second operation data in a third preset time interval according to the second operation data, and aggregating the second operation data according to the utilization rate in the third preset time interval to summarize the second operation data into third operation data. By adopting the method, the technical problems that the WAF equipment in the prior art cannot display state data in a large latitude and the disk capacity is wasted by storing meaningless state data are solved.

title_en: Information processing method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses an information processing method and device, and the specific implementation scheme is as follows: in response to receiving an information processing request sent by a user, extracting respective data cleansing information and cleansing codes from a configuration file, wherein each data cleansing information comprises: the type of the source data source, the connection information of the source data source, the type of the destination data source and the connection information of the destination data source; acquiring each piece of data on each source data source according to the connection information of each source data source, and generating a data table corresponding to each piece of data cleaning information; based on the type of the source data source and the type of the destination data source, cleaning the data in each data table by using cleaning codes; and writing the data in the data table corresponding to the cleaned corresponding data cleaning information into the destination data source according to the connection information of each destination data source. The scheme realizes a simple, efficient and de-differentiated information processing method.

title_en: Method and system for collecting water and soil conservation data
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for collecting water and soil conservation data, wherein the system comprises a mobile terminal and a server terminal, wherein the mobile terminal receives a water and soil conservation sampling task checking request of a user, acquires water and soil conservation sampling tasks distributed for the user from the server terminal and displays the water and soil conservation tasks, acquires the water and soil conservation data collected according to the water and soil conservation sampling tasks, records the collected water and soil conservation data into a task electronic form corresponding to the water and soil conservation sampling tasks, performs compliance checking on the water and soil conservation data in the received task electronic form, and the server terminal creates engineering to perform compliance checking on the water and soil conservation data in the task electronic form uploaded by each mobile terminal and stores the compliance data in an electronic form mode. The water and soil conservation monitoring efficiency can be improved.

title_en: Data processing method, device, server and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a data processing method, a data processing device, a server and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of information processing. The data processing method comprises the steps of receiving a data processing request for first data in a first data set; wherein the first data set comprises at least one encrypted data set; in response to the data processing request, in a case where it is determined that the first data includes encrypted data in the encrypted data group, acquiring a decryption key corresponding to the first data set; decrypting the encrypted data group corresponding to the first data according to the decryption key to obtain second data, and processing the second data to obtain target data; wherein the second data comprises at least part of the data in the decrypted data. By adopting the data processing method, the data processing device, the server and the storage medium, the problem that data processing cannot be effectively and flexibly carried out on the premise of ensuring data safety in the prior art is at least solved.

title_en: Elevator component state detection method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method, an apparatus, an electronic device and a storage medium for detecting a state of an elevator assembly, the method comprising: acquiring real-time image information of an elevator traction steel belt; and carrying out image detection on the real-time image information based on a damage detection network to obtain a damage detection result of the elevator traction steel belt in the real-time image information. The elevator traction steel belt detection device can improve the detection efficiency of the elevator traction steel belt and reduce the operation difficulty of the elevator traction steel belt detection.

title_en: Method and device for cleaning partial discharge data, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a device for cleaning partial discharge data, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: and obtaining target partial discharge data by a filtering function based on the partial discharge data corresponding to the target polarity in the target insulating material so as to avoid the interference generated by non-target partial discharge data in the partial discharge data. The first curve and the second curve are respectively determined from a reference discharge amount, a reference phase, an initial maximum discharge amount, and an ending maximum discharge amount determined based on the target partial discharge data. And determining a target starting phase and a target ending phase based on a first zero crossing point and a second zero crossing point in the first curve and the second curve respectively, and obtaining cleaned partial discharge data based on the target starting phase and the target ending phase. Therefore, the interval where the partial discharge data to be cleaned are located can be accurately determined, the noise of the partial discharge data can be effectively eliminated, and the evaluation on the state of the insulating material in the power equipment cannot be influenced.

title_en: Professional talent classification statistical database and method beneficial to cloud search
abstract_en: The invention discloses a professional talent classified statistic database and a method beneficial to cloud search, belonging to the technical field of talent databases. Index guidance is provided, so that a guide channel capable of quickly searching and screening is formed, and index information is independent of a data packet and a database, is easy to update and is convenient to delete; personal information leakage is avoided, and meanwhile talent searching efficiency is improved; realizing the specialization and enterprise screening type talent index.

title_en: Data encryption method and device
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a data encryption method and device, and relates to the field of information security, wherein any two identical plaintext data can be encrypted to obtain different ciphertext data, and therefore the security of the ciphertext data is improved. The specific scheme comprises the following steps: the server responds to the encryption instruction, and obtains interference factor data corresponding to plaintext data to be encrypted, wherein the same plaintext data corresponds to different interference factor data; generating an object to be encrypted based on the plaintext data and the interference factor data; and encrypting the object to be encrypted to obtain ciphertext data.

title_en: Large intestine polyp segmentation method and system based on endoscope image and related components
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large intestine polyp segmentation method, a large intestine polyp segmentation system and related components based on endoscope images, wherein the method comprises the following steps: inputting the endoscope image into a pre-trained Res2Net model for feature coding to obtain a plurality of low-layer features and a plurality of high-layer features; respectively carrying out feature enhancement processing on a plurality of high-level features and carrying out feature fusion by using a feature integration module to obtain a global mapping chart; carrying out dimension reduction guidance processing on the high-rise features of the highest layer by using the global mapping map to obtain a first-level detection map, carrying out dimension reduction guidance processing on the high-rise features of the second layer by using the first-level detection map to obtain a second-level detection map, and so on to obtain a detection map corresponding to each high-rise feature; and performing probability calculation on the detection graph of the high-level features of the lowest level to obtain a final prediction result. According to the method, the Res2Net model and the feature integration module are used for extracting the image features, the feature extraction module is used for training to obtain the final segmentation result graph, the whole process is more efficient and faster, and the obtained segmentation result is more accurate.

title_en: Artificial intelligence based monitoring system and monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent monitoring, and provides a monitoring system and a monitoring method based on artificial intelligence, wherein the monitoring system comprises a data acquisition unit; a data storage unit; the data processing unit is used for analyzing and processing the data through an artificial intelligence technology, acquiring image data, monitoring equipment data and shooting time data which are identified from a video, inputting multi-source information data into a machine learning model, and acquiring image data classified according to image types and/or image data classified according to monitoring equipment and/or image data ordered according to time sequence; the data matching unit is used for comparing the target image data with the label data obtained by the data processing unit, if the comparison is consistent, the matching is successful, and if the comparison is inconsistent, the matching is failed; and the data positioning unit is used for positioning all image data successfully matched in the data matching unit to acquire video data. The invention can save the time for the user to know the monitoring condition of the target area.

title_en: PCIE link negotiation method, system, device and medium for storage device
abstract_en: A method for negotiating a PCIE link of a storage device includes: monitoring the state of a state machine of each Port of the Switch chip in real time, and judging whether the Port has hard disk access; responding to the state that the state is the non-predetermined state and the hard disk access exists, and powering down the hard disk on the Port; responding to the power-off of the hard disk, and sequentially carrying out Unbind and bind operations on the Port by the Switch chip; in response to the operation being completed, the hard disk on Port is powered up and the Switch chip renegotiates the link with the hard disk on Port. According to the method, whether the state machine of the Port on the Switch chip works normally or not is judged by monitoring the state of the state machine of the Port on the Switch chip, and the PCIE equipment on the abnormal Port on the Switch chip is mounted on the Switch chip again by restarting the local simulation equipment when the state machine is abnormal, so that the renegotiation connection from the Switch chip to the PCIE link is realized.

title_en: Aircraft aerodynamic analysis method based on boundary substitution hybrid model
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to an aircraft pneumatic analysis method based on a boundary substitution hybrid model, and solves the problems of large calculation amount and low efficiency of a traditional aircraft CFD method. An aircraft aerodynamic analysis method based on a boundary substitution hybrid model is realized by adopting the following steps: firstly, establishing a spherical aerodynamic reduced-order model of the correlation among pressure, density, flow velocity and temperature of air on a spherical surface; then establishing an adjacent field CFD model of the aircraft; then, a boundary substitution hybrid model is obtained by coupling the spherical aerodynamic reduced-order model and the near-field CFD model of the aircraft: and finally, performing pneumatic analysis on the newly designed aircraft by using the boundary replacement hybrid model. The boundary substitution hybrid model can consider the influence of the surrounding flow field on the aircraft, does not need to carry out CFD simulation on the surrounding background flow field, greatly reduces the calculation amount of numerical simulation, and obviously accelerates the design process of the aerodynamic shape of the aircraft.

title_en: Early warning method, device, equipment and storage medium for business compliance risk
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for early warning of business compliance risk, wherein the method comprises the following steps: aiming at each functional task in the insurance industry, determining a single risk parameter and a comprehensive risk parameter of the functional task by utilizing the service type of the functional task; determining a first parameter value of each single service evaluation parameter related to the functional task according to the completed task data of the target executor aiming at the functional task in a preset monitoring period; generating and transmitting first early warning information aiming at a target executor if any one of the first parameter values is abnormal; determining a second parameter value of the comprehensive service evaluation parameter related to the functional task according to the first parameter value of each target single service evaluation parameter in response to the fact that all the first parameter values are normal; and generating and transmitting second early warning information aiming at the target executor in response to the occurrence of the abnormality of the second parameter value. In this way, the monitoring efficiency of the business compliance risk can be improved.

title_en: Blade intersecting line of impeller machine, design method of blade and blade of impeller machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a design method of a blade intersecting line of an impeller machine, which comprises the following steps: determining a two-dimensional blade outer ring molded line of the blade according to the two-dimensional blade outer ring molded line, and determining an intersecting line of the blade and the outer ring according to the blade outer ring molded line and the inner surface parameters of the outer ring; calculating a corresponding three-dimensional blade outer ring bone line of the two-dimensional blade outer ring bone line on the inner surface of the outer ring according to the two-dimensional blade outer ring bone line and the inner surface parameters of the outer ring; determining a projection vector according to the three-dimensional blade outer ring bone line, determining a projection plane according to the projection vector, and projecting the three-dimensional blade outer ring bone line on the projection plane; taking a point set of projection of the three-dimensional blade outer ring bone line on a projection plane to determine a two-dimensional blade inner ring bone line; and determining a two-dimensional blade inner ring line of the blade according to the determined two-dimensional blade inner ring line, and determining an intersecting line of the blade and the inner ring according to the two-dimensional blade inner ring line, parameters of a projection surface and outer surface parameters of the inner ring.

title_en: Controllable firmware upgrading device and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a controllable firmware upgrading device and a method thereof.A decryption algorithm is used for encrypting and decrypting firmware, upgrading times and authority levels among a computer, an upgrading device and an elevator component based on a firmware key, an upgrading time key and an authority level key; the upgrading device integrates a firmware upgrading function and a debugging function, the two functions are operated according to the permission level, firmware upgrading equipment and debugging equipment are unified, the cost is reduced, the convenience is improved, and a manufacturer still has the application range and the application times for controlling the device on the premise that a tool is lost, so that the damage of own benefits is prevented.

title_en: Burma language image text recognition method and device fusing multi-scale semantic feature maps
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for recognizing Burma language image texts fusing a multi-scale semantic feature map, and belongs to the field of natural language processing. Aiming at the structural characteristics of Burma image characters, the invention provides a Burma image text recognition method fusing a multi-scale semantic feature diagram, which mainly comprises four parts of Burma image text data preprocessing, a Burma recognition model fusing the multi-scale semantic feature diagram, Burma image text recognition model training based on an MIX UP data enhancement strategy, Burma image text recognition and the like. The method provided by the invention can effectively fuse the character structure characteristics of the Burma image to improve the Burma image text recognition model performance, and has theoretical and practical application values for southeast Asia image text recognition.

title_en: Formula-based data processing method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a formula-based data processing method, which can obtain a formula character string to be processed with grammar errors, and then input the formula character string to be processed into a machine learning model to obtain a target formula character string. The machine learning model mentioned here can correct the formula character string with grammar error into the formula character string meeting the grammar requirement. Therefore, in the embodiment of the present application, after the formula character string to be processed is input into the machine learning model, a target formula character string meeting the grammar requirement can be obtained, in other words, the obtained target formula character string has no grammar error. Therefore, after the target formula character string is obtained, the target formula can be obtained according to the target formula character string. Therefore, by using the scheme of the embodiment of the application, the grammar errors of the formula character string to be processed, which have grammar errors, can be corrected, so that the target formula is obtained.

title_en: Application execution method and related device
abstract_en: The application discloses an application execution method, which comprises the following steps: when the encryption function of the application is executed, skipping the execution flow to the virtual machine layer; obtaining custom instruction data corresponding to the encryption function from the application; and performing interpretation and execution processing on the custom instruction data based on the interpreter function of the virtual machine layer to obtain an execution result, and returning the execution result. The method comprises the steps of interpreting and executing custom instruction data of an encryption function through an interpreter function of a virtual machine layer to obtain an execution result, and returning the execution result, so that the actual execution logic of the encryption function is kept secret in application, the custom instruction data of the encryption function is executed in the virtual machine, the execution logic of the encryption function is prevented from being leaked, and the data security of source codes is further improved. The application also discloses an application execution device, a server and a computer readable storage medium, which have the beneficial effects.

title_en: Image data cleaning method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for cleaning image data, and belongs to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the following steps: extracting features of a plurality of first image data to be cleaned; determining second image data satisfying a cleansing condition among the plurality of first image data based on features of the plurality of first image data; in response to determining that the end condition is not satisfied based on the second image data, extracting features of third image data, and iteratively obtaining a cleaning result based on the features of the third image data, wherein the third image data is the plurality of first image data or image data except the second image data in the plurality of first image data. The method improves the accuracy of the extracted features through an iterative method of extracting the features for multiple times and determining the image data meeting the cleaning conditions until the end conditions are met, thereby obtaining a better data cleaning effect.

title_en: Non-contact multi-target positioning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-contact multi-target positioning method, which comprises the following steps: parameter estimation processing, including mathematical modeling, spatial spectrum function construction, spectrum peak value solving and heat map generation; CBR module processing, namely taking the heat map obtained in the parameter estimation processing as model input, and processing by adopting a plurality of CBR modules; and (4) processing by a classifier module, taking the data processed by the CBR module as input, and classifying by using a Softmax method to obtain a prediction result of the final position information. The method estimates the position information parameters (AoA value and ToF value) of multi-target positioning by adopting the MUSIC algorithm, converts the parameter information into a heat map form and inputs the heat map form into the convolutional neural network, so that the extraction capability of the characteristics is greatly enhanced. On the basis of strong position feature extraction capability, the technical scheme provided by the invention realizes the high-precision positioning function of indoor multiple targets.

title_en: Data cache loading method and device
abstract_en: The application relates to a data cache loading method and a data cache loading system, in particular to the technical field of network communication. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring service information corresponding to network equipment; the service information is used for indicating the execution condition of each service program on the network equipment; determining a target service instruction corresponding to the target service program according to the service information; determining a target cache region matched with the target service instruction in a cache region in the network equipment; and storing and locking the target service instruction in the target cache region. According to the scheme, the target service program is screened from each service program, and the corresponding target service instruction is solidified in the target cache region, so that when the target service program is executed for multiple times, the target service instruction can be directly read from the cache region, the running efficiency of the target service program is improved, and the execution efficiency of the network equipment is improved.

title_en: Data processing method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data processing method and device, and relates to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a data stream to be stored, wherein the data stream comprises state data and metadata of the state data, storing the state data into a pre-established storage table, wherein the storage table is located outside a data stream processing platform, responding to an instruction for carrying out data snapshot on the data stream processing platform, and carrying out snapshot processing on the metadata of the state data based on a snapshot mechanism. The embodiment realizes the stripping of the state data from the data flow management, reduces the data volume of the snapshot data, shortens the snapshot time, and solves the snapshot blocking problem during the real-time calculation of mass data, thereby effectively enhancing the robustness, stability and fault tolerance of the real-time calculation of the data.

title_en: Quick health code scanning method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of computers, and provides a quick health code scanning method, a quick health code scanning device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of automatically acquiring a plurality of recently scanned two-dimensional codes of a scanning program when the scanning program of mobile equipment is opened; and the user selects the recently scanned two-dimensional code corresponding to the current access control for identification. According to the quick health code scanning method, when a scanning program of the mobile equipment is started, a plurality of recently scanned two-dimensional codes of the scanning program are automatically acquired; then the user selects the recently scanned two-dimensional code corresponding to the current access control to identify, so that the health code can be rapidly scanned, the health code which needs to be identified frequently can be rapidly scanned without queuing, and the code scanning speed is improved.

title_en: Detection image generation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection image generation method and a detection image generation system, relates to the technical field of detection image generation, and aims to solve the problem that a detection image cannot be generated efficiently. The detection image generation method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining a detection true value and random noise, then generating a target foreground image by using a foreground target generation model according to the detection true value, and generating a background image by using a background generation model according to the random noise. And finally, overlapping the foreground image and the background image of the target to obtain a detection image. The detection image generation method and the detection image generation system are used for generating the detection image facing the detection task and expanding the small sample.

title_en: Voice self-adaptive completion system based on multi-mode knowledge graph
abstract_en: A multi-modal knowledge-graph based speech adaptive completion system, comprising: a data receiver, a data analyzer, and a data reasoner, wherein: the data receiver performs preprocessing according to the received audio and video data and outputs the preprocessed audio and video data to the data analyzer; the data analyzer analyzes the voice and the image to extract a waveform time sequence characteristic and a lip track characteristic, and a phoneme sequence is obtained through multi-modal combined characterization; and the data inference device carries out domain conversation modeling and candidate text prediction according to the historical text, carries out text inference by combining the phoneme sequence to obtain sentences with semantics, and synthesizes complete voice according to the waveform characteristics. According to the method, the phoneme recognition is carried out when the voice mode is absent through the phoneme reasoning model, meanwhile, the domain conversation modeling is carried out on the historical text generated by the existing voice according to the semantic relation among the entities in the multi-mode knowledge map, so that the text with the semantics is deduced and generated, and the voice is synthesized by combining the waveform characteristics of the voice of the user to form the audio after completion.

title_en: Parking route sharing processing method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a parking route sharing processing method, device and equipment. The method comprises the following steps: displaying the recorded at least one parking route after the vehicle completes the learning of the at least one parking route; receiving a parking route to be shared selected by a sharing party from the at least one parking route; generating a sharing access entrance according to the parking route to be shared; and receiving a sharing issuing instruction of the sharing party to the sharing access entrance so that the vehicle of the sharing receiver can automatically drive by using the received parking route. According to the scheme, the parking routes can be shared, so that different users can make full use of the shared parking routes to improve the parking efficiency and improve the user experience.

title_en: Conversation method, conversation device, electronic equipment and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a conversation method, a conversation device, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of communication. The method comprises the following steps: displaying a dialog interface of the target dialog object, wherein the dialog interface comprises at least one piece of dialog information and an information input box; responding to the operation of inputting information in the information input box, and displaying a popup window, wherein the popup window comprises a reminding control which is used for reminding whether a target conversation object is correct or not; and responding to the operation of the reminding control, and if the target dialog object is determined to be correct, displaying the information input box. The method and the device for the instant messaging software avoid the problem that the user selects the wrong conversation object due to excessive messages of different conversation objects, assist the user in operation when the user frequently receives and sends messages, improve the efficiency and the correctness of message reply of the user, and improve the use experience of the user on the instant messaging software.

title_en: Accurate text representation method based on neural network self-attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses an accurate text representation method based on a neural network self-attention mechanism, which comprises the following steps of: preprocessing the data set according to different types of tasks; initializing and representing a vector according to the semantic vector model word level; obtaining a primary global word representation using a Bi-LSTM neural network model; fusing global information by using an attention mechanism to obtain a context screening vector; two accurate text representation vector models are adapted for different text tasks, accurate text representation of word granularity is obtained for the abstract task, and the abstract text is generated based on a Seq2Seq model and attention mechanism decoding; and for the classification task, obtaining accurate text representation of sentence granularity and obtaining a prediction result. The method simulates human thinking paths in a real scene, reads the text to obtain the context information, determines the importance degree of each word, screens important text information from a semantic level, improves the accuracy of text expression vectors, and improves the accuracy of text summarization and text classification tasks.

title_en: Method and device for storing mass files, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for storing massive files, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a data file uploaded by a client, and a data volume and a file identifier corresponding to the data file; determining a corresponding data node according to the data volume of the data file, and sending the data file to the data node so that the data node stores the data file; receiving and storing attribute information sent by a data node; generating index information according to the data volume and the file identification corresponding to the data file and the attribute information of the data node; and sending the index information to the query node so that the query node stores the index information. By separately storing the attribute information of the data nodes and the index information of the data files, the content of file management can be reduced, and the performance of file management is improved.

title_en: Industrial sewage monitoring and processing method and system based on edge calculation and block chain
abstract_en: The invention provides an industrial sewage monitoring and processing system and method based on edge calculation and a block chain, which comprises an edge end, a cloud platform, a block chain network and a supervision department; the method comprises the following steps that the edge terminals acquire the sewage quality of each treatment link through Internet of things equipment, all acquired data are uploaded to a cloud platform, and the cloud platform predicts a sewage treatment model through statistical analysis and then sends the sewage treatment model to each edge terminal; the edge end calculates the optimal sewage treatment index through a model issued by the cloud platform and controls the sewage treatment equipment; the block chain network is deployed on each edge end and a supervision department and used for recording the full life cycle data of sewage treatment; the supervision department carries out source tracing inquiry through the access block chain network and gives corresponding reward and punishment measures; according to the invention, through the synergistic effect of the edge calculation and the block chain, the real-time sewage treatment capacity is improved, the sewage treatment process is more intelligent, and the traceability of the information of the sewage treatment process is ensured.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and storage medium for recognizing actions in video data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for identifying actions in video data, wherein the related method comprises the following steps: pooling the original video feature tensor from different directions at different scales by adopting a video data multi-content dependence modeling mode, and performing dependence activation by utilizing a convolution layer to obtain a corresponding dependence representation; and (3) realizing aggregation of dependent characteristics by using an attention mechanism of an inquiry structure, optimizing the original video feature tensor, and identifying the action by using an optimization result. According to the scheme, the convolution-based motion recognition model can be directly inserted, almost no additional parameters and calculated amount are provided, and experiments show that the classification performance of the motion recognition model can be obviously improved.

title_en: Forest and grassland fire early warning system and method based on PNN neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a forest and grassland fire early warning system and method based on a PNN neural network, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence early warning. The system comprises: the early warning management platform and the plurality of detection devices are in communication connection with the early warning management platform; the detection device comprises: the system comprises a detection module, a wireless communication module and a microprocessor; the detection module comprises a plurality of detection sensors; the microprocessor is used for controlling the wireless communication module to send the information detected by the detection module to the early warning management platform; the system is also used for analyzing the information detected by the detection module by using a fire early warning model based on a PNN neural network to obtain fire early warning information comprising a fire early warning grade; and the early warning management platform is used for early warning according to the fire early warning information determined by the detection device. According to the invention, the artificial intelligent neural network is adopted to carry out intelligent analysis on various detection information, so that the early warning accuracy can be improved, and the fire early warning grade matched with the current fire condition can be obtained, thus the early warning treatment is more suitable.

title_en: Software version management system of relay protection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a software version management system of a relay protection device, which is characterized in that: the system comprises an equipment account standing module, an event analysis module, a defect management module and an inspection management module. When the relay protection device account is manually input, the system can automatically match the version number and the check code from the standard version library, thereby adapting to the requirements of new trends and bringing convenience to the work management of dispatching services.

title_en: Data processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a data processing method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, and relates to an artificial intelligence technology, comprising the following steps: determining target medical resources in the integrated medical system based on medical record information of a user, acquiring target session information from the target medical resources, determining a characteristic matrix corresponding to the target session information, calling an analysis model corresponding to the target medical resources to process the characteristic matrix, and generating an analysis result report. And performing hit matching on the analysis result report and the channel theme of each user channel, determining the user channel which is successfully hit matched as a target user channel, and adding the associated account of the user to the target user channel, so that the user data in the user channels can be managed in a grouping manner, and the data management efficiency is improved. The present application may relate to blockchain techniques, such as analysis result reports may be written into blockchains. The application also relates to the technical field of digital medical treatment, and the medical record information is electronic medical record information.

title_en: House source recommendation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure discloses a house source recommendation method, a house source recommendation device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the house source recommendation method comprises the steps of receiving decoration requirement information sent by a decoration design client, wherein the decoration requirement information comprises current house type structure data, geographic positions and design requirement information of a house, inquiring a design scheme meeting the design requirement information based on the current house type structure data of the house, responding to an inquiry result that no design scheme meeting the design requirement information exists, acquiring house source information with total price information of the house, the geographic positions and the matching degree of the design requirement information being larger than a first matching degree, and sending the house source information to the decoration design client. According to the embodiment of the disclosure, when the decoration design application program can not provide the AI design scheme meeting the expectations for the user, the user directly gives up the problem of low viscosity of the application program user caused by the application program, and the utilization rate of the decoration design application program is improved.

title_en: Offshore wind farm access system risk assessment method considering time-varying working conditions
abstract_en: The invention relates to a risk assessment method for an offshore wind farm access system considering time-varying working conditions, which comprises the following steps: 1) determining the time-varying fault rate of n key devices of an offshore wind farm access system; 2) simulating the running state of the key equipment by a Monte Carlo method according to the time-varying fault rate of the key equipment; 3) judging whether the offshore wind farm access system loses power or not by a graph theory method according to the running state of the key equipment, if so, calculating and recording the power loss of the offshore wind farm access system, and otherwise, repeating the step 2); 4) and (3) judging whether the convergence precision is met, if so, calculating a risk evaluation index of the offshore wind farm access system, and otherwise, repeating the step (2). Compared with the prior art, the method provided by the invention has the advantages that the integrity research is carried out on the offshore wind farm access system, and the accuracy is high.

title_en: Air-ground cooperative self-organizing network data transmission method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air-ground cooperative self-organizing network data transmission method, which comprises the following steps: constructing a ground self-organizing network data transmission system model assisted by an unmanned aerial vehicle; constructing a joint optimization problem related to the unmanned aerial vehicle track and ground node access by taking the maximum end-to-end time delay of the minimized data packet as an optimization target; constructing a system MDP model of the unmanned aerial vehicle-assisted ground self-organizing network transmission data packet; and solving the joint optimization problem by adopting a deep reinforcement learning algorithm, and applying a solving result to the air-ground cooperative self-organizing network data transmission to reduce the end-to-end time delay of the data packet. The invention solves the joint optimization problem of unmanned aerial vehicle track and ground node access by adopting a deep reinforcement learning algorithm, can realize quick online decision, enables the data packet to be flexibly transmitted in a better line-of-sight link, improves the transmission performance of the self-organized network and expands the application range of the self-organized network.

title_en: Data issuing method, device, electronic equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a data issuing method, apparatus, electronic device, medium, and product, and relates to the field of computer technologies, in particular, to the field of over-the-air download technologies. The specific implementation scheme comprises the following steps: and the quota system determines the current remaining issued quota after the preset duration and judges whether the current remaining issued quota is greater than the preset quota or not. If yes, determining the quota allocated to each issuing node, and sending a first message to each issuing node, wherein the sum of the quota allocated to each issuing node is equal to the current remaining issued quota, so that each issuing node issues data according to the quota in the first message. If not, sending a second message to each issuing node, wherein the second message is used for indicating that each issuing node commonly maintains the current remaining issuing quota, so that each issuing node issues data and updates the current remaining issuing quota when determining that the current remaining issuing quota is not zero. Thereby improving the flexibility of data transmission.

title_en: Chat intelligent analysis monitoring system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a chat intelligent analysis monitoring system based on big data, comprising: the data acquisition module is connected with the game client and used for acquiring chat data in the game client and sending the acquired chat data to the data analysis module; the data analysis module is used for receiving the chatting data sent by the data analysis module and judging whether the chatting data contains sensitive characters or not; the data sending module is used for receiving the chatting data with the marks sent by the data analysis module and replacing the marks with specific characters, and when the replacement is completed, the data sending module sends the chatting data to a chatting interface in the game client; and the database module is used for storing and updating the sensitive characters and storing the similar meaning words and the replacement words of the sensitive characters. The method and the device can avoid that a user sends abuse characters in a mode of combining a plurality of chat data and a plurality of characters, and can shield sensitive characters more accurately.

title_en: Stack state detection method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a stack state detection method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, comprising the following steps: determining a storage position of a target stack, and distributing a memory space with a preset size at a preset position of the target stack; writing the initial preset value into a memory space, and directly reading the initial preset value in the memory space to obtain a corresponding first read-back value; judging whether the first read-back value is consistent with the initial preset value or not, and if so, reading back the initial preset value through a preset detection interface to obtain a corresponding second read-back value; and judging whether the second read-back value is consistent with the initial preset value, if not, judging that the stack state is in an abnormal state and executing program assertion operation. According to the method and the device, the initial preset value stored in the preset position of the stack is read twice, the read-back value and the initial preset value are judged, and the state of the target stack is determined based on the second judgment result, so that low consumption is realized, the stack state is detected efficiently, and the stable operation of a bare engine system is ensured.

title_en: Image correction method, image correction device, electronic equipment and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to an image correction method, an image correction device, a computer device and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an image to be corrected; detecting a target face area in the image to be corrected; performing gridding processing on the image to be corrected to obtain an initial grid corresponding to the image to be corrected, wherein grid points in the initial grid corresponding to the target face area are target grid points; carrying out projection transformation on the target grid points to obtain projection grid points; carrying out scale transformation on the projection grid points to obtain scale grid points; adjusting background grid points except the scale grid points according to the position of the target face area in the image to be corrected to obtain a target grid; and correcting the image to be corrected based on the target grid to obtain a target image. By adopting the method, the visual effect of the corrected image can be effectively improved.

title_en: Floating window display method and device, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a floating window display method and device, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of terminals. The method is applied to the electronic equipment with the telescopic screen, and comprises the following steps: receiving a first input of a user to a floating window on a target interface under the condition that the target screen displays the target interface; and responding to the first input, extending the telescopic screen, canceling the display of the floating window on the target interface, and displaying the floating window in an extending area of the telescopic screen.

title_en: CPU + GPU heterogeneous high-concurrency sequence alignment calculation acceleration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-concurrency sequence comparison calculation acceleration method based on CPU + GPU isomerism, which comprises the following steps: reconstructing a BWA-MEM algorithm code; and (3) concurrent processing of tasks on the CPU: completing the division of a sequence set, and forming a plurality of concurrent tasks for the first time; running a BWA-MEM algorithm after code reconstruction to complete data concurrent processing on the GPU; and (3) task concurrent processing on the GPU: and for the seed set and the chain generated in the sequence data comparison process, dividing the seed set with the same or adjacent length, position and number into the same data block, and performing the same treatment on the chain, thereby completing the division of the seed set and the chain and forming a plurality of concurrent tasks for the second time. The invention closely combines the characteristics of the BWA-MEM algorithm and the characteristics of the GPU accelerating equipment by designing a task parallel and data parallel mode, fully utilizes the strong concurrent operation capability of the GPU, provides excellent performance for a sequence comparison algorithm, and has high comparison and concurrent processing efficiency.

title_en: Query statement generation method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method and a device for generating query sentences, which comprise the steps of obtaining text information, extracting query keywords from the text information, determining slot types corresponding to the query keywords according to the text information, and generating the query sentences by adopting the query keywords and the slot types corresponding to the query keywords. The method can directly determine the query keywords and the slot types corresponding to the query keywords from the text information, and generate a query statement query database, so that the processing efficiency can be improved, and higher accuracy can be obtained.

title_en: Method, device and system for federal learning, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method, a device and a system for federated learning, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to the technical field of computer vision and deep learning. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: performing multiple rounds of training on the global model until a training end condition is met to obtain a trained global model; and publishing the trained global model to the plurality of devices. Each of the multiple rounds of training includes: sending a current global model to at least a portion of the plurality of devices; receiving trained parameters for the current global model from the at least a portion of devices; performing aggregation on the received parameters to obtain a current aggregation model; and adjusting the current aggregation model based on the global shared data set, and updating the adjusted aggregation model to be used as a new current global model for next round of training.

title_en: Method for improving WAF rule matching speed
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for improving WAF rule matching speed, which comprises grouping all rules according to attack types or rule grades; creating an equal number of rule services according to the number of rule groups; simultaneously sending a user request to a rule service cluster through a rule engine front-end processor to perform simultaneous matching; the front end processor assembles the cluster return result and returns the cluster return result to the WAF. Through the distributed rule engine, WAF rule matching performance is greatly improved, so that the performance of the whole WAF is greatly improved.

title_en: Data processing method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a data processing method, a device, an electronic device and a storage medium, which comprise the steps of comparing the value of initial hash data with the memory cache fixed value of the electronic device in advance, dividing the initial hash data into N pieces of sub data when the value of the initial hash data is larger than the memory cache fixed value of the electronic device, so that the value of each piece of sub data is smaller than or equal to the memory cache fixed value of the electronic device, solving the problem that the memory size of the electronic device is limited and hash processing can not be realized, carrying out hash processing according to an initial vector for each piece of sub data to obtain a first hash value, and completing the hash processing of data to be processed on the electronic device according to the processing result of the first hash value of each piece of sub data.

title_en: Method, device and medium for predicting stable boundary of gas compressor aiming at outburst matching
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, equipment and a medium for predicting a stable boundary of a gas compressor aiming at the concurrency matching. The invention analyzes and predicts the flow stability based on the knowledge of the space distribution and the critical load of the compressor load, and the invention considers that the instability can be triggered when the load of the compressor in the existing region reaches the local critical load, thereby having higher prediction precision. In addition, due to the adoption of a calculation method based on a distributed force source volume force model, the load space distribution of the compressor can be quickly acquired under the condition of forward matching, so that the efficiency of stable boundary prediction work can be greatly improved.

title_en: Transaction control method and device for k8s declarative resources
abstract_en: The invention provides a transaction control method and device for k8s declarative resources, belonging to the technical field of cluster management of cloud platforms, and comprising the following steps: the cloud management platform acquires k8s resources needing operation control, and sets a timer, a resource monitor and a reverse operation pool according to the type of the operation control; the cloud management platform monitors resource changes in the k8s cluster through a resource monitor, and identifies resource changes caused by operation control; the cloud management platform judges whether the k8s resource reaches the expected state in the period of the timer according to the resource change, and when the expected state is reached, the task of the timer is ended, and when the expected state is not reached yet when the period of the timer is ended, the reverse operation control task of the reverse operation pool is triggered, and the original state of the k8s resource is recovered. The invention enables the operation of the cloud management platform on the k8s container cluster to be more in line with the design principle of the cloud management platform, and enables a user to more clearly and concisely acquire the operation result.

title_en: Derived variable generation method, device, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to a derivative variable generation method, a device, terminal equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining target derivative variable information to be generated; according to the target derived variable information, at least one piece of preset data field information required by generating the target derived variable is matched from a pre-constructed logic pool, and a pre-configured processing rule is adopted, according to each piece of preset data field information, a preset data field corresponding to the preset data field information is called from a preset storage path, and the preset data field is processed according to the pre-configured processing rule, so that the target derived variable is generated. In this way, the situation that the parsing module cannot work normally or the processing module cannot execute work caused by the change of the original message format or the change of the data structure is prevented. The generation process of the derivative variable is greatly quickened, and the working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Closed loop detection system and method for multi-scale feature fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a closed loop detection system and a method for multi-scale feature fusion, wherein the closed loop detection system comprises a basic feature extraction module and a multi-scale feature extraction-fusion module which are used for respectively processing a similarity to-be-matched image formed by a current acquired image and any one image acquired in a history, and a multi-dimensional similarity measurement module used for acquiring a similarity score of the to-be-matched image. According to the invention, a unified end-to-end network system is constructed by considering different receptive field information of images, different dimensional information of features and the like, a closed loop detection result can be directly output, and the system has high accuracy and higher recall rate, so that the estimated pose of the robot in the SLAM system can be effectively corrected, repositioning of the robot when the pose is lost is assisted, track accumulated errors of the robot which are increased along with time are corrected, and a global consistency map is constructed, so that the robot can obtain more accurate positioning and better map construction effects.

title_en: Method, device, terminal and server for supervising illegal delivery garbage behavior
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method, a device, a terminal and a server for supervising illegal delivery garbage behaviors, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: receiving violation delivery information of a first user, which is sent by a first terminal; determining a target user from the plurality of second users according to the illegal delivery information and the working state information of the plurality of second users; and sending a supervision task message carrying the illegal delivery information to the target user, wherein the supervision task message is used for indicating the target user to supervise the first user aiming at the illegal delivery garbage behavior described in the illegal delivery information. According to the method and the device, after the fact that the first user has the illegal delivery garbage behavior is recognized, the target user can monitor the illegal delivery garbage behavior of the first user in a targeted mode by sending the monitoring task message to the target user, the monitoring degree of the illegal delivery garbage behavior is enhanced, the problem that the illegal delivery garbage behavior is difficult to monitor is effectively solved, and the monitoring effect is good.

title_en: Distributed switchable industrial honey net trapping method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an industrial control honey net trapping method, in particular to a distributed switchable industrial control honey net trapping method based on a honey pot technology and a computer dynamic evidence obtaining technology, which is used for capturing the attack behaviors of an intruder on an industrial system and tracing the identity of the intruder through behavior feature library comparison and customized Trojan horse technology. The method comprises the following steps: (1) The third generation network data acquisition engine (Colasoft Packet Capture Engine, CSPCE for short) and the bottom layer driver (supporting Windows and Linux dual platform) acquire data; (2) Reading out and importing the data packet and the time stamp of the data packet in the PCAP file; (3) Storing the data using a storage engine (Colasoft Storage, CSStorage) technique; (4) The feature recognition technology and the behavior pattern recognition technology perform retrospective analysis on the data.

title_en: Data processing method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a data processing method, a data processing device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: receiving initial message data sent by a gateway; screening the initial message data according to the configured blockchain plugins to obtain target message data; and the target message data is uplink to a blockchain. According to the method and the device, the message data received by the gateway are stored in the blockchain after being processed by the configured blockchain plugin, so that the data can be prevented from being tampered; meanwhile, the plug-in modules are added into the blockchain application in the form of blockchain plug-in modules, so that the installation and the uninstallation are convenient, and meanwhile, the plug-in modules with corresponding functions can be configured according to specific application scenes, so that the service application scenes of data processing are enriched.

title_en: Medical named entity recognition model training method, recognition method and federal learning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical named entity recognition model training method, a medical named entity recognition method and a federal learning system. The medical named entity recognition model training method comprises the following steps: receiving a global model which is sent by a central server and used for identifying medical named entities; training a global model based on local medical text labeling data, and calculating to obtain corresponding gradient data; sending the gradient data to a central server so that the central server trains the global model based on each gradient data received by the federal learning system to obtain a new global model, and distributing the converged global model if the new global model is converged currently; receiving a converged global model; and carrying out localization fine tuning processing on the converged global model based on a local prompt template to form a localization medical named entity recognition model. The technical scheme of the invention realizes privacy protection of medical data and local personalization of the medical named entity recognition model.

title_en: Architecture system type system based on multi-service working mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a architecture system type system based on a multi-service working mode, which comprises a physical layer processing unit, a Hail processing and switching unit, a flow ending and exception processing unit, a state recovery and switch scheduling unit, an automatic retransmission processing unit and a protocol main control unit. The invention realizes splitting each function required by CCSDS Proximity-1 protocol from parallel processing and serial processing dimension, and performs fusion design on parallel processing parts according to the processing similarity to form a general FPGA internal flow processing unit, namely a physical layer processing unit, a Hail processing and switching unit, a flow ending and exception processing unit, a state recovery and switch scheduling unit and an automatic retransmission processing unit, and the serial processing parts are combined into a protocol main control unit, and flexible control is performed by adopting a processing method based on a state base, so that the problems of independent design of each mode and large resource consumption in the traditional protocol realization method are solved, and the development requirements of deep space model miniaturization and low power consumption are supported to the greatest extent.

title_en: Method and system for identifying authenticity of sneakers based on attention mechanism multi-view deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying the authenticity of a sneaker based on attention mechanism multi-view deep learning, belonging to the field of computer vision and comprising the following steps: collecting multi-view sneaker image data; respectively extracting image features; attention-weighted fusion multiview features; training an identification model through labeled and unlabeled data; and predicting the authenticity of the sneakers. The method adopts the convolutional neural network as a basic model to extract the picture characteristics, uses the attention mechanism to adaptively weight and fuse the multi-view characteristic fitting expert experience, improves the anti-interference capability and the generalization performance of the model by learning the identification capability of the model through the marked data and performing semi-supervised learning on a large amount of unmarked data, and can efficiently and accurately identify the authenticity of the sneakers. According to the invention, through flexible deployment of the model, counterfeit sneakers can be detected from a sales source and the identification requirements of consumers can be quickly responded at a sales terminal, so that the current challenge of identifying the authenticity of the large-scale sneakers can be effectively responded.

title_en: High-precision underwater imaging method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-precision underwater imaging method and device, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a scene radiation sub-network, inputting an acquired underwater distortion image, outputting the acquired underwater distortion image into a scene radiation image, estimating a transmittance image and a background light image from the underwater distortion image, synthesizing the scene radiation image, the transmittance image and the background light image into a simulated underwater distortion image according to an underwater imaging formula, constructing a priori discrimination sub-network based on the underwater distortion image, inputting the scene radiation image into the scene radiation image, outputting the degradation degree of the underwater image, and optimizing scene radiation sub-network parameters based on the degradation degree of the underwater image so as to output the optimized high-precision scene radiation image. The invention aims at solving the problem that the underwater image has no truth value when the underwater imaging problem is solved by utilizing the deep learning, avoids the dependence on the truth value diagram, combines an underwater imaging model, and recovers the clear, high-contrast and color-corrected underwater image by utilizing one underwater distorted image.

title_en: Image matching method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides an image matching method, an apparatus and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises: acquiring a contrast group image, a training set sample and a test set sample according to an image set corresponding to the identification object; calculating the maximum Mutual Information Coefficient (MIC) value between the images of the control group and the pixel points in the training set sample; obtaining matched pixel points corresponding to the images of the control group by using the test set samples according to the MIC value; and matching the images to be matched according to the matching pixel points to obtain a matching result. The method, the device and the storage medium can improve the recognition rate of the image, reduce the matching time, improve the matching efficiency and improve the use experience of a user.

title_en: Method and apparatus for post-training quantification of neural networks
abstract_en: A method and apparatus (100) for dynamic point quantization of neural networks to achieve higher accuracy and lower storage requirements is provided. Conventional neural network models require a large amount of disk space, which increases the computational costs associated with these models, requiring the user device to provide a large amount of performance and power. The invention focuses on the quantized deep learning model, thereby reducing the storage requirement without compromising the accuracy and realizing higher performance compared with the traditional model. The neural network is quantified by determining whether an input is positive or negative (901), determining an exponential range of the input (902), determining a maximum range of layer parameters of the input (903), determining an offset of a layer of the input (904), performing an exponential adjustment by converting the input to its corresponding binary form (905), and determining an exponential representation of the input by adding the offset to an exponential adjustment value (906).

title_en: Software upgrading method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of automobile diagnosis equipment, and provides a software upgrading method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the software upgrading method is applied to the diagnosis equipment, and the diagnosis equipment is provided with a software basic package and comprises the following steps: acquiring a target vehicle type and a production year; acquiring a target software package corresponding to the target vehicle type and the production year; and upgrading the software basic package according to the target software package. The method and the device can reduce resource waste, save cost for the user and enhance user experience, thereby being beneficial to effectively expanding new functions of software or enhancing the performance of a software system for the user and further ensuring the effectiveness of vehicle diagnosis.

title_en: Ship rapid detection method based on knowledge distillation and semi-supervised learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship rapid detection method based on knowledge distillation and semi-supervised learning, which comprises the following steps: 1) Constructing a ship data set by utilizing the existing ship data and the ship data acquired from the sea area to be deployed, marking ship targets on part of the data in the data set, generating training samples according to priori frame sliding and enhancing the data; 2) Constructing a teacher network, pre-training by using a marked sample, and then performing semi-supervised training by combining a non-marked sample to realize ship detection; 3) Constructing a lightweight student network, and guiding the student network to realize knowledge distillation on the marked sample and the unmarked sample by using a trained teacher network; 4) And converting the trained student network model into ONNX format, and further optimizing and deploying the student network by adopting OpenVINO to realize rapid ship detection. According to the invention, the knowledge learned by the teacher network with high precision and large capacity is transferred to the lightweight student network, so that the detection precision is ensured, and meanwhile, the rapid ship detection is realized.

title_en: Method for device security verification, computer device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for equipment safety verification, computer equipment and a storage medium. The equipment comprises a main controller, a sub-controller and a safety integrated circuit, wherein the sub-controller and the safety integrated circuit are connected with the main controller, and the method comprises the following steps: the sub controller obtains the verification result of the main controller from the safety integrated circuit; the secondary controller judges whether to terminate the operation of the main controller according to the verification result; and when the sub controller determines to terminate the operation of the main controller according to the verification result, the sub controller terminates the operation of the main controller. The invention realizes the safety verification of the main controller through the safety integrated circuit, and stops the operation of the main controller through the auxiliary controller when the verification of the main controller fails, thereby ensuring the safety of the terminal equipment.

title_en: Coal mine wellhead patrol management system based on iris recognition
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coal mine wellhead patrol management system based on iris recognition, which comprises: all-in-one and wisdom patrol management platform, all-in-one and wisdom patrol management platform pass through the LAN and link to each other. The all-in-one machine comprises a face recognition module, an iris recognition module, a database module and a central control module, and the intelligent patrol management platform comprises an equipment management module, a personnel management module, a patrol management module and a system management module. According to the invention, an iris recognition algorithm and a face recognition algorithm are deployed to an integrated machine and an intelligent patrol management platform component to form a set of system so as to adapt to more patrol scenes, and the problems that patrol management, cheating and class replacement cannot be carried out under special scenes are solved, so that the management cost of property and the equipment investment cost are reduced; the face recognition adjusting parameters are set in the central control module, and the information data of the preset night patrol personnel are locally stored in the all-in-one machine database module, so that the problem of data transmission such as low face recognition speed is solved, and the night patrol management efficiency is improved.

title_en: Lamp set
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of self-timer equipment, and provides a lamp, which comprises: the lamp body is provided with a clamping piece for clamping the mobile terminal equipment; the light module is used for identifying ambient light information; the distance module is used for identifying distance information between the lamp body and a user; and the control module is used for adjusting the brightness of the lamp body based on the ambient light information and the distance information. Compared with the prior art, the intelligent lamp has the advantages that the ambient light information and the distance information between the lamp body and a user are identified through the light module and the distance module, the brightness of the lamp body is intelligently adjusted through the control module based on the identified information, proper light illumination can be provided for the user, the adjusting process is simple, the adjusting effect is excellent, the luminous intensity of the lamp body intelligently changes along with the ambient light information and the distance information, and the intelligent lamp is energy-saving and environment-friendly.

title_en: Block chain-based user identity data verification method, device, system and storage medium
