abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, a system and a storage medium for checking user identity data based on a block chain, wherein the method comprises the following steps: respectively calculating hash values of the user identity data with multiple dimensions to be verified by responding to the verification request, and determining the certificate storage hash for verification according to the dimension attribute combination of the user identity data to be verified; then, combining the hash value of the user identity data of at least one other dimension with the hash value of the user identity data to be verified according to a data structure of the certificate-storing hash for verification to form a verification hash; finally, reading out the certificate-storing hash from the block chain, and judging whether the verification hash is consistent with the certificate-storing hash; if the verification result is consistent with the verification result, the verification is prompted to pass, and otherwise, the verification is prompted to fail. Therefore, the invention can realize rapid multi-dimensional user identity data verification aiming at a multi-party data common maintenance scene, can reduce the pressure of block chain transaction processing capacity, and improves the timeliness of service processing.

title_en: Internet of things monitoring system for parking equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automobile internet of things management, in particular to a parking equipment internet of things monitoring system, and solves the problem that a logistics truck is inconvenient to manage due to the fact that parking equipment capable of monitoring and managing functional information of the truck is absent in the prior art. The utility model provides a parking equipment thing networking monitored control system, includes bottom thing networking information perception layer, network information layer, information processing layer, cell-phone APP terminal and remote call center software application layer. The invention monitors, counts and controls the information of a plurality of trucks through the APP layer of the remote call center, provides intelligent Internet of things management for the truck parking equipment, provides safe and stable shape guarantee for the trucks through monitoring and managing various functions of the trucks, can more conveniently manage fleet safety for the existing logistics companies, improves the transportation efficiency, ensures the matching of vehicles and goods, reduces the oil and gas consumption cost, and better intelligently manages.

title_en: Multi-module driving device based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-module driving device based on a block chain, which comprises a hexagonal middle mounting cylinder, wherein block main boards are arranged on the outer side walls of the middle mounting cylinder, mounting ports for mounting control modules are formed in the block main boards, a rectangular moving port communicated with the mounting ports is formed in the inner wall of the middle mounting cylinder, a heat dissipation channel is formed in the bottom of the rectangular moving port, a mounting frame is arranged in the rectangular moving port, a mounting module is arranged in the mounting frame, and the mounting module is connected with two oppositely-arranged linkage columns through a synchronous linkage assembly. According to the invention, the middle mounting cylinder is arranged, the block main boards are dispersedly arranged on the outer side wall of the middle mounting cylinder, and the mounting modules in the mounting frame and the mounting ports of the block main boards are assembled and connected through the matching of the linkage columns and the mounting frame during mounting, and the mounting of a plurality of mounting modules can be synchronously realized, so that the mounting efficiency is accelerated, the connection of the device is synchronously realized, and the synchronous opening of each block chain is ensured.

title_en: Method for simplifying configuration of comprehensive background monitoring management system of intelligent station house
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for simplifying configuration of an intelligent station room comprehensive background monitoring management system, which comprises the following steps of starting an ID acquisition module to acquire the corresponding relation between an I/0 port of a target host and sensor equipment, and storing the corresponding relation in a form of a table into a designated position; the starting terminal configuration module is connected with the target host and sets configuration rules corresponding to the target host system; importing the form generated by the ID acquisition module into the terminal configuration module, automatically filling the configuration information of each sensor into the corresponding position in the terminal configuration module, and submitting the configuration information to a server database for updating configuration; and checking whether the sensor data is accessed on the background of the target host and the client, and finishing all configuration if the sensor data is accessed normally. The intelligent station room configuration method and the intelligent station room configuration system have the advantages that batch operation is carried out through auxiliary software, configuration of each sensor in the intelligent station room is completed, tasks of sensor ID reading and terminal configuration are completed respectively, and reading and configuration operations are concise and efficient.

title_en: Multi-view software defect prediction method and system based on counterstudy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-view software defect prediction method and a system based on counterstudy, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a first network model according to sample data of a multi-view software module, wherein the first network model is used for constructing an inter-view discriminant analysis loss function for distinguishing similar views from heterogeneous views through depth measurement learning; constructing a second network model according to the multi-view software module sample data, wherein the second network model is used for constructing a countermeasure loss function for distinguishing different software module views in a public subspace through countermeasure learning; constructing a third network model according to the first network model and the second network model; and inputting the multi-view software test data into the third network model to obtain a prediction result. The invention solves the technical problems of poor prediction performance and low accuracy of prediction results of the existing single-view-based software defect prediction technology.

title_en: Data checking method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a data checking method and a data checking device, and the method can comprise the following steps: determining data to be checked from target data, and configuring a linkage checking rule aiming at the data to be checked; screening out associated checking data having a blood relationship with the data to be checked from the target data according to the blood relationship of the data; and checking the processing specifications between the data to be checked and the associated checking data according to the linkage checking rule.

title_en: Hardware architecture applied to Fastformer neural network and calculation method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a hardware architecture applied to Fastformer neural networks and a calculation method thereof. The hardware architecture comprises a data storage module, a reading buffer module, a writing buffer module, a calculation module and a control module, wherein the control module is used for controlling the hardware architecture to execute calculation operation, the calculation module comprises a linear calculation sub-module, a nonlinear calculation sub-module and an intermediate storage sub-module, the linear calculation module comprises a plurality of vector calculation units and is used for executing linear operation comprising vector matrix multiplication, matrix addition and element product by element product, and the nonlinear sub-module is used for executing normalized exponential function operation. The hardware architecture and the calculation method thereof can effectively improve the operation speed and efficiency of Fastformer neural networks.

title_en: Knowledge graph construction method and device for cloud computing and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a knowledge graph construction method and device for cloud computing and a storage medium. In the embodiment of the application, a knowledge graph relation graph for cloud computing is generated in advance, a plurality of problem type entity types, answer type entity types and edge relations among the entity types in a cloud computing after-sale scene are defined in the knowledge graph relation graph, on the basis of the problem type entity phrases are mined from an original after-sale problem corresponding to the cloud computing service and a standard after-sale problem in an after-sale knowledge base, answer type entity phrases are mined from a standard solution in the after-sale knowledge base, and edges are added between the problem type entity phrases and the answer type entity phrases, so that the knowledge graph for the cloud computing after-sale service is obtained. And then, the knowledge graph is applied to the after-sale service of the cloud computing service, so that various problems brought forward by a user in the process of using the cloud computing service can be solved on line and in time, the cost of human resources is reduced, and the after-sale quality of the cloud computing service is improved.

title_en: Product production management system based on secondary analysis
abstract_en: The application provides a product production management system based on secondary analysis, which comprises an MES system; the MES system is used for acquiring a production order and production data of the target product, performing automatic matching and logical operation according to the production order and the production data, generating MES work order information and generating a product bar code according to the MES work order information; wherein the production data comprises: process basic information, a process route base table, material main information and process and material comparison information; MES work order information includes: order quantity, production date, process path information and working procedure material BOM information. The product production management system based on the secondary analysis can create a product production management, product tracing and after-sale service system of a unified identification system based on the secondary analysis, realize resource sharing and business collaboration, and provide data support for purchase optimization, intelligent manufacturing and large-scale customization modes.

title_en: Touch screen processing method and device, mobile terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a touch screen processing method and device, a mobile terminal and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of mobile terminals. The method is applied to a mobile terminal, the mobile terminal comprises a touch screen and a gyroscope, and the method comprises the following steps: and receiving target angular velocity data acquired by the gyroscope, acquiring a target working mode corresponding to the target angular velocity data, and adjusting the working mode of the touch screen based on the target working mode. The touch screen processing method and device, the mobile terminal and the storage medium provided by the embodiment of the application acquire the target angular velocity data through the gyroscope of the mobile terminal, acquire the target working mode corresponding to the target angular velocity data, and adjust the working mode of the mobile terminal based on the target working mode, so that the dynamic adjustment of the working mode is realized, and the use experience and the power consumption of the mobile terminal are balanced.

title_en: Method, device and equipment for determining weighing state
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device and equipment for determining a weighing state, which are used for judging whether the weighing state of a logistics piece to be weighed is normal or not more visually and accurately from an image layer, and can carry out accurate coping processing according to a judgment result of the weighing state, thereby ensuring the stability and the sorting efficiency of automatic sorting operation. The application provides a method for determining a weighing state, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a target image, wherein the target image is an image obtained by shooting a weighing device for weighing the logistics piece to be weighed; carrying out logistics piece identification in the target image to obtain a logistics piece identification result; and determining whether the weighing state of the logistics piece to be weighed is normal or not according to the logistics piece identification result and the preset abnormal weighing state condition of the logistics piece.

title_en: Soil humidity prediction method and device based on EDC-LSTM model and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, and provides a soil humidity prediction method based on an EDC-LSTM model and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical sample data; the historical sample data comprises soil humidity, precipitation and atmospheric temperature at each preset historical moment; training a preset prediction model through the historical sample data so that the prediction model reaches preset precision; wherein the prediction model comprises a first data processing layer and a second task prediction layer; determining intermediate time sequence data between the input time step and a prediction time step based on a first data processing layer of the prediction model reaching a preset precision through input data in the input time step; and predicting the soil humidity to be predicted within the prediction time step through the second task prediction layer based on the input data and the intermediate time sequence data. The technical scheme provided by the invention can solve the problem of low soil humidity prediction precision by using the traditional LSTM model.

title_en: Information pushing method and system based on supply chain management
abstract_en: The invention relates to an information pushing method and system based on supply chain management, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring preference characteristic data and correlation characteristic data of a supplier, wherein the preference characteristic data and the correlation characteristic data are associated with all purchasing item key information being recruited by a platform; respectively carrying out quantization processing on the preference characteristic data and the correlation characteristic data to obtain preference quantization data and correlation quantization data; inputting the preference quantitative data and the correlation quantitative data characteristic data into a preset user behavior model to obtain a matching score of each purchase item; and performing descending order arrangement on the matching scores of each purchasing item to obtain a first sequence, and pushing the purchasing items corresponding to the first s matching scores in the first sequence to the supplier. The invention shortens the time and investment of the supplier in the aspect of acquiring the business information, actively and accurately matches the purchasing item information which the supplier is interested in, thereby pushing the personalized business information for the user.

title_en: Parsing queries using structured and unstructured data
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method comprising: receiving a question in a natural language format; deriving a plurality of sub-queries from the problem; determining that a first sub-query of the plurality of sub-queries cannot be resolved using the curated knowledge base; parsing the first sub-query with unstructured text; and adjusting the curated knowledge base using the parsed first sub-query.

title_en: Gymnasium robot system assisting in exercise recovery and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a gymnasium robot system for assisting exercise recovery, which comprises: the system comprises a recovery scheme setting unit, a foreground terminal, a robot scheduling unit, a health-care worker terminal, a historical database, a physical therapy table and intelligent fitness equipment. The recovery scheme setting unit is used for automatically generating a recovery scheme; the foreground terminal is used for associating the member ID with the RFID card; the robot scheduling unit is used for scheduling the intelligent robot; the health care worker terminal is used for confirming and adjusting the recovery scheme; and the historical database is used for storing the historical data of the user. The invention combines the recovery scheme setting unit, the foreground terminal, the robot scheduling unit, the health-care personnel terminal, the historical database, the physical therapy table and the intelligent fitness equipment into a gymnasium robot system for assisting exercise recovery, can collect training data of a user, generates a recovery scheme according to the training data, and recovers the body of the user after body building according to the recovery scheme.

title_en: Optimal carbon reduction operation method for high-proportion clean energy power grid power supply
abstract_en: The invention provides an optimal carbon reduction operation method for a high-proportion clean energy power grid power supply. Introducing different types of power output and loads of each unit at each moment in the whole year, and constructing a power grid power supply and load balance model, an online electricity price and income model, a power generation cost model, an economic benefit model and a carbon emission target model; and constructing a power supply optimal carbon reduction operation strategy comprehensive target model according to the economic benefit model and the carbon emission target model, and constructing a system constraint condition model. And taking the power supply optimal carbon reduction operation strategy comprehensive target model as an optimization target, taking the system constraint condition model as a constraint condition, and carrying out optimization solution on the target model through an NSGA-II algorithm to obtain the optimal output strategy of each type of power supply at each moment all the year after optimization. The invention divides the whole year into a plurality of time intervals under the condition of meeting the constraint conditions of a system and various power supplies in a high-occupancy clean energy power grid, and respectively optimizes and selects the configuration capacity of each power supply, so that the carbon emission of the power grid is minimum and the economic benefit is maximized.

title_en: Non-invasive-based equipment health management algorithm library construction method
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-invasive-based equipment health management algorithm library construction method, which comprises the following steps: constructing a micro service platform of a Python WEB architecture; building a container platform, deploying a plurality of independent docker containers in the container platform, and deploying the operating environment of an algorithm model in the docker containers; building an algorithm library, wherein the algorithm library is used for storing an algorithm model; establishing a template engine, instantiating an algorithm model and verifying the validity of the algorithm model by the template engine, and storing the algorithm model in an algorithm library; and establishing an operation engine, independently operating the algorithm model in an operation environment by the operation engine, and calling the algorithm model at any time. The invention adopts a database management mode to store the algorithm model in the algorithm library, dynamically fuses the algorithm model into the operating environment through the template engine and the operating engine, does not need to change any bottom codes, achieves the real non-invasive algorithm library construction, and solves the problem that different algorithm models are fused into the equipment health management service platform.

title_en: Method, device and equipment for determining test failure reasons
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a device and equipment for determining a test failure reason, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining at least one test failure case, determining transaction codes and error codes of the test failure cases, combining and classifying the transaction codes and the error codes to obtain error code types, selecting to-be-processed combinations from the combinations, wherein the to-be-processed combinations comprise target error codes and target transaction codes, and determining the test failure reason according to the target transaction codes combined with a predetermined data desensitization rule base when the error code types of the target error codes are of a preset type. The method solves the problem that the test failure cause cannot be accurately positioned when the test fails, combines and classifies the test failure cases through the transaction code and the error code, determines the current combination to be processed for failure cause analysis, determines the test failure cause according to the target transaction code and the data desensitization rule base, and accurately judges whether the test failure cases are related to data desensitization.

title_en: Image-text pre-training model training and image-text prediction model training method and device
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a device for training an image-text pre-training model and an image-text prediction model, computer equipment, a storage medium and a computer program product. The method comprises the following steps: and carrying out feature masking on the original features of the training image and the original features of the training text to obtain target features of the training image and target features of the training text, inputting the target features of the training image and the target features of the training text into an initial image-text pre-training model to evaluate the image-text matching degree to obtain the initial image-text matching degree, carrying out cross-modal information interaction by using the initial image-text matching degree, the target features of the training image and the target features of the training text to obtain interaction features of the initial image and interaction features of the initial text, and carrying out iterative training to obtain a target image-text pre-training model. By adopting the method, the training accuracy can be improved. The embodiment of the application can be applied to various scenes such as cloud technology, artificial intelligence, intelligent traffic, auxiliary driving and the like.

title_en: Vocoder training method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a vocoder training method, device, equipment and storage medium, relates to the technical field of computers, and in particular relates to the artificial intelligence field of speech synthesis, deep learning and the like. The method for training the vocoder comprises the steps of obtaining existing data, wherein the existing data comprise existing audio, performing data enhancement processing on the existing audio to obtain expanded audio, and training the vocoder based on the existing audio and the expanded audio. The present disclosure may improve the effectiveness of the vocoder.

title_en: Training sample label distribution method and system for neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a training sample label distribution method and system of a neural network, wherein the distribution method comprises the following steps of S1, inputting a picture to be trained into an anchor-free neural network after pretreatment, S2, outputting a characteristic diagram after the picture to be trained transmitted by the anchor-free neural network is processed by the anchor-free neural network, S3, obtaining anchors of all points on the characteristic diagram according to a target frame, S4, calculating IOU values between the anchors and the target frame obtained in the step S3, and then determining positive sample points, negative sample points and/or neglect sample points according to the IOU values. The invention solves the problems of the prior art that the distribution mode of positive and negative samples of the target with larger length-width ratio has obviously poor effect, poor detection effect and the like.

title_en: Computer mainframe convenient for installing main board for computer hardware development
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computers and discloses a computer mainframe box convenient for installing a mainboard for developing computer hardware, which comprises a fixed base, wherein a mainframe box shell is installed at the upper end of the fixed base, a limiting plate is installed on the rear wall of the mainframe box shell in an oblique symmetrical mode, a limiting column is arranged on the limiting plate in a sliding mode, a clamping plate is installed at one end of the limiting column, a clamping shell is installed at the other end of the limiting column, a plurality of clamping teeth are arranged on the clamping plate, an abutting ring is sleeved outside the limiting column between the limiting plate and the clamping plate, a limiting spring is sleeved on the limiting column between the abutting ring and the clamping plate, a fixed plate is fixedly installed on the side wall of the mainframe box shell, and a plurality of fixing racks meshed with the clamping teeth are arranged on the fixed plate. According to the invention, through the mutual matching of the limiting plates and the limiting columns, the up-and-down movement of the clamping shell positions is realized, and under the matching of the adjusting grooves and the fixed racks, the position keeping between the clamping shells is realized, and finally the quick installation of the chassis main board is satisfied.

title_en: Equipment upgrading method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for upgrading equipment, and can acquire a target local area network of the surrounding environment where the equipment is located when the equipment is in an upgrading mode; establishing communication connection with a server corresponding to the target local area network through the target local area network; sending a configuration file acquisition request to a target address corresponding to the server through the communication connection, and receiving a configuration file returned by the server based on the configuration file acquisition request; and upgrading the equipment according to the configuration file. The problem of equipment upgrading inefficiency is solved, equipment upgrading efficiency has been improved.

title_en: Transformer substation equipment defect/hidden danger management and control system combining maintenance plan
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transformer substation equipment defect/hidden danger control system combined with a maintenance plan, which is characterized in that newly-added defect/hidden danger information of transformer substation equipment is acquired through a defect/hidden danger database and is sent to a defect control module; the defect management and control module sends the defect/hidden danger information and preset optional responsibility departments to a division interaction interface for display, so that a dispatcher selects the responsibility departments according to the defect/hidden danger information and sends the defect/hidden danger information to a maintenance planning module of a division unit selected by the dispatcher; and the maintenance plan module associates and matches the defect/hidden danger information with each maintenance plan to be implemented, which is made by the defect/hidden danger information, integrates the defect/hidden danger information into the maintenance plan with the highest association degree, sends the integrated maintenance plan to maintenance personnel, and reminds the maintenance personnel to process the newly-added defects/hidden dangers together during maintenance, so that the treatment efficiency of defect management and control is improved.

title_en: Optical fingerprint identification and anti-counterfeiting method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical fingerprint identification and anti-counterfeiting method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: providing a detection light spot, wherein the detection light spot irradiates the surface of an identification object and comprises an identification area and an anti-counterfeiting area presenting a preset pattern; wherein the anti-counterfeiting area generates first detection light, and the identification area generates second detection light; providing a photosensitive imaging unit, wherein the photosensitive imaging unit receives the detection light reflected by the identification object and forms a fingerprint sensing image; separating fingerprint identification information corresponding to the identification area detection light and fingerprint anti-counterfeiting information corresponding to the anti-counterfeiting area detection light in the fingerprint sensing image; and extracting characteristic parameters in the fingerprint anti-counterfeiting information to judge that the identification object is a two-dimensional finger or a three-dimensional finger. The invention can ensure the safety of the fingerprint identification equipment and further improve the efficiency of fingerprint identification and anti-counterfeiting detection.

title_en: Method and device for realizing DDOS user matching based on Trie tree
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for realizing DDOS user matching based on a Trie, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the management system manually inputs user information and IP address information corresponding to the user through a web interface; the management system synchronously transmits the information to the downstream detection equipment, the detection system converts the IP address into binary data after receiving the information, generates IP nodes through a Trie tree algorithm, and simultaneously generates a binary Trie tree corresponding to the id information; the router sends a Netflow message to the DDOS detection system, decodes the data message and acquires the destination IP address information; the DDOS detection system matches according to the generated Trie tree, and after matching to the address, the user information of the current message IP attribution CIDR network segment is obtained; and the detection system sends the user information acquired by the Trie data algorithm to downstream matching, and discards the message data which are not matched. The method and the device carry out user IP matching on the messages with large data volume based on the Trie tree technology, realize high-performance user data matching and improve data processing performance.

title_en: Phase-adjustable arbitrary waveform generator
abstract_en: The invention provides a phase-adjustable arbitrary waveform generator, which comprises a controller unit, a storage unit, a clock control unit, a direct digital frequency synthesizer and a comparator, wherein the controller unit is used for controlling the phase-adjustable arbitrary waveform generator; the storage unit is used for storing and reading data and outputting waveforms; the clock control unit is used for controlling a reading or writing clock of the storage unit; the clock control unit comprises three clock inputs: a read clock, a write clock, and an external read clock; wherein the external read clock is generated by the direct digital frequency synthesizer after passing through the comparator; the clock control unit selects a read clock or the external read clock through a clock input selection signal; the direct digital frequency synthesizer is configured by a controller unit. The invention adopts the complete asynchronism of the read-write clock, and can change the frequency of the output waveform by changing the speed of the read-write memory.

title_en: Liquid crystal writing board, control method thereof and writing system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a liquid crystal writing board, a control method thereof and a writing system. According to the liquid crystal writing board provided by the embodiment of the application, the adjusting material is arranged on the liquid crystal layer, so that the pitch of bistable liquid crystal can be changed by the adjusting material under the first excitation condition, so that the wavelength range of visible light reflected by the bistable liquid crystal in a plane texture state can be changed, the color of the handwriting displayed by the liquid crystal writing board can be changed, the liquid crystal writing board can display the handwriting with different colors, the diversified use requirements of users can be met, and the use experience of the users is ensured.

title_en: Intelligent and multifunctional variable fire-fighting checking system, method and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent and multifunctional variable fire-fighting checking system, a method and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of fire fighting and comprise a telecommunication operator base station, a server, a management system host, a handheld scanning warehouse-in/warehouse-out machine, a label, a gateway host, a gateway slave machine, a radio frequency cable and an antenna, wherein the output end of the server is bidirectionally connected with the input end of the management system host through a wire, and the handheld scanning warehouse-in/warehouse-out machine is bidirectionally connected with the management system host through a wireless network. The intelligent and multifunctional variable fire-fighting checking system, the method and the storage medium adopt a convenient and efficient technology to simplify the fussy manual checking work into advanced and rapid automatic work. The problems of low personnel checking speed, time and labor waste and omission are solved; a set of rapid, time-saving, labor-saving and accurate inventory operation process is formed, the inventory efficiency of the emergency rescue tool is improved, and the use efficiency of emergency rescue resources is improved.

title_en: Lane departure degree detection method and readable storage medium
abstract_en: A method for detecting a degree of lane departure, a readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises: acquiring a road surface image in front of a vehicle; inputting the road surface image in front of the vehicle into a pre-trained lane line detection model to obtain a lane line image; detecting a lane line straight line from the lane line image; the method comprises the steps of finding out the distance from the intersection point of each lane line straight line and the lower boundary of a lane line image to the central axis of the lane line image, taking the first lane line with the smallest distance as the current lane, judging whether the second lane line of the current lane can be obtained according to whether the lane line straight line with the horizontal included angle opposite in sign to the horizontal included angle of the first lane line exists, distinguishing the situation that two lane lines can be obtained and only one lane line can be obtained, calculating the lane departure degree in different manners, adapting to the calculation of the lane departure degree when only one lane line is obtained, widening the applicable scene and improving the accuracy of the calculation of the lane departure degree.

title_en: Nucleic acid molecular structure screening method and device, and computer equipment
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a nucleic acid molecular structure screening method and device, and computer equipment. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining nucleic acid molecule parameters, the nucleic acid molecule parameters comprising: nucleic acid molecule sequences, the length of the nucleic acid molecule sequences, chemical modification of the nucleic acid molecules, and the configuration of a plurality of nucleic acid molecules to be screened, corresponding energy and experimental data obtained by computational simulation based on quantum mechanics and molecular dynamics; searching a nucleic acid library for a similar nucleic acid molecule structure for each of the plurality of nucleic acid molecule configurations to be screened; based on the stability of the similar nucleic acid molecule structure, the energy corresponding to the configuration of the plurality of nucleic acid molecules to be screened and experimental data, calculating the probability distribution of the configuration of the plurality of nucleic acid molecules to be screened; and screening at least one nucleic acid molecule configuration with qualified stability in the plurality of nucleic acid molecule configurations to be screened according to the probability distribution of the plurality of nucleic acid molecule configurations to be screened.

title_en: Terminal and partition mounting method
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a terminal and a partition mounting method. The method comprises the following steps: displaying a plurality of data partitions when the system is mounted in the starting process, wherein the data partitions are partitions for storing application data; responding to a selection instruction of a user, determining a data partition selected by the user, and mounting the selected data partition to a specified directory according to the mounting parameter of the selected data partition; and after the mounting is finished, executing a loading process and creating service in the starting process. According to the method and the device, the plurality of data partitions are displayed during system mounting in the terminal starting process, so that a user can select the data partitions for use, and after the user selects the data partitions, the data partitions selected by the user are mounted in the appointed directory. Therefore, the user can store the user data on different data partitions by selecting different data partitions, so that the isolation of the user data is realized, and the safety of the user privacy is improved.

title_en: Automatic assembly line material detection system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a system and a method for detecting materials of an automatic assembly line, wherein the system comprises a workbench, a bracket, a multidirectional adjusting mechanism, an image acquisition device, a light source and an industrial personal computer, the bracket is arranged on the workbench, one end of the multidirectional adjusting mechanism is fixed on the bracket, the image acquisition device and the light source are fixed at the other end of the multidirectional adjusting mechanism, and the industrial personal computer is electrically connected with the image acquisition device. The automatic assembly line feeding device can conveniently and effectively detect whether the feeding position of the automatic assembly line is successfully fed or not, so that the product qualification rate is guaranteed, and the automatic assembly line feeding device is high in efficiency and low in labor cost.

title_en: Abnormality determination method, abnormality determination device, electronic device, and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides an anomaly determination method, which can be applied to the technical field of computers. The anomaly determination method comprises the steps of receiving a scanning request, wherein the scanning request comprises at least one item to be scanned, determining target information to be scanned respectively associated with each item to be scanned according to each item to be scanned in the at least one item to be scanned to obtain at least one target information to be scanned, and obtaining scanning result information according to each target information to be scanned in the at least one target information to be scanned. The present disclosure also provides an abnormality determination apparatus, an electronic device, a storage medium, and a program product.

title_en: Association rule mining method for dam deformation monitoring data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an association rule mining method applicable to dam deformation monitoring data, and relates to the field of dam safety monitoring. It includes: s1, inputting dam crack monitoring data and preprocessing the dam crack monitoring data; s2, performing attribute conversion on the preprocessed data; s3, constructing front and back parts of the single-measuring-point time sequence association rule and/or front and back parts of the multi-measuring-point space association rule, setting an association index threshold value and screening strong association rules by adopting an FP-Growth algorithm; s4, judging whether the strong association rule screened out in the step S3 accords with the actual engineering, if so, entering the step S5, otherwise, returning to the step S3; and S5, outputting the strong association rule set. The invention respectively carries out association rule mining on dam deformation monitoring data from two angles of single-measuring-point time sequence association and multi-measuring-point space association, extracts an objective rule which effectively reflects dam operation characters from massive monitoring data, and further provides a brand new thought for realizing the collaborative diagnosis of dam space-time monitoring information fusing multi-dimensional and multi-measuring-point.

title_en: Vortex street moisture split-phase flow measuring method based on liquid film flow parameter modeling
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for measuring the moisture split-phase flow of a vortex street based on liquid film flow parameter modeling, which utilizes signals acquired by a vortex street piezoelectric sensor and a liquid film flow parameter sensor, establishes an overreading prediction model by combining the non-dimensionalized liquid film thickness and the disturbance wave speed, predicts the split-phase flow according to an overreading coefficient OR and realizes the moisture split-phase flow measurement, and comprises the following steps: collecting two-phase pressure, two-phase temperature, time sequence signals output by a vortex street piezoelectric sensor and upstream and downstream liquid film thickness sequences output by a liquid film flow parameter sensor; calculating the density of the gas and the density of the liquid; obtaining vortex shedding frequency; obtaining the average liquid film thickness; performing cross-correlation calculation to obtain a transit time; obtaining the thickness of a dimensionless liquid film and the dimensionless disturbance wave speed; calculating the indicating value result of the gas phase volume flow; calculating a vortex street over-reading coefficient OR; calculating the real gas flow; the liquid phase flow rate was calculated.

title_en: Two-step system optimization method and device suitable for clearing and checking of provincial standby market
abstract_en: The invention provides a two-step system optimization method and a two-step system optimization device suitable for clearing and checking of a provincial reserve market.

title_en: Interactive English word memory device and use method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of teaching equipment, and discloses an interactive English word memory device and a using method thereof, wherein the interactive English word memory device comprises a placing support, an adjusting driving piece and an interactive scene adjusting component, wherein the top of the adjusting driving piece is provided with the interactive scene adjusting component for switching reserved words in a scene, and the outer side of the interactive scene adjusting component is sleeved with a protective shell; the adjusting chuck is pushed to ascend and descend under the control of the command control module, a connecting clamping ring which is needed and suitable for the study in the day is selected, the information receiving and transmitting module receives signal transmission in the ascending and descending state when the adjusting chuck ascends and descends, and sends scene images stored in the scene information storage module to the interactive scene display screen for projection through the information receiving and transmitting module synchronously, so that a learner can take in the words through the sound reading module and judge the pronunciation through the voice judging module according to corresponding prompts of image scene rendering during projection of the interactive scene display screen, and the understanding and memory of the meaning of the words and the vocabularies are realized in an auxiliary mode.

title_en: Industrial control network intrusion detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an industrial control network intrusion detection method and system, and belongs to the technical field of industrial network security. According to the industrial control network intrusion detection method provided by the invention, the trained LSTM-ARFIMA mixed cycle network model is used as the industrial control network intrusion detection model, so that the obtained industrial flow data is subjected to intrusion detection, and the detection result can be accurately obtained. In addition, the adoption of the LSTM-ARFIMA mixed cycle network model can overcome the overfitting problem of the neural network while reducing the volatility problem to the maximum extent.

title_en: Grading method and device for laser radar system
abstract_en: The application provides a grading method and a grading device of a laser radar system, wherein the grading method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target data set; eliminating invalid data in the target data set to obtain a data set after target screening; performing capture matrix statistics on the data set after the target screening to obtain a statistical result corresponding to the data set after the target screening; determining whether the number of statistical values contained in the data set after the target screening meets the requirement of a preset number or not according to the statistical result corresponding to the data set after the target screening; if so, determining whether the target laser radar system is mature according to a statistical result corresponding to the data set after the target screening; and if the target laser radar system is mature, calculating the uncertainty precision level of the target laser radar system according to the data set after target screening. Therefore, the uncertainty precision level of the target laser radar system can be calculated.

title_en: Applet cross-terminal application method, related device and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an applet cross-end application method, a related device and a computer storage medium, wherein the method can comprise the steps of acquiring a plurality of pages contained in a target applet; the method comprises the steps of determining page node information, node display information and logic management information of each page, converting codes corresponding to the page node information, the node display information and the logic management information of each page into identifiable codes, generating page node information, node display information and logic management information corresponding to a second application program based on the identifiable codes, and generating pages corresponding to a plurality of pages contained in a target applet in the second application program based on the page node information, the node display information and the logic management information of the second application program. The embodiment of the application can realize one code with multiple ends, namely, different platforms can realize the related functions of the target applet by using one set of codes.

title_en: Method and device for analyzing charging load of electric vehicle in power distribution area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for analyzing charging load of an electric automobile in a power distribution station area, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting charging data of charging piles in a power distribution station area; processing the charging data to obtain the charging state distribution of the electric automobile; acquiring basic load data of a power distribution station area, and determining the electricity price of each time period in one day according to the basic load data; according to the electric vehicle charging state distribution and the electricity price of each time period, establishing a charging and discharging model with the minimum user charging cost and the minimum load variance of a power distribution station area; optimizing the charging and discharging model based on a particle swarm algorithm to obtain an optimal charging scheme of the electric automobile; the method can balance the load of the power distribution area and the charging load of the electric automobile on the basis of fully considering the charging desire of the user, saves the charging cost of the user, and is high in accuracy of an analysis result, more reasonable and strong in feasibility.

title_en: Multi-camera high-speed synchronous shooting system and shooting method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-camera high-speed synchronous shooting system and a shooting method, wherein the system comprises a hardware synchronizer main board, a hardware synchronizer slave board, a camera, a data acquisition computer and a power supply part; the hardware synchronizer master board is used for sending a hardware control trigger signal, and outputting the hardware control trigger signal to the hardware synchronizer slave board after passing through the amplifying circuit; the hardware synchronizer slave board is used for receiving a signal of the hardware synchronizer master board and transmitting a control signal to the camera so as to trigger the camera to shoot; and the camera is used for receiving the signals of the slave plate of the hardware synchronizer, taking pictures according to the frequency of the control trigger signal and transmitting the pictures to the data acquisition computer. The invention can realize the synchronous shooting of the cameras under the conditions of multiple cameras, multiple viewpoints and high speed, so that the shot data can obtain a multi-viewpoint video sequence with high synchronism and reliability without post adjustment.

title_en: Mask face recognition algorithm based on low-rank attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mask face recognition technology based on a low-rank attention mechanism. Firstly, introducing low-rank operation in an attention mechanism, wherein the low-rank attention mechanism can be used for sensing mask information and human faces; then, the mask technology is combined to reduce the weight of part of the mask, and the interference of the mask on the face recognition task is reduced. The model is used for extracting the human face features and then comparing the human faces, so that the high accuracy of normal human face recognition is kept, and the accuracy of mask human face recognition is improved.

title_en: Man-machine interaction method, device, storage medium, program product and robot
abstract_en: The application relates to a human-computer interaction method, a human-computer interaction device, a robot, a storage medium and a computer program product, wherein the method comprises the following steps: positioning a desktop area; projecting a preset article selection interface to the desktop area; identifying the click position of the user in the desktop area based on a plane fitting technology; and performing position conversion on the click position to determine the selected article. In the whole process, a preset article selection interface is displayed to a user in a projection mode so as to be selected by the user, the selected article is determined based on a plane fitting technology, fixed human-computer interaction equipment is not required, the method can be flexibly applied to different application scenes, and convenience is brought to the user.

title_en: Seawater intrusion prediction method based on Bayesian multi-model set pair analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seawater intrusion prediction method based on Bayesian multi-model set pair analysis, which comprises the following steps of: selecting model parameters, setting and optimizing parameter value ranges, and constructing seawater intrusion numerical models of different schemes; updating model weights of different schemes by combining chloride ion concentration observation data and prediction data and utilizing a Bayesian multi-model set pair analysis technology; and carrying out weighted average on the prediction result of the seawater intrusion model to obtain the integrated space-time distribution of the chloride ion concentration. The invention organically combines the Bayes theorem with the set pair analysis method, improves the weight calculation based on the similarity of a plurality of sets of set pairs, and proves the feasibility of the Bayes multi-model set pair analysis method in predicting the migration of underground water pollutants.

title_en: DevOps-based quality analysis method, system, device and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a quality analysis method, a system, equipment and a medium based on DevOps, in particular to the field of software development and test, the method scans static codes of source codes related to a software program by acquiring the software program to be tested to generate static analysis data; configuring the pipeline according to the static analysis data until the source codes related to the pipeline are packed and deployed to the corresponding test environment; calling each measurement testing tool to carry out automatic testing on the source code, and determining first measurement data of the software program testing, wherein the first measurement data comprises unit testing result data and performance testing result data; ETL processing is carried out on various heterogeneous first measurement data and static analysis data, and second measurement data after data processing are determined; quality measurement reports of different formats are generated and issued by analyzing the measurement indexes, the dimension types and the measurement requirements of the second measurement data, so that the accuracy, the generation efficiency and the universality of the quality measurement reports are improved.

title_en: Virtual resource transfer method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: Responding to a control instruction aiming at the virtual object, controlling the virtual object to acquire virtual resources in the game scene in the office, and storing the virtual resources into an in-office storage system; the method comprises the steps of responding to a target prop opening instruction, displaying virtual resource items corresponding to virtual resources in the local storage system, responding to selection operation aiming at the virtual resource items, selecting at least one target virtual resource from the virtual resource items, and controlling the target virtual resource to be transferred from the local storage system to the external storage system before the current local task is ended. The application saves the resources of the in-office storage system, improves the processing efficiency of the computer and improves the current game smoothness.

title_en: Data access device, method, readable medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The data access device comprises a Fuse module, a plurality of first socket interfaces and a memory, wherein the Fuse module is communicated with the memory through the first socket interfaces, the Fuse module and the first socket interfaces are located in a kernel space, the Fuse module is used for receiving a data access request, determining a target socket interface corresponding to the data access request from the first socket interfaces, and the Fuse module is further used for acquiring target data from the memory by using the target socket interface and sending the target data to a target application program. According to the method and the device, the target data can be acquired from the memory by the Fuse module through the target socket interface according to the data access request, the data access request can be directly sent to the memory in the kernel space without transferring in the user space, and the access performance of the target data is improved.

title_en: Memory-resistor-based integrated calculation unit, array circuit and control method
abstract_en: The invention provides a computing unit, an array circuit and a control method based on memory and calculation of a memristor, wherein the drain electrode of a first MOS tube of the computing unit is connected with a first voltage input signal, and the source electrode of a second MOS tube of the computing unit is connected with a second voltage input signal; the grid electrode of the first MOS tube and the grid electrode of the second MOS tube are connected with a control voltage signal together; the source electrode of the first MOS tube is connected with one end of the first memristor, and the drain electrode of the second MOS tube is connected with one end of the second memristor; the other end of the first memristor and the other end of the second memristor are connected with a grid electrode of the fourth MOS transistor; the drain electrode of the fourth MOS tube is connected with the source electrode of the third MOS tube, the source electrode of the fourth MOS tube is connected with the drain electrode of the fifth MOS tube, the source electrode of the fifth MOS tube is grounded, and the drain electrode of the third MOS tube is used as a current output end, so that the accuracy of circuit output current can be improved, and the pruning function of a neural network is realized on hardware.

title_en: Flexible product manufacturing method and device based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for flexibly manufacturing a product based on a block chain, wherein the method comprises the steps that a user uploads a manufacturing task to an edge server, the edge server decomposes the task and sends a message to inquire the state of equipment in a production workshop; the edge server root evaluates the state of the equipment, calls an intelligent contract to execute a task, and simultaneously changes the number of the subtasks; the edge server distributes the tasks by using a scheduling module, and the equipment completes the tasks according to the sequence; and after the equipment completes the task, the information is sent to the edge server, and the edge server judges and verifies the information after receiving the information. Compared with the prior art, the flexible manufacturing method and device for the product based on the block chain, provided by the invention, have the advantages that the task allocation efficiency is improved, the smoothness of the execution sequence is improved, and the whole production process can be traced.

title_en: Off-duty early warning method, off-duty early warning device, computer equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The application relates to an off-duty early warning method, an off-duty early warning device, computer equipment, a storage medium and a program product. The method comprises the following steps: monitoring the duty state of a target duty personnel according to the image in the duty place range acquired by the camera equipment; if the duty state of the target duty personnel is monitored to be off duty state, acquiring off duty time of the target duty personnel from the moment of monitoring the off duty of the target duty personnel; if the off-duty time is longer than the preset time, outputting first alarm information to a target duty personnel; the first alarm information is used to indicate that the target duty personnel has timed out off duty. By adopting the method, the off-duty behavior of the duty personnel can be effectively early-warned.

title_en: License plate detection method with any inclination angle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the license plate detection technology, and relates to a license plate detection method with any inclination angle, wherein features of a collected data set are extracted through a backbone network and then sent into a feature pyramid for extracting the features, the extracted features are sent into a multi-scale cavity convolution to generate a license plate classification probability and a distance field, a license plate initial region is determined through the combination of the license plate classification probability and the distance field, then four vertexes of a circumscribed rectangle of the license plate initial region are selected as control points for license plate correction, feature information at the control points is sent into a graph convolution neural network for correction, and the corrected license plate vertex coordinates are used for correcting the license plate to obtain a rectangular license plate beneficial to subsequent recognition; the method utilizes the graph convolution neural network to correct the license plate so as to solve the problems of detection and correction of the inclined license plate, can be used for detecting the license plate at the side position and can also be used for recognizing the license plate of images collected by high-position and low-position cameras.

title_en: Display device including touch sensor and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention may provide a display device including a touch sensor and a method of manufacturing the same, the display device including: a first touch signal line and a second touch signal line disposed on the first insulating layer; a second insulating layer disposed on the first and second touch signal lines; first and second communicating portions connected to the first and second touch signal lines through first and second contact holes included in the second insulating layer, respectively; and a common electrode disposed on the second insulating layer, wherein the first communicating portion is connected to the common electrode, and the second communicating portion is not connected to the common electrode.

title_en: Expansion method based on semi-structured natural language EARS demand template
abstract_en: The invention provides an expansion method based on a semi-structured natural language EARS demand template, which comprises the steps of expanding a semi-structured natural language EARS and naming the semi-structured natural language EARS as EARS _NFR to obtain a semi-structured natural language EARS _NFR demand template, constructing a framework of the semi-structured natural language EARS _NFR demand template, and checking and modifying natural language demands input into the framework to enable the natural language demands to meet the semi-structured natural language EARS _NFR demand template. The invention can process more different types of demands, in particular non-functional demands, and has strong universality and wide application range.

title_en: Hierarchical flow measurement method based on complementary coding
abstract_en: The invention relates to fluid flow measurement and speed measurement, which aims to apply a complementary coding principle with good correlation in the communication field to the design of ADCP emission waveforms and improve waveform resolution and flow measurement performance. Therefore, the technical scheme adopted by the invention is that a layered model of marine environment is established based on a layered flow measurement method of complementary coding, a transmitted signal meeting index conditions is designed based on a pseudorandom sequence, a waveform is designed based on a complementary coding principle, and hydrological measurement is carried out by utilizing the designed transmitted signal based on the complementary coding. The invention is mainly applied to hydrological measurement occasions.

title_en: Evapotranspiration estimation method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for estimating evapotranspiration and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring remote sensing data and meteorological reanalysis data in a target area, wherein the meteorological reanalysis data is used for representing climatic parameters of the target area; matching the time scale and the space scale of the remote sensing data and the meteorological reanalysis data; respectively calculating a decoupling coefficient and a potential evapotranspiration value based on the matched remote sensing data and meteorological reanalysis data, wherein the decoupling coefficient is used for representing the relation between the potential evapotranspiration value and an actual evapotranspiration value; and calculating an actual evapotranspiration value based on the decoupling coefficient and the potential evapotranspiration value. The technical scheme provided by the invention realizes the estimation of the evapotranspiration of the target area in a shorter time scale.

title_en: Problem data processing method and system for distribution network engineering management
abstract_en: The invention provides a problem data processing method and system for distribution network engineering management, which specifically comprise the following steps: determining a problem information transmission path corresponding to the first power monitoring information in the digital twin distribution network model, and taking each node in the problem information transmission path as a target screening node; acquiring all other distribution network equipment connected with the target screening node in the problem information transmission path to generate a twin node topological graph, taking all other distribution network equipment as auxiliary screening nodes, classifying the auxiliary screening nodes corresponding to the target screening nodes according to the twin node topological graph, and acquiring a verification screening set corresponding to each target screening node; sequentially traversing each target screening node in the node screening sequence, and screening according to a verification screening set corresponding to each target screening node to obtain the problem data; and processing the problem data based on an information cascade strategy and a preset twin strategy database to obtain corresponding processing data.

title_en: Digital twin emergency plan simulation system and method based on Feiteng CPU
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin emergency plan simulation system and method based on a Feiteng CPU, which belong to the field of emergency plans and comprise the Feiteng CPU, an i3D three-dimensional interactive application engine based on the Feiteng CPU and a simulation operation unit based on the i3D three-dimensional interactive application engine, wherein the simulation operation unit operates based on the Feiteng CPU architecture and adopts the i3D three-dimensional interactive application engine on a Feiteng CPU hardware server. The system can synchronize accident information, scheduling information, emergency measures and the like in accident emergency into the twin system, and can synchronously maintain the operation of the emergency simulation system and simultaneously utilize the twin system to carry out complete reproduction and simulation of the accident.

title_en: Image object segmentation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a device for segmenting an image target, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The image target segmentation method comprises the following steps: performing image target segmentation processing on the medical image to obtain a first segmentation result; extracting a target image containing the image target from the medical image according to the first segmentation result; carrying out registration processing on the target image and a preset standard image to obtain a registration result; the preset standard image is an image containing a standard image target; and performing image target segmentation processing on the target image according to the registration result to obtain an image target segmentation result. Therefore, the accuracy of the image target segmentation result is effectively improved, and a more reliable basis is provided for clinical diagnosis and pathological research.

title_en: Industrial computer circuit board positioning mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses an industrial personal computer circuit board positioning mechanism which comprises an industrial personal computer shell and a circuit board body, wherein the circuit board body is arranged in the industrial personal computer shell; the inner wall of the rear side of the industrial personal computer shell is fixedly connected with a first transverse guide rod and a second transverse guide rod, moving blocks are respectively connected to the first transverse guide rod and the second transverse guide rod in a sliding mode, the circuit board body comprises two groups of circuit boards, the circuit boards correspond to the moving blocks one by one and are connected with the moving blocks, and a driving mechanism for driving the two groups of moving blocks to move is arranged in the industrial personal computer shell; the left side and the right side of the industrial personal computer shell are respectively provided with an opening, the outer side of the opening is fixedly connected with a cover plate, the industrial personal computer shell is laterally connected with a dust guard in front of the cover plate, the circuit board positioning is realized, the circuit board is simple and convenient to install on the relatively fixed industrial personal computer shell, and the circuit board can be moved through the driving mechanism, so that the later-stage maintenance is facilitated.

title_en: Magnetic disk health check method, device, electronic equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure discloses a disk health check method, a disk health check device, electronic equipment, a medium and a product, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining an associated link between each logical disk and a physical disk in a storage system; acquiring a mapping relation between nodes in an associated link corresponding to a logical disk; and carrying out health check on each node in the associated link, and outputting the position information of the target logical disk and the position information of the target physical disk corresponding to the target node based on the mapping relation among the nodes when the health check result of the target node is abnormal. According to the technical scheme, the disk can be inspected more comprehensively, the output result can indicate the service party to perform fault isolation on the service on the target logical disk and indicate operation and maintenance personnel to maintain and replace the target physical disk, effective linkage of service processing and disk maintenance is realized, and rapid processing of disk faults is realized.

title_en: Infrared touch point positioning scheme
abstract_en: The invention discloses an infrared touch point positioning scheme, which comprises the following steps: setting the number k of scanning directions and specific angles of each direction, setting a threshold t1 of the number of unilateral blocked light paths, a threshold t2 of different directions and a threshold t3 of included angles of the light paths in different directions, executing scanning of a frame, counting the blocked light paths, jumping to the step S4 if X and Y sides are simultaneously blocked at present, or else, only X or Y sides are blocked at present, and the beneficial effects achieved by the invention comprise: the invention provides a scheme idea of performing point positioning only according to an X or Y unilateral light path, provides an idea of judging whether to perform point positioning operation or not according to conditions such as the number of unilateral shielded light paths, included angles between light paths with different slopes and the like, and ensures the accuracy of the outline and the point position of a final output point, thereby reducing the line breaking probability of fine-pen writing, being beneficial to reducing the cost (supporting the reduction of the number of lamp tubes) of a touch scheme and achieving the purpose of improving the writing experience.

title_en: Knowledge-enhanced attention-force-diagram-based neural network next item recommendation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a knowledge-based next recommendation method for enhancing an attention-seeking neural network, which comprises the following steps of: representing each conversation in a conversation data set as a project sequence in the conversation, a target behavior sequence of the conversation and an auxiliary behavior sequence of the conversation, and dividing the conversation data set into a training set, a testing set and a verification set; constructing an initial model of a next recommendation method NR-KAGNN based on the knowledge enhanced attention graph neural network by using the training set; carrying out parameter adjustment on the initial model of the NR-KAGNN by utilizing the training set and the verification set to obtain an optimization model of the NR-KAGNN, and evaluating the recommendation accuracy of the optimization model by utilizing the test set; and providing the next item of recommendation for the user in the conversation data set or the actual conversation data by using the obtained NR-KAGNN optimization model. The next recommendation method provided by the invention has the characteristic of high recommendation accuracy and has wide application prospects in a plurality of fields such as music, movies, online news, electronic commerce and the like.

title_en: Industrial control network flow real-time intrusion detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time intrusion detection method for industrial control network flow, which relates to an internet security detection method, and provides an intrusion detection method aiming at the periodic characteristics of the real-time flow of an industrial internet, wherein the intrusion detection method carries out sliding window grouping on the acquired normal flow to construct normal flow characteristics, and normal flow sentinels are arranged; then, carrying out sliding window grouping on the collected attack flow to construct attack flow characteristics, and setting an abnormal flow sentinel; and then, quickly screening an absolute normal flow group and an absolute abnormal flow group in the real-time flow through the two sentinels, separating the normal flow from the abnormal flow through mean value clustering under the condition of doping the normal flow and the abnormal flow in the group, marking the abnormal flow and feeding back to a visualization platform so as to achieve the purposes of situation awareness and intrusion detection. The method has higher detection success rate, accelerates the intrusion detection speed through three aspects, and further meets the requirement of real-time performance of an industrial control system.

title_en: Risk rating method and device for noble metal leasing transaction
abstract_en: The application provides a risk rating method and device for a precious metal leasing transaction, which can be used in the financial field or other fields, and comprises the steps of receiving a risk rating request of a target precious metal leasing transaction sent by a business system, obtaining business data of the target precious metal leasing transaction from a database server according to the risk rating request, determining the default loss rate and risk opening of the target precious metal leasing transaction according to the business data of the target precious metal leasing transaction, a preset default loss rate model and a risk opening rule, determining the risk level of the target precious metal leasing transaction according to the risk opening, the default loss rate and a preset risk rating standard, and returning the risk level to the business system, wherein the preset risk rating standard comprises a corresponding relation among a risk opening interval, a default loss rate interval and the risk level. The application can improve the accuracy and efficiency of the risk rating of the noble metal leasing transaction, and further can improve the safety of the noble metal leasing transaction.

title_en: Unsupervised anomaly detection method, system, device and storage medium
