abstract_en: The invention discloses an unsupervised anomaly detection method, a system, equipment and a storage medium, wherein a plurality of student networks are used for jointly participating in prediction, so that the influence of randomization when a single student network is used is avoided, and the unsupervised anomaly detection method has better model robustness; by using the characteristic pyramid structure and using multi-scale characteristics, abnormal conditions under multiple scales can be dealt with; the semantic segmentation network is used for further assisting in improving the prediction result, and the excellent recognition capability of the semantic segmentation network on the abnormal region contour is used for assisting in correcting the result of the previous step, so that the overall method achieves the best effect. Experiments prove that the method obtains the highest accuracy rate and can be better applied to an abnormality detection task.

title_en: Hearing aid hearing compensation integral control method and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a hearing compensation integral control method and equipment for a hearing aid, comprising the following steps: acquiring audiogram of an audiogram patient in each frequency band, constructing a first hearing model of the audiogram of the frequency band, and obtaining a first volume change model of the first hearing model; determining a virtual mapping of the first hearing model, and constructing a second hearing model based on the virtual mapping to obtain a second volume change model of the second hearing model; obtaining a volume error model according to the first volume change model and the second volume change model, constructing an integrator by taking the volume error in the volume error model as an input variable, and combining the integrator with the volume error model to obtain a hearing compensation control system; and the hearing compensation control system is adopted to perform hearing compensation on the sound input into the hearing aid, so that the compensated volume is ensured to be matched with the audiogram. The invention can effectively regulate and control the hearing compensation overflow of the hearing aid and improve the user experience of the hearing aid.

title_en: Semi-Lagrange interpolation communication optimization method based on vertical layer grouping
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of numerical forecasting, and discloses a semi-Lagrange interpolation communication optimization method based on vertical layer grouping, which is used for collecting three-dimensional field data in semi-Lagrange interpolation and grouping all three-dimensional fields in the vertical direction; dividing the operation of each group into two parts of communication and calculation, wherein the communication part is carried out in FLD3I and YHSPFI, and interpolation results are respectively stored in FLD3O and YHSPFO; re-planning calculation and communication under the grouping condition, and realizing overlapping of calculation and communication; for the candidate number of packets, the number of packets is selected that minimizes the execution time of the semi-Lagrangian scheme phase. The invention reduces the operation time at the starting and ending parts of the pipeline and improves the overall calculation efficiency; and carrying out subsequent service numerical forecasting by adopting the determined optimal packet number, and reducing the time of service numerical forecasting to the greatest extent.

title_en: Resource allocation method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification discloses a resource allocation method, a resource allocation device and resource allocation equipment, and belongs to the technical field of machine learning. The method comprises the steps of determining service attributes related to available resources, determining a plurality of micro time sequences corresponding to macro time sequences to be predicted and used for describing the change condition of the service attributes, clustering the micro time sequences to obtain a plurality of micro time sequence groups, respectively predicting the micro time sequence groups to obtain predicted values of the micro time sequence groups, predicting the predicted values of the macro time sequences according to the predicted values of the micro time sequence groups, and allocating the available resources to the service corresponding to the service attributes according to the predicted values of the macro time sequences.

title_en: Anchoring engineering safety evaluation method and newly-built anchoring engineering safety design method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an anchoring engineering safety evaluation method and a newly-built anchoring engineering safety design method. The safety evaluation method of the anchoring engineering comprises the following steps: acquiring the service time, the design age, the safety index design requirement and the safety index after the service time of the anchoring engineering, and the endurance time of an anchoring structure on the anchoring engineering; evaluating the safety of the anchoring engineering based on the relation between the service time of the anchoring engineering, the endurance time of the anchoring structure and the design life and the relation between the safety index after the service time of the anchoring engineering and the design requirement of the safety index; the method for acquiring the endurance time of the anchoring structure comprises the following steps: acquiring the design section diameter, material parameters and environment variables of an anchoring mechanism in an anchoring structure; calculating the endurance time of the anchoring mechanism based on the designed section diameter of the anchoring mechanism, the material parameters and the environmental variables; the endurance time of the anchoring structure is determined based on the endurance time of the anchoring structure. The invention is suitable for the field of rock and soil anchoring engineering.

title_en: Method for predicting semiconductor process measurement data
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting semiconductor process measurement data, which comprises the following steps: providing historical measurement data and historical original process data of a wafer; performing time step shortening processing on the first time sequence data by using an auto-encoder to obtain second time sequence data; fitting and training a prediction model by utilizing the second time sequence data and the historical measurement data, wherein the prediction model comprises a transformer encoder and a multilayer perceptron; and inputting the original process data to be predicted into the time step shortening model and the prediction model to obtain the predicted measurement data. In the invention, the self-encoder is used for shortening the time step of the time sequence data so as to be beneficial to improving the overall calculation efficiency on the premise of no damage of characteristic information, and then the parallel calculation of the transform encoder is used for improving the calculation speed, and the self-attention mechanism is used for obtaining the size characteristic of the data and simultaneously considering the characteristic on the time step so as to improve the accuracy of prediction.

title_en: Medical document analysis method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides an analysis method of a medical document, relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and particularly relates to the field of deep learning. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring a medical document, and extracting at least one piece of first condition information in the medical document; determining a first classification label corresponding to the medical document according to the medical document and the first disease state information; and determining a second classification label corresponding to the medical document from the sub-labels according to at least one sub-label corresponding to the first classification label and preset classification basis information of each sub-label. The method and the device can improve the accuracy of the medical document analysis result.

title_en: Application no-response processing method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an application no-response processing method and electronic equipment, relates to the technical field of electronics, and can optimize the processing process of the electronic equipment when the application has no response, so that the user experience is improved. The specific scheme is as follows: the electronic equipment runs a first application program and displays a first interface; the method comprises the steps that when the electronic equipment determines that the first application program has the application program unresponsive ANR, the electronic equipment displays a first prompt window; the electronic equipment receives a first operation that a user waits for a first application program to recover response; responding to the first operation, and displaying a second prompt window by the electronic equipment; the electronic equipment receives a second operation that the user switches the first application program to the background of the electronic equipment; and responding to the second operation, the electronic equipment switches the first application program to the background of the electronic equipment and displays a second interface, wherein the second interface is an interface corresponding to the second application program.

title_en: Implementation method of three-dimensional (3D) tower crane construction scene display system based on ThreeJS
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of three-dimensional display, in particular to an implementation method of a three-dimensional (ThreeJS) -based 3D tower crane construction scene display system. The main points are that the data of the tower crane running state of the construction site is obtained through the network, the 3D model obtains the data, the tower crane state of the display site, and the main scheme comprises S1: declaration of tower crane name, S2: sensor name declaration, S3: edge device name declaration, S4: edge device configuration, S5: the edge device uniformly parses the data format, S6: cloud server configuration, S7: edge device scene presentation, S8: and displaying the scenes of the cloud server. The tower crane display system is built based on cloud computing and edge computing, and combines the advantages of the cloud computing and the edge computing. The tower crane display system is a three-dimensional (3D) engine frame based on ThreeJS, and is used for displaying a construction site of a 3D tower crane at a webpage end.

title_en: Remote sensing data on-satellite processing system and equipment based on model definition
abstract_en: The processing system comprises a basic resource layer, a data processing layer and a data processing layer, wherein the basic resource layer is configured to store at least two bottom operator modules required for realizing on-satellite processing tasks; the core function layer is configured to store at least two processing cores required for realizing the on-satellite processing task; the processing core is realized by combining at least one bottom operator module by calling the bottom operator module in the basic resource layer; therefore, when the satellite processing task is realized based on the system, the task instruction is configured on the application expression layer only according to the application requirement of the satellite processing task, so that the corresponding processing core can be called from the core function layer through the task instruction to generate the corresponding satellite processing task, the duplication rate of the similar algorithm is reduced, the development period of the satellite processing system is further reduced, and the satellite processing system meets the requirements of low cost and rapid deployment of the future satellite.

title_en: Image processing method, system, terminal device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an image processing method, an image processing system, terminal equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of respectively inputting an image to be processed and a target image into a pre-trained skin migration model for feature extraction to obtain a first extracted feature and a second extracted feature; the method comprises the steps of carrying out feature fusion on a first image feature and a second skin feature according to a pre-trained skin migration model to obtain an image expected feature, carrying out image generation according to the image expected feature to obtain a first migration image, carrying out image scaling on the first migration image and an image to be processed to obtain a first image pyramid and a second image pyramid, and carrying out skin migration on the image to be processed according to the first image pyramid and the second image pyramid to obtain an output image. According to the invention, the characteristics of irrelevant skin types such as contours, five sense organs, backgrounds and the like in the image to be processed and the skin type characteristics in the target image can be effectively reserved in the first migration image, so that the accuracy of skin type migration is improved.

title_en: Information processing system, information processing method, and program
abstract_en: The subjects are numerical analysis appropriately using machine learning. The information processing system (1) is provided with a target data acquisition unit (212) and a numerical analysis processing unit (213) (or a configuration estimation unit (316)). A target data acquisition unit (212) acquires data of a target object for numerical analysis (or design simulation of a structure) represented by a grid shape. A numerical analysis processing unit (213) (or a structure estimation unit (316)) acquires an estimation result obtained by estimating the result of numerical analysis (or the result of design simulation of a structure) in an object to be numerically analyzed (or the result of design simulation of a structure) using a machine learning model in which machine learning is performed on the result of numerical analysis (or design simulation of a structure) of physical characteristics in units of the relationship between two adjacent nodes of graph data corresponding to a mesh shape.

title_en: Fault prediction method, device and equipment for hard disk
abstract_en: A fault location device firstly obtains a first attribute value of a hard disk, inputs the first attribute value into a fault prediction model, and obtains a first abnormal score which indicates the running state of the hard disk under the first attribute value. The fault prediction model is trained based on a second attribute value during normal operation of the hard disk, and the second attribute value is used for indicating the operation state of a plurality of components during normal operation of the hard disk; and comparing the first anomaly score with a threshold value, wherein when the first anomaly score is larger than the threshold value, the hard disk can run but has a fault risk, and a fault can occur at a certain future time. And training the fault prediction model by using the attribute value of the hard disk in normal operation, and improving the accuracy of the fault prediction model. Therefore, the output value output by the fault prediction model can reflect the running state of the hard disk more accurately, and whether the hard disk has a fault risk or not can be accurately determined.

title_en: Power image processing method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power image processing method and device, and the method comprises the steps of acquiring a first image, carrying out registration alignment processing on the first image and a reference image through a SIFT algorithm, differencing the registered and aligned first image and the reference image to obtain a difference image, and determining a difference region in the first image by adopting a picture frame strategy based on the difference image. According to the scheme, the collected images are compared with the reference images corresponding to the normal working state, so that abnormal power equipment is determined, effective monitoring of defects, running states and safety risks of the power transformation equipment is realized, the inspection work efficiency of the power transformation equipment is greatly improved, and the control capacity of the equipment quality is improved.

title_en: Target behavior identification method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a target behavior identification method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to the technical fields of image processing, intelligent video analysis and the like, and can be applied to intelligent cloud, intelligent city, city management and intelligent city management scenes. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: the method comprises the steps of extracting frames from an acquired video stream, obtaining N target image frames, carrying out behavior identification on the target image frames, obtaining behavior detection frames on the target image frames, carrying out clustering processing on the behavior detection frames, obtaining M clustering clusters, obtaining an interested area on the image frames, and determining the target behavior detection frames based on the interested area and the behavior detection frames included in the clustering clusters. According to the method and the device, the behavior of the target image frame obtained by video streaming frame extraction is identified to obtain the behavior detection frame, clustering processing is carried out to obtain the clustering cluster, and the target behavior detection frame is determined based on the region of interest and the behavior detection frame, so that the accuracy of the identification result is improved, and the identification effect is enhanced.

title_en: Ultrasonic processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure discloses an ultrasonic processing method, device, equipment and storage medium, wherein the ultrasonic processing method comprises the steps of determining frequency combinations corresponding to target data to be transmitted, wherein one frequency combination comprises at least two different frequencies, and transmitting ultrasonic waves of each frequency in the frequency combination within a preset duration. According to the method disclosed by the embodiment of the disclosure, the target data can be sent through multi-frequency combination, so that the error rate is reduced to a certain extent, and the method has good anti-interference performance.

title_en: Calibration model and method for 3D vision camera and mechanical arm for welding
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vision guide technology, in particular to a calibration model and a calibration method for a 3D vision and mechanical arm for welding, which comprises a calibration structure, a locking mechanism and a model body; the calibration structure is movably arranged above the rotary table along the radial direction of the rotary table, and the rotary table is coaxially and rotatably matched with the model platform; after the model installation part and the manifold are pre-installed, the position of the calibration structure can be finely adjusted, the central spine calibration part in the calibration structure is ensured to be positioned on the axis of the welding gun barrel, the welding gun barrel on the mechanical arm and the 3D camera are positioned in the same coordinate system, and the guide error of the 3D camera is reduced. In the calibration method, the method of installing the calibration model, setting the origin, setting the track route and importing data is adopted to enable the presented three-dimensional track to be closer to the preset welding path, so that the error is reduced; the calculation amount of the point position is smaller, the calculation load of a host is reduced, and meanwhile the presentation rate of the path can be improved.

title_en: Smart campus security detection method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for detecting the safety of a smart campus, wherein the method comprises the following steps: setting a plurality of nodes on traffic for buildings in a campus; calling a camera to collect video data for each node; detecting a first user registered in a campus in video data; if the identity registered by the first user in the campus is a student or a teacher, determining that the first user is a second user; generating a passing network according to nodes passed by a second user and a first time length consumed by the nodes; detecting a third user which is not registered in the campus and does not meet a peer condition in the video data, wherein the peer condition is that the distance between the third user and any first user is less than a distance threshold value and the duration time exceeds a time threshold value; generating a passing link according to the nodes passed by the third user and the second time consumed by the nodes; matching the passing link with a passing network; and if the matching fails, executing an alarm operation on a third user. The safety of the campus is improved.

title_en: Method for predicting tropical cyclone track, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting tropical cyclone track, computer equipment and storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: statistical information of the current tropical cyclone is collected, preprocessing and characteristic engineering are carried out to obtain statistical characteristics and track characteristics, the characteristics are input into a pre-trained LightGBM model, and the future tropical cyclone track position can be predicted. The method fully utilizes statistical information related to tropical cyclone track prediction, and excavates statistical characteristics and track characteristics from the statistical information, so that track changes of the tropical cyclone are fully reflected; the LightGBM model is used for modeling and prediction, data normalization is not needed, and the prediction precision is higher; the prediction result can be obtained within a few seconds, the speed is high, and the prediction result can be referred by related personnel before the professional prediction result is issued.

title_en: Method for identifying key line of electric-gas coupling system based on maximum flow theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric-gas coupling system key line identification method based on a maximum flow theory, which is based on the maximum flow theory and combines a complex network theory, improves the traditional line betweenness, overcomes the defect that energy or power between nodes of an integrated energy system is supposed to be propagated along the shortest path between the nodes, considers all possible transmission paths of the integrated energy system, and better accords with the characteristics of the integrated energy system. Meanwhile, considering from two aspects of structural importance and state importance of the line, a line comprehensive importance index reflecting the structural centrality and the transmission bearing capacity of the line is established, so that the identification of the key line of the comprehensive energy system is more accurate and reliable, and a new thought and a new method are provided for the identification of the key line of the comprehensive energy system. The method can be used for identifying the key line of the comprehensive energy system, can also be popularized and used for identifying the key line of a thermodynamic system, a traffic system, a logistics system and other large-scale complex systems, and has wide application value.

title_en: Grabbing pose detection method based on RGB-D feature depth fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to a grabbing pose detection method based on RGB-D characteristic depth fusion. Secondly, an end-to-end convolutional neural network for target detection, positioning and grabbing posture prediction is constructed, and the RGB image and the depth image are input into the constructed convolutional neural network in two paths. And then, performing depth fusion on the RGB-D characteristics, obtaining two-dimensional plane grabbing pose representation of the object to be grabbed by a self-adaptive anchor frame setting method based on a two-step approximation idea, and further mapping the grabbing pose to a three-dimensional space by utilizing calibration information of a mechanical arm and a camera to implement grabbing operation. The invention can overcome the problems of low grabbing efficiency and poor generalization performance of the mechanical arm in the prior art, realize end-to-end target positioning and grabbing detection, can accurately detect the grabbing pose of the target in real time, and has accuracy and robustness through experimental verification.

title_en: Method and system for determining thickness of oil film of axial plunger pump sliding shoe pair
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for determining the thickness of an oil film of a sliding shoe pair of an axial plunger pump, which relate to the field of axial plungers, and the method comprises the following steps: determining a slipper motion parameter according to the slipper structure parameter and the axial plunger pump working parameter; determining the rotation angular speed and the eccentric ring area of the return disc according to the sliding shoe structure parameters, the axial plunger pump working parameters and the sliding shoe motion parameters; determining the stress information of the plunger according to the rotation angular speed of the return disc and the plunger of the axial plunger pump; constructing a balance equation set of oil film pressure and moment of the sliding shoes according to the stress information of the plunger, the motion parameters of the sliding shoes and the eccentric ring area; and constructing a plunger pump sliding shoe pair oil film thickness field model, a plunger pump sliding shoe pair oil film temperature field model and a plunger pump sliding shoe pair oil film pressure field model according to the sliding shoe structure parameters and the sliding shoe motion parameters, and further determining the oil film thickness of the sliding shoe pair by utilizing a Newton iteration method. The invention improves the calculation precision of the oil film thickness by considering the eccentric contact factor of the return disc and the sliding shoe.

title_en: Method and system for safely controlling login of company background application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for controlling the login security of a company background application, belonging to the technical field of information security, wherein the method comprises the steps of opening a client of a security control system on a computer; the client acquires the corresponding authorization code of the automatic registration of the computer hardware information; when a client opens a login page of an office system, a browser calls a local port to obtain an authorization code encryption string so as to verify whether a current computer passes an approved and approved authentication computer of a company, and if the current computer passes the approved and approved authentication computer, the current computer can be used; the method comprises the steps of inputting an account and a password at a client, sending a login request, verifying a user name and the password and analyzing an authorization code encryption string by a server, simultaneously obtaining current computer hardware information and position information, uniformly sending the information to the server, and normally logging in if the account is verified and authenticated. The invention also provides a safety control system for the background application login of the company, which comprises a server side and a client side. The invention limits the non-permitted computer access, facilitates the later-stage check and can trace the business.

title_en: High-quality sample enhancement and expansion method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of data enhancement and discloses a high-quality sample enhancement and expansion method. Through sample data generation and label enhancement processing, the generation quantity and quality of samples are improved from two angles of data and labels, and finally diversified expansion and usability improvement of the samples on the basis of approaching to real data are realized. The invention realizes the sample high-quality enhancement expansion under the hierarchical processing flow formed by data generation and label enhancement, can ensure the high quality and the availability under the premise of ensuring the sample data increment generation, effectively overcomes the problems of poor approximability to the real sample state and low utilization rate of label data in the prior art, and can better assist the training of data driving models such as a deep neural network and the like under the condition of small samples.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for placing goods on high-order goods shelf of unmanned forklift
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of automatic control, and discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for placing goods on a high-level goods shelf of an unmanned forklift. The method comprises the steps of obtaining image information of a forklift tray and a goods shelf through a depth camera on a fork arm of an unmanned forklift, determining point cloud data of the forklift tray and the goods shelf according to the image information of the forklift tray and the goods shelf, determining space position information of the forklift tray and the goods shelf according to the point cloud data, determining a distance difference value between the forklift tray and the front surface of the goods shelf according to the space position information, and controlling the fork arm to conduct pose adjustment according to the distance difference value so as to finish goods placing. Through the mode, the situation that the portal shakes due to too high lifting of the forklift when the high-position goods shelf is put is reduced, so that the unmanned forklift is more accurate in put, the possibility of safety accidents is reduced, and the use experience of a user is improved.

title_en: Integrated circuit and design method of integrated circuit
abstract_en: The present inventive concept relates to an integrated circuit and a method of designing an integrated circuit. The integrated circuit includes first standard cells arranged successively in rows having a first height and rows having a second height different from the first height. The integrated circuit further includes a second standard cell arranged successively on the row having the first height and the row having the second height, a plurality of first power supply lines formed on a boundary of the plurality of rows and configured to supply a first power supply voltage to the standard cell, and a plurality of second power supply lines formed on a boundary of the plurality of rows and configured to supply a second power supply voltage to the standard cell. The arrangement order of the power supply lines supplying voltage to the first standard cells is different from the arrangement order of the power supply lines supplying voltage to the second standard cells.

title_en: Intention recognition model training and user intention recognition method and device
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps of firstly determining historical dialogue data comprising multiple rounds of dialogue as training samples, determining user intention of each round of dialogue of each training sample through a first intention recognition model, determining feedback intention based on a service corresponding to the training sample executed by a user, determining a first risk recognition result according to the user intention and the feedback intention of the training sample, determining each prediction intention and a second risk recognition result of the training sample through a second intention recognition model, and finally training the second intention recognition model by taking the minimum difference between the first risk recognition result and the second risk recognition result of each training sample as an optimization target. By combining the feedback intention and the user intention determined by the first intention recognition model, an accurate risk recognition result is obtained so as to train the second intention recognition model, and the risk recognition capability of the second intention recognition model is improved.

title_en: Natural ecology simulated marine aquaculture illumination intelligent adjusting method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image data processing, in particular to an intelligent regulation method and system for marine aquaculture illumination simulating natural ecology. The method comprises the steps of carrying out frame difference processing on gray scale images of a culture pond at two adjacent moments obtained by shooting to obtain frame difference images, determining connected domains in the frame difference images according to a connected domain extraction algorithm, establishing a graph structure of the frame difference images by taking each connected domain on the frame difference images as a node, obtaining a possible value of fish existing in a region corresponding to each node on the gray scale images based on the maximum value of edge weights from each node to all the nodes, completing enhancement processing on each region on the gray scale images by using the obtained possible value, obtaining enhanced gray scale images capable of representing the number of fish swarms in the culture pond more accurately, determining the most appropriate illumination intensity after inputting the enhanced gray scale images into a trained neural network model to determine the more accurate number of the fish swarms, saving the production cost and improving the culture effect.

title_en: Distance relation determination method, equipment control method, model training method and related device
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a related device for distance relation determination, equipment control and model training, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of sound acquisition data which correspond to a plurality of devices one by one, wherein each sound acquisition data in the plurality of sound acquisition data comprises reference voice data and a device identification of the device, wherein the reference voice data is obtained by acquiring the sound of a sound source target by the corresponding device; determining at least one relative distance identifier according to the plurality of sound acquisition data and a pre-trained distance comparison model, wherein each relative distance identifier in the at least one relative distance identifier is used for indicating the position of corresponding equipment in an equipment distance relation sequence, the equipment distance relation sequence is a sequence formed by sequencing the plurality of equipment according to a preset sequencing strategy of distance, and the distance refers to the distance between the equipment and a sound source target. The method and the device realize the prediction of the relative distance relation containing the global information through the distance comparison model, and are beneficial to improving the efficiency and the applicability of the prediction of the relative distance relation.

title_en: Distribution network line three-dimensional perception model reconstruction method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a system for reconstructing a three-dimensional perception model of a distribution network line, and belongs to the technical field of distribution network line maintenance. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring binocular camera image information of a distribution network line, and acquiring point clouds of equipment units in the distribution network line based on the binocular camera image information; obtaining a rotation translation matrix of each equipment unit relative to a camera coordinate system based on a preset RANSAC algorithm and the point cloud; obtaining 6-DoF pose information of a device unit based on the rotation and translation matrix; and importing models of preset equipment units based on the 6-DoF pose information to realize the reconstruction of the three-dimensional perception model of the distribution network line. The scheme of the invention solves the problem of large error existing in the prior art that the three-dimensional perception model reconstruction method is directly applied to the reconstruction of the distribution network line.

title_en: Multi-mode emotion classification method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence, and discloses a multi-mode emotion classification method, which comprises the following steps: extracting text features, image features and voice features; respectively fusing the text features, the image features and the voice features in pairs to obtain text image features, text voice features and voice image features; splicing the text image features, the text voice features and the voice image features to obtain multi-modal features; and carrying out emotion classification on the multi-modal characteristics by using the trained model to obtain an emotion result. The invention also relates to a blockchain technique in which text features, image features, and speech features can be stored in blockchain nodes. The invention also provides a multi-mode emotion classification device, equipment and medium. The invention can improve the accuracy of emotion classification.

title_en: Correction method for large-field-angle image distortion
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for correcting distortion of a large-field-angle image, which comprises the following steps of: step S1: providing a camera lens specification, and fitting a distortion model of a distorted image according to specification parameters in the camera lens specification; and step S2: a one-dimensional lookup table is established according to the distortion model, a camera lens specification provided by a camera lens manufacturer is fully utilized, and the influence of subjective factors on image distortion correction is reduced; the existing two-dimensional lookup table is reduced to a one-dimensional lookup table, data needing to be stored is greatly reduced, and hardware cost is reduced.

title_en: Providing multi-device services using a network application programming interface
abstract_en: A multi-device service is provided using a network application programming interface. The server obtains accessibility information indicating a plurality of devices and their capabilities. Multiple devices have the same user identity. In this way, the server may control the devices participating in MuD service.

title_en: BMC chip management method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps that a GPIO register used for detecting interruption is arranged in the BMC chip, and the GPIO register used for detecting the interruption is configured, so that the falling edge of a signal input with GPIO generates interruption; enabling a program running in a CPU to enter a system, automatically loading a driver of Super I/O equipment related to GPIO interrupt processing in the system, and registering an lpc _ gic _ int interrupt processing program; starting an application program, wherein the pin position of the GPIO input pin generates falling edge change, and the BMC chip generates GPIO interruption; the Super I/O device transmits GPIO interrupt information to the CPU through LPC, and generates LPC _ gic _ int interrupt in the CPU; entering an interrupt response program registered by a driver in the system, identifying GPIO (general purpose input/output) generating an interrupt signal, and counting; and interrupting the application program through the running GPIO interruption, acquiring an interruption count value in the driving program and displaying the interruption count value. The system function based on the BMC chip is expanded more, and the BMC chip resource is fully utilized.

title_en: Intelligent tourism comprehensive service system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent tourism comprehensive service system and a method thereof. The client sends data to the server and transmits real-time positioning information of the client; the server analyzes and processes the received data and transmits the analyzed and processed data to the platform service center and the client; the platform service center displays the data and position information of the tourists and other information of the scenic spot on a monitoring screen, and matches or pushes the requirements of the tourists to corresponding server customer service personnel according to the text data, the voice data and the real-time facial image data of the tourists; and the platform service center pushes the information to the client. The invention can improve the comprehensive service efficiency and quality of the intelligent tourist attraction.

title_en: Information pushing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an information pushing method, an information pushing device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: under the condition that the user is detected to be in the vehicle and the vehicle is in a static state, obtaining a detection result of the vehicle navigation information; determining target push information from a preset information base based on at least one of the read position information and the label information of the user according to the detection result of the vehicle navigation information; and outputting the target push information. According to the embodiment of the application, the problem that the current information pushing is inaccurate can be solved.

title_en: Early warning method for echelon lithium battery pack
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of measuring electrical variables, in particular to an early warning method for a echelon lithium battery pack. The invention can detect the availability of the echelon battery in the future time period in advance, thereby realizing early warning and effectively solving the problem that the existing echelon battery performance detection has certain hysteresis.

title_en: Control device, data processing method, storage system, and SOC
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a control apparatus including a bus interface, a memory interface, a write-once storage unit, and a security unit; the bus interface is used for connecting a bus of the system on chip SOC; the number of the bus interfaces is one or more, and at least part of the bus interfaces are connected with the memory interface through the safety unit; the memory interface is used for connecting a memory of the SOC: the write-once storage unit stores an encryption and decryption key; the safety unit is connected with the write-once storage unit; the security unit includes: and the encryption and decryption module is used for encrypting the data written into the memory by the security unit according to the encryption and decryption key and decrypting the data read out from the memory by the security unit. The disclosure also provides a data processing method, a storage system and an SOC.

title_en: Data conversion method, system and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a data conversion method, a system and a device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when the triggering condition corresponding to the scheduling task is met, triggering the scheduling task, and transmitting the task parameter to a main program of the pushing task; by pushing a task main program, inquiring target data in a database by adopting a stream mode based on task parameters, analyzing the target data according to a template file, and writing the target data into a floor fragment data file; after target data in a database are inquired and written into the land fragmented data files, determining the total number of the target data in each data mode, and generating a text file corresponding to each data mode according to the total number of the target data in each data mode and each land fragmented data file in each data mode; and compressing the text file corresponding to each data mode, and uploading the compressed text file to a target server. The method can ensure the timeliness and the accuracy of data pushing and realize the decoupling of the database and the data consumption end.

title_en: Data element acquisition method, system, device and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data element acquisition method, a system, equipment and a computer readable storage medium. The data element acquisition method comprises the following steps: creating object identification for the data element to mark the area, type, database address and serial number of the data element; receiving a search request of a user, wherein the search request carries data element search information, and the data element search information comprises an area, or a type, or an object identifier; parsing the search request to determine at least one target data element to be searched by the user; initiating a query request to a data vault in which the target data element is stored based on the data vault address and the serial number of each target data element, wherein the query request carries an object identifier of the target data element; and receiving the data element returned by the database with the target data element stored therein so as to return to the user. The invention can effectively ensure that the data elements can safely and efficiently circulate in the whole network domain, and helps the user to legally find the required data.

title_en: Text detection method and device, electronic equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a text detection method, a text detection device, an electronic device and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the text detection method comprises the following steps: acquiring a text to be detected; covering each forward emotion word of a text to be detected to obtain a first mask text; covering each negative emotion word of the text to be detected to obtain a second mask text; predicting the masked forward emotion words in the first mask text to generate a first reconstructed text; predicting the masked negative emotion words in the second mask text to generate a second reconstructed text; determining a first similarity between the first reconstructed text and the text to be detected and a second similarity between the second reconstructed text and the text to be detected; and determining the text to be detected as sarcasm text in response to the first similarity and/or the second similarity being smaller than a set threshold value. This application not only can improve the detection accuracy of ironic text, can also save a large amount of data labeling work, realizes unsupervised ironic detection.

title_en: Method for detecting tensile strength of garment fabric
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of methods for identification by using electronic equipment, in particular to a method for detecting the tensile strength of clothing fabric, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a fabric image after a tensile test, performing rotation transformation on the fabric image to obtain a target image in which yarns are vertical or parallel to the horizontal direction, acquiring a defect area in the image according to edge detection, thinning the defect area to obtain a single-pixel line segment, and determining the yarn defect area in the fabric image according to the angle between the single-pixel line segment and the edge of the target image; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a gray level change curve of a yarn defect area, analyzing and obtaining an amplitude set and a period set of the gray level change curve, determining broken line areas in the yarn defect area according to the amplitude set and the period set, calculating the broken line degree of each broken line area, and determining whether the tensile strength of the fabric is qualified or not according to the broken line degree and a broken line degree threshold value.

title_en: Feline gene analysis method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention provides a feline gene analysis method and a feline gene analysis system based on big data, which are characterized by collecting the loads of available nodes in a cluster and target gene sequences, determining the number of actuators of the big data of each available node and the number of CPU cores corresponding to each actuator according to the loads of the available nodes, sequencing the target gene sequences according to the length of the target gene sequences, and grouping the sequenced target gene sequences, wherein each group comprises the target gene sequences with the same number as the actuators; and uniformly distributing the grouped target gene sequences to an actuator, establishing a corresponding relation between the target gene sequences and the cores, and scheduling the target gene sequences corresponding to the cores to a new actuator according to the relation between a Storage Memory and an Execution Memory in the actuator Execution process. The invention effectively improves the speed of gene analysis of the feline by adjusting the number of actuators and the number of cores and scheduling the target gene sequence.

title_en: Method for testing number of carbon fibers
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for testing the number of carbon fibers, and belongs to the technical field of carbon fiber production. Firstly, a carbon fiber multifilament sample to be tested is obtained and is cured by adopting a dry yarn sample preparation method, so that the problems of large loss of the number of carbon fibers and low accuracy of a test result caused by the traditional wet yarn sample preparation are solved; secondly, embedding the cured carbon fiber multifilament sample by using denture base resin dental powder and denture base resin dental water, wherein the embedding procedure is simple and easy to operate, and the cured carbon fiber multifilament sample has high hardness and is easy to polish; finally, grinding and polishing the embedded carbon fiber multifilament sample; and (6) counting the photographed images. The problems of large measurement error, difficult sample preparation and poor operability in the asphalt-based carbon fiber root number test in the prior art are solved.

title_en: Main keel positioning method and main keel positioning system
abstract_en: The invention provides a main keel positioning method and a main keel positioning system, which comprise the steps of establishing a three-dimensional model of a main keel, establishing a three-dimensional scanning point cloud model of a constructed entity building, overlapping the three-dimensional model of the main keel and the three-dimensional scanning point cloud model of the constructed entity building to obtain the entity model, obtaining coordinates of at least two reference points in the constructed entity building in the entity model, calculating coordinates of a marking point through the obtained coordinates of the reference points in the constructed entity building and the relation of at least two marking points on the main keel related to the reference points, and marking the reference points and the marking points on the constructed entity building. The invention can rapidly and simply position the main joist.

title_en: Fuzzy test method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a fuzzy test method, a fuzzy test device, equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of protocol security detection. The method comprises the following steps: generating a fuzzy test case based on a genetic algorithm, and executing the fuzzy test case to trigger the operation of the monitored target program; obtaining a feedback result after the operation of the monitored target program, wherein the feedback result comprises the following steps: the test result meets the stop condition and the test result does not meet the stop condition; determining a target test case according to the feedback result; and testing the program to be tested based on the target test case. According to the method and the device, more effective fuzzy test cases can be obtained, and therefore more comprehensive protocol security detection can be achieved.

title_en: Contract vulnerability processing method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of machine learning and block chaining, in particular to a contract vulnerability processing method based on machine learning, which comprises the following steps: summarizing 31 types of vulnerability types of 12 types and block chain vulnerability field characteristics as the basis for manual labeling according to vulnerability judgment bases; manually labeling more than 9000 truly occurring intelligent contracts crawled from EtherScan; dividing an unstructured solid source code sequence by code slices; constructing a word embedding matrix for the code sequence; training a model; according to the contract vulnerability processing method, the vulnerability code mode is automatically learned through a machine learning method, manual summary of the vulnerability mode is not needed, the generalization is good, various types of vulnerabilities can be identified, and the automation degree is high; because the identity code has unique code field characteristics, and the occurrence of the vulnerability is always related to the field characteristics, the attention mechanism is introduced into the method, so that the block chain field characteristics are concerned by the model, and the vulnerability predicting capability of the model is improved.

title_en: Acquiring sensor data sets of vehicles of a fleet
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for acquiring a sensor data set of a vehicle of a fleet of vehicles, in which sensor data of at least one sensor of the vehicle is received. A plurality of triggers for respectively acquiring an object or a situation are defined or provided on a server outside the vehicle, each trigger having a trigger calculation power value, a trigger classifier and a trigger requirement. A plurality of triggers are sent to the vehicle. In a vehicle, corresponding priorities are assigned to a plurality of triggers according to corresponding trigger calculation power values of the triggers, and corresponding trigger classifiers of one or more triggers are directly or indirectly applied to sensor data according to the priorities of the triggers within a range allowed by calculation capacity of a vehicle server, thereby obtaining corresponding classifier quality values. Finally, the sensor data set based on the sensor data is transmitted from the vehicle to the vehicle external server only when the corresponding classifier quality value meets the trigger requirements of the corresponding trigger.

title_en: Multi-mode supervision and contrast learning-based head and neck cancer local recurrence information acquisition method
abstract_en: A method for obtaining local recurrence information of head and neck cancer based on multi-mode supervision and contrast learning specifically comprises the following steps: sample set division and image preprocessing, multi-view data enhancement, image coding network construction based on multi-mode supervision and contrast learning, coding network construction by training, view pooling fusion image coding, coding clinical data according to a mixed coding strategy based on attributes, classifier network construction based on multi-mode decoupling bilinear pooling fusion, and training of the constructed classifier network; the invention adds a multi-mode structure on the basis of the original contrast learning method, optimizes the contrast loss in modes and among modes together, adds tag information, and respectively fuses the extracted image features, images and clinical features by using a decoupling bilinear pooling mode, thereby improving the accuracy of the acquisition result of the recurrent signals of the head and neck cancer.

title_en: Storage RGV position sensing and decision management method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of scheduling management methods of storage RGVs, in particular to a position sensing and decision-making management method of storage RGVs. The method comprises the specific steps of S1, path management, generation of information points on a running path, S2, soft state management of the information points on the running path through task information acquisition, further path planning, S3, discrete state position sensing, rapid acquisition of current position information through an interrupt system of a controller, S4, task arbitration, task switching when event triggering of the soft state of the information points is detected, S5, abnormal processing, analysis and processing of various abnormal conditions on the path, and stability of RGV performance and smooth transition of motion states can be improved, and urgent requirements of modern industry are met.

title_en: Optimization design method for utilization of red mud solid waste in filling mining of water-rich mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to an optimal design method for utilizing red mud solid wastes in filling mining of a water-rich mine, which takes red mud and fly ash as filling materials and ordinary portland cement as an activator to perform potential activity excitation on the filling materials to generate hydration reaction so as to form a cemented filling body, meet the mining requirements of a filling method, and realize the dual purposes of stable solidification treatment of the red mud and low-cost filling method mining. The method comprises the steps of establishing a red mud-based filling slurry optimization design model for proportion optimization by taking the filling slurry cost per unit volume as an optimization target and the strength of a filling body, the water-resistant stability of the filling body, the pH value of a leaching solution and the maximum aperture as constraint conditions, so as to prepare the red mud-based filling slurry, realize solid waste disposal and mining by a filling method, and obtain the maximum economic benefit and environmental protection benefit. The method not only can avoid the potential problems of land occupation and potential safety and environmental protection of the piling of the red mud on the ground surface, but also can reduce the loss and dilution of resource exploitation.

title_en: Method for monitoring health state of IPTV EPG service based on AI algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for monitoring the health state of IPTV EPG service based on AI algorithm, belonging to the technical field of artificial intelligence, which specifically comprises the following steps: collecting basic log data which at least comprises EPG background server operation data, interface and EPG page access data, user behavior access data and user ordering data, forming basic log data, dividing the basic log data into a model training data set and a verification data set, training a data comprehensive analysis model adopting a machine learning algorithm, and generating a trained data comprehensive analysis model; the method comprises the steps of collecting operation data, interface and EPG page access data, user behavior data and user ordering data of an EPG background server in real time, forming an input set, and obtaining a service operation real-time monitoring result and an operation state real-time monitoring result of the EPG based on a data comprehensive analysis model after training is completed, and displaying or early warning, so that the accuracy and comprehensiveness of service analysis are improved.

title_en: E-commerce cargo monitoring and analyzing cloud platform based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an E-commerce cargo monitoring and analyzing cloud platform based on the Internet of things; the E-commerce cargo monitoring and analyzing cloud platform based on the Internet of things comprises a self-picking point basic information acquisition module, a distributor identity verification information generation module, a distributor identity information confirmation module, a distributor distribution video acquisition and analysis module, a cargo placement information acquisition module, a customer identity verification information generation module, a customer identity information confirmation module, a customer pickup video acquisition and analysis module, an early warning terminal and a database; according to the method and the device, the goods distribution video and the goods taking video of the target distributor and the target customer are obtained and are sequentially analyzed to obtain the goods distribution standard evaluation coefficient of the target distributor and the goods taking standard evaluation coefficient of the target customer, so that the problem that the monitoring strength of the current technology on goods is not strong is effectively solved, the phenomena that the goods are taken by the customer by mistake and are taken by more are avoided, and the problem that the goods are damaged in the placing process is avoided.

title_en: Display device and input sensing member
abstract_en: A display device and an input sensing member are disclosed. The display device having a first region and a second region extending from the first region and having a curved shape, the display device including: a display module including a display panel having a corner portion in the second region; an input sensing member on the display panel and including a main body portion overlapping the display panel and an extension portion extending from the main body portion, located in the second region, and not overlapping the display panel; and a first bonding layer between the display module and the input sensing member, wherein an edge of the extension portion extends beyond an edge of the corner portion.

title_en: Method and system for predicting permeability characteristics of spherical particle system based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting permeability characteristics of a spherical particle system based on machine learning, wherein the method adopts a discrete unit method to generate spherical particle aggregates with different gradations, region segmentation is carried out on a particle sample, a sample data set containing particle material gradation information and a three-dimensional image structure is established, the permeability of the particle sample is calculated through a lattice Boltzmann method and a D3Q19 lattice model, macroscopic and microscopic structural characteristics of the particle sample are extracted, a data set for training a machine learning model is constructed, and the machine learning model is trained to finally obtain a model capable of accurately and effectively predicting the permeability through a plurality of dimensional structural characteristics of the particle material. The method overcomes the defect that the macro-structure parameters cannot accurately describe the complex structure inside the pore. Meanwhile, a permeability prediction model based on machine learning is built based on the extracted structural parameters, so that the problem that the traditional seepage test is long in time consumption and limited in test equipment due to large particle size change range is solved.

title_en: Neural network-based contraband position detection method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for detecting the position of contraband based on a neural network. The method comprises the following steps: forming an induction area according to the transmitting coil and the receiving coil, wherein the induction area comprises an area position mark; when the target to be detected passes through the induction area, acquiring characteristic data of the target to be detected; inputting the characteristic data into a pre-trained first neural network model to obtain a detection result of whether the target to be detected contains contraband or not; when the target to be detected contains contraband, inputting the characteristic data into a pre-trained second neural network model to obtain the position of the detected contraband in the induction area. The contraband comprises one or more of electronic equipment such as a mobile phone, an intelligent watch, an interphone and the like and control tools. The method is based on the pre-trained neural network model, not only can detect whether the target to be detected contains contraband or not, but also can identify the position of the contraband, and the accuracy and the efficiency of the contraband detection are greatly improved.

title_en: Chip decoding method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological chips, and provides a chip decoding method and a device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a chip to be tested and a microsphere array template of the chip to be tested; collecting a first fluorescence image of a chip to be detected, and carrying out block segmentation on the first fluorescence image to obtain a second fluorescence image; carrying out microsphere point location matching on the microsphere array template and the second fluorescent image block by block, and determining the microsphere matching point location of each block in the second fluorescent image and the microsphere array template; performing fluorescence identification on the microsphere matching point positions in the second fluorescence image, and determining the gene probe types of the microsphere matching point positions in the second fluorescence image; and determining the spatial position information of the microsphere matching point positions in the second fluorescence image. The invention can identify and position millions of fluorescent signals in the microsphere array chip, output digital fluorescent decoding information and finally obtain decoding data of the biochip.

title_en: Accounting method and storage medium for drainage basin ecological compensation standard
abstract_en: The invention discloses an accounting method and a storage medium for a drainage basin ecological compensation standard, wherein the drainage basin ecological compensation standard is divided into three grades from low to high, the first grade is direct protection cost, the second grade also comprises ecological service value on the basis of the first grade, and the third grade also comprises opportunity cost on the basis of the second grade; the direct protection cost comprises the source control and pollution interception cost of pollutant discharge and the ecological restoration cost; the ecological service value comprises a water source conservation value, a soil retention value, a wind prevention and sand fixation value and a flood regulation and storage value; opportunity costs include development costs and enterprise shutdown costs; when the average GDP of the downstream area is lower than that of the upstream area or the average GDP of the downstream area is relative, the ecological compensation standard of the first-grade drainage basin is used; when the average GDP of the downstream area is higher than that of the upstream area, the ecological compensation standard of the second drainage basin is used; when the GDP of the downstream area is higher than that of the upstream area and the requirement of maintaining high-quality ecological environment is urgently required, the ecological compensation standard of the third river basin is used.

title_en: Medical artificial intelligence reasoning method and system based on low-code programming
abstract_en: The invention provides a medical artificial intelligence reasoning method and system based on low code programming, comprising the following steps: acquiring a plurality of medical artificial intelligence models and a plurality of data sets to be inferred; defining a low-code programming template according to the calculation content and the application method of the artificial intelligence model, and converting the medical artificial intelligence model into the low-code model according to the low-code programming template; selecting a model to be executed and a data set to be executed from all low-code models and all data sets according to prompts in a visual interface, dragging and combining the model to be executed and the data set to be executed in the visual interface, and assigning values for parameters of the model to be executed to generate a medical AI reasoning and calculating task; and constructing a cloud computing engine according to the computing environment required by the reasoning task so as to execute the medical AI reasoning computing task on the accessed cloud to obtain an execution result.

title_en: Power grid data processing method and system based on cloud edge cooperation and blockchain
abstract_en: The application relates to a cloud edge cooperation and blockchain-based power grid data processing method. The method comprises the following steps: and acquiring first real-time data corresponding to the energy transfer event in the jurisdiction of the edge server, performing energy application analysis based on the first real-time data to obtain first power grid operation data, and writing the first real-time data and the first power grid operation data into a first block chain. In response to a first data synchronization request of the edge gateway, data of a second blockchain to which the edge gateway belongs is synchronized to the first blockchain. And sending a second data synchronization request to the cloud server, synchronizing the first real-time data, the first power grid operation data and the second real-time data in the first block chain to the cloud server, so that the cloud server performs energy application analysis based on the second real-time data to obtain second power grid operation data, and synchronizing the second power grid operation data to the first block chain and the second block chain. By adopting the method, the data can be efficiently processed in real time and the data safety can be ensured.

title_en: Automated deployment method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic deployment method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1: recording the deployment process of each task to be deployed, generating a deployment log of each task to be deployed, and acquiring a deployment log set; s2: screening a deployment log set to be analyzed from the deployment log set based on a preset screening condition; s3: performing commonality analysis on the deployment log set to be analyzed to determine an optimizable step; updating the initial deployment process based on the optimizable step, and continuously executing the rest deployment tasks contained in the deployment task list based on the updated initial deployment process; the method and the device are used for screening and analyzing the commonalities of the logs recording the process of executing the task to be deployed, determining the optimizable steps in the initial deployment process, realizing the positioning analysis of the reasons of the deployment failure, realizing the continuous optimization learning in the deployment process, improving the efficiency of automatic deployment and reducing a large number of redundant files generated due to the deployment failure.

title_en: Resource scheduling method, device and equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a resource scheduling method, a resource scheduling device, resource scheduling equipment and a readable storage medium, relates to the technical field of computers, and aims to solve the problem of low algorithm operation stability in practice. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that an algorithm platform receives task expectation information of a target analysis task sent by a user; the algorithm platform identifies an expected state of the target analysis task based on the task expected information, wherein the expected state comprises addition, modification or cancellation; the algorithm platform acquires the number of analysis tasks of the currently and actually executed analysis tasks of the target algorithm corresponding to the target analysis task; under the condition that the expected state is newly increased or modified, the algorithm platform performs container expansion on the target algorithm under a first condition according to the number of the analysis tasks; and under the condition that the expected state is cancelled, the algorithm platform performs container reduction on the target algorithm under a second condition according to the number of the analysis tasks. The invention can improve the stability of the operation of the algorithm.

title_en: Internet-based network tag data processing method and system
abstract_en: According to the internet-based net tag data processing method and system, the internet net tag data carrying similar recording directions and the corresponding user behavior data are obtained, after the internet net tag data are optimized, the net tag data optimization result of the internet net tag data can be determined, then the net tag data optimization result of the internet net tag data is identified through the user behavior data, the identification processing result of the internet net tag data is obtained, the net tag data optimization result of the internet net tag data is identified, the obtained identification processing result of the internet net tag data is accurate and reliable, and therefore the credibility of the identification processing result is improved.

title_en: Self-adaptive confidence threshold adjustment method for improving video detection continuity
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-adaptive confidence threshold adjustment method for improving continuity of video detection, which relates to the field of target detection and video detection, wherein when the detection model is used for video detection, the detection capability of the detection model is fully exerted, the continuity of the video detection can be improved without additional methods such as tracking, the confidence threshold of the detection result is displayed by the detection model, more results can be detected, more false detection can be caused, the false detection can be reduced due to the fact that the confidence threshold is lower, but the false detection can be caused due to the fact that the false detection is higher, a threshold self-adaptive adjustment method is designed, a low threshold detection result is saved, a high threshold detection result is displayed, when the false detection occurs in the high threshold detection, the low detection threshold result saved by the target is called for matching, a detection frame with the high threshold false detection is supplemented by a detection frame detected in the low threshold, and a method matching mechanism is used only in a small range around the false detection target frame, so that the calculation amount is small.

title_en: Power equipment fault diagnosis method and system based on cloud edge end cooperative framework
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fault diagnosis method and system of power equipment based on cloud edge end cooperative architecture, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining voiceprint vibration data of target power equipment; the method comprises the steps of extracting feature vectors from voiceprint vibration data by a neural network integrated with a voiceprint vibration propagation mechanism to obtain a plurality of feature vectors, carrying out weight self-adaptive calculation and weighted fusion on the feature vectors to obtain a mixed feature vector, carrying out fault identification and classification on the mixed feature vector by a depth residual error network, and outputting fault identification and classification results. The invention can improve the accuracy and stability of the fault diagnosis of the power equipment under the condition of ensuring the real-time performance.

title_en: Binocular vision distance measurement method based on baseline distance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of binocular computer vision measurement, in particular to a binocular vision distance measurement method based on a baseline distance. The method comprises the following steps: s1, calibrating a binocular camera; s2, image acquisition is carried out by using a binocular camera: s3, calculating the parallax of target points in a left view imaged by the left eye camera and a right view imaged by the right eye camera by using a target recognition and feature point matching algorithm; s4, rightwards offsetting the right view imaged by the right eye camera by a distance C: and S5, adjusting the baseline distance to enable the image parallax to be 0, and obtaining the distance to be measured according to the adjusted baseline distance. When the method is used for ranging, the problem that the measurement precision at two ends is dispersed in the existing parallax method ranging can be effectively solved, so that the effective measurement range is wider and the precision is higher.

title_en: Multi-mode perception reminding method and system for current driving state of vehicle
