abstract_en: The invention provides a multimode perception reminding method aiming at the current running state of a vehicle, which comprises the following steps: identifying target traffic identification which belongs to safety risk categories in a preset range in front of the vehicle; determining a safety risk subcategory to which the target traffic identification belongs; and activating a multimode perception reminding scheme aiming at the current driving state of the vehicle according to the safety risk subcategory to which the target traffic identification belongs. The invention also provides a multimode perception reminding system, a computer device and a non-transitory computer readable storage medium aiming at the current driving state of the vehicle.

title_en: Non-contact access control identification method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a non-contact access control identification method and a non-contact access control identification system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target image of a face to be recognized, which contains an object to be recognized; judging whether a shielded area exists on the face to be recognized or not; when an occluded area exists on the face to be recognized, determining a reference face image from a database based on an unoccluded area in the face to be recognized, wherein the reference face image comprises a reference face of a reference object; and outputting a target judgment result of the object to be recognized based on the reference face and the face to be recognized.

title_en: Double-fed fan control parameter identification method based on LSTM neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-fed fan controller parameter identification method based on LSTM, which utilizes RT-LAB to obtain double-fed fan controller hardware-in-loop test data, utilizes a Person correlation coefficient method to extract characteristic quantity with higher correlation and is used for neural network training, identifies control parameters of a voltage outer loop and a current inner loop, and tests feasibility, effectiveness and practicability of an algorithm through hardware-in-loop test data. Compared with the prior parameter identification method, the method can simulate the operation characteristic of the fan control system by training the historical sample data, and input the measured data to the LSTM neural network under the condition of not operating the fan model to carry out the off-line identification of the control parameters.

title_en: Interaction method with dialogue system and training method of dialogue system
abstract_en: The application provides an interaction method with a dialogue system and a training method of the dialogue system. The interaction method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first user target input by a user; determining a plurality of first sub-targets according to the first user target; taking a plurality of first sub-targets as input to interact with the dialogue system; wherein the dialog system represents the dialog system after training by the user simulator.

title_en: Method for identifying kitchen pest invasion based on computer vision
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for identifying kitchen pest invasion based on computer vision, and relates to the field of biological identification methods. The method for recognizing kitchen pest invasion based on computer vision includes the steps of obtaining video data through existing camera equipment, regularly extracting frames from video data streams, extracting one frame for several seconds, performing down-sampling on the image data obtained by frame extraction, performing binarization and marginalization on the data after down-sampling, performing differencing comparison on processed feature maps of adjacent frame extraction time points, obtaining image picture change features before and after extraction through comparison results, extracting features of moving objects, performing kitchen pest probability classification on feature values by using a logistic regression classification algorithm to obtain final probability values, determining whether the feature values belong to pests according to the probability values, improving pest recognition accuracy, reducing kitchen modification cost and achieving good robustness and high efficiency.

title_en: AI model-based service user feature identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a business user characteristic identification method and system based on an AI model, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence. In the invention, image information acquisition operation is carried out on the target service user so as to output an image information set corresponding to the target service user. And for each frame of service user image in the multi-frame service user images included in the image information set, performing user characteristic point identification operation on the service user image to output a user characteristic point set corresponding to the service user image, wherein the user characteristic point set comprises a plurality of user characteristic points. And identifying the user characteristic points included in the user characteristic point set through an AI model formed by pre-training so as to output the user identity characteristic information of the target service user. Based on the method, the reliability of the user feature identification can be improved.

title_en: Regression test case selection method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for selecting a regression test case and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a test analysis panorama; acquiring a target test case corresponding to a target service scene based on the test analysis panorama, and confirming target service scene parameters corresponding to the target test case based on the database and user input data; performing a first round of system test based on the target service scene parameters to obtain test problem conditions, and confirming first round problem influence parameters based on analysis results of users on the test problem conditions; and comprehensively analyzing the target service scene parameters, the first round problem influence parameters and the historical defect influence parameters to obtain standard values of the test cases, determining regression threshold values based on actual test conditions input by users, and selecting the standard values of the test cases based on the regression threshold values to obtain a regression test case set. The invention improves the efficiency and effectiveness of selecting the regression test case, thereby improving the efficiency and effectiveness of the regression test.

title_en: Text processing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a text processing method, a text processing device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of computers. One embodiment of the method comprises: receiving a target text input by a user, and calling a preset generation model to generate a corresponding index identifier; querying a corpus identifier set associated with the index identifier from a preset corpus to obtain corpus attribute values corresponding to each corpus identifier in the corpus identifier set; calling a preset calculation model, calculating scores corresponding to all the corpus identifiers based on the corpus attribute values, and screening a target number of corpus identifiers from the corpus identifier set; and sending the corpora related to the corpus identification of the target quantity. The implementation mode can solve the problem that the input association function is generally to search the document or sentence output containing the input content from the document type database, so that the accuracy of the output result is low.

title_en: Cockpit-oriented information processing method and device and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a cockpit-oriented information processing method, a cockpit-oriented information processing device and related equipment, wherein the method is applied to a cockpit data center, acquires the identity information of an operator of a target object, and calls stored synchronous information which is issued by a ground data center and contains appointed identity information, task information and permission information of the operator; matching the collected operator identity information with stored operator identity information to perform identity authentication on a target object; if the identity authentication of the target object passes, outputting the identity information of the target operator, the target task information and the target authority information matched with the target object from the synchronous information for displaying; and if the confirmation operation aiming at the target task information input by the target object is obtained, authorizing the operation authority of the target object according to the target authority information, and guiding the task flow of the target object according to the authorized operation authority of the target object and the target task information.

title_en: Antenna housing wave beam average incidence angle calculation method
abstract_en: An electromagnetic integral algorithm with high precision is used for replacing a geometric optical method with low precision, threshold value screening and weighted averaging are combined, and more accurate antenna housing wave beam average incident angle parameters are obtained, so that more accurate design parameters are provided for antenna housing electrical property design and optimization.

title_en: Optimization method for simulating tunnel excavation
abstract_en: The invention provides an optimization method for simulating tunnel excavation. The method comprises the following steps: sequentially building rock-soil body components and lining components, and integrally assembling the lining components to corresponding positions of the rock-soil body components; dividing the rock-soil body part into a plurality of partial rock-soil bodies according to a preset partial excavation construction method; determining the execution sequence of the steps of establishing ground stress analysis, supporting analysis, softening analysis and removing analysis; performing an earth stress analysis step, wherein the lining component is wholly failed, and earth stress balance is implemented; performing a support analysis step, integrally activating the lining part, and implementing lining support; and (4) sequentially executing a softening analysis step and a removing analysis step on each part of the divided rock-soil body to obtain the tunnel. The invention can greatly reduce the repeated workload, reduce the error rate of the program and is beneficial to the convergence of the program.

title_en: Method and device for recommending third-party library and related equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a method for recommending a third party library, which comprises the steps of obtaining historical data and a plurality of third party libraries, wherein the historical data comprises records of replacing a to-be-processed third party library with any third party library in the plurality of third party libraries by reference software. And then, according to the acquired historical data, determining a target third-party library from the plurality of third-party libraries, wherein the target third-party library is used for replacing the to-be-processed third-party library called by the target software, so that the determined target third-party library is presented. Because the history records of the third-party libraries to be processed are replaced by the reference software, the appropriate target third-party libraries can be recommended for the software developed by the developer from the plurality of third-party libraries, so that the quality of the software can reach a higher level after the target software uses the replaced target third-party libraries. In addition, the application also provides a device for recommending the third-party library and related equipment.

title_en: Web page processing method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of information extraction, in particular to a website page processing method. The method comprises the following steps: s100, crawling a target website page to obtain a text T corresponding to the target website page; s200, NLP processing is carried out on the T by utilizing an advertisement removal algorithm to obtain a first text T  1  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the S300, acquiring an image P of a target website page, and carrying out region division and classification on the P by utilizing a trained neural network model matched with the target website page to obtain a first-class region image and a second-class region image; s400, performing OCR text recognition on the first category region image to obtain a second text T  2  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Traversal T  1  And T  2  If s  m  And a certain s  n,q  If the matching is carried out, then the T is reserved  1  Middle s  m  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Otherwise, delete T  1  Middle s  m  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the S500, obtaining updated T  1  . The invention can effectively filter the non-text content related to the text on the website page.

title_en: Milling parameter multi-objective optimization and decision method based on chaotic genetic algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a milling parameter optimization and decision method based on a chaotic genetic algorithm, which comprises the following steps: s1: establishing a milling parameter multi-objective optimization model; s2: obtaining an initial population Q by the milling parameters through Tent chaotic mapping  t  (ii) a S3: initial population Q  t  Substituting a chaotic genetic algorithm to solve the milling parameter multi-objective optimization model to obtain a Pareto solution set; and the Pareto solution set is a milling parameter optimization result. According to the invention, milling parameters are subjected to multi-objective optimization to obtain an initial population through Tent chaotic mapping, the Tent chaotic mapping is subjected to population initialization to obtain a better effect than a pseudo random number, the uniformity of the initial population can be improved to a certain extent, and the diversity of the population and the distribution of solutions are further improved; further optimizing the model for multiple targets in the chaotic genetic algorithmWhen the solution is carried out, the obtained Pareto solution is concentrated on any individual, namely the milling parameter, and the processing efficiency and the processing quality can be optimized after the milling is actually carried out.

title_en: Binary tree generation method and device, computer readable storage medium and terminal
abstract_en: A binary tree generation method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a terminal are provided, and the method comprises the following steps: determining a program to be stored, wherein the program to be stored comprises a plurality of business objects and at least one object calculation, and the object calculation is used for indicating the logical relationship between the business objects; extracting a business object and calculating the object in the program to be stored; determining a root node of the binary tree, wherein the root node is used for storing a first service object in the program to be stored; and adding child nodes to the current node layer by layer according to the extraction sequence, wherein the child nodes added each time are used for storing the current business object or the next business object or the object calculation calculated by the object. The scheme can concisely and unambiguously store the program to be stored containing the word order information and the logic relation information, reduce the storage complexity, reduce the storage space occupation and improve the analysis efficiency of the program to be stored.

title_en: Vehicle extraction method, device and system and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle extraction method, a device and a system and a computer readable storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a vehicle to be detected corresponding to information of a part to be detected, and acquiring passing point information of the vehicle to be detected in a production line; obtaining the position information of the vehicle to be detected according to the passing point information; obtaining the passing time of the vehicle to be detected according to the position information and the preset production time information; and extracting the vehicle to be detected corresponding to the position information and the passing point time. The method and the device reduce the complexity in the vehicle extraction process by quickly searching the vehicle and accurately predicting the offline time of the vehicle to be detected.

title_en: Top cavity for center fixed actuator
abstract_en: Flow chambers, cooling systems, and methods are described. The flow chamber includes an upper chamber having a top wall, an actuator, and a lower chamber. The actuator is positioned distally of the top wall. The lower chamber receives fluid from the upper chamber when the actuator is actuated. The top wall includes at least one cavity therein. The cooling system utilizes a cooling unit that includes a flow chamber. The method includes driving an actuator at a frequency that directs fluid through the flow chamber.

title_en: Cross-screen eye movement interaction method and system for aircraft cockpit based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for cross-screen eye movement interaction of an aircraft cockpit based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: step S1: acquiring an eye movement training set by adopting a large-scale sight line identification method; step S2: continuously training the eye movement training set by using a deep learning method of a visual Transformer to obtain eye movement information; and step S3: carrying out user eye movement proofreading on a plurality of screens according to the eye movement information to obtain a plurality of screen relative positions; and step S4: calculating a screen matched with the eye movement focus of the user according to the real-time eye movement data of the user and the relative position of the screen to obtain an eye movement focus screen; step S5: and activating the matched display and control system screen of the aircraft cockpit in real time according to the eye movement focus screen, and executing preset interactive operation. The cross-screen eye movement interaction method for the aircraft cockpit can be oriented to complex flight scenes, and improves cross-screen interaction efficiency and user experience of pilots.

title_en: Wallpaper setting method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a wallpaper setting method, a wallpaper setting device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: if the setting operation aiming at the target wallpaper is detected, setting the terminal wallpaper of a first terminal as the target wallpaper, acquiring a terminal identification corresponding to a second terminal connected with the first terminal, and setting the terminal wallpaper of the second terminal as the target wallpaper based on the terminal identification. By adopting the method and the device, the terminal wallpaper arranged on the first terminal is synchronized to the second terminal connected with the first terminal, so that the terminal wallpapers of a plurality of terminal devices are synchronously arranged, steps required by the terminal wallpaper are reduced, the wallpaper arrangement process is more humanized and intelligent, and the use effect of the terminal devices is improved.

title_en: Anti-cracking device and method with embedded passive radio frequency noise suppressor
abstract_en: A Radio Frequency Integrated Circuit (RFIC) chip includes an Integrated Circuit (IC) region and an anti-cracking device laterally surrounding the IC region. The crack prevention device includes a metal barrier (or concentric metal barrier) electrically isolated from the IC area. One or more noise suppressors, in particular one or more passive filters (e.g. low pass, high pass, band pass and/or band stop filters) are integrated into the structure of the metallic barrier to suppress noise signals within a specific RF range from propagating through the anti-cracking device. The specific radio frequency range may be a customer specified operating parameter. By embedding a customized noise suppressor into the crack prevention device, local signal interference specific to customer-specified operating parameters can be minimized while also avoiding or at least minimizing the risk of moisture entering the IC area. A method of forming the chip is also disclosed.

title_en: Fragile code segment clone detection method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a fragile code fragment clone detection method, a fragile code fragment clone detection device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the fragile code fragment clone detection method comprises the following steps: generating a program dependence graph of a program to be tested; positioning all second initial nodes matched with first initial nodes of a plurality of fragile code fingerprint subgraphs in a program dependence graph of a program to be tested by using a locality sensitive hashing algorithm, and determining a pair of matched first initial nodes and second initial nodes as an initial node clone pair, wherein the fragile code fingerprint subgraphs are partial program dependence graphs extracted from the program dependence graph of the fragile code segment; and performing slice subgraph matching on the fragile code fingerprint subgraph and the program dependency graph of the program to be tested in parallel based on all the initial node clone pairs, thereby detecting the cloned fragile code segment. By extracting the fragile code fingerprint subgraph, quickly matching the initial node clone pair by using a locality sensitive hashing algorithm and then executing subgraph matching in parallel, the accuracy and efficiency of fragile code clone detection are improved.

title_en: Data security defense emergency system and method based on cloud computing
abstract_en: The invention relates to a data security defense emergency system and a method based on cloud computing, wherein the system comprises a collecting unit which is built on a cloud server and is used for collecting log data of historical heterogeneous security equipment, converting the log data format of the historical heterogeneous security equipment into corresponding target log data and acquiring security events and associated equipment which are obtained after threat information analysis and correspond to the log data of the historical heterogeneous security equipment; the modeling unit is used for extracting characteristic values of historical target log data and then corresponding the original target log data to the safety events thereofRelationship establishment for one-to-one mapping relationship R between characteristic values of target log data and security events  1  Establishing a one-to-one mapping relation R between the characteristic value of the target log data and the associated equipment based on the corresponding relation between the original target log data and the associated equipment  2  And also used for learning and modifying the mapping relation R through historical data  1  And a mapping relation R  2  。

title_en: Synchronous positioning and mapping back-end optimization method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps of determining a target three-dimensional space point in three-dimensional space points of a plurality of key frames positioned by a synchronous positioning and mapping system, further determining a reprojection error according to the target three-dimensional space point, providing a weight for a maximum parallax corresponding to the target three-dimensional space point after preprocessing to obtain a relative reprojection error, wherein the relative reprojection error describes the difference between the space position of the point and the space position of a camera, so that more robust residual construction is provided for the optimization problem of synchronous positioning and mapping, the spatial positioning is better performed, and the problems that the existing back-end optimization cannot well show the relation between the reprojection error and the depth of the point, the description of space information is lacked, and the accuracy rate of pose estimation after optimization is lower are solved.

title_en: Intervertebral fusion cage bionic design method based on lumbar vertebra statistical shape model
abstract_en: A bionic design method of an intervertebral fusion cage based on a lumbar vertebra statistical shape model comprises the steps of medical CT data segmentation and pretreatment, automatic lumbar vertebra statistical shape model database construction, statistical shape model database classification analysis and intervertebral fusion cage bionic design. The method can automatically generate a lumbar vertebrae statistical shape model database, and automatically, quickly and effectively generate a large number of lumbar vertebrae three-dimensional shape models. By extracting the shape characteristics of the lumbar vertebrae, carrying out classification analysis and bionic design, the intervertebral fusion cage which can meet the requirement of a larger group range and is more in line with the shape of the individual lumbar vertebrae is obtained.

title_en: Construction method of construction target, project decoupling method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a construction method of a constructed target, a project decoupling method, a project decoupling device and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of application programs, wherein the method comprises the following steps: responding to a building instruction aiming at any building target, and acquiring a configuration file of the building target; acquiring a target general component and a target non-general component corresponding to the constructed target and business logic data corresponding to each target general component according to the configuration file; constructing the build target based on the target non-generic component, the target generic component, and the business logic data. The embodiment of the invention not only improves the coupling problem of the codes in the specific business process, but also enables the overall quality of the codes to be controllable, ensures the operating efficiency of the application program and improves the user experience. Moreover, each part of the components has the content which needs to be processed, so that the iteration of the whole project is easy and organized, and the maintainability of the application program is ensured.

title_en: Triple extraction system and method for technical standard document
abstract_en: The invention discloses a triple extraction system, which firstly carries out extraction on an S field and a P field in a sentence, then determines tail positions of the S field and the P field, and finally extracts a corresponding O field according to a text vector representation of an input sentence and a relative position relation of the S field and the P field. The invention also discloses a triple extraction method used in the technical standard document, which mainly adopts unlimited type documents to train a new triple extraction model to obtain an open domain triple extraction model; then, extracting different types of technical standard documents by adopting the trained open domain ternary group extraction model so as to obtain a P field in a technical standard file for training the closed domain ternary group extraction model; and respectively adopting the trained open domain three-tuple extraction model and the trained closed domain three-tuple extraction model to extract the technical standard document to be extracted, and de-superposing the extraction results of the two models to obtain the triples in the technical standard document to be extracted.

title_en: Power distribution network single-phase earth fault positioning method and device based on rough set algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a single-phase earth fault positioning method and device for a power distribution network based on a rough set algorithm. When the resistance earth fault occurs in the system, the fault section is positioned by adopting the current effective value characteristic; and when the intermittent arc grounding fault occurs in the system, judging a fault section by adopting phase current transient sudden change characteristics. The method can perform algorithm optimization according to the conditions of specific fault types, characteristics and the like on site, realize fault identification and fault section positioning on multiple fault types such as resistance, intermittent arc and the like, and expand the feasible region of the positioning technology; and only phase current is adopted for judgment, and zero sequence voltage of the system does not need to be acquired, so that the adaptability of the technology is ensured.

title_en: Gastric cancer pathological image classification method and system based on HER2 gene detection
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of computers and image processing, and particularly relates to a gastric cancer pathological image classification method and system based on HER2 gene detection, aiming at solving the problem that in the prior art, gastric cancer pathological images cannot be accurately classified, so that doctors cannot be effectively assisted in predicting the curative effect of trastuzumab therapy on patients. The invention comprises the following steps: acquiring a stomach digital pathological section image of a gastric cancer patient; performing region extraction and segmentation operation to obtain a plurality of image blocks with set pixel sizes and set tissue types; performing data enhancement normalization and data division on the image blocks to obtain training image packets; performing network iterative training through a training image packet to obtain a gastric cancer pathological image classification model; and classifying the digital pathological section images of the stomach of the patient, which are acquired in real time through the gastric cancer pathological image classification model. The method realizes accurate classification of the pathological images of the gastric cancer, thereby assisting doctors to effectively predict the curative effect of trastuzumab therapy of patients.

title_en: Method and system for detecting three-dimensional information of running train in complex environment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of information detection, in particular to a method and a system for detecting three-dimensional information of a running train in a complex environment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when a freight train passes, acquiring three paths of video information, three paths of point cloud data and top point cloud data of the freight train; decomposing the three paths of video information into three paths of image information, and extracting three paths of optimal frame pictures from the three paths of image information; carrying out distortion correction on the three paths of optimal frame pictures, and carrying out same-proportion processing on the three paths of optimal frame pictures after distortion correction to obtain three paths of same-proportion pictures; carrying out train contour positioning according to the top point cloud data to obtain train contour information; carrying out equal-scale reduction on the three paths of point cloud data by utilizing the train contour information to obtain equal-scale point cloud data; and calibrating the three paths of images with the same proportion and the point cloud data with the same proportion in a combined manner, and fusing to obtain a three-dimensional point cloud live-action image, so that the multidimensional information of the vehicle meeting the requirements can be conveniently acquired in various complex environments.

title_en: Base station acceptance method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a base station acceptance method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an equipment image of equipment to be checked and received in a base station acquired by camera equipment; identifying the equipment image to obtain equipment information in the equipment image; and determining the acceptance result of the equipment to be accepted according to the equipment information. The invention realizes that the acceptance of the automatic base station can be completed only by acquiring the images of the equipment through the camera equipment by the acceptance personnel without coordinating the arrival of the acceptance personnel of all parties, thereby greatly saving the acceptance time and improving the acceptance efficiency.

title_en: Data recording method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a data recording method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of responding to a media content recording request of a target subprogram running in a target application program, determining an audio and video source matched with the target subprogram, acquiring first audio and video data acquired from the front end of the target subprogram according to a target data transmission mode matched with attribute information of a client of the target application program when the audio and video source comprises the front end of the target subprogram, and generating media content recording data corresponding to the target subprogram based on the first audio and video data.

title_en: Method for generating order by high-concurrency recharging
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computers, in particular to a method for generating an order by high-concurrency recharging, which comprises the steps of acquiring recharging data of a user to generate a data character string, generating an encrypted data character string by the encrypted data character string, decrypting the encrypted string by a server to obtain a decryption result, simulating the decryption result to store in a database to generate order information, processing based on the order information and returning a processing result, and storing the order information in batches by data in a server list.

title_en: Language processing method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The present application relates to the field of natural language processing, and in particular, to a language processing method, apparatus, and storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a text to be processed of a target language processing task and first prompt information, wherein the first prompt information is a text sequence with any length, encoding the first prompt information into second prompt information, the second prompt information is a vector group with fixed length, performing splicing processing on the second prompt information and the text to be processed to obtain a spliced text to be processed, and inputting the spliced text to be processed into a target language model which is trained in advance for processing. The embodiment of the application designs and realizes a scheme that the first prompt information with any length is encoded into the second prompt information with fixed length, and the second prompt information is spliced with the text to be processed and then is subjected to language processing, so that the problem that the length of the prompt information is severely limited by the input maximum length of the pre-training language model is solved, and the language processing effect is improved.

title_en: Augmented reality task unloading method based on heuristic algorithm under edge-side collaborative environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to an augmented reality task unloading method based on heuristic algorithm under the edge-side collaborative environment, the invention divides the AR total task into a plurality of fine-grained subtasks at first, and confirms the size of each AR subtask; determining the environmental characteristics of the bottom layer of the edge server which influence the execution delay of the AR subtask; collecting 'feature-time delay' data, constructing a BN (boron nitride), and predicting the execution time delay of the AR subtask on the edge server; calculating the execution time delay of the AR subtask in the mobile terminal and the total time delay unloaded to the edge server; and coding each AR total task unloading scheme by using a PSO algorithm, and after the GA acceleration scheme is used for convergence, giving a scheme with the shortest total time delay as a final unloading scheme of the AR tasks. The invention can design a reasonable AR task unloading strategy, effectively reduce the total execution time delay of the AR task and more quickly return the interaction result of the user and the scene.

title_en: Scene synchronization method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a scene synchronization method and device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the following steps: responding to a scene synchronization instruction, and determining a target scene file to be synchronized in a preset scene manager and an update type of the target scene file; and executing the synchronization operation corresponding to the updating type on the target scene file, so that a preset cloud server finishes the synchronization of the target scene file. By applying the scene synchronization method provided by the invention, the synchronization operation can be executed on the target scene file to be synchronized in the scene manager, so that the cloud server can complete the synchronization of the target scene file, namely, the scene synchronization can be carried out under the condition that the scene file to be synchronized exists in the scene manager of the edge end, and the scene of the edge end and the scene of the cloud end can be kept consistent.

title_en: Automatic driving control method and system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic driving control method, an automatic driving control system and a storage medium, which comprise the steps of inputting a vehicle front image into a pre-trained image processing model for processing, outputting image gradient information, superposing disturbance quantity on the vehicle front image according to the image gradient information to obtain a disturbance sample, attacking a vehicle automatic driving model by using the disturbance sample, outputting the disturbance sample as a countermeasure sample if the attack is successful, performing countermeasure training on the vehicle automatic driving model by using the vehicle front image and the countermeasure sample, inputting the countermeasure sample into a vehicle automatic driving model after the countermeasure training, judging whether the sample input into the vehicle automatic driving model after the countermeasure training is the countermeasure sample by using a pre-trained judging model, if the sample input into the vehicle automatic driving model after the countermeasure training is the countermeasure sample, successfully defending, and using the vehicle automatic driving model after the countermeasure training for carrying out image identification on the vehicle front image to output an identification result, thereby improving the safety of an automatic driving automobile.

title_en: Power grid redundant data elimination method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid informatization, in particular to a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for removing redundant data of a power grid, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring power grid data to be processed, wherein the power grid data to be processed comprises at least one of high-voltage side current and low-voltage side current of a power grid, short-circuit loss, short-circuit voltage percentage, no-load loss and no-load current percentage data of the power grid; carrying out dimensionality reduction on the power grid data to be processed to obtain a power grid working data feature vector; carrying out word frequency statistics on the power grid working data characteristic vector to obtain a word frequency matrix of the power grid working data characteristic vector; performing theme analysis on the word frequency matrix to obtain theme probability distribution; and redundant data in the power grid data to be processed are removed through the topic probability distribution, so that the redundant data in the power grid data to be processed are accurately and quickly removed through the word frequency statistics and the topic analysis of the power grid data to be processed, and the informatization and intelligentization degree of the power grid is further improved.

title_en: Vehicle intelligent scene interaction system and method, electronic equipment and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vehicle scene intelligent interaction, in particular to a vehicle intelligent scene interaction system, a vehicle intelligent scene interaction method, electronic equipment and a vehicle; the system comprises an information collection module, a data processing module, a scene analysis module, a scene model matching module and a scene model matching module, wherein the information collection module collects information of a user and a vehicle, the data processing module integrates the information data, the scene analysis module judges whether the integrated information data can be matched with scene model data or not through analysis, the matched scene model is pushed to the user, if the matched scene model is not obtained, the scene model is newly built in an interactive system, in the scheme, data capture is carried out on condition information inside and outside the vehicle, analysis matching comparison is carried out according to the captured data and the scene model preset in the system, and the scene model is switched into the corresponding scene model. If the corresponding scene mode is not matched, the user can select to directly create the scene mode, the problem that the scene mode cannot be newly added is solved, the actual use condition of the vehicle can be better met, the practicability is high, and the application range is wide.

title_en: Material determination method, system and related equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a material determining method, a material determining system and related equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of matching retrieval information with material information in a category mapping table to obtain a target category identifier; and acquiring material evaluation information according to the selected material information, wherein the material evaluation information is used for selecting target materials from the selected materials. According to the method and the device, the object category identification is conveniently and correspondingly found according to the category mapping table, so that the material evaluation information for selecting the object material can be obtained effectively, and the searching progress of the object material is quickened. According to the target category identification, the material information of different supply sources can be pertinently aggregated, the information of each supply source is saved to be searched, the workload of each search result is integrated, the object searching time of supply chain service is reduced, and the operation is flexible and the universality is strong.

title_en: Corrugated base paper production progress data monitoring method and system based on digital factory
abstract_en: According to the corrugated base paper production progress data monitoring method and system based on the digital factory, the comparison result of the production monitoring data to be processed after processing and the sample production monitoring data to be processed after processing is located in the configured comparison result interval, and the problem that the noise comparison result of the production monitoring data to be processed and the sample production monitoring data is unstable is solved. And projecting the processed sample production monitoring data and the processed production monitoring data to be processed, and then performing progress monitoring processing on the processed production monitoring data to be processed by using one or a plurality of projected sample production monitoring data to generate a target progress monitoring result corresponding to the processed production monitoring data to be processed. Therefore, the method and the device can accurately and reliably obtain the production monitoring data, ensure the normal operation of production equipment, and improve the production efficiency of the corrugated base paper.

title_en: Network security theory race management system and method in answering mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network security theory race management system and method in a quiz mode. The system comprises an administrator terminal for managing theoretical competition information and configuring a response rule, a host terminal for switching questions and allowing response control, a player terminal for response of contestants and a background server terminal for storing relevant information and scoring. The background server combines Redis TTL and Redis INCR technologies to carry out answering time and determine answering titles, answer scores of contestants are determined according to score percentages of the titles set by the answering rules, and the host end can display the answering conditions. The invention changes the traditional theoretical game mode, increases the host end to control the game progress, has strong system configuration capability, can integrate factors such as response speed and the like into the game score, improves the interactivity and the interestingness of the theoretical game, and is beneficial to selecting players with strong comprehensive strength.

title_en: Video motion segmentation and recognition method based on frame sequence order perceptual coding
abstract_en: The invention discloses a video motion segmentation and identification method based on frame sequence sequential perception coding, which comprises the steps of extracting feature vectors of a given video, coding the feature vectors to obtain motion features of the given video, carrying out coding matrix learning based on the motion features of the given video to obtain a coding matrix of the given video, constructing an affinity graph based on the coding matrix of the given video, and completing motion segmentation of the given video based on the affinity graph to obtain motion segments of the given video. The identification method comprises the steps of dividing the video to be identified into a plurality of action fragments based on the dividing method, inputting the characteristics of each action fragment into a pre-trained classifier, and distributing action labels according to the probability of the category to which each action fragment belongs. The method and the device can not only fully encode the motion characteristics and frame sequence information of the video, but also accurately segment the action fragments and identify the categories thereof by overcoming the influence of noise in the video.

title_en: Basic-level data management method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a basic level data management method and device, the method comprises the steps of obtaining a data query request of a field to be queried, enabling the field to be queried to be related to information of a behavior main body, enabling the behavior main body to be related to users, enterprises and social organizations, invoking a query interface, retrieving basic level associated data of content of the field to be queried in a basic level data management relationship graph, matching the field to be queried in a standard field dictionary to determine an associated relationship of the field to be queried for the behavior main body, enabling the standard field dictionary to comprise a plurality of standard field names of the basic level data management relationship graph and associated relationships of each standard field name, enabling the associated relationship to represent the degree that the field to be queried can identify the behavior main body, determining the confidence of the basic level associated data according to the associated relationship, enabling the confidence of the basic level associated data to be higher, and displaying the basic level associated data and the confidence in a front-end user interface. And the data management efficiency of the base layer is improved.

title_en: Multi-channel time reversal pulse compression power synthesis method
abstract_en: A multi-channel time reversal pulse compression power synthesis method comprises the steps of 1, constructing a multi-port time reversal cavity system; step 2, initial signal s is processed  ori  (t) injecting the signals into the time reversal system through an initial port, and respectively obtaining response signals s at other response ports  res,i  (t), wherein t and i represent time and corresponding port, respectively; step 3, all response signals s  res,i  (t) time reversal to s  res,i  (-t) and is denoted as the inversion signal s  rev,i  (t)＝s  res,i  (-t); step 4, adjusting inversion signal s  rev,i  (t) time delay, and inverting all the signals s  rev,i  (t) injecting or radiating into the time-reversal system along the corresponding port, peak power synthesis for pulse compression can be generated at the initial port; the pulse peak power is improved; utensil for cleaning buttockThe radiation source has the characteristics of simple structure, small volume, light weight, easy realization and capability of generating high-power radiation.

title_en: Design method and system for power device layout
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device and a storage medium for designing a power device layout, wherein the method comprises the following steps: selecting a process design file in a layout design interface of a power device, and establishing a standard cell library of the process design file; establishing a top-level design window in the standard unit library; wherein the top level design window comprises at least two design regions; obtaining a design rule of any subunit of a power device, and generating a subunit layout in any design area corresponding to any subunit according to the design rule; synthesizing all the subunit layouts generated in at least two design areas into a complete power device layout; and deriving the power device layout. The method and the device can reduce manual intervention on power device layout design, avoid various errors possibly generated by manually designing the power device layout, and improve the efficiency and the design freedom of the power device layout design.

title_en: Method and system for generating plant process layer physical loop diagram
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for generating a plant process layer physical loop diagram, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a device list and a physical loop list which are matched with the type of a process layer physical loop diagram to be constructed, and establishing a one-to-one corresponding relation between the device list and the physical loop list to form a process layer network model; determining a local layout type according to the type of the switch in the device list, calculating the length of the switch, the port and the relative coordinates of the device, and generating a local canvas; calculating relative coordinates among the local canvas to obtain global relative coordinates of each primitive to form a global canvas; calculating inflection point coordinates of the connecting lines according to relative coordinates of ports at two ends of the connecting lines among the switches in the overall canvas to form path information of the connecting lines; and automatically laying out the primitives according to the coordinates and path information of the primitives and the connecting lines to form a process layer physical loop diagram. The invention can effectively improve the operation and maintenance bearing capacity of the system and reduce the time investment of operation and maintenance personnel.

title_en: Protocol stack simulation method of Wi-Fi distributed coordination function DCF
abstract_en: The invention discloses a protocol stack simulation method of a Wi-Fi distributed coordination function DCF, wherein the distributed coordination function DCF is a Wi-Fi channel random access method, and based on shared memory and signal quantity, channel competition is simulated through a software lock; the inter-process shared memory of the Linux platform is used as the data bearing of the wireless channel, the data transmission process on the channel is converted into the writing operation of the shared memory, the data receiving process on the channel is converted into the reading operation of the shared memory, and further the DCF channel preemption and the data transmission process between network elements are simulated, so that the simulation of the basic mode and the request transmission/permission transmission mode of the DCF is realized. The method decouples the software running environment from the chip hardware, reduces the purchase quantity of the hardware simulation platform, and saves the research and development cost of the chip; the debugging and optimizing work of the software is greatly advanced, and the aim of shortening the research and development period of the chip product is finally realized.

title_en: Accelerated degradation test data processing method and device based on wiener process
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a device for processing accelerated degradation test data based on a wiener process, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining accelerated degradation test data of a product to be tested, screening a target time reduced model from a preset time reduced model set according to the accelerated degradation test data, constructing a nonlinear wiener degradation process based on the target time reduced model, determining a product reliability function of the product to be tested, testing the reliability of the product to be tested according to the product reliability function, and obtaining a product reliability test result of the product to be tested. According to the scheme, a nonlinear wiener process is constructed based on the screened target time reduced model, and nonlinearity of performance degradation is considered; and based on the nonlinear wiener process, determining a product reliability function, and utilizing the product reliability function to realize accurate test of the reliability of the product to be tested. In conclusion, the method can realize accurate product reliability test.

title_en: Immediate migration of load store and atomic instructions
abstract_en: One embodiment provides a graphics processor comprising processing resources including a register file, memory, cache memory, and load/store/cache circuitry to process load, store, and prefetch messages from the processing resources. The circuitry includes support for an immediate address offset to be used to adjust an address provided for a memory access requested by the circuitry. Including support for immediate address offsets eliminates the need to execute additional instructions to adjust the address to be accessed prior to executing the memory access instruction.

title_en: Code similarity detection method and device and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a method, an apparatus and a storage medium for code similarity detection. The code similarity detection method comprises the following steps: respectively carrying out structure analysis on the code to be detected and the first comparison code to obtain a structure class diagram; calculating the similarity between the code structure class diagram to be detected and the first comparison code structure class diagram; under the condition that the similarity is smaller than or equal to a first threshold value, judging that the code structures are similar, calculating the distribution proportion between the terms of the code to be detected and the terms of the second comparison code, and arranging the distribution proportions according to the sequence from big to small to obtain a first feature vector; calculating the occurrence frequency weight of the code entry to be detected to obtain a second feature vector; obtaining an intersection of the first feature vector and the second feature vector to obtain a final feature vector; and calculating cosine similarity according to the final feature vector and the entry vector of the first comparison code, and comparing the cosine similarity with a second threshold value to judge whether plagiarism exists or not.

title_en: Medical data desensitization method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data processing, and discloses a medical data desensitizing method and a system, wherein the medical data desensitizing method comprises the following steps: classifying the acquired medical data into text data and non-text data; extracting keywords in text data, retaining original texts of non-keywords, and taking the extracted keywords and the non-text data as data to be desensitized; classifying the data to be desensitized into personal identity information, personal medical information, date information, address information and other information; and desensitizing the classified information. The medical data desensitization system includes: the system comprises a data classification module, a sensitive word extraction module, a field classification module and a data desensitization module. The medical data desensitization method and the system provided by the invention can complete full-automatic desensitization of the medical data, and a user only needs to input medical fields contained in the medical data; desensitization may be performed with respect to the multiplexed medical data.

title_en: High-order rigid-flexible coupling dynamic simulation model based on grid-free method rotation FGM beam in temperature field, and establishing method and simulation method thereof
abstract_en: The scheme relates to a high-order rigid-flexible coupling dynamic simulation model of a rotary FGM beam based on a meshless method in a temperature field, and an establishing method and a simulation method thereof, wherein the simulation model comprises the following steps: describing a displacement field which is deformed by large-range rotary motion of any point on an FGM beam in an FGM beam system with additional concentrated mass in a floating coordinate system by adopting a mixed coordinate method; taking into account a nonlinear coupling high-order term generated by the transverse deformation of the FGM beam, and adopting a non-grid point interpolation method and a non-grid radial base point interpolation method to disperse the large-range rotary deformation of the FGM beam; establishing an FGM beam high-order rigid-flexible coupling kinetic equation with additional concentrated mass in a temperature field; and solving the FGM beam high-order rigid-flexible coupling dynamic simulation model with the additional concentrated mass under the temperature field by adopting a Newmark method to obtain a deformation schematic diagram of the FGM beam with the additional concentrated mass and large-range rotary motion. The simulation model and the simulation method have the advantages of high efficiency and high precision.

title_en: Remote sensing image defogging method based on transmissivity refinement
abstract_en: The invention provides a remote sensing image defogging method based on transmissivity refinement, which is used for solving the problems of inaccurate estimation of transmissivity in a remote sensing image and low defogging quality of the remote sensing image; and the problem of low contrast of the remote sensing image after defogging. The method comprises the following implementation steps: calculating an atmospheric intensity value of the foggy remote sensing image; obtaining a Gaussian weighted dark channel image of the foggy remote sensing image by using a Gaussian weighted algorithm; calculating the thinning transmissivity of the foggy remote sensing image; and defogging the foggy remote sensing image according to the atmospheric intensity value and the refined transmissivity to obtain a defogged image. The invention overcomes the problem of inaccurate transmissivity calculation in the prior art, can carry out high-quality defogging on the foggy images including the remote sensing images, can improve the contrast of the images after defogging and increase the detail information of the images.

title_en: Infant food nutrition analysis method and system based on spectral reconstruction and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and a storage medium for infant food nutrition analysis based on spectral reconstruction, wherein when the infant food nutrition analysis is carried out, an acquired low-dimensional spectral image is reconstructed into a high-dimensional spectral image through a constructed spectral reconstruction model, so that richer food spectral information can be obtained; then, the nutrition analysis of the infant food can be realized based on the high-dimensional spectral image; therefore, the method for reconstructing the low-dimensional spectrum into the high-dimensional spectrum is adopted for nutrition analysis, compared with the traditional method for nutrition analysis based on the low-dimensional spectrum and the visual technology, the method has high accuracy of analysis results, and a commercial spectrometer is not needed for obtaining initial spectrum data, so that the cost is greatly reduced, and the method is suitable for daily living environments; in addition, the spectral reconstruction model constructed by the method is provided with the denoising network, so that accurate spectral reconstruction with good generalization can be realized, and the accuracy of nutritional analysis is further improved.

title_en: Medical test tube specimen scanning and automatic numbering device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical test tube sample scanning and automatic numbering device in the technical field of medical equipment, which comprises a rack and a bar code identification device, wherein a test tube loading mechanism, a test tube transferring mechanism, a test tube identification mechanism, the bar code identification device and a test tube numbering mechanism are sequentially arranged on the surface of the rack.

title_en: Quality control method and device for clinical detection sample, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a quality control method, a quality control device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for a clinical detection sample, and belongs to the technical field of high-throughput sequencing technology. The quality control method of the clinical detection sample comprises the steps of performing quality control filtering on an original FASTQ data file to obtain a target FASTQ data file, comparing the target FASTQ data file with a reference genome sequence file to obtain a BAM file, determining comparison rate, rRNA content and globin RNA content according to the BAM file, performing sequencing depth detection on the BAM file to obtain a gene 3 'end sequencing depth and a gene 5' end sequencing depth, performing consistency inspection on a plurality of sequencing data obtained by performing a plurality of sequencing strategies on the clinical detection sample to obtain a consistency inspection result, and comprehensively judging whether the clinical detection sample is qualified. The application can accurately detect the quality of the clinical detection sample and improve the effectiveness of the data.

title_en: ATT and CK-based APT attack modeling method for power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ATT and CK-based power system APT attack modeling method, which comprises the following steps: analyzing the attack target and determining to use an attack means; preparing for attack according to the determined attack means and characteristics of the victim, developing a corresponding program, and implanting the malicious program into a system; according to the invention, through modeling and analyzing the APT, security technicians can be helped to understand attack processes, identify vulnerable nodes in a network system, extract information, analyze threat information, hunt threat, trace source attack and the like, so that security risks can be dynamically and integrally known on the basis of environment, the discovery, identification, understanding, analysis and response handling capabilities of security threats are improved from a global perspective, and the security situation perception capability of a network space is improved.

title_en: LOD file asset generation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for generating LOD file assets, and relates to the technical field of scene rendering, wherein the method comprises the steps of loading a model file corresponding to a target object model in a game, obtaining material path information of the target object model, and determining a plurality of model areas corresponding to the target object model based on the material path information; the method comprises the steps of carrying out material combination on a plurality of model areas to obtain combined material areas, carrying out mapping baking treatment on the combined material areas to obtain a target mapping, carrying out wiring reconstruction on a target object model to obtain a grid model after face reduction, and generating LOD file assets corresponding to the target object model based on the target mapping and the grid model. The application can reduce the times of drawing calls (Draw calls) during rendering, further reduce the time consumption and the occupancy rate of the GPU during rendering, and simultaneously improve the efficiency of model rendering.

title_en: Method and system for generating target source file of user interface
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of generating a target source file of a user interface, in particular to a method and a system for generating the target source file of the user interface, which are realized by acquiring a generated header file h  0  Identifying h from regular expressions  0  The three sentences are respectively stored in different containers; traversing corresponding sentences in each container, and respectively replacing first type elements of the first type sentences with first type target elements to obtain updated first type sentences; replacing class names in the second sentence and the third sentence with target class names and replacing object pointer names with target object pointer names respectively to obtain updated second and third sentences; recombining the updated first, second and third sentences into a target source file to achieve the goal of recombining the header file h  0  The purpose of automatically generating the target source file can not only accelerate development progress, but also reduce errors of manual writing, and secondary development can be reused.

title_en: Method and device for constructing knowledge graph in field of intelligent careless care
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for constructing a knowledge graph in the field of intellectual disability, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical care data of the intelligent-losing personnel, and extracting initial data of the knowledge graph nodes from the historical care data based on preset knowledge graph nodes; preprocessing the initial data to obtain target data of the nodes of the knowledge graph; determining a first association relation between the nodes of the knowledge graph based on a first preset rule; determining a second incidence relation between each knowledge graph node based on a second preset rule and the first incidence relation; and obtaining an intelligent care knowledge graph according to the target data and the second incidence relation. According to the method, the historical care data of the mentally disabled person is obtained, and the mentally disabled care knowledge graph is constructed and obtained by combining the preset rule, so that the efficiency of obtaining the care scheme by the caregivers according to the mentally disabled care knowledge graph is improved.

title_en: Data flashback inquiry or flashback recovery method based on multi-version timestamp sorting mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data flash query or flash recovery method based on a multi-version timestamp sorting mechanism, which belongs to the field of backup and recovery of a distributed database, and comprises the steps of respectively storing metadata and user data in the distributed database into a database storage module; and when any one of the metadata and the user data is changed by a transaction entering the distributed database, storing the changed data and the timestamp associated with the current transaction into the database storage module. By adopting a mode of separately storing metadata and user data in the storage module, the management of historical data is simplified, and an operation log does not need to occupy extra space for storage; historical data is periodically cleared by setting an effective time range, effective management of historical versions is realized, meanwhile, the space occupation of data storage is reduced, and multiple flashback queries of multiple data table objects can be carried out by specifying an ASOF timestamp once through an explicit transaction.

title_en: Data display method for drainage basin cascade power station monitoring system database
abstract_en: The invention provides a data display method of a drainage basin cascade power station monitoring system database, which comprises the following steps: according to the object tree dictionary, object tree structures corresponding to all levels of power stations are constructed; expanding each node of an object tree structure corresponding to each stage of power station, and numbering and naming each node; numbering the object tree structures of all the power stations according to the distribution positions of all the power stations of the cascade power stations in a drainage basin; configuring the operation data of each stage of power station in each node of the corresponding object tree structure; receiving a query request of a user, wherein the query request comprises a number combination; and sequentially expanding each node which corresponds to the object tree and accords with the number combination according to the number combination, and displaying the operation data configured by the final node. The technical problem that the operation data is inconvenient to inquire and monitor when the cascade power station is operated in a centralized control way.

title_en: Farm management method and computer program product
abstract_en: The application provides a management method of a farm and a computer program product, wherein the management method of the farm comprises the following steps: acquiring breeding data of a breeding object; determining at least one index parameter by using a preset rule based on the breeding data of the breeding objects, wherein the index parameter is used for representing annual reproduction information, abortion information, participation information, conception information or ratio information of the non-pregnant objects; and displaying the index parameters in a display page. According to the management method of the farm, the preset rules can be utilized to automatically analyze and process the breeding data, index parameters under different dimensions are generated, the real-time situation of the farm is visually displayed under the different dimensions, and therefore managers can quickly locate and solve problems, and automatic management of the farm is achieved.

title_en: Terminal battery transportation power-saving shutdown mode control method and device and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a terminal battery transportation power-saving shutdown mode control method, a device and a storage medium. The terminal battery transportation power-saving shutdown mode control method comprises the following steps: setting the label type of a shutdown mode control label as a first label type in response to monitoring a trigger instruction for triggering a terminal battery to enter a transportation power-saving shutdown mode; in response to monitoring a shutdown instruction, detecting a tag type of a shutdown mode control tag; and if the label type of the shutdown mode control label is detected to be the first label type, controlling the terminal battery to enter a transportation power-saving shutdown mode. According to the method and the device, the terminal battery can be controlled to enter the transportation power-saving shutdown mode under the condition that the terminal receives the shutdown instruction and detects the first label type.

title_en: Neural network model optimization method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a neural network model optimization method and device, relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and is used for improving the calculation performance of a neural network model and reducing the time for executing calculation tasks. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a first calculation map of a neural network model, generating a second calculation map according to a preset rule and the first calculation map, wherein the time for calculating the input data by the second calculation map is shorter than the time for calculating the input data by the first calculation map according to the same input data, and the preset rule comprises at least one of a mathematical splitting rule, an instruction fusion rule, an instruction splitting rule and a hardware fusion rule, and outputting the second calculation map. In this way, the first computational graph of the neural network model is optimized to a second computational graph with stronger computational performance and less computation time required to perform the computational task. Therefore, the calculation speed of the neural network model when executing the calculation task is improved, and the time for executing the calculation task is reduced.

title_en: Algorithm authorization method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an algorithm authorization method, a device, equipment and a medium, the method detects whether a first authorization mode of a slave chip is the same as a second authorization mode currently selected by a master chip or not during algorithm authorization, if not, the first authorization mode of the slave chip is switched to be the same as the master chip, authorization verification is carried out on an algorithm to be authorized by obtaining verification information corresponding to the second authorization mode of the master chip, and then authorization is carried out on the algorithm to be authorized by adopting the second authorization mode according to a verification result. In the process, the slave chip can adapt to the authorization mode of the master chip, so that the slave chip can support dynamic switching of various authorization modes, and stable operation of the algorithm is further ensured.

title_en: Report generation method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: In the report generation method, after an industry report cloning request is acquired, the industry report cloning request is analyzed, industry data corresponding to the identification of the industry to be cloned is acquired, then the industry data is cloned to generate an industry analysis template, further user data is acquired, finally an industry analysis report conforming to the industry analysis template is generated according to the user data, therefore, cloning of static data, logical relations, report configuration and the like can be completed through analyzing the realization logic of each report based on the industry, and the dependency relations among the reports, a large number of preset industry reports with the logical relations can be customized at one time, and the organization structure and the logical relations among the reports can be reproduced.

title_en: Memory operation method, memory and memory system
abstract_en: The application discloses a memory operation method, a memory and a memory system. The operation method comprises the steps of obtaining first operation data customized for the peripheral circuit in a first scene, configuring the peripheral circuit based on the first operation data, wherein the first scene is different from a default scene configured for the peripheral circuit in initialization configuration, and enabling the performance of the memory to meet the requirements in the first scene.

title_en: Management system of object-oriented database based on BS architecture
