abstract_en: The invention discloses a management system of an object-oriented database based on a BS architecture, which logically comprises three layers: the presentation layer is responsible for man-machine interaction, transmits instructions to the logic layer, receives data of the data layer and feeds back the data to a user; the logic layer is an application program on the remote server and is responsible for processing instructions transmitted by a user and simultaneously carrying out operation and backup management on data; the data layer is the storage of the original database data and is mainly stored on the hardware of the client. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages that: the invention is based on B/S architecture development, is divided into three layers of a data layer, a logic layer and a presentation layer, aims to process data which is closer to the actual situation, can rapidly produce data through inheritance relations among a plurality of classes, can further process stored data by a user-defined method, simplifies user operation steps and learning cost, and can process data types such as images, hypertext, sound and the like.

title_en: Hydraulic frame identification positioning method based on Hough transformation
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydraulic vehicle frame identification positioning method based on Hough transformation, which relates to the technical field of image-based object identification, and comprises the following steps: acquiring an original image of the hydraulic frame, and preprocessing the original image; extracting edges of the original image to obtain an edge image, and detecting straight lines in the edge image based on Hough transformation; performing repeated screening and extension operation on the straight line detected in the edge image; designating grouping rules for the prolonged straight lines, grouping every two straight lines so that each group is two straight lines of the same hydraulic frame, and solving the intersection point coordinates of the two straight lines; and acquiring the pixel coordinates of the central point of the hydraulic frame according to the coordinates of the intersection point and the size of the hydraulic frame, and completing the positioning of the hydraulic frame. The invention overcomes the complex environment of the production site, overcomes the self adverse conditions of illumination, uneven color and the like of the hydraulic frame, improves the accuracy of the identification of the hydraulic frame and achieves the accurate positioning of the center point of the hydraulic frame.

title_en: Low-resolution target detection method, system and device based on MCU
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-resolution target detection method, a system and a device based on MCU, which belong to the technical field of computer vision and neural network, and the implementation process of the method is as follows: using a low resolution image sensor for data acquisition; model construction and training: constructing a target detection model by using a common convolution, a depth separable convolution and a YOLOv5 detection head, and performing model training and a background subtraction algorithm by using the acquired data; compressing a trained model, performing channel pruning according to BN layer weight parameters in the model, and performing fine tuning on the pruned model to ensure the accuracy of the model; then carrying out quantization after training, and converting the weight and the activation value of the model into the type int8 from FP 32; then calibrating the model accuracy by the calibration data set; and deploying the compressed model to an MCU for target detection. The invention has simple deployment and can reduce the power consumption and the use cost.

title_en: Deep learning-based Internet of vehicles data modeling method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a vehicle networking data modeling method and system based on deep learning, comprising the following steps: carrying out data preprocessing on the Internet of vehicles data, and importing the processed data into a database; clustering the processed internet of vehicles data by using a clustering optimization algorithm to obtain data characteristics; establishing a reference model according to the data characteristics, and performing unsupervised training on the reference model; mining and analyzing the data characteristics by using the reference model to generate association rules; according to the method, the required data characteristics are accurately and effectively extracted from the multidimensional internet of vehicles data through the data preprocessing technology and the clustering technology, and further, the automatic analysis of the internet of vehicles data is realized by establishing the reference model and combining the data mining technology, so that the intelligent level of a system is improved, and the data mining requirements of different data types of the internet of vehicles are met.

title_en: Engineering test data analysis management method and system based on blockchain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a block chain-based engineering test data analysis and management method and a block chain-based engineering test data analysis and management system, and relates to the field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when the sampling position data meets the source scene sampling area clustering result and the sampling time information meets the source scene sampling time zone clustering result, acquiring verification instruction information; the engineering test data management block chain is called, test detection backtracking data are output, and test detection data and test detection indexes are verified by combining a deviation verification rule, so that a deviation verification result is generated; and when the deviation checking result is a passing signal, the basic information of the checking batch is stored in the engineering test data management block chain in an encrypted mode. The technical problems that in the prior art, the management effect on engineering test data is poor, and the accuracy and the integrity of the engineering test data cannot be guaranteed are solved. The technical effects of improving the management quality of engineering test data and effectively guaranteeing the accuracy and the integrity of the engineering test data are achieved.

title_en: Power load prediction method, device, computer equipment and medium
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure disclose power load prediction methods, apparatus, computer devices, and media. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring operation related data of a target date; inputting the operation related data into a pre-trained power load prediction model to generate a power load predicted value, wherein a training sample set of the power load prediction model is obtained based on data similarity; transmitting the power load predicted value to a target device with a display function; and controlling the target device to display the power load predicted value. According to the method and the device for predicting the electric load, based on the operation related data, the electric load is accurately predicted by using the pre-trained electric load prediction model, convenience is provided for operators to know the operation condition of the device and overhaul the device, and the service life of the device is prolonged.

title_en: Method and device for removing fingers in image
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for removing fingers in an image. Step S1: acquiring a finger region from an input image by using a first neural network for image segmentation; if the first neural network acquires a finger area from the input picture, continuing to step S2; otherwise, the whole method is exited. Step S2: a second neural network for image harmony is employed to remove shadows around the finger in the image. Step S3: and filling the finger area in the picture with the text removed by using a third neural network for image restoration, namely removing the finger area in the picture. The invention can better remove the finger and the shadows around the finger in the image, thereby obtaining the image with higher readability and neater.

title_en: 3D point cloud target detection method and device based on weighted relation perception
abstract_en: The application provides a 3D point cloud target detection method and device based on weighted relation perception, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring original 3D point cloud data; processing the original 3D point cloud data by utilizing a PointNet++ network to obtain a plurality of seed points; processing a plurality of seed points by utilizing a shared voting model which is trained in advance to obtain a voting cluster comprising a plurality of votes; sampling and grouping the voting clusters to obtain a plurality of target candidates; updating the target candidate by using a weighting relation perception proposal generation model which is trained in advance to obtain an updated target candidate; processing the updated target candidates by using a multi-layer perceptron to obtain an object proposal; decoding the object proposal to obtain a target detection result. According to the method and the device, the accuracy of target detection of the 3D point cloud data can be improved.

title_en: Intelligent file cabinet based on multidimensional data processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent file cabinet based on multidimensional data processing, which is characterized by comprising a cabinet body and a plurality of wearable devices, wherein the wearable devices are used for carrying by staff, a plurality of accommodating cavities are arranged in the cabinet body, an electronic lock is arranged at an opening of each accommodating cavity, and a main control module, a page turning scanning module, a biological identification module and a wireless communication module are also arranged on the cabinet body; the intelligent file cabinet is configured with a file storage strategy, a file fetching strategy and an information query strategy. The file cabinet can judge the confidentiality degree of the file when the file is stored, and the judgment process is not interfered by artificial subjective factors; judging whether the file needs to be kept secret for the staff when the staff wants to take out the file, so that accurate management when the secret file is taken out is realized; and the superior leader can judge the development direction of staff using the file cabinet more comprehensively and accurately through the file cabinet.

title_en: Method for rapidly exploring quantitative trait genes of rice
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for rapidly exploring quantitative trait genes of rice, which comprises the following steps: carrying out whole genome association analysis and linkage analysis of each sub-population on the rice nest type combined mapping population, and exploring quantitative trait loci which can be identified by two methods at the same time; carrying out comprehensive analysis on the functions, variation and expression of candidate genes in the QTL locus; and (3) carrying out weighted scoring and sequencing on the number of keyword matching times specific to the target phenotype in the candidate gene annotation information, the influence of the candidate gene mutation site on the gene function, the expression quantity of the candidate gene in specific tissues and the like, and selecting the 3 genes with the highest scores as candidate genes of the target quantitative trait. The invention evaluates and screens the quantitative trait candidate genes discovered in the rice NAM group by developing a set of evaluation scoring system which can judge the function of the candidate genes according to the keywords and comprehensively judge the influence of the mutation on the gene functions, thereby greatly improving the efficiency of the quantitative trait gene discovery of the rice.

title_en: Method, device and equipment for detecting dependency relationship between components
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computers, in particular to a method, a device and equipment for detecting dependency relationship among components, which comprise the steps of judging whether a plurality of embedded components in a component to be developed comprise the same sub-component or not; if the same sub-assembly exists, the version range of the sub-assembly corresponding to each of the embedded assemblies is obtained; determining an intersection between the plurality of version ranges; and optionally selecting a component corresponding to the version number from the intersection as a sub-component to be updated, and updating the sub-components stored in the sub-component to be developed and corresponding to a plurality of embedded components with the same sub-component by using the sub-component to be updated. By the method, the problem that the sub-components updated by the components to be developed are not suitable for the corresponding embedded components is avoided, closed loop dependency detection among the components is realized, and the problem that the dependency detection of the closed loop among the components is difficult to form in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Image stitching method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an image stitching method, an image stitching device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method is applied to a multi-line laser imaging system, and an object to be imaged is placed between two parallel rows of calibration patterns. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of groups of images to be spliced; for any group of images to be spliced, determining actual coordinates of each calibration pattern in the gray level image, and calculating an affine matrix for transforming each actual coordinate to a corresponding ideal coordinate; transforming the height map and the gray map by using an affine matrix to obtain a first height map and a corrected gray map, and performing plane fitting according to the height information of each calibration pattern in the first height map to obtain a corrected plane; correcting the height information of each pixel point in the first height map by using a correction plane to obtain a corrected height map; and splicing the corrected images to be spliced to obtain the imaging of the object to be imaged. The method can quickly and accurately realize correction and splicing of the images to be spliced.

title_en: Software development display screen device
abstract_en: The invention provides a software development display screen device, which relates to the technical field of screen display and comprises a screen installation base box, wherein a screen placement groove is formed in the screen installation base box, two out-of-screen wiring recovery assemblies are arranged at the corners of the inner side of the screen placement groove, a junction box is fixedly arranged in the screen placement groove, a plurality of display screen connecting wires are electrically connected to the junction box, and a foam-rubber cushion is fixedly arranged in the middle of the inside of the screen placement groove.

title_en: Continuous-discontinuous numerical simulation method and device for rock material
abstract_en: The application relates to a continuous-discontinuous numerical simulation method and device for rock materials. The specific scheme is as follows: randomly generating a discrete fracture network DFN line on a cross section of the target rock material; performing discrete processing on the sectional view to obtain a plurality of triangular unit grids; determining whether a bonding breaking unit between every two adjacent triangle unit networks belongs to a DFN line or not based on network topology information of the triangle unit meshes so as to obtain a first result; assigning a first parameter value to the bond breaking unit in response to the bond breaking unit belonging to the DFN line; assigning a second parameter value to the bond breaking unit in response to the bond breaking unit not belonging to the DFN line; simulating the upper loading plate and the lower loading plate to press the target rock material, and respectively determining whether each bonding breaking unit is broken or not to obtain a second result; a rock material cracking simulation result graph is generated based on the first result and the second result. The method and the device can solve the problem of high research cost on rock mechanical behaviors.

title_en: Timing task arranging method, scheduling method, server and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a timing task arranging method, a scheduling method, a server and equipment, and relates to the technical field of computers. Aiming at a target service, acquiring a plurality of timing tasks related to the target service; determining the dependency relationship among the timing tasks according to the service logic of the target service; and arranging the timing tasks according to the dependency relationship among the timing tasks to obtain a scheduling framework of the target service. The invention digs the dependency relationship among the timing tasks, and arranges the timing tasks according to the dependency relationship to generate the scheduling frame, thereby optimizing the scheduling method of the timing tasks and improving the execution efficiency of the target service.

title_en: Data processing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a data processing method, apparatus, electronic device, and storage medium, where the method includes: acquiring target data to be processed; determining a data processing grade corresponding to the target data at the current moment according to a preset rule; the data processing grades are divided according to the data access heat; determining a data compression algorithm and/or a corresponding storage medium corresponding to the target data according to the data processing grade corresponding to the target data; and when the data processing grade of the target data is judged to be changed, carrying out compression processing on the target data according to a data compression algorithm corresponding to the changed data processing grade, and/or storing the target data into a storage medium corresponding to the changed data processing grade. According to the data processing method and device, through the division of the data processing grades, different data compression algorithms and storage media are adopted for different data processing grades, so that the data storage cost is reduced while the data processing stability is ensured.

title_en: Small multifunctional integrated subway intelligent inspection vehicle and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small multifunctional integrated intelligent subway inspection vehicle and a method, which belong to the technical field of subway operation and maintenance and comprise an inspection trolley body, wherein a power system is arranged at the lower part of the inspection trolley body, a detection device is arranged at the top of the power system, the detection device comprises a three-dimensional laser scanner and an infrared detector, the detection device is connected with a remote analysis processing system, the remote analysis processing system comprises an intelligent disease recognition system and a trolley motion analysis system, the intelligent disease recognition system is used for establishing and judging various intelligent disease recognition models, and the trolley motion analysis system is used for judging the real-time position of occurrence of diseases so as to realize real-time disease recognition, positioning, recording and analysis. The inspection vehicle can realize intelligent inspection, real-time analysis and synchronous maintenance, and solves the problems of low manual inspection efficiency, heavy intelligent inspection equipment and single function.

title_en: Inspection system of database
abstract_en: The application relates to a database inspection system, and relates to the technical field of database inspection. The system comprises an execution module and a data processing module; the task execution machine is used for receiving the inspection tasks assigned by the distributed task scheduling sub-module, and according to the inspection tasks, invoking inspection scripts in the data processing module, executing the inspection scripts to obtain inspection results; the execution module comprises at least two task execution machines and a distributed task scheduling sub-module; the distributed task scheduling sub-module is used for monitoring the execution state of the task executor and assigning the routing inspection task currently executed by any one task executor to the task executor with the execution state of normal operation under the condition that the execution state of any one task executor is faulty. The problem of extremely relying on a task execution machine to execute the inspection task on the database, so that the execution success rate of the inspection task is low is solved.

title_en: Three-dimensional face shape generation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a three-dimensional face shape generating method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the three-dimensional face shape generating method comprises the following steps: calculating a first 3DMM parameter corresponding to the input two-dimensional face image through a trained first parameter estimation network model; determining a rough three-dimensional face shape corresponding to the two-dimensional face image based on the first 3DMM parameter and a preset 3DMM model; according to the two-dimensional face image and the rough three-dimensional face shape, estimating a network model through the trained second parameters, and calculating a second 3DMM parameter corresponding to the two-dimensional face image; and determining a fine three-dimensional face shape corresponding to the two-dimensional face image based on the second 3DMM parameter and a preset 3DMM model. According to the method, the rough three-dimensional face shape of the input two-dimensional face image can be obtained through first 3DMM parameters predicted by the first parameter estimation network model, and then the fine three-dimensional face shape can be obtained through second 3DMM parameters predicted by the second parameter estimation network model according to the rough three-dimensional face shape.

title_en: Real-time face detection and recognition method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a real-time face detection and recognition method which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a face detection and recognition system, S2, training a face detection model, S3, constructing a query data set, S4, inputting all face images in the query data set into the trained face detection model to obtain feature images corresponding to each face image, S5, calculating fusion feature matrixes corresponding to each feature image, splicing the fusion feature matrixes corresponding to all face images to obtain a query matrix Q, S6, inputting a face image P to be detected into the trained face detection model to obtain a corresponding feature image, inputting the feature images P into the face detection model to obtain a corresponding fusion feature matrix Np, multiplying Np and Q to obtain a matrix P, comparing the maximum value in P with a threshold value, and further outputting a judgment result. The invention can effectively and quickly identify the human face, has small calculated amount and high calculation speed, and can simultaneously operate and detect a plurality of cameras.

title_en: Microbial genome reference database, construction method and application thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a microbial genome reference database, which is constructed according to a method comprising the following steps: (1) data acquisition; (2) data quality control; (3) constructing a representative genome collection; (4) genome screening; (5) constructing a reference set and (6) constructing a pan genome. The optimized microbial genome reference database combines the advantages of representing the fungus classification specificity and the sensitivity of all genomes, and ensures the accuracy of a final result on the premise of bearable computing resources.

title_en: Correction strategy effectiveness evaluation system based on BP neural network model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a correction strategy effectiveness evaluation system based on a BP neural network model, which comprises a correction strategy storage module, a task presentation module, a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a result feedback module and a cloud data module, wherein model training is carried out by utilizing the BP neural network by collecting self-made force data of community criminals before and after receiving a judicial correction strategy, the purpose of predicting self-made force results of the community criminals after receiving the correction is achieved, and the effectiveness of the correction strategy is judged by comparing the self-made forces of the community criminals before and after receiving the judicial correction, so that the correction strategy of the current community criminals is adjusted in real time according to the effectiveness results of different correction strategies in each region. The correction strategy provided by judicial is evaluated to effectively reduce the crime risk of the community criminal personnel, a reference basis is provided for the judicial staff to correct the community criminal personnel, and the risk of the community criminal personnel for crime is effectively reduced.

title_en: Correction mirror control method, device, equipment, storage medium and intelligent correction mirror
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of medical equipment, and particularly discloses a control method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and an intelligent correcting mirror, wherein a user three-dimensional model is generated according to user static joint data, after training action schematic data are displayed on an intelligent correcting mirror display, user action joint data when a user acts according to the display training action schematic data are collected, then the user action joint data are matched, the user three-dimensional model is driven to track and display the user action on the intelligent correcting mirror display, so that the user can determine whether the user action is collected by the intelligent correcting mirror or not during the action, and meanwhile, compared with a traditional method that the intelligent correcting mirror only displays user plane video, the action state of the user can be displayed more intuitively, so that the user can adjust the body state and the action of the user in a targeted manner, and a more accurate motion evaluation result of the user is obtained.

title_en: Processing method and related device for machine side content information in interactive works
abstract_en: The application provides a processing method and a related device of machine side content information in an interactive work, wherein the method comprises the following steps: and if the human eye gazing state is judged to be gazing at the display screen of the terminal equipment, determining that the type of the machine side output content information is a non-video type when the equipment type information is judged to be the intelligent watch, outputting the video type content to the user if the output time length of the non-video type content is longer than or equal to the longest output time length, otherwise outputting the non-video type content to the user, and outputting the non-video type content to the user if the human eye gazing state is judged not to be gazing at the display screen of the terminal equipment. Therefore, whether the video type content or the non-video type content is output to the user in an interaction manner with the terminal equipment is determined according to the equipment type, the eye gaze state and the output time of the non-video type content, and the method is beneficial to improving user experience and improving the reading interest of the user.

title_en: Lane line map generation method, device, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a lane line map generation method, a lane line map generation device, an electronic device and a storage medium, wherein the lane line map generation method comprises the following steps: acquiring an original image acquired by a vehicle-mounted camera; determining a corresponding mask image based on the original image, wherein the mask image comprises lane line attribute information; constructing a corresponding grid map based on the mask image; filling lane line attribute information into a grid map based on the mask image and internal and external parameters of the vehicle-mounted camera to obtain a filled grid map; and generating a local lane line map based on the filled grid map. According to the method and the device, the problem that the lane line map cannot be generated through the image information of the visual space in the prior art is solved, and the lane line map is generated according to the image information of the visual space.

title_en: Lane marking method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a lane marking method, a device, an electronic apparatus, and a storage medium, wherein the lane marking method, the device, the electronic apparatus, and the storage medium are configured to detect each frame of image in a plurality of frames of images by acquiring the plurality of frames of images and collecting pose data of the apparatus when each frame of image is collected, obtain lane points of each frame of image, obtain at least two sets of lane point cloud data of each frame of image based on the lane points of adjacent frames of image for the lane points of each frame of image, fuse the at least two sets of point cloud data, obtain fused point cloud of the lane lines of each frame of image, and obtain lane lines marked in each frame of image based on the fused point cloud of the lane lines of each frame of image. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device have the advantages that at least two groups of point clouds of the lane lines of each frame of image are fused, the fused point clouds of the lane lines of each frame of image are obtained, the lane lines which are missed to be detected can be repaired and the lane lines which are discarded to be detected in error can be repaired, the lane line detection accuracy is improved, and therefore the lane line marking effect is improved.

title_en: Shift register, gate driving circuit and display substrate
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a shift register, comprising: the voltage control circuit is coupled with the output control node; at least one drive output circuit, the drive output circuit comprising: the output transistor and the capacitor structure are arranged along a first direction, the output transistor is coupled with the capacitor structure through a first conductive wire extending along a second direction, and the first conductive wire is coupled with a signal output wire configured for driving the output circuit; the output transistor comprises a grid electrode, a first electrode and at least two second electrodes, the grid electrode of the output transistor is coupled with the output control node and the first voltage writing electrode of the capacitor structure, the first electrode of the output transistor is coupled with a clock signal line configured for driving the output circuit, and the second electrode of the output transistor is coupled with the first conductive line; a second conductive wire is arranged between the first conductive wire and the capacitor structure, and the first conductive wire is coupled with a second voltage writing pole of the capacitor structure through the second conductive wire.

title_en: FPGA with built-in interconnection module containing heterogeneous selector
abstract_en: The application discloses an FPGA with built-in interconnection modules comprising heterogeneous selectors, which relates to the FPGA technology, wherein the interconnection modules in the FPGA are not all internally provided with symmetrical selectors, but are provided with at least one built-in heterogeneous selector of the interconnection modules, and the heterogeneous selector comprises a first selection circuit and a second selection circuit, so that when an input signal is connected to interconnection input points of the interconnection modules and is fanned out to a plurality of interconnection output points, part of conduction paths are realized by the first selection circuit, part of conduction paths are realized by the second selection circuit, and the second selection circuit is not connected with a pull-up circuit, so that load requirements are hardly generated, and more fanout quantity can be realized by using a pull-down circuit with smaller driving capability, thereby reducing the occupied area and power consumption of the pull-down circuit and reducing the waste of the area and the power consumption.

title_en: Distributed real-time carbon flow calculation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distributed real-time carbon flow calculation method, and belongs to the technical field of low carbon of power systems. The technical proposal is as follows: the power grid tide and carbon bank data are corrected, tide data and equipment connection relation of each equipment in a power transmission network and a power distribution network are obtained in real time, and effective data are formed through analysis and correction and used for carbon stream calculation; the power network is decomposed, and the power network is decomposed into a main network and a sub-network system by combining the topological characteristics of the power network; and (3) calculating the distributed carbon flow, solving the carbon flow distribution of each subsystem capable of being solved independently based on the distributed calculation, taking the solved result as boundary data, solving the full-network initial edition carbon flow distribution result, and obtaining the carbon row data of each node and each branch. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the power grid system is divided into a plurality of subsystems according to the specific grid topology, and the carbon flow value of each subsystem is calculated in a distributed mode, so that the power grid carbon flow calculation efficiency is improved, and the real-time performance of carbon flow calculation is ensured.

title_en: Community equipment facility safe operation risk monitoring and prevention and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for monitoring and preventing and controlling the risk of safety operation of community equipment facilities, which comprises the steps of firstly, carrying out risk assessment on community equipment, determining the risk level distribution of the space of the community equipment, and carrying out optimized layout of equipment monitoring sensors on the basis; hierarchical monitoring is carried out on facility equipment and space with different risk levels, the risk of community facility equipment is divided according to the monitoring result by the system, and the position and the level of the risk are calculated and positioned, and the development situation of the risk is analyzed; issuing a risk map and early warning information to related departments according to the accident information; generating an emergency auxiliary decision plan, and displaying risk related dynamic information of community equipment and facilities, wherein the risk related dynamic information comprises risk distribution, risk thermodynamic diagram, risk radar and early warning information. The method can realize real-time monitoring, automatic alarm, active fault tolerance and risk prevention and control of the running risk of equipment and facilities.

title_en: Quantitative evaluation method for primary frequency modulation capability of large power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of large power grid frequency safety, and provides a quantization evaluation method for primary frequency modulation capability of a large power grid, which comprises the steps of firstly identifying transfer function parameters of a primary frequency modulation system model of the power grid by adopting a particle swarm optimization algorithm based on measured disturbance data; then calculating the actual difference adjustment rate of each generator set according to the set frequency modulation test data in the primary frequency modulation checking system, correcting the equivalent primary frequency modulation coefficient of the power grid by a weighted aggregation method, and combining the transfer function of primary frequency modulation to obtain a corrected primary frequency modulation system model; and finally, carrying out Laplace inverse transformation on the corrected primary frequency modulation system model to obtain a primary frequency modulation time domain expression of the power grid, and calculating the overall dynamic and steady primary frequency modulation capacity of the power grid by combining the power flow section data and the starting mode of the generator set. The method can evaluate the primary frequency modulation capability of the power grid on line under different running modes of the power grid so as to ensure that the power grid has enough primary frequency modulation capability under the continuously changing load demands.

title_en: Signal amplifying circuit, touch chip and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a signal amplifying circuit, a touch chip and electronic equipment. The signal amplifying circuit is applied to a touch screen including a plurality of detection electrodes. The signal amplifying circuit includes: a plurality of sense operational amplifiers and a feedback circuit. The first input end of the detection operational amplifier is connected with the corresponding detection electrode, the second input end of the detection operational amplifier is connected with the common mode voltage, the first output end of the detection operational amplifier outputs a first amplified signal, and the second output end of the detection operational amplifier outputs a second amplified signal. The feedback circuit generates a feedback signal according to the first amplified signals and the second amplified signals of the plurality of detection operational amplifiers and provides the feedback signal to the first input terminal of the detection operational amplifiers. The feedback circuit reduces the effect of noise on the signal amplification circuit.

title_en: Orthogonal unbalance compensation method, system, device and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an orthogonal unbalance compensation method, a system, a device and a medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the direct current residual term of the quadrature demodulation signal received by the distributed acoustic sensing system is eliminated by a method of solving the mean value of the envelope; parameter estimation is carried out by tracking the cyclic symmetry of the orthogonal demodulation signal, so as to obtain constraint conditions; wherein the constraint condition is obtained based on a regularization principle; and carrying out quadrature imbalance correction by an adaptive filtering mode according to constraint conditions. Firstly, eliminating direct current residual items by a method of solving an envelope mean value, and reducing the interference of the residual items; and further, through parameter estimation and constraint condition acquisition, the orthogonal unbalance correction is performed in an adaptive filtering mode, so that the problem of orthogonal unbalance is solved, and is converted into the problem of adaptive filtering, the noise problem caused by hardware defects is effectively restrained, the orthogonal unbalance compensation is effectively realized, and the method can be widely applied to the technical field of signal noise reduction.

title_en: Geological prediction model construction method, modeling method, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction method of a map deep learning geological prediction model, which comprises the following steps: s1, constructing a sample data set, and carrying out graph structuring processing on the sample data set to form a geological node graph structural grid as a training data set; s2, constructing a graph deep learning geological prediction model based on a GNN-transporter model, wherein the graph deep learning geological prediction model comprises a GNN module, a transporter geological element graph global feature extraction module and a fully-connected classification mapping module which are sequentially connected, the GNN module generates embedded vectors for all graph nodes, and the transporter geological element graph global feature extraction module is used for further encoding the embedded vectors output by the GNN module; s3, a loss function is set, a map deep learning geological prediction model is trained, spatial correlation among geological nodes is intuitively constructed through a map structure, spatial relations of neighbor geological nodes are represented through GNN aggregation, a transform module is used for effectively excavating a spatial distribution mode of geological elements, and local and global spatial correlation of the geological elements can be considered.

title_en: Multi-domain content recommendation method and system integrating novelty
abstract_en: The application provides a multi-domain content recommendation method and system integrating novelty, which are based on BiasSVD model optimization and decomposition of a user item scoring matrix, addition of a novelty factor prediction user scoring matrix, alleviation of the problem that recommendation effect is not ideal and the like caused by data sparseness in a traditional model, calculation of similarity based on user characteristic information, solving of the problem that a traditional recommendation algorithm excessively depends on historical data to cause cold start, enabling recommendation results to be closer to real scores, improving recommendation accuracy, introduction of a novelty relation among users, and improvement of novelty of recommendation results of the traditional collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm. The method disclosed by the application can be used for relieving the problem of sparse scoring data, and improving the novelty of the recommended result, so that the recommended result is not too single, thereby causing aesthetic fatigue of a user.

title_en: Information processing method, apparatus, electronic device, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an information processing method, an information processing device, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium; the related embodiments can be applied to various scenes such as cloud technology, artificial intelligence, intelligent transportation, auxiliary driving and the like. According to the method, after interaction information to be processed is obtained, interaction objects participating in interaction are extracted from the interaction information to be processed, after an interaction object set is obtained, target interaction information of each interaction object in the interaction object set is respectively screened out from a preset interaction information set, interaction characteristics of the interaction objects are extracted from the target interaction information, then the interaction characteristics are converted into time sequence characteristics, then the time sequence characteristics are fused to obtain target time sequence characteristics corresponding to the interaction information to be processed, and then target information of the interaction information to be processed is determined according to the target time sequence characteristics; the scheme can improve the accuracy of information processing.

title_en: Research and development efficiency prediction method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a research and development efficiency prediction method, a device, equipment and a medium, which relate to the technical field of computers and comprise the following steps: acquiring an original characteristic value of research and development efficiency; determining an original feature set based on the original feature value, and preprocessing the original feature set to obtain data to be predicted; the data to be predicted is sent to a server, so that the server can determine research and development efficiency data based on the data to be predicted and call a research and development efficiency prediction model preset by a third party; and acquiring the research and development efficiency data sent by the server side, and processing the research and development efficiency data to obtain a research and development efficiency prediction result. Through the technical scheme, the artificial error can be reduced, the accuracy of research and development efficiency prediction is improved, and therefore the prediction result is closer to objective reality, and the actual research and development is better guided.

title_en: Evaluation method for electric power inspection scene model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation method for a power inspection scene model, which comprises the following steps: s1: the method comprises the steps of researching and analyzing an electric power inspection scene algorithm model, and establishing an index algorithm model test mode; s2: carrying out customized analysis on a typical scene of a power grid, and analyzing to obtain corresponding evaluation index data; s3: performing calculation analysis by combining the data characteristics, the planning tasks and the actual scenes of the step S2, and determining evaluation indexes of all sub-scenes of the corresponding tasks and the corresponding power inspection scenes; s4: and calculating the evaluation index of the corresponding scene through the evaluation index of the scene model. Aiming at a specific scene represented by power inspection, the method is used for combining the safety requirements of typical scenes such as a small part identification scene, a transmission line inspection scene, an insulator defect detection scene and the like with different scenes, constructing a customized evaluation index and further improving the reliability and the accuracy of sub-scene evaluation.

title_en: Ultrasonic diagnostic apparatus and ultrasonic image processing method
abstract_en: The invention provides an ultrasonic diagnostic apparatus and an ultrasonic image processing method. A marker (48) for identifying a lesion (50) is displayed on the tomographic image (42). A two-dimensional map 44 and a graph 46 are displayed regardless of whether the sign 48 is displayed. A two-dimensional graph (44) shows the spatial distribution of the probability of the lesion. The graph (46) shows the temporal change in probability of the lesion.

title_en: Dam displacement monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of dam monitoring, in particular to a dam displacement monitoring method, which comprises the following steps: setting a plurality of monitoring points in a target dam; setting a monitoring device at each monitoring point; after receiving the two position coordinates, the monitoring satellite calculates the distance between the two monitoring devices and the monitoring satellite according to the position of the monitoring satellite; the monitoring center calculates a monitoring value; and constructing a monitoring matrix according to time sequences of the monitoring values at different moments, solving the monitoring matrix by utilizing a time sequence matrix change algorithm to obtain a discrimination value, comparing the discrimination value with a preset threshold range, and judging that the target dam is displaced if the discrimination value is out of the preset threshold range. The dam displacement monitoring method improves the dam displacement monitoring precision and accuracy, and achieves timely early warning and prevention of dam displacement.

title_en: Maximum power point identification method of inverter under non-uniform illumination
abstract_en: The invention discloses a maximum power point identification method of an inverter under uneven illumination, which comprises the steps of obtaining operation data of the inverter under different working conditions, building a hybrid neural network model based on an MATLAB neural network tool box, training the hybrid neural network model, predicting real-time power mutation probability of the inverter on line, adjusting control parameters of the inverter to enable the PV voltage of the inverter to be maintained at an optimal efficiency point, and judging the probability of power mutation of the maximum power point due to uneven illumination according to input parameters in real time through neural network operation based on multiple influence factor data in the operation process of the inverter.

title_en: Method, system and storage medium for extracting bidding elements based on NLP technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a bid and ask element extraction method based on NLP information extraction technology, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring an bidding original file; s2, obtaining a pre-training model A; s3, acquiring a labeling training sample; s4, carrying out data enhancement on the marked sample; s5, training a sentence potential element type identification model B; s6, training elements and relation extraction models C; s7, outputting a result by the data through a standardized module; a bid and ask element extraction system based on NLP information extraction technology comprises a processor and a memory; a computer readable storage medium having stored thereon a computer program which, when executed by a processor, implements the above-described method and electronic system for extracting bid elements based on NLP technology. The invention has the advantages that: the development efficiency is greatly improved, the development cost is reduced, the limit of the text length of the traditional model 512 is broken through, the element nesting can be efficiently performed, and the recall rate of element information extraction is high.

title_en: Digital twinning-based crane monitoring method, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crane monitoring method based on digital twinning, computer equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of cranes, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a crane jib grid model; inputting the real-time dynamic data into a pre-trained RBF proxy model to output real-time coarse grid deformation data and real-time coarse grid stress data of coarse grid nodes; coloring the crane jib grid model according to the real-time coarse grid deformation data or the real-time coarse grid stress data to generate a crane jib model with a cloud picture effect; processing a pre-constructed crane jib equal-proportion three-dimensional model according to the real-time component relation to generate a model machine model without cloud picture effect; and constructing a stress-strain digital twin model of the crane jib according to the crane jib model and the prototype model. By adopting the invention, the geometric form and the stress-strain state change of the crane in the operation process can be accurately known, the safe operation of the crane is ensured, and the potential safety hazard in the construction process is reduced.

title_en: Emergency load decision method, decision model training method and training equipment thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency load shedding decision model training method, training equipment thereof and an emergency load shedding decision method, wherein the emergency load shedding decision model is an agent with a branch competition Q network, the model training method comprises the steps of inputting a state s  k  into the agent, deciding to obtain updated emergency load shedding actions a  k+1 , obtaining corresponding states s  k+1  and rewards r  k , obtaining interaction samples { s  k ,a k+1 ,s k+1 ,r k  }, wherein the agent randomly selects one strategy from greedy strategies and exploration strategies to decide the emergency load shedding actions, the greedy strategies randomly select emergency load shedding actions from partial loads with lower load bus voltages along with the increase of decision rounds, exploration strategy probability decays, exploration strategies randomly select the interaction samples under the current power grid transient voltage instability faults through multiple iterations, and extracting interaction samples to update the parameters of the agent. The training efficiency and decision performance of the BDQ intelligent body can be improved by adopting a mode of combining a greedy strategy with constraint and an exploration strategy.

title_en: Prediction method of cross-border E-commerce defective product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic commerce data analysis, and discloses a method for predicting cross-border electronic commerce defect products, which comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a database: accessing an electronic commerce platform data interface, collecting comment data of commodities, customer service and user chatting data and a production database of the electronic commerce platform, wherein the comment data of each commodity is constructed into a sub-database, each comment is a data element, the chatting data of each merchant customer service is constructed into a sub-database, and each chatting information is a data element. According to the invention, by deleting the invalid comment and generating the product defect model by combining the service attitudes of the product selling merchants, the user is facilitated to check the real and effective product evaluation, the rights and interests of the consumer are maintained, and meanwhile, the service attitudes of the merchants are also brought into a part of the product, so that the user is facilitated to judge whether the purchasing experience is satisfied enough or not after the product is purchased.

title_en: Unmanned distribution vehicle road section delivery amount estimation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method and a device for estimating the delivery quantity of an unmanned delivery vehicle road section. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining running state information and vehicle information of an unmanned distribution vehicle, carrying out parameter calibration on the unmanned distribution vehicle, secondly constructing unmanned distribution vehicles and other vehicle models based on the unmanned distribution vehicle parameter calibration, modeling urban basic road sections under different traffic environments by combining road design specifications, carrying out unmanned distribution vehicle throwing influence simulation and evaluation through a simulation technology, determining a throwing amount model of the unmanned distribution vehicle on the urban basic road sections through throwing amount, and finally forming an unmanned distribution vehicle road section throwing estimation device by combining the unmanned distribution vehicle throwing model.

title_en: Multispectral cloud detection method based on sharpening module and Gaussian mixture model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multispectral cloud detection method based on a sharpening module and a Gaussian mixture model, which comprises the steps of obtaining a remote sensing image to be detected, inputting the remote sensing image to be detected into a pre-built trained cloud detection model to obtain an output cloud detection result, wherein the cloud detection model building training method comprises the steps of obtaining a remote sensing image dataset, preprocessing the remote sensing image dataset to obtain a cloud detection dataset, carrying out feature selection on the cloud detection dataset to obtain three clustering features, and building the cloud detection model by utilizing the cloud detection dataset and the clustering features, wherein the cloud detection model comprises a feature selection module, a thin cloud sharpening module, a GMM clustering module and a superposition module. The method is simple to operate and fast in operation, reduces the complexity of the cloud detection model, and can realize fast and high-precision cloud detection for different cloud types.

title_en: Image reconstruction method, device, equipment and medium of capsule robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an image reconstruction method, device, equipment and medium of a capsule robot. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a magnetic field conversion matrix corresponding to an external magnetic field module in a capsule robot, wherein the external magnetic field module is used for controlling the pose of a binocular camera in the capsule robot, determining a target camera conversion matrix corresponding to the binocular camera based on the magnetic field conversion matrix, and carrying out three-dimensional reconstruction on point cloud data acquired by the binocular camera based on the target camera conversion matrix to obtain a reconstructed image. The embodiment of the invention solves the problem that the camera gesture depends on the image characteristics in the existing image reconstruction process, improves the accuracy of the camera gesture, and further improves the quality of image reconstruction.

title_en: Remote sensing image collaborative interpretation method, system, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing image collaborative interpretation method, a remote sensing image collaborative interpretation system, electronic equipment and a medium, and belongs to the technical field of remote sensing image processing. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring remote sensing images of different detection resources; dividing the remote sensing image according to different areas to obtain remote sensing images of a plurality of areas; performing target recognition on the remote sensing images of the areas based on a deep learning algorithm, and performing fusion processing on targets recognized in the remote sensing images of overlapping parts of different areas; the targets include aircraft and ships; and marking the remote sensing images of different areas based on the target, and integrating the remote sensing images of the marked different areas. The method can ensure timeliness, accuracy and rapidity of target interpretation of the remote sensing image in a large range.

title_en: Hinge device and intelligent terminal
abstract_en: The application provides a hinge device and an intelligent terminal, wherein the hinge device comprises at least two supporting plates, at least two supporting plates are arranged along a target direction, two adjacent supporting plates are hinged through a hinge shaft, the supporting plates comprise bearing surfaces, the bearing surfaces are connected with a flexible screen, the axis of the hinge shaft is located at one side of the bearing surfaces, and in the direction along the axis of the hinge shaft, the projection of the flexible screen is at least partially overlapped with the projection of the hinge shaft, so that the hinge device is in an unfolding state and a folding state, and the size of the flexible screen is consistent. Through the technical scheme, the screen pulling of the intelligent terminal in use is reduced.

title_en: Front-end page construction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a front-end page construction method, a front-end page construction device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the field of front-end page design. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining a page newly-built request, carrying out page configuration on a preset blank page according to the page newly-built request to obtain initial page, obtaining page component information, screening a preset candidate component data table according to component configuration information in the page component information to obtain a target component data table, adding field information in the selected component data table to preconfigured component column information to obtain target component column information, merging the target component column information, the page component information and the initial page information of the initial page to obtain target page information, and carrying out page rendering according to the target page information to obtain the target page. According to the embodiment of the application, the construction of the front-end page can be completed through simple configuration, so that the page can be constructed according to different page requirements, and the repeatability of the content of the front-end page is reduced.

title_en: Method for supplementing small sample temporal knowledge graph based on relational adaptive network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for supplementing a temporal knowledge graph of an hour sample based on a relational adaptive network. The innovation point of the invention is that aiming at the temporal knowledge graph, the long tail and the sparse problem of the relation are relieved, and the completion performance is improved. The temporal knowledge graph completion model constructs a time sequence evolution encoder and a relationship self-adaptive decoder which are fused with local and global history modes, further enhances the representation of the small sample relationship on the basis of capturing the time sequence characteristics, and finally improves the effect of the temporal knowledge graph completion of the small sample.

title_en: Service quality evaluation method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a service quality evaluation method, a service quality evaluation device, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining data to be tested of a target service; and carrying out prediction processing on the data to be detected through a preset predictor to obtain a prediction result of the target service. The preset predictor is obtained by training dial testing data obtained by dial testing of sample service under different service types and application scenes, so that prediction is performed by combining service data under actual service and application scenes, the prediction accuracy of the preset predictor is improved, and the accuracy of service quality evaluation is improved.

title_en: Automatic parking positioning method, automatic parking positioning device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The present application relates to an automatic parking positioning method, an automatic parking positioning device, a computer device, a storage medium and a computer program product. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a data point set of a calibration plate under a northeast day coordinate system and a point cloud coordinate set corresponding to the data point set under a laser radar coordinate system; inputting the data point set and the point cloud coordinate set into a pre-constructed calibration algorithm processing model to obtain a conversion matrix; acquiring a vector error value between a plane normal vector and a ground real normal vector, and converting the point cloud of the multi-laser radar into a northeast day coordinate system according to a conversion matrix under the condition that the vector error value is smaller than a preset value to obtain a splicing point cloud; preprocessing the splice point cloud, and synthesizing a target parking lot map of the parking lot according to the preprocessed splice point cloud; and acquiring the coordinate value of the current vehicle in the target parking lot map, and taking the coordinate value of the current vehicle as the actual positioning result of the current vehicle in the parking lot. By adopting the method, the parking efficiency of the unmanned automobile can be improved.

title_en: State data updating method and device in on-chain data warehouse-in process
abstract_en: One or more embodiments of the present disclosure provide a method and apparatus for updating status data in a data-in-link process. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring on-chain data maintained in a block chain system, and analyzing a plurality of transactions in the same granularity unit in the on-chain data according to a preset state data updating granularity; the state data update granularity is used for defining transactions involved in single update of the state data; under the condition that transaction analysis in the granularity unit is completed, integrating the analysis data obtained by analysis to obtain integrated analysis data corresponding to the granularity unit, wherein the integrated analysis data is used for representing the comprehensive adjustment condition of the analysis data on the state data; and updating the state data based on the integrated analysis data so as to record the updated state data in a link database.

title_en: Method, system and medium for detecting lane crossing point
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a system and a medium for detecting a lane crossing point. The method can be applied to scenes such as ports, mines, high speed or parks and the like. The method comprises the steps of receiving an image to be detected sent by a vehicle-mounted camera device, identifying lane lines in the image to be detected, performing curve fitting on the identified lane lines to obtain corresponding lane line curves, determining lane line calibration widths corresponding to positions of the lane line curves for each lane line curve, performing feature extraction on the image to be detected according to each lane line curve and the lane line calibration widths corresponding to positions of each lane line curve to obtain corresponding feature images, inputting the feature images into a cross point detection model, and determining cross points of the lane lines in the image to be detected according to results output by the cross point detection model. The method reduces the installation cost of the vehicle driving system and improves the stability of system detection.

title_en: Test result recognition method and test result recognition device
abstract_en: The invention provides a test result identification method and a test result identification device. The method comprises the following steps: controlling an image capturing device to capture a first image of a display picture according to the image capturing parameters; in response to determining that a reference image area comprising a first designated character string exists in the first image, controlling an image capturing device to capture a first test image on the display screen according to the image capturing parameters; acquiring a first image area corresponding to a reference image area from a first test image, and performing text cutting operation on the first image area to convert the first image area into a second image area; and performing a text recognition operation on the second image area to obtain a first test result corresponding to the first test image. Thus, the reliability of the automated test can be correspondingly increased.

title_en: Service supervision method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a service supervision method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which belong to the technical field of service supervision, wherein the service supervision method comprises the following steps: acquiring voice data of a service provider; based on the voice data, identifying the identity of the service provider to obtain the identity information of the service provider; carrying out emotion recognition based on the voice data to obtain emotion categories of the service provider; based on the voice data, carrying out service flow identification to obtain a service flow of the service provider; and carrying out illegal activity recognition based on the identity information, the emotion category and the service flow to obtain an illegal activity recognition result. The method and the system can effectively identify the defects and the loopholes of the service behaviors, and improve the flexibility and the convenience of service supervision.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and storage medium for classifying strabismus type of eye image
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for classifying strabismus type of eye images, relates to strabismus classification of eye images in the field of artificial intelligence, and aims to solve the technical problem that the accuracy rate of classifying strabismus type of eye images in the prior art is low. The method comprises the steps of inputting text data containing basic information of a patient and image data comprising an eye image of the patient, adopting a feature extraction module based on a ResNet50V2 model residual block connection mechanism to extract features of the eye image data, then adopting a feature fusion module based on a joint multi-head attention mechanism to fuse the image features extracted by the ResNet50V2 and the text features subjected to normalization processing, and finally adopting a multi-classification module based on a hierarchical classification method to output classification results (10 classifications of normal and strabismus). The whole model improves multi-classification precision through multi-mode and hierarchical classification architecture, reduces errors among classes, and has stronger practical significance and clinical value.

title_en: Determinant-based API finite state security calling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an API finite state safety calling method based on determinant, which comprises a client and an API, and comprises the following steps: defining a refined client call API framework, which comprises a plurality of step flows; step two, defining different finite states of the client and the API according to the step flow in the process of calling the API by the client; step three, designing data packets with different formats under different finite states; step four, designing a determinant-based secure transmission mode of an identity identifier (API_Key), so that an attacker cannot directly intercept the API_Key information issued by the API in the process of calling the API by a client, and ensuring the process safety; step five, the client acquires the specific value of the API_Key by calculating the information of the API_Key, so that the API call is successfully realized; according to the invention, determinant call is carried out between the set client and the API, so that the flow of the API call is standardized, and the safety transmission and transmission performance of the API_Key in the API call process are ensured.

title_en: Text classification method based on artificial intelligence and related equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a text classification method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium based on artificial intelligence, wherein the text classification method based on the artificial intelligence comprises the following steps: preprocessing the text to be classified to obtain a first text, wherein the preprocessing at least comprises sensitive word removal and text recognition; acquiring a high-frequency error-prone dictionary, and performing text error correction on the first text based on the high-frequency error-prone dictionary to acquire a second text; acquiring key data sets of different text categories, and text screening the second text based on the key data sets to acquire a third text, wherein the key data sets comprise keywords corresponding to the text categories; performing text splicing on all keywords with the occurrence frequency higher than the preset frequency in the third text and the third text to obtain an input text; input text is input to the text classification model to output text categories of text to be classified. The text classification method and device can improve accuracy of text classification.

title_en: Intelligent question-answering method and system based on flow automatic robot technology
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent question-answering method and system based on a process automation robot technology, which relate to the technical field of intelligent question-answering and comprise the following steps: reading a customer service work chat record, accurately identifying chat response, extracting key word characteristics of the chat record, classifying parts of speech of the key word characteristics, constructing a plurality of part-of-speech channel sets, carrying out association strength identification, interacting message contents of real-time clients, carrying out content segmentation extraction of the message contents, carrying out matching identification, outputting response contents of each channel, carrying out common response content extraction on all channels, calculating joint channel strength characteristic values, and carrying out response processing on the message contents according to common response contents corresponding to the highest joint channel strength characteristic values. The application solves the technical problems that the intelligent question-answering system in the prior art cannot analyze according to the history chat record, so that the question-answering system answers relatively fixedly, and the questions of different users cannot be accurately and pertinently answered.

title_en: Digital twin system, construction method, vehicle-mounted air conditioner optimization and life prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of air conditioners, in particular to a digital twin system, a construction method, a vehicle-mounted air conditioner optimization and life prediction method, and aims to solve the problems that in the use process of the existing parking air conditioner, the risk that parts are to be broken cannot be found in time and the parts cannot be quickly and effectively prevented from being broken. The method for constructing the digital twin system mainly comprises the steps of firstly constructing a bench test system, a multi-body dynamics model and a finite element analysis model according to a vehicle-mounted air conditioner and a vehicle, acquiring load spectrums of the vehicle under different roads, loading the load spectrums to the bench test system and the multi-body dynamics model, comparing detection results to optimize the multi-body dynamics model, acquiring power spectrum density of an installation position of the vehicle-mounted air conditioner through the multi-body dynamics model, loading the power spectrum density to the bench test system and the finite element analysis model, and optimizing the finite element analysis model according to the detection results. The digital twin system is used for the optimal design and life prediction of the vehicle-mounted air conditioner.

title_en: Image information enhancement method, model training method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an image information enhancement method. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring image information sequences and point cloud information acquired by a plurality of cameras; selecting an alternative target sample from a target sample set, adding the alternative target sample into the current moment image information to obtain enhanced current moment image information, adding point cloud information corresponding to the alternative target sample into other moment image information to obtain enhanced other moment image information, and adding the point cloud information corresponding to the alternative target sample to enable the positions of the alternative target sample in the other moment image information and the current moment image information to meet the time sequence training requirement, so that the diversity of the target sample in the image information is greatly increased through the extraction, screening and mapping processing of the target sample, the excessive number of model parameters is avoided, the number distribution of the target sample is more balanced, the generalization performance and the detection precision of a model are further improved, and the detection performance of less target sample types can also be improved.

title_en: AR (augmented reality) glasses-based field rice planthopper investigation method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a field rice planthopper investigation method and device based on AR glasses, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring a white disc image acquired by the AR glasses; inputting the white disc image into a convolutional neural network model to obtain a white disc image marked with rice planthopper types; the white-disc image marked with the rice planthoppers is subjected to statistical processing to obtain the quantity of each rice planthopper type, and the white-disc image, each rice planthopper type and the corresponding quantity are sent to a client so that the client displays each rice planthopper type and the corresponding quantity in the white-disc image.
