The rice planthoppers beaten on the white disk image are identified through the convolutional neural network model, the defects of low efficiency, high professional skill, high labor intensity and the like caused by traditional manual disk shooting and counting can be effectively avoided, and interaction between the AR glasses and the mobile terminal can be realized through a mode of feeding back identification and counting results to the client side, so that the use experience of a user is improved.

title_en: Game scene frame rate improving method, equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a game scene frame rate improving method, equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: identifying, in a first set of element color data values of a primary scene model of a primary buffer of a current frame, whether each element color value is the same as an element color value in a second set of element color data values of a simplified model of a secondary buffer; and in the next frame of the current frame, each element with the same element color value is placed in the secondary buffer zone, then image rendering processing is directly waited, coordinate conversion, perspective conversion and clipping operations are carried out on each element with different element color values, then the element is placed in the primary buffer zone, and the image rendering processing is waited. The method and the device realize an efficient game scene frame rate improvement scheme, reduce the calculated amount, save the processing resources and enhance the game experience of users.

title_en: Wettability prediction method and device based on multi-granularity cascade forest and super-parameter optimization
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rock wettability, in particular to a wettability prediction method and a device based on multi-granularity cascade forest and super-parameter optimization, wherein the wettability prediction method based on the multi-granularity cascade forest and super-parameter optimization comprises the following steps: detecting an experimental sample to obtain sample characteristic data; modeling operation is carried out based on a multi-granularity cascade forest algorithm, and a prediction model to be trained is obtained; training the prediction model to be trained by using the sample characteristic data to obtain a wettability prediction model; obtaining an optimized wettability prediction model according to the sample characteristic data, the wettability prediction model and a preset sequence model optimization algorithm; and inputting the characteristic data of the sample to be predicted into an optimized wettability prediction model to obtain a wettability prediction result. The shale wettability prediction method is accurate in prediction and rapid in response.

title_en: Electromechanical system maintenance mode prediction method based on fault bottom layer characteristics
abstract_en: The invention provides an electromechanical system maintenance mode prediction method based on failure floor characteristics. The method comprises the following steps: based on maintenance records of an electromechanical system, fault data are taken as examples, fault types are taken as labels, a correlation matrix between the examples and the labels is constructed, clustering is carried out on all the labels, euclidean distances between the examples and clustering centers of positive and negative example sets of the labels are calculated, and a mapping relation between the examples and the labels is obtained; constructing a binary classifier, taking fault data of a faulty electromechanical system as an unknown example, inputting the unknown example into the binary classifier, and outputting a preliminary judgment result of a maintenance mode of the faulty electromechanical system; and introducing a calibration label, and updating the preliminary judgment result of the maintenance mode of the fault electromechanical system by using the fault bottom layer characteristics and the calibration label to obtain a final judgment result of the maintenance mode. The method provided by the invention can effectively judge the maintenance mode according to the data acquired by the complex electromechanical system, and has high precision.

title_en: Abnormality processing method, abnormality processing device, electronic device, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: An exception handling method, apparatus, electronic device and computer readable storage medium, the exception handling method comprising: monitoring preset key indexes of the public components, and determining whether the public components are abnormal or not; the public components are operated on a node server, the node server is in communication connection with an application server, and the public components are used for providing services for applications deployed in the application server; if the public assembly is monitored to be abnormal, acquiring the abnormal type of the public assembly; determining an exception handling policy that matches the exception type; and processing the exception of the common component based on the exception handling policy. The method and the device can automatically preprocess the abnormality, and improve timeliness of the abnormality processing, so that availability of public components and service stability of an application system are improved.

title_en: Operator automatic generation method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an operator automatic generation method, device, equipment and medium, comprising the following steps: compiling through a front-end compiler according to the algorithm primitive language input by the user to obtain an initial forward data flow graph; optimizing each node in the initial forward data flow graph according to a specified rule to obtain an optimized forward data flow graph; acquiring a chip instruction set matched with the optimized forward data flow graph; and compiling the target algorithm through a back-end compiler according to the chip instruction set. After compiling the obtained initial forward data flow graph according to the algorithm primitive language input by the user through the front-end compiler, optimizing the obtained initial forward data flow graph, obtaining a chip instruction set corresponding to the optimized forward data flow graph, and automatically generating a target algorithm according to the chip instruction set through the back-end compiler, so that the algorithm can be automatically generated based on the multi-level cache processor equipment of the DMA without the need of user parameters.

title_en: Write assist circuit, static random access memory and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a write assist circuit, a static random access memory and an operation method thereof, wherein the write assist circuit comprises a voltage tracking circuit and a power control circuit, the voltage tracking circuit determines the pulse width of a write enable signal by referring to two timing delay signals based on an external clock signal, wherein the two timing delay signals are respectively powered by a power supply voltage and a peripheral circuit power supply voltage; the power control circuit discharges a memory cell internal power supply voltage in response to the write enable signal to provide the memory cell internal power supply voltage. The invention automatically tracks the change of the power supply voltage and the peripheral circuit power supply voltage when the wide voltage design is carried out, ensures the stability of the memory cell in the holding mode and the reading mode, and avoids the problem of difficult writing operation caused by overlarge gap between the two modes in the writing mode.

title_en: Method, device and system for accelerating data transmission of storage device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for accelerating data transmission of storage equipment, which is operated in the storage equipment comprising a hardware processing engine and a software processing engine and comprises the following steps: acquiring the priority and the actual bandwidth of the host IO queue; according to the priority and actual bandwidth of the host IO queue, the mapping relation between the host IO queue and a plurality of IO queue polling threads in the software processing engine and/or a plurality of IO queue polling modules in the hardware processing engine is dynamically adjusted so as to realize load balancing of the host IO queue relative to the plurality of IO queue polling threads in the software processing engine and/or the plurality of IO queue polling modules in the hardware processing engine.

title_en: Model training method and related system
abstract_en: The application provides a model training method, which is applied to the technical field of Artificial Intelligence (AI), and comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a training data set, respectively carrying out strong enhancement and weak enhancement on an unlabeled image in the training data set to obtain a strong enhanced image and a weak enhanced image, carrying out prediction on a target in the unlabeled image through a first model and the weak enhanced image to obtain a first label, carrying out prediction on the target in the unlabeled image through a second model, the strong enhanced image and the first label to obtain a prediction result, wherein the prediction result comprises a prediction position of a candidate frame of the target and a prediction category of the target, carrying out secondary prediction on the target in the unlabeled image through the first model, the weak enhanced image and the prediction position of the candidate frame to obtain a second label, and updating parameters of the second model according to the second label so as to train the second model. Thus, the problem of insufficient AI model precision or recall rate caused by low quality of the pseudo tag is solved through secondary inspection.

title_en: Split-screen text display control method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a split-screen text display control method, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: setting a split screen for the video conference, and determining text parameters added on each sub-screen; establishing a matrix structure body container for storing sub-screen split-screen information; finding out matrix data of the corresponding sub-split screen through the split screen field; calculating the width and the height of the text according to the font size; calculating the coordinates of the initial position of the text according to the text position and the matrix data of the sub-screen; calculating the distance of the initial position of the text to the basic coordinate according to the offset of the text; and transmitting the calculated coordinates of the initial position of the text, parameters such as text content, font size and the like and video stream to an encoder. The application can complete the text setting of all the sub-screens through one-time setting, has simpler operation, is not limited by the number of split screens, improves the office efficiency, and is particularly suitable for meeting video scenes.

title_en: Method and system for context-aware dependency-guided kernel fuzzy test case variation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for context-aware dependency-guided kernel fuzzy test case variation, and belongs to the technical field of software security and operating system kernel test. The method comprises the steps of dynamically collecting and minimizing a high-potential system call sequence set to serve as a training set, modeling dependency relationships contained in the training set based on a neural network language model, realizing context-aware dependency guided variation by utilizing the language model in a variation stage, helping to select system calls adapting to current contexts and establishing an effective state path, alternately switching and exploring, dynamically scheduling variation operation by utilizing an upper-limit confidence algorithm in two stages to give consideration to the diversity and efficiency of the test, avoiding being trapped in local optimum, and repeating the steps until the fuzzy test is finished. The method and the device can improve the quality of the test case, trigger the core deep code logic, and optimize the coverage rate and the vulnerability mining efficiency.

title_en: Spoken language learning method and device based on large language model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a spoken language learning method and device based on a large language model, electronic equipment and a computer readable medium. According to the method, the scene and the person setting are set, so that students can select interesting scenes to learn the spoken language by the aid of the specific person setting, the large language model feeds back based on the specific scene, the specific person setting, the spoken language content of the students and the spoken language level of the students, interactive learning is performed with the students, a difficulty following mechanism is adopted, the feedback difficulty of the large language model accords with the spoken language level of the students or is slightly higher than the spoken language level of the students, the effect of targeted learning according to different situations of different students is achieved, the students can learn the foreign language spoken language anytime and anywhere, and the spoken language learning is very targeted and practical based on dialogue practice of the specific scene and the person setting.

title_en: Communication method and device
abstract_en: The communication method comprises the steps that a first network element sends a first request message to a second network element, wherein the first request message is used for requesting data of a terminal equipment group, and terminal equipment in the terminal equipment group is terminal equipment participating in transverse federal learning. The first network element receives data of the terminal equipment group from the second network element, the data of the terminal equipment group comprises aggregation information of measurement results of QoS parameters, the first network element adjusts the QoS parameters of the first terminal equipment in the terminal equipment group according to the data of the terminal equipment group, and the first network element sends the adjusted QoS parameters of the first terminal equipment to the strategy control network element. By adopting the method, the efficiency of model training of federal learning can be improved.

title_en: Travel route recommendation method based on user portrait and user experience
abstract_en: The application discloses a travel route recommending method based on user portrait and user experience. The application comprises the following steps: step one, establishing a user portrait based on a user travel mode; step two, clustering users; and thirdly, establishing a path recommendation system based on user experience. According to the application, through the combination of the data analysis technology and the path recommendation algorithm technology, the individuation and satisfaction of the travel path of the user are improved.

title_en: Security alarm information processing method, device, server and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a safety alarm information processing method, which relates to the technical field of network safety and is applied to a server, wherein the server is electrically connected with network safety equipment, the number of the network safety equipment is at least one, and the method comprises the following steps: receiving security alarm information sent by each network security device; classifying the safety alarm information according to a preset classification standard to obtain a plurality of classification results; the preset classification standard comprises a network attack type; determining the hazard level of each classification result according to the sampling analysis result of each classification result so as to obtain a first classification result belonging to the first hazard level; the first hazard level is a highest hazard level.

title_en: Identity recognition method and device based on network fingerprint
abstract_en: The application provides an identity recognition method and device based on network fingerprints, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a user relationship network; the user relation network takes a user identifier as a node and takes an association relation among users as an edge; screening the user relation network by utilizing network fingerprints; and clustering the user relation network after the screening processing to determine a unique user identifier. According to the network fingerprint-based identity recognition method and device, the user relationship network is constructed based on the relationship of mutual awareness among users, then preliminary de-duplication screening is performed through network fingerprint indexes, and finally the real users in the network fingerprint-based identity recognition method and device are obtained through analysis according to the degree of the mutual awareness among the users through clustering, so that a data basis is provided for subsequent processing.

title_en: Method for improving quantum computing stability
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of quantum computing, in particular to a method for improving quantum computing stability. The application provides a method for improving quantum computing stability, which comprises the following steps: an interference layer is arranged at a position of 2-4 cm on one side of the quantum chip; the interference layer sequentially comprises a frequency conversion layer and a reflecting layer along the thickness direction, the frequency conversion layer is close to the quantum chip, the preparation material of the frequency conversion layer comprises shape memory metal or negative poisson ratio material, the reflecting layer is used for reflecting electromagnetic waves incident to the surface of the reflection layer, and the frequency conversion layer is provided with an electromagnetic inductor for detecting the intensity of the electromagnetic waves; collecting electromagnetic wave intensity of the quantum chip by using an electromagnetic sensor; when the electromagnetic sensor receives the electromagnetic wave signal intensity of the quantum chip which is higher than a preset value for more than 1s, the variable frequency layer is controlled to change the structure so as to adjust the frequency of the induction electromagnetic wave formed by the variable frequency layer. The application provides a method for improving quantum computing stability, which can be used for weakening or eliminating electromagnetic resonance to improve the quantum computing stability.

title_en: Multi-disciplinary interaction teaching system and teaching method based on cloud platform
abstract_en: A multidisciplinary interaction teaching system and a teaching method based on a cloud platform relate to the technical field of intelligent teaching, and comprise the steps of extracting teacher input data and student input data from the cloud platform; carrying out semantic coding on the teacher input data and the student input data to obtain a teacher input data semantic understanding feature vector and a student input data semantic understanding feature vector; constructing a teacher-student input data semantic understanding association feature vector between the teacher input data semantic understanding feature vector and the student input data semantic understanding feature vector; and generating a teaching plan based on the teacher-student input data semantic understanding associated feature vector. Thus, knowledge points can be comprehensively and accurately compiled and a teaching plan can be generated, so that the efficiency and quality of multi-disciplinary interactive teaching can be improved.

title_en: Identification method and device for safety state of driver and passenger
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for identifying the safety state of drivers and passengers, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a video stream of a driver and passengers in a vehicle, and sampling the video stream according to a preset sampling rate to obtain a video frame sequence; inputting the video frame sequence into a preset skeleton key point extraction model according to the number of preset input frames in sequence to obtain a human body key point heat map sequence consisting of a plurality of human body key point heat maps; generating a plurality of feature vector sequences according to the human body key point heat map sequences and a plurality of preset feature dimensions; and inputting each characteristic vector sequence into a preset action recognition model to perform action recognition, and determining the safety state of the driver and the passenger according to the action recognition result, so that the actions of the driver and the passenger are recognized based on a plurality of preset characteristic dimensions, the safety state of the driver and the passenger is accurately recognized, and the trip safety is improved.

title_en: Performance adjustment method and device and computing equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a performance adjustment method, a performance adjustment device and computing equipment, wherein the performance adjustment method comprises the following steps: inputting N preset load-pulling currents to a Central Processing Unit (CPU) in a first main board, sampling the input current of the CPU in the first main board under each load-pulling current to obtain first signal values, obtaining N first signal values, wherein the first main board is a main board to be calibrated of a load-pulling current processing firmware, and N is an integer greater than or equal to 1; determining a compensation relation between N first signal values and N reference signal values, wherein the N reference signal values are obtained by sampling input currents of a CPU in a reference main board under the condition that N preset currents are input to the CPU in the reference main board, and the reference main board is a main board calibrated by a pull load current processing firmware; and updating the pull-load current processing firmware of the first main board according to the compensation relation. By adopting the embodiment of the application, the maximum performance of the server can be ensured.

title_en: Method and device for realizing man-machine interaction
abstract_en: The present application relates to computer interaction technology, and in particular, to a method for implementing man-machine interaction and a device for implementing the method. The method for realizing man-machine interaction according to one aspect of the application comprises the following steps: presenting a virtual reality interface view through a gesture interaction device, wherein the virtual reality interface view comprises a second interaction element with a mapping relation with a first interaction element in the touch interaction interface view, and for the second interaction element with a size smaller than a set value, a third interaction element with a larger size is overlapped on the second interaction element, and the third interaction element is transparent to a user in the virtual reality interface view and has a mapping relation with the first interaction element; identifying a gesture mode of a set type for the second or third interaction element from the captured hand actions by using the gesture interaction device, wherein the gesture mode of the set type corresponds to a specified type of touch operation on the touch interaction interface view; a process flow corresponding to the specified type of touch operation is initiated in the processing system.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle, return electric quantity adjusting method and device thereof and flight controller
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle, a return electric quantity adjusting method and device thereof, and a flight controller, wherein the return electric quantity adjusting method of the unmanned aerial vehicle is applied to the flight controller and comprises the following steps: obtaining estimated electric quantity of the unmanned aerial vehicle for returning; acquiring the ambient wind speed and the ambient wind direction when the unmanned aerial vehicle flies; acquiring an adjustment coefficient of the estimated electric quantity according to the ambient wind speed and the ambient wind direction; and adjusting the estimated electric quantity according to the adjustment coefficient to obtain the adjusted return electric quantity. According to the method, the accuracy of unmanned aerial vehicle return electric quantity prediction can be improved by acquiring the adjustment coefficient of unmanned aerial vehicle return electric quantity according to the ambient wind speed and the ambient wind direction and adjusting the unmanned aerial vehicle return estimated electric quantity according to the adjustment coefficient.

title_en: Urban three-dimensional space land function attribute identification and space-time change monitoring analysis method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method for identifying the ground function attribute and monitoring and analyzing the space-time change of a three-dimensional space of a city, which belongs to the technical field of data processing and specifically comprises the following steps: performing regular calculation on address information of POI data of the target area to obtain floor information; correcting POI data and floor information; dividing the corrected floor information into statistical categories according to the number of floors; calculating the frequency index and the type proportion of the three-dimensional functional intensity; calculating the function attribute type to obtain a land function attribute identification result of the target area; and obtaining a plurality of three-dimensional land function attribute recognition results by utilizing POI data of different years of the target area, and performing difference calculation according to the function attribute recognition results of floors to obtain a function attribute space-time change result of the target area. By the scheme of the invention, the efficiency, adaptability and accuracy of identifying the three-dimensional space land function attribute of the urban building and monitoring the space-time change of the urban building are improved.

title_en: Data consistency verification method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application provides a data consistency verification method, a device, equipment and a medium, which can be applied to the field of big data or finance and comprises the following steps: acquiring a source table and a target table; responding to the main key of the source table or the target table, and carrying out all-external connection on the source table and the target table according to the main key to obtain a comparison table; in response to the source table or the target table without a primary key, respectively sequencing all fields of the source table and the target table, and then adding a serial number as the primary key to generate two temporary tables; according to the main key, the two temporary tables are connected in an all-external mode, and a comparison table is obtained; and judging whether the fields of each row of the comparison table are consistent or not, and obtaining a consistency verification result of the source table and the target table. According to the data verification rule, different verification processes are generated according to the two conditions of whether a source table or a target table has a main key or not, and the data table in the basic data platform and the data table in the data management platform are automatically compared, so that consistency verification is completed, and the cost of manual comparison is reduced.

title_en: Data processing method and system for high-power charging energy
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of data processing, and provides a data processing method and system of a high-power charging energy source, wherein the data processing method comprises the following steps: collecting using parameters of a charging energy source to obtain a matrix to be analyzed; calculating the association coefficient of each row of data sequences in the matrix to be analyzed, and calculating the stability index of each data point in the differential sequence corresponding to each row of data sequences; calculating a fusion characteristic value of each data point in each row of data sequences based on the association coefficient and the stability index, and determining suspected abnormal data as data to be detected from each row of data sequences of the matrix to be analyzed based on the fusion characteristic value of each data point in each row of data sequences; and carrying out anomaly detection on the data to be detected, and further determining the anomaly data in the data to be detected. According to the method, normal data in the collected data are removed according to the fusion characteristic values of the data points, and only the data to be detected of the suspected abnormal data are subjected to abnormal detection, so that the calculated amount can be reduced, and the operation speed of an algorithm is greatly improved.

title_en: Flux line filter
abstract_en: Techniques for generating a low pass filter associated with a flux line are presented. The qubit device can include a first substrate and a second substrate. A low pass filter may be formed comprising at least one inductor and at least one capacitor, wherein respective components of or associated with the low pass filter may be formed on the first or second substrate, and wherein one or more bump bonds may extend between the substrates to connect the respective components on the respective substrates. The filter may receive an input signal through an input line and filter the signal to produce a filtered signal as an output of a flux line proximate to a coupler having a SQUID loop and one or more flux-tunable qubits formed on one of the substrates. The filter may reduce electrical noise and peltier attenuation associated with the flux line.

title_en: Image processing apparatus and method for processing multiple frames using the same
abstract_en: An image processing apparatus according to an embodiment is disclosed, wherein the image processing apparatus includes: a memory storing one or more instructions; and a processor executing one or more instructions stored in the memory, wherein the processor: identifying a predicted sample corresponding to a current sample of a current frame in a previous frame; generating a predicted frame for the current frame by changing a sample value of a co-located sample of the previous frame according to the sample value of the predicted sample; deriving weights by comparing sample values of the current samples with sample values of the predicted samples; applying the weights to co-located samples of the predicted frame so as to obtain a weighted predicted frame; and obtaining a current output frame by processing a weighted prediction frame and the current frame via a neural network comprising a convolutional layer, wherein the parity samples of the previous frame and the parity samples of the prediction frame are parity samples for the current sample.

title_en: Service monitoring method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a service monitoring method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, which can be used in the field of big data platforms. The method comprises the following steps: determining a first service view corresponding to the service system, wherein the first service view can comprise a plurality of overview matters and a plurality of service matters, determining the matters information of the plurality of service matters, and the matters information of the service matters comprises at least one of the following matters: the item progress, item risk degree or item state, and determining item information of a plurality of overview items according to item information of a plurality of business items, wherein the item information of the overview items comprises at least one of the following: item progress, item risk level, or item status, item information for a plurality of overview items is displayed in the first business view. The method of the application improves the monitoring efficiency through the service view comprising the multi-dimensional overview matters.

title_en: Expression Recognition Method Based on Local Features and Global Features
abstract_en: The invention discloses an expression recognition method based on local features and global features, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a facial expression image dataset; constructing a facial expression recognition model based on local features and global features, wherein the facial expression recognition model comprises a multi-scale local feature extraction fusion network and a vit network; and acquiring an expression recognition result of the facial expression image to be detected based on the trained facial expression recognition model. The invention not only utilizes the characteristic of expanding receptive fields of a multi-scale local feature extraction fusion network, extracts local features of different scales in a face image, reduces interference of useless information and enhances useful information, but also fuses the multi-scale local features through an improved attention mechanism, utilizes the advantage of learning global features through a vit network, takes the local features obtained by the multi-scale local feature extraction fusion network as an original feature map, inputs the global features into the vit, outputs a final expression classification result, and effectively improves the accuracy of facial expression recognition.

title_en: Solid state disk combined type testing device
abstract_en: The application relates to a solid state disk combined type testing device, which belongs to the technical field of testing devices and comprises a feeding mechanism, a clamping and material moving mechanism, a material collecting and conveying mechanism, a turntable material distributing mechanism and an AGV testing cabinet mechanism, wherein the AGV testing cabinet mechanism comprises a power-off testing cabinet and an aging testing cabinet, the solid state disk is packaged with a plastic shell and then is conveyed to the feeding mechanism, the clamping and material moving mechanism moves a product on the feeding mechanism to the material collecting and conveying mechanism, then the material collecting and conveying mechanism conveys the product to the turntable material distributing mechanism, the turntable material distributing mechanism respectively moves the product to the power-off testing cabinet and the aging testing cabinet for testing, and the whole testing process is more automatic and intelligent. The application has the effect of reducing the labor amount of staff in the process of testing the solid state disk.

title_en: Intelligent diagnosis method for working condition of sucker rod pump well
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent diagnosis method for working conditions of a sucker rod pump well, which comprises the steps of data acquisition and indicator diagram normalization, wherein the data comprises ground indicator diagram cards and corresponding characteristic sensitive parameters; building a neural network and building a knowledge base corresponding to various working conditions; diagnosing based on the neural network and knowledge deduction, outputting the result as a final diagnosis result when the corresponding parameters of the working condition diagnosis result of the neural network model meet the requirements of a knowledge base, comparing the confidence coefficient of the neural network and knowledge deduction diagnosis result when the diagnosis result of the neural network model cannot pass the secondary verification of knowledge deduction, and selecting the working condition with high confidence coefficient as the final diagnosis working condition and the abnormal working condition taking the pump detection result as the reference; model training is carried out, and model parameters and architecture are optimized. The method can solve the problem of low accuracy of the working condition classification result of the traditional neural network extraction method.

title_en: Intelligent control type energy-saving environment-friendly digital twin system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent control type energy-saving environment-friendly digital twin system and a method, wherein the system comprises a configuration acquisition service, an equipment protocol service, an edge data fusion service, a KAFKA service and a digital twin service; the configuration acquisition service acquires basic data and converts the basic data and then sends the basic data to the equipment protocol service, the equipment protocol service acquires real-time data of each sensor through the configuration data and transmits the real-time data to the edge data fusion service for processing, the data processed by the edge data fusion service generates a message queue through KAFKA service, and the digital twin service simulates the data of the message queue and finally transmits the data to the terminal. The intelligent control type energy-saving and environment-friendly digital twin system unifies intelligent control type energy-saving and environment-friendly equipment, and continuously provides collected equipment data for an energy-saving device system for data calculation and visualization.

title_en: Method for carrying out complex forest plant community sample party investigation based on RTK technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for carrying out complex forest plant community sample side investigation based on an RTK technology. The forest plant community sample side background investigation is a basic premise for carrying out research works such as species investigation, phylogenetic development and evolution, forest community structure analysis, inter-species relationship discrimination, community succession progress, forest plant community change and response under the global climate change background. The forest plant community sample party investigation is carried out on the basis of the RTK technology, so that the efficiency of the forest plant sample party investigation can be effectively improved, and the use convenience is improved; particularly, when the complex group falls down, the system error is effectively reduced, and the investigation cost is reduced; meanwhile, the technical threshold of the operation is reduced, so that the method is convenient for more institutions, research institutions and institutions to use, fills the blank of the actual technical operation in the field, and expands the practical space of the technology.

title_en: Industrial internet post-service knowledge graph analysis platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an industrial internet post-service knowledge graph analysis platform which comprises a processing center module, a graph analysis module, a graph recording module and a graph scanning module, wherein a graph recognition module is arranged between the graph recording module and the processing center module, a graph classification module is arranged in the graph recording module, the graph analysis module is connected with a system resource library through data flow, and the system resource library is connected with an industrial internet resource library. The invention solves the problem that the time efficiency is lower because the knowledge graph needs to be recorded again in the process of analyzing, and the known graph in the industrial Internet resource library is recorded and compared by setting the system resource library and the industrial Internet resource library in one-way supplement relation with the system resource library to form the one-way supplement relation, so that the complex analysis and recording process can be avoided when the corresponding graph is needed, and the acquisition process of the knowledge graph can be convenient.

title_en: Long-tail recommendation method based on collaborative knowledge graph proximity sampling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a long-tail recommendation method based on collaborative knowledge graph proximity sampling, which comprises the following steps: constructing a user-object bipartite graph, a knowledge graph and a collaborative knowledge graph; randomly sampling a synergy path for each user on a synergy graph; calculating the average item popularity of each cooperative path of each user; selecting all article nodes in the path with the lowest average article popularity to replace the original first-order neighbors of the user, and taking the original first-order neighbors as new first-order neighbors of the user; generating attention weight based on the relation between each node and the neighbor node, and aggregating neighbor node information; the target user node and the input self-attention layer are embedded, and the target user in output is embedded as a final user; and performing dot product embedding on the finally obtained user and the article, predicting the interaction score of the user and the article, and taking the top N items of the descending order sequencing set of the prediction scores as recommendation results. On the premise of ensuring the recommendation accuracy, the recommendation performance of long-tail articles is improved.

title_en: BootLoader upgrading method and device, vehicle-mounted navigator and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automobile electronics, and provides a BootLoader upgrading method, a BootLoader upgrading device, a vehicle-mounted navigator and a medium, wherein the BootLoader upgrading method comprises the following steps: when the vehicle-mounted navigator is powered on, a first upgrading request initiated by a server is received, wherein the first upgrading request comprises a first target address, and the first target address is used for designating an address in a special area; based on the first upgrade request, upgrade data sent by a server is received, wherein the upgrade data comprises a target BootLoader for upgrade; storing the target BootLoader into a special area according to the first target address; and upgrading the target BootLoader by using the target BootLoader in the special area. The invention greatly improves the BootLoader upgrading efficiency and reduces the BootLoader upgrading cost.

title_en: Order management method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The application relates to an order management method and system based on big data, comprising the steps of obtaining a current initial setting order, and generating order setting attention data according to order setting process data; acquiring the product characteristics of the current order, acquiring the current actual remark information of the current initial setting order, and generating initial order demand data according to the product characteristics of the current order and the current actual remark information; and screening an initial screening standard order matched with the initial order demand data based on a preset large database, generating current screening order parameter data, generating a current actual screening order, and generating a final screening target order according to the current actual screening order and the current initial setting order. The application realizes recommending a final screening target order which is better and more in line with the actual demands of the user, thereby meeting the setting demands of the user order and realizing the efficient management of the order.

title_en: Model training method and identification method for single-towing operation behavior of fishing boat
abstract_en: The present disclosure proposes a model training method for identifying a single-drag operation behavior of a fishing boat and an identification method of a single-drag operation behavior of a fishing boat, the method comprising obtaining initial historical track data of a sample fishing boat having the single-drag operation behavior; filtering the initial historical track data to obtain target historical track data of the sample fishing boat in single-towing operation; the target historical track data are data of the sample fishing boat in single-towing operation; training the recognition model according to the target historical track data to obtain a trained target recognition model; the recognition model is used for recognizing whether the single drag operation acts or not based on the target historical track data. Therefore, training of the identification model can be achieved, and the prediction effect of the model is improved, namely the accuracy and reliability of the prediction result of the model are improved.

title_en: Method and system for explaining extraction process of remote sensing image elements
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for explaining a remote sensing image element extraction process, which relate to the technical field of remote sensing image processing and comprise the following steps: s1, collecting output of each middle layer in a deep learning model, calling a get_layer () function of a TensorFlow to output and store the characteristics calculated by each middle layer in a matrix form; s2, aggregating the characteristics of the multiple dimensions of the remote sensing image data of each intermediate layer, calculating principal component information of the characteristics of the multiple dimensions of each intermediate layer, restoring the principal component information into principal characteristics corresponding to the principal component information, and visually displaying the principal characteristics; s3, explaining the main characteristics of each intermediate layer based on the main component information and the main characteristics visually displayed; the method solves the problem that the deep learning model cannot show and extract specific elements and the importance degree of each element, and improves the interpretation of the deep learning model in the remote sensing image interpretation process.

title_en: Audio providing method and device based on android system
abstract_en: The invention provides an audio providing method and device based on an android system and a computer readable storage medium. The audio providing method includes the steps of: responding to an audio input focus application of a first upper application with an echo cancellation function or a second upper application without an echo cancellation function, obtaining at least one path of microphone audio and at least one path of corresponding speaker audio in a frame layer of an android system by default, and performing echo cancellation on the microphone audio according to the speaker audio; and transmitting the microphone audio after echo cancellation to the first upper layer application or the second upper layer application according to the audio input focus application. By executing the steps, the audio providing method can reduce the development cost and development difficulty of application of an application layer, reduce the data processing load of the application layer of the android system, and promote the use experience of application programs without customized echo cancellation functions.

title_en: Intelligent control system of automobile air conditioner based on driver state
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent control system of an automobile air conditioner based on a driver state, which relates to the field of intelligent control of automobile air conditioners, wherein a driver concentration state, a driver slight concentration state and a driver serious concentration state corresponding driver state sensing coefficient range are set based on the principle that a driver state sensing coefficient is positively related to the driver concentration degree, the driver state sensing coefficient is acquired according to the acquired driver concentration state, the corresponding driver state is determined according to the acquired driver concentration state, a control instruction corresponding to a preset air outlet mode is output according to the determined driver state, and the driver state is considered into the intelligent control of the automobile air conditioner according to the relation between the driver concentration state and the driver state sensing coefficient, so that the driver concentration is reminded to a certain extent, and the limitation that the traditional air conditioning system does not consider the driver state is overcome.

title_en: Automatic deployment method and system for application program in cloud native
abstract_en: The application discloses an automatic deployment method and system for application programs in cloud native, wherein the method specifically comprises the following steps: establishing an application program mirror image library: the application program component is containerized and the container images are uploaded to an image library for invocation by the container orchestration tool. Container arrangement tool: and adopting a container arranging tool to automatically deploy, stretch and manage in the cluster. Automatic expansion and contraction capacity: and the use condition of cluster resources is monitored, so that automatic capacity expansion and contraction are realized. When the cluster resources are insufficient, new nodes are automatically added, and the quantity of containers is ensured to be suitable for loads. Dynamic load balancing: and dynamic load balancing is realized by adopting strategies such as elastic load balancing, service discovery and the like, so that the requests can be uniformly distributed to different container examples. By comprehensively applying the technical means and measures, the cloud-protogenesis-based automatic application program deployment can realize rapid, flexible and reliable application program deployment.

title_en: Layout design method for reducing SAR ADC capacitance mismatch
abstract_en: The invention discloses a layout design method for reducing SAR ADC capacitance mismatch, which comprises the following steps: and determining the number of unit capacitors contained in each capacitor according to the capacitor array structure, extracting parasitic capacitors for capacitor array layout and wiring, performing data analysis, and determining whether the designed layout meets the requirements according to the data analysis result. According to the design method, the relation between the parasitic capacitances is subjected to data processing, so that the influence of the parasitic capacitances on mismatch can be intuitively displayed, and the direction is indicated for improvement of the layout. Compared with the traditional method for increasing the unit capacitance size, the layout designed by the invention can improve the matching property of the capacitor without increasing the area of the capacitor array, thereby reducing the influence of parasitic capacitance on SAR ADC results and improving the dynamic performance of an ADC system.

title_en: Target detection method under weak alignment of visible light-infrared image
abstract_en: The invention relates to a target detection method under weak alignment of visible light-infrared images, and belongs to the technical field of image processing based on deep learning. Inputting the visible light and infrared images into a feature extraction network, and extracting global features of the visible light and infrared images; inputting the visible light image into an illumination sensing module, and extracting illumination information; inputting the visible light and infrared image features into a multi-scale space alignment module for feature alignment to obtain visible light and infrared image features aligned under the same potential physical space; inputting the visible light and infrared image characteristics into a characteristic fusion module, and fusing target complementary information of the visible light and infrared image characteristics to obtain a fused characteristic diagram; the illumination information and the feature map are input to a detector for target detection. The invention can effectively align the characteristics of each dimension of the visible light and infrared images in the characteristic layer, and enhance the detection robustness of the target detector to the visible light and infrared images with misaligned information of each dimension.

title_en: Pedestrian re-identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pedestrian re-recognition method, which belongs to the field of computer vision and adopts a recognition terminal and a recognition system for the recognition terminal, and comprises the following steps of 1, preparing training data sets, namely preparing Market-1501, dukemtmc-Reid and Cuhk03 data sets, training the data sets, preprocessing the data sets before training, including image preprocessing and data enhancement, and 2, building a posture estimation algorithm, training and optimizing. Appearance modeling matching under different postures is achieved by adopting a posture estimation algorithm, field-adaptive pedestrian re-recognition is achieved, better recognition effect and robustness are achieved, a portable pedestrian re-recognition device can be manufactured, stable and high-accuracy identity recognition is carried out on pedestrians in a real-time video stream by means of the combination of the device, requirements of people on pedestrian re-recognition under various scenes can be met, and the device has high practicability and application prospects.

title_en: Data attack processing method and system applied to intelligent cloud
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and discloses a data attack processing method and system applied to intelligent cloud, wherein the method comprises the following steps: knowledge extraction is carried out on the historical attack data of the intelligent cloud, so that knowledge data of the historical attack data are obtained; carrying out data fusion on the knowledge data to obtain fusion data of the knowledge data, and generating a historical knowledge graph of historical attack data according to the fusion data; acquiring real-time attack events of the intelligent cloud, and generating event attack numbers of the real-time attack events according to a preset attack number algorithm; generating an attack path of a real-time attack event, and carrying out map updating on the historical knowledge map according to the attack path and the event attack number to obtain an updated knowledge map of the historical knowledge map; and generating an intrusion attack sequence of the intelligent cloud according to the updated knowledge graph, and carrying out data attack processing on the intelligent cloud by utilizing the intrusion attack sequence. The method and the device can improve the accuracy of data attack processing applied to the intelligent cloud.

title_en: Training and predicting method of intelligent prediction model of drilling overflow working condition and underground overflow risk prediction system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a training and predicting method of an intelligent predicting model for drilling overflow working conditions and an underground overflow risk predicting system, which comprise the following steps: data preprocessing, training a machine learning group intelligent model, taking an optimal fusion model, predicting the optimal fusion model and visualizing. The overflow condition can be monitored in real time, advanced prediction of overflow can be realized, the overflow occurrence probability in the current and future time periods can be visualized, and a targeted AI operation suggestion can be given when the overflow condition is predicted, so that overflow is further prevented; the invention fuses and improves a plurality of machine learning models, wherein most of mainstream prediction algorithms are summarized, training and new sample data prediction evaluation are carried out according to logging data provided by a user, and an optimal fusion model is combined through a plurality of error evaluation results.

title_en: Obstetrical surgery monitoring method, system and related equipment based on image processing
abstract_en: The application provides an obstetrical operation monitoring method, system and related equipment based on image processing, which are characterized in that an obstetrical operation image is subjected to brightness division and reinforcement treatment, so that an obstetrical operation brightness reinforcement image is determined, an obstetrical operation brightness reinforcement image is subjected to operation knife characteristic conversion, an obstetrical operation knife image characteristic matrix is obtained, an obstetrical operation knife image characteristic deviation coefficient of the obstetrical operation knife image characteristic matrix is determined, so that an obstetrical operation knife image characteristic deviation matrix is determined, an obstetrical operation knife characteristic reinforcement image is determined, an obstetrical operation knife meat-in value and an obstetrical operation knife inclination angle are determined according to the obstetrical operation knife characteristic reinforcement image, an obstetrical operation knife meat-in dangerous value is calculated according to the obstetrical operation knife meat-in dangerous value and the obstetrical operation knife meat-in dangerous threshold interval, and obstetrical operation monitoring is performed on the obstetrical operation according to the obstetrical operation knife meat-in dangerous value and the predetermined obstetrical operation knife meat-in dangerous threshold interval, so that the accuracy of obstetrical operation monitoring can be improved.

title_en: Construction method of wound data security risk assessment system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the field of medical data security, and provides a method for constructing a wound data security risk assessment system and electronic equipment, wherein the method for constructing the system comprises the following steps: acquiring entity characteristics and characteristic types of the entity characteristics in reply information of preset interview contents; hierarchical clustering is carried out on the entity characteristics to obtain a plurality of clustering clusters; obtaining a multi-level safety management theme based on the cluster and preset interview content; determining objective weights of current safety treatment topics based on the feature types in the corresponding cluster in each safety treatment topic, and carrying out objective weighting marking on the safety treatment topics; calculating subjective weight of a safety management subject with objective weighting marks; and merging the objective weight and the subjective weight to obtain a weight coefficient of the safety treatment theme so as to obtain the wound data safety risk assessment system. The method can take subjective and objective aspects into consideration, so that the weight coefficient of the safety treatment theme is more scientific and accords with the actual condition of wound data safety.

title_en: Comprehensive layout optimization method for meteorological monitoring points along rail transit line
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of rail transit, and aims to provide a comprehensive layout optimization method for meteorological monitoring points along a rail transit, which can be used for laying the meteorological monitoring points at low cost and accurately meeting risk monitoring requirements of each section of a line. The technical scheme is that the comprehensive layout optimization method for the meteorological monitoring points along the track traffic line comprises the following steps: step S01: specifying a point position mark; step S02: constructing a line weather risk fuzzy Bayesian network; step S03: dividing a line evaluation section and determining the state of a root node; step S04: acquiring the risk probability of the meteorological element condition of the evaluation section; step S05: giving out a new weather monitoring point layout suggestion; step S06: existing weather monitoring point optimization based on the mixed similarity measure; step S07: and (5) comprehensive layout.

title_en: License plate recognition method, license plate recognition device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a license plate recognition method, a device and a storage medium, which are used for recognizing license plates of non-motor vehicles or motorcycles and comprise the following steps: s1, detecting targets of non-motor vehicles and/or motor vehicle license plates in videos by using a license plate detection model; s2, tracking a plurality of video frames in real time by using a tracking algorithm, and associating the same license plate in the plurality of video frames; s3, license plate content recognition is carried out on the same license plate in each video frame related to the same license plate by using a license plate recognition model, and recognition confidence is obtained; s4, determining license plate position weights according to positions of the same license plate in each video frame; and S5, determining license plate contents serving as final recognition results of the same license plate according to the product of the recognition confidence and the license plate position weight. By utilizing the technical scheme, the license plate recognition accuracy in the running process of a non-motor vehicle or a motorcycle in a complex scene can be improved.

title_en: Processing method, device, equipment and medium of game data refreshing system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of data refreshing systems, in particular to a processing method, a device, equipment and a medium of a game data refreshing system, wherein the method specifically comprises the following steps: according to each female module and the corresponding sub-module of the game function module set, constructing a refreshing prompt architecture corresponding to the hierarchical relationship based on the prefix tree structure at the data structure layer; the detection driving layer monitors the refresh prompt architecture, and detects the data node triggering the refresh detection event in the refresh prompt architecture when the processing time of the data node triggering the refresh detection event in the refresh prompt architecture reaches a first time threshold; and the refreshing expression layer informs the game function module corresponding to the data node in the state to be detected to display the prompting special effect according to the callback function list. The invention realizes the efficient and smooth refreshing prompt special effect display effect based on the data structure layer, the detection driving layer and the refreshing expression layer of the game data refreshing system.

title_en: Language generation method and device based on computer database and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a language generation method, a language generation device, a physical space relation model construction method and a physical space relation model construction device based on a computer database, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a physical space relation model based on the space position relation among entities in a real scene, and storing the physical space relation model in the database; searching a target node and an auxiliary node with a mapping relation with the target node in a database through the mapping relation based on an entity word data set, searching directed edges associated with the target node and the auxiliary node from the directed edge data set based on the mapping relation, generating a data segment describing the spatial position relation of the target node through the target node, the auxiliary node and the directed edges, and generating a statement describing the spatial position relation of the target node after encoding the data segment based on an encoder. The method and the device enable the language generation process to be more accurate, the position relation among the entities to be clearer, and the position recognition rate among the entities to be greatly improved.

title_en: Curve structure segmentation method based on skeleton and boundary enhancement
abstract_en: Aiming at the problems of low boundary precision, poor topological connectivity, difficult segmentation of narrow curve branches and the like in curve structure segmentation, the invention provides a curve structure segmentation method based on boundary and skeleton enhancement. The invention builds Skeleton and Edge Boosted Network (SEBN), which is based on a coder-decoder architecture, with encoders for generating features of different scales, and three decoding heads designed in the decoder: a curve segmentation head, a boundary detection head and a skeleton extraction head. The skeleton extraction head relieves the problem of unbalanced branch scale in curve structure segmentation, and improves the connectivity of curve segmentation; the edge detection head focuses on edge features to accurately locate the edges of curved objects. Importantly, the invention integrates the two solution wharfs and the curve segmentation Head into Three-Head-fusion-Module (THFM) to realize Three-feature fusion, the model decoder consists of four THFM which are connected in series, three-feature exchange is carried out on different scales of the decoder, and high-quality curve structure segmentation is realized. In addition, in the SEBN test stage, a signature-supply-Module (SSM) is designed at the end of the SEBN, and skeleton prediction is used for supplementing segmentation prediction. The method can be used for curve structure segmentation such as medical blood vessel segmentation, road crack detection and the like, and can obtain high-quality curve structure segmentation results.

title_en: Event detection method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses an event detection method and electronic equipment, which are used for improving event detection efficiency. The event detection method comprises the steps of determining at least one frame of collected image acquired for a monitored target scene, detecting markers of the image by a deep learning network based on the at least one frame of collected image, determining image position information of at least one marker, determining an image detection area of an event by utilizing the image position information of the at least one marker, and detecting the event for pedestrians in the image detection area. The technical scheme provided by the application has the characteristics of real-time performance, reproducibility and controllability, and accords with the reliability.

title_en: Medical text labeling method and device based on label knowledge base
abstract_en: The application provides a medical text labeling method and a medical text labeling device based on a label knowledge base, which are used for automatically pre-labeling an acquired medical text to be labeled through a pre-established label knowledge base to obtain a text with a first label and/or a first relationship label pre-label; the manual auditing and adjusting operation is supported to be carried out on the pre-marked text so as to generate a second label mark and/or a second relation mark; finally, obtaining an annotation text according to a first label annotation and/or a first relation annotation of the pre-annotation text and a second label annotation and/or a second relation annotation generated by the adjustment operation of the pre-annotation text; the method and the device adopt a scheme of pre-labeling and manual auditing operation based on a label knowledge base, complete the rapid high-quality labeling work of the medical texts, save the work of manually labeling each word and each sentence of the text to be labeled one by one, greatly improve the reading speed and efficiency of scientific researchers and avoid omission.

title_en: Data file writing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data file writing method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: responding to a writing request of a data file, and calling a writing interface of a communication-based train control CBTC signal system, wherein the CBTC signal system is based on a two-by-two-out-of-two security platform; receiving target data to be written through the writing interface; executing the writing operation of the target data according to the period on the two-by-two-out-of-two security platform; and reading a primary system check result and a backup system check result which are respectively output by the primary system and the backup system of the two-by-two access two security platform, and generating a writing result of the target data according to the primary system check result and the backup system check result. The invention solves the technical problem that the related technology can not safely write data in the CBTC signal system, and improves the safety and reliability of the system.

title_en: Training method of text classification model, text classification method and device
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a training method of a text classification model, a text classification method and a device, relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and particularly relates to the technical fields of natural language processing, machine learning and the like. The implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring a sample set; at least one adjustment to parameters of the first text classification model based on the sample set to obtain a trained second text classification model, each adjustment comprising: adjusting parameters of a current first text classification model by using a first subset of the current sample set to obtain an adjusted text classification model; determining a first evaluation value of each first output category of the adjusted text classification model by using a second subset of the current sample set; deleting a sample of which the class label is the first output class from the current sample set in response to the first evaluation value of any first output class being less than a threshold value; and determining the adjusted text classification model as a second text classification model in response to the first evaluation value of each first output category being greater than or equal to the threshold.

title_en: Target re-recognition model training method, target re-recognition method and control device
abstract_en: The invention provides a target re-identification model training method, a target re-identification method and a control device, wherein the target re-identification model training method comprises the steps of training a homography model; training the target re-identification model, wherein the homography model and the target re-identification model use the same backbone network for characteristic feature extraction during training. The homography model and the target re-recognition model share the same backbone network for feature extraction in the training process, so that the target re-recognition model has better generalization capability when processing target images under different camera view angles, and the recognition capability of the target re-recognition model on the same target under different view angles is improved.

title_en: Product transaction method, apparatus, computer device, storage medium, and program product
abstract_en: The present application relates to a product transaction method, apparatus, computer device, storage medium and program product for product transaction efficiency. Relates to the technical field of meta-universe, and the method comprises the following steps: if the meta-universe platform of the product transaction of the target user is detected, acquiring the identity information and the historical transaction information of the target user and the affordable risk level information of the target user on the product transaction; determining a target virtual role of the target user in the meta-universe platform and a dedicated service object corresponding to the target virtual role according to the identity information and the affordable risk level information of the target user; and assisting the target user to conduct product transaction according to the historical transaction information of the target user through the exclusive service object. The method can improve the product transaction efficiency.

title_en: Narrow-band random process teaching method based on radar signal echo simulation software
abstract_en: The application discloses a narrow-band random process teaching method based on radar signal echo simulation software, belonging to the field of teaching; the method comprises the following steps: firstly, developing a simulation software for analyzing the statistical characteristics of a microwave imaging radar signal, and applying the simulation software to the teaching of a narrow-band random process; then, a ground scene simulation module and an intermediate frequency echo signal simulation module in simulation software are applied to concept teaching, a narrow-band random process is generated, and a spectrogram, an autocorrelation function and the like are drawn; then, the intermediate frequency echo signal simulation module is applied to statistical property teaching, the statistical properties of the narrow-band random process are visualized, and the statistical properties such as an autocorrelation function, a power spectrum and the like are drawn; finally, the video echo signal simulation module is applied to the in-phase component and quadrature component statistical characteristic teaching, and the statistical characteristics such as an autocorrelation function, a power spectrum and the like of the in-phase component and the quadrature component are drawn; meanwhile, each teaching process student can adjust parameters by itself, so that abstract concepts are more visualized and intuitive.

title_en: Data processing method, device, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a data processing method, a data processing device, electronic equipment and a medium, relates to the technical field of computers, and particularly relates to the fields of automatic driving and intelligent transportation. The implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring risk information in driving scene data of a driving scene; determining a risk factor set based on the risk information, the risk factor set including risk factors present in the driving scenario data; and generating a simulated risk scene based on the risk factor set, the simulated risk scene reflecting at least one risk factor in the risk factor set.

title_en: Underwater structured light combined imaging method capable of completely removing back scattering
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater structured light combined imaging method capable of completely removing back scattering, which comprises the following steps of structured light scanning imaging: continuously emitting structural light with structural light bars to the surface of a target object in the moving process by a light source, realizing continuous scanning of the target object, acquiring frame images continuously scanned by the structural light by a camera at a matched frame rate, synthesizing the structural light bars of all frame images, and obtaining a complete synthesized image of the scanned surface of the target object; flood illumination imaging: the light source emits illumination light to the same surface of the target object, and the camera shoots the target object and acquires a floodlight image of the illuminated surface of the target object; and (3) removing back scattering: and determining the backscattering proportion relation between the composite image and the floodlight image, and performing difference between the composite image and the floodlight image to remove the backscattering of the imaging of the underwater target object. The invention uses the structure light scanning imaging prior forward scattering distribution and restores when deconvolution, and uses the integral operation of scanning frame images to overcome the problem of uneven underwater illumination intensity distribution.

title_en: Heavy-duty train speed tracking control method for long and large downhill circulating braking
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heavy-duty train speed tracking control method for long and large downhill circulating braking, which is characterized in that a heavy-duty train speed tracking controller is designed based on an interference observer and a self-adaptive iterative learning method, the self-adaptation of controller parameters is effectively carried out by utilizing information in the running process of a train, the judgment of the application time of air braking is independent of the accurate modeling of an air braking system of the heavy-duty train, the judgment of the application time of air braking is independent of experience time, and the accurate tracking control of the speed and the position of the train is realized. The invention provides a control decision judgment standard for the cyclic braking and alleviation of the heavy-duty train when running on a long and large downhill slope, and ensures the running safety of the train.

title_en: Aviation parameter traceability entity identification method based on deep learning
