abstract_en: An aviation parameter traceability entity identification method based on deep learning comprises the following steps of S1: the method comprises the steps of providing an AeroBERT pre-training language model oriented to the aviation field, introducing the character pattern characteristics of Chinese characters in word embedding, and pre-training by adopting an inter-point information mask strategy; s2: providing an AeroBERT-CRF-based aviation parameter traceability entity identification model, fine-tuning the AeroBERT after pre-training, and introducing an optimal label of a CRF layer prediction entity; s3: and manually labeling a small amount of aviation parameter traceability training data set, and introducing an active learning algorithm in the model training process to expand the scale of the training set and improve the generalization capability of the model. The invention has better entity recognition performance, meets the entity recognition requirement of aviation text, provides support for automatic extraction of metering traceability information, and lays a foundation for downstream tasks such as knowledge graph construction, question-answering system and the like.

title_en: Text deduplication method for open source information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a text deduplication method for open source information, which comprises the following steps: establishing an open source information text set; establishing a professional fieldA word stock base set; establishing a temporary expansion set; establishing a professional field word stock; word segmentation is carried out on the texts in the open source information text set by utilizing a universal dictionary and a word stock in the professional field; calculating a TFIDF value of the non-stop word in the document j; the TFIDF value is used as the information weight of vocabulary i in document j The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Calculating simhash feature vectors, text similarity and text information quantity of the document j; for any document, a similarity threshold is set, the document with the similarity larger than the threshold is identified as repeated document, the metadata is combined for the repeated documents, the document with the largest text information amount is selected for reservation, and the combined metadata is attached as the metadata of the reserved document. By the method, metadata in the material can be effectively reserved during deduplication, and information loss caused by the deduplication of the material is avoided.

title_en: Screenshot processing method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of big data and the field of financial science and technology, and relates to a screenshot processing method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring screenshot condition information of a screenshot request; acquiring a target v i deo element in a target webpage; creating a target canvas element based on the target vi deo element; if the screenshot request information is static screenshot, processing a target vi deo element and a target canvas element by using an htm l 2canvas tool based on a first screenshot mode to generate a corresponding first screenshot picture; if the screenshot request information is a dynamic screenshot, processing the target vi deo element and the target canvas element by using an htm l 2canvas tool based on a second screenshot mode to generate a corresponding second screenshot picture. The application also provides a screenshot processing device, computer equipment and a storage medium. In addition, the application also relates to a blockchain technology, and the screenshot pictures can be stored in the blockchain. The method and the device can be applied to the webpage screenshot scene in the financial field, can realize rapid generation of the screenshot picture corresponding to the screenshot request, and improve the processing efficiency of generating the screenshot picture.

title_en: Lightweight model training method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lightweight model training method, a device, equipment and a medium, wherein the training method comprises the following steps: constructing an image classification lightweight model based on the image classification large model, and respectively inputting training data into the image classification large model and the image classification lightweight model to obtain final loss of an image classification task; constructing a target detection lightweight model based on the target detection large model, and respectively inputting training data into the target detection large model and the target detection lightweight model to obtain the final loss of a target detection task; and carrying out weighted summation on the final loss of the image classification task and the final loss of the target detection task to obtain joint task loss, and updating parameters in the image classification lightweight model and the target detection lightweight model by adopting a gradient descent method based on the joint task loss. The invention can improve the effect of the lightweight model.

title_en: Multi-complexity behavior recognition system and method based on self-adaptive feature extraction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-complexity behavior recognition system and method based on self-adaptive feature extraction, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, wherein the system comprises a human behavior data acquisition module, a human behavior data transmission module, a human behavior data storage module, a human behavior data preprocessing module, an MFAEF simple human behavior recognition network module, an LSGRA complex behavior recognition network module and a human behavior information application module; the MFAEF simple behavior recognition network module comprises a feature pre-extraction unit, a parallel multidimensional space-time feature extraction multiplexing unit, a self-adaptive multidimensional space-time feature extraction unit, a feature fusion unit and a simple behavior discrimination output unit which are connected in sequence; the LSGRA complex behavior recognition network module comprises a single-window simple behavior feature acquisition unit, a circulating multi-window attention unit and a complex behavior discrimination output unit which are connected in sequence. The invention adopts the structure to make up for the defects of high cost, easy interference and poor privacy of behavior identification based on vision.

title_en: Satellite automatic scheduling method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a satellite automatic scheduling method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the driving template is called, and a node range and a criterion index range are obtained from the driving template; defining an execution flow of a scheduling task according to the node range and the criterion index range; registering a timing scheduling task according to the execution flow; and executing the timing scheduling task on the appointed satellite according to the flow node in the execution flow and the criterion index in the execution flow. By adopting the embodiment of the invention, the flow of the scheduling task is defined through the driving template, the timing scheduling task is registered according to the execution flow, and the corresponding timing scheduling task can be automatically executed for the appointed satellite at the preset moment through the nodes and the criterion indexes in the execution flow, so that a large number of operations such as manual parameter setting are avoided at each node or link, and the manual operation amount is reduced.

title_en: User interest recognition method and device
abstract_en: According to the user interest identification method and device, in view of the fact that the active debugging examples and the passive debugging examples of the push interest identification network application are priori user page interactive behavior images in the target page service session, the information bearing capacity is rich, and the method and device can comprise all target page attention item information in the target page service session, so that mining analysis of page attention items is facilitated. The push interest recognition networks for completing debugging can recognize target page attention matters from different ideas so as to accurately, comprehensively and rapidly determine the push interest item recognition views of the target page attention matters, and further improve the push interest mining quality of page service users aiming at the page service users to be subjected to push interest recognition processing.

title_en: Abnormal webpage detection method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to an abnormal webpage detection method, an abnormal webpage detection device, computer equipment, storage media and a computer program product. Relates to the field of artificial intelligence, and can be applied to vehicle-mounted scenes. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining image low-dimensional features and image high-dimensional features of each marked webpage image, then matching feature clustering results of the low-dimensional features of each image with feature clustering results of the high-dimensional features of each image to obtain feature clustering result matching pairs, determining image clustering results of each marked webpage image based on the feature clustering result matching pairs, respectively constructing clustering feature vectors of each marked webpage image, and carrying out anomaly detection on unlabeled webpage images through the clustering feature vectors to obtain anomaly webpage detection results. According to the clustering method for extracting the differential content features, the low-dimensional features and the high-dimensional features of the images are fused, so that more accurate and rich clustering results are obtained, and the accuracy of detecting the abnormal web pages based on clustering is improved.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring system for aquaculture
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent monitoring of aquaculture, in particular to an intelligent monitoring system of aquaculture. The system comprises a visual perception module, a light intensity factor acquisition module, a region division module, a region correction module and a water body abnormal region acquisition module. The visual perception module is used for acquiring a water surface image and a corresponding water surface area; the light intensity factor acquisition module is used for calculating a light intensity factor based on the minimum standard voltage, the maximum standard voltage and the real-time standard voltage under outdoor light intensity; the area dividing module is used for analyzing the water surface area to obtain a light reflecting area and a non-light reflecting area; the region correction module is used for correcting the brightness value of the region according to the gamma correction index obtained by calculation; the water body abnormal region acquisition module is used for acquiring the corrected water body abnormal region in the water surface region. According to the invention, by correcting the water surface area of water surface cultivation, the accuracy of detecting the abnormality of the water surface area is improved, the real-time monitoring is realized, and the interference of dynamic objects is eliminated.

title_en: Motion microwave detection method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a motion microwave detection method and a motion microwave detection system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the terminal equipment periodically transmits a plurality of microwave signals to a test object, wherein the frequency of each microwave signal in the plurality of microwave signals is different, and a plurality of reflected signals corresponding to the plurality of microwave signals are received; the terminal equipment determines signals with the same frequency in the plurality of microwave signals and the plurality of reflected signals as a group to obtain a plurality of signal groups, wherein each signal group comprises a microwave signal and a reflected signal; the terminal equipment acquires a plurality of time groups in a plurality of signal groups, wherein each time group comprises: a transmission time of a microwave signal and a reception time of a reflected signal; and determining a first gesture of the test object according to the plurality of groups of time groups and the microwave transmitting direction, generating a control command corresponding to the first gesture, and transmitting the control command to gateway equipment. The technical scheme provided by the application has the advantage of improving the user.

title_en: Combined simulation and detection method for thermoelectric magnetic field of motor and controller for vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined simulation and detection method of a thermoelectric magnetic field of a motor and a control machine for a vehicle, which comprises a shell of the motor, wherein two bearings are arranged in the shell, rotatable rotors are arranged in the middle of the two bearings, stators are arranged outside the rotors, one ends of the rotors penetrating through the bearings are connected with fans in a threaded manner, a sealing mechanism is arranged on one side of the shell, a placing rack is arranged at the bottom of the shell, and a heat dissipation assembly is arranged outside the placing rack. The invention has the advantages of stable placement, good internal dustproof effect, high cleaning efficiency, good heat dissipation effect, prolonged service life of the motor for the vehicle, auxiliary cleaning, heat dissipation cleaning of peripheral devices, reduction of economic loss of detection in real environment, early warning in advance, automatic backup of detection information, data safety guarantee, networking for providing a solution in an abnormal state, and improvement of problem solving efficiency.

title_en: Method for measuring concentration of trace-level sulfur dioxide in air
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of materials tested by utilizing optical means, in particular to a method for measuring trace-level sulfur dioxide concentration in air, which comprises the steps of firstly analyzing spectrum curves under different sulfur dioxide concentrations and determining each data interval of the spectrum curves; then, a target data interval is obtained according to the change of the data interval, and then the noise influence degree is obtained according to the change of the target data interval of different sulfur dioxide concentrations; based on the noise influence degree, denoising each reference infrared spectrum curve and each detection infrared spectrum curve by utilizing wavelet transformation, and determining the concentration of trace-level sulfur dioxide to be detected based on the spectral data after denoising. According to the invention, the noise influence degree determined by analyzing the spectrum curves under different sulfur dioxide concentrations is utilized, the noise removal effect of spectrum data is enhanced, the accuracy of trace-level sulfur dioxide concentration measurement results is further improved, and the method is mainly applied to the field of air quality detection.

title_en: Tunnel seepage deformation monitoring technical system and method based on LSTM neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel seepage deformation monitoring technical system and a tunnel seepage deformation monitoring method based on an LSTM (least squares) neural network, wherein the system comprises the following components: the system comprises an acquisition module, a processing module, a prediction module and an alarm module; the acquisition module is used for acquiring the original data of the karst tunnel in real time; the processing module is used for processing and calculating indexes of the original data acquired in real time; the prediction module is used for predicting the future trend of karst tunnel seepage according to the processed original data and the index calculation result; the alarm module is used for carrying out preventive alarm according to karst tunnel seepage trend prediction results. The invention effectively improves the safety and reliability of karst tunnels.

title_en: Electrical equipment multi-parameter transmitter simulation installation evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a simulation installation evaluation method and system for a multi-parameter transmitter of electrical equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a first neural network model for extracting the characteristic representation of the installation mode and a second neural network model for extracting the characteristic representation of the measurement process based on the data acquired by the standard transmitter and the measured transmitter; and sorting the output results of the two neural network models and target value data for evaluation into a new data set, and constructing a third neural network model, wherein the third neural network model comprises an input layer, a difference layer, a fusion layer and an output layer. The invention provides a more scientific, objective and comprehensive method for evaluating the installation and measurement process of the transmitter to be tested, reduces the influence of human subjective factors, improves the repeatability and accuracy of evaluation, and simultaneously can more effectively process a large amount of data and reduce the waste of time and human resources by applying the neural network model.

title_en: Park security monitoring system and method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of digital image processing, in particular to a park security monitoring system and method based on the Internet of things, wherein a data acquisition module is used for shooting video pictures in a park as original video data, a data storage module is used for storing the original video data according to a preset storage mode, a data transmission module is used for sending marked video data to an image processing module according to the preset transmission mode, the image processing module is used for encrypting a target linked list according to an encryption mode, the data transmission module is also used for determining a transmission mode of the target video data according to abnormal behavior parameters, an abnormal recognition module is used for determining a compression mode of the marked video data according to similarity vectors, an abnormal alarm module is used for determining an alarm mode according to the image similarity and giving an alarm, the technical problems of low abnormal recognition accuracy and low consumption cost of the park security monitoring system are solved, and the technical effect of intelligently recognizing abnormal behaviors in real time is achieved.

title_en: Real-time transmission and visual communication system for road surface three-dimensional information detection data
abstract_en: The application discloses a real-time transmission and visualization communication system for road surface three-dimensional information detection data, which comprises a vehicle-mounted detection terminal, a communication transmission module and a display terminal; the vehicle-mounted detection terminal is used for collecting road video images; the vehicle-mounted detection terminal extracts position coordinates of the laser lines frame by adopting a zero-crossing road laser line extraction algorithm for a road laser line video sequence acquired by the infrared camera, establishes a relation between depth and the pixel height of the laser line image through depth calibration, and generates ordered three-dimensional point cloud data of the road surface laser lines by combining time sequence information in video frames; and the communication transmission module encodes and transmits the ordered three-dimensional point cloud data of the road surface laser line to the display terminal, and the display terminal decodes, splices and visualizes the data. According to the application, the ordered three-dimensional point cloud data of the road surface generated by the extracted laser line is remotely transmitted, so that the transmitted data quantity is greatly reduced, and the transmission speed of the road surface detection data is improved.

title_en: Method and apparatus for encoding and method and apparatus for decoding
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and means may be provided to ignore coding information and/or reconstructed samples from spatially adjacent ones that span a surface discontinuity. It may be determined whether the current block is located at a surface discontinuity. The surface discontinuity may be a surface boundary between two or more adjacent tiles, wherein the two or more adjacent tiles may not be spherical neighbors. The coding availability of a neighboring block to the current block may be determined, for example, based on whether the neighboring block is on the same side of the face discontinuity as the current block. For example, if the neighboring block is on the same side of the face discontinuity as the current block, it may be determined that the neighboring block is available for decoding the current block, and if the neighboring block is not on the same side of the face discontinuity, the neighboring block is not available. The neighboring blocks may be spatial neighboring blocks or temporal neighboring blocks.

title_en: Testing method and device of cloud edge cooperative system, storage medium and equipment
abstract_en: The specification discloses a testing method, a testing device, a storage medium and testing equipment of a cloud edge cooperative system. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a test warehouse according to each test element, wherein the test elements comprise: the method comprises the steps of constructing configuration files containing various test configurations according to different element values corresponding to test elements, detecting whether each test configuration has errors according to the test parameter constants, if not, reading the load files from a storage path of the test load, calling Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) of each function in the cloud-edge cooperative system to be tested, sequentially executing test flows for each function based on the load files, pulling test data of each function, and processing the test data according to the statistical information corresponding to the test configuration and the test indexes to obtain test results of the test configuration on the cloud-edge cooperative system.

title_en: Linear crack extraction method for asphalt pavement detection image under non-uniform illumination
abstract_en: The application provides a linear crack extraction method for an asphalt pavement detection image under non-uniform illumination, and belongs to the technical field of image processing. S1, processing pavement disease images to obtain a ground area image matrix and an illumination area image matrix; s2, converting the image matrix from a time domain matrix to a frequency domain matrix, determining a frequency threshold value, generating a new frequency domain matrix, and converting the frequency domain matrix to the time domain matrix; s3, extracting high-frequency components of the image, and removing an illumination area to obtain an image for eliminating illumination non-uniformity; s4, training a linear crack image recognition model, and outputting an RGB image containing the linear crack; s5, converting the RGB image into a gray image; s6, obtaining a new binarized image; s7, training a linear crack extraction model, and outputting a linear crack in the image. The method solves the problem of low accuracy of linear crack identification caused by poor image quality due to uneven illumination, and realizes effective extraction of the crack region.

title_en: Space target behavior monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space target behavior monitoring method, which relates to the technical field of target monitoring, and accurately predicts the state of a target through a nonlinear state evolution function, external input and process noise, an observation equation describes the relation between observation data and the state of the target, the state of the target is mapped to the observation data by using the nonlinear observation function, meanwhile, the influence of the observation noise is added, a Kalman filtering algorithm is adopted to track the target, state estimation and covariance update are carried out, kalman filtering is carried out through the state equation, the state estimation is carried out by using the observation data to update the state estimation, the target tracking is realized, a deep reinforcement learning agent is adopted, a state space, an action space and a reward function are established, then output information is fused, a real-time decision is made by using a Bayesian decision theory, whether the target behavior accords with the expected and predicted future behavior is monitored, and more accurate target behavior estimation and more targeted real-time decision is provided.

title_en: Multi-mode pre-training method for document understanding
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of document reading, in particular to a multi-mode pre-training method for document understanding. The method comprises the following steps: s1: the CNN architecture of the image feature extraction module is improved by taking ResNet-50 as a main trunk network; s2: adopting a pre-training model transducer as a trunk model, and extracting global features of the image through a residual convolution network; s3: introducing a spatial attention mechanism into a transducer pre-training model, and learning hidden layer characteristics among a plurality of transducer layers through a THL module; s4: the Res-THL network is pre-trained by means of a data set. According to the multi-mode pre-training method for document understanding, through the transform hidden layer learning module, a spatial attention mechanism is introduced to adaptively learn layout features and text features contained in the transform hidden layer; and simultaneously, a new residual error network module is provided, so that the capability of the model to learn image features is improved.

title_en: Deep learning question-answering method, device and system based on massive knowledge patterns
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning question-answering method, device and system based on a massive knowledge graph, which are used for obtaining a first entity and a first entity relation by calling a preset named entity recognition model to conduct deep learning recognition processing on a first problem text obtained after text pretreatment; and searching the first entity and the first entity relation through a preset search model to obtain a first candidate answer set, and performing iterative training on the first entity, the first entity relation and the first candidate answer set after obtaining until an output answer text is obtained and is used as the first answer text to be output and displayed. The invention simplifies and definitely processes the problem input by the user through the text preprocessing and named entity recognition model, improves the accuracy and efficiency of obtaining the relation between the first entity and the first entity, and further improves the matching degree of the obtained answer text and the problem text input by the user through the retrieval model and the cyclic iteration training.

title_en: Lightning arrester defect identification method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method, a device and electronic equipment for identifying defects of a lightning arrester, wherein the method trains an initial defect identification model by acquiring target defect sample data formed by a plurality of characteristic parameter data of the lightning arrester as training sample data so as to obtain a target defect identification model. When the potential defects of the lightning arrester are required to be identified, the characteristic parameter data of a plurality of types generated by the target lightning arrester currently are input into the target defect identification model, and the defect types of the target lightning arrester are output by means of the target defect identification model. By adopting the embodiment of the application, the defect identification model is constructed by means of the characteristic parameter data generated by each lightning arrester in the power system, and the defect type of the target lightning arrester can be accurately identified by means of the identification model and the characteristic parameter data generated by the target lightning arrester, so that the stability of the power system is improved.

title_en: Verification system and verification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a verification system and a verification method, wherein the verification system comprises a first test interface module, a rate conversion module, a FPGA verification platform, a second test interface module and a verification module, wherein the first test interface module is used for receiving test data, obtaining a first digital signal according to the test data, the first digital signal is transmitted to the FPGA verification platform through the rate conversion module, the FPGA verification platform carries out logic operation on the first digital signal to obtain a second digital signal, the second digital signal is transmitted to the second test interface module through the rate conversion module, the second test interface module obtains verification data according to the second digital signal, the verification data is provided to the verification module, the verification module is used for judging whether the verification data meets preset conditions to obtain a simulation verification result, a first transmission rate is arranged between the rate conversion module and the first test interface module and the second test interface module, a second transmission rate is arranged between the rate conversion module and the FPGA verification platform, and the first transmission rate is larger than the second transmission rate, so that an ASIC (application specific integrated circuit) is easy to transplant, verification reliability is enhanced, and development period is saved.

title_en: Improved DETR-based detection method for water surface ship
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection method of a water surface ship based on improved DETR. Preparing a marked ship image data set; constructing an improved DETR model, wherein a backbone network of the improved DETR model adopts ResNet, and a middle part of the improved DETR model adopts a transducer, wherein the transducer adopts 3 Encoder layers and 3 Decoder layers; training an improved DETR model using the marine image dataset; detecting the water surface ship in the target detection image by adopting a trained improved DETR model; the converter is provided with an RPN layer which is arranged on the final generated characteristic diagram of the Encoder layer. The ship detection method can effectively improve the speed and the accuracy of ship detection on the water surface.

title_en: Game substitute money tray, table game management system, game substitute money tray system, and game substitute money management method
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel game substitute money tray system, which comprises a game substitute money tray with a double-layer tray structure for accommodating game substitute money. A game substitute money tray system is provided with: a double-layer tray comprising a lower-layer tray (172) and an upper-layer tray (171) stacked on the lower-layer tray, for storing a game substitute banknote (120) provided with an RF tag (125), the RF tag (125) storing tag information; a camera (2) for capturing images of the game currency (120) stored in the upper tray (171) and acquiring tray image data; an RFID reader (170) for reading tag information from an RF tag (125) of a game currency (120) stored in a lower tray (172); and a game recording device (11) which records the tray image data and/or the image analysis result of the tray image data for the game substitute money (120) contained in the upper tray (171), and records the tag information read by the RFID reading device (170) for the game substitute money (120) contained in the lower tray (171).

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for creating oval flower bonding pad
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of electronic element creation, and provides a method, a device, equipment and a medium for creating an elliptical flower bonding pad, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the outer diameter and the inner diameter of an oval flower pad to be created and calculating the opening width of the oval flower pad to be created based on the inner diameter; creating an elliptical ring centered at the target origin based on the outside diameter and the difference between the outside diameter and the inside diameter; creating a first line and a second line which are perpendicular to each other and have line widths corresponding to the opening widths respectively based on the target origin and the direction in which the outside diameter and/or the inside diameter are located; and respectively taking intersection sets of the first paths corresponding to the elliptical rings and the second paths corresponding to the first lines and the third paths corresponding to the second lines, taking complementary sets of the intersection set and the first paths to obtain a set of target paths, and creating an elliptical flower bonding pad to be created based on all the target paths in the set. The present application simplifies the complexity of creating elliptical flower pads.

title_en: Ship thrust distribution method based on improved dung beetle algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of dynamic positioning ship thrust distribution, in particular to a ship thrust distribution method based on an improved dung beetle algorithm, which comprises the following steps: 1. initializing various parameters of the ship; 2. calculating a constraint term special solution of a thrust distribution equation and an individual variable dynamic boundary according to the current and historical data information; 3. initializing and improving parameters of a dung beetle optimizing algorithm, including population size, maximum iteration times, obtaining an initial population by using space block and elite screening methods and the like; 4. updating individual variables by using an original dung beetle optimization algorithm; 5. updating individual variables by using a variable step length 'class gradient method'; 6. judging whether the maximum iteration times are reached, if so, executing the step 7, otherwise, executing the step 4; 7. and (3) outputting a thrust distribution result, updating the ship state parameters, and jumping to the step (2) to perform thrust distribution calculation of the next period. The method can obtain the global optimal solution of thrust distribution with fewer iteration times, and improve the thrust distribution precision of the ship.

title_en: Nitrogen production energy allocation method and equipment based on optimized segmentation of liquid nitrogen yield curve
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data acquisition and analysis, and provides a nitrogen production energy allocation method and equipment based on optimization segmentation of a liquid nitrogen yield curve, wherein the method comprises the following steps: randomly dividing the nitrogen production curve for a plurality of times according to constraint conditions, adopting a plurality of dividing schemes to form a first generation dividing scheme set, and performing competitive ordering on the first generation dividing scheme set according to an objective function to obtain a first generation competitive dividing scheme set; extracting a plurality of dominant segmentation schemes as a first generation competition segmentation scheme subset, and generating a second generation competition segmentation scheme subset after adjustment; extracting a plurality of dominant segmentation schemes from the first generation competition segmentation scheme set, and randomly combining the dominant segmentation schemes with the second generation competition segmentation scheme subset to generate a second generation segmentation scheme set, and performing competition sequencing to obtain the second generation competition segmentation scheme set; repeatedly generating a multi-generation competition dividing scheme set, determining the dividing scheme with the maximum competition advantage and performing energy allocation. The invention avoids the extensive use of energy sources in the liquid nitrogen preparation process.

title_en: Expansion device and automatic connection control method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses expansion equipment, which comprises a detection module, a driving module and an expansion plug, wherein when the detection module detects that a terminal equipment is located at a preset position, the driving module is controlled to drive the expansion joint to move and electrically connect the terminal equipment, and electric signals are interactively transmitted with the terminal equipment through the expansion plug so as to provide charging, data transmission and external function expansion for the terminal equipment. The expansion device disclosed by the embodiment of the application can automatically identify the position of the terminal device, and when the terminal device is positioned at the preset position, the expansion plug is controlled to be connected with the terminal device, so that the expansion device can expand the functions of charging, data transmission and external function of the terminal device. The embodiment of the application also discloses an automatic connection control method applied to the expansion equipment.

title_en: Redundant asset identification method in data lake, data processing system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a redundant asset identification method in a data lake, a data processing system and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the number of upstream objects referenced by a target data table in a data lake; if the number of the upstream objects is single, determining that the data source type of the target data table is a single data source type, and calling a single data source redundant asset identification strategy to judge whether the target data table is a redundant asset; and if the number of the upstream objects is multiple, determining that the data source type of the target data table is a multiple data source type, and calling a multiple data source redundant asset identification strategy to judge whether the target data table is a redundant asset. When the redundant assets in the data lake are cleaned, redundant identification can be carried out on the data tables of a plurality of business boards in the boards and across the boards, and the problem of how to identify the redundant assets among a plurality of business functional modules is solved.

title_en: Greedy value representation-based multi-unmanned carrier scheduling method and greedy value representation-based multi-unmanned carrier scheduling system
abstract_en: The application provides a greedy value representation-based multi-unmanned carrier scheduling method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-AGV team decision model and a multi-criticizer evaluation model; the AGV interacts with the environment through a multi-AGV team decision model to obtain a training sample and form an experience buffer zone; sampling from an experience buffer zone, calculating a value function corresponding to greedy actions and non-greedy actions, remodelling a target value function of the non-greedy actions according to the greedy action value function, and performing first round of strategy optimization to form a priority experience buffer zone; performing second round of strategy optimization from the sampling of the priority experience buffer area to obtain a priority action sample; and inputting the priority action sample into the multi-AGV team decision model, and training to obtain a final multi-unmanned carrier scheduling model for generating an optimal cooperative scheduling strategy of the multi-AGV. The method can eliminate non-optimal convergence points of the multi-agent scheduling algorithm, and realizes optimal collaborative scheduling of the multi-AGV on the premise that the environment is fully explored.

title_en: Asset management data processing method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to an asset management data processing method, a device, computer equipment, a storage medium and a computer program product, which are used for acquiring historical data of a target asset, carrying out multi-factor feature analysis on an asset management factor pool based on the historical data, screening to obtain the target factor data, then inputting the historical data and the target factor data into a trend prediction fusion model for prediction to obtain a lifting probability prediction value of the target asset, and finally outputting an action instruction of the target asset based on the lifting probability prediction value of the target asset for completing management of the target asset.

title_en: Method and system for detecting illegal carrying articles of personnel of mine overhead manned device
abstract_en: A method and a system for detecting illegal carried articles of personnel of a mine overhead manned device are characterized in that a main feature extraction module and a feature enhancement fusion module are used for collecting article features, a knowledge distillation module is added to the output of the feature enhancement fusion module to enhance the information collection capacity, an auxiliary information enhancement module is used for further detecting target article information, a positioning network and a classification network are improved, classification loss of the YOLOv8 is improved, positioning and classification accuracy is enhanced, and classified information flows are transmitted to an alarm system to realize detection of illegal products. The detection capability of carrying illegal objects by personnel of the mine overhead manned device is enhanced.

title_en: Dynamic random access memory structure, dynamic random access memory, electronic device and data writing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic random access memory structure, a memory, electronic equipment and a data writing method, relates to the technical field of memories, and is used for improving the integration density of a dynamic random access memory under the condition that the dynamic random access memory structure has good memory performance. The dynamic random access memory structure includes a transistor, a heating element, a thermoelectric storage element, and a thermally insulating dielectric layer. The heating element is in parallel with the thermoelectric storage element. The grid electrode of the transistor is electrically connected with the word line of the dynamic random access memory, the first electrode of the transistor is electrically connected with the bit line of the dynamic random access memory, and the second electrode of the transistor is grounded or connected with a power supply through the thermoelectric storage element and the heating element. The transistor is used for driving the heating element to heat the hot end of the thermoelectric storage element according to the data signal connected to the bit line under the control of the gating control signal so as to write the data signal into the thermoelectric storage element. The insulating medium layer covers at least the heating element and the hot end of the thermoelectric storage element.

title_en: Molecular generation method of single system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a molecular generation method of a single system, belongs to the technical field of deep learning and molecular generation, and aims to solve the technical problem of how to accurately and efficiently generate molecules. The method comprises the following steps: based on the target molecule and the similar molecules forming a molecular data set, the molecules in the molecular data set are formed by SMILES expressions; screening elements contained in molecules from the SMILES expression, wherein the elements are separated by spaces, and a sample data set is constructed by taking the preprocessed molecular SMILES expression as a sample; constructing a molecular generation model, and performing model training on the molecular generation model through a Next Token Prediction training task based on a sample data set; and carrying out parameter adjustment on the trained molecular generation model by a reinforcement learning method based on the fine adjustment data set to obtain a final molecular generation model, and predicting and outputting each element in the molecular SMILES expression by the final molecular generation model.

title_en: Method and device for monitoring and processing system full link abnormality
abstract_en: The application discloses a system all-link abnormity monitoring and processing method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring system internal flow data, confirming abnormal scenes in the system based on the system internal flow data, and setting corresponding monitoring mechanisms for the abnormal scenes in the system; performing anomaly monitoring on the system full link, and judging whether anomaly information is monitored or not based on monitoring mechanisms corresponding to various anomaly scenes in the system; when abnormal information is monitored, pushing the abnormal information to a designated terminal through a unified message interface and through a kafka message middleware; based on the pushed abnormal information, inquiring the corresponding abnormal log, and automatically positioning the fault point of the abnormal information. The application informs service personnel of system abnormality in real time by means of monitoring, information and the like, processes the abnormality in time, can quickly inquire the needed log when the fault exists, shortens the fault positioning time, further improves the availability and provides convenience for users.

title_en: Binarization method and free form mask optimization procedure
abstract_en: A method for determining a mask pattern for a patterning device is described herein. The method comprises the following steps of obtaining: a target pattern to be printed on the substrate, (ii) an initial continuity image of the patterning device corresponding to the target pattern, (iii) a binarization function (e.g., an S-type function, an arctangent function, a step function, etc.) configured to convert the initial continuity image, and (iv) a process model configured to predict the pattern on the substrate from an output of the binarization function; and generating, by the hardware computer system, a binarized image having a mask pattern corresponding to the initial continuity image by iteratively updating the initial continuity image based on the cost function such that the cost function is reduced. A cost function (e.g., EPE) determines the difference between the predicted pattern and the target pattern determined by the process model.

title_en: Data storage method and application for separate storage system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data storage method and application for a separated storage system, belonging to the technical field of computer data storage, comprising the following steps: in the computing node, respectively generating a corresponding key value pair for each input data to be stored, and combining the key value pairs to generate a plurality of key value blocks with fixed sizes; and processing each key value block by adopting an erasure code algorithm to generate corresponding data blocks and check blocks, and transmitting the data blocks and the check blocks to a remote nonvolatile memory node for storage. Before erasure coding processing, the invention gathers key value pairs with smaller size into larger blocks, and processes a plurality of small key value pairs in batches, thus realizing data storage with higher fault tolerance with smaller delay cost.

title_en: Cosmetic efficacy evaluation quality control method and system based on blockchain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quality control method and a system for evaluating the efficacy of cosmetics based on a blockchain, wherein the method comprises the steps of extracting authority value information of each node in a quality control system, and determining a primary master node set and a global master node of the quality control system; receiving an information packet sent by a client by a global master node, and carrying out standardized preprocessing on the received information to obtain a uplink request message; according to the uplink request message, executing a node allocation evaluation flow to obtain a quality evaluation result, and judging whether to accept the uplink request according to the quality evaluation result; constructing a node authority value evaluation Model according to the quality evaluation result  N  User reputation evaluation Model  U  According to Model  N  Updating data corresponding to each node in the quality control node set according to the output result of the Model  U  The method and the system can update the user data, quickly and efficiently control the quality of the cosmetic efficacy evaluation information, provide a new thought for information auditing of a block chain network platform, and ensure the authenticity of the cosmetic efficacy evaluation information.

title_en: Risk prediction method based on big data
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of risk prediction, and discloses a risk prediction method based on big data, which comprises the following steps: establishing an enterprise financial database, wherein the enterprise financial database comprises financial databases corresponding to a plurality of target enterprises, and the financial databases comprise historical financial data of a plurality of years; establishing a risk index system based on the enterprise financial database; establishing a risk prediction model based on a machine learning method and a time sequence prediction method; dividing the data in the risk index system into a training set and a testing set; training the risk prediction model by utilizing the training set; and inputting the test set into a trained risk prediction model to obtain a risk prediction result. The application can process a large amount of data by utilizing machine learning, and can combine time continuity and relevance among historical data by utilizing a time sequence prediction method, thereby effectively predicting enterprise risks.

title_en: Device and method for reconstructing three-dimensional scouring pit in real time based on stereoscopic vision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for reconstructing a three-dimensional scouring pit in real time based on stereoscopic vision. The invention removes sediment particles in images by utilizing a laser speckle matrix and a self-adaptive median filtering algorithm to obtain flushing pit image information which can be matched in real time, a self-enhanced spatial attention mechanism SAM module is fused in a LoFTR algorithm backbone network, the extraction capacity of an improved SLoFTR algorithm on laser speckle characteristic information is enhanced, and a flushing pit surface space-time evolution model can be established by utilizing a reconstruction point set three-dimensional coordinate after matching left and right images and carrying out proper interpolation and gray level paving. The invention can realize automation of the observation process, collect three-dimensional information of the flushing pit in real time in a non-invasive way, and improve the accuracy of reconstructing the three-dimensional surface.

title_en: Realization method and system of lightweight augmented reality system based on three-dimensional model
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of three-dimensional augmented reality, in particular to a method and a system for realizing a lightweight augmented reality system based on a three-dimensional model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: initializing a mobile device with a camera and an attitude sensor; collecting an image of an AR ground plane and extracting characteristic points of the image to obtain a characteristic point set; acquiring a sparse point cloud based on the characteristic point set, and carrying out plane grouping on the characteristic points to obtain a plane set; acquiring three-dimensional space position information of the mobile equipment, calculating Euclidean distance from the mobile equipment to each plane by combining the plane sets, and estimating depth information; and locking a coordinate origin and loading an AR model based on the depth information, so as to realize positioning and displaying of the AR model. The application can realize high-precision and high-performance large-scale virtual reality scene fusion effect with low cost.

title_en: Grid compression based on atlas sampling using graphs with general topology
abstract_en: Methods, apparatuses, and systems for dynamic mesh compression based on atlas sampling are provided. The process may include: receiving a mesh frame having polygons representing surfaces of objects; determining that the grid frame is associated with an irregular UV map in response to one or more singular components in the grid frame; performing boundary detection on the UV map to identify one or more boundary loops in the UV map; and compressing information of the identified one or more boundary loops into a bitstream.

title_en: Iron and steel enterprise molten iron transportation simulation optimization method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a simulation optimization method for molten iron transportation of a steel enterprise, and belongs to the technical field of metallurgical methods. The technical scheme of the invention is as follows: after empty ladle receiving of molten iron, the dispatching center dispatches the molten iron according to three strategies of a first-in first-out principle, the quantity of the molten iron at a blast furnace and a converter is not lower than the set minimum stock quantity and the maximum quantity limit of one locomotive head for transporting large molten iron and small molten iron, and the heavy ladle transportation and converter steelmaking are carried out. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the material flow and the information flow in the steel production process can be comprehensively managed, key factors influencing the ladle turnover rate are found through simulation, a ladle scheduling strategy is designed, intelligent scheduling of the ladle is realized, and the ladle turnover rate is effectively improved.

title_en: Transformer substation monitoring interface entity identification test method and system based on machine vision
abstract_en: The application discloses a machine vision-based substation monitoring interface entity identification test method and a machine vision-based substation monitoring interface entity identification test system, wherein the identification test method comprises the steps of carrying out coordinate conversion on an acquired monitoring image; calculating a global self-adaptive threshold value for the monitoring image after coordinate conversion, and performing binarization processing; carrying out median filtering on the binarized image, and extracting a monitoring information area image on the image subjected to median filtering by adopting an equidistant rotation searching method; extracting entity image characteristics from the monitoring information area image by using an HOG operator, and combining to obtain an entity monitoring image; using a support vector machine as a classifier to perform state recognition on the obtained entity monitoring image, and outputting a recognition result; and comparing the identification result with the automatic test result, and outputting a test result report. The application realizes the whole process from the issuing of the test instruction to the outputting of the monitoring report, and carries out full-automatic closed-loop test on the monitoring interface of the transformer substation, thereby reducing the manual participation and effectively improving the efficiency of the test process.

title_en: Computer vision-based target recognition analysis method, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, equipment and a storage medium for identifying and analyzing a target based on computer vision, which relate to the technical field of computers and comprise an image acquisition module and an image processing module. The image acquisition module is used for acquiring fruit images. The image processing module is used for carrying out defect identification on the fruit image and comprises the following steps: performing defect identification on the target fruit image by using a convolutional neural network to obtain a black scar defect area; determining the probability of calyx/fruit stalk according to the gray change of the pixel points at the edge of the black scar defect area; correcting the recognition result of the convolutional neural network according to the calyx/fruit stalk probability. According to the invention, the probability that the black scar defect is likely to be a calyx/fruit stalk is obtained through the gray level change degree of the edge of the obtained black scar defect region, and the primary identification result is corrected by combining the calyx/fruit stalk probability, so that the accuracy of identifying the surface defect of the fruit is improved, the situation that the good fruit is misjudged as the bad fruit is prevented, and the waste and the loss are avoided.

title_en: Method for realizing bond scene NAT ALG processing based on DPDK
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing bond scene NAT ALG processing based on DPDK, which relates to the technical field of gateway communication, wherein a control connection data packet is imported into a linux kernel for ALG processing in a bond mode by utilizing VPP in combination with kni mechanisms of DPDK, and service data can be processed in the VPP. The ALG processing is realized, the related application can be ensured to normally access communication, and the subsequent service data access can be processed with high performance and high reliability in the bond mode of the VPP.

title_en: Interface test frame generation method, test method, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of software testing, and provides an interface testing framework generating method, a testing method, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the obtained http request packet is converted into an interface template; maintaining and classifying the interface templates, and setting service attributes; constructing various use case scenes by using an interface template to form a use case library containing a plurality of test cases; combining the test cases to form a test set adapting to different scenes; defining an interface and designing return parameters after the interface is called. The scheme is used for efficiently maintaining the interface template; rapidly constructing a use case scene by using an interface template; maintaining the parameters of the interface test to realize seamless splicing of the interface associated interface test cases; the testers can use the interface test parameters by selecting the templates and arranging the templates, so that the interface test parameters can be automatically obtained, parameters can be automatically entered, a return result can be automatically obtained, the working efficiency is improved, and the manpower investment for repeated development is reduced.

title_en: Three-dimensional object detection method, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a three-dimensional target detection method, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a detection image; inputting the detection image into a target detection model after training, and determining the object type of the object in the detection image, the two-dimensional side frame of the object and the rotation angle of the object by using the target detection model; according to the object types, searching a three-dimensional object model library to determine an object model corresponding to the object and a three-dimensional side frame corresponding to the object model; determining the distance from the camera to the object model according to the size of the two-dimensional side frame of the object, the image information of the detection image and the focal length of the camera; and determining the position of the object model in the three-dimensional space according to the rotation angle of the object, the distance between the camera and the object model and the three-dimensional side frame, and taking the position of the object model in the three-dimensional space as the position of the object in the three-dimensional space. The application can rapidly obtain the position of the object in the three-dimensional space.

title_en: Ultrasonic image analysis method and related device
abstract_en: The application discloses an ultrasonic image analysis method and a related device, which are applied to the field of artificial intelligence. The method provided by the application can segment the focus area of the ultrasonic image to obtain focus positioning results, acquire personal information and medical history of a target object corresponding to the ultrasonic image as first clinical information, record and detect the current drug use of the target object as second clinical information, and input the focus positioning results, the first clinical information and the second clinical information into the multi-layer perceptron to analyze the disease diagnosis results. By the method, the focus positioning result is analyzed by combining the previous clinical information and the current clinical information of the target object, the influence of individual difference is avoided, and the accuracy of the diagnosis result is improved.

title_en: CPS-oriented production management and control system and system modeling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CPS-oriented production control system and a system modeling method, which are characterized in that a basic manufacturing unit of the production control system is defined, the basic manufacturing unit comprises physical entity equipment, information control software and an industrial communication network, the production control system is constructed on the basis of the basic manufacturing unit, the production control system comprises a field control layer, a network connection layer, a data processing layer, a system model layer, a monitoring calculation layer and an enterprise application layer, and finally the system modeling method supporting the system operation is provided, wherein the system modeling method comprises a production resource semantic model, a production data model and a manufacturing unit behavior model. The CPS-oriented production control system constructed by the invention realizes system functions through the cooperative operation of each layer, adopts a modeling mode of combining a resource model and a behavior model, and can describe the characteristics of the production system in more clear and detailed manner compared with a single modeling method so as to aggregate the physical space and the information space of the system and provide systematic reference and guidance for further study on the intellectualization of the production system.

title_en: MES system-based optical device semi-finished product interception method and related equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an optical device semi-finished product interception method and related equipment based on an MES system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving an interception instruction aiming at a semi-finished product to be processed, wherein the interception instruction carries an interception dimension, an interception procedure identifier and a material information data table of the semi-finished product, and determining an interception object data table corresponding to each interception dimension according to the interception dimension and the material information data table, wherein the interception object data table comprises an interception object, a current procedure identifier corresponding to the interception object and an interception rule; according to the current procedure identification and the interception procedure identification corresponding to each interception object in the interception object data table, at the interception procedure corresponding to the interception procedure identification, an interception rule is executed on the interception object to generate interception information of a semi-finished product.

title_en: Face detection method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a face detection method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, which are applied to the technical field of image recognition, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a first image; detecting the human body of the first image to obtain a human body frame image; extracting first context information of the human body frame image; and carrying out face detection on the human body frame image based on the first context information to obtain a face detection result. According to the method, the human face detection process is used as a transition process of human face detection, background characteristics can be effectively filtered, background influence is reduced, the human face detection technology is more focused on human face characteristic extraction, and the human face detection is further carried out by taking first context information of a human frame image as a guide, so that a human face detection result is obtained, and the improvement of the human face detection accuracy is facilitated.

title_en: Medical health knowledge popularization method, device and medium based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical health knowledge popularization method, device and medium based on artificial intelligence, and relates to the technical field of information push. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a history browsing record of a user; extracting keywords from the content of each browsing page in the plurality of browsing pages to obtain keywords of each browsing page; determining at least one field to which the content of interest of the user belongs based on keywords of each browsing page in the plurality of browsing pages; extracting first browsing behavior characteristics of a user; similarity calculation is carried out on the first browsing behavior characteristics and second browsing behavior characteristics corresponding to various predetermined users, and the user category to which the user belongs is determined; and setting the pushing priority of medical health knowledge which belongs to at least one field and matches the corresponding age group with the age group corresponding to the user category to which the user belongs in the medical health knowledge list to be pushed as a first priority. The method, the device and the medium disclosed by the invention can improve the popularization effect of medical health knowledge.

title_en: Method, device and storage medium for generating multimedia data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of data processing, and discloses a method, equipment and a storage medium for generating multimedia data. The method comprises the following steps: when receiving text content to be processed, generating a character array corresponding to the text content according to a preset punctuation mark; generating audio for the character array according to a preset text-to-speech algorithm, and generating visual data for the character array according to a preset text-to-image algorithm; generating an audio and video for the character array according to the audio and visual data; generating subtitles for the audio and video to obtain target audio and video; and embedding the target audio and video into the text content to obtain the multimedia data. The invention can improve the reading efficiency of the text content by the user.

title_en: Data processing method and system convenient for electromechanical pipeline synthesis of three-dimensional model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data processing method and a system for facilitating the synthesis of an electromechanical pipeline of a three-dimensional model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring rvt data of at least one component in the three-dimensional model; defining first rvt data corresponding to at least one pipeline, second rvt data corresponding to at least one pipe and connection relation between at least one pipeline and at least one pipe respectively to obtain different preset original protocols; the method comprises the steps of obtaining geometric metadata in a three-dimensional model, converting the geometric metadata into electromechanical pipeline topology data based on different preset original protocols, carrying out electromechanical pipeline comprehensive processing on the electromechanical pipeline topology data, and reading processing results according to preset data protocols. The collision adjustment of the electromechanical pipeline meeting the preset conditions can be completed rapidly and accurately, the labor cost is saved, and the comprehensive deepening efficiency of the electromechanical pipeline is improved.

title_en: Color leaf research and development data processing method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a color leaf research and development data processing method and system. The method obtains chlorophyll content of the colored-leaf plant at each moment; according to the change of chlorophyll content, obtaining the chlorophyll accumulation amount of the color leaf plant in the sub-time period, and further obtaining the accumulation fluctuation degree of the temperature area; obtaining distance weight according to the fluctuation degree and the temperature difference of the scraping of the color leaf plant and the temperature area of the target plant and the fluctuation difference of the chlorophyll scraping amount, and further obtaining a color leaf cluster through a K-means clustering algorithm; and detecting the heights of the colored-leaf plants in the colored-leaf cluster through a local outlier factor algorithm, and determining the abnormal colored-leaf plants. According to the method, the distance weight between the colored-leaf plants and the target plants is obtained, so that the colored-leaf plants are accurately classified, abnormal colored-leaf plants in the color She Julei cluster are accurately and efficiently detected through the local outlier factor algorithm, and the abnormal conditions are accurately identified.

title_en: Privacy computing method, system and medium for secure two-party matrix hybrid multiplication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a privacy computing method, a system and a medium for secure two-party matrix mixed multiplication, which relate to the field of information security and comprise the following steps: the first computing party and the second computing party are based on a secure two-party matrix multiplication computing protocol and on a private matrix A  1  And private matrix B  2  Based on private matrix A  2  And private matrix B  1  Performing safe two-party matrix multiplication calculation, and randomly splitting each matrix multiplication calculation result into two pieces of random data items; while the first computing participant is based on the private matrix a  1  And private matrix A  2  The second computing participant is based on the private matrix B  1  And private matrix B  2  Respectively executing private matrix multiplication; the first computing participant and the second computing participant are respectively based on the corresponding two follow-up piecesAnd the machine data item and the private matrix multiply result to obtain a final result matrix and send the final result matrix to a calculation requester to calculate a privacy calculation result. The method can greatly improve the privacy calculation precision of the safe two-party matrix mixed multiplication.

title_en: Case report form design method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a case report form design method and a system, which relate to the field of report form design and comprise the following steps: s1, loading a configuration file, and finishing verification and analysis; s2, generating a data definition operation interface according to the configuration file; s3, storing definition data of a user; according to the case report form design method and system, the filling positions of the sub-templates in the main template can be rapidly analyzed through template analysis, rapid input analysis and data importing and modifying, the working efficiency of workers is improved, row definition, column definition and form definition functions are provided for a single template through template editing, multiplexing attributes are uniformly managed, only part of cell data is needed to be stored during storage, the data redundancy is greatly reduced, and meanwhile, the template pattern definition can be efficiently completed through operation of cells.

title_en: Method for detecting acrylic emulsion production wastewater based on image processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image segmentation, in particular to an acrylic emulsion production wastewater detection method based on image processing; image segmentation is carried out on the wastewater pool image to obtain a target area; obtaining initial algae probability according to the area characteristics and the distribution characteristics of the target area; obtaining the regional neighbor degree according to the distance characteristics of the target region and other target regions in the preset neighborhood; obtaining the density duty ratio of the neighborhood region according to the distance characteristics of the target region and other target regions in the preset neighborhood and the area characteristics of other target regions in the preset neighborhood; and obtaining the final algae probability of the target area according to the initial algae probability, the area neighbor degree and the neighborhood area density ratio. According to the invention, the algae area of the wastewater and the pollution degree of the wastewater are judged according to the final algae probability, and the analysis accuracy of the algae area and the pollution degree is improved.

title_en: Mechanical arm drawing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a mechanical arm drawing method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the mechanical arm drawing method comprises the following steps: receiving target drawing data, wherein the target drawing data comprises a prompt word or an image; generating a target image based on a prompt word or an image by using a pre-trained image generation model, wherein the image generation model is obtained by training based on a preset drawing image set, visual elements of drawing images in the drawing image set are lines and strokes, and the image generated by the image generation model and the drawing images in the drawing image set have similar visual elements; and controlling the mechanical arm to draw the target image. The embodiment of the disclosure can make the mechanical arm draw faster and better, or improve the interest and the creative of drawing of the mechanical arm.

title_en: Multi-channel measurement method and system based on vector network analyzer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multichannel measuring method and a multichannel measuring system based on a vector network analyzer, wherein the multichannel measuring method comprises the following steps: dividing the whole channel by the channel dividing requirement, traversing different channel measuring modes, and feeding back the measuring times of each channel measuring mode under the respective configuration sequence by a built-in memory according to an actual port configuration program; the measurement times of the initial excitation points are used as the reference times of the channels to be judged, and the frequency of the frequency change of the reference times is used as the judgment reference of other sub-channels in the channels, so that whether the other sub-channels in the measurement modes of all the channels execute port configuration is determined; and finally, counting the port configuration result to generate measurement port configuration information of the whole channel. The embodiment of the invention can adjust the measurement modes of all channels of the whole channel by exciting the information and combining the channel configuration technology, thereby improving the efficiency of port configuration.

title_en: Enterprise-oriented mass product data template management system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data management, and particularly relates to an enterprise-oriented mass product data template management system and method.
