The method comprises the following steps: pre-storing a plurality of standard data templates; obtaining screening conditions, and screening a plurality of pre-stored standard data templates according to the screening conditions to obtain corresponding standard data templates; parameter adjustment is carried out on the standard data templates obtained through screening so as to obtain adjusted standard data templates; marking the adjustment content in the adjusted standard data template to obtain a marked standard data template; obtaining a standard data template after marking, and auditing the marked content; and acquiring the marked standard data template after the verification is passed, and issuing and using. The invention improves the efficiency and accuracy of data template formulation.

title_en: Information processing method, device, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an information processing method, an information processing device, information processing equipment, information processing media and information processing products, and relates to the technical field of information processing, comprising the following steps: receiving a loan application request of a target user sent by user equipment, wherein the loan application request comprises loan application information of the target user; based on loan application information of a target user, acquiring a target case matched with the loan application information of the target user from a preset case library; transmitting a target case to the user equipment, wherein the target case is used for acquiring a plurality of first face images of a target user in the process of reading the target case under the condition that the target case is displayed by the user equipment; and generating prompt information under the condition that the emotion information of the target user is abnormal emotion information. According to the embodiment of the application, the accuracy of detecting whether the loan application is abnormal or not is improved.

title_en: FPSA-L2 CSNet-based sight estimation system and method
abstract_en: A sight line estimation system and method based on FPSA-L2CSNet relates to the field of computer sight line estimation. The facial feature extraction unit comprises 5 Single BlazeBlock for acquiring low-level features and 6 Double BlazeBlock for acquiring high-level features, and acquiring facial feature information of a human face according to a low-level feature map and a high-level feature map, and positioning a left eye region and a right eye region; the ResNet network comprises a first residual error module group, a second residual error module group, a third residual error module group and a fourth residual error module group which are sequentially arranged, wherein the first residual error module group, the second residual error module group, the third residual error module group and the fourth residual error module group are respectively formed by a plurality of residual error modules, and each residual error module comprises two 1 multiplied by 1 convolution layers and a PSA module. The extraction range of the human eye characteristic region is reduced through the facial characteristic extraction unit, and the characteristic extraction at a finer granularity level is realized by adopting an improved ResNet network, so that an accurate sight estimation effect is achieved.

title_en: Apparatus, method, and system for device translation of a back-up buffer pre-translated instruction and extension to an input/output memory management unit protocol
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and apparatuses are described that support device translation of a reserve buffer pre-translated instruction. A hardware system comprising: an input/output device; an input/output memory controller for performing direct memory access to a memory of the input/output device; and a processor core separate from the input/output device and including decoder circuitry for decoding a single instruction into a decoded single instruction, the single instruction including one or more fields for identifying a virtual address to physical address mapping of the input/output device in memory, and an opcode for instructing the execution circuitry to store the virtual address to physical address mapping into a translation look-aside buffer within the input/output device; and execution circuitry to execute the decoded individual instructions according to the opcode.

title_en: Mobile robot positioning method and system based on multi-camera fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile robot positioning method and a system based on multi-camera fusion, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an RGB image and a map image and preprocessing data; training a convolutional neural network model according to the preprocessed data set to obtain a target detection model; fitting and calibrating the moving track of the mobile robot based on the target detection model to obtain preliminary moving robot track positioning data; and carrying out error correction processing on the preliminary mobile robot positioning data by a multi-camera weighted positioning method to obtain final mobile robot track positioning data. According to the invention, the positioning of the indoor mobile robot with higher precision is realized through the mutual coordination between the target detection network algorithm and the image and the multi-camera multi-parameter weighting real-time calibration. The mobile robot positioning method and system based on multi-camera fusion can be widely applied to the technical field of mobile robot positioning.

title_en: Calibration method and device of head-mounted equipment and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a calibration method, a device and electronic equipment of head-mounted equipment, which relate to data processing and are used for solving the problem that in the prior art, when a calibrator calibrates VR equipment, experience of the calibrator is relied on, so that the calibration precision of the VR equipment is lower. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a mechanical arm script for fixing a mechanical arm of the head-mounted device to be calibrated, obtaining a calibration image based on the mechanical arm script, determining the actual distance between each target feature point and each target feature point except the target feature point in the calibration image according to calibration parameters of the head-mounted device to be calibrated and the calibration image, and determining the calibration result of the head-mounted device to be calibrated according to the theoretical distance and the actual distance between each target feature point and each target feature point except the target feature point.

title_en: Active listening of assistant systems
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a method includes: receiving a first user input from a first client system, the first user input comprising a wake word associated with an assistant xbot; setting an assistant xbot to a listening mode, wherein continuous non-visual feedback is provided via the first client system while the assistant xbot is in the listening mode; receiving a second user input from the first client system while the assistant xbot is in the listening mode, the second user input comprising a user utterance; determining that the second user input has ended based on the completion of the user utterance; and setting the assistant xbot to an inactive mode, wherein the non-visual feedback is terminated via the first client system while the assistant xbot is in the inactive mode.

title_en: Method for laying out controls, computing device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for arranging controls, which is suitable for being executed in a computing device, and comprises the following steps: setting a plurality of controls in a layout window, wherein the controls comprise size information; initializing an anchoring system, and generating an anchor line of a control in the anchoring system; setting the position relation among a plurality of controls in an anchoring system according to anchor lines; and loading a layout window, and displaying a plurality of controls in the layout window according to the size information and the position relation of the controls. A computing device and a computer-readable storage medium are also disclosed.

title_en: Method and system for magnetocardiographic image registration
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to methods and systems for magnetocardiographic image registration. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring heart structure information of a tested person through B ultrasonic detection, selecting heart structure marking points according to the heart structure information, and attaching heart structure markers to the heart structure marking points; selecting at least two reference mark points on the body surface of the tested person, and attaching the reference mark on the at least two reference mark points; acquiring position information of a cardiac structural marker and a reference marker through three-dimensional scanning to generate a cardiac structural diagram; attaching a reference coil to at least two reference marker points after the cardiac structural marker and the reference marker are removed; performing a magnetocardiogram measurement with the reference coil energized to generate a magnetocardiogram map; and registering the cardiac magnetic field map with the cardiac structural map by matching the position of poles of the reference coil in the cardiac magnetic field map with the position of the reference marker in the cardiac structural map.

title_en: Board defect detection method and system based on 3D visual recognition
abstract_en: The application provides a plate defect detection method and system based on 3D visual identification, wherein image feature extraction is carried out on each target plate segmented image obtained after image segmentation cutting based on a trained feature dimension reduction mapping model, and defect detection is carried out on each target plate segmented image through the obtained segmented image dimension reduction mapping feature and dimension reduction mapping feature of each reference segmented image in a preset reference segmented image library to obtain a segmented defect detection result; and determining the defect detection result corresponding to the target plate surface image according to the block defect detection results of at least two target plate block images. The method and the device can extract the dimension reduction mapping characteristics of the block images of the target plate block images with high precision, and further can accurately detect defects of the surface images of the target plate based on the dimension reduction mapping characteristics of the block images, thereby helping control of the yield of the plate.

title_en: Dual-attention-guided crowd counting method, apparatus and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crowd counting method guided by double attention, which comprises the steps of preprocessing an acquired crowd image, generating a corresponding true value segmentation diagram and a vectorization binary diagram by using labeling information, constructing a crowd counting network guided by double attention, and initializing; inputting the preprocessed crowd images, the truth value segmentation map and the vectorized binary map into a crowd counting network guided by double attention so as to finish forward propagation; calculating loss by taking care of the graph and the truth value segmentation graph, estimating the loss by using the crowd density graph and the vectorized binary graph, and iteratively updating parameters of the network; and obtaining a crowd density map based on the crowd image through the crowd counting network guided by the double attention after iterative updating, and obtaining the estimated number of people according to the crowd density map. The invention also discloses a device based on the method. The invention uses the attention-directed feature aggregation to recover fine granularity information, adopts segmentation attention to try to filter background noise, and improves the accuracy.

title_en: Metal spectrum identification method and system based on collision radiation and spectrum correlation
abstract_en: The invention provides a metal spectrum identification method and a system based on collision radiation and spectrum association, which belong to the field of aerospace plasma propulsion, and the method comprises the steps of firstly determining the offset of the central wavelength of a spectrum acquired in an experiment; under the condition of meeting the offset, comprehensively comparing the intensities of the Einstein emission coefficient, the relative intensity, the upper energy level and the lower energy level to perform primary identification of spectral lines; for spectral lines which have the offset meeting the determined range and cannot be distinguished, the energy level structure on the spectral lines is focused, other strong spectral lines with the same upper energy level are found out, whether the spectral lines exist or not is further determined, so that metal spectrum identification of complex structures based on collision radiation and spectrum association is completed, and metal spectral lines of key components in the barium-tungsten hollow cathode can be identified and separated by means of the method.

title_en: Reservoir lithology prediction method based on multidisciplinary data fusion clustering algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir lithology prediction method based on a multidisciplinary data fusion clustering algorithm, and particularly relates to the technical field of geophysics. According to the method, an initial sample set is constructed based on reservoir original data comprising logging data, seismic data and geological data, pearson correlation analysis is conducted on logging attributes and target lithology, the seismic attributes are extracted by using logging attributes sensitive to lithology to serve as attribute samples, after the attribute sample set and a support vector regression machine are constructed, a particle swarm optimization method is adopted to optimize the support vector regression machine by using the attribute sample set, a PSO-SVR model for predicting lithology sensitive logging attributes is obtained, the lithology sensitive logging attributes are obtained by means of prediction of the PSO-SVR model, cluster analysis is conducted by combining exploration data, lithology of a horizon to be predicted is divided, and visualization is conducted. The method reduces lithology recognition time consumption, improves lithology division precision, and is favorable for guiding reservoir development.

title_en: Image acquisition method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an image acquisition method and electronic equipment, which are applied to the electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: displaying a first interface, wherein the first interface is an interface of a first application program in the electronic equipment; acquiring a first image in response to a first operation on a first interface; performing first processing on the first image, and simultaneously, responding to second operation on the first interface, displaying a second interface which is not an interface of the first application program, wherein the second operation is used for changing the first application program from running in the foreground to running in the background, and before the first processing of the first image is finished, adjusting the running priority of the first application program from the first priority to the second priority; and based on the second priority, when a second image is obtained, saving the second image, wherein the second image is obtained by processing the first image. Therefore, the application can avoid the situation of losing the graph as far as possible by improving the priority of the first application program, and ensure the use experience of the user.

title_en: Federal learning privacy protection method based on improved diffusion model
abstract_en: The invention relates to personal privacy information protection of users, and discloses a federal learning privacy protection method based on an improved diffusion model, which realizes data protection of a client local model and comprises the following steps: step one: each client receives data distributed by a central server; step two: the data is subjected to all T updating iterations on N clients to obtain an updated model; step three: updating the client with the obtained model Encryption encoding is carried out by adopting the improved depth neural network of the Diffuse Model to obtain a forward encryption Model Step four: uploading the encrypted model to a central server, sampling and decoding the encrypted model at the central server, aggregating and updating the model to obtain a new round of global model, and transmitting the model to a client to perform updating iteration of the model of the next round of federal learning. The invention is mainly applied to occasions of federal learning communication privacy protection, and simultaneously greatly improves federal learning communication efficiency.

title_en: Space division method and device for three-dimensional model, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a space division method, a device, terminal equipment and a storage medium of a three-dimensional model, which relate to the technical field of building engineering informatization, wherein the space division method of the three-dimensional model comprises the following steps: acquiring component information of the modeled three-dimensional model, wherein the component information includes, but is not limited to, component elevation data and component axis network data; generating a component information selection instruction of the three-dimensional model according to a construction plan of an actual construction service corresponding to the three-dimensional model; and determining a target three-dimensional space region based on the component elevation data, the component axis network data and the selection instruction, and carrying out space division on the three-dimensional model according to the target three-dimensional space region so as to conduct construction guidance. By adopting the scheme, the three-dimensional model can be spatially divided based on the component information of the three-dimensional model and the selection instruction generated according to the construction plan, the three-dimensional model can be spatially divided at any time according to the construction requirement, the flexibility of model application is improved, and the guiding capability of the model on construction is enhanced.

title_en: Data processing device and data processing method of field programmable gate array
abstract_en: The data processing device comprises a preprocessing device, a shifter and a judging device, wherein the preprocessing device is used for carrying out first data processing on divisor data items to obtain an index item and a constant item, so that the divisor data items are equivalent to the difference between an integer power of 2 and the constant item, the index item represents the numerical value of the integer power, the shifter is used for carrying out shifting operation on the divisor data items, the shifting bit number is the numerical value corresponding to the index item, and the judging device is used for multiplying the first data item by the constant item, adding the obtained multiplied result with the second data item and assigning the multiplied result to the divisor data items; adding the first data item to the initial value of the quotient data item; in the case where the dividend data item is smaller than the divisor data item, the dividend data item is assigned to the remainder data item, and therefore, for the data processing problem that the divisor is not the whole power of 2, only a simple operation is required, and the calculation accuracy is high.

title_en: Method for quickly combining various quantization algorithms with MNN
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for quickly fusing a quantization method into MNN, which is particularly useful for quantization algorithms with complex quantization processes, wherein the process of solving quantization parameters S and Z is still carried out according to the original flow, ONNX is simplified off-line, unnecessary nodes are removed, corresponding parameters are extracted and then are fused into MNN, and the modification is simple and convenient. The method is a feasible, simple and rapid method for quickly combining the model quantized by other methods with the MNN.

title_en: Ocean garbage target detection method based on yolov8-CA-AFPN model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater robot target detection method based on a yolov8-CA-AFPN model, and belongs to the technical field of deep learning and computer vision. The method mainly comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring data to be processed of underwater target detection, and enhancing the data; s2, improving a backbone network by adopting a C2f-CA module to extract characteristics of data, and improving the attention capacity of a target; s3, the neck network adopts an improved feature fusion network AFPN to strengthen the multi-scale feature fusion process, and the expression capacity of the features is improved while the parameter cost is maintained; s4, transmitting the obtained three different feature maps to a detection head for prediction, and adopting MPDIOU loss as boundary frame loss in a training stage to improve the overall performance of a detection task. The yolov8-CA-AFPN model framework provided by the invention can solve the problems of complex underwater environment, blurred image, unobvious target characteristics and the like in the process of detecting an underwater target. The model provided by the invention can accurately carry out the underwater target detection task, and can ensure the recognition and grabbing of the underwater robot during working.

title_en: Resource virtualization and resource scheduling architecture of universal resource management platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of information, and provides a resource virtualization and resource scheduling architecture of a universal resource management platform. The application aims to solve the problems of difficult deployment and multiplexing of development application services on a universal resource management platform. The main scheme includes management Agent, equipment resource virtualization combination service, application resource virtualization combination service and equipment/application resource scheduling combination service, wherein the management Agent is responsible for dynamically generating the services and operating a resource tree to form a complete service resource virtualization framework flow. When the universal resource management platform is initialized, loading service virtualization configuration files is responsible, equipment resource trees and application resource trees are respectively constructed on the platform according to the resource tree structure, then source codes and compiling scripts of all service modules are recursively spliced according to the matching relation of service slots according to service combination configuration, a single complete executable module is generated, and the single complete executable module is dynamically loaded into the universal resource management platform to operate.

title_en: Method and apparatus for information processing
abstract_en: According to embodiments of the present disclosure, methods and apparatus for information processing are provided. The method includes determining a set of target factors for a target object based on an unstructured text set for the target object. Each target factor represents an aspect of the target object. The method further includes determining a causal event pair including a causal event and an outcome event by analyzing text in the text set. The method further includes determining a first causal relationship between a first factor of the set of target factors and a second factor of the target object based on the causal event pair. The scheme is beneficial to perfecting the mining of the causal relationship of the target object, thereby being beneficial to the improvement of the target object.

title_en: Method and system for positioning based on infrared marker
abstract_en: A method and system for locating based on infrared markers is disclosed. The method comprises the following steps: the depth camera projects infrared light to a shot area and shoots a two-dimensional image; extracting relevant pixels of the infrared mark from the shot two-dimensional image and calculating depth information of the infrared mark according to the relevant pixels; and determining the relative position relation between the depth camera and the equipment to be positioned provided with the infrared mark according to the calculated depth information. For the shot object needing frequent calibration or positioning, by arranging the infrared mark capable of reflecting the infrared light projected by the depth camera on the shot surface, the depth camera can conveniently and rapidly determine the position of the shot object, thereby facilitating various subsequent operations based on the accurate positioning of the shot object by the depth camera.

title_en: Semiconductor assembly, operation method thereof and semiconductor structure
abstract_en: The disclosed embodiments provide a semiconductor assembly including: a substrate; an active pillar array structure over the substrate, the active pillar array structure including a plurality of active pillars arranged in an array along a second direction and a third direction, each active pillar extending along a first direction, the first direction being parallel to the substrate plane, the second direction being parallel to the substrate plane and perpendicular to the first direction, the third direction being perpendicular to the substrate plane, wherein the active pillars include a first semiconductor layer, a second semiconductor layer, and a third semiconductor layer stacked in sequence along the second direction; and each active column arranged in the third direction corresponds to one first word line and one second word line, each first word line covers the first semiconductor layer in the active column corresponding to the first word line, and each second word line covers the third semiconductor layer in the active column corresponding to the second word line.

title_en: Method, device, computer equipment and storage medium for synchronizing difference data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of cloud technology, and discloses a method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium for synchronizing difference data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when the triggering time of the current period is reached and the current period is determined to be a non-first period, acquiring a first data operation log and first task information from the multi-cloud management platform, and acquiring a second data operation log and second task information from the target third-party cloud platform; comparing the first data operation log with the second data operation log to determine a first data identification set; comparing the first task information with the second task information to determine a second data identification set; the first data identification set and the second data identification set form a target difference data identification set; and extracting the difference data from the target third-party cloud platform according to the target difference data identification set, and synchronizing the difference data to the multi-cloud management platform. The invention can improve the efficiency of synchronizing data.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle cloud edge end cooperative control system of 5G security rescue net allies oneself with
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 5G security rescue network-connected unmanned aerial vehicle cloud edge end cooperative control system, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles and comprises the following componentsThe system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle end, an edge end and a cloud end which are mutually cooperated, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle end comprises a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles carrying cameras, and at least two unmanned aerial vehicles are arranged on the same road section; the technical key points are as follows: according to the inspection guidance coefficient The calculation obtains the discrete coefficient Dcif of the inspection frequency, the accuracy of guiding the inspection frequency pre-estimated value Ygz is guaranteed, after analysis and calculation processing, the inspection operation of the unmanned aerial vehicle can automatically set the inspection frequency according to the condition of the actual inspection road, the two groups of unmanned aerial vehicles are utilized to alternately cruise on the same road section, the cruising performance of the unmanned aerial vehicle is guaranteed, the inspection operation can be carried out according to the actual condition of the road section, and the unmanned aerial vehicle is combined with the 5G technology, so that effective early warning and management can be provided for the security protection of the urban road.

title_en: Form full-element extraction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for extracting all elements of a form, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring each initial cell and each cell text in a target table; determining cells corresponding to the initial cells based on the positions of the first vertexes of the initial cells, and determining the structural information of the target table based on the relative positions of the cells, wherein the cells have common vertexes; determining attribute information of each cell in the target table based on the structure information of the target table and the text of each cell, wherein the attribute information comprises keys or values; and extracting all elements in the target table based on the structural information of the target table and the attribute information of each cell. Based on the structure information of the target table and the attribute information of each cell, each element corresponding to the attribute information can be extracted correctly, the situation that the attribute information of each extracted element does not correspond is avoided, and the accuracy of element extraction can be improved.

title_en: Parameter updating device and parameter updating method
abstract_en: The present invention provides a parameter updating apparatus (1) for updating parameters of an error compensator in a control system having a feedback controller, a nominal model, and the error compensator, the apparatus comprising: a data acquisition unit (32) that acquires input data representing a control input to a control object and output data representing an output from the control object; a reference signal acquisition unit (34) that obtains a pseudo reference signal as a control target value using the input data and the output data; and a parameter updating unit (36) that updates the parameter of the error compensator by minimizing the evaluation function defined by the pseudo-reference signal.

title_en: Regional science popularization capability evaluation method based on VIKOR method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional science popularization capability evaluation method based on a VI KOR method, which relates to the technical field of science popularization capability evaluation, and comprises the steps of S1 normalizing original data by using a very poor method, S2 carrying out correlation analysis on each index by using a Spearman method, S3 utilizing a conditional generalized variance minimum selection index among indexes and S4 comprehensive evaluation analysis, constructing a science popularization capability index system by using the Spearman method and the generalized variance minimum method, integrating subjective and objective weights of each index by using a game theory combined weighting method, and determining the weights of each index. Finally, the obtained weight is used for analyzing and evaluating the science popularization capability by using a Vikor method, so that the result obtained by the Vikor method is more objective. The method is carried out step by step from index screening, weight determination and method evaluation, and a process reference is provided for the evaluation and research of science popularization capability. The method is beneficial to scientifically making scientific popularization work planning according to the actual conditions of the area in each area.

title_en: Missing genotype filling method based on automatic encoder sample matching
abstract_en: The invention provides a filling method of a missing genotype based on automatic encoder sample matching, which realizes low-cost accurate filling of the missing genotype and can provide more accurate gene data support for various genetic analysis works. The method converts genotype information values of samples at each position in the target data file and finally codes the genotype information values into single-hot codes, divides a training set and a testing set, and then constructs a convolution denoising self-encoder model. According to the invention, an automatic preprocessing strategy is used for carrying out segmentation processing on the sample data set participating in filling, so that the memory occupation of the device is reduced, and a user can smoothly carry out high-precision genotype filling by using only a device with lower cost. The invention has high filling precision, simple and reliable model structure and high training efficiency, has wide application prospect in the field of gene sequence analysis, and can be used for subsequent biological whole genome association analysis and whole genome selection work.

title_en: Equal-generation damping ratio calculation method for additional damping device
abstract_en: The application relates to an equivalent damping ratio calculation method of an additional damping device, which comprises the following steps: establishing an energy balance equation of the bridge structure system under a certain single mode, wherein the bridge structure system is provided with an additional damping device; acquiring each mode parameter under a mode to be solved; and applying impact load, and recording the amplitude of oscillation in each period to obtain the equivalent damping ratio of the additional damping device. The invention provides a calculation method of equal-generation damping ratio of an additional damping device, which combines the principle of conservation of energy, the vibration characteristics of each mode and the relation between longitudinal and vertical bending large deformation on the basis of dynamics theory, simultaneously considers the two effects of large deformation nonlinear vibration and linear vibration, establishes a generalized single-degree-of-freedom system energy balance equation for a bridge structure system provided with the additional damping device, applies impact load according to the energy balance equation so as to accurately calculate the equal-generation damping ratio of the additional damping device, and can more accurately evaluate the damping efficiency of the damping device in actual engineering.

title_en: Cost analysis method and system for Perturb-seq experiment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biological information, and discloses a cost analysis method and a system for a Perturb-seq experiment, wherein the cost analysis method comprises the following steps: obtaining infection efficiency of the target gRNA, disturbance data of the target gRNA on the target gene, preset significant level data and preset efficacy data according to the target gRNA information and the target gene information, and estimating the number of cells used for detecting the influence of the target gRNA on the target gene; and (3) according to the estimated cell number, carrying out experimental cost analysis and gRNA proportion analysis to obtain an optimized experimental scheme. The cell number estimated by the method is not only beneficial to experiment personnel to carry out experiments, but also can carry out experiment cost analysis, when the user considers that the experiment cost is too high, the cell number can be appropriately deleted, and when the target gRNA is a plurality of the target gRNAs, the gRNA proportion distribution can be optimized, so that the experiment cost is reduced, the waste of biological resources is avoided, and the experiment efficiency is improved.

title_en: Health state monitoring data safety acquisition device and method for rotating equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification discloses a health status monitoring data safety acquisition device and method of rotating equipment, wherein the device comprises: the MCU circuit, the safe encryption unit and the active identification unit are connected with the MCU circuit; the safety encryption unit is used for receiving health state monitoring data of the rotating equipment uploaded by the MCU circuit and converting the health state monitoring data into bit strings; acquiring elliptic curve parameters of an internal elliptic curve encryption algorithm, and calculating and determining an encryption value of the bit string based on the elliptic curve parameters and random numbers generated by a random number generator arranged in the calculation unit; encrypting the bit string based on the encryption value to obtain ciphertext data of the health state monitoring data for storage; the active identification unit is used for acquiring ciphertext data of the health state monitoring data, extracting a device identification code of the rotating equipment, binding the ciphertext data with the device identification code, and transmitting the ciphertext data to a corresponding enterprise platform in a WIFI or 4G-based mode.

title_en: Log storage method and device for small system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a log storage method and device of a small system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which are applied to the electronic equipment, wherein the electronic equipment comprises the small system and log grabbing service, and the method comprises the following steps: after the small system is started, the log grabbing service calls a log interface of the small system, and log data are obtained from a log partition of the small system; the log grabbing service stores the log data into a preset storage area according to a preset log category; the preset storage area is a storage area of the log grabbing service application, which is different from the log partition of the small system. Therefore, the log data corresponding to the small system can be stored under the condition that the small system operates.

title_en: Manufacturing workshop effective man-hour interpretability calculation method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for calculating the effective man-hour interpretability of a manufacturing workshop based on digital twinning. Firstly, establishing an information database of workshop personnel; then, establishing a three-dimensional virtual scene of the workshop; integrating machine vision and UWB ultra-wideband equipment to identify and dynamically track personnel to acquire identity, coordinates and timestamp information of the personnel; pairing the personnel information obtained in the two modes, detecting and deleting abnormal values in the coordinate data through a mean-variance method, and fusing the coordinate data through a weighted average method to obtain more real coordinate information; establishing connection between an information database and Unity, displaying the moving track and behavior of personnel in real time in a virtual workshop, and performing visual interpretation on effective working hours; finally, calculating the total working time T1 of the staff during the working period, analyzing the non-working action occupation time of the staff in the working area, recording as invalid working time T1, subtracting T2 from T1 to obtain effective working time T3, and feeding back to Untiy.

title_en: Detection method and system based on deep fake product detection model
abstract_en: The application discloses a detection method and a detection system based on a deep forgery product detection model, wherein the detection method based on the deep forgery product detection model comprises the following steps: constructing a deep counterfeiting product detection model; acquiring image data to be detected, and inputting the image data into a constructed deep forgery product detection model; the depth forgery product detection model outputs a detection result of the image data. The application range is wider, no special requirement is provided for the input image format, the application is suitable for images and videos, and only partial frames are needed for the videos, and a sequence associated with the video in front of and behind is not needed. In addition, most of the prior art is only based on the face characteristics, and strict requirements are also imposed on the image content, so that the application can capture the evidence of counterfeiting techniques.

title_en: Nuclear power station panoramic image detection surface defect positioning method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for positioning surface defects of panoramic image detection of a nuclear power station, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the field of video inspection of the nuclear power station. The invention comprises the following steps: collecting video information on the surface of the nuclear power station; stitching the video frame pixels extracted from the video into a full Jing Tuxiang; acquiring pixel point coordinates of a defect in the panoramic image; extracting position character information of each original frame in the video; establishing an index for each defective pixel point in the extracted panoramic image and the position character information in the original frame where the defective pixel point is located; establishing a corresponding relation between the pixel points and the position character information in the original frame; and the defect is positioned by establishing a corresponding relation between character information reflecting accurate position information and a pixel point at the defect in the generated panoramic image. The invention can effectively solve the problem of defect positioning in panoramic image detection, has accurate and reliable positioning precision, and obviously improves the efficiency and accuracy of defect detection.

title_en: Monocular camera calibration method based on phase target and two-way path basis function neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monocular camera calibration method based on a phase target and a two-way path basis function neural network, which adopts a characteristic extraction method of a three-step phase shift method, calculates absolute phases by using a multi-frequency method, converts the absolute phases carried by phase target characteristic points into a three-dimensional space, establishes a corresponding relation between characteristic point image coordinates and world coordinates, and finally uses a two-RBF neural network to complete direct mapping from two-dimensional image coordinates to three-dimensional space coordinates, and the whole RBF neural network adopts a genetic algorithm to carry out iterative optimization on width parameters and uses an improved minimum mean square learning rule to prevent excessive calculation. Meanwhile, the function model is used for constraint in the depth direction, so that the convenience and accuracy of the monocular camera calibration method are improved, and the camera calibration requirement can be met under a complex distortion environment.

title_en: Structure data storage method, loading device, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a structure data storage method, a loading device, electronic equipment and a medium, and relates to the technical field of industrial control, wherein the structure data storage method comprises the following steps: creating a structure definition record in a preset definition table according to names and data types respectively corresponding to the structures; creating a first layer member definition record of each structure in the definition table according to the hierarchical relationship among the structures and between the structures and the non-structures; and generating a structure definition table according to each structure definition record and each first-layer member definition record, and storing the structure definition table in a database. The method and the device can solve the technical problem that redundant data in structural body data stored in a database are too much.

title_en: Man-machine interaction intention understanding method based on visual language multi-mode fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a man-machine interaction intention understanding method based on vision language multi-mode fusion. And extracting intention understanding key information by adopting a real-time interaction semantic analysis model integrating voice recognition and natural language processing NLP. At the semantic layer, the robot understands key information from the interactive intent extracted from the human instruction language. The operation layer receives the key information in the text form, and matches the noun text in the key information with the object class name of the visual detection model to obtain the position information of the object in the key information. The model based on the vision language multi-mode fusion can convert the language instruction of the person into the operation vector which can be understood by the robot and is of an operation layer, and the model is concise and efficient and has strong practicability; especially for the detection of small objects or items in complex interaction scenes.

title_en: Early warning method, device, equipment and storage medium for vehicle oil tank liquid level reduction event
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of data processing, in particular to a vehicle oil tank liquid level reduction event early warning method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical oil tank liquid level reduction data of a target area; performing cluster analysis on the historical oil tank liquid level reduction data based on the oil tank liquid level variation dimension, the space dimension and the time dimension to obtain a historical distribution result of the historical oil tank liquid level reduction data; acquiring oil tank liquid level reduction event information of a target area based on a historical distribution result; performing tank level reduction event early warning on the target area based on the tank level reduction event information; according to the scheme, the tank liquid level reduction event early warning is carried out on the target area based on the tank liquid level reduction event information, so that a user can conveniently obtain the tank liquid level reduction event condition of the target area, and the problem that the tank liquid level reduction event cannot be found and early warned in time in the related technology is solved.

title_en: Policy sending method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a policy sending method, a policy sending device, a policy sending equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the policy sending method comprises the steps of obtaining equipment parameters of terminal equipment, obtaining equipment scores aiming at the terminal equipment, wherein the equipment parameters are used for reflecting equipment performance of the terminal equipment, the equipment scores are obtained by evaluating the performance of the terminal equipment based on scoring equipment, determining grading information of the terminal equipment based on the equipment parameters of the terminal equipment and the equipment scores of the terminal equipment, determining a target processing policy aiming at the terminal equipment based on the grading information of the terminal equipment, and sending the target processing policy to the terminal equipment so that the terminal equipment adopts the target processing policy to process data. By adopting the embodiment of the application, targeted data processing can be realized, and the data processing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Psychological health auxiliary evaluation method based on emotion event knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a psychological health auxiliary evaluation method based on an emotion event knowledge graph, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent psychological health evaluation. S1, constructing an emotion knowledge graph; s2, firstly, constructing a concept layer; then, according to the defined event representation and event relation, extracting information from the text of the consultant to obtain a knowledge tuple to complete the construction of an instance layer; the extracted information is constructed into a knowledge form to form an emotion event knowledge graph; s3, developing a visual system based on the emotion event knowledge graph; s4, inputting the self-described text of the person to be detected into the system, processing the self-described text by the system to obtain an emotion event knowledge graph, and displaying the knowledge graph through the front end for assisting in assessing mental health. The method of the invention digs the consultant to construct a knowledge graph from the events and the emotions in the text and visualizes the knowledge graph, and deduces the emotion causes and the emotion change states by utilizing the dynamic of the emotion event development so as to evaluate the psychological health.

title_en: Automatic generation method and system for fusion two-dimensional code
abstract_en: The disclosure provides an automatic generation method and system for a fusion two-dimensional code, which relate to the technical field of two-dimensional code generation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: based on the deployment generation environment, basic information importing and two-dimensional code generating are carried out, and an initial two-dimensional code is determined; activating a self-adaptive adjustment and modification model, adjusting and reconstructing the initial two-dimensional code, and determining a standard two-dimensional code; leading in a pre-fusion picture, activating a fusion model, and combining fusion constraint conditions to perform fusion processing of a standard two-dimensional code and the pre-fusion picture, thereby determining to generate a two-dimensional code; combining the verification model, performing anomaly detection and camouflage restoration on the generated two-dimensional code, and determining a corrected two-dimensional code; and storing the address of the corrected two-dimensional code. The method can solve the technical problems of low generation efficiency and poor quality caused by more manual operation in the generation process due to lower automation degree of the existing fusion two-dimensional code generation method, and can improve the intellectualization and automation of fusion two-dimensional code generation and further improve the generation efficiency and quality.

title_en: Method and system for providing a collision model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for providing a collision model, comprising-acquiring patient information having information about the spatial positioning of a medical object into an access site of an examination object, wherein the patient information is registered with a movable medical device, -acquiring object information having information about the geometry and spatial position of an operator moving the medical object, wherein the operator comprises a moving means and/or a medical operator, -determining the relative positioning of the operator with respect to the examination object based on the patient information and the object information, -providing a collision model for moving the medical device based on the relative positioning and the object information. The invention also relates to a system and a computer program product.

title_en: Intracranial hemorrhage anatomy identification and positioning method and system based on CT image
abstract_en: The invention provides an intracranial hemorrhage anatomical recognition and positioning method and system based on CT images. The method comprises the following steps: processing the intracranial hemorrhage CT sequence image to obtain hematoma identification and positioning results corresponding to each CT image on the cross section, wherein the hematoma identification and positioning results comprise hemorrhage subtype types and hematoma position information marked by a boundary frame; for hematoma recognition and localization results are bleeding in brain areas: inputting the sub-image of the boundary box marking area to the first segmentation model to obtain a hematoma boundary; obtaining a generated CT image through a generated countermeasure network; inputting the generated CT image to a second segmentation model to obtain a brain region segmentation boundary; and determining the partition where the hematoma is located by intersecting the hematoma boundary and the brain region partition boundary, and outputting the hematoma identification and positioning result and the name of the partition where the hematoma is located. In order to avoid interference of the hematoma area on the subarea of the brain area, the CT image is generated to obtain the subarea boundary, and the hematoma boundary and the subarea boundary are intersected to obtain the name of the subarea where the hematoma is located, so that accurate anatomical positioning is realized.

title_en: Wind power cluster power prediction model based on multi-feature similarity matching method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind power cluster power prediction model based on a multi-feature similarity matching method, and belongs to the field of power system scheduling. The specific method comprises the following steps: dividing historical numerical weather forecast data and historical power data of the wind power cluster into training data and test data, and performing principal component analysis processing on the historical numerical weather forecast data of the training part; the model sets four parameters of a distance percentage, a distance attenuation coefficient, a time attenuation coefficient and a power adjustment coefficient, optimizes the four parameters of the prediction model by adopting a variable measurement grid search method, calculates the characteristic distance between an input data matrix of a prediction point and a history point, compares the characteristic distance with a threshold value, and obtains a data set with highest matching degree with the prediction data set; analyzing the influence of the four parameters on the prediction error by adopting a control variable method, and adjusting initial optimization values of the four parameters to obtain an optimal combination of the four parameters; and obtaining the predicted power by utilizing the historical data through a multi-feature similarity matching method according to the optimal combination of the parameters.

title_en: Temperature control system and method for integrated die-casting die
abstract_en: The invention relates to a temperature control system and a temperature control method for an integrated die-casting die, which belong to the technical field of die-casting dies, and solve the problems that in the prior art, the monitored points are too many, the critical monitored points are difficult to determine, and the temperature monitoring efficiency is low because the monitored points are too many, by selecting the point positions of an inlet, an outlet, a maximum thickness part and a die core of the die-casting die and adopting a principal component analysis method to identify the point positions with obvious temperature change in the die-casting process; the method comprises the steps of acquiring experience data based on multiple times of die casting of key points, establishing a multiple logistic regression model between the temperature data of the key points and the die casting effect data variable, and solving the problems that in the prior art, the relation between the temperature of the key monitoring points and the die casting effect is difficult to quantify, the accuracy of temperature control is reduced, and the die casting effect is unstable.

title_en: System, method and related device for wireless burning of printed circuit board
abstract_en: The application provides a system, a method and a related device for wirelessly burning a printed circuit board, and the method for detecting resource leakage provided by the embodiment of the application is implemented, so that an upper computer can firstly send first data to be burned to a printed circuit board by utilizing a wired communication mode, and the printed circuit board receives data necessary for the printed circuit board to use wireless communication service through a primary serial port of a central processing unit. After the first data to be burnt is burnt by the printed circuit board, the upper computer can send the rest data to be burnt to the printed circuit blank board in a wireless communication mode, so that the data burning of the printed circuit blank board is completed. It can be seen that the method of the embodiment of the application only needs to realize data burning by using the primary serial port and wireless communication mode of the central processing unit in the printed circuit blank board, and does not need to keep the USB related burning interface or circuit, thereby reducing the manufacturing cost of the printed circuit board and ensuring the burning efficiency of the printed circuit board.

title_en: Method, device, medium and equipment for generating pseudo random sequence calculation program
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, a medium and equipment for generating a pseudo random sequence calculation program, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring bit width, polynomial and initial value of a pseudo-random sequence to be calculated; determining a target expression of the pseudo-random sequence to be calculated in a specified script based on the bit width, the polynomial and the initial value of the pseudo-random sequence to be calculated; therefore, the application can rapidly determine the target expression corresponding to the pseudo-random sequence to be calculated without manual calculation, and can save the time for determining the target expression; and finally, in response to executing the specified script, generating a target program for calculating the pseudo-random sequence based on the target expression, so that the target program for calculating the pseudo-random sequence is automatically generated through the specified script, the programming workload is reduced, and the programming working efficiency is improved.

title_en: CAN bus safety test method and system based on UDS
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of CAN bus testing, in particular to a CAN bus safety testing method and system based on UDS, which comprises the steps of establishing communication connection between a testing computer and a CAN bus interface of a vehicle to be tested through connecting hardware; the test computer sends a standard UDS diagnosis request, and the ECU supporting the UDS communication protocol is identified through the standard UDS diagnosis request; executing a UDS sub-service discovery request on each ECU, and identifying a sub-service list supported by each ECU; according to the UDS sub-services corresponding to each ECU, analyzing the functions and potential risks corresponding to each UDS sub-service, and identifying the UDS sub-services with high risks; based on the UDS sub-service with high risk, the test computer automatically generates simulation request information and sends the simulation request information to the ECU corresponding to the UDS sub-service, whether the response of the corresponding ECU accords with a predefined security policy is verified, and if not, the UDS sub-service is judged to have potential security holes.

title_en: Subway fault early warning method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of rail transit and provides a subway fault early warning method, a subway fault early warning device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring auxiliary monitoring information of each subway; wherein the subway auxiliary monitoring information comprises at least one of the following: subway equipment operation sound information, subway equipment operation vibration information, subway equipment operation current information and subway equipment operation voltage information; analyzing each piece of subway auxiliary monitoring information through an outlier algorithm, and determining at least one piece of subway auxiliary monitoring abnormal information in each piece of subway auxiliary monitoring information; and determining subway fault equipment based on the subway equipment corresponding to the subway auxiliary monitoring abnormal information.

title_en: Magnetic suspension motor control method and device, motor controller and storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to the field of motors, and in particular, to a magnetic levitation motor control method, a magnetic levitation motor control device, a motor controller, and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of switching off a power supply when the operation of the magnetic levitation motor is abnormal, controlling the rotor to rotate downwards before the rotor of the magnetic levitation motor stops rotating, and converting the kinetic energy of the rotor into the electric energy of a power supply module of the magnetic levitation motor so as to enable the rotor to be in a suspension state before the rotor stops rotating. The method can prevent the rotor from instantaneously falling after the washing machine is suddenly powered off, so that irreparable damage is caused to the washing machine.

title_en: Intelligent window opening and closing system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent window opening and closing system and a method, wherein the intelligent window opening and closing system comprises: the system comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a model construction module and a decision module; the data acquisition module collects indoor and outdoor environment information and integrates the indoor and outdoor environment information to obtain an environment data set; the data processing module performs data preprocessing on the environment data set to obtain a processed data set; the model construction module constructs a decision tree, embeds nodes of the decision tree into a target feedforward neural network model, and generates a switch window decision model; the decision module inputs the processing data set to a window opening and closing decision model to obtain a window opening and closing decision result, and transmits the window opening and closing decision result to the singlechip to control the opening and closing of the window. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device have the advantages that the window opening and closing decision result is obtained through the window opening and closing decision model, the window opening and closing control is realized through the singlechip, the window opening and closing is intelligently regulated and controlled according to the indoor environment and the outdoor environment, and further the use experience of a user is improved.

title_en: Quantitative fluorescence measurement calibration system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a quantitative fluorescence measurement calibration system, in particular to the technical field of quantitative fluorescence measurement, which comprises an information acquisition module, a measurement module and a measurement module, wherein the information acquisition module acquires historical measurement data and measurement environment information of the water content of each stratum corneum; the data analysis module is used for analyzing the effectiveness of the acquired stratum corneum water content historical measurement data; the data processing module is used for analyzing the standard measurement range of the water content of the stratum corneum; the measurement calibration module is used for correcting through a standard measurement range of the water content of the stratum corneum so as to obtain the water content of the stratum corneum to be measured; the measurement optimization module is used for optimizing the measurement process of the fluorescence intensity of the stratum corneum to be measured; the updating module is used for updating the analysis process of the validity of the historical measurement data of the next monitoring period; the updating correction module corrects the updating process of the analysis process of the validity of the historical measurement data of the next monitoring period; the invention improves the quantitative measurement efficiency and accuracy of the object to be measured.

title_en: Real-time early warning method and system for safety state of switch cabinet
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic digital data processing, in particular to a real-time early warning method and system for the safety state of a switch cabinet, comprising the following steps: analyzing the change characteristics of temperature data at different positions of a switch cabinet in a three-dimensional coordinate system, constructing the change significance degree of data points, fusing the change significance degree, the offset adjustment weight and the coordinates of target data points, weighting and adjusting the distances among the data points in a cluster, finally obtaining abnormal data points through the cluster, deleting the abnormal data points, and predicting and alarming new temperature data by using a prediction algorithm. The invention improves the detection rate of abnormal data points, further improves the accuracy of real-time early warning of the safety state of the switch cabinet and ensures the safe operation of the switch cabinet.

title_en: Deep reinforcement learning-based power grid frequency control method and device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power grids and discloses a power grid frequency control method and device based on deep reinforcement learning; the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a power grid system state, inputting the power grid system state into an intelligent agent, and outputting a preliminary control strategy; wherein the agent is established based on a soft actor-critics SAC depth reinforcement learning algorithm; filtering the preliminary control strategy based on a control barrier system to obtain a target control strategy; the control barrier system is used for ensuring that the state of the power grid system at any moment is in a safe area; and controlling the active frequency of the power grid based on the target control strategy. The control strategy can be timely adjusted to adapt to a new power grid system state, any control strategy output by an intelligent agent is ensured not to cause the power grid system state to enter an unsafe area, reliable guarantee is provided for stable operation of a power grid, and accuracy, safety and robustness of active frequency control of the power grid are improved.

title_en: Remote wireless intelligent monitoring method and system for automation equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote wireless intelligent monitoring method and a remote wireless intelligent monitoring system for automatic equipment, which relate to the technical field of intelligent monitoring and comprise the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a standard physical state monitoring index and a standard energy consumption monitoring index through processing respectively by collecting physical state monitoring data and energy consumption monitoring data when equipment normally operates; periodically acquiring real-time physical state monitoring data and energy consumption monitoring data when the equipment is in operation, and respectively calculating a physical state monitoring index and an energy consumption monitoring index in a current monitoring period; calculating a physical state and an energy consumption deviation index by combining the real-time index with the standard index, and further judging whether the equipment is abnormal or not; and once an abnormality occurs, recording abnormal working time, and sending out an abnormal signal when a preset threshold value is reached, so that the remote control equipment stops operating. The timeliness and the accuracy of the abnormality detection of the automatic equipment are improved by remotely monitoring multiple items of data of the automatic equipment in real time during operation.

title_en: Artificial intelligent chip architecture scheme with voltage self-adjustment and charge-discharge supplementation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence chip-oriented implementation method and a circuit, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the proposed artificial intelligent chip takes a computing array as a core, a plurality of computing units are contained in the computing array, the computing units can support different working voltages to realize flexible adjustment of self working voltages, the computing units can flexibly switch the self working voltages according to task and configuration requirements so as to realize voltage rising or voltage reducing in the current computing equipment and can flexibly perform self-allocation, for example, part of high-calculation-force demand tasks can be executed in a voltage range to obtain quick correspondence, part of low-calculation-force demand tasks can be executed in a low-voltage range to better support multi-voltage operation and other applications. Furthermore, the proposed computing units comprise charge-discharge supplementary modules therebetween to realize integration and pull-up operations of the cross-voltage data and flexible voltage distribution and adjustment of computing tasks.

title_en: Standard data processing method based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a standard data processing method based on a knowledge graph, which comprises the steps of obtaining source data to be subjected to standardized processing and performing word segmentation processing, and determining a target field according to a word segmentation result of the source data; further acquiring corresponding triples in the knowledge graph to obtain a first set; extracting a model by adopting a relation of a self-attention mechanism to obtain a second set to be standardized; the method can improve the consistency and accuracy of the standardized data and provide powerful support for the work of scientific research, management, analysis and the like.

title_en: Method and system for self-identifying noise of earphone
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for self-identifying noise of an earphone, wherein the method for self-identifying noise comprises the steps of creating a filtered white list, and the data of the filtered white list comprises at least one piece of standard sound information; acquiring an environmental sound, extracting information of at least one group of sub-sounds in the environmental sound, and emitting information of different sub-sounds by different sound sources; extracting characteristic data of the sub-sound, matching the characteristic data with the data of the filtered white list, determining the recognition type of the sub-sound according to the matching result, and transmitting the effective sound to the user according to the recognition type. According to the method, under the preset recognition rule, the accuracy of judging whether the sound is noise or not is improved by comparing the two dimensions of the voiceprint data and the voice data of the target sound with the data of the filtered white list, so that the recognition result is more in line with the needs of a user, the user can listen to the song and experience, and the user can obtain external effective information better.

title_en: 5G repeater signal processing method and system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of wireless communication networks, and in particular, to a method and a system for processing a 5G repeater signal. The method comprises the following steps: performing analog-to-digital conversion and digital down-conversion on the 5G signal data to obtain intermediate frequency signal data; performing memory model construction on the historical signal monitoring data to obtain a long-term and short-term memory model; performing countermeasure training on the historical signal monitoring data to obtain a generated countermeasure network model; performing data mimicry based on the generated countermeasure network model to obtain nonlinear distortion simulation data and simulation original data; performing nonlinear distortion compensation on the clock offset correction data to obtain nonlinear distortion compensation data; performing multi-signal interference prediction on the nonlinear distortion compensation data based on the depth Q network model, so as to obtain multi-signal interference prediction data; and carrying out beam suppression strategy training on the multi-signal interference prediction data so as to acquire a beam suppression strategy. The invention can realize the accurate interference suppression of the signal data of the 5G repeater.

title_en: Motor neural network coder-decoder
abstract_en: The computing system receives a broadcast video stream of the game. The codec module of the computing system extracts image-level features from the broadcast video stream. The codec module includes an object detection section configured to detect a player in the broadcast video stream and a subnet section attached to the object detection section. The subnet section is configured to identify foreground information of the detected player. The codec module provides the image level features to a plurality of task-specific modules for analysis. The plurality of task-specific modules generate a plurality of outputs based on the image-level features.

title_en: Abnormality detection method and device for software, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method, apparatus, computer program product, non-transitory computer readable storage medium, and electronic device for abnormality detection of software. The abnormality detection method of the software comprises the following steps: generating a screenshot of the software running environment; acquiring software operation information associated with a software operation environment, wherein the software operation information corresponds to a screenshot; writing software running information associated with the software running environment into the screenshot; and detecting whether the operation of the software is abnormal or not according to the screenshot with the software operation information. The embodiment of the disclosure is beneficial to reducing the cost of software anomaly detection and improving the precision of anomaly detection.

title_en: Method and device for acquiring process machine set energy data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for acquiring process machine set energy data, wherein the acquisition method specifically comprises the following steps: determining the energy utilization type and providing a process machine set for acquiring energy utilization data in a discrete factory; acquiring the number of process machines in a process machine group and operation data of a single process machine, wherein the operation data comprises a load rate, an on-rate and an energy consumption peak value coefficient; based on a pre-constructed energy analysis model, energy data of a single process machine in the process machine set and an energy peak superposition coefficient of the process machine set are given; and combining the operation data, the energy data and the energy peak value superposition coefficient of the process machine set of the single process machine to give the energy data of the process machine set. The method for acquiring the process machine set energy data can rapidly and accurately acquire the average quantity and the peak value quantity of the energy required by the power system under the condition of the standard attribute of the equipment based on the design stage.

title_en: Regional carbon emission prediction system and method based on combined prediction model
