abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional carbon emission prediction method based on a combined prediction model, which comprises the steps of converting the carbon emission of a region corresponding to historical data of coal, petroleum and natural gas, and constructing linear or nonlinear regression models of various energy main bodies and regional carbon emission; carrying out data analysis on the carbon emission influence factors by utilizing a time sequence prediction model on the historical data, and obtaining a prediction result by prediction analysis; introducing the annual prediction result of the carbon emission influence factors into STIRPAT model, quantitatively researching the relation between carbon emission and each influence factor, and predicting regional carbon emission; analyzing the two regional carbon emission prediction conditions, and establishing a regional carbon emission combination prediction model based on an optimal weighting method; and introducing the regional carbon emission prediction result data into a combined prediction model to predict the final carbon emission of the region. The invention can reduce the prediction error and improve the stability of prediction.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted voiceprint awakening method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a vehicle-mounted voiceprint awakening method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a voiceprint wake-up data set and a voiceprint wake-up network; the voiceprint wake-up network is obtained by fitting a voiceprint recognition network and a voice wake-up network; acquiring vehicle-mounted noise data in a vehicle-mounted scene, adding the vehicle-mounted noise data with simulation capability into a voiceprint wake-up data set, and carrying out vehicle-mounted noise enhancement on the voiceprint wake-up data set; training the voiceprint wake-up network by adopting the voiceprint wake-up data set with enhanced vehicle-mounted noise to obtain a target voiceprint wake-up network, and waking up the vehicle-mounted voiceprint by adopting the target voiceprint wake-up network. By adopting the scheme, the voiceprint recognition network and the voice wake-up network are fused at the algorithm level, so that a voiceprint wake-up network is constructed, and the influence of reducing the performance of the voiceprint extraction network due to short sentences is reduced; and enhancing the vehicle noise aiming at the vehicle scene so as to improve the robustness of the model.

title_en: Method for evaluating operation performance of alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the operation performance of an alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps of obtaining the operation data of the alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production device, and obtaining the performance index of the alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production device according to the operation data; the performance indexes comprise a first-level index and a second-level index, a preset evaluation quantitative scale is obtained, a corresponding membership function is constructed according to the evaluation quantitative scale, a membership matrix is obtained by combining the second-level index and the membership function, the importance degree of each performance index is obtained, the evaluation weight of the performance index is determined according to the importance degree, and the performance evaluation result of the alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production device is obtained by combining the membership matrix and the evaluation weight. The method provides an operation performance evaluation method of the alkaline water electrolysis hydrogen production device under the fluctuation working condition, and the evaluation weight of the performance index is reasonably planned, so that the performance evaluation result is accurate and comprehensive.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and readable storage medium for adjusting steel truss girder axial deviation
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a system, equipment and a readable storage medium for adjusting the axial deviation of a steel truss girder, which comprises the steps of determining a first increment of a first splice plate between a framed girder section and a first adjustment Liang Duanjian and a third increment of a second splice plate between the first adjustment Liang Duanjian based on the girder width of the main girder, the length of a first adjustment girder section, the length of a second adjustment girder section and the transverse-longitudinal distance of an upper end node of the framed girder section; determining a second amount of increase of the erected girder segment and the first adjustment Liang Duanjian of the first longitudinal stiffener splice plate based on the girder width, the distance of the longitudinal stiffener relative to the girder lower edge, and the first amount of increase; determining a fourth increment of the splice plate of the first adjusting beam section and the second adjusting Liang Duanjian second longitudinal stiffening rib based on the girder width, the distance between the longitudinal stiffening rib and the lower edge of the girder and the third increment; and adjusting the main beam axis deviation based on the first increment, the second increment, the third increment, the fourth increment and the initial interval of the bolt group, so as to ensure that the main beam axis deviation is within a specified limit value.

title_en: Image correction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to an image correction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an image to be processed; determining a target color channel according to the pixel values of the color channels of each pixel point in the image to be processed; wherein the pixel values of the target color channel are distributed in a preset pixel value range; reconstructing the pixel value of the target color channel according to the pixel value of the color channel of each pixel point; the pixel value range of the target color channel after reconstruction is larger than the preset pixel value range, and the number of different pixel values of the target color channel after reconstruction is larger than the number of different pixel values of the target color channel before reconstruction; and performing white balance treatment on the reconstructed image to be treated to obtain a color cast corrected image. By the method, the effect of image color cast correction can be improved.

title_en: Video processing method and device, electronic equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a video processing method and device, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of video processing. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a video frame containing a target object in a video to be processed; and extracting the characteristics of the target object to obtain object attribute information of the target object, and determining a target frame from the video frame according to the object attribute information and the image attribute information of the corresponding area of the target object. The video frame extraction method and device can improve accuracy and frame extraction quality of video frames.

title_en: Auxiliary device for laying cable pipeline and connecting method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cable pipeline laying, and discloses a cable pipeline laying auxiliary device and a connecting method. When the auxiliary device for laying the cable pipelines works, on one hand, butt joint connection between every two pipelines can be realized, and on the other hand, butt joint and concentric alignment operation of every two cable pipelines can be realized rapidly.

title_en: CCUS dynamic characteristic evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CCUS dynamic characteristic evaluation method, which comprises the following steps: s1, measuring the dry weight and the size of a rock core, measuring the porosity and the pore volume of the rock core, vacuumizing the rock core, saturating stratum water, and aging the rock core; s2, placing the rock core into a holder, carrying out water displacement treatment after the rock core is saturated with oil, and setting back pressure as pressure a; s3, carrying out core treatment in the clamp holder: injecting CO  2  to 100 percent of gas into the rock core at a constant speed, closing an air outlet of the back pressure control device after the gas is discharged for a period of time, injecting CO  2  at a constant speed to increase the pressure to b, and injecting CO  2  again to the pressure b until the pressure is balanced after the pressure is conducted and balanced; s4, establishing a CCUS characteristic curve; s5, qualitatively judging a CO  2  sealing mechanism according to the change rule of dynamic characteristic parameter indexes of different stages of the CCUS characteristic curve, and quantitatively calculating the CO  2  sealing quantity. According to the invention, by analyzing the dynamic characteristic curve, qualitative research on the CO  2  sealing mechanism and quantitative calculation of the CO  2  sealing quantity are realized.

title_en: Text hard tag anti-attack method and system based on differential evolution algorithm
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of Internet security, and particularly relates to a text hard tag challenge-against method and system based on a differential evolution algorithm, which can be used for efficiently realizing challenge-against based on a differential evolution thought and generating a high-quality challenge sample with similar semantics and smooth content. The method for initializing the countermeasure sample at multiple angles is adopted, the problem of local optimum of the countermeasure sample caused by single initialization is avoided, and the combination optimization of key words is combined, so that the quality of the generated countermeasure sample is effectively improved. The invention can realize the attack resistance of the model and the API in the real world scene with little expenditure, thereby making the attack resistance and defense research of the hard tag more feasible. The invention evaluates the effectiveness of the attack method, and the experimental result shows that the method not only remarkably improves the attack efficiency, but also obtains good results in the test of semantic similarity, confusion degree and the like.

title_en: Soft measurement modeling method for temperature of blast furnace tuyere convolution zone
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of metallurgical engineering, in particular to a soft measurement modeling method for the temperature of a blast furnace tuyere convolution zone. According to the method, through introducing concepts of homomorphic mapping and algebraic topology, the internal structure and mode of temperature data can be deeply analyzed, the method not only reveals complex relations and characteristics hidden in the data, but also enhances deep understanding of a temperature control mechanism, and secondly, the combined optimization theory is applied to a data processing flow, so that key links such as data preprocessing, characteristic extraction and model optimization are optimized, the efficiency and accuracy of data processing are improved, and the overall performance of temperature prediction and control is enhanced.

title_en: Method for simulating original data of wave spectrometer
abstract_en: The application relates to an original data simulation of an ocean wave spectrometer. The method comprises the following steps: performing discrete gridding on the sea surface scene; calculating a sea wave altitude spectrum, and further generating a sea wave altitude field, a sea wave orbit speed field and a sea wave orbit acceleration field; generating a spectrometer sea surface backscattering coefficient field by using the quasi-mirror scattering model and simulation parameters; converting the sea surface altitude field, the sea wave orbit speed field, the sea wave orbit acceleration field and the sea surface backscattering coefficient field into a satellite orbit-orbit coordinate system from a radar beam rotation polar coordinate system, and then merging into a radar instantaneous distance equation; after a radar equation of a spectrometer is used for generating a radar echo power field and a radar receiver thermal noise power, generating an echo complex random amplitude field containing speckle noise and a thermal noise complex random signal; substituting the instantaneous distance equation, the echo complex random amplitude field and the thermal noise complex random signal into a spectrometer radar response equation to finally obtain the original data of the wave spectrometer. The effectiveness of the data simulation of the spectrometer is improved.

title_en: Biological genetic sample transcriptome sequencing analysis method based on DRS
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biological genetic sample transcriptome sequencing analysis method based on DRS, and relates to the technical field of gene sequencing. The method comprises the steps of enriching mRNA to establish a direct sequencing library; performing second generation sequencing and third generation DRS sequencing; performing quality control and error correction on the sequenced data; comparing and counting the error-corrected transcript sequence with a reference gene to obtain a new transcript; performing functional annotation and coding region prediction on the new transcript; optimizing the structure of the transcripts, performing variable shear analysis, fusion transcript analysis, lncRNA prediction, transcript expression quantification analysis, differential expression and functional enrichment analysis, poly (a) analysis, methylation analysis and pseudouridine analysis. The method builds an integrated analysis flow based on nextflow and dock, optimizes the content from new transcript identification to quantitative difference analysis, and further plays the advantage of RNA direct sequencing; multiple analysis processes are added and related to expression, and the transcript expression is systematically explained in multiple angles.

title_en: Image fusion quality evaluation method based on Gaussian and Laplacian pyramid learning
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of image evaluation, in particular to an image fusion quality evaluation method based on Gaussian and Laplacian pyramid learning, which comprises the following evaluation steps: s1, acquiring a fusion image, and selecting a random infrared visible light image, a medical image and a multi-focus image from a known database for fusion; s2, sampling a source image and constructing a Gaussian pyramid; s3, sampling the obtained Gaussian pyramid image to construct a second layer of Laplacian pyramid; s4, calculating SSIM index scores of the source image and the fusion image; s5, setting the weight ratio of each fusion image through calculation. According to the application, the SSIM index is utilized to calculate the information entropy, the weight of each level of the information entropy of each level of the Gaussian pyramid and the Laplacian pyramid is utilized, the weight is multiplied by the corresponding SSIM index score to be used as a final evaluation score, and the difference between the calculated fusion quality score and subjective quality evaluation of human eyes is reduced.

title_en: Method for distinguishing evapotranspiration of orchard forest-grass composite system based on underlying surface conductivity method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of evapotranspiration distinction, in particular to an orchard forest-grass composite system evapotranspiration distinction method based on an underlying surface conductivity method, which realizes distinction of canopy evapotranspiration, grass evapotranspiration and soil evaporation of orchard fruits. The scheme comprises the following steps: collecting and processing data; calculating the total conductivity of the fruit garden-grass composite system based on the water flux data and a reverse-push Penman-Monteth formula; calculating the total primary productivity of the fruit garden-grass composite system according to the carbon flux data, and calculating the grass primary productivity and the fruit tree primary productivity based on the productivity evaluation model; calculating the canopy conductivity and the grass conductivity of the fruit tree based on the underlying surface conductivity model, and calculating the soil conductivity from the total conductivity; and (3) setting and constructing the relationship among the transpiration of the underlying surface, the transpiration of the canopy of the fruit tree, the transpiration of the grass and the soil, the total conductivity, the conductivity of the canopy of the fruit tree, the conductivity of the grass and the conductivity of the soil based on the consistent unit conductivity water flux, so as to realize the distinction of the transpiration of the underlying surface of the fruit garden-grass composite system. The invention is suitable for the evapotranspiration distinction of the fruit garden-grass composite system.

title_en: Feature extraction method of single-band backbone network architecture based on glance and staring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a feature extraction method of a single-band backbone network architecture based on glance and staring, which comprises the following steps: constructing a backbone network comprising a glancing network, a low-scale feature extraction module and a plurality of staring networks with different scales; acquiring a single-band infrared image and inputting the single-band infrared image into a glance network to obtain an infrared image candidate region and an enhanced infrared image; the enhanced infrared image is input to a low-scale feature extraction module to obtain extracted features; the extracted features and the infrared image candidate areas are respectively input into a first staring network to obtain first scale features; the first scale feature and the infrared image candidate region are respectively input into the next staring network to obtain a second scale feature, and the second scale feature is obtained until the last staring network processes the obtained scale feature as the infrared target depth feature. The method can actively, rapidly and accurately extract the target high-dimensional characteristics in the single-band image.

title_en: Data processing method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a data processing method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a program product, wherein the method comprises the following steps: identifying text triggering scene information corresponding to a first participation object, and acquiring target text keywords associated with the text triggering scene information from the text keywords based on the triggering scene information corresponding to the text keywords; acquiring candidate document data comprising target document keywords, and acquiring object information of a second participation object aimed at by the document triggering scene information; and generating a target document based on the object information of the second participation object and the candidate document data. By adopting the embodiment of the application, the matching degree of the target document and the document triggering scene information in the Internet page can be improved.

title_en: Matcher-based medical image sequence segmentation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical image sequence segmentation method based on Matcher. Firstly, preprocessing images in a target medical image sequence and a reference medical image sequence, extracting features, and calculating a corresponding relation matrix; matching the reference mask with the corresponding relation matrix through a bidirectional matching strategy to obtain a matching layer; screening the matching layers, and processing the screened matching layers by adopting k-means++ clustering to generate a prompt sampling set; processing the obtained prompt sampling set as the input of a pre-trained SAM model to obtain a proposal list; performing instance level matching between the reference mask and the prediction mask to obtain a result list; and finally, sequencing the result list to obtain a final segmentation result and outputting the final segmentation result. The method adopts strategies such as bidirectional matching, prompt sampling, instance level matching and the like, can generate high-quality masks, and realizes clearer and more accurate segmentation results.

title_en: Management method for data of unmanned mine car
abstract_en: The invention provides a management method of unmanned mine car data, which relates to the field of data management and comprises the following steps: acquiring a first image of an unmanned mine car to obtain a current driving environment; based on the driving environment and driving requirements, matching corresponding driving routes; based on the real-time dimension data, the real-time level data and the driving route of the unmanned mine car, a current adjusting route is obtained; terminal modification of the driving route based on the obstacle parameters involved on the adjustment route; and (3) the driving route modified by the evaluation terminal is stored in a driving route database, so that the operation efficiency of the mine site is improved, the safe driving of the unmanned mine car is ensured, and the operation safety of the mine site is ensured.

title_en: Method and device for capturing artificial descending plume, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for capturing artificial downflow plumes, which can be applied to the fields of oceans and lakes. Because the density of the artificial downflow plume is lower than that of the water body in the receiving environment, the plume can completely escape from the anoxic layer due to buoyancy, so that the oxygenation of the artificial downflow plume is ineffective; the control method is simple and reliable, is convenient to operate, and can easily obtain the optimal height of the distribution of the downflow guide pipe, thereby ensuring that the artificial downflow plume is completely captured by the low-oxygen layer and realizing the maximization of oxygenation efficiency.

title_en: Diagnostic report generation method, device and medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a diagnostic report generation method, apparatus, and medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an actual color fundus image, an actual fundus fluorescence angiography image and corresponding actual clinical characteristics; performing diagnosis classification by using the constructed fundus disease multi-label diagnosis classification model, and constructing a data set when constructing the fundus disease multi-label diagnosis classification model comprises the following steps: and collecting a plurality of FFA reports of the third hospital in Beijing university, wherein each report has corresponding clinical characteristics and fundus lesion reports and diagnosis conclusions issued by a senior retinal specialist, the plurality of FFA reports comprise a plurality of CFPs and a plurality of FFAs, the plurality of FFA reports are divided into a training set, a verification set and a test set in proportion, and the training set is used for training a multi-label classification model of fundus diseases. The technical effect of accurately identifying fundus diseases and generating a diagnosis report by utilizing an artificial intelligence technology is achieved.

title_en: Voice interaction type database query method, device and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a voice interactive database query method, a device and a medium, which are used for receiving voice signals input by a user, identifying the voice signals to obtain texts, obtaining query sentences according to the texts and a natural language processing model for completing training, executing the query sentences in a target database to obtain query results matched with the query sentences.

title_en: Equipment fault prediction method and system based on data driving
abstract_en: The application provides a device fault prediction method and a system based on data driving, which relate to the technical field of data processing, and the method comprises the following steps: collecting a multi-modal dataset of device operation; outputting a depth feature extraction model; extracting depth features of the multi-modal data set and outputting multi-modal depth features; deep fault feature extraction is carried out on the multi-mode deep features, and multi-mode deep fault features are output; training a multi-mode fault prediction model; and carrying out fault prediction according to the multi-mode fault prediction model, and outputting a fault prediction result. The method and the device can solve the technical problem that the failure prediction precision is insufficient due to poor fusion analysis effect on the multi-modal heterogeneous data in the prior art, and the deep feature extraction is carried out on the multi-modal data fusion to train the failure prediction model, so that the accuracy of semantic matching is improved, the training efficiency and the robustness of the neural network are improved, and the technical effect of the failure prediction precision is ensured.

title_en: Electronic device with antenna having compound curvature
abstract_en: The head-mounted device may have a head-mounted housing configured to be worn on the head of a user. When the head-mounted device is worn, the left and right displays in the optical module in the head-mounted device may provide images to the eyebox located at the rear of the head-mounted device. A front-facing publicly viewable display located on the front of the head mounted device may be covered with a transparent housing portion forming a display cover layer. A dielectric member having an annular edge portion surrounding a publicly viewable display may be mounted under a corresponding edge portion of the display cover layer. A flexible printed circuit antenna having a compound curvature may be laminated to the edge portion of the dielectric member.

title_en: Name generation method and device, electronic equipment and computer program product
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method and apparatus for generating a first name, an electronic device, and a computer program product, where the method includes: acquiring an automatic voice recognition text; extracting a target sentence from the automatic voice recognition text, wherein the target sentence comprises a context text for describing a name; extracting a name text and a name interpretation text from the target sentence; and generating a target name according to the name text and the interpretation text of the name. The method and the device can improve the accuracy of extracting the name from the automatic voice recognition text.

title_en: Building load prediction method and related system based on transfer learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to building load prediction, and discloses a building load prediction method based on transfer learning and a related system. The model is suitable for building energy consumption prediction with less historical data. The feature extractor provided by the invention has robustness to noise, and can reduce the influence of bottom shared distribution noise in the process of extracting private and public features. The method not only can reduce the loss of information, but also can decouple the features into the domain-specific features and the domain-invariant features, wherein the domain-invariant features are used for migrating knowledge, the domain-specific features are used for reducing the generalization error of the target domain, and the high-level semantics of the features can be extracted.

title_en: Engineering data management system and method based on digital construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses an engineering data management system and method based on digital construction, and belongs to the technical field of engineering data management. The system of the invention comprises: the system comprises a data extraction and classification module, a data visualization and feature analysis module, a risk assessment and strategy establishment module, a real-time data monitoring and analysis module and an emergency plan pushing and executing module; the data extraction and classification module extracts historical engineering data from the engineering project digital platform and classifies the historical engineering data; the data visualization and feature analysis module performs visualization representation on historical engineering data and performs feature analysis; the risk assessment and strategy establishment module calculates an abnormal risk assessment value and establishes an abnormal event coping strategy library; the real-time data monitoring and analyzing module acquires real-time engineering data and performs real-time analysis; the emergency plan pushing and executing module forms a comprehensive emergency plan based on the real-time abnormal risk assessment value and the abnormal event coping strategy library and pushes the comprehensive emergency plan to related personnel.

title_en: Visual defect detection method for three-axis turntable
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of edge detection, in particular to a visual defect detection method of a three-axis turntable. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an initial defect area in a gray level image of a part, combining gradient angle differences of adjacent edge pixel points on the edge of the initial defect area, obtaining an initial defect value of the initial defect area by the aid of the discrete degree of the shape of the initial defect area and the tangential edge length of the edge pixel points on the edge, and selecting a suspected defect area by the aid of the initial defect value; and screening out the actual defect area in the gray level image of the part according to the gray level distribution and the initial defect value of the suspected defect area and the gradient value distribution of the edge pixel points on the edge of the suspected defect area. The invention combines the shape characteristic, the edge smoothing characteristic and the color characteristic of the initial defect area to screen, thereby improving the accuracy of defect detection of the component in the three-axis turntable.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle scheduling checking method based on pipeline early warning and related device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle scheduling and checking method based on pipeline early warning and a related device, and belongs to the technical field of pipelines. The method comprises the following steps: after receiving the optical fiber early warning, obtaining first position information corresponding to the optical fiber early warning; determining a target unmanned aerial vehicle according to the first position information, and controlling the target unmanned aerial vehicle to shoot an image of a target pipeline corresponding to the first position information to obtain an initial shooting image; performing anomaly detection on the initial shooting image by using an image processing model to obtain an anomaly region of the initial shooting image; determining the abnormal type of the target pipeline according to the abnormal region; determining a target instruction of the target unmanned aerial vehicle and target voice corresponding to the target instruction according to the abnormal type, and sending the target instruction and the target voice to the target unmanned aerial vehicle, so that the target unmanned aerial vehicle executes early warning action according to the target instruction, and playing the target voice. Therefore, the abnormal conditions of the pipeline can be rapidly identified and processed, and the safety management efficiency and the safety management precision of the oil and gas pipeline are further improved.

title_en: Robot positioning method based on visual image processing
abstract_en: The application discloses a robot positioning method based on visual image processing, which is applied to a robot positioning system, wherein the robot positioning system comprises a plurality of robots and a master controller; each robot is provided with a visual image processing module, a marking module, a laser transmitting module, a laser receiving module and a processor module, and the robot positioning method combines visual image processing and laser signal processing, does not need to adopt devices such as a laser radar or a laser range finder to carry out ranging, and saves cost; all robots to be positioned can be positioned simultaneously by transmitting laser signals through the reference robot, the positioning speed is high, the specific direction of rotation of the visual image processing module is directly given, visual contrast matching is not needed for images of a plurality of angles, and the calculation resources and the positioning time required by the visual image processing module are greatly reduced.

title_en: Fully assembled steel plate composite beam structure and construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fully assembled steel plate composite beam structure and a construction method, which relate to the technical field of bridge engineering and comprise prefabricated bridge decks, I-shaped steel beams, two rows of bolt connecting pieces, two rows of embedded steel sleeves, bridge deck pavement and a plurality of U-shaped steel shear keys; the prefabricated bridge deck is arranged on the upper side of the I-shaped steel beam, a plurality of U-shaped steel shear keys are arranged on the upper side of the prefabricated bridge deck, the U-shaped steel shear keys are spliced along the bridge direction in sequence, the I-shaped steel beam and the U-shaped steel shear keys are arranged in an up-down corresponding mode, and the two rows of embedded steel sleeves are embedded and fixed on the prefabricated bridge deck. According to the invention, the first reserved through hole is larger than the high-strength bolt through the shearing resistance of the friction force generated by the bolt connecting piece, so that a larger fault tolerance range can be provided for the manufacture of components, especially the processing of the concrete precast slab.

title_en: Airport network delay propagation causality checking method, device and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a system for checking the delay propagation causality of an airport network, which comprise the steps of constructing delay time sequences of all airports based on acquired historical flight data, and generating an original data set; inputting the original data set into a pre-constructed depth separable expansion time convolution neural network based on an attention mechanism to obtain an attention vector; based on the attention vector and the original data set, attention interpretation, causality verification and causality delay mining are sequentially carried out, and an airport network delay propagation causality is obtained; and drawing a corresponding airport delay propagation causal network graph according to the airport network delay propagation causal relationship, and identifying a key airport in an airport network. The method and the device can solve the problem that the delay propagation causality between airports is difficult to capture in the prior art.

title_en: Exchange memory optimization method based on asynchronous deduplication and recompression
abstract_en: The application provides an exchange memory optimization method based on asynchronous deduplication and recompression, relates to the technical field of computers, and solves the problems that the amount of storage space is small because compressed data continuously fed into ZRAM space occupies a large amount of storage space when data in a memory is gradually increased under the conditions that memory resources of mobile phone equipment are limited and applications opened by users are more. The method comprises the following steps: starting an independent thread in the ZRAM space to scan, and sending the page with the retention time exceeding the threshold value 1 to FLASH; for pages exceeding the threshold 2 but being smaller than the threshold 1, searching for repeated pages with a plurality of pages_crc, decompressing the repeated pages and comparing the contents of the pages to realize judgment of a page sharing mechanism; other pages will perform a recompression operation in that interval using an algorithm that is better in compression performance.

title_en: Cross-modal hash model construction and retrieval method based on deep semantic interaction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cross-modal hash retrieval, and provides a cross-modal hash model construction and retrieval method based on deep semantic interaction, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a training example; inputting the image text pair and the label into a feature extraction module in an initial cross-modal hash model to obtain a first image feature, a first text feature and a label feature; inputting the first image feature, the first text feature and the label feature into a feature interaction module to obtain a second image feature and a second text feature; inputting the first image feature, the first text feature, the second image feature and the second text feature into a hash generation module to obtain an image hash code and a text hash code; and obtaining target loss based on the image hash code and the text hash code, and updating the initial cross-modal hash model to construct the cross-modal hash model. The method and the device improve the accuracy of cross-modal hash retrieval.

title_en: Data handling method for fast registers, processor and computing device
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a data handling method, processor, computing device for a fast register. The data handling method according to the present disclosure includes: reading cache data corresponding to a cache address of a cache controller; combining the read cache data according to a storage rule of thread data in a fast register, so that the combined data comprises data blocks of M threads in N threads of a processor, wherein M and N are integers larger than 1, and M is not larger than N; and carrying the combined data to the fast register, so that the data to be sent to the fast register can be combined, the combined data comprises data blocks in a plurality of threads of the processor, and then carrying the combined data to the fast register, thereby reducing the occupation of an access interface of the fast register and improving the processing efficiency of the processor.

title_en: Ore potential drawing method based on self-integrated graph convolution neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a mineral potential drawing method based on a self-integrated graph convolution neural network, which relates to the field of mineral resource prediction and potential evaluation, and comprises the following steps: analyzing geological background and deposit ore forming rules of a research area, and determining ore control elements and ore finding indexes; adopting data mining and feature extraction technology to quantitatively characterize the mine formation information, and constructing a quantitative and structured mine control element data set and a topological relation data set; introducing a disturbance strategy in the topological relation dataset, and enhancing the robustness and generalization capability of a self-integrated graph convolutional neural network (SEGCN) model; building a training model according to a loss function of the SEGCN model, and checking and evaluating the performance of the model; and calculating ore deposit ore forming probability by using the optimized training model, and drawing an ore forming potential prediction graph. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the invention can obtain a steady mineral product prediction result by utilizing SEGCN model advantages and can provide reliable decision service for decision makers.

title_en: Physical unclonable function circuit and chip
abstract_en: The application provides a physical unclonable function circuit and a chip, which are realized based on a cross switch array and a bidirectional analog switch, wherein the physical unclonable function circuit comprises: coding module, crossbar array and two-way analog switch, wherein: the coding module is used for generating a switch activating signal and an array input signal according to the accessed exciting signal; the cross switch array is connected with the coding module, and a plurality of wires of the cross switch array are respectively provided with a bidirectional analog switch, and the bidirectional analog switch is used for determining wires serving as input ends or output ends from the plurality of wires according to switch activation signals; and the crossbar array is used for generating array output signals with arbitrary lengths based on the array input signals so as to obtain response signals output by the physical unclonable function circuit. The method can solve the technical problems that response signals generated by a physical unclonable function circuit in the prior art are easy to crack and have high cost.

title_en: Method and system for collecting big data information of computer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of information collection, in particular to a method and a system for collecting big data information of a computer, which are used for solving the problems that in the existing big data information collection mode, new data cannot be obtained in real time, and old data can be outdated due to frequent information updating on the Internet, so that the data collection cannot be normally carried out due to the fact that the requirements of users on real-time information are not met.

title_en: Method for analyzing and preventing risk state of new energy power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for analyzing and preventing a risk state of a new energy power grid, which comprises the following steps that S1, operation data of the new energy power grid are obtained by utilizing a cloud edge cooperative system, and the operation state of an analyzer is analyzed; s2, analyzing a risk state according to the power grid operation data and making a solution to prevent the risk state of the new energy power grid. The blockchain technology is added between the edge end and the cloud end, so that a new storage space is provided for the data to relieve the pressure of the cloud end for storing the data; on the other hand, the edge computing end has the chain entering authentication before entering the blockchain for storing the data, so that the security of the data can be ensured. The operation state of the power grid can be obtained according to the power grid data acquired by the cloud edge cooperative framework, a power generation probability model is built by utilizing the acquired data, potential problems of the power grid are estimated according to the operation state of the new energy power grid, risk planning is made, the operation state of the power grid is protected in an omnibearing manner, and the safety and stability of the operation of the power grid are improved.

title_en: Animation object display method, electronic device, storage medium and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vehicle interaction, and discloses an animation object display method, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a vehicle, wherein the animation object display method comprises the following steps: acquiring a moving main body of a front road section of the vehicle and a moving attribute of the moving main body in real time, wherein the moving attribute at least comprises an actual position, an actual speed and a moving direction of the moving main body; creating an animation object based on the motion body for display on a display device, a side end of the display device being a movement start point of the animation object; judging the state of the animation object based on the motion attribute and the position of the animation object on the display device; in response to the animated object being in a lag state, the animated object chases the moving body. The animation object display method can prevent the animation object from suddenly appearing on the display device, and has better display effect.

title_en: Fault checking method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a fault detection method, a fault detection device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: version information of an operating system is obtained, and environment deployment data of an application program is stored in the operating system; determining a command type corresponding to the version information, and determining a fault investigation result of the environment deployment data according to a detection command corresponding to the command type; and generating the fault information of the environment deployment based on the fault checking result. By adopting the method, the failure omission rate of environmental deployment can be reduced, so that the safety performance of the whole operating system is improved.

title_en: Multi-parameter synergistic intelligent pre-warning method for deformation neural network of super high-rise building
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent pre-warning method for a deformation neural network of a multi-parameter synergistic super high-rise building, and belongs to the field of deformation monitoring of super high-rise buildings; the multi-parameter collaborative intelligent deformation monitoring and early warning method is provided, and the multi-parameter collaborative intelligent deformation monitoring and early warning method utilizes the coupling relation between the parameters such as vision, acceleration, displacement, wind load and the like to accurately analyze the deformation of the super high-rise building in a multi-layer analysis and multi-view manner, combines the advantages of high stability and high fault tolerance of the Elman neural network, realizes the accurate prediction of the fine deformation of the super high-rise building, and improves the reliability of the deformation monitoring and early warning of the super high-rise building.

title_en: Automatic building construction scheme generation method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of natural language processing, and particularly discloses an automatic generation method and an automatic generation system for a building construction scheme based on artificial intelligence. Therefore, the design efficiency of the building construction scheme can be improved, the scientificity and the practicability of the construction scheme are improved, and the development of the building construction industry towards the intelligent and efficient direction is promoted.

title_en: Riving knife cleaning and detecting method
abstract_en: The invention provides a riving knife cleaning and detecting method, which comprises the following steps: s1, placing a chopper to be cleaned in a sodium hydroxide solution, and decomposing aluminum scraps on the chopper in an ultrasonic vibration mode; s2, cleaning the riving knife to be cleaned after the step S1 by using deionized water; s3, purging the washed riving knife to be washed by clean air; s4, detecting whether the dried riving knife to be cleaned can be used continuously. The invention has the beneficial effects that: through the cleaning of the riving knife to be cleaned, the impurity residue is prevented, and the cleaning air is used for sweeping the cleaned riving knife to be cleaned, so that the dust attachment is prevented.

title_en: Data processing method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a data processing method, a device and equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first feature vector corresponding to historical service data; performing risk detection processing on the first feature vector through a first module of the service processing model, determining a predicted risk type corresponding to the historical service data, and determining a first sub-loss value based on the predicted risk type and the target risk type; based on a preset segmentation dimension, carrying out characterization segmentation mapping processing on the first feature vector to obtain a second feature vector; constructing a positive sample pair and a negative sample pair based on the second feature vector and a target risk type corresponding to the historical service data, and determining a second sub-loss value based on a second module of the service processing model and the positive sample pair and the negative sample pair; and determining whether the service processing model is converged based on the first sub-loss value and the second sub-loss value until the service processing model is converged, and obtaining the trained service processing model.

title_en: YOLOv 5-based signal lamp target detection system
abstract_en: The application provides a signal lamp target detection system based on YOLOv, which comprises: the detection module is used for preprocessing the image; the extraction module is connected with the detection module and is used for extracting characteristic information of different scales from the image preprocessed by the detection module; the analysis module is used for effectively fusing semantic information and position information of the feature images with different depths, downsampling the features and increasing the size of the received field; the output module is used for respectively generating three scale feature vectors, and then screening the target frame through a non-maximum value straight-through method, so that the accuracy of network identification is improved; according to the application, the CA structure is embedded into YOLOv main network after being light-weighted and improved, the capturing capacity of the long-distance dependency relationship of the main network is improved, the correlation between the spatial direction and the position of the image is further excavated, and the characteristic extraction capacity of the network is enhanced.

title_en: Household transformer identification method and system for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides a household transformer identification method and a household transformer identification system for a power distribution network, comprising the steps of obtaining user power consumption data, and extracting data content which accords with a preset standard in the user power consumption data to obtain current moment data and voltage moment data; wherein the user electricity data at least comprises current data and voltage data; combining the current time data and the voltage time data according to a preset incidence matrix format, and carrying out normalization processing to obtain a corresponding current-voltage incidence matrix; taking each column of data of the current-voltage correlation matrix as one sample, and forming a corresponding similarity matrix by all samples; and clustering samples based on the similarity matrix, and outputting a clustering result as a final recognition result. The invention makes up for the technical blank that users can not accurately realize topology identification for lack of enough electricity data; the recognition accuracy is high, the speed is high, and the installation, operation and maintenance investment cost of the transparent sensing equipment of the distribution network is greatly reduced.

title_en: Rapid detection method and system for direct current characteristics of lightning arrester
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid detection method and a rapid detection system for direct current characteristics of a lightning arrester, wherein the rapid detection method comprises the following steps: detecting direct current characteristics of a target lightning arrester, and analyzing reference voltage to obtain reference voltage information; detecting leakage current of the target lightning arrester according to the reference voltage information, and formulating a test control strategy; setting a self-checking flow, performing an automatic direct current test on a target lightning arrester to obtain reference voltage and leakage current, and performing performance state evaluation to obtain performance state evaluation information; judging whether performance degradation occurs to the target lightning arrester according to the performance state evaluation information, and predicting the health condition of the target lightning arrester to obtain health condition prediction information; and acquiring severe weather information, analyzing whether the target lightning arrester can bear the current severe weather, and performing maintenance early warning. The efficiency and the comprehensiveness of direct current characteristic detection are improved, the real-time state of the target lightning arrester is detected, maintenance early warning is carried out, and the probability of safety accidents under severe weather is reduced.

title_en: Printing control method, device and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of computers, in particular to a printing control method, a device and a system, wherein the method can accurately calculate the ink-jet interval time of each color nozzle when ink is jetted to an ink-jet point on a first cross section of a variable cross section cylinder, so that the ink jetted by each color nozzle falls on the ink-jet point when ink is jetted to each ink-jet point of the cross section; furthermore, when the inkjet device is adjusted to jet ink to the inkjet points of other cross sections based on the inkjet interval time corresponding to the cross section, the inkjet interval time is adjusted according to the diameter change of the cross section, and then the inkjet is performed; in the application, accurate ink jet of ink jet points on other cross sections can be realized, and the ink jet points of all color jet openings can be fallen when each ink jet point on the surface of the cylinder is used for ink jet, so that the integral good printing effect of the cylinder with the variable cross section is ensured.

title_en: Trailer segmentation method based on laser radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vehicle detection, and discloses a trailer segmentation method based on a laser radar, which comprises the following steps of: scanning a trailer by using a laser radar to obtain an original point cloud set P, and step 2: dividing the point cloud set P into m areas according to the X-axis direction, counting the number of the point clouds in each divided area, forming a set C, and calculating to obtain an upper edge point set H, wherein the length of each divided area in the X-coordinate direction is d; step 3: smoothing the upper edge point set H to obtain a set G; step 4: calculating to obtain a minimum value point M (x  min ,y min ) in the set G; step 5: calculating to obtain a lower mutation point D (x  D ,y D ) and an upper mutation point U (x  U ,y U ) of the trailer; step 6: calculating to obtain a trailer initial point S (x  S ,y S ); step 7: calculating to obtain a final trailer point cloud set R; the invention effectively overcomes the limitation of the traditional method on the trailer model by means of the non-parametric curve fitting technology, realizes the universal segmentation of various types of trailers, enhances the robustness of the algorithm to abnormal conditions and noise, and ensures the steady application in real complex scenes.

title_en: Intelligent recruitment process optimization and talent mining method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent recruitment process optimization and talent mining method, which comprises the following steps: generating a data set according to the collected human resource data, and further carrying out data preprocessing on the data set; training the data set continuously by adopting a deep learning method to obtain a corrected interview analysis model, deploying the interview analysis model, and further continuously collecting real-time recruitment interview data; inputting real-time recruitment interview data into an interview analysis model to generate interview analysis results; classifying emotions of job seekers according to the interview analysis result, giving matched emotion scores, and further generating recruitment assessment information according to the emotion scores and interview evaluation indexes. The intelligent recruitment process optimization and talent mining method provided by the invention can objectively give out interview evaluation of job seekers and optimize talent mining processes.

title_en: AGV forklift control method based on 3D point cloud data
abstract_en: The application provides an AGV forklift control method based on 3D point cloud data, and relates to the technical field of robot control. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a camera image obtained by shooting the surrounding environment of the forklift; preprocessing the camera image to obtain a preprocessing result of the camera image; constructing a corresponding dense map according to the preprocessing result; acquiring a depth image obtained by photographing an obstacle; converting image data in the depth image into laser radar data; generating a path plan based on the specified path end point and according to the dense map and the laser radar data. Therefore, the problem that the suspended obstacle cannot be detected in place in the obstacle avoidance mode of the traditional AGV forklift can be solved.

title_en: Method for preventing fluorescence quenching and keeping image brightness consistent and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for preventing fluorescence quenching and keeping consistent image brightness and application thereof, wherein firstly, only effective fluorescence information is reserved by calculating and eliminating background pixels of a color fluorescence image. And then judging whether the image is quenched or not according to the brightness difference, and enhancing the quenched image by adopting preset weights. And then, adjusting the weight by using a closed loop feedback mechanism to achieve the consistency with the brightness of the target image. Further, the image is divided into a plurality of small blocks to be independently subjected to brightness correction, so that brightness balance of each small block is ensured. And splicing the corrected small blocks back into the whole image according to the original position to finish the local brightness adjustment. Finally, the high-quality fluorescent image with consistent brightness and improved quenching phenomenon after treatment is stored.

title_en: Organic molecule virtual screening library construction method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for constructing an organic molecule virtual screening library, relates to the technical field of virtual database construction, and solves the technical problem that the existing virtual screening library has lower discovery efficiency on new molecules. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring and marking active sites in molecular fragments by using R placeholders based on a SMILES known molecular fragment set to generate a plurality of molecular fragment mol files with R marks; regenerating SMILES character strings of a plurality of groups and a plurality of skeletons to be assembled; inputting the SMILES character strings of all groups, all skeletons to be assembled and the number of preset access points into a concurrent executor for assembly traversal cycle to obtain a first combination subset; and screening to obtain a second combined molecule based on InChI identifiers and chemical similarity indexes of the first combined molecule, and constructing to obtain a virtual screening library of the organic molecules.

title_en: Method, device and storage medium for determining safety monitoring boundary of vehicle power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for determining a safety monitoring boundary of a vehicle power system and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of vehicles. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining target test data in a target test scene, wherein the target test scene is used for performing controllability test on a vehicle power system, and the target test data comprises: subjective evaluation data of a driver and objective posture data of a vehicle; analyzing the importance degree of the objective attitude data of the vehicle based on subjective evaluation data of a driver to obtain an analysis result, wherein the analysis result is used for reflecting the controllability grade score of a vehicle power system; and determining a safety monitoring boundary of the vehicle power system based on the subjective evaluation data of the driver and the analysis result, wherein the safety monitoring boundary is used for providing safety prevention and control for an electric control component responsible for driving the vehicle power system. The invention solves the technical problems of low safety and reliability of the actuating force system caused by the fact that the safety monitoring boundary cannot be accurately determined in the related art.

title_en: Down jacket simulation method, electronic device, storage medium and computer program product
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a down jacket simulation method, an electronic device, a storage medium, and a computer program product, including: for each down filling cavity of a down jacket model, responding to a slab editing instruction of the down filling cavity, generating a first slab and a second slab, and associating edge vertexes of the first slab and the second slab to obtain an inner container of the down filling cavity; responding to a supporting configuration instruction aiming at each inner container, and configuring each inner container so that each inner container provides supporting force for a down filling cavity where the inner container is positioned; and simulating the down jacket model with the liner arranged in the down filling cavity. According to the scheme, a more real down jacket simulation effect is achieved.

title_en: Operation input device and method for operating operation input device
abstract_en: The invention relates to an operation input device (10) having an operation surface (11), touch sensor means (20), force sensor means (30) and evaluation means (40), and a method for operating such an operation input device (10), the evaluation means (40) being arranged to determine an actuation state of the operation input device (10) and to generate and output an operation signal (BDS) characterizing the actuation state of the operation input device (10), wherein the operation input device (10) is capable of assuming an unactuated output state (Z0) and at least one actuation desired state (Z1, Z2), wherein in the unactuated initial state (Z0) a current basic force value (BKW) corresponds to a value of a currently detected actual force signal (IKS), and in the actuation desired state (Z1, Z2) the current basic force value (BKW) is a defined force value, respectively, and wherein the operator input device (10) is arranged to change from the unactuated initial state (Z0) to the first actuation desired state (Z1) upon detection of a touch of the operator interface (11) and/or to a pre-defined gradient of an applied force (F) and/or a gradient of the applied force (F) is compared with a pre-defined gradient of the determined gradient of the force and the force (F) is compared with the determined gradient of the force, then the unactuated initial state (Z0) is changed to the second actuated desired state (Z2).

title_en: Atmospheric polarization navigation method under interference environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an atmospheric polarization navigation method in an interference environment, which comprises the following steps: acquiring an atmospheric polarized light intensity image at the current moment, and acquiring a polarized angle image and a polarized degree image according to the atmospheric polarized light intensity image; the interference-free polarization angle image with the integrated polarization degree is obtained by carrying out interference-free processing on the polarization angle image and the polarization degree image; acquiring azimuth angles of solar meridians under a carrier coordinate system based on the interference-free polarization angle image of the fusion polarization degree; and according to the azimuth angle of the solar meridian under the carrier coordinate system, combining the azimuth angle of the solar meridian under the geographic coordinate system, obtaining a course angle, and realizing navigation. The method is to fuse the region with the interference removed by the polarization angle with the region with the interference removed by the polarization degree; the method not only can directly remove the interference of the image through the polarization information, but also can avoid the defect that the polarization angle information on the solar meridian area is easy to be used as the interference to remove, thereby effectively improving the navigation orientation precision.

title_en: Scheme for inserting data entries in sparsely populated data structures
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a scheme for inserting data entries in a sparsely populated data structure. The plurality of data entries are written into a first memory bank that includes a portion of a data structure stored across the plurality of memory banks. For a subsequent data entry, determining that the subsequent data entry has a value that is greater than a first data entry of the plurality of data entries in the first bank and less than a second data entry of the plurality of data entries in the first bank. The subsequent data entry is written to an address location in a second bank of the plurality of banks, the address location being located between a lowest address location and a highest address location of the second bank, and a first bit corresponding to the address location in the second bank to which the subsequent data entry is written is stored in the data structure.

title_en: Memory data management method and device, readable storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a memory data management method, a device, a readable storage medium and an electronic device, comprising: receiving a data writing request and acquiring writing data; acquiring the data type of the written data, and determining a target cache space according to the data type; caching the write-in data in the target cache space to obtain cache data, and counting the data quantity of the cache data; judging whether the data volume of the cache data reaches a preset unit storage volume, if so, writing the cache data reaching the unit storage volume into a storage unit; the unit storage amount is the same as the maximum data storage amount of the storage unit. The problem of reduced reading performance of the storage unit caused by the fact that different types of writing data are stored in the storage unit due to the fact that the different types of writing data are mixed and written into the storage unit is avoided.

title_en: Method and system for detecting heat treatment deformation of machined part
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting heat treatment deformation of a workpiece, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a workpiece original image and a workpiece heat treatment image, and preprocessing the workpiece original image and the workpiece heat treatment image to obtain an original gray level image and a heat treatment gray level image; acquiring first gray values of all first pixel points of an original gray image and second gray values of all second pixel points of a heat-treated gray image; detecting contour points of an original gray image through a clustering algorithm based on a first gray value of a first pixel point to obtain an original region contour of a workpiece; performing heat treatment gray level image contour point detection on the heat treatment gray level image through a clustering algorithm based on a second gray level value of a second pixel point to obtain a workpiece heat treatment region contour; calculating according to a first gray value of the contour of the original area of the workpiece and a second gray value of the contour of the heat treatment area of the workpiece to obtain a difference value of the gray values; and judging whether the heat treatment image of the workpiece is deformed or not through the difference value of the gray values.

title_en: Cross-domain small sample crowd counting method based on meta-learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a cross-domain small sample crowd counting method based on meta-learning, which comprises the following steps of S1, S2, constructing a scene self-adaption module for dynamically adjusting a network according to scene context information, S3, constructing a crowd counting model, S4, designing a training strategy based on meta-learning, S5, testing on the meta-test set by utilizing the model obtained in S4 through a regularization fine tuning method based on knowledge distillation, and the method provided by the invention remarkably reduces the cost of data collection and labeling, solves the problem of overfitting by using a regularization fine tuning method based on knowledge distillation, and also introduces the scene self-adaption module for adjusting the network according to the scene context information into the model for improving the generalization capability of the model under the cross-domain condition.

title_en: Parameter registration error identification method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for identifying parameter registration errors, relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and can be used in the financial field or other technical fields. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a parameter set to be identified; comparing the parameter values between every two parameters to be identified to obtain target parameters to be identified, and calculating the parameter name similarity distance and the parameter description similarity distance between every two target parameters to be identified; clustering each target parameter to be identified according to the parameter name similarity distance and the parameter description similarity distance to obtain clustering groups, respectively carrying out similar parameter consistency comparison in the clustering groups according to the parameter types and the parameter levels, and determining whether the parameter has a recognition result of registration errors according to a comparison result. The apparatus performs the above method. The method and the device provided by the embodiment of the invention can improve the parameter registration error identification efficiency.

title_en: Intelligent forestry management method and system based on forest stereoscopic perception
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent forestry management method and system based on forest stereoscopic perception, and relates to the technical field of intelligent forestry management. Comprising the following steps: acquiring detailed information of forest resources in a forest area in an acquisition mode to obtain a vegetation information set; building a damage model, and obtaining vegetation states corresponding to different vegetation information in the vegetation information set based on the input vegetation information set to obtain a vegetation state set; dividing the vegetation state into a plurality of grades, judging which grade the current state of the vegetation is in based on the vegetation state set by a judging method to obtain a state dividing set, and obtaining a vegetation damage result based on the state dividing set. According to the method, the different damage states of the vegetation under different damage conditions are obtained based on the big data, the damage states of the vegetation are judged on the basis of abnormal vegetation growth conditions, and the damage states of the vegetation can be judged more accurately.

title_en: Sensitive amplifier control method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a sense amplifier control method and an electronic device applying the same, wherein the sense amplifier control method comprises an idle phase, an offset elimination phase, a charge sharing phase and a sense amplification phase which sequentially occur in time sequence, wherein: in the offset elimination stage, the first node is controlled to be connected with the bit line, the second node is controlled to be connected with the complementary bit line, and the first switch and the second switch are in a conducting state; and in the charge sharing stage, after the first node is controlled to be disconnected with the bit line and the second node is controlled to be disconnected with the complementary bit line, the first switch and the second switch are controlled to be turned off, and the first switch and the second switch are not turned off at the same time. The embodiment of the disclosure can reduce the noise of the sense amplifier.

title_en: Non-small cell lung cancer immune combined chemotherapy progression-free survival prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-small cell lung cancer immune combined chemotherapy progression-free survival prediction method and a system. Extracting image features from CT images of non-small cell lung cancer patients by adopting a color moment and gray scale co-occurrence matrix method, collecting a non-progress lifetime data set of the non-small cell lung cancer patients after immune combined chemotherapy, dividing the non-progress lifetime data set into a training set and a test set, and initializing a population; binary coding is carried out on each individual in the current population, and the characteristics are coded by using a conversion function; calculating the fitness value of the current population; updating the individual positions of the population by adopting a rime algorithm updating formula; updating the relevant parameters of the Gaussian kernel probability strategy, and further updating the population by utilizing the Gaussian kernel probability strategy; and selecting the next generation population through greedy selection and performing population updating operation until the iterative computation is finished. The invention can improve the prediction performance of the non-small cell lung cancer patient immune combined chemotherapy in a non-progressive lifetime of more than 12 months.

title_en: Cell penetration speed planning method based on stress failure model
abstract_en: The invention provides a cell penetration speed planning method based on a stress failure model, which belongs to the technical field of cell-level micromanipulation and comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing a cell penetration simulation environment; step 2, establishing a stress failure model of mechanical damage of cells in the penetrating process; step 3, detecting stress failure proportion in the cell penetration process; and 4, evaluating cell penetration processes at different speeds based on the stress failure model, and planning penetration speeds. Compared with the traditional method, the cell penetration speed planning method based on the stress failure model can evaluate the mechanical damage result of cells at a large range of dynamic penetration speed, so that the optimal penetration speed is planned, the subsequent development rate of the cells is improved, and the effectiveness of the cell penetration speed planning method is proved by comparing and verifying the result in a practical experiment.

title_en: Pre-training large model-based weak surveillance video abnormal behavior space-time detection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a weak supervision video abnormal behavior space-time detection method based on a pre-training large model, and belongs to the field of image detection. The method comprises the steps of constructing an ST-VadCLIP model, inputting training videos into the ST-VadCLIP model for training, respectively extracting global image features and spatial local image features by utilizing a frozen CLIP image encoder, extracting global text labels and label features of the local text labels by utilizing the frozen CLIP text encoder, performing attention aggregation on the local image features, fusing the local image features with the global image features to obtain video frame level features, sending the video frame level features into a classification auxiliary detection head for coarse classification, then calculating cosine similarity with the global text label features to obtain frame level time sequence abnormal confidence, selecting frames with abnormal occurrence according to the frame level time sequence abnormal confidence, calculating the spatial local image features of the frames and the cosine similarity of the local text label features, and combining abnormal activity motion measurement priori rules to obtain an abnormal event space positioning result.

title_en: Multi-agent driving behavior modeling method based on generation of countermeasure imitation learning
