abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent driving, and discloses a multi-agent driving behavior modeling method based on generation of countermeasures and imitation learning, which comprises the following steps: step 1, constructing an expert data set for representing the behavior of a driver; step 2, constructing a lower-layer vehicle dynamics model and a transverse-longitudinal controller based on the model in a double-layer driver model; step 3, constructing an upper driver characteristic data generator model in the double-level driver model, wherein the Markov decision process needs to be improved and the countermeasure imitation learning needs to be improved; and 4, sharing the policy parameters learned by a single agent to a plurality of agents, and accelerating convergence by setting course learning and rewarding enhancement modes. The invention simulates the traffic flow environment of a plurality of vehicles by using the method for generating the countermeasure imitation learning, and learns the driving behavior from the driving history demonstration data in the real world, thereby improving the traffic safety and the traffic efficiency.

title_en: Aortic dissection patient complication risk prediction model based on tissue boundary influence
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of image segmentation and discloses an aortic dissection patient complication risk prediction model based on tissue boundary influence, which comprises an initial prediction image acquisition module, a deep learning model, a priori knowledge acquisition module, a loss function definition and loss item setting module, a judging module, an auxiliary weight giving module, a target focus area image output module, a key feature information selection module and a risk prediction result output module; the priori knowledge at least comprises an aortic aneurysm image, tracheal shape information, aortic aneurysm shape information and positional change information of a trachea and an aortic aneurysm which are marked manually; according to the method, a shape loss term and a position loss term are introduced into a loss function, different auxiliary weights are given to the shape loss term according to the overlapping size of the trachea and the aortic aneurysm, the shape of the trachea area is weakened by the shape of the salient focus area in the model optimization process, and the target focus area is more accurately segmented.

title_en: Large-scale text increment fuzzy de-duplication method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a large-scale text increment fuzzy de-duplication method, a device, equipment and a medium. Based on the global dictionary and a preset hash function, document signatures are generated for the documents in different document sets, so that identical contents in the different document sets are ensured to be consistent on the document signatures, and repeated content detection across the document sets is facilitated. Because the document signature is calculated only for the first document without recalculating the archive document signature of the existing second document, the order of magnitude of the feature calculation is greatly reduced, and the deduplication processing efficiency of the incremental document is further improved. Because the document signature is adopted as the characteristic for measuring the similarity of the document, namely, by comparing the incremental document signature with the archive document signature, various forms of the repeated document can be more comprehensively captured in principle compared with simple keyword matching, the duplicate removal coverage is higher, and the accurate duplicate removal of the incremental document is realized.

title_en: OPGW (optical fiber composite overhead ground wire) tower quick and accurate positioning method based on multidimensional parameter fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional parameter fusion-based OPGW shaft tower rapid and accurate positioning method which comprises the steps of obtaining a strain tower preliminary positioning value taking an amplitude parameter as a carrier, a splicing tower preliminary positioning value taking a frequency shift parameter as a carrier, a strain tower preliminary positioning value taking a strain parameter as a carrier and a tangent tower preliminary positioning value taking a temperature parameter as a carrier based on an acquired backward Rayleigh scattering signal and a Brillouin scattering signal, comparing the four parameters with a shaft tower geographic distance graph to complement shaft tower positioning information, constructing a mapping relation between a full-line optical fiber skin length and line geographic information according to the shaft tower point positioning information and the actual geographic distance, and calculating the geographic position of an abnormal event by adopting the mapping relation between the full-line optical fiber skin length and the line geographic information. The invention overcomes the limitation of positioning single physical parameter and realizes the quick and accurate positioning of the OPGW line tower.

title_en: Wheat new visual angle synthesis method based on improved nerve radiation field group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new view angle synthesis method of wheat based on an improved nerve radiation field group, which relates to the technical field of computer vision, and comprises the following steps of shooting images of wheat based on groups and constructing a wheat data set based on groups; constructing a nerve radiation field of a group wheat scene, producing rays in the nerve radiation field, acquiring sampling points according to a nerve radiation field sampling strategy, obtaining the 3D positions and directions of the sampling points, inputting the 3D positions x of the sampling points into a multi-plane hash encoder, inputting the encoded data into a nerve radiation field network, performing rendering loss training, predicting the sampled color and density, and obtaining a new image of a new visual angle after training is completed. The invention has the beneficial effects that the invention adopts the strategy of reference image guidance, improves the multi-plane hash coding on NeRF networks, and can fit complex and dense scene reconstruction with high efficiency and high quality.

title_en: Personnel intrusion detection method, system, terminal and storage medium for custom area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pedestrian detection, and discloses a method, a system, a terminal and a storage medium for detecting personnel intrusion in a custom area. According to the method, the dangerous area is defined in the image acquisition view angle, when the human body frame is identified and the distance between the human body frame and the dangerous area is within a certain range, the invasion direction of the personnel is judged, a plurality of key points are deployed on the human body frame, the key points are selected as judgment bases according to the invasion direction, the relative spatial position relation between the personnel and the dangerous area is judged, and whether the personnel invade the dangerous area or not is detected, so that detection omission caused by the image view angle is avoided. The invention realizes intelligent intrusion detection of the static dangerous area and has higher detection precision and real-time detection capability.

title_en: Apparatus and method for generating circuit clock signal
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide apparatus and methods for generating a circuit clock signal. The apparatus includes a clock buffer configured to buffer an original clock signal to obtain a buffered clock signal, a clock delay unit configured to delay the original clock signal to obtain a plurality of delayed clock signals, the plurality of delayed clock signals being respectively delayed by different amounts of time relative to the original clock signal, a stretched clock generator configured to generate a stretched clock signal based on the original clock signal and the plurality of delayed clock signals, the stretched clock signal having a frequency lower than a frequency of the original clock signal, and a clock selector configured to select one of the buffered clock signal and the stretched clock signal as the circuit clock signal based on a selection signal.

title_en: Low-light diffraction element compensation method, system, optical device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of low-light diffraction, in particular to a low-light diffraction element compensation method, a system, an optical device and a storage medium. The compensation method comprises the following steps: acquiring real-time temperature distribution information of the micro-light diffraction element; preprocessing the temperature distribution information, eliminating noise and optimizing temperature data of the temperature distribution information; calculating the refractive index change of the low-light diffraction element based on the optimized temperature data; and converting the original phase compensation pattern into a format phase compensation pattern which can be identified by the spatial light modulator. The compensation method of the low-light diffraction element effectively solves the problem of unstable performance caused by the thermal effect of the low-light diffraction element in high-power laser application by acquiring temperature distribution information in real time, calculating refractive index change and local phase distortion and utilizing a spatial light modulator to apply dynamic compensation.

title_en: Heterogeneous network community discovery method integrating deep learning and social recommendation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heterogeneous network community discovery method integrating deep learning and social recommendation, which comprises the following steps: arranging the heterogeneous data into a heterogeneous information network through a network mode, selecting an effective element path, and constructing a user-user social network and a user-community binary network; training and optimizing a user-user social network and a user-community binary network through a graph neural network and a marking mechanism, and fusing to construct a user-community expansion graph; selecting a meta path based on the user-community expansion graph, measuring similarity between a target user and a target community based on the meta path, and acquiring a target user-target community node pair; training the target user-target community node pair in the input graph neural network, outputting the probability of the target user joining the target community, and applying the probability to heterogeneous network community discovery. The method and the system can conduct community recommendation on a large-scale social network, and improve accuracy of community recommendation.

title_en: Node scaling method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a node scaling method, a node scaling device, node scaling equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of determining a target node in a canvas, acquiring node information based on the target node and canvas information, determining a width scaling and a height scaling according to the node information and the canvas information, determining a target scaling according to the width scaling and the height scaling, and scaling the target node according to the target scaling. The width scaling proportion and the height scaling proportion are determined by combining node information and canvas information, the width scaling proportion and the height scaling proportion are comprehensively considered to determine the target scaling proportion, scaling operation is automatically carried out on the target node, the node can still keep the original shape scaling after scaling, distortion deformation can not occur, the whole picture or layout is more coordinated and attractive, the requirements of users are better met, overflow of canvas after scaling of the node is avoided, and meanwhile rationality and logic of the whole layout are prevented from being damaged due to improper scaling in a single direction.

title_en: CFD-DEM-based two-phase flow numerical simulation method for jet mill
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CFD-DEM-based two-phase flow numerical simulation method for an air flow mill, which comprises the following steps: step 1, basic information of an air mill is obtained, and a geometric model of the air mill is established by modeling software based on the basic information of the air mill; then simplifying the simulation model into an air flow mill; step 2, establishing an air flow mill model in a CFD solver; step 3, establishing a particle model in a DEM solver; step 4, setting a CFD-DEM four-way coupling data transmission method, so that CFD and DEM solvers are bidirectionally coupled and mutually transmit data; and 5, synchronously performing numerical simulation calculation on the CFD solver and the DEM solver by adopting an implicit simulation method of a pressure-speed coupling algorithm to obtain output simulation result data. The invention quantitatively analyzes the sorting of the jet mill, can better control the particle size distribution of the product and improve the quality of the product.

title_en: Ship outer plate processing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship outer plate processing method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein model files of a plurality of outer plate parts are generated in an SPD system based on ship outer plate unfolding files and stored in a part library, the outer plate parts to be perforated meeting numerical control perforation conditions are screened out from the outer plate parts based on the ship outer plate unfolding files, perforation information of the outer plate parts to be perforated is acquired, the model files of the outer plate parts to be perforated are converted into CAD file formats for each outer plate part to be perforated and then are imported into CAD, perforation operation is conducted by importing the model files of the outer plate parts to be perforated into the CAD, perforation setting is completed, numerical control blanking can be conducted based on the model files, perforated outer plate parts are obtained, ship building cycle can be shortened for the outer plate parts, and arc light and dust injuries are reduced.

title_en: Automatic generation system for ultrasonic endoscope structured report
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical image processing, and discloses an automatic generation system of an ultrasonic endoscope structured report, which comprises the following components: the primary checking module is used for acquiring an endoscope image, obtaining a result of whether an abnormal area exists in the endoscope image, and reminding the ultrasonic endoscope checking to be carried out when the abnormal area exists; the image segmentation module is used for segmenting a plurality of digestive tract structures in the ultrasonic image; the text generation module is used for obtaining echo condition description and boundary condition description of each digestive tract structure through a text description model; the focus segmentation module is used for obtaining focus areas of each frame of ultrasonic image based on a plurality of frames of ultrasonic images, and judging whether the focus areas are overlapped with each digestive tract structure or not; and the report generation module is used for generating an ultrasonic endoscope report based on the echo condition description, the boundary condition description and the overlapping condition. Can improve the standardization of the ultrasonic endoscope report and the working efficiency of ultrasonic endoscope doctors.

title_en: Vehicle audio playing method and device, electronic equipment, vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a vehicle audio playing method, a device, electronic equipment, a vehicle and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of audio synthesis, wherein the method comprises the following steps: responding to an audio playing instruction carrying function triggering information, calling a preset callback function according to the function triggering information, and acquiring current driving data of the vehicle in a driving state according to the called preset callback function; determining vehicle operation parameters of the vehicle according to the current driving data; determining audio attribute information according to the vehicle operation parameters; generating a target digital audio fragment according to the audio attribute information; and controlling the vehicle to play the target digital audio clip when the vehicle is in the driving state. The application can realize that the speed of the automobile is matched with the audio frequency when the automobile is driven.

title_en: Protecting blockchain transactions based on uncertain data
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method for locking blockchain transactions based on uncertain data is described. The present invention is implemented using a blockchain network. The locking node may include a locking script for locking the digital asset in a blockchain transaction. The locking script includes instructions for determining a public key of the data source and causing a verification node executing the locking script to verify the data source provided in the unlocking script in the following manner: a) Generating a modified public key based on the public key for determining the data source and based on the data defined in the unlock script; b) The encrypted signature in the unlock script is evaluated based on the modified public key. Blockchain transactions including a locking script are sent by the locking node to the blockchain network. The lock may be removed using an encrypted signature generated from a private key modified based on the data.

title_en: Fan control system, method, computer program product, apparatus, and storage medium
abstract_en: The present application relates to a fan control system, a method, a computer program product, an apparatus and a storage medium, the system comprising: the device comprises a power supply, a voltage acquisition circuit, a discharge circuit, a fan controller and a baseboard management controller; the discharging circuit at least comprises a first resistor, a discharging switch and a second resistor, wherein the first end of the first resistor is connected with the output end of the power supply, the second end of the first resistor is connected with the drain electrode of the discharging switch, the source electrode of the discharging switch is grounded, the first end of the second resistor is connected with the grid electrode of the discharging switch, the second end of the second resistor is connected with the source electrode of the discharging switch, and the grid electrode of the discharging switch is connected with the fan controller; the substrate management controller is connected with the fan controller and generates a control instruction according to the target fan information acquired by the voltage acquisition circuit; the fan controller receives the control instruction, controls the on/off of the discharging circuit and controls the rotating speed of the fan. The system can improve the safety and reliability of the operation of the fan.

title_en: Distributed energy storage power station intelligent management method based on fuzzy control
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent management method of a distributed energy storage power station based on fuzzy control, which relates to the technical field of power station management and is used for collecting information of the distributed energy storage power station, wherein the information of the distributed energy storage power station comprises energy storage energy of the energy storage power station and positions of the energy storage power station, the energy storage power station is segmented to obtain energy storage units, identity information of the energy storage units is given, weather information in preset time is obtained, the electric energy information is converted to obtain electric energy information generated by continuous photovoltaic power generation based on Fourier transformation, a power generation segment of the units and the corresponding energy storage units are bound to be used as charging information based on fuzzy control, and the weather information in real time and preset time is collected. The invention ensures that the least storage battery is used as much as possible each time, thereby ensuring the reduction of the charging times and prolonging the service life of the storage battery.

title_en: Parametric design method for axisymmetric precooling type air inlet channel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a parameterized design method of an axisymmetric precooling type air inlet channel, which is based on the existing design of the air inlet channel according to experience, and can determine the inner profile of the air inlet channel through a series of control parameters. The method can quickly obtain the inner type surface of the corresponding precooling type air inlet channel under different control parameters, and is beneficial to quick design and performance evaluation of the axisymmetric air inlet channel.

title_en: Address translation method, address translation device, address translation apparatus, address translation program product, and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides an address conversion method, an address conversion device, a readable storage medium and a program product, and relates to the fields of system on chip and the like. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a plurality of consecutive read requests or a plurality of consecutive write requests, each of the plurality of consecutive read requests comprising a logical address of the first data, each of the plurality of consecutive write requests comprising a logical address of the second data; determining the physical address of each first data through address conversion processing based on the logical address of any one of the first data, or determining the physical address of each second data through address conversion processing based on the logical address of any one of the second data; and sending the physical address of each first data to the memory, reading each first data from the memory based on the physical address of each first data, or sending the physical address of each second data to the memory, and writing each second data into the memory based on the physical address of each second data.

title_en: Automatic matching method for space-to-ground remote sensing images
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic matching method of an air-ground remote sensing image, which comprises the following steps: s1, constructing an empty map pair data set; s2, extracting a deep feature expression diagram; s3, obtaining a structural feature attention map with weak boundary attributes; s4, carrying out overall and local context information enhancement; s5, training an image matching network; s6, outputting a matching result. The method can effectively extract the multi-scale information in the air image and generate the corresponding multi-scale deep feature description; meanwhile, the invention can induce consistent attention response from the same area of different space images, and provides effective prior for feature descriptor matching. The local context feature descriptor in the invention can obtain the context perception from big to global to small around the feature points, thereby effectively enhancing the robustness of the descriptor to the matching of the weak texture and the repeated texture region.

title_en: Photovoltaic real-time performance evaluation and early warning system and method based on multi-source information fusion
abstract_en: The photovoltaic real-time performance evaluation and early warning system and method based on multi-source information fusion are characterized in that a central control system is used for coordinating and managing photovoltaic output of each area, each area is provided with an independent monitoring center and a sensor network, key data of a photovoltaic panel and related equipment are collected in real time, a deep learning architecture is integrated with a convolutional neural network and a long-term and short-term memory network, a feature recognition system based on an attention mechanism is used for enhancing recognition and processing capacity of key features, and a fuzzy logic control module is used for automatically adjusting operation parameters of the photovoltaic equipment when the performance is detected to be lower than a preset threshold value. The invention improves the data integrity and the response speed of the system through multi-source information fusion, overcomes the problem of data fragmentation in the traditional monitoring system, can realize the functions of large-scale and distributed photovoltaic accurate prediction, real-time tracking after grid connection, dynamic consistency check, coordination control, state early warning and the like, and can effectively support the safe and efficient operation of a low-inertia multi-source new energy power grid.

title_en: Hearth temperature control method in urban solid waste incineration process
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for controlling the temperature of a hearth in the urban solid waste incineration process, which belongs to the field of urban solid waste incineration and comprises the following steps: collecting manipulated variable value data and hearth temperature data; inputting the manipulated variable value data and the hearth temperature data into a preset interval two-type model width prediction module to obtain a hearth temperature predicted value and a predicted error; and inputting the hearth temperature predicted value into a preset particle swarm rolling optimization module to obtain the control variable value. The invention improves the prediction precision, the optimization efficiency and the reliability of the system by utilizing the two-type model width prediction module and the particle swarm rolling optimization module.

title_en: Entity relation extraction method based on large model and dynamic prompt
abstract_en: The invention discloses a entity relation extraction method based on a large model and dynamic prompt, which comprises the following steps: defining a mode layer and an entity set of the domain knowledge graph; constructing an entity relation triplet example set by using the mode layer and the entity set; constructing an entity vector database DB; constructing a template set PR of the template; dividing a text to be processed into paragraphs, and extracting a keyword list of the paragraphs; constructing a paragraph-entity association list T for each paragraph by using the keyword list; and constructing a dynamic prompt by using the template set PR of the association list T, prompt and the entity relation triplet example set for each paragraph, sending the dynamic prompt into a large model to extract the entity relation, and checking the correctness of the result. The invention combines the advantages of knowledge graph, entity vector representation, dynamic prompt and large model, does not need to finely adjust the large model, realizes the automatic extraction of entity relationship, reduces the cost of entity relationship extraction, improves the efficiency and the accuracy, and has wide application and popularization values.

title_en: Psychological state assessment method based on feature extraction
abstract_en: The invention provides a psychological state assessment method based on feature extraction, and relates to the field of psychological health and deep learning. The method comprises the steps of comprehensively collecting physiological indexes, behavior data and language use characteristics of an individual, extracting main dynamic characteristics by using a principal component analysis method, and constructing a psychological state assessment model based on machine learning, wherein the model can receive the physiological indexes, the behavior data and the language use characteristics of a person to be assessed as input and output corresponding psychological states and confidence degrees thereof, and the model accuracy is ensured to continuously accord with the standard by periodically assessing the performance of the model and adjusting and optimizing the performance of the model. The invention can improve the real-time performance, accuracy and intelligent level of psychological state assessment, and provides a novel monitoring and early warning means for the field of psychological health.

title_en: Modeling and calibrating method and device for cooling system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a modeling and calibrating method and device for a cooling system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of simulation modeling, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a first model according to the geometric parameters of the thermal management integrated module, and constructing a second model according to the geometric parameters of the cooling system loop; the cooling system comprises a thermal management integrated module and a cooling system loop; calibrating a first resistance coefficient of the internal flow channel for the first model and calibrating a second resistance coefficient of the internal flow channel for the second model; acquiring a first flow error between a test flow result of the thermal management integrated module and a simulation flow result of the first model, and acquiring a second flow error between the test flow result of the cooling system loop and the simulation flow result of the second model; adjusting a first resistance coefficient of an internal flow channel of the first model according to the first flow error; adjusting a second resistance coefficient of an internal flow channel of the second model according to the second flow error; accurate modeling is realized, and accurate simulation analysis can be performed on the cooling system.

title_en: Maintenance scheme generating system, method and program product based on large language model
abstract_en: A maintenance scheme generating system, method and program product based on a large language model belong to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The system comprises a task distributor, a first comparator, a training device, a second comparator, a first time variance target value and a second time variance target value, wherein the task distributor is used for distributing maintenance problems to K second-level agents, the relevant calculator is used for calculating the relevance of a maintenance scheme searched by each second-level agent and the distributed maintenance problems, the first comparator is used for comparing the relevance with a threshold value, the maintenance modification scheme with the relevance exceeding the threshold value is provided for the training device, the training device utilizes a maintenance scheme set, a prediction search strategy set and a rewarding set with the relevance exceeding the threshold value to calculate the first time variance target value and broadcast the first time variance target value to the K second-level agents, and the search strategy network searches the generated maintenance scheme from a database according to the maintenance problems distributed by the task distributor and reports the search strategy and rewarding to the first-level agents. The invention can learn autonomously, adapt to new environment and new task, and can make corresponding adjustment according to the change and feedback of the search environment.

title_en: Three-dimensional scene model simplification method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of three-dimensional model simplification, and provides a three-dimensional scene model simplification method, a three-dimensional scene model simplification device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: determining an initial data set according to model data corresponding to an initial three-dimensional scene model, wherein the initial three-dimensional scene model comprises a plurality of three-dimensional monomers; determining geographic information corresponding to each of the plurality of three-dimensional monomers according to map vector coordinate data corresponding to the initial three-dimensional scene model; for each three-dimensional monomer, constructing an initial monomer model corresponding to the three-dimensional monomer according to geographic information and an initial data set corresponding to the three-dimensional monomer; performing point location simplification on the initial monomer model based on preset precision parameters to obtain a simplified monomer model; and determining a target three-dimensional scene model according to all the simplified monomer models. The whole simplifying process of the method does not need to be manually participated, the degree of automation is high, and the model simplifying efficiency is effectively improved.

title_en: Speaker log model training and speaker log processing method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a speaker log model training method, a speaker log processing device and equipment, comprising the following steps: acquiring target audio, and extracting audio features of the target audio through a speaker log model to be trained; carrying out audio estimation on the audio features through a speaker log model to be trained to obtain an audio estimation result of the target audio; determining an error estimation result of the target audio according to the audio characteristics and the audio estimation result; and training the speaker log model to be trained based on the error estimation result and the audio estimation result to obtain a trained speaker log model. Not only is the characteristic analysis of the audio and the classification of the speaker in the audio provided, but also the log model of the speaker to be trained is trained according to the error estimation result, so that the predicted result of the log model of the speaker after training can be more accurate.

title_en: Quality assessment method, device, equipment and storage medium for video call
abstract_en: The application discloses a quality evaluation method, device and equipment for video call and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of communication. The quality evaluation method of the video call comprises the following steps: acquiring video data in a video call, wherein the video data is associated with at least one of resolution and frame rate of the call video; evaluating and analyzing the video call based on the video data to obtain a video quality evaluation result of the video call; and fusing the video quality evaluation result with the experience perception evaluation result of the video call to obtain a video evaluation result corresponding to the video call, wherein the experience perception evaluation result is obtained by evaluating experience perception data in the video call, the experience perception data is associated with network index parameters, the network index parameters are parameters influencing the experience of a user for watching the video, and the video evaluation result is used for representing the video quality of the video call.

title_en: Part quality prediction and evaluation optimization method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a part quality prediction and evaluation optimization method and device, which relate to the technical field of intelligent part processing quality prediction, and the method comprises the steps of collecting part production data and part quality data in historical data, comprehensively analyzing the part quality data to generate part qualification indexes capable of evaluating the quality of parts, comparing the part qualification indexes of each part with a preset threshold value to judge the qualification condition of the parts, generating part quality prediction coefficients for the qualification conditions of the part qualification indexes of the parts, wherein the historical production data is a data set, and using the part quality prediction coefficients as labels, and the method comprises the steps of The regression method is used for constructing a part quality prediction model, training and optimizing the part quality prediction model by using a data set, inputting production data to be predicted into the optimized part quality prediction model to obtain a part quality prediction coefficient, and completing the evaluation and optimization of the part through the part quality prediction coefficient.

title_en: Facial action expression migration method and device for detail optimization compensation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a facial action expression migration method and device for detail optimization compensation. The invention uses the three-dimensional facial reconstruction model to carry out modeling coding on facial action expression, realizes the collection and compression of facial information, and ensures the consistency of the generated video characters by utilizing the sliding window; the face pixel flow field is obtained by using a multiple deep information fusion technology, primary distortion is carried out on an original image, and the problem that the facial generalization capability of a facial expression migration model based on key points is poor and the action expression is missing for people with large differences is solved; and (3) utilizing a multi-level face detail coding and optimizing compensation model to carry out targeted repair on the missing part of the image, so as to solve the problems of detail missing, edge distortion and the like caused by information missing.

title_en: Efficient mussel yield increasing method based on artificial upflow system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency mussel yield increasing method based on an artificial upflow system, which comprises the following steps: according to the suspension height, the sea water density profile, the sea water chlorophyll concentration profile, the average depth of the culture area, the tidal current incoming flow direction and the flow velocity of the culture area of the mussel fries in the culture area, the implementation engineering parameters (including the gas injection amount, the gas injection depth, the diameter of a gas injection nozzle, the injected gas density and the bubble sliding speed) of the artificial upflow system are regulated, the transport track (including the height of the plume, the half width of the plume reaching the maximum height and the horizontal displacement when reaching the maximum height) of the artificial upflow plume is calculated, so that the distribution position and the engineering parameters of the artificial upflow in the mussel culture area are optimized, the culture mode of efficiently supplementing mussel baits by combining the artificial upflow under the tidal current pushing action is formed, and the efficient mussel yield increase is realized.

title_en: Intelligent industrial chain management method and system based on data map
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing of data patterns, in particular to an intelligent industrial chain management method and system based on data patterns, wherein the method analyzes network environment data to which industrial chain data update belongs, evaluates network reliability factors prepared by industrial chain data update, so as to select an optimal network environment to update industrial chain data, simultaneously analyzes industrial chain data update process parameters to obtain monitoring abnormality indexes of the industrial chain data update process, if the abnormality degree of the data updating process is higher, the updating deviation index of the associated chart to which the industrial chain data belongs is judged, and intelligent updating management of the industrial chain data of the data map is fed back according to the updating deviation grade, so that the accuracy of the industrial chain data updating in the data map is ensured, meanwhile, the industrial chain data updating process can be automatically optimized, the manual intervention is reduced, and the management efficiency of the industrial chain data in the data map is improved.

title_en: Open set scene-oriented noise bias mark learning model and image processing device
abstract_en: The invention provides an open set scene-oriented noise bias mark learning model and an image processing device, comprising a picture encoder, a classifier, a bias mark classification loss module, a noise bias mark sample identification module and a sample reconstruction module, wherein: the picture encoder obtains hidden space representation according to the input image sample; the classifier outputs the classification probability of the sample to each category; the partial mark classification loss module inputs the prior distribution of the sample classification probability and the candidate labels, and outputs a loss value; the noise bias mark sample recognition module divides the training sample into three types of normal sample, closed set noise and open set noise according to the sample classification probability and the candidate tag set, and updates the candidate tag set; the sample reconstruction module decodes the sample into a feature space according to the sample hidden space representation and the label information to obtain a reconstructed sample; the effect is that: the closed set and the open set noise bias mark data can be identified, and the negative influence of the semantic ambiguity of the bias mark sample on model training is relieved.

title_en: Abdominal multi-organ segmentation method based on dual-path feature extraction
abstract_en: Aiming at the problems of large difference of the dimensions of the multiple organs of the abdomen and fuzzy segmentation boundaries, the invention provides the abdomen multiple organ segmentation method combining the double-path feature extraction, the cross attention mechanism and the space reverse attention mechanism, which effectively improves the segmentation precision and keeps the details. Specifically, the local feature extraction module ResNet and the global feature extraction module VMamba are used for learning morphological features of multiple organs of the abdomen and outputting multi-scale information; establishing an effective feature fusion between the fine granularity feature and the coarse granularity feature by using a cross-attention mechanism; introducing a spatial back attention mechanism in the jump connection enables enhancing the segmentation boundary between different organs while supplementing the detail information.

title_en: SCMA-VLC system deep learning detection method based on codebook priori knowledge
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning detection method of an SCMA-VLC system based on codebook priori knowledge, which relates to the technical field of visible light communication and comprises the following steps: the user bit information of the transmitting end is coded by SCMA to obtain a superimposed codeword, the SCMA superimposed codeword is converted into a non-negative real signal under a direct-current bias light orthogonal frequency division multiplexing modulation scheme, and the LED is driven to transmit an optical signal; and the optical signal received by the receiving end is collected by the photodiode and converted into an electric signal, DCO-OFDM demodulation is carried out, and finally, the received signal is processed by adopting a deep learning detection network based on codebook priori knowledge, so that the bit information recovery of the user is realized. The invention adopts a noise reduction and detection integrated network, and enhances the extraction capability of network signal characteristics, thereby reducing the influence of LED nonlinear distortion and system noise on multi-user detection performance, and solving the problem that the multi-user detection performance of the system is reduced under the condition of larger nonlinear distortion due to the limited capability of the traditional MPA detection algorithm for resisting the signal nonlinear distortion.

title_en: Interface layout method and device of intelligent terminal and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a background layout method, a device and a computer readable storage medium of an intelligent terminal, wherein the interface layout method comprises the following steps: in response to obtaining an instruction for carrying out layout on the interface, carrying out layout recommendation on icons in the interface based on user hobbies and types of target backgrounds; receiving a selection instruction made by a user based on layout recommendation; the icons are rearranged based on the selection instruction. By the method, personalized interface layout recommendation can be realized, icon layout is completed by one key, diversified and personalized interface layout setting requirements of users are met, and user experience is improved.

title_en: Method, device, equipment, medium and product for predicting blocked line
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment, a medium and a product for predicting a blocking line, and relates to the technical field of power system planning, wherein the method is executed before the power spot market is cleared, and comprises the steps of rewriting transmission constraint of a power transmission line by using output change of a generator to obtain the rewritten transmission constraint of the power transmission line; the method comprises the steps of determining constraint after redundancy removal according to a solution of a feasible region of an optimal power flow model, determining a first blocking line set according to output change of each generator, power transfer distribution factors of each power transmission line and each generator in a target power transmission line set and residual transmission capacity of each power transmission line in the target power transmission line set, determining a second blocking line set according to the power transfer distribution factors of each power transmission line and each generator in the target power transmission line set and the residual transmission capacity of each power transmission line, and determining intersection of the two blocking line sets as blocking lines.

title_en: Method, device, medium and product for single-step running of virtual machine by using Hypervisor
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, a medium and a product for single-step running of a virtual machine by using a Hypervisor, which comprise the following steps: running a GDB simulation program in dom0 and a GdbServer simulation program in a Hypervisor layer based on an xen Hypervisor virtual machine monitor; the GDB simulation program interacts with the user command and performs parameter analysis, analysis information is transmitted to the GdbServer simulation program, and a domu target program virtual machine is operated; the GdbServer simulator controls the domu target program virtual machine to achieve target program breakpoint and single-step operation. According to the invention, a single-step running function of non-Linux application layer software debugging is realized by using a pure software scheme, and the defect of GDB coverage scenes is overcome. The method and the device enable developers to rapidly develop programs and debug problems, and solve the problems in the programs.

title_en: Method and device for adding watermark to contract
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for adding watermarks to a syndication, wherein the method comprises the following steps: automatically generating contract numbers and marking information after the examination of the contract files is completed; acquiring the contract file, reading the text of the contract file as a file stream, and writing the file stream into a text object; determining watermark correlation properties; and inserting the contract number and the marking information into the text object according to the watermark correlation attribute to generate a watermark version contract text. By utilizing the scheme of the invention, the anti-tampering effect of the contract can be improved.

title_en: Defect detection method, device, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a defect detection method, a device, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method is applied to first detection equipment which is arranged outside a defect detection flow on a production line, second detection equipment and control equipment are arranged in the defect detection flow, the second detection equipment stores images based on an image storage disc used during defect detection, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an image to be detected from a graph storage disk; performing defect detection on an object on a production line based on an image to be detected to obtain a first detection result; and sending the first detection result to the control equipment so that the control equipment controls the target equipment on the production line to execute target operation according to the first detection result and a second detection result which is generated by the second detection equipment and comprises the same object identification as the object identification included in the first detection result. The first detection device and the second detection device can automatically detect defects of objects on the production line according to the images.

title_en: Gesture recognition iteration method and device and head-mounted electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a gesture recognition iteration method, a gesture recognition iteration device and head-mounted electronic equipment, which are applied to the head-mounted electronic equipment, wherein the head-mounted electronic equipment is provided with a gesture recognition system and a gesture recognition optimization system, and the gesture recognition optimization system comprises: the system comprises a true value labeling model, a data acquisition module and a Finetune model; responding to an optimization instruction, determining a target label, and collecting a first gesture image corresponding to the target label; inputting the first gesture image acquired by the data acquisition module into a truth labeling model to output a gesture 2D truth value and a gesture 3D truth value, and generating a hand prediction frame by utilizing the gesture 2D truth value, wherein the target image comprises the first gesture image; according to the gesture truth values of the target labels and the target images, the Finetune model is utilized to train the gesture recognition system Finetune, and the gesture recognition system can be set by a user according to own requirements, so that the user experience is improved.

title_en: SAR robust waveform design method facing expansion target in band limited environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a SAR steady waveform design method facing an expansion target in a band limited environment, which belongs to the field of signal processing and comprises the following steps: s1, selecting a signal-to-noise ratio as an optimization criterion, establishing an error model of auxiliary knowledge, applying various constraints, and constructing an optimization problem of SAR robustness waveform design; s2, solving the minimization problem of the inner layer, and pushing out a closed solution of the target and background scattering characteristic statistics; s3, constructing a sub-optimization problem about waveforms, and decoupling a numerator and a denominator of an objective function; s4, converting the sub-problem in the iteration process into a semi-definite programming problem; s5, judging whether a stopping condition is met; if yes, executing S6, and if not, continuing iteration; and S6, judging whether an optimality condition is met, if yes, ending the solving process, and if not, adopting semi-definite relaxation and rank one decomposition to solve the sub-problem obtained in the step S3 until a stopping condition is met. The SAR image scattering method can obviously improve the signal-to-noise ratio of the SAR image and effectively highlight the scattering characteristic of the expansion target.

title_en: Recommendation method for alleviating interest mutation based on local interest modeling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of information processing, in particular to a recommendation method for relieving interest mutation based on local interest modeling, which comprises multi-scale local interest modeling, self-adaptive calibration and candidate item recommendation. The multi-scale local interest modeling divides the interactive subsequence, models evolution inside the subsequence and among the subsequences, and generates multi-scale local interests; generating an interest signal related to the object by self-adaptive calibration, predicting the mutation degree of the user interest, and carrying out self-adaptive interest calibration; the interest locality and the interest mutation of the user are comprehensively considered, so that the effect of the personalized recommendation system is improved; by combining the locality modeling and the interest mutation modeling, the interest change of the user can be more accurately understood and predicted, and more personalized recommendation service can be provided for the user.

title_en: Intelligent control system applied to differential fiber high-density composite yarn treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent control system applied to differential fiber high-density composite yarn treatment, which relates to the field of treatment flow control systems, and provides an adjustment object and a data basis for optimizing and adjusting the performance parameters of pretreatment by setting initial parameters and performance parameter thresholds of each pretreatment step corresponding to each differential fiber raw material; the method comprises the steps of carrying out prediction on a performance parameter data matrix, carrying out optimization adjustment on parameters in a pretreatment step in time, enabling efficiency in the pretreatment step to be higher, further improving efficiency of the whole treatment process of the differential fiber high-density composite yarn, and constructing a final CNN (computer numerical network) classification model to provide a classification model for classifying and acquiring color grade data of a differential fiber raw material set after pretreatment after first comprehensive treatment, and continuously dyeing the color grade data until the color grade data does not meet the requirement.

title_en: Construction method of universal grounding current calculation model for motor applicable to time domain and wide frequency domain simultaneously
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for constructing a universal grounding current calculation model of a motor, which is applicable to a time domain and a wide frequency domain at the same time, and belongs to the field of motor driving systems. The universal grounding circuit model for the motor is simple in structure and comprises five parts, namely a bearing, a stator winding, a stator core, a rotor and parasitic coupling capacitance in the motor. The model respectively establishes equivalent circuit models of all parts according to the distribution condition of the actual physical composition construction of the motor, and calculates specific parameter values of all circuit elements through the test results of the common mode impedance, the differential mode impedance, the impedance between the rotor and the shell and the frequency response of the impedance between the three-phase winding short-circuit points and the rotor. Compared with the existing model, the method has the characteristics of simple calculation, accurate estimation, coupling consideration of common mode and differential mode effects, applicability to a higher frequency domain range, and no limitation to specific motor types, and can realize more accurate calculation of the high-frequency grounding current of the motor under the background of high-speed high-voltage high-frequency development.

title_en: Single-frequency sinusoidal signal frequency, amplitude and phase estimation method based on minimum MSE
abstract_en: The invention discloses a single-frequency sinusoidal signal frequency, amplitude and phase estimation method based on a minimum MSE, which comprises the steps of taking frequency estimation results of an M-life algorithm and a HAQSE algorithm as 2 initial frequency estimation results, fitting signals to be estimated by utilizing the 2 initial frequency estimation results and a three-parameter or four-parameter sinusoidal fitting algorithm to obtain 2 corresponding fitting results, respectively calculating MSE between the 2 fitting results and the signals to be estimated, and selecting an estimation result with smaller MSE as a starting value of frequency search. And then iterating in a section near the initial value of the frequency search, and finding the estimated frequency corresponding to the MSE minimum value in the section to obtain a frequency estimation result. The method can accurately estimate the frequency of the single-frequency sinusoidal signal, bring the estimated frequency into a three-parameter or four-parameter sinusoidal fitting algorithm, and accurately estimate the amplitude and the phase of the signal, thereby obtaining all physical quantities of the single-frequency signal.

title_en: Self-adaptive noise reduction method and device based on implicit feedback
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electronic commerce recommendation systems, in particular to a self-adaptive noise reduction method and device based on implicit feedback, which comprises the steps of obtaining implicit feedback data of a user on commodities, and calculating to obtain a preference value of the user on interactive commodities interacted with the user according to the implicit feedback data of the user on the commodities; the method comprises the steps of calculating according to preference values of users on interactive commodities to obtain confidence levels of the users on the interactive commodities, calculating to obtain commodity heat of all the commodities, calculating according to the commodity heat to obtain confidence levels of the users on uninteresting non-interactive commodities which are not interacted with the user, constructing a negative example set according to the commodity heat, modeling the users and the commodities, adaptively adjusting weights trained on the negative examples when the negative example set is adopted for training, so that adaptive noise reduction is achieved, an accurate user-commodity model is obtained, a recommendation list is generated for the users based on the user-commodity model, the noise interference problem of implicit feedback data is solved, and adaptive noise reduction is achieved.

title_en: Room space segmentation method based on distance constraint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a room space segmentation method based on distance constraint, which is implemented according to the following steps: firstly, simplifying an original point cloud, and distinguishing free voxels and occupied voxels by calculating a space occupied probability grid; secondly, calculating the three-dimensional Euclidean distance between the free voxel and the nearest occupied voxel; on the basis, obtaining a room seed area through a distance threshold constraint and a DBSCAN clustering method; and then carrying out wave front growth on the unmarked area to obtain a room space segmentation result. The invention is directly realized in three-dimensional space, and solves the room space segmentation in complex indoor scenes.

title_en: Sign language recognition method, device, storage medium and computer program product
abstract_en: The application discloses a sign language identification method, a device, a storage medium and a computer program product, which relate to the technical field of sign language identification, wherein the sign language identification method is based on a Transformer model to carry out sign language identification, the Transformer model comprises an image embedding module, a key point embedding module and a characteristic processor, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring at least one frame of target image of sign language identification to be performed; the image embedding module is used for carrying out embedding processing on the target image to obtain an image vector; extracting key points in the target image through the key point embedding module, and embedding the key points to obtain key point vectors; and inputting the image vector and the key point vector to the feature processor to obtain a sign language recognition result. The application improves the accuracy of sign language recognition results.

title_en: Large-span space bridge structure design method based on bidirectional progressive topological optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a design method of a large-span space bridge structure based on bidirectional progressive topological optimization, which comprises the steps of obtaining unit sensitivity functions based on obtained parameter data of all units and combining parameters of a set large-span space bridge structure model, obtaining unit sensitivities of all units in an area to be optimized through the unit sensitivity functions, obtaining sensitivity threshold values, and finally optimizing the area to be optimized based on the sensitivity threshold values. The invention can avoid the conditions of unstable analysis numerical value output, numerical value error or algorithm failure, and the like. The large-span space bridge structure model is set to be two partial areas, one partial area is a model non-designable domain, the other partial area is a model designable domain, and the relation between the volume fraction and the design variable is modified, so that the large-span space bridge structure is optimized more accurately. The calculation speed of the unit node filter function can be greatly improved by quantizing the parameter data of all units through the functions in the numpy library.

title_en: Vision-based blade structure detection method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wind power generation, in particular to a method and a device for detecting a blade structure based on vision. The detection method comprises the steps of obtaining a first image with a calibration point, calculating a mapping formula of pixel distance and actual distance according to the first image, obtaining a second image with the calibration point, identifying and marking effective detection angular points on the second image, measuring second pixel distances of the effective detection angular points and the calibration point, calculating the actual distance of the effective detection angular points and the calibration point according to the mapping formula and the second pixel distances, and constructing a corresponding blade clearance curve. The detection method and the detection device provided by the invention can detect the blade structure during the running period of the wind driven generator without stopping operation. The efficiency of fan blade detection has been improved greatly, has reduced artifical input, increases the comprehensiveness of testing the content, guarantees accuracy and timeliness of testing result.

title_en: Medical archive electronic information management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical care information, in particular to an electronic information management system of medical care files, which comprises a first processing end, a second processing end and a third processing end, wherein the first processing end acquires the similarity of working skills among target objects, performs first clustering by using the similarity of the working skills, determines a plurality of first clustering clusters, acquires the capability similarity among the target objects in each first clustering cluster, further performs re-clustering on the target objects in each first clustering cluster by using the capability similarity, and determines a plurality of second clustering clusters. Clustering personal information archival data of medical staff according to capability similarity, and determining the score value of medical archival word segmentation of each target object in each second cluster, so that personalized culture word segmentation of medical staff in each cluster is calculated, and then a target culture mode is formulated for the medical staff in each cluster according to the personalized culture word segmentation of the medical staff in each cluster, so that islanding among the medical staff archival data is eliminated, and management efficiency is improved.

title_en: Flexible straight system voltage stability evaluation method and system based on improved MLE calculation
abstract_en: A soft-direct system voltage stability assessment method and system based on improved MLE calculation are provided, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining voltage amplitude time sequence data and voltage phase angle time sequence data of all alternating current bus nodes of an electric power system under transient state, then calculating the maximum Lyapunov index of the voltage amplitude based on the voltage amplitude time sequence data, drawing a voltage amplitude MLE curve, calculating the maximum Lyapunov index of the voltage phase angle based on the voltage phase angle time sequence data, drawing a voltage phase angle MLE curve, judging whether the voltage amplitude MLE curve oscillates or not, assessing whether transient voltage is stable based on the voltage amplitude MLE curve if the voltage amplitude MLE curve does not oscillate, and assessing whether the transient voltage is stable based on the voltage phase angle MLE curve if the voltage amplitude MLE curve oscillates. Compared with the traditional transient voltage stability evaluation method only by voltage amplitude MLE, the method provided by the invention evaluates by using the voltage phase angle MLE curve under the working condition that the voltage amplitude MLE curve oscillates, and the evaluation accuracy is higher.

title_en: Periodic impact load supporting structure dynamics optimization method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a dynamic optimization method of a periodic impact load supporting structure, which comprises the steps of determining excitation frequency and interval time of an impact load based on the application frequency of the periodic impact load received by the supporting structure, obtaining initial first-order natural frequency of the supporting structure through finite element analysis or directly adopting a mode test, determining a free oscillation period of the supporting structure based on the initial first-order natural frequency of the supporting structure, determining the optimized first-order natural frequency based on a preset relation if the interval time and the free oscillation period meet the preset relation, and simultaneously providing a dynamic optimization device of the periodic impact load supporting structure.

title_en: Protein data conversion method
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a protein data conversion method for converting the disclosed protein structure data into a deep learning model of an electron density modality, which comprises two processes of processing and labeling the electron density data. The method can convert a large amount of public data in the field of biological research into three-dimensional electron density data which can be used for deep learning, and further advance the development of machine learning in the field of biological pharmacy.

title_en: Power distribution network area dynamic digestion capability analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network station dynamic capacity analysis method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining basic data of a power distribution network, wherein the basic data comprise node data, branch data, power generation data, load data, transformer data and network topology structure data, respectively constructing a power flow calculation model, a distributed photovoltaic output model and a load model according to the basic data, calculating distributed photovoltaic fitness of each station according to coupling results of distributed photovoltaic and load characteristics, determining an access position and an access station according to the distributed photovoltaic fitness, determining an access scheme according to the access position and the access station, and outputting the distributed photovoltaic maximum capacity of the access scheme. The coupling relation between the distributed photovoltaic and the load characteristic is considered, meanwhile, the bearing capacity is calculated dynamically by combining the relation of the power flow of the platform area, and the problems of static state, low precision, few considerations and the like of a calculation result in the prior art are solved.

title_en: Image size intelligent recommendation method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of image processing, and relates to an intelligent image size recommending method, an intelligent image size recommending device, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an image file; identifying byte section data of the image file, determining the format of the image file according to the byte section data, determining byte sections for storing the image size according to the format of the image file, determining the image size according to the data in the byte sections, performing optimized display based on the image size, and providing image processing suggestions. The method and the device have the advantages that the size information of various image formats is intelligently and efficiently obtained, optimized display and processing suggestions are provided based on the size information, efficient size detection can be performed without downloading the image files in full, bandwidth and storage resources can be saved, optimization suggestions such as clipping, scaling, format conversion and the like can be provided, the image display effect and loading speed are improved, a recommendation algorithm can be continuously optimized through user feedback, and the intelligent level of the system can be improved.

title_en: Voice recognition method, device and equipment of equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a voice recognition method, a device, equipment and a storage medium of equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of responding to a voice awakening instruction, and performing voiceprint recognition to obtain voiceprint information of a user; the voice broadcasting method comprises the steps of obtaining target language type coding information of preset voiceprint information according to a matching result of the user voiceprint information and the preset voiceprint information, transmitting the target language type coding information to a cloud terminal, enabling a language identification model of a cloud terminal based on target language type coding information switching equipment to be a target language identification model of a target language type, and carrying out voice broadcasting according to the target language type. By adopting the voice recognition technology and the voiceprint recognition technology, the voice audio of the user is analyzed and recognized, so that voiceprint information of the user is recognized, the target language type which is required to be used by equipment is obtained, further, the target language type is automatically selected and used for voice interaction, and the switching accuracy under the condition of multiple languages is improved.

title_en: Method, system and equipment for identifying real-time combustion faults of coal-fired boiler
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and equipment for identifying real-time combustion faults of a coal-fired boiler, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out variable-working-condition CFD numerical simulation on a combustion state in the boiler, carrying out POD decomposition after obtaining temperature field data and speed field data in the boiler, extracting POD modes and modal coefficient vectors of all simulation working conditions, obtaining actual measured temperature data and actual measured speed data on site, obtaining a temperature modal coefficient vector and a speed modal coefficient vector of a current working condition by combining the extracted POD modes and utilizing gappy POD algorithm, respectively traversing and comparing the temperature modal coefficient vector and the speed modal coefficient vector of the current working condition and the simulation working condition to obtain a simulation working condition with the smallest included angle with the current working condition, and if the simulation working condition with the smallest included angle with the current working condition is an abnormal working condition, carrying out current combustion abnormality. The invention can identify the combustion fault in the furnace in a short time.

title_en: River channel safety early warning method and system based on BIM and multi-model information fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river channel safety early warning method and system based on BIM and multi-model information fusion, the method comprises the steps of obtaining pre-warning target river channel topographic environment data and historical flow data, building a precipitation flow model based on a BIM technology, carrying out regional division on the upstream of a target river channel according to the precipitation flow model, setting a flow warning threshold value of a pre-warning section, obtaining continuous flow data of the pre-warning section of the upstream site of the target river channel as a training data set and a checking data set, completing calibration of a deep neural network model and an Elman neural network model, carrying out multi-model information fusion on the two models based on a Stacking algorithm by using a random forest algorithm as a framework, completing construction of a flow prediction combined model, inputting real-time data of the upstream site into the flow prediction combined model, generating flow prediction data of a future pre-warning section, and importing the flow prediction data into the precipitation flow model to realize visualization and generate pre-warning information.

title_en: Power distribution network fault diagnosis and positioning method and system based on deep neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network fault diagnosis and positioning method and system based on a deep neural network, comprising the following steps: variants of the IEEE33 node system are built in Simulink and simulation data is generated by different topologies and distributed power configurations. The fault type and the fault line position are classified and positioned by using the Attention-LSTM network, and the diagnosis efficiency is improved and the calculation consumption is reduced by the design of double output heads. The accurate position of the fault section is regressed through the TCN-BiLSTM network, so that the defect of the traditional method in positioning precision is overcome. Robustness verification is carried out under various topological structures and power supply configurations, and stability and reliability of the system are proved. The method and the device can accurately and quickly judge the fault type and the position in the power distribution network, and provide effective support for fault repair of the power distribution network.

title_en: Sensing and storing integrated device for attitude regulation and control
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sensing and storing integrated device for gesture regulation, which comprises a hardware neural network formed by a memristor array, wherein the hardware neural network receives gesture analog signal input from a gesture sensor and an external gesture control instruction, the hardware neural network outputs an analog control signal to a controlled object driver, the network structure of the hardware neural network corresponds to the network structure of a gesture regulation network trained by software, and the conductivity value of each memristor in the hardware neural network is determined based on the weight value of a corresponding neuron in the gesture regulation network. According to the invention, the algorithm design of the high-performance attitude controller and the design of the end-to-end hardware neural network are fused together, so that the full-angle range convergence effect can be realized, the rapid limited time convergence capability is realized, and meanwhile, the analog signal system has a higher response bandwidth.

title_en: Configuration detection method and device based on DIMM memory slot position and computer equipment
