abstract_en: The application relates to a configuration detection method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium based on DIMM memory slots, wherein the method comprises the steps of creating a DIMM memory configuration recommendation table, listing DIMM slot number combinations of installed memory slots and priorities corresponding to the DIMM slot number combinations according to the number of CPUs and the memory capacity as indexes in the DIMM memory configuration recommendation table, detecting and acquiring a current DIMM memory configuration scheme of a server after a system is powered on, judging whether the current DIMM memory configuration scheme of the server accords with the optimal performance according to the DIMM memory configuration recommendation table, if the current DIMM memory configuration scheme of the server is optimal, the server works normally, and if the current DIMM memory configuration scheme of the server is not optimal, adjusting the DIMM memory configuration of the current server according to the optimal DIMM slot number combinations after the system is powered off. The application realizes the intelligent management of the server component configuration.

title_en: Transformer model evolution method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a Transformer model evolution method and system, the method comprises the steps of collecting Transformer operation data, selecting training samples, dividing the Transformer operation data into a historical data set X  0  and a data set X  1  to be updated, constructing a time sequence feature fusion module, extracting and fusing data features of the sample data set X  0  and the data set X  1  to be updated to obtain an advanced fusion feature Y  1 , constructing a data feature processing module, processing the data feature processing module by using a time sequence data difference method to obtain a new feature fusion result Z, constructing a Transformer time sequence prediction model, carrying out time sequence prediction on a similar feature data set Y  in  to obtain a prediction result Z  out , and updating weight parameters of the Transformer time sequence prediction model through increment learning. The method solves the technical problems of poor stability and flexibility of the model, reduced prediction precision along with time and lost characteristic information.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle ground control station and intelligent voice control device thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle ground control station and an intelligent voice control device thereof, and belongs to the technical field of voice control. The unmanned aerial vehicle ground control station comprises a control station body and an intelligent voice control device, wherein the intelligent voice control device comprises voice input equipment, a processing chip and a network transmission module. The invention can convert the voice information into text information, and then the voice processing module converts the text information into a specific protocol and transmits the specific protocol to the unmanned aerial vehicle ground control station. The ground control station generates a control instruction or executes corresponding operation through protocol analysis. The invention provides a brand-new unmanned aerial vehicle control mode, which is simpler and more convenient to operate compared with the prior art.

title_en: Unsupervised multi-focus image fusion method and model construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an unsupervised multi-focus image fusion method and a model construction method thereof, belonging to the technical field of computer image processing; the invention relates to a method for image fusion based on a decision graph, wherein an encoder is used for extracting characteristics, and a decoder is used for reconstructing an image by using the characteristics provided by the encoder. The present invention proposes a new activity level calculation module using pixel-based Laplace correction sums to act as a model for extracting image features using dual branches including detail branches and semantic branches in an encoder The processing unit obtains an initial decision diagram, then obtains a final decision diagram through the morphological processing unit, and finally realizes fusion through the fusion module. The model of the invention can be fused under the condition of no supervision information and large-scale image set to obtain a clear fused image. The features can be extracted more effectively by adopting a mode of extracting the features by double branches, and the method adopts Measuring the activity level can greatly improve the fusion effect.

title_en: Optimal scheduling method, system and equipment for charging and discharging resources of electric automobile
abstract_en: The method, the system and the equipment for optimizing and dispatching the charge and discharge resources of the electric automobile predict the dispatchable charge and discharge resources of each charge and discharge station according to the charge state of the electric automobile and the vacant charge piles of each charge and discharge station, and take the minimum power of a power grid of a station area, the minimum running cost and the highest satisfaction degree of users of the electric automobile as targets to construct an optimizing and dispatching model of the charge and discharge resources of the electric automobile, so as to obtain an optimizing and dispatching strategy of the charge and discharge resources of the electric automobile. According to the invention, the potential energy storage resource utilization rate of the electric automobile is fully excavated, the scheduling instruction and the scheduling plan are corrected in real time by predicting the charge and discharge resources of the electric automobile in the station, the influence of source load uncertainty caused by the quantity change of the electric automobile in the charging station is eliminated, the accuracy of a power grid scheduling strategy in the station area is improved, and the consumption of a renewable distributed power source and the economic benefit of a power grid are increased.

title_en: Cable auxiliary selection method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cables, and provides a cable auxiliary selection method and device, comprising the following steps of S1, constructing a cable database, and inputting standard construction scene information and standard cable parameters into the cable database; step S2, acquiring construction scene information of actual requirements and historical environment parameters of actual construction geographic positions, inquiring a cable database based on the construction scene information of the actual requirements, the historical environment parameters of the actual construction geographic positions and cable length requirements to obtain matched available cables and cable parameters thereof, step S3, determining available combination modes of the available cables according to the cable length requirements, pushing recommended results, and step S4, calculating corresponding costs according to the available combination modes of the available cables selected by a user, acquiring construction modes corresponding to the construction scenes, and displaying the costs corresponding to the available combination modes of the available cables selected by the user and related construction modes. The invention ensures the selection reliability of the cable.

title_en: New energy power grid risk early warning method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy power grid risk early warning method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining weight proportions of a photovoltaic system, a wind power generation system and a hydroelectric generation system; the method comprises the steps of obtaining variable data of monitoring variables corresponding to a photovoltaic system, a wind power generation system and a hydroelectric generation system and grid fluctuation data reflecting the grid fluctuation condition, calculating the correlation between each monitoring variable and the grid fluctuation condition, sequencing the correlation, taking the monitoring variables with the correlation sequenced in the front and preset number as target monitoring variables, calculating Gaussian distribution of the variable data of each target monitoring variable, determining an abnormal threshold value of each target monitoring variable according to the Gaussian distribution, marking the variable data exceeding the abnormal threshold value as abnormal data, and carrying out risk early warning according to the abnormal data. The invention can effectively reduce the operation pressure of the early warning system and improve the early warning response speed of the system.

title_en: Intelligent slope landslide displacement monitoring method and system based on Beidou positioning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of slope monitoring and discloses a slope landslide displacement intelligent monitoring method and system based on Beidou positioning. The method comprises the steps of setting auxiliary marking points in a slope monitoring area, establishing a coordinate system, carrying out preliminary positioning on the set auxiliary marking points through Beidou satellites, setting two groups of positioning modes of offline positioning and online positioning, positioning each auxiliary marking point in the slope monitoring area based on the set offline positioning mode after preliminary positioning, storing offline positioning information in real time, positioning each auxiliary marking point in the slope monitoring area based on the set online positioning mode after preliminary positioning, storing online positioning information in real time, and finally monitoring displacement conditions in the slope monitoring area based on the stored combination of the offline positioning information and the online positioning information, so that accuracy of intelligent monitoring of slope landslide displacement is improved.

title_en: Access record processing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a processing method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium of an access record, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining the access record of a client side for a target file after the client side accesses the target file; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a first audit report returned by a blockchain network, obtaining the first audit report by the blockchain network, carrying out audit processing on the first audit report by the blockchain network based on the access record corresponding to the transaction data, and sending the first audit report to a client. Therefore, audit of the access records is carried out based on the blockchain network, the non-falsification of the access records is ensured, and the safety and reliability of the data are also improved.

title_en: VGPSO algorithm-based wireless sensor network node configuration optimization method
abstract_en: The application provides a wireless sensor network node configuration optimization method based on VGPSO algorithm, which relates to the field of wireless sensor networks, and comprises the steps of optimizing and defining the wireless sensor network node configuration as a problem M; the improved particle swarm algorithm is guided by a random Halton sequence, a multi-factor cosine dynamic parameter adjustment strategy, a multi-population multi-strategy evolution mode and a Voronoi diagram, and the problem M is solved by the improved particle swarm algorithm, so that the global optimal position of each sensor node in the wireless sensor network is output. And a multi-factor cosine dynamic parameter adjustment strategy is introduced to balance global and local optimizing searching capability and enhance the diversity of particle populations. And using the Voronoi polygons to guide the evolution direction, and searching the coverage hole direction by calculating the Voronoi centroid so as to optimize the coverage holes in the population evolution process.

title_en: Method and system for generating sorting task based on image recognition
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of intelligent sorting, and particularly relates to a method and a system for generating sorting tasks based on image recognition, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an intelligent sorting system and constructing a sorting system model based on the intelligent sorting system; the method comprises the steps of operating an intelligent sorting system, obtaining a cargo monitoring image, carrying out shape analysis on the cargo monitoring image to generate a cargo entity model, identifying cargo label information, determining a sorting path, carrying out conveying path simulation according to the sorting path, determining sorting time, reading an initial state of a sorting mechanical arm, generating a mechanical arm sorting task, and sending the mechanical arm sorting task to a corresponding sorting mechanical arm. According to the invention, each sorting mechanical arm is independently controlled, a control instruction is sent to each sorting mechanical arm, the operation of a plurality of sorting mechanical arms can be realized through one data processing center, the sorting efficiency is improved, the sorting of cargoes can be realized under the condition of using high-cost intelligent mechanical arms, and the operation cost is reduced.

title_en: Content display method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps of responding to a display request for interactive multimedia content, scheduling and distributing a plurality of pre-created cloud virtual machines to be distributed in a virtual machine message queue, determining a target cloud virtual machine running a target interaction program for providing the interactive multimedia content in real time, feeding back connection information of the target cloud virtual machine to a request terminal corresponding to the display request, so that the request terminal displays the interactive multimedia content acquired in real time from the target cloud virtual machine based on the connection information, keeping the connection information of the cloud virtual machines to be distributed stored in the virtual machine message queue consistent with the connection information of an unassigned cloud virtual machine stored in a virtual machine database, and storing the connection information of the cloud virtual machine generated in the cloud virtual machine pre-creation process in the virtual machine database. By utilizing the embodiment of the invention, the efficiency and accuracy of virtual machine distribution can be improved, and further the content display delay of the request terminal can be reduced.

title_en: Computing power hardware resource adaptive scheduling method and system under cloud edge cooperative system
abstract_en: The invention provides a computing power hardware resource self-adaptive scheduling method and system under a cloud edge cooperative system, which are characterized by acquiring hardware resource state data, constructing first combination features, respectively transmitting the first combination features to a plurality of first field self-adaptive algorithms to obtain first algorithm embedded output features, determining the information coverage degree of each data packet of the hardware resource state data deployed in advance, constructing first vacancy indication features based on the information coverage degree of each data packet of the hardware resource state data and quantization features set for each data packet, determining importance parameters of each first field self-adaptive algorithm according to the first vacancy indication features, carrying out feature weighted fusion on each first algorithm embedded output feature according to the importance parameters to obtain first vacancy perception features, and obtaining a scheduling strategy based on feature combination results of the first vacancy perception features and each first algorithm embedded output feature. The invention can self-adaptively formulate an accurate scheduling strategy.

title_en: Traffic event detection system based on multi-mode data
abstract_en: A traffic event detection system based on multi-mode data belongs to the technical field of traffic event detection. The method aims at the problems that the existing traffic event detection method is poor in traffic event detection capability and cannot effectively correlate with context information due to insufficient video data in the training process. The method comprises the steps of obtaining high-dimensional visual features of sample event images and sample event videos by a visual encoder, obtaining text feature vectors of prompt words describing texts of sample events by a text encoder, obtaining high-dimensional visual features aligned with the text feature vectors by a feature mapping layer, obtaining common multi-modal features by a multi-modal joint learning module, obtaining semantic prediction results and answer text sequences of the sample events by a large language module, and obtaining traffic event classification results by a traffic event classification module. The method is used for online detection of traffic events.

title_en: Rigid-flexible coupling modeling analysis method for vacuum manipulator
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of vacuum mechanical manual mechanical modeling, and particularly relates to a rigid-flexible coupling modeling analysis method of a vacuum mechanical arm; the method comprises the steps of describing an arm by adopting a rigid body model, describing a steel belt by adopting a chord model in the field of a continuum, wherein the rigid body is a finite degree of freedom system, the continuum is an infinite degree of freedom system, discretizing the infinite degree of freedom system into the finite degree of freedom system by adopting a global space discretization method, and orderly integrating the 2 finite degree of freedom systems to obtain a rigid-flexible coupling dynamics equation of the vacuum manipulator. The invention establishes a system dynamics model based on an energy method, has clear thought, provides a good solution for dynamic modeling of a rigid-flexible coupling system, and solves the problem that a vacuum manipulator senses in real time without an end point and cannot sense the state of the system in real time to provide state feedback quantity for control.

title_en: Method and device for distributing read-write permission and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a read-write permission distribution method, a device and an electronic device, wherein a permission modification instruction is acquired, the permission modification instruction comprises an identity mark of at least one processor and number information of at least one target register, the target register is a register of one or more registers, the permission to be modified is required to be modified, a target processor corresponding to a port connected with the target register is determined according to the permission modification instruction, and the permission of the read-write target register is distributed for the target processor according to the identity mark of the target processor, so that the permission of the processor for reading and writing each register can be distributed through the identity mark of the processor, and the read-write task is executed on the register by the processor based on the read-write permission of each processor, thereby improving the flexibility of changing the read-write permission of the processor.

title_en: Information processing method, information processing device, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses an information processing method, an information processing device, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of receiving a first input, responding to the first input, executing inquiry operation according to first information corresponding to the first input, and displaying an inquiry result corresponding to the inquiry operation.

title_en: Substation equipment state evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a state evaluation method and system of substation equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of S101 of acquiring a historical operation state data set of the substation equipment, S102 of extracting local data characteristics of the substation equipment in each operation state and integral data characteristics of the substation equipment in each operation state from the historical operation state data set to construct a state characteristic library, S103 of acquiring real-time operation parameters of the substation equipment to acquire operation characteristics of the substation equipment, wherein the operation characteristics comprise real-time integral data characteristics and real-time local data characteristics of the substation equipment, and S104 of generating a substation equipment operation state report based on the operation characteristics and state characteristic library of the substation equipment. The method extracts the operation characteristics of each transformer substation equipment in various states based on the historical data, evaluates the operation state of the current transformer substation equipment according to the operation characteristics, has high evaluation result accuracy, and has important significance in reducing the failure rate of the transformer substation equipment.

title_en: Data management method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a data management method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of digital information. According to the data management method, production data is added to a first historical data object, a first time range version created according to a preset period corresponding to a target production task contained in the first historical data object is obtained, when a first time stamp corresponding to the addition of the production data is within a period corresponding to a start time and an end time contained in the first time range version, the production data in the first time range version is managed according to the first historical data object, the first time range version and the first time stamp, fine management of the production data is achieved, and meanwhile management difficulty of the production data is reduced.

title_en: Image stitching method, computer readable storage medium and computer program product
abstract_en: The application provides an image stitching method, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product, wherein one specific implementation mode of the method comprises the steps of obtaining at least two images to be processed, determining candidate angular points of objects to be stitched in the images to be processed according to each image to be processed, checking the candidate angular points, determining target angular points of the objects to be stitched according to a checking result, performing perspective transformation on an image area surrounded by the target angular points in the images to be processed to obtain the images to be stitched, and stitching at least two images to be stitched to obtain the target image. The method can improve the image distortion condition and improve the splicing robustness and the splicing speed.

title_en: Nonlinear proteomics causal association analysis method based on genetic scores
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of proteomics causal association analysis, and discloses a genetic score-based nonlinear proteomics causal association analysis method, which comprises the steps of predicting different protein expression levels of each sample by adopting a genetic score model; the method comprises the steps of matching each predicted protein expression level with an actual measured value in a database, calculating a correlation coefficient between the matched predicted protein expression level and the corresponding actual measured value, fitting a nonlinear causal relation between the predicted protein expression level with the correlation coefficient larger than a preset coefficient threshold value and a disease risk by adopting a restrictive cubic spline model, obtaining a protein with obvious nonlinear causal relation with the disease risk, and realizing causal relation analysis. The nonlinear association analysis is performed based on the protein expression level predicted by genetic scores, so that the sample size of analysis is increased, and the association evidence is upgraded into causal evidence, thereby being a stable and widely applicable nonlinear proteomics causal association analysis method.

title_en: Vehicle screen adjusting method and device and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of vehicle control, and provides a method and equipment for adjusting a vehicle screen, a vehicle, a first screen and a second screen, wherein the first screen is at least used for displaying instrument information, the second screen is at least used for displaying multimedia information and/or vehicle control information; and comparing the target image quality parameter with the current image quality parameter of the target adjusting screen to obtain a first comparison result, and then adjusting the image quality parameter of the target adjusting screen. And the linkage adjustment is canceled for the vehicle screen, corresponding image quality parameters are respectively determined, the requirements of the transportation mode on energy consumption reduction are met, the driver is ensured to clearly read the basic information of the vehicle during transportation, and the driving safety is ensured.

title_en: Accurate aeration operation method for sewage treatment plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sewage treatment, in particular to an accurate aeration operation method of a sewage treatment plant, which comprises the steps of collecting bubble images in an aeration process through a camera, carrying out morphological treatment and feature extraction on the bubble images, obtaining the characteristics of the area, the number of areas, deformation, track curvature, average speed and the like of bubbles, collecting DO content through a sensor, establishing a correlation model of the bubble characteristics and water quality for predicting future DO content after aeration response, establishing a power consumption model through calculating the power consumption of a blower and a water pump in the aeration process, generating overall power consumption of the aeration process, calculating an aeration rewarding value according to the overall power consumption and the future DO content, and generating an optimized aeration strategy through using a DQN model according to the aeration rewarding value. The invention can improve the accuracy of aeration operation of the sewage treatment plant and realize high-efficiency and energy-saving aeration operation.

title_en: Method and system for optimally training machine learning algorithms
abstract_en: The application relates to a method for optimally training a machine learning algorithm, comprising the steps of providing a domain model having domain parameters and/or domain values for at least one domain, providing a data model having a training data set having training data for at least one domain, removing and/or hiding and/or changing at least one training data from the training data set according to at least one domain parameter and/or domain value to provide a reduced training data set, training a neural network based on the reduced training data set to determine a model performance from the reduced data set, comparing the determined model performance with a model performance assigned to the training data set and determining a model performance deviation from the reduced data set, selecting training data from the training data set according to the model performance deviation, training the machine learning algorithm based on the selected training data, and providing a trained machine learning algorithm.

title_en: Model distillation method, apparatus, medium, device and computer program product
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a model distillation method, device, medium, equipment and computer program product, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a word list of a teacher model and a word list of a student model for model distillation, determining a shared word list corresponding to the teacher model and the student model based on the word list of the teacher model and the word list of the student model, converting probability distributions output by the teacher model and the student model based on the shared word list to obtain conversion probability distributions corresponding to the teacher model and the student model respectively, wherein the conversion probability distributions are probability distributions corresponding to words in the shared word list, determining target loss of the student model based on the conversion probability distributions corresponding to the teacher model and the conversion probability distributions corresponding to the student model, and training the student model based on the target loss.

title_en: Retrieval enhancement method and system based on structural entropy hierarchical knowledge tree
abstract_en: The application discloses a retrieval enhancement method based on a structural entropy hierarchical knowledge tree and a system thereof, by combining a hierarchical clustering HCSE algorithm with RAG, and a community structure of multi-level layer-by-layer refined information is constructed, and the accuracy and the generation efficiency of answers are improved. The method specifically comprises the steps of carrying out graph construction on a text data set and an image data set by utilizing a large language model LLM to respectively obtain corresponding graph structures, directly generating a multi-level community structure by utilizing a hierarchical clustering HCSE algorithm based on structural entropy and constructing a hierarchical knowledge tree, analyzing node degrees and community densities of each community in the hierarchical knowledge tree by utilizing the large language model LLM to generate corresponding community summary and sequencing according to information priority, carrying out hierarchical search according to the sequence of a top-middle community-bottom community in combination with the community summary in the hierarchical knowledge tree to generate local answers, and integrating all the local answers in a Map-Reduce mode to generate final answers.

title_en: Method and system for achieving fusion information touch of 5G message, short message and voice
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for achieving fusion information of a 5G message, a short message and voice, and relates to the technical field of information processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining information content to be sent, real-time geographic position information of a user and an initial multi-mode user portrait, optimizing the initial multi-mode user portrait by utilizing the information content to be sent and the real-time geographic position information of the user to obtain a target multi-mode user portrait, analyzing the information content to obtain an analysis result, determining a target communication strategy corresponding to the information content by utilizing a reinforcement learning framework based on the target multi-mode user portrait and the analysis result, determining a target communication resource allocation scheme by utilizing a dynamic resource allocation algorithm based on the target communication strategy according to the real-time geographic position information of the user and network conditions, executing an information transmission process based on the target communication resource allocation scheme, and introducing a differential privacy protection mechanism to encrypt the information transmission process. The application improves the accuracy of information content touch.

title_en: Power down test circuit and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a power failure test circuit and a system, and belongs to the technical field of hardware testing. The power down test circuit comprises a plurality of interfaces with various bus standards, a plurality of output voltage control circuits configured to provide various output voltages, a power supply circuit electrically connected with the output voltage control circuits and configured to convert an access power supply into power supply voltages required by the output voltage control circuits, and a main control chip electrically connected with the output voltage control circuits and configured to control the power up or power down of the output voltage control circuits according to target power up time information and target power down time information.

title_en: Liquid tank displacement finite element calculation method for ultra-large liquefied gas carrier
abstract_en: The invention relates to a calculation method of liquid tank displacement finite element of an oversized liquefied gas carrier, which comprises the steps of conducting grid division on a liquid tank three-dimensional model, setting material properties of unit grids, adjusting material density, conducting model diagnosis on the adjusted finite element three-dimensional model, placing a rotary pier at a strong structure at the bottom of the liquid tank, conducting modeling on the rotary pier through a Gap unit, conducting node coupling on the liquid tank and a module group through Rigid rigid units respectively, conducting overturning analysis on the arrangement position of the module group, judging whether the liquid tank has overturning risk or not, adjusting the module group arrangement if the liquid tank has overturning risk, conducting stress analysis on the rotary pier, and adjusting the pier if the rotary pier is overlarge in bearing capacity and breaks or the liquid tank is overlarge in stress strain. According to the invention, displacement overturning analysis and pier placing stress analysis are carried out by means of finite element calculation, so that overturning in the actual displacement process is avoided, damage to the liquid tank and the module group is avoided, and the safety of the whole displacement of the liquid tank is improved.

title_en: Reservoir fracturing comprehensive evaluation method based on priori knowledge
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of oil and gas yield increase, in particular to a reservoir fracturing comprehensive evaluation method based on priori knowledge, which comprises the steps of 1) optimizing fracturing evaluation indexes by using priori knowledge, qualitatively determining all the fracturing evaluation indexes, constructing virtual positive and negative ideal point labels, 2) constructing an original evaluation matrix based on the optimized fracturing evaluation indexes, 3) carrying out standardized treatment on the optimized fracturing evaluation indexes, 4) determining weights of all the fracturing evaluation indexes by adopting an entropy weight method, 5) weighting the weights obtained by calculating the entropy weight method into the original evaluation matrix to construct a weighted standardized matrix, and 6) calculating Euclidean distance from an evaluation point to a positive ideal point and a negative ideal point and Euclidean paste progress to evaluate the reservoir fracturing. The method introduces the concept of priori knowledge into comprehensive evaluation of the reservoir, so that a large amount of data on site is effectively utilized, the reservoir fracturing property can be scored, and the reservoir fracturing property can be quantized.

title_en: Mixed reality-based oral and maxillofacial lesion positioning and registering method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mixed reality, in particular to a method and a system for positioning and registering an oral and maxillofacial lesion based on mixed reality, which comprise the steps of acquiring an oral and maxillofacial lesion of a patient, carrying out three-dimensional reconstruction, identifying a three-dimensional reconstruction model to acquire specific positions of all parts of the oral and maxillofacial lesion of the patient, carrying out marking, presetting a label on the oral and maxillofacial lesion of the patient, utilizing MR to scan the label, acquiring a label image, acquiring a coordinate position of the label under an MR coordinate system according to a slam algorithm, carrying out world coordinate system conversion on the coordinate position of the label under the MR coordinate system, registering the coordinate position of the label under the world coordinate with an oral and maxillofacial marking point in the three-dimensional reconstruction model to acquire a position coordinate of the oral and maxillofacial lesion marking point under the world coordinate.

title_en: Image processing method, device, battery detection method, apparatus, system and medium
abstract_en: The application provides an image processing method, an image processing device, a battery detection method, equipment, a system and a medium, and belongs to the technical field of batteries. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a detection image containing an object to be detected, respectively extracting gradients of the detection image along a first direction and a second direction to obtain a first gradient image and a second gradient image of the detection image, wherein the first direction and the second direction are different, performing compression processing on the first gradient image and the second gradient image to obtain a first compression gradient image and a second compression gradient image, and performing image reconstruction based on the first compression gradient image and the second compression gradient image to obtain a reconstructed image of the object to be detected. For the reconstructed image, even if the gray values between adjacent pixel points are not different, the gray values can be more easily identified from the reconstructed image, so that detail features in the reconstructed image are clearer, and the accuracy of an image identification result is improved.

title_en: Optimization method for reporting capacity of electric smelting magnesium group furnace before participation of primary frequency modulation day
abstract_en: The invention provides an optimization method for reporting capacity of an electric smelting magnesium group furnace before a primary frequency modulation day, belongs to the field of primary frequency modulation of an electric power system, and is applied to the participation of high-energy consumption electric smelting magnesium furnace loads in primary frequency modulation of a power grid. The method comprises the steps of 1) establishing an objective function to maximize the overall benefit, 2) determining constraint conditions, considering frequency modulation requirements, energy consumption limitation and product quality, and 3) processing uncertainty of the adjustment capability of the electric smelting magnesium group furnace, and allowing optimization solution to be conducted without meeting the constraint among partial cells so as to achieve efficient processing of the uncertainty. The invention expresses the uncertainty of the adjustment capability of the electric smelting magnesium group furnace in a probability form by an opportunity constraint method, and solves the problem of the optimal reporting capacity of the electric network primary frequency modulation participated in each time period before the day. The method provides support for the electric smelting magnesium enterprises to reasonably participate in primary frequency modulation of the power grid and the frequency modulation capacity declared in the future as load side demand response resources.

title_en: Intelligent contract byte code similarity detection method based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent contract byte code similarity detection method based on a graph neural network, which comprises the steps of performing disassembly operation on byte codes of an Ethernet virtual machine, performing data flow analysis and control flow analysis on disassembly results to obtain data flow graphs and control flow graphs corresponding to the byte codes, combining the data flow graphs and the control flow graphs of each external function into byte code feature graphs, adopting a large number of intelligent contract training graph neural networks with similar labels, performing vectorization operation on the byte code feature graphs in the training process to obtain feature vectors, taking a problem contract as a reference intelligent contract, respectively inputting the reference intelligent contract and the byte code feature graphs of the intelligent contracts to be detected into the trained graph neural networks to respectively obtain corresponding feature vectors, comparing Euclidean distances of the two feature vectors, and measuring to obtain the similarity of byte codes of the two intelligent contracts. Compared with the traditional method, the method has higher accuracy, can effectively identify problem contracts, and enhances the safety of a block chain system.

title_en: Newton iteration model-based automatic positioning method for common operating point of double-duct fans
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic positioning method for common operating points of a double-duct fan based on a Newton iteration model, which comprises the steps of respectively performing linear fitting on two common operating lines of an inner duct and an outer duct of the double-duct fan, selecting the back pressure disturbance quantity of the outlet of the inner duct and the back pressure of the outlet of the outer duct, solving the back pressure flow fields of the outlet of the inner duct and the back pressure of the outlet of the outer duct before disturbance, obtaining a Jacobian matrix of the common operating line distance of the inner duct and the outer duct to the back pressure of the outlet of the inner duct and the back pressure of the outlet of the outer duct by using a finite difference method, and obtaining the variation quantity of the back pressure of the outlet of the inner duct and the back pressure of the outlet of the outer duct based on the Newton iteration until the distance between the operating points and the common operating line after Newton iteration is smaller than a preset error, and successfully and automatically positioning the common operating points of the double-duct fan. The invention is a new method for quickly, accurately and automatically positioning the common working point of the double-duct fans, improves the research efficiency, shortens the research and development time, reduces the design cost, and powerfully supports and promotes the research and design of the double-duct fans.

title_en: Low-altitude intelligent cluster flight management method, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The application discloses a low-altitude intelligent cluster flight management method, equipment, medium and product, and relates to the technical field of aviation, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a knowledge graph based on structured and unstructured data of a low-altitude network intelligent carrier; the method comprises the steps of analyzing airspace characteristics in a knowledge graph by utilizing an LSTM model, predicting a flow time-space graph of a carrier, dividing a low-altitude airspace based on the flow time-space graph, determining a low-altitude airspace distribution result, taking the flight safety of the carrier as a reward function, taking the time of a flight path as a cost function, iterating an initialized low-altitude network intelligent carrier path by adopting a Q-learning+traffic factor penalty algorithm to obtain an optimal path, and constructing a formation flight cooperative control model with the minimum delay rate as a target according to the low-altitude network intelligent carrier cluster. The application can improve the airspace utilization efficiency and the flight safety of the low-altitude network intelligent carrier.

title_en: Medical image segmentation method and device
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method and apparatus for medical image segmentation. According to the method and the device, the preliminary labeling of the image is achieved by acquiring the plurality of rough labeling information in the medical image, corresponding rough labeling data are generated, the labeling cost is effectively reduced, and meanwhile, the efficiency of researching the medical image is improved. Based on a plurality of trained high-precision segmentation models, a multi-expert system is constructed, rough labeling information in the medical image is subjected to deep analysis, and fine labeling information is generated. And determining the pixel point of interest by voting on each pixel point, and further identifying the region of interest in the medical image. By adopting a progressive labeling information processing mode, the high-precision segmentation of the medical image is realized, the labeling accuracy is remarkably improved, and the possible misjudgment of a single high-precision segmentation model is avoided, so that the robustness of region segmentation is enhanced.

title_en: Data processing method, apparatus, device, storage medium, and program product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a data processing method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a program product, which are applied to a data transmission system in data processing equipment; and carrying out framing processing or frame de-framing processing on the intermediate data according to the data processing type to obtain target data. The method is beneficial to reducing the format requirement of the data transmission system on the input initial data by preprocessing the initial data to obtain the intermediate data, and the different intermediate data are subjected to framing or de-framing split processing according to the data processing type of the intermediate data, so that a framing subsystem and a de-framing subsystem are not required to be independently arranged, and the architecture of the data transmission system is simplified.

title_en: Lower limb movement state recognition model training method and lower limb movement state recognition method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a lower limb movement state recognition model training method and a lower limb movement state recognition method. The model training comprises the steps of determining the sorting order of the two classification models corresponding to the motion states of various lower limbs, training the two classification models in sequence according to the sorting order to obtain model parameters and the current classification results of all sample data, and training a result decision model according to the two classification results obtained by processing the sample data by the two classification models corresponding to the motion states of all lower limbs and the lower limb motion state labels of the sample data to determine the model parameters of the result decision model. By referring to the output results of the previous classification results, the correct output results of the next classification model can be realized as far as possible, the model accuracy and the robustness of the next classification model are improved, and the accuracy and the robustness of the whole lower limb movement state identification model are further improved.

title_en: Accompanying method, ejector optimization and jet centrifugal pump optimization design method
abstract_en: The application relates to a concomitant method, ejector optimization and an optimization design method of a jet centrifugal pump. The application relates to the technical field of jet centrifugal pumps, which comprises the following steps of step 1, establishing a geometric model of a jet centrifugal pump and producing grids, step 2, calculating a flow field of the jet centrifugal pump, step 3, carrying out accompanying calculation on the jet centrifugal pump by an accompanying method, step 4, analyzing sensitivity of the jet centrifugal pump, step 5, establishing a geometric model of a jet device and generating grids, step 6, calculating the flow field of the jet device and carrying out accompanying calculation, step 7, analyzing sensitivity of the jet device and deforming the grids, step 8, carrying out new flow field simulation on the updated design by simulation and analysis again, confirming correctness of an optimization direction and analyzing an optimization effect, and repeating the steps 6 to 7 until obtaining a proper solution.

title_en: Method and device for deploying language model, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The present application relates to the field of data processing, and in particular, to a method and apparatus for deploying a language model, an electronic device, and a storage medium. According to the method, training data in the preset field are generated through various data generation modes, a basis is provided for model training aiming at the specific field, the absolute degree of dependence on manual annotation is reduced through the various data generation modes, and the efficiency and the diversity of data generation are improved. And then comparing the first prediction feedback data with the difference data obtained by the first feedback data to update the model parameters, so that the model is continuously adjusted to the correct direction, and the accuracy of the model in the specific field is improved. With continuous training and updating, the model can better understand and handle the problems in the specific field, and reduce the mispredictions caused by inaccurate data. And performing performance test on the target language model, and executing deployment operation if the performance test is passed, so that an automatic process from model training to deployment aiming at a specific field is realized.

title_en: Space-time correlation-based method and space-time correlation-based system for predicting multi-user short-term load of district
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space-time correlation-based platform region multi-user short-term load prediction method and system, and relates to the technical field of power load prediction. The method comprises the steps of identifying abnormal load data by a DBSCAN algorithm, clustering users by a K-means algorithm, replacing abnormal characteristic values by means of average values in the same time class to obtain an optimized load data set, constructing comprehensive correlation analysis indexes to quantitatively analyze the correlation between each influence factor and the load, selecting the influence factors with strong correlation as input features of a multi-element load prediction model, extracting and predicting features of Informer and GCN in time and space respectively, and fusing single prediction results by means of a variance-covariance combination prediction model to realize load prediction in a certain period of time in the future. The invention can effectively improve the short-term load prediction precision by means of the introduced space-time related information of the multi-user load of the station area.

title_en: Method and system for recommending interpretable problems based on relation attributes
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent teaching, in particular to a method and a system for recommending interpretable problems based on relation attributes, which are characterized by processing interactive data between users and problems in the existing data set, building a user-problem knowledge graph according to the relation between the data, and initializing the user-problem knowledge graph; the method comprises the steps of inputting an initialized user-problem knowledge graph example into a TransE model for training to obtain an embedded vector of a trained entity and relationship, carrying out user practice problem recommendation on the user-problem knowledge graph, forming the user practice problem recommendation into a Markov decision process, and carrying out multi-step path reasoning on the user-problem knowledge graph by constructing a reinforcement learning system to realize the user practice problem recommendation. The invention not only realizes more accurate user portrait, but also improves the accuracy of the recommendation system, and simultaneously extracts the path between the recommendation problem and the problem practiced by the students from the knowledge graph to generate the interpretable recommendation.

title_en: Fault identification method, system, equipment and medium for distribution network uninterrupted operation
abstract_en: The application is suitable for the technical field of distribution networks, and provides a fault identification method for uninterrupted operation of a distribution network, which comprises the steps of acquiring monitoring data of the distribution network in real time under a plurality of view angles; the method comprises the steps of carrying out fusion on monitoring data based on a large transducer model to obtain fusion characteristic representation, carrying out fault identification on distribution network equipment based on the fusion characteristic representation to obtain potential fault data, wherein the fault data comprise potential fault points, potential fault positions and potential fault types, carrying out quantitative analysis on distribution of the distribution network equipment in a distribution network and the running state of the distribution network equipment based on the potential fault data to obtain fault risk results, dynamically adjusting a distribution network scheduling strategy based on the fault risk results to generate an operation scheduling plan, and adopting a communication technology to enable all distribution equipment in the distribution network to work cooperatively based on the operation scheduling plan. The application can improve the accuracy and efficiency of fault identification, optimize the distribution network scheduling strategy, promote the cooperative work of distribution network equipment and further improve the operation and maintenance level of the distribution network.

title_en: Speech synthesis method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a voice synthesis method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and is suitable for the technical field of finance and technology. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-mode reference data, extracting visual reference embedded features, audio reference embedded features, text reference embedded features and emotion description embedded features from the multi-mode reference data, carrying out feature projection on the visual reference embedded features, the audio reference embedded features and the text reference embedded features based on a multi-mode projection matrix to obtain multi-mode implicit emotion embedded features, carrying out feature projection on the emotion description embedded features based on a multi-mode projection matrix to obtain emotion prompt projection embedded features, carrying out feature calculation based on the multi-mode implicit emotion embedded features and the emotion prompt projection embedded features to obtain emotion reference embedded features, and carrying out voice synthesis based on the emotion reference embedded features and voice synthesis text embedded features. The embodiment of the application can improve the naturalness of the voice synthesis.

title_en: Three-dimensional medical image lossless compression method and system based on transducer decoder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional medical image lossless compression method and system based on a transform decoder, which comprises the steps of preprocessing a three-dimensional medical image to obtain a voxel sequence, dividing the voxel sequence to obtain a multi-voxel sequence block, inputting the multi-voxel sequence block into a double-layer decoder model, roughly predicting the multi-voxel block sequence by a first layer decoder, predicting each voxel by using a rough prediction result as a priori feature by a second layer decoder to obtain the prediction probability distribution of the next voxel, sending the prediction probability distribution of all voxels and each voxel into an encoder for encoding to obtain a code stream, decoding the code stream by adopting the same prediction mode and sequence as the double-layer decoder model to obtain a decoded voxel sequence, and carrying out inverse preprocessing on the decoded voxel sequence to obtain the lossless compressed three-dimensional medical image. The invention models voxels from rough to fine, reduces the calculation time of each voxel, realizes remote modeling dependence and realizes high-performance lossless compression.

title_en: Information processing method, device, equipment and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an information processing method, which comprises the steps of screening corpus data to be processed based on target information to obtain screened corpus data, wherein the target information at least comprises information related to information of a user and target words, processing the screened corpus data by adopting a target quality classification model to obtain high-quality corpus data to be optimized, and optimizing the high-quality corpus data to be optimized based on data characteristics of the corpus data to obtain target corpus data. The embodiment of the application also discloses an information processing device, equipment and a computer readable storage medium.

title_en: Bearing fault diagnosis method combining multi-scale residual error and multi-task depth separable convolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bearing fault diagnosis method combining multi-scale residual errors and multi-task depth separable convolution, which comprises the following steps of preprocessing bearing signals to generate a two-dimensional code image, dividing the two-dimensional code image into a training set, a test set and a verification set, constructing a shared network to extract general shared features, constructing a branch network to extract task features of subtasks, combining the shared network with the branch network to construct a multi-task classification model, screening the shared features through a attention mechanism, inputting the training set into the multi-task classification model, reasonably distributing computing resources by utilizing a dynamic loss weight algorithm, introducing an online label into a softmax classifier to smoothly accelerate the model convergence speed, and outputting classification results of all subtasks. The invention can effectively extract the fault characteristics of each subtask and realize the efficient and accurate fault diagnosis of the multitask bearing.

title_en: Cable line optimization method, device and equipment based on artificial intelligent reasoning model
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure discloses a cable line optimization method, a device and equipment based on an artificial intelligence reasoning model. The method comprises the steps of obtaining route point identifiers of candidate cables, obtaining geographic space feature information, conducting line optimization data extraction processing on the geographic space feature information, obtaining cable route point identifier directed graph data, traversing a cable route point identifier directed graph corresponding to the cable route point identifier directed graph data, conducting optimization processing on initial cable line information to obtain optimized cable line information corresponding to a preset cable terminal field identifier group, generating cable line laying information, generating cable laying mode information corresponding to the optimized cable line information, determining the optimized cable line information and the cable laying mode information as cable line information, and displaying the cable line information on a preset cable line optimization page. The embodiment improves the experience of the cable construction user.

title_en: Method for realizing SR-IOV virtual device discovery by jailhouse
abstract_en: The invention provides a jailhouse method for realizing SR-IOV virtual device discovery, which belongs to the technical field of virtual device discovery and comprises enabling a PCIe device SR-IOV function on a host to generate n VF devices in jailhouse drive, creating a VF device resource table associated with PF devices of a PCIe network card in a Hypervisor to generate VF device information, and controlling the access of a non-root client PCI configuration space in the Hypervisor in an MMIO simulation mode. According to the invention, VF equipment can be found on a none root client by using a partition virtual machine tool jailhouse in armv framework in a physical PCIe equipment discovery mode, and further, SR-IOV virtual equipment transparent transmission can be realized by combining a msi-x interrupt transparent transmission method.

title_en: Program code data processing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a processing method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium of program code data, wherein first operation data generated by a server operating a first version of target program code are obtained, target execution sentences are obtained from the first operation data, a code call chain corresponding to the target execution sentences is determined based on the first operation data, and code difference data of a function indicated by the code call chain is determined based on a second version of target program code and the first version of target program code. In the mode, a user can clearly know the code execution process corresponding to the preset requirement influenced by the modified function by checking the code call chain, so that the efficiency of analyzing the service function influenced by the code modification is improved, the code call chain is generated based on the operation data of the server, the code call relationship is more accurate, and the analysis accuracy of the service influence effect is improved.

title_en: Method and system for identifying and classifying typical rock mass in western region based on remote sensing image
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying and classifying typical rock mass in western regions based on remote sensing images, and belongs to the technical field of rock mass identification and classification. The method comprises the following steps of S1, collecting historical remote sensing data of a target area, preprocessing the historical remote sensing data to obtain identification data, S2, constructing a rock mass identification and classification model, training the rock mass identification and classification model by adopting the identification data to obtain a final model, and S3, carrying out identification and classification on the remote sensing data collected by the target area based on the final model to obtain an identification and classification result. The invention can realize the rapid and accurate identification and classification of complex geological structures and rock masses in western regions, and provides powerful support for geological investigation and mineral resource exploration.

title_en: Fire extinguishing system of underground comprehensive pipe rack
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire protection system of an underground utility tunnel, which comprises a sensing layer, a transmission layer and a platform layer, wherein the sensing layer comprises a fire early warning detection module, a fire warning detection module and a temperature image detection module, the fire early warning detection module is used for acquiring electric data, the fire warning detection module is used for acquiring alarm data, the temperature image detection module is used for acquiring image data and temperature data through a distributed image fire detector and a distributed optical fiber line type temperature-sensing fire detector, the alarm data at least comprises one of alarm information, fireproof door monitoring information, linkage equipment information and fire extinguishing equipment information, the transmission layer is used for transmitting data of the sensing layer to the platform layer, and the platform layer is used for monitoring, maintaining, alarming and analyzing the underground utility tunnel according to the data transmitted by the transmission layer. The distributed optical fiber linear temperature-sensing fire detector and the distributed image fire detector are used as main materials, other information is linked, and a set of fire protection system for transmitting more information is constructed.

title_en: Memory inner multiplication accumulation calculating device and method based on SRAM
abstract_en: The invention discloses a memory multiplication accumulation calculation device and method based on SRAM, wherein the device comprises a first SRAM bit unit, a second SRAM bit unit, a first transmission gate circuit and a second transmission gate circuit, the first transmission gate circuit comprises a first NMOS tube, a first PMOS tube and a first input port, the second transmission gate circuit comprises a second NMOS tube, a second PMOS tube and a second input port, a third MOS tube and a fourth MOS tube are arranged between a BLL bit line and the first and second transmission gate circuits, a fifth MOS tube and a sixth MOS tube are arranged between a BLR bit line and the first and second transmission gate circuits, a NOT gate is arranged between the BLR bit line and a carry output port, and the NOT gate input end is respectively connected with a NAND gate output end and the BLL bit line. By adopting the technical scheme, the multiplication and accumulation results of two groups of inputs and weights can be directly output, a multiplication unit and a first-stage half adder circuit in an addition tree are not needed, the use of transistors is saved, the area and the power consumption expenditure of the addition tree are reduced, and the energy efficiency of the whole CIM macro is improved.

title_en: Runner parameter optimization method, device and equipment of water pump turbine and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydroelectric generation, and discloses a runner parameter optimization method, a device, equipment and a storage medium of a water pump turbine, wherein the method comprises the steps of adjusting initial geometric parameters, inputting the adjusted parameters into a pre-constructed parameter optimization model so as to enable the parameter optimization model to output the pressure pulsation amplitude of a vaneless area corresponding to the adjusted geometric parameters, and (3) until the amplitude of the bladeless area pressure pulsation corresponding to the adjusted geometric parameter is smaller than a preset threshold value, storing the geometric parameter as an optimized target parameter, and quickly and efficiently finding out the optimal geometric parameter for inhibiting the bladeless area pressure pulsation based on an artificial intelligent optimization algorithm, so that the optimization efficiency and precision of the geometric parameter are greatly improved, and the time and cost required by the traditional trial-and-error method are reduced.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for determining shape parameters of radiating fins
abstract_en: The present application relates to the technical field of heat dissipation devices, and in particular, to a method, an apparatus, a device, and a medium for determining a shape parameter of a heat dissipation fin. The method comprises the steps of determining adaptive data of a corresponding group of shape parameters in a current iteration process according to the fin quality and the fin surface area of a heat radiation fin to be designed under each group of shape parameters in the corresponding fin design population in the current iteration process, taking at least one group of reference shape parameters and at least one group of derivative shape parameters as the fin design population in the next iteration process under the condition that the adaptive data in the current iteration process does not meet the preset iteration termination condition, and determining target shape parameters of the heat radiation fin according to the group of shape parameters in the current iteration process.

title_en: Data processing method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of data processing, and relates to a data processing method which comprises the steps of judging whether a data adding request for a target index library triggered by a user is received, wherein the data adding request carries original data, if yes, displaying a preset configuration page, receiving a designated compression algorithm name input by the user in the configuration page, searching an implementation class of a designated compression algorithm corresponding to the designated compression algorithm name from a preset target cache, calling the designated compression method corresponding to the implementation class of the designated compression algorithm, compressing the original data based on the designated compression method to obtain corresponding target data, and storing the target data into the target index library. The application also provides a data processing device, computer equipment and a storage medium. In addition, the application also relates to a blockchain technology, and target data can be stored in the blockchain. The application effectively improves the flexibility and the intelligence of data compression processing.

title_en: Three-dimensional multi-time scale load prediction method based on transverse-longitudinal multi-dimensional check
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional multi-time scale load prediction method based on transverse and longitudinal multi-dimensional check, which relates to the technical field of power load prediction and comprises the steps of collecting historical load data and environment data of a power grid, and dividing the historical load data into short-term, medium-term and long-term load data sets according to multi-time scale division; under each time scale, carrying out load characteristic analysis based on a transverse and longitudinal multi-dimensional checking method to obtain a load change rule under each time scale; and constructing a multidimensional load prediction model according to the analysis result of the load characteristics of each time scale, and predicting the future load. Through hierarchical analysis and comprehensive modeling of load characteristics of multiple time scales, load dynamic change characteristics are accurately captured, prediction accuracy is improved, scientific support is provided for short-term scheduling and medium-long term planning of a power system, power resource distribution is optimized, and overall efficiency and stability of the system are improved.

title_en: Edge construction method and device of graph database
abstract_en: The application discloses an edge construction method and device of a graph database. The edge construction method of the graph database comprises the steps of generating character strings based on attribute values of edges in the graph database, converting characters at preset positions in the character strings into long integers to obtain numerical value type long integer identifications of the edges, and writing the numerical value type long integer identifications serving as the identifications of the edges into the graph database. The application can change the unknown edge mark into the known edge mark by the edge construction method, and can avoid the action of inquiring the edge before updating or rewriting the edge, thereby improving the performance of updating or rewriting the edge.

title_en: Automatic wharf import container position distribution method embedded with deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic wharf import container bit allocation method embedded with deep reinforcement learning. The method comprises the steps of firstly establishing an objective function for a suitcase area based on the total processing time of the current batch of containers and the total turnover time of all future containers, then carrying out robust peer-to-peer conversion on the established mathematical model, converting an uncertainty model into a deterministic model and correspondingly adding constraints for the layout selection of the shellfish bits, carrying out statistics and simplification on the possible layout of the shellfish bits, greatly reducing the number of constraint conditions in the model, solving the upper limit value of the turnover in the objective function after the robust peer-to-peer conversion through a deep reinforcement learning method, and finally obtaining a bin allocation scheme by utilizing a commercial solver. On the basis of remarkably improving the solution efficiency of the box allocation strategy, the invention ensures that the wharf has higher stability and reliability when working against the import box with high uncertainty, and provides powerful decision support for wharf operation management.

title_en: Deep learning DDoS detection method based on feature distribution test
abstract_en: The invention relates to a deep learning DDoS detection method based on feature distribution inspection, belonging to the field of information security. The method comprises the steps of S1, collecting and preprocessing access data, S2, obtaining statistical features and frequency domain features by using a statistical method and FFT, S3, extracting dynamic features by using a TCN (TCN self-encoder), S4, extracting static features by using CNN for the statistical features and the frequency domain features, S5, establishing a loss function by using HSIC (high speed integrated circuit), carrying out parameter optimization on the TCN self-encoder, S6, splicing the dynamic features and the static features, inputting the dynamic features and the static features into a classifier to obtain a detection result, S7, establishing the loss function, combining a result label, training network parameters, and S8, carrying out DDoS attack detection on real-time access data by using a trained network. The method can improve the accuracy of the DDoS attack detection result, and meanwhile, the cut trained network can directly carry out high-efficiency and accurate DDoS attack detection on time sequence data in a time domain.

title_en: Data transmission method, data receiving method, device and system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of data transmission technologies, and in particular, to a data transmission method, a data receiving method, a device, and a system. The data transmission method is applied to host equipment and comprises the steps of determining clock frequency, wherein the clock frequency comprises a first frequency, a second frequency lower than the first frequency or/and a third frequency higher than the first frequency, and transmitting a composite signal through the change trend of the clock frequency and a transmission period, wherein the composite signal comprises a clock signal and a characteristic signal, and the clock signal and the characteristic signal are synchronously transmitted. The invention fuses the characteristic signals on the clock signals, reduces the number of data transmission interfaces in a compound mode, and improves the transmission efficiency.

title_en: Data blood edge analysis method, device, terminal equipment and computer program product
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of artificial intelligence and provides a data blood-edge analysis method, a device, terminal equipment and a computer program product, which comprise the steps of acquiring a statement to be queried and determining metadata information corresponding to the statement to be queried; the method comprises the steps of constructing graph structure data based on sentences to be queried and metadata information, wherein the graph structure data comprises a plurality of nodes and a plurality of edges, obtaining data blood edge analysis results corresponding to the sentences to be queried based on the graph structure data and a graph attention network, and the graph attention network comprises a multi-head attention layer used for capturing different types of node relations. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device for analyzing the blood edges of the image structure data based on the multi-head attention layer have the advantages that the blood edges of the image structure data corresponding to the statement to be queried are analyzed by combining the attention network of the image, accuracy and fine granularity of the blood edges of the data are improved, meanwhile, the multi-head attention layer can capture different types of node relations, so that the node relations can be understood more comprehensively and abundantly, and the accuracy of the blood edges of the data is improved.

title_en: Magnetic suspension bearing control system and magnetic suspension bearing system based on public follow current topology
