abstract_en: The invention discloses a magnetic bearing control system and a magnetic bearing system based on a common follow current topology, which belong to the field of magnetic bearing control and comprise a plurality of groups of H-bridges which are connected with windings in a one-to-one correspondence manner, a current sensor and a control module which are arranged on the side of a direct current bus, wherein the upper end and the lower end of each bridge arm are respectively connected with the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the direct current bus, the upper end or the lower end of a front bridge arm and the lower end of a rear bridge arm in the same group of H-bridges are respectively connected with the two ends of the current sensor, the control module is used for sequentially selecting one winding as a target winding in each switching period in turn, controlling the upper pipe of the front bridge arm connected with the target winding to be conducted, the lower pipe of the rear bridge arm to be turned off, controlling the upper pipe of the front bridge arm connected with the other windings to be conducted, measuring the current of the target winding, predicting the current of the other windings through a current model prediction control algorithm, generating PWM waves of each switching pipe, and applying the PWM waves to the corresponding switching pipes. The invention can improve the influence of winding current ripple on the current sampling value.

title_en: Method, device and equipment for safely starting digital certificate updating
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device and equipment for updating a safe starting digital certificate, which relate to the technical field of system safe starting and are applied to a host, and comprise the steps of loading a locally stored original digital certificate through a basic input and output system when the host triggers safe starting operation, and accessing a shared memory of a management controller through a bus link to determine whether a new digital certificate exists in the shared memory; if there is new digital certificate in the shared memory, the new digital certificate is read from the shared memory by the basic input and output system, and the original digital certificate stored locally is updated based on the new digital certificate, so as to execute the safe starting operation of the host according to the updated digital certificate. Therefore, the basic input and output system can access the preset shared memory in the management controller to read the new digital certificate, and the manual labor and the complicated operation can be reduced.

title_en: Novel auxiliary bidding review system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of information data processing, and provides a novel auxiliary bidding review system, which comprises a server side, a bidding party client side and a background control side, wherein the automatic processing and review of bidding documents are realized through modules of bidding material acquisition, classification, matching, inspection, review and the like, the system can receive bidding materials in various formats, conduct image recognition and classification, match project demand information, simulate compliance of the bidding materials, feed back correction results, and finally, the system carries out review on the corrected bidding materials.

title_en: Data interaction method, device, equipment and storage medium of multi-layer stacked memory
abstract_en: The invention relates to a data interaction method, device, equipment and storage medium of a multi-layer stacked memory, which comprises the following steps of mapping storage positions of target transmission data based on an access frequency clustering result to obtain a multi-layer storage allocation policy table, carrying out interaction path planning on the target transmission data based on the multi-layer storage allocation policy table to obtain an optimal interaction path planning, carrying out hierarchical migration scheduling on the target transmission data based on the optimal interaction path planning to obtain a data migration execution queue, and carrying out parallel data transmission on the data migration execution queue through an asynchronous pipeline transmission mechanism.

title_en: Interactive content generation method and device, electronic equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a method, a device, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a program product for generating interactive content. The method comprises the steps of obtaining target business content information, wherein the target business content information is associated with a target user, extracting first business keywords based on the target business content information to obtain a first business keyword set, and generating business interaction content corresponding to the target user according to the first business keyword set and preset interaction content attribute information. By utilizing the technical scheme, the embodiment of the disclosure can enrich the generation modes of knowledge interaction content in an enterprise.

title_en: Important place safe electricity protection method based on topological structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an important place safe electricity protection method based on a topological structure, which comprises the following steps of detecting position information in an electricity protection instruction, establishing an electricity protection path according to the position information in the electricity protection instruction, topologically protecting the electricity protection path and modeling by combining point cloud data of a venue to obtain an electricity protection path model, judging whether electricity protection equipment is in the electricity protection path model, if yes, adding the electricity protection equipment into an electricity protection equipment group, conducting electricity protection according to the electricity protection equipment group when the electricity protection equipment group is built, conducting topology calculation on the electricity protection range according to the current topological relation and the real-time state, obtaining a safety index corresponding to the electricity protection range, evaluating each electricity protection equipment according to the safety index, establishing the electricity protection path by combining the topological path, evaluating the state of the electricity protection equipment, improving the electricity protection reliability, and realizing accurate acquisition of the electricity protection effect and efficient control on the electricity protection equipment.

title_en: Boundary gateway protocol anomaly detection method and device and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of border gateway protocol anomaly detection, and discloses a border gateway protocol anomaly detection method, a border gateway protocol anomaly detection device and computer equipment, wherein BGP data to be detected are obtained, are each type of data in various BGP data, and are obtained by preprocessing; the method and the device for detecting the BGP data anomaly comprise the steps of extracting BGP data to be detected from BGP data to be detected, fusing the BGP data to be detected of various BGP data, inputting the BGP data to be detected after fusion into a BGP time convolution network for detection to obtain the BGP data anomaly detection result to be detected, and finally, the method and the device for detecting the BGP data anomaly detection can process long-time sequence characteristics of the BGP data and capture long-term dependency relationship of the BGP data, so that accuracy of BGP data anomaly detection is improved.

title_en: Method for constructing resin-based material curing dynamics model based on Fourier infrared spectrum
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a resin-based material curing dynamics model based on Fourier infrared spectrum, which comprises the steps of 1, constructing a resin-based material curing dynamics model containing unknown parameters by utilizing an autocatalysis reaction dynamics model, 2, carrying out curing tests of different curing times at different curing temperatures to obtain resin-based material samples, 3, carrying out Fourier infrared spectrum test on each resin-based material sample, and 4, determining the resin-based material curing dynamics model. According to the invention, the characteristic peak areas participating in the reaction are calculated by testing the Fourier infrared spectrograms of the resin samples under different curing temperatures and times to obtain the curing degree data of the resin material, and the curing dynamics model of the resin material is constructed according to the curing degree and the curing time, namely the curing speed data. The method can reflect the solidification dynamics performance of the resin material on the macroscopic scale in bridge deck pavement, and can better guide the construction of the resin-based bridge deck pavement material.

title_en: Auditing personalized intelligent power grid data privacy protection method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an auditable personalized smart power grid data privacy protection method which comprises the steps that a gateway sends security parameters to a blockchain, a power grid company sets privacy budget and acceptable maximum utility loss of each type of users according to the security parameters issued by the gateway, the blockchain and the power grid company generate the same Laplacian random number list, the gateway randomly selects noise from the mixed Laplacian random number list based on a verifiable shuffling protocol and adds the noise to user power consumption data to obtain noisy user power consumption data, the noisy user power consumption data and related data are uploaded to the blockchain, the blockchain runs a certification protocol corresponding to the verifiable shuffling protocol to verify the related data uploaded by the gateway, the verification is recorded by the blockchain and sent to the power grid company, and the power grid company decrypts the encrypted user power consumption data by utilizing homomorphic encryption attributes to obtain noisy user power consumption data.

title_en: UAV and USV network resource allocation system and method based on improved whale algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for allocating UAV and USV network resources based on an improved whale algorithm, wherein a constraint condition construction module is used for taking an association coefficient between USVs and the UAVs, service duration of the UAVs for providing services for the UAVs and processor calculation frequency of the USVs as constraint conditions; the resource allocation module is used for carrying out iterative solution on the optimization problem by utilizing an improved whale algorithm to obtain resource allocation between the UAV and the USV network. The invention combines the traditional whale optimization algorithm with the novel coding mode and the cross mutation operation, solves the problems of poor feasible solution performance, poor convergence and high time complexity in the existing resource allocation, and meets the QoS requirement in intensive tasks.

title_en: Storage space management method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: A storage space management method and electronic equipment relate to the technical field of computers. And the electronic equipment determines the predicted life index of the data block according to the life cycle index of the file to which the file system data block belongs. And then, the electronic equipment manages the storage space of the file system according to the predicted life index of the data block. The predicted lifetime indicator is used to indicate the expected number of data blocks allocated by the file system between writing to a failure. The lifecycle indicator of a file is used to indicate the expected number of data blocks that the file system allocates between creation and deletion of the file. The electronic device can more efficiently manage the storage space by predicting the service life of the data block and knowing the predicted failure time of the data block in advance, thereby reducing the management load of the storage space.

title_en: Processing method, device, program product and storage medium for geographic language model
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a processing method, equipment, a program product and a storage medium of a geographic language model, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining geographic information of points of interest (POI), areas (AOI) and roads (Road) in a preset geographic range, constructing data representation of each POI according to the geographic information of each geographic entity, wherein the data representation of the POI comprises address description text, longitude and latitude and associated information for describing AOI and/or Road with an associated relation with the POI, the associated relation comprises an included relation for representing that the AOI comprises the POI and an adjacent relation for representing that the AOI is adjacent to the POI or the Road is adjacent to the POI, and training the preset geographic language model based on the data representation of each POI.

title_en: Dynamic non-waiting displacement running water workshop generation type scheduling method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of production scheduling, in particular to a generation type scheduling method of a dynamic non-waiting replacement flow shop, which comprises the steps of acquiring job information of the dynamic non-waiting replacement flow shop, inputting the job information into a preset encoding network to extract at least one job feature of each job of the dynamic non-waiting replacement flow shop so as to generate a corresponding job state according to the at least one job feature, decoding the job state by utilizing a preset decoding network, and calculating the selection probability distribution of each job by combining the historical scheduling information of each job so as to generate a scheduling decision of each job at the current moment according to the selection probability distribution. The application can design the coding and decoding network based on the attention mechanism based on the characteristic of no waiting replacement flow shop, and realize the efficient feature extraction and representation of the operation information so as to combine the history state and the global information to perform efficient dynamic decision adjustment and realize the quick response to the arriving order.

title_en: Voice recognition model training method and device, and voice recognition method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a voice recognition model training method and device, a voice recognition method and device, wherein the voice recognition model training method comprises the steps of obtaining preference audio data and non-preference audio data associated with an initial voice recognition model, selecting a network layer to be trimmed in the initial voice recognition model, configuring a low-rank adapter for a weight matrix of the network layer to be trimmed, obtaining an intermediate voice recognition model according to a configuration result, predicting the preference audio data and the non-preference audio data by using the intermediate voice recognition model to perform voice recognition, calculating a target loss value according to a voice recognition result, and updating parameters associated with the low-rank adapter in the network layer to be trimmed based on the target loss value until a target voice recognition model meeting training stop conditions is obtained.

title_en: Anti-cracking method, electronic device, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The application discloses an anti-cracking method, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a program product, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a first byte sequence of a program to be executed, wherein the program to be executed is executed by a target operating system, and the first byte sequence is byte information of a target position of the program to be executed; and determining whether the program to be executed is a target program to be decrypted or not based on the first byte sequence and the target byte sequence, wherein the target program to be decrypted comprises an encrypted code segment. The application identifies the program to be protected through byte sequence comparison, pertinently implements encryption and decryption, avoids operating all programs, optimizes the utilization of system resources, ensures the safety of key parts, and maintains the performance and stability of the system. And the operating system is in a forbidden call state during decryption, interference and attack are prevented, the virtual memory is utilized for decryption and mapping operation, and the security and the integrity of the decryption process are improved.

title_en: Optimization method based on external platform intelligent ISO (International organization for terminal) graph
abstract_en: The invention relates to an optimization method based on an intelligent ISO map of an external platform, which comprises the following steps of S1, importing a model and model type judgment, importing the model and judging whether the model is a two-dimensional model or a three-dimensional model, S2, verifying the three-dimensional model, S3, splitting model data, splitting the verified three-dimensional model, S4, generating a pipeline assembly file, S5, processing the generated PCF file through an ISO# algorithm, S6, generating an ISO map of a pipeline according to data processed by the ISO# algorithm, S7, generating a unique reference number and coordinates, establishing a data version management mechanism, S9, automatically updating two-dimensional model data and the ISO map when the three-dimensional model is modified, S10, auditing and publishing, and auditing the generated ISO map. By efficiently processing the two-dimensional model data in the engineering project, the automatic generation of the ISO drawing is realized, and the method is widely applied to the fields of CAD design and the like, and the working efficiency and the drawing accuracy are improved.

title_en: Large model distillation method and system for low-resource short text classification
abstract_en: The invention provides a large model distillation method and a system for low-resource short text classification. The method comprises the steps of utilizing the same large model, establishing a semantic syntax enhancement thinking chain and a domain knowledge thinking chain according to a multi-step prompt method, utilizing the semantic syntax enhancement thinking chain to extract key concepts in a short text, searching common knowledge of the short text through the key concepts, outputting improved text after integrating the semantic and syntactic reasoning knowledge according to the common knowledge, utilizing the domain knowledge thinking chain to extract basic concepts in the short text, generating domain knowledge through the basic concepts, and training the small model through a short text classification task, a semantic and syntactic reasoning task output by taking the improved text as a model and a domain knowledge extraction task output by taking the domain knowledge as a model. The scheme provided by the invention can save hardware resources, is suitable for more application scenes, improves classification accuracy, supports reasoning without retraining, and improves reasoning and emerging capacity of a thinking chain design.

title_en: Data copying method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a data copying method, a data copying device and electronic equipment. The embodiment of the application correspondingly creates a plurality of copy LUNs for the source LUNs for copying data in the storage space corresponding to the subsequent source LUNs, and can be seen that the embodiment adopts a one-to-many copy scheme, namely a copy scheme of one source LUN corresponding to a plurality of copy LUNs, wherein the plurality of copy LUNs correspondingly store the historical data of the source LUNs at a plurality of historical moments, so that the historical data of a plurality of historical moments can be retrieved through the plurality of copy LUNs when the source LUNs are in disaster, the usability of the data is improved, and when one or a plurality of copy LUNs corresponding to the source LUNs are in disaster, the copy LUNs except the copy LUNs corresponding to the source LUNs except the copy LUNs corresponding to the disaster are used for carrying out data recovery, thereby avoiding the situation that the data is thoroughly lost due to the fact that the copy LUNs are also in the disaster in the one-to-one copy scheme, and further improving the reliability of data recovery.

title_en: Session management method, system, electronic device, storage medium, and program product
abstract_en: The invention provides a dialogue management method, a dialogue management system, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a program product, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out intention recognition on input text of a user to obtain an intention recognition result; the method comprises the steps of carrying out matching in an intention list with use permission of a user based on an intention recognition result, calling a first target tool associated with the intention recognition result to execute corresponding service and return a service execution result if the matching is successful, correcting the intention recognition result if the matching is failed, calling a second target tool associated with the corrected intention recognition result to execute corresponding service and return the service execution result. According to the dialogue management method provided by the invention, an intention correction mechanism is introduced, so that the false recognition rate caused by multiple intentions and similar intentions is effectively reduced, and meanwhile, the accuracy of executing the business process is improved, thereby improving the overall reliability and user experience of the system and ensuring the efficient business execution in a complex environment.

title_en: Two-stage characteristic construction and link prediction method and device based on GCN
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage feature construction and link prediction method and device based on GCN, which are characterized in that a life cycle of a preset technical field in multi-source data is acquired, an LDA model, a technical subject co-occurrence network and a prediction model are built, a technical opportunity multi-dimensional evaluation system is built by combining the prediction model, market demand, technical competitiveness and policy matching degree, a technical innovation direction of the technical opportunity multi-dimensional evaluation system is combined with sensitivity analysis and research judgment, a technical opportunity identification method of multi-dimensional index evaluation and sensitivity analysis is combined, new technical opportunities possibly occurring in the future can be predicted efficiently and accurately, more comprehensive information coverage is provided for the technical subject co-occurrence network, the problems of co-occurrence relation redundancy, key relation screening and the like are avoided, and the prediction model realizes the multi-dimensional attribute embedding and model identification capability enhancement of nodes by integrating the characteristics of network semantic association and the characteristics of the topological structure, and the precision processing of similarity indexes and machine learning are combined, so that the accuracy and the robustness of the model are effectively improved.

title_en: Method for identifying authenticity of semen cassiae based on hyperspectral imaging
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of detection and identification, in particular to a cassia seed authenticity identification method based on hyperspectral imaging, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting hyperspectral images of a cassia seed sample by using hyperspectral imaging equipment, S2, correcting spectral drift of the hyperspectral images by using a spectral baseline correction method, S3, dividing the corrected spectral images, distinguishing a target area and a background area of the cassia seed sample, extracting an effective spectral area of the cassia seed sample by combining a division result, S4, separating key spectral characteristics related to chemical components of the cassia seed from redundant characteristics influenced by interference, S5, training an authenticity identification model based on LGBM algorithm, and S6, inputting the key spectral characteristics of the to-be-detected cassia seed sample into the authenticity identification model to output an authenticity identification result. According to the invention, interference factors such as ambient light change, equipment deviation and surface impurities are effectively removed, so that high-quality input data is provided for true and false identification.

title_en: Key frame determination method, key frame determination device, electronic device, medium and program product
abstract_en: The application provides a key frame determining method, a key frame determining device, electronic equipment, a medium and a program product, which can be used in the field of image processing; the method comprises the steps of determining a target event area of a first image of a current frame in a video, obtaining an event fragment of the target event area in the video, obtaining image characteristics and audio characteristics of the event fragment, reasoning the event fragment according to the image characteristics and the audio characteristics to determine a key frame in the video, and detecting risks of images corresponding to the key frame. In the application, the image area representing the end of the behavior event is inferred through the images and the audio of the event fragment, the inference on the whole image is not needed, the time length of risk auditing of the image is reduced, namely, under the condition of smaller resource expenditure, the key frame analysis is performed by combining the two modes of video and audio, the capturing accuracy and the recall rate of the key frame are obviously improved, and the video wind control effect is obviously improved.

title_en: Cow body type and appearance judging method based on key point detection and related equipment
abstract_en: A dairy cow body type and appearance judging method and related equipment based on key point detection relate to the technical field of image processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining first images of cows to be tested, wherein each first image comprises at least two continuous frames of images, inputting each first image into an appearance feature detection model, obtaining key points output by the appearance feature detection model, correcting the key points in each first image based on the association relation between the key points in at least two continuous frames of each first image to obtain target key points, and determining the body type appearance of the cows to be tested based on the pixel point distances between the target key points, wherein the appearance feature detection model is obtained by training sample cow images and sample labels, and the sample labels are pixel points corresponding to the key points representing the body type appearance features of the cows in the sample cow images. By implementing the technical scheme provided by the application, the problem of inaccurate positioning of key points caused by posture change of the dairy cows can be effectively solved, so that the accuracy of assessing the body type and appearance of the dairy cows is improved.

title_en: Server
abstract_en: The application discloses a server which comprises a Central Processing Unit (CPU), a Baseboard Management Controller (BMC), a hot plug processing component and an exchange chip, wherein the CPU is connected with the BMC and used for transmitting a hot plug command to the BMC, the BMC is connected with the hot plug processing component and used for transmitting a corresponding control command to the hot plug processing component after receiving the hot plug command, and the hot plug processing component is used for converting the control command corresponding to the hot plug command into a corresponding GPIO signal and outputting the GPIO signal so as to control equipment to be hot plugged to complete a corresponding hot plug flow. In the application, the CPU-BMC-hot plug processing component forms an additional channel, and the channel of the hot plug processing component is not completely managed by the CPU, so that the notification type hot plug of the PCIe device hung under the exchange chip can be realized under the condition that the PCIe device hung under the exchange chip connected with the CPU comprises the hot plug-able device and the non-hot plug-able device.

title_en: Corrosion simulation analysis method for aircraft aluminum alloy connection structure
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of corrosion analysis of an aircraft aluminum alloy connection structure, and particularly relates to a simulation analysis method of corrosion of the aircraft aluminum alloy connection structure, comprising the following steps of firstly, establishing a simulation model of the self-corrosion problem of an aircraft aluminum alloy metal material; the method comprises the steps of carrying out multi-working-condition corrosion simulation analysis on an aircraft aluminum alloy connecting structure by using a simulation model of the self-corrosion problem of the aircraft aluminum alloy metal material, carrying out multi-working-condition simulation on the simulation result, analyzing and correcting the simulation model, establishing an aircraft aluminum alloy connecting structure corrosion simulation model based on the simulation model of the self-corrosion problem of the aircraft aluminum alloy metal material, and carrying out multi-working-condition corrosion simulation analysis on the aircraft aluminum alloy connecting structure by using the aircraft aluminum alloy connecting structure corrosion simulation model.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for detecting apparent viscosity of material
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for detecting apparent viscosity of materials, which firstly determine a target apparent viscosity detection model corresponding to the current stirring equipment, training samples of the model were constructed based on test data collected during the process of testing the stirring device to stir the newtonian fluid material, and the test stirring device had the same device parameters as the current stirring device. And then obtaining the detection stirring rotating speed and the detection stirring torque of the material to be detected in the current stirring equipment, wherein the material to be detected can be a Newtonian fluid material or a non-Newtonian fluid material. And finally, inputting the detected stirring rotating speed and the detected stirring torque into a target apparent viscosity detection model for reasoning to obtain the apparent viscosity of the material to be detected. The method does not need sampling, realizes in-situ online detection of the apparent viscosity of the material, and can reflect the overall apparent viscosity of the material in the stirring equipment in real time.

title_en: Convolutional neural network compiling method based on CPU/NPU cooperative computing
abstract_en: A convolution neural network compiling method based on CPU/NPU cooperative calculation comprises the steps of carrying out model quantization and compression on various CNN models under different network frameworks, exporting the CNN models in ONNX file format, completing ONNX file compiling process through fusion of ONNX-MLIR tool chains and NPU compilers, respectively generating task lists distributed to a CPU and the NPU, generating effective RISC-V instructions for the CPU tasks at a CPU end ONNX-MLIR, supporting efficient scheduling, and carrying out algorithm and hardware matching of the NPU tasks and efficient mapping of operators to an NPU platform at the NPU end by a customized NPU compiler. The invention solves the problem that CNN can not effectively run on a heterogeneous architecture (RISC-V CPU/NPU) by functional functions and optimizing core stages, and realizes remarkable improvement of computing performance.

title_en: Fusion model-based shear point prediction method and apparatus
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of ultrasonic equipment, and provides a shearing point prediction method and device based on a fusion model, wherein a first model with better prediction advance and a second model with better reliability are established through historical electric signal parameters, and the variable parameters of a real-time electric signal of an ultrasonic knife generator are obtained under the condition that an object to be cut is sheared by the ultrasonic knife; and based on the predicted demand of operators, according to the predicted demand, the first output and the second output, a predicted result of the cutting point moment is obtained, a cutting point predicted result meeting the demand is given, and the situation that the operators observe that the cut object is cut, so that the cutter head of the ultrasonic cutter generates higher temperature and the service life of the ultrasonic cutter is reduced is avoided.

title_en: Washing and sweeping vehicle cleaning control method based on multi-mode sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cleaning control method of a cleaning and sweeping vehicle based on multi-mode sensing, which comprises the steps of obtaining road surface pollutant image data of different angles, fusing the road surface pollutant image data of different angles to obtain a first fused image, identifying the first pollutant type and the pollution degree thereof through the first fused image, obtaining road surface pollutant smell data, fusing the first fused image and the road surface pollutant smell data according to the first pollutant type to obtain fused data characteristics, judging the second pollutant type and the pollution degree thereof through the fused data characteristics, and generating a cleaning strategy corresponding to the pollutant type according to the first pollutant type and the second pollutant type.

title_en: Online answer judgment method and online answer system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an online answer judgment method and an online answer system, and belongs to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of carrying out initialization setting on each node thread, carrying out one-time setting condition judgment in response to receiving one-time answer operation of a user, generating a time stamp based on the current node thread, the number of times of the current node thread and a global sequence number if the number of times of the current node thread counter is smaller than the preset time stamp distribution number, carrying out self-increment on the number of times of the current node thread counter once, updating the node thread and the global sequence number once if the number of times of the current node thread counter is larger than or equal to the preset time stamp distribution number of times, and generating the time stamp through the updated node thread. Through the method, the uniqueness and the sequence of the time stamp can be guaranteed, and then the uniqueness and the sequence of the time stamp are utilized to determine the sequential processing of the judging operation, so that the method is applicable to high concurrency scenes.

title_en: Transparent wave absorber super-surface structure and design method thereof
abstract_en: The transparent wave absorber super-surface structure and the design method thereof solve the problems that the transparent wave absorber super-surface structure is easy to imitate and has lower design freedom, and belong to the field of transparent wave absorber design. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a binary coding matrix, selecting a fold line outline of 0 in the coding matrix to obtain a plurality of fold line outlines, arranging the fold line outlines according to the sequence from the large to the small of the fold line outline length, selecting the first M fold line outlines, carrying out size normalization processing on the first M fold line outlines to obtain a unit pattern, scaling the unit pattern according to the size required to be designed by the super-surface pattern, generating the transparent wave absorber super-surface pattern by taking the scaled unit pattern as a reference, and generating the super-surface structure according to the transparent wave absorber super-surface pattern. The invention adopts the complex speckle pattern structure to design the super surface, so that the super surface structure is difficult to effectively measure and evaluate the structural dimension performance, and the possibility of imitation of the design is reduced.

title_en: Dual-network redundancy database based read-write method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of system software communication and discloses a dual-network redundancy database-based read-write method. The method comprises the steps of S100, configuring a first database connection pool and a second database connection pool when loading is carried out for the first time, wherein the first database connection pool and the second database connection pool are respectively arranged in an accessible first address and an accessible second address, S102, acquiring a database client from the database connection pool corresponding to the first address, S104, judging whether the acquisition is successful, and turning to S106 if the acquisition is successful, otherwise turning to S110, returning to the database client, S108, carrying out reading and/or writing operation on a database server by utilizing the returned database client, S110, counting the exchange times of the first database connection pool and the second database connection pool, S112, judging whether the current count value exceeds the maximum time, prompting failure of acquiring the database client if the current count value exceeds the maximum time, and otherwise, returning to S102. Thus, high-reliability reading and writing of the database can be realized.

title_en: Method and device for generating three-dimensional layout based on planar layout and electronic equipment
abstract_en: A method and device for generating a three-dimensional layout based on a planar layout and electronic equipment. The method for generating the three-dimensional layout based on the plane layout comprises the steps of inputting or collecting space information of a region to be repaired to generate a plane diagram of the region to be repaired, performing functional division on the region to be repaired to form at least one functional region in response to operation of a user, adding at least one assembly type structure component in the region to be repaired in response to operation of the user, and automatically matching the region to be repaired to generate a corresponding assembly type three-dimensional decoration layout scheme based on the information collected in the steps and personalized selection information input by the user. The application can utilize the user to set the functional area by himself, and the space is divided in a self-defined way, thereby solving the technical problem that the planar step method in the prior art can not meet the personalized requirements of the user, and improving the planar arrangement efficiency.

title_en: Printing still picture fine observation system with real-time self-checking function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing, in particular to a printing still picture fine observation system with a real-time self-checking function. The device comprises an image acquisition module, a flaw screening module, a flaw determination module and a flaw determination module, wherein the image acquisition module is used for acquiring a printed product image in a printing process, the flaw screening module is used for carrying out local segmentation on the printed product image, carrying out repeated downsampling iteration on different local areas, analyzing local information loss of each local area when downsampling iteration is carried out each time, screening out a high printing information area, screening out a printing flaw area from the high printing information area according to edge lines and area chromatic aberration in the high printing information area, and the flaw determination module is used for comparing the printing flaw area with a printing template and identifying printing flaws in the printing flaw area. The invention reduces the calculated amount in the flaw identification process and improves the precision of flaw identification.

title_en: Substation inspection image recognition method and system based on image processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a substation inspection image recognition method and system based on image processing, and relates to the technical field of substation inspection, wherein the method comprises the steps of remotely acquiring inspection images of all equipment in a substation, and marking acquisition places and acquisition time of the inspection images; the method comprises the steps of identifying equipment types in each inspection image, grouping inspection images with different equipment types according to the acquisition positions and the acquisition time of the images, sequentially identifying whether defective equipment exists in each group by adopting a restriction domain comparison identification algorithm, if not, neglecting, entering the next processing step, diagnosing the identified defects based on a defect database, generating inspection reports according to diagnosis results and forwarding the inspection reports to operation and maintenance personnel, and periodically integrating the operation and maintenance reports returned by the operation and maintenance personnel into the defect database to ensure the accuracy of the diagnosis results. The limit domain comparison and identification algorithm of the invention greatly reduces the influence factors brought by the acquisition time and the acquisition place.

title_en: Power distribution system source load scene generation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution system source load scene generation method. The method comprises the steps of calculating the correlation between new energy output and load according to the preprocessed new energy output historical data and load historical data of the power distribution system, generating an expansion adjacency matrix, generating an countermeasure network model based on a pre-constructed message transmission neural network model and a time sequence, determining a power distribution system source load scene generation model, training the power distribution system source load scene generation model by utilizing the new energy output historical data, the load historical data and the expansion adjacency matrix, and generating a source load scene according to the trained power distribution system source load scene generation model. The invention not only can adapt to the change of the topological structure caused by the network reconstruction of the power distribution system, but also can effectively capture the source load characteristics of the network after the reconstruction, thereby enhancing the flexibility and the adaptability of the model. And the space-time correlation between the output of the new energy and the load can be simulated more accurately, and the precision of generating the power distribution system source load scene is improved.

title_en: Liquid cooling heat dissipation device and control method
abstract_en: The application discloses a liquid cooling heat dissipation device and a control method, which relate to the technical field of liquid cooling heat dissipation, wherein the liquid cooling heat dissipation device comprises a heat shield, a heat conducting plate, a cooling structure and a control system; the cooling structure is correspondingly provided with a plurality of spraying areas, each heat conduction area can be at least matched with one spraying area, each heat conduction area is correspondingly provided with a temperature detection mechanism, the temperature data of each heat conduction area can be monitored in real time, and the corresponding spraying areas are dynamically adjusted and controlled to spray a proper amount of cooling liquid according to the temperature data of each heat conduction area by the aid of the control system, so that the technical problems that the heat distribution in the server is uneven and the overall efficiency of the cooling system is affected can be solved, the accurate and efficient cooling of the heat conduction areas is realized, the accurate heat dissipation is realized according to the heat difference generated at different positions of a piece to be cooled, and the technical effect of heat dissipation uniformity is ensured.

title_en: Connection method and device applied to connection of cross metal in simulated layout
abstract_en: The invention discloses a connection method and a device for connecting crossed metals in a simulated layout, which relate to the technical field of layout design, wherein the method comprises the steps of traversing all metal wire names required to be connected to obtain a metal wire name set, classifying to obtain an initial vertical wire set and an initial horizontal wire set, searching metal wires in the initial vertical wire set and the initial horizontal wire set according to target names to obtain metal wire pairs, obtaining the vertical wire set and the horizontal wire set according to all the metal wire pairs, and determining metal wire cross connection points in the target vertical wire set and the target horizontal wire set through a preset algorithm after preset sequencing of the vertical wire set and the horizontal wire set. The method has the advantages that the metal wire name set is obtained, the non-repetition of the name of the metal wire is ensured, the repeated processing of the same metal wire is avoided, the metal wires in the initial wire set are searched according to the target name, and then the cross connection points of the target vertical wire set and the target horizontal wire set are determined through traversing, so that the comprehensiveness and the accuracy of the result are ensured, and the efficiency of layout design is improved.

title_en: B-scan image alignment method and system in optical coherence layer imaging
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of optical coherence layer imaging. A B-scan image alignment method and system in optical coherence layer imaging are provided, a plurality of B-scan images with the same size at the same position are obtained, the total gray value of each pixel point is calculated to obtain a gray value image, a first pixel point of the gray value image is taken as the center, the number of pixels occupied by a blood vessel on the gray value image is taken as the diameter, a circular area is defined, two B-scan images are selected in the circular area to perform cross correlation analysis, the image position is moved, the position with the largest cross correlation coefficient is determined to finish alignment, the rest B-scan images are sequentially aligned to obtain an alignment scheme, a plurality of other pixel points of the gray value image are taken as the center to obtain a plurality of alignment schemes, and the optimal alignment scheme is selected according to the expected cross correlation coefficient, the expected coincidence degree and the key point matching rate.

title_en: Short-term precipitation prediction method and system for generating countermeasure network based on self-attention ConvLSTM
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for forecasting short-term precipitation based on self-attention ConvLSTM to generate an countermeasure network, and belongs to the technical field of weather forecast. The method combines a self-attention mechanism and ConvLSTM networks, improves the precision and timeliness of precipitation prediction through multi-scale feature fusion, adopts a self-attention memory module on a model structure, captures long-range dependence in a space-time sequence through enhancing the relevance among input features, introduces a generated countermeasure network frame, further optimizes the generation effect of the model through a countermeasure training mode, adopts a WGAN-GP algorithm, and utilizes a gradient penalty term constraint discriminator to keep a stable training process in order to solve the problem of mode collapse in training. The method can be effectively applied to the fields of weather forecast and the like, and provides more accurate and real-time forecast support for weather disaster early warning.

title_en: DDPM-based water chilling unit fault monitoring method apparatus and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a DDPM-based water chilling unit fault monitoring method, equipment and medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out data standard processing on running data of the water chilling unit in different states to obtain one-dimensional time sequence data; the method comprises the steps of carrying out continuous wavelet transformation on one-dimensional time sequence data to obtain a two-dimensional time frequency diagram, inputting the two-dimensional time frequency diagram into a denoising diffusion probability model, introducing noise into the two-dimensional time frequency diagram to obtain a noise coverage diagram, carrying out noise prediction on the noise coverage diagram, carrying out inverse denoising on the noise coverage diagram according to predicted noise to obtain a data enhancement time frequency diagram, fusing the fault time frequency diagram with the two-dimensional time frequency diagram when the data enhancement time frequency diagram has a fault time frequency diagram to obtain an enhancement data set, and obtaining the fault type of a chiller according to the enhancement data set and a pre-constructed lightweight residual convolution neural network. The original data set is effectively expanded through the noise-removing and noise-removing process of the noise-removing diffusion probability model, and more abundant and effective data support is provided for fault diagnosis.

title_en: Analysis model of eddy current angular position sensor and high signal-to-noise ratio optimization design method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high signal-to-noise ratio optimization design method of an eddy current angular position sensor, and relates to the field of eddy current angular position sensors. Firstly, a three-dimensional equivalent magnetic circuit model of the sensor is established, the equivalent average magnetic density of the rotor eddy current on the surface of the receiving coil is defined, and the receiving coil induced voltage calculation formula represented by the equivalent average magnetic density is given according to Faraday electromagnetic induction law. The method comprises the steps of establishing a two-dimensional simplified electromagnetic model of an exciting coil-rotor, solving a rotor area and an air gap area magnetic field by utilizing a Fourier transform method, introducing an equivalent average magnetic density correction coefficient, calculating and correcting the equivalent average magnetic density of a rotor vortex according to air gap magnetic density distribution, obtaining a corrected receiving coil induced voltage calculation formula, further obtaining an analysis model from each design parameter to the receiving coil induced voltage, and determining an optimal design parameter combination which enables a sensor to output voltage signals under different size requirements and exciting conditions to obtain a higher signal-to-noise ratio by the analysis model.

title_en: Caregivers go out supervisory equipment based on infrared camera and degree of depth study
abstract_en: The invention provides a nursing staff outgoing supervision device based on an infrared camera and deep learning, which combines the infrared camera with a deep learning model by means of an embedded system, and can acquire and analyze infrared images in real time so as to judge whether the nursing staff is indoor or outdoor. The method comprises the following working procedures that after a carer checks cards and signs in, equipment is automatically started, an infrared camera acquires environment images at fixed intervals of once every 10 seconds, an embedded system performs preprocessing such as denoising and normalization on the images, a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model is utilized to extract features and classify the images, and finally analysis results (indoor/outdoor and confidence degrees), time stamps and equipment IDs are uploaded to a server through a wireless network. If the server receives the outdoor result or does not receive the data, the server automatically triggers a video sampling inspection mechanism, the AI customer service dials the video telephone to verify the condition, and the video content is stored for subsequent inspection.

title_en: Cladding part
abstract_en: A cladding feature is provided. The housing sidewall of the portable electronic device includes an elongated cladding material including titanium defining an outer surface of the portable electronic device, aluminum secured to the titanium and defining an inner surface of the portable electronic device, a recessed feature defined by the titanium and the aluminum, and a non-metallic portion coupled to the titanium and the aluminum at the recessed feature.

title_en: Bending member support, support positioning method and intelligent terminal
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bent component support, a support positioning method and an intelligent terminal, and relates to the field of building engineering technology, comprising a lower support plate, wherein a plurality of first positioning holes for bolts to pass through are formed in the lower support plate; the basin body is fixedly connected to the lower support plate, the basin body is internally provided with a mounting hole coaxially arranged with the basin body, the first adjusting component is arranged on the lower support plate and used for moving the position of the lower support plate, the second adjusting component is arranged on the basin body and used for moving the position of the upper support plate, the upper support plate is arranged on the cross module and used as a connecting piece connected with a bent component, the upper support plate is provided with a plurality of second positioning holes for bolts to pass through, and the positioning components are arranged in the first positioning holes and the second positioning holes and comprise distance measuring sensors. The invention has the advantages of simulating the manual alignment process through automatic machine learning, needing no manual operation, reducing the cost of manual operation and freeing a great deal of labor force.

title_en: Oil-water-slag separator separation effect monitoring and evaluating method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for monitoring and evaluating the separation effect of an oil-water-slag separator, which particularly relates to the field of wastewater treatment and is used for solving the problem of misjudgment of separation efficiency caused by grease solidification and flow field disorder in a cold start stage, and the method comprises the steps of precisely calculating thermodynamic state offset and flow field stability parameters by collecting axial temperature distribution and fluid flow speed fluctuation data of a separation cavity in real time, dynamically predicting semisolid distribution proportion of an oil layer and reconstruction delay time of a separation interface by combining a pre-training model and an interface recovery theory, the actual effective separation area is calculated by utilizing a dynamic compensation algorithm, the oil layer polymerization degree evolution curve is predicted, finally, the time for reaching the separation effect standard is intelligently judged according to the synchronization rate index of the double-parameter evaluation matrix, the water quality pollution caused by oil layer damage caused by early oil discharge or too late operation is avoided, meanwhile, the equipment operation strategy is optimized by accurately predicting the oil layer polymerization state, the invalid abrasion of mechanical parts is reduced, the service life of key parts is prolonged, and the stable water quality reaching the standard of effluent is ensured.

title_en: Patient multisource monitoring data fusion analysis system based on time sequence analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data fusion, in particular to a patient multi-source monitoring data fusion analysis system based on time sequence analysis, which comprises a processor and a memory, wherein the processor executes a computer program stored in the memory to realize the following steps of acquiring a target signal segment of a physical sign data signal, obtaining the decomposition layer number corresponding to the target signal segment according to a frequency domain signal corresponding to the target signal segment, and carrying out wavelet transformation on the corresponding target signal segment according to the decomposition layer number corresponding to the target signal segment to obtain all component signals corresponding to the target signal segment; and carrying out inverse transformation on component signals corresponding to the target signal segments of all the sign data signals in the sign data signal set to obtain a target fusion signal. The invention can improve the accuracy and reliability of signal decomposition, thereby improving the reference value and reliability of the fusion result.

title_en: Pile stack supporting structure-based safety stability simplified calculation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a pile stack supporting structure-based safety stability simplified calculation method, which comprises the steps of enabling guard piles to be equivalent to underground continuous walls and enabling each group of pile stacks to be equivalent to sheet piles, selecting one group of pile stacks to be a calculation object, taking the center of each group of pile stacks as a symmetrical center, respectively selecting half of a pile spacing to two sides to form a calculation unit, calculating inertia moment of the calculation unit, enabling the whole calculation unit to be equivalent to the underground continuous walls, calculating displacement and internal force of each pile stack according to the equivalent underground continuous walls, and judging safety stability of the pile stack supporting structure. The calculation method can perform sectional calculation on each group of pile stacks, optimize the number of rows of support piles and the number of support piles in each row of pile stacks while considering safety and stability, and can effectively reduce engineering cost, save construction time and improve construction efficiency.

title_en: Efficient reinforcement learning method for solving batch travel business problems in express package distribution
abstract_en: An efficient reinforcement learning method for batch traveler problem (TSP) solution in express package delivery. And a planning strategy is designed based on a graph structure environment model of the distribution task by constructing a planning information design and fusion module, non-parameterized planning information is fused into a neural solver decision process, so that path exploration is guided, and the exploration efficiency of batch tasks is improved. Designing a diversity group exploration module, adopting a shared encoder-multiple decoder architecture, endowing each decoder with a diversity decoding strategy, introducing a group collaborative baseline, storing a path scheme through a shared buffer area, calculating an average distribution distance as a baseline, promoting strategy diversity and improving the overall exploration capacity. The coarse-granularity three-point search method is implemented, the Gaussian noise disturbance is combined with the three-point search mechanism, the optimal planning information intensity interval is rapidly locked, the generalization capability of the nerve solver is optimized, and the shortest total distribution distance is achieved. The method provides an efficient solution for optimizing the express delivery path.

title_en: Minimum detection distance estimation method based on boundary of action range of underwater equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a minimum detection distance estimation method based on an action range boundary of underwater equipment, which relates to the technical field of underwater defense of water surface ships and comprises the steps of estimating minimum detection distances meeting the action range near-limit deployment condition of equipment under different shipside angles by the spatial position relationship among a ship, a target and equipment in the deployment process of the underwater equipment; and forming an estimated distance lookup table by the minimum detection distances under different bulwark conditions, and inquiring from the estimated distance lookup table according to the target detection bulwark to obtain the minimum detection distance corresponding to the target detection bulwark. According to the invention, the spatial position relationship among the ship, the target and the equipment in the underwater equipment laying process is utilized to estimate the target detection distance under the condition of meeting the near-range laying condition of the equipment, so that the quick judgment of the laying condition of the underwater equipment by a user is supported, and the use and capability assessment research of the underwater equipment is supported.

title_en: Multi-main-body collaborative power sharing double-layer nested game virtual power plant optimization method based on risk assessment and user satisfaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-subject collaborative power sharing double-layer nested game virtual power plant optimization method based on risk assessment and user satisfaction, and belongs to the field of virtual power plant optimization. And the power distribution network operator is used as an upper layer leader, interacts with the lower layer virtual power plant alliance body through price guidance, and realizes balanced management of risks and benefits. The virtual power plant alliance body members optimize internal power transactions by sharing idle resources and responding to price signals, and the flexibility and the response capability of the system are enhanced. And the user satisfaction quantitative index is increased in the model, the virtual power plant scheduling strategy is optimized, and the requirements of user comfort and service quality are met while the economic benefit is improved.

title_en: Explosion shock wave absorption structure and design method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an explosion shock wave-absorbing structure and a design method, which relate to the technical field of underground mine mining, the wave-absorbing structure comprises a core wave-absorbing rock and a roadway which is arranged by taking the core wave-absorbing rock as the center, the core wave-absorbing rock is a right triangle or an obtuse triangle, one side of a corner with the largest angle is an explosive reservoir connecting roadway, the explosion warehouse connecting lane is connected with the underground explosion warehouse, is used as an entering end of explosion shock waves of the explosion warehouse, two side sides and opposite sides connected with the corner with the largest angle of the core wave-blocking rock triangle structure are used as shock wave gas buffer lanes, and a safety roadway connecting lane is arranged at the midpoint of the opposite side of the corner with the largest angle. The blast wave generated by unexpected explosion of the underground explosive reservoir can be absorbed through the blast wave absorption structure engineering arrangement, so that the effect of protecting main roadways, personnel and equipment at the position of an output end is achieved.

title_en: Intelligent man-machine-ring cooperative management method for building robot
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent construction man-machine-ring collaborative management method of a construction robot, which belongs to the technical field of collaborative management of a computer system and the robot, and comprises the following steps that 1, a construction area is divided into a plurality of grid units, and an electronic tag containing preset parameters is established; the method comprises the steps of step 2 of collecting attribute data of each working unit, determining a collaborative health degree index of each working unit, marking the collaborative health degree index as a unit to be optimized when the collaborative health degree index is lower than a preset threshold value, step 3 of carrying out environment optimization on each unit to be optimized and then carrying out robot resource allocation, step 4 of obtaining the attribute data of each unit to be optimized after the robot resource allocation and determining a corresponding collaborative health degree index to carry out manual supplementary optimization, and step 5 of obtaining the attribute data of the unit to be optimized after the manual optimization to carry out effect confirmation until the preset requirement is met and storing preset type data into a case library. The invention effectively improves the working efficiency and the construction quality.

title_en: Dynamic summarization analysis method and system for ocean nitrogen and phosphorus pollutant data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic summarization analysis method and system for ocean nitrogen and phosphorus pollutant data, which comprises the steps of defining a three-dimensional coordinate system of ocean by PostGIS, constructing a rectangular space geometric model comprising a sea level direction and a direction vertical to the sea level direction, constructing a cube space geometric model, carrying out assignment storage on nitrogen and phosphorus pollutant concentration values in the cube space geometric model corresponding to the same time period according to horizontal position information, depth position information and nitrogen and phosphorus pollutant detection values of a nitrogen and phosphorus pollutant sensor, constructing a space slicing function, obtaining nitrogen and phosphorus pollutant concentration values in the cube space geometric model corresponding to the slicing position by using the space slicing function, carrying out principal component analysis and space autocorrelation analysis according to the nitrogen and phosphorus pollutant concentration values obtained by the space slicing function, and judging the similarity of the nitrogen and phosphorus pollutant types and concentration distribution of adjacent rectangular space geometric models according to the principal component analysis and the space autocorrelation analysis.

title_en: Informationized management method and system for monitoring electrical equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of informatization management, and particularly discloses an informatization management method and system for monitoring electrical equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical temperature, historical current, real-time current and real-time temperature of the electrical equipment, obtaining a temperature mutation rate and a current mutation rate of the electrical equipment, and preliminarily determining abnormal electrical equipment; acquiring a monitoring video with the radius of the abnormal electrical equipment as a preset distance, identifying a monitoring target, forming a motion track of the monitoring target, substituting the motion track into a behavior model to obtain an abnormal behavior detection result of the monitoring target, analyzing the monitoring target with the abnormal detection result, and determining a corresponding management strategy. The method comprises the steps of firstly preliminarily determining the abnormal electrical equipment, then checking the images around the abnormal electrical equipment to further determine the monitoring target, then judging the motion trail of the monitoring target, finding out the abnormal reason and carrying out targeted solution, realizing automatic monitoring of the electrical equipment, and being particularly suitable for outdoor power transmission lines.

title_en: Self-supervision abstract generation method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of natural language processing and discloses a self-supervision abstract generation method, a system, equipment and a medium. The method comprises the steps of generating a document-abstract pair by using a pre-training language model, screening the document-abstract pair through a self-supervision filter module to obtain a data set, performing multi-round self-supervision learning on the data set by using an expert iteration module, iterating a teacher model, distilling knowledge of the teacher model after iteration into a student model, introducing control attributes in training and reasoning stages through a controllable abstract generation module, and generating a customized abstract by using the student model according to the control attributes. By constructing a self-supervision information theory target and combining a small language model for distillation and training, the dependence on a large-scale pre-training model is reduced. The method can at least be used for solving the technical problem of low abstract generation quality.

title_en: Design method and system for piezoelectric energy harvesting structure under action of dynamic load
abstract_en: The invention relates to a design method and a system for a piezoelectric energy harvesting structure under the action of a dynamic load, wherein the method comprises the steps of S1, dispersing a design domain of the piezoelectric energy harvesting structure to be designed into N units, constructing a multiphase material interpolation model which represents the structural distribution of a base material, a piezoelectric material and an empty material in the piezoelectric energy harvesting structure for each unit, wherein the design domain is a two-dimensional cross section of the piezoelectric energy harvesting structure, S2, constructing a dynamic compliance objective function and an objective function of energy conversion efficiency of the piezoelectric energy harvesting structure under the action of the dynamic load, and constructing a piezoelectric energy harvesting structure topology model under the dynamic load based on the dynamic compliance objective function, the multiphase material interpolation model and the objective function of energy conversion efficiency, and S3, solving the piezoelectric energy harvesting structure topology model under the dynamic load to obtain the designed piezoelectric energy harvesting structure. The piezoelectric energy harvesting structure with higher energy harvesting efficiency can be designed under the action of power load.

title_en: Method for automatically annotating unstructured data based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for automatically annotating unstructured data based on a neural network, which relates to the technical field of unstructured data and comprises the steps of establishing a preprocessing annotation method based on an NLP technology and a CV technology, acquiring an annotation processing interval by using the preprocessing annotation method, establishing the neural network and establishing a deep annotation method, training the neural network to acquire a preferred neural network, and automatically annotating the unstructured data based on the preferred neural network.

title_en: Computing device
abstract_en: An apparatus may include a first housing including a pivot and a hinge recess including a stop surface, a second housing including a pivot and a hinge recess, a hinge link including a first portion coupled to the pivot of the first housing, a second portion coupled to the pivot of the second housing, and a recessed portion disposed between the first portion and the second portion, wherein the recessed portion includes a stop, and a stop disposed in the hinge recess of the first housing, wherein the stop forcibly biases the stop of the hinge link against the stop surface of the hinge recess of the first housing at a predefined open position when the second housing transitions between a closed position and a fully open position relative to the first housing to lock the hinge link in a locked link position.

title_en: Control information display method, server and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a control information display method, a server and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of data display. The method comprises the steps of determining the number of characters which can be displayed at most in a control according to the total length of the control, the blank length of the control, the text word size and the font width coefficient which are related to the control, translating a first target text of a first language type which is related to the control, and displaying the second target text in an area where the control is located according to the blank length of the control, the text word size and the font width coefficient which are related to the control, wherein the second target text can be translated to obtain a second target text of a second language type which has the same meaning as the first target text and has the number of characters which are smaller than or equal to the number of the characters which can be displayed at most, and the translation efficiency is high.

title_en: Problem positioning method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of data processing and discloses a problem positioning method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium, and the disclosure provides the problem positioning method, which comprises the steps of displaying a query page, including a first data query control for querying a first comparison test item of a reproducible problem and a second data query control for querying a second comparison test item of a non-reproducible problem; displaying a first item to be tested and a second item to be tested, which are obtained by randomly dividing the items to be tested, in a data area of a test page, displaying prompt information in an information area of the test page, wherein the prompt information is used for prompting selection of the items to be tested which can reproduce problems to divide the items to be tested, so as to position the abnormal items to be tested in the items to be tested, and the items to be tested which can reproduce the problems are the first item to be tested or the second item to be tested. The problem investigation difficulty can be simplified, and the working efficiency of problem positioning is improved.

title_en: Machine vision-based damage detection method for lining plate of vertical lifting skip
abstract_en: The invention discloses a machine vision-based vertical lifting skip lining plate damage detection method, which relates to the technical field of machine vision and comprises the steps of collecting multi-mode data streams, preprocessing, carrying out space-time alignment on the multi-mode data streams by utilizing time stamps synchronously, outputting a multi-mode data set, constructing a multi-scale feature pyramid, extracting local detail features and capturing global deformation features, dynamically distributing weights of different scale features by utilizing reinforcement learning, generating a dynamic multi-scale damage detection model through pre-training, transmitting an abnormal sample to a cloud when unrecorded damage types are detected according to a three-dimensional deformation report, and updating the dynamic multi-scale damage detection model through a federal learning frame. According to the invention, through a multi-mode space-time alignment and cross-mode attention fusion mechanism, the robustness and accuracy of damage detection in a complex mine environment are improved.

title_en: On-chain redemption method, device, equipment and medium for NFT digital asset
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of blockchains and provides an on-chain redemption method, device, equipment and medium of NFT digital assets, which can construct a redemption priority model according to a barrel model structure so as to clearly express redemption priorities and redemption proportions through the model, store the priority information of the redemption priority model by utilizing NFT metadata on the blockchains so as to ensure that the redemption sequence keeps consistent and verifiable in a full life cycle, detect the redemption funds to account event on the blockchains according to a preset period by utilizing intelligent contracts, and carry out on-chain redemption on the redemption funds to account according to the priority information by utilizing the redemption contracts in the intelligent contracts when detecting the redemption funds to account event on the blockchains, thereby realizing high-efficiency and safe on-chain redemption through the on-chain priority model.

title_en: Block chain security verification system and method for data element circulation
