abstract_en: The invention discloses a blockchain security verification system and a blockchain security verification method for data element circulation, relates to the technical field of information security and blockchains, and is used for solving the problems of behavior recognition accuracy reduction and authority control hysteresis under frequent data uplink, collecting user uplink frequency, delay and data items through a sliding time window, constructing a standardized matrix and clustering to judge risk states. And starting safety verification when the risk is high, combining the identity and the behavior characteristics of the user, constructing a feature vector based on the character hash embedded matching degree and the behavior risk level, adopting a random forest and a support vector machine to jointly judge the legitimacy, enabling a legal user to enter a reliability evaluation stage, calculating the deviation of the hash drift degree and the structural stability, comprehensively evaluating the reliability of data, and executing dynamic authority adjustment according to the interval of the data, so as to realize the safety and the data credibility control of the blockchain system.

title_en: Dynamic interaction system, interaction executing mechanism and intelligent device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic interaction system, an interaction executing mechanism and intelligent equipment, which belong to the technical field of dynamic interaction and comprise the following components: receiving user operation demands, collecting data through a basic platform pressure sensor to generate a matrix, analyzing pressure stability through a time window, only processing data in a stable period to extract the outline of the contact body, synchronously judging the placement state and generating a calibration signal. The extracted contour is matched with the standard contour feature points, and the geometric relationship and the elastic transformation are combined to generate accurate operation point coordinates and control instructions. The executing link drives the executing unit to operate the contact body, and the adjustable unit dynamically compensates the low pressure area and the supporting area to ensure uniform stress and stability. The interactive feedback module guides adjustment and visualization of the state through the multi-mode interface. The scheme improves the identification precision and the operation stability through dynamic pressure analysis, intelligent contour verification and the like, is suitable for medical and industrial scenes and provides a high-efficiency intelligent solution.

title_en: Power time sequence data prediction method and system based on size model cooperation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a power time sequence data prediction method and a power time sequence data prediction system based on size model cooperation, wherein the method comprises the steps of S1, acquiring and preprocessing a power time sequence data set for training, unifying data formats, S2, constructing a time sequence small model and a time sequence large model, performing pretraining, S3, extracting features from the time sequence large model through knowledge distillation, performing supervised learning on the small model according to the features, S4, collecting power time sequence data in real time, predicting through the time sequence small model, and calling the time sequence large model to perform global analysis if a prediction result deviates from a historical mode or exceeds a preset threshold value, so as to obtain and output a corrected prediction result. According to the invention, short-term prediction is optimized by small model distillation, and large model collaborative correction is triggered when the prediction deviates from a historical mode, so that a precise time sequence prediction result considering real-time performance and global rule is finally generated. The invention solves the defects of the existing model in the aspects of precision, coverage and practicability.

title_en: NVH (noise, vibration and harshness) improvement method after automobile collision based on structural analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a structural analysis-based NVH (noise, vibration and harshness) improvement method after an automobile collision, which relates to the technical field of automobile collision, and comprises the steps of acquiring automobile type information based on big data, setting a corresponding automobile NVH management library based on the automobile type information, acquiring automobile type information of a target automobile, matching corresponding member information affecting NVH based on the automobile NVH management library as target automobile member information, acquiring a collision position of the target automobile, acquiring current member information of the collision position of the target automobile, establishing a corresponding relation with the current member information based on local member information to obtain member distinguishing information, and adjusting the current member information based on the distinguishing information to improve NVH performance. According to the invention, the NVH of the automobile after collision is better improved by comparing and referencing the components of the automobile after collision, so that the problem that the NVH is influenced by the automobile after collision can be accurately known.

title_en: High-fruiting-rate stropharia rugoso-annulata cultivation system and method based on fungus grass culture medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a stropharia rugoso-annulata high fruiting rate cultivation system and method based on a fungus grass culture medium, which belong to the technical field of stropharia rugoso-annulata cultivation, and comprise an experiment design module, a data acquisition and preprocessing module, an evaluation index weight distribution module, a stropharia rugoso-annulata cultivation parameter optimizing module and a super parameter optimizing module, wherein the experiment design module is used for receiving cultivation parameters input by a user and generating different experimental schemes, and the data acquisition and preprocessing module is responsible for collecting evaluation index data and carrying out cleaning and normalization processing. The evaluation index weight distribution module calculates each index weight through a statistical method. The cultivation parameter optimizing module is combined with a comprehensive evaluation formula, a convolutional neural network and a bitling optimizing algorithm to accurately find an optimal cultivation parameter combination. The super-parameter optimization module optimizes the super-parameters of the model through a Bayesian optimization method, and improves the performance of the model. The invention obviously improves the cultivation efficiency and fruiting rate of stropharia rugoso-annulata and provides powerful technical support for large-scale cultivation of stropharia rugoso-annulata.

title_en: Memory controller, memory device including the same, and method of operating the memory device
abstract_en: A memory controller, a memory device, and an operating method of the memory device are provided. The storage controller includes a post-write processing module configured to output a cache update request in response to a write completion, a cache processing module configured to output a cache update response based on the cache update request and release at least one of a cache memory and a cache memory, and a metadata processing module configured to update mapping data indicating a correspondence between physical addresses and logical addresses, wherein the post-write processing module is further configured to determine whether the mapping data is updatable based on the cache update response and output a mapping update request based on the determination, and the metadata processing module is further configured to update the mapping data in response to the mapping update request.

title_en: Design method for improving take-off thrust of aero-engine in temperature-limited state
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of aero-engine control, and particularly relates to a design method for improving take-off thrust of an aero-engine in a temperature-limited state. The method comprises the steps of firstly calculating the taking-off thrust of the engine according to the actual measurement parameters, secondly identifying the taking-off state, and thirdly determining the taking-off thrust improvement strategy according to the taking-off thrust of the engine and the taking-off state. According to the design method for improving the take-off thrust of the aero-engine in the temperature-limited state, whether the aircraft meets the take-off thrust requirement is determined according to the take-off thrust of the engine and the take-off state, and the take-off thrust requirement is met by increasing the warm-up time, enlarging the throat area of the tail nozzle of the engine and increasing the forced fuel flow under the condition that the requirements are not met.

title_en: Intent recognition method based on thought chain guidance
abstract_en: The invention provides an intention recognition method based on thinking chain guidance, and relates to the technical field of large language model reasoning. The method comprises the steps of constructing a self-adaptive thinking chain guiding mechanism, guiding a large language model in a way of learning by a small sample, gradually disassembling the problem into a plurality of independent processing sub-problems by using a set of universal thinking chain guiding prompt templates when facing the complex problem, then converting a classification task of the sub-problems into a selection problem decision by using a supervision fine tuning method, selecting the most suitable processing module for different types of sub-problems, specifically, introducing a sub-task modularized design, dividing different processing paths into independent task processing units, and executing corresponding processing flows according to the properties of the tasks. The invention can help the model maintain the consistency and accuracy of reasoning when facing the tasks containing a plurality of subtasks and complex logic relations through the fine task disassembly and reasoning path guidance.

title_en: Artificial intelligence application deployment method based on domestic GPU
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligent application deployment method based on a domestic GPU, which comprises the steps of loading an algorithm model of the artificial intelligent application, analyzing and extracting neural network operators used in the algorithm model, forming a calculation flow graph according to an operator sequence in an original algorithm model, selecting domestic GPU equipment from an OpenCL platform, creating a context based on the GPU equipment, creating a command queue on the context, simultaneously creating kernel objects and memory objects for each operator by using a buffer area object, writing parallel calculation kernel of each operator by using OpenCL, simultaneously generating program objects of each operator and instantiation kernel, sequentially calling kernel according to an operator front-rear connection relation in the calculation flow graph, and operating the kernel on the domestic GPU equipment, thereby completing deployment of the artificial intelligent application. The invention enables AI application to be deployed with high performance, network transmission is not needed, and delay is low.

title_en: Information fusion method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to an information fusion method, an information fusion device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining first attribute information of each electric device in a low-voltage distribution system in a target building, second attribute information in a BMS and device connection relations among the electric devices, determining similarity characteristics between the first attribute information and the second attribute information of each electric device according to the first attribute information and the second attribute information of each electric device, determining attribute characteristics of each electric device according to a device topological structure diagram of each electric device, and carrying out information fusion on the first attribute information and the second attribute information according to the similarity characteristics between the first attribute information and the second attribute information of each electric device and the attribute characteristics of each electric device. By adopting the method, the information fusion and attribute mapping process of each electrical device in the target building in the low-voltage power distribution system and the BMS can be accurately completed.

title_en: Chip screening method and system based on deep Q learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chip screening method and system based on deep Q learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly acquiring n chips to be processed and parameter information of the chips to be processed; based on the parameter information of the chips to be processed, determining m parallel chips from the n chips to be processed by using a network model based on deep Q learning. The chip screening strategy based on deep Q learning is provided, and the screened chip can reduce the parameter difference between parallel devices and effectively reduce the phenomenon of unbalanced current junction temperature caused by the chip difference.

title_en: Monitoring system and method for emergency water supply
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring system and a method for emergency water supply, and relates to the technical field of data management, wherein the monitoring system comprises the steps of establishing a three-dimensional model of an emergency area, acquiring characteristic areas in the emergency area, and calculating the water supply deflection degree of each characteristic area; the method comprises the steps of establishing a plane coordinate system of an emergency area, obtaining the characteristic degree corresponding to each coordinate in the plane coordinate system according to the position of each characteristic area and the water supply deflection degree, obtaining the number of water outlets of the fire-fighting equipment to obtain a plurality of initial areas in the emergency area, setting the circulation times of the initial areas, calculating the iteration ratio of each initial area to obtain a plurality of target points, and disposing the water outlets at the positions of the target points. According to the invention, by combining the actual situation of the emergency area, the water outlet position of the fire-fighting facility is reasonably set, so that water resources are effectively allocated, and a fire department can effectively treat the emergency in time, so that the fire-fighting efficiency is improved when the emergency is dealt with.

title_en: Edge server load prediction method and system based on multi-scale time-frequency analysis
abstract_en: The edge server load prediction method and system based on multi-scale time-frequency analysis comprises the following steps of S1, calculating the weight of each resource of an edge server based on data driving and analytic hierarchy process, weighting and fusing to obtain load data, S2, constructing LWMSPformer model, extracting the cycle time span of the load data based on Lomb-Scargle spectrum analysis process, extracting the trend time span and the mutation time span of the load data by combining wavelet decomposition technology to generate segment size candidate sets, S3, carrying out batch processing on the load data to obtain input data, carrying out periodic decomposition and trend decomposition on the input data, and calculating the adaptation degree of each segment size in the segment size candidate sets. According to the method and the system, the segment size candidate set is constructed, the segment size selector is utilized to select a plurality of segment sizes for dynamic segment blocking, feature extraction is carried out from a plurality of scales, the accuracy of server load prediction is effectively improved, and dynamic changes of the edge server load are better dealt with.

title_en: Code peculiar smell detection method and system based on large language model
abstract_en: The invention provides a code peculiar smell detection method and system based on a large language model, and relates to the technical field of code peculiar smell detection, wherein the method comprises the steps of extracting context code information of a code to be detected, wherein the context code information comprises a method code and a class code; the method comprises the steps of respectively extracting key information of a method code and a class code, constructing a method information set and a class information set, constructing a large language model, constructing a prompt word of the large language model based on a thinking chain and a thinking tree, constructing a code replacement strategy based on a hierarchy, dynamically adjusting context code information according to the code replacement strategy by using the method information set and the class information set, inputting the prompt word and the dynamically adjusted context code information into the large language model for code odor detection, and outputting a code odor detection result of a code to be detected.

title_en: Intelligent auxiliary teacher lesson preparation system and method based on large education model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent auxiliary teacher lesson preparation system and method based on an education big model, which comprises the following steps of S1, generating a standardized teacher lesson preparation data set, S2, constructing a teaching knowledge graph, S3, generating preliminary intelligent lesson preparation content, S4, presenting the preliminary intelligent lesson preparation content, providing an interactive interface combining natural language and voice recognition, S5, generating an adjusted intelligent lesson preparation content, S6, carrying out self-adaptive learning and optimization on the intelligent lesson preparation content according to teacher history lesson preparation data and interactive feedback data, adjusting weights of key knowledge points in the teaching knowledge graph, and updating a content generation strategy of the education big model to generate a final intelligent lesson preparation scheme. The invention obviously improves the response capability of the intelligent generated content to the teaching intention of the teacher, supports the dynamic collaboration of the teaching content and the test question style along with the teaching rhythm and the classroom feedback, and provides an intelligent decision support foundation for large-scale personalized teaching.

title_en: Method and related device for decomposing optical mode of complex medium structure under special point light source
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a related device for decomposing an optical mode of a complex medium structure under a special point light source, and relates to the technical field of nano photonics and optical engineering; based on the three-dimensional geometric model, adopting a finite difference time domain method to carry out numerical simulation, determining electromagnetic field distribution information of the complex medium structure under the irradiation of a special point light source, carrying out multistage decomposition on the electromagnetic field distribution information to obtain a plurality of multipole modes, respectively determining two-dimensional far-field radiation information of each multipole mode based on the multipole modes, and combining the two-dimensional far-field radiation information of each multipole mode to obtain a comprehensive three-dimensional far-field radiation pattern. The application can effectively analyze the optical characteristics of the complex medium structure under the irradiation of the special point light source and accurately reflect the multipole mode contribution and interaction of the complex medium structure under the irradiation of the special point light source.

title_en: Conversion and transmission method and system for alarm information between operation and maintenance monitoring platforms
abstract_en: The invention discloses a conversion and transmission method and a system for alarm information among operation and maintenance monitoring platforms, comprising the following steps of obtaining alarm formats in an old operation and maintenance monitoring system and a new operation and maintenance monitoring system, respectively storing the alarm formats in a first key value pair list and a second key value pair list, monitoring first alarm information of the old operation and maintenance monitoring system, matching the first alarm information with the second key value pair list, carrying out information conversion according to different matching relations, and enabling the formats of the first alarm information to be consistent with the second key value pair list.

title_en: Data reading method and memory controller
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a data reading method and a memory controller, which are applied to a memory device configured with a memory module. The method includes obtaining a first read instruction from a host system that does not include a target memory address pointer, reading target data from a memory module during preparation of the target memory space by the host, sending a data ready notification to the host system requesting the target memory space when the target data is obtained, obtaining a second read instruction that includes the target memory address pointer when the target memory space is ready, and transmitting the target data to the host system according to the target memory address pointer. According to the method and the device, the parallel processing of host memory allocation and read data preparation is realized by changing the data reading flow of the traditional NVMe protocol, so that the reading performance of the storage device under the condition of shortage of host memory is effectively improved, the memory requirement of a host system is remarkably reduced, and the memory pressure of the host system is reduced.

title_en: Electric field with inclined contact surface in point source current field
abstract_en: The invention discloses an analytical calculation technology of an inclined contact surface electric field in a point source current field. And directly calculating the electric field intensity horizontal component Ex measured by the electric potential U of the point current source at two sides of the half-space inclined contact surface and the earth surface in the x direction by adopting a formula. The technical scheme includes that a horizontal distance from a point source A to an inclined contact surface with an inclination angle alpha is d, the point source A is used as a round point, the trend of a vertical inclined contact surface is an x axis, the trend of a parallel inclined contact surface is a z axis, a right-hand rectangular coordinate system is established, and resistivity at two sides of an interface is uniformly distributed, wherein the values of the resistivity are rho  1  and rho  2  respectively. Calculating the vertical angle theta of the point source A, when theta is less than alpha, obtaining a dynamic coefficient Cm related to the position of the point, the inclination angle of the interface and the resistivity of two sides, calculating the distance gamma  1 、γ 2  between the point source A and the point and the distance gamma  3  between the mirror image virtual point source A  1  of the contact surface of the point source A and the point, and finally calculating the potential U  1  of the active side and the horizontal component of the electric field intensity by using an analytical formula And a passive side potential U  2 , an electric field intensity horizontal component . title_en: Information extraction method and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an information extraction method and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of decomposing an information extraction task into a plurality of logically consecutive subtasks through a dynamic task decomposition mechanism to form a structured thinking chain reasoning path, obtaining multi-mode data to be processed, wherein the multi-mode data at least comprises text data and table data, gradually reasoning the multi-mode data by adopting a large model based on the thinking chain reasoning path to generate an intermediate reasoning result, analyzing and verifying the intermediate reasoning result, and outputting the structured extraction result.

title_en: Data analysis method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The present application relates to a data analysis method, apparatus, computer device, storage medium and computer program product. The method comprises the steps of calling a first language model and a target object to conduct multi-round conversation around an analysis task, conducting intention recognition based on the multi-round conversation to obtain task description content according to the multi-round conversation, calling a second language model to rewrite the task description content to obtain task parameters in a preset format, and transmitting the task parameters to a data analysis platform to instruct the data analysis platform to execute the analysis task based on the task parameters to obtain a data analysis result. By adopting the method, the analysis accuracy of data analysis can be improved.

title_en: Operator fusion method and corresponding device in computational graph
abstract_en: The application relates to a method for operator fusion in a calculation graph, which is applied to an AI compiling process, and comprises the steps of obtaining a target graph, wherein the target graph comprises a plurality of nodes and at least one edge; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a computing graph, determining computing types of two nodes connected by a first edge, determining computing logic of the two operators corresponding to the two nodes, combining the computing types of the two operators into the computing types of the other operator according to the first computing type and the second computing type, and obtaining a fused operator after the two operators are fused. According to the scheme provided by the application, the cyclic sentences of the operators are not required to be compressed into one dimension, the indexes are recalculated for the operators, and the two operators can be fused through the calculation types of the two operators, so that the high-performance fusion operator can be obtained.

title_en: Grassland ecological system monitoring method and system based on remote sensing data, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grassland ecological system monitoring method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium based on remote sensing data, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting an original remote sensing image covering a grassland area by using a satellite sensor, and preprocessing the original remote sensing image to obtain a multispectral image data set; extracting spectral features in the multispectral image dataset, calculating reflectivity and vegetation indexes of each wave band, determining a spectral feature distribution map of grassland vegetation, utilizing a convolutional neural network to identify the spectral feature distribution map to obtain vegetation structural features, extracting and analyzing functional feature parameters from the vegetation structural features to obtain quantitative characterization results, utilizing a time sequence analysis method to obtain space-time variation trend of the vegetation state of the grassland based on the spectral feature distribution map, the vegetation structural features and the quantitative characterization results, comparing the space-time variation trend with a preset ecological health threshold value through a clustering analysis method, and judging health status partitions of a grassland ecological system to obtain a health status classification map.

title_en: Accounting method and device for carbon footprint in recovery process of wind turbine generator
abstract_en: The application provides a calculation method and device for carbon footprint in a recovery process of a wind turbine, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of links involved in the recovery process of the wind turbine, obtaining energy consumption and energy consumed by processing the wind turbine in any one of the links, determining carbon emission factors of the energy according to regions where the wind turbine is located, determining carbon emission generated by processing the wind turbine in the links according to the carbon emission factors and the energy consumption of the energy, and determining total carbon footprint generated in the recovery process of the wind turbine according to the carbon emission generated by processing the wind turbine in each link. Therefore, the calculation of the total carbon footprint in the recovery process of the wind turbine generator is realized, the accuracy of the calculation of the carbon footprint in the recovery process of the wind turbine generator is effectively improved, and the subsequent processing based on the calculated carbon footprint is convenient.

title_en: Threat assessment method, threat assessment device, threat assessment equipment and threat assessment medium for electric power system assets
abstract_en: The invention provides a threat assessment method, device, equipment and medium for electric power system assets, which comprise the steps of collecting target electric power system asset data, extracting data characteristics, calculating the data characteristics through probability density distribution functions based on a multi-element Gaussian mixture model to obtain target posterior probabilities of the assets, carrying out clustering processing on all the target posterior probabilities, and identifying threat states of each asset according to clustering results to determine whether the asset is in a safe state or faces attack types. According to the method and the device, the probability density distribution function based on the multi-element Gaussian mixture model can process the asset data in different formats or structures so as to identify the threat state of each asset, so that the integration and unified analysis of different types of asset data are realized, the problem of difficult information integration in the prior art is solved, the method and the device can be used for threat identification of multi-source heterogeneous asset data, and the evaluation efficiency is effectively improved.

title_en: Intelligent moxibustion application scheme generation system based on acupoint thermosensitive moxibustion quantification
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent moxibustion scheme generating system based on acupoint thermosensitive moxibustion quantification, which comprises a user interaction module, an AI diagnosis and treatment module, a vision guiding module and a terminal camera, wherein the user interaction module is used for multi-terminal interaction among doctors, patients and families and provides image-text, voice and video communication functions, the AI diagnosis and treatment module analyzes user input symptoms through a natural language processing technology and combines a thermosensitive moxibustion diagnosis and treatment database to generate a preliminary scheme, the doctor terminal is automatically switched when the matching degree is lower than a threshold value, the vision guiding module calls a terminal camera to realize two working modes, namely a bidirectional video guiding channel is established when the doctors are connected, and the deviation of moxibustion parts is monitored through a bone recognition algorithm when the AI runs autonomously. According to the invention, through the AI diagnosis and treatment module and the symptom-acupoint mapping sub-module, and by combining with natural language processing and a decision tree algorithm, the symptom of a patient can be rapidly analyzed and a personalized acupoint scheme is recommended, so that compared with the traditional mode of relying on the experience of doctors, the accuracy and efficiency of diagnosis and treatment are remarkably improved, and meanwhile, the risk of misdiagnosis is reduced.

title_en: Terminal load power supply association relation intelligent checking method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent verification method and system for a terminal load power supply association relation based on multi-source data fusion. The method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time energy consumption data and mechanical vibration signals of preprocessed electric equipment sent by an edge computing node, carrying out multi-source data fusion on the real-time energy consumption data and the mechanical vibration signals by utilizing a deep learning model to identify dynamic association relations between the electric equipment and a power supply, adjusting abnormal threshold rules of the electric equipment according to the dynamic association relations, triggering corresponding alarm signals when abnormal energy consumption or power supply failure of the electric equipment is detected according to the abnormal threshold rules of automatic logistics equipment, and pushing the alarm signals to a management terminal through an Internet of things platform. According to the technical scheme provided by the application, the abnormal threshold rule of the electric equipment is optimized in real time through multi-source data fusion and deep learning, and the intelligent alarm is triggered when the electric equipment is abnormal, so that the power supply safety and the energy efficiency management are improved.

title_en: Method, device, processor and readable storage medium for realizing cross-platform high-compatibility automatic unified operation and maintenance monitoring data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for realizing cross-platform high-compatibility automatic unified operation and maintenance monitoring data fusion, which comprises the following steps of automatically and uniformly acquiring cross-platform multi-dimensional operation and maintenance monitoring data; and the root cause inference based on the alarm joint analysis. The invention also relates to a device, a processor and a computer readable storage medium thereof for realizing cross-platform high-compatibility automatic unified operation and maintenance monitoring data fusion. The method, the device, the processor and the computer readable storage medium for realizing cross-platform high-compatibility automatic unified operation and maintenance monitoring data fusion are adopted, unified operation and maintenance monitoring on various operating systems and hardware platforms is realized through automatic acquisition of cross-platform multi-dimensional operation and maintenance monitoring data, operation and maintenance monitoring cost and management complexity are reduced, resource requirements are predicted, resource allocation is optimized through multi-dimensional operation and maintenance monitoring data fusion, redundant information is reduced through alarm joint analysis, and fault accurate positioning efficiency is improved.

title_en: Method for reconstructing information of flexible supporting stress field of reflecting mirror in multitasking Gaussian process
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of structural simulation calculation, and particularly relates to a method for reconstructing information of a flexible supporting stress field of a reflecting mirror in a multitasking Gaussian process. First, for a particular mirror flexible support structure, its boundary conditions and load conditions are determined. And meshing the structure by using finite element analysis software to generate a finite element model containing node and unit information. Then, a plurality of state input samples are generated in the value range of the load by a Latin hypercube sampling method and the like. And uniformly selecting part of nodes from the nodes of the finite element model as task input. Finite element analysis acquires training data and builds a graph-based multitasking gaussian process model. And calculating a correlation matrix of the state and the task, and determining a log-likelihood function. And adjusting the super parameters of the model through an optimization algorithm. And for an unknown state or an unknown task requiring reconstruction of stress field information, predicting by using a trained model. And according to the prediction result, reconstructing stress field information.

title_en: User advertisement recommendation method and system based on fused neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computers and discloses a user advertisement recommendation method and system based on a fused neural network; the method comprises the steps of extracting features of different modal data in a user behavior sequence, constructing an intra-modal element relation map, capturing dependency relations among elements by applying a sub-graph attention network, constructing a lightweight student network by knowledge distillation by using a large pre-training multi-modal model as a teacher network, introducing inter-modal contrast learning to enhance semantic alignment among modalities, and integrating user context information into a recommendation process by using a context condition embedding technology. The invention realizes high-precision and high-efficiency advertisement recommendation, and is particularly suitable for mobile terminal resource limited scenes.

title_en: Method for judging roughness and cleanliness of metal structure surface after rust removal
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for judging roughness and cleanliness of a metal structure surface after rust removal, which comprises the steps of establishing a metal structure surface cleanliness and roughness judging standard, establishing a database, utilizing YOLOv to establish a cleanliness and roughness target detection model, preprocessing an image, introducing a small target detection module, introducing a Hab algorithm, introducing a CBAM attention mechanism, namely a Wise-IoU (WIoU) loss function, and carrying out model weight reduction, and after training of a YOLOv network, testing and verifying the model to obtain a visual result. In order to realize the deployment of the model on the mobile equipment, YOLOv target detection networks are introduced as basic model structures, the model is improved by combining the metal surface cleanliness and roughness imaging characteristics and introducing the characteristic extraction module, and meanwhile, the model is designed in a lightweight manner, so that the accuracy and the efficiency of detection are improved.

title_en: Big data-based aging index test analysis method for power plant monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention provides a large data-based aging index test analysis method for a power plant monitoring device, which relates to the technical field of power plants and comprises the following steps of deploying a multi-type sensor array at a node of the power plant monitoring device, collecting multi-source operation data in real time, synchronously acquiring power grid dispatching instructions and load fluctuation data, adopting a noise filtering algorithm to clean and align the multi-source operation data, constructing a large data sample base, dividing the processed data into data subsets according to power grid working conditions, embedding working condition tag metadata, and calculating various aging indexes of the monitoring device based on the data of the large data sample base.

title_en: Adapter and quality evaluation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an adapter and a quality evaluation method thereof, wherein the adapter comprises a first shell, a second shell and a plate part, A shell connecting part is arranged between the first shell and the second shell, and a plate connecting part is arranged between the second shell and the plate part. The quality evaluation method comprises the steps of determining a first shell, a second shell and a plate part as auxiliary parameters of a first composition parameter, constructing weight matrixes among all auxiliary parameters, calculating to obtain weight vectors of different composition parameters and different auxiliary parameters after normalization, and obtaining a quality evaluation formula of the adapter after consistency detection of the weight matrixes. The invention realizes the structure of the specific adapter and establishes the method for evaluating the final quality of the specific adapter so as to be convenient for standardization and standardization of the actual adapter production process.

title_en: Filter error analysis method based on multi-task linear classifier
abstract_en: The invention provides a filter error analysis method based on a multi-task linear classifier, and belongs to the technical field of filters. The method comprises the steps of obtaining simulation data of a filter and constructing an input data set, constructing and training a multi-task linear classifier, and carrying out error analysis on a piece to be tested by utilizing the multi-task linear classifier to obtain the position and the error value of a machining error. The method can realize prejudgement correction of the secondary edition processing parameters, reduce the iteration times of the traditional design-processing-testing, form a data-driven self-adaptive compensation mechanism and finally achieve the effect of reducing the research and development comprehensive cost.

title_en: Training data enhancement method, training data enhancement device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a training data enhancement method, training data enhancement equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of data processing. According to the method, the historical monitoring data acquired by each node of the drainage pipe network are acquired, the historical monitoring data corresponding to each node is taken as one data point, an original data set is acquired, the original data set is divided into an ordered data set and an unordered data set according to the adjacent distance between each data point in the original data set and the adjacent data point corresponding to the target first equalization parameter based on the target first equalization parameter, then linear interpolation is carried out on the ordered data set, gaussian noise is added to each data point in the unordered data set based on the target second equalization parameter, balanced enhancement data are acquired, and the technical problem of low regulation accuracy of the drainage pipe network due to unbalanced data distribution is solved.

title_en: Image data acquisition method and system for lens plastic part
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing, in particular to an image data acquisition method and system of a lens plastic part, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring and preprocessing a multi-view surface image, and then evaluating the possibility of a light reflecting area according to pixel gray values and texture characteristics; calculating the corner response function of each pixel point according to the Harris corner detection algorithm, presetting the size of a local window for the pixel point, correcting the corner response function according to the contrast of the pixel point in the local window and the possibility of a light reflection area, acquiring characteristic points according to the corrected corner response function, registering multi-view images, and fusing the registered multi-view images to obtain a complete image of the surface of the lens plastic part so as to store the data of the complete image as a final acquisition result. According to the invention, the problem of difficult analysis caused by reflection and characteristic missing is analyzed, so that the high-quality acquisition of the full-coverage image on the surface of the lens plastic part is realized.

title_en: Target tracking model training method, target tracking method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a target tracking model training method, a target tracking device and target tracking equipment, which are used for improving the accuracy and the precision of target tracking. In the model training process, a trigger aiming at the target template image can be generated based on class activation characteristics of the target template image, a target search area image overlapped with the trigger is obtained by superposing the trigger on the target position of the target template image, the target search area image is input into a target tracking model to be trained, the target tracking model analyzes the target search area image based on the trigger and a context awareness attention mechanism, key area focusing can be achieved, the capturing capability of the target tracking model on target characteristics and surrounding context information is enhanced, interactive modeling of the target and environment is enhanced, local neighborhood characteristics are enhanced, the accuracy and the accuracy of target tracking can be effectively improved based on the trigger, similar background interference can be restrained, and the robustness of target tracking is improved.

title_en: Four-wheel drive cooperative control method for distributed electric drive self-propelled plant protection machine
abstract_en: The invention provides a four-wheel drive cooperative control method of a distributed electric drive self-propelled plant protection machine, which is characterized in that a control strategy model of four-wheel rotation speed and a cooperative control strategy model of four-wheel rotation speed and torque are established, a four-wheel real-time slip rate model is established by collecting current running state information and current driving state information of the plant protection machine, the tire slip rate is calculated, slip wheel identification is carried out according to a preset slip rate threshold value, then the driving mode is selected, and meanwhile, an optimization algorithm based on model predictive control is introduced to carry out predictive control on control parameters of all wheels in a future period of time. The invention can detect and identify the slipping wheel in real time, and can quickly inhibit slipping phenomenon by dynamically adjusting the rotating speed and torque of the slipping wheel and the compensation control of other wheels, and can automatically adjust the power output of other wheels when the single wheel slips by the real-time dynamic coordination of the rotating speed and torque of four wheels, thereby ensuring the accuracy of the movement track of the whole vehicle.

title_en: Minute grade mountain land approaching precipitation prediction method and system based on improved Vision Transformer terrain physical constraint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a minute-scale mountain land approaching precipitation forecasting method and system based on improved Vision Transformer terrain physical constraint, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a model training data set based on complex mountain area multisource weather observation site data and terrain feature data, improving Vision Transformer network based on a position self-adaptive dynamic convolution network and a rainless mask feature extraction strategy, constructing a combined loss function capable of providing terrain forced precipitation physical constraint, training an improved Vision Transformer network based on the training data set to obtain an optimal approaching precipitation forecasting model, and inputting real-time multisource weather observation grid point data and terrain feature grid point data into the optimal approaching precipitation forecasting model to obtain the approaching precipitation. The invention can obviously improve the forecasting performance of the strong precipitation position and the forecasting skill of the minute-scale close strong precipitation in the complex mountain area.

title_en: Crystallization abnormality identification method based on unsupervised learning
abstract_en: The application discloses a crystallization abnormality identification method based on unsupervised learning, which relates to the technical field of crystallization abnormality identification and comprises the following steps of setting a plurality of machine positions, obtaining crystallization video stream data, and performing frame extraction analysis to obtain a multi-machine-position crystallization frame image; cutting each image into a plurality of sub-blocks, identifying a crystallization main body area of each sub-block by adopting an unsupervised learning algorithm, extracting characteristics of the crystallization main body area to obtain crystallization main body characteristics, comparing the similarity among the crystallization main body characteristics of each sub-block, taking the minimum similarity as the overall similarity, comparing the overall similarity with an adaptive threshold value, and judging whether crystallization abnormality exists or not. According to the application, the omnibearing abnormal recognition is realized by acquiring the crystal video stream data through multiple machine positions, and the comprehensiveness and robustness of the crystal abnormal recognition are improved by combining an unsupervised learning algorithm, feature extraction, similarity comparison and self-adaptive threshold.

title_en: Device and method for rapidly identifying wood types
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for quickly identifying wood types, which are characterized by firstly collecting image data of each rosewood, dividing the image data into a training set and a test set after being regular, constructing a wood image identification multi-layer convolutional neural network, performing deep learning on the wood image identification multi-layer convolutional neural network by adopting the training set, performing test optimization model parameters on a model subjected to the deep learning by adopting the test set to generate a wood image identification model, and identifying the wood image data to be identified according to the wood image identification model. The rapid wood species identification device provided by the invention meets the requirements of mobile detection and identification, is simple and convenient to operate, has the advantages of high accuracy in identifying tree species, high identification speed and the like, can be widely applied to the fields of customs inspection, wood trade, wood identification and the like, and overcomes the defect that the existing identification equipment is not mobile or inconvenient to carry and use.

title_en: Log abnormality detection method, equipment and storage medium based on multi-feature fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of log anomaly detection, in particular to a log anomaly detection method, device and storage medium based on multi-feature fusion. According to the method, log data are analyzed through a Drain algorithm, a log template and a log level are extracted, semantic features are extracted by combining a BERT model, meanwhile, adjacent log time differences are calculated, time features are generated, the semantic, time and log level features are fused and then are input into a time sequence convolution network (TCN) and a transform module, the TCN is responsible for capturing fine-granularity local time sequence features to complement global context features captured by the transform module, the two features are deeply fused through a cross attention mechanism, and therefore a more comprehensive log sequence representation is formed, and accuracy, robustness and instantaneity of log anomaly detection are effectively improved.

title_en: Chinese character word searching method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Chinese character word searching method, which comprises the following steps of firstly extracting all keywords and corresponding manuscript IDs, secondly converting the pinyin of the keywords, thirdly establishing a pinyin tree, fourthly submitting the keywords and converting the pinyin, fifthly calculating an array subscript value corresponding to letters, sixthly checking whether array elements are empty or not through subscripts, extracting all the manuscript IDs and the corresponding keywords from a database when starting, converting the pinyin of the keywords according to the keywords, ensuring that all pinyin letters are lower-case letters, traversing the pinyin of the keywords of all manuscripts, firstly taking the initial letters of the pinyin of the keywords, subtracting 97 the ASCII values of the letters to obtain numbers and corresponding 26 sub-node array subscripts.

title_en: Page component loading method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a loading method, equipment and a storage medium of a page component, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting behavior characteristics and context characteristics of a user aiming at the page when the user accesses the page; the method comprises the steps of inputting behavior features and context features into a behavior prediction model, locating a component which is expected to be accessed by a user in the next step in a page and is used as a target component, preloading the target component in the page, monitoring a component which is actually accessed by the user in the next step in the page and is used as a reference component, and updating the behavior prediction model according to the target component and the reference component. According to the behavior of the user and the components which are expected to be accessed by the contextual user in the next step in the page, and by comparing the components which are actually accessed by the user in the next step in the page and updating the behavior prediction model, the accuracy of predicting the components which are accessed by the user in the next step in the page can be continuously improved.

title_en: Cross-domain distribution method and device for materials
abstract_en: The application discloses a material cross-domain distribution method and device, which comprise the steps of constructing a material cross-domain distribution multi-target optimization model by taking the minimum total delay time of material cross-domain distribution as a first optimization target and taking the minimum scheduling cost from a material support point to a material demand point as a second optimization target under comprehensive constraint conditions, mapping the material cross-domain distribution multi-target optimization model by using a Logistic chaotic function, generating an initialized population, blending a variable neighborhood search operator into a MOEA/D algorithm to obtain an optimized MOEA/D algorithm, solving the material cross-domain distribution multi-target optimization model based on the optimized MOEA/D algorithm to obtain a pareto front solution set of the material cross-domain distribution multi-target, and accordingly determining a material cross-domain distribution scheme based on a preset selection criterion according to the pareto front solution set, so that the task reliability of the whole-cycle inner mixed material cross-domain distribution can be effectively improved, and the cost ratio of the whole-cycle inner mixed material cross-domain distribution can be improved.

title_en: Method and system for tracking aggregate movement in concrete stirring process based on monocular X-ray imaging
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for tracking aggregate movement in a concrete stirring process based on monocular X-ray imaging, wherein the system comprises a single X-ray source, a flat panel detector, a trace aggregate containing special mark points, an image acquisition and processing unit and a three-dimensional position and posture resolving unit, wherein the single X-ray source is used for generating cone beam rays, the flat panel detector is positioned at the opposite side of the X-ray source, the three-dimensional position and posture resolving unit is used for reducing the cost of the system, compared with a binocular X-ray system, the equipment requirement is reduced by half, the construction and maintenance cost is greatly reduced, the system structure is simplified, the combination of the single X-ray source and the detector is reduced, the space requirement and the installation complexity are reduced, the high-precision three-dimensional tracking is realized, the positioning precision of an XY plane can reach +/-1 mm, the positioning precision of a Z axis can reach +/-2 mm, and the posture resolving precision is controlled within +/-5 degrees.

title_en: Underwater broadband Z-shaped two-phase ultrathin sound insulation structure and optimization method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of underwater sound regulation and control. The invention aims to provide an underwater broadband Z-shaped two-phase ultrathin sound insulation structure, which consists of a periodic array of basic structural units and damping materials arranged on two sides of the periodic array of the basic structural units, and utilizes the combined action of impedance mismatch and damping dissipation mechanisms to enable the two-phase vibration insulation superstructure to realize the suppression of underwater vibration in a broadband range with ultrathin thickness, thereby reducing the intensity of underwater radiation noise generated by a protected object. The second purpose of the invention is to provide an optimization method of the underwater broadband Z-shaped two-phase ultrathin sound insulation structure, wherein a genetic algorithm is adopted to optimize the geometric parameters of the metal part of the underwater broadband Z-shaped two-phase ultrathin sound insulation structure, the optimization target is that the objective function, namely the fitness, is maximized within a given frequency range, and meanwhile, the minimum size requirement of the structure needs to be met in the optimization process and the structure is not damaged under the preset hydrostatic pressure.

title_en: Non-uniformity correction method and system based on spatial domain and frequency domain characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-uniformity correction method and a system based on spatial domain and frequency domain characteristics, which relate to the technical field of infrared image processing, and the correction steps are that an image to be corrected is input into a trained infrared image non-uniformity correction model, and a correction image is output; the model training method comprises the steps of constructing a training data set based on a visible light data set, constructing an initial infrared image non-uniformity correction model, constructing a non-uniformity correction trunk module by adopting a U-Net structure, wherein a airspace feature extraction module and a frequency domain feature extraction module are arranged in the non-uniformity correction trunk module, and performing iterative training on the initial infrared image non-uniformity correction model by utilizing the training data set to obtain the infrared image non-uniformity correction model. According to the invention, local pixel level information is captured through the airspace feature extraction module, and the local noise suppression and global structure optimization synergistic effect is realized by combining the global spectrum features extracted by the frequency domain feature extraction module, so that the accuracy and the robustness of the non-uniformity correction are improved.

title_en: Behavior clone model training method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent decision making, and can be applied to business system platforms of financial science and technology, medical health and the like, and discloses a behavior clone model training method, device, equipment and medium, which comprises the steps of acquiring multi-modal input, and performing feature extraction and splicing on the multi-modal input to obtain input representation; extracting potential representation of input representation by using a preset decoder, decoding the potential representation into action data by using a preset strategy head, calculating a mutual information loss function value of the potential representation by using an information bottleneck principle, calculating a mean square error loss value of the action data and preset real action data, carrying out iterative updating on parameters of the preset decoder and the preset strategy head according to the mutual information loss function value and the mean square error loss value to obtain an updated model, detecting whether a joint loss function value in the updated model is smaller than a preset threshold in real time, and stopping parameter iterative updating when the joint loss function value is smaller than the preset threshold to obtain an optimized model.

title_en: Audio zooming method, electronic device, storage medium and computer program product
abstract_en: The application discloses an audio zooming method, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a computer program product, and relates to the technical field of signal processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out beam forming processing on microphone array signals by taking a preset direction as a voice enhancement direction to obtain enhancement signals, wherein the preset direction is determined according to the shooting direction of a camera device; and fusing the enhancement signal with at least one path of signal in the microphone array signal according to the video zooming multiple of the image pickup device, and obtaining a target output signal according to the fused signal, wherein the larger the video zooming multiple is, the larger the corresponding fusion proportion of the enhancement signal is. The application adopts simple wave beam forming and signal fusion technology, which has small occupation to computing resource and memory resource and high algorithm robustness, thus the audio zooming algorithm is possible to be deployed in the equipment with limited resources.

title_en: Knowledge graph construction method for structure information aggregation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of knowledge graphs, and particularly discloses a knowledge graph construction method for structure information aggregation. The method converts discrete, disordered and heterogeneous entity attribute information in a cross-source knowledge graph into continuous, ordered and structured entity attribute vectors serving as a carrier for structure information aggregation, achieves gradual aggregation from a local triplet structure to a graph-level semantic structure, reserves structural semantic roles of entities in different knowledge graphs, selectively models adjacent relations through an attention mechanism, introduces relation semantic similarity, enhances entity representation consistency and discriminance, and achieves knowledge graph semantic space consistency and knowledge density improvement through repeated complement and alignment alternate execution of closed-loop enhancement processes of entity level and structure level.

title_en: Design method of metamaterial microwave absorber based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a design method of a metamaterial microwave absorber based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of data acquisition and convolutional neural network training. Firstly, a forward prediction convolutional neural network model is built, namely, the structure of a metamaterial microwave absorber predicts the corresponding absorptivity and infrared emissivity of the convolutional neural network model, and for a reverse design model, a self-encoder is added to perform data dimension reduction, high-dimension data of absorptivity and infrared emissivity is mapped into a vector of a low-dimension space, and meanwhile, the structure of the convolutional neural network is reversely designed.

title_en: Method and system for testing split type safety link structure of high-voltage wire frame
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of safety test of high-voltage wire frames, and discloses a method and a system for testing a split type safety link structure of a high-voltage wire frame. According to the method, the mechanical arm is used for performing the plugging and bending test on the split type link structure of the high-voltage wire frame, and the interface pressure and structure deformation image data are collected in real time. And analyzing interface wear and structural fatigue damage characteristics by utilizing a pre-trained wear detection model, and outputting a real-time wear degree evaluation result. And after the test period is finished, integrating the multi-mode data and the evaluation result to generate a three-dimensional visual detection report, positioning the wear concentration position, marking the abnormal wear point and quantifying the structural safety level. The invention solves the problems of incomplete test and inaccurate evaluation in the prior art, and improves the safety and reliability of products.

title_en: Pipeline irrigation pipe diameter optimization method based on small-sized electromechanical canal irrigation area system layout
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pipe diameter optimization method for pipe irrigation based on a small-sized electromechanical canal irrigation area system layout, which takes total head of open canal irrigation as a reference, determines total pipe network pressure according to the requirement that the total head of the pipe irrigation system is not more than a certain multiple of the total head of the open canal irrigation system, distributes the total pipe network pressure in each level of pipe network by adopting an orthogonal design method, and deduces pipe network diameter and pipe network engineering investment in each row of an orthogonal table according to the pressure distributed by each level of pipe network, and determines the minimum pipe network investment and corresponding pipe diameter of each level of pipe through orthogonal analysis. The invention improves the rationality and practicability of the design of the pipeline irrigation system.

title_en: Parameter self-adaptive three-dimensional point cloud crown volume calculation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a parameter self-adaptive three-dimensional point cloud crown volume calculation method which comprises the following steps of 1, judging whether a point cloud is in a detection frame or not for input scene three-dimensional point cloud data and a crown label file to determine whether the point cloud is a crown point cloud or not, so as to extract a crown part. And 2, circularly traversing each crown through crown label data, reading the types of the crowns, and judging the crowns to be spheres, ellipsoids or other types. And 3, calculating the volume of each crown one by adopting an improved convex hull method for the spherical or ellipsoidal crowns, and storing. And 4, for other types of crowns, calculating the volume of each crown one by adopting a modified ALPHA SHAPE method and storing. And 5, outputting the volumes of all crowns of the current scene. The method solves the problem that the traditional single crown volume calculation algorithm is difficult to adapt to crowns with large morphological differences.

title_en: Method and device for preventive testing of capacitive voltage transformer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for preventive testing of a capacitive voltage transformer, which relate to the technical field of preventive testing of voltage transformers, and are characterized in that an upper section error prediction model, a middle section error prediction model and a lower section error prediction model corresponding to the models are trained, the upper section error prediction model, the middle section error prediction model and the lower section error prediction model corresponding to the models are read, an upper section test dielectric loss value, a middle section test dielectric loss value and a lower section test dielectric loss value of the voltage transformer to be tested are respectively obtained by using a high-voltage lead testing method without dismantling, lower section correction dielectric loss is obtained based on lower section error characteristics, lower section test dielectric loss value and lower section error prediction model, comprehensive dielectric loss is calculated, the measurement effect of a high-precision dielectric loss instrument can be achieved when a non-high-precision dielectric loss instrument is used for preventive testing, and the purchase cost of the dielectric loss instrument is reduced.

title_en: Geological structure edge detection method based on enhanced gravity tensor eigenvalue
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of geophysics and provides a geological structure edge detection method based on an enhanced gravity tensor eigenvalue, which comprises the steps of data preparation and gravity gradient tensor matrix generation; the method comprises the steps of carrying out characteristic decomposition on gravity gradient tensor matrix lines to obtain a gravity tensor characteristic value, carrying out deep decomposition on the gravity tensor characteristic value to extract amplitude information, constructing an enhanced edge detection filter F based on the amplitude information, and carrying out edge detection calculation based on the enhanced gravity tensor characteristic value to obtain the edge of the underground geological structure according to the steps. Compared with the common characteristic value detection technology, the geological structure (or target body) edge detection result obtained by the method can obtain a clearer and continuous identification effect, has high positioning accuracy, can be well suitable for multi-scale and different buried depth superimposed geological structure (or target body) edge characterization, and has stronger practicability.

title_en: Data management method, device, medium and product
abstract_en: The application discloses a data management method, equipment, medium and product, relating to the computer technical field, when the data of a program running on a certain processor core needs to be inserted into a shared cache, data belonging to different applications is placed in different priority levels according to the class of the application. The shortest time that data is guaranteed to stay in the private cache is for the data to walk from the highest priority location to the lowest priority location that matches the processor core to which the data is subordinate, and the intermediate process is not accessed again. The data blocks with higher hit rate are stored in the cache system for a longer time, so that the hit rate of the whole cache system is improved.

title_en: Brake leaf spring crack data analysis method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a brake leaf spring crack data analysis method and system, which relate to the field of vehicle fault diagnosis and data analysis and are used for receiving maintenance reports of a third-party maintenance station, vehicle-mounted vibration sensor data and user feedback data, sending a standardized braking instruction to drive a brake caliper to clamp when a vehicle engine is flameout and a contradiction is identified, enabling a brake pad assembly containing a brake leaf spring to be excited to generate vibration response, synchronously triggering an accelerometer to acquire a target vibration response signal at a high sampling rate, carrying out advanced feature extraction on the signal to obtain a vehicle feature vector, comparing the feature vector with a preset standard sample library feature set by adopting a multidimensional feature vector similarity comparison algorithm, and determining the actual crack state of the brake leaf spring according to the comparison result. According to the application, standardized excitation is triggered through multi-source data contradiction, and the characteristic analysis of high-fidelity vibration signals is combined, so that the problem of misjudgment of brake leaf spring cracks under the traditional single data source is solved, and the detection accuracy under the complex working condition is improved.

title_en: Motorcycle instrument oil quantity display calibration method based on multi-sensor fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a motorcycle instrument oil quantity display calibration method based on multi-sensor fusion, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of acquiring data signals of sensors, carrying out data fusion and preprocessing, calculating fuel consumption rate by adopting a dynamic self-adaptive fuel consumption model, predicting residual oil quantity, and dynamically adjusting residual mileage. The intelligent travel system has the beneficial effects that the multi-sensor data and dynamic environment compensation are fused, the liquid level measurement error is < +/-1%, the endurance prediction error is < +/-5%, the integral oil quantity calculation accuracy is improved to 98%, the DAFCM model supports millisecond-level response, the intelligent travel system is dynamically adapted to complex driving scenes, the low-resource occupation is realized, the intelligent travel system is suitable for a low-end vehicle-mounted controller, and reliable data support is provided for intelligent travel.

title_en: Combined modeling method, system and medium based on financial data
abstract_en: The application provides a joint modeling method, a system and a medium based on financial data, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining original data of different participants, and converting the original data into standard data in a unified format according to a standard template; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a verification result corresponding to each participant through verification of standard data by a verification tool, encrypting the verification result, sending the verification result to a coordinator, decrypting and verifying the encrypted verification result by the coordinator, initializing a global model by the coordinator after verification is passed, sending initial parameters of the global model to each participant, respectively carrying out model training on the global model by the standard data of each participant to obtain an updated model, and taking the current updated model as a target model after the updated model is determined to meet the requirements.

title_en: Deletion mode emotion recognition method and system based on cross-mode attention fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for identifying missing mode emotion based on cross-mode attention fusion, which belong to the technical field of emotion identification and comprise the steps of obtaining multi-mode data of emotion to be identified, marking missing mode indication of the missing mode of the multi-mode data, carrying out feature preprocessing to obtain primary features and preprocessed features, carrying out feature extraction to the primary features of each mode to obtain advanced features, calculating attention scores among the advanced features of each mode by using a cross-mode attention fusion layer, carrying out weighted summation on the advanced features according to the attention scores, dynamically adjusting the fusion degree of the features of each mode through a gating fusion mechanism to obtain primary fusion features, fusing the primary fusion features and the preprocessed features through a residual error connection module to obtain full-mode features, and carrying out emotion identification on the full-mode features by using a depth classification network. The invention learns the interrelation between different modal data to realize the effective identification of multi-modal emotion.

title_en: Fine linear defect dividing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing and computer vision, and discloses a fine linear defect segmentation method. The method comprises the steps of carrying out detail enhancement processing and nonlinear contrast amplification processing on an image to be processed in series to obtain a pre-enhanced image; the invention can make the original indistinct fine and light linear defects become relatively obvious in the image through the serial two-stage pre-enhancement processing, the enhanced image provides stronger and easier-to-learn defect characteristics for the deep learning image segmentation network, thus effectively solving the problem that the deep learning image segmentation network is difficult to converge or has poor convergence effect when processing such defects.

title_en: Fatigue identification and early warning method and system for cloud cabin safety personnel under multi-vehicle supervision scene
