abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent vehicle remote driving safety monitoring, in particular to a cloud cabin safety fatigue identification early warning method and a system under a multi-vehicle supervision scene, comprising the steps of constructing a differential sub-model system under different human-vehicle ratio scenes through an LSTM model-attention mechanism, and generating a personalized fatigue identification sub-model adapting to the fatigue rule under each human-vehicle ratio scene; the method comprises the steps of respectively extracting fatigue characteristics of corresponding multi-mode data by each personalized fatigue identification sub-model, outputting sub-fatigue identification results, fusing parameter information of each personalized fatigue identification sub-model through multi-task federal learning to generate a global fatigue identification model, and integrating the fatigue characteristics and the sub-fatigue identification results of each personalized fatigue identification sub-model through the global fatigue identification model to obtain comprehensive fatigue identification results. The method and the device can improve the accuracy and the robustness of fatigue identification and reduce the risk of remote driving supervision failure caused by fatigue.

title_en: Detection and defense method for APT attack
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection and defense method for APT attack, which relates to the technical field of network protection. Then, the circulation condition of the marking information is monitored in real time by using a network flow analyzer and a safety information management system, and the abnormal change is captured. These anomaly data are then recorded and analyzed to construct an exhaustive database of aggression. Based on the database, an attack prediction model is established. And finally, a network security situation awareness system is established to provide powerful guarantee for network security. By actively scattering marked information, diffusing channels, deeply mining nonlinear characteristics and space-time characteristics of network traffic data, monitoring and analyzing network security situation in real time and other measures, APT attacks can be effectively detected and defended, the security and stability of the network are improved, the attacks are actively triggered, and therefore the data reliability of an attack prediction model is improved.

title_en: Attack resistance method based on perception loss and attack heuristic
abstract_en: The invention discloses a challenge attack resistance method based on perception loss and attack inspiring, and relates to the technical field of challenge attack resistance. The method comprises the steps of 1) selecting a data set, 2) constructing a discriminator model by using a deep convolutional neural network, constructing three different probability loss functions and combining the three different probability loss functions into a loss function of the discriminator model, 3) constructing a generator model by designing a generator model consisting of an encoder module, a residual error module and a decoder module, constructing three different probability loss functions and combining the three different probability loss functions with a perception loss to generate a loss function of the discriminator model, 4) selecting an attacker and a target model, 5) training the generator model and the discriminator model, combining the target model and the output of the discriminator with the loss function to train the generator and the discriminator, and 6) testing an attack countermeasure method based on the perception loss and the attack heuristic. The network model constructed by the invention can effectively improve the attack success rate of the attack resistance and provide a new design thought for the attack resistance.

title_en: Intelligent warehouse supervision system based on comprehensive data analysis of Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent warehouse supervision system based on comprehensive data analysis of the Internet of things, which belongs to the field of warehouse supervision systems and comprises a self-help weighing subsystem, a central control server, a state comparison module and an abnormal source tracing engine, wherein the self-help weighing subsystem is used for automatically weighing target waste in warehouse, acquiring and encrypting and storing gross weight data and tare weight data, and capturing an initial state image set of the waste, the central control server is in communication connection with the self-help weighing subsystem and comprises a state comparison module, the state comparison module is used for calling the warehouse-in state image set of the target waste when the target waste goes out of warehouse and performing multi-dimensional similarity matching with the warehouse-out state image set acquired in real time, and the abnormal source tracing engine is activated when the weight deviation rate exceeds a preset threshold or the image similarity is lower than a set standard, and is used for calling continuous monitoring video flow in a storage period of the target waste to perform abnormal event identification. The invention can more comprehensively monitor the stage of storing and taking out the waste and old objects, and timely find and remedy the abnormality when the abnormality occurs.

title_en: Simulation evaluation method for cross-regional environmental influence of food consumption
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation evaluation method of cross-regional environmental impact of food consumption, which comprises the steps of selecting a reference input-output table, collecting food consumption data and environmental satellite account data, wherein the food consumption data is consistent or similar to the reference input-output table in year, processing the food consumption data to generate a final food consumption demand vector, processing the environmental satellite account data to generate a second environmental satellite account, constructing an environmental footprint evaluation model of the food consumption, carrying out regional decomposition on the environmental footprint, analyzing the cross-regional flow pattern of the environmental footprint of the food consumption, and the like.

title_en: Program sequence recommending method and system based on group interest multi-level decoupling
abstract_en: The invention provides a program sequence recommending method and system based on group interest multi-level decoupling, belonging to the technical field of personalized recommendation, wherein the method comprises the steps of encoding a group interaction sequence processed by an embedded layer through a group sequence encoder to obtain a group representation; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a group-level interest decoupling module, decoupling interest representations of different members from the group representations through the group-level interest decoupling module, further decoupling the interest representations of the different members decoupled from the group-level interest decoupling module through a group variation automatic encoder in the group-level interest decoupling module to obtain the decoupling representations of the different members and a group consensus representation, carrying out next item prediction on the decoupling representations of the different members and the group consensus representation, obtaining candidate item scores of the group at the next moment, and recommending the candidate item scores to the group. The invention can solve the problems of poor accuracy and poor robustness of the IPTV program recommendation of the existing home group.

title_en: Server device
abstract_en: The application discloses a server, which relates to the technical field of servers and comprises a power backboard, a first power panel and a second power panel. The memory node of the server is connected with the power backboard. The plurality of power supply units comprise a plurality of first power supply units and a plurality of second power supply units, wherein the plurality of first power supply units are arranged on the first power panel and are electrically connected with the memory nodes. The plurality of second power supply units and the plurality of battery backup units are arranged on the second power panel. The plurality of battery backup units include a first battery backup unit electrically connected to the memory node, the first battery backup unit configured to power the memory node in the event of a loss or abnormality of power supplied by the first power supply unit. The standby power response speed of the first battery backup unit in the server is high, the power supply stability of the system is improved, and the data in the memory node can be ensured not to be lost due to short power failure.

title_en: Painting skill assessment method based on painting handwriting analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image recognition application, in particular to a painting skill assessment method based on painting handwriting analysis, which comprises the following steps of collecting pen pressure and speed sequences, calculating displacement vector standard deviation mark turning points by a sliding window, and extracting interval product characteristics to generate a rhythm label, generating a bit map by four-dimensional compression coding of a direction included angle and a trend label, and calculating the rhythm segment bit density by density segmentation to generate a skill assessment matrix. According to the invention, pen pressure and speed data are acquired through the pressure-sensitive digital panel, a sliding window is used for judging a standard differential state threshold value of a displacement vector, an action turning point is accurately marked, a time sequence characteristic of a pen conveying track is captured, a trend comparison algorithm is used for quantifying the product change of pen pressure speed to generate a rhythm trend label, a four-dimensional compression fusion direction vector and a rhythm label are normalized into a binary bit map, a rhythm enhancement section is segmented by a density threshold value, a skill evaluation matrix is calculated, the problems of subjective evaluation dependence and dynamic deletion are solved, and evaluation objectivity and interpretation are improved.

title_en: Intelligent calculation and prediction method and system for springback of hyperbolic aluminum plate
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent auxiliary calculation and shell spring metal forming, and provides an intelligent calculation and prediction method and system for springback of a hyperbolic aluminum plate. The method comprises the steps of carrying out automatic setting of a finite element analysis software forming analysis strategy, collecting stress data and different amplitude data of an aluminum plate in the Z direction, generating an analysis file, utilizing a pre-written series restarting analysis script to carry out automatic processing on the analysis file so as to obtain Z-direction displacement of points corresponding to the hyperbolic aluminum plate after rebound, taking a processing result obtained by automatic processing, corresponding pre-simulation coordinates and material parameters during analysis as input data, training a neural network model, setting the material parameters, inputting a coordinate data table, outputting coordinate correction results of the points corresponding to the hyperbolic aluminum plate based on the trained neural network model, and realizing estimation and correction of rebound errors of the hyperbolic aluminum plate. The spanning type upgrading of the springback analysis of the hyperbolic aluminum plate from 'manual trial-and-error' to 'intelligent prediction' is realized.

title_en: Intelligent identification system and identification method for transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent identification system and an identification method of a transformer substation, wherein the intelligent identification system is structurally characterized in that an intelligent identification board is in wireless connection with a handheld control device, the handheld control device comprises a touch screen controller main control chip, a touch control board and a main control unit, the touch screen controller main control chip is used for scanning nodes on a touch screen, capturing touch signals and processing and analyzing the touch signals, the touch control board is used for converting the touch signals into control signals, the main control unit is used for adjusting display information of the display board according to the control signals and outputting control instructions, the intelligent identification board comprises a receiving controller, the receiving controller is used for converting the control instructions sent by the main control unit of the handheld control device into the control signals, an LED driving unit is used for driving an LED display screen according to the control signals, and the LED display screen is used for displaying corresponding identification information according to the driving signals. The invention saves the workload and time for manually replacing the signboard, realizes the dynamic and real-time update of the transformer substation information, and improves the working efficiency of operation and maintenance personnel.

title_en: Intelligent micro-grid panoramic sensing system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twinning-based intelligent micro-grid panoramic sensing system, which relates to the technical field of micro-grid panoramic sensing and comprises a data acquisition layer, a data processing layer, a digital twinning model layer, an application service layer and a user interaction layer; the invention divides the sensor into a core layer, key equipment/nodes and an edge layer, common equipment/non-key nodes, and introduces a self-adaptive sampling frequency adjustment mechanism, dynamically adjusts the sampling frequency according to the running state of a micro-grid, reduces the frequency in the stable state, improves the frequency in the abnormal state, solves the problems of data redundancy and insufficient instantaneity of the traditional sensor network, and combines the high-precision acquisition of key data and the optimization of non-key data efficiency, the cooperative data processing of edge calculation and federal learning, and the edge calculation nodes deploy a lightweight deep learning model to realize real-time data preprocessing, filtering, denoising and feature extraction.

title_en: Method and device for detecting ancient hollyhock road and ancient tree along ancient hollyhock road in sparse shielding environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for detecting ancient hollyhock road and ancient tree along the line under a sparse shielding environment, belonging to the technical field of LiDAR data target extraction; the method comprises the steps of analyzing a high-resolution L-band SAR image, identifying vertical isolated strong reflection points or clusters as suspected tall and big ancient trees, forming a suspected cultural heritage point bitmap layer, constructing a geometric inversion model of radar imaging and ground coordinates, determining plane coordinates of suspected ancient roads and ancient trees, constructing Gao Chengjie calculation formulas applicable to ancient road slopes and ancient trees, combining projection position differences of target points in double-track SAR images, inverting to obtain three-dimensional space coordinates of the target points, and reconstructing the three-dimensional model of the ancient road surface based on point cloud density, terrain continuity and gradient analysis. The invention realizes accurate detection of the ancient ways and the ancient trees along the line in a sparse shielding environment.

title_en: Voice recognition method based on feature fusion of inertial measurement unit
abstract_en: The invention provides a voice recognition method based on feature fusion of an inertial measurement unit, which comprises the following steps of combining six-axis data of an accelerometer and a gyroscope into RGB feature images to obtain time-frequency feature images of the accelerometer and the gyroscope, respectively obtaining high-level features through multiple layers of CNNs, respectively enhancing the high-level features of the accelerometer and the gyroscope through a channel attention module, mutually calibrating the features of the accelerometer and the gyroscope through a spatial attention weight, carrying out feature fusion on the features after the spatial attention calibration through a gating fusion module, carrying out multi-scale fusion on the fused features through an FPN module, and finally classifying and recognizing through a classifier module. According to the invention, through fusing the multi-axis data of the accelerometer and the gyroscope, the effective perception range can be expanded by the complementary information, the sound characteristics are restored together, and the recognition of the voice of the wireless earphone wearer and the sound of the earphone loudspeaker is realized under the ultralow sampling rate.

title_en: List field dynamic rendering method and system based on custom form configuration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a list field dynamic rendering method based on user-defined form configuration, which comprises the steps of S1, configuring a user-defined form through a graphical interface or a code mode and defining field information of the user-defined form, S2, analyzing the user-defined form configured by the user, extracting the field information and generating field objects so as to obtain analyzed field entities and form configuration information, wherein the field entities are used for rendering a list, the form configuration is used for rendering the form and providing user input information, S3, dynamically generating a list template containing required fields based on the field objects, and S4, rendering the field objects into an inputtable form and providing the inputtable form to user filling content. Corresponding systems, electronic devices, and computer-readable storage media are also disclosed.

title_en: Big data-based computer data management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of big data processing, and particularly discloses a computer data management system based on big data. The system comprises a distributed data acquisition module, an intelligent storage scheduling engine, a fusion computing framework, a self-adaptive strategy center, a multi-level safety protection system, an attribute-based decryption and dynamic desensitization system, wherein the distributed data acquisition module captures multi-source data through an API gateway and a crawler and embeds quality labels, the intelligent storage scheduling engine adopts a columnar and distributed hybrid architecture to realize automatic migration of cold and hot data, the computing framework is fused, the flow processing and the batch processing resource execution feature extraction are dynamically coordinated, the self-adaptive strategy center generates data partitioning and encryption strategies based on reinforcement learning, and the attribute-based decryption and dynamic desensitization are deployed. The method solves the problems of resource scheduling stiffness and safety protection hysteresis in the prior art, reduces the storage cost by more than 40%, compresses the inquiry delay to within 200ms, and is suitable for real-time decision scenes in the electronic commerce and financial fields.

title_en: Question answering method, device, equipment and storage medium based on multi-model collaboration
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of large language models and discloses a question answering method, device, equipment and storage medium based on multi-model collaboration, wherein the method comprises the steps of responding to input question information, generating first conclusion information corresponding to the question information through a first large language model; generating correction information corresponding to the first conclusion information through a second large language model based on the first conclusion information and the problem information; and generating and displaying second conclusion information of the problem information through a third large language model according to the first conclusion information, the problem information and the correction information. The application can effectively improve the accuracy of question answering.

title_en: Building function vertical distribution estimation method based on mobile phone signaling data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of space planning, in particular to a building function vertical distribution estimation method based on mobile phone signaling data, which comprises the steps of extracting user travel data, spatially superposing and analyzing building data, extracting stable living users, calculating sample expansion living population, integrating multi-source data, screening POIs (point of interest), calculating density proportion by an inverse distance weighting method, judging function types by a threshold value, constructing a consumption coefficient model, solving, extracting a base and floors, calculating living space amount according to the function types, and outputting distribution according to height classification. According to the building function vertical distribution estimation method based on the mobile phone signaling data, the actual situation that a plurality of functional areas exist in a single building is fully considered, the building function vertical distribution estimation method based on the mobile phone signaling data is constructed from the vertical angle, and the mobile phone signaling technology is utilized to observe and analyze the commuting behaviors of mobile phone users, so that the rapid and automatic classification of large-scale buildings is realized.

title_en: Separation layer grouting safety zone determining method, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining a separation layer grouting safety zone, a storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of respectively collecting a rock stratum sample of each rock stratum of a region to be grouting after determining the region to be grouting; the method comprises the steps of preparing each rock stratum sample into a corresponding standard test piece, carrying out a physical experiment on the standard test piece to obtain corresponding physical mechanical parameters, establishing a mining area numerical simulation model and a mining area physical similarity simulation model according to the physical mechanical parameters to obtain a first grouting safety area and a second grouting safety area, determining working face mining height and rock stratum bending parameters in the mining area numerical simulation model or the mining area physical similarity simulation model, calculating a third grouting safety area according to the working face mining height and the rock stratum bending parameters, and determining a target grouting safety area according to the first grouting safety area, the second grouting safety area and the third grouting safety area. By implementing the method, the separation layer grouting safety zone is accurately determined before coal mining, the aquifer is protected, and the safety is improved.

title_en: Medical image analysis method and device based on oviduct dissection segmentation
abstract_en: The application relates to a medical image analysis method and equipment based on oviduct dissection, which comprises the steps of obtaining a laparoscope image, extracting flow direction and speed information of blood to generate a blood flow direction diagram, dividing an oviduct into three areas of an umbrella part, an ampullate part and an isthmus part, extracting and marking the structural edges of the three areas to generate an anatomical structure boundary diagram, carrying out image fusion processing on the blood flow direction diagram and the anatomical structure boundary diagram to identify a blood flow abnormal concentration area, carrying out image segmentation and pathological feature identification on the blood flow abnormal concentration area, judging whether pathological tissues exist or not, marking the area if so, and generating prompt information. By means of the technical scheme, through analyzing the blood flow direction and speed and combining the dissection segmentation of the fallopian tube, the position of a bleeding point can be accurately identified, an abnormal blood flow area can be timely found, and a doctor is assisted in making a more accurate and safe decision in the operation process.

title_en: Parking space rendering method, electronic equipment, storage medium, program product and vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to a parking space rendering method, electronic equipment, a storage medium, a program product and a vehicle, when the application renders a parking space, under the condition that the parking space to be rendered comprises at least two, clustering the to-be-rendered parking spaces according to at least two kinds of clustering conditions to obtain at least one parking space group, so that the parking spaces in the clustered parking space group are rendered. According to the embodiment of the application, the parking spaces to be rendered are clustered for multiple times, and the rendering display of the parking spaces is realized by using a clustered parking space group, so that the parking space rendering efficiency can be improved, the error in the process of parking space rendering is reduced, the precision of parking space rendering is improved, and the self-help parking accuracy and reliability of vehicles can be further improved.

title_en: Pulmonary respiration monitoring system and method based on LSTM neural network multi-sign fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lung respiration monitoring system and method based on LSTM neural network multi-sign fusion, which realize the dynamic monitoring of multi-sign parameter cooperation by collecting physiological parameters and lung respiration sound signals of users; the method and the device are used for determining the probability threshold of the user in the current monitoring period by utilizing the historical probability threshold data of the user, based on the probability threshold data, the probability threshold of the user can be generated for different users, so that the self-adaptive change of the alarm threshold based on the patient is realized, and finally, the probability threshold and the lung respiration health probability are sent to the medical care terminal, so that an accurate auxiliary basis can be provided for medical care personnel.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for centralized management of multi-storage financial images
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, equipment and a medium for centralized management of multi-storage financial images, belonging to the technical field of data storage; the method comprises the steps of establishing a storage strategy rule base, defining a mapping relation between file attributes and storage modules, receiving financial image files, identifying the file attributes, selecting a target storage module by combining the storage strategy rule base, configuring a base path according to an enterprise organization architecture, generating a dynamic image storage path according to the selected target storage module, splicing the final storage path, executing storage of the financial image files, establishing a unified metadata base, establishing a real-time index for the financial image files, establishing a unified retrieval interface based on the real-time index, responding to a combined query request, and executing file operation. According to the application, through multi-module storage, the financial image management efficiency is improved, the storage cost is reduced, the data safety is ensured, and the enterprise operation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Medical experiment flow optimization method and system based on multi-mode data
abstract_en: The invention provides a medical experiment flow optimization method and system based on multi-modal data, which comprises the steps of firstly acquiring a multi-modal medical data set of a target medical experiment scene, recording at least two acquisition time points of multi-modal data containing images, time sequences and text mode data, extracting features from the multi-modal data in a cross-modal mode, carrying out standardized alignment treatment to obtain a standardized cross-modal feature set, carrying out weighting fusion on different modal features based on a dynamic weight adjustment strategy to generate a target fusion feature set, calling a flow optimization analysis model to carry out experiment flow state identification on the target fusion feature set, obtaining an optimization strategy set containing equipment operation, resource allocation and data acquisition time sequence adjustment parameters, finally inputting the optimization strategy set into a pre-trained flow execution verification model to carry out feasibility verification, outputting verified execution parameters and triggering a medical experiment device to execute optimization operation, and realizing optimization of a medical experiment flow.

title_en: Feed proportioning optimization method and configuration equipment based on laying hen growth characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a feed proportioning optimization method and configuration equipment based on the growth characteristics of laying hens, and mainly relates to the field of laying hen cultivation. The weighing device is matched with each laying hen to carry out weighing detection on the weight of the laying hen, the weighing device is connected with the sub-control board in a data mode, and the sub-control board is connected with the integrated control system in a data mode so that the sub-control board can transmit data to the integrated control system. The method has the beneficial effects that the method can scientifically feed and forecast the laying hens with different ages, so that when the laying hens are fed by workers, the laying hens can be fed better by combining the conditions of the laying hens, and the economic benefit brought by the feed feeding process of a farm is maximized.

title_en: Ultra-large-space bumper car CAVE projection interaction system and interaction method
abstract_en: A bumper car CAVE projection interaction system and method in ultra-large space belong to the technical field of projection interaction and are used for solving the problems of high cost, poor applicability, positioning drift error, tracking lag and the like of the existing camera-based visual identification scheme and the ultra-wideband wireless positioning technical scheme. The system comprises a collision vehicle position recognition subsystem, a server computer host and a CAVE projection game subsystem, wherein the collision vehicle position recognition subsystem is used for acquiring preliminary positioning information and motion data of a collision vehicle and sending the preliminary positioning information and the motion data to the server computer host, the server computer host is used for preprocessing the preliminary positioning information and the motion data respectively, then carrying out data fusion to acquire accurate positioning information of the collision vehicle and sending the accurate positioning information to the CAVE projection game subsystem, and the CAVE projection game subsystem is used for driving a projector on a wall surface and the ground according to the received information to realize real-time interaction between the collision vehicle and a game scene and between the collision vehicle and the collision vehicle. The invention is suitable for the CAVE projection interaction of the dodgem in an ultra-large space.

title_en: Smoke self-adaptive elimination method and system based on visible light video
abstract_en: The invention discloses a smoke self-adaptive elimination method and system based on visible light video, which belong to the technical field of image processing and comprise the following steps of S1, acquiring a real-time image I  b  of a fire region, S2, converting the real-time image I  b  into a gray image I  gray , normalizing gray values in the gray image I  gray  to generate an initial binary mask, judging whether the initial binary mask contains a smoke region or not, S3, removing mist in a region covered by a final mask in the gray image I  gray , S4, denoising a processed image by adopting dark channel prior treatment on the dense mist region to obtain a denoised image, and fusing the denoised image with an image J after removing the mist to output a fused image. The method can avoid the problems of detail loss, noise amplification, color distortion and edge artifact caused by a dark channel algorithm, so that the image defogging effect is better, and the method has positive significance for the image identification of the fire scene.

title_en: Man-car intersection detection method based on tracking
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of target detection, in particular to a man-vehicle intersection detection method based on tracking. The method comprises the following steps of S1, capturing image frames from a video stream and a still camera, preprocessing the captured image frames, S2, detecting and processing the same image by using a YOL0v4 pedestrian detection model and a YOLOv vehicle detection model, and outputting a pedestrian boundary frame and a vehicle boundary frame, so that pedestrians and vehicles on the same image are respectively output, and the subsequent processing efficiency is improved. And S3, tracking the detected pedestrians and vehicles by using DeepSort tracking models, so that the method is more suitable for multi-target tracking tasks in various scenes, and stability and accuracy are improved. S4, analyzing the motion trail and state of each target through a state tracking model according to the tracking result, S5, analyzing the relative positions and motion trends of pedestrians and vehicles by using a decision and risk assessment model, and judging whether crossing and potential dangerous situations exist.

title_en: Intelligent body method and system for continuous evolution of robot operation skills
abstract_en: The invention discloses an agent method and a system for continuous evolution of robot operation skills, comprising a skill sharing semantic rendering module, a skill sharing representation distillation module and a skill specific evolution planner, aiming at long-term challenges of 3D scene representation and human task learning faced by a robot when adapting to a new sequence task in an actual scene, the invention can continuously learn new 3D scene semantics and robot operation skills from skill sharing and skill specific attributes, wherein the skill sharing semantic rendering module and the skill sharing representation distillation module effectively learn 3D scene semantics by means of a nerve radiation field and a visual basic model, solve the problem of 3D scene representation neglect, and continuously embed new skill specific knowledge by using the skill specific evolution planner through potential and low-rank space decoupling skill knowledge. The invention also designs a robot operation reference, and experiments show that the performance of the method in a robot operation task is obviously improved.

title_en: Intelligent matching and energy consumption compensation method for screw speed of extruder based on deep learning
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent matching and energy consumption compensation method for screw speed of an extruder based on deep learning, which relates to the technical field of monitoring and analysis and comprises the steps of collecting corresponding operation state parameters and material characteristic parameters of the extruder, constructing a material-equipment coupling data set, carrying out screw equivalent torque analysis based on the material-equipment coupling data set to generate a screw load characteristic map, carrying out temperature-pressure coupling field evolution simulation according to the screw load characteristic map to obtain melt phase change process parameters so as to generate an intelligent speed control curve, establishing an energy consumption compensation coefficient matrix, carrying out phase difference compensation mapping on the energy consumption compensation coefficient matrix according to electric parameter characteristics of a driving motor winding of the extruder to generate an energy consumption compensation instruction set, constructing an energy consumption dynamic balance model, carrying out online optimization on the energy consumption dynamic balance model to generate a screw speed-energy consumption cooperative controller and deploying the screw load characteristic map to an edge computing terminal.

title_en: Intelligent substation monitoring system based on graph self-generation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a substation intelligent monitoring system based on graphic self-generation, which relates to the field of substation monitoring, and comprises a data acquisition module, a model analysis module, a layout calculation module, a graphic rendering module and an exception processing module, wherein the data acquisition module acquires equipment real-time data through an IEC61850 protocol and stores the equipment real-time data into a time sequence database InfluxDB, the model analysis module analyzes a standardized model file in an XML format to construct a topological structure in a memory, the layout calculation module calls a dynamic layout algorithm to generate equipment position coordinates, the graphic rendering module draws equipment graphics by using WebGL, updates colors and sizes according to the real-time data, and triggers an alarm and records the alarm to a log file when the absence of a model field is detected. On the basis of multi-element data acquisition, the invention can realize automatic graphic configuration by using the state-color mapping model and the numerical value-size mapping model in the graphic rendering module, thereby having simple maintenance and high flexibility and improving the efficiency.

title_en: Batch program production method and system for energy storage converter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a batch program production method and a system of an energy storage converter, comprising the steps of obtaining a user configuration file and a history item configuration template; and uploading the content of the configuration change to different blocks of the block chain network when the configuration change is carried out, wherein each block comprises a previous block hash value. The method has the main technical scheme and the effect that the flexibility of program configuration is obviously improved, the flexible combination of parameters and functional modules is realized by establishing the general core program and the specification of configuration files, the method can be rapidly adapted to the differentiated requirements of different projects and areas, and the production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Information security professional education system and method based on large language model agent
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence and education intersection, and relates to an information security professional education system and method based on a large language model agent, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition and storage module, a data processing module and a data processing module, wherein the data acquisition and storage module is used for acquiring and storing information security professional student data and teaching data; the intelligent agent module is used for constructing a multi-agent large language model agent for the information security professional teaching scene, and the information security domain professional knowledge representation and reasoning module is used for constructing a time-series and reasoning knowledge system for information security education so as to provide knowledge support for the multi-agent large language model agent. The method creatively builds a time-sequential and inferable knowledge system oriented to information security education, and can provide accurate, time-efficient and inferable knowledge support for teaching tasks through a retrieval enhancement generation mechanism.

title_en: Feature hierarchical type attention fusion and dynamic optimization method for single-stage target detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a feature hierarchical type attention fusion and dynamic optimization method for single-stage target detection, and relates to the technical field of computer vision. The method comprises the steps of collecting image data, preprocessing an image, dividing the image into a training set, a testing set and a verification set, utilizing a dynamic up-sampling single pixel point sampling and recovering feature resolution by a HAF-DRFPN neck network, utilizing a gating residual mechanism and depth separable convolution optimization feature extraction, introducing a feature refining feed-forward network through multi-layer perception generation weight, enhancing feature expression, utilizing channels, spatial attention and cross attention to capture and fuse shallow detail and deep semantic information respectively, adopting a multi-branch dynamic sampling stacking architecture, self-adaptively fusing and optimizing trans-scale features, and utilizing an overall architecture multi-module collaborative process to provide more discriminative multi-scale features for a detection head, and forming a model HAF-DRNet suitable for target detection by connecting a YOLO12 trunk and a detection head with the HAF-DRFPN.

title_en: E-business generation operation heterogeneous system adaptation and data synchronization method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of E-business operation, in particular to an adaptation and data synchronization method of an E-business operation heterogeneous system, which realizes data conversion between heterogeneous E-business systems by constructing a transfer unified data model and an adapter, utilizes a data synchronization engine to manage data synchronization tasks, ensures the efficiency and accuracy of data synchronization, solves the problem of data synchronization of the E-business operation heterogeneous system in the prior art, provides effective data support for the E-business operation, simultaneously carries out suitability test processing to judge whether the performance of the adapter in the heterogeneous system is stable or not so as to ensure the data suitability of the heterogeneous system, simultaneously deeply analyzes the data integrity before and after the adapter processing so as to ensure the data consistency and the data integrity before and after the adapter processing, effectively reduces service faults caused by data synchronization problems and carries out consistency analysis and synchronization performance analysis before and after the data synchronization so as to realize the overall supervision of the data synchronization.

title_en: Time-space characteristic fusion concrete arch dam deformation prediction method based on multi-scale hierarchical clustering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-scale hierarchical clustering-based space-time feature fusion concrete arch dam deformation prediction method which comprises the steps of decomposing a dam deformation sequence into trend, period and fluctuation items, constructing new multi-scale similarity distance indexes, adopting a hierarchical clustering method based on Ward criteria, utilizing the constructed multi-scale similarity distance indexes to cluster deformation measuring points with similar deformation rules, constructing a deep learning model TCT-CANet fused with space-time features, predicting the deformation of the concrete arch dam by utilizing the constructed TCT-CANet model, evaluating the prediction performance of the model through various evaluation indexes, analyzing the effect of each module on space-time feature capturing and prediction precision improvement through an ablation experiment, and comparing the TCT-CANet model with various time sequence prediction methods on all measuring points to verify the superiority and generalization capability of the model. According to the invention, a prediction model TCT-CANet based on space-time feature fusion is constructed, and accurate prediction of concrete arch dam deformation is realized.

title_en: Prediction boundary box dynamic correction method based on multidimensional kinematic features
abstract_en: The invention provides a prediction boundary frame dynamic correction method based on multidimensional kinematic features, and belongs to the technical field of prediction boundary frame dynamic correction. The method comprises the following steps of parameter initialization and data preparation, track effectiveness judgment, border frame offset calculation based on historical displacement offset, track acceleration calculation, turning state detection, border frame offset calculation combined with displacement offset, acceleration and turning state, self-adaptive threshold calculation based on recent movement trend reliability, border frame offset adjustment combined with self-adaptive threshold, and adjustment of an original prediction border frame. The invention can dynamically adjust parameters without additional training data, can be integrated into the existing tracking or predicting system as a light module, can effectively reduce the prediction error of the boundary frame, improves the target positioning stability in complex dynamic scenes, and saves hardware cost and deployment complexity.

title_en: Remote sensing image production system and method based on plug-in registration management
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing image production system and a remote sensing image production method based on plug-in registration management, which relate to the technical field of data processing, wherein a registration management module is used for isolating and storing plug-ins to obtain a plurality of plug-in elements, corresponding to plug-in identity codes corresponding to a plurality of plug-in element marks, determining available plug-ins in the plurality of plug-in elements and registering, establishing a backup chain between the plug-in elements with the registered plug-in elements and a processing pool, and a plug-in calling module is connected with the registration management module and used for determining plug-in chains corresponding to remote sensing data, wherein the plug-in chains are formed by a plurality of plug-in identity codes according to the sequence, calling the plug-in corresponding plug-in elements based on the plug-in chains and migrate to the processing pool, and the processing module is connected with the plug-in calling module and used for inputting a remote sensing image to the processing pool for processing, and simultaneously, the plug-in can recover the status of the plug-in processed data rapidly and accurately, avoid the initialization of the plug-in before the crash, and ensure the plug-in recovery efficiency and quality.

title_en: Work order processing method, device, equipment and storage medium based on large model
abstract_en: The application discloses a large-model-based work order processing method, device, equipment and storage medium, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, comprising the steps of obtaining a target work order to be processed in government industry, extracting target elements in the target work order to be processed based on target prompt words by utilizing a target large model, and carrying out multidimensional verification on the target elements to obtain a target verification result; the method comprises the steps of determining a target problem type corresponding to a target to-be-processed work order by using a target large model, determining a target label corresponding to the target to-be-processed work order based on a preset label library and the target problem type, determining a target work order receiving department corresponding to the target to-be-processed work order based on the target label, and determining a target historical case corresponding to the target to-be-processed work order based on a preset machine learning algorithm, so that the target work order receiving department processes the target to-be-processed work order based on target government industry knowledge, target elements, target verification results and target historical cases. The application can improve the efficiency and accuracy of work order processing.

title_en: Personalized employment guidance service system based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a personalized employment guidance service system based on data analysis, which relates to the technical field of data processing and comprises a user characteristic analysis module, a post label generation module, a characteristic weight construction module, a candidate post generation module, a difference characteristic priority screening module, a group feedback adjustment module and a recommendation result generation module. The system decomposes features such as academic, specialty, skill and interest to form basic features and rare features, and combines post tag weight distribution and user feature vector construction to generate a candidate post set. Further, through difference calculation and self-adaptive threshold screening, posts with rare characteristics are reserved preferentially, dynamic index reconstruction is carried out on post labels by combining group feedback, and finally, personalized recommendation results are output, so that recommendation differentiation and post distribution balance are realized.

title_en: Charging pile coordinate system construction method and device, readable storage medium and robot
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a charging pile coordinate system construction method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the steps of obtaining laser radar point cloud data of a robot, collected by a charging pile, determining a first symmetry axis according to the laser radar point cloud data, determining a coordinate system transformation matrix transformed from the charging pile coordinate system to the robot coordinate system according to the first symmetry axis and a second symmetry axis, wherein the second symmetry axis is a longitudinal axis of the robot coordinate system, and constructing the charging pile coordinate system according to the robot coordinate system and the coordinate system transformation matrix. According to the application, the charging pile coordinate system can be automatically constructed according to the laser radar point cloud data, so that the complex operation of manual participation is avoided, the introduction of human errors is avoided, and the precision is higher.

title_en: Transient electromagnetic inversion method based on deep neural network heavy parameter regularization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transient electromagnetic inversion method based on depth neural network heavy parameter regularization, which belongs to the field of geophysical electromagnetic data processing and analysis technology research and comprises the steps of constructing an untrained depth neural network, inputting random hidden vectors conforming to a depth neural network input layer structure and boundary values of resistivity and stratum thickness required by transient electromagnetic inversion into the depth neural network, outputting a geological model containing regularization effect, carrying out iterative update on a transient electromagnetic inversion objective function by a self-adaptive moment estimation algorithm, judging whether convergence conditions are met or not, taking the weight of each layer of network of the depth neural network as a variable to be updated if the convergence conditions are not met, and iteratively updating the weight of each layer of network so that the depth neural network generates a new geological model containing regularization effect. The invention not only ensures that the regularization effect on the generated geological model is easily applied to physical constraint without external training data, but also has good noise immunity.

title_en: TTL circuit compatible with multiple communication protocols
abstract_en: The invention discloses a TTL circuit compatible with various communication protocols, which comprises a mode selection module, a main control module and a multi-protocol conversion module, wherein the mode selection module is used for outputting a mode selection instruction, a control signal input end of the main control module is connected with an output end of the mode selection module, the main control module is used for outputting a mode switching signal according to the mode selection instruction so as to switch the communication mode of the TTL circuit, an input end of the multi-protocol conversion module is connected with a control signal output end of the main control module, and an output end of the multi-protocol conversion module is used for executing the switching of the communication mode according to the mode switching signal. The TTL circuit can be in communication connection and debugging with various communication protocol devices without additional configuration of special communication conversion devices, so that compatibility and universality are greatly improved, and the risk of unstable communication signal transmission caused by signal interference due to different compatibility among various communication modules is avoided.

title_en: LIMS report management method, equipment and medium based on blockchain
abstract_en: The application discloses a block chain-based LIMS report management method, equipment and medium, and relates to the technical field of computers, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining management report data of a laboratory, and performing chained hash computation on the management report data to obtain a report hash value; the report hash value is used as a uplink request, a consensus achievement report is determined through PBFT consensus based on the uplink request, audit signature processing is conducted on the consensus achievement report to obtain a consensus achievement report of the digital signature of the associated audit node, the Merkle root hash written into the blockchain is determined through Merkle tree construction according to the consensus achievement report of the digital signature of the associated audit node, and link collaborative traceability analysis is conducted on management report data to obtain the mapping relation between the consensus achievement report and the content addressing hash. The method solves the technical problems of data credibility and cross-mechanism trust existing in report management of the existing LIMS system.

title_en: AI dialogue prompt word optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AI dialogue prompt word optimization method and system, the method comprises the steps of respectively inputting each candidate prompt word into a preset text model, outputting candidate texts corresponding to each candidate prompt word by the text model, determining first semantic similarity between each candidate text and an original text of an original prompt word, determining second semantic similarity between each candidate text and the corresponding candidate prompt word, determining a target candidate prompt word set according to the first semantic similarity and the second semantic similarity, and fusing each target candidate prompt word in the target candidate prompt word set with the original prompt word by adopting a preset optimization rule to obtain a final optimized target prompt word. The accuracy of the optimization of the prompt words in the AI dialogue can be remarkably improved.

title_en: Multi-VSG-VSC grid-connected system interaction quantification and stability analysis method, system and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for interaction quantification and stability analysis of a multi-VSG-VSC grid-connected system and a readable storage medium, belonging to the field of stability analysis of an electric power system; the problem of systematic instability caused by interaction of the traditional multi-VSC grid-connected system after interconnection is solved; the technical scheme is as follows: the method comprises the following steps: establishing a state space model of a VSC grid-connected system based on VSG control; quantifying interaction intensity inside the VSG-VSC grid-connected system and between each VSG-VSC grid-connected system, establishing a connection between the interaction intensity inside the VSG-VSC grid-connected system and between each VSG-VSC grid-connected system and a small interference stability margin of the grid system, and analyzing the influence of the interaction intensity inside the VSG-VSC grid-connected system and the interaction intensity between each VSG-VSC grid-connected system on the stability of the grid; the method is applied to stability analysis of the power grid system.

title_en: Online document processing method and device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a processing method, a device and a storage medium of an online document, which are used for responding to online document creation operation of a first object to create an initial online document, wherein the initial online document comprises a region to be filled, responding to collection table creation operation of the first object to create a collection table associated with the initial online document, the collection table comprises collection items, the region to be filled is associated with the collection items, responding to release operation of the first object on the collection table to fill the collection table to a second object, responding to submitting operation of the second object on the collection table after the collection items are filled, acquiring filling content of the second object aiming at the collection items, and filling the filling content into the region to be filled in the initial online document to obtain the target online document. The embodiment of the application can improve the accuracy of the generated document by utilizing the collection table to assist in creating the target online document, thereby meeting the requirements of quick response and large-scale application.

title_en: Dynamic scene robust visual SLAM method based on multi-feature collaborative optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic scene robust visual SLAM method based on multi-feature collaborative optimization, which comprises the following steps of obtaining an image sequence, carrying out dynamic target detection and segmentation through an instance segmentation network, generating a segmentation mask containing dynamic region marks, identifying and separating dynamic objects and static backgrounds, removing feature points corresponding to the dynamic objects based on the segmentation mask to obtain static feature points, carrying out pose estimation based on the static feature points, carrying out feature matching on a key frame by minimizing a reprojection error and a previous key frame, solving to obtain camera poses of each key frame, carrying out camera pose tracking and data association on the previous frame by adopting an optical flow algorithm for a non-key frame, accumulating solving results, and obtaining pose tracks of each non-key frame.

title_en: Frequency control method and system for nerve processing unit
abstract_en: A frequency control method for a neural processing unit according to at least one embodiment includes receiving information about a neural network model to be executed on the Neural Processing Unit (NPU), extracting static feature data determined during an off-line time of the neural network model and dynamic feature data determined during a run time of the neural network model from the information about the NPU and the information about the neural network model, generating a prediction model for predicting an operating frequency of the NPU for executing the neural network model based on the static feature data and the dynamic feature data, and controlling the operating frequency of the NPU based on the prediction model.

title_en: Deep learning signal type identification method based on variable-length multidimensional input
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of signal processing, and provides a depth learning signal type identification method based on non-fixed-length multidimensional input, which comprises the steps of respectively carrying out continuous wavelet transformation processing and discrete wavelet transformation processing on original data of a signal to be predicted to obtain continuous wavelet transformation characteristic data and discrete wavelet transformation characteristic data; and carrying out normalization processing on the original data, the continuous wavelet transformation characteristic data and the discrete wavelet transformation characteristic data, and inputting the normalized data, the continuous wavelet transformation characteristic data and the discrete wavelet transformation characteristic data into a pre-trained deep learning network for signal type identification. The invention performs high-dimensional feature extraction and feature compression on the original signal and corresponding continuous wavelet transformation data and discrete wavelet transformation data through the deep learning multi-mode network to finish the recognition of the signal type, can obtain the representative feature expression in the time domain, the frequency domain and the time-frequency domain, and improves the comprehensiveness and the discriminant of the features.

title_en: Image processing method and corresponding device
abstract_en: The application provides an image processing method which can be applied to various scenes needing image processing, such as auxiliary driving, automatic driving, AR, VR, high-precision mapping, three-dimensional scene reconstruction and the like. The method comprises the steps of reconstructing a generalization scene of target features based on a plurality of first images to obtain a second image of a second visual angle, wherein the target features are obtained based on the first images, the target features comprise space geometric features of scenes from which the plurality of first images are derived, the second visual angle is different from the first visual angle, and the second image is output. The application uses the space geometric feature of the scene from which the first image is derived in the scene reconstruction process, so that when reconstructing the second image of the new view angle, the space information of the new view angle and the image content of the new view angle can be better determined by utilizing the space geometric feature, thereby increasing the image reconstruction range, improving the generalization capability of image processing and improving the quality (such as definition) of the second image.

title_en: Mobile terminal waterfall stream display method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a mobile terminal waterfall stream display method, device equipment and storage medium, and relates to the technical field of mobile terminal interface display, wherein the method comprises the steps of initializing a data source to be displayed, creating WaterfallCollectionViewLayout and performing layout parameter setting; initializing a column height group, calculating to obtain the layout attribute of each element in the data source, determining the position of each element in the column, obtaining the layout attribute of the elements in the designated area, calculating UICollectionView the content size to obtain the total height of all the elements after being laid out, and implementing related protocols in the view controller to display the elements in UICollectionView according to the layout attribute of the elements. The application can effectively realize the waterfall flow demonstration in the iOS system.

title_en: Data integration method and device for crop phenotype accurate identification
abstract_en: The invention provides a data integration method and device for crop phenotype accurate identification, the method comprises the steps of constructing a cloud platform for crop phenotype accurate identification, interconnecting the cloud platform with data acquisition equipment through a network, constructing a corresponding data acquisition model aiming at the data acquisition equipment, acquiring data acquisition tasks through the cloud platform and distributing the data acquisition tasks to the data acquisition equipment, acquiring crop phenotype data and environment type data, respectively collecting and processing the crop phenotype data in different data formats, associating the structured phenotype data to be integrated with the environment type data, and further associating and aligning the unstructured phenotype data to be integrated to obtain multi-mode fusion data of each crop variety. The invention is beneficial to improving the accuracy and reliability of accurate identification of the crop phenotype by integrating the multisource and multisystem data of the crop phenotype, and has important significance for improving the crop breeding efficiency and accelerating the breeding process of new varieties.

title_en: Heterogeneous stratum physical and chemical parameter simulation model establishment and simulation method and device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of oil and gas exploration, and provides a method and a device for establishing and simulating a heterogeneous stratum physical and chemical parameter simulation model. The method comprises the steps of obtaining logging data and geological data corresponding to a target stratum, establishing a first geological model according to the logging data and the geological data, carrying out global prediction on temperature distribution conditions and pressure distribution conditions in the first geological model by means of stratum temperature data and stratum pressure data in the logging data to obtain a second geological model, carrying out generalization on porosity and permeability in the second geological model by means of the logging data to obtain a third geological model, and carrying out visual fluid field-chemical field simulation on the third geological model based on fracture position and lithology pore permeability information of the third geological model and coupling characteristics of fluid flow and chemical reaction to obtain a physical and chemical parameter simulation model. By the embodiment of the application, the dynamic change process of the physical and chemical parameters of the heterogeneous stratum can be rapidly and accurately simulated.

title_en: Calculation method and system for air defense weapon fight coordination efficiency
abstract_en: The invention provides a calculation method and a system for the fight matching efficiency of an air defense weapon, and relates to the technical field of air defense weapons as a whole. The invention can measure the fight matching efficiency by using a unified quantization standard, accurately evaluate the fight matching effect, and is more in line with the actual design situation of the fight system of the air defense weapon.

title_en: Multi-industry supply chain plan configuration method
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-industry supply chain plan configuration method, which is characterized in that time sequence data of multi-industry supply chain business are converted into event-driven grammar structures, a unified data analysis layer is constructed through a domain specific language, business rules of cross industries are decomposed into configurable DSL semantic units to form an atomization rule discrimination module, the DSL semantic units are analyzed and executed in real time through a dynamic rule engine, interaction of the business rules and the execution engine is realized based on a DSL compiler to generate supply chain plan configuration results which can be suitable for different industries, and dynamic aggregation, subtraction and prediction error analysis are carried out on the supply chain data through a time sequence calculation frame to generate real-time business guiding indexes. The scheme realizes cross-industry rapid adaptation through DSL unified abstract business rules, dynamic configuration of rules supports millisecond level validation, a visual DSL editor reduces coding requirements, and a time sequence calculation framework combines complex aggregation and loop detection.

title_en: Food image labeling method and system based on multi-information fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a food image labeling method and a food image labeling system based on multi-information fusion, and relates to the technical field of computer vision, wherein the method comprises the following steps of 1, acquiring food images to be labeled, and synchronously acquiring shooting angles, distances between a terminal and food and shooting directions through a mobile terminal sensor; and step 3, performing graph cutting circulation processing on a target area of the preliminary target detection result, and generating binary mask data of the food area by combining morphological corrosion and expansion. According to the method, the food image is marked by fusing the multidimensional information, the food examples are identified and distinguished, a comprehensive and accurate marking result is provided for food related analysis application, and the marking quality and efficiency are improved.

title_en: Fruit fly feeding behavior analysis method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for analyzing feeding behaviors of drosophila, which relate to the technical field of insect behavior analysis and comprise the following steps: and setting different environment parameter groups, carrying out a fruit fly feeding monitoring test, collecting motion videos of a single fruit fly at a feeding device, and dividing frames such as the videos into continuous characteristic segments. And determining the starting point and the end point of each round of suspected food taking process by analyzing the characteristic fragments, and acquiring food surface images before and after suspected food taking. And comparing the structural characteristic changes of the surface images before and after suspected feeding, judging whether feeding behavior occurs, if so, defining the round of process as feeding process, and representing the feeding amount based on the surface characteristic changes. The method has the advantages that the time resolution and the result accuracy are remarkable, and particularly the short-time feeding behaviors of the drosophila can be analyzed.

title_en: Storage particle pre-screening method and device, storage control chip and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for pre-screening storage particles, a storage control chip and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of executing first-round local scanning on Flash to generate a first-round local scanning result, judging whether the Flash is medium-high quality Flash or not based on the first-round local scanning result, and judging whether the Flash is low-quality Flash or not if the first-round local scanning result does not reach a first preset standard. After the Flash is subjected to the first round of local scanning according to the preset standard, determining which quality interval the Flash is located in according to whether the result of the first round of local scanning meets the standard requirement, and because the local scanning is adopted, compared with the full-disc scanning, the quality screening of the Flash by a storage product manufacturer can be quickened through the local scanning, the mass production efficiency of the storage product is further improved, and the quick stock preparation of the storage product manufacturer is quickened.

title_en: Managed nonvolatile memory device with data verification
abstract_en: Various examples are directed to systems and methods involving managed NAND non-volatile memory devices including memory arrays and memory controllers. The memory controller may receive a verification request from a requesting device, the verification request including an indication of a first portion of the memory array, and a first known check value. The memory controller may apply operations to generate a calculated check value based at least in part on first data from the first portion of the memory array and determine verification result data based at least in part on the first known check value and the calculated check value.

title_en: Auxiliary identification method and system for industrial injury based on double-path retrieval enhancement generation
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method and a system for assisting in identifying a work injury based on two-way retrieval enhancement generation, which relate to the technical field of artificial intelligence and assisting in identifying a work injury, and comprise the steps of obtaining multi-mode data of a wounded sport video, a medical image and a case text; the method comprises the steps of integrating semantic vectors of images, texts and videos into unified semantic expression vectors, inputting the semantic expression vectors into a double-path retrieval enhancement generation model, inputting the semantic expression vectors into the double-path retrieval enhancement generation model, respectively entering a rule structured knowledge graph retrieval path and a historical case semantic retrieval path, extracting final expression of each node in the rule structured knowledge graph by the rule structured knowledge graph retrieval path, and performing rule node path expansion to obtain a rule graph matching basis chain, and calculating historical related cases by the historical case semantic retrieval path through semantic similarity to obtain case core abstract information. The present disclosure improves the efficiency of auxiliary evaluation and enhances the interpretability of the results.

title_en: Cold quantity prediction method and device, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of cold quantity determination, and provides a cold quantity prediction method, a device, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium. The method comprises the steps of collecting multi-dimensional environment data of a cold energy demand scene, processing the multi-dimensional environment data to obtain real-time numerical characteristics, periodic numerical characteristics and discrete characteristics, embedding and fusing the real-time numerical characteristics, the periodic numerical characteristics and the discrete characteristics to obtain combined characteristic vectors, carrying out parameter integration processing on the combined characteristic vectors to obtain a plurality of scaling integrated characteristics, carrying out shared parameter transformation on the scaling integrated characteristics to obtain parameter transformation characteristics corresponding to each scaling integrated characteristic, and carrying out head-by-head aggregation prediction processing on the parameter transformation characteristics through a preset linear output head to obtain a target cold energy prediction result of the cold energy demand scene, so that cold energy prediction precision is improved, universal capability is enhanced, and resource consumption is reduced.

title_en: Remote screen-throwing control method and system based on Hongmon NEXT
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image data processing, in particular to a remote control method and a remote control system based on hong Monte NEXT. The method comprises the following steps of constructing a port mapping channel and judging the current equipment type, if the equipment type is a mobile phone, injecting a preset screen-throwing tool into a controlled end of a hong Mongolian NEXT system, extracting screen picture contents of the controlled end through the preset screen-throwing tool to form picture data, if the equipment type is a simulator, intercepting running frames of the simulator according to a preset frame rate, combining the running frames into a continuous image sequence to form the picture data, executing video coding on the picture data, transmitting the video coding to a control end in real time through the port mapping channel, receiving and decoding by the control end, rendering and displaying to obtain a visual picture. The invention realizes the cross-platform low-delay screen-throwing and high-precision remote control between the hong Mongolian NEXT real machine and the simulator by establishing the self-adaptive port mapping channel and the differential picture acquisition mechanism.

title_en: Model training method and device and electronic equipment
