abstract_en: The application provides a model training method, a model training device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of classifying sample documents in a first sample set in multiple stages based on fields, sub-fields and application scenes; training an initial model based on a data block of a sample document to obtain a first parameter adjustment file, adjusting model parameters of the initial model based on model parameters in the first parameter adjustment file to obtain a first model, training the first model based on a question-answer result of the data block and the data block to obtain a second parameter adjustment file, adjusting model parameters of the first model based on model parameters in the second parameter adjustment file to obtain a second model, optimizing the second model based on a reinforcement learning algorithm to obtain a third model, wherein the third model comprises a field, a sub-field and/or an application scene enhanced model of the sample document. The application can obtain the model with high adaptability in each sub-field of each field and each scene.

title_en: Flexible resource layered cooperative scheduling method and device considering external disturbance influence of active power distribution network
abstract_en: The application provides a flexible resource layered cooperative scheduling method and device considering the external disturbance influence of an active power distribution network, belonging to the field of operation control of power systems; the method comprises the steps of obtaining relevant data, constructing a mathematical model comprising a state space for describing the running state of the power distribution system, an action space for describing a scheduling decision, a multi-objective rewarding function for evaluating the scheduling effect and constraint conditions which the power distribution system must meet in running, dynamically switching and executing a hierarchical optimization strategy according to the real-time load loss rate of the power distribution system, training and solving the mathematical model by adopting a depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm, and outputting an optimal flexible resource collaborative scheduling strategy.

title_en: Method and device for dynamically measuring computing force of intelligent computing center cloud platform based on computing force operation task
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for dynamically measuring computing force based on a computing force operation task by an intelligent computing center cloud platform, which relate to the technical fields of intelligent computing centers, computing force infrastructures and intelligent computing clouds, wherein the method for dynamically measuring computing force based on the computing force operation task by the intelligent computing center cloud platform comprises the following steps that S1, a parameter value of first operation data of a first GPU in a first time period is obtained, and the first GPU is a GPU for operating the first computing force operation task; the method comprises the steps of S2, determining a first task type of a first computing power operation task based on a parameter value of first operation data, S3, determining a weighting coefficient corresponding to the first task type, and S4, calculating a computing power value of the first computing power operation task in the first time period based on the weighting coefficient and the parameter value of the first operation data. The invention can greatly improve the calculation force measurement accuracy of calculation force operation tasks in the intelligent calculation center cloud platform.

title_en: Special article risk monitoring and identifying method and system based on multidimensional feature capture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a special article risk monitoring and identifying method and a system based on multidimensional feature capture, and relates to the technical field of knowledge maps, wherein the method comprises the steps of extracting risk metadata of multidimensional features, correlating the risk metadata with risk factors and outputting a dynamic risk injection table; the method comprises the steps of inputting multidimensional features and a dynamic risk injection table into a risk evolution model, carrying out causal relation recognition by a causal reasoning layer, carrying out time sequence fitting by a dynamic modeling layer, constructing a risk evolution map, setting a hierarchical early warning threshold value based on the risk evolution map, carrying out deviation index calculation on the risk evolution map to obtain risk deviation, arranging and outputting a deviation analysis report, and adjusting parameters of the risk evolution model according to the deviation analysis report to generate a structured risk disposal map. According to the method, the depth fusion of the knowledge graph is realized through the risk evolution model and the risk metadata of the multi-dimensional features is extracted, and the comprehensiveness and the accuracy of risk identification are improved.

title_en: Mobile electric automobile charging service method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning
abstract_en: A mobile electric vehicle charging service method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning may include generating an electric vehicle charging demand, detecting a state of a mobile charging station, and determining an action of the mobile charging station, including moving or waiting, based on the electric vehicle charging demand and the state of the mobile charging station. The method may further include paying rewards as feedback to results including charging profits and mobile costs based on the determined actions, storing and accumulating the actions, results, and rewards as learning data, and training a multi-agent reinforcement learning model by using the accumulated learning data to generate an optimal deployment of mobile charging stations.

title_en: Project sea evaluation coordination method applied to offshore wind farm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a project sea evaluation coordination method applied to an offshore wind farm, relates to the technical field of ocean space planning, and aims to acquire ocean functional regions and ecological sensitive region distribution of a sea area where an offshore wind farm construction project is located, integrate current situation data of sea area development and utilization to obtain a sea area space dataset, analyze project sea features based on the sea area space dataset and acquire a project sea feature sequence. According to the method, the sea characteristics of the offshore wind farm project are accurately mastered by integrating the sea space data set and comprehensively analyzing the sea function regions, the ecological sensitive region distribution and the current sea development and utilization status multi-aspect information, and on the basis, the sea type, the mode, the scale and the layout are scientifically managed and optimized, so that the project is used in a more reasonable and orderly manner, the resource waste and the idle are avoided, the utilization efficiency of sea resources is effectively improved, and the efficient promotion of the offshore wind farm project construction is ensured.

title_en: Sensing method for middle-ring obstacle vehicle in automatic parking
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sensing method of a circular obstacle vehicle in automatic parking, which comprises the steps of acquiring an image acquired by a circular fish eye camera after the vehicle enters a parking state, constructing a circular obstacle detection model, wherein a target frame of the circular obstacle detection model is a rotating frame, parameters of the rotating frame comprise central point coordinates, long sides, short sides and included angles between the long sides and an x axis, classification of labels of the circular obstacle detection model comprises a vehicle side, a vehicle head and a vehicle tail, performing circular obstacle vehicle target detection on the image based on the circular obstacle detection model, converting a target detection result into ground point coordinates of the obstacle vehicle, optimizing the circular obstacle detection model, improving the sensing precision of the obstacle vehicle, enabling a ground point of a regression vehicle to be more accurate, converting the ground point of the regression vehicle into world coordinates, and facilitating fusion use.

title_en: Self-checking and self-repairing method and device for electronic equipment, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of automatic operation and maintenance, and discloses a self-checking and self-repairing method, device, equipment and storage medium of electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining current configuration information and real-time operation information of the electronic equipment, denoising the real-time operation information to obtain denoising operation information, inputting the current configuration information and the denoising operation information into a trained fault prediction model to obtain the fault occurrence probability of the electronic equipment in a future time period, and identifying and obtaining a target fault type when the fault occurrence probability exceeds a preset threshold value; the current configuration information, the denoising operation information, the target fault type and the fault occurrence probability are input into a trained repair strategy model to obtain at least one configuration repair action, and the current configuration information of the electronic equipment is modified, so that the self-checking and self-repair capabilities are realized, the dependence on manual intervention is reduced, and the automation level is improved.

title_en: Method, system and electronic device for inquiring fault code based on handheld diagnostic device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of automobile fault diagnosis, in particular to a method, a system and electronic equipment for inquiring fault codes based on handheld diagnostic equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a first original fault code, carrying out ASCII value conversion on the first original fault code to obtain a first target fault code, carrying out query matching on the first target fault code in an index table to obtain target data information, wherein the target data information comprises a second target fault code and an original index id, the first target fault code is identical to the second target fault code in correspondence, extracting the original index id from the target data information, carrying out preset system format conversion to obtain a first target index id, and carrying out query matching on the target index id from a pre-stored database to obtain description information corresponding to the first original fault code. The application can improve the efficiency of inquiring the fault code of the handheld diagnosis equipment so as to improve the experience of the customer.

title_en: Arc detection method based on differential increase and structured attention
abstract_en: The application discloses an arc detection method based on differential increase and structured attention, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting and preprocessing current signals, carrying out differential increase according to sample types, adopting strong increase to improve generalization capability of arc samples, adopting weak increase to avoid overfitting of normal samples, relieving class imbalance problems and improving model generalization capability, secondly obtaining six complementary characteristic representations of time domain waveforms, frequency domain spectrums, time-frequency analysis, envelope characteristics, statistical distribution and related characteristics from the differential increased current signals through a multi-mode characteristic extraction method, fusing to generate multi-mode images, designing a deep learning model integrating structured attention, carrying out differential attention on different characteristic analysis areas of the multi-mode images, directionally enhancing arc characteristics, and finally carrying out dynamic quantization on the trained model, reducing model size and reasoning delay, and supporting efficient deployment of various edge computing devices.

title_en: Track data coding and inquiring method, system, terminal equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a track data coding and inquiring method, a system, terminal equipment and a medium, which comprise the steps of obtaining track data, carrying out semantic coding on each track point by utilizing a semantic coding rule to obtain semantic track data, constructing an index tree based on a reinforcement learning algorithm according to the semantic track data, introducing a semantic pruning mechanism to optimize the index depth of the index tree to obtain an optimized index tree, receiving or responding to an inquiring request, carrying out space-time inquiring on the optimized index tree, and returning a track inquiring result matched with the inquiring request. The invention can improve the space-time semantic information query efficiency of the track.

title_en: Context provisioning system for large language model applications
abstract_en: In an example embodiment, an iterative tool-based solution is utilized in which a list of possible tools for context collection may be provided as input by a host program to the LLM along with user cues. The LLM then generates text that when executed by the host program invokes one or more of the tools. When the host program executes text generated from the LLM, the context is collected according to one or more tools selected by the LLM. This context can then be fed back into the LLM. The process may iterate continuously until the LLM has enough upper and lower Wen Laisheng responses to the initial user prompt itself.

title_en: Water network functional integrity evaluation model construction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fluid engineering modeling, in particular to a method and a system for constructing a water network functional integrity evaluation model, comprising the following steps: collecting node coordinates and function labels, analyzing path density and index trend, deducing dynamic adjustment proportion, constructing a dynamic structure model, screening a function index set, evaluating index conduction efficiency, constructing a hierarchical evaluation framework, generating a hierarchical table by comparing level standards, and integrating influence values to generate an integrity evaluation set. According to the invention, a dynamic structure model is constructed by collecting node data and dynamic monitoring parameters in real time, the topological relation and the functional change of the water network are accurately mapped, the low-efficiency index is evaluated and stripped through the conduction efficiency, the focusing core function of the hierarchical framework is reconstructed, the multi-dimensional level mapping rule is generated by combining the real-time monitoring data and a preset threshold value, the division refinement is improved, the dynamic data is integrated to derive an influence value, an evaluation mechanism from static superposition to dynamic coupling is established, and the guidance of the result on engineering regulation is enhanced.

title_en: Complex long-acting preparation steady-state pharmacokinetic extrapolation equivalence prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a complex long-acting preparation steady-state pharmacokinetics extrapolation equivalence prediction method, which relates to the technical field of steady-state bioequivalence and comprises the steps of collecting and unifying concentration-time, a dosing scheme and covariates, generating a standardized time, an event sign code and a covariate dictionary, setting deletion weight and crowd alignment weight, setting candidate structures based on population pharmacokinetics, estimating a model and covariate effect through a quality threshold, constructing a virtual crowd, carrying out multiple dosing simulation, judging to be stable with continuous two valley concentration relative changes, generating a peak-valley sampling time window, carrying out non-atrioventricular analysis in a steady-state interval, calculating a dosing interval area, a steady-state peak value and a steady-state valley value, calculating a geometric mean ratio and a confidence interval for the two preparations, carrying out efficacy-sample quantity linkage, outputting a recommended design, and reducing test burden, shortening period and improving decision transparency.

title_en: Acoustic load optimization method and system based on route gradient and audio climax
abstract_en: The application relates to an acoustic load optimization method based on route gradient and audio climax, which comprises the following steps of obtaining driving route data and real-time state data of a vehicle, predicting a vehicle driving power demand sequence arranged in time sequence in a future preset time period based on the obtained driving route data and the real-time state data of the vehicle, identifying songs to be played in the future preset time period in an audio stream, and determining a start-stop time stamp and a predicted power demand value of a climax segment of each song. According to the method and the system for optimizing the acoustic load of the route gradient and the audio climax, the power conflict points of the predicted power requirement values of the vehicle driving power requirement and the audio climax fragment play are predicted, and the data preloading task is intelligently scheduled by utilizing the time difference, so that the instantaneous high load which is possibly overlapped is flattened in the time dimension, the peak power impact frequency and amplitude of a battery system are obviously reduced, and the risk of the electrical stability of the whole vehicle caused by voltage drop is avoided.

title_en: Compound patch colon release tablet effective part screening method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of screening of effective components of a traditional Chinese medicine compound preparation, and discloses a method for screening effective components of a compound patch colon-sustained release tablet based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of constructing a time sequence drug effect path library and recording biological path activity data of each component of the compound patch colon-sustained release tablet at a plurality of time points; the method comprises the steps of designing a causal intervention traceability network, quantifying the causal relation of each component to the nodes of the channel through anti-facts intervention analysis, developing a key node identification algorithm, identifying key regulation nodes, establishing a channel evolution tracking model, predicting the long-term influence of the drug components on the channel, generating a mechanism interpretability score, evaluating the reliability of the drug effect mechanism of each component, and screening effective components with a definite action mechanism.

title_en: High-resolution TDC system based on blind compensation mechanism and time interval measurement method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a TDC system, in particular to a high-resolution TDC system based on a blind compensation mechanism and a time interval measuring method, wherein a first processing chip is used as a main processing channel and is responsible for carrying out high-speed coarse-grain sampling on an analog signal to be measured, determining the position of a blind area where a time interval is positioned, providing a coarse delay measurement value, calculating with a fine time measurement value sent by a second processing chip to obtain a high-precision time interval measuring result, and a second processing chip is used as an auxiliary processing channel and is responsible for carrying out fine blind compensation on the blind area determined by the first processing chip, carrying out fine-grain sampling on the analog signal to be measured, accurately measuring the fine time measurement value of high resolution in the blind area and sending the fine time measurement value to the first processing chip.

title_en: Multipole magnetic trap magnetic flux distribution prediction method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of plasma energy engineering, and discloses a multipole magnetic trap magnetic flux distribution prediction method, a device and equipment, which comprise the following steps: the method comprises the steps of constructing a neural network framework comprising a magnetic flux neural network, a plasma current neural network and a convolution differential operator, outputting total magnetic flux distribution through the magnetic flux neural network, obtaining plasma current density from the total magnetic flux distribution by utilizing the plasma current neural network, obtaining a first constraint condition, obtaining a second constraint condition from the total magnetic flux distribution by combining the convolution differential operator, and determining a prediction result by comparing convergence errors of the two constraint conditions. Physical constraint is introduced through a convolution differential operator, the problem that the magnetic flux distribution prediction and actual deviation are large due to the lack of physical constraint of a common neural network is solved, meanwhile, the convergence and stability of a model are improved through feedback coupling between the magnetic flux neural network and a plasma current neural network, and the model is closer to the actual multipolar magnetic trap magnetic flux distribution prediction effect.

title_en: Global-local feature complementary low-voltage distribution network leakage severity identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a global-local feature complementary low-voltage distribution network leakage severity identification method which comprises the following steps of inputting residual current waveform data to be predicted into a trained low-voltage distribution network leakage fault feature extraction model based on global-local feature complementation to extract global features and local features, fusing the local features and the global features to form a fused feature vector, inputting the fused feature vector into a multi-label classifier, judging whether leakage faults exist or not, and outputting fault severity grades. The invention realizes the identification of the severity of the leakage fault of the low-voltage distribution network through the recursion diagram, the residual network, the Hilbert-Huang algorithm and other algorithms, and improves the leakage protection capability of the low-voltage distribution network.

title_en: Quality analysis method and device for multisource traffic perception data
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to a quality analysis method and a quality analysis device for multisource traffic perception data, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an intersection data/monitoring/daily comment array for an intersection, setting the intersection data array based on entrance speed observation information, carrying out extreme abnormal quality analysis and data consistency quality analysis on the added data of the intersection data array, carrying out quality scoring and data weight allocation, adding entrance speed monitoring information in the intersection monitoring array in a weighted average mode of floating weights, adding entrance data integrity rate for each entrance at the intersection daily comment array when each day is finished, adding intersection data integrity rate and entrance availability ratio for the whole intersection, and carrying out early warning based on the entrance/intersection data integrity rate on the current day. In a multi-data source fusion scene, the data accuracy and the data quality stability of the inlet speed monitoring information can be improved based on the method and the device.

title_en: Multi-angle plane wave ultrasonic imaging method based on neural network optimization
abstract_en: The application provides a multi-angle plane wave ultrasonic imaging method based on neural network optimization, which belongs to the technical field of convolutional neural networks and ultrasonic synthesis and comprises the steps of obtaining original channel radio frequency data of multi-angle plane waves, wherein the original channel radio frequency data comprise a plurality of channels, scanning depths and angles, screening an effective angle subset from the original channel radio frequency data through a first neural network, extracting a corresponding radio frequency data subset based on the effective angle subset, wherein the radio frequency data subset is used for subsequent beam synthesis, carrying out beam synthesis processing on the radio frequency data subset through a second neural network to generate a single-frame ultrasonic imaging image, and optimizing parameters of the first neural network and the second neural network based on the difference between the single-frame ultrasonic imaging image and a reference image. Aiming at the problems of low multi-angle radio frequency data processing efficiency and limited image quality in the traditional ultrasonic imaging, the application realizes high-efficiency and high-quality ultrasonic imaging by integrating data screening and beam synthesis.

title_en: Event anti-shake method and device for application interface, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application is suitable for the technical field of intelligent control, and provides an event anti-shake method, an event anti-shake device, electronic equipment and a storage medium of an application interface, wherein the method comprises the steps of starting a first anti-shake timer after responding to a first interaction event when the first interaction event is triggered and is not in a first anti-shake time window under the condition of starting the event anti-shake function; the event anti-shake function is realized by implanting anti-shake control logic into the frame layer and packaging the anti-shake control logic for different interaction components based on the frame layer, the frame layer does not respond to the same interaction event triggered again in an anti-shake time window of the interaction event, and a second anti-shake timer is started after responding to the second interaction event when the second interaction event is triggered and is not in a second anti-shake time window. According to the application, the anti-shake control logic is implanted into the application framework layer to enable the event anti-shake function to be the bottom public service, so that global anti-shake is realized, repeated writing of the anti-shake function of each component is not required, and the development efficiency is effectively improved.

title_en: RH vacuum exhaust system fault positioning method and system based on hybrid expert system
abstract_en: The invention provides a fault positioning method and system of an RH vacuum exhaust system based on a hybrid expert system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining production process data of the RH vacuum exhaust system and preprocessing the data; according to the preprocessed RH vacuum exhaust system production process data, a constructed time sequence K mean value based on dynamic time regularity is recorded as DTKmeans algorithm training to obtain a fault threshold value, a fault zone bit is calculated, and according to the fault zone bit, a hybrid expert system summarizes various fault types and a judging rule base to calculate a fault position. The invention utilizes the artificial intelligent algorithm to realize that the RH process vacuum exhaust system can provide fault point positioning as fast as possible, and improves the efficiency of searching fault points.

title_en: Collaborative manufacturing product quality tracing and management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quality tracing and management system for collaborative manufacturing products, belongs to the technical field of product quality tracing and management, and aims to solve the problems of serious data island, low tracing efficiency, insufficient information security and lack of a unified management platform in cross-enterprise collaborative manufacturing. The system comprises a production coordination module, a data warehouse module and a traceability processing module which are sequentially connected in a communication mode, wherein the production coordination module disassembles and distributes production tasks across enterprises to support parallel/sequential production, the data coordination module records and synchronizes production data and isolates enterprise information, the data warehouse module encrypts and stores data and builds indexes to quickly retrieve traceability data, and the traceability processing module receives requests, positions problem enterprises and equipment and feeds back results. The system realizes cross-enterprise data sharing and full-chain quality tracing, improves production efficiency and product quality, ensures data safety, and is suitable for multi-enterprise joint manufacturing scenes.

title_en: Virtual object display method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of photovoltaic array site selection, in particular to a virtual object display method, a device, a storage medium and electronic equipment. The virtual object display method comprises the steps of collecting resource environment data and forbidden area data of an area to be addressed, identifying a photovoltaic available area based on the resource environment data and the forbidden area data, conducting grid division on the photovoltaic available area to obtain a plurality of photovoltaic panel array grid areas, calculating area parameters corresponding to the photovoltaic panel array grid areas respectively, configuring a virtual object based on the photovoltaic panel array grid areas, configuring the area parameters as virtual tags of the virtual object, and displaying the virtual object and the virtual tags in an augmented reality terminal device. The virtual object display method provided by the invention can intuitively perform enhanced display of the photovoltaic site selection related information.

title_en: Board card online upgrading method based on flash
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of AD analog data application programs under a DSP system, and discloses a flash-based board card online upgrading method, which comprises the following steps of S1, creating a boot program; S2, creating an application program bin file, and S3, upgrading the application program by using the upper machine tool. The invention provides a scheme for solving the online upgrading problem of the DSP type, and can realize upgrading according to different choices of users, thereby effectively solving the problem of difficult upgrading caused by the field or equipment problem.

title_en: Reading optimization method based on three-layer LSM tree block index
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of high-performance storage systems and computer system structures, and particularly discloses a reading optimization method based on three-layer LSM tree block indexes. The invention removes the way of changing the bloom filter into the hash table to directly index the target position of the data block, can read the data block faster, and reduces the searching delay of the bloom filter. Secondly, a floating threshold value is configured for all data blocks of SSTable files of a disk, and the hot data blocks are floated into the upper layer after a certain number of accesses, so that when the next reading request arrives, the target key is read on a shorter path, and the response of the reading request is faster.

title_en: Application of MNP (MNP) marker combination for identifying plasmodium, primer group, kit and application of MNP marker combination
abstract_en: The invention discloses an application of MNP (MNP) marker combination for identifying plasmodium, a primer group, a kit and an application thereof, wherein the application comprises a genome region which is screened on a plasmodium falciparum genome and is distinguished from other species and has a plurality of nucleotide polymorphisms in the interior of the species by using the MNP marker combination for non-disease diagnosis, the primer group comprises a 1 st primer pair to a 3 rd primer pair, a forward primer of the 1 st primer pair, a reverse primer of the 1 st primer pair to a forward primer of the 3 rd primer pair and a reverse primer of the 3 rd primer pair, and the sequence is shown as SEQ ID NO:1 to SEQ ID NO:6 in sequence table. The application, primer group, kit and application of the MNP label combination for identifying plasmodium can realize efficient, accurate and sensitive identification, mutation monitoring and cross-host tracing of plasmodium falciparum based on a multi-target detection scheme.

title_en: Heterogeneous-sensing self-adaptive low-bit neural network deployment method
abstract_en: The invention provides a heterogeneous perception self-adaptive low-bit neural network deployment method, which relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and heterogeneous computation, and comprises the steps of firstly acquiring hierarchical computation characteristic information of each layer of the neural network and heterogeneous hardware dynamic characteristic parameter information to form a multi-level basic information set, and then constructing a hierarchical efficiency association model to describe association relation of computation precision, hardware dynamic characteristics and layer computation efficiency according to the hierarchical computation characteristic information and the heterogeneous hardware dynamic characteristic parameter information. And tracking the real-time load state and the energy efficiency constraint condition of hardware to generate a dynamic state monitoring result when in online operation, and generating a hierarchical deployment configuration scheme by combining the dynamic state monitoring result and adopting a multi-objective optimization algorithm. And finally, a lightweight runtime scheduler is called to distribute computing tasks according to a scheme, load interlayer dependent data and execute the computing tasks, so that the deployment of the cross-hardware device dynamic neural network is realized, and the deployment effect and the running efficiency are improved.

title_en: Intelligent optimization method for assembly type road surface plate mix ratio based on multi-source test data driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent optimization method for the mix proportion of an assembled road slab based on multi-source test data driving. The method comprises the steps of collecting and preprocessing multi-source mixing proportion and performance test data, constructing and training a multi-index regression prediction model based on a neural network to realize intelligent prediction of performance of the road surface plate under different mixing proportion parameters, carrying out global optimization on the mixing proportion parameters according to performance target weights by combining optimization algorithms such as differential evolution and the like, and finally realizing automatic screening of optimal and alternative mixing proportion combinations through multi-criterion comprehensive evaluation and intelligent recommendation. According to the method, through combining the multi-source test data and the deep learning model, accurate recommendation and automatic adjustment of the mixing ratio parameters are realized, and the target requirements of structural performance, construction performance, durability and the like are met.

title_en: Reliability evaluation method and system for crimping IGBT device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reliability evaluation method and a system of a crimping IGBT device, comprising the steps of obtaining bridge arm current data when a pre-constructed MMC model operates; and calculating the cycle failure period number based on a preset life model according to the junction temperature data and the junction temperature fluctuation data to obtain a reliability evaluation result of the target crimping IGBT device. Firstly, a target crimping IGBT finite element model is adopted, a simple thermal resistance network is not adopted, the accuracy of data is improved, secondly, steady state calculation is firstly carried out, transient state calculation is then carried out, more real junction temperature data and junction temperature fluctuation data can be obtained, and finally, the junction temperature fluctuation data is converted into a quantized cycle failure period number, so that an engineer can conveniently and accurately evaluate the service life of the crimping IGBT device under a specific working condition.

title_en: Image processing method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an image processing method and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of computers. According to the image processing method provided by the application, the image rendered by the electronic equipment is input into the super-resolution neural network, the second image is output, the second image is synthesized by the synthesizer, the synthesized target image is sent to the display screen for display, and the super-resolution neural network at least comprises an edge feature extraction module and a convolution block group, and the convolution block group is obtained by converting a complex network structure. By adopting the image processing method in the embodiment of the application, the speed of the electronic equipment for processing the low-resolution image can be improved, the quality of the image processing can be improved, and the power consumption of the electronic equipment can be reduced.

title_en: Method and system for reading and writing nonvolatile memory
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for reading and writing a nonvolatile memory, wherein the method comprises a writing step and a corresponding reading step, the writing step comprises the steps of obtaining first data in a writing command, determining whether to write back the first data according to the number proportion of first numerical values in the first data to obtain corresponding data to be written and a turning identification bit, writing the turning identification bit into a preset storage address of the turning identification information, namely, on the basis of ensuring that physical writing operation always deviates to a low stress state which is most favorable for a device, a special, highly reliable and high-durability storage mode is provided for the turning identification bit on the basis of smoothing power consumption, reducing delay and obviously prolonging the service life of the device, single-point faults of the existing mode are fundamentally eliminated, and long-term reliability of the system is ensured. The invention not only optimizes the data writing, but also fundamentally solves the abrasion bottleneck of metadata, ensures the stable operation of the system in the whole life cycle, and realizes the real long-life design.

title_en: Grating algae growth prediction method, system and medium based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scenedesmus growth prediction method, a system and a medium based on multi-source data fusion, belonging to the field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data of scenedesmus; the method comprises the steps of carrying out quantization treatment on environment stress data to obtain microalgae stress inhibition coefficients, constructing an environment stress vector according to the microalgae stress inhibition coefficients and the environment stress data, carrying out quantization treatment on biological effect data to obtain microalgae stress inhibition coefficients, determining a total effect coefficient, constructing a growth environment vector according to growth environment data, constructing a biological effect vector according to biological effect data and the total effect coefficient, fusing the growth environment vector, the biological effect vector and the environment stress vector to obtain a fusion vector, obtaining real growth data and real survival rate corresponding to multi-source data of scenedesmus to construct a training set, and training a preset deep learning network model to obtain a trained model. The invention improves the prediction precision of the growth of the scenedesmus.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle cluster autonomous decision-making method and system integrating Beidou enhanced service and multi-source perception
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster autonomous decision-making method and system integrating Beidou enhancement service and multisource perception, wherein the method comprises the steps that each unmanned aerial vehicle receives a star base enhancement signal, real-time resolving is carried out on the star base enhancement signal by utilizing a precise single-point positioning technology to obtain precise PVT information, each unmanned aerial vehicle synchronously collects sensor information and carries out space-time alignment with the precise PVT information, meanwhile, an information fusion model is utilized to process local perception characteristics and wide area geographic information to generate a global environment situation tensor, the global environment situation tensor is input into a deep reinforcement learning strategy network to obtain a task instruction set, consensus confirmation is carried out on key instructions in the task instruction set by utilizing global short messages to obtain consensus task instructions, each unmanned aerial vehicle carries out collaborative operation based on the consensus task instructions, new perception data generated in an execution process and the precise PVT information are fused in real time, and are input into the information fusion model again to complete autonomous decision-making closed loop.

title_en: Method special for long text voice recording scene and digital screen system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method special for long text voice recording scenes and a digital screen system. In the prior art, when the voice is recorded, the universal computer and the mouse are used for operation, and the problems of flow splitting, inconvenient marking and easy interruption of recording continuity exist. To solve this problem, the present invention provides an integrated solution. The system includes a digital screen hardware body, a pressure sensitive stylus, and a shortcut operation unit (e.g., a foot pedal). The method comprises the steps of automatically analyzing an imported manuscript through an AI intelligent engine to realize formatting processing such as character line recognition, color separation and emotion annotation, establishing an intelligent ink layer on the displayed manuscript to support a user to use a pressure-sensitive handwriting pen to perform natural marking and annotation, and finally controlling starting and stopping of recording and page turning of the manuscript through a quick operation unit such as a pedal, so that hands are liberated, and seamless recording without interrupting broadcasting and speaking is realized.

title_en: Cross-domain text retrieval method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a cross-domain text retrieval method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of computers, and the method comprises the steps of slicing a document to be retrieved to obtain a plurality of sliced texts; generating a slice vector database corresponding to the document to be searched based on expert sub-models corresponding to the slice texts, wherein the expert sub-models are used for processing texts in different fields, receiving user query texts, generating query text vectors corresponding to the user query texts, and performing text search in the slice vector database based on the query text vectors to obtain text search results. The application can generate the slice vector database based on the expert sub-model corresponding to the slice text in the document to be searched, and search the text based on the query text vector and the slice vector database, thereby solving the technical problem that the text searching method in the prior art is difficult to capture semantic features of a plurality of fields at the same time, and the searching accuracy is low.

title_en: Intensive small target detection method for unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photographing scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dense small target detection method for an unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photographing scene, and belongs to the technical field of computer vision and target detection. Aiming at the problems of small target scale dynamic change and feature expression weakening caused by flight height change, imaging resolution difference and scene complexity in unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photography, the method provides a detection frame integrating attention scale selection (AGSS) and dynamic local self-attention (DPSA) modules. The method specifically comprises the following improvements that (1) an AGSS module enhances the significance and discrimination capability of small targets in multi-scale features through a global context modeling and dynamic weight distribution mechanism, and (2) a DPSA module introduces a sparse selection mechanism in the channel dimension to focus computing resources on a channel sensitive to the small targets, so that efficient and light-weight attention modeling is realized. The modules cooperate with each other, so that the small target detection precision and robustness under complex background, low illumination and dense target scenes are remarkably improved while higher reasoning efficiency is maintained. Experimental results show that on typical unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photographing data sets such as VisDrone-DET2019, the method is superior to the existing main stream method in multiple indexes such as average precision (mAP), precision rate and recall rate, has obvious advantages in the aspects of the integrity and stability of small target detection, and has good practical application value and popularization prospect.

title_en: BIM-based steel structure engineering real-time monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time monitoring and early warning method of steel structure engineering based on BIM, which relates to the technical field of steel structure monitoring, solves the technical problems of lack of scientificity and suitability of baseline establishment, weak abnormality judgment and root cause identification capability, adopts a theoretical calculation baseline and actual measurement initial baseline double-baseline fusion strategy, the theoretical baseline is subjected to finite element model parameter calibration and multi-working condition simulation correction, the actual measurement baseline is subjected to environment stabilization period acquisition and wavelet transformation purification, when the deviation exceeds the threshold value, the model parameters are reversely calibrated, the deviation between the final base line and the real health state of the structure is reduced, the problem of poor adaptability of the fixed base line is solved, false anomalies are distinguished firstly based on fluctuation amplitude and environment correlation through double-layer anomaly identification logic of time sequence feature research and judgment and coupling correlation verification, then a parameter mapping matrix is constructed through a physical coupling relation, the false alarm rate and the false alarm rate are reduced, and the dual targets of accurate anomaly type identification and clear root cause positioning are realized.

title_en: Lightweight reasoning acceleration architecture based on instruction set architecture
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lightweight reasoning acceleration architecture based on an instruction set architecture, which comprises the steps of initializing hardware layer configuration and constructing a software layer environment, constructing a basic operation environment of the lightweight reasoning acceleration architecture, adopting a model analysis mode to reduce memory requirements and distribute and optimize memories, constructing a reasoning execution basis, adopting an accelerator parameter configuration mode, a weight data preloading mode and an output data loading mode to complete calculation parameter configuration, dynamically scheduling calculation resources based on calculation tasks and monitoring information of calculation processes to realize efficient scheduling and execution of the calculation tasks, improving energy efficiency based on a data reuse strategy, a memory access optimization mode and a power consumption management mode, constructing a comprehensive anomaly detection system, detecting abnormal conditions and reporting, achieving the collaborative optimization of reducing power consumption and improving calculation efficiency, achieving instantaneity and stability, and realizing efficient and reliable lightweight reasoning under an edge calculation scene.

title_en: Public-water intermodal inventory path optimization method based on self-adaptive large-scale neighborhood search
abstract_en: The invention relates to a public water intermodal inventory path optimization method based on self-adaptive large-scale neighborhood search, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing an inventory route decision model, S2, constructing a traffic model, S3, constructing an initial solution, S4, selecting an operator, S5, repairing and judging the mechanism, S6, designing the operator, S7, accepting the strategy of the solution, S8, stopping the algorithm, and integrally optimizing a public water intermodal inventory path optimization method of the commodity vehicle by considering the public water intermodal scene of the commodity vehicle, integrating a transportation route scheme and inventory management, splitting the inventory path optimization problem into a transportation route optimization module and a traffic optimization module, solving the transportation route optimization module which involves more variables and has high solving difficulty of an accurate algorithm by using a heuristic method, solving the traffic module which is relatively easy to solve by using the accurate algorithm, and ensuring the algorithm efficiency and quality.

title_en: Defogging and low-light enhancement method and system for video image
abstract_en: The application provides a defogging and low illumination enhancement method and a system for video images, and relates to the technical field of video processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of synchronously acquiring a video frame sequence, a reference frame and a light intensity correlation value of a scene, firstly utilizing a Fourier laminated imaging method to reconstruct ghost images, and then fusing the reconstructed images with fog concentration gradients, illumination attenuation coefficients and turbulence disturbance intensities extracted from the video frame sequence to generate a fusion feature map; dividing the fog effect, low illumination and turbulence areas by adopting a pulse coupling neural network, and carrying out dynamic routing and feature reconstruction on each area by utilizing a capsule network to obtain a feature vector set; and finally, carrying out self-adaptive restoration on each region by combining the characteristics of the reference frame to generate a clear image. The digital twin system can effectively improve the image quality and stability of the digital twin system in complex outdoor scenes such as low illumination superposition turbulence in foggy days.

title_en: Arrhythmia detection method, intelligent terminal and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an arrhythmia detection method, an intelligent terminal and a system, and aims to realize efficient and intelligent individual arrhythmia management. The method comprises the steps of collecting electrocardiosignals of a user and calculating physiological parameters of the user based on the electrocardiosignals. The method comprises the steps of inputting the electrocardiosignal into a pre-trained mixed deep learning model to extract enhancement features fused with local features, time sequence association and attention weighting and output arrhythmia classification probability, comparing the arrhythmia classification probability with a personalized self-adaptive threshold and generating an early warning signal according to a comparison result, wherein the personalized self-adaptive threshold is dynamically adjusted at least based on the physiological parameters. The invention not only realizes the deep analysis and dynamic focusing of multi-level characteristics of electrocardiosignal through the mixed model, but also can accurately identify complex arrhythmia such as atrial fibrillation, ventricular premature beat and the like, and further remarkably improves the sensitivity and the specificity of detection by means of a personalized self-adaptive threshold mechanism.

title_en: Method and equipment for configuring computing power resources
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method and equipment for configuring computing power resources, which can be applied to the field of automatic driving and can be applied to intelligent automobiles, automatic driving automobiles, network-connected automobiles and the like, and comprises the following steps: and receiving calculation force configuration data corresponding to the DCU, which is sent by a cloud server or an upper computer, by any one Domain Controller (DCU) of the vehicle, wherein the calculation force configuration data comprises preset configuration numbers of various types of processors (including processor cores) in the DCU, the DCU de-resets a target processor in the DCU according to the calculation force configuration data, and under the condition that the perception information acquired by the vehicle belongs to the DCU processing category, processing the perception information based on the de-reset target processor. The computing power configuration data supports the update of near-end Upgrade (UDS) or far-end upgrade (OTA), and the computing power configuration data can be updated according to the need to realize the adjustment of computing power resources in the DCU, so that the computing power resources are saved on the premise of ensuring smooth operation of the service, and the situation that the corresponding computing power configuration data can only be solidified in eFuses and cannot be modified when the DCU leaves a factory is avoided.

title_en: Method and system for determining bearing capacity of truss floor support plate
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a system for determining the bearing capacity of a truss floor carrier plate, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source parameters of the truss floor carrier plate; the method comprises the steps of determining a first theoretical bearing capacity of a truss floor bearing plate according to the multi-source parameters, determining the bearing capacity of the truss floor bearing plate according to the first theoretical bearing capacity, a first preset correction parameter and a second preset correction parameter, outputting the bearing capacity of the truss floor bearing plate, wherein the determination process of the preset correction parameters comprises the steps of obtaining at least three groups of experimental multi-source parameters and actual measurement bearing capacities of the truss floor bearing plate, determining the second theoretical bearing capacity of the truss floor bearing plate according to the experimental multi-source parameters, and determining the first preset correction parameter and the second preset correction parameter according to the actual measurement bearing capacity and the second theoretical bearing capacity of the at least three groups. The invention can integrate theoretical calculation and experimental data to obtain high-precision bearing capacity which is more close to engineering reality.

title_en: Natural resource dynamic monitoring and evaluating system based on multisource space-time data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of natural resource monitoring and evaluation, and discloses a natural resource dynamic monitoring and evaluation system based on multisource spatio-temporal data fusion, which comprises a semantic mapping module, a semantic mapping module and a semantic analysis module, wherein the semantic mapping module analyzes a business document to generate constraint rules and constructs basic spatio-temporal tensors; the system comprises a sensing strategy module, a state evolution module, an energy quality fingerprint module, a deviation risk module, a time sequence energy quality data module and a resource audit report, wherein the sensing strategy module monitors the evolution of state nodes and generates an acquisition strategy instruction to drive an external sensor to acquire enhanced sensing data, the state evolution module deduces an expected legal state sequence and reconstructs an actual physical state sequence by combining the enhanced sensing data, the energy quality fingerprint module utilizes the time sequence energy quality data to establish nonlinear mapping and calculates fingerprint consistency indexes to verify authenticity of the physical state, and the deviation risk module combines the consistency indexes to calculate a space-time semantic distance and a propagation risk value based on a topological network to generate the resource audit report. According to the invention, through event-driven active sensing and cross-modal energy implicit verification, the problems of insufficient space-time precision of monitoring data and difficult disguise compliance identification are effectively solved.

title_en: Intelligent early warning method and system for thermal runaway of energy storage battery based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of battery thermal safety management and discloses an intelligent early warning method and system for thermal runaway of an energy storage battery based on machine learning, wherein the intelligent early warning method for thermal runaway of the energy storage battery based on machine learning comprises the steps of obtaining cooling layout parameters of an energy storage system and sensor data flow, and generating a data missing mode recognition result comprising a missing period, a missing position and a missing type; the method comprises the steps of deducing probability distribution of temperature and flow physical quantity of a missing sensor through a message transmission mechanism, outputting a numerical distribution deducing result of the missing sensor, calculating posterior state distribution through Bayesian reasoning, generating a virtual-real mixed thermal state estimation result, analyzing the thermal state estimation result based on a confidence weighting multi-objective optimization algorithm, constructing a multi-objective function comprising weighted risk minimization and cooling energy consumption cost minimization, and outputting a cooling control instruction. The invention solves the technical problem that the traditional digital twin system is strongly dependent on the data integrity.

title_en: Standard cell library file generation verification method and device based on grammar and semantic rule inspection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a standard unit library file generation verification method based on grammar and semantic rule checking, which comprises the steps of performing lexical-grammar analysis on an input standard unit library file after a program is started to generate a memory data structure corresponding to a Liberty grammar specification, recursively circulating a specific data structure to check a group corresponding to the file and the attribute thereof, performing rule matching on each node in a node queue to be checked according to a preset grammar-semantic rule library, calling a corresponding checking algorithm for the matched rule and checking, classifying error information obtained by checking according to error grades, error categories, belonging groups and attribute paths, and generating a structured error record. Not only can help to promote simulation accuracy, but also simulation efficiency is high. The information prompt and method for locating errors can be more intuitively known for the user, and verification of the feature extraction result of the standard cell library is facilitated.

title_en: Quick recognition system of zebra fish abnormal behavior based on computer vision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quick recognition system for abnormal zebra fish behaviors based on computer vision, which is used for generating a stimulus event stream through a top strong light stimulus module and a vibration and sound stimulus module, obtaining high-quality zebra fish behavior image data, outputting three-dimensional track information of zebra fish and three-dimensional posture parameters of the zebra fish, forming a zebra fish behavior characterization feature set, encoding the zebra fish behavior characterization feature set, the stimulus event stream and experimental protocol metadata into multi-channel time sequence data according to a uniform time axis, outputting a zebra fish behavior state sequence, generating a zebra fish abnormal behavior recognition result, and adjusting output parameters of the top strong light stimulus module, the vibration and sound stimulus module in real time to realize stimulus-recognition-feedback closed loop control. The invention obviously improves the defects that the existing NeRF or 2D framework is easy to lose lock and drift under complex optical conditions.

title_en: Dynamic loading and unloading method based on multi-core AMP architecture DSP operating system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dynamic loading and unloading method based on a multi-core AMP architecture DSP operating system, which comprises the steps of transmitting a dynamic image to the running multi-core AMP architecture DSP operating system, transmitting the dynamic image to an operating system file system through network services of the running DSP operating system, analyzing and loading the dynamic image by a single core, executing a loaded dynamic module function by multiple cores, sharing a code segment and a global data segment in a generated dynamic module by multiple cores, enabling each core of a private data segment to be private, and completing repositioning of dynamic symbols, wherein a function interface in the dynamic module can be called and executed on each core at the moment, unloading the dynamic module by the single core, and releasing and recovering allocated resources are completed when the process of unloading the dynamic module is the inverse process of the loading process. The method solves the problem that cores of the AMP framework adopted by the DSP operating system are mutually independent, and access to shared peripheral equipment and shared memory is mutually related, realizes that the dynamic mirror image is loaded by a single core and can be accessed by multiple cores, and improves flexible deployment of the dynamic application mirror image.

title_en: Method, device and medium for constructing multi-field urban low-carbon development evaluation index system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a medium for constructing a multi-field urban low-carbon development evaluation index system. The method comprises the steps of constructing an initial index system of each industry of low-carbon development of the multi-field city, screening effective indexes in the initial index system by adopting an index contribution quantization method to obtain an effective index set of each industry, and determining weights of all indexes in the index system formed by the effective index set by adopting a combined weighting method to obtain a final evaluation index system of each industry.

title_en: Intelligent control system for body position of disabled old people based on deep learning gesture recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent control system for body positions of disabled persons based on deep learning gesture recognition, which comprises a multi-mode sensing acquisition module, a topology pressure field feature extraction module, a body position time sequence recognition module, a body position safety potential energy calculation module, a body position micro-motion control module and an individuation learning optimization module, wherein the multi-mode sensing acquisition module is used for generating a multi-mode input data set, the topology pressure field feature extraction module is used for performing topology maintenance mapping to generate a topology pressure field feature sequence, the body position time sequence recognition module is used for outputting body position types, gesture change trends and body position risk indexes through an improved Mamba model, the body position safety potential energy calculation module is used for generating potential energy distribution results, the body position micro-motion control module is used for generating micro-motion instructions, executing small-angle displacement and updating the risk indexes in real time, and the individuation learning optimization module is used for storing the recognition results, the risk indexes and control records and continuously optimizing Mamba model parameters. According to the invention, through an improved Mamba model and a potential energy control mechanism, the accurate identification and safe self-adaptive regulation and control of the body position of the disabled old are realized.

title_en: Wind power cable performance detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cable detection, in particular to a wind power cable performance detection method and system. The method comprises the steps of collecting reference spectrum data of an unaged wind power cable, obtaining near infrared reflection spectrum data of the wind power cable to be tested, calculating an oxidative degradation index and a component loss index based on the near infrared reflection spectrum data, constructing a matrix permeability factor by using the component loss index, carrying out nonlinear correction on the oxidative degradation index to obtain an effective oxidative damage degree, and finally constructing a structural integrity factor based on the component loss index and the effective oxidative damage degree, and evaluating the comprehensive mechanical performance of the wind power cable to be tested. According to the method, the problem that the physical synergy of the multiple degradation mechanisms cannot be represented by the traditional single-index detection is solved by constructing the synergistic failure model, and the accuracy and the sensitivity of wind power cable aging state assessment are remarkably improved.

title_en: Natural language processing method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a natural language processing method, a device and a storage medium, which belong to the technical field of natural language processing and comprise the steps of acquiring natural language information input by a user, preprocessing the natural language information to obtain clear language information, carrying out emotion recognition on the clear language information to extract emotion tendencies contained in the clear language information, carrying out text content conversion to accurately convert the language information into a structured text, finally synchronously acquiring the emotion information and the text information, starting an intention recognition flow by taking the acquired emotion information and the text information as dual basis, judging the real intention of the user by analyzing the core appeal of the text content and combining the influence of the emotion tendencies on the priority and potential requirements, then obtaining an adaptive answer based on the recognized intention, and outputting the answer to the user. The natural language processing method, the natural language processing device and the storage medium provided by the invention have the advantages that the intention recognition of the user is more accurate, the interaction is more humanized and the efficiency is higher.

title_en: Electric energy meter safety event monitoring and alarming method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for monitoring and alarming safety event of electric energy meter, which solves the problems of alarming storm and reliable delivery caused by concurrent reporting caused by large-area power failure, and the invention uses topology and time related clustering penetrated by storm identification, representation table election meeting heterogeneous constraint, rough abstract reporting of carrying covering abstract and signature, master station side check duplicate removal and sliding window layering threshold confirmation, and confirming and pulling the non-representative inhibition and detail pulling closed loop driven by the instruction, realizing the technical effects of preferential and stable sending of key alarms, reduced peak load of the main station and reduced repeated processing overhead.

title_en: Shale gas reservoir mixed gas injection parameter optimization method considering microscopic adsorption mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shale gas reservoir mixed gas injection parameter optimization method considering a microscopic adsorption mechanism, and relates to the technical field of oil and gas field development. According to the invention, an Latin hypercube sampling method is adopted to generate an initial sample point set in a four-dimensional parameter space, molecular dynamics simulation is carried out by utilizing the initial sample point set to establish a sample database and a displacement efficiency prediction model, a Bayesian optimization acquisition function is established based on a target aperture value, a displacement efficiency prediction model prediction result is combined, the Bayesian optimization acquisition function is maximized to determine the most potential mixed gas injection parameters, after a new four-dimensional sample point is generated and molecular dynamics simulation is carried out to obtain the displacement efficiency of the mixed gas injection parameters, a new parameter point update sample database is obtained, the optimal mixed gas injection parameters are obtained by optimizing the displacement efficiency prediction model through the sample database after multiple updates, the relationship between the aperture and the optimal mixed gas injection parameters is established, the dominant displacement mechanism of shale reservoirs under different apertures is disclosed, and the efficient optimization of the mixed gas injection parameters is realized.

title_en: Service upgrading method and system
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a service upgrading method and a system, wherein the service upgrading method comprises the steps of obtaining upgrading information aiming at a target service, generating an upgrading statement based on the upgrading information, importing the upgrading statement into a first production environment database corresponding to the target service to upgrade and deploy the target service, and obtaining target data through the upgrading statement or a preset service interface based on a data request of a user. According to the method and the device for upgrading the service, the upgrade statement is directly imported into the first production environment database, so that upgrade deployment of the service can be completed, the deployment mode is convenient and efficient, the deployment period can reach the second level, the service upgrade efficiency can be greatly improved, meanwhile, service is not required to be suspended in the service upgrade process, the use of a user is not affected, and service upgrade which is not perceived by the user can be achieved.

title_en: Mode linking method and system based on database content enhancement
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mode linking, in particular to a mode linking method and a mode linking system based on database content enhancement, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring original query sentences and query identifications input by a user, and determining a plurality of original query keywords and query complexity; the method comprises the steps of determining a key database based on query identifications, constructing an enhanced entity set, determining a plurality of candidate data tables and associated characteristic values corresponding to the candidate data tables based on comparison results and query complexity of original keywords and the enhanced entity set, determining a plurality of key data tables based on the associated characteristic values corresponding to the candidate data tables, inputting relevant mode information corresponding to the key data tables into a preset large language model to determine a target data table, and generating target query sentences based on the target data table and corresponding complete mode information. The invention can enhance the complex query support and improve the accuracy and recall rate of the mode link.

title_en: Electronic cigarette intelligent voice interaction and control system based on natural language understanding
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic cigarette control and voiceprint recognition, in particular to an electronic cigarette intelligent voice interaction and control system based on natural language understanding, the system comprises a voice acquisition and front-end processing module, a multi-mode feature fusion analysis module, a dynamic semantic understanding and intention decision module, an active health intervention strategy generation module and a control execution and feedback module. By extracting acoustic features from voice, fusing and analyzing multidimensional features such as voiceprint, physiological state, use behavior and the like, and combining semantic understanding to perform context perception decision, instructions can be intelligently corrected or personalized health intervention strategies can be generated, and active guidance and health risk intervention of user use behaviors are realized.

title_en: Resource pushing method, device, electronic equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of data processing, and discloses a resource pushing method, a device, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a program product. The method comprises the steps of displaying a media interaction interface, displaying resource pushing information and guiding information on the media interaction interface, wherein the resource pushing information comprises a virtual object and a target recommended resource bound with the virtual object, responding to the triggering operation of the target object on the guiding information on the media interaction interface, jumping to a resource display page corresponding to the resource pushing information, wherein the resource display page comprises an association control, responding to the triggering operation on the association control, constructing an association relation between the target object and the virtual object, responding to resource release content generated on the target recommended resource, and pushing the resource release content to the target object by utilizing the virtual object based on the association relation. By implementing the technical scheme, the instant pushing of the resource release content is performed through the virtual object, and the pushing effect of the target recommended resource is improved.

title_en: Automatic judging method for steel pipe defect magnetic flux leakage detection waveform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic judging method for a steel pipe defect magnetic flux leakage detection waveform, which belongs to the technical field of casing magnetic flux leakage detection and is specifically implemented according to the following steps of S1, setting a longitudinal coordinate threshold line on flaw detection software, S2, collecting magnetic flux leakage data of a steel pipe by flaw detection software to generate a waveform diagram, S3, locating a pixel longitudinal coordinate corresponding to the threshold line on the waveform diagram, S4, scanning the pixel longitudinal coordinate point by point in a scanning period, S5, when the waveform exceeds the threshold line, changing a pixel point RGB exceeding the threshold line and generating a signal with the Boolean quantity of 1, S6, converting the signal obtained in S6 into a 24V electric signal through a singlechip, S7, controlling a relay to be attracted to trigger a buzzer to alarm, and judging by staff. According to the invention, on the premise of keeping the existing magnetic flux leakage detection efficiency unchanged, the defects in the oil casing are effectively identified, the degree of manual intervention is reduced, and the detection rate of the buried defects is effectively improved.

title_en: Method and system for generating text-created content based on large model fine tuning
