abstract_en: The application provides a text creation content generation method and system based on big model fine tuning, which comprises the steps of processing cultural symbols in text description data according to initial feature vectors by adopting a text analysis technology, establishing association mapping relations between visual features and cultural semantics, acquiring similar design element clusters aiming at different cultural backgrounds through a structural design resource library, judging design logic consistency in the clusters, processing the similar design element clusters by adopting an iterative optimization technology according to a design logic consistency judgment result to obtain an optimal design element combination scheme, adjusting combination parameters to determine a finally-adapted design intention expression form if semantic conflict exists in the optimal design element combination scheme, and generating text creation design contents fusing traditional and modern styles through the finally-adapted design intention expression form to obtain an output result with unique characteristics.

title_en: Data category-free federal forgetting learning method based on countermeasure sample generation
abstract_en: The invention provides a data class federal forgetting learning method based on the generation of a countermeasure sample, which skillfully bypasses the limitation that the original data cannot be accessed in federal learning by generating countermeasure network synthesized data. Memory for the target class in the model is actively "erased" by the combined action of classification loss and countermeasures loss. Meanwhile, mechanisms such as parameter regularization, feature matching and gradient punishment effectively restrict the forgetting process, and ensure that the performance of non-target classes is reserved to the greatest extent. Dynamic scheduling and early shutdown rules further optimize training efficiency and final results.

title_en: Emergency power generation vehicle dispatching method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a dispatching method, a dispatching device and electronic equipment of an emergency power generation vehicle, and relates to the technical field of dispatching of emergency power generation vehicles. Based on the multidimensional scheduling data, constructing a multi-objective optimization function taking minimum total fuel consumption, minimum weighted power failure loss and minimum emergency response time deviation as cooperative targets, setting expansion constraint conditions including emergency response time constraint, electric generating vehicle endurance constraint, user priority constraint and electric generating vehicle power supply capacity constraint, solving the multi-objective optimization function by adopting an improved non-dominant ordering genetic algorithm, outputting a target scheduling scheme meeting the expansion constraint conditions, monitoring whether a preset dynamic event is triggered in real time in the scheduling execution process, and if so, acquiring the multidimensional scheduling data again and dynamically adjusting the target scheduling scheme, thereby realizing the dynamics, multidimensional and accurate scheduling and improving the utilization efficiency and emergency guarantee capacity of the emergency electric generating vehicle.

title_en: On-line detection management method for liquid crystal display screen
abstract_en: The invention provides an online detection management method of a liquid crystal display screen, which relates to the technical field of data processing, and comprises the steps of equally dividing a verified reference axis to generate a plurality of continuous detection analysis sections, and calculating according to the discrete degree of all the detection analysis sections to obtain a dynamic compensation coefficient; correcting the judging standard value in the detection parameter set according to the dynamic compensation coefficient to obtain a corrected judging standard value, comparing the initial detection data set with the corrected judging standard value for analysis, judging whether each detection item is qualified or not to obtain a recognition result of the failure type of the failure item, generating a final quality judging result based on the failure type of the failure item and the defect grade corresponding to each failure item, and executing corresponding management action according to the final quality judging result. The invention improves the accuracy and rationality of detection and judgment, and effectively ensures the balance of detection precision and production control efficiency.

title_en: Quality detection system for baked food production
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of food detection, and mainly relates to a quality detection system for baked food production, which converts free format requirements such as characters, pictures and the like submitted by clients into structured production instructions through an order analysis module, acquires cake images through a rotatable camera, uses a deep learning model to perform image alignment, comprehensively uses edge detection, feature point extraction and OCR technology to precisely position decoration elements and character areas, automatically judges whether patterns and character contents are correct or not and whether placement positions are correct or not through geometric comparison of physical key points and ideal layout, finally, feeds back all detection results in real time in a visual mode, and performs data storage in a whole-process related order information, thereby realizing full-process automatic quality inspection, early problem interception and production quality tracing from orders to finished products, and effectively reducing high-cost reworking caused by appearance errors.

title_en: Deep learning-based proton exchange membrane fuel cell fault diagnosis method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fuel cell fault diagnosis and health management, and in particular relates to a proton exchange membrane fuel cell fault diagnosis method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps of constructing a semi-mechanism semi-empirical model of a proton exchange membrane fuel cell system, and collecting time sequence data of a plurality of sensors; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing time sequence data, converting one-dimensional time sequence data into two-dimensional images by using a Grami angle field technology, taking the two-dimensional images as input, adopting a pre-trained ResNet convolutional neural network to combine transfer learning to perform feature extraction and fault classification, training, verifying and testing the neural network, outputting a fault classification result, building a semi-mechanism semi-empirical model of a fuel cell system, preliminarily verifying the accuracy of the semi-mechanism semi-empirical model, and applying ResNet and related knowledge of transfer learning to PEMFC fault diagnosis, so that the fault diagnosis accuracy is higher, the speed is faster, and the effect is better.

title_en: Aquatic organism environment sampling method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a system, equipment and a medium for sampling aquatic environment, which are used for determining the sampling density of each functional partition through the sampling frequency and the space layout point number of a sensor in each functional partition of a target water body and screening high-density partitions from the target water body based on each sampling density; comparing water quality parameters in sampling information of each sensor in the density partition to obtain water quality parameter similarity among the sensors, determining data redundancy of each sensor in the high density partition through the water quality parameter similarity and the spatial position proximity among the sensors, screening out a plurality of redundant sensors from the high density partition through each data redundancy, distributing and combining all the redundant sensors based on the water quality parameter similarity and the spatial position proximity, and sampling the environment of the target water body through the distributed and combined sensors. Based on the scheme, redundant combination of the sensors in the aquatic organism environment sampling can be realized.

title_en: Informationized beam rib sample overturning proportion optimization method
abstract_en: The application discloses an informationized beam rib sample overturning proportion optimization method, and relates to the technical field of construction material processing. The application establishes a beam rib proportioning program based on Python, wherein the beam rib comprises standard dies and residual materials, and comprises the steps of determining the number of a group of standard dies, setting standard die values, taking the difference between standard die collocation addition and beam rib length collocation addition as constraint and less than the maximum value of the residual materials, screening beam rib length collocation combination, splitting the beam rib length into the standard die values and the residual material length, integrating the standard die values and the residual material length as proportioning data, and independently processing beam rib raw materials according to the proportioning data. The method solves the problems that the existing software cannot be comprehensively proportioned according to the length of the raw material and is difficult to comprehensively process all beams uniformly, and achieves the purposes of minimizing the residual materials and restoring the scene of on-site processing.

title_en: Wind power prediction method based on seasonal characteristic and load characteristic fusion
abstract_en: A wind power prediction method based on seasonal feature and load characteristic fusion selects historical wind power data, meteorological data and power system load data as a data set, carries out outlier processing and data standard preprocessing on the historical wind power data and the load data, carries out seasonal feature extraction on the meteorological data, builds a load characteristic model based on the preprocessed load data, quantifies the association relation between load and wind power output, fuses the remarkably-related load characteristic index with the preprocessed wind power data and the seasonal feature extracted meteorological data to form a feature set, builds a mixed model of convolutional neural network feature extraction and long-short-term memory network time sequence prediction, and carries out wind power prediction. The method provided by the invention has the advantages that the prediction accuracy is obviously better than that of the traditional method, the robustness is strong, and the method is suitable for wind power prediction scenes of different climatic conditions and wind power field types.

title_en: Ultra-short-term wind power prediction method based on twenty-four solar terms self-adaptive modal decomposition framework
abstract_en: A method for predicting ultra-short-term wind power based on twenty-four solar terms self-adaptive modal decomposition frame belongs to the field of wind power prediction of wind power generation, and comprises the steps of dividing historical wind power data of a wind power plant into subsets according to solar terms, designing sample entropy difference adaptation degree functions for each subset, optimizing experimental modal decomposition key parameters of a complete self-adaptive noise set through a particle swarm algorithm, decomposing the subsets after optimization to obtain intrinsic modal components reflecting different frequency characteristics, screening weather variables highly related to wind power, and constructing a neural network model by taking the screened weather variables and the intrinsic modal components as inputs for ultra-short-term wind power prediction. The method and the device utilize the difference of different solar terms and wind resource characteristics, and can effectively improve the ultra-short term wind power prediction accuracy by dynamic optimization of modal decomposition parameters and fusion of key meteorological characteristics.

title_en: Virtual power plant heterogeneous resource adjustment capability assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of reliability evaluation of a power system and operation optimization of a virtual power plant, and provides a method and a system for evaluating heterogeneous resource adjustment capability of the virtual power plant, wherein the technical scheme is that an empirical Copula function is obtained by utilizing historical data fitting aiming at multi-source uncertainty variables, and a time sequence scene set is generated based on the empirical Copula function and a trained stacked automatic encoder model; the method comprises the steps of generating a time sequence scene set, calculating the adjustment capability of all uncertainty scenes based on the generated time sequence scene set, constructing an adjustment capability sample set based on the adjustment capability of all uncertainty scenes obtained through calculation, constructing a multi-confidence level adjustment curve library based on the constructed adjustment capability sample set, embedding the multi-confidence level adjustment curve library into daily rolling scheduling as constraint conditions, and obtaining a probabilistic evaluation result of power supply reliability by combining the reliability calculation of power supply with the set power supply reliability criterion. The method can meet the access requirements of different types and different scales of distributed energy resources.

title_en: Method and apparatus for machine learning model
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a computer-implemented method for a machine learning model including providing a set of inputs to the machine learning model, obtaining gradients based on the set of inputs, retrieving a first optimizer state and a second optimizer state, updating the first optimizer state and the second optimizer state based on the gradients, and compressing the updated first optimizer state and second optimizer state in a separate manner.

title_en: Eddy current sensor signal processing method and system based on digital demodulation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of eddy current sensors, and particularly relates to a signal processing method and system of an eddy current sensor based on digital demodulation, wherein an original induction signal acquired by the eddy current sensor is acquired, a standardized signal is generated through a wavelet packet transformation algorithm, orthogonal synchronous demodulation is performed based on a self-adaptive digital demodulation algorithm, a baseband signal is output, a variation modal decomposition and a dynamic threshold suppression algorithm are adopted to conduct layering suppression on residual noise, a pure target characteristic signal is obtained, an original characteristic parameter is deduced according to the pure target characteristic signal, a self-learning calibration model is constructed, optimized characteristic parameters are acquired, a real-time environment parameter is combined, calibration is performed through a temperature and humidity double-parameter linkage calibration algorithm, and a signal processing result and a real-time dynamic waveform diagram are generated based on the calibrated characteristic parameters. Therefore, the problems that in the prior art, noise suppression capability is insufficient, demodulation accuracy is greatly influenced by frequency and phase drift and the like are solved.

title_en: Depth-averaged avalanche motion simulation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a depth-averaged avalanche motion simulation method, and belongs to the technical field of avalanche disaster prevention and reduction. Based on a depth average theory, the method sequentially builds a mass, momentum, particle random fluctuation energy and heat conservation equation, and builds a dynamic function relation between a motion resistance parameter, particle random fluctuation energy and water content, so as to realize self-adaptive updating of the resistance parameter along with the internal state of the avalanche. The invention can more completely describe the dynamic process of the avalanche motion, dynamically reflect the mobility change of the avalanche motion, remarkably improve the accuracy of avalanche motion simulation and engineering applicability, and can provide reliable basis for disaster risk assessment and protection design.

title_en: Confidentiality-guaranteed fleet management
abstract_en: A method for confidentiality assurance fleet management of automation equipment in an industrial plant is disclosed. The method includes providing a platform including fleet management for an automation equipment application within a trusted execution environment TEE, wherein the fleet management for the automation equipment application includes a computing module and is associated with a first company. The method also includes receiving first data into fleet management for the automation equipment application within the trusted execution environment, the first data indicating information about a first automation equipment fleet associated with the second company. The method further includes processing the first data using the computing module. And the method further comprises outputting the result of the processing from the trusted execution environment.

title_en: Large screen display control method and device for monitoring experiment platform, storage medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a large-screen display control method, a device, a storage medium and equipment for monitoring an experiment platform, which divide corresponding monitoring subareas according to electronic fence areas corresponding to experiment equipment in the experiment platform, correlate each monitoring subarea with the monitoring large-screen subareas, reduce repeated display of monitoring pictures of the same area and different angles, improve the efficiency of displaying the monitoring large-screen pictures, and adjust the monitoring pictures by combining user task information in the monitoring pictures, corresponding equipment running states and equipment-environment heat point diagrams, so that the monitoring pictures of each monitoring large-screen subarea comprise specific personnel information, environment information and equipment state information, the effectiveness of the monitoring large-screen display information is improved, and meanwhile, monitoring management personnel can quickly know the running state of the experiment platform and the personnel state in the experiment platform, and can respond to abnormal states of the experiment platform more efficiently.

title_en: Camera calibration method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The present application relates to the field of computer technologies, and in particular, to a camera calibration method, an electronic device, and a storage medium. In the method, the electronic device may acquire a first image acquired by a first camera (for example, a side view camera) and a second image acquired by a second camera on the vehicle, where the first image and the second image both include lane lines of a first lane, and the number of lane lines shot by the second camera is greater than that of lane lines shot by the first camera. Then, first location data corresponding to the lane line of the first lane may be determined based on the first image and the first calibrated external parameter of the first camera, and second location data corresponding to the lane line of the first lane may be determined based on the second image and the calibrated external parameter of the second camera. And under the condition that the first distance information between the first position data and the second position data does not meet the preset condition, adjusting the first calibration external parameter of the first camera into a third calibration external parameter. Thus, the precision and accuracy of the calibration external parameters of the first camera can be ensured.

title_en: Method for tracking billet information in bar tandem rolling mill area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bar continuous rolling mill zone blank information tracking method, and belongs to the technical field of metallurgical production control methods. The technical scheme of the invention is that stock information is stored by taking a rolling number as an index, a tracking area is divided by rolling, the rolling number information of the head of a rolled piece is tracked and memorized, the actual passing tracking area time of the rolled piece is compared with a passing time threshold, when the actual passing tracking area time of the rolled piece is greater than or equal to the passing time threshold, abnormal rolling condition is judged, and the rolling number information of the abnormal rolling area is deleted. The invention realizes the automatic and accurate tracking of the key information of the blank in the area by utilizing the characteristic of the single running direction of the continuous rolling blank of the bar and adopting the head tracking memory, abnormal state information deletion and accessory information table lookup method of the rolled piece with the rolling plan number of the blank information as an index, thereby having extremely high popularization and application values in industry.

title_en: Energy storage charge and discharge control method based on multi-time scale transaction and differentiation clearing
abstract_en: The invention relates to an energy storage charging and discharging control method based on multi-time scale transaction and differential clearing, which comprises a multi-time scale transaction control process, a differential clearing sorting process and a multi-objective optimization solving process, wherein the multi-time scale transaction control process is used for dynamically selecting an optimal transaction mode, the differential clearing sorting process is used for determining an energy storage clearing list, and the multi-objective optimization solving process is used for determining an optimal energy storage charging and discharging plan and clearing result and controlling the working state of each energy storage device. Compared with the prior art, the method can realize the collaborative optimization of energy storage benefits and power grid benefits, and effectively solve the problems of scene collaborative deletion, single yielding dimension and optimization target one-sided in the prior art by fusing multi-time scale transactions and considering the differentiation of price and response capability.

title_en: Task processing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a task processing method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving a target task request sent by a target user; the method comprises the steps of carrying out task disassembly on a target task request to obtain a plurality of subtasks, determining task constraint information, task information and task dependency relation corresponding to the subtasks respectively, determining matched target agents from a pre-constructed agent library according to the task information and the task constraint information for each subtask, generating task cooperation information according to the task dependency relation and the target agents corresponding to the subtasks respectively, sending the task information, the task constraint information and the task cooperation information to the target agents and obtaining an execution result for each subtask, and integrating the execution results corresponding to the subtasks respectively to obtain a target result. The application can improve the reliability and the synergy of task processing in the vehicle-mounted scene.

title_en: Factory equipment abnormality monitoring method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a factory equipment abnormality monitoring method and system based on the Internet of things, which belong to the technical field of equipment abnormality monitoring and comprise the following steps: selecting a signal analysis path according to the type of a monitoring factory, collecting a multi-scale signal set of each device, executing multi-scale signal analysis of each device at an edge gateway to obtain a signal analysis result of each device, marking the device with an abnormal signal analysis result as an abnormal device, up-regulating the sampling frequency of each abnormal device, executing high-frequency sampling of each abnormal device, analyzing to obtain an uploading data packet of each abnormal device, uploading the uploading data packet to an analysis center, performing abnormality detection by the analysis center by using a deep learning model, triggering an alarm based on the abnormality detection result, and pushing maintenance suggestions. The method solves the technical problems that the prior art cannot effectively capture high-frequency short-time impact and fine spectral line change due to strong smoothing treatment, so that early weak abnormality cannot be timely identified, and particularly the potential problem of mechanical failure is solved.

title_en: Gesture-based virtual space configuration
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to gesture-based virtual space configuration. The virtual space configuration system of the artificial reality system may detect user gestures and provide various corresponding customizations of the virtual space of the system. The virtual space configuration system may provide seating virtual space customization when the user is in a seating pose. In various implementations, these customizations may include allowing adjustment of floor height, setting a flag that may be revealed to an application to adjust the mechanism of the application for a seated user, customizing the display of virtual space boundaries while in seating mode to reduce interference, providing options to detect when a user leaves seating mode and triggers corresponding actions, providing a pass-through workspace area to allow a user to interact naturally with certain real world objects without removing a virtual reality headset, or automatically determining virtual space dimensions for a seated user.

title_en: Heterogeneous computing power task monitoring method, heterogeneous computing power task monitoring device, heterogeneous computing power task monitoring computer equipment, heterogeneous computing power task monitoring readable storage medium and heterogeneous computing power task monitoring program product
abstract_en: The application relates to a heterogeneous computing power task monitoring method, a heterogeneous computing power task monitoring device, a heterogeneous computing power task monitoring computer readable storage medium and a heterogeneous computing power task monitoring computer program product. The method comprises the steps of obtaining monitoring index data collected in the process of executing heterogeneous computing tasks by different computing containers, summarizing the monitoring index data according to task granularity to obtain aggregation index data corresponding to each heterogeneous computing task, carrying out anomaly identification processing based on the aggregation index data to determine abnormal tasks in the heterogeneous computing tasks, and carrying out searching and destroying processing on the abnormal tasks. The application gathers the monitoring index data of the heterogeneous computing power tasks according to the task granularity, and makes use of heterogeneous computing power resources occupied by the abnormal tasks through identification and searching and destroying treatment of the abnormal tasks, so that the utilization rate of the heterogeneous computing power resources is improved, unnecessary expenditure of service computing power cost is reduced, and the effects of reducing the service cost and enhancing the efficiency are comprehensively realized.

title_en: Logging stratum information intelligent analysis system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of stratum data acquisition, in particular to an intelligent analysis system for logging stratum information. According to the invention, the probability density distribution function of the basic lithology logging response is constructed by acquiring core calibration data and utilizing a core density estimation algorithm, dependence on a fixed pattern plate and a static cut-off value is eliminated, dynamic probabilistic description of formation response characteristics is realized, then initial credibility and sensitivity weight of response values are calculated based on the distribution and are used for adjusting evidence distribution, further, the evidence theory combination rule is invoked to fuse the adjusted multi-source information, the formation state is determined according to the highest accumulated credibility, the misjudgment problem caused by response overlapping is effectively solved, and accuracy and objectivity of formation lithology and fluid property identification are remarkably improved.

title_en: Hydrogen transport pipeline steel crack acceleration propagation prediction method based on multi-sample method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-sample method-based hydrogen transportation pipeline steel crack acceleration and propagation prediction method, which belongs to the technical field of hydrogen energy infrastructure safety, and comprises the steps of carrying out fatigue crack propagation test in an inert environment and a high-pressure hydrogen environment through a multi-sample method to obtain a complete relation curve, calculating a hydrogen induced crack propagation acceleration factor to construct a multivariable coupling intelligent acceleration factor model, integrating on-site dynamic monitoring data to realize full-life cycle dynamic prediction of full-size pipeline cracks from initiation to propagation, optimizing the model through typical load spectrum verification and incremental learning algorithm, overcoming the defects of long test period, high cost and limited precision of the traditional method, greatly improving the prediction precision compared with the traditional method, obviously reducing the test cost and the evaluation period, adapting complex working conditions, providing a grading early warning function and providing efficient and reliable technical support for hydrogen transportation pipeline safety design, in-service evaluation and intelligent operation and maintenance.

title_en: Automatic production station man-hour statistics system and method based on near field communication
abstract_en: The invention provides a production station man-hour automatic counting system and method based on near field communication, wherein the system comprises an identity recognition layer, a data acquisition layer, an edge calculation layer, a cloud service layer and a terminal interaction layer, the method relies on the system to finish the steps of initialization, NFC interaction triggering, multi-mode anti-false touch verification and the like, the NFC, sensor and face recognition technology are integrated, the core modules of intelligent task matching, energy consumption-man-hour linkage accounting, cross-station collaborative man-hour splitting and the like are designed, and the system also has the functions of offline intelligent caching and multi-dimensional man-hour analysis. The invention realizes automation and precision of man-hour statistics, adapts to single-station standardization and multi-station collaborative production scenes, ensures reliable and non-lost data, realizes deep fusion of production data, reduces the hardware and management cost of enterprises, and improves the intelligent manufacturing refinement management level.

title_en: High-precision correction method for bird electromagnetic emission simulation model based on sensitivity influence sorting
abstract_en: The high-precision correction method for the bird electromagnetic emission simulation model based on sensitivity influence sequencing comprises the steps of obtaining structural parameters, material parameters and electrical parameters of an external excitation circuit of a gun barrel, an emission assembly and a driving coil in a bird electromagnetic emission system driven by a multistage coil, building the bird electromagnetic emission simulation model driven by the multistage coil according to the obtained structural parameters, the material parameters and the electrical parameters, building the external excitation circuit of a corresponding current source series current control switch aiming at the driving coil, realizing simulation solution of emission speed, displacement and emission efficiency of a bird according to the bird electromagnetic emission simulation model driven by the multistage coil, building a bird emission performance sensitivity analysis system based on a Workbench platform, carrying out sensitivity analysis, and carrying out multi-level model correction based on the bird electromagnetic emission simulation model driven by the multistage coil according to the obtained sensitivity analysis result to obtain an optimal design variable value.

title_en: Open caisson construction-oriented AI knowledge base question-answering system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an AI knowledge base question-answering system and electronic equipment for open caisson construction, and relates to the technical field of intelligent construction and engineering informatization. The system comprises a knowledge base construction module, an intelligent question-answering module, a scheme generation module, a risk early warning module, a semantic analysis and mixed retrieval rapid and accurate identification knowledge, a construction decision efficiency improvement and a scheme generation mechanism integration historical data, wherein the knowledge base construction module is used for constructing a domain exclusive knowledge base comprising a vector index and a graph database, the intelligent question-answering module is used for receiving natural language questions of a user and generating a quoted professional answer, the scheme generation module is used for generating a construction technical scheme comprising texts and multi-mode drawings based on parameters input by the user, the risk early warning module is used for identifying construction risks based on real-time monitoring data and triggering early warning and emergency response, the exclusive knowledge base is constructed by integrating data in various construction domains, the construction decision efficiency is improved based on semantic analysis and mixed retrieval, the scheme generation mechanism integration historical data is used for generating a specific scheme aiming at major risk events, complex and changeable construction environments are adapted, and personnel dependence is reduced.

title_en: Polymer multi-property prediction method based on self-supervision feature learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polymer multi-property prediction method based on self-supervision feature learning, which relates to the technical field of high polymer material information detection and comprises the following steps of constructing a polymer data set containing various property labels, carrying out monomer validity filtration on data, constructing a polymer virtual graph containing real edges and virtual edges based on a monomer structure, generating an electric property label of each atom through self-supervision learning, training an improved 2D graph neural network and a sequence prediction model based on the electric property label, respectively training the model aiming at different target properties, searching and optimizing the model performance through super-parameters, finally carrying out weighted fusion on prediction results of a plurality of basic models by utilizing an integrator, and outputting final prediction values of the target properties.

title_en: Method, equipment and medium for predicting breakthrough point of key technology of power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method, equipment and medium for predicting a key technical breakthrough point of a power grid, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting relevant patent or literature texts of the power grid technology and preprocessing the texts, dividing data according to a preset time window to form a time sequence text set, obtaining technical topic distribution corresponding to the time window and keywords of each technical topic based on the time sequence text set, constructing topic evolution characteristics of each technical topic, based on topic probability characteristics, considering strategy influence and technical collaborative correction, fitting an S-shaped curve to obtain replacement parameters, based on pre-established topic evolution characteristics-replacement parameter rules, matching the technical breakthrough point directions, clustering the keywords of the technical topics to obtain breakthrough point sub-directions, quantitatively evaluating the priority of the breakthrough point sub-directions according to technical feasibility, economic feasibility and strategy suitability, and outputting the prediction of the key technical breakthrough point of the power grid. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device realize accurate prediction of the key technical breakthrough point of the power grid.

title_en: Bearing current damage identification method and device based on multi-mode manifold retention
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wind driven generator fault diagnosis, in particular to a bearing current damage identification method and device based on multi-mode manifold maintenance, comprising the steps of collecting damaged fault operation data and normal bearing operation data without faults; noise reduction is carried out on collected data, then the collected data is decomposed into a plurality of modal signals in manifold space, high-dimensional sample entropy of each manifold subspace modal signal is calculated, multimode manifold sample entropy of normal, fault and current damage bearings is obtained, special analysis signals of each bearing state are built through Hilbert transformation based on corresponding sample entropy signals, instantaneous amplitude, phase, frequency and sample entropy statistical characteristics are extracted, an initial characteristic set is built, a local maintenance projection method is adopted for reducing the dimension to obtain a low-dimensional main flow characteristic set, the low-dimensional main flow characteristic set is input into a classifier of a neural network model, current damage and other state characteristic differences are compared, and accurate identification is achieved. The method improves the accuracy of bearing current damage identification.

title_en: Temperature evaluation method and system of submarine cable bending limiter
abstract_en: The invention provides a temperature evaluation method and a temperature evaluation system for a submarine cable bending limiter, wherein the temperature evaluation method comprises the steps of obtaining actual measurement power data and submarine cable structural parameters of a submarine wind power plant, obtaining a submarine cable load typical value based on the data and a preset submarine cable distribution parameter circuit model, calculating first equivalent thermal resistance, second equivalent thermal resistance, third equivalent thermal resistance and fourth equivalent thermal resistance based on a preset sample submarine cable and the data, constructing a multi-physical-field coupling simulation model based on the data, obtaining actual measurement temperature distribution data, obtaining simulation errors based on the multi-physical-field coupling simulation model and the actual measurement temperature distribution data, and completing temperature evaluation of the submarine cable bending limiter if the simulation errors are smaller than a preset tolerance threshold. According to the temperature evaluation method for the submarine cable bending limiter, provided by the invention, the problem that the calculation error of the temperature distribution of the submarine cable bending limiter section is large because of not considering axial heat transfer and relying on IEC standard calculation heat parameters is avoided, and the accurate simulation of the temperature distribution of the submarine cable bending limiter is realized.

title_en: Method and device for enhancing endoscope image, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for enhancing an endoscope image, which are characterized in that after a plurality of image features are extracted from the acquired endoscope image and fused, the fused feature image is subjected to segmentation processing in a double-threshold mode to determine a blood vessel region and a mucous membrane region in the image, and the blood vessel region and the mucous membrane region in the endoscope are accurately segmented in different image processing modes to obtain a target image, so that the contrast ratio of the blood vessel region and the mucous membrane region in the endoscope image can be improved, the image region corresponding to the image processing mode in the image can be enhanced in different image processing modes, the enhanced target image can be obtained, the definition of the whole image can be improved, a large number of data processing steps can be reduced, the accuracy of the image enhancement processing can be ensured, and the image processing efficiency can be improved.

title_en: Point cloud denoising clustering method and device based on intensity aggregation profile
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of photon sounding, and discloses a point cloud denoising clustering method and device based on an intensity aggregation profile, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a noise region photon distribution model and a signal interface photon distribution model; defining uniform intensity, gaussian concentration intensity and linear concentration intensity of photons, respectively deriving distribution functions of photon distribution models under each intensity, carrying out convolution operation on original point cloud images by utilizing convolution check of each intensity to obtain a Gaussian intensity map, a Gaussian concentration intensity map and a linear concentration intensity map, acquiring an interface field position by utilizing the Gaussian concentration intensity map, distinguishing submarine and sea surface signals according to the Gaussian intensity map, supplementing topography lacking of part of submarine signals in the section by utilizing the linear concentration intensity map, fitting the Gaussian intensity map according to the submarine and sea surface interface field position, and carrying out reverse deduction to obtain parameters of each distribution model. In this way, the automation process and the precision of the process for automatically identifying the submarine topography and the sea surface shape are improved.

title_en: Method for poisoning attack in recommendation system based on generation type countermeasure network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a poisoning attack method in a recommendation system based on a generation type countermeasure network, which relates to the technical field of data security and comprises the steps of extracting an embedded drift representation from a global object embedded table of a current round and a global object embedded table of a previous round, and executing state migration update on generator parameters of the generation type countermeasure network to obtain the generator parameters of the current round; inputting the parameters of the generator of the current turn and the global object embedding table of the current turn into a generator of a generated countermeasure network, outputting candidate user agent characterizations, acquiring candidate interaction sequences through a tested recommendation model, synchronously executing target object disturbance processing and consistency constraint processing to generate sequence pairs, inputting the sequence pairs into a discriminator of the generated countermeasure network, and executing gating screening by combining with a hierarchical similarity threshold table to obtain a poisoning interaction sequence. The invention improves the stability and reproducibility of the screening process of the poisoning interaction sequence and supports the continuous output of the data safety evaluation result set.

title_en: Generating predictions related to chemical processes using machine learning models
abstract_en: In some embodiments, a computer-implemented method of generating predictions related to a chemical workflow comprising a process performed on at least one chemical is provided. The computing system encodes the representation of the at least one chemical using a chemical encoder to create at least one potential chemical representation. The computing system creates a potential experimental representation based on the at least one potential chemical representation. The computing system decodes the potential experiment representation using the experiment decoder to predict one or more properties of the output of the chemical workflow, to generate an updated representation of the at least one chemical, or to generate an updated representation of the process.

title_en: Application of protein marker in preparation of rheumatoid arthritis diagnostic kit
abstract_en: The invention relates to application of a protein marker in preparation of a rheumatoid arthritis diagnosis kit, and belongs to the technical field of biological medicines. The protein marker for diagnosing the rheumatoid arthritis is screened from the plasma and the plasma exosomes, specifically, the AUC of the C4BPA of the source plasma exosomes is 0.878, the specificity is as high as 94.1 percent, and the protein marker has remarkable advantages in the aspect of excluding non-RA people. Both plasma-derived C4BPA and diamine oxidase (DAO) have good diagnostic value in independent diagnosis of RA, AUC being 0.844 and 0.946, respectively. The AUC of the combined diagnostic model constructed based on plasma C4BPA and plasma DAO was raised to 0.965. Therefore, the protein marker has an accurate diagnosis effect on rheumatoid arthritis and has good transformation application prospect on auxiliary diagnosis and risk assessment of RA.

title_en: Application program interface scheduling management system and method thereof
abstract_en: An application program interface scheduling management system and a method thereof are provided. The system comprises a memory database, an associated database, a front-end interface module, a work execution module and an automation management module. The front-end interface module is configured to receive an API scheduling setting corresponding to the API work from the user interface and synchronize the API scheduling setting to the memory database and the associated database. The work execution module is configured to execute corresponding API work according to the API scheduling settings in the memory database. The automation management module is configured to check whether the memory database is consistent with the API schedule settings in the associated database. In response to finding the inconsistency, the automation management module is further configured to shut down the work execution module, align the API schedule settings in the memory database and the relational database, and start the work execution module.

title_en: Fire-fighting voice image fusion transmission method based on semantic segmentation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting voice image fusion transmission method based on semantic segmentation, which aims to solve the problems of unstable linkage between voice automatic triggering and push-to-talk and link fluctuation and echo interference in cross-system intercom and public network intercom fusion transmission, and the technical effects of synergy of traditional intercom and public network intercom, reliable broadcasting with low time delay, sound-image synchronization and echo suppression are realized by combining deep voice activity detection and gate control triggering of a dangerous gate and a loop gate, and generating a fusion code stream containing a semantic mask and a synchronous mark by strengthening learning of a linkage channel and a link and adopting region-of-interest neural coding.

title_en: Visual weld bead feature extraction and welding parameter planning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visual weld bead feature extraction and welding parameter planning method and a system, which belong to the technical field of welding, wherein the method comprises the steps of respectively acquiring a welding scene image and a laser line image under the same welding vision field, and carrying out pixel superposition processing on the two images to obtain a fusion image; the method comprises the steps of inputting a fused image into a characteristic edge to extract a neural network to obtain a weld bead line, a bevel line and a laser line, calculating pixel intersection points of the laser line and the bevel line or the weld bead line to serve as bevel characteristic points, converting the bevel characteristic points from image coordinates to physical space coordinates to obtain characteristic point positions in an actual space, planning the residual weld bead in the current welding layer in real time by combining preset welding process parameters, and generating planning parameters of a next weld bead to be welded. The fusion image comprises clear textures and laser contour information, and the multi-class characteristic lines of the fusion image are dynamically identified based on the neural network, so that the characteristic lines can be stably identified when the height of a welding bead is slowly changed.

title_en: Intelligent quality control method and system for potato processing based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The application relates to an intelligent quality control method and system for potato processing based on multi-source data fusion, belonging to the technical field of visual detection application, wherein the method comprises the steps of synchronously collecting three-dimensional visual data, X-ray detection data and processing state data in the potato processing process, inputting the three-dimensional visual data, the X-ray detection data and the processing state data into a potato defect fusion recognition model, and outputting a quality control prejudgment result; the method comprises the steps of determining first qualified potato materials, first defective potato materials and first waste potato materials based on quality control pre-judging results and quality sorting conditions, establishing a three-dimensional virtual model based on three-dimensional visual data, simulating and generating cutting tracks for the first defective potato materials in the three-dimensional virtual model according to the quality control pre-judging results, re-screening the second defective potato materials and the second waste potato materials in the first defective potato materials according to the cutting tracks, and controlling a sorting mechanism to sort the first qualified potato materials, the first waste potato materials, the second defective potato materials and the second waste potato materials onto corresponding conveying belts and process the first qualified potato materials, the first waste potato materials, the second defective potato materials and the second waste potato materials respectively. The application improves the yield and the quality stability of the finished product.

title_en: Dynamic scanning compensation method of DNA synthesis equipment based on ink-jet printing and DNA synthesis equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic scanning compensation method of DNA synthesis equipment based on ink-jet printing and the DNA synthesis equipment, belonging to the field of DNA synthesis. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a circular area of each reaction site by threshold segmentation, connected domain analysis and circular Hough transformation on a standard analysis image, judging whether each reaction site meets the requirement of roundness according to the circle center position of all edge points of each reaction site from the circular boundary of each reaction site, and obtaining the information of the missing reaction site. Meanwhile, aiming at the possible inaccurate condition of circular Hough transformation, the result is calibrated by combining a target detection model YOLO based on a convolutional neural network, and the detection of the missing reaction sites with high precision, which is suitable for industrial application, can be obtained. And further, in YOLOv model training, the identification weight of defect reaction sites such as overlarge distance between partial edge points and circle centers is increased, so that the suitability of the defect reaction sites and the defect reaction sites is further improved, the detection accuracy is improved, and the high-precision DNA synthesis requirement can be met.

title_en: Simplified analysis method and device for automobile bumper lateral pressure simulation
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of automobiles, in particular to a simplified simulation analysis method and device for lateral pressure of an automobile bumper, wherein the method comprises the steps of intercepting a target bumper body as a target length when a target vehicle is in a low-temperature and low-speed test working condition, and building a simplified simulation analysis model of the vehicle according to the bumper body and material properties thereof; and determining a first target stress interval of the bumper body and at least one lateral connecting bolt through the model, comparing the first target stress interval with a second target stress interval obtained by a preset whole vehicle simulation analysis model, and outputting stress and deformation results of the bumper body and the lateral connecting bolts according to comparison results. Therefore, the problems that the research scene and the analysis dimension of the stress of the bumper are obviously limited, the practical guiding value of the stress analysis result on engineering design is reduced, and the requirements of multi-working-condition structural design and safety check of the bumper cannot be met in the related technology are solved.

title_en: Data fusion and abnormality early warning method for multi-parameter water quality monitoring instrument
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of environmental monitoring and automatic control, and discloses a data fusion and abnormality early warning method of a multi-parameter water quality monitoring instrument, which comprises the following steps of acquiring multi-dimensional original time sequence data of a water quality detection terminal, calculating dynamic self-adaptive time windows of all parameters, and generating actual measurement time sequence gradients; the method comprises the steps of creating a theoretical coupling partial guide matrix by calling a water chemistry physical equation library, calculating expected gradients of forced variables and generating a residual sequence, sending a physical excitation instruction to a terminal to drive a target sensor to execute physical cleaning or polarization action when the residual sequence is over, extracting a recovery response slope, distinguishing real water quality pollution from a sensor physical fault according to a comparison result of the slope and a standard value, calculating trust entropy based on distribution probability to reconstruct sensor fusion weight when confirming hardware faults, and calculating a virtual substitution value. The invention effectively eliminates phase dislocation, avoids high-frequency false alarm of traditional threshold judgment, and maintains continuous operation of the system under local fault.

title_en: Log playback method of database and related products
abstract_en: The invention provides a log playback method of a database and related products. The log playback method of the database comprises the steps of monitoring a pre-written log data generation state of each node in a main database cluster, determining that a target node enters a log idle state in response to the fact that the target node in each node does not generate new pre-written log data in a preset monitoring period, triggering the target node to generate auxiliary pre-written log data according to the log idle state, and synchronizing the auxiliary pre-written log data to a slave database through a stream replication link of the target node. According to the scheme, the master database node actively senses the generation state of the pre-written log data of the master database node, generates auxiliary pre-written log data and sends the auxiliary pre-written log data to the slave database, so that the log buffer structure of the slave database is continuously filled all the time, and the technical problems that the slave database cannot finish the selection of the pre-written log data to be replayed and the replay process is stagnated due to long-time idle of a single node are fundamentally solved.

title_en: Scraper pull-deflection chain identification system and method for thermal imaging and multidimensional quality screening
abstract_en: The application discloses a scraper pull deflection chain identification system and a method for thermal imaging and multidimensional quality screening, and relates to the technical field of industrial equipment fault detection, wherein the system comprises a thermal imaging data acquisition module for acquiring a scraper thermal imaging image or video and outputting original data containing thermal characteristics of a chain and a scraper; the multi-dimensional quality screening module pre-processes original data and outputs an effective image data set, the example segmentation model training module trains an identification model based on the data set and outputs a trained model, the mask post-processing module uses the model to infer a real-time image and outputs a target mask, the linear fitting module processes the target mask and fits and outputs a linear equation, the broken chain feature detection module outputs a broken chain judging result through link continuity analysis, gap detection and thermal feature mutation identification, the angle calculation and comprehensive judging module calculates three types of angles, and the mask integrity and the broken chain result are combined to output an early warning grade and a judging result.

title_en: Senile metabolic co-disease personalized nutrition intervention system based on multiple-study screening
abstract_en: The invention discloses a personalized nutrition intervention system for senile metabolic co-diseases based on multi-group screening, which belongs to the technical field of senile health and comprises a data acquisition and processing module, a feature extraction unification module, an environment state identification module, a metabolic map construction module, a causal inference analysis module, a twin modeling prediction module, a nutrition scheme generation module, an intervention simulation evaluation module and a safety joint evaluation module; compared with the traditional static evaluation method, the method can identify whether the patient is in an adaptation state or a risk state in real time, thereby providing a reliable basis for the dynamic adjustment of a follow-up intervention strategy, improving the adaptation capability of a system to complex environment changes, avoiding the false correlation problem which is easy to occur in the traditional correlation analysis, leading the identification of an intervention target point to be more accurate, being beneficial to guiding the design of a nutrition scheme from the mechanism level, improving the scientificity and the effectiveness of the intervention, and improving the safety and the controllability of the intervention.

title_en: Full-link AI (advanced technology attachment) collaboration system and method for production and research
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production and research full-link AI collaboration system and method, which adopts an in-process fusion deployment architecture to deploy and share a data layer with a host application in the same process. The system comprises four modules, namely, pipeline management, character skill configuration, an AI orchestration engine and a man-machine collaborative auditing module, wherein the pipeline management module defines a processing flow state machine, the character skill configuration module presets a multi-class capacity container as a processing logic abstract frame and supports dynamic increase and decrease and memory mount when a pluggable execution unit runs, the AI orchestration engine dynamically schedules the execution unit and the driving capacity container to complete tasks in a process according to the flow state machine circulation, and the man-machine collaborative auditing module displays AI generation content and historical asset comparison results and acquires manual correction characteristic driving models to self-evolve. The invention realizes the depth fusion of AI and hosts, can flexibly expand the capability, eliminates the cross-system communication overhead and data splitting, and ensures that the generated content is consistent with the semantic meaning of the history asset.

title_en: Method, apparatus, device and storage medium for model distillation
abstract_en: According to embodiments of the present disclosure, methods, apparatuses, devices, and storage media for model distillation are provided. The method includes generating a predicted video frame sequence by performing at least one denoising operation from a noisy image based on text input using a target video generation model, adding a first noise to the predicted video frame sequence to obtain a noisy video frame sequence, determining a first predicted noise added to the predicted video frame sequence by performing multiple denoising operations from the noisy video frame sequence using a reference video generation model, determining a second predicted noise added to the predicted video frame sequence by performing multiple denoising operations from the noisy video frame sequence using an auxiliary video generation model, determining a first prediction score based on a difference between the first predicted noise and the first noise, and determining a second prediction score based on a difference between the second predicted noise and the first noise, and updating a model parameter set of the target video generation model based on the difference between the first prediction score and the second prediction score to obtain an updated target video generation model.

title_en: Ship target high-precision sensing system based on three-source signal fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship target high-precision sensing system based on three-source signal fusion, which relates to the technical field of ship prevention and control and comprises an AIS receiving module, an AIS processing module, a multi-source signal fusion module and a multi-source signal fusion module, wherein the AIS receiving module is used for receiving AIS original data with 1 second as a period, extracting longitude and latitude core parameters and establishing a reference frame as a reference anchor point of the multi-source signal fusion; and configuring a local clock calibrated by the Beidou time service and the PTP protocol, actively inquiring and acquiring the latest AIS data by the FPGA when the AIS signal is not actively output, and adopting FIR filtering noise reduction processing to the AIS signal. According to the invention, a three-source fusion, frequency stabilization and track prediction three-in-one system is constructed, so that the cooperation of ship target frequency updating, high-precision sensing and prospective prediction is realized for the first time, the core pain points with single signal lag and inaccurate prediction in the prior art are solved, and the signal stability and prediction precision are remarkably improved.

title_en: Detection enhancement method, system, equipment and medium for industrial equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a detection enhancement method, a detection enhancement system, detection enhancement equipment and detection enhancement media for industrial equipment. The method comprises the steps of injecting all sensor data in each sampling period into the same global frame sequence number and a high-precision acquisition time stamp to obtain an original synchronous data frame, carrying out signal conditioning on the original synchronous data frame to generate an atomic transmission unit based on the constant constraint of the global frame sequence number and the high-precision acquisition time stamp, storing a reconstructed sensor data frame into a synchronous frame queue according to the ascending sequence of the global frame sequence number, carrying out time alignment decision according to the high-precision acquisition time stamp and the target presentation time corresponding to the reconstructed sensor data frame at the head of the synchronous frame queue to obtain a reconstructed sensor data frame to be rendered currently, carrying out time interpolation calculation based on the reconstructed sensor data frame to be rendered in combination with the previous visual rendering cycle, and generating a synchronous rendering data set. By adopting the method, cross-platform data synchronous visual presentation can be realized.

title_en: Privacy calculation protection method and system for AI large model service
abstract_en: The invention discloses a privacy calculation protection method and a privacy calculation protection system for AI large model service, which relate to the technical field of artificial intelligence and data security, and comprise the following steps: in the privacy calculation protection operation process, a calling time sequence and a privacy consumption decrementing record of a high concurrency stage are collected, alignment processing is carried out according to a uniform time scale, a consumption change sequence is formed, and a consumption approximation mark is written in the tail of the consumption change sequence. According to the method, the consumption change sequence and the consumption approximation mark are constructed, the privacy consumption and output rhythm dislocation section is identified by combining time density comparison and output precision correspondence analysis, continuous high-precision release risks in a critical stage are eliminated from a time structure level through rhythm rearrangement, precision decremental transition and time scale reverse offset dispersion and centralized decremental processes, and dynamic adjustment capacity and overall safety of privacy calculation protection in a large model service scene are improved.

title_en: Turbine blade cooling multi-factor sensitivity analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for analyzing cooling multi-factor sensitivity of a turbine blade. The method comprises the steps of establishing a value interval and probability distribution for each input parameter, and performing first-round sampling to obtain a plurality of samples. And carrying out CFD simulation on the blade geometric model corresponding to each sample. The proxy model is trained using simulation results. And sampling each input parameter for the second round, and inputting the obtained sample into the proxy model to predict the corresponding blade thermal response index. And extracting statistical characteristics for quantifying uncertainty of thermal response indexes of the blades. A first order sensitivity index, a total effect sensitivity index, for each input parameter is calculated, and a sensitivity ranking for each input parameter variation is calculated. According to the invention, the agent model is trained through a small number of sample CFD simulation, and then the agent model is used for replacing large-scale CFD simulation, so that the calculated amount and time cost are effectively reduced, and the uncertainty quantification and sensitivity analysis of the turbine blade are efficiently completed under the condition of limited resources.

title_en: Singlechip intelligent power management system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a singlechip intelligent power management system based on deep reinforcement learning, which belongs to the technical field of power management and artificial intelligence, and comprises a power parameter acquisition circuit, a lightweight reinforcement learning module, a strategy network, a multi-level reward function calculation unit, an increment updating unit and a PWM output control circuit, wherein the lightweight deployment of the deep reinforcement learning model is realized through model quantization, network pruning and low-rank decomposition, the comprehensive optimization efficiency, temperature and stability of the multi-level reward function are designed, and online learning and self-adaptive control are realized by adopting an increment updating mechanism.

title_en: Food supply chain large model knowledge service method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of food supply chains, in particular to a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for large model knowledge service of a food supply chain, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a document to be processed; the method comprises the steps of carrying out content analysis on a document to be processed, generating text content and calculating a content abstract identifier, segmenting the text content into a plurality of document fragments according to a preset segmentation strategy, establishing corresponding relations between the document fragments and the document identifier and between the document fragments and a knowledge base identifier, respectively constructing a term retrieval index, a probability retrieval index and a vector retrieval index based on the document fragments, storing an index result in an index directory of a corresponding knowledge base, filtering candidate document fragments based on tenant isolation, role authority, document-level access control and knowledge base strategy when a query request is received, and carrying out multipath retrieval and score normalization and weighted fusion on the filtered candidate document fragments to obtain a target retrieval result.

title_en: Method for automatic composition of camera photographing in off-line state
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for automatically composing a picture by taking a picture by a camera in an off-line state. The method for automatically composing the picture by the camera in the off-line state comprises the steps of acquiring continuous image frame data of a shooting scene in real time through a camera of shooting equipment, carrying out geometric processing on the continuous image frame data, calculating geometric parameters of visual elements, judging main body elements and secondary body elements in a current picture according to the geometric parameters of the visual elements, calculating optimal composition point coordinates of the current picture by taking the visual gravity center of the main body elements as a reference, and guiding a user on a screen of the shooting equipment in real time in a multi-mode according to deviation between the optimal composition point coordinates and the current main body element position. The invention runs on the equipment local completely, does not need any network connection, and the image data is always stored on the user equipment local, so that the low-delay real-time composition guidance can be realized, the privacy of the user is effectively protected, the use cost of the user is reduced, and the invention is suitable for various indoor and outdoor shooting environments.

title_en: Optical chip fault analysis method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optical chips and discloses an optical chip fault analysis method, an optical chip fault analysis device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-mode detection data of an optical chip production line; the method comprises the steps of encoding multi-mode detection data to obtain feature vectors corresponding to each mode detection data, fusing all the feature vectors corresponding to the multi-mode detection data to obtain multi-mode joint vectors, constructing a knowledge graph of the optical chip field, constructing a fine adjustment data set based on the knowledge graph of the optical chip field, fine adjusting a pre-training large model based on the fine adjustment data set to obtain a fine adjustment large model, and reasoning based on the multi-mode joint vectors by adopting the fine adjustment large model and the knowledge graph of the optical chip field to obtain a fault analysis result. According to the invention, through fusion of the multi-mode feature vectors, association analysis can be performed from a global view, and fault analysis is performed by combining the knowledge graph and the large model, so that the accuracy, comprehensiveness and intelligence level of fault analysis are improved.

title_en: Watermark identification-based bidding document tracing and anti-cross bidding method and device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electronic bidding anti-surrounding string marks, and aims to solve the problem that surrounding string mark behaviors are difficult to find and trace. The method comprises the steps of generating a unique identification ID for a bidder, carrying out hash coding to generate a binary watermark sequence, processing the binary watermark sequence to obtain a redundant watermark sequence, coding information bits in the redundant watermark sequence into corresponding stripe units according to a preset gray coding rule, embedding the stripe units at the bottom of a logo picture to form a hidden stripe watermark, calculating a perceived hash value of the logo picture, storing the perceived hash value and bidder identification information as watermark metadata in a database, extracting the logo picture from a PDF bid file, determining the source of the bid file and the identity of the bidder through perceived hash fuzzy matching, constructing a watermark similarity matrix of the bid file based on watermark verification results, carrying out cluster analysis and identifying abnormal association relations among different bid files, and judging whether string surrounding behaviors exist.

title_en: Identity sensing method, device and equipment applied to robot with body
abstract_en: The application provides an identity sensing method, device and equipment applied to a robot with a body, wherein the robot with the body firstly obtains current multi-mode sensing data of an object to be identified, processes the current multi-mode sensing data by utilizing a trained identity recognition model to obtain a current sequence-level identity characteristic representation of the object to be identified, and obtains a current identity sensing result corresponding to the current sequence-level identity characteristic representation in a matching way based on a constructed identity understanding map (V, E), wherein V represents identity nodes at all moments, E represents node relations, so that more accurate and robust identity recognition can be realized to promote the robot to comprehensively transform from a task executor to an environment percepter and an autonomous interactor.

title_en: Information release processing method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides an information release processing method and device, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring storage operation system management information to be processed from a data storage information base, acquiring purchase logistics management information to be processed from a purchase management system and acquiring storage logistics management information to be processed from a warehouse management system based on a preset application and data integration system, performing information processing on the storage operation system management information, the purchase logistics management information and the storage logistics management information according to information processing operation triggered by a target verification user to obtain information release contents to be released, creating corresponding hypertext markup language webpages based on the information release contents to be released, and releasing the hypertext markup language webpages to clients in different corresponding areas for display. The information release processing method provided by the invention can effectively improve the efficiency of logistics information release processing, thereby improving the use experience of users.

title_en: Headache etiology analysis method based on knowledge graph and deep learning
