abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of knowledge graph and deep learning, and relates to a headache etiology analysis method based on knowledge graph and deep learning, which comprises the steps of obtaining unstructured text vectors representing the state of an analysis object and a multidimensional time sequence feature sequence, and extracting multidimensional feature tensors after modal alignment; the method comprises the steps of constructing a logic topology gating matrix based on a global knowledge graph, multiplying the logic topology gating matrix by a dynamic edge feature matrix generated according to the integral overlapping degree of a time window to obtain a path response intensity matrix, inputting the matrix into a graph neural network to implement topological pruning, and blocking a feature propagation path deviating from causal constraint.

title_en: Online and offline integrated retail inventory real-time synchronization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an online and offline integrated real-time synchronization method for retail inventory, and relates to the technical field of retail information. The method comprises the steps of constructing a behavior transformation probability model according to commodity SKUs and business hours based on store historical cash register transaction running water and electronic price tag touch event logs to obtain initial probability parameters and attenuation rate parameters, detecting goods taking sign events of store shelf areas in real time, generating a preemption record containing preemption validity period by combining real-time environment correction factors, sending the preemption record to a cloud inventory center to deduct saleable inventory on a line in advance and storing the preemption record in a preemption record pool, monitoring cash register transaction running water generated by a cash register system, confirming that the preemption record is converted into formal sales record when preset space-time matching conditions are met, and canceling the preemption record and recovering the inventory when the preemption record is not confirmed. The inventory preemption triggered by taking the goods symptoms is beneficial to improving the real-time performance of online and offline inventory synchronization.

title_en: Batch cutting method and system for spliced document images based on parting line detection and quality check
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of document image processing, and provides a batch cropping method and system for spliced images based on parting line detection and quality verification. The method comprises the steps of obtaining images formed by splicing multiple pages of content according to rows and columns, initializing an ultra-large resolution image, carrying out graying and noise reduction, carrying out edge detection, adopting directional morphological operation to strengthen a linear structure, obtaining candidate line segments based on linear detection of a strengthening result, screening partition line coordinates according to direction constraint and boundary elimination, merging, de-duplication and sequencing similar partition lines, constructing a cutting area according to the ordered partition lines to generate candidate subgraphs, checking and filtering invalid slices through a minimum size/area threshold value and geometric consistency, outputting a checking list if necessary, and storing and recording abnormal information through checked subgraph numbers. By the scheme, cutting consistency and processing stability of automatic splitting of the spliced document images are improved, miscut is reduced, and traceability of results is enhanced.

title_en: Geological attribute grid rendering method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a geological attribute grid rendering method which comprises the steps of obtaining geometric outer surface parameters, constructing a hollow model shell according to the geometric outer surface parameters, obtaining coordinates of the hollow model shell, conducting attribute mapping on the hollow model shell based on the coordinates of the hollow model shell to obtain a mapping model, analyzing the mapping model, determining geological grids on the mapping model, merging planes of the geological grids with similar attributes on the mapping model to obtain a low-precision model, and rendering the low-precision model to obtain a high-precision mapping model. The method has the advantages that the number of geometric bodies such as triangles can be effectively reduced, the model is simplified, the data volume of rendering is reduced, the calculated volume of rendering is reduced, the rendering efficiency is improved, and the rendering effect is better.

title_en: Personalized pet nutrition and health care product recommendation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a personalized pet nutrition and health care product recommending method and system, and relates to the field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the specific steps of collecting pet related information and labels from a multi-source system, executing normalization and nonlinear interaction feature construction on the numerical features, executing self-adaptive embedding and class crossing on the class type features to obtain enhanced original vectors, screening the features by using label related information, carrying out clustering fusion to obtain a fusion feature matrix, adopting an improved feature crossing network, introducing low-rank decomposition and pet health knowledge prior to construct a classification model, constructing a loss function introducing rule constraint regular terms, training the model, updating parameters, and recommending nutrition and health products for the pets by the trained model. The method can accurately capture the complex relation between the features and remarkably improve the accuracy of model prediction.

title_en: Forbidden band width measurement method and device
abstract_en: A method for measuring the width of forbidden band includes such steps as thermally coupling the semiconductor sample to be measured with temp sensor, fixing it, connecting the resistance measuring probe to universal measuring interface, recognizing the type of probe, loading the matched measuring protocol and correction algorithm, applying constant current excitation, building constant-current voltage and temp acquisition link, real-time acquisition of voltage and conversion of resistance, synchronous acquisition of temp data, calculating the variation rate of temp and variation of resistance, judging the state of measuring scene, switching sampling period, regulating heating link to realize closed-loop control of temp, and full-temp area scan adaptation. At each temperature stabilizing point in the target temperature interval, measuring at least two groups of total resistances with different effective lengths to obtain intrinsic resistances, obtaining a temperature intrinsic resistance value pair, synchronously collecting multiple physical quantity parameters, slicing, carrying out environmental error correction, constructing a linear relation based on correction data, calculating the forbidden bandwidth by using a slope, and outputting a measurement report, thereby providing an efficient and reliable technical scheme for the accurate measurement of the forbidden bandwidth of the semiconductor material.

title_en: Capsule endoscope image enhancement recovery method based on degradation competition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a capsule endoscope image enhancement and restoration method based on degradation competition, and belongs to the field of image enhancement and restoration. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a current capsule endoscope color image, checking adjacent frames at the same time, screening and registering reference frames, constructing a reference color map and a brightness reference map, calling a pre-calibrated physical prior model to estimate a physical illumination field and a reflective diffusion field, calculating low illumination, mirror reflection, motion blur and liquid film scattering degradation credibility, competing to determine a pixel level dominant degradation state, controlling a restoration item to selectively participate in joint optimization through a dominant restoration sign, auxiliary restoration weight and restoration gating information, combining chromaticity constraint, mucosa microstructure direction continuous constraint, uncertainty fusion and high uncertainty area rollback to obtain an enhanced restoration brightness image, updating a color channel according to a brightness ratio, and outputting the enhanced restored capsule endoscope color image.

title_en: Corrosion monitoring method, system and storage medium in oil pipeline
abstract_en: The invention provides an oil pipeline corrosion monitoring method, system and storage medium, which are used for monitoring the initial period, collecting response data of a defect geometry and a sensor array by scanning a reference pipe section containing a defect with a known size and non-uniformity, constructing an initial response matrix through singular value decomposition as a zero moment posterior response matrix, establishing a response matrix time evolution state space model based on a last moment posterior response matrix and an error covariance, determining a process noise covariance by combining a last moment corrosion form space frequency characteristic, predicting a current moment prior response matrix and the error covariance, selecting an optimal wavelet base according to the corrosion form characteristic, constructing a sparse transformation matrix, collecting a current sensor signal, solving an L1 norm minimization problem in a sparse domain by taking form sparsity as a constraint, reconstructing corrosion form distribution, and updating the response matrix and the error covariance by utilizing an actual measurement signal and a reconstruction result.

title_en: Artifact consciousness element comparison detection system for flow type brain electrical data
abstract_en: A flow type brain electricity data-oriented artifact consciousness element comparison detection system comprises a preprocessing module, a differential entropy feature extraction module, an artifact processing module, an artifact consciousness image neural network, a Transformer network and a classification module, wherein the flow type pipeline is strictly causally adopted, all statistics are based on history or global static prior, the image neural network is controlled by a real-time mask, aggregation weights among nodes are closed or opened in real time according to current signal quality, complex physiological signal variation is disassembled into three observable dimensions through a hierarchical supervision comparison loss function to carry out step learning, and the model can be quickly adapted to a target tested by utilizing a small sample through element learning.

title_en: Method for determining temperature field of refrigerator, controller, refrigerator, medium and program product
abstract_en: The application provides a method for determining a refrigerator temperature field, a controller, a refrigerator, a medium and a program product, which comprise the steps of recording multidimensional basic observation data based on a time stamp in a preset sampling period, performing data cleaning and feature extraction on the basic observation data to obtain time sequence features and working condition features, performing logic combination to construct a high-dimensional feature vector, performing normalization processing on the high-dimensional feature vector to obtain normalized features, inputting the normalized features into a local lightweight virtual sensor model, outputting to obtain temperature field data in a compartment, performing training on the lightweight virtual sensor model in advance based on normal operation parameters of a prototype refrigerator under various working conditions to obtain a basic virtual sensor model, and performing optimization on the basic virtual sensor model through controller hardware parameter adaptation processing, structure pruning processing and low-level wide fixed point quantitative processing. The application can solve the problems of dead zone, slow temperature measurement response, large fluctuation and the like of the temperature measurement of the traditional refrigerator.

title_en: Real-time data processing method and medium for dynamic DWS six-face scanning system
abstract_en: The invention provides a real-time data processing method and medium of a dynamic DWS six-sided scanning system, which relate to the technical field of DWS scanning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of constructing a unified time reference, mapping original point cloud data acquired by a DWS six-sided scanner, executing observation confidence fusion of each voxel grid according to a mapping result, executing conflict voxel detection, executing local reconstruction processing according to voxel abnormal identifiers, executing global verification recognition after updating the observation confidence fusion result by utilizing the local reconstruction result, converting the updated observation confidence fusion result into a structured description code and outputting the structured description code, and solving the technical problem that the asynchronous sampling error of a plurality of scanning surfaces is difficult to process based on time synchronization and linear speed compensation in the conventional six-sided scanning, so that point cloud dislocation is inconsistent with structural reconstruction in a dynamic conveying scene. The technical effects of the DWS measurement accuracy and reliability are improved by constructing unified dynamic space-time reference and voxel level multisource confidence fusion through encoder pulses.

title_en: Multi-mode gastric cancer risk prediction method and system based on gating attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multimode stomach cancer risk prediction method and a multimode stomach cancer risk prediction system based on a gating attention mechanism, which relate to the technical field of stomach cancer risk prediction and comprise, preprocessing abdomen CT image, stomach organ identification result and health text information, fusing standardized CT image and stomach organ identification result, and constructing organ priori enhanced image. And extracting image features and text features from the organ prior enhanced image and the healthy text information, respectively calculating self-attention and cross-attention, generating a gating fusion coefficient of the image and the text according to a self-attention entropy value and a cross-attention peak value, weighting and fusing the two attention outputs to obtain the gating fusion features, then calculating the self-attention and the cross-attention, adding the self-attention and the cross-attention in equal proportion to obtain the fusion features, and classifying and outputting the risk of gastric cancer of the target sample. The invention makes the image feature and the text feature mutually complement, improves the accuracy and the stability of gastric cancer risk prediction, is suitable for health management assistance, and does not serve as clinical diagnosis basis.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for generating augmented question-answer pair retrieval enhancement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for generating an augmented question and answer pair retrieval enhancement, which relate to the technical field of large model retrieval enhancement generation and illusion alleviation and comprise the steps of obtaining a structured corpus; extracting entity and association sets of each of paired entity and multiple entities from corpus, combining entity-association-question-answer pairs to obtain domain knowledge base, extracting entity keywords and association keywords for user inquiry, combining knowledge diffusion mechanism by vector retrieval to obtain optimal supplementary knowledge set, fusing original inquiry and optimal supplementary knowledge set by prompt template, inputting the fused prompt template into LLM to generate final response. The invention captures complex association in data comprehensively through the hypergraph structure, obviously reduces the illusion rate of LLM and improves the accuracy and reliability of response.

title_en: Edge gateway computing power dynamic distribution system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of dynamic computing power distribution, and discloses an edge gateway dynamic computing power distribution system based on deep reinforcement learning. The system extracts the received data volume of each load domain, the length of a queue to be analyzed and the deadline of the earliest task before protocol analysis, and generates an entry congestion index in a fusion way. And then converting the index into an initial calculation power quota through an offline trained strategy network, deducting the basic reserved calculation power, and compiling into a system calculation power token. The dispatcher analyzes and infers the preprocessing task according to the token control protocol, and the task exceeding the bearing limit is kept in the receiving buffer. According to the invention, the calculation force scheduling is attached to the hardware bus beat, and the overall calculation force response efficiency of the edge equipment is improved.

title_en: Systems and methods for wide neural network and sense array measurement estimation
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to systems and methods for wide neural networks and sensing array measurement estimation. The full sensing array can be modeled using a wide neural network (BNN). The sense array may generate a first vector comprising P measurements. The full sensing array may be modeled by generating a second vector comprising Q wave domain measurements using the first vector as follows. The first vector may be multiplied by an interpolation matrix to produce interpolated vectors that each include Q interpolated values. Applying a transform function to the interpolated vector produces a representation vector that can be interleaved to produce Q pooled inputs. The second vector may be generated by performing a plurality of non-linear pooling operations on the Q pooled inputs, wherein one of the non-linear pooling operations generates one of the Q wave domain measurements in the second vector from one of the Q pooled inputs. The interpolation matrix may be generated by training the BNN.

title_en: AI self-adaptive drug delivery control system and method of intelligent drug delivery equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AI self-adaptive drug delivery control system and method of intelligent drug delivery equipment, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent medical equipment and artificial intelligence. The technical problems to be solved are the problems of poor suitability of the existing open-loop drug delivery, insufficient interpretability of AI decisions, missing safety protection mechanisms and poor privacy compliance. The technical scheme is characterized in that a multi-source data acquisition module is used for acquiring real-time physiological signals, historical treatment data and activity mode data of a user, a standardized data set is obtained through space-time alignment and time sequence feature extraction, an AI model integrating time sequence prediction and reinforcement learning is input, drug delivery parameters are output, drug delivery execution is controlled after double safety verification, and the model and individual drug generation parameters are dynamically optimized through a closed loop feedback module, so that personalized self-adaptive drug delivery of a full-link closed loop is realized.

title_en: Ship track prediction method and device based on world model, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a ship track prediction method, a device, electronic equipment and a medium based on a world model, wherein the method comprises the steps that a primary coarse-grained classification layer determines a target sea area based on historical track data and performs grid division to predict coarse-grained grid indexes of a target ship; the physical consistency constraint module determines a preliminary prediction position based on the coarse-granularity grid index and the fine position offset, maps the preliminary prediction position into a pre-constructed world model comprising an unreachable area for physical consistency verification, and outputs a target prediction track based on a verification result. According to the method, the continuous coordinate regression task is converted into the stepwise nested classification task through the first-level coarse-grained classification layer and the multi-level fine classification layer, so that the convergence difficulty of the ship track prediction model is effectively reduced, and the accuracy and the authenticity of track prediction in a multi-ship scene are remarkably improved.

title_en: Comprehensive investigation and value coupling evaluation method for geological remains, ecological environment and human landscape
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive investigation and value coupling evaluation method for geological remains, ecological environment and humane landscape, and relates to the technical field of resource environment investigation and evaluation. The method comprises the steps of firstly constructing a comprehensive investigation index system comprising three parallel dimensions of geological remains, ecological environment and human landscape, collecting data, then calculating value indexes of the dimensions respectively, then introducing a coupling coordination degree model, quantitatively calculating coupling degree, comprehensive coordination indexes and coupling coordination degree among the three systems, and finally dividing a target area into a pure scientific value area, a comprehensive travel value area and an ecological protection value area according to the relative relation between the coupling coordination degree and the value indexes of the dimensions, and outputting corresponding planning management strategies. The invention solves the technical problems that the view angle is single, the system is split, the comprehensive value and the cooperative conflict relation cannot be evaluated in the prior art, and can provide a quantitative decision basis for scientific planning and management of national parks, geological parks and ecological protection areas.

title_en: Three-dimensional thermal network model construction method and system for power module
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional thermal network model construction method and system for a power module. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining parameters of each material layer and a convective heat transfer coefficient of fluid, obtaining distribution of heat flow density along the thickness direction through single-chip simulation, deriving an equivalent heat transfer area based on heat flow conservation and abstracting the equivalent heat transfer area into an ellipse with equal area after fitting the heat flow density attenuation coefficient, obtaining an effective heat transfer area through physical boundary cutting and overlapping area division, constructing longitudinal heat transfer resistance according to the effective heat transfer area, establishing transverse coupling heat resistance based on chip center distance and overlapping area, mapping the effective area of the bottom surface of a radiator to a fin side at the same time, calculating the convective heat transfer heat resistance, taking the effective heat transfer areas of each layer as temperature nodes, obtaining the equivalent heat capacity through discrete integration of the volumes of the material layers, and finally taking each heat resistance and heat capacity as basic elements to form a three-dimensional heat network model. The method can uniformly process the boundary effect and the thermal coupling of the multi-chip, is suitable for different power modules and radiating structures, and realizes rapid thermal design.

title_en: Performing thermal management in a processor device based on a temperature evolution model
abstract_en: Performing thermal management in a processor device based on a temperature evolution model is disclosed herein. In some aspects, a processor device provides cluster thermal management circuitry configured to determine power consumption measurements for corresponding functional units of processor cores of a plurality of processor cores of a core cluster. The cluster thermal management circuitry also determines temperature measurements made by corresponding digital thermal sensors (thermal sensors) external to a point of interest (POI) within the processor core. The cluster thermal management circuit generates a predicted temperature at the POI based on a temperature evolution model that correlates the power consumption measurements and the temperature measurements with the predicted temperature at the POI. The cluster thermal management circuitry performs a thermal management operation on condition that the cluster thermal management circuitry determines that the predicted temperature at the POI exceeds a thermal mitigation threshold.

title_en: Method and device for evaluating operation fatigue degree of coupling muscle, gesture and fatigue grading
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for evaluating operation fatigue of coupling muscle, gesture and fatigue classification, which relate to operation and human-machine fatigue evaluation and comprise the steps of collecting electromyographic signals under the current operation environment and extracting electromyographic data characteristic values; the method comprises the steps of carrying out fitting on fatigue grading and myoelectricity data characteristic values under the current working environment based on a support vector regression method to obtain fitting results as muscle subjective fatigue data, collecting image data of limb parts covering corresponding areas of muscle surfaces, establishing a skeleton-based convolution gesture machine CPM model, inputting the image data into the CPM model to output joint point thermodynamic diagrams, obtaining gesture fatigue scores through a quick upper limb assessment RULA method based on the joint point thermodynamic diagrams to determine gesture fatigue data, and fitting the muscle subjective fatigue data and the gesture fatigue data by adopting a first principal component method to determine working fatigue assessment results. The application is used for more comprehensively and objectively evaluating the fatigue degree of the upper limb of certain operation.

title_en: Ancient city space evolution simulation system and method based on entity interaction driving
abstract_en: The invention provides an ancient city space evolution simulation system and method based on entity interaction driving, which realize dynamic simulation from micro-architecture to macro-city texture evolution through bidirectional coupling of an entity chessboard at a physical end and a rule evolution engine at a digital end. The invention realizes non-line-of-sight entity identification through the pressure sensing matrix, effectively solves the problem that visual interaction is easy to be blocked and disturbed by illumination, improves the system stability under complex operation, converts microcosmic architecture landing into macroscopic city evolution in real time by combining with an event-driven multi-stage rule matching engine, and realizes dynamic simulation and visual explanation of history logic in the ancient city space generation process.

title_en: Report analysis method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a report analysis method, a report analysis device and electronic equipment, which comprise the steps of obtaining a report to be analyzed, converting the report to be analyzed into text information and layout information corresponding to the text information, determining a feature vector of the report to be analyzed in at least one dimension according to the text information and the layout information, obtaining at least one analysis strategy for analyzing the report to be analyzed, determining strategy weights corresponding to the analysis strategies according to the feature vector, analyzing the report to be analyzed according to the strategy weights corresponding to the analysis strategies respectively, obtaining preliminary analysis results corresponding to the analysis strategies, and fusing the preliminary analysis results to obtain target analysis results of the report to be analyzed. The embodiment of the application can automatically analyze reports such as financial reports and the like which need to be analyzed, and allocate corresponding strategy weights for analysis strategies aiming at different reports so as to analyze different reports, thereby improving the analysis efficiency of the reports and the analysis quality of the reports.

title_en: Operational dimension data processing method and device for pumped storage power station based on big data
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device, computer equipment, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product for processing operation and maintenance data of a pumped storage power station based on big data, which can be used in the technical field of big data. The method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source operation and maintenance data of target equipment in a pumped storage power station, extracting multi-dimensional feature data from the multi-source operation and maintenance data, carrying out feature screening and fusion processing on the multi-dimensional feature data to obtain fusion feature vectors, inputting the fusion feature vectors into a pre-trained health prediction model to carry out health prediction processing to obtain health information of the target equipment, generating early warning information of the target equipment according to the health information and a dynamic health threshold of the target equipment, and carrying out resource collaborative scheduling processing on the target equipment based on the early warning information. By adopting the method, the timeliness of scheduling processing of the equipment can be improved.

title_en: Gait muscle strength dynamic estimation method based on muscle synergy
abstract_en: The invention relates to a gait muscle strength dynamic estimation method based on muscle synergy, and relates to the technical field of biomechanical analysis and rehabilitation exoskeleton control. The method comprises the steps of obtaining gait data of a subject, constructing a personalized musculoskeletal digital twin model, constructing a smooth muscle-tendon dynamics model, constructing an optimal control problem of fusion level anatomical collaborative constraint, discretizing the problem into a nonlinear programming problem by using a direct point distribution method, implementing a hot start strategy based on a static optimization and layering degradation mechanism to generate an initial solution, and calling a solver to solve and output a gait cycle muscle force curve. The method disclosed by the invention is added with a layered hot start mechanism while introducing a nerve control prior, eliminates non-physiological high-frequency calculation artifacts on the basis of ensuring high dynamics tracking precision, solves the difficult problem that high-dimensional solution is easy to fall into local minima, and thus provides a high-fidelity and high-robustness methodology foundation for clinical rehabilitation of specific patients and exoskeleton controller planning.

title_en: Heavy-load joint pretightening force self-adaptive control method based on wearing state of transmission part
abstract_en: The invention relates to a heavy-duty joint pretightening force self-adaptive control method based on a transmission piece wearing state, which comprises the steps of collecting load data and vibration signals of a joint in real time, adopting a support vector machine algorithm to identify initial wearing feature indexes of the transmission piece, dynamically estimating the wearing state of the transmission piece by using a Kalman filtering algorithm to obtain an estimated value containing pretightening force attenuation amount, separating a wearing acceleration factor from the estimated value and carrying out numerical integration to obtain an accumulated wearing increment, determining a compensation coefficient according to a preset wearing-pretightening force proportional relation, generating a control instruction sequence according to the compensation coefficient, outputting the control instruction sequence to a joint driver by an embedded controller, and applying the real-time pretightening force compensation value. The invention can dynamically sense the real abrasion state of the transmission part and establish the mapping relation between the abrasion loss and the pretightening force compensation, thereby realizing the real-time self-adaptive adjustment of the pretightening force of the joint under the complex heavy-load working condition and continuously maintaining the high-precision and high-stability operation of the joint.

title_en: Difficulty controllable question setting method and system based on bloom cognitive hierarchy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a difficulty controllable question setting method and a difficulty controllable question setting system based on a Bloom cognition level, belongs to the technical field of intelligent education, and solves the problems that an existing automatic question setting system lacks explicit modeling of the question cognition level, causes uncontrollable question difficulty and difficult matching of student capability level, six K1-K6 knowledge units corresponding to a Bloom classification method are defined, a subject examination point knowledge map with cognition level annotation is constructed through five-round hierarchical annotation, ablation verification and semantic clustering duplication elimination driven by a large language model, a natural language anchor point to knowledge node mapping is established, cognition constraint is determined through anchor point projection and knowledge sub-graph retrieval during question setting, high-quality questions are generated through candidate questions generation, multidimensional evaluation and thinking back iteration, and human-computer cooperation closed loop feedback of teachers is supported.

title_en: Coal mine drilling coiled tubing lowering anti-blocking device and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of underground continuous pipes of coal mines, and relates to a coal mine drilling continuous pipe lowering anti-blocking device and a method, wherein the method utilizes the anti-blocking device to lower the continuous pipe in an underground open hole drilling of the coal mine, and specifically comprises the following steps of selecting the anti-blocking device with corresponding specification according to the inner diameter of the drilling hole and the outer diameter of the continuous pipe, and calculating the appointed distance for installing the interval between two adjacent anti-blocking devices; when the coiled tubing is lowered into the borehole, the anti-blocking devices are sequentially arranged on the coiled tubing at intervals of a designated distance. The invention establishes a mathematical model for reasonably arranging the anti-blocking devices, combines the inner diameter of a drilling hole, the outer diameter of a continuous pipe and the underground stress characteristics with the control of the clearance coefficient of the anti-blocking devices, provides a method for selecting the anti-blocking devices with proper specifications and the interval distance between the two anti-blocking devices, and avoids structural redundancy caused by serious eccentricity or too small interval caused by too large interval.

title_en: Dynamic identification system for multi-source heterogeneous data element feature learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic identification system for multi-source heterogeneous data element feature learning, which comprises a data acquisition preprocessing module, a data element semantic lattice construction module, a heterogeneous characterization casting mould module, a cross-source association matching module, a feature learning module, a positioning identification module and an incremental updating module, wherein the data acquisition preprocessing module is used for generating a multi-source standardized data set, the data element semantic lattice construction module is used for carrying out data element semantic lattice construction to generate a data element sample set, the heterogeneous characterization casting mould module is used for carrying out heterogeneous characterization casting to generate a data element initial feature set, the cross-source association matching module is used for carrying out data element cross-source association matching to generate a data element association candidate set, the feature learning module is used for utilizing an improved UniTTab model to generate a unified data element feature representation set, the positioning identification module is used for carrying out positioning identification of a characterization star map to generate a dynamic identification result, and the incremental updating module is used for generating an updated dynamic identification result, so that unified characterization, cross-source association matching, dynamic identification and continuous updating of multi-source heterogeneous data elements are realized.

title_en: Portable medical PDA terminal based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of medical FDA terminals, and particularly relates to a portable medical PDA terminal based on artificial intelligence, which comprises a shell, wherein a hardware module and a software module are arranged on the shell, the hardware module comprises a display screen, the display screen is arranged on the shell, a bar code scanner, an RFID reader-writer and a camera are arranged on one side of the shell, which is close to the display screen, a microphone is arranged on the front side of the shell, which is close to the display screen, a loudspeaker is arranged on the inner side wall of the shell, a processor, a wireless network module and a battery are arranged in the shell, and the software module comprises an AI engine module and a data processing module, and the AI engine module and the data processing module are arranged in the shell.

title_en: Engineering construction progress management system based on building construction process data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an engineering construction progress management system based on building construction process data, which relates to the technical field of engineering construction management, wherein the invention firstly judges the progress deviation of a construction process based on the construction process data, if the progress deviation exceeds a preset deviation threshold value, identifies a basic root cause affecting the construction progress based on the construction process data to obtain root cause identification data, then inputs the root cause identification data and conduction prediction auxiliary data into an engineering twinning model to complete risk conduction simulation and output progress prediction data, and finally combines dynamic resource constraint, construction period constraint and cost constraint to generate a progress optimization scheme.

title_en: Content detection method, device, apparatus, storage medium, and program product
abstract_en: The application discloses a content detection method, a content detection device, a content detection apparatus, a content detection device, a content detection storage medium and a content detection program product, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps of obtaining user input content to be detected, detecting the user input content through at least two target detection engines in M detection engines to obtain a judging detection result and a first confidence coefficient of the judging detection result output by each target detection engine, determining probability distribution information of each target detection engine on detection results of different categories according to reliability dynamic evaluation data of each target detection engine and the first confidence coefficient of the judging detection result, determining target confidence coefficient of the at least two target detection engines on the detection results of different categories according to the probability distribution information and conflict factors, and determining the detection result of the user input content according to the target confidence coefficient. Thus, the problem of inaccurate content detection results can be solved.

title_en: Vibration characteristic analysis method and related device for high-end bearing rotor system
abstract_en: The application discloses a vibration characteristic analysis method and a related device of a high-end bearing rotor system, and relates to the technical field of ship power systems; based on ship impact specification, taking a three-way explosion shock wave time-course curve as excitation input of a model, solving an impact dynamics equation in the model to obtain impact acceleration of a bearing-rotor-casing system, converting the impact acceleration into dynamic contact force of a bearing supporting node, inputting the dynamic contact force into the model, solving time-varying film thickness distribution and a flash temperature field based on lubricating oil pressure sticking effect, oil film shearing property and surface roughness, establishing a critical temperature criterion of bonding failure, comparing a peak value of the flash temperature field with the critical temperature criterion to determine the risk of bonding failure of the bearing, and determining the vibration property and interface failure evaluation result of the system according to the coupling influence rule of an impact load form, an impact action stage and a rotating speed working condition on vibration response, interface lubrication state and friction temperature rise of the system.

title_en: Urban and rural water supply scheduling optimization system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban and rural water supply dispatching optimization system and method, which relate to the technical field of hydraulic engineering and comprise the following steps: the system comprises a hydraulic water quality dynamic coupling model module, an emergency simulation and tracing module, a zoned pressure barrier dynamic construction module, a multi-target collaborative optimization scheduling module and a pipeline structure stress hydraulic state feedback module. According to the invention, by constructing the hydraulic water quality dynamic coupling model and integrating the sudden pollution event simulation and tracing, the partition pressure barrier dynamic construction, the multi-objective collaborative optimization scheduling and the pipeline structure stress feedback mechanism, the integrated and accurate scheduling of the urban and rural water supply system in the normal state and the emergency state is realized, the defects of the prior art that the hydraulic water quality model is disjointed, the pollution tracing efficiency is low, the emergency control means is single and the multi-objective collaborative is insufficient are effectively overcome, and the water quality safety guarantee capability, the pollution diffusion inhibition efficiency and the pipe network operation life of the water supply system are remarkably improved.

title_en: Automatic parting and resetting strategy generation method, system and equipment for maxillofacial fracture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and equipment for generating an automatic parting and resetting strategy for maxillofacial fracture. The method comprises the steps of obtaining CT images and dentition scanning data of a patient, generating a fracture block surface point cloud and an occlusion contact point cloud through pretreatment, respectively constructing a fracture map taking the fracture block as a node and an occlusion map taking the contact point as a node, respectively encoding two types of map structures through a geometric encoder and a functional encoder, mapping form and functional information to the same embedded space through cross-modal contrast loss joint optimization, initializing primitive vectors of binding atom rigid body transformation in the embedded space, obtaining the prediction rigid body transformation of each fracture block through weighting combination according to the matching weight of the fracture block node characteristics and the primitives, completing end-to-end training through a joint loss function comprising parting constraint and resetting constraint, and synchronously outputting fracture parting results and individualized resetting strategies during reasoning. By the scheme, the cooperative optimization of the form and the function can be realized, and the parting precision and the resetting quality are improved.

title_en: Comment information filtering inspection and tracing method and system based on multi-source public data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical fields of big data processing, information security and network information analysis, and discloses a comment information filtering, checking and tracing method and a system based on multi-source public data, the invention obtains original comment data through a multi-source data acquisition mechanism, carries out semantic analysis and structuring processing to form standardized data, then constructs a multi-dimensional characteristic system comprising account characteristics, content characteristics and propagation characteristics, and carrying out reliability assessment on comment information, further constructing a propagation graph model by combining comment propagation relations, realizing accurate tracing of comment sources through time sequence analysis and node confidence calculation, extracting a complete propagation path, simultaneously introducing a blockchain storage certificate and a digital watermarking technology, carrying out multiple verification on a tracing result, finally fusing the reliability assessment result and the tracing information based on a dynamic updating mechanism, generating a structured comment reliable result set and outputting a tracing report.

title_en: Commercial opportunity mining method integrating quality perception reasoning
abstract_en: The invention provides a business machine mining method integrating quality perception reasoning, which comprises the steps of carrying out attribute identification on information data to obtain data attributes of the information data, wherein the data attributes comprise data source types, data credibility, data integrity and data emphasis, determining at least one analysis dimension corresponding to the information data based on the data emphasis and the data source types, calling an analysis agent corresponding to the analysis dimension, carrying out reasoning depth prediction based on the data source types, the data credibility and the data integrity to obtain reasoning rounds and reasoning confidence of the analysis agent for reasoning the information data, calling an analysis agent corresponding to the analysis dimension, carrying out data analysis on the information data based on the reasoning rounds and the reasoning confidence to obtain a target analysis result of the information data of the analysis dimension, and generating a business machine report of the information data based on the target analysis result of the at least one analysis dimension. Through the mode, the accuracy of the excavated business machine can be improved.

title_en: International logistics proxy expense checking system and method based on intelligent contract
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of blockchain technology and data processing, and discloses an international logistics proxy expense checking system and method based on intelligent contracts. The method comprises the steps of collecting business data by an adaptation module to generate a merck tree and chaining a root hash value, calling a directed acyclic graph model by an execution module to execute topology calculation, suspending a flow and generating a context snapshot if a difference value exists in the amount of money, restoring the model under the chain by an exploration module, reversely locking an input node causing divergence, injecting discrete parameters to perform trial calculation, extracting a converged target state variable and a cryptology proving path thereof to be sent to the chain, and executing local recalculation to release suspension after the verification of the execution module is passed. The application reduces the consumption of calculation force on the chain caused by full graph back recalculation by separating the on-chain verification and the off-chain deduction, and realizes the automatic fault-tolerant adjustment of the reconciliation process.

title_en: Memory device and memory calibration method
abstract_en: A memory device includes a memory array and a peripheral circuit. The memory array includes a first memory region and a second memory region. The peripheral circuit is electrically connected to the memory array and is used for receiving an external clock signal, a first synchronous signal and a second synchronous signal. The peripheral circuit is used for generating a first pulse signal corresponding to the first storage area and a second pulse signal corresponding to the second storage area according to an external clock signal. The peripheral circuit is used for adjusting the time sequence of the first pulse signal and the second pulse signal by using the same parameter, and the same parameter is set as an internal calibration parameter of the memory device when the first phase of the first pulse signal corresponds to a preset phase of the first synchronous signal and the second phase of the second pulse signal corresponds to a preset phase of the second synchronous signal. Accordingly, correction of the memory device will be accomplished efficiently.

title_en: Simulation propulsion method and system based on double-engine fusion and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of parallel heterogeneous computation and simulation, and provides a simulation propulsion method, a simulation propulsion system and a readable storage medium based on double-engine fusion; the method comprises the steps of constructing a joint working mechanism of a simulation engine and a rendering engine, wherein the simulation engine is used for logic calculation, the rendering engine is used for representing presentation, a discrete event drive and a continuous rendering drive are fused to form a hybrid propulsion mechanism, a real time line and a simulation time line are maintained in parallel, a simulation step size is calculated through a time management mechanism, the simulation engine is driven by the step size to carry out discrete event propulsion, the rendering engine carries out continuous rendering update, and the time management mechanism dynamically adjusts the simulation step size based on frame interval calculation, state judgment and a time acceleration factor. According to the invention, through the cooperation of the double engines and the uniform step driving, the high-efficiency synchronization of logic calculation and visual expression is realized, the time synchronization error is reduced, the utilization rate of the CPU and the GPU is obviously improved, and the method is suitable for tactical countermeasure simulation and digital twin scenes.

title_en: Locating and correcting method for special-shaped part jig based on vision measurement
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of industrial vision measurement and discloses a positioning and correcting method for a special-shaped part jig based on vision measurement, which comprises the steps of establishing a jig coordinate system and a theoretical feature set of the special-shaped part, collecting a first image of the special-shaped part before clamping after the special-shaped part is put into the jig, and solving the initial pose of the special-shaped part before clamping; the method comprises the steps of collecting a second image of the special-shaped piece in a pre-clamping state, solving a pre-clamping pose, judging the state, collecting a third image of the special-shaped piece in a complete clamping state, solving to obtain a final effective pose, comparing to obtain a positioning correction quantity, generating a correction processing result, carrying out positioning compensation on a follow-up executing mechanism according to the positioning correction quantity and the correction processing result, and solving the final effective pose in a combined mode by combining a visible feature set after clamping, the pre-clamping pose, the micro-slippage quantity and the state judging result, so that the fluctuation of the positioning result caused by irregular local contours of the special-shaped piece, shielding of a clamping structure or reduction of effective features can be reduced.

title_en: Low-frequency RFID multi-antenna circuit and card reader
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a low-frequency RFID multi-antenna circuit and a card reader, which comprises a controller, a detection shaping circuit and one or more antenna modules, wherein one end of each antenna module is connected with an output pin of the controller; the other end of the antenna module is connected with an input pin of the controller through a detection shaping circuit. The utility model provides a low frequency RFID multiaerial circuit and card reader has reduced manufacturing cost, has promoted the card reading efficiency.

title_en: Externally-hung display screen with reinforced structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of external hanging display screen design, in particular to an external hanging display screen with a reinforced structure, which comprises a display screen shell, a filter screen plate and a back plate, wherein the display screen is fixedly connected inside the right side of the display screen shell, the upper end and the lower end of the display screen shell are both fixedly connected with a sliding plate, the upper side and the lower side of the left side of a heat radiating device are both fixedly connected with a U-shaped block, the right side of the U-shaped block is spirally connected with a screw, the right side of the U-shaped block is slidably connected with a supporting block, the left side of the supporting block is fixedly connected with a clamping block, the outer side of the clamping block is slidably connected with the back plate, in the utility model, the display screen shell is wrapped and protected by the arranged filter screen plate and the arranged baffle plate, and the heat radiating device and the back plate are effectively fixed by the arranged U-shaped block, the supporting, prevent that the display screen shell from falling down because of self overweight.

title_en: Fan fixed bolster push-and-pull device on four ways machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fan fixed bolster push-and-pull device on four ways machine, including outer frame, be equipped with installation components and parts in the outer frame, and outer frame both sides are equipped with the handle, outer frame rear end is equipped with the fixed plate, and is equipped with the mounting panel on the fixed plate, be equipped with radiator fan in the mounting panel, and the mounting panel both sides are equipped with the connection inserted bar, the mounting panel is flexible swing joint with the fixed plate through connecting the inserted bar in connecting slot. The outer frame rear end of the fan fixed bolster push-and-pull device on the four-way machine is equipped with the fixed plate, and the fixed plate upper end is equipped with the mounting panel, and be equipped with radiator fan in the mounting panel, and the mounting panel both sides are equipped with the connection inserted bar, and connection slot has been seted up to the fixed plate both sides moreover, and connection slot's shape and the shape phase-match of connecting the inserted bar, and the mounting panel is flexible swing joint through connecting the inserted bar in connection slot with the fixed plate, make the device can carry out the quick slide dismouting like this, it is more convenient to.

title_en: Electronic teaching display device convenient to adjust
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electronic teaching display device convenient to adjust belongs to electronic teaching technical field, and it includes display and casing, the equal fixedly connected with connecting plate of the left and right sides face of display, first spout has been seted up to the left surface of connecting plate, sliding connection has four first sliders, two in the first spout the same connecting rod of opposite face fixedly connected with of first slider, four the same cloth that hides of back fixedly connected with of connecting rod. This electron teaching display device convenient to adjust through setting up kelly, connecting rod, drape, slide bar, commentaries on classics handle, screw rod and screw cap for this device can be installed on the wall surface, not only can guarantee the installation stability of display, can also adjust the work of display position according to the demand, and this device can also shelter from the protection to the display in addition, reduces the display and receives the problem that external force leads to the screen damage, thereby can guarantee the work of display normal use.

title_en: Touch-control type bedside ultrasonic equipment
abstract_en: A touch-control bedside ultrasonic device comprises a supporting device, a floating device, a touch-control device and a control device. The touch device is provided with the touch screen, and a control panel is not required to be additionally arranged, so that the volume of the whole equipment is reduced. The floating device comprises a first floating arm and a second floating arm, wherein the first floating arm comprises at least two first connecting arms which are sequentially and rotatably connected end to end, the second floating arm comprises at least two second connecting arms which are sequentially and rotatably connected end to end, the first floating arm and the second floating arm are respectively provided with a first end and a second end which are oppositely arranged, and the first ends of the first floating arm and the second floating arm are respectively and rotatably connected onto a supporting device, so that the floating device can rotate relative to the supporting device. The first floating arm and the second floating arm are both connected with the floating device in a rotating mode, so that the touch device can rotate relative to the floating device. The flexible rotation range of the floating device of the equipment is large, the position of the touch device can be flexibly adjusted according to use occasions, and the requirement of doctors on more cross-bed operation is met.

title_en: Computer network security vulnerability scanning control device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of computers, and discloses a computer network security leak scanning control device, which comprises a protection box, wherein a telescopic pipe is fixedly arranged on the bottom wall of an inner cavity of the protection box, the top end of the telescopic pipe is fixedly connected with a bottom plate, the outer wall of the telescopic pipe is sleeved with a first spring, the upper end and the lower end of the first spring are respectively positioned at the bottom wall of the inner cavity of the protection box and the bottom end of the bottom plate, the top end of the bottom plate is movably connected with a device body, two groups of inserted bars are inserted at the left side and the right side of the protection box, the novel scheme can protect the device body by arranging the first spring, the telescopic pipe, the bottom plate, a second spring, the inserted bars, side plates and a clamping plate in a matching way, prevent the device body from being damaged when the protection box is collided, and can, the dust is prevented from entering the inner cavity of the protection box by the arrangement of the protection net.

title_en: Electronic device
abstract_en: The application provides an electronic device, and relates to the technical field of electronic devices. Wherein, electronic equipment includes: the device comprises a shell, a first input component, a second input component and a control unit, wherein the shell is provided with an accommodating space, and the surface of the shell is provided with at least one input component; the controller is arranged in the accommodating space; the detection piece is arranged in the accommodating space, is connected with the controller and can determine the state of the electronic equipment; wherein the controller is capable of disabling an input function of the input component when the electronic device is in a first predetermined state.

title_en: Commercial concrete quality monitoring system based on cloud platform
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a capital construction engineering technical field discloses a commercial concrete quality monitoring system based on cloud platform, including video acquisition device, data coding device, data transmission device, cloud platform, access control monitoring system, civil engineering detecting system and user terminal, video acquisition device and cloud platform communication link together, data coding device respectively with data acquisition device and data transmission device electric connection together, data transmission device and cloud platform communication link together, cloud platform is used for handling, sending and storing each item data, access control monitoring system, civil engineering detecting system and user terminal respectively with cloud platform communication link together; the utility model has the characteristics of data sampling is timely, supervise effectually.

title_en: Finger vein keyboard
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a biological feature recognition technology field, in particular to finger vein keyboard, include: the voice module, the LED module, the single chip microcomputer module, the finger vein module, the keyboard and the keyboard control circuit are arranged in the keyboard, the voice module, the LED module, the finger vein module and the keyboard control circuit are respectively connected with the single chip microcomputer module, and the finger vein module and the keyboard control circuit are further connected with a USB interface. The finger vein keyboard combines the finger vein module with the keyboard, and the keyboard and the computer can be operated only by finger vein authentication before a user operates the keyboard and logs in the computer. The method is suitable for the use of the high-safety intelligent terminal.

title_en: Radiator with good heat radiation performance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a radiator with good heat dissipation performance, which comprises a heat dissipation fan, a plurality of heat dissipation fins, a plurality of heat pipes and a bottom plate; the plurality of radiating fins are arranged in a stacking manner at even intervals from top to bottom to form a radiating fin module; one ends of the plurality of heat pipes penetrate upwards from the bottom of the radiating fin module to the top of the radiating fin module, and the other ends of the plurality of heat pipes are connected to the bottom plate; the radiating fan is connected to one side of the radiating fin module; the front side and the rear side of the radiating fin module are both provided with air grooves which are inwards concave from the outer side of the radiating fin module; a plurality of convex strips are arranged at the upper end of the bottom plate in an upward protruding manner, and a heat dissipation groove is formed between every two adjacent convex strips; an auxiliary positioning frame is arranged between the radiating fan and the radiating fin module; therefore, the wind energy of the cooling fan can be better gathered at the middle part of the cooling fin module, the phenomenon of sound explosion can be avoided, the overall cooling performance of the radiator is better, and the stability of the connection of the cooling fan and the cooling fin module is improved.

title_en: Passive label positioning device and system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a passive label positioner and system, this positioner includes: a passive tag; an array antenna, the array antenna comprising: the first direction antenna array is used for acquiring the incident angle of the passive tag in the first direction; and the second direction antenna array is used for acquiring the incident angle of the passive tag in the second direction. The utility model can complete the positioning of the passive tag in the coverage field only by using one positioning array antenna without placing a plurality of readers and reference tags; even if the vehicle attached with the passive tag is in a high-speed driving state, the positioning device can still accurately acquire tag information and calculate the position information of the tag information, and meanwhile, the driving track of the vehicle can be obtained.

title_en: Information acquisition device for tobacco
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an information acquisition device for tobacco, belonging to the technical field of tobacco anti-counterfeiting identification, which is used for the information acquisition device for tobacco to acquire a main body; the detector is arranged on the collecting main body, and the supporting mechanism is used for placing the cigarette carton and is arranged opposite to the detector; the detector is used for detecting whether a cigarette carton is placed on the supporting mechanism, detecting an anti-counterfeiting code of the cigarette carton, reading data information of the cigarette carton and transmitting the data information to the background server; wherein, supporting mechanism is adjustable mechanism for adjust the angular position of strip cigarette. The utility model discloses technical scheme has solved the problem of present strip cigarette true and false discernment difficulty, has promoted the convenience of selling the merchant to the strip cigarette discernment.

title_en: Simple data acquisition unit for dynamic loop monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotating ring monitored control system uses simple and easy data collection station, which comprises an outer shell, the left part of the preceding side surface of shell is provided with the RS485 interface, the rectangle mounting groove has all been seted up in the left and right sides of shell, the fan mounting groove has been seted up at the middle part of rectangle mounting groove, the internally mounted of fan mounting groove has radiator fan, the inside of shell is equipped with the component installation cavity, the intake has been seted up to the inner wall equidistant of fan mounting groove, the radiating groove has been seted up to the upside surface equidistant of shell, the louvre has been seted up to the bottom wall equidistant of radiating groove. The utility model discloses a fan mounting groove has been seted up in the both sides of shell, and radiator fan installs in fan mounting groove for the cool wind gets into the component installation intracavity from the both sides of shell, and the radiating effect is good, and radiator fan is located outside the component installation chamber, is convenient for maintain or change radiator fan, has further improved the radiating effect.

title_en: Automatic testing arrangement of cell-phone software
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic testing arrangement of cell-phone software relates to electronic engineering technical field, including data line, detection case and display panel, still including the bearing structure who is used for supporting and buffer adjustment, be used for stabilizing the stable structure of data electric wire and data head and the insulation system who prevents the electric shock, the upper end of the positive one side of detection case is provided with display panel, and the lower extreme of the positive one side of detection case is provided with aviation terminal interface, one side that display panel was openly kept away from to the detection case is provided with the suggestion panel, and the front of suggestion panel evenly is provided with the fault lamp, one side that aviation terminal interface was openly kept away from to the detection case is provided with operating panel, the lower extreme of detection case one side is connected with the data line. The utility model discloses a set up and form firm triangle-shaped between fixed plate and horizontal pole, the backup pad, when the detection case produced a large amount of effort because external strength simultaneously, and the buffer board can play absorbing effect, has solved the problem of inconvenient support.

title_en: Combined socket and keyboard comprising same
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a relate to the keyboard field, especially relate to a be applied to combination formula socket of mechanical keyboard button. The combination type socket includes: a socket body; the plurality of key plugging blocks are respectively arranged on one side of the socket body and correspond to the plurality of plugging pins of the key switch one by one; and the plurality of LED lamp plugging blocks are respectively arranged on the other side of the socket body, and the plurality of LED lamp plugging blocks correspond to the plurality of electric connection lamp pins of the LED lamp one to one. The utility model discloses a plug the piece with the button and plug the piece with the led lamp and fix respectively in socket ontology's both sides, can integrated into one piece, just so can not practice thrift the cost, the installation of being convenient for moreover.

title_en: Touch control type clamping support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a touch control type clamping bracket, which comprises a shell and clamping arms respectively extending out of the left side and the right side of the shell, wherein the clamping arm at least one side is driven by a motor to be selectively opened and closed relative to the shell; the touch control circuit also comprises a main control circuit, and a key detection circuit, a touch detection circuit and a motor drive circuit which are respectively connected with the main control circuit; the shell is provided with a key and a touch panel, and the touch detection circuit comprises a touch detection chip; when the mobile phone is put in, the touch panel is touched, and the main control circuit controls the motor to work according to the output of the output level port OUT so that the clamping arms on the two sides are clamped inwards; when the mobile phone is taken, the key is pressed, the key detection circuit sends a signal to the master control circuit, and the master control circuit triggers the generator to work so that the clamping arms on the two sides are opened outwards. So, solved traditional support and needed both hands operation and complex operation's problem, especially, adopt touch control to press from both sides tightly, press control to open, avoid the maloperation, the operation when getting and putting the cell-phone also shows more humanized.

title_en: Neonate electronic monitoring label
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a neonate's electronic monitoring label, include: the electronic integrated circuit comprises an electronic integrated block and a bracelet, wherein the bracelet is provided with a front surface, two ends of the front surface are provided with extension rings, and the extension rings are arc-shaped and extend downwards; the locking block is connected with the lower ends of the two extension rings in an adsorption manner and integrally connected, and the bracelet and the locking block are integrally surrounded; the front face of the bracelet is provided with a placing opening for accommodating an electronic integrated block, and the electronic integrated block is detachably arranged in the placing opening; the electronic integrated block is used for detecting the body data of the neonate, the bracelet is used for wrapping the electronic integrated block, the electronic integrated block can be replaced, different detection monitoring purposes can be conveniently realized, and the electronic integrated block is convenient to detach, so that the electronic integrated block is convenient to clean and disinfect integrally and is beneficial to recycling.

title_en: Campus restaurant management device based on big data technology
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a campus dining room management device based on big data technology, including organism, touch screen and louvre, organism top one side is provided with the mount, be provided with the purple light fluorescent tube in the mount, the organism top is provided with the touch screen, touch screen one side is provided with switch, the touch screen opposite side is provided with the reaming hole. Has the advantages that: the utility model discloses a set up mount and purple light fluorescent tube, can make the purple light fluorescent tube pass through the mount and install at the organism top, in the device period of not using, shine the disinfection to the touch screen through the purple light fluorescent tube, guarantee the health nature of device, through setting up connecting plate and fixed suction cup, can make fixed suction cup pass through the connecting plate and fix the back at the organism, make the organism adsorb the wall body department of fixing on the station through fixed suction cup, avoid the device to receive external force collision and take place to empty, prevent to have the potential safety hazard, guarantee the life of device.

title_en: External heat abstractor is used to server
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an external heat dissipation device for a server, which comprises an arc support, wherein a heat dissipation mechanism is arranged on the arc support, a first through arc-shaped groove is arranged on the arc support, a second through arc-shaped groove is arranged on the inner side wall of the first arc-shaped groove, a gear belt is fixedly arranged on the inner side wall of the first arc-shaped groove, and an arc-shaped spring is fixedly arranged on the inner side wall of the first arc-shaped groove. The heat dissipation effect is good for the server heat dissipation.

title_en: Computer scanner connecting wire clamping device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a connecting wire clamping device of a computer scanner, relates to the technical field of computer scanning equipment, and aims to solve the problems that an effective clamping structure is lacked in the installation and connection process of the existing connecting wire clamping device, the detection is not in place, and a cable is easy to damage. The improved cable fixing structure is characterized in that a flat wire pressing magnetic plate is installed above the fixing structure, a circular wire pressing magnetic plate is arranged on one side of the flat wire pressing magnetic plate, a placing groove is installed below the circular wire pressing magnetic plate, a magnetic suction block is arranged below the flat wire pressing magnetic plate, a movable rotary column is installed in the middle of the fixing structure, a current and voltage display is arranged in the middle of the movable rotary column, a cable access end is installed on one side of the current and voltage display, a movable shaft is arranged at one end of the circular wire pressing magnetic plate, an insulating layer is installed on the inner wall of the movable rotary column, an access slot is formed in the rear end of the movable rotary column, and a damping sheath is installed on one side of the access slot.

title_en: Handwriting board module with local erasing function and handwriting board
abstract_en: The application provides a handwriting pad module with local erase function includes: the device comprises a touch control assembly, a writing assembly and a main control assembly; the writing component comprises a first driving layer, a liquid crystal layer and a second driving layer which are sequentially overlapped, wherein one of the first driving layer and the second driving layer is provided with at least two independent driving areas, and the other driving layer is provided with a driving area at least partially opposite to the independent driving areas; the touch control assembly is arranged on one side of the first driving layer far away from the liquid crystal layer; the main control assembly is electrically connected with the touch assembly, the first driving layer and the second driving layer and used for acquiring the coordinates of the activated position of the touch assembly and then controlling potential difference between the part of the independent driving area corresponding to the coordinates and the part of the driving area corresponding to the coordinates according to the coordinates. The main control assembly is used for acquiring coordinates corresponding to the content to be erased on the touch assembly, so that the corresponding content can be only cleared, the local erasing of the handwriting board module is realized, and the user requirements are greatly met.

title_en: Off-line voice panel
