abstract_en: The utility model relates to an off-line voice panel, wherein a middle frame is fixedly arranged between a base and a control panel, a voice control component is arranged in the middle of the middle frame, clamping grooves and separating strips are arranged between two side ends and upper and lower sections of the voice control component, a voice control protective net is sleeved with the voice control component through the clamping grooves and the separating strips, the separating strips divide a control panel installation area into an upper control panel installation area and a lower control panel installation area, the upper control panel installation area and the lower control panel installation area are respectively provided with a control panel, key switches with different functions are respectively arranged in the control panel, the key switches are matched with cross buttons arranged on the bottom surface of a longitudinal connecting rib, the control functions are switched, and a switch panel is sleeved on the control panel. The structure of the voice panel structure reduces the production cost while ensuring the stable structural connection of the off-line voice panel, and has simple installation process and convenient disassembly and maintenance.

title_en: Intelligent household appliance voice controller
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent household appliance voice controller, which comprises: a speech processor; the power supply management module is electrically connected with the voice processor; the level matching circuit is electrically connected with the voice processor and electrically connected with an upper computer; the interface filtering circuit is electrically connected with the voice processor, the interface filtering circuit is electrically connected with the electrostatic impeder, and the electrostatic impeder is electrically connected with the output interface; the output filter circuit is electrically connected with the voice processor, the output filter circuit is electrically connected with the power amplification unit, the power amplification unit is electrically connected with the loudspeaker, and the loudspeaker is externally or internally arranged; a microphone electrically connected with the speech processor, and other circuits and modules; the household appliance is stably and reliably controlled through voice interaction, and the size of the equipment body is small.

title_en: Communication device for display instrument of electric moped
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a display instrument assembly of an electric moped, in particular to a communication device for the display instrument of the electric moped. It is characterized by comprising a CAN communication chip. And a data sending pin of the CAN communication chip is connected with a singlechip of the display instrument of the electric moped through the first resistor. And a high-level CAN bus pin of the CAN communication chip is sequentially connected with the second resistor and the first capacitor in series and then grounded. And a low-level CAN bus pin of the CAN communication chip is connected with the non-grounding end of the first capacitor through a third resistor. And an interface voltage pin of the CAN communication chip is used for being connected with a power supply after passing through the fifth resistor. And an interface voltage pin of the CAN communication chip is grounded through a fifth resistor. And a data receiving pin of the CAN communication chip is connected with a singlechip of the display instrument of the electric moped through a sixth resistor. The communication device has stable transmission signals and is not easy to be interfered by the outside.

title_en: Paper contract automatic identification categorised device based on OCR
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a paper contract automatic identification sorter based on OCR's device belongs to paper contract identification sorter technical field, this paper contract automatic identification sorter based on OCR, include: pack up the box, pack up the interior bottom surface of box and install four telescopic links, fixedly connected with adjustable shelf between the top of four telescopic links, the recognizer body is installed to the top surface of adjustable shelf, and two sliding trays have been seted up to the top surface of adjustable shelf. This paper contract automatic identification sorter based on OCR shoots the file through the recognizer body, discernment and processing, electronic clamping jaw drives the file and removes, classify to the file, later take off the file after classifying by the staff, discernment categorised speed is faster, the effect is also better, it is rotatory to drive the lifting threaded rod through the pivot, can remove the comfortable position of user with the adjustable shelf, adapt to the user of different height states, also can adapt to the not position of placing of co-altitude.

title_en: Integrated plug circuit and integrated plug
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrated plug circuit and an integrated plug, a first port circuit, a second port circuit and a third port circuit; wherein the first port circuit, the second port circuit and the third port circuit are communicated with each other; when corresponding connectors are connected into at least two of the first port circuit, the second port circuit and the third port circuit, charging or discharging or data transmission is carried out between the corresponding connectors. The utility model discloses a first port circuit, second port circuit and third port circuit interconnect can realize that the plug provides a plurality of operation directions that link to each other with the Micro-USB port, derive many kinds of thing networking application products when for example cell-phone leather sheath embedding temperature sensor, humidity transducer, speedtransmitter, infrared sensor, fingerprint sensor, can realize the expansibility usage, along with the application of thing networking smart home, 5G network technology, improve cell-phone leather sheath applicability.

title_en: Image recognition device based on drill rod and oil pipe joint of drilling machine
abstract_en: The utility model provides an image recognition device based on rig drilling rod and oil pipe junction relates to rig automation equipment technical field, including handling terminal, display device and a plurality of industry camera towards the setting of drilling rod and oil pipe junction, a plurality of industry cameras encircle drilling rod and oil pipe's junction setting, display device and a plurality of industry cameras all with handle terminal signal connection. The industrial cameras are used for converting the connection condition of the connection position of the drill pipe and the oil pipe of the drilling machine into three-dimensional image information, and the industrial cameras are arranged around the connection position of the drill pipe and the oil pipe so as to integrate the three-dimensional image data in all directions and combine the three-dimensional image data into a complete three-dimensional image of the connection position of the drill pipe and the oil pipe. The three-dimensional image information is transmitted to the processing terminal for data processing, and the three-dimensional image or the processing result is displayed through the display device, so that the equipment operator can carry out remote monitoring, and can be far away from a high-risk area around a wellhead, and the safety of the equipment operator is ensured.

title_en: Elastic touch key cap keyboard
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a keyboard technical field especially relates to elasticity sense of touch key cap keyboard. The technical scheme comprises the following steps: the keyboard body, sealed shell and key cap body, the top swing joint of keyboard body has the key cap body, and the surface bonding at key cap body top has transparent rubber pad, key cap body outlying keyboard body top bonds and has the rubber piece, the bottom of keyboard body bonds and has the rubber sleeve, the thread groove has been seted up to the both sides of keyboard body bottom, and the inside swing joint of thread groove has the thread piece, the fixed surface of keyboard body both sides is connected with the cassette, and the inside movable mounting of cassette has the fixture block, fixed mounting has sealed shell between the peripheral fixture block of rubber piece, and sealed shell and the peripheral surface bonding of cassette have the silica gel cover. The utility model discloses a combination of various structures makes this device have good sense of touch and comfort performance in the use, has the protection of good and prevents making things convenient for the user of service to clean the maintenance work at any time when falling the effect.

title_en: Wall-mounted display
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wall built-up display, which comprises a display, one side of display is provided with the fixed disk, one side of fixed disk is provided with angle adjusting device, angle adjusting device keeps away from one side of fixed disk is provided with the hexagonal mounting box, the mounting groove has been seted up at one side middle part of hexagonal mounting box, the inside middle part of mounting groove is provided with rotation adjusting device. Has the advantages that: through fixing the locating plate on the surface of wall body, and then insert the upper end of locating plate with the picklock, thereby reach the effect with the display wall built-up, the inclination of being convenient for adjust the display through angle adjusting device's setting, thereby effectual improvement display's sight shadow impression, and can carry out transverse angle's regulation to it when using the display through rotation adjusting device's setting, thereby be convenient for make the display remain the horizontal angle throughout, thereby be favorable to the installation of device to use.

title_en: Heat sink for computer
abstract_en: The utility model provides a heat abstractor for computer, including quick-witted case, water-cooling bucket, pivot spare and bung, the sealed setting of machine case, a plurality of water storage chambeies are split into to the inside of water-cooling bucket, and each water storage intracavity is filled with water, locates the pivot spare of water-cooling barrel head portion, is equipped with first air duct on the pivot spare, and first air duct switches on with arbitrary water storage chamber, and the pivot of bung relatively of water-cooling bucket is equipped with the second air duct on the bung, and first air duct switch on with same water storage chamber. A heat abstractor for computer, through setting up first air duct, second air duct and water-cooling bucket for the hot-air that takes out from quick-witted incasement returns quick-witted case again after the water-cooling in the water-cooling bucket, thereby dispel the heat to computer machine case, because quick-witted case is airtight quick-witted case again, make the air only can circulate in quick-witted case and first air duct, second air duct, prevent that the dust from causing the harm to the electronic component of quick-witted incasement.

title_en: Mouse with adjustable mouse line
abstract_en: The application provides a mouse with an adjustable mouse line, which comprises a mouse body and the adjustable mouse line, wherein the front end of the mouse body is provided with a first USB female end, and the adjustable mouse line comprises a contraction box, a connecting wire, a first joint part and a second joint part; first joint portion is connected with connecting wire one end, the second joint portion is connected with the connecting wire other end, the collapsible setting of connecting wire is in the shrink box, first joint portion is first USB head end, the second joint portion includes the second USB head end, but first USB head end or second USB head end and the first USB female end plug of mouse body are connected, still include wireless transmitter, the inside of mouse body is provided with wireless receiver, the mouse body passes through wireless receiver and wireless transmitter signal connection. The method and the device realize wired connection and wireless connection of the mouse.

title_en: Service software device component
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a service software equipment component, which belongs to the technical field of computers, and particularly relates to a service software equipment component, comprising a bottom plate, wherein a guide rail is arranged on the bottom plate, two sliding mechanisms are arranged on the guide rail, a first half shell and a second half shell are respectively and fixedly connected with the two sliding mechanisms, the two sliding mechanisms can realize the closing of the first half shell and the second half shell when the guide rail moves oppositely, and the two sliding mechanisms can realize the separation of the first half shell and the second half shell when the guide rail moves away from the guide rail, and the utility model has the beneficial effects that: the two half shells are arranged to form the shell, and the two half shells can slide on the guide rail, so that the opening and closing of the shell are realized, the disassembly of the shell is greatly facilitated, and the overhaul of an inner assembly inside is facilitated; the two half shells are both in sliding connection on the guide rail, and the first sliding block is in sliding connection with the guide rail, so that the contact area between the first sliding block and the guide rail is large, and the sliding stability of the half shells can be effectively maintained.

title_en: Outdoor industrial tablet personal computer with adjustable use angle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an outdoor industrial tablet personal computer with an adjustable use angle, and relates to the technical field of industrial tablet personal computers. The utility model comprises the following steps: a tablet computer body; a movement adjusting device; the movable adjusting device comprises a fixed frame, a rotating assembly connected to the rear end face of the fixed frame, a supporting rod connected to the rear surface of the rotating assembly, a fixed ring connected to the tail end of the supporting rod, and a telescopic rod connected to the inner position of the fixed ring; a kind of electronic device with high-pressure air-conditioning system; a protective device. The movable adjusting device and the protecting device are arranged, so that the problems that when the existing outdoor industrial tablet personal computer is used, the angle adjustment or the height adjustment can be generally carried out, the adjusting effect is single, the requirements of users cannot be met, the limitation is great, the industrial tablet personal computer is improved in safety, the protection is still needed, and when the existing outdoor industrial tablet personal computer is used, the data on the tablet personal computer can be changed due to false touch, and the adverse problem is caused are solved.

title_en: Server convenient for maintenance for software development
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a server convenient to overhaul and used for software development, which comprises a server shell and a shell cover, wherein an opening communicated with the inside of the server shell is arranged at the position, close to the top, of the front surface of the server shell, the shell cover is inserted into the opening in a sliding manner, connecting plates are fixedly connected to the left side and the right side of the shell cover, connecting grooves corresponding to the connecting plates are formed in the inner two sides of the opening, one end, far away from the shell cover, of the connecting plates is extended into the connecting grooves in a sliding manner, a sliding groove is formed in the connecting plates, a sliding block is connected onto the inner wall of the sliding groove in a sliding manner, an elastic supporting mechanism is arranged between the sliding block and the sliding groove, and a clamping rod is fixedly connected to one side, far away from the shell cover, of the sliding block. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the mechanisms such as the pull rope, the sliding block, the clamping rod and the like, the shell cover is rapidly separated from the server shell, so that a user can conveniently maintain and overhaul the inside of the server shell, and the practicability and convenience are improved.

title_en: Intelligent medicine storage box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent medicine storage box which comprises a box body, wherein a box door is arranged on the front side of the box body, a hinge is connected between one side of the box door and the box body, a touch screen is arranged on one side of the box body, a processor is connected to the inner side of the touch screen, a scanning module is arranged on one side, close to the touch screen, of the inner side of the box body, a camera is arranged at the top of an inner cavity of the box body, and an electromagnetic lock is arranged in the middle of one side, far away from the hinge, of the box door. The utility model can realize the medicine information inquiry function of the medicine storage box by arranging the scanning module and the inquiry window, thereby being convenient for medical staff or interns with insufficient clinical experience to accurately grasp the information of the stored medicines in the box and the use description of each medicine; through setting up fixed block and inserted block, can reach under the condition that the chamber door is opened and scanning module does not enter the medicine all the time, remind medical personnel to access the medicine and scan and enter, the chamber door is locked temporarily and can not be closed, ensures the accurate route of medicine access and types.

title_en: DDR test device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a DDR (double data rate) testing device, which relates to the technical field of DDR testing devices and comprises a bottom disc, wherein the top of the bottom disc is fixedly connected with a supporting bottom rod, and the middle part of the supporting bottom rod is movably connected with a supporting top rod.

title_en: Spectrum analysis system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a spectrum analysis system, which comprises a plurality of Led arrays with different wavelengths, a sample cell for loading a sample, an aspheric lens for irradiating the sample after collimating light emitted by the Led in the transverse direction and the longitudinal direction, and a photoelectric detector for receiving light from the sample, wherein the LED arrays are arranged on the sample cell; the Led array and/or the sample cell are provided with a motion mechanism for realizing the relative motion between the Led array and the sample cell; the control unit is electrically connected with the photoelectric detector, the movement mechanism is controlled by the control unit, the Led is controlled by the control unit, the control unit is solidified with a data processing module, and the data processing module is used for spectrum analysis. The utility model adopts LED array scanning to realize the collection of the spectrum signals, thereby realizing the spectrum detection of the substance components and the concentration; low cost, convenient operation and suitability for popularization and application in consumer markets.

title_en: Cutting-off counting device of line number printer
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of accessories of electric connector production equipment, in particular to a cutting-off counting device of a line number printer. The utility model provides a cutting-off counting device of a line number printer, which solves the technical problem that the line number printer in the prior art cannot count the printing quantity. The cutting-off counting device of the line number printer comprises a frame, wherein the frame is provided with a cutting-off knife, the frame is also provided with a supporting seat, and the cutting-off knife is positioned above the supporting seat; the counter can be used for manufacturing a cost or blank every time when a numerical value is counted, and the line-size printer can accurately know the finished yield and the unfinished yield at any time in the working process, so that the yield can be accurately preset, and the consumable is saved.

title_en: Information inquiry unit that digital archives was convenient for install
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an information inquiry device convenient for installation in a digital archive, which comprises an installation base plate and a U-shaped installation plate, wherein the installation base plate is connected with the U-shaped installation plate through two connecting vertical plates, an adjusting rotating shaft is connected between the inner walls of the U-shaped installation plate in a penetrating way, and two connecting lantern rings are fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the adjusting rotating shaft. According to the utility model, the mounting partition plate is positioned with the ground through the mounting bolts, so that the mounting substrate can be fixed and limited, when the query touch plate is required to be used, if the brightness of light rays which directly irradiate to the top end of the query touch plate is higher, the fastening nut can be taken down, then the positioning column is pulled through the adjusting pull handle, and then the adjusting rotating shaft is rotated, so that the query touch plate is enabled to vertically cross the U-shaped mounting plate after ninety degrees of rotation, then the positioning column is pushed to be connected with the penetrating through groove in a penetrating way through the adjusting pull handle, and then the fastening nut is reset, so that the direct irradiation of light rays to the query touch plate can be avoided, and the use of the query touch plate is facilitated.

title_en: Cabinet U-position asset management device
abstract_en: The utility model is applicable to the field of asset management, and provides a U-position asset management device of a cabinet, which comprises: the U-position controller is arranged at the top of the cabinet; the U-position asset bar is arranged on the cabinet and connected with the U-position controller through a circuit; the U-shaped asset strip comprises a U-shaped asset strip, wherein a first connecting end and a second connecting end are arranged on the U-shaped asset strip, the first connecting end and the second connecting end are connected through a connecting line, the second connecting end is magnetically attracted to the U-shaped asset strip, and the first connecting end is fixed to a server. According to the utility model, the mode of synchronously controlling a plurality of groups of U-bit asset bars by the U-bit controller is adopted, so that the hardware structure is reduced, the manufacturing cost is reduced, the control purpose is realized with lower power consumption, the production efficiency is improved, and the difficulty of later-stage software upgrading and maintenance is avoided.

title_en: Intelligent digital image anti-fake identification device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of intelligent digital image anti-counterfeiting identification devices, and discloses an intelligent digital image anti-counterfeiting identification device which comprises a detection table, wherein a supporting block is arranged on one side of the upper end face of the detection table, a first sliding groove is arranged on one side of the supporting block, a threaded rod is connected with the first sliding groove in a rotating mode, a first sliding block is connected with the first sliding groove in a sliding mode, a supporting seat is arranged on one side of the first sliding groove, a second sliding groove is arranged on the upper end face of the supporting seat, a two-way threaded screw rod is connected with the second sliding groove in a rotating mode, a second sliding block is connected with the second sliding groove in a sliding mode, clamping blocks are arranged on the upper end faces of the second sliding groove, and a detector is clamped between the second sliding blocks. The device has novel overall design and simple structure, can enable the detector to adapt to the detection of the anti-counterfeiting codes of various sizes of articles, improves the detection efficiency, can conveniently and rapidly take down the detector, and improves the practicability of the intelligent digital image anti-counterfeiting identification device.

title_en: Paper cup counting equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to paper cup counting equipment, the lower part of the upper part of a counting assembly base is connected with the lower part of the counting assembly base through a rotating shaft, the upper part of the counting assembly base is turned forward for ninety degrees by taking the rotating shaft of the upper part of the lower part of the counting assembly base as a circle center, bending control air bags are arranged in the upper part of the counting assembly base and the lower part of the counting assembly base, a circular groove is arranged on the upper side of the lower part of the counting assembly base, a push rod is pushed by a spring, upright posts are fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the upper part of the counting assembly base at equal intervals, a hoop is fixedly arranged at the top end of each upright post, and two or three upright rails are arranged between the hoop and the upper part of the counting assembly base.

title_en: Reinforced portable operating platform with foldable operating lever
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a reinforced portable operating platform with a foldable operating rod, which is characterized by comprising a main box body, a display assembly, a keyboard assembly and an operating rod assembly, wherein the display assembly is arranged on the main box body, the keyboard assembly is arranged on the main box body, an installation cavity is arranged on the main box body and positioned on one side of the keyboard assembly, and the operating rod assembly is rotatably arranged in the installation cavity.

title_en: Server and server system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a server and a server system, wherein the server comprises a processor node, an optical module, a re-timer and a control module, a first interconnection signal transmission end of the processor node is connected with a second interconnection signal transmission end of the re-timer, a third interconnection signal transmission end of the re-timer is connected with a fourth interconnection signal transmission end of the optical module, a fifth interconnection signal transmission end of the optical module is connected with a switching module, an in-place signal output end of the optical module is connected with an in-place signal detection end of the control module, and a reset signal output end of the control module is connected with a reset signal input end of the re-timer. By adopting the utility model, the on-site detection of the optical module can be realized, so that the server can obtain the plugging condition of the optical module in time.

title_en: Touch screen with assemble structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of touch screens and discloses a touch screen with an assembled structure, which comprises a display screen group, wherein a mounting frame is arranged outside the display screen group, three screws are fixedly connected to two sides of the rear part of the mounting frame, a rear shell is connected to the outer part of each screw in a clamping manner, a heat dissipation box is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the rear shell, a heat dissipation fan is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the heat dissipation box, a connecting sleeve is connected to the outer threads of each screw, a bolt is connected to one side of the inner part of the connecting sleeve in a threaded manner, a spring is sleeved outside the bolt, and the bolts are connected to the inner part of the rear shell in a threaded manner. According to the utility model, the convenient disassembly of the rear shell of the device is realized, so that the cooling fan or the electric element is maintained, the convenience and the efficiency of maintenance are improved, the display screen group is stably installed and the components are tightly connected, the safety and the stability of the display screen group are ensured, and the whole structure of the device is firmer.

title_en: Computer charger interface device with anti-corrosion structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of computers, in particular to a computer charger interface device with an anti-corrosion structure. The utility model provides a computer charger interface device with an anti-corrosion structure, which comprises a charger, a patch cord, a plug connector, a power cord and a power head, wherein the patch cord is connected to the front side of the charger, the plug connector is connected to the front end of the patch cord, the power cord is plugged to the rear side of the charger, the power head is connected to the rear end of the power cord, the computer charger interface device also comprises a protective shell, a sliding shell and the like, the protective shell is connected to the patch cord, and the sliding shell is connected to the protective shell in a sliding manner. Through protecting crust, slip shell, connecting block, rolling plate, torsional spring, first magnet and the setting of second magnet, protecting crust and slip shell can wrap up the protection with the bayonet joint, prevent that it from exposing outside, and the rolling plate can seal the slip shell front side, further strengthens sealed effect, effectively prevents dust, impurity and moisture entering bayonet joint, avoids the bayonet joint to be corroded, ensures its long-term stable use.

title_en: Systems and methods for using probabilities of lithologies in an inversion
abstract_en: Systems and methods for training a model that uses probabilities of lithologies as prior information in an inversion are disclosed. Exemplary implementations may: obtain training data, the training data including (i) subsurface map data sets, and (ii) known lithologies; obtain an initial seismic mapping model; generate a conditioned seismic mapping model by training the initial seismic mapping model; store the conditioned seismic mapping model; obtain a target subsurface map data set; apply the conditioned seismic mapping model to generate a classified lithology map data set; apply an inversion to the classified lithology map data set to generate volumes of lithologies; generate an image that represents the volumes of lithologies; display the image.

title_en: Circuitry for use in smart cards and other applications
abstract_en: A smart card comprising rectification circuitry arranged to receive an alternating electrical signal from a near field RF communications antenna of the smart card, and convert it into DC electrical energy for powering an auxiliary circuit. The rectification circuitry comprises a first inductor arranged so that the alternating electrical signal flows through the first inductor and a second inductor arranged for inductive coupling with the first inductor to provide the alternating electrical signal to a near field RF communicator.

title_en: Model-free physics-based reconstruction of images acquired in scattering media
abstract_en: A method comprising receiving a digital image acquired in a scattering medium, wherein the digital image comprises at least one color channel; for each of the at least one color channel: (a) calculating multiple sets of contrast stretch limits for the color channel, (b) calculating different contrast-stretched versions of the color channel, based on the multiple sets of stretch limits, (c) fusing the different contrast-stretched versions to produce an enhanced color channel; and reconstructing an enhanced digital image based on the at least one enhanced color channel.

title_en: Tactile vibration generator
abstract_en: Provided is a tactile vibration generator comprising: a supporting block, a vibration plate, and a vibration actuator, wherein the vibration plate comprises a first part, which is not in contact with the supporting block, and a second part, which is fixed to the supporting block, and wherein the vibration actuator is attached to a surface of the first part.

title_en: A cross reality system
abstract_en: A cross reality system that provides an immersive user experience by storing persistent spatial information about the physical world that one or multiple user devices can access to determine position within the physical world and that applications can access to specify the position of virtual objects within the physical world. Persistent spatial information enables users to have a shared virtual, as well as physical, experience when interacting with the cross reality system. Further, persistent spatial information may be used in maps of the physical world, enabling one or multiple devices to access and localize into previously stored maps, reducing the need to map a physical space before using the cross reality system in it. Persistent spatial information may be stored as persistent coordinate frames, which may include a transformation relative to a reference orientation and information derived from images in a location corresponding to the persistent coordinate frame.

title_en: Method and apparatus of training depth estimation network, and method and apparatus of estimating depth of image
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method of training a depth estimation network, which relates to fields of computer vision, deep learning, and image processing technology. The method includes: performing a depth estimation on an original image by using a depth estimation network, so as to obtain a depth image for the original image; removing a moving object from the original image so as to obtain a preprocessed image for the original image; estimating a pose based on the original image and modifying the pose based on the preprocessed image; and adjusting parameters of the depth estimation network according to the original image, the depth image and the pose modified. The present disclosure further provides an apparatus of training a depth estimation network, a method and apparatus of estimating a depth of an image, an electronic device, and a storage medium.

title_en: Method, device, camera and software for performing electronic image stabilization of a high dynamic range image
abstract_en: The present invention relates generally to an algorithm for electronic image stabilization, EIS for a high dynamic range, HDR, image captured by a rolling shutter image sensor and more specifically to an algorithm configured to perform EIS on the HDR image, by, for each specific block of pixels among the blocks of pixels in the HDR image, the specific block of pixels spatially corresponding to a pixel region of the rolling shutter image sensor, determining whether the specific block of pixels is copied from pixel data of the first image or the second image, or is a blend of pixel data from both the first image and the second image, and use motion data measured when capturing the first and second images for performing EIS based on the origin of the specific block of pixels.

title_en: Data correctness optimization
abstract_en: The present invention relates to providing a ground truth dataset and optimizing data correctness using the ground truth dataset. A plurality of datasets is received from different data sources (610A, 610B, 610C). The datasets comprise a plurality of data elements. Each data element includes an identifier and at least one attribute value associated with the identifier. Data correctness values are determined for the attribute values. A data correctness value is associated with a probability that an attribute value is correct. A data element with a single data correctness value is added to the ground truth dataset for each attribute value for each identifier with which a respective attribute value is associated based on the determined data correctness values for the attribute values such that the data correctness values in the ground truth dataset define probability distributions of data correctness for the attribute values. A new dataset can be received from a data source (610A, 610B, 610C) with the new dataset comprising a plurality of data elements and each data element including an identifier and at least one attribute value associated with the identifier. Data correctness values for the attribute values of the data elements of the new dataset can be determined based on the data correctness values for the attribute values of the data elements with known identifiers of the ground truth dataset. A known identifier is an identifier which is included in the ground truth dataset and in the new dataset.

title_en: Determining print quality based on information obtained from rendered image
abstract_en: An example image forming apparatus includes an image forming apparatus, a processor, and a memory storing instructions executable by the processor. The processor of the image forming apparatus executes the instructions to render a print job, obtain information regarding a pattern for determining print quality from a rendered image of the print job, scan, through the image forming job unit, a document on which the rendered image is printed, and determine the print quality based on a scanned image of the document and the obtained information regarding the pattern.

title_en: Image processing method in remote control, device, apparatus and program product
abstract_en: An image processing method in remote control, a device, an apparatus and a program product are provided and related to the field of automatic driving technologies. The specific implementation solution is: receiving image information sent by a vehicle, wherein the image information includes multiple-channel image data collected by the vehicle; performing a stitching process on the multiple-channel image data, to obtain a stitched image; sending the stitched image to a remote cockpit apparatus for controlling the vehicle. The remote driving effect of the remote cockpit apparatus may be improved in the present disclosure.

title_en: Electronic systems and methods for the assessment of emotional state
abstract_en: The present invention is directed to an electronic system for the assessment of emotional state. The system allows individual employees to specify their emotions using a set of emojis. The system provides a graphical user interface that displays a list of different emotions and associated emojis that the user can select. The system allows the user to write an entry about his thoughts and emotions in conjunction with the selected emojis and send the message with the emojis to individuals with whom he chooses to share. The system provides a list of company-wide employees from which the user can select. The system receives the messages and implements data structures to process the received messages and produce individual and company-wide emotional state information.

title_en: Method and system with multiple heterogeneous tee implementations
abstract_en: A TEE system that includes a first platform that runs a first TEE, a second platform that runs a second TEE, and a merging unit that is adapted to merge a first output from the first TEE of the first platform, with a second output from the second TEE of the second platform, so as to form an output of the TEE system. The first TEE and the second TEE are based on different implementations. In this way, the security of the system is improved, as a malicious actor even be able to access "t" machines, still would not be able to retrieve the secret unless there are multiple exploitable TEE vulnerabilities on all executing TEE platforms at the same time.

title_en: System and method for url fetching retry mechanism
abstract_en: A method for overcoming intermittent, temporary, or other fetching failures by using multiple attempts for retrieving a content from a web server to a client device is disclosed. The URL fetching may use direct or non-direct fetching schemes, or a combination thereof. The non-direct fetching method may use intermediate devices, such as proxy server, Data-Center proxy server, tunnel devices, or any combination thereof. Upon sensing a failure of a fetching action, the action is repeated using the same or different parameters or attributes, such as by using different intermediate devices, selected based on different parameters or attributes, such as different countries. The repetitions are limited to a pre-defined maximum number or attempts. The fetching attempts may be performed by the client device, by an intermediate device in a non- direct fetching scheme, or a combination thereof. Various fetching schemes may be used sequentially until the content is retrieved.

title_en: Degradation suppression program, degradation suppression method, and information processing device
abstract_en: A deterioration suppression device generates a plurality of trained machine learning models having different characteristics on the basis of each training data included in a first training data set and assigned with a label indicating correct answer information. In a case where estimation accuracy of label estimation with respect to input data to be estimated by any trained machine learning model among the plurality of trained machine learning models becomes lower than a predetermined standard, the deterioration suppression device generates a second training data set including a plurality of pieces of training data using an estimation result by a trained machine learning model with the estimation accuracy equal to or higher than the predetermined standard. The deterioration suppression device executes re-learning of the trained machine learning model with the estimation accuracy lower than the predetermined standard using the second training data set.

title_en: Ring chain architecture
abstract_en: A system stores transaction data in a ring chain architecture. A ring chain comprises blocks of data stored as a length-limited block chain in a ring buffer configuration. A block of transactions is stored on a ring chain until enough new blocks are added to overwrite the ring buffer with new blocks. The system stores multiple ring chains that update at varying frequencies. A new block on a lower frequency ring chain stores an aggregation of data from the blocks that were added to a higher frequency ring chain in the time since the previous addition of a block to the lower frequency ring chain. Thus, a system of ring chains stores progressively summarized state transition data over progressively longer time intervals while maintaining immutability of the record and reducing storage requirements.

title_en: Spoof detection based on specular and diffuse reflections
abstract_en: The present invention relates biometric authentication using an optical biometric arrangement comprising an image sensor comprising a photodetector pixel array configured to capture an image of an object, the image sensor being arranged under a controllable light source comprising light source units, the method comprising: providing a light pattern comprising portions of different light intensity for illuminating the object; acquiring an image of the object, the image comprising image portions corresponding to the portions of different light intensity of the light pattern illuminating the object, at least one image portion being captured by pixels in the photodetector pixel array arranged directly under a light source unit being active during image acquisition, and at least one image portion being captured by pixels in the photodetector pixel array arranged under an at least partly in-active illumination area of the controllable light source during image acquisition, performing biometric authentication at least partly based on metrics extracted from the image portions.

title_en: Semi-autonomous intelligent task hub
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to systems and methods for an interactive, intelligent hub built around the completion of a task. This hub brings together resources, information, suggested steps, and other automated assistance to facilitate the completion of the task. AI-based assistance may indicate which steps can be completed by automated processes, and dispatch those processes, or suggest resources to assist in the completion of other steps. The hub displays the current status of the task, and lives until the completion of the task, or abandonment by the user.

title_en: Artificial neural network module for performing artificial neural network operation on plurality of subgraphs and operating method thereof
abstract_en: A method for an artificial neural network operation on a plurality of subgraphs may include generating a resource determination trigger corresponding to a target subgraph among the plurality of subgraphs included in a target neural network model; generating a control signal for hardware allocated to the target subgraph and driving resource settings in response to the resource determination trigger; changing, based on the control signal, at least one of hardware allocated to the target subgraph and driving resource settings; and performing an operation on the target subgraph based on the changed hardware and driving resource settings.

title_en: Method and system for initiating a location-based topic
abstract_en: A method and a system for initiating a location-based topic are provided. The system includes a serving system (12) that allows a user to initiate the location-based topic within a social media and a graphical user interface (110) initiated in a user device (100) through a software means. The method allows the user to initiate a topic page when browsing digital contents in the social media via the graphical user interface (110). Besides being able to browse various location-based topics created by other users and the responses, the user himself can also create a location-based topic provided for other users to browse and respond to. Through web and computer technology, the serving system (12) allows the user to browse the various digital contents via the social media and interact with other users through the various location-based topics.

title_en: Process of signing documents
abstract_en: There is described a process of signing documents comprising generating a document identification (DID) from a digital copy (DOC DC ) of a document to be signed by at least one signatory and encoding the document identification (DID) into one or more watermarks (WM; WM SA ;...). A hard copy (DOC HC ) of the document to be signed incorporating the one or more watermark (WM; WM SA ;...) is produced. The one or more watermarks (WM; WM SA ;...) provided on the hard copy (DOC HC ) of the document is/are read using an optical reader device (ORD; 10) and the document identification ([DID] ENC ) encoded into the one or more watermarks (WM; WM SA ) read by the optical reader device (ORD; 10) is decoded. The hard copy (DOC HC ) of the document to be signed is associated to the digital copy (DOC DC ) of the document to be signed based on the decoded document identification ([DID] DEC ). Signing of the document by the at least one signatory is performed using a digital signing device (DSD; 10), and signatory information (K SIG ) unique to the at least one signatory using the digital signing device (DSD; 10) is obtained. Finally, a digital signature (SIG) of the digital copy (DOC DC ) of the document is generated based on the decoded document identification ([DID] DEC ) and the signatory information (K SIG ), following which the digital signature (SIG) is applied to the digital copy (DOC DC ) of the document to produce a digitally signed copy (DOC SIG ) of the document.

title_en: Method and apparatus for training neural network for determining molecule retrosynthesis route
abstract_en: A method for training a neural network for determining a molecule retrosynthesis route, comprises: for a plurality of molecules, when determining retrosynthesis routes of the molecules, using a hierarchical learning concept, dividing a training process, which needs a relatively deep search of a molecule retrosynthesis route, into multiple layers for training, replacing a complete retrosynthesis reaction process with the multiple layers of molecule retrosynthesis routes, and upon the completion of the training of one layer of molecule retrosynthesis route, selecting, by means of a molecular filtering method, representative molecules as starting molecules of the next layer of molecule retrosynthesis route. The present invention can effectively improve the efficiency of searching for a molecule retrosynthesis route, such that accurate molecule cost value information can be extracted more efficiently. In a hierarchical manner, a large amount of calculation overheads caused by determining a molecule retrosynthesis route are greatly reduced, and on the basis of ensuring the accuracy of the molecule retrosynthesis route, the time for determining the molecule retrosynthesis route is reduced.

title_en: Language model biasing
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and apparatus for receiving audio data corresponding to a user utterance and context data, identifying an initial set of one or more n-grams from the context data, generating an expanded set of one or more n-grams based on the initial set of n-grams, adjusting a language model based at least on the expanded set of n-grams, determining one or more speech recognition candidates for at least a portion of the user utterance using the adjusted language model, adjusting a score for a particular speech recognition candidate determined to be included in the expanded set of n-grams, determining a transcription of user utterance that includes at least one of the one or more speech recognition candidates, and providing the transcription of the user utterance for output.

title_en: Systems and methods for virtual gpu-cpu memory orchestration
abstract_en: A server system generates a model of a first memory architecture of a client device, the model of the first memory architecture including a GPU memory portion and a CPU memory portion. The server system receives a representation of a first image asset, and stores a first texture image corresponding to the first image asset in the GPU memory portion of the model at the server system. The first texture image is stored in the GPU memory portion of the client device. The server system determines, using the model, that the GPU memory portion at the client device needs to be reallocated. The server system identifies, using the model, one or more texture images that are stored in the GPU memory portion at the client device to evict and transmits an instruction, to the client device, to evict the one or more texture images from the GPU memory portion.

title_en: Blockchain-based method and system for sdp access control
abstract_en: Provided in embodiments of the present disclosure are a blockchain-based method and system for SDP access control. An SDP connection accepting host transmits information of the SDP connection accepting host and a supported connection policy to a blockchain system node, performs blockchain node verification and consensus, and records in a blockchain ledger; an SDP connection initiating host submits an identity authentication request to the blockchain system node; the blockchain system node verifies information of the identity authentication request, and searches for a list of SDP connection accepting hosts accessible to the SDP connection initiating host, and returns to the SDP connection initiating host; the SDP connection initiating host initiates a connection request, the connection request comprising a signature of the blockchain system node with respect to the SDP connection accepting hosts; the SDP connection accepting host verifies the connection request initiated by the SDP connection initiating host and provides an access service upon successful verification. The embodiments of the present disclosure prevent an SDP controller from coming under a DDoS attack and prevent the SDP controller from implementing an incorrect authorization.

title_en: Enhancing dental video to ct model registration and augmented reality aided dental treatment
abstract_en: Disclosed herein methods and systems for registering intraoral frames of a patient to a dental CT model of the patient, comprising receiving a dental 3D visual model of a patient created based on an intraoral scan of the patient captured after one or more teeth of the patient are marked with intraoral markers located inside the patient's mouth, registering the 3D visual model to a 3D CT model of the patient, receiving intraoral frames captured during a dental treatment to the patient, each frame depicts at least some of the intraoral markers, registering each frame to the 3D visual model based on the intraoral markers, registering each frame to the 3D CT model based on its registration to the 3D visual model registered to the 3D CT model, and creating a plurality of fused frames each merging a respective frame with a corresponding segment of the registered 3D CT model.

title_en: Augmented reality system for viewing an event with mode based on crowd sourced images
abstract_en: Augmented reality systems provide graphics over views from a mobile device for both in-venue and remote viewing of a sporting or other event. A server system can provide a transformation between the coordinate system of a mobile device (smart phone, tablet computer, head mounted display) and a real world coordinate system. Requested graphics for the event are displayed over a view of an event.

title_en: Error detection program, error detection method, and information processing apparatus
abstract_en: An information processing apparatus determines a combination of a first data qubit and a second data qubit that further reduces the energy represented by an energy equation. The energy equation includes first to third energy terms. The first energy term is used to identify the first data qubit on which a Z error has occurred. The second energy term is used to identify the second data qubit on which an X error has occurred. The third energy term reduces the energy as the number of data qubits each being a third data qubit on which both a Z error and an X error have simultaneously occurred increases. The information processing apparatus determines that a Y error has occurred on the third data qubit.

title_en: Training a machine learning algorithm using digitally reconstructed radiographs
abstract_en: Disclosed is a computer-implemented method of training a likelihood-based computational model for determining the position of an image representation of an annotated anatomical structure in a two-dimensional x-ray image, wherein the method encompasses inputting medical DRRs together with annotation to a machine learning algorithm to train the algorithm, i.e. to generate adapted learnable parameters of the machine learning model. The annotations may be derived from metadata associated with the DRRs or may be included in atlas data which is matched with the DRRs to establish a relation between the annotations included in the atlas data and the DRRs. The thus generated machine learning algorithm may then be used to analyse clinical or synthesized DRRs so as to appropriately add annotations to those DRRs and/or identify the position of an anatomical structure in those DRRs.

title_en: Processing method and apparatus for communication service data, and computer storage medium
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present application are a processing method and apparatus for communication service data. The processing method comprises: acquiring a query request based on a query time point (S100); querying a main database to obtain a first communication service data set at the current time point, and querying incremental backup data in a mirror database to obtain a second communication service data set (S200); merging the first communication service data set with the second communication service data set to form a merged data set, and performing screening on communication service data in the merged data set according to a primary key, and the query time point corresponding to the query request, so as to obtain a screened data set (S300); and constructing, according to the screened data set, a communication service topology portrait for representing a communication service data state (S400).

title_en: Method, apparatus, device, storage medium and program product for target positioning
abstract_en: The present application provides a method, apparatus, device, storage medium and program product for target positioning. The method applied to a smart terminal includes: obtaining image data of a surrounding environment; generating a spatial image of the surrounding environment based on the image data; determining and obtaining the spatial image corresponding to a positioning target; generating anchor point information corresponding to the positioning target based on the corresponding spatial image; and determining a specific location of the positioning target using the spatial image and the anchor point information.

title_en: Audio content generation and classification
abstract_en: Some disclosed methods involve receiving audio data of at least a first audio data type and a second audio data type, including audio signals and associated spatial data indicating intended perceived spatial positions for the audio signals, determining at least a first feature type from the audio data and applying a positional encoding process to the audio data, to produce encoded audio data. The encoded audio data may include representations of at least the spatial data and the first feature type in first embedding vectors of an embedding dimension. Some methods may involve training a neural network, based on the encoded audio data, to transform audio data from an input audio data type having an input spatial data type to a transformed audio data type having a transformed spatial data type. Some methods may involve training a neural network to identify an input audio data type.

title_en: Computing device, data processing method and system, and related device
abstract_en: A computing device and a data processing method and system are provided. The computing device includes a central processing unit, at least one heterogeneous device, and a shared memory pool. The central processing unit is configured to: divide the shared memory pool into a plurality of memory spaces, store, in a first memory space in the plurality of memory spaces, first to-be-processed data that is provided by a client and that is associated with a service, and notify a first heterogeneous device of an address of the first to-be-processed data in the first memory space and a first operation that needs to be performed by the first heterogeneous device. The first heterogeneous device performs the first operation on the first to-be-processed data, and stores obtained first data in a second memory space. According to the method, the heterogeneous device does not need to perform data movement on the first to-be-processed data between different memories, but can directly process the first to-be-processed data in the shared memory pool, thereby avoiding problems of high resource consumption and a high service processing delay.

title_en: Slidable electronic device including flexible display
abstract_en: According to an embodiment disclosed herein, a slidable electronic device comprises: a first housing; a second housing that can slide relative to the first housing; a flexible display that includes a first region and a second region extending from the first region; a display support plate disposed on the rear surface of the second region of the flexible display; a belt connecting the first housing and the display support plate; and a pulley device configured to roll a certain section of the belt according to the sliding in or out of the second housing. In the belt, a portion disposed corresponding to the pulley device may include two curved regions and a straight region between the two curved regions.

title_en: Elevation map systems and methods for tracking of objects
abstract_en: Systems and methods for improved three-dimensional tracking of objects in a traffic or security monitoring scene are disclosed herein. In various embodiments, a system includes an image sensor, an object localization system, and a coordinate transformation system. The image sensor may be configured to capture a stream of images of a scene. The object localization system may be configured to detect an object in the captured stream of images and determine an object location of the object in the stream of images. The coordinate transformation system may be configured to transform the object location of the object to first coordinates on a flat ground plane, and transform the first coordinates to second coordinates on a non-flat ground plane based at least in part on an elevation map of the scene. Associated methods are also provided.

title_en: Image synthesis
abstract_en: A first apparatus comprises a first receiver (301) receiving images of a scene captured and a second receiver (303) receives 3D spatial data for the scene A view synthesis neural network (307) generates view shifted images for the scene for different view poses from the images and the spatial data. A neural network trainer (309) trains the view synthesis neural network (307) based on images of the scene for different view poses. A generator (305) generates an audiovisual data stream comprising: image data for the images, scene data representing the three dimensional spatial data, and coefficient data describing coefficients of the view synthesis neural network (307) after training. A second apparatus receives the audio visual data stream and sets a local neural network (403) based on the coefficient data. The local neural network (403) is then used to generate images of the scene for different view poses.

title_en: Method for modelling an anatomical structure of the human body
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for modelling an anatomical structure of the human body in three dimensions that is computer-implemented and that comprises the following steps: - obtaining a plurality of consecutive images of the anatomical structure using a device for capturing images that is in movement and that bears a light source, - identifying anatomical sub-structures of the anatomical structure in the obtained images, - carrying out three-dimensional modelling of the anatomical structure based on the obtained images, - comparing the three-dimensional shape of the anatomical sub-structures of the obtained images with models of anatomical sub-structures stored in a database, step (6) of carrying out three-dimensional modelling of the anatomical structure based on the obtained images comprising predicting the depth of the anatomical structure and predicting the movement of the image-capturing device.

title_en: A method, an apparatus and a computer program product for encoding and decoding of digital media content
abstract_en: The embodiments relate to a method for encoding/decoding, the method comprising encoding/ decoding (910) a picture comprising a number of samples, wherein a phase of the encoding/decoding comprises a division operation; determining (920) a numerator and a denominator; determining (930) an approximated output for the division operation between the numerator and the denominator, wherein the determining comprises deriving a scale parameter using a piecewise approximation; deriving a shift parameter and a rounding parameter, and applying the scale parameter, the shift parameter, and the rounding parameter to the numerator; using (940) the approximated output for the division operation in said phase of the encoding/decoding. The embodiments also relate to an apparatus and a computer program product for implementing the method.

title_en: System and method for biometric identification and authentication
abstract_en: A biometric authentication and identification system (100) and related methods are disclosed. The system (100) comprises a quantization unit (102) for assigning a quantization index k to each datapoint of a biometric time series, a plurality of volatile threshold switches (108a), an address decoder (105) for selecting, at each time step t of the time series, a single threshold switch of through an index combination comprising at least the quantization index k[t] corresponding to the time step t and the quantization index k[t-T] corresponding to an earlier time step t-T, a pulse generator (115) for applying write pulses to the selected threshold switches, a readout unit (109) for accumulating measured leakage currents of each threshold switch in the high resistance state as components of a query vector, and a database (111) for matching the query vector with at last one biometry class vectors stored as token for a predefined user group. Each threshold switch transitions from a high resistance state to a low resistance state while subjected to a write pulse, and cycling history-dependent shifts in the threshold voltage being relaxed in the high resistance state.

title_en: Systems and methods for determining a region of interest of a biological tissue
abstract_en: According to a first aspect, the present disclosure relates to a system for determining a region of interest of a biological tissue comprising: an image acquisition system configured to obtain an image of the biological tissue; a first processing module configured to generate, using the image of the biological tissue: a classification parameter for characterising the image of the biological tissue; an attention matrix, wherein the attention matrix is a matrix of weights associated to regions of the image, wherein each weight indicates an impact contribution of the associated region of the image on the generating of the classification parameter; and a local parameters matrix, wherein each parameter of the local parameters matrix corresponds to a weight of the attention matrix and characterises the associated region of the image; a second processing module configured to generate a mapping element based on the classification parameter, the attention matrix, and the local parameters matrix the mapping element identifying the region of interest; and a display module configured to display the mapping element relative to the image of the biological tissue.

title_en: Task management with image-capture monitoring of user actions
abstract_en: Techniques for presenting a user with instructions for completing tasks based on monitoring images of user actions are disclosed. A system monitors user actions to identify a next operation in a set of operations to present to a user. The system presents to the user instructions for completing the next operation. The system monitors user actions and may also monitor a manufacturing component status or operating equipment status to determine whether an operation has been completed. The system may reorder a sequence of operations for a particular task based on one or both user input and identifying a different sequence of operations associated with a superior task execution rating.

title_en: Object classification in images
abstract_en: The present invention relates to image classification, in particular to object recognition/detection in images. According to an aspect of the present invention, there is provided a computer implemented method of classifying an object in an image. The method comprises: identifying, using one or more machine-learned local feature identification models, a plurality of local features of an object in the image, each local feature comprising a respective feature identity and a respective feature area; comparing the plurality of identified local features to a plurality of sets of masked images of candidate objects, wherein: each set of masked images corresponds to a respective candidate object and comprises a plurality of masked images of the respective candidate object from a plurality of viewing angles; each masked image comprises a plurality of feasible search zones for local features of the candidate object; and the comparison of the plurality of local features to a masked image of a candidate object is based on an overlap between the identified local features and feasible search zones of said candidate object in the masked image; and classifying the object in the image as one of the candidate objects based on the comparison of identified local features to a plurality of sets of masked images of candidate objects.

title_en: Joint uv optimization and texture baking
abstract_en: A method of optimizing a simplified model associated with a high-poly model includes obtaining information about the simplified model; iteratively updating values of an initialized set of parameters of the simplified model to obtain optimized values; updating the initial set of vertices of a low-poly mesh with the optimized values; optimizing coordinates associated with the simplified model based on the optimized values of the initialized set of parameters; and baking texture from the high-poly model onto the optimized coordinates to generate the simplified model.

title_en: Method and apparatus for determining a growth factor
abstract_en: An apparatus and method for determining a growth factor. The method may include receiving, by a processor, entity data and determining, by the processor, a growth factor. Further, the method may include generating, by the processor, at least an interface element as a function of the growth factor and transmitting, by the processor, the at least an interface element to a graphical user interface (GUI).

title_en: System and method of drainless link repair for increased accelerator utilization during failure
abstract_en: A system for repair of an accelerator architecture including a plurality of accelerator host having a plurality of accelerator elements in each host and high-speed interconnects between accelerator elements and including a link health monitor service in the host determining a status of each interconnect internal and external to the host. The link health monitor service detects link status of the interconnects and communicates this to a pod manager responsible for managing a number of interconnected hosts. The pod manager communicates with a scheduler for scheduling processing tasks to each accelerator element or group of elements. Upon detection of an interconnect problem, the pod manager flags a least common ancestor in a binary tree of elements containing elements adjacent to the failed interconnect and flags the ancestor and its parent nodes as unavailable. Pod manager further generates a corrective action repairing the problem interconnect communicating the action to a technician.

title_en: Systems, devices and methods for wireless communications in analyte monitoring devices
abstract_en: Systems, devices and methods are provided that allow for enhanced performance, power efficiency, interoperability, data security and user privacy for in vivo analyte monitoring systems that utilize wireless communications. The in vivo analyte monitoring systems can include a Bluetooth or Bluetooth Low Energy enabled handheld relay device for wirelessly relaying analyte data between a sensor unit device and one or more reader devices. The in vivo analyte monitoring systems can employ advertisement and encryption schemes for wirelessly transmitting data in a manner that allows for improved security, efficiency and privacy.

title_en: Information processing device, information processing method, and program
abstract_en: An information processing apparatus includes a control unit configured to perform control to display related content that is associated with music piece content and includes a plurality of pages on which a character or an image is displayed, and display a page guide indicating a page being displayed in a whole of the related content.

title_en: Apparatus for controlling a polyurethane foam recycling process
abstract_en: The invention refers to an apparatus (110) for controlling a polyurethane foam recycling process. A data providing unit (111) provides measurement data associated with the foam product. The measurement data is indicative of a spectrum received from the foam product. An foam model providing unit (112) provides a machine learning based foam model for determining an isocyanate content and/or polyol content in the polyurethane foam product. The foam model has been trained utilizing historical training data to determine the isocyanate content and/or polyol content in a foam product based on the measurement data. An con- tent determination unit (113) determines the isocyanate content and/or polyol content in the foam product based on the foam model and the measurement data. A control data generation unit (114) generates control data for controlling the foam product recycling process based on the determined isocyanate content and/or polyol content.

title_en: A malware process detection technique
abstract_en: It is proposed a method comprising obtaining, for identified processes from raw data, a list of activities and a list of used resources related to an execution of identified processes; generating, for each of the identified processes, a graph representation, wherein the graph representation comprises nodes and edges, wherein the nodes are assigned with elements from the list of used resources or an identifying value of one of the two identified processes, and wherein the edges are assigned with elements from the list of activities; combining the generated graph representations of the identified processes when the identified processes are linked together, wherein the combining outputting a combined graph representation being a representation of one of the events to be classified; providing the representation of one of the events to be classified to a classification model.

title_en: Notification device, notification method, program, and notification system
abstract_en: A notification device (10A) includes: an outputter (14) that outputs a sound according to a predetermined condition after outputting notification start information, when the predetermined condition is met; an obtainer (12) that obtains notification start information output from another notification device (10B); and a controller (13) that controls whether to cause the outputter (14) to output the sound, based on timing at which the notification start information from the other notification device is obtained.

title_en: Method and apparatus for indicating status of a voice-related system
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides method and apparatus for indicating status of a voice-related system. A method for indicating status of a voice-related system is provided, performed at a dedicated first processing unit and including: in response to an actuation of a button in the voice-related system, changing current mute status information; receiving a first display instruction from a second processing unit, wherein the first display instruction is associated with a processing status of a voice event; and providing a second display instruction to a display unit in the voice-related system, based on the first display instruction and the current mute status information, wherein in case that the current mute status information indicates mute status of a microphone in the voice-related system, the second display instruction is associated with the current mute status independently of the first display instruction, and in case that the current mute status information indicates unmute status of the microphone, the second display instruction is associated with the first play instruction.

title_en: Communication method and apparatus
abstract_en: This application belongs to the field of communication technologies, and provides a communication method and apparatus, to obtain a model. In this method, an AnLF functional entity may determine, by determining that a first notification message carries first indication information, to obtain a first model. For example, when the first notification message is used to provide an updated model, the first notification message may carry the first indication information indicating that the first model is updated, so that the AnLF functional entity determines, based on the first indication information, that the first model is updated, that is, determines to obtain the first model. For another example, when the first notification message is used to provide a new model or an updated model, the first notification message may carry the first indication information indicating that an MTLF functional entity provides the model, so that the AnLF functional entity determines, based on the first indication information, that the first model needs to be obtained, and obtains the first model. In this way, the AnLF functional entity can obtain the first model when determining that the first model needs to be obtained.

title_en: Computer-implemented method for co-simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for message processing that is consistent over time, in co-simulation with two simulators which operate asynchronously and exchange messages with FIFO buffers via a communication channel. Each message includes a timestamp indicating the simulation time of the transmitting simulator. In the receiving simulator, a playback time and an estimated current time of the transmitting simulator are determined on the basis of the time stamp and dynamically updated. Depending on the time reference, incoming messages are stored, discarded or made available for output. Tolerance thresholds are taken into account in order to compensate for slight time deviations. In the event of a relatively large time delay, the playback time can be updated in an accelerated manner, a minimum time having to be observed between such jumps. The method enables robust, flexible, and efficient synchronization without cyclic communication.

title_en: Characterizing macrotextures of ground surfaces
