abstract_en: The invention pertains to a computer-implemented method (100) for characterizing a macrotexture of a ground surface, the method comprising receiving (110) 3D point cloud data of a scene, the scene comprising one or more ground surfaces, the 3D point cloud data comprising a plurality of ground points related to the one or more ground surfaces, selecting (130) a sampling unit of one of the ground surfaces, performing plane fitting (140) for fitting one or more planes, each plane representing a portion of the sampling unit, wherein the plane fitting is based on ground points related to the portion represented by the respective plane, calculating (150) a set of roughness indices, each roughness index characterizing the macrotexture of the sampling unit, wherein the calculation of each roughness index is based on distance values of ground points related to the respective portions, the distance values indicating a distance of the respective ground point relative to the respective plane, generating (160) output based on the set of roughness indices, and providing (170) a graphical representation of the output in a graphical user interface.

title_en: Code modification using a virtual assistant
abstract_en: A system can receive an input via a chatbot interface. The input can be indicative of an update to a control parameter. The system can generate, using a large language model, a search query based on the input. The system can filter, using the search query, data related to control parameters. The system can detect, using the large language model, updates to the control parameters based on the filtered data. The system can identify, based on the updates to the control parameters and product metadata, products that fail to comply with the updates. The system can determine code segments within a source code corresponding to the products. The code segments can be related to the control parameters. The system can modify the code segments to comply with the updates to the control parameters. The system can execute the modified code segments to perform an operation.

title_en: Malware detection
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method for identifying malware in computer systems comprises receiving a plurality of executable files labeled as being malicious or benign, training a machine learning model using properties extracted from overlays associated with each of the plurality of received labeled executable files, receiving an executable file that is not labeled, determining whether the received unlabeled executable file is malicious or benign using the trained machine learning model based on properties extracted from an overlay associated with the received unlabeled executable file, and transmitting information identifying the received unlabeled executable file as malicious when the received unlabeled executable file is determined to be malicious.

title_en: Systems and methods for sortation of products using a conveyor assembly
abstract_en: A conveyor 102, comprising a scanner such as an RFID scanner 104, a plurality of sorting modules 106, each comprising a sorting portion 110, with a set of rollers to direct the product to at least one destination, and a control circuit (216, fig 7) configured to receive ID data and determine the sortation destination for a product before using the sortation modules to send the product to the right destination, where the controller communicates with each sorting module to establish their relative position to send items to the correct destination, and where when the conveyor is reconfigured, or a new sorter is added, the controller can again communicate with each controller to determine their relative positions.

title_en: Quality review management system
abstract_en: A quality review management system for reviewing an operation of a process being implemented by process equipment comprises a records database that stores a plurality of records, each of the plurality of records indicating an exception within the process and a review application executed on a computer processing device. The review application enables a user to view the records stored in the database via a user interface and includes a search routine that accepts one or more search parameters from a user, an access module that retrieves relevant records from the records database, and a presentation module that presents the relevant records via multiple different screens on the user interface. The review application obtains successive sets of records at different times, including a first set of records 700 displayed to the user at a first time T1 and a second set of records displayed to the user at a second subsequent time T2, and stores a marker or anchor (e.g. ‘Anchor1top’) marking one or more of the records for the first set of records displayed to the user and uses the marker to obtain the second set of records to display via the user interface at the second time.

title_en: Apparatus for generating and detecting photons
abstract_en: An apparatus 100 having a silicon substrate (104, Fig. 1) comprises a first surface and an opposing second surface. On the first surface is a lithium niobate waveguide 102 configured to guide photons from the waveguide to the substrate. On the second surface is at least one photon detector 106. The waveguide may convert a pump photon 108 into a photon pair (110, Fig. 1). The photon detector may be arranged to detect photons which have passed through the substrate. The pump photon may be converted into a photon pair having orthogonal polarisation via three wave mixing. The waveguide may comprise of a periodically poled waveguide and one or more grating couplers 204, 208 & 210 configured to direct photons towards the second surface of the silicon substrate. Pumped and converted photons may be guided into the silicon substrate. At least one first photon detector may detect idler photons 202, at least one second photon detector detects signal photons 206. The at least one photon detector may comprise a cavity-based superconducting nanowire single photon detector. The apparatus may comprise one or more interferometers. The apparatus may be used for quantum computing. A method for forming a waveguide is also claimed.

title_en: Methods, communications apparatus and devices

title_en: Road condition measurement apparatus, method and program
abstract_en: To make it possible to measure a road width, slope, inclination of a facility of a narrow road by image processing of photographs.SOLUTION: An HDD 18 stores a plurality of road surface photographs 40 taken mainly of a road surface of a road to be measured with a predetermined overlap rate or more, and a plurality of road sides photographs 42 taken mainly of road sides of the road to be measured with a predetermined overlapped rate or more. A point group generation function 30 of a CPU 12 generates point group data 44 indicating three-dimensional positions of the road surface and a road side facility of the road to be measured by matching, mutual orientation and absolute orientation from the road surface photographs 40 and the road side photographs 42. An image generation function 32 generates an ortho-image including the road surface and the road side facility of the road to be measured from the point group data 44. title_en: User terminal, control method and computer program
abstract_en: To provide a user terminal capable of completing preparation for enabling a user to further easily grasp size of products having various size with simpler work, a control method and a computer program.SOLUTION: In an information providing system, a user terminal 10 comprises: an information providing unit 161 that acquires product identification information indicating a product and a size specified value showing size of the product; and a size changing unit 162 that generates image data of a changed image the size of which has been changed to the size presented by the size specified value, by transforming image data of an initial image generated as an image of a product with predetermined size in advance based on the size specified value. title_en: Printing system, printer, printing program, and printing method
abstract_en: To provide a printing system that, after a user issues instructions intended to stop printing, can take different measures in terms of refund for settled fees in accordance with the cause of the stop to improve the user's convenience.SOLUTION: In a printing system, a multi-functional machine has: a printing unit that executes printing of a settled print job; a "copy temporary stop" button that receives input of instructions to temporarily stop printing that has been started; a reason input button that receives, for the printing that has been temporarily stopped, input of instructions to execute subsequent post-stop processing; and a processor. The processor temporarily stops the printing that has been started in response to the input to the "copy temporary stop" button. A processor of a data processing server and the processor of the multi-functional machine execute, as the post-stop processing, either one of post-settlement processing related to refund of at least part of settled fees or provision of benefits equivalent thereto, or resume processing of, after the cause of input to a first instruction input unit is solved, resuming the printing that has been temporarily stopped to complete the print job.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing program, information processing device, and information processing method
abstract_en: To enable an AR display with the matching with the surrounding real object being taken into consideration.SOLUTION: The situation of a natural light source is estimated in accordance with the position information on a user terminal, time information, and weather information. Information on a real corresponding object on a virtual space caused to correspond to a real object present around the user terminal is obtained. A picked-up image picked up by the user terminal and imaging direction information are obtained. The effect of a light source to the real corresponding object under the estimated natural light source situation is calculated. Information on a virtual object placed around the position of the user terminal and possibly present within the imaging range of a camera device is obtained. The effect of the light source to the virtual object under the estimated natural light source situation is calculated with the effect of the natural light source to the real corresponding object being taken into consideration. The grounding position of the virtual object on the picked-up image is identified. The virtual object and the calculated light source effect are displayed so as to be superimposed on the identified grounding position on the picked-up image.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Virtual houseboat
abstract_en: To provide a virtual houseboat for enjoying a houseboat without being infected with the coronavirus.SOLUTION: In a virtual houseboat, applications such as ZOOM are used; participants are displayed on a screen using a PC and a smartphone using Internet communication; a departure scene, wave video, wave sound, video and audio of departure greetings of a toastmaster and an organizer, video inside and outside the ship, audio and video of the participants' chorus, and video and audio of the participants' self-introduction are reproduced; karaoke song sound is output and lyrics are displayed on the screen; video of a singer's face and audio of the singer are reproduced; mutual chat and the like are displayed on the screen; video and audio of an outboard scenery and a wavefront are produced; the screen is shaken and wave sound is made so that the participants experience the sensation of shaking of the houseboat on which they are riding due to waves of ships passing nearby; then a turn signal and audio and video of everyone's chorus are reproduced; and a scenery of arrival at a wharf are projected on the screen.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information processing device and information processing program
abstract_en: To provide an information processing device and an information processing program capable of estimating a user's reaction to an advertising phrase when the advertising phrase is given to an object for advertisement.SOLUTION: An information processing device according to a first aspect includes a processor. The processor obtains object information that is information on an object for advertisement, and classification information that is information including advertisement phrases relating to the object classified for each set, and inputs the obtained object information and classification information into an already learnt reaction estimating model that estimates the user's reaction so as to estimate the user's reaction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Information processing device, information processing system, method and program
abstract_en: To provide a device, a system, a method and a program capable of providing information an optimum order.SOLUTION: An information processing device includes: storage means for storing registration information on information registered by each provider providing the information, each user receiving the provision of the information, or both of them, and address information showing a storage place of the information provided by each provider; reception means for receiving a providing request for in formation from a terminal of the user; determination means for drawing and determining an order of the information to be displayed in the terminal of the user by using the registration information stored in the storage means according to a set condition; and transmission means for transmitting the determined order and the address information of each information stored in the storage means to the terminal of the user.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Image processing method, image processing system, and program
abstract_en: To provide an image processing system, an image processing method, and a program that improve convenience of a performance image.SOLUTION: In a performance analysis system connected with a keyboard instrument by wire or wirelessly and having a control device, a storage device, a scanning device, a display device, and an imaging device, image extraction processing includes region estimation processing Sb1 and region extraction processing Sb2. The region estimation processing Sb1 estimates a specific region for a performance image represented by image data. The specific region includes a keyboard image and a finger image in the performance image. When the control device executes the region estimation processing Sb1, an element (a region estimation unit) that estimates the specific region of the performance image is achieved. The region extraction processing Sb2 extracts a specific region from the performance image represented by image data. When the control device executes the region extraction processing Sb2, an element (a region extraction unit) that extracts the specific region of the performance image is achieved.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 8

title_en: Vehicle interior monitoring system and vehicle operation management system
abstract_en: To provide a vehicle interior monitoring system and a vehicle operation management system that can determine whether or not there is space to ease congestion in a vehicle interior.SOLUTION: A ceiling center camera 18 (first imaging unit) images a plan view image of a vehicle interior from a center of a ceiling in the vehicle interior. A side camera 19 (second imaging unit) images a side view image of the vehicle interior from a peripheral edge of the ceiling or a side of a vehicle interior 40. A vehicle interior image recognition unit 36 recognizes a person and luggage included in the plan view image and the side view image. A congestion estimation unit 37 obtains, on the basis of the recognized person and luggage, a congestion rate of the vehicle interior. The vehicle interior image recognition unit 36 obtains a plan view section of the person and luggage recognized in the plan view image, and obtains a side view section of the person and luggage recognized in the side view image. A volume calculation unit 37E obtains, on the basis of the plan view section and the side view section of the person and luggage, volume of the person and luggage. A congestion rate calculation unit 37G calculates a congestion rate on the basis of a difference between total volume of the person and luggage and volume of the vehicle interior 40.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Hardware system for automatic direct memory access data formatting
abstract_en: To provide a hardware DMA controller for properly configuring direct memory access (DMA) channels prior to data transfer.SOLUTION: A processing circuitry of a hardware DMA controller receives data comprising a header and payload from an electronic device via an input port, parses the header to determine data parameters including a register length and an input data format, and selects a target destination for the data based on the data parameters. The processing circuitry also allocates memory within the target destination based on a transaction length, formats the payload for direct memory access based on the data parameters, and transfers the formatted payload for storage within the allocated memory within the target destination via an output port using direct memory access.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Image reading device and image forming apparatus
abstract_en: To provide an image reading device and an image forming apparatus that prevent a shading correction error due to temperature fluctuation.SOLUTION: An image reading device 100 has: irradiation means that irradiates a document with light; a first light guide member that guides light reflected on the document; output means that outputs a read signal obtained from the reflected light; a reference member for correcting shading in the read signal; correction means that outputs a read image obtained by correcting the shading in the read signal of the document by using correction data obtained from the read signal of the reference member; and control means that controls the timing of irradiation performed by the irradiation means and the timing of output performed by the output means. Before the output means outputs read signals of the document and the reference member, the control means heats the first light guide member with the light radiated from the irradiation means. The correction means corrects the shading in the read signal of the document output from the output means while the first light guide member is heated by using the correction data obtained while the first light guide member is heated.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Framework for learning to transfer learn
abstract_en: To provide a method and system capable of realizing a framework for learning to transfer learn.SOLUTION: A method comprises: receiving a source dataset and a target dataset; and identifying a loss function for a deep learning model based on the source dataset and the target dataset. The loss function includes encoder weights, source classifier layer weights, target classifier layer weights, coefficients, and a policy weight. The method also comprises: applying gradient descent-based optimization during a first stage of each of multiple learning iterations for a learning to transfer learn (L2TL) architecture, to learn the encoder weights, the source classifier layer weights and the target classifier weights that minimize the loss function; sampling actions of a policy model to determine the coefficients; and determining the policy weight that maximizes an evaluation metric during a second stage of each of the multiple learning iterations.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Multilayer universal resolver system for distributed id environment and driving method
abstract_en: To provide a multilayer universal resolver system for a distributed ID environment, and a driving method.SOLUTION: The present invention relates to a distributed ID (distributed identity) technique, and more particularly to a multilayer universal resolver system and a method therefor for a distributed ID environment that can manage universal resolvers (also called general-purpose resolvers) in multiple layers to control accesses to connected distributed ledger information and that can prevent exposure and leakage in an identity verification system based on self-main sponsor type/distributed IDs (DIDs). title_en: Information processor, information processing method, and program
abstract_en: To improve technology to determine service areas.SOLUTION: An information processor 20 searches a predetermined search area to determine a target area for providing an on-demand transportation subscription service that dispatches a vehicle to a boarding point in response to a request from a user. The information processor 20 includes a control unit 21 that acquires evaluation information indicating an evaluation value calculated for each link for each of a plurality of links connecting a plurality of nodes included in a road network in the search area, selects two or more links from the plurality of links based on the evaluation value indicated by the acquired evaluation information, and determines an area defined by the set of the selected two or more links as a target area.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Exploratory orchestration of mixed methodology incident remediation workflows
abstract_en: To provide an improved computing tool for automatically performing exploratory orchestration.SOLUTION: Mechanisms are provided for generating, executing, orchestrating and monitoring an information technology (IT) incident remediation task workflow. An IT incident notification is received and a knowledge data structure associated with IT resources corresponding to the IT incident is retrieved. IT remediation tasks are extracted from the knowledge data structure and correlated with skills in a plurality of predetermined skills. Automated tools are correlated with corresponding skills in the plurality of predetermined skills. An IT incident remediation task workflow is generated based on matching of skills associated with the IT remediation tasks and automation tools. The generated IT incident remediation task workflow is automatically executed on at least one IT resource.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Program and information processing device
abstract_en: To grant an appropriate reward to a user according to the content of a movement when the user makes the movement using a vehicle rented from a vehicle rental business operator.SOLUTION: A program causes a computer capable of communicating with a vehicle to function as acquisition means for acquiring location information indicating the location of the vehicle from the vehicle, generating means for generating movement information that includes location information acquired by the acquisition means while the vehicle moves from one of a plurality of bases to another base different from the one, and time information indicating the time the vehicle was located at the location indicated by the location information, determination means for determining whether or not a user who rented the vehicle has achieved a reward granting condition based on the movement information generated by the generating means, and granting means for granting a reward to the user when the determination means determines that the user has achieved the reward granting condition.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Action control system
abstract_en: To make an electronic device take an appropriate action in response to an action of a user.SOLUTION: An action control system disclosed herein comprises: a condition recognition unit for recognizing the user condition including an action of a user and the condition of an electronic device; an emotion determination unit for determining emotions of the user or emotions of the electronic device; and an action determination unit configured to use an action determination model and at least one of the user condition, the condition of the electronic device, the emotions of the user, and the emotions of the electronic device at given time to determine one of multiple types of device operations, including non-operation, as an action to be taken by the electronic device. title_en: Event determination method, device and program using, text moving image classification model
abstract_en: To provide an event determination method, a device, and a program capable of determining presence/absence of an event in moving image data, even in an event for which definition is difficult, without using a large number of pieces of teacher data.SOLUTION: An event determination device which is connected to a text moving image classification model and a time series analysis model through a network, first designates, a moving image for which determination is performed, an event which the user wants to detect, and a text moving image classification model which the user uses, on an input screen 20 provided on the input means, then generates a keyword in a detection event, and in the moving image, calculates an existence ratio of the keyword for acquiring time series probability data 29. Then, the device analyzes the time series probability data 29 by using a moving image in which the detection event is reproduced and the time series analysis model which was learned using the keyword, for determining presence of the event for which estimation is difficult and definition is doubtful such as, stumbling or tottering.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Information processing system, solver device, information processing method, program, and circuit information
abstract_en: To reduce the amount of data received from an information processing device by a solver device.SOLUTION: An information processing system solves a combination optimization problem. Among a plurality of coefficients, a first coefficient is represented by a predetermined first data type. The solver device stores restoration information representing a first restoration value corresponding to the first identification value. title_en: Signal response medium, signal response medium identification system, code detection system, signal response medium identification method, and code detection method
abstract_en: To provide a signal response medium, a code detection system, and a code detection method in which detection accuracy of a response signal is improved.SOLUTION: A signal response medium includes: an input unit to which a chirp signal whose oscillation frequency changes with time in a predetermined frequency band is input; a signal processing unit that includes a parallel circuit in which a plurality of band-pass filters that selectively pass signals having a center frequency different from each other in the frequency band are connected in parallel, and generates a plurality of response signals related to the center frequencies different from each other when a chirp signal is input to the parallel circuit via the input unit; and an output unit that outputs a response signal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Relay device
abstract_en: To provide a relay device capable of reducing a data communication amount required for updating update object information in a timely manner.SOLUTION: A relay device comprises: a control unit 21 which receives apparatus information about a housing apparatus 1 from the housing apparatus 1, and transmits the received apparatus information to a server 33 via an external communication network 32 by wireless communication of a volume-based charging system; and a storage unit 22 in which update object information which is information used for processing in the control unit 21, and may be updated is stored. title_en: Information processing program, information processing device, information processing method, printing program, printing device, and printing method
abstract_en: To provide a new method for presenting subscription to a printing service that provides consumable items consumed in printing on a printing device.SOLUTION: An information processing program causes a control unit of an information processing device to execute print processing and presentation processing. title_en: Mobile analysis system
abstract_en: To provide a mobile analysis system capable of improving detection accuracy for dynamic data on a moving body in a work site etc.SOLUTION: The present invention relates to a mobile analysis system that detects a moving body included in video data and then analyzes data related to the operation of the moving body, and the mobile analysis system comprises: a first camera which acquires first video data generated by taking a bird's-eye photograph of the moving body; a second camera which is mounted on the moving body and acquires second video data on a view from the moving body; an operation quantity estimation part which estimates an operation quantity of the moving body based upon the first video data; an operation estimation part which estimates operation details of the moving body of the second video data; and an operation analysis part which analyzes data related to the operation of the moving body based upon the operation quantity of the moving body obtained when it is estimated that operation details show that the moving body is moving.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Moving picture creating method

title_en: Aggregate quality estimation method, quality estimation program, aggregate quality estimation device, ready-mixed concrete manufacturing method, and ready-mixed concrete manufacturing system
abstract_en: To improve prediction accuracy when predicting quality by using a prediction model constructed by machine learning.SOLUTION: A quality prediction method of an aggregate includes a first acquisition step of acquiring color captured image data obtained by imaging an aggregate to be evaluated, a pre-processing step of generating input image data by gray-scaling the captured image data, a second acquisition step of acquiring input information including the input image data, a prediction step of acquiring a physical property value corresponding to input information acquired in the second acquisition step using a prediction model constructed in advance so as to output the physical property value of the aggregate according to an input of the input information, and a construction step of constructing the prediction model by machine learning based on training data. title_en: system

abstract_en: To provide a wireless tag communication device that performs warning processing when there is difficulty in reading or inference.SOLUTION: A wireless tag communication device according to an embodiment includes an antenna, a reading unit, and a warning unit. title_en: Acquisition method of image data used for determining appropriateness of dropping failure of scrap, and creation method of learned model using image data acquired by acquisition method
abstract_en: To provide an image data acquisition method capable of acquiring high-quality image data indicating a scrap falling failure, and a learning model creation method using the image data acquired by the acquisition method.SOLUTION: In the method for acquiring image data used for determining the propriety of the falling failure of scraps 72 generated from a workpiece 70 processed by a press die 52, a computer 11 simulates the operation of discharging a plurality of scraps 72 to the outside of the press die through a scrap chute 52. title_en: Hospital integrated logistics management system using ai technology and hospital integrated logistics management method using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated hospital logistics management system and an integrated hospital logistics management method using the same, which can maintain proper safe inventory levels at all times in accordance with an inventory quantity, an inventory state, a release quantity, etc. of an article of a hospital by allowing artificial intelligence to use big data to analyze a trend, a seasonal trend, etc. and predict actual usage through artificial intelligence technology to allow an artificial intelligence system to automatically process a reorder, an exchange product, etc. According to the present invention, the integrated hospital logistics management system comprises: an order processing module linked to a supplier providing an article of a hospital to process an order and reception of an article; a logistics management module to request a purchase or an exchange of an article in the hospital from the order processing module in accordance with the state of the article; and a system control module including a machine learning unit to generate and learn a rule about the operation of the article by using metadata and a control unit to control the logistics management module in accordance with the rule.

title_en: Yoke snapping testing device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for inspecting the presence/absence of a snap ring of a yoke. According to the present invention, a coupling member to which a yoke is detachably attached is installed on an upper surface of a moving plate, an inspection pedestal that moves a torque transmission member to the rear end of a yoke shaft is installed on the upper surface of the moving plate to move forward and backward, a pressure sensor that detects the pressure generated from the torque transmission member according to the presence or absence of a snap ring mounted on the yoke shaft is installed to be connected to a control unit, and the control unit installs and configures an alarm generator that generates an alarm sound according to a control signal of the control unit when no detection signal is received from the pressure sensor to be connected to the control unit, and eventually, it is possible to prevent in advance that the yoke on which a barcode is printed is not equipped with a snap ring that prevents the detachment of the torque transmission member, the reliability of the product can be improved since a snap ring is always attached to the yoke on which a barcode is printed, and it is possible to inspect whether a snap ring is mounted on the yoke shaft before a barcode is printed on the yoke or even after the barcode is printed, thereby increasing work efficiency.

title_en: Automatic robot measuring system for transit tunnel safety inspection
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automated diagnosis robot system for a railway tunnel safety inspection, capable of collecting state information from each inspection target and performing integrated management while autonomously driving on rails for a safety inspection on a railway tunnel. The automated diagnosis robot system includes: a tunnel wall inspector including a wall photographing camera, a tunnel shape measurer measuring a distance to a wall, and a wall inspection controller controlling the operation of the wall photographing camera and the tunnel shape measurer and converting collected information into wall abnormal-spot information as data; a railway rail inspector including a rail photographing camera, and a rail inspection controller controlling the operation of the railway rail inspector and converting collected information into rail abnormal-spot information as data; a roadbed inspector including a roadbed photographing camera, and a roadbed inspection controller controlling the operation of the roadbed photographing camera and converting collected information into roadbed abnormal-spot information as data; and a driver including a driving image camera, a detection sensor sensing an obstacle, a distance measurement module measuring a vector distance to the obstacle by analyzing collected information of the driving image camera or a sensed signal of the detection sensor, an area setting module determining setting an effective area which is a position range to be determined as an effective obstacle among placement positions of the obstacle sensed by the driving image camera, the detection sensor and the distance measurement module, and determining the effective obstacle, a driving control module generating a driving signal corresponding to a driving operation and generating a stop signal in accordance with a determination signal of the area setting module, and driving equipment controlling the operation of a driving part in accordance with the driving signal and the stop signal.

title_en: Method and apparatus for estimating road surface condition based on smart wheel sensor using machine-learning technique
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a method for estimating a road surface condition comprises the steps of: (a) collecting, by each smart wheel sensor located on each wheel side of a vehicle, predetermined wheel condition data, inputting the wheel condition data to a pre-trained machine learning model to estimate a first road surface condition value, and determining location data of the wheel at which each smart wheel sensor is located; (b) determining, by a road surface condition determination unit located on a body side of the vehicle, a final road surface condition value based on data collected from other sensors within the vehicle except for a wheel side and a first road surface condition value received from the smart wheel sensor; and (c) controlling, by a control unit of the vehicle, the braking and traveling of the vehicle according to the final road surface condition value received from the road surface condition determination unit. The present invention can prevent data loss which can occur during transmission.

title_en: Method of operating server calculating cbti type based on user's diagnosis of integrity competency and comparing calcuated cbti type for each user
abstract_en: A server operating method is disclosed. The server operating method according to the present disclosure includes the steps of: calculating numerical values for individual integrity knowledge and individual integrity attitude corresponding to individual integrity competency, and for job characteristics and departmental integrity culture corresponding to organizational integrity competency, based on user responses to a plurality of questions for evaluating an integrity perception index provided to a user terminal; determining a user's clean balance type indicator (CBTI) type related to the integrity perception index based on numerical information including numerical values for each item including individual integrity knowledge, individual integrity attitude, job characteristics, and departmental integrity culture; and providing a report including information on the determined CBTI type to the user.

title_en: Integration management system for apartment house electric equipment using IoT
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated management system for electrical equipment in an apartment housing using Internet of Things (IoT), which allows built-in outlets and multi-outlets among electric equipment installed or used in an apartment housing to be safely and effectively managed, wherein built-in outlets of each unit within the apartment housing are connected to a management office based on Internet of Things (IoT) technology, enabling integrated safety management of the built-in outlets and the multi-outlets connected thereto. The integrated management system for electrical equipment in an apartment housing using Internet of Things (IoT) according to the present invention comprises a database server, built-in outlets, a QR code reader, a QR code display unit, a communication module, an integrated management server, multi-outlets, a second QR code reader, a first short-range wireless communication module, and a second short-range wireless communication module.

title_en: System for Short-term Photovoltaic Power Prediction
abstract_en: The present invention comprises: a solar radiation amount prediction unit for measuring a cloud amount from an artificial satellite image and a cheongcheon image at a specific time point in a specific area including a position of a solar power plant, and predicting a short-term solar radiation amount at a short-term prediction time point from the specific time point by using the cloud amount; and a power generation amount prediction unit for predicting a short-term power generation amount of the solar power plant based on solar power plant information of the solar power plant and weather information including the short-term solar radiation amount.

title_en: Document collecting method, document collecting system, and computer program for the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a document collection method, a document collection system, and a computer program therefor. According to an aspect of the present invention, disclosed are a document collection method, a document collection system, and a computer program therefor, which collect a document provided by a web server using a crawler, determine whether to classify the document as a document collection target using the document downloaded in a temporary directory, and perform metadata analysis and standardized data generation of the document according to the result, thereby improving the efficiency of document collection.

title_en: Methods and systems for matching and recommending human resources by analyzing individual competencies and mbti tendencies based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and system for matching and recommending human resources by analyzing individual competencies and MBTI tendencies based on artificial intelligence, which can match and recommend optimal customized human resources required by a company by analyzing the results of MBTI tendency analysis of job seekers and the types of excellent human resources preferred by the company using an artificial intelligence algorithm.

title_en: Display device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a display device capable of preventing a folding area from being bent. According to the present invention, the display device comprises: a display module; a first support part and a second support part arranged in a first direction and disposed below the display module; a plurality of spacers disposed between the first and second support parts; a third support part and a fourth support part disposed below the first and second support parts, respectively; a plurality of hinge parts connected to the third and fourth support parts; a plurality of sliding units disposed in openings defined in the third and fourth support parts and connected to the first and second support parts; and a plurality of elastic units defined in the third and fourth support parts and disposed in guide grooves extending from the openings in the first direction toward the outside of the third and fourth support parts.

title_en: Electronic device including display
abstract_en: According to various embodiments of the present invention, an electronic device capable of preventing a danger of scattering due to damage to a window layer of a glass material and saving costs. The electronic device includes: a housing; a flexible display; and a camera device. The flexible display, which is exposed to the outside of the electronic device in a first direction through at least a portion of the housing, includes: a display panel including a first opening; a window layer stacked on the top surface of the display panel; a first protective layer including a first material stacked on the top surface of the first window layer; and a second protective layer including a second material stacked on the top surface of the first protective layer. The camera device is disposed to be substantially aligned with the first opening. When the flexible display is viewed in the first direction, the second protective layer includes a delamination part, which overlaps with a viewing angle of the camera device and which is disposed to be separated from the second protective layer. Besides, various embodiments are possible.

title_en: Electronic device and method for controlling the same
abstract_en: Provided is an electronic device comprising: an input/output interface; and one or more processors that output a constraint condition for the user authentication information through the input/output interface, determine the characteristics of a user input based on the user authentication information inputted based on the constraint condition, and output, through the input/output interface, the constraint condition for the user authentication information updated based on the determined characteristics of the user input. Therefore, an objective of the present invention is to provide the electronic device capable of receiving a consistent user input.

title_en: Electronic apparatus and control method thereof
abstract_en: An electronic apparatus is disclosed. The electronic apparatus includes: a communication interface; a memory in which information for correcting a signal received from each of other electronic apparatuses is stored; and a processor which is connected to the memory and the communication interface to control the electronic apparatus. The processor can control the communication interface to communicate with one other electronic apparatus operating as a soft access point; identify, when a signal is received from one other electronic apparatus through the communication interface, the other electronic apparatus, which has transmitted a signal, of the other electronic apparatuses based on the received signal; and correct the received signal based on correction information corresponding to the other electronic apparatus, of the information stored in the memory.

title_en: Electronic device having rollable display and display method thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed is an electronic device comprising: a display; a display movement part that controls the display to change a size of the display area viewable to the outside of the electronic device; and a processor. The display can be expanded by being rolled out from a center part of the display, and can be reduced by being rolled to the center part. In addition to thereof, various embodiments are possible. Therefore, the present invention is capable of increasing a flexibility of a rollable display.

title_en: Fingerprint authentication device, display device including the same, and method for authenticatiing fingerprint of display device
abstract_en: A fingerprint authentication device comprises: a biometric sensor generating a detection signal by detecting biometric information; a singular point determination unit selecting at least one piece of fingerprint from the biometric information and determining a singular point of an image including biometric information detected by analyzing the at least one piece of fingerprint; an image processing unit generating a fingerprint image from the detection signal and extracting an interested region including a singular point from the fingerprint image based on a coordinate of the singular point; and an authentication unit performing fingerprint authentication by comparing the interested region and registered fingerprint information.

title_en: Filter and Method with Multiplication Operation Approximation Capability
abstract_en: Disclosed is a filter. The filter comprises: at least one first multiplication approximation unit for approximating at least one first multiplication operation corresponding to at least one first coefficient, and with at least one first bit-wise shift operation; and at least one second multiplication approximation unit for approximating with at least one second multiplication operation corresponding to the at least one second coefficient, and with a plurality of second bit-wise shift operations and at least one addition operation.

title_en: System for alarming defect reception
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for alarming a defect in a building, which is able to notify the reception of a defect in real time. According to an aspect of the present invention, the system for alarming a defect in the building comprises: a core keyword selection unit classifying past defect data by type and selecting a core keyword for each type; a new defect data pre-processing unit which, when a new defect data including a core keyword of a specific type is received, extracts past defect data of a similar type to the new defect data or past defect data including a similar core keyword, and analyzes the extracted past defect data and the received new defect data, and extracts peripheral words related to the core keyword of the specific type; and an image creation unit visualizing the core keyword of the specific type and the peripheral words, and creating an image.

title_en: Electronic device for converting the electronic document to the knowledge data document and the operating method thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed are an electronic device for converting an electronic document into a knowledge data document and an operating method thereof. According to the present invention, the electronic device and the operating method thereof, if a command of conversion into a knowledge data document for a prescribed electronic document is applied from a user, convert the electronic document into a web document having a markup language-based format, then select important keywords in the web document, check information of entities inserted into the web document, generate a summary for the web document, then generate a javascript object notation (JSON) format-based knowledge data document file including data for the summary, the information of the entities, the important keywords, and the body of the web document, and display the body of a document, the important keywords, the information of the entities, and the summary on a single screen if the knowledge data document file is subsequently executed by a user to support to allow a user to check a variety of information for the electronic document at a glance.

title_en: Software application license management of camera device through mediation device
abstract_en: A program license management method disclosed by the present invention comprises the steps of: receiving an authentication request from a mediation device; transmitting a request message for requesting the installation of an application from a server to the authenticated mediation device after the mediation device is authenticated successfully, wherein the request message includes the device identification information of a camera device; receiving signature information and application data from the mediation device; performing license verification including determination of whether the signature information includes the device identification information and whether the signature information performed by the server is valid; and installing the application data if the license verification is successful.

title_en: Apparatus and method for re-sampling of point cloud using point charge repulsion force model
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a device and method for re-extracting a point cloud using a point charge repulsive force model. Modeling each point constituting the initial point cloud for a three-dimensional object with a predetermined point charge is possible. It is possible to move each point based on repulsive force applied to each point and re-extract point cloud according to movement of each point.

title_en: Method and apparatus for providing home cafe contents in multiple languages
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present disclosure, a method of providing home cafe content supporting multiple languages comprises: a step of receiving a first user input selecting a coffee menu; a step of outputting a lecture image associated with a recipe of the coffee menu composed of a first language on a lecture screen among the entire screens of a display device based on the first user input by a controlling unit; a step of a step of responding to a second user input for a learning menu, outputting the stored learning content matched with the lecture image in a first language on a learning content screen of the entire screen by the controlling unit; a step of outputting supplementary learning content matched with the lecture image and learning content in the first language on a supplementary learning content screen of the entire screen while the lecture image is being reproduced by the controlling unit; and a step of responding to a third user input for the supplementary-learning menu and outputting a sub-content to the supplementary learning content screen by the controlling unit such that the sub-content composed of the second language amplifies the supplementary learning content. According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, a user can receive feedback in real-time from an instructor such as a professional barista or another user while watching the lecture image of the instructor.

title_en: Method for on-device android malware detection using transfer learning based adaptive model, recording medium and device for performing the method
abstract_en: An on-device android malicious code detection method based on an adaptive model through transfer learning comprises the steps of: determining whether an application is malicious or not preferred in a list of applications installed in a device; decompiling, in the device, the APK of the application installed in the device; generating a head model in a server and transmitting the determined list and the decompiled APK file to the server so that the head model can be used for transfer learning with a base model; analyzing a malicious code in the device using the transfer learning model received from the server for an application newly installed in the device; and providing a malicious code analysis result to a user through the device. Accordingly, since malicious code analysis is performed on the device, availability and real-time performance that enables analysis even outside a network range are guaranteed.

title_en: Data collection and provision system for offline stores
abstract_en: The present invention comprises: a connection unit which is for connection with a depth camera installed in a store and a terminal; a moving line producing unit which receives a depth image for a store where a customer is located from the depth camera, compares the depth image with a pre-stored store image data, and produces a moving line of the customer from a location of the customer in the store; a product information input unit which receives locations of products in the store and relevant data input from the terminal of the store, and receives questions on products and survey data provided from the customer; a contact product extracting unit which extracts a label image of a product contacted by the customer in the store from the image provided by the depth camera, compares the extracted label image with relevant data of products having the product information input unit received by image processing, and extracts relevant data of products contacted by the customer; a preference calculation unit which counts time during which the customer contacts the product and calculates preference results in proportion to the contact time; and a preference data providing unit which uses artificial intelligence to process moving line data of a customer produced by the moving line producing unit, product questions and survey data provided to the product information input unit, the preference result calculated by the preference calculation unit and relevant data of the preference-targeted product extracted by the contact product extracting unit as desirable formats and provides terminals of predetermined manufacturers or sellers with the processed data. The purpose of the present invention is to increase the efficiency of production placement and store management, meet various needs of customers, and contribute to increase sales.

title_en: Monitoring system and monitoring method of construction machinery
abstract_en: A monitoring system for a construction machine according to exemplary embodiments for achieving the purpose of the present invention may include: a plurality of cameras for taking images of the surroundings of the construction machine; an image processing device for recognizing a moving object in the image taken by the cameras and storing the image when the object enters within a preset distance from the construction machine; and a wireless communication device for transmitting the stored image to the server.

title_en: Electronic device including pocket clip structure for supporting component
abstract_en: An electronic apparatus according to an embodiment comprises: a housing including a through-hole, which is formed on the outside, and a resting portion, which is connected to the through-hole and into which an electronic pen is inserted via the through-hole; a cover surrounding at least a portion of the resting portion; and a cantilever disposed on the resting portion and including an elastic portion that extends so as to increase in distance from the cover along the direction of insertion of the electronic pen. In the cantilever, while the electronic pen is inserted into the housing, by pressing the electronic pen through another part of the cantilever that is in contact with the electronic pen while being supported by one side of the cover that is in contact with one part of the cantilever, the electronic pen inserted into the housing is fixed. In addition, various embodiments are possible.

title_en: Twofold semi-automatic symbolic propagation method of training data for natural language understanding model, and device therefor
abstract_en: The present invention is intended to provide a method for double augmentation of learning data for a natural language understanding model and a device for performing the same. A method for double augmentation of learning data for a natural language understanding model is provided. The method is configured to analyze the intent of input data containing text. The method comprises the steps of: obtaining the input data including text for at least one domain; removing noise from the input data and preprocessing the input data; analyzing morphemes and conjugated-type lemmas of the preprocessed data based on lexical units and tagmemes; generating first learning data by labeling the analysis data by sequence based on a database prepared for each entity name, feature word, event, and discourse; generating second learning data by generating a new sequence including at least one of the entity name, the feature word, the event, and the discourse element based on the database; and constructing double augmented learning data by integrating the first data and the second data.

title_en: Non-destructive inspection systems and methods for DPF
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a non-destructive inspection system and method for a DPF. The non-destructive inspection system for a DPF comprises: an X-ray generation part for radiating X-rays toward a diesel particulate filter (DPF) installed below a vehicle; an image plate coated with a photostimulable phosphor, absorbing the X-rays transmitted through the DPF to store the same as energy, and formed of a flexible material; a CR reader for obtaining DPF image data by radiating radiated light to the image plate and receiving and processing reactive light emitted from the image plate; and a determination part for determining whether the DPF is damaged by performing the machine learning of the DPF image data provided from the CR reader. Therefore, provided are a non-destructive inspection system and method for the early detection of damage to a DPF using an image plate and a CR reader.

title_en: Memory cell with temperature modulated read voltage
abstract_en: An integrated chip has a semiconductor substrate and a memory cell array disposed on a driver circuit. The driver circuit provides a read voltage that changes in relation to an approximate temperature of the memory array to the array to improve temperature subordination of a read current. The driver circuit may change the read voltage in inverse proportion to the temperature. The read voltage may be changed continuously or stepwise, and the driver circuit may use a table lookup. The driver circuit optionally measures a current and modulates the read voltage until the current is within a target range. The memory cell may be a multi-level phase change memory cell including a plurality of phase change elements disposed between a lower electrode and an upper electrode. Modulating the read voltage to reduce a temperature-subordinate current change is particularly useful for multi-level cells.

title_en: Apparatus and method for retrieving image
abstract_en: Disclosed are an apparatus and a method for retrieving an image. The image retrieval method is an image retrieval method performed by a processor of an image retrieval device. The method comprises the steps of: training a generative adversarial network (GAN) using pre-prepared artifact images; deriving vectors matching the features of the artifact images through the trained GAN; extracting principal component vectors by applying principal component analysis (PCA) to the vectors derived using a vector space composed of the derived vectors; generating control items corresponding to the principal component vectors; receiving values for each control item generated by a user; generating a target image using the trained GAN according to the received values of the control items; receiving a confirmation signal from the user for the generated target image; and retrieving and providing similar images based on the target image for which the confirmation signal was received. The present invention can increase retrieval accuracy using images.

title_en: A high-speed search method for similar images in a video and a server that performs the method.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a high-speed search for similar images in a video. More specifically, provided are a method and server capable of measuring similarity more precisely using the fingerprint technique, which may remove unnecessary data by first performing a preprocessing step to reduce the number of frames in order to minimize target resources when extracting similar images from a video.

title_en: Electronic apparatus and controlling method thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed is an electronic device. The electronic device comprises: a memory that stores a cooking history and recipe information corresponding to each of a plurality of cooking objects; and a processor that identifies a cooking object corresponding to acquired identification information among the plurality of cooking objects when identification information for the cooking object is acquired, identifies the cooking history corresponding to cooking setting information among a plurality of cooking histories stored in the memory when cooking setting information corresponding to a user input is acquired, and acquires a cooking prediction result corresponding to the identified cooking history and provides information for the acquired cooking prediction result. Therefore, the present invention is capable of providing the electronic device that cooks the cooking object.

title_en: Image processing method, apparatus, and vehicle comprising the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an image processing method, an apparatus, and a vehicle including the same, which may train a deep learning model centering on a vulnerable point of the model. The image processing method comprises: acquiring image information; inputting ground truth; inputting the image information into an object recognition model to output recognition information including a location and type of an object included in the image information; generating misrecognition data based on the output recognition information and the ground truth; generating a vulnerable pattern map of the object recognition model based on the processing of the misrecognition data; and classifying a vulnerable database based on the vulnerable pattern map and at least one pre-stored image information.

title_en: How to provide customized real-time store information
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for providing customized real-time store information. According to an aspect of the present invention, the method for providing customized real-time store information includes: a product notification step of indicating that a product including position information exists on a screen; a position information indicating step of indicating the position information on a store selling the product or a related product; and a product list indicating step of indicating information about the product which is sold in the store. A content providing step may include a position recognition code combination step of combining a position recognition code indicating a kind of the product with a frame. According to the present invention, the method for providing customized real-time store information provides a user with the information about the product and the position of the adjacent store when a user wants to buy an article shown on the screen while the user watches a video. Therefore, the method for providing customized real-time store information enables the user to easily buy the product through the screen while watching a broadcast.

title_en: System for providing location based subway route list automatic alignment service
abstract_en: Provided is a system for providing a location-based subway favorite list automatic alignment service comprising: a user terminal that designates and saves a moving path comprising a departure station or an arrival station of a subway as a favorite, and lists a result wherein a favorite list is automatically aligned based on a current location after agreeing to provide location information; and an automatic alignment service providing server comprising an archive part comprising the moving path in the favorite list, when designating the moving path comprising the departure station or the arrival station of the subway as the favorite in the user terminal, and an automatic alignment part that aligns the favorite list so that the moving path that starts from a station located at the shortest distance based on a walking distance wherein the current location of the user terminal is from the current location of the user terminal is disposed on an upper-end, when agreeing to provide location information in the user terminal. Therefore, the present invention is capable of minimizing manual operation or touch of a user.

title_en: Electronic terminal apparatus that supports to perform dictation practice based on the sentence for dictation practice and the operating method thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed are an electronic terminal device and an operating method thereof. The present invention proposes an electronic terminal device and an operation method thereof for supporting to perform dictation practice based on a sentence for dictation practice, thereby supporting a user to improve spelling and floating skills more quickly.

title_en: Battary data processing device and operating method of the same
abstract_en: A data processing device according to one embodiment of the present invention may include: a first controller which selects a first raw data group from a raw data storage, stores a first copy data group corresponding to the first raw data group in a buffer storage, and deletes the first raw data group of the raw data storage if the first copy data group is stored in the buffer storage; a first loader which receives the first copy data group from the buffer storage, stores a first storage data group corresponding to the first copy data group in a database, and deletes the first copy data group of the buffer storage if the first storage data group is stored in the database; and a monitor unit which monitors the buffer storage to determine whether the first copy data group is processed.

title_en: Apparutus and Method of Detecting Thickness
abstract_en: A thickness measuring device, according to the present invention, includes: an imaging unit arranged on an inspection substrate including a substrate, a pattern, and an inspection layer, and outputting inspection image data; and a data calculating unit that receives the inspection image data and calculates a thickness value of the inspection layer from the inspection image data. The imaging unit is positioned at a fixed angle relative to the inspection substrate. Since the data calculating unit calculates the thickness value of the inspection layer using the coordinate values of the pattern from the inspection image data, the processing of thickness measurement is simplified and the cost required for thickness measurement can be reduced.

title_en: Anomaly detection system and method based on classifying time series type
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for detecting an abnormality based on time series type classification and, more specifically, to a system and a method for detecting an abnormality based on time series type classification, which train an artificial intelligence model with various types of time series data and detect an abnormality of time series data collected through the trained artificial intelligence model.

title_en: Artificial intelligence human body detection device with enhanced personal information protection
abstract_en: An artificial intelligence human body detection device with enhanced personal information protection according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: an image camera (1) for generating image data by photographing a boundary area; a thermal motion detection unit (2) for detecting thermal motion in the boundary area; a central processing unit (5) for analyzing the image data to analyze whether an object in the image has a human shape, to analyze whether the object is inanimate, to determine thermal motion, to determine coordinate movement in accordance with the object movement, and to convert a posture state into a sign combination when it is determined that the object is a human being; and a communication unit (12) for transmitting the sign combination to a security manager.

title_en: Method and Apparatus for Providing Corporate Reputation Information
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and an apparatus for providing corporate reputation information. according to an embodiment of the present invention, the method and the apparatus for providing corporate reputation information provide corporate reputation information by converting internal data and external data related to a company into a collected processable form and extracting corporate feature information by analyzing, managing, and predicting transactions between companies based on big data through intelligent learning.

title_en: Method for making control flow graph based on autosar platform and system using the same
abstract_en: A method for creating a control flow graph based on an AUTOSAR platform of the present invention comprises the steps of: identifying a plurality of components included in design data; generating a plurality of nodes corresponding to each of the plurality of components; and generating an edge forming a connection relationship of the nodes based on a correlation between the plurality of components.

title_en: Memory device and scheduling method thereof
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a memory device comprises: a request register for receiving a first signal including a requester identifier from a host using a first protocol, and outputting a first priority corresponding to the requester identifier; a checker module for receiving a second signal including a command and a request type from the host using a second protocol different from the first protocol, receiving the first priority from the request register, and determining a second priority of the command based on the first priority and the request type; a command generator for generating an internal command for a memory operation from the command; and a memory controller for scheduling the internal command based on the second priority.

title_en: Memory connection system and memory connection method for acceleration of operation
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a memory connection system for accelerating artificial neural network operations, including: an application processor for executing an application that performs artificial neural network operations; and an FPGA (field programmable gate array) accelerator that accelerates the artificial neural network operation speed, including a computational unit that performs the artificial neural network operations. The application processor and the FPGA accelerator are connected based on PCIe (Peripheral Component Interconnect Exchange) communication. Therefore, it is possible to access the hardware accelerator without applying a separate compiler or library for allocating and arranging operations to the hardware accelerator in a code written in a standard programming language, and it is also possible to reduce the difficulty of code writing by a programmer since it is unnecessary to modify the code of an application for artificial neural network operations or to write dedicated code dependent on the hardware accelerator.

title_en: Method and electronic device for processing text input based on user input signal to external electronic device
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present disclosure, a method for processing, by an electronic device, a text input based on a user input signal for an external electronic device comprises: a step of outputting a keyboard interface comprising areas representing a plurality of key groups on a display of the electronic device; a step of receiving a first control signal corresponding to a first user input signal from the external electronic device; a step of identifying at least one key group among the plurality of key groups as a target group based on the first control signal; a step of receiving a second control signal corresponding to a second user input signal from the external electronic device; a step of identifying at least one key element among a plurality of key elements included in the target group as a target element based on the second control signal; and a step of processing an input operation for the target element.

title_en: Electronic device comprising buttonless key, method and non transitory computer readable recording medium for controlling the same
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a user interface (ui) corresponding to a multi-display and an electronic device for supporting the operation thereof. An electronic device includes: a first housing; a second housing rotatably connected to one side of the first housing; a third housing rotatably connected to the other side of the first housing; a flexible display including a first display area of the first housing, a second display area of the second housing, and a third display area of the third housing; a first sensor for sensing an angle between the first housing and the second housing; a second sensor for sensing an angle between the second housing and the third housing; an input unit including a touch sensor and a pressure sensor for sensing a user's input; and at least one processor operatively connected to the flexible display, the first sensor, the second sensor, and the input unit.

title_en: Wired remote controller and power-saving method thereof
abstract_en: A wired remote controller is disclosed. A wired remote controller comprises: a display panel; a wired interface connected to an indoor unit in a wired manner; a memory storing information on power capacity for each indoor unit model; and a processor receiving power from the indoor unit through the wired interface and communicating with the indoor unit through the wired interface. The processor receives information on power consumption of the indoor unit through the wired interface, identifies power capacity corresponding to the indoor unit from the memory, and adjusts luminance of the display panel based on the identified power capacity and the received power consumption of the indoor unit.

title_en: Operation method of 3d random access memory including select transisor
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method for operating a three-dimensional random access memory including a selection transistor. According to embodiments, a method for operating a three-dimensional random access memory can prevent a memory operation for a memory cell corresponding to a selected gate electrode among memory cells of an unselected vertical structure from occurring by applying a first voltage having at least a partial value of an operating voltage to a horizontal portion of a selected bit line, applying a second voltage having a polarity opposite to that of the first voltage and having a remaining partial value of the operating voltage to a selected gate electrode, or applying a pass voltage having a half value of the operating voltage to an unselected gate electrode.

title_en: Method and Apparatus for Calibrating by Using Input-Output Distribution of Neighboring Layer
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a calibration method and apparatus using an input/output distribution of an adjacent layer. According to an aspect of the present disclosure, provided is a calibration method comprising: an operation process of generating a first operation result in an operation layer of an artificial neural network; a calibration process of obtaining a first effective input range by using information of another layer adjacent to the operation layer; a first quantization process of generating a first quantization result by quantizing the first operation result based on the first effective input range; and an activation process of generating a first activation output by inputting the first quantization result to the first activation function.

title_en: Method and system for providing review data
abstract_en: In order to solve the above-described problems, a method for providing review data according to the present invention may include the steps of: receiving review data for a plurality of products included in a specific product group; obtaining numerical information of each of a plurality of different review items for the plurality of products using the review data; and displaying a graphic object corresponding to each of the plurality of products in a matrix area based on the numerical information.

title_en: A Method for preparing transcriptome library and method for analyzing transcriptome using the same
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a transcriptome analysis method that can be performed in a single reaction unit and allows for the omission of purification processes between each step, thereby significantly reducing the labor, time, and cost of building an NGS library and facilitating large-scale transcriptome profiling and drug screening experiments.

title_en: Apparatus and method for recognizing sketch
abstract_en: Disclosed are an apparatus and a method for recognizing a sketch.
