An embodiment of the invention adapts an electronic presentation in real-time so that the graphics, language (words, sentences, paragraphs etc.), and overall structure of the work becomes dynamic and responsive to the context of individual users, rather than operating as a static object. In one particular example, delivering personalized text and visuals on electronic devices may entail three technology system components: a machine-learning or artificial intelligence (AI) platform; a display program, and a computing device comprising a display.

title_en: Event presentation system and event presentation method
abstract_en: In an event presentation system 100, a product storage unit 64 stores information on purchase purposes input by past purchasers of exercise-related products. An event storage unit 68 stores exercise-related event schedule information and information on participation purposes input by past participants of exercise-related events. A purchase information acquisition unit 55 acquires information indicating purchase of a product by an interested buyer. A purpose acquisition unit 57 acquires information on a purpose of purchasing the product by the interested buyer. A relation analysis unit 56 determines, as a recommended event, an exercise-related event corresponding to a participation purpose related to the purchase purpose of the interested buyer. An event presentation unit 58 presents, to the interested buyer, the determined recommended event as an exercise-related event related to the purchase purpose of the interested buyer.

title_en: Operation support apparatus and method for energy storage system
abstract_en: An operation support apparatus, according to an embodiment of the present invention, is an operation support apparatus for an energy storage system and may comprise at least one processor, and a memory storing at least one instruction that is executed by the at least one processor. The at least one instruction may include the instructions of: collecting information about batteries that can be applied to the energy storage system; deriving, on the basis of the structure of the energy storage system, a plurality of combinations, each including one or more batteries that can be applied to the energy storage system; calculating an operating cost of the energy storage system for each of the combinations; and generating recommended combination information including information about a combination that, among the combinations, represents the minimum operating cost.

title_en: Systems and methods for increased efficiency and reliability of contactless card transactions
abstract_en: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR INCREASED EFFICIENCY AND RELIABILITY OF CONTACTLESS CARD TRANSACTIONS Example embodiments of systems and methods for performing a transaction involving a transmitting device and a receiving device. A state machine may be configured to monitor the data communications, data reads, and data writes performed between the transmitting device and the receiving device. In the event of a disruption during the transaction, the state machine may allow the transaction to resume following the most recent data communication, data read, or data write once the disruption is resolved. CONTACTLESS CARD TRANSACTIONS

title_en: System and method for processing an interaction request and an interaction response
abstract_en: A method and system are provided for processing an interaction response of a request service provider. The method includes detecting the interaction response for a first interaction session using a first interaction channel, determining a task associated with the interaction response, and obtaining context data of a plurality of other interaction sessions. The context data is related to activity of the request initiator. The method also includes associating a subset of the context data that is related to the task with the interaction response and modifying the interaction response using the subset of the context data. A method and system are also provided for processing an interaction request using context data.

title_en: Systems and methods for predicting operational events
abstract_en: A system and method for predicting operational loss events in transactions using artificial intelligence modeling. The system and method include receiving, by one or more processors, a request for a risk score associated with an organization; applying, by the one or more processors, a scoring dataset to a risk predictive model that is trained with a training dataset causing the risk predictive model to generate one or more risk scores based on the scoring data, the one or more risk scores indicative of a probability for an operational loss event to occur responsive to a transaction by the organization; and sending, by the one or more processors, a message that includes the one or more risk scores to a client device.

title_en: Findr
abstract_en: An application platform that allows users to post a specific job with the parameters of a detailed photo of job required, size of location that user would go to get the service requested and date of availability.  The service providers that fit the parameters input by the user would be notified of the job and post a bid. lf the service provider is outbid, they are notified to glve the opportunity for them to outbid the last bid. The agreed upon service is then paid for via the app after service is provided and service provider must be rated using a 5-star systern. This platform allows clients (the users) and service providers to connect, est.ablish a negotiated price for services and make payment for this service.

title_en: Systems and methods for health education, certification, and recordation
abstract_en: Method 700 may include obtaining 702, at server 110, a user input from a user interface. The user input may define interval 212 for a desired CPR certification schedule. Method 700 may include generating 704, at server 110, CPR certification program 200. Generating 704 CPR certification program 200 may include generating at least two task groups 222. Each task group 222 of the at least two task groups 222 may include a healthcare certification task 228. Method 700 may include administering, at server 110, CPR certification program 200. Administering CPR certification program 200 may include assigning 706, at interval 212 defined by the user input, one task group 222 of the at least two task groups 222 to a user enrolled in CPR certification program 200, and receiving 708 an indication that the enrolled user has completed healthcare certification task 228 of the assigned one task group 222.

title_en: Transportable refrigerated container and method of distribution of perishable goods
abstract_en: A transportable refrigerated container is disclosed that has an interior chamber sub- divided into separate compartments by movable partitions that allow free air circulation to maintain the compartments at the same temperature and a plurality of security doors in at least one of the sides of the container, each door affording access only to a selected respective compartment or group of compartments. A method of distributing perishable goods from a supply depot to a plurality of customers is also disclosed that utilizes such a container. In the method, at the supply depot, goods for different customers are loaded into separate compartments and the container is then transported to a location convenient to all the customer. There, delivery drivers who can each only open a door leading to a compartment containing goods intended for a specific customer, transfer the goods from the compartment onto a smaller vehicle and deliver them to their respective customer.

title_en: Double-code anti-counterfeiting bottle cap and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The double-code anti-counterfeiting bottle cap comprises an encrypted information two-dimensional code and an anti-counterfeiting inquiry two-dimensional code, wherein the information encrypted code is arranged outside the bottle cap, the anti-counterfeiting inquiry two-dimensional code is arranged inside the bottle cap, the encrypted information two-dimensional code is associated with a product information management platform, a client scanning end for scanning the encrypted information two-dimensional code is a mobile phone or a two-dimensional code scanner, the anti-counterfeiting inquiry two-dimensional code is associated with a computer identification system, and the computer identification system is associated with the product information management platform. In addition, the anti-counterfeiting inquiry two-dimensional code can only enter a computer identification system when corresponding to the encrypted information two-dimensional code, so that enterprises need to copy the encrypted information two-dimensionally, and the counterfeiting cost is further increased.

title_en: Management method and equipment for driver order taking
abstract_en: The invention discloses a management method and equipment for driver order taking, which are used for providing a safer method for managing driver order taking and improving the safety of passenger users in taxi taking. The method provided by the invention comprises the following steps: receiving taxi calling information sent by passengers, wherein the taxi calling information comprises: boarding location information and destination information of the passenger; sending the taxi calling information to drivers in a preset range according to the taxi getting-on place information; receiving an order receiving request sent by the driver, wherein the order receiving request comprises: fingerprint information input by the driver; acquiring a matching result of matching the fingerprint information input by the driver with the fingerprint authentication information recorded in a fingerprint authentication database; and if the matching result is successful, sending order-receiving success information to the driver and sending the order-receiving information of the driver to the passenger.

title_en: Establishment method and device of collection channel and collection method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for establishing a collection channel, a collection method and a device, wherein the method and the device establish a signing collection channel corresponding to signing information by receiving the input signing information, and respectively establish the signing collection channel corresponding to the signing information aiming at different signing information when a receiver inputs a plurality of different signing information, and establish the association between a receiver account and the signing information as well as between the receiver account and the signing collection channel, so that the receiver can realize collection through different collection channels according to the self requirement by signing at one time. Compared with the prior art that a user needs to sign agreements with a plurality of banks respectively to realize the mode of collecting money from different paying parties, the method and the system realize the integration of a plurality of money collecting channels through one-time signing and are used by the user, and the user can select different money collecting channels to collect money for different paying parties without cooperation of the user and the plurality of banks. The operation is simple, and the workload of the user is reduced.

title_en: Method and device for increasing block generation speed
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for improving block generation speed, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when the block stores data, transaction information is stored in a database, and the hash value is stored in the block; establishing an index relation between the hash value and transaction information in the database; and when the true existence of the transaction information is verified, downloading the transaction information to be verified for verification according to the index relation. The invention reduces the transaction information confirmation event, improves the block generation speed and further realizes the purpose of improving the transaction efficiency of the block chain network.

title_en: Energy management system and method
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to energy management systems and methods. The method for energy management comprises the steps of: collecting data during a time period; identifying a data cluster within the data; classifying the data clusters in the time period; analyzing the data cluster; and assigning the classification to the time period. The real-time data may be compared to the performance of the schedule. In cases where energy is used inefficiently, real-time notifications may be provided to the user. The energy efficiency of meters within a site may be ranked to identify meters in which energy is being inefficiently used. A system for performing the methods of the present disclosure is also provided.

title_en: Biometric pattern control method and related product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a biological recognition mode control method and a related product. The method comprises the following steps: determining a reference biometric pattern of the mobile terminal; when the reference biological identification mode is started, acquiring a target working strategy of a preset light source corresponding to the reference identification mode; and controlling the preset light source to work according to the target working strategy. The embodiment of the invention is beneficial to improving the flexibility and the safety of the mobile terminal for controlling the biological recognition mode.

title_en: Reservoir bank collapse prediction method based on third-equal-fourth-order method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir bank collapse prediction method based on a third-class and fourth-class classification method. Measuring the terrain section of the bank slope under the current situation; dividing the type of the bank slope geological structure and drawing a geological profile; determining a bank slope stable slope angle after water storage of the reservoir; drawing a stable slope shape predicted by reservoir bank collapse; determining the relative slope angle and the like; and determining the grade of the difficulty degree of bank collapse. The defects that the actual collapse width after reservoir water storage is often inconsistent with the prediction result or even greatly different from the actual collapse width after reservoir water storage in the prior art, the collapse prediction result is uncontrollable and the collapse prediction width is large due to excessive consideration of influence factors are overcome; the method has the advantages of simplicity, practicability, strong operability and accurate and reliable landslide prediction result.

title_en: Service guiding method, device, system, server and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, a system, a server and an electronic device for guiding service, wherein a specific implementation mode of the method comprises the following steps: acquiring current business information and positioning information of a service provider as reference information; determining a target guiding event aiming at the service according to the reference information; and executing corresponding voice service guide operation based on the target guide event. The implementation method can perform service guiding operation on the service provider in a voice mode in the process of providing the service by the service provider, thereby not only improving the service efficiency, but also ensuring the safety of the service provider.

title_en: Method, system and storage medium for identifying a customer in a transaction via facial recognition
abstract_en: Merchants and users register with a payment processing system that establishes facial templates based on user images. The user logs into a payment application via a user computing device that receives an identifier from a merchant beacon device to send to the payment processing system. The payment processing system sends facial templates to the merchant point-of-sale device for the user and for other users who are also logged into the payment application within range of the merchant beacon device. The merchant POS device determines whether it has a threshold number of face templates and may request and receive additional face templates from the payment processing system to reach the threshold. The merchant POS operator selects a face template corresponding to the user. The merchant POS device sends transaction details to the payment processing system, which processes the transaction with the issuer system.

title_en: Logistics traceability system-based vehicle-mounted terminal and logistics traceability method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle-mounted terminal based on a logistics tracing system and a logistics tracing method thereof, wherein the vehicle-mounted terminal based on the logistics tracing system comprises: the intelligent navigation device comprises a shell and a substrate arranged inside the shell, wherein an MCU (micro controller Unit) is arranged on the substrate, and the Beidou combined positioning navigation module, the NB-IOT wireless communication module, the ZIGBEE wireless communication module and the power management module are integrated with a satellite positioning unit and an inertial positioning unit, and are integrated with a 4G communication unit, and the MCU is connected with a CAN/IO interface and a Beidou communication machine interface. The Beidou combined positioning navigation module realizes multimode positioning, supports GNSS satellite positioning, carries out interactive data transmission with the central monitoring server through various communication channels, displays the position of the vehicle in real time after the central monitoring server receives positioning information of the vehicle-mounted terminal, stores the running track of the vehicle and plays back the historical track. For important vehicles, such as dangerous vehicles or alarming vehicles, real-time tracking can be set and carried out on the vehicle-mounted terminal.

title_en: Marketing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marketing system, comprising: the advertisement gift demand end, the sharing platform, the advertisement gift supply end, the advertisement gift release channel, the consumer end and the logistics end; the advertisement gift demand end is used for providing the characteristic information of the advertisement to be distributed to the sharing platform; the advertisement gift supply end is used for providing the advertisement gift attribute information to the sharing platform; the sharing platform is used for matching the advertisement gift attribute information with the advertisement feature information to be distributed and forming a matching result; the advertisement gift release channel is used for matching the attribute information of the advertisement gift with the attribute information of the consumer and recommending the matched advertisement gift to the consumer side; the consumer end is used for interacting with the advertisement gift release channel to realize accurate matching of the advertisement gift and receiving confirmation of the advertisement gift recommended by the advertisement gift release channel and matched with the consumer; performing ordering operation on advertisement objects promoted by advertisement gift advertisements; and the logistics end is used for sending a logistics instruction to the logistics system.

title_en: System and method for facilitating error analysis of product defects
abstract_en: The present application discloses a system and method that facilitates error analysis of product defects. The system may include a processor configured to: storing life cycle information related to a life cycle of a product in a life cycle database; storing manufacturing operation information related to a manufacturing operation of a product in a manufacturing operation database; storing additional lifecycle information related to lifecycle issues and/or ineligible items for the product in a lifecycle database; storing additional manufacturing operation information related to concerns and/or complaints about the product in a manufacturing operation database; storing first reference information relating to further lifecycle information from the lifecycle database in a manufacturing operations database; generating, by a display device, a Graphical User Interface (GUI); the manufacturing operation information, the additional manufacturing operation information, and the additional lifecycle information are caused to be displayed in the GUI.

title_en: Item recommendation method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses an article recommendation method and device. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of recommended articles and a first recommended value corresponding to each recommended article according to N target articles, and obtaining a first recommended value sequence of each recommended article, wherein N is an integer larger than 0, and each recommended article is related to at least one target article; and acquiring the generation time of each recommended article, performing data processing on the first recommended value of each recommended article according to the current time and the generation time of each recommended article, and acquiring the second recommended value of each recommended article, so as to obtain the second recommended value sequence of each recommended article. The method and the device solve the technical problems that in the prior art, the recommended articles recommended are poor in timeliness, and the interest of a user in the recommended articles is reduced.

title_en: Anti-counterfeiting encoding method using label die cutting information
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-counterfeiting coding method by using label die cutting information, which comprises the following steps: 1) carrying out gray level binarization on the label picture, and carrying out die cutting positioning; 2) the method comprises the steps of carrying out area division on selectable areas of die cutting to obtain block areas, respectively estimating the gray level mean value of each block area, recording and storing the pixel positions and the gray level mean values of the block areas, and using the pixel positions and the gray level mean values as codes of the label die cutting; 3) the method comprises the steps of carrying out grey level binarization on a label to be tested, mapping pixel point positions of partitioned areas stored in a code record of registered label die cutting to the label to be tested, recording a grey level mean value of a corresponding area on the label to be tested, and finally calculating the Euclidean distance between the registered label and the grey level mean value of the label to be tested to serve as a standard for measuring authenticity. The coding method provided by the invention adopts a simple coding mode of label die cutting, and has low coding memory compared with the traditional coding memory; for anti-counterfeiting, the die cutting difference is physically unavoidable, and the identification accuracy is high.

title_en: Container unit combined type automatic storage method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of container wall structures, and discloses a combined automatic storage method of container units, which comprises the following steps: the system comprises a warehousing information identification unit, a storage area storage unit and a ex-warehouse conveying unit, wherein the warehousing information identification unit transmits materials to a bar code identification device by using a transmission device, a bar code reader reads the material information, and the storage area storage unit and the ex-warehouse conveying unit are realized through an intelligent storage system. The invention uses the code scanning identification system and the intelligent storage system to realize the warehousing and the ex-warehouse of materials in the container unit, realizes the mobile storage, can expand the material storage capacity according to the number of the combined units, and embodies the combination and the flexibility of the storage.

title_en: Transaction data processing method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a transaction data processing method, a transaction data processing device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein in the transaction process, the execution result of each accounting step is monitored, and when the execution result of one accounting step is monitored, the state value in a preset state column in an accounting flow water meter of the transaction process is updated to the state value corresponding to the monitored execution result of the accounting step; when the state value in the preset state column is a state value representing that the accounting step fails, or a state value representing that the first type of accounting step is unknown, the transaction flow is processed according to a first preset processing mode corresponding to the state value, so that the transaction flow is in a successful execution state or an unexecuted execution state, and therefore the transaction data are guaranteed to be consistent in a plurality of systems. The operation of service personnel is simplified, and the data processing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Continuous batch order fulfillment
abstract_en: A batch order fulfillment method includes assigning a plurality of orders to a picker. Each order includes a plurality of units to be picked, and the picker picks the units in a logical travel sequence that substantially minimizes travel time of the picker. The method also includes assigning a new order including a plurality of units to be picked to the picker after completion of one of the previously assigned orders. The picker picks the units of the new order and the unsorted units of the previously assigned order in a logical travel sequence that substantially minimizes the travel time of the picker.

title_en: House property leasing method, system, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of house renting transactions, in particular to a house property renting method, a system, computer equipment and a storage medium. The house property renting method comprises the following steps: the house source information is acquired by the house source renting node, a house source block is generated and is uplinked to form a new block chain, all the house source information is displayed in a preset house source checking interface by the house source renting node, a house renting contract is received by the house source renting node, and a contract block is generated and is uplinked to form a new block chain. The invention introduces a block chain system, records house source information and contracts by means of the decentralization characteristic of the block chain, and multiparty participation of lessors, intermediaries, lessees and the like, and jointly maintains data information on the block chain, thereby realizing the purpose that the house source is unique and the lessors do not need to worry about being harassd.

title_en: Method, device and system for providing solution
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device and a system for providing a solution, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an appeal model, forming historical appeal data based on the appeal model, recording a new appeal based on the appeal model, retrieving the historical appeal data related to the new appeal from the historical appeal data, and extracting the retrieved historical appeal data. The method, the device and the system improve the efficiency of processing the customer appeal and improve the customer satisfaction.

title_en: Reservoir flood resource utilization risk decision method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir flood resource utilization risk decision method, and belongs to the technical field of reservoir flood resource utilization. Which comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring basic information of a reservoir to be researched; step 2: constructing a reservoir flood resource utilization risk decision model based on adjustment of reservoir flood limit water level; and step 3: identifying risk factors of reservoir flood resource utilization by adopting an analytic hierarchy process, and determining main risk factors; and 4, step 4: calculating the risk rate of each risk index by adopting a probability theory and mathematical statistics method, and solving the comprehensive risk rate; and 5: calculating risk benefits based on a C-D production function method and an energy value method; step 6: calculating risk loss based on a flood inundation area and unit area loss method; and 7: solving a risk decision model by using a constraint method; and 8: and determining an optimal balanced flood limit water level adjustment scheme for reservoir flood resource utilization. The invention provides a theoretical basis for safely utilizing flood resources.

title_en: Civil aviation airport ground service support personnel scheduling method and system thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a scheduling method and a system for ground service support personnel of a civil aviation airport, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a target mathematical model; performing flight segmentation and task decomposition pretreatment on flight data to be guaranteed and support personnel data based on a target mathematical model; aiming at the first segment, constructing a flight-personnel distance matrix based on an improved Hungarian algorithm; calculating a flight-personnel distance matrix based on an improved Hungarian algorithm to form a solving result of a first section; repeating the steps for the rest segments to form solving results of a plurality of segments; and realizing the dispatching of ground service support personnel of the civil aviation airport according to a plurality of solving results. By implementing the embodiment of the invention, the problems that the personnel are not efficiently scheduled and reasonably allocated due to the fact that the existing scheduling means only allocates spare personnel for different flights according to the sequential scheduling strategy and the sequence scheduling strategy by the experience of the scheduler in the actual personnel allocation process are solved.

title_en: Remote desktop access method for operation and maintenance auditing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote desktop access method for an operation and maintenance auditing system.A simulation server establishes a plurality of simulation user terminals which are in one-to-one correspondence with remote terminals, so that a user terminal is connected with the corresponding remote terminals through the simulation user terminals, and the user terminal selects or switches any one of the connected remote terminals to carry out operation and maintenance work. According to the invention, a plurality of remote terminals can be logged in only by carrying out authentication of the user terminal once, so that the efficiency of newly establishing connection by the user is improved; when the user terminal accesses a plurality of remote terminals, only one session window is displayed on the user terminal, and the user can switch the sessions through the list, so that the resource overhead of the user terminal is reduced, and the operation and maintenance experience of the multi-remote terminal during operation and maintenance is improved.

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation online prediction method based on average Lyapunov index
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel photovoltaic power generation online prediction method based on an average Lyapunov index. The randomness and the intermittence of the photovoltaic power generation along with the weather change can influence the energy storage capacity configuration and the stable operation of a power grid and a photovoltaic micro-power grid; the method comprises the steps of firstly classifying photovoltaic power generation historical data according to 3 weather types of sunny days, cloudy days and rainy days, and respectively constructing photovoltaic power generation time sequences under the 3 weather states; setting an embedding dimension and delay time according to the current weather type, and reconstructing a phase space of the photovoltaic power generation time sequence; and calculating an average Lyapunov index of the phase space evolution process based on the dynamic evolution process starting from the phase space initial state point, taking the average Lyapunov index as the separation rate of the state locus in the phase space, and calculating the predicted value of the photovoltaic power generation power on line. The online prediction method provided by the invention effectively reduces the influence of photovoltaic power generation power fluctuation on a power grid, and has important significance on popularization and application of photovoltaic power generation.

title_en: Helicopter performance analysis and evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a helicopter performance analysis and evaluation method, which comprises the following steps: step 1: determining an evaluation index of helicopter performance, and establishing a helicopter performance evaluation model; step 2: respectively calculating the weight value of each evaluation index by using a layering factor method and an expert estimation method; and step 3: determining a target function by utilizing a multi-target improved genetic algorithm based on the results of the expert estimation method and the hierarchical factor method, screening a genetic algorithm population, and selecting an optimal individual to obtain a new weight value of each evaluation index; and 4, step 4: and (4) substituting the new weight value obtained in the step (3) into a helicopter performance evaluation model to finally obtain a helicopter performance evaluation result. The method disclosed by the invention is more dependent on the mathematical idea, and can obtain a weight distribution result which scientifically and comprehensively reflects the importance degree of each evaluation index, so as to evaluate the helicopter performance.

title_en: Multi-screen payment control method, equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-screen payment control method, equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of monitoring the holding state of terminal equipment in real time, and determining a corresponding first pre-starting instruction according to the holding state; then, determining a payment program corresponding to the payment demand, calling the payment program according to a second pre-starting instruction, and generating and caching a payment image; and finally, monitoring and judging whether the payment demand is at the payment moment, if so, determining a payment screen in the terminal equipment according to the current holding state and the object to be paid, and displaying the payment image in the payment screen to execute the payment operation. The invention realizes a humanized multi-screen payment control scheme, so that a user can load a payment code image in advance according to an actual application scene when using the terminal equipment to carry out mobile payment, and the user experience is further improved.

title_en: IC card encryption method, device, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of IC card encryption, and provides an IC card encryption method, an IC card encryption device, an IC card encryption terminal and a storage medium, which are used for solving the problem that an encrypted IC card is easy to be copied without authorization. The invention provides an IC card encryption method, an IC card encryption device, a terminal and a storage medium, wherein the IC card encryption device comprises the following steps: acquiring identification information in the IC card; matching the acquired identification information of the IC card with the stored identification information; if the matching is unsuccessful, warning information is sent out; if the matching is successful, generating new identification information; the new identification information is updated into the IC card, and the stored identification information is updated. The IC card is added with identification information, so that the card can be effectively prevented from being copied, and even if the card is copied, the copied card can not be used again as long as the original card user uses the card once; or after the copy card is used, the original card cannot be used again, so that the number of cards is still controllable.

title_en: Grooved pulley drive type horse race type box meal vending system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grooved pulley driven horse race type boxed meal automatic vending system, which comprises a user handheld terminal, a vending machine and a cloud server, wherein the user handheld terminal is provided with a boxed meal vending mobile phone APP, the vending machine is provided with a code scanning mechanism, the user handheld terminal is connected with the cloud server through a network, and the vending machine is connected with the cloud server through a GPRS (general packet radio service); the vending machine comprises a box body, a box door, a roller driving device, a vertically arranged first roller, a vertically arranged second roller, a first synchronous belt sleeved at the upper end of the first roller and the upper end of the second roller, a second synchronous belt sleeved at the lower end of the first roller and the lower end of the second roller, a material taking device, a heating device, a linear driving device and a boxed meal placing cavity.

title_en: Power quotation simulation method and system based on load flow analysis and calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power quotation simulation method based on load flow analysis and calculation, which comprises the steps of acquiring regional power grid information and generating a power load flow network diagram; adding the power constraint conditions and the market constraint conditions into the power flow network diagram, and calculating the power income meeting the constraint range; adjusting the power grid information, and updating the power flow network diagram so as to obtain corresponding power income; and sorting the electric power income in size and outputting simulation result parameters to finish quotation simulation. The technical scheme of the invention also discloses a power quotation simulation system based on the load flow analysis and calculation. Aiming at the problem that the power supply side (power generation enterprises) in the current power market can not obtain an effective quotation strategy, the technical scheme of the invention can realize an intuitive, simple and practical quotation pre-model through the power quotation simulation system based on the tidal current analysis and calculation, and can provide instructive opinions for the power supply side.

title_en: Urban street green land vegetation space configuration method based on biodiversity support function
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for detecting biological diversityThe method for configuring the space of the green vegetation beside the urban street with the support function comprises the following steps: 1) arranging a street green land in a city, wherein at least one side of the street green land is close to urban road land, and the street green land is internally provided with a shrub area and an arbor area in sequence from the urban road land; 2) configuration D t Calculating A; 3) configuring At, As and Ah, and calculating R; 4) configuring arbor plant, calculating H t . According to the urban street green vegetation space configuration method based on the biodiversity support function, the capacity of resisting external interference pressure of the street green space is enhanced by controlling the distance of retreat of the arbor region, the greening coverage area ratio of the arbor region, the average height of the arbor region and the like, a safe shelter space with high canopy density is provided for birds, the biodiversity of the street green space is improved, and a life community with harmonious and natural coexistence is constructed.

title_en: Settlement system and user management device
abstract_en: The present application discloses a settlement system and a user management device, which can carry out credit card settlement without greatly changing the structure of the prior credit card settlement and reduce the risk that card data is known by a third party, and the settlement system comprises: a user management device includes a storage unit, a second acquisition unit, a first notification unit, and a second notification unit, and a settlement receiving device includes a first acquisition unit, a third acquisition unit, and a request unit. The storage unit stores the association code in association with the user code. The first acquisition unit, the second acquisition unit, and the first notification unit notify the credit card processing device of the associated code of the user code associated with the user who performs the settlement in the storage unit. The second notifying unit, the third acquiring unit and the requesting unit notify the user of the identification code notified from the credit card processing device according to the notification, acquire the identification code, and request the credit card processing device for credit card settlement according to the notification of the identification code.

title_en: Information acquisition method and related product
abstract_en: The application discloses an information acquisition method and a related product, wherein the method is applied to electronic equipment and comprises the following steps: receiving a data acquisition request from a server of an insurance company, wherein the data acquisition request comprises identification information of a insured; responding to the data acquisition request, extracting the identification information of the insured person in the data acquisition request, and acquiring the policy information of the insured person from a database according to the identification information; extracting home position information and working position information of the insured person in the policy information, and determining a target hospital set when the insured person is in medical treatment according to the home position information and the working position information; pushing the target hospital set to terminal equipment of the insurance company. The embodiment of the application is beneficial to simplifying the claim settlement process and improving the user experience.

title_en: Entity matching method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses an entity matching method, an entity matching device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an entity name to be matched; determining a first coding vector for representing the semantic meaning expressed by the entity name according to the character string contained in the entity name; respectively calculating the distance between the first coding vector of the entity name and the second coding vector of each standard entity name in the standard name library; selecting at least one candidate entity name with smaller distance from a plurality of standard entity names in the standard name library; determining feature matching degrees of the candidate entity name and the entity name on a plurality of preset dimensions according to the first encoding vector of the entity name and the second encoding vector of the candidate entity name; and determining the candidate entity name with the characteristic matching degree meeting the preset requirement as a standard entity name corresponding to the entity name. The method and the device can improve the accuracy of entity matching and reduce the consumption of human resources.

title_en: Data processing method, device, equipment and storage medium based on product popularization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data processing method, a device, equipment and a storage medium based on product popularization, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving a data submitting request sent by a client, and acquiring user identification information and product popularization data in the data submitting request; calculating commission data for the user in combination with the commission rate and the product extension data; encrypting the commission data according to a preset encryption mode, and sending the obtained ciphertext data to a payment platform so that the payment platform carries out online payment according to the ciphertext data; carrying out big data analysis on the user identification information, the commission data and the product promotion data to obtain product promotion task information, wherein the product promotion task information comprises product promotion tasks customized for users in a personalized way; and sending the product popularization task information to the client corresponding to the user identification information. The technical scheme of the invention is used for solving the problems of low efficiency and low automation level of data management in the product popularization process.

title_en: Thermal power generating unit combination optimization method and system based on time sequence production simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a thermal power generating unit combination optimization method and system based on time sequence production simulation, comprising the following steps: classifying the thermal power units with the same installed capacity as the thermal power units into one type; obtaining optimal operation schemes of various thermal power generating units by utilizing a pre-constructed operation time deviation value model; controlling various thermal power units based on optimal operation schemes of the various thermal power units; the combination optimization method can effectively shorten the workload of the dispatcher, and is more accurate and scientific in combination optimization result and stronger in practical performance.

title_en: Method and device for estimating time and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device and electronic equipment for estimating time, wherein one specific implementation mode of the method comprises the steps of estimating the completion time of a journey corresponding to a target order by utilizing a preset rule to obtain an initial estimation result, determining target information corresponding to the target order, wherein the target information comprises a personalized coefficient of a service provider corresponding to the target order, the maximum order holding capacity of the service provider and historical estimation deviation information of a service area corresponding to the target order, inputting the target information into a pre-trained model, and correcting the initial estimation result by utilizing data output by the model to obtain a target estimation result. According to the method and the system, the influence of potential factors of the service provider corresponding to the target order and the service area corresponding to the target order on the initial estimation result is fully considered, and the initial estimation result is corrected, so that the corrected target estimation result is higher in accuracy.

title_en: Cross-region power transmission multi-energy complementary optimization method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a trans-regional power transmission multi-energy complementary optimization method and device, and belongs to the technical field of electric power. The method comprises the following steps: calculating performance evaluation indexes at different moments according to the wind power outgoing power, the photovoltaic outgoing power and the hydropower outgoing power of the transmitting-end power grid at different moments, and the wind power receiving power, the photovoltaic receiving power and the hydropower receiving power of the receiving-end power grid at different moments; and calculating the starting and stopping modes of the thermal power generating unit according to the performance evaluation indexes at different moments. Due to the fact that the power consumption requirement of a receiving end power grid is considered, and the cross-region wind power, hydropower, photovoltaic and thermal power are optimally scheduled, an optimal scheme is provided for the delivery and consumption of cross-region clean energy, and the power consumption cost of a power grid enterprise is reduced.

title_en: Loan credit risk assessment method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lending credit risk assessment method and a lending credit risk assessment device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring statistical characteristic information and historical repayment information corresponding to the borrower; determining the risk category of the borrower according to the statistical characteristic information and the historical repayment information; and evaluating the overdue probability and the bad account probability of the borrower through a pre-trained overdue-bad account risk model according to the historical repayment information and the risk category. The invention classifies the credit risk of the borrower according to the characteristics of the borrower, simultaneously examines the overdue risk and the bad account risk of the borrower through the overdue-bad account risk model, can identify the repayment capability of the borrower, predicts the overdue and the bad account risk of the next term according to the repayment condition of each single term of the borrower, and can cover the whole life cycle of the multiperiod repayment of the borrower in the whole risk assessment process.

title_en: Irrigated area meteorological and remote sensing information monitoring platform
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of meteorological monitoring, and discloses an irrigation area meteorological and remote sensing information monitoring platform, which comprises: the meteorological data acquisition unit is used for acquiring meteorological information and remote sensing data of a designated meteorological station, processing and storing the meteorological information and forming pre-stored meteorological information to be called; the meteorological data analysis and calculation unit is used for calling prestored meteorological information, calculating the ET0 of all specified meteorological stations, performing Kriging/IDW interpolation on the meteorological data aiming at a specific irrigation area, generating a corresponding interpolation image, and storing a calculation result and the interpolation image; and the meteorological data query and display unit outputs data or interpolation images appointed by the user through the foreground client. The invention is a platform integrating the acquisition, analysis, release and query of meteorological and remote sensing data, can provide nationwide users with real-time query of meteorological data and remote sensing data of various places, and provides higher-precision data customization service for specific irrigation areas.

title_en: Power generation side member dynamic quotation decision method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic quotation decision method, a dynamic quotation decision device and dynamic quotation decision equipment for members on a power generation side, wherein the method comprises the steps of S1, generating a reinforcement learning initial strategy space of each power generation member, and initializing the selection probability of each quotation strategy; s2, selecting a quotation strategy with the maximum selection probability; s3, obtaining a market clearing result by using a clearing model; s4, generating a local optimal strategy space based on a diagonalization optimization mechanism; s5, calculating an evaluation function value of each quotation strategy through a reinforcement learning method and correcting the selection probability of the quotation strategies; s6, when the reinforcement learning termination condition is not met, re-executing the step S2; and S7, outputting an optimal quotation strategy when the evaluation function value meets the reinforcement learning termination condition. The method solves the problem that the clearing result in the market with Nash equilibrium deviates from the Nash equilibrium point, and introduces the analysis of market power generation members so as to be closer to the real decision making process of the market power generation members.

title_en: Method and device for acquiring user set of client group
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method and a device for acquiring a user set of a client group, wherein the method comprises the following steps: according to the rules corresponding to the client groups, at least one public condition is obtained, wherein the public condition is a condition appearing in the rules corresponding to the two client groups; for each public condition, acquiring a first user set conforming to the public condition according to user data; for each client group, if the rule of the client group comprises a public condition and a non-public condition, for each independent sub-condition belonging to the non-public condition in the rule of the client group, acquiring a second user set conforming to the independent sub-condition according to the user data, and carrying out logic operation on all first user sets and all second user sets corresponding to the client group according to logic corresponding to the rule of the client group to obtain a target user set of the client group. According to the method and the device for obtaining the user set of the client group, the public conditions are obtained, high-performance hardware support is not needed, and the efficiency of obtaining the user set of the client group can be improved.

title_en: Bidding evaluation method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a bid evaluation method and a bid evaluation device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: firstly, forming each bidding data pair according to the using specifications of the bidding document and the bidding document, then comparing the contents of the bidding parameters and the bidding parameters in each bidding data pair, and determining whether the bidding parameters meet the requirements of the bidding parameters. According to the method, each matched bidding parameter and bidding parameter is automatically formed into a bidding data pair according to the use specifications of the bidding document and the bidding document, and then the contents of the bidding parameter and the bidding parameter in each bidding data pair are automatically compared, so that whether each bidding parameter in the bidding document meets the requirements of the bidding parameter can be judged more quickly and accurately, a large amount of manpower is not required for manual examination, and the examination efficiency and the examination quality are improved.

title_en: Suspicious transaction message generation method and device and server
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present specification provides a method, an apparatus, and a server for generating a suspicious transaction message, including: coding the customer characteristics of each dimension in the characteristic detail to form a characteristic coding sequence corresponding to the characteristic detail; inputting the characteristic coding sequence into a suspicious transaction message generation model, and outputting a coding form message containing the characteristic coding sequence based on the suspicious transaction message generation model; by backfilling the characteristic value with detailed characteristics to the corresponding coding position in the coding form message, the suspicious transaction message aiming at the target client is generated, so that message connection caused by message splicing, a large amount of rule maintenance in message sequence and message screening are avoided, the complexity of generating the suspicious transaction message is reduced, and the time is saved and the efficiency is high.

title_en: Information processing method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of financial science (Fintech), and discloses an information processing method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the value of one or more target features corresponding to a user, and acquiring the dialing time of the user according to the value of one or more target features corresponding to the user; wherein the one or more target features include features that are strongly related to dialing success and features that are strongly related to dialing failure. In the embodiment of the invention, the value of the first target feature and the value of the second target feature can be used for measuring the contact effect by determining the first target feature which is strongly related to the dialing success and the second target feature which is strongly related to the dialing failure; in other words, in the embodiment of the invention, the time for dialing the user is obtained through pre-analysis, so that a better contact effect can be obtained, and the contact efficiency with the user can be improved.

title_en: Data transmission method and device, computer equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data transmission method, a data transmission device, computer equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: if the fact that the user participates in a preset interaction activity is detected, a sharing two-dimensional code is correspondingly generated according to the interaction activity participated by the user, and the sharing two-dimensional code is a two-dimensional code carrying an H5 page unique identifier of the interaction activity and a television terminal unique identifier; detecting whether the sharing two-dimensional code is scanned and opened in real time; if the H5 page is scanned and opened, monitoring the H5 page in real time to acquire the reported information of other users on the H5 page; and transmitting the acquired reporting information back to the television terminal in real time through the H5 page and displaying the information. According to the embodiment of the invention, the sharing two-dimensional code is correspondingly generated according to the preset interaction activity participated by the user, the H5 page of the interaction activity is shared to a plurality of social friends for opening and participation after the sharing two-dimensional code is scanned, and then the behavior data of the social friends of the user in the interaction activity is transmitted to the television terminal through the H5 page.

title_en: Data processing and tendency characteristic value identification method and device, and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure discloses a data processing and tendency characteristic value identification method, a device and electronic equipment. The data processing method comprises the following steps: acquiring sample data; wherein the sample data comprises a plurality of sample features of a product category provided by a sample object; the sample features include behavioral data generated by a user for a product under the product category; determining tendency characteristic values of the product categories provided by the user for the sample objects according to partial sample characteristics in the sample data; and training a tendency characteristic value identification model according to the sample data and the tendency characteristic value. The tendency characteristic value identification model can learn the weight of each characteristic which can influence the tendency characteristic value of the user to the object such as the product and/or the service from the behavior data of the user, further identify the real requirement of the user according to the weight of the characteristic, can be applied to the technical fields such as retrieval and the like, and improves the accuracy of retrieval results.

title_en: Partitioned optimization method for crop irrigation system of underground water shallow-buried area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a partitioned optimization method for a crop irrigation system of an underground water shallow-buried area. It includes: acquiring local historical data; obtaining first simulated yield and simulated water consumption of different growth stages of crop wheat in different areas under different set irrigation systems by using an Aquacrop model based on local historical data, wherein the set underground water burial depth is taken as a partition boundary line in the different areas; according to all the first simulated yields and the simulated water consumption corresponding to each growth stage, adopting a set multiple-moisture production function model to obtain second simulated yields of all regional crops under each moisture production function model and stage sensitivity coefficients or indexes of different growth stages; calculating a decision coefficient between the first simulated yield and the second simulated yield; determining an optimal moisture production function model corresponding to each area by adopting a stage sensitivity coefficient or index and a decision coefficient; and taking the stage sensitivity coefficient or index under the optimal water production function model as an irrigation decision variable, and setting an irrigation quota to obtain an irrigation system by utilizing Aquacrrop.

title_en: Urban rail transit passenger travel path selection estimation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for selecting and estimating a travel path of an urban rail transit passenger, and belongs to the technical field of urban rail transit operation control. The method is based on time-sharing OD time band analysis of AFC data, and the relation between the travel time and the travel path of a passenger OD pair is determined; according to the relation between the travel time and the travel route, a passenger route selection Gaussian mixture model is constructed; and (4) solving the passenger path selection Gaussian mixture model based on an EM algorithm to obtain the path selection probability of the passenger OD pair. Compared with the SP method, the method provided by the invention is verified to be capable of truly and effectively calculating the time zone of each path and the selection probability of each path selected by a passenger based on the AFC data-driven passenger path estimation method. The invention provides a data basis for formulating and estimating the passenger flow control strategy.

title_en: Warehouse remote monitoring method and system, storage medium and processor
abstract_en: The application discloses a remote monitoring method and device for warehouse, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving running gear data uploaded by a running gear; wherein the running gear data includes at least one of fault data and status data; storing running gear data in a database; and pushing real-time information to a monitoring terminal according to the running gear data in the database, so that the monitoring terminal can update a monitoring picture according to the real-time information. The method and the device solve the technical problems that monitoring data in warehouse management cannot be analyzed by using big data in the related technology, and professional monitoring personnel cannot remotely monitor and solve the problem in production.

title_en: Unmanned vehicle scheduling method and device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a method and a device for dispatching unmanned vehicles, which are characterized in that idle vehicles to be dispatched in a first range around a user to be rescued are determined according to a rescue request sent by the user to be rescued, vehicles to be assessed are selected from the determined vehicles to be dispatched according to position information and comfort level attribute information of the vehicles to be dispatched, and a dispatching notification message is sent to the vehicles to be assessed, so that the vehicles to be assessed can receive and send the user to be rescued according to the dispatching notification message; according to the method and the device, the factors such as distance, vehicle idle state and vehicle comfort level can be comprehensively considered based on the transportation requirements of the user for medical treatment, rescue and the like, the most suitable unmanned vehicle nearby is scheduled to be used by the user, a relatively spacious space and a comfortable environment can be provided for treating and caring the user to be rescued in the process of transporting the user to be rescued, the social value of the unmanned technology is improved, and the use scene of the unmanned technology is expanded. The present disclosure also provides a server and a computer readable medium.

title_en: Parallel chain node excitation method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a parallel chain node excitation method, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method generates a first parallel chain mine excavation transaction through accounts which are uniformly pre-configured for all nodes of a current parallel chain; triggering a parallel chain mining contract to add and issue a plurality of proofs in the contract when a first parallel chain block comprising a first parallel chain mining transaction is executed, and generating a first consensus transaction; and when the self-consensus is carried out on a plurality of consensus transactions including the first consensus transaction and the self-consensus is successful, triggering a parallel chain mining contract to issue a plurality of evidence-based methods according to the pre-configured incentive rules, and motivating parallel chain nodes to build and maintain parallel chains.

title_en: Whole-process litchi growth condition monitoring method and system, cloud server and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a litchi growth condition whole-process monitoring method and system, a cloud server and a storage medium, wherein the system is based on the Internet of things and comprises an environmental data acquisition device, a networking camera, a router and the cloud server, wherein the environmental data acquisition device and the networking camera are respectively connected with the router, and the router is connected with the cloud server; the cloud server can acquire litchi images and environmental data information, detect information such as litchi growth period, litchi fruit number and maturity by using a target detection algorithm and an image processing technology based on deep learning, and provide a management strategy meeting agricultural requirements for a litchi plantation manager by combining environmental data acquired by various sensors; the Internet of things management platform and the e-commerce platform are deployed in the cloud server, litchi related information can be checked, the e-commerce platform integrates the virtual roaming module, and the litchi planting base is virtualized through a virtual reality technology, so that the e-commerce platform has litchi plantation virtual display and virtual roaming functions.

title_en: Aviation product management system using rule engine and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an aviation product management system using a rule engine, which comprises a downstream subsystem, a gateway subsystem, a cache unit, a rule processing subsystem, a background management subsystem and an upstream system, wherein the downstream subsystem is connected with the gateway subsystem; the downstream subsystem sends a service request to the gateway subsystem; the gateway subsystem calls the upstream system service interface and acquires a condition parameter from the rule processing subsystem through the cache unit; and the background management subsystem is used for carrying out rule reloading on the rule processing subsystem. The system also provides an application method, and by introducing the cache unit and the rule processing subsystem, appropriate new strategies or new rules are uniformly issued to the downstream subsystem, so that the integrated management and control of the system are realized, the problem of formulation of product sale rules and marketing strategies of the downstream subsystem in a multi-channel scene is solved, and the upstream speed of related functions of the downstream subsystem is accelerated; through centralized rule management, various marketing rules are convenient for a manager to execute and optimize.

title_en: Human body model automatic creation method and three-dimensional fitting system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of optics and computers, in particular to a human body model automatic creation method and a three-dimensional fitting system. The method comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring a first RGBD image of a human body in a first posture; s2: identifying a loose part of human clothing and a compact part of a human body in the first RGBD image; s3: according to the recognition result, guiding the human body to make at least one preset second gesture which can enable the loose part to become the compact part, and acquiring at least one second RGBD image; s4: extracting characteristic parameters of a human body net model according to the first RGBD image and the at least one second RGBD image; s5: and creating a human body net model according to the characteristic parameters. The invention can convert the loose parts of the human body into the compact parts through a plurality of specific postures, and can construct a three-dimensional model which is more close to the real body type of the human body by combining the recognition of the loose parts, thereby improving the fitting effect.

title_en: Dynamic migration method for Internet of vehicles service
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic migration method of Internet of vehicles service, which fully considers the influence of the moving speed on the migration decision, establishes a relation model of the benefits and the cost of the moving speed and the service migration, designs a dynamic migration mechanism, and dynamically balances the migration cost and the service QoS according to the moving speed of a vehicle. Compared with the prior art, the dynamic migration strategy design is carried out according to the moving speed of the vehicle, so that the income of an operator is effectively increased, and the QoS of the service can be better guaranteed; the moving speed of the vehicle and the service migration time are fully considered, the fact that the service is migrated to the MEC server closest to the user when migration is completed is guaranteed, and compared with the prior art, migration benefits are effectively increased.

title_en: Intelligent vertical type storage unit management method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of furniture logistics management, and discloses an intelligent vertical type storage unit management method.

title_en: Forging resistance furnace production optimization method based on SPEA2 algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resistance furnace production optimization method based on a SPEA2 algorithm, which is used for analyzing the flow characteristic of energy in a forging process and establishing a resistance furnace energy consumption model based on resistance furnace energy balance by combining technical performance indexes of a heating furnace, furnace lining material parameters and thermophysical properties of the materials according to a heat conduction theory. On the basis of four working stages and energy consumption models of the resistance furnace, an optimization model with minimum energy consumption cost, time and furnace tolerance in the single-machine production planning process of the resistance furnace is provided. And optimizing the production process model based on the SPEA2 algorithm to respectively obtain an efficient mode corresponding to the minimum time optimization and an energy-saving mode corresponding to the minimum energy consumption optimization, simultaneously optimizing the corresponding comprehensive modes by multiple targets, and selecting by decision-making staff according to actual conditions. Under the condition that the enterprise does not increase extra capital investment, the method makes a production plan, realizes production in different modes, and decision-making personnel can make selections according to actual conditions, thereby realizing economic benefit and environmental protection.

title_en: Electric quantity prediction method based on capacity utilization hours
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric quantity prediction method based on capacity utilization hours, which respectively predicts the electric quantity of industries according to different conditions of various industries, has close variation trends, predicts the electric quantity of the industries by taking the capacity utilization hours as a coefficient, has large variation trend difference, checks the average capacity utilization hours according to different variation trends of GDP (product data processing) of the industries so as to predict the electric quantity of the industries, and then sums the electric quantity to obtain an electric quantity prediction result. Compared with the general intelligent algorithm for predicting the electric quantity, the method is simpler and more feasible, and avoids uncertainty caused by self-learning in parameter estimation in the intelligent algorithm, so that when a periodic electric quantity prediction result is issued as a decision basis, the method is more accurate, and the data change is stable and the load actual operation trend is carried out.

title_en: Information acquisition method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses an information acquisition method and device, relates to the field of computers, and aims to improve the interestingness of information acquisition, wherein the method comprises the following steps: displaying an information acquisition interface on a display screen, wherein the information acquisition interface comprises at least one question for information acquisition and a plurality of areas, one area is displayed with an option for answering one question and one area corresponds to one note or one music piece; receiving a selection of at least one of the plurality of regions; forming a selection result based on the selection; based on the selection result, music is output. The method and the device are used for information acquisition.

title_en: Mechanical product service optimization method in cloud manufacturing environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mechanical product service optimization method under a cloud manufacturing platform. According to the method, firstly, the user demand is decomposed into a plurality of subtasks according to the user demand, each subtask corresponds to a plurality of service parties, the k optimal service combination schemes are recommended to the user by using the k optimal algorithm with service time and service cost as indexes, the calculation complexity is reduced, meanwhile, the problem that the meta heuristic algorithm is not easy to converge is avoided, a reliable selection range can be provided for the user more efficiently and accurately, the time cost in the working process of the user is saved, and the enterprise competitiveness is improved.

title_en: Short-term optimized scheduling method and system for cascade reservoir group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-term optimized dispatching method and a short-term optimized dispatching system for a cascade reservoir group, which belong to the field of cooperative optimized dispatching of water-fire power stations, and are characterized in that the fitness of each individual in an initial population is obtained, and the positions of an optimal fitness individual, a suboptimal fitness individual and a third optimal fitness individual in the population are updated; then updating the positions of all individuals in the population and generating a temporary population; screening the population by adopting a variation strategy based on the population and the temporary population obtained after updating all individual positions of the population; and the self-adaptive boundary strategy is adopted to effectively prevent the population from falling into local optimum. And updating all individual positions in the population through iteration, and outputting the individual position with the optimal fitness as the optimal scheduling process of the cascade hydropower system after the stop condition is reached. The method has the advantages of high convergence speed, high solving precision, strong optimizing capability, capability of effectively avoiding being trapped in local optimal solution and the like, can well coordinate the water-fire power station cooperative scheduling among the power grids, improves the economic benefit, and has very high practical value.

title_en: Near field payment method based on data identification model
