abstract_en: The invention discloses a near field payment method based on a data identification model, which comprises the following steps: the receiving party terminal generates receiving content according to the service scene identifier and the corresponding service scene template, uses the private key of the receiving party to digitally sign the service scene identifier and the receiving content by adopting an asymmetric algorithm, and attaches an asymmetric public key of the receiving party; the receiving party terminal generates receiving data to be transmitted according to the data identification model; the payment terminal enters a unified payment entrance, and the payment terminal uses an asymmetric public key of the payee to verify whether the service scene identification and the result of the payee content are consistent with the digital signature of the payee by adopting an asymmetric algorithm; if the two types of information are consistent, the safety authentication is passed; if the payment flow is inconsistent, the payment flow cannot pass the verification, and the payment flow is ended; and automatically identifying and jumping to a corresponding payment scene flow according to the service scene identification to finish payment. The problems of fragility of service functions, inconvenience in use of users, data security risk and the like in the existing payment service flow are solved.

title_en: Goods picking system and goods picking method
abstract_en: A goods picking system and a goods picking method, wherein a data processing unit is used for making a goods picking path according to the position of a carrying device and the carrying capacity of the carrying device, so that when a plurality of carrying devices simultaneously carry out goods picking operation, an insert list can be assigned to the carrying device with the most proper site, and the insert list can be picked.

title_en: Teaching system and dot matrix teaching courseware
abstract_en: The application provides a teaching system and a dot matrix teaching courseware. The teaching system comprises: the first dot matrix teaching courseware, dot matrix acquisition equipment and teacher end; the first lattice teaching courseware is provided with an answer area, the answer area is provided with a lattice code, and the lattice code is used for forming answer data which are made for the test questions at any position of the answer area; the lattice acquisition equipment is used for acquiring answer data aiming at test questions; the teacher end is used for acquiring answer data aiming at the test questions and collected by the lattice collecting equipment and determining matching results of the answer data and the test questions. The dot matrix codes are used for forming the answer data which is made on any position of the answer area and aims at the test questions, namely, the association relation between the answer area of the first dot matrix teaching courseware and the test questions is relieved, so that the first dot matrix teaching courseware can be produced in batches, the production cost of the first dot matrix teaching courseware is reduced, and the popularization and the use of dot matrix teaching are facilitated.

title_en: Intelligent express dispatching system and method based on public transport system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent express dispatch system and method based on a bus system, comprising a bus, a bus stop, a bus dispatch system and an express delivery management center; the express delivery management center is used for receiving the delivery tasks of the express, and executing the following actions: generating a distribution scheme according to the distribution task, and pushing the distribution scheme to a bus station; receiving scheduling information of a bus scheduling system, acquiring planned shift time of an operation line, and calculating estimated arrival time of each shift bus to a target station; receiving transfer information of a bus stop, updating the occupation condition of a storage space of a distribution box of the bus, and updating temporary storage information of an express cabinet of the bus stop; and receiving the mail sending and mail taking information of the bus station, and starting or terminating the delivery task. Based on the express delivery of the invention, the express can reach each bus station in the urban area within 1-2 hours after the delivery of the initial station, so that the timeliness is good, and the beneficial supplement of the urban express delivery system is realized.

title_en: Commodity adjusting method and device in live broadcast process
abstract_en: The invention provides a commodity adjusting method and a commodity adjusting device in a live broadcasting process, which relate to the technical field of live broadcasting marketing, and are characterized in that a first purchasing condition of a first commodity in a first live broadcasting e-commerce platform is obtained; determining a target user representation according to the first purchase condition; determining a first purchase preference based on the target user representation; determining a second item according to the first purchase preference; judging whether the second commodity meets a first preset condition or not; when the first preset condition is not met, the second commodities are listed in the first live-broadcast catalog, so that the technical problems that in the prior art, live-broadcast commodities are generally fixedly pushed and selected and commodity strategies cannot be adjusted in real time according to the live-broadcast sale condition, the live-broadcast shopping experience of a user is influenced are solved, the commodity strategies can be adjusted in real time according to the live-broadcast sale condition, and the technical effects of purchase desire and live-broadcast shopping experience of the user are greatly improved.

title_en: Off-line commodity recommendation method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an off-line commodity recommendation method, an off-line commodity recommendation device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring visual information of visiting clients; extracting visual characteristic information from the visual information; determining recommended commodities of the visiting clients from the commodities according to the visual characteristic information and scores of the commodities acquired in advance; and displaying the recommended commodity to the visiting client. The embodiment of the invention can improve the commodity recommendation effect.

title_en: Data processing method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of financial science and technology (Fintech), and discloses a data processing method and device.

title_en: Reading management method, device, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a reading management method, a device, a system and a storage medium, wherein a reading task is formulated through a platform manager client, the reading task is issued to a lower manager client, the lower manager client determines reading books and examination contents suitable for managed readers according to the reading task, a reading subtask is created, the reading subtask is then sent to the reader client of the managed readers, and the reading subtask is completed by the reader client. According to the invention, through issuing tasks in a grading manner, the task is quickly formulated by different layers of administrators, the time cost and the labor input cost of mutual communication waste of each layer of administrators can be reduced, and meanwhile, the task can be selected to be suitable for reading books and examination contents of readers, so that the reading requirements of the readers can be better met.

title_en: Method and device for evaluating state of power equipment and storage medium thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to an evaluation method and device for the state of power equipment and a storage medium thereof, wherein the evaluation method comprises the following steps: s1, obtaining evaluation index data in mutual inductor equipment and constructing an evaluation model; s2, determining index weight for evaluation index data in the evaluation model based on a ancient forest method to obtain an index weight value matrix; s3, preprocessing evaluation index data in the evaluation model to obtain mutual inductor state data; s4, grading the state data of the mutual inductor, and obtaining an evaluation matrix of the state of the mutual inductor equipment based on the cloud model and according to the grading; and S5, multiplying the index weight value matrix with the evaluation matrix to obtain the evaluation result of the mutual inductor equipment. The running state of the mutual inductor equipment can be evaluated, the failure rate of the equipment is reduced, the maintenance can be arranged in advance, the equipment is prevented from being subjected to safety accidents, and the running safety and reliability of the equipment are ensured, so that the safety and stability of a power system with the mutual inductor equipment are improved.

title_en: Road and bridge maintenance decision optimization method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a road and bridge maintenance decision optimization method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining the type and specific information of diseases of roads and bridges, wherein the type and specific information of the diseases are collected by using terminal equipment in a patrol mode; calculating and quantitatively evaluating by combining with road and bridge maintenance technical specifications to obtain a quality condition score of the road and bridge; establishing a maintenance decision optimization model of the road bridge by using the quality condition score, wherein the maintenance decision optimization model comprises a single-target maintenance decision optimization model and a multi-target maintenance decision optimization model; and solving the road maintenance decision optimization model to obtain a globally optimal scheme of maintenance decisions. The method has the advantages of clear quality evaluation flow, novel and practical modeling thought, high efficiency and accuracy of a solving algorithm, and capability of providing practical and visual reference for road and bridge maintenance decisions.

title_en: Data processing method and system
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of data processing, and provides a data processing method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining intermediate data having a target data format; analyzing the intermediate data according to a preset data mapping relation to obtain callback parameters; and carrying out service processing according to the callback parameters to obtain a processing result, and returning the processing result. After receiving the initial data with the initial data format, the invention firstly carries out centralized processing on the initial data to convert the initial data into the intermediate data with the target data format, and separates callback parameter analysis, service mapping and service processing, thereby not needing to carry out independent development aiming at different products, simplifying the development of callback processing of payment results, greatly shortening development time, simultaneously obviously reducing the maintenance cost of a data access system and being beneficial to meeting the quick connection and online requirements of insurance products.

title_en: Intelligent advertising method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent advertisements, and provides an intelligent advertisement method and device. The method comprises the steps of obtaining one or more pieces of user information in a current scene; generating one or more advertisement bidding sheets according to the user information; and generating a current round of advertisement bidding result according to the advertisement bidding list, and playing advertisement content according to the bidding result. According to the invention, the camera is introduced to collect the face images of the users, so that a plurality of users in the current scene (such as an elevator advertisement putting scene) can be identified, and the advertisement bidding list carries the user distribution on each consumption type, the consumption attribute of each user and/or the advertisement attribute of the user in the current scene through big data analysis, thereby providing a targeted reference dimension for advertisement bidding, and enabling the finally presented advertisement content to have higher pertinence and effectiveness.

title_en: Large-scale BIM model data processing and loading method and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and equipment for processing and loading massive BIM model data, belonging to the technical field of BIM data processing and comprising a model data import module; a data export module; a model data grouping module; a model data derivation module; a model data lightweight module; and a model layer manufacturing module. The BIM loading of the invention adopts the principle of nearby loading, can quickly display the scene model closest to the current visual angle, and can automatically unload according to the loading condition when the number of the models reaches a certain online state.

title_en: Transmission line insulator defect image identification method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a defect image recognition method for an insulator of a power transmission line, which comprises the following steps: s1: establishing a sample library of insulator images; s2: graying of the insulator picture to be identified, analyzing the digital image in a most basic matrix form, and analyzing different states of the image by adopting gray values of different pixels; s3: dividing an insulator picture to be identified into an environment background area and an insulator area by an image maximum entropy segmentation method; s4: determining the contour of an insulator and the gray value of the contour of the insulator in the image data by using the image data of the divided areas through a local detail characteristic algorithm; s5: comparing the processed insulator image with a sample library to determine whether the insulator has defects. The method can give out problematic image data faster, and through manual judgment, the workload of the power inspection personnel for later data processing is reduced to a great extent, and meanwhile, some redundant data volume is also eliminated.

title_en: Automatic dispatch method and system for complaint service request
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a complaint service request automatic dispatch method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: identifying complaint keywords in the complaint service request; matching the complaint keywords in a preset complaint template library, and determining a target template from the complaint template library; and dispatching the complaint service request to a background support person corresponding to the target template. According to the automatic dispatch method and system for the complaint service request, which are provided by the embodiment of the invention, the workflow of traditional manual dispatch is changed, and the complaint keywords are analyzed to be automatically dispatched to the most suitable background support personnel, so that the time and resources are saved.

title_en: Nuclear power plant indoor combustible gas explosiveness risk analysis method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for analyzing the explosiveness risk of combustible gas in a nuclear power plant room, which comprises the following steps: (1) Determining the room containing an explosive gas release source in the nuclear power plant and the fireproof space parameters where the room is located; (2) sequentially determining parameters of release sources of each room; (3) Confirming the position and the position range of a fixed fire source and a temporary fire source with fire risks in a fireproof space where the release source is positioned; (4) performing gas diffusion simulation analysis on the release source; (5) explosion scenario screening; (6) Performing explosion simulation analysis by using tools such as simulation software and the like; (7) performing functional analysis on explosion results; (8) And judging the explosion-proof measures and the protection measures to be adopted according to the result of the functional analysis. By utilizing the analysis method, the explosion risk of the combustible gas of the nuclear power plant can be estimated more practically, the damage condition of the gas explosion to the nuclear safety related equipment or the cable can be analyzed, and explosion prevention and protection measures can be adopted according to the final function analysis result.

title_en: Tourist commodity settlement processing method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a travel commodity settlement processing method, a device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: recording tourist commodity information into a commodity database, and publishing the information through a designated webpage, wherein the tourist commodity information comprises a tourist commodity number and a commodity price corresponding to the tourist commodity number; receiving a purchase request sent by a user terminal, searching a corresponding commodity price from a commodity database according to the number of the travelling commodity in the request, and searching a credit limit value of the user number from the user database according to the user number; and determining whether the user number meets the purchase condition according to the commodity price and the credit line value, and deducting the line value corresponding to the commodity price from the credit line value if the user number meets the purchase condition. The invention replaces real-time cash settlement by the credit line value, and controls the accumulated settlement value within a certain range, when the credit line value is insufficient, the buying of the buyer is stopped, the risk of the seller is reduced, the market of the tourism industry is also met, and the transaction efficiency of the buyer and the seller is improved.

title_en: Method, device, terminal and storage medium for predicting running state of vehicle
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method, a device, a terminal and a storage medium for predicting the running state of a vehicle, and belongs to the field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: collecting ambient sounds by a microphone while in a vehicle; extracting the characteristics of the environmental sound to obtain the environmental sound characteristics of the environmental sound, wherein the environmental sound characteristics comprise at least one of energy characteristics and time-frequency characteristics; inputting the environmental sound characteristics into a preset prediction model to obtain a target prediction result output by the preset prediction model, wherein the preset prediction model comprises at least one of a first prediction model and a second prediction model, the second prediction model is a classification model adopting RNN, and the target prediction result is the predicted running state of the vehicle; and determining the target running state of the vehicle according to the target prediction result. In the embodiment of the application, the running state is predicted by using the sound change characteristics of the vehicle, so that the accuracy and the effectiveness of the running state prediction are improved.

title_en: Data processing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The present specification provides a data processing method including: acquiring index data of the business entity corresponding to each evaluation index according to at least two evaluation indexes; determining the carbon saving amount corresponding to each evaluation index according to the index data of each evaluation index; fusing the carbon saving amount corresponding to each evaluation index by using the trained sequencing fusion model to obtain the carbon saving amount corresponding to the business entity; the ranking fusion model is obtained by training by taking the index data of each evaluation index and the corresponding carbon saving amount as training data; processing specific data of the business entity according to the carbon saving amount corresponding to the business entity; wherein the specific data is related to the amount of carbon saving. The specification also provides a data processing device, an electronic device and a storage medium for realizing the method.

title_en: Electronic contract signing device
abstract_en: An electronic contract signing device is applicable to electronic contract data, and comprises an online contract server, a first user device and a second user device, wherein the online contract server pre-stores the electronic contract data and a plurality of account identification codes, provides a plurality of private keys and public keys, distributes the private keys to the first user device and the second user device, the first user device encrypts a contract abstract related to the electronic contract data by the private keys to generate a first encrypted abstract, the second user device encrypts the first encrypted abstract by the private keys to generate a second encrypted abstract, and the online contract server verifies the second encrypted abstract by the corresponding public keys, and records the electronic contract data as a valid contract when verification is successful.

title_en: Light pollution evaluation method and device
abstract_en: According to the light pollution evaluation method and the light pollution evaluation device disclosed by the embodiment of the invention, the target light source chromaticity data of the target illumination area is obtained; determining a target light source type corresponding to the target illumination area based on the target light source chromaticity data and a preset light source type index database; invoking an evaluation index database corresponding to the target light source type; and inquiring an evaluation index database by using the chromaticity data of the target light source to obtain the relative light pollution evaluation index corresponding to the target illumination area. By implementing the invention, the light pollution level is directly estimated based on the chromaticity information of the urban illumination light, the required calculated amount is less, and the effectiveness, the real-time performance and the accuracy of the light pollution estimation are ensured.

title_en: Service consensus method and device in alliance block chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for service consensus in union block chains, which are used for initializing union block chain network cluster nodes to obtain node domain information, wherein the node domain information comprises node domain information of each union block chain network cluster node, and each node domain comprises at least one union block chain network cluster node; in response to receiving a transaction, voting the transaction by using the obtained node domain information, so that any node in each node domain receives the transaction, votes for the transaction to obtain a voting result, and takes the voting result as the voting result of the node domain; determining a consensus result of the transaction according to the voting result of each node domain; and updating the state information of the transaction according to the consensus result. The node domain replaces the node to vote, so that the time for waiting the node can be reduced, the efficiency and the utilization rate of the node are improved, and the network efficiency of the block chain is improved.

title_en: Travel path planning method considering population pollutant exposure
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a travel path planning method considering crowd pollutant exposure, which is characterized in that Vehicle emission data of a road section is obtained by calculating Vehicle Specific Power (VSP) distribution; on the basis, a Gaussian steady-state smoke plume equation is applied to establish a diffusion distribution model of pollutants of the motor vehicles on the urban road, and the time-space variation characteristics of the concentration of the pollutants on each road section are estimated in real time; and finally, carrying out gridding treatment on the pollutant concentration distribution parameters, further calculating the pollutant exposure parameters of characteristic crowds in the grid by using a crowd pollutant exposure model, establishing a low pollutant exposure path optimization method by using the pollutant exposure parameters as weights and applying an operation research method, and outputting to obtain an optimal path, an alternative path, corresponding travel time and a pollutant exposure value. The embodiment of the invention is based on the perspective of travelers, fully considers the coordination relationship between travel time and pollutant exposure, can provide a travel path with low pollutant exposure for travelers who walk and ride, and provides a reference basis for the travel decision of travelers.

title_en: Data acquisition method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification discloses a data acquisition method and device and an embodiment of electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out iterative processing by using the following steps until a preset condition is met: selecting first data from a first data set according to a value prediction model, wherein the first data set comprises at least one first data, and the first data is acquired in a coarse acquisition mode; acquiring second data by using a fine acquisition mode according to the data identifier corresponding to the selected first data; acquiring characteristic data corresponding to the data identification according to the selected first data; according to the collected second data, determining a label corresponding to the data identifier; and training the value prediction model according to the label and the characteristic data. The data acquisition method, the data acquisition device and the electronic equipment in the embodiment of the specification can save the data acquisition cost.

title_en: Error-proof basic data checking method based on electric power system sample plate interval
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for checking error-proof basic data based on a power system template interval, which comprises the following steps: step S1, importing a CIM model file of the transformer substation, acquiring relevant data of primary equipment from the CIM model file through a primary equipment analysis module, and setting a boundary to divide the transformer substation into N intervals; step S2: selecting data of an interval and designating the data as a sample reference interval S; step S3 selects a template interval S and a verified interval A, identified by the interval master 1 ‑A N Analyzing the template interval and checked interval data, step S4, analyzing and checking the primary equipment of the checked interval and the template interval S, step S5: screening device tables corresponding to the same equipment in the point table data; s6, screening secondary equipment tables corresponding to the same devices in the point table data, and S7: looping the steps S4-S6 until all checked intervals are checked; step S7: and after checking is finished, displaying a comparison result. The invention effectively improves the checking efficiency of the anti-error basic data.

title_en: Charging and metering system for direct-current brushless fan coil air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of air conditioner charging, in particular to a charging and metering system of a direct-current brushless fan coil air conditioner, which comprises a data collector T1, an energy consumption metering device T2, a state controller and charging system software, wherein the data collector T1 is used for collecting and storing power consumption information of the direct-current brushless fan calculated by the direct-current fan coil metering device, and is connected with a computer, and the energy consumption metering device T2 is used for metering energy consumption of the direct-current brushless fan. The charging and metering system for the direct-current brushless fan coil air conditioner can reasonably meter the air conditioner using cost of each user through a direct-current fan coil fee counter, an acquisition terminal, a computer terminal and system software, charge the cost, print reports and the like. The air conditioner operation cost can be effectively and reasonably and fairly distributed and collected, the property management level is effectively improved, and the problem that the direct-current brushless fan coil air conditioner cannot charge is solved.

title_en: Abnormal operation detection and model training method, device and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a readable storage medium for abnormal operation detection and model training, which comprises the steps of obtaining a user characteristic vector; inputting the obtained user characteristic vector into an unsupervised model to predict abnormal operation behaviors of the user to obtain a prediction result; calculating an evaluation score for representing the abnormal operation behavior of the user according to the prediction result; and if the obtained evaluation score exceeds the threshold score, determining that the current user has abnormal operation behaviors. Therefore, the method and the device utilize the unsupervised model to identify the abnormal operation behavior of the operation characteristics of the user, have higher identification accuracy and further reduce the phenomenon of stealing, transferring and brushing.

title_en: Regional bill spelling method, terminal equipment and server
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a regional menu sharing method, terminal equipment and a server, wherein the method comprises the steps that a passenger client side obtains travel information of a passenger regional menu, and the travel information comprises a departure place and a destination; according to the travel information, if the departure place and the destination are determined to be in the same travel area, the travel price corresponding to the travel area is obtained, the travel price is displayed, a ticket issuing request input by a passenger is received, a travel carpooling request is sent to a server according to the ticket issuing request, and a travel carpooling response sent by the server is received. According to the method, when the departure place and the destination are determined to be in the same travel area, the passenger client sends a travel carpooling request to the server, and meanwhile, when the departure place and the destination are determined to be in the same travel area, the server dispatches a bill to a driver in the travel area, carpooling in the same area is achieved, riding selection of passengers is enriched, and the passengers travel more conveniently.

title_en: Task scheduling method and system for imaging satellite
abstract_en: The invention provides a task scheduling method and system for an imaging satellite, and relates to the field of satellite observation. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring satellite resources and satellite tasks; acquiring satellite task observation income and satellite task priority based on satellite resources and satellite tasks; setting an objective function based on the satellite task observation income and the satellite task priority, and setting a constraint condition; constructing a satellite task observation model based on the objective function and the constraint condition; acquiring a satellite task population based on a satellite task observation model; and processing the satellite task population based on a preset ant colony algorithm to obtain a satellite task observation scheme. The invention has high efficiency of satellite scheduling.

title_en: Method and device for generating and verifying linkable ring signature in blockchain
abstract_en: One or more embodiments of the present specification provide a method and apparatus for generating and verifying a linkable ring signature in a blockchain, the method may include determining a signer array (p_j, id_j) including a public key p_j of a signer and a unique identification id_j of an asset to be spent held by the signer, where G is a base point of an elliptic curve, |g|=p and P is a prime number, x_j is a private key of a signer and 0< x_j < P, generating a key image I from the private key x_j of the signer and the signer array (p_j, id_j), and adding the key image I to the linkable ring signature when generating the linkable ring signature for a transaction M related to the asset to be spent.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for determining urban livability scheme
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for determining urban livability scheme. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a city digital model according to city geographic information data and city information point data; acquiring at least one urban livability index and urban development operation data, and determining an urban livability value corresponding to the at least one urban livability index according to the development operation data; determining a current urban livability assessment result according to the urban digital model, urban livability indexes and urban livability values; adjusting a city digital model according to the current urban livability assessment result, and determining at least one urban livability scheme according to the adjusted city digital model; and comparing urban livability assessment results corresponding to the urban livability schemes, and determining the optimal urban livability scheme according to the comparison results. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention improves the rationality, the simplicity and the accuracy of determining the urban livability scheme.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for constructing weight matrix
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for constructing a weight matrix. The method comprises the following steps: taking each observation unit in the observed object as a target unit one by one; for each target unit, determining whether each observation unit in the observed object and the target unit meet a square adjacency relation or not; if the three-dimensional space weight matrix is satisfied, taking the observation unit as an adjacent unit, and assigning matrix elements corresponding to the target unit and the observation unit in the pre-constructed three-dimensional space weight matrix as a first numerical value; if the number of the target units and the number of the observation units do not meet the preset value, matrix elements corresponding to the target units and the observation units in the preset three-dimensional space weight matrix are assigned to be second numerical values, wherein the preset three-dimensional space weight matrix is a square matrix taking the number of the observation units as the number of rows and the number of columns. The embodiment of the invention solves the problem of larger error of the distance weight matrix, and improves the calculation accuracy of the space metering economic model.

title_en: Conveying condition estimating system
abstract_en: The conveyance condition estimation system (1) is provided with: a storage unit (102) for storing container information in which a container ID and loading cargo information including at least information indicating the loading time and loading location of each cargo contained in a container (60) are associated with each other; an input unit (101) for receiving the input of tracking information; a determination unit (103) for determining which cargo of the tracking object corresponds to the cargo of the loading cargo information based on the loading time and the loading location of each cargo included in the loading cargo information and the loading time and the loading location of the tracking object included in the tracking information, and for determining the container ID of the container (60) containing the determined cargo based on the container information, and an estimation unit (104) for estimating the transportation state of the cargo of the tracking object based on the container ID determined by the determination unit (103).

title_en: Method for quantifying boundary overlapping features of natural protected area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quantizing boundary overlapping features of a natural protected area, which comprises the following steps: s1, classifying boundaries of different types of natural protection grounds; s2, extracting boundary overlapping areas of different types of natural protected areas; s3, calculating the absolute overlapping rate of each natural protection place and other natural protection places; s4, calculating the absolute overlapping number of each natural protection place and other natural protection places; s5, acquiring a continuous overlapping area model based on the absolute overlapping number; and S6, carrying out grade and category division according to the continuous overlapping region model to obtain the aggregation characteristics of each region. The invention can provide a quantitative method for the overlapping characteristics and the relations of the space boundaries of different types of natural reserve areas, systematically clear the complex cross overlapping relations of the natural reserve areas, provide scientific basis for space planning and layout selection of the natural reserve area system, and provide a data calculation method for the optimization and integration of the natural reserve areas and the national park construction.

title_en: Method for creating node group and transaction based on node group in alliance chain network
abstract_en: A method of creating node groups in a federated chain network based on node group transactions is disclosed. The manager of the first node in the federated chain network may initiate a group creation transaction through its own federated chain account, the group creation transaction comprising a group creation sub-transaction. After the group creation transaction is broadcast to the federated chain network, the first node, upon executing the group creation transaction, creates a private chain locally from the group creation sub-transaction, equivalent to creating a node group containing the first node. While other nodes do not create private chains locally when executing the set of creation transactions. Eventually both the first node and the other nodes will write the set of created transactions to the local federation chain. By the scheme, the privacy of service data of node butt joint can be protected.

title_en: Android cc + + three-party library management based on private software warehouse
abstract_en: The invention discloses an android cc + + three-party library management based on a private software warehouse, which comprises the following steps: compiling the source code through the purchased library code or the free library code; establishing and generating a private software warehouse with a library file format of deb; downloading an ffmpeg source code, and compiling to generate an ffmpeg-3.0.0.deb packet; when an application developer develops, a dpkg install ffmpeg-head command is operated, and a file is installed locally; when the android application installation package is compiled, operating a dpkg install mpeg-level command; download header files and compiled libraries. The method can be used for centralized compiling, the cc + + library used in the android application development process is used, respective compiling by research personnel is avoided, the time consumed in the compiling process is short, and manpower resources are saved by centralized compiling. And the compiled libraries are referred by the self-defined configuration file, so that the dependency relationship among the libraries is solved. The compiled library file does not exist in the code warehouse, software developers can carry out unit testing locally, and the compiled library is downloaded and packaged only during integration testing.

title_en: Civil aviation passenger source data analysis method, electronic equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a civil aviation passenger source data analysis method, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring LBS data corresponding to a mobile phone identification number according to the mobile phone identification number of a historical passenger; s2, taking the mobile phone identification numbers as statistical dimensions, and analyzing the liveness of each mobile phone identification number; s3, performing aggregation on the flight data and the LBS data by taking the start-stop places and the start-stop times as aggregation conditions; s4, sorting the association degree of the mobile phone identification number and the flight data, selecting the flight data with the association degree sorted in the front, and determining the corresponding relation between the flight data and the mobile phone identification number; s5, the corresponding relation is subjected to data processing and model adaptation suitable for specific business scenes, and a user portrait is formed. The invention gathers LBS data and flight data to form user portraits, which is provided for airports, thereby not only facilitating the travel of passengers, but also improving the efficiency of resource scheduling and decision execution in all aspects of airports and increasing economic benefits.

title_en: Quick-witted detection device, terminal equipment and vehicle tear open
abstract_en: The invention provides a dismantling detection device, terminal equipment and a vehicle, wherein the dismantling detection device comprises: the scanning equipment is arranged on the outer surface of the shell of the terminal equipment and used for scanning and learning the surrounding environment and generating the feature code, and the terminal equipment is vehicle-mounted terminal equipment; and the comparator is connected with the scanning equipment and used for comparing whether the feature code is consistent with the preset standard feature code or not, and if not, the terminal equipment is determined to be disconnected. According to the disassembling detection device, the terminal equipment and the vehicle, when the feature code generated by the scanning equipment is inconsistent with the preset standard feature code, the comparator determines that the terminal equipment is disassembled, so that whether the terminal equipment is disassembled can be accurately detected, and the terminal equipment is not easy to crack.

title_en: Traffic processing method and device based on diversion and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the present specification provides a traffic processing method based on flow guidance, which includes monitoring operation information of a user on a flow guidance entry, configuring an entry identifier for the user if the monitored operation information indicates that the user clicks the flow guidance entry, providing a page for participating in a service, enabling the user to carry the entry identifier to participate in the service, acquiring operation behavior information generated by the user participating in the service, generating service information carrying the entry identifier for the user by using the carried entry identifier, restoring conversion effect data of each flow guidance entry by using the entry identifier carried in each service information, and adjusting an input strategy by using the conversion effect data. Since the service information can reflect the actual delivery effect, the entry identifier is carried in the service information when the user participates in the service by monitoring and configuring the entry identifier for the user, the flow guide entry can be traced back to the service information, and then the delivery strategy is adjusted, so that the management level of the delivery strategy can be improved.

title_en: Information processing method, apparatus and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an information processing method, an information processing device and a storage medium, wherein after an operation instruction represented by a node comprising a node to be processed is received, the node to be processed is determined from pre-constructed graph information according to the node identification of the node to be processed, and because the graph information comprises identification information of a plurality of nodes and attribute information of a plurality of edges which are stored in an array mode, the node to be processed can be directly determined from the array, each node is not required to be traversed in a linked list in sequence, and all the outbound nodes corresponding to the same inbound node are stored in the same array; or, all the incoming degree nodes corresponding to the same outgoing degree node are stored in the same array, so that all the outgoing degree nodes corresponding to the outgoing degree node or all the incoming degree nodes corresponding to the outgoing degree node can be determined in the array, the determination efficiency of the nodes is improved, and the information processing efficiency is improved when the determined nodes to be processed are processed.

title_en: Storage guide lamp management system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent warehousing management and discloses a warehousing guide lamp management system and method. The warehousing guide lamp management system comprises a workstation, a control terminal and a plurality of guide lamps; the workstation is in communication connection with the control terminal and is used for sending a task instruction to the control terminal; the control terminal is in communication connection with the guide lamps and is used for receiving the task instructions and controlling the display states of the corresponding guide lamps according to the task instructions; the guide lamp is installed in the first preset position that corresponds the goods position, and the display state of guide lamp is used for the storage position state or the access state of sign goods position. The warehouse guide lamp management system provided by the invention can combine communication signals, control the display state of the guide lamp through the control terminal, quickly guide workers to find the goods position of the goods to be stored and taken, and grasp the storage position state of the warehouse in real time, thereby improving the warehousing efficiency and reliability of the goods.

title_en: AGV application system based on industry internet platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AGV application system based on an industrial Internet platform, which comprises an AGV robot, a scheduling system, a tooling system, a visual system, an intelligent goods shelf control terminal, a lamp tube and an intelligent goods shelf, wherein the scheduling system is arranged on the AGV robot and used for receiving industrial Internet data information commands and issuing the industrial Internet data information commands, the tooling system is arranged on the AGV robot and used for unloading and loading materials after receiving AGV commands, the visual system is arranged on the AGV robot and used for scanning so as to determine coordinate values and distance values and then issuing the commands to the tooling system, the intelligent goods shelf control terminal, the lamp tube is arranged on a storage position of each intelligent goods shelf, and the intelligent goods shelf control terminal is connected with the lamp tube; the automatic material feeding system has the advantages that the dispatching system issues instructions to the AGV robot, automatic feeding is achieved, and then the visual system on the automatic material feeding system is matched with the intelligent goods shelf management system and the intelligent goods shelf control terminal, so that automatic feeding, material preparation and query operations of materials on the goods shelves are achieved.

title_en: Method and device for presenting agricultural big data search results based on machine learning engine
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for presenting agricultural big data search results based on a machine learning engine, which comprises the following steps: agricultural information matched with the current search word is searched in the agricultural large database based on the current search word of the user, and the search result is presented in a process logic visualization mode, namely the quality of the agricultural information search process is evaluated in five dimensions of accuracy, relevance, filtering degree, maturity and freshness, and is additionally presented in the search result in a quantitative scoring mode. Meanwhile, the invention provides a machine learning engine device aiming at agricultural big data search, and the device can provide technical support for agricultural big data search result process logic visualization.

title_en: Supply chain logistics cloud system based on software as a service (SaaS)
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses supply chain logistics cloud system based on SaaS, and the cloud system comprises: the supplier management subsystem is used for receiving goods supply information sent by at least one supplier node; and further configured to determine a priority order of the at least one supplier based on the at least one supplier credit rating; the goods receiving party management subsystem is used for receiving the goods demand information sent by at least one goods receiving node; the system is also used for determining the priority order of at least one receiver according to the qualification grade and the credit grade of at least one receiver; and the transaction management subsystem is used for matching the goods supply information with the goods demand information, generating transaction recommendation information after the goods supply information is successfully matched with the goods demand information, and respectively sending the transaction recommendation information to the at least one supply node and the at least one receiving node. By the aid of the method and the device, accuracy of information can be improved, information matching efficiency of two parties is improved, and intelligent degree of supply chain management is improved.

title_en: Block chain data storage method and device and block chain link points
abstract_en: The specification provides a block chain data storage method and a block chain node. One embodiment of the method comprises: the block chain link point executes the transaction of creating/calling the contract, and generates the state related to the block chain external account to be stored; and storing the state related to the blockchain external account to be stored into a state storage of the corresponding blockchain external account. Through the embodiment of the specification, the access of the blockchain system to the external accounts can be dispersed into the state storage of each external account, so that the problem of single account hot spots can be avoided. Meanwhile, the load pressure stored by each external account is relatively low, and the performance of the whole block chain system can be improved.

title_en: Financial data accounting method, device, equipment and storage medium based on equity
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a financial data accounting method, device, equipment and storage medium based on equity, and relates to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a financial accounting instruction; determining a target object to be accounted and inquiring employment information; selecting different accounting strategies according to different occupational states; if the occupation state is in-position, calling a first accounting strategy; acquiring reserved associated information and first target information from the employment information, and calling a first calculation formula; calculating the accumulated cost to be confirmed; if the occupation state is retired, calling a second accounting strategy; executing a second accounting strategy, acquiring second target information, and calling a second calculation formula; the cumulative cost to be confirmed is calculated. According to the method, the employees in different occupational states are divided into different accounting types, the system computing logic is optimized, the data computing efficiency is improved, and the cost amortization condition can be accurately accounted during statistics for different employees with shares for a long time.

title_en: Method and device for processing enterprise credit investigation data, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a processing method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium of enterprise credit investigation data, wherein a transaction request sent by a target enterprise client is obtained, and the transaction request carries a target enterprise identifier, an associated bank identifier and transaction operation information; and establishing an association relation between the target enterprise and an associated bank according to the target enterprise identifier and the associated bank identifier, and updating the resource quantity in the enterprise credit investigation account according to the transaction operation information and the intelligent contract through the association relation, so that the problem of information asynchronization between the bank and the enterprise is effectively solved, and the data security sharing between different banks can be ensured.

title_en: Earth surface information prediction method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for predicting earth surface information, and relates to the technical field of earth surface prediction. In the present application, first, a surface information prediction model is constructed based on a graph neural network and a recurrent neural network. And secondly, updating the earth surface information prediction model based on the obtained multiple sample information sets to obtain an updated earth surface information prediction model, wherein the multiple sample information sets acquire information of the target area at multiple historical times. And then, carrying out prediction processing on the target earth surface information based on the updated earth surface information prediction model to obtain predicted earth surface information. Based on the method, the problem of low reliability of the prediction result in the existing surface prediction technology can be solved.

title_en: Poultry breeding record analysis method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a breeding device of a poultry breeding recording and analyzing method, which comprises a breeding cage, wherein a separation net is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the breeding cage, the separation net divides the breeding cage into a plurality of breeding chambers, feeding dishes are fixed to the sides of the bottom ends of the breeding chambers on the front side and the back side, which are opposite to the sides, respectively, a collecting channel is connected between the bottom sides of the two breeding chambers on the same vertical position in a penetrating manner, an electronic scale is fixedly connected to the middle part of the inner bottom surface of the collecting channel, a through hole is formed in the rear side of the inner bottom surface of the collecting channel, a detection table is connected to the inner wall of the through hole in a sliding manner, an installation dish is fixedly connected to the. The invention has reasonable design and convenient data acquisition, greatly improves the accuracy of data analysis by analyzing and comparing the data through a computer, and is convenient to reject the breeding which does not meet the requirement after analysis, thereby greatly improving the quality of poultry cultivation.

title_en: Task allocation method and device for vehicle, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a task allocation method and device for a vehicle, a computer device and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a task time interval and demand information in the task time interval; the task time interval at least comprises a first task time interval and a second task time interval, and the tasks required to be executed in the first task time interval and the second task time interval are different; distributing processing tasks for the vehicles according to the task time interval and the demand information; wherein the processing task is used for processing the requirement information. The method can improve the utilization rate of the vehicles.

title_en: Traffic accident handling and scheduling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traffic accident handling and scheduling system, when the staff of the traffic management department receives the traffic accident alarm call, the related information of the traffic accident is known, and the traffic accident information is recorded into the system, the system firstly acquires the current working state of the traffic police on duty in real time through the terminal equipment carried by the traffic police on duty, including executing tasks and patrolling, then the position data of the traffic police on duty in the patrolling state is collected again, the distance between the traffic accident position and each traffic police on duty is calculated, the traffic police on duty which is closest to the traffic accident position and patrols is selected, the traffic accident handling tasks are issued to the terminal equipment, and the traffic accident handling tasks are guided to the traffic accident site for handling, the invention utilizes the technology of Internet of things, realizes the monitoring and intelligent scheduling handling of the traffic accident, ensures the timely handling of the traffic accident, saves manpower and material resources and has good social benefit and development prospect.

title_en: Information processing method, device and system
abstract_en: The application discloses an information processing method, a device and a system, comprising the following steps: presenting information to be checked, wherein the information to be checked comprises a first check message; acquiring second check-up information input by a user; when it is determined that first verification information in the information to be verified is consistent with second verification information input by a user, a preset processing operation is executed based on the information to be verified. Therefore, as the first verification information is located in the information to be verified, when the second verification information input by the user is consistent with the first verification information in the information to be verified, it indicates that the user has browsed the information to be verified carefully and determines the verification information from the information to be verified, and the accuracy of the information to be verified can be ensured under the condition that the user browses the information to be verified, so that the safety of subsequent operation on the information to be verified can be improved.

title_en: Intelligent classification method for tower inspection information
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent classification method for tower inspection information, which comprises the steps of positioning a tower signboard in each tower signboard image; extracting and correcting the pole and tower signboard to form a new pole and tower signboard; identifying signboard texts in each new tower signboard; and classifying and storing the texts of the signboard so as to finish the intelligent classification method of the tower inspection information. The invention can effectively detect, position and extract the pole and tower signboard in the image, and correct the pole and tower signboard, thereby improving the accuracy of subsequent recognition.

title_en: Information processing method, system, information server and information display client
abstract_en: The invention discloses an information processing method, an information server, an information display client, a system and related equipment. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring configuration data content aiming at information; determining a preset protocol rule, and generating a description protocol for information according to the configuration data content and the protocol rule; the method comprises the steps of sending a description protocol of information to an information display client, wherein the information display client analyzes the description protocol of the information to generate information rendering data, renders the information according to the information rendering data and displays the rendered information content. According to the method, the description protocol for the information is generated by the configuration data content of the acquired information through the unified protocol rule, then the protocol is sent to the information showing client, and the information showing client analyzes the description protocol of the information through the unified protocol rule, so that the difference of the product line client technology is shielded, the unified style is very convenient to modify, and the efficiency of developers is improved.

title_en: Performance and equity management system, method and equipment based on score verification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a performance and equity management system, a method and equipment based on score verification, wherein the system comprises a server, and the server is provided with the following modules: the setting module is used for setting performance assessment standards for enterprises; the data acquisition module is used for acquiring the original data of each employee; the original data comprises working data and information data; a management module to: obtaining a first assessment result according to the working data and by combining the performance and equity assessment standards; obtaining a second assessment result according to the information data and by combining the performance and equity assessment standards; carrying out data aggregation on each assessment result and then displaying an output result; the beneficial effects are as follows: the objective contribution value of a worker is accurately reflected by using objective working data and information data as basic contents, the lever effect of the system is prominent, subjective factors and artificial factors can be effectively removed, the whole system is automatically operated, the manual intervention is less, and the processing efficiency is high.

title_en: Method for selecting address of power wireless private network base station and related equipment
abstract_en: One or more embodiments of the present specification provide a method for selecting an address of a power wireless private network base station and related equipment, where the method includes: design calculation expression R [ S, A ] of reward function](ii) a Initializing relevant parameters and defining state space And the motion space (ii) a Randomly selecting a base station planning state S; selecting a base station planning action A according to a greedy strategy E-greedy; executing the base station planning action A and reaching a new state S' at the next moment; transferring the planning state of the base station to a sample [ S, A, R, S']Storing the base station planning experience playback pool; calculating a base station planning target Q value and updating a loss function; updating the base station planning target Q neural network parameter omega every other C moments  ‑  (ii) a Planning a target Q value according to the final output base stationAnd obtaining the site selection result of the optimal power wireless private network base station. The method solves the base station site selection problem through the DQN algorithm, and can further improve the convergence performance while realizing the solution of the high-dimensional large-scale site selection problem.

title_en: Mobile auxiliary paper marking system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile auxiliary scoring system and a method, wherein the system comprises: the authorization login module is used for activating to complete registration, authorizing and allowing login after the mobile equipment scans the two-dimensional code which is legally obtained and successfully authorized; the operation module is used for controlling the closing of the wireless network module on the mobile equipment by the file server application program on the mobile equipment; the management module is used for operating the file server according to the operation module and managing files in the file server; the marking module is used for operating the file server according to the operation module and marking the files in the file server; and the evidence proof module is used for sorting out corresponding evidence in the evidence plate block from the file in the file server according to the management module and the marking module, and the evidence plate block generates a review report text which can be used for court evidence according to the operation module. The invention improves the current situations of high office cost, inconvenient terminal carrying and unsafe data transmission of a system of a monitoring hospital, and effectively utilizes scattered time to improve the business.

title_en: Marketing strategy matching method, system and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marketing strategy matching method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring characteristic data, consumption behavior data and marketing strategy data of a client to be analyzed; determining association degree data between different characteristics and consumption behaviors according to the characteristic data and the consumption behavior data, determining target characteristics from the different characteristics according to the association degree data, and determining a client with the target characteristics in the clients to be analyzed as a target client; and determining sensitivity data of the target client to different marketing strategies according to the characteristic data, the consumption behavior data and the marketing strategy data, and determining a target marketing strategy matched with the target client from the different marketing strategies according to the sensitivity data. The invention also discloses a marketing strategy matching system and a computer readable storage medium. And the target client is determined through the association degree data, and the target marketing strategy is determined through the sensitivity data, so that marketing is purposeful, and the marketing effect is improved.

title_en: Error reporting information processing method and device
abstract_en: One or more embodiments of the present disclosure provide an error information processing method and apparatus, including obtaining error information, determining a problem keyword according to the error information, querying a preset problem processing table according to the problem keyword, and obtaining a problem positioning result; the problem processing table comprises problem keywords and corresponding problem positioning results, and problem solving ways are output according to the problem positioning results. The method of the embodiment can greatly simplify the processing flow of the error reporting information, improve the timeliness of problem processing and improve the working efficiency.

title_en: Household appliance leasing control method and device, household appliance and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application also provides a household appliance leasing control method and device, a household appliance and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring first identity verification information of the first control module; verifying the validity of the first control module based on the first identity verification information; the validity of the first control module is verified, and the first control module is allowed to control the locking and unlocking of the household appliance; and if the validity verification of the first control module fails, the control operation of the first control module on the locking and unlocking of the household appliance is forbidden. Therefore, the first control module is provided with the identity authentication information, whether the first control module is the exclusive control module of the household appliance is monitored according to the first identity authentication information, the situation that unlocking and locking control functions are invalid due to manual change of the first control module, normal leasing control operation is influenced can be avoided, and safety and reliability of leasing control are improved.

title_en: Intelligent compatibility system for hazardous waste
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hazardous waste disposal, and provides an intelligent hazardous waste compatibility system which aims to solve the problem that when a compatibility system is used for compatibility at present, for a certain type of special hazardous waste, when no hazardous waste matched with the compatibility system is stored in an inventory, the hazardous waste cannot be disposed in time; the storage module is also preset with a classification rule for classifying the hazardous wastes according to the analysis data; the classification module is used for classifying the dangerous waste in the storehouse according to the classification rule; the storage module prestores inventory thresholds of different types of hazardous wastes; the statistical module is used for counting the classified stock of the similar dangerous wastes to obtain a stock statistical value; the comparison module is used for comparing the inventory statistic value and the inventory threshold value of the similar hazardous wastes; and the prompt module is used for sending the supplement prompt information of the corresponding dangerous wastes when the comparison export inventory statistic value is smaller than the inventory threshold value.

title_en: Sequence recommendation method for knowledge distillation based on land moving distance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sequence recommendation method for knowledge distillation based on land mobile distance, which comprises the following steps: constructing a teacher model and a corresponding student model; training a teacher model by taking the set loss function as a target to obtain a pre-training teacher model; fixing parameters of the pre-training teacher model, adding the student model for collaborative training, and only optimizing parameters of the student model to distill knowledge of the pre-training teacher model into the student model, wherein in the knowledge distillation process, a many-to-many mapping relation between a middle hidden layer of the pre-training teacher model and a middle hidden layer of the student model is adaptively learned by utilizing land movement distance; and using the trained student model and taking the historical browsing sequence of the user as input to provide a sequence recommendation service for the user. The student model obtained by the invention can obviously reduce the parameter scale without losing precision, thereby providing quick and accurate recommendation service for users.

title_en: Underground space development suitability evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an underground space development suitability evaluation method and system, wherein the method is used for establishing an underground space three-dimensional voxel coordinate system sigma of an evaluation area 0 In the 2000 national geodetic coordinate system Σ 1 Find the coordinate system sigma 0 Is in the coordinate system sigma 1 Establishing a coordinate system sigma 0 And a coordinate system Σ 1 Affine transformation relation; establishing a two-dimensional earth surface grid coordinate system sigma s Forming a grid set G in the evaluation area, recording the grid G (x, y) epsilon G, and forming a set V by the underground space voxels xy (ii) a Building a data structure T (x, y, I) based on g (x, y) to describe a subsurface space voxel set V xy Each evaluation index data; carrying out sensitivity classification on the evaluation indexes, and dividing the evaluation indexes into general indexes and sensitive indexes; comprehensively evaluating the general indexes through quantitative indexes and qualitative indexes, and calculating evaluation values of the general indexes; increasing the weight of index with too low or extremely high evaluation value, adjusting to obtain the comprehensive evaluation value of the evaluation unit, and dividing underground space suitability evaluation according to the valueAnd in the stage, the method realizes three-dimensional fine evaluation of the development suitability of the underground space.

title_en: Block generation and verification method and device, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a block generation and verification method, a block generation and verification device, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the block composition of a block chain is modified, so that the xth block contains a world state achieved after the transaction in the xth-d blocks is executed, parallel processing (although delayed execution) of transaction execution logic and consensus logic of the blocks is realized, and the world state is immediately available without waiting when the block generation and verification are carried out in the consensus process. Therefore, the performance of the whole block chain is basically unrelated to the transaction time complexity, the transaction quantity contained in the block is not limited by the time complexity of transaction execution any more, and the performance of the whole block chain can be greatly improved because the transaction execution does not need to be waited.

title_en: Verification method for authenticity of waste resource regeneration transaction
abstract_en: A method for verifying the authenticity of a waste resource regeneration transaction comprises the following steps: 1) Developing a renewable resource transaction platform according to a computer and the Internet; 2) Transporting waste resource materials through a logistics platform to generate waybill information; 3) Positioning at a recycling site through a bank, and generating transaction information and payment money; 4) The method comprises the steps of regularly obtaining waybill information and transaction information, binding in one-to-one correspondence, and matching transaction time with transaction geographic positions; 6) Further judging the authenticity of the transaction, judging whether the payment transaction time and the transaction place are in an error range with the picking time and the picking place of the bill, and if so, judging the transaction as the real transaction; 7) Initiating an invoice application instead of a recycle bin, and requesting the recycle bin to confirm; 8) Initiating an invoice application to a tax system, and returning a pre-application number of the invoice to a renewable resource transaction platform by the tax system through verification; 9) The renewable resource enterprises send out value-added tax special invoices to the tax bureau by means of the invoice pre-application number.

title_en: High-efficiency high-safety report distribution method and device for banking industry
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency high-safety report distribution method and a device for banking industry, which belong to the technical field of data safety and solve the problem that source data is easy to leak because a report directly transmits the source data in the prior art, and comprise the following steps: recording the report type and the report content required by the client user at the user terminal, and generating the report type and the report content required by the user from the source data by the server terminal; the server side updates the report type and the report content regularly; the bank staff applies for obtaining the report at the user terminal according to the report requirement of the user, the server terminal generates a visual report picture according to the corresponding report type and the report content according to the identity information of the bank staff and the report requirement, and sends the visual report picture to the user terminal in an encryption mode; and the user side receives the visual report picture and then displays the visual report containing the background watermark of the user identification code or the user information.

title_en: Train simulation task configuration method, device, equipment and storage medium
