abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for configuring a train simulation task, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of displaying at least one running line of a target train according to input scene task adding operation of the target train, loading a station yard graph corresponding to the target running line according to input selection operation aiming at the target running line, displaying the target train at a station where a first signal machine is located in the station yard graph according to input train adding operation aiming at the first signal machine in the station yard graph, and creating environment item point information at a first position on the station yard graph according to first item point editing operation aiming at the first position in the station yard graph, wherein the environment item point information is used for representing a simulation environment of the target train simulating an approach at the first position on the target running line. According to the scene task editing method and device, the scene task is edited in a visual mode of the station yard graph, so that a user can add trains at specified stations on the station yard graph, and the configuration efficiency of the scene task is improved.

title_en: Coupon pushing method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coupon pushing method, a coupon pushing system, coupon pushing equipment and a coupon pushing storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: generating a commodity coupon when a commodity settlement request is received; acquiring user order information according to the commodity settlement request; and pushing the commodity coupons matched with the user order information to the user. The method and the device solve the problems that the conventional way for pushing the coupons by merchants is not targeted and the repurchase rate of customers is difficult to improve, realize targeted pushing of the product coupons to users, and are beneficial to promoting the consumption enthusiasm of the users.

title_en: Middle and high-office integrated data co-control management application system based on epidemic situation prevention and control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a middle and high-office integrated data co-control management application system based on epidemic prevention and control, and relates to the field of big data management application platforms. The system comprises: the system comprises a preposed library server, a resource library server and a business library server, wherein the resource library server comprises encryption equipment, a data sorting module, a ticket box module, a data distribution module and a reader-writer. According to the invention, under an epidemic situation prevention and control environment, various information data of students and teaching staff in a middle and high school are integrally and cooperatively managed and controlled under a big data framework system, so that the management efficiency is improved, the collected data is encrypted by using a resource library server, the safety and privacy of the data are ensured, the data are sorted, packaged and distributed and then written into a business library server through a reader-writer, the data management mode is optimized, the utilization rate and response time of the resource library server are improved, the complexity of data management is reduced, and the efficiency of operation and maintenance is improved.

title_en: Dangerous chemical library construction method based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dangerous chemical library construction method based on a knowledge graph, which comprises the following steps: step 1, constructing a dangerous chemical data set; step 2: determining the basic attribute of the chemical according to the content of the established chemical knowledge graph, and determining accident risk information used; step 3, establishing a risk information extraction model: and designing a neural network model taking AlBert as a pre-training model as an extraction risk information model. The invention has the beneficial effects that: four parts are extracted from the risk information describing dangerous chemicals by utilizing the strong expression capacity of deep learning, all data can be directly extracted after a model is trained, and the step of manually screening text information is omitted; the problem that only the periphery is concerned but the whole situation is not concerned in the training process is avoided, and correct entities can be more effectively extracted from sentences; various kinds of information of the chemicals are stored in a knowledge base in a knowledge map mode, and the information can be consulted more conveniently.

title_en: Comprehensive energy consumption optimization method, medium and device based on attention mechanism LSTM
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive energy consumption optimization method, medium and equipment based on an attention mechanism LSTM, which are used for sending an energy-saving strategy matrix consisting of environment data, a terminal controller set value and a machine room equipment working state into an LSTM network added with the attention mechanism to train a building comprehensive energy consumption prediction model to obtain the building comprehensive energy consumption prediction model; establishing an optimization model for comprehensive energy consumption aiming at commercial buildings by combining the comprehensive energy time-sharing price standard and the energy-saving strategy matrix value constraint condition; and solving a comprehensive energy cost optimization model of the commercial building by adopting a genetic algorithm, calculating an energy-saving strategy matrix which corresponds to the least consumption of k time periods in the future, and adjusting the set value of each end controller and the working state of the refrigerating machine room equipment in the k time periods in the future according to the value of the energy-saving strategy matrix so as to minimize the comprehensive energy cost in the k time periods in the future. And (3) formulating an energy use scheme with the lowest cost for k time periods in the future of the building through solving the model.

title_en: Cross-chain transaction processing method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for processing cross-chain transactions, wherein the method is suitable for the cross-chain transactions of N +1 participants on M +1 block chains, N and M are positive integers, N is greater than or equal to M, and the method specifically comprises the following steps: if the first participant determines that the transaction triggering conditions of the transaction triggering transactions to be executed on the M +1 block chains of the cross-chain transfer transaction are all preset transaction triggering conditions, then for each block chain in the M +1 block chains, calling a target intelligent contract on the block chain according to a first transaction triggering parameter of the first transaction triggering transaction; and after the target intelligent contract is successfully called, executing the corresponding transaction triggering transaction of the preset transaction triggering condition on the block chain. When the method is applied to financial technology (Fintech), as long as one block chain is successful, the preset transaction triggering conditions on other block chains are met, and the credibility problem does not exist.

title_en: Multi-path multi-target emergency material distribution path selection method based on SHADE algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a differential evolution (SHADE) algorithm based on success history adaptive parameters, which is used for searching emergency rescue paths of emergency supplies and mainly comprises the following steps: by learning the cross rate and the variation rate of successful individuals in the differential evolution algorithm, the method can find a more superior path. In order to search more equivalent emergency material rescue scheduling paths, the fitness sharing mechanism is simultaneously used in a target space and a decision space to ensure the diversity of the paths, provide various feasible paths for a user to select, and avoid the condition that a single path cannot pass due to some sudden reason. The invention not only can search the optimal emergency goods and materials rescue scheduling path meeting the target condition, but also can provide a plurality of equivalent paths, thereby providing guarantee for sending emergency goods and materials to the destination for rescue at the first time.

title_en: Job shop scheduling method based on Keras
abstract_en: The Keras-based job shop scheduling method comprises the following steps: (1) defining a job shop scheduling problem; (2) constructing a network model; (3) and loading the DQN classes of the job shop scheduling problem. The invention integrates a neural network and Q learning method to optimize the scheduling problem of the job shop. The state and the action of the job shop scheduling in practical application are taken as the input of the neural network, and then the Q value of the action is obtained after the neural network analysis, so that the memory of the computer can be greatly optimized, and the original more complex problem can be simplified. The experience playback mechanism of the deep Q learning algorithm can sequentially store experience data generated by interaction of an intelligent agent in the environment into an experience pool with a fixed size, a small batch of data is randomly extracted from the experience pool to learn during each iteration of the algorithm, and the mode of randomly extracting the data from the experience pool breaks through the strong correlation of original sequence data, improves the stability of the algorithm and improves the utilization efficiency of the data.

title_en: Generator intelligent agent and quotation method based on depth certainty strategy gradient algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a generator agent and a quotation method based on a depth certainty strategy gradient algorithm, wherein the agent comprises: the depth certainty strategy gradient algorithm network construction module is used for establishing an Experience playback library which consists of a depth Actor network, a depth Critic network and an Experience playback memory; and the exploratory quotation action generating module is used for establishing a market bidding model of the power generator in the electric energy, selecting quotation action according to the established market bidding model based on the result calculated by the Current Actor Network, submitting the quotation of the power generator to ISO for clearing, and storing the Current state, quotation coefficient, reward and new state of the power generator intelligent agent corresponding to the clearing into an expert Replay memory. The dynamic quotation strategy of the generator under the incomplete information is searched by a deep reinforcement learning method, and the dynamic quotation strategy is an efficient quotation decision tool and is beneficial to the generator to accurately quote in the electric power market.

title_en: Environment weather observation device, pollution grade determining system and method
abstract_en: The application discloses an environmental meteorological observation device and a system and a method for determining pollution levels. The weather sensing mechanism is used for acquiring weather monitoring data. The particulate matter sensing mechanism is used for acquiring particulate matter concentration monitoring data. The centralized control mechanism is used for collecting and processing the meteorological monitoring data and the particulate matter concentration monitoring data. The environment weather observation device can be used for predicting the pollution level of the insulator in the windblown sand arid area, and has higher accuracy, thereby providing a basis for external insulation design and preventing the insulator from pollution flashover.

title_en: Order method and device, computer storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to an order distribution method and device and a computer storage medium, and relates to the technical field of computers. The order distribution method comprises the following steps: dividing a plurality of orders into a first order set and a second order set according to attributes; determining a first order set to be delivered according to the area where each order of the first order set is located, and delivering orders according to the first order set to be delivered; and planning a path according to the position relationship between the positions of the orders in the second order set and the position relationship between the position of each order and the position of the distribution starting point, determining a second order set to be distributed and a path to be distributed thereof, and distributing the orders according to the path to be distributed. According to the method and the device, different order distribution modes are adopted for different orders, and distribution efficiency is improved.

title_en: Satellite cloud picture prediction method based on depth cross-scale extrapolation fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a satellite cloud picture prediction method based on depth cross-scale extrapolation fusion, which comprises the following steps: constructing a training set observation cloud picture sequence; adjusting the size proportion of observation cloud pictures in the training set observation cloud picture sequence to obtain a training set multi-scale cloud picture sequence; inputting the training set multi-scale cloud picture sequence into a depth prediction network for training to obtain multi-scale depth prediction model parameters; taking the training set observation cloud picture sequence as an input, and outputting a training set multi-scale prediction cloud picture by a multi-scale depth prediction model; amplifying the training set multi-scale prediction cloud picture to the size of the observation cloud picture to obtain a training set adjustment prediction cloud picture; obtaining multi-scale prediction cloud picture fusion model parameters; and inputting the real-time observation cloud picture sequence serving as operation data into the multi-scale depth prediction model and the multi-scale prediction cloud picture fusion model, and outputting a prediction result cloud picture. The method can realize the prediction of the satellite cloud picture sequence with high definition and high accuracy.

title_en: Yield determination method, determination device, computer readable storage medium and processor
abstract_en: The application provides a yield determination method, a determination device, a computer readable storage medium and a processor, wherein the determination method comprises the following steps: training a fully-connected neural network by adopting training data to obtain a plurality of first weight matrixes, wherein the first weight matrixes are weight matrixes connecting any two adjacent network layers; calculating the sensitivity of the variable according to the weight matrix; determining a sensitive variable according to the sensitivity, wherein the sensitive variable is a variable with the sensitivity larger than or equal to a preset value; and inputting the sensitive variable into a Deep end of the Wide & Deep model, and inputting the variable into a Wide end of the Wide & Deep model to obtain the natural gas yield, wherein the Wide end is a linear model, and the Deep end is a DNN neural network. The method for determining the Wide & Deep model improves the performance of the Wide & Deep model and improves the accuracy of the method for determining the Wide & Deep model.

title_en: Data analysis-based distribution room line loss electric energy monitoring system and monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses platform district line loss electric energy monitoring system and monitoring method based on data analysis includes: the electric energy transmission is completed by outputting the converted electric energy; acquiring the electric energy of the output end of the transformer area, and finishing the collection of the line loss of the transformer area; performing line distribution on the total line loss branch system to meet the electricity utilization requirement in the region; acquiring the electricity consumption in the area; an independent power supply line is provided for each user, and the safety of the power supply line is ensured; counting the electric energy consumption of the user to complete the calculation of the power consumption of the sub-branches; and acquiring the electric energy consumption of each user through a progressive architecture, and calculating the line loss of different areas. The line loss of the branch cable is obtained layer by adopting a progressive structure, the line loss of different branch paths is analyzed through a clustering algorithm, the calculation of the line loss path is improved, a user continuously searches an optimal solution influencing the output of the power grid operation data, and the loss of the power grid line is further optimized through searching the optimal solution.

title_en: Truck route planning method and device based on similar vehicle driving characteristic data
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for planning a truck route based on similar vehicle running characteristic data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: based on attribute data of the full trucks, clustering is carried out by adopting a KMeans algorithm, and all trucks are divided into different categories; KMeans clustering is carried out on the running times of all routes of all vehicles in the country based on real-time track data of all trucks, so that all routes are divided into a plurality of classes according to the running times; carrying out weighted sequencing on the speed limit value and the running times of the route to generate new route type data of each type of vehicle; selecting different types of route categories for the vehicle according to the length, the width, the height, the load and the number of axles of the vehicle, and selecting the route with the minimum total weight value as a planned route of the vehicle based on a weight function of the route categories. According to the method and the device, the actual running track of the full-scale truck is used as a key route planning characteristic, and a route suitable for the running of the truck is recommended for a user.

title_en: Block chain based transaction block output method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of block chains, and provides a block-chain-based transaction block-out method, which comprises the following steps: performing primary selection according to transaction identification information of transaction data in the transaction pool to obtain first primary selection transaction identification information; broadcasting and sending the first primary selection transaction identification information and the local block quality data to a block chain system; receiving second primary selection transaction identification information and corresponding node block quality data which are broadcast and sent by other nodes; screening the first primary selection transaction identification information; and generating final selection transaction identification information from the first primary selection transaction identification information after screening processing, packaging transaction data corresponding to the final selection transaction identification information into a block broadcast, and sending the block broadcast to the block chain system. Correspondingly, the application also provides a block trading system based on the block chain, a terminal device and a readable storage medium. By implementing the application, the resource loss can be reduced, and the duplicate removal efficiency is improved.

title_en: Method and device for monitoring suspicious transactions of anti-money laundering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for monitoring suspicious transactions of anti-money laundering, and relates to the technical field of computers. One embodiment of the method comprises: screening suspicious customers for the transaction to be monitored based on a rule model to obtain a first suspicious customer set, and screening suspicious customers for the transaction to be monitored based on a machine learning model to obtain a second suspicious customer set; filtering and screening the first suspicious client set by using a preset suspicious client screening rule to obtain a first target client in the first suspicious client set; acquiring intersection customers and second target customers according to other first suspicious customers and second suspicious customer sets in the first suspicious customer set; and generating suspicious reports according to the first target client, the second target client and the intersection client so as to carry out manual screening according to the suspicious reports. According to the implementation mode, the invalid alarm of the conventional rule model can be reduced under the condition of ensuring high recall rate, and the labor cost of a financial institution is saved.

title_en: Video cold picture prediction method and device based on space-time sequence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a video cold picture prediction method and a device based on a time-space sequence, wherein video metadata information of each film on each storage node in a monitoring time period is obtained through data analysis, and the video metadata information comprises basic attribute information and user behavior information of the film; constructing a space-time sequence decision model based on the storage space distribution characteristics of the film and the video metadata information; the space-time sequence decision model is used for calculating a cold film sequencing metric value of each film; and based on the obtained video metadata information of each film on each storage node, calculating a cold film sequencing metric value of each film in a monitoring time period by using the space-time sequence decision model, and further completing cold film prediction and elimination according to a calculation result. The technical problems of low efficiency, low accuracy, complex maintenance, low automation degree and the like of the traditional cold plate judging mechanism can be effectively solved.

title_en: Atmospheric pollution traceable diffusion analysis system and method based on Gaussian diffusion model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an atmospheric pollution tracing diffusion analysis system and method based on a Gaussian diffusion model.

title_en: Intelligent auxiliary assembly system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent auxiliary assembly system and method, which relate to the technical field of engineering machinery, wherein the intelligent auxiliary assembly system comprises an assembly platform, a design release client, integrated head-mounted equipment and a server, wherein the design release client, the integrated head-mounted equipment and the server are respectively in communication connection with the assembly platform; the server is connected with the automatic material distribution navigation device; the design and release client is used for releasing the three-dimensional model and the assembly process data of the mechanical equipment; the integrated head-wearing equipment is used for displaying a virtual scene of prototype assembly of the mechanical equipment; the server is used for storing the assembly process data and receiving the feedback information, and performing fusion calculation on the virtual scene and the real scene; the material distribution automatic navigation device is used for distributing materials to the assembly platform under the control of the server. The invention reduces the degree of dependence on the experience of workers in field assembly when trial production and small-batch production of a prototype are carried out, greatly saves time cost, improves assembly efficiency and avoids long-time field guidance of designers.

title_en: Polishing path planning method based on machine vision
abstract_en: The invention relates to a grinding path planning method based on machine vision, which comprises the following steps: (1) positioning of robot coordinates and machine vision; (2) fixing a workpiece to be polished; (3) visual scanning; (4) fitting data; (5) Debugging feedback, namely observing whether the polishing parameters are abnormal or not, and completing debugging if the polishing parameters are abnormal; if the abnormality exists, entering the step (6); (6) Replacing the data fitting mode for fitting to obtain another polishing processing path, debugging the feedback again and entering the step (7) if the feedback is abnormal; (7) And increasing the number of point positions, and fitting by selecting a data fitting mode in the database again to obtain a new polishing processing path for debugging. The invention combines the machine vision with the path planning of data fitting, debugs and plans the polishing path through a polishing parameter feedback mechanism, and performs the polishing according to the smooth polishing path when the consistency of workpieces is poor, thereby obtaining good polishing quality.

title_en: User recommendation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a user recommendation method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: drawing the pulse recommendation data aiming at the recommended user from a preset pulse recommendation pool, and returning the pulse recommendation data to the terminal; receiving operation information aiming at the recommended user and sent by the terminal; the operation information is generated by a feedback operation acted on the recommended user by the terminal user; and updating the recommendation degree information of the recommended user according to the operation information. By combining user behaviors and user feedback on the basis of the existing user related tether of the existing user recommendation mode, user relationship data are pushed from multiple dimensions, and the user recommendation effect is guaranteed.

title_en: Cloud service station and cloud service method
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a cloud service station and a cloud service method. This go up cloud service station, its characterized in that includes: the function layer provides a function module required by cloud on an enterprise; wherein, the functional layer includes: the statistical analysis module is used for providing statistical analysis data of the application result of the cloud service station on the enterprise; the cloud-up navigation module is used for providing a route map aiming at enterprise cloud-up; the enterprise cloud diagnosis module is used for evaluating the enterprise intelligent level based on enterprise investigation data according to the evaluation diagnosis model and giving an evaluation result; the intelligent transformation service module is used for providing intelligent transformation service for enterprises; and the enterprise cloud module is used for providing cloud service, production line cloud service, business cloud service and basic cloud service for enterprise equipment. The cloud computing system and the cloud computing method can objectively evaluate the existing intelligent level of the enterprise by providing corresponding evaluation diagnosis service for the enterprise, can help the enterprise to establish a staged cloud computing target, clearly and intelligently reforms an evolution path, and achieves cloud computing of the enterprise.

title_en: Time convolution-based interactive knowledge representation learning model TCIM prediction method
abstract_en: The invention provides a prediction method of an interactive knowledge representation learning model TCIM based on time convolution. The invention captures the characteristic information of time through the convolutional neural network, thereby completing the dynamic knowledge graph.

title_en: Electric-gas coupling network energy flow solving method considering state variables of energy source station
abstract_en: The disclosure provides an electric-gas coupling network energy flow solving method considering state variables of an energy source station, which includes the following steps: establishing an energy station collection model capable of reflecting the coupling and conversion relation of the electric energy flow and the gas energy flow; based on an energy station model, a gas turbine and an electric compressor device in a network are considered, on the basis of state variables of an original subsystem, electric and gas input variables and electric and heat output variables of the energy station are added, a Jacobian matrix and an iteration relation of the electric and gas input variables and the electric and heat output variables are deduced, an IEGS multi-energy flow unified solution model is established, and voltage, phase angle, node pressure and flow calculation results of the system are obtained through solution. The multi-energy flow solving algorithm considering the EH state quantity of the invention considers the interaction between the energy flows, simplifies the derivation of the Jacobian matrix, can quickly converge, reduces the iteration times of the algorithm and improves the calculation efficiency.

title_en: Method and device for recycling logistics boxes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for recycling a logistics box, and relates to the technical field of logistics. One embodiment of the method comprises: receiving a request to be recovered sent by a first user, wherein the request to be recovered carries position information of a logistics box and order completion time; wherein the order completion time is the time when the order associated with the logistics box completes delivery; determining the recovery reminding time of the logistics box according to the order completion time, and generating a task to be recovered, wherein the task to be recovered carries the position information of the logistics box; if the recovery reminding time of the logistics box is reached, pushing the task to be recovered to the first user; and receiving a recovery confirmation message or a recovery rejection message sent by the first user. The embodiment can solve the technical problem that the logistics boxes are not recovered timely or are lost.

title_en: Online and offline shopping method and device, readable storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to an online and offline shopping method and device, a readable storage medium and an electronic device. The method comprises the following steps: in the event that operation of a first user to log in to an online shopping system is detected, determining whether a prepresentable target item exists for the first user; if the target item capable of being pre-presented exists, determining a target association task of the target item capable of being pre-presented; sending the target associated task to a target user to execute the target associated task by the target user, wherein the target user comprises the first user and/or a second user associated with the first user; and if the target user completes the target association task within a first preset time period, determining that the target object capable of being given away in advance is a free object. In this way, the customer attraction capacity of each of the offline merchant and the online merchant is improved by the linkage between the online and offline consumer modes. And moreover, the shopping mode of the user is more flexible and convenient.

title_en: Blast furnace expert rule knowledge base management system based on data middleware
abstract_en: The invention relates to a blast furnace expert rule knowledge base management system based on data middleware, which comprises an inference engine management system database, an inference engine management system, a rule base variable configuration module, data middleware and a blast furnace operation state database, wherein the inference engine management system database is used for storing blast furnace expert knowledge rules; the inference machine management system configures and maintains the blast furnace expert knowledge rules through the rule base variable configuration module, reads blast furnace operation data from the blast furnace operation state database through the data middleware, matches and infers the blast furnace operation data with the inference machine management system database, and then feeds back operation furnace type suggestions and furnace condition descriptions matched with the rules to blast furnace operators. The data middleware enables the inference engine to be independent from the expert system to form a platform product which can be reused in different blast furnaces, so that the development cost of blast furnace informatization software is saved.

title_en: Disease and pest risk prediction method
abstract_en: The application relates to a disease and pest risk prediction method, which comprises the following steps: obtaining a crop area where a crop to be detected is located, and respectively obtaining a weather model of the crop to be detected, wherein the disease and insect pest are easy to occur; respectively acquiring a weather forecast value corresponding to each weather parameter in each pest and disease damage occurrence meteorological model; respectively calculating the probability of the disease and insect damage occurrence corresponding to each disease and insect damage occurrence meteorological model according to all the meteorological forecast values corresponding to each disease and insect damage occurrence meteorological model and a preset disease and insect damage prediction algorithm; acquiring the disease and insect resistance grade coefficient of the crop to be detected and the pest and insect occurrence degree coefficient in a preset range around the crop area; and respectively calculating the pest risk probability of each pest type according to the probability of easy occurrence, the disease and pest resistance grade coefficient and the pest occurrence degree coefficient corresponding to each pest easy-to-occur meteorological model.

title_en: Intelligent personalized garment customization method
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent personalized clothing customization method, and relates to the technical field of clothing customization. The intelligent personalized clothing customization method comprises a three-dimensional scanning end, a mobile terminal, a clothing customization platform, a technical communication platform, a central data platform, a clothing modeling platform and a clothing production platform; the method comprises the steps that a client of the mobile terminal registers on a garment customization platform on the internet, the garment customization requirement of the client is issued, then the garment customization platform gives the using authority of a three-dimensional scanning end of the client of the mobile terminal, and the three-dimensional scanning end collects a three-dimensional model and posture data of the client of the mobile terminal after the using authority is confirmed. The invention has the advantages of very quick integral process and proper link of each link, can ensure that a customer obtains the customized clothes which best meets the requirements in the shortest time, can meet all individualized requirements, is very flexible, can comprehensively appreciate the style of the customized clothes before production, and is very convenient for re-customization at the later stage.

title_en: Garbage treatment system, method and device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a garbage treatment system, a method, a device and a storage medium, wherein the garbage treatment system at least comprises the following components: the system comprises a garbage treatment information platform, a garbage pretreatment vehicle and a user side; the garbage treatment information platform is used for acquiring a garbage recovery request of at least one user side, determining a planned journey according to the garbage recovery request and issuing the planned journey to the garbage pretreatment vehicle; the garbage pretreatment vehicle is used for acquiring a planned travel of the garbage treatment information platform and acquiring classified garbage of a user according to the planned travel; and the user side is used for generating a garbage recovery request according to the user requirement and sending the garbage recovery request to the garbage management information platform. Through rubbish administration information platform, rubbish preliminary treatment car and user end to rubbish clearance carry out intelligent management and control, improve rubbish recovery efficiency, reduce rubbish and in the time of piling up of district, reduce the influence of rubbish smell to the environment.

title_en: Logistics supply chain management system based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of logistics supply, in particular to a logistics supply chain management system based on a block chain. The system comprises a logistics order management center, wherein the input end of the logistics order management center is connected with the output end of an order input system, and the input end of the logistics order management center is also connected with a block chain identification system. In the invention, the long-range dependence of the global face features is jointly learned by adopting a cyclic convolution and a dense residual error network, so as to assist the modeling of the global face contour; meanwhile, the additionally arranged local enhancement network learns the mapping relation between the low-resolution face cutout and the high-resolution face cutout, and is used for enhancing the modeling of local face features, particularly facial features.

title_en: Shop display method, system, equipment and medium based on mixed reality
abstract_en: The invention provides a shop display method, a shop display system, shop display equipment and a shop display medium based on mixed reality, wherein the shop display method, the shop display system, the shop display equipment and the shop display medium comprise the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining depth image information of a plurality of angles of a shop, and obtaining a plurality of characteristic objects based on the depth image information; identifying the parameters of the characteristic objects, and inputting the parameters into a data training library for learning according to the characteristic objects and the corresponding parameters; establishing a three-dimensional model of the shop; establishing a three-dimensional model for the trained and learned feature object, and inserting the feature object into a corresponding position of the three-dimensional model of the shop according to the parameters of the feature object to obtain a shop mixed reality three-dimensional model; and overlaying the shop mixed reality three-dimensional model to a real shop environment for displaying. The online real-time online shopping system has the advantages that the image information of the offline shop is collected, the three-dimensional model is built, and the mixed reality technology is combined, so that a user can really experience the offline physical shop online, and the user can really watch and feel different commodities to shop.

title_en: Intelligent electronic information product management system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent management, in particular to an electronic information product intelligent management system based on the Internet of things, which comprises an Internet of things module, wherein a data acquisition module is used for transmitting electronic product data information from the Internet of things module to a signal processing module for signal processing, the processed signal is transmitted to a central processing unit through a data transmission module, and the data is transmitted to a data calculation module after the data is preliminarily calculated by the central processing unit. The invention can grasp the updated electronic product information, the electronic product quantity and the inventory data under the condition of safety and stability, and can enable a manager to know the data information at first time.

title_en: Portable intelligent device for on-site cooperative operation and mobile command
abstract_en: The invention discloses portable field cooperative work and mobile command intelligent equipment which comprises a wearable audio-video interactive component module, a mobile intelligent command terminal module, a distributed ad hoc network expansion unit module, an intelligent field service guarantee center module, a field safety supervision and control module, a remote support and control platform module, a personnel information acquisition module and a tool information acquisition module. The invention takes the command and control of an operation field as the core, and covers the solution of the cooperation, the control and the command of field operation personnel, tools, processes and other multi-role and whole processes.

title_en: Securities trade simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a securities trade simulation method and a system, which belong to the technical field of computer simulation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a plurality of independent exchange simulation examples, wherein each exchange simulation example starts a process, and each newspaper board is connected with an independent exchange simulation example; establishing a trade matching strategy model based on two dimensions of trade time and trade service, wherein the matching strategy model comprises a global trading strategy model and a local trading strategy model; matching strategy model matching is carried out according to the received instance information of the user declaration order, and matching simulation is carried out by combining with quotation; and acquiring a corresponding matching simulation result according to the configuration time of the user declaration order, and generating a declaration clearing file. The invention can meet the demand of simple use, full time period and configurable trading rules of the securities trade test, and improves the efficiency and quality of the securities trade test.

title_en: Outdoor use equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides outdoor use equipment, which comprises a touch display data end of a controller, a position positioning data end of a position positioning module, a network data connecting end of a wireless network connecting module and a network data connecting end of a controller, wherein the touch display data end of the controller is connected with the touch display data end of a touch display screen; the cloud end forms at least one route determined by the minimum angle from the current position information acquired by the position positioning module to the destination position and displays the route on the touch display screen. The invention can plan the advancing route and enhance the experience of users walking outdoors.

title_en: Flood sensitivity risk assessment method based on ensemble learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood sensitivity risk assessment method based on ensemble learning, which comprises the following steps: collecting data of landform, hydrological weather, soil vegetation and the like of a research area as characteristic data, and carrying out standardized processing on the characteristic data; extracting and researching historical flooding points and non-flooding points of the drainage basin according to the historical water level data and the remote sensing data; selecting an optimal feature subset by using the Laplace score; dividing the sample points into a training set and a testing set and training the ensemble learning model; and carrying out flood risk sensitivity calculation on the whole watershed by using the trained model to generate a watershed flood sensitivity risk grade distribution map. The method uses characteristic data of the research area as input, adopts a novel integrated learning model, improves accuracy of watershed flood risk assessment, finally generates a watershed flood risk mapping chart, and can visually show flood risk conditions of the research area.

title_en: Basic data management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a basic data management method and a system, which relate to the technical field of data management.

title_en: Bearing fault database construction method, analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a bearing fault database construction method, an analysis method and a system, which are used for acquiring historical fault recognition results; constructing a bearing product structure tree by taking the grade of the forming unit of the bearing as a minimum unit according to the historical fault identification result; and defining a fault mode by using the minimum unit granularity, establishing a bearing fault dictionary, and forming a database. The method establishes a motor train unit bearing localization bearing fault database, records fault reason analysis of the bearing, and has important significance in ensuring operation safety, improving maintenance efficiency, avoiding unnecessary loss and the like.

title_en: Block chain transaction execution method, block chain node and control device
abstract_en: The present specification provides a blockchain transaction execution method, a blockchain node, and a control device, according to which a plurality of transactions belonging to a first block are acquired; executing the plurality of transactions; consensus is made on the results of the execution of the plurality of transactions; and storing the value of the write parameter included in the execution result of each transaction successfully identified in the plurality of transactions into a cache region. Therefore, the problem of update and maintenance lag of transaction data is solved.

title_en: Wind power cluster power prediction method based on sparse constraint and dynamic weight distribution
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wind power cluster power prediction method based on sparse constraint and dynamic weight distribution, which comprises the following specific steps of: the method comprises the steps of analyzing the power space correlation among wind power plants in a cluster, determining the space correlation wind power plants of the wind power plants in the cluster, determining a cluster reference wind power plant for predicting the power of the wind power cluster, establishing a wind power cluster power prediction model and correcting a power prediction error.

title_en: Monthly power demand prediction method based on VMD-ANFIS-ARIMA
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monthly power demand prediction method based on VMD-ANFIS-ARIMA, which solves the defects of the prior art and comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring monthly power consumption sequence data, and determining the number of VMD components VMF; step 2, predicting by using an ANFIS model by taking the screened influence factors as independent variables and the trend item in the VMF as dependent variables; step 3, performing sequence stationarity test on the VMF except the trend item, and determining the order of the AR and the MA according to the correlation coefficient and the partial autocorrelation coefficient thereof; step 4, using an ARIMA model to predict the time series of the VMF except the trend item; and 5, performing linear reconstruction on each VMD component prediction result to obtain a final power consumption demand prediction result.

title_en: Event-driven power distribution network information physical system risk assessment calculation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a risk assessment and calculation method for a power distribution network information physical system based on event driving. And then, based on a cross-space cascading failure evolution model, providing and establishing a distribution network operation quantitative risk assessment index. Finally, a risk assessment calculation method of the power distribution network information physical system based on event driving is provided. The invention discloses a risk evaluation calculation method of a power distribution network information physical system, which aims at extracting key elements of the power distribution network cross-information-physical space cascading failure, provides description on risk conduction of different levels and propagation and mapping relations of risks among the different levels, and provides a calculation evaluation method for the risks of the power distribution network information physical system based on an event-driven model.

title_en: Wisdom garden environmental protection management system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent park environment-friendly management system, which comprises a monitoring platform; a plurality of noise detection devices connected to the monitoring platform; the soil detection devices are connected with the monitoring platform; the indoor environment detection device is connected with the monitoring platform; the atmospheric environment detection device is connected with the monitoring platform; the intelligent classification garbage can is connected with the monitoring platform; and a sewage classification treatment system connected with the monitoring platform; noise detection device, soil detection device, indoor environment detection device, atmospheric environment detection device, intelligent classification garbage bin all are equipped with orientation module and unique identification code. Through above-mentioned embodiment, reduce the cost of labor when improving the convenience of garden environmental protection management.

title_en: Meteorological element prediction method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a meteorological element prediction method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein prediction node attribute information, prediction source attribute information and prediction edge attribute information at a target time are determined based on historical node attribute information, historical source attribute information and historical edge attribute information of a meteorological element graph corresponding to a meteorological site to be predicted at a historical time, and then target meteorological element information of the meteorological element of the meteorological site to be predicted at the target time is determined based on the prediction node attribute information, the prediction source attribute information and the prediction edge attribute information at the target time, so that the determined meteorological element better conforms to a physical rule, and the accuracy of a prediction result is improved.

title_en: Logistics carrying object recommendation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of logistics, and provides a method and a device for recommending a logistics carrying object, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The logistics carrying object recommendation method comprises the following steps: obtaining target logistics timeliness of each logistics line according to historical logistics data; calculating the time efficiency standard-reaching rate of each logistics carrying object on each logistics route according to the target logistics time efficiency of each logistics route, and arranging the logistics carrying objects of each logistics route in a descending order according to the time efficiency standard-reaching rate to obtain a carrying object recommendation list of each logistics route; and pushing a carrier object recommendation list of the logistics route with the delivery address of each merchant system as the starting point to each merchant system. According to the invention, the timeliness of each logistics carrying object is analyzed by combining the overall timeliness of the logistics route, and the carrying object recommendation list with the timeliness being ranked from high to low is pushed to the corresponding merchant system, so that the logistics carrying objects are selected according to the timeliness when the merchants deliver goods, and the shopping experience of users on an e-commerce platform is improved.

title_en: Lottery information processing method, device, server and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computers, and discloses a lottery drawing information processing method, a lottery drawing information processing device, a server and a readable storage medium, wherein the lottery drawing information processing method comprises the following steps: respectively adding the time-consuming work tasks in the lottery drawing process into different work queues; respectively writing lottery activity information in a database and a cache, reading the lottery activity information from the cache and issuing the lottery activity information; receiving user lottery drawing information sent by terminal equipment, calling the lottery drawing activity rule in the cache to judge the user lottery drawing information, and adding a work task for processing the user lottery drawing information into a corresponding work queue when the user lottery drawing information is judged to be in accordance with the lottery drawing activity rule; settling the received lottery drawing information of the user to obtain winning information, and storing the winning information into a cache and a database; and reading the winning information in the cache and returning a winning result to the terminal equipment. The invention can effectively avoid the problem of logic confusion when lottery drawing information is processed at high concurrency.

title_en: Unmanned logistics vehicle distribution method and system based on action analysis
abstract_en: The unmanned logistics vehicle distribution method and system based on action analysis are characterized in that cloud end receives warehouse information, vehicle parking area information, state information and order information of unmanned logistics vehicles in real time, generates planning information, schedules proper unmanned logistics vehicles, and sends the planning information to the scheduled unmanned logistics vehicles in real time; the planning information comprises unmanned logistics vehicle global path planning and task information; the unmanned logistics vehicle combines local path planning on the basis of the global path planning, generates a fusion planning route in real time, and automatically drives along the fusion planning route; the unmanned logistics vehicle end adopts a multi-branch delivery type processing mode, and different delivery modes are selected according to different delivery scenes, so that the automatic delivery effect of delivering goods to a receiving person in a 'hands' and receiving goods of a sender in a 'hands' is realized.

title_en: Energy-saving effect evaluation method for high-position steam turbine generator unit
abstract_en: The invention provides an energy-saving effect evaluation method of a high-position steam turbine generator unit, which comprises the following steps: acquiring pipeline structure parameters of each section of pipeline of the high-position arranged steam turbine and fluid parameters corresponding to each section of pipeline; determining a resistance change value of each section of pipeline of the high-position-arrangement steam turbine generator unit based on the pipeline structure parameters of each section of pipeline and the fluid parameters corresponding to each section of pipeline; determining the heat rate influence value of each section of pipeline on the high-position steam turbine generator unit based on the resistance change value of each section of pipeline, and determining the relative change percentage of the high-position steam turbine generator unit relative to the total heat rate of the conventionally arranged steam turbine generator unit based on the heat rate influence value; and evaluating the energy-saving effect of the high-position steam turbine generator unit based on the relative change percentage. The method for arranging the steam turbine generator unit at the high position can realize the pre-evaluation of the energy-saving effect of the high-position arrangement technology of the steam turbine generator unit, further provide technical decision and reduce the investment risk.

title_en: Multi-source information-based patrol plan intelligent generation method and device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a patrol plan intelligent generation method, device and storage medium based on multi-source information, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the multi-source information of a point to be patrolled from an information base, and carrying out quantitative aggregation on the multi-source information of the point to be patrolled; associating corresponding patrol strategies for the aggregated multi-source information of the viewpoint to be patrolled; and generating a corresponding patrol work order based on the patrol strategy, and sending the patrol work order to the client terminal. According to the invention, the most useful data display which can be visualized visually can be obtained according to the multi-source information of the viewpoint to be patrolled, the relevance of the data and the equipment state is improved, the multi-dimensional data quantization standard is constructed, the patrolling work order is dynamically generated, and the efficiency and the quality of the patrolling operation can be greatly improved.

title_en: Online intelligent education method for college students
abstract_en: The invention provides an online intelligent education method for college students, which comprises the following steps: acquiring an online education request of each target user, and calling a knowledge database from a preset data database based on a big data technology; acquiring learning information of a target user, and performing first education quantification on the learning information; acquiring behavior information of a target user, and performing second education quantification on the behavior information; establishing a first incidence relation between the first education quantification and the knowledge database and a second incidence relation between the second education quantification and the knowledge database, and screening information to be educated from the knowledge database; and classifying the knowledge units related to the education information according to the first incidence relation and the second incidence relation, and meanwhile, marking the priority of the knowledge units based on the classification result to intelligently educate the target user. The on-line learning efficiency is improved.

title_en: Comprehensive demand response method based on comprehensive energy system node energy price strategy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive demand response method based on a node energy price strategy of a comprehensive energy system, which comprises the steps of constructing an electricity-gas-heat comprehensive energy system operation framework; providing an energy price calculation method of an electric-gas-thermal coupling multi-energy flow network node containing fan output; the method comprises the steps of obtaining node energy prices, building an energy consumption cost model considering load change of user comprehensive demand response, and analyzing response behaviors of various flexible loads under the guidance of an energy pricing mechanism of a comprehensive energy system. According to the comprehensive demand response method based on the node energy price strategy of the comprehensive energy system, the comprehensive energy using behavior of the multi-energy users is guided through the node energy price, the response potential of the multi-energy users can be further mined, the energy using of the users is more economical and flexible, and the win-win situation of an energy network and the users is realized.

title_en: Account concurrent generation method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to the field of automatic programming, and in particular, to a method, an apparatus, a computer device, and a storage medium for concurrently generating an account, where the account is composed of a classification code, a concurrent value, and a sequence number, and the method for concurrently generating an account includes: generating a request according to the account number, and acquiring a classification code and a concurrent value; storing the account generation request into a request queue of concurrent values; sequentially responding to the account generation requests in the request queue of the concurrent value, adding 1 to the sequence number of the concurrent value locking in each response, using the processed value as the sequence number corresponding to the account generation request, and updating the sequence number of the concurrent value locking by using the processed value; and generating a complete account according to the classification code, the concurrent value and the sequence number corresponding to the account generation request. The method can support the generation of high-concurrency account numbers, achieves the effects of flexibility, configurability and persistent performance, improves the account number generation efficiency, and is beneficial to the development of businesses such as banks and the like.

title_en: Attention observation and reminding system applied to college English teaching classroom
abstract_en: The invention provides an attention observing and reminding system, which comprises a forward wide-angle shooting assembly and a backward wide-angle shooting assembly; the forward wide-angle camera assembly comprises a fisheye camera with a first resolution and a head gesture recognition engine; the backward wide-angle camera shooting assembly comprises a common camera with a second resolution and a body gesture recognition engine; the space region where the teaching classroom is located is divided into a plurality of coding subregions which can be identified by the plurality of wide-angle camera assemblies in advance; the attention viewing system comprises a small visible light signal indication screen on which at least one of said encoded sub-areas is indicated by a visible light signal. The attention system also comprises a touch display screen arranged at the front end of the classroom, and a plurality of coding subareas are displayed on the touch display screen; and forming an attention reminding signal on the touch display screen based on an analysis result of the head gesture recognition engine.

title_en: Electronic fence effective time period management and control method based on intelligent Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to an electronic fence effective time period management and control method based on an intelligent Internet of things. According to the method, tide analysis of vehicles is carried out according to data of vehicles randomly parked, and addresses of primary selected electronic fences in different time periods are obtained; calculating the range of the primarily selected electronic fence in each time period by using the historical data of the parking amount of each primarily selected electronic fence in each time period, and optimizing the primarily selected electronic fence according to the overlapping degree of the range of the primarily selected electronic fence to obtain an effective electronic fence and the corresponding effective time thereof; and correspondingly dividing each effective electronic fence according to the change of the historical parking data of each effective electronic fence to obtain a plurality of sub-electronic fences and corresponding effective time of the sub-electronic fences. The embodiment of the invention uses the dynamic electronic fence to make the electronic fence more intelligent, and plays a role in limiting the user from randomly stopping and playing the electronic fence to the maximum extent.

title_en: Ocean platform leakage combustible gas cloud cluster volume prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting the volume of a leaked combustible cloud cluster of an ocean platform, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: 1) Acquiring a leakage angle, a wind speed and a leakage mass rate of a leakage point to be predicted; 2) The obtained leakage angle, wind speed and leakage mass rate of the leakage point to be predicted are input into a pre-constructed leakage natural gas cloud cluster volume prediction model to obtain the volume of the combustible gas cloud cluster under the corresponding leakage diffusion working condition, wherein the leakage natural gas cloud cluster volume prediction model is constructed according to the set key leakage parameters and the volume of the combustible gas cloud cluster obtained through simulation.

title_en: Multi-agricultural-machine scheduling operation method based on improved artificial fish swarm algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-agricultural machine scheduling operation method based on an improved artificial fish swarm algorithm, which comprises the following steps: initializing the scale of artificial fish shoal and initializing parameters of the artificial fish shoal algorithm based on the artificial fish shoal algorithm, wherein each artificial fish represents a scheduling and distributing scheme; calculating the fitness parameter f of each artificial fish in the artificial fish swarm, and recording the artificial fish number with the optimal fitness parameter f on the bulletin board; respectively executing foraging, gathering, rear-end collision and random behaviors on the artificial fish shoals, and respectively selecting optimal artificial fish from a plurality of updated artificial fish shoals; comparing the selected optimal artificial fish with the optimal artificial fish on the bulletin board, and if the fitness parameter f of the selected artificial fish is greater than the fitness parameter f of the artificial fish on the bulletin board, updating and outputting the optimal artificial fish on the bulletin board. The algorithm global convergence capability has strong adaptability to initial value setting, and can quickly and efficiently generate an agricultural machine scheduling scheme.

title_en: Intelligent parking integrated system for electric vehicle wireless charging station
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric automobiles, and discloses an intelligent parking integrated system of an electric automobile wireless charging station. This integrated system is parked to electric automobile wireless charging station intelligence, through the man-machine interaction system, environmental data collection system, central processing unit and control strategy execution system carry out the automation to the vehicle and park, avoid manual parking in-process to cause the position of charging and wait to charge the position dislocation and lead to the circumstances such as the charging efficiency low and wasting of resources to take place, rethread automatic wireless charging system discerns and monitors the vehicle, the precision of parking of this integrated system is parked to intelligence has further been improved, and charge it through automatic charging system, reach the effect of simple convenient high-efficient wireless charging.

title_en: Online education system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based online education system, belongs to the technical field of online education, and aims to solve the problems of how to improve the weak knowledge of students and the problems that students feel boring and unattractive in the learning process, wherein the system comprises a server, a pet module, a registration login module, a storage module, an operation module, a drawing module and a straightening moduleThe system comprises a broadcasting module and a course mall module, wherein the homework module comprises a layout unit, a reply unit, a correction unit, a language unit and a wrong question bank, and the language unit is used for inputting voice content in homework to help students to further know homework content and give reference content to help the students to learn, the knowledge weakness part of the students is pertinently improved through a pull-up module, and the priority value Q is used for i The teacher can be helped to know the weak knowledge of students more intuitively, the weak knowledge of students can be taught by aiming reinforcement, and the comprehensive development of the students is promoted.

title_en: Method, computing device and storage medium for determining grouping data of geographic area
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a computing device and a computer readable storage medium for determining group data of a geographic area. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining raster data of a plurality of grids of the geographic area; acquiring positioning data of a plurality of persons within the geographic area and determining trajectory data for each person based on the positioning data and the grid data; determining a number of persons in the plurality of persons to transfer from a first grid to a second grid in the plurality of grids based on the trajectory data of the plurality of persons to construct a sample data set, each sample data in the sample data set comprising the number of persons to transfer from the first grid to the second grid in the plurality of persons; clustering the sample data sets of the plurality of people into a plurality of clusters by using a community discovery algorithm to obtain a cluster label of each grid; and fusing grids belonging to the same cluster label to determine group data corresponding to the cluster label.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for equipment maintenance
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for equipment maintenance. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring parameter information of at least one device in a first preset range in a preset time period; extracting characteristic information in the parameter information of each device; determining a data model corresponding to each device according to the characteristic information of each device; obtaining a residual life value of at least one device and/or a fault value of each component in the at least one device according to the data model; a replacement device or a component of the replacement device is determined or a device parameter is adjusted. According to the equipment maintenance method, device, equipment and storage medium, the data models of the nearby equipment are obtained, the data models among the equipment are compared, and the situation of the equipment is reasonably, accurately and pertinently predicted according to regional characteristics.

title_en: Power consumer classification method and device and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for classifying power users and terminal equipment, and belongs to the field of data analysis, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a pre-constructed power consumer tag set; acquiring label data corresponding to each power consumer based on each power consumer label in the power consumer label set; and carrying out fuzzy clustering on the label data corresponding to each power consumer to obtain the affiliated classification of each power consumer. The method, the device and the terminal equipment for classifying the power users can realize the classification of the power users and provide data support for subsequent differentiated services.

title_en: Novel consumption apportionment system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel consumption allocation system, which provides a personal code and team code module for a user, the user scans the personal code or the team code according to the actual consumption condition and carries out expense pre-payment by a third-party financial institution, meanwhile, the allocation proportion in the team code can be set, but the team personnel can take effect after the team personnel circle is checked and passed, thereby reducing the phenomena of personal escape and the like during payment, meanwhile, the invention can count the personal accounts of the user according to the conditions of personal consumption, team consumption, allocation proportion and the like, the user only needs to recheck and pay, and the user experience of the user is improved.

title_en: Business data sharing model system based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a business data sharing model system based on a block chain, which relates to the technical field of the block chain and comprises a business data center module, a service center module, an alliance center module, a public block chain module and a private interplanetary file cluster module. The invention constructs a alliance chain among business data centers, maintains the operation of the system together on the basis, and the business data copy is hooked with the public chain, so that the data maintenance cost can be reduced, and the data security is ensured.

title_en: Network security situation sensing method based on electric power CPS
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network security situation perception method based on an electric power CPS, which comprises the following steps: s1: preprocessing alarm data; s2: fusing alarm data, namely fusing multi-source alarm information by using an alarm information fusion method based on credibility; s3: power CPS security risk assessment based on a threat propagation tree. According to the network security situation sensing method based on the electric power CPS, correlation analysis can be performed by utilizing the time-space characteristics in the preprocessing of the security alarm log data, redundant data are further merged, and the processing efficiency is improved; the effectiveness is high, the safety threatening action often leaves traces in logs of different devices, and the traces are often correlated in time and space and are often the same or similar in time and space, and the false data and  threat can be effectively distinguished by the property.

title_en: Information providing device and information providing program
abstract_en: The information providing device (50) is provided with: a usage status information acquisition unit that acquires information indicating the usage status of each of the toilet devices (30); a usage status information providing unit that provides information indicating the usage status of each of the plurality of toilet devices (30) acquired by the usage status information acquiring unit; and a cleaning order providing unit that determines and provides an order in which a cleaning person cleans the toilet devices (30) based on the use status of each of the toilet devices (30).

title_en: Identity recognition method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification discloses an identity identification method, an identity identification device, identity identification equipment and identity identification media. The scheme comprises the following steps: acquiring input behavior characteristics when a user inputs a password; calculating the similarity between the input behavior features and preset input behavior features in a preset input behavior feature set; judging whether the value of at least one similarity in the similarities of the input behavior features and the preset input behavior features in the preset input behavior feature set is greater than or equal to a first threshold value or not to obtain a first judgment result; and if the first judgment result shows that the numerical values of the similarity between the input behavior feature and each preset input behavior feature in the preset input behavior feature set are all smaller than the first threshold, executing an identity verification process based on biological information identification for the user.

title_en: Crowd-sourcing-aware task allocation and user recruitment model cross-validation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross validation method and a system of a crowd sensing task allocation and user recruitment model, wherein the method comprises the steps of inputting a plurality of space-time subtasks obtained by dividing a crowd sensing task model according to regions and time by using a task allocation model to be cross validated and parameters of an agent determined by using the user recruitment model; importing the space-time subtask into an artificial social platform which is pre-established with a user intelligent agent model, an artificial social environment model and an intelligent agent interaction model, and starting simulation calculation to generate an experimental sample; and performing data statistics on the generated experimental sample aiming at the performed specified evaluation index to obtain an experimental result containing the specified evaluation index. The method can realize the cross validation of the task allocation model and the user recruitment model, and has the advantages of strong parallel computing capability, good user customization capability, simple and efficient development process, strong practicability and wide application prospect.

title_en: Method, device, electronic equipment and readable storage medium for creating meeting invitation information
