abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of information synchronization, and discloses a method for creating meeting invitation information, which comprises the following steps: acquiring first meeting invitation information from a chat client; acquiring meeting time and a participant mailbox according to the first meeting invitation information; and creating second meeting invitation information according to the meeting time and the meeting participant mailbox. Therefore, the first meeting invitation information is acquired from the chat client, the meeting time and the attendee mailbox are acquired according to the first meeting invitation information, and the second meeting invitation information is automatically created according to the meeting time and the attendee mailbox, so that the meeting management client can automatically create the second meeting invitation information according to the first meeting invitation information, and the efficiency of the meeting management client for creating the meeting invitation information is improved. The application also discloses a device, an electronic device and a readable storage medium for creating the meeting invitation information.

title_en: Student's homework distribution system of teaching usefulness
abstract_en: The utility model provides a student's homework distribution system of teaching usefulness, relates to a distribution system, including central processing unit, the last scanning module that is equipped with of central processing unit is equipped with the analysis information after class on the scanning module, central processing unit's output on be provided with teacher's module's input, the output of central processing unit is equipped with the input that the module was arranged in the homework, the homework is arranged and is equipped with software module on the output of module, central processing unit's output on be equipped with the input of analysis database, the output and the input of central processing unit of analysis database are connected. The device can realize that the device is provided with the post-class analysis module at the front end, which is beneficial for teachers and systems to collect the mastering conditions of the students on courses and avoid the misjudgment of the conditions of the students; the dual monitoring module of system and teacher module is provided with, avoids single judgement to produce the judgement error to student's condition, also is favorable to mr to a grasp of student's condition simultaneously, is favorable to changing to the mode of giving lessons.

title_en: Building intelligent management system based on BIM
abstract_en: The invention relates to a building intelligent management system based on BIM, which consists of a data docking layer, a standard data layer, a storage and calculation layer, a business logic layer, a multi-terminal open data application display layer and a functional application layer. The advantages are that: based on the BIM technology, the energy consumption analysis of the building space is carried out, and the energy is saved; based on the BIM technology, the building fault is eliminated in time; giving an accident escape scheme and an accident point prompt in time based on the BIM technology; based on the BIM technology, parking spaces are reasonably arranged; and effectively combing data information and quickening the response speed.

title_en: Automatic analysis method and system for data collection of distribution substation meter data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution transformer meter data acquisition automatic analysis method and a system, the method comprises an interface power grid production account system, a power grid metering automation system and a power grid marketing system, the power grid production account data of the power grid production account system, the backflow data of the power grid metering automation system and the marketing data of the power grid marketing system are automatically acquired, the data cleaning and filtering are carried out on the power grid production account data, the backflow data and the marketing data, then the cleaned and filtered data are subjected to correlation matching classification processing, the reason analysis is intelligently carried out aiming at the data of the category of 'metering acquisition failure', and the analysis result is output, on one hand, the problems existing in manual analysis are avoided, on the other hand, the reason of the metering acquisition failure is intelligently distinguished as distribution transformer shutdown or form code acquisition, the problem existing in the process of distribution transformer meter code acquisition failure in the manual distribution network analysis is solved, and the problem of the difficulty in analyzing the distribution transformer meter code, the accuracy is difficult to ensure, and the timeliness is poor.

title_en: Recipe determination method and apparatus, storage medium, and electronic apparatus
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recipe determining method and device, a storage medium and an electronic device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: inputting food material pictures of food material storage equipment into a visual processing model to obtain food material information of the food material storage equipment, wherein the visual processing model is trained by machine learning by using multiple groups of data, and each group of data in the multiple groups of data comprises: the food material pictures and the food material information corresponding to the food material pictures; determining a food material list of food material storage equipment according to the food material types corresponding to the food material information; under the condition that the recommendation instruction of the target object is obtained, a plurality of recipes to be made are determined according to the food material list, the problems that food material updating information cannot be obtained in real time, recipe recommendation is carried out based on existing food materials and the like are solved, and then the food material list of the food materials is updated according to the storage condition of the food material storage device, so that the recommended recipes have high operability, and the success rate of making by using the recommended recipes is improved.

title_en: Power system wind control model construction and application method based on user behavior information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a wind control model of an electric power system based on user behavior information. The method establishes a user behavior information database by collecting user behavior information of a user and an abnormal user, preprocessing user behavior information data, packaging the preprocessed user behavior information data into one-dimensional characteristic vectors to obtain a group of vectors for describing user portrait data, calibrating data labels for the user portrait data, building a neural network model, inputting the user portrait data with the data labels into the neural network model to be trained, training the neural network, storing the neural network wind control model, collecting user behavior information data in real time, inputting the user behavior information data into the stored neural network wind control model to predict the user behavior risk coefficient, when the user behavior risk coefficient exceeds a preset threshold value, a system alarm is generated and an early warning notice is sent to the power system, so that the time consumed by reprocessing in the model operation process is reduced, and the neural network training efficiency is improved.

title_en: Intelligent experiment method, device, system and medium based on online education
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent experimental method, a device, a system and a medium based on online education, wherein the system comprises a client module, a student module, a teacher module, a course management module and an administrator module which are connected with each other; the course management module is used for simulating experimental data through course simulation; when the students modify and operate the experimental data according to the experimental process and the teachers guide and modify the simulation process, the contents learned by the students are verified through the experimental data, and the experimental data are sent to the intelligent operation module after the verification is finished; and receiving related instructions of the student module and the teacher module through the intelligent operation module, and operating the physical operation module according to the instruction content to perform experiments. The invention can make students more conveniently study courses, exercise the practical ability of the students, deepen the understanding of course knowledge and reasonably apply the knowledge to the practice, and also make teachers more conveniently manage the students and check the practical ability of the students.

title_en: Anchor selection related system, method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a system, a method, a device and equipment related to anchor selection. The anchor selection system determines first characteristic information of at least one second user corresponding to the first user and second characteristic information of the to-be-selected commodity object through the server; determining a first matching degree of at least one first characteristic dimension between a second user group and the to-be-selected commodity object according to the first characteristic information and the second characteristic information; determining target commodity object information corresponding to the first user at least according to the first matching degree; and the client receives and displays the target commodity object information sent by the server for the first user to manually select the commodity. By adopting the processing mode, the association relationship between the fans and the commodities is determined based on the images of the fan group of the anchor and the commodity images, and the commodities suitable for the fan group of the anchor are selected for the anchor by considering the matching degree between the fans and the commodities; therefore, the quality and the efficiency of the selected products can be effectively improved, and the direct broadcast benefit is improved.

title_en: Event scoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an event scoring method, which comprises an event scoring system, wherein the event scoring system comprises an AI robot capable of identifying user information, a controller capable of processing and calculating data transmitted by the AI robot to finally obtain scoring data information and a display screen for displaying the scoring data; the controller is in communication connection with the display screen, the controller is in communication connection with the AI robot, more than one data repository for different event information and score information is arranged in the controller, and the event scoring system completes the registration process step and the event scoring operation step in sequence. The invention can inquire the match roll, match sign-in, match score and score, and the data can be real-time stored, online, paperless and real-time inquired, to reduce the complexity of match score, reduce the labor cost and improve the working efficiency.

title_en: Atmospheric pollutant source tracing analysis method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an atmospheric pollutant source tracing analysis method, which is based on a Gaussian diffusion mode, and realizes the refinement, light weight and automation of source tracing by calculating and evaluating the pollution influence of traffic lines to an automatic air quality monitoring station one by one and realizing automatic coding. The invention can realize hourly fine traceability analysis of traffic line sources, realize fine traceability of atmospheric pollution by calculating the pollution influence of roads to a single monitoring station, and lock a road list with high pollutant concentration influencing the single monitoring station, thereby realizing accurate enforcement and achieving the effect of half the effort of prevention and control work.

title_en: Artificial intelligence-based power grid event diagnosis autonomous learning method and system
abstract_en: The application provides an artificial intelligence-based power grid event diagnosis autonomous learning method and system, which comprise an autonomous learning model offline preprocessing part, an autonomous learning model online training part and an autonomous learning model online running part. An autonomous learning model offline preprocessing part determines the characteristic attribute of data required by a training algorithm model through preprocessing historical power grid alarm event data containing a large number of missing values and characteristic engineering; an on-line training part of an autonomous learning model trains an algorithm model by regularly and autonomously processing algorithm model data and selecting an optimal algorithm and algorithm parameters; and in the online operation part of the autonomous learning model, selecting the algorithm model with the highest accuracy to diagnose the power grid event, and displaying the model training and event diagnosis results in a visual mode. The algorithm model is independently constructed and selected, so that the prediction accuracy of the algorithm model and the operation safety of the autonomous learning system are improved.

title_en: Ecological space intensive utilization optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological space intensive utilization optimization method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1: dynamically acquiring an ecological space according to the comprehensive value of the service functions of the multi-year ecological system and the change characteristics of the comprehensive value; s2: according to the service function value of each single ecological system, identifying the dominant ecological system service function of the ecological space; simulating the ecological space leading ecological system service function pattern from the basic year to the target year, and carrying out evolution analysis on the service function of the leading ecological system; s3: and coupling optimization of the number structure and the spatial layout of the service functions of the leading ecological system in the target year is performed by adopting an LP-Markov-CA composite model, so that intensive utilization optimization of the service functions of the leading ecological system in the ecological space is realized. The invention realizes the cooperative optimization of the ecological space quantity structure, the spatial layout and the service function, successfully obtains the ecological space intensive utilization layout with the maximum ecological system service function, and provides a new method for the intensive utilization and optimization configuration of the homeland space.

title_en: Person arrival post detection method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for detecting people arriving at post, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of images of a scene of people arriving at a post and storing the images into a data set; marking personnel in the images aiming at each image in the plurality of images to obtain marking information of the images and store the marking information into a data set; constructing a Sparse R-CNN model, and performing network integration on the Sparse R-CNN model by using HyperNet to obtain a preset model; training a preset model by using a data set to obtain a post detection model; acquiring an image to be detected in a preset area in real time by using a camera, and inputting the image to be detected into a post detection model to obtain the number of predicted personnel in the image to be detected; and acquiring the number of corresponding post personnel corresponding to the preset area, and determining that the preset area is in a meeting state when the number of the predicted personnel in the image to be detected is matched with the number of corresponding post personnel corresponding to the preset area. The method does not need to depend on manpower for monitoring and management, and has high efficiency.

title_en: Intelligent advertisement analysis and promotion system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent advertisement analysis and promotion system based on big data, which relates to the technical field of advertisement promotion systems and aims at the problems that the existing advertisement putting is not targeted, and the played advertisement is not needed by people at that time, so the volume of the delivered advertisement is low, and the like. The invention calculates advertisement receiving crowd, putting cost and profit, obtains optimal advertisement putting time and time period, and carries out targeted popularization, thereby avoiding huge investment cost of wide popularization, enabling popularization to be most profitable, reducing popularization cost of enterprises and improving volume of bargaining.

title_en: Method and device for determining power transmission line inspection area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for determining a power transmission line inspection area, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting hidden danger point data and constructing a hidden danger point data set; setting a calculation area according to the potential hazard point data set and a preset routing inspection diameter; calculating hidden danger early warning weights of corresponding hidden danger points according to the calculation regions; traversing all the hidden danger points in the hidden danger point data set, and determining a routing inspection area according to the hidden danger early warning weight; comparing the number of the routing inspection areas with a preset number, and determining the routing inspection areas with the corresponding number as target routing inspection areas when the number of the routing inspection areas is equal to the preset number; the problem of because transmission line quantity is huge, the mode of regularly patrolling and examining consumes a large amount of manpowers is solved, effectively improve and patrol and examine efficiency, reduce the human cost.

title_en: Medal, inspection device, method for manufacturing medal, and management system for table game
abstract_en: Since the pattern of the amusement substitute money (amusement substitute money) on the amusement table is complicated, there is a problem that it is impossible to determine whether or not the player correctly replaces the amusement substitute money corresponding to the betting amusement substitute money at the time of the replacement by the image analysis technique, and thus the error prevention is not sufficient. The detection system of the invention is provided with a control device (14) for detecting cheating behaviors performed on a game table (4) by using an image analysis result of an image analysis device (12), and the game substitute currency (120) used in the detection system is a multilayer structure in which a plurality of plastic layers with different colors are laminated, a coloring layer (121) is arranged at least in the middle, and white layers (122) or light layers (although not shown, the color is lighter than the coloring layer (122)) are laminated on two sides of the coloring layer (121) in the middle.

title_en: Transformer substation planning method and device based on environmental factors, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application provides a transformer substation planning method, a transformer substation planning device, electronic equipment and a medium based on environmental factors, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of determining position information of a transformer substation to be built, then creating a transformer substation mixed integer linear programming MILP model based on the position information of the transformer substation to be built, and then determining transformer information and power transmission line information of the transformer substation to be built based on the MILP model to build the transformer substation, wherein the MILP model comprises a target function and conditions of transformer substation building simulation constraints. The transformer substation planning method and device based on the environmental factors, the electronic equipment and the medium can realize planning and construction of the transformer substation on the basis of considering environmental pollution reaching standards.

title_en: Labeled multi-bin modeling automation equipment state evaluation method and system
abstract_en: A tagged bin modeling automation equipment state evaluation method and system comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting metadata of a power system, and labeling the metadata based on the data type of the metadata; step 2, based on preset correlation influence factors of the automation equipment, evaluating metadata corresponding to the automation equipment by adopting an analysis and evaluation algorithm model, and establishing a comprehensive evaluation data warehouse of the automation equipment based on evaluation; and 3, filtering the corresponding information of the automation equipment in the comprehensive evaluation data warehouse, and acquiring the health condition evaluation of the automation equipment and the operation and maintenance decision of the automation equipment. The technical scheme of the invention has the advantages of simple and quick algorithm, accurate result and good effect.

title_en: 5G-based four-way shuttle vehicle multi-vehicle scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a 5G-based four-way shuttle vehicle multi-vehicle scheduling method which is used for same-layer multi-vehicle scheduling, wherein a 5G micro base station is deployed in a four-way shuttle vehicle three-dimensional warehouse, a four-way shuttle vehicle and a scheduling control system thereof communicate through 5G, and information such as running states of the four-way shuttle vehicle, a shuttle vehicle hoister and the like is reported to the scheduling control system through a 5G network; control instructions of the dispatching control system are issued to the four-way shuttle vehicles through the 5G network, and by combining the corresponding dispatching method, the technical problem which cannot be solved under the original WIFI technology can be well solved, the vehicles can plan driving paths in a larger degree of freedom, the system efficiency can be obviously improved, and safe, stable and efficient four-way shuttle vehicle dispatching is realized.

title_en: Multi-objective optimization method for sponge city engineering design
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sponge city engineering design multi-objective optimization method, which comprises the steps of establishing a sponge facility multi-objective optimization model of site scale, taking sponge engineering total cost, sponge facility efficiency evaluation and sponge facility landscape effect evaluation as objective functions according to sponge city engineering construction objective requirements, taking construction objective and decision variable value range as constraint conditions, and solving a plurality of optimized facility combination schemes meeting the sponge city engineering construction objective through a multi-objective optimization algorithm. According to the invention, under the condition of low basic data requirements, the optimal combination scheme under different conditions and value orientations can be obtained, an optimal theoretical support and a practical and feasible optimization method are provided for sponge city design, and scientific reference basis is provided for projects.

title_en: Intelligent auxiliary supervision method and system for road occupation facilities
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent auxiliary supervision method and system for road occupation facilities, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining first application information of a first lane occupation facility; acquiring first track occupation area information and first track occupation area information; calling first region road monitoring information at first time; judging whether the first lane occupation area information meets a preset lane occupation standard or not, and obtaining a first judgment result; acquiring field lane occupation area survey data at a second time; generating actual survey comparison information; inputting the first application information and the actual survey comparison information into a road occupation facility supervision evaluation model to obtain a first evaluation result; if the first road occupation identification information passes the preset time, automatically generating first road occupation identification information; and carrying out intelligent auxiliary supervision on the first lane occupation facility. The method and the device solve the technical problem that the whole-course auxiliary supervision before, in and after the lane occupation of the lane occupation facility cannot be carried out in the prior art, so that the unreasonable lane occupation behavior cannot be corrected in time, and the urban management order is influenced.

title_en: Project scoring optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a project score optimization method and system, which gradually perform first-level review and second-level review through a plurality of acquired first-level scores, correct the scores twice by manpower to reduce the influence of subjective factors, flatten the score sets of a plurality of projects based on an average value mode after the two times of manual review and correction, unify the average scores of all the score sets, reduce the score difference of the adjusted score sets, ensure that the presented scores have no great difference, reduce the influence of the scores of the subjective factors on the scored persons, and ensure the working enthusiasm of the scored persons.

title_en: Management system of pressed salted duck processing quality
abstract_en: The invention discloses a management system for processing quality of salted ducks, which comprises a raw material preparation part, a plurality of raw material storage parts, a plurality of cold processing parts, a hot processing part and a packaging part which are sequentially connected, and a management center for formulating a raw material batch distribution scheme, wherein each part comprises one or more storage units and an operation log for representing a raw material distribution relation between an upstream process and a downstream process, and the management center establishes an optimization model for formulating the raw material batch distribution scheme according to a production plan and a distribution principle, so that the product quality traceability range and the difficulty are reduced, and the recall cost of enterprises is reduced.

title_en: Data estimation method, device, equipment and storage medium of business object
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a data estimation method, a device, equipment and a storage medium of a business object, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical consumption data corresponding to a target service object and a reference service object, and constructing user consumption characteristic sequences respectively corresponding to a plurality of target users based on the historical consumption data; adopting an unsupervised clustering model to map each service object identifier contained in the user consumption characteristic sequence into a service object vector in a preset dimension vector space; calculating the similarity between the target business object and each reference business object according to the target business object vector and the reference business object vector, and determining a target reference business object according to the similarity; and estimating the duration data corresponding to the target service object according to the duration data corresponding to the target reference service object and the similarity corresponding to the target reference service object. By adopting the technical scheme, the technical effect of pre-estimating the time length data of the service object can be achieved, and the reliability is high.

title_en: Performance data processing method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a performance data processing method, a device and an electronic device, which can obtain the current performance static parameter value of each employee in the current period according to the target platform development construction parameter value and the target platform use feedback parameter value of each employee in the current period; obtaining a performance static matrix and a performance dynamic matrix according to the current performance static parameter value of each employee and the historical performance static parameter value of each employee in at least one historical period, wherein the historical period is a period which is before the current period and has the same time span unit as the current period; acquiring a performance comprehensive evaluation matrix according to the performance static matrix and the performance dynamic matrix; and processing the performance comprehensive evaluation matrix by using an ideal point method to obtain the performance evaluation result of each employee in the current period. The method and the device can obtain reasonable and objective performance evaluation results by fully utilizing the performance data to carry out static and dynamic comprehensive processing.

title_en: Mining area transportation frequency detection method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mining area transportation frequency detection method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method for detecting the number of times of transportation in the mining area comprises the following steps: acquiring initial positioning data of the transportation equipment; determining a key passing position according to the unloading position and the mining position; and detecting the transportation times of the transportation equipment according to the key passing position and the initial positioning data. The embodiment of the invention realizes the effects of improving the detection efficiency of the number of times of mine transportation and reducing the labor cost.

title_en: Method and system for refining enterprise equipment management informatization
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for refining enterprise equipment management informatization, and belongs to the technical field of equipment management informatization. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a management evaluation index and defining a key performance index, acquiring a management element item of the equipment, and determining a management service process task item of the equipment according to the management element item and by combining professional classification of the equipment; acquiring monitoring information of equipment, acquiring an execution process or an execution result of a task item of a management business process to acquire management data, respectively updating a key performance index and a management evaluation index by using the monitoring information and the management data, and respectively acquiring key performance management and control data and business management and control data by combining the updated key performance index and the updated management evaluation index and a preset calculation model. The invention comprehensively manages and controls the service, the flow, the technology, the tool, the cost and the expense according to the professional classification of the equipment.

title_en: Multi-cycle and multi-constraint fused aviation emergency rescue efficiency evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aviation emergency rescue efficiency evaluation method with multi-cycle and multi-constraint fusion, which comprises the steps of firstly disassembling an aviation emergency rescue task into a set of a plurality of OREAD cycles, obtaining five indexes, then determining the weight of the five indexes according to task training requirements, then obtaining a task time consumption coefficient and a task success rate according to task completion conditions, then determining a cycle probability and a cycle difficulty coefficient according to cycle occurrence probability and difficulty, finally obtaining evaluation values of the five indexes, and calculating to obtain a single efficiency evaluation result and a team comprehensive efficiency evaluation result. The task is disassembled into an OREAD cycle set, so that the mapping from the task execution process to the evaluation index is realized; two constraints of a task time consumption coefficient and a task success rate are introduced, and two constraints of a cycle probability and a cycle difficulty coefficient are increased, so that efficiency evaluation is more accurate; the single index is independent from the comprehensive evaluation, and the bidirectional evaluation is realized, so that the evaluation and the training are more targeted.

title_en: Municipal infrastructure monitoring operation and maintenance method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a municipal infrastructure monitoring operation and maintenance method, a system and a storage medium, wherein the monitoring operation and maintenance method comprises the following steps: step 1: establishing a working path of the three-dimensional laser scanner, and setting a path benchmark; step 2: driving a three-dimensional laser scanner to continuously scan the infrastructure structure outline along a preset path to obtain infrastructure outline point cloud data; and step 3: splicing the point cloud images to obtain a contour characteristic diagram; and 4, step 4: obtaining the matching degree between the contour characteristic graph of the spliced image and a pre-stored infrastructure construction contour graph, if the matching degree is lower than a preset threshold value, executing the step 5, otherwise, returning to the step 1; and 5: acquiring deformation data of an infrastructure structure deformation area; step 6: and carrying out visual processing on the deformation data, and simultaneously carrying out early warning to realize monitoring, operation and maintenance of the infrastructure. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of low arrangement difficulty, low cost, high processing speed and the like.

title_en: Ticket information display method, processing method, device, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The description provides a ticket information display method, a ticket information processing device, electronic equipment and a ticket information medium. Therefore, the scheme of the specification can effectively cope with the situations of hot time periods and the situation that the remaining tickets on the route are easily sold out, and effectively improves the user experience of the ticket purchasing user.

title_en: Commodity variable prediction method, commodity variable prediction device, and computer-readable medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a commodity variable prediction scheme, which can determine interference variables which have correlation with independent variables and target variables simultaneously from a characteristic pool related to commodities, and then determining a causal relationship graph among the independent variable, the target variable and the disturbance variable, so that the causal relationship among the variables can be determined through the causal relationship graph, if the causal relationship exists between the independent variable and the target variable, the change value of the independent variable and the sample data of the interference variable can be input into a causal prediction model to obtain a causal prediction value of the target variable after the independent variable is changed, the causal predictor thus obtained is not a relevant predictor determined based on the correlation between the variables, but can indicate a result directly caused by a change in the target variable, and can be applied to a scene in which the direct influence of the commodity variable is predicted.

title_en: Agricultural product purchasing system, method, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a system, a method, a terminal and a storage medium for purchasing agricultural products, which comprise a customer management module, a purchase management module and a storage management module, wherein the customer management module is used for adding and managing customers; the customer type is a supplier; the demand order module is used for creating an agricultural product demand order after a buyer designates a supplier, and the supplier generates an agricultural product sales order corresponding to the buyer after receiving the agricultural product demand order; and the agricultural product containing piece management module is used for managing the lease information of the agricultural product containing pieces in the purchasing process. The agricultural product purchasing system integrates diversified functional modules, ensures the accuracy of various data such as agricultural product purchasing and money transaction, reduces a large amount of manual complicated operations, reduces the labor cost, and simultaneously solves the problems that in the prior art, a merchant has to prepare a large number of storage pieces, the cost is high, the utilization rate of the storage pieces is low, and the like.

title_en: Block chain-based default asset processing method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The present specification provides a block chain-based default asset processing method, apparatus, and electronic device, including: receiving a target transaction sent by an asset management platform in the storage life of the securitized asset; the targeted transaction includes a targeted base asset for which a breach has occurred in the pool of base assets during the lifetime of the securitized asset; in response to the target transaction, invoking asset default processing logic in an intelligent contract deployed on a blockchain, and issuing default refund information of the target basic asset to the blockchain, so that after the escrow bank system monitors the default refund information, the capital refund of the target basic asset is completed to the equity beneficiary of the target basic asset from the investment account of the original equity beneficiary of the target basic asset based on the default refund information; and updating the rights and interests of the target basic asset into original rights and interests when the fund refund record corresponding to the target basic asset and issued to the block chain by the escrow bank system is obtained.

title_en: Logistics path graphical generation method, equipment, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a graphical generation method, equipment, an electronic device and a storage medium of a logistics path, wherein the graphical generation method of the logistics path comprises the following steps: generating a plurality of path block diagrams through graphical programming according to a preset first logistics transportation rule, and arranging the path block diagrams to generate a first logistics map; acquiring a transportation starting point and a transportation end point of a material, and acquiring a plurality of transportation block diagrams for material transportation from a first logistics map according to the starting point and the end point; and connecting the conveying block diagrams to generate a conveying path of the material. According to the method and the device, the problem that the generation efficiency of the logistics path is low due to the fact that the logistics path is generated in a programming mode of the PLC and the PC in the related technology is solved, and the generation efficiency of the material conveying path is improved.

title_en: Riding hot spot area prediction method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a riding hot spot region prediction method, a riding hot spot region prediction device, riding hot spot region prediction equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein vehicle passenger information in a time period needing to be clustered is processed, and then clustering is carried out by using an OPTICS clustering algorithm to obtain the number of clustering clusters in the vehicle passenger information and the number information of objects in each clustering cluster; comparing the number of the objects of each clustering cluster with a first threshold, and if the number of the objects in the clustering cluster is greater than the first threshold, inputting the clustering cluster with the number of the objects greater than the first threshold into a second model to obtain an optimal K value, wherein the K value is the number of the centers of the clustering clusters; and clustering the second information by using the optimal K value through a K-means algorithm to obtain a hot spot area for taking a bus. According to the method, the vehicle-mounted information of the vehicle is processed, and then secondary clustering is carried out, so that the taxi taking demand of a given area in a given time period is predicted.

title_en: Trusted data chain crossing system based on block chain all-in-one machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a trusted data cross-chain system based on a block chain all-in-one machine, relates to the technical field of block chains, and is used for solving the problems that data circulation among different block chains is difficult, interoperability among block chain applications is insufficient, cross-domain trusted data circulation and value exchange cannot be effectively carried out, each block chain is still an information island and a trust island, and the fusion development of block chain application ecology is hindered to a great extent; according to the invention, trusted data interaction is carried out between heterogeneous block chain platforms through a cross link through the trusted interaction module, different block chain platforms can respectively provide a block chain adapter, any block chain can be accessed to the cross link platform through the block chain adapter as long as the block chain follows a block chain access model, and the high-efficiency circulation of the value digital assets on the heterogeneous block chain platforms and the trusted connection and data interaction between the heterogeneous block chain platforms are realized.

title_en: Loan total calculation method for protecting user privacy
abstract_en: The application discloses a loan total amount calculation method for protecting user privacy, which comprises the steps that a first financial institution receives and verifies a loan application signature command and generates a request loan total signature command; summing the random number and the first loan amount to obtain a first loan sum; encrypting and signing the loan by using the next hop public key to obtain a first loan encryption sum, and sending the first loan encryption sum to the next hop node; and encrypting the current loan sum by using the next hop public key of the current node, signing and sending the current loan sum to the next hop of financial institution node until the first financial institution receives the corresponding previous hop of loan encrypted sum, and subtracting a random number from the first decrypted loan sum to obtain the actual loan total of the user. The privacy of the user is protected by the participation of the random number in the calculation. According to the embodiment of the application, on the premise that the business process is not influenced, the data privacy and the loan privacy of the user are protected, the privacy of the financial institution to the loan amount of the user is protected, and the data security is improved.

title_en: Method for generating annotation data aiming at dangerous driving behaviors and data acquisition system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data acquisition system, which comprises: the vehicle-mounted device is suitable for collecting vehicle state data in the process of executing a collection task, wherein the collection task comprises a plurality of different types of events pointing to dangerous driving behaviors; the at least one camera is suitable for collecting image data in the process of executing the collection task; the mobile terminal is arranged on the vehicle and is suitable for collecting driving state data in the process of executing the collection task and binding with the data collection equipment through the server; the data acquisition device is arranged on the vehicle and is respectively coupled with the vehicle-mounted device and the at least one camera to acquire vehicle state data and image data; and the server is suitable for carrying out association processing on the driving state data, the vehicle state data and the image data to obtain labeling data indicating dangerous driving behaviors. According to the data acquisition system provided by the invention, high-quality annotation data aiming at dangerous driving behaviors can be obtained.

title_en: Image recognition-based auditing method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to an artificial intelligence technology, and provides an auditing method, device, equipment and storage medium based on image identification, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a written qualification image to be examined, wherein the written qualification image is a prescription, an inspection report and the like; acquiring text information in the written qualification image based on the image recognition model; determining a target written qualification template corresponding to the written qualification image in a preset written qualification template according to the text information in the written qualification image; determining matching parameters of the written qualification image and the target written qualification template according to text information in the written qualification image; determining a first auditing result of the written qualification image according to matching parameters based on a preset auditing model; and executing a preset task according to the first examination result. The method can save time and labor required by auditing insurance claim settlement materials. The application also relates to a blockchain technology, and the auditing result of the written qualification image can be stored in the blockchain.

title_en: Breast risk diagnosis prediction model in thoracoscopic lung cancer resection and construction system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of operation risk diagnosis prediction models, and discloses a thoracotomy risk diagnosis prediction model in thoracoscopic lung cancer resection and a construction system thereof, wherein the construction system of the thoracotomy risk diagnosis prediction model in thoracoscopic lung cancer resection comprises: the system comprises a data acquisition module, a risk diagnosis model construction module, a data preprocessing module, a data fusion module, a data set training module, a model verification and optimization module, a central control module, a risk diagnosis prediction module, a data storage module and an update display module. The invention is based on tens of thousands of data of thoracic surgery of western China hospital, and based on the machine learning algorithms of classical logistic regression, artificial neural network, random forest and the like, a risk diagnosis and prediction model of thoracotomy in the thoracoscopic lung cancer surgery is established, and based on the established webpage version nomogram graph, after some indexes are input, the online prediction of the thoracotomy risk in the thoracoscopic lung cancer resection can be realized.

title_en: Government affair hot line work order allocation method based on event extraction and authority list
abstract_en: The invention discloses a government affair hotline work order allocation method based on event extraction and a authority list, which comprises the following steps: step 1, constructing a semantic coding layer; step 2, constructing an event extraction layer; step 3, constructing a authority list embedding layer; and 4, allocating the work orders. The method can realize the rapid positioning of the hot events and hot areas in the government affair hot line work order, thereby providing reasonable suggestion suggestions for government services, optimizing the government service effect and improving the satisfaction of people.

title_en: Parameter global optimization method of modular flood forecasting model
abstract_en: The invention provides a parameter global optimization method of a modular flood forecasting model, which comprises the following specific steps: copying a parameter global optimization main program and an optimization algorithm control file to an installation catalogue of a Chinese flood forecasting system, and performing rating calculation by using a rating parameter control file and a parameter file generated by the Chinese flood forecasting system, wherein the rated parameter file is a parameter rating result and can be directly used for real-time operation forecasting; the parameter global optimization method of the modularized flood forecasting model is reasonable in design, a general interface of a mathematical optimization method and a modularized flood forecasting model is designed, optimization calibration software is isolated into method software, a three-water-source full-scale runoff accumulation model, a three-water-source lag calculation convergence model, a Masjing river channel subsection continuous calculation model, a runoff calculation model based on soil hydrodynamics and a VG formula and other common flood forecasting models are supported, and the modularized flood forecasting model has universality, independence and expandability.

title_en: Work order reverse transmission device and method
abstract_en: The application discloses work order reverse transmission device and method, wherein, work order reverse transmission device includes: the power plant work order processing module, the power plant work order receiving module and the two-dimensional code scanning gun; the power plant work order processing module is used for converting the power plant work order into a two-dimensional code group; the two-dimensional code scanning gun identifies and stores the two-dimensional code group; the power plant work order receiving module is used for resolving the two-dimensional code into a power plant work order. The device is in order to guarantee the information security of power plant, and the device has realized that the three districts of power plant safety transmit data to the safe one district of power plant under the condition that does not change current power plant network safety floodgate. The target work order information can be timely and quickly transmitted to the first safety area of the power plant.

title_en: Method for evaluating quantitative energy storage under multiple scenes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantitative energy storage evaluation method under multiple scenes, which starts from four indexes, namely an economic index, a technical performance index, an environmental impact index and a power grid related index. Firstly, establishing an evaluation index of energy storage; secondly, standardizing the score by adopting a z-score standardization method; then, selecting weights by adopting a matrix judging method; and finally, obtaining the energy storage score condition under the current scene. The invention aims to select the factors which need to be considered for the specific type of energy storage under a specific scene, and the energy storage system which is better in performance under the scene can be selected according to the requirement by the evaluation method. The method has comprehensive selected energy storage evaluation indexes, and evaluates the application of the energy storage system in a specific scene through a multi-dimensional and multi-target evaluation system.

title_en: Data processing method and device for relational network
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a data processing method and device for a relational network, and in a corresponding embodiment, topology structure information of a target entity in the relational network is mined through a path. The topology structure information is represented by characteristic values on path characteristic items corresponding to a plurality of reference paths, the reference paths are screened from random walk paths taking all target nodes as starting points, and the commonalities among the nodes can be mined. The embodiment can improve the accuracy of the result of the predicted service processing aiming at the target node and the usability of the relation network.

title_en: Fish pond water quality detection and adjustment system based on multiple spot pH statistics
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fish pond water quality detection and adjustment system based on multipoint pH statistics, which comprises a fish pond (1), a fish pond water quality control system (2), a movable water quality detection platform (3), a suction type treatment platform (4), N pH value sensing detection modules (5), a detection buoy (6) and a water quality abnormity warning module (7); the fishpond water quality control system (2) is respectively in data communication connection with the movable water quality detection platform (3), the suction type treatment platform (4), the pH value sensing detection module (5), the detection buoy (6) and the water quality abnormity warning module (7). According to the multi-point pH statistics-based fishpond water quality detection and adjustment system and the inspection and adjustment method, the plurality of pH value detection points are arranged, the plurality of pH value points are observed, the overall characteristics and the local characteristics of the plurality of pH values are utilized for analysis, the water quality characteristics are comprehensively considered, and therefore the modes of internal circulation and external circulation are selected, the influence on the external water quality is reduced, the necessary conditions of fish culture are guaranteed, and the system and the method are environmentally friendly.

title_en: Electric vehicle dynamic path planning optimization solving method based on hybrid charging strategy
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric vehicle dynamic path planning optimization solving method based on a hybrid charging strategy, which comprises the following steps: (1) collect solutions in history and new environment: collecting solutions in historical and new environments to train a migration function f tr (ii) a (2) Generating artificial inflection point individuals similar to the inflection point characteristics by using different individual generation methods until the sum of the number of inflection points and the number of artificial inflection points in the source domain is equal to the number of non-inflection points; synthesizing artificial inflection points in the target domain, so that the sum of the number of the inflection points and the artificial inflection points in the target domain is equal to the number of non-inflection points; (3) migration function f tr Identifying high quality individuals to form a high quality initial populationTherefore, the solving efficiency of various optimization algorithms based on the population is accelerated; (4) obtaining a migration function f during training tr Then, generating a large number of solutions in a random mode; (5) migration function f tr Individuals identified as inflection points are picked as the initial population.

title_en: Discretization parameter drawing method based on four elliptical arc lines of clothes
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of garment customization, and particularly discloses a discretization parameter drawing method based on four elliptical arc lines of a garment, wherein the discretization parameter drawing method comprises the following steps: acquiring basic parameters of a target four-ellipse arc line; obtaining the radius of a base circle and the quantity of discretized line segments of the elliptic arc line; deformation and displacement processing are carried out on the quarter circular arc determined by the radius of the base circle according to basic parameters of a target quarter elliptical arc line, and a deformed and displaced quarter elliptical arc is obtained; discretizing the four-quarter elliptic arc according to the discretization line segment number of the elliptic arc to obtain a plurality of discretization line segments; drawing according to the multiple discrete line segments to obtain a target four-quadrant elliptical arc line; and outputting the target four-quarter elliptic arc line and the coordinate data corresponding to each discretization line segment to the numerical control cutting equipment. The discretization parameter drawing method based on the four elliptical arc lines of the clothes improves the universality of the drawn clothes plate core diagram.

title_en: Internal control investigation and evaluation system based on enterprise internal control flow key points and professional judgment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an internal control investigation and evaluation system based on enterprise internal control flow key points and professional judgment, and relates to the technical field of enterprise internal control management and enterprise risk management. Comprises a quantitative evaluation system and a final evaluation system; the quantitative evaluation system comprises a business flow control main point identification module, a first control main point analysis module, a weight assignment module and a first evaluation module; the final evaluation system comprises a determination evaluation item and index module, a second control point evaluation standard module, a second control point analysis module and a second evaluation module; according to the invention, through the establishment of a proprietary data platform, internal control evaluation can reflect the internal control construction of enterprises better, and supports can be formed for users of all parties.

title_en: Intelligent energy-saving variable-frequency water supply system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent energy-saving variable-frequency water supply system and a control method thereof, and particularly relates to the technical field of variable-frequency water supply. According to the invention, the statistical module, the comparison module, the data modeling module, the prediction module, the standby water supply module and the state regulation module are arranged, so that the prediction accuracy of the water supply system is ensured, and the auxiliary effect on the daily required flexibility is achieved.

title_en: Virtual resource processing method and device
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a processing method and device of virtual resources, relates to the field of data processing, and solves the problems of high instantaneous flow and high processing pressure of a server. The specific scheme comprises the following steps: the terminal equipment acquires a first preset time and the starting time of a target service; randomly determining a first time within a time period corresponding to a first preset time length before the starting time; sending a pre-allocation request to a server at a first moment, wherein the pre-allocation request is used for requesting to allocate target virtual resources in advance; receiving a response message from the server, wherein the response message comprises a target keyword and indication information, the indication information is used for indicating that target virtual resources are allocated in advance, and the target keyword corresponds to the target virtual resources; after the target service is started at the starting moment, sending a virtual resource acquisition request comprising a target keyword to a server, wherein the virtual resource acquisition request is used for requesting to acquire a target virtual resource corresponding to the target keyword; a target virtual resource is received from a server.

title_en: Method for treating medical waste collection problem by using improved genetic algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for processing medical waste collection problems by using an improved genetic algorithm, wherein medical waste collection work is completed by a plurality of robots, and a scheduling scheme of the robots is obtained by the following steps: s1, determining positions of collecting points and robot workstations in the graph according to a plan view of a hospital, calculating distances between the collecting points and the workstations and distances between the collecting points to obtain a distance matrix, and determining the amount of medical waste at each collecting point; s2, establishing a robot scheduling model for medical waste collection; and S3, solving the robot scheduling model for medical waste collection established in the step S2 through an improved genetic algorithm, so as to obtain a scheduling scheme of a plurality of robots. The invention has the advantages of improving the efficiency of medical waste collection, improving the safety and usability in the collection process, avoiding the algorithm from falling into an extreme value trap, and the like.

title_en: User identification method based on user joint information super vector and joint information model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a user identification method based on a user joint information super vector and a joint information model, which comprises the following steps: mapping user information from a one-dimensional feature space to a high-dimensional feature space, and constructing a user joint information feature super vector; constructing a user expansion joint information characteristic super vector according to various names or calling methods presented by user information; in the training stage, training the user joint information characteristic super vector to obtain a user joint information model; in the identification stage, model matching is carried out on the input user combined information characteristic super vector, or model matching is carried out after the input user expanded combined information characteristic super vector is converted into the user combined information characteristic super vector, and user identification is carried out according to a matching result. The invention can more accurately and quickly find the user when the information such as the name, the unit, the address and the like of the user presents various names and various calling methods, and has extremely high real-time property.

title_en: Intelligent parameter information acquisition system for predicting state of clinical emergency equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of information acquisition, in particular to a parameter information acquisition system for predicting the state of intelligent clinical emergency equipment, which comprises a parameter calling unit, a parameter identification unit, a parameter processing unit, a parameter judgment unit, a sending unit and a parameter selecting and acquiring unit, wherein the parameter calling unit is used for calling the parameter information; the information-reference calling unit is used for storing information of the relevant information of the intelligent clinical emergency equipment and transmitting the information of the relevant information to the information-reference identifying unit; the parameter identification unit is used for identifying the parameter information, and the invention carries out further data processing on the related classified data so as to finely process the change of the related data and analyze the numerical values of the equipment parts at the same time and in the same state, thereby facilitating the comparison of the data in the later period, increasing the accuracy of the compared numerical values and increasing the reliability of the data.

title_en: User classification method and device and item recommendation method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a user classification method and device, a project recommendation method and device, an electronic device and a computer storage medium, wherein the user classification method comprises the following steps: acquiring a user attribute data set and the number of initial clustering centers; clustering data points in the user attribute data set until convergence, and generating a plurality of first clusters corresponding to the number of initial clustering centers; determining the intra-cluster evaluation index and the number of intra-cluster users of each first cluster; and when determining that the intra-cluster evaluation index does not meet the standard intra-cluster evaluation index and/or the number of intra-cluster users does not meet the standard intra-cluster user number, adjusting the number of the clustering centers, re-clustering the data points in the user attribute data set according to the adjusted number of the clustering centers until convergence, generating a plurality of second clusters corresponding to the adjusted number of the clustering centers, and adjusting the number of the clustering centers to improve the accuracy of the clustering result.

title_en: Recruitment method, device, equipment and storage medium based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to an artificial intelligence technology, and discloses a recruitment method based on artificial intelligence, which comprises the following steps: screening target user information conforming to recruitment information from a preset user information cluster; extracting a telephone number from the target user information, and calling the telephone number to acquire user voice data generated in the calling process; recognizing the voice emotion of the voice data of the user, and calculating the intention degree according to the recognition result; extracting semantic information of user voice data, and calculating the matching degree of the semantic information and standard speech in a preset speech template library; and calculating the score of the user corresponding to the target user information according to the intention degree and the matching degree, and screening the user with the score larger than a preset threshold as a recruitment candidate. In addition, the present invention relates to blockchain technology, such as recruitment information that may be stored at nodes of the blockchain. The invention also provides recruitment device, equipment and medium based on the artificial intelligence. The invention improves the accuracy of recruitment post matching.

title_en: Sulfur hexafluoride recycling management system and method based on blockchain
abstract_en: The invention provides a sulfur hexafluoride recycling management system and method based on a blockchain, and the scheme is that an in-equipment gas weighing system is designed, the weight of sulfur hexafluoride in equipment is accurately determined in real time based on a Betty-Bridgman state equation and a self-tuning weighing sensor tag arranged at the bottom of a steel cylinder, meanwhile, information such as equipment and gas circulation and the blockchain technology are combined, a distributed storage and sharing mechanism of sulfur hexafluoride gas data is realized, the chain management rule is jointly followed, real data management of sulfur hexafluoride gas consumption is realized, the state of gas can be tracked in real time, the recovered and purified gas can be recycled in time, and the management efficiency is improved.

title_en: Route planning method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a route planning method, a route planning device, route planning equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a starting point, a plurality of intermediate points and an ending point of a route to be planned, planning a first route segment according to the plurality of intermediate points and the ending point of the route to be planned, judging whether the starting point of the route to be planned is in a factory, planning the shortest route from the starting point of the route to be planned to the first route segment according to a pre-built restricted route database when the starting point of the route to be planned is in the factory, obtaining a second route segment, planning the second route segment from the starting point of the route to be planned to the starting point of the first route segment according to the pre-built restricted route database when the starting point of the route to be planned is not in the factory, and obtaining a planned complete route according to the first route segment and the second route segment. According to the method, the nearest route can be planned in the factory and the embedded factory, and the problem that the route is influenced by the factory and the embedded factory in the process of planning the route is solved.

title_en: Flight plan minimum sample size confirmation method and device for airspace simulation analysis
abstract_en: A flight plan minimum sample size confirming method and device for airspace simulation analysis can find a balance point between workload and accuracy, provide a data base for airspace simulation modeling and evaluation analysis, can be popularized to post analysis of airspace evaluation, and collect air traffic control monitoring data with reasonable scale and proper accuracy for analysis when airspace operation state is evaluated by using air traffic control monitoring historical data. The method comprises the following steps: (1) calculating pearson correlation coefficients of the sector evaluation index; (2) analyzing the correlation coefficient differences to determine a minimum sample size: and analyzing the correlation coefficient of the evaluation index of each day in a week, analyzing the correlation coefficient of the evaluation index of each week in a week, analyzing the correlation coefficient of the evaluation index of each two weeks in a week, and determining the minimum sample size by analyzing and comparing the Pears correlation coefficients of the airspace simulation evaluation indexes of one day, one week, two weeks and three weeks of a control sector of a certain area.

title_en: Nuclear power station system operation trend prediction method based on improved random forest
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting the operation trend of a nuclear power station system based on improved random forests, which comprises the following steps: (1) predicting the single step of the random forest; (2) a random forest multi-step prediction step; (3) and (4) multi-step prediction correction. The random forest method used by the invention is accurate in single-step prediction and poor in multi-step prediction effect, because the random forest can predict the change trend of a curve during prediction, but is insensitive to data change, the error of the random forest is likely to become larger when the data is increased or decreased and becomes slow, and the slope prediction considers the change of the slope in a short time and is sensitive to the change of the data in the short time, so that the prediction can be carried out in a weighted average mode of the random forest prediction and the slope prediction, the method can effectively improve the accuracy of the multi-step prediction and improve the usability of the multi-step prediction of the random forest.

title_en: Consensus method and device for block chain system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a consensus method and a consensus device of a block chain system, wherein the block chain system comprises a plurality of node mechanisms, and each node mechanism is provided with a plurality of nodes; the method comprises the following steps: aiming at least one node mechanism, a first main node in the node mechanism generates election proof and sends the election proof to a first election node in the node mechanism; the first main node is determined by each node in the node mechanism based on a Raft consensus algorithm; generating an election proof transaction based on the received plurality of election proof signatures and election proofs; the election certification signature is obtained by signing the election certification after the first election node determines that the election certification meets the first verification requirement; and the first main node is used as a PBFT consensus node of the block chain system after the block chain system determines that the election proves that the transaction consensus is successful based on the PBFT consensus algorithm. The calculated amount of the consensus process in the block chain system is reduced, the complexity of the PBFT consensus algorithm network is reduced, and the expandability of the block chain system is improved.

title_en: Method, system, electronic device and storage medium for predicting credit risk of user
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a system, an electronic device and a storage medium for credit risk prediction of a user, wherein the method comprises the following steps: converting the user behavior sequence data into a time sequence coding vector and a mechanism sequence coding vector according to the user behavior sequence dictionary; then, converting the time sequence coding vector and the mechanism sequence coding vector through Embedding to obtain a low-dimensional dense time sequence coding vector and a mechanism sequence coding vector, and splicing the low-dimensional dense time sequence coding vector and the mechanism sequence coding vector to obtain a spliced vector; and finally, processing the spliced vector through a wavenet module, extracting a characteristic vector of the user behavior to obtain a target vector, inputting the target vector into a DNN module for prediction, and outputting to obtain a target variable value to be predicted. Through the application, the generalization capability of the model is enhanced, and the distinguishing effect of the model is improved.

title_en: Data verification method, data verification system, and readable storage medium
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention provide a data verification method, a data verification system, and a readable storage medium. The data checking method comprises the steps of sending a data checking request to a service system, receiving a checking starting instruction sent by the service system and controlling first electronic equipment to start working according to the checking starting instruction, sending checking data acquired by the first electronic equipment to the service system for the service system to perform data checking operation on the checking data, receiving a checking result of the checking data sent by the service system and controlling the first electronic equipment to work according to the checking result. By sending the data checking request to the service system, on one hand, the first electronic equipment is prevented from being manually blocked from sending checking data to the service system to perform data checking operation in the insurance sales process, and on the other hand, the situation that an operator forgets to establish connection with the service system due to negligence in work can be avoided, so that the service system cannot be started in time to perform data checking operation.

title_en: Security knowledge map construction and fusion method and system based on geographic knowledge
abstract_en: The invention discloses a security knowledge map construction and fusion method based on geographic knowledge, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: the method comprises the steps that geographic data and security data are obtained, and the two types of data are used as bodies and stored in a graph database; analyzing the association degree of the security scene ontology and the geographic position ontology; adding and fusing the geographical position ontology with higher association degree with the security scene ontology into a knowledge graph node of the security ontology; according to whether the use result of the subsequent security knowledge graph ontology meets the security requirement or not, the orientation relation, the distance relation, the inheritance relation and the affiliation relation of the knowledge graph are redistributed; and in the process of displaying the knowledge graph, the relevant geographic ontology nodes in the security ontology are highlighted in key according to the danger probability, so that a manager can obtain the most dangerous geographic position information in time in the emergency state of the security incident. The method for associating and fusing the two knowledge maps is favorable for optimizing the construction of the two knowledge maps at the beginning of map construction, and can perform association display according to the association of different knowledge maps.

title_en: Thermal power generating unit performance index evaluation method based on hypothesis testing method
