abstract_en: The invention discloses a thermal power generating unit performance index evaluation method based on a hypothesis testing method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring monitoring values of the performance indexes of the thermal power generating unit in two adjacent monitoring periods; calculating the average value and the standard deviation of the monitoring values of the performance indexes of the thermal power generating unit in two adjacent detection periods; and calculating a statistical inspection quantity T according to the calculated average value and standard deviation, and evaluating the performance index of the thermal power generating unit according to the statistical inspection quantity T.

title_en: Computer-implemented system and method for effecting transfers over blockchain networks
abstract_en: The present invention provides an improved validation solution for blockchain implemented transfers. The improved authentication solution is suitable for, but not limited to, implementation in an SPV wallet. According to one embodiment, a system or resource is provided that includes a plurality of novel SPV verification components whose activities are coordinated by a coordination component. The system enables bob to send a payment transaction template (template Tx3) to alice and request the following: complete transaction data for all input transactions (Tx1, Tx2), including at least one output that Alice wants to spend, as input for the transfer (Tx 3); (ii) the mercker paths of all input transactions (Tx1, Tx2) linking them to respective mercker roots associated with their respective tile heads; the completed transfer transaction (Tx 3). Alice provides this information along with her signature. Bob may then perform local SPV checks on the incoming transactions Tx1, Tx2 using transaction Tx1 and Tx2, their corresponding Mercker path 1, path 2, and Bob's local block header list. Bob broadcasts the transfer transaction (Tx3) to the P2P network.

title_en: Creative project management method, device, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a creative project management method, a creative project management device, a terminal and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: receiving creative files sent according to the requirements of clients; determining a target approval process according to the type of the client; performing on-line examination and approval on the creative file according to the target examination and approval process, and determining a target examination and approval result; and if the target approval result is qualified, sharing the creative file to the client. According to the invention, the service requirements are released on the project management platform, the creative file corresponding to the service requirements sent by the designer is received, then the platform examines and approves the creative file, and the creative file is directly shared to the client after the examination and approval are finished.

title_en: Resource quota allocation method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a resource quota allocation method, a device, an electronic device and a computer readable medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring user information of a user, wherein the user information comprises basic information and behavior information; extracting a plurality of risk analysis models from a model library, wherein the plurality of risk analysis models are generated through different machine learning algorithms and/or historical user information; respectively inputting the user information into the multiple risk analysis models to generate multiple risk scores; comparing the plurality of risk scores with a plurality of threshold intervals to generate a plurality of adjustment coefficients; and allocating a resource quota for the user based on the plurality of adjustment coefficients. The resource quota allocation method, the device, the electronic equipment and the computer readable medium can be used for rapidly and accurately allocating the resource quota to the user, improving the user satisfaction, reducing the enterprise resource risk and improving the server processing efficiency.

title_en: Power line control system for power teaching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power line control system for power teaching, which comprises a classroom collection module, a teaching analysis module and an examination control module, the classroom collecting module is used for collecting the hand-raising information of students in class, the teaching analysis module is used for calculating the participation degree of each teacher in class, the assessment control module is used for adjusting the bonus allocation of teachers according to the classroom participation degree of students, the classroom collecting module comprises an infrared sensing module, a timing module and a counting module, the teaching analysis module comprises a classroom matching module and a participation degree analysis module, the examination control module comprises a bonus allocation module and a line control module, the infrared sensing module is electrically connected with the line control module, the participation degree analysis module is electrically connected with the bonus distribution module, and the invention has the characteristic of adjusting the teaching quality bonus dispensing quantity of teachers according to the hand-lifting condition of students.

title_en: Analysis method and system for service recording
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an analysis method for service recording. The method comprises the following steps: performing voice transcription on the service recording from the digital store, and determining a text to be analyzed; mining the unknown knowledge related to the service from the text to be analyzed, and organizing the knowledge according to the analysis granularity to automatically generate a data source containing each topic and corresponding multi-level sub-topics; and determining an analysis index based on the data source, and displaying the analysis index in a visual page. The embodiment of the invention also provides an analysis system for the service recording. According to the embodiment of the invention, the unknown knowledge related to the service is mined, the mined content can be automatically expanded according to the change of the service recording, the analysis result of the service recording is more extensive and accurate, the applicability is wider, and the mined content is dynamically associated with the mining algorithm, so that the use experience is improved.

title_en: Method for evaluating competitive advantage degree of submerged plants in different hydrodynamic areas and application
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating competitive advantage degrees of submerged plants in different hydrodynamic regions and application, and relates to the technical field of ecological restoration of submerged plants. According to the method, according to the hydrodynamic characteristics of different areas of the water body, an indoor middle-intermediate space test is set to simulate different hydrodynamic conditions, the indigenous species in the target water area are selected for co-planting culture, the change of the competitive advantage degrees of the different species under the different hydrodynamic conditions is evaluated, and powerful theoretical support and practical foundation are provided for constructing submerged plant communities to carry out field restoration. According to the method, a competition system is constructed, submerged plant species with high competitive advantages under different water exchange conditions are selected, and reference is provided for restoring submerged plants in the field; the method is simple to operate and low in cost.

title_en: Power utilization safety inspection system and analysis method
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of power equipment inspection, and provides an electricity safety inspection system and an analysis method, wherein the system comprises a cloud service platform and at least one wearable inspection device, the wearable inspection device is provided with a wearing bracket, the front end of the wearing bracket is provided with a display lens and a depth camera lens, the wearing bracket is provided with a device positioning module, a wireless transmission module and a device safety identification processing module, and the device safety identification processing module comprises: an input unit; an operation and storage unit; a virtual object database; a deficiency-excess fusion mechanism; and an output unit. The embodiment of the invention can quickly identify and analyze the cable and the meter, visually display the inspection personnel through the virtual-real fused image, greatly improve the efficiency of the inspection personnel, improve the accuracy of safety inspection, reduce the labor cost and time cost, and simultaneously seek remote or on-site assistance when independent processing cannot be carried out.

title_en: Multi-account fusion payment method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-account fusion payment method and a device, which relate to the technical field of artificial intelligence, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving a payment request submitted by a user, wherein the payment request comprises a bill amount; inputting behavior data when a user submits a payment request into a user behavior analysis model to obtain payment priorities of a plurality of accounts of the user; the user behavior analysis model is obtained by training the machine learning model according to historical behavior data of a user and corresponding historical payment priorities of a plurality of accounts of the user; and sequentially deducting the available balance from the plurality of accounts of the user according to the sequence from high payment priority to low payment priority until the deduction total amount meets the bill amount. The invention can avoid the breakpoint in the payment process of the user, improve the payment efficiency of the user and improve the user experience.

title_en: Monitoring method and device of shared equipment and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a monitoring method and device for shared equipment and electronic equipment, and belongs to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a plurality of signaling reported by a signaling acquisition system, wherein each signaling comprises an Internet of things card identification code and a position coordinate of a sharing device uniquely corresponding to the Internet of things card identification code at the current reporting moment; acquiring position coordinates of the target equipment at all reporting moments; judging whether at least one position coordinate in all position coordinates of the target equipment is located in a preset risk block or not; if at least one position coordinate is located in the risk block, determining a target risk type of the target equipment according to all position coordinates of the target equipment; and applying risk treatment measures corresponding to the target risk types to the target equipment. Through the scheme, the equipment identification and the position coordinate acquisition are carried out by utilizing the pre-existing Internet of things card in the Internet of things sharing equipment, so that the positioning cost is reduced, and the risk monitoring efficiency and timeliness of the sharing equipment are improved.

title_en: Business collaboration method and system based on block chain
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a business collaboration method and a business collaboration system based on a block chain. The method executed on the side of the inquirer comprises the following steps: the first business investigation system receives a business investigation request input by an inquirer; the service collaborative query request comprises service information, information of query personnel and information of a queried target; the first service investigation system uploads the related information of the service investigation request to the blockchain to obtain a first blockchain address for storing the related information; the first service assistance system sends a service assistance request and a first blockchain address to the second service assistance system. The method does not need to be handled by inquiry personnel on site, and realizes the non-forgery, non-repudiation and traceability of the service inquiry process.

title_en: Multi-unit multi-mode heat supply power plant operation comprehensive evaluation method based on fuzzy analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive evaluation method for multi-unit multi-mode heat supply power plant operation based on fuzzy analysis, which comprises the following steps: s1, setting a multi-heating mode combination scheme when the heating unit participates in deep peak shaving cooperative operation; s2, constructing a digital twin model of the multi-mode depth peak regulation of the unit; s3, establishing a multi-mode deep peak regulation evaluation model of the heat supply unit at least comprising an economic evaluation index, an environmental protection evaluation index and a multi-dimensional constraint condition; s4, constructing a judgment matrix among the evaluation indexes, determining a weight vector of each evaluation index to unit peak regulation, and establishing a fuzzy decision matrix between each multi-heating mode combination scheme and each evaluation index; and step S5, fuzzy calculation is carried out on the weight vector and the fuzzy decision matrix by adopting a fuzzy decision algorithm. The invention evaluates the units with different heat supply mode combination schemes, realizes the optimization of the unit transformation technical combination scheme, and realizes the plant-level intelligent quantitative operation scheduling decision of the peak-shaving thermal power plant.

title_en: Method, system, device and storage medium for configuring energy in region
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, a device and a storage medium for configuring energy in a region, wherein the method comprises the following steps: predicting an energy load amount in a first time period based on user information in the area; calculating the energy supply amount of the region in a first time period based on the natural environment information and the preset planning information; calculating an energy consumption amount of the area based on the energy load amount and the energy supply amount; calculating a configuration parameter range of the energy source based on the energy consumption; calculating a target configuration parameter that maximizes an energy revenue parameter for an area during a first time period, within a configuration parameter range; the capacity of the energy source within the area is configured based on the target configuration parameter. According to the method and the device, the energy load amount is estimated based on the user information in the region, and the energy supply amount is estimated according to the natural environment information and the preset planning information in the region, so that the target configuration parameter for maximizing the energy profit parameter is calculated, and the energy in the region is reasonably configured according to the target configuration parameter.

title_en: Method for requesting resources, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for requesting resources, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining index values of a plurality of first indexes corresponding to each historical request based on at least one resource scheduling parameter corresponding to each historical request in a first request set corresponding to first resources; the method comprises the steps of constructing a decision tree based on index values of a plurality of first indexes corresponding to each historical request and first thresholds corresponding to each first index, adjusting the first thresholds corresponding to at least one first index in the decision tree and request sets corresponding to each node in the decision tree based on the adjusted first thresholds under the condition that index values of any second index are not in corresponding setting ranges, determining at least one first index sequence and corresponding threshold sequences based on the adjusted decision tree, and processing the first request based on the determined first index sequences and corresponding threshold sequences, wherein the first request is used for requesting to increase the number of first resources.

title_en: Portrait photo content analysis method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portrait photo content analysis method and system based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a background picture and at least one portrait picture in the portrait picture to be analyzed based on the portrait segmentation model; obtaining a probability value of each type of environmental features in the background picture and a probability value of each type of human body features in the portrait picture based on a 2 classification model; and obtaining the probability value of each type of fine-grained object in the portrait picture based on a single-target detection model. The invention aims to provide a portrait photo content analysis method and system based on deep learning, and aims to solve the problems that background environment features and object features in a portrait photo cannot be extracted simultaneously in the prior art, and the problems that the number of samples required by content recognition model training is large, the investment of labeling cost is high, and the requirement on training environment resources is high.

title_en: Comprehensive evaluation system, method and storage medium for expressway operation and maintenance management
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive evaluation system, a method and a storage medium for expressway operation and maintenance management, wherein the system comprises a data access interface: accessing reference data for evaluating user operation service data into a server of the evaluation system by using a uniform data interface; a data acquisition subsystem: the system is used for recording and transmitting user operation service data in real time; evaluation and analysis subsystem: the operation and maintenance management evaluation system is used for analyzing and evaluating the operation and maintenance information and the real-time operation data according to the input reference data and obtaining an operation and maintenance management evaluation result; and the result display subsystem: the operation and maintenance management evaluation result is displayed; by fusing the operation service system and the evaluation system, smooth butt joint of data information can be quickly realized from implementation to association to feedback of operation and maintenance, the intermediate transition period is reduced, and efficient conversion from use to regulation is realized; the method realizes the visual management of the real-time operation and real-time evaluation and real-time feedback, and provides accurate decision support for managers.

title_en: Method and device for parallel processing of picking and invoice printing
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for parallel processing of goods picking and invoice printing, which are characterized in that batch numbers of goods picking batches are set in a cross-wave increasing mode, then based on configuration of preset container numbers, the container numbers corresponding to the batch numbers of all the goods picking batches are determined in a mode of adding 1 after the batch numbers and the preset container numbers are obtained, and the invoice of each goods picking batch is placed in a container corresponding to the container number, so that the situation that all the invoice are stacked together or the container where the invoice is located is difficult to position is avoided, and the technical problems of low efficiency and high traversal number in matching the invoice with goods when the printing and goods picking of the invoice are carried out are solved.

title_en: Power generation demand dispatching method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a power generation demand dispatching method, a power generation demand dispatching device and electronic equipment, which are applied to a server, wherein the server is in communication connection with a plurality of base stations and a plurality of power generation vehicles; the method comprises the steps of creating a power generation requirement work order of any base station in a plurality of base stations if power failure warning signals of the base stations are received, wherein the power failure warning signals carry position information of the base stations, screening target power generation vehicles meeting preset requirements from the plurality of power generation vehicles according to the position information of the base stations, and distributing the power generation requirement work order of the base stations to the target power generation vehicles so as to provide power generation services for the base stations through the target power generation vehicles. According to the method, through preset requirements, target power generation vehicles meeting the preset requirements are automatically screened from a plurality of power generation vehicles, so that the dispatching efficiency of the power generation vehicles is improved.

title_en: Intelligent mobile phone assembly production teaching method based on virtual simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a teaching method for intelligent assembly production of a mobile phone based on virtual simulation, which can develop digital twin simulation according to different production lines, processing equipment or teaching instruments, perform virtual simulation in a computer and simulate the running condition of real equipment in real time. The configuration and the working flow of a real intelligent mobile phone manufacturing production line are simulated through the virtual teaching practical training system, a student writes a PLC program, inputs a real PLC, and performs data communication with digital twin simulation software through the PLC program to drive virtual equipment in a virtual simulation scene to simulate the production process according to the working flow designed by the program. The invention can avoid equipment safety accidents, ensure the personal safety of students in teaching and practical training, avoid the damage loss of real equipment in virtual simulation, and greatly improve the teaching effect by enabling the students to test the equipment in a large scale.

title_en: AI talent docking system and method, storage medium, and electronic apparatus
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an AI talent docking system and method, storage medium and electronic device, belongs to the technical field of internet recruitment, and includes job hunting end, enterprise end and server, the job hunting end includes: the intelligent search system comprises a registration module, a login module, a resume module and a post search module, wherein the post search module comprises a first AI on duty unit, and the first AI on duty unit is configured to perform intelligent search screening according to an individualized setting value and send a notification when posts are matched; post display module, the enterprise end includes: the intelligent search system comprises a second AI on duty unit, a third AI on duty unit and a server, wherein the second AI on duty unit is configured to perform intelligent search, screening and matching according to an individualized setting value and receive feedback information of the first AI on duty unit in the server, and the third AI on duty unit is configured to perform intelligent search and screening according to detailed search conditions and send a notice when the posts are matched, so that the problems of talent job hunting and low enterprise recruitment efficiency in the related technology are at least solved.

title_en: Long-term load prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a long-term load prediction method, which comprises the steps of obtaining load relevance influence factor data; preprocessing the load relevance influence factor data; fusing the characteristics of the preprocessed relevance influence factor data; and using the fused features for training a LightGBM model, and predicting the load through the trained LightGBM model. The method does not depend on historical load data, only takes load relevance factors such as buildings, weather and the like as input, and predicts the load for a period of time in the future.

title_en: Method and device for selecting and optimizing quick-charging piles and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quick-charging pile selection optimization method, a quick-charging pile selection optimization device and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the quick-charging pile selection optimization method comprises the following steps: when the preset conditions are met, positioning the serial number and the position of the quick filling pile; judging whether the quick-filling pile is a current-limiting quick-filling pile or not; if the quick-filling pile is a current-limiting quick-filling pile, recording the serial number of the current-limiting quick-filling pile; and when an instruction for selecting the quick filling pile from the client is received, automatically filtering the current-limiting quick filling pile according to the serial number of the current-limiting quick filling pile. By implementing the method and the device, whether the current limiting phenomenon exists in the quick-charging pile can be judged, the risk that a user uses the current-limiting quick-charging pile is avoided in advance, the quick-charging pile selection optimization is realized, the quick-charging efficiency is improved, the problem that the user complains about slow quick charging is prevented, and the vehicle using experience is improved.

title_en: Short-term power load prediction method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a short-term power load prediction method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring time to be predicted and a transformer area to be predicted; acquiring a plurality of district load types corresponding to the district to be predicted; acquiring a load prediction model corresponding to each platform area load type; inputting the time to be predicted, the environmental data corresponding to the time to be predicted and the time attribute into each load prediction model to obtain a load prediction value output by each load prediction model; and summing all the load predicted values to obtain a target load predicted value corresponding to the to-be-predicted platform area. The technical problem that the accuracy is low in the existing short-term power load prediction method is solved.

title_en: Model-based monitoring data display method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and provides a monitoring data display method and device based on a model, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: responding to a monitoring data viewing request of a user, and verifying the user; if the verification is passed, establishing connection between the called logging module and each monitoring tool, and acquiring monitoring data from the monitoring tools based on the logging module; determining a target abnormity prediction model from a plurality of abnormity prediction models generated by pre-training; carrying out anomaly analysis on each monitoring data based on the target anomaly prediction model to obtain a corresponding anomaly analysis result; performing state labeling on each monitoring data based on the abnormal analysis result to obtain labeled monitoring data; and displaying the marked monitoring data through a preset billboard. The efficiency of acquiring and arranging the monitoring data and the processing efficiency of anomaly analysis can be improved through the method and the device. The method and the device can also be applied to the field of block chains, and the monitoring data can be stored on the block chains.

title_en: Target classification evaluation method and device based on informed production information
abstract_en: One or more embodiments of the present specification provide a method and an apparatus for target classification evaluation based on known production information, including: acquiring comparison information, and performing admission verification according to a verification rule table; after the access, inquiring the intellectual property information and judging whether the intellectual property information meets the conditions or not; if yes, continuously extracting anti-fraud information items, carrying out anti-fraud scoring, and judging whether the sum of scores exceeds a threshold value; if not, determining an index score corresponding to each item of comparison information according to a preset score table, and calculating a final comprehensive score through a score card model in combination with the weight; and determining the target type of the target, constructing a resource allocation scheme according to the target type, and outputting the resource allocation scheme. One or more embodiments of the present disclosure perform multiple checks on the comparison information of the target, and perform comprehensive evaluation around the intellectual property information, so that the evaluation factors of the target are more comprehensive, the classification of the target after evaluation is more accurate, and the efficiency and accuracy of target classification are improved.

title_en: Remote advisor video management system, method, device and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a remote advisor video management system, a method, a device and computer equipment, which are applied to the field of Internet. The system comprises: the system comprises a client side arranged in an offline store and used for initiating a video call request when receiving an operation instruction of calling a remote consultant; and the management center is arranged at the cloud end and used for receiving the video call request, distributing an advisor end for the video call request as a target advisor end according to the latest remote advisor data, and establishing a video call between the target advisor end and the user end. The invention can improve the coverage rate of consumers.

title_en: Method, device, terminal equipment and storage medium for sending short message
abstract_en: The application is suitable for the technical field of artificial intelligence, and provides a method, a device, terminal equipment and a storage medium for sending a short message. Firstly, acquiring test set data of target commodities, wherein the test set data comprises a first test set and a second test set, then inputting the first test set into a probability prediction model for processing to obtain predicted probability values of target commodities purchased by historical users, dividing the obtained predicted probability values into probability distribution intervals, then respectively calculating average conversion rate of each probability distribution interval according to the predicted probability values contained in each probability distribution interval, then inputting the second test set into the probability prediction model for processing to obtain the predicted probability values of target commodities purchased by the target users, and calculating the predicted conversion number of the target commodities based on the obtained predicted probability values and the average conversion rate of each probability distribution interval, and finally, determining whether to send short messages of the target commodities to the target users according to the predicted conversion number.

title_en: Automatic data analysis system for performance detection of new energy lithium battery
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of data analysis systems, in particular to an automatic data analysis system for performance detection of a new energy lithium battery, aiming at the problem that the existing operation and analysis are carried out manually and errors are easy to occur, the invention provides a scheme which comprises an acquisition module, a data uploading module, a data storage module, a demand analysis module, a process step confirmation module, an analysis parameter setting module, an automatic data analysis module, a report generation module and an output module, wherein the acquisition module is connected with the data uploading module, the data uploading module is connected with the data storage module, the data storage module is connected with the demand analysis module, the demand analysis module is connected with the process step confirmation module, the process step confirmation module is connected with the analysis parameter setting module, and the analysis parameter setting module is connected with the automatic data analysis module, so that the analysis efficiency can be improved, avoiding human errors and analysis inconsistency and improving the quality of battery research, development, trial production and production products.

title_en: Method and device for determining illumination intensity
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for determining illumination intensity. The method comprises the steps of obtaining current environment state space parameters in a target area, wherein the environment state space parameters at least comprise indoor illumination intensity, current time and real-time electricity price, obtaining an instant punishment value and an accumulated punishment value according to the environment state space parameters, obtaining a regulating instruction according to the instant punishment value and the accumulated punishment value, wherein the regulating instruction is used for regulating the illumination intensity of illumination equipment, regulating the illumination intensity in the target area based on the regulating instruction, and determining the target illumination intensity based on the regulated illumination intensity. The application solves the technical problems that the normal work of a user is influenced, the electric energy resource is wasted and the user experience is influenced because the illumination intensity is adjusted by setting a fixed threshold value in the related art without considering the user preference.

title_en: Elevator dispatching method, system, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The elevator dispatching method, system, device and storage medium comprise the steps of obtaining first identification information of an article to be dispatched through an information acquisition terminal, conducting authority verification on the first identification information and second identification information of the information acquisition terminal, determining that verification is passed, extracting dispatching information according to the first identification information, wherein the dispatching information comprises a destination floor, determining a target elevator according to the dispatching information, generating a first elevator calling instruction according to the target elevator and the destination floor, and controlling the target elevator to operate to the destination floor according to the first elevator calling instruction.

title_en: Stable currency transaction model and stable currency transaction algorithm based on digital certificate
abstract_en: The invention provides a stable currency transaction model based on a digital certificate, which comprises three types of participation roles, wherein the three types of participation roles are as follows: the system comprises a stable currency issuer, a virtual asset facilitator and a client, wherein the client comprises an enterprise or an individual, the stable currency issuer obtains an authorized issue stable currency through a full-text unit, the stable currency issuer obtains an authorized issue digital certificate, a holder obtains a corresponding digital certificate to indicate ownership of the digital certificate, transaction of all the stable currencies is realized through verification, generation and invalidation of the digital certificate on a block chain, nodes on the block chain complete generation, verification and invalidation of the digital certificate, and the nodes on the block chain maintain an invalidation certificate ID list which is used for recording the digital certificate which is invalidated due to loss or expense and is used for verifying validity of the digital certificate; the stable currency issuer may also be the virtual asset facilitator at the same time. Corresponding trading algorithms are also disclosed.

title_en: Calculation scheme for retailers to collect commodity sales rebate fees from suppliers
abstract_en: The invention discloses a calculation scheme for a retailer to collect commodity sales rebate fees from suppliers, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: step S1: abstract modeling is carried out according to elements and rules signed in the rebate agreement contract, and more than 1 rebate fee charging rules are configured in the built model to form a rule model data structure; step S2: and uploading the streaming data to a regular model data structure through the MQ system, wherein the streaming data comprises the steps of service time, commodity coding, supplier coding, store coding, promotion coding, moving average cost, service quantity data and the like. The invention flexibly establishes a plurality of rebate rules according to the protocol by abstracting and modeling the service scene and flow of rebate cost calculation, rapidly screens the rules and processes the rebate logic, realizes the complex charging flow by adopting a software system, liberates the labor cost and improves the calculation efficiency of the running water rebate cost.

title_en: Combined optimization method and device for asset delivery, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a combination optimization method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium for asset delivery. The method comprises the steps of obtaining order demand parameters, reading asset data meeting order demands in a database according to the order demand parameters, obtaining overlap relations among the asset data, integrating the overlap relations to obtain an asset list, inputting the asset list into a preset integer programming model, and solving according to preset constraint conditions and preset objective functions of the integer programming model to determine target assets needing to be delivered. By applying the integer programming model, only the asset data is transmitted, the proper target asset can be automatically solved, the optimal solution can be obtained at the second level, the speed of obtaining the result is greatly improved, the asset matching efficiency can be effectively improved, the quick utilization of the asset is realized, the unified measurement standard is provided, and the optimal solution can be obtained for a plurality of similar matching results according to the measurement standard, so that the solving result has higher quality.

title_en: Traffic flow prediction method based on space-time data embedding
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traffic flow prediction method based on space-time data embedding, which comprises the steps of obtaining historical traffic flow data, executing space-time data embedding based on the historical traffic flow data, wherein the traffic flow interval represents that each determined traffic flow interval belongs to be converted into a corresponding traffic flow interval, generating traffic flow vectors, taking all traffic flow intervals as input data, adopting a Word2vec model to convert the input data into embedded data, namely corresponding traffic flow vectors, extracting time features based on the traffic flow vectors to obtain node feature matrixes, extracting correlations among electric alarm devices to obtain dynamic correlation graphs, and inputting the node feature matrixes and the dynamic correlation graphs into a graph convolution neural network to obtain prediction results output by the graph convolution neural network. The method can quantify and measure implicit relativity between traffic flows, extract high-level time characteristics and dynamic association diagrams to perform effective modeling, and obtain accurate and stable traffic flow prediction.

title_en: Illegal client detection method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to network security technology, and discloses an illegal client detection method, which comprises the following steps: analyzing an access request of the account number to a target access interface to obtain a mobile terminal IP address where the account number is located; judging whether the binding number of the account is a local number corresponding to the IP address of the mobile terminal; if the number is the local number, allowing the account to be accessed; if the number is not the local number, storing the account number into an access record queue; when the number of stored accounts in an access record queue is smaller than or equal to a limiting threshold value, allowing the accounts to be accessed; when the number of stored accounts in the access record queue is larger than a limiting threshold, setting the IP address of the mobile terminal as a suspected illegal client, and determining the authenticity of the suspected illegal client according to the attempted access record and risk management and control strategy of the suspected illegal client. The application also provides an illegal client detection device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The application can improve the detection accuracy of illegal users.

title_en: Warehouse position article identification and selection system, equipment and method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a warehouse position article identification and picking system, equipment and a method. The method has the advantages that identification and guidance equipment of a ultrahigh frequency radio frequency identification (UHF RFID) technology is utilized in a replenishment warehousing link, so that when the goods are replenished and warehoused, the binding relationship between the goods and the warehouse location is automatically recorded on the data processing equipment after the goods are placed at any warehouse location. The problem of the wrong is selected to the delivery after the replenishment article placed the position mistake under traditional light guide is solved, the efficiency of picking, the rate of accuracy, the degree of dependence that reduces to skilled worker kind of the goods of selecting the scene are provided to the article.

title_en: Data processing method, program product, readable medium, and electronic device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of data processing technology, and in particular, to a data processing method, a program product, a readable medium, and an electronic device, where the method is applied to a system including a first electronic device and a second electronic device; a first electronic device is located in a data processing network and a second electronic device is located in a data storage network, the method comprising: the data scheduling system in the second electronic device responds to the data processing request for processing the target data and transmits the target data and the data processing request acquired from the database to the data processing system in the first electronic device across the network; the data processing system performs corresponding data processing on the target data according to the data processing request to obtain processed target data and transmits the processed target data to the data scheduling system across the network; the data scheduling system outputs the processed target data for the database. Therefore, the data processing system cannot directly acquire the client data, and the privacy security of the client data is ensured.

title_en: Life cycle management method, device and system for battery pack of electric vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a life cycle management method, device and system of an electric vehicle battery pack, and relates to the technical field of new energy vehicles. The invention relates to a life cycle management method of an electric vehicle battery pack, which is applied to a battery replacement station and comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a network access request of a user terminal, sending the network access request to a battery swapping platform, distributing a battery pack for an electric vehicle matched with the user terminal according to a use protocol, and sending first battery information of the battery pack to the battery swapping platform; acquiring a battery replacement request of a user terminal and second battery information of a battery pack, when the first battery information and the second battery information simultaneously meet a battery replacement condition, allocating a new battery pack for the electric automobile according to the battery replacement request, and sending the second battery information to a battery replacement platform; and when the first battery information meets the scrapping condition, recovering the battery pack used by the electric automobile at the moment. The invention effectively improves the experience of mild users in using the battery replacement service, and is beneficial to giving full play to the battery value so as to improve the user experience.

title_en: Intelligent contract transaction exception maintenance method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent contract transaction exception maintenance method, device, equipment and readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of recording the current stack state of an Ethernet virtual machine; tracking the transaction process of the intelligent contract on the Ethernet virtual machine to obtain transaction information of the transaction, judging whether the transaction is abnormal after the transaction is finished, if so, determining an abnormal source code corresponding to the value of the abnormal program counter contained in the transaction information according to the corresponding relation between the value of the preset program counter and the source code of the intelligent contract, modifying relevant parameters of the transaction according to the abnormal source code, and executing the modified transaction on the Ethernet virtual machine with the same stack state. Obviously, the application can determine the abnormal source code for triggering the intelligent contract transaction according to the preset corresponding relation, and can modify the transaction according to the abnormal source code, so that the modified transaction is executed on the same Ethernet virtual machine as the transaction before modification, and whether the modified transaction can be executed successfully or not is verified.

title_en: Marketing auxiliary system and method suitable for multiple personalized businesses
abstract_en: The invention provides a marketing auxiliary system and a marketing auxiliary method suitable for a plurality of personalized businesses, comprising a system table structure module, a marketing list storage module and a marketing management module, wherein the system table structure module is used for storing marketing lists of the businesses; and the system service module is used for carrying out service according to the stored marketing list of the business. The invention can efficiently manage target clients, has the capabilities of high reliability, high concurrency, high performance and the like, can comprehensively support business marketing, can meet the requirements of individual business marketing, and has the capability of different business hybrid marketing and quick response to any newly added business capability.

title_en: Optimistic byzantine fault-tolerant consensus method without backspacing
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimistic Byzantine fault-tolerant consensus method without backspacing, which comprises the steps that a main node initiates a proposal, all nodes carry out first-round voting on the proposal, the main node judges whether the condition of a system is an optimistic condition or not according to the voting result of the first round, and different consensus methods are adopted to carry out consensus on the proposal under the optimistic condition and the non-optimistic condition; all nodes verify the proposal request sent by the main node and execute corresponding operation according to the message type; in this process, if a node finds that a master node has byzantine behavior, a view change request is broadcast to elect a new master node. The invention can be applied to the consensus layer as the consensus protocol in the block chain application, has simple implementation method and strong universality, effectively reduces the consumption of bandwidth, and has the advantages of high efficiency, high robustness and the like.

title_en: Similarity measure between users for detecting fraud
abstract_en: Techniques related to determining the validity of a tagged transaction in a transaction service are disclosed. The server computer system may receive an indication of a tagged transaction between a sending user and a receiving user of the transaction service. The server computer system may collect transaction information including sender information and receiver information in response to the indication and then determine a similarity value indicating a measure of similarity between the sender information and the receiver information. The server computer system may evaluate whether the tagged transaction is valid based on the similarity value.

title_en: Accident control method for waste chemical liquid vehicle and related product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an accident control method of a waste chemical liquid vehicle and a related product, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the server receives vehicle information uploaded by the vehicle-mounted terminal, wherein the vehicle information comprises: speed, position coordinates and liquid level data; the server determines whether the waste chemical liquid in the vehicle leaks or not according to the speed and the liquid level data, and extracts a position coordinate set after the vehicle leaks if the waste chemical liquid is judged to leak; and the server generates a leakage path according to the position coordinate set and sends the leakage path and the components of the waste chemical liquid of the vehicle to an accident handling unit. The technical scheme provided by the application has the advantage of reducing environmental pollution.

title_en: Method, equipment and storage medium for sharing block chain data based on LWE-CPBE
abstract_en: The invention discloses a block chain data sharing method, equipment and a storage medium based on LWE-CPBE, wherein the method comprises the following steps: a data accessor sets an access control strategy, generates a master key and a public key based on the access control strategy, sends the public key to a block chain for storage, and the master key entrusts a key center to keep the master key, encrypts data to be issued into a ciphertext and uploads the ciphertext to a third party for storage, and the third party for storage sends a ciphertext storage address to the block chain; a data user acquires a master key from a key center, then synthesizes a user attribute key, and decrypts the acquired ciphertext by using the user attribute key to complete data sharing; the invention has higher security and efficiency of data sharing, can conveniently update the access control strategy, has small calculation amount in the updating process, and saves more key space cost and encryption time cost.

title_en: Part circulating light sorting system and method
abstract_en: The application discloses part circulation light picking system and method relates to the technical field of automobile manufacturing, and comprises the following steps: the terminal display subsystem comprises a plurality of indicator lamps; the data processing subsystem is used for generating queue numbers of multiple queues of vehicles to be loaded, sequence numbers in each queue of vehicles to be loaded and indicator lamp control signals corresponding to all parts of each vehicle to be loaded; the logic control subsystem is used for receiving queue numbers of a plurality of queues of vehicles to be loaded, sequence numbers in each queue of vehicles to be loaded and indicator lamp control signals corresponding to all parts of each vehicle to be loaded; the terminal display subsystem is controlled to light the indicator lights corresponding to all parts on each picking line according to the vehicles to be assembled one by one in a queue; the colors of the indicator lamps adopted by two adjacent vehicles to be assembled are different. The circulating light picking system and method realize intelligent error prevention of part picking operation and improve intelligent manufacturing and quality level of enterprises.

title_en: Credit transfer method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a credit transfer method and a credit transfer system, wherein the credit transfer method comprises the following steps: splitting and circulating the credit based on the tree structure data chain; wherein, the rule of splitting circulation includes: the sub credit amount which belongs to the same divided credit amount can not be transferred again after being transferred out by the sub node; and sub credit amounts from two different root credit amounts can not be combined into one sub credit amount to be split and circulated; modeling the credit splitting and flow transferring process based on the closure table, and enabling the transferring-out node to be a joint primary key of the transfer transaction for the same credit transferred out by the transferring-in node. The invention can improve the tracking and backtracking efficiency of the credit circulation link, reduce the integrity of circulation record data and the consistency control difficulty, and simplify the data verification process.

title_en: Inventory allocation method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to an inventory allocation method, an inventory allocation device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring initial request replenishment quantity of target articles in each sub-warehouse; when the sum of the initial request replenishment quantities is larger than the inventory quantity of the target articles in the total warehouse, respectively determining the marginal order satisfaction rate of the corresponding sub-warehouse according to the initial request replenishment quantities; screening the sub-warehouse with the minimum marginal order satisfaction rate from each sub-warehouse as a target warehouse; subtracting a preset value from the initial request replenishment quantity corresponding to the target warehouse to obtain a target request replenishment quantity; and when the sum of the target request replenishment quantity of the target warehouse and the initial request replenishment quantity of the remaining sub-warehouses is smaller than or equal to the inventory quantity, allocating inventory for each sub-warehouse according to the target request replenishment quantity of the target warehouse and the initial request replenishment quantity of the remaining sub-warehouses. By adopting the method, the overall order satisfaction rate can be improved, and the loss of goods shortage can be further reduced.

title_en: System and method for performing drug loading optimization in an electronic drug storage cabinet
abstract_en: An electronic medication storage cabinet includes a plurality of drawers configured with a plurality of sensors arranged to identify the positioning of storage pockets within the drawers. Upon receiving an indication of a new drug container to be loaded in the bin, a sequence of steps to load the drug container into the bin is generated based on the mapping algorithm. The first step is displayed on a display of the cabinet and it is determined whether the first step is associated with one of the plurality of drawers. In response to determining that the first step is associated with one of the plurality of drawers, the drawer is automatically unlocked. In response to determining that the first step has been completed successfully, it is determined whether execution of any additional steps is pending and indicated on the display.

title_en: Anti-fraud method, system, equipment and storage medium based on natural language processing technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a natural language processing technology-based anti-fraud method, a natural language processing technology-based anti-fraud system, natural language processing equipment and a storage medium, wherein sample data required by processing are acquired from a financial anti-fraud transfer transaction data set, and are subjected to labeling processing; analyzing transfer remark information of each transaction data, processing the transfer remark information, analyzing user association characteristics needed by each sample, establishing a target sample data set by combining transfer remark information processing results and sample labeling processing results, preprocessing a training neural network, deploying the trained neural network to an online anti-fraud decision server, fusing the user association characteristic information to carry out anti-fraud transfer transaction decision when carrying out online decision, and returning an anti-fraud transaction decision result. The invention considers the operation characteristic data of the auxiliary service scene in the electronic banking service, and uses the auxiliary service scene to assist the identification of the fraud operation request in the target service scene, so that the fraud identification accuracy of the anti-fraud model is greatly improved.

title_en: Bidding project process node state control method, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bidding project process node state control method, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the bidding project process node state control method comprises the steps of issuing a bidding preview, searching a known supplier in the industry and sending an invitation, wherein the bidding preview at least comprises a bidding road performance; acquiring market demands, presetting bidding data, receiving bidding provider information, and combing the bidding provider information; by releasing the bidding standard, bidding enterprises are screened, decision makers can conveniently and rapidly screen, and the practical value of the method is greatly improved.

title_en: Human-vehicle collision risk degree analysis method based on automatic driving of vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pedestrian and vehicle collision risk degree analysis method based on an automatic driving automobile, which comprises the steps of firstly dividing street crossing behaviors into different habit types through Gaussian clustering according to street crossing characteristics in a pedestrian street crossing historical data set, utilizing a joint probability distribution function to help an automatic driving vehicle to obtain a possible future state set according to the current motion state of a pedestrian, considering the dynamic space-time relation of the pedestrian and the vehicle through a GCN graph convolution neural network to obtain a possible future trajectory set of the pedestrian, finally considering the trajectory collision probability and the minimum meeting distance, utilizing an object element extension theory to perform characteristic dimension reduction, establishing a risk degree function, and realizing real-time judgment of the pedestrian and vehicle collision risk degree. The method focuses on the characteristic that the movement state of the pedestrian has sudden change, more particularly considers the influence of the space-time relation of the pedestrian and the vehicle on the track, improves the accuracy and the reliability of the collision judgment result of the pedestrian and the vehicle through the fusion of multiple indexes, further improves the intelligence of automatic driving, and improves the riding comfort and the safety.

title_en: Alternating current group generation method and device, medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method, an apparatus, a medium and an electronic device for generating an exchange group, in a review mode of a presentation, responding to a presentation image determined by a reviewer and displaying the presentation image in a presentation window of a user interface, and acquiring first identification information of the presentation image; acquiring all note information of each sentence text in the presentation image based on the first identification information; respectively displaying the recommended text of each piece of note information in a text window of the user interface in a triggerable manner; and responding to the triggering of any one of the recommended texts, determining second identification information of sentence texts corresponding to the triggered recommended texts, acquiring historical communication information related to the sentence texts from a communication data set based on the second identification information, generating a communication group for communicating the sentence texts to learn hearts based on the historical communication information, and displaying the communication group in a first communication window of the user interface. The review efficiency is improved.

title_en: Activity popularization method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an activity promotion method, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: a user terminal acquires two-dimension code information of an activity promotion applet displayed by a video terminal; the two-dimension code information sends a first instruction back-end server for inquiring the list information of the preferential activity merchants; analyzing the first instruction, and sending the preferential activity merchant list information to the user terminal; the user terminal sends a second instruction for inquiring the activity detail information of the target merchant to the back-end server; analyzing the second instruction and the activity detail information to the user terminal; sending a purchase request instruction to a back-end server according to the purchase information; analyzing the purchase request instruction, generating purchase page information and sending the purchase page information to the user terminal; submitting payment information to a back-end server according to the purchase page information; and generating order information according to the payment information and sending the order information to the terminal. The activity promotion method and the activity promotion system increase the activity promotion range through the interaction between the large-screen interactive network television terminal and the small program terminal and the promotion mode of the small program two-dimensional code.

title_en: Reconciliation method and device based on function calculation
abstract_en: The invention provides a reconciliation method and a reconciliation device based on function calculation, which can be applied to the field of finance, and the method comprises the following steps: determining the number of servers to be called according to the acquired reconciliation workflow, and calling a corresponding number of server groups from the idle server resource pool; determining a required function set according to the reconciliation workflow, and performing reconciliation work execution arrangement on the server group according to the function set to generate a reconciliation execution result; and initializing the server group and returning to the idle server resource pool after the account checking execution result is obtained. The account checking business process is split, an execution function required by each step in the account checking operation is obtained, then a plurality of idle servers are called according to the account checking business process, the execution functions are sequentially and respectively deployed on the idle servers, dynamic resource allocation is calculated through functions, the functions are modularized, workflow arrangement is carried out, computing resources are repeatedly utilized, code resources are flexibly configured, and a customized account checking batch processing system is achieved.

title_en: Page display method, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a page display method, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The page display method comprises the steps of responding to detection of access operation for a target page, obtaining a target resource sequence corresponding to the target page, wherein the target resource sequence comprises a first number of first resources, the first resources belong to a first resource type, determining a first display position corresponding to the first resource type and a second display position corresponding to the second resource type in the target page based on the first number and the preset interval number, and displaying the second resources corresponding to the first resource and the second resource type in the target page according to the first display position and the second display position. According to the embodiment of the disclosure, the attention of the user to the second resource can be improved, the advertisement putting benefit is improved, and the user is not influenced to browse the first resource.

title_en: Multi-type power grid load resource data processing and adjusting method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-type power grid load resource data processing and adjusting method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: analyzing response characteristics and control modes of typical flexible load resources of the power grid to classify the loads, and constructing adjustment attributes and schedulable attributes of different types of load resources; carrying out layered and partitioned modeling on multi-type power grid load resources, and carrying out layer-by-layer aggregation on load adjustability; processing and checking data of different dimensions of the multi-type power grid load resources to realize real-time perception and abnormal alarm of the multi-type power grid load resource data; and establishing a safe and reliable interaction mechanism of the load regulation instructions across the safe areas and carrying out regulation control on the load resource data of the multi-type power grid. The invention provides a modeling, data processing and adjusting method and strategy of multi-type load resources, which can realize participation of multi-type load resource aggregators in market interaction and power grid operation control and have important significance for supporting clean energy consumption and safe and efficient operation of a power grid.

title_en: Information processing method, device, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides an information processing method and apparatus, a terminal, and a storage medium. The information processing method comprises the following steps: displaying the first evaluation information and the second evaluation information in a first page; the first page comprises a first display area and a second display area, the first display area displays first evaluation information aiming at a preset user, and the second display area displays second evaluation information aiming at the preset user; and in response to the triggering operation of the first display area in the first page, displaying the first task information in the display area of the first evaluation information. By displaying the first task information in the display area of the first evaluation information and having the association relationship with the second evaluation information in time, the corresponding reference information can be provided in the page of the evaluation system, eliminating the need to manually input the first task information and improving the convenience of the user and the efficiency of information processing.

title_en: Time-of-use electricity price pricing method suitable for park comprehensive energy supply service
abstract_en: The invention discloses a time-of-use electricity price pricing method suitable for park comprehensive energy supply service, which belongs to the field of comprehensive energy supply service of an electric power system and comprises the following steps: (1) carrying out clustering analysis on user groups; (2) determining time-sharing time intervals; (3) pricing time-of-use electricity price; (4) and (5) solving an algorithm. The implementation of the time-of-use electricity price can enable residents to enjoy the benefits on one hand, and is also beneficial to power plants, power grids and low-carbon economy on the other hand. The user changes the electricity utilization mode, so that the electricity is used more at the valley, and less at the peak, and the electricity charge expenditure can be reduced; the peak clipping, valley filling and load balancing effects brought by the implementation of time-of-use electricity prices can be beneficial to power generation enterprises and power grid enterprises; meanwhile, the improvement of the power generation efficiency can reduce carbon emission, protect the environment and benefit the society.

title_en: Order management method and device applied to electric automobile
abstract_en: A method for order management applied to an electric vehicle (200), an order distribution device (103) at a platform side acquires information of each operation vehicle and a safe point position, wherein the information of the vehicles comprises information of the operation electric vehicle, such as the current position and the residual electric quantity of the vehicles, the order distribution device (103) selects a service vehicle for passengers, when the service vehicle is the electric vehicle (200), the residual electric quantity of the service vehicle is ensured to be enough to complete a safe driving route, the safe driving route is a route connecting the current position, the starting position, the destination position and the safe point position closest to the destination position, and the order distribution device (103) distributes orders to the service vehicle. By the mode, the electric automobile (200) still has sufficient electric quantity to reach a chargeable safety point after the order is completed, and the electric quantity safety of the electric automobile (200) after the order is completed is ensured.

title_en: Searching and retrieving keying data maintained using a keying database
abstract_en: The present invention relates to searching and retrieving keyed data maintained using a keyed database. A digital component deduplication system for generating packetized data with encrypted tokens for transmission via one or more packetized networks is described herein. The packetized data search determines to include an encrypted token with the packetized data. The cryptographic token includes keying data representing the first digital component. The packetized data search engine searches the keying database to identify content in the keying database that includes one or more entries of keying data representing the first digital component. A list of candidate digital components is generated. For a candidate number component associated with a data interface for requesting a qualification value from a second client device associated with the candidate number component, the security server generates additional packetized data using the data interface, the additional packetized data including i) a request for the qualification value from the second client device, and ii) an encrypted token.

title_en: Water quality grade prediction method, system, terminal device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of computer application, and provides a water quality grade prediction method, a water quality grade prediction system, terminal equipment and a computer-readable storage medium, wherein the water quality grade prediction method comprises the following steps: establishing a site detection diagram of the target water area according to the site position of the target water area and the index type data associated with each site; performing node aggregation on the site detection graph of the target water area based on the attention network of the heteromorphic graph to obtain a feature update result of each node in the site detection graph of the target water area; generating a water area feature vector of the target water area according to the feature update result of each node in the station detection graph of the target water area; the water quality grade of the target water area is predicted according to the historical detection data and the water area feature vector, the influence of various types of indexes on the water quality condition can be comprehensively considered, the influence of the historical water quality feature on the future water quality condition is introduced, the accuracy of water quality grade prediction is effectively improved, and the problem that the current prediction accuracy of the water quality condition has deviation is solved.

title_en: Adaptive cruise decision system, method, computer device and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: An adaptive cruise decision system, method, computer device and computer readable storage medium, the system comprising: the decision model establishing module is used for establishing a network decision model, and the network decision model comprises an upper layer decision network, a bottom layer execution network and a reward function; an initialization module for initializing environment parameters and obtaining environment initial external state s 0meta Initial internal state s 0controller (ii) a A decision-making execution module for executing a decision,for dependent on an external state parameter S imeta Selecting initial sub-target parameter coarse i Initializing a reward parameter r imeta (ii) a Judging the sub-target completion condition: the distance between the vehicle and the front vehicle is smaller than a preset minimum value or larger than a preset maximum value, and the vehicle speed is 0; if not, according to the internal state parameter s jcontroller Selecting an initial action a j Interacting with the environment to obtain an internal state parameter s j+1controller Outputting a reward parameter r in interaction with the environment jcontroller Storing memory { s jcontroller ,a j ,r j ,s j+1controller ,goal i }；r imeta ＝r imeta +r j+1controller (ii) a i, circulating from 1 to N until the completion of the sub-targets; memory storage { s imeta ,goal i ,r imeta ,s i+1meta }。

title_en: Enterprise index management method and device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise index management method, an enterprise index management device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining performance indexes of the stores and performance indexes of the employees according to the historical performance data of the stores and the historical performance data of the employees; the performance indexes comprise monthly performance indexes and annual performance indexes; importing a performance index, and calculating to obtain a daily average performance index of each store and each employee according to the performance index; acquiring order data generated by stores every day, counting daily actual performances of the stores and the employees according to performance division proportion of items in the order data, and calculating the index completion condition of each store and each employee according to the daily average performance index and the daily actual performance; and pushing the index completion condition to the client according to different pushing time. The embodiment of the invention can effectively improve the efficiency of enterprise index management.

title_en: Method and device for calculating new energy consumption cost of electric power system in market environment
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for calculating new energy consumption cost of an electric power system in a market environment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first annual market clearing result and operation cost of the power system by using a preset random unit combination model; acquiring a second annual market clearing result and operation cost of the power system by using a preset first deterministic unit combination model; converting a new energy unit in the power system into a target controllable unit, and acquiring a third annual market clearing result and operation cost of the target controllable unit by using a preset second deterministic unit combination model; and comparing the annual market clearing result with the operation cost, and calculating the new energy consumption cost of the power system based on the comparison result.
