Therefore, the technical problem that in the related technology, the change of the overall operation cost of the power system after the new energy installation is increased is emphasized, so that the power system is difficult to directly quantify the consumption cost caused by the uncertainty and the uncontrollable property of the output of the new energy is solved.

title_en: Enterprise data acquisition and analysis system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise data acquisition and analysis system based on big data, which comprises a data storage module, a permission authentication module, a data analysis module and a visualization module; the data storage module is used for storing enterprise data; the data analysis module is used for sending a data calling request to the authority authentication module; the authority authentication module is used for performing authority verification on the data calling request in a face recognition mode and sending the data calling request to the data storage module after the authority verification is passed; the data storage module is also used for sending the enterprise data to the data analysis module after receiving the data calling request; the data analysis module is also used for carrying out big data analysis on the enterprise data to obtain an analysis result; the visualization module is used for visually displaying the analysis result. The invention effectively improves the security of the data calling process and can effectively avoid the condition that the data security is influenced because the account password is leaked.

title_en: Wind speed multipoint synchronous prediction method for coupling numerical weather forecast and measured data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind speed multipoint synchronous prediction method for coupling numerical weather forecast and measured data, which comprises the following steps of: firstly, inputting historical actual measurement gust wind speed data and numerical weather forecast data of different measuring points as models, outputting the actual measurement data at the current moment of the measuring points, comparing the importance degree of each input variable by adopting a characteristic selection method, and selecting a variable with higher degree as final input; then, establishing a gust wind speed prediction model based on Bayesian dynamic regression by adopting a mobile window method, and evaluating a prediction result to obtain a high-precision wind speed prediction model; and finally, utilizing the prediction model to predict the gust wind speed at multiple measurement points for a long term and a short term. The method can improve the calculation efficiency and realize the synchronous prediction of the gust wind speed at multiple measuring points on the basis of ensuring the accuracy and reliability of the gust wind speed prediction result.

title_en: Resource load prediction method for multi-model small-batch production line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resource load prediction method for a multi-model small-batch production line, which comprises three processes of establishing a resource load prediction function model, preparing simulation data and carrying out Monte Carlo simulation by using Crystal Ball software, wherein the Monte Carlo simulation method is used for carrying out simulation operation on the proposed resource load prediction function model to obtain a specific load result of equipment resources, and resource load prediction and check are carried out on the existing production scheme; the method of the invention predicts the production resource load, can effectively support the formulation of a dynamic scheduling plan, and the accurate load prediction result is helpful for improving the robustness of a scheduling scheme and reducing the production cost.

title_en: Source network load and storage capacity planning method and system considering periodic supply and demand balance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a source network charge and storage capacity planning method and system considering periodic supply and demand balance, and aims to solve the problems that the regional power and electricity balance between active load and stored energy in an hour and day period is not considered in the prior art, and the overall profit degree of a source network charge and storage region is considered to be low. According to the wind power plant time sequence output sequence, the photovoltaic power station time sequence output sequence, the active load operation mode, the annual region passive load time sequence and the energy storage operation mode, production simulation is conducted on power supply, energy storage and load combination, then the production simulation result and the constraint condition are combined, the daily income of the source network charge storage region is obtained, finally, all the regional daily income is combined, the capacity combination scheme corresponding to the maximum income is selected, and the source network charge storage capacity planning is achieved. The method considers the short-term and medium-term regional power and electricity balance, takes the active load as the variable of the power and electricity balance, and fills the blank of the source network load and storage integrated regional related planning method.

title_en: Gift card safe generation, exchange and encryption storage method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of Internet marketing security, and particularly discloses a method for safely generating, exchanging and encrypting a gift card. The method comprises the steps of carrying out encryption for a plurality of times by combining a random number with a secret key, and carrying out gift card information and user information, generating static two-dimension codes by the encryption information, binding the two-dimension codes to the gift card and sending the two-dimension codes to a user, and decrypting and verifying the encryption information on the two-dimension codes one by a system when the user scans the two-dimension code information on the gift card to carry out rewarding and exchanging, so that the safety problem existing in the gift card issuing and exchanging process is effectively solved.

title_en: Transparent ordering method for online taxi appointment with driver queuing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of online booking, and particularly discloses a transparent booking receiving method for a driver queuing, which comprises the following steps: s1: the relation of separation driver service quality and the strategy of receiving an order, driver service quality and the strategy of receiving an order are irrelevant can promote the driver to the trust degree of platform dispatch, net car appointment platform sets up driver's service quality and only draws proportional, driver reward relevant, and with the strategy of receiving an order irrelevant, specifically do: if the service quality of the driver is good, the online booking platform is low in proportion, and the driver can participate in higher-level driver reward activities; the invention sends orders through the driver queues in the single area and the surrounding areas, has simple algorithm model and high execution efficiency, simultaneously relieves the relation between the order judgment and the service quality of the driver, prompts the driver to improve the service quality, and compared with the prior art, improves the satisfaction of the driver and the trust of the network car booking platform.

title_en: Raft PBFT two-stage consensus mechanism based on node grouping in alliance chain
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of two-stage consensus mechanisms, and discloses a Raft PBFT two-stage consensus mechanism based on node grouping in a alliance chain, which comprises the following steps: 1) the method comprises the steps of (1) carrying out Raft node grouping and generating Leader nodes; 2) PBFT nodes are generated, a many-to-many communication mode is adopted among the nodes, corresponding screening is carried out on the selection of the nodes, and two types of nodes in the stage are obtained; 3) each grouped node of the Raft layer is responsible for collecting transactions from a client and aggregating the transactions to a grouped proxy node; 4) entering a PBFT consensus stage, rapidly verifying the transaction and achieving consensus, and distributing the transaction to each Raft group by a group agent node; 5) the Raft packet verifies the block forwarded by the packet proxy node and starts the packet consensus phase. In the Raft PBFT two-stage consensus mechanism based on node grouping in the alliance chain, blocks are checked through PBFT consensus stages, and blocks packed in the PBFT consensus stages are checked through Leader nodes, so that the safety of a block chain system is improved.

title_en: Privacy capacity guaranteeing system and method suitable for electric carbon information conversion of park
abstract_en: The invention discloses a secrecy capacity guarantee system and a method suitable for electric carbon information conversion of a park, wherein the system comprises the following steps: end layer, edge layer, service layer. The terminal layer realizes data acquisition by deploying the multi-mode internet of things terminal on the electrical equipment. The side layer comprises a multi-mode edge computing gateway, the gateway interacts with the electrical equipment through a multi-mode communication medium, and data are uploaded to the service layer through a private network. And the service layer realizes deep analysis of data and supports low-carbon service operation through a big data analysis and machine learning method. The method comprises the following steps: by jointly optimizing the channel selection and power distribution strategies, the weighted difference of the confidentiality capacity, the equipment energy consumption and the queuing time delay can be maximized under the constraint of the equipment side queue stability, the problem of conflict between low-carbon service and multimodal communication resource adaptation and multimodal access is solved, and the multi-attribute QoS requirement of the low-carbon service is guaranteed.

title_en: Cross-chain asset management method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of computers, and particularly relates to a cross-chain asset management method, equipment and a storage medium.

title_en: Novel supply chain system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel supply chain system which comprises a hardware platform and a software platform, wherein the software platform comprises a platform management system, a buyer center, a merchant center, a supplier center and a logistics center, the connecting ends of the buyer center, the merchant center, the supplier center and the logistics center are all connected with the platform management system, the connecting end of the platform management system is connected with an online terminal and an offline terminal, the buyer center comprises individuals and units, the units comprise buyers and non-buyers, and a settlement center is arranged between the buyer center and the merchant center. The invention covers individuals and units through client objects, is favorable for forming a comprehensive B2B2B and B2B2C platform system, is wide in the oriented audience group, is favorable for improving economic benefit, is convenient for improving the safety of a database, avoids data from being stolen or damaged, improves the advancement, the optimization and the integration of the system, and is convenient for the stable operation of the system.

title_en: Work support system, work support method, and program
abstract_en: The invention provides a work support system, a work support method, and a program. The work support system (10) is used together with a work machine (3), and is provided with an estimation unit (12) and an output unit (13). The working machine (3) travels in the field using an engine (31) as a power source. An estimation unit (12) estimates whether or not a target event associated with a load change has occurred, based on at least the magnitude of the load of the engine (31). An output unit (13) outputs output data corresponding to the estimation result of the estimation unit (12).

title_en: Mine safety monitoring and early warning system and comprehensive monitoring and early warning method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of early warning systems, in particular to a mine safety monitoring early warning system and a comprehensive monitoring early warning method thereof; the mine safety monitoring and early warning system comprises data monitoring equipment, a server and a client. The data monitoring equipment forms monitoring data; the server is in communication connection with the data monitoring equipment, and is provided with a monitoring and early warning system unit and a service function unit, wherein the service function unit is used for carrying out safety management to form safety management data; the monitoring and early warning system unit is provided with a safety monitoring and early warning module with early warning threshold value data, and the safety monitoring and early warning module processes monitoring data and safety management data according to the early warning threshold value data to obtain early warning information; the client is in communication connection with the server and used for checking the early warning information. The invention aims to solve the problems that the conventional safety monitoring and early warning system cannot comprehensively analyze the safety production state of a mine enterprise and cannot reflect the overall safety condition of the mine enterprise.

title_en: Intelligent anti-fraud method, system, device and medium based on decision engine
abstract_en: The application relates to an intelligent anti-fraud method, system, device and medium based on a decision engine, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining external early warning clues, guiding the external early warning clues into a decision engine, screening the external early warning clues through the decision engine, and classifying suspected fraud clues in the external early warning clues; secondly, inputting the classified clues into corresponding sub-decision engines according to different fraud types for processing, and performing label setting on the classified clues according to processing conditions; and finally, judging whether the current clue contains the fraud behavior according to the label, and making a corresponding decision according to different conditions. Through the application, the problems of high labor cost and high case rate in the actual dissuading process of different fraud types are solved, the dissuading success rate of a decision engine is improved, the case rate is reduced, and the labor cost is reduced.

title_en: Cloud service quality assessment method and device for government affair cloud and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device and a storage medium for evaluating cloud service quality of government affair cloud, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring first target information of a target government affair cloud, wherein the target government affair cloud comprises any government affair service platform using cloud service, and the first target information comprises cloud service availability information and/or cloud service reliability information and/or cloud service responsiveness information; and according to the first target information, evaluating the cloud service quality of the target government affair cloud based on the determined evaluation model to obtain a target cloud service quality evaluation result of the target government affair cloud. Therefore, the cloud service quality of the government affair cloud can be accurately evaluated, and the evaluation accuracy of the cloud service quality is improved.

title_en: Project development time calculation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and discloses a project development working hour calculation method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when a target project issuing instruction is received, acquiring target project starting time; when the starting time of the target project is reached, all initial project files of the developing project are obtained; periodically acquiring a working area picture, and adding a preset time length to the accumulated working time length when the working area picture comprises a picture element of a target user; when a target project completion instruction is received, acquiring a result project file of each in-development project, and comparing the initial project file with the result project file to obtain the information variation of each in-development project; accumulating the information variation of each developing project to obtain the total information variation; obtaining a change occupation ratio according to the ratio of the target information variation of the target item to the total information variation; and obtaining the project development working hours according to the product of the change occupation ratio and the accumulated working time.

title_en: Service processing method and device, electronic equipment and computer readable medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a business processing method, a business processing device, electronic equipment and a computer readable medium, which relate to the field of big data analysis, and the method comprises the following steps: receiving a service processing request, and acquiring a corresponding user identifier and a withholding identifier; responding to the fact that the withholding identification is a batch withholding identification, obtaining information to be paid based on the user identification, and generating a withholding list according to the information to be paid; determining a corresponding deduction account according to the deduction list, generating batch deduction requests, and sending the batch deduction requests to a personal loan account core system and a payment settlement system; receiving batch withholding state identification generated by a personal loan accounting core system and batch extra-network transfer state identification generated after a payment settlement system executes extra-network transfer on a second type of account corresponding to a user identification; and returning the batch withholding state identification and the batch over-network transfer state identification to the employee channel system corresponding to the user identification. The secondary account is convenient to use for batch deduction and repayment, and convenience of user repayment is improved.

title_en: Numerical simulation method for mine pressure display rule of working face of steep-dip extra-thick coal seam
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mining and mine pressure analysis, in particular to a numerical simulation method for a mine pressure display rule of a working face of a steep extra-thick coal seam, which can digitize the evolution process of a stress field-displacement field of coal rock mined from the steep extra-thick coal seam and more efficiently, accurately and visually reflect the mine pressure display rule of the working face, thereby providing a theoretical basis for mine pressure control of the working face of the steep extra-thick coal seam, and the method comprises the following steps: collecting geology and mining technical information of a coal rock layer of a working face of a steep super-thick coal seam; step two, applying FLAC 3D Establishing a numerical model by software, and performing initial static balance calculation; simulating a subsection excavation process of a working face of the steeply inclined extra-thick coal seam; step four, outputting the calculation results of the stress and the displacement of the working surface of the steeply inclined super-thick coal seam to obtain steeply inclined super-thick coalAnd (5) displaying the mine pressure law of the working face of the layer.

title_en: Intellectual property intelligence analysis method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data analysis, in particular to an intellectual property intelligence analysis method. The method comprises the following steps: a thread determining step: acquiring suspicious basic data and determining a preliminary clue; a data acquisition step: mining various data information associated with the preliminary clues through a multi-way channel according to the preliminary clues; a condition setting step: setting screening conditions of various data information; and (3) data analysis step: filtering and screening various data information according to a screening rule to generate a single analysis result of the various data information; a target generation step: and (4) analyzing the suspected target by combining the one-way analysis results of various data information. The method can deeply mine the copy data of the counterfeit products and find the suspected target of the copy.

title_en: OKR management scheme generation method, system, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a OKR management scheme generation method, a OKR management scheme generation system, electronic equipment and a medium. The OKR management scheme relates to a plurality of configuration items, each configuration item comprises a plurality of options, the combination of the different options is used for generating different OKR management schemes, the generation method of the OKR management scheme comprises the steps of configuring member information, respectively configuring matching relations between feature combinations and options for each configuration item, acquiring a plurality of target features corresponding to the members for each member, respectively determining a plurality of target options matching the target features according to the matching relations, and combining the target options to generate the OKR management scheme corresponding to the members. The invention dynamically generates a plurality of OKR management schemes by one-time deployment, solves the problem of difficult development of different OKR management schemes, and greatly reduces the development cost of different OKR management schemes.

title_en: Digitalized home decoration method, digitalized home decoration device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital home decoration method, a digital home decoration device and a storage medium. The digital home decoration method comprises the following steps: acquiring a design scheme of a house to be decorated, wherein the design scheme is a design scheme of a digital decoration part matched with the house to be decorated, and the digital decoration part is a decoration part which accords with a preset digital product definition rule and is subjected to digital product definition; splitting the design scheme according to a preset digital product definition rule, and determining digital definition data of the digital decoration parts, wherein the digital definition data comprises product data, component data, material data, rule data, basic setting data and resource data of the digital decoration parts; and sending the product data, the component data, the material data, the rule data, the basic setting data and the resource data to the material supply system.

title_en: Teaching aid manufacturing deviation analysis system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a teaching aid manufacturing deviation analysis system, which comprises: the teaching aid manufacturing mechanism is used for manufacturing a 3D entity teaching aid for teaching, and the 3D entity teaching aid comprises part or all of human bones; the real-time transmission mechanism is arranged at the rear end of the teaching aid manufacturing mechanism and used for pushing the currently manufactured 3D entity teaching aid to a detection station when the teaching aid manufacturing mechanism finishes manufacturing one 3D entity teaching aid; a target recognition component for constructing a 3D solid model of the nearest 3D solid teaching aid; and the parameter identification component is used for judging the total manufacturing deviation of the nearest 3D entity teaching aid. The teaching aid manufacturing deviation analysis system is simple and convenient to operate and wide in application. Because the simulation error of the 3D entity teaching aid for teaching manufactured at present is accurately analyzed by adopting a targeted visual analysis mechanism and an error weight analysis mechanism, the 3D entity teaching aid with distortion is prevented from flowing into the market.

title_en: Two carbon number data center systems in circular economy environmental protection industrial park
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of double-carbon management, and discloses a double-carbon-number data center system of a circular economy and environmental protection industrial park, which comprises a double-carbon-number data center system, wherein the double-carbon-number data center system comprises a data management module, a carbon asset management module, a carbon transaction management module, a project management module and an emission reduction management module, the data management module comprises data collection, data processing, data modeling, algorithm programming, embedded service, data results, data organization, a database, query, manual judgment, automatic processing, export and early warning, the double-carbon-number data center system is convenient to track the double-carbon-number data center system, is suitable for carbon emission reduction calculation and methodology under different application scenes, is simple and convenient to manage carbon assets, manages the carbon asset requirements of the circular economy and environmental protection industrial park by monitoring different data indexes, and authenticates the carbon emission reduction authority, and carbon trading is conveniently carried out, a proper trading market is conveniently selected, and higher income is obtained.

title_en: Duplication removing method and system for manager card to be paid, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a duplication eliminating method, a duplication eliminating system, electronic equipment and a storage medium for a manager card to be paid, wherein the duplication eliminating method comprises the following steps: acquiring first collection information, wherein the first collection information comprises a first collection account and payment arrival information, and the first collection account is one of a main card account and a sub card account; acquiring second collection information according to the money receiving information, wherein the second collection information comprises a second collection account which is the other one of the primary card account and the secondary card account; and generating target collection information according to the first collection information and the second collection information. According to the method and the system, whether the collection information received by the merchant platform is the same collection information or not is judged through the payment information, so that the repeated generation of the collection information is avoided, and the cost of manual screening is reduced; in addition, on the premise that the collection information of the daughter card is more detailed than that of the main card, the collection information of the daughter card is preferentially reserved for recording the collection information in more detail, so that the safety of funds is ensured, and the collection amount is accurately determined.

title_en: FMS reliability dynamic quantitative evaluation method based on fuzzy operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an FMS reliability dynamic quantitative evaluation method based on fuzzy operation, and more particularly relates to a method for quantitatively evaluating the reliability of an FMS based on a fuzzy transformation matrix, which aims at the running characteristics of the FMS, considers the problem of correlation between fault expression forms of control software and mechanical equipment, constructs a system reliability evaluation system, counts the failure times and the fault expression forms of various elements in the running process of the system, quantitatively evaluates single element fault form classification by considering the influence degree of the single element fault form classification on the system performance, and provides a system reliability quantitative evaluation method based on the fuzzy transformation matrix, thereby providing a theoretical basis for the optimization and maintenance of a manufacturing system.

title_en: Method, system and equipment for finding people stream density mutation time points
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system and equipment for discovering people flow density mutation time points, which combine a temperature change gradient, a CO2 concentration change gradient and a history record to judge whether the current people flow density is suddenly changed, solve the problem of how to acquire large-scale space people flow change, can discover the arrival of people flow density peaks or valleys in advance, has high judging speed and reliable judging result.

title_en: Cloud-edge-end-cooperation-based comprehensive energy terminal electric energy quality data processing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloud-edge-based collaborative comprehensive energy terminal power quality data processing method, which comprises the following steps of: the method comprises the steps that data are collected, classified and processed by a collection terminal on the end side, an edge device on the side analyzes data uploaded by the collection terminal, and a cloud platform on the cloud side analyzes the uploaded data based on the calculation power of the cloud platform and the cooperation of the cloud edge to obtain possible problems and positions where the problems occur; based on monitoring and analysis of the power quality, a lightweight power quality monitoring method suitable for edge computing equipment is provided, the high-frequency data sampling and preprocessing capabilities of the edge equipment or end-side equipment are exerted, high-performance cloud computing capabilities are combined, and the power quality accuracy analysis facing a comprehensive energy scene is realized through cloud edge-side cooperation, so that the problems of high price and large equipment volume of the existing power quality equipment detection equipment are solved. And meanwhile, the function of positioning and analyzing the power quality fault is completed through data monitoring of a plurality of edge equipment terminals.

title_en: Intelligent system and method for evaluating service level of formaldehyde treatment industry
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent system and method for evaluating service level of formaldehyde treatment industry, and belongs to the field of formaldehyde treatment service. The invention discloses an intelligent service level evaluation system and method for a formaldehyde treatment industry, wherein a formaldehyde treatment client comprises a formaldehyde treatment device and a remote operation module, the remote operation module comprises a mobile data module and a controller module, the detection client comprises a formaldehyde detection device and a data transceiving module, the formaldehyde detection device is used for detecting the air quality in a formaldehyde treatment area at regular time, and the level evaluation system is in bidirectional connection with a data management platform. According to the inside condition adjustment formaldehyde treatment device in formaldehyde treatment area, make the formaldehyde treatment device carry out the adaptability adjustment to reach best treatment effect, accessible data management platform screens data fast, acquires best evaluation data, according to the big data of network and the good grade data value automatic management data of formulating in advance, make things convenient for the customer to carry out the rapid judgement to the service data that formaldehyde was administered.

title_en: Sandstone thermal reservoir development and utilization suitability quantification method and device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a sandstone thermal reservoir development and utilization suitability quantification method, a device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring various influence factors; obtaining the weight values of various influence factors through an analytic hierarchy process; and processing each influence factor and weight value after normalization by using a GIS, and determining the development and utilization suitability index of each development unit by using a sandstone thermal reservoir development and suitability index model so as to obtain an influence degree frequency distribution map and perform development and utilization suitability zoning. On the basis of fully analyzing geological and hydrogeological data and other data of an area to be evaluated, various influence factors of the development and utilization suitability of the sandstone thermal reservoir are obtained, a hierarchical analysis method is adopted to determine the weight value of each influence factor and establish a development and utilization suitability index model, and GIS is adopted to determine the development and utilization suitability index of each development unit so as to draw an influence degree frequency distribution map, so that the development and utilization suitability quantitative evaluation of the sandstone thermal reservoir is completed.

title_en: Power facility operation quality detection system based on data processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power facility operation quality detection system based on data processing, which relates to the technical field of power facility quality detection, solves the technical problem that the operation and maintenance of a power facility are not analyzed when the operation quality of the power facility is detected in the prior art, so that the accuracy of operation quality detection is reduced, judges the influence of operation strength on the operation quality of an analysis object according to a corresponding analysis object in an operation chain, improves the detection efficiency of the operation quality, and enhances the efficiency of efficient operation of the power facility; the efficiency and the accuracy of operation quality detection are improved, and meanwhile, the maintenance of the electric power facilities can be controlled, so that the increase of abnormal operation risks of the electric power facilities due to unqualified maintenance of the electric power facilities is prevented; whether the operation quality of the analysis object is qualified or not is judged, the operation efficiency of the analysis object is improved, and meanwhile, the maintenance and complexity of the analysis object are used as influence factors of operation quality analysis, so that the accuracy of operation quality detection can be improved.

title_en: Power distribution network reconstruction method based on binary particle swarm algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution network reconstruction method based on a binary particle swarm algorithm, which comprises the following steps of: a multi-objective optimization model comprising the minimized network loss and the minimized switch operation cost is provided; in the solving process, a Binary Particle swarm algorithm (BPSO) is adopted to research the reconstruction optimization problem of the active power distribution network considering uncertain data. The invention can reconstruct the power distribution network by using the binary particle swarm algorithm, thereby enhancing the elasticity of the power distribution network system and leading the power distribution network to have smaller network loss and less operation cost.

title_en: Method for measuring and calculating cost performance of iron ore powder for sintering
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for measuring and calculating the cost performance of iron ore powder for sintering; comprising the following steps: step 1, calculating the valuable grade: calculating the valuable grade according to the chemical components and the burning loss; step 2, calculating a dry basis tax removal to list price; step 3, calculating 1% valuable grade price and performance; and 4, calculating the cost performance. According to the invention, ti and Sn are incorporated into cost performance measurement and calculation, so that the phosphorus and sulfur reduction coefficient is improved; the method for measuring and calculating the cost performance of the iron ore powder for sintering provided by the invention ensures that the price participates in the cost performance measurement, and the iron ore powder with the same performance and the lowest price shows the high cost performance. According to the method, the performance price ratio is calculated and ranked firstly, and then the specific ore matching characteristic is combined, so that the method has high selectivity and price ratio as much as possible, can be matched in a large amount, is beneficial to environmental protection, prolonging the service life of a blast furnace, improving the steel performance and reducing the processing cost, and can be used for purchasing iron ore powder, and the direct or indirect economic benefit is increased for iron and steel enterprises.

title_en: Method and system for realizing block chain
abstract_en: The present invention provides a novel and advantageous solution for controlling or influencing the use and/or access of resources. The resource may be a device, such as an IoT (internet of things) device or process. The invention is implemented by a distributed ledger (blockchain). This may be a bitcoin blockchain or some alternative blockchain platform/protocol. In an illustrative embodiment, the controlled resource is a parking timer. The present invention may provide a method comprising the steps of: generating a blockchain transaction (Tx) indicative of a resource usage condition, the blockchain transaction including a multi-signature script requiring a plurality of signatures to complete the blockchain transaction; providing a first subset of the plurality of signatures to the blockchain transaction to generate a partially signed signature script to partially complete the blockchain transaction; and in response to a condition for resource usage being met, providing a second subset of the plurality of signatures to the blockchain transaction to fully complete the blockchain transaction. The condition for using the asset may be that a discrete amount of the asset is used and the second subset of the plurality of signatures is provided in response to the discrete amount of the asset being used.

title_en: Additional verification method and system for enhancing bank account security
abstract_en: The invention discloses an additional verification method for enhancing bank account safety, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a sample image, and encoding pixels of the sample image to obtain encoded pixels; dividing pixels of a sample image into a high-order sample and a low-order sample according to a first bit value of the encoded pixels; initializing a neural network model, and generating initial populations with the quantity corresponding to the quantity proportion of the high-level samples and the low-level samples based on a preset coding structure; calculating the fitness value of each individual in the population; performing iterative optimization on the initial population according to the fitness value, and when the disturbance condition is met, outputting an individual with the minimum fitness value as a disturbance individual training neural network model; and responding to the received operation request of the account and the verification image, judging whether the verification image is an interference image according to the trained neural network model, and if not, executing corresponding operation based on the operation request. Therefore, the disturbance image is efficiently and rapidly generated, and the purpose of detecting the security holes of the deep neural network is achieved.

title_en: Finished oil pipeline conveying coordination optimization system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of finished oil delivery, and relates to a coordinated optimization system for delivery of a finished oil pipeline, which comprises: the system comprises a logistics information input module, a pipe transmission coordination optimization module and an optimization scheme output module; the logistics information input module is used for importing basic information required by the pipe transportation coordination optimization module; the pipeline transportation coordination optimization module is used for realizing the logistics cost optimization of an oil product shipper and the income optimization of a pipeline carrier; and the optimization scheme output module is used for exporting the optimized price scheme and the overall transportation scheme. The method and the system uniformly optimize the finished oil pipeline transportation price of the pipeline carrier and the whole finished oil transportation scheme of the oil product shipper so as to promote the pipeline carrier to promote the pipeline transportation turnover amount and the profit level, simultaneously, the whole logistics cost of the oil product shipper is not increased, and the long-term stable coordination relationship between the pipeline carrier and the oil product shipper is maintained.

title_en: Preparation method of commodity identity information identifier, and identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of a commodity identity information identifier, an identification method and a system, wherein the identification method comprises the following steps: forming a metallographic identifier; establishing a commodity identity library based on different commodity metallographic identifications; and receiving a commodity metallographic identification request sent by a user, extracting the metallographic identification of the commodity to be detected, performing matching search, and returning a result of identifying authenticity. The identification method adopts the microcosmic metallographic structure form of the metal material as the identification, has stable and unchangeable uniqueness and irreproducibility, is suitable for commodities, has a wide application range and low cost, identifies and matches the metallographic identification through an image search algorithm, is matched with the bar code and the two-dimensional code, has high search efficiency and is easy to identify.

title_en: People flow monitoring method and system based on intelligent farm trade
abstract_en: The invention discloses a people flow monitoring method and system based on intelligent farm trade, which comprises the steps of taking the volume of trades selling the same agricultural products of each stall in a farm trade market in a certain time period, comparing the volume of trades selling the same agricultural products of the stalls in the same time period one by one, calculating the volume difference between the stall selling the highest volume of trades and each stall selling the same agricultural products of other stalls according to the compared volume of trades selling the same agricultural products of the stalls in the same time period, and the like, wherein the invention calculates the volume difference between the merchants selling the same agricultural products by comparing the volume of trades selling the same agricultural products in a certain time period, compares the volume difference with the floating difference caused by other factors, judges that the services of the merchants have some problems when the volume difference is larger than the floating difference under the condition of excluding other factors, and a service rectification notification is provided for the merchant, so that a better service is provided for the customer, and the loss of the customer flow of the merchant is avoided.

title_en: Bank outlet customer transaction risk control method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for controlling customer transaction risk of banking outlets, which relate to the technical field of transaction data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of classifying transactions according to transaction data; the method comprises the steps of determining a transaction category vector corresponding to a number at a current moment, determining a transaction category vector corresponding to the number at a historical moment, determining a similar historical moment at the current moment according to a plurality of transaction category vectors corresponding to the current moment and a plurality of transaction category vectors corresponding to each historical moment in a plurality of historical moments, determining a main transaction category of a bank website and a risk control model corresponding to the main transaction category according to transaction data after the similar historical moment, issuing the main transaction category and the risk control model to the bank website, and performing risk control on current transaction of a client according to the main transaction category and the risk control model of the bank website when the client performs transaction at the bank website.

title_en: Rural tourism depicting system based on multi-source heterogeneous big data
abstract_en: The invention provides a rural tourism depicting system based on multi-source heterogeneous big data, and relates to the field of rural tourism informatization. The invention realizes one-stop service of 'searching scenic spots', 'selecting scenic spots', 'customizing routes' and 'recommending scenic spots' of the rural tourism plan through the rural tourism front-end depicting system, thereby avoiding the complex information collecting process when the tourism plan is made; the country element screening system is mainly used for enabling a user to quickly set screening elements and obtaining screening results of country scenic spots; the tourist portrait recommendation system can perform scenic spot recommendation in various modes according to user portraits and scenic spot portraits, and increases the diversity and personalized recommendation of a recommendation list; the visual country map system can display various routes of country tourism and display the relevant information of scenic spots at corresponding positions of the map, thereby facilitating users to formulate tourism plans and tourism routes.

title_en: Automatic construction method of link topology in financial transaction log
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic construction method of a link topology in a financial transaction log, and relates to the technical field of construction of transaction chains of financial transaction systems. The invention automatically constructs the transaction link in a machine learning mode, can save a large amount of manpower and time and ensure the accuracy. The invention solves the problems that manual combing is time-consuming and labor-consuming, the implementers usually do not know the business of the client, the full cooperation of the owners is needed, time-consuming and labor-consuming, and errors are easy to occur in the process of manually combing the transaction link topology. The invention can be used in the place where the Agent is installed in the server where the application is located, thereby saving system resources and better ensuring system service.

title_en: Data processing method, device, system and equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a data processing method, a device, a system and equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving a risk identification result of a server side aiming at a first user, wherein the risk identification result of the first user is obtained by performing risk identification on first feature data of the first user by the server side based on a pre-trained first risk identification model, and the pre-trained first risk identification model is obtained by training the server side based on a preset first number of user feature data; performing initialization training on a preset second risk identification model based on second characteristic data of the first user and a risk identification result of the first user to obtain a second risk identification model after the initialization training; and carrying out parameter updating processing on the initialized and trained second risk recognition model based on the characteristic data of the second user and the risk recognition result of the second user to obtain a pre-trained second risk recognition model.

title_en: AC/DC transmission channel power optimization distribution method, device and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to an alternating current/direct current transmission channel power optimization distribution method, an alternating current/direct current transmission channel power optimization distribution device, computer equipment, a storage medium and a computer program product. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring monthly decomposition electric quantity of the cross-province and cross-region protocol and scheduling parameters; inputting the monthly decomposition electric quantity and the scheduling parameters into a pre-constructed power collaborative calculation model, and calculating to obtain a monthly power transmission plan; acquiring inter-provincial and inter-regional marketized monthly transaction decomposed electric quantity, inputting the monthly transaction decomposed electric quantity, a monthly power transmission plan and scheduling parameters into a pre-constructed power plan adjustment model for adjustment, and obtaining a monthly power distribution plan; and carrying out transmission power control on the AC/DC transmission channel according to the monthly power distribution plan. By adopting the method, the monthly power distribution plan can be more in line with the power transmission requirement of the medium-long-term market environment, and the safe and reliable transmission of the electric quantity of the AC/DC power transmission channel in the medium-long-term market environment is improved.

title_en: Online multi-round election method and system, intelligent terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to an online multi-round election method, a system, an intelligent terminal and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S100: acquiring the types of the posts needing to be elected and determined and the final name amount of the people selected in each post; step S200: constructing a candidate set and a non-candidate set; step S300: selecting a target number of candidate persons from a candidate person set based on a preset election rule, taking a set consisting of the selected candidate persons as a candidate person set, listing unselected candidate persons in a non-candidate person set for total, and recording the non-candidate person set; step S400: repeating the step S300, wherein the repetition times m is the number N of the post types, so that a plurality of non-candidate sets and a candidate set are obtained; step S500: and updating the pre-stored organization structure according to the determined final person selection of each post level. The method and the system can be used for electing the final people on each post level in an online multi-round election mode, so that groups or organizations can be more convenient when election activities are carried out.

title_en: Data acquisition payment marketing integration intelligent service system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital acquisition payment marketing integrated intelligent service system, which comprises a cash register, a receipt printer, intelligent integrated equipment and an intelligent equipment management cloud platform, wherein the intelligent integrated equipment is connected with the receipt printer; the intelligent integrated equipment is wirelessly connected with the intelligent equipment management cloud platform; the intelligent integrated equipment comprises a data acquisition module, an intelligent tracing module, an aggregation payment module and a card and ticket verification and sale module; and the intelligent equipment management cloud platform is used for storing the data sent by the data acquisition module, analyzing the payment command and the receipt printing command, acquiring a corresponding preferential point rule, calculating the current user point and finishing verification of the card and ticket information in the card and ticket verification process, and is also used for managing the intelligent integrated equipment and the user information. The invention improves the acceptance rate of the merchant for the data acquired by the shopping center, provides preferential service for the customer, and can effectively improve the business efficiency of the shopping center and the merchant.

title_en: Contract page pushing method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a subscription page pushing method and device, and relates to the technical field of communication. The method comprises the following steps: when a user finishes order payment operation, acquiring historical signing information corresponding to the user and fatigue degree information recommended by the user for signing; judging whether the user meets preset subscription recommendation conditions or not based on the historical subscription information and the fatigue degree information; and if the user meets the preset subscription recommendation condition, generating and displaying a subscription page free of secret payment so as to recommend the subscription to the user. The method and the device can improve the signing efficiency and the signing success rate of the secret payment-free payment.

title_en: Management system for biological strain expanding culture production
abstract_en: The invention discloses a management system for biological strain propagation production, and relates to the field of strain management systems; the system comprises a bacterial treasure house and a mobile phone app, wherein an electronic password of the bacterial treasure house is associated with the mobile phone app, and the mobile phone app is associated with an ID of a designated person; the mobile phone app comprises a password management unit, a seed liquid expanding and culturing unit, a seed liquid handover unit and a seed liquid reservation unit; the serial numbers and the number of the strains stored in and taken from the strain storage library can be recorded through the mobile phone app, and the system can also automatically record the ID of the input personnel and the input time, so that the working efficiency of the management personnel is improved, and the error rate is reduced.

title_en: Electric heating hydrogen multi-energy complementary scheduling method and system based on hydrogen-burning gas turbine
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electrothermal hydrogen multi-energy complementary scheduling method and system based on a hydrogen-burning gas turbine, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a multi-energy complementary system and a control strategy of the multi-energy complementary system; the energy form of the multi-energy complementary system comprises hydrogen energy and other energy sources; respectively establishing mathematical models of all the devices in the multi-energy complementary system; based on each mathematical model, establishing a system optimization scheduling objective function taking the minimum total coal consumption and the maximum waste wind consumption of the multi-energy complementary system as optimization objectives; determining constraint conditions of system optimization scheduling; and solving the optimal scheduling objective function of the system based on the constraint condition and the control strategy so as to realize optimal scheduling of the electrothermal hydrogen multi-energy complementary system. The invention fully utilizes the space-time complementary characteristic of the multi-energy complementary system and the capability of conversion between different energy forms, has the advantage of peak regulation, and realizes clean and high efficiency in the true sense through the utilization of hydrogen energy.

title_en: LSTM-based electric power system oscillation risk prediction method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric power system oscillation risk prediction, and particularly relates to an LSTM-based electric power system oscillation risk prediction method. The method is characterized in that oscillation information in power grid WAMS real-time measurement data is extracted, the change situation of oscillation times in a certain time period of a power grid is counted and used as training data of an LSTM long-term and short-term memory neural network, the neural network is trained by adjusting neural network parameters, accurate prediction of the oscillation times in the future time period of the power system is finally achieved, early warning is provided for power grid dispatching operation personnel, the early warning is used as a basis for taking safety control measures, and the safe and stable operation of the power system is guaranteed.

title_en: Fine prediction method for icing thickness of mountain micro-terrain power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention provides a refined prediction method for ice coating thickness of a mountain micro-terrain power transmission line, which comprises the steps of (1) refining 3km multiplied by 3km ice coating thickness prediction grid points of a mountain micro-terrain into 300m multiplied by 300m grid points, determining each refined grid point category, wherein the refined grid points are divided into 4 categories of high-altitude grid points, ridge grid points, windward grid points and leeward grid points according to categories, (2) correcting ice coating thickness prediction values of the high-altitude grid points, (3) correcting ice coating thickness prediction values of the leeward grid points, windward grid points and ridge grid points, and (4) correcting the corrected windward grid points and ridge grid point ice coating thickness prediction values according to wind directions. The method realizes the ice coating thickness prediction of the gear stage, improves the accuracy of the ice coating thickness prediction of the circuit in the micro-topography area, and has the advantages of wide applicability and high calculation speed.

title_en: Control method and device based on online training platform classification management
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of online training platforms, in particular to a control method and a device based on online training platform classification management. The invention has the advantages that: through set up in the classification management host computer and accomodate the groove and make the display screen accomodate wherein, make the display screen can place in accomodating the groove at non-user state to reduce the display screen and transport and not use the time damage that causes owing to colliding with, space that occupies when also can reduce equipment transportation, it is more convenient to make equipment transportation install, make the display screen can rotate through setting up the second pivot in accomodating the groove, use the display screen to rotate it to the inclined plane laminating with the front side when needs.

title_en: Load aggregation information display method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of energy, and provides a load aggregation information display method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: collecting the Internet of things measurement point parameters of target peak shaving execution equipment of a target aggregated and controlled party in each execution period in a preset execution period and peak shaving auxiliary data issued by a load dispatcher, wherein the Internet of things measurement point parameters at least comprise real-time execution power and peak shaving execution time; according to a preset statistical analysis strategy, carrying out statistical analysis on the Internet of things measurement point parameters and peak shaving auxiliary data to obtain load aggregation information, wherein the load aggregation information at least comprises real-time effective peak shaving auxiliary quantity; and mapping and outputting the load aggregation information to a corresponding information display block on a preset load aggregation display screen. The method and the system can realize that various load aggregation related information in the peak shaving auxiliary process is efficiently and highly displayed to the load aggregator, and the load aggregator expands more potential aggregated control.

title_en: Loan contract evidence-saving method based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of information, in particular to a loan contract evidence-saving method based on a block chain.A financial institution makes an electronic loan contract and sends the electronic loan contract to an enterprise applying for loan; after the enterprise checks, the hash value of the signed electronic loan contract is recorded as a contract signature and is sent to a financial institution; the financial institution packages the loan application materials, the electronic loan contract and the contract signature as a certificate storage package, extracts the hash value of the certificate storage package, records the hash value as a certificate storage hash value, and sends the certificate storage hash value to the enterprise; after the enterprise checks the certificate storage package and the certificate storage hash value, signing the certificate storage hash value; the financial institution uploads the hash value of the electronic loan contract, the contract signature, the certificate-storing hash value and the certificate-storing signature to a block chain for storage; storing the certificate storing packet in association with the certificate storing signature and the block height; and sending the certificate storage package and the certificate storage signature to a notarization server, and issuing a notarization certificate after the notarization server verifies. The substantial effects of the invention are as follows: the credit card of the loan contract can be completed on line, and the efficiency of the credit card is improved.

title_en: Urban intelligent traffic emergency monitoring, regulation and control management system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban intelligent traffic emergency monitoring, regulating and controlling management system based on the Internet of things, which analyzes the predicted fault maintaining time of each fault sub-line by acquiring the corresponding fault parameter of each fault sub-line in a target urban traffic electric power line, analyzes the required electric quantity of each fault sub-line according to the unit time electric quantity of each traffic signal lamp in each fault sub-line, acquires the predicted vehicle flow of the traffic road corresponding to each fault sub-line in the predicted fault maintaining time interval, analyzes the emergency response index of each fault sub-line and performs corresponding emergency regulation and control management according to the comparison result, thereby being capable of accurately analyzing the emergency response grade of the fault electric power line in many aspects, further realizing the pertinence, the intelligence and the timeliness of the urban traffic electric power line emergency regulation and control management and improving the urban traffic electric power line emergency regulation and control information level to the greatest extent.

title_en: New era vocational education production and teaching fusion treatment system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a new-era vocational education production and teaching fusion treatment system and method. The new era vocational education production and education fusion treatment system and method are convenient to use, can be checked at any time, are convenient to know information changes in time, and improve communication and fusion between enterprises and schools. By checking enterprise demands, future development directions and welfare treatments of work issued by enterprise personnel, the method is convenient for improving the cognition of students to society and planning the future working directions, can also help the school optimize the future education of the students, improve the capacity of conveying talents on a campus, avoid the situation that the school knowledge is behind the development of society, quickly screen data through network cloud computing, not only facilitate the students to autonomously learn necessary knowledge and plan the future working directions, places, industries and the like, but also avoid the students from entering society for the first time to generate confused psychology.

title_en: Smart city data analysis and study judgment system
abstract_en: The invention provides a smart city data analysis studying and judging system, which comprises a data collection module, wherein the data collection module is used for collecting data through a network connection terminal or APP, storing the collected data into a corresponding memory through a data line, the data retrieval module is connected with the memory through the data line, the data retrieval module can retrieve the data in the memory, extract the characteristics of the detected data through a characteristic detection module, verify the data with the data of a characteristic index library, analyze the data through a data analysis module, and be connected with a central processing module through the data line, so that the analyzed data can be processed and summarized through the central processing module, and then are transmitted through the network connection terminal or APP; the problem of current wisdom city data analysis adopt mechanical type data analysis, lead to its analysis speed too slow, the analysis result degree of accuracy is lower is solved.

title_en: Method, system, device and storage medium for demand side resource to participate in capacity market
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power automation, and discloses a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for demand side resources to participate in a capacity market, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target capacity and a capacity demand curve of a capacity market, and capacity declaration amount, capacity declaration and quotation amount and capacity credibility of traditional coal-electricity units and demand side resources; calling and solving a preset capacity market model according to a target capacity and capacity demand curve of a capacity market, and capacity declaration amount, capacity declaration price and capacity credibility of the traditional coal-electricity unit and demand side resources to obtain a capacity medium scalar and a capacity clearing price of the demand side resources; and outputting the scalar quantity in the capacity and the clearing price in the capacity of the resource on the demand side, wherein the scalar quantity in the capacity and the clearing price in the capacity of the resource on the demand side are used for controlling the resource on the demand side to participate in the capacity market. The demand of the capacity market on the capacity of the traditional coal-electric set is effectively reduced, the investment of the generator set and the investment of a system network architecture are delayed, and the operation cost of a power system is reduced.

title_en: Professional construction and student growth analysis method and system based on professional ability big data
abstract_en: The invention provides a professional construction and student growth analysis method and system based on professional ability big data, which comprises the steps of obtaining the historical employment situation of school students, extracting keywords for post requirements and expanding the keywords; performing semantic analysis on the post requirements, and clustering posts with similar semantics; taking an intersection of skills in the second clustering positive sample resume, taking a union of skills in the second clustering negative sample resume, and solving a difference between the first intersection and the first union as a key skill of a corresponding post; and (3) averaging each professional class of the third clustering positive sample, averaging each professional class of the third clustering negative sample, and comparing the averaging of each professional class of the third clustering positive sample with the averaging of each professional class of the third clustering negative sample, wherein the professional class with the largest difference is the key professional class of the corresponding post. The invention obtains the real intention of the employment unit by analyzing the resume information of the students and provides professional guidance for professional construction and student growth.

title_en: Comprehensive management system and method for microorganism laboratory
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive management system and a method for a microorganism laboratory, wherein the system comprises an indoor air pressure management unit, a cleanliness management unit, a temperature and humidity management unit, a people flow management unit, a logistics management unit and a logistics and sewage management unit; the indoor air pressure management unit is used for regulating and controlling the indoor air pressure of each room in the microbial laboratory; the cleanliness management unit is used for monitoring the dust and bacteria conditions of the general clean room; the temperature and humidity management unit is used for detecting the indoor temperature and humidity of each room in the microbial laboratory; the people flow management unit is used for managing the entrance and exit conditions of personnel; the logistics management unit is used for managing the circulation trend of logistics; the logistics and sewage management unit is used for managing the circulation trend of the logistics and sewage flow. The invention realizes scientific management and control of personnel flow, material flow and material sewage flow in a laboratory, realizes the monitoring of cleanliness of a clean area and temperature and humidity of different rooms in the laboratory and the regulation and control of gradient pressure of different rooms, and can more scientifically and reasonably control the experimental process.

title_en: Digital mobile telephone transaction and payment system
abstract_en: The present application relates to a digital mobile phone transaction and payment system comprising: the digital RMB storage module is used as a safety carrier of the digital RMB and used for storing the digital RMB on line and/or off line; the limit setting module is used for setting the limit of the digital RMB paid from the security chip in the payment action, and one payment receiving activity comprises a payment action and a payment receiving action; the payment interface synchronization module is used for setting and storing a plurality of payment interfaces and automatically synchronizing the payment interfaces when the payment interfaces are different in the current receipt and payment activities; and the payment behavior verification module is used for setting the payment behavior of the digital RMB and verifying that the payment behavior is correct so as to carry out the payment of the digital RMB. The method and the device have the effect of facilitating the payment of the digital RMB by the digital mobile phone in an off-line state.

title_en: Training content generation and data processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a training content generation and data processing method, device and equipment and a storage medium. In the embodiment of the application, the training task is described from a plurality of dimensions of task type information, personnel description information and content description information, so that the training task is more diversified and flexible, under the condition of receiving the training task, the target personnel which need to participate in the training task are determined according to the personnel description information, the task type information and the content description information required by the training task, the operation behavior data of each target personnel can be combined, the personalized training content can be respectively generated for each target personnel by utilizing a machine learning model, the personalized recommendation of the training content can be realized by combining the individual differences of different personnel, the training effect is improved, the growth period of the personnel is shortened, in addition, the generation efficiency of the training content is improved by combining machine learning in the task training, the training efficiency is improved, and the growth period of the personnel is further shortened.

title_en: Safety management method and system for attached outer wall scaffold
abstract_en: The application relates to a safety management method and a safety management system for an attached outer wall scaffold, which belong to the field of scaffolds, wherein the method comprises the steps of judging whether the scaffold is inclined or not based on a preset inclination sensor; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a scaffold inclination factor based on a monitoring sensor if the scaffold is inclined, generating a corresponding scaffold management strategy based on the inclination factor, and correcting the inclination of the scaffold according to the scaffold management strategy. The inclination sensor is used for detecting whether the scaffold is inclined or not, if the scaffold is inclined, the scaffold body structure of the scaffold is indicated to be deformed structurally, at the moment, the inclination factor of the scaffold is determined according to the monitoring sensor, so that workers can know the reason that the scaffold body structure of the scaffold is deformed structurally in time, and according to the inclination factor, a corresponding scaffold management strategy is generated, so that the workers can repair the scaffold body structure of the scaffold in a targeted manner under the condition that the inclination factor of the scaffold is known, and the personal safety of the workers can be guaranteed.

title_en: Emergency medical management system and method for urban public health event
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency medical management system and method for urban public health events, which comprises the following steps: the system comprises a model building module, a data acquisition module, an event classification module, a prevention and control command module and a rescue taking module; the model construction module is used for constructing a classification model based on urban public health event data; the data acquisition module is used for acquiring real-time data of a field monitoring object; the event classification module classifies the real-time data based on a classification model to obtain a classification result; the prevention and control command module is used for formulating an emergency plan of the urban public health event based on the classification result; and the rescue taking module takes corresponding rescue measures based on the emergency plan. By the technical scheme, the danger level of the public health incident can be accurately judged, and rescue measures can be taken in time according to the public health incident with the danger level.

title_en: Site selection method and device for distribution center
abstract_en: The application discloses a site selection method and device for a distribution center, which are mainly applied to the military field. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a target simulation environment of the target area according to the environment parameters of the target area; inputting the current site selection position of the distribution center in the target simulation environment into a reinforcement learning model for site selection of the distribution center; acquiring a suggested site selection position of a distribution center output by the reinforcement learning model in a target simulation environment; and when the recommended site selection position is inconsistent with the current site selection position, the recommended site selection position is used for changing the site selection position of the distribution center in the target area. The simulation environment with higher accuracy can be obtained through simulation environment modeling, and environment modeling and reinforcement learning are combined, so that the accurate simulation environment can be relied on, and the recommended site selection position of the distribution center in the simulation environment is dynamically selected by using a reinforcement learning algorithm, so that the optimal site selection position of the distribution center is obtained, the reasonable site selection of the distribution center is realized, and the function of the distribution center is played to the greatest extent.

title_en: Intelligent equipment control system for intelligent manufacturing of wheel steel ring
