abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent equipment control system for intelligent manufacturing of wheel steel rings, belongs to the field of general control systems, and particularly relates to the field of computer program control, wherein a processor of the control system executes a computer program stored in a memory to realize the following steps: obtaining the preheating temperature of a target automobile wheel steel ring before spinning, the feeding ratio in the spinning process and the cooling temperature after spinning; calculating a preheating uniformity evaluation index, a feeding ratio sequence and a cooling effect evaluation index of a target automobile wheel steel ring, and inputting the indexes into a trained LSTM network for prediction; and if the predicted spinning quality evaluation index of the target automobile wheel steel ring is smaller than the quality evaluation index threshold value, optimally controlling the production process of the automobile wheel steel ring. The invention belongs to an artificial intelligence system in the production field, can be applied to the intelligent manufacturing equipment industry, the industrial automatic control system device manufacturing industry and the intelligent heat treatment production line, and can improve the quality of the produced automobile wheel steel ring.

title_en: Lost circulation type analysis method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: According to the method, the device, the equipment and the medium for analyzing the well leakage type, the well leakage data to be measured are obtained, the data processing is carried out on the well leakage data, the sample data to be predicted is obtained, then the sample data to be predicted is input into the well leakage type prediction model obtained through pre-training, whether the well leakage occurs or not can be accurately judged, the well leakage type corresponding to each depth in the sample data to be predicted is obtained, the well leakage type is stored, the decision basis can be provided for field technicians, the preparation for leakage prevention and leakage stoppage is carried out in advance, the well drilling safety is effectively guaranteed, the well leakage is avoided, the processing is carried out again, and the production cost is reduced.

title_en: Reservoir supervisory systems based on digit twin
abstract_en: A reservoir supervision system based on digital twins comprises a bottom service module and a cloud service module; the bottom layer service module comprises: the device comprises a data acquisition submodule and an equipment management submodule. The cloud service module comprises: the device comprises a visualization sub-module, a data storage sub-module, a data analysis sub-module, a terrain evolution deduction sub-module, an equipment energy conservation analysis sub-module and a communication interaction sub-module. And the staff accesses the cloud service module through the remote client to realize remote monitoring management. The invention not only realizes the visual supervision of the reservoir operation, but also deeply excavates the data value, realizes the functions of risk water level warning, terrain evolution deduction and equipment energy-saving analysis, and improves the intelligent level of the system. And the interactive request of a remote client can be received, and a control instruction is sent to the bottom service module, so that the remote control of bottom equipment is realized, and the digital twin advantage is better exerted.

title_en: Carbon loading capacity determining method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon load capacity determining method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, the method predicts the current carbon load capacity of a target particle trap according to a pre-trained carbon load capacity prediction model by acquiring current carbon load capacity prediction parameters such as current front-end inlet air temperature, current rear-end exhaust air temperature, current transient exhaust gas volume flow, current pressure difference, current estimated carbon load capacity and the like of the target particle trap and historical carbon load capacity prediction parameters, the method takes the front-end inlet air temperature, the rear-end exhaust air temperature, the pressure difference and the estimated carbon load capacity as the parameters for predicting the carbon load capacity, can adapt to the states of oil products and parts such as oil injector abrasion and the like, improves the carbon load capacity estimation precision, and predicts the carbon load capacity at the current moment based on the current moment and the relevant parameters at the historical moments to ensure that the predicted carbon load capacity accords with the change rule by combining the relevant parameters at the historical moments, the prediction accuracy of the carbon loading of the particle trap is further improved.

title_en: Hot-rolled working roll on-machine selection method and roll on-machine expert system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for selecting a hot-rolled working roll on a machine and an expert system for selecting the hot-rolled working roll on the machine, belonging to the field of rolling control. The on-machine selection method obtains five types of product specification attributes of the on-site rolled product; presetting a reference rolling plan and corresponding roller requirements, and analyzing the existence states of five gauge attribute categories in the reference rolling plan relative to all gauge attribute categories; calculating the contribution degree of each category to the characteristics of the reference rolling plan according to the adaptive coefficient, calculating the characteristic difference degree between the target rolling plan and the reference rolling plan, determining the requirements of target rollers, selecting all rollers meeting the target rolling plan, and performing priority ranking; evaluating the state of the roller with the lowest priority, calculating the matching degree of the target rolling plan and the roller and comparing the matching degree with a threshold value; if not, correcting the adaptive coefficient and recalculating the contribution degree; otherwise, obtaining the selection result on the computer. The invention realizes the reasonable distribution and automatic pushing of the roller resources, saves the process of manually selecting the rollers and reduces the consumption of the rollers.

title_en: Hot-rolled working roll on-machine selection method and roll on-machine expert system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for selecting a hot-rolled working roll on a machine and an expert system for selecting the hot-rolled working roll on the machine, belonging to the field of rolling control. The on-machine selection method obtains five types of product specification attributes of the on-site rolled product; presetting a reference rolling plan and corresponding roller requirements, and analyzing the existence states of five gauge attribute categories in the reference rolling plan relative to all gauge attribute categories; calculating the contribution degree of each category to the characteristics of the reference rolling plan according to the adaptive coefficient, calculating the characteristic difference degree between the target rolling plan and the reference rolling plan, determining the requirements of target rollers, selecting all rollers meeting the target rolling plan, and performing priority ranking; evaluating the state of the roller with the lowest priority, calculating the matching degree of the target rolling plan and the roller and comparing the matching degree with a threshold value; if not, correcting the adaptive coefficient and recalculating the contribution degree; otherwise, obtaining the selection result of the computer. The invention realizes the reasonable distribution and automatic pushing of the roller resources, saves the process of manually selecting the rollers and reduces the consumption of the rollers.

title_en: Intelligent oil reservoir knowledge base construction method, system and readable medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of oil reservoir development, and relates to an intelligent oil reservoir knowledge base construction method, a system and a readable medium, wherein the intelligent oil reservoir knowledge base construction method comprises the following steps: establishing a data logic model of an oil reservoir knowledge base; processing the single well parameters into a piece of data according to the data logic model, and calling the data when needed; establishing a subordinate relation of a single well, a block and an oil field, and when partial parameters of the oil field are lost and the subordinate block or the single well has the parameters corresponding to the oil field loss, automatically calculating oil field parameter information by the system, adding the oil field parameter information into an intelligent oil reservoir knowledge base, and supplementing the lost part in the oil reservoir knowledge base; when the oil field to be developed needs to be predicted, the oil field with the similar characteristics is searched according to the characteristics of the oil field to be developed, an oil field prediction model is established according to the oil field with the similar characteristics, parameters of the oil field to be developed are predicted according to the oil field prediction model, and the oil field prediction model is stored in an oil reservoir knowledge base. The method can automatically read data from the data lake, establish an analog oil reservoir knowledge base and provide a data base for analog query and similar oil field calculation.

title_en: Energy storage fault prediction method and device
abstract_en: The application provides an energy storage fault prediction method and device, the method comprises the steps of dividing sample data into positive sample data and negative sample data, classifying the positive sample data, combining any two categories by adopting OVO-SVM classification decision, inputting the positive sample data to train an SVM model to generate a fault probability classifier, carrying out statistics on the negative sample data by adopting database language to obtain fault types, filtering the data based on the fault types, carrying out training on the negative sample data by utilizing a random forest algorithm to generate a fault type classifier, inputting preset quantity data in the sample data into the fault probability classifier and the fault type classifier respectively, and outputting a predicted fault type and a predicted fault probability. According to the application, through positive and negative sample bidirectional modeling, the fault rate of the system operation in a future period of time and the accuracy of the fault type of the system operation in the future period of time and the corresponding occurrence probability are improved.

title_en: Fishery disaster risk assessment method and system suitable for offshore seawater pond culture
abstract_en: The invention provides a fishery disaster risk assessment method and system suitable for offshore seawater pond culture. The method is based on the external sea hydrodynamic elements and wind speed and combines coastal embankment to evaluate the damage risk of the seawater pond culture facilities, and firstly, the range of an evaluation object area, basic geographic information of the evaluation area and the like are obtained; then, performing hydrodynamic force calculation, including open sea hydrodynamic force calculation and aquaculture pond internal hydrodynamic force calculation, wherein storm surge and water accumulation elevation + breakwater wave climbing are used as open sea hydrodynamic force elements, and pond stem storm and water accumulation elevation + wave climbing are used as aquaculture pond internal hydrodynamic force elements; and finally, evaluating the risk hidden danger of the marine facility fishery disaster and compiling a report according to the calculated external sea hydrodynamic elements and the hydrodynamic elements in the culture pond. The quantitative relation is established based on the disaster-stricken factors of the open sea and the disaster-stricken factors in the culture pond, and a basis can be provided for pre-disaster safety evaluation, disaster risk early warning and post-disaster damage evaluation of seawater pond culture.

title_en: Case dispute focus identification method and device based on semi-supervised graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a case dispute focus identification method and a case dispute focus identification device based on a semi-supervised graph neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of embedding rich complaint both-side key statement sentences by using judicial knowledge graph triples, designing a key word screening mechanism, sequencing and extracting input complaint text words, constructing a text graph by using the processed words and texts as two nodes, and inputting the text graph into a graph attention network to realize multi-label text classification, thereby identifying a dispute focus. The invention enhances the text characteristics, improves the problem of long text limitation, reduces the occupied resources of the model, finally realizes the identification of the dispute focus by the multi-label text classification technology based on the semi-supervised graph neural network and improves the court trial efficiency by utilizing the knowledge elements in the judicial knowledge graph and the key text word screening mechanism.

title_en: Identity authentication method and system based on multiple information authentication
abstract_en: The invention discloses an identity authentication system based on multiple information authentication, which comprises a cloud end, wherein an alarm module is arranged at the output end of the cloud end, a mobile terminal is arranged at the input end of the cloud end, a safety device is arranged at the connecting end of the mobile terminal, a wireless transmission module is arranged between the safety device and the cloud end and is mutually connected through the wireless transmission module, the authentication safety is improved by utilizing multiple authentications in the whole process, and the alarm work and the property protection effect are implemented by utilizing double voice authentications on the premise of protecting the safety of life and property, the alarm is carried out through the limitation of numerical values and times without influencing the operation, the amplified output of electric power can increase the operation time, the safety is improved, the double positioning effect is realized, the guarantee of the safety of life and property is further enhanced, the secrecy in the whole process is higher, so the safety is high, and the operation is convenient, the intellectualization is better, and the life and property safety of people is well protected.

title_en: Material supply system and material supply method
abstract_en: The invention provides a material supply system and a material supply method. When the supply of the material used in the plurality of production sites is stopped, the shortage calculation section calculates, for each of the plurality of production sites, a shortage of the shortage material using the usage information, the production plan, and the surplus information. The inventory center determination section determines an inventory center that supplies the shortage material to each of the plurality of production sites at the shortest time using the inventory information, the movement information, and the shortage amount.

title_en: Label generation method, device, equipment and storage medium based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application belongs to the field of artificial intelligence, and relates to a label generation method based on artificial intelligence, which comprises the following steps: acquiring original user data of a target user; preprocessing original user information to obtain first user data; screening the first user data based on a preset feature selection algorithm to obtain second user data; inputting second user data into a preset sparse representation model, and performing calculation processing on the second user data through the sparse representation model to generate an output result corresponding to the second user data; and generating a target user label corresponding to the target user based on the output result. The application also provides a label generation device based on artificial intelligence, computer equipment and a storage medium. In addition, the application also relates to a block chain technology, and the target user label can be stored in the block chain. According to the method and the device, the target label of the target user is generated by using the sparse representation model, so that the processing efficiency and accuracy of the user label data are effectively improved.

title_en: Intelligent control method and system for secondary pressurizing station, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a secondary pressurization station intelligent control method, system, electronic device, and storage medium, the method comprising the steps of: acquiring time-interval water consumption and water pressure data of each water consumption unit; carrying out statistical analysis according to the time-interval water consumption of each water consumption unit to obtain the time-interval total water consumption of each water consumption unit and the proportion of the time-interval water consumption of each water consumption unit to the time-interval total water consumption; and determining the total time interval water supply amount of the secondary pressurizing station and the instant water supply amount of each water using unit according to the total time interval water using amount of each water using unit, the proportion of the total time interval water using amount of each water using unit to the total time interval water using amount, and the water pressure data and the regional water price. The water supply system can realize that the secondary pressurizing station provides water according to the total time interval water consumption of each water unit, reasonably distributes water according to the time interval water consumption proportion of each water unit, saves water sources, and is also favorable for maximizing the benefit of the secondary pressurizing station.

title_en: Extreme seismic region intensity evaluation method and system, electronic device and readable storage medium
abstract_en: An earthquake region intensity evaluation method, an earthquake region intensity evaluation system, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium belong to the technical field of earthquake disaster evaluation, and the method comprises the following steps: expanding the data samples by adding an artificial disturbance method, so that the quantities of the various types of data samples after expansion are equivalent; normalizing the data in the data sample and inputting the normalized data into a width learning network for training; and normalizing the data to be predicted, and inputting the data into the trained width learning network to obtain an intensity prediction result. The invention also discloses an earthquake region intensity evaluation system, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium. Under the conditions of unbalanced data types and insufficient samples, the method provided by the invention expands the data samples in a mode of artificial disturbance, and alleviates the problems of unbalanced data types and insufficient samples. Simulation proves that compared with the traditional model-based method, the intensity prediction accuracy is improved by the evaluation method.

title_en: Intelligent card cutting method and related device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a smart card cutting method and a related device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring position information of the electronic equipment; confirming geo-fence information corresponding to the position of the electronic equipment according to the position information, wherein the geo-fence information is used for indicating the boundary and the range of a building, a park or a community of the position of the electronic equipment; and confirming a target virtual card to be used for executing the data interaction operation according to the geo-fence information. Therefore, through the method provided by the embodiment of the application, the geo-fence is selected through interaction between the user and the electronic equipment, and the map area coordinate is combined to draw the geo-fence area more accurately, so that the intelligent card cutting efficiency and accuracy are improved.

title_en: Loan management system with function of pre-granting credit for line of cigarette sales merchant
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of loan management, and discloses a loan management system with a cigarette sales merchant amount pre-credit granting function. The loan management system with the function of pre-granting credit for the line of a cigarette sales merchant is based on a branch characteristic industry-aid e-loan model and realizes data direct connection with a new business alliance system, the system finishes the comparison work of business enterprise survey data and pushed data according to business requirements after receiving the pushed data of the new business alliance system, completes the verification of the pre-granted credit line of a client according to the pre-granted credit rule set by a bank and pushes the verified result to a president bank, and meanwhile, the system regularly produces reports according to the requirements to realize the function of business account checking.

title_en: Method and system for quantitatively evaluating influence degree of shift work on circadian rhythm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for quantitatively evaluating the influence degree of shift work on circadian rhythm, which comprises the following steps: evaluating the shift indexes, screening the shift indexes based on evaluation results to obtain representative shift indexes, and forming a shift exposure comprehensive evaluation index system, wherein the evaluation results comprise importance scores, familiarity scores and judgment basis scores; constructing a judgment matrix based on the importance scores, and calculating based on the judgment matrix to obtain a combined weight; acquiring original data, and acquiring single shift index exposure level data based on the original data; based on the combination weight and the single shift index exposure level data, the comprehensive exposure level of shift, namely shift index, is obtained.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for processing infrared inspection data of power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for processing infrared inspection data of a power transmission line. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring infrared inspection data of the power transmission line, and determining the data type according to the attribute of the infrared inspection data of the power transmission line; determining whether the infrared inspection data of the power transmission line are valid data or not according to the data type; when the infrared inspection data of the power transmission line are effective data, acquiring a temperature file corresponding to the infrared inspection data of the power transmission line; and determining the defect grade of the infrared inspection data of the power transmission line according to the temperature file. According to the embodiment of the invention, the defect grade of the transmission line infrared inspection data is obtained by processing the transmission line infrared inspection data, so that the processing efficiency of the transmission line infrared inspection data is improved.

title_en: Service processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a service processing method, a device, equipment and a storage medium. The method is applied to workflow technology, and comprises the following steps: receiving a first service processing request input by a user through a target page; the first service processing request comprises an operation request of first service data; the flow node corresponding to the user is a first flow node; the target page is a page developed based on a P2 framework and a micro service; processing the first service data to obtain a first service processing result; the first service processing result comprises processing success or processing failure; if the first service processing result is successful, calling a preset process engine to transfer the first process node to a second process node; the second process node is the next process node of the first process node; the preset process engine is used for circulation among the process nodes. The method improves the development efficiency of the development business related to the workflow.

title_en: Method for calculating influence of overwater photovoltaic on water temperature of underlying closed water area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for calculating the influence of overwater photovoltaics on the water temperature of an underlying closed water area, which comprises the following steps: collecting information; calculating solar short-wave radiation; calculating atmospheric long radiation received by the water surface under the photovoltaic shielding; calculating evaporation scattering; calculating the convection heat flux; calculating the outward long-wave radiant heat flux of the water body; computing t   0  Time of day free surface total heat flux; calculating influence of photovoltaics t   0  → t   1  The water temperature of the water body changes at any moment;computing t   1  The water temperature that is affected by the photovoltaic at all times. According to the method, the influence of the overwater photovoltaic power station on the water temperature change is quantitatively calculated according to local meteorological conditions and photovoltaic array layout parameters to be built aiming at the pile foundation overwater photovoltaic power station in the closed water area through a water body heat balance calculation method and a calculation formula of influence of each flux subentry influence factor on the photovoltaic array, the water temperature and the water temperature change calculated according to the method can be used as a basis for evaluating the influence of the photovoltaic power station on the water environment, and a scientific basis is provided for development and utilization of the water area after the photovoltaic power station is built in the future.

title_en: Method and device for generating bidding document template based on docx type document identification
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for identifying and generating a bidding document template based on a docx type document, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a label file and a basic bidding file template from a specified position; adding and modifying a basic bidding document according to the requirement; reading the processed basic bidding document into a document. Acquiring label data suitable for the bidding document from the label file; the contents of the document.xml file are read, the read contents are replaced by the label data according to a set rule, and a first edition bidding file template is generated; carrying out name matching on the key processing chapters and the filtered set chapters and the sub-templates of the electronic bidding system to obtain the sub-templates larger than the set threshold value for the user to select; and combining the first edition bidding document template with the sub-template to obtain a final edition bidding document template, so that the user can conveniently and rapidly generate the bidding document template, the work complexity is reduced, and the work efficiency is improved.

title_en: Small micro-load electricity right auction method based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small micro-load electricity right auction method based on a block chain, which relates to the technical field of electric power information and is used for solving the problem of lack of a bilateral auction mechanism of electricity right auction at present; after authentication, calculating auction volume quotes according to the auction information, sending the bid volume to a blockchain, clearing, matching and checking the bid volume through an intelligent contract of the blockchain, receiving a checking result of the intelligent contract, and sending the checking result to a buyer client. The invention realizes interaction between the user and the blockchain through the relay device, and realizes automatic electricity right transaction of buying and selling bilateral.

title_en: Method and device for selecting main geological parameters influencing evaluation of block to be surveyed
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and equipment for selecting main geological parameters influencing the evaluation of a block to be surveyed, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring all geological parameters of a block to be surveyed, and classifying all the geological parameters according to a preset rule to obtain a plurality of groups of geological variables of different types; acquiring a plurality of groups of sample data of each geological parameter in a target geological variable of a block to be surveyed, and carrying out standardization processing on all the sample data to obtain the standardized data of each geological parameter in the target geological variable; the target geological variable is any one of a plurality of groups of geological variables of different types; and performing principal component analysis on the standardized data of all the geological parameters in all the target geological variables, and selecting main geological parameters influencing the evaluation of the block to be surveyed from all the geological parameters based on the analysis result. The method can screen out the problem of the main geological parameters of the shale gas resource evaluation in the block.

title_en: Stone arch bridge safety assessment method based on Bayesian analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a stone arch bridge safety assessment method based on Bayesian analysis, which comprises the following steps: determining evaluation parameters related to structural performance, and acquiring data by adopting methods of searching documents and non-invasive measurement; establishing a three-dimensional nonlinear finite element or two-dimensional rigid block limit model based on actual measurement and literature data; extracting parameters most relevant to structural capacity through sensitivity analysis; giving a key parameter probability; combining with a Bayesian basic theory and obtaining a posterior probability distribution function of key parameters by a Monte Carlo sampling method; and carrying out safety evaluation based on reliability theory analysis, and calculating failure probability and reliability indexes. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: by introducing the uncertainty of parameters, the problem of less parameter data caused by the reason of protecting the cultural relics in the evaluation process of the ancient Chinese stone arch bridge structure is solved.

title_en: Dynamic monitoring method and system for submarine cable operating environment
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic monitoring method and a dynamic monitoring system for a submarine cable operating environment, which relate to the technical field of electrical digital data processing, and are characterized in that an interactive signal set is obtained and analyzed to obtain positioning signal information, further an interactive signal optimized position interval and path feedback information are determined, and monitoring signals in the interactive signal set are screened to obtain a screened interactive signal set; the method comprises the steps of acquiring a monitoring image set by image acquisition of an interactive signal optimization position interval, performing cable monitoring evaluation through the monitoring image set and a screening interactive signal set to generate cable state evaluation information, and performing dynamic monitoring management on the submarine cable based on the cable state evaluation information and path feedback information.

title_en: Electromechanical device nonlinear fault prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nonlinear fault prediction method and a system for electromechanical equipment, wherein the nonlinear fault prediction method comprises the following steps: 1: acquiring the equipment attribute of the electromechanical equipment, inputting the equipment attribute into a preset equipment model to establish an initial electromechanical model, and S2: acquiring the real-time working state of the electromechanical device, adjusting the initial model state of the initial electromechanical model to the real-time working state, establishing a prediction electromechanical model, and S3: analyzing and predicting the working trend of the electromechanical model in different real-time working states and after the electromechanical model continuously works for a preset time, and S4: and performing nonlinear fault prediction on the working trend based on a nonlinear prediction model to obtain a fault trend, and acquiring a fault device and a fault position corresponding to the fault trend so as to find a fault in time when the electromechanical equipment works and analyze a fault source, thereby reducing the overhaul work of light workers.

title_en: Method for determining production plan and system for processing steel
abstract_en: The application provides a method for determining a production plan and a system for processing steel products, and relates to the field of materials. The method is executed by a controller, and comprises the steps of obtaining the composition, specification and application of N pieces of transversely cut steel; determining the process flow of the N pieces of steel according to the components, specifications and purposes of the N pieces of steel; determining the posts of each process and the number of people required by the posts of each process in the process flow; acquiring the quantity of steel materials which can be processed in each unit time in the heat treatment process included in the process flow; and determining the time required for the heat treatment process of the N steel materials according to the number of the steel materials in each unit time and the total number N of the steel materials, wherein the production plan of the N steel materials comprises the posts of all the processes included in the process flow, the number of staff required for the posts of all the processes and the time required for the heat treatment process of the N steel materials. According to the method and the system, the advanced technicians are prevented from determining the production plan for multiple times, so that the workload of the advanced technicians can be reduced, and the working cost is reduced.

title_en: Data processing method and device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a data processing method, a data processing device and a storage medium. By acquiring transaction information; then, the transaction object and the transaction platform are used as network nodes, and the network nodes are connected based on transaction information to obtain a heterogeneous network; node migration is carried out in the heterogeneous network to obtain a meta path; carrying out vector representation according to the meta path to obtain a node vector; and classifying the transaction objects based on the distance between the node vectors to obtain the object of the target type. Therefore, the commercial tenant identification process based on artificial intelligence is realized, the distribution of the transaction platform is wide, the coverage of transaction objects is guaranteed, the vector representation involved in the identification process is carried out based on the occurrence of transaction behaviors, the accuracy of vector representation is improved, and the accuracy of object type identification is improved.

title_en: Target account identification method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a target account identification method, a target account identification device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of Internet. The target account identification method comprises the steps of generating a plurality of interaction bipartite graphs according to resource interaction information between each first type account and each second type account, detecting connection density between nodes in the obtained interaction bipartite graphs to obtain detection results corresponding to the nodes, and determining whether an account corresponding to each candidate node is a target account or not according to the total number of the detection results containing the candidate node for each candidate node. According to the resource interaction information between each first type account and each second type account, a plurality of interaction bipartite graphs belonging to heterogeneous networks are generated, and target accounts in the first type accounts and the second type accounts are determined by detecting the interaction bipartite graphs belonging to the heterogeneous networks. By the method, the target account can be rapidly identified, and the identification efficiency of the target account is improved.

title_en: Data prediction method and device for promotion content, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a data prediction method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium of promotion content, wherein target content conversion data of target promotion content and historical content conversion data of historical promotion content are obtained, the target content conversion data comprises converted quantity of the target promotion content for completing content conversion in a current time period, conversion rate analysis processing is conducted on the historical promotion content based on content conversion time information of the historical promotion content to obtain conversion rate distribution information of the historical promotion content in a preset conversion time period, the predicted conversion quantity of the target promotion content for completing content conversion in a future time period is predicted according to the conversion rate distribution information and the converted quantity, and a delivery index of the target promotion content in the target time period is predicted based on the predicted conversion quantity and the converted quantity. The method can improve the prediction accuracy of the future conversion quantity, further more accurately determine the release index, and is beneficial to improving the achievement rate of popularization contents.

title_en: Information interaction method, system, electronic device and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: In the embodiment of the invention, through acquiring the information of a seal and the information of a target task, the seal is used for packaging a target object of the corresponding target task, and the information of the seal and the information of the target task are associated so as to bind the seal and the target task. The binding relationship between the seal and the target task is established, so that the seal is irreplaceable, and therefore the embodiment of the invention can accurately determine whether the target object has an abnormal state in the task processing process based on the information of the seal of the packaged object in the target task, and the safety of the packaged object is improved.

title_en: Charging safety state evaluation method and system based on BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a charging safety state evaluation method and a charging safety state evaluation system based on a BP (back propagation) neural network, wherein power battery safety data are obtained from historical message data; setting an evaluation index SOS of a safety state, establishing a BP neural network, and predicting the SOS according to the BP neural network; performing SOS calculation according to the real-time message data, and performing charging control according to the calculation result; the scheme of the invention combines the advantage that the neural network can process big data with the advantage of a specialist law, provides the safety state index SOS, predicts the safety state SOS of the electric vehicle in charging by using the BP neural network building model, can effectively make different judgments on the safety condition of the power battery pack according to the battery safety state SOS, and effectively improves the safety monitoring efficiency.

title_en: Circuit risk early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electric power, and particularly relates to a line risk early warning method and system. Processing point cloud data of a line area to obtain line point cloud data and plant point cloud data; determining key nodes from the line point cloud data, and determining a warning area according to the key nodes; marking the plant point cloud data in the warning area as risk point cloud data; and processing the risk point cloud data according to the warning rule to output risk early warning information. By processing the point cloud data of the line area, the line point cloud data and the plant point cloud data are identified, and data can be provided for subsequent analysis of the influence of plants on the line; key nodes are determined from the point cloud data of the line, and a warning area is determined according to the key nodes, so that the safety/danger range of the line can be determined; marking the plant point cloud data in the warning area as risk point cloud data; and processing the risk point cloud data according to the warning rule to output risk early warning information, and giving a warning according to specific risk points to reduce safety risks.

title_en: Budget processing method and device based on configurable and caching technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a budget processing method and a budget processing device based on a configurable and caching technology, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s101, judging whether a configuration queue has a configuration instruction or not, and if not, executing a step S103; s102, if yes, taking out the configuration instruction from the configuration queue, and configuring a construction calculation formula of a construction quota of a corresponding target according to the configuration instruction; s103, receiving bidding demand information and data required by cost calculation input by a user; s104, determining a target quotation according to the bidding demand information; s105, determining a cost calculation formula corresponding to the target quotation according to the construction calculation formula of each construction quota corresponding to the target quotation; and S106, replacing each unknown parameter in the cost calculation formula with a corresponding numerical value according to the data required by the cost calculation and the target quotation, and determining the scheme budget of the audio and video acousto-optic system. And a formula configurable mode is adopted, so that the flexibility of cost calculation is improved.

title_en: Method, system and electronic equipment for constructing traceable link of block chain
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a system and electronic equipment for constructing a traceable link of a blockchain, which relate to the technical field of blockchains and comprise the steps of obtaining a link design request of a blocknode for creating a link, wherein the link design request comprises a flow sequence and a plurality of target flows; determining participating block nodes based on the link design request; acquiring a target flow constructed by the participated block nodes; checking and summarizing the target flow, and constructing a traceability link based on the flow sequence; notifying the participating block nodes to vote for a traceable link; based on the voting results of the participating block nodes, the uplink stores and executes personalized traceability links, so that the research and development cost is reduced, and the operation time is saved; and the block chain technology is adopted to realize co-processing sharing of data on the chain and improve the safety of the data.

title_en: Wind power receiving capacity evaluation method and device for receiving-end power grid and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a receiving-end power grid wind power receiving capacity evaluation method, a device and electronic equipment, wherein the method is applied to a receiving-end power grid, and comprises the following steps: establishing an operation optimization model of the receiving-end power grid based on power balance constraint, branch capacity constraint, wind power output constraint and curtailment load constraint and taking the curtailment wind rate of the receiving-end power grid as a target; converting the operation optimization model to obtain a converted operation optimization model with the aim of maximizing the wind power consumption; obtaining a first analytical expression of the wind power consumption with respect to the abandoned load rate and the wind power capacity based on the converted operation optimization model through parameter planning; establishing a functional relation between the curtailment wind rate and the wind power consumption; obtaining a second analytical expression of the wind abandon rate relative to the load abandon rate and the wind capacity based on the functional relation and the first analytical expression; and evaluating the wind power receiving capacity of the receiving end power grid based on the second analytical expression. The wind power receiving capacity of the receiving-end power grid is evaluated through the method and the device.

title_en: Visual optical cable running state monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a visual optical cable running state monitoring method and system, and relates to the technical field of optical cable monitoring. The method comprises the following steps: the monitoring equipment monitors the area paved with the optical cable to obtain first monitoring information, and the first monitoring information is transmitted to a background server; the background server processes the first monitoring information, and identifies an abnormal picture, wherein the abnormal picture is a picture of an optical cable fault area where an optical cable with an abnormal running state is located; the background server performs coordinate positioning on the optical cable with abnormal running state based on the abnormal picture; and the background server remotely controls the multiple cameras to monitor the optical cable fault area to obtain second monitoring information, and the second monitoring information is sent to terminal equipment of maintenance personnel. The method can realize automatic monitoring of the operation state of the optical cable, saves human resources, can discover faults in time, accurately positions the faulty optical cable, and improves the efficiency of fault investigation.

title_en: Single-line full-flow scheduling algorithm for silk production workshop and coding method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coding method for a single-line full-flow production scheduling algorithm of a silk making workshop, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: collecting the night rest time of a workshop, wherein the night rest time is represented by a special symbol; real number coding is adopted to code the processing sequence of the workpieces and the intervals of the workpieces, and special symbols are added in the coding to divide the workpieces processed in different days. The method solves the problem that the night rest time cannot be identified in the single-line full-flow production scheduling algorithm of the conventional tobacco processing workshop, and avoids the arrangement of tobacco shred batches in the rest time range; meanwhile, the encoding can accurately reflect the production scheduling condition of the workshop, and is convenient for decoding the encoding reversely into the production process.

title_en: Method for planning parking path of trailer tractor based on HybridA algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a trailer tractor parking path planning method based on Hybrid A algorithm, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a trailer tractor kinematic model, describing abstract motion states into specific data, then carrying out node updating by taking the trailer tractor kinematic model based on HybridA algorithm, setting a reasonable valuation function to screen an optimal running node, and solving a vehicle parking path conforming to the trailer tractor kinematics. The method can enable the trailer tractor to rapidly plan a parking path which accords with the kinematics of the trailer tractor in any pose, and improves the parking efficiency and accuracy.

title_en: Transaction method and device for digital assets
abstract_en: The application discloses a transaction method and device of digital assets, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: the block chain server side responds to a pre-transaction request sent by a holder side by using a plaintext transaction token of the digital asset, and verifies the tradable state of the digital asset; the holder terminates the clear text transaction token of the digital assets sent from the sender end; sending a pre-transaction request to a blockchain server by using a plaintext transaction token; responding to the block chain server to determine that the digital assets are in a tradable state, and conducting trading of the digital assets with the buyer; the issuer side verifies the validity of the verification information of the digital assets; sending a plaintext transaction token of the digital asset to the holder end, and sending a ciphertext transaction token of the digital asset to the blockchain server end; the purchaser terminal responds to the blockchain server terminal to determine that the digital asset is in a tradable state, and the purchaser terminal carries out the transaction of the digital asset with the holder terminal, and the method realizes the safe transaction of the digital asset.

title_en: Verification method, device and system for real estate mortgage address and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a verification method, a device, a system and a storage medium of a real estate mortgage address, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an information text of the real estate mortgage address, performing address verification on the information text by utilizing a fine-granularity address element analysis model to obtain an address verification result, and confirming a key address element which is missing in the information text according to the address verification result. According to the method, after the information text in the real estate mortgage address is obtained, the information text is subjected to address verification by utilizing the pre-trained fine-granularity address element analysis model, so that the key address elements missing in the information text can be further confirmed according to the address verification result. The method provided by the invention can accurately check whether the key address elements are missing in the mortgage real estate address information text filled in the process of handling the mortgage loan of the real estate of the bank by the client, can meet the requirements of business and supervision, and provides convenience for the mortgage business of the real estate of the bank.

title_en: Business handling method of mobile banking and ATM
abstract_en: The invention discloses a business handling method of a mobile banking and an ATM (automatic teller machine), and relates to the technical field of finance, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when the ATM detects that a first user inserts an SIM card into an SIM card inserting device of the ATM, under the condition that the first user is authorized, the ATM acquires the telephone number of the SIM card and collects first face information of the first user; acquiring identity information of the first user according to the telephone number, and determining second face information reserved by the first user in a bank according to the identity information; when the similarity between the first face information and the second face information is larger than the preset similarity, acquiring an operation page of the first user after logging in the mobile phone bank from a bank background system, and displaying the operation page to the first user; receiving a mobile banking business handling instruction input by a first user according to an operation page; and processing the corresponding mobile banking business for the first user according to the mobile banking business processing instruction. The invention can improve the flexibility of mobile banking business handling.

title_en: Method and system for intelligently analyzing and predicting transformer state of transformer substation
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for intelligently analyzing and predicting the state of a transformer substation, mainly relates to the technical field of transformers of the transformer substation, and is used for solving the problems that an existing mechanism model is not timely and asynchronous, an algorithm model is not accurate enough and the like. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-source data of a transformer pair; determining a calculation running state and a calculation change trend corresponding to multi-source data based on a preset multi-physical field mechanism model and a preset first artificial intelligence model; and determining the final operation state and the final change trend corresponding to the transformer according to the preset second artificial intelligence module, the calculation operation state and the calculation change trend. According to the method, the defects of a single mode are overcome, and high-precision state evaluation, risk identification and situation prediction of component level and equipment level performance of the main transformer under complex working conditions are achieved.

title_en: Power order generation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a power order generation method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of data processing. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring electricity purchasing data of a plurality of electricity purchasing parties and electricity selling data of a plurality of electricity selling parties; correspondingly converting the electricity purchasing matching and sequencing quotations of a plurality of electricity purchasing parties according to the electricity purchasing data of the electricity purchasing parties, and correspondingly converting the electricity selling matching and sequencing quotations of a plurality of electricity selling parties according to the electricity selling data of the electricity selling parties; generating a power purchase matching and sequencing quotation group according to the power purchase matching and sequencing quotations of the plurality of power buyers, and generating a power sale matching and sequencing quotation group according to the power sale matching and sequencing quotations of the plurality of power sellers; and matching a power purchasing party and a power selling party according to the power purchasing matching and sequencing quotation group and the power selling matching and sequencing quotation group to generate a power trading order. The present disclosure can improve the rationality of conducting transactions through power orders.

title_en: College instructor is with student's education information input system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a student education information input system for a college instructor, which comprises an input management module, an authorization module, an information input module and a database module, wherein the input management module manages the operation of other modules of the student education information input system, the login module is used for a user to log in, the authorization module verifies user information and authorizes the user to log in, when the instructor enters an input tutoring interface after obtaining the authority of a school through an upper application unit during initial login, the input tutoring interface and a preview interface are folded and hung on the top of a subsequently used interface, the tutor who is used for the first time can conveniently check tutoring and previewing information at any time, and after the tutoring information is input, the student is authorized to enter the login system and check personal information, after the system is used proficiently, the interface which can be skipped is selected through a custom setting unit, and the unnecessary interface is directly skipped in the subsequent use process, so that the system is simplified and the tutor can conveniently use.

title_en: Deep early warning method, device, equipment and storage medium for blacklist
abstract_en: The invention relates to an artificial intelligence technology, and discloses a blacklist depth early warning method, which comprises the following steps: judging whether the client is contained in the blacklist or not; when the client is included in the blacklist, generating interception reminding information; performing service check on the client according to the interception reminding information; when the checking result has a problem, intercepting; when the checking result has no problem or the client is not included in the blacklist, normally insuring the client; when the number of times of interception of the customer during normal insurance putting is higher than a threshold value, adding the customer into a white list; and constructing a risk scoring model for the client, obtaining a risk scoring grade of the client according to the risk scoring model, adding the client into the blacklist database when the scoring grade is at high risk, and giving an early warning to the blacklist client in the blacklist database. The invention also provides a blacklist depth early warning device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The invention can reduce the risk to the enterprise when the client performs business operation.

title_en: Sharing rental system for motion cameras
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shared rental system of a motion camera, which comprises a camera storage device, a network server, a cloud computing server and a cloud object storage. The camera storage device is a cabinet type device with a plurality of storage grid structures and is provided with a single chip microcomputer controller, a network communication module, a human-computer interaction terminal and the like. And a camera NFC induction coil, a camera accessory NFC induction coil and a data interface structure are arranged in the storage grid. The motion camera is provided with a camera NFC chip and the camera accessory is provided with an accessory NFC chip. The induction coil, the data interface structure and the electronic lock are all connected with the single chip microcomputer controller. The single chip microcomputer controller, the network communication module and the network server form a servo background system, and are connected and controlled by a user leasing service system of the cloud computing server. The cloud object storage is controlled by the file self-service transmission service system connection. The renting system is technically provided, which takes a mobile phone as a terminal and an internet as a support, and is used for self-service access of the motion camera and shared use.

title_en: Power distribution network flexibility assessment and resource allocation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network flexibility evaluation and resource allocation method and system, which are characterized in that characteristics presented under different time scales are considered in the operation process of a power distribution network, a corresponding operation scene set is obtained by respectively solving a specific uncertainty method, then respective flexible capacity models are built by comprehensively considering multi-type flexible resources such as a micro gas turbine, an energy storage device and a demand response load, finally a flexible resource optimization allocation method combining planning and operation is designed, decoupling and information transmission of a planning layer and an operation layer are realized by adopting a target cascading method, and multi-type flexible resource allocation is realized under the condition that flexible supply and demand balance is met through repeated iteration.

title_en: Supply logistics management method, device, equipment and medium for production enterprise
abstract_en: The invention discloses a supply logistics management method, a device, equipment and a medium for a production enterprise, wherein the method adopts a sectional type goods taking method and carries out sectional processing on a transportation order according to each logistics transportation road section; calculating the latest departure time and the latest arrival time corresponding to each segmented order, and generating a logistics transportation plan according to a goods taking mode set by a logistics transportation route; and determining a trusting relation between the primary container and the secondary container for loading the production materials based on the logistics transportation plan, the loading capacity of the transportation vehicle and preset constraint conditions, and performing trusting planning and loading planning on the secondary container according to a preset trusting strategy and a loading strategy, thereby determining a secondary container loading plan corresponding to each train number and completing supply logistics management of the production materials. The invention can ensure that the transportation route of the production materials is the optimal transportation route, and can obviously improve the loading rate of the transportation vehicles, thereby improving the logistics transportation efficiency of the production materials.

title_en: Multifunctional user device
abstract_en: A method includes a data processing computer receiving an authorization request message from a network processing computer including a user device identifier, add method data, and an amount of interaction. The network processing computer determines the user device identifier from a token associated with a first interaction type of a plurality of interaction types associated with a plurality of tokens. The data processing computer may then determine whether the user device identifier matches a stored user device identifier. The data processing computer may further process the interaction using the user device identifier and the add-method data if the user device identifier matches the stored user device identifier.

title_en: Adjustable potential evaluation and demand response scheduling method for high-energy-carrying industrial load
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-energy-carrying industrial load adjustable potential evaluation and demand response scheduling method, and relates to the technical field of industrial internet. Firstly, constructing a high-energy-consumption magnesium oxide industrial internet system, and clustering high-energy-consumption load and commercial load data in the high-energy-consumption magnesium oxide industrial internet system; respectively calculating the load regulation rate and the load fluctuation rate of different clusters, and further evaluating the adjustable potential of the industrial load in the high-energy-consumption magnesium oxide industrial internet system; dividing the electricity utilization time interval into peak, flat and Gu Shiduan; establishing a segmented demand response load model according to the load transfer rate of each power utilization transition period, and determining the load power transferred or reduced in a certain power utilization period; establishing an optimized scheduling model of the demand response participated by the high-energy-consumption magnesium oxide industrial Internet; and finally, solving the optimal scheduling model of the demand response to obtain an optimal demand response scheduling scheme.

title_en: Intelligent production management system, method and storage medium thereof
abstract_en: The system comprises a WMS storage module, a WMS storage module and a WMS storage module, wherein the WMS storage module is used for acquiring information of newly purchased articles, performing RFID (radio frequency identification) marking on the articles to generate article information, and generating tracking data in real time after the article information is subjected to warehousing processing, ex-warehouse processing or inventory processing according to a preset tracking algorithm; the ERP management module is used for acquiring the article information and the tracking data, and calculating the tracking data and the article information by using a preset flow algorithm to generate flow data; the SAS analysis module is used for acquiring the flow data and calculating instant cost data according to a preset cost algorithm through the flow data and the article information; calculating efficiency analysis data by using preset time data and instant cost data according to a preset analysis algorithm; the instant cost data and the flow rate data of the same type of articles and unit price in the article information form positive correlation setting; the method and the system can improve the flow efficiency of the process between the management systems of different departments.

title_en: VR virtual reality-based intelligent driving training system and method for deaf-mute
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of driving simulation control, and discloses a deaf-mute intelligent driving training system and method based on VR virtual reality, which comprises a construction module, a virtual reality simulation module and a virtual reality simulation module, wherein the construction module is used for constructing a corresponding VR vehicle model and a VR scene model according to the identity information of a target person; the training module is used for performing driving training on the target person by utilizing the VR vehicle model and the VR scene model and acquiring training data in real time in the training process; the human-computer interaction module is used for realizing an interaction function with a target person in the training process; and the evaluation module is used for evaluating the training data to determine the qualification rate and the error operation of the target personnel and performing error guidance. Direct, vivid, visual, intelligent and safe driving training courses can be provided by constructing a VR model to drive and train deaf-mute people, the training quality and efficiency are improved, the training cost is reduced, the problem that the deaf-mute people and coaches are difficult to communicate is avoided, the practicability is improved, the risk is reduced, and the safety is improved.

title_en: Intelligent examination method and device for contract
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for intelligently examining contracts, wherein the method comprises the following steps: extracting at least one contract element according to a plurality of original contract texts of different types in the contract database to obtain a contract element library; determining at least one contract examination rule according to a plurality of original contract texts of different types in the contract database to obtain a contract examination rule base, wherein all the contract examination rules in the contract examination rule base are classified; constructing a contract examination model according to the contract element library and the contract examination rule library; and examining the target contract through the contract examination model to obtain an examination result, wherein the target contract is any contract to be examined. Therefore, the method and the device can quickly perform the contract examination, improve the efficiency of the contract examination, and simultaneously have higher false detection rate of the contract examination, thereby improving the examination effect of the contract.

title_en: Regional traffic flow prediction method and device for strip mine, storage medium, and electronic device
abstract_en: The application discloses a regional vehicle flow prediction method and device, a storage medium and an electronic device for an open pit mine, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining vehicle data information and real-time external factor data information in the open pit mine; obtaining a regional traffic flow result after semantic feature fusion through a pre-trained traffic flow prediction model, wherein the traffic flow prediction model is obtained by using multiple groups of data through machine learning training, and each group of data in the multiple groups of data comprises: regional traffic flow data and standardized external factor data information corresponding to the regional traffic flow data; and predicting the regional vehicle flow of the strip mine at a specified time step in the future according to the regional vehicle flow result. The method and the device realize accurate and rapid prediction of the traffic flow of the open pit area.

title_en: Method, device and equipment for recording business process and displaying business process
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a method, a device and equipment for recording and displaying a business process, and is applied to the technical field of network security. The method comprises the following steps: after receiving a service triggering instruction corresponding to a target service, displaying an operation interface corresponding to the target service so that a user executes the target service based on the operation interface; performing screen recording on a target service execution flow displayed on the operation interface to obtain a service flow video; and sending the business process video to a storage device for storage. The method can effectively record the execution process of the business, and can effectively analyze the business execution process based on the recorded business execution flow when the investigation is needed, so that the corresponding risk can be effectively investigated, the data safety of the user is ensured, and the use experience of the user is improved.

title_en: Method for intelligently and hierarchically displaying content of official document in heterogeneous CPU system
abstract_en: The technical problem to be solved by the invention is as follows: under different CPU system architectures, different browsers have differences in displaying the content of the official documents in the web pages and the office plug-ins. In order to solve the technical problems, the technical scheme of the invention is to provide a method for intelligently and hierarchically displaying the content of the official document in a heterogeneous CPU system. The method provided by the invention solves the problem of realizing intelligent hierarchical display of the official document content under a heterogeneous CPU system, is beneficial to the migration of the office information system to various CPU systems, is beneficial to solving the composite problem of content hierarchical display and webpage compatibility, is beneficial to reducing the workload and difficulty of customized development, and is beneficial to the change and maintenance of the office information system. The method provided by the invention can be used for automatically grading and monitoring the document content in real time by using the artificial intelligent grading system on the premise of not increasing the complexity of the webpage, uniformly processing the display format and the display content, and is suitable for various CPU system environments and browsers.

title_en: Data request message verification method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a data request message verification method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of data processing and are used for receiving a first data request message, wherein the first data request message comprises a first terminal equipment identifier and key data information, generating sequence data information according to the first terminal equipment identifier and the key data information, establishing a mapping relation between the sequence data information and the key data information to obtain storage data information, receiving a second data request message, and verifying the second data request message according to the second data request message and the storage data information. By adopting the technical scheme, the data security in the short message verification process can be fully ensured, further the data is prevented from being tampered, and finally the consistency of the data content of the short message and the content submitted by the user is ensured.

title_en: Unattended material receiving and selling system of concrete mixing plant and working method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unattended material receiving and selling system of a concrete mixing station and a working method thereof, belonging to the technical field of material receiving and selling of the concrete mixing station; the system comprises a registration module, a transport vehicle identification module, a weighing module, an intelligent warehouse selection module, a production organization module and a receiving and sending auditing module, and the method comprises the steps of registration, entry of a transport vehicle, first weighing of the transport vehicle, receiving and selling materials, receiving and sending auditing, second weighing of the transport vehicle, weighing, document printing and leaving; the unattended receiving and selling business support of the concrete mixing plant is realized; the business of entering and leaving the factory is automatically controlled by the system, thus ensuring the business fairness and the execution efficiency; marks are left in the whole process of entering and leaving the field weighing process, and the traceability of the system is ensured through the modes of snapping pictures and recording; the vehicle operation is guided in time through the forms of voice, LED screen playing, weChat message and the like, and the use experience of a user is improved through humanized guidance; the system realizes multi-wagon balance data sharing and multi-person cooperative work.

title_en: Realization method for unitization of financial system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a realization method of financial system unitization, which comprises the following steps: dividing the financial system into a plurality of units, wherein each unit has a unique identifier; storing all detailed data of the same client into the same unit; if a new client is added, storing all detailed data of the new client into the most idle unit in all units; establishing a mapping routing table according to the condition that all detailed data of the client is stored in each unit; performing unitization processing of online transaction, receiving a client request, inquiring a mapping routing table to obtain a unit corresponding to a client, and sending the client request to the corresponding unit for processing; and performing batch processing unitization, sending all files to be processed to each unit, processing the files of the clients with all detailed data in the unit only by each unit, and generating and combining unit result files. The invention ensures that the financial system gradually tends to load balance to the maximum extent and improves the system performance.

title_en: Text analysis-based intelligent question-answering system for power grid planning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a text analysis-based intelligent question-answering system for power grid planning, which comprises an application layer, a supporting layer, a knowledge layer and a data layer, wherein the knowledge layer is provided with a text analysis module, and a text analysis module special for analyzing text information is arranged. Firstly, the magnetic characteristics of each power grid industry term are marked by establishing an industry term library, the accuracy of analyzing the professional knowledge of the power grid planning by the system is improved, secondly, the knowledge information elements are associated through structural information, so that the whole text information forms a net-shaped topological structure, the association between the text information can be analyzed according to the net-shaped topological structure, and a new association relation is generated, so that the knowledge map has accuracy, and the answer information errors caused by the failure of part terms, time coverage and different priorities of the text information are avoided.

title_en: Intelligent security communication system for home-school combined communication
