abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent security communication system for home-school combined communication, which relates to the field of intelligent security communication and is used for solving the problems that effective certificates are provided in communication to confirm the current problems of students, and the two parties are ensured to confirm key points of the problems in home-school combined communication.

title_en: Intelligent decoration engineering design management system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of decoration, relates to a data analysis technology, and aims to solve the problem that the selection efficiency of a design template is low because the conventional decoration engineering design management system cannot analyze the hobbies of customers, in particular to an intelligent decoration engineering design management system based on big data, which comprises an engineering management platform, wherein the engineering management platform is in communication connection with a style analysis module, a distribution management module, a progress management module, a design monitoring module and a storage module, and the style analysis module is used for performing demand analysis on the decoration style of the customers: and the customer selects style labels through a style analysis module: the method comprises the steps of calling an overall decoration scheme which simultaneously contains L2 intention labels from a storage module and marking the overall decoration scheme as a marking scheme; the invention can analyze the style preference of the customer, the preselection scheme can meet the initial style selection of the customer, and meanwhile, the habit matching is carried out by combining various parameters of the customer.

title_en: Target distribution service determination method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for determining target distribution service, and belongs to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the following steps: determining a plurality of delivery services of the target order, wherein the plurality of delivery services are different delivery services signed by a resource receiving party of the target order; acquiring service images of a plurality of delivery services, wherein the service images represent service configuration and service quality of the delivery services, and the service quality represents the quality of delivery capacity completion orders corresponding to the delivery services; acquiring selection conditions of the target order, wherein the selection conditions represent the distribution requirements of the target order; and determining a target delivery service of the target order from the plurality of delivery services according to the selection condition and the service images of the plurality of delivery services. The scheme can help the resource receiver to select the proper delivery service, ensures the delivery effect of the target order and reduces the operation of the resource receiver.

title_en: Order processing method, device, storage medium and equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an order processing method, an order processing device, a storage medium and equipment, wherein in the method, the score of each order in an order grabbing pool is determined by taking the time length of the order entering the order grabbing pool and the reward of the order as scoring indexes, when a target client side successfully grabs the order, the order to be grazed is sequenced according to the score of the order to be grazed in the order grabbing pool and the correlation degree between the order to be grazed and the order to be grazed, and then the target order is screened out based on the sequencing result and recommended to the target client side. Therefore, the service personnel can quickly select the order suitable for the service personnel, the time cost of the service personnel is effectively saved, meanwhile, some orders which are not easy to notice can be digested, and the customer satisfaction is improved.

title_en: Novel carbon trading method, device and platform based on automatic market makers
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel carbon trading method, a novel carbon trading device and a novel carbon trading platform based on automatic market makers, and belongs to the technical field of carbon trading. The novel carbon trading method based on the automatic market makers comprises the steps of constructing a block chain carbon trading model and an automatic market maker model, and encrypting carbon trading data by using a public key to obtain carbon trading encrypted data; acquiring a private key carried by a user transaction demand, and decrypting the carbon transaction encrypted data according to the private key to obtain carbon transaction demand data; the carbon transaction demand data is processed to complete the carbon transaction, the liquidity can be improved from the transaction angle, the liquidity problem caused by the defects of a centralized transaction mode is radically improved, the direct exchange of the currency and the carbon currency can be realized, the mutual waiting of both parties of the transaction is not needed, the rapid completion of a transaction order is facilitated, and the liquidity of the carbon transaction is enhanced.

title_en: Commodity label marking method and device, equipment and medium thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to a commodity label marking method, a device, equipment and a medium thereof in the technical field of computers, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining text information of a target commodity, wherein the text information comprises description information of the commodity; the method comprises the steps of extracting deep semantic information of text information by a multi-language encoder of a text classification model to obtain corresponding coding feature vectors, wherein the multi-language encoder is suitable for representing the text information obtained by describing the same meaning in different languages as the coding feature vectors of the same semantic space, and carrying out classification mapping by a classifier of the text classification model according to the coding feature vectors to obtain corresponding commodity labels. The text classification model is simple and convenient to prepare, does not need to introduce a large amount of manual labeling cost, is efficient in training, and can ensure the accuracy of the text classification model.

title_en: Investment portfolio analysis method and device based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses an investment portfolio analysis method and device based on a knowledge graph, which can be used in the field of finance, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring internal knowledge graph data of an enterprise and external knowledge graph data of the enterprise; generating an investment portfolio enterprise map according to the enterprise internal knowledge map data and the enterprise external knowledge map data; establishing a first map model according to the investment portfolio enterprise map and a pre-established first enterprise relation table; determining a root node and corresponding child node information according to the first graph model; establishing a second map model according to the root node, the corresponding child node information and a pre-established second enterprise relation table; and analyzing the investment portfolio by using a concentration algorithm according to the second map model. The invention can analyze investment portfolio based on knowledge graph, to analyze the influence of enterprise activities on enterprise and the influence and risk of investor.

title_en: Distribution transformer load rate correction prediction method based on heavy overload probability statistics and similar days
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of load prediction, and particularly relates to a distribution transformer load rate correction prediction method based on heavy overload probability statistics and similar days. According to the method, the time points with the heavy overload possibility are obtained by counting the probability of the heavy overload of the load rate at each time point in the near term, the time points with the heavy overload possibility are concentrated and corrected, and the correction efficiency is improved; in consideration of the influence of short-term external factors on the load rate peak value, the load rate similar day of the prediction day is found by means of the load rate curve of the previous day and the similar day of the prediction day, and then the initial predicted load rate curve is corrected at the moment when the overload probability exists according to the load rate peak value heights of the previous day and the similar day of the prediction day, so that the prediction accuracy of the overload part is improved, and the problem of overload missing judgment is solved.

title_en: Cross-platform information management method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The present application relates to the field of big data e-commerce technologies, and in particular, to a cross-platform information management method, apparatus, computer device, and storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring order settlement data sent by an e-commerce platform, wherein the order settlement data at least comprises a settlement order table; acquiring a transfer order form generated by an e-commerce platform according to a preset first time period, and comparing the transfer order form with a settlement order form to acquire an account checking success form; generating a commission transaction summary table corresponding to the reconciliation success table based on a preset external commission rule, and posting external commission to a virtual account of the information management platform based on the commission transaction summary table; and acquiring a project table corresponding to the channel platform, respectively paying out the guest pushing commission to the channel platform, and paying out the platform commission to the information management platform. By adopting the method, the efficiency of operation management can be improved, and the operation management cost can be reduced.

title_en: Payment method, payment device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a payment method, an apparatus, an electronic device, and a storage medium, which can be applied to the technical field of data processing, the financial field, or other fields. The method comprises the following steps: according to the head posture of the target object, determining the watching operation of the target object on the adjustable display component; acquiring vision information of a target object, and adjusting display parameters of an adjustable display component according to comprehensive parameters, wherein the vision information comprises naked eye vision information or glasses degree information, and the comprehensive parameters are obtained according to at least one of the vision information and operation details of watching operation; determining preset eyeball identification information of the target object according to input information of the target object, wherein the input information is a watching operation executed by the target object based on the content displayed by the display parameters; acquiring current eyeball identification information of a target object, and comparing the current eyeball identification information with preset eyeball identification information to generate a comparison result; and executing payment operation according to the received payment information and the comparison result.

title_en: Method and device for coordinating resources
abstract_en: According to embodiments of the present disclosure, a method, an apparatus, an electronic device, a computer storage medium, and a computer program product for resource coordination are provided. The method described herein comprises: constructing a graph structure based on historical service demands of a plurality of geographic areas in at least one historical time period, wherein the graph structure comprises at least one layer, the at least one layer corresponds to each time period in the at least one time period respectively, each layer in the at least one layer has the same nodes and edge connections in the layer, the nodes are used for representing the corresponding areas, and the edge connections are used for representing the correlation among different areas; and determining the service requirement of the target area in the target time period based on the graph structure so as to coordinate the traffic resource. Based on the above manner, the embodiment of the disclosure can consider the space-time correlation between regions to more accurately realize the coordination of the traffic resources for a specific area.

title_en: Urban traffic flow prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic prediction, in particular to a method for predicting urban traffic flow, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting real-time data and then preprocessing the collected data; constructing a prediction model, inputting the preprocessed data, and processing the data to form a preliminary prediction model; repeatedly training the prediction model by using a training set, calculating a prediction error through an error function, correspondingly updating the weight coefficient to an optimal value, and further updating to obtain an optimal prediction model; according to the invention, the accuracy of traffic flow prediction can be effectively improved through the fusion of the Informer model and the LightGBM model.

title_en: Data processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: An embodiment of the application provides a data processing method, a data processing device, a data processing apparatus and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring data to be summarized, and determining a first data object type of the data to be summarized; traversing a predetermined total object type attribute array based on the first data object type to obtain a first object type attribute array corresponding to the data to be summarized; and acquiring a first summary list of the data to be summarized from the first object type attribute array. The method aims to realize the universality of data summarization so as to improve the data summarization efficiency.

title_en: Intelligent law query method based on multi-round pruning Skyline algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent legal inquiry method based on a multi-round pruning Skyline algorithm, which comprises the following steps: local equipment of a legal department acquires a local legal case according to a query command issued by the central server; and uploading the obtained local legal cases to a central server in an encrypted form, and performing integration analysis by the central server to obtain the legal cases with higher comprehensive document similarity and sending the legal cases to local equipment. And the scheduling strategy module of the central server obtains the physical nodes of the local legal department or corresponding priority information of the legal department according to the attributes of the name, the sex, the native place, the address, the case name, the case solving event, the capturing event, the case reporting event and the like in the legal case. The invention can prevent legal information searching personnel from reading a large number of cases, save a large amount of time, manpower and material resources, and particularly provide technical guarantee for solving cases, searching similar cases, solving clues and concluding crime trends.

title_en: File accuracy detection method based on front-end electricity utilization service change
abstract_en: The application relates to a file accuracy detection method based on front-end electricity utilization service change, and relates to the technical field of electricity utilization management. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a standard library of change certificates and a file checking rule library; acquiring an initial file and a real-time file of a target user; detecting the initial file by changing the certificate standard library, implanting a file checking rule in the service change process to obtain a file accuracy detection result, wherein the file accuracy detection result is used for indicating the accuracy of the initial file; generating archive modification information based on the archive accuracy detection result. The technical scheme realizes the forward movement of the integrity and effectiveness detection of the files, changes the original after-detection into before-detection, and improves the working efficiency.

title_en: Smart community construction method based on garbage classification recycling service
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing an intelligent community based on garbage classification recycling service, which comprises the following steps: s1, customizing a community service program and a management program, and respectively logging in and registering residents and managers; s2, intelligent garbage sites are distributed according to community regional data, and a visual display map is constructed; s3, residents use the community service program to carry out garbage bag purchasing and garbage classification service; s4, the intelligent garbage station monitors resident behavior data and collects station data; s5, the administrator classifies and recovers the garbage according to the station data and records recovery time; and S6, identifying and detecting different types of garbage by the garbage collection station. According to the intelligent service and management system, the intelligent service and management system associated with the residential side, the management side and the intelligent garbage site is constructed, so that a residential user can be helped to quickly and accurately know garbage classification recycling knowledge and intelligent community service modes by means of on-line consultation, learning and the like.

title_en: Transportation dynamic monitoring and early warning system based on data analysis technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transportation dynamic monitoring and early warning system based on a data analysis technology, and belongs to the technical field of data analysis and processing. Intelligently planning a transportation route through a Beidou satellite navigation module; collecting the perception information data of the transportation route, constructing a driving time prediction model and calculating a first transportation risk value; constructing a loading and unloading time prediction model based on the loading capacity of the tank truck and loading and unloading time corresponding to different loading capacities; calculating a second transportation risk value according to the driving time and loading and unloading time prediction model; obtaining a comprehensive transportation risk value according to the first transportation risk value and the second transportation risk value; generating a plurality of transportation routes according to the comprehensive transportation risk value; the transport process is dynamically monitored in real time, early warning information is output, the transport route is changed in time, risks in the transport process are avoided, meanwhile, real-time dynamic monitoring can be carried out on the risks, and the transport task can be safely completed in time.

title_en: Automatic processing method and system for PCB engineering order
abstract_en: The application discloses a PCB engineering order automatic processing method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the order type as an internal order according to the order information of the order; calculating the impedance of a customer product, simulating the parameter information of a PCB corresponding to the customer product, converting and designing an impedance design manuscript, calculating the virtual waiting time of each order, and sequencing the processing of the orders according to the order of the virtual waiting time from short to long; determining a difficulty coefficient of the order according to factors related to CAM data processing difficulty of the order, and determining the grade of a processing person of the order according to the difficulty coefficient, wherein internal order taking is successful; and finishing CAM manuscript conversion design by the determined processing personnel according to the processing sequence of the orders, and finishing automatic ordering and processing of PCB engineering. The application realizes the integration of order pool, outsourcing, CAM and QE, and realizes the one-key dispatch of engineering clerks, thereby realizing accurate ranking Cheng Gaoxiao.

title_en: Digital design checking system and method based on structuring rules
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital design checking system and method based on a structural rule, which belong to the technical field of three-dimensional digital design, wherein the system comprises a checking key point knowledge base, a three-dimensional engine, a flow engine and a user interaction interface, the method comprises the steps of S1, analyzing design standards, disassembling the design standards into checking key points capable of checking one by one, inputting the checking key point knowledge base, S2, aiming at a certain professional to-be-checked result, automatically matching a checking key point list through a predefined template, S3, completing checking by a computer program automatically or through man-machine interaction according to the checking key point list, and S4, returning design modification according to the checking result or sending the checking result to a next-stage checking person. According to the invention, regulatable texts in the design standard are disassembled to construct the structured checking rules, and part of digital design checking work is automatically or assisted by a computer, so that the workload of checking staff is reduced, and the efficiency and accuracy of digital design checking are improved.

title_en: Thermal power archive informatization management system with high archive availability
abstract_en: This scheme discloses archives high availability's thermoelectricity archives information-based management system, include system server and install the APP at mobile terminal department, system server is connected with the database that is used for saving thermoelectricity archives, thermoelectricity archives includes the archives information of equipment, the archives information of each equipment is relevant with the KKS code of corresponding equipment in the database, when the user uses APP scanning field device's KKS code, the APP uploads to system server with the KKS code that the scanning obtained, system server acquires the archives information of corresponding equipment and sends to the APP in the database according to received KKS code. The system utilizes a two-dimensional code scanning technology, a scanned object is changed into a KKS code, the field device and the file information are quickly associated, the device has a code, the code can be associated with a file, and the file content can be read by scanning the code.

title_en: Flat grain height calculating method, control device, storage medium and flat grain system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flat grain height calculating method, a control device, a storage medium and a flat grain system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining unit images of a plurality of calibration areas, transversely splicing the unit images to form a plurality of strip-shaped images, obtaining a plurality of template depth matrixes, obtaining a combined depth matrix of corresponding combined images according to the depth matrixes of each template, finally obtaining transverse depth matrixes of the plurality of strip-shaped images, longitudinally and sequentially splicing the transverse depth matrixes according to the position of a coincident boundary to obtain an integral depth matrix, obtaining the space volume between the plane of a grain leveling device and the top surface of grains in a grain bin according to the integral depth matrix, and calculating according to the space volume and the plane area of the grain bin to obtain the grain leveling height. The pictures are spliced in a mode of matching with image synthesis to be synthesized into an integral depth matrix, the space volume is calculated through the integral depth matrix to further obtain the height of the flat grain, the accurate depth of the flat grain can be directly obtained according to the method, and the efficiency of the flat grain is improved.

title_en: Same-city electronic bill synchronization system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a same-city electronic bill synchronization system, which comprises: the shared data storage and management module is used for classifying the bills to be stored to form a first identification bill set and a second identification bill set and managing the time of the bills according to the time of the bills to be stored; the bill input and recommendation module is used for extracting and identifying key phrases based on input single bill information and extracting from a first identification bill set and a second identification bill set according to extraction information to form a similar bill set; and the user verification module inputs endorsement information based on the similar bill collection to perform data screening. The on-city electronic bill synchronization system provided by the invention realizes synchronization of similar bills and order form, reduces the number of times of identifying bills by a single customer and the speed of hanging the bill, improves the integrity of order form information, reduces the time of hanging the bill by the customer, can improve the integrity of the order form information and increases the bill transaction probability.

title_en: Method and device for identifying distance between fault point and power supply point and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a storage medium for identifying the distance between a fault point and a power supply point, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a fault equipment node with a fault in the power system, and acquiring a fault node identifier of the fault equipment node; determining continuous L-level intermediate device nodes between the fault device node and a power supply point based on the fault node identification and a pre-established first network topological structure, wherein L is a natural number more than 1, and the first network topological structure represents a first connection relation between the node identifications of the device nodes in the power system; determining a total length of the L-level intermediate device nodes based on the continuous L-level intermediate device nodes and a pre-established length database; and determining the distance between the fault equipment node and a power supply point according to the total length of the L-level intermediate equipment nodes. Therefore, the method and the device can improve the acquisition efficiency and convenience of the distance from the position of the fault point to the power supply point.

title_en: Project comprehensive benefit analysis method based on resource planning
abstract_en: The invention provides a project comprehensive benefit analysis method based on resource planning, which is used for specifically acquiring project construction content, acquiring a project knowledge graph according to the project construction content, performing project necessity analysis and determining an invalid project; performing project repeated construction analysis based on the project position distribution diagram to obtain repeated construction contents in the project construction contents; constructing an incidence relation among the project data, determining the influence of the project time sequence abnormality on the equipment power failure based on the incidence relation among the project data, and performing project time sequence optimization analysis according to the influence of the project time sequence abnormality on the equipment power failure; and calculating resource consumption and project income for eliminating invalid projects, canceling repeated construction contents and project time sequence optimization and visual economic benefits of the project income in resource planning, and acquiring a project comprehensive benefit analysis result. The method and the system can consider the optimization content in the project construction process, so that the accuracy of the comprehensive benefit analysis result of the project is improved.

title_en: Intelligent logistics system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an intelligent logistics system based on edge calculation, and relates to the technical field of image recognition. The system comprises at least one monitoring camera, an edge computing module and an alarm module, wherein the monitoring camera is used for collecting images in a whole object logistics warehouse, the edge computing module is arranged in the monitoring camera and used for identifying whether any pre-specified abnormal condition exists in the images in the object logistics warehouse through a preset AI image identification algorithm, and the alarm module is connected with the edge computing module in a network mode and used for sending alarm information when the edge computing module identifies that the abnormal condition exists in the images in the object logistics warehouse. The invention can intelligently and automatically identify the abnormal condition in the image in the logistics warehouse and give an alarm in time, thereby effectively saving the labor cost and improving the monitoring effect.

title_en: Intelligent dispatching system for shipping electrolytic copper products
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent dispatching system for shipping electrolytic copper products, and particularly relates to the technical field of dispatching systems, wherein the intelligent dispatching system comprises the following modules: a recording module; the logging module is a working module which uses various data for docking and logging processing. According to the invention, through mutual cooperation among multiple modules, not only can actual numerical value comparison work be carried out through a comparison module, so that a corresponding comparison result is obtained, corresponding past data comparison and difference value calculation processing are carried out by taking the comparison result as reference, so that a final scheduling result is obtained, and the determination result is conveyed to a scheduling port through self-determination processing, so that the technical problem that if the internal data volume is small or the output data volume is not easy to extract and overview is avoided, the scheduling function is difficult to play, and the whole process of easy dragging and slow delivery and scheduling work caused by the lack of the comparison result with small data volume is avoided, so that the technical problem of working efficiency in actual delivery and scheduling processing is reduced.

title_en: Equipment operation management method, system and medium based on equipment health degree
abstract_en: The application discloses a device operation management method, a device operation management system and a device operation management medium based on device health, and belongs to the technical field of data processing methods based on management purposes. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a health evaluation model; collecting operation values corresponding to a plurality of operation state parameters in real time, and respectively calculating the maintenance feature health degree corresponding to the maintenance piece and the key feature health degree corresponding to the related weight piece according to the operation values, the critical range and the preset value through a health degree evaluation model; determining the equipment health degree corresponding to the equipment according to the maintenance feature health degree and the key feature health degree; determining a health degree grade matched with the health degree of the equipment, and determining whether the running state corresponding to the equipment is healthy or not according to the health degree grade; under the condition that the running state is unhealthy, correspondingly determining an attenuation interval where the maintenance piece and the weight closing piece are located according to the maintenance feature health degree and the key feature health degree, so as to adopt a corresponding management strategy for the maintenance piece or the weight closing piece according to the attenuation interval.

title_en: Prediction method for pile foundation lateral displacement of high pile wharf
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high pile wharf pile foundation lateral displacement prediction method which comprises the steps of obtaining a high pile wharf pile foundation lateral displacement deep learning sample set, establishing a high pile wharf pile foundation lateral displacement deep learning prediction model, training the prediction model by adopting the deep learning sample set to obtain an optimized trained high pile wharf pile foundation lateral displacement deep learning prediction model, and inputting real-time acquired high pile wharf pile actual measurement data into the optimized trained high pile wharf pile foundation lateral displacement deep learning prediction model to obtain a model output prediction result. According to the invention, through mixing and correcting of the actual measurement data set and the finite element simulation data set of the lateral displacement of the pile foundation of the high pile wharf, abundant sample data are provided for establishing a deep learning prediction model of the lateral displacement of the pile foundation of the high pile wharf, and the accuracy and reliability of the lateral displacement prediction are ensured.

title_en: Data processing method for multiple types of data sources
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to a data processing method of a plurality of types of data sources, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a first vehicle coordinate, a first road scene and a plurality of types of data sources at any time; converting position coordinates of the multiple data sources according to the first vehicle coordinates and the first road scene; taking the earliest data time in the multi-class data sources as an initial time point, and performing time axis segmentation on a time period from the initial time point to the current time according to data frequency f to obtain a first time axis; performing data integration on the multiple types of data sources based on the time scale of the first time axis; correcting the speed type data in the first integrated data sequence; identifying mask data sequences of various data sources; and outputting the first integrated data sequence and the multi-class mask data sequence. The invention provides a solution for integrally preprocessing various data sources.

title_en: Intelligent object identifying platform, method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The utility model provides an intelligent object recognizing platform, method, system and storage medium, which can judge the specific type information of the material by analyzing the image and weighing the material to be recognized. Through the technical scheme that the utility model provides, can realize the automatic accurate discernment to treating the claiming and/or treating the material of depositing, gravity induction data and the image shooting data of treating the discernment material are utilized in the discernment in-process in step, and set for different matching coefficients according to the material type of difference, make and to shoot data and acquire accurate material parameter information based on gravity induction data and image, it can have accurate cognition to the material information of getting and sending to be convenient for get and send the material personnel, effectively avoided getting and sending confusion between the material personnel to approximate material, personnel's accuracy and convenience of getting and sending the material have been promoted, have application and spreading value of preferred in application fields such as unmanned supervision warehouse.

title_en: Water resource shortage risk prediction method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a water resource shortage risk prediction method and device and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of water conservancy. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a historical runoff sequence of a target river basin, determining a threshold runoff quantity according to the historical runoff sequence, determining a probability distribution function by fitting a generalized additivity GAMLSS model to the historical runoff sequence, and determining a first calculation result according to the probability distribution function, wherein the first calculation result represents a predicted value from the beginning of calculation of years to the year of which the runoff quantity is lower than the threshold runoff quantity for the first time. The embodiment of the invention can predict and obtain the year predicted value of the water resource shortage, thereby improving the evaluation effect on the risk of the water resource shortage.

title_en: Digital twin drainage basin scene modeling method based on water circulation dynamic knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-basin scene modeling method based on a hydrologic cycle dynamic knowledge graph, which comprises the following steps of constructing the hydrologic cycle dynamic knowledge graph based on hydrologic cycle remote sensing inversion data in a basin and ground station monitoring data, constructing a multiscale nested digital twin framework of basin-sub-basin-aggregation unit-minimum granularity unit, developing data space-time spreading and model configuration on a step-by-step grid, and realizing self-association of data and a model by utilizing the knowledge graph so as to realize digital twin-basin scene modeling. According to the invention, a water circulation dynamic knowledge graph is taken as a knowledge base, a multi-scale nested digital twin framework is constructed, a data and water circulation module is coupled, a data organization mechanism with consistent space and time is realized, a mirror image digital watershed with high fidelity is constructed, and technical support is provided for high-precision hydrologic forecasting, flood control scheduling and analog forecasting based on the parallel digital watershed.

title_en: Rapid prediction method and system for power grid power transmission and transformation equipment storm flooding
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for quickly predicting the rainstorm flooding of power grid power transmission and transformation equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring range data of the arrangement region and drawing an arrangement region base map; dividing the arrangement areas according to the arrangement area base map and the elevation data, and generating an arrangement area map layer; calculating the flow of the pipeline, the sluice and the pump station in each drainage area, and calculating the drainage capacity of the drainage area; calculating a water level-volume curve of each row area; determining a relation curve between the maximum volume and the rainfall of each row area under different rainfall durations and different rainfall conditions; determining the current flood control capacity of the equipment in the drainage area according to the relation curve of the maximum volume and the rainfall and the elevation of each piece of equipment in the drainage area; and calculating the rainstorm submerging depth of the equipment in the row area according to the area and the relative depth of the depression, and judging that the equipment in the depression is damaged when the rainstorm submerging depth of the equipment reaches or exceeds a threshold value. The invention does not need complex integral and differential calculation and has high calculation efficiency.

title_en: Robust optimization method considering toughness of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robust optimization method considering toughness of a power distribution network. The method comprises the steps of obtaining elastic response capability of a power distribution network to a fault and recovery capability after the fault, building a system performance model of the power distribution network under an extreme event, analyzing change trend of a system toughness curve at each stage, building a power distribution network toughness quantification index under the extreme event by combining system load loss under the fault, building a data load space-time transfer model by considering flexible regulation and control capability of delayed data load, building a robust optimization model for considering flexible regulation and control of energy storage and data load space-time from the viewpoint of improving power distribution network viability in order to cope with loss caused by the small probability-high loss extreme event, and verifying rationality and feasibility of a robust optimization scheme through examples. The method considers the influence of the extreme event of small probability-high loss on the power distribution network planning, provides theoretical guidance for power grid planning personnel, and improves the reliability and the robustness of the planning scheme.

title_en: Multi-sensor station distribution method facing target space coverage
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-sensor station distribution method facing target space coverage, and belongs to the field of sensor monitoring. The method comprises the steps of gridding a station arrangement alternative space of a monitoring sensor, a monitoring target surface, terrain and ground objects between the alternative space and the monitoring target, and analyzing the visibility of each grid of the alternative space of the monitoring sensor and each grid of the target surface by utilizing a parallel maximum elevation angle principle moment by moment; and the station arrangement position of a carrying platform carrying the monitoring sensor is determined by analyzing the data of the through-looking analysis result at each moment, so that the full-space coverage monitoring of the target is realized. Compared with the traditional monitoring method, the invention has the advantages of flexible station distribution, no blind area, full airspace monitoring and the like.

title_en: Community epidemic situation prevention and control oriented disinfection operation path optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for optimizing a disinfection operation path for community epidemic situation prevention and control, and belongs to the field of path optimization. The method comprises the steps of obtaining road data of a killing cancellation area, preprocessing the collected road data to form a killing arc, numbering the preprocessed killing arc to obtain a required quantity, generating an initial solution and taking the initial solution as a first current solution, generating a new solution on the basis of the current solution, judging whether the new solution is accepted or not by utilizing a Metropolis criterion, judging an algorithm termination condition after the iteration number is reached, if the algorithm termination condition is met, outputting an optimal solution, obtaining a complete optimized killing path scheme and forming a task set after the optimal solution is obtained, and distributing tasks in the task set to all killing vehicles. And the disinfection operation path optimization for community epidemic situation prevention and control is realized.

title_en: Coordination method for battery changing station site selection and electric vehicle path planning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for coordinating the site selection of a power change station and the path planning of an electric vehicle, which comprises the steps of firstly, establishing a relational expression between a detour probability and accumulated mileage anxiety according to the relation between the detour probability and the electric vehicle electric quantity state; then establishing an optimization model which minimizes the construction cost of the power station and the driving cost of the electric vehicle, and minimizes the additional cost generated by the accumulated mileage anxiety of the driver in the whole journey; and finally, expressing the solution of the optimization model by using a power station site selection sequence and an electric vehicle path sequence, and performing iterative solution on the optimization model to obtain an optimal power station site selection and electric vehicle path planning scheme. The invention considers the site selection problem of the power conversion station and the cooperation behavior of both the supply and demand parties, and can effectively reduce the cost of the supply chain and improve the efficiency of the supply chain.

title_en: Logistics data processing method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for processing logistics data, and belongs to the technical field of logistics data processing. The logistics data processing method and the logistics data processing system determine the logistics association data table based on the logistics waybill number of each logistics data in the first logistics data set and the second logistics data set, and can perform logistics data processing operations such as address query, stop and update processing and dispatch path planning based on the logistics association data table. Because the data granularity of the second stream data is smaller than that of the first stream data, the second stream data is associated with the first stream data, so that the stopping range is reduced, the affected area is reduced and the data processing precision is improved when stopping and updating processing operation is carried out; meanwhile, a service containing second logistics data can be inquired according to the first logistics data, and the function of dispatching path planning is achieved.

title_en: Living body detection method and system
abstract_en: In the living body detection method and system provided by the present specification, after a plurality of original mode images of a to-be-detected portion of a target object are obtained, the plurality of original mode images are input to a first model, a plurality of corresponding original mode feature vectors are obtained, at least one stable mode in the plurality of modes is determined based on the plurality of original mode feature vectors, and a living body detection is performed on the target object based on the at least one stable mode to obtain a living body detection result of whether the target object is a living body. The scheme can improve the stability of the in-vivo detection performance.

title_en: Ore blending optimization system, method, equipment and medium based on ore facies composition
abstract_en: The application provides a mineral blending optimization system, method, equipment and medium based on mineral facies composition, and the method comprises the following steps: the single mineral powder management module is used for creating a first mapping relation between different mineral phase compositions of single mineral powder sintered under different sintering parameters and corresponding sintering parameters, and associating the first mapping relation with attribute data of the corresponding single mineral powder; the ore blending management module is used for carrying out proportioning combination on the single ore powder in the single ore powder management module to obtain a plurality of mixed ores, determining the ore phase composition of each mixed ore under different sintering parameters according to the first mapping relation, and establishing a second mapping relation between the ore phase composition of the sintered ore corresponding to the mixed ore and the performance index; and the ore blending optimization module is used for constructing a plurality of ore blending schemes meeting the preset mixed ore component constraint conditions according to the single ore powder inventory information, and screening the ore blending scheme with the lowest cost from the target ore blending schemes according to the single ore powder price.

title_en: Method and device for verifying digital certificate and secret key
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for verifying a digital certificate and a secret key, which relate to network security, and the method comprises the following steps: packaging the certificate and the verification transaction of the key verification into a jar package; storing the digital certificate and the key to be verified into a preset folder, and determining a configuration file; and executing jar package to initiate verification according to the configuration file, and determining a digital certificate and a key verification result. The invention can be used by an external organization before production, verify the validity of the digital certificate and the secret key of the external organization in advance, and avoid transaction abnormity caused by invalid certificate or secret key after delivery.

title_en: Multifunctional vehicle and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a multifunctional vehicle, comprising: the system comprises a data management module, a computer device, office equipment, a goods selling cabinet and a monitoring device, wherein the data management module is used for communicating with a cloud computing system, a plurality of seats for providing a massage function for people in the vehicle, the computer device for providing internet surfing service for the people in the vehicle, the office equipment for office work of the people in the vehicle and the monitoring device for monitoring the service duration of the seats, the office equipment and the goods selling cabinet are arranged in a carriage; the data management module automatically drives the vehicle to a driving receiving position according to an instruction issued by the cloud computing system, then controls the seat, the computer equipment, the office equipment and/or the goods selling cabinet to provide required services for personnel in the vehicle, charges according to service duration fed back by the monitoring device after confirming that the user finishes the services, and automatically drives the vehicle to a service base closest to the vehicle after confirming that the user is away from the vehicle.

title_en: Comprehensive optimization method for train speed curve and timetable under reversible traction power supply system
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive optimization method of a train speed curve and a timetable under a reversible traction power supply system, which belongs to the technical field of urban rail train energy-saving operation.

title_en: Urban built-up environment and climate factor and network taxi appointment demand correlation evaluation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic demand management, and discloses a system for evaluating relevance between an urban built-up environment and climate factors and network appointment demands, which comprises the following components: the system comprises an input module, a data processing module and a data processing module, wherein the input module is used for acquiring gridded urban built environment and climate data and corresponding network appointment demand data, and cleaning and screening the data; the index module is used for calculating and storing a built environment index system related to the network appointment demand, and quantizing and calculating each index value in the built environment index system according to the data input by the input module; the analysis module is used for establishing a multi-layer development model for correlation analysis of urban built-up environment and climate factors and network car booking requirements according to the index values output by the index module; and the evaluation output module is used for acquiring and analyzing an evaluation result through a multilayer development model. The method comprehensively evaluates the correlation between various factors and the travel demand of the online taxi appointment; and the network taxi appointment scheduling and the resource allocation in the city construction process are optimized, and the network taxi appointment operation service efficiency is improved.

title_en: Television production line management method based on digital twin modeling
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of production line management, and particularly relates to a television production line management method based on digital twin modeling, which comprises the following steps: s1, obtaining modeling information data of a television production line; s2, performing digital twinning modeling on the television production line based on modeling information data to obtain a digital twinning model of the television production line; s3, after receiving a production order, formulating an initial production task according to the order requirement; s4, judging whether the production task meets the simulation requirement or not, and if the production task meets the simulation requirement, turning to S5; if the simulation requirement is not met, turning to S6; s5, simulating the production task by using a digital twin model of the television production line, and evaluating the production task according to a simulation result; and S6, controlling a television production line to produce the television according to the production task. The invention can reasonably make a production plan before formal production, thereby better and effectively managing the television production line.

title_en: Information processing method and system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses an information processing method, an information processing system and electronic equipment, which are used for obtaining a public account form filling request; obtaining identification information corresponding to the public account based on the public account form filling request; acquiring first pre-stored identity information of the public account based on the identification information of the public account; and responding to the public account form filling request, and filling the first identity information of the public account into the account form electronic template specified by the public account form filling request. According to the scheme, when the public account needs to be filled, the corresponding identification information is obtained based on the public account filling request, and the pre-stored first identity information is further obtained, so that the first identity information is directly filled into the account form electronic template appointed by the public account filling request, automatic filling of the public account is achieved, the problems of manual operation and complex flow are solved, and the public account processing speed is improved.

title_en: Low-carbon demand response method of comprehensive energy system based on dynamic carbon emission factor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-carbon demand response method of an integrated energy system based on a dynamic carbon emission factor, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a generator set model of the integrated energy system, then establishing a generator set output with the minimum power generation cost as a target according to the constructed generator set model of the integrated energy system, and obtaining the optimal output of the generator set; according to the invention, by constructing an electro-thermal coupling dynamic carbon emission factor, transmitting the carbon emission of the power system from the source side to the load side and updating in real time, a user can clearly recognize the carbon emission generated by the self power utilization behavior, so that the high carbon emission behavior is greatly reduced, and then a low carbon demand response mechanism meeting the principles of perception, fairness, incentive and incentive is established, so that the user can further adjust the power utilization time, and the transferable load and the reducible load are reduced to the greatest extent, thereby achieving the effects of energy conservation and emission reduction, and being suitable for wide popularization and use.

title_en: Intelligent safety management and control system and method based on 3D technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent safety management and control system and a management and control method based on a 3D technology, which are used for a transformer substation, wherein the system comprises wearable equipment and a remote terminal which are in wireless connection; the intelligent wearable equipment combines the positioning technology to realize the full-perception full-management and control management of authority, behavior, information and materials of the transformer substation, the safety quality management and control level is improved, the remote terminal and the wearable equipment can be linked, the violation behaviors are identified and the language interaction function is combined, the worker can be remotely reminded to stop the violation behaviors, the safety production is ensured, the comprehensive intelligent management level of a power grid is improved, and huge economic benefits and social benefits are brought.

title_en: Method and system for monitoring enterprise and authorized personnel relationship change
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for monitoring enterprise and authorized personnel relationship change, which relate to the technical field of data security, and the method comprises the following steps: creating a first authorization relationship table comprising a first authorization seal code set corresponding to a plurality of department codes; calling an event interface according to the electronic seal change event so that the event interface changes an authorized printer associated with the target department code, and issuing an event containing the target department code; monitoring a release event to obtain a target department code, and calling a preset method to inquire a second authorization seal person code set currently associated with the target department code; and generating a second authorization relationship table according to the second authorization seal code set and the corresponding first authorization seal code set. The system can adapt to complex processing caused by data change caused by each service under different scenes by adding the authorization relation table and the event monitor, thereby greatly freeing productivity and improving development efficiency.

title_en: Industrial Internet equipment instruction operation safety method based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a blockchain-based industrial Internet equipment instruction operation safety method which comprises the steps of calculating an individual industrial Internet equipment instruction value through an industrial enterprise asset quantitative calculation method, constructing a IIOT equipment instruction value model, calculating based on the IIOT equipment instruction value model to obtain an instruction initial value, calculating based on an equipment instruction risk level, an operation instruction risk level and the instruction initial value, constructing an instruction asset model, carrying out instruction asset quota on a user based on the instruction asset model, initiating access to field equipment and an intelligent terminal based on blockchain and the instruction asset quota, firstly carrying out operation instruction asset, then distributing instruction operation quota according to actual requirements of the user on the intelligent terminal or the field equipment, and finally controlling the access of the user to the equipment through an instruction authority and quota mechanism.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for detecting quality of regional agricultural products
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for detecting the quality of regional agricultural products, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring environment data of each grid area of an agricultural product to be detected according to preset Internet of things equipment; acquiring basic information of an agricultural product to be detected and planting areas of grid areas of the agricultural product to be detected; inputting the basic information, the planting area and the environmental data into a preset yield prediction model to obtain predicted yield values of agricultural products to be detected in each grid area, and synchronizing the predicted yield values with corresponding purchasing terminals; and obtaining an actual yield value of the acquisition terminal, and comparing the predicted yield value with the actual yield value to judge whether the quality problem exists in the agricultural product to be detected.

title_en: Insurance commission accounting method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an insurance commission accounting method and an insurance commission accounting system. The insurance commission accounting method includes: uploading and configuring commission rules; after the user makes an application, automatically calculating commissions according to commission rules to obtain commission fees corresponding to each insurance broker; the commission fees are automatically allocated into corresponding individual insurance broker accounts. The system comprises modules corresponding to the method steps. Monitoring whether the commission rule is updated in real time, updating real-time conditions according to the commission rule, and determining the commission rule based on the current commission fee calculation by setting a buffer time period mode. The system comprises modules corresponding to the method steps.

title_en: Highway maintenance big data classification decision method based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a neural network-based highway maintenance big data classification decision method, which comprises the following steps: big data analysis technology in the highway maintenance system is researched and analyzed; the highway maintenance data processing method based on machine learning comprises the steps of performing normalization processing on text data in a highway by adopting an NLP word bag model, performing word frequency statistics on the text data to obtain word frequency characteristics, converting the word frequency characteristics into a numerical form after word bag processing, and performing dimensionality reduction processing on the data by adopting a self-encoder model; the maintenance suggestions are divided into three categories by adopting artificial labels, a gradient boost decision tree classification model for classification decision of highway maintenance big data is constructed, and influence factors on the classification decision are increased from the traditional mode that only the road use performance is considered to the mode that two basic data of the road use performance and the number of lanes and historical maintenance data are considered at the same time. The method processes and classifies the pavement maintenance data, and provides technical support for a highway maintenance decision system.

title_en: Intelligent pharmacy position management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for managing the position of an intelligent pharmacy, wherein the method comprises the following steps: sequencing the occurrence frequency of the medicines in the medicine order database, and determining N main medicines with the highest occurrence frequency; determining whether position adjustment needs to be carried out on the main medicines or not from the main medicines with the highest occurrence frequency according to time information and medicine information recorded in a medicine order database; performing secondary sequencing on the medicine orders corresponding to each main medicine, and sequencing according to the occurrence frequency of related medicines; determining whether a related drug is co-located with the primary drug based on drug correlations in the drug correlation database; adjust the drug locations and update the drug association database. By the method, the positions of the main medicines and the related medicines are reasonably arranged in the intelligent pharmacy, the working time of the medicine taking robot is shortened, and the operation efficiency of the intelligent pharmacy is improved.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for planning and optimizing assembly process
abstract_en: The application discloses an assembly process planning optimization method, device, equipment and medium, relates to the technical field of planning optimization of assembly processes, and solves the technical problem that the feasibility of the assembly process planning of aviation equipment cannot be guaranteed in the prior art, so that the total assembly time of aviation cannot be minimized. The method comprises the steps of obtaining assembly tasks of target aviation equipment, generating an assembly plan of the target aviation equipment, distributing required resources for each assembly task to obtain feasibility of each assembly task, forming constraint on the assembly plan of the target aviation equipment under the condition that each assembly task can be executed, and optimizing the assembly plan of the target aviation equipment forming the constraint by sequencing the assembly tasks and distributing the required resources of the assembly tasks. The method can minimize the total assembly time of the target aviation equipment, so that the assembly efficiency of the target aviation equipment can be improved.

title_en: Resource recommendation method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a resource recommendation method, a resource recommendation device, an electronic device and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: sampling an initial behavior sequence of a target account from a pre-constructed first account behavior profile; according to the resources associated with the target resources in the pre-constructed resource semantic isomorphic diagram, performing expansion processing on the initial behavior sequence to obtain an expansion behavior sequence of the target account; sampling a similar resource sequence of the candidate resource from the resource semantic isomorphic diagram, and sampling an interactive account sequence of the candidate resource from a second account behavior isomorphic diagram symmetrical to the first account behavior isomorphic diagram; determining interaction index information of the target account on the candidate resources according to account characteristics of the target account, resource characteristics of the candidate resources, an expansion behavior sequence, a similar resource sequence and an interaction account sequence; and determining a resource recommendation result aiming at the target account according to the interaction index information. By adopting the method, the accuracy of resource recommendation can be improved.

title_en: Project planning management system, project planning management method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a project planning management system, a project planning management method, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of project management, wherein the project planning management system comprises: the project management subsystem is used for storing a plurality of plans added by the plan responsible person node, associating and storing a target event added by the manager node, a plan of the target event and an event responsible person node of the target event, associating and storing a target project added by the manager node, a plan and a flow chart of the target project and the project responsible person node of the target project, and realizing information query operation of the plan responsible person node, the manager node, the event responsible person node and the project responsible person node; a flow management subsystem for managing the flow chart; and the system management subsystem is used for managing the user information, the role information and the menu authority of each user node. The invention can make the work command and execution more efficient in project management.

title_en: Ecological system stability assessment method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological system stability assessment method, an ecological system stability assessment device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The ecological system stability assessment method comprises the following steps: firstly, acquiring a vegetation index of a target area in a specified time range, wherein the vegetation index comprises a normalized vegetation index, an enhanced vegetation index and a sunlight-induced chlorophyll fluorescence value; secondly, judging whether the target area is disturbed by disasters within a specified time range according to the vegetation index; then if the vegetation is disturbed by disasters, determining vegetation stability data of the target area according to the vegetation index and the time length of the appointed time range, wherein the vegetation stability data comprises vegetation resistance data and vegetation restoring force data; and finally, evaluating the stability of the ecosystem of the target area according to the vegetation stability data. According to the method, whether the target area is disturbed by the disaster can be judged, vegetation stability data after the disaster disturbance is obtained, and the stability of the ecological system can be accurately estimated.

title_en: Campus consumption information management system and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of multi-equipment multi-rule real-time information management, in particular to a safe and efficient campus consumption information management system and application thereof, which are characterized by comprising a consumption management cloud platform, a front-end processor, a consumption machine and a smart card terminal, wherein the consumption management cloud platform and the front-end processor are in data connection through an HTTP protocol, the consumption machine and the front-end processor are in communication through a TCP protocol, and the smart card terminal is in communication with the consumption machine and finishes payment consumption; the front-end processor is provided with an interface for interfacing with a Redis cache, and the Redis cache consumes rules, last piece of consumption record information of consumer equipment and accumulated consumption records; by introducing the Redis cache and the rubbitmq message queue, the processing efficiency of campus consumption management is improved, and a guardian can monitor the consumption record and the recharging record in real time, so that the errors of the student consumption or recharging record are avoided.

title_en: Data processing method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a data processing method, a data processing device and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: receiving user data from a plurality of users of a plurality of user devices; determining target users meeting a first preset condition in a plurality of users according to the user data; the first preset condition comprises at least one of data traffic generated when the mobile communication technology is used in a first preset time period being greater than a first traffic threshold, the number of times of accessing a preset website in a second preset time period being greater than an access threshold, and user data comprising preset identifications; calculating a quantization value of the target user according to the preset function and the user data; acquiring a plurality of positions; the concentration degree of the target users is obtained from the plurality of positions to meet the second preset condition, and the quantized value of the target users meets the target position of the third preset condition, so that the density of the target users in the corresponding range of the target position is relatively high, and the accuracy of site selection is improved.

title_en: Method, system, medium and equipment for analyzing economic index of green product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of green product analysis and control, in particular to a green product economic index analysis method, a system, a medium and equipment. The scheme comprises the steps of obtaining administrative jurisdiction division of all monitoring points in a region to be monitored and real-time output of various products; obtaining output duty ratio and speed increasing ratio of all subareas of the area to be monitored according to the administrative administration division and real-time output of various products; performing association analysis on each partition according to the output duty ratio and the speed increasing ratio to obtain an association partition; obtaining regional feature ranks, and calculating correction coefficients according to the regional feature ranks; judging whether to send out a green conversion starting command according to the associated partition and the correction coefficient; and after receiving the command for starting the green conversion, converting the green food with the preset proportion into pickled Chinese cabbage. According to the scheme, through the analysis of the association relation between the output ratio and the speed increasing ratio and the combination of the regional characteristic analysis, automatic and time-division pickled Chinese cabbage conversion is realized, and the balanced control of the green products is balanced.

title_en: Method for detecting safety of network-access side equipment based on boosting reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The application relates to a network side equipment safety detection method based on boosting reinforcement learning, which comprises the following specific steps: 1) Carrying out body structure analysis on mass heterogeneous network-side equipment, extracting characteristic information and constructing scoring parameters; 2) Constructing a credible grading parameter vector matrix, namely constructing a grading vector matrix by using grading parameters of different credible devices according to grading parameters obtained by various credible side devices collected in the step 1); 3) Based on the two steps, constructing a rating standard data set of the side equipment, learning by using an optimized boosting algorithm, and constructing a rating generator of the side equipment; 4) Extracting characteristic information of the side equipment to be accessed and taking the characteristic information as input of a grading generator of the side equipment in the step 3) to obtain multi-dimensional grading and overall grading results of the equipment; 5) Accurately identifies the abnormal equipment and gives a warning. The method and the device can dynamically and continuously evaluate the credibility of the unknown side equipment in a finer granularity and multiple directions.

title_en: Method for predicting residual wall thickness of heat transfer tube of shell-and-tube heat exchanger of nuclear power plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting the residual wall thickness of a heat transfer tube of a shell-and-tube heat exchanger of a nuclear power plant, which is used for obtaining the defect depth of the heat transfer tube at each cycle end before the first cycle end, calculating the expansion rate of the defect depth of the heat transfer tube according to the defect depth of the heat transfer tube at each cycle end before the first cycle end, predicting the defect depth of the heat transfer tube after the completion of the first cycle end, and predicting the residual wall thickness of the heat transfer tube after the completion of the first cycle end according to the defect depth of the heat transfer tube after the completion of the first cycle end. The method is based on the data of the residual wall thickness of the eddy current inspection of the heat transfer tube, and fits a defect growth rate equation according to a mathematical calculation method aiming at the heat transfer tube with the defect type of pitting or wearing, so as to iteratively calculate the residual wall thickness of the heat transfer tube at the end of the future cycle life.

title_en: Predictive model training method and device, medium and computer equipment
