abstract_en: A predictive model training method and apparatus, medium, and computer device, the method comprising: acquiring a supply-demand relation diagram among a plurality of sample distribution areas; the supply-demand relation graph among the plurality of sample distribution areas is used for representing the similarity among the historical supply-demand information of the distribution resources in the plurality of sample distribution areas; inputting a supply-demand relation graph among the plurality of sample distribution areas into a pre-trained graph neural network, and obtaining supply-demand vectors of distribution resources in the plurality of sample distribution areas output by the graph neural network; training a prediction model based on supply and demand vectors of distribution resources in the plurality of sample distribution areas; the prediction model is used for predicting the state of a demand side and/or a supply side of the distribution resource in the target distribution area.

title_en: Message pushing method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a message pushing method, a message pushing device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an initial sample set, wherein the initial sample set comprises positive samples with up-to-standard activity participation and negative samples with up-to-standard activity participation, converting the negative samples meeting label conversion conditions into positive samples to obtain an intermediate sample set, inputting the intermediate sample set into a pre-trained causal model, identifying common factors and personality factors among the samples through the causal model, labeling basic information containing the common factors and the personality factors with common factor labels and personality factor labels to obtain a labeled final sample set, inputting the final sample set into a multi-label multi-classification model, predicting target activity types corresponding to the samples by the multi-label multi-classification model, and pushing activity messages corresponding to the target activity types to the samples. The method can solve the problems that the individual characteristics are not obvious, training is sparse and the effective expansion cannot be achieved due to too few positive samples, and the like.

title_en: Cross-chain interaction method and terminal based on notary group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-chain interaction method and a terminal based on a notary group, which select a transaction notary group and a verification notary group from a plurality of notary nodes by using an improved webpage ranking algorithm, send notary group information corresponding to the transaction notary group and the verification notary group to an initiator and a receiver, verify the transaction according to transaction credentials based on the verification notary group, and complete the transaction by using the transaction notary group if the verification is passed, so that the transaction notary group is only responsible for actual cross-chain transaction operation, the verification of the data of the verification notary group and the supervision of transaction behaviors are supported, the cross-chain transaction speed is improved, the execution of a single node is not relied on, the centralization risk and the node aversion risk are avoided, and the reliability of the transaction and the verification notary group are ensured by using the improved webpage ranking algorithm, thereby improving the reliability of the cross-chain interaction and the interaction efficiency.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and storage medium for evaluating supply and demand of cultural services of ecosystem
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for evaluating supply and demand of an ecosystem cultural service, and relates to the field of evaluation of the ecosystem cultural service. The method for evaluating the supply and demand of the cultural services of the ecosystem comprises the steps of collecting social media photos and comment data, determining environmental and social economic elements influencing the cultural services of the ecosystem, constructing an environmental factor layer, drawing a spatial distribution diagram of CES supply and demand, and carrying out spatial correlation analysis to identify hot spots and cold spots of the supply and demand. And carrying out double-variable space autocorrelation calculation on the supply and demand of the cultural service of the ecological system by utilizing GeoDa software to obtain a double-variable cluster map. And analyzing the spatial correlation between the supply and the demand to further identify the matching and mismatch conditions of the supply and the demand spatial distribution. The method solves the problems that the existing assessment method is difficult to measure the distribution condition of supply and demand in space, and is difficult to acquire data in multiple times due to the limitation of time and labor cost, so that the method is not suitable for analysis of the dynamic change of the supply and demand relationship.

title_en: Interaction method and device based on virtual scene, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: One or more embodiments of the present disclosure provide an interaction method, an interaction device, an electronic device, and a storage medium based on a virtual scene. The method is applied to a first client corresponding to a first user; the method comprises the following steps: outputting an interaction option for acquiring an electronic credential from a second user in a virtual scene in response to a distance between an avatar of the first user and an avatar of the second user output in the virtual scene being less than a preset distance; the electronic certificate is used for acquiring the allocation authority of the virtual resource in the preset virtual resource; and responding to the triggering operation of the first user for the interaction option, and acquiring an electronic credential from the electronic credential set held by the second user. By triggering the visual interaction between the virtual image of the first user and the virtual image of the second user in the virtual scene, interactivity and interestingness of the user in the process of collecting the electronic certificates and distributing the virtual resources can be improved, and user experience is improved.

title_en: Power distribution network transformation value evaluation method, system, storage medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method, a system, a storage medium and equipment for evaluating transformation value of a power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical load information of an existing power grid in a target area in a set time period, and determining a load grade and a load weight coefficient of the existing power grid corresponding to each sub-partition in the target area; and acquiring engineering data information and single transformation price information corresponding to the engineering transformation type of the power distribution network, and calculating transformation value of the power distribution network by combining the load weight coefficient of each sub-partition and the capacity-to-load ratio of power distribution network engineering facilities in the target area. By analyzing the historical load information and combining with preset load grade division standards, the load grade and load weight coefficient corresponding to each sub-partition are determined, the power distribution network transformation value is determined by combining engineering data information and single transformation price information according to the differentiation processing of each sub-partition, the accuracy and scientificity of the power distribution network transformation value evaluation are greatly improved, the subjective influence of manpower is avoided, and the evaluation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Current collecting line impact trip probability prediction and alarm method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power transmission lines, in particular to a current collection line impact trip probability prediction and alarm method and system. According to the method for predicting the counterattack tripping probability of the collecting circuit, firstly, a monitoring area is set by taking the collecting circuit as a center, and lightning history data of the monitoring area are obtained; acquiring lightning prediction data of a monitoring area in a time period to be predicted by combining the lightning history data; then, calculating the counterattack tripping probability of the collecting circuit in single lightning stroke by combining the lightning prediction data P     l    . According to the invention, the actual lightning history data is combined to predict the impact tripping probability of the current collection circuit, and meanwhile, the circuit parameters and the circuit lightning protection performance are combined, so that the prediction result is more accurate.

title_en: Flight simulation training management method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a flight simulation training management method and system based on the internet of things, and relates to the technical field of electric digital data processing, wherein the method comprises: basic training information and training scene information of a training user are read; reading the interaction control data, performing training control evaluation, and generating a training control evaluation result; constructing a training reference image set; calling a training action database based on the training scene information, and performing action feature matching on the reference image set through the training action database; generating auxiliary training evaluation data based on the action characteristic matching result, and generating a comprehensive training evaluation result through the training control evaluation result and the auxiliary training evaluation data; the flight simulation training management is carried out on the training user, so that the technical problems of low efficiency and low training quality of the flight simulation training management caused by insufficient detail of analysis on training data in the prior art are solved.

title_en: Intelligent user experience display method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an intelligent user experience display method, an intelligent user experience display system and a storage medium. Belongs to the technical field of big data and immersive experience. The method comprises the following steps: collecting pre-stored information and personal attribute information of a user, carrying out user attribute identification to obtain requirement attribute information, then combining the collected action information and the information searching information to obtain a requirement information portrait, extracting personalized requirement information, combining the information searching information to obtain requirement experience information, inputting the requirement experience information into a requirement experience simulation display platform to process the requirement experience information to obtain a virtual experience display model, carrying out virtual display on the user according to the model, obtaining experience pickup information, and checking a virtual display effect; the method comprises the steps of obtaining personalized requirements through information of a user, processing the personalized requirements, obtaining virtual experience display, checking marketing effects of the virtual display, collecting and processing the user requirement information through big data, performing virtual experience display, and checking marketing effects of personalized virtual experience display technology.

title_en: Industrial robot predictive maintenance system based on enterprise application integration
abstract_en: The application provides an industrial robot predictive maintenance system based on enterprise application integration, comprising: the integrated application terminal system, the service terminal system and the client terminal system are sequentially connected in a communication mode and are used for respectively acquiring monitoring data of all industrial robots in the automobile manufacturing site and industrial robot fault prediction tool data from enterprise applications corresponding to automobile manufacturing enterprises, storing the monitoring data, generating industrial robot fault prediction results aiming at the automobile manufacturing site based on the industrial robot fault prediction tool data and the monitoring data, and displaying the industrial robot fault prediction results. According to the method and the system, predictive maintenance for the industrial robot is achieved through integration of enterprise application and data interaction among a plurality of subsystems, various different systems and data are integrated, more comprehensive and accurate data support can be provided for the predictive maintenance, and further efficiency and comprehensiveness for the predictive maintenance of the industrial robot can be effectively improved.

title_en: Substation inspection management method and device based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a substation inspection management method and device based on deep reinforcement learning, comprising the steps of constructing an inference task scheduling model which takes real-time calculation forces of edge nodes and cloud as input and takes specific edge node equipment numbers or cloud as prediction results for output by utilizing a Muzero algorithm; the method comprises the steps of training an inference task scheduling model by using data information generated by various patrol tasks in a transformer substation with load balancing as a target; based on the current state of the transformer substation, performing node prediction by using a trained reasoning task scheduling model, and distributing edge computing resources for the patrol task according to a prediction result so as to realize load balance of patrol management of the transformer substation. According to the invention, through a deep reinforcement learning model based on a Muzero algorithm, the edge nodes and the cloud are used as characteristic input networks together, and the distributed edge nodes are selected with load balance as a target, so that edge cloud coordination is realized, and the reliability and the operation efficiency of a substation inspection system are improved.

title_en: Risk model-based network communication risk prediction method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network communication risk prediction method and device based on a risk model, comprising the following steps: determining a source communication end and a target communication end corresponding to a target communication task in all communication tasks to be executed in a current communication network; determining a first risk prediction model corresponding to the source communication end and a second risk prediction model corresponding to the target communication end according to the corresponding equipment type and the corresponding equipment information; based on the corresponding risk prediction model and the corresponding equipment information prediction source communication terminal, the first communication risk information corresponding to the target communication information and the second communication risk information corresponding to the target communication information are sent by the target communication terminal; and determining comprehensive risk information according to the two communication risk information. Therefore, the invention can improve the prediction accuracy and the prediction efficiency of the network communication risk, and improve the reliability when the network communication safety is improved based on the communication risk prediction mode, thereby being beneficial to ensuring the normal operation of the communication network.

title_en: Resource processing method, device, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a resource processing method, a device, terminal equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of intelligent terminals; the method can control the reserved resources at the end of the current resource processing period and simultaneously meet the resource requirement of the next resource processing period and the storage limit of the current resource processing period. Receiving historical resource change data sent by first electronic terminal equipment; receiving reserved resources sent by first electronic terminal equipment; acquiring effective resources in the next resource processing period from the reserved resources; according to the historical resource change data, the expected removal quantity of the effective resource in the next resource processing period is obtained; when the residual quantity of the effective resources is larger than the expected removal quantity of the effective resources in the next resource processing period, taking the effective resources with the target quantity as resources to be returned; and establishing a return task for the resource to be returned, and sending the return task to the target first electronic terminal equipment.

title_en: Construction scheme optimization method based on new energy node performance attribute
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of planning and designing of power grid construction schemes, and particularly relates to a construction scheme optimization method based on new energy node performance attributes, which comprises the steps of constructing a new energy node performance attribute evaluation matrix; the method comprises the steps of determining a normalized scheme attribute matrix and an energy efficiency attribute weight matrix, constructing a new energy node efficiency attribute weight evaluation matrix, solving the approach coefficient and the energy efficiency attribute compact coefficient of a new energy node construction scheme and a local good and bad scheme, determining an energy optimization index value based on the approach coefficient and the energy efficiency attribute compact coefficient of the new energy node construction scheme and the local good and bad scheme, and determining an optimal scheme.

title_en: Resource allocation method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a resource allocation method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical data corresponding to a target resource, wherein the historical data comprises first dimension data and second dimension data; based on the first dimension data, judging an internal influence factor of the target resource by using a preset submergence decision model to obtain an influence result of the internal environment on the configuration strategy; based on the second dimension data, judging external influence factors of the target resources by using a preset external pressure decision model to obtain an influence result of an external environment on the configuration strategy; based on the influence result of the internal environment on the configuration strategy and the influence result of the external environment on the configuration strategy, judging the configuration strategy of the target resource by utilizing a preset configuration decision model so as to dynamically configure the target resource according to the judgment result. The method and the device improve the stability of the resource configuration result and the efficiency of the resource configuration, and realize the intelligent dynamic configuration of the resources.

title_en: Item rule engine mechanism and implementation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transaction rule engine mechanism and implementation, which comprises a transaction rule configuration module and a transaction engine processing module, and comprises the following steps: s100, constructing a source data table and a result data table, and configuring through attribution service; s200, configuring influence factor files required by item identification based on item identification rules, wherein each item can be configured with any plurality of files; s300, configuring a recognition result file based on a transaction recognition comparison rule, and integrating the files to form a set; s400, combining the influence factors to specific data of the set of the determined result files by the item factor maintenance configuration; through the item rule engine, the original stream data is converted into the standard stream data with a plurality of archives, and three elements of accounting are identified when the common scene is financial accounting: accounting type, atomic event and amount type, after passing through the transaction engine, accounting financial running water becomes more refined, and plays a key role in subsequent multidimensional analysis and account management.

title_en: Social security automatic reporting abnormal state early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a social security automatic reporting abnormal state early warning method and a system, which relate to the technical field of data processing, and the method comprises the following steps: transmitting the target social security order information to a third party platform; acquiring scheduling resource information of the third-party platform, wherein the scheduling resource information comprises robot resource information and salesman resource information; obtaining abnormal order information and automatic order information; obtaining an abnormal characteristic value set and an automatic characteristic value set; outputting a first matching result; outputting a second matching result; performing matching verification, and generating reporting abnormal early warning information according to a verification result; and generating a scheduling control instruction according to the reporting abnormality early warning information, activating a task distribution module of the third party platform, and stopping task distribution, thereby solving the technical problems in the prior art that the efficiency and the accuracy of the social security reporting are insufficient because the automatic reporting of the social security cannot be completed cooperatively by a man-machine.

title_en: Medical care data cross-referencing method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical data, and discloses a medical nursing data cross-referencing method and a system, wherein the medical nursing data cross-referencing method comprises a data input module, a data processing module, a data transfer module and a data calling module, wherein the data calling module can acquire nursing means corresponding to each other and nursing comprehensive scoring data corresponding to each other in a preoperative preparation period, an perioperative period and a postoperative recovery period of congenital heart disease nursing; the congenital heart disease nursing data are mutually cited, a more accurate nursing scheme can be formulated according to the illness state of a patient, the data are mutually cited through the Internet, accurate and timely decisions are made more quickly, and medical staff of different medical systems are promoted to communicate and share data experience.

title_en: SNCR denitration prediction method fusing multiple neural networks
abstract_en: The invention discloses an SNCR denitration prediction method fusing a plurality of neural networks, which comprises the following steps: step S1, training a plurality of initial models, and screening to obtain a plurality of screened models; s2, outputting different post-screen predicted values by each post-screen model, and calculating to obtain the correlation and the prediction accuracy between the post-screen predicted values; s3, adjusting the proportion of each input parameter of the screened model to obtain a plurality of optimized models; step S4, calculating to obtain the correlation among all the optimized predicted values and the prediction accuracy; s5, adjusting the proportion of each input parameter of each optimization model to obtain an adjusted optimization model; step S6, judging whether the prediction accuracy difference between the optimal model with the highest nearest prediction accuracy and the optimal model with the highest last prediction accuracy is lower than a preset threshold value: if yes, outputting an optimization model with highest nearest prediction accuracy as a final model; if not, go to step S5. The method improves the prediction accuracy of the NOx output content.

title_en: Directional transaction method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for directional transaction, and relates to the technical field of big data. One embodiment of the method comprises the following steps: responding to the code scanning operation of the first user, and acquiring a transaction request; the transaction request indicates a first account corresponding to the first user, a product type corresponding to the first account, a second account corresponding to the code scanning operation and a transaction amount; determining whether the first account opens a directional transaction function according to the product type; determining whether the second account is a directional account under the condition that a directional transaction function is started; if so, responding to the transaction request according to the transaction amount to realize the transaction between the first account and the second account. This embodiment may enable different transaction limitations for different types of products. In the case of turning on the directional transaction function, the directional transaction between the first account and the second account is performed by verifying whether the second account is the directional account.

title_en: Abnormal user identification method and device, computer storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and provides an abnormal user identification method, an abnormal user identification device, a computer storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein the abnormal user identification method comprises the following steps: according to the historical traffic index corresponding to each user in a plurality of users, determining the historical traffic time sequence data corresponding to each user; predicting predicted traffic timing data for each user in a future period according to the historical traffic timing data; generating fusion traffic time sequence data corresponding to each user according to the historical traffic time sequence data and the predicted traffic time sequence data; and identifying abnormal users from the plurality of users based on the fused traffic time sequence data corresponding to each user. The method for identifying the abnormal user can timely discover the abnormal user.

title_en: Automatic management method and device based on script file
abstract_en: The method converts targets actually required to be executed into tasks in the script file in a YAML format, and sets corresponding threads for each task, namely sets execution steps for each target, so that an independent adjustment execution command is realized, and the logic operation capability or function of the script file is improved; and finally, activating through the node name, thereby automatically executing the corresponding thread and realizing the automatic management of the flow of the script file.

title_en: Method and system for realizing personalized automobile instrument interface
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for realizing a personalized automobile instrument interface, wherein the method comprises the following steps: in response to a meter creation instruction input by a user, starting an HMI configuration window for editing by the user to acquire user HMI editing information; acquiring an automobile HMI configuration parameter matched with the user HMI editing information from a preset HMI configuration database; and sending the configuration parameters of the automobile HMI to a vehicle end so that the vehicle end configures a vehicle end instrument interface according to the configuration parameters of the automobile HMI. According to the invention, based on the Open HMI operation service, the favorite personalized instrument of the user can be created according to the habit/preference of the user, the requirements of different user groups on instrument styles are met, and the technological experience of the automobile is improved.

title_en: Knowledge graph technology electric quantity and electric charge scene data multi-situation enabling method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for enabling multiple situations of electric quantity and electricity charge scene data based on a knowledge graph technology, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, analyzing a power grid system as a preset project, determining an operation structure of the power grid system, and collecting electric quantity and electricity charge data of the power grid system; s2, taking the electric quantity and electricity charge data as a main body to carry out scene design; s3, constructing a power grid knowledge graph according to the time node scene data; s4, configuring the electric quantity and electricity charge scene data as entity nodes of a power grid knowledge graph, and planning an entity node set; s5, extracting knowledge from the entity nodes; s6, analyzing the scene data, sensing the multi-azimuth development situation of the power grid data, bringing the development situation into the entity node set to energize the electric quantity and the electric charge, and predicting the fluctuation of the power grid source load to obtain a plan. Compared with the prior art, the technical scheme provided by the invention has the advantages that the multi-stage situation of the electric quantity of the power grid is perceived, the abnormal fluctuation degree of the power grid source load can be accurately predicted, and the power supply reliability is improved.

title_en: Rapid technical support comprehensive evaluation method for complex equipment under emergency condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid technical support comprehensive evaluation method for complex equipment under emergency conditions, which decomposes an emergency rapid support process of each equipment into 18 classifications of 9 sub-aspects of equipment support quality and equipment support safety, adopts a manner of grading by a current expert, records posterior evaluation score data of the equipment after finishing tasks by the expert, establishes a special neural network based on equipment support time bias, is used for simulating complex nonlinear relations of three aspects of rapid technical support comprehensive evaluation of the complex equipment, equipment support quality, equipment support time and equipment support safety, fully utilizes the existing historical data and trains network errors to converge to a near 0 area by utilizing the strong parallel computing capability of the neural network, and finally obtains rapid technical support comprehensive evaluation results of the complex equipment under emergency conditions by substituting the equipment data to be evaluated into the trained neural network.

title_en: Data processing method, apparatus, device, computer readable storage medium and product
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a data processing method, apparatus, device, computer readable storage medium and product, applied to big data field, the method includes: acquiring target transaction data meeting preset comparison conditions, wherein the target transaction data comprises transaction data which are failed to be compared by performing comparison operation on first transaction data of first equipment and second transaction data of second equipment in a target partition; inputting the target transaction data into a target decision tree, determining a transaction time period corresponding to the target transaction data according to the target decision tree, so that a user positions the target transaction data in a preset distributed server based on the transaction time period, and performing fault analysis operation on the target transaction data. Therefore, the target transaction data which is failed to be checked currently can be rapidly positioned in the distributed server based on the transaction time period corresponding to the target transaction data, so that a user can conduct fault analysis on the target transaction data in a targeted manner, and the efficiency of transaction data fault processing is improved.

title_en: Method for determining comprehensive degradation coefficient of pollutant
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for determining a comprehensive degradation coefficient of pollutants, which comprises the steps of dividing the comprehensive degradation coefficient K of the pollutants into K  0  obtained by laboratory simulation, neglecting influence coefficients K  1  generated by partial point and surface pollution sources, calculating to obtain a preliminary K value, obtaining a K  0  value, calculating to obtain preliminary K  1  values, obtaining preliminary K  1  value coefficients a and b by using a least square method, obtaining rated complete coefficient a and b values, obtaining a K  1  value according to the rated complete coefficient a and b value, and obtaining a final K value by combining the K  0  value. The method considers the specific situation in the actual river based on the laboratory simulation method, makes up the defect that the laboratory simulation method does not fully consider the actual situation, and improves the convergence rate of parameter calibration and the precision of water quality simulation by utilizing a method combining a least square method and a steepest descent method in the parameter calibration process.

title_en: Method and system for predicting degree of ecological water level variation under mining of coal seam in ecological fragile area
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of green mines and provides a method and a system for predicting the variation degree of an ecological water level under coal seam mining in an ecological fragile area, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly determining the thickness of an effective water-resisting layer of a rock covering after coal seam mining according to mine engineering geological conditions, hydrogeological conditions and coal seam mining condition related data of the ecological fragile area; and finally, on the basis of building well flow models under different ecological diving seepage states, calculating the ecological water level drop depth in the virtual water injection process, realizing the prediction of the ecological water level variation degree under different ecological diving seepage states, avoiding the mode of on-site geological drilling water level monitoring, and realizing the comprehensive prediction of the ecological water level variation degree under the coal seam mining in an ecological fragile area.

title_en: Evaluation method of urban space-time data prediction causal model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of machine learning based on a specific calculation model, in particular to an evaluation method of a city space-time data prediction causal model.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for determining target user
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for determining a target user. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring attribute characteristic information and product sales data of a product to be recommended; obtaining associated sample data related to the product to be recommended according to the attribute characteristic information and the trained product classification model; determining a target user portrait matched with the product to be recommended according to the associated sample data and the product sales data; and determining a target recommended user of the product to be recommended according to the target user portrait and the established user list. A user portrayal model is constructed by determining associated sample data of a product to be recommended and combining product sales data of the product to be recommended so as to determine a target user portrayal, and users matched with the target user portrayal are determined in a large number of users. The method and the device realize the accurate determination of the target user of the product to be recommended, solve the problem that the target user cannot be accurately determined due to the fact that the available data of the new product is less in the early stage, and reduce the popularization difficulty of the new product.

title_en: Verification method, device, equipment and storage medium for power grid project
abstract_en: The invention discloses a verification method, a verification device, verification equipment and a storage medium for a power grid project, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of determining a planned edge layout in a project scheme of power grid planning, sequentially performing electric simulation on the edge layout and a power grid in multiple dimensions to obtain multiple operation indexes, calculating differences between the indexes of the edge layout and the indexes of the power grid, and verifying whether the project scheme meets the expected target of power grid planning according to the differences, so that verification of the power grid project is achieved without relying on manpower, reasonable analysis can be performed on the power grid project under the conditions of high working efficiency and high verification accuracy, verification is completed, and therefore fine project planning is achieved, and the benefit of power grid investment is improved.

title_en: Target intelligent recognition method based on fusion of visual image and audio data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a target intelligent identification method based on fusion of visual images and audio data, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring image data and audio data of a target to be detected, and preprocessing the image data and the audio data respectively; s2, encrypting the image data of the object to be detected, and transmitting the image data in a mode of combining an inner network with an outer network; s3, decrypting the image data, and extracting features of the decrypted image data and audio data to obtain feature data; s4, fusion processing is carried out on the characteristic data of the target to be tested, fault level analysis of the target to be tested is carried out according to the fusion result, and the identification result of the target to be tested is obtained. According to the method, the image data and the audio data are fused to obtain the identification result of the target to be detected, so that the comprehensive identification of the faults of the power distribution network is realized, and the identification accuracy and the practicability are high.

title_en: Urban road speed prediction method considering space-time characteristics of traffic network
abstract_en: The urban road speed prediction method considering the space-time characteristics of the traffic network is used for predicting the traffic flow of urban road sections. Firstly, collecting traffic network data information, such as speed time sequence of road segments, an adjacency matrix describing adjacency relations among the road segments and traffic events happening on each road segment, analyzing and modeling the collected data, and dividing the collected data into a training set and a testing set. Secondly, a DG-GRU model is built by using a graph attention network, a gating circulating unit and a dense connection network, and space-time characteristics of a traffic network are extracted. And finally, sending the training set into a DG-GRU model for training, adjusting model parameters to enable the model to achieve the best predicted performance, and evaluating the model performance by using the test set. The invention can also be applied to other spatio-temporal prediction tasks.

title_en: Back pressure unit characteristic equation and extraction steam quantity operation limit value deduction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a back pressure unit characteristic equation and a method for deducing the operation limit value of steam extraction quantity, wherein in a 1-section steam extraction back pressure unit, the steam extraction quantity of the 1-section back pressure unit, the steam extraction quantity of the 2-section back pressure unit and the total power are obtained, the power is obtained according to a first coefficient, a second coefficient and a second coefficient in a power expression of the 1-section back pressure unit, and the steam extraction quantity is obtained according to a fourth coefficient, a fifth coefficient and a sixth coefficient in a steam extraction quantity expression of the 1-section back pressure unit. The invention saves the number of the on-site performance test working conditions of the back pressure unit, and is favorable for relieving the phenomena of overlarge power generation power of the heat motor unit, difficult peak regulation of the thermoelectric unit and wind and light abandoning in the peak regulation and dispatching of the power grid.

title_en: Tunnel stability prediction method based on sample rule base reasoning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel stability prediction method based on sample rule base reasoning. The invention monitors and obtains the convergence deformation of the left arch shoulder, the arch crown and the right arch shoulder based on the displacement sensor of the anchor rod, and respectively constructs a corresponding sample type rule base. And after the left arch shoulder, the arch crown and the right arch shoulder monitoring samples at the current moment are obtained on line, the left arch shoulder, the arch crown and the right arch shoulder monitoring samples are brought into the corresponding rule base, stability reliability distribution of the last item of the activation rule is fused according to the activation degree, stability reliability distribution at the future moment is obtained, the obtained three stability distributions are subjected to weighted fusion, and finally, the stability grade of the tunnel at the future moment is predicted according to the reliability maximization principle.

title_en: Rainfall prediction method based on convolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rainfall prediction method based on convolution, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring rainfall and wind data, and processing the rainfall and wind data to obtain two-dimensional information; s2, inputting the two-dimensional information into a multi-mode fusion structure to obtain a rainfall characteristic diagram after information supplementation; s3, inputting the rainfall characteristic diagram into a UNet model to obtain a rainfall intensity classification result, and completing rainfall prediction; according to the rainfall prediction method based on convolution, higher-precision rainfall prediction can be obtained by utilizing complementarity among multiple modes, on the basis of adopting a multi-mode fusion technology, the provided UNet model can effectively construct a remote characteristic dependency relationship to strengthen characteristic extraction of edge information and time sequence information, and a lightweight convolution structure is constructed by changing a characteristic extraction process, so that the effect is optimal on the accuracy of rainfall prediction. The invention shows excellent performance in terms of both improving rainfall prediction accuracy and reducing model complexity.

title_en: Power system broadband oscillation risk identification method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a broadband oscillation risk identification method and device for a power system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the damping ratio of the power system under each working condition combination according to the grid-connected impedance characteristics of the equipment to be grid-connected and the power system under each working condition combination; clustering analysis is carried out on the working condition combinations of which the damping ratio of the power system is smaller than the oscillation threshold value, and broadband oscillation risk points are determined; the method and the device can effectively, conveniently and accurately identify the risk points which are easy to cause broadband oscillation in the power system.

title_en: Intelligent risk supervision and early warning method and system for engineering project
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent risk supervision and early warning method and system for engineering projects, and relates to the field of engineering early warning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing data mining based on multilevel preset engineering risk supervision factors to obtain an engineering risk distribution model; constructing an engineering risk supervision model based on the engineering risk distribution model; acquiring real-time state data of a target engineering project; performing risk analysis on the real-time state data based on the engineering risk supervision model to obtain a target risk analysis result; when the target risk analysis result meets the engineering risk constraint condition, an engineering early warning signal is obtained; and carrying out risk early warning on the target engineering project based on the engineering early warning signal. The technical problems that in the prior art, risk supervision and early warning aiming at engineering projects is insufficient in accuracy and cannot be timely and effectively achieved are solved.

title_en: Intelligent flow splicing method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of business processes, in particular to an intelligent process assembling method and system. Comprising the following steps: collecting a plurality of related files containing a flow model, obtaining sub-flow data of the plurality of related files, and generating a plurality of log data corresponding to the sub-flow data based on a clustering algorithm; generating a sub-flow model diagram conforming to the national standard based on a plurality of sub-flow models; generating a flow model diagram conforming to the national standard based on a plurality of related files; converting formats of the sub-flow model diagrams and the flow model diagrams, and obtaining sub-flow trees and flow trees; extracting node relation between the sub-process tree and the process tree, setting the specificity of the process components, assembling a plurality of process components conforming to the preset specificity, and establishing a brand new complete process. The invention can realize the interconnection and intercommunication of business processes among enterprise full-chain systems, support the development of related businesses more efficiently, and achieve the purposes of improving quality, reducing cost and enhancing efficiency.

title_en: Epidemic prevention early warning system for reworking and production of enterprises
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of epidemic prevention and control, in particular to an epidemic prevention early warning system for the reworking and reworking of enterprises, which comprises a user login module, an information verification module, a big data reading module, an information processing module, an information uploading module, an information backup module, an early warning module, an alarm module, a data retrieval module and an early warning algorithm.

title_en: Snow melting flow prediction method and system based on environmental feature analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a snow melting flow prediction method and a system based on environmental feature analysis, which relate to the technical field of artificial intelligence, acquire environmental feature information of a preset area, evaluate and predict the environmental feature information to generate flow prediction information and flow direction prediction information, further conduct flow path prediction optimizing, acquire a flow path prediction result, conduct loss analysis on the flow prediction information to generate a flow backlog quantity and a flow backlog area, and add the flow backlog quantity and the flow backlog area into the snow melting flow prediction result, so that the problems that the prediction method for the snow melting flow in the prior art is insufficient in intelligence, insufficient in reference surface and insufficient in execution mode, and cause a certain deviation of the prediction result compared with the actual situation are solved.

title_en: Evaluation method, system, equipment and medium for schedulable capacity of electric automobile
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment and a medium for evaluating the schedulable capacity of an electric automobile, comprising the following steps: based on the characteristic variable of the running of the electric automobile and the basic data of the electric automobile, predicting the space-time state and the charge state of the electric automobile; based on the user information of the electric automobile, predicting a user response state of the electric automobile; based on the user response state, the space-time state and the charge state, determining a schedulable electric vehicle in the electric vehicles capable of responding; the method and the device have the advantages that the maximum sustainable dispatching capacity is used as an objective function to plan the charge and discharge load of the dispatching electric vehicle, the maximum sustainable dispatching capacity result of the dispatching electric vehicle is calculated, and the maximum sustainable dispatching capacity result is used as an evaluation result of the dispatching electric vehicle dispatching capacity.

title_en: Big data bus route congestion point-based reminding system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of traffic guiding, relates to a data analysis technology, and aims to solve the problem that an existing bus route congestion point reminding system cannot predict and analyze the congestion condition of the remaining complete route of a bus route, and particularly relates to a big data bus route congestion point reminding system, which comprises a congestion reminding platform, wherein the congestion reminding platform is in communication connection with a road condition analysis module, a congestion analysis module, a grade assessment module and a storage module; the road condition analysis module is used for detecting and analyzing the running road condition of the bus route, marking the bus in the running state as a detection object, marking the non-running road section in the running line of the detection object as an analysis line, and detecting and analyzing the running road condition of the bus route, obtaining the congestion coefficient by comprehensively analyzing a plurality of parameters such as the bearing vehicles of the roads and the bearing capacity of the vehicles, and feeding back the running road condition state of the bus route through the congestion coefficient.

title_en: Guidance system for an electric motor vehicle
abstract_en: The present invention provides a guidance system for an electric motor vehicle. A guidance system (10) for an electric vehicle (20) is provided with a registration unit (43) for an electric vehicle (20) in which a battery can be replaced, a replacement location (50) for the battery (21B) being registered, a estimation unit (33B) for estimating the distance that the electric vehicle (20) can travel on the basis of the remaining battery power of the electric vehicle (20), and a display unit (33H) for displaying on map information a replacement location (50) that is within the estimated distance that the electric vehicle (20) can travel, among the replacement locations (50) for the battery (21B) registered in the registration unit (43).

title_en: Three-dimensional space identification method based on qualitative and quantitative function evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional space identification method based on qualitative and quantitative functional evaluation, which divides three-dimensional space into 3 single spaces of production, life and ecology and 4 compound spaces of production-life, production-ecology, life-ecology and production-life-ecology. The three-dimensional space is identified and divided by four steps of calculating a qualitative function evaluation value, calculating a quantitative function evaluation value, calculating a qualitative-quantitative function evaluation value and calculating a first-last index, and the three-dimensional space type is judged, and the three-dimensional space is corrected by using a coupling cooperative control. The invention provides a theoretical basis for the optimization research of the national soil space structure and the space layout, guides the optimization of the national soil space structure and the space layout, improves the rationality and the scientificity of the resource element configuration in the national soil space planning, promotes the optimization development of the national soil space pattern, and has practical significance and good application prospect.

title_en: Commercial opportunity recommending method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a business opportunity recommending method, a business opportunity recommending device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a business client list, calculating the business value rate of each business client in the business client list, and generating an initial business value rate of each business client; screening each business client based on the initial business value rate to obtain target clients with the initial business value rate meeting the preset conditions; acquiring real-time client data of a target client, and inputting the real-time client data into a business machine value rate identification model to obtain a target business machine value rate of the target client; and generating product recommendation data corresponding to the target clients based on the target business opportunity value rate. The embodiment of the invention can reduce a great amount of screening and analysis time of financial managers, and is directly based on a value priority strategy; and the value rate analysis and the dynamic recommendation are dynamically adjusted in real time according to the client will, so that the client time is saved.

title_en: Takeaway riders fast meal taking device and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of Internet and discloses a takeaway rider fast food taking device and system, wherein the takeaway rider fast food taking device comprises a main body mechanism, a software and hardware product mechanism and an auxiliary mechanism, the software and hardware product mechanism is positioned at the front end of the main body mechanism, the auxiliary mechanism is positioned at the right side of the software and hardware product mechanism, the main body mechanism comprises a fast food taking auxiliary device body, a ventilation net is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the fast food taking auxiliary device body, the software and hardware product mechanism comprises a client and a server, and the client is movably arranged at the left end of the front end of the fast food taking auxiliary device body. This take-out and ride quick meal taking device and system of hand, when the rider gets the meal to the shop, only need to operate a key on APP and get the meal, alright fix a position and get the meal target, realize that the rider advances the store fast-forward and goes out, avoid the mistake to get the meal, tie the heap and find the meal etc. phenomenon, have fine simple operation nature, practice thrift cost, repeatedly used, expandable, match the effect of order kurtosis, the practicality of use is strong.

title_en: Method for evaluating store in combination with correlation index of ambient environment of store
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating a store by combining related indexes of surrounding environments of the store, which is used for collecting geographic information data of the surrounding of the store under a line; carrying out statistical modeling on main bodies around a store; reasonably extracting a theme feature index SSTI; a linear regression model evaluation system; the invention is convenient for a user to quickly and efficiently master the surrounding environment state by quantifying the geographic information and the natural environment around the target area point into eight-dimension numerical values, combines the geographic information and the related natural characteristics as index scores, provides reference basis for the evaluation capability of store operation conditions or operation demands, provides reference for store site selection, store grouping and store management, can be used as prediction characteristics of the store operation conditions, and observes whether the surrounding environment has significant influence on attention indexes such as passenger flow and the like and the influence magnitude by using a regression model, thereby having guiding significance on the service.

title_en: Funds supervision method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a fund supervision method, a device, equipment and a readable storage medium, which execute corresponding fund supervision operation on a target supervision account according to a service instruction sent by a house management system, obtain a supervision result and return to the house management system. The operation request of the transaction user to which the target supervision account belongs is obtained by receiving the instruction of the house management system, the house management system responds to the fund transaction request of the user, the fund supervision system is controlled to execute corresponding operation, the house management system is used as a control center of the supervision system, the fund transaction process is monitored in a centralized manner, the fund management of the target supervision account is realized while the transaction information of the account is monitored, and the supervision efficiency and the security are improved.

title_en: Block chain-based insurance application flow data storage method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a block chain-based insurance application flow data storage method and a block chain-based insurance application flow data storage system, which belong to the technical field of data storage, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring flow data of insurance application, and generating a display label according to the flow data; sequentially storing the structured data fields into a linked list data structure; carrying out digital signature on each data field in the linked list flow data; constructing a new block in the block chain network, and storing the flow data to the new block; creating an intelligent contract with three-party constraints; creating a side chain network in parallel with the blockchain network; deploying the smart contract to a side-chain network; when the storage pressure of the blockchain network is high, storing the non-stored data to a side chain network; randomly selecting a plurality of nodes from a block chain network, and broadcasting a new block in the plurality of nodes; judging whether the number of the nodes of the new area block reaches the preset number of nodes or not; and displaying the display tag serving as display information of the new block in the blockchain network to finish the storage of the flow data.

title_en: Fruit and vegetable distribution optimization method based on-line dispatching system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural product path planning, and discloses a fruit and vegetable distribution optimization method based on an on-line dispatching system, which comprises the following steps: receiving a fruit and vegetable distribution optimizing instruction, determining an optimal distribution path according to the fruit and vegetable distribution optimizing instruction, acquiring the current storage amount of a distribution destination point by utilizing an on-line scheduling system, wherein the current storage amount is determined by stored fruits and vegetables in the distribution destination point, acquiring the maximum storage amount of the distribution destination point and the fruit and vegetable distribution amount of the fruits and vegetables to be distributed, when the fruits and vegetables to be distributed start to be distributed based on the optimal distribution path, executing dynamic warehouse-out on the stored fruits and vegetables based on the maximum storage amount and the current storage amount until the addition value of the current storage amount and the fruit and vegetable distribution amount is smaller than the maximum storage amount, completing dynamic warehouse-out and obtaining an idle position point for storing the fruits and vegetables to be distributed, and thus completing the distribution optimization of agricultural products. The invention can save the computing resource and solve the problem that the delivery destination stores excessive agricultural products.

title_en: Road information reporting rewarding method, device and system based on digital currency
abstract_en: The invention discloses a road information reporting rewarding method, device and system based on digital currency, and relates to the technical field of digital currency. One embodiment of the method comprises the following steps: receiving road information reported by a vehicle-mounted system of a user side; sending a road condition information checking instruction to a road side unit based on a road address and road condition information in the road information, and receiving a road condition information checking result returned by the road side unit; and under the condition that the road condition information checking result is correct, determining the rewarding amount according to the road condition information checking result and the rewarding rule, and sending digital currency corresponding to the rewarding amount to the digital currency wallet of the user in the user information based on the digital currency platform. According to the method and the device, the road information can be reported on the vehicle-mounted system of the user, the convenience of reporting the operation flow is improved, the reported road information is comprehensive and accurate, meanwhile, rewards can be timely issued in the form of digital currency, and the user experience is improved.

title_en: Information traceability transmission system for aerated concrete production line
abstract_en: The invention discloses an information traceability transmission system for an aerated concrete production line, which belongs to the technical field of the aerated concrete production line and comprises an assembly frame and side plates, wherein identification codes are added to the assembly frame, a pouring stirrer is arranged at the outer end of the assembly frame, the pouring stirrer is in signal connection with the side plates, a pouring mold box is arranged at the outer end of the pouring stirrer, a cutting unit is arranged at the outer end of the pouring mold box, a side cutter is arranged at the outer end of the cutting unit, a trigger is arranged at the outer end of the side cutter, a clamp is arranged at the outer end of the trigger, the blank of the existing aerated concrete production line technology can be filled, the whole process management and the traceability management of products are provided for the production line, and an information automatic management scheme of the production line from a raw material purchasing, producing and selling closed-loop system is provided; and the comprehensive product life cycle control such as raw material management control, raw material quality control, product production quality management control, sales management control and the like is provided for the production line.

title_en: Industrial electricity prediction method based on seasonal index gray model
abstract_en: The invention provides an industrial electricity prediction method based on a seasonal index gray model, which comprises the steps of sampling historical data and determining a sampling data sequence, and further comprises the following steps: extracting a seasonal index; correcting the sampled data sequence; constructing a gray GM model; carrying out gray GM model prediction to form a prediction sequence of a model; performing inverse adjustment on the predicted sequence; checking the gray GM model; and outputting the predicted value. According to the industrial electricity prediction method based on the seasonal index gray model, which is provided by the invention, the internal characteristics and the development trend of the gray model good description data sequence are utilized, and the seasonal index is introduced before and after modeling by adopting the gray model to correct modeling data and restore prediction data, so that the seasonal fluctuation of real data is effectively reflected, and a more accurate prediction result is obtained.

title_en: Advertisement putting system based on big data and Internet
abstract_en: The invention discloses an advertisement putting system based on big data and the Internet, which comprises an advertisement generating module, wherein the advertisement generating module is used for generating advertisement pushing information, and the advertisement pushing information can be analyzed by equipment to generate advertisements; the target screening module screens target crowd, marks equipment of the target crowd as target equipment, and acquires equipment area S of the target equipment; the device six-dimensional analysis module is used for carrying out six-dimensional analysis on the target device and obtaining an expected area S1; the big data collection module is used for sending a preset instruction to the target crowd and collecting feedback data of the target crowd; the pushing evaluation module compares the equipment area S with the expected area S1, and when the S area is greater than or equal to S1, the corresponding target equipment is marked as pushing equipment, otherwise, the target equipment is not marked; the sending module pushes the advertisement pushing information to the pushing equipment, and the advertisement pushing method and device can automatically conduct advertisement delivery on the target crowd according to the state of the target crowd.

title_en: Automatic text labeling method, system, equipment and terminal for judge document
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data labeling, and discloses an automatic labeling method, system, equipment and terminal for texts of referee documents, wherein texts with punctuation marks are segmented into sentences and then input into a Jieba Chinese parser for word segmentation; based on word frequency word segmentation results, a path with the highest probability is found out by adopting a dynamic programming method, text word segmentation terms are stored in a word segmentation middle database, manually marked texts are trained through a machine learning model, automatic marking of the texts is realized through a constructed corpus marking library, annotation data in the database are scored and then automatically reloaded for marking, and data sorting is carried out according to marking scores. According to the method, the text enhancement and semi-supervised learning are combined, the event extraction and marking are carried out on the target case document according to the preset event extraction rule, and the labor cost of text entity marking is greatly reduced by combining an external online database, so that the efficiency and accuracy of text marking are improved.

title_en: Block chain-based coal origin tracing and cheating identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a block chain-based coal origin tracing and cheating identification method and system, and belongs to the field of coal identification. The method comprises the following steps: extracting sample characteristics of a sample coal image and extracting target characteristics of a target coal image; constructing a feature update contract, an identification contract and a production place judgment contract of the blockchain according to the sample features; based on a feature update contract called by a predictor, uploading the sample features and the information of the origin corresponding to the sample features to a block chain; based on the predictor call identification contract, uploading the target features to the blockchain for processing; and calling a producing area judgment contract based on the predictor, judging the producing area of the processed target characteristic, and obtaining the producing area information of the target coal. The invention applies the blockchain to the tracing and cheating identification of the coal production place, avoids the defects that the traditional method of inspection cannot trace the source of the coal production place, cannot detect the whole sample, has high inspection cost and slow inspection, has the cheating behavior, and can stop the adulteration behavior.

title_en: Balanced scheduling method and system applied to intelligent bus line
abstract_en: The invention relates to a balanced dispatching method and a balanced dispatching system applied to an intelligent bus line, wherein the method comprises the following steps of L1, acquiring all passenger flow historical data information of the same intelligent bus line, dividing and arranging the passenger flow historical data information by taking preset time as a period, and outputting passenger flow time sequence data information of the intelligent bus line; step 2, based on the intelligent bus line passenger flow volume time sequence data information, extracting feature data according to the original feature data information affecting the passenger flow volume to obtain a feature set acting on the passenger flow volume; and step L, based on the characteristic set acting on the passenger flow volume, performing characteristic training by adopting a GBDT algorithm, calculating the characteristic importance degree acting on the passenger flow volume and performing characteristic screening. The intelligent bus operation efficiency is improved through passenger flow synchronous optimization, the traffic efficiency is improved, the congestion is reduced, and the travel time of passengers is shortened.

title_en: Electric vehicle charging demand side response capability evaluation method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric vehicle charging demand side response capability evaluation method based on big data, and belongs to the technical field of electric power systems. According to the invention, charging behavior data of an electric vehicle owner are collected in a questionnaire investigation and data grabbing mode, charging habit data such as a charging behavior occurrence time period, a charging interval, a charging consumption time and the like are cleaned, a demand side matching degree, a battery health degree and a battery upper and lower reserve amount are respectively calculated according to charging behavior big data, and a demand side response capability of the electric vehicle is evaluated; when the charging pile operation unit is scheduled, the electric vehicle with strong response capacity on the demand side is preferentially selected. The demand side response capability evaluation method based on the charging behavior habit of the electric car owner can provide references for operation scheduling and charging electricity price of the charging pile.

title_en: Data cleaning method, system and storage medium for massive marketing and allocation data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data cleaning method, a system and a storage medium for massive nutrition and allocation data, relates to the technical field of nutrition and allocation data processing, and solves the problem that the accuracy of subsequent data analysis and processing is low due to the fact that a corresponding data cleaning method cannot be provided. The technical scheme is characterized by comprising the following steps: carrying out data layering processing on the acquired marketing and allocation data according to the data attribute to acquire first data; detecting a first data category and acquiring category information; editing a data cleaning rule through a graphical interface based on the category information; cleaning the acquired marketing and distribution data through the data cleaning rule to obtain second data; performing matching verification on the first data and the second data to obtain a verification result, and performing data association when the matching verification is inconsistent; and when the matching verification is consistent, cleaning is completed. The invention provides a data cleaning method, a system and a storage medium for massive nutrition allocation data, which realize high-quality cleaning of the data and ensure the accuracy of subsequent analysis and processing.

title_en: Intelligent hydrologic system based on Unity3D
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Unity 3D-based intelligent hydrologic system. According to the method, a full-river-basin hydrologic hydraulic model is constructed through integrating risk map results, and a full-river-basin river evolution process is calculated and forecasted. The calculation result is uploaded and released in real time through an ICHS intelligent hydrologic platform, so that interactive sharing of multiple departments (traffic, urban management and weather) of data is realized, and decision support is provided. And constructing a river intelligent hydrological model, collecting core driving data such as water level, water quality and the like in real time, and automatically detecting the water level and analyzing the water quality in real time. Compared with traditional monitoring, the current monitoring information can be released in real time, a water level and water quality simulation function is added, and a final river model and water quality panorama are obtained by adjusting various indexes and water level heights in river water. Effectively solves the problems of unilateral detection, general detection, lack of systemization and standardization and the like of the traditional technology. The water level and water quality scheduling is changed from the original scattered scheduling to the unified scheduling and supervision of the same platform, so that the water conservancy scheduling and management can be performed according to the basis and the supervision in place.

title_en: Intelligent digital lawyer consultation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for consulting an intelligent digital person lawyer, which relate to the technical field of artificial intelligent digital persons; extracting keywords in the user consultation information; the key words comprise related words in the field of the dry business; matching the keywords with the entities in the legal knowledge graph to obtain an expanded word set of the keywords; the expanded word set is a set formed by a plurality of related words of the legal field, wherein the related words of the legal field have similar meanings to those of the related words of each legal field in the key words; the entities in the legal knowledge graph are related words in the legal field; and finding out answers of the user consultation information from the legal answer library according to the expansion word set, and sending the answers to the user in a virtual digital human audio form. The invention can be used for the legal field of users to be consulted definitely, is suitable for the common masses with low legal knowledge level, and has wide legal field covered by the invention, thereby reducing the labor cost and the economic cost of legal consultation enterprises.

title_en: Supply chain system management method, device, equipment and medium based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a supply chain system management method, a supply chain system management device, supply chain system management equipment and a supply chain system management medium based on a block chain, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining transaction information to be verified, and determining a first number based on the geographic position of a supply chain participant corresponding to the transaction information, wherein the first number is the number of consensus nodes participating in the consensus; determining the second number of sub-users selected randomly in each consensus node of the block chain, and mapping the second number into a weight value when the consensus node participates in consensus; selecting a first number of consensus nodes from the consensus nodes based on the weight values and the reputation values of the consensus nodes, and taking the first number of consensus nodes as target consensus nodes participating in the consensus; and verifying the transaction message through the target consensus node to obtain a verification result. By adopting the technical scheme, the authenticity and the accuracy of the transaction information among all the participants in the supply chain are improved.

title_en: Intelligent right-of-sewage transaction system based on river sewage outlet
