abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent right-to-drain transaction system based on a river-entering drain, which is characterized in that a flowmeter and a pollutant analysis device are arranged at the river-entering drain and are respectively used for collecting data of the water quantity and pollutant discharge quantity of sewage discharged into a river by an enterprise, then the data are transmitted to a transaction system terminal, the water quantity and the actual pollutant discharge quantity of the river-entering drain are measured and calculated, and the right-to-drain and the left right-to-drain used by the enterprise in real time are judged; the system can monitor and control the use condition of the right of sewage and the influence condition on the environmental quality through the river-entering sewage outlet, thereby facilitating the ecological environmental department to master the residual right of sewage of each sewage unit after the right of sewage is traded; after the right to drain trade, the system updates the right to drain in real time, and the data is updated timely; the system can support most of quantifiable pollutants to carry out right-of-discharge transaction, and simultaneously is provided with a plurality of wind power, solar energy and other self-generating facilities, so that the problem of inconvenience caused by the fact that most river-entering sewage outlets are located in places difficult to supply power in the wild and the like can be solved.

title_en: Monitoring management system for intelligent campus
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent campuses, and particularly discloses a monitoring management system for an intelligent campus, which comprises an intelligent door lock system, a video monitoring system, an intelligent early warning notification module, an intelligent lighting system and a monitoring management system, wherein the video monitoring system comprises a first intelligent camera, a second intelligent camera and a third intelligent camera, and the first intelligent camera, the second intelligent camera and the third intelligent camera are connected with a face recognition module and a gesture safety recognition module; through campus intelligent monitoring management, gesture information and facial information when discernment student is closed in the classroom to with information transfer give at school security personnel, class teacher and student's head of a family, intelligent regulation campus light, ensured that the student is safe to leave the campus under security personnel, student's head of a family and class teacher know and accompany the circumstances, solved the student by the problem of the unable response of making the adaptation of control management after closing the classroom.

title_en: Tunnel construction geological disaster prevention and control knowledge system construction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a construction method and a construction system of a tunnel construction geological disaster prevention and control knowledge system, belongs to a data processing system or a data processing method for supervision or prediction, and aims at solving the problem that the existing effective tunnel construction geological disaster prevention and control knowledge system is lack for standardized management of tunnel construction geological disaster prevention and control knowledge. The tunnel construction geological disaster prevention and control structured knowledge base is established through the knowledge frame carding, interactive labeling, intelligent extraction and knowledge fusion processing modes, so that characteristics such as tunnel outline, engineering geology, hydrogeology, disaster type, position, scale, form, property, evolution state and the like and prevention and control principles, measures, opportunities, materials, equipment, procedures, parameters and other knowledge units related to prevention and control countermeasures and internal relations among the knowledge units are effectively managed, and intelligent analysis and intelligent decision of disaster prevention and control are guided.

title_en: Power consumption supply and demand matching method, medium and system based on power metering
abstract_en: The invention provides a power consumption supply and demand matching method, medium and system based on power metering, belonging to the technical field of power consumption supply and demand, wherein the method comprises the following steps: dividing a load area into a plurality of electricity utilization units according to electricity utilization categories to form an electricity utilization unit set; acquiring historical power metering data of each power utilization unit and historical production data corresponding to the production power utilization units in the power utilization unit set, wherein the historical power metering data is power metering data of at least one year in succession, and the historical production data is the sum of historical production data of all production enterprises in the production power utilization units; and calculating the electricity consumption load demand of the load area in the designated time period according to the historical electricity metering data and the historical production data corresponding to the production electricity consumption unit, wherein the electricity consumption load demand is the sum of the production electricity consumption load demand and the non-production electricity consumption load demand. An electrical load supply distribution including the amounts of power supplied by the plurality of power supply stations is calculated based on the electrical load demand.

title_en: Store jewelry management system
abstract_en: The invention proposes a store jewelry management system comprising: a storage module for storing existing jewelry at a store in a display counter, cash register or warehouse; the checking module is matched with the storage module to perform setting and is used for checking the existing jewelry of a store; the display module is used for displaying the designated jewelry stored in the display counter and the cash register; and the alarm module is used for carrying out safety monitoring on jewelry in the store and sending out an alarm signal when a jewelry accident occurs. The invention can perfect the management of jewelry in the store by the jewelry store.

title_en: Lithium ion battery electricity-measuring cost prediction method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a lithium ion battery electricity cost prediction method and device, and relates to the field of energy storage. The trend prediction research on the lithium ion battery electricity cost fills the gap of research on the lithium ion battery electricity cost prediction. And the sensitivity analysis on the lithium ion battery electricity-testing cost trend is beneficial to digging out the lithium ion battery electricity-testing cost sensitivity factor, and provides a reference for reducing the lithium ion battery electricity-testing cost in the future.

title_en: Industrial carbon emission detection system and method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to an industrial carbon emission detection system and a method thereof, comprising the steps of detecting actual statistical raw material consumption of raw materials consumed by current industrial production equipment in a carbon emission monitoring time period, acquiring equipment use data of the current industrial production equipment in the carbon emission monitoring time period, and generating equipment aging coefficients according to the equipment use data; calculating according to the actual statistical raw material consumption and the equipment aging coefficient and generating the current actual carbon emission; generating theoretical carbon emission and generating a current carbon emission difference value; judging whether the current carbon emission difference value is in a normal difference carbon emission range, and displaying the current actual carbon emission in real time if the current carbon emission difference value is in the normal difference carbon emission range. According to the application, the aging degree of the equipment is considered, so that the accuracy and reliability of detecting the carbon emission are improved.

title_en: Food material distribution system and distribution method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of logistics distribution, in particular to a food material distribution system and a food material distribution method. The system comprises: the food material database is stored with the temperature of the storage warehouse and the initial deterioration value of each food material, and the initial deterioration value characterizes the deterioration degree of the food material when entering the storage warehouse and is a set value; an order receiving section configured to receive order data from a user; the order data includes at least: the type of food material, the quantity of demand and the delivery address; and a food material deterioration simulation unit configured to acquire an initial deterioration value corresponding to a food material of a predetermined type from a food material database based on the type of the food material. The invention improves the quality of food materials, improves the distribution efficiency, monitors the state of the food materials in real time, provides personalized distribution service, saves resources and reduces the waste of the food materials.

title_en: Natural resource registration unit pre-demarcating method
abstract_en: A natural resource registration unit pre-defining method comprises the following steps of S1, data preparation, S2, setting a small spot searchable range and a step length change value according to the space position and the distribution situation of the small spots of a natural resource, S3, searching according to the set searching range, carrying out aggregation analysis meeting aggregation conditions to form a centralized continuous aggregation result, S4, eliminating holes in the aggregation result, S5, and circularly executing the steps S2 to S4 to obtain registration unit pre-defining results of different searching ranges. The invention uses the rights data as the basis, vectorizes the rights data into the rights small spots, and sets the searching range and the step length change value by inputting the natural resource basic data, thus realizing the automatic pre-demarcation of a plurality of natural resource registration units and providing data auxiliary support decision and multi-unit comparison application analysis for the final demarcation of the natural resource registration units.

title_en: Regulation and control method, device, equipment and medium of power equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regulating and controlling method, a device, equipment and a medium of power equipment, which comprise the steps of responding to a regulating and controlling request and determining a corresponding cascading simulation level based on the equipment structure of the power equipment; acquiring an input vector, an output vector and a state vector of the power equipment, and determining a state space model corresponding to the cascade simulation level by adopting the input vector, the output vector and the state vector; performing cascade simulation calculation on the input vector, the state vector and a state space model corresponding to the cascade simulation level by adopting target simulation software to generate a regulation simulation result; and analyzing the regulation simulation result, determining the corresponding characteristic to be regulated of the power equipment, and regulating the power equipment based on the preset regulation boundary and the characteristic to be regulated. The simulation calculation method and the simulation calculation device solve the technical problems that in the prior art, only a single component or a single physical field in the power equipment is considered, interaction between a plurality of components and the physical field in the power equipment is ignored, and the effect of regulating and controlling the power equipment is not ideal.

title_en: Public index prediction method and system based on deep learning model
abstract_en: The invention provides a public index prediction method and a public index prediction system based on a deep learning model, wherein the method comprises a shipping internal index generation step, a public index extraction processing step, an internal and external index correlation calculation step, a model establishment and a public index prediction step, wherein the shipping internal index is generated through ship full life cycle identification and various shipping related conditions, the public index is crawled by using a script language, the public index and the shipping internal index which is advanced by a certain number of days are subjected to Person correlation calculation according to a corresponding time difference, the shipping internal index and the public index of which the correlation calculation result is larger than a set threshold value are stored, the shipping index and the public index which are stored within a period of time are used as training set samples to be trained to establish the deep learning model, the shipping internal index of which all the correlation calculation results are larger than the set threshold value is used as input, and the public index of a future period is predicted according to the deep learning model, and the prediction effect is good.

title_en: Capacity allocation method, device, equipment and medium of wind power and pumped storage system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of capacity allocation of power systems, in particular to a capacity allocation method, a device, equipment and a medium of a wind power and pumped storage system, which comprise the following steps: establishing a wind power and pumped storage combined system model containing a variable-speed pumped storage unit; according to the combined system model, the flattening degree electricity cost, the net load peak-valley difference between the combined system and the regional power grid and the daily output fluctuation amount are selected as target functions, and constraint conditions of wind power output constraint, pumping and storage unit operation constraint, reservoir capacity and water level constraint are considered to establish a multi-target capacity optimization model of the wind power pumping and storage combined system; generating a typical wind power output sequence by adopting a generating countermeasures network scene generating model and a K-means clustering algorithm; and constructing a nested algorithm by adopting a multi-objective algorithm and a mixed integer linear model, and solving the multi-objective capacity optimization model to obtain a capacity optimization configuration scheme. According to the application, the new energy consumption is improved, and the new energy friendly grid-connected utilization is realized.

title_en: Data analysis processing method based on event log file
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of event log files, and particularly discloses a data analysis processing method based on the event log files, which comprises the steps of S1, power event log file acquisition, S2, power event log file classification, S3, power event log file analysis, S4, power equipment maintenance analysis, S5, line layout inspection period analysis, S6, proper maintenance duration display and S7 and proper inspection period display.

title_en: Intelligent operation and maintenance monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent operation and maintenance monitoring method and system, and relates to the field of electronic information. The application provides an intelligent operation and maintenance monitoring method, which comprises the steps of acquiring basic data of hot rolling equipment in advance, acquiring statistical templates and key monitoring data of hot rolling strokes corresponding to different areas according to local settings of different production line areas, and uploading the key monitoring data to a sharing platform.

title_en: System and method for learning words based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of literacy teaching, and discloses a literacy system and method based on artificial intelligence. The character learning system comprises: a display module; the teaching module is used for calling the corresponding teaching content to display and output; four links of reading, reciting, slicing and flashing are required to be sequentially executed in the teaching module, and the translation link is optional according to different learning requirements; the assessment module is used for calling the corresponding assessment content to display and output; the intelligent control module is used for scoring teaching contents or examination contents corresponding to the pronunciation data according to the pronunciation data acquired by the voice acquisition module, and selecting a corresponding teaching mode and an examination mode according to the accuracy, repetition times and user history achievement data of the acquired pronunciation phonemes after the current teaching contents or examination contents are finished. The learning system can greatly reduce the invalid exercise times through the continuous interaction process with the user, so that the learning efficiency can be improved.

title_en: Illegal account identification method based on graph comparison learning
abstract_en: The invention provides an illegal account identification method based on graph comparison learning, which comprises the steps of preprocessing transaction data and constructing the transaction data into a transaction network graph; extracting account history transaction characteristics; obtaining each account node subgraph through breadth-first traversal sampling, filtering neighbor nodes based on account balance, transaction size and transaction frequency, retaining important neighbors, and generating a comparison sample; performing contrast learning by using the generated contrast sample and the original sample, and training a model to obtain an embedded representation containing local structures and node characteristics; and (3) classifying and identifying, namely embedding the obtained nodes into a full-connection layer for processing, and classifying and identifying illegal accounts through multiple classifications. The problems of inherent local structural characteristics and unbalanced classes of the graph which cannot be effectively captured by the traditional method are solved. The method has more pertinence, accuracy and effectiveness for illegal account identification.

title_en: Workflow configuration method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a workflow configuration method, a workflow configuration device, an electronic device and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical fields of financial science and technology, information technology industry and automatic programming. The method comprises the following steps: identifying whether a current node of the initial workflow is a node of a target class; if the current node is a node of the target class, configuring first information of the current node, wherein the first information comprises a processing object; if the current node is not the node of the target class, configuring second information of the current node, wherein the second information does not comprise a processing object; acquiring a next node of the current node; updating the next node of the current node as the current node, and returning to execute the node for identifying whether the current node is the target class and the subsequent steps. Therefore, whether the current node is the node of the target class can be identified, and the first information or the second information of the current node is configured according to the identification result, so that the method is applicable to the configuration scenes of various nodes and further applicable to the configuration scenes of various workflows.

title_en: Gas pipeline safety evaluation early warning system, method and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas pipeline safety evaluation early warning system, a gas pipeline safety evaluation early warning method and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of data analysis, wherein the gas pipeline safety evaluation early warning system comprises a device layer, a data storage layer and a control layer; the equipment layer comprises a pressure gauge, a pressure transmitter, a flowmeter, a CPU and an alarm; the data storage layer is used for storing data generated by the system; the control layer comprises a region division module, a gas flow monitoring module, a pipeline pressure measuring module, a safety evaluation module and an early warning module, wherein the region division module is used for dividing a gas pipeline, the gas flow monitoring module is used for monitoring gas flow of a gas inlet and a gas outlet of the gas pipeline, the pipeline pressure measuring module is used for measuring internal and external pressure values of the gas pipeline, the safety evaluation module is used for evaluating safety of the gas pipeline, and the early warning module is used for early warning. The invention improves the practicability of the safety evaluation of the gas pipeline and avoids the influence of artificial evaluation on evaluation early warning.

title_en: Method and device for constructing risk prediction model and method and device for risk prevention and control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for constructing and controlling risk prediction models, and relates to the technical field of computers, wherein the method for constructing the risk prediction models comprises the following steps: according to the risk type of the service object, a corresponding initial risk value is given to the service object; according to the interaction relation between the business objects, combining the initial risk values to determine the comprehensive risk value of the business objects; determining a risk label of the business object according to the comprehensive risk value; and training a risk prediction model according to the interactive behavior data of the business object and the corresponding risk label. According to the scheme, the risk prediction model can be effectively trained, and the efficiency and accuracy of risk prediction are improved.

title_en: Information reminding method, device, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an information reminding method, an information reminding device, terminal equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: inquiring a preset product list to obtain product information; traversing a preset rule set through the product information to obtain the rule set of the product information; and generating a notification reminder according to the rule set of the product information. The invention solves the problem of low flexibility of product configuration in the information disclosure reminding rule, and improves the efficiency of information reminding.

title_en: Image feature determining method and device for target object and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device, computer equipment, a storage medium and a computer program product for determining portrait characteristics of a target object, and relates to the technical field of big data. The method comprises the following steps: and determining each data change interval and each data analysis index interval corresponding to the target object based on the resource interaction data corresponding to the target object, and generating the resource interaction image characteristic of the target object based on the first accumulated resource characteristic, the second accumulated resource characteristic and the excess resource characteristic of each interval. By adopting the method, on the basis of acquiring the resource interaction data of the target object, the plurality of portrait features of the target object are determined through the plurality of feature determination models, so that quantitative evaluation of the target object in terms of resource interaction is realized, and the accuracy of evaluation and the effectiveness of the generated portrait features are ensured.

title_en: Digital rural management platform and management method
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital rural management platform and a digital rural management method, and relates to the technical field of rural management. The platform comprises: the basic information acquisition module is used for acquiring basic condition information of village personnel and basic information of village projects in a corresponding range; the characteristic analysis module is used for carrying out characteristic analysis and generating personnel characteristic information and project characteristic information; the personnel channel establishing module is used for establishing personnel management channels between management personnel and each common person; the project equipment association module is used for associating each project with the project equipment to generate project equipment association information; the personnel and project association module is used for associating corresponding personnel with projects to generate personnel and project association information; the project channel establishing module is used for establishing a project management channel between a manager and a project; and the management module is used for managing personnel and projects. The application combines the characteristics of rural personnel and projects to realize comprehensive, accurate and efficient rural digital management.

title_en: Rice field methane emission prediction method, system, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a paddy field methane emission prediction method, a paddy field methane emission prediction system, a paddy field methane emission prediction device and a paddy field methane emission storage medium, wherein the paddy field methane emission prediction method comprises the following steps: determining the emission influencing factors of paddy methane; acquiring paddy methane historical data according to the emission influencing factors, and constructing a prediction model in advance according to the paddy methane historical data; obtaining actual measurement data of influence factors according to the emission influence factors, constructing a variable data set according to the actual measurement data of the influence factors, and performing parameter optimization on a pre-constructed prediction model based on the variable data set to obtain an optimal prediction model; and carrying out variable prediction based on the variable data set and the optimal prediction model, and outputting a paddy methane emission prediction value. According to the application, the prediction model is constructed and parameter optimization is carried out, so that the prediction model has good nonlinear characteristics and generalization; the influence factors are input into the prediction model to predict the emission, so that the influence problem of environmental parameters and soil hydraulic parameters can be well solved, and the prediction effect is good.

title_en: Multi-wheel dialogue teaching method and system for intelligent robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-round dialogue teaching method and a system for an intelligent robot, comprising the following steps: constructing a multi-wheel dialogue robot corresponding to each course based on the teaching plan file of each course uploaded by a teacher; the multi-round dialogue robot comprises a natural language understanding module, a dialogue strategy module and an action server; based on courses selected by students, starting a corresponding course multi-round dialogue robot to give dialogue to the students; acquiring a voice text corresponding to the voice of the student, and identifying the intention of the student corresponding to the voice text based on a natural language understanding module; if the student intention is identified, selecting sentences from the action server to reply the student based on the dialogue strategy module by utilizing the student intention; otherwise, an auxiliary question-answering module is called, and sentences are selected from the question-answering database to answer students by using the voice text. The intelligent system has the advantages that the teaching effect of the intelligent system is improved, the intelligent system is more in line with the teaching scene of a real teacher, and an auxiliary question-answering module is additionally added, so that the robot teaching is more intelligent.

title_en: Data processing system, data processing method, program, and data processing integration system
abstract_en: The present invention solves the problem of providing spatially coordinated items to a user. The data processing system (1) according to the invention comprises an acquisition unit (102) and a generation unit (103). An acquisition unit (102) acquires field investigation data relating to a space. Based on the field survey data, a generation unit (103) changes at least one of a size, a design, and a function represented by item data related to items to be placed in a space to coordinate the items with the space, and generates item processing data for processing items corresponding to the changed item data. The field survey data includes spatially related data relating to a space. A generation unit (103) generates article processing data based on the spatially correlated data.

title_en: Bird migration route graph theory modeling method based on GPS tracking data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bird migration route graph theory modeling method based on GPS tracking data, which comprises the following steps: step 1, considering the migration behavior mode of birds and the space-time distribution characteristics of stopping points, constructing a self-adaptive space-time clustering module according to the track in GPS tracking data, wherein the self-adaptive space-time clustering module is used for merging adjacent merging state segments, extracting the merging state segments and obtaining candidate stopping points; step 2, taking the energy attenuation coefficient of bird migration into consideration, giving the weight of the edges between candidate stay points, and further establishing a graph model of bird migration routes V denotes a set of nodes of the graph model G, and E denotes a set of edges connecting two nodes of the graph model G. The invention is used for analyzing and evaluating the migration routes of different birds. The invention belongs to the technical field of graphic mining and processing of space-time data.

title_en: Solenoid valve with replaceable filter screen and method for determining specification of filter screen
abstract_en: The invention relates to a solenoid valve with a replaceable filter screen and a method for determining the specification of the filter screen, which comprises a solenoid valve body, wherein a plurality of grooves are formed in the solenoid valve body, an oil inlet and a control oil port are formed in the grooves, an elastic filter screen is embedded in the grooves and covers the control oil port and the oil inlet, an opening is formed in the elastic filter screen, and the elastic filter screen is elastic, and can be embedded into the grooves or taken out of the grooves in a manner of expanding the opening, so that the convenience of replacing the elastic filter screen is greatly improved.

title_en: Visual configuration method for insurance products based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of insurance, in particular to a visual configuration method of an insurance product based on data analysis. The method comprises the steps of recording internal data and client data of an insurance company according to client behaviors, and outputting all insurance products interested by clients; classifying and sorting the data by adopting a machine learning algorithm, and extracting key factors; configuring insurance products in a free combination mode according to key factors, generating a plurality of alternative configuration schemes, and outputting optimal insurance product combinations from the configuration schemes; and (5) inputting the configuration scheme to output an analysis result, and displaying the analysis result to a client in a visual mode. The invention is convenient to determine the insurance products of interest of the clients, configures the optimal insurance product combination aiming at the insurance products of interest of the clients, is favorable for analyzing the client demands and preferences on the premise of meeting the configuration efficiency and the recommendation service, and realizes more efficient, convenient and accurate insurance product configuration and personalized recommendation service.

title_en: Oscillation risk sensitivity analysis method for direct-current transmission end alternating-current system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oscillation risk sensitivity analysis method of a direct-current transmission end alternating-current system, which comprises the steps of firstly classifying oscillations generated by a direct-current transmission end alternating-current network into local oscillations and non-local oscillations; according to the alternating current grid structure of the direct current end of the actual engineering, determining and constructing an equivalent alternating current network simplified network model; according to the actual situation and the equivalent alternating current network simplified network model, a complex network weighting network model of the power system is established; and defining oscillation risk characteristic indexes, and performing sensitivity analysis by the oscillation risk indexes based on the complex network weighted network model of the power system. According to the oscillation risk characteristic index provided by the invention, the sensitivity relation between the system network structure and the parameters to the oscillation risk can be obtained by only establishing a complex network weighting model of the power system and a sensitivity algorithm; easy to implement and strong in practicability, and is more beneficial to engineering practice.

title_en: Article warehouse-in processing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for warehousing articles, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of computers. One embodiment of the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a corresponding article set and a target time period, and inquiring a corresponding historical time period; acquiring a historical sales volume, a historical stock volume and a historical warehouse-in volume corresponding to each preset period in a historical time period, calculating the association relation between the stock volume of the articles and the warehouse-in volume of the articles, calculating the change trend of the historical warehouse-in volume of each article, and determining a constraint condition set; the method comprises the steps of obtaining initial inventory of each article, calling a preset turnover number of days determining model, taking the initial inventory as a model input parameter, and determining a warehousing strategy of each article in the article set through a constraint condition set so as to execute article warehousing operation. According to the method and the device, the problem that the turnover rate of the article is affected due to the fact that the accuracy of the warehousing strategy is low as the warehousing strategy for determining the article according to the manual experience is too dependent on the manual experience can be solved.

title_en: Method for deducing economic attribute missing value of power consumer
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inference method of economic attribute missing values of electric power users. Clustering is carried out again on the complete data subsets in the user group, the outlier users are eliminated to obtain a cluster class, and a relation model of missing attributes and undelayed attributes is generated according to the cluster class. And inputting the incomplete data subset in the user group into the model, and calculating the value of the missing economic attribute. According to the invention, the users are divided into different user groups, and model training is carried out in the groups, so that the difference between the non-user groups and the similarity between the same user groups can be well utilized, and the accuracy of deducing the missing economic attribute is improved.

title_en: Data asset management platform, electronic device, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a data asset management platform, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the data asset management platform comprises: the data acquisition module is used for acquiring service data from one or more data sources; the data processing module comprises an offline sub-module and a real-time sub-module; the off-line sub-module performs business data processing on the data in the digital warehouse through a Kettle task, and the data warehouse layer is operated to the data warehouse layer and the data mart layer is operated to the data warehouse layer; the real-time sub-module performs real-time calculation on the butt joint Kafka queue, and the butt joint Kafka queue falls into a data warehouse layer from an operation data layer, the data warehouse layer is accessed to KAFKA through OGG, and then the data warehouse layer is synchronized to a data mart layer in real time by OGG; the data asset management module is used for standardizing and fusing various types of data source data to obtain standardized data; and the data management and control module is used for distributing the standardized data. By the technical scheme, the asset, manageability and controllable requirements on the target data can be realized.

title_en: Processing method and device of fund data and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for processing fund data and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring credit card account data of a credit card user; if the overflow payment exists in the credit card account of the credit card user, pushing financial product purchasing information to the credit card user; and after receiving a financial buying request instruction of the credit card user, finishing the financial product buying based on the overflow payment, and recording the purchased financial product as the overflow payment financial product. According to the embodiment of the invention, the user is guided to pay and purchase financial resources by overflowing, the income is automatically earned for the user, and the payment is automatically redeemed and paid until the next payment date, so that the utilization rate of the overflowing funds is improved, the financial resources are earned for the user, the payment can be carried out on schedule on the bill date, and the commission of the credit card over-period payment is reduced.

title_en: Intelligent automatic course arrangement method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent automatic course arranging method, a system, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of distributing a plurality of first templates to a plurality of computers, and randomly designating classrooms and time for each first template to obtain a plurality of second templates; carrying out hard constraint condition inspection on each piece of to-be-class data in the plurality of second templates, and calculating a satisfaction rate of each piece of to-be-class data meeting the hard constraint condition by adopting a soft constraint mathematical model to obtain a plurality of satisfaction rate values corresponding to each piece of to-be-class data; selecting a highest satisfaction rate value from the plurality of satisfaction rate values, marking the successful course arrangement mark on the course arrangement data corresponding to the highest satisfaction rate value which is larger than or equal to the expected satisfaction rate value, and deleting the course arrangement data which are marked with the successful course arrangement mark in the course arrangement data set; and adopting the data set to be processed after deleting the data set to be processed after the successful processing mark is processed in the data set to be processed to process the next iteration. The application can improve the course arrangement efficiency and quality.

title_en: Method, device and system for authorizing subscription
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a method and a device for authorizing subscription. The method comprises the steps that a target SDK integrated in a merchant application responds to a call request of the merchant application, information acquisition is carried out on equipment to obtain first equipment information, and the first equipment information and a signing application are sent to an intermediate server. And the intermediate server sends an authorization request to a first service side providing the first electronic wallet according to the subscription application. The middle page responds to the authorization code for the authorization request received from the first service side, acquires information of the equipment where the middle page is located to obtain second equipment information, and sends the second equipment information to the middle server. The intermediate server verifies that the first device information and the second device information are consistent and in case they are consistent, obtains an authorization code from the intermediate page, and then uses the authorization code to obtain an access token from the first server, which is forwarded to the merchant application.

title_en: Ecological treatment method for reservoir hydro-fluctuation belt of pumped storage power station
abstract_en: The invention provides an ecological management method for a water-level-fluctuating zone of a water storage power station reservoir, which comprises the following steps: acquiring water level data of a reservoir, exposure time of each elevation and sunlight time range; determining a hydro-fluctuation belt range according to the water level data; and carrying out regional treatment on the hydro-fluctuation belt according to the water level data, the exposure time of each elevation in the hydro-fluctuation belt range, the sunshine time range and the like, wherein the region comprises an engineering measure treatment region, an ecological treatment protection region and a vegetation recovery buffer region. Therefore, the ecological management problem of the hydro-fluctuation belt area can be fundamentally solved by accurately dividing the management area of the hydro-fluctuation belt of the pumped storage power station and configuring different management measures for different areas.

title_en: Public comprehensive traffic system accessibility computing method
abstract_en: The application relates to a method for calculating the accessibility of a public comprehensive traffic system, which comprises the following steps: step S1, constructing a public transportation line library and a site library based on urban public transportation network information and public transportation line schedule data; step S2, based on a public transportation line library and a site library, public line connection between sites is obtained, and a comprehensive traffic network weighted directed graph is constructed by combining a walking mode; s3, planning a shortest path between each travel OD pair on the basis of a graph network of a comprehensive traffic network weighted directed graph, and generating an OD travel matrix; and S4, rasterizing the urban area, and calculating the traffic accessibility of each grid area based on the generated OD travel matrix. The application realizes the accurate correspondence between the traffic accessibility and the traffic network structure and the dynamic allocation of resources.

title_en: Mobile terminal payment electricity purchasing anti-fraud method and system based on biological probe technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fraud detection, in particular to a mobile terminal payment electricity purchasing anti-fraud method based on a biological probe technology; the method comprises the steps of acquiring a first position coordinate of a mobile terminal when acquiring a first face image of a target object, judging whether the first face image is matched with registered first face information of the target object stored in the mobile terminal, if so, moving the mobile terminal from the first position coordinate to a second position coordinate, acquiring a second face image of the target object after the mobile terminal moves to the second position coordinate, and if so, confirming that user authentication is passed by the terminal, wherein in the process of identity authentication, the face image of the target object corresponds to the space position coordinate, and a biological probe sensor in the mobile terminal is used for recording a change track of the space position coordinate of the mobile terminal, so that fraudulent behavior during authentication is effectively prevented and controlled.

title_en: Comprehensive management prediction method for carbon emission of charging pile and storage medium
abstract_en: According to the application, the big data cloud management platform of the charging equipment is established to collect the carbon emission related data of the charging equipment, the big data cloud management platform is used for carrying out carbon emission monitoring on the charging equipment based on the carbon emission related data, scoring the carbon emission of the charging equipment based on the carbon emission related data, obtaining the running health index of the charging equipment based on the scoring result, regulating and controlling the charging equipment according to the running health index, counting the carbon emission condition of the charging equipment, and predicting the carbon arrival peak condition of the charging equipment based on the counting result, so that the comprehensive management and monitoring of the charging equipment are combined, the carbon neutralization route can be more comprehensively and effectively determined, the economic and social development and the balanced development of the charging equipment layout can be realized, and the safe and efficient carbon neutralization route is finally realized.

title_en: Engineering cost consultation service management method, system, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of engineering project management, in particular to an engineering cost consultation service management method, an engineering cost consultation service management system, terminal equipment and a storage medium. If the data integrity corresponding to the cost data does not meet the cost task integrity standard corresponding to the project cost management task, stopping the data processing operation and outputting a data empty item corresponding to the cost data; if yes, judging whether the data matching degree of the cost data meets the data matching degree standard corresponding to the project cost management task; if the data is not matched with the target cost data, matching the corresponding target cost data according to the data matching degree standard, and taking the target cost data as updated cost data; if the data is in accordance with the data, a construction cost result report corresponding to the construction project category is generated, and the construction cost consultation service management method, the system, the terminal equipment and the storage medium provided by the application have the normative effect of improving the corresponding data processing of the construction cost consultation service.

title_en: Robot asset inventory method based on multi-sensor fusion
abstract_en: A robot asset counting method and system based on multi-sensor fusion relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and adopts RFID, multi-line laser radar and IMU multi-sensor fusion to acquire asset information of a counting area, the asset information is input into a map building algorithm as a strong point of a point cloud to finish the construction of a real-time high-precision asset point cloud map, the asset position information is directly visualized in the asset point cloud map, the mode of manually memorizing the asset position in the traditional counting mode is improved, the problems of unclear fixed asset position and the like are solved, the conditions of dynamic adjustment of the asset and the like can be responded quickly, abnormal reports of missing detection and false detection can be given quickly through comparing the asset information of corresponding assets in a robot identification area, the manual counting step is saved in the whole counting process, the intelligent degree is improved, and the fixed asset counting period is shortened effectively.

title_en: Electric automobile charging load prediction method, system and prediction terminal
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a system and a terminal for predicting charging load of an electric automobile, which belong to the technical field of electric automobiles, wherein a predicted time period is configured, split is carried out on the predicted time period, and travel starting time, travel time period and travel ending time of the electric automobile are obtained; classifying the electric vehicles based on the travel starting time and the travel ending time, and drawing a frequency distribution histogram; establishing an association relation between the residual electric quantity and the driving mileage of the electric automobile; respectively calculating the probability of starting charging of the electric automobile in the first period, the probability of not stopping charging in the first period and the probability of not fully charging in the first period; calculating the probability that the electric automobile is being charged in the first period of time; and calculating the load generated by the electric automobile in the first period. The application can respectively fit according to different conditions to generate more relevant probability density functions. The prediction result is more practical.

title_en: Automatic construction method and system for procedure solid model of rotary part with allowance optimization
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for automatically constructing a procedure solid model of a rotary part taking allowance optimization into consideration, wherein firstly, the structural characteristic range of the part model is obtained; constructing a layer intersection element by the intersection surface, defining and judging element types, and identifying axial layering characteristics; then, calculating corresponding characteristic parameters of the turning working procedure piece, and perfecting turning body layer elements; optimizing turning body layering element according to the technological requirements to adapt to machining allowance; and finally, judging the corresponding relation among the pixels, and constructing a turning process model. The invention effectively realizes automatic modeling of the turning process model of the rotary cabin body with complex inner cavity, remarkably reduces the pressure of manually constructing the process model by process staff while ensuring the standardization, standardability and rationality of the process model, and provides an effective basis for CAM programming of the turning process.

title_en: Cargo distribution planning method, device, equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a cargo distribution planning method, a cargo distribution planning device, cargo distribution planning equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the cargo distribution planning method comprises the following steps: acquiring the service requirement of a user; determining distribution points in each cluster by dividing N distribution points into K clusters according to the positions of the main warehouse, the positions of the distribution points and parameters of aggregation degrees which are required to be met for dividing N distribution points; and determining M delivery routes starting from the main warehouse position and delivery amounts of the delivery routes according to the positions of the delivery points in each cluster and the cargo demand of each delivery point. The application can flexibly control the distribution amount of each area while meeting the aggregation property.

title_en: Risk monitoring method, device, system, equipment and medium for leasing transaction
abstract_en: The application relates to a risk monitoring method, a device, a system, equipment and a medium for leasing transaction, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the contract amount of the renting contract and the operation information of renting equipment; judging whether the contract amount is smaller than the balance of a preset risk pool or not, if yes, storing the renting contract into the risk pool, wherein the balance of the risk pool is the difference between the preset limit of the risk pool and the current accumulated contract amount of the risk pool; judging whether the renting contract meets a preset risk early warning rule according to the operation information, if so, carrying out early warning on the renting contract, and moving the renting contract out of the risk pool; updating the risk pool balance. The application puts forward the concept of the risk pool and sets the limit of the risk pool, ensures that the leasing company controls the risk within a certain limit range, and continuously makes large leasing amount by orderly entering and exiting leasing projects in the risk pool, thereby obtaining the maximum income.

title_en: Transaction business reconciliation method, device, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a transaction business reconciliation method, a device, an electronic device and a readable storage medium, comprising the following steps: acquiring message quantity account checking information and amount account checking information of a target transaction service carried by at least one account checking sub-account; the message quantity account checking information is input to a general account checking model together, and account checking is carried out on the message quantity of each account checking sub-account through the general account checking model, so that message quantity account checking results respectively corresponding to each account checking sub-account are obtained; when the message quantity checking result is detected to display message quantity checking, the sum checking information is input into a general checking model together, and the sum of each checking sub-account is checked through the general checking model to obtain sum checking results corresponding to each checking sub-account respectively; and posting the sum of money to the posting total account commonly corresponding to each posting sub-account to obtain the posting result of the posting total account for posting the target transaction business. The application solves the technical problem of high checking complexity of checking transaction business.

title_en: Industrial flexible load matching method, system, medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an industrial flexible load matching method, an industrial flexible load matching system, a medium and industrial flexible load matching equipment, wherein an industrial flexible load linear complementary coordination matrix is constructed and all industrial flexible loads are incorporated; calculating the multi-dimensional requirement of a multi-type new energy consumption problem scene on an adjustment target, quantifying the multi-dimensional adjustment requirement, and forming a requirement column vector of the same dimension of the industrial flexible load linear complementary coordination matrix; utilizing the tight constraint in the multi-dimensional regulation requirement of the regulation target to carry out preliminary screening on the industrial flexible load; obtaining a preliminarily screened complementary coordination matrix, and constructing a high-dimensional linear complementary problem model matched with a multi-dimensional vector of a multi-type new energy consumption problem scene adjusting target on the basis of a linear complementary theory and by considering uncertainty of industrial flexible load; and solving the obtained high-dimensional linear complementary problem model to realize the matching of the industrial flexible load and the multi-type new energy consumption problem scene.

title_en: Maintenance effect evaluation method and system for water pump motor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a maintenance effect evaluation method and a system for a water pump motor, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a calibration feature set of a water pump motor; constructing a historical data set of the water pump motor, wherein the historical data set comprises a fault data set, a maintenance data set and a use data set; generating an aging influence factor by using the data set as an evaluation index; establishing a mapping maintenance effect evaluation index of the fault and the maintenance strategy by taking the maintenance data set as zero time; and taking the real-time data set as basic data, mapping maintenance effect evaluation indexes as evaluation data, taking aging influence factors as compensation data, executing maintenance effect evaluation, and performing equipment management of the water pump motor. The invention solves the technical problem of low accuracy of the evaluation result due to single maintenance effect evaluation index of the water pump motor in the prior art, and achieves the technical effects of improving the accuracy and comprehensiveness of the water pump maintenance effect evaluation through multi-dimensional index evaluation.

title_en: Site selection method for complete residential community endowment service facility
abstract_en: The invention discloses a site selection method of a complete living community endowment service facility, which comprises the following steps: determining the range and boundary of the complete residential community S to be researched, and obtaining the current senile service facility point and the candidate senile service facility point J  N  Information and data of (a); determining the number N of cells contained in a complete living community S  S  Cell number I  S  Cell footprint M  S  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Determining a weighting coefficient of each cell in the complete residential community based on the multidimensional element; determining a weight coefficient of the current senile service facility point and the candidate senile service facility point based on the multidimensional element; determining a travel distance r; through minimum impedance traffic accessibility analysis, ARCGIS software is utilized to select service points J of senile facilities  1  Forming a travel buffer zone; calculating the community senile service coverage rate P of the facility point by combining the weighting coefficient of the cell determined in the step three  J1  Combining the facility point weight system determined in the step fourCounting, calculating feasibility index H of the service point to arrange senile service facilities  J1  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Senile service facility feasibility index H for comparing all alternative pension facility points  JN  And finally determining the most preferred site point of the pension facility.

title_en: Quasi-synchronous large-scale multi-station offshore ocean current continuous observation method, system and application
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ocean observation data acquisition, and discloses a quasi-synchronous large-scale multi-station offshore ocean current continuous observation method, a quasi-synchronous large-scale multi-station offshore ocean current continuous observation system and application. The observation method is to optimize the space and time aspects of the observation station, the investigation ship and the investigation sequence of the multi-station synchronous ocean current continuous observation; each investigation ship needs to complete investigation tasks of 1-2 stations in sequence in the tide period; the observation efficiency of multi-ship synchronous ocean current observation is improved, the utilization rate of investigation ships is improved, and 2 batches of ocean current observation can be efficiently completed in 1 typical tide period; on the premise of basically equivalent workload, the invention increases the investigation capability of one time of investigation units, solves the problem of insufficient quantity of investigation personnel, investigation ships and observation equipment, and provides quasi-synchronous multi-station ocean current continuous observation data which are basically the same as the ocean current data obtained by the conventional method in quality through actual inspection.

title_en: Monitoring device for monitoring working state
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring device for monitoring working states, and belongs to the technical field of building construction safety management. The invention relates to a monitoring device for monitoring working states, which comprises a field operation terminal, a safety management terminal, a data processing unit and an alarm unit. The invention solves the problem that the working state of constructors cannot be accurately and efficiently mastered in the prior art, the mobile terminal is matched with the safety helmet, the vest and the bracelet, positioning data, gravity acceleration data and physical sign data acquired by the safety helmet, the vest and the bracelet are pushed to the PC terminal in real time, management staff can conveniently master the working state of constructors in real time, the acquired positioning data, gravity acceleration data and physical sign data are subjected to comparative analysis through the data processing unit, alarm information is generated when abnormality occurs, the alarm information is used for reminding the constructors and the management staff, and the management staff is assisted in making safety production management decisions, so that the safety of the constructors is guaranteed.

title_en: Method for rapidly predicting network advertisement space effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of network advertisements, and discloses a method for rapidly predicting the effect of a network advertisement space, which comprises the following steps: s1, collecting effective crowds, such as the crowds with advertisements clicked or the crowds with apps opened, which are usually real high-quality users, suggesting that the number of the collected crowds is at least 1000 ten thousand, and counting the click rate, the wake-up rate (the number of apps opened) or other effects of the high-quality users. The method for rapidly predicting the network advertisement space effect realizes the effect which is not known in advance, in addition, not only click rate and wake-up rate can be predicted, but also other advertisement effects can be predicted, and then comparison tests are carried out on 2 positions with the best prediction effect and 2 positions with the worst prediction effect, so that the prediction effect can be found, and the effective control error is within 10%, thereby providing auxiliary reference for clients, enabling the clients to know the expected effect, enabling the clients to trust, and further improving the input cost of the clients.

title_en: Shared vehicle temporary parking control method, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, equipment and a storage medium for controlling temporary parking of a shared vehicle, and relates to the technical field of shared vehicle control, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring first vehicle state information in response to the vehicle request information; when the requested shared vehicle is in a temporary parking state: acquiring first order information, confirming a second user, and sending vehicle release request information to the second user; acquiring feedback information, and judging whether to release the requested shared vehicle according to the feedback information; if the first order information is released, the first order information is settled, the second order information is created, and an unlocking signal is sent. When the first user requests to use the shared vehicle in the temporary parking state, the second user rented at present is reminded, the second user is prevented from forgetting the temporary parked shared vehicle, the unplanned expense is avoided to be increased, if the second user agrees to release the temporary parked shared vehicle, the first user can rent the shared vehicle, the use efficiency of the shared vehicle is improved, and the shared vehicle resources are fully utilized.

title_en: Method and device for building commodity replenishing flow, storage medium and computer equipment
abstract_en: According to the method, the device, the storage medium and the computer equipment for constructing the commodity supplementing flow, when a user triggers a request operation for constructing the target commodity supplementing flow, the request operation can be responded, a target commodity supplementing scene and a target commodity supplementing mode corresponding to the target commodity supplementing flow are obtained, and then common nodes and characteristic nodes in a service logic node pool are determined; therefore, after determining the common node and the characteristic node in the service logic node pool, the application can call the preset node router to connect the common node and the characteristic node in the service logic node pool in series according to the target replenishment scene and the target replenishment mode, and then form the target replenishment flow corresponding to the target replenishment scene.

title_en: Legal consultation report generation system and method based on legal knowledge graph
abstract_en: The application discloses a legal consultation report generating system and a method based on a legal knowledge graph, which relate to the technical field of legal consultation and comprise data acquisition, wherein a large amount of legal related data, including legal provision, cases, legal documents and the like, are stored and updated in real time in the legal consultation report generating system; data processing, namely cleaning and arranging the data through a natural language processing technology; constructing a knowledge graph, and structuring and organizing massive data by a knowledge graph technology to construct a knowledge graph comprising information such as entities, attributes, relations and the like; an intelligent question-answering engine; generating a consultation report; reporting the assessment; and (5) optimizing the system. The application can solve the problems of limited human resource pressure, limited manual legal knowledge storage, low analysis and solution efficiency, subjective errors, low service quality and the like in the legal consultation service process, thereby providing a more comprehensive, efficient and reliable solution.

title_en: Transformer substation equipment abnormality detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of abnormality detection of substation equipment, and particularly discloses a method and a system for detecting the abnormality of the substation equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the invention not only can accurately provide more scientific data support for the subsequent analysis of the abnormal operation condition of the whole main transformer equipment, but also can ensure the reliability and operation stability of the substation equipment to a certain extent, and can effectively reflect the actual condition of the operation abnormality of the power electronic equipment by judging the operation abnormality degree index of each power electronic equipment.

title_en: Electronic cigarette production data management system based on big data
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to an electronic cigarette production data management system based on big data, which comprises a data acquisition module: collecting quality characteristic data of the electronic cigarette; and a data processing module: obtaining the distinguishing strength of each quality feature according to the quality feature data change; constructing a correlation index of each feature combination according to the difference between the quality feature data sequences of each electronic cigarette; combining the distinguishing strength of each quality feature to obtain the quality feature optimization rate of each feature combination; and the early warning module is used for: and obtaining the optimal feature combination of each decision tree according to the quality feature optimization rate, and completing the classification management of the electronic cigarettes by combining a random forest algorithm. Therefore, the electronic cigarette production data management is realized, the correlation among different decision trees is reduced, the accuracy of a random forest algorithm model is improved, and the quality evaluation accuracy of the electronic cigarette is improved.

title_en: Digital economic community retail distributed computing system based on shared consumption profit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of shared consumption, in particular to a digital economic community retail distributed computing system based on shared consumption profits. The system comprises a private domain operation management module, an operation scheme matching module and a promotion rule making module. According to the invention, the private domain operation management module is used for collecting information of passenger sources around off-line shops, promoting the off-line shops, providing commodity information existing in the off-line shops for the passenger sources according to the requirements of the various passenger sources of the off-line shops, promoting customer consumption, matching an operation scheme for the corresponding shops according to a commodity supply channel and a shop sales state through the operation scheme matching module, formulating a promotion rule through the promotion rule formulating module, determining a commodity discount rate adjustment range, an integral gift rule, various weight value allocations and transaction residual value allocation rules, formulating residual value allocation rules generated by commodity purchase each time, and reasonably allocating residual values generated by commodity purchase each time of the passenger sources.

title_en: AR technology-based traditional Chinese medicine decoction piece purchasing method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of computers, and aims to provide a traditional Chinese medicine decoction piece purchasing method, system, equipment and medium based on an AR technology. According to the application, through the AR display, a vivid, visual and interactive display effect of the traditional Chinese medicine decoction pieces can be provided for a user in the process of purchasing the traditional Chinese medicine decoction pieces, so that the user can intuitively feel the character characteristics of the traditional Chinese medicine decoction pieces, further, the experience of the user in the process of purchasing the traditional Chinese medicine decoction pieces can be enhanced, the purchase will of the user can be improved, the return rate of the traditional Chinese medicine decoction pieces can be reduced, the electronic commercialization development of the traditional Chinese medicine decoction pieces can be promoted, and the popularization and application values are realized.

title_en: Medicine data processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a medicine data processing method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring medicine preparation historical data of each medicine preparation main body and medicine inventory information in a target period; determining medicine demand information of the medicine preparation main body in a target period according to the medicine preparation historical data of each medicine preparation main body; generating a drug scheduling task based on drug inventory information and drug demand information of each drug preparation subject; and sending the medicine scheduling task to the medicine scheduling terminal so that the medicine scheduling terminal executes the medicine scheduling action according to the medicine scheduling task. According to the application, the medicine scheduling task is generated by each medicine preparation main body in medicine inventory information and medicine demand information, so that intelligent scheduling of Tibetan medicine among different medicine preparation main bodies is realized, each Tibetan medicine preparation main body is ensured to have sufficient medicine raw materials in a target period, and the overall preparation efficiency of all Tibetan medicine preparation main bodies in a regional range is improved.

title_en: Park comprehensive energy system scheduling method based on double-layer distributed robust predictive game
abstract_en: The invention provides a park comprehensive energy system scheduling method based on double-layer distributed robust prediction game, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing a park comprehensive energy system scheduling model and collecting reference operation information of a future period system; the comprehensive energy service provider is used as a game upper layer party, an electricity selling benefit loss function is constructed, and the electricity selling benefit loss function is converted into a multi-stage distribution robust mixed integer programming problem; constructing an energy efficiency loss function by taking a load aggregator as a game lower layer party, and converting the energy efficiency loss function into a multi-time domain optimal decision constraint; the power market decision-making transaction center performs optimization solution according to the acquired problems and constraints, and performs energy scheduling according to the solution result; the invention is based on the Steinberg game theory, combines the model predictive control rolling optimization framework, provides a double-layer predictive game mechanism, and has more reasonable decision results.

title_en: Electric bicycle power change demand prediction algorithm based on ARIMA model
abstract_en: The invention relates to an ARIMA model-based electric bicycle power change demand prediction algorithm, which comprises the following steps: preprocessing electric bicycle power conversion order data of four months of a large power conversion enterprise; constructing an ARIMA model by utilizing the preprocessed electric bicycle power change order data; calling an ARIMA model to calculate a model evaluation index; and verifying the effectiveness of the ARMIA model on the short-time order quantity prediction according to the model evaluation index. Compared with other baseline models, the electric bicycle power change demand prediction algorithm based on the ARIMA model has higher prediction precision in the demand prediction of short-time power change orders, and compared with the other baseline models, each index is the best, the fact that the power change demands tend to be linear in time is verified, and the power change cabinet position optimization and short-time demand prediction results provide data support for power change cabinet site selection and battery input of a power change enterprise, so that the service efficiency of the power change cabinet is improved, and the equipment cost is saved.

title_en: Power distribution network power supply fault performance evaluation management algorithm
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power distribution network power supply fault performance evaluation, and relates to a power distribution network power supply fault performance evaluation management algorithm.
