According to the invention, the power supply fault information, the power supply fault maintenance information and the power supply fault history information of the target power distribution network are acquired, so that the influence degree of the power supply fault of the target power distribution network is analyzed, the loss of a power failure area is evaluated, the later maintenance processing is facilitated, the power supply fault maintenance difficulty coefficient of the target power distribution network is analyzed, the power supply fault maintenance duration of the target power distribution network is evaluated, the power supply fault maintenance duration of the target power distribution network is effectively and accurately evaluated from the diversified angle, the reliability of the power supply fault area of the target power distribution network is analyzed, the reliability grade of the power supply fault area of the target power distribution network is obtained, the stability of the power distribution network is improved, the power supply quality of the power distribution network is improved, the satisfaction of users is improved, and the social loss is reduced.

title_en: Coordination analysis method based on space layout planning
abstract_en: The application discloses a coordination analysis method based on space layout planning, which comprises the following steps: remote sensing data of an industrial development area are obtained by utilizing a remote sensing technology; utilizing a pre-established layout industrial coarse measurement model to measure and calculate the industrial coarse layout type and the industrial coarse layout scale of the industrial development area based on remote sensing data of the industrial development area; and establishing an industry layout and land utilization coordination optimization target of an industry development area. According to the application, the industrial coarse layout type and the industrial coarse layout scale of the industrial development area are calculated based on the remote sensing data of the industrial development area by utilizing the pre-established layout industrial coarse calculation model, so that the efficiency of the industrial space layout of the development area is improved, and the industrial fine layout type and the industrial fine layout scale of the industrial development area are obtained by carrying out fine layout on the industrial coarse layout type and the industrial coarse layout scale of the industrial development area based on the industrial layout and land utilization coordination optimization targets, so that the coordination of the industrial space layout of the development area is improved.

title_en: Commodity recommendation method, commodity recommendation device, commodity recommendation equipment and commodity recommendation medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a commodity recommendation method, a commodity recommendation device, commodity recommendation equipment and commodity recommendation media, relates to the technical field of computers, and particularly relates to the technical field of recommendation. The implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring a plurality of pieces of evaluation information for a plurality of candidate commodities in a plurality of scenes based on user portraits of a target user; determining a recommended commodity for the target user from the plurality of candidate commodities based at least on the user representation of the target user and the plurality of rating information; acquiring at least one target evaluation information for the recommended commodity based on the user portrait of the target user; and acquiring a recommendation reason for the recommended commodity based on the at least one target evaluation information.

title_en: Data processing method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application provides a data processing method, a device, equipment and a medium, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring first transaction data of a first target account from at least one server; identifying a second target account transacted with the first target account based on the posting data and/or the outbound data; screening a third target account from the second target accounts based on the target screening information; and generating an account thermodynamic diagram according to a matching result between the basic information of the third target account and the account opening line information corresponding to the server, wherein the account thermodynamic diagram is used for displaying the distribution information of the potential registered accounts of which the matching result is the corresponding account opening line in the third target account. By the method, the extended users of the financial institutions and the distribution situation of the extended users can be accurately identified, so that the marketing efficiency of the financial institutions to the extended users is effectively improved.

title_en: Dangerous area avoidance method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a dangerous area avoidance method, a dangerous area avoidance device, dangerous area avoidance equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the dangerous area avoidance method comprises the following steps: acquiring environment information within a preset range of a target user; judging whether a dangerous area exists in a preset range according to the environmental information; when a dangerous area exists, the dangerous area is avoided. By implementing the scheme of the application, the dangerous area can be accurately judged through the environmental information and avoided in advance, so that dangerous accidents are effectively prevented.

title_en: E-commerce operation management system based on cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electronic commerce operation management system based on a cloud platform, and relates to the technical field of cloud computing. The E-commerce server acquires daily original interaction data of a target E-commerce user, encrypts the original interaction data to obtain first data, and uploads the first data to the cloud server; the cloud server divides the first data into a preset number of data blocks, randomly stores the data blocks into storage spaces of the distributed storage modules, and generates a storage dictionary corresponding to the first data; and when the cloud server receives a data analysis request of the e-commerce server, restoring and decrypting the first data according to the storage dictionary to obtain original interaction data, performing data analysis on the original interaction data to determine the current operation management risk, and sending an early warning message to the e-commerce server according to the operation management risk. The system stores the data in the cloud by adopting encryption and segmentation modes, and the cloud server can restore and analyze the data only by receiving an authorization file of the e-commerce server, so that the security of data privacy is ensured.

title_en: Non-invasive load monitoring method and storage medium based on co-evolution algorithm
abstract_en: The application relates to a non-invasive load monitoring method and a storage medium based on a co-evolution algorithm, wherein the method comprises the following steps: encoding the acquired target information and the first gene value to generate a plurality of first encoding arrays comprising a plurality of first encodings; determining a target group which is currently subjected to genetic operation by using a genetic algorithm in a plurality of first coding groups of each first coding array; determining a local optimal coding array in the plurality of evolution coding arrays, and updating coding genes of the evolution coding arrays except the local optimal coding array based on the intention coding genes acquired from the local optimal coding array to obtain a plurality of second coding arrays; and processing a plurality of second codes of each second code array based on a co-evolution algorithm based on the corresponding adaptability of the second code array, performing genetic operation on the second code groups obtained by processing, and performing coding gene updating on the corresponding second codes to obtain a load monitoring result comprising the target code array.

title_en: Intelligent decision-making system based on large model
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent decision system based on a large model, which relates to the field of intelligent decision, and comprises the following components: constructing a decision router according to the decision problem and data required by the decision, and designing an intelligent decision framework by combining different decision algorithms and decision scenes; after receiving the successful information of the work execution, the execution result is input into the intelligent decision framework to obtain a decision result, and the decision result is converted and output according to the expected form, so that the method has higher accuracy in the process of involving a plurality of works, and has universal capability and practicability.

title_en: Virtual fitting and dressing method, virtual fitting and dressing equipment and system
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of the Internet of things, and particularly relates to a virtual fitting and dressing method, virtual fitting and dressing equipment and a system, wherein the virtual fitting and dressing method comprises the steps of obtaining physical characteristics, facial characteristics and current clothes information of a target user; generating a human body model corresponding to the target user according to the physical characteristics; generating a human body image corresponding to the target user according to the human body model and the current clothes information; according to the human body image and facial features, a recommended dressing appearance is obtained; and combining the recommended makeup with the human body image, generating a recommended image of the target user, and displaying the recommended image. The application can enable the user to complete the virtual fitting and virtual fitting process at one time, thereby improving the fitting and fitting efficiency of the user.

title_en: Service-oriented green intelligent manufacturing configuration optimization method based on target layering solution
abstract_en: In order to solve the technical problems that the existing centralized manufacturing service optimizing configuration method is difficult to obtain a global optimal solution, has long optimizing time, is difficult to respond and coordinate dynamic changes of different manufacturing service supply modes and manufacturing capacities of different enterprises and is lack of an optimizing configuration method taking green and low carbon as indexes currently, the invention provides a service-oriented green intelligent manufacturing configuration optimizing method based on a target layer solution. The invention adopts a distributed collaborative optimization strategy, can solve the problems of high computational complexity, long optimization time and the like caused by complex manufacturing tasks and more manufacturing services, and considers green low-carbon indexes in the process of optimizing configuration.

title_en: Customer service intelligent switching method based on user behavior analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a customer service intelligent switching method based on user behavior analysis, which relates to the technical field of data processing, and comprises the following steps: obtaining a keyword set; obtaining a comparison result; triggering a first customer switching instruction to acquire a first user dialogue action information set; performing replying content correlation and user emotion feature recognition to obtain a first communication energy efficiency index sequence; generating a second customer service switching instruction; according to the second customer service switching instruction, the idle customer service set is called, and the artificial customer service is optimized to obtain optimized customer service; the first artificial customer service is switched into the optimizing customer service, so that the technical problems that the communication energy efficiency of the artificial customer service and the analysis accuracy of individual characteristics of users are poor, the switching effect between the artificial customer service is poor, the communication capacity of the switched customer service is insufficient, the user experience is influenced, the communication energy efficiency of the switched customer service is improved, and the technical effect of user experience is improved are solved.

title_en: National library cash management method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of cash management, in particular to a national library cash management method, a national library cash management device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring national library data; wherein the national library data comprises financial four-book budget balance data, library money data, cross-linked data, temporary money data, stock fund data, debt income data and regular deposit data; inputting the national library data into a pre-trained expenditure prediction model to obtain expenditure prediction results; inputting the national library data into a pre-trained income prediction model to obtain income prediction results; based on the expenditure prediction result and the income prediction result, carrying out cash prediction of the deposit money, and generating a cash management strategy; wherein the expense prediction model is a deep learning model; the expenditure prediction model is a deep learning model, national library cash management is assisted through the scheme, unreasonable expenditure conditions are avoided, and normal operation of socioeconomic performance is guaranteed.

title_en: Method and system for optimizing deep peak shaving of thermal power unit by participation of hybrid energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system optimization, and particularly provides a method and a system for optimizing deep peak shaving of a hybrid energy storage system participating in a thermal power unit, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a target battery energy storage life loss model; acquiring historical power station power grid data to predict and obtain predicted power station power grid data; obtaining battery energy storage life loss cost based on a target battery energy storage life loss model, and constructing an objective function based on the wind and light discarding cost, the load shedding cost, the carbon emission cost and the battery energy storage life loss cost; determining an operation scene based on the predicted power station power grid data, determining a fitness function based on the minimum value of an objective function aiming at the operation scene, and solving by adopting a multi-objective moth fire suppression optimization algorithm to obtain an optimal solution of the state parameters of the thermal power unit and an optimal solution of the state parameters of the battery energy storage system so as to generate an optimal scheduling instruction to control the operation of the unit and the battery energy storage system. The method can improve the efficiency and economy of the coordination of the deep peak shaving and the hybrid energy storage of the thermal power unit.

title_en: Low-voltage area short-term load prediction method and system based on hybrid model
abstract_en: A low-voltage area short-term load prediction method and system based on a hybrid model are characterized in that the method comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting short-term load historical data of a low-voltage station area, and preprocessing the short-term load historical data to obtain a training set and a testing set respectively; step 2, inputting a first training set and a first testing set obtained after pretreatment into a first prediction model, obtaining a first prediction set, and inputting a second training set and a second testing set obtained after pretreatment into a second prediction model, and obtaining a second prediction set; and step 3, splicing the first prediction set and the second prediction set to obtain spliced data, and inputting the spliced data into a neural network so as to output a short-term load prediction result of the low-voltage area. Compared with a single intelligent algorithm model, the model provided by the application has higher prediction precision.

title_en: Automatic dispatch method and system based on city complaint worksheet recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic dispatch method and system based on urban operation complaint worksheet recognition, belonging to the worksheet distribution technical field, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving a city operation complaint work order; the method comprises the steps of performing deletion type desensitization treatment on a city complaint work order; constructing a work order semantic recognition model with a BERT layer, an attention mechanism layer and a single-dimensional maximum pooling layer, and training the work order semantic recognition model by utilizing historical city operation complaint work order data; carrying out semantic recognition comprising weight analysis on the desensitized city complaint worksheets, and judging the worksheet types of the city complaint worksheets; determining the emergency degree of the work order according to the type of the work order, and calculating the order-dispatching priority of the city operation complaint work order by combining the complaint time length of the work order and the geographical distance of the work order; combining the dispatch priority and the work order type to construct a decision model based on random forests; and distributing the city complaint work orders to corresponding receiving units by utilizing the decision model. The automatic dispatch capacity and dispatch speed of the work order are improved, and the problem that the work order is placed for a long time is avoided.

title_en: Operation safety evaluation system for power grid power transmission system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system safety evaluation, in particular to a power grid transmission system operation safety evaluation system, which comprises: and a data acquisition module: the method comprises the steps of collecting operation data of a power grid power transmission system; and a data processing module: the method comprises the steps of processing collected operation data of a power grid power transmission system; and (3) running a fitting module: the method is used for fitting the running state of the power grid power transmission system based on the improved BP neural network; and a security evaluation module: the method is used for carrying out safety evaluation on the power grid power transmission system according to the multi-level fault classification strategy. According to the invention, the running state data of the power grid power transmission system is output based on the improved BP neural network, the weight and the bias value are updated rapidly based on the steepest descent method so as to improve the network operation speed, the safety evaluation is carried out on the power grid power transmission system through the multi-level fault type of the divided power grid power transmission system by the multi-classifier evaluation algorithm, the calculated amount is obviously reduced through the hierarchical evaluation, and the rapid and accurate evaluation of the safety of the power grid power transmission system is realized.

title_en: Participant anti-repetition processing method of flow node and related equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a participant anti-repetition processing method and related equipment of a process node, which are applied to the field of Internet of things or finance, wherein a to-be-processed process node is firstly determined, the to-be-processed process node is processed by a plurality of participants, part of the participants in the history processing process of the to-be-processed process node are processed, the history processing result of the to-be-processed process node is obtained, a target participant is determined based on the history processing result, the target participant is a participant which does not give a first preset processing result in the history processing process of the to-be-processed process node in the plurality of participants, a proper participant is determined for the to-be-processed process node, the proper participant is used for processing the to-be-processed process node, the repeated processing condition of the participants of the to-be-processed process node can be reduced, and the processing efficiency of the process node is improved.

title_en: Rock burst intelligent prediction method based on combination of SMOTE oversampling and Autogluon model
abstract_en: The invention provides a rock burst intelligent prediction method based on combination of SMOTE oversampling and an Autogluon model, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: s1, collecting rock burst case data and constructing a rock burst case database; s2, balancing a database by using a Synthetic Minority Oversampling (SMOTE) oversampling method, and dividing the database into a training set and a testing set; s3, training the Autogluon model by using the training set divided in the step S2 to obtain an optimal training model result; s4, predicting the test set which is well obtained in the step S2 according to the optimal model which is well trained in the step S3. The prediction accuracy of the invention reaches 94.2%, the prediction time is 0.04 seconds, and the invention has excellent performance in the aspect of rock burst prediction.

title_en: Intelligent medical data interaction method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention provides a smart medical data interaction method and system based on big data, and relates to the technical field of medical treatment, wherein the method comprises the steps of reserving numbers for a diagnosis and treatment department corresponding to a diagnosis and treatment project for a current user according to user position information, and sending the reserved numbers to a current user side; when the fact that the current user cannot arrive at the diagnosis and treatment department on time is monitored, analyzing the estimated time point of the current user arriving at the diagnosis and treatment department; selecting other user terminals after the estimated time point according to the estimated time point, and sending reservation number exchange information to the selected user terminals; when receiving the exchange agreement information fed back by the selected user side, exchanging the reservation number of the current user with the reservation number of the user side fed back the exchange agreement information, thereby not affecting the following patients, providing the opportunity of early treatment for the patients with urgent treatment, and simultaneously re-reserving the number conforming to the treatment behavior capability of the patients for the current user, and not delaying the treatment time of the current patients.

title_en: Regional comprehensive energy system control method and device considering master-slave game
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for controlling an regional comprehensive energy system considering master-slave gaming, wherein an RIES operator and a comprehensive demand in comprehensive RIES energy transaction respond to interest demands of a user side, and a master-slave gaming model with the RIES operator as a leader and the user as a follower is established. In the model, a leader considers the running economic cost to optimally formulate the time-sharing energy electricity price, and a user side optimally formulates a demand response plan according to the energy price and the comprehensive benefit function. Secondly, in order to cope with wind power output uncertainty risks, a day-ahead-day two-stage distribution robust optimization scheduling model which introduces a comprehensive norm constraint limit probability confidence interval is constructed on the basis, a double-layer game model is converted into a single-layer distribution robust optimization model by using KKT, and a column and constraint generation algorithm is adopted for solving. Finally, the result of calculation shows that the optimal scheduling strategy is effective in balancing the benefits of each subject and resisting the wind power uncertain risk.

title_en: Wind turbine generator blade icing quality prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting ice coating quality of a wind turbine blade, and relates to the field of wind turbines, wherein the method comprises the following steps: analyzing a two-phase flow control mechanism of an air phase and a water drop phase in the icing process of the wind turbine blade; analyzing a water drop motion track mechanism in the icing process of the wind turbine blade; analyzing an icing quality growth mechanism in the icing process of the wind turbine blade; according to the obtained mechanism, carrying out model verification through wind turbine generator blade icing historical data; according to the obtained mechanism passing verification, a physical mechanism model is built to build the relation between the environmental parameter and the fan state parameter; and inputting the environmental parameters and the fan state parameters according to the obtained physical mechanism model, and outputting the environmental parameters and the fan state parameters correspondingly through the model to realize the prediction of the icing quality of the wind turbine generator blade.

title_en: Local path planning method based on bubbling region time elastic band algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of path planning of logistics robots, in particular to a local path planning method based on an bubbling region time elastic band algorithm. The invention comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring information of a current local path, wherein the information comprises known global path points, the current position of a robot and known environmental information; s2, constraint optimization of a bubbling area time elastic band algorithm, wherein the constraint optimization comprises bubbling area constraint, speed obstacle constraint, jerk constraint and linear constraint, and the BR-TEB algorithm is solved by utilizing constraint optimization; s3, outputting information of the optimized local path, and obtaining local path points and corresponding speed control instructions according to an optimization result; the invention can plan a local passable path which is obstacle avoidance, continuous and safe, and meets the requirements of actual application scenes; the invention can solve the problem of local path planning, obtain better local paths and control instructions, and is more suitable for path planning of the logistics robot.

title_en: Exhibition point position recommendation method and device, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a display point position recommending method, a device, an electronic device and a storage medium, wherein the display point position recommending method comprises the following steps: according to the user information and the exhibition point position where the user is currently located, obtaining portrait data of the user and data of the exhibition point position where the user is currently located from a preset knowledge graph; inputting the portrait data of the user and the data of the display point where the user is currently positioned into a pre-trained recommendation model to generate target display points and target display point sequences for the user to select. According to the method and the device for automatically planning and recommending the navigation robot, the efficiency of developing the function of automatically planning and recommending the navigation robot is improved.

title_en: BIM-based engineering supervision information management method, system, medium and equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a method, a system, a medium and equipment for managing engineering supervision information based on BIM, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring construction node information, and acquiring a standard BIM model corresponding to the construction node information based on the construction node information; judging whether the quality of the standard BIM model accords with a preset quality standard, if not, acquiring an engineering design file corresponding to the construction node information, acquiring engineering design parameters corresponding to the building component indicated by the construction node information based on the engineering design file, and generating a target BIM model based on the engineering design parameters, wherein the quality of the target BIM model is superior to that of the standard BIM model; acquiring site construction data of a construction site indicated by the construction node information, and generating a construction BIM model based on the site construction data; and comparing and determining first construction supervision information based on the target BIM model and the construction BIM model.

title_en: Multi-working condition emission data fake detection method, device and system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-condition emission data fake detection method, a device, a system and a storage medium, wherein enterprise historical production data and emission data are input as a model: (1) Establishing a self-adaptive working condition classification model, and judging working conditions of enterprises in different periods; (2) Establishing a statistical rule model under the condition of data unbalance under different working conditions, and judging whether the emission data is counterfeited or not; (3) Establishing a classification model under the working condition without using, extracting rules, and judging whether the emission data is counterfeited or not; (4) And (3) establishing an integrated model, and giving out comprehensive judgment of whether the emission data is counterfeited or not according to the output of the model (2) and the model (3). The invention can rapidly and accurately identify whether the enterprise emission data is falsified, thereby providing a timely and accurate auxiliary decision basis for ensuring the quality control of the environmental monitoring.

title_en: Stock transaction recommendation system and method based on pattern recognition and quantization indexes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stock trading recommendation system and method based on pattern recognition and quantization indexes, which takes the stock screening based on pattern recognition as an innovation point, takes the pattern recognition as the basis of stock screening, and assists with the widely used quantization index screening at present to carry out stock screening. The system comprises a graph screening module, an index screening module, a transaction management module and a strategy back-testing module; the graph screening module is responsible for preparing a CNN data set, checking a single k-line graph and constructing and using a CNN model; the index screening module is responsible for buying two rounds of screening, selling screening and warehousing screening; the transaction management module is responsible for managing the holding information and the transaction information; the strategy return module is responsible for carrying out warehouse-holding return and history return, and helps a user to know the strategy yield so as to optimize the strategy. The invention provides abundant quantitative screening indexes for individual investors, adopts reasonable quantitative trading strategies, and explores more possibilities for the individual investors to improve the profits.

title_en: On-site operation assisting method and on-site operation assisting system
abstract_en: The invention provides a field operation assisting method and a field operation assisting system, which display attention calling information suitable for implementing dangerous prediction activities before starting operation in consideration of not only operation content but also field conditions. A site operation support method for supporting a site operation includes: a working condition input step (S1) for inputting the working content and the site condition; an attention calling information extraction step (S3) for extracting attention calling information corresponding to the inputted work content and the site situation by referring to the database; and an attention calling information display step (S5) for displaying the extracted attention calling information.

title_en: Comprehensive evaluation optimization method for mineral sources of quartz sand fracturing propping agent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive evaluation optimization method for quartz sand fracturing propping agent mineral sources; relates to the technical field of oil and gas field development; the method solves the problem that whether the quartz ore has the performance as a fracturing propping agent cannot be quantitatively evaluated in the prior art; the method comprises the following steps: s1, collecting relevant information data of a quartz ore sample to be evaluated; s2, establishing an evaluation index system reflecting the mineral separation requirement of the quartz sand for fracturing; s3, carrying out dimensionless normalization processing on each evaluation index value of the quartz ore sample; s4, determining the weight of each evaluation index in the evaluation index system; s5, establishing a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation analytic hierarchy process mathematical model of ore dressing to obtain an application index; s6, comparing the application index of the quartz ore sample with the ore dressing threshold according to a predetermined ore dressing threshold, and determining an ore dressing evaluation conclusion of the quartz ore sample; the method can realize quantitative calculation and evaluation of the application performance level of the quartz ore as the fracturing propping agent.

title_en: Informationized management system for furniture production
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of informatization management, in particular to an informatization management system for furniture production; comprising the following steps: the system comprises a data acquisition module, a server, a production analysis module and a dispatching distribution module; the human resources and the equipment resources are accurately analyzed to judge whether the situation of unbalanced resource utilization exists, and the equipment and the human resources in each workshop can be optimally utilized through personnel scheduling in an up-regulating workshop and a out-regulating workshop, so that the production efficiency and the productivity are improved, unnecessary resource waste and excessive investment are avoided, and reasonable allocation and full utilization of the resources are realized; the production values of workshops after the scheduling of human resources are analyzed, and furniture parts are distributed and produced according to the production values, so that reasonable resource distribution and utilization are achieved, furniture manufacturers are helped to avoid production delay and resource waste, and informationized management of the furniture manufacturers is perfected.

title_en: Cloud computing-based data resource quality evaluation and optimization system
abstract_en: The invention provides a data resource quality evaluation and optimization system based on cloud computing, which comprises the following steps: the acquisition module is used for acquiring a plurality of data resources; the evaluation module is used for evaluating a plurality of data resources to obtain a resource evaluation result; the screening module is used for screening a plurality of data resources according to the resource evaluation result to determine abnormal data resources; and the optimizing module is used for optimizing the abnormal data resources to obtain optimized data resources. The method and the device have the advantages that reasonable and effective evaluation of the data resources is achieved, accurate evaluation results are obtained, the data resources are optimized according to the evaluation results, the optimized data resources are further obtained, the quality of the data resources is guaranteed, and the effectiveness, usability and value of the data resources are improved.

title_en: Climbing auxiliary service market clearing method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for clearing a climbing auxiliary service market, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining daily market declaration information and determining climbing capacity demand constraint of an electric power system based on the declaration information; based on the climbing capacity demand constraint, market clearing is carried out by utilizing a preset market safety constraint economic dispatch model, and a first clearing result is obtained; calculating the wind-discarding quantity of the system according to the first clearing result, and calculating the wind-discarding rate according to the wind-discarding quantity of the system; and outputting a second clearing result when the wind and light rejection rate passes the verification. The invention can control the new energy source wind-abandoning and light-abandoning requirements to be controlled within a certain range, and the application ensures that the new energy source participates in climbing and needs to consider the green value attribute, also considers the influence of the limitation range of the wind-abandoning and light-abandoning, and can truly reflect the climbing value of the new energy source different from the traditional thermal power generating unit.

title_en: Design work management method and related device based on 3D object customization model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a design work management method and a related device based on a 3D object customization model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: sending a request for a comment activity to the registered first user through the 3D object customization model platform; displaying the 3D object design model information to be compared to the first user, and responding to the operation of the first user on the 3D object design model to be compared; responding to first dimension scoring of the 3D object design model information to be compared by the first user; counting second dimension scores of the 3D object design model information to be compared; and establishing a scoring model of the 3D object design model to be compared according to the first dimension score and the second dimension score, and screening out a preset number of 3D design works according to the scoring model. According to the invention, the comprehensive scoring model is obtained based on the first dimension scoring and the second dimension scoring, so that the normalization and accuracy of the design work scoring are improved.

title_en: Distributed micro electric energy storage system, method, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed micro electric energy storage system, a method, a computer device and a storage medium, comprising: collecting historical electricity utilization data of the electricity utilization node, and drawing an electricity utilization map according to the historical electricity utilization data; judging the electric energy richness of the current power utilization node at the current moment according to the power utilization map, and storing and releasing the electric energy of the miniature electric energy storage unit according to a preset storage rule; outputting an optimized prediction node and an optimized prediction route of the power grid model through the load prediction model; calculating the electric energy storage quantity of each miniature electric energy storage unit in the power grid model according to rated load; finally, outputting the electric energy storage and release quantity of the distributed micro electric energy storage unit at each moment, and controlling the distributed micro electric energy storage unit to finish electric energy storage and release at each moment; optimizing the load of the power grid: by means of the prediction model and effective scheduling of the storage units, the load of the power grid can be balanced better, the power pressure in the peak period is reduced, and the running stability of the power grid is improved.

title_en: Rural E-commerce product quality traceability system based on double chains
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rural e-commerce product quality traceability system based on double chains, which comprises: the product information acquisition module: the system comprises a block chain link point module, a chain link point module and a chain link point module, wherein the block chain link point module is used for acquiring quality information and production place information of a product; block link point module: the product information acquisition module is used for receiving information sent by the product information acquisition module, giving time stamps to the information and signing the information to share the information; product processing monitoring module: the processing, processing and storage information for recording the product is sent to the block chain link point module; product transportation monitoring module: the system comprises a block chain link point module, a chain link point module and a chain link point module, wherein the block chain point module is used for monitoring the environment, the path and the time information of a product in the transportation process; product sales site monitoring module: and the information for recording the distribution of the transported products to different sales places is sent to the block link point module. The system solves the problems of integrity, fairness and credibility of quality safety data in a rural e-commerce product quality safety traceability system.

title_en: Charging station planning method and system based on new energy passenger car charging demand prediction
abstract_en: The invention provides a charging station planning method and a charging station planning system based on new energy passenger car charging demand prediction, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly, collecting and processing operation data of a new energy passenger car, constructing a space-time track diagram, and extracting and obtaining charging and driving related information of the vehicle through the space-time track diagram; then, aiming at the battery capacity attenuation condition of the new energy passenger car, carrying out data reconstruction on the operation data of the new energy passenger car; then, a vehicle journey energy consumption prediction model and a vehicle charging energy prediction model are built, a vehicle energy consumption prediction result and a vehicle battery charging energy prediction result are obtained, and space-time prediction is carried out on the charging demand of the target area; and finally, constructing a double-stage rapid site selection scheme based on a traffic network and charging requirements, obtaining the optimal site selection of the charging station according to a charging requirement space-time prediction result, and completing planning of the specification and the number of the charging piles of the charging station according to the historical charging habits of users and the charging requirement peak value data.

title_en: Card customization method and device, electronic equipment and computer readable medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a card customization method, a card customization device, electronic equipment and a computer readable medium, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein a specific implementation mode comprises the steps of receiving a card customization request and obtaining corresponding card type identification and user demand data; calling an identification tool to determine a corresponding card adding object according to the user demand data, and determining the type of the card adding object; determining a target card making workflow according to the card type identification and the type; and executing the target card making workflow to generate a target card. The personalized degree of card manufacture is improved, cross-industry cooperation is facilitated, the total quantity of social card sending is reduced, and environmental protection is facilitated.

title_en: Training method of risk identification model, risk identification method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification discloses a training method of a risk identification model, which comprises the steps of obtaining wind control sample data; splitting the wind control sample data into sub-sample sequences according to a preset time granularity; inputting the sub-sample sequence into an encoder to obtain a first sample feature vector; arranging the first sample feature vectors according to a time sequence to obtain second sample feature vectors; inputting the second sample feature vector into a classifier; determining a loss function based on the prediction result of the classifier and the real label of the wind control sample data; updating parameters of the encoder and the classifier based on the loss function; the risk identification model is determined based on the encoder and the classifier. Accordingly, the invention discloses a risk identification method and a risk identification device.

title_en: Abnormal transaction data monitoring method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an abnormal transaction data monitoring method, device, equipment and storage medium, relates to the technical field of abnormal transaction data monitoring, and solves the problems that the existing abnormal data monitoring method is low in monitoring efficiency, too mechanized in monitoring process and poor in flexibility.

title_en: Party-keeping method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a participating method, a participating device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of health care, wherein the method comprises the following steps: sending a participation inquiry request of a user participating in a target insurance to a blockchain, determining that the user can participate in the target insurance according to an inquiry result returned by the blockchain, generating a participation insurance policy of the user aiming at the target insurance, and first participation information; uploading the first participation information to a blockchain; updating the first participating information into the second participating information in the blockchain when the participating and protecting policy payment is completed; when the user participates in insurance, the participation situation of the user is checked through the block chain, and when the participation requirement is met, the participation service is provided for the user, so that the efficiency and the reliability of checking whether the user participates in target insurance can be effectively improved, and the probability of repeated participation of the user is reduced.

title_en: Wind power prediction method for optimizing neural network by genetic algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wind power prediction, and discloses a wind power prediction method for optimizing a neural network by a genetic algorithm, which comprises the following steps: s1, grouping and sequencing fan power data in a preset time range according to minutes; s2, dividing the input time sequence into intervals with a certain length, removing abnormal values in each interval, and filling with the last value of the blank value; s3, decomposing the time sequence after the abnormal value is processed into n components by using an EEMD decomposition method, and then respectively inputting the components into a GA-BP neural network model; s4, respectively predicting the time sequence components input in the S3 to obtain a result, and adding the results to obtain a real predicted result. And a BP algorithm is improved by adopting a mode of combining a genetic algorithm and an EEMD decomposition algorithm, an EEMD-GA-BP model for wind power output prediction is established, the accurate prediction of wind power output is realized, and the large-scale development and utilization of wind power are facilitated, and the construction of a novel power-assisted power system is facilitated.

title_en: Intelligent planning system for power distribution network based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent planning system of a power distribution network based on artificial intelligence, which relates to the technical field of intelligent planning of the power distribution network, wherein a power grid region data collection module is arranged to collect power grid region data in the power distribution network, a risk training data collection module is arranged to collect risk training data of each power utilization region, a risk prediction model training module is arranged to train a risk prediction model for predicting power utilization risk probability, a power generation amount prediction module is arranged to collect the predicted power generation amount of a power plant, a power grid power distribution module is arranged to output the power distribution amount of each power utilization region by using an Actor network in an Actor-Critic network model, an actual rewarding value is calculated, and the Actor-Critic network model is trained by the actual rewarding value; therefore, the power supply of different parts in the power system is regulated through the power distribution strategy, the power distribution to the most needed place is ensured, and the risks caused by power faults and the harm of insufficient power supply to important equipment can be reduced.

title_en: Method for evaluating manufacturing capacity of power transformer supplier
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating the manufacturing capacity of a power transformer supplier, which belongs to the technical field of power equipment supplier evaluation and comprises the following steps: constructing an evaluation index system of the manufacturing capacity of the power transformer suppliers; establishing an evaluation standard of each evaluation index; acquiring and arranging data information of suppliers in the power transformer industry; configuring the weight of each evaluation index; calculating index scores by using an efficacy coefficient method and a grade evaluation method; the total score of the suppliers is weighted. The invention has the advantages that the evaluation index system is comprehensive and scientific, the evaluation standard is detailed and quantitative, the evaluation method is convenient and efficient, and the objective, fair and comprehensive reflection of the manufacturing capacity level of the power transformer suppliers is achieved.

title_en: Student transaction management system and method
abstract_en: A student transaction management system, comprising: the system comprises an APP end transaction application module, a management end transaction processing module and a notification center module; wherein: the APP end transaction application module is used for providing application submission, application state check and application record management services for the user; the management end transaction processing module is used for providing transaction checking, approval operation and history checking services for a user to be approved; the notification center module is used for providing approval result notification receiving and system reminding services for the user; the effect of real-time notification of the submitted application state is achieved, and timely receipt of approval information is ensured. The invention realizes the whole-course on-line of student application and teacher approval, improves the convenience and efficiency of operation, can generate detailed application and approval reports, and provides data support for a school management layer.

title_en: Training method, application method and related device of click value estimation model
abstract_en: The application discloses a training method, an application method and a related device of a click value prediction model, which can be used for carrying out conversion condition and conversion bid analysis on the whole historical aggregated content, constructing a target conversion label and a target conversion bid label corresponding to the whole historical aggregated content, constructing training sample data based on the historical aggregated characteristic data and the corresponding labels of the historical aggregated content, training the model to obtain the click value prediction model capable of carrying out conversion condition and conversion bid prediction on the whole aggregated content, and calculating the click value corresponding to the whole aggregated content accurately through the prediction parameters output by the model, so that the click value aggregation effect of the aggregated content on the single content in the mode can be accurately embodied, the click value corresponding to the aggregated content is accurately obtained, the efficiency in the model training and application process is improved, and the data quantity required by the click value analysis is reduced.

title_en: Distributed intelligent cabinet transaction video commodity identification system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distributed intelligent cabinet transaction video commodity identification system and a method, wherein the system comprises an intelligent cabinet, a transaction video cloud processing server, an edge reasoning terminal and a manual processing seat; the intelligent cabinet comprises a cabinet body, a camera, a central control and a wireless interface; the camera is used for recording the transaction video and then transmitting the transaction video to the video cloud processing server; the edge reasoning terminal is connected with the video cloud processing server and registers a station port; the transaction video cloud processing server downloads a cabinet model associated with the edge reasoning terminal to the local, screens the transaction video, pushes the transaction video into a pre-distribution file pool, and pushes the file name of the transaction video to the edge reasoning terminal or a manual processing seat; the edge reasoning terminal downloads corresponding transaction video processing after receiving the file name sent by the transaction video cloud processing server and returns the processing result to the transaction video cloud processing server for deduction; the manual processing agent identifies deductions for the transaction videos distributed by the transaction video cloud processing server.

title_en: Power grid capacity constraint-based distributed photovoltaic maximum installed capacity calculation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid capacity constraint-based distributed photovoltaic maximum installed capacity calculation method, which comprises the following steps of: acquiring a distribution network structure of a regional distribution network, and recording node load capacity and original distributed photovoltaic installed capacity of the distribution network structure; based on the node load capacity of the distribution network structure and the original distributed photovoltaic installed capacity, the access capacity of the distributed photovoltaic is continuously added into the distribution network structure, and the distributed maximum installed capacity meeting the power grid capacity constraint is calculated by adopting a gray wolf optimization algorithm and a simulated annealing algorithm. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of avoiding local optimization, improving calculation accuracy and the like.

title_en: Certificate inquiry system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a credential inquiry system which comprises a first data acquisition module, a second data acquisition module, a matching module, a request generation module, an approval module, a credential management module and a credential display module. The certificate inquiry system can optimize the inquiry flow of accounting certificates of universities, improves the inquiry efficiency and saves a great deal of manpower and time cost compared with the current manual inquiry mode.

title_en: Sports training course recommendation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sports training course recommendation method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of S1, presetting initial recommendation parameters of each sports training course, S2, obtaining initial heat of each sports training course according to the initial recommendation parameters of each sports training course and carrying out heat sequencing to obtain the initial recommendation sequencing of each sports training course, S3, recording user behaviors in real time, obtaining user access quantity of each sports training course and course page display duration data, calculating to obtain interaction heat of each sports training course according to the initial heat and the interaction heat of each sports training course, S4, calculating to obtain final heat of each sports training course, and re-sequencing each sports training course according to the final heat to obtain final recommendation sequencing of each sports training course. The method and the system can rapidly and accurately recommend the related sports training courses to the user, and improve the user purchasing efficiency.

title_en: Answer sheet classification method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for classifying answer sheets, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of intersection of artificial intelligence and intelligent education. The method comprises the following steps: selecting part of the answer sheet as a sample answer sheet; obtaining the score distribution range of the sample answer test paper, selecting a plurality of score intervals, and taking the sample answer test paper falling into the same score interval as the same sample answer test paper training set; respectively extracting terms and splitting fixed collocation phrases for all sample answer sheets in the same sample answer sheet training set, and establishing an answer sheet feature library; judging the vector position relation between the term and the fixed collocation phrase, obtaining the characteristic word vector relation, and establishing an answer sheet scoring model; and adapting the answer sheet to be processed according to the answer sheet scoring model, and classifying the answer sheet to be processed according to the suggestion score and the model fitting degree. Therefore, the test paper is automatically classified, the components of human subjectivity are reduced, and the fairness and fairness of the paper reading result are ensured.

title_en: Comment analysis report generation method, device and storage medium based on large language model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a comment analysis report generation method, equipment and storage medium based on a large language model. Through the use of a large language model to design proper context prompt words to carry out emotion judgment, attribute classification and other pre-processing and feature processing on comments, comment data are divided into different attribute spaces, the probability of misclassification is reduced, meanwhile, the large model summarizing capability is applied, the natural language viewpoint is directly provided, users can clearly know the market demands and feedback conditions, and the method is more accurate than general comment analysis and comment viewpoint automatic extraction.

title_en: Method and device for generating credit rating cause of user
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for generating a credit rating cause of a user, which relate to the technical field of credit evaluation and can also be used in the financial field, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining target characteristic values respectively corresponding to the target user and a plurality of credit association characteristics; inputting a plurality of target characteristic values into a target model, and outputting a target credit rating corresponding to a target user; determining contribution degree values of the plurality of credit association features to the target credit rating respectively based on the plurality of target feature values and the target credit rating; determining a degree of correlation value between the plurality of credit-related features based on the plurality of target feature values and the plurality of contribution degree values; and determining target credit characteristics affecting the target credit rating from the plurality of credit association characteristics according to the correlation degree values among the plurality of credit association characteristics. The invention improves the comprehensiveness of the explanation of the reasons of the generated user credit rating.

title_en: Supply chain purchasing system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of supply chain purchasing and discloses a supply chain purchasing system which comprises a historical data storage module, a rating model training module and a rating model training module. The historical parameter extraction module is used for extracting historical purchasing item evaluation data of the target class service and sending the historical purchasing item evaluation data to the evaluation model training module. The evaluation model training module is used for acquiring a relation model between an evaluation result after the project purchase and evaluation parameters according to the post-evaluation data of the historical purchase project and the evaluation data of the historical purchase project, and sending the relation model to the current project evaluation module. The current item evaluation module is used for acquiring an evaluation result of the current purchase item according to the evaluation parameter of the current purchase item and the relation model. The invention can avoid distortion of the marking scoring model, reduce purchasing cost, and improve effective utilization of products and technical service quality.

title_en: Power engineering asset data management method, device, computing equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power engineering asset data management method, a device, a computing device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing hierarchical classification based on the acquired asset data to obtain a tree data network; determining the access level of a terminal in response to identity information carried by an access request of the terminal; retrieving hierarchical data matching the access level from the tree data network based on the access level; uploading the hierarchical data to a digital twin space for content identification, and obtaining different identification contents corresponding to each hierarchical node in the hierarchical data; and displaying different identification contents corresponding to each hierarchical node in the hierarchical data in the digital twin space step by step. The invention improves the inspection safety at least to a higher degree. The invention improves the management effect of the asset data at least to a higher degree.

title_en: Method for intelligently predicting reservoir blue algae population dynamics
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for intelligently predicting reservoir blue algae population dynamics, which combines a cyclic supervision artificial neural network, an unsupervised artificial neural network and a genetic algorithm to construct a comprehensive prediction model. The cyclic supervised neural network mimics the deterministic modeling principle of ordinary differential equations for processing time series data while taking into account current external inputs and neuron weight feedback at previous moments. The unsupervised artificial neural network is used for autonomously identifying the characteristics of input data, forming clustering input through Euclidean distance calculation, and further performing effective clustering analysis on the data by adopting a K-means algorithm. In addition, the distance and the cluster between the data points are visualized through the U-matrix and the partition map, so that the accuracy and the interpretability of prediction are improved. The method can process complex environmental parameters such as water temperature, illumination intensity, pH value, nutrient salt concentration and the like, and provides an efficient and accurate prediction tool for lake management and blue algae population control.

title_en: Method for managing order system of multiple specifications of same product in supply chain
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for managing a multi-specification order system of a same product in a supply chain, which comprises the following steps: obtaining product indexes of a preset number of specifications; acquiring a secondary sub-dimension evaluation index of the primary dimension evaluation index of each secondary product based on the mapping parameter of the secondary product evaluation index; taking the information of the supplied products and the information of the product business; and selecting and configuring among a plurality of primary dimension production indexes and secondary sub-dimension production indexes according to the supplied product information and the product service information to generate a supplier order. According to the method, the evaluation parameters of each required secondary index are obtained, and are substituted into the formulas of the candidate evaluation indexes to respectively calculate the weight of each primary index; the candidate evaluation indexes are analyzed according to the comprehensive weight of the first-level index of each requirement second-level index, so that the applicability of the whole product can be inspected and evaluated by a system in a comprehensive concept, and the automatic management of enterprises on different specifications of the same product is realized.

title_en: ETC (electronic toll collection) -based intelligent parking lot management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent parking lot management method and system based on ETC charging, wherein the invention combines an image recognition method and an ETC electronic license plate recognition method to jointly recognize license plate numbers of the same vehicle, then judges whether the vehicle is a fake license plate vehicle or not by judging whether the vehicle is the same, and finishes parking management of the vehicle by using different parking lot charging payment methods based on a judgment result; when the electronic license plate is consistent with the license plate identified by the image, fee deduction is carried out by utilizing ETC equipment, and if the electronic license plate is inconsistent with the license plate identified by the image, the real license plate identified by the image is adopted to calculate the parking fee, and a parking payment code is generated, so that an imposter can manually pay the parking fee; therefore, the invention solves the problem that the traditional technology brings economic loss to the real vehicle owner caused by the impossibility of the license plate, improves the reliability of ETC parking charging, and is suitable for large-scale application and popularization in the ETC parking charging field.

title_en: Corner mark prompting method for document collaborative editing of objects in multiple people selection
abstract_en: The invention provides a corner mark prompting method for cooperatively editing objects in multiple human options in a document, which comprises the following steps: s1, a user opens a document cooperatively edited by multiple persons; s2, selecting an object by a user; s3, judging whether the selected object is selected by other users, if so, drawing an angle mark on a view layer; s4, judging whether a mouse of the user hovers over the corner mark pattern, if so, expanding a list of other collaborators except the user. The method and the device have the advantages of avoiding user cooperation conflict, reasonably distributing operation tasks, efficiently cooperating, improving cooperation office efficiency, enabling operation experience to be better and the like.

title_en: Urban water system joint arrangement joint debugging data management method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for managing urban water system joint debugging data, which are characterized in that after water system data are acquired, importance marks are carried out on the water system data, and the water system data with different importance degrees are sequenced according to the importance of the water system data, meanwhile, in the process of grouping the water system data, the water system data are grouped in a stepwise increasing mode by the water system data amount in groups, namely, as the grouping is increased, the more the water system data can be stored in the larger grouping number, the less the water system data can be stored in the smaller grouping number, so that the important water system data can be respectively stored in different groupings, and the processing efficiency of the important water system data such as emergency early warning condition data is improved by integrating and storing the relatively unimportant water system data.

title_en: Intelligent piling monitoring management method and system based on BIM and IOT
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent piling monitoring management method and system based on BIM and IOT. The intelligent piling monitoring management method based on BIM and IOT comprises the following steps: importing an original CAD drawing into an established BIM model, and performing light weight processing on the imported BIM model by using Unity3D to generate a BIM model with original design drawing information; uploading the BIM model with the original design drawing information to an IOT management platform, and carrying out online information management on the pile foundation construction process by utilizing the IOT management platform; pile foundation information in the construction process is acquired in real time by using a satellite system equipped with the pile machine and fed back to a three-dimensional model in the BIM model. The system comprises modules corresponding to the method steps.

title_en: Construction method of multi-middle section combined mining horizontal ore pillar critical thickness optimization calculation model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a multi-middle section combined mining horizontal ore pillar critical thickness optimization calculation model, and belongs to the technical field of mining processes. According to the method, the mechanical state of the horizontal ore pillar is analyzed, under the boundary condition of four-side solid support based on Mindlin medium plate theory, the horizontal ore pillar mechanical model with the bottom surface in the temporary space state is subjected to the combined action of multiple stress fields of upper uniform load, self gravity and bidirectional horizontal stress, the finite Fourier integral transformation method is adopted to solve and analyze the horizontal ore pillar mechanical model to obtain the internal force distribution rule of the horizontal ore pillar, the critical thickness optimization model of the horizontal ore pillar is constructed based on the maximum tensile stress rule, the mechanical effect of the horizontal ore pillar is clarified, and the constructed critical thickness optimization model of the horizontal ore pillar has important theoretical research significance and higher popularization and application value for accurately determining the critical thickness of the horizontal ore pillar in mines.

title_en: Method for calculating safety risk value of concrete gravity dam in operation period
abstract_en: The invention discloses a concrete gravity dam operation period safety risk value calculation method, which belongs to the field of hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering, and comprises the steps of firstly determining a concrete gravity dam operation period safety risk element and a risk event, and determining a risk factor weight, a risk event weight, a monitoring point weight and a dam segment weight and a severity level of the risk event in a questionnaire manner; then, establishing a judging standard table and a risk grade standard table of risk factors based on historical monitoring data and safety control requirements; finally, sequentially obtaining a risk factor possibility index, a risk event risk magnitude, each dam segment risk magnitude and an engineering overall safety risk value through multiple weighted averages. The method can perform comprehensive quantitative evaluation on the operation safety state of the dam, and plays an effective supporting role in intelligent management and accurate decision of engineering safety.

title_en: Urban water supply network comprehensive safety evaluation and monitoring point location method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of water supply network monitoring, and particularly relates to comprehensive safety evaluation and monitoring point selection of an urban water supply networkAn addressing method comprising the steps of: s1, establishing a comprehensive water supply safety evaluation system of a pipe network based on fuzzy analytic hierarchy process; s2, calculating a security risk index R of each node of the pipe network by using a fuzzy analytic hierarchy process based on the water supply security comprehensive evaluation system established by the S1  i  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the S3, obtaining a security risk index R of each node based on S2  i  Constructing a multi-objective optimization model, wherein the multi-objective optimization model is used for solving a monitoring point arrangement scheme; the objective function of the multi-objective optimization model comprises the maximum node coverage safety risk index, the maximum node coverage water quantity and the minimum monitoring point quantity ratio; and S4, solving and analyzing the multi-objective optimization model constructed in the step S3 by using an NSGA-II algorithm to obtain a monitoring point arrangement scheme. The method can directly obtain a reasonable monitoring point arrangement scheme, reduces subsequent optimization work, and saves manpower and material resources time.

title_en: Path fitting method, system and device based on tabu search algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a path fitting method, a system and a device based on a tabu search algorithm, wherein the tabu search algorithm is introduced to fit a vehicle passing path, so that a global optimal solution can be efficiently found, and accurate fitting of the path is realized. Meanwhile, an auxiliary verification model is built, various limiting requirements are built, the path is optimized in the process of fitting the path, and the problems that a user is wrong in station-around fitting and sub-closed loops appear in fitting are solved.

title_en: Cross-border protection priority region identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-border protection priority region identification method, which comprises the steps of constructing a resistance surface in an ecological network identification process through landscape ecological risk assessment; the ecological system service synergistic effect is identified through principal component analysis, so that the ecological function importance of different landscape units is evaluated, ecological recreation, biodiversity maintenance and soil conservation services are used as evaluation standards; identifying an ecological source land based on the importance of ecological functions and the existing protection area; and identifying the ecological network elements which are not covered by the existing protection area through GIS space superposition analysis, and taking the ecological network elements as the protection priority area. The invention identifies the ecological network elements which are not covered by the existing protection area through GIS space superposition analysis, and can be used for formulating more effective protection strategies and management measures as the protection priority area so as to protect the integrity and stability of the ecological system.

title_en: Synchronization method and device for verification face information and accessories of purchase invoice
