abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of an incoming invoice system, solves the problems that in the prior art, an accessory returned by verification information is not updated and the verification information is not synchronized to an incoming invoice management module, and discloses a method and a device for synchronizing verification face information and the accessory of a purchase invoice, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the state of an invoice and invoice information from a purchasing invoice management module; judging whether the invoice is verified according to the state of the invoice; judging whether the invoice is successfully verified according to the verification result; the method can automatically acquire an invoice source file, automatically update an accessory returned by verification information, and synchronously verify the same unverified invoice in the incoming invoice management module after the incoming invoice management module performs the incoming verification operation without re-verifying the same.

title_en: High-reliability electronic signature method of paperless transaction system for second-hand house transaction
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-reliability electronic signature method of a paperless transaction system for a second-hand house transaction, and relates to the technical field of electronic signatures. The method comprises the steps of sending electronic signature request information and obtaining signature track transformation information sent by a target terminal through different paths; the signature track is re-carved on the electronic signature board according to the signature track transformation information to form terminal typical signature information; signature authentication information from the data platform is obtained and is matched and compared with typical signature information of the terminal, so that complete electronic signature authentication information is formed. According to the method, the signature information is authenticated and uploaded and matched with different paths, so that safer information authentication is realized, and the reliability of the electronic signature information is greatly improved.

title_en: Risk processing method, device, equipment and medium for power grid line
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure relates to a risk processing method, device, equipment and medium for a power grid line, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a plurality of types of fault parameter values of each power grid line in a plurality of power grid lines; generating a first matrix according to a plurality of types of fault parameter values of each power grid line in the plurality of power grid lines; normalizing each matrix element in the first matrix to obtain a second matrix; calculating risk assessment values corresponding to each matrix element in the second matrix to obtain a third matrix; and calculating a risk index value of each power grid line according to the third matrix, and determining a target power grid line meeting preset risk processing conditions in the plurality of power grid lines according to the risk index value so as to facilitate risk processing on the target power grid line. In the technical scheme, the risk of possible faults of each power grid line can be accurately estimated, and the method has important significance for guaranteeing the safety of the power grid lines.

title_en: Method for synchronously processing data of multiple docking systems
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for synchronously processing data of a multi-docking system, which is applied to a first client, and comprises the following steps: responding to the application of the first client to the first data sent by at least two docking systems respectively, and calling the checking interfaces of each docking system to check the docking systems according to the type of the first data so as to enable the docking systems passing the checking to generate a system version number; according to a preset sending sequence, nesting all the slave transactions in turn; starting a main transaction and sending an application to a docking system; when the processing of the master transaction is successful, triggering and starting the next slave transaction nested by the master transaction, and sending an application to a docking system corresponding to the slave transaction until all the master transactions and the slave transactions are processed, or any one of the master transactions or the slave transactions fails to be processed, so that a client docks a plurality of systems, and the consistency of data sent to each docking system is ensured.

title_en: Comprehensive evaluation method for household garbage landfill excavation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive evaluation method for the excavation of a domestic garbage landfill, which comprehensively evaluates the feasibility of the recycling utilization of the excavation of the landfill from the aspects of overall sustainability including environment, economy and energy. The comprehensive evaluation of the three layers of environment, economy and energy can be performed on the landfill excavation, so that the excavation necessity of the landfill can be better evaluated. The method comprises the following steps: A. analyzing data; B. performing on-site investigation; C. sampling on site; D. analyzing on site; E. sample feeding detection; F. establishing a model; G. and (5) calculating and evaluating. The foundation data is input into the model by landfill excavation evaluation personnel, comprehensive evaluation indexes including environment, economy and energy are obtained by solving, the situation of landfill excavation is comprehensively known, suggestions are provided for the feasibility and the necessity of the landfill excavation, the evaluation efficiency of the household garbage landfill excavation is effectively improved, and the funds required by the household garbage landfill excavation evaluation are reduced.

title_en: Equipment operation control method, device, server and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device operation control method, a device, a server and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring passenger flow information of a target business area in a first time period and passenger flow information of a target business area in a second time period, wherein the first time period is a time period before the second time period; predicting passenger flow prediction information of a third time period according to the passenger flow information of the first time period and the passenger flow information of the second time period, wherein the third time period is a time period after the second time period; acquiring a first power plan of a third time period, wherein the first power plan comprises first operation power of electric equipment and first operation electric quantity of energy storage equipment; according to the passenger flow prediction information, adjusting the first operation power of the electric equipment and the first operation electric quantity of the energy storage equipment to obtain a second electricity utilization plan of a third time period; and controlling the operation of the electric equipment and the energy storage equipment according to the second electricity utilization plan in a third time period.

title_en: Industrial and commercial load potential analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a potential analysis method of industrial and commercial loads, which comprises the steps of acquiring historical data information of industrial and commercial loads and performing data processing to obtain a processing data set; constructing a work and business load potential analysis index set; calculating potential analysis indexes of industrial and commercial loads by adopting a processing data set; and completing potential analysis of the industrial and commercial loads according to the potential analysis index data. The invention also discloses a system for realizing the industrial and commercial load potential analysis method. According to the method, the obtained historical data are subjected to data cleaning and processing, the load potential analysis index is constructed in a targeted mode, and the load potential analysis index is calculated according to the historical data, so that analysis of industrial and commercial load potential is completed; therefore, the invention has higher reliability, better accuracy and more objectivity and science.

title_en: Logging data interpretation method based on multidimensional signal analysis neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of log data interpretation, and discloses a log data interpretation method based on a multidimensional signal analysis neural network, which comprises the following steps: performing characteristic transformation on the logging curve to obtain a logging curve characteristic diagram; the overall characteristic diagram of the logging curve is obtained through connection operation of the logging curve characteristic diagram; obtaining statistical information of the overall feature map on the channel through global statistical pooling to obtain pooling results; the pooling result is processed through a compression network to obtain a compression vector; and transforming the compression vector by using an expansion network, multiplying the characteristic diagram of each logging curve by the corresponding channel attention according to the channel, adding the multiplied characteristic diagram and the corresponding channel attention to obtain a comprehensive logging curve characteristic diagram, and inputting the comprehensive logging curve characteristic diagram into an output network to obtain the geological information of the well. The invention can effectively capture the complex relation between the multi-dimensional signals of the logging data samples, and can highlight the key characteristics inside a single signal.

title_en: Method and device for testing lithium battery state estimation algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of lithium batteries and discloses a method and a device for testing a lithium battery state estimation algorithm. According to the method, a python script program is adopted to read battery standard working condition data acquired by a battery acquisition instrument according to a preset first time interval, single working condition data at a single temperature and working condition data at different temperatures are randomly switched to form combined working condition data, the single working condition data and the combined working condition data are determined to be real-time working condition data, the real-time working condition data are transmitted to a data center station through a modbus protocol according to a preset second time interval, and testing of a lithium battery state estimation algorithm is completed. The invention can improve the debugging efficiency and the testing efficiency of the state estimation algorithm, realize more flexible and accurate algorithm testing and save testing time.

title_en: Based on CO2Full-period source-sink matching optimization method for source-sink attribute and decision time
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-period source-sink matching optimization method based on CO  2  source-sink attributes and decision time, which comprises the following steps: determining the quantity of all CO  2  sources and sinks, the service lives of the CO  2  sources and the sinks, the annual trapping capacity of the CO  2  sources and the annual sealing capacity of the sinks; taking the initial working time of each CO  2  source and sink as a decision variable, taking the total amount of CO  2  captured from any CO  2  source point and sealed in any CO  2  sink in a preset system planning period and any year in the system planning period as a process variable, establishing a system maximum CO  2  sealing quantity model, and solving to obtain the maximum CO  2  sealing quantity and the initial working time of each CO  2  source and sink in the whole system period; and determining the lowest transportation cost function of the system based on the maximum CO  2  storage quantity of the system, and solving to obtain a source-sink matching scheme. The invention provides a specific source sink matching scheme of the CO  2  source and sink at any moment under the condition of meeting the maximum system sealing quantity and the lowest transportation cost.

title_en: Method for automatically generating claim bill based on claim data
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for automatically generating a claim bill based on claim data, which comprises the following steps: s1: the user logs in a claim bill page; s2: the user authorizes to acquire the position information; s3: according to the acquired position information, interacting with the background, and matching and screening claim settlement data; s4: selecting claim data to be displayed; s5: configuring a template; s6: responding to user operation, sending a generation instruction, and outputting a generation result; s7: the user confirms whether the generated result is satisfied; the invention realizes the sharing of the claim data of provinces, cities and business units, acquires the claim data of the business units, the city companies and the provinces of the self in real time by using personnel through the data display of the foreground, completely realizes the sharing of the claim data, and solves the problems of uneven distribution of the claim data, opaque data and the like in daily business. The method is suitable for various use scenes such as automatic generation and communication of users at any time and any place when users are about clients and settle and communicate.

title_en: Automatic acceptance and distribution method for digital government administration event
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data calculation, relates to automatic acceptance and allocation of events according to event content in the fields of government administration, digital government network management and other industries, and particularly relates to an automatic acceptance and allocation method of digital government administration events. The invention aims to realize automatic acceptance and allocation of government governmental events by the method and the system, and solve the problems of large workload, low allocation accuracy, time and labor consumption, low disposal efficiency and the like of manual acceptance and allocation of government governmental events. In the process of calculating event handling departments, the invention adopts various algorithms to calculate the handling departments corresponding to the events, and determines the main responsibility department and the sponsor department of event handling according to the similarity between the calculated events and the events, thereby solving the problems of withering and tearing skin among departments, low handling efficiency and the like in the event handling process.

title_en: Regional polishing parameter generation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of floor tile polishing, and particularly discloses a method and a device for generating regional polishing parameters, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a monitoring video set of a target area; analyzing flow information and placer information in a target area according to a monitoring video set to divide the target area into a plurality of different types of functional areas, wherein the types of the functional areas comprise a flow area, an unmanned area, a fixed article area and a moving article area; configuring polishing parameters of each functional area according to the types of the functional areas and a preset polishing parameter mapping table; the method divides the target area into a plurality of different types of functional areas which can respectively represent the use modes and the use conditions of different areas based on the video data of the monitoring video set, and then configures proper polishing parameters based on the types of the functional areas so as to enable the floor tile polishing robot to polish and renew the floor tile, thereby guaranteeing the polishing and renewing effects of the floor tile polishing robot.

title_en: Power distribution network voltage prediction method based on long-short-period neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network voltage prediction method based on a long-short-period neural network, which comprises the steps of obtaining a power distribution network voltage data set; dividing a power distribution network voltage data set to obtain a training set, a verification set and a test set; training the long-term and short-term neural network by adopting a training set, and checking the long-term and short-term neural network model result by adopting a verification set; optimizing the verification set by adopting a Bayesian optimization algorithm, and storing a trained long-and-short-term neural network model; inputting a test set to verify a long-term and short-term neural network test set; the method has the advantages that the test set is optimized by adopting the Bayesian optimization algorithm, the power distribution network voltage prediction model is output, the power distribution network voltage is predicted to obtain a voltage prediction graph and the like, the power distribution network voltage can be accurately predicted, long-term dependency in the sequence can be better captured through LSTM on time sequence data, the relationship between the sequences can be more comprehensively understood, and therefore the performance of the model is improved.

title_en: Attendance management system and attendance management method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an attendance management system and an attendance management method, which relate to the technical field of attendance management.

title_en: Post-loan risk monitoring method and system for agricultural loan based on land parcel information
abstract_en: A post-loan risk monitoring method and system of agricultural loans based on land parcel information relates to the technical field of intelligent loan risk monitoring, and the post-loan risk monitoring method and system are characterized in that remote sensing images of loan application information of target customers and remote sensing images of target land parcel are acquired, and then image processing and semantic understanding algorithms are introduced into the rear end to analyze the remote sensing images and the loan application information, so that post-loan risk detection and grade judgment are comprehensively carried out, the accuracy and efficiency of post-loan risk monitoring can be improved, the cost and risk loss of manual investigation are reduced, and better decision basis is provided for financial institutions.

title_en: Forest fire risk assessment method and device, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a forest fire risk assessment method, a forest fire risk assessment device, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: for each monitoring area, determining each monitoring point in the monitoring area from the causal probability sum or graph, and calculating the fire occurrence probability of the monitoring area according to the fire occurrence probability of each monitoring point contained in the monitoring area; and determining each monitoring area in the forest to be evaluated from the causal probability and the or graph, and determining the fire occurrence probability of the forest to be evaluated according to the fire occurrence probability of each monitoring area in the forest to be evaluated so as to obtain a fire risk evaluation result of the forest to be evaluated. By the method, the comprehensiveness of forest fire risk assessment is improved, and forest loss is reduced.

title_en: Cloud computing-based pharmaceutical and mechanical recommendation analysis algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloud computing-based pharmaceutical recommendation analysis algorithm, which relates to the technical field of pharmaceutical recommendation, and is characterized in that characteristic data are extracted by carrying out characteristic engineering on attribute data of data points, a processing end calculates Euclidean distance matrix among the data points according to the characteristic data, the data points are divided into core points, boundary points and noise points based on a preset neighborhood radius and a sample number threshold value in combination with Euclidean distance among the data points, three types of data clusters are generated according to the division result of the data points, and after recommendation ordering is carried out on all the data points in the data clusters, different data clusters are visualized by using the scatter diagram. According to the analysis algorithm, the medical instruments produced by enterprises are classified based on the characteristic data, so that the analysis algorithm is suitable for enterprises of different types, and when historical purchases of users are matched with the clusters, optimal medical instrument products can be automatically recommended to the users, so that the purchase conversion rate of the medical instruments is effectively improved, and the selection faced by the users is simplified and reasonable.

title_en: Power supply user partitioning method based on current load
abstract_en: The invention provides a current load-based power supply user partitioning method, which relates to the technical field of power supply partitioning, and comprises the following steps: acquiring an average area of a house and taking the average area of the house as a quantization index of a power supply area; gridding a power supply area; and carrying out regional division on the meshed power supply region. By the method, the technical problem that a series of potential safety hazards exist in rural power distribution network construction and operation is solved, and the technical effects of dividing power supply users in rural planning areas in a partitioning mode and enabling the power supply users to be more accurate and scientific are achieved.

title_en: Digital twinning-based ergonomic evaluation system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an ergonomic evaluation system and method based on digital twinning, and belongs to the field of digital twinning. According to the invention, through the combined action of the software part and the hardware part, the digital twin association relationship between the physical entity and the virtual model is established. The data acquisition device worn by the system operator realizes the acquisition of actual motion and state data of a real-world human body in the process of operating equipment according to an operation rule or related requirements by the operator, the data of the change process of the human-computer system is represented by a three-dimensional model, and the visibility, the accessibility and the comfort in the process of operating the equipment are evaluated by using a model identification module, a model correction module, a human-computer evaluation module and a data storage module of the system. The invention provides a digital twin-based ergonomic evaluation system and a digital twin-based ergonomic evaluation method, which can effectively realize the ergonomic evaluation of equipment in a design stage, shorten the development period of the equipment and the equipment, and improve the design efficiency.

title_en: Health evaluation method, system, terminal equipment and storage medium of photovoltaic power station
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of photovoltaic field health degree evaluation, and provides a health degree evaluation method, a system, terminal equipment and a storage medium of a photovoltaic power station, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the equipment types of all the equipment of the photovoltaic power station; aiming at each equipment type, acquiring operation data corresponding to equipment belonging to the equipment type according to the corresponding relation between the equipment type and the operation data in the evaluation knowledge base; the operational data includes voltage data; performing data processing on the voltage data of each device to obtain statistical voltage data; and calling a preset evaluation rule from an evaluation knowledge base, and performing health evaluation on each device based on the statistical voltage data and the preset evaluation rule to obtain health evaluation results of each device and health evaluation results of the photovoltaic power station. According to the method and the device, the operation data of each device of the photovoltaic power station can be automatically acquired, the workload of manual evaluation is reduced, and the accuracy of the health evaluation result is improved.

title_en: System and method for automatically calculating doubling delay fulfillment gold in segmentation mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for automatically calculating doubling delay fulfilling money in a sectionalized mode, wherein an interest rate information module is used for configuring different synchronous loan benchmark interest rates, corresponding time points and grades; the configuration module is used for setting delay fulfillment starting date and delay track ending date and calculating the number of interest days of each section by combining the time point of the synchronous loan reference interest rate in a subsection manner; the computing base setting module is used for setting a computing base; and the calculation module is used for respectively calculating the delayed performance fund summation of each segment according to the number of the rest days of the segments, the corresponding synchronous loan reference interest rate, the grade and the calculation base to obtain doubled debt interest, and outputting calculation results and processes. The invention omits the complicated manual calculation, and automatically searches the corresponding interest rate, so that the standard of the calculation process is unified and accords with the relevant regulation of law, and the calculation process is searchable.

title_en: Intelligent auxiliary training system and method based on nuclear facility simulator
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nuclear facility operator training, and particularly relates to an intelligent auxiliary training system and method based on a nuclear facility simulator. Inquiring from a coach station database and a hardware interface point database of the nuclear facility simulator to generate a fault table, a fault group table and a platform screen hardware point table of the intelligent auxiliary training system database; realizing examination question editing, new construction and editing of training scenes, saving the examination questions and the training scenes to a question library and a scene library, and forming a scene file for each scene; loading a scene file generated by a scene editor, displaying scene content, transmitting a control command to a core facility simulator according to a time sequence, changing input model parameters so that each simulation model of the core facility simulator influences calculation, analyzing and executing evaluation logic codes, evaluating operation, and realizing multi-disc on the stored and recorded training data; and automatically collecting management scene execution data, and analyzing and counting. The cognitive depth of teaching staff on the training effect is enhanced, and the refinement and scientificalness level of training is improved.

title_en: Time sequence processing method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The specification provides a time sequence processing method, a time sequence processing device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of groups of time sequences of a plurality of data sources aiming at respective indexes to be detected; determining second type starting time of each group of time sequences and aligned time after each time sequence is segmented according to the first type starting time and sampling interval of each group of time sequences; the first type of starting time is the starting time of the initial time series of each group, the second type of starting time is the starting time of the time series of each group after being processed, optimized and aligned, and the second type of starting time of the time series of multiple groups is the same; calculating index data at the time points of which the time sequences correspond to the second type starting time and the time points aligned after the time sequence segmentation processing to obtain time sequences of which the time points are aligned and a plurality of groups of index data are contained; the method solves the problem that time sequences acquired by different data sources aiming at respective indexes to be detected are not aligned in time.

title_en: Case analysis method, device, equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a case analysis method, a case analysis device, case analysis equipment and a computer readable storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of legal consultation. After a first case text of a target foreign family event is detected, inputting the first case text into a pre-trained case analysis model, wherein the first case text comprises case facts of the target foreign family event, and the case analysis model is trained based on a BERTopac model; based on a case analysis model and a preset case database, carrying out case analysis on the target foreign-household events to obtain target judgment reasons and target judgment results of the target foreign-household events, wherein the case database stores a large number of case facts, judgment reasons and judgment results of the foreign-household events. The invention improves the quality of legal consultation service.

title_en: Identification method and system of simulation equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an identification method and system of analog equipment, equipment and a storage medium. Firstly, acquiring software parameters and hardware parameters from an operation environment through an SDK of a client; executing a section of specific code in the client to compare the execution results according to different characteristics of the simulation device and the real chip architecture; the variability of user behavior patterns in the case of analog devices and true machines is also taken into account. And finally, carrying out weighted calculation on detection results of all the clients through a preset weight model on the client or the server so as to judge whether the terminal is the simulation equipment, and because a plurality of conditions are comprehensively considered in the detection process of the simulation equipment, the misjudgment problem caused by adopting one mode alone can be avoided, and the accuracy and the stability of the detection of the simulation equipment are improved.

title_en: Standardized evaluation management method and system for enterprise safety production
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise safety production standardized evaluation management method and system, in particular to the technical field of safety evaluation, which mainly solves the problem that the qualification rate of the returned goods is reduced after the returned goods are transported back and forth through evaluation detection, predicts the quantity of stock form according to the historical sales quantity of the products, evaluates the state of the products in a warehouse, and determines the products to be periodically rotated according to the evaluation result; acquiring state parameters and transportation environment parameters of the returned goods products, and establishing a product safety quality assessment coefficient through data analysis; the enterprise safety production standardized evaluation management system is characterized by comprising the following modules: the method is favorable for improving the quality of sold products, reducing the cost, improving the qualification rate of returned goods products and winning market competition advantages.

title_en: Early warning method and early warning device for transport vehicle, cloud server and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a pre-warning method, a pre-warning device, a cloud server and a storage medium of a transport vehicle, wherein the method is applied to the field of vehicle transport and comprises the following steps: under the condition that the vehicle is in a transportation mode, acquiring transportation parameters of the vehicle, wherein the transportation parameters are used for representing the vehicle state of the vehicle in the transportation mode; determining whether the vehicle meets preset early warning conditions according to the transportation parameters; under the condition that the vehicle meets the preset early warning condition, after the vehicle exits the transportation mode, determining whether the vehicle is abnormal in the transportation process according to the first image before the vehicle is transported and the second image after the vehicle is transported. The method can intelligently judge whether the vehicle is abnormal during transportation according to the transportation parameters and images of the vehicle, and ensures the accuracy and reliability of vehicle state identification.

title_en: Resource cluster regulation and control method, system, storage medium and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a resource cluster regulation and control method, a system, a storage medium and computer equipment, and relates to the technical field of power systems; generating at least one energy storage cluster and at least one power transmission cluster according to the energy storage equipment data and the power transmission equipment data; generating at least one power generation cluster according to the power generation geographic position; generating time power characteristics of the power generation clusters according to the power generation historical data; dividing the power generation cluster into at least one stable power generation sub-cluster and at least one fluctuation power generation sub-cluster according to the time power characteristics; according to load demands, all stable power generation sub-clusters, fluctuation power generation sub-clusters, energy storage clusters and power transmission clusters are matched, stable power transmission data, fluctuation power transmission data and energy storage power transmission data are respectively generated, and a resource cluster regulation and control scheme is generated based on an optimizing algorithm. The invention can improve the running efficiency of the power grid and reduce the power grid loss.

title_en: Regional level comprehensive energy large-scale data cleaning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a regional comprehensive energy large-scale data cleaning method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a power data segment; acquiring suspected abnormal power data segments according to the data in each power data segment; acquiring each piece of suspected abnormal power data in the suspected abnormal power data section according to adjacent data in the suspected abnormal power data section, and calculating irrational degree of change of each piece of suspected abnormal power data; and acquiring the normal degree of the suspected abnormal power data according to the irrational degree of the variation of the suspected abnormal power data, obtaining the selection range of the root node in the isolated forest algorithm for the suspected abnormal power data section, cleaning the abnormal data in the suspected abnormal power data section, and performing power data cleaning. According to the invention, the abnormal data can be easily segmented by narrowing the selection range of the root node in the isolated forest algorithm, so that the aim of improving the data cleaning efficiency is fulfilled.

title_en: Water resource system vulnerability prediction method and system based on downscaling information processing
abstract_en: The invention provides a water resource system vulnerability prediction method and system based on downscaling information processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring simulated climate data and measured climate data of a river basin to be predicted; performing downscaling information processing and correction processing on the simulated climate data; inputting corrected simulated future climate data into a river basin scale distributed hydrological model, and simulating to obtain runoff data and evaporation data under the future climate change situation; water resource system vulnerability is predicted by combining population data, economic data, land data, water usage data and a prediction framework. The scale of the simulated climate data can be reduced to the scale of the river basin to be predicted, so that the spatial resolution of the data for prediction is improved, and the quality of a prediction result is improved; in addition, the deviation between the predicted result and the actual data of the water resource system can be reduced by correcting the actually measured climate data, so that the risk existing in the water resource system can be timely reflected.

title_en: Contract generation method, platform and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a contract generation method, a contract generation platform and a contract generation storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of responding to a contract configuration request, generating a contract visual configuration view, wherein the contract visual configuration view comprises an attribute component area, a contract generation area and an associated configuration area; in the contract visual configuration view, dragging the selected component from the attribute component area to the contract generation area in response to the component configuration request, and performing component configuration operation on the component selected in the contract generation area; in the contract visual configuration view, responding to an association configuration input request, and carrying out association component setting on the components selected in the contract generation area in the association configuration area; the display content in the contract generation area is released to generate the first contract, and the platform and the storage medium apply the method, so that the process of online contract configuration can be simplified through the method, and the online contract configuration is more convenient and efficient.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for positioning uploading signing receipt
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of base note uploading, and discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for uploading and signing a base note in a positioning way; the method comprises the steps of obtaining the base bill information of a shipping bill to be dispatched and the longitude and latitude information of a package position; analyzing longitude and latitude information of a package position of a shipping bill to be dispatched into longitude and latitude and geographic structure information; acquiring the longitude and latitude information of the real-time package position of the to-be-dispatched bill, and analyzing the real-time package longitude and latitude information of the to-be-dispatched bill into real-time longitude and latitude and real-time geographic structure information; transmitting the real-time longitude and latitude and the real-time geographic structure information to a server side; receiving positioning judgment information and result judgment information sent by a server; according to the positioning judgment information, display map information and display result information are generated, operation can be guaranteed to be carried out at the correct preset place by a dispatcher all the time, the situation that a shipping bill is not signed is avoided, timeliness and quality of service are guaranteed, and efficiency of logistics operation is improved.

title_en: Talent belonging industry determining method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a talent belonging industry determining method, a talent belonging industry determining device, talent belonging equipment and a talent belonging storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a resume to be analyzed, analyzing the resume to be analyzed, and determining at least one piece of historical work information; determining industry information corresponding to each piece of historical work information; determining target industry information according to the industry information and preset attenuation weights; according to the method, an industry classification result is determined according to target industry information, the problem of inaccurate industry prediction is solved, because working information in different time periods affects current industry selection differently, attenuation weights are preset, the industry information is subjected to weighting operation through the preset attenuation weights to obtain the target industry information, the industry classification result of the industry to which talents belong is determined through the target industry information, the accuracy of the industry classification result is improved through weighting the industry information through the attenuation weights, the industry to which the talents belong is better positioned, and talents are reasonably screened.

title_en: Food quality detection method and device based on machine learning
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a food quality detection method and device based on machine learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting historical detection records of food quality detection, public data sets and related data of data provided by partners, and integrating the collected data to ensure that the format and structure of the data are consistent; labeling the data with consistent format and structure, and distributing quality labels for each sample data; inputting the labeling data into a yolo-v5 model for training; classifying each anchor frame determined by the yolo-v5 model to distinguish the existence of an object in the anchor frame; continuously monitoring detection data output by the yolo-v5 model, observing the distribution, change and other conditions of the data, determining information that the data value exceeds a threshold value and the distribution changes when the monitoring data is abnormal, and outputting abnormal identification as records of food quality detection abnormality. The food quality detection method and device improve accuracy, efficiency and automation degree of food quality detection, and reduce detection cost.

title_en: Electric automobile virtual energy storage cluster scheduling target collaborative optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cooperative optimization method and a cooperative optimization system for virtual energy storage cluster dispatching targets of an electric automobile, and belongs to the technical field of electric automobile dispatching optimization. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a layered architecture for layered energy management, dividing the electric vehicle into clusters, and obtaining virtual energy storage clusters of the electric vehicle; constructing a multi-target quantum genetic algorithm, and solving a preset model according to various parameters of the electric vehicle charging and discharging service determined by a terminal user and the multi-target quantum genetic algorithm to obtain a multi-target quantum genetic energy management strategy; and optimally controlling virtual energy storage cluster dispatching of the electric automobile according to the multi-target quantum genetic energy management strategy. According to the method, a layered architecture is formed by adopting a layered energy management mode, user will is considered for different clusters, a multi-target quantum genetic energy management strategy is obtained through solving a multi-target quantum genetic algorithm, optimal scheduling of electric vehicles with coordinated targets is achieved, and power grid scheduling efficiency is improved.

title_en: Method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium for determining pest control adaptation period
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for determining a proper period for pest control, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of pest control. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring pest monitoring data of a crop planting area, wherein the pest monitoring data are acquired by pest monitoring equipment deployed in the crop planting area; if the insect-port monitoring data is larger than or equal to a preset insect-port threshold value, determining that the control adaptive period of the crop planting area is the current moment; and if the pest population monitoring data is smaller than a preset pest population threshold value, determining a control period monitoring result of the crop planting area based on the pest occurrence period monitoring result of the crop planting area. The invention can improve the accuracy of determining the proper period of pest control, further improve the pest control effect, finally improve the yield and quality of crops, reduce the pesticide spraying amount and further reduce the pest control cost.

title_en: Customer service scoring model construction method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a customer service scoring model construction method, a customer service scoring model construction device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The application relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and deep learning. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of unlabeled customer service data, real label information thereof and a plurality of identification teacher networks, and identifying each customer service data and data types of each identification teacher network; based on the recognition teacher network, predicting pseudo tag information of each customer service data, and screening target customer service data corresponding to noise values lower than a noise threshold; generating a transition probability matrix of the data type based on transition probability information between pseudo tag information and real tag information of each target customer service data; training an initial recognition student model through a knowledge distillation loss function based on the information to obtain a recognition student model corresponding to the data type; and obtaining a scoring strategy of each data type, thereby constructing a customer service scoring model. By adopting the method, the training efficiency of the customer service scoring model can be improved.

title_en: Method and device for collaborative supervision of energy distribution
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a device for cooperatively monitoring energy distribution. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring data of a to-be-detected area of the area and electric power data of a power distribution network; carrying out quality analysis according to the electric energy data of the power grid, the data of the to-be-detected area and a preset quality analysis model to obtain a quality analysis result; and carrying out scheme screening according to the quality analysis result and a preset energy control scheme to obtain a target energy control scheme. By adopting the method, the power quality of the station area can be monitored in real time, so that the power quality of the station area is improved, the energy of the adjacent station area is reasonably distributed, the analysis efficiency and accuracy of the power quality can be improved by utilizing the preset quality analysis model, and meanwhile, the stable operation of the station area can be ensured based on the preset energy management and control scheme.

title_en: Intelligent workshop fuzzy scheduling method and system based on genetic algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent workshop fuzzy scheduling method and system based on a genetic algorithm, which relate to the technical field of workshop task scheduling, and the method comprises the following steps: randomly generating an initial population P, and dividing the initial population P into a plurality of evolutionary subgroups according to similarity; performing one round of independent evolution on each evolution subgroup, and transmitting excellent workshop scheduling schemes and evolution experiences to other evolution subgroups; carrying out one round of integral evolution on all evolutionary subgroups; the method comprises the steps of independent evolution and integral evolution, and the method comprises the steps of dividing an initial population into a plurality of evolution subgroups according to similarity, then adopting the independent evolution of each evolution subgroup, transmitting excellent information data, and carrying out data processing in an integral evolution alternate mode of all evolution subgroups, so that the problem that the population falls into a stagnation state is avoided, the method is beneficial to searching for a global optimal solution while maintaining the diversity of the population, and the global superiority of the scheduling scheme is improved.

title_en: Text watermarking method, system, equipment and storable medium based on character size in financial field
abstract_en: The invention provides a text watermarking method based on character size, a text watermarking system based on character size, text watermarking equipment based on character size and a storage medium in the financial field, wherein a common Chinese character determining algorithm based on K-means clustering is used, and the algorithm takes Chinese characters as data points, introduces density, and avoids merging small clusters of a high-density region with large clusters of a low-density region; the K value is adaptively adjusted according to the distribution of the data. The invention does not need to modify the system word stock, only needs to regenerate a text according to the identity information of the user, and aims at the common words in work, the text can be modified in word size, and the modification rule of the word size is the embedded watermark information. The method is simple and efficient, is suitable for printing, scanning, photographing, screenshot and other scenes, does not need to add hidden watermark information in the text, only modifies the word size of the common word, and avoids the possible influence of the word stock replacement method on the stability of the operating system.

title_en: Method for detecting production quality of protection leather sheath with keyboard by iPad
abstract_en: The invention relates to a production quality detection method for an iPad protection leather sheath with a keyboard, and belongs to the technical field of data processing. Comprises the steps of evaluating the quality of the protective leather sheath; photographing the protective leather sheath to be detected through an imaging detection system to obtain an image to be detected; noise reduction is carried out on the detection image, and a plurality of images are combined; performing edge detection and gray scale treatment of the protective leather sheath; obtaining the abnormal degree of the color, shape and texture of each region; performing hole position accuracy evaluation on the protection leather sheath detection image, and obtaining a standard protection leather sheath model according to the design information of the protection leather sheath; comparing the protective leather sheath with a standard protective leather sheath model, and performing a pressure simulation test; sorting the protective leather sheath. The invention provides a method for detecting the production quality of a protective leather sheath with a keyboard by using an iPad, which is used for carrying out quality on the protective leather sheath based on a target image, avoiding artificial interference and improving the detection precision and the detection efficiency of detection.

title_en: Text feature fraud early warning system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides a text feature fraud early warning system based on artificial intelligence, which relates to the field of electric digital data processing and comprises a case acquisition module, a text analysis module, an information interception module and a fraud early warning module, wherein the case acquisition module is used for acquiring real fraud case information, the text analysis module is used for extracting text information in a case and analyzing the text information to obtain text features, the information interception module is used for acquiring chat information received by a terminal, and the fraud early warning module is used for carrying out fraud recognition and early warning on the chat information; the system is based on a large number of actual cases, the text information is intelligently analyzed to obtain the characteristic information, and the chat content on the terminal is identified as fraud according to the characteristic information, so that the fraud information can be effectively pre-warned.

title_en: Method and system for automatically scheduling deicing vehicle and guiding vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for automatically dispatching deicing vehicles and guiding vehicles, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining deicing requirement information, wherein the deicing requirement information comprises deicing time information, airplane position information, deicing grade information and a task scheduling mode; determining corresponding demand quantities of the deicing vehicle and the guiding vehicle according to a preset strategy, deicing grade information and a task scheduling mode; screening deicing vehicle groups which are matched with the deicing time information, wherein the distance between the deicing vehicle groups and the aircraft position information accords with a preset distance, meet the corresponding demand of the deicing vehicle and the guide vehicle, and are matched with the deicing time information from a configured task schedule, and the deicing vehicle groups comprise at least one deicing vehicle and at least one guide vehicle; and transmitting deicing requirement information to the adaptive deicing vehicle set. The method for automatically dispatching the deicing vehicle and guiding the vehicle can optimize task allocation and route planning of the vehicle, improve the operation efficiency and reduce the waiting time and queuing waiting.

title_en: Contractor safety management system based on integral system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a contractor safety management system based on an integral system, which comprises a safety information acquisition terminal and a server, wherein a safety training video is played and controlled through a safety training acquisition control module, and safety training video information is acquired; the server acquires the acquired information of the safety information acquisition terminal through the safety information acquisition module, the safety point calculation module carries out point calculation according to the acquired safety training video information, the safety risk assessment module carries out the grade assessment of the safety risk according to the point calculation result of the safety point calculation module and outputs safety prompt signals of corresponding grades, and the safety information acquisition terminal is provided with a plurality of safety information acquisition terminals so as to acquire and calculate the safety information of multiple parties, so that the timely discovery and processing of the multi-party safety monitoring and potential safety risk can be realized, and the production safety of enterprises is ensured.

title_en: Air conditioner hose product performance test data management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air-conditioning hose product performance test data management system, which belongs to the technical field of air-conditioning hose product performance test data management and comprises a data statistics module and a data analysis module, wherein the data statistics module is used for butting a database for storing air-conditioning hose product performance test data, identifying each performance test data, carrying out classification statistics on each performance test data to form a test statistical diagram of an air-conditioning hose product, the data analysis module is used for carrying out performance analysis on the air-conditioning hose product based on the test statistical diagram, acquiring batch analysis data from the test statistical diagram according to an acquired product number table, setting a batch test value set according to the batch analysis data, calculating a batch analysis value according to the batch test value set, generating a corresponding batch curve according to the batch test value and the number of test batches, identifying peaks in the batch curve in real time, calculating curve difference values of each test batch based on the peaks in real time, and generating production optimization data when the curve difference values are larger than a threshold value X1.

title_en: Building engineering project progress management system and optimization method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction project progress management system and an optimization method thereof, which relate to the technical field of project progress management, wherein progress conditions of tasks are tracked in real time through a progress monitoring module, a risk assessment module is used for identifying and assessing risks related to task progress when different project tasks progress, a quality management module is used for recording quality control activities of different project tasks when the different project tasks progress, analyzing progress quality of the projects by combining construction quality of the different project tasks after the projects are completed, and a reporting module is used for generating various reports and analyzing and displaying the reports to an administrator. The management system can effectively track the progress of tasks of different projects, evaluate the risk and quality of the tasks in the progress tracking process, ensure the safety and quality of the progress of the tasks, comprehensively analyze the overall progress quality of the engineering projects according to the quality analysis result of each task after the engineering projects are finished, realize more comprehensive analysis and facilitate corresponding management of administrators.

title_en: Project management method, system, equipment and medium for street engineering construction
abstract_en: A project management method, system, equipment and medium for street engineering construction relates to the engineering construction field. In the method, street engineering construction project management flow chart data are acquired and analyzed, and association relations among project management nodes are determined; generating project management task execution time sequences corresponding to each project management node according to the association relation; carrying out node task calculation on each project management node in turn according to the project management task execution time sequence to obtain a calculation result; and correlating the calculation result with the street engineering construction project management flow chart data. By implementing the technical scheme provided by the application, the effect of automatically managing the projects in the street engineering construction is realized.

title_en: Repair process modularization combination optimization design method and system for repair line
abstract_en: The invention provides a repair process modularization combination optimization design method and a repair process modularization combination optimization design system for a repair line, which belong to the field of equipment repair, wherein the method comprises the following steps: dividing the actual field space by the field space of the single equipment, and calculating the number of repair line modules; calculating a repair process array, and dividing the responsible repair process for each repair line module; taking the maximum number of repair personnel required by each process in each module as the number of repair personnel of the module; and outputting the overall scheme. The invention can rapidly and stably obtain the overall scheme of the repair line with the average repair time being the main optimization target, and the repair process modularization combination optimization design method of the repair line has universality.

title_en: Sealing point leakage detection method and system for refining enterprise, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sealing point leakage detection method for a refining enterprise, which comprises the following steps: s110, establishing a seal point basic information base based on geographic information, graphic images and attribute characteristics; s120, establishing an association relation between the sealing point and the related execution rule or taking the related execution rule as an additional attribute of the sealing point; s130, determining a detection plan type according to a detection purpose, screening a sealing point to be detected, configuring a detection path optimization strategy, and generating a sealing point detection list; and S140, performing leakage detection, quality control and integrity evaluation according to the sealing point detection list. The invention also discloses a sealing point leakage detection system, electronic equipment and a storage medium of the refining enterprise. The invention can be related according to the data information of the sealing points and related execution regulations, so that the detection path is automatically optimized, the problem that the detection sequence and the statistical sequence cannot be completely matched is solved, and the locating efficiency is high.

title_en: Intelligent city treatment system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent city management system based on the Internet of things, and the operation method of the system comprises the following steps: step one: image acquisition and garbage stacking state monitoring are carried out; step two: monitoring and calculating the filling level of the dustbin; step three: garbage clearance is realized by integrating the garbage overlapping degree and the filling degree of the garbage can; step four: based on historical data and real-time monitoring data, predicting future garbage generation trend and demand, wherein the garbage stacking state monitoring and image acquisition module is used for monitoring garbage stacking states around the garbage can in real time and acquiring state information of the garbage can through image acquisition; the dustbin filling level monitoring and calculating module is used for monitoring the current filling level of each dustbin in real time; the garbage generation trend and demand prediction module is used for predicting the future garbage generation trend and demand; the invention has the characteristic of effectively improving the urban garbage management quality.

title_en: Driving training track playback content analysis method
abstract_en: The application provides a driving training track playback content analysis method, which comprises the following steps: according to the driving training track, playing back video data, and acquiring the environment information of braking and steering of a driver in the driving process; according to the environmental information of braking and steering of a driver in the driving process, extracting braking and steering characteristics; according to the environmental condition information and the extracted braking and steering characteristic data, evaluating the braking timeliness and steering accuracy of a driver; recording the sight line movement and the gaze point of a driver, extracting the sight line behavior characteristics of the driver under different conditions, and calculating the sight line transfer speed; according to the sight line behavior characteristics and the sight line transfer speed of the driver under different conditions, evaluating the sight line transfer strategy of the driver; and (3) establishing a driver reaction and decision model, and evaluating the reaction modes and decision countermeasures of the driver under different driving situations.

title_en: Energy consumption analysis system for urban illumination street lamp
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban street lamp energy consumption analysis, which is used for solving the problems that in the existing urban street lamp system, the energy consumption of a street lamp is not regulated and controlled effectively, so that energy is wasted and unnecessary energy consumption is caused, in addition, the dirt state and the environmental illumination requirement of the street lamp are not monitored and analyzed effectively, and intelligent energy consumption management cannot be realized, in particular to an energy consumption analysis system for an urban illumination street lamp, which comprises an illumination physical influence analysis module, an illumination environment requirement analysis module, an illumination energy consumption regulation and control module, a cloud database and a management terminal. According to the invention, the energy consumption state of the street lamp is monitored and regulated in real time, and the feedback grade and the illumination demand grade are combined with the light transmission influence, so that the energy consumption of the urban illumination street lamp is effectively managed and optimized, and the purposes of saving energy, reducing emission, improving the illumination effect and reducing the energy consumption cost are achieved.

title_en: Distributed photovoltaic virtual data acquisition and characteristic analysis method, system and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed photovoltaic virtual data acquisition and characteristic analysis method, a system and equipment, and belongs to the technical field of electric power, wherein the method comprises dividing subareas based on a clustering analysis result of target acquisition area information, scoring photovoltaic power station information in the subareas to obtain a first score, and determining a marker post power station in the subareas according to the scoring result; determining a data transmission sequence according to the data scoring result and the first scoring result; according to the data scoring result, the real-time bandwidth and the communication delay, adjusting the sampling frequency; establishing a plurality of prediction models through the data of the marker post power station, and carrying out weighted average on a plurality of first prediction results to serve as a final prediction result of the prediction target; comparing the actual data with the predicted result at regular intervals; and updating the prediction model and the weight of each prediction model according to the comparison result, so that the efficiency and accuracy of data acquisition, the high efficiency and stability of data transmission and the accuracy and adaptability of the prediction model are improved.

title_en: Blower life prediction and fault analysis detection system based on ensemble learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of blower maintenance, in particular to a blower life prediction and fault analysis detection system based on ensemble learning. The invention comprises a data collection module, a data storage module, a data classification module, a data calling module, a data comparison module and a result analysis module. Through quantization fault data and parameter, conveniently come the quick judgement fault cause through detecting fault data, avoid dismantling mechanical trouble, improve the accurate assurance of fault inquiry simultaneously, the convenience is to the symptomatic medicine, fast to the processing of handling of air-blower equipment trouble, study the fault data of gathering through the integrated study mode, make the maintenance equipment more accurate judge the fault and take place the reason, help the maintenance personnel to overhaul fast, and give corresponding reasonable maintenance scheme, synthesize various numerical values and synthesize judgement equipment life, make things convenient for the maintenance personnel to replace equipment in time, avoid scrapping the influence and use.

title_en: Prediction result conversion method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a prediction result conversion method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining prediction results of target services corresponding to a plurality of data samples, wherein the prediction results of the plurality of data samples are obtained based on a prediction model; constructing target distribution which is accordant with evaluation data according to a target evaluation interval and a target duty ratio corresponding to the target evaluation interval; constructing an accumulated distribution corresponding to each evaluation data in the target evaluation interval based on the target distribution, wherein the accumulated distribution represents the corresponding relation between each evaluation data and the accumulated duty ratio in all the evaluation intervals; and mapping each prediction result to the target distribution according to the accumulated distribution, and obtaining evaluation data of each prediction result according to the target distribution. The embodiment of the specification can improve the conversion efficiency and simplify the conversion step.

title_en: Visual information data processing system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention provides a visual information data processing system based on the Internet of things, which comprises a processor for executing database operation and a memory for storing database script language codes; an extended control structure for implementing complex logic decisions and flow control; data processing functions for performing advanced data aggregation, transformation, and analysis operations. The database system is optimized for high concurrency and large data volume environments, a multi-core processor architecture, a high-speed memory and an efficient data transmission mechanism are used, high performance and low delay in the process of processing large-scale data operation are ensured, the instantaneity and the flexibility of processing the data of the Internet of things are enhanced, and the system can better adapt to the rapidly-changing data processing requirements.

title_en: Cell detection method and cell detection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cell detection method and a cell detection system, which relate to the technical field of cell detection and effectively improve the efficiency, accuracy and intelligent level of cell detection by optimizing various measures such as experiment plans, intelligent channel management, accurate evaluation of cell parameters, intelligent distribution of detection channels, adjustment of detection structure combination and the like. The method not only provides higher-quality cell detection service for target enterprises, but also is beneficial to optimizing resource utilization and improving experimental efficiency, brings important technical progress and application prospect to the fields of cell research and medical diagnosis, intelligently distributes detection channels according to comprehensive performance evaluation coefficients, ensures that each cell sample can be properly detected and focused, improves the comprehensiveness and efficiency of detection, adjusts the structural combination of the detection channels, further optimizes the detection scheme, and improves the sensitivity and operability of detection.

title_en: Thermal power plant wastewater treatment method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of thermal power plant wastewater, in particular to a thermal power plant wastewater treatment method and system. Comprising the following steps: establishing a plurality of wastewater subareas, and generating pollution evaluation values according to historical parameters of the wastewater subareas; setting the circulation grade and the monitoring time node of each wastewater subarea according to the pollution evaluation value, and acquiring the water quality monitoring parameters of the wastewater subareas according to the monitoring time node; and establishing a wastewater control model among the wastewater subareas, and setting wastewater treatment parameters of the wastewater subareas according to the wastewater control model and the water quality monitoring parameters. A plurality of waste water points are set according to the process flow of the thermal power plant, the waste water pollution degree of each waste water point is classified and divided, water in the thermal power plant is uniformly managed, the discharge amount of waste water in the whole range of the plant area is reduced, and therefore the water cost of the thermal power plant is reduced.

title_en: Preparation method of semiconductor chip with asymmetric geometric structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of semiconductor chips, in particular to a preparation method of a semiconductor chip with an asymmetric geometric structure. Firstly, acquiring chip images under different angles, wherein each chip image is divided into at least two sub-blocks uniformly; combining chip images corresponding to the same chip under different angles to obtain a target image; acquiring a cutter path cutting time and an overheat temperature coefficient corresponding to a chip image; and inputting the chip image, the cutter path cutting time and the overheat temperature coefficient into a trained expert model, and judging the quality of chip arrangement corresponding to the chip image. The preparation method provided by the embodiment of the invention determines the angle and the gesture and the comprehensive arrangement mode by analyzing the surface reflection characteristics of the semiconductor chip, thereby optimizing the arrangement condition of the chip.

title_en: Intelligent approval decision-making system
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of data processing, and provides an intelligent approval decision-making system, which comprises: the flow creation module is used for the applicant to create an initial approval flow and determine approval information; the flow auditing module is used for auditing the initial approval flow by an auditor in an auditing department to obtain a final approval flow; the flow application module is used for filling in the approval content by the applicant to obtain an approval form and enabling the approval form to follow the final approval flow to be approved; the application approval module is used for assisting an approver of an approval department to approve the approval form in the final approval process. The application provides an intelligent approval decision-making system, which is used for realizing the technical effect of providing various approval processes and solving the technical problem that the existing approval processes are relatively fixed and single.

title_en: Method and system for constructing multi-cloud scheduling capability
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for constructing multi-cloud scheduling capability, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring service requirements of networks with different domain names; generating a CDN link by the same network resource according to the service requirements of networks with different domain names through a scheduler; the network with different domain names obtains network resources with own service demands through CDN links. According to the invention, the business requirements of websites with different domain names can be freely combined to generate a CDN link, then the network resources with the business requirements are obtained from the CDN link according to the authority information of each website, the same network resource only needs to be assigned with one business requirement, and then the same network resource with different business requirements is obtained from the same CDN link through the authority of each website, so that multiple resource transmission is not needed, and the development iteration cost is reduced.

title_en: Special transformer terminal user shunt load power reporting, monitoring and managing system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of reporting and supervising of shunt load power of a special transformer terminal, and relates to a monitoring and managing system of shunt load power of a special transformer terminal user.
