The invention is helpful to find and solve potential electric power problems in time by analyzing the abnormal condition of each special change terminal user corresponding to each electric power shunt on the current date, is helpful to reduce the investigation time and improve the maintenance efficiency, is helpful to avoid the erroneous judgment of the problem caused by data errors by obtaining each special change terminal user corresponding to each mark electric power shunt on the current month, is helpful to prolong the service life of equipment, reduce the failure rate and improve the stability and reliability of the system, is helpful to ensure the stable operation of an electric power system by obtaining the actual electric load reporting data of each special change terminal user of the month to be reported, is helpful to optimize the configuration of electric power resources, reduce the energy waste, is helpful to promote the scientificity and the effectiveness of electric power management and promote the sustainable development of the electric power industry.

title_en: Constant volume gas reservoir recovery ratio calculation method based on reserve analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to a constant volume gas reservoir recovery ratio calculation method based on reserve analysis, which comprises the following steps: obtaining basic parameters of a constant volume gas reservoir; calculating a gas reservoir plane sweep coefficient, a vertical sweep coefficient and a gas-expelling efficiency based on the acquired gas reservoir basic parameters; and calculating the gas reservoir recovery ratio based on the obtained plane sweep factor, the obtained vertical sweep factor and the obtained gas-expelling efficiency. The invention comprehensively considers reserves and the differences of the reserves of the gas reservoir region, the utilization region and the sweep region, not only can determine the value of the recovery ratio of the gas reservoir, but also can determine the plane sweep coefficient, the vertical sweep coefficient and the gas-expelling efficiency which influence the recovery ratio; the method can be used for calculation of the recovery ratio of the gas reservoir and explanation of the cause of the recovery ratio of the gas reservoir.

title_en: Method, medium and device for solving imaging quality degradation under high electromagnetic environment
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a medium and a device for solving the problem of imaging quality degradation in a high electromagnetic environment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: shooting a texture image of a hydropower station, and acquiring shooting position coordinates and electromagnetic field strength; when the first neural network is used for judging that the image overlapping degree and the definition of the texture image meet the requirements, respectively carrying out laser scanning on the hydropower station by using a three-dimensional laser scanning system, obtaining a point cloud image of a hydropower station target object through a second neural network, and measuring scanning position coordinates and electromagnetic field strength; when the integrity and the density of the point cloud image are judged to meet the requirements by utilizing the third neural network, extracting characteristic points from the texture image and the point cloud image respectively, and determining homonymous characteristic points; and constructing a mapping relation between the texture image and the point cloud image according to the homonymous feature points, thereby obtaining the real-scene three-dimensional model of the hydropower station. The invention utilizes the neural network to judge the quality of the texture image and the point cloud image, and solves the problem of imaging quality degradation under high electromagnetic field intensity.

title_en: Multi-module electromechanical teaching intelligent management platform
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electromechanical teaching intelligent management, and particularly discloses a multi-module electromechanical teaching intelligent management platform, which comprises the following components: the course data importing module ensures accurate importing of circuit diagrams and error-prone point information, the operation data acquiring module acquires student real-time operation videos in real time to acquire key operation data, the wiring accuracy analyzing module analyzes wiring accuracy of students deeply, the wiring mastering degree analyzing module evaluates wiring skills of the students, the error wiring labeling module accurately labels errors to generate reports, the circuit energizing judging module judges circuit states according to accuracy, the student operation evaluating module comprehensively evaluates the student real-time operation skills to achieve skill grading and teaching fitness analysis, and finally, the teacher teaching feedback module feeds evaluation results back to teachers to assist teaching optimization.

title_en: Water supply network optimal scheduling method and system based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of water supply network management and discloses a water supply network optimal scheduling method and system based on data analysis, wherein the method comprises the steps of dividing a water supply network into a plurality of target areas, and arranging a plurality of groups of detection points on the network in the target areas to collect water supply quantity, water pressure, flow data and water quality data; acquiring historical water consumption and population data in a target area, inputting the historical water consumption and population data into a pre-trained predicted water consumption model, and outputting predicted water consumption of the target area; adjusting the water supply amount of the target area according to the water supply scheduling strategy according to the predicted water consumption; according to the water pressure data, the flow data and the water quality data, calculating and obtaining a water supply quality index of a target area after water supply quantity adjustment, combining the water supply quality index with the actual water consumption to obtain water supply abnormality degree, comparing the water supply abnormality degree with a water supply abnormality threshold interval, and judging that the current state of the target area is abnormal water supply, normal water supply or pipe network fault according to a comparison result.

title_en: Information processing method, apparatus, device, storage medium, and program product
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides an information processing method, apparatus, device, storage medium, and program product, which can be applied to the information technology field and the financial field. The information processing method comprises the following steps: responding to the triggering of a first timing task, screening M pieces of transaction information to be processed to obtain P pieces of first transaction information, wherein M is a positive integer greater than or equal to 2, P is less than or equal to M, and P is a positive integer; responding to the triggering of a second timing task, and determining second transaction information according to Q pieces of residual transaction information, wherein Q is a positive integer, and the residual transaction information is related to the transaction information to be processed; and determining an information processing result according to the P pieces of first transaction information and the P pieces of second transaction information.

title_en: Airport engineering wisdom energy management and control platform
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of energy management and control, and provides an airport engineering intelligent energy management and control platform which comprises an access layer, a data layer, an application layer and a display layer; the access layer is used for carrying out data butt joint with the energy subsystem and collecting energy information of water, gas and electricity meters, operation of charging vehicles, flights and passengers; the data layer is used for acquiring the energy information acquired by the access layer, and carrying out standardized processing on the data of the energy information to obtain standardized processed energy data; the application layer is used for carrying out energy monitoring, energy regulation and control, energy analysis and operation management on the subsystem of the access layer based on the standardized energy data; and the display layer is used for supporting the display of the WEB end, the mobile end and the large screen of the energy management and control platform on the basis of the BIM light engine. The energy management and control platform can formulate a corresponding energy saving strategy according to the energy use condition of the airport, and can intelligently find an energy saving space so as to achieve the aim of saving energy of the airport.

title_en: Wind turbine generator operation monitoring method and system based on big data AI algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind turbine generator operation monitoring method and system based on a big data AI algorithm, which relate to the technical field of data analysis and comprise the following steps: the target wind turbine generator is interacted to obtain output power related information; synchronizing to an output power prediction model to predict the output power, and obtaining a real-time power prediction result; pre-constructing an associated fault identification sub-network; obtaining real-time output power information; if the real-time output power information does not meet the real-time power prediction result, calling the operation parameters of the equipment to obtain K operation time sequence data of K units forming the equipment; and mapping and synchronizing the K operation time sequence data to a plurality of associated fault recognition channels of the associated fault recognition sub-network to obtain an operation fault monitoring result. The method solves the technical problems that the running state of the wind turbine generator cannot be accurately monitored and then the fault identification cannot be accurately carried out in the prior art, and achieves the technical effects of comprehensively and accurately monitoring the running state of equipment and timely finding potential faults.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for recording instant inventory data in ERP product
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a medium for recording instant inventory data in an ERP product. The method comprises the following steps: designing an instant inventory background table according to at least one relevant parameter of the instant inventory data; setting instant stock record time parameters by sub-organizations; configuring rules of the field mapping of the instant inventory background table; processing billing logic to record the on-demand inventory data via the on-demand inventory background table. According to the scheme, the instant stock data used for inquiry are stored in each column in one table in a scattered manner, so that the inquiry speed is greatly accelerated, particularly the speed of selecting the instant stock during the delivery is greatly accelerated, and the quick delivery is facilitated; the calculation method for adjusting the data of each column in the instant inventory by the system parameters is suitable for different business scenes for recording the instant inventory data, the client requirements are met to the maximum extent, the expansion requirements for secondary development are met, the configuration of field mapping is provided, and the newly added fields of the user can be counted in the instant inventory data.

title_en: Intelligent agricultural planting control method and system based on cloud computing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloud computing-based intelligent agricultural planting control method and system, and relates to the technical field of intelligent agricultural control. According to the intelligent agricultural planting control method and system based on cloud computing, by setting the data acquisition module, the crop disease and pest analysis module, the crop planting analysis module, the crop environment analysis module and the user control module, the crop disease and pest control index, the crop planting control index and the crop environment control index are computed, accurate monitoring and management of the crop growth environment can be achieved, a user is helped to better know the crop growth condition and the environment, and accordingly targeted management measures are adopted, intelligent and accurate management of agricultural production can be achieved, crop yield and quality are improved, meanwhile, a data visual analysis report is provided for the user, and the user is helped to know trends and rules of agricultural production.

title_en: Multi-card multi-binding method, device and system based on 5G message
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-card multi-binding method, a device and a system based on 5G information, which relate to the technical field of 5G information and can be used in the technical field of finance, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving customer information and card information of at least one card; the client information and the card information are sent by a 5G message processing node according to a bank signing node related to a card in a card binding application after the identity of the client is verified successfully, and the card binding application is sent by a 5G client; checking card information according to the client information; transmitting the customer information and the checked card information to at least one payment mechanism node; checking the passed card information to confirm the binding condition of the card at the payment mechanism node, wherein the binding condition is used for the 5G client to obtain a new card binding requirement; and generating a binding protocol of each card according to the new card binding requirement, and sending the binding protocol to a payment mechanism to be bound of each card for carrying out card binding operation. The invention has the advantages of good data safety and reliability and high binding efficiency.

title_en: Printing control method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a printing control method and a printing control system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a printing pattern and a printing requirement of a user; generating a printing preview image based on the printing pattern, the printing requirement and a preset preview template; displaying the print preview to a user; when the user confirms the print preview, generating a print job based on the print pattern and the print requirement; and issuing the printing task to a printing site. According to the printing control method and system, a user can input printing patterns and printing requirements, and can check and confirm the printing preview images on line, after the user confirms, the system generates a printing task and sends the printing task to a printing site, a printing company does not need to be contacted by the user, the printing patterns and the printing requirements which need to be printed are abutted, the printing order is carried out on line and remotely, and convenience of the user is greatly improved.

title_en: Resource management method, device, related equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a resource management method, a device, related equipment, a storage medium and a program product, wherein the resource management method comprises the following steps: responding to a resource transfer request of a target server, and acquiring a resource transfer subscription record corresponding to a first user identifier, wherein the resource transfer request comprises the first user identifier and a first resource quantity; determining a first transfer service template corresponding to the resource transfer subscription record; if the resource transfer quota function of the first transfer service template is started, acquiring a first resource transfer quota from the resource transfer subscription record; and under the condition that the first resource quantity is matched with the first resource transfer allowance, executing resource transfer operation based on the first user identification and the first resource quantity, and sending a resource transfer result to the target server.

title_en: Vehicle ash removal hidden danger prediction method, device, equipment and medium based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of application of vehicle networking data and discloses a vehicle dust removing hidden danger prediction method, device, equipment and medium based on big data, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring historical dust removing data of different vehicles, carrying out data analysis, and determining dust removing hidden danger thresholds corresponding to different vehicle types and the accumulated influence weight of different vehicle parameters on particulate matters under the vehicle types; the method comprises the steps of obtaining the type of the target vehicle corresponding to the target vehicle and target data corresponding to the last ash removal, determining the corresponding ash removal hidden danger threshold value and influence weight, calculating the ash removal hidden danger score of the target vehicle according to the corresponding target data and influence weight, and determining the next ash removal time of the target vehicle according to the magnitude relation between the grade and the ash removal hidden danger threshold value corresponding to the target vehicle.

title_en: Active order service system and method
abstract_en: The application provides an active service system and method of order, the system includes: the supply chain subsystem is configured to monitor orders according to preset active service conditions; the service subsystem is configured to create a logistics hosting task for the order when the order meets the active service condition according to the monitoring result of the supply chain subsystem, and send out an order monitoring instruction based on the logistics hosting task; and the digital warehouse subsystem is configured to respond to the order monitoring instruction to monitor the state of the order and synchronize the state of the order to the service subsystem. According to some embodiments, the status information of the order is actively monitored and tracked, and the status of the order is timely notified to the user after the status of the order is changed, so that the frequency of the user needing to actively acquire the status information of the order is reduced.

title_en: Method for screening power load characteristics of large industrial users
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial electric loads, and particularly discloses a method for screening electric load characteristics of large industrial users, which comprises the following steps of S-1: collecting various equipment power load parameters used by large users of industrial electricity, constructing an original power data set, preprocessing the data, and dividing the data set into a training set and a testing set; s-2: according to the data quality and the power load characteristics of the power load parameters, extracting time-frequency domain characteristics of the original power data; by more comprehensive data acquisition, a large amount of time-frequency domain features are extracted, so that the characteristics of the power load can be comprehensively known from multiple dimensions, and the comprehensiveness is helpful for more accurately describing complex load fluctuation and modes; better predictability, the multidimensional time-frequency domain features provide stronger predictability, so that the future load demand can be predicted more accurately, and the scheduling and planning of power supply are facilitated; more comprehensive data records are ensured by a large number of feature extractions.

title_en: Method, apparatus, device, medium, and program product for extracting feature data
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, equipment, a medium and a program product for extracting characteristic data; the method comprises the following steps: generating a directed acyclic graph based on the preconfigured feature description file, wherein the directed acyclic graph comprises a plurality of root nodes and a plurality of leaf nodes with dependency relationships in the feature extraction process; filling object data and article data to be processed into at least one root node, and updating an invasiveness value of at least one leaf node depending on the root node; generating tasks corresponding to the leaf nodes with zero input values, and writing the tasks corresponding to the leaf nodes into a ready queue; executing tasks corresponding to the leaf nodes in the ready queue to obtain output characteristic data of the leaf nodes, and writing the output characteristic data of the leaf nodes into a completion queue; and responding to the fact that the number of ready tasks of the ready queue is the same as the number of completed tasks of the completion queue, and taking the output characteristic data in the ready queue as a characteristic extraction result. The application can ensure the consistency of the extracted feature data and improve the feature extraction efficiency.

title_en: Intelligent campus system based on student information index
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent campus system based on student information index, which comprises an acquisition end, a behavior analysis subsystem, an information tree subsystem, a triggering constellation diagram subsystem, a data storage subsystem and an information calling subsystem; the information tree and the triggering condition constellation diagram are respectively configured, a unique information calling path is formed, and only when the calling authority has corresponding information or the information itself is abnormal, the information can be permitted to be called, so that compared with direct request type calling, the information safety can be ensured, and the information is called based on student information, compared with authority type calling, the restriction on the calling end is reduced, and the information is more convenient to call.

title_en: Production monitoring method and system for high-strength anti-slip coating based on digitization
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of production monitoring, in particular to a method and a system for monitoring production of high-strength anti-slip paint based on digitization. According to the method, firstly, the distribution characteristics of the monitoring data in the sample space in the preset historical production period are analyzed, the anomaly score of the monitoring data distributed at the edge of the sample space but locally gathered is corrected by combining the deviation between the monitoring data and the quality standard, so that the anomaly detection effect on the monitoring data is improved, the quality of the coating at the current moment can be monitored abnormally according to the anomaly index of each monitoring data in the preset historical production period, and the coating production monitoring effect is improved.

title_en: Method for constructing fire hazard visualization based on satellite and radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing fire visualization based on satellites and radars, which belongs to the technical field of fire visualization and comprises the following steps: collecting data, performing primary processing on the received data, extracting relevant characteristics of fire, and mapping the analyzed data to a visual platform; according to the method, a fire disaster visualization method constructed based on satellites and radars can effectively provide comprehensive, real-time and accurate fire disaster monitoring and assessment service, the efficiency and effect of fire disaster prevention, control and emergency response can be improved, fire disaster information and geographical information are organically fused together in the method and fed back as visual information, workers can quickly and intuitively know the fire disaster information, and meanwhile, a process for generating treatment comments and a process for generating an emergency plan are further arranged in the method, so that the fire disaster can be controlled in the first time after the fire disaster occurs, the property safety of people is guaranteed, and the fire disaster control effect is improved.

title_en: Distributed new energy storage scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed new energy storage scheduling method, which relates to the technical field of distributed new energy storage scheduling and comprises the steps of collecting real-time data of a distributed new energy storage system; preprocessing the new energy storage real-time data and integrating the new energy storage real-time data into a central database; constructing a distributed new energy storage model; formulating an energy storage scheduling strategy; real-time monitoring and early warning are carried out on the new energy storage system; collating data and collecting user feedback. According to the invention, by constructing the highly flexible and intelligent energy storage scheduling model, the supply condition of the new energy and the load demand of the power grid are improved and predicted, and the optimal energy storage scheduling strategy is prepared, so that the high-efficiency utilization of the energy and the intelligent level of the system are improved.

title_en: Multi-dimensional project acceptance method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of project report acceptance, and discloses a multi-dimensional project acceptance method and device; receiving equipment project acceptance request information, generating a target acceptance material acquisition command according to the equipment project acceptance request information, and sending the target acceptance material acquisition command to an acquisition end; acquiring acceptance data information sent by an acquisition end, processing the acceptance data, and generating an equipment project report and acceptance list according to the acceptance data; approval is carried out on the equipment project report sheet, and the equipment project report sheet is submitted Application for Inspection; receiving Application for Inspection a pushing result, and judging whether the pushing result is successfully pushed or not; if yes, completing the project acceptance process; has the advantages of improving the verification accuracy and efficiency Application for Inspection.

title_en: Intelligent analysis method and system for power failure service
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of big data processing, and provides an intelligent analysis method and system for power failure service, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring weather early warning information of a preset area on the same day; acquiring a target record item of the current day from a preset first backup work order, wherein the target record item records a power failure event prediction result with weather description information corresponding to the preset region; calculating semantic similarity of the weather early warning information and the weather description information, determining that the weather early warning information is associated with the power failure event under the condition that the similarity is larger than a preset similarity threshold value, and marking the target record item; and analyzing the reason of the complaint of the power failure event based on the target record item. The intelligent analysis method and the intelligent analysis system for the outage service realize the analysis of the outage service event.

title_en: Implementation method of intelligent irrigation management system
abstract_en: The invention provides an implementation method of an intelligent irrigation management system, which comprises sensing nodes, user nodes and edge nodes, wherein the sensing nodes are distributed in an irrigation area and are used for collecting data of the irrigation area; the edge nodes and the user nodes are distributed in an irrigation edge area; the user node acquires the data acquired by the sensing node through the edge node, and the staff can quickly acquire the monitoring data of the irrigation area, such as drought degree, through the implementation method of the intelligent irrigation management system provided by the invention, so that timely irrigation is adopted, healthy growth of crops is ensured, and the stability and the sustainability of agricultural production are improved, and the intelligent irrigation management system has a wide application prospect.

title_en: Cost efficiency evaluation and optimization system based on total nitrogen treatment of sewage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cost efficiency evaluation and optimization system based on total nitrogen treatment of sewage, which relates to the technical field of cost efficiency evaluation and optimization and comprises a monitoring center, wherein the monitoring center is in communication connection with a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a data analysis module, a cost efficiency evaluation module and an optimization module; the method comprises the steps of acquiring actual data during total nitrogen treatment of sewage, storing the actual data separately, dividing the actual data acquired in different acquisition periods into real-time data and historical data, and acquiring a water quality evaluation value according to the real-time data; analyzing the water quality evaluation value to obtain the cost of the agent for treating the total nitrogen in the sewage in the current acquisition period; obtaining a cost-effective ratio according to the cost of the medicament, and generating alarm information; according to the historical data, a standard water quality evaluation prediction model is constructed, a prediction cost-effectiveness ratio is obtained, and early warning information is generated; and the accuracy of cost efficiency evaluation and optimization is greatly improved.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for matching data standard in financial industry
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment and a medium for data standard benchmarking in the financial industry, which belong to the technical field of data standard benchmarking, and the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a data dictionary to be subjected to data standard alignment of an application system as a data dictionary to be aligned, and setting an alignment mechanism for the data dictionary to be aligned; configuring tags for data standards in a data standard library and configuring tags for a to-be-aligned data dictionary of which an alignment mechanism is set; performing keyword targeting, similarity targeting and data detail targeting on the to-be-targeted data dictionary and the data standard which are configured by the completed tag according to a targeting mechanism, and generating a targeting result; inquiring data bid-matching suggestions according to the bid-matching results, and manually checking and checking the bid according to the data bid-matching suggestions. The invention unifies the data standard alignment process of the data dictionary of the application system of the financial industry, realizes the quality stability of the data standard alignment, and improves the alignment efficiency.

title_en: Virtual object generation method, computer terminal, storage medium and product
abstract_en: The application discloses a virtual object generation method, a computer terminal, a storage medium and a product. The method relates to the field of image processing in the field of data processing, and comprises the following steps: capturing a first entity image of a biological object in a physical environment and a second entity image of a target object, wherein the target object is skin information to be covered on the surface of the biological object; determining a first key point appointed in a first entity image and a second key point appointed in a second entity image, wherein the first key point and the second key point have an association relation; generating a virtual object in a virtual environment based on the first entity image, the second entity image, the first key point and the second key point by using an image generation model, wherein the virtual object is used for representing an object covered with a target object on the surface of the biological object. The application solves the technical problems that the image effect generated by the virtual fitting technology is poor and the fitting requirement of consumers cannot be met.

title_en: Energy storage system operation mode and optimal scheduling method for power system requirements
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy storage system optimization, and particularly discloses an energy storage system operation mode and an optimal scheduling method for power system requirements, wherein the method comprises the following steps: predicting the power generation power of the new energy station and the market demand load, and analyzing to obtain an expected power capacity margin assessment index of the power system; evaluating the market price level and the energy storage state level, and comprehensively analyzing to obtain an energy storage system operation benefit evaluation index; and analyzing to obtain an integrated decision index of the energy storage system according to the expected power capacity margin evaluation index of the power system and the operation benefit evaluation index of the energy storage system, and regulating and controlling the charge and discharge of the energy storage system according to the integrated decision index of the energy storage system. According to the invention, the charge and discharge benefits of the energy storage system are analyzed from three angles of the power generation side, the market side and the energy storage side, the charge and discharge states of the energy storage system are comprehensively regulated, the utilization rate of power generation equipment is improved, and the operation cost of the energy storage system is reduced.

title_en: Learning material sharing method based on cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of learning material sharing. The invention relates to a learning material sharing method based on a cloud platform. Which comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a cloud platform for learning material sharing through a communication protocol at a school network server, accessing a teacher data management end, and opening auditing rights for a teacher user at the cloud platform; the learning materials uploaded by the teacher user are combined with the knowledge graph to extract keywords, so that the learning materials are conveniently displayed according to the search vocabulary entry of the student user, the requirements of students are met, after the student user views the learning materials, the note materials can be directly uploaded, the learning efficiency of other students in consulting the learning materials is improved, the teacher is required to review the note materials, the note material quality is guaranteed, and the note materials are updated continuously, so that one piece of learning materials has various different note materials, and the sharing quality of the learning materials is improved.

title_en: Method and system for monitoring business operation state based on carbon emission and related equipment thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of enterprise supervision, and discloses an enterprise operation state monitoring method, system and related equipment based on carbon emission, wherein the total product quantity and total energy consumption of a production enterprise are obtained to calculate the carbon emission of unit products, and then the financial data of the production enterprise is synthesized to score the operation state of the production enterprise, so that the carbon emission condition of the production enterprise can be effectively brought into the enterprise operation state monitoring process, and a reference basis is provided for the economic development of jurisdictions of supervision institutions and the reasonable setting of a comprehensive carbon emission management scheme.

title_en: Patent authorization method and system based on competition cooperation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of information processing, in particular to a patent authorization method and system based on competition cooperation. Step S1, constructing a competition cooperation structure of a manufacturer i and a manufacturer j; step S2, defining three patent authorization scenes; step S3, defining variables for judging the authorized scene; step S4, no matter what the market share, the product substitution and the production cost advantage are, a unidirectional authorization scene is not selected; step S5, selecting a competition scene or a cross-authorization scene when the production cost advantage of the manufacturer i is smaller or larger; step S6, when the production cost advantage of the manufacturer i is moderate, selecting a competition scene or a cross-authorization scene. Aiming at the problem that manufacturers lack patent authorization decision methods under the existing competition cooperation background, the invention provides a competition cooperation-based patent authorization method and system, which take competition cooperation as the background and improve the optimal decision of the manufacturers under different scenes and the balanced analysis capability among different modes.

title_en: Training method and device for large language model in vertical field of E-commerce
abstract_en: The invention provides a large language model training method and device in the vertical field of electronic commerce, and relates to the technical field of large language models. The training method comprises the steps of S1, acquiring a pre-training data set. And S2, verifying performance of the open-source large language model under different classification data proportions according to the pre-training data set, and obtaining a first data proportion. S3, continuously pre-training the existing open-source large language model by using LoRA method according to the data proportion and the pre-training data set to obtain the base model. S4, acquiring a fine adjustment data set of the base model. And S5, verifying performance of the base model under different fine adjustment data classification ratios according to the fine adjustment data set, and obtaining a second data ratio. S6, performing multi-task integrated instruction fine adjustment on the base model according to the second data proportion and the fine adjustment data set to obtain a fine adjustment model. And S7, optimizing through manual reinforcement learning according to the fine tuning model to obtain a final E-commerce vertical field large language model.

title_en: Logistics order receiving address preference setting method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of logistics, in particular to a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for setting preference of a logistics order receiving address, which comprise the steps of obtaining user information of a registered user and obtaining corresponding receiving address data according to the user information; performing data preprocessing on the receipt address data to form a standard address database; performing preference analysis on the standard address database based on a preference analysis algorithm to obtain preference characteristics of the recipient address of the user; generating a recommendation list based on a recommendation algorithm and the recipient address preference feature; acquiring operation preference data of a user according to the user information, and generating address setting display information according to the operation preference data and a recommendation list; acquiring an address setting instruction according to the address setting display information; the method can preset the recommendation list of the receiving address according to the receiving preference and the use preference of the user, so that the user can conveniently and quickly complete the setting of the receiving address.

title_en: Student classroom behavior supervision method, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a student class behavior supervision method, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of defining class scenes, recording student seat information in the class scenes, and obtaining the information of students on each seat in class; the method comprises the steps of determining correction scores of each frame, determining a first concentration score, a second concentration score, a third concentration score, a fourth concentration score, a first fatigue score and a second fatigue score according to the information of each student in the seat, determining the concentration score of each student in the seat according to the information of each student in the seat and the four concentration scores, determining the fatigue score of each student in the seat according to the first fatigue score and the second fatigue score, determining a student class performance criterion score according to the correction scores, the concentration score and the fatigue score of each student in the seat, and determining whether the student class performance of each seat is abnormal according to the student class performance criterion score.

title_en: Statistical analysis system based on intelligent substation operation data management and control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of data processing, in particular to a statistical analysis system based on intelligent substation operation data management and control, which comprises the following components: each item of parameter data of the transformer substation is collected periodically or according to needs through a data collection module, in a data segmentation module, each item of parameter is subjected to fine segmentation by utilizing a sliding window track algorithm, target segments with statistical analysis value are screened out, a data calculation module comprehensively evaluates the comprehensive abnormal degree and fluctuation coefficient of each target segment and distributes a preferred degree value for each target segment, a data compression and storage module uses the preferred degree of each target segment as a screening basis, target segments are selected for compression storage in a targeted manner, the accuracy of data compression is improved, the storage space is saved, and effective statistics and analysis of operation data of the intelligent transformer substation can be realized.

title_en: Information recommendation method, device, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The information recommendation method, the information recommendation device, the electronic equipment and the medium can be applied to the technical field of big data and the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: responding to the target client to carry out money transfer business transaction, and identifying the identity information of the target client; responding to the passing of the identity identification of the target client, and acquiring target money transfer service data and target client portraits corresponding to the target client; obtaining a target customer money transfer tendency label based on the target customer representation; dividing and judging business guest groups based on the target customer remittance tendency labels; responding to the fact that the target client belongs to a cross-border business client group, and predicting a cross-border money transfer key element by utilizing a pre-constructed information prediction model to obtain cross-border money transfer snapshot information; and recommending the cross-border money transfer snapshot to the target client based on the cross-border money transfer snapshot information.

title_en: Enterprise environmental health risk classification method and system based on environmental monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise environmental health risk grading method and system based on environmental monitoring, and relates to the technical field of environmental monitoring. According to the technical scheme, the risk source concentration is divided into different levels according to the degree of influence on health, the grading boundary concentration of the sudden atmospheric pollution risk source to be monitored is obtained, the concentration of each sudden atmospheric pollution risk source in different areas of an enterprise to be monitored is collected in real time at a fixed time interval t, a sudden atmospheric pollution risk source concentration prediction model is constructed, when the next time interval t of the current state is obtained according to the model, the sudden atmospheric pollution risk source concentration prediction value in any area is obtained, the risk grade type of each area in the enterprise to be monitored is divided according to the obtained grading boundary concentration and the obtained risk source concentration prediction value, the future trend of the environmental state health risk of the enterprise is evaluated, and the influence range and the influence degree of the risk event are reduced when the sudden atmospheric environmental pollution event occurs.

title_en: Intelligent planning method and system for storage yard
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent coordination of a storage yard, in particular to an intelligent planning method and system of the storage yard, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source information of a port yard through a bulk dry bulk wharf overall process intelligent management and control system; establishing a port information optimization model, and optimizing port yard multisource information by using the port information optimization model to obtain a yard planning data set; constructing a port cargo handling analysis model based on a storage yard planning data set, and analyzing port cargo handling conditions through the port cargo handling analysis model; acquiring a port comprehensive information set according to a yard planning data set, and establishing a port yard planning model by combining the port comprehensive information set and port cargo dredging conditions; and realizing intelligent planning of bulk dry bulk cargo wharf yards by using a port yard planning model. According to the method, the relevant model is constructed by utilizing port information, intelligent planning can be rapidly and accurately carried out on the port yard, planning time is shortened, and yard management efficiency and planning effect are improved.

title_en: Industrial big data application scene construction method combining three-dimensional digital twin model
abstract_en: The invention relates to an industrial big data application scene construction method combining a three-dimensional digital twin model, which comprises the following steps: three-dimensional digital twin models of reservoirs, buildings, hydroelectric generating sets, electrical equipment facilities and auxiliary facilities of the hydropower station are built in a classified mode; the method comprises the steps of connecting with an industrial Internet platform of a hydropower station, and extracting hydropower industrial big data; designing and developing an industrial three-dimensional scene of the hydropower station; establishing a three-dimensional engine which accords with the actual characteristics of the hydropower station, a twin model of the hydropower station and the data format requirements of industrial big data of the hydropower station; establishing a data exchange interface compatible with a three-dimensional engine in a data format of a hydroelectric three-dimensional digital twin model; scene-based hydropower stations and simulated simulations of reservoirs. The invention realizes the simulation of the hydropower station and the reservoir based on the scene and the real-time display and summarization of the operation and maintenance data of the hydropower station based on the three-dimensional application scene, improves the digital level of the hydropower station, and is beneficial to improving the management working efficiency and the safety level of the hydropower station.

title_en: Method, equipment and system for calling foreign exchange derivative estimation data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, equipment and a system for calling foreign exchange derivative valuation data, and relates to the technical field of data request and calling processing. The method comprises the steps of extracting estimation data in a mechanism, constructing an estimation index library, obtaining estimation service request information of a requesting party user, optimizing request parameters to obtain optimized request parameters, inquiring the estimation index library by using the optimized request parameters to obtain matched estimation data results, integrating the obtained estimation data results to obtain integrated estimation information, and returning the integrated estimation information to the requesting party once, wherein the integrated processing is carried out on common data and non-common data based on field characteristics of the data. The invention can realize that a single call returns the data result of the multi-valuation scene, increases the data call and processing efficiency and reduces the burden of the system.

title_en: Man-machine collaborative scene security understanding method based on process supervision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a man-machine cooperative scene security understanding method based on process supervision, which comprises the following steps: determining scene security cognition and grading standards; constructing a scene security understanding data set based on process supervision; performing supervision fine tuning on the open-source large language model according to the data set; generating data for human comparison according to the supervised fine tuning model, and generating a human process feedback data set; and performing process supervision training on the reward model according to the data set fed back by the human. The invention is based on a process supervision mode, so that the model is aligned with human beings in the thinking process, an accurate scene security cognition result can be obtained in the actual implementation process, meanwhile, the influence judgment of the model on the security of each entity and the relation between the entities in the scene is provided, and the interpretation of the result is improved.

title_en: Planning method and device
abstract_en: A planning method and device are used for selecting a planning path with optimal rationality from a plurality of planning paths. In the present application, the method comprises: determining N planning paths according to the K order groups; for a first planned path of the N planned paths, performing the following operations: determining a first distribution sequence of an order group in which the first order is located in K order groups and a second distribution sequence of the first order in M orders according to the first planning path; inputting the first delivery sequence and the second delivery sequence into a time prediction model to obtain the predicted delivery time of the first order; the predicted arrival time of the first order is not associated with the predicted arrival time of the previous order of the first order; determining an evaluation result of the first planning path according to the estimated delivery time of M orders corresponding to the first planning path; and sending the optimal planning path in the N planning paths to the terminal of the rider according to the evaluation result of the first planning path.

title_en: Distribution equipment defect and fault risk conversion association analysis method
abstract_en: According to the correlation analysis method of the power distribution equipment defects and the fault risk conversion, corresponding historical fault data are generated in defect detail data by establishing correlation rules of the defects and the faults according to the corresponding relations of the historical defect discovery time and the fault discovery time and the corresponding relations of the historical defect equipment and the fault equipment, so that a defect and fault correlation library is formed.

title_en: Upstream and downstream industrial chain collaborative level analysis method based on power data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power data analysis, in particular to an upstream and downstream industrial chain collaborative level analysis method based on power data; the abnormal month electricity consumption of each enterprise is identified by utilizing a trusted interval and corrected, so that the accuracy of the finally obtained first month electricity consumption data is ensured, the stability of the business electricity consumption of the enterprise in an industrial chain is gradually determined by calculating the stability, the trend difference degree, the mutual stability and the total stability, stable enterprises are selected, adverse effects of partial enterprises with poor operation or large business fluctuation on the evaluation of the upstream and downstream coordination level of the industrial chain are eliminated, and finally the coordination level is finally calculated by stabilizing the first electricity consumption data of the enterprises; the problem that when a certain enterprise has a plurality of main business which belong to different industry chains, the power data of the enterprise is directly used for analyzing the collaboration level of the upstream and the downstream of the certain industry chain, and the error is possibly larger is solved.

title_en: Intelligent-based method and device for checking and managing two tickets of power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent-based two-ticket auditing and controlling method and device for an electric power system, which relate to the technical field of electric power two-ticket processes and comprise the steps of dividing ticket information into first information, second information, third information and a detachable two-ticket template according to the prior two-ticket information; the pre-checking result is combined with the risk characteristics and the pre-checking result to carry out risk assessment on the electronic two-ticket face information so as to confirm the risk level; determining an approval path of the electronic two tickets; after the electronic two-ticket encryption approval passes, respectively splitting the electronic two-ticket according to the information of the operators and the risk level, sending the residual ticket to the corresponding operators, and carrying out identity verification; and collecting each residual ticket, combining each residual ticket into a complete electronic two-ticket, and automatically archiving. The security of the two tickets in the auditing is improved, the ticket face information of the two tickets is displayed adaptively, and the leakage risk is reduced. The adaptability of the incomplete ticket splitting basis is ensured, and a reliable basis is provided for the safe and stable operation of the power system.

title_en: Building test block identification management method based on NFC technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a building test block identification management method based on NFC technology, and relates to the technical field of building material detection. The method comprises the steps of establishing an identification management system and carrying out identification operation, wherein the identification operation is realized based on the identification management system; establishing the identification management system includes operation a: building an identification management platform; operation B: producing an NFC identification tag; the identification operation includes step S1: manufacturing a building test block, and embedding the NFC identification tag into the building test block during manufacturing; step S2: collecting a surface image of a building test block; step S3: establishing a corresponding association relation between two-dimensional code data and appearance information on a building test block; step S4: and comparing the identified appearance information with the appearance information on the building test block real object. The invention solves the problems that in the prior art, the two-dimensional code label is easy to take off and transfer and can be imitated, so that the building test block is easy to be in a false and spurious condition, and the quality of the construction unit building material cannot be truly detected.

title_en: Data encryption method, apparatus, computer device, readable storage medium, and program product
abstract_en: The application relates to a data encryption method, a data encryption device, computer equipment, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product, which are applied to the technical field of information security. The method comprises the following steps: masking the plaintext data to be encrypted to obtain masking data; determining multiple encryption algorithms for the plaintext data according to the target characters in the mask data; and according to the multiple encryption algorithm, encrypting the plaintext data to obtain encrypted data. The method can improve the universality of the encrypted data.

title_en: Photovoltaic power generation power prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a photovoltaic power generation power prediction method and system. The photovoltaic power generation method comprises the steps of collecting real-time power generation data and real-time environment data of photovoltaic power generation, performing first data processing and second data processing on the real-time power generation data and the real-time environment data to obtain a power generation data set and an environment data set, performing feature extraction and optimization processing on the power generation data set to obtain an optimized feature set, performing analysis and quantization processing on the environment data set to obtain quantized feedback of influence of the environment data on the photovoltaic power generation, predicting photovoltaic power generation power based on the optimized feature set, and optimizing prediction of the photovoltaic power generation power based on the quantized feedback to obtain an optimized prediction result. The method solves the technical problems of low accuracy and reliability of photovoltaic power generation data processing and poor accuracy of photovoltaic power generation power prediction.

title_en: Object sequence recommendation method and device, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of sequence recommendation, and provides an object sequence recommendation method, an object sequence recommendation device, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical behavior data of a user; inputting the user historical behavior data into an object sequence recommendation model, and performing embedding processing on the user historical behavior data to obtain embedded vectors corresponding to all target objects; determining a target hidden state vector corresponding to the historical behavior data of the user according to the embedded vector corresponding to each target object and a preset query vector; performing index normalization processing on the target hidden state vector corresponding to the user historical behavior data through comparing the activation function to obtain the probability of the executed preset behavior corresponding to each target object; and sequencing each target object based on the probability of the executed preset behavior corresponding to each target object to obtain a target object recommendation sequence sent to the terminal equipment corresponding to the user, so that the accuracy and the flexibility of object sequence recommendation are improved.

title_en: Optimization adjustment method for sludge blending combustion amount of power station boiler
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimization adjustment method for sludge blending combustion amount of a power station boiler, and belongs to the technical field of new energy and environmental protection. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring real-time operation data of the sludge blending amount; according to the real-time operation data of the sludge blending combustion amount, obtaining an optimal sludge blending combustion proportion based on a pre-constructed sludge blending combustion prediction model and limiting conditions thereof; according to the optimal sludge blending combustion proportion, optimizing and adjusting the sludge blending combustion amount to obtain the optimized and adjusted optimal sludge blending combustion amount; the construction of the sludge co-combustion prediction model comprises the step of constructing the sludge co-combustion prediction model according to the acquired optimal historical data set. The invention can reduce the pollution of the sludge to the environment, improve the digestion capability of the power station boiler to the sludge, reduce the dependence of an optimization method on data and complex sampling, and provide technical support for the safe and environment-friendly incineration disposal of the sludge of the coal-fired boiler.

title_en: Method and device for judging health state of wheel
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for judging the health state of wheels, and relates to the technical field of railway wagon overhaul. The method for judging the health state of the wheels comprises the following steps: calculating a manufacturing health coefficient of the wheel at a manufacturing stage; calculating the application health coefficient of the wheel in the application stage; calculating the health state deduction items of the wheels in the overhaul stage; calculating the health status score of the wheel according to the manufacturing health coefficient of the wheel, the application health coefficient and the health status deduction item in the maintenance stage; and evaluating the health state of the wheel according to the health state score of the wheel. According to the method and the device for judging the health state of the wheel, disclosed by the invention, by adopting an automatic and digital technical means, the manual labor intensity is reduced, the overhaul efficiency and the overhaul quality are improved, the accurate analysis and evaluation of the technical state of the wheel are realized, the interference of human factors is avoided, and the accuracy and the reliability of the evaluation are improved.

title_en: Automatic expense collecting system for scientific research projects
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic expense collecting system for scientific research projects, which belongs to the technical field of financial information, and comprises a characteristic module, a frame module, a model creation module and a collecting module, wherein the financial characteristics are identified by analyzing financial data and tax policies of the scientific research projects, then rules are confirmed and a mapping frame is established, the historical data is summarized, a mapping model is created, an automatic aggregation system is built by using the model and a corresponding algorithm, an automatic mapping frame is realized, manual input errors are reduced, the accuracy of financial data is improved, financial expenditure is better predicted, information support of financial decisions is enhanced, financial management flow is simplified, and operation efficiency is improved.

title_en: High-speed rail line wind speed prediction method based on wind speed state change
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting wind speed along a high-speed rail based on wind speed state change, which comprises the steps of constructing a vector autoregressive model, dividing the historical wind speed along the rail into three areas by using a Markov state, and obtaining a corresponding wind speed sequence; based on the wind speed sequence, eliminating fragments with Hurst indexes smaller than 0.5 in the wind speed sequence based on a fluctuation function to obtain fragments with different time scales; decomposing the sequence segments with different time scales in the step S2 into intrinsic mode components by adopting a variation mode decomposition model, calculating the Hurst index of the components and classifying the components; according to the characteristics of the components, wind speed prediction is carried out by adopting different methods, and the prediction results of the different components are added to obtain the final wind speed prediction result. The invention can effectively improve the prediction accuracy.

title_en: Material compliance analysis method based on power grid infrastructure project
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid material analysis, in particular to a material compliance analysis method based on a power grid foundation project, which comprises the steps of foundation project screening, foundation project material compliance assessment, foundation project material early warning prompt, obtaining the cement pole use data of each completed foundation project, monitoring and analyzing the cement pole use condition of the power grid foundation project, screening out each analysis foundation project, and integrating the material data of each analysis foundation project and the cement pole use data, and evaluating the material use compliance of each analysis infrastructure project, comparing the material use compliance with a material use compliance interval, and finally carrying out early warning prompt on the material compliance condition of the total power grid infrastructure project, so that the problem of unreasonable material supply of the power grid infrastructure project can be timely found and solved, construction delay of the power grid infrastructure project caused by the fact that the material is not compliant is avoided, and the reliability of the follow-up power grid operation is improved by managing the material compliance use condition of the power grid infrastructure project.

title_en: Intelligent water injection control system and method for oil field
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent water injection control system and method for an oil field, which relate to the technical field of oil field water injection, wherein the system comprises water injection equipment, data acquisition and processing equipment, automatic control equipment and communication equipment, the communication equipment is respectively connected with the water injection equipment, the data acquisition and processing equipment and the automatic control equipment, the automatic control equipment is respectively connected with the water injection equipment and the data acquisition and processing equipment, the automatic control device is used for regulating and controlling the water injection device to perform corresponding water injection according to an optimization strategy, and the communication module is used for data transmission among the devices. The invention solves the problems that the existing water injection system cannot optimize and adjust parameters in time and cannot ensure the high-efficiency, energy-saving and safe operation of the system.

title_en: Dynamic feeding back calculation processing method, device and medium based on ERP system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic feeding back calculation processing method, equipment and medium based on an ERP system, belongs to the technical field of enterprise informatization ERP, and is used for solving the technical problems that the existing feeding back calculation is easy to generate deviation, is easily influenced by various uncertain factors, is difficult to accurately predict and adjust, and increases production risk. The method comprises the steps of carrying out matching query processing on a BOM table according to a target production product to obtain required material information, carrying out available inventory use judgment on the maximum available inventory for production according to an inventory result of the required material information to obtain a use result, determining the product quantity of the target production product according to the required material information if the matching result is not a checking matching result, circulating the available inventory of each required material information in the BOM table to determine the product quantity of the target production product if the matching result is a checking matching result, and generating feeding production order information based on the product quantity and the BOM table.

title_en: Automatic production system for high-strength alloy templates for building structure construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image data processing, in particular to a high-strength alloy template automatic production system for building structure construction, which can realize the following steps through mutual cooperation among a plurality of modules: acquiring a target surface image corresponding to the high-strength alloy template, and performing edge detection; carrying out analysis processing on the extension rule of the hidden crack stress in multiple directions on each edge point; determining hidden crack probability factors corresponding to non-stress points; screening candidate hidden crack points, and clustering the candidate hidden crack points and stress points; determining target hidden crack indexes corresponding to target clusters, and screening candidate hidden crack clusters; and screening out target hidden crack areas from each candidate hidden crack cluster, and carrying out automatic production on the high-strength alloy template based on all the target hidden crack areas. According to the invention, the accuracy of hidden crack defect detection of the high-strength alloy template is improved by performing image data processing on the target surface image, so that the stability of automatic production is improved.

title_en: Regional carbon emission monitoring method, regional carbon emission monitoring device, regional carbon emission monitoring equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a regional carbon emission monitoring method, a regional carbon emission monitoring device, electronic equipment, a computer program and a storage medium, wherein the regional carbon emission monitoring method comprises the steps of obtaining regional environment measurement data, constructing an edge surface fitting model according to geographical position data to obtain a measurement edge surface, calculating gas flow of the measurement edge surface according to meteorological data and the measurement edge surface, wherein the gas flow comprises gas inflow and gas outflow, and calculating carbon emission of a current measurement region according to the gas flow of the measurement edge surface. The method has the advantages that the number of the sampling points can be freely controlled, the method is suitable for various emission source types and conditions, multiple predictions can be carried out during sampling monitoring of the whole area, so that the accuracy and the robustness of the result are improved, meanwhile, the predicted value of the carbon emission can be obtained more quickly, the endurance requirement of the unmanned aerial vehicle is reduced, and the monitoring efficiency is improved.

title_en: E-commerce promotion management page display method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for displaying electronic commerce promotion management pages, wherein the method comprises the steps of respectively obtaining commodity data of all authorized stores on a plurality of electronic commerce platforms, determining promotion rule information applied to commodities of all stores, displaying promotion rule information based on interaction areas of the promotion management pages, wherein the interaction areas comprise a first interaction area and a second interaction area, the first interaction area comprises at least two interaction controls, the second interaction area displays discount information applied to commodities of all stores, the second interaction area is used for switching and displaying discount information corresponding to the interaction controls in response to a first triggering operation for the interaction controls, and the promotion management pages are used for switching and displaying promotion rule detail pages in response to a second triggering operation for target commodities located in the second interaction area, wherein the promotion rule detail pages comprise application time period graphics. The application can integrate the preferential rule information of each electronic commerce platform into the promotion management page, and improve the operation efficiency of managing and controlling commodity promotion activities by users.

title_en: Sight-guided clinical care education enhancement system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sight-guided clinical care education enhancement system, which comprises a cloud platform, a client APP and a glasses type eye movement instrument, wherein the cloud platform is connected with the client APP; the client APP comprises a new nurse APP and a nurse APP with teaching, wherein the new nurse APP comprises a data acquisition uploading module, a learning feedback module, a remote guidance module and an operation examination module; the nurse terminal APP with teaching comprises an invigilation module, a guidance feedback module and a training resource library module; the cloud platform comprises a database module, a data preprocessing module, a machine learning analysis module and a feedback generation module. According to the invention, remote guidance of a nurse with education on a new nurse is realized by using the cloud platform, so that the problem of shortage of human resources is effectively relieved; meanwhile, the cloud platform can not only guide a new nurse with a teaching nurse, but also automatically feed back data, correct the operation errors of the new nurse in time and reduce the occurrence of medical accidents; in addition, a plurality of models are also arranged for analysis, so that the system has various functions and high feedback accuracy, and can effectively process abnormal data.

title_en: Advertisement pushing method, advertisement pushing device, advertisement pushing computer equipment, advertisement pushing storage medium and advertisement pushing program product
abstract_en: The application relates to an advertisement pushing method, an advertisement pushing device, a computer device, a storage medium and a program product. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring calendar information and consumption related information of an application user; the consumption associated information at least comprises consumption capability information of an application user and area information of an area to which the application user belongs; selecting a target advertisement for the application user from the candidate advertisements according to the calendar information and the consumption association information; targeted advertising is pushed to application users. By adopting the method, the contact rate of the advertisement can be improved.

title_en: Document display method, device, apparatus, medium and program product
abstract_en: The application discloses a document display method, a device, equipment, a medium and a program product, and relates to the technical field of online documents. The method comprises the following steps: responding to the received triggering operation of the document uploading control, and displaying a document operation area; responsive to receiving a selection operation of a target document type in the at least two document type options, displaying a document creation area corresponding to the target document type; in response to receiving the send operation, the online document is sent and displayed in the group session interface. The user can establish an online document of the target document type in the document operation area, and send and display the online document in the group session interface, so that the diversity of online document sending and displaying modes in the group session interface is enriched; meanwhile, the user can quickly create a file through the file uploading control and send the file to the group session interface, so that the operation path for sending the new file in the group session interface by the user is reduced, and the sending efficiency of the online file is improved.

title_en: Big data-based power supply data processing method and device
